verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलाकारं वह्नेरण्डमिव स्थितम् |
जलेनावृतमित्याहुस्तोयेनाम्बु च मण्डलम् ||
verses.transliteration:
brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vahneraṇḍamiva sthitam |
jalenāvṛtamityāhustoyenāmbu ca maṇḍalam ||
verses.translation: The Brahmanda (cosmic egg) is sphere-shaped, like a fire-egg, resting thus. It is said to be surrounded by water, and the water-region by another element.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्ड गोलाकार (अण्डाकार) है, अग्नि के अण्ड की भाँति स्थित है। उसे जल से आवृत कहते हैं और जल-मण्डल को दूसरे तत्त्व से।
verses.commentary: The Brahmanda Purana envisions the universe as a sphere — concentric layers of elements surrounding a central reality. Written millennia before modern cosmology, this nested-sphere model is a remarkable intuition. The universe is not flat and chaotic but ordered, bounded, and layered — like an egg, the symbol of potential and completeness.
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanda Purana envisions the universe as a sphere — concentric layers of elements surrounding a central reality. Written millennia before modern cosmology, this nested-sphere model is a remarkable intuition. The universe is not flat and chaotic but ordered, bounded, and layered — like an egg, the symbol of potential and completeness.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मीनारायणो यत्र यत्र गौरीशङ्करौ |
यत्र साहित्यविद्या च तत्र भूरि सुखं नृणाम् ||
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmīnārāyaṇo yatra yatra gaurīśaṅkarau |
yatra sāhityavidyā ca tatra bhūri sukhaṃ nṛṇām ||
verses.translation: Where Lakshmi-Narayana are (prosperity with virtue), where Gauri-Shankara are (love with consciousness), and where literature and learning are — there is abundant happiness for human beings.
verses.hindi: जहाँ लक्ष्मी-नारायण हैं (समृद्धि और सत्त्व), जहाँ गौरी-शंकर हैं (प्रेम और चेतना), और जहाँ साहित्य-विद्या है — वहाँ मनुष्यों को प्रचुर सुख मिलता है।
verses.commentary: The Brahmanda Purana's complete formula for human flourishing: three elements must be present together — prosperity with integrity (Lakshmi-Narayana), devotion and consciousness (Gauri-Shankara), and learning (sahitya-vidya). Not one alone — all three. Wealth without virtue produces anxiety; devotion without learning produces superstition; learning without devotion produces arid intellectualism.
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanda Purana's complete formula for human flourishing: three elements must be present together — prosperity with integrity (Lakshmi-Narayana), devotion and consciousness (Gauri-Shankara), and learning (sahitya-vidya). Not one alone — all three. Wealth without virtue produces anxiety; devotion without learning produces superstition; learning without devotion produces arid intellectualism.

verses.sanskrit: देवी देवानां देवता देवीनां देवतानाम् | सर्वभूतानां च शक्तिः सर्वभूतानां च धारिणी ||
verses.transliteration: devī devānāṃ devatā devīnāṃ devatānām | sarvabhūtānāṃ ca śaktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ ca dhāriṇī ||
verses.translation: The Goddess is the deity of the gods, the goddess of goddesses. She is the power of all beings, and the sustainer of all beings.
verses.hindi: देवी देवताओं की देवता है, देवियों की देवी है। वह सभी प्राणियों की शक्ति है, और सभी प्राणियों की धारिणी है।
verses.commentary: The Lalita Sahasranama declares the Goddess as the power behind all powers — the deity of deities. This is the Shakta vision: every form of power, every deity, every force in nature is an expression of the supreme Shakti.
verses.wordMeaning: The Lalita Sahasranama declares the Goddess as the power behind all powers — the deity of deities. This is the Shakta vision: every form of power, every deity, every force in nature is an expression of the supreme Shakti.

verses.sanskrit: यां विन्दते सा वै शक्तिर्या वा विद्यात्मिका परा | या च कर्मात्मिका प्रोक्ता त्रिधा शक्तिः प्रतिष्ठिता ||
verses.transliteration: yāṃ vindate sā vai śaktiryā vā vidyātmikā parā | yā ca karmātmikā proktā tridhā śaktiḥ pratiṣṭhitā ||
verses.translation: That which is found is Shakti; that which is supreme knowledge; and that which is declared as action — Shakti is established in these three forms.
verses.hindi: जो प्राप्त होती है वह शक्ति है, जो परम विद्या है, और जो कर्म-स्वरूपा कही जाती है — शक्ति इन तीन रूपों में प्रतिष्ठित है।
verses.commentary: The Brahmanda Purana describes the Goddess in three modalities: as the power that makes things happen (karma-shakti), as the knowledge that illuminates (vidya-shakti), and as the supreme reality that is both (para-shakti). This threefold Shakti is not a hierarchy but a spectrum: the same energy appears as action at the grossest level, as knowledge at the intermediate level, and as pure being at the subtlest. The Lalita Sahasranama explores all three dimensions.
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanda Purana describes the Goddess in three modalities: as the power that makes things happen (karma-shakti), as the knowledge that illuminates (vidya-shakti), and as the supreme reality that is both (para-shakti). verses.sanskrit: सिन्दूरारुणविग्रहां त्रिनयनां माणिक्यमौलिस्फुरत् | तारानायकशेखरां स्मितमुखीमापीनवक्षोरुहाम् ||
verses.transliteration: sindūrāruṇaviGrahāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamauliSphurat | tārānāyakaśekharāṃ smitamukhīmāpīnavakṣoruhām ||
verses.translation: She whose form is red as sindura, who has three eyes, who wears a crown of rubies, adorned with the moon, with a smiling face and full bosom...
verses.hindi: जिनका रूप सिन्दूर के समान लाल है, तीन नेत्रों वाली, माणिक्य-मुकुट वाली, चंद्र-शिखर, मुस्कुराते मुख वाली...
verses.commentary: The Lalita Sahasranama begins with a vivid physical description of the Goddess — not as abstract philosophy but as a living, radiant presence. This approach is characteristic of the Shakta tradition: the divine is not an abstraction but a living beauty, a luminous form that can be encountered directly through love and visualization. The detailed physical description is a meditation object — a doorway into the presence.

verses.sanskrit: श्री माता श्री महाराज्ञी श्रीमत् सिंहासनेश्वरी | चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता देवकार्यसमुद्यता ||
verses.transliteration: śrī mātā śrī mahārājñī śrīmat siṃhāsaneśvarī | cidagnikuṇḍasambhūtā devakāryasamudyatā ||
verses.translation: The holy Mother, the great queen, the sovereign of the jewelled throne, born from the fire of consciousness, ever engaged in the tasks of the gods.
verses.hindi: श्री माता, श्री महाराज्ञी, रत्नसिंहासन की स्वामिनी; चिदग्निकुण्ड से उत्पन्न, देवकार्य में सदा संलग्न।
verses.commentary: The first names of the Lalita Sahasranama establish the Goddess as simultaneously the tender Mother (Mata) and the supreme sovereign ruler (Maharajni). She is born from the fire of consciousness (Cidagni-kunda) — indicating that her nature is pure awareness itself. And she is ever engaged in cosmic work (devakaryasamudyata) — the divine is not passive but perpetually active in the world.

verses.sanskrit: यो वेत्ति कालस्य गतिं स वेत्ति | क्षणं मुहूर्तं च दिनं च रात्रिम् | मासं ऋतुं संवत्सरं च युगम् | स ज्ञानी न मोहस्य वशं प्रयाति ||
verses.transliteration: yo vetti kālasya gatiṃ sa vetti | kṣaṇaṃ muhūrtaṃ ca dinaṃ ca rātrim | māsaṃ ṛtuṃ saṃvatsaraṃ ca yugam | sa jñānī na mohasya vaśaṃ prayāti ||
verses.translation: One who truly knows the movement of time — the moment, the hour, the day and night, the month, the season, the year, and the cosmic age — that one is a jnani who does not fall under the sway of delusion.
verses.hindi: जो काल की गति को जानता है — क्षण, मुहूर्त, दिन-रात, मास, ऋतु, वर्ष और युग को — वह ज्ञानी मोह के वश में नहीं जाता।
verses.commentary: The Brahmanda Purana offers an unusual path to wisdom: understanding time at all scales. From the moment (kshana) to the cosmic age (yuga), each level of time has its own rhythms, possibilities, and constraints. The person who understands these nested time cycles — biological rhythms, seasonal cycles, historical epochs — is not deluded by short-term appearances.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापादे हिरण्यगर्भोत्पत्तिवर्णनं नाम तृतीयो ऽध्याय सुत उवाच आत्मन्यवस्थिते व्यक्ते विकारे प्रतिसंहते । साधर्म्येणावतिष्ठेते प्रधानपुरुषौ तदा
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpāde hiraṇyagarbhotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāya suta uvāca ātmanyavasthite vyakte vikāre pratisaṃhate / sādharmyeṇāvatiṣṭhete pradhānapuruṣau tadā
verses.translation: These two have Tamat and Sattva gupai. They are stationed on a par with each other. Hence they are said to be mutual pursuert. They are not excetuve (in the manifestation of the Gunas) •
verses.hindi: संसार के सृजन, उसके पालन अथवा उसके संहार काल में सत्व स्वरूप वाले के लिए दारम्बार नमस्कार हैं । रजोगुण-तमोगुण और सत्व गुण के तील स्वरूप वाले भगवाद् स्वयम्भू के लिए नमस्कार है।१। जन्म न धारण करने वासे, विश्व के स्वरूप वाले, गुणों से रहित और गुणों के रूप
verses.wordMeaning: These two have Tamat and Sattva gupai. They are stationed on a par with each other. Hence they are said to be mutual pursuert. They are not excetuve (in the manifestation of the Gunas) •
verses.commentary: Sense: These two have Tamat and Sattva gupai. They are stationed on a par with each other. Hence they are said to be mutual pursuert. They are not excetuve (in the manifestation of the Gunas) •

verses.sanskrit: तमःसत्त्व गुणावेतौ समत्वेन व्यवस्थितौ । अनुद्रिक्तावनुचरौ तेन प्रोक्तौ परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tamaḥsattva guṇāvetau samatvena vyavasthitau / anudriktāvanucarau tena proktau parasparam
verses.translation: Laya (Dissolution) should be understood to occur when Gurtas are in equilibrium. It is called creation when there is predominance (of one Guna over the other.)
verses.hindi: वाले, विश्व के स्वरूप वाले, गुणों से रहित ओर गुणों के रूप वाले, लोकों के धारण करने वाले उन भगवाच हरि से जय प्राप्त किया है २६ समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Laya (Dissolution) should be understood to occur when Gurtas are in equilibrium. It is called creation when there is predominance (of one Guna over the other.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Laya (Dissolution) should be understood to occur when Gurtas are in equilibrium. It is called creation when there is predominance (of one Guna over the other.)

verses.sanskrit: गुणसाम्ये लयो ज्ञेय आधिक्ये सृष्टिरुच्यते । सत्त्ववृद्धौ स्थितिरभूद् ध्रुवं पद्म शिखास्थितम्
verses.transliteration: guṇasāmye layo jñeya ādhikye sṛṣṭirucyate / sattvavṛddhau sthitirabhūd dhruvaṃ padma śikhāsthitam
verses.translation: When Rajas closely follows and stations itself in Tamas and Sattva, it is the Rajas that causes the other things to function in the same way as in the case of the water causing the seeds to function.
verses.wordMeaning: When Rajas closely follows and stations itself in Tamas and Sattva, it is the Rajas that causes the other things to function in the same way as in the case of the water causing the seeds to function.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Rajas closely follows and stations itself in Tamas and Sattva, it is the Rajas that causes the other things to function in the same way as in the case of the water causing the seeds to function.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तमसि सत्त्वे च रजोप्यनुगतं स्थितम् । रजः प्रवर्तकं तच्च बीजेष्विव यथा जलम्
verses.transliteration: yadā tamasi sattve ca rajopyanugataṃ sthitam / rajaḥ pravartakaṃ tacca bījeṣviva yathā jalam
verses.translation: The Guas assume inequality and they become stabi* lized casually. It should be known that three (divinities) were bom out of the Guas which are agitated.
verses.hindi: लोकों के रचने बाले, सबके ज्ञाता, पराजित न होने वाले, भूत-भविष्यत् और बत्तंमान काल के प्रभु सत्पति ।३। अनृपम ज्ञान के स्वरूप और उन जगतों के स्वामी का ज्ञान, वेराग्य तथा ऐश्वयं और धम्मं ये चारों सत्पुरुषों के द्वारा सेबन करने के योग्य हैं ।४। नित्य हो भले और बुरे स्वरूप वाले.
verses.wordMeaning: The Guas assume inequality and they become stabi* lized casually. It should be known that three (divinities) were bom out of the Guas which are agitated.

verses.sanskrit: गुणा वैषम्यमासाद्य प्रसंगेन प्रतिष्ठिताः । गुणेभ्यः क्षोभ्यमाणेभ्यस्त्रयो ज्ञेया हि सादरे
verses.transliteration: guṇā vaiṣamyamāsādya prasaṃgena pratiṣṭhitāḥ / guṇebhyaḥ kṣobhyamāṇebhyastrayo jñeyā hi sādare
verses.translation: They are eternal, extremely mysterious; the souls of everyone and embodied; the Sattva qualily is ViQu; the Rajas is Brahma and the Tamas is Rudra, the Prajapati.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य के इन भावों की क्रिया के भाव के लिए ईश्वर ने फिर रचना की थी ।५। लोकों की रचना करनेःवाले और लोकों के तत्वों के ज्ञाता, योग के जानने वाले भगवान् ने योग में समास्थित होकर समस्त स्थावर (अचर) ओर जङ्गम (चर) जीवों की रचना की थी १६। पुराण के आख्यान की
verses.wordMeaning: They are eternal, extremely mysterious; the souls of everyone and embodied; the Sattva qualily is ViQu; the Rajas is Brahma and the Tamas is Rudra, the Prajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are eternal, extremely mysterious; the souls of everyone and embodied; the Sattva qualily is ViQu; the Rajas is Brahma and the Tamas is Rudra, the Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: शाश्वताः परमा गुह्याः सर्वात्मानः शरीरिणः । सत्त्वं विष्णू रजो ब्रह्मा तमो रुद्रः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: śāśvatāḥ paramā guhyāḥ sarvātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ / sattvaṃ viṣṇū rajo brahmā tamo rudraḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Visttu the enlightener and revealcr of the Rajas becomes Brahm&, and attains the status of the creator. It is from him that being of great vitality that the variety of creation of the worlds, takes its origin.
verses.hindi: इच्छा वाले मैंने व्यापक सत्पति लोकों के साक्षी विश्वकर्मा उन प्रभु की शरण ग्रहण की है ।७। र
verses.wordMeaning: Visttu the enlightener and revealcr of the Rajas becomes Brahm&, and attains the status of the creator. It is from him that being of great vitality that the variety of creation of the worlds, takes its origin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visttu the enlightener and revealcr of the Rajas becomes Brahm&, and attains the status of the creator. It is from him that being of great vitality that the variety of creation of the worlds, takes its origin.

verses.sanskrit: रजःप्रकाशकोविष्णुर्ब्रह्मस्रष्टृत्वमाप्नुयात् । जायते च यतश्चत्रा लोकसृष्टिर्महोजसः
verses.transliteration: rajaḥprakāśakoviṣṇurbrahmasraṣṭṛtvamāpnuyāt / jāyate ca yataścatrā lokasṛṣṭirmahojasaḥ
verses.translation: Viu as the enlightener and revealer of the Tamas stands separate in the from of Kala (Time).
verses.wordMeaning: Viu as the enlightener and revealer of the Tamas stands separate in the from of Kala (Time).
verses.commentary: Sense: Viu as the enlightener and revealer of the Tamas stands separate in the from of Kala (Time).

verses.sanskrit: तमःप्रकाशको विष्णुः कालत्वेन व्यवस्थितः । सत्त्वप्रकाशको विष्णुः स्थितित्वेन व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tamaḥprakāśako viṣṇuḥ kālatvena vyavasthitaḥ / sattvaprakāśako viṣṇuḥ sthititvena vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: These alone are the three worlds; these alone are the three Gunas; these alone are the three Vedas; these alone are the three sacred fires.
verses.wordMeaning: These alone are the three worlds; these alone are the three Gunas; these alone are the three Vedas; these alone are the three sacred fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: These alone are the three worlds; these alone are the three Gunas; these alone are the three Vedas; these alone are the three sacred fires.

verses.sanskrit: एत एव त्रयो लोका एत एव त्रयो गुणाः । एत एव त्रयो वेदा एत एव त्रजो ऽग्नयः
verses.transliteration: eta eva trayo lokā eta eva trayo guṇāḥ / eta eva trayo vedā eta eva trajo 'gnayaḥ
verses.translation: These have mutual interassociation; these are mutually attached; they exist by mutual help and they impel inter se.
verses.wordMeaning: These have mutual interassociation; these are mutually attached; they exist by mutual help and they impel inter se.
verses.commentary: Sense: These have mutual interassociation; these are mutually attached; they exist by mutual help and they impel inter se.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परान्वया ह्येते परस्परमनुव्रताः । परस्परेण वर्तन्ते प्रेरयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: parasparānvayā hyete parasparamanuvratāḥ / paraspareṇa vartante prerayanti parasparam
verses.translation: These are mutually coupled; these are mutually inter* dependent; these do not become separated even for a moment; they do not abandon each other.
verses.wordMeaning: These are mutually coupled; these are mutually inter* dependent; these do not become separated even for a moment; they do not abandon each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are mutually coupled; these are mutually inter* dependent; these do not become separated even for a moment; they do not abandon each other.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यं मिथुनं ह्येते अन्योन्यमुपजीविनः । क्षणं वियोगो न ह्येषां न त्यजन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: anyonyaṃ mithunaṃ hyete anyonyamupajīvinaḥ / kṣaṇaṃ viyogo na hyeṣāṃ na tyajanti parasparam
verses.translation: Though Pur&ua accepa the Sinkhya theory regarding the crea¬ tion the universe being due to the imbalance of the three Guas, the penoni- fication of the Gu in Brahmi (Rajas), Viion (Sattva) and Rudra amai) is the puranie way of praentatioo for the understanding cf the proccas by the masses.
verses.wordMeaning: Though Pur&ua accepa the Sinkhya theory regarding the crea¬ tion the universe being due to the imbalance of the three Guas, the penoni- fication of the Gu in Brahmi (Rajas),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Though Pur&ua accepa the Sinkhya theory regarding the crea¬ tion the universe being due to the imbalance of the three Guas, the penoni- fication of the Gu in Brahmi (Rajas),…

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानगुणवैषम्यात्सर्गकाले प्रवर्त्तते । अदृष्टाधिष्ठितात्पूर्वे तस्मात्सदसदात्मकात्
verses.transliteration: pradhānaguṇavaiṣamyātsargakāle pravarttate / adṛṣṭādhiṣṭhitātpūrve tasmātsadasadātmakāt
verses.translation: As a result of the unevenness of the GuqjiSj the Pra** dh&na begins to function at the time of creation. At the outset it begins to function (from that Avjfokta) of the nature o{ Sat and Asat and presided over by Adrsfa (the unmanifest).
verses.wordMeaning: As a result of the unevenness of the GuqjiSj the Pra** dh&na begins to function at the time of creation. At the outset it begins to function (from that Avjfokta) of the nature o{ Sat and Asat and presided over by Adrsfa (the unmanifest).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा बुद्धित्वमिथुनं युगपत्संबभूव ह । तस्मात्तमोव्यक्तमयं क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञकः
verses.transliteration: brahmā buddhitvamithunaṃ yugapatsaṃbabhūva ha / tasmāttamovyaktamayaṃ kṣetrajño brahmasaṃjñakaḥ
verses.translation: The pair Brahma and Buddhi (Cosmic intellect) took their orn simultaneously from that (Pradh&na) of the nature of Tamas and unmanifestness*. The Ksetrajfla (and) that >vhich is (also) named Brahma (was born from that pair).

verses.sanskrit: संसिद्धकार्यकरणो ब्रह्मग्रे समवर्त्तत । तेजसाप्रतिमो धीमानव्यक्तः संप्रकाशकः
verses.transliteration: saṃsiddhakāryakaraṇo brahmagre samavarttata / tejasāpratimo dhīmānavyaktaḥ saṃprakāśakaḥ
verses.translation: Fully equipped vfithKdtya (effect?) and Karova (the instruments; the sense*organs) Brahma appeared (existed) at the outset. He was unparalleled in lustre, intelligent, unmanifest but excellent enlightener (revealer).
verses.wordMeaning: Fully equipped vfithKdtya (effect?) and Karova (the instruments; the sense*organs) Brahma appeared (existed) at the outset. He was unparalleled in lustre, intelligent, unmanifest but excellent enlightener (revealer).

verses.sanskrit: स वै शरीरप्रथमो धारणत्वव्यवस्थितः । ज्ञानेनाप्रतिमेनेह वैराग्येण च सप्ततिः

verses.translation: (Defective text). He is the first embodied being stabilised in retention. He is endowed with unequalled know* ledge and absence of passionate attachment.

verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text). He is the first embodied being stabilised in retention. He is endowed with unequalled know* ledge and absence of passionate attachment.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तत्वाय तेनास्य मनसा यद्यदिच्छति । वशीकृतत्वात्त्रैगुण्यात्सापेक्षत्वाच्च भावतः

verses.translation: On account of his being unmanifest and because he had kept (everything) under control, since these are three Ounai and because all evolved beings are interdependent, (Brahma attains) whatever he desires mentally.
verses.hindi: 'लोकतत्व के अर्थ वाले, वेद के समान सम्पूर्ण पुराण की भगवान् प्रजापति ने-बसिष्ठ मुनि के आगे प्रशंसा की थी अर्थात् उनको पढ़ाया था ।८। भगवानु वसिष्ठ ऋषि ने परम पुण्यमय अमृत के सहश इस तत्व ज्ञान को शक्ति के पुत्र अपने पोत्र पराशर को पढ़ाना था।€। आचीत काल में
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his being unmanifest and because he had kept (everything) under control, since these are three Ounai and because all evolved beings are interdependent, (Brahma attains) whatever he desires mentally.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his being unmanifest and because he had kept (everything) under control, since these are three Ounai and because all evolved beings are interdependent, (Brahma attains) whatever he desires mentally.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्मुखस्तु ब्रह्मत्वे कालत्वे चान्तकृद्भवः । सहस्रमूर्धा पुरुषस्तिस्रो ऽवस्थाःस्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: caturmukhastu brahmatve kālatve cāntakṛdbhavaḥ / sahasramūrdhā puruṣastisro 'vasthāḥsvayaṃbhuvaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: The self'bom deity has three states: He has four faces as Brahma; as Kata (God of Death) heisBhava, the 4cstroyer; (as ViQu) he is the Purua with thousand heads.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं रजश्च ब्रह्मत्वे कालत्वे चरजस्तमः । सात्त्विकः पुरुषत्वे च गुणवृतं स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ rajaśca brahmatve kālatve carajastamaḥ / sāttvikaḥ puruṣatve ca guṇavṛtaṃ svayaṃbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: As Brahma, he creates the worlds; as Kala, he annihilates them; as Purua, he is indifferent; these are the three states of the self bom deity.'

verses.wordMeaning: As Brahma, he creates the worlds; as Kala, he annihilates them; as Purua, he is indifferent; these are the three states of the self bom deity.'
verses.commentary: Sense: As Brahma, he creates the worlds; as Kala, he annihilates them; as Purua, he is indifferent; these are the three states of the self bom deity.'

verses.translation: As Brahma, he possesses Rajas exclusively; as Kala he has Rajas and Tamas and as Purusa (i.e. Vinu) he is exclusively Sattvika;—this is the position of the Gunas in the case of the setf*born deity.

verses.wordMeaning: As Brahma, he possesses Rajas exclusively; as Kala he has Rajas and Tamas and as Purusa (i.e. Vinu) he is exclusively Sattvika;—this is the position of the Gunas in the case of the setf*born deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Brahma, he possesses Rajas exclusively; as Kala he has Rajas and Tamas and as Purusa (i.e. Vinu) he is exclusively Sattvika;—this is the position of the Gunas in the case of the setf*born deity.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा कमल पत्राक्षः कालो जात्यञ्जनप्रभः । पुरुषः पुण्डरीकाक्षो रूपेण परमात्मनः

verses.hindi: सूत परम विनम्र, धार्मिक ओर्, पवित्र थे अतः उनको यह् भदुभुत वृत्तान्त वाला पुराण पढ़ाया था
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmi has eyes like lotus-petals*; Kala has the lustre ofcollyrium ever since his origin. Puru is lotuseyed with the form of the supreme Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmi has eyes like lotus-petals*; Kala has the lustre ofcollyrium ever since his origin. Puru is lotuseyed with the form of the supreme Atman.

verses.translation: The physical bodies adopt different kinds of shapes, activities, colours and features. Since he has the pastime of remaining threefold in the world, he is called Trigu (one that has three Gu).

verses.sanskrit: परमः संप्रहृष्टत्वाद्देवतादोमिति स्मृतिः । सर्वज्ञः सर्वविज्ञानात्सर्वःसर्वंयतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: paramaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatvāddevatādomiti smṛtiḥ / sarvajñaḥ sarvavijñānātsarvaḥsarvaṃyatastataḥ
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: नराणां स्वापनं ब्रह्मा तस्मान्नारायणः स्मृतः । त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं सकलः संप्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: narāṇāṃ svāpanaṃ brahmā tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / tridhā vibhajya cātmānaṃ sakalaḥ saṃpravarttate
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: सृजते ग्रसते चैव पाल्यते च त्रिभिः स्वयम् । सो ऽग्रे हिरण्यगर्भः सन् प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sṛjate grasate caiva pālyate ca tribhiḥ svayam / so 'gre hiraṇyagarbhaḥ san prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.hindi: परम विनयी लोमहषंण मुनि ने इस परम श्रेष्ठ पुराण का अध्ययन करके जब समाप्त किया था तो ऋषि आपने उनसे पूछा था जो कि भली अकार से घमं के समाचरण करने वाले और परम प्रज्ञावान् ये ।५१। अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यो हि स्ववशश्चैव अजातत्वादजः स्मृतः । तस्माद्धिरण्यगर्भश्च पुराणेषु निरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ādyo hi svavaśaścaiva ajātatvādajaḥ smṛtaḥ / tasmāddhiraṇyagarbhaśca purāṇeṣu nirucyate
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयंभुवो निवृत्तस्य कालो वर्णाग्रतस्तु यः । न शक्यः परिसंख्यातुं मनुवर्षशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: svayaṃbhuvo nivṛttasya kālo varṇāgratastu yaḥ / na śakyaḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ manuvarṣaśatairapi
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.hindi: मुनियों के साथ संयुत होकर समस्त मुनियों को शिर झुकाकर प्रणामे किया था और परम भाक्त भाव से युक्त होकर प्रदक्षिणा की थी ।१६। सम्पूर्ण बिद्या को प्राप्त करके ये परम सन्सुष्ठ हुए और फिर वे कुरुक्षेत्र में पहुँचे गये थे । जहाँ पर एक विशाल यज्ञ होरहा था और पवित्र बहुत से यंजमान
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पसंख्यानिवृत्तस्तु परार्धो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः । तावत्त्वे सो ऽस्य कालो ऽन्यस्तस्यान्ते प्रतिबुद्ध्यते
verses.transliteration: kalpasaṃkhyānivṛttastu parārdho brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / tāvattve so 'sya kālo 'nyastasyānte pratibuddhyate
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.hindi: तथा ऋषिंगण विद्यमान ये ।१७। सब याझिकों ने परम नन्ता से रोमहषण ऋषि से भेंट की थी। शास्त्रों के अनुसार विधि पूर्वक प्रज्ञा से अंतिगमन किया था ।१८। उस समय में उन समस्त ऋषियों ने भी रोमहषण मुनि का दर्शन प्राप्त कर अत्यन्त हषं प्राप्त किया था और सबके' मन में विशेष
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिवर्षसहस्राणि गृहभूतानि यानि च । समतीतानि कल्पानां तावच्छेषात्परेतु ये
verses.transliteration: koṭivarṣasahasrāṇi gṛhabhūtāni yāni ca / samatītāni kalpānāṃ tāvaccheṣātparetu ye
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नता हुईं थी ।१९। सब ऋषियों ने उनका विशेष समादर एवं सत्कार करके अर्ध्यपाद्य आदि के द्वारा उनका समर्चन किया था  राजा के द्वारा आज्ञा प्राप्त करके संमस्त' मृनिगणों को प्रणाम किया 'था।२०) कुणल-लेम' पूछे जाने पर,समस्त ऋषियों के द्वारा आज्ञा प्राप्त की थी । सलातन ब्रह्म
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: यत्स्वयं वर्त्तते कल्पो वाराहस्तन्निबोधत । प्रथमं सांप्रतस्तेषां कल्पो वै वर्त्तते च यः
verses.transliteration: yatsvayaṃ varttate kalpo vārāhastannibodhata / prathamaṃ sāṃpratasteṣāṃ kalpo vai varttate ca yaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.hindi: के तेज स्वरूप , उनसब ऋषियों के समीप जाकर सदस्यों के द्वारा अनुमत अपने आसन पर बिराजमान हो गये ये
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे युगसहस्रे तु परिपाल्यं नरेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: pūrṇe yugasahasre tu paripālyaṃ nareśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and crores of years that had been the abode of Kalpas have passed by. As noany are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापदे लोककल्पनं नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः श्रीसूत उवाच आपो ऽग्रे सर्वगा आसन्नेनसिमन्पृथिवीतले । शान्तवातैः प्रलीने ऽस्मिन्न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpade lokakalpanaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ śrīsūta uvāca āpo 'gre sarvagā āsannenasimanpṛthivītale / śāntavātaiḥ pralīne 'sminna prājñāyata kiñcana
verses.translation: At the beginnii;, the waters were present everywhere on the surface of the earth. When this (visible world) had been annihilated and when the winds had become quiet, nothing could be known.
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginnii;, the waters were present everywhere on the surface of the earth. When this (visible world) had been annihilated and when the winds had become quiet, nothing could be known.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginnii;, the waters were present everywhere on the surface of the earth. When this (visible world) had been annihilated and when the winds had become quiet, nothing could be known.

verses.sanskrit: एकार्णवे तदा तस्मिन्नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे । विभुर्भवति स ब्रह्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्
verses.transliteration: ekārṇave tadā tasminnaṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / vibhurbhavati sa brahmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt
verses.translation: In that vast ocean-like expanse of water, when the whole world consbting of mobile and unmobile beings had
verses.hindi: उस समय में उनके अपने आसन पर बैठ जाने पर समस्त मुनियों ने ब्रत धारण किया था और परम प्रसन्न होकर विनीत भाव से सावधान होकर उचित स्थान पर वे सब स्थित हो गये थे ।२२। उन समस्त ऋषियों: ने महान ब्रत धारण करके परम त्रीति से'समन्बित होकर उन सूतनन्दन जी
verses.wordMeaning: In that vast ocean-like expanse of water, when the whole world consbting of mobile and unmobile beings had
verses.commentary: Sense: In that vast ocean-like expanse of water, when the whole world consbting of mobile and unmobile beings had

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्मवर्णो ह्यतीन्द्रियः । ब्रह्म नारायणाख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा
verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇo hyatīndriyaḥ / brahma nārāyaṇākhyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā
verses.translation: At that time Brahma named Nar&yana lay asleep in the waters. He had a thousand heads. He was the Puru$a with golden colour and was beyond the ken of the sense-oians.
verses.hindi: से पूछा था ।२३। है महान् भाग वाले ! हम सब आपका स्वागत करते हैं। हे धीमन् ! यहाँ पर स्थित हुए हम सब परम कुशल, सुन्दर ब्रतधारी ओर यों में परम श्रेष्ठ आपका हम दर्शन कर रहे हैं।२४। पुण्य कमों वाले आपके पदार्पण से आज ही यह भूमि हमारे लिए आनन्दमयी हुई है। हे
verses.wordMeaning: At that time Brahma named Nar&yana lay asleep in the waters. He had a thousand heads. He was the Puru$a with golden colour and was beyond the ken of the sense-oians.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time Brahma named Nar&yana lay asleep in the waters. He had a thousand heads. He was the Puru$a with golden colour and was beyond the ken of the sense-oians.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वोद्रेकान्निषिद्धस्तु शून्यं लोकमवैक्षत । इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्रर् श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sattvodrekānniṣiddhastu śūnyaṃ lokamavaikṣata / imaṃ codāharantyatrar ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati
verses.translation: Prohibited* (?) on account of the excess of Sattva, he saw the empty world. In this context as regards Nirayaia they cite this iloka (verse).
verses.hindi: सूतजी ! आप तो महान् आत्मा वाले उन शरीव्यासजी के कृपा पात्र हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Prohibited* (?) on account of the excess of Sattva, he saw the empty world. In this context as regards Nirayaia they cite this iloka (verse).
verses.commentary: Sense: Prohibited* (?) on account of the excess of Sattva, he saw the empty world. In this context as regards Nirayaia they cite this iloka (verse).

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः । अयन तस्य ताःप्रोक्तास्तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ / ayana tasya tāḥproktāstena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Waters are called Xdras (because) the waters are indeed the children of (JVWa) (Man); the waters are his place of resort. Hence, he is remembered as Narayaa.*
verses.hindi: ब्यासदेव जी के आप अनुग्रह के योग्य शिष्य हैं और सदा शिष्य में होने बाले गुण-गणों से युक्त है तथा परम बुद्धिमान् हैं। है प्रभो ! आप बुद्धि से युक्त हैं और गुरुदेव के अनुग्रह के पात्र होने से आपको सम्पूर्ण तत्ब ज्ञान है ।२६। आपने बहुत अधिक ज्ञान की प्राप्ति की है अतः आपके सभी प्रकार के
verses.wordMeaning: Waters are called Xdras (because) the waters are indeed the children of (JVWa) (Man); the waters are his place of resort. Hence, he is remembered as Narayaa.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Waters are called Xdras (because) the waters are indeed the children of (JVWa) (Man); the waters are his place of resort. Hence, he is remembered as Narayaa.*

verses.sanskrit: तुल्य युगसहस्रस्य वसन्कालमुपास्यतः । स्वर्णपत्रेप्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्वादर्शकारणात्
verses.transliteration: tulya yugasahasrasya vasankālamupāsyataḥ / svarṇapatreprakurute brahmatvādarśakāraṇāt
verses.translation: (Defective text). He remains meditating for a period equal to a thousand Yugas. He performs meditation on a (}otu.<t) with golden petals in order to reach the ideal state of Brahman. ••
verses.hindi: संशय दूर हो गये हैं । है प्राज्ञ! हम लोग अब पूछ रहे हैं अतएव सभी फुछ हमारे सामने वर्णन करने के योग्य होते हैं ।२७। हम लोग सब श्रुति सम्मित परमदिष्य पुराण सम्बन्धिनी कथा का श्रवण करना चाहते हैं। आपने इस इसका श्रवण व्यासदेव जी से किया है उसी धर्माथें से युक्त पोराणिक कथा
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text). He remains meditating for a period equal to a thousand Yugas. He performs meditation on a (}otu.<t) with golden petals in order to reach the ideal state of Brahman. ••
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text). He remains meditating for a period equal to a thousand Yugas. He performs meditation on a (}otu.<t) with golden petals in order to reach the ideal state of Brahman. ••

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म तु सलिले तस्मिन्नवाग् भूत्वा तदा चरन् । निशायामिव खद्योतः प्रापृट्काले ततस्ततः
verses.transliteration: brahma tu salile tasminnavāg bhūtvā tadā caran / niśāyāmiva khadyotaḥ prāpṛṭkāle tatastataḥ
verses.translation: Like a glowworm at night during the rainy season, Brahmi moves about here and there in the water, stooping down with his face turned downwards.
verses.hindi: को हुम सुनना चाहते हैं ।२८। उस समय में जब इस प्रकार के ऋषियों के द्वारा कहा गया तो विनय से संधुत और परम पण्डित सूतजी ने उत्तम विनीत उत्तर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Like a glowworm at night during the rainy season, Brahmi moves about here and there in the water, stooping down with his face turned downwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a glowworm at night during the rainy season, Brahmi moves about here and there in the water, stooping down with his face turned downwards.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु सलिले तस्मिन् विज्ञायान्तर्गते महत् । अनुमानादसंमूढो भूमेरद्धरणं प्रति
verses.transliteration: tatastu salile tasmin vijñāyāntargate mahat / anumānādasaṃmūḍho bhūmeraddharaṇaṃ prati
verses.translation: On seeing that the earth had sunk into the water he thought—"what form shall I assume and uplift the earth?**
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that the earth had sunk into the water he thought—"what form shall I assume and uplift the earth?**
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that the earth had sunk into the water he thought—"what form shall I assume and uplift the earth?**

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्काराषृतनुं त्वन्यां कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा । ततो महात्मा मनसा दिव्यरूपम चिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: oṅkārāṣṛtanuṃ tvanyāṃ kalpādiṣu yathā purā / tato mahātmā manasā divyarūpama cintayat
verses.translation: Cf. Punisa-sfikta (BVJC.90.1).
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Punisa-sfikta (BVJC.90.1).
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Punisa-sfikta (BVJC.90.1).

verses.sanskrit: सलिले ऽवप्लुतां भूमिं दृष्ट्वा स समचिन्तयत् । किं तु रूपमहं कृत्वा सलिलादुद्धरे महीम्
verses.transliteration: salile 'vaplutāṃ bhūmiṃ dṛṣṭvā sa samacintayat / kiṃ tu rūpamahaṃ kṛtvā salilāduddhare mahīm
verses.translation: The usual derivatknt of NSrkyana found in other PurSas also but for a diffisrent derivation vide 4.28.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual derivatknt of NSrkyana found in other PurSas also but for a diffisrent derivation vide 4.28.

verses.sanskrit: जलक्रीडासमुचितं वाराहं रूपमस्मरत् । उदृश्यं सर्वभूतानां वाङ्मयं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: jalakrīḍāsamucitaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamasmarat / udṛśyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vāṅmayaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: It had a huge body like a great mountain. It had curved fangs white, sharp and terrible. It bore resembl¬ ance (in lustre to) lightning and fire. Its brilliance was like that the sun.
verses.hindi: ऋषि व्यासदेव से जो भी कुछ मैंने श्रवण किया है और उस क्वण करने से जो ज्ञान मुझे प्राप्त हुआ है जिससे भली-भाति श्रवण कराने के लिए बह ज्ञान पूर्णंतया,सत्य है--ऐसा मेरा निश्चय है ।३०। है उत्तम द्विजगणो ! इस प्रकार से ज्ञान प्राप्त होने पर जो भी कुछ मेरे द्वारा कहा जा सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: It had a huge body like a great mountain. It had curved fangs white, sharp and terrible. It bore resembl¬ ance (in lustre to) lightning and fire. Its brilliance was like that the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had a huge body like a great mountain. It had curved fangs white, sharp and terrible. It bore resembl¬ ance (in lustre to) lightning and fire. Its brilliance was like that the sun.

verses.sanskrit: दशयोजनविस्तीर्णमायतंशतयोजनम् । नीलमेघप्रतीकाशं मेघस्तनितनिःस्वनम्
verses.transliteration: daśayojanavistīrṇamāyataṃśatayojanam / nīlameghapratīkāśaṃ meghastanitaniḥsvanam
verses.translation: It had thick long and round shoulders. It used to walk with the (steady) steps of Vipju. The region of its hips was raised up (well-developed) and stout. It was honoured with the characteristic features of a bull.
verses.hindi: मैं कहुँगा । जिस विषय में आपकी जो भी जानने की इच्छा है। उसको आप आश्ञा देने के योग्य हैं ।३१। मुनिगणों ने उनफे इस प्रकार के मधुर भाषण को सुनकर उन्होंने प्रेमाश्,ओं से भरी हुई आँखों बाले सूतजी से फिर कहा था ।३२। आप तो विशेष रूप से निपुण हैं और आपने साक्षात
verses.wordMeaning: It had thick long and round shoulders. It used to walk with the (steady) steps of Vipju. The region of its hips was raised up (well-developed) and stout. It was honoured with the characteristic features of a bull.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had thick long and round shoulders. It used to walk with the (steady) steps of Vipju. The region of its hips was raised up (well-developed) and stout. It was honoured with the characteristic features of a bull.

verses.sanskrit: महापर्वतवर्ष्माणं श्वेततीक्ष्णोग्रदंष्ट्रिणाम् । विद्युदग्निप्रतिकाशमादित्यसमतेजसम्
verses.transliteration: mahāparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ śvetatīkṣṇogradaṃṣṭriṇām / vidyudagnipratikāśamādityasamatejasam
verses.translation: Assuming this inimitable form of a boar, Hari entered the nether worlds for uplifting the earth.
verses.hindi: रूप से श्री व्यासजी का दर्शन किया है। इस कारण से आप इस लोक की सम्पूर्णं उत्पत्ति को विशेष रूप से दिखलाने की कृपा कीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming this inimitable form of a boar, Hari entered the nether worlds for uplifting the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming this inimitable form of a boar, Hari entered the nether worlds for uplifting the earth.

verses.sanskrit: पीनवृत्तायतस्कन्धं विष्णुविक्रमगामि च । पीनोन्नतकटीदेशं वृषलक्षणपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: pīnavṛttāyataskandhaṃ viṣṇuvikramagāmi ca / pīnonnatakaṭīdeśaṃ vṛṣalakṣaṇapūjitam
verses.translation: VV.d-]I remind of TaitBrShmapa 1.2.1.3 which stales
verses.hindi: जिसके बंश में जो-जो भी हुए हैं. उन-उन सबको हम जानना चाहते हैं। शोर. आप उनके पूर्व में होने वाली प्रजापति की विचित्र विशेष सृष्टि को भी बतलाइए-यह भी हम सब जानने की इच्छा करते हैं। सत्कार करके. उन महात्मा सूतजी से जब पूछा गया था ।३४। तब उन परमश्र छ महापुरुष

verses.translation: Mt.R 247.66 rands difieratly.

verses.transliteration: ahorātrekṣaṇādharo vedāṅgaśrutibhūṣaṇaḥ / ājyagandhaḥ sruvastuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān
verses.translation: The Mt.P. and afikara read upamef/furveakah: Whose pendant lower-life was updkoma (redtatioa of the Vedas). Can we take ruci for ncaka?

verses.sanskrit: सत्यधर्ममयः श्रीमान् कर्मविक्रमसत्कृतः । प्रायश्चित्तनखो घोरः पशुजानुर्महामखः
verses.transliteration: satyadharmamayaḥ śrīmān karmavikramasatkṛtaḥ / prāyaścittanakho ghoraḥ paśujānurmahāmakhaḥ
verses.translation: The whorls of hair on Uie front of hone's chat is regarded as onup mental. The same on the chest of the boar would be beutifying.
verses.hindi: नैमिषारण्य के निवासी महात्मा मुनियों ने पहिले पूछा था। पुराण का लक्षण ही यह है--सर्ग अर्थात् सृष्टि और प्रतिसगं अर्थात् उस सृष्टि से होने वाली सृष्टि, वंशों को वर्णन, मन्वन्तर अर्थात् मनुओं का कथन ततप कौन-कौन मनु किस-किस के पश्चात् हुए ।३७ बंशों में होने: वालों का
verses.wordMeaning: The whorls of hair on Uie front of hone's chat is regarded as onup mental. The same on the chest of the boar would be beutifying.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whorls of hair on Uie front of hone's chat is regarded as onup mental. The same on the chest of the boar would be beutifying.

verses.sanskrit: उद्गातात्रो होमलिङ्गः फलबीजमहोषधीः । वाद्यन्तरात्मसत्रस्य नास्मिकासो मशोणितः
verses.transliteration: udgātātro homaliṅgaḥ phalabījamahoṣadhīḥ / vādyantarātmasatrasya nāsmikāso maśoṇitaḥ
verses.translation: Day and night represent the Sun and the Moon. Hiey are the two eyes of DMne Boar.
verses.hindi: चरित--यह ही पांचों बातों का होना पुराण का लक्षण है। इसमें भी चार पाद' होते हैं-प्रक्रिया पहिला पाद है जो कथा में परिग्रह होता है ।३४ा अनुषङ्क, उत्पोद्धात और उपसहार इस प्रकार से संक्षेप से मैंने चार पाद बतला दिये हैं ।३९। अब पहिले उनको क्रम के अनुसार विस्तार के सार्थ
verses.wordMeaning: Day and night represent the Sun and the Moon. Hiey are the two eyes of DMne Boar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Day and night represent the Sun and the Moon. Hiey are the two eyes of DMne Boar.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ता यज्ञवराहान्ताश्चापः संप्राविशत्पुनः । अग्निसंछादितां भूमिं समामिच्छन्प्रजापतिम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktā yajñavarāhāntāścāpaḥ saṃprāviśatpunaḥ / agnisaṃchāditāṃ bhūmiṃ samāmicchanprajāpatim

verses.hindi: बतलाऊेंगा । सबसे प्रथम सभी शास्त्रों से पूवं ब्रह्माजी ने पुराण का क्षणं किया था ।४०। इसके पश्चात् उनके मुख से वेद निकले थे ओर वेद के अङ्गं शास्त्र, धर्मशास्त्र क्रत तथा नियमं आदि उनके मुख से निकले थे ।४१।'जो अव्यक्त कारण है बह नित्य है और सत् तथा असत् स्वरूप वाला है । महंत

verses.sanskrit: उपगम्या जुहावैता मद्यश्चाद्यसमन्यसत् । मामुद्राश्च समुद्रेषु नादेयाश्च नदीषु च । पृथक् तास्तु समीकृत्य पृथिव्यां सो ऽचिनोद्गिरीन्
verses.transliteration: upagamyā juhāvaitā madyaścādyasamanyasat / māmudrāśca samudreṣu nādeyāśca nadīṣu ca / pṛthak tāstu samīkṛtya pṛthivyāṃ so 'cinodgirīn
verses.translation: He allocated (he waters of the ocean in the oceans and those of the rivers in the rivers. After making them separate and equal, he gathered the mountains on the earth for its stability.
verses.hindi: आदि लेकर विशेष के अन्त तक का मैं सूजन करता है-ऐसा विशेष निश्चय किया था
verses.wordMeaning: He allocated (he waters of the ocean in the oceans and those of the rivers in the rivers. After making them separate and equal, he gathered the mountains on the earth for its stability.
verses.commentary: Sense: He allocated (he waters of the ocean in the oceans and those of the rivers in the rivers. After making them separate and equal, he gathered the mountains on the earth for its stability.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्सर्गे दह्यमानास्तु तदा संवर्तकाग्निना । देनाग्निना विलीनास्ते पर्वता भुवि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: prāksarge dahyamānāstu tadā saṃvartakāgninā / denāgninā vilīnāste parvatā bhuvi sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: These mountains had been burnt in the previous Sarga (period of creation) by the Sar/wartaka fire (i.e. fire of destruction at the time of universal annihilation). Along with that fire these mountains had got merged in the earth completely.
verses.wordMeaning: These mountains had been burnt in the previous Sarga (period of creation) by the Sar/wartaka fire (i.e. fire of destruction at the time of universal annihilation). Along with that fire these mountains had got merged in the earth completely.
verses.commentary: Sense: These mountains had been burnt in the previous Sarga (period of creation) by the Sar/wartaka fire (i.e. fire of destruction at the time of universal annihilation). Along with that fire these mountains had got merged in the earth completely.

verses.transliteration: satyādekārṇave tasmin vāyunā yattu saṃhitāḥ / niṣiktā yatrayatrāsaṃstatratatrācalo 'bhavat

verses.transliteration: tatasteṣu prakīrṇeṣu lokodadhigirīṃstathā / viśvakarmā vibhajate kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ

verses.sanskrit: ससमुद्रामिमां पृथ्वीं सप्तद्वीपां सपर्वताम् । भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान्पुनःपुनरकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: sasamudrāmimāṃ pṛthvīṃ saptadvīpāṃ saparvatām / bhūrādyāṃścaturo lokānpunaḥpunarakalpayat
verses.translation: After they had been scattered, Vifvakarman divided the worlds, oceans and mountains. He divides like this again •and again at the beginning of every Kalpa.
verses.wordMeaning: After they had been scattered, Vifvakarman divided the worlds, oceans and mountains. He divides like this again •and again at the beginning of every Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: After they had been scattered, Vifvakarman divided the worlds, oceans and mountains. He divides like this again •and again at the beginning of every Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: लाकान्प्रकल्पयित्वा च प्रजासर्ग ससर्ज ह । ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवाम् सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: lākānprakalpayitvā ca prajāsarga sasarja ha / brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavām sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: He created again and again this earth consisting of seven continents along with the oceans and the mountains. He (also) created again the four worlds beginning with BhQ (earth).

verses.commentary: Sense: They arc arranged into eight classes with hellish characteristics (i.e. such characteristic features as are conducive to hell). Those men with souls of spiritual achievement are similar in characteristic features to the Gandharvas.

verses.transliteration: yasmāttervākpravartante tatorvākūsrotasastu te / te ca prakāśabahulāstamaspṛṣṭarajodhikāḥ
verses.translation: W.4€b»50 describe the fourth creation called dovm*
verses.wordMeaning: W.4€b»50 describe the fourth creation called dovm*
verses.commentary: Sense: W.4€b»50 describe the fourth creation called dovm*

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्ते दुःखबहुला भूयोभूयश्च कारिमः । प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च मनुष्याः साधकाश्च ते
verses.transliteration: tasmātte duḥkhabahulā bhūyobhūyaśca kārimaḥ / prakāśā bahirantaśca manuṣyāḥ sādhakāśca te
verses.translation: There icons to be coofuson in the present text Here BhdSM
verses.wordMeaning: There icons to be coofuson in the present text Here BhdSM
verses.commentary: Sense: There icons to be coofuson in the present text Here BhdSM

verses.sanskrit: लक्षणैर्नारकाद्यैस्तैरष्टधा च व्यवस्थिताः । सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्ते गन्धर्वैः सह धर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṇairnārakādyaistairaṣṭadhā ca vyavasthitāḥ / siddhātmāno manuṣyāste gandharvaiḥ saha dharmiṇaḥ
verses.translation: These (latter) five creations are the Vaikria (Medi¬ tated) creation. The first three are remembered as Prikfta (per* taining to Prakrti) creations. The ninth creation called the Kaumara (brought about by Kumiira i.e. Sanatkumira etc.) sarga. (The eight creations mentitmed before are) PrSkfta and Vcikfta.
verses.hindi: अन्नेः प्रजायाः संभूतिः स्वाहायां यत्र कीत्येते । पितू, णाँ द्विप्रकाराशां स्वायां तदनन्तरम्
verses.wordMeaning: These (latter) five creations are the Vaikria (Medi¬ tated) creation. The first three are remembered as Prikfta (per* taining to Prakrti) creations. The ninth creation called the Kaumara (brought about by Kumiira i.e. Sanatkumira etc.) sarga.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These (latter) five creations are the Vaikria (Medi¬ tated) creation. The first three are remembered as Prikfta (per* taining to Prakrti) creations. The ninth creation called the Kaumara (brought about by Kumiira i.e. Sanatkumira etc.) sarga.…

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमो ऽनुग्रहः सर्गश्चतुर्द्धा स व्यवस्थितः । विपर्ययेण शक्त्या च सिद्ध मुख्यास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: pañcamo 'nugrahaḥ sargaścaturddhā sa vyavasthitaḥ / viparyayeṇa śaktyā ca siddha mukhyāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: {Defictioi Uxi) The three Pr&lcrta creations are BuddhipUrvas (created with consciousness and foreknowledge). The Vikrta creations function BuddhiApUrvas (without consci* ousness and foreknowledge). Their classes pertain to the Brahman (?)
verses.wordMeaning: {Defictioi Uxi) The three Pr&lcrta creations are BuddhipUrvas (created with consciousness and foreknowledge). The Vikrta creations function BuddhiApUrvas (without consci* ousness and foreknowledge). Their classes pertain to the Brahman (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: {Defictioi Uxi) The three Pr&lcrta creations are BuddhipUrvas (created with consciousness and foreknowledge). The Vikrta creations function BuddhiApUrvas (without consci* ousness and foreknowledge). Their classes pertain to the Brahman (?)

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्ता वर्तमानाश्च प्रजायन्ते पुनःपुनः । भूतादिकानां सत्त्वानां षष्ठः सर्गः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: nivṛttā vartamānāśca prajāyante punaḥpunaḥ / bhūtādikānāṃ sattvānāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sargaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: After creating the souls of different Sthdnas (positions), he created other beings, the Devas and the Pitrs by whom these subjects fiourished.
verses.hindi: उसी प्रकार से ही शतरूपा में उन दोनों के पुत्र समुत्पन्न हुए थे । इसके भागे प्रियद्रत और उत्तानपाद हुए थे । प्रसूति की परम शुभ आकृ- तियाँ थीं ।५७। त्रिभुबन में जो प्रतिष्ठा न थे वे पापों से रहित थे- ऐसा ही कहा जाता है। प्रजापति से रुचि की ओर फिर आकूति में मिथुने
verses.wordMeaning: After creating the souls of different Sthdnas (positions), he created other beings, the Devas and the Pitrs by whom these subjects fiourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating the souls of different Sthdnas (positions), he created other beings, the Devas and the Pitrs by whom these subjects fiourished.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च ज्ञेया भूतादिकाश्च ते । प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: svādanāścāpyaśīlāśca jñeyā bhūtādikāśca te / prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇastu saḥ
verses.translation: He created nine mental sons, viz., Bhrgu, Angiras, Mallei, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak, Atri and Vasisha.
verses.hindi: से उत्पत्ति हुई थी ।५८। प्रजापति दक्ष की कन्याओं का प्रसूति में जन्म परम शुभ हुआ शब्दाद्य दाक्षायणीओं में भी महान् आत्मा वाले ध्म का उबूभव हुआ था ।५९। यह धमं का जन्म परम सात्विक और सुख के उदय वालों सगे कहा जाता है। उसी भांति हिसा में अधर्म का उद्भव हुआ है जो
verses.wordMeaning: He created nine mental sons, viz., Bhrgu, Angiras, Mallei, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak, Atri and Vasisha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created nine mental sons, viz., Bhrgu, Angiras, Mallei, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak, Atri and Vasisha.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूत सर्गः स उच्यते । वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु चैद्रियः सर्ग उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūta sargaḥ sa ucyate / vaikārikastṛtīyastu caidriyaḥ sarga ucyate
verses.translation: These are decisively termed nine Brahmas in the Purina because they wete just Kkc Brakma (in regard to the creation) of all Brahma Ycini their sons.
verses.hindi: तामस औरं अशुभ लक्षण वाला है ।६०। भृगु आदि ऋषियों की प्रजा कें सर्ग का उप वर्णन है और जिसमें ब्रह्मि वसिष्ठजी के गोत्र का अनुकीत्त न किया है ।६१। जिसमें स्वाहा नाम धारिणी स्वाहा पत्नी में अग्नि की सन्तति का वर्णेन किया जाता है। इसके उपरान्त स्वधा नाम की पत्नी में दों प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: These are decisively termed nine Brahmas in the Purina because they wete just Kkc Brakma (in regard to the creation) of all Brahma Ycini their sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are decisively termed nine Brahmas in the Purina because they wete just Kkc Brakma (in regard to the creation) of all Brahma Ycini their sons.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येत प्राकृताः सर्गा उत्पन्ना बुद्धिपूर्वकाः । मुख्यसर्गश्च तुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ityeta prākṛtāḥ sargā utpannā buddhipūrvakāḥ / mukhyasargaśca turthastu mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter Brahmh created form qut of his
verses.hindi: के पितृगणों का वर्णन किया जाता है ।६२। पितृगणों के वंश के प्रसङ्ग से भगवान् महेश्वर से और सती से दक्ष प्रजापति के लिए शाप का वर्णन है और परम बुद्धिमान भृगु आदि ऋषियों को जो प्रतिशाप दिया गया है उसका वर्णन होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Brahmh created form qut of his
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Brahmh created form qut of his

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यक्स्रोतःससर्गस्तु तैर्यग्योन्यस्तु पञ्चमः । तथोर्द्धस्रोतसां सर्गः षष्ठो देवत उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tiryaksrotaḥsasargastu tairyagyonyastu pañcamaḥ / tathorddhasrotasāṃ sargaḥ ṣaṣṭho devata ucyate
verses.translation: Then Brahma created lyaifosa (Energetic effort) the creature of the nature of pleasure. From the Samkalpa of the creator whose source of origin was the unmanifest one Samkalpa was born.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma created lyaifosa (Energetic effort) the creature of the nature of pleasure. From the Samkalpa of the creator whose source of origin was the unmanifest one Samkalpa was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma created lyaifosa (Energetic effort) the creature of the nature of pleasure. From the Samkalpa of the creator whose source of origin was the unmanifest one Samkalpa was born.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोर्द्धस्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः । अष्टमोनुग्रहः सर्गः सात्त्विकस्तामसश्च सः
verses.transliteration: tatrorddhasrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ / aṣṭamonugrahaḥ sargaḥ sāttvikastāmasaśca saḥ
verses.translation: Dharma and others should be known and they are remembered as the first bom sons of Brahmin Bhrgu and others who were created (later ), were not expounders of Brahman.
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma and others should be known and they are remembered as the first bom sons of Brahmin Bhrgu and others who were created (later ), were not expounders of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma and others should be known and they are remembered as the first bom sons of Brahmin Bhrgu and others who were created (later ), were not expounders of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चैते वैकृताः सर्गाः प्राकृताद्यास्त्रयः स्मृताः । प्राकृतो वैकृतश्चैव कौमारो नवमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pañcaite vaikṛtāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtādyāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ / prākṛto vaikṛtaścaiva kaumāro navamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: These twelve sons of Brahma are to be known as the ancient householders. O Brahmana, these are born along with Rudra.
verses.wordMeaning: These twelve sons of Brahma are to be known as the ancient householders. O Brahmana, these are born along with Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: These twelve sons of Brahma are to be known as the ancient householders. O Brahmana, these are born along with Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृता बुद्धिपूर्वास्तु त्रयः सर्गास्तु वैकृताः । दुद्धिबुर्वाः प्रवर्तेयुस्तद्वर्गा ब्राह्मणास्तु वै
verses.transliteration: prakṛtā buddhipūrvāstu trayaḥ sargāstu vaikṛtāḥ / duddhiburvāḥ pravarteyustadvargā brāhmaṇāstu vai
verses.translation: Kratu and Sanatkumara, these two lived in perpetual -celibacy. In the previous birth* they are elder to all.
verses.wordMeaning: Kratu and Sanatkumara, these two lived in perpetual -celibacy. In the previous birth* they are elder to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kratu and Sanatkumara, these two lived in perpetual -celibacy. In the previous birth* they are elder to all.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तराच्च यथा सर्वे कीर्त्यमानं निबोधत । चतुर्द्धा च स्थितस्सो ऽपि सर्वभूतेषु कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: vistarācca yathā sarve kīrtyamānaṃ nibodhata / caturddhā ca sthitasso 'pi sarvabhūteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: In the seventh Kalpa, these ancient Sddhakas of the world had already passed away. They shine (refulgently) in this world by means of the splendour of their own souls.
verses.wordMeaning: In the seventh Kalpa, these ancient Sddhakas of the world had already passed away. They shine (refulgently) in this world by means of the splendour of their own souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the seventh Kalpa, these ancient Sddhakas of the world had already passed away. They shine (refulgently) in this world by means of the splendour of their own souls.

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययोण शत्त्या च बुद्ध्या सिद्ध्या तथैव च । स्थावरेषु विपर्यासस्तिर्यग्योनिषु शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: viparyayoṇa śattyā ca buddhyā siddhyā tathaiva ca / sthāvareṣu viparyāsastiryagyoniṣu śaktitaḥ
verses.translation: Both of them were Ypgins by nature. Those two, of great power, carried out the duties of subjects and love by superimposing the soul (on the supreme soul) by means of the
verses.wordMeaning: Both of them were Ypgins by nature. Those two, of great power, carried out the duties of subjects and love by superimposing the soul (on the supreme soul) by means of the
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of them were Ypgins by nature. Those two, of great power, carried out the duties of subjects and love by superimposing the soul (on the supreme soul) by means of the

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्तु पुष्टिर्देवेषु कृत्स्नशः । अथो ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान्
verses.transliteration: siddhātmāno manuṣyāstu puṣṭirdeveṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ / atho sasarja vai brahmā mānasānātmanaḥ samān
verses.translation: He continues to be in the same state as he was in, when he was bom. So he is called Kumara. Thereupon, hU name Sanatkumara became well established.
verses.hindi: नीलः श्वेतश्च खड़ी च कोत्यंन्ते सप्त पव॑ताः
verses.wordMeaning: He continues to be in the same state as he was in, when he was bom. So he is called Kumara. Thereupon, hU name Sanatkumara became well established.
verses.commentary: Sense: He continues to be in the same state as he was in, when he was bom. So he is called Kumara. Thereupon, hU name Sanatkumara became well established.

verses.sanskrit: वैवर्त्येन तु ज्ञानेन निवृत्तास्ते महौ जसः । संबुद्ध्य चैव नामाथो अपवृत्तास्त्रयस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: vaivartyena tu jñānena nivṛttāste mahau jasaḥ / saṃbuddhya caiva nāmātho apavṛttāstrayastu te
verses.translation: Their twelve races are divine and are endowed with the groups of Devas; they performed holy rites; they had progeny and they had great sages ornamenting the race.
verses.hindi: अद्भुत कर्मों वाले भगवानु रुद्र से दक्ष के प्रतिशाप का कथन है और दोष के दर्शन से वेर के प्रतियेध का कोत्तंन किया जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Their twelve races are divine and are endowed with the groups of Devas; they performed holy rites; they had progeny and they had great sages ornamenting the race.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their twelve races are divine and are endowed with the groups of Devas; they performed holy rites; they had progeny and they had great sages ornamenting the race.

verses.sanskrit: असृष्ट्वैव प्रजासर्गंप्रतिसर्गं ततस्ततः । ब्रह्मा तेषु व्यरक्तेषु ततो ऽन्यान्सा धकान्सृजन्
verses.transliteration: asṛṣṭvaiva prajāsargaṃpratisargaṃ tatastataḥ / brahmā teṣu vyarakteṣu tato 'nyānsā dhakānsṛjan
verses.translation: After seeing those twelve Sdttvika beings born of his vital airs, the lord created the Asuras, the PitrSf the Devas and the human beings.
verses.hindi: अन्वन्तर के प्रसङ्ग से काल का भी आख्यान कहा जाता है प्रजापति कदम की कल्या का शुभ लक्षण बताया जाता है ।६५। जहाँ पर प्रियग्रत राजा के पुओं का बिस्तार कीत्तित किया जाता है और दीपों में तथा देशों में पृथक्- पृथक् उनके नियोग का वर्णन है ।६६। इसके अनन्तर स्वायम्भुव मनु के सगे
verses.wordMeaning: After seeing those twelve Sdttvika beings born of his vital airs, the lord created the Asuras, the PitrSf the Devas and the human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: After seeing those twelve Sdttvika beings born of his vital airs, the lord created the Asuras, the PitrSf the Devas and the human beings.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानाभिमानिनो देवाः पुनर्ब्रह्मानुशासनम् । अभूतसृष्ट्यवस्था चे स्थानिनस्तान्निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: sthānābhimānino devāḥ punarbrahmānuśāsanam / abhūtasṛṣṭyavasthā ce sthāninastānnibodha me
verses.translation: He created the Devas from his mouth; the Pitrs from his chest; the human beings from his organ of generation and he created the Asuras from his buttocks.
verses.hindi: का वर्णेन किया जाता है और सब वर्षों का नेदियों का और समस्त उनके भेदों का अनुकी्'न किया जाता है ।६७। फिर सह्नों द्वीपों के भेदों का सात द्वीपों में ही अन्तभवि का वर्णेन तथा जम्बू द्वीप और समुद्र के मण्डल का विस्तार से वर्णन किया जाता है ।६ना योजनों के अग्रभाग से पर्वतों कें
verses.wordMeaning: He created the Devas from his mouth; the Pitrs from his chest; the human beings from his organ of generation and he created the Asuras from his buttocks.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created the Devas from his mouth; the Pitrs from his chest; the human beings from his organ of generation and he created the Asuras from his buttocks.

verses.sanskrit: आपो ऽग्निः पृथिवी वायुरन्तरिक्षो दिवं तथा । स्वर्गो दिशः समुद्राश्च नद्यश्चैव वनस्पतीन्
verses.transliteration: āpo 'gniḥ pṛthivī vāyurantarikṣo divaṃ tathā / svargo diśaḥ samudrāśca nadyaścaiva vanaspatīn
verses.translation: Carrying on his creative activities during the night, the lord of the Devas created souls of human beings from the moonlight. He created the Pitrs from the nectar.
verses.hindi: साथ प्रमाण का कीत्तान किया जाता है। इसके अनन्तर हिमवांनु-हेमकूट- निषध-मेरु-नील श्वेत ओर ज्यज़-इन सात पवतों का वर्णन किया जाता है ।६९। उनके अन्तर विष्कम्भ, उच्छाय, आयाम और विस्तार का रणेन किया जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Carrying on his creative activities during the night, the lord of the Devas created souls of human beings from the moonlight. He created the Pitrs from the nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Carrying on his creative activities during the night, the lord of the Devas created souls of human beings from the moonlight. He created the Pitrs from the nectar.

verses.sanskrit: औषधीनां तथात्मानो ह्यात्मनो वृक्षवीरुधाम् । लताः काष्ठाः कलाश्चैव मुहूर्ताः संधिरात्र्यहाः
verses.transliteration: auṣadhīnāṃ tathātmāno hyātmano vṛkṣavīrudhām / latāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kalāścaiva muhūrtāḥ saṃdhirātryahāḥ
verses.translation: After creating the Mukhya (prominent) nd Armkhya (non*prominent) Devas and Asuras, he created from his mind the human beings and the great Pitfs who were like their own fathers.
verses.hindi: कीत्यैन्ते योजनाग्रेण ये च तथ निवासिनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: After creating the Mukhya (prominent) nd Armkhya (non*prominent) Devas and Asuras, he created from his mind the human beings and the great Pitfs who were like their own fathers.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating the Mukhya (prominent) nd Armkhya (non*prominent) Devas and Asuras, he created from his mind the human beings and the great Pitfs who were like their own fathers.

verses.sanskrit: अर्द्धमासाश्च मासाश्च अयनाब्दयुगानि च । स्थाने स्रोतःस्वभीमानाः स्थानाख्याश्चैव ते स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: arddhamāsāśca māsāśca ayanābdayugāni ca / sthāne srotaḥsvabhīmānāḥ sthānākhyāścaiva te smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He created the lightning, the thunder and the clouds, the red coloured rainbows, the PLks, the Yajus Mantras and the Sanun songs for the fulfilment of the Yajhas.
verses.wordMeaning: He created the lightning, the thunder and the clouds, the red coloured rainbows, the PLks, the Yajus Mantras and the Sanun songs for the fulfilment of the Yajhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created the lightning, the thunder and the clouds, the red coloured rainbows, the PLks, the Yajus Mantras and the Sanun songs for the fulfilment of the Yajhas.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानात्मनः स सृष्ट्वा तु ततो ऽन्यान्स तदासृजत् । देवांश्चैव पितॄंश्चैव यौरिमा वर्द्धिताः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: sthānātmanaḥ sa sṛṣṭvā tu tato 'nyānsa tadāsṛjat / devāṃścaiva pitṝṃścaiva yaurimā varddhitāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: The living beings> high and low, were bom of his splendour. The creation of subjects by Brahma comprises of the Devas, the sages the Pttp and the human beings.
verses.wordMeaning: The living beings> high and low, were bom of his splendour. The creation of subjects by Brahma comprises of the Devas, the sages the Pttp and the human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The living beings> high and low, were bom of his splendour. The creation of subjects by Brahma comprises of the Devas, the sages the Pttp and the human beings.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वङ्गिरा मरीचिश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । दक्षो ऽत्रिश्च वसिष्ठश्च सासृजन्नव मानसान्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvaṅgirā marīciśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / dakṣo 'triśca vasiṣṭhaśca sāsṛjannava mānasān
verses.translation: Again he creates living beings, the mobile and the immobile ones, the Yakfas, the Piiacas, the Gandharvas and all the Apsaras, all round.
verses.wordMeaning: Again he creates living beings, the mobile and the immobile ones, the Yakfas, the Piiacas, the Gandharvas and all the Apsaras, all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again he creates living beings, the mobile and the immobile ones, the Yakfas, the Piiacas, the Gandharvas and all the Apsaras, all round.

verses.sanskrit: नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः । ब्रह्मा यथात्मकानां तु सर्वेषां ब्रह्मयोगिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ / brahmā yathātmakānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ brahmayoginām
verses.translation: He created men, Kinnaras, RSkasas, the birds, the animals, the deer and the serpents. He created the two types, the mobile and the immobile, as well as the Vjfoya (perishable) and the Avyaya (Imperishable).
verses.wordMeaning: He created men, Kinnaras, RSkasas, the birds, the animals, the deer and the serpents. He created the two types, the mobile and the immobile, as well as the Vjfoya (perishable) and the Avyaya (Imperishable).
verses.commentary: Sense: He created men, Kinnaras, RSkasas, the birds, the animals, the deer and the serpents. He created the two types, the mobile and the immobile, as well as the Vjfoya (perishable) and the Avyaya (Imperishable).

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसृजत्पुनर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रं रोषत्मसंभवम् । संकल्पं चैव धर्म च सर्वेषामेव पर्वतौ
verses.transliteration: tato 'sṛjatpunarbrahmā rudraṃ roṣatmasaṃbhavam / saṃkalpaṃ caiva dharma ca sarveṣāmeva parvatau
verses.translation: This II the iflOEonble Lew of Karmaa. Even ster KalpAnta, the KanxiA follows Its doer immediately alter the new ereatioo of the wodd.
verses.wordMeaning: This II the iflOEonble Lew of Karmaa. Even ster KalpAnta, the KanxiA follows Its doer immediately alter the new ereatioo of the wodd.
verses.commentary: Sense: This II the iflOEonble Lew of Karmaa. Even ster KalpAnta, the KanxiA follows Its doer immediately alter the new ereatioo of the wodd.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽसृजद्व्यवसायं तु ब्रह्मा भूतं सुखात्मकम् । संकल्पाच्चैव संकल्पो जज्ञे सो ऽव्यक्तयोनिनः

verses.sanskrit: प्राणाद्दक्षो ऽसृजद्वाचं चक्षुर्भ्यां च मरीचिनम् । भृगुश्च हृदयाज्जज्ञे ऋषिः सलिलयोनिनः
verses.transliteration: prāṇāddakṣo 'sṛjadvācaṃ cakṣurbhyāṃ ca marīcinam / bhṛguśca hṛdayājjajñe ṛṣiḥ salilayoninaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 100-103 give an aUegorical description of the universe or Saifuira as the forest tree of god Brahma. The compariton with the tree and the universe is as follows.
verses.hindi: योजनों की अग्रता से वहाँ पर उन पवंतों में जो निवास किया करते हैं उत्तका ,भी-बर्णन किया जाता है ओर भारत आदि वर्षों का नदियों के और पर्वतों के साथ बर्णन किया जाता है ।७१। जो कि भूतों से और सति- मान् प्रूजों के साथ वहां पर उपनिबिष्ट हैं उनका कीत्तंन किया जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 100-103 give an aUegorical description of the universe or Saifuira as the forest tree of god Brahma. The compariton with the tree and the universe is as follows.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 100-103 give an aUegorical description of the universe or Saifuira as the forest tree of god Brahma. The compariton with the tree and the universe is as follows.

verses.sanskrit: शिरसश्चाङ्गिराश्चैव श्रोत्रादत्रिस्तथैव च । पुलस्त्यश्च तथोदानाद्व्यानात्तु पुलहस्तथा
verses.transliteration: śirasaścāṅgirāścaiva śrotrādatristathaiva ca / pulastyaśca tathodānādvyānāttu pulahastathā
verses.translation: This ii called iiaugraAa creation as it v caused or created through the fiivour of Atota or Prakrti aa noted ia V.lOO above
verses.hindi: जम्बू द्वीप आदि द्वीप सात असुद्रों के द्वारा घिरे हुए हैं ।७२। वहाँ पर स्वर्ण से परिपूर्ण है और बहा पर लोकालोक नाम वाला पर्वत है--यह्-बताया जाता है.।ये सब लोक प्रमाणों से युक्त हैं और सप्तद्वीप तथा पृथिवी हैं-- इसका: भी प्रमाण बताया जाता है।७३। करण से प्राकृतों के साथ-साथ
verses.wordMeaning: This ii called iiaugraAa creation as it v caused or created through the fiivour of Atota or Prakrti aa noted ia V.lOO above
verses.commentary: Sense: This ii called iiaugraAa creation as it v caused or created through the fiivour of Atota or Prakrti aa noted ia V.lOO above

verses.sanskrit: समानतो वसिष्ठश्च ह्यपानान्निर्ममे क्रतुम् । इत्येते ब्रह्मणः श्रेष्ठाः पुत्रा वै द्वादश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: samānato vasiṣṭhaśca hyapānānnirmame kratum / ityete brahmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ putrā vai dvādaśa smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: As noted above three are Pfikrta aargai and lix arc Vaikfia amt. Tins nakei the total of nine cfeacioos.
verses.hindi: प्रादिक का कीत्त न किया जाता है। यह सभी कुछ प्रधान के परिमाण: काः एक देशिका है,अर्थात् यह सब प्रकृति के परिणाम के कारण ही होता है
verses.wordMeaning: As noted above three are Pfikrta aargai and lix arc Vaikfia amt. Tins nakei the total of nine cfeacioos.
verses.commentary: Sense: As noted above three are Pfikrta aargai and lix arc Vaikfia amt. Tins nakei the total of nine cfeacioos.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मादयः प्रथमजा विज्ञेया ब्रह्ममः स्मृताः । भृग्वादयस्तु ये सृष्टा न च ते ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: dharmādayaḥ prathamajā vijñeyā brahmamaḥ smṛtāḥ / bhṛgvādayastu ye sṛṣṭā na ca te brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: * After staying there for ten Kalpas they go again to the (world of) Satya. (Those who reach) the world of Brahma attain the goal from which they never return.
verses.hindi: इनका-पर्याय-परिणाम यहाँ पर बहुत ही संक्षेप के साथ कीतित किया जाता है। सूर्य और चन्द्र का तथा पृथिवी का पूर्ण परिणाम बताया जाता है-
verses.wordMeaning: * After staying there for ten Kalpas they go again to the (world of) Satya. (Those who reach) the world of Brahma attain the goal from which they never return.
verses.commentary: Sense: * After staying there for ten Kalpas they go again to the (world of) Satya. (Those who reach) the world of Brahma attain the goal from which they never return.

verses.sanskrit: गृहमेधिपुराणास्ते विज्ञेया ब्रह्मणः सुताः । द्वादशैते प्रसूयन्ते सह रूद्रेण च द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: gṛhamedhipurāṇāste vijñeyā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ / dvādaśaite prasūyante saha rūdreṇa ca dvijāḥ
verses.translation: With the exception of overiordship, they are on a par with him in regard to Aiioafya (prosperity, power to control etc.) They become equal to Brahma as far as form and object are concerned.
verses.hindi: इस समय में होने वाले उनके अभिमानी अर्थात् स्वामियों का प्रमाण योजनों के हिसाब से कहा जाता है। मानस के उत्तर में ऊपर परम शुभ और पुष्पः मय महेन्द्र आदि हैं--उनका वर्णन,है। इसके ऊपर अलात. (मशाल). के चक्र की भांति सूर्य की गति बतायी गयी है। ओर नागवीथी तथा अक्षवीथी का
verses.wordMeaning: With the exception of overiordship, they are on a par with him in regard to Aiioafya (prosperity, power to control etc.) They become equal to Brahma as far as form and object are concerned.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the exception of overiordship, they are on a par with him in regard to Aiioafya (prosperity, power to control etc.) They become equal to Brahma as far as form and object are concerned.

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुः सनत्कुमारश्च द्वावेतावूर्द्धरेतसौ । पूर्वोत्पत्तौ पुरा ह्येतौ सर्वेषामपि पूर्वजौ
verses.transliteration: kratuḥ sanatkumāraśca dvāvetāvūrddharetasau / pūrvotpattau purā hyetau sarveṣāmapi pūrvajau
verses.translation: There they stay endowed with pleasure and accompanied by themselves (and their possessions). On account of the inevitability of the matter, it (he) expands the Prakrta (creation) himself.
verses.wordMeaning: There they stay endowed with pleasure and accompanied by themselves (and their possessions). On account of the inevitability of the matter, it (he) expands the Prakrta (creation) himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: There they stay endowed with pleasure and accompanied by themselves (and their possessions). On account of the inevitability of the matter, it (he) expands the Prakrta (creation) himself.

verses.sanskrit: व्यतीतौ सप्तमे कल्पे पुराणौ लोकसाधकौ । विरजेते ऽत्र वै लोके तेजसाक्षिप्य चात्मनः
verses.transliteration: vyatītau saptame kalpe purāṇau lokasādhakau / virajete 'tra vai loke tejasākṣipya cātmanaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: An echo Imn the Funisa SCkts ((tV.X.90)
verses.commentary: Sense: An echo Imn the Funisa SCkts ((tV.X.90)

verses.sanskrit: तापुभौ योगधर्माणावारोप्यात्मानमात्मना । प्रजाधर्मं च कामं च वर्तयेते महौजसौ
verses.transliteration: tāpubhau yogadharmāṇāvāropyātmānamātmanā / prajādharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca vartayete mahaujasau
verses.translation: The contact of the Tuktas (sages ofYogic practice) the seers of reality should be known as Prakrti. It is the cause of their Apavarga (salvation) of those persons who go on a never to return journey of those who arc not reborn.
verses.wordMeaning: The contact of the Tuktas (sages ofYogic practice) the seers of reality should be known as Prakrti. It is the cause of their Apavarga (salvation) of those persons who go on a never to return journey of those who arc not reborn.

verses.sanskrit: यथोत्पन्नस्तथैवेह कुमार इति चोच्यते । ततः सनत्कुमारेति नाम तस्य प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: yathotpannastathaiveha kumāra iti cocyate / tataḥ sanatkumāreti nāma tasya pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: While on that occasion the residents of the surface of the earth are staying there,* the thousand rays of the sun perish (?). They become seven rays and each one of these rays becomes a sun. Gradually they assume a hundred times in* creased magnitude and bum the three worlds.

They become seven rays and each one of these rays becomes a sun. Gradually they assume a hundred times in* creased magnitude and bum the three worlds.

verses.transliteration: tataste salile tasmin naṣṭāgnau pṛthivītale / praśāntavāte 'ndhakāre nirāloke samantataḥ
verses.translation: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
