verses.sanskrit: येनैवाधिष्ठितं हीदं ब्रह्मणः पुरुषः प्रभुः । विभागमस्य लोकस्य प्रकर्तुं पुनरैच्छत
verses.transliteration: yenaivādhiṣṭhitaṃ hīdaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ / vibhāgamasya lokasya prakartuṃ punaraicchata
verses.translation: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.hindi: पात्रों का; दुम्धों का और वत्सों का विशेषण वताया'गया है। यूज में ही ब्रह्मा आदिं'के द्वारा'इस' वसुन्धरा का दोहन किया गया था ।१०६। देश प्रचेताओं से मारिया में अ'श' से समान धीमान्. दक्ष के जन्मे कां कीने किया जाता है ।१०७। महेन्द्रो के भूतभव्य और शवेशत्व का कीत्त न किया
verses.wordMeaning: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.commentary: Sense: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.

verses.sanskrit: शार इत्येव शीर्णे तु नानार्थो धातु रुच्यते । एकर्णवे ततस्तस्मिन्नष्टे स्थावर जङ्गमे । तदा भवति स ब्रह्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्
verses.transliteration: śāra ityeva śīrṇe tu nānārtho dhātu rucyate / ekarṇave tatastasminnaṣṭe sthāvara jaṅgame / tadā bhavati sa brahmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt
verses.translation: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.hindi: जातौ है। बहुत से आंड्यानों से युक्त मन्वादिक होंगे ।१०८ा Mss के स्गेका विस्तार कहा'जाता'है और ब्रह्मादि "कोशे और चुगुं आदि' उत्पत्ति का वर्णन किया जाता है ।१०हा विनिष्कर्षक करके'चाक्'प मनुके शुभ प्रजा के सँ में वेतस्वत के अन्तर में ब्यान से दक्ष के सगे का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.commentary: Sense: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्मवर्णो ह्यतीन्द्रियः । ब्रह्मा नारायणा ख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा
verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇo hyatīndriyaḥ / brahmā nārāyaṇā khyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā
verses.translation: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.hindi: किया जाता है ।११०। ब्रह्माजी के मानस अर्थात् मन से सनुत्पन्न पुत्र श्री नारद जी नें सम्बांद'करके महाव् वलवान् दक्ष के पुत्रों को शापं'के लिए विनाश युक्त कर दिया: का ।१११। इसके अनन्तरे प्रजापति दक्ष ने कन्याओं को समुत्पन्न किया था जो कि वैरी के द्वारा नाम विश्वुत हुए थे मंते के
verses.wordMeaning: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.commentary: Sense: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वोद्रेकात्प्रबुद्धस्तु स शून्यं लोकमैक्षत । अनेनाद्येन पादेन पुराणं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: sattvodrekātprabuddhastu sa śūnyaṃ lokamaikṣata / anenādyena pādena purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.hindi: प्रवाह में मरुत देवी दिति में समुत्पन्न हुआ'था
verses.wordMeaning: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.
verses.commentary: Sense: MW. does not give a word tike Apaiwu or Upatatw.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापादे लोककल्पनं नाम पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच इत्येवं प्रथमं पादं प्रकृत्यर्थं प्रकीर्तितम् । श्रुत्वा तु संहृष्टमनाः कापेयः संशयायति
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpāde lokakalpanaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca ityevaṃ prathamaṃ pādaṃ prakṛtyarthaṃ prakīrtitam / śrutvā tu saṃhṛṣṭamanāḥ kāpeyaḥ saṃśayāyati
verses.translation: On hearing the first Pada (section) the main theme of which is the Prakrti» thus recountedt Kapeya (Kaiyapeya in V&.P.) who was delighted had some doubts.
verses.hindi: कीत्यैन्ते मरुतां चात्र गणास्ले सप्त सश्तकाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the first Pada (section) the main theme of which is the Prakrti» thus recountedt Kapeya (Kaiyapeya in V&.P.) who was delighted had some doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the first Pada (section) the main theme of which is the Prakrti» thus recountedt Kapeya (Kaiyapeya in V&.P.) who was delighted had some doubts.

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य वचसा सूतं तस्यार्थ त्वपरां कथाम् । अथ प्रबृति कल्पज्ञः प्रतिसंधिः प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: ārādhya vacasā sūtaṃ tasyārtha tvaparāṃ kathām / atha prabṛti kalpajñaḥ pratisaṃdhiḥ pracakṣate
verses.translation: On being thus requested by Kapeya, Suta> the most excellent among eloquent men, began to narrate the origin of the three worlds entirely.
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus requested by Kapeya, Suta> the most excellent among eloquent men, began to narrate the origin of the three worlds entirely.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus requested by Kapeya, Suta> the most excellent among eloquent men, began to narrate the origin of the three worlds entirely.

verses.sanskrit: समतीतस्य कल्पस्य वर्तमानस्य चानयोः । कल्पयोरन्तरं यत्र प्रतिसंधिश्च यस्तयोः । एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि यथावत्कुशलो ह्यसि
verses.transliteration: samatītasya kalpasya vartamānasya cānayoḥ / kalpayorantaraṃ yatra pratisaṃdhiśca yastayoḥ / etadveditumicchāmi yathāvatkuśalo hyasi
verses.translation: Now I shall describe factually, O men of holy vows, the Kalpa of the past and the Kalpa of the future and the period of transit that is between these two.
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall describe factually, O men of holy vows, the Kalpa of the past and the Kalpa of the future and the period of transit that is between these two.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall describe factually, O men of holy vows, the Kalpa of the past and the Kalpa of the future and the period of transit that is between these two.

verses.sanskrit: कापेयेनैवमुक्तस्तु सूतः प्रवदतां वरः । त्रैलोक्यस्योद्भवं कृत्स्नमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: kāpeyenaivamuktastu sūtaḥ pravadatāṃ varaḥ / trailokyasyodbhavaṃ kṛtsnamākhyātumupacakrame
verses.translation: (I shall also describe) O men of holy rites, the dif* ferent Manvantaras in the Kalpas. The Kalpa that is current now is Varaha—an auspicious Kalpa.
verses.wordMeaning: (I shall also describe) O men of holy rites, the dif* ferent Manvantaras in the Kalpas. The Kalpa that is current now is Varaha—an auspicious Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: (I shall also describe) O men of holy rites, the dif* ferent Manvantaras in the Kalpas. The Kalpa that is current now is Varaha—an auspicious Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तराणि कल्पेषु यानि यानि च सुव्रताः । यश्चायं वर्तते कल्पो वाराहः सांप्रतः शुभः
verses.transliteration: manvantarāṇi kalpeṣu yāni yāni ca suvratāḥ / yaścāyaṃ vartate kalpo vārāhaḥ sāṃprataḥ śubhaḥ
verses.translation: Understand themtervcning transitional stage between this Kalpa and the old (ancient) Kalpa that preceded this and passed away.
verses.wordMeaning: Understand themtervcning transitional stage between this Kalpa and the old (ancient) Kalpa that preceded this and passed away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand themtervcning transitional stage between this Kalpa and the old (ancient) Kalpa that preceded this and passed away.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मात्कल्पात्तु यः पूर्वः कल्पो ऽतीतः सनातनः । तस्य चास्य च कल्पस्य मध्यावस्थां निबोधत
verses.transliteration: asmātkalpāttu yaḥ pūrvaḥ kalpo 'tītaḥ sanātanaḥ / tasya cāsya ca kalpasya madhyāvasthāṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: When the previous Kalpa recedes without a Prati- sandhi (intermediate period), another Kalpa begins again with Janaloka and others.
verses.hindi: इसमें मरुतों कें गणों कें सात सप्तक अर्थात् उनचास कीत्तित किये जाते हैं । इनको इन्द्र के वास होने से देवत्व है तथा वायु के.स्कन्धों में आश्रम है ।११३। हैत्यों की--दानवों की ओर यक्ष=-गन्धने तथा राक्षसों की-सब भूत और पिशाचों की-यक्षों की--पक्षियों की और बीसधों की
verses.wordMeaning: When the previous Kalpa recedes without a Prati- sandhi (intermediate period), another Kalpa begins again with Janaloka and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the previous Kalpa recedes without a Prati- sandhi (intermediate period), another Kalpa begins again with Janaloka and others.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यागते पूर्वकल्पे प्रतिसंधिं विनानघाः । अन्यः प्रवर्त्तते कल्पो जनलोकादयः पुनः
verses.transliteration: pratyāgate pūrvakalpe pratisaṃdhiṃ vinānaghāḥ / anyaḥ pravarttate kalpo janalokādayaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Two (consecutive) Kalpas have a transitional stage separating them mutually. All beings are completely annihilat¬ ed at the end of a Kalpa.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्तियाँ हुईं थीं।११४। इन सबकी उत्पत्तियों का और अप्सराओं की उत्पत्ति का बहुत विस्तृत कोत्तंन किया जाता है-। सम्पूर्ण मार्तण्ड मण्डल का और ऐरावत हुस्ती का जन्म बताया गया है ।११५॥ बेनतेग की उत्पत्ति और राज्य पर अभिषेक का वर्णन है  भूगुओं का और अज़िराओं का
verses.wordMeaning: Two (consecutive) Kalpas have a transitional stage separating them mutually. All beings are completely annihilat¬ ed at the end of a Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two (consecutive) Kalpas have a transitional stage separating them mutually. All beings are completely annihilat¬ ed at the end of a Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: व्युच्छिन्नप्रतिसंधिस्तु कल्पात्कल्पः परस्परम् । व्युच्छिद्यन्ते प्रजाः सर्वाः कल्पान्ते सर्वशस्तदा
verses.transliteration: vyucchinnapratisaṃdhistu kalpātkalpaḥ parasparam / vyucchidyante prajāḥ sarvāḥ kalpānte sarvaśastadā
verses.translation: Further, in everyone of theKalpas, thcDcvas moving about in aerial chariots are remembered to be seventy thousand more.
verses.hindi: विस्तार कहा गया है ।११६। जहाँ पर कश्यप--पुलस्त्य और महात्मा अति का तथा पराशर मुनि की प्रजाओं का विस्तार बताया गया है ।११७। तीत्त कन्याऐ' बतायी जाती हैं जिनमें सबलोक प्रतिष्ठित हैं । इच्छा का विस्तार कहा गया है और इसके बाद आदित्य का विस्तृत वर्णन है ।११०। किकुवित्
verses.wordMeaning: Further, in everyone of theKalpas, thcDcvas moving about in aerial chariots are remembered to be seventy thousand more.
verses.commentary: Sense: Further, in everyone of theKalpas, thcDcvas moving about in aerial chariots are remembered to be seventy thousand more.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्कल्पात्तु कल्पस्य प्रतिसंधिर्न विद्यते । मन्वन्तरे युगाख्यानामविच्छिन्नास्तु संधयः
verses.transliteration: tasmātkalpāttu kalpasya pratisaṃdhirna vidyate / manvantare yugākhyānāmavicchinnāstu saṃdhayaḥ
verses.translation: In the fourteen Manvantaras there were the Devas, the Pitrs and the sages imbibing nectar (A.mrtapas) in the firmament and heaven.
verses.hindi: का चरित कहा गया है । धुव का निवर्हण है। बृहद्लों का वर्णन है और संक्षेप से इक्वाकु आदि कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In the fourteen Manvantaras there were the Devas, the Pitrs and the sages imbibing nectar (A.mrtapas) in the firmament and heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the fourteen Manvantaras there were the Devas, the Pitrs and the sages imbibing nectar (A.mrtapas) in the firmament and heaven.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परात् प्रवर्तन्ते मन्वन्तरयुगैः सह । उक्ता ये प्रक्रियार्थेन पूर्वकल्पाः समासतः
verses.transliteration: parasparāt pravartante manvantarayugaiḥ saha / uktā ye prakriyārthena pūrvakalpāḥ samāsataḥ
verses.translation: They had their servants (followers), wives and sons. At that time, the Devas in the firmament were beyond the discipline of the Vardas (castes) and the Jiframas (stages in life).
verses.wordMeaning: They had their servants (followers), wives and sons. At that time, the Devas in the firmament were beyond the discipline of the Vardas (castes) and the Jiframas (stages in life).
verses.commentary: Sense: They had their servants (followers), wives and sons. At that time, the Devas in the firmament were beyond the discipline of the Vardas (castes) and the Jiframas (stages in life).

verses.sanskrit: तेषां परार्द्धकल्पानां पूर्वे यस्मात्तु यः परः । आसीत्कल्पे व्यतीते वै परर्द्धात्परमस्तु यः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ parārddhakalpānāṃ pūrve yasmāttu yaḥ paraḥ / āsītkalpe vyatīte vai pararddhātparamastu yaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, when the annihilation of all living beings along with objects approached, all of them became persons of equal position and condition with those that had attained
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, when the annihilation of all living beings along with objects approached, all of them became persons of equal position and condition with those that had attained
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, when the annihilation of all living beings along with objects approached, all of them became persons of equal position and condition with those that had attained

verses.sanskrit: कल्पास्त्वन्ये भविष्या ये ह्यपरार्द्धगुणीकृताः । प्रथमः सांप्रतस्तेषां कल्प्ॐ यो वर्तते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: kalpāstvanye bhaviṣyā ye hyaparārddhaguṇīkṛtāḥ / prathamaḥ sāṃpratasteṣāṃ kalpoṃ yo vartate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: (Defective text). They practise Yoga and make use of the great (thing) in the body** (?) All of them abound in purity. They have achieved the mental Siddhi (achievement).
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text). They practise Yoga and make use of the great (thing) in the body** (?) All of them abound in purity. They have achieved the mental Siddhi (achievement).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text). They practise Yoga and make use of the great (thing) in the body** (?) All of them abound in purity. They have achieved the mental Siddhi (achievement).

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्पूर्वे परार्द्धे तु द्वितीयः पर उच्यते । एष संस्थितकालस्तु प्रत्याहारस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: asminpūrve parārddhe tu dvitīyaḥ para ucyate / eṣa saṃsthitakālastu pratyāhārastataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: W.24I describe the progress of gods upto Sstya-loka, the region of god BrahoiS.
verses.wordMeaning: W.24I describe the progress of gods upto Sstya-loka, the region of god BrahoiS.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.24I describe the progress of gods upto Sstya-loka, the region of god BrahoiS.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मात्कल्पात्ततः पूर्वं कल्पो ऽतीतः पुरातनः । चतुर्युगसहस्रति सह मन्वन्तरैः पुरा
verses.transliteration: asmātkalpāttataḥ pūrvaṃ kalpo 'tītaḥ purātanaḥ / caturyugasahasrati saha manvantaraiḥ purā
verses.translation: AAer going to Maharloka, the fourteen groups of the Devaa become agitated. Thereafter, they directed their mind towards Janaloka.
verses.wordMeaning: AAer going to Maharloka, the fourteen groups of the Devaa become agitated. Thereafter, they directed their mind towards Janaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: AAer going to Maharloka, the fourteen groups of the Devaa become agitated. Thereafter, they directed their mind towards Janaloka.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीणे कल्पे ततस्तस्मिन् दाहकाल उपस्थिते । तस्मिन्काले तदा देवा आसन्वैमानिकास्तु ये
verses.transliteration: kṣīṇe kalpe tatastasmin dāhakāla upasthite / tasminkāle tadā devā āsanvaimānikāstu ye
verses.translation: In thb order the residents of the Kalpa mutually(?) proceeded for thousands of Yugas according to the reckoning of the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: In thb order the residents of the Kalpa mutually(?) proceeded for thousands of Yugas according to the reckoning of the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In thb order the residents of the Kalpa mutually(?) proceeded for thousands of Yugas according to the reckoning of the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रग्रहताराश्च चन्द्रसूर्यादयस्तु ते । अष्टाविंशतिरेवैताः कोट्यस्तु सुकृतात्म नाम्
verses.transliteration: nakṣatragrahatārāśca candrasūryādayastu te / aṣṭāviṃśatirevaitāḥ koṭyastu sukṛtātma nām
verses.translation: All of them abounded in purity. They have achieved the mental Siddhi (achievement of spiritual powers), the Jana (Loka) was attained by those residents of Kalpa together.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them abounded in purity. They have achieved the mental Siddhi (achievement of spiritual powers), the Jana (Loka) was attained by those residents of Kalpa together.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them abounded in purity. They have achieved the mental Siddhi (achievement of spiritual powers), the Jana (Loka) was attained by those residents of Kalpa together.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरे यथैकस्मिन् चतुर्द्दशसु वै तथा । त्रीणि कोटिशतान्यासन् कोट्यो द्विनवतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: manvantare yathaikasmin caturddaśasu vai tathā / trīṇi koṭiśatānyāsan koṭyo dvinavatistathā
verses.translation: After staying there for ten Kalpas, they go to the Satya (Loka) once again. After going to the world of Brahm4, they attain a goal from where there is no return.
verses.wordMeaning: After staying there for ten Kalpas, they go to the Satya (Loka) once again. After going to the world of Brahm4, they attain a goal from where there is no return.
verses.commentary: Sense: After staying there for ten Kalpas, they go to the Satya (Loka) once again. After going to the world of Brahm4, they attain a goal from where there is no return.

verses.sanskrit: अथाधिकासप्त तिश्च सहस्राणां पुरा स्मृता । एकैकस्मिंस्तु कल्पे वै देवा वैमानिकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: athādhikāsapta tiśca sahasrāṇāṃ purā smṛtā / ekaikasmiṃstu kalpe vai devā vaimānikāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Except the overlordship, they become equal to Brahmi. They are equal to Brahma in regard to features and object (of the sense organs) (i.e. Vifaya).
verses.hindi: निण्यादिक नृपों का पलाण्डु हरण आदि के द्वारा भूपति ययाति का भी समे विस्तार पूर्वक कहा गया है ।१२०। राजा यदु के बंश का समुर्द श और हैहय का निस्तार बताया गया है। क्रोध के अनन्तर बंश का विस्तार कहा गया है.।१२१। ज्यामघ का माहाटम्य और उसकी प्रजाओं की उत्पत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Except the overlordship, they become equal to Brahmi. They are equal to Brahma in regard to features and object (of the sense organs) (i.e. Vifaya).
verses.commentary: Sense: Except the overlordship, they become equal to Brahmi. They are equal to Brahma in regard to features and object (of the sense organs) (i.e. Vifaya).

verses.sanskrit: अथ मन्वन्तरेष्वासंश्चतुर्दशसु खे दिवि । देवाश्च पितरश्चैव ऋषयो ऽमृतपास्तथा
verses.transliteration: atha manvantareṣvāsaṃścaturdaśasu khe divi / devāśca pitaraścaiva ṛṣayo 'mṛtapāstathā
verses.translation: There they stay with pleasure in the Sarhyamas* (? worlds of that name). After attaining bliss from Brahman, they become liberated along with Brahma.
verses.hindi: कीत्तित की जाती है । देवा बृध--अन्धक ओर महान आत्मा वाले धृष्टि का बणेन किया जाता है ।१२२। अनमित्र का बंश-वर्णन, तथा विशु का मिथ्या अभिशंसन और धीमान् मणिरत्न का विरोध तथा अनुसम्प्राप्ति बतायी गयी है ।१२३। राजि देवमीढ के प्रजा के सर्गे में सत्राजित् -और शूर का भी
verses.wordMeaning: There they stay with pleasure in the Sarhyamas* (? worlds of that name). After attaining bliss from Brahman, they become liberated along with Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: There they stay with pleasure in the Sarhyamas* (? worlds of that name). After attaining bliss from Brahman, they become liberated along with Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामनुचराश्चैव पत्न्यः पुत्रास्तथैव च । वर्णाश्रमातिरिक्ताश्च तस्मिन्काले तु खे सुराः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmanucarāścaiva patnyaḥ putrāstathaiva ca / varṇāśramātiriktāśca tasminkāle tu khe surāḥ
verses.translation: In view of the inevitability of affairs concerning (the course of) Prakrii, they remain (bound along) with honour, wonhip etc. as is produced at the same time.* *
verses.hindi: जन्म कहा है तथा इस महात्मा का चरित भी बताया गया है ।१२४। राजा कंस की दुरात्मता और एकोवंश्ल से समुत्पत्ति बतायी गयी है। वसुदेव. का जन्म और देवकी के गर्भ से अपरिमित तेज वाले भगवान् विष्णु का आवि- भाव हुआ था ।१२५। इसके पश्चात् ऋषि का सर्गे है और प्रजाओं के समे
verses.wordMeaning: In view of the inevitability of affairs concerning (the course of) Prakrii, they remain (bound along) with honour, wonhip etc. as is produced at the same time.* *
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of the inevitability of affairs concerning (the course of) Prakrii, they remain (bound along) with honour, wonhip etc. as is produced at the same time.* *

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तैः सायुज्यगैः सार्द्ध प्राप्ते वस्तुमये तदा । तुल्यनिष्ठाभवन्सर्वे प्राप्ते ह्याभूतसंप्लवे
verses.transliteration: taistaiḥ sāyujyagaiḥ sārddha prāpte vastumaye tadā / tulyaniṣṭhābhavansarve prāpte hyābhūtasaṃplave
verses.translation: Just as in the case of a sleeping person the faculty of knowledge functions without (clearcut) perceptions {Abuddhi" pQrvam ), so also when they are purified and rendered service, the bliss begins to function.
verses.hindi: का उपवर्णन है। देवासुर के समुत्पन्न होने पर विष्णु भगवानू के द्वारा स्त्री का वध किये जाने पर।१२६१ इन्द्र के बघ का संरक्षण करने वाले ने पहिले
verses.wordMeaning: Just as in the case of a sleeping person the faculty of knowledge functions without (clearcut) perceptions {Abuddhi" pQrvam ), so also when they are purified and rendered service, the bliss begins to function.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as in the case of a sleeping person the faculty of knowledge functions without (clearcut) perceptions {Abuddhi" pQrvam ), so also when they are purified and rendered service, the bliss begins to function.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते ऽवश्यभावित्वादू बुद्ध्याः पर्या यमात्मनः । त्रैलोक्यवासिनो देवा इह तानाभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: tataste 'vaśyabhāvitvādū buddhyāḥ paryā yamātmanaḥ / trailokyavāsino devā iha tānābhimāninaḥ
verses.translation: (The bliss begins to function) by the withholdings of differences. These arc different in regard to lustrous ones. Along with them their effects and instruments (sense organs) also develop.
verses.hindi: २४   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण भृगु का शाप प्राप्त किया था और भूगु ने शुक्र की दिव्य माता -को उठाया था
verses.wordMeaning: (The bliss begins to function) by the withholdings of differences. These arc different in regard to lustrous ones. Along with them their effects and instruments (sense organs) also develop.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The bliss begins to function) by the withholdings of differences. These arc different in regard to lustrous ones. Along with them their effects and instruments (sense organs) also develop.

verses.sanskrit: स्थितिकाले तदा पूर्णे आसन्ने पश्चिमोत्तरे । कल्पावसानिका देवास्त स्मिनप्राप्ते ह्युपप्लवे
verses.transliteration: sthitikāle tadā pūrṇe āsanne paścimottare / kalpāvasānikā devāsta sminaprāpte hyupaplave
verses.translation: Afier proclaiming itself (or the soul), the Prakrti is factually observed as different from Purua and as multifarious and as such it functions.
verses.hindi: देवानां च ऋषीणां च संक्रमा द्वादशाहता: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Afier proclaiming itself (or the soul), the Prakrti is factually observed as different from Purua and as multifarious and as such it functions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afier proclaiming itself (or the soul), the Prakrti is factually observed as different from Purua and as multifarious and as such it functions.

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्सुका विषादेंन त्यक्तस्थानानि भागशः । महर्लोकाय संविग्नास्ततस्ते दधिरे मनः
verses.transliteration: tadotsukā viṣādeṃna tyaktasthānāni bhāgaśaḥ / maharlokāya saṃvignāstataste dadhire manaḥ
verses.translation: Again when the creation begins to function Prakrti should be known in its connection with the liberated (?) souls who perceive reality and who arc identical with the existent causes.
verses.wordMeaning: Again when the creation begins to function Prakrti should be known in its connection with the liberated (?) souls who perceive reality and who arc identical with the existent causes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again when the creation begins to function Prakrti should be known in its connection with the liberated (?) souls who perceive reality and who arc identical with the existent causes.

verses.sanskrit: ते युक्ता नुपपद्यन्ते महतीं च शरीरिके । विशुद्धिबहुलाः सर्वे मानसीं सिद्धिमास्थिताः
verses.transliteration: te yuktā nupapadyante mahatīṃ ca śarīrike / viśuddhibahulāḥ sarve mānasīṃ siddhimāsthitāḥ
verses.translation: There, those persons attaining salvation do not return by the same path (of Saihsara). There non existence had been caused once again like that of (he blazing flames that had been extinguished.
verses.wordMeaning: There, those persons attaining salvation do not return by the same path (of Saihsara). There non existence had been caused once again like that of (he blazing flames that had been extinguished.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, those persons attaining salvation do not return by the same path (of Saihsara). There non existence had been caused once again like that of (he blazing flames that had been extinguished.

verses.sanskrit: तैः कल्पवासिभिः सार्द्धं महानासादितस्तदा । ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैस्तद्भवैश्चापरैर्जनैः
verses.transliteration: taiḥ kalpavāsibhiḥ sārddhaṃ mahānāsāditastadā / brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaistadbhavaiścāparairjanaiḥ
verses.translation: While those noble souls had gone far above the three worlds along with these, the Maharloka is not occupied by them.
verses.hindi: देवों के और ऋषियों के संक्रम से द्वादण आहूत हुए थे । नारसिंह
verses.wordMeaning: While those noble souls had gone far above the three worlds along with these, the Maharloka is not occupied by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: While those noble souls had gone far above the three worlds along with these, the Maharloka is not occupied by them.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तु ते महार्लोकं देवसंघाश्चतुर्द्दश । स्ततस्ते जनलोकाय सोद्वेगा दधिरे मनः
verses.transliteration: gatvā tu te mahārlokaṃ devasaṃghāścaturddaśa / stataste janalokāya sodvegā dadhire manaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. the concept ot Brahnanifvd9a in the BG. VV.24*26.
verses.hindi: प्रभुति पापों के भाश करने वाले कौत्तित किये गये हैं।१२८। अत्यन्त घोर तफ के द्वारा शुक्र देव ने भगवानु शिव की आराधना की थी । फिर उसने बर के प्रदान करने वाले भगवान् शिव की स्तुति की थी ।१२९। इसके उप- रान्तं देवों और असुरों की विशेष चेष्टा का निर्देश किया गया है जह पर
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. the concept ot Brahnanifvd9a in the BG. VV.24*26.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. the concept ot Brahnanifvd9a in the BG. VV.24*26.

verses.sanskrit: एतेन क्रमयोगेन ययुस्ते कल्पवासिनः । एवं देवयुगानां तु सहस्राणि परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: etena kramayogena yayuste kalpavāsinaḥ / evaṃ devayugānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi parasparam
verses.translation: VV. 43-60. This desetipeu of the Kalpa-dlha and the end of the
verses.hindi: महात्मा में शुक्र ने जयन्ती के साथ इन्द्र ने किया था ।१३० बुद्धिमान् ने इत्र के रूप से असुरों को मोहित कर दिया था। और महती ' ति वाले वृहस्पति ने शुक्राचार्य को लाप दे दिया था ।१३१। भगवान् विष्णु के जन्म में विष्णु का माहात्म्य कहा जाता हैं। वहाँ पर तुर्वसु'दौ हित्र था जो यदु
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 43-60. This desetipeu of the Kalpa-dlha and the end of the
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 43-60. This desetipeu of the Kalpa-dlha and the end of the

verses.sanskrit: विशुद्धिबहुलाः सर्वे मानसीं सिद्धिमास्थिताः । तैः कल्पवासिभिः सार्द्धं जन आसादितस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: viśuddhibahulāḥ sarve mānasīṃ siddhimāsthitāḥ / taiḥ kalpavāsibhiḥ sārddhaṃ jana āsāditastu vai
verses.translation: They arc well known* ** and freed from the sunshine by the auspicious (rain) that has great continuity shower* ing incessantly. Thereafter, those people are joined with other people of similar forms and features.
verses.hindi: का सब से छोटा हुआ था ।१३२। अनुद्रुह्य आदि सब नृप उसके पुत्र हुए थे। उसके महात्मा श्र ष्ठ नृप उनके पीछे बंश में होने वाले हुए थे
verses.wordMeaning: They arc well known* ** and freed from the sunshine by the auspicious (rain) that has great continuity shower* ing incessantly. Thereafter, those people are joined with other people of similar forms and features.
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc well known* ** and freed from the sunshine by the auspicious (rain) that has great continuity shower* ing incessantly. Thereafter, those people are joined with other people of similar forms and features.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कल्पान्दश स्थित्वा सत्यं गच्छन्ति वै पुनः । गत्वा ते ब्रह्मलोकं वै अपरावर्त्तिनीं गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tatra kalpāndaśa sthitvā satyaṃ gacchanti vai punaḥ / gatvā te brahmalokaṃ vai aparāvarttinīṃ gatim
verses.translation: After staying there durii the night of Brahm& born of the unmanifest one, they become the mental sons of Brahmi at the time of subsequent creation.
verses.wordMeaning: After staying there durii the night of Brahm& born of the unmanifest one, they become the mental sons of Brahmi at the time of subsequent creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: After staying there durii the night of Brahm& born of the unmanifest one, they become the mental sons of Brahmi at the time of subsequent creation.

verses.sanskrit: आधिपत्यं विमाने वै ऐश्वर्येण तु तत्समाः । भवन्ति ब्रह्मणा तुल्या रूपेण विषयेण च
verses.transliteration: ādhipatyaṃ vimāne vai aiśvaryeṇa tu tatsamāḥ / bhavanti brahmaṇā tulyā rūpeṇa viṣayeṇa ca
verses.translation: He has the lustre and colour of the sun. He is the protector of the universe. *Hc is single. He is the first Virdf (cosmic personage). He is Hiranyagarbha of noble soul. He is beyond the Ken of mind.
verses.wordMeaning: He has the lustre and colour of the sun. He is the protector of the universe. *Hc is single. He is the first Virdf (cosmic personage). He is Hiranyagarbha of noble soul. He is beyond the Ken of mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has the lustre and colour of the sun. He is the protector of the universe. *Hc is single. He is the first Virdf (cosmic personage). He is Hiranyagarbha of noble soul. He is beyond the Ken of mind.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते ह्यवतिष्ठन्त प्रीतियुक्ताश्च संयमान् । आनन्दं ब्रह्मणः प्राप्य मुच्यन्ते ब्रह्मणा सह
verses.transliteration: tatra te hyavatiṣṭhanta prītiyuktāśca saṃyamān / ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya mucyante brahmaṇā saha
verses.translation: Cf. Punis Sdktt ((tVJC.90). The Vedic concept regarding Virdj, Hirajufgarbka here ide&Ufled with Brahmi or Puruia of the Fumia- sttku are the difTereot stages in the evution. That Puntsa k credited with three gttas for the ertadoo, luitenance and destruction of the universe.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Punis Sdktt ((tVJC.90). The Vedic concept regarding Virdj, Hirajufgarbka here ide&Ufled with Brahmi or Puruia of the Fumia- sttku are the difTereot stages in the evution. That Puntsa k credited with three gttas for the ertadoo, luitenance and destruction of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Punis Sdktt ((tVJC.90). The Vedic concept regarding Virdj, Hirajufgarbka here ide&Ufled with Brahmi or Puruia of the Fumia- sttku are the difTereot stages in the evution. That Puntsa k credited with three gttas for the ertadoo, luitenance and destruction of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: अवश्यभाविनार्थेन प्राकृतेनैव ते स्वयम् । मानार्चनाभिः संबद्धास्तदा तत्कालभाविताः
verses.transliteration: avaśyabhāvinārthena prākṛtenaiva te svayam / mānārcanābhiḥ saṃbaddhāstadā tatkālabhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: All the subjects of the four types (i.e. Svedajay Andya, Udbkijja and Jardyuja) are covered with Tamas, due to the Sakti of Brahma. lathe Maharloka, the great sages see Kala (God of death) sleeping.
verses.wordMeaning: All the subjects of the four types (i.e. Svedajay Andya, Udbkijja and Jardyuja) are covered with Tamas, due to the Sakti of Brahma. lathe Maharloka, the great sages see Kala (God of death) sleeping.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the subjects of the four types (i.e. Svedajay Andya, Udbkijja and Jardyuja) are covered with Tamas, due to the Sakti of Brahma. lathe Maharloka, the great sages see Kala (God of death) sleeping.

verses.sanskrit: स्वपतो बुद्धिपूर्वं तु बोधो भवति वै यथा । तथातु भाविते सेवां तथानन्दः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: svapato buddhipūrvaṃ tu bodho bhavati vai yathā / tathātu bhāvite sevāṃ tathānandaḥ pravartate
verses.translation: At that time the great sages referred to above are Bhrgu and others. The great sages, when the Kalpa comes to a close, are the eight sages, Satya and others. The great thing that is surrounded by them when they revolve is the Makat* (?)
verses.wordMeaning: At that time the great sages referred to above are Bhrgu and others. The great sages, when the Kalpa comes to a close, are the eight sages, Satya and others. The great thing that is surrounded by them when they revolve is the Makat* (?)

verses.transliteration: nānā tvadarśināṃ teṣāṃ brahmalokanivāsinām / vinivṛttādhikāraṇāṃ svena dharmeṇa tiṣṭhatām
verses.translation: Thus Brahma (continuesto function) in thousands of nights. The great sages who were brought by him then saw the sleeping K&la.

verses.transliteration: te tulyalakṣaṇāḥ siddhāḥ śuddhātmāno nirañjanāḥ / prākṛte karaṇopetāḥ svātmanyeva vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: Since in the beginning of the Kalpa, Brahma evolv¬ ed fourteen assemblages (worlds)(?) of diverse forms, it is defined as Kalpa.*

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तिते पुनः सर्गे तेषां साकारणात्मनाम् । संयोगे प्रकृतिर्ज्ञैया मुक्तानां तत्त्वदर्शिनाम्
verses.transliteration: pravartite punaḥ sarge teṣāṃ sākāraṇātmanām / saṃyoge prakṛtirjñaiyā muktānāṃ tattvadarśinām

verses.wordMeaning: A correct etynsology.
verses.commentary: Sense: A correct etynsology.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपवर्गिणां तेषां न पुनर्मार्गगामिनाम् । अभावः पुनरुत्पन्नः शान्तानामर्चिषामिव
verses.transliteration: tatropavargiṇāṃ teṣāṃ na punarmārgagāminām / abhāvaḥ punarutpannaḥ śāntānāmarciṣāmiva
verses.translation: Definitioa of Kalpa; cf. VA. 77.
verses.hindi: जहाँ पर पूर्णरूप से अधिक द्रव्य और तेज वाले विप्रि के धमे के संश्रय से आतिथ्य का कीत्तंन किया जाता है ।१३४। जहाँ पर सूरियों ने बृहस्पति के शाप को प्राप्त किया था । हर बंश के यश का स्पर्श है और राजा शन्तनु के थी पराक्रम का कयन है ।१३५। आगे भविष्य में होने वोलें
verses.wordMeaning: Definitioa of Kalpa; cf. VA. 77.
verses.commentary: Sense: Definitioa of Kalpa; cf. VA. 77.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषु गतेषूर्ध्वं त्रैलोक्येषु महात्मसु । एतैः सार्धं महर्लोकस्तदानासादितस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣu gateṣūrdhvaṃ trailokyeṣu mahātmasu / etaiḥ sārdhaṃ maharlokastadānāsāditastu vai
verses.translation: Thus the inter.relation between two KaSpas has been recounted. The present has become the antecedent state in between the two.
verses.hindi: राजाओं के.उपक्षंहार का कथन है। जो अनागत संघ है और प्रभु हैं उनका उपबणंन है.।१३६। भोत्य के अन्त में कलियुग के क्षोण हो जाने पर संहार का वर्णन.है.। जो भी किसी निमित्त के कारण होने वाले थे, प्राकुतिक ये और जो आस्यन्तिक कहे गये हैं ।१३७। समस्त प्राणियों का अनेक प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the inter.relation between two KaSpas has been recounted. The present has become the antecedent state in between the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the inter.relation between two KaSpas has been recounted. The present has become the antecedent state in between the two.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छिष्या वै भविष्यन्ति कल्पदाह उपस्थिते । गन्धर्वाद्याः पिशाचाश्च मानुषा ब्राह्मणादयः
verses.transliteration: tacchiṣyā vai bhaviṣyanti kalpadāha upasthite / gandharvādyāḥ piśācāśca mānuṣā brāhmaṇādayaḥ
verses.translation: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.hindi: का अप्रतिःसञ्चरण .या.उसक्रा कीर्तन किया जाता है । भगवान् भास्कर का हृष्टि.में न.आने वाला परम घोर संजत'क अनल था ।१३५। सांख्य में लक्षण ०५ 2 है. इसके बाद विशेष रूप से ब्रह्म का वर्णन है। ध्रुव आदि सात
verses.wordMeaning: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.

verses.sanskrit: पशवः पक्षिणस्चैव स्थावराश्च सरीसृपाः । तिष्ठत्सु तेषु तत्कालं पृथिवीतलवासिषु
verses.transliteration: paśavaḥ pakṣiṇascaiva sthāvarāśca sarīsṛpāḥ / tiṣṭhatsu teṣu tatkālaṃ pṛthivītalavāsiṣu

verses.hindi: का उप वर्णन है ।१३९। अपराद्ध परों के द्वारा लक्षण का परिकीत्तन किया जाता है! योजनाभ्र से ब्रह्म के परिमाण का विशेष निणेय किया गमा है ।१४०। रौरव आदि नरका का तवा सभी: प्राणियों के पापों के .निर्णय का वर्णन किया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.

verses.transliteration: tatasteṣūpapanneṣu janaistrailokyavāsiṣu / nirdagdheṣu ca lokeṣu tadā sūryaistu saptabhiḥ

verses.transliteration: vṛṣṭyā kṣitau plāvitāyāṃ vijaneṣvarṇaveṣu ca / sāmudrāścaiva meghāśca āpaḥ sarvāśca pārthivāḥ

verses.transliteration: śaramāṇā vrajantyeva salilākhyāstathā nugāḥ / āgatāgatikaṃ caiva yadā tatsalilaṃ bahu

verses.transliteration: saṃchādyemāṃ sthitāṃ bhamimarṇavākhyaṃ tadābhavat / ābhāti yasmāt svābhāso bhāśabdo vyāptidīptiṣu
verses.translation: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म। के प्रति संसर्ग से सब संसार का वर्णन होता है । धर्म और अधर्म के समाश्रय याली ऊध्वंगति और अधोगति कही गयी है ।१४२। कल्प कल्प में महानु भूतों का भी संक्षय होता है और असंख्य दुःख होते हैं तथा ब्रह्मा को.भी नित्यता नहीं है अर्थात् ब्रह्मा. का भी विनाश होता है

verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ samanuprāptyā tāsāṃ cāmbho vibhāvyate / tadantastanute yasmātsarvāṃ pṛthvīṃ samanta tataḥ
verses.translation: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.hindi: भोगों की दुरात्मता है अर्थात् भोगी का बुरा प्रभाव होता है भौर संहार के समय में बड़ा क्ट होता है । दोषों के देखने से जो वैराग्य उत्पन्न होता है बह बहुत कठित है और मोक्ष होना महान दुर्लेम है।१४४ व्यक्त भौर अष्यक्त का पूर्ण सत्व ब्रह्म में संस्थित हो जाता है। नाना रूपता के दर्शन

verses.transliteration: dhātustanoti vistāre nacaitāstanavaḥ smṛtāḥ / śara ityeṣa śīrṇe tu nānārtho dhāturucyate

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष प्रतिसंबन्धः कीर्तितः कल्पयोर्द्वयोः । सांप्रतं हि तयोर्मध्ये प्रागवस्था बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa pratisaṃbandhaḥ kīrtitaḥ kalpayordvayoḥ / sāṃprataṃ hi tayormadhye prāgavasthā babhūva ha
verses.translation: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.wordMeaning: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तितस्तु समासेन पूर्वकल्पे यथातथम् । सांप्रतं संप्रवक्ष्यामि कल्पमेतं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: kīrtitastu samāsena pūrvakalpe yathātatham / sāṃprataṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi kalpametaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.wordMeaning: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything has been recounted briefly in the previous Kalpa in the manner as it was factually. Now I shall recount the current Kalpa. Understand the same.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये अनुषङ्गापादे कल्पमन्वन्तराख्यानवर्णनं नाम षष्ठो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच तुल्यं युगसहस्रं वै नैशं कालमुपास्य सः । शर्वर्यंते प्रकुरुते ब्रह्मा तूत्सर्गकारणात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye anuṣaṅgāpāde kalpamanvantarākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tulyaṃ yugasahasraṃ vai naiśaṃ kālamupāsya saḥ / śarvaryaṃte prakurute brahmā tūtsargakāraṇāt
verses.translation: He passed a period of time equal to a thousand Yugas as his night. At the end of the nighty Brahma creates the universe through the cause (potentiality) of creation.
verses.wordMeaning: He passed a period of time equal to a thousand Yugas as his night. At the end of the nighty Brahma creates the universe through the cause (potentiality) of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He passed a period of time equal to a thousand Yugas as his night. At the end of the nighty Brahma creates the universe through the cause (potentiality) of creation.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा तु सलिले तस्मिन् वायुर्भूत्वा तदाचरत् । अन्धकारार्णवे तस्मिन्नष्टे स्थावरजंगमे
verses.transliteration: brahmā tu salile tasmin vāyurbhūtvā tadācarat / andhakārārṇave tasminnaṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame
verses.translation: \t that time, in that vast expanse of water, Brahmi became wind and moved about (in that ocean) enveloped in darkness when the mobile and the immobile beings had (already) perished (and became nonexistent).
verses.wordMeaning: \t that time, in that vast expanse of water, Brahmi became wind and moved about (in that ocean) enveloped in darkness when the mobile and the immobile beings had (already) perished (and became nonexistent).
verses.commentary: Sense: \t that time, in that vast expanse of water, Brahmi became wind and moved about (in that ocean) enveloped in darkness when the mobile and the immobile beings had (already) perished (and became nonexistent).

verses.sanskrit: जलेन समनुप्लाव्य सर्वतः पृथिवीतले । प्रविभागेन भूतेषु सत्यमात्रे स्थितेषु वा
verses.transliteration: jalena samanuplāvya sarvataḥ pṛthivītale / pravibhāgena bhūteṣu satyamātre sthiteṣu vā
verses.translation: He flooded the surface of the earth all round with water. When the elements had been stationed in Satya* (truth) along with their divisions, he moved about like the glowworm during the nhts in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: इस भूमि”को सीमा से रहित करके,उनहोने राजी कृष्ण का आहरण-
verses.wordMeaning: He flooded the surface of the earth all round with water. When the elements had been stationed in Satya* (truth) along with their divisions, he moved about like the glowworm during the nhts in the rainy season.
verses.commentary: Sense: He flooded the surface of the earth all round with water. When the elements had been stationed in Satya* (truth) along with their divisions, he moved about like the glowworm during the nhts in the rainy season.
