verses.sanskrit: सोप्युपायं प्रतिष्ठायां मार्गमाणस्तदा भुवम् । ततस्तु सलिले तस्मिन् ज्ञात्वा त्वन्तर्गतो महीम्
verses.transliteration: sopyupāyaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ mārgamāṇastadā bhuvam / tatastu salile tasmin jñātvā tvantargato mahīm
verses.translation: Every continent has seven tub-contineots. Thus the number of tub- coetineoti be c o m es 7 s 7«49. Their list is described later in dti. 18 and 19.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वो के द्वारा।सु रक्षित देखकर फिर उसका. सन्तिपात - हुआ 'था। उसी.
verses.wordMeaning: Every continent has seven tub-contineots. Thus the number of tub- coetineoti be c o m es 7 s 7«49. Their list is described later in dti. 18 and 19.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every continent has seven tub-contineots. Thus the number of tub- coetineoti be c o m es 7 s 7«49. Their list is described later in dti. 18 and 19.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धमन्यतमं बुद्धा भूमेरुद्धरणक्षमः । चकार तं तु देवो ऽथ पूर्वकल्पादिषु स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: andhamanyatamaṃ buddhā bhūmeruddharaṇakṣamaḥ / cakāra taṃ tu devo 'tha pūrvakalpādiṣu smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After creating the souls for the abodes, he created the period of Yugas namely Kfta, Treti, Dvipara and Tiqya (i.e. Kali).
verses.hindi: प्रकार'से यज्ञमें महषियों ने वेखा या ।१६४। बहा पर सभी कुछ सुबणंमयः उन्होंने देखा था और उनका उसके साथ विवाद हुआ था॥ उस अवसर. पर
verses.wordMeaning: After creating the souls for the abodes, he created the period of Yugas namely Kfta, Treti, Dvipara and Tiqya (i.e. Kali).
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating the souls for the abodes, he created the period of Yugas namely Kfta, Treti, Dvipara and Tiqya (i.e. Kali).

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं रूपं वराहस्य कृत्वाभो ऽनुप्रविश्य च । अद्भिः संछादितामिच्छन् पृथिवीं स प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ rūpaṃ varāhasya kṛtvābho 'nupraviśya ca / adbhiḥ saṃchāditāmicchan pṛthivīṃ sa prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: At the beginning of the Kalpa, he created the sub¬ jects at the outset. Those subjects of the previous Kalpa have been recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: नैमिषेयों कातवह'सक्र (मञ्च) बारह वषं का "था उस यज्ञः में ।१६५। उस भाँति परस्पर में विवाह करने बाले उन्होंने -यदु,को. संस्थापित - किया-.थाः।; इसकेःअनतर' अमृत यदुःके पुत्रों वाले उस अरण्य को बचा दिया था ५१६६ उस यज्ञककी'परिसमालिःकरके उन्होंने कासुदेव-की उपासना की थी ।-ह:
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning of the Kalpa, he created the sub¬ jects at the outset. Those subjects of the previous Kalpa have been recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning of the Kalpa, he created the sub¬ jects at the outset. Those subjects of the previous Kalpa have been recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्योर्वीमथ न्यस्ता सापत्यांतामतिन्यसत् । सामुद्राश्च समुद्रेषु नादेयाश्च नदीषु च
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtyorvīmatha nyastā sāpatyāṃtāmatinyasat / sāmudrāśca samudreṣu nādeyāśca nadīṣu ca
verses.translation: Being created, they exist for the sake of their pro¬ geny. They are regarded as having achieved the four Punisa- rthas viz.: Dharma, Artha, KAma and Mokya.
verses.hindi: कृत्यों का समुद्देश-है जो पुराण के इस अश में उपर्वाणत :किय।'गया ,है-।. ।१दढा इसी अनुक्रम से यह पुराण संध्रकाक्षित-होता है समास से सुखअथं: होता है और इससे महान् भो उपनक्षित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Being created, they exist for the sake of their pro¬ geny. They are regarded as having achieved the four Punisa- rthas viz.: Dharma, Artha, KAma and Mokya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being created, they exist for the sake of their pro¬ geny. They are regarded as having achieved the four Punisa- rthas viz.: Dharma, Artha, KAma and Mokya.

verses.sanskrit: पृथक्तास्तु समीकृत्य पृथिव्यां सो ऽचिनोद्गिरीन् । प्राक्सर्गे दह्यमाने तु पुरा संवर्त काग्निना
verses.transliteration: pṛthaktāstu samīkṛtya pṛthivyāṃ so 'cinodgirīn / prāksarge dahyamāne tu purā saṃvarta kāgninā
verses.translation: The Devas, the Pitfs and the human beingi (are created) in order; thereafter, they equipped themselves with penance; they filled the abodes at the outset.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas, the Pitfs and the human beingi (are created) in order; thereafter, they equipped themselves with penance; they filled the abodes at the outset.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas, the Pitfs and the human beingi (are created) in order; thereafter, they equipped themselves with penance; they filled the abodes at the outset.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाग्निना विलीनास्ते पर्वता भुवि सर्वशः । शैल्यादेकार्णवे तस्मिन्वायुना ये तु संहिताः
verses.transliteration: tenāgninā vilīnāste parvatā bhuvi sarvaśaḥ / śailyādekārṇave tasminvāyunā ye tu saṃhitāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, those human beings become Brahmaas and souls of spiritxial achievement. Due to their Karman con¬ taminated by the faults of hatred and too much of attachment* they went to heaven (7)
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, those human beings become Brahmaas and souls of spiritxial achievement. Due to their Karman con¬ taminated by the faults of hatred and too much of attachment* they went to heaven (7)
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, those human beings become Brahmaas and souls of spiritxial achievement. Due to their Karman con¬ taminated by the faults of hatred and too much of attachment* they went to heaven (7)

verses.sanskrit: निषिक्ता यत्र यत्रासंस्तत्रतत्राचलो ऽभवत् । स्कन्धाचलत्वादचलाः पर्वभिः पर्वताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: niṣiktā yatra yatrāsaṃstatratatrācalo 'bhavat / skandhācalatvādacalāḥ parvabhiḥ parvatāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: While returning in an embodied state, they are born in every Yuga. With the remnants of the fruits of their Karman, (they are bom again and again); they are well known as Tadd- tmd;as (P Identified with them).
verses.wordMeaning: While returning in an embodied state, they are born in every Yuga. With the remnants of the fruits of their Karman, (they are bom again and again); they are well known as Tadd- tmd;as (P Identified with them).
verses.commentary: Sense: While returning in an embodied state, they are born in every Yuga. With the remnants of the fruits of their Karman, (they are bom again and again); they are well known as Tadd- tmd;as (P Identified with them).

verses.sanskrit: गिरयो हि निगीर्णत्वादयनात्तु शिलोच्चयाः । तत स्तावासमुद्धृत्य क्षितिमंतर्जलात्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: girayo hi nigīrṇatvādayanāttu śiloccayāḥ / tata stāvāsamuddhṛtya kṣitimaṃtarjalātprabhuḥ
verses.translation: The subjects beginning with the Devas and ending with the immobile beings are bom (influencing) themselves mutually. Their pure (or sanctified) Karmans usually pre¬ dominated.
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects beginning with the Devas and ending with the immobile beings are bom (influencing) themselves mutually. Their pure (or sanctified) Karmans usually pre¬ dominated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects beginning with the Devas and ending with the immobile beings are bom (influencing) themselves mutually. Their pure (or sanctified) Karmans usually pre¬ dominated.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तसप्त तु वर्षाणि तस्या द्वीपेषु सप्तसु । विषमाणि समीकृत्य शिलाभिरभितो गिरीन्
verses.transliteration: saptasapta tu varṣāṇi tasyā dvīpeṣu saptasu / viṣamāṇi samīkṛtya śilābhirabhito girīn
verses.translation: Therefore, they attained only those names and features (which they had before). Again and again they are bom with names and forms in the (different) Kalpas.
verses.hindi: संसर्गकालेऽपि करोति से संहारकाले च न
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, they attained only those names and features (which they had before). Again and again they are bom with names and forms in the (different) Kalpas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, they attained only those names and features (which they had before). Again and again they are bom with names and forms in the (different) Kalpas.

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपेषु तेषु वर्षाणि चत्वारिंशत्तथैव तु । तावंतः पर्वताश्चैव वर्षांते समवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: dvīpeṣu teṣu varṣāṇi catvāriṃśattathaiva tu / tāvaṃtaḥ parvatāścaiva varṣāṃte samavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: He created a thousand (couples) of Asats (not good ones) from his arras. Dominated as they were from Rajas and TamaSi they are remembered as grhaHU (attached to houses),
verses.hindi: इस कारण से समास का उद्देश्य करके आपको विस्तार से कहूँगा । जो अपनी इन्द्रियों पर बिजय प्राप्त कर लेने बाला पुरुष इस आद पाद का भली-भाँति से अध्ययन किया करता है ।१६६। उसने इस सम्पूर्ण पुराण का ही मानों अध्ययन कर लिया है--इसमें लेशमात्र भी संशय नहीं है  द्विज-
verses.wordMeaning: He created a thousand (couples) of Asats (not good ones) from his arras. Dominated as they were from Rajas and TamaSi they are remembered as grhaHU (attached to houses),
verses.commentary: Sense: He created a thousand (couples) of Asats (not good ones) from his arras. Dominated as they were from Rajas and TamaSi they are remembered as grhaHU (attached to houses),

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गादौ कांतिविष्टास्ते स्वभावेनैव नान्यथा । सप्तद्वीपा समुद्राश्च अन्योन्यस्यानुमंडलम्
verses.transliteration: svargādau kāṃtiviṣṭāste svabhāvenaiva nānyathā / saptadvīpā samudrāśca anyonyasyānumaṃḍalam
verses.translation: Thus with mental emotions those subjects without progeny stay dear** (?) So also the families were bom with which this universe was filled up.
verses.hindi: गणों ! अङ्गों ओर उपनिषदों के सहित जिसने चारों वेदों का शान प्राप्त कर लिया हैं ।१७०। इतिहास पुराणों से वेद को समुपृ' हित करना चाहिए। जो बहुत ही कम पढ़ा लिखा पुरुष है उससे वेद भो भय खाता है कि यह् अरे ऊपर प्रहार करेगा ।१७१। साक्षात् स्वयम्भू ने स्वयं कहा है कि इस
verses.wordMeaning: Thus with mental emotions those subjects without progeny stay dear** (?) So also the families were bom with which this universe was filled up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus with mental emotions those subjects without progeny stay dear** (?) So also the families were bom with which this universe was filled up.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निविष्टाः स्वभावेन समावृत्य परस्परम् । भूराद्याश्चतुरो लोकाश्चंद्रादित्यौ ग्रहैः सह
verses.transliteration: sanniviṣṭāḥ svabhāvena samāvṛtya parasparam / bhūrādyāścaturo lokāścaṃdrādityau grahaiḥ saha
verses.translation: They resort to rivers, lakes and oceans as well as to mountains. Then those subjects have that war(?) but they move in it.***
verses.hindi: अध्याय के अभ्यास करने वाला पुरुष आपदा को प्राप्त करके भी कभी मोह को प्राप्त नहीं हुआ करता है ओर अपनी अभीष्ट गति को प्राप्त कर लिया करता है।१७२। कारण यह है कि यह पुराण प्राचीन काल में. हुमा था और उनने यह कहा था कि जो इसके निरुक्त जानता है वह सव
verses.wordMeaning: They resort to rivers, lakes and oceans as well as to mountains. Then those subjects have that war(?) but they move in it.***
verses.commentary: Sense: They resort to rivers, lakes and oceans as well as to mountains. Then those subjects have that war(?) but they move in it.***

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववन्निर्ममे ब्रह्मा स्थावराणीह सर्वशः । कल्पस्य चास्य ब्रह्मा चासृजद्यः स्थानिनः सुरान्
verses.transliteration: pūrvavannirmame brahmā sthāvarāṇīha sarvaśaḥ / kalpasya cāsya brahmā cāsṛjadyaḥ sthāninaḥ surān
verses.translation: They say that the earth with Rm (juice, water,) is their food. Desirous of mental siddhb those subjects move about as they please.
verses.hindi: प्रकार के पापों से प्रमुक्त हो'जाया करता है ।१७३। इसलिए इसके संक्षेप का- श्रवण करो । यह सम्पूर्ण पुराण साक्षात् भगवान् नारायण का ही स्वरूपः हे। संसग काल में भी सगं करता है और संहार के काल में फिर नहीं होता है
verses.wordMeaning: They say that the earth with Rm (juice, water,) is their food. Desirous of mental siddhb those subjects move about as they please.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that the earth with Rm (juice, water,) is their food. Desirous of mental siddhb those subjects move about as they please.

verses.sanskrit: आपोग्निं पृथिवीं वायुमंतरिक्षं दिवं तथा । स्वर्गं दिशः समुद्रांश्च नदीः सर्वांस्तु पर्वतान्
verses.transliteration: āpogniṃ pṛthivīṃ vāyumaṃtarikṣaṃ divaṃ tathā / svargaṃ diśaḥ samudrāṃśca nadīḥ sarvāṃstu parvatān
verses.translation: In the Krtayuga, the subjects human beings etc.) had equsd length of life, happiness and beauty. In the first Yuga, at the beginning of the Kalpa, there was no Obarma and Adharma.
verses.wordMeaning: In the Krtayuga, the subjects human beings etc.) had equsd length of life, happiness and beauty. In the first Yuga, at the beginning of the Kalpa, there was no Obarma and Adharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Krtayuga, the subjects human beings etc.) had equsd length of life, happiness and beauty. In the first Yuga, at the beginning of the Kalpa, there was no Obarma and Adharma.

verses.sanskrit: ओषधीनामात्मनश्च आत्मनो वृक्षवीरुधाम् । लवकाष्ठाः कलाश्चैव मुहुर्त्तान्संधिरात्र्यहान्
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīnāmātmanaśca ātmano vṛkṣavīrudhām / lavakāṣṭhāḥ kalāścaiva muhurttānsaṃdhirātryahān
verses.translation: W.d9«57 give a rosy picture of the Kta Yuga.
verses.hindi: कियन्तं चेव तत्कालं कथं च समवर्त्तत ।
verses.wordMeaning: W.d9«57 give a rosy picture of the Kta Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.d9«57 give a rosy picture of the Kta Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: अर्द्धमासांश्च मासांश्च अयनाब्दान् युगानि च । स्थानाभिमानिनश्चैव स्थानानिच पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: arddhamāsāṃśca māsāṃśca ayanābdān yugāni ca / sthānābhimāninaścaiva sthānānica pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: In every Yuga, they were bom with their res¬ pective rights and authority. They say that the Krta yuga at the beginning, had four thousand years in accordance with the reckoning of the gods. The two periods of junction consisted of four hundred years.
verses.wordMeaning: In every Yuga, they were bom with their res¬ pective rights and authority. They say that the Krta yuga at the beginning, had four thousand years in accordance with the reckoning of the gods. The two periods of junction consisted of four hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: In every Yuga, they were bom with their res¬ pective rights and authority. They say that the Krta yuga at the beginning, had four thousand years in accordance with the reckoning of the gods. The two periods of junction consisted of four hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानात्मनस्तु सृष्ट्वा च युगावस्था विनिर्ममे । कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च तिष्यं चैव तथा युगम्
verses.transliteration: sthānātmanastu sṛṣṭvā ca yugāvasthā vinirmame / kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca tiṣyaṃ caiva tathā yugam
verses.translation: For their sustenance, there were flowers and fruits alongwith bulbous roots. The time was entirely and exclusively pleasant; it was neither too hot nor too chill.
verses.wordMeaning: For their sustenance, there were flowers and fruits alongwith bulbous roots. The time was entirely and exclusively pleasant; it was neither too hot nor too chill.
verses.commentary: Sense: For their sustenance, there were flowers and fruits alongwith bulbous roots. The time was entirely and exclusively pleasant; it was neither too hot nor too chill.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पस्यादौ कृतयुगे प्रथमं सो ऽसृजत्प्रजाः । प्रागुक्ताश्च मया तुभ्यं पूर्व्वे कल्पे प्रजास्तु ताः
verses.transliteration: kalpasyādau kṛtayuge prathamaṃ so 'sṛjatprajāḥ / prāguktāśca mayā tubhyaṃ pūrvve kalpe prajāstu tāḥ
verses.translation: (The vegetation) caused strength and fineness of complexion unto them. It destroyed their sickness and old age, Those subjects had stable (everlasting) youth with their bodies not requiring purificatory rites.
verses.wordMeaning: (The vegetation) caused strength and fineness of complexion unto them. It destroyed their sickness and old age, Those subjects had stable (everlasting) youth with their bodies not requiring purificatory rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The vegetation) caused strength and fineness of complexion unto them. It destroyed their sickness and old age, Those subjects had stable (everlasting) youth with their bodies not requiring purificatory rites.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्संवर्त माने तु कल्पे दग्धास्तदग्निना । अप्राप्तायास्तपोलोकं पृथिव्यां याः समासत
verses.transliteration: tasminsaṃvarta māne tu kalpe dagdhāstadagninā / aprāptāyāstapolokaṃ pṛthivyāṃ yāḥ samāsata
verses.translation: In their case, even without copulation subjects (pro¬ geny) are bom through mere mental conception. The birth and features are the same (in regard to everyone). They are on a par (with one another) and they are pleased and happy.
verses.wordMeaning: In their case, even without copulation subjects (pro¬ geny) are bom through mere mental conception. The birth and features are the same (in regard to everyone). They are on a par (with one another) and they are pleased and happy.
verses.commentary: Sense: In their case, even without copulation subjects (pro¬ geny) are bom through mere mental conception. The birth and features are the same (in regard to everyone). They are on a par (with one another) and they are pleased and happy.

verses.sanskrit: आवर्तन्ते पुनः सर्गे वीक्षार्थं ता भवन्ति हि । वीक्ष्यार्थं ताः स्थितास्तत्र पुनः सर्गस्य कारणात्
verses.transliteration: āvartante punaḥ sarge vīkṣārthaṃ tā bhavanti hi / vīkṣyārthaṃ tāḥ sthitāstatra punaḥ sargasya kāraṇāt
verses.translation: In the Krta yuga, all the subjects are born with equal beauty, features and span of life. They are devoid of in¬ feriority and superiority. Usually they are happy, they aie free from sorrow.
verses.hindi: तपश्नर्या के धन बाले उन ऋषियों ने श्रीसूतजी से फिर कहा था कि उन भदूभुत कर्मों के करने बालों का वह यज्ञ कहां पर हुआ था।१। वह समय जिसमें यज्ञ का यजन हुआ था कितना था और वहे किस प्रकार से सम्पन्न हुआ था ? । बायुदेव ने पुराण की किंस 'रीतिं से कहा था ?
verses.wordMeaning: In the Krta yuga, all the subjects are born with equal beauty, features and span of life. They are devoid of in¬ feriority and superiority. Usually they are happy, they aie free from sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Krta yuga, all the subjects are born with equal beauty, features and span of life. They are devoid of in¬ feriority and superiority. Usually they are happy, they aie free from sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ताः सृज्यमानास्तु सन्तानार्थं भवन्ति हि । धर्म्मार्थ काममोक्षाणामिह ताः साधिताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: tatastāḥ sṛjyamānāstu santānārthaṃ bhavanti hi / dharmmārtha kāmamokṣāṇāmiha tāḥ sādhitāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: VV.59-60 give a comparative siatoncnt of the special features of four Yugas.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने बहुत बिस्तार के साथ इस पुराण का कथन किया था--इसमें हम सबके हृदय में बड़ा भारी कोतूहल हो रहा है। इस प्रकार से जब प्रेरित किया गया या तो श्री सुतजी ने परम शुभ वचन से उत्तर दिया था।३। है सुनियो  आप लोग श्रवण कीजिए । जहाँ पर उन धीरों ने उस उत्तम संत्र
verses.wordMeaning: VV.59-60 give a comparative siatoncnt of the special features of four Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.59-60 give a comparative siatoncnt of the special features of four Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च पितरश्चैव क्रमशो मानवास्तथा । ततस्ते तपसा युक्ताः स्थानान्यापूरयन्पुरा
verses.transliteration: devāśca pitaraścaiva kramaśo mānavāstathā / tataste tapasā yuktāḥ sthānānyāpūrayanpurā
verses.translation: VV.61-71 deKdbe the lUte ia the period ioterveoing beiweea Krta and Tretft.
verses.hindi: को किया था । और जितने समय पर्यन्त बह वहाँ पर हुआ था और जिस रीति से हुआ था ।४। इस विशाल विश्व का सृजन करने की इच्छा बाला यजन करत।.है तब पहिले विसूजन करता है। यह सत्र अत्यधिक पुण्य मय है जो कि एक सहस्न परिवत्सरों तक हुआ था ।५। जहाँ पर गृहपति कां
verses.wordMeaning: VV.61-71 deKdbe the lUte ia the period ioterveoing beiweea Krta and Tretft.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.61-71 deKdbe the lUte ia the period ioterveoing beiweea Krta and Tretft.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो मनवस्ते वै सिद्धात्मानो भवन्ति हि । आसंगद्वेषयुक्तेन कर्मणा ते दिवं गताः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo manavaste vai siddhātmāno bhavanti hi / āsaṃgadveṣayuktena karmaṇā te divaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: When the junction has passed away, there was mental progeny. The achievement of spirituality was in another Yuga called Treti, next to Krta.
verses.hindi: बह्मा तप स्वयं ही हुआ था और जिसमें पत्नीत्व इडा का था ओर जहां बुद्धिमान् शामित्र था ।६। उन महात् आत्माओं वालों के यज में महातेज वाले मृत्यु ने सब किया था। सहस्र परिवत्सरो तक वहाँ पर देवगणों ने निवास किया था
verses.wordMeaning: When the junction has passed away, there was mental progeny. The achievement of spirituality was in another Yuga called Treti, next to Krta.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the junction has passed away, there was mental progeny. The achievement of spirituality was in another Yuga called Treti, next to Krta.

verses.sanskrit: आवर्तमानास्ते देहे संभवन्ति युगे युगे । स्वकर्म्मफलशेषेण ख्याताश्चैव तदात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: āvartamānāste dehe saṃbhavanti yuge yuge / svakarmmaphalaśeṣeṇa khyātāścaiva tadātmakāḥ
verses.translation: The eight mental Siddhis that had been recounted (as existent) by me in the beginning of the creation, become reduced gradually.
verses.wordMeaning: The eight mental Siddhis that had been recounted (as existent) by me in the beginning of the creation, become reduced gradually.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight mental Siddhis that had been recounted (as existent) by me in the beginning of the creation, become reduced gradually.

verses.sanskrit: संभवन्ति जने लोकाः कल्पागमनिबन्धनाः । अप्सु यः कारणं तेषां बोधयन्कर्म्मणा तु सः
verses.transliteration: saṃbhavanti jane lokāḥ kalpāgamanibandhanāḥ / apsu yaḥ kāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ bodhayankarmmaṇā tu saḥ
verses.translation: The origin of Kamutsiddhi (achievement of Karman} in Kfta is brought about by the conduct of the people of different castes and stages of life (?). The Sandhyd (junction) of the Krta is reduced by a quarter (?)
verses.wordMeaning: The origin of Kamutsiddhi (achievement of Karman} in Kfta is brought about by the conduct of the people of different castes and stages of life (?). The Sandhyd (junction) of the Krta is reduced by a quarter (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The origin of Kamutsiddhi (achievement of Karman} in Kfta is brought about by the conduct of the people of different castes and stages of life (?). The Sandhyd (junction) of the Krta is reduced by a quarter (?)

verses.sanskrit: कर्म्मभिस्तैस्तु जायन्ते जनलोकाच्छुभाशुभैः । गृह्णन्ति ते शरीराणि नानारूपाणि योनिषु
verses.transliteration: karmmabhistaistu jāyante janalokācchubhāśubhaiḥ / gṛhṇanti te śarīrāṇi nānārūpāṇi yoniṣu
verses.translation: These parts of the junctions of Krta take up the three (? other parts) and those Tuga Dharmas as well as penance, learning, strength and longevity decrease and decline.
verses.wordMeaning: These parts of the junctions of Krta take up the three (? other parts) and those Tuga Dharmas as well as penance, learning, strength and longevity decrease and decline.
verses.commentary: Sense: These parts of the junctions of Krta take up the three (? other parts) and those Tuga Dharmas as well as penance, learning, strength and longevity decrease and decline.

verses.sanskrit: देवाद्याः स्थावरांतास्तु आपद्यन्ते परस्परम् । तेषां मेध्यानि कर्म्माणि प्रायशः प्रतिपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: devādyāḥ sthāvarāṃtāstu āpadyante parasparam / teṣāṃ medhyāni karmmāṇi prāyaśaḥ pratipedire
verses.translation: When the Krta yuga and its transitional part have passed, O excellent sages, it is the beginning of Treta yuga along with its parts.
verses.wordMeaning: When the Krta yuga and its transitional part have passed, O excellent sages, it is the beginning of Treta yuga along with its parts.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Krta yuga and its transitional part have passed, O excellent sages, it is the beginning of Treta yuga along with its parts.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यन्नांमरूपाणि तान्येव प्रतिपेदिरे । पुनः पुनस्ते कल्पेषु जायन्ते नामरूपेणः
verses.transliteration: tasmādyannāṃmarūpāṇi tānyeva pratipedire / punaḥ punaste kalpeṣu jāyante nāmarūpeṇaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective) Pstrts of waters returned (to the firma- ment) in the form of clouds. From the thundering clouds the showering of rain began to function.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) Pstrts of waters returned (to the firma- ment) in the form of clouds. From the thundering clouds the showering of rain began to function.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) Pstrts of waters returned (to the firma- ment) in the form of clouds. From the thundering clouds the showering of rain began to function.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्गो ह्युपसृष्टिं सिसृक्षोर्ब्रह्मणस्तु वै । ताः प्रजा ध्यायतस्तस्य सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sargo hyupasṛṣṭiṃ sisṛkṣorbrahmaṇastu vai / tāḥ prajā dhyāyatastasya satyābhidhyāyinastadā
verses.translation: When the surface of the earth had been perfected (watered) by that rain occurring only once the subjects came into being. Thereupon the trees became designated as their abodes.
verses.hindi: तत्र ते मेनिरे शैलं नैमिषे ब्रह्मवादिनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: When the surface of the earth had been perfected (watered) by that rain occurring only once the subjects came into being. Thereupon the trees became designated as their abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the surface of the earth had been perfected (watered) by that rain occurring only once the subjects came into being. Thereupon the trees became designated as their abodes.

verses.sanskrit: मिथुनानां सहस्रं तु मुखात्समभवत्किल । जनास्ते ह्युपपद्यन्ते सत्त्वोद्रिक्ताः सुतेजसः
verses.transliteration: mithunānāṃ sahasraṃ tu mukhātsamabhavatkila / janāste hyupapadyante sattvodriktāḥ sutejasaḥ
verses.translation: Ail kinds of worldly enjoyment of those subjects emanated from them (the trees). In the beginning of the Treti yuga» the subjects maintained themselves with them.
verses.hindi: भ्रमण करते हुए, धमं. चक्र. की नेमि जहा पर णीणं हो गयी थी । उस कर्म से मुनियों केद्वारा समचित नेमिष विख्यात, हुआ था ।८। जहाँ परम पुण्यमसी गोमती सदी है जो कि सिद्धों और चारणों के द्वारा सदा सेवित रहा करती है.। वहां पर ससुता रोहिणी एक ही क्षणमात्र में बह गोमती
verses.wordMeaning: Ail kinds of worldly enjoyment of those subjects emanated from them (the trees). In the beginning of the Treti yuga» the subjects maintained themselves with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ail kinds of worldly enjoyment of those subjects emanated from them (the trees). In the beginning of the Treti yuga» the subjects maintained themselves with them.

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुषो ऽन्यत्सहस्रं तु मिथुनानां ससर्ज्ज ह । ते सर्वे रजसोद्रिक्ताः शुष्मिणश्चाप्यमर्षिणः
verses.transliteration: cakṣuṣo 'nyatsahasraṃ tu mithunānāṃ sasarjja ha / te sarve rajasodriktāḥ śuṣmiṇaścāpyamarṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective) then, after the lapse of a great deal of time, due to their own chstnge, they had a sudden emotion in the form of a great desire for close contact.
verses.hindi: हो गयी थी ।६।।महृएत्सा बसिछ की शक्ति. ज्येष्ठा हुई थी जो उत्तम तेज, बाली अरुस्धती की हुता का यात्रा. दान था ।१०। कल्माषपाद तुह और शक्ति के-सहित इस्द्रदेव ये जहां पर विश्वामित्र और वसिष्ठ मुनि का वेर हुआ था ।११। जिस स्थल पर अहश्यन्ती में पराशर मुनि ने जन्म ग्रहण किसा
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) then, after the lapse of a great deal of time, due to their own chstnge, they had a sudden emotion in the form of a great desire for close contact.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) then, after the lapse of a great deal of time, due to their own chstnge, they had a sudden emotion in the form of a great desire for close contact.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रमन्यदसृजद् बाहूनामसतां पुनः । रजस्तमोभ्यासुद्धिक्ता गृहशीलास्ततः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sahasramanyadasṛjad bāhūnāmasatāṃ punaḥ / rajastamobhyāsuddhiktā gṛhaśīlāstataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: In the case of women (of the modem days} mens* truation occun till the end of their life (?) But then (i.e. in the Tretft yuga), that did not take place on account of the power of the Yuga.
verses.hindi: था.। जिसके ज्ञात में वसिष्ठ मुनि का पराभव हुआ था।११। वहाँ पर उन ब्रह्म बादियों ने उस लेल को नमिष. माना था। क्योंकि वहां पर नैमिष यज्ञन किया था अतएव तभी से वे सब नैमिष कहे गये थे ।१३। वह सत्र उन बुद्धिमातों का द्वाइश.वषों तक हुआ था जबकि विक्रमी पुरूरवा तृप इस
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women (of the modem days} mens* truation occun till the end of their life (?) But then (i.e. in the Tretft yuga), that did not take place on account of the power of the Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women (of the modem days} mens* truation occun till the end of their life (?) But then (i.e. in the Tretft yuga), that did not take place on account of the power of the Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्ॐऽते प्रसूयंते मिथुनान्येव वासकृत् । कूटकाकूटकाश्चैव उत्पद्यंते मुमूर्षुणाम्
verses.transliteration: āyuṣoṃ'te prasūyaṃte mithunānyeva vāsakṛt / kūṭakākūṭakāścaiva utpadyaṃte mumūrṣuṇām
verses.translation: But in the case of those women (of later days), the menstrual Aow began to function month by month. As a con« sequence thereof, sexual intercourse also takes place then*
verses.wordMeaning: But in the case of those women (of later days), the menstrual Aow began to function month by month. As a con« sequence thereof, sexual intercourse also takes place then*
verses.commentary: Sense: But in the case of those women (of later days), the menstrual Aow began to function month by month. As a con« sequence thereof, sexual intercourse also takes place then*

verses.sanskrit: कुतः कुलमथोत्पाद्य ताः शरीराणि तत्यजुः । ततः प्रभृति कल्पे ऽस्मिन्मैथुनानां च संभवः
verses.transliteration: kutaḥ kulamathotpādya tāḥ śarīrāṇi tatyajuḥ / tataḥ prabhṛti kalpe 'sminmaithunānāṃ ca saṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: When they had perished, the subjects became be¬ wildered and agitated in ail their sense-organs. They began to meditate on their Siddhi. They were truthful in their meditation then.
verses.wordMeaning: When they had perished, the subjects became be¬ wildered and agitated in ail their sense-organs. They began to meditate on their Siddhi. They were truthful in their meditation then.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they had perished, the subjects became be¬ wildered and agitated in ail their sense-organs. They began to meditate on their Siddhi. They were truthful in their meditation then.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानेन मनसा तासां प्रजानां जायते कृते । शब्दादिविषयः शुद्धः प्रत्येकं पञ्चलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dhyānena manasā tāsāṃ prajānāṃ jāyate kṛte / śabdādiviṣayaḥ śuddhaḥ pratyekaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Those subjects maintained themselves with that at the beginning of Treti yuga. With that Siddhi they became hale, hearty and welKnourished. They were free from feverish ailments.
verses.wordMeaning: Those subjects maintained themselves with that at the beginning of Treti yuga. With that Siddhi they became hale, hearty and welKnourished. They were free from feverish ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those subjects maintained themselves with that at the beginning of Treti yuga. With that Siddhi they became hale, hearty and welKnourished. They were free from feverish ailments.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं मानसैर्भावैः प्रेष्ठं तिष्ठंति चाप्रजाः । तथान्वयास्तु संभूता यैरिदं पूरितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ mānasairbhāvaiḥ preṣṭhaṃ tiṣṭhaṃti cāprajāḥ / tathānvayāstu saṃbhūtā yairidaṃ pūritaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Thereafter, on other occasions also, the subjects became overwhelmed by greed thus, once again. They seized the trees and took by force the nectar and honey.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, on other occasions also, the subjects became overwhelmed by greed thus, once again. They seized the trees and took by force the nectar and honey.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, on other occasions also, the subjects became overwhelmed by greed thus, once again. They seized the trees and took by force the nectar and honey.

verses.sanskrit: सरित्सरःसमुद्रांश्च सेवंते पर्वतानपि । तदा ता ह्यल्पसंतोषायुद्धे तस्मिंश्चरंति वै
verses.transliteration: saritsaraḥsamudrāṃśca sevaṃte parvatānapi / tadā tā hyalpasaṃtoṣāyuddhe tasmiṃścaraṃti vai
verses.translation: On account of this misdemeanour on their part brought about by their covetousness, theKalpa trees (wishyicld- ing trees) perished here and there along with the Lord *(?)
verses.wordMeaning: On account of this misdemeanour on their part brought about by their covetousness, theKalpa trees (wishyicld- ing trees) perished here and there along with the Lord *(?)
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of this misdemeanour on their part brought about by their covetousness, theKalpa trees (wishyicld- ing trees) perished here and there along with the Lord *(?)

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वी रसवती नाम आहारं व्याहरंति च । ताः प्रजाः कामचारिण्यो मानसीं सिद्धिमिच्छतः
verses.transliteration: pṛthvī rasavatī nāma āhāraṃ vyāharaṃti ca / tāḥ prajāḥ kāmacāriṇyo mānasīṃ siddhimicchataḥ
verses.translation: The chillness, the wind and the sunshine were severe. Therefore they were much tormented. Being afflicted by the mutually opposed pairs of feelings and reactions, they bewailed their wounds*• (?)
verses.wordMeaning: The chillness, the wind and the sunshine were severe. Therefore they were much tormented. Being afflicted by the mutually opposed pairs of feelings and reactions, they bewailed their wounds*• (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The chillness, the wind and the sunshine were severe. Therefore they were much tormented. Being afflicted by the mutually opposed pairs of feelings and reactions, they bewailed their wounds*• (?)

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यमायुः सुखं रूपं तासामासीत्कृते युगे । धर्माधर्मौं तदा न स्तः कल्पादौ प्रथमे युगे
verses.transliteration: tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāmāsītkṛte yuge / dharmādharmauṃ tadā na staḥ kalpādau prathame yuge
verses.translation: Eight thousand Dhanus make one Tojana as determin¬ ed by them. With this Tojana (as the unit of measurement) settlements (i.e. colonies) were made thereafter.
verses.hindi: अद्ठारह समुद्र के द्वीपों का अशन करते हुए भी, पुरूरवा लोभ से रत्नों से सन्दष्ट न हुआ था--ऐसा हमने सुना है।१५। देवदूतों के द्वारा प्रेरित हुईं उवंशी ने उसको अपनो पति बनाने की कामना की थी । उर्थेशी के साथ संगत होकर उसने उस सत्र का आहरण किया था ।१६। उस नर पति के
verses.wordMeaning: Eight thousand Dhanus make one Tojana as determin¬ ed by them. With this Tojana (as the unit of measurement) settlements (i.e. colonies) were made thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight thousand Dhanus make one Tojana as determin¬ ed by them. With this Tojana (as the unit of measurement) settlements (i.e. colonies) were made thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेनस्वेनाधि कारेण जज्ञिरे तु युगेयुगे । चत्वारि तु सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिव्यसंख्यया
verses.transliteration: svenasvenādhi kāreṇa jajñire tu yugeyuge / catvāri tu sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divyasaṃkhyayā
verses.translation: Among the four (types of) fortresses, three arc natural and the fourth (type of) fort is artificial. I shall men¬ tion its decisive features.
verses.hindi: होते पर नैमिषीयों ने सत्र किया था। गंगा नें पाक से दीप्त तेज वाले जिस गर्भ का प्रसव किया था ।१७। उसके तुल्य पर्वत में व्यस्त किया हुआ हिरण्य (सुवर्ण) हो गया था । इसके अनन्तर उन. महात्माओं को, हिरण्मय कर दिया था ।१८। लोकों को प्रसन्न करने बाले प्रम भावुक विश्वकर्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Among the four (types of) fortresses, three arc natural and the fourth (type of) fort is artificial. I shall men¬ tion its decisive features.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the four (types of) fortresses, three arc natural and the fourth (type of) fort is artificial. I shall men¬ tion its decisive features.

verses.sanskrit: आदौ कृतयुगं प्राहुः संध्यांशौ च चतुःशतौ । ततः सहस्रशस्तास्तु प्रजासु प्रथितास्विह
verses.transliteration: ādau kṛtayugaṃ prāhuḥ saṃdhyāṃśau ca catuḥśatau / tataḥ sahasraśastāstu prajāsu prathitāsviha
verses.translation: It has a thick elevated rampart (esp. a surrounding wall elevated on a mound of earth) with cavities (or openings).
verses.hindi: स्वयं देव था। उन अपरिमित तेज वालों के सत्र में किर उस विश्वकर्मा ने प्रवैश किया था। ऐड पुरूरना ने शिकार करते हए उस देश का सेवन किया था। उसने जब देखा था कि वह यज्ञ का स्थल एकदम सुवर्णमंय है तो उसको महान् आश्चर्य हुआ था ।१६-२०। लोभ कै कारण उस राजा का संब
verses.wordMeaning: It has a thick elevated rampart (esp. a surrounding wall elevated on a mound of earth) with cavities (or openings).
verses.commentary: Sense: It has a thick elevated rampart (esp. a surrounding wall elevated on a mound of earth) with cavities (or openings).

verses.sanskrit: न तासां प्रतिघातो ऽस्ति न द्वंद्वं नापि च क्रमः । पर्वतोदधिवासिन्यो ह्यनिकेताश्रयास्तु ताः
verses.transliteration: na tāsāṃ pratighāto 'sti na dvaṃdvaṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ / parvatodadhivāsinyo hyaniketāśrayāstu tāḥ
verses.translation: (Defective text}* The moats two Hastas in breadth are excellent in the case of the Kumiilpura. The total breadth of the current of water in (the moat) may be eight, nine or ten (?).
verses.hindi: शान नष्ट हो गया था और उसने उसको स्वयं ग्रहण करने का उपक्रम कियो था। तब तो जो नेमिषोय मुनिगण वहाँ पर थे वे उस राजा परं बहुत करदे हुए थे
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text}* The moats two Hastas in breadth are excellent in the case of the Kumiilpura. The total breadth of the current of water in (the moat) may be eight, nine or ten (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text}* The moats two Hastas in breadth are excellent in the case of the Kumiilpura. The total breadth of the current of water in (the moat) may be eight, nine or ten (?).

verses.sanskrit: विशोकाः सत्त्वबहुला एकांतसुखिनः प्रजाः । ताश्शश्वत् कामचरिण्यो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः
verses.transliteration: viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāṃtasukhinaḥ prajāḥ / tāśśaśvat kāmacariṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ
verses.translation: The extent of a Pura (city) shall be half of the maximum length (?). There must be a river(?) flowing to its east or north. It should be divided into a bypotenum and seg- mena. It must be laid out in the shape of a spread fan.
verses.wordMeaning: The extent of a Pura (city) shall be half of the maximum length (?). There must be a river(?) flowing to its east or north. It should be divided into a bypotenum and seg- mena. It must be laid out in the shape of a spread fan.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent of a Pura (city) shall be half of the maximum length (?). There must be a river(?) flowing to its east or north. It should be divided into a bypotenum and seg- mena. It must be laid out in the shape of a spread fan.

verses.sanskrit: पशवः पक्षिणश्चैव न तदासन्सरीसृपाः । नोद्विजा नोत्कटाश्चैव धर्मस्य प्रक्रिया तु सा
verses.transliteration: paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva na tadāsansarīsṛpāḥ / nodvijā notkaṭāścaiva dharmasya prakriyā tu sā
verses.translation: The Viistu (site of a building; dwelling place) tliat is not more than twenty to\}X Hastas b short; that of one hundred and eight {Hasias) is great. In this matter they praise the middle one and the short one which has no (wooden structure).
verses.wordMeaning: The Viistu (site of a building; dwelling place) tliat is not more than twenty to\}X Hastas b short; that of one hundred and eight {Hasias) is great. In this matter they praise the middle one and the short one which has no (wooden structure).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viistu (site of a building; dwelling place) tliat is not more than twenty to\}X Hastas b short; that of one hundred and eight {Hasias) is great. In this matter they praise the middle one and the short one which has no (wooden structure).

verses.sanskrit: समूल फलपुष्पाणि वर्त्तनाय त्वशेषतः । सर्वैकान्तसुखः कालो नात्यर्थं ह्युष्णशीतलः
verses.transliteration: samūla phalapuṣpāṇi varttanāya tvaśeṣataḥ / sarvaikāntasukhaḥ kālo nātyarthaṃ hyuṣṇaśītalaḥ
verses.translation: The chief settlement should be eight hundred
verses.wordMeaning: The chief settlement should be eight hundred
verses.commentary: Sense: The chief settlement should be eight hundred

verses.sanskrit: मनो ऽभिलषितः काम स्तासां सर्वत्र सर्वदा । उत्तिष्ठंति पृथिव्यां वै तेषां ध्यानै रसातलात्
verses.transliteration: mano 'bhilaṣitaḥ kāma stāsāṃ sarvatra sarvadā / uttiṣṭhaṃti pṛthivyāṃ vai teṣāṃ dhyānai rasātalāt
verses.translation: The hamlet shall be a Yojana (ateut 12 km) from the city and the village shall be half a Yojana £rom the hamlet. The outermost boundary shall be two Kroias (I KroiaS kms). The boundary of a field is four Dharms.
verses.wordMeaning: The hamlet shall be a Yojana (ateut 12 km) from the city and the village shall be half a Yojana £rom the hamlet. The outermost boundary shall be two Kroias (I KroiaS kms). The boundary of a field is four Dharms.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hamlet shall be a Yojana (ateut 12 km) from the city and the village shall be half a Yojana £rom the hamlet. The outermost boundary shall be two Kroias (I KroiaS kms). The boundary of a field is four Dharms.

verses.sanskrit: बलवर्णकरी तेषां जरारोगप्रणाशिनी । असंस्कार्यैः शरीरैस्तु प्रजास्ताः स्थिरयौवनाः
verses.transliteration: balavarṇakarī teṣāṃ jarārogapraṇāśinī / asaṃskāryaiḥ śarīraistu prajāstāḥ sthirayauvanāḥ
verses.translation: The pathway along the quarters (i.e. East-west and North-south) was made twenty Dhanus wide by them. The road in the village was abo twenty Dhartus (wide). 'Fhe path in the boundary was only ten Dhanus (wide).
verses.wordMeaning: The pathway along the quarters (i.e. East-west and North-south) was made twenty Dhanus wide by them. The road in the village was abo twenty Dhartus (wide). 'Fhe path in the boundary was only ten Dhanus (wide).
verses.commentary: Sense: The pathway along the quarters (i.e. East-west and North-south) was made twenty Dhanus wide by them. The road in the village was abo twenty Dhartus (wide). 'Fhe path in the boundary was only ten Dhanus (wide).

verses.sanskrit: तासां विना तु संकल्पाज्जायंते सिथुनात्प्रजाः । समं जन्म च रूपं च प्रीयंते चैव ताः समाः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ vinā tu saṃkalpājjāyaṃte sithunātprajāḥ / samaṃ janma ca rūpaṃ ca prīyaṃte caiva tāḥ samāḥ
verses.translation: The branchtreets %vere measured by them (and made) four Dhanus (wide). The roads joining the high-ways shall be three Dhanus (wide) and their branches two Dhanus wide,
verses.hindi: बभूव सत्रे तेषां तु ब्रह्मचर्यं महात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The branchtreets %vere measured by them (and made) four Dhanus (wide). The roads joining the high-ways shall be three Dhanus (wide) and their branches two Dhanus wide,
verses.commentary: Sense: The branchtreets %vere measured by them (and made) four Dhanus (wide). The roads joining the high-ways shall be three Dhanus (wide) and their branches two Dhanus wide,

verses.sanskrit: तदा सत्यमलोभश्च संतुष्टिश्च च सुखं दमः । निर्विशेषाश्च ताः सर्वा रूपायुःशिल्पचेष्टितैः
verses.transliteration: tadā satyamalobhaśca saṃtuṣṭiśca ca sukhaṃ damaḥ / nirviśeṣāśca tāḥ sarvā rūpāyuḥśilpaceṣṭitaiḥ
verses.translation: (Defective text) The Jahghdpatha* (? the thigh- road) has fourPadas width; the passage between rows of houses a three quarcen (wide). Dhrlimirga** (? path of courage] if more than one sixth. The Padika (Foot-Path?) is remembered thus in due order.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) The Jahghdpatha* (? the thigh- road) has fourPadas width; the passage between rows of houses a three quarcen (wide). Dhrlimirga** (? path of courage] if more than one sixth. The Padika (Foot-Path?) is remembered thus in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) The Jahghdpatha* (? the thigh- road) has fourPadas width; the passage between rows of houses a three quarcen (wide). Dhrlimirga** (? path of courage] if more than one sixth. The Padika (Foot-Path?) is remembered thus in due order.

verses.sanskrit: अबुद्धिपूर्विका पृत्तिः प्रजानां भवति स्वयम् । अप्रवृत्तिः कृतद्वारे कर्मणः शुभपापयोः
verses.transliteration: abuddhipūrvikā pṛttiḥ prajānāṃ bhavati svayam / apravṛttiḥ kṛtadvāre karmaṇaḥ śubhapāpayoḥ
verses.translation: They thought over it again and again about the trees designated as their bouses as to how they were before, and began to build like them.
verses.wordMeaning: They thought over it again and again about the trees designated as their bouses as to how they were before, and began to build like them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They thought over it again and again about the trees designated as their bouses as to how they were before, and began to build like them.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थाश्च न तदासन्न तत्कराः । अनिच्छाद्वेषयुक्तास्ता वर्त्तयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavyavasthāśca na tadāsanna tatkarāḥ / anicchādveṣayuktāstā varttayanti parasparam
verses.translation: The branches of trees have gone down. Others have gone this way. Still others have gone up. In the same way, some have gone obliquely.
verses.hindi: डन मनीषियों ने बहुत क्रोधित होते हुए कुश के बच्चों से उसका हनन किया था क्योंकि वे मुनिगण तपश्चर्या में निष्ठा रखने बाले. और हैव, के दवारा प्रेरित थे ।२२। कुशाओं के वज्यों से पिसकर उस राजा ने अपना शरीय त्याग दिया था । उसके अनन्तर भूमि में उसके उर्वशी के पुत्रों के साथ तूप
verses.wordMeaning: The branches of trees have gone down. Others have gone this way. Still others have gone up. In the same way, some have gone obliquely.
verses.commentary: Sense: The branches of trees have gone down. Others have gone this way. Still others have gone up. In the same way, some have gone obliquely.

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यरूपायुषः सर्वा अधमोत्तमवर्जिताः । सुखप्राया विशोकाश्च उत्पद्यंते कृते युगे
verses.transliteration: tulyarūpāyuṣaḥ sarvā adhamottamavarjitāḥ / sukhaprāyā viśokāśca utpadyaṃte kṛte yuge
verses.translation: With their intellect, they have observed carefully how the branches have gone. Apartments were constructed by them in the same way. Hence they (the apartments) are re¬ membered as Sdlds.
verses.hindi: ने युद्ध किया था ।२३। नहुष के जिसको महात्मा पिता कहते हैं। उन अब- भूथों में ही वह महीपति बहुत ही घर्मेशील था ।२४। इस सत्र में बह नर्: श्रेष्ठ आगुराय और अन्म से बहुत श्रेष्ठ था । उस समय में ब्रह्म वेत्ताओं ने राजा को शान्त किया था ।२५। आत्म मूर्ति वाले उन्होंने पृथ्वी के समान
verses.wordMeaning: With their intellect, they have observed carefully how the branches have gone. Apartments were constructed by them in the same way. Hence they (the apartments) are re¬ membered as Sdlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their intellect, they have observed carefully how the branches have gone. Apartments were constructed by them in the same way. Hence they (the apartments) are re¬ membered as Sdlds.

verses.sanskrit: लाभालाभौ न वा स्यातां मित्रामित्रौ प्रियाप्रियौ । मनसा विषयस्तासां निरीहाणां प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: lābhālābhau na vā syātāṃ mitrāmitrau priyāpriyau / manasā viṣayastāsāṃ nirīhāṇāṃ pravartate
verses.translation: Thus dlds (apartments, dwellings) became well- known from the branches. So abo the abodes. Therefore they are remembered as idlAs, That is remembered as their
verses.hindi: सत्र करने का आरम्भ कर दिया था उनके सत्र में उन महात्माओं का ब्रह्मा- चये हुआ था ।२६। विश्व के सृजन करने की इच्छा वाले का प्राचीनकाल में विश्व के स्रष्टाओं की भाँति वंखानस-प्रियसखा-बालखिल्य-मरी चियों-अज और मुनिगण-पितृगण-देव-अप्सरा-सिद्ध-गन्धर्व-उरग और चारण के साथ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus dlds (apartments, dwellings) became well- known from the branches. So abo the abodes. Therefore they are remembered as idlAs, That is remembered as their

verses.sanskrit: नाति हिंसति वान्योन्यं नानुगृङ्णंति वै तदा
verses.transliteration: nāti hiṃsati vānyonyaṃ nānugṛṅṇaṃti vai tadā
verses.translation: Popular but importaat etymolocy of 'aa apaitnent or dwei-
verses.hindi: यह सूर्य तथा वैश्वानर के समान प्रभा वाला हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Popular but importaat etymolocy of 'aa apaitnent or dwei-
verses.commentary: Sense: Popular but importaat etymolocy of 'aa apaitnent or dwei-

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां यज्ञ उच्यते । पवृत्तं द्वापरे युद्धं स्तेयमेव कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ yajña ucyate / pavṛttaṃ dvāpare yuddhaṃ steyameva kalau yuge
verses.translation: Since people are delighted therein {Prasidanti) they are designated as(palaces). Therefore, the abodes, apartments and palaces are designated as Prlisadas.
verses.wordMeaning: Since people are delighted therein {Prasidanti) they are designated as(palaces). Therefore, the abodes, apartments and palaces are designated as Prlisadas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since people are delighted therein {Prasidanti) they are designated as(palaces). Therefore, the abodes, apartments and palaces are designated as Prlisadas.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं कृतं रजस्त्रेता द्वापरं तु रजस्तमः । कलिस्तमस्तु विज्ञेयं गुणवृत्तं गुमेषु तत्
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ kṛtaṃ rajastretā dvāparaṃ tu rajastamaḥ / kalistamastu vijñeyaṃ guṇavṛttaṃ gumeṣu tat
verses.translation: When the wishyielding Kalpa trees perished along with the honey,(the subjects) attached by the Dvandvas (mutual opposed pain of feelings etc.) began to think about the means of agriculture and other occupations for livelihood.
verses.wordMeaning: When the wishyielding Kalpa trees perished along with the honey,(the subjects) attached by the Dvandvas (mutual opposed pain of feelings etc.) began to think about the means of agriculture and other occupations for livelihood.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the wishyielding Kalpa trees perished along with the honey,(the subjects) attached by the Dvandvas (mutual opposed pain of feelings etc.) began to think about the means of agriculture and other occupations for livelihood.

verses.sanskrit: कालः कृतयुगे त्वेष तस्य सन्ध्यां निबोधत । चत्वारि तु सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम्
verses.transliteration: kālaḥ kṛtayuge tveṣa tasya sandhyāṃ nibodhata / catvāri tu sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam
verses.translation: The subjects created were seen agitated due to ex¬ haustion and sorrow. Thereafter, the Siddhi appeared in front of them in the Treta yuga.
verses.hindi: आराधने स सस्मार ततः कर्मान्तरेष, च
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects created were seen agitated due to ex¬ haustion and sorrow. Thereafter, the Siddhi appeared in front of them in the Treta yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects created were seen agitated due to ex¬ haustion and sorrow. Thereafter, the Siddhi appeared in front of them in the Treta yuga.

verses.sanskrit: साध्यांशौ तस्य दिव्यानि शतान्यष्टौ तु संख्यया । चत्वार्यैव सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मोनुषाणि तु
verses.transliteration: sādhyāṃśau tasya divyāni śatānyaṣṭau tu saṃkhyayā / catvāryaiva sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ monuṣāṇi tu
verses.translation: Another (type of) rain became the means of achiev¬ ing all objects for them. The waters of the rain were sweet and were as much as they wished for.
verses.wordMeaning: Another (type of) rain became the means of achiev¬ ing all objects for them. The waters of the rain were sweet and were as much as they wished for.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another (type of) rain became the means of achiev¬ ing all objects for them. The waters of the rain were sweet and were as much as they wished for.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तासु भवंत्याशु नोत्क्रोशाच्च विपर्ययाः । ततः कृत्युगे तस्मिन् ससंध्यांशे गते तदा
verses.transliteration: tadā tāsu bhavaṃtyāśu notkrośācca viparyayāḥ / tataḥ kṛtyuge tasmin sasaṃdhyāṃśe gate tadā
verses.translation: The fourteen (types of lands in) villages and forests (began to flourish) without being ploughed and without the seeds being sown. The trees and the bushes put forth flowers and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.hindi: नैव यज्ञहरा हैत्या नैव वाजमुखा स्त्रिणः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The fourteen (types of lands in) villages and forests (began to flourish) without being ploughed and without the seeds being sown. The trees and the bushes put forth flowers and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fourteen (types of lands in) villages and forests (began to flourish) without being ploughed and without the seeds being sown. The trees and the bushes put forth flowers and fruits at the proper seasons.

verses.sanskrit: पादावशिष्टो भवति युगधर्मस्तु सर्वशः । सन्ध्यायास्तु व्यतीतायाः सांध्यः कालो युगस्य सः
verses.transliteration: pādāvaśiṣṭo bhavati yugadharmastu sarvaśaḥ / sandhyāyāstu vyatītāyāḥ sāṃdhyaḥ kālo yugasya saḥ
verses.translation: In the Treti yuga, medicinal herbs and plants began to appear themselves on the earth. In the beginning of the Treta yuga, the subjects sustained themselves with those plants and herbs.*
verses.hindi: भारतीयों के द्वारा राजा देवगणों से इन्द्र के समान शोभायुक्त हुआ था । शस्त्रो-स्तोत्रों और शृहों से देवगणों का तथा पिश्य कर्मों से पितृगणों का और गन्धव आदि का जाति के अनुसार विधिपूर्वक किया. करते थे। उसने आराधना में और फिर अन्य कर्मों में स्मरण किया था
verses.wordMeaning: In the Treti yuga, medicinal herbs and plants began to appear themselves on the earth. In the beginning of the Treta yuga, the subjects sustained themselves with those plants and herbs.*
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Treti yuga, medicinal herbs and plants began to appear themselves on the earth. In the beginning of the Treta yuga, the subjects sustained themselves with those plants and herbs.*

verses.sanskrit: पादमिश्रावशिष्टेन संध्याधर्मे पुनः पुनः । एवं कृतयुगे तस्मिन्निश्शेषेंतर्दधे तदा
verses.transliteration: pādamiśrāvaśiṣṭena saṃdhyādharme punaḥ punaḥ / evaṃ kṛtayuge tasminniśśeṣeṃtardadhe tadā
verses.translation: Thereafter, due to the inevitability of affairs and due to the Tret& yuga those subjects ban to have passion and covetousness for ever.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वृगण सामवेद के मन्त्रों का गान कर रहे थे परम शुभ और विचित्र अक्षरों और पदों से युक्त वाणी का उच्चारण कर रहे ये जो परमं शुभ थी 3३१ वहाँ पर विद्वान् लोग परस्पर में मन्त्रों का जप करते थे । प्रतिवादी गण वितण्डाबाद के वचनों के द्वारा निहुनन कर रहे ये ।३२। ऋषिगण और
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, due to the inevitability of affairs and due to the Tret& yuga those subjects ban to have passion and covetousness for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, due to the inevitability of affairs and due to the Tret& yuga those subjects ban to have passion and covetousness for ever.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां च सन्धौ नष्टायां मानसी चाभवत्प्रजा । सिद्धिरन्ययुगे तस्मिंस्त्रेताख्ये ऽनंतरे कृतात्
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ ca sandhau naṣṭāyāṃ mānasī cābhavatprajā / siddhiranyayuge tasmiṃstretākhye 'naṃtare kṛtāt
verses.translation: Then, they forcibly seized rivers, fields, mountains, trees, btishes and medicinal herbs as much as they could (in accordance with their strength).
verses.hindi: शब्दां तथा न्याय के ज्ञाता वहाँ पर थे। वहां पर कुछ भी हारित नहीं था और ब्रह्म॒राक्षसों ने प्रवेश किया था ।३३। देत्यगण यज्ञ के हरण करने बाले नहीं थे और वाजमुख अस्त्र आदि थे । प्रायश्चित्त और दरिद्रता वहाँ पर नहीं थे ।३४। शक्ति-प्रजा और क्रिया के योगों से आशिषों में विधि अनुष्ठिते
verses.wordMeaning: Then, they forcibly seized rivers, fields, mountains, trees, btishes and medicinal herbs as much as they could (in accordance with their strength).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, they forcibly seized rivers, fields, mountains, trees, btishes and medicinal herbs as much as they could (in accordance with their strength).

verses.sanskrit: सर्गादौ या मयाष्टौ तु मानस्यो वै प्रकीर्तिताः । अष्टौ ताः क्रमयोगेन सिद्धयो यांति संक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: sargādau yā mayāṣṭau tu mānasyo vai prakīrtitāḥ / aṣṭau tāḥ kramayogena siddhayo yāṃti saṃkṣayam
verses.translation: Etymology oT Prisida *s palace*.
verses.hindi: की गयी थी। इस रीति से वह यज्ञ मनीवियों का बारह वषं पर्यन्त बुद्धि पुक्त हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Etymology oT Prisida *s palace*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Etymology oT Prisida *s palace*.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पादौ मानसी ह्येका सिद्धिर्भवति सा कृते । मन्वंतरेषु सर्वेषु चतुर्युगविभागशः
verses.transliteration: kalpādau mānasī hyekā siddhirbhavati sā kṛte / manvaṃtareṣu sarveṣu caturyugavibhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: W 128ff show the prevalence of food-gathering economy in the
