verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाचारकृतः कर्मसिद्ध्युद्भवः कृतः । संध्या कृतस्य पादेन संक्षेपेण वशात्ततः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramācārakṛtaḥ karmasiddhyudbhavaḥ kṛtaḥ / saṃdhyā kṛtasya pādena saṃkṣepeṇa vaśāttataḥ
verses.translation: In ihe previous births, due to the glory of their auspiciousnesi (i.e. meritorious aca) as well as sins they were conceived as Brahmanas, Ktriyas, Vaiiyas, SOdrasand mali* cious people.
verses.wordMeaning: In ihe previous births, due to the glory of their auspiciousnesi (i.e. meritorious aca) as well as sins they were conceived as Brahmanas, Ktriyas, Vaiiyas, SOdrasand mali* cious people.
verses.commentary: Sense: In ihe previous births, due to the glory of their auspiciousnesi (i.e. meritorious aca) as well as sins they were conceived as Brahmanas, Ktriyas, Vaiiyas, SOdrasand mali* cious people.

verses.sanskrit: कृतसंध्यांशका ह्येते त्रीनादाय परस्परम् । हीयंते युगधर्मास्ते तपःश्रुतबलायुषः
verses.transliteration: kṛtasaṃdhyāṃśakā hyete trīnādāya parasparam / hīyaṃte yugadharmāste tapaḥśrutabalāyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: After making Uie Sumeru mountain (as) the calf he milked this earth in the form of a cow that yielded seeds on the surface of the earth in the form of the mtlk.
verses.wordMeaning: After making Uie Sumeru mountain (as) the calf he milked this earth in the form of a cow that yielded seeds on the surface of the earth in the form of the mtlk.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making Uie Sumeru mountain (as) the calf he milked this earth in the form of a cow that yielded seeds on the surface of the earth in the form of the mtlk.

verses.sanskrit: कृते कृताशे ऽतीते तु वभूव तदनन्तरम् । त्रेतायुगसमुत्पत्तिः सांशा च ऋषिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kṛte kṛtāśe 'tīte tu vabhūva tadanantaram / tretāyugasamutpattiḥ sāṃśā ca ṛṣisattamāḥ
verses.translation: The lord made those seeds grow as the medicinal herbs (and other plants) that ended when the fruits became ripe. (That is, the plants yielded fruits but once and then they perished) they are the group of seventeen.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord made those seeds grow as the medicinal herbs (and other plants) that ended when the fruits became ripe. (That is, the plants yielded fruits but once and then they perished) they are the group of seventeen.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord made those seeds grow as the medicinal herbs (and other plants) that ended when the fruits became ripe. (That is, the plants yielded fruits but once and then they perished) they are the group of seventeen.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षीणे कृतांशे वै तासु शिष्टासु सप्तसु । कल्पादौ संप्रवृत्तायास्त्रेतायाः प्रसुखे तदा
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣīṇe kṛtāṃśe vai tāsu śiṣṭāsu saptasu / kalpādau saṃpravṛttāyāstretāyāḥ prasukhe tadā
verses.translation: All these fourteen varieties (of medicinal herbs and plants) peculiar to villages and forests grew at Che beginning of the first Tretk yuga. They are not grown by ploughing.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों का जो कि नैमिषीय थे वह सत्र इन्द्र कें समान हुआ था । बरद्धाद्य.-ऋत्बविज और वीर पीछे की ओर गमन करने वाले होते हुए ज्योति- छोमों को पृथक् २ सबको अयुत दक्षिणा वाले कर रहे थे। जहाँ पर यज्ञ समाप्त हुआ था वहाँ पर महान् आधिप भगवान् वासुदेव से जो कि अमित
verses.wordMeaning: All these fourteen varieties (of medicinal herbs and plants) peculiar to villages and forests grew at Che beginning of the first Tretk yuga. They are not grown by ploughing.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these fourteen varieties (of medicinal herbs and plants) peculiar to villages and forests grew at Che beginning of the first Tretk yuga. They are not grown by ploughing.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणश्यति तदा सिद्धिः कालयोगेन नान्यथा । तस्यां सिद्धौ प्रनष्टायामन्या सिद्धिरजायत
verses.transliteration: praṇaśyati tadā siddhiḥ kālayogena nānyathā / tasyāṃ siddhau pranaṣṭāyāmanyā siddhirajāyata
verses.translation: The trees, hedges, creepers, winding plants, spread¬ ing creepers and (various) species of grasses yielded roots, fruits,*** shoots etc. unto them. They plucked their fruits.
verses.hindi: आत्मा बाले थे पूछा था कि.आपने मुझ ब्राह्मण को प्रेरित किया था कि अपने बंश के लिए यह कड़ो.। ओर उन ध्रभु ने उनसे कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: The trees, hedges, creepers, winding plants, spread¬ ing creepers and (various) species of grasses yielded roots, fruits,*** shoots etc. unto them. They plucked their fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees, hedges, creepers, winding plants, spread¬ ing creepers and (various) species of grasses yielded roots, fruits,*** shoots etc. unto them. They plucked their fruits.

verses.sanskrit: अपांशौ तौ प्रतिगतौ तदा मेघात्माना तु वै । मेघेभ्यः स्तनयितृभ्यः प्रवृत्तं पृष्टिसर्जनम्
verses.transliteration: apāṃśau tau pratigatau tadā meghātmānā tu vai / meghebhyaḥ stanayitṛbhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ pṛṣṭisarjanam
verses.translation: Those seeds which were milked out of the earth formerly by the self-born lord, began to grow as medictnsd herbs putting forth floweri and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.hindi: शिष्य वशी देव Se है जो प्रत्यक्ष रूप से देखने वाला. है. और अणिमा आदि,आठों सूक्ष्म अङ्गो से समन्वित रहते हैं ।३६। जोकि तिर्य॑ग्वात आदि वर्षोःसे समस्त लोकों का भरण किया करले हैं । सात स्कऱ्धशाखाओं से भृत थे और विषयों से सर्व तो था जराजर युक्त ये जिसके मदत् सप्त सप्तक
verses.wordMeaning: Those seeds which were milked out of the earth formerly by the self-born lord, began to grow as medictnsd herbs putting forth floweri and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those seeds which were milked out of the earth formerly by the self-born lord, began to grow as medictnsd herbs putting forth floweri and fruits at the proper seasons.

verses.sanskrit: सकृदेव तया वृष्ट्या संसिद्धे पृषिवीतले । प्रजा आसंस्ततस्तासां वृक्षश्च गृह संज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃsiddhe pṛṣivītale / prajā āsaṃstatastāsāṃ vṛkṣaśca gṛha saṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: When the medicinal herbs created before did not grow and flourish again, he made means of livelihood for them by means of agricultural occupations.
verses.hindi: संस्थितः महाबल सूत तीनों ठ्यूहों का सत्र कर रहा था ।४०-४१। उपायों के शरीर घारी तेज का यहां पर धारण करता है । धारणाओं की प्राणाद्य पांच बृत्तियां अपनी बृत्तियों से युक्त थी
verses.wordMeaning: When the medicinal herbs created before did not grow and flourish again, he made means of livelihood for them by means of agricultural occupations.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the medicinal herbs created before did not grow and flourish again, he made means of livelihood for them by means of agricultural occupations.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वः प्रत्युपभोगस्तु तासां तेभ्यो व्यजायत । वर्त्तयंतेस्म तेभ्यस्तास्त्रेतायुगमुखे प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: sarvaḥ pratyupabhogastu tāsāṃ tebhyo vyajāyata / varttayaṃtesma tebhyastāstretāyugamukhe prajāḥ
verses.translation: The self-born lord (blessed them) with the power of working with their own hands and achieving great results. Thenceforth, the medicinal herbs became Krffapac (ploughed and grown).
verses.wordMeaning: The self-born lord (blessed them) with the power of working with their own hands and achieving great results. Thenceforth, the medicinal herbs became Krffapac (ploughed and grown).
verses.commentary: Sense: The self-born lord (blessed them) with the power of working with their own hands and achieving great results. Thenceforth, the medicinal herbs became Krffapac (ploughed and grown).

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता तासामेव विपर्ययात् । संगलोलात्मको भावस्तदा ह्याकस्मिको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyayāt / saṃgalolātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko 'bhavat
verses.translation: After achieving his purpose in the matter of agri* cultural occupation, the Prajpati (lord of the subjects i.e. god Brahmi established the bounds of decency by means of which they protected one another.
verses.wordMeaning: After achieving his purpose in the matter of agri* cultural occupation, the Prajpati (lord of the subjects i.e. god Brahmi established the bounds of decency by means of which they protected one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: After achieving his purpose in the matter of agri* cultural occupation, the Prajpati (lord of the subjects i.e. god Brahmi established the bounds of decency by means of which they protected one another.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तद्भवति नारीणां जीवितांते तदार्तवम् । तदा तद्वै न भवति पुनर्युगबलेन तु
verses.transliteration: yattadbhavati nārīṇāṃ jīvitāṃte tadārtavam / tadā tadvai na bhavati punaryugabalena tu
verses.translation: Among them some were very powerful and they seized the realm. He established them as Ksatriyas and it was their duty to protect others.
verses.wordMeaning: Among them some were very powerful and they seized the realm. He established them as Ksatriyas and it was their duty to protect others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among them some were very powerful and they seized the realm. He established them as Ksatriyas and it was their duty to protect others.

verses.sanskrit: तासां पुनः प्रवृत्तं तन्मासिमासि तदार्तवम् । ततस्तेनैव योगेन वर्त्तते मैथुनं तदा
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ punaḥ pravṛttaṃ tanmāsimāsi tadārtavam / tatastenaiva yogena varttate maithunaṃ tadā
verses.translation: (Defective).* All those subjects who had been created will be worshipping you. 'Tell the truth in accord¬ ance with the fact'. Those (subjects) who said this were the Brahman as.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणा यत्पुरा प्रोक्तः पुराणं ज्ञाममुत्तसभ् । देवतानामृषीणां च: स्ंपापन्रमोचनम्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective).* All those subjects who had been created will be worshipping you. 'Tell the truth in accord¬ ance with the fact'. Those (subjects) who said this were the Brahman as.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective).* All those subjects who had been created will be worshipping you. 'Tell the truth in accord¬ ance with the fact'. Those (subjects) who said this were the Brahman as.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तत्का लभावित्वान्मासिमास्युपगच्छताम् । अकाले चार्तवोत्पत्त्या गर्भोत्पत्तिस्तदाभवत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tatkā labhāvitvānmāsimāsyupagacchatām / akāle cārtavotpattyā garbhotpattistadābhavat
verses.translation: VV.lSlfT described the traositioa from food-gathering economy to the food-growing one by the introduction of Agriculture. This ste crysta- lized the four-fold classilication of the society with their specihe duties {pidi VV 16M65 below).
verses.hindi: जिसका शरीरों का घररणं'को पूर्यमाण-होता हुआ करता है। आकाश जिसकी योनि हैः बह द्विगुण ठै. और "शब्द तथा ' स्पर्शे समन्वितः।४३। शब्द शास्त्र अर्थात्: व्याकरण के  विद्रातों -के ; द्वारा  काचोरणि कही . गयी है । परमः नः्र और-मधुर बाणी से सभी मुनिगणों को-आनन्दित करते हुए
verses.wordMeaning: VV.lSlfT described the traositioa from food-gathering economy to the food-growing one by the introduction of Agriculture. This ste crysta- lized the four-fold classilication of the society with their specihe duties {pidi VV 16M65 below).
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.lSlfT described the traositioa from food-gathering economy to the food-growing one by the introduction of Agriculture. This ste crysta- lized the four-fold classilication of the society with their specihe duties {pidi VV 16M65 below).

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययेण तेषां तु तेन तत्काल भाविता । प्रणश्यंति ततः सर्वे वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: viparyayeṇa teṣāṃ tu tena tatkāla bhāvitā / praṇaśyaṃti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: Vi. 162a gives a better reading:
verses.hindi: ही ऐसा किया' था ।४४। सुन्दरः मनः वाले-जो ,पुराथों के ज्ञाता ये उन्होंतें पुराणों के समाश्रय के युक्त होकर जो पुराणों के प्रवचन करने में नियत-ये उनसे विभु ने कहा'कही थी ॥४५। है द्विजश्रेष्तो  यह'सव आख्यान जैसा भी हुआ' था । ऋषियों का यह परमःसर्वोत्तपः लोक तत्व है ।४६। प्राचीन-काल
verses.wordMeaning: Vi. 162a gives a better reading:
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi. 162a gives a better reading:

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषु प्रनष्टेषु विभ्रांता व्याकुलेन्द्रियाः । अभिध्यायंति ताः सिद्धिं सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣu pranaṣṭeṣu vibhrāṃtā vyākulendriyāḥ / abhidhyāyaṃti tāḥ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā
verses.translation: Although the establishment of the classification into the four castes had been made by him (LordBrahmi), the subjects, out of delusion» did not conform to those rules.
verses.hindi: में ब्रह्माजी से उत्तम जान पुराण कहा था बह वेवताओं सेःओऔर ऋषियों के सभी प्रकार 'के पापों का-मोचन-करने - वाला है अब : पूर्ण विस्तार से और 'आलुपूर्बी अर्थात्-आरम्भ7से. अन्त तक क्रम से मैं अनुक्रम-सेःबतलाऊंगा
verses.wordMeaning: Although the establishment of the classification into the four castes had been made by him (LordBrahmi), the subjects, out of delusion» did not conform to those rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the establishment of the classification into the four castes had been made by him (LordBrahmi), the subjects, out of delusion» did not conform to those rules.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्बभूवुस्तेषां तु वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः । वस्त्राणि च प्रसूयंते फलान्याभरणानि च
verses.transliteration: prādurbabhūvusteṣāṃ tu vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ / vastrāṇi ca prasūyaṃte phalānyābharaṇāni ca
verses.translation: The subjects who lived in accordance with the duties of the (different) castes became antagonistic to one another. Lord Brahma understood everything factually.
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects who lived in accordance with the duties of the (different) castes became antagonistic to one another. Lord Brahma understood everything factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects who lived in accordance with the duties of the (different) castes became antagonistic to one another. Lord Brahma understood everything factually.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव जायते तेषां गन्धर्वाणां रसान्वितम् । आन्वीक्षिकं महावीर्यं पुटके पुटके मधु
verses.transliteration: tathaiva jāyate teṣāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ rasānvitam / ānvīkṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu
verses.translation: The abode of the Sudras who abide by their duty of rendering service is the world belonging to the Gandharvas. These are the abodes (after death) of the people of the differ¬ ent castes who remain good and maintain the conduct of life befitting their respective station in life.
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of the Sudras who abide by their duty of rendering service is the world belonging to the Gandharvas. These are the abodes (after death) of the people of the differ¬ ent castes who remain good and maintain the conduct of life befitting their respective station in life.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of the Sudras who abide by their duty of rendering service is the world belonging to the Gandharvas. These are the abodes (after death) of the people of the differ¬ ent castes who remain good and maintain the conduct of life befitting their respective station in life.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ता वर्त्तयन्ति स्ममुखे त्रेतायुगस्य वै । त्दृष्टपुष्टास्तया सिद्ध्या प्रजास्ता विगतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: tena tā varttayanti smamukhe tretāyugasya vai / tdṛṣṭapuṣṭāstayā siddhyā prajāstā vigatajvarāḥ
verses.translation: When this mode of disciplined life of the four castes had been well-established, the people of the different castes strictly adhered to the duties of their respective castes because they were afraid of punishment otherwise. Then, after the castes had been established, he stabilised the stages of life.
verses.wordMeaning: When this mode of disciplined life of the four castes had been well-established, the people of the different castes strictly adhered to the duties of their respective castes because they were afraid of punishment otherwise. Then, after the castes had been established,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When this mode of disciplined life of the four castes had been well-established, the people of the different castes strictly adhered to the duties of their respective castes because they were afraid of punishment otherwise. Then, after the castes had been established,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालांतरेप्येवं पुनर्लोभावृताः प्रजाः । वृक्षांस्ताः पर्यगृह्णंत मधु वा माक्षिकं बलात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālāṃtarepyevaṃ punarlobhāvṛtāḥ prajāḥ / vṛkṣāṃstāḥ paryagṛhṇaṃta madhu vā mākṣikaṃ balāt
verses.translation: The Lord established as before the following four Airamas (stages in life) viz-the householder, the celibate reli¬ gious student, the forest hermit and the ascetic.
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord established as before the following four Airamas (stages in life) viz-the householder, the celibate reli¬ gious student, the forest hermit and the ascetic.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord established as before the following four Airamas (stages in life) viz-the householder, the celibate reli¬ gious student, the forest hermit and the ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: तासां तेनापचारेण पुनर्लोभकृतेन वै । प्रनष्टा प्रभुणा सार्द्धं कल्पवृक्षाः क्वचित्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ tenāpacāreṇa punarlobhakṛtena vai / pranaṣṭā prabhuṇā sārddhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacitkvacit
verses.translation: (Defective text) the people of the four castes per¬ formed the duties of the respective castes. After doing their duties they erected their residences and maintained their stages of life and then enjoyed themselves.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) the people of the four castes per¬ formed the duties of the respective castes. After doing their duties they erected their residences and maintained their stages of life and then enjoyed themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) the people of the four castes per¬ formed the duties of the respective castes. After doing their duties they erected their residences and maintained their stages of life and then enjoyed themselves.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामेवाल्पशिष्टायां सिद्ध्यां कालवशात्तदा । वर्त्तंते चानया तासां द्वंद्वान्यत्युत्थितानि तु
verses.transliteration: tasyāmevālpaśiṣṭāyāṃ siddhyāṃ kālavaśāttadā / varttaṃte cānayā tāsāṃ dvaṃdvānyatyutthitāni tu
verses.translation: Brahma established those Airamas, He directed and guided those who swerved from these and recounted righteous virtues to them.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma established those Airamas, He directed and guided those who swerved from these and recounted righteous virtues to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma established those Airamas, He directed and guided those who swerved from these and recounted righteous virtues to them.

verses.sanskrit: शीतवातातपास्तीव्रास्ततस्ता दुःखिता भृशम् । द्वंद्वैस्तैः पीड्यमानास्तु चुक्रुशुरावृणानि वा
verses.transliteration: śītavātātapāstīvrāstatastā duḥkhitā bhṛśam / dvaṃdvaistaiḥ pīḍyamānāstu cukruśurāvṛṇāni vā
verses.translation: The following are the duties of the householder in brief: Marriage, maintenance of sacrificial fire, hospitability to guests, performance of Yajftas and continuation of his race (procreation).
verses.hindi: श्री सूतजो ने कहा--समस्त पापों का प्रमोचन कर देने बाली उनकी परम विव्य कथा का आप अब श्रवण कीजिए जो कि मेरे द्वारो कही जा रही है। यहद कथा बहुत ही विचित्र है और श्रुति के संमत है। इसका प्रचुर अर्थे भी है।१। जो पुरुष इस कया को नित्य घारण किया करता है ओर
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the duties of the householder in brief: Marriage, maintenance of sacrificial fire, hospitability to guests, performance of Yajftas and continuation of his race (procreation).
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the duties of the householder in brief: Marriage, maintenance of sacrificial fire, hospitability to guests, performance of Yajftas and continuation of his race (procreation).

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा द्वन्द्वप्रतीयातं निकेतानि विचेतसः । पूर्व निकामचारास्ते ह्यनिकेता यथाभवन्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā dvandvapratīyātaṃ niketāni vicetasaḥ / pūrva nikāmacārāste hyaniketā yathābhavan
verses.translation: The duties of the religious student are as follows: He must wear the girdle (of the munja grass) and hold the staff. He must wear the skin of an antelope. He must sleep on the ground. He must serve his preceptor. He must beg for alms. He must be eager to acquire learning.
verses.hindi: बारम्बार इसका श्रवण किया करता है वह अपने वंश को धारण करके अभ्त में स्वर्गलोक में प्रतिष्ठित हुआ करता है।२। जिस प्रकार से हुआ है और जैसा सुता गया है जो यह पंच विश्‍व तारा है । ज्ञान प्राप्त करने के लिए कीत्तित किया हुआ यह पूर्व में होने बालों की कीत्ति का बढ़ाने वाला है
verses.wordMeaning: The duties of the religious student are as follows: He must wear the girdle (of the munja grass) and hold the staff. He must wear the skin of an antelope. He must sleep on the ground. He must serve his preceptor. He must beg for alms. He must be eager to acquire learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: The duties of the religious student are as follows: He must wear the girdle (of the munja grass) and hold the staff. He must wear the skin of an antelope. He must sleep on the ground. He must serve his preceptor. He must beg for alms. He must be eager to acquire learning.

verses.sanskrit: यथायोगं यथाप्रीति निकेतेष्ववसन्पुरा । मधुधुन्वत्सु निष्ठेषु पर्वतेषु नदीषु च
verses.transliteration: yathāyogaṃ yathāprīti niketeṣvavasanpurā / madhudhunvatsu niṣṭheṣu parvateṣu nadīṣu ca
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: यह परम धन्यपण देने वाला -आगयु के बढ़ाने वाला--स्वर्गेलो क प्राप्त कराने जाला ओर शत्रुओं का नाशक है। स्थिर कीति से युक्त-दुष्य कर्मों वाले सबका कीत्तंन करना इन उपयुक्त सभी के देने वाला होता है ।ह जिसके कल्प भी कल्प का रूप धारण किया करता है ओर सम्पूर्ण शुचि के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: संश्रयंति च दुर्गाणि धन्वपावर्तमौदकम् । यथाजोषं यथाकामं समेषु विषमेषु च
verses.transliteration: saṃśrayaṃti ca durgāṇi dhanvapāvartamaudakam / yathājoṣaṃ yathākāmaṃ sameṣu viṣameṣu ca
verses.translation: VV.169-189 deichbe the dudes of the four Airamas or stages in life.
verses.hindi: भी शुचि है उन पुरुषों के स्वामी हिरण्यगर्भ के लिए जो अजन्मा है--संबसे प्रथम है--सबमें परमश्रेष्ठ है और प्रजांओं का सृजन करने वाले हैं उन लोह तन्त्र स्वयम्भू ब्रह्माजो के लिए नमस्कार है ।५-६। जो महत् का आदि में होने बाला है, जो विशेष के अन्त बाला है जो वैरूप्य से युक्त है-जो लक्षण
verses.wordMeaning: VV.169-189 deichbe the dudes of the four Airamas or stages in life.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.169-189 deichbe the dudes of the four Airamas or stages in life.

verses.sanskrit: आरब्धास्तान्निकेतान्वै कर्तुं शीतोष्णवारणात् । ततस्तान्निर्मयामासुः खेटानि च पुराणि च
verses.transliteration: ārabdhāstānniketānvai kartuṃ śītoṣṇavāraṇāt / tatastānnirmayāmāsuḥ kheṭāni ca purāṇi ca
verses.translation: Gf. g(hartko jwur qjanaMd
verses.hindi: बाला है--जो पांच प्रणामों वाला है-जो षद् श्रान्त है और पुरुषाधिष्ठित है
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. g(hartko jwur qjanaMd
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. g(hartko jwur qjanaMd

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामांश्चैव यथाभागं तथैव नगराणि च । तेषामायामविष्कंभाः सन्निवेशांतराणि च
verses.transliteration: grāmāṃścaiva yathābhāgaṃ tathaiva nagarāṇi ca / teṣāmāyāmaviṣkaṃbhāḥ sanniveśāṃtarāṇi ca
verses.translation: Five of them pertain to Bhikfus viz.: besting, knowledge (ofvedas) and religious vows.*
verses.wordMeaning: Five of them pertain to Bhikfus viz.: besting, knowledge (ofvedas) and religious vows.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Five of them pertain to Bhikfus viz.: besting, knowledge (ofvedas) and religious vows.*

verses.sanskrit: चक्रुस्तदा यथाज्ञानं मीत्वामीत्वात्मनोगुलैः । मानार्थानि प्रमाणानि तदा प्रभृति चक्रिरे
verses.transliteration: cakrustadā yathājñānaṃ mītvāmītvātmanogulaiḥ / mānārthāni pramāṇāni tadā prabhṛti cakrire
verses.translation: There are eightyeight thousand sages who live in perpetual celibacy. The place remembered as their is alone the abode of those who live with their preceptor (i.e. (Brahmtudrins),
verses.wordMeaning: There are eightyeight thousand sages who live in perpetual celibacy. The place remembered as their is alone the abode of those who live with their preceptor (i.e. (Brahmtudrins),
verses.commentary: Sense: There are eightyeight thousand sages who live in perpetual celibacy. The place remembered as their is alone the abode of those who live with their preceptor (i.e. (Brahmtudrins),

verses.sanskrit: ययांगुलप्रदेशांस्त्रीन्हस्तः किष्कुं धनूंषि च । दश त्वंगुलपर्वाणि प्रादेश इति संज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: yayāṃgulapradeśāṃstrīnhastaḥ kiṣkuṃ dhanūṃṣi ca / daśa tvaṃgulaparvāṇi prādeśa iti saṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: The place remembered as the abode of the seven sages (the great Bear) is (assigned as) that of the forest-dwel¬ lers. The world of Prajipati is the abode of house-holders and Brahma's abode is that of the ascetics.
verses.hindi: जगद्योनिम्महाभूतं पर् ब्रह्म सतातनम् । विग्रहं सर्वभूतानामव्यक्तमभवत्किल ।
verses.wordMeaning: The place remembered as the abode of the seven sages (the great Bear) is (assigned as) that of the forest-dwel¬ lers. The world of Prajipati is the abode of house-holders and Brahma's abode is that of the ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: The place remembered as the abode of the seven sages (the great Bear) is (assigned as) that of the forest-dwel¬ lers. The world of Prajipati is the abode of house-holders and Brahma's abode is that of the ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: अंगुष्ठस्य प्रदेशिन्या व्यासप्रादेश उच्यते । तालः स्मृतो मध्यमया गोकर्णश्चाप्यनामया
verses.transliteration: aṃguṣṭhasya pradeśinyā vyāsaprādeśa ucyate / tālaḥ smṛto madhyamayā gokarṇaścāpyanāmayā
verses.translation: ** (Defective tcxt)The abode of the Yogins has not been created (?) without conquering thern it does not exist (?) Those abodes of the penons of different stages of life are in¬ deed in the abode of Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: ** (Defective tcxt)The abode of the Yogins has not been created (?) without conquering thern it does not exist (?) Those abodes of the penons of different stages of life are in¬ deed in the abode of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: ** (Defective tcxt)The abode of the Yogins has not been created (?) without conquering thern it does not exist (?) Those abodes of the penons of different stages of life are in¬ deed in the abode of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठया वितस्तिस्तु द्वादशांगुल उच्यते । रत्निरंगुलपर्वाणि संख्यया त्वेकविशतिः
verses.transliteration: kaniṣṭhayā vitastistu dvādaśāṃgula ucyate / ratniraṃgulaparvāṇi saṃkhyayā tvekaviśatiḥ
verses.translation: Only four paths have been created as Devayanas (paths of the Devas). Only four paths are remembered as Pitryinas (paths of the manes).
verses.wordMeaning: Only four paths have been created as Devayanas (paths of the Devas). Only four paths are remembered as Pitryinas (paths of the manes).
verses.commentary: Sense: Only four paths have been created as Devayanas (paths of the Devas). Only four paths are remembered as Pitryinas (paths of the manes).

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि विंशतिश्चैव हस्तः स्यादंगुलानि तु । किष्कुः स्मृतो द्विरत्निस्तु द्विचत्वारिंशदंगुलः
verses.transliteration: catvāri viṃśatiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṃgulāni tu / kiṣkuḥ smṛto dviratnistu dvicatvāriṃśadaṃgulaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, in the first Manvantara (these had been created) by Brahm& who administered the worlds. Ravi (the sun) is remembered as the entrance to those paths that (are known as) Devay&nas. The moon (Candramas) is mentioned as the entrance ofPitryfinas.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, in the first Manvantara (these had been created) by Brahm& who administered the worlds. Ravi (the sun) is remembered as the entrance to those paths that (are known as) Devay&nas. The moon (Candramas) is mentioned as the entrance ofPitryfinas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, in the first Manvantara (these had been created) by Brahm& who administered the worlds. Ravi (the sun) is remembered as the entrance to those paths that (are known as) Devay&nas. The moon (Candramas) is mentioned as the entrance ofPitryfinas.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्हस्तो धनुर्द्दंडो नालिका युगमेव च । धनुःसहस्त्रे द्वे तत्र गव्यूतिस्तौः कृता तदा
verses.transliteration: caturhasto dhanurddaṃḍo nālikā yugameva ca / dhanuḥsahastre dve tatra gavyūtistauḥ kṛtā tadā
verses.translation: In that first Treti yuga, when it gradually reached its middle period he began to create mental progeny other than (what was before).
verses.hindi: इस परमोत्तम भूतों के सर्गे को संयम से आरम्भ करने हैं बतला-
verses.wordMeaning: In that first Treti yuga, when it gradually reached its middle period he began to create mental progeny other than (what was before).
verses.commentary: Sense: In that first Treti yuga, when it gradually reached its middle period he began to create mental progeny other than (what was before).

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ धनुःसहस्राणि योजनं तैर्विभावितम् । एतेन योजनेनेह सन्निवेशास्ततः कृताः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau dhanuḥsahasrāṇi yojanaṃ tairvibhāvitam / etena yojaneneha sanniveśāstataḥ kṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Then the same lord created the subjects with pre¬ dominating Sattva and Rajas qualities. They had the pursuit of virtue (Dharma), wealth, love and liberation and they accom¬ plished their professions for livelihood.
verses.hindi: ऊगा। जो अ्यक्त कारण है यह नित्य है और उसको स्वरूप सत् एवं जगत् दोनों ही प्रकार का है ।८। शस्यो का चिस्तत करने वाले विचारक लोग उस अ्यम्बक को प्रधान तथा प्रकृति कहा करते हैं जो कि गन्घ-्स्पशे और रस से रहित है तथ।-शब्द से भी विवर्जित हैं ।६। इस सम्पूर्णं जगत् की उत्पत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Then the same lord created the subjects with pre¬ dominating Sattva and Rajas qualities. They had the pursuit of virtue (Dharma), wealth, love and liberation and they accom¬ plished their professions for livelihood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the same lord created the subjects with pre¬ dominating Sattva and Rajas qualities. They had the pursuit of virtue (Dharma), wealth, love and liberation and they accom¬ plished their professions for livelihood.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्णामथ दुर्गाणां स्वयमुत्थानि त्रीणि च । चतुर्थ कृतिमं दुग तस्य वक्ष्यामि निर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: caturṇāmatha durgāṇāṃ svayamutthāni trīṇi ca / caturtha kṛtimaṃ duga tasya vakṣyāmi nirṇayam
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: स्थान, महाभूत सनातन परब्रह्म तथा समस्त भूतों का विग्रह निश्चित रूप से अव्यक्त हो गया था ।१०। आदि और अन्त से रहित अजन्मा, सूक्ष्म रूप वाला सत्व-रज और तम-इन तीन गुणों से युक्त अर्थात् त्रिगुणात्मक, सबका प्रभाव भी यह है जो असाम्प्रतिक, न जानने के योग्य, सत् और असत् स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: सोत्सेधरंध्रप्राकारं सर्वतः खातकावृतम् । रुचकः प्रतिकद्वारं कुमारीपुरमेव च
verses.transliteration: sotsedharaṃdhraprākāraṃ sarvataḥ khātakāvṛtam / rucakaḥ pratikadvāraṃ kumārīpurameva ca
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: वाला; पर ब्रह्म है । जो सभी भूतों का निग्रह है वही अब्यक्त हो. गया है। ।११। उसी को आत्मा से यह सम्पूर्ण विश्व व्याप्त है तम से परिपूर्ण है । उस समय में उस गुणों (तीतों गुणों) के साध्य होने पर यह तमोमय विभात नहीं होता है ।१९।'जब सृजन का समय होता है उस काल में कत्र. कें शाता
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: द्विहस्तः स्रोतसां श्रेष्ठं कुमारीपुरमञ्चतान् । हस्तस्रोतो दशश्रेष्ठो नवहस्तोष्ट एव च
verses.transliteration: dvihastaḥ srotasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kumārīpuramañcatān / hastasroto daśaśreṣṭho navahastoṣṭa eva ca
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: के द्वारा अधिष्ठित प्रधान के गुणों के भय से भासभान होने पर यह महा- तत्व होगया था ।१३। आगे बह सूक्ष्म रूप वाला महान् अव्यक्त . से समावृत था। सत्व गुण की अधिकता से युक्त महान् केवल सत्व का ही प्रकाश करने
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: खेटानां च पुराणां च ग्रामाणां चैव सर्वशः । त्रिविधानां च दुर्गाणां पर्वतोदकधन्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: kheṭānāṃ ca purāṇāṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ / trividhānāṃ ca durgāṇāṃ parvatodakadhanvinām
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्रिमाणां च दुर्गाणां विष्कम्भायाममेव च । योजनादर्द्धविष्कम्भमष्टभागाधिकायतम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtrimāṇāṃ ca durgāṇāṃ viṣkambhāyāmameva ca / yojanādarddhaviṣkambhamaṣṭabhāgādhikāyatam
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: परमार्द्धार्द्धमायामं प्रागुदक्प्लवनं पुरम् । छिन्नकर्णविकर्णं च व्यजनाकृतिसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: paramārddhārddhamāyāmaṃ prāgudakplavanaṃ puram / chinnakarṇavikarṇaṃ ca vyajanākṛtisaṃsthitam
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्तं वज्रं च दीर्घ च नगरं न प्रशस्यते । चतुरस्रयुतं दिव्यं प्रशस्तं तैः पुरं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: vṛttaṃ vajraṃ ca dīrgha ca nagaraṃ na praśasyate / caturasrayutaṃ divyaṃ praśastaṃ taiḥ puraṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशत्परं ह्रस्वं वास्तु वाष्टशतं परम् । अत्र मध्यं प्रशंसंति ह्रस्वं काष्ठविवर्ज्जितम्
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśatparaṃ hrasvaṃ vāstu vāṣṭaśataṃ param / atra madhyaṃ praśaṃsaṃti hrasvaṃ kāṣṭhavivarjjitam
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: सत्र से बह मह।च् एक जानने के योगै । और एक ही कारण कहा गया हैं क्षेत्रज से अधिषिठत महत् केवल लिङ्ग ही समुत्पन्न हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: अथ किष्कुशतान्यष्टौ प्राहुर्मुख्यं निवेशनम् । नगरादर्द्धविषकंभः खेटं पानं तदूर्द्धतः
verses.transliteration: atha kiṣkuśatānyaṣṭau prāhurmukhyaṃ niveśanam / nagarādarddhaviṣakaṃbhaḥ kheṭaṃ pānaṃ tadūrddhataḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: 'उसंकी 'छै' प्रकार की वृत्ति बतायी गयी है--एक तो सङ्भूल्प और दूसरी वृत्ति अध्यवसाय' है । सृजन करने की “इच्छा से वीतमांन वहं इस महती सृष्टि'को' दिया करता है ।१६। ओर घर्म आदिःअूत लोकतत्वाथं के हेतु हैं । महांन्ं'आरमा' में मन हो बहा है और ईश्वर से इसकी दुबुं द्धि यह ख्याति है
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: नगराद्योजनं खेटं खेटाद्गामोर्द्धयोजनम् । द्विक्रोशः परमा सीमा क्षेत्रसीमा चतुर्द्धनुः
verses.transliteration: nagarādyojanaṃ kheṭaṃ kheṭādgāmorddhayojanam / dvikrośaḥ paramā sīmā kṣetrasīmā caturddhanuḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: इस कारण से विभु'चेष्टा'के वाला होता है।१८। भोक्ता (भोगने बाला) वरि्ांण करने वाला-विभक्त आत्मा वाला बरतने वाला जो है'वही मन कहा जातां हैं । जिसमें तत्वों के संग्रह में है और परिणाम से महानूः है
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: विंशद्धनूंषि विस्तीर्णो दिशां मार्गस्तु तैः कृतः । विंशद्धनुर्ग्राममार्गः सीमामार्गो दशैव तु

verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.transliteration: siddhātmānastu ye pūrvaṃ vyākhyātā vaḥ kṛte mayā / brahmaṇo mānasāste vai utpannā ye janādiha

verses.sanskrit: शांता ये शुष्मिणश्चैव कर्मिणो दुःखितास्तथा । तत आवर्त्तमानास्ते त्रेतायां जज्ञिरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: śāṃtā ye śuṣmiṇaścaiva karmiṇo duḥkhitāstathā / tata āvarttamānāste tretāyāṃ jajñire punaḥ

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याःशूद्रा द्रोहजनास्तथा । भाविताः पूर्वजातीषु ख्यात्या ते शुभपापयोः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥśūdrā drohajanāstathā / bhāvitāḥ pūrvajātīṣu khyātyā te śubhapāpayoḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: जिस अणु में ये सात लोक संप्रतिष्ठित हैं। इनमें पृथिवी है जो सात द्वीपों से और सात समुद्रो से युक्त हैं इस पृथ्बो में महान् पर्वत है और सहस्रों नदियाँ भी बिद्यमान है । अन्दर स्थित इसके ये सब लोक हैं और अन्दर में. रहने विश्व में यह जगत रहता है ।२६-३०। समस्त नक्षनों के साथ चन्द्रमा
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते प्रबला ये तु सत्यशीला अहिंसकाः । वीतलोभा जितात्मानो निवसंति स्मृतेषु वै
verses.transliteration: tataste prabalā ye tu satyaśīlā ahiṃsakāḥ / vītalobhā jitātmāno nivasaṃti smṛteṣu vai
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: और सूरय है तथा.वायु के साथ संग्रह है । और, लोकालोक है । जो कुछ भी. है । वह सब्र उस अण्ड में प्रतिष्ठित हैं अर्थात् विद्यमान रहा करता है
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: परिग्रहं न कुर्वंति वदंतस्तु उपस्थिताः । तेषां कर्माणि कुर्वंति तेभ्यश्चैवाबलाश्च ये
verses.transliteration: parigrahaṃ na kurvaṃti vadaṃtastu upasthitāḥ / teṣāṃ karmāṇi kurvaṃti tebhyaścaivābalāśca ye
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: दण'गुनेःतेज के साथ बाहिर को ओर जल आवृत रहते हैं । इश गुणित बायु के द्वारा बह तेज भी आवृत रहता है ।३२। दश गुने नभ (आकाश) से बह बायु वृत रहता है जोकि बाहिरि को आर है। फिर बह आकाश . सम्पूर्ण बाहिर भूतादि से आवृत है ।३३। भूतादिक महान से समावृत है और महान
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: परिचर्यासु वर्त्तन्ते तेभ्यश्चान्ये ऽल्पतेजसः । एवं विप्रतिपन्नेषु प्रपन्नेषु परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: paricaryāsu varttante tebhyaścānye 'lpatejasaḥ / evaṃ vipratipanneṣu prapanneṣu parasparam
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: प्रधान के द्वारा आवृत है । इन सात प्राकृत आवरणों के द्वारा यह अण्ड, आवृत रहा करता है ।३४। एक दूसरे के मरण में परस्पर में इच्छा से आवृत प्रकृतियाँ स्थित हैं और प्रस्ग के अर्थात् सृजन के समय में स्थित होकर परस्पर में ग्रसन किया करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.transliteration: tena doṣeṇa vai śāṃtā oṣadhyo nitarāṃ tadā / pranaṣṭā gṛhyamāṇā vai muṣṭibhyāṃ sikatā yathā
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.transliteration: athāsya tu yugabalādgāmyāraṇyāścaturddaśa / phalairgṛhṇaṃti puṣpaiśca tathā mūlaiśca tāḥ punaḥ

verses.sanskrit: वृत्त्यर्थमभिलिप्संत्यो ह्यादौ त्रेतायुगस्य ताः । ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् ज्ञात्वा तासां मनीषितम्

verses.transliteration: puṣṭipratyakṣadṛṣṭena darśanena vicārya saḥ / grastāḥ pṛthivyā tvoṣadhyo jñātvā pratyarūhatpunaḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से परस्पर में एक दूसरे को धारण किया करते हैं । ये विकार वालों में आधार ओर आधेय के भाव से वे सब विकार होते हैं । ।३६। इस अभ्यक्ता को ही क्षेत्र कहा जाता है ओर ब्रह्मा क्षेत्रज्ञ कहा जाया करता है । इस रोति से यह प्राकृत सर्ग है और बह कषेत्रज्ञ से अधिष्ठितं

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वत्सं समेरुं तु दुदोह पृथिवीमिमाम् । दुग्धेयं गौस्तदा तेन बीजानि वसुधातले
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vatsaṃ sameruṃ tu dudoha pṛthivīmimām / dugdheyaṃ gaustadā tena bījāni vasudhātale
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: होता है ।३७ प्रथम अबुद्धि पूर्वक होता है जिस तरह से तड़ित होती है । हिरण्यगर्भे का जन्म तो ता्बिक रूप से जानता हूँ बह आयु बाला-कीशि से समभ्वित-धन्य और प्रज्ञा वाला होता. है--इसमें लेशमात्र भी संशय नहीं हैं । कषा
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.transliteration: jajñire tāni bījāni grāmāraṇyāstu tāḥ prabhuḥ / oṣadhyaḥ phalapākātāḥ kṣaṇasaptavaśāstu tāḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.transliteration: māṣā mudgā masūrāstu nīvārāḥ sakulatthakāḥ / harikāścarakāścaiva gamaḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नाः प्रथमस्यैता आदौ त्रेतायुगस्य ह । अफालकृष्टास्ताः सर्वा ग्राम्यारण्यश्चतुर्द्दश
verses.transliteration: utpannāḥ prathamasyaitā ādau tretāyugasya ha / aphālakṛṣṭāstāḥ sarvā grāmyāraṇyaścaturddaśa
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: श्रीसूतजी ने कहा-व्यक्त के आत्मा  में अवस्थित होत़े- पर: और चिकार के प्रति सहत हो जाने पर उस समय में प्रधान और पुरुष सहकर्मता के साथ अवस्थित हुआ करते हैं ।१। तमोगुण और सत्वगुण ये दोनों समता से व्यवस्थित हुआ करते हैं। उसके साथ ये उद्रिक्त नहीं होते ' हैं" और

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्ल्यो वीरुधस्तृणजातयः । मूलैः फलैश्च रोहैश्चगृह्णन्पुष्टाश्च यत्फलम्

verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: परस्पर से उसके अनुगामी रहा करते हैं ।२। जब इन ग् णों की समता होती है तो' उस समय में लय जान लेना चाहिए”आर जब इनमें किसी भी अधिन कता अर्थात् परस्पर में विषमता होती है तो उस अवस्था में: सृष्टिःकहीः जाया करती है सत्व की वृद्धि में स्थिति हुई थी और ध्रुव पद्म शिखा में.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वी दुग्धा तु बीजानि यानि पूर्वं स्वयंभुवा । ऋतुपुष्पफलास्ता वै ओषध्यो जज्ञिरे त्विह
verses.transliteration: pṛthvī dugdhā tu bījāni yāni pūrvaṃ svayaṃbhuvā / ṛtupuṣpaphalāstā vai oṣadhyo jajñire tviha
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: होता'है' ओरं वह बीजों में जल के ही समान श्रवत्तक होता है ।४॥ ये गुण' विषमता की दशा को प्राप्तकरके प्रसङ्ग से प्रतिष्ठित होते हैं। ग्.णों के क्षोभ्यमाण होने से ये तीनों गण बड़े आदर में जानने के योग्य होते हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रसृष्टा ओषध्यो न प्रथंतीह याः पुनः । ततस्तासां च पृत्त्यर्थै वार्तोपायं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: yadā prasṛṣṭā oṣadhyo na prathaṃtīha yāḥ punaḥ / tatastāsāṃ ca pṛttyarthai vārtopāyaṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: ये शाए्वल अर्थात् नित्य रहने वाले हैं-परमग,ह्य है-सबकी आत्मा. हैः और शरीरधारी है । सत्वग्ण विष्णु हैं--रजोग्ण प्रजापति ब्रह्मा है और तमोग्,ण साक्षात् रुद्र देव हैं ,।६॥ रजोगुण के प्रकाशक विष्णु ब्रह्मा के स्रष्टा होने की अवस्था को प्राप्त किया करते हैं। जिस महात् ओज वाले से यह
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: तासां स्वयंभूर्भगवान् हस्तसिद्धिं स्वकर्मजाम् । ततः प्रभृति चौषध्यः कृष्टपच्यास्तु जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ svayaṃbhūrbhagavān hastasiddhiṃ svakarmajām / tataḥ prabhṛti cauṣadhyaḥ kṛṣṭapacyāstu jajñire
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: बिचित्र प्रकार की सृष्टि समुत्पन्न हुआ करती है

verses.transliteration: saṃsiddhakāyo vārtāyāṃ tatastāsāṃ prajāpatiḥ / maryādāṃ sthāpayāmāsa yayārakṣatparasparam

verses.transliteration: ye vai parigrahītārastāsāmāsanbalīyasaḥ / itareṣāṃ kṛtatrāṇān sthāpayāmāsa kṣatriyān

verses.transliteration: upatiṣṭhaṃti tāvaṃto yāvanto nirmitāstathā / satyaṃ būta yathābhūtaṃ dhruvaṃ vo brahmaṇāstu tāḥ

verses.transliteration: śilpājīvabhṛtāṃ caiva śūdrāṇāṃ vyadadhātpunaḥ / sāmānyāni ca karmāṇi brahmakṣatraviśāṃ punaḥ

verses.transliteration: yajanādhyāpane dānaṃ sāmānyānītareṣu ca / karmājīvaṃ tu vai dattvā teṣāmiha parasparam

verses.hindi: उस पतित पावनी ग्भा के पुनीत जल से उन सबके गात्रनअस्थि और भस्म के पवित्र हो जाने पर वे समस्त आपके ,पितृगण स्वगे में गति को प्राप्त करेगे ।१०! है नृपनन्दन उस गङ्का का माहारम्य ही ऐसा अद्भुत है । राजा भगीरथ के द्वारा यहाँ लाने से इस लोक में उसका नाम भागीरथी

verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ lokāṃtare mūrdhni sthānāni vidadhe punaḥ / prājāpatyaṃ dvijātīnāṃ smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ kriyāvatām

verses.hindi: असिद्ध होगा ।५१। गङ्का का बड़ा अदुभुठ माहातम्य होता है कि उसके जल में किसी भी प्राणी को अस्थि-भस्म-न आदि कोई भी भाग जब प्लावित हो जाता है तो बह प्राणी नरक की यातनाओं से भी मुक्त होकर अक्षय स्वर्गलोक में चला जाया करता है ।५२। इस कारण से अब आप यहां से

verses.transliteration: sthānamaidraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ saṃgrāmeṣvapalāyinām / vaiśyānāṃ mārutaṃ sthānaṃ svasvakarmopajīvinām

verses.transliteration: gāṃdharvaṃ śūdrajātīnāṃ paricarye ca tiṣṭhatām / sthānānyetāni varṇānāṃ yogyācāravatāṃ satām

verses.transliteration: saṃsthityāṃ sukṛtāyāṃ vai cāturvarṇyasya tasya tat / varṇāstu daṃḍabhayataḥ svesve varṇye vyavasthitāḥ / tataḥ sthiteṣu varṇeṣu sthāpayāmāsa hyāśramān

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थो यतिस्तथा । आश्रमाश्चतुरो ह्येतान्पूर्ववत्स्थापयन्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho yatistathā / āśramāścaturo hyetānpūrvavatsthāpayanprabhuḥ

verses.hindi: बह प्रयम ही शरीर था जो कि धारणत्व से व्यवस्थित था। यहाँ

verses.sanskrit: वर्णकर्माणि ये केचित्तेषामिह चतुर्भवः । कृतकर्म्म कृतावासा आश्रमादुपभुञ्जते
verses.transliteration: varṇakarmāṇi ye kecitteṣāmiha caturbhavaḥ / kṛtakarmma kṛtāvāsā āśramādupabhuñjate

verses.hindi: पर अनृपम ज्ञान से और बेराग्य से सप्तति था। इसके अब्यक्तता के लिए उस मन से वह जो-जो भी इच्छा करता था बही करता था क्योंकि इसके तीनों गुण बश में किये हुए थे और भाव से वे एक दूसरे की अपेक्षा करने बाले थे ।१५-१६। चतुमु' ख ब्रह्मात्व को प्राप्त किया था और अन्त करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा तान्स्थापयामास आश्रमान् भ्रामतामतः । निर्द्दिदेश ततस्तेषां ब्रह्मा धर्मान्प्रभा षते
verses.transliteration: brahmā tānsthāpayāmāsa āśramān bhrāmatāmataḥ / nirddideśa tatasteṣāṃ brahmā dharmānprabhā ṣate
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: पुरुष हुए । इस प्रकार से स्वयम्भू की हो ये तीन अवस्थाएं थीं । १७। ब्रह्मत्व की दशा में सब रजोगण है और काल की अबस्था में रजोग,ण और तमो- ग्ण होता है ।.जब पुरुष की दशा में यह होते हैं तो तत्वग,ण के युक्त होते हैं। इस प्रकार से “स्वयम्भू में ग,णों की वृत्ति होती है ।१८। जब ब्रह्मा की

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्थानानि तु तेषां च यमान्सनियमांस्तथा । चतुर्वर्णात्मकः पूर्वं गृहस्थस्याश्रमः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: prasthānāni tu teṣāṃ ca yamānsaniyamāṃstathā / caturvarṇātmakaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhasthasyāśramaḥ sthitaḥ

verses.transliteration: trayāṇā māśramāṇāṃ ca vṛttiyonīti caiva hi / yathākramaṃ ca vakṣyāmi vrataiśca niyamaistathā

verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām / smṛtaṃ teṣāṃ tu yat sthānaṃ tadeva guruvāsinām

verses.hindi: अनेक क्रिया-आकार और स्वरूप का आश्रय ग्रहण किया करते हैं और यह सब अपनी ही लीला से करते रहा करते हैं। लोक में यह तीन प्रकार बाले होकर रहते हैं इसी कारण से इनको विगुण कहा जाता है ।२२। जार भ्रकार से प्रबिभवत होने से यह चतुब्यूं ह कहा गया है। जिस
