verses.transliteration: yogināmakṛtaṃ sthānaṃ tānājitbā na vidyate / sthānānyāśramiṇastāni brahmasthānasthitāni tu
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: होता है । इसी से आत्मा कहा जाता है ओर ऋषि इसमें सबंगत हैं। वह शरीर में आते हैं ।२५। भगवान् विष्णु सबके स्वामी हैं क्योंकि विष्णु का सभी में प्रवेश होता है। भगवान् अप्रसदुभावस नाग हैं ओर ताग का संश्रयः नहीं होता है ।२५। संप्रहृष्ट होने से परम है और देवता होने से ओस् यह
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वार एव पंथानो देवयानानि निर्मिताः । पंथानः पितृयानास्तु समृताश्चत्वार एव ते
verses.transliteration: catvāra eva paṃthāno devayānāni nirmitāḥ / paṃthānaḥ pitṛyānāstu samṛtāścatvāra eva te
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: स्मृति है। सबके बिज्ञान होने से यह सर्वेज्ञ हैं क्योंकि यह सबमें हैं अतएव सह् सर्व कहा जाता है ।२६। नरों में अर्थात् जलों में यह स्वपन किया करते हैं इस कारण से ब्रह्माजी नारायण कहे गये हैं और अपने आपके स्वरूप को तीन प्रकार से विभक्त करके यह सकल से संप्रवृत्त हुआ करते हैँ ।२७। इन
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणां लोकतन्त्रेण आद्ये मन्वन्तरे पुरा । पंथानो देवयाना ये तेषां द्वारं रंविः स्मृतः । तथैव पितृयानानां चन्द्रमा द्वारमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇāṃ lokatantreṇa ādye manvantare purā / paṃthāno devayānā ye teṣāṃ dvāraṃ raṃviḥ smṛtaḥ / tathaiva pitṛyānānāṃ candramā dvāramucyate
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: तीनों स्वरूपो से यह लोकों का सूजन पालन और करम से गसन किया करते हैं। बही सबसे आगे हिरण्यगर्भ होते हुए स्वयं प्रादुभू'त हुए हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वर्णाश्रमाणां च प्रविभागे कृते तदा । यदा प्रजा ना वर्द्धंत वर्णधर्मसमासिकाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca pravibhāge kṛte tadā / yadā prajā nā varddhaṃta varṇadharmasamāsikāḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्यां मानसीं स्वां वै त्रेतामध्ये ऽसृजत्प्रजाः । आत्मनस्तु शरीरेभ्यस्तुल्याश्चैवात्मना तु ताः
verses.transliteration: tato 'nyāṃ mānasīṃ svāṃ vai tretāmadhye 'sṛjatprajāḥ / ātmanastu śarīrebhyastulyāścaivātmanā tu tāḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिस्त्रेतायुगे त्वाद्ये मध्यं प्राप्ते क्रमेण तु । ततो ऽन्यां मानसीं सो ऽथ प्रजाः स्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tasmistretāyuge tvādye madhyaṃ prāpte krameṇa tu / tato 'nyāṃ mānasīṃ so 'tha prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सत्त्वरजोद्रिक्ताः प्रजाः सह्यसृजत्प्रभुः । धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां वार्त्तानां साधकाश्च याः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sattvarajodriktāḥ prajāḥ sahyasṛjatprabhuḥ / dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ vārttānāṃ sādhakāśca yāḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च पितरश्चैव ऋषयो मनवस्तथा । युगानुरूपा धर्मेण यैरिमा वर्द्धिताः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: devāśca pitaraścaiva ṛṣayo manavastathā / yugānurūpā dharmeṇa yairimā varddhitāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्थिते तदा तस्मिन् सृष्टिवर्गे स्वयंभुवः । अभिध्याय प्रजा ब्रह्मा नानावीर्याः स्वमानसीः
verses.transliteration: upasthite tadā tasmin sṛṣṭivarge svayaṃbhuvaḥ / abhidhyāya prajā brahmā nānāvīryāḥ svamānasīḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वोक्ता या मया तुभ्यं जनानीकं समाश्रिताः । कल्पे ऽतीते पुराण्यासीद्देवाद्यास्तु प्रजा इह
verses.transliteration: pūrvoktā yā mayā tubhyaṃ janānīkaṃ samāśritāḥ / kalpe 'tīte purāṇyāsīddevādyāstu prajā iha
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि यह सबसे आदि काल में होने वाले हैं। अतएव यहु स्ववशी हैं अर्थात् अपने' ही' वश में रहने वाले हैं ऐसा हो कहा गया है । उसी कारण से पुराणों में इनको" हिरण्वगभं' कहा जाया. करता है ।२९। जो स्वयम्भुब है बह निवृत्त का वर्णों में अग्रकाल है। इसकी परिसंख्या x के सेकड़ों बर्षों
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतस्तस्य तानीह संभूत्यर्थमुपस्तिताः । मन्वंतरक्रमेणेह कनिष्ठाः प्रथमेन ताः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyatastasya tānīha saṃbhūtyarthamupastitāḥ / manvaṃtarakrameṇeha kaniṣṭhāḥ prathamena tāḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: में भी नहीं की जा सकती है'३०। कल्पों ' की संख्या से निवृत्तः ब्रह्मा का पराध॑ कहा गया है । उतने ही में इसका वह काल है उसके अन्त में'अन्य' काल" प्रतिबुद्ध होता' है ।३१। करोड़ों सहस्नर-वर्ष' जो कि इसके'गृहभूत हैं। उतने कल्पों के समतीत हैं और जो शेष हैं वे दूसरे हैं।३२। जो स्वयं कल्प
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातास्तु वंश्यैरेतैस्तु पूर्वं यैरिह भाविताः । कुशलाकुशलैः कंदैरक्षीणैस्तैस्तदा युताः
verses.transliteration: khyātāstu vaṃśyairetaistu pūrvaṃ yairiha bhāvitāḥ / kuśalākuśalaiḥ kaṃdairakṣīṇaistaistadā yutāḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.hindi: है वह वाराह कल्प है“-ऐसा ही समझ'लो। प्रथम उनमें साम्प्रत” है ओर! जो कल्प होता है 7३३। एक सहल्न युगों के पूर्ण हो जाने पर नरेशवरों के द्वारा परिपालन के योग्य है'
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्मफलदोषेण ह्युपबाधाः प्रजज्ञिरे । देवासुरपितॄंश्चैव यक्षैर्गन्धर्वमानुषैः
verses.transliteration: tatkarmaphaladoṣeṇa hyupabādhāḥ prajajñire / devāsurapitṝṃścaiva yakṣairgandharvamānuṣaiḥ
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसैस्तु पिशाचैस्तैः पशुपक्षिसरीसृपैः । वृक्षनारककीटाद्यैस्तैस्तैः सर्वैरुपस्थिताः । आहारार्थं प्रजानां वै विदात्मानो विनिर्ममे
verses.transliteration: rākṣasaistu piśācaistaiḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpaiḥ / vṛkṣanārakakīṭādyaistaistaiḥ sarvairupasthitāḥ / āhārārthaṃ prajānāṃ vai vidātmāno vinirmame
verses.translation: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Oevas, the Pitfs, the sages and the Manus (i.e. human beings?) In regard to their characteristics they were in accordance with the respective Yugas. By these, the subjects (in the universe) flourished.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्मांडे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषंगपादे लोकज्ञान वर्णनं नाम सप्तमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच ततोभिध्यायतस्तस्य मानस्यो जज्ञिरे प्रजाः । तच्छरीरसमुत्पन्नैः कार्यैस्तैः कारणैः सह
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṃḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṃgapāde lokajñāna varṇanaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tatobhidhyāyatastasya mānasyo jajñire prajāḥ / taccharīrasamutpannaiḥ kāryaistaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: That physical body discarded by him immediately became Night. Since that physical body bad the Tamas ele¬ ment predominant, the night too consisting of three Tdtnas (watches of night of the duration of three hours each) became Tamcbokula (one in which darkness prevails).
verses.wordMeaning: That physical body discarded by him immediately became Night. Since that physical body bad the Tamas ele¬ ment predominant, the night too consisting of three Tdtnas (watches of night of the duration of three hours each) became Tamcbokula (one in which darkness prevails).
verses.commentary: Sense: That physical body discarded by him immediately became Night. Since that physical body bad the Tamas ele¬ ment predominant, the night too consisting of three Tdtnas (watches of night of the duration of three hours each) became Tamcbokula (one in which darkness prevails).

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञाः समवर्त्तन्त क्षेत्रस्यैतस्य धीमतः । ततो देवासुरपितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च चतुषृयम्
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñāḥ samavarttanta kṣetrasyaitasya dhīmataḥ / tato devāsurapitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca catuṣṛyam
verses.translation: After creadng the Devas, ho discarded that divine body. Thai physical body discarded by hiin became "day".
verses.wordMeaning: After creadng the Devas, ho discarded that divine body. Thai physical body discarded by hiin became "day".
verses.commentary: Sense: After creadng the Devas, ho discarded that divine body. Thai physical body discarded by hiin became "day".

verses.sanskrit: सिसृक्षुरयुतातानि स चात्मानमयूयुजत् । युक्तात्मनस्ततस्तस्य तमोमात्रासमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: sisṛkṣurayutātāni sa cātmānamayūyujat / yuktātmanastatastasya tamomātrāsamudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, people worship the Devas with holy rites performed during the daytime. After creating the Devas, he adopted another body.
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, people worship the Devas with holy rites performed during the daytime. After creating the Devas, he adopted another body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, people worship the Devas with holy rites performed during the daytime. After creating the Devas, he adopted another body.

verses.sanskrit: तदाभिध्यायतः सर्गं प्रयत्नो ऽभूत्प्रजापतेः । ततो ऽस्य जघ नात्पूर्वमसुरा जज्ञिर सुताः
verses.transliteration: tadābhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ prayatno 'bhūtprajāpateḥ / tato 'sya jagha nātpūrvamasurā jajñira sutāḥ
verses.translation: He discarded diat body whereby the Pitfs were created. The body that liad been discarded by him fonliwith became the twilight.
verses.wordMeaning: He discarded diat body whereby the Pitfs were created. The body that liad been discarded by him fonliwith became the twilight.
verses.commentary: Sense: He discarded diat body whereby the Pitfs were created. The body that liad been discarded by him fonliwith became the twilight.

verses.sanskrit: असुः प्राणः स्मृतो विज्ञैस्तज्जन्मानस्ततो ऽसुराः । सृष्टा यया सुरास्तन्वा तां तनुं स व्यपोहत
verses.transliteration: asuḥ prāṇaḥ smṛto vijñaistajjanmānastato 'surāḥ / sṛṣṭā yayā surāstanvā tāṃ tanuṃ sa vyapohata
verses.translation: Hence the Devas, the Asuras, the sages and the hu- man beings, while practising Yoga, worship that body which is in between dawn and morning (day-break).
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the Devas, the Asuras, the sages and the hu- man beings, while practising Yoga, worship that body which is in between dawn and morning (day-break).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the Devas, the Asuras, the sages and the hu- man beings, while practising Yoga, worship that body which is in between dawn and morning (day-break).

verses.sanskrit: सापविद्धा तनुस्तेन सद्यो रात्रिरजायत । सा तमोबहुला यस्मात्ततो रात्रिस्त्रियामिका
verses.transliteration: sāpaviddhā tanustena sadyo rātrirajāyata / sā tamobahulā yasmāttato rātristriyāmikā
verses.translation: Hence, Brma perform at the junction
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा तु सलिलेततस्मिन्नवाग् सूत्वा तदाः चरच्।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, Brma perform at the junction
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, Brma perform at the junction

verses.sanskrit: आवृतास्तमसा रात्रौ प्रजा स्तस्मात्स्वयं पुनः । सृष्ट्वासुरांस्ततः सो ऽथ तनुमन्यामपद्यत
verses.transliteration: āvṛtāstamasā rātrau prajā stasmātsvayaṃ punaḥ / sṛṣṭvāsurāṃstataḥ so 'tha tanumanyāmapadyata
verses.translation: That body which the lord created mentally was solely constituted by the Rajas clement. They (the progeny so created) are his sons through the mind. Since they were bot- ten {Pfigananilt), they became Prajis (subjects).
verses.wordMeaning: That body which the lord created mentally was solely constituted by the Rajas clement. They (the progeny so created) are his sons through the mind. Since they were bot- ten {Pfigananilt), they became Prajis (subjects).
verses.commentary: Sense: That body which the lord created mentally was solely constituted by the Rajas clement. They (the progeny so created) are his sons through the mind. Since they were bot- ten {Pfigananilt), they became Prajis (subjects).

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तां सत्त्वबहुलां ततस्तां सो ऽभ्ययुञ्जत । ततस्तां युञ्ज मानस्य प्रियमासीत्प्रभोः किल
verses.transliteration: avyaktāṃ sattvabahulāṃ tatastāṃ so 'bhyayuñjata / tatastāṃ yuñja mānasya priyamāsītprabhoḥ kila
verses.translation: Since, he meditated (before creation) {Manmdl) they are called Mommas (Mm); they became wellknown as Prajds because they were procreated. After creating the subjccta again, he discarded his own body.
verses.hindi: श्रीसूतजी ने' कहा--इस पृथिवी तत्व में सबसे पूर्व जल ही जल सर्वत्र था और यह शोल तथाः प्रलीनःथा । २ इसमेंशउस-समय कुछ भी नहीं जाना जाता था ।१। केवल एक समुद्र ही था और उस सागर में सभी स्था- वर (अचर) ओर जङ्गम (चर) नष्ट हो गये ये। विभु (व्यापक) वह ब्रह्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Since, he meditated (before creation) {Manmdl) they are called Mommas (Mm); they became wellknown as Prajds because they were procreated. After creating the subjccta again, he discarded his own body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since, he meditated (before creation) {Manmdl) they are called Mommas (Mm); they became wellknown as Prajds because they were procreated. After creating the subjccta again, he discarded his own body.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुखात्समुत्पन्ना दीव्यतस्तस्य देवताः । यतो ऽस्य दीव्यतो जातास्तेन देवाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: tato mukhātsamutpannā dīvyatastasya devatāḥ / yato 'sya dīvyato jātāstena devāḥ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: Correct etymoI<igy coeaos both *to play* and 'to shine'.
verses.hindi: जी उस समय में सहाँ पादों ओर नेत्रों वाले हो जाया करते हैं ।२। सहस्रों शीर्षो वाले, सुवणे के समान जिनका वर्ण था और जो इन्द्रियों की पहुँच से परे थे अर्थात् अप्रत्यक्ष थे ऐसे पुरुष नारायण नाम वाले ब्रह्म उस समय 'में समुद्र में शयन कर रहे ये ।३। सत्व के उद्रेक से "निषिद्ध होते हुए उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: Correct etymoI<igy coeaos both *to play* and 'to shine'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Correct etymoI<igy coeaos both *to play* and 'to shine'.

verses.sanskrit: धातुर्दिव्येति यः प्रोक्तः क्रीडायां स विभाव्यते । तस्मात्तन्वास्तु दिव्याया जज्ञिरे तेन देवताः
verses.transliteration: dhāturdivyeti yaḥ proktaḥ krīḍāyāṃ sa vibhāvyate / tasmāttanvāstu divyāyā jajñire tena devatāḥ
verses.translation: Thus these physical bodies discarded by that noble* souled person immediately became night, day, twilight and moonlight.'
verses.hindi: उस समय में इस लोक को शून्य देखा था । यहाँ पर भगवान् नारायणं के
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these physical bodies discarded by that noble* souled person immediately became night, day, twilight and moonlight.'
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these physical bodies discarded by that noble* souled person immediately became night, day, twilight and moonlight.'

verses.sanskrit: देवान् सृष्ट्वा ततः सो ऽथ तनुं दिव्यामपोहत । उत्सृष्टा सा तनुस्तेन अहः समभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: devān sṛṣṭvā tataḥ so 'tha tanuṃ divyāmapohata / utsṛṣṭā sā tanustena ahaḥ samabhavattadā
verses.translation: The moonlight, the twilight, and the day these three are constituted solely of the Sattva element. The night is cons¬ tituted of Tainas only. Hence that is A'tydmiifl* (that which checks, restrains and restricts).
verses.hindi: को नारा कहा गया है और ये जल ही नर के आत्मज हैं। वे जल ही उन TR के निवास स्यान है अतएव प्रभु का नाम नारायण कहा गया है ।५। सहस्रों युगों के तुल्य काल तक वे प्रभु वहाँ पर निवास करते हुए स्थित रहे ये । ब्रह्मत्व के अदशेन के कारण से वे स्वर्ण पत्र किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The moonlight, the twilight, and the day these three are constituted solely of the Sattva element. The night is cons¬ tituted of Tainas only. Hence that is A'tydmiifl* (that which checks, restrains and restricts).
verses.commentary: Sense: The moonlight, the twilight, and the day these three are constituted solely of the Sattva element. The night is cons¬ tituted of Tainas only. Hence that is A'tydmiifl* (that which checks, restrains and restricts).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादहःकर्मयुक्ता देवताः समुपासते । देवान्सृष्ट्वा ततः सो ऽथ तनुमन्यामपद्यत
verses.transliteration: tasmādahaḥkarmayuktā devatāḥ samupāsate / devānsṛṣṭvā tataḥ so 'tha tanumanyāmapadyata
verses.translation: So, the Devas were created by means of the shining divine body with pleasure and sportiveness through the face (mouth). Since their birth was during the day time, they are powerful during the day time.
verses.hindi: जिस तरह से वर्षा ऋतु में राचि में खद्योत चकमता हुआ यहाँ से वहाँ भूमा करता है
verses.wordMeaning: So, the Devas were created by means of the shining divine body with pleasure and sportiveness through the face (mouth). Since their birth was during the day time, they are powerful during the day time.
verses.commentary: Sense: So, the Devas were created by means of the shining divine body with pleasure and sportiveness through the face (mouth). Since their birth was during the day time, they are powerful during the day time.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वमात्रात्मिकामेव ततो ऽन्यामभ्ययुङ्क्त वै । पितेव मन्यमानस्तान्पुत्रान्प्रध्याय स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sattvamātrātmikāmeva tato 'nyāmabhyayuṅkta vai / piteva manyamānastānputrānpradhyāya sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Since the lord created the Asuras at night from his loins through the vital breaths, and as they were born during the night, they are invincible durii the night.
verses.hindi: उका राष्टतनु' त्वन्यां कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since the lord created the Asuras at night from his loins through the vital breaths, and as they were born during the night, they are invincible durii the night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the lord created the Asuras at night from his loins through the vital breaths, and as they were born during the night, they are invincible durii the night.

verses.sanskrit: पितरो ह्यभवंस्तस्या सध्ये रात्र्यहयोः पृथक् । तस्मात्ते पितरो देवाः पितृत्वं तेषु तत्स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: pitaro hyabhavaṃstasyā sadhye rātryahayoḥ pṛthak / tasmātte pitaro devāḥ pitṛtvaṃ teṣu tatsmṛtam
verses.translation: These following, viz.: the moonlight, the night, the day and the twilight—these alone become the causes (of origin) of all future Devas, Manes, human beings along with the Asuras in all the Manvantaras that had passed by and that have not yet come. Since these four spread and shine there, the water is called Ambhas. The root vha is used in the sense of spreading and shining.'
verses.wordMeaning: These following, viz.: the moonlight, the night, the day and the twilight—these alone become the causes (of origin) of all future Devas, Manes, human beings along with the Asuras in all the Manvantaras that had passed by and that have not yet come.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These following, viz.: the moonlight, the night, the day and the twilight—these alone become the causes (of origin) of all future Devas, Manes, human beings along with the Asuras in all the Manvantaras that had passed by and that have not yet come.…

verses.sanskrit: ययासृष्टास्तु पितरस्तां तनुं स व्यपोहत । सापविद्धा तनुस्तेन सद्यः संध्या व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: yayāsṛṣṭāstu pitarastāṃ tanuṃ sa vyapohata / sāpaviddhā tanustena sadyaḥ saṃdhyā vyajāyata
verses.translation: VV. 22*27 summarise the four main creations from god Brahm&*i body and their other features as follows:
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 22*27 summarise the four main creations from god Brahm&*i body and their other features as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 22*27 summarise the four main creations from god Brahm&*i body and their other features as follows:

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादहर्देवतानां रात्रिर्या साऽसुरी स्मृता । तयोर्मध्ये तु वै पैत्री या तनुः सा गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: tasmādahardevatānāṃ rātriryā sā'surī smṛtā / tayormadhye tu vai paitrī yā tanuḥ sā garīyasī
verses.translation: Popular derivation
verses.wordMeaning: Popular derivation
verses.commentary: Sense: Popular derivation

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्देवासुराश्चैव ऋषयो मानवास्तथा । युक्तास्तनुमुपासंते उषाव्युष्ट्योर्यदन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāddevāsurāścaiva ṛṣayo mānavāstathā / yuktāstanumupāsaṃte uṣāvyuṣṭyoryadantaram
verses.translation: They are Pannagas because they moved and wrig¬ gled. The state of being Sarpas is due to the fact that they crawled. Their abode of repose is in the earth under the sun, the moon and the clouds*.
verses.wordMeaning: They are Pannagas because they moved and wrig¬ gled. The state of being Sarpas is due to the fact that they crawled. Their abode of repose is in the earth under the sun, the moon and the clouds*.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Pannagas because they moved and wrig¬ gled. The state of being Sarpas is due to the fact that they crawled. Their abode of repose is in the earth under the sun, the moon and the clouds*.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्रात्र्यहयोः संधिमुपासंते तथा द्विजाः । ततो ऽन्यस्यां पुनर्ब्रह्मा स्वतन्वामुपपद्यत
verses.transliteration: tasmādrātryahayoḥ saṃdhimupāsaṃte tathā dvijāḥ / tato 'nyasyāṃ punarbrahmā svatanvāmupapadyata
verses.translation: Puranic etymology of rSkfw and Ttik}a.
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त उस जल में अन्तर्गत में महत् का ज्ञान प्राप्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: Puranic etymology of rSkfw and Ttik}a.
verses.commentary: Sense: Puranic etymology of rSkfw and Ttik}a.

verses.sanskrit: रजोमात्रात्मिका या तु मनसा सो ऽसृजत्प्रभुः । मनसा तु सुतास्तस्य प्रजनाज्जज्ञिरे प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: rajomātrātmikā yā tu manasā so 'sṛjatprabhuḥ / manasā tu sutāstasya prajanājjajñire prajāḥ
verses.translation: Another derivation of VyaU — vAU and oU—Ai—generally eki is
verses.hindi: किया था ।८।-इसके पश्चात् अन्य ओंकाराष्ट्र तनु का जैसे पहिले कल्पं के आदि में था उन महात्मा ने मन में ही उस दिव्य स्वरूप का चिन्तन किया था ।९। उस विशाल जल की राशि में उन्होंते डूबी हुई भूमि को देखकर भली भाँति चिन्तन किया था कि कया स्वरूप धारण करके मैं इस भूमि का
verses.wordMeaning: Another derivation of VyaU — vAU and oU—Ai—generally eki is
verses.commentary: Sense: Another derivation of VyaU — vAU and oU—Ai—generally eki is

verses.sanskrit: मननाच्च मनुषयास्ते प्रजनात्प्रथिताः प्रजाः । सृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रजाः सो ऽथ स्वां तनुं स व्यपोहत
verses.transliteration: mananācca manuṣayāste prajanātprathitāḥ prajāḥ / sṛṣṭvā punaḥ prajāḥ so 'tha svāṃ tanuṃ sa vyapohata
verses.translation: W. 37-41 describe the creation of various tribes of demt-gods and gives popular etymologies of PiidM and Candhdftd,
verses.hindi: जल से उद्धार करूँ ।१०। जल में क्रोड़ा करना बहुत हो उचित है।. इस ठरह से उन्होंने वाराह के रूप का स्मरण किया था। जो कि समस्त प्राणियों के द्वारा न देखने के योग्य है और वाङ्मय ब्रह्म की संज्ञा वाला है ।११। उसका विस्तार दश योजन का था उसकी चौड़ाई अर्थात् फैलाव सी
verses.wordMeaning: W. 37-41 describe the creation of various tribes of demt-gods and gives popular etymologies of PiidM and Candhdftd,
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 37-41 describe the creation of various tribes of demt-gods and gives popular etymologies of PiidM and Candhdftd,

verses.sanskrit: सापविद्धा तनुस्तेन ज्योत्स्ना सद्यस्त्वजायत । तस्माद्भवन्ति संहृष्टा ज्योत्स्नाया उद्भवे प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: sāpaviddhā tanustena jyotsnā sadyastvajāyata / tasmādbhavanti saṃhṛṣṭā jyotsnāyā udbhave prajāḥ
verses.translation: The terrible fiery foetus bom of his (Brahma's) anger entered in the form of poison in those serpents who* were bom along with them.
verses.hindi: योजन था । नीले मेघ के समान उसका वर्ण था और मेघ के ग्जन के सहश बनि धी-।१२। एक विशाल पंत के तुल्य उसका शरीर था और उसकी वाढ़ें श्वेत एवं उप्र और तीकण थी । विजली की अग्नि जैसी होती है उसी अकार चमक थी तथा सूर्य के समान उसमें तेज था ।१३। मोटे और चोड़े
verses.wordMeaning: The terrible fiery foetus bom of his (Brahma's) anger entered in the form of poison in those serpents who* were bom along with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The terrible fiery foetus bom of his (Brahma's) anger entered in the form of poison in those serpents who* were bom along with them.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतास्तनवस्तेन ह्यपविद्धा महात्मना । सद्यो रात्र्यहनी चैवसंध्या ज्योत्स्ना च जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: ityetāstanavastena hyapaviddhā mahātmanā / sadyo rātryahanī caivasaṃdhyā jyotsnā ca jajñire
verses.translation: After creating the serpents out of his anger a set of terrible beings whose diet was flesh and who were furious by nature were created. They had the tawny colour.
verses.hindi: स्कन्ध थे और भगवान् विष्थु के विक्रम से गमनशील थे। उसकी कटि का भाग स्थूल और ऊँचा था । बह दृष के लक्षणों से पूजित था
verses.wordMeaning: After creating the serpents out of his anger a set of terrible beings whose diet was flesh and who were furious by nature were created. They had the tawny colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating the serpents out of his anger a set of terrible beings whose diet was flesh and who were furious by nature were created. They had the tawny colour.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योत्स्ना संध्याहनी चैव सत्त्वमात्रात्मकं त्रयम् । तमोमात्रात्मिका रात्रिः सा वै तस्मान्नियामिका
verses.transliteration: jyotsnā saṃdhyāhanī caiva sattvamātrātmakaṃ trayam / tamomātrātmikā rātriḥ sā vai tasmānniyāmikā
verses.translation: Since they had been hom (BkBtcicdt), they are remern* bered as B/iOtas; and a$ they ate flesh (PihVi/andO) they were called PUdeas Even as he (Brahma) was singing words, the Gandharvas were born as his sons.
verses.wordMeaning: Since they had been hom (BkBtcicdt), they are remern* bered as B/iOtas; and a$ they ate flesh (PihVi/andO) they were called PUdeas Even as he (Brahma) was singing words, the Gandharvas were born as his sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they had been hom (BkBtcicdt), they are remern* bered as B/iOtas; and a$ they ate flesh (PihVi/andO) they were called PUdeas Even as he (Brahma) was singing words, the Gandharvas were born as his sons.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्देवा दिव्यतन्वा तुष्ट्या सृष्टा सुखात्तु वै । यस्मात्तेषां दिवा जन्म बलिनस्तेन ते दिवा
verses.transliteration: tasmāddevā divyatanvā tuṣṭyā sṛṣṭā sukhāttu vai / yasmātteṣāṃ divā janma balinastena te divā
verses.translation: The root Dhajy ii recited by poets in the sense of 'drinking*. Since they were born drinking the (musical) words, they are remembered as Gandharvas.
verses.wordMeaning: The root Dhajy ii recited by poets in the sense of 'drinking*. Since they were born drinking the (musical) words, they are remembered as Gandharvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The root Dhajy ii recited by poets in the sense of 'drinking*. Since they were born drinking the (musical) words, they are remembered as Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: तन्वा यदसुरान्रत्र्या जघनादसृजत्प्रभुः । प्राणेभ्यो रात्रिजन्मानो ह्यजेया निशि तेन ते
verses.transliteration: tanvā yadasurānratryā jaghanādasṛjatprabhuḥ / prāṇebhyo rātrijanmāno hyajeyā niśi tena te
verses.translation: After creating these eight divine beings, he created the Cckandas (Prosody, Vedas) as he pleased [Cchandatali ). He created the birds through his age (? KoyorJ).
verses.wordMeaning: After creating these eight divine beings, he created the Cckandas (Prosody, Vedas) as he pleased [Cchandatali ). He created the birds through his age (? KoyorJ).
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating these eight divine beings, he created the Cckandas (Prosody, Vedas) as he pleased [Cchandatali ). He created the birds through his age (? KoyorJ).

verses.sanskrit: एतान्येव भविष्याणां देवानामसुरैः सह । पितॄणां मानुषाणां च अतीताना गतेषु वै
verses.transliteration: etānyeva bhaviṣyāṇāṃ devānāmasuraiḥ saha / pitṝṇāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca atītānā gateṣu vai
verses.translation: After creating the birds, he created the groups of animals. He created goats out of his mouth and the sheep out of his chest.
verses.hindi: सत्यधमं मयः श्रीमाच् कर्मे विक मसत्क्रतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: After creating the birds, he created the groups of animals. He created goats out of his mouth and the sheep out of his chest.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating the birds, he created the groups of animals. He created goats out of his mouth and the sheep out of his chest.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु निमित्तानि भवन्ति हि । ज्योत्स्ना रात्र्यहनी संध्या चत्वार्येतानि तानि वा
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣu sarveṣu nimittāni bhavanti hi / jyotsnā rātryahanī saṃdhyā catvāryetāni tāni vā
verses.translation: Formerly, at the beginning of this Kalpa, at the- advent of the Treta yuga, he created the five types of medi* cinal herbs and then engaged himself in the sacrifices.
verses.hindi: हरि भगवान् ने अमित वाराह के रूप को धारण किया था जो अतुल या और पृथिवी के जल से उद्धरण करने के लिए उन्होंने रसातल में प्रवेश किया था । अब वाराह भगवान के स्वरूप को यज्ञ का रूप देते हुए बताया जाता है दीक्षा की समाप्ति इष्टि के दाढ़ों वाले ये । उनके दाँत क्रतु था और.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, at the beginning of this Kalpa, at the- advent of the Treta yuga, he created the five types of medi* cinal herbs and then engaged himself in the sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, at the beginning of this Kalpa, at the- advent of the Treta yuga, he created the five types of medi* cinal herbs and then engaged himself in the sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: भान्ति यस्मात्ततो भाति भाशब्दो व्याप्तिदीप्तिषु । अंभांस्येतानि सृष्ट्वा तु देवदानवमानुषान्
verses.transliteration: bhānti yasmāttato bhāti bhāśabdo vyāptidīptiṣu / aṃbhāṃsyetāni sṛṣṭvā tu devadānavamānuṣān
verses.translation: The buffaloes, the Gavaya oxen, and the camels, the- cloven-footed animab, the Sarabha (the eight-footed fabulous
verses.hindi: मुख में आहुति थी । जिह्वा अग्नि थी और उनके रोम दभों के समान थे। महाचु तपस्वी ब्रह्म णोर्ष था ।१५-१६। वेदों के स्कन्धों वाले तथा हवि की गन्ध से युक्त - और हम्य-कव्य आदि के बेग से संयुत है । प्राग्वंश के शरीर बाले-- छू ति से युक्त हैं ओर नाना प्रकार की शिक्षाओं से समन्वित है
verses.wordMeaning: The buffaloes, the Gavaya oxen, and the camels, the- cloven-footed animab, the Sarabha (the eight-footed fabulous
verses.commentary: Sense: The buffaloes, the Gavaya oxen, and the camels, the- cloven-footed animab, the Sarabha (the eight-footed fabulous

verses.sanskrit: पितॄंश्चैव तथा चान्यान्विविधान्व्य सृजत्प्रजाः । तामुत्सृज्य ततो च्योत्स्नां ततो ऽन्यां प्राप्य स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pitṝṃścaiva tathā cānyānvividhānvya sṛjatprajāḥ / tāmutsṛjya tato cyotsnāṃ tato 'nyāṃ prāpya sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Strangely enough the PurAo* includes the hunum species among domesticated aiumals.
verses.hindi: हृदय दक्षिणा है तथा श्रद्धा सत्व से परिपूर्ण विधु योगी हैं। उपाकर्म की रुचि वाले और प्रबग्याबत्त भूषण बाले हैं।१८। अनेक छन्द गति: पथ है और गुह्य उपनिषद आसन है। मायारूपिणी पत्ती की सहायता वाले तथा प्त की शिखर के समान उच्च है ।१६।. अहोरात्र अर्थात् दिन और राजि
verses.wordMeaning: Strangely enough the PurAo* includes the hunum species among domesticated aiumals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Strangely enough the PurAo* includes the hunum species among domesticated aiumals.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्तिं रजस्तमोद्रिक्तां ततस्तां सो ऽभ्ययुञ्जत । ततो ऽन्याः स्ॐऽधकारे च क्षुधाविष्टाः प्रजाः सृजन्
verses.transliteration: mūrttiṃ rajastamodriktāṃ tatastāṃ so 'bhyayuñjata / tato 'nyāḥ soṃ'dhakāre ca kṣudhāviṣṭāḥ prajāḥ sṛjan
verses.translation: Through his first face (mouth)» he created the following, viz: the Gayatri> the the TrivrtsUma and Ratkantara and Agnisfoma among the Yajfias.
verses.hindi: रूपी नेत्रों के.धारण करने बाले हैं तथा वेदों के अज्भ श्रुति बाले हैं।.घुत गन््याले है--तुण्ड ही खय है तथा सामवेद का घोष ही ध्वत्ति है जो कि महान है।२०। श्लीमाचु सत्यधमं से परिपूर्ण है और कर्मों के विक्रम से सत्कृत है । प्रायश्चित्तों के नखों वाले हैं और घोर पशु जानु हैं ऐसा यह महामख
verses.wordMeaning: Through his first face (mouth)» he created the following, viz: the Gayatri> the the TrivrtsUma and Ratkantara and Agnisfoma among the Yajfias.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through his first face (mouth)» he created the following, viz: the Gayatri> the the TrivrtsUma and Ratkantara and Agnisfoma among the Yajfias.

verses.sanskrit: ताः सृष्टास्तु क्षुधाविष्टा अम्भांस्यादातुमुद्यताः । अम्भांस्येतानि रक्षाम उक्तवन्तस्तु तेषु ये
verses.transliteration: tāḥ sṛṣṭāstu kṣudhāviṣṭā ambhāṃsyādātumudyatāḥ / ambhāṃsyetāni rakṣāma uktavantastu teṣu ye
verses.translation: Through his right-hand (southern) face (mouth)» he created the Yajurveda hymns, the Traiffubha metre, the fifteenth Stoma (hymn) and the Brhalsdman hymn. -
verses.wordMeaning: Through his right-hand (southern) face (mouth)» he created the Yajurveda hymns, the Traiffubha metre, the fifteenth Stoma (hymn) and the Brhalsdman hymn. -
verses.commentary: Sense: Through his right-hand (southern) face (mouth)» he created the Yajurveda hymns, the Traiffubha metre, the fifteenth Stoma (hymn) and the Brhalsdman hymn. -

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसास्ते स्मृतास्तस्मात्क्षुधात्मानो निशाचराः । ये ऽब्रुवन् क्षिणुमो ऽम्भांसि तेषां त्दृष्टाः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāste smṛtāstasmātkṣudhātmāno niśācarāḥ / ye 'bruvan kṣiṇumo 'mbhāṃsi teṣāṃ tdṛṣṭāḥ parasparam
verses.translation: Through his backward (western) face (mouth), he created the Saman hymns, the Jagatl metre, the seventeenth Stoma (hymn), Che Vairupya and Atiratra (part of Jyoti$toma) sacrifices.
verses.wordMeaning: Through his backward (western) face (mouth), he created the Saman hymns, the Jagatl metre, the seventeenth Stoma (hymn), Che Vairupya and Atiratra (part of Jyoti$toma) sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through his backward (western) face (mouth), he created the Saman hymns, the Jagatl metre, the seventeenth Stoma (hymn), Che Vairupya and Atiratra (part of Jyoti$toma) sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ते कर्मणा यक्षा गुह्यकाः क्रूरकर्मिणः । रक्षेति पालने चापि धातुरेष विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: tena te karmaṇā yakṣā guhyakāḥ krūrakarmiṇaḥ / rakṣeti pālane cāpi dhātureṣa vibhāvyate
verses.translation: Through his fourth face (mouth), he created the twentyfirst {stoma i.e. hymn). The Atharva-Veda, the Aphr He created the Yajus and Saman Mantras for the accomplishment of Yajfias. The living beings both high and low were born of the limbs of Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: Through his fourth face (mouth), he created the twentyfirst {stoma i.e. hymn). The Atharva-Veda, the Aphr He created the Yajus and Saman Mantras for the accomplishment of Yajfias. The living beings both high and low were born of the limbs of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through his fourth face (mouth), he created the twentyfirst {stoma i.e. hymn). The Atharva-Veda, the Aphr He created the Yajus and Saman Mantras for the accomplishment of Yajfias. The living beings both high and low were born of the limbs of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: य एष क्षीतिधातुर्वै क्षपणे स निरुच्यते । रक्षणाद्रक्ष इत्युक्तं क्षपणाद्यक्ष उच्यत
verses.transliteration: ya eṣa kṣītidhāturvai kṣapaṇe sa nirucyate / rakṣaṇādrakṣa ityuktaṃ kṣapaṇādyakṣa ucyata
verses.translation: VV. 50*53 give the creation of Vedic literature, Vedic metres and special sacrifices from the mouths or faces of BrahmS.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 50*53 give the creation of Vedic literature, Vedic metres and special sacrifices from the mouths or faces of BrahmS.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 50*53 give the creation of Vedic literature, Vedic metres and special sacrifices from the mouths or faces of BrahmS.

verses.sanskrit: तान्दृष्ट्वा त्वप्रियेणास्य केशाः शीर्णाश्च धीमतः । ते शीर्णा व्युत्थिता ह्यूर्द्धमारो हन्तः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tāndṛṣṭvā tvapriyeṇāsya keśāḥ śīrṇāśca dhīmataḥ / te śīrṇā vyutthitā hyūrddhamāro hantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: TfivtstofUiK three-fold stoma (in which at first, the three Uc verses of each Tfci of ftv.lX.l! are sung together, then the 2nd verses and lastly the 3rd verses). Rathanksra'. the verses to be sung according to Sfcma-music arc RV.VII.32.22>23 Mi tU ete.-S.V. ll.l.l.ll.
verses.wordMeaning: TfivtstofUiK three-fold stoma (in which at first, the three Uc verses of each Tfci of ftv.lX.l! are sung together, then the 2nd verses and lastly the 3rd verses). Rathanksra'. the verses to be sung according to Sfcma-music arc RV.VII.32.22>23 Mi tU ete.-S.V. ll.l.l.ll.
verses.commentary: Sense: TfivtstofUiK three-fold stoma (in which at first, the three Uc verses of each Tfci of ftv.lX.l! are sung together, then the 2nd verses and lastly the 3rd verses). Rathanksra'. the verses to be sung according to Sfcma-music arc RV.VII.32.22>23 Mi tU ete.-S.V. ll.l.l.ll.

verses.sanskrit: हीना ये शिरसो बालाः पन्नाश्चैवापसर्पिणः । बालात्मना स्मृता व्याला हीनत्वादहयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: hīnā ye śiraso bālāḥ pannāścaivāpasarpiṇaḥ / bālātmanā smṛtā vyālā hīnatvādahayaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Some men say that the manly endeavour (is the sole cause of achievement). Some men say that it is the Karman (previous actions). Other Br&hma say that it is the destiny. Tht BhQtacintakas (those who think about the elements—perhaps the C&rvikas) say that it is nature and latent instinct.
verses.wordMeaning: Some men say that the manly endeavour (is the sole cause of achievement). Some men say that it is the Karman (previous actions). Other Br&hma say that it is the destiny.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some men say that the manly endeavour (is the sole cause of achievement). Some men say that it is the Karman (previous actions). Other Br&hma say that it is the destiny.…

verses.sanskrit: पन्नत्वात्पन्नगाश्चापि व्यपसर्पाच्च सर्प्पता । तेषां लयः पृथिव्यां यः सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ घनाः
verses.transliteration: pannatvātpannagāścāpi vyapasarpācca sarppatā / teṣāṃ layaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yaḥ sūryācandramasau ghanāḥ
verses.translation: (But real thinkers)know chat there is no difference or superiority among the manly endeavour, previous action and the destiny. The same is understood through the nature of the outcome of fmits (of actions etc.) (Some say ) this is thus and not thus—this is both nor is it both. But persons abiding by Sattva and having impartial vision say (that the Universe) is the object of its own activity.
verses.wordMeaning: (But real thinkers)know chat there is no difference or superiority among the manly endeavour, previous action and the destiny. The same is understood through the nature of the outcome of fmits (of actions etc.) (Some say ) this is thus and not thus—this is both nor is it both.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (But real thinkers)know chat there is no difference or superiority among the manly endeavour, previous action and the destiny. The same is understood through the nature of the outcome of fmits (of actions etc.) (Some say ) this is thus and not thus—this is both nor is it both.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य क्रोधोद्भवो यो ऽसावग्निगर्भः सुदारुणः । स तान्सर्प्पान् सहोत्पन्नानाविवेश विषात्मकः
verses.transliteration: tasya krodhodbhavo yo 'sāvagnigarbhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ / sa tānsarppān sahotpannānāviveśa viṣātmakaḥ
verses.translation: As noted above this Pui&a emphasises the law of Karman. The ead of a Kalpa does not destroy the Karma of an individual.
verses.wordMeaning: As noted above this Pui&a emphasises the law of Karman. The ead of a Kalpa does not destroy the Karma of an individual.
verses.commentary: Sense: As noted above this Pui&a emphasises the law of Karman. The ead of a Kalpa does not destroy the Karma of an individual.

verses.sanskrit: सर्प्पान्सृष्ट्वा ततः क्रोधात् क्रोधात्मानो विनिर्मिताः । वर्णेन कपिशेनोग्रास्ते भूताः पिशिताशनाः
verses.transliteration: sarppānsṛṣṭvā tataḥ krodhāt krodhātmāno vinirmitāḥ / varṇena kapiśenogrāste bhūtāḥ piśitāśanāḥ
verses.translation: Apparendy the view (anUcUatdodda) of SaAjaya BeUtthi Ptitsa The names pertaining to the teigcs and the visioni belonging to the Devas—these, the unborn lord assigns to those who are bom at the end of the night.
verses.hindi: अन्त्र ही 'उद्गान्त हे-होमलिङ्ग और फलों के बीज 'महौषंधि हैं। 'बाचन्तर आत्मसत्र के हैं तथा नास्मिका सोमशोणित है ।२२। यजवराहान्त भक्त हैं और फिर जलों में प्रवेश किया था । अग्नि से सं्छादित भूमि को सभा चाहते हुए प्रजापति को प्राप्त हुए और वहाँ पहुँच कर इनका  हवन
verses.wordMeaning: Apparendy the view (anUcUatdodda) of SaAjaya BeUtthi Ptitsa The names pertaining to the teigcs and the visioni belonging to the Devas—these, the unborn lord assigns to those who are bom at the end of the night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Apparendy the view (anUcUatdodda) of SaAjaya BeUtthi Ptitsa The names pertaining to the teigcs and the visioni belonging to the Devas—these, the unborn lord assigns to those who are bom at the end of the night.

verses.sanskrit: भूतत्वात्ते रमृता भूताः पिशाचा पिशिताशनात् । गायतो गां ततस्तस्य गन्धर्वा जज्ञिरे सुताः
verses.transliteration: bhūtatvātte ramṛtā bhūtāḥ piśācā piśitāśanāt / gāyato gāṃ tatastasya gandharvā jajñire sutāḥ
verses.translation: By means of his mind, the lord then created five Kwrtrs (doers or agents of creation). via.: Rudra. Dharma, Manas (mind), Ruci and Akrti.
verses.hindi: किया था तथा म्य का अद सन्यास किया था और सामुद्र समुत्रों में तथा जो नादेयं थे वे नदियों ने उन सयको पृथक् सभी कृत करके उन्होंने पृथिबी “में गिरियों को चुना था ।२३-२४। पहिले सगं में प्रलय काल की संवर्तेक अग्नि से जो उस समय में दह्यमान थे । उस अग्नि से समी ओर भूमि में वे
verses.wordMeaning: By means of his mind, the lord then created five Kwrtrs (doers or agents of creation). via.: Rudra. Dharma, Manas (mind), Ruci and Akrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his mind, the lord then created five Kwrtrs (doers or agents of creation). via.: Rudra. Dharma, Manas (mind), Ruci and Akrti.

verses.sanskrit: धयेति धातुः कविभिः पानार्थे परिपठ्यते । पिबतो जज्ञिरे वाचं गन्धर्वास्तेन ते स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: dhayeti dhātuḥ kavibhiḥ pānārthe paripaṭhyate / pibato jajñire vācaṃ gandharvāstena te smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: All these are mighty-armed and they are the causes of the sustenance of the subjects. When the medicinal herbs decline again and again, it is Rudra who sustains them and revives them. Then he saw the Tamas element moving within himself. Thanks to its own action, it had abandoned Rajas and Sattva and was existing by itself.
verses.hindi: विलीन हों गये ये।९५। उस एक मात्र रहने वाले समुद्र में सत्य से जो वायु के दवारा संहित ये । जहाँ-जहाँ पर निषिक्त थे वहाँ-वहाँ पर अचल हो गया था ।२६। उसके अनन्तर उनके प्रकीणे होने पर लोक तथा अधि 'गिरियों को विश्वकर्मा ने कल्पादि में बार-बार विभाजित किया है ।२७। समुद्र से इस
verses.wordMeaning: All these are mighty-armed and they are the causes of the sustenance of the subjects. When the medicinal herbs decline again and again, it is Rudra who sustains them and revives them. Then he saw the Tamas element moving within himself. Thanks to its own action,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All these are mighty-armed and they are the causes of the sustenance of the subjects. When the medicinal herbs decline again and again, it is Rudra who sustains them and revives them. Then he saw the Tamas element moving within himself. Thanks to its own action,…

verses.sanskrit: अष्टास्वेतासु सृष्टासु देवयोनिषु स प्रभुः । छन्दतश्चैव छन्दासि वयांसि वयसासृजत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāsvetāsu sṛṣṭāsu devayoniṣu sa prabhuḥ / chandataścaiva chandāsi vayāṃsi vayasāsṛjat
verses.translation: Thereupon, due to that sorrow, the lord of the uni¬ verse felt grieved. He pushed out the Tamas element and after¬ wards covered it with Rajas.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी को जो सातों ढीपों जे युक्त जोर पवंतों के सहित है । भू आदि चारों लोकों को बार-बार कल्पित किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, due to that sorrow, the lord of the uni¬ verse felt grieved. He pushed out the Tamas element and after¬ wards covered it with Rajas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, due to that sorrow, the lord of the uni¬ verse felt grieved. He pushed out the Tamas element and after¬ wards covered it with Rajas.

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिणस्तु स सृष्ट्वा वै ततः पशुगणान्सृजन् । मुखतोजाः सृजन्सो ऽथ वक्षसश्चाप्यवीः सृजन्
verses.transliteration: pakṣiṇastu sa sṛṣṭvā vai tataḥ paśugaṇānsṛjan / mukhatojāḥ sṛjanso 'tha vakṣasaścāpyavīḥ sṛjan
verses.translation: That Tamas pushed out by him gave birth to a pair. On account of his unrighteous conduct, Hirhsd (Violence) and Soka (grief) were bom. When that pair in the fonn of Tarotia (covering up), was bom, the lord became delighted. He resorted to this.

verses.sanskrit: गावश्चैवोदराद्ब्रह्मा पाश्वीभ्यां च विनिर्ममे । पादतो ऽश्वान्समातङ्गान् रासभान् गवयान्मृगान्
verses.transliteration: gāvaścaivodarādbrahmā pāśvībhyāṃ ca vinirmame / pādato 'śvānsamātaṅgān rāsabhān gavayānmṛgān
verses.translation: When those subjects created by that intclligenc self- possessed being did not increase in ntunber, he created other mental sons similar to himself.
verses.wordMeaning: When those subjects created by that intclligenc self- possessed being did not increase in ntunber, he created other mental sons similar to himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: When those subjects created by that intclligenc self- possessed being did not increase in ntunber, he created other mental sons similar to himself.

verses.sanskrit: उष्ट्रांश्चैव वराहांश्च शुनो ऽन्यांश्चैव जातयः । ओषध्यः फल मूलिन्यो रोमभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: uṣṭrāṃścaiva varāhāṃśca śuno 'nyāṃścaiva jātayaḥ / oṣadhyaḥ phala mūlinyo romabhyastasya jajñire
verses.translation: C2f. Maau 1.32. Then Brahma created again Dharma who was delightful and pleasant unto all living beings; as well as the Prajapati Ruci. These two were the citlost of all ancient ones.
verses.wordMeaning: C2f. Maau 1.32. Then Brahma created again Dharma who was delightful and pleasant unto all living beings; as well as the Prajapati Ruci. These two were the citlost of all ancient ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: C2f. Maau 1.32. Then Brahma created again Dharma who was delightful and pleasant unto all living beings; as well as the Prajapati Ruci. These two were the citlost of all ancient ones.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पञ्चौषधीः सृष्ट्वा व्ययुञ्जत्सो ऽध्वरेषु वै । अस्य त्वादौ तु कल्पस्य त्रेतायुगमुखेपुरा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pañcauṣadhīḥ sṛṣṭvā vyayuñjatso 'dhvareṣu vai / asya tvādau tu kalpasya tretāyugamukhepurā
verses.translation: He created from his intellect Dharma who was delightful and pleasant unto all living beings. He who is named Ruci was born of the mind of (the lord of) umnanifest birth.
verses.wordMeaning: He created from his intellect Dharma who was delightful and pleasant unto all living beings. He who is named Ruci was born of the mind of (the lord of) umnanifest birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created from his intellect Dharma who was delightful and pleasant unto all living beings. He who is named Ruci was born of the mind of (the lord of) umnanifest birth.

verses.sanskrit: गौरजः पुरुषो ऽथाविरश्वाश्वतरगर्दभाः । एते ग्राम्याः समृताः सप्त आरण्याः सप्त चापरे
verses.transliteration: gaurajaḥ puruṣo 'thāviraśvāśvataragardabhāḥ / ete grāmyāḥ samṛtāḥ sapta āraṇyāḥ sapta cāpare
verses.translation: Bhrgu and others who had I>een created arc remem. bored as Brahmarsis (Brahmlnical.sages). They arc the ancient housc.holders and Dharma (virtue) was initially established by them. cr. Maau 145 also VP.I.8,4.6.

verses.sanskrit: श्वापदो द्वीपिनो हस्ती वानरः पक्षिपञ्चमः । औदकाः पशवः षष्ठाः सप्तमास्तु सरीसृपाः
verses.transliteration: śvāpado dvīpino hastī vānaraḥ pakṣipañcamaḥ / audakāḥ paśavaḥ ṣaṣṭhāḥ saptamāstu sarīsṛpāḥ
verses.translation: By (another) half he became a woman and she was SatarupA. She was the Prakrti, the mother of all living beings (and manifested thus) because the lord was creating out of desire.
verses.hindi: यस्मात्तेषां कृताः बुडिदृँःखानि करणानि च। तस्माच्च संवृतात्मानो नगा मुख्याः प्रकीतिताः ४३४. मुख्यसगे तदोद्भूतं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मसंभवः । अप्रतीतमनाः सो5थ तदोत्पत्तिमयन्मत
verses.wordMeaning: By (another) half he became a woman and she was SatarupA. She was the Prakrti, the mother of all living beings (and manifested thus) because the lord was creating out of desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: By (another) half he became a woman and she was SatarupA. She was the Prakrti, the mother of all living beings (and manifested thus) because the lord was creating out of desire.

verses.sanskrit: महिषा गवयोष्ट्राश्च द्विखुराः शरभो द्विषः । मर्कटः सप्तमो ह्येषां चारण्याः पशवस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: mahiṣā gavayoṣṭrāśca dvikhurāḥ śarabho dviṣaḥ / markaṭaḥ saptamo hyeṣāṃ cāraṇyāḥ paśavastu te
verses.translation: They were Priyavrata and Uttanapada. These two sons were the most excellent sons that persons possessing sons could expect. (She gave birch to) two daughters also of great fortune. From them these subjects were bom. The S&Akhya pair of Prakrti and Purufa are represented here as acarCpi and Menu. ternu Vatrija, Purufa, Mauu (and Samrif) are used as lynooyini.
verses.hindi: अतेक प्रकार की प्रजाओं का सृजन करने की इच्छा वाले ब्रह्माजी मे जो स्वयम्भू भगवान् हैं अनेक लोकों की कल्पना करके उन्होंने प्रंजाओँ का सृजन किया या ।२९। पहिले कल्प आदि में जो स्वरूप था उसी रूप कीं भृष्टि का मूजन किया था । उस सृजन का अभिध्यान करते हुए उन्होंने बुँखिं
verses.wordMeaning: They were Priyavrata and Uttanapada. These two sons were the most excellent sons that persons possessing sons could expect. (She gave birch to) two daughters also of great fortune. From them these subjects were bom.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Priyavrata and Uttanapada. These two sons were the most excellent sons that persons possessing sons could expect. (She gave birch to) two daughters also of great fortune. From them these subjects were bom.…

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं च ऋचं चैव त्रिवृत्सतोमरथन्तरे । अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ ca ṛcaṃ caiva trivṛtsatomarathantare / agniṣṭomaṃ ca yajñānāṃ nirmame prathamānmukhāt
verses.translation: They were the divine lady named Akuti and auspi«* cious lady Prasuti. Both of them were auspicious. The lordly son of the self-born lord gave Prasuti to Dak$a.
verses.hindi: पूर्वक ही सर्ग किया था ।३०। प्रधान के समकाल में तम से पूणे प्रादुभूल हुआ था। उस तम का मोहे-महामोहे-तामिख और अन्ध-ये सज्ञाए थीं ।३१। उन महान् आत्मा वाले को पहुच पर्वा अविद्या ्रादुभूत हुई थी अत: एंवं उन आमिमानी और ध्यान करने बाले ब्रह्माजी का वह सर्ग भीं पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: They were the divine lady named Akuti and auspi«* cious lady Prasuti. Both of them were auspicious. The lordly son of the self-born lord gave Prasuti to Dak$a.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the divine lady named Akuti and auspi«* cious lady Prasuti. Both of them were auspicious. The lordly son of the self-born lord gave Prasuti to Dak$a.

verses.sanskrit: यजूंषि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दः स्तोमं पञ्चदशं तथा । बृहत्साम तथोक्तं च दक्षिणात्सो ऽसृजन्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: yajūṃṣi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ stomaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tathā / bṛhatsāma tathoktaṃ ca dakṣiṇātso 'sṛjanmukhāt
verses.translation: He gave Akuti to Ruci» the Prajapati. An auspicious pair was born of Akuti as the progeny of Ruci» the mental son (of Brahma). They were the twins Yajfia and Daksiia. Twelve sons were bom to YajAa and Dakiltk.
verses.hindi: प्रकार का व्यवस्थित हुआ था ।३२। सभी ओर बीज-कुम्भ और ताए तम मे आदुत वे और बाहिर तणा अन्दर प्रकाश नहीं था तथा सब निःसंग था ।३३। जिससे उनकी वृद्धि की गयी थी और दुःख-तथा करण हुएं ये और उससे संवत आरा खाले नगर मुख्य कहे गये हैं ।३४। अपने आप ही समु-

verses.sanskrit: सामानि जगतीं चैव स्तोमं सप्तदशं तथा । वैरूप्यमतिरात्रं च पश्चिमात्सो ऽसृजन्मखात्
verses.transliteration: sāmāni jagatīṃ caiva stomaṃ saptadaśaṃ tathā / vairūpyamatirātraṃ ca paścimātso 'sṛjanmakhāt
verses.translation: They were the Devas named Yimas in the Sviyam- bhuva Manvantara. They were the sons of twins, viz: Yajfta and Dakini. Hence they are remembered as Yamas.
verses.hindi: स्पन्ने हुए ब्रह्माजी ने उस समय में मुख्य सर्ग में उद्धुत को देखा था और अपनें मन मैं अप्रतीति करने वालें उन्होंने उस समय में उत्पत्ति ही मान
verses.wordMeaning: They were the Devas named Yimas in the Sviyam- bhuva Manvantara. They were the sons of twins, viz: Yajfta and Dakini. Hence they are remembered as Yamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the Devas named Yimas in the Sviyam- bhuva Manvantara. They were the sons of twins, viz: Yajfta and Dakini. Hence they are remembered as Yamas.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशमथर्वाणमाप्तोर्यामं तथैव च । अनुष्टुभं सवैराजं चतुर्थादसृजन्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: ekaviṃśamatharvāṇamāptoryāmaṃ tathaiva ca / anuṣṭubhaṃ savairājaṃ caturthādasṛjanmukhāt
verses.translation: (?) Two groups of Brahma are remembered vie: Ajitas and Sukras. The Y&mas who have the appellation Diimu' kas (heaven-dwellers) circumambulated the former. Lord Dak$a begot of Prasuti, the daughter of Sviyambhuva Manu, twenty-four daughten who became modiers of the world.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युतो ऽशनिमेघांश्व रोहितेद्रधनूंषि च । सृष्ट्वासौ भगवान्देवः पर्जन्यमितिविश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: vidyuto 'śanimeghāṃśva rohitedradhanūṃṣi ca / sṛṣṭvāsau bhagavāndevaḥ parjanyamitiviśrutam
verses.translation: All of them were highly fortunate. All of them were lotus-eyed. All of them were wives of Yogins and' all of them were Yogic mothers. All of them were expounders of Brahman and all of them were the mothers of the universe.

verses.transliteration: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni nirmame yajñasiddhaye / uccāvacāni bhūtāni gātrebhyastasya jajñire
verses.translation: To Marici, he gave Sambhuti, and Smrti to AAgiras» To Pulastya he gave Priti and K$am5 to Pulaha. Derivation of Yarns, the gods of the Svaytmbhuva Manvantara.

verses.transliteration: brahmaṇāstu prajāsargaṃ sṛjato hi prajāpateḥ / sṛṣṭvā catuṣṭayaṃ pūrvaṃ devarṣipitṛmānavān
verses.translation: To Kratu» he gave Sannati and the (daughter) named Anasuyi to Atri. He gave t}rja to Vasisha and Svahi to Agni (the fire-god).

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसृजत भूतानि चराणि स्थावराणि च । सृष्ट्वा यक्षपिशाचांश्च गन्धर्वप्सरसस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tato 'sṛjata bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca / sṛṣṭvā yakṣapiśācāṃśca gandharvapsarasastadā

verses.sanskrit: नरकिन्नररक्षांसि वयःपशुमृगोरगान् । अव्ययं च व्ययं चैव द्वयं स्थावरजङ्गमम्

verses.translation: Through Maya, Maya gave birth to Mftyu (Death) that takes away all living beings. Then Ouldcha (Misery) was bom of Vedana through Raurava (Hell).

verses.wordMeaning: They were neither superior to him nor inferior. They were his mental sons on a par with himself. He created thousands and thousands of such childern wearing elephant hides.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were neither superior to him nor inferior. They were his mental sons on a par with himself. He created thousands and thousands of such childern wearing elephant hides.

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतेषु नानात्वमिन्द्रियार्तेषु मूर्तिषु । विनियोगं च भूतानां धातैव व्यदधात्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārteṣu mūrtiṣu / viniyogaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhātaiva vyadadhātsvayam
verses.translation: W. 68-60 docribe the lUudri Sn|i (eresdoa by Rudra) and he wai asked by BrabnU to stop creation ai be was procread immonal progeny and Rudra complied. These hideous and bluish-red coloured subjects who had been created by me in thousands and thousands, have come out of my own self.
verses.hindi: 'अभिष्यान करने बाले उनका अन्य एक तिर्मक् स्रोत हुआ था। जिससे तिर्मक् बिवत्तित होते थे इस कारण से वह फिर तिर्यक् खोत कहा गया था ।३६। उस तिर्यक् स्रोत में तमोग,ण की अधिकता थी इस कारण से बे सभी बहुत अधिक अज्ञान से समन्वित कहे गये हैं। वे सब उत्पाद. के
verses.wordMeaning: W. 68-60 docribe the lUudri Sn|i (eresdoa by Rudra) and he wai asked by BrabnU to stop creation ai be was procread immonal progeny and Rudra complied. These hideous and bluish-red coloured subjects who had been created by me in thousands and thousands,…
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 68-60 docribe the lUudri Sn|i (eresdoa by Rudra) and he wai asked by BrabnU to stop creation ai be was procread immonal progeny and Rudra complied. These hideous and bluish-red coloured subjects who had been created by me in thousands and thousands,…

verses.sanskrit: केचित्पुरुषकारं तु प्राहुः कर्म च मानवाः । दैवमित्यपरे विप्राः स्वभावं भूतचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: kecitpuruṣakāraṃ tu prāhuḥ karma ca mānavāḥ / daivamityapare viprāḥ svabhāvaṃ bhūtacintakāḥ
verses.translation: These Devas will be known by the name ofRudras. They are highly powerful. Those Rudripls are well-known over the earth and firmament.
verses.hindi: ग्राही थे और उस अज्ञान में ही शान के मानने बाले ये ।३७। बे भहद्भार से युक्त थे और आत्माहङ्कारी थे । ऐसे वे अद्ठाईस प्रकार के थे। इन द्वादश इन्द्रियों के भेद थे जो कि नेत्र, कान, नासिका, जिहबा और त्वक्-ये पाँच ज्ञानैन्द्रियाँ हैं और हाथ, पद, ग्रुदा उपस्थ और जिह्वाये पाच कर्मेन्द्रियाँ
verses.wordMeaning: These Devas will be known by the name ofRudras. They are highly powerful. Those Rudripls are well-known over the earth and firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Devas will be known by the name ofRudras. They are highly powerful. Those Rudripls are well-known over the earth and firmament.

verses.sanskrit: पौरुषं कर्म दैवं च फलवृत्तिस्वभावतः । न चैव तु पृथग्भावमधिकेन ततो विदुः
verses.transliteration: pauruṣaṃ karma daivaṃ ca phalavṛttisvabhāvataḥ / na caiva tu pṛthagbhāvamadhikena tato viduḥ
verses.translation: Enumerated in the (Vedic text) atarudra, they will become worthy of Yajfias. All of them will partake of the Yajflas along with the groups of Devas. Till the end of the Yuga, they will remain, on being worshipped along with those Devas bom of Cchandas (Vedas or—bom as they are pleased) in the Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: हैं और एक मन है । तथा नौ प्रकार के आत्मा हैं ।३८। और आठ तारकादि हैं,और् उनकी शक्ति के प्रकार कहे गये हैं। वे सब अन्दर में प्रकाश बाले हैं फिर वे बाहिर से समावृत हैं ।३९। तिर्यक् स्रोत कहे जाया. करते हैं और बश्यात्मा तीन संज्ञा वाले हैं ।४०। तिर्यक् खोत का सृजन करके ईश्वर ने
verses.wordMeaning: Enumerated in the (Vedic text) atarudra, they will become worthy of Yajfias. All of them will partake of the Yajflas along with the groups of Devas. Till the end of the Yuga, they will remain,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Enumerated in the (Vedic text) atarudra, they will become worthy of Yajfias. All of them will partake of the Yajflas along with the groups of Devas. Till the end of the Yuga, they will remain,…

verses.sanskrit: एतदेवं च नैवं च न चोभे नानुभे न च । स्वकर्मविषयं ब्रूयुः सत्त्वस्थाः समदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: etadevaṃ ca naivaṃ ca na cobhe nānubhe na ca / svakarmaviṣayaṃ brūyuḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus by Mahadeva, that lord Brahma, the delighted lord of subjects replied to the terrible Rudra.
verses.hindi: दूसरे विश्व की रचना की थो। इसके अनन्तर उद्भूत अभिप्राय, को देखकर अर्थात् उस प्रकार के सगं का अबलोकन किया था ।४१। इस तरह से अभि: ध्यान करने वाले उनके जो अन्त्य सात्विक सर्ग समुत्पन्न हुआ था । तीसरा तो ऊड.बं खरोत था और वह निश्चित रूप से ऊपर की ही ओर व्यवस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by Mahadeva, that lord Brahma, the delighted lord of subjects replied to the terrible Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by Mahadeva, that lord Brahma, the delighted lord of subjects replied to the terrible Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: नानारूपं च भूतानां कृतानां च प्रपञ्चनम् । वेदशब्देभ्य एवादौ निर्ममे स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: nānārūpaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ kṛtānāṃ ca prapañcanam / vedaśabdebhya evādau nirmame sa maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: ''O lord welfare unto you. Let it be as spoken by Thenceforth, the lord Sth&nu did not beget subjects. He remained celibate till the ultimate annihilation.
verses.wordMeaning: ''O lord welfare unto you. Let it be as spoken by Thenceforth, the lord Sth&nu did not beget subjects. He remained celibate till the ultimate annihilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O lord welfare unto you. Let it be as spoken by Thenceforth, the lord Sth&nu did not beget subjects. He remained celibate till the ultimate annihilation.

verses.sanskrit: आर्षाणि चैव नामानि याश्च देवेषु दृष्टयः । शर्वर्यन्ते प्रसूतानां पुनस्तेभ्यो दधात्यजः
verses.transliteration: ārṣāṇi caiva nāmāni yāśca deveṣu dṛṣṭayaḥ / śarvaryante prasūtānāṃ punastebhyo dadhātyajaḥ
verses.translation: Derivation of
verses.hindi: प्रकाशा बहिरंतश्च उद्ध वंसोतः प्रजाः स्मृताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Derivation of
verses.commentary: Sense: Derivation of

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे मानससृष्टिवर्णनं नामाष्टमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच रुद्रं धर्मं मनश्चैव रुचिं चैवाकृतिं तथा । पञ्च कर्तॄन् हि स तदा मनसा व्यसृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde mānasasṛṣṭivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca rudraṃ dharmaṃ manaścaiva ruciṃ caivākṛtiṃ tathā / pañca kartṝn hi sa tadā manasā vyasṛjatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: The branches of trees have gone down. Others have gone this way. Still others have gone up. In the same way, some have gone obliquely.
verses.hindi: ऊद वंसोतस्तृतीयो यः स्मृतः सर्व: सहैविकः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The branches of trees have gone down. Others have gone this way. Still others have gone up. In the same way, some have gone obliquely.
verses.commentary: Sense: The branches of trees have gone down. Others have gone this way. Still others have gone up. In the same way, some have gone obliquely.

verses.sanskrit: एते महाभुजाः सर्वे प्रजानां स्थितिहेतवः । औषधीः प्रतिसंधत्ते रुद्रः क्षीणः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ete mahābhujāḥ sarve prajānāṃ sthitihetavaḥ / auṣadhīḥ pratisaṃdhatte rudraḥ kṣīṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: With their intellect, they have observed carefully how the branches have gone. Apartments were constructed by them in the same way. Hence they (the apartments) are re¬ membered as Sdlds.
verses.hindi: उद्ध वंसोतः सु सृष्टेषु देवेषु स तदा प्रभु: ।
verses.wordMeaning: With their intellect, they have observed carefully how the branches have gone. Apartments were constructed by them in the same way. Hence they (the apartments) are re¬ membered as Sdlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their intellect, they have observed carefully how the branches have gone. Apartments were constructed by them in the same way. Hence they (the apartments) are re¬ membered as Sdlds.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तौषधिफलैर्देवः सम्यगिष्टः फलार्थिभिः । त्रिभिरेव कपालैस्तु त्र्यंबकैरोषधीक्षये
verses.transliteration: prāptauṣadhiphalairdevaḥ samyagiṣṭaḥ phalārthibhiḥ / tribhireva kapālaistu tryaṃbakairoṣadhīkṣaye
verses.translation: Thus dlds (apartments, dwellings) became well- known from the branches. So abo the abodes. Therefore they are remembered as idlAs, That is remembered as their
verses.wordMeaning: Thus dlds (apartments, dwellings) became well- known from the branches. So abo the abodes. Therefore they are remembered as idlAs, That is remembered as their
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus dlds (apartments, dwellings) became well- known from the branches. So abo the abodes. Therefore they are remembered as idlAs, That is remembered as their

verses.sanskrit: इज्यते मुनिभिर्यस्मात्तस्मात्त्त्र्यंबक उच्यते । गायत्रीं चैव त्रिष्टुप् च जगती चैव ताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ijyate munibhiryasmāttasmātttryaṃbaka ucyate / gāyatrīṃ caiva triṣṭup ca jagatī caiva tāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Popular but importaat etymolocy of 'aa apaitnent or dwei-
verses.wordMeaning: Popular but importaat etymolocy of 'aa apaitnent or dwei-
verses.commentary: Sense: Popular but importaat etymolocy of 'aa apaitnent or dwei-

verses.sanskrit: अंबिकानां मया प्रोक्ता योनयः स्वनस्पतेः । ताभिरेकत्वभूता भिस्त्रिविधाभिः स्ववीर्यतः
verses.transliteration: aṃbikānāṃ mayā proktā yonayaḥ svanaspateḥ / tābhirekatvabhūtā bhistrividhābhiḥ svavīryataḥ
verses.translation: Since people are delighted therein {Prasidanti) they are designated as(palaces). Therefore, the abodes, apartments and palaces are designated as Prlisadas.
verses.wordMeaning: Since people are delighted therein {Prasidanti) they are designated as(palaces). Therefore, the abodes, apartments and palaces are designated as Prlisadas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since people are delighted therein {Prasidanti) they are designated as(palaces). Therefore, the abodes, apartments and palaces are designated as Prlisadas.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिसाधनः पुरोडाशस्त्रिकपालस्ततः स्मृतः । त्र्यंबकः स पुरोडाशस्तेनेह त्र्यंबकःस्मृतः
verses.transliteration: trisādhanaḥ puroḍāśastrikapālastataḥ smṛtaḥ / tryaṃbakaḥ sa puroḍāśasteneha tryaṃbakaḥsmṛtaḥ
verses.translation: When the wishyielding Kalpa trees perished along with the honey,(the subjects) attached by the Dvandvas (mutual opposed pain of feelings etc.) began to think about the means of agriculture and other occupations for livelihood.
verses.hindi: कारण यह है कि यह ऊघ्वे में रहा था । इसीलिए उसकी उध्वं स्रोत संज्ञा होती हैं। वे सुख पूर्वक बहुत प्रीति पूर्ण थे और बाहर भीतर आवृत थे।४३। बाहिर भीतर रहने वाले प्रकाश ऊर्ध्वे स्रोत प्रजा कहे गये थे।'जो नौ धाता आदिक थे वे तुष्ट आत्मा वाले बुध कहे गये हैं ।४४। जो ऊध्बंस्ोत
verses.wordMeaning: When the wishyielding Kalpa trees perished along with the honey,(the subjects) attached by the Dvandvas (mutual opposed pain of feelings etc.) began to think about the means of agriculture and other occupations for livelihood.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the wishyielding Kalpa trees perished along with the honey,(the subjects) attached by the Dvandvas (mutual opposed pain of feelings etc.) began to think about the means of agriculture and other occupations for livelihood.

verses.sanskrit: धत्ते धर्मः प्रजाः सर्वा मनो ज्ञानकरं स्मृतम् । आकृतिः सुरुचे रूपं रुचिः श्रद्धाकरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: dhatte dharmaḥ prajāḥ sarvā mano jñānakaraṃ smṛtam / ākṛtiḥ suruce rūpaṃ ruciḥ śraddhākaraḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The subjects created were seen agitated due to ex¬ haustion and sorrow. Thereafter, the Siddhi appeared in front of them in the Treta yuga.
verses.hindi: तीसरा कहा गयां हैं यह सब सदेविक है । उस समय में ऊध्वं स्रोतों के सृजत किये जाने पर वह प्रभु प्रसन्न हुए थे ।४४। ब्रहाजी का मन बहुते प्रीतिथुक्त ' हो गया था और फिर अन्य को नहीं मांना था । फिर ईश्वर ने अन्य साधक सर्ग के सृजन की इच्छा की थी ।४६। सर्ग की रचना का अभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects created were seen agitated due to ex¬ haustion and sorrow. Thereafter, the Siddhi appeared in front of them in the Treta yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects created were seen agitated due to ex¬ haustion and sorrow. Thereafter, the Siddhi appeared in front of them in the Treta yuga.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेते प्रजापालाः प्रजानां स्थितिहेतवः । अथास्य सृजतः सर्गं प्रजानां परिवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: evamete prajāpālāḥ prajānāṃ sthitihetavaḥ / athāsya sṛjataḥ sargaṃ prajānāṃ parivṛddhaye
verses.translation: Another (type of) rain became the means of achiev¬ ing all objects for them. The waters of the rain were sweet and were as much as they wished for.
verses.hindi: ध्यान करने बाले और उस समय में स्रोत अर्वाक् साधक था ।४७। कारणं यह है कि वे अवाक् प्रबृत्त हुआ करते हैं इसी से वे अर्वाक स्रोत होते हैं इसी से वे अर्वाक स्रोत होते हैं ओर उनमें प्रकाश की बहुलता हुआ करती हैं और तम से स्पे किये हुए रजोगण को अधिकता से युक्त होते हैं ।४दा
verses.wordMeaning: Another (type of) rain became the means of achiev¬ ing all objects for them. The waters of the rain were sweet and were as much as they wished for.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another (type of) rain became the means of achiev¬ ing all objects for them. The waters of the rain were sweet and were as much as they wished for.

verses.sanskrit: न व्यवर्द्धत ताः सृष्टाः प्रजाः केनापि हेतुना । ततः स विदधे बुद्धिमर्थनिश्चयगा मिनीम्
verses.transliteration: na vyavarddhata tāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ prajāḥ kenāpi hetunā / tataḥ sa vidadhe buddhimarthaniścayagā minīm
verses.translation: The fourteen (types of lands in) villages and forests (began to flourish) without being ploughed and without the seeds being sown. The trees and the bushes put forth flowers and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.hindi: इस कारण उनमें दुःखों की अधिकता है ओर पुनः पुनः करने वाले हैं। 5 और अन्दर प्रकाश होते हैं और वे मनुष्य साधना करने वाले
verses.wordMeaning: The fourteen (types of lands in) villages and forests (began to flourish) without being ploughed and without the seeds being sown. The trees and the bushes put forth flowers and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fourteen (types of lands in) villages and forests (began to flourish) without being ploughed and without the seeds being sown. The trees and the bushes put forth flowers and fruits at the proper seasons.

verses.sanskrit: अथात्मनि समद्राक्षीत्तमोमात्रां तु चारिणीम् । रजः सत्त्वं परित्यज्य वर्तमानां स्वकर्मतः
verses.transliteration: athātmani samadrākṣīttamomātrāṃ tu cāriṇīm / rajaḥ sattvaṃ parityajya vartamānāṃ svakarmataḥ
verses.translation: In the Treti yuga, medicinal herbs and plants began to appear themselves on the earth. In the beginning of the Treta yuga, the subjects sustained themselves with those plants and herbs.*
verses.wordMeaning: In the Treti yuga, medicinal herbs and plants began to appear themselves on the earth. In the beginning of the Treta yuga, the subjects sustained themselves with those plants and herbs.*
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Treti yuga, medicinal herbs and plants began to appear themselves on the earth. In the beginning of the Treta yuga, the subjects sustained themselves with those plants and herbs.*

verses.sanskrit: ततः स तेन दुखेनशुचं चक्रे जगत्पतिः । तमश्च व्यनुदत्पश्चाद् रजसातु समावृणोत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa tena dukhenaśucaṃ cakre jagatpatiḥ / tamaśca vyanudatpaścād rajasātu samāvṛṇot
verses.translation: Thereafter, due to the inevitability of affairs and due to the Tret& yuga those subjects ban to have passion and covetousness for ever.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, due to the inevitability of affairs and due to the Tret& yuga those subjects ban to have passion and covetousness for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, due to the inevitability of affairs and due to the Tret& yuga those subjects ban to have passion and covetousness for ever.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तमः प्रतिनुत्तं वै मिथुनं संप्रसूयत । अधर्माचरणा त्तस्य हिंसा शोको व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: tattamaḥ pratinuttaṃ vai mithunaṃ saṃprasūyata / adharmācaraṇā ttasya hiṃsā śoko vyajāyata
verses.translation: Then, they forcibly seized rivers, fields, mountains, trees, btishes and medicinal herbs as much as they could (in accordance with their strength).
verses.hindi: भूतादिकानां सत्त्वानां षष्ठः सगं: सः उच्यते .। ५२.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, they forcibly seized rivers, fields, mountains, trees, btishes and medicinal herbs as much as they could (in accordance with their strength).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, they forcibly seized rivers, fields, mountains, trees, btishes and medicinal herbs as much as they could (in accordance with their strength).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मिन्समुद्भूते मिथुने वरणात्मके । ततः स भगवानासीत् प्रीतश्चैतं हि शिश्रिये
verses.transliteration: tatastasminsamudbhūte mithune varaṇātmake / tataḥ sa bhagavānāsīt prītaścaitaṃ hi śiśriye
verses.translation: Etymology oT Prisida *s palace*.
verses.wordMeaning: Etymology oT Prisida *s palace*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Etymology oT Prisida *s palace*.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ prītātmanastasya svadehārddhādviniḥsṛtā / nārī paramakalyāṇī sarvabhūtamanoharā
verses.translation: W 128ff show the prevalence of food-gathering economy in the
verses.hindi: प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः॥।५३.
verses.wordMeaning: W 128ff show the prevalence of food-gathering economy in the
