verses.sanskrit: सा हि कामात्मना सृष्टा प्रकृतेः सा सुरूपिणी । शतरूपेति सा प्रोक्ता सा प्रोक्तैव पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sā hi kāmātmanā sṛṣṭā prakṛteḥ sā surūpiṇī / śatarūpeti sā proktā sā proktaiva punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: In ihe previous births, due to the glory of their auspiciousnesi (i.e. meritorious aca) as well as sins they were conceived as Brahmanas, Ktriyas, Vaiiyas, SOdrasand mali* cious people.
verses.hindi: बैका रिकस्तृतीयस्तु चे रिय: सग उच्यते ४५२४
verses.wordMeaning: In ihe previous births, due to the glory of their auspiciousnesi (i.e. meritorious aca) as well as sins they were conceived as Brahmanas, Ktriyas, Vaiiyas, SOdrasand mali* cious people.
verses.commentary: Sense: In ihe previous births, due to the glory of their auspiciousnesi (i.e. meritorious aca) as well as sins they were conceived as Brahmanas, Ktriyas, Vaiiyas, SOdrasand mali* cious people.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रजाः समुद्भूता यथा प्रोक्ता मया पुरा । प्रक्रियायां यथा तुभ्यं त्रेतामध्ये महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajāḥ samudbhūtā yathā proktā mayā purā / prakriyāyāṃ yathā tubhyaṃ tretāmadhye mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: After making Uie Sumeru mountain (as) the calf he milked this earth in the form of a cow that yielded seeds on the surface of the earth in the form of the mtlk.
verses.wordMeaning: After making Uie Sumeru mountain (as) the calf he milked this earth in the form of a cow that yielded seeds on the surface of the earth in the form of the mtlk.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making Uie Sumeru mountain (as) the calf he milked this earth in the form of a cow that yielded seeds on the surface of the earth in the form of the mtlk.

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रजास्तु ताः सृष्टा न व्यवद्धत धीमतः । ततो ऽन्यान्मानसान्पुत्रानात्मनः सदृशो ऽसृजत
verses.transliteration: yadā prajāstu tāḥ sṛṣṭā na vyavaddhata dhīmataḥ / tato 'nyānmānasānputrānātmanaḥ sadṛśo 'sṛjata
verses.translation: The lord made those seeds grow as the medicinal herbs (and other plants) that ended when the fruits became ripe. (That is, the plants yielded fruits but once and then they perished) they are the group of seventeen.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord made those seeds grow as the medicinal herbs (and other plants) that ended when the fruits became ripe. (That is, the plants yielded fruits but once and then they perished) they are the group of seventeen.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord made those seeds grow as the medicinal herbs (and other plants) that ended when the fruits became ripe. (That is, the plants yielded fruits but once and then they perished) they are the group of seventeen.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वङ्गिरोमरीचींश्च पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च निर्ममे मानसान्सुतान्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvaṅgiromarīcīṃśca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum / dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca nirmame mānasānsutān
verses.translation: All these fourteen varieties (of medicinal herbs and plants) peculiar to villages and forests grew at Che beginning of the first Tretk yuga. They are not grown by ploughing.
verses.hindi: बे/नारक-आदि/लक्षणों से आठ प्रकार से व्यवस्थित होते. हैं। वे मनुष्यः गत्वोंके साथ धर्म बाले होते हुए सिद्ध आत्मा बाले हैं ।५०। पाचवा अनुग्रह तामक सर्ग है जो चार प्रकार का व्यवस्थित है। विप्रयंय से. और शक्ति-से-और-शक्ति से उसी माँति सिद्ध मुख्य हैं ।५१। निवृत्त और वतमान
verses.wordMeaning: All these fourteen varieties (of medicinal herbs and plants) peculiar to villages and forests grew at Che beginning of the first Tretk yuga. They are not grown by ploughing.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these fourteen varieties (of medicinal herbs and plants) peculiar to villages and forests grew at Che beginning of the first Tretk yuga. They are not grown by ploughing.

verses.sanskrit: नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः । ब्रह्मा यतात्मकानां तु सर्वेषामात्मयोनिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ / brahmā yatātmakānāṃ tu sarveṣāmātmayoninām
verses.translation: The trees, hedges, creepers, winding plants, spread¬ ing creepers and (various) species of grasses yielded roots, fruits,*** shoots etc. unto them. They plucked their fruits.
verses.hindi: बार-बार, उतपन्न हुंआ-करते हैं। भूतादिक सत्वों.का जो सर्गी है बह,छडा सर्ग कहा जाता है।५२।-ओर' भूतादिक स्वादन,और आया.णोल जानने के योग्य हैं। प्रथमः महृत्ः'का सर्ग है वह ब्रह्मा का सर्ग तन्मात्रइओं का होता. है और -भूतसर्ग कहा जाया करता है और भूतसर्भ कहा जाया. करता. है ।
verses.wordMeaning: The trees, hedges, creepers, winding plants, spread¬ ing creepers and (various) species of grasses yielded roots, fruits,*** shoots etc. unto them. They plucked their fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees, hedges, creepers, winding plants, spread¬ ing creepers and (various) species of grasses yielded roots, fruits,*** shoots etc. unto them. They plucked their fruits.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसृजत्पुनर्ब्रह्मा धर्मं भूतसुखावहम् । प्रजापतिं रुचिं चैव पूर्वेषामेव पूर्वजौ
verses.transliteration: tato 'sṛjatpunarbrahmā dharmaṃ bhūtasukhāvaham / prajāpatiṃ ruciṃ caiva pūrveṣāmeva pūrvajau
verses.translation: Those seeds which were milked out of the earth formerly by the self-born lord, began to grow as medictnsd herbs putting forth floweri and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.hindi: तीसरा सर्ग- बैकारिक है. जो इन्द्रिय सर्ग के नाम से पुकारा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Those seeds which were milked out of the earth formerly by the self-born lord, began to grow as medictnsd herbs putting forth floweri and fruits at the proper seasons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those seeds which were milked out of the earth formerly by the self-born lord, began to grow as medictnsd herbs putting forth floweri and fruits at the proper seasons.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धितः ससृजे धर्मं सर्वभूतसुखावहम् । मनसस्तु रुचिर्नाम जज्ञे जो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: buddhitaḥ sasṛje dharmaṃ sarvabhūtasukhāvaham / manasastu rucirnāma jajñe jo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: When the medicinal herbs created before did not grow and flourish again, he made means of livelihood for them by means of agricultural occupations.
verses.hindi: ये सभी: पाकतः सरी हैं जो बुद्धि पूर्वक समुत्पन्न हुए हैं। प्रमुख सर्ग चीथा है ओर निश्चय ही.स्थावर मुख्य- कहे -गगे- हैं ।४४।- जियक स्रोत तो तिर्यग योनियों बाला-पाँचववाँ, होता है-+ उसी भाँति ऊघ्बं खोतों का सर्मा छठा है जो:देवत सर्म-के-नाम से कहा जाया करता है ५६१
verses.wordMeaning: When the medicinal herbs created before did not grow and flourish again, he made means of livelihood for them by means of agricultural occupations.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the medicinal herbs created before did not grow and flourish again, he made means of livelihood for them by means of agricultural occupations.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुस्तु त्दृदयाज्जज्ञे ऋषिः साललयोनिनः । प्राणाद्दक्षं सृजन्ब्रह्मा चक्षुर्भ्यां तु मरीचिनम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgustu tdṛdayājjajñe ṛṣiḥ sālalayoninaḥ / prāṇāddakṣaṃ sṛjanbrahmā cakṣurbhyāṃ tu marīcinam
verses.translation: The self-born lord (blessed them) with the power of working with their own hands and achieving great results. Thenceforth, the medicinal herbs became Krffapac (ploughed and grown).
verses.wordMeaning: The self-born lord (blessed them) with the power of working with their own hands and achieving great results. Thenceforth, the medicinal herbs became Krffapac (ploughed and grown).
verses.commentary: Sense: The self-born lord (blessed them) with the power of working with their own hands and achieving great results. Thenceforth, the medicinal herbs became Krffapac (ploughed and grown).

verses.sanskrit: अभिमानात्मकं रुद्रं निर्ममे नीललोहितम् । शिरस्ॐगिरसं चैव श्रोत्रादत्रिं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: abhimānātmakaṃ rudraṃ nirmame nīlalohitam / śirasoṃgirasaṃ caiva śrotrādatriṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: After achieving his purpose in the matter of agri* cultural occupation, the Prajpati (lord of the subjects i.e. god Brahmi established the bounds of decency by means of which they protected one another.
verses.hindi: विस्तराच्च यया सर्वे कीत्येमानं निबोधत । चतुर्ढा चं स्थितस्सोऽपि सर्वभूलेषु कृत्स्नशः
verses.wordMeaning: After achieving his purpose in the matter of agri* cultural occupation, the Prajpati (lord of the subjects i.e. god Brahmi established the bounds of decency by means of which they protected one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: After achieving his purpose in the matter of agri* cultural occupation, the Prajpati (lord of the subjects i.e. god Brahmi established the bounds of decency by means of which they protected one another.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यं च तथोदानाद्व्यानाच्च पुलहं पुनः । समानजो वसिष्ठश्च ह्यपानान्निर्ममे क्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: pulastyaṃ ca tathodānādvyānācca pulahaṃ punaḥ / samānajo vasiṣṭhaśca hyapānānnirmame kratum
verses.translation: Among them some were very powerful and they seized the realm. He established them as Ksatriyas and it was their duty to protect others.
verses.hindi: अथो ससर्ज वे ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समाद्
verses.wordMeaning: Among them some were very powerful and they seized the realm. He established them as Ksatriyas and it was their duty to protect others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among them some were very powerful and they seized the realm. He established them as Ksatriyas and it was their duty to protect others.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते ब्रह्मणः पुत्राः प्रजादौ द्वादश स्मृताः । धर्मस्तेषां प्रथमजो देवतानां स्मृतस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: ityete brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ prajādau dvādaśa smṛtāḥ / dharmasteṣāṃ prathamajo devatānāṃ smṛtastu vai
verses.translation: (Defective).* All those subjects who had been created will be worshipping you. 'Tell the truth in accord¬ ance with the fact'. Those (subjects) who said this were the Brahman as.
verses.hindi: हीं पर ऊध्वं जोतों का सातवां सर्ग है वह आठवाँ अनुग्रह नाम वाला सर्ग हैं ओर वह दो प्रकार सात्विक सर्ग है-और वूसरा तामस है ।५७।-ये पाँच बंकृत अर्थात् विकार से. युक्त सर्ग होते हैं और जो भ्राक्ृत सर्ग हैं वे तीन कहे गये हैं । प्राकृत और
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective).* All those subjects who had been created will be worshipping you. 'Tell the truth in accord¬ ance with the fact'. Those (subjects) who said this were the Brahman as.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective).* All those subjects who had been created will be worshipping you. 'Tell the truth in accord¬ ance with the fact'. Those (subjects) who said this were the Brahman as.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वादयस्तु ये सृष्टास्ते वै ब्रह्मर्षयः स्मृताः । गृहमेधिपुराणास्ते धर्मस्तैः प्राक् प्रवर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvādayastu ye sṛṣṭāste vai brahmarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ / gṛhamedhipurāṇāste dharmastaiḥ prāk pravarttitaḥ
verses.translation: VV.lSlfT described the traositioa from food-gathering economy to the food-growing one by the introduction of Agriculture. This ste crysta- lized the four-fold classilication of the society with their specihe duties {pidi VV 16M65 below).
verses.hindi: बैक्ृत दोनों प्रकार का जो सर्ग है वह नवम कौमार होता है ।५८। भाकृत तीनों सर्भ शुद्धि पूर्वक हैं वेतसा बुद्धि पूवं प्रवृत्त होते,है और उसके वर्ग राह्मण हैं ।५६।-जिस प्रकार से ये सब हैं वे सब विस्तार से कीत्तित होने वाले हैं. उनको समझ लीजिए । वह भी चार प्रकार से स्थित है और
verses.wordMeaning: VV.lSlfT described the traositioa from food-gathering economy to the food-growing one by the introduction of Agriculture. This ste crysta- lized the four-fold classilication of the society with their specihe duties {pidi VV 16M65 below).
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.lSlfT described the traositioa from food-gathering economy to the food-growing one by the introduction of Agriculture. This ste crysta- lized the four-fold classilication of the society with their specihe duties {pidi VV 16M65 below).

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशैते प्रसूयन्ते प्रजाः कल्पे पुनः पुनः । तेषां द्वादश ते वंशा दिव्या देवगुणान्विताः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśaite prasūyante prajāḥ kalpe punaḥ punaḥ / teṣāṃ dvādaśa te vaṃśā divyā devaguṇānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Vi. 162a gives a better reading:
verses.hindi: पूर्णरूप से समस्त भूतों में है॥६०। विपरीतता से शक्ति से बुद्धि से और सिद्धि से होते हैं। स्थावरों में तो विपर्यास होता है--तियंग, योनियों में सूंक्ति से होता है।६१। सिद्धात्मा मनुष्य पूर्णतया देवों में पुष्टि है। इसके उपरान्त ब्रह्माजी ने अपनी आत्मा के ही समान मानस अर्थात् मत हे
verses.wordMeaning: Vi. 162a gives a better reading:
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi. 162a gives a better reading:

verses.sanskrit: क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्षिभिरलङ्कृताः । यदा तैरिह सृष्टैस्तु धर्म्माद्यैश्च महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: kriyāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharṣibhiralaṅkṛtāḥ / yadā tairiha sṛṣṭaistu dharmmādyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Although the establishment of the classification into the four castes had been made by him (LordBrahmi), the subjects, out of delusion» did not conform to those rules.
verses.hindi: समुत्पन्तों का सुंजन-किया था ।६२। वे चैवर्त्य ज्ञान के द्वारा. महान ओज वाले अवृत्ति के अर्थात्- सृजन के कार्य से निवृत्त हो गये थे । नाम को भली: भाँति जानकर वे तीनों अपवृत्त हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Although the establishment of the classification into the four castes had been made by him (LordBrahmi), the subjects, out of delusion» did not conform to those rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the establishment of the classification into the four castes had been made by him (LordBrahmi), the subjects, out of delusion» did not conform to those rules.

verses.sanskrit: सृज्यमानाः प्रजाश्चैव न व्यवर्द्धन्त धीमतः । तमोमात्रावृतः सो ऽभूच्छोकप्रतिहतश्च वै
verses.transliteration: sṛjyamānāḥ prajāścaiva na vyavarddhanta dhīmataḥ / tamomātrāvṛtaḥ so 'bhūcchokapratihataśca vai
verses.translation: The subjects who lived in accordance with the duties of the (different) castes became antagonistic to one another. Lord Brahma understood everything factually.
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects who lived in accordance with the duties of the (different) castes became antagonistic to one another. Lord Brahma understood everything factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects who lived in accordance with the duties of the (different) castes became antagonistic to one another. Lord Brahma understood everything factually.

verses.sanskrit: यथाऽवृतः स वै ब्रह्मा तमोमात्रा तु सा पुनः । पुत्राणां च तमोमात्रा अपरा निःसृताभवत्
verses.transliteration: yathā'vṛtaḥ sa vai brahmā tamomātrā tu sā punaḥ / putrāṇāṃ ca tamomātrā aparā niḥsṛtābhavat
verses.translation: The abode of the Sudras who abide by their duty of rendering service is the world belonging to the Gandharvas. These are the abodes (after death) of the people of the differ¬ ent castes who remain good and maintain the conduct of life befitting their respective station in life.
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of the Sudras who abide by their duty of rendering service is the world belonging to the Gandharvas. These are the abodes (after death) of the people of the differ¬ ent castes who remain good and maintain the conduct of life befitting their respective station in life.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of the Sudras who abide by their duty of rendering service is the world belonging to the Gandharvas. These are the abodes (after death) of the people of the differ¬ ent castes who remain good and maintain the conduct of life befitting their respective station in life.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिस्रोतात्मको ऽधर्मो हिंसा चैवाशुभात्मिका । ततः प्रतिहते तस्य प्रतीते वरणात्मके
verses.transliteration: pratisrotātmako 'dharmo hiṃsā caivāśubhātmikā / tataḥ pratihate tasya pratīte varaṇātmake
verses.translation: When this mode of disciplined life of the four castes had been well-established, the people of the different castes strictly adhered to the duties of their respective castes because they were afraid of punishment otherwise. Then, after the castes had been established, he stabilised the stages of life.
verses.wordMeaning: When this mode of disciplined life of the four castes had been well-established, the people of the different castes strictly adhered to the duties of their respective castes because they were afraid of punishment otherwise. Then, after the castes had been established,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When this mode of disciplined life of the four castes had been well-established, the people of the different castes strictly adhered to the duties of their respective castes because they were afraid of punishment otherwise. Then, after the castes had been established,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वां तनुं स तदा ब्रह्मा समपोहत भास्वराम् । द्विधा कृत्वा स्वकं देहमर्द्धेन पुरुषो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: svāṃ tanuṃ sa tadā brahmā samapohata bhāsvarām / dvidhā kṛtvā svakaṃ dehamarddhena puruṣo 'bhavat
verses.translation: The Lord established as before the following four Airamas (stages in life) viz-the householder, the celibate reli¬ gious student, the forest hermit and the ascetic.
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord established as before the following four Airamas (stages in life) viz-the householder, the celibate reli¬ gious student, the forest hermit and the ascetic.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord established as before the following four Airamas (stages in life) viz-the householder, the celibate reli¬ gious student, the forest hermit and the ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धेन नारी सा तस्य शतरूपा व्यजायत । प्रकृतिर्भूतधात्री सा कामाद्वै सृजतः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: ardhena nārī sā tasya śatarūpā vyajāyata / prakṛtirbhūtadhātrī sā kāmādvai sṛjataḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: (Defective text) the people of the four castes per¬ formed the duties of the respective castes. After doing their duties they erected their residences and maintained their stages of life and then enjoyed themselves.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) the people of the four castes per¬ formed the duties of the respective castes. After doing their duties they erected their residences and maintained their stages of life and then enjoyed themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) the people of the four castes per¬ formed the duties of the respective castes. After doing their duties they erected their residences and maintained their stages of life and then enjoyed themselves.

verses.sanskrit: सा दिवं पृथिवीं चैव महिम्ना व्याप्य सुस्थिता । ब्रह्माणः सा तनुः पूर्वा दिवमावृत्य तिष्टतः
verses.transliteration: sā divaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva mahimnā vyāpya susthitā / brahmāṇaḥ sā tanuḥ pūrvā divamāvṛtya tiṣṭataḥ
verses.translation: Brahma established those Airamas, He directed and guided those who swerved from these and recounted righteous virtues to them.
verses.hindi: प्रजा की सृष्टि को न देखकर ही फिर ब्रह्माजी ने अनन्तर में प्रतिसर्ग की रचना की थी । उनके विरक्त हो जाने पर उन्होंने अन्य साधकों का सुजन किया था ।६४। देवगण अपने स्थान के अभिमॉन रखने बाले थे। ब्रह्माजी का अनुशासन हुआ । न हुई सृष्टि की अवस्था वाले जो स्थानी थे
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma established those Airamas, He directed and guided those who swerved from these and recounted righteous virtues to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma established those Airamas, He directed and guided those who swerved from these and recounted righteous virtues to them.

verses.sanskrit: या त्वर्द्धा सृज्यते नारी शतरूपा व्यजायत । सा देवी नियुतं तप्त्वा तपः परम दुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: yā tvarddhā sṛjyate nārī śatarūpā vyajāyata / sā devī niyutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ parama duścaram
verses.translation: The following are the duties of the householder in brief: Marriage, maintenance of sacrificial fire, hospitability to guests, performance of Yajftas and continuation of his race (procreation).
verses.hindi: उनकी ज्ञान आप लोग मुझसे प्राप्त कर लेवें ।६५। जल-अग्ति--पृथिवी-
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the duties of the householder in brief: Marriage, maintenance of sacrificial fire, hospitability to guests, performance of Yajftas and continuation of his race (procreation).
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the duties of the householder in brief: Marriage, maintenance of sacrificial fire, hospitability to guests, performance of Yajftas and continuation of his race (procreation).

verses.sanskrit: भर्त्तारं दीप्तयशसं पुरुषं प्रत्यपद्यत । स वै स्वायंभुवः पूर्वं पुरुषो मनुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bharttāraṃ dīptayaśasaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyapadyata / sa vai svāyaṃbhuvaḥ pūrvaṃ puruṣo manurucyate
verses.translation: The duties of the religious student are as follows: He must wear the girdle (of the munja grass) and hold the staff. He must wear the skin of an antelope. He must sleep on the ground. He must serve his preceptor. He must beg for alms. He must be eager to acquire learning.
verses.hindi: घियों की आतमामें-बृक्षों और वीरुधों की आत्मायें=लता--काषा-कला-
verses.wordMeaning: The duties of the religious student are as follows: He must wear the girdle (of the munja grass) and hold the staff. He must wear the skin of an antelope. He must sleep on the ground. He must serve his preceptor. He must beg for alms. He must be eager to acquire learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: The duties of the religious student are as follows: He must wear the girdle (of the munja grass) and hold the staff. He must wear the skin of an antelope. He must sleep on the ground. He must serve his preceptor. He must beg for alms. He must be eager to acquire learning.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैकसप्ततियुगं मन्वन्तरमिहोच्यते । लब्ध्वा तु पुरुषः पत्नीं शतरूपामयोनिजाम्
verses.transliteration: tasyaikasaptatiyugaṃ manvantaramihocyate / labdhvā tu puruṣaḥ patnīṃ śatarūpāmayonijām
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: में स्रोतों में अभिमान वाले हैं और वे स्थान नाम से कहे गये हैं ।६६-६८। ट उन ब्रह्माजी ने स्थानात्मा देखा तो ऐसा सेवलोकन करके उनका सृजन करके फिर उस समय में उन्होंने अन्नों का सृजन किया था । उन्होंने देवों की और पितृगणों की सृष्टि की थी जिनके द्वारा ये प्रजायें परिवर्धित हुई
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: तया स रमते सार्द्धं तस्मात्सा रतिरुच्यते । प्रथमः संप्रयोगः स कल्पादौ समवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: tayā sa ramate sārddhaṃ tasmātsā ratirucyate / prathamaḥ saṃprayogaḥ sa kalpādau samavarttata
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: थीं ।६६। उन ब्रह्मोओ ने अपने मन के द्वारा नो पुत्रों की सृष्टि की थी। वे नौं ये हैं--भूगु- मरीचि--पुलस्त्य--पुलह---कुतु-दक्ष-अत्रि और वसिछ्ठ। उस समय में इनका सृजन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: विराजमसृजद्ब्रह्मा सो ऽभवत्पुरुषो विराट् । सम्राट् सशतरूपस्तु वैराजस्तु मनुः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: virājamasṛjadbrahmā so 'bhavatpuruṣo virāṭ / samrāṭ saśatarūpastu vairājastu manuḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: स वैराजः प्रजासर्गं ससर्ज पुरुषो मनुः । वैराजात्पुरुषाद्वीरौ शतरूपा व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: sa vairājaḥ prajāsargaṃ sasarja puruṣo manuḥ / vairājātpuruṣādvīrau śatarūpā vyajāyata
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: नव ब्राह्मण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवतां वरौ । कन्ये द्वे सुमहाभागे याभ्यां जाता इमाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: priyavratottānapādau putrau putravatāṃ varau / kanye dve sumahābhāge yābhyāṃ jātā imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: देवी नाम्ना तथाकूलिः प्रसूतिश्चैव ते शुभे । स्वायंभुवः प्रसूतिं तु दक्षाय व्यसृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: devī nāmnā tathākūliḥ prasūtiścaiva te śubhe / svāyaṃbhuvaḥ prasūtiṃ tu dakṣāya vyasṛjatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: सोऽसुजद्व् यवसायं तु ब्रह्मा भूतं सुखात्मकम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: रुचेः प्रजापतेश्चैव आकूतिं प्रत्य पादयत् । आकूत्यां मिथुनं जज्ञे मानसस्य रुचेः शुभम्
verses.transliteration: ruceḥ prajāpateścaiva ākūtiṃ pratya pādayat / ākūtyāṃ mithunaṃ jajñe mānasasya ruceḥ śubham
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञश्च दक्षिणा चैव यमलौ तौ बभूवतुः । यज्ञस्य दक्षिणायां च पुत्रा द्वादश जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: yajñaśca dakṣiṇā caiva yamalau tau babhūvatuḥ / yajñasya dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca putrā dvādaśa jajñire
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: भृग्वादयस्तु ये सृष्टा न च ते ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: यामा इति समाख्याता देवाः स्वायंभुवेतरे । यमस्य पुत्रा यज्ञस्य तस्माद्यामास्तु ते स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: yāmā iti samākhyātā devāḥ svāyaṃbhuvetare / yamasya putrā yajñasya tasmādyāmāstu te smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: अजिताश्चैव शुक्राश्च द्वौ गणौ ब्रह्मणः स्मृतौ । यामाः पूर्वं परिक्रान्ता येषां संज्ञा दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: ajitāścaiva śukrāśca dvau gaṇau brahmaṇaḥ smṛtau / yāmāḥ pūrvaṃ parikrāntā yeṣāṃ saṃjñā divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: ये नो ब्रह्मा ही हैं-ऐसा पुराण में निश्चय को प्राप्त हुए थे। इन

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभूव सुतायां तु प्रसूत्यां लोकमातरः । तस्यां कन्याश्चतुर्विंशद्दक्षस्त्वजनयत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhūva sutāyāṃ tu prasūtyāṃ lokamātaraḥ / tasyāṃ kanyāścaturviṃśaddakṣastvajanayatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.hindi: सन ब्रह्मयोगी' आत्मकों का ब्रह्मा के ही समान प्रभाव था ।७१। इसके अनन्तर ब्रह्माजोःने रोष रूपी अपने आत्मज रुद्रदेव काःसृजन किया था: सर्कुल्प और धमं का सूजन किया था ओर सभी के पवंतों की रचना की थी ।७२। उन ब्रह्माजो ने व्यवसाय की सृष्टि की थी और ब्रह्मा ने सुखात्मक

verses.sanskrit: सर्वास्ताश्च महाभागाः सर्वाः कमललोचनाः । योगपत्न्यश्च ताः सर्वाः सर्वास्ता योगमातरः
verses.transliteration: sarvāstāśca mahābhāgāḥ sarvāḥ kamalalocanāḥ / yogapatnyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ sarvāstā yogamātaraḥ

verses.hindi: भूत की रचना की थी उन्होंने अव्यक्त योगी सङ्कल्प से सङ्कुल्प को जन्म दिया था "॥७३। दक्षः ने प्राण 'वाक्'का सृजन किया था ओर चक्षुओं से मरीचि को-उत्पन्नःकिया-या। सलिल योगी के हृदय से भृगु ऋषि उत्पन्नः इए ये।७४। शिर से अङ्गिरा ने जन्म ग्रहण किया था । उदान वायु सें

verses.transliteration: sarvāśca brahmavādinyaḥ sarvā viśvasya mātaraḥ / śraddhā lakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā tathā kriyā

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्ततो ब्रह्मा महादेवेन स प्रभुः । प्रत्युवाच तथा भीमं त्दृष्यमाणः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastato brahmā mahādevena sa prabhuḥ / pratyuvāca tathā bhīmaṃ tdṛṣyamāṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ

verses.sanskrit: एवं भवतु भद्रं ते यथा ते व्यात्दृतं प्रभो । ब्रह्मणा समनु ज्ञाते ततः सर्वमभूत्किल
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te yathā te vyātdṛtaṃ prabho / brahmaṇā samanu jñāte tataḥ sarvamabhūtkila
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति देवः स न प्रासूयत वै प्रजाः । ऊर्ध्वरेताः स्थितः स्थाणुर्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti devaḥ sa na prāsūyata vai prajāḥ / ūrdhvaretāḥ sthitaḥ sthāṇuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्प्रोक्तं स्थितो ऽस्मीति तस्मात्स्थाणुर्बुधैः स्मृतः । ज्ञानं तपश्च सत्यं च ह्यैश्वर्यं धर्म एव च
verses.transliteration: yasmātproktaṃ sthito 'smīti tasmātsthāṇurbudhaiḥ smṛtaḥ / jñānaṃ tapaśca satyaṃ ca hyaiśvaryaṃ dharma eva ca

verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यमात्मसंबोधः कृत्स्नान्येतानि शङ्करे । सर्वान्देवानृषींश्चैव समेतानसुरैः सह
verses.transliteration: vairāgyamātmasaṃbodhaḥ kṛtsnānyetāni śaṅkare / sarvāndevānṛṣīṃścaiva sametānasuraiḥ saha
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: अत्येति तेजसा देवो महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः । अत्येति देवा नैश्वर्याद्वलेन च महासुरान्
verses.transliteration: atyeti tejasā devo mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ / atyeti devā naiśvaryādvalena ca mahāsurān
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेन च मुनीन्सर्वान्योगाद्भूतानि सर्वशः । एवमेव महादेवः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः । प्रजामनु द्यामां सृष्ट्वा सर्गादुपरराम ह
verses.transliteration: jñānena ca munīnsarvānyogādbhūtāni sarvaśaḥ / evameva mahādevaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ / prajāmanu dyāmāṃ sṛṣṭvā sargādupararāma ha
verses.translation: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.wordMeaning: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the duties of the forest hermits; wearing barks and leaves or skins of antelope (for clothes), maintaining themselves by means of roots, fruits and medicinal herbs found in the forests, bathing both at dawn and dusk and performance of Homa.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे रुद्रप्रसववर्णनं नाम नवमो ऽध्यायः ऋषिरुवाच अस्मिन्कल्पे त्वया नोक्तः प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः । महादेवस्य रुद्रस्य साधकैरृषिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde rudraprasavavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣiruvāca asminkalpe tvayā noktaḥ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ / mahādevasya rudrasya sādhakairṛṣibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: The manifestadon in thisKalpa of the noble-sou led great lord Rudra along with the Sddh42ka (spiritual aspirants) has not been narrated by you.
verses.wordMeaning: The manifestadon in thisKalpa of the noble-sou led great lord Rudra along with the Sddh42ka (spiritual aspirants) has not been narrated by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The manifestadon in thisKalpa of the noble-sou led great lord Rudra along with the Sddh42ka (spiritual aspirants) has not been narrated by you.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच उत्पत्तिरादिसर्गस्य मया प्रोक्ता समासतः । विस्तरेण प्रवक्ष्यामि नामानि तनुभिः सह
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca utpattirādisargasya mayā proktā samāsataḥ / vistareṇa pravakṣyāmi nāmāni tanubhiḥ saha
verses.translation: The origin of the primordial creation has been succinct¬ ly tneniioned by me. I shall now narrate in detail the names along with the physical bodies.
verses.wordMeaning: The origin of the primordial creation has been succinct¬ ly tneniioned by me. I shall now narrate in detail the names along with the physical bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: The origin of the primordial creation has been succinct¬ ly tneniioned by me. I shall now narrate in detail the names along with the physical bodies.

verses.sanskrit: पत्नीषु जनयामास महादेवः सुतान्बहून । कल्पेष्वन्येष्वतीतेषु ह्यस्मिन्कल्पे तु ताञ्शृणु
verses.transliteration: patnīṣu janayāmāsa mahādevaḥ sutānbahūna / kalpeṣvanyeṣvatīteṣu hyasminkalpe tu tāñśṛṇu
verses.translation: Mahadeva begot of his wives many sons in the other Kalpas that have passed by. Listen to thoe (procreated) in this Kalpa.
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva begot of his wives many sons in the other Kalpas that have passed by. Listen to thoe (procreated) in this Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva begot of his wives many sons in the other Kalpas that have passed by. Listen to thoe (procreated) in this Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पादावात्मनस्तुल्यं सुतमध्यायत प्रभुः । प्रादुरा सीत्ततोङ्के ऽस्य कुमारो नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: kalpādāvātmanastulyaṃ sutamadhyāyata prabhuḥ / prādurā sīttatoṅke 'sya kumāro nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord contemplated on a son on a par with himself. Thereafter, the child Nllalohita appeared on his lap.
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord contemplated on a son on a par with himself. Thereafter, the child Nllalohita appeared on his lap.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord contemplated on a son on a par with himself. Thereafter, the child Nllalohita appeared on his lap.

verses.sanskrit: रुरोद सुस्वरं घोरं निर्दहन्निव तेजसा । दृष्ट्वा रुदन्तं सहसा कुमारं नीललोहितम्
verses.transliteration: ruroda susvaraṃ ghoraṃ nirdahanniva tejasā / dṛṣṭvā rudantaṃ sahasā kumāraṃ nīlalohitam
verses.translation: Derivation of MakidM,
verses.hindi: अनेक सुरम्य पुरों से तथा परम स्फीत जनपदों से समलंकत. हैं-- इस.
verses.wordMeaning: Derivation of MakidM,
verses.commentary: Sense: Derivation of MakidM,

verses.sanskrit: किं रोदिषि कुमारेति ब्रह्मा तं प्रत्यभाषत । सो ऽब्रवीद्देहि मे नाम प्रथमं त्वं पितामह
verses.transliteration: kiṃ rodiṣi kumāreti brahmā taṃ pratyabhāṣata / so 'bravīddehi me nāma prathamaṃ tvaṃ pitāmaha
verses.translation: "O lord, you are named Rudra**. On being told thus he cried again. "Why do you cry, O child?" asked Brahmi to him.
verses.hindi: ग्रह्मवन में सबके ज्ञाता अव्यक्त ब्रह्माजी सञ्चरण किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, you are named Rudra**. On being told thus he cried again. "Why do you cry, O child?" asked Brahmi to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, you are named Rudra**. On being told thus he cried again. "Why do you cry, O child?" asked Brahmi to him.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्त्वं देव नामासि स इत्युक्तो ऽरुदत्पुनः । किं रोदिषि कुमारेति ब्रह्मा तं प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: rudrastvaṃ deva nāmāsi sa ityukto 'rudatpunaḥ / kiṃ rodiṣi kumāreti brahmā taṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: "Give me a second name", said he to the self*bom Lord. "You are Bhava by name, O Lord". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त के बीज से जो समुट्पत्ति है वह अनेक हीं अनुग्रह में स्थित होता हैं। यह एक वृक्ष है--ऐसा ही रूपक यहाँ पर दिया जाता है--इसकी वृद्धि हौ स्कन्धों से परिपूर्ण है और अन्य इंन्द्रियाँ कोटर हैं।१००। महामूतों का प्रकाश' है और विज्लेषों से बह पत्रों वाला है । इसके धर्म और अधर्म पुष्पः हैं"
verses.wordMeaning: "Give me a second name", said he to the self*bom Lord. "You are Bhava by name, O Lord". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Give me a second name", said he to the self*bom Lord. "You are Bhava by name, O Lord". On being told thus he cried again.

verses.sanskrit: नाम देहि द्वितीयं मे इत्युवाच स्वयंभुवम् । भवस्त्वं देवनाम्नासि इत्युक्तः सो ऽरुदत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: nāma dehi dvitīyaṃ me ityuvāca svayaṃbhuvam / bhavastvaṃ devanāmnāsi ityuktaḥ so 'rudatpunaḥ
verses.translation: "Why do you cry?", enquired Brahma of the crying child. "Give me a third name". On being told thus, he said again.
verses.hindi: तथा उनका परिणाम रूप सुखं और दुःख इसके फलों का उदय है।हैं०॥ यह सनातन अर्थात् सर्गा से चला जाने वाला ब्रह्म वृक्ष समस्त प्राणियों की आजीब' होता है । उस ब्रह्म वृक्ष का यह ब्रह्मवन है !१०२। जहाँ पर सतः और असत् स्वरूप वाला नित्य अव्यक्त ही कारण है। तत्वों के चिन्तन
verses.wordMeaning: "Why do you cry?", enquired Brahma of the crying child. "Give me a third name". On being told thus, he said again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why do you cry?", enquired Brahma of the crying child. "Give me a third name". On being told thus, he said again.

verses.sanskrit: किं रोदिषीति तं ब्रह्मा रुदन्तं प्रत्युवाच ह । तृतीयं देहि मे नाम इत्युक्तः सो ऽब्रवीत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ rodiṣīti taṃ brahmā rudantaṃ pratyuvāca ha / tṛtīyaṃ dehi me nāma ityuktaḥ so 'bravītpunaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, you are rva by name." On being told thus he cried again, "Why do you cry?", asked Brahmi again to the crying child.
verses.hindi: करने वाले मनीषी इसको प्रधास-अ्रकृति और माया कहा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, you are rva by name." On being told thus he cried again, "Why do you cry?", asked Brahmi again to the crying child.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, you are rva by name." On being told thus he cried again, "Why do you cry?", asked Brahmi again to the crying child.

verses.sanskrit: शर्वस्त्वं देव नाम्नासि इत्युक्तः सो ऽरुदत्पुनः । किं रोदिषीति तं ब्रह्मा रुदन्तं प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: śarvastvaṃ deva nāmnāsi ityuktaḥ so 'rudatpunaḥ / kiṃ rodiṣīti taṃ brahmā rudantaṃ pratyuvāca ha
verses.translation: "Give me a foiu'th name." On being told thus, he said again, "O lord, you are liana by name". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.hindi: कृपा से होमे वाला इस रीति से यह अनुग्रह सर्ग ब्रह्म के निमित्त वाला कहा: गया है अबुद्धि पूर्मक :ब्रह्माजी के तीन सर्ग है जो प्राकृत कहे गये हं
verses.wordMeaning: "Give me a foiu'th name." On being told thus, he said again, "O lord, you are liana by name". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Give me a foiu'th name." On being told thus, he said again, "O lord, you are liana by name". On being told thus he cried again.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थ देहि मे नाम इत्युक्तः सो ऽब्रवीत्पुनः । ईशानो देवनाम्नासि इत्युक्तः सो ऽरुदत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: caturtha dehi me nāma ityuktaḥ so 'bravītpunaḥ / īśāno devanāmnāsi ityuktaḥ so 'rudatpunaḥ
verses.translation: "Why do you cry", said Brahmi to that cryit child again. He replied to the self-bom lord—"Give me a fifth name."
verses.hindi: मुख्य आदिकः छै सर्ग-हैं जो आकृत न होकर बेकृत कहे जाते हैं और: बुद्धिः
verses.wordMeaning: "Why do you cry", said Brahmi to that cryit child again. He replied to the self-bom lord—"Give me a fifth name."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why do you cry", said Brahmi to that cryit child again. He replied to the self-bom lord—"Give me a fifth name."

verses.sanskrit: किं रोदिषीति तं ब्रह्मा रुदन्तं पुनरब्रवीत् । पञ्चमं नाम देहीति प्रत्युवाच स्वयंभुवम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ rodiṣīti taṃ brahmā rudantaṃ punarabravīt / pañcamaṃ nāma dehīti pratyuvāca svayaṃbhuvam
verses.translation: "You are the lord and master of all PaSus (Animals, living beings)". On being told thus, he cried again. "Why do you cry?*' said Brahma to that crying child, once again.
verses.hindi: द    अह्याण्डःपुराणः के योग से किये जाते हैं ब्रह्मा के अभिमन्यु वे कल्प. से संत्रवृत्त होते
verses.wordMeaning: "You are the lord and master of all PaSus (Animals, living beings)". On being told thus, he cried again. "Why do you cry?*' said Brahma to that crying child, once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You are the lord and master of all PaSus (Animals, living beings)". On being told thus, he cried again. "Why do you cry?*' said Brahma to that crying child, once again.

verses.sanskrit: पशूनां त्वं पतिर्देव इत्युक्तः सो ऽरुदत्पुनः । किं रोदिषीति तं ब्रह्मा रुदन्तं पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: paśūnāṃ tvaṃ patirdeva ityuktaḥ so 'rudatpunaḥ / kiṃ rodiṣīti taṃ brahmā rudantaṃ punarabravīt
verses.translation: "Indeed, give me the sixth name". On being told thus he replied to him—"O lord, you are Bhima by name*'. On being told thus he cried again.
verses.hindi: सर्गाः परस्परोत्पन्नाः कारणं तु बुधैः स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: "Indeed, give me the sixth name". On being told thus he replied to him—"O lord, you are Bhima by name*'. On being told thus he cried again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Indeed, give me the sixth name". On being told thus he replied to him—"O lord, you are Bhima by name*'. On being told thus he cried again.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठं वै देहि मे नाम इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाच तम् । भीमस्त्वं देव नाम्नासि इत्युक्तः सो ऽरुदत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai dehi me nāma ityuktaḥ pratyuvāca tam / bhīmastvaṃ deva nāmnāsi ityuktaḥ so 'rudatpunaḥ
verses.translation: "Why do you cry?", asked Brahma again to that crying child. "Give me the seventh name". On being told thus he replied:
verses.hindi: अ डजस्तु स्वयं ब्रह्मा लोकास्तेन कृताः स्वयम् १०६
verses.wordMeaning: "Why do you cry?", asked Brahma again to that crying child. "Give me the seventh name". On being told thus he replied:
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why do you cry?", asked Brahma again to that crying child. "Give me the seventh name". On being told thus he replied:

verses.sanskrit: किं रोदिषीति तं ब्रह्मा रुदन्तं पुनरब्रवीत् । सप्तमं देहि मे नाम इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: kiṃ rodiṣīti taṃ brahmā rudantaṃ punarabravīt / saptamaṃ dehi me nāma ityuktaḥ pratyuvāca ha
verses.translation: This name signifies identification of Rudra and Fire.
verses.hindi: हो लोका ब्रह्मलोक वे अपरावतिनीं गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: This name signifies identification of Rudra and Fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: This name signifies identification of Rudra and Fire.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रस्त्वं देव नाम्नासि इत्युक्तः सो ऽरुदत्पुनः । तं रुदन्तं कुमारं तु मारोदीरिति सो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ugrastvaṃ deva nāmnāsi ityuktaḥ so 'rudatpunaḥ / taṃ rudantaṃ kumāraṃ tu mārodīriti so 'bravīt
verses.translation: W. 5 if. This episode of crying for a name and god BrahmS's
verses.hindi: भवंति ब्रह्माणा तुल्या रूपेण विषयेण च
verses.wordMeaning: W. 5 if. This episode of crying for a name and god BrahmS's
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 5 if. This episode of crying for a name and god BrahmS's

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽब्रवीदष्टमं नाम देहि मे त्वं विभो पुनः । त्वं महादेवनामासि इत्युक्तो विरराम ह
verses.transliteration: so 'bravīdaṣṭamaṃ nāma dehi me tvaṃ vibho punaḥ / tvaṃ mahādevanāmāsi ityukto virarāma ha
verses.translation: lord, you are Ugra by name*'. On being told thus, he cried again. To that crying child he said—
verses.hindi: के इस प्रकार से प्राकृत और बेकृत नौ सर्ग कहे गये हैं । ये सर्गः पर- स्पर में. ही समुत्पन्न हुए हैं और बुघजनों ने.तो कारण बताया है ।१०६। वेद जिसके मूर्धा को कहते हैं--वियत इसकी नाभि है ओर चन्द्र तथा सूर्य जिसके :बोनों नेर हैं । दिशायें इसके शोत हैं, भूमिको इसके चरण समझिए-
verses.wordMeaning: lord, you are Ugra by name*'. On being told thus, he cried again. To that crying child he said—
verses.commentary: Sense: lord, you are Ugra by name*'. On being told thus, he cried again. To that crying child he said—

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा नामानि चैतानि ब्रह्माणं नीललोहितः । प्रोवाच नाम्नामेतेषां स्थानानि प्रदिशेति ह
verses.transliteration: labdhvā nāmāni caitāni brahmāṇaṃ nīlalohitaḥ / provāca nāmnāmeteṣāṃ sthānāni pradiśeti ha
verses.translation: He said—"Give me, O lord, the eighth name". "You arc Mahadeva by name". On being told thus, he stopped crying.
verses.hindi: बहू न चिन्तन करने के योग्य आत्मा वाला और समस्त भूतों का अणेता है ।१०७। जिसके मुखसे ब्राह्मण समुत्पन्न हुए हैं और जिसके चक्षःस्थल से पूर्व भाग में क्षत्रियं की समुत्पत्ति हुई है । जिसके ऊं से वैश्य और पदों से शुद्रससमुद्भूतःहृए हैं । समरो चारीं वर्ण उसी के शरीर से उत्पन्न हुए हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He said—"Give me, O lord, the eighth name". "You arc Mahadeva by name". On being told thus, he stopped crying.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said—"Give me, O lord, the eighth name". "You arc Mahadeva by name". On being told thus, he stopped crying.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विसृष्टास्तनव एषां नाम्ना स्वयंभुवा । सूर्यो जलं मही वायुर्व ह्निराकाशमेव च
verses.transliteration: tato visṛṣṭāstanava eṣāṃ nāmnā svayaṃbhuvā / sūryo jalaṃ mahī vāyurva hnirākāśameva ca
verses.translation: After securing these names. Nilalohita requested Brahm—"Indicate the abodes of these names''.
verses.hindi: ।१०अ व्यक्त नारायण से पर अण्ड हूं जो अव्यक्तः संज्ञा वाला है। इस अप्ड' सेः्जन्म ग्रहण करने वाला स्वयं ब्रह्मा है और उसी के द्वारा स्वयं लोकों की
verses.wordMeaning: After securing these names. Nilalohita requested Brahm—"Indicate the abodes of these names''.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing these names. Nilalohita requested Brahm—"Indicate the abodes of these names''.

verses.sanskrit: दीक्षिता ब्राह्मणश्चन्द्र इत्येवं ते ऽष्टधा तनुः । तेषु पूज्यश्च वन्द्यश्च नमस्कार्यश्च यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: dīkṣitā brāhmaṇaścandra ityevaṃ te 'ṣṭadhā tanuḥ / teṣu pūjyaśca vandyaśca namaskāryaśca yatnataḥ
verses.translation: The abodei of the aames of NiUJohiu are the eight forms mUrtis) of Siva and they vymboliar the five MahdbhUUs (grou elefQenti) the two principle vital ain and ApinA and the principle of the Mind.
verses.hindi: लोककल्पनस्(२)   रचना की-गकी है।१०७ बहाँ पर दशा कल्यो. तक स्थिते होकर केः फिर सस्यःकोःचले'जाया-करते हैं। वे लोक ब्रह्मलोक को जाते. हैं जोःकिःगति अपरा-वत्तिनी होती हैं ।१ १० विना आधिप्रत्य केःवे/निश्चय-ही ऐश्वर्मी-के
verses.wordMeaning: The abodei of the aames of NiUJohiu are the eight forms mUrtis) of Siva and they vymboliar the five MahdbhUUs (grou elefQenti) the two principle vital ain and ApinA and the principle of the Mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abodei of the aames of NiUJohiu are the eight forms mUrtis) of Siva and they vymboliar the five MahdbhUUs (grou elefQenti) the two principle vital ain and ApinA and the principle of the Mind.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच तं पुनर्ब्रह्मा कुमारं नीललोहितम् । यदुक्तं ते मया पूर्वं नाम रुद्रेति वै विभो
verses.transliteration: provāca taṃ punarbrahmā kumāraṃ nīlalohitam / yaduktaṃ te mayā pūrvaṃ nāma rudreti vai vibho
verses.translation: Since the sun comes into view frequently and since it vanishes frequently, one, who desires for longevity, should not directly sec the sun. One should always be pure.
verses.hindi: द्वारा उसके समान होते हैं। के सभी स्वरूप से: ओर विषय से. ब्रह्मा के हो तुल्य होते हैं। वहाँ पर वे स्वयंयुत प्रीति से युक्त होते हुए अवस्थितः रहा करते हैं। अवश्यम्मावी अर्थ से वे प्राकृत को स्वयं विस्तृत किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Since the sun comes into view frequently and since it vanishes frequently, one, who desires for longevity, should not directly sec the sun. One should always be pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the sun comes into view frequently and since it vanishes frequently, one, who desires for longevity, should not directly sec the sun. One should always be pure.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यादित्यतनुर्नाम्नः प्रथमा प्रथमस्य ते । इत्युक्ते तस्य यत्तेजश्चक्षुस्त्वासीत्प्रकाशकम्
verses.transliteration: tasyādityatanurnāmnaḥ prathamā prathamasya te / ityukte tasya yattejaścakṣustvāsītprakāśakam
verses.translation: Lord Rudra does not oppress the Brahmaa who strictly adheres to these principles. Then Brahma said again to that lord Nilalohita.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Rudra does not oppress the Brahmaa who strictly adheres to these principles. Then Brahma said again to that lord Nilalohita.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Rudra does not oppress the Brahmaa who strictly adheres to these principles. Then Brahma said again to that lord Nilalohita.

verses.sanskrit: विवेश तत्तदादित्यं तस्माद्रुद्रो ह्यसौ स्मृतः । उद्यतमस्तं यन्तं च वर्जयेद्दर्शनेरविम्
verses.transliteration: viveśa tattadādityaṃ tasmādrudro hyasau smṛtaḥ / udyatamastaṃ yantaṃ ca varjayeddarśaneravim
verses.translation: Your second name has been mentioned by nic as Bhava. Let the waters be the second physical body of this name ofyours.
verses.wordMeaning: Your second name has been mentioned by nic as Bhava. Let the waters be the second physical body of this name ofyours.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your second name has been mentioned by nic as Bhava. Let the waters be the second physical body of this name ofyours.

verses.sanskrit: शश्वच्च जायते यस्माच्छश्वत्संतिष्ठते तु यत् । तस्मात्मूर्यं न वीक्षेत आयुष्कामः शुचिः सदा
verses.transliteration: śaśvacca jāyate yasmācchaśvatsaṃtiṣṭhate tu yat / tasmātmūryaṃ na vīkṣeta āyuṣkāmaḥ śuciḥ sadā
verses.translation: On this being mentioned, the element of the nature of Rasa (Juice )(i.e. water) became stationed in his body. Since he entered it, the water is remembered as Bhava*
verses.hindi: त॑ शग साधं  वर्तत कार्याणि कारणानि च ।
verses.wordMeaning: On this being mentioned, the element of the nature of Rasa (Juice )(i.e. water) became stationed in his body. Since he entered it, the water is remembered as Bhava*
verses.commentary: Sense: On this being mentioned, the element of the nature of Rasa (Juice )(i.e. water) became stationed in his body. Since he entered it, the water is remembered as Bhava*

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागतं रुद्रं विप्रा ह्याप्याययन्ति यत् । उभे संध्ये ह्युपासीना गृणन्तः सामऋग्यजुः
verses.transliteration: atītānāgataṃ rudraṃ viprā hyāpyāyayanti yat / ubhe saṃdhye hyupāsīnā gṛṇantaḥ sāmaṛgyajuḥ
verses.translation: Since the living beings are bom (bhavanat) of him, and since he evolves (bhavanat) the living beings through them (i.c. the waters) he is called Bhava* (due to his creation and evolution of beings).
verses.wordMeaning: Since the living beings are bom (bhavanat) of him, and since he evolves (bhavanat) the living beings through them (i.c. the waters) he is called Bhava* (due to his creation and evolution of beings).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the living beings are bom (bhavanat) of him, and since he evolves (bhavanat) the living beings through them (i.c. the waters) he is called Bhava* (due to his creation and evolution of beings).

verses.sanskrit: उद्यन्स तिष्ठते ऋक्षु मध्याह्ने च यजुःष्वथ । सामस्वथापराह्णे तु रुद्रः संविशति क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: udyansa tiṣṭhate ṛkṣu madhyāhne ca yajuḥṣvatha / sāmasvathāparāhṇe tu rudraḥ saṃviśati kramāt
verses.translation: This Puranic peculation turned out to be a scientific truth.
verses.wordMeaning: This Puranic peculation turned out to be a scientific truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Puranic peculation turned out to be a scientific truth.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्भवेन्नाभ्युदितो बाह्यस्तमित एव च । न रुद्रम्प्रति मेहेत सर्वावस्थं कथं चन
verses.transliteration: tasmādbhavennābhyudito bāhyastamita eva ca / na rudramprati meheta sarvāvasthaṃ kathaṃ cana
verses.translation: Nor should one enumerate (?) these whether flowing or still. These bodies of the waters are declared by the sages %Medhya (Pure) and Amedhya (Impure).
verses.wordMeaning: Nor should one enumerate (?) these whether flowing or still. These bodies of the waters are declared by the sages %Medhya (Pure) and Amedhya (Impure).
verses.commentary: Sense: Nor should one enumerate (?) these whether flowing or still. These bodies of the waters are declared by the sages %Medhya (Pure) and Amedhya (Impure).

verses.sanskrit: एवं युक्तान् द्विजान् देवो रुद्रस्तान्न हिनस्ति वै । ततो ऽप्रवीत्पुनर्ब्रह्मा तं देवं नीललोहितम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yuktān dvijān devo rudrastānna hinasti vai / tato 'pravītpunarbrahmā taṃ devaṃ nīlalohitam
verses.translation: Waters devoid of taste, waters of bad odour and colour and water in very little quantity should be avoided on all occasions. The sea is the source of origin of waters. Hence waters desire it.
verses.wordMeaning: Waters devoid of taste, waters of bad odour and colour and water in very little quantity should be avoided on all occasions. The sea is the source of origin of waters. Hence waters desire it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Waters devoid of taste, waters of bad odour and colour and water in very little quantity should be avoided on all occasions. The sea is the source of origin of waters. Hence waters desire it.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं नामधेयं ते मया प्रोक्तं भवेति यत् । एतस्यापो द्वितीया ते तनुर्नाम्ना भवत्विति
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ nāmadheyaṃ te mayā proktaṃ bhaveti yat / etasyāpo dvitīyā te tanurnāmnā bhavatviti
verses.translation: After reaching the sea, the waters become sacred and Amrta (nectarine). Hence one should not obstruct the
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the sea, the waters become sacred and Amrta (nectarine). Hence one should not obstruct the
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the sea, the waters become sacred and Amrta (nectarine). Hence one should not obstruct the

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते त्वथ तस्यासीच्छरीरस्थं रसात्मकम् । विवेश तत्तदा यस्तु तस्मादापो भवः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ityukte tvatha tasyāsīccharīrasthaṃ rasātmakam / viveśa tattadā yastu tasmādāpo bhavaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: lord, the third name of yours that had been luentioned by me is Sarva. It this earth be tlie physical body of that third name.
verses.hindi: उस समय में उस काल से भावित होते हुए नानात्व से अभि संबध्य होते हैं। अबुद्धि पूर्वक शबन करते हुए जोसे ही निश्चित'बोश्र होता' है ॥ ।११३।-उस काल से भाषित होने पर उनको उस प्रकार का ज्ञान वृत्त होता है । उन भेदों के प्रत्याहारों से ही होता, शुष्मियों का नहीं होताहै
verses.wordMeaning: lord, the third name of yours that had been luentioned by me is Sarva. It this earth be tlie physical body of that third name.
verses.commentary: Sense: lord, the third name of yours that had been luentioned by me is Sarva. It this earth be tlie physical body of that third name.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्भवन्ति भूतानि ताभ्यस्ता भावयन्ति च । भवनाद्रावनाच्चैव भूतानामुच्यते भवः
verses.transliteration: yasmādbhavanti bhūtāni tābhyastā bhāvayanti ca / bhavanādrāvanāccaiva bhūtānāmucyate bhavaḥ
verses.translation: On this being mentioned, the hard and firm (part) in his body, namely bones entered the earth. Therefore, it is called Sarva.
verses.hindi: और उनके साथही कार्म तथा कारण परृत्त हुआ करते- हैं। नानात्व के दर्शी ब्रह्मलोक के निवासी उनका जो अपने धर्म से: विशेष रूप से'निदृत्त विकारों वाले हैं और स्थित हैं तुल्य लक्षण वाले सिद्ध-शुभात्मा और
verses.wordMeaning: On this being mentioned, the hard and firm (part) in his body, namely bones entered the earth. Therefore, it is called Sarva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On this being mentioned, the hard and firm (part) in his body, namely bones entered the earth. Therefore, it is called Sarva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मूत्रं पुरीषं च नाप्सु कुर्वीत कर्हिचित् । न निष्ठीवेन्नावगाहेन्नैव गच्छेच्च मैथुनम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca nāpsu kurvīta karhicit / na niṣṭhīvennāvagāhennaiva gacchecca maithunam
verses.translation: Hence, one should not evacuate the bowels or uri« nate in the ploughed land. One.should not urinate in the shade of trees, or in the pathway or in one's own shadow.
verses.hindi: ६ ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण तिरञ्जन हैं ।१५-११६॥ प्राक्त सर्ग में कारणों से उपेत हैं और अपनी आत्मा में ही व्यवस्थित है । और आत्मा को प्रख्यापित करके तत्व से यह् अकति है ।११७ पुरुषान्य से यह प्रतीत प्रवृत्त नहीं होती है। फिर उन
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should not evacuate the bowels or uri« nate in the ploughed land. One.should not urinate in the shade of trees, or in the pathway or in one's own shadow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should not evacuate the bowels or uri« nate in the ploughed land. One.should not urinate in the shade of trees, or in the pathway or in one's own shadow.

verses.sanskrit: न चैताः परिचक्षीत वहन्त्यो वा स्थिता अपि । मैध्यामेध्यास्त्वपामेतास्तनवो मुनिभिः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: na caitāḥ paricakṣīta vahantyo vā sthitā api / maidhyāmedhyāstvapāmetāstanavo munibhiḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: After covering the ground with grass and covering one's head, one should evacute the bowels. Sarva docs not oppress or injure him who behaves like this towards tlic earth.
verses.hindi: साकारणात्माओं का सर्ग प्रवृत्त होता है।११०। युक्त तत्व दशियों' का संयोग प्रकृति जातनी चाहिए । अपुनर्भारगामी उनको वह् उपवर्गिणी है ।११९।.
verses.wordMeaning: After covering the ground with grass and covering one's head, one should evacute the bowels. Sarva docs not oppress or injure him who behaves like this towards tlic earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After covering the ground with grass and covering one's head, one should evacute the bowels. Sarva docs not oppress or injure him who behaves like this towards tlic earth.

verses.sanskrit: विवर्णरसगन्धाश्च वर्ज्या अल्पाश्च सर्वशः । अपां योनिः समुद्रस्तु तस्मात्तं कामयन्ति ताः
verses.transliteration: vivarṇarasagandhāśca varjyā alpāśca sarvaśaḥ / apāṃ yoniḥ samudrastu tasmāttaṃ kāmayanti tāḥ
verses.translation: Lord Maheiana docs not oppress or injure him who properly behaves towards the wind and those who honour 4he wind by means of YajAas and those who serve it*
verses.hindi: ततस्तेषु गतेष् द्ध बं तलोक्यात्त, मुदात्मसु
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Maheiana docs not oppress or injure him who properly behaves towards the wind and those who honour 4he wind by means of YajAas and those who serve it*
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Maheiana docs not oppress or injure him who properly behaves towards the wind and those who honour 4he wind by means of YajAas and those who serve it*

verses.sanskrit: मध्याश्चैवामृता ह्यापो भवन्ति प्राप्य सागरम् । तस्मादपो न रुन्धीत समुद्रं कामयन्ति ताः

verses.hindi: है । इसका अवण करके कापेय के मन में बहुत हो संदर्ण हुआ था किन्तु उसके मन में संशय भी होता है।६॥ उन्होंने दाणी के द्वारा सूतजो की

verses.transliteration: bhavasya yā dvitīyā tu āpo nāmnā tanuḥ smṛtā / tasyā dhātrī smṛtā patnī putraśca uśanā smṛtaḥ

verses.transliteration: śarvasya yā tṛtīyasya nāmno bhūmistanuḥ smṛtā / tasyāḥ patnī vikeśī tu putro 'syāṅgārakaḥ smṛtaḥ

verses.hindi: आराधना की थी और उसका अर्थ तथा दूसरी कया को अवण करने की इच्छा को थो। आज से लेकर कल्पज् प्रति सन्धि कहा जातां है।२। वीत इए करूप का ओर वर्तमान कल्प को इन दोनों का अन्तर और जहाँ पर जनं दोनों की प्रतिसम्धि हैं । यह मैं जानना चाहता हूँ क्योंकि आप ठीके

verses.sanskrit: ईशानस्य चतुर्थस्य नाम्ना वातस्तनुस्तु या । तस्याः पत्नी शिवा नाम पुत्रश्चास्या मनोजवः
verses.transliteration: īśānasya caturthasya nāmnā vātastanustu yā / tasyāḥ patnī śivā nāma putraścāsyā manojavaḥ

verses.hindi: प्रकार से यह बताने के लिए परम कुशल हैं।३। कापेय के द्वारा इंस प्रकार से पूछे जाने पर प्रवचन करने वालों में श्र ष्ठ सूतजी ने यहं सम्पूण ही करने को उपक्रम किया था ।४। भो सूतजो ने कहा था-है सुन्दर ब्रतों वालो ! इस विषय में जो कुछ भी हैं वह सभी यथार्थ रूप से वर्णन करूंगा । कल्प

verses.transliteration: avijñātagatiścaiva dvau putrau cānilasya tu / nāmnā paśupateryā tu tanuragnirdvijaiḥ smṛtā

verses.hindi: जो हो गये हैं और आगे होने बाले हैं तथा इन दोनों की जो प्रति सन्धिं है- इसको भी बताऊगा ।५। इन कल्पो' में जो-जो भी मन्वन्तर है और जो यह् कल्प ब्तीमान है वहं इस समय कल्प परम शुभ वाराह हैं।६ं। इस कल्प से पूर्ग में होने वाला जो कल्प था जो कि सनातन ब्यतीत हो गया है उसकी

verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ patnī smṛtā svāhā skandastasyāḥ sutaḥ smṛtaḥ / nāmnā ṣaṣṭhasya yā bhīmā tanurākāśamucyate

verses.transliteration: dīkṣā patnī smṛtā tasyāḥ saṃtānaḥ putra ucyate / nāmnāṣṭamasya mahastanuryā candramāḥ smṛtaḥ

verses.sanskrit: तासु वन्द्यो नमस्यश्च प्रतिनामतनूषु वै । सूर्येप्सूर्व्यां तथा वायावग्नौ व्योम्न्यथ दीक्षिते

verses.wordMeaning: Understand that, Sambhuti, the wife of Marici the Prajapati, gave birth to ilie son Purama and the following <laughters:
