verses.sanskrit: बलस्य तेजः पुत्रस्तु उन्मादस्य तु संशयः । तस्यान्ये मानसाः पुत्रा आसन् व्योमविचारिणः
verses.transliteration: balasya tejaḥ putrastu unmādasya tu saṃśayaḥ / tasyānye mānasāḥ putrā āsan vyomavicāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Krri, Vr9ti, Tvifli and the splendid Upaciti. Purna* masa begot of SarasvaU two sons:
verses.hindi: एकँकस्मिस्तू कल्पे वे देवा वैमानिकाः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Krri, Vr9ti, Tvifli and the splendid Upaciti. Purna* masa begot of SarasvaU two sons:
verses.commentary: Sense: Krri, Vr9ti, Tvifli and the splendid Upaciti. Purna* masa begot of SarasvaU two sons:

verses.sanskrit: ये वहन्ति विमानानि देवानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् । मेरुकल्पे स्मृते भार्ये विधातुर्धातुरेव च
verses.transliteration: ye vahanti vimānāni devānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām / merukalpe smṛte bhārye vidhāturdhātureva ca
verses.translation: Sudhaman, the son ofViraja and Gauri, resorted to the Eastern quarter. He was a valorous and noble-souled guar¬ dian of the quarter, (ruler of the world).
verses.wordMeaning: Sudhaman, the son ofViraja and Gauri, resorted to the Eastern quarter. He was a valorous and noble-souled guar¬ dian of the quarter, (ruler of the world).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sudhaman, the son ofViraja and Gauri, resorted to the Eastern quarter. He was a valorous and noble-souled guar¬ dian of the quarter, (ruler of the world).

verses.sanskrit: आयतिर्नियतिश्चैव तयोः पुत्रौ दृढव्रतौ । प्राणश्चैव मृकण्डश्च ब्रह्मकोशौ सनातनौ
verses.transliteration: āyatirniyatiścaiva tayoḥ putrau dṛḍhavratau / prāṇaścaiva mṛkaṇḍaśca brahmakośau sanātanau
verses.translation: Sadvati gave birth to Parjanya the son of Agni (i.e. Bharatagni). (Another) Parjanya (otherwise called) Hir* anyaroman was born of Marici.
verses.wordMeaning: Sadvati gave birth to Parjanya the son of Agni (i.e. Bharatagni). (Another) Parjanya (otherwise called) Hir* anyaroman was born of Marici.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sadvati gave birth to Parjanya the son of Agni (i.e. Bharatagni). (Another) Parjanya (otherwise called) Hir* anyaroman was born of Marici.

verses.sanskrit: मनस्विन्यां मृकण्डस्य मार्कण्डेयो बभूव ह । सुतो वेदशिरास्तस्य धूम्रपत्न्यामजायत
verses.transliteration: manasvinyāṃ mṛkaṇḍasya mārkaṇḍeyo babhūva ha / suto vedaśirāstasya dhūmrapatnyāmajāyata
verses.translation: The sons and grandsons of those noble-souled Atreyas were hundreds and thousands. They all passed away in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: The sons and grandsons of those noble-souled Atreyas were hundreds and thousands. They all passed away in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons and grandsons of those noble-souled Atreyas were hundreds and thousands. They all passed away in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: पीवर्यां वेदशिरसः पुत्रा वशकराः स्मृताः । मार्कण्डेयाः समाख्याता ऋषयो वेदपारगाः
verses.transliteration: pīvaryāṃ vedaśirasaḥ putrā vaśakarāḥ smṛtāḥ / mārkaṇḍeyāḥ samākhyātā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ
verses.translation: Kama gave birth to the sons of Pulaha*, the Praja** pati. All of them had the brilliance of the three sacrificial fires. Their fame is wcH-established.
verses.hindi: किर इस कल्प से पूर्ण में होने वाला अतीत 'पुरातन कल्प है जो
verses.wordMeaning: Kama gave birth to the sons of Pulaha*, the Praja** pati. All of them had the brilliance of the three sacrificial fires. Their fame is wcH-established.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kama gave birth to the sons of Pulaha*, the Praja** pati. All of them had the brilliance of the three sacrificial fires. Their fame is wcH-established.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणस्य पुण्डरीकायां द्युतिमानात्मजो ऽभवत् । उन्नतश्चद्युतिमतः स्वनवातश्च तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: prāṇasya puṇḍarīkāyāṃ dyutimānātmajo 'bhavat / unnataścadyutimataḥ svanavātaśca tāvubhau
verses.translation: They were three viz. Kardama, Urvarivan and Sahi$tu. Sage Kanakapitha (also was his son). There was a beautiful daughter named PIvari.
verses.hindi: पहिले एक जहसू चारों युगों की चोकड़ी के अन्त में मन्वन्तरों के साथ हैं। ।१४॥ फिर उस कल्प के क्षीण हो जाने पर और दाह काल के उपस्थित होता है । उस समय में तब जो गैमानिक देव हैं वे थे।१६। वे नक्षत्र-ग्रह और नारायण तथा चन्द्र सूर्य आदिक हैं । वे सब अद्ठाईस हैं । सुकृतात्माओं
verses.wordMeaning: They were three viz. Kardama, Urvarivan and Sahi$tu. Sage Kanakapitha (also was his son). There was a beautiful daughter named PIvari.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were three viz. Kardama, Urvarivan and Sahi$tu. Sage Kanakapitha (also was his son). There was a beautiful daughter named PIvari.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च भार्गवाणां परस्परात् । स्वायंभुवेन्तरे ऽतीता मरीचेः शृणुत प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ putrāśca pautrāśca bhārgavāṇāṃ parasparāt / svāyaṃbhuventare 'tītā marīceḥ śṛṇuta prajāḥ
verses.translation: Karoya bore to Priyavrata ten sons on a par with the Sv&yambhuva Manu and two daughten. It is through these that the Ksatrlya race spread.
verses.hindi: की करोड़ों की संख्या है अर्थात् जिन्होंने सुकृत् किया है उन्हीं की करोड़ों संक्ष्या है ।१७। जिस प्रकार से एक मन्वन्तर में तथा चौदहों में वे तीन करोड़ थे तथा बानवे करोड़ ये ।१८। इसके अनन्तर अर्थात् विमानों में रहने वाले देवगण कहे ग्रये हैं ।१६। इसके अनन्तर आकाश में दिवलोक में चौदह मन्व-
verses.wordMeaning: Karoya bore to Priyavrata ten sons on a par with the Sv&yambhuva Manu and two daughten. It is through these that the Ksatrlya race spread.
verses.commentary: Sense: Karoya bore to Priyavrata ten sons on a par with the Sv&yambhuva Manu and two daughten. It is through these that the Ksatrlya race spread.

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी मरीचेः संभूतिर्विजज्ञे ह्यात्मसंभंवम् । प्रजापतेः पूर्णमासं कन्याश्चेमा निबोधत
verses.transliteration: patnī marīceḥ saṃbhūtirvijajñe hyātmasaṃbhaṃvam / prajāpateḥ pūrṇamāsaṃ kanyāścemā nibodhata
verses.translation: Yaiodhara, the lady of beautiful waist, gave birth to Sahinu* he son of Kanakapicha. (She gave birth] to Kama* deva (also).
verses.hindi: न्तरों में थे । उनमें देवगण-पिठृगण-ऋषिगण तयां ज के पान करने बाले थे ।२०। उनके अनुचर हैं, उनकी पत्नियाँ हैं और उनके पुत्र भी होते हैं। उस काल में आकाण में सुरगण वर्णों और आश्नमों से अतिरिक्त थे। ।२१। उस काल में वस्तुओं से परिपूर्ण प्राप्न होने पर उन-उन सायुज्य में
verses.wordMeaning: Yaiodhara, the lady of beautiful waist, gave birth to Sahinu* he son of Kanakapicha. (She gave birth] to Kama* deva (also).
verses.commentary: Sense: Yaiodhara, the lady of beautiful waist, gave birth to Sahinu* he son of Kanakapicha. (She gave birth] to Kama* deva (also).

verses.sanskrit: कृषिर्वृष्टिस्त्विषा चैव तथा चोपचितिः शुभा । पूर्णमासः सरस्वत्यां पुत्रौ द्वावुदपादयत्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣirvṛṣṭistviṣā caiva tathā copacitiḥ śubhā / pūrṇamāsaḥ sarasvatyāṃ putrau dvāvudapādayat
verses.translation: Sannati bore auspicious sons to Kratu. They were equal to Kratu. They had neither wives nor sons. All of them were celibate.
verses.hindi: गमन करने वालों के साथ में ये । आभूत सप्लव अर्थात् महा ' प्रलय के प्राप्त होने पर वे तुल्य निष्ठा वाले हुए ये
verses.wordMeaning: Sannati bore auspicious sons to Kratu. They were equal to Kratu. They had neither wives nor sons. All of them were celibate.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sannati bore auspicious sons to Kratu. They were equal to Kratu. They had neither wives nor sons. All of them were celibate.

verses.sanskrit: विरजं चैव धर्मिष्ठं पर्वशं चैव तावुभौ । विरजस्यात्मजो विद्वान् सुधामा नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: virajaṃ caiva dharmiṣṭhaṃ parvaśaṃ caiva tāvubhau / virajasyātmajo vidvān sudhāmā nāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: They were well known as V&lakhilyas and are sixty thousand in number. They surround the sun and go ahead in front of Aruna.
verses.wordMeaning: They were well known as V&lakhilyas and are sixty thousand in number. They surround the sun and go ahead in front of Aruna.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were well known as V&lakhilyas and are sixty thousand in number. They surround the sun and go ahead in front of Aruna.

verses.sanskrit: सुधामा स तु वैराजः प्राचीं दिशमुपा श्रितः । लोकपालः स धर्मात्मा गौरीपुत्रः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: sudhāmā sa tu vairājaḥ prācīṃ diśamupā śritaḥ / lokapālaḥ sa dharmātmā gaurīputraḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: All of them are (perpetual) associates of the Sun till the time of ultimate annihilation (of the universe). They bad two younger sisters, PuQyk and Satyavatl. They were the daughters-in-law of Parvaia, the son ofPuroamasa.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them are (perpetual) associates of the Sun till the time of ultimate annihilation (of the universe). They bad two younger sisters, PuQyk and Satyavatl. They were the daughters-in-law of Parvaia, the son ofPuroamasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them are (perpetual) associates of the Sun till the time of ultimate annihilation (of the universe). They bad two younger sisters, PuQyk and Satyavatl. They were the daughters-in-law of Parvaia, the son ofPuroamasa.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वशः पर्वगणनां प्रविष्टः स महायशाः । पर्वशः पर्वशायां तु जनया मास वै सुतौ
verses.transliteration: parvaśaḥ parvagaṇanāṃ praviṣṭaḥ sa mahāyaśāḥ / parvaśaḥ parvaśāyāṃ tu janayā māsa vai sutau
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: यजुर्धाम च धीमन्तं स्तंभकाश्यपमेव च । तयोर्गोत्रकरौ पुत्रौ जातौ संन्यासनिश्चितौ
verses.transliteration: yajurdhāma ca dhīmantaṃ staṃbhakāśyapameva ca / tayorgotrakarau putrau jātau saṃnyāsaniścitau
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतस्त्वं गिरसः पत्नी जज्ञे सा ह्यात्मसंभवान् । पुत्रो कन्याश्चतस्रश्च पुण्यास्ता लोकविश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: smṛtastvaṃ girasaḥ patnī jajñe sā hyātmasaṃbhavān / putro kanyāścatasraśca puṇyāstā lokaviśrutāḥ
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: सिनीवाली कुहूश्चैव राका चानुमतिस्तथा । तथैव भरताग्निं च कीर्तिमन्तं च तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: sinīvālī kuhūścaiva rākā cānumatistathā / tathaiva bharatāgniṃ ca kīrtimantaṃ ca tāvubhau
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेः पुत्रं च पर्जन्यं सद्वती सुषुवे तथा । हिरण्यरोमा पर्जन्यो मारीच्यामुदपद्यत
verses.transliteration: agneḥ putraṃ ca parjanyaṃ sadvatī suṣuve tathā / hiraṇyaromā parjanyo mārīcyāmudapadyata
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: आभूतसंप्लवस्थायी लोकपालः स वै स्मृतः । यज्ञे कीर्त्तिमतश्चापि धेनुका वीतकल्मषौ
verses.transliteration: ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī lokapālaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ / yajñe kīrttimataścāpi dhenukā vītakalmaṣau
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: चरिष्णुं धृतिमन्तं च उभावङ्गिरसां वरौ । तयोः पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च अतीता वै सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: cariṣṇuṃ dhṛtimantaṃ ca ubhāvaṅgirasāṃ varau / tayoḥ putrāśca pautrāśca atītā vai sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: अनसूया विजज्ञे वै पञ्चात्रेयानकल्मषान् । कन्यां चैव श्रुतिं नाम माता शङ्खपदस्य सा
verses.transliteration: anasūyā vijajñe vai pañcātreyānakalmaṣān / kanyāṃ caiva śrutiṃ nāma mātā śaṅkhapadasya sā
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त वे तान के अभिमानी देवगण जो त्रॅलोक्य के निवासी चे यहाँ पर आत्मा की बुद्धि के अवश्य भावी होने से ये ।२३। उस काल में
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: कर्दसस्य तु पत्नी सा पौलहस्य प्रजापतेः । सत्यनेत्रश्च हव्यश्च आपो मूर्त्तिः शनैश्चरः
verses.transliteration: kardasasya tu patnī sā paulahasya prajāpateḥ / satyanetraśca havyaśca āpo mūrttiḥ śanaiścaraḥ
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: स्थिति का समय पूर्ण हो चुका था ओर पश्चिमोत्तर में आसन्न था। जो देव कल्प में अवसान प्राप्त होने वाले थे वे उस उपप्लव को प्राह हुआ देखने वाले थे.।२४। उस अवसर में उत्सुक हुए और विषाद से भागों में स्थानों को ब्यक्त करके फिर उन्होंने सबिम्न होते हुए अयन भाग महर्लोक के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: सोमश्च पञ्चमस्तेषामासीत्स्वायंभुवेन्तरे । यामदेवैस्सहातीताः पञ्चात्रेयाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: somaśca pañcamasteṣāmāsītsvāyaṃbhuventare / yāmadevaissahātītāḥ pañcātreyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: बनाया. था ।२५। वे युक्तों को उपपन्न होते हैं और शरीर में महती को '्राप्न होते हैं बे सब प्रचर.विशुद्धि, से समन्वित थे तथा मानसी सिद्धि में समा- स्थित. हुए थे ।२६। उस समय में उन कल्पवासियों के साथ सहान आसादित हुआ था.। उनके साथ में गमन करने वाले ब्राह्मण--क्षत्रिय--वेश्य और
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च आत्रेयाणां महात्मनाम् । स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे ऽतीताः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca ātreyāṇāṃ mahātmanām / svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare 'tītāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: अप्ररजन भी थे । बे चोदह देवों के संघ महलोंक में प्राप्त हो गये थे । फ़िर उस महलोंक से गमन करके बड़े उद्वंग के सहित उन्होंने अपना मन जन लोक में जाने के लिए किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यभार्यायां दाना ग्निस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । पूर्वजन्मनि सो ऽगस्त्यः स्मृतः स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: prītyāṃ pulastyabhāryāyāṃ dānā gnistatsuto 'bhavat / pūrvajanmani so 'gastyaḥ smṛtaḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यमो देवबाहुश्च अत्रिनामा च ते त्रयः । स्वमा यवीयसी तेषां सद्वती नाम विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: madhyamo devabāhuśca atrināmā ca te trayaḥ / svamā yavīyasī teṣāṃ sadvatī nāma viśrutā
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: पर्जन्यजननी शुभ्रा पत्नी चाग्नेः स्मृता शुभा । पौलस्त्यस्य च ब्रह्मर्षेः प्रीतिपुत्रस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: parjanyajananī śubhrā patnī cāgneḥ smṛtā śubhā / paulastyasya ca brahmarṣeḥ prītiputrasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: भवंति ब्रह्माणा तुल्या रूपेण विषयेण च ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: दानाच्च सुषुवे पत्नी सुजङ्घी चं बहून्सुतान् । पौलस्त्या इति विख्याताः स्मृताः स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: dānācca suṣuve patnī sujaṅghī caṃ bahūnsutān / paulastyā iti vikhyātāḥ smṛtāḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: आनंदं ब्रह्मणः श्राप्य मुच्यन्त ब्रह्मणा सह
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा तु सुषुवे पुत्रान्पुलस्त्यस्य प्रजापतेः । त्रेताग्निवर्चसः सर्वे येषां कीर्त्तिः प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: kṣamā tu suṣuve putrānpulastyasya prajāpateḥ / tretāgnivarcasaḥ sarve yeṣāṃ kīrttiḥ pratiṣṭhitā
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: कर्दमश्चोर्वरीवांश्च सहिष्णुश्चेति ते त्रयः । ऋषिः कनकपीठश्च शुभा कन्या च पीवरी
verses.transliteration: kardamaścorvarīvāṃśca sahiṣṇuśceti te trayaḥ / ṛṣiḥ kanakapīṭhaśca śubhā kanyā ca pīvarī
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: कर्दमस्य श्रुतिः पत्नी आत्रेय्यजनयत्स्वयम् । पुत्रं शङ्खपदं नाम कन्यां काम्यां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kardamasya śrutiḥ patnī ātreyyajanayatsvayam / putraṃ śaṅkhapadaṃ nāma kanyāṃ kāmyāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: इसी क्रम के योग से वे कल्पवासी चले गये ये । इस प्रकार से सहस्रों ही देवों के युग थे ।२६। सभी विशुद्धि को प्रचुरता वाले ये और अतएव वे सब मातसो सिद्धि में समास्थित ये। उतने कल्प वासियों के साथ जनलोः
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: स वै शङ्खपदः श्रीमांल्लोकपालः प्रजापतिः । दक्षिणस्यां दिशि रतः काम्या दत्ता प्रियव्रते
verses.transliteration: sa vai śaṅkhapadaḥ śrīmāṃllokapālaḥ prajāpatiḥ / dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi rataḥ kāmyā dattā priyavrate
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: काम्या प्रियव्रताल्लेभे स्वायंभुवसमान्सुतान् । दश कन्याद्वयं चैव यैः क्षत्रं सम्प्रवर्त्तितम्
verses.transliteration: kāmyā priyavratāllebhe svāyaṃbhuvasamānsutān / daśa kanyādvayaṃ caiva yaiḥ kṣatraṃ sampravarttitam
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: को प्राप्त किया था ।३०। वहां जनलोक में दश कल्यों तक स्थित होकर फिर सत्य लोक को चले जाते हैं । वे ब्रह्मलोक को भ्राहन करके अपरावत्तिनी गति को प्राम हो जाते हैं ।३१। वे विमान में आधिपत्य पाकर ऐश्वर्य से उनके ही समान हो जाया करते हैं। फिर वे ब्रह्माजी के ही तुल्य हो जाया करते
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं कनकपीठस्य सहिष्णुं नाम विश्रुतम् । यशोधरा विजज्ञे वै कामदेवं सुमध्यामा
verses.transliteration: putraṃ kanakapīṭhasya sahiṣṇuṃ nāma viśrutam / yaśodharā vijajñe vai kāmadevaṃ sumadhyāmā
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: है और रूप तथा विषय के द्वारा ब्रह्मा के समान हूँ।३२। वहाँ पर वे प्रीति से युक्त होते हुए संयमों को अवस्थित हुआ करते है। वहाँ पर ब्रहमा का आनन्द प्राप्त करवे ब्रह्माजी के ही साथ मुक्ति को प्राप्त हो जाया करते हैँ ।३३। प्राकृत अवश्य भावी अर्थ से वे स्वयं उस समय में उसका से भावित
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: क्रतोः क्रतुसमान्पु त्रान् विजज्ञे संनतिः शुभान् । तेषां न भार्या पुत्रो वा सर्वे ते उर्द्धरेतसः
verses.transliteration: kratoḥ kratusamānpu trān vijajñe saṃnatiḥ śubhān / teṣāṃ na bhāryā putro vā sarve te urddharetasaḥ
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: होते हुए सम्मान और अचेन आदि के द्वारा सम्बद्ध होते हैं ।३४। जिस प्रकार से बुद्धिपूवंक र्यपन करते हुए बोध होता है उसी भांति सेवा के भावित होने पर जैसा ही आनन्द प्रबृत्त होता हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: तानि षष्टिसहस्राणि वालखिल्या इति श्रुताः । अरुणस्याग्रतो यान्ति परिवार्य दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: tāni ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi vālakhilyā iti śrutāḥ / aruṇasyāgrato yānti parivārya divākaram
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.hindi: तैः साद्धं वदधते तेषां कार्याणि करणानि च॥
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: आभूतसंप्लवात्सर्वेपतङ्गसहचारिणः । स्वसारौ तद्यवीयस्यौ पुण्या सत्यवती चते
verses.transliteration: ābhūtasaṃplavātsarvepataṅgasahacāriṇaḥ / svasārau tadyavīyasyau puṇyā satyavatī cate
verses.translation: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Her younger brothers, the seven sons of Vasitha arc well known. They arc—Raka, Garta, Crdhvabahu, Savana, Pavana, Siuapas and Sanku. All of them are remembered as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वशस्य स्नुवे ते वै पूर्णमास सुतस्य तु । ऊर्जायां तु वसिष्ठस्य वासिष्ठाः सप्त जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: parvaśasya snuve te vai pūrṇamāsa sutasya tu / ūrjāyāṃ tu vasiṣṭhasya vāsiṣṭhāḥ sapta jajñire

verses.sanskrit: ज्यायसी च सुता तेषां पुण्डरीका सुमध्यमा । जननी सा द्युतिमतः प्राणस्य महिषी प्रियाः
verses.transliteration: jyāyasī ca sutā teṣāṃ puṇḍarīkā sumadhyamā / jananī sā dyutimataḥ prāṇasya mahiṣī priyāḥ

verses.transliteration: vistareṇānupūrvyācca agnervakṣyāmyataḥ param / iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde ṛṣisargavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca yo 'sāvagne rabhimānī smṛtaḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putrastasmātsvāhā vyajāyata
verses.translation: A mental son of Brahma is remembered as the deity identifying itself with fire in the Svayambhuva Manvan- I shall mention their divisions separately along with their names. The secular fire is well known as the first son of Brahma.
verses.hindi: रहने वाले हैं ।३७। वे समान लक्षणों वाले सिद्ध हैं शुद्ध आत्माओं वाले तथा निरञ्जन हैं । प्राकृत में वे करणों से उपेत हैं और अपनो आत्मा में ही व्यवस्थित हैं ।३८। और आत्मा को श्रख्यापित करके तात्विक रूप से यह प्रकृति अन्य पुरुषों के. बहुत्व होने से प्रतीत होतो हुई प्रवृत्त होती है
verses.wordMeaning: A mental son of Brahma is remembered as the deity identifying itself with fire in the Svayambhuva Manvan- I shall mention their divisions separately along with their names. The secular fire is well known as the first son of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mental son of Brahma is remembered as the deity identifying itself with fire in the Svayambhuva Manvan- I shall mention their divisions separately along with their names. The secular fire is well known as the first son of Brahma.

verses.translation: Thus the sons of Pavaka fire have been described here. Thereafter b the solai fire Suci. It is called Ayus by the Gandharvas. This fire generates other fires on being churned in the Arai; this fire b taken from one place to another; this lord is known by the name Ayus.

verses.translation: In the Manvamara of Svayambliuva in the first Sarga (creation), these fires that 9,rc Abhimdnins (those that identify themselves) had passed away along with the Yimas, the excellent Devas. verses.translation: These fires were stationed in the holy rites and Yajftas. They had passed away in the previous Manvantara along with chose Sukras and Yagas (?) In the Manvantara of the first Manu, they had passed away along with the holy noble-souled Devas. Thua the abodes of these Stkins (those that identify themselves with the abodes) have been enumerated by me.

verses.translation: The characteristics of jatavedas (fires) in the Man van taras of the past and future are enumerated through them. All of them are remembered as ascetics and Brahma- bhfts (those that sustain the knowledge of Brahman). All of them were lords of subjects. They are remembered as Luminous.
verses.hindi: त्वेत दरध होते हैं।४६। पहिले वृष्टि के अभाव से सभी शुष्क हो जाते हैं और सरसता नाम मात्र को भी कहीं पर नहीं रहती है । इसके पश्चात् बे सब उक्त सूयो से जो अतीव प्रखर हैं प्रधूषित होते हैं। उस काल से सभी विवश होकर निर्देगध हों जाते हैं और सूयों की किरण से जल भुन जाया

verses.translation: The present fires exist along with the current Yama Devas. The future fires (lit. those that have not yet come) shall exist along with the future Devas. Thus the* group of fires has been duly described in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: विधीयन्ते यथास्थानं सौत्ये ऽह्नि सवने क्रमात् । होत्रीयस्तु स्मृते ह्यग्निर्वह्निर्यो हव्यवाहनः
verses.transliteration: vidhīyante yathāsthānaṃ sautye 'hni savane kramāt / hotrīyastu smṛte hyagnirvahniryo havyavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, Suta addressed Saihapayani and told the story connected with Dak (along with) the cause of the curse of Tryambaka. Daksa had eight daughters who have already been mentioned by me. The father brought them from their (hus¬ bands' ) houses to his own house and honoured them.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, Suta addressed Saihapayani and told the story connected with Dak (along with) the cause of the curse of Tryambaka. Daksa had eight daughters who have already been mentioned by me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, Suta addressed Saihapayani and told the story connected with Dak (along with) the cause of the curse of Tryambaka. Daksa had eight daughters who have already been mentioned by me.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तो ऽग्निः प्रचेतास्तु द्वितीयश्चात्र नामकः । ततो ऽग्निर्वैश्वदेवस्तु ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: praśānto 'gniḥ pracetāstu dvitīyaścātra nāmakaḥ / tato 'gnirvaiśvadevastu brāhmaṇācchaṃsirucyate
verses.translation: On being told thus, Daksa spoke toher with his eyes turned red:— 'Thesc girls, my daughters, arc more worthy of respect and more excellent than you.
verses.hindi: एतेनाधिष्ठितं हीदं ब्रह्मा स पुरुषः प्रभुः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, Daksa spoke toher with his eyes turned red:— 'Thesc girls, my daughters, arc more worthy of respect and more excellent than you.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, Daksa spoke toher with his eyes turned red:— 'Thesc girls, my daughters, arc more worthy of respect and more excellent than you.

verses.sanskrit: उशिगग्निः कविर्यस्तु पोतो ऽग्निः स विभाव्यते । आवारिरग्निर्वाभारिर्वैष्ठीयः स विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: uśigagniḥ kaviryastu poto 'gniḥ sa vibhāvyate / āvāriragnirvābhārirvaiṣṭhīyaḥ sa vibhāvyate
verses.translation: O Satl, their husbands also are highly respected by me. They are highly proficient in the Vedas, endowed with good power of penance; possessing great Yogic power and very pious. O Sad, all of them are superior to Tryambaka, on account of their good qualities and are more praiseworthy. They are my excellent 8on$-in*law, vie.: Vasisjha, Alri, Pulastya, Angiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Bhrgu and Marici.
verses.wordMeaning: O Satl, their husbands also are highly respected by me. They are highly proficient in the Vedas, endowed with good power of penance; possessing great Yogic power and very pious. O Sad, all of them are superior to Tryambaka,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Satl, their husbands also are highly respected by me. They are highly proficient in the Vedas, endowed with good power of penance; possessing great Yogic power and very pious. O Sad, all of them are superior to Tryambaka,…

verses.sanskrit: अवस्फूर्जो विवस्वांस्तु आस्थांश्चैव स उच्यते । अष्टमः सुध्युरग्निर्योमार्जालीयः स उच्यन्ते
verses.transliteration: avasphūrjo vivasvāṃstu āsthāṃścaiva sa ucyate / aṣṭamaḥ sudhyuragniryomārjālīyaḥ sa ucyante
verses.translation: 'Since you insult me although I am devoid of defects verbally, mentally and physically, O father, 1 am abandoning this body bom of you'*.
verses.hindi: तदा भवति स ब्रह्मा सहसाक्षः सहस्पात् ।
verses.wordMeaning: 'Since you insult me although I am devoid of defects verbally, mentally and physically, O father, 1 am abandoning this body bom of you'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Since you insult me although I am devoid of defects verbally, mentally and physically, O father, 1 am abandoning this body bom of you'*.

verses.sanskrit: धिष्ण्यावाहरणा ह्येते सौत्येह्नीज्यन्त वै द्विजैः । अपां योनिः स्मृतो ऽसौ स ह्यप्सुनामा विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: dhiṣṇyāvāharaṇā hyete sautyehnījyanta vai dvijaiḥ / apāṃ yoniḥ smṛto 'sau sa hyapsunāmā vibhāvyate
verses.translation: Then, being Infuriated and aggrieved on account of that dishonour, goddess Satl bowed down to the self-bom lord and spoke these words. Wherever 1 am bom again with a brilliant body whether lam not born(of a womb)or whether I am bom of a righteous person, I should necessarily attain the status of the virtuous wife of the self-pc»scssed three-eyed lord alone."
verses.wordMeaning: Then, being Infuriated and aggrieved on account of that dishonour, goddess Satl bowed down to the self-bom lord and spoke these words. Wherever 1 am bom again with a brilliant body whether lam not born(of a womb)or whether I am bom of a righteous person,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, being Infuriated and aggrieved on account of that dishonour, goddess Satl bowed down to the self-bom lord and spoke these words. Wherever 1 am bom again with a brilliant body whether lam not born(of a womb)or whether I am bom of a righteous person,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो यः पावको नाम्ना अब्जो यो गर्भ उच्यते । अग्निः सो ऽवभृथे ज्ञेयो वरुणेन सहेज्यते
verses.transliteration: tato yaḥ pāvako nāmnā abjo yo garbha ucyate / agniḥ so 'vabhṛthe jñeyo varuṇena sahejyate
verses.translation: The tridentbearing lord heard about that death of Satl. Sankara came to know about their conversation factually. Hence the lord became angry withDaka and the sages.
verses.wordMeaning: The tridentbearing lord heard about that death of Satl. Sankara came to know about their conversation factually. Hence the lord became angry withDaka and the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tridentbearing lord heard about that death of Satl. Sankara came to know about their conversation factually. Hence the lord became angry withDaka and the sages.

verses.sanskrit: त्दृच्छयस्तत्सुतो ह्यग्निर्जठरे यो नृणां पचन् । मृत्युमाञ् जाठरस्याग्नेर्विद्वानाग्निः सुतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tdṛcchayastatsuto hyagnirjaṭhare yo nṛṇāṃ pacan / mṛtyumāñ jāṭharasyāgnervidvānāgniḥ sutaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: 'Bhurloka is spoken of as the first one among all the worlds. At the behest of Paramesthin (supreme lord), I ahall sustain it always. All the lustrom worlds stand by on being held on to this earth. At his behest, I shall hold them here always.
verses.hindi: एकमात्र अर्णव के होने पर आप शीघ्र नहीं है उससे वे नर हैं । उस
verses.wordMeaning: 'Bhurloka is spoken of as the first one among all the worlds. At the behest of Paramesthin (supreme lord), I ahall sustain it always. All the lustrom worlds stand by on being held on to this earth. At his behest, I shall hold them here always.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Bhurloka is spoken of as the first one among all the worlds. At the behest of Paramesthin (supreme lord), I ahall sustain it always. All the lustrom worlds stand by on being held on to this earth. At his behest, I shall hold them here always.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परोत्थितः सो ऽग्निर्भूतानीह विनिर्दहेत् । पुत्रस्त्वग्नेर्मन्युमतो घोरः संवर्तकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: parasparotthitaḥ so 'gnirbhūtānīha vinirdahet / putrastvagnermanyumato ghoraḥ saṃvartakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that, Dakcuned Rudra once again Since, on account of me you rendered evil to the tages, the Br&hmaas will not worship you along with the Devas in the course of a Yajfia,
verses.hindi: एक सहस्न युगों के अन्त में जबकि ब्रह्माजी का दिन संस्थित होता है ५७ उतने समय में सलिल के स्वरूप-से रजनी के वतंमान होने का अवसर: रहता है'। फिर उस जल मे इस पृथ्वी तल में अग्नि तल में अग्नि बिल्कुल नष्ट हो जाया करती है ।५८। उस समय में ब/यु एकदम प्रशान्त होती है ओर
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that, Dakcuned Rudra once again Since, on account of me you rendered evil to the tages, the Br&hmaas will not worship you along with the Devas in the course of a Yajfia,
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that, Dakcuned Rudra once again Since, on account of me you rendered evil to the tages, the Br&hmaas will not worship you along with the Devas in the course of a Yajfia,

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्नवः स वसति समुद्रे वडवामुखः । समुद्रवासिनः पुत्रः साहरक्षो विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: pibannavaḥ sa vasati samudre vaḍavāmukhaḥ / samudravāsinaḥ putraḥ sāharakṣo vibhāvyate
verses.translation: O ruthless one, after offering the Ahuti unto you in the course of their holy rites, they will touch the holy water again. At the close of the Yuga, they will abandon heaven and will stay here alone". After realisir the lord and deity of Yajflas, Dakfa, the householder, worshipped him with the entire Yajfta along with the other deities.
verses.hindi: सभी ओर घोर अन्धकार रहता है तथा सभी ओर आलोक का अभाव रहता है। यह सब इसके ही द्वारा-अधिछित रहता है ओर ब्रह्माजी ही वह प्रभु पुरुष होते हैं ।५६। फिर उन्होंने इस लोक के विभाग करने की इच्छा की थी जिस समय में सभी जङ्गम ओर स्थावर बिनष्ट होचुके थे और केवल
verses.wordMeaning: O ruthless one, after offering the Ahuti unto you in the course of their holy rites, they will touch the holy water again. At the close of the Yuga, they will abandon heaven and will stay here alone". After realisir the lord and deity of Yajflas, Dakfa, the householder,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O ruthless one, after offering the Ahuti unto you in the course of their holy rites, they will touch the holy water again. At the close of the Yuga, they will abandon heaven and will stay here alone". After realisir the lord and deity of Yajflas, Dakfa, the householder,…

verses.sanskrit: सहरक्षसुतः क्षामो गृहाणां दहते नृणाम् । क्रव्यादग्निः सुतस्तस्य पुरुषानत्ति यो मृतान्
verses.transliteration: saharakṣasutaḥ kṣāmo gṛhāṇāṃ dahate nṛṇām / kravyādagniḥ sutastasya puruṣānatti yo mṛtān
verses.translation: After the advent of the Vaivasvata Manvantara, the lord of mountains begot of Mcni the goddess Uma who had been the noble lady Sat! previously.
verses.hindi: एक ही अर्णव सभी ओर था ।६०। उस अवसर से वे ब्रह्माजी सहस्रों शिरों बाले और सहस्रं पदों बाले होते हैं। वे सहस्रं शिरों वाले पुरुष सुकणे के समान वर्ण बाले थे और सब इन्द्रियों पर विजय प्राप्त करने बाले थे । भग- बालू नारायण के प्रति यहाँ पर इस श्लोक का उदाहरण दिया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After the advent of the Vaivasvata Manvantara, the lord of mountains begot of Mcni the goddess Uma who had been the noble lady Sat! previously.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the advent of the Vaivasvata Manvantara, the lord of mountains begot of Mcni the goddess Uma who had been the noble lady Sat! previously.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते पावकस्याग्नेः पुत्रा एव प्रकीर्त्तिताः । ततः शुचिस्तु वै सौरो गन्धर्वैरायुराहुतः
verses.transliteration: ityete pāvakasyāgneḥ putrā eva prakīrttitāḥ / tataḥ śucistu vai sauro gandharvairāyurāhutaḥ
verses.translation: She who had been the noble lady Sati prcviomly became Uma afterwards. She is the wife of Bhava always. Bhava is never abandoned by her. They return and arc born again and again in the Kalpas along with them.
verses.hindi: आप (जल) जो उसके तनु है--यहू अर्थ सुनते हैं । वहाँ पर वे आपूर्य माण हैं--इसलिए नारायण कहे गये हैं ।६२। सहस्र शीषों से संयुत सुन्दर मन वाले-सहस्न चरणों से युक्त--सहस्र चक्षु. ओर गुखों बाले सहस्र कृत हैं। सहस बाहुओं वाले हैं--ऐसे प्रथम प्रजापति हैं । यह पुरुष श्रयी से परिपूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: She who had been the noble lady Sati prcviomly became Uma afterwards. She is the wife of Bhava always. Bhava is never abandoned by her. They return and arc born again and again in the Kalpas along with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: She who had been the noble lady Sati prcviomly became Uma afterwards. She is the wife of Bhava always. Bhava is never abandoned by her. They return and arc born again and again in the Kalpas along with them.

verses.sanskrit: मथितो यस्त्वरण्यां च सो ऽग्निरग्निं समिन्धति । आयुर्नाम्ना तु भगवानसौ यस्तु प्रणीयते
verses.transliteration: mathito yastvaraṇyāṃ ca so 'gniragniṃ samindhati / āyurnāmnā tu bhagavānasau yastu praṇīyate
verses.translation: This has been heard by us that on account of the curse he was born second time aa king, as the son of M&ris& and the ten Pracetas.
verses.wordMeaning: This has been heard by us that on account of the curse he was born second time aa king, as the son of M&ris& and the ten Pracetas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been heard by us that on account of the curse he was born second time aa king, as the son of M&ris& and the ten Pracetas.

verses.sanskrit: आयुषो महिषः पुत्रः सहसो नाम तत्सुतः । पाकयज्ञेष्वभीमानी सोग्निस्तु सहसः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: āyuṣo mahiṣaḥ putraḥ sahaso nāma tatsutaḥ / pākayajñeṣvabhīmānī sognistu sahasaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus began the story that rids one of sins and that pertains to Daksa. It has been formerly urged for narra¬ tion by you. This story had been recounted in the context of narration of the line of the Pitrs.* Henceforth, I shall recount the Devas in the same order as that of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: आदित्यवर्णो भुवनस्य गोप्ता एको ह्यमूर्तः घ्रथमस्त्वसौ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus began the story that rids one of sins and that pertains to Daksa. It has been formerly urged for narra¬ tion by you. This story had been recounted in the context of narration of the line of the Pitrs.* Henceforth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus began the story that rids one of sins and that pertains to Daksa. It has been formerly urged for narra¬ tion by you. This story had been recounted in the context of narration of the line of the Pitrs.* Henceforth,…

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रश्च सहसस्याग्नेरद्भुतः स महायशाः । विविधिश्चाद्भुतस्यापि पुत्रो ऽग्नेस्तुमाहान्स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: putraśca sahasasyāgneradbhutaḥ sa mahāyaśāḥ / vividhiścādbhutasyāpi putro 'gnestumāhānsmṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, in the beginning of the Treti yuga in the Sviyambhuva Manvantara, there were the Devas well-known as Y&mas and they were the sons of Yajfia.*
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, in the beginning of the Treti yuga in the Sviyambhuva Manvantara, there were the Devas well-known as Y&mas and they were the sons of Yajfia.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, in the beginning of the Treti yuga in the Sviyambhuva Manvantara, there were the Devas well-known as Y&mas and they were the sons of Yajfia.*

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तेष्वभीमानी हुतं भुङ्क्ते हविः सदा । विविधेस्तु सुतो ह्यर्क्क स्तस्य चाग्नेः सुता इमे
verses.transliteration: prāyaścitteṣvabhīmānī hutaṃ bhuṅkte haviḥ sadā / vividhestu suto hyarkka stasya cāgneḥ sutā ime
verses.translation: They weie the well-reputed sons of Brahma. Since they were Ajas (unborn), they are Ajitas (unconquered). These are the mental sons of Svayambhuva. They are named Sakta. Therefore, these arc remembered as the three groups of Devas (? Yama, Ajita and Sakta). The Cchandajas* were thirty-three in the creation of Svayambhuva.
verses.wordMeaning: They weie the well-reputed sons of Brahma. Since they were Ajas (unborn), they are Ajitas (unconquered). These are the mental sons of Svayambhuva. They are named Sakta. Therefore, these arc remembered as the three groups of Devas (? Yama, Ajita and Sakta).…
verses.commentary: Sense: They weie the well-reputed sons of Brahma. Since they were Ajas (unborn), they are Ajitas (unconquered). These are the mental sons of Svayambhuva. They are named Sakta. Therefore, these arc remembered as the three groups of Devas (? Yama, Ajita and Sakta).…

verses.sanskrit: अनीकवान् वाजसृक् च रक्षोहा चष्टिकृत्तथा । सुरभिर्वसुरन्नादो प्रविष्टो यः स रुकमराट्

verses.translation: Bhfgu, Ahgiras, Marici, Fulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri and Vasifha, these seven (?) were in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.

verses.commentary: Sense: Bhfgu, Ahgiras, Marici, Fulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri and Vasifha, these seven (?) were in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.

All these four (i.e. Kila, the sun, the Moon and the wind god) are lords of subjects; they are bom of the flanks (of Brahmi); they are the fathen of all the worlds. verses.commentary: Sense: The three Vedic metres viz.: Giyairi, Trifubh and Jagati arc remembered by the name Tryambakas, Out of love they arc the sources of origin of the vegitablc kingdom.

verses.hindi: सूजन करने बाला है । महादेव व्यक्त है। इसका ही यह सम्पूर्ण जगत है ।७५। वह दोनों कल्पों का प्रति सम्बन्ध कर दिया गया है। इस समय में उनः दोनों के मध्य में पूर्व की अवस्था हुई थी ।७६। पूर्व में होने वाले कल्प में ठीक-ठीक कह दिया गया है। इस समय में इस कल्प के विषय में बंत-
verses.wordMeaning: They were neither superior to him nor inferior. They were his mental sons on a par with himself. He created thousands and thousands of such childern wearing elephant hides.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were neither superior to him nor inferior. They were his mental sons on a par with himself. He created thousands and thousands of such childern wearing elephant hides.

verses.sanskrit: तपाश्चैव तपस्यश्च मन्युमन्तौ तु शैशिरौ । कालावस्थासु षट्स्वेते मासाख्या वै व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tapāścaiva tapasyaśca manyumantau tu śaiśirau / kālāvasthāsu ṣaṭsvete māsākhyā vai vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: W. 68-60 docribe the lUudri Sn|i (eresdoa by Rudra) and he wai asked by BrabnU to stop creation ai be was procread immonal progeny and Rudra complied.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 68-60 docribe the lUudri Sn|i (eresdoa by Rudra) and he wai asked by BrabnU to stop creation ai be was procread immonal progeny and Rudra complied.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 68-60 docribe the lUudri Sn|i (eresdoa by Rudra) and he wai asked by BrabnU to stop creation ai be was procread immonal progeny and Rudra complied.

verses.sanskrit: इमे च ऋतवः प्रोक्ताश्चेतनाचेतनेषु वै । ऋतवो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा विज्ञेयास्ते ऽभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: ime ca ṛtavaḥ proktāścetanācetaneṣu vai / ṛtavo brahmaṇaḥ putrā vijñeyāste 'bhimāninaḥ
verses.translation: These hideous and bluish-red coloured subjects who had been created by me in thousands and thousands, have come out of my own self.
verses.hindi: कियंति चेव वर्षाणि तेंषु नद्यश्च काः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: These hideous and bluish-red coloured subjects who had been created by me in thousands and thousands, have come out of my own self.
verses.commentary: Sense: These hideous and bluish-red coloured subjects who had been created by me in thousands and thousands, have come out of my own self.

verses.sanskrit: मासार्द्धमासस्थानेषु स्थानिनौ ऋतवो मताः । स्थानानां व्यतिरेकेण ज्ञेयाः स्थानागिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: māsārddhamāsasthāneṣu sthāninau ṛtavo matāḥ / sthānānāṃ vyatirekeṇa jñeyāḥ sthānāgimāninaḥ
verses.translation: These Devas will be known by the name ofRudras. They are highly powerful. Those Rudripls are well-known over the earth and firmament.
verses.wordMeaning: These Devas will be known by the name ofRudras. They are highly powerful. Those Rudripls are well-known over the earth and firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Devas will be known by the name ofRudras. They are highly powerful. Those Rudripls are well-known over the earth and firmament.

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्राणि मासाश्च ऋतवश्चायनानि च । संवत्सराश्च स्थानानि कामाख्या ह्यभिमानिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ahorātrāṇi māsāśca ṛtavaścāyanāni ca / saṃvatsarāśca sthānāni kāmākhyā hyabhimāninām
verses.translation: Enumerated in the (Vedic text) atarudra, they will become worthy of Yajfias. All of them will partake of the Yajflas along with the groups of Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: Enumerated in the (Vedic text) atarudra, they will become worthy of Yajfias. All of them will partake of the Yajflas along with the groups of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enumerated in the (Vedic text) atarudra, they will become worthy of Yajfias. All of them will partake of the Yajflas along with the groups of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषु स्थानिनो ये तु कालावस्था व्यवस्थिताः । तत्सतत्त्वास्तदात्मानस्तान्वक्ष्यामि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: eteṣu sthānino ye tu kālāvasthā vyavasthitāḥ / tatsatattvāstadātmānastānvakṣyāmi nibodhata
verses.translation: Till the end of the Yuga, they will remain, on being worshipped along with those Devas bom of Cchandas (Vedas or—bom as they are pleased) in the Manvantaras.
verses.wordMeaning: Till the end of the Yuga, they will remain, on being worshipped along with those Devas bom of Cchandas (Vedas or—bom as they are pleased) in the Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Till the end of the Yuga, they will remain, on being worshipped along with those Devas bom of Cchandas (Vedas or—bom as they are pleased) in the Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वण्यस्ति थयः संध्याः पक्षा मासार्द्धसंमिताः । निमेषाश्च कलाः कष्ठा मुहुर्त्ता दिवसाः क्षयाः
verses.transliteration: pārvaṇyasti thayaḥ saṃdhyāḥ pakṣā māsārddhasaṃmitāḥ / nimeṣāśca kalāḥ kaṣṭhā muhurttā divasāḥ kṣayāḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus by Mahadeva, that lord Brahma, the delighted lord of subjects replied to the terrible Rudra.
verses.hindi: अचित्याः खलु ये भावा न तांस्तरकेण साधयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by Mahadeva, that lord Brahma, the delighted lord of subjects replied to the terrible Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by Mahadeva, that lord Brahma, the delighted lord of subjects replied to the terrible Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: द्वावर्द्धमासौ मासस्तु द्वौ मासावृ तुरुच्यते । ऋतुत्रयं चाप्ययनं द्वे ऽयने दक्षिणोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: dvāvarddhamāsau māsastu dvau māsāvṛ turucyate / ṛtutrayaṃ cāpyayanaṃ dve 'yane dakṣiṇottare
verses.translation: ''O lord welfare unto you. Let it be as spoken by
verses.hindi: श्री सूतजी ने कहा--इस रीति से शांशपायनि ने प्रजा के सन्निवेश का श्रवण करके फिर उसने श्री सूतजी ने नियत रूप से पृथिवी और उदधि के विस्तार के विषय में पूछा या ।१। द्वीप कितने हैं, समुद्र अथवा परेत कितने बताये गये हैं ? कितने वषं हैं और उन चषा में "नदियों कौन-कौन
verses.wordMeaning: ''O lord welfare unto you. Let it be as spoken by
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O lord welfare unto you. Let it be as spoken by

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरः समेतश्च स्थानान्येतानि स्थानिनाम् । ऋतवस्तु निमेः पुत्रा विज्ञेयास्ते तथैव षट्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaraḥ sametaśca sthānānyetāni sthāninām / ṛtavastu nimeḥ putrā vijñeyāste tathaiva ṣaṭ
verses.translation: Thenceforth, the lord Sth&nu did not beget subjects. He remained celibate till the ultimate annihilation.
verses.hindi: बताथी गयी हैं? ।२ी महाभूतो का क्या प्रमाण हैं तथा लोकालोक प्रमाण क्या हैं? चन्द्र और सूर्य का पर्याय-परिमाण और गति कया हैं ?' है भग- वाच् ! यह सव आप विस्तार पूर्वक यथार्थ रूप से हमको बतलाइए'।३।' भी सूतजी ने कहा--हर्ष की बात है, मैं आपके सामने पृथ्वी का आयाम और
verses.wordMeaning: Thenceforth, the lord Sth&nu did not beget subjects. He remained celibate till the ultimate annihilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thenceforth, the lord Sth&nu did not beget subjects. He remained celibate till the ultimate annihilation.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुपुत्राः स्मृताः पञ्च प्रजाः स्वार्तवलक्षणाः । यस्माच्चैवार्त्तवेभ्यस्तु जायन्ते स्थाणु जङ्गमाः
verses.transliteration: ṛtuputrāḥ smṛtāḥ pañca prajāḥ svārtavalakṣaṇāḥ / yasmāccaivārttavebhyastu jāyante sthāṇu jaṅgamāḥ
verses.translation: Derivation of
verses.hindi: विस्तार बतलाऊँगा ।४। समुद्रों की संख्या और द्वीपों का विस्तार भी बत” लाऊंगा। यों तो द्वीपों' के सहसों भेद होते हैं किन्तु ने भेव सात द्वीपों'के सहसों भेद होते हैं किन्तु वे सभीःद सात द्वीपो के ही अन्तर्गतः है जिनके द्वारा निरन्तर यह जगत है वे सब क्रम से यहाँ पर नहीं बताये'जो
verses.wordMeaning: Derivation of
verses.commentary: Sense: Derivation of

verses.sanskrit: आर्तवाः पितरस्तस्मादृतवश्च पितामहाः । समेतास्तु प्रसूयन्ते प्रजाश्चैव प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: ārtavāḥ pitarastasmādṛtavaśca pitāmahāḥ / sametāstu prasūyante prajāścaiva prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: The manifestadon in thisKalpa of the noble-sou led great lord Rudra along with the Sddh42ka (spiritual aspirants) has not been narrated by you.
verses.hindi: सकते हैं। मैं इस समय में तो आपके समक्ष में सात द्वीपो' को ही बताऊँगा और उनके साथ चन्द्र-सूर्भ और ग्रहो' का वर्णन करूँगा ।६॥ मानव उत्को प्रमाण तकी के ढ्वारा कहा करते हैं। किन्ते निश्चित रूप से जो भाव चिन्तन करने के योग्य नहीं हैं उनका तरक के सहारे साधन कभी नहीं करना
verses.wordMeaning: The manifestadon in thisKalpa of the noble-sou led great lord Rudra along with the Sddh42ka (spiritual aspirants) has not been narrated by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The manifestadon in thisKalpa of the noble-sou led great lord Rudra along with the Sddh42ka (spiritual aspirants) has not been narrated by you.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स्मृतः प्रजानां वै वत्सरः प्रपितामहः । स्थानेषु स्थानिनो ह्येते स्थानात्मानः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsmṛtaḥ prajānāṃ vai vatsaraḥ prapitāmahaḥ / sthāneṣu sthānino hyete sthānātmānaḥ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: The origin of the primordial creation has been succinct¬ ly tneniioned by me. I shall now narrate in detail the names along with the physical bodies.
verses.wordMeaning: The origin of the primordial creation has been succinct¬ ly tneniioned by me. I shall now narrate in detail the names along with the physical bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: The origin of the primordial creation has been succinct¬ ly tneniioned by me. I shall now narrate in detail the names along with the physical bodies.

verses.sanskrit: तदाख्यास्तत्ससत्त्वाश्च तदात्मानश्च ते स्मृताः । प्रजापतिः स्मृतो यस्तु स तु संवत्सरो मतः
verses.transliteration: tadākhyāstatsasattvāśca tadātmānaśca te smṛtāḥ / prajāpatiḥ smṛto yastu sa tu saṃvatsaro mataḥ
verses.translation: Mahadeva begot of his wives many sons in the other Kalpas that have passed by. Listen to thoe (procreated) in this Kalpa.
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva begot of his wives many sons in the other Kalpas that have passed by. Listen to thoe (procreated) in this Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva begot of his wives many sons in the other Kalpas that have passed by. Listen to thoe (procreated) in this Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरसुतो ह्यग्नि ऋत इत्युच्यते बुधैः । ऋतात्तु ऋतवो यस्माज्जज्ञिरे ऋतवस्ततः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarasuto hyagni ṛta ityucyate budhaiḥ / ṛtāttu ṛtavo yasmājjajñire ṛtavastataḥ
verses.translation: In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord contemplated on a son on a par with himself. Thereafter, the child Nllalohita appeared on his lap.
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord contemplated on a son on a par with himself. Thereafter, the child Nllalohita appeared on his lap.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord contemplated on a son on a par with himself. Thereafter, the child Nllalohita appeared on his lap.

verses.sanskrit: मासाः षडर्तवो ज्ञेयास्तेषां पञ्चर्तवाः स्मृताः । द्विपदां चतुष्पदां चैव पक्षिणां सर्वतामपि
verses.transliteration: māsāḥ ṣaḍartavo jñeyāsteṣāṃ pañcartavāḥ smṛtāḥ / dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ caiva pakṣiṇāṃ sarvatāmapi
verses.translation: Derivation of MakidM,
verses.hindi: जो प्रकृतियों से परे हैं बही चिन्तन न करने के योग्य नहीं है--ऐसा कहते हैं । नी वर्षों से समस्वित जम्बू द्वीप को यथार्थ रूपः से. बतलाऊगा +८। उसको विस्तार से और मण्डल से योजतों के दरारा समझ लीजिए योजनाग्र से सभी ओर एक सौ सहस्र है। यह अनेक जनपदों से घिरा हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Derivation of MakidM,
verses.commentary: Sense: Derivation of MakidM,

verses.sanskrit: स्थावराणां च पञ्चानां पुष्पं कालार्त्तवं स्मृतम् । ऋतुत्वमार्तवत्वं च पितृत्वं च प्रकीर्त्तितम्
verses.transliteration: sthāvarāṇāṃ ca pañcānāṃ puṣpaṃ kālārttavaṃ smṛtam / ṛtutvamārtavatvaṃ ca pitṛtvaṃ ca prakīrttitam
verses.translation: "O lord, you are named Rudra**. On being told thus he cried again. "Why do you cry, O child?" asked Brahmi to him.
verses.hindi: है और विविध परम शुभ नगरों से समन्वित है। यह सिद्धगण और चारणों से समाकीणं है और अनेक पर्वतों से उपशोधित है ।६-१०। शिलाओं के समुदायों से'समुत्पन्न समस्त धातुओं से निबद्ध यह द्वीप है। इसके सभी ओर अनेक नदियाँ हैं जो पव॑त से उद्भूत हुई हैं ।११। यह जम्बूद्वीप बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, you are named Rudra**. On being told thus he cried again. "Why do you cry, O child?" asked Brahmi to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, you are named Rudra**. On being told thus he cried again. "Why do you cry, O child?" asked Brahmi to him.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते पितरो ज्ञेया ऋतवश्चार्तवाश्च ये । सर्वभूतानि तेभ्यो यदृतुकालाद्विजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: ityete pitaro jñeyā ṛtavaścārtavāśca ye / sarvabhūtāni tebhyo yadṛtukālādvijajñire
verses.translation: "Give me a second name", said he to the self*bom Lord. "You are Bhava by name, O Lord". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.hindi: विशाल है । श्री सम्पन्त है तथा इसका मण्डल भी महान हैं। भूतों के करने वाले नो भुवनों से यह सम्पूर्ण समावृत है ।१२। इसके चारों ओर क्षार समुद्र है जिसका भी विस्तार अम्बर द्वीप के विस्तार के ही समान है
verses.wordMeaning: "Give me a second name", said he to the self*bom Lord. "You are Bhava by name, O Lord". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Give me a second name", said he to the self*bom Lord. "You are Bhava by name, O Lord". On being told thus he cried again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेते हि पितर आर्तवा इति नः श्रुतम् । मन्वन्तरेष्विह त्वेते स्थिताः कालभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: tasmādete hi pitara ārtavā iti naḥ śrutam / manvantareṣviha tvete sthitāḥ kālabhimāninaḥ
verses.translation: "Why do you cry?", enquired Brahma of the crying child. "Give me a third name". On being told thus, he said again.
verses.hindi: गायत सुपर्वा ये; छे वषं पंत हैँ जो दोनों ओर पूवें और पश्चिम समुद्रों से अवगाढ हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "Why do you cry?", enquired Brahma of the crying child. "Give me a third name". On being told thus, he said again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why do you cry?", enquired Brahma of the crying child. "Give me a third name". On being told thus, he said again.

verses.sanskrit: कार्यकारणयुक्तास्तु ए श्वर्याद्व्याप्य संस्थिताः । स्थानाभिमानिनो ह्येते तिष्ठन्तीह प्रसंगमात्
verses.transliteration: kāryakāraṇayuktāstu e śvaryādvyāpya saṃsthitāḥ / sthānābhimānino hyete tiṣṭhantīha prasaṃgamāt
verses.translation: "O lord, you are rva by name." On being told thus he cried again, "Why do you cry?", asked Brahmi again to the crying child.
verses.hindi: नाभिबंधनसंभूतो ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः । पूर्वतः श्वेतवर्णश्च ब्राह्मणस्तस्य तेन तेत्
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, you are rva by name." On being told thus he cried again, "Why do you cry?", asked Brahmi again to the crying child.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, you are rva by name." On being told thus he cried again, "Why do you cry?", asked Brahmi again to the crying child.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदः पितरो विविधाः पुनः । जज्ञे स्वधापितृभ्यस्तु द्वे कन्ये लोकविश्रुते
verses.transliteration: agniṣvāttā barhiṣadaḥ pitaro vividhāḥ punaḥ / jajñe svadhāpitṛbhyastu dve kanye lokaviśrute
verses.translation: "Give me a foiu'th name." On being told thus, he said again, "O lord, you are liana by name". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.wordMeaning: "Give me a foiu'th name." On being told thus, he said again, "O lord, you are liana by name". On being told thus he cried again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Give me a foiu'th name." On being told thus, he said again, "O lord, you are liana by name". On being told thus he cried again.

verses.sanskrit: मेना च धारणी चैव याभ्यां धतमिदं जगत् । ते उभे ब्रह्मवादिन्यौ योगिन्यौ चैव ते उभे
verses.transliteration: menā ca dhāraṇī caiva yābhyāṃ dhatamidaṃ jagat / te ubhe brahmavādinyau yoginyau caiva te ubhe
verses.translation: "Why do you cry", said Brahmi to that cryit child again. He replied to the self-bom lord—"Give me a fifth name."
verses.wordMeaning: "Why do you cry", said Brahmi to that cryit child again. He replied to the self-bom lord—"Give me a fifth name."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why do you cry", said Brahmi to that cryit child again. He replied to the self-bom lord—"Give me a fifth name."

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्ते निजे कन्ये धर्मार्थं प्रददुः शुभे । अग्निष्वात्तास्तु ये प्रोक्तास्तेषां मेना तु मानसी
verses.transliteration: pitaraste nije kanye dharmārthaṃ pradaduḥ śubhe / agniṣvāttāstu ye proktāsteṣāṃ menā tu mānasī
verses.translation: "You are the lord and master of all PaSus (Animals, living beings)". On being told thus, he cried again. "Why do you cry?*' said Brahma to that crying child, once again.
verses.hindi: हिमवान् गिरि में प्रायः हिम समूह होता है और हेमक़ूट पर्वत हैम से संयुत है। निषध एक महान पर्वत है जो सभो ऋतुओं में सुखदायी होता है।१५ मरु पर्वत चार वर्णों बाला है और सुवणं से युक्त है यहः अधिक सुन्दर कहा गया है और मूर्धा में बत्तीस सहस्र योजनों के विस्तार वाला है
verses.wordMeaning: "You are the lord and master of all PaSus (Animals, living beings)". On being told thus, he cried again. "Why do you cry?*' said Brahma to that crying child, once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You are the lord and master of all PaSus (Animals, living beings)". On being told thus, he cried again. "Why do you cry?*' said Brahma to that crying child, once again.

verses.sanskrit: धारणी मानसी चैव कन्या बर्हिषदां स्मृता । मेरोस्तां धारणीं नाम पत्न्यर्थं वा सृजन् घुभाम्
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇī mānasī caiva kanyā barhiṣadāṃ smṛtā / merostāṃ dhāraṇīṃ nāma patnyarthaṃ vā sṛjan ghubhām
verses.translation: "Indeed, give me the sixth name". On being told thus he replied to him—"O lord, you are Bhima by name*'. On being told thus he cried again.
verses.hindi: ।१६। यह वृत्त आकृति और प्रमाण याला है तथा चौकोर और समुकिङत
verses.wordMeaning: "Indeed, give me the sixth name". On being told thus he replied to him—"O lord, you are Bhima by name*'. On being told thus he cried again.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Indeed, give me the sixth name". On being told thus he replied to him—"O lord, you are Bhima by name*'. On being told thus he cried again.

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्ते बर्हिषदः स्मृता ये सोमपायिनः । अग्निष्वात्तास्तु तां मेना पत्नी हिमवते ददुः
verses.transliteration: pitaraste barhiṣadaḥ smṛtā ye somapāyinaḥ / agniṣvāttāstu tāṃ menā patnī himavate daduḥ
verses.translation: "Why do you cry?", asked Brahma again to that crying child. "Give me the seventh name". On being told thus he replied:
verses.hindi: अर्थात् ऊँचा है। इसके पाश्व भागों में अनेक वर्ण हैं तथा यह् प्रजापति के
verses.wordMeaning: "Why do you cry?", asked Brahma again to that crying child. "Give me the seventh name". On being told thus he replied:
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why do you cry?", asked Brahma again to that crying child. "Give me the seventh name". On being told thus he replied:

verses.sanskrit: उपहूता स्मृता ये वै तद्दौहित्रान्निबोधत । मेना हिमवतः पत्नी मैनाकं सा व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: upahūtā smṛtā ye vai taddauhitrānnibodhata / menā himavataḥ patnī mainākaṃ sā vyajāyata
verses.translation: This name signifies identification of Rudra and Fire.
verses.hindi: गुणोंसे संयुत है ।१३। अव्यक्त जन्म वाले ब्रह्माजी के नाभिबन्धन से यह समुत्पन्न हुआ है। उसके पूर्व की ओर यह श्वेत वण' वाला है इससे ब्राह्मण है।१८। उत्तर की ओर' पाश्वंभाग उसका स्वभाव से ही रक्तवणं है। इस कारण से मेरु के अनेक अर्थ कारण से इसका क्षत्र भाव है।१९। यह दक्षिण
verses.wordMeaning: This name signifies identification of Rudra and Fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: This name signifies identification of Rudra and Fire.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गां सरिद्वरां चैव पत्नी या लवणोदधेः । मैनाकस्या त्मजः क्रौचः क्रैञ्चद्वीपो यतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāṃ saridvarāṃ caiva patnī yā lavaṇodadheḥ / mainākasyā tmajaḥ kraucaḥ kraiñcadvīpo yataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: W. 5 if. This episode of crying for a name and god BrahmS's
verses.hindi: दिशा की ओर पीत है इससे इसका बैश्यभाव अभी होता है। पश्चिम की ओर पीत है इससे इसका वैश्यभाव अभीष्ट होता है। पश्चिम की ओर यह. शुङ्ञपत्र के सहश समाचित हैं ।०। इस कारण से इसका शूद्रभाव होता है--इस तरह से इसके चार बर्ण कहे गये हैं। यह स्वभाव से वृत्त कहा
verses.wordMeaning: W. 5 if. This episode of crying for a name and god BrahmS's
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 5 if. This episode of crying for a name and god BrahmS's

verses.sanskrit: मेरोस्तु धारणी पत्नी दिव्यौषधिसमन्वितम् । मन्दरं सुषुवे पुत्रं तिस्रः कन्याश्च विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: merostu dhāraṇī patnī divyauṣadhisamanvitam / mandaraṃ suṣuve putraṃ tisraḥ kanyāśca viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: lord, you are Ugra by name*'. On being told thus, he cried again. To that crying child he said—
verses.hindi: है और व्ण तथा परिमाण से भी बताया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: lord, you are Ugra by name*'. On being told thus, he cried again. To that crying child he said—
verses.commentary: Sense: lord, you are Ugra by name*'. On being told thus, he cried again. To that crying child he said—

verses.sanskrit: वेलां च नियतिं चैव तृतीयां चायतिं विदुः । धातुश्चैवायतिः पत्नी विधातुर्नियतिः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: velāṃ ca niyatiṃ caiva tṛtīyāṃ cāyatiṃ viduḥ / dhātuścaivāyatiḥ patnī vidhāturniyatiḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: He said—"Give me, O lord, the eighth name". "You arc Mahadeva by name". On being told thus, he stopped crying.
verses.wordMeaning: He said—"Give me, O lord, the eighth name". "You arc Mahadeva by name". On being told thus, he stopped crying.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said—"Give me, O lord, the eighth name". "You arc Mahadeva by name". On being told thus, he stopped crying.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायं भुवेंऽतरे पूर्वं ययोर्वै कीर्त्तिताः प्रजाः । सुषुवे सागराद्वेला कन्यामेकामनिन्दिताम्
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃ bhuveṃ'tare pūrvaṃ yayorvai kīrttitāḥ prajāḥ / suṣuve sāgarādvelā kanyāmekāmaninditām
verses.translation: After securing these names. Nilalohita requested Brahm—"Indicate the abodes of these names''.
verses.wordMeaning: After securing these names. Nilalohita requested Brahm—"Indicate the abodes of these names''.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing these names. Nilalohita requested Brahm—"Indicate the abodes of these names''.

verses.sanskrit: सवर्णां नाम सामुद्रीं पत्नीं प्राचीनबर्हिषः । सवर्णायां सुता जाता दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः
verses.transliteration: savarṇāṃ nāma sāmudrīṃ patnīṃ prācīnabarhiṣaḥ / savarṇāyāṃ sutā jātā daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ
verses.translation: The abodei of the aames of NiUJohiu are the eight forms mUrtis) of Siva and they vymboliar the five MahdbhUUs (grou elefQenti) the two principle vital ain and ApinA and the principle of the Mind.
verses.hindi: नील=-वैदू्य॑मय-= श्वेत--हिरण्मय-- मोर के  वहाण के वर्ण बाला और णातकौम्भ तथा श्वुङ्गवाद् है ।२२। ये सब पर्वेतों के शिरोमणि:राजा प्त हैं जो कि सिद्धों और चारणों के द्वारा सेवित रहा करते हैं, अर्थात् इनमें सिद्ध और चारण' निवास किया करते हैं। उनका अस्त र-लिण्फम्भ- तो
verses.wordMeaning: The abodei of the aames of NiUJohiu are the eight forms mUrtis) of Siva and they vymboliar the five MahdbhUUs (grou elefQenti) the two principle vital ain and ApinA and the principle of the Mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abodei of the aames of NiUJohiu are the eight forms mUrtis) of Siva and they vymboliar the five MahdbhUUs (grou elefQenti) the two principle vital ain and ApinA and the principle of the Mind.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे प्रचेतसो नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः । तेषां स्वायंभुवो दक्षः पुत्रत्वं जग्मि वान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sarve pracetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ / teṣāṃ svāyaṃbhuvo dakṣaḥ putratvaṃ jagmi vānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Since the sun comes into view frequently and since it vanishes frequently, one, who desires for longevity, should not directly sec the sun. One should always be pure.
verses.hindi: सहल्र/योजनः कहा जाता" है ।२३। मध्य में इलावृत नाम बाला -गिरि है जो भहामेरु के समंतम है । यह भी इसी प्रकार से नो सहस्र हीसबः ओर-से विस्तार यालाः है।२४। इसके मध्य में महा है जो धूमः से रहित अरिति.के समान देवीष्यमान है मेक के वेदी का अर्घ दक्षिण है तथा उत्तर अघे भाग
verses.wordMeaning: Since the sun comes into view frequently and since it vanishes frequently, one, who desires for longevity, should not directly sec the sun. One should always be pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the sun comes into view frequently and since it vanishes frequently, one, who desires for longevity, should not directly sec the sun. One should always be pure.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयंबकस्याभिशापेन चाक्षुषस्यातरे मनोः । एतच्छुत्वा ततः सूतमपृच्छच्छांशपायनिः
verses.transliteration: trayaṃbakasyābhiśāpena cākṣuṣasyātare manoḥ / etacchutvā tataḥ sūtamapṛcchacchāṃśapāyaniḥ
verses.translation: Lord Rudra does not oppress the Brahmaa who strictly adheres to these principles. Then Brahma said again to that lord Nilalohita.
verses.hindi: उत्तर हैः१२५।-जो छै वर्ण हैं : उनके जो वर्ष पर्गत हैं ऊ चाई-से दो-दो सहन योजन विस्तीर्णे हैं ।२६॥ जम्बू द्वीप के विस्तार से उनका आयाम-कहा जाता .है।।  दो गिरिः सौः सहस्र योजन आयत हैं ।२७। नोल और निषध उन बोनों से जो दूसरे हैं जे हीन हैं।- श्गेत=-हेमकूट--हिमवान तथाः व्पुङ्गवाच्
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Rudra does not oppress the Brahmaa who strictly adheres to these principles. Then Brahma said again to that lord Nilalohita.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Rudra does not oppress the Brahmaa who strictly adheres to these principles. Then Brahma said again to that lord Nilalohita.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नः स कथं दक्षो ह्यभिशापाद्भवस्य तु । चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वं तन्नः प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: utpannaḥ sa kathaṃ dakṣo hyabhiśāpādbhavasya tu / cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvaṃ tannaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām
verses.translation: Your second name has been mentioned by nic as Bhava. Let the waters be the second physical body of this name ofyours.
verses.hindi: इदं हैमवतं वर्ष भारतं नाम विश्रुतम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Your second name has been mentioned by nic as Bhava. Let the waters be the second physical body of this name ofyours.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your second name has been mentioned by nic as Bhava. Let the waters be the second physical body of this name ofyours.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः कथयामास सूतो दक्षाश्रयां कथाम् । शांशपायनिमामन्त्र्य त्र्यंबकाच्छापकारणम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ kathayāmāsa sūto dakṣāśrayāṃ kathām / śāṃśapāyanimāmantrya tryaṃbakācchāpakāraṇam
verses.translation: On this being mentioned, the element of the nature of Rasa (Juice )(i.e. water) became stationed in his body. Since he entered it, the water is remembered as Bhava*
verses.wordMeaning: On this being mentioned, the element of the nature of Rasa (Juice )(i.e. water) became stationed in his body. Since he entered it, the water is remembered as Bhava*
verses.commentary: Sense: On this being mentioned, the element of the nature of Rasa (Juice )(i.e. water) became stationed in his body. Since he entered it, the water is remembered as Bhava*

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच दक्षस्यासन्सुता ह्यष्टौ कन्या याः कीर्त्तिता मया । स्वेभ्यो गृहेभ्य आनाय्य ताः पिताभ्यर्चयद्गृहे
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca dakṣasyāsansutā hyaṣṭau kanyā yāḥ kīrttitā mayā / svebhyo gṛhebhya ānāyya tāḥ pitābhyarcayadgṛhe
verses.translation: Since the living beings are bom (bhavanat) of him, and since he evolves (bhavanat) the living beings through them (i.c. the waters) he is called Bhava* (due to his creation and evolution of beings).
verses.hindi: उनसे दो'सहर्र नव्ये ओर को सहन अस्सी आग्रत हैं। उनकेः मध्य- में'जनपद हैं गे'सात'बषे है )२९। उनः भ्रपातों से विषम पर्जतों से गे हैं।। निरन्तर बहने वाली नदियों के बहत से मेदों से ठो परस्पर में गमत कारने' के अयोग्य/ है ।३०। उनमें अनेक जातियों. वाले जीव निवास करते हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: Since the living beings are bom (bhavanat) of him, and since he evolves (bhavanat) the living beings through them (i.c. the waters) he is called Bhava* (due to his creation and evolution of beings).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the living beings are bom (bhavanat) of him, and since he evolves (bhavanat) the living beings through them (i.c. the waters) he is called Bhava* (due to his creation and evolution of beings).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वभ्यर्चिताः सर्वा न्यवसंस्ताः पितुर्गृहे । तासां ज्येष्ठा सती नाम पत्नी या त्र्यंबकस्य वै
verses.transliteration: tatastvabhyarcitāḥ sarvā nyavasaṃstāḥ piturgṛhe / tāsāṃ jyeṣṭhā satī nāma patnī yā tryaṃbakasya vai
verses.translation: This Puranic peculation turned out to be a scientific truth.
verses.hindi: सभी' ओर जे वहाँ रहा करते हैं । यह हैमवल वर्ष है जो भारत--इस' नासे से्रसिदध है।३१। इससे आगे हेमकूट है जो नाम से किम्पुरुष कहा/ गया हैं।। हेमकूट' से आगे नेपध है जो हरि वर्ष कहा जाया करता है ।३२। हरिवषं से परे मेरु का वह इलावृत है । इलावूत से आगे नील है जो रम्यक नामः से'
verses.wordMeaning: This Puranic peculation turned out to be a scientific truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Puranic peculation turned out to be a scientific truth.

verses.sanskrit: नाजुहावात्मजां तां वै दक्षो रुद्रमभिद्विषन् । अकरोत्संनतिं दक्षे न कदाचिन्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: nājuhāvātmajāṃ tāṃ vai dakṣo rudramabhidviṣan / akarotsaṃnatiṃ dakṣe na kadācinmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Nor should one enumerate (?) these whether flowing or still. These bodies of the waters are declared by the sages %Medhya (Pure) and Amedhya (Impure).
verses.hindi: विख्यात ' है ।३३। रम्यक' से आगे श्‍्गेत है जो हिरण्मय नाम से विश्रुता है”? हिरण्मय से आगे ्पु्गवत् हैँ जो कुक कहा गया है ।३४॥ दक्षिण और"उत्तरु दिशा में धलु:संस्थ दो वपं जानने चाहिए । वहाँ पर चार दी है जो मध्यम है बह इलावृत है
verses.wordMeaning: Nor should one enumerate (?) these whether flowing or still. These bodies of the waters are declared by the sages %Medhya (Pure) and Amedhya (Impure).
verses.commentary: Sense: Nor should one enumerate (?) these whether flowing or still. These bodies of the waters are declared by the sages %Medhya (Pure) and Amedhya (Impure).

verses.sanskrit: जामाता श्वशुरे तस्मिन्स्वभावात्तेजसि स्थितः । ततो ज्ञात्वा सती सर्वाः न्यवसंस्ताः पितुर्गृहे
verses.transliteration: jāmātā śvaśure tasminsvabhāvāttejasi sthitaḥ / tato jñātvā satī sarvāḥ nyavasaṃstāḥ piturgṛhe
verses.translation: Waters devoid of taste, waters of bad odour and colour and water in very little quantity should be avoided on all occasions. The sea is the source of origin of waters. Hence waters desire it.
verses.wordMeaning: Waters devoid of taste, waters of bad odour and colour and water in very little quantity should be avoided on all occasions. The sea is the source of origin of waters. Hence waters desire it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Waters devoid of taste, waters of bad odour and colour and water in very little quantity should be avoided on all occasions. The sea is the source of origin of waters. Hence waters desire it.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम साप्यनाहूता सती तत्स्व पितुर्गृहम् । ताभ्यो हीनां पिता चक्रे सत्याः पूजामसंमताम्
verses.transliteration: jagāma sāpyanāhūtā satī tatsva piturgṛham / tābhyo hīnāṃ pitā cakre satyāḥ pūjāmasaṃmatām
verses.translation: After reaching the sea, the waters become sacred and Amrta (nectarine). Hence one should not obstruct the
