verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the sea, the waters become sacred and Amrta (nectarine). Hence one should not obstruct the

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽब्रवीत्सा पितरं देवी क्रोधादमर्षिता । यवीयसीभ्यो प्यधमां पूजां कृत्वा मम प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tato 'bravītsā pitaraṃ devī krodhādamarṣitā / yavīyasībhyo pyadhamāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā mama prabho
verses.translation: lord, the third name of yours that had been luentioned by me is Sarva. It this earth be tlie physical body of that third name.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर निषध के नीचे नेदी के अर्धभाग दक्षिण कहा गया है। नीलवान् है और जो गेचधं है वह उत्तर है।३६। वेधं दक्षिण भौर उत्तर में तीन-तीन वर्ष है । उन दोनों के मध्य में मेरु जानना चाहिए और मध्य में इलावृत है ।३७। नील के दक्षिण दिशा की ओर और तिषध की
verses.wordMeaning: lord, the third name of yours that had been luentioned by me is Sarva. It this earth be tlie physical body of that third name.
verses.commentary: Sense: lord, the third name of yours that had been luentioned by me is Sarva. It this earth be tlie physical body of that third name.

verses.sanskrit: असत्कृत्य पितर्मां त्वं कृतवानसि गर्हितम् । अहं ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा च त्वं मां सत्कर्तुमर्ह सि
verses.transliteration: asatkṛtya pitarmāṃ tvaṃ kṛtavānasi garhitam / ahaṃ jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca tvaṃ māṃ satkartumarha si
verses.translation: On this being mentioned, the hard and firm (part) in his body, namely bones entered the earth. Therefore, it is called Sarva.
verses.hindi: उत्तर की ओर--उत्तर की ओर आयत एक महान् शैल है जो नाम से भाल्यवोन कहा जाता है ।३८। एक सहसत योजनः नील और तिषध तक आयत है और आयाम से यह चौबीस सहस योजन कहा गया है ।३६। इसके पश्चिम में गन्ध्रमादन नामक पर्णत जानने के योग्य है । आयाम (चौड़ाई)
verses.wordMeaning: On this being mentioned, the hard and firm (part) in his body, namely bones entered the earth. Therefore, it is called Sarva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On this being mentioned, the hard and firm (part) in his body, namely bones entered the earth. Therefore, it is called Sarva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो ऽब्रवीदेनां दक्षः संरक्तलोचनः । त्वत्तः श्रेष्ठावरिष्ठाश्च पूज्या बालाः सुता मम
verses.transliteration: evamukto 'bravīdenāṃ dakṣaḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ / tvattaḥ śreṣṭhāvariṣṭhāśca pūjyā bālāḥ sutā mama
verses.translation: Hence, one should not evacuate the bowels or uri« nate in the ploughed land. One.should not urinate in the shade of trees, or in the pathway or in one's own shadow.
verses.hindi: और विस्तार से माल्यबान्--इस नाम से यह प्रसिद्ध है ।४०। परिमण्डलो के मध्य में मेरु पर्वत है जो कनक पर्वत है। बह चार वर्णों वाला और सुवर्णः का तंथा चतुरस्र अर्थात् चौकोर समुच्छित है ।४१। सुमेरु शो भाशाली' होता था जो पास शुभ्र है ओर एक राजा के ही समान समधिष्ठित रहता
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should not evacuate the bowels or uri« nate in the ploughed land. One.should not urinate in the shade of trees, or in the pathway or in one's own shadow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should not evacuate the bowels or uri« nate in the ploughed land. One.should not urinate in the shade of trees, or in the pathway or in one's own shadow.

verses.sanskrit: तासां चैव तु भर्तार स्ते मे बहुमाताः सति । ब्रह्मिष्ठाः सुतपस्काश्च महायोगाः सुधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ caiva tu bhartāra ste me bahumātāḥ sati / brahmiṣṭhāḥ sutapaskāśca mahāyogāḥ sudhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: After covering the ground with grass and covering one's head, one should evacute the bowels. Sarva docs not oppress or injure him who behaves like this towards tlic earth.
verses.hindi: है। इसके-वणं'की आभा तरुण सूर्य के ही समान है तथा बिना धुआ वाली अग्नि के तुल्य है
verses.wordMeaning: After covering the ground with grass and covering one's head, one should evacute the bowels. Sarva docs not oppress or injure him who behaves like this towards tlic earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After covering the ground with grass and covering one's head, one should evacute the bowels. Sarva docs not oppress or injure him who behaves like this towards tlic earth.

verses.sanskrit: गुणैश्चैवाधिकाः श्लाघ्याः सर्वे ते त्र्यंबकात्सति । वसिष्ठो ऽत्रिः पुलस्त्यश्च ह्यङ्गिरा पुलहः क्रतुः
verses.transliteration: guṇaiścaivādhikāḥ ślāghyāḥ sarve te tryaṃbakātsati / vasiṣṭho 'triḥ pulastyaśca hyaṅgirā pulahaḥ kratuḥ
verses.translation: Lord Maheiana docs not oppress or injure him who properly behaves towards the wind and those who honour 4he wind by means of YajAas and those who serve it*
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Maheiana docs not oppress or injure him who properly behaves towards the wind and those who honour 4he wind by means of YajAas and those who serve it*
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Maheiana docs not oppress or injure him who properly behaves towards the wind and those who honour 4he wind by means of YajAas and those who serve it*

verses.sanskrit: भृगुर्मरीचिश्च तथा श्रैष्ठा जामातरो मम । यस्मान्मां स्पर्द्धते शर्वः सदा चैवावमन्यते
verses.transliteration: bhṛgurmarīciśca tathā śraiṣṭhā jāmātaro mama / yasmānmāṃ sparddhate śarvaḥ sadā caivāvamanyate
verses.translation: O lord, your seventh name that had been mentioned by me was Ugra. The initiated Brahmaa becomes the body of that name of yours.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, your seventh name that had been mentioned by me was Ugra. The initiated Brahmaa becomes the body of that name of yours.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, your seventh name that had been mentioned by me was Ugra. The initiated Brahmaa becomes the body of that name of yours.

verses.sanskrit: तेन त्वां न विभूषोमि प्रतिकूलो हि मे भवः । इत्युक्तवांस्तदा दक्षः संप्रमूढेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: tena tvāṃ na vibhūṣomi pratikūlo hi me bhavaḥ / ityuktavāṃstadā dakṣaḥ saṃpramūḍhena cetasā
verses.translation: On this being uttered, the Ctixianya (consciousness, alertness) that was in bis body entered the initiated Brah¬ ma who performs the Soma sacrifice.
verses.hindi: चह चौरासी सहस्र योजन ऊँचा है। एक योजन चार कोस का होता है। सोलह योजन नीचे की ओर प्रविष्ट है और सोलह ही भोजेन विस्तार बाला है ।४३। शराव संस्थित होने से बसीस योजन मूर्धा में विस्तृत है। बिल्‍्तार से सभी ओर उसका तिगुना परिणाम है ।४४। मण्डल प्रमाण
verses.wordMeaning: On this being uttered, the Ctixianya (consciousness, alertness) that was in bis body entered the initiated Brah¬ ma who performs the Soma sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: On this being uttered, the Ctixianya (consciousness, alertness) that was in bis body entered the initiated Brah¬ ma who performs the Soma sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: शापार्थमात्मनश्चैव ये चोक्ताः परमर्षयः । तथोक्ता पितरं सा वै क्रुद्धा देवीदम ब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śāpārthamātmanaścaiva ye coktāḥ paramarṣayaḥ / tathoktā pitaraṃ sā vai kruddhā devīdama bravīt
verses.translation: For that duration, the initiated Brahmatia becomes lord Ugra. Hence, no one shall abuse or revile at him nor shall anyone speak vulgar word s about him.
verses.hindi: से उसका म(न व्य 'अभीष्ट होता है। सब ओर चौवालीस सहे योजन है॥४४॥ व्यसन मैं अर्थात् तीनों मोर में उसका मानः आठ अधिक योजनं कहा गथा है। सभी ओर चतुरख मात से परिणाम होता है।४६। चौंसठ सहसु योजनः कहा जाता है । बह पर्वत बहुत ही अधिक दिव्य. है और दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: For that duration, the initiated Brahmatia becomes lord Ugra. Hence, no one shall abuse or revile at him nor shall anyone speak vulgar word s about him.
verses.commentary: Sense: For that duration, the initiated Brahmatia becomes lord Ugra. Hence, no one shall abuse or revile at him nor shall anyone speak vulgar word s about him.

verses.sanskrit: वाङ्मनः कर्मभिर्यस्माददुष्टां मां विगर्हसे । तस्मात्त्यजाम्यहमिमं देहं तात तवात्मजम्
verses.transliteration: vāṅmanaḥ karmabhiryasmādaduṣṭāṃ māṃ vigarhase / tasmāttyajāmyahamimaṃ dehaṃ tāta tavātmajam
verses.translation: Tiioit who censure him take away hb sins. Lord Ugra does not oppress or injure those Brahmanas who behave properly thus.
verses.hindi: औषधियों से समन्वितः है ।४७। यह सम्पूर्ण सुबणंमय परम शुभः भुबनों से घिरा हुआ है । वहाँ पर समस्त देवों के गण--गन्धर्व---और राक्षस निवासः दिया: करते हैं ।४८। उस शेलों के राजा के ऊपर शुभ अप्सराओं के समुदाय भी दिखलाई दिया करते हैं: वह मेर पर्वत भूतों के भावन भुबनों से परि+
verses.wordMeaning: Tiioit who censure him take away hb sins. Lord Ugra does not oppress or injure those Brahmanas who behave properly thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tiioit who censure him take away hb sins. Lord Ugra does not oppress or injure those Brahmanas who behave properly thus.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेनावमानेन सती दुःखादमर्षिता । अब्रवीद्वचनं देवी नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवे
verses.transliteration: tatastenāvamānena satī duḥkhādamarṣitā / abravīdvacanaṃ devī namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve
verses.translation: On the new moon day a Brahmaa should not cut trees, bushes or medicinal herbs. Some (Moon) U remem¬ bered as Mahadeva and his Atman (soul) is the group of medicinal herbs.
verses.hindi: भद्राशवा भरताश्चौ व केत् मालाश्च पञ्चिमाः
verses.wordMeaning: On the new moon day a Brahmaa should not cut trees, bushes or medicinal herbs. Some (Moon) U remem¬ bered as Mahadeva and his Atman (soul) is the group of medicinal herbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the new moon day a Brahmaa should not cut trees, bushes or medicinal herbs. Some (Moon) U remem¬ bered as Mahadeva and his Atman (soul) is the group of medicinal herbs.

verses.sanskrit: यत्राहमुपपद्ये च पुनर्देहेन भास्वता । तत्राप्यहमसंभूता संभूता धार्मिकादपि
verses.transliteration: yatrāhamupapadye ca punardehena bhāsvatā / tatrāpyahamasaṃbhūtā saṃbhūtā dhārmikādapi
verses.translation: His first body has been glorified by the name RaudrI. Its wife is Suvarcala and her son is anaiicara (the Saturn).
verses.wordMeaning: His first body has been glorified by the name RaudrI. Its wife is Suvarcala and her son is anaiicara (the Saturn).
verses.commentary: Sense: His first body has been glorified by the name RaudrI. Its wife is Suvarcala and her son is anaiicara (the Saturn).

verses.sanskrit: गच्छेयं धर्मपत्नीत्वं त्र्यंबकस्यैव धीमतः । तत्रैवाथ समासीना युक्तात्मानं समादधे
verses.transliteration: gaccheyaṃ dharmapatnītvaṃ tryaṃbakasyaiva dhīmataḥ / tatraivātha samāsīnā yuktātmānaṃ samādadhe
verses.translation: O Brahmaias, let there be welfare unto the bipeds. Let there be welfare unto the quadrupeds. Now the names and bodies of Mahadeva have been recounted. Listen to the progeny of Bhju.
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmaias, let there be welfare unto the bipeds. Let there be welfare unto the quadrupeds. Now the names and bodies of Mahadeva have been recounted. Listen to the progeny of Bhju.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmaias, let there be welfare unto the bipeds. Let there be welfare unto the quadrupeds. Now the names and bodies of Mahadeva have been recounted. Listen to the progeny of Bhju.

verses.sanskrit: धारयामास चाग्नेयीं धारणां मनसात्मनः । तत आत्मसमुत्थो ऽस्या वायुना समुदीरितः । सर्वागेभ्यो विनिःसृत्य वह्निस्तां भस्मसात्करोत्
verses.transliteration: dhārayāmāsa cāgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ manasātmanaḥ / tata ātmasamuttho 'syā vāyunā samudīritaḥ / sarvāgebhyo viniḥsṛtya vahnistāṃ bhasmasātkarot
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: तदुपश्रुत्य निधनं सत्या देवो ऽथ शूलभृत् । संवादं च तयोर्बुद्धा याथातथ्येन शङ्करः । दक्षस्य च ऋषीणां च चुकोप भगवान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tadupaśrutya nidhanaṃ satyā devo 'tha śūlabhṛt / saṃvādaṃ ca tayorbuddhā yāthātathyena śaṅkaraḥ / dakṣasya ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca cukopa bhagavānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.hindi: तत्र काला नराः सर्गे महासत्त्वा महाबलाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: रुद्र उवाच सर्वेषामेव लोकानां भूर्लोकस्त्वादिरुच्यते । तं सदा धारयिष्यामि निदेशात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: rudra uvāca sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ bhūrlokastvādirucyate / taṃ sadā dhārayiṣyāmi nideśātparameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: अस्यां क्षितौ धृता लोकाः सर्वे तिष्ठन्ति भास्वराः । तानहं धारया मीह सततं च तदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: asyāṃ kṣitau dhṛtā lokāḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti bhāsvarāḥ / tānahaṃ dhārayā mīha satataṃ ca tadājñayā
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यं हि देवानां ते चाप्येकत्र भुञ्जते । नाहं तैः सह भोक्षये वै ततो दास्यन्ति ते पृथक्
verses.transliteration: cāturvarṇyaṃ hi devānāṃ te cāpyekatra bhuñjate / nāhaṃ taiḥ saha bhokṣaye vai tato dāsyanti te pṛthak
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.hindi: जिसके चार देण हैं जो चारों पाश्वों में समधिष्ठित हैं। जिनके नाम भद्राश्व--भरत--केतुपाल और पश्चिम है।५०। उत्तर और कुरु कृतपुण्य प्रतिश्नव हैं । गन्धमादन के पाश्व॑ में तो यह पर अपर गण्डिका है ।५१। ये सभी ऋतुओं में परम रमणीय हैं और निर ही' प्रमुदित तथा शिव हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादवमता दक्ष मत्कृते ऽनागसा सती । प्रशस्ताश्चेतराः सर्वाः स्वसुता भर्तृभिः सह
verses.transliteration: yasmādavamatā dakṣa matkṛte 'nāgasā satī / praśastāścetarāḥ sarvāḥ svasutā bhartṛbhiḥ saha
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.hindi: दू्वेओर'पण्चिम से बत्तीस'सहस् योजनों से युक्त हैं ।१२। प्रमाण से इनका आयाम चौंत्तीस सहसूं योजनों वाला है । वहाँ पर वे परम शुभ कर्मों वालें केतुमाल' देश" प्रतिष्ठित है ।५३। वहाँ पर जब नर'काल हैं जो' महान् सत्वं बालें और: महिन् बल से सम्पन्न है और वहाँ की स्त्रिय! कमलदल की
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: तस्मा द्वैवस्वते प्राप्ते पुनरेते महर्षयः । उत्पत्स्यन्ते द्वितीये वै मम यज्ञ ह्ययोनिचाः
verses.transliteration: tasmā dvaivasvate prāpte punarete maharṣayaḥ / utpatsyante dvitīye vai mama yajña hyayonicāḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.hindi: आभा वॉली तथा देखने में बहुत प्रिय लगती हैं ।१४। बहा पर एक बहुत ही उत्तम पनस का महान वृक्ष है जिसमें छरसः विद्यमान रहा करते हैं। उसकी स्वामी ब्रह्मा का पुत्र कामना से चरण करने वाले 'मनोजय' हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: यतः पतिः स भगवान् प्रजेशानां प्रजापतिः । भावनः सर्वभूतानां सर्वात्मा नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: yataḥ patiḥ sa bhagavān prajeśānāṃ prajāpatiḥ / bhāvanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvātmā nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: औषधीः प्रतिसंधत्ते रुद्रः क्षीणाः पुनःपुनः । प्रजापतिमुखैर्देवैः सम्यगिष्टफलार्थिभिः
verses.transliteration: auṣadhīḥ pratisaṃdhatte rudraḥ kṣīṇāḥ punaḥpunaḥ / prajāpatimukhairdevaiḥ samyagiṣṭaphalārthibhiḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिरेव कपालैश्च त्रयंबकैरौषधिक्षये । इज्यते भगवान् यस्मात्तस्मार्त्र्यंबक उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tribhireva kapālaiśca trayaṃbakairauṣadhikṣaye / ijyate bhagavān yasmāttasmārtryaṃbaka ucyate
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: गायत्री चैव त्रिष्टुप्च जगती चैव याः स्मृताः । त्र्यंबका नामतः प्रेम्णा योनयस्ता वनस्पतेः
verses.transliteration: gāyatrī caiva triṣṭupca jagatī caiva yāḥ smṛtāḥ / tryaṃbakā nāmataḥ premṇā yonayastā vanaspateḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: ताभिरेकत्वभूताभिस्त्रिविधाभिः स्ववीर्यतः । त्रिसाधनः पुरोडाशस्त्रिकपालः स वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tābhirekatvabhūtābhistrividhābhiḥ svavīryataḥ / trisādhanaḥ puroḍāśastrikapālaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यंबकः स पुरोडाशस्तेनैष त्र्यंबकः स्मृतः । इत्येतत्पञ्चवर्षं हि युगं प्रोक्तं मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: tryaṃbakaḥ sa puroḍāśastenaiṣa tryaṃbakaḥ smṛtaḥ / ityetatpañcavarṣaṃ hi yugaṃ proktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैष पञ्चधात्मा वै प्रोक्तः संवत्सरो द्विजैः । सैकः षट्को विजज्ञे ऽथ मध्वादिऋतुसंज्ञकः
verses.transliteration: yaścaiṣa pañcadhātmā vai proktaḥ saṃvatsaro dvijaiḥ / saikaḥ ṣaṭko vijajñe 'tha madhvādiṛtusaṃjñakaḥ
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.hindi: हैं। और जो दक्षिण में होने वाले दूसरे जनपद हैं उनका भी ज्ञान प्राप्त करलो ।५७-५९। सूर्यारक-कलिवन-गुर्गाल-कुन्तल-पौलेय--किरात--रूपक- तापक-करोति ओर सब-करल्घर और नासिकः तथा जो अस्प? नमंदा के अन्तर में हैं ।६०-६१। . सहकरच्छ-समाडेय-सारस्वत-कच्छिप-सुराष्ट्रआनतं-
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुपुत्रार्त्तवाः पञ्च इति सर्गः समासतः । इत्येष बहुमानो वै प्राणिना जीवितानि च । नदीवेग इवासक्तः कालो धावति संहरन्
verses.transliteration: ṛtuputrārttavāḥ pañca iti sargaḥ samāsataḥ / ityeṣa bahumāno vai prāṇinā jīvitāni ca / nadīvega ivāsaktaḥ kālo dhāvati saṃharan
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.hindi: अबुद--यै सब और अपरान्त जो विम्ध्य कें बास करने वाले हैं उनको आप सुनिये । मलद-करुष मेकल-उत्कल-ये जनपद विन्ध्य के वास करने वाले हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां यदपत्यं वै तदशक्यं प्रमाणतः । बहुत्वात्परिसंख्यातुं पुत्र पौत्रमनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ yadapatyaṃ vai tadaśakyaṃ pramāṇataḥ / bahutvātparisaṃkhyātuṃ putra pautramanantakam
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: इमं वंशं प्रजेशानां महतः पुण्यकर्मणाम् । कीर्त्तयन्पुण्यकीर्त्तीनां महतीं सिद्धिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ vaṃśaṃ prajeśānāṃ mahataḥ puṇyakarmaṇām / kīrttayanpuṇyakīrttīnāṃ mahatīṃ siddhimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.wordMeaning: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and
verses.commentary: Sense: Tejas (fiery brilliance) was the son of Bala and

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे कालसद्भाववर्णनं नाम त्रयोदश्ॐऽध्याय सुत उवाच अथान्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह । तुल्याभिमानिनः सर्वे जायन्ते नामरूपतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde kālasadbhāvavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśoṃ'dhyāya suta uvāca athāntareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣviha / tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve jāyante nāmarūpataḥ
verses.translation: In all the Manvantaras of the past and the future, all the subjects are bom with similar identification in regard to names and forms.'
verses.wordMeaning: In all the Manvantaras of the past and the future, all the subjects are bom with similar identification in regard to names and forms.'
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the Manvantaras of the past and the future, all the subjects are bom with similar identification in regard to names and forms.'

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्चाष्टविधा ये च तस्मिन्मम्वन्तरे ऽधिपाः । ऋषयो मनवश्चैव सर्वे तुल्यप्रयोजनाः
verses.transliteration: devāścāṣṭavidhā ye ca tasminmamvantare 'dhipāḥ / ṛṣayo manavaścaiva sarve tulyaprayojanāḥ
verses.translation: The year, laid to be of five souls (vide V.i 19), is again divided into six divisioAS according to season (ffiu).
verses.wordMeaning: The year, laid to be of five souls (vide V.i 19), is again divided into six divisioAS according to season (ffiu).
verses.commentary: Sense: The year, laid to be of five souls (vide V.i 19), is again divided into six divisioAS according to season (ffiu).

verses.sanskrit: महर्षिसर्गः संक्रान्तो वंशं स्वायंभुवस्य तु । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च कीर्त्य मानं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: maharṣisargaḥ saṃkrānto vaṃśaṃ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca kīrtya mānaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: This IS the main thesu of the Purfiga. This chapter deab with Punmk coonogrhy. It tttociates the names of continents (Afhii) %vitb the dcscea* daats of Svftyambhuva Manu. For similar dcscripiion vide A. , KP.I.40 Bh. P.V 16.1-26, Mt.P.U2, 121, 122.
verses.wordMeaning: This IS the main thesu of the Purfiga. This chapter deab with Punmk coonogrhy. It tttociates the names of continents (Afhii) %vitb the dcscea* daats of Svftyambhuva Manu. For similar dcscripiion vide A. , KP.I.40 Bh. P.V 16.1-26, Mt.P.U2, 121, 122.
verses.commentary: Sense: This IS the main thesu of the Purfiga. This chapter deab with Punmk coonogrhy. It tttociates the names of continents (Afhii) %vitb the dcscea* daats of Svftyambhuva Manu. For similar dcscripiion vide A. , KP.I.40 Bh. P.V 16.1-26, Mt.P.U2, 121, 122.

verses.sanskrit: मनोः स्वायंभूवस्यासन् दश पौत्रास्तु तत्समाः । यैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपत्तना
verses.transliteration: manoḥ svāyaṃbhūvasyāsan daśa pautrāstu tatsamāḥ / yairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā
verses.translation: The Devas who are of eight types are the overlords in that Manvantara. The sages and the Manus—alt of them serve the same purpose.
verses.hindi: उत्तमों के दशाण॑-भोज-किव्किन्धकन्तोशल-कोशप--त्रोपुर--लैंदिशः -तुहुण्ड--वर्ब र-षद्पुर--नेषध-- अनूप -- तुण्डिके र--बी तिहो क-- अब स्ति' यें सब जनपद विन्ध्य गिरि के ऊपर' निवास करने वाले हैं इसके आगेः मैं उन देशों का वर्णन कखेंगा जो पर्वतो का आशयत ग्रहण 'करकेःनिवासः
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who are of eight types are the overlords in that Manvantara. The sages and the Manus—alt of them serve the same purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who are of eight types are the overlords in that Manvantara. The sages and the Manus—alt of them serve the same purpose.

verses.sanskrit: ससमुद्रा करवती प्रतिवर्षं निवेशिता । स्वायंभुवेंऽतरे पूर्वमाद्ये त्रेतायुगे तथा
verses.transliteration: sasamudrā karavatī prativarṣaṃ niveśitā / svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare pūrvamādye tretāyuge tathā
verses.translation: Kimya that extremely fortunate daughter of Kar- dama the Prajipati, bore unto Priyavrata heroic sons endowed with their own progeny.*
verses.hindi: किया'करतें हैं ।६४-६६। निहीर-हंसमार्ग-कुपथन्त ङ्कणन्शक-अपः प्रावरण ऊदे हुङवैक-तिगर्त-मण्डलनकिरात-्तामर-ये समस्त देश' पर्ेतों के ऊपर' समाश्रय लेने वाले हैं। ऋषियों ने भारतवर्ष में चार युगों का होना वतन लाया था । प्रथम कृतयुग अर्थात् सत्ययुग हैः-दूसरा' त्ेता;- तीसरा  द्वापरः
verses.wordMeaning: Kimya that extremely fortunate daughter of Kar- dama the Prajipati, bore unto Priyavrata heroic sons endowed with their own progeny.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Kimya that extremely fortunate daughter of Kar- dama the Prajipati, bore unto Priyavrata heroic sons endowed with their own progeny.*

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतस्य पुत्रैस्तैः पौत्रैः स्वायंभुवस्य तु । प्रजा सत्त्वतपोयुक्तैस्तैरियं विनिवेशिता
verses.transliteration: priyavratasya putraistaiḥ pautraiḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu / prajā sattvatapoyuktaistairiyaṃ viniveśitā
verses.translation: The race of Priyavrata:
verses.hindi: और चौथा तिष्यःहै। इन सबका निसगे ऊपर सेहीं सम्पूर्ण मैं आपको
verses.wordMeaning: The race of Priyavrata:
verses.commentary: Sense: The race of Priyavrata:

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतात्प्रजोपेतान् वीरान्काम्यान्व्यजायत । कन्या सा तु महाभाग कर्दमस्य प्रजा पतेः
verses.transliteration: priyavratātprajopetān vīrānkāmyānvyajāyata / kanyā sā tu mahābhāga kardamasya prajā pateḥ
verses.translation: Priyavrata crowned seven of them in seven-continents as kings with due religious rites. Understand them as well as those continents.
verses.wordMeaning: Priyavrata crowned seven of them in seven-continents as kings with due religious rites. Understand them as well as those continents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Priyavrata crowned seven of them in seven-continents as kings with due religious rites. Understand them as well as those continents.

verses.sanskrit: कन्ये द्वे दश पुत्राश्च सम्राट् कुक्षिश्च ते शुभे । तयोर्वै भ्रातरः शूराः प्रजापतिसमा दश
verses.transliteration: kanye dve daśa putrāśca samrāṭ kukṣiśca te śubhe / tayorvai bhrātaraḥ śūrāḥ prajāpatisamā daśa
verses.translation: He crowned Vapusman (Earlier mentioned as Vaau) as king in the Salmala dvipa. The lord madejyotisman, the king in Kuia dvipa.
verses.wordMeaning: He crowned Vapusman (Earlier mentioned as Vaau) as king in the Salmala dvipa. The lord madejyotisman, the king in Kuia dvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Vapusman (Earlier mentioned as Vaau) as king in the Salmala dvipa. The lord madejyotisman, the king in Kuia dvipa.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नीध्रश्चाग्निबा हुश्च मेधा मेधातिथिर्वसुः । ज्योतिष्मान् द्युतिमान्हव्यः सवनः सभ्र एव च
verses.transliteration: āgnīdhraścāgnibā huśca medhā medhātithirvasuḥ / jyotiṣmān dyutimānhavyaḥ savanaḥ sabhra eva ca
verses.translation: He coronated Dyutimin as the king in Kraufica dvipa; Priyavrata made Havya the lord of Saka dvipa.
verses.wordMeaning: He coronated Dyutimin as the king in Kraufica dvipa; Priyavrata made Havya the lord of Saka dvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He coronated Dyutimin as the king in Kraufica dvipa; Priyavrata made Havya the lord of Saka dvipa.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतो ऽभ्यषिञ्चत्तान्सप्तसप्तसु पार्थिवान् । द्वीपेषु तेषु धर्मेण द्वीपान्ताश्च निबोधत
verses.transliteration: priyavrato 'bhyaṣiñcattānsaptasaptasu pārthivān / dvīpeṣu teṣu dharmeṇa dvīpāntāśca nibodhata
verses.translation: VV.1&22. The seven sub-divisions ol Ssksdvipa are named after the seven sons of Havya.
verses.wordMeaning: VV.1&22. The seven sub-divisions ol Ssksdvipa are named after the seven sons of Havya.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.1&22. The seven sub-divisions ol Ssksdvipa are named after the seven sons of Havya.

verses.sanskrit: जंबूद्वीपेश्वरं चक्रे आग्नीध्रं सुमहाबलम् । प्लक्षद्वीपेश्वरश्चापि तेन मेधातिथिः कृतः
verses.transliteration: jaṃbūdvīpeśvaraṃ cakre āgnīdhraṃ sumahābalam / plakṣadvīpeśvaraścāpi tena medhātithiḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Lords of Salmala were (as if) embellished with subjects endowed with the disciplined conduct of life pertain¬ ing to the various Aramas (stages of life).
verses.wordMeaning: The Lords of Salmala were (as if) embellished with subjects endowed with the disciplined conduct of life pertain¬ ing to the various Aramas (stages of life).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lords of Salmala were (as if) embellished with subjects endowed with the disciplined conduct of life pertain¬ ing to the various Aramas (stages of life).

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मले तु वपुष्मन्तं राजानं सो ऽभिषिक्तवान् । ज्योतिष्मन्तं कुशद्वीपे राजानं कृतवान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: śālmale tu vapuṣmantaṃ rājānaṃ so 'bhiṣiktavān / jyotiṣmantaṃ kuśadvīpe rājānaṃ kṛtavānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: They were Sveta, Harita, Jimuta Rohita, Vaidyuia Manasa and Suprabha, the seventh one.
verses.wordMeaning: They were Sveta, Harita, Jimuta Rohita, Vaidyuia Manasa and Suprabha, the seventh one.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Sveta, Harita, Jimuta Rohita, Vaidyuia Manasa and Suprabha, the seventh one.

verses.sanskrit: द्युतिमन्तं च राजानं क्रैञ्चद्वीपे ऽभ्यषेचयत् । शाकद्वीपेश्वरं चापि हव्यं चक्रे प्रियव्रतः
verses.transliteration: dyutimantaṃ ca rājānaṃ kraiñcadvīpe 'bhyaṣecayat / śākadvīpeśvaraṃ cāpi havyaṃ cakre priyavrataḥ
verses.translation: W.22-26 eaumerate te\ea tub-diviuons of Krauficadvipa which are named after the seven sons of Dyutimin.
verses.hindi: काष्ठा निमेषा दश पंच चेव त्रिणच्च काष्ठा गणयेत्कलां तु ।
verses.wordMeaning: W.22-26 eaumerate te\ea tub-diviuons of Krauficadvipa which are named after the seven sons of Dyutimin.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.22-26 eaumerate te\ea tub-diviuons of Krauficadvipa which are named after the seven sons of Dyutimin.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्कराधिपतिं चैव सवनं कृतवान्प्रभुः । पुष्करे सवनस्याथ महावीतः सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: puṣkarādhipatiṃ caiva savanaṃ kṛtavānprabhuḥ / puṣkare savanasyātha mahāvītaḥ suto 'bhavat
verses.translation: W.27-30. The seven sub-dtvukuu of Kuiadvipa are named aAer the seven sons of Jyotifoan, long of Kuiadpa.
verses.wordMeaning: W.27-30. The seven sub-dtvukuu of Kuiadvipa are named aAer the seven sons of Jyotifoan, long of Kuiadpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.27-30. The seven sub-dtvukuu of Kuiadvipa are named aAer the seven sons of Jyotifoan, long of Kuiadpa.

verses.sanskrit: धातकिश्चापि द्वावेतौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवता वरौ । महावीतं स्मृतं वर्षं तस्य नाम्ना महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dhātakiścāpi dvāvetau putrau putravatā varau / mahāvītaṃ smṛtaṃ varṣaṃ tasya nāmnā mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The seven sons of Vipufinin mentioned in the neat verse have given
verses.wordMeaning: The seven sons of Vipufinin mentioned in the neat verse have given
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven sons of Vipufinin mentioned in the neat verse have given

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना च धातकेश्चापि धातकीखण्ड उच्यते । हव्यो व्यजनयत्पुत्राञ् शाकद्वीपेश्वराञ् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nāmnā ca dhātakeścāpi dhātakīkhaṇḍa ucyate / havyo vyajanayatputrāñ śākadvīpeśvarāñ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: I shall recount Plakvipa after the Jambudvipa. The seven sons of Medhatithi were the kings ruling over Plakadvlpa.
verses.hindi: ऋषि ने कहा--जो चार युग हैं और पूर्व में स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर में थेः। है भगवन! उनका जिसमे कंसे हुआ और उनका क्या तत्व है-यह मैं विस्तार के साथ श्रवण करना चाहता हैं ।१। श्रीसूत -जी ने कहा--पृथिवी आदि के प्रसंग से जो मैने पूर्व में कहा था उनके चारों युगों के विषय में मैं
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount Plakvipa after the Jambudvipa. The seven sons of Medhatithi were the kings ruling over Plakadvlpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount Plakvipa after the Jambudvipa. The seven sons of Medhatithi were the kings ruling over Plakadvlpa.

verses.sanskrit: जलदं च कुमारं च सुकुमारं मणीवकम् । कुसुमोत्तरमोदाकौ सप्तमं च महाद्रुगम्
verses.transliteration: jaladaṃ ca kumāraṃ ca sukumāraṃ maṇīvakam / kusumottaramodākau saptamaṃ ca mahādrugam
verses.translation: Priyavrata installed Agnidhra, the extremely power¬ ful son of K&myi and his eldest successor as the king and over- lord of Jambudvipa.
verses.hindi: अवः चतलाऊेगा । उसको आप भली-भाँति समझ लीजिए ॥२। यहाँ पर संख्या के द्वारा प्रसंख्यान करके और सब प्रकार से विस्तृत मैं कहैगा-। युगः्युग का भेद-युग का धर्म-युग सन्धि का अंश-युग सनधान-यह षट् प्रकाश युग को आख्या है। उन सबको मैं तात्विक रूप से आपको बतलाऊेगा।३-४।'
verses.wordMeaning: Priyavrata installed Agnidhra, the extremely power¬ ful son of K&myi and his eldest successor as the king and over- lord of Jambudvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Priyavrata installed Agnidhra, the extremely power¬ ful son of K&myi and his eldest successor as the king and over- lord of Jambudvipa.

verses.sanskrit: जलदं जलदस्याथ प्रथमं वर्षमुच्यते । कुमारस्य तु कौमारं द्वितीयं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: jaladaṃ jaladasyātha prathamaṃ varṣamucyate / kumārasya tu kaumāraṃ dvitīyaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: W.3e-40 enumerate seven sons of king Mcdhitithi, who became kings of te v qi Varyas—tub-cootincxits—which were named after their founder-kings.
verses.hindi: लौकिक प्रमाण -मनुष्य के वर्ष का निष्पादन करके उसो शब्द से प्रसंख्यान' करके यहाँ पर मैं चारों युगों को बतलाऊगा । निमेष काल उसे ही 'जानना' चाहिए जो कि लघु अक्षर के तुल्य होता है ।५। पन्द्रहनिमेषों: का जितना: काल होता है उप्तकी एक काक्षा होती है ओर तीस काक्षाओं के समय को
verses.wordMeaning: W.3e-40 enumerate seven sons of king Mcdhitithi, who became kings of te v qi Varyas—tub-cootincxits—which were named after their founder-kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.3e-40 enumerate seven sons of king Mcdhitithi, who became kings of te v qi Varyas—tub-cootincxits—which were named after their founder-kings.

verses.sanskrit: सुकुमारं तृतीयं तु सुकुमारस्य तत्स्सतम् । मणीवस्य चतुर्थं तु मणीवकमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: sukumāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu sukumārasya tatssatam / maṇīvasya caturthaṃ tu maṇīvakamihocyate
verses.translation: W.4M9 deKribe the e«Bmo& fhatura of the five cootmentsfrom Hakya to Sfikadvlpa.
verses.hindi: कला गिना चाहिए । तीस कलाओं का एक मुहूतं होता है । तीस मुहूत के सम रात्रि और दिन हुआ करते हैं ।६॥ दिन और रात्रि का विभाग सूये किया करता है जो कि मनुष्य का लौकिक होता है
verses.wordMeaning: W.4M9 deKribe the e«Bmo& fhatura of the five cootmentsfrom Hakya to Sfikadvlpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.4M9 deKribe the e«Bmo& fhatura of the five cootmentsfrom Hakya to Sfikadvlpa.

verses.sanskrit: कुसुमोत्तरवर्षं यत्पञ्चमं कुसुमोत्तरम् । मोदकस्यापि मोदाकं षष्ठं वर्षं प्रकीर्त्तितम्
verses.transliteration: kusumottaravarṣaṃ yatpañcamaṃ kusumottaram / modakasyāpi modākaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ varṣaṃ prakīrttitam
verses.translation: AgiUdhra crowned those sons in due order in those sub-continents. Tliereafter, that pious-souled one became enga¬ ged in penance.
verses.wordMeaning: AgiUdhra crowned those sons in due order in those sub-continents. Tliereafter, that pious-souled one became enga¬ ged in penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: AgiUdhra crowned those sons in due order in those sub-continents. Tliereafter, that pious-souled one became enga¬ ged in penance.

verses.sanskrit: महाद्रुमस्य नाम्ना च सप्तमं तन्महाद्रुमम् । तेषां तु नामभिस्तानि सप्त वर्षाणि तत्र वै
verses.transliteration: mahādrumasya nāmnā ca saptamaṃ tanmahādrumam / teṣāṃ tu nāmabhistāni sapta varṣāṇi tatra vai
verses.translation: Thus the entire earth consisting of the seven conti¬ nents was colonized by the seven sons of Priyavrata, who were the grandsons of Sv&yambhuva Manu.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the entire earth consisting of the seven conti¬ nents was colonized by the seven sons of Priyavrata, who were the grandsons of Sv&yambhuva Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the entire earth consisting of the seven conti¬ nents was colonized by the seven sons of Priyavrata, who were the grandsons of Sv&yambhuva Manu.

verses.sanskrit: क्रैञ्चद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि पुत्रो द्युतिमतस्तु वै । कुशलो मनोनुगस्छोष्णः पावनश्चान्धकारकः
verses.transliteration: kraiñcadvīpeśvarasyāpi putro dyutimatastu vai / kuśalo manonugaschoṣṇaḥ pāvanaścāndhakārakaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, when annihilation takes place, these seven settlements (continents) are created again and again by the kings in all the seven sub-continents.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, when annihilation takes place, these seven settlements (continents) are created again and again by the kings in all the seven sub-continents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, when annihilation takes place, these seven settlements (continents) are created again and again by the kings in all the seven sub-continents.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिश्च दुन्दुभिश्चैव सुता द्युतिमतस्तु वै । तेषां स्वनामभिर्देशाः क्रैञ्चद्वीपाश्रयाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: muniśca dundubhiścaiva sutā dyutimatastu vai / teṣāṃ svanāmabhirdeśāḥ kraiñcadvīpāśrayāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Jaina tradition supports tUs theory regardin the nante of BhArata-
verses.hindi: शतानि चीणि मासानां षष्टघा चाप्यधिकानि वै ।
verses.wordMeaning: Jaina tradition supports tUs theory regardin the nante of BhArata-
verses.commentary: Sense: Jaina tradition supports tUs theory regardin the nante of BhArata-

verses.sanskrit: कुशलस्य तु देशो ऽभूत कौशलो नाम विश्रुतः । देशो मनोनुगस्यापि मानोनुगे इते स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kuśalasya tu deśo 'bhūta kauśalo nāma viśrutaḥ / deśo manonugasyāpi mānonuge ite smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: उष्णस्योष्णः स्मृतो देशः पावनस्यापि पावनः । अन्धकारस्य देशस्तु आन्धकारः प्रकीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: uṣṇasyoṣṇaḥ smṛto deśaḥ pāvanasyāpi pāvanaḥ / andhakārasya deśastu āndhakāraḥ prakīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.hindi: लौकिकेनैव मानेन त्यव्बो यो मानुषः, स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: मुनेश्च मौनिदेशो वै दुन्दुभेर्दुन्दुभिः स्मृतः । एते जनपदाः सप्त क्रैञ्चद्वीपे तु भास्वराः
verses.transliteration: muneśca maunideśo vai dundubherdundubhiḥ smṛtaḥ / ete janapadāḥ sapta kraiñcadvīpe tu bhāsvarāḥ
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मतः कुशद्वीपे सप्तैवासन्महौजसः । उद्भिज्जो वेणुमांश्चैव वैरथो लवणो धृतिः
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣmataḥ kuśadvīpe saptaivāsanmahaujasaḥ / udbhijjo veṇumāṃścaiva vairatho lavaṇo dhṛtiḥ
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.hindi: ये ते राज्यहनी दिव्ये प्रसंख्यानं तयोः पुनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठः प्रभाकरश्चा पि सप्तमः कपिलः स्मृतः । उद्भिज्जं प्रथमं वर्षं द्वितीयं वेणुमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhaḥ prabhākaraścā pi saptamaḥ kapilaḥ smṛtaḥ / udbhijjaṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ veṇumaṇḍalam
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.hindi: उतमें' दिन तो कर्मों के करने की चेष्टा में लगाया जाता है और रात्रि फ समय सोने के लिए कहा जाता है । दिव्य रावि और दिन मास होता है। उन दोनों या प्रविभाग फिर होता है ।८। उनका कृष्ण पक्षःउनकी'राचिः होती है । मनुष्यों के जो तीस मास होते हैं 'बही पितृगणों का मास कहा
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं वै रथाकारं चतुर्थं लवणं स्मृतम् । पञ्चमं धृतिमद्वर्षं षष्ठं वर्षं प्रभाकरम्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ vai rathākāraṃ caturthaṃ lavaṇaṃ smṛtam / pañcamaṃ dhṛtimadvarṣaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ varṣaṃ prabhākaram
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.hindi: गया है ।६। तीन सौ साठ मासों का पितृगणो का एक वेषे होता है। यहः संख्या मनुष्यों के मासों से विभावित हुआ करती है ।१०। मनुष्यों के भोन से जो सो वर्ष होते हैं वे पितृगणों के तोन वष संख्यात किये गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तमं कपिलं नाम कपिलस्य प्रकीर्त्तितम् । तेषां देशाः कशद्वीपे तत्सनामान एव च
verses.transliteration: saptamaṃ kapilaṃ nāma kapilasya prakīrttitam / teṣāṃ deśāḥ kaśadvīpe tatsanāmāna eva ca
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.hindi: यहाँ पर दश मास अधिक पितृ गणों की: संड्या संज्ञा बाली- हुई हैः लौकिक मान से ही जो मनुष्यों का शब्द कहा गया है ।६२। यह दिष्यः अर्थात् देनों का अहोरात्र अर्थात् एक दिन ओर रात है जो शास्त्र निश्वयः को प्राप्त हुआ है । दिव्य राजि ओर दिन वर्ष है. ओर उनः दोनों का फिंरः
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमाचारयुक्ताभिः प्रजाभिः समलङ्कृताः । शाल्मलस्येश्वराः सप्त सुतास्ते च वपुष्मतः
verses.transliteration: āśramācārayuktābhiḥ prajābhiḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ / śālmalasyeśvarāḥ sapta sutāste ca vapuṣmataḥ
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.hindi: १७०  ब्रह्माण्ङःपुरांग प्रविभाग है ।१३। वहाँ पर जो दिन है वह उत्तरायण होता है और जो राक्ि है.बहः दक्षिणायन होता है जो वे दिव्य रात्रि ओर दिन हैं उसका पुनः प्रसंख्यान है
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतश्च हरितश्चैव जीमूतो रोहितस्तथा । वैद्युतो मानसश्चापि सुप्रभः सप्तमस्तथा
verses.transliteration: śvetaśca haritaścaiva jīmūto rohitastathā / vaidyuto mānasaścāpi suprabhaḥ saptamastathā
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतस्तु देशः श्वेतस्य हरितस्य सुहारितः । जीमूतस्यापि जीमूतो रोहितस्यापि रोहितः
verses.transliteration: śvetastu deśaḥ śvetasya haritasya suhāritaḥ / jīmūtasyāpi jīmūto rohitasyāpi rohitaḥ
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.hindi: मनुष्यों के जो तीस वर्ष होते हैं उतने समब का देवों का दिव्य मास कहा गया है । जो मानवों के एक सो वपं हैं उतने समय का दिव्य तीन मास हुआ करते'हैं। १५॥ तथा: दश दिन हैं--यही दिव्य-विश्ि,'कही गयी है। तीन' सौ! साठ जजों बघं मनुष्यों केः होते हैं यह एक दिव्य सम्वत्सरः कहा गया है ।
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: वैद्युतो वैद्युतस्यापि मानसस्य तु मानसः । सुप्रभः सुप्रभस्यापि सप्तैते देशपालकाः

verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवेंऽतरे पूर्वं शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । एवं स्वायं भुवः सर्गो येनेदं पूरितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare pūrvaṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / evaṃ svāyaṃ bhuvaḥ sargo yenedaṃ pūritaṃ jagat
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्दैवतैश्चापि पिर्तृगन्धवराक्षसैः । यक्षभूतपिशाचैश्च मनुष्यमृगपक्षिभिः । तेषां सृष्टिरियं प्रोक्ता युगैः सह विवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhirdaivataiścāpi pirtṛgandhavarākṣasaiḥ / yakṣabhūtapiśācaiśca manuṣyamṛgapakṣibhiḥ / teṣāṃ sṛṣṭiriyaṃ proktā yugaiḥ saha vivarttate
verses.translation: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundred sons. All of them were kings. The important one among them was Vivajyotis. It is through thern that these subjects flourished.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे प्रियव्रतवंशानुकीर्त्तनं नाम चतुदशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एवं प्रजासन्निवेशं श्रुत्वा वै शांशपायनिः । पप्रच्छ नियतं सूतं पृथिव्युद धिविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde priyavratavaṃśānukīrttanaṃ nāma catudaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca evaṃ prajāsanniveśaṃ śrutvā vai śāṃśapāyaniḥ / papraccha niyataṃ sūtaṃ pṛthivyuda dhivistaram
verses.translation: (It is full of mountains) endowed with all kinds of minerals originating from clusten of rocks. It is full of rivers flowing from mountains.
verses.wordMeaning: (It is full of mountains) endowed with all kinds of minerals originating from clusten of rocks. It is full of rivers flowing from mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: (It is full of mountains) endowed with all kinds of minerals originating from clusten of rocks. It is full of rivers flowing from mountains.

verses.sanskrit: कति द्वीपा समुद्रा वा पवता वा कति स्मृताः । कियन्ति चैव वर्षाणि तेषु नद्यश्च काः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kati dvīpā samudrā vā pavatā vā kati smṛtāḥ / kiyanti caiva varṣāṇi teṣu nadyaśca kāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: * The following are the six Varsaparvcias (Mountains
verses.hindi: घामिकता के न रहने से मित्र मनुध्यों की मति का मेद हो जाया करता है। ये सब-आफ्स को भी किसी के साथ सहानुभूति नहीं होती है । सन की सृष्टि में विध्रम हो जाया करता है ।। यह घमं है अथवा यहु अधर्म हैं--इसका कोई भो निश्चय नहीं हुआ करता है । कारणों के बिकल्प
verses.wordMeaning: * The following are the six Varsaparvcias (Mountains
verses.commentary: Sense: * The following are the six Varsaparvcias (Mountains

verses.sanskrit: महा भूतप्रमाणं च लोकालोकं तथैव च । पर्यायं परिमाणं च गतिं चन्द्रार्कयोस्तथा । एतत्प्रबूहि नः सर्वं विस्तरेण यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: mahā bhūtapramāṇaṃ ca lokālokaṃ tathaiva ca / paryāyaṃ parimāṇaṃ ca gatiṃ candrārkayostathā / etatprabūhi naḥ sarvaṃ vistareṇa yathārthataḥ
verses.translation: Its northern side has a natural red colour. Hence, the Katriya-hood of Meru on account of various reasons and purposes. (?)
verses.hindi: होने से और कार्यो: के निश्चय नहीं होने से धर्माधमं का कोई निश्चय नहीं: हुआ करता हैँं।९। उन मनुष्यों को मति के विभेद होने से उनकी इष्टियों का भी:विज्ञम हो जाता है । फिर विभिन्न इष्टियों वाले भनुष्यों के दस शास्त्रों को भो अगकुलित कर दिया या ।१०। वेद एक ही था उसको तरेता
verses.wordMeaning: Its northern side has a natural red colour. Hence, the Katriya-hood of Meru on account of various reasons and purposes. (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Its northern side has a natural red colour. Hence, the Katriya-hood of Meru on account of various reasons and purposes. (?)

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच हन्त वो ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि पृथिव्यायामविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca hanta vo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi pṛthivyāyāmavistaram
verses.translation: All these lordly mountains are frequented by the Siddhas and Caranas. Their internal diameter is said to be nine thousand Yojanas.
verses.hindi: युय में चार पादों वाला किया जाता है । आयु के संक्षय होने- से द्वापर युग में यह व्यवस्थित हो जाता है ।११ ऋषियों ने और मन्त्रों के फिर भेदः
verses.wordMeaning: All these lordly mountains are frequented by the Siddhas and Caranas. Their internal diameter is said to be nine thousand Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these lordly mountains are frequented by the Siddhas and Caranas. Their internal diameter is said to be nine thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: संख्यां चैव समुद्राणां द्वीपानां चैव विस्तरम् । द्वीपभेदसहस्राणि सप्तस्वन्तर्गतानि च
verses.transliteration: saṃkhyāṃ caiva samudrāṇāṃ dvīpānāṃ caiva vistaram / dvīpabhedasahasrāṇi saptasvantargatāni ca
verses.translation: The Vara-Parvatas which belong to the six Vars are two thousand Yojanas in extent and in height.
verses.wordMeaning: The Vara-Parvatas which belong to the six Vars are two thousand Yojanas in extent and in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vara-Parvatas which belong to the six Vars are two thousand Yojanas in extent and in height.

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यन्ते क्रमेणेह वक्तुं यैः सततं जगत् । सप्त द्वीपान्प्रवक्ष्यामि चन्द्रादित्यग्रहैः सह
verses.transliteration: na śakyante krameṇeha vaktuṃ yaiḥ satataṃ jagat / sapta dvīpānpravakṣyāmi candrādityagrahaiḥ saha
verses.translation: The two sub-continents in the south and the north should be known as situated in the form of a bow. Four others are stationed lengthwise and the middle one is Ilivfta.
verses.hindi: होने से यह दृष्टि के बि्रमों से युक्त हो जाता है । जिस ३ मन्त्र भाग और आहण आग का विन्यास होता है और म्वरों तथा वरणो का विपये होला है ।१२। महषियों के द्वारा ऋग्वेद-यजुर्वेद और सामवेद की संहितायें पढ़ी जाया करती हैं । कहों पर सामान्य और कहीं-कहीं पर दृष्टि की भिन्नता
verses.wordMeaning: The two sub-continents in the south and the north should be known as situated in the form of a bow. Four others are stationed lengthwise and the middle one is Ilivfta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two sub-continents in the south and the north should be known as situated in the form of a bow. Four others are stationed lengthwise and the middle one is Ilivfta.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मनुष्या स्तर्क्केण प्रमाणानि प्रचक्षते । अचिन्त्याः खलु ये भावा न तांस्तर्केण साधयेत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ manuṣyā starkkeṇa pramāṇāni pracakṣate / acintyāḥ khalu ye bhāvā na tāṃstarkeṇa sādhayet
verses.translation: In the southern side of Vedyardba, there are three Var$as and on the northern side of Vedyardha also there are three Varsas. Meru should be known as existing in between them and Ilavrta is in the middle of Meru.
verses.hindi: होने पर बॅकृत ये पढ़ी जाया है ।१३। ब्राह्मण-कल्प सूत्र और मन्त्र प्रवचन और अन्य भी प्रस्थित हैं और कुछ उनके प्रति अवस्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In the southern side of Vedyardba, there are three Var$as and on the northern side of Vedyardha also there are three Varsas. Meru should be known as existing in between them and Ilavrta is in the middle of Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the southern side of Vedyardba, there are three Var$as and on the northern side of Vedyardha also there are three Varsas. Meru should be known as existing in between them and Ilavrta is in the middle of Meru.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिभ्यः परं यच्च तदचिन्त्यं प्रचक्षते । नववर्षं प्रवक्ष्यामि जंबूद्वीपं यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: prakṛtibhyaḥ paraṃ yacca tadacintyaṃ pracakṣate / navavarṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi jaṃbūdvīpaṃ yathātatham
verses.translation: To the south of the Nila and to the nortli of Nisa* dha, there is a great mountain stretching to the north named Milyavin.*
verses.wordMeaning: To the south of the Nila and to the nortli of Nisa* dha, there is a great mountain stretching to the north named Milyavin.*
verses.commentary: Sense: To the south of the Nila and to the nortli of Nisa* dha, there is a great mountain stretching to the north named Milyavin.*

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरान्मण्डलाच्चैव योजनैस्तन्निबोधत । शतमेकं सहस्राणां योजनाग्रात्समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: vistarānmaṇḍalāccaiva yojanaistannibodhata / śatamekaṃ sahasrāṇāṃ yojanāgrātsamantataḥ
verses.translation: It stretches a thousand Yojanas from Nila to Nia- dha. It is glorified as one, thirtyfour thousand Yojanas in extension.
verses.wordMeaning: It stretches a thousand Yojanas from Nila to Nia- dha. It is glorified as one, thirtyfour thousand Yojanas in extension.
verses.commentary: Sense: It stretches a thousand Yojanas from Nila to Nia- dha. It is glorified as one, thirtyfour thousand Yojanas in extension.

verses.sanskrit: नानाजनपदाकीर्णः पुरैश्च विविधैश्शुभैः । सिद्धचारणसंकीणः पर्वतैरुपशोभितः
verses.transliteration: nānājanapadākīrṇaḥ puraiśca vividhaiśśubhaiḥ / siddhacāraṇasaṃkīṇaḥ parvatairupaśobhitaḥ
verses.translation: The mountain Gandhamadana should be known as situated to its west. In length and extent it is reputed to be like Milyavan.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Gandhamadana should be known as situated to its west. In length and extent it is reputed to be like Milyavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Gandhamadana should be known as situated to its west. In length and extent it is reputed to be like Milyavan.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वधातुनिबद्धैश्च शिलाजाल समुद्भवैः । पर्वतप्रभवाभिश्च नदीभिः सर्वतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvadhātunibaddhaiśca śilājāla samudbhavaiḥ / parvataprabhavābhiśca nadībhiḥ sarvatastataḥ
verses.translation: Called Veyaddba in Jain (Ardha MagadhI) canon.
verses.hindi: यह सब कुछ द्वापर युग में प्रवृत्त होते हैं जर कलियुग में भी सभी अद-अरुद निवृत्त हो जाते हैं । एक आव्क्यंक था और फिर दो प्रकार हो गये थे।१४। साधारण और विपरित अचो के द्वारा यह शास्त्र आकुल कर दिया गया था यह बहुधा आध्वर्यव के व्याकुली- कृत प्रस्थानों के द्वारा ही
verses.wordMeaning: Called Veyaddba in Jain (Ardha MagadhI) canon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Called Veyaddba in Jain (Ardha MagadhI) canon.

verses.sanskrit: जंबूद्वीपः पृथुः श्रीमान् सर्वतः पृथुमण्डलः । नवभिश्चावृतः सर्वो भुवनैर्भूतभावनैः
verses.transliteration: jaṃbūdvīpaḥ pṛthuḥ śrīmān sarvataḥ pṛthumaṇḍalaḥ / navabhiścāvṛtaḥ sarvo bhuvanairbhūtabhāvanaiḥ
verses.translation: Pur&nas give different locatioQS of Gandhamidana and Milyav&n.
verses.hindi: हुआ था ।१६। तथा अर्यात् उसो प्रकार से संज्ञा केद्वासा अथर्ग-ऋचू और सामों के विकल्पों से भी हुआ था नित्य ही इस तरह से व्याकुल द्वापर में विभिन्‍न दर्शन शास्त्रों कै द्वारा किया जाता है ।१७। संख्या ले उनके भेद" प्रतीभेद-और बिकल्प ढापर युग में भली-आांति प्रदृत्त होते हैं और फिर जब
verses.wordMeaning: Pur&nas give different locatioQS of Gandhamidana and Milyav&n.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pur&nas give different locatioQS of Gandhamidana and Milyav&n.

verses.sanskrit: लवणेन समुद्रेण सर्वतः परिवारितः । जंबूद्वीपस्य विस्तारात् समेन तु समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: lavaṇena samudreṇa sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ / jaṃbūdvīpasya vistārāt samena tu samantataḥ
verses.translation: The brilliant Sumcru shiaeSf established like a king» It has the colour and brilltancc of the midday sun. It is re* fulgent like the smokeless fire.
verses.hindi: कलियुग आ जाता है तो सभी विनष्ट हो जाया करते हैं ।१८। द्वापर मैं फिर
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliant Sumcru shiaeSf established like a king» It has the colour and brilltancc of the midday sun. It is re* fulgent like the smokeless fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliant Sumcru shiaeSf established like a king» It has the colour and brilltancc of the midday sun. It is re* fulgent like the smokeless fire.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागायताः सूपर्वाणः षडिमे वर्षपर्वताः । अवगाढा ह्युभयतः मसुद्रौ पूर्वपश्चिमौ
verses.transliteration: prāgāyatāḥ sūparvāṇaḥ ṣaḍime varṣaparvatāḥ / avagāḍhā hyubhayataḥ masudrau pūrvapaścimau
verses.translation: This >pesn to be the four<of»inent (Colur-ipf) theory about the earth where the distributioG Vanas is as follows:
verses.hindi: उनके विपरीत समुत्पन्न हो जाते हैं। दृष्टि का अक्राव-व्याधि-उपद्रव-मरण- थे सब होते हैं ।१९। कायिक, वाबिक और मानसिक सभी प्रकार के दुःख होते हैं और उन दुःखों के समुदाय से फिर मनों निर्नेद उत्पन्न हो जाता है । यह समी निस्सार है--ऐसा जब नि्गेद हृदयों में होता है लो फिर उन
verses.wordMeaning: This >pesn to be the four<of»inent (Colur-ipf) theory about the earth where the distributioG Vanas is as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This >pesn to be the four<of»inent (Colur-ipf) theory about the earth where the distributioG Vanas is as follows:

verses.sanskrit: हिमप्रायश्च हिमवान् हेमकूटश्च हेमवान् । सर्वर्त्तुषु सुखश्चापि निषधः पर्वतो महान्
verses.transliteration: himaprāyaśca himavān hemakūṭaśca hemavān / sarvarttuṣu sukhaścāpi niṣadhaḥ parvato mahān
verses.translation: All the men there are black and very strong. They have great inherent vitality. The women have the colour and lustre of the petals of lilies. All of them are pleasing to behold.
verses.hindi: प्राणियों के हूदयों में इन सब दुःखों से छुटकारा पाने का विचार होला है ।२०। ऐसी जब विचारणा होती है तो उससे सबके प्रसि विरागता हो जाया करती है और उस ैराग्य से ओगोपमोमों में दोषों का दर्शन होने लगता है। दोषों के देखने से ही द्वापर में अश्ञान को उत्पत्ति हो जाली है
verses.wordMeaning: All the men there are black and very strong. They have great inherent vitality. The women have the colour and lustre of the petals of lilies. All of them are pleasing to behold.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the men there are black and very strong. They have great inherent vitality. The women have the colour and lustre of the petals of lilies. All of them are pleasing to behold.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वर्णश्च सौवर्णो मेरुश्चारुतमः स्मृतः । द्वात्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि विस्तीर्णः स च मूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: caturvarṇaśca sauvarṇo meruścārutamaḥ smṛtaḥ / dvātriṃśacca sahasrāṇi vistīrṇaḥ sa ca mūrddhani
verses.translation: They drink the juice of its fruits and live for ten thousand years.
verses.wordMeaning: They drink the juice of its fruits and live for ten thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: They drink the juice of its fruits and live for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्ताकृतिप्रमाणश्च चतुरस्रः समुच्छ्रितः । नानावर्णास्तु पार्श्वेषु प्रजापतिगुणान्वितः
verses.transliteration: vṛttākṛtipramāṇaśca caturasraḥ samucchritaḥ / nānāvarṇāstu pārśveṣu prajāpatiguṇānvitaḥ
verses.translation: It has the same length and extent as the western GapdikA. Bhadr&ivas should be known (as the people) there* They are always delighted in their minds.
verses.wordMeaning: It has the same length and extent as the western GapdikA. Bhadr&ivas should be known (as the people) there* They are always delighted in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has the same length and extent as the western GapdikA. Bhadr&ivas should be known (as the people) there* They are always delighted in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: नाभिबन्धनसंभूतो ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः । पूर्वतर्ः श्वेतवर्णश्च ब्राह्मणस्तस्य तेन तत्

verses.sanskrit: पार्श्वमुत्तरतस्तस्य रक्तवर्मः स्वभावतः । तेनास्य क्षत्त्रभावस्तु मेरोर्नानार्थकारणात्
verses.transliteration: pārśvamuttaratastasya raktavarmaḥ svabhāvataḥ / tenāsya kṣattrabhāvastu merornānārthakāraṇāt
verses.translation: Their limbs are cool of touch like the moon. They have the odour of lilies. Their span of life is ten thousand years and 28 free from ailments.
verses.hindi: उन शान से रहित मानवों से पढिने स्वायम्तुय मन्वन्तर में जो कि सबसे पहिला है उस द्वापर में सभी शास्त्रों के परिपन्थो अर्थात् विरोध करने वाले लोग समुत्पत्त हो जाया करते हैं ।२२। रोगों के विषय में आपु- बेंद शास्त्र का विकल्प और ज्योतिष शास्त्र का विकल शास्त्र के विषय
verses.wordMeaning: Their limbs are cool of touch like the moon. They have the odour of lilies. Their span of life is ten thousand years and 28 free from ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their limbs are cool of touch like the moon. They have the odour of lilies. Their span of life is ten thousand years and 28 free from ailments.

verses.sanskrit: पीतश्च दक्षिणेनासौ तेन वैश्यत्वमिष्यते । भृङ्गपत्रनिभश्चापि पश्चिमेन समाचितः
verses.transliteration: pītaśca dakṣiṇenāsau tena vaiśyatvamiṣyate / bhṛṅgapatranibhaścāpi paścimena samācitaḥ
verses.translation: Tha Menu to be modem Ghins.
verses.hindi: में विकल्प और हेतु शास्त्र का विकल्प है ।२३। कल्फसुओं की क्रिया, भाष्य विद्या का विकल्प और स्मृति शास्त्रों के प्रभेद ऐसे अलग-अलग प्रस्थान हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Tha Menu to be modem Ghins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tha Menu to be modem Ghins.

verses.sanskrit: तेनास्य शूद्रभावः स्यादिति वर्णाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः । वृत्तः स्वभावतः प्रोक्तो वर्णतः परिमाणतः

verses.translation: Ideatified with aacieni Sogriiens si the dacriptioii ullhfs with the Uodi pUnt-life and pele of ihoM tiiaei, M.Ali/Kd. p -84.

verses.wordMeaning: Ideatified with aacieni Sogriiens si the dacriptioii ullhfs with the Uodi pUnt-life and pele of ihoM tiiaei, M.Ali/Kd. p -84.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ideatified with aacieni Sogriiens si the dacriptioii ullhfs with the Uodi pUnt-life and pele of ihoM tiiaei, M.Ali/Kd. p -84.

verses.sanskrit: एते पर्वतराजानः सिद्धचारणसेविताः । तेषामन्तरविष्कंभो नवसाहस्र उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ete parvatarājānaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ / teṣāmantaraviṣkaṃbho navasāhasra ucyate
verses.translation: The trees there have Madhu (honey, wine) for its fruit. They put forth perpetual Sowers, fruits and sprouts. They yield garments and ornaments by way of fruits.
verses.hindi: पूर्णतया विध्वंस हो जाता है और प्राणियों में प्रायः काम और क्रोध उत्पन्न हो जाया करते हैं ।२७। द्वापर युग में लोगों के मनों में र।म-लोभ और वध' करने की भावनायें उत्पन्न हो जामा करती है । द्वापर के आदि में ब्यासदेव जी ने वेद के चार भाग किये थे

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये त्विलावृतं नाम महामेरोः समन्तमः । नवैवं तु सहस्राणि विस्तीर्णं सर्वतस्तु तत्

verses.transliteration: madhye tasya mahāmerurvidhūma iva pāvakaḥ / vedyarddhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ meroruttarārddhaṃ tathottaram
verses.translation: Other trees arc ksirlns (Milky ones) byname. They are very delightful and they always exude milk comparable to nectar having six tastes.
verses.hindi: एसे स्वभावास्तिष्यस्य साथ्षयंति च बै प्रजाः ।

verses.translation: Recount to u$ the sub-continents of Kimpuru$a and Harivar as actually they are really. The sub-continent of BhSrata has already been recounted by you.

verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca śuśrūṣā yatra vo viprāstacchṛṇudhvamatandritāḥ / plakṣakhaṇḍaḥ kiṃpuruṣe sumahānnandanopamaḥ

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि स्थितिः किंपुरुषे स्मृता । सुवर्णवर्णाः पुरुषाः स्त्रियश्चाप्सरसो पमाः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sthitiḥ kiṃpuruṣe smṛtā / suvarṇavarṇāḥ puruṣāḥ striyaścāpsaraso pamāḥ
verses.translation: Ills remembered that the span of life in Kimpurusa is for ten thousand years. The men have golden complexion and the women are comparable to celestial damsels.

verses.sanskrit: अनामया अशोकाश्च नित्यं मुदितमानसाः । जायन्ते मानवास्तत्र निस्तप्तकनकप्रभाः
verses.transliteration: anāmayā aśokāśca nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ / jāyante mānavāstatra nistaptakanakaprabhāḥ
verses.translation: All people there, are free from ailments and sorrows. They are perpetually joyous in their minds. They have the lustre of hot glowing gold.
verses.wordMeaning: All people there, are free from ailments and sorrows. They are perpetually joyous in their minds. They have the lustre of hot glowing gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: All people there, are free from ailments and sorrows. They are perpetually joyous in their minds. They have the lustre of hot glowing gold.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षे किंपुरुषे पुण्ये वृक्षो मधुवहः शुभः । तस्य किंपुरुषाः सर्वे ऽपिबन् हि रसमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: varṣe kiṃpuruṣe puṇye vṛkṣo madhuvahaḥ śubhaḥ / tasya kiṃpuruṣāḥ sarve 'piban hi rasamuttamam
verses.translation: In the holy sub-continent of Ktmpuru$a, there is an auspicious tree oozing out (exuding) honey. All the Kimpuru$as drink its excellent juice.
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy sub-continent of Ktmpuru$a, there is an auspicious tree oozing out (exuding) honey. All the Kimpuru$as drink its excellent juice.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy sub-continent of Ktmpuru$a, there is an auspicious tree oozing out (exuding) honey. All the Kimpuru$as drink its excellent juice.

verses.sanskrit: ततः परं किंपुरुषो हरिवर्षः प्रचक्षते । महारजतसंकाशा जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paraṃ kiṃpuruṣo harivarṣaḥ pracakṣate / mahārajatasaṃkāśā jāyante tatra mānavāḥ
verses.translation: All the people in the sub-continent of Harivar are those who have been dropped down from die Devaloka (Region of the Devas). All of them have the characteristics and racial features of the Devas. They drink the auspicious sugarcane juice.
verses.wordMeaning: All the people in the sub-continent of Harivar are those who have been dropped down from die Devaloka (Region of the Devas). All of them have the characteristics and racial features of the Devas. They drink the auspicious sugarcane juice.
