verses.sanskrit: देवलोकच्युताः सर्वे देवानूकाश्च सर्वेशः । हरिवर्षे नराः सर्वे पिबन्तीक्षुरसं शुफम्
verses.transliteration: devalokacyutāḥ sarve devānūkāśca sarveśaḥ / harivarṣe narāḥ sarve pibantīkṣurasaṃ śupham
verses.translation: Men are born there with the lustre of the lotus. They have the colour of their complexion resembling that of the lotus. They have eyes like lotus and fragrance like that of the lotus petals.
verses.hindi: सन्ध्यांशों में. युगों की धमं सिद्धियों का ह्लास. हुआ करता है । इस
verses.wordMeaning: Men are born there with the lustre of the lotus. They have the colour of their complexion resembling that of the lotus. They have eyes like lotus and fragrance like that of the lotus petals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men are born there with the lustre of the lotus. They have the colour of their complexion resembling that of the lotus. They have eyes like lotus and fragrance like that of the lotus petals.

verses.sanskrit: एकादश सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तु निरामयाः । हरिवर्षे तु जीवन्ति सर्वे मुदितमानसाः
verses.transliteration: ekādaśa sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tu nirāmayāḥ / harivarṣe tu jīvanti sarve muditamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Their diet consists of the fruit and juice of the rose- apple. They do not have sweat trickling down from their bodies. They arc sweet-smelling. They arc intelligent. They enjoy all sensual pleasures, and the fruits of their meritorious actions.
verses.hindi: प्रकार से यह जो भ्रति सन्ध्रि है + है द्विजो ! मैंने कीत्तित कर दी हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Their diet consists of the fruit and juice of the rose- apple. They do not have sweat trickling down from their bodies. They arc sweet-smelling. They arc intelligent. They enjoy all sensual pleasures, and the fruits of their meritorious actions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their diet consists of the fruit and juice of the rose- apple. They do not have sweat trickling down from their bodies. They arc sweet-smelling. They arc intelligent. They enjoy all sensual pleasures, and the fruits of their meritorious actions.

verses.sanskrit: न जरा बाधते तत्र न म्रियन्ते च ते ऽचिरात् । मध्यमं यन्मया प्रोक्तं नाम्ना वर्षमिलावृतम्
verses.transliteration: na jarā bādhate tatra na mriyante ca te 'cirāt / madhyamaṃ yanmayā proktaṃ nāmnā varṣamilāvṛtam
verses.translation: They are fallen down from the world of the Devas. They have golden garments. The excellent men who live in the sub-contineuc Ilavrta have a span of life extending to thirteen thousand years.
verses.hindi: इसी से चारों युगों का सबका प्रसाधन है। यह चारों युगोंकी आवृत्ति सह से लेकर गुणीकृत है ।११४) यह ब्रह्मा का दिन कहा गया है । जितना बड़ा दिन होता है उतनी ब्रह्माजी की रात्रि हुआ करती है । यहाँ पर युग क्षय से. लेकर भूतों का जो सोधापन है बह जड़ी मान होता है ।११५।. यही ही.
verses.wordMeaning: They are fallen down from the world of the Devas. They have golden garments. The excellent men who live in the sub-contineuc Ilavrta have a span of life extending to thirteen thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are fallen down from the world of the Devas. They have golden garments. The excellent men who live in the sub-contineuc Ilavrta have a span of life extending to thirteen thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र सूर्यस्तपति न तु जीर्यन्ति मानवाः । चन्द्रसूर्यै सनक्षत्रौ न प्रकाशाविला वृते
verses.transliteration: na tatra sūryastapati na tu jīryanti mānavāḥ / candrasūryai sanakṣatrau na prakāśāvilā vṛte
verses.translation: It goesdown a thousand Yojanas deep into the earth. Its girth also is the same. The mountain M&lyav&n is to its (i.c. Merus) east and its dimensions have been already recounted (as the same).
verses.hindi: समस्त युगों का लक्षण कहा गया है । यह बारों चौकड़ी. इकहत्तरः हो जाया करती ।११६। जब क्रम से यह चौकड़ियाँ इकहत्तर समाप्त होकर दूसरी बदलती हैं तभी दूसरे मनु का अन्तर हुआ करता है। चारों युगों की चोकड़ी में किस प्रकार से यहां होती है उसी प्रकार से यह होता है
verses.wordMeaning: It goesdown a thousand Yojanas deep into the earth. Its girth also is the same. The mountain M&lyav&n is to its (i.c. Merus) east and its dimensions have been already recounted (as the same).
verses.commentary: Sense: It goesdown a thousand Yojanas deep into the earth. Its girth also is the same. The mountain M&lyav&n is to its (i.c. Merus) east and its dimensions have been already recounted (as the same).

verses.sanskrit: पद्मप्रभाः पद्बवर्णास्तथा पद्बनिभेक्षणाः । पद्मपत्रसुगन्धाश्च जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः
verses.transliteration: padmaprabhāḥ padbavarṇāstathā padbanibhekṣaṇāḥ / padmapatrasugandhāśca jāyante tatra mānavāḥ
verses.translation: In the case of all these mountains, the girth is the aame as the extent to which they go deep down into the earth. It is reaembered that their total length k a hundred thoiuand Yqjanai.
verses.hindi: ।११७। उसी भाँति अन्यों में होता है और फिर उसी के समान यथा क्रम से हुआ करता है। उसो प्रकार से प्रत्येक सगं में भेद उत्पन्न हुआ करते हैं ।११७। ये पैतीस परिमित ही हैं और न इनसे कम हैं और न अधिक होते हैं ऐसा ही बताया गया है । उसी रीति से कल्प युगों के साथ लक्षणों के
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of all these mountains, the girth is the aame as the extent to which they go deep down into the earth. It is reaembered that their total length k a hundred thoiuand Yqjanai.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of all these mountains, the girth is the aame as the extent to which they go deep down into the earth. It is reaembered that their total length k a hundred thoiuand Yqjanai.

verses.sanskrit: जंबूफलरसाहारा अनिष्यन्दाः सुगन्धिनः । मनस्विनो भुक्तभोगाः सत्कर्मफलभोगिनः
verses.transliteration: jaṃbūphalarasāhārā aniṣyandāḥ sugandhinaḥ / manasvino bhuktabhogāḥ satkarmaphalabhoginaḥ
verses.translation: On the southern side of the Meru and to the north of the Nisadhaj there is an ancient eternal Rose*applc tree named Sudariana.
verses.hindi: होते हैं । समस्त मन्वन्तर को यह हो लक्षण होता है
verses.wordMeaning: On the southern side of the Meru and to the north of the Nisadhaj there is an ancient eternal Rose*applc tree named Sudariana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the southern side of the Meru and to the north of the Nisadhaj there is an ancient eternal Rose*applc tree named Sudariana.

verses.sanskrit: देवलोकच्यताश्चैव महारजतवाससः । त्रयोदशसहस्राणि वर्षाणां ते नरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: devalokacyatāścaiva mahārajatavāsasaḥ / trayodaśasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ te narottamāḥ
verses.translation: The height of that nobte*souled lordly tree is one thousand and one hundred Yojanas. Everywhere it touches the firmament on all sides.
verses.hindi: तथा न संतिष्ठति जीवलोकः क्षयोदयाभ्यां परिवर्तमानः १२०
verses.wordMeaning: The height of that nobte*souled lordly tree is one thousand and one hundred Yojanas. Everywhere it touches the firmament on all sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: The height of that nobte*souled lordly tree is one thousand and one hundred Yojanas. Everywhere it touches the firmament on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: आयुः प्रमाणं जीवन्ति ये तु वर्ष इलावृते । मेरोः प्रतिदिशं यच्च नवसाहस्रविस्तृतम्
verses.transliteration: āyuḥ pramāṇaṃ jīvanti ye tu varṣa ilāvṛte / meroḥ pratidiśaṃ yacca navasāhasravistṛtam
verses.translation: As they fall on the ground* these fruits make a loud sound. The juice of the fruits ofthat Jambu (Rose apple) tree flows as a river.
verses.wordMeaning: As they fall on the ground* these fruits make a loud sound. The juice of the fruits ofthat Jambu (Rose apple) tree flows as a river.
verses.commentary: Sense: As they fall on the ground* these fruits make a loud sound. The juice of the fruits ofthat Jambu (Rose apple) tree flows as a river.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि षट्त्रिंशत्तस्य विस्तरः । यतुरस्रं समन्ताच्च शरावाकारसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśattasya vistaraḥ / yaturasraṃ samantācca śarāvākārasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: This river circumambulates the Meru and penetrates into the ground deep down at the root of the Jambu tree. The delighted (inhabitants) of llavrta always drink the juice of the Jambu.
verses.wordMeaning: This river circumambulates the Meru and penetrates into the ground deep down at the root of the Jambu tree. The delighted (inhabitants) of llavrta always drink the juice of the Jambu.
verses.commentary: Sense: This river circumambulates the Meru and penetrates into the ground deep down at the root of the Jambu tree. The delighted (inhabitants) of llavrta always drink the juice of the Jambu.

verses.sanskrit: मेरोः पश्चिमभागे तु नवसाहस्रसम्मिते । चतुस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि गन्धमादनपर्वतः
verses.transliteration: meroḥ paścimabhāge tu navasāhasrasammite / catustriṃśatsahasrāṇi gandhamādanaparvataḥ
verses.translation: The auspicious juice of the fhiits of the respective representative trees of all the subcontinents is hailed by all.
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious juice of the fhiits of the respective representative trees of all the subcontinents is hailed by all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious juice of the fhiits of the respective representative trees of all the subcontinents is hailed by all.

verses.sanskrit: उदग्दक्षिणतश्चैव आनीलनिषधायतः । चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि परिवृद्धो महीतलात्
verses.transliteration: udagdakṣiṇataścaiva ānīlaniṣadhāyataḥ / catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi parivṛddho mahītalāt
verses.translation: Sefa, Vasuki> Takfaka—(yes) all the serpents (live) on the Nifadha. The thirtythree (groups of) Devas (gods) authorised to partake of the shares in the Yajfta» sport about on the Mahimeru.
verses.hindi: देवा ह्यष्टविधा ये वा इह मन्वंतरेश्वराः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sefa, Vasuki> Takfaka—(yes) all the serpents (live) on the Nifadha. The thirtythree (groups of) Devas (gods) authorised to partake of the shares in the Yajfta» sport about on the Mahimeru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sefa, Vasuki> Takfaka—(yes) all the serpents (live) on the Nifadha. The thirtythree (groups of) Devas (gods) authorised to partake of the shares in the Yajfta» sport about on the Mahimeru.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रमवगाढश्च तावदेव च विस्तृतः । पूर्वेण माल्यवाञ्छैलस्तत्प्रमाणः प्रकीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: sahasramavagāḍhaśca tāvadeva ca vistṛtaḥ / pūrveṇa mālyavāñchailastatpramāṇaḥ prakīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: जिस तरह से युगों के परिकत्तंन युगों के स्वभाव से चिरप्रवृत्त होते हैं उस प्रकार से क्षय भोर उदय से परि-बत्तमान जीव लोक भली भाँति स्थित नहीं रहता है ।१२०। बहुत ही संक्षेप के साथ यह इतजञा ही युगों का लक्षण बताया गया है १२१ यहां पर मन्बन्तरों में जो बीत चुके हैं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणेन तु नीलश्च निषधश्चोत्तरेण तु । तेषां मध्ये महामेरुः स्वैः प्रमाणैः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇena tu nīlaśca niṣadhaścottareṇa tu / teṣāṃ madhye mahāmeruḥ svaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: जो अनागत हैं उनका सब यही है और एक मन्वन्तर के द्वारा ही समस्त अन्तर होते हैं ।१२२। कल्प से कल्प जो होता है वे सव विख्यात हैं उत्को. जान लो । जो अभी तक नहीं आये हैं उनमें ज्ञान पुरुष के द्वारा उसी प्रकार से तर्क कर लेना चाहिए ।१२३। समस्त मन्बन्तरों में व्यतीत हो गये हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव शैलानामवगाढो यथा भवेत् । विस्तरस्तत्प्रमाणः स्यादायामो नियुतं स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva śailānāmavagāḍho yathā bhavet / vistarastatpramāṇaḥ syādāyāmo niyutaṃ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: जो अनागत हैं उनमें यहां पर नाम और रूपों से सब तुल्य अभिमान बाले. हैं ।१२४। जो आठ प्रकार के देवगण हैं अथवा यहाँ पर मन्बन्तरेएबर. हैं । ऋषिगण ओर मनुगण सब प्रयोजनों से तुल्य हैं।१२५।-इस तरह से पहिले युग में बणों और आश्रमों के प्रकृष्ट विभाग को और युगों के स्वभावों को
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्तभावास्समुद्रस्य महीमण्डलभावतः । आयामाः परिहीयन्ते चतुरस्रसमाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: vṛttabhāvāssamudrasya mahīmaṇḍalabhāvataḥ / āyāmāḥ parihīyante caturasrasamāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: सदा प्रभुः किया करते हैं ।१२६। वर्णा्मों के विभाग युग ओर युगों की सिद्धियाँ अनुषंग से यह कह दिये गये हैं । अब सृष्टि के सगं को समझ सो । यहाँ पर युगों में विस्तार के साथ ओर आनृपूर्वी से अर्थात् आरम्भ से अन्त
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: इलावृतं चतुष्कोणं भिन्दन्ती मध्यभागतः । प्रभिन्नाञ्जनसंकाशा जम्बूरसवती नदी
verses.transliteration: ilāvṛtaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ bhindantī madhyabhāgataḥ / prabhinnāñjanasaṃkāśā jambūrasavatī nadī
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: मेरोस्तु दक्षिणे पार्श्वे निषधस्योत्तरेण च । सुदर्शनो नाम महाञ्जम्बूवृक्षः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: merostu dakṣiṇe pārśve niṣadhasyottareṇa ca / sudarśano nāma mahāñjambūvṛkṣaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यपुष्पफलोपेतः सिद्धचारणसेवितः । तस्य नाम्ना समा ख्यातो जम्बूद्वीपो वनस्पतेः
verses.transliteration: nityapuṣpaphalopetaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ / tasya nāmnā samā khyāto jambūdvīpo vanaspateḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्रं च शतं चान्यन्महात्मनः । उत्सेधो वृक्षराजस्य दिवं स्पृशति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ ca śataṃ cānyanmahātmanaḥ / utsedho vṛkṣarājasya divaṃ spṛśati sarvataḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: अरत्नीनां शतान्यष्टावेकषष्ट्यधिकानि तु । फलप्रमाणं संख्यातमृषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: aratnīnāṃ śatānyaṣṭāvekaṣaṣṭyadhikāni tu / phalapramāṇaṃ saṃkhyātamṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: पतमानानि तान्युर्व्यां कुर्वन्ति विपुलं स्वनम् । तस्या जम्ब्वाः फलरसो नदी भूत्वा प्रसर्प्पति
verses.transliteration: patamānāni tānyurvyāṃ kurvanti vipulaṃ svanam / tasyā jambvāḥ phalaraso nadī bhūtvā prasarppati
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: श्री बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--हे राजन् ! अमित ओज से समन्वित महानु
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा जम्बूमूलं विशत्यधः । तं पिबन्ति सदा त्दृष्टा जंबूरसमिलावृते
verses.transliteration: meruṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā jambūmūlaṃ viśatyadhaḥ / taṃ pibanti sadā tdṛṣṭā jaṃbūrasamilāvṛte
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: आत्मा वाले जमदग्ति के इस प्रकार से प्रवृत्तमान होते हुए कुछ वषं व्यतीत हों गये वे ।१। है नृपशादूंल । समस्त धर्मों के धारण करने वालों में परम“ श्रेष्ठ राम भी वेदांग के तत्वों के ज्ञाता और सब शास्त्रों के विशारव थे
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: जंबूफलरसे पीते न जरा बाधते तु तान् । न क्षुधा न श्रमश्चापि न मृत्युर्न च तन्द्रि तम्
verses.transliteration: jaṃbūphalarase pīte na jarā bādhate tu tān / na kṣudhā na śramaścāpi na mṛtyurna ca tandri tam
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: महान् मति से समन्वित और विनीत आत्मा वाले उनने अपने माता-पिता की शुसूषा की थी और निज की चेष्टाओं से प्रतिदिन प्रीति को बढ़ा दिया था।।। बुद्धिमानों में परम अं छ राम ने है तृप ! माता-पिता की शुशूषा' के द्वारा इस तरहसे प्रवृत्त ञानहोते हुए कुछ वर्ष बिता दिये थे।४। है राजन्'!
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र जांबूनदं नाम कनकं देवभूषमम् । इन्द्रगोपकसंकाशं जायते भास्वरं तु तत्
verses.transliteration: tatra jāṃbūnadaṃ nāma kanakaṃ devabhūṣamam / indragopakasaṃkāśaṃ jāyate bhāsvaraṃ tu tat
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: किसी समय में महान् तेज वालें पितामह ने उस परम हढ़ की ओर गमन करने का निश्चय देव के द्वारा नियोजित होते हुए किया था?।५। भृगु पु'गव' ने माता-पिता के चरणों में अपना शिर रखकर अपने दोनों हाथ जोड़ते हुए नञ्जता'पूर्णक ' यह वचन बोले ये ।६। है तात ! इस समय में आपके'और
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां वर्षवृक्षाणां शुभः फलरसः स्तुतः । स्कन्नं भवति तच्छुभ्रं कनकं देवभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ varṣavṛkṣāṇāṃ śubhaḥ phalarasaḥ stutaḥ / skannaṃ bhavati tacchubhraṃ kanakaṃ devabhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: माता के समक्ष में कुछ अर्थ विज्ञापित करने की अभिलाया रखता हूैँ। आप भेरी उस अभिलाषित को अवण करने के योग्य होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मूत्रं पुरीषं च दिक्षु सर्वासु सर्वशः । ईश्वरानुग्रहाद्भूमिर्मृताश्च ग्रसते तु तान्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca dikṣu sarvāsu sarvaśaḥ / īśvarānugrahādbhūmirmṛtāśca grasate tu tān
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षःपिशाचयक्षाश्च सर्वे हैमवतः स्मृताः । हेमकूटे तु गन्धर्वा विज्ञेयाः साप्सरोगणाः
verses.transliteration: rakṣaḥpiśācayakṣāśca sarve haimavataḥ smṛtāḥ / hemakūṭe tu gandharvā vijñeyāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे नागस्तु निषधे शेषवासुकितक्षकाः । महामेरौ त्रयस्त्रिंशत्क्रीडन्ते यज्ञियाः सुराः
verses.transliteration: sarve nāgastu niṣadhe śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ / mahāmerau trayastriṃśatkrīḍante yajñiyāḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: मैं अधिक समय से पितामह के दर्शन करने के लिए. उत्कण्ठित मन बाला हो रहा हूँ । इस कारण से आप दोनों की आज्ञा से इस समय में उनके समीप में गमन करूंगा ।=। है तात ! बड़े प्रसन्न मन वाली पितामही के द्वारा मैं कितनी हीं बार बुलाया गया हूँ और उनके हृदय में मुझमें मिलने
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: नीले तु वैदूर्यमये सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽमलाः । दैत्यानां दानवानां चर् श्वेतः पर्वत उच्यते
verses.transliteration: nīle tu vaidūryamaye siddhā brahmarṣayo 'malāḥ / daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ car śvetaḥ parvata ucyate
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: की अधिक उत्कण्ठा हैं । बहुत लोगों के द्वारा उन्होंने यह कहलाया है कि ने मुझे देखने की अधिक इच्छा करती है ।६। मेरा मिलना पितृगण और पितामह जो भी प्रिय है । इस कारण से उनके समीप में जाने की आप मुझे आज्ञा प्रदान कीजिए ।१०। श्री बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--इस प्रकार सें उनके इस
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गवान्पर्वतश्रेष्ठः पितॄणां प्रतिसंचरः । नवस्वेतेषु वर्षेषु यथाभागं स्थितेषु वै
verses.transliteration: śṛṅgavānparvataśreṣṭhaḥ pitṝṇāṃ pratisaṃcaraḥ / navasveteṣu varṣeṣu yathābhāgaṃ sthiteṣu vai
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: परम सम्भ्रात कहें हुए वचन का श्रवण करके वे दोनों माता-पिता बहुतः हीं प्रहृषित हुए थे और उनके नेत्रों में अश्रुओं के कण झलक उठे ये।११। उन दोनों ने उस महाचू भाग बाले पुत्र का आलिंगन किया था और बड़े आदर के साथ उसके मस्तक का उपाघ्राण किया था। आशीवाद से उसका अभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: भूतान्युपनिविष्टानि गतिमन्ति ध्रुवाणि च । तेषां विवृद्धिर्बहुधा दृश्यते दिव्यमानुषी । न संख्या परिसंख्यातुं श्रद्धेया तु बुभूषताम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtānyupaniviṣṭāni gatimanti dhruvāṇi ca / teṣāṃ vivṛddhirbahudhā dṛśyate divyamānuṣī / na saṃkhyā parisaṃkhyātuṃ śraddheyā tu bubhūṣatām
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.hindi: नन्दन करके उन दोनों ने उससे कहा था ।१२। हें तात ! पितामह के गृह को तुम सुख पूर्वक जाओ जिससे पितामह और पितामही के दर्शन प्राप्त करोगे ओर उनकी प्रीति भी होगी ।१३। वहाँ पहुँच कर न्यायपूर्वक उनकी शुश्नूषा में तत्पर रहना । कुछ समय तक है वत्स ! उनकी प्रीति को प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे किंपुरुषादिवर्षवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच मध्ये हिमवतः पृष्ठे कैलासो नाम पर्वतः । तस्मिन्निवसति श्रीमान्कुबेरः सह राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde kiṃpuruṣādivarṣavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca madhye himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe kailāso nāma parvataḥ / tasminnivasati śrīmānkuberaḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ

verses.transliteration: apsaronucaro rājā modate hyalakādhipaḥ / kailāsapādātsaṃbhūtaṃ puṇyaṃ śītajalaṃ śubham
verses.translation: There is a great splendid divine park on its banks called Caitraratha. On that mountain lives Manibhadra along with his followers. He is the ruthless lord of the armies of Yak$as. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas.

verses.translation: For understanding the Pur&];ac presentation of the ancient river- System, the following points are to be noted:

verses.sanskrit: रत्नधातुमयं चित्रं सबलं पर्वतं प्रति । चन्द्रप्रभो नाम गिरिः सुशुभ्रो रत्नसन्निभः

verses.translation: Unless mentioned otherwise all the r e f ere n ce s are to M. All's of ParJaar.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पादे महाद्दिव्यं स्वच्छोदं नाम तत्सरः । तस्माद्दिव्यात्प्रभवति स्वच्छोदा नाम निम्नगा
verses.transliteration: tasya pāde mahāddivyaṃ svacchodaṃ nāma tatsaraḥ / tasmāddivyātprabhavati svacchodā nāma nimnagā
verses.translation: On its bank is the great park named Dcv&raoya which is devoid of sorrow. On that mountain lives Maiidhara the Yak?a of good self-control. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas who arc gentle and highly virtuous.
verses.hindi: आ जाना।१५। अपने पुत्र के देखने के बिना हम लोग आधे क्षण भी नहीं रह सकते हैं। इसी कारण से आप पितामह के घर में अधिक लम्बे समय तक ठहरने के योग्य नहीं होते हैं ।६१। पितामह. के समीप में गये हुए.भी है पुत्र ! उतकी ही आज्ञा प्राप्त कर उनकी अनुभा से क्रम से शीघ्र ही यहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: On its bank is the great park named Dcv&raoya which is devoid of sorrow. On that mountain lives Maiidhara the Yak?a of good self-control. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas who arc gentle and highly virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: On its bank is the great park named Dcv&raoya which is devoid of sorrow. On that mountain lives Maiidhara the Yak?a of good self-control. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas who arc gentle and highly virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तीरे महद्दिव्यं वनं चैत्ररथं शुभम् । तस्मिन् गिरौ निवसति मणिभद्रः सहानुगः
verses.transliteration: tasyāstīre mahaddivyaṃ vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ śubham / tasmin girau nivasati maṇibhadraḥ sahānugaḥ
verses.translation: At its foot is (he highly divine, splendid and charming lake named Bindusara. It has golden sandy bed.
verses.hindi: पर आ जाओ ।१७। बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--इस प्रकार से जब उससे कहा गया तो बह महा. बुद्धिमाचू था । उतने उनको प्रणाम करके परिक्रमा की थी और माता-पिता की आज्ञा पाकर वहाँ से बह पितामह के घर को चल दिया था ।१८। वहाँ पर जाकर उस राम ने महात्मा शृगुवरये ऋचीक के
verses.wordMeaning: At its foot is (he highly divine, splendid and charming lake named Bindusara. It has golden sandy bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: At its foot is (he highly divine, splendid and charming lake named Bindusara. It has golden sandy bed.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षसेनापतिः क्रूरो गुह्यकैः परिवारितः । पुण्या मन्दाकिनी चैव नदी स्वच्छोदका च या
verses.transliteration: yakṣasenāpatiḥ krūro guhyakaiḥ parivāritaḥ / puṇyā mandākinī caiva nadī svacchodakā ca yā
verses.translation: The lake Sailoda seems to be the Wular lake which once covered the whole of Kashmir valley. The river Siloda Is the Jhelum which still Dows through it and runs towards the west between the Indus and the Sutlej (the Caku and SiU in the Purina)—-M. Ali.
verses.hindi: आश्रम में प्रवेश किया था जो कि अनेक मुनिगण ओर शिष्यों से उपशोभित था ।१६। वह आश्रमसभी ओर वेदाध्ययन के बहुत बड़े उद्घोष से प्रति: ध्वनित हो रहा था और वहाँ क सभी प्राणियों में सबंथा वेर भाव नहीं था तथा सभी जीवोंके द्वारा बह् अतीव मनोहर था ।२०। उस परशुराम ने परम
verses.wordMeaning: The lake Sailoda seems to be the Wular lake which once covered the whole of Kashmir valley. The river Siloda Is the Jhelum which still Dows through it and runs towards the west between the Indus and the Sutlej (the Caku and SiU in the Purina)—-M. Ali.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lake Sailoda seems to be the Wular lake which once covered the whole of Kashmir valley. The river Siloda Is the Jhelum which still Dows through it and runs towards the west between the Indus and the Sutlej (the Caku and SiU in the Purina)—-M. Ali.

verses.sanskrit: महीमण्डलमध्येन प्रविष्टे ते महोदधिम् । कैलासाद्दक्षिणे प्राच्यां शिवसत्त्वौषधिं गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: mahīmaṇḍalamadhyena praviṣṭe te mahodadhim / kailāsāddakṣiṇe prācyāṃ śivasattvauṣadhiṃ girim
verses.translation: Gaura. Hiramaya and Soma (mentioned later in v.27 and in V&.P.) are the Tibetan ranges north of Kailftsa and are called now Tanglha, Aling Kangri and Nychenthangla—M. Ali. ( ).
verses.hindi: परशुराम का संवाद   Rs सुन्दर आश्रम में प्रवेश करके है राजेन्द्र ! आसन पर विराजमान ऋचीक का दर्शन किया था और आगे स्थित पितामह को देखा था
verses.wordMeaning: Gaura. Hiramaya and Soma (mentioned later in v.27 and in V&.P.) are the Tibetan ranges north of Kailftsa and are called now Tanglha, Aling Kangri and Nychenthangla—M. Ali. ( ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Gaura. Hiramaya and Soma (mentioned later in v.27 and in V&.P.) are the Tibetan ranges north of Kailftsa and are called now Tanglha, Aling Kangri and Nychenthangla—M. Ali. ( ).

verses.sanskrit: मनः शिलामयं दिव्यं चित्राङ्गं पर्वतं प्रति । लोहितो हेमशृङ्गश्च गिरिः सूर्यप्रभो महान्
verses.transliteration: manaḥ śilāmayaṃ divyaṃ citrāṅgaṃ parvataṃ prati / lohito hemaśṛṅgaśca giriḥ sūryaprabho mahān
verses.translation: Bindutara can be explained in two ways;
verses.wordMeaning: Bindutara can be explained in two ways;
verses.commentary: Sense: Bindutara can be explained in two ways;

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पादे महद्दिव्यं लोहितं नाम तत्सरः । तस्मात्पुण्यः प्रभवति लौहित्यः स नदो महान्
verses.transliteration: tasya pāde mahaddivyaṃ lohitaṃ nāma tatsaraḥ / tasmātpuṇyaḥ prabhavati lauhityaḥ sa nado mahān
verses.translation: The divine river Tripathagi (the Gangi) (lit. the river with three courses) was at the outset established there as the deity* That river originating from the foot-hills of Soma flows in seven channels.
verses.wordMeaning: The divine river Tripathagi (the Gangi) (lit. the river with three courses) was at the outset established there as the deity* That river originating from the foot-hills of Soma flows in seven channels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine river Tripathagi (the Gangi) (lit. the river with three courses) was at the outset established there as the deity* That river originating from the foot-hills of Soma flows in seven channels.

verses.sanskrit: देवारण्यं विशोकं च तस्य तीरे महद्वनम् । तस्मिन्गिरौ निवसति यक्षो मणिधरो वशी
verses.transliteration: devāraṇyaṃ viśokaṃ ca tasya tīre mahadvanam / tasmingirau nivasati yakṣo maṇidharo vaśī
verses.translation: Golden sacrificial posts studded with jewels have been scattered there. Sakra performed a sacrifice there along with all the Devas and attained Siddhi(spiritual enlightenment).
verses.wordMeaning: Golden sacrificial posts studded with jewels have been scattered there. Sakra performed a sacrifice there along with all the Devas and attained Siddhi(spiritual enlightenment).
verses.commentary: Sense: Golden sacrificial posts studded with jewels have been scattered there. Sakra performed a sacrifice there along with all the Devas and attained Siddhi(spiritual enlightenment).

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यैः मुधार्मिकैश्चैव गुह्यके परिवारितः । कैलासाद्दक्षिणे पार्श्वे क्रूरसत्त्वौषधिर्गिरिः
verses.transliteration: saumyaiḥ mudhārmikaiścaiva guhyake parivāritaḥ / kailāsāddakṣiṇe pārśve krūrasattvauṣadhirgiriḥ
verses.translation: Sanctifying the heaven and the firmament, the celestial river fell on the head of Bhava (god 8iva) and got blocked up by means of his Yogic Maya.
verses.hindi: उनका स्वरूप थिष्ण्यमें स्थित पात्रकके ही समान तपसे जाज्वल्यमान था । दक्षिणा के द्वारा अध्वर की ही भाँति सत्यवती के द्वारा वे-उपासित थे ।२२। है जप ! उन दोनों ने अपने समीप में समागत हुए राम को देखा था और समाज्ञा पुर्वक देखते वाले उन दोनों ने उसके विषय में बहुत समय तक
verses.wordMeaning: Sanctifying the heaven and the firmament, the celestial river fell on the head of Bhava (god 8iva) and got blocked up by means of his Yogic Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanctifying the heaven and the firmament, the celestial river fell on the head of Bhava (god 8iva) and got blocked up by means of his Yogic Maya.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्रकायात्किलोत्पन्नमञ्जनं त्रिककुं प्रति । सर्वधातुमयस्तत्र सुमहान्वैद्युतो गिरिः
verses.transliteration: vṛtrakāyātkilotpannamañjanaṃ trikakuṃ prati / sarvadhātumayastatra sumahānvaidyuto giriḥ
verses.translation: Being impeded smilingly by Bhava (Siva), the river goddess mentally thought of hurling down Sankara.
verses.hindi: मनमें विमर्श किया था ।२३। यह तपश्चर्या के राशिँ के ही सहश कौन है जो कि सभी लक्षणों से पूजित हैं । है तो यह बालक  परन्तु ' गम्भीरता" और विनय से युक्त बहुत बलवान् प्रतोत होता है।२४। उन दोनों के हृदय में बड़ा कुतूहल हो रहा था ओर ये हं के साथ यही मन में चिन्तन कर रहे
verses.wordMeaning: Being impeded smilingly by Bhava (Siva), the river goddess mentally thought of hurling down Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being impeded smilingly by Bhava (Siva), the river goddess mentally thought of hurling down Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पादे कलः पुण्यं मानसं सिद्धसेवितम् । तस्मात्प्रभवेते पुण्या सरयूर्लोकविश्रुता
verses.transliteration: tasya pāde kalaḥ puṇyaṃ mānasaṃ siddhasevitam / tasmātprabhavete puṇyā sarayūrlokaviśrutā
verses.translation: Art the three ways Gaoga its three stages?
verses.hindi: थे कि राम परम विनीत भाव से समन्वित होते हुए धीरे से उनके समीप में पहुँच गया था ।२५। उस बुद्धिमान् रामने अपने नाम और गोत्र का उच्चा रण करके परमानन्दित होते हुए उन दोनों के चरणों का स्पर्श मस्तक के द्वारा किया और दोनों हाथों से उनका अभिवादन किया था ।२६। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: Art the three ways Gaoga its three stages?
verses.commentary: Sense: Art the three ways Gaoga its three stages?

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तीरे वन दिव्यं वैभ्राजं नाम विश्रुतम् । कुबेरा नुचरस्तत्र प्रहेतितनयो वशी
verses.transliteration: tasyāstīre vana divyaṃ vaibhrājaṃ nāma viśrutam / kuberā nucarastatra prahetitanayo vaśī
verses.translation: Hence that river b BhIrathl. It joined the salt sea. All these seven (channels, rivers) sanctify the sub-conti¬ nent named Hima.
verses.hindi: अनन्तर परम प्रीतियुक्त मन वाले उनने उस श्रेष्ठतम को उठा लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Hence that river b BhIrathl. It joined the salt sea. All these seven (channels, rivers) sanctify the sub-conti¬ nent named Hima.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence that river b BhIrathl. It joined the salt sea. All these seven (channels, rivers) sanctify the sub-conti¬ nent named Hima.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मपितो निवसति राक्षसो ऽनन्तविक्रमः । अतरिक्षचरैर्घोरैर्यातुधानशतैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: brahmapito nivasati rākṣaso 'nantavikramaḥ / atarikṣacarairghorairyātudhānaśatairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: M. All. ( ) tdantifica NftUnl, Hredini and Pavani—the east- flowing riven—with the Yangtse, Mekong and Salween, the rivers flowing to the west. vb. the Slti, the Cak>us and the Sindhu vrith the Yarkand, the Shyok and the Indus, while the southern river BhSgiratJ is the GaAgS. De however identifies Sita with the Jaaartes ( ) and the Cakius with the Oxus or Amudaria ( ).
verses.wordMeaning: M. All. ( ) tdantifica NftUnl, Hredini and Pavani—the east- flowing riven—with the Yangtse, Mekong and Salween, the rivers flowing to the west. vb. the Slti, the Cak>us and the Sindhu vrith the Yarkand, the Shyok and the Indus, while the southern river BhSgiratJ is the GaAgS.…
verses.commentary: Sense: M. All. ( ) tdantifica NftUnl, Hredini and Pavani—the east- flowing riven—with the Yangtse, Mekong and Salween, the rivers flowing to the west. vb. the Slti, the Cak>us and the Sindhu vrith the Yarkand, the Shyok and the Indus, while the southern river BhSgiratJ is the GaAgS.…

verses.sanskrit: अपरेण तु कैलासात्पुण्यसत्त्वौषधिर्गिरिः । अरुणः पर्वतश्रेष्ठो रुक्मधातुमयः शुभः
verses.transliteration: apareṇa tu kailāsātpuṇyasattvauṣadhirgiriḥ / aruṇaḥ parvataśreṣṭho rukmadhātumayaḥ śubhaḥ
verses.translation: The river Cakfus flows over the following clintes viz. Clnamarus, the Talas> the Camasamulikas, the Bhadras, the Tusaras, the Lamy&kas, the Bahiavas, the Pa(as and the Khaiai. Then it falls into the sea.
verses.hindi: ओर दोनों ने अलग-अलग आशीर्वाद के-द्वारा उसका अभिनन्दन: किया.था ।१७। उसको अपने वक्ष:स्थल से लगाकर आलिंगन किया था और अपनी गोद में विठाकर उन दोनों के हृदय में इतना हर्ष हुआः-था कि उतके नेत्र अश्वुओं से समाप्लुत हो गये थे । उस राम के मुख कमल को देखते हुए उन
verses.wordMeaning: The river Cakfus flows over the following clintes viz. Clnamarus, the Talas> the Camasamulikas, the Bhadras, the Tusaras, the Lamy&kas, the Bahiavas, the Pa(as and the Khaiai. Then it falls into the sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river Cakfus flows over the following clintes viz. Clnamarus, the Talas> the Camasamulikas, the Bhadras, the Tusaras, the Lamy&kas, the Bahiavas, the Pa(as and the Khaiai. Then it falls into the sea.

verses.sanskrit: भवस्य दयितः श्रीमान्पर्वतो मेघसन्निभः । शातकैंभमयैः शुभ्रैः शिलाजालैः समावृतः
verses.transliteration: bhavasya dayitaḥ śrīmānparvato meghasannibhaḥ / śātakaiṃbhamayaiḥ śubhraiḥ śilājālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The scholarly Kauberaka (son of Kubera) of great self-control stays onHiraoyairhga (Golden Peak). He practi¬ ses the performance of Yajflas. He is very great and valorous and his strength and splendour cannot be measured.
verses.wordMeaning: The scholarly Kauberaka (son of Kubera) of great self-control stays onHiraoyairhga (Golden Peak). He practi¬ ses the performance of Yajflas. He is very great and valorous and his strength and splendour cannot be measured.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholarly Kauberaka (son of Kubera) of great self-control stays onHiraoyairhga (Golden Peak). He practi¬ ses the performance of Yajflas. He is very great and valorous and his strength and splendour cannot be measured.

verses.sanskrit: शातसंख्यैस्तापनीयैः शृङ्गैर्दिवमिवोल्लिखन् । मुञ्जवास्तु महादिव्यो दुर्गः शैलो हिमाचितः
verses.transliteration: śātasaṃkhyaistāpanīyaiḥ śṛṅgairdivamivollikhan / muñjavāstu mahādivyo durgaḥ śailo himācitaḥ
verses.translation: The prosperity of the residents of the mountain should also be known in the same manner. In regard to virtue, love and wealth each is double than the former (?)
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त जब वह सुख पूर्वक बेठ गये तो उस आत्मवंश के. समुद्ृहन करने बाले से उस समय में उन दोनों दम्पति ने क्षेम कुशल धूछा' था ।२६। उन्होंने पूछा था कि है वत्स ! तुम्हारे माता-पिता सकुशल हैं और तुम्हारेःसब-भाई सानन्द तो हैं । तुम्हारी बृत्ति अनायास से ही कम हो गई.
verses.wordMeaning: The prosperity of the residents of the mountain should also be known in the same manner. In regard to virtue, love and wealth each is double than the former (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The prosperity of the residents of the mountain should also be known in the same manner. In regard to virtue, love and wealth each is double than the former (?)

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्गिरौ निवसति गिरीशो धूम्रलोचनः । तस्या पादात्प्रभवति शैलोदं नाम तत्सरः
verses.transliteration: tasmingirau nivasati girīśo dhūmralocanaḥ / tasyā pādātprabhavati śailodaṃ nāma tatsaraḥ
verses.translation: Noted as Lake SayanS or NSga in other Purias is the Lake NAk Tso' whidi with Paogong Tso forms an extensive water-iheetMAlL ].
verses.hindi: हैं। ३० इसके अनन्तर' है राजन् ! जेसा कहा गया था बह सम्पूर्ण उसने कह दिद्ला-था:॥ अपने माता-पिता की-अनुग्रामिता, और भाइयों का जो चेष्टित था वह-मी कह दिया था १३१। है महाराज ! इस तरह से उन दोनों की: सम्प्रीतिःसे' समुत्पन्न गुणग्रणों से बहुत ही प्रसन्‍न खम पिता के, पित्त के
verses.wordMeaning: Noted as Lake SayanS or NSga in other Purias is the Lake NAk Tso' whidi with Paogong Tso forms an extensive water-iheetMAlL ].
verses.commentary: Sense: Noted as Lake SayanS or NSga in other Purias is the Lake NAk Tso' whidi with Paogong Tso forms an extensive water-iheetMAlL ].

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रभवते पुण्या शिलोदा नाम निम्रगा । सा चक्षुः सीतयोर्मध्ये प्रविष्टा लवणोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātprabhavate puṇyā śilodā nāma nimragā / sā cakṣuḥ sītayormadhye praviṣṭā lavaṇodadhim
verses.translation: Modem Lake Chakmakdn. the aouree of the Wdsaa river which flows west in the land of Gandhanras. It is in the Wakhan region that Meru and Nisadba come doeeat to each odwr. Ali. ( ).
verses.hindi: घर में रहा।था ।३२। वह घर में सभी प्राणियों के मन और नेत्रों को आनन्दः
verses.wordMeaning: Modem Lake Chakmakdn. the aouree of the Wdsaa river which flows west in the land of Gandhanras. It is in the Wakhan region that Meru and Nisadba come doeeat to each odwr. Ali. ( ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Modem Lake Chakmakdn. the aouree of the Wdsaa river which flows west in the land of Gandhanras. It is in the Wakhan region that Meru and Nisadba come doeeat to each odwr. Ali. ( ).

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तीरे वनं दिव्यं विश्रुतं सुरभीति वै । सव्योत्तरेण कैलासाच्छिवः सत्त्वौषधिर्गिरिः
verses.transliteration: tasyāstīre vanaṃ divyaṃ viśrutaṃ surabhīti vai / savyottareṇa kailāsācchivaḥ sattvauṣadhirgiriḥ
verses.translation: In the sub-continentsKimpuru etc., the lord does not shower rains. Excellent rivers flow here with waters that pierce through the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: In the sub-continentsKimpuru etc., the lord does not shower rains. Excellent rivers flow here with waters that pierce through the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the sub-continentsKimpuru etc., the lord does not shower rains. Excellent rivers flow here with waters that pierce through the ground.

verses.sanskrit: गौरं नाम गिरिश्रेष्ठं हरितालमयं प्रति । हिरण्यशृङ्गः सुमहान् दिव्यो मणिमयो गिरिः
verses.transliteration: gauraṃ nāma giriśreṣṭhaṃ haritālamayaṃ prati / hiraṇyaśṛṅgaḥ sumahān divyo maṇimayo giriḥ
verses.translation: The following three mountains of great knotty ridges extend towards the east. They are immersed under the briny sea. They are the $abha, the Dundubhi and the great moun* tain Dhumra.
verses.hindi: देने वाला होगया था । उनकी सुधा में तत्पर होंकर उसने वहाँ परु कुछ मास तेक निवास किया था ।३३। है राजन् ! इसके पश्चात् महान् मत्त-वाले शगु वयं ने'उन दोनों की आज्ञा प्राप्त करके पितामह के गुरु कें निवासः स्थल आश्षम में गमन करने की इच्छा को'थो।३४। परम त्रीति से संयुत-उन दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: The following three mountains of great knotty ridges extend towards the east. They are immersed under the briny sea. They are the $abha, the Dundubhi and the great moun* tain Dhumra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following three mountains of great knotty ridges extend towards the east. They are immersed under the briny sea. They are the $abha, the Dundubhi and the great moun* tain Dhumra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या पादे महाद्दिव्यं शुभं काञ्चनवालुकम् । रम्यं बिन्दुसरो नाम यत्र राजा भगीरथः
verses.transliteration: tasyā pāde mahāddivyaṃ śubhaṃ kāñcanavālukam / ramyaṃ bindusaro nāma yatra rājā bhagīrathaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: कें द्वारा उसका आशीवंचनों से अभिनन्दन किया गया था और' उन दोनों ने जिस प्रकार में और्याश्रम के प्रति प्रदर्शन कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गनिमित्तं राजर्षिरुवास बहुलाः समाः । दिवं यास्यन्ति ते बुर्वे गङ्गतोयपरिप्लुताः
verses.transliteration: gaṅganimittaṃ rājarṣiruvāsa bahulāḥ samāḥ / divaṃ yāsyanti te burve gaṅgatoyapariplutāḥ
verses.translation: The mountains Somaka, Varaha and the N&rada extend towards the west where they have entered the briny sea.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains Somaka, Varaha and the N&rada extend towards the west where they have entered the briny sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains Somaka, Varaha and the N&rada extend towards the west where they have entered the briny sea.

verses.sanskrit: मदीय इति निश्चित्य समाहितमनाः शिवे । तत्र त्रिपयगा देवी प्रथमं तु प्रतिष्ठिता । सोमपादात्प्रसूता सा सप्तधा प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: madīya iti niścitya samāhitamanāḥ śive / tatra tripayagā devī prathamaṃ tu pratiṣṭhitā / somapādātprasūtā sā saptadhā pratipadyate
verses.translation: M.Ali. ( ) identifies it with (be Kara Kul of northern Pamirs. It is a twin-lake aimtioned as Payoda and Puj>4anka (like lakes MAaasaiaro* vara and Rik|asa TU in the Ksiliia rcfion).
verses.wordMeaning: M.Ali. ( ) identifies it with (be Kara Kul of northern Pamirs. It is a twin-lake aimtioned as Payoda and Puj>4anka (like lakes MAaasaiaro* vara and Rik|asa TU in the Ksiliia rcfion).
verses.commentary: Sense: M.Ali. ( ) identifies it with (be Kara Kul of northern Pamirs. It is a twin-lake aimtioned as Payoda and Puj>4anka (like lakes MAaasaiaro* vara and Rik|asa TU in the Ksiliia rcfion).

verses.sanskrit: यूपा मणिमयास्तत्र वितताश्च हिरण्मयाः । तत्रेष्ट्वा तु गतः सिद्धिं शक्रः सर्वैः सुरैः सह
verses.transliteration: yūpā maṇimayāstatra vitatāśca hiraṇmayāḥ / tatreṣṭvā tu gataḥ siddhiṃ śakraḥ sarvaiḥ suraiḥ saha
verses.translation: Thme art lakes in Siberia. It shows that the Purank authors had some idea that there were big lakes in that region. I doubt AU*i sdentificattoo of the RalfcaA and the Baikal with the Jaya lake.
verses.wordMeaning: Thme art lakes in Siberia. It shows that the Purank authors had some idea that there were big lakes in that region. I doubt AU*i sdentificattoo of the RalfcaA and the Baikal with the Jaya lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thme art lakes in Siberia. It shows that the Purank authors had some idea that there were big lakes in that region. I doubt AU*i sdentificattoo of the RalfcaA and the Baikal with the Jaya lake.

verses.sanskrit: दिवि च्छायापथो यस्तु अनुनक्षत्रमण्डलः । दृश्यते भास्वरो रात्रौ देवी त्रिपथगा तु सा
verses.transliteration: divi cchāyāpatho yastu anunakṣatramaṇḍalaḥ / dṛśyate bhāsvaro rātrau devī tripathagā tu sā
verses.translation: These great mountaim—the Cakra the Bal&haka and the Main&ka, extend towards the southern sea.
verses.wordMeaning: These great mountaim—the Cakra the Bal&haka and the Main&ka, extend towards the southern sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: These great mountaim—the Cakra the Bal&haka and the Main&ka, extend towards the southern sea.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षं दिवञ्चैव भावयन्ती सुरापगा । भवोत्तमाङ्गे पतिता संरूद्धा यौगमायया
verses.transliteration: antarikṣaṃ divañcaiva bhāvayantī surāpagā / bhavottamāṅge patitā saṃrūddhā yaugamāyayā
verses.translation: I shall succinctly recount (information about) the continent of Plakfa in the manner it really is. Listen to rhifl O excellent Brahmana even as I speak about it factually.
verses.hindi: उस महान तपस्वी ने विधिपूर्वक च्यवन की सेवा में प्रणाम किया
verses.wordMeaning: I shall succinctly recount (information about) the continent of Plakfa in the manner it really is. Listen to rhifl O excellent Brahmana even as I speak about it factually.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall succinctly recount (information about) the continent of Plakfa in the manner it really is. Listen to rhifl O excellent Brahmana even as I speak about it factually.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या ये बिन्दवः केचित् क्रुद्धायाः पतिता भुवि । कृतं तु तैर्बिदुसरस्ततो बिन्दुसरः स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: tasyā ye bindavaḥ kecit kruddhāyāḥ patitā bhuvi / kṛtaṃ tu tairbidusarastato bindusaraḥ smṛtam
verses.translation: TIus it n6xt to Jaaib4dvlpA. Its name Plt1tft(a fig tree) indi- catei a land of warm tonperate disute. 'without heahatiw', Idexui-
verses.hindi: था और बड़े हपंपूर्वेक उनसे आज्ञा प्राप्त कर वह राम भृगु के आश्रम की ओर रवाना हो गया था ।३९ वह समस्त झुनिगणों में मुख्य भगु के आश्रम मण्डल में जाकर देखा था कि वह आश्रम'परम"भान्तः चित्त बाले मुनियों से सभी ओर चिरा हुआ है।३७। अतीव "चनी और शीतल छाया वालेःऔर

verses.commentary: Sense: TIus it n6xt to Jaaib4dvlpA. Its name Plt1tft(a fig tree) indi- catei a land of warm tonperate disute. 'without heahatiw', Idexui-

verses.sanskrit: ततो निरूद्धा सा देवी भवेन स्मयता किल । चिन्तयामास मनसा शङ्करक्षेपमं प्रति
verses.transliteration: tato nirūddhā sā devī bhavena smayatā kila / cintayāmāsa manasā śaṅkarakṣepamaṃ prati
verses.translation: The third mountain U high and unscalable. It is named Nrada. It was on this mountain that Narada and Parvata were bom formerly.
verses.hindi: सभी ऋतुओं के गुणों से समन्वित तथा प्रीतिदायक फलों और पुष्पों सयुक्त तरुबरों से वह आश्रम संयुत या ।३८। विविध अकार के पक्षियों-कों ध्वनियां पर हो रही'्चो जो मत और कानों को परम सुख प्रदानःक रने वाली थीं:
verses.wordMeaning: The third mountain U high and unscalable. It is named Nrada. It was on this mountain that Narada and Parvata were bom formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The third mountain U high and unscalable. It is named Nrada. It was on this mountain that Narada and Parvata were bom formerly.

verses.sanskrit: भित्त्वा विशामि पातालं स्रोतसागृह्य शङ्करम् । ज्ञात्वा तम्या अभिप्रायं क्रूरं देव्याश्चिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: bhittvā viśāmi pātālaṃ srotasāgṛhya śaṅkaram / jñātvā tamyā abhiprāyaṃ krūraṃ devyāścikīrṣitam
verses.translation: In all these (sub-continents) the Devas, the Gan* dharvas and the Siddhas play and sport about along with the C&ratias. They are being seen along with them.
verses.hindi: २३०   - ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण बेद मन्त्रों के सबुच्चारण के घोष से वह आश्रम सभी ओर से प्रतिध्वनित हो. रहा था.।३९। मन्वोच्चारण पूर्वक दी हुई आहुतियों के द्वारा जो.होम किया जाता है उसका अन्य बनों में फेलने वाले गन्ध से जो सभी ओर है
verses.wordMeaning: In all these (sub-continents) the Devas, the Gan* dharvas and the Siddhas play and sport about along with the C&ratias. They are being seen along with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all these (sub-continents) the Devas, the Gan* dharvas and the Siddhas play and sport about along with the C&ratias. They are being seen along with them.

verses.sanskrit: तिरोभावयितुं बुद्धिरासीदङ्गेषु तां नदीम् । तस्यावलेपं ज्ञात्वा तु नद्याःक्रुद्धस्तुशङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tirobhāvayituṃ buddhirāsīdaṅgeṣu tāṃ nadīm / tasyāvalepaṃ jñātvā tu nadyāḥkruddhastuśaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: There are seven rivers in every one of the sub-conti¬ nents. They flow into the seas. I shall mention these seven Ganges by name, O ascetics.
verses.hindi: उससे समस्त थाषों का समूह जिससे निरस्त हो गया है ऐसा बह आश्रम है
verses.wordMeaning: There are seven rivers in every one of the sub-conti¬ nents. They flow into the seas. I shall mention these seven Ganges by name, O ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are seven rivers in every one of the sub-conti¬ nents. They flow into the seas. I shall mention these seven Ganges by name, O ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: न्यरुपाच्च शिरस्येनां वेगेन पततीं भुवि । एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दृष्ट्वा राजानमग्रतः
verses.transliteration: nyarupācca śirasyenāṃ vegena patatīṃ bhuvi / etasminneva kāle tu dṛṣṭvā rājānamagrataḥ
verses.translation: The following are the seven excellent rivers, viz.
verses.hindi: दण्ड, मेखला ओर मृगछालाओ' से विभूषित, परम सुन्दर मुनियो. के कुमारो' से सायने वह आश्म शोभा युक्त है ।४१। बीच में इधर-उधर हाथो में पुष्प और जल लिए हुए सञ्चरण करने वाली कन्याओ' से वह आश्रम डपशोभित है
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the seven excellent rivers, viz.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the seven excellent rivers, viz.

verses.sanskrit: धमनीसंततं क्षीणं क्षुधया व्याकुलेन्द्रियम् । अनेन तोषितश्चाहं नद्यर्थं पूर्वमेव तु
verses.transliteration: dhamanīsaṃtataṃ kṣīṇaṃ kṣudhayā vyākulendriyam / anena toṣitaścāhaṃ nadyarthaṃ pūrvameva tu
verses.translation: Those rivers grow towards those places where Vasava (i.e. Indra) showen (rains). They have plenty of water and (swift) currents. Thousands of other rivers flow into them.
verses.wordMeaning: Those rivers grow towards those places where Vasava (i.e. Indra) showen (rains). They have plenty of water and (swift) currents. Thousands of other rivers flow into them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those rivers grow towards those places where Vasava (i.e. Indra) showen (rains). They have plenty of water and (swift) currents. Thousands of other rivers flow into them.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धास्य वरदानं च कोपं नियतवांस्तु सः । ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा धारय स्वर्णदीमिति
verses.transliteration: buddhāsya varadānaṃ ca kopaṃ niyatavāṃstu saḥ / brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā dhāraya svarṇadīmiti
verses.translation: All the subjects were strong and free from ailments. They are devoid of sickness. Amcmg them none deteriorates and no one goes high up in arrogance (sr there is no evolution- axy and involutionary eras.*
verses.wordMeaning: All the subjects were strong and free from ailments. They are devoid of sickness. Amcmg them none deteriorates and no one goes high up in arrogance (sr there is no evolution- axy and involutionary eras.*
verses.commentary: Sense: All the subjects were strong and free from ailments. They are devoid of sickness. Amcmg them none deteriorates and no one goes high up in arrogance (sr there is no evolution- axy and involutionary eras.*

verses.sanskrit: ततो विसर्जयामास संरुद्धां स्वेन तेजसा । नदीं भगीरथस्यार्थे तपसोग्रेण तोषितः
verses.transliteration: tato visarjayāmāsa saṃruddhāṃ svena tejasā / nadīṃ bhagīrathasyārthe tapasogreṇa toṣitaḥ
verses.translation: These are the things to be understood in the five continents, Plaksadvipa etc. The assignment of period is in conformity with the conditions of the region.
verses.wordMeaning: These are the things to be understood in the five continents, Plaksadvipa etc. The assignment of period is in conformity with the conditions of the region.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the things to be understood in the five continents, Plaksadvipa etc. The assignment of period is in conformity with the conditions of the region.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विसृज्यमानायाः स्रोत स्तत्सप्तधा गतम् । तिस्रः प्ताचीमिमुखं प्रतीचीं तिस्र एव तु
verses.transliteration: tato visṛjyamānāyāḥ srota statsaptadhā gatam / tisraḥ ptācīmimukhaṃ pratīcīṃ tisra eva tu
verses.translation: Puntnic description of Sftlmato dvipa bads, M. Ali to identify it with tropical Africa boidering on the Indian ocean, including Madagasgar.
verses.wordMeaning: Puntnic description of Sftlmato dvipa bads, M. Ali to identify it with tropical Africa boidering on the Indian ocean, including Madagasgar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Puntnic description of Sftlmato dvipa bads, M. Ali to identify it with tropical Africa boidering on the Indian ocean, including Madagasgar.

verses.sanskrit: नद्याः स्रोतस्तु गङ्गायाः प्रत्यपद्यत सप्तधा । नलिनी ह्लादिनी चैव पावनी चैव प्राच्यगाः
verses.transliteration: nadyāḥ srotastu gaṅgāyāḥ pratyapadyata saptadhā / nalinī hlādinī caiva pāvanī caiva prācyagāḥ
verses.translation: In those seven sub continents even the rivers are sources of precious gems.
verses.wordMeaning: In those seven sub continents even the rivers are sources of precious gems.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those seven sub continents even the rivers are sources of precious gems.

verses.sanskrit: सीता चक्षुश्च सिन्धुश्च प्रतीचीन्दिशमास्थिताः । सप्तमी त्वन्वगात्तासां दक्षिणेन भगीरथम्
verses.transliteration: sītā cakṣuśca sindhuśca pratīcīndiśamāsthitāḥ / saptamī tvanvagāttāsāṃ dakṣiṇena bhagīratham
verses.translation: It stands with lofty peaks full of all minerals and rugged with clusters of cliffs.
verses.wordMeaning: It stands with lofty peaks full of all minerals and rugged with clusters of cliffs.
verses.commentary: Sense: It stands with lofty peaks full of all minerals and rugged with clusters of cliffs.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्भागीरथी या सा प्रविष्टा लवणोदधिम् । सप्तैता भावयन्तीदं हिमाह्वं वर्षमेव तु
verses.transliteration: tasmādbhāgīrathī yā sā praviṣṭā lavaṇodadhim / saptaitā bhāvayantīdaṃ himāhvaṃ varṣameva tu
verses.translation: Thus, these are the seven mountains in the Sal- mala continent. They are bedecked in jewels. 1 shall mention their splendid sub-continents. They are only seven (in number).
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, these are the seven mountains in the Sal- mala continent. They are bedecked in jewels. 1 shall mention their splendid sub-continents. They are only seven (in number).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, these are the seven mountains in the Sal- mala continent. They are bedecked in jewels. 1 shall mention their splendid sub-continents. They are only seven (in number).

verses.sanskrit: प्रसूताः सप्त नद्यस्ताः शुभा बिन्दु सरोद्भवाः । नानादेशान्प्लावयन्त्यो मलेच्छप्रायास्तु सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: prasūtāḥ sapta nadyastāḥ śubhā bindu sarodbhavāḥ / nānādeśānplāvayantyo malecchaprāyāstu sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Listen to the subjects in the northern continents, O sages conversant with piety. Understand them even as I recount properly in the manner I have heard. It should be known that the mountain Vidruma is the first mountain in the Kuiadvipa; the second one is the mountain Hema.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा के पूण विश्वास से शङ्का से रहित अपने छोटे-छोटे बच्चों, के सहित हरिणियो के झुण्ड जिससे मुनियो कुटिओ' के आँगन में लगे हुए वृक्षों को छाया में बेठे हुए हैं।४३। रोमन्थः से परामृष्टि यूब के साक्षिक आनन्द के प्रदान करने वाले तथा सधुर स्वर से समस्वित वाणी बोलने वाले
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to the subjects in the northern continents, O sages conversant with piety. Understand them even as I recount properly in the manner I have heard. It should be known that the mountain Vidruma is the first mountain in the Kuiadvipa; the second one is the mountain Hema.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the subjects in the northern continents, O sages conversant with piety. Understand them even as I recount properly in the manner I have heard. It should be known that the mountain Vidruma is the first mountain in the Kuiadvipa; the second one is the mountain Hema.

verses.sanskrit: उपगच्छन्ति ताः सर्वा यतो वर्षति वासवः । शिलीन्ध्रान्कुन्त लांश्चीनान्बर्बरान्यवनाध्रकान्
verses.transliteration: upagacchanti tāḥ sarvā yato varṣati vāsavaḥ / śilīndhrānkunta lāṃścīnānbarbarānyavanādhrakān

verses.hindi: मयूरों का नृत्य जिस आश्रम में प्रारमूम  होगया है।४४ा समीप में.गमन
verses.wordMeaning: After detailing the meiii features of ICula dpa M. Ail concludes that it is identtfiabte with the tropteal gra»laodi via. Iran, Irac and the fringing lands of hot deKrt, op. dt« (p <M1}.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्कराश्च कुलिन्दांश्च अच्ॐलद्विचराश्च ये । कृत्वा त्रिधा सिंहवन्तं सीतागात्पश्चिमोद धिम्
verses.transliteration: puṣkarāśca kulindāṃśca acoṃladvicarāśca ye / kṛtvā tridhā siṃhavantaṃ sītāgātpaścimoda dhim
verses.translation: They play and sport about everywhere in great de¬ light. There arc neither robbers nor Mlcccha (barbarous) tribes in them. Hereafter, I shall recount the extent of Krauilca dvipa. It is remembered to be twice as much as Kuiadvipa in extent.
verses.wordMeaning: They play and sport about everywhere in great de¬ light. There arc neither robbers nor Mlcccha (barbarous) tribes in them. Hereafter, I shall recount the extent of Krauilca dvipa. It is remembered to be twice as much as Kuiadvipa in extent.
verses.commentary: Sense: They play and sport about everywhere in great de¬ light. There arc neither robbers nor Mlcccha (barbarous) tribes in them. Hereafter, I shall recount the extent of Krauilca dvipa. It is remembered to be twice as much as Kuiadvipa in extent.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चीनमरूंश्चैव तालांश्च मसमूलिकान् । भद्रास्तुषारांल्लाम्याकान्बाह्लवान्पारटान्खशान्
verses.transliteration: atha cīnamarūṃścaiva tālāṃśca masamūlikān / bhadrāstuṣārāṃllāmyākānbāhlavānpāraṭānkhaśān
verses.translation: M. All examinca the deaenption of this from different source! and concludes that *tbe Krauhea <Mpa of the Puriaa is re pr es ented by the bf ififf of the Black Sea. (op. dt p -46)
verses.hindi: करने बाले मृगों के शब्दों से जहाँ पर कण फेले हुए हैं तथा अनालीढ आतप की छाया में नीवारों की. राशि जहाँ पर सुख रही है ऐसा वह सुरम्य आसय आखय है ।ी जिस आश्रम में समय पर असिति में आहुतियाँ दी जाती हैं और जहाँ पर अतिथिधों के समुदाय का अर्चन एवं सत्कार किया
