verses.sanskrit: एताञ्जनपदां श्चक्षुः प्रावयन्ती गतोदधिम् । दरदांश्च सकाश्मीरान् गान्धरान् रौरसान् कुहान्
verses.transliteration: etāñjanapadāṃ ścakṣuḥ prāvayantī gatodadhim / daradāṃśca sakāśmīrān gāndharān raurasān kuhān
verses.translation: They are covered with different kinds of trees and creepers endowed with plenty of flowers and fruits. They arc twice as much as each other in extent. They increase the delight of residents. The seven rivers Gauri, Kumudvati, Sandhya, R&tri, Manojava, Khyati and Pundrika are remembered as Gahga.
verses.hindi: जाया करता है। जिस आसनम में भेदों के छन्दो का अभ्यास किया जाता है तथा जो कुछ भी शास्त्रो में कहा गया है उसका चिन्तन किया जाता है ४६ पड़े जाने वाले सम्पूर्ण स्मृति प्रतिपादित तथा वेदिक अर्थ का विचार 'किया जाता है । जिसमें देवो' ओर पितृगणो” का यजन प्रारम्भ कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: They are covered with different kinds of trees and creepers endowed with plenty of flowers and fruits. They arc twice as much as each other in extent. They increase the delight of residents. The seven rivers Gauri, Kumudvati, Sandhya, R&tri, Manojava,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are covered with different kinds of trees and creepers endowed with plenty of flowers and fruits. They arc twice as much as each other in extent. They increase the delight of residents. The seven rivers Gauri, Kumudvati, Sandhya, R&tri, Manojava,…

verses.sanskrit: शिवशैलानिन्द्रपदान्वसतीश्च विसर्जमान् । सैन्धवान्रन्ध्रकरकाञ्छमठाभीररोहकान्
verses.transliteration: śivaśailānindrapadānvasatīśca visarjamān / saindhavānrandhrakarakāñchamaṭhābhīrarohakān
verses.translation: There arc thousands of other rivers flowing near them and approaching them (i.e. flowing into them like tributaries). They are large with plenty of water.
verses.hindi: गया हैं तथा जो आश्रम सभी प्राणियों के लिए परस सुन्दर है ।४७। जिस परम सुरम्य आश्रम में बहुत से तपस्वी गण विद्यमान है और जो कापुरुष नहीं हैं उन्हीं कें द्वारा सेवित है यह तपश्चर्या की वृद्धि करने वाला--परम पुण्यमेय और सभी जीवों के सुखों का स्थल है ।४८। जिनका एकमात्र तप
verses.wordMeaning: There arc thousands of other rivers flowing near them and approaching them (i.e. flowing into them like tributaries). They are large with plenty of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: There arc thousands of other rivers flowing near them and approaching them (i.e. flowing into them like tributaries). They are large with plenty of water.

verses.sanskrit: शुनासुखांश्चोर्द्धमरून्सिन्धुरेतान्निषेवते । गन्धर्वकिन्नरान्यक्षान्रक्षोविद्याधरोरगान्
verses.transliteration: śunāsukhāṃścorddhamarūnsindhuretānniṣevate / gandharvakinnarānyakṣānrakṣovidyādharoragān
verses.translation: I shall recount Sakadvlpa definitely as it exists. Listen even as I recount factually and realistically. There the territories of the general public arc very sacred. The people die after a long life. Whence is there famine among them? (i.e. they do not experience famine). Whence is the fear from old age and sickness?
verses.hindi: ही धन है उन तापसों के आनन्द का यह आश्रय देने वाला है ओर यह ऐसा दिखलाई देता है मानो यह दूसरा ब्रह्मलोक हो हो । पुष्पों की सुगन्ध से भ्रमण करते हुए भ्रमरों की ग्ुझजार से यह आश्रम गुञ्जित है ।४हा
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount Sakadvlpa definitely as it exists. Listen even as I recount factually and realistically. There the territories of the general public arc very sacred. The people die after a long life. Whence is there famine among them? (i.e. they do not experience famine).…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount Sakadvlpa definitely as it exists. Listen even as I recount factually and realistically. There the territories of the general public arc very sacred. The people die after a long life. Whence is there famine among them? (i.e. they do not experience famine).…

verses.sanskrit: कलापग्रामकांश्चैव पारदांस्तद्गणान् खशान् । किरातांश्चपुलिन्दांश्च कुरून् सभरतानपि
verses.transliteration: kalāpagrāmakāṃścaiva pāradāṃstadgaṇān khaśān / kirātāṃścapulindāṃśca kurūn sabharatānapi
verses.translation: There too there arc only seven splendid mountains bedecked in jewels. The seven rivers arc sources of origin of precious gems. Listen to their names from me.
verses.wordMeaning: There too there arc only seven splendid mountains bedecked in jewels. The seven rivers arc sources of origin of precious gems. Listen to their names from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: There too there arc only seven splendid mountains bedecked in jewels. The seven rivers arc sources of origin of precious gems. Listen to their names from me.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालान्काशिमत्स्यां श्च मगधाङ्गांस्तथैव च । सुह्मोत्तरांश्च वङ्गांश्च ताम्रलिप्तांस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: pañcālānkāśimatsyāṃ śca magadhāṅgāṃstathaiva ca / suhmottarāṃśca vaṅgāṃśca tāmraliptāṃstathaiva ca
verses.translation: Strangely enough, two scholan come to different concluuoos about the location of filkadvlpa. M. All idendfict it with the Monioon laocU of Aua where teak abounds via. Malaya, Siam, Indo-CShina arid soutbm China, while De identifies It %vith Tartaiy mdudiog Tuestan in central Asia (p -178). They arc Sukumari, Kumarl, Naliril, VenukA, Iksu, VeriukJi** (?) and the seventh one Gabhasti.
verses.wordMeaning: Strangely enough, two scholan come to different concluuoos about the location of filkadvlpa. M. All idendfict it with the Monioon laocU of Aua where teak abounds via. Malaya, Siam, Indo-CShina arid soutbm China,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Strangely enough, two scholan come to different concluuoos about the location of filkadvlpa. M. All idendfict it with the Monioon laocU of Aua where teak abounds via. Malaya, Siam, Indo-CShina arid soutbm China,…

verses.sanskrit: एताञ्जनपदान्मान्यान्गङ्गा भावयते शुभान् । ततः प्रतिहता विन्ध्यात्प्रविष्टा लवणोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: etāñjanapadānmānyāngaṅgā bhāvayate śubhān / tataḥ pratihatā vindhyātpraviṣṭā lavaṇodadhim
verses.translation: There are other rivers too, thousands of them with sacred waters and cool currents. They are splendid rivers flowing in the places where Visava showers.
verses.wordMeaning: There are other rivers too, thousands of them with sacred waters and cool currents. They are splendid rivers flowing in the places where Visava showers.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other rivers too, thousands of them with sacred waters and cool currents. They are splendid rivers flowing in the places where Visava showers.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च ह्लादिनी पुण्य प्राचीमभिमुखा ययौ । प्रावयन्त्युपभागांश्च नैषधांश्च त्रिगर्त कान्
verses.transliteration: tataśca hlādinī puṇya prācīmabhimukhā yayau / prāvayantyupabhāgāṃśca naiṣadhāṃśca trigarta kān
verses.translation: Neither their names nor their magnitude can be adequately understood or fully enumerated. Those excellent rivers are very holy. The delighted folks of the clime, O Sarhsapayana, drink the (waters of those) rivers. TTiis continent is vast and is situated in the form of a wheel.
verses.hindi: ऽसभी-ओरुऽनिविघ प्रकार की वायु से यह वोज्यमान है अर्थात् जहाँ 'परु नाता भाँति की बायु सवंज बहन किया करती है । इस रीति से अनेक अकार केगुणों सेयह आशक्षम समन्वित - है। ऐसे आश्रम को जो बहुत ही उत्तम है उस राम ने देखा या-।५०। जिस तरह-कोई सुकृत करने वाला पुरुष
verses.wordMeaning: Neither their names nor their magnitude can be adequately understood or fully enumerated. Those excellent rivers are very holy. The delighted folks of the clime, O Sarhsapayana, drink the (waters of those) rivers. TTiis continent is vast and is situated in the form of a wheel.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither their names nor their magnitude can be adequately understood or fully enumerated. Those excellent rivers are very holy. The delighted folks of the clime, O Sarhsapayana, drink the (waters of those) rivers. TTiis continent is vast and is situated in the form of a wheel.

verses.sanskrit: धीवरानृषिकांश्चैव तथा नीलमुखानपि । केकरानौष्टकर्णांश्च किरातानपि चैव हि
verses.transliteration: dhīvarānṛṣikāṃścaiva tathā nīlamukhānapi / kekarānauṣṭakarṇāṃśca kirātānapi caiva hi
verses.translation: Therein, the rural regions, the mountains, and the rivers arc splendid and sacred. The lands (sub-continents) arc fully inhabited by persons following the discipline of the four castes and the stages of life. They (the sub-continents), arc seven in number.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग में प्रवेश किया करता है उसी तरह से परम बिनीत.उस राम-ने वहाँ पर आश्रम में प्रवेश किया था । उस आश्रम के उपान्त में प्रवेश करके राम ने-अपसे प्रपितासह का दर्शन आरप किया था 4५१+ है राजन् ! वे भ्रपितामह सैकड़ों ही मुनियों और शिष्यों से चारों ओर घिरे हुए ये । वे व्याख्यान
verses.wordMeaning: Therein, the rural regions, the mountains, and the rivers arc splendid and sacred. The lands (sub-continents) arc fully inhabited by persons following the discipline of the four castes and the stages of life. They (the sub-continents), arc seven in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therein, the rural regions, the mountains, and the rivers arc splendid and sacred. The lands (sub-continents) arc fully inhabited by persons following the discipline of the four castes and the stages of life. They (the sub-continents), arc seven in number.

verses.sanskrit: कालोदरान्विवर्णाश्च कुमारान्स्वर्णभूमिकान् । आमण्डलं समुद्रस्य तिरोभूतांश्च पूर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kālodarānvivarṇāśca kumārānsvarṇabhūmikān / āmaṇḍalaṃ samudrasya tirobhūtāṃśca pūrvataḥ
verses.translation: Only this much can be described in regard to that continent. Only this much need be heard in regard to the resi¬ dents of Sakadvipa. Pukara u identified by M. All with Japan, Manchuna and the South-eastern Siberia op. cil. (p -44), while De identifies it with a portion of central Asia from the north rf the Oxus includingWesternTartary. Pufkara » a Sanakritisatioo of Bhushkara or Bokhara, op. cit ( ).
verses.hindi: करने।की जो वेदिका थी उसके मध्य में एक कुशा के आसन पर बिराजमान थे । उनके एमश्र,-जटा'और' कूचे (दाढ़ी) एकदस सफेव थे तथा ब्रह्मसूत्र से उपशोभित'थे।१२। कामजंघा ओर जानु से दक्षिण ऊरु से वे अध्यस्त थे ।५३। योग पट्ट से संबीत अपने 'देह वाले के ऋषियों में परम श्रेष्ठ थे तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Only this much can be described in regard to that continent. Only this much need be heard in regard to the resi¬ dents of Sakadvipa. Pukara u identified by M. All with Japan, Manchuna and the South-eastern Siberia op. cil. (p -44),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Only this much can be described in regard to that continent. Only this much need be heard in regard to the resi¬ dents of Sakadvipa. Pukara u identified by M. All with Japan, Manchuna and the South-eastern Siberia op. cil. (p -44),…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु पावनी चापि प्राचीमेव दिशं ययौ । सुपथान्पावयं तीह त्विन्द्रद्युम्नसरोपि च
verses.transliteration: tatastu pāvanī cāpi prācīmeva diśaṃ yayau / supathānpāvayaṃ tīha tvindradyumnasaropi ca
verses.translation: The mountain range Minasottara covers lialf of the continent. It is situated near the sea-shore just like the rising moon.
verses.hindi: उयाख्यान' करने की मुद्रा से शोभित सब्य करकमल वाले थे ।५४। योग पट्ट के: ऊपर रमसे हुए परम शोभित बाम कर बाले ओर भली भातितआारण्यक उपनिषद् के थाकयों के सूक्ष्म तत्व के अर्थ की संहति काः विशेष. स्रियरण कर रहे थे ।५५। और उनका. बिवरण करके वे-तपोनिधि. मुख्य मुनियों को श्रवण:
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain range Minasottara covers lialf of the continent. It is situated near the sea-shore just like the rising moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain range Minasottara covers lialf of the continent. It is situated near the sea-shore just like the rising moon.

verses.sanskrit: तथा खरपथांश्चैव वेत्रशङ्कुपथानपि । मध्यतोजानकिमथो कुथप्रावरणान्ययौ
verses.transliteration: tathā kharapathāṃścaiva vetraśaṅkupathānapi / madhyatojānakimatho kuthaprāvaraṇānyayau
verses.translation: It rises upto a height of fifty thousand Yojanas. Its circular extent all round is also the same (number of Yojanas.) The men there live for ten thousand years. They are free from sickness. They have plenty of pleasurable experi¬ ences. They have attained mental powers (to a great extent).
verses.hindi: करा रहे ये। राम ने पितामह का दर्शन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: It rises upto a height of fifty thousand Yojanas. Its circular extent all round is also the same (number of Yojanas.) The men there live for ten thousand years. They are free from sickness. They have plenty of pleasurable experi¬ ences.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It rises upto a height of fifty thousand Yojanas. Its circular extent all round is also the same (number of Yojanas.) The men there live for ten thousand years. They are free from sickness. They have plenty of pleasurable experi¬ ences.…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्वीप समुद्रं तु प्रविष्टां लवणोदधिम् । ततस्तु नलिनी प्रायात् प्राचीमाशां जवेन तु
verses.transliteration: indradvīpa samudraṃ tu praviṣṭāṃ lavaṇodadhim / tatastu nalinī prāyāt prācīmāśāṃ javena tu
verses.translation: The span of life and the handsome features of all the people in both the Vars arc declared to be the same. There is no distinction among them as superior or inferior. They are equal in features and conduct.
verses.wordMeaning: The span of life and the handsome features of all the people in both the Vars arc declared to be the same. There is no distinction among them as superior or inferior. They are equal in features and conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: The span of life and the handsome features of all the people in both the Vars arc declared to be the same. There is no distinction among them as superior or inferior. They are equal in features and conduct.

verses.sanskrit: तोमरान्भावयन्तीह हंसमार्गान्सहैहयान् । पूर्वन्देशांश्च सेवन्ती भित्त्वा सा बहुधागिरीन्
verses.transliteration: tomarānbhāvayantīha haṃsamārgānsahaihayān / pūrvandeśāṃśca sevantī bhittvā sā bahudhāgirīn
verses.translation: The three Vedas, the (fourteen) Vidyas, the system of civil and criminal administration, the desire to serve and arts and crafts—all these are not present in cither of the two sub-continents of Pufkara. Thus the entire mode of activity and life in the Dhitaklkhatida and Mahavtta in the continent of Pukara has been recounted in the due order.
verses.wordMeaning: The three Vedas, the (fourteen) Vidyas, the system of civil and criminal administration, the desire to serve and arts and crafts—all these are not present in cither of the two sub-continents of Pufkara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The three Vedas, the (fourteen) Vidyas, the system of civil and criminal administration, the desire to serve and arts and crafts—all these are not present in cither of the two sub-continents of Pufkara.…

verses.sanskrit: कर्णप्रावरणान्प्राप्य संगत्या श्वमुखानपि । सिकतापर्वतमरुं गत्वा विद्याधरान्ययौ
verses.transliteration: karṇaprāvaraṇānprāpya saṃgatyā śvamukhānapi / sikatāparvatamaruṃ gatvā vidyādharānyayau
verses.translation: Thus, the seven continents arc surrounded by the seven seas. The sea that is immediately after a continent is equal to that continent.
verses.hindi: प च्छ कुशल श्नं तमालोक्य भृगुस्तदा ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the seven continents arc surrounded by the seven seas. The sea that is immediately after a continent is equal to that continent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the seven continents arc surrounded by the seven seas. The sea that is immediately after a continent is equal to that continent.

verses.sanskrit: नगमण्डलमध्येन प्रविष्टा लवणोदधिम् । तासां नद्युपनद्यश्च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: nagamaṇḍalamadhyena praviṣṭā lavaṇodadhim / tāsāṃ nadyupanadyaśca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, the mutual increase in size, of the continents and the seas should be understood. The sea is called Samudra on account of the Samudrekd (the state of being plentiful) of the waters. The root \/rs means ''to sport about'* and the root \/yrs means "to strengthen.*' Since the sub-continent enables the people to spoit about and to slengthen their power for sexual dalliance, it is called Varfa,
verses.hindi: हे महाराज ! फिर वह राम उन महान आत्मा वाले के समीप में धीरे से प्राप्त हुआ था । उसको समागत हुआ देखकर वहाँ पर जो भी स्थित थे वे सभी राम के प्रवल प्रभाव से धक्षित हो गये ये ।५७। हैः नृप ! समस्त मुनिगण दूर से ही शङ्का को प्राप्त हो गये बे तब तक अमेय आत्मा वाले
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the mutual increase in size, of the continents and the seas should be understood. The sea is called Samudra on account of the Samudrekd (the state of being plentiful) of the waters.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the mutual increase in size, of the continents and the seas should be understood. The sea is called Samudra on account of the Samudrekd (the state of being plentiful) of the waters.…

verses.sanskrit: उपगच्छन्ति ताः सर्वा यतो वर्षति वासवः । वक्वौकसायास्तीरे तु वनं सुरभि विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: upagacchanti tāḥ sarvā yato varṣati vāsavaḥ / vakvaukasāyāstīre tu vanaṃ surabhi viśrutam
verses.translation: A popular etymology of Samtdra 't
verses.hindi: भृगु उसके आगमन, से तोषित हुए ये. ।५०। है पाथिव ! उसको देखते. हुए ही अत्य कथा को बात चीत को उन्होने बम्द कर दिया था.। राम भी उनके समीप में पहुँचकर बिलय से विनन्न मुख कमल बाला हो गया था ।५९। जिस प्रकार से उपेन्द्र ब्रह्माजी की बन्दना किया करते हैं ठीक उसी तरह से स्ाय
verses.wordMeaning: A popular etymology of Samtdra 't
verses.commentary: Sense: A popular etymology of Samtdra 't

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यशृङ्गे वसति विद्वान्कौबेरको वशी । यज्ञोपेतश्च सुमहानमितौजाः सुविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaśṛṅge vasati vidvānkauberako vaśī / yajñopetaśca sumahānamitaujāḥ suvikramaḥ
verses.translation: 'a mbontinoat* U traoed to pU ■ 'to enter', 'to Just as the water in the boiler appears to increase due to iu contact with fire, so also the water in ihe great ocean becomes increased by itself naturally.
verses.hindi: पूबंक राम ने उनकी वन्दना की थो । विनञ्जता समन्वित राम ने न्याय पूर्वक सबका अभिवादन किया था ।६०। राम ने समस्त मुनियों को अवस्था के अनुसार क्रम से सम्भावित किया था । और उन सब मुत्तियों ते भी आनन्द से,समरिब्रित होकर आशीर्वादों के द्वारा उस रामको परिवधित किया थो
verses.wordMeaning: 'a mbontinoat* U traoed to pU ■ 'to enter', 'to Just as the water in the boiler appears to increase due to iu contact with fire, so also the water in ihe great ocean becomes increased by itself naturally.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'a mbontinoat* U traoed to pU ■ 'to enter', 'to Just as the water in the boiler appears to increase due to iu contact with fire, so also the water in ihe great ocean becomes increased by itself naturally.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रत्यैस्तैः परिवृतौ विद्वद्भिर्ब्रह्मराक्षसैः । कुबेरानुचरा ह्येते चत्वारस्तु समाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: tatratyaistaiḥ parivṛtau vidvadbhirbrahmarākṣasaiḥ / kuberānucarā hyete catvārastu samāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: During the bright and dark fortnights when the moon rises and sets, the waters in the sea increase and decrease in a quantity that is neither more nor less than usual.
verses.hindi: ।६१। वह परम मेधा से सुसम्पन्न राम भी उन सबकी अनुज्ञा से भूमि पर समीप में बैठ गया था  फिर जब बैठ गया तो सबने राम को आशीर्वेचनो' से अभिनन्दित किया था ।६१। उस समय में भुगु ने उस राम का अवलोकन करके उससे कुशल प्रश्न पूछा था कि है वत्स ! तुम्हारा कुशल तो है और
verses.wordMeaning: During the bright and dark fortnights when the moon rises and sets, the waters in the sea increase and decrease in a quantity that is neither more nor less than usual.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the bright and dark fortnights when the moon rises and sets, the waters in the sea increase and decrease in a quantity that is neither more nor less than usual.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव तु विज्ञेया ऋद्धिः पर्वतवासिनाम् । परस्परेण द्विगुणा धर्मतः कामतोर्ऽथतः
verses.transliteration: evameva tu vijñeyā ṛddhiḥ parvatavāsinām / paraspareṇa dviguṇā dharmataḥ kāmator'thataḥ
verses.translation: The increase and decrease in the quantity of water of the sea in accordance with the increase and decrease in the size of the moon is five hundred and ten Ahgulas. During the Parvan days the increase and decrease of the waters of the ocean can be seen. The continents sur¬ rounded everywhereby waterarc rememberedasDvIpas because oi Dvirdpkatva (i.e. the state of having water on either side.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे माता-पिता-पिता का स्वास्थ्य सुखमय है
verses.wordMeaning: The increase and decrease in the quantity of water of the sea in accordance with the increase and decrease in the size of the moon is five hundred and ten Ahgulas. During the Parvan days the increase and decrease of the waters of the ocean can be seen.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The increase and decrease in the quantity of water of the sea in accordance with the increase and decrease in the size of the moon is five hundred and ten Ahgulas. During the Parvan days the increase and decrease of the waters of the ocean can be seen.…

verses.sanskrit: हेमकूटस्य पृष्ठे तु वर्चोवन्नामतः सरः । मनस्विनीप्रभवति तस्माज्ज्योतिष्मती च या
verses.transliteration: hemakūṭasya pṛṣṭhe tu varcovannāmataḥ saraḥ / manasvinīprabhavati tasmājjyotiṣmatī ca yā
verses.translation: The great lord Brahma, the overlord of the three worlds is worshipped there. Brahma, the Prajapati, lives in that (sub-continent) along with the Sadhyas.
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord Brahma, the overlord of the three worlds is worshipped there. Brahma, the Prajapati, lives in that (sub-continent) along with the Sadhyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord Brahma, the overlord of the three worlds is worshipped there. Brahma, the Prajapati, lives in that (sub-continent) along with the Sadhyas.

verses.sanskrit: अवगाढे ह्युभयतः समुद्रौ पूर्वपश्चिमौ । सरो विष्णुपदं नाम निषधे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: avagāḍhe hyubhayataḥ samudrau pūrvapaścimau / saro viṣṇupadaṃ nāma niṣadhe parvatottame
verses.translation: There, the thirty three Devas perform the worship along with the great sages. That lord, the most excellent of all the Devas is worshipped there by the Devas. Etymplogy of vdaJhi lea*.
verses.wordMeaning: There, the thirty three Devas perform the worship along with the great sages. That lord, the most excellent of all the Devas is worshipped there by the Devas. Etymplogy of vdaJhi lea*.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, the thirty three Devas perform the worship along with the great sages. That lord, the most excellent of all the Devas is worshipped there by the Devas. Etymplogy of vdaJhi lea*.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्द्वयं प्रभवति गान्धर्वी नाकुली च तैः । मेरोः पार्श्वात्प्रभवति ह्रदश्चन्द्रप्रभो महान्
verses.transliteration: tasmāddvayaṃ prabhavati gāndharvī nākulī ca taiḥ / meroḥ pārśvātprabhavati hradaścandraprabho mahān
verses.translation: VV 138«140 explain why particular continents are named S&lrnala, KrauAca, etc.
verses.wordMeaning: VV 138«140 explain why particular continents are named S&lrnala, KrauAca, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV 138«140 explain why particular continents are named S&lrnala, KrauAca, etc.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र जंबूनदी पुण्या यस्या जांबूनदं स्मृतम् । पयोदं तु सरो नीले सुशुभ्रं पुण्डरीकवत्
verses.transliteration: tatra jaṃbūnadī puṇyā yasyā jāṃbūnadaṃ smṛtam / payodaṃ tu saro nīle suśubhraṃ puṇḍarīkavat
verses.translation: The self-bom lord protects the subjects both the sluggish as welt as scholarly in the two sub-continents that had been mentioned in the Puskaradvipa. Raising up his rod of chastisement, lord Brahmi, the overlord of the three worlds, protects the subjects. That lord is the Minister of Visnu. He is the father and grandfatlier.
verses.wordMeaning: The self-bom lord protects the subjects both the sluggish as welt as scholarly in the two sub-continents that had been mentioned in the Puskaradvipa. Raising up his rod of chastisement, lord Brahmi, the overlord of the three worlds, protects the subjects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The self-bom lord protects the subjects both the sluggish as welt as scholarly in the two sub-continents that had been mentioned in the Puskaradvipa. Raising up his rod of chastisement, lord Brahmi, the overlord of the three worlds, protects the subjects.…

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीका पयोदा य तस्मान्नद्यौ विनिर्गते । श्वेतात्प्रवर्त्तते पुण्यं सरयूर्मानसाद्ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: puṇḍarīkā payodā ya tasmānnadyau vinirgate / śvetātpravarttate puṇyaṃ sarayūrmānasāddhruvam
verses.translation: The subjects always take in the meal that approa¬ ches them (automatically) by itself. The meal has great nutritive value and it consists of all the six tests.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे भाइयों का आपके पिता के माता-पिता का कुणल-मङ्ूल तो है ? इस समय में तुम किस प्रयोजन के लिए यहाँ पर मेरे समीप में समांगत हुए हो ? ।६४। क्या किसी ने तुम को यहाँ आने की आज्ञा दी है अथवा तुम स्वयं अपनी ही इच्छा से यहाँ पर आये ? इसके पश्चात् राम ने
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects always take in the meal that approa¬ ches them (automatically) by itself. The meal has great nutritive value and it consists of all the six tests.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects always take in the meal that approa¬ ches them (automatically) by itself. The meal has great nutritive value and it consists of all the six tests.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योत्स्ना च मृगाकामा च तस्माद्द्वे संबभूवतुः । सरः कुरुषु विख्यातं पद्ममीनद्विजाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: jyotsnā ca mṛgākāmā ca tasmāddve saṃbabhūvatuḥ / saraḥ kuruṣu vikhyātaṃ padmamīnadvijākulam
verses.translation: The great sea with sweet water as its liquid content envelops the halves ofPu$kara» The sea encircles it allround. Beyond it, appears the existence of a great world. It is golden. The entire ground is like a single rocky slab. It is twice as large as the sea.
verses.hindi: उनको सेवा में न्यायपूर्वक सभी कुछ पूर्णतया निवेदित कर दिया था । उन. महात्मा ने उस वक्त जो भी पूछा था वह सब कह दिया था जो भी कुछ 'पिता-माता का और महान् आत्मा वाले भाइयों का वृत्तान्त था ।६५-६६। हे नृप ! उन दोनों पिता के माता-पिता की कुशलता से दशंन का होता-यह
verses.wordMeaning: The great sea with sweet water as its liquid content envelops the halves ofPu$kara» The sea encircles it allround. Beyond it, appears the existence of a great world. It is golden. The entire ground is like a single rocky slab. It is twice as large as the sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sea with sweet water as its liquid content envelops the halves ofPu$kara» The sea encircles it allround. Beyond it, appears the existence of a great world. It is golden. The entire ground is like a single rocky slab. It is twice as large as the sea.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रकान्तमिति ख्यातं निर्मितं तद्भवेन तु । अन्ये चाप्यत्र विख्याताः पद्मामीनद्विजाकुलाः
verses.transliteration: rudrakāntamiti khyātaṃ nirmitaṃ tadbhavena tu / anye cāpyatra vikhyātāḥ padmāmīnadvijākulāḥ
verses.translation: All the worlds are included in the half that is bright and the dark regions are external ones. The (region having the absence of brilliance outside extends all round to the extent of the worlds within.
verses.hindi: और आय भृगु का नम्रता के साय आनन्द से सब बता दिया था। और अपना जो भी कुछ अभीष्ट था उसका निवेदन कर विया था। है राजन ! राम के द्वारा वणित यह सव श्रवण करके और विशेष रूप से उसको देखकर भूगु बहुत ही प्रसन्न हुए थे और उसका अभिनन्दन किया था। इस तरह
verses.wordMeaning: All the worlds are included in the half that is bright and the dark regions are external ones. The (region having the absence of brilliance outside extends all round to the extent of the worlds within.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the worlds are included in the half that is bright and the dark regions are external ones. The (region having the absence of brilliance outside extends all round to the extent of the worlds within.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना ह्रदा जया नाम द्वादशोदधिसन्निभाः । तेभ्यः शान्ता य माध्वी च द्वे नद्यौ संबभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: nāmnā hradā jayā nāma dvādaśodadhisannibhāḥ / tebhyaḥ śāntā ya mādhvī ca dve nadyau saṃbabhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: It should be known that there are thousands and crores of cosmic eggs like this, above, below and sideways. The cause of origin thereof is the unchartng Atman. All of them are encircled mutually and are evolved mutually. AU round this (Cosmic egg) is situated the Ghanodadhi —sea of solidified waters.
verses.hindi: से अतीव उत्कृष्ट अपने कर्मों के द्वारा उसका प्रिय करते हुए राम ने वहाँ निवास किया था। है नृप ! राम उस आश्रम में कुछ दिन तक रहा था। इसके उपरान्त मुनिवर ने राम को किसी समय में एकान्त में बुलाया था।
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that there are thousands and crores of cosmic eggs like this, above, below and sideways. The cause of origin thereof is the unchartng Atman. All of them are encircled mutually and are evolved mutually.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that there are thousands and crores of cosmic eggs like this, above, below and sideways. The cause of origin thereof is the unchartng Atman. All of them are encircled mutually and are evolved mutually.…

verses.sanskrit: यानि किंपुरुषाद्यानि तेषु देवो न वर्षति । उद्भिदान्युदकान्यत्र प्रवहन्ति सरिद्वराः
verses.transliteration: yāni kiṃpuruṣādyāni teṣu devo na varṣati / udbhidānyudakānyatra pravahanti saridvarāḥ
verses.translation: The BhUtddi (the cosmic Ego) holds the ether and Mahan (the great principle) sustains (supported) by the Infinite principle, the Avyakta (the unmanifest one).
verses.wordMeaning: The BhUtddi (the cosmic Ego) holds the ether and Mahan (the great principle) sustains (supported) by the Infinite principle, the Avyakta (the unmanifest one).
verses.commentary: Sense: The BhUtddi (the cosmic Ego) holds the ether and Mahan (the great principle) sustains (supported) by the Infinite principle, the Avyakta (the unmanifest one).

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभो दुन्दुभिश्चैव धूम्नश्च सुमहागिरिः । पूर्वायता महापर्वा निमग्ना लवणाभसि
verses.transliteration: ṛṣabho dundubhiścaiva dhūmnaśca sumahāgiriḥ / pūrvāyatā mahāparvā nimagnā lavaṇābhasi
verses.translation: The nether-worlds beneath the Rasitala are seven in number and those above them are also seven in number. O Brihmatias, there are seven Skandhas (layers) of the wind along with the Brahmasadana (abode of firahmi). The Living beings, originating from many species go about (here and there). They are beginningless and endless. The Prakrti stationed in (resting on) the Brahman is the cause of the univenc. It is mysterious and variegated.
verses.wordMeaning: The nether-worlds beneath the Rasitala are seven in number and those above them are also seven in number. O Brihmatias, there are seven Skandhas (layers) of the wind along with the Brahmasadana (abode of firahmi). The Living beings,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The nether-worlds beneath the Rasitala are seven in number and those above them are also seven in number. O Brihmatias, there are seven Skandhas (layers) of the wind along with the Brahmasadana (abode of firahmi). The Living beings,…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रः काकस्तथा द्रोणः सुमहान्तः शिलोच्चयाः । उदग्याता उदीच्यान्ता अवगाढा महोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: candraḥ kākastathā droṇaḥ sumahāntaḥ śiloccayāḥ / udagyātā udīcyāntā avagāḍhā mahodadhim
verses.translation: Lord Jankrdanaisa great Yog:in. His limbs are divided in many ways. This lord of the worlds is worshipped in all the worlds in diverse ways.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Jankrdanaisa great Yog:in. His limbs are divided in many ways. This lord of the worlds is worshipped in all the worlds in diverse ways.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Jankrdanaisa great Yog:in. His limbs are divided in many ways. This lord of the worlds is worshipped in all the worlds in diverse ways.

verses.sanskrit: सोमकश्च वराहश्च नारदश्च महीधरः । प्रतीच्यामायतास्ते वै प्रविष्टा लवणोदधिम
verses.transliteration: somakaśca varāhaśca nāradaśca mahīdharaḥ / pratīcyāmāyatāste vai praviṣṭā lavaṇodadhima
verses.translation: Thus Ae %)ds bora of each other are sustaiaed mutually. 'Dieie VUedras (products or effects) of the Avikbin The earth etc. are the Vikiras (effects). They arc restricted by each other. They are superior to each other and they have penetrated mutually.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Ae %)ds bora of each other are sustaiaed mutually. 'Dieie VUedras (products or effects) of the Avikbin The earth etc. are the Vikiras (effects). They arc restricted by each other. They are superior to each other and they have penetrated mutually.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Ae %)ds bora of each other are sustaiaed mutually. 'Dieie VUedras (products or effects) of the Avikbin The earth etc. are the Vikiras (effects). They arc restricted by each other. They are superior to each other and they have penetrated mutually.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रो बलाहकश्चैव मैनाको यश्च पर्वतः । आयतास्ते महाशैलाः समुद्रं दक्षिणं प्रति
verses.transliteration: cakro balāhakaścaiva maināko yaśca parvataḥ / āyatāste mahāśailāḥ samudraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ prati
verses.translation: Since they have been created mutually, they have attained stability. In the beginning they were without Viiesas They are called ViUfos because they qualify others.
verses.wordMeaning: Since they have been created mutually, they have attained stability. In the beginning they were without Viiesas They are called ViUfos because they qualify others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they have been created mutually, they have attained stability. In the beginning they were without Viiesas They are called ViUfos because they qualify others.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रमैनाकयोर्मध्य विदिशं दक्षिणां प्रति । तत्र संवर्त्तको नाम सो ऽग्निः पिबति तज्जलम्
verses.transliteration: cakramainākayormadhya vidiśaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prati / tatra saṃvarttako nāma so 'gniḥ pibati tajjalam
verses.translation: The three (Elements) beginning with the earth and ending with Vahni (fire)* are limited ones. In view of the essence of the increase of qualities, they have Pariceheda (exact determinateness, concrete state) in particular. The accurate decision or judgement about the remaining principles is not perceived, owing to their subtle* ness {aukfmyo)- That earth is remembered as VydlokA (some* thing that has a special brilliance?) beyond all these other elements.
verses.wordMeaning: The three (Elements) beginning with the earth and ending with Vahni (fire)* are limited ones. In view of the essence of the increase of qualities, they have Pariceheda (exact determinateness, concrete state) in particular.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The three (Elements) beginning with the earth and ending with Vahni (fire)* are limited ones. In view of the essence of the increase of qualities, they have Pariceheda (exact determinateness, concrete state) in particular.…

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना समुद्रवासस्तु और्वःस वडवामुखः । द्वादशैते प्रविष्टा हि पर्वता लवणोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: nāmnā samudravāsastu aurvaḥsa vaḍavāmukhaḥ / dvādaśaite praviṣṭā hi parvatā lavaṇodadhim
verses.translation: The whole of these four elements are bigger and superior to one another. As long as these elements exist the period of creation lasts to that extent.
verses.hindi: मुनि ने कहा था--हे वत्स ! उपह्वर में आओ । वह रामभी उन मुनि कें समीप में जाकर अपने हाथ जोड़कर उनका उसने अभिवादन. किया 'था।७१। राम परम प्रसन्न आत्मा से उतके आगे स्थित हो गया था और असन्न मन वाले भृगु ने आशीर्वादों के द्वारा अभिनन्दन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: The whole of these four elements are bigger and superior to one another. As long as these elements exist the period of creation lasts to that extent.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole of these four elements are bigger and superior to one another. As long as these elements exist the period of creation lasts to that extent.

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रभयवित्रस्ताः पक्षच्छे दभयात्पुरा । यदेतद्दृश्यते चन्द्रे श्वेते कृष्णशशाकृति
verses.transliteration: mahendrabhayavitrastāḥ pakṣacche dabhayātpurā / yadetaddṛśyate candre śvete kṛṣṇaśaśākṛti
verses.translation: Hence, the differences which are of the nature of effects are declared to be limited. The differences such as Mahat and others are of the nature of cause. Thus, O Brahmanas, the real situation comprising of the seven continents, oceans etc. has been recounted by me topic by topic as it exists— (realistically).
verses.hindi: उसने न अधिगत अ श वाले राम को आदर के साथ देखकर कहा था। हे बत्स ! आप भेरा वचन श्रवण करो जो इस समय में मैं आपको कहुँगा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the differences which are of the nature of effects are declared to be limited. The differences such as Mahat and others are of the nature of cause. Thus, O Brahmanas, the real situation comprising of the seven continents, oceans etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the differences which are of the nature of effects are declared to be limited. The differences such as Mahat and others are of the nature of cause. Thus, O Brahmanas, the real situation comprising of the seven continents, oceans etc.…

verses.sanskrit: भारतस्य तु वर्षस्य भेदास्ते नव कीर्त्तिताः । इहोदितस्य दृश्यन्ते यथान्ये ऽन्यत्र चोदिते
verses.transliteration: bhāratasya tu varṣasya bhedāste nava kīrttitāḥ / ihoditasya dṛśyante yathānye 'nyatra codite
verses.translation: The partial transformation the Pradh&na with the cosmic form has been mentioned in detail. The zones have been enumerated.
verses.hindi: यह वचन समस्त लोकों के तुम्हारे और हमारे हित के लिये है। है पुत्र ! मेरे आवेश से अब महात् पर्यत हिमवान् को चले जाओ ।७४। तपणचर्या करने के लिये अपने मन में निशवय करके इसो समय इस आश्रम से चले जाओ । है महाभाग, वहाँ जाकर उस आश्रम के स्थान को शुभ बना दो
verses.wordMeaning: The partial transformation the Pradh&na with the cosmic form has been mentioned in detail. The zones have been enumerated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The partial transformation the Pradh&na with the cosmic form has been mentioned in detail. The zones have been enumerated.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरोत्तरमेतेषां वर्षमुद्दिश्यते गुणैः । आरोग्यायुः प्रमाणानां धर्मतः कामतोर्ऽथतः
verses.transliteration: uttarottarameteṣāṃ varṣamuddiśyate guṇaiḥ / ārogyāyuḥ pramāṇānāṃ dharmataḥ kāmator'thataḥ
verses.translation: Only this much of the situation (of the universe) can be recounted by me. Only this much has to be heard (i.e. listened to and understood) in regard to the situation of the earth and things connected with it. These seven Btokrixi sustain one another. 1 am not able to enumerate them with reference to their extents and dimensions.
verses.hindi: ७५ यहाँ पर तपस्या और नियम से महादेवजी की समाराधना करो । खिरकाल तक अनस्य भक्ति से आप उनकी भीति का समुस्पादन करो
verses.wordMeaning: Only this much of the situation (of the universe) can be recounted by me. Only this much has to be heard (i.e. listened to and understood) in regard to the situation of the earth and things connected with it. These seven Btokrixi sustain one another.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Only this much of the situation (of the universe) can be recounted by me. Only this much has to be heard (i.e. listened to and understood) in regard to the situation of the earth and things connected with it. These seven Btokrixi sustain one another.…

verses.sanskrit: समन्वितानि भूतानि पुण्यैरेतैस्तु भागशः । वसंति नानाजातीनि तेषु वर्षेषु तानि वै । इत्येषा धारयन्तीदं पृथ्वी विश्वं जगत्स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: samanvitāni bhūtāni puṇyairetaistu bhāgaśaḥ / vasaṃti nānājātīni teṣu varṣeṣu tāni vai / ityeṣā dhārayantīdaṃ pṛthvī viśvaṃ jagatsthitam
verses.translation: The Vrokrtis arc innumerable, above, below and at the sides. The situation of the constellations is in firmament in different zones and regions.
verses.hindi: इसके करने से आप महानु श्रेय की प्राप्ति करेंगे--इस विषय में लेशमात्र भी सन्देह नहीं करता चाहिए । शोघ् ही आपकी भक्ति से भगवाव शङ्कर! परम प्रसन्न हो जायेगे
verses.wordMeaning: The Vrokrtis arc innumerable, above, below and at the sides. The situation of the constellations is in firmament in different zones and regions.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vrokrtis arc innumerable, above, below and at the sides. The situation of the constellations is in firmament in different zones and regions.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे जम्बूद्वीपवर्णनं नामाष्टादशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच प्लक्षद्वीपं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावदिह संग्रहात् । शृणुतेमं यथातत्त्वं ब्रुवतो मे द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde jambūdvīpavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca plakṣadvīpaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadiha saṃgrahāt / śṛṇutemaṃ yathātattvaṃ bruvato me dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Called Veyaddba in Jain (Ardha MagadhI) canon.
verses.hindi: करिष्यति च ते सर्व मनसा यद्यदिच्छसि ।
verses.wordMeaning: Called Veyaddba in Jain (Ardha MagadhI) canon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Called Veyaddba in Jain (Ardha MagadhI) canon.

verses.sanskrit: जंबूद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद्द्विगुणास्तस्य विस्तरः । विस्तराद्द्विगुणश्चास्य परिणाहः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: jaṃbūdvīpasya vistārāddviguṇāstasya vistaraḥ / vistarāddviguṇaścāsya pariṇāhaḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Pur&nas give different locatioQS of Gandhamidana and Milyav&n.
verses.wordMeaning: Pur&nas give different locatioQS of Gandhamidana and Milyav&n.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pur&nas give different locatioQS of Gandhamidana and Milyav&n.

verses.sanskrit: तेनावृतः समुद्रो वै द्वीपेन लवणोदकः । तत्र पुण्या जनपदाश्चिरान्न म्रियते जनः
verses.transliteration: tenāvṛtaḥ samudro vai dvīpena lavaṇodakaḥ / tatra puṇyā janapadāścirānna mriyate janaḥ
verses.translation: The brilliant Sumcru shiaeSf established like a king» It has the colour and brilltancc of the midday sun. It is re* fulgent like the smokeless fire.
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliant Sumcru shiaeSf established like a king» It has the colour and brilltancc of the midday sun. It is re* fulgent like the smokeless fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliant Sumcru shiaeSf established like a king» It has the colour and brilltancc of the midday sun. It is re* fulgent like the smokeless fire.

verses.sanskrit: कृत एव च दुर्भिक्षं जराव्याधिभयं कुतः । तत्रापि पर्वताः पुण्याः सप्तैव मणिभूषणाः
verses.transliteration: kṛta eva ca durbhikṣaṃ jarāvyādhibhayaṃ kutaḥ / tatrāpi parvatāḥ puṇyāḥ saptaiva maṇibhūṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: This >pesn to be the four<of»inent (Colur-ipf) theory about the earth where the distributioG Vanas is as follows:
verses.wordMeaning: This >pesn to be the four<of»inent (Colur-ipf) theory about the earth where the distributioG Vanas is as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This >pesn to be the four<of»inent (Colur-ipf) theory about the earth where the distributioG Vanas is as follows:

verses.sanskrit: रत्नाकरास्तथा नद्यस्तासां नामानि च बुवे । ब्लक्षद्वीपादिषु त्वेषु सप्त सप्त तु पञ्चसु
verses.transliteration: ratnākarāstathā nadyastāsāṃ nāmāni ca buve / blakṣadvīpādiṣu tveṣu sapta sapta tu pañcasu
verses.translation: All the men there are black and very strong. They have great inherent vitality. The women have the colour and lustre of the petals of lilies. All of them are pleasing to behold.
verses.wordMeaning: All the men there are black and very strong. They have great inherent vitality. The women have the colour and lustre of the petals of lilies. All of them are pleasing to behold.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the men there are black and very strong. They have great inherent vitality. The women have the colour and lustre of the petals of lilies. All of them are pleasing to behold.

verses.sanskrit: ऋज्वायताः प्रतिदिशं निविष्टा वर्षपर्वताः । प्लक्षद्वीपे तु वक्ष्यामि सप्तद्वीपान् महा बलान्
verses.transliteration: ṛjvāyatāḥ pratidiśaṃ niviṣṭā varṣaparvatāḥ / plakṣadvīpe tu vakṣyāmi saptadvīpān mahā balān
verses.translation: They drink the juice of its fruits and live for ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: बे भगवान् शङ्कुर त सभी कार्ये पूर्ण कर देंगे जो-जो भी आप अपने मन में चाहेंगे । उन भक्तों पर स्यार Ee वाले जगत् के स्वामी भगवान् शङ्कुर के सन्तुष्ट हो जाने पर तुम को यह करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: They drink the juice of its fruits and live for ten thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: They drink the juice of its fruits and live for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: गोमेदको ऽत्र प्रथमः पर्वतो मेघसन्निभः । ख्यायते यस्य नाम्ना तु वर्षं गोमेदसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: gomedako 'tra prathamaḥ parvato meghasannibhaḥ / khyāyate yasya nāmnā tu varṣaṃ gomedasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: It has the same length and extent as the western GapdikA. Bhadr&ivas should be known (as the people) there* They are always delighted in their minds.
verses.hindi: को आप उनसे वरदान में माँग सेना । तुमको समस्तः देवों की भलाई के लिए इस परम दुष्कर काये को कर ही लेता चाहिए ।७६। शहत्रों के द्वारा साधन करने के योग्य अनेक कर्म होते हैं और विशेष अधिक होते हैं। इस कारण से तुम देवों के भी आराध्य देव भगवान् शक्कर की आराधना करो।
verses.wordMeaning: It has the same length and extent as the western GapdikA. Bhadr&ivas should be known (as the people) there* They are always delighted in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has the same length and extent as the western GapdikA. Bhadr&ivas should be known (as the people) there* They are always delighted in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयः पर्वतश्चन्द्रः सर्वौंष धिसमन्वितः । अश्विभ्याममृतस्यार्थमोषध्यो यत्र संभृताः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaḥ parvataścandraḥ sarvauṃṣa dhisamanvitaḥ / aśvibhyāmamṛtasyārthamoṣadhyo yatra saṃbhṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The women have the colour and lustre of the water- lilies. They are beautiful and pleasing to behold. They have Che lunar brilliance and hue. Their faces resemble the moon,
verses.hindi: परमाधिक भक्ति से जब तुम संयुत हो जाओगे तो तुम सम्पूर्ण अपना प्राप्त कर लोगे
verses.wordMeaning: The women have the colour and lustre of the water- lilies. They are beautiful and pleasing to behold. They have Che lunar brilliance and hue. Their faces resemble the moon,
verses.commentary: Sense: The women have the colour and lustre of the water- lilies. They are beautiful and pleasing to behold. They have Che lunar brilliance and hue. Their faces resemble the moon,

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयो नारदो नाम दुर्गशैलो महोच्चयः । तत्राचले समुत्पन्नौ पूर्वं नारदपर्वतौ
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyo nārado nāma durgaśailo mahoccayaḥ / tatrācale samutpannau pūrvaṃ nāradaparvatau
verses.translation: Their limbs are cool of touch like the moon. They have the odour of lilies. Their span of life is ten thousand years and 28 free from ailments.
verses.wordMeaning: Their limbs are cool of touch like the moon. They have the odour of lilies. Their span of life is ten thousand years and 28 free from ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their limbs are cool of touch like the moon. They have the odour of lilies. Their span of life is ten thousand years and 28 free from ailments.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थस्तत्र वै शैलो दुदुंभिर्न्नाम नामतः । छन्दमृत्युः पुरा तस्मिन्दुन्दुभिः सादितः सुरैः
verses.transliteration: caturthastatra vai śailo duduṃbhirnnāma nāmataḥ / chandamṛtyuḥ purā tasmindundubhiḥ sāditaḥ suraiḥ
verses.translation: Tha Menu to be modem Ghins.
verses.wordMeaning: Tha Menu to be modem Ghins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tha Menu to be modem Ghins.

verses.sanskrit: रज्जुदोलोरुकामं यः शाल्मलिश्चासुरान्तकृत् । पञ्चमः सोमको नाम देवैर्यत्रामृतं पुरा
verses.transliteration: rajjudolorukāmaṃ yaḥ śālmaliścāsurāntakṛt / pañcamaḥ somako nāma devairyatrāmṛtaṃ purā
verses.translation: Ideatified with aacieni Sogriiens si the dacriptioii ullhfs with the Uodi pUnt-life and pele of ihoM tiiaei, M.Ali/Kd. p -84.
verses.wordMeaning: Ideatified with aacieni Sogriiens si the dacriptioii ullhfs with the Uodi pUnt-life and pele of ihoM tiiaei, M.Ali/Kd. p -84.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ideatified with aacieni Sogriiens si the dacriptioii ullhfs with the Uodi pUnt-life and pele of ihoM tiiaei, M.Ali/Kd. p -84.

verses.sanskrit: संभृतं चाहृतं चैव मातुरर्थे गरुत्मता । षष्टस्तु सुमना नाम सप्तमर्षभ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃbhṛtaṃ cāhṛtaṃ caiva māturarthe garutmatā / ṣaṣṭastu sumanā nāma saptamarṣabha ucyate
verses.translation: To the north of and to the south of the
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of and to the south of the
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of and to the south of the

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यक्षो वराहेण तस्मिञ्छैले निषूदितः । वैभ्राजः सप्तमस्तत्र भ्राजिष्णुः स्फाटिको महान्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakṣo varāheṇa tasmiñchaile niṣūditaḥ / vaibhrājaḥ saptamastatra bhrājiṣṇuḥ sphāṭiko mahān
verses.translation: The trees there have Madhu (honey, wine) for its fruit. They put forth perpetual Sowers, fruits and sprouts. They yield garments and ornaments by way of fruits.
verses.hindi: तत्र तत्र निवासेषु मुनीनां निवसन्पथि । ती्येषु भेत्रमुख्येषु निवसन्वा ययौ शनेः
verses.wordMeaning: The trees there have Madhu (honey, wine) for its fruit. They put forth perpetual Sowers, fruits and sprouts. They yield garments and ornaments by way of fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees there have Madhu (honey, wine) for its fruit. They put forth perpetual Sowers, fruits and sprouts. They yield garments and ornaments by way of fruits.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चिर्भिर्भ्राजते यस्माद्वैभ्राजस्तेन संस्मृतः । तेषां वर्षाणि वक्ष्यामि नामतस्तु यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: arcirbhirbhrājate yasmādvaibhrājastena saṃsmṛtaḥ / teṣāṃ varṣāṇi vakṣyāmi nāmatastu yathākramam
verses.translation: Some of the trees are very delightfully charming and they bestow all desires. They exude excellent honey full of sweet smell, colour and taste.
verses.wordMeaning: Some of the trees are very delightfully charming and they bestow all desires. They exude excellent honey full of sweet smell, colour and taste.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of the trees are very delightfully charming and they bestow all desires. They exude excellent honey full of sweet smell, colour and taste.

verses.sanskrit: गोमेदं प्रथमं वर्षं नाम्नाशान्तभयं स्मृतम् । चन्द्रस्य शिशिरं नाम नारदस्य सुखोदयम्
verses.transliteration: gomedaṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ nāmnāśāntabhayaṃ smṛtam / candrasya śiśiraṃ nāma nāradasya sukhodayam
verses.translation: Other trees arc ksirlns (Milky ones) byname. They are very delightful and they always exude milk comparable to nectar having six tastes.
verses.hindi: श्री वसिष्ठ जी ने कहा-शुगु मुनि के द्वारा इस प्रकार से कहे जाने पर मैं ऐसा ही करूंगा-यह कहकर राम नें उनको प्रभाम किया था और
verses.wordMeaning: Other trees arc ksirlns (Milky ones) byname. They are very delightful and they always exude milk comparable to nectar having six tastes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other trees arc ksirlns (Milky ones) byname. They are very delightful and they always exude milk comparable to nectar having six tastes.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दं दुन्दुभेर्वर्षं सोमकस्यशिवं स्मृतम् । क्षेमकं वृषभस्यापि वैभ्राजस्य ध्रुवं तथा
verses.transliteration: ānandaṃ dundubhervarṣaṃ somakasyaśivaṃ smṛtam / kṣemakaṃ vṛṣabhasyāpi vaibhrājasya dhruvaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Splendid human beings displaced and dropping down from the world of the Devas arc born there. They arc white- complcxioncd and richly endowed with nobility of birth. All have steady perpetual youth.
verses.wordMeaning: Splendid human beings displaced and dropping down from the world of the Devas arc born there. They arc white- complcxioncd and richly endowed with nobility of birth. All have steady perpetual youth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Splendid human beings displaced and dropping down from the world of the Devas arc born there. They arc white- complcxioncd and richly endowed with nobility of birth. All have steady perpetual youth.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषु देवगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च सह चारणैः । विहरन्ति रमन्ते च दृश्यमानाश्च तैः सह
verses.transliteration: eteṣu devagandharvāḥ siddhāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ / viharanti ramante ca dṛśyamānāśca taiḥ saha
verses.translation: shall recount to you all the subjects here in the Bh&rata Var$a.
verses.hindi: राम उनके द्वारा आज्ञा प्राप्त करके वहाँ पर गमन करने का मन वाला हौ गया था ।१। भूगु के सुयश का गान कर तया विधि पूर्वक उनकी परिक्रमा करते हुए प्रणाम करके राम ने प्रस्थान करने की तैयारी की थी । उन दोनों ने उसका परिष्वजन किया था और आशोवंचनों से राम का अभिनन्दन
verses.wordMeaning: shall recount to you all the subjects here in the Bh&rata Var$a.
verses.commentary: Sense: shall recount to you all the subjects here in the Bh&rata Var$a.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां नद्यस्तु सप्तैव प्रतिवर्षं समुद्रगाः । नामतस्ताः प्रवक्ष्यामि सप्तगङ्गास्तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ nadyastu saptaiva prativarṣaṃ samudragāḥ / nāmatastāḥ pravakṣyāmi saptagaṅgāstapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: All round in the bordering regions the sub-continem is colonized by Mlccchas (barbarous tribes). The Kiratas live in the Eastern border lands and the Yavanas in the Western border lands.
verses.hindi: किया.था।२। वहाँ पर जो भी मुनिगण बे उन सबके लिए राम ने प्रणाम किया था तथा बह उन सब के द्वारा बह गमन करने के लिए अनुमोदन पराप्त करने वाला हुआ था । फिर राम उस आश्रम के स्थल से तपश्चर्या करने के लिए मन में पूर्ण निश्चय वाला होकर निकल दिया था ।३। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: All round in the bordering regions the sub-continem is colonized by Mlccchas (barbarous tribes). The Kiratas live in the Eastern border lands and the Yavanas in the Western border lands.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round in the bordering regions the sub-continem is colonized by Mlccchas (barbarous tribes). The Kiratas live in the Eastern border lands and the Yavanas in the Western border lands.

verses.sanskrit: अनुतप्तासुखी चैव विपाशा त्रिदिवा क्रमुः । अमृता सुकृता चैव सप्तैताः सरितां वराः
verses.transliteration: anutaptāsukhī caiva vipāśā tridivā kramuḥ / amṛtā sukṛtā caiva saptaitāḥ saritāṃ varāḥ
verses.translation: The Brihmapas, the Kjatriyas and the Vaiiyas live in the central areas and the Sudras (are scattered) indifferent parts. They are well settled maintaining themselves by means of performance of sacrifices, wielding of weapons and carrying on trading activities.
verses.hindi: अनन्तर गुरु देव के नियोग से और उनके द्वारा बताये हुए बताये हुए मार्गे से महार मन वाले राम ने गिरियों में परम श्रेष्ठ हिमवान् ' को गमन किया था ।४। मागे में उसको अनेक देश--पर्बंत-नदियाँ-बन और प्रमुख मुनियों के आचास-स्थल मिले थे। उन सबका उसने धीरे-धीरे अतिक्रमण किया था
verses.wordMeaning: The Brihmapas, the Kjatriyas and the Vaiiyas live in the central areas and the Sudras (are scattered) indifferent parts. They are well settled maintaining themselves by means of performance of sacrifices, wielding of weapons and carrying on trading activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brihmapas, the Kjatriyas and the Vaiiyas live in the central areas and the Sudras (are scattered) indifferent parts. They are well settled maintaining themselves by means of performance of sacrifices, wielding of weapons and carrying on trading activities.

verses.sanskrit: अभिगच्छन्ति ता नद्यस्ताभ्यश्चान्याः सहस्रशः । बहूदका ह्योघवत्यो यतो वर्षति वासवः
verses.transliteration: abhigacchanti tā nadyastābhyaścānyāḥ sahasraśaḥ / bahūdakā hyoghavatyo yato varṣati vāsavaḥ
verses.translation: Some of these mountains arc identified as follows:
verses.hindi: और जो मुखय क्षेत्र ये तया तों स्थल मिले थे उनमें निवास करते हुए धीरे-धीरे वह वहाँ पर चलते चला गया था।५। मागं में अनेक देशों का अतिक्रमण करके और परम मनोरथ देशों का अवलोकन करते हुए अन्त में परमोत्तम और पवंतों में श्रं ष्ठ हिमवान् पर बह पहुँच गया था

verses.sanskrit: ताः पिबन्ति सदा हृष्टा नदीजनपदास्तु ते । शुभाः शान्तभयाश्चैव प्रमुदं शैशिराः शिवाः
verses.transliteration: tāḥ pibanti sadā hṛṣṭā nadījanapadāstu te / śubhāḥ śāntabhayāścaiva pramudaṃ śaiśirāḥ śivāḥ
verses.translation: The regions interspersed with these mountains arc partially inhabited by Aryas and partially by the MIecchas (tribal •barbarous* people). The following rivers (beginning with) the GaAgi, the Sindhu and the Sarasvati arc utilised by them for drinking purposes.
verses.wordMeaning: The regions interspersed with these mountains arc partially inhabited by Aryas and partially by the MIecchas (tribal •barbarous* people). The following rivers (beginning with) the GaAgi, the Sindhu and the Sarasvati arc utilised by them for drinking purposes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The regions interspersed with these mountains arc partially inhabited by Aryas and partially by the MIecchas (tribal •barbarous* people). The following rivers (beginning with) the GaAgi, the Sindhu and the Sarasvati arc utilised by them for drinking purposes.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दाश्च सुखाश्चैव क्षेमकाश्च ध्रुवैः सह । वर्णाश्रमाचारयुता प्रजास्तेष्ववधिष्ठिताः

verses.transliteration: na tatrāsti yugāvasthā caturyugakṛtā kvacit / tretāyugasamaḥ kālaḥ sarvadā tatra varttate
verses.translation: The following rivers have originated from the mountain Malaya. All of them are auspicious and they have cool waters. They arc: the Kri&mila, the Timrapari, the Pufpajatl and the Utpalavatl.
verses.wordMeaning: The following rivers have originated from the mountain Malaya. All of them are auspicious and they have cool waters. They arc: the Kri&mila, the Timrapari, the Pufpajatl and the Utpalavatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following rivers have originated from the mountain Malaya. All of them are auspicious and they have cool waters. They arc: the Kri&mila, the Timrapari, the Pufpajatl and the Utpalavatl.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपादिषु ज्ञेयः पञ्चस्वेतेषु सर्वशः । देशस्यानुविधानेन कालस्यानुविधाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpādiṣu jñeyaḥ pañcasveteṣu sarvaśaḥ / deśasyānuvidhānena kālasyānuvidhāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The following rivers remembered as daughters of the mount Mahcndra:* The Trisami, sikulyi, The Vamjuli, the Tridivd, the (A) bald, the LangOlinl and the Varhiadhari.
verses.hindi: वह उस श्रेष्ठ पर्वेत पर पहुँच गया था जहाँ पर अनेक प्रकार के वृक्ष और लताएं थीं । उसमे वहाँ पर देखा था कि बहुत से ऐसे ऊँचे शिखर विद्यमान हैं जो मानों अम्बर का स्पर्श करके उस पर कुछ लिख रहे हों
verses.wordMeaning: The following rivers remembered as daughters of the mount Mahcndra:* The Trisami, sikulyi, The Vamjuli, the Tridivd, the (A) bald, the LangOlinl and the Varhiadhari.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following rivers remembered as daughters of the mount Mahcndra:* The Trisami, sikulyi, The Vamjuli, the Tridivd, the (A) bald, the LangOlinl and the Varhiadhari.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षद्वीपः पृथुः श्रीमान्सर्वतो धनधान्यवान् । दिव्यौषधिफलोपेतः सर्वौंषधिवनस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: prakṣadvīpaḥ pṛthuḥ śrīmānsarvato dhanadhānyavān / divyauṣadhiphalopetaḥ sarvauṃṣadhivanaspatiḥ
verses.translation: The modem names of these rivers arc given in brackets:
verses.hindi: स्फटिक अञ्जन से बुरे बर्ण वाले स्वर्ण के समूह की प्रभा की किरणों के द्वारा स्फुरण करते हुए परस्पर में छाया शरों से प्रसिद्ध था।१२। उपत्य- काओं की शिलाओं के पृष्ठ भाग पर वालातप का सेबन करने बाले तुषार से किलम्न सिद्धं के समुदाय से वह बह वन कहीं पर उद्भासित हो रहा था।

verses.sanskrit: आवृतः पशुभिः सर्वैर्ग्राम्यारण्यैः सहस्रशः । जंबूवृक्षेम संख्यातस्तस्य मध्ये द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: āvṛtaḥ paśubhiḥ sarvairgrāmyāraṇyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ / jaṃbūvṛkṣema saṃkhyātastasya madhye dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The following rivers are remembered as originating from Suktiman: The B> 9 ikulyi 9 theKumaxi, thcMandaga, the Mandag&min!, the Krp and the Pal&iinl.
verses.hindi: किसी-किसी जगह पर सूर्य की किरणों से संभिन्न सुबणे को शिलाओं पर समाश्षय ग्रहण करने बाले यकं के समुदायों से पावक में प्रवेश करने बालों की तरह उसका उपान्त भासित हो रहा था
verses.wordMeaning: The following rivers are remembered as originating from Suktiman: The B> 9 ikulyi 9 theKumaxi, thcMandaga, the Mandag&min!, the Krp and the Pal&iinl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following rivers are remembered as originating from Suktiman: The B> 9 ikulyi 9 theKumaxi, thcMandaga, the Mandag&min!, the Krp and the Pal&iinl.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षो नाम महावृक्षस्तस्य नाम्ना स उच्यते । स तत्र पूज्यते स्थाने मध्ये जनपदस्य ह

verses.translation: All these rivers are identical with the Sarasvatl and the Gaiigi. They flow into the sea. All of them are rem¬ embered as the mothers of the universe and disp>ellers of the sins of the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: All these rivers are identical with the Sarasvatl and the Gaiigi. They flow into the sea. All of them are rem¬ embered as the mothers of the universe and disp>ellers of the sins of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: sarvadhātumayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ śilājālasamākulaiḥ / dvitīyaḥ parvataścātra hyuttamo nāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: The following can be identified as per De and M. Ati.
verses.hindi: विशाल शिला एवं तटके तरुवर जिसमें विद्यमान ये ।१६। कहीं पर कलभों के उत्मेषण से आक्ृष्ट हुई करिणियों के द्वारा भागे हुए गवयों के खुर से वहाँ के तट प्रस्थ संक्षुण्ण थे ।१७। किसी स्यान पर वासित अथं में विशेष बढ़े हुए मद से उन्मत्त गजों से जो कि परस्पर में युद्ध कर रहे थे गण्ड स्थलों के
verses.wordMeaning: The following can be identified as per De and M. Ati.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following can be identified as per De and M. Ati.

verses.transliteration: haritālamayaiḥ śṛṅgairdivamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati / tṛtiyaḥ parvatastatra balāhaka iti śrutaḥ

verses.sanskrit: जात्यञ्जनमयैः शृङ्गैर्दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठति । चतुर्थः पर्वतो द्रोणो यत्र सा वै सहोषधिः
verses.transliteration: jātyañjanamayaiḥ śṛṅgairdivamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati / caturthaḥ parvato droṇo yatra sā vai sahoṣadhiḥ
verses.translation: Recount to u$ the sub-continents of Kimpuru$a and Harivar as actually they are really. The sub-continent of BhSrata has already been recounted by you.
verses.hindi: से युक्त हाथियों कै करन्दन की ध्वनि से सम्पूणं बन पूरित होरहा था
verses.wordMeaning: Recount to u$ the sub-continents of Kimpuru$a and Harivar as actually they are really. The sub-continent of BhSrata has already been recounted by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Recount to u$ the sub-continents of Kimpuru$a and Harivar as actually they are really. The sub-continent of BhSrata has already been recounted by you.

verses.sanskrit: विशल्यकरणी चैव मृतसञ्जीविनी तथा । कङ्कस्तु पञ्चमस्तत्र पर्वतः सुमहोदयः
verses.transliteration: viśalyakaraṇī caiva mṛtasañjīvinī tathā / kaṅkastu pañcamastatra parvataḥ sumahodayaḥ
verses.translation: Listen attentively, O Br&hmanas, to what you are <lc8irou8 of hearing. There is a very large grove of Plakja trees in the subcontinent Kimpuru$a. It can be compared with the {heavenly} Nandana park.
verses.hindi: अष्टपादों के द्वारा बलपूर्वक जिनके केसर खींच लिए गये हैं उनके परम दारण शब्द से कहीं कहीं पर पर्वेत की गम्मोर गुफाएँ भी सब भेद्यमान थी
verses.wordMeaning: Listen attentively, O Br&hmanas, to what you are <lc8irou8 of hearing. There is a very large grove of Plakja trees in the subcontinent Kimpuru$a. It can be compared with the {heavenly} Nandana park.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen attentively, O Br&hmanas, to what you are <lc8irou8 of hearing. There is a very large grove of Plakja trees in the subcontinent Kimpuru$a. It can be compared with the {heavenly} Nandana park.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यपुष्पफलोपेतो वृक्षवीरुत्समावृतः । षष्ठस्तु पर्वतस्तत्र महिषो मेघसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: nityapuṣpaphalopeto vṛkṣavīrutsamāvṛtaḥ / ṣaṣṭhastu parvatastatra mahiṣo meghasannibhaḥ
verses.translation: Ills remembered that the span of life in Kimpurusa is for ten thousand years. The men have golden complexion and the women are comparable to celestial damsels.
verses.wordMeaning: Ills remembered that the span of life in Kimpurusa is for ten thousand years. The men have golden complexion and the women are comparable to celestial damsels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ills remembered that the span of life in Kimpurusa is for ten thousand years. The men have golden complexion and the women are comparable to celestial damsels.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्सो ऽग्निर्निवसति महिषो नाम वारिजः । सप्तमः पर्वतस्तत्र ककुद्मान्नाम भाष्यते
verses.transliteration: yasminso 'gnirnivasati mahiṣo nāma vārijaḥ / saptamaḥ parvatastatra kakudmānnāma bhāṣyate
verses.translation: All people there, are free from ailments and sorrows. They are perpetually joyous in their minds. They have the lustre of hot glowing gold.
verses.wordMeaning: All people there, are free from ailments and sorrows. They are perpetually joyous in their minds. They have the lustre of hot glowing gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: All people there, are free from ailments and sorrows. They are perpetually joyous in their minds. They have the lustre of hot glowing gold.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र रत्नान्यनेकानि स्वयं रक्षति वासवः । प्रजापतिमुपादाय प्रजाभ्यो विधिवत्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra ratnānyanekāni svayaṃ rakṣati vāsavaḥ / prajāpatimupādāya prajābhyo vidhivatsvayam
verses.translation: In the holy sub-continent of Ktmpuru$a, there is an auspicious tree oozing out (exuding) honey. All the Kimpuru$as drink its excellent juice.
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy sub-continent of Ktmpuru$a, there is an auspicious tree oozing out (exuding) honey. All the Kimpuru$as drink its excellent juice.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy sub-continent of Ktmpuru$a, there is an auspicious tree oozing out (exuding) honey. All the Kimpuru$as drink its excellent juice.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते पर्वताः सप्त शाल्मले मणिभूषणाः । तेषां वर्षाणि वक्ष्यामि सर्पैव तु शुभानि वै
verses.transliteration: ityete parvatāḥ sapta śālmale maṇibhūṣaṇāḥ / teṣāṃ varṣāṇi vakṣyāmi sarpaiva tu śubhāni vai
verses.translation: All the people in the sub-continent of Harivar are those who have been dropped down from die Devaloka (Region of the Devas). All of them have the characteristics and racial features of the Devas. They drink the auspicious sugarcane juice.
verses.wordMeaning: All the people in the sub-continent of Harivar are those who have been dropped down from die Devaloka (Region of the Devas). All of them have the characteristics and racial features of the Devas. They drink the auspicious sugarcane juice.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the people in the sub-continent of Harivar are those who have been dropped down from die Devaloka (Region of the Devas). All of them have the characteristics and racial features of the Devas. They drink the auspicious sugarcane juice.

verses.sanskrit: कुमुदस्य स्मृतं श्वेतमुत्तमस्य च लोहितम् । बलाहकस्य जीमूतं द्रोणस्य हरितं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: kumudasya smṛtaṃ śvetamuttamasya ca lohitam / balāhakasya jīmūtaṃ droṇasya haritaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Men are born there with the lustre of the lotus. They have the colour of their complexion resembling that of the lotus. They have eyes like lotus and fragrance like that of the lotus petals.
verses.wordMeaning: Men are born there with the lustre of the lotus. They have the colour of their complexion resembling that of the lotus. They have eyes like lotus and fragrance like that of the lotus petals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men are born there with the lustre of the lotus. They have the colour of their complexion resembling that of the lotus. They have eyes like lotus and fragrance like that of the lotus petals.

verses.sanskrit: कङ्कस्य वैद्युतं नाम महिषस्य च मानसम् । ककुदः सुप्रदं नाम सप्तैतानि तु सप्तधा
verses.transliteration: kaṅkasya vaidyutaṃ nāma mahiṣasya ca mānasam / kakudaḥ supradaṃ nāma saptaitāni tu saptadhā
verses.translation: Their diet consists of the fruit and juice of the rose- apple. They do not have sweat trickling down from their bodies. They arc sweet-smelling. They arc intelligent. They enjoy all sensual pleasures, and the fruits of their meritorious actions.
verses.wordMeaning: Their diet consists of the fruit and juice of the rose- apple. They do not have sweat trickling down from their bodies. They arc sweet-smelling. They arc intelligent. They enjoy all sensual pleasures, and the fruits of their meritorious actions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their diet consists of the fruit and juice of the rose- apple. They do not have sweat trickling down from their bodies. They arc sweet-smelling. They arc intelligent. They enjoy all sensual pleasures, and the fruits of their meritorious actions.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणि पर्वताश्चैव नदीस्तेषु निबोधत । ज्योतिः शान्तिस्तथा तुष्टा चन्द्रा शुक्रा विमोचनी
verses.transliteration: varṣāṇi parvatāścaiva nadīsteṣu nibodhata / jyotiḥ śāntistathā tuṣṭā candrā śukrā vimocanī
verses.translation: They are fallen down from the world of the Devas. They have golden garments. The excellent men who live in the sub-contineuc Ilavrta have a span of life extending to thirteen thousand years.
verses.hindi: किसी स्थल पर संरब्ध बहुत से शबरों केरा प्रसक्त रोछों के मूथ पतियों के आनस में एक दूसरे के साय संमर्दे में शिलाए' भग्न हो गयीं थीं ।२२। कहीं पेर पेत की कुज्जों में करिणियाँ क्रीड़ाएँ कर रही थीं और बहा पर कोई करी नहीं था तब करेणु पर मत्तगज, दोड़कर चले जा रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: They are fallen down from the world of the Devas. They have golden garments. The excellent men who live in the sub-contineuc Ilavrta have a span of life extending to thirteen thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are fallen down from the world of the Devas. They have golden garments. The excellent men who live in the sub-contineuc Ilavrta have a span of life extending to thirteen thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिः सप्तमी तासां प्रतिवर्षं तु ताः स्मृताः । तासां समीपगाश्चान्याः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः

verses.wordMeaning: It goesdown a thousand Yojanas deep into the earth. Its girth also is the same. The mountain M&lyav&n is to its (i.c. Merus) east and its dimensions have been already recounted (as the same).
verses.commentary: Sense: It goesdown a thousand Yojanas deep into the earth. Its girth also is the same. The mountain M&lyav&n is to its (i.c. Merus) east and its dimensions have been already recounted (as the same).

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षवृक्षेण संख्यातस्तस्य मध्ये महा द्रुमः । शाल्मलिर्विपुलस्कन्धस्तस्य नाम्ना स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: plakṣavṛkṣeṇa saṃkhyātastasya madhye mahā drumaḥ / śālmalirvipulaskandhastasya nāmnā sa ucyate
verses.translation: On the southern side of the Meru and to the north of the Nisadhaj there is an ancient eternal Rose*applc tree named Sudariana.
verses.hindi: दिशाएँ पूरित थीं ।२६। उस महाव गिरि पर का बन इधर-उधर विचरण करती हुई अरण्य देवताओं के चरणों में लगे हुए महावर के रस से बहू भूतल चरणों के चिहनों से अङ्कित हो रहा या ।२७। सङ्गीत के मघुर स्वरों से समन्वित-मयूर-मयू रियों के शुण्ड अपनो पंखों को फॅलाकर कहीं पर
verses.wordMeaning: On the southern side of the Meru and to the north of the Nisadhaj there is an ancient eternal Rose*applc tree named Sudariana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the southern side of the Meru and to the north of the Nisadhaj there is an ancient eternal Rose*applc tree named Sudariana.
