verses.transliteration: śālmalastu samudreṇa surodena samāvṛtaḥ / vistarācchālmalasvaiva same na tu samantataḥ
verses.translation: The height of that nobte*souled lordly tree is one thousand and one hundred Yojanas. Everywhere it touches the firmament on all sides.
verses.hindi: आनन पूर्वक नृत्य कर रहें थे
verses.wordMeaning: The height of that nobte*souled lordly tree is one thousand and one hundred Yojanas. Everywhere it touches the firmament on all sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: The height of that nobte*souled lordly tree is one thousand and one hundred Yojanas. Everywhere it touches the firmament on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरेषु तु धर्मज्ञाद्वीपेषु शृणुत प्रजाः । यथाश्रुतं यथान्यायं ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: uttareṣu tu dharmajñādvīpeṣu śṛṇuta prajāḥ / yathāśrutaṃ yathānyāyaṃ bruvato me nibodhata
verses.translation: As they fall on the ground* these fruits make a loud sound. The juice of the fruits ofthat Jambu (Rose apple) tree flows as a river.
verses.hindi: 'रामो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठस्तपसे च मनों दधे । शाकमूलफलाहारो नियतं नियतेद्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: As they fall on the ground* these fruits make a loud sound. The juice of the fruits ofthat Jambu (Rose apple) tree flows as a river.
verses.commentary: Sense: As they fall on the ground* these fruits make a loud sound. The juice of the fruits ofthat Jambu (Rose apple) tree flows as a river.

verses.sanskrit: कुशद्वीपं प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्थं तु समासतः । सुरोदकः परिवृतः कुशद्वीपेन सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kuśadvīpaṃ pravakṣyāmi caturthaṃ tu samāsataḥ / surodakaḥ parivṛtaḥ kuśadvīpena sarvataḥ
verses.translation: This river circumambulates the Meru and penetrates into the ground deep down at the root of the Jambu tree. The delighted (inhabitants) of llavrta always drink the juice of the Jambu.
verses.hindi: तपश्चचार देवेशं विनिवेश्यात्ममानसे । भृगूपदिष्टमार्गेण भक्तघा परमया' युतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: This river circumambulates the Meru and penetrates into the ground deep down at the root of the Jambu tree. The delighted (inhabitants) of llavrta always drink the juice of the Jambu.
verses.commentary: Sense: This river circumambulates the Meru and penetrates into the ground deep down at the root of the Jambu tree. The delighted (inhabitants) of llavrta always drink the juice of the Jambu.

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मलस्य तु विस्ताराद्द्विगुणेन समन्ततः । सप्तैव च गिरींस्तत्र वर्ण्यमानान्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: śālmalasya tu vistārāddviguṇena samantataḥ / saptaiva ca girīṃstatra varṇyamānānnibodhata
verses.translation: The auspicious juice of the fhiits of the respective representative trees of all the subcontinents is hailed by all.
verses.hindi: पूजयामास देवेशमेकाग्रमनसा नृप । अनिकेतः सः वर्षासु शिशिरे जलसंश्रयः
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious juice of the fhiits of the respective representative trees of all the subcontinents is hailed by all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious juice of the fhiits of the respective representative trees of all the subcontinents is hailed by all.

verses.sanskrit: कुशद्वीपे तु विज्ञेयः पर्वतो विद्रुमश्च यः । द्वीपस्य प्रथमस्तस्य द्वितीयो हेमपर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kuśadvīpe tu vijñeyaḥ parvato vidrumaśca yaḥ / dvīpasya prathamastasya dvitīyo hemaparvataḥ
verses.translation: Sefa, Vasuki> Takfaka—(yes) all the serpents (live) on the Nifadha. The thirtythree (groups of) Devas (gods) authorised to partake of the shares in the Yajfta» sport about on the Mahimeru.
verses.wordMeaning: Sefa, Vasuki> Takfaka—(yes) all the serpents (live) on the Nifadha. The thirtythree (groups of) Devas (gods) authorised to partake of the shares in the Yajfta» sport about on the Mahimeru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sefa, Vasuki> Takfaka—(yes) all the serpents (live) on the Nifadha. The thirtythree (groups of) Devas (gods) authorised to partake of the shares in the Yajfta» sport about on the Mahimeru.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयो द्युतिमान्नाम जीमूतसदृशो गिरिः । चतुर्थः पुष्पवान्नाम पञ्चमस्तु कुशेशयः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyo dyutimānnāma jīmūtasadṛśo giriḥ / caturthaḥ puṣpavānnāma pañcamastu kuśeśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages devoid of impurities live on the Nila full ofVaidurya (Lapis Lazuli). It is mentioned that the mountain Sveta belongs to the Daityas and the DAnavas.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठो हरिगिरिर्नाम सप्तमो मन्दरः स्मृतः । मन्दा इति ह्यपा नाम मन्दरो दारणादयम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭho harigirirnāma saptamo mandaraḥ smṛtaḥ / mandā iti hyapā nāma mandaro dāraṇādayam
verses.translation: In the midst of the Himalayan ridges, there it a
verses.wordMeaning: In the midst of the Himalayan ridges, there it a
verses.commentary: Sense: In the midst of the Himalayan ridges, there it a

verses.sanskrit: तेषामन्तरविषकंभो द्विगुणः प्रविभागतः । उद्भिदं प्रथमं वर्षं द्वितीयं वेणुमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāmantaraviṣakaṃbho dviguṇaḥ pravibhāgataḥ / udbhidaṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ veṇumaṇḍalam
verses.translation: There is a great splendid divine park on its banks called Caitraratha. On that mountain lives Manibhadra along with his followers. He is the ruthless lord of the armies of Yak$as. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas.
verses.wordMeaning: There is a great splendid divine park on its banks called Caitraratha. On that mountain lives Manibhadra along with his followers. He is the ruthless lord of the armies of Yak$as. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a great splendid divine park on its banks called Caitraratha. On that mountain lives Manibhadra along with his followers. He is the ruthless lord of the armies of Yak$as. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं वै रथाकारं चतुर्थं लवणं समृतम् । पञ्चमं धृतिमद्वर्षं षष्ठं वर्षं प्रभाकरम्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ vai rathākāraṃ caturthaṃ lavaṇaṃ samṛtam / pañcamaṃ dhṛtimadvarṣaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ varṣaṃ prabhākaram
verses.translation: The description of mount Kailiia though a poetic one, shows that the Puripa writer was conversant with the topographical features of the M&nasa-sarovara basin.—vide M. All. cp.cit., p -58.
verses.wordMeaning: The description of mount Kailiia though a poetic one, shows that the Puripa writer was conversant with the topographical features of the M&nasa-sarovara basin.—vide M. All. cp.cit., p -58.
verses.commentary: Sense: The description of mount Kailiia though a poetic one, shows that the Puripa writer was conversant with the topographical features of the M&nasa-sarovara basin.—vide M. All. cp.cit., p -58.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तमं कपिलं नाम सर्वे ते वर्ष भावकाः । एतेषु देवगन्धर्वाः प्रजास्तु जगदीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: saptamaṃ kapilaṃ nāma sarve te varṣa bhāvakāḥ / eteṣu devagandharvāḥ prajāstu jagadīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: For understanding the Pur&];ac presentation of the ancient river- System, the following points are to be noted:
verses.hindi: ऐसे अनेक परम मनोरथ हृश्यों से परिपूर्णे उसःहिमवान् भिरि पर एक आश्रम अपना बनाकर सतिमातों में परभश्जे छ राम ने तपस्या करने का मन में विचार किया था ओर बह तपश्चर्या करने के लिये शाकों तथा मूलों के आहार करने बाला होकर नियत इन्द्रियों वाला बन गया था ।२६। उसने
verses.wordMeaning: For understanding the Pur&];ac presentation of the ancient river- System, the following points are to be noted:
verses.commentary: Sense: For understanding the Pur&];ac presentation of the ancient river- System, the following points are to be noted:

verses.sanskrit: विहरन्ति रमन्ते च हृष्यमाणास्तु सर्वशः । न तेषु दस्यवः संति म्लेच्छ जातय एव च
verses.transliteration: viharanti ramante ca hṛṣyamāṇāstu sarvaśaḥ / na teṣu dasyavaḥ saṃti mleccha jātaya eva ca
verses.translation: Unless mentioned otherwise all the r e f ere n ce s are to M. All's of ParJaar.
verses.hindi: देवेश भगवान् शङ्कुर को अपने मन में विनिवेशित करके तपस्या की थी । भुगुमुनि ने जी भो मार्ग बताया था उसी के अनुसार वह परमाधिक भक्ति से युक्त हो गया थ! ।३० ये नृप ! उसने एक निछ मन से देवेश्वर की पूजा की थी । वर्षा काल में भो वह बिना कहीं पर आश्रयः ग्रहण किये हुए खुले
verses.wordMeaning: Unless mentioned otherwise all the r e f ere n ce s are to M. All's of ParJaar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unless mentioned otherwise all the r e f ere n ce s are to M. All's of ParJaar.

verses.sanskrit: गौरप्रायो जनः सर्वः क्रमाच्च म्रियते तथा । तत्रापि नद्यः सप्तैव धूतपापाशिवा तथा
verses.transliteration: gauraprāyo janaḥ sarvaḥ kramācca mriyate tathā / tatrāpi nadyaḥ saptaiva dhūtapāpāśivā tathā
verses.translation: On its bank is the great park named Dcv&raoya which is devoid of sorrow. On that mountain lives Maiidhara the Yak?a of good self-control. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas who arc gentle and highly virtuous.
verses.hindi: में तप करते लगा था और शिशिर ऋतु में भी जल में स्थित रहा करता ।३१। ग्रीष्म में पाँच अग्नियों के मध्य में बैठा रहता था । इस रीति से राम फे तप किया था ओर चिरकाल वह तपश्चर्या को यी। जिसमें षद् ऊर्मियों का विधूनन करके काम क्रोध-लोभ-मोह आदि शत्र ओं को भली भांति जीत
verses.wordMeaning: On its bank is the great park named Dcv&raoya which is devoid of sorrow. On that mountain lives Maiidhara the Yak?a of good self-control. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas who arc gentle and highly virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: On its bank is the great park named Dcv&raoya which is devoid of sorrow. On that mountain lives Maiidhara the Yak?a of good self-control. He is surrounded by the Guhyakas who arc gentle and highly virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रा संततिश्चैव विद्युद्दंभा मही तथा । अन्यास्ताभ्यो ऽपरिज्ञाताः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: pavitrā saṃtatiścaiva vidyuddaṃbhā mahī tathā / anyāstābhyo 'parijñātāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: At its foot is (he highly divine, splendid and charming lake named Bindusara. It has golden sandy bed.
verses.hindi: लिया था ।३२। जितने भी शीत-उष्ण आदि दन्द हैं इनसे उसकी बुद्धि उद्ब- चित नहीं होतो 'थी ओर बह ताप के दोषों से कमो व्याकुल. भी नहीं होता था । यों और नियमों के द्वारा उसका देह परम शुद्ध था तथा वह बहुत हो समाहित रहता था ।३३१ उसके देइ में जो वायु था उसको उसने भ्राणा-
verses.wordMeaning: At its foot is (he highly divine, splendid and charming lake named Bindusara. It has golden sandy bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: At its foot is (he highly divine, splendid and charming lake named Bindusara. It has golden sandy bed.

verses.sanskrit: अभिगच्छन्ति ताः सर्वा यतो वर्षति वासवः । घृतोदेन कुशद्वीपो बाह्यतः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: abhigacchanti tāḥ sarvā yato varṣati vāsavaḥ / ghṛtodena kuśadvīpo bāhyataḥ parivāritaḥ
verses.translation: The lake Sailoda seems to be the Wular lake which once covered the whole of Kashmir valley. The river Siloda Is the Jhelum which still Dows through it and runs towards the west between the Indus and the Sutlej (the Caku and SiU in the Purina)—-M. Ali.
verses.hindi: दामों के द्वारा अपने-वश में कर लिया था। वह महान् मुनि मौनधारी- पदुमासन को जीत लेने बाला और परम स्थिर चित्त वाला था ।३४। प्रत्या- हार में तत्पर रहकर उसने अपनी समस्त इन्द्रियों को अपने वश में कर लिया था। आल्मवाब् उस राम ने धारणाओं के द्वारा परम चड-चल तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The lake Sailoda seems to be the Wular lake which once covered the whole of Kashmir valley. The river Siloda Is the Jhelum which still Dows through it and runs towards the west between the Indus and the Sutlej (the Caku and SiU in the Purina)—-M. Ali.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lake Sailoda seems to be the Wular lake which once covered the whole of Kashmir valley. The river Siloda Is the Jhelum which still Dows through it and runs towards the west between the Indus and the Sutlej (the Caku and SiU in the Purina)—-M. Ali.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञेयः स तु विस्तारात्कुशद्वीपसमेन तु । इत्येष सन्निवेशो वः कुशद्वीपस्य कीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: vijñeyaḥ sa tu vistārātkuśadvīpasamena tu / ityeṣa sanniveśo vaḥ kuśadvīpasya kīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: Gaura. Hiramaya and Soma (mentioned later in v.27 and in V&.P.) are the Tibetan ranges north of Kailftsa and are called now Tanglha, Aling Kangri and Nychenthangla—M. Ali. ( ).
verses.hindi: अमथन शोल बलवान् मन को भी स्थिर कर लिया था जो कभी भो साधा- रण या काबू में नहीं आया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Gaura. Hiramaya and Soma (mentioned later in v.27 and in V&.P.) are the Tibetan ranges north of Kailftsa and are called now Tanglha, Aling Kangri and Nychenthangla—M. Ali. ( ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Gaura. Hiramaya and Soma (mentioned later in v.27 and in V&.P.) are the Tibetan ranges north of Kailftsa and are called now Tanglha, Aling Kangri and Nychenthangla—M. Ali. ( ).

verses.sanskrit: क्रैञ्चद्वीपस्य विस्तारं वक्ष्याम्यहमतः परम् । कुशद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद्द्विगुणः स तु वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kraiñcadvīpasya vistāraṃ vakṣyāmyahamataḥ param / kuśadvīpasya vistārāddviguṇaḥ sa tu vai smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Bindutara can be explained in two ways;
verses.wordMeaning: Bindutara can be explained in two ways;
verses.commentary: Sense: Bindutara can be explained in two ways;

verses.sanskrit: घृतोदकसमुद्रो वै क्रैञ्च द्वीपेन संयुतः । तस्मिन्द्वीपे नगश्रेष्ठः क्रैञ्चस्तु प्रथमो गिरिः
verses.transliteration: ghṛtodakasamudro vai kraiñca dvīpena saṃyutaḥ / tasmindvīpe nagaśreṣṭhaḥ kraiñcastu prathamo giriḥ
verses.translation: The divine river Tripathagi (the Gangi) (lit. the river with three courses) was at the outset established there as the deity* That river originating from the foot-hills of Soma flows in seven channels.
verses.wordMeaning: The divine river Tripathagi (the Gangi) (lit. the river with three courses) was at the outset established there as the deity* That river originating from the foot-hills of Soma flows in seven channels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine river Tripathagi (the Gangi) (lit. the river with three courses) was at the outset established there as the deity* That river originating from the foot-hills of Soma flows in seven channels.

verses.sanskrit: क्रैञ्चात्परो वामनको वामनादन्धकारकः । अन्धकारात्परश्चापि दिवावृन्नाम पर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kraiñcātparo vāmanako vāmanādandhakārakaḥ / andhakārātparaścāpi divāvṛnnāma parvataḥ
verses.translation: Golden sacrificial posts studded with jewels have been scattered there. Sakra performed a sacrifice there along with all the Devas and attained Siddhi(spiritual enlightenment).
verses.wordMeaning: Golden sacrificial posts studded with jewels have been scattered there. Sakra performed a sacrifice there along with all the Devas and attained Siddhi(spiritual enlightenment).
verses.commentary: Sense: Golden sacrificial posts studded with jewels have been scattered there. Sakra performed a sacrifice there along with all the Devas and attained Siddhi(spiritual enlightenment).

verses.sanskrit: दिवावृतः परश्चापि द्विविदो गिरिसत्तमः । द्विविदात्परतश्चापि पुण्डरीको महागिरिः
verses.transliteration: divāvṛtaḥ paraścāpi dvivido girisattamaḥ / dvividātparataścāpi puṇḍarīko mahāgiriḥ
verses.translation: Sanctifying the heaven and the firmament, the celestial river fell on the head of Bhava (god 8iva) and got blocked up by means of his Yogic Maya.
verses.hindi: चितयामास देवेशं ध्याने हष्ट वा जगद्गुरुम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sanctifying the heaven and the firmament, the celestial river fell on the head of Bhava (god 8iva) and got blocked up by means of his Yogic Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanctifying the heaven and the firmament, the celestial river fell on the head of Bhava (god 8iva) and got blocked up by means of his Yogic Maya.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकात्परश्चापि प्रोच्यते दुन्दुभिस्वनः । एते रत्नमयाः सप्त क्रैञ्चद्वीपस्य पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: puṇḍarīkātparaścāpi procyate dundubhisvanaḥ / ete ratnamayāḥ sapta kraiñcadvīpasya parvatāḥ
verses.translation: Being impeded smilingly by Bhava (Siva), the river goddess mentally thought of hurling down Sankara.
verses.wordMeaning: Being impeded smilingly by Bhava (Siva), the river goddess mentally thought of hurling down Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being impeded smilingly by Bhava (Siva), the river goddess mentally thought of hurling down Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: बहुपुष्पफलोपेतनानावृक्षलतावृताः । परस्परेण द्विगुणा विस्तृता हर्षवर्द्धनाः
verses.transliteration: bahupuṣpaphalopetanānāvṛkṣalatāvṛtāḥ / paraspareṇa dviguṇā vistṛtā harṣavarddhanāḥ
verses.translation: Art the three ways Gaoga its three stages?
verses.wordMeaning: Art the three ways Gaoga its three stages?
verses.commentary: Sense: Art the three ways Gaoga its three stages?

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणि तत्र वक्ष्यामि नामतस्तान्निबोधत । क्रैञ्चस्य कुशलो देशो वामनस्य मनोनुगः
verses.transliteration: varṣāṇi tatra vakṣyāmi nāmatastānnibodhata / kraiñcasya kuśalo deśo vāmanasya manonugaḥ
verses.translation: Hence that river b BhIrathl. It joined the salt sea. All these seven (channels, rivers) sanctify the sub-conti¬ nent named Hima.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence that river b BhIrathl. It joined the salt sea. All these seven (channels, rivers) sanctify the sub-conti¬ nent named Hima.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence that river b BhIrathl. It joined the salt sea. All these seven (channels, rivers) sanctify the sub-conti¬ nent named Hima.

verses.sanskrit: मनोनुगात्परश्चोष्णस्तृतीयं वर्षमुच्यते । उष्णात्परः पीवरकः पीवरादन्धकारकः
verses.transliteration: manonugātparaścoṣṇastṛtīyaṃ varṣamucyate / uṣṇātparaḥ pīvarakaḥ pīvarādandhakārakaḥ
verses.translation: M. All. ( ) tdantifica NftUnl, Hredini and Pavani—the east- flowing riven—with the Yangtse, Mekong and Salween, the rivers flowing to the west. vb. the Slti, the Cak>us and the Sindhu vrith the Yarkand, the Shyok and the Indus, while the southern river BhSgiratJ is the GaAgS. De however identifies Sita with the Jaaartes ( ) and the Cakius with the Oxus or Amudaria ( ).
verses.hindi: ध्यान के द्वारा राम ने देवों के भी देवेश्वर भगवान् शकूर का: दर्शन प्राप्त कर दिया था  उसक। अन्तःकरण परम स्वस्थ था तथा वह सबका मित्र और समस्त बाधाओं से रहित था।३६। इन जगद्गुरु को ध्यान में देखकर उसने देवेश्वर का चिन्तन किया था । वह अपने ध्येय प्रभु में अब-
verses.wordMeaning: M. All. ( ) tdantifica NftUnl, Hredini and Pavani—the east- flowing riven—with the Yangtse, Mekong and Salween, the rivers flowing to the west. vb. the Slti, the Cak>us and the Sindhu vrith the Yarkand, the Shyok and the Indus, while the southern river BhSgiratJ is the GaAgS.…
verses.commentary: Sense: M. All. ( ) tdantifica NftUnl, Hredini and Pavani—the east- flowing riven—with the Yangtse, Mekong and Salween, the rivers flowing to the west. vb. the Slti, the Cak>us and the Sindhu vrith the Yarkand, the Shyok and the Indus, while the southern river BhSgiratJ is the GaAgS.…

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकारात्परश्चापि मुनिदेशः स्मृतो बुधैः । मुनिदेशात्परश्चैव प्रोच्यते दुन्दुभिस्वनः
verses.transliteration: andhakārātparaścāpi munideśaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ / munideśātparaścaiva procyate dundubhisvanaḥ
verses.translation: The river Cakfus flows over the following clintes viz. Clnamarus, the Talas> the Camasamulikas, the Bhadras, the Tusaras, the Lamy&kas, the Bahiavas, the Pa(as and the Khaiai. Then it falls into the sea.
verses.hindi: स्थित चित्त और आत्मा वाला था । उसकी इन्द्रियां और देह निश्चल ये ।३७। वह् अपने काल की अवधि तक निर्वात स्थान में दीपक के समान वहाँ पर स्थित रहा था । वह अपी बुद्धि से देवदेव का जप तथा व्यान करता हुआ यहाँ पर स्थित था ।३। उस अमेय आत्मा बाले ने सब भावों में स्थित
verses.wordMeaning: The river Cakfus flows over the following clintes viz. Clnamarus, the Talas> the Camasamulikas, the Bhadras, the Tusaras, the Lamy&kas, the Bahiavas, the Pa(as and the Khaiai. Then it falls into the sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river Cakfus flows over the following clintes viz. Clnamarus, the Talas> the Camasamulikas, the Bhadras, the Tusaras, the Lamy&kas, the Bahiavas, the Pa(as and the Khaiai. Then it falls into the sea.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णो गौरप्रयो जनः स्मतः । तत्रापि नद्यः सप्तैव प्रतिवर्ष स्मृताः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇo gauraprayo janaḥ smataḥ / tatrāpi nadyaḥ saptaiva prativarṣa smṛtāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: The scholarly Kauberaka (son of Kubera) of great self-control stays onHiraoyairhga (Golden Peak). He practi¬ ses the performance of Yajflas. He is very great and valorous and his strength and splendour cannot be measured.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर की आराधना की थी । इसके अनन्तर उस प्रभु का चिन्तन किया था जो फल रहित रूप है--ईश्वर और जो निरंजन है ।३६। जो परम ज्योति स्वरूप अचिन्तनीय-योगियों के द्वारा ध्यान करने के योग्य ओर सर्वोत्तम है। जो नित्य शुद्ध, सदा शान्त-इन्द्रियों की पहुँच से परे और उपसा से रहित
verses.wordMeaning: The scholarly Kauberaka (son of Kubera) of great self-control stays onHiraoyairhga (Golden Peak). He practi¬ ses the performance of Yajflas. He is very great and valorous and his strength and splendour cannot be measured.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholarly Kauberaka (son of Kubera) of great self-control stays onHiraoyairhga (Golden Peak). He practi¬ ses the performance of Yajflas. He is very great and valorous and his strength and splendour cannot be measured.

verses.sanskrit: गौरी कुमुद्वती चैव संध्या रात्रिर्मनोजवा । ख्यातिश्च पुण्डरीका च गङ्गाः सप्तविधाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: gaurī kumudvatī caiva saṃdhyā rātrirmanojavā / khyātiśca puṇḍarīkā ca gaṅgāḥ saptavidhāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The prosperity of the residents of the mountain should also be known in the same manner. In regard to virtue, love and wealth each is double than the former (?)
verses.hindi: है) जो केवल आनन्द के स्वरूप वाला अबल ओर समस्त चर और अचर में व्याप्त है ।४०। ऐसे देवों के देर्वै के उस रूप का उस भार्गव ने है राज शाहूल ! बहुत समय ध्यान किया या औरे बह सोऽहं भाव में समन्वित हो गया था अर्थात् ध्येय और ध्याता की एक रूपता हो गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: The prosperity of the residents of the mountain should also be known in the same manner. In regard to virtue, love and wealth each is double than the former (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The prosperity of the residents of the mountain should also be known in the same manner. In regard to virtue, love and wealth each is double than the former (?)

verses.sanskrit: तासां सहस्रशश्चान्या नद्यो यास्तु समीपगाः । अभिगच्छन्ति ताः सर्वा विपुलाः सुबहूदकाः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ sahasraśaścānyā nadyo yāstu samīpagāḥ / abhigacchanti tāḥ sarvā vipulāḥ subahūdakāḥ
verses.translation: Noted as Lake SayanS or NSga in other Purias is the Lake NAk Tso' whidi with Paogong Tso forms an extensive water-iheetMAlL ].
verses.wordMeaning: Noted as Lake SayanS or NSga in other Purias is the Lake NAk Tso' whidi with Paogong Tso forms an extensive water-iheetMAlL ].
verses.commentary: Sense: Noted as Lake SayanS or NSga in other Purias is the Lake NAk Tso' whidi with Paogong Tso forms an extensive water-iheetMAlL ].

verses.sanskrit: क्रैञ्चद्वीपः समुद्रेण दधिमण्डौदकेन तु । आवृतः सर्वतः श्रीमान्क्रैञ्चद्वीपसमेन तु
verses.transliteration: kraiñcadvīpaḥ samudreṇa dadhimaṇḍaudakena tu / āvṛtaḥ sarvataḥ śrīmānkraiñcadvīpasamena tu
verses.translation: Modem Lake Chakmakdn. the aouree of the Wdsaa river which flows west in the land of Gandhanras. It is in the Wakhan region that Meru and Nisadba come doeeat to each odwr. Ali. ( ).
verses.wordMeaning: Modem Lake Chakmakdn. the aouree of the Wdsaa river which flows west in the land of Gandhanras. It is in the Wakhan region that Meru and Nisadba come doeeat to each odwr. Ali. ( ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Modem Lake Chakmakdn. the aouree of the Wdsaa river which flows west in the land of Gandhanras. It is in the Wakhan region that Meru and Nisadba come doeeat to each odwr. Ali. ( ).

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपादयो ह्येते समासेन प्रकीर्त्तिताः । तेषां निसर्गोद्वीपानामानुपूर्व्येण सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpādayo hyete samāsena prakīrttitāḥ / teṣāṃ nisargodvīpānāmānupūrvyeṇa sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: In the sub-continentsKimpuru etc., the lord does not shower rains. Excellent rivers flow here with waters that pierce through the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: In the sub-continentsKimpuru etc., the lord does not shower rains. Excellent rivers flow here with waters that pierce through the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the sub-continentsKimpuru etc., the lord does not shower rains. Excellent rivers flow here with waters that pierce through the ground.

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यो विस्तराद्वक्तुं दिव्यवर्षशतैरपि । निसर्गो यः प्रजानां तु संहारो यश्च तासु वै
verses.transliteration: na śakyo vistarādvaktuṃ divyavarṣaśatairapi / nisargo yaḥ prajānāṃ tu saṃhāro yaśca tāsu vai
verses.translation: The following three mountains of great knotty ridges extend towards the east. They are immersed under the briny sea. They are the $abha, the Dundubhi and the great moun* tain Dhumra.
verses.wordMeaning: The following three mountains of great knotty ridges extend towards the east. They are immersed under the briny sea. They are the $abha, the Dundubhi and the great moun* tain Dhumra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following three mountains of great knotty ridges extend towards the east. They are immersed under the briny sea. They are the $abha, the Dundubhi and the great moun* tain Dhumra.

verses.sanskrit: शाकद्वीपं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावदिह निश्चयात् । शृणुध्वं तु यथातथ्यं ब्रुवतो मे यथार्थवत्
verses.transliteration: śākadvīpaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadiha niścayāt / śṛṇudhvaṃ tu yathātathyaṃ bruvato me yathārthavat
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: क्रैञ्चद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद्द्विगुणास्तस्य विस्तरः । परिवार्य समुद्रं स दधिमण्डोदकं स्थितः
verses.transliteration: kraiñcadvīpasya vistārāddviguṇāstasya vistaraḥ / parivārya samudraṃ sa dadhimaṇḍodakaṃ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पुण्या जनपदाश्चिरात्तु म्रियते जनः । कुत एव च दुर्भिक्षं जराव्याधिभयं कुतः
verses.transliteration: tatra puṇyā janapadāścirāttu mriyate janaḥ / kuta eva ca durbhikṣaṃ jarāvyādhibhayaṃ kutaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: श्री बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--उस समय में भगवान् शिव में एकाग्र मन बाले--एकान्त में एक निष्ठ होकर निरत रहने बाले--नियत और शंसित द्रत से युक्त उस तपस्वो राम का श्रवण करके तप से निधूत कल्मण वाले ऋषियों ने जो ज्ञान और कर्मों में वृद्ध महान् और शंसित ब्रत वाले ये सभी
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि पर्वताः शभ्राः सप्तैव मणिभूषणाः । रत्नाकरास्तथा नद्यस्तेषां नामानि मे शृणु
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi parvatāḥ śabhrāḥ saptaiva maṇibhūṣaṇāḥ / ratnākarāstathā nadyasteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: दर्शन की इच्छा वाले हुए थे देखने की इच्छा से समन्वित वे सब कुतुहल वाले वहाँ पर आये ये। है राजन् ! वे सब मझानू आत्मा वाले उस राम कै परम श्रेष्ठ तप का वर्णत करने वाले ये ।३। बड़े-बड़े मुलियों के द्वारा संमत भृमु -अतरि-क्रतु--जावालि-बामदेव और मृकण्डु सब उस राम की
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिगन्धर्वयुतः प्रथमो मेरुरुच्यते । प्रागायतः स सौवर्णो ह्युदयो नाम पर्वतः
verses.transliteration: devarṣigandharvayutaḥ prathamo merurucyate / prāgāyataḥ sa sauvarṇo hyudayo nāma parvataḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: प्रशसा'करने नाले थे ।४ तपस्या का तपन करने वाले उस राम के आश्रय में सब समागत हुए थे । ये सब बहुत महान् और पुण्य क्षेत्र के निवास करने बाले बहुत ही दूर से बहाँ आये ये ।५॥ समस्त लोकों में यह तप बहुत बड़ा उत्तम है और ज्ञान भी है। इस रीति से उन सब ने उसके तप की प्रशंसा
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: वृष्ट्यर्थं जलदास्तत्र प्रभंवति च यान्ति च । तस्यापरेण सुमहाञ्जलधारो महागिरिः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṭyarthaṃ jaladāstatra prabhaṃvati ca yānti ca / tasyāpareṇa sumahāñjaladhāro mahāgiriḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: की थी और फिर'वे समो अपने-अपने आश्रम को चले गये ये ।६। है जूपों
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: यतो नित्यमुपादत्ते वासवः परमं जलम् । ततो वर्षं प्रभवति वर्षाकाले प्रजास्विह
verses.transliteration: yato nityamupādatte vāsavaḥ paramaṃ jalam / tato varṣaṃ prabhavati varṣākāle prajāsviha
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: १४४   अहण्ड पुराण में श्र७ ! इस प्रकार से तपश्चर्या में प्रवु होते हुए राम के ऊपर भगवाय् शिव बहुत ही प्रसन्‍न चित्त वाले हो गये वे
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योत्तरे रैवतको यत्र नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितम् । रेवती दिवि नक्षत्रं पितामहकृतो विधिः
verses.transliteration: tasyottare raivatako yatra nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitam / revatī divi nakṣatraṃ pitāmahakṛto vidhiḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापरेण सुमहान् श्यामो नाम महागिरिः । तस्माच्छ्यामत्वमापन्नाः प्रजाः पूर्वमिमाः किल
verses.transliteration: tasyāpareṇa sumahān śyāmo nāma mahāgiriḥ / tasmācchyāmatvamāpannāḥ prajāḥ pūrvamimāḥ kila
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: है राजन् ! भगवान् शंकर आत्मा में उसकी भक्ति के बिषय में जानने की इच्छा याले होकर पशुओं के व्याध का रूप धारण करके उस राम के समीप में गये थे ।७। तब ख्याघ के स्वरूप का वर्णन किया जाता है--वह पिसे हुए अङ्जन के ढेर के समान कृष्ण वर्ण वाला था। उसके बड़े और
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापरेण सुमहान्नाजतो ऽस्तगिरिः स्मृतः । तस्यापरे चांबिकेयो दुर्गशैलो महागिरिः

verses.hindi: इस कारण से मेरी अनुमति के बिना यहाँ पर कोई भी नहीं आया करता है। यही मेरा वृत्तान्त है जो पूर्णतया तुम्हारे सामने मैंने कह दिया है।२२। और अब आप अपना पूरा हाल तात्विक रूप से मुझे बतलाइए । आप कौन हैं--किस कारण से यहाँ पर समागत हुए हैं और किस प्रयोजन
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करं सप्तमं द्वीपं प्रवक्ष्यामि निबोधत । पुष्करेण तु द्वीपेन वृतः क्षीरोदको बहिः
verses.transliteration: puṣkaraṃ saptamaṃ dvīpaṃ pravakṣyāmi nibodhata / puṣkareṇa tu dvīpena vṛtaḥ kṣīrodako bahiḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: की सिद्धि के लिये यहाँ पर समधिष्ठित हो रहे हैं? अथवा यहाँ से किसी अन्य स्थान में जाने के समुद्यत हैं अथवा आपकी कया करने की इच्छा है ।२३। श्री वसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--जब उसके द्वारा इस प्रकार से कहा गया तो महान् द्यूति से सम्पन्न राम ने हँसकर एक क्षण के लिए चुप होकर कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: शाकद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद्द्विगुणेन संमततः । पुष्करे पर्वतः श्रीमानेक एव महाशिलः
verses.transliteration: śākadvīpasya vistārāddviguṇena saṃmatataḥ / puṣkare parvataḥ śrīmāneka eva mahāśilaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: नीचे की ओर मुख करके चिन्तन किया था ।२४। उसने अपने मन में विचार किया था कि यह दुराधषं कौन है जिसकी ध्वनि सजल - मेघ के सहश है और अधिक सुस्पष्ट अर्थ वाले पदों से युक्त वाणी बोलता है।२५। इसका वपु मेरे हृदय में बहुत अधिक णका समुत्पन्न कर रहा है । यह विजातीय
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रैर्मणिमयैः शृङ्गैः शिलाजालैः समुच्छ्रितः । द्वीपस्य तस्य पूर्वर्द्धे चित्रसानुः स्थितो महान्
verses.transliteration: citrairmaṇimayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ śilājālaiḥ samucchritaḥ / dvīpasya tasya pūrvarddhe citrasānuḥ sthito mahān
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: है और नीच जाति का समाश्रय पाकर भी इसका शरीर शर की ही भांति परम रमणीय है ।२६। इस तरह से चिन्तन करते हुए उसको परम शुभ निमित्त हो रहे थे जो भूमि में --देह में अपने अभोष्ट अथं के लिये पूर्ण रूप से प्रदानः करने बाले थे ।२७। इसके अनन्तर उस भृगु कुल में श्रेष्ठ ने मन
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: स मण्डलसहस्राणि विस्तीर्णः पञ्चविंशतिः । उर्द्धं चैव चतुस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि महीतलात्
verses.transliteration: sa maṇḍalasahasrāṇi vistīrṇaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ / urddhaṃ caiva catustriṃśatsahasrāṇi mahītalāt
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: से बहुत बार विचार करके धीरे से उस व्याध से सूनृत अक्षरों वाले. बचन

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपर्धस्य परिक्षिप्तः पर्वतो मानसोत्तरः । स्थितो वेलासमीपे तु नवचन्द्र इवोदितः
verses.transliteration: dvīpardhasya parikṣiptaḥ parvato mānasottaraḥ / sthito velāsamīpe tu navacandra ivoditaḥ

verses.sanskrit: महावीतं तु यद्वर्ष बाह्यतो मानसस्य तत् । त्स्यैवाभ्यन्तरेणापि धातकीखण्डमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: mahāvītaṃ tu yadvarṣa bāhyato mānasasya tat / tsyaivābhyantareṇāpi dhātakīkhaṇḍamucyate

verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो--मैं जमबब्नि का पुत्र. नाम से मैं भार्गव राम है।इस समय में मैं अपने गुरुदेव के आदेश से यहाँ पर तपश्चर्या का.समा- चरण करने के ही लिए आया हूँ ।२६। तपस्यान्भक्ति ओर: नियम से-इस पर्णत पर सर्वलोकेश्वर की आराधना करने को चिरकाल कें लिये मैंसमुः

verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि तत्र जीवति मानवाः । अरोगाः सुखबाहुल्या मानसीं सिद्धिमास्थिताः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tatra jīvati mānavāḥ / arogāḥ sukhabāhulyā mānasīṃ siddhimāsthitāḥ

verses.hindi: द्यत हुआ हूँ।३०। इस कारण से सर्वेश्वर-सबकीं रक्षा करने वांले--अभय के देने वाले-समस्त पापों के दमन करने वाले--अपने भक्तों पर वात्सल्य रखने वाले तीन नेत्रों से समन्वित भगवान् शक्कर को मैं प्रसन्त करूंगा

verses.sanskrit: मससायुश्च रूपं च तस्मिन्वर्षद्वये स्मृतम् । अधमोत्तमा न तेष्वस्ति तुल्यास्ते रूपशीलतः

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरो दण्डसुद्यम्य ब्रह्मा त्रिभुवनेश्वरः । स विष्णोः सचिवो देवः स पिता स पितामहः
verses.transliteration: īśvaro daṇḍasudyamya brahmā tribhuvaneśvaraḥ / sa viṣṇoḥ sacivo devaḥ sa pitā sa pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: उसी भाति से समस्त ध्राणधारियों को अपने प्राण परम प्रिय हुआ करते हैं-ऐसा ही अपने मन में समझ लो । आप जिनका हनन किया करते हैं उनकी भी व्यथा इसी प्रकार से हुआ करती है और अन्य प्रकार की नहीं होती है ।५०। प्राणिमात्र की हिसा न करना ही सनातन अर्थात् सदा से चले
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: भोजनं चाप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्वयमुपस्थितम् । षड्रसं सुमहावीर्यं भुञ्जते तु प्रजाः सदा
verses.transliteration: bhojanaṃ cāprayatnena tatra svayamupasthitam / ṣaḍrasaṃ sumahāvīryaṃ bhuñjate tu prajāḥ sadā
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: आने वाला घमं है। इसके विरुद्ध कार्यों का समाचरण करना ही नित्य सत्पुरुषों के द्वारा बुरा माता जाता है ।५१। अपने प्राणों की. अभिरक्षा के ही लिए हम सब शरीर धारियों का हनन किया करेंगे । फिर आगे क्यों नहीं सतपुरुषों में निन्दा को प्राप्त होंगे ।५२। है अधम पुरुष ! इस कारण से
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: परेण पुष्करस्यार्द्धे आवृत्यावस्थितो महान् । स्वादूदकः समुद्रस्तु समन्तात्परिवेष्ट्य तम्
verses.transliteration: pareṇa puṣkarasyārddhe āvṛtyāvasthito mahān / svādūdakaḥ samudrastu samantātpariveṣṭya tam
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: आप बहुत णी ही यहाँ से चले जाओ । तुम्हारे द्वारा किए कृत्यों के दोष से मेरे कायं की कोई हानि नहीं होगी ।५३। यदि आप स्वयं ही यहाँ से नहीं गमन करते हैं तो मं बलपूर्वक भी स्पष्टतया तुम्हारै अपसपं की बुद्धि समुत्पन्न कर देता हैं ।५४। है पापात्मत् ! यहाँ पर आधे क्षण भी आपकी
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: परेण तस्य महती दृश्यते लोकसंस्थितिः । काञ्चनी द्विगुणा भूमिः सर्वाह्येकशिलोपमा
verses.transliteration: pareṇa tasya mahatī dṛśyate lokasaṃsthitiḥ / kāñcanī dviguṇā bhūmiḥ sarvāhyekaśilopamā
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: संस्थिति अच्छी नहीं है। विरुद्ध आचरण वाला धर्मे का द्वेषी ऐसा कौन है जो सदा कल्याण को प्राप्त किया करता है अर्थात् ऐसा कोई भी नहीं होता है ।५५। श्री जसिष्ठजी ने कहा--राम के ऐसे बचनों को सुनकर मन में बहुत प्रसन्न होते हुए भी वे स्वरूपधारी भगवान् शंकर क्रुद्ध के ही समान उस
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापरेण शैलश्च पर्यासात्पस्मिण्डलः । प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोकः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tasyāpareṇa śailaśca paryāsātpasmiṇḍalaḥ / prakāśaścāprakāśaśca lokālokaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: राम से यह वचन बोले ये
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: आलोकस्तस्य चार्वक्तु निरालोकस्ततः परम् । योजनानां सहस्राणि दश तस्योच्छ्रयः समृतः
verses.transliteration: ālokastasya cārvaktu nirālokastataḥ param / yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśa tasyocchrayaḥ samṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: कुतस्त्वं क्लिश्यसे मूढ तपसा तेन तेऽ्रुना ।
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: तावांश्च विस्तरस्तस्य पृथिव्यां कामगश्च सः । आलोको लोकवृत्तिस्थो निरालोको ह्यलौकिकः
verses.transliteration: tāvāṃśca vistarastasya pṛthivyāṃ kāmagaśca saḥ / āloko lokavṛttistho nirāloko hyalaukikaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: धुवं मिथ्याप्रवृत्तस्य न हि तुष्यति शङ्करः
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: लोकार्द्धे संमिता लोका निरालोकास्तु बाह्यतः । लोकविस्तारमात्रं तु ह्यलोकः सर्वतो बहिः
verses.transliteration: lokārddhe saṃmitā lokā nirālokāstu bāhyataḥ / lokavistāramātraṃ tu hyalokaḥ sarvato bahiḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: परिच्छिन्नः समन्ताच्च उदकेनावृतस्तु सः । आलोकात्परतश्चापि ह्यण्डमा वृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: paricchinnaḥ samantācca udakenāvṛtastu saḥ / ālokātparataścāpi hyaṇḍamā vṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: अण्डस्यान्तस्त्विमे लोकाः सप्तद्वीपा च मेदिनी । भूर्लोको ऽथ भुवर्ल्लोकः स्वर्लोको ऽथ महस्तथा
verses.transliteration: aṇḍasyāntastvime lokāḥ saptadvīpā ca medinī / bhūrloko 'tha bhuvarllokaḥ svarloko 'tha mahastathā
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: संपूजकोऽपि तस्य त्वं योग्यो नात्र विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: जनस्तपस्तथा सत्यमेतावांल्लोकसंग्रहः । एतावानेव विज्ञेयो लोकान्तश्चैव यः परः
verses.transliteration: janastapastathā satyametāvāṃllokasaṃgrahaḥ / etāvāneva vijñeyo lokāntaścaiva yaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: कुंभस्थायी भवेद्यादृवप्रतीच्यां दिशि चन्द्रमाः । आदितः शुक्लपक्षस्य वपुश्चाण्डस्य तद्विधम्
verses.transliteration: kuṃbhasthāyī bhavedyādṛvapratīcyāṃ diśi candramāḥ / āditaḥ śuklapakṣasya vapuścāṇḍasya tadvidham
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: अण्डानामीदृशानां तु कोट्यो ज्ञेयाः सहस्रशः । तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधो वापि कारणस्याव्ययात्मनः
verses.transliteration: aṇḍānāmīdṛśānāṃ tu koṭyo jñeyāḥ sahasraśaḥ / tiryagūrdhvamadho vāpi kāraṇasyāvyayātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: मैं यह सब कुछ मानता हूँ तथापि आपका ऐसा निश्चय कि भगवान् शङ्कर का वर्शन प्राप्त करूंगा यह सब व्यर्थे है । कहाँ तो प्रथम ज्ञानी हैं-- कहाँ भगवांस् देवों के देव शम्भु हैं तथा कहाँ उनको प्राप्त करने के लिए यह तुम्हारी तपस्या है ? अर्थात् भगवान् शम्भु के प्रत्यक्ष करने के लिए कहीं
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: धरणैः प्राकृतैस्तत्तदावृतं प्रति सप्तभिः । दशाधिक्येन चान्योन्यं धारयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: dharaṇaiḥ prākṛtaistattadāvṛtaṃ prati saptabhiḥ / daśādhikyena cānyonyaṃ dhārayanti parasparam
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: अत्यधिक ज्ञान ओर विशेष तपस्या होनी चाहिए क्योंकि ये साधारण साधन से प्राप्त होने ठाले नहीं हैं । आपकी साघना सर्वधा अकिडित्चल्कर है ।५७। है भूक! इसःसमय में इस तप के द्वारा आप क्यों क्लेशित' हो रहे हैं ? यह निश्चय है कि इस तरह से मिच्याप्रवृत्ति वाले आपसे भगवान् शकूर कभी
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परावृताः सर्वे उत्पन्नाश्च परस्परम् । अण्डस्यास्य समन्तात्तु सन्निविष्टो घनोदधिः
verses.transliteration: parasparāvṛtāḥ sarve utpannāśca parasparam / aṇḍasyāsya samantāttu sanniviṣṭo ghanodadhiḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: भीं सन्तुष्ट नहीं होगे ।५८। है सुदुर्मते ! शम्भु तो लोक के आचरण के सर्वेथां विदेद्ध हैँ। उनकी विशेष तुष्टि के लिए तुमको" छोड़कर कौन अबुद्ध 'ऐसी कृष्ट तपस्या किया करता हैँ अर्थात् ऐसा कोई भी'नहीं करता है।५९।'और' अथवा मैं आज गया और यह बिना ही संशय के युक्त है। पूज्य और पूजनं
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: समन्तात्तु वनोदेन धार्यमाणः स तिष्टति । बाह्यतो घनतो यस्य तिर्यगूर्द्ध्वं तु मण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: samantāttu vanodena dhāryamāṇaḥ sa tiṣṭati / bāhyato ghanato yasya tiryagūrddhvaṃ tu maṇḍalam
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: कीं विधि "में भगवान् णम्भु का और आपका सङ्गम है ।६०।आपके'दवारा उनकी पूजा करना युक्त है। वे ही समस्त भुवन में रत हैं। उनकी भली भाँति पूजा करने वाले आप भी योग्य हैं-इसमें कोई संशय नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: धार्यमाणं समन्तात्तु तिष्ठते यत्तु तेजसा । अयोगुडनिभो वाह्नः समन्ता न्मण्डलाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: dhāryamāṇaṃ samantāttu tiṣṭhate yattu tejasā / ayoguḍanibho vāhnaḥ samantā nmaṇḍalākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: समस्त लोकों. के पिता यह परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माजी के शिर का छेदन करके शम्भु ने फिर ब्रह्म हत्या प्राप्त की थी ।६२। है द्विज ! ब्रह्महत्या से अभिभूत शम्भु ने प्रायः आपको उपदेश दिया है कि ऐसा करें । यदि ऐसा नहीं है तो आप इस रीति से कंसे कर रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: समन्ताद्धनवातेन धार्यमाणः स तिष्ठति । घनवातं तथाकाशो दधानः खलु तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: samantāddhanavātena dhāryamāṇaḥ sa tiṣṭhati / ghanavātaṃ tathākāśo dadhānaḥ khalu tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.hindi: जाता है उतने ही प्राणियों का मैं हनन किया करता हूँ । इससे भी अधिक मैं हनन करूँ तो मैं पाप से युक्त होऊंगा ।७४। जितने मॉस से सबका पोषण होते उतने ही प्राणियों के घात करने से हम लोग कभी भी निन्दित नहीं होते हैं। यह सबका विचार करके ही आप मेरी निन्दा करें या प्रशंसा

verses.hindi: करें ।७५। अच्छा हो या बुरा ही जिसका जो कर्म पहिले ही विधोता ने बना दिया है वही कमं किसी भी प्रकार से आपत्काल में भी उसे करना चाहिए ।७६। अब आप स्वयं अपनी ही बुद्धि से मेरे कमं में जो भी अन्तर हो उसका

verses.transliteration: bhūtānyāloka ākāśe paricchinnāni sarvaśaḥ / pātre mahati pātrāṇi yathaivāntargatāni tu

verses.sanskrit: भवन्त्यन्योन्यहीनानि परस्परसमाश्रयात् । तथा ह्यालोक आकाशे भेदास्त्वन्तर्गता मताः
verses.transliteration: bhavantyanyonyahīnāni parasparasamāśrayāt / tathā hyāloka ākāśe bhedāstvantargatā matāḥ

verses.hindi: निरूपण कर लीजिए । मैं तो सब प्रकार से मित्र आदि के भरण पोषण के ही काये में निरत रहा करता हूँ

verses.transliteration: kṛttnānyetāni catvāri hyanyonyasyādhikāni tu / yāvadetāni bhūtāni tāvadutpattirucyate

verses.sanskrit: तन्तुनामिव संतारो भूतेष्वन्तर्गतो मतः । प्रत्या ख्याय तु भूतानि कार्योत्पर्त्तिन विद्यते
verses.transliteration: tantunāmiva saṃtāro bhūteṣvantargato mataḥ / pratyā khyāya tu bhūtāni kāryotparttina vidyate

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्परिमिता भेदाः स्मृताः कार्य्यात्मकास्तु ते । कारणात्मकास्तथैक स्युर्भेदा ये महदादयः
verses.transliteration: tasmātparimitā bhedāḥ smṛtāḥ kāryyātmakāstu te / kāraṇātmakāstathaika syurbhedā ye mahadādayaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: अब अपने कर्मों की ओर हष्टिपात करिए । आपने अपने परम वृद्ध पिता का परित्याग कर दिया है और अपनी आपको जन्म देकर अपने स्तनों के दुग्ध से पोषण करने बाली माता का विहनन कर दिया है। यह बुरे से बुरा कमं करके भी आप परम धाभिक बनकर तपश्चर्या करने के

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष संनिवेशो वै मया प्रोक्तो विभागशः । सप्तद्वीपसमुद्राड्यो याथातथ्यन वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa saṃniveśo vai mayā prokto vibhāgaśaḥ / saptadvīpasamudrāḍyo yāthātathyana vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: लिए यहाँ पर समागत हो गये हैं ।७८। जो लोग उनके मूल फे जाता हैं उनको विस्पष्ट दर्शन होता है। यह जिह्वा से कहकर वचनों के द्वारा समी- हित. करने का विषय यहाँ पर नहीं है ।७६। मैं तो आपका सम्पूर्ण आचरण भली भांति जानता हूँ ओर मुझे पूर्ण उसका शान है। है भृगुद्दद  इस
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरान्मण्डलाश्चैव प्रसंख्यानेन चैव हि । वैश्वरूप्रधानस्य परिणामैकदेशिकः
verses.transliteration: vistarānmaṇḍalāścaiva prasaṃkhyānena caiva hi / vaiśvarūpradhānasya pariṇāmaikadeśikaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.
verses.hindi: कारण से यह आपका तप निष्फल है । इसे व्यथं मत करो ।८०। भाई अपना सुख चाहते. हो तो इस काया को बलेशित करने वाले तप का त्याग कर दोजिए । है राम ! अब आप किसी भी अन्य स्थान में चले जाइए जहाँ पर कि कोई भी मनुष्य आपको न जान सकें

verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhitaṃ bhagavatā yasya sarvamidaṃ jagat / evaṃbhūtagaṇāḥ sapta sanniviṣṭāḥ parasparam
verses.translation: The mountains of great lofty cliffs—the Candra, the Kaka and the Droa extend towards the north. In the nor¬ thern end they are immersed under the salt sea.

verses.sanskrit: एतावान्संनिवेशस्तु मया शक्यः प्रभाषितुम् । एतावदेव श्रोतव्यं संनिवेशे तु पार्थेवे

verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyātāḥ prakṛtayastiryyagūrddhvamadhastathā / tārakāsaṃniveśaśca yāvaddivyānumaṇḍalam

verses.transliteration: paryyā yasanniveśastu bhūmestadanu maṇḍalaḥ / ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi kṛthivyā vai vicakṣaṇāḥ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे प्लक्षादिद्वीपवर्णनं नामैकोनविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अधःप्रमाणमूर्द्ध्व च वक्ष्यमाणं निबोधत । पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde plakṣādidvīpavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca adhaḥpramāṇamūrddhva ca vakṣyamāṇaṃ nibodhata / pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam
verses.translation: Similarly, the element of fire pervades all the worlds. It is cited as infinite, all-pervasive and orinattag from everything.
verses.hindi: को वा त्वं वपुषानेन ब्रूहि मां समुपागल. ॥

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ता धातवो ह्येतं व्यापकास्तु प्रकीर्त्तिताः । जननी सर्वभूतानां सर्वसत्त्वधरा धरा
verses.transliteration: anantā dhātavo hyetaṃ vyāpakāstu prakīrttitāḥ / jananī sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvasattvadharā dharā
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: श्री वसिष्ठ जी ने कहा -हे भूपाल ! मतिमानों में परम श्रेष्ठ राम से अब, इस प्रकार से कहा गया था तो फिर उसने मन से निरूपणं करके

verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: नानाजनपदाकीर्णा नानाधिष्ठानपत्तना । नानानदनदीशैला नैकजातिसमाकुला
verses.transliteration: nānājanapadākīrṇā nānādhiṣṭhānapattanā / nānānadanadīśailā naikajātisamākulā

verses.hindi: ही विस्मित होते हुए उससे कहा था ।१। राम ने कहा--हे महान् भाग

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ता गीयते देवी पृथिवी बहुविस्तरा । नदीनदससुद्रस्थास्तन्था क्षुद्राश्रयस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: anantā gīyate devī pṛthivī bahuvistarā / nadīnadasasudrasthāstanthā kṣudrāśrayasthitāḥ

verses.hindi: ले ! आप मुझे यह बतलाइए कि आप कीन हैं? आप कोई पराकृत पुरुष हैं नहीं  आपका शरीर तो अनुभाव से इन्द्र के ही समान लक्षित हो (रहा है ।२। विचित्र अथं बाले पदों की bs 5५ गो की गम्भीरता की जातियों से आपकी वाणी सर्वे की ही अधिक बुनाई दे रही है

verses.sanskrit: पर्वताकाशसंस्थाश्च अन्तर्भूमिगाताश्च याः । आपो ऽनन्ता हि विज्ञेयास्तथाग्निः सर्वलोकगः
verses.transliteration: parvatākāśasaṃsthāśca antarbhūmigātāśca yāḥ / āpo 'nantā hi vijñeyāstathāgniḥ sarvalokagaḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: ५।३। आप था तो इन्द्र हैं--अग्निदेव हैं-यभधाता-बरुण अथवा कुंबेर'हैं। आप या तो ईशान है-तपन-द्रह्मा-बायु-सोम-गुरु और या गुहु हैं ।४। इन ऊपर बताये हुओं में से ही आप कोई से भी एक हो सकते हैं--यही बहुधा अतीत होता है । आपके अनुभाव कुछ ऐसे ही हैं कि मेरे हृदय मैं आपकी
