verses.hindi: वाले को देखा या।१८ा इसके अनन्तर अपनी आँखें खोलकर भार्गव ने शीक्ष- उठकर उसी शरीरसे संयुत और सामने स्थित देव का दर्शन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: च्यवनस्य तु विज्ञेयं राक्षसस्य च मन्दिरम् । राक्षसेंद्रस्य च पुरं कुम्भिलस्य खरस्य च
verses.transliteration: cyavanasya tu vijñeyaṃ rākṣasasya ca mandiram / rākṣaseṃdrasya ca puraṃ kumbhilasya kharasya ca
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: है महाराज ! अपने ऊपर अनुग्रह करने के लिए-भक्तो पर प्रेम करने वाले तथा शरण में समागत के रक्षक देवेश्वर को राम ने बड़े सम्भ्रम के साथ प्रकट हुए देखा था ।२०। उस महामति के अङ्गं में रोमाळ्च उद्भिन्न हो गये थे और परमाधिक हषं के उद्रेक से आनन्दाश्र,ओं से नेत्र भर गये थे ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: विराधस्य च क्रूरस्य पुरमुल्कासुखस्य च । हेमकस्य च नागस्य तथा पाण्डुरकस्य च
verses.transliteration: virādhasya ca krūrasya puramulkāsukhasya ca / hemakasya ca nāgasya tathā pāṇḍurakasya ca
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: फिर भक्तिभाव से वह उनके चरणों में भूमि पर उनके सामने गिर गया था अर्थात् उसने उके चरण कमलों में साष्टाङ्ग प्रणाम किया था
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: मणिनागस्य च पुरं कपिलस्य च मन्दिरम् । नेदकस्योरगपतोर्विशालाक्षस्य मन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: maṇināgasya ca puraṃ kapilasya ca mandiram / nedakasyoragapatorviśālākṣasya mandiram
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पुरसहस्राणि नागदानवरक्षसाम् । तृतीये ऽस्मिंस्तले विप्रा नीलभौमे न संशयः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ purasahasrāṇi nāgadānavarakṣasām / tṛtīye 'smiṃstale viprā nīlabhaume na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थे दैत्यसिंहस्य कालनेमेर्महात्मनः । गजकर्णस्य च पुरं नगरं कुञ्जरस्य च
verses.transliteration: caturthe daityasiṃhasya kālanemermahātmanaḥ / gajakarṇasya ca puraṃ nagaraṃ kuñjarasya ca
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसेंद्रस्य च पुरं सुमालेर्बहुविस्तरम् । मुञ्जस्य लोकनाथस्य वृकवक्त्रस्य चालयम्
verses.transliteration: rākṣaseṃdrasya ca puraṃ sumālerbahuvistaram / muñjasya lokanāthasya vṛkavaktrasya cālayam
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: बहुयोजनविस्तीर्णं बहुपक्षिसमाकुलम् । नगलं वैनतेयस्य चतुर्थे ऽस्मिन्नसातले
verses.transliteration: bahuyojanavistīrṇaṃ bahupakṣisamākulam / nagalaṃ vainateyasya caturthe 'sminnasātale
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: हे नृप. ! उस राम नेः सम्भ्रम से समाकुलित वाणी से गद्गद कण्ठ होकर इन प्रभु से कहा था और बारम्बार है सबं ! आप मेरे रक्षक होइए ऐसी प्रार्थना की थी ।२२। इसके अनन्तर अपने स्वरूप को धारण करने वाले शम्भु ने राम की भक्ति के भाव से परम सन्तुष्ट होते हुए भूमि में प्रणाम
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमे शर्कराभौमे बहुयोजनविस्तरम् । विरोजनस्य नगरं दैत्यसिंहस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: pañcame śarkarābhaume bahuyojanavistaram / virojanasya nagaraṃ daityasiṃhasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: करने में पड़े हुए उसको ऊपर 'अपने कर कमलों से उठा लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: वैद्युतस्याग्निजि ह्वस्य हिरण्याक्षस्य चालयम् । पुरं च विद्युज्जिह्वस्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: vaidyutasyāgniji hvasya hiraṇyākṣasya cālayam / puraṃ ca vidyujjihvasya rākṣasendrasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: जगतु के घाता के द्वारा अपने ही करों से वह भृगूढ़ह ऊपर उठा लिया गया
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: सहामेघस्य च पुरं राक्षसेंद्रस्य मालिनः । किर्मीरस्य च नागस्य स्वस्तिकस्य जयस्य च
verses.transliteration: sahāmeghasya ca puraṃ rākṣaseṃdrasya mālinaḥ / kirmīrasya ca nāgasya svastikasya jayasya ca
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: शा । फिर उस राम ने उनके समक्ष में स्थित होकर हाथ जोड़कर उन देव- देवेश्वर 'का स्तवन किया -था-।२४। राम ने कहा--देवों के भी देव आदि मूर्ति भगवान् शङ्कर - के लिये मेरा-अजाम स्वीकार हो । शबे--परमणान्त और शाश्वत प्रभु शम्भु के लिए -मेरा बारम्बार प्रणास है 4२४। नीलकण्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पुरसहस्राणि नागदानवरक्षसाम् । पञ्चमे ऽस्मिंस्तले ज्ञेयं शर्करानिचये सदा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ purasahasrāṇi nāgadānavarakṣasām / pañcame 'smiṃstale jñeyaṃ śarkarānicaye sadā
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: -और'नीलन्लोहित मूत्ति वाले के लिए मेरा अनेक बार प्रणाम निवेदित है । आफ तो -भूतों के लाय हैं ऐसे-भूतवास आपके लिए मेरा चारम्वार प्रणाम है
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठे तले दैत्यपतेः केसरे नगरोत्तमम् । सुपर्वणः पुलोम्नश्च नगरं महिषस्य च
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhe tale daityapateḥ kesare nagarottamam / suparvaṇaḥ pulomnaśca nagaraṃ mahiṣasya ca
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: शिव-त्रिनेत्र और अनेक रूप बाले देवेश की सेवा में मेरा बारम्बार प्रणाम स्वीकार हो ।२७। है जगत् के स्वामित्् ! है शर्ब ! आपके ही चरणों में भक्ति रखते वाले भेरे आप रक्षक हो जाइए । जो किसी अन्य देव का समा- श्रय ग्रहण न कर आपके ही चरणों का आश्रय लेते हैं वे अनन्य भक्त होते
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसेंद्रस्य च पुरं सुरोषस्य महात्मनः । तत्रास्ते सुरमापुत्रः शतशीर्षो मुदा युतः
verses.transliteration: rākṣaseṃdrasya ca puraṃ suroṣasya mahātmanaḥ / tatrāste suramāputraḥ śataśīrṣo mudā yutaḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: हैं उनके लिए आप ही परायण हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रस्य सखा श्रीमान्वासुकिनाम नागराट् । एवं पुरसहस्राणि नागदानवरक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: mahendrasya sakhā śrīmānvāsukināma nāgarāṭ / evaṃ purasahasrāṇi nāgadānavarakṣasām
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठे तले ऽस्मिन्विख्याते शिलाभौमे रसातले । सप्तमे तु तले ज्ञेयं पाताले सर्वपश्चिमे
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhe tale 'sminvikhyāte śilābhaume rasātale / saptame tu tale jñeyaṃ pātāle sarvapaścime
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: पुरं बलेः प्रमुदितं नरना रीगणाकुलम् । असुराशीविषैः पूर्णं सुखितैर्देवशत्रुभिः
verses.transliteration: puraṃ baleḥ pramuditaṃ naranā rīgaṇākulam / asurāśīviṣaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sukhitairdevaśatrubhiḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: मुचुकुन्दस्य देत्यस्य तत्रैव नगरं महात् । अनेकैर्दितिपुत्राणां समुदीर्णैर्महापुरैः
verses.transliteration: mucukundasya detyasya tatraiva nagaraṃ mahāt / anekairditiputrāṇāṃ samudīrṇairmahāpuraiḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव नागनगरैर्द्युतिमद्भिः सहस्रशः । दैत्यानां दानवानां च समुदीर्णैर्महापुरैः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva nāganagarairdyutimadbhiḥ sahasraśaḥ / daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca samudīrṇairmahāpuraiḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: अक्तो हिं मे त्वमत्यर्थं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: उदीर्णै राक्षसावासैरनेकैश्च समाकुलम् । पातालान्ते च विप्रेन्द्रा विस्तीण बहुयोजने
verses.transliteration: udīrṇai rākṣasāvāsairanekaiśca samākulam / pātālānte ca viprendrā vistīṇa bahuyojane
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: है शा र-! मैंने जो भी कुछ अपकार किया -है अथवा आपके अति “मैंने जो-बुरे-शय्दों-का अयोग किया था बह मेरे अज्ञान के कारण से ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते रक्तारविन्दाक्षो महात्मा ह्यजरामरः । धौतशङ्खोदरवपुर्नील वासा महाबलः
verses.transliteration: āste raktāravindākṣo mahātmā hyajarāmaraḥ / dhautaśaṅkhodaravapurnīla vāsā mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: विशालभोगो द्युतिमांश्चित्रमाल्यधरो बली । रुक्मशृङ्गावदातेन दीप्तास्येन विराजता
verses.transliteration: viśālabhogo dyutimāṃścitramālyadharo balī / rukmaśṛṅgāvadātena dīptāsyena virājatā
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: हुआ था क्योंकि में आपको'जान' नहीं पाया था ॥ उस सबको ओप क्षमा करने के योग्य होते-हैं।२श अनन्य वे्-रूप वाले आपके सद्भावःकोःकोन- सा पुरुष है सर्वेशः ! ओरू आपको भले प्रकार से जान सकता हैःअर्थात् कोई भी नहीं जानता है ।३०। हेश डुर ! इस कारण-से आप स्वभावः से मेरे
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभुर्मुख सहस्रेण शोभते चैककुण्डली । स जिह्वामालया दीप्तो लोलज्ज्वालानलार्चिषा
verses.transliteration: prabhurmukha sahasreṇa śobhate caikakuṇḍalī / sa jihvāmālayā dīpto lolajjvālānalārciṣā
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: ऊपर प्रसन्‍न हो जाइए + आपके विना मेरी. अन्य कोई. भी गति नहीं है. अर्थात् मेसा उद्धार केवल आप ही कर सकले हैं अ्एव आपके लिए सोरा; पुन: बारम्बार नमस्कार है. ।३१॥ शरी वसिछज़ी ने. कहा--इस प्रकार, से. सामने स्थित. होकर दोनों करों को जोड़े हुए वह स्तुति कर रहा था।
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालापरिक्षिप्तः कैलास इव लक्ष्य ते । स तु नेत्रसहस्रेण द्विगुणेन विराजता
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālāparikṣiptaḥ kailāsa iva lakṣya te / sa tu netrasahasreṇa dviguṇena virājatā
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: जगन्मय प्रसन्न, आत्मा वाले भगवान् ने उससे कहा था: ।३२। भगवात् -ने- कहा--हे तात ! अब आपकी इस तपश्चर्या से आपके ऊपर मैं बहुत प्रसक्ष, हैं है भागेवों सें परम श्रेष्ठ ! मैं आपकी अनपायिनी. भक्ति से अत्यधिकः असल्त हैं ।३३॥ जो भी आपने अपने मन में विचार रबखा है वह सभी कुछ.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: बालसूर्याभिताम्रेण शरीरस्निग्धपाण्डुना । तस्य कुन्देन्दुवर्णस्य नेत्रमाला विराजते
verses.transliteration: bālasūryābhitāmreṇa śarīrasnigdhapāṇḍunā / tasya kundenduvarṇasya netramālā virājate
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: में आपको दे रहा दूगा॥. आप मोरे बहुत ही अधिक प्रिय भक्त हैं--इसमें कुछ भी सशय बाली बात नहीं है ।३४॥ इस. समय में जो: भी कुछ आपके: हृदय में है बह मुझे सभो अबगत है अर्थात्. उस सबको मैं. भली भांति, जानता हूँ । इसी कारण से मैं आपको बतलाता हैं और आप कोई. भी.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: तरुणादित्यमालेव श्वेतपर्वतमूर्द्धनि । विकरालोच्छ्रिततनुर्लक्ष्यते शयनासने
verses.transliteration: taruṇādityamāleva śvetaparvatamūrddhani / vikarālocchritatanurlakṣyate śayanāsane
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: बिशेष णका न रखते हुए वही करिए
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तीर्ण इव मेदिन्यां सहस्रशिखरो गिरिः । महानागैर्महाभोगैर्महाविज्ञैर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: vistīrṇa iva medinyāṃ sahasraśikharo giriḥ / mahānāgairmahābhogairmahāvijñairmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यते महातेजा महानागपतिः स्वयम् । स राजा सर्वनागानां शेषो ऽनन्तो महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: upāsyate mahātejā mahānāgapatiḥ svayam / sa rājā sarvanāgānāṃ śeṣo 'nanto mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.hindi: अंतहिते जगन्नाथे रामोः नत्व तु शंकरमूः।
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: सा वैष्णवी व्यवहृतिर्मर्यादा या व्यवस्थिता । सप्तैवमेते कथिता व्यवहार्या रसातलाः
verses.transliteration: sā vaiṣṇavī vyavahṛtirmaryādā yā vyavasthitā / saptaivamete kathitā vyavahāryā rasātalāḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: देवासुरम हानागराक्षसाध्युषिताः सदा । अतः परमनालोकमगम्यं सिद्धसाधुभिः
verses.transliteration: devāsurama hānāgarākṣasādhyuṣitāḥ sadā / ataḥ paramanālokamagamyaṃ siddhasādhubhiḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: देवानामप्यविदितं व्यवहारविवक्षया । पृथ्व्यंबुव ङ्निवायूनां नभसश्च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: devānāmapyaviditaṃ vyavahāravivakṣayā / pṛthvyaṃbuva ṅnivāyūnāṃ nabhasaśca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: महत्त्वमृषिभिश्चैवं वर्ण्यते नात्र संशयः । अत ऊर्द्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: mahattvamṛṣibhiścaivaṃ varṇyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / ata ūrddhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sūryācandramasorgatim
verses.translation: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.wordMeaning: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Viyu (wind) originated from the Ether. The waters are stationed within and above the earth. The earth is established on the water.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे ऽधोलोकवर्णनं नाम विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच सूर्या चन्द्रमसावेतौ भ्रमतो यावदेव तु । प्रकाशैस्तु प्रभाभिस्तौ मण्डलाभ्यां समुच्छ्रितौ
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde 'dholokavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca sūryā candramasāvetau bhramato yāvadeva tu / prakāśaistu prabhābhistau maṇḍalābhyāṃ samucchritau
verses.translation: As long a.5 the Sun and the Moon revolve, they are elevated by means of thetr lustre and brilliance through their discus.
verses.hindi: है वर्स ! आज आपके अन्दर अस्त्रों के धारण करने की शक्ति नहीं है। ये सब रोद्र अस्त्र हैं। इससे आप फिर भी परम घोर तप का समाचरण कीजिए ।३६। इस सम्पूणं भूमण्डल पर भ्रमण करके क्रम से समस्त तीथं स्थलों में स्नान कीजिए । फिर जब आप पवित्र शरीर बाले हो जाँयगे तो
verses.wordMeaning: As long a.5 the Sun and the Moon revolve, they are elevated by means of thetr lustre and brilliance through their discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As long a.5 the Sun and the Moon revolve, they are elevated by means of thetr lustre and brilliance through their discus.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तानां तु समुद्राणां द्वीपानां सतु विस्तरः । विस्तरार्द्धे पृथिव्यास्तु भवेदन्यत्र बाह्यतः
verses.transliteration: saptānāṃ tu samudrāṇāṃ dvīpānāṃ satu vistaraḥ / vistarārddhe pṛthivyāstu bhavedanyatra bāhyataḥ
verses.translation: The root y/av means illumination and protection. Revolving all round, the sun illuminates and protects the three worlds. Hence, on account of illumination and protection, he is remembered as Ravi.**
verses.hindi: आप सभी अन्त्रों कों प्राप्त करेगे ।३७। इतना यह कर देवेश्वर विभु उसी शरीर से वहाँ पर अन्तर्हित हो गये थे । है राजन् ! राम यह देख ही हों गये थे ।३८। जगत् कें स्वामी के अन्तहित हो जाने पर राम ने भगवान् शक्र को प्रणाम किया था और फिर सम्पूर्ण वसुधा पर भ्रमण करके तीर्थो
verses.wordMeaning: The root y/av means illumination and protection. Revolving all round, the sun illuminates and protects the three worlds. Hence, on account of illumination and protection, he is remembered as Ravi.**
verses.commentary: Sense: The root y/av means illumination and protection. Revolving all round, the sun illuminates and protects the three worlds. Hence, on account of illumination and protection, he is remembered as Ravi.**

verses.sanskrit: पर्यासपरिमाणं तु चन्द्रादित्यौ प्रकाशतः । पर्यास्तात्पारिमाण्येन भूमेस्तुल्यं दिवं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: paryāsaparimāṇaṃ tu candrādityau prakāśataḥ / paryāstātpārimāṇyena bhūmestulyaṃ divaṃ smṛtam

verses.sanskrit: अवति त्रीनिमांल्लोकान् यस्मात्सूर्यः परिभ्रमन् । अविधातुः प्रकाशाख्यो ह्यवनात्स रविः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: avati trīnimāṃllokān yasmātsūryaḥ paribhraman / avidhātuḥ prakāśākhyo hyavanātsa raviḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: In diameter as well as girth (Circumference }| the moon is twice as much as the sun.
verses.hindi: की सुन्दर क्रियाएं तीथों में विधिपूर्वक करते हुए उसने पृथ्बी पर परिक्रमण' किया था
verses.wordMeaning: In diameter as well as girth (Circumference }| the moon is twice as much as the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: In diameter as well as girth (Circumference }| the moon is twice as much as the sun.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रमाणं चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । महित्तत्त्वान्महीशब्दो ऽह्यस्मिन्वर्षे निपाद्यते
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ / mahittattvānmahīśabdo 'hyasminvarṣe nipādyate
verses.translation: The extent and girth {circumference) of the earth consisting of seven continents has been reckoned in proper measure in the Purapas.
verses.wordMeaning: The extent and girth {circumference) of the earth consisting of seven continents has been reckoned in proper measure in the Purapas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent and girth {circumference) of the earth consisting of seven continents has been reckoned in proper measure in the Purapas.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य भारतवर्षस्य विष्कंभात्तुल्यविस्तृतम् । मण्डलं भास्करस्याथ योजनानि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: asya bhāratavarṣasya viṣkaṃbhāttulyavistṛtam / maṇḍalaṃ bhāskarasyātha yojanāni nibodhata
verses.translation: shall recount that» after enumerating the current Abkimdnins (Deities etc. who preside or have the sense of possession etc.). Those Abhimdnins who have gone by arc on a par with the current ones.
verses.wordMeaning: shall recount that» after enumerating the current Abkimdnins (Deities etc. who preside or have the sense of possession etc.). Those Abhimdnins who have gone by arc on a par with the current ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: shall recount that» after enumerating the current Abkimdnins (Deities etc. who preside or have the sense of possession etc.). Those Abhimdnins who have gone by arc on a par with the current ones.

verses.sanskrit: नवयोजनसाहस्रो विस्तारो भास्करस्य तु । विस्तारात्र्रिगुणश्चास्य परिणाहस्तु मण्डले
verses.transliteration: navayojanasāhasro vistāro bhāskarasya tu / vistārātrriguṇaścāsya pariṇāhastu maṇḍale
verses.translation: The Devas who have gone by arc on a par with the current ones in forms and names. Hence, I shall describe the surface of the earth through the current Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who have gone by arc on a par with the current ones in forms and names. Hence, I shall describe the surface of the earth through the current Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who have gone by arc on a par with the current ones in forms and names. Hence, I shall describe the surface of the earth through the current Devas.

verses.sanskrit: विष्कंभमण्डलाच्चैव भास्कराद्द्विगुणः शशी । अथ पृथिव्या वक्ष्यामि प्रमाणं योजनैः सह
verses.transliteration: viṣkaṃbhamaṇḍalāccaiva bhāskarāddviguṇaḥ śaśī / atha pṛthivyā vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ yojanaiḥ saha
verses.translation: (I shall recount) the situation of the heavenly world entirely through the current (Dcvai).
verses.wordMeaning: (I shall recount) the situation of the heavenly world entirely through the current (Dcvai).
verses.commentary: Sense: (I shall recount) the situation of the heavenly world entirely through the current (Dcvai).

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपसमुद्राया विस्तारो मण्डलं च यत् । इत्येतदिह संख्यातं पुराणे परिमाणतः
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpasamudrāyā vistāro maṇḍalaṃ ca yat / ityetadiha saṃkhyātaṃ purāṇe parimāṇataḥ
verses.translation: The situation of the spheres of the worlds is one over the other with the girth gradually reduced falling within the previous sphere.
verses.wordMeaning: The situation of the spheres of the worlds is one over the other with the girth gradually reduced falling within the previous sphere.
verses.commentary: Sense: The situation of the spheres of the worlds is one over the other with the girth gradually reduced falling within the previous sphere.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वक्ष्यामि समाख्याय सांप्रतैरभिमानिभिः । अभिमानिनोव्यतीता ये तुल्यास्ते सांप्रतैस्त्विह
verses.transliteration: tadvakṣyāmi samākhyāya sāṃpratairabhimānibhiḥ / abhimāninovyatītā ye tulyāste sāṃprataistviha
verses.translation: Understand the movement of the sun during the southern transit, as he goes to that qtiarter. His movement is above all the guardians of the quarters.
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the movement of the sun during the southern transit, as he goes to that qtiarter. His movement is above all the guardians of the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the movement of the sun during the southern transit, as he goes to that qtiarter. His movement is above all the guardians of the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ये वै व्यतीतास्तु रूपैर्नामभिरेव च । तस्मात्तु सांप्रतैर्देवैर्वक्ष्यामि वसुधातलम्
verses.transliteration: devā ye vai vyatītāstu rūpairnāmabhireva ca / tasmāttu sāṃpratairdevairvakṣyāmi vasudhātalam
verses.translation: During his southern transit, the sun rushes forward like an arrow that is discharged. He revolves always, taking the circle of luminaries with him.
verses.wordMeaning: During his southern transit, the sun rushes forward like an arrow that is discharged. He revolves always, taking the circle of luminaries with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: During his southern transit, the sun rushes forward like an arrow that is discharged. He revolves always, taking the circle of luminaries with him.

verses.sanskrit: दिवास्तु सन्निवेशं वै सांप्रतैरेव कृत्स्नशः । शतार्द्धकोटिविस्तारा पृथिवी कृत्स्नशः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: divāstu sanniveśaṃ vai sāṃprataireva kṛtsnaśaḥ / śatārddhakoṭivistārā pṛthivī kṛtsnaśaḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: When the sun is in the middle (of the hrma- mant) at Amaravati (city of Indra) his rising is seen in Samya* mana belonging to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama). At Sukha it shall be the middle of ti night and the sun (appears to) set at Vibha (Le. Vibhavari).
verses.hindi: है नृप ! इस प्रकार से क्रम से तीर्थो में स्नान करके और सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun is in the middle (of the hrma- mant) at Amaravati (city of Indra) his rising is seen in Samya* mana belonging to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama). At Sukha it shall be the middle of ti night and the sun (appears to) set at Vibha (Le. Vibhavari).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun is in the middle (of the hrma- mant) at Amaravati (city of Indra) his rising is seen in Samya* mana belonging to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama). At Sukha it shall be the middle of ti night and the sun (appears to) set at Vibha (Le. Vibhavari).

verses.sanskrit: तस्या ऊर्द्ध्वप्रमाणेन मेरोर्यावत्तु संस्थितिः । पृथिव्या ह्यर्द्धविस्तारो योजनाग्रात्प्रकीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: tasyā ūrddhvapramāṇena meroryāvattu saṃsthitiḥ / pṛthivyā hyarddhavistāro yojanāgrātprakīrttitaḥ
verses.hindi: पृथिवी की प्रदक्षिणा करके धीरे-धीरे वह शुद्ध देह वाला हो गया था
verses.commentary: Sense: a V. P. II 8.9-11.

verses.sanskrit: मेरोर्मध्यात्प्रतिदिशं कोटिरेका तु सा स्मृता । तथा शातसहस्राणामेकोन नवतिः पुनः
verses.transliteration: merormadhyātpratidiśaṃ koṭirekā tu sā smṛtā / tathā śātasahasrāṇāmekona navatiḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: The sun revolves rapidly like the whirling firebrand. Moving about, the sun traverees the revolving consiellations.
verses.hindi: बह भार्गव राम शम्भु भगवान् के शासन से इस रीति से परथिवी की परि- क्रमा देकर फिर वह उसी भू भाग पर पहुँच गया था जहाँ पर कि वह प्रथम समय में निवास करता था ।४४। है राजन् ! बह वहाँ पर जाकर स्थित हो गया था और तप तथा नियमों के द्वारा भक्ति-भाव से उमा के पति देवेषबर'
verses.wordMeaning: The sun revolves rapidly like the whirling firebrand. Moving about, the sun traverees the revolving consiellations.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun revolves rapidly like the whirling firebrand. Moving about, the sun traverees the revolving consiellations.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशत्तु सहस्राणि पृथिव्यर्द्धस्य मण्डलम् । गणितं योजनाग्रात्तु कोट्यस्त्वेकादश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: pañcāśattu sahasrāṇi pṛthivyarddhasya maṇḍalam / gaṇitaṃ yojanāgrāttu koṭyastvekādaśa smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the sun thereby moves to the south among the four quarters. The sun rises and sets again and again.
verses.hindi: का भले प्रकार से पूजन किया था ।४५। उसी समय में है राजनं ! ' देवों का असुरोंके साथ बहुत समय तक बड़ा ही भीषण रोमहषण युद्ध हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sun thereby moves to the south among the four quarters. The sun rises and sets again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sun thereby moves to the south among the four quarters. The sun rises and sets again and again.

verses.sanskrit: तथा शतसहस्राणि सप्तत्रिंशाधिकानि तु । इत्येतदिह संश्यातं पृथिव्यन्तस्य मण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: tathā śatasahasrāṇi saptatriṃśādhikāni tu / ityetadiha saṃśyātaṃ pṛthivyantasya maṇḍalam
verses.translation: The sun warms two Devalayas (abodes of gods i.e. those of Indr a and others) in the forenoon and two (other) Dev&layas in the afternoon. During the midday also, he blazes with his own rays.
verses.hindi: इसके पएचात् महान् बलशाली असुरों ने सब देवों को युद्ध में पराजित करके सम्पूर्णे जो देवों का ऐश्वर्य था उसको ग्रहण करें लिया था और' फिर वे निर्भीक होकर रहने लगे थे ।४७। उस युद्ध में सब इन्द्र आदि देवगण परा- जित हो गये थे और शत्रुओं के द्वारा अपहृत वेमव वाले सब भगवानु शंकर
verses.wordMeaning: The sun warms two Devalayas (abodes of gods i.e. those of Indr a and others) in the forenoon and two (other) Dev&layas in the afternoon. During the midday also, he blazes with his own rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun warms two Devalayas (abodes of gods i.e. those of Indr a and others) in the forenoon and two (other) Dev&layas in the afternoon. During the midday also, he blazes with his own rays.

verses.sanskrit: तारकासंनिवेशास्य दिवि याव च्च मण्डलम् । पर्याससन्निवेशश्च भूमेर्यावत्तु मण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: tārakāsaṃniveśāsya divi yāva cca maṇḍalam / paryāsasanniveśaśca bhūmeryāvattu maṇḍalam
verses.translation: After rising up the sun blazes and increases in warmth by means of his own rays till the midday. Thereafter, with his rays decreasing (in warmth) the sun sets.
verses.hindi: की शरणागति में प्राप्त हुम् थे ।४८। उन देवगर्णो ने जगत के नाथ भगवान पिनाकी को प्रणाम-जय और संस्तयनों के द्वारा प्रसन्न कर लिया था और फिर उन्होंने भगवावू शङ्कुर से असुरों के हनन करने के लिए प्रार्थना की थी
verses.wordMeaning: After rising up the sun blazes and increases in warmth by means of his own rays till the midday. Thereafter, with his rays decreasing (in warmth) the sun sets.
verses.commentary: Sense: After rising up the sun blazes and increases in warmth by means of his own rays till the midday. Thereafter, with his rays decreasing (in warmth) the sun sets.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यासपरिमाणेन भूमेस्तुल्यं दिवः स्मृतम् । सप्तानामपि द्वीपानामेत त्स्थानं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: paryāsaparimāṇena bhūmestulyaṃ divaḥ smṛtam / saptānāmapi dvīpānāmeta tsthānaṃ prakīrtitam
verses.translation: Thii if a mythical mountain lurroundmg the outermoat border oT (he world. It U so called as it divides the visible world from the region of dark* aefl. For iti descriptioa vide W. 104-107 below.
verses.wordMeaning: Thii if a mythical mountain lurroundmg the outermoat border oT (he world. It U so called as it divides the visible world from the region of dark* aefl. For iti descriptioa vide W. 104-107 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thii if a mythical mountain lurroundmg the outermoat border oT (he world. It U so called as it divides the visible world from the region of dark* aefl. For iti descriptioa vide W. 104-107 below.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यायपरिमाणेन मण्डलानुगतेन च । उपर्युपरि लोकानां छत्रवत्परिमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: paryāyaparimāṇena maṇḍalānugatena ca / uparyupari lokānāṃ chatravatparimaṇḍalam
verses.translation: When the sun sets along with his rays, the lustre of the sun enters the fire at night. Hence it shines from a distance.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun sets along with his rays, the lustre of the sun enters the fire at night. Hence it shines from a distance.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun sets along with his rays, the lustre of the sun enters the fire at night. Hence it shines from a distance.

verses.sanskrit: संस्थितिर्विहिता सर्वा येषु तिष्ठन्ति जन्तवः । एतदण्डकपालस्य प्रमाणं परिकीर्त्तितम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsthitirvihitā sarvā yeṣu tiṣṭhanti jantavaḥ / etadaṇḍakapālasya pramāṇaṃ parikīrttitam
verses.translation: The heat of the fire enters the sun when it rises up. The sun blazes during the day time on being united with the fire.
verses.hindi: समासाद्य स तं देशं ष्ट्वा रामं महामुनिम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The heat of the fire enters the sun when it rises up. The sun blazes during the day time on being united with the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heat of the fire enters the sun when it rises up. The sun blazes during the day time on being united with the fire.

verses.sanskrit: अण्डस्यान्तस्त्विमे लोकाः सप्तद्वीपा च मेदिनी । भूर्लोकश्च भुवर्ल्लोकस्तृतीयस्सृरिति स्स्वतः
verses.transliteration: aṇḍasyāntastvime lokāḥ saptadvīpā ca medinī / bhūrlokaśca bhuvarllokastṛtīyassṛriti ssvataḥ
verses.translation: The lustre and the heat are the brilliance of the sun and the fire. They shine and flourbh day and night, due to their mutual penetration.
verses.wordMeaning: The lustre and the heat are the brilliance of the sun and the fire. They shine and flourbh day and night, due to their mutual penetration.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lustre and the heat are the brilliance of the sun and the fire. They shine and flourbh day and night, due to their mutual penetration.

verses.sanskrit: महर्ल्लोको जनश्चैव तपः सत्यं च सप्तमम् । एते सप्त कृता लोकाश्छत्राकारा व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: maharlloko janaścaiva tapaḥ satyaṃ ca saptamam / ete sapta kṛtā lokāśchatrākārā vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: In the northern as well as southern halves of the earth, the night enters the water when the sun rises.
verses.hindi: 'इसके'अनम्तर है नृप. ! उन दानवों के दच के लिए प्रतिज्ञा करके देवों कोः वरदान प्रदान-करने वाले भगवात् शम्भुने महोदर से कहा. था.
verses.wordMeaning: In the northern as well as southern halves of the earth, the night enters the water when the sun rises.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the northern as well as southern halves of the earth, the night enters the water when the sun rises.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकैरावरणैः सूक्ष्मैर्धार्यमाणाः पृथक्पृथक् । दशभागाधिकाभिश्च ताभिः प्रकृतिभिर्बहिः
verses.transliteration: svakairāvaraṇaiḥ sūkṣmairdhāryamāṇāḥ pṛthakpṛthak / daśabhāgādhikābhiśca tābhiḥ prakṛtibhirbahiḥ
verses.translation: Understand that it traverses in the southern quarter in the mountain Minasottara. The Viuva (Equinox) is in the middle (?)
verses.hindi: हिमवाल पवंल,,के-दक्षिण आग में. एक राम नाम वाला महान तपस्वी. है । यह मुनि का. पुतन बहुत ही अधिक तेजस्वी है जो कि मेरा ही उद्देश्य लेकर. तप करता हैः।५१। वहाँ आज ही जाकर तुम मेरे आदेश को उससे कह दो हे महोदर ! उस-तपश्चर्या करने वाले को यहाँ पर ले आओ. और. इस, कायं
verses.wordMeaning: Understand that it traverses in the southern quarter in the mountain Minasottara. The Viuva (Equinox) is in the middle (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand that it traverses in the southern quarter in the mountain Minasottara. The Viuva (Equinox) is in the middle (?)

verses.sanskrit: पूर्यमाणा विशेषैश्च समुत्पन्नैः परस्परात् । अस्याण्डस्य समन्ताच्च सन्निविष्टो घनोदधिः
verses.transliteration: pūryamāṇā viśeṣaiśca samutpannaiḥ parasparāt / asyāṇḍasya samantācca sanniviṣṭo ghanodadhiḥ
verses.translation: AccordiAg to Vftr&kaaJiiini BrhatcsMiiUi, VftM U a particular division of the planetary sphere auaprwDg of three asteriims. Thus the division eomprising asterismi MAla, ParvftfSdhl and UttaritMhA CMutitutei the AjVttki, whUe Aiviid, Bhartol and KrttikS form the JVdio- MUi
verses.hindi: में विलम्ब मत करो ।५२। इसः प्रकारः से आजा पाया हुआ वह महोदर--मैं ऐसा ही करोगा--यह-कहकरु और ईन .को प्रणास्र- करके वायु के समान अआतिःतीक़ वेग से वहाँ पर चला गगा था जहाँ पर राम व्यवस्थित था
verses.wordMeaning: AccordiAg to Vftr&kaaJiiini BrhatcsMiiUi, VftM U a particular division of the planetary sphere auaprwDg of three asteriims. Thus the division eomprising asterismi MAla, ParvftfSdhl and UttaritMhA CMutitutei the AjVttki, whUe Aiviid, Bhartol and KrttikS form the JVdio- MUi
verses.commentary: Sense: AccordiAg to Vftr&kaaJiiini BrhatcsMiiUi, VftM U a particular division of the planetary sphere auaprwDg of three asteriims. Thus the division eomprising asterismi MAla, ParvftfSdhl and UttaritMhA CMutitutei the AjVttki, whUe Aiviid, Bhartol and KrttikS form the JVdio- MUi

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्या मण्डलं कृत्स्नं घनतोयेन धार्यते । घनोदधिः परेणाथ धार्य्यते घनतेजसा
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyā maṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ ghanatoyena dhāryate / ghanodadhiḥ pareṇātha dhāryyate ghanatejasā
verses.translation: During Uttarayaoa the sun goes round the internal zones. During the Dakfiiiyana it goes round the external zones always in the due order.
verses.hindi: उस देशः पर पहुँच-करः उसने महामुनि राम का दर्शन किया .था। वह तपस्या कर रहा था। उससे-परम विनयी होकर उसने यह वाक्य कहा. चाका णम्भु प्रभु आप को देखने की इच्छा करते हैं। उनकी आज्ञा से! अृगुवर्य आपके'समीक्र में मैं आया हैँ। सो. अब आप, उनके चरणों की
verses.wordMeaning: During Uttarayaoa the sun goes round the internal zones. During the Dakfiiiyana it goes round the external zones always in the due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: During Uttarayaoa the sun goes round the internal zones. During the Dakfiiiyana it goes round the external zones always in the due order.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यतो घनतेजस्च तिर्य्यगूर्द्ध्वं तु मण्डलम् । संमताद्धनवातेन धार्यमाणं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: bāhyato ghanatejasca tiryyagūrddhvaṃ tu maṇḍalam / saṃmatāddhanavātena dhāryamāṇaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: There are one hundred and eighty three zones in the north. In the south also the sun traverses that much.
verses.hindi: सन्निधि में चलिए ।५५। भागंब ने उस महोदर के इस वचन का श्रवण, करके वह बहुत णीघ उठकर खड़ा हो गया था । भगवान् शम्भु की आज्ञा को शिर पर धारण करके उस आदेश का अभिनन्दन करते हुए मै अभी चलता है--यह उसको राम ने उत्तर दिया'था
verses.wordMeaning: There are one hundred and eighty three zones in the north. In the south also the sun traverses that much.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are one hundred and eighty three zones in the north. In the south also the sun traverses that much.

verses.sanskrit: घनवातं तथाकाशमाकाशं च महात्मना । भूतादिना वृतं सर्वं भूतादिर्महता वृतः
verses.transliteration: ghanavātaṃ tathākāśamākāśaṃ ca mahātmanā / bhūtādinā vṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtādirmahatā vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: This magnitude of the zone has thus been recount¬ ed in so many Yojanas.
verses.wordMeaning: This magnitude of the zone has thus been recount¬ ed in so many Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This magnitude of the zone has thus been recount¬ ed in so many Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: वृतो महाननन्तेन प्रधानेनाव्य यात्मना । पुराणि लोकपालानां प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: vṛto mahānanantena pradhānenāvya yātmanā / purāṇi lokapālānāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam
verses.translation: The Potter's wheel whirls still more slowly at the Kavel. In the same manner, like the lumpofclay in the middle, the pole star (Dhruva) revolves.
verses.wordMeaning: The Potter's wheel whirls still more slowly at the Kavel. In the same manner, like the lumpofclay in the middle, the pole star (Dhruva) revolves.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Potter's wheel whirls still more slowly at the Kavel. In the same manner, like the lumpofclay in the middle, the pole star (Dhruva) revolves.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्गुणप्रचारस्य प्रमाणपरिसिद्धये । मेरोः प्राच्यां दिशि तथा मानसस्यैव मूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: jyotirguṇapracārasya pramāṇaparisiddhaye / meroḥ prācyāṃ diśi tathā mānasasyaiva mūrddhani
verses.translation: Thus, by means of regular and irregular move¬ ments and proceeding along its orbit, the sun divides days and nights.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, by means of regular and irregular move¬ ments and proceeding along its orbit, the sun divides days and nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, by means of regular and irregular move¬ ments and proceeding along its orbit, the sun divides days and nights.

verses.sanskrit: वस्वौकसारा माहेन्द्री पुरी हेमपरिष्कृता । दक्षिणेन पुनर्मेरोर्मानसस्यैव मूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: vasvaukasārā māhendrī purī hemapariṣkṛtā / dakṣiṇena punarmerormānasasyaiva mūrddhani
verses.translation: These guardians of the four quarters are stationed •on the Lokoka mountain. Agastya (the star Canopus) quickly traverses over them.
verses.wordMeaning: These guardians of the four quarters are stationed •on the Lokoka mountain. Agastya (the star Canopus) quickly traverses over them.
verses.commentary: Sense: These guardians of the four quarters are stationed •on the Lokoka mountain. Agastya (the star Canopus) quickly traverses over them.

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतो निव सति यमः संयमने पुरे । प्रतीच्यां तु पुनर्मेरोर्मानसस्यैव मूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: vaivasvato niva sati yamaḥ saṃyamane pure / pratīcyāṃ tu punarmerormānasasyaiva mūrddhani
verses.translation: Fifteen Nimew constitute one Kastha. Thirty Kisfhas make one Kala. Thirty Ka} make a Muhurta and thirty such Muhurtas make a full day consisting of day and night.
verses.wordMeaning: Fifteen Nimew constitute one Kastha. Thirty Kisfhas make one Kala. Thirty Ka} make a Muhurta and thirty such Muhurtas make a full day consisting of day and night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fifteen Nimew constitute one Kastha. Thirty Kisfhas make one Kala. Thirty Ka} make a Muhurta and thirty such Muhurtas make a full day consisting of day and night.

verses.sanskrit: सुखा नाम पुरी रम्या वरुणस्यापि धीमतः । वरुणो यादसां नाथस्सुखाख्ये वसते पुरे
verses.transliteration: sukhā nāma purī ramyā varuṇasyāpi dhīmataḥ / varuṇo yādasāṃ nāthassukhākhye vasate pure
verses.translation: These verses state the five para of the day, each part being of three Muhfirtas in duration.
verses.wordMeaning: These verses state the five para of the day, each part being of three Muhfirtas in duration.
verses.commentary: Sense: These verses state the five para of the day, each part being of three Muhfirtas in duration.

verses.sanskrit: दिश्युत्तरस्यां मेरोस्तु मानसस्यैव मूर्द्धनि । तुल्या महेन्द्रपुर्य्यास्तु सोमस्यापि विभावरी
verses.transliteration: diśyuttarasyāṃ merostu mānasasyaiva mūrddhani / tulyā mahendrapuryyāstu somasyāpi vibhāvarī
verses.translation: This should be considered as the excellent part. Naika Ghati (24 minutes) is the cause hereof. The five (units of time beginning with Saihvaisara arc diversified i due to four measures (?) (Sec verse 137).
verses.wordMeaning: This should be considered as the excellent part. Naika Ghati (24 minutes) is the cause hereof. The five (units of time beginning with Saihvaisara arc diversified i due to four measures (?) (Sec verse 137).
verses.commentary: Sense: This should be considered as the excellent part. Naika Ghati (24 minutes) is the cause hereof. The five (units of time beginning with Saihvaisara arc diversified i due to four measures (?) (Sec verse 137).

verses.sanskrit: मानसोत्तरवृष्टे तु लोकपालाश्चतुर्दिशम् । स्थिता धर्मव्यवस्थार्थ लोकमंरक्षणाय च
verses.transliteration: mānasottaravṛṣṭe tu lokapālāścaturdiśam / sthitā dharmavyavasthārtha lokamaṃrakṣaṇāya ca
verses.translation: Thirty units of days and nighis make one solar month. Sixtyone such days make one Rtu.
verses.hindi: आष्पात्त्, सिक्तकायेन स तु गत्वा हरांतिकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty units of days and nighis make one solar month. Sixtyone such days make one Rtu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty units of days and nighis make one solar month. Sixtyone such days make one Rtu.

verses.sanskrit: लोकपालोपरिष्टात्तु सर्वतो दक्षिणायने । काष्ठागतस्य सूर्यस्य गतिया तां निबोधत
verses.transliteration: lokapālopariṣṭāttu sarvato dakṣiṇāyane / kāṣṭhāgatasya sūryasya gatiyā tāṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: The following arc the four measures (for calculating time) viz.: Saura (Solar), Saumya (Lunar), Mksatra (sidereal) and Sdvana (based on Savana calculation of days from sunrise to sunset). These measures arc decisively mentioned in the Puranas.
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् महोदर ने राम को बहुत ही शीघ्षतासे शम्भु के समीप
verses.wordMeaning: The following arc the four measures (for calculating time) viz.: Saura (Solar), Saumya (Lunar), Mksatra (sidereal) and Sdvana (based on Savana calculation of days from sunrise to sunset). These measures arc decisively mentioned in the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following arc the four measures (for calculating time) viz.: Saura (Solar), Saumya (Lunar), Mksatra (sidereal) and Sdvana (based on Savana calculation of days from sunrise to sunset). These measures arc decisively mentioned in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यगश्चामरावत्यां यदा भवति भास्करः । वैवस्वते संयमते उदयस्तत्र दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: madhyagaścāmarāvatyāṃ yadā bhavati bhāskaraḥ / vaivasvate saṃyamate udayastatra dṛśyate
verses.translation: This Puraoa records the age-old tradition that the Yuga period consisted of five years. Even in the Vedk rimes Yuga was of dve yean and the names of those hve years (with a slight variations in the name ldpaUara viz.
verses.hindi: गन्धववंगण गान अर्थात् भगवान् के गुणों का गायन कर रहे थे तथा अप्सरा- उनके मनोबिनोद के लिए समक्ष में नृत्य कर रही थीं ।५६। सभी जन वहाँ पर देवेणवर् की उपासना में संलग्न थे । शम्भु गज के चमे को धारण क्रिये हुए थे और उनके समस्त अङ्भों में भस्म लगी हुई थी जिससे उनका शरीरा
verses.wordMeaning: This Puraoa records the age-old tradition that the Yuga period consisted of five years. Even in the Vedk rimes Yuga was of dve yean and the names of those hve years (with a slight variations in the name ldpaUara viz.

verses.sanskrit: सुखायामर्द्धरात्रं स्याद्विभायामस्तमेति च । वैवस्वते संयमने मध्यगः स्याद्रविर्यदा । सुखायामथ वारुण्यामुत्तिष्ठन्स तु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: sukhāyāmarddharātraṃ syādvibhāyāmastameti ca / vaivasvate saṃyamane madhyagaḥ syādraviryadā / sukhāyāmatha vāruṇyāmuttiṣṭhansa tu dṛśyate
verses.translation: During the time in between the Autumn and the Spring, the sun proceeds with a medium speed and he resorts to its eastern peak.
verses.hindi: घूलित हो रहा था-। तीन नेत्रों के घारण करने बाले शिव के मस्तक में चन्द्रमा विराजमान था ।६०। भगवान् पिङ्गल वर्णे की जटाजूट का भार शिर पर घारण किये हुए थे और नागों के आभरणों से उनके अङ्ग विभुः चित थे। उनका बपु परम सोम्य था तथा उनके ओष्ठ और भुजाए लम्बी
verses.wordMeaning: During the time in between the Autumn and the Spring, the sun proceeds with a medium speed and he resorts to its eastern peak.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the time in between the Autumn and the Spring, the sun proceeds with a medium speed and he resorts to its eastern peak.

verses.sanskrit: विभाया मर्द्धरात्रं स्यान्माहेन्द्यामस्तमेति च । यदा दक्षिणपुर्वेषामपराह्णो विधीयते
verses.transliteration: vibhāyā marddharātraṃ syānmāhendyāmastameti ca / yadā dakṣiṇapurveṣāmaparāhṇo vidhīyate
verses.translation: Hence, the dispeller of darkness makes the day and night equal. Divine green-coloured horses are yoked to his great chariot. They appear as though they are smeared with the rays red as lotus.
verses.hindi: थी और उनका मुख कमल प्रसन्नता से खिला हुआ था ।६१। है नूप ! उस देवों की परिषद में शम्भु सुवणं के पट्ट पर विराजमान ये । हाथ जोड़े हुए राम देवेश्बर के समीप में आ्राप्त हुआ था ।६२। भ्रगवात् श्री कण्ठ के दर्शत से आहलदातिरेक से राम का सम्पूर्ण शरीर रोमाडिचत हो गया-था और
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the dispeller of darkness makes the day and night equal. Divine green-coloured horses are yoked to his great chariot. They appear as though they are smeared with the rays red as lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the dispeller of darkness makes the day and night equal. Divine green-coloured horses are yoked to his great chariot. They appear as though they are smeared with the rays red as lotus.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणापरदेश्यानां पूर्वह्णः परिकी र्त्तितः । तेषामपररात्रश्च ये जना उत्तराः परे
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāparadeśyānāṃ pūrvahṇaḥ parikī rttitaḥ / teṣāmapararātraśca ye janā uttarāḥ pare
verses.translation: To the close of Mtfa and TuU the duration of the day from sunrise to sunset is fifteen Muhurtas. The night is also equally long.
verses.hindi: आनन्वाश्रुओं से उसका शरीर सिक्त हो गया था । ऐसी दशा में परमानन्दित होते हुए राम भगवान् शम्भु के समीप में उपस्थित हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: To the close of Mtfa and TuU the duration of the day from sunrise to sunset is fifteen Muhurtas. The night is also equally long.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the close of Mtfa and TuU the duration of the day from sunrise to sunset is fifteen Muhurtas. The night is also equally long.

verses.sanskrit: देशा उत्तरपूर्वा ये पूवरात्रस्तु तान्प्रति । एवमेवोत्तरेष्वर् के भुवनेषु विराजते
verses.transliteration: deśā uttarapūrvā ye pūvarātrastu tānprati / evamevottareṣvar ke bhuvaneṣu virājate
verses.translation: When the sun enters the first degree or part of the constellation KrUikd, it should be known that the moon enters the fourth part of the constellation VUdkhd.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun enters the first degree or part of the constellation KrUikd, it should be known that the moon enters the fourth part of the constellation VUdkhd.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun enters the first degree or part of the constellation KrUikd, it should be known that the moon enters the fourth part of the constellation VUdkhd.

verses.sanskrit: सुखायासथ वारुण्यां मध्याह्ने चार्यमा यदा । विभायां सोमपुर्यां वा उत्तिष्ठति विभावसुः
verses.transliteration: sukhāyāsatha vāruṇyāṃ madhyāhne cāryamā yadā / vibhāyāṃ somapuryāṃ vā uttiṣṭhati vibhāvasuḥ
verses.translation: When the sun moves through the third part of the constellation Viiakhi, it should be known that the moon has occupied the top of the constellation Krttika.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun moves through the third part of the constellation Viiakhi, it should be known that the moon has occupied the top of the constellation Krttika.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun moves through the third part of the constellation Viiakhi, it should be known that the moon has occupied the top of the constellation Krttika.

verses.transliteration: rātryarddha cāmarāvatyāmastameti yamasya ca / somapuryā vibhāyāṃ tu madhyāhne syāddivākaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: महेद्रस्यामरावत्यां सूर्य उत्तिष्ठते तदा । अर्द्धरात्रं संयमने वारुण्यामस्तमेति च
verses.transliteration: mahedrasyāmarāvatyāṃ sūrya uttiṣṭhate tadā / arddharātraṃ saṃyamane vāruṇyāmastameti ca
verses.translation: The months of Magha, Phalguna, Caitra, Vaiiakha, Jyestha and Asaha constitute Uttarayaa (Northern transit). The months ofSravana, Bhadrapada, Aivina, Karttika, Marga* iirsa and Pausa constitute Daksinayana.*
verses.hindi: तस्मान्ममाज्ञया राम देवानां च प्रियेप्सया । जहि देत्यगणान्सर्वान्समर्थेस्त्वं हि मे मतः॥
verses.wordMeaning: The months of Magha, Phalguna, Caitra, Vaiiakha, Jyestha and Asaha constitute Uttarayaa (Northern transit). The months ofSravana, Bhadrapada, Aivina, Karttika, Marga* iirsa and Pausa constitute Daksinayana.*
verses.commentary: Sense: The months of Magha, Phalguna, Caitra, Vaiiakha, Jyestha and Asaha constitute Uttarayaa (Northern transit). The months ofSravana, Bhadrapada, Aivina, Karttika, Marga* iirsa and Pausa constitute Daksinayana.*

verses.sanskrit: स शीघ्रमेव पर्येति भास्करो ऽलातच त्रवत् । भ्रमन्वै भ्रममार्णानि ऋक्षाणि चरते रविः
verses.transliteration: sa śīghrameva paryeti bhāskaro 'lātaca travat / bhramanvai bhramamārṇāni ṛkṣāṇi carate raviḥ

verses.sanskrit: एवं चतुर्षु पार्श्वेषु दक्षिणां तेन सर्पति । उदयास्तमने चासावृत्ति ष्ठति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ caturṣu pārśveṣu dakṣiṇāṃ tena sarpati / udayāstamane cāsāvṛtti ṣṭhati punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: The guardians of the quarters are stationed in the middle of theLokaloka. Those four(?) noble-souled guardians remain till the annihilation of all living beings.
verses.hindi: भक्ति भाव से सम्भ्रम के साथ हषं से गद्गद वाणी के द्वारा व्याकुल अक्षरों में शम्भु से बोले--हे देवदेव ! आपके लिए मेरा प्रणाम निवेदित है ।६४। संगवान् त्रिपुरारि प्रभु के चरण कमलों को मस्तक से स्पशें करते हुए उसने भूमि पतित होकर साष्टांग प्रणिपात किया था। समस्त देवों के
verses.wordMeaning: The guardians of the quarters are stationed in the middle of theLokaloka. Those four(?) noble-souled guardians remain till the annihilation of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The guardians of the quarters are stationed in the middle of theLokaloka. Those four(?) noble-souled guardians remain till the annihilation of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: पूवाह्णे चापराह्णे च द्वौ द्वौ देवालयौ तु सः । तपत्यर्कश्च मध्याह्ने तैरेव च स्वरश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: pūvāhṇe cāparāhṇe ca dvau dvau devālayau tu saḥ / tapatyarkaśca madhyāhne taireva ca svaraśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: They are Sudhama, Vairaja, Kardama, Sankhapa, Hir any a roman, Parjanya, Ketuman and Rajasa. (Perhaps they are in pairs and hence called four?).
verses.hindi: समुदाय वहाँ पर देख रहे थे । उनके मध्य में उस भृगु कुलोंद्ह ने प्रणिपात किया था।६५। भगवान् शिव ने परम प्रसन्न होकर विकसित मुखकमल बाले उस राम को उठाया था और हँसते हुए परम मधुर वाणी से आदर पूर्वक राम से कहा था ।६६। ये सब देवों के समुदाय हैत्यों के द्वारा समाः
verses.wordMeaning: They are Sudhama, Vairaja, Kardama, Sankhapa, Hir any a roman, Parjanya, Ketuman and Rajasa. (Perhaps they are in pairs and hence called four?).
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Sudhama, Vairaja, Kardama, Sankhapa, Hir any a roman, Parjanya, Ketuman and Rajasa. (Perhaps they are in pairs and hence called four?).

verses.sanskrit: उदितो वर्द्धमानाभिरामध्याह्नं तपन्रविः । अतः परं ह्रसंतीभिर्गोभिरस्तं निगच्छति
verses.transliteration: udito varddhamānābhirāmadhyāhnaṃ tapanraviḥ / ataḥ paraṃ hrasaṃtībhirgobhirastaṃ nigacchati
verses.translation: They are free from Dvandvas (mutually opposed pairs) and false prides. They are boundless and free from pari- grahas (acceptances of [gifts from others). These guardians of quarters are stationed on theLokaloka in all the four directions.
verses.hindi: कन्त हो रहे हैं और ये सब अपने निवास स्थान से परिच्युत कर दिये गये हैं। बिचारे ये देवगण उनका हनन करने की सामर्थ्य न रखते हुए ही इस समय मेरे समीप में समागत हुए हैं ।६७। इसलिए है राम ! मेंरी आज्ञों से और सब देवों के प्रिय कार्य करने की इच्छा से समस्त हैत्यगणों का आप
verses.wordMeaning: They are free from Dvandvas (mutually opposed pairs) and false prides. They are boundless and free from pari- grahas (acceptances of [gifts from others). These guardians of quarters are stationed on theLokaloka in all the four directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are free from Dvandvas (mutually opposed pairs) and false prides. They are boundless and free from pari- grahas (acceptances of [gifts from others). These guardians of quarters are stationed on theLokaloka in all the four directions.

verses.sanskrit: उदयास्तमयाभ्यां च स्मृते पूर्वापरे दिशौ । यावत्पुरस्तात्तपति तापत्पृष्ठे ऽथ पार्श्वयोः
verses.transliteration: udayāstamayābhyāṃ ca smṛte pūrvāpare diśau / yāvatpurastāttapati tāpatpṛṣṭhe 'tha pārśvayoḥ
verses.translation: To the North of the star Agastya* and to the south of AjavithI is the pathway called Pitryaiia. It is outside the path Vaivanara.
