verses.commentary: Sense: For a bettrr and detailed description how all the stars and constel¬ lations arc located as difTcrcot parts of the body aC this heavenly porpoise (SUumdra) vide Bh- P. V. 23.4-7,…

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवस्य मनसा चासौ सर्वते ज्योतिषां गणः । सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तारा नक्षत्राणि ग्रहैः सह
verses.transliteration: dhruvasya manasā cāsau sarvate jyotiṣāṃ gaṇaḥ / sūryācandramasau tārā nakṣatrāṇi grahaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Bh. P. V. 2 attribute} the power of setting in motion this stellar system to the Almighty KaU (Time) and not to Dhruva.
verses.hindi: उठाया था + दयालु आपने पिता की ही भांति: मेरे पर कृपा की-थी जेसे पिला अपने पुत्र-पर अत्यधिक प्रेस किया करता है। मेरा यही इतना वृत्तान्त है जो कि मेरे द्वारा-पूर्ण रूप से आपके समक्ष में कह दिया-गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Bh. P. V. 2 attribute} the power of setting in motion this stellar system to the Almighty KaU (Time) and not to Dhruva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bh. P. V. 2 attribute} the power of setting in motion this stellar system to the Almighty KaU (Time) and not to Dhruva.

verses.sanskrit: वातानीकमयैर्बन्धैर्ध्रुवे बद्धानि तानि वै । तेषां योगश्च भेदश्च कालश्चारस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vātānīkamayairbandhairdhruve baddhāni tāni vai / teṣāṃ yogaśca bhedaśca kālaścārastathaiva ca
verses.translation: W 12-17 describe the ancient concept of the water-cycle. Their belief In the indestructibility of water (V.17) is surpriiinfly modem, but the later description from 19b If shows old climatological concepts.
verses.hindi: स्थित्वा नाति चिरं कालमथ गंतुमियेष सः
verses.wordMeaning: W 12-17 describe the ancient concept of the water-cycle. Their belief In the indestructibility of water (V.17) is surpriiinfly modem, but the later description from 19b If shows old climatological concepts.
verses.commentary: Sense: W 12-17 describe the ancient concept of the water-cycle. Their belief In the indestructibility of water (V.17) is surpriiinfly modem, but the later description from 19b If shows old climatological concepts.

verses.sanskrit: अस्तोदयौ तथोत्पाता अयने दक्षणोत्तरे । विषुवद्ग्रहवर्णाश्च द्रुवात्सर्वं प्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: astodayau tathotpātā ayane dakṣaṇottare / viṣuvadgrahavarṇāśca druvātsarvaṃ pravarttate
verses.translation: Being obstructed by the wind, the clouds scatter water over the earth. Thus water is continuously thrown up (i.e. turned iuto vapour) and dropped down.
verses.wordMeaning: Being obstructed by the wind, the clouds scatter water over the earth. Thus water is continuously thrown up (i.e. turned iuto vapour) and dropped down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being obstructed by the wind, the clouds scatter water over the earth. Thus water is continuously thrown up (i.e. turned iuto vapour) and dropped down.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षा घर्मो हिमं रात्रिः संध्या चैव दिनं तथा । शुभाशुभं प्रजानां च ध्रुवात्सर्वं प्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: varṣā gharmo himaṃ rātriḥ saṃdhyā caiva dinaṃ tathā / śubhāśubhaṃ prajānāṃ ca dhruvātsarvaṃ pravarttate
verses.translation: The three worlds along with the mobile and immobile beings are pervaded by this Maya. The sun is the lordly creator of the worlds. Endowed with a thousand (innu¬ merable eyes) lie is the lord of the universe. He is the mighty lord of the subjects, the creator of the entire universe.
verses.hindi: श्री वसि्ठजी ने कहा--हे राजेन्द्र ! उस समय में इस भ्रकार से उस विग्रसुत के द्वारा पूछे गये रामने कहकर सुना दिया था ३७१। इसके अनन्तर बे दोनों परस्पर में त्रीति से.समन्वित होकर वार्तालाप 'करते रहे थे । अत्य घिकःकालतक नहाँ न ठहरकर उसने गमन करने की इच्छा की थी +७२।
verses.wordMeaning: The three worlds along with the mobile and immobile beings are pervaded by this Maya. The sun is the lordly creator of the worlds. Endowed with a thousand (innu¬ merable eyes) lie is the lord of the universe. He is the mighty lord of the subjects,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The three worlds along with the mobile and immobile beings are pervaded by this Maya. The sun is the lordly creator of the worlds. Endowed with a thousand (innu¬ merable eyes) lie is the lord of the universe. He is the mighty lord of the subjects,…

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवेणाधिष्टितश्चैव सूर्यो ऽपो गृह्य वर्षति । तदेष दीप्त किरणः स कालग्निर्दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: dhruveṇādhiṣṭitaścaiva sūryo 'po gṛhya varṣati / tadeṣa dīpta kiraṇaḥ sa kālagnirdivākaraḥ
verses.translation: These two, viz. the moon of cool virility and the sun of hot virility, sustain the world by means of their combi¬ nation.
verses.hindi: राम भी उसके पश्चात् उसी के पीछे गमन करने वाला हो गया था और -उसःगुफा के मुख से निकलकर बड़े आनन्द के साथ अपरे माता-पिता के निवास स्थान को ओर उसने भी 'प्रस्थान कर दिया था ।७३।-व्याश्न-के द्वारा भूमि में गिरा भी दिया गया था तो भी उसके देह में कोई भी कहीं
verses.wordMeaning: These two, viz. the moon of cool virility and the sun of hot virility, sustain the world by means of their combi¬ nation.
verses.commentary: Sense: These two, viz. the moon of cool virility and the sun of hot virility, sustain the world by means of their combi¬ nation.

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्तक्रमाद्विप्रा भाभिरालोकयन् दिशः । सूर्यः किरमजालेन वायुयुक्तेन सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: parivarttakramādviprā bhābhirālokayan diśaḥ / sūryaḥ kiramajālena vāyuyuktena sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: (The Gahga), the great rivers beginning with Bha- drasoma and the waters (humids) that flow within the bodies of all living beings mobile and immobile, become smoke (i.e. vapour).
verses.wordMeaning: (The Gahga), the great rivers beginning with Bha- drasoma and the waters (humids) that flow within the bodies of all living beings mobile and immobile, become smoke (i.e. vapour).
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Gahga), the great rivers beginning with Bha- drasoma and the waters (humids) that flow within the bodies of all living beings mobile and immobile, become smoke (i.e. vapour).

verses.sanskrit: जगतो जलमादत्ते कृत्स्नस्य द्विजसत्तमाः । आदित्यपीतं सकलं सोमः संक्रमते जलम्
verses.transliteration: jagato jalamādatte kṛtsnasya dvijasattamāḥ / ādityapītaṃ sakalaṃ somaḥ saṃkramate jalam
verses.translation: When the mobiles and immobiles get heated (and burnt) they spread everywhere as vapour.
verses.hindi: पर ब्रण नहीं हुआ था । उस विनिहनन करने वाले व्याध से बह राम के द्वारा सुरक्षित हुआ था ७४ है राजेन्द्र ! इसी कारण से इसका नाम भूमण्डल में प्रथित हो गया था फिर उस विप्र के पुत्र का अकृत त्रण ही नाम पड़ गया था ।७५। है पाथिब ! तभी से लेकर आतप के पीछे गमन करने
verses.wordMeaning: When the mobiles and immobiles get heated (and burnt) they spread everywhere as vapour.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the mobiles and immobiles get heated (and burnt) they spread everywhere as vapour.

verses.sanskrit: नाडीभिर्वायुयुक्ताभिर्लोकधारा प्रवर्त्तते । यत्सोमात्स्रवते ह्यंबु तदन्नेष्वेव तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: nāḍībhirvāyuyuktābhirlokadhārā pravarttate / yatsomātsravate hyaṃbu tadanneṣveva tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: In combination with the wind, the rays (of the sun) carry the waten from the ocean that water (then) becomes the nectar-like life-giver unto the plants.
verses.hindi: वाली छाया के ही समान वह भूमि में सभी प्रकार की अवस्थाओं में उसका अत्यधिक प्रिय मित्र हो गया था ।७६। है राजन् भृगु की सन्निधि को प्राप्त करके बह उसी के साथ अनुगत हो गया था और ख्याति को देखकर बह सामने उपस्थित हुआ था तया विनय के साथ उसने अभिवादन किया
verses.wordMeaning: In combination with the wind, the rays (of the sun) carry the waten from the ocean that water (then) becomes the nectar-like life-giver unto the plants.
verses.commentary: Sense: In combination with the wind, the rays (of the sun) carry the waten from the ocean that water (then) becomes the nectar-like life-giver unto the plants.

verses.sanskrit: मेघा वायुविघातेन विसृजन्ति जलं भूवि । एवमुत्क्षिप्यते चैव पतते चासकृज्जलम्
verses.transliteration: meghā vāyuvighātena visṛjanti jalaṃ bhūvi / evamutkṣipyate caiva patate cāsakṛjjalam
verses.translation: Then, as the season approaches at the proper time, the sun changes (the saltish water into sweet water) and gives
verses.wordMeaning: Then, as the season approaches at the proper time, the sun changes (the saltish water into sweet water) and gives
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, as the season approaches at the proper time, the sun changes (the saltish water into sweet water) and gives

verses.sanskrit: न नाश उदकस्यास्ति तदेव परिवर्त्तते । संधारणार्थं लोकानां मायैषा विश्वनिर्मिता
verses.transliteration: na nāśa udakasyāsti tadeva parivarttate / saṃdhāraṇārthaṃ lokānāṃ māyaiṣā viśvanirmitā
verses.translation: The waters stationed in the clouds fall down when they are wafted by the wind. Accompanied by the wind (they spread everywhere), for the welfare of all living lacings.
verses.hindi: ताभ्यां च प्रीतिः दुका राम: समभिनं दितः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The waters stationed in the clouds fall down when they are wafted by the wind. Accompanied by the wind (they spread everywhere), for the welfare of all living lacings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters stationed in the clouds fall down when they are wafted by the wind. Accompanied by the wind (they spread everywhere), for the welfare of all living lacings.

verses.sanskrit: अन्या मायया व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । विश्वेशो लोककृद्देवः सहस्राक्षः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: anyā māyayā vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / viśveśo lokakṛddevaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The three kinds of clouds have been enumerated. I shall mention the manner of their origin.
verses.wordMeaning: The three kinds of clouds have been enumerated. I shall mention the manner of their origin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three kinds of clouds have been enumerated. I shall mention the manner of their origin.

verses.sanskrit: धाता कृत्स्नस्य लोकस्य प्रभविष्णुर्दिवाकरः । सार्वलोकिकमंभो यत्तत्सोमान्नभसश्व्युतम्
verses.transliteration: dhātā kṛtsnasya lokasya prabhaviṣṇurdivākaraḥ / sārvalokikamaṃbho yattatsomānnabhasaśvyutam
verses.translation: Gold winds and winds on cloudy days are their characteristics. They take the shapes of buffaloes, boars and intoxicated elephants.
verses.wordMeaning: Gold winds and winds on cloudy days are their characteristics. They take the shapes of buffaloes, boars and intoxicated elephants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold winds and winds on cloudy days are their characteristics. They take the shapes of buffaloes, boars and intoxicated elephants.

verses.sanskrit: सोमाधारं जगत्सर्वमेतत्तथ्यं प्रकीर्तितम् । सूर्यादुष्णं निस्रवते सोमाच्छीतं प्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: somādhāraṃ jagatsarvametattathyaṃ prakīrtitam / sūryāduṣṇaṃ nisravate somācchītaṃ pravarttate
verses.translation: They arc devoid of lightning streaks. They hai down with torrents of water. They arc silent clouds of huge bodies. They are under the control of Avaha (A kind of wind).
verses.hindi: परमप्रीति से समन्वित उन दोनों के द्वारा बह आशीवंचनों से अभि- नन्दिन किया गया था । उसके प्रिय करने की अभिलाषा से उसने वहाँ पर कुछ दिन तक निवास किया था ।७८। इसके उपरान्त उन दोनों की अनुमति से शिष्यों के समुदायों से समावृत महामुनि च्यवन के आश्रम की और वह्
verses.wordMeaning: They arc devoid of lightning streaks. They hai down with torrents of water. They arc silent clouds of huge bodies. They are under the control of Avaha (A kind of wind).
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc devoid of lightning streaks. They hai down with torrents of water. They arc silent clouds of huge bodies. They are under the control of Avaha (A kind of wind).

verses.sanskrit: शीतोष्णवीर्यौं द्वावेतौ युक्त्या धारयतो जगत् । सोमाधारा नदी गङ्गा पवित्रा विमलोदका
verses.transliteration: śītoṣṇavīryauṃ dvāvetau yuktyā dhārayato jagat / somādhārā nadī gaṅgā pavitrā vimalodakā
verses.translation: ThU la A fandnU derivation of Abhra 'a cloud*. Normly Abhra is derived from'v/«»Wr—+suffix—oc (i.c.—o) or from ap + bhf —suffix—e, meaning 'bearer of water.
verses.hindi: चला गया था ।७६। उस महान मन वाले ने अपने अन्त:-करण को नियन्त्रण में रहने वाले और परम शान्त मन वाले उस महा मुनि की तथा सुकन्या
verses.wordMeaning: ThU la A fandnU derivation of Abhra 'a cloud*. Normly Abhra is derived from'v/«»Wr—+suffix—oc (i.c.—o) or from ap + bhf —suffix—e, meaning 'bearer of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: ThU la A fandnU derivation of Abhra 'a cloud*. Normly Abhra is derived from'v/«»Wr—+suffix—oc (i.c.—o) or from ap + bhf —suffix—e, meaning 'bearer of water.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रसोमपुरोगाश्च महानद्यो द्विजोत्तमाः । सर्वभूतशरीरेषु ह्यापो ह्यनुसृताश्च याः
verses.transliteration: bhadrasomapurogāśca mahānadyo dvijottamāḥ / sarvabhūtaśarīreṣu hyāpo hyanusṛtāśca yāḥ
verses.translation: W. 30-46 give the pseudoscientihc clauificaiion of clouds as believ¬
verses.hindi: नाम धारिणी जो उनकी भार्या थी उसकी वन्दना की थो ।८०। परम ध्रीति से सुसम्पन्न उन दोनों के द्वारा राम का भली-भाति अभिनन्दन किया गया 'था । तप की निधि का दर्शन करने की कामना बाले उसने औबें के आश्रम को प्राप्त किया था ।८१। है नृप ! मेधावी राम ने उनका अभिवादन किया
verses.wordMeaning: W. 30-46 give the pseudoscientihc clauificaiion of clouds as believ¬
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 30-46 give the pseudoscientihc clauificaiion of clouds as believ¬

verses.sanskrit: तेषु संदह्यमानेषु जङ्गमस्थावरेषु च । धूमभूतास्तु ता ह्यापो निष्कामन्तीह सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: teṣu saṃdahyamāneṣu jaṅgamasthāvareṣu ca / dhūmabhūtāstu tā hyāpo niṣkāmantīha sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: They shower rain from within one and a half to three kilometres. They shower rain on the tops and ridges of the mountains and roar out.
verses.hindi: था और ओर्व महामुनि के द्वारा राम का अभिनन्दन किया गया था । वहाँ पर उनकी प्रीति होने सें वह कतिपय दिनों तक रह था ।२। फिर घीरे से आनन्द के साथ उस मुनि के द्वारा राम की विदाई की गयी थी और अक्त व्ण के ही सहित श्रीमान् भार्गव ने वहाँ से प्रस्थान किया था ।५३। पिता
verses.wordMeaning: They shower rain from within one and a half to three kilometres. They shower rain on the tops and ridges of the mountains and roar out.
verses.commentary: Sense: They shower rain from within one and a half to three kilometres. They shower rain on the tops and ridges of the mountains and roar out.

verses.sanskrit: तेन चाभ्राणि जायन्ते स्थानमभ्रमयं स्मृतम् । तेजोर्ऽकः सर्वभूतेभ्य आदत्ते रश्मिभिर्जलम्
verses.transliteration: tena cābhrāṇi jāyante sthānamabhramayaṃ smṛtam / tejor'kaḥ sarvabhūtebhya ādatte raśmibhirjalam
verses.translation: Those clouds named Brahmajas are bom of the breath of god Brahma. They cause impregnation of the white cranes and they sustain their youx ones in the womb.
verses.hindi: के पिता-माता के चरणों में पृथकपृथक् बन्दना को थी । है नृप ! उन दोनों ने उसका बड़े ही हं से अभिनन्दन किया था ।=४। .
verses.wordMeaning: Those clouds named Brahmajas are bom of the breath of god Brahma. They cause impregnation of the white cranes and they sustain their youx ones in the womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those clouds named Brahmajas are bom of the breath of god Brahma. They cause impregnation of the white cranes and they sustain their youx ones in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्राद्वायुसंयोगाद्वहन्त्यापो गभस्तयः । संजीवनं च सस्यानामंभस्तदमृतोपमम्
verses.transliteration: samudrādvāyusaṃyogādvahantyāpo gabhastayaḥ / saṃjīvanaṃ ca sasyānāmaṃbhastadamṛtopamam
verses.translation: Indeed they are endued with streaks of lightning and reverberations of thundering that are pleasing. Due to their continuous rumbling sound, the earth expresses horri¬ pilation in the from of (plants and trees) sprouting from it.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed they are endued with streaks of lightning and reverberations of thundering that are pleasing. Due to their continuous rumbling sound, the earth expresses horri¬ pilation in the from of (plants and trees) sprouting from it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed they are endued with streaks of lightning and reverberations of thundering that are pleasing. Due to their continuous rumbling sound, the earth expresses horri¬ pilation in the from of (plants and trees) sprouting from it.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वृतुवशात्काले परिवत्य दिवाकरः । यच्छत्यापो हि मेघेभ्यः घुक्लाशुक्लैर्गभस्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: tatastvṛtuvaśātkāle parivatya divākaraḥ / yacchatyāpo hi meghebhyaḥ ghuklāśuklairgabhastibhiḥ
verses.translation: Like a queen who has been installed (on the throne of) a kingdom, she attains the freshness of youth once again. Strongly attached to the rains, she becomes the source of the life of beings.
verses.hindi: अपृच्छतां च तौ रामं कालेनैतावता त्वया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Like a queen who has been installed (on the throne of) a kingdom, she attains the freshness of youth once again. Strongly attached to the rains, she becomes the source of the life of beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a queen who has been installed (on the throne of) a kingdom, she attains the freshness of youth once again. Strongly attached to the rains, she becomes the source of the life of beings.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रस्थाः प्रपतन्त्यापो वायुना समुदीरिताः । सर्वभूतहितार्थाय वायुमिश्राः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: abhrasthāḥ prapatantyāpo vāyunā samudīritāḥ / sarvabhūtahitārthāya vāyumiśrāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Those clouds depend on Pravaha, the second type of wind. These clouds (shower rain) from within twelve to eighteen kilometres.
verses.hindi: कि क्रतं पुत्र को वायं कुत्र वा त्वमुपस्थितः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those clouds depend on Pravaha, the second type of wind. These clouds (shower rain) from within twelve to eighteen kilometres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those clouds depend on Pravaha, the second type of wind. These clouds (shower rain) from within twelve to eighteen kilometres.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वर्षति षण्मासान्सर्वभूतविवृद्धये । वायव्यं स्तनितं चैव वैद्युतं चाग्निसंभवम्
verses.transliteration: tato varṣati ṣaṇmāsānsarvabhūtavivṛddhaye / vāyavyaṃ stanitaṃ caiva vaidyutaṃ cāgnisaṃbhavam
verses.translation: Those clouds named PukarUvaftakas arc born of the Wings. Its conception is threefold. The shower is glorified as continuous downp)our.
verses.wordMeaning: Those clouds named PukarUvaftakas arc born of the Wings. Its conception is threefold. The shower is glorified as continuous downp)our.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those clouds named PukarUvaftakas arc born of the Wings. Its conception is threefold. The shower is glorified as continuous downp)our.

verses.sanskrit: मेहनाच्च मिहेधातोमघत्वं व्यजयन्ति हि । न भ्रश्यन्ति यतश्चापस्तदभं कवयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: mehanācca mihedhātomaghatvaṃ vyajayanti hi / na bhraśyanti yataścāpastadabhaṃ kavayo viduḥ
verses.translation: The wings of very powerful mountains that had in¬ creased in size and who used to go wherever as they pleased, were chopped off by I ndrn who wished to secure the welfare of all living beings.
verses.hindi: फिर उन दोनों के द्वारा उदार बुद्धि वाले उससे अपना वृत्तान्त पूर्ण रूप से पूछा गया था । है राजेन्द्र ! जो कुछ भी जिस तरह से हुआ था वह अनुक्रम के साथ राम ने कहा था ।=५। वहाँ पर भी कुछ दिन तक स्थित रहकर फिर उनकी अपुञ्ना से परम आनन्द से संयुत होकर माता-पिता के
verses.wordMeaning: The wings of very powerful mountains that had in¬ creased in size and who used to go wherever as they pleased, were chopped off by I ndrn who wished to secure the welfare of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wings of very powerful mountains that had in¬ creased in size and who used to go wherever as they pleased, were chopped off by I ndrn who wished to secure the welfare of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: मेघानां पुनरुत्पत्तिश्त्रिविधा योनिरुच्यते । आग्नेया ब्रह्मजाश्चैव पक्षजाश्च पृथग्विधाः
verses.transliteration: meghānāṃ punarutpattiśtrividhā yonirucyate / āgneyā brahmajāścaiva pakṣajāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ
verses.translation: Those clouds named Pufkara (were born of those wings). They increased in size competing with the waters. For the reason, they arc termed Pukardoartakas (revolving Pukaras),
verses.wordMeaning: Those clouds named Pufkara (were born of those wings). They increased in size competing with the waters. For the reason, they arc termed Pukardoartakas (revolving Pukaras),
verses.commentary: Sense: Those clouds named Pufkara (were born of those wings). They increased in size competing with the waters. For the reason, they arc termed Pukardoartakas (revolving Pukaras),

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा मेघाः समाख्यातास्तेषां वक्ष्यामि संभवम् । आग्नेया स्तूष्णजाः प्रोक्तास्तेषां धूमप्रवर्त्तनम्
verses.transliteration: tridhā meghāḥ samākhyātāsteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi saṃbhavam / āgneyā stūṣṇajāḥ proktāsteṣāṃ dhūmapravarttanam
verses.translation: They assume many forms. Their thundering sound is very terrible. They are the creators of the torrential rain at the end of the Kalpas. They control the Sarhvartaka fire (which burns down the universe then).
verses.hindi: निवासं स्थान को वह चला गया था।८६। है राजन् ! उस परमोत्तम आश्रम में माता-पिता विराजमान थे। उनके सामने उपस्थित होकर भूभुनेन्दन ने उन दोनों कें चरणों में यथोचित रीति से वन्दना की थी )८७। उन्होने अपने चरणों में मस्तक झुकाने वाले राम को आदर के साथ उठाकर आश्लेषण
verses.wordMeaning: They assume many forms. Their thundering sound is very terrible. They are the creators of the torrential rain at the end of the Kalpas. They control the Sarhvartaka fire (which burns down the universe then).
verses.commentary: Sense: They assume many forms. Their thundering sound is very terrible. They are the creators of the torrential rain at the end of the Kalpas. They control the Sarhvartaka fire (which burns down the universe then).

verses.sanskrit: शीतदुर्दिनवाता ये स्वगुणास्ते व्यवस्थिताः । महिषाश्च वाराहाश्च मत्तमातङ्गरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: śītadurdinavātā ye svaguṇāste vyavasthitāḥ / mahiṣāśca vārāhāśca mattamātaṅgarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: These (clouds) shower rain at the close of the Yugas. (Thus) those third (sets of clouds) have been recount¬ ed. They have many forms, configurations and aggregates. They fill the Earth.
verses.hindi: किया था और परमानन्दित होते हुए अपने वात्सल्य के कारण आये हुए घ्रेमाश्नुओं से उसका परिषिञ्चन किया था ।८८। आशीर्वादों के द्वारा अभि- नन्दन करके उन्होंने अपनी गोद में बिठा लिया था और बारम्बार उस अपने पुत्र के मुख का अवलोकत करते हुए उसके अङ्गो का परिस्पर्शं करके
verses.wordMeaning: These (clouds) shower rain at the close of the Yugas. (Thus) those third (sets of clouds) have been recount¬ ed. They have many forms, configurations and aggregates. They fill the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: These (clouds) shower rain at the close of the Yugas. (Thus) those third (sets of clouds) have been recount¬ ed. They have many forms, configurations and aggregates. They fill the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा धरणिमभ्येत्य रमन्ते विचरन्ति च । जीमूता नाम ते मेघा ह्येतेभ्यो जीवसंभवः
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā dharaṇimabhyetya ramante vicaranti ca / jīmūtā nāma te meghā hyetebhyo jīvasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: On being directed to make the plants and trees flourish, Parjanya and the Diggajas (Elephants of the quarters) shower snowdrops during Hemanta (early winter), born of cool virility,
verses.hindi: परुभाधिक आनन्द को प्राप्त हुए थे ।८६। उन दोनों मे राम से'पूछा था हे पुत्र  इतने लम्बे समय तक आपने क्‍या किया था और यह दूसरा कौन तुम्हारे साय में है तथा तुम कहँ इतरो समय र्न्तः रहे 'थे ?.।९०। किस प्रकार से तुम सकाश में साथ समास्थित हुए ये अथवा यहाँ पर कहाँ से इस
verses.wordMeaning: On being directed to make the plants and trees flourish, Parjanya and the Diggajas (Elephants of the quarters) shower snowdrops during Hemanta (early winter), born of cool virility,
verses.commentary: Sense: On being directed to make the plants and trees flourish, Parjanya and the Diggajas (Elephants of the quarters) shower snowdrops during Hemanta (early winter), born of cool virility,

verses.sanskrit: विद्युद्गुणविहीनाश्च जलधारा विलंबिनः । मूकमेघा महाकाया आवहस्य वशानुगाः
verses.transliteration: vidyudguṇavihīnāśca jaladhārā vilaṃbinaḥ / mūkameghā mahākāyā āvahasya vaśānugāḥ
verses.translation: The sixth wind named Parivaka is their support. This powerful (wind) holds up the Ganga of the firmament, the holy divine river of exquisite nectar-Iikc water. The Ganga is situated in the path Svti (i.e. firmament) in three cur¬ rents. With their huge trunks, the elephants of the quarters receive the waters oozing from thcGangli and scatter them in the form of water spray. That is remembered as dew-drops.
verses.hindi: समय में समागत हुए ये ? है वस्स ! आपको , हम दोनों के सामने जो भी सश्य-सत्य हो बह सब बतला देना चाहिए ।€१।
verses.wordMeaning: The sixth wind named Parivaka is their support. This powerful (wind) holds up the Ganga of the firmament, the holy divine river of exquisite nectar-Iikc water. The Ganga is situated in the path Svti (i.e. firmament) in three cur¬ rents. With their huge trunks,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sixth wind named Parivaka is their support. This powerful (wind) holds up the Ganga of the firmament, the holy divine river of exquisite nectar-Iikc water. The Ganga is situated in the path Svti (i.e. firmament) in three cur¬ rents. With their huge trunks,…

verses.sanskrit: क्रोशमात्राच्च वर्षन्ति क्रोशार्द्धादपि वा पुनः । पर्वताग्र नितंबेषु वर्षति च रसंति च
verses.transliteration: krośamātrācca varṣanti krośārddhādapi vā punaḥ / parvatāgra nitaṃbeṣu varṣati ca rasaṃti ca
verses.translation: The clouds and their activity of causing the develop¬ ment (of various things) —all these have been recounted. The sun alone is mentioned as the creator of showers.
verses.hindi: कार्तवीर्य का जमदरिति ऑश्म में आगमन
verses.wordMeaning: The clouds and their activity of causing the develop¬ ment (of various things) —all these have been recounted. The sun alone is mentioned as the creator of showers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The clouds and their activity of causing the develop¬ ment (of various things) —all these have been recounted. The sun alone is mentioned as the creator of showers.

verses.sanskrit: बलाकागर्भदाश्चैव बलाकागर्भधारिणः । ब्रह्मजा नाम ते मेघा ब्रह्मनिश्वाससंभवाः
verses.transliteration: balākāgarbhadāścaiva balākāgarbhadhāriṇaḥ / brahmajā nāma te meghā brahmaniśvāsasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: The rainfall has its root (source) in the sun water; proceeds from (functions on account of) the sun. It is after being presided over by Dhruva that the sun works for rain.
verses.wordMeaning: The rainfall has its root (source) in the sun water; proceeds from (functions on account of) the sun. It is after being presided over by Dhruva that the sun works for rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rainfall has its root (source) in the sun water; proceeds from (functions on account of) the sun. It is after being presided over by Dhruva that the sun works for rain.

verses.sanskrit: ते हि विद्युद्गुणोपेतास्तनयित्नुप्रियस्वनाः । तेषां शश्र्वत्प्रणादेन भूमिः स्वाङ्गरूहोद्भवा
verses.transliteration: te hi vidyudguṇopetāstanayitnupriyasvanāḥ / teṣāṃ śaśrvatpraṇādena bhūmiḥ svāṅgarūhodbhavā
verses.translation: The Cctmdas (Vedic Metres) have assumed the forms of horses and arc stationed in the direction of the wheel. The chariot has characteristics similar to those of the chariot of Varuia.
verses.hindi: तौ च तेनोदितं सर्वे श्रुत्वा तत्कर्म विस्तरम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Cctmdas (Vedic Metres) have assumed the forms of horses and arc stationed in the direction of the wheel. The chariot has characteristics similar to those of the chariot of Varuia.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Cctmdas (Vedic Metres) have assumed the forms of horses and arc stationed in the direction of the wheel. The chariot has characteristics similar to those of the chariot of Varuia.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञी राज्याभिषिक्तेव पुनर्यौंवनमश्नुते । तेष्वियं प्रावृडासक्ता भूतानां जीवितोद्भवा
verses.transliteration: rājñī rājyābhiṣikteva punaryauṃvanamaśnute / teṣviyaṃ prāvṛḍāsaktā bhūtānāṃ jīvitodbhavā
verses.translation: Muhurtas and Kal are remembered as the beauti¬ ful trappings and fittings. Kastha is remembered as its nose and the (Moment) is its axle.
verses.wordMeaning: Muhurtas and Kal are remembered as the beauti¬ ful trappings and fittings. Kastha is remembered as its nose and the (Moment) is its axle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Muhurtas and Kal are remembered as the beauti¬ ful trappings and fittings. Kastha is remembered as its nose and the (Moment) is its axle.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं प्रवहं वायुं मेघास्ते तु समाश्रिताः । एतं योजनमात्राच्च साध्यर्द्धा निष्कृतादपि
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ pravahaṃ vāyuṃ meghāste tu samāśritāḥ / etaṃ yojanamātrācca sādhyarddhā niṣkṛtādapi
verses.translation: VV. 61*62 give a symbolic docriptioo of the CbsHot of the SuAt The significance of each part of the chariot, the horses yoked etc. Is given ia W, 67 ff below.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु-कदाचिद्धेहयेश्वर: । इयेष मृगयां गंतु' चतुरंगबलान्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 61*62 give a symbolic docriptioo of the CbsHot of the SuAt The significance of each part of the chariot, the horses yoked etc. Is given ia W, 67 ff below.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 61*62 give a symbolic docriptioo of the CbsHot of the SuAt The significance of each part of the chariot, the horses yoked etc. Is given ia W, 67 ff below.

verses.sanskrit: वृष्टिर्गर्भस्त्रिधा तेषां धारासारः प्रकीर्त्तितः । पुष्करावर्त्तका नाम ते मेघाः पक्षसंभवाः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṭirgarbhastridhā teṣāṃ dhārāsāraḥ prakīrttitaḥ / puṣkarāvarttakā nāma te meghāḥ pakṣasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) these two are remembered as the tips of the yoke and the axle.
verses.hindi: श्री वसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--हें राजन् ! जब उस समय में -इस प्रकार से राम से पूछा गया था तो उसने अपने दोनों करों को जोड़कर उन दोनों के समक्ष में बह सम्पूर्ण अपना घटित घटनाओं का इतिवृत्त कह. दिया था जो भी कुछ अपने द्वारा अब तक किया था ।१। अपने कुलदेब की आज्ञा से
verses.wordMeaning: Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) these two are remembered as the tips of the yoke and the axle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) these two are remembered as the tips of the yoke and the axle.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रेण पक्षच्छिन्ना ये पर्वतानां महौजसाम् । कामागानां प्रवृद्धानां भूतानां शिवमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: śakreṇa pakṣacchinnā ye parvatānāṃ mahaujasām / kāmāgānāṃ pravṛddhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ śivamicchatā
verses.translation: The seven Metres are Gayatr! Tri?lup, Anus|up, Jagati, Pahkti, Brhati and Unik.
verses.hindi: अपनी तपश्चर्या का समाचरण तथा भगवान शम्भु के निर्देश से यथाक्रम तीयो का पयटन जो किया था--बह सभी कुछ निवेदित कर दियां'या
verses.wordMeaning: The seven Metres are Gayatr! Tri?lup, Anus|up, Jagati, Pahkti, Brhati and Unik.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven Metres are Gayatr! Tri?lup, Anus|up, Jagati, Pahkti, Brhati and Unik.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करा नाम ते मेघा बृंहन्तस्तोयमत्सराः । पुष्करावर्त्तकास्तेन कारणेनेह शब्दिताः
verses.transliteration: puṣkarā nāma te meghā bṛṃhantastoyamatsarāḥ / puṣkarāvarttakāstena kāraṇeneha śabditāḥ
verses.translation: Propelled by Dhruva, the great wheel whirls along with the Axis. Thus is the structure of lus chariot in view of specific purpose.
verses.hindi: फिर शंकर कीं ही आज्ञा से देवों की सुरक्षा करने के कारण से ' जों दंतंमों' का वध किया था वह भी सुता दिया था। यह! पर भी भगवान हर के' प्रसादं से ही अकृत ब्रग का दर्शन हुआ था ।३। यह सम्पूर्ण पूर्णतया जो हुआ' था वह और जो अपने द्वारा कुछ भी किया गया था वह सब परम प्रसन्न
verses.wordMeaning: Propelled by Dhruva, the great wheel whirls along with the Axis. Thus is the structure of lus chariot in view of specific purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: Propelled by Dhruva, the great wheel whirls along with the Axis. Thus is the structure of lus chariot in view of specific purpose.

verses.sanskrit: नानारूपधराश्चैव महाघोरस्वनाश्च ते । कल्पान्तवृष्टेः स्रष्टारः संवर्ताग्ने र्नियामकाः
verses.transliteration: nānārūpadharāścaiva mahāghorasvanāśca te / kalpāntavṛṣṭeḥ sraṣṭāraḥ saṃvartāgne rniyāmakāḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, by means of combination the shining chariot has l)een evolved. By means of that shining chariot, lord sun-god traverses the firmament.
verses.hindi: माता-पिता, के सामने राम ने कहकर सुना दिया था ।४। उन दोनों ने राम के द्वारा कहा हुआ सब उसके कर्मों का विस्तार श्रवण किया था और परम सन्त हुए ये । है राजय् ! फिर वे दोनों एक दूसरे हषं को भी प्रत हुए थे.।५। है मद्वाराज ! इस रीति से उस भृगुकुल में परम श्रेष्ठ राम ने अपने'
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, by means of combination the shining chariot has l)een evolved. By means of that shining chariot, lord sun-god traverses the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, by means of combination the shining chariot has l)een evolved. By means of that shining chariot, lord sun-god traverses the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षन्त्येते युगान्तेषु तृतीयास्ते प्रकीर्त्तिताः । अनेकरूपसंस्थानाः पूरयन्तो महीतलम्

verses.hindi: माता-प्रिता की शुश्रूषा करते हुए पूर्णतया उनके प्रति अपने कर्तव्य को सबिनय पालन किया था और अपने भाइयों की भी सेवा उसी भाव से उसने की थी ।६। इसी समय में किसी वक्‍त हैह्यस्वर चतुरज़िणी सेना के सहित मृगया करने को गमन करने वाला हुआ था छा
verses.wordMeaning: There are two rein-cords fixed to the extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot. Those two rein-cords re¬ volve in Dhruva (and perform the function) of a pair of wheels.

verses.sanskrit: वायुं पुरा वहन्तः स्युराश्रिताः कल्पसाधकाः । यान्यण्डस्य तु भिन्नस्य प्राकृतस्याभवंस्तदा
verses.transliteration: vāyuṃ purā vahantaḥ syurāśritāḥ kalpasādhakāḥ / yānyaṇḍasya tu bhinnasya prākṛtasyābhavaṃstadā

verses.hindi: मंद. वीजति शओद्ध,तकेतकीवनराजिमिः । प्राभातिके गंधवहे कुमुदाकरसंस्पृशि ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot revolve all round along with the rein-cords like the rope fixed to a peg.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्ब्रह्मा समुत्पन्नश्चतुर्वक्त्रः स्वयंप्रभुः । तान्येवाण्डकपालानि सर्वे मेघाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: yasminbrahmā samutpannaścaturvaktraḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ / tānyevāṇḍakapālāni sarve meghāḥ prakīrttitāḥ

verses.hindi: बाले हो गये'थे ।३०। इस प्रकार से कुछ सवागुर गिरते हुए और गिरे केद्वारा सभी ओर सम्पूण पृथ्वी तल को रक्त से भीगी हुई करके अनुकीणं' कर दिया था । कुछ मृग' कुत्तों के दारा खदेड़ हुए'होकर' भाग रहे'येतऔर' और आत्त होकर चीखें मारते हुए प्राणों के भय सेः अति आतुर और भम-
verses.wordMeaning: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•
verses.commentary: Sense: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•

verses.sanskrit: तथैव बाह्यतः सूर्यो भ्रमते मण्डलानि तु । उद्वेषाटयन्स वेगेन मण्डलानि तु गच्छति
verses.transliteration: tathaiva bāhyataḥ sūryo bhramate maṇḍalāni tu / udveṣāṭayansa vegena maṇḍalāni tu gacchati
verses.translation: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•
verses.hindi: भीत हों रहे ये।३१-३रा जिस तरह से युग के अन्त समय में सब्र विभीर hs पूणं स्थिति हुआ करती हैं ठोक उस समय से अत्यन्त आतुर हो' रहे थे जिसके कारण वह सम्पूर्ण वन समाकुल होकर शोभित हो रहा था ।३३। वहाँ पर चमरी-रुरु-गोमायु-गवयन्रीछ और बहुत से वृक-क्ृष्णसार-
verses.wordMeaning: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•
verses.commentary: Sense: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे देवग्रहानुकीर्तनं नाम द्वाविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच सरथो ऽधिष्ठितो देवैरादित्यैर्मुनिभिस्तथा । गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde devagrahānukīrtanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca saratho 'dhiṣṭhito devairādityairmunibhistathā / gandharvairapsarobhiśca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ
verses.translation: These abide in the sun for the period of two months each in due order.
verses.hindi: ओर मारे जा रहे वे जिनमें दूध पीने वाले बहुत से बहुत छोटे पशु थे और बालक वृद्ध तथा जवान पशुओं के जोड़े भी थे । वहाँ पर सभी का निहननः
verses.wordMeaning: These abide in the sun for the period of two months each in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: These abide in the sun for the period of two months each in due order.

verses.sanskrit: एते वसंति वै सूर्ये द्वौ द्वौ मासौ क्रमेण तु । धातार्ऽयमा पुलस्त्यश्च पुलहश्च प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: ete vasaṃti vai sūrye dvau dvau māsau krameṇa tu / dhātār'yamā pulastyaśca pulahaśca prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: These verses (2-24) ecumierate the names of the different devw> sages etc.-tbe hqitad who occupy the solar chariot every month. These verses are common to the descrdoa of the Solar chariot in other Purioai e.g. the Mt. F. 125. 1«$4, Vk* 1-26 with slight differences in the names of the bccupaati of the chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: These verses (2-24) ecumierate the names of the different devw> sages etc.-tbe hqitad who occupy the solar chariot every month. These verses are common to the descrdoa of the Solar chariot in other Purioai e.g. the Mt. F. 125. 1«$4,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These verses (2-24) ecumierate the names of the different devw> sages etc.-tbe hqitad who occupy the solar chariot every month. These verses are common to the descrdoa of the Solar chariot in other Purioai e.g. the Mt. F. 125. 1«$4,…

verses.sanskrit: एरावतो वासुकिश्च कंसो भीमश्च तावुभौ । रथकृच्च रथौजाश्च यक्षावेतावुदा त्दृतौ
verses.transliteration: erāvato vāsukiśca kaṃso bhīmaśca tāvubhau / rathakṛcca rathaujāśca yakṣāvetāvudā tdṛtau
verses.translation: Making the Pitt'S, Devas and Human beings well nourished, O Britbmanas, Savitf the cause of days and nights goes on revolving.
verses.wordMeaning: Making the Pitt'S, Devas and Human beings well nourished, O Britbmanas, Savitf the cause of days and nights goes on revolving.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making the Pitt'S, Devas and Human beings well nourished, O Britbmanas, Savitf the cause of days and nights goes on revolving.

verses.sanskrit: तुंबुरुर्नारदश्चैव सुस्थला पुञ्जिकस्थला । रक्षो हेतिः प्रहेतिश्च यातुधानावुदाहृतौ
verses.transliteration: tuṃbururnāradaścaiva susthalā puñjikasthalā / rakṣo hetiḥ prahetiśca yātudhānāvudāhṛtau
verses.translation: These Devas reside in the sun for periods of two months in due order. These twelve groups of seven (orheptads) identify themselves with their place of office and residence.
verses.wordMeaning: These Devas reside in the sun for periods of two months in due order. These twelve groups of seven (orheptads) identify themselves with their place of office and residence.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Devas reside in the sun for periods of two months in due order. These twelve groups of seven (orheptads) identify themselves with their place of office and residence.

verses.sanskrit: एते वसंति वै सूर्य्ये मधुमाधवयोः सदा । मित्रश्च वरुणश्चैव मुनिरत्रिरुदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: ete vasaṃti vai sūryye madhumādhavayoḥ sadā / mitraśca varuṇaścaiva muniratrirudāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: By means of their splendour they increase the excels lent splendour of the sun. By means of words (and prayers) composed by themselves, sages eulogise the sun.
verses.hindi: मध्ये दिनकरे प्राप्ते ससैन्य: स तदा नृपः ३७
verses.wordMeaning: By means of their splendour they increase the excels lent splendour of the sun. By means of words (and prayers) composed by themselves, sages eulogise the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of their splendour they increase the excels lent splendour of the sun. By means of words (and prayers) composed by themselves, sages eulogise the sun.

verses.sanskrit: तथा वसिष्ठो विख्यातः सहजन्या च मेनका । राक्षसौ च समाख्यातौ पौरुषेयो वधस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tathā vasiṣṭho vikhyātaḥ sahajanyā ca menakā / rākṣasau ca samākhyātau pauruṣeyo vadhastathā
verses.translation: The Gandharvas and the Apsaras serve him by means of songs and dances. The Grimaols, Yakas and Bhutas perform the worship of his rays.
verses.wordMeaning: The Gandharvas and the Apsaras serve him by means of songs and dances. The Grimaols, Yakas and Bhutas perform the worship of his rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gandharvas and the Apsaras serve him by means of songs and dances. The Grimaols, Yakas and Bhutas perform the worship of his rays.

verses.sanskrit: हाहा हूहूश्च गन्धर्वौं यज्ञश्चापि रथस्वनः । रथचित्रस्तथैवान्यो नागसाक्षकसंज्ञेतः
verses.transliteration: hāhā hūhūśca gandharvauṃ yajñaścāpi rathasvanaḥ / rathacitrastathaivānyo nāgasākṣakasaṃjñetaḥ
verses.translation: The serpents carry the sun, the demons follow him. From sunrise to sunset, the Valakhilyas surround the sun and lead him on.
verses.hindi: राजा के सैनिकों ने शस्त्रों के द्वारा वध करने के जो भी पशु योग्य थे उन सबक। पेने शस्त्रों से हनन कर दिया था । इस प्रकार से प्राय: हिंसा करने वाले महान घोर पशुओं का वहाँ पर पूर्ण रूप से हनन किंगा था
verses.wordMeaning: The serpents carry the sun, the demons follow him. From sunrise to sunset, the Valakhilyas surround the sun and lead him on.
verses.commentary: Sense: The serpents carry the sun, the demons follow him. From sunrise to sunset, the Valakhilyas surround the sun and lead him on.

verses.sanskrit: रंभकश्च वसन्त्येते मासयोः शुचिशुक्रयोः । ततः सूर्ये पुनस्त्वन्या निवसंतीह देवताः
verses.transliteration: raṃbhakaśca vasantyete māsayoḥ śuciśukrayoḥ / tataḥ sūrye punastvanyā nivasaṃtīha devatāḥ
verses.translation: All these followers of the day revolve along with the sun. They'shower rain on the subjects, they scorch them and they delight them (too).
verses.hindi: इस तरह से शिकार करने से शिकार करने से तृप के सैनिक बड़े भारी श्रम से थक गये थे। भुवन भास्कर सूयेदेव मध्य में प्राप्त हो गये थे । उस समयः दोपह्रो के वक्त में राजा अपनी सेना के सहित सूर्यातप से बेचैन हो गया. 'था।३७। चाम से संतप्त होकर व्यासा राजा धीरे से नमंदा के तट पर चला.
verses.wordMeaning: All these followers of the day revolve along with the sun. They'shower rain on the subjects, they scorch them and they delight them (too).
verses.commentary: Sense: All these followers of the day revolve along with the sun. They'shower rain on the subjects, they scorch them and they delight them (too).

verses.sanskrit: इद्रश्चैव विवस्वांश्च अङ्गिरा भृगुरेव च । एलापत्रस्तथा सर्पः शङ्खपालाश्च तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: idraścaiva vivasvāṃśca aṅgirā bhṛgureva ca / elāpatrastathā sarpaḥ śaṅkhapālāśca tāvubhau
verses.translation: The sun releases heat energy during the summer. He scatters rain during the rainy season and snow (during winter). He is the maker of day and night. He keeps up his movement in accordance with (the changing) seasons and gratifies the Devos, the Pitrs and the human beings with the rays suitably adapted.
verses.hindi: गया था और फिर वह उस नमंदा के जल में सव वाहनों और सक के सहित उतर गया था ।३५। भूख और प्यास से उत्पीड़ित राजा ने -उ' जल में अवगाहन किया था और उस नदी के परम शीतल जल में स्तान, किया था और उसका पान भी किया था ।३६। अपनी समस्त सेना के सहित
verses.wordMeaning: The sun releases heat energy during the summer. He scatters rain during the rainy season and snow (during winter). He is the maker of day and night. He keeps up his movement in accordance with (the changing) seasons and gratifies the Devos,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun releases heat energy during the summer. He scatters rain during the rainy season and snow (during winter). He is the maker of day and night. He keeps up his movement in accordance with (the changing) seasons and gratifies the Devos,…

verses.sanskrit: विश्वावसूग्रसेनौ च श्वेतश्चैवारुणस्तथा । प्रम्लोचा इति विख्यातानुम्लोचेति च ते उभे
verses.transliteration: viśvāvasūgrasenau ca śvetaścaivāruṇastathā / pramlocā iti vikhyātānumloceti ca te ubhe
verses.translation: By means of the (ray) named Susumna, the sun develops the m(x>n in the bright iinlf day by day ami makes it complete (on the full moon day). He propitiates the Devas by means of the nectar. Tlic Devas imbibe it during the dark half.
verses.hindi: राजा ने उसके जल के भीतर खतर कर बहुत काल पर्यन्त विशेष रूप से. जल-क्रीड़ा- की थी तथा परम स्वादिष्ट शुक्र विस क तन्तुओं का अशन भी. किया था ।४०। जब सूर्यदेव आलम्बने हो गये थे तो सब अनुचरों और
verses.wordMeaning: By means of the (ray) named Susumna, the sun develops the m(x>n in the bright iinlf day by day ami makes it complete (on the full moon day). He propitiates the Devas by means of the nectar. Tlic Devas imbibe it during the dark half.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of the (ray) named Susumna, the sun develops the m(x>n in the bright iinlf day by day ami makes it complete (on the full moon day). He propitiates the Devas by means of the nectar. Tlic Devas imbibe it during the dark half.

verses.sanskrit: यातुधानस्तदा सर्पो व्याघ्रश्चव तु तावुभौ । नभोनभस्ययोरेष गाणो वसति भास्करे
verses.transliteration: yātudhānastadā sarpo vyāghraścava tu tāvubhau / nabhonabhasyayoreṣa gāṇo vasati bhāskare
verses.translation: Men conquer (satisfy) hunger by means of food- stuffs and beverages and medicinal herbs developed by means of rain, with waters lifted up and released by means of his rays by the sun.
verses.wordMeaning: Men conquer (satisfy) hunger by means of food- stuffs and beverages and medicinal herbs developed by means of rain, with waters lifted up and released by means of his rays by the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men conquer (satisfy) hunger by means of food- stuffs and beverages and medicinal herbs developed by means of rain, with waters lifted up and released by means of his rays by the sun.

verses.sanskrit: शरद्यन्याः पुनः शुभ्रा वसंति मुनिदेवताः पर्जन्यश्चैव पूषा च भारद्वाजः सगौतमः
verses.transliteration: śaradyanyāḥ punaḥ śubhrā vasaṃti munidevatāḥ parjanyaścaiva pūṣā ca bhāradvājaḥ sagautamaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the sun traverses the quarters by means of his swift chariot with one wheel. The horses arc splendid but they do not have the usual pace* (? Ahamail ).
verses.hindi: सैनिकों सहित राजा ने तख्वरों के समूह से मण्डित उस शरिता के तट पर विश्वास क्रिया था। फिर उन विन्ध्याचल के गहन वन से अपने नगर में जाने के लिये राजा निकल दिया था। वहाँ से गमन करते हुए ही उसने नर्मदा के तट पर समाध्ित एक आश्रम का दर्शन दिया था १४१-४२।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sun traverses the quarters by means of his swift chariot with one wheel. The horses arc splendid but they do not have the usual pace* (? Ahamail ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sun traverses the quarters by means of his swift chariot with one wheel. The horses arc splendid but they do not have the usual pace* (? Ahamail ).

verses.sanskrit: परावसुश्च गन्धर्वस्तथैव सुरुचिश्च यः । विश्वाची च घृताची च उभे ते शुभलक्षणे
verses.transliteration: parāvasuśca gandharvastathaiva suruciśca yaḥ / viśvācī ca ghṛtācī ca ubhe te śubhalakṣaṇe
verses.translation: In the course of a day and night, the sun traverses the earth consisting of the seven continents and oceans by means of his chariot with a single wheel.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of a day and night, the sun traverses the earth consisting of the seven continents and oceans by means of his chariot with a single wheel.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of a day and night, the sun traverses the earth consisting of the seven continents and oceans by means of his chariot with a single wheel.

verses.sanskrit: नाग एरावतश्चैव विश्रुतश्च धनञ्जयः । श्चेनजिच्च सुषेणश्च सेनीर्ग्राम णीश्च तौ
verses.transliteration: nāga erāvataścaiva viśrutaśca dhanañjayaḥ / ścenajicca suṣeṇaśca senīrgrāma ṇīśca tau
verses.translation: Surrounded by Valakhilyas, they wander both night and day. The sun is cultised by great sages by means of words (and prayers) of the highest order and composed by themselves.
verses.hindi: उपेत्य मुनिणादू ल॑ ननाम शिरसा नूपः।
verses.wordMeaning: Surrounded by Valakhilyas, they wander both night and day. The sun is cultised by great sages by means of words (and prayers) of the highest order and composed by themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surrounded by Valakhilyas, they wander both night and day. The sun is cultised by great sages by means of words (and prayers) of the highest order and composed by themselves.

verses.sanskrit: आपो वातश्च द्वावेतौ यातुधानावुदाहृतौ । वसंत्येते तु वै सूर्ये सदैवाश्विनकर्तिके
verses.transliteration: āpo vātaśca dvāvetau yātudhānāvudāhṛtau / vasaṃtyete tu vai sūrye sadaivāśvinakartike
verses.translation: The chariot of Soma (the Moon) has three wheels.* His horses have the lustre of Kunda (white Jasmine) flowers. They are ten in number and they are yoked to the lefl as well as to the right. The moon traverses by means of this.
verses.hindi: संभावयित्वा तां पूजां विहितां मुनिना तदा
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot of Soma (the Moon) has three wheels.* His horses have the lustre of Kunda (white Jasmine) flowers. They are ten in number and they are yoked to the lefl as well as to the right. The moon traverses by means of this.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot of Soma (the Moon) has three wheels.* His horses have the lustre of Kunda (white Jasmine) flowers. They are ten in number and they are yoked to the lefl as well as to the right. The moon traverses by means of this.

verses.sanskrit: हैमन्तिकौ तु द्वौ मासौ वसंति च दिवाकरे । अंशो भगश्च द्वावैतौ कश्यपश्य क्रतुश्च ह
verses.transliteration: haimantikau tu dvau māsau vasaṃti ca divākare / aṃśo bhagaśca dvāvaitau kaśyapaśya kratuśca ha
verses.translation: They traverse the stars supported by the Viihi (the path of the firmament). They gain velocity by means of the
verses.wordMeaning: They traverse the stars supported by the Viihi (the path of the firmament). They gain velocity by means of the
verses.commentary: Sense: They traverse the stars supported by the Viihi (the path of the firmament). They gain velocity by means of the

verses.sanskrit: भुजङ्गश्च महापद्मः सर्वः कर्केटक स्तथा । चित्रसेनश्च गन्धर्व ऊर्णायुश्चैव तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: bhujaṅgaśca mahāpadmaḥ sarvaḥ karkeṭaka stathā / citrasenaśca gandharva ūrṇāyuścaiva tāvubhau
verses.translation: This verse practically i>eatt V. 42 in different words.
verses.wordMeaning: This verse practically i>eatt V. 42 in different words.
verses.commentary: Sense: This verse practically i>eatt V. 42 in different words.

verses.sanskrit: उर्वशी पूर्वचित्तिश्च तथैवाप्सरसा उभे । तार्क्षश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च सेनानीर् ग्रामणीश्च तौ
verses.transliteration: urvaśī pūrvacittiśca tathaivāpsarasā ubhe / tārkṣaścāriṣṭanemiśca senānīr grāmaṇīśca tau
verses.translation: It should be known that the chariot of the moon has three wheels with horses on cither side. The chariot is born (i.e. evolved] out of the womb of the waters along with the horses and the charioteer.
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the chariot of the moon has three wheels with horses on cither side. The chariot is born (i.e. evolved] out of the womb of the waters along with the horses and the charioteer.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the chariot of the moon has three wheels with horses on cither side. The chariot is born (i.e. evolved] out of the womb of the waters along with the horses and the charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युत्स्फूर्जः शतायुश्च यातुधानावुदात्दृतौ । सहे चैव सहस्ये च वसंत्येते दिवाकरे
verses.transliteration: vidyutsphūrjaḥ śatāyuśca yātudhānāvudātdṛtau / sahe caiva sahasye ca vasaṃtyete divākare
verses.translation: It has three wheels with hundred spokes. It is yoked with ten excellent white horses. Thev arc slim and divine. They arc unimpeded and they have the swiftness of the mind.
verses.wordMeaning: It has three wheels with hundred spokes. It is yoked with ten excellent white horses. Thev arc slim and divine. They arc unimpeded and they have the swiftness of the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has three wheels with hundred spokes. It is yoked with ten excellent white horses. Thev arc slim and divine. They arc unimpeded and they have the swiftness of the mind.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शैशिर योश्चापि मासयोर्निवसंति वै । त्वष्टा विष्णुर्जामदग्न्यो विश्वामित्रस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaiśira yoścāpi māsayornivasaṃti vai / tvaṣṭā viṣṇurjāmadagnyo viśvāmitrastathaiva ca
verses.translation: These (horses) carry the Moon-lord with great dedication (and respect). The moon traverses (its orbit) surrounded by the Devas and the phrs.
verses.hindi: बह एक महान् आत्मा वाले और पुण्यशील जमदग्नि मुनि का आश्रम था । राजा ने वहाँ से लौटकर कुछ दूरी पर अपनी सेनाओं को अब स्थापित कर दिया , था।४३।-अपने साथ में कतिपय परिचारकों को लेकर ही बह उस आश्रम में गया । पुरोहित के सहित ही राजा ने उस परम रम्य आश्रम
verses.wordMeaning: These (horses) carry the Moon-lord with great dedication (and respect). The moon traverses (its orbit) surrounded by the Devas and the phrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: These (horses) carry the Moon-lord with great dedication (and respect). The moon traverses (its orbit) surrounded by the Devas and the phrs.

verses.sanskrit: काद्रवेयौ तथा नागौ कंबलाश्वतरावुभौ । गन्धर्वो धृतराष्ट्रश्च सूर्यवर्चास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kādraveyau tathā nāgau kaṃbalāśvatarāvubhau / gandharvo dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sūryavarcāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: At the end of the dark half and at the beginning of the bright half, when the sun is steady in the opposite direction, the moon is filled up, and as days pass by (the digits arc reinstilled).
verses.hindi: में गेमन किया था ४४। राजा ने वहाँ पर पहुँच कर उस मुनिशोदूँल के चरणों में शिर झुकाकर प्रणाम किया या । जमदस्नि ने उस श्रेष्ठ राजा का आशीर्वचनों के द्वारा अभिनन्दन किया था ।४५। मुभि ने अध्ये-पाद्य और आसनः आदिःके द्वारा उस राजा का अचेन किया था । उस समय. में मुनि
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the dark half and at the beginning of the bright half, when the sun is steady in the opposite direction, the moon is filled up, and as days pass by (the digits arc reinstilled).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the dark half and at the beginning of the bright half, when the sun is steady in the opposite direction, the moon is filled up, and as days pass by (the digits arc reinstilled).

verses.sanskrit: तिलोत्तमा तथा रंभा ब्रह्मापेतश्च राक्षसः । यज्ञापेतम्तथैवान्यो विश्यातो राक्षसो त्तमः
verses.transliteration: tilottamā tathā raṃbhā brahmāpetaśca rākṣasaḥ / yajñāpetamtathaivānyo viśyāto rākṣaso ttamaḥ
verses.translation: When the (nectarine) body of the moon has been imbibed by the Devas, it becomes exhausted on the fifteenth
verses.hindi: के द्वारा की हुई पूजा को स्वीकार किम्रा था ।८६। फिर राजा उन महामुनि के सामने परम शुत्र आसन परे विराजमान हो गया था ।: जब राजा अपने:
verses.wordMeaning: When the (nectarine) body of the moon has been imbibed by the Devas, it becomes exhausted on the fifteenth
verses.commentary: Sense: When the (nectarine) body of the moon has been imbibed by the Devas, it becomes exhausted on the fifteenth

verses.sanskrit: ऋतजित्सत्यजिच्चैव गन्धर्वौं समुदाहृतौ । तपस्तपस्ययोः सूर्ये वसंति मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: ṛtajitsatyajiccaiva gandharvauṃ samudāhṛtau / tapastapasyayoḥ sūrye vasaṃti munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: By means of the ray called Susumna (the sun) fills a part (of the moon) (digit by digit) every day. On being replenished thus by the Susumna (ray), the white and bright digits increase.
verses.hindi: आसन पर उपविष्ट हों गये तो ते मुनिवर जमदग्नि एक कुशा के आसन पर संस्थित हो गये थे ।४आ महामुनि ने उस राजा के साथ संलाप करते हुए पुत्र-सित्र और 4५६ ६५४० आदि के विषय में राजा से क्षेम-कुशल पूछा था
verses.wordMeaning: By means of the ray called Susumna (the sun) fills a part (of the moon) (digit by digit) every day. On being replenished thus by the Susumna (ray), the white and bright digits increase.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of the ray called Susumna (the sun) fills a part (of the moon) (digit by digit) every day. On being replenished thus by the Susumna (ray), the white and bright digits increase.

verses.sanskrit: पितृदेवमनुष्यादीन्स सदाप्याययन्प्रभुः । परिवर्त्तत्यहोरात्रकारणं सविता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pitṛdevamanuṣyādīnsa sadāpyāyayanprabhuḥ / parivarttatyahorātrakāraṇaṃ savitā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: During the dark half, the digits become reduced and they are developed (replenished) during the bright half. The moon is thus developed, due to the power of the sun.
verses.hindi: थोड़े ही समय तक स्थित होकर महामुनि ने अपना अतिथि-सत्कार करने के लिए राजा को निमन्त्रित किया था । हसके अनन्तर राजा परम भ्रीतिमात् होकर जमवग्नि मुनि से बोला था ।४६। र:
verses.wordMeaning: During the dark half, the digits become reduced and they are developed (replenished) during the bright half. The moon is thus developed, due to the power of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the dark half, the digits become reduced and they are developed (replenished) during the bright half. The moon is thus developed, due to the power of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: एते देवा वसंत्यर्के द्वौ द्वौ मासौ क्रमेण तु । स्थानाभिमानिनो ह्येते गाणा द्वादशसप्तकाः
verses.transliteration: ete devā vasaṃtyarke dvau dvau māsau krameṇa tu / sthānābhimānino hyete gāṇā dvādaśasaptakāḥ
verses.translation: On the full Moon day, it appears bright in a com¬ plete disc. In the bright half, the moon is thus fully replenished
verses.wordMeaning: On the full Moon day, it appears bright in a com¬ plete disc. In the bright half, the moon is thus fully replenished
verses.commentary: Sense: On the full Moon day, it appears bright in a com¬ plete disc. In the bright half, the moon is thus fully replenished

verses.sanskrit: सुर्यस्याप्याययन्त्येते तेजसा तेज उत्तममा । ग्रथितैः स्वैर्वचोभिश्च स्तुवन्ति ह्यृषयो रविम्
verses.transliteration: suryasyāpyāyayantyete tejasā teja uttamamā / grathitaiḥ svairvacobhiśca stuvanti hyṛṣayo ravim
verses.translation: On being imbibed gradually by the Pitrs and the Devas at the beginning of the dark half, the digits of the moon which face the sun become reduced gradually.
verses.wordMeaning: On being imbibed gradually by the Pitrs and the Devas at the beginning of the dark half, the digits of the moon which face the sun become reduced gradually.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being imbibed gradually by the Pitrs and the Devas at the beginning of the dark half, the digits of the moon which face the sun become reduced gradually.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव गीतनृत्यैरुपासते । ग्रामणीयक्षभूतानि कुर्वते ऽभीषुसंग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvāpsarasaścaiva gītanṛtyairupāsate / grāmaṇīyakṣabhūtāni kurvate 'bhīṣusaṃgraham
verses.translation: Thirtythrcc, three hundred (?) and three and three thousand and three Devas imbibe {the juice of) the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: Thirtythrcc, three hundred (?) and three and three thousand and three Devas imbibe {the juice of) the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirtythrcc, three hundred (?) and three and three thousand and three Devas imbibe {the juice of) the moon.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पा वहन्ति वै सूर्यं यातुधानास्तु यान्ति च । वालखिल्या नंयत्यस्तं परिवार्योदयाद्रविम्
verses.transliteration: sarpā vahanti vai sūryaṃ yātudhānāstu yānti ca / vālakhilyā naṃyatyastaṃ parivāryodayādravim
verses.translation: On being sucked thus, tht black digits of the moon increase. Hence, the white digits become reduced and the dark ones become increased.
verses.hindi: इत्येवमुक्तः स मुनिस्तं श्राह स्थीयतां क्षणम् ॥ ५३.
verses.wordMeaning: On being sucked thus, tht black digits of the moon increase. Hence, the white digits become reduced and the dark ones become increased.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being sucked thus, tht black digits of the moon increase. Hence, the white digits become reduced and the dark ones become increased.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषामेव देवानां यथावीर्यं यथातपः । यथाधर्मं यथायोगं यथासत्यं यथाबलम्
verses.transliteration: eteṣāmeva devānāṃ yathāvīryaṃ yathātapaḥ / yathādharmaṃ yathāyogaṃ yathāsatyaṃ yathābalam
verses.translation: The nectar of Svadha oozes from its rays on the New Moon day. After drinking that Svadha for their own satisfac* don (to the full) for the period of a month, those (Pitrs) go away.
verses.wordMeaning: The nectar of Svadha oozes from its rays on the New Moon day. After drinking that Svadha for their own satisfac* don (to the full) for the period of a month, those (Pitrs) go away.
verses.commentary: Sense: The nectar of Svadha oozes from its rays on the New Moon day. After drinking that Svadha for their own satisfac* don (to the full) for the period of a month, those (Pitrs) go away.

verses.sanskrit: तपत्यसौ तश्रा सूर्य एषामिन्द्रस्तु तेजसा । इत्येते निवसंतीह द्वौ द्वौ मासौ दिवाकरे
verses.transliteration: tapatyasau taśrā sūrya eṣāmindrastu tejasā / ityete nivasaṃtīha dvau dvau māsau divākare
verses.translation: They arc of three (varieties), the Saumyas, the Barhisads and the Agnisvattas. Those who are mendoned as Kavyas are all Picp.
verses.wordMeaning: They arc of three (varieties), the Saumyas, the Barhisads and the Agnisvattas. Those who are mendoned as Kavyas are all Picp.
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc of three (varieties), the Saumyas, the Barhisads and the Agnisvattas. Those who are mendoned as Kavyas are all Picp.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वाः पन्नगाप्सरसां गणाः । ग्रामण्यश्च तथा यक्षा यातुधानाश्च मुख्यशः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo devagandharvāḥ pannagāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ / grāmaṇyaśca tathā yakṣā yātudhānāśca mukhyaśaḥ
verses.translation: The Kavyas are Saiiivatsaras, chose who are remem- be red by the Brahmanas as PaiUdbdAs (the five years). Saumyaa should be known as the tus and Barhisads are remembered as the Mdsas (Months).
verses.wordMeaning: The Kavyas are Saiiivatsaras, chose who are remem- be red by the Brahmanas as PaiUdbdAs (the five years). Saumyaa should be known as the tus and Barhisads are remembered as the Mdsas (Months).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kavyas are Saiiivatsaras, chose who are remem- be red by the Brahmanas as PaiUdbdAs (the five years). Saumyaa should be known as the tus and Barhisads are remembered as the Mdsas (Months).

verses.sanskrit: एते तपन्ति वर्षन्ति भान्ति वान्ति सृजन्ति च । भूतानां चशुभं कर्म व्यपोहन्ति प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: ete tapanti varṣanti bhānti vānti sṛjanti ca / bhūtānāṃ caśubhaṃ karma vyapohanti prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: The increase and decrease of the moon arc remembered (as occurring) on the sixteenth day at the beginning of a fort¬ night* It is thus that the increase and decrease in the moon occur on account of the sun.
verses.hindi: हैहयेश्वर राजा ने महामुनि से प्रार्थना की थी कि है महर्षे ! आप मुझे अपनी आज्ञा दीजिए । मैं अबःअपने पुर को गमन करूंगा । है'महा- मुने! कारण यह हैं कि मेरे साथ समस्तः सेनाएँ वाइन भी हैं ।५०। इस वन: में वन्य फल मूलों का अशनः करने वाले आपके द्वारा आतिध्य नहीं किया
verses.wordMeaning: The increase and decrease of the moon arc remembered (as occurring) on the sixteenth day at the beginning of a fort¬ night* It is thus that the increase and decrease in the moon occur on account of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The increase and decrease of the moon arc remembered (as occurring) on the sixteenth day at the beginning of a fort¬ night* It is thus that the increase and decrease in the moon occur on account of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: मानवानां शुभं ह्येते हरन्ते दुरितात्मनाम् । दुरितं सुप्रचाराणां व्यपोहन्ति क्वचि त्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: mānavānāṃ śubhaṃ hyete harante duritātmanām / duritaṃ supracārāṇāṃ vyapohanti kvaci tkvacit
verses.translation: Again (i.e. henceforth), I shall describe the chariots of the stars, planets and Ru.
verses.hindi: जा सकता है । अथवा यह भी हो सकता है कि आप अपनी तपश्चर्या की:
verses.wordMeaning: Again (i.e. henceforth), I shall describe the chariots of the stars, planets and Ru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again (i.e. henceforth), I shall describe the chariots of the stars, planets and Ru.

verses.sanskrit: एते सहैव सूर्येण भ्रमन्ति दिवासानुगाः । वर्षन्तश्च तपन्तश्च ह्लादयन्तश्च वै प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: ete sahaiva sūryeṇa bhramanti divāsānugāḥ / varṣantaśca tapantaśca hlādayantaśca vai prajāḥ
verses.translation: Riding in a chariot of black steel (iron) fitted with stroi horses born of the firmament, the Saturn proceeds ahead very slowly.
verses.wordMeaning: Riding in a chariot of black steel (iron) fitted with stroi horses born of the firmament, the Saturn proceeds ahead very slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Riding in a chariot of black steel (iron) fitted with stroi horses born of the firmament, the Saturn proceeds ahead very slowly.

verses.sanskrit: गोपायन्ति च भूतानि सर्वाणीहामनुक्षयात् । स्थानाभिमानिनामेतत्स्थानं मन्वन्तरेषु वै
verses.transliteration: gopāyanti ca bhūtāni sarvāṇīhāmanukṣayāt / sthānābhimānināmetatsthānaṃ manvantareṣu vai
verses.translation: All of them are fastened to Dhruva by means of gaseous rays. They are fully developed. While whirling duly they blaze as well.
verses.hindi: शक्ति से मेरा आतिस्य- करने-की सामथ्ये रखते हैं तो भी यह उचित नहीं है और आप मुझे मेरी नगरों की ओर गमन करने की आज्ञा देने के योग्य हैं। अन्य प्रकार से अर्थात् यदि मैं ठहर भी जाऊ तो है मुनि श्रेष्ठ ! ये सैनिक बड़े ही दुष्ट स्वभाव'वाले हैं। इनके द्वारा तपस्वियों के नियमों क्षय
verses.wordMeaning: All of them are fastened to Dhruva by means of gaseous rays. They are fully developed. While whirling duly they blaze as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them are fastened to Dhruva by means of gaseous rays. They are fully developed. While whirling duly they blaze as well.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागतानां च वर्त्तन्ते सांप्रतं च ये । एवं वसंति वै सूर्ये सप्तकास्ते चतुर्दश । चतुर्दशसु सर्वेषु गणा मन्वन्तरेष्विह
verses.transliteration: atītānāgatānāṃ ca varttante sāṃprataṃ ca ye / evaṃ vasaṃti vai sūrye saptakāste caturdaśa / caturdaśasu sarveṣu gaṇā manvantareṣviha
verses.translation: (Repetition) They arc fully developed due to invisible gaseous rays. Being bound (to Dhruva) by means of these, the moon, the sun and the planets revolve in the firmament.
verses.hindi: करने वाली बडृत ही अधिक आप-लोगों को पीड़ा हो जायगी ।५१। वसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--इस तरह से जब राजा के द्वारा मुनिवर से कहा गया-था:तो उन मंहामुनिने राजा से कहा था किआप कुछ क्षण के लिए यहाँ पर विराजमान तो रहिए ।१२-५३। मैं आपका समस्त. अनुगामियों के ही सहित
verses.wordMeaning: (Repetition) They arc fully developed due to invisible gaseous rays. Being bound (to Dhruva) by means of these, the moon, the sun and the planets revolve in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Repetition) They arc fully developed due to invisible gaseous rays. Being bound (to Dhruva) by means of these, the moon, the sun and the planets revolve in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे च वर्षासु च मुञ्चमानो घर्मं हिमं वर्ष दिनं निशां च । गच्छत्यसावृतुवशात्परिवृत्तरश्मिर्देवान् पितॄ#ंश्च मनुजांश्च हि तर्पयन्वै
verses.transliteration: grīṣme ca varṣāsu ca muñcamāno gharmaṃ himaṃ varṣa dinaṃ niśāṃ ca / gacchatyasāvṛtuvaśātparivṛttaraśmirdevān pitṝ#ṃśca manujāṃśca hi tarpayanvai
verses.translation: There are as many bonds of gaseous rays as there are stars. All of them arc fastened to Dhruva. They whirl them¬ selves and they make others also revolve.
verses.hindi: पूरा आतिथ्य सत्कार'सम्पन्न कर दूंगा । इतना राजा से कहकर उस महा- मुनि ने दोरधी घेनु -को श्रुलाकर उससे कहा था कि यह राजा आज मेरे अतिथि के स्वरूप में समागत हो-गये हैं ।५४। जब यह-यहाँ पर समागत हो गये हैं. तो इसी कारण मे . आप इनका आज पूर्णतया सत्कार करिए । इस
verses.wordMeaning: There are as many bonds of gaseous rays as there are stars. All of them arc fastened to Dhruva. They whirl them¬ selves and they make others also revolve.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are as many bonds of gaseous rays as there are stars. All of them arc fastened to Dhruva. They whirl them¬ selves and they make others also revolve.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीणाति देवानमृतेन सूर्यः सोमं सुषुम्णेन च वर्द्धयित्वा । शुक्ले तु पूर्णं दिवसक्रमेण तं कृष्णपक्षे विबुधाः पिबन्ति
verses.transliteration: prīṇāti devānamṛtena sūryaḥ somaṃ suṣumṇena ca varddhayitvā / śukle tu pūrṇaṃ divasakrameṇa taṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe vibudhāḥ pibanti
verses.translation: Just as the oil-rollers whirl and cause the wheel also to whirl so also do the luminaries fixed (to Dhruva) on all sides by means of gaseous rays.
verses.hindi: रीति से मुनि के द्वारा कही हुई उस बोगधरी जे महामुनि के गौरब के,कारण पूर्णरूप से राजा का आतिथेय किया-था ओर जो-जो भी राजा के आतिथ्य के योग्य पदार्थ थे वे सभी बहुत शीघ्र दोहन करके उपस्थित कर विये थे ।५५। इसके अनन्तर उस सुरभि के प्रभाव से उस श्रेष्ठ मुनि का आश्रम
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the oil-rollers whirl and cause the wheel also to whirl so also do the luminaries fixed (to Dhruva) on all sides by means of gaseous rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the oil-rollers whirl and cause the wheel also to whirl so also do the luminaries fixed (to Dhruva) on all sides by means of gaseous rays.

verses.sanskrit: पीतं च सोमं हि कलावशिष्टं कृष्णक्षये रश्मिभिरक्षरन्तम् । सुधामृतं तत्पितरः पिबन्ति देवाश्च सौम्याश्च तथैव काव्याः
verses.transliteration: pītaṃ ca somaṃ hi kalāvaśiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇakṣaye raśmibhirakṣarantam / sudhāmṛtaṃ tatpitaraḥ pibanti devāśca saumyāśca tathaiva kāvyāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the group of planets attached to Dhruva, moves about. This Gangetic porpoise and Dhruva should be known as made up of constellations in the firmament.
verses.hindi: सुरराज के सद्म के समान वैभवों के अनेक भेदों के द्वारा ऐसा. न सोचने के योग्य स्वरूप वाला हो गया था कि जो अन्य किसी के भी द्वारा साध्य नहीं हो सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the group of planets attached to Dhruva, moves about. This Gangetic porpoise and Dhruva should be known as made up of constellations in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the group of planets attached to Dhruva, moves about. This Gangetic porpoise and Dhruva should be known as made up of constellations in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्येण गोभिश्च समुज्झिताभिरद्भिः पुनश्चैव समुद्धृताभिः । वृष्ट्याभिवृद्धाभिरथौषधीभिर्मर्त्याः क्षुधं त्वन्नपानैर्जयन्ति
verses.transliteration: sūryeṇa gobhiśca samujjhitābhiradbhiḥ punaścaiva samuddhṛtābhiḥ / vṛṣṭyābhivṛddhābhirathauṣadhībhirmartyāḥ kṣudhaṃ tvannapānairjayanti
verses.translation: On the top of the Meru Mountain, single-handed he whirls when he pulls them with face down. He observes Mcru at the border and circumambulates it.
verses.wordMeaning: On the top of the Meru Mountain, single-handed he whirls when he pulls them with face down. He observes Mcru at the border and circumambulates it.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the top of the Meru Mountain, single-handed he whirls when he pulls them with face down. He observes Mcru at the border and circumambulates it.

verses.sanskrit: तृप्तिश्च शुक्ले सुधया सुराणां पक्षे च कृष्णे सुधया पितणाम् । अन्नेन शश्वच्च दधाति मर्त्यान्सुर्यस्तपंस्तान्सुबिभर्त्ति गोभिः
verses.transliteration: tṛptiśca śukle sudhayā surāṇāṃ pakṣe ca kṛṣṇe sudhayā pitaṇām / annena śaśvacca dadhāti martyānsuryastapaṃstānsubibhartti gobhiḥ
verses.translation: What has been described in details by your honour is about the abodes. Now describe to us how may be the abodes cf gods and how arc the luminaries. When this universe rema ned in the form of alt the original (Elements )and the specific particularities (distinc¬
verses.hindi: काँस्यारकूटारसता ञ्रहे मदुर णेसौघो पलदारुमृदिभिः.। पृथग्विमिश्रेभंवने रनेकीः सद्भासितं नेत्रमनो भिरामैः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: What has been described in details by your honour is about the abodes. Now describe to us how may be the abodes cf gods and how arc the luminaries. When this universe rema ned in the form of alt the original (Elements )and the specific particularities (distinc¬
verses.commentary: Sense: What has been described in details by your honour is about the abodes. Now describe to us how may be the abodes cf gods and how arc the luminaries. When this universe rema ned in the form of alt the original (Elements )and the specific particularities (distinc¬

verses.sanskrit: ह्रियन्हरिस्तैर्हरिभिस्तुरङ्गमैर्हरत्यथापः किरणैर्हरिद्भिः । विसर्गकाले विसृजंश्च ताः पुनर्बिभर्त्ति शश्वत्सविता चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: hriyanharistairharibhisturaṅgamairharatyathāpaḥ kiraṇairharidbhiḥ / visargakāle visṛjaṃśca tāḥ punarbibhartti śaśvatsavitā carācaram
verses.translation: The fires born of water arc three, viz.: Vaidyut (Lightening) Jdfhara (gastric) and Saura (Solar). It is on account of this, that the sun blazes in the heaven after drinking water by means of his rays.
verses.wordMeaning: The fires born of water arc three, viz.: Vaidyut (Lightening) Jdfhara (gastric) and Saura (Solar). It is on account of this, that the sun blazes in the heaven after drinking water by means of his rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fires born of water arc three, viz.: Vaidyut (Lightening) Jdfhara (gastric) and Saura (Solar). It is on account of this, that the sun blazes in the heaven after drinking water by means of his rays.

verses.sanskrit: हरिर्हरिद्भिर्ह्रि यते तुरङ्गमैः पिबत्यथापो हरिभिः सहस्रधा । ततः प्रमुञ्चत्यपि तास्त्वसौ हरिः समूह्यमानो हरिभिस्तुरङ्गमैः
verses.transliteration: harirharidbhirhri yate turaṅgamaiḥ pibatyathāpo haribhiḥ sahasradhā / tataḥ pramuñcatyapi tāstvasau hariḥ samūhyamāno haribhisturaṅgamaiḥ
verses.translation: The (fire) Vdrfya (originating from Var,\d or rain) contained in lighten ng, does not become cool by means of water. The fire that abides within the stomach of human beings does not become cool by means of water. Hence, the solar fire, the Vaidyuta fire and the gastric fire are fires that have water for their fuel.
verses.hindi: वलभ्यलिंदांगणचारुतो रणैरदध्रपर्यंतचतुष्किकादिभिः कुड्येषु संशोभित दिव्यरत्नेविचित्रचित्रे: परिशोभमाने: ।
verses.wordMeaning: The (fire) Vdrfya (originating from Var,\d or rain) contained in lighten ng, does not become cool by means of water. The fire that abides within the stomach of human beings does not become cool by means of water. Hence, the solar fire,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The (fire) Vdrfya (originating from Var,\d or rain) contained in lighten ng, does not become cool by means of water. The fire that abides within the stomach of human beings does not become cool by means of water. Hence, the solar fire,…

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष एकचक्रेण सूर्यस्तूर्णरथेन तु । भद्रैस्तैरक्रमैरश्वैः स्पन्दने वैदिकक्षयः
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa ekacakreṇa sūryastūrṇarathena tu / bhadraistairakramairaśvaiḥ spandane vaidikakṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The irmatkya fire (i.e. the fire produced by churn¬ ing or friction) has wood for its fuel. That fire is brought under control by means of water.
verses.wordMeaning: The irmatkya fire (i.e. the fire produced by churn¬ ing or friction) has wood for its fuel. That fire is brought under control by means of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The irmatkya fire (i.e. the fire produced by churn¬ ing or friction) has wood for its fuel. That fire is brought under control by means of water.

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्राद्रथेनासावेकचक्रेण वै भ्रमन् । सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रान्तां सप्तभिः सप्तभिर्हयैः
verses.transliteration: ahorātrādrathenāsāvekacakreṇa vai bhraman / saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ saptabhiḥ saptabhirhayaiḥ
verses.translation: (The same is the case with) the fire without heat that is in the zone (of the sun). It is white and it illuminates. When the sun sets, the day enters waters. Hence, during the night, the waters are seen white (and sparkling).
verses.wordMeaning: (The same is the case with) the fire without heat that is in the zone (of the sun). It is white and it illuminates. When the sun sets, the day enters waters. Hence, during the night, the waters are seen white (and sparkling).
verses.commentary: Sense: (The same is the case with) the fire without heat that is in the zone (of the sun). It is white and it illuminates. When the sun sets, the day enters waters. Hence, during the night, the waters are seen white (and sparkling).

verses.sanskrit: छन्दोभिरश्वरूपैस्तैर्यतश्चक्रं ततः स्थितैः । कामरूपैः सकृद्युक्तैर्वामतस्तैर्मनोजवैः
verses.transliteration: chandobhiraśvarūpaistairyataścakraṃ tataḥ sthitaiḥ / kāmarūpaiḥ sakṛdyuktairvāmatastairmanojavaiḥ
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: हरितैख्ययैः पिङ्गैरीश्वरैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः । त्र्यशीतिमण्डलशतं भ्रमन्त्यब्देन ते हयाः
verses.transliteration: haritaikhyayaiḥ piṅgairīśvarairbrahmavādibhiḥ / tryaśītimaṇḍalaśataṃ bhramantyabdena te hayāḥ
verses.translation: This tabular statement shows the monthwise distribution of the The sun infuses strength in the medicinal herbs; he makes the (stronger) by means of Svsdha; he infuses nectar in the Devas. Thus he gives three things to the three.
verses.hindi: अब सुरभि की महिमा के आश्रम की जेसी परम विशाल शोभा हुई
verses.wordMeaning: This tabular statement shows the monthwise distribution of the The sun infuses strength in the medicinal herbs; he makes the (stronger) by means of Svsdha; he infuses nectar in the Devas. Thus he gives three things to the three.
verses.commentary: Sense: This tabular statement shows the monthwise distribution of the The sun infuses strength in the medicinal herbs; he makes the (stronger) by means of Svsdha; he infuses nectar in the Devas. Thus he gives three things to the three.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं चैव मण्डलं दिवसक्रमात् । कल्पादौ संप्र युक्तास्ते वहन्त्याभूतसंप्लवात्
verses.transliteration: bāhyamābhyantaraṃ caiva maṇḍalaṃ divasakramāt / kalpādau saṃpra yuktāste vahantyābhūtasaṃplavāt
verses.translation: In this manner the thousand rays of the sun achieve the requisite things of the people of the world. They differ inas¬ much as they exude snow, rain or hot rays.
verses.hindi: थी उसकी छटा का वर्णन किया जाता है--उस आश्रम के अन्दर का भाग नाना भाँति के रत्नों की देदीप्यमान ति से विचित्र हो गया था और सुवर्णं के चाकविक्य से संयुत प्रकाश माला से घिरा हुआ था तथा पूर्ण चन्द्र के समान परम शुञ्र और अत्युच्च अन्तरिक्ष को छूने वाली शिखरों से
verses.wordMeaning: In this manner the thousand rays of the sun achieve the requisite things of the people of the world. They differ inas¬ much as they exude snow, rain or hot rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner the thousand rays of the sun achieve the requisite things of the people of the world. They differ inas¬ much as they exude snow, rain or hot rays.

verses.sanskrit: आवृत्ता वालखिल्यैस्ते भ्रमन्ते रात्र्यहानि तु । वचोभिरग्र्यैर्ग्रथितैः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: āvṛttā vālakhilyaiste bhramante rātryahāni tu / vacobhiragryairgrathitaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: All these, viz. the moon, the stars and the planets should be known as originating from the sun. The moon is the lord of all stars and the sun is the king of planets. The remaining flve planets should be known as gods moving about as they please.
verses.hindi: समग्बित आसादों से चारों ओर, परिपूर्ण वह आलम हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: All these, viz. the moon, the stars and the planets should be known as originating from the sun. The moon is the lord of all stars and the sun is the king of planets. The remaining flve planets should be known as gods moving about as they please.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these, viz. the moon, the stars and the planets should be known as originating from the sun. The moon is the lord of all stars and the sun is the king of planets. The remaining flve planets should be known as gods moving about as they please.

verses.sanskrit: सेव्यते गीतनृत्यैश्च गन्धर्वैश्चाप्सरोगणैः । पतङ्गैः पतगैरश्वैर्भ्रममाणो दिवस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: sevyate gītanṛtyaiśca gandharvaiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ / pataṅgaiḥ patagairaśvairbhramamāṇo divaspatiḥ
verses.translation: Understand the sources of origin of the remaining planets being described well. Skanda, the commander-in-chief of the army of the Devas, is cited as the planet Angaraka (the Mars).
verses.hindi: काँस्य-आरक़ेर-ताञऋ-हेम-सुर्वेण सौधोपल-दारु और मृत्तिका के -पृथक् और मिञ्तित नेश्रों तथा मन को परम अभिराम प्रतीत होने वाले अनेक भवनों से बह आस्म समुद्भासित हो गया था ।५८ उस महामुनि का बह आस्म उस समय में महा मूल्यवान रत्नों से समुज्ज्वल था और हेम की
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the sources of origin of the remaining planets being described well. Skanda, the commander-in-chief of the army of the Devas, is cited as the planet Angaraka (the Mars).
