verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the sources of origin of the remaining planets being described well. Skanda, the commander-in-chief of the army of the Devas, is cited as the planet Angaraka (the Mars).

verses.sanskrit: रथास्त्रचक्रःसोमस्य कुदाभास्तस्य वाजिनः । वामदक्षिणतो युक्ता दश तेन चरन्त्यसौ
verses.transliteration: rathāstracakraḥsomasya kudābhāstasya vājinaḥ / vāmadakṣiṇato yuktā daśa tena carantyasau
verses.translation: W.41-42 give the ursdibooa] seasonwlse colours or complexioai of the luQ. The existence and non-existence of the worlds have formerly emanated from the sun. The plant that should be understood by the whole universe, O, Br&hmanas, is the brilliant sun of great lustre.
verses.hindi: वेदिका-निष्कुट-सोपान-कुटी और बिटंककों से समन्वित था । तुला- कपाट-अगेला-कुझ्य (भीत)-देहली-निशान्तशाला-अजिर (आँगन) की शोभा से बहुत ही बह आश्रम संयुत था ।५९। बलभी-अलिन्द-अञ्जण और परम रम्य तोरणों से युक्त था तथा अदभ्र चतुरिका आदि से विशोभित
verses.wordMeaning: W.41-42 give the ursdibooa] seasonwlse colours or complexioai of the luQ. The existence and non-existence of the worlds have formerly emanated from the sun. The plant that should be understood by the whole universe, O, Br&hmanas, is the brilliant sun of great lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.41-42 give the ursdibooa] seasonwlse colours or complexioai of the luQ. The existence and non-existence of the worlds have formerly emanated from the sun. The plant that should be understood by the whole universe, O, Br&hmanas, is the brilliant sun of great lustre.

verses.sanskrit: वीथ्याश्रयाणि ऋक्षाणि ध्रुवाधारेण वेगिताः । ह्रासवृद्धी तथैवास्य रश्मीनां सूर्यवत्स्मृते
verses.transliteration: vīthyāśrayāṇi ṛkṣāṇi dhruvādhāreṇa vegitāḥ / hrāsavṛddhī tathaivāsya raśmīnāṃ sūryavatsmṛte
verses.translation: He scorches the three worlds iaclusive of the mobile and immobile beings, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: चा । उस आस्म में जो स्तम्म बने हुए ये उनमें और जो दीवालें थीं उनमें परिशोभ्रमान दिव्य रत्नों कै विचित्र चित्र विद्यमान थे। इनसे उस आश्रम की अद्भुत शोभा हो रही थी ।६०। वह महामुनि का आश्रम छोटे व कीमती श्रेष्ठ रत्नों से युक्त था और उसमें अत्यद्भूत सुवर्ण के अनेक सिंहासन और
verses.wordMeaning: He scorches the three worlds iaclusive of the mobile and immobile beings, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He scorches the three worlds iaclusive of the mobile and immobile beings, O excellent Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिचक्रोभयतो ऽश्वश्च विज्ञेयः शशिनो रथः । अपां गर्णात्समुत्पन्नो रथः साश्वः ससारथिः
verses.transliteration: tricakrobhayato 'śvaśca vijñeyaḥ śaśino rathaḥ / apāṃ garṇātsamutpanno rathaḥ sāśvaḥ sasārathiḥ
verses.translation: After resorting to the excellent path of the wind, he gives heat to this entire universe by means of his rays, at the sides, above and below, nay, at all sides. The most excellent among the thousand rays of the sun cited by me before, are the seven rays that are the sources of origin of the planets.
verses.hindi: पीठिका आदि निर्मित थे । उस आश्रम के एक देश में भक्य और भोज्य- लेहा-चोष्य आदि अशनोपयोगी पदार्थ वत्तोमान थे तथा अन्न-्पानों से समुपेत भाण्ड भी वहाँ पर विद्यमान ओ ।६१।.उसमें ऐसे अनेक गृह बने हए थे जो देवों के लायक सब प्रकार की नयनों और मन के परम रमणीक
verses.wordMeaning: After resorting to the excellent path of the wind, he gives heat to this entire universe by means of his rays, at the sides, above and below, nay, at all sides. The most excellent among the thousand rays of the sun cited by me before,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After resorting to the excellent path of the wind, he gives heat to this entire universe by means of his rays, at the sides, above and below, nay, at all sides. The most excellent among the thousand rays of the sun cited by me before,…

verses.sanskrit: शतारैश्च त्रिभिश्चक्रैर्युक्तः शुक्लैर्हयोत्तमैः । दशभिस्तु कृशैर्दिव्यैरसंगैस्तैर्मनोजवैः
verses.transliteration: śatāraiśca tribhiścakrairyuktaḥ śuklairhayottamaiḥ / daśabhistu kṛśairdivyairasaṃgaistairmanojavaiḥ
verses.translation: Visvakarman, the ray to the south, right, nur¬ tures Budha(Mercury). Viivairavas the ray to the west, behind, is remembered by learned men as the source of origin of Sukra (the Venus).
verses.hindi: लगने वाली सम्पदा से समन्वित ये। वह मुनि का आश्रम सुरभि की महिमा से मनोहर बन्धुओं से सुन्दर नगर के समान परमशोभित हो रहा
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarman, the ray to the south, right, nur¬ tures Budha(Mercury). Viivairavas the ray to the west, behind, is remembered by learned men as the source of origin of Sukra (the Venus).
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarman, the ray to the south, right, nur¬ tures Budha(Mercury). Viivairavas the ray to the west, behind, is remembered by learned men as the source of origin of Sukra (the Venus).

verses.sanskrit: सकृद्युक्ते रथे तास्मिन्वहन्ते चायुगक्षयात् । संगृहीतरथे तस्मिञ्श्वेतश्चक्षुःश्रवाश्च वै
verses.transliteration: sakṛdyukte rathe tāsminvahante cāyugakṣayāt / saṃgṛhītarathe tasmiñśvetaścakṣuḥśravāśca vai
verses.translation: This U a peculiar way of associating the particular ray of the sun as the source of origin of particular planet: The divine spheres of the sun and the moon are sparkling and white. They are of the form (or full of) of fire and water. They move about in the firmament. They resemble auspicious round pots.
verses.wordMeaning: This U a peculiar way of associating the particular ray of the sun as the source of origin of particular planet: The divine spheres of the sun and the moon are sparkling and white. They are of the form (or full of) of fire and water. They move about in the firmament.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This U a peculiar way of associating the particular ray of the sun as the source of origin of particular planet: The divine spheres of the sun and the moon are sparkling and white. They are of the form (or full of) of fire and water. They move about in the firmament.…

verses.sanskrit: अश्वास्तमेकवर्णस्ते वहन्ते शङ्खवर्चसः । यजुश्चण्डमनाश्चैव वृषो वाजी नरो हयः
verses.transliteration: aśvāstamekavarṇaste vahante śaṅkhavarcasaḥ / yajuścaṇḍamanāścaiva vṛṣo vājī naro hayaḥ
verses.translation: W. 72-77. Our author takes iatercit in popular etymologies. Here are some specimens:
verses.wordMeaning: W. 72-77. Our author takes iatercit in popular etymologies. Here are some specimens:
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 72-77. Our author takes iatercit in popular etymologies. Here are some specimens:

verses.sanskrit: अश्वो गविष्णुर्विख्यातो हंसो व्योमो मृगस्तथा । इत्येते नामभिः सर्वे दश चन्द्रमसो हयाः
verses.transliteration: aśvo gaviṣṇurvikhyāto haṃso vyomo mṛgastathā / ityete nāmabhiḥ sarve daśa candramaso hayāḥ
verses.translation: All the stars enter the Mak,nairas (abodes meant for constellation) and stars. AU these are the luminary abodes of those who are pious-souled and meritorious. These (abodes) have been created by the self-bom lord (Brahma) at the beginning of a Kalpa and they have begun to function since then. These abodes remain till the annihilation of all living beings (at the end of the world).
verses.wordMeaning: All the stars enter the Mak,nairas (abodes meant for constellation) and stars. AU these are the luminary abodes of those who are pious-souled and meritorious.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the stars enter the Mak,nairas (abodes meant for constellation) and stars. AU these are the luminary abodes of those who are pious-souled and meritorious.…

verses.sanskrit: एते चन्द्रमसं देवं वहन्ति सह दीक्षया । देवैः परिवृतः सोमः पितृभिश्चैव गच्छति
verses.transliteration: ete candramasaṃ devaṃ vahanti saha dīkṣayā / devaiḥ parivṛtaḥ somaḥ pitṛbhiścaiva gacchati
verses.translation: Lord 8ukra, belonging to Bhiu clan should be known as the performer of sacrifices on behalf of the Asuras.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord 8ukra, belonging to Bhiu clan should be known as the performer of sacrifices on behalf of the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord 8ukra, belonging to Bhiu clan should be known as the performer of sacrifices on behalf of the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य शुक्लपक्षादौ भास्करे परतः स्थिरे । आपूर्यते परस्यान्ते सततं दिवसक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: somasya śuklapakṣādau bhāskare parataḥ sthire / āpūryate parasyānte satataṃ divasakramāt
verses.translation: These arc mentioned as the abodes and those who occupy the abodes are deities. The abode of Svarbhanu is Tdmasa (dark). It is the abode of those who cause the distress of all living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: These arc mentioned as the abodes and those who occupy the abodes are deities. The abode of Svarbhanu is Tdmasa (dark). It is the abode of those who cause the distress of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: These arc mentioned as the abodes and those who occupy the abodes are deities. The abode of Svarbhanu is Tdmasa (dark). It is the abode of those who cause the distress of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: देवैः पीततनुं सोममाप्याययति नित्यदा । क्षीणं पञ्चदशाहं तु रश्मिनैकेन भास्करः
verses.transliteration: devaiḥ pītatanuṃ somamāpyāyayati nityadā / kṣīṇaṃ pañcadaśāhaṃ tu raśminaikena bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: The diameter and extent of the sphere of Bhargava (the Venus) it laid down as one-sixteenth of that of the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: The diameter and extent of the sphere of Bhargava (the Venus) it laid down as one-sixteenth of that of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diameter and extent of the sphere of Bhargava (the Venus) it laid down as one-sixteenth of that of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: आपूरयन्सुषुम्णेन भागं भागमहःक्रमात् । सुषुम्णाप्यायमानस्य शुक्ला वर्द्धन्ति वै कलाः
verses.transliteration: āpūrayansuṣumṇena bhāgaṃ bhāgamahaḥkramāt / suṣumṇāpyāyamānasya śuklā varddhanti vai kalāḥ
verses.translation: Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one- fourth less than the Venus (i.e. three fourths of its size). The stars and constellations differ in extent from one another by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred and also two hundred Yojanas.
verses.hindi: श्री दसिष्ठजी ने कहा--सन्तुलित महेन्द्र की नगरी के प्रभाव वाले ड्स न मुनिवर की घेनु ने उन गृहों में इसके पश्चात् उनके ही योग्य नर-नारियों के समुदायों की रचना भी कर दी थी ।१। अब जो नारीगणों का निर्माण उस पुर में किया था उनकी वेष-भूषा--रूय माधुर्य--सौन्‍्दर्य
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one- fourth less than the Venus (i.e. three fourths of its size). The stars and constellations differ in extent from one another by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred and also two hundred Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one- fourth less than the Venus (i.e. three fourths of its size). The stars and constellations differ in extent from one another by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred and also two hundred Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्ध्रसंति वै कृष्णे शुक्ले स्वाप्याययन्ति तम् । इत्येवं सूर्यवीर्येण चन्द्रश्चाप्यायितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tasmāddhrasaṃti vai kṛṣṇe śukle svāpyāyayanti tam / ityevaṃ sūryavīryeṇa candraścāpyāyitastataḥ
verses.translation: The spheres of the stars are lesser than the earlier ones. There is no star smaller than the ones with one and a half Yojanas.
verses.wordMeaning: The spheres of the stars are lesser than the earlier ones. There is no star smaller than the ones with one and a half Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The spheres of the stars are lesser than the earlier ones. There is no star smaller than the ones with one and a half Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: पौर्णमास्यां स दृश्येत शुक्लः संपूर्णमण्डलः । एवमाप्यायितः सोमः शुक्ल पक्षे दिनक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: paurṇamāsyāṃ sa dṛśyeta śuklaḥ saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaḥ / evamāpyāyitaḥ somaḥ śukla pakṣe dinakramāt
verses.translation: W. 99*126. These vt the ideas of the aode&t Indians abotit the locations, dimerutons and movements of planets and the heavenly bodies -in the preteletcope days. Of Bh. P. V. 22. 8-17. Three planets among them which orbit very far away and above all are the Saturn, the Jupiter and the Mars. It should be known that they orbit very slowly.
verses.hindi: छटा और कार्ये कुशलता:आदि/का वर्णन किया जाता है--उन नारियों के विचित्र वेष थे और अद्भुत आभरण-प्रसुन-गन्धादि से समखंक्रृत शरीर! थे। तथा के अपने हाबभावों से ससन्वित थीं और उदार चेष्टाए--श्री-- कान्ति और सौन्दर्य आदि गुणगुण से युक्त थीं।२। भन्द स्फुरण करने वाली
verses.wordMeaning: W. 99*126. These vt the ideas of the aode&t Indians abotit the locations, dimerutons and movements of planets and the heavenly bodies -in the preteletcope days. Of Bh. P. V. 22. 8-17. Three planets among them which orbit very far away and above all are the Saturn,…
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 99*126. These vt the ideas of the aode&t Indians abotit the locations, dimerutons and movements of planets and the heavenly bodies -in the preteletcope days. Of Bh. P. V. 22. 8-17. Three planets among them which orbit very far away and above all are the Saturn,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्वितीयाप्रभृति बहुलस्य चतुर्द्दशीम् । अपां सारमयस्येन्दो रसमात्रात्मकस्य तु
verses.transliteration: tato dvitīyāprabhṛti bahulasya caturddaśīm / apāṃ sāramayasyendo rasamātrātmakasya tu
verses.translation: The great planets beneath them are the four fast moving ones, viz. the sun> the moon, the Mercury and the Venus.
verses.hindi: दन्त पंक्ति. की -मरीचियों के जाल से विशेष रूप से द्योतित उनका मुख कमल तथा जिससे उन्होंने चन्द्र की आभा को भी पराजित कर दिया था। उनकी वाणी नूतन यौवन के भार से वल्गुता से संयुत थी तथा प्रेम पूर्वक धीमे कटाओं से संयुक्त उनका निरीक्षण था।३। उनके वदन की प्रजा अत्य-
verses.wordMeaning: The great planets beneath them are the four fast moving ones, viz. the sun> the moon, the Mercury and the Venus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great planets beneath them are the four fast moving ones, viz. the sun> the moon, the Mercury and the Venus.

verses.sanskrit: पिबत्यंबुमयं देवा हृष्टाः सौम्यं स्वधामृतम् । संभृतं त्वर्द्धमासेन ह्यमृतं सूर्यतेजसा
verses.transliteration: pibatyaṃbumayaṃ devā hṛṣṭāḥ saumyaṃ svadhāmṛtam / saṃbhṛtaṃ tvarddhamāsena hyamṛtaṃ sūryatejasā
verses.translation: There are as many croresof stars all round as there are constellations. The movement of these constellations has been duly regulated by god Brahma. Hence, in view of the movements of the luminaries, the sun and the moon set and rise at the same time (every day) during the equinotical days.
verses.hindi: घिक थीं और प्रीति की भाव-भज़ी से वे परम असन्न हृदयों वाली थीं तथा अपने श्ङ्गार में कल्पतरु के परम सुन्दर सुमनों से विभूषित थीं । उनका
verses.wordMeaning: There are as many croresof stars all round as there are constellations. The movement of these constellations has been duly regulated by god Brahma. Hence, in view of the movements of the luminaries,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There are as many croresof stars all round as there are constellations. The movement of these constellations has been duly regulated by god Brahma. Hence, in view of the movements of the luminaries,…

verses.sanskrit: भक्षार्थममृतं सोमः पौर्णमास्यामुपासते । एकां रात्रिं सुरैः सर्वैः पितृभिः सर्षिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: bhakṣārthamamṛtaṃ somaḥ paurṇamāsyāmupāsate / ekāṃ rātriṃ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sarṣibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: In the northern paths, the times of rising and setting are different. During the new moon and full moon, they should be understood as following the circle of luminaries.
verses.hindi: आकृति देवाङ्भना के समान ही थी जिनके कारण वे नारियाँ अतीव रडिजत थीं ।४। तपे हुए सुबणे के कलशों के हीं सहश अत्यधिक सुन्दर-परिपुष्ट उनके दोनों उरोज थे जिनके बहून करने के भार सो उत नारियों का मध्य भाग कुछ नीचे की ओर शुका हुआ था । उन नारियों के श्रेणियों का भार
verses.wordMeaning: In the northern paths, the times of rising and setting are different. During the new moon and full moon, they should be understood as following the circle of luminaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the northern paths, the times of rising and setting are different. During the new moon and full moon, they should be understood as following the circle of luminaries.

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य कृष्णपक्षादौ भास्कराभिमुखस्य तु । प्रक्षीयन्ते पिदृदेवैः पीयमानाः कलाः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: somasya kṛṣṇapakṣādau bhāskarābhimukhasya tu / prakṣīyante pidṛdevaiḥ pīyamānāḥ kalāḥ kramāt
verses.translation: When the sun orbits through the path of the south* ern transit, it docs so beneath all the planets. The Mercury orbits above all the stars. The Venus orbits above the Mercury. The Mars docs so above the Venus and the Jupiter above the Mars.
verses.hindi: ऐसा था कि उसके वहन करने में उनको कुछ खेद होता था और खिन्नता के कारण से परिधित रुधिर से तथा लगे हुए पाबक रस से उनके चरणों का भाग अरुणिमा से संगुत था ।५।केयूर-हार-मणियों के द्वारा विनिर्भित कंकण-सुव्े का कण्ठ सूर और विमल श्रवणों के मूषणों से वे नारियाँ
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun orbits through the path of the south* ern transit, it docs so beneath all the planets. The Mercury orbits above all the stars. The Venus orbits above the Mercury. The Mars docs so above the Venus and the Jupiter above the Mars.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun orbits through the path of the south* ern transit, it docs so beneath all the planets. The Mercury orbits above all the stars. The Venus orbits above the Mercury. The Mars docs so above the Venus and the Jupiter above the Mars.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयश्च त्रिंशतश्चैव त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तथैव च । त्रयश्च त्रिसहस्राश्च देवाः सोमं पिबन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: trayaśca triṃśataścaiva trayastriṃśattathaiva ca / trayaśca trisahasrāśca devāḥ somaṃ pibanti vai
verses.translation: The intervening distance between the stars and the planets high above is two htmdrei thousand Yojanas,
verses.hindi: विभूषित थीं । उनके कुन्तल केशपाशो में परम सुन्दर सुमनों की मालाए" गुथी हुई' थीं और करधनी में लगे हुए घू'घरों की तथा नृपुरों की ध्वनि से वे समायुक्त थीं ।६। आक्ृष्ट रोष की परिसान्त्वना में नर्म (प्रणयालाप)- हास-केली-और प्रिय आलाप करने में-- भाषण और रोष तथा भर्त्सना में
verses.wordMeaning: The intervening distance between the stars and the planets high above is two htmdrei thousand Yojanas,
verses.commentary: Sense: The intervening distance between the stars and the planets high above is two htmdrei thousand Yojanas,

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतैः पीयमानस्य कृष्णा वर्द्धति वै कलाः । क्षीयन्ति तस्माच्छुक्लाश्च कृष्णा आप्याययन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ityetaiḥ pīyamānasya kṛṣṇā varddhati vai kalāḥ / kṣīyanti tasmācchuklāśca kṛṣṇā āpyāyayanti ca
verses.translation: The planets, the moon and the sun orbit in the hrmament with divine splendour. In their regular movement, they duly come into contact with the constellations. The planets, the stars and the sun may be low, high or straight during their mutual contact or when separate, yet they look at the subjects simultaneously.
verses.hindi: दक्ष एवं पार्थिव निजप्रिय धेर्येबन्ध सबके अपहार में कुशल भावों से वे नारियाँ.अपने मन को लगाने-काली शीं
verses.wordMeaning: The planets, the moon and the sun orbit in the hrmament with divine splendour. In their regular movement, they duly come into contact with the constellations. The planets, the stars and the sun may be low, high or straight during their mutual contact or when separate,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The planets, the moon and the sun orbit in the hrmament with divine splendour. In their regular movement, they duly come into contact with the constellations. The planets, the stars and the sun may be low, high or straight during their mutual contact or when separate,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं दिनक्रमात्पीते विबुधैस्तु निशाकरे । पीत्वार्द्ध मासं गच्छन्ति चामावास्यां सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dinakramātpīte vibudhaistu niśākare / pītvārddha māsaṃ gacchanti cāmāvāsyāṃ surottamāḥ
verses.translation: These are situated face to face. They come into contact mutually. That their mutual conjunction is without any confusion should be understood by learned men.
verses.wordMeaning: These are situated face to face. They come into contact mutually. That their mutual conjunction is without any confusion should be understood by learned men.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are situated face to face. They come into contact mutually. That their mutual conjunction is without any confusion should be understood by learned men.

verses.sanskrit: पितरश्चोपतिष्ठन्ति ह्यमावास्यां निशाकरम् । ततः पञ्चदशेकाले किञ्चिच्छिष्टे कलात्मके
verses.transliteration: pitaraścopatiṣṭhanti hyamāvāsyāṃ niśākaram / tataḥ pañcadaśekāle kiñcicchiṣṭe kalātmake
verses.translation: Vivasvn, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, the sun-god, was bom in the constellation Viiakha in the Cakfusa Manvantara. Tviicnan, the son of Dharma, the lord moon god, the son of Vasu, the cool-rayed cause of nights was bom in the constellation Kfttika.
verses.wordMeaning: Vivasvn, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, the sun-god, was bom in the constellation Viiakha in the Cakfusa Manvantara. Tviicnan, the son of Dharma, the lord moon god, the son of Vasu, the cool-rayed cause of nights was bom in the constellation Kfttika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vivasvn, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, the sun-god, was bom in the constellation Viiakha in the Cakfusa Manvantara. Tviicnan, the son of Dharma, the lord moon god, the son of Vasu, the cool-rayed cause of nights was bom in the constellation Kfttika.

verses.sanskrit: अपराह्णे पितृगणा जघन्यं पयुपासते । पिबन्ति द्विलवं कालं शिष्टास्तस्य कलास्तु याः
verses.transliteration: aparāhṇe pitṛgaṇā jaghanyaṃ payupāsate / pibanti dvilavaṃ kālaṃ śiṣṭāstasya kalāstu yāḥ
verses.translation: The planet Brhaspati (the Jupiter) who has twelve fiery flames (rays), who is the son of Angiras and who is the preceptor of the Universe, was born in the Purvaphalguni.
verses.wordMeaning: The planet Brhaspati (the Jupiter) who has twelve fiery flames (rays), who is the son of Angiras and who is the preceptor of the Universe, was born in the Purvaphalguni.
verses.commentary: Sense: The planet Brhaspati (the Jupiter) who has twelve fiery flames (rays), who is the son of Angiras and who is the preceptor of the Universe, was born in the Purvaphalguni.

verses.sanskrit: निःसृतं तदमावास्यां गभस्तिभ्यः स्वधामृतम् । तां स्वधां मासतृप्त्यै च पीत्वा गच्छन्ति ते ऽमृतम्
verses.transliteration: niḥsṛtaṃ tadamāvāsyāṃ gabhastibhyaḥ svadhāmṛtam / tāṃ svadhāṃ māsatṛptyai ca pītvā gacchanti te 'mṛtam
verses.translation: W. 129-137 give the stan (or coostellatloos) uader which these planets were *bom*. Sanaiicara (the Saturn), the son of the sun» was born in the constellation Revaii. He has seven fiery flames.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 129-137 give the stan (or coostellatloos) uader which these planets were *bom*. Sanaiicara (the Saturn), the son of the sun» was born in the constellation Revaii. He has seven fiery flames.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 129-137 give the stan (or coostellatloos) uader which these planets were *bom*. Sanaiicara (the Saturn), the son of the sun» was born in the constellation Revaii. He has seven fiery flames.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यस्तस्मिन्सुषुम्णे यस्तापितस्तेन चन्द्रमाः । कृष्णपक्षे सुरैस्तद्वत्पीयते वै सुधामयः
verses.transliteration: sūryastasminsuṣumṇe yastāpitastena candramāḥ / kṛṣṇapakṣe suraistadvatpīyate vai sudhāmayaḥ
verses.translation: Among fortnights the bright halfand among Tithis (lunar fortnightly days) Pratipat is the first. The day is glorified as the first among the divisions of day, night etc.
verses.wordMeaning: Among fortnights the bright halfand among Tithis (lunar fortnightly days) Pratipat is the first. The day is glorified as the first among the divisions of day, night etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among fortnights the bright halfand among Tithis (lunar fortnightly days) Pratipat is the first. The day is glorified as the first among the divisions of day, night etc.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्या बर्हिषदश्चैव अग्निष्वात्ताश्च ते त्रिधा । काव्यश्चैव तु ये प्रोक्ताः पितरः सर्व एव ते
verses.transliteration: saumyā barhiṣadaścaiva agniṣvāttāśca te tridhā / kāvyaścaiva tu ye proktāḥ pitaraḥ sarva eva te
verses.translation: The Yuga (Era) consisting of five years begins with Dhanistha and ends with Sravana. The learned man should comprehend and retain in belief, by means of scripture, inference, perception, and reasoning after testing intelligently and carefully.
verses.hindi: अनेकरेत्नोज्ञ्वलितैविचित्रेः प्रासादसंचे तुले रसंख्यैः । रथाशवमातेगख रोष्ट्रगोजायोग्येरनेकरपि मंदिरैश्च
verses.wordMeaning: The Yuga (Era) consisting of five years begins with Dhanistha and ends with Sravana. The learned man should comprehend and retain in belief, by means of scripture, inference, perception, and reasoning after testing intelligently and carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yuga (Era) consisting of five years begins with Dhanistha and ends with Sravana. The learned man should comprehend and retain in belief, by means of scripture, inference, perception, and reasoning after testing intelligently and carefully.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरास्तु वै काव्याः पञ्चाब्दा ये द्विचैः स्मृताः । सौम्यास्तु ऋतुवो ज्ञेया मासा बर्हिषदः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarāstu vai kāvyāḥ pañcābdā ye dvicaiḥ smṛtāḥ / saumyāstu ṛtuvo jñeyā māsā barhiṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas of the most excellent intellect these are five expedients (means) to comprehend the group of lumin¬ aries viz.: eye, scripture, water, picture and calculation.
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas of the most excellent intellect these are five expedients (means) to comprehend the group of lumin¬ aries viz.: eye, scripture, water, picture and calculation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas of the most excellent intellect these are five expedients (means) to comprehend the group of lumin¬ aries viz.: eye, scripture, water, picture and calculation.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्वात्तार्त्तवाश्चैव पितृसर्गा हि वै द्विजाः । पितृभिः पीयमानस्य पञ्चदश्यां कला तु वै
verses.transliteration: agniṣvāttārttavāścaiva pitṛsargā hi vai dvijāḥ / pitṛbhiḥ pīyamānasya pañcadaśyāṃ kalā tu vai
verses.translation: After recounting this (astronomical information in the last chapter) Lord Vayu (The Wind god) of very great intellect and who is (always) engaged in what is conducive to the welfare of the world, commenced the Japa (muttering in an undertone the Mantra) that was to be chanted when the sun reached the middle of the sky. All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.wordMeaning: After recounting this (astronomical information in the last chapter) Lord Vayu (The Wind god) of very great intellect and who is (always) engaged in what is conducive to the welfare of the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After recounting this (astronomical information in the last chapter) Lord Vayu (The Wind god) of very great intellect and who is (always) engaged in what is conducive to the welfare of the world,…

verses.sanskrit: यावत्प्रक्षीयते तस्य भागः पञ्चदशस्तु यः । अमावास्यां तदा तस्य तत आपूर्यते परः
verses.transliteration: yāvatprakṣīyate tasya bhāgaḥ pañcadaśastu yaḥ / amāvāsyāṃ tadā tasya tata āpūryate paraḥ
verses.translation: The Wind god prayed: Nilakantha, obeisance
verses.hindi: वीणा के तारों से निकले हुए स्वर के समान परम. मञ्जुल और सौम्य गाने, के योग्य, गन्धबोँ के समुच्च एवं मधुर निनाद से भाषण करने बालो वे सब नारियाँ थीं । वीणा के वादन में परम प्रवीण पाणि की अंगु- लियाँ के द्वारा गम्भीर चक्र के चटु बाद में निरत एवं वे समस्तं नारियाँ
verses.wordMeaning: The Wind god prayed: Nilakantha, obeisance
verses.commentary: Sense: The Wind god prayed: Nilakantha, obeisance

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धक्षयौ वै पक्षादौ षोडश्यां शशिनः स्मृता । एवं सूर्यनिमित्तैष क्षयोवृद्धिर्निशाकरे
verses.transliteration: vṛddhakṣayau vai pakṣādau ṣoḍaśyāṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtā / evaṃ sūryanimittaiṣa kṣayovṛddhirniśākare
verses.translation: This popular story as lo how Siva's throat became blue due to drink¬ ing the deadly pouon KiUkCta spears in the Mbh. (Adi. 18.41-43) and other PurScaa. The text of this chter from V. 6 onwards is the same as that of the V4. P.J4.I0 ff. All verbal utterances are impelled by you, O Vayu. The function of speech is dependent on Varna (sound of letters) and Sih&na (place of articulation).
verses.hindi: समुत्सुक थीं ।८॥ वे समस्तःना्याँ योवन- के मद से अधिक अलस और अत्यधिक प्रगलभ भावों वाली थीं । तथा वे सब आकुलित एवं, कामुक अर्थात् कामकेली की वासना से संयुत मनों वाली थीं । कामवासना से रचनात्मक प्रयोग करने में वे वारी 'बहुत ही निपुण थो। तथा परिपूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: This popular story as lo how Siva's throat became blue due to drink¬ ing the deadly pouon KiUkCta spears in the Mbh. (Adi. 18.41-43) and other PurScaa. The text of this chter from V. 6 onwards is the same as that of the V4. P.J4.I0 ff. All verbal utterances are impelled by you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This popular story as lo how Siva's throat became blue due to drink¬ ing the deadly pouon KiUkCta spears in the Mbh. (Adi. 18.41-43) and other PurScaa. The text of this chter from V. 6 onwards is the same as that of the V4. P.J4.I0 ff. All verbal utterances are impelled by you,…

verses.sanskrit: ताराग्रहाणां वक्ष्यामि स्वर्भानोश्च रथान्पुनः । तेयतेजोमयः शुभ्रः सोमपुत्रस्य वै रथः
verses.transliteration: tārāgrahāṇāṃ vakṣyāmi svarbhānośca rathānpunaḥ / teyatejomayaḥ śubhraḥ somaputrasya vai rathaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you, O Samiraa (wind god), there is no one who pervades everything. This living world is directly perceptible to you from all sides, O Anila (wind-god).
verses.hindi: सम्पदा-उदारता-रूप-गुण और शील स्वभाब से समन्वित थीं'३। संख्या को भी अतिक्रफण-करने वाले-अर्थात् बहुक्त ही-अधिकः घर के कर्मों: में: बहुत संलग्न रहने पर भी अपने प्राणी पतियों की परिचय करने वाली थीं,। वहू पुर उन नारियों के गुणगणों के लायक ही रूप और शोभा बाले--उद्-
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, O Samiraa (wind god), there is no one who pervades everything. This living world is directly perceptible to you from all sides, O Anila (wind-god).
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, O Samiraa (wind god), there is no one who pervades everything. This living world is directly perceptible to you from all sides, O Anila (wind-god).

verses.sanskrit: सोपासंगप ताकस्तु सध्वजो मेघनिस्वनः । भार्गवस्य रथः श्रीमांस्तेजसा सूर्यसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: sopāsaṃgapa tākastu sadhvajo meghanisvanaḥ / bhārgavasya rathaḥ śrīmāṃstejasā sūryasannibhaḥ
verses.translation: You know the lord of speech, Isvara, the leader (controller) of minds. Tell us wherefore (for what) is there an aberration of the colour and feature in the region of his neck (throat) On hearing the words of those sages of sanctified souls, Vayu who has great splendour and who is revered by the world, replied.
verses.hindi: भासित और सभी ओर से ग्रहीं में सञ्चरण'करने वाले पुरुषों से घिरा हुआ था ।१०। वह नगर राजमार्म, आपण सौध-सोपान-देवालयों के आँगनों
verses.wordMeaning: You know the lord of speech, Isvara, the leader (controller) of minds. Tell us wherefore (for what) is there an aberration of the colour and feature in the region of his neck (throat) On hearing the words of those sages of sanctified souls,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You know the lord of speech, Isvara, the leader (controller) of minds. Tell us wherefore (for what) is there an aberration of the colour and feature in the region of his neck (throat) On hearing the words of those sages of sanctified souls,…

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीसंभवैर्युक्तो नानावर्णैर्हयोत्तमैः । श्वेतः पिशङ्गः सारङ्गो नीलः पीतो विलोहितः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīsaṃbhavairyukto nānāvarṇairhayottamaiḥ / śvetaḥ piśaṅgaḥ sāraṅgo nīlaḥ pīto vilohitaḥ
verses.translation: 'Formerly, in Kftayuga, there was a Brahmaa called Vasistha who was extremely interested in deciding the (mean¬ ing of) Vedas. He was a righteous soul. He was the mental son (of Brahma). He was a Frajapati.
verses.wordMeaning: 'Formerly, in Kftayuga, there was a Brahmaa called Vasistha who was extremely interested in deciding the (mean¬ ing of) Vedas. He was a righteous soul. He was the mental son (of Brahma). He was a Frajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Formerly, in Kftayuga, there was a Brahmaa called Vasistha who was extremely interested in deciding the (mean¬ ing of) Vedas. He was a righteous soul. He was the mental son (of Brahma). He was a Frajapati.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णश्च हरितश्चैव पृषतः पृश्रिरेव च । दशभिस्तैर्महाभागैरकृशैर्वातरंहसैः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaśca haritaścaiva pṛṣataḥ pṛśrireva ca / daśabhistairmahābhāgairakṛśairvātaraṃhasaiḥ
verses.translation: O extremely fortunate one, it behoves you to detail everything without excluding anything. Narrate this auspicious and sacred story that destroys all sins. Please tell us this story for my delight.** On hearing the words of Wrvati, the lover of Parvat!, Sankara, recounted the story fully endued with auspiciousness.
verses.hindi: में समस्त अर्थ ग्रहों वाले तथा परिपूर्णे कामनाओं से संयुत नागरिकों से चारों ओर अध्यास्यमान था अर्थात् परिगुणशाली पुरवासी सभी ओर निवास कर रहे थे।११। उस नगर में असंड्य-अनृपम ओर नाना भांति के रत्नों से समुज्ज्वलित एवं विचित्र प्रासादों के समुदायों की अवस्थिति थी
verses.wordMeaning: O extremely fortunate one, it behoves you to detail everything without excluding anything. Narrate this auspicious and sacred story that destroys all sins. Please tell us this story for my delight.** On hearing the words of Wrvati, the lover of Parvat!, Sankara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O extremely fortunate one, it behoves you to detail everything without excluding anything. Narrate this auspicious and sacred story that destroys all sins. Please tell us this story for my delight.** On hearing the words of Wrvati, the lover of Parvat!, Sankara,…

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाश्वः काञ्चनः श्रीमान्भौमस्यापि रथोत्तमः । असंगैर्लोहितैरश्वैः सर्वगैरग्निसंभवैः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśvaḥ kāñcanaḥ śrīmānbhaumasyāpi rathottamaḥ / asaṃgairlohitairaśvaiḥ sarvagairagnisaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing, O lady of excellent face, the multitudes- of Devas and Daityas became dejected. All of them appro¬ ached BrahmS.
verses.hindi: और वहाँ पर अनेक ऐसे मन्दिर थे जहाँ पर अनेक रथ-अश्व-हाथी खर- उष्ट्र और गौए विद्यमान थे।१२। उस नगर में चारों ओर नरेन्द्रं सामन्त- निषाद सादी-पदाति-सेनापति ओर नायकों के तथा रथी-सारधी-सागध- चन्दीगण ओर विग्र प्रभृतियों के गृह बने हुए ये ।१३। उस अनृपम नगर में
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing, O lady of excellent face, the multitudes- of Devas and Daityas became dejected. All of them appro¬ ached BrahmS.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing, O lady of excellent face, the multitudes- of Devas and Daityas became dejected. All of them appro¬ ached BrahmS.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसर्पति कुमारो वै ऋजुवक्रानुव क्रगैः । ततश्चाङ्गिरसो विद्वान्देवाचार्यो बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: prasarpati kumāro vai ṛjuvakrānuva kragaiḥ / tataścāṅgiraso vidvāndevācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the frightened groups of Devas, Brahma,, of great splendour, asked: * highly fortunate ones, why are you frightened? Why are you dejected in the mind? You are the lords and masters of the three worlds* All of you are free from ailments. In the creation of subjects- there is no one who dares to transgress my behest.
verses.hindi: विविक्त अर्थात् खुली हुई रच्याए" थों--सभी आपण ये जिनके चत्वरं बहुत ही विचित्र थे। वहाँ पर अनेक प्रकार की वस्तुओं का क्रय और बिक्रय हो रहा था। उस नगर में ब्रारांगनाओं के परम शुक्र गृहों के समुह वितिमित थे जिनके निर्माण करने में. बहुत अधिक धन के व्यय से सब सामान भली-
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the frightened groups of Devas, Brahma,, of great splendour, asked: * highly fortunate ones, why are you frightened? Why are you dejected in the mind? You are the lords and masters of the three worlds* All of you are free from ailments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the frightened groups of Devas, Brahma,, of great splendour, asked: * highly fortunate ones, why are you frightened? Why are you dejected in the mind? You are the lords and masters of the three worlds* All of you are free from ailments.…

verses.sanskrit: गौरैरश्वैः काञ्चनेन स्यन्दनेन प्रसर्पति । अब्जैस्तु वाजिभिर्दिव्यैरष्टभिर्वातरंहसैः
verses.transliteration: gaurairaśvaiḥ kāñcanena syandanena prasarpati / abjaistu vājibhirdivyairaṣṭabhirvātaraṃhasaiḥ
verses.translation: All of you move about in aerial chariots. All of you go about as you please. (All of you are very competent) in regard to spiritual things, worldly beings and providential ones for ever),
verses.wordMeaning: All of you move about in aerial chariots. All of you go about as you please. (All of you are very competent) in regard to spiritual things, worldly beings and providential ones for ever),
verses.commentary: Sense: All of you move about in aerial chariots. All of you go about as you please. (All of you are very competent) in regard to spiritual things, worldly beings and providential ones for ever),

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रे ऽब्दं स तिष्ठन्वै संवेधास्तेन गच्छति । ततः शनैश्चरो ऽप्यश्वैः सबलैर्व्योमसंभवैः
verses.transliteration: nakṣatre 'bdaṃ sa tiṣṭhanvai saṃvedhāstena gacchati / tataḥ śanaiścaro 'pyaśvaiḥ sabalairvyomasaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: You are competent to make all the subjects function, in accordance with the consequence of their previous actions. Hence, why are you all agitated due to fear like the deer harassed by lion? Od hearing the words of Brahma, the supreme 5ouI> those Devas, leading Daityas and Danavas accompanied by
verses.wordMeaning: You are competent to make all the subjects function, in accordance with the consequence of their previous actions. Hence, why are you all agitated due to fear like the deer harassed by lion? Od hearing the words of Brahma, the supreme 5ouI> those Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are competent to make all the subjects function, in accordance with the consequence of their previous actions. Hence, why are you all agitated due to fear like the deer harassed by lion? Od hearing the words of Brahma, the supreme 5ouI> those Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: कार्ष्णायसं समारुह्य स्यन्दनं याति वै शनैः । स्वर्भानोश्च तथैवाश्वाः कृष्णा ह्यष्टौ मनोजवाः
verses.transliteration: kārṣṇāyasaṃ samāruhya syandanaṃ yāti vai śanaiḥ / svarbhānośca tathaivāśvāḥ kṛṣṇā hyaṣṭau manojavāḥ
verses.translation: Pitamaha (Braluna the grandfather) when the ocean was being churned by the Devas and Asuras» a terrible poison had turned up. It resembled serpents and black bees. It was like the blue cloud* It had the sparkling lustre of the Banivarta fire (the fire that bums down the universe at the end of a Kalpa). It had cropped up like the god of death and destruction. It had the fiery splendour of the sun at the end of the Yugas. It had the brilliance of the sun capable of annihi* lating the three worlds. It spread all round.
verses.wordMeaning: Pitamaha (Braluna the grandfather) when the ocean was being churned by the Devas and Asuras» a terrible poison had turned up. It resembled serpents and black bees.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitamaha (Braluna the grandfather) when the ocean was being churned by the Devas and Asuras» a terrible poison had turned up. It resembled serpents and black bees.…

verses.sanskrit: रथं तमोमयं तस्य सकृद्युक्ता वहं त्युत । आदित्यान्निःसृतो राहुः सोमं गच्छति पर्वसु
verses.transliteration: rathaṃ tamomayaṃ tasya sakṛdyuktā vahaṃ tyuta / ādityānniḥsṛto rāhuḥ somaṃ gacchati parvasu
verses.translation: ''O Virupak (Lord ofuncvcn-thrcceycs) obeisance la Purioas it h customaiy to attribute the hipest epithets to the ieity eulogiicd. Sometimei it raulU in a siring of names or adjectives. Here

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यमेति सोमश्च पुनः सौरेषु पर्वसु । अथ केतुरथस्याश्वा अष्टौ वै वातरंहसः
verses.transliteration: ādityameti somaśca punaḥ saureṣu parvasu / atha keturathasyāśvā aṣṭau vai vātaraṃhasaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto thee who are Brahma, Rudra and Visi>u. Bow to the Saihkhya; to the Yoga. Obeisance to the assemblage of all spirits (incarnate).
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance unto thee who are Brahma, Rudra and Visi>u. Bow to the Saihkhya; to the Yoga. Obeisance to the assemblage of all spirits (incarnate).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance unto thee who are Brahma, Rudra and Visi>u. Bow to the Saihkhya; to the Yoga. Obeisance to the assemblage of all spirits (incarnate).

verses.sanskrit: पलालधूमवर्णाभा सबला रासभारुणाः । एते वाहा ग्रहाणां च ह्युपाख्याता रथैः सह
verses.transliteration: palāladhūmavarṇābhā sabalā rāsabhāruṇāḥ / ete vāhā grahāṇāṃ ca hyupākhyātā rathaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Hail to the destroyer of the body of Manmatha (Giod of Love). Obeisance to the lord with Time {kAla) for his back. Obeisance to Rudra of excellent semen. Bow to the lord of the Devas and to the Vehement one. Obeisance to Kapardin (one having matted hair), to Sankara the terrible one. Hail to Hara, the bearer of a skull one of hideous features Obeisance to Siva the bestower of boons.
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the destroyer of the body of Manmatha (Giod of Love). Obeisance to the lord with Time {kAla) for his back. Obeisance to Rudra of excellent semen. Bow to the lord of the Devas and to the Vehement one. Obeisance to Kapardin (one having matted hair),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the destroyer of the body of Manmatha (Giod of Love). Obeisance to the lord with Time {kAla) for his back. Obeisance to Rudra of excellent semen. Bow to the lord of the Devas and to the Vehement one. Obeisance to Kapardin (one having matted hair),…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ध्रुवनिब द्धास्ते प्रवृद्धा वातरश्मिभिः । तपन्ते ब्राम्यमाणास्तु यथायोगं भ्रमन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: sarve dhruvaniba ddhāste pravṛddhā vātaraśmibhiḥ / tapante brāmyamāṇāstu yathāyogaṃ bhramanti vai
verses.translation: Obeisance to the destroyer of the three cities (of demons). Bow to the destroyer of the sacrifice (ofDaksa). Hail to the lord of the mothers. Obeisance to the Vrddha (the ancient god); Obeisance to Suddha (the pure one), to the Mukta (Liberated one); obeisance to the mighty one.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the destroyer of the three cities (of demons). Bow to the destroyer of the sacrifice (ofDaksa). Hail to the lord of the mothers. Obeisance to the Vrddha (the ancient god); Obeisance to Suddha (the pure one), to the Mukta (Liberated one); obeisance to the mighty one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the destroyer of the three cities (of demons). Bow to the destroyer of the sacrifice (ofDaksa). Hail to the lord of the mothers. Obeisance to the Vrddha (the ancient god); Obeisance to Suddha (the pure one), to the Mukta (Liberated one); obeisance to the mighty one.

verses.sanskrit: वायव्याभिरदृश्याभिः प्रवृद्धा वातरश्मिभिः । परिभ्रमन्ति तद्ब्रद्धांश्चन्द्रसुर्यग्रहा दिवि
verses.transliteration: vāyavyābhiradṛśyābhiḥ pravṛddhā vātaraśmibhiḥ / paribhramanti tadbraddhāṃścandrasuryagrahā divi
verses.translation: Obeisance to the sole hero among the three worlds to the moon, to Varuria; to Agra (the foremost one), to Ugra (the terrible one); to (knower of the Vedas) of many eyes. Obeisance toRajas to Sattva\ obeisance unto you of unmanifest origin. Bow to tlie Eternal one; to the non-ctemal one; and to the eternal-cum-nonetemal one.
verses.hindi: जात्वा ततो मुनिवरो द्विजहोमधेन्वा संपादितं नरपते
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the sole hero among the three worlds to the moon, to Varuria; to Agra (the foremost one), to Ugra (the terrible one); to (knower of the Vedas) of many eyes. Obeisance toRajas to Sattva\ obeisance unto you of unmanifest origin. Bow to tlie Eternal one;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the sole hero among the three worlds to the moon, to Varuria; to Agra (the foremost one), to Ugra (the terrible one); to (knower of the Vedas) of many eyes. Obeisance toRajas to Sattva\ obeisance unto you of unmanifest origin. Bow to tlie Eternal one;…

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमन्तमनुगछन्ति ध्रुवं ते ज्योतिषां गणाः । यथा नह्युदके नौस्तु सलिलेन सहो ह्यते
verses.transliteration: bhramantamanugachanti dhruvaṃ te jyotiṣāṃ gaṇāḥ / yathā nahyudake naustu salilena saho hyate
verses.translation: Hail to the manifest one, to the Unmanifest one, as well as to the manifest-cum-unmanirest one. Obeisance to
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the manifest one, to the Unmanifest one, as well as to the manifest-cum-unmanirest one. Obeisance to
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the manifest one, to the Unmanifest one, as well as to the manifest-cum-unmanirest one. Obeisance to

verses.sanskrit: तथा देवालया ह्येते ऊह्यन्ते वातरश्मिभिः । सर्प्पमाणा न दृश्यन्ते व्योम्नि देवगणास्तु ते
verses.transliteration: tathā devālayā hyete ūhyante vātaraśmibhiḥ / sarppamāṇā na dṛśyante vyomni devagaṇāstu te
verses.translation: Obeisance to the diapeller of distress of all the worlds; Bow to the lord who is fond of Narayaa; Obeisance to *$arva, the lover ofUmi, Hail to the lord marked with the face of Nandin? {nandi*vakirdiUfya)* Hail to (the lord identifying himself with) Paka (fortnight), Mdsa (Month) and ArdhanUlsa (half a month); obeisance to (the Lord, the identifier with) the season and SarAvatsara{yczr ); Bow to the lord of many forms, to the lord with shaven head, to the lord bearing a staff, to the lord wearing a mailed armour.
verses.hindi: उस सुरम्य नगर में बहुत ही मूल्यवान् "रत्नों से उज्ज्वल एवं
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the diapeller of distress of all the worlds; Bow to the lord who is fond of Narayaa; Obeisance to *$arva, the lover ofUmi, Hail to the lord marked with the face of Nandin? {nandi*vakirdiUfya)* Hail to (the lord identifying himself with) Paka (fortnight),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the diapeller of distress of all the worlds; Bow to the lord who is fond of Narayaa; Obeisance to *$arva, the lover ofUmi, Hail to the lord marked with the face of Nandin? {nandi*vakirdiUfya)* Hail to (the lord identifying himself with) Paka (fortnight),…

verses.sanskrit: यावत्यश्चैव ताराश्च तावन्तो वातरश्मयः । सर्वा ध्रुवे निबद्धाश्च भ्रमन्त्यो भ्रामयन्ति ताः
verses.transliteration: yāvatyaścaiva tārāśca tāvanto vātaraśmayaḥ / sarvā dhruve nibaddhāśca bhramantyo bhrāmayanti tāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord with the skull in his hand; Bow to the god having quarters for his raiment (the naked one); to one with a tufted head; Obeisance to the lord with a bow and a chariot, and to the celibate god with self control.
verses.hindi: समुन्नत गोपुर बने हुए थे तथा श्वा-गृद्धों के समुदायों के बत्तन के आलय बने हुए थे। उसमें बिचित्र ध्वजा ऐँ-पताकाए" और शुभ्र पटों से संयुत उन्नत गण्डपिकाएः निनिमित्त थी ।१५। उस नगर में जल में भरे हुए अनेक तालाब-बाबड़ी और सरोबर घे जिनमें अनेक प्रकार की रमणीक ध्वनि हो
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord with the skull in his hand; Bow to the god having quarters for his raiment (the naked one); to one with a tufted head; Obeisance to the lord with a bow and a chariot, and to the celibate god with self control.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord with the skull in his hand; Bow to the god having quarters for his raiment (the naked one); to one with a tufted head; Obeisance to the lord with a bow and a chariot, and to the celibate god with self control.

verses.sanskrit: तैलपीडा यथा चक्रं भ्रमन्तो भ्रामयन्ति ह । तथा भ्रमन्ति ज्योतींषि वातबद्धानि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: tailapīḍā yathā cakraṃ bhramanto bhrāmayanti ha / tathā bhramanti jyotīṃṣi vātabaddhāni sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing it, ail of us were frightened and agitated in the mind. O great lord, swallow it up with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. You alone are competent to swallow it. There is no one other than you O great lord, to bear the brunt of its advance".
verses.hindi: रही थी तया वहाँ पर उनका जल कहलार-कमल-कुमुद और उत्पलों की रेणु से सुवासिश था और चक्रवाक-हंस-कुररी-वगुला तथा -सारसों की ध्वनियां सुनाई दे रही थीं ।१६। उस नगर में अनेक प्रकार के वृक्ष लगे हुए थे जिनके आलवाल भी बने हुए ये । उन तरुदरों में आम्न-प्रियालपन-मधूक
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing it, ail of us were frightened and agitated in the mind. O great lord, swallow it up with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. You alone are competent to swallow it. There is no one other than you O great lord, to bear the brunt of its advance".
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it, ail of us were frightened and agitated in the mind. O great lord, swallow it up with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. You alone are competent to swallow it. There is no one other than you O great lord, to bear the brunt of its advance".

verses.sanskrit: अलातचक्रवद्यान्ति वातचक्रेरितानि तु । यतो ज्योतींषि वहते प्रवहस्तेन स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: alātacakravadyānti vātacakreritāni tu / yato jyotīṃṣi vahate pravahastena sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: *'You shine splendidly O great lord of excellent holy rites,*with this (such) neck".
verses.hindi: जम्बू और प्लक्ष के बृंक्ष ये । वहाँ पर पर्वतों में परम सुन्दर नाग केंतुकी पुन्नाग और चम्पक के बन थे जो पक्षियों के द्वारा सेवित थे अर्थात् जिन पर अनेक पक्षी नि्ास कर रहे थे ।१७। बह नगर अनेक तरह के बुं से शोमित था जिनका स्वरूप जगत् परमाश्चये जनक था । वहाँ पर युसंरक्षित
verses.wordMeaning: *'You shine splendidly O great lord of excellent holy rites,*with this (such) neck".
verses.commentary: Sense: *'You shine splendidly O great lord of excellent holy rites,*with this (such) neck".

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्रुवनिबद्धो ऽसौ सर्पते ज्योतिषां गणः । सैष तारामयो ज्ञेयः शिशुमारो ध्रुवो दिवि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dhruvanibaddho 'sau sarpate jyotiṣāṃ gaṇaḥ / saiṣa tārāmayo jñeyaḥ śiśumāro dhruvo divi
verses.translation: That Kalakufa, the poison of terrible action, was retained by me in my throat. On seeing it being contained thus, the groups of Devas and Daityas became extremely surprised. how wonderful are your strength, virility and exploit, O lord. Your body and Y<ic power are simply wonderful.
verses.hindi: चारों ओर उपदनों की पंक्तियाँ थीं एवं बहा अनेक मन्दार-कुन्द-करवीर- सुन्दर यूथिका और जाती आदि के पुष्पों तथा फलों बाले वृक्ष लगे हुए थे ।१५। है नरेन्द्र ! उस नगर में समस्त ऋतुओं में भर वसन्त में सुरभित वायु के मन्द-मन्द प्रचलन से घमं के काल को भसित कर दिया गया था।
verses.wordMeaning: That Kalakufa, the poison of terrible action, was retained by me in my throat. On seeing it being contained thus, the groups of Devas and Daityas became extremely surprised. how wonderful are your strength, virility and exploit, O lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: That Kalakufa, the poison of terrible action, was retained by me in my throat. On seeing it being contained thus, the groups of Devas and Daityas became extremely surprised. how wonderful are your strength, virility and exploit, O lord.…

verses.sanskrit: यदह्ना कुरुते पापं दृष्ट्वा तन्निशिमुञ्चते । यावत्यश्चैव तारास्ताः शिशुमाराश्रिता दिवि
verses.transliteration: yadahnā kurute pāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tanniśimuñcate / yāvatyaścaiva tārāstāḥ śiśumārāśritā divi
verses.translation: You alone are the sun and the moon. You alone are the manifestation of this world of mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से वह नगर सुरासुरों की परम मनोरम योगों की सम्पदा के
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are the sun and the moon. You alone are the manifestation of this world of mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are the sun and the moon. You alone are the manifestation of this world of mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: तावन्त्येव तु वर्षाणि जीवताभ्यधिकानि तु । साकारः शिशुमारश्च विज्ञेयः प्रविभागशः
verses.transliteration: tāvantyeva tu varṣāṇi jīvatābhyadhikāni tu / sākāraḥ śiśumāraśca vijñeyaḥ pravibhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: You alone are the creator and sustainer of the entire world of mobile and immobile beings. You alone are its annihilation (i.e. annihilator) I shall mention the extensive beneftt acquired by the persem who retains in memory this splendid narrative proclaim¬ ed by Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are the creator and sustainer of the entire world of mobile and immobile beings. You alone are its annihilation (i.e. annihilator) I shall mention the extensive beneftt acquired by the persem who retains in memory this splendid narrative proclaim¬ ed by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are the creator and sustainer of the entire world of mobile and immobile beings. You alone are its annihilation (i.e. annihilator) I shall mention the extensive beneftt acquired by the persem who retains in memory this splendid narrative proclaim¬ ed by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: औत्तानपादस्तस्याथ विज्ञेयो ह्यत्तरो हनुः । यज्ञः परस्तु विज्ञेयो धर्मो मर्द्धानमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: auttānapādastasyātha vijñeyo hyattaro hanuḥ / yajñaḥ parastu vijñeyo dharmo marddhānamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: O lady of great beauty and excellent hip, all poi¬ sons whether mobile or immobile (solid or liquid?) are immedia¬ tely destroyed on coming into contact with his body.
verses.hindi: विस्पष्टमान वैभव वाला था ।१६। उस मुनि की होम धेनु ने तुरन्त ही अमित सौभाग्य के भोगःको करके शीघ्र-ही-उस महामुनीन्द्र -की- सेवा में कर दिया था। इसके अनन्तर उन मुनिश्रेष्ठ ने द्विज होम घेनु-के द्वारा राजा का परम रुचिर आतिथेय-सम्पादित किया हुआ जान लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of great beauty and excellent hip, all poi¬ sons whether mobile or immobile (solid or liquid?) are immedia¬ tely destroyed on coming into contact with his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of great beauty and excellent hip, all poi¬ sons whether mobile or immobile (solid or liquid?) are immedia¬ tely destroyed on coming into contact with his body.

verses.sanskrit: हृदि नारायणः साध्यो ह्यश्विनौ पूर्वपादयोः । वरुणश्चार्यमा चैव पश्चिमे तस्य सक्थिनी
verses.transliteration: hṛdi nārāyaṇaḥ sādhyo hyaśvinau pūrvapādayoḥ / varuṇaścāryamā caiva paścime tasya sakthinī
verses.translation: It subdues all terrible inauspicious features. It dispels and decreases (the effect of) evil dreams. The person He wins arguments. He becomes victorious in battle. When travelling, he docs so with safety ami welfare. His house is full with perpetual prosperity.
verses.hindi: फिर उस मुनीर ने अपने किसी गुणशाली शिष्य को बुलाकर है राजन् ! शीघ्र ही हैययेश्वर के समीप में भेज दिया था। उस मुनि सुत ने शी धर वेग से विशों केःअधिपति के समीप में गमन करके बहुत ही नस्ता से यह उससे
verses.wordMeaning: It subdues all terrible inauspicious features. It dispels and decreases (the effect of) evil dreams. The person He wins arguments. He becomes victorious in battle. When travelling, he docs so with safety ami welfare. His house is full with perpetual prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: It subdues all terrible inauspicious features. It dispels and decreases (the effect of) evil dreams. The person He wins arguments. He becomes victorious in battle. When travelling, he docs so with safety ami welfare. His house is full with perpetual prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: शिश्रं संवत्सरस्तस्य मित्रो ऽपानं समाश्रितः । पुच्छे ऽग्निश्च महेन्द्रश्च मारीचः कश्यपो ध्रुवः
verses.transliteration: śiśraṃ saṃvatsarastasya mitro 'pānaṃ samāśritaḥ / pucche 'gniśca mahendraśca mārīcaḥ kaśyapo dhruvaḥ
verses.translation: The Vaisya acquires proht. The Sudra shall attain happiness. The sick man is rid of hb ailments. The fettered one is released from imprisonment.
verses.hindi: कुलेदेशिकाज्ञा । राजा ततो .मुनिवरेण कृताभ्यनुज्ञः संप्राविशत्पुरवरं स्वकृते कृतं तत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Vaisya acquires proht. The Sudra shall attain happiness. The sick man is rid of hb ailments. The fettered one is released from imprisonment.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vaisya acquires proht. The Sudra shall attain happiness. The sick man is rid of hb ailments. The fettered one is released from imprisonment.

verses.sanskrit: तारकाः शिशुमारस्य नास्तं याति चतुष्टयम् । नक्षत्रचन्द्रमूर्याश्च ग्रहास्तारागणैः सह
verses.transliteration: tārakāḥ śiśumārasya nāstaṃ yāti catuṣṭayam / nakṣatracandramūryāśca grahāstārāgaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: The pregnant woman obiairu a son; the virgin gets a good husband. Every one obtains the lost wealth here and hereafter. He who retains in memory a foot or half a foot, a quatrain or a distitch (of this story) goes to the world of Rudra for ever
verses.wordMeaning: The pregnant woman obiairu a son; the virgin gets a good husband. Every one obtains the lost wealth here and hereafter. He who retains in memory a foot or half a foot, a quatrain or a distitch (of this story) goes to the world of Rudra for ever
verses.commentary: Sense: The pregnant woman obiairu a son; the virgin gets a good husband. Every one obtains the lost wealth here and hereafter. He who retains in memory a foot or half a foot, a quatrain or a distitch (of this story) goes to the world of Rudra for ever

verses.sanskrit: उन्मुखा विमुखाः सर्वे वक्रीभूताः श्रिता दिवि । ध्रुवेणाधिष्ठिताश्चैव ध्रुवमेव प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: unmukhā vimukhāḥ sarve vakrībhūtāḥ śritā divi / dhruveṇādhiṣṭhitāścaiva dhruvameva pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: A prayer greater than this, there never had been before nor will ever be. Neither the Yakas, nor the Piiacas, neither the goblins nor Vinayakas (spirits creating impediment) shall bring about any obstacle in the house of that person where this prayer is kept.
verses.wordMeaning: A prayer greater than this, there never had been before nor will ever be. Neither the Yakas, nor the Piiacas, neither the goblins nor Vinayakas (spirits creating impediment) shall bring about any obstacle in the house of that person where this prayer is kept.
verses.commentary: Sense: A prayer greater than this, there never had been before nor will ever be. Neither the Yakas, nor the Piiacas, neither the goblins nor Vinayakas (spirits creating impediment) shall bring about any obstacle in the house of that person where this prayer is kept.

verses.sanskrit: परियान्तीश्वरश्रेष्ठं मेढीभूतं द्रुवं दिवि । अग्नीन्द्रकश्यपानां तु चरमो ऽसौ ध्रुवः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pariyāntīśvaraśreṣṭhaṃ meḍhībhūtaṃ druvaṃ divi / agnīndrakaśyapānāṃ tu caramo 'sau dhruvaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O lady of Jotuslike eyes, the greatness of this prayer has been mentioned by me to you as I am delighted. It is destructive of multitudes of sins. It is accompanied by the merit of holiness. It is sung by the four*faced lord himself. After recounting this story endued with the fruits of meritorious deeds to the goddess, the lord whose matted hair has been fixed with the moon and who is fond of Guha (Kirttikeya) went to Kailasa cave on the back of his Bull. He was accompanied by Umk.
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of Jotuslike eyes, the greatness of this prayer has been mentioned by me to you as I am delighted. It is destructive of multitudes of sins. It is accompanied by the merit of holiness. It is sung by the four*faced lord himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of Jotuslike eyes, the greatness of this prayer has been mentioned by me to you as I am delighted. It is destructive of multitudes of sins. It is accompanied by the merit of holiness. It is sung by the four*faced lord himself.…

verses.sanskrit: एक एव भ्रमत्येष मेरुपर्वतमूर्द्धनि । ज्योतिषां चक्रमेतद्धि गदा कर्षन्नवाङ्मुखः । मेरुमालोकयत्येष पर्यन्ते हि प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: eka eva bhramatyeṣa meruparvatamūrddhani / jyotiṣāṃ cakrametaddhi gadā karṣannavāṅmukhaḥ / merumālokayatyeṣa paryante hi pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: This story that dispels sins has been heard by me from Prajapati. It is recounted to you.
verses.wordMeaning: This story that dispels sins has been heard by me from Prajapati. It is recounted to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: This story that dispels sins has been heard by me from Prajapati. It is recounted to you.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महादृवायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे ध्रुवचर्याकीर्त्तनं नाम त्रयोविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु सुनयः पुनस्ते संशयान्विताः । पप्रच्छुरुत्तरं भूयस्तदा ते रोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahādṛvāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde dhruvacaryākīrttanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etacchrutvā tu sunayaḥ punaste saṃśayānvitāḥ / papracchuruttaraṃ bhūyastadā te romaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: The rainfall has its root (source) in the sun water; proceeds from (functions on account of) the sun. It is after being presided over by Dhruva that the sun works for rain.
verses.wordMeaning: The rainfall has its root (source) in the sun water; proceeds from (functions on account of) the sun. It is after being presided over by Dhruva that the sun works for rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rainfall has its root (source) in the sun water; proceeds from (functions on account of) the sun. It is after being presided over by Dhruva that the sun works for rain.

verses.sanskrit: यदेतदुक्तं भवतागृहाणीत्येव विस्तृतम् । कथं देवगृहाणि स्युः कथं ज्योतींषिवर्णय
verses.transliteration: yadetaduktaṃ bhavatāgṛhāṇītyeva vistṛtam / kathaṃ devagṛhāṇi syuḥ kathaṃ jyotīṃṣivarṇaya
verses.translation: The Cctmdas (Vedic Metres) have assumed the forms of horses and arc stationed in the direction of the wheel. The chariot has characteristics similar to those of the chariot of Varuia.
verses.wordMeaning: The Cctmdas (Vedic Metres) have assumed the forms of horses and arc stationed in the direction of the wheel. The chariot has characteristics similar to those of the chariot of Varuia.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Cctmdas (Vedic Metres) have assumed the forms of horses and arc stationed in the direction of the wheel. The chariot has characteristics similar to those of the chariot of Varuia.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व ज्योतिषां चैव निर्णयम् । वायुरुवाच श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां तदा सूतः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva jyotiṣāṃ caiva nirṇayam / vāyuruvāca śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ tadā sūtaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Muhurtas and Kal are remembered as the beauti¬ ful trappings and fittings. Kastha is remembered as its nose and the (Moment) is its axle.
verses.wordMeaning: Muhurtas and Kal are remembered as the beauti¬ ful trappings and fittings. Kastha is remembered as its nose and the (Moment) is its axle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Muhurtas and Kal are remembered as the beauti¬ ful trappings and fittings. Kastha is remembered as its nose and the (Moment) is its axle.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच परमं वाक्यं तेषां संशयनिर्णयम् । अस्मिन्नर्थे माहाप्राज्ञैर्यदुक्तं ज्ञानबुद्धिभिः
verses.transliteration: uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ teṣāṃ saṃśayanirṇayam / asminnarthe māhāprājñairyaduktaṃ jñānabuddhibhiḥ
verses.translation: VV. 61*62 give a symbolic docriptioo of the CbsHot of the SuAt The significance of each part of the chariot, the horses yoked etc. Is given ia W, 67 ff below.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 61*62 give a symbolic docriptioo of the CbsHot of the SuAt The significance of each part of the chariot, the horses yoked etc. Is given ia W, 67 ff below.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 61*62 give a symbolic docriptioo of the CbsHot of the SuAt The significance of each part of the chariot, the horses yoked etc. Is given ia W, 67 ff below.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वो ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्भवम् । यथा देवगृहाणीह सूर्यचन्द्रग्रहाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: etadvo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi sūryācandramasorbhavam / yathā devagṛhāṇīha sūryacandragrahāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) these two are remembered as the tips of the yoke and the axle.
verses.wordMeaning: Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) these two are remembered as the tips of the yoke and the axle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) these two are remembered as the tips of the yoke and the axle.

verses.sanskrit: ततः परं च त्रिविधस्याग्नेर्वक्ष्ये समुद्भवम् । दिव्यस्य भौतिकस्याग्नेरब्योनेः पार्थि वस्य तु
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paraṃ ca trividhasyāgnervakṣye samudbhavam / divyasya bhautikasyāgnerabyoneḥ pārthi vasya tu
verses.translation: The seven Metres are Gayatr! Tri?lup, Anus|up, Jagati, Pahkti, Brhati and Unik.
verses.hindi: हमारे कुल गुरुदेव की यह आज्ञा हुई है कि हमारे द्वारा समुपादित आतिथ्य को राजा के द्वारा शोघ्न ही ग्रहण करना चाहिए। इसके पश्चात् राजा ने मुनिवर के द्वारा अनुज्ञा प्राप्त करके उस परम श्र नगर में प्रवेश किया था जोकि अपने ही लिए निर्मित किया गया थाः।२२। वह राजा
verses.wordMeaning: The seven Metres are Gayatr! Tri?lup, Anus|up, Jagati, Pahkti, Brhati and Unik.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven Metres are Gayatr! Tri?lup, Anus|up, Jagati, Pahkti, Brhati and Unik.

verses.sanskrit: व्युष्टायां तु रजन्यां वै ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः । अव्याकृतमिदं त्वासीन्नैशेन तमसावृतम्
verses.transliteration: vyuṣṭāyāṃ tu rajanyāṃ vai brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ / avyākṛtamidaṃ tvāsīnnaiśena tamasāvṛtam
verses.translation: Propelled by Dhruva, the great wheel whirls along with the Axis. Thus is the structure of lus chariot in view of specific purpose.
verses.hindi: अपनी! सेना के समस्त: सैनिकों के सहित उस नगर में प्रविष्ट हुआ था जो कि मुनि की होमधेनु को अत्यद्भुत शक्ति-सामर्थ्यं का सूचक था और जो सभी प्रकार के उपभोगों का एक महान विशाल आगार था। अन्दर उस राजा ने भली-भाति प्रवेश करके सभी लोकों का समोहन करने बाली उस
verses.wordMeaning: Propelled by Dhruva, the great wheel whirls along with the Axis. Thus is the structure of lus chariot in view of specific purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: Propelled by Dhruva, the great wheel whirls along with the Axis. Thus is the structure of lus chariot in view of specific purpose.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतावशिष्टे ऽस्मिंल्लोके नष्टविशेषणे । स्वयंभूर्भगवांस्तत्र लोकतन्त्रार्थसाधकः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtāvaśiṣṭe 'smiṃlloke naṣṭaviśeṣaṇe / svayaṃbhūrbhagavāṃstatra lokatantrārthasādhakaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, by means of combination the shining chariot has l)een evolved. By means of that shining chariot, lord sun-god traverses the firmament.
verses.hindi: नगर की समृद्धि का अभिसमीक्षण करके अत्यधिक भ्रसन्चता- प्राप. की थी ।२३। उस. समय अपनी सेता के सहित परम दानी ओर महान् धीर उस राजा शे प्रीति से प्रसन्न वदन वाला होकर अत्यधिक विस्मय को प्राप्त किया था । देवों की स्त्रियों के नेत्ररूपी ्मरों के यूथों के द्वारा पाप करने
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, by means of combination the shining chariot has l)een evolved. By means of that shining chariot, lord sun-god traverses the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, by means of combination the shining chariot has l)een evolved. By means of that shining chariot, lord sun-god traverses the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: खद्योतवत्स व्यचरदाविर्भावचिकीर्षया । सो ऽग्निं दृष्ट्वाथ लोकादौ पृथिवीजलसंश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: khadyotavatsa vyacaradāvirbhāvacikīrṣayā / so 'gniṃ dṛṣṭvātha lokādau pṛthivījalasaṃśritam
verses.translation: There are two rein-cords fixed to the extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot. Those two rein-cords re¬ volve in Dhruva (and perform the function) of a pair of wheels.
verses.hindi: का एक माव पात्र समुचित एवं सुन्दर सूति वाला जिस समय वहाँ गमन कर रहा था । अर्थात् गमन करते हुए देवाज़नाएँ अपने नयनों से उसकी सुन्दर मृत्तिका अवलोकत कर रही थी ।२४। देवगणों के समुदाय के साथ उस राजा हैहयपति ने कुवेर की वसति में महेन्द्र के ही समान पुर के राज
verses.wordMeaning: There are two rein-cords fixed to the extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot. Those two rein-cords re¬ volve in Dhruva (and perform the function) of a pair of wheels.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are two rein-cords fixed to the extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot. Those two rein-cords re¬ volve in Dhruva (and perform the function) of a pair of wheels.

verses.sanskrit: संवृत्य तं प्रकाशार्थं त्रिधा व्यमजदीश्वरः । पवनो यस्तु लोके ऽस्मिन्पार्थिवः सो ऽग्निरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃvṛtya taṃ prakāśārthaṃ tridhā vyamajadīśvaraḥ / pavano yastu loke 'sminpārthivaḥ so 'gnirucyate
verses.translation: The extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot revolve all round along with the rein-cords like the rope fixed to a peg.
verses.hindi: मार्गे में प्रम रमण किया था । राजमार्ग के द्वारा जब प्रस्थान कर रहा था उस समय में सौधों (विशाल सहस्रो) पर स्थित होती हुई" पौराञ्जनाओं ने चारों ओर से चन्वन के जल से सिक्त परम सुन्दर असूनों और लाजाओं (खीलों) के प्रकरों से त़िरस्तर उस राजा के ऊपर वर्षा की थी । समागत
verses.wordMeaning: The extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot revolve all round along with the rein-cords like the rope fixed to a peg.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extremities of the yoke and the axis of the chariot revolve all round along with the rein-cords like the rope fixed to a peg.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चासौ तपते सूर्ये शुचिरग्निस्तु स स्मृतः । वैद्युतो ऽब्जस्तु विज्ञेयस्तेषां वक्ष्ये ऽथ लक्षमम्
verses.transliteration: yaścāsau tapate sūrye śuciragnistu sa smṛtaḥ / vaidyuto 'bjastu vijñeyasteṣāṃ vakṣye 'tha lakṣamam
verses.translation: During Uttarayau the rein-cords become reduced (in length) as they move in circles. During the Daksiyana they increase in size.
verses.hindi: अतिथि के अचेन करने में परमाधिक समुत्सुक उस नगर वासियों की अङ्गं नाओं के करकमलों से गिरी हुई खीलों की वर्षा हो रही घी । उस समय में होने वाले प्छ (कीच) से सुगन्धितं नन्दन वन में समुत्पन्न पुष्पों की"राशियाँ बरसायों जा रही थीं जिन पर सोरभ से संमोहित भ्रमर-गुञ्जारः कर रहे
verses.wordMeaning: During Uttarayau the rein-cords become reduced (in length) as they move in circles. During the Daksiyana they increase in size.
verses.commentary: Sense: During Uttarayau the rein-cords become reduced (in length) as they move in circles. During the Daksiyana they increase in size.

verses.sanskrit: वैद्युतो जाठरः सौरो ह्यपां गर्भास्त्रयो ऽग्रयः । तस्मादपः पिबन्सूर्यो गोभिर्दीप्यत्यसौ दिवि
verses.transliteration: vaidyuto jāṭharaḥ sauro hyapāṃ garbhāstrayo 'grayaḥ / tasmādapaḥ pibansūryo gobhirdīpyatyasau divi
verses.translation: The two rein-cords of the chariot fixed to the extre¬ mities of the yoke and the axis are caught hold of by Dhruva and the two rcin-cordi lead the sun.
verses.hindi: २०२ ) . ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण ये । वहाँ पर वह राजा वहाँ को वनिताओं के द्वारा अब्जञन रत्न सार मुक्ताओं से अनृपद प्रकोयंमाण हो रहा शा ।२५-२३-२७! बह अवनिपति इस प्रकार को विशद बुष्टियों से चारों ओर विशेष रूप से भ्राजित हुआ शा
verses.wordMeaning: The two rein-cords of the chariot fixed to the extre¬ mities of the yoke and the axis are caught hold of by Dhruva and the two rcin-cordi lead the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two rein-cords of the chariot fixed to the extre¬ mities of the yoke and the axis are caught hold of by Dhruva and the two rcin-cordi lead the sun.

verses.sanskrit: वैद्युतेन समाविष्टो वार्ष्यो नाद्भिः प्रशाम्यति । मानवा नां च कुक्षिस्थो नाद्भिः शास्यति पावकः
verses.transliteration: vaidyutena samāviṣṭo vārṣyo nādbhiḥ praśāmyati / mānavā nāṃ ca kukṣistho nādbhiḥ śāsyati pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•
verses.hindi: जैसे मन्दराचल चन्द्रमा की किरणों के सबुदाय से शोभाशाज़ी हुआ करता है। उस सभय अस्पन्त उवार और लोकों में चिन्तन न करने के योग्य ब्राह्मणों की तपश्चर्या का भी अबलोकन राज! ने किया था जो कि अस्य लोकों में महादुलंभ और स्पृहणीय शोभा से समन्वित सी रचा
verses.wordMeaning: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•
verses.commentary: Sense: When presided over by Dhruva, those two reincords are dcagged, the sun revolves in circles within (the orbit)•

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सौरो वैद्युतश्च जाठरश्चप्यनिन्धनः । किञ्चिदप्सु मतं तेजः किञ्चिद्दृष्टमबिं धनम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsauro vaidyutaśca jāṭharaścapyanindhanaḥ / kiñcidapsu mataṃ tejaḥ kiñciddṛṣṭamabiṃ dhanam
verses.translation: These abide in the sun for the period of two months each in due order.
verses.hindi: मेने च हैहयपति भूं त्रि दुरलभिय क्षात्री मनोहरतरा सहिता
verses.wordMeaning: These abide in the sun for the period of two months each in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: These abide in the sun for the period of two months each in due order.

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठेन्धनस्तु निर्मथ्यः सो ऽद्भिः शाम्यति पावकः । अर्चिष्मान्पवमानो ऽग्निर्निष्प्रभो जाठरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhendhanastu nirmathyaḥ so 'dbhiḥ śāmyati pāvakaḥ / arciṣmānpavamāno 'gnirniṣprabho jāṭharaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: These verses (2-24) ecumierate the names of the different devw> sages etc.-tbe hqitad who occupy the solar chariot every month. These verses are common to the descrdoa of the Solar chariot in other Purioai e.g. the Mt. F. 125. 1«$4, Vk* 1-26 with slight differences in the names of the bccupaati of the chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: These verses (2-24) ecumierate the names of the different devw> sages etc.-tbe hqitad who occupy the solar chariot every month. These verses are common to the descrdoa of the Solar chariot in other Purioai e.g. the Mt. F. 125. 1«$4,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These verses (2-24) ecumierate the names of the different devw> sages etc.-tbe hqitad who occupy the solar chariot every month. These verses are common to the descrdoa of the Solar chariot in other Purioai e.g. the Mt. F. 125. 1«$4,…

verses.sanskrit: यश्चायं मण्डले शुक्लो निरूष्मा संप्रकाशकः । प्रभा सौरी तु पादेन ह्यस्तं याति देवाकरे
verses.transliteration: yaścāyaṃ maṇḍale śuklo nirūṣmā saṃprakāśakaḥ / prabhā saurī tu pādena hyastaṃ yāti devākare
verses.translation: Making the Pitt'S, Devas and Human beings well nourished, O Britbmanas, Savitf the cause of days and nights goes on revolving.
verses.wordMeaning: Making the Pitt'S, Devas and Human beings well nourished, O Britbmanas, Savitf the cause of days and nights goes on revolving.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making the Pitt'S, Devas and Human beings well nourished, O Britbmanas, Savitf the cause of days and nights goes on revolving.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमाविशते रात्रौ तस्माद्दूरात्प्रकाशते । उद्यन्तं च पुनः सूर्यमौष्णमयमाग्नेयमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: agnimāviśate rātrau tasmāddūrātprakāśate / udyantaṃ ca punaḥ sūryamauṣṇamayamāgneyamāviśat
verses.translation: These Devas reside in the sun for periods of two months in due order. These twelve groups of seven (orheptads) identify themselves with their place of office and residence.
verses.hindi: पोरे: समेत्य विविकाहणपाणिसि्च मार्गे मुदा विरचितां:
verses.wordMeaning: These Devas reside in the sun for periods of two months in due order. These twelve groups of seven (orheptads) identify themselves with their place of office and residence.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Devas reside in the sun for periods of two months in due order. These twelve groups of seven (orheptads) identify themselves with their place of office and residence.

verses.sanskrit: पादेन पार्थिवस्याग्नेस्तस्मादग्निस्तपत्यसौ । प्राकाश्यं च तथौष्ण्यं च सौराग्नेये तु तेजसी
verses.transliteration: pādena pārthivasyāgnestasmādagnistapatyasau / prākāśyaṃ ca tathauṣṇyaṃ ca saurāgneye tu tejasī
verses.translation: By means of their splendour they increase the excels lent splendour of the sun. By means of words (and prayers) composed by themselves, sages eulogise the sun.
verses.hindi: कक्षांतराणि नुषतिः अनकेरतोत्य ओणि क्रमेण च
verses.wordMeaning: By means of their splendour they increase the excels lent splendour of the sun. By means of words (and prayers) composed by themselves, sages eulogise the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of their splendour they increase the excels lent splendour of the sun. By means of words (and prayers) composed by themselves, sages eulogise the sun.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परानुप्रवेशादाप्यायेते परस्परम् । उत्तरे चैव भूम्यर्द्धे तथा ह्यग्निश्च दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: parasparānupraveśādāpyāyete parasparam / uttare caiva bhūmyarddhe tathā hyagniśca dakṣiṇe
verses.translation: The Gandharvas and the Apsaras serve him by means of songs and dances. The Grimaols, Yakas and Bhutas perform the worship of his rays.
verses.wordMeaning: The Gandharvas and the Apsaras serve him by means of songs and dances. The Grimaols, Yakas and Bhutas perform the worship of his rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gandharvas and the Apsaras serve him by means of songs and dances. The Grimaols, Yakas and Bhutas perform the worship of his rays.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठति पुनः सूर्ये रात्रिराविशते ह्यपः । तस्मात्तप्ता भवन्त्यापो दिवारत्रिप्रवेशनात्
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭhati punaḥ sūrye rātrirāviśate hyapaḥ / tasmāttaptā bhavantyāpo divāratripraveśanāt
verses.translation: The serpents carry the sun, the demons follow him. From sunrise to sunset, the Valakhilyas surround the sun and lead him on.
verses.wordMeaning: The serpents carry the sun, the demons follow him. From sunrise to sunset, the Valakhilyas surround the sun and lead him on.
verses.commentary: Sense: The serpents carry the sun, the demons follow him. From sunrise to sunset, the Valakhilyas surround the sun and lead him on.

verses.sanskrit: अस्तं याति पुन सूर्ये अहर्वै प्रविशत्यपः । तस्मान्नक्तं पुनः शुक्ला आपो ऽदृश्यन्त भास्वराः
verses.transliteration: astaṃ yāti puna sūrye aharvai praviśatyapaḥ / tasmānnaktaṃ punaḥ śuklā āpo 'dṛśyanta bhāsvarāḥ
verses.translation: All these followers of the day revolve along with the sun. They'shower rain on the subjects, they scorch them and they delight them (too).
verses.wordMeaning: All these followers of the day revolve along with the sun. They'shower rain on the subjects, they scorch them and they delight them (too).
verses.commentary: Sense: All these followers of the day revolve along with the sun. They'shower rain on the subjects, they scorch them and they delight them (too).

verses.sanskrit: एतेन क्रमयोगेन भूम्यर्द्धे दक्षिणोत्तरे । उदयास्तमने नित्यमहोरात्रं विशत्यपः
verses.transliteration: etena kramayogena bhūmyarddhe dakṣiṇottare / udayāstamane nityamahorātraṃ viśatyapaḥ
verses.translation: The sun releases heat energy during the summer. He scatters rain during the rainy season and snow (during winter). He is the maker of day and night. He keeps up his movement in accordance with (the changing) seasons and gratifies the Devos, the Pitrs and the human beings with the rays suitably adapted.
verses.hindi: क्षत्रियों के अधिपति ने उस नगर की सम्पदा को देखकर है राजन्! बचनों की भाति मन में बहुत ही अधिक प्रशंसा की थी। और हैहयपति ने यह् मान लिया था कि भूमण्डल में अधिक मनोहह हित के सहित क्षत्रियों की सम्पदा ऐसी परम दुलंभ है । अर्थात् क्षत्रियों को सम्पदा ऐसी कभी भी
verses.wordMeaning: The sun releases heat energy during the summer. He scatters rain during the rainy season and snow (during winter). He is the maker of day and night. He keeps up his movement in accordance with (the changing) seasons and gratifies the Devos,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun releases heat energy during the summer. He scatters rain during the rainy season and snow (during winter). He is the maker of day and night. He keeps up his movement in accordance with (the changing) seasons and gratifies the Devos,…

verses.sanskrit: यश्चासौ तपते सूर्यः पिबन्नंभो गभस्तिभिः । पार्थिवाग्निविमिश्रो ऽसौ दिव्यः शुचिरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yaścāsau tapate sūryaḥ pibannaṃbho gabhastibhiḥ / pārthivāgnivimiśro 'sau divyaḥ śuciriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: By means of the (ray) named Susumna, the sun develops the m(x>n in the bright iinlf day by day ami makes it complete (on the full moon day). He propitiates the Devas by means of the nectar. Tlic Devas imbibe it during the dark half.
verses.hindi: नहीं हो सकती है ।२६। सुरों के द्वारा समपित इस विप्रं की श्री के समक्ष में क्षत्रियों की श्री शतांश की भी तुलना प्राप्त करने में समर्थ नहीं होती है। पुर के मध्य में अपने पुरोहित और मन्तरियों के साथ में जब उस पुर के निवासियों के द्वारा उपचित विभूतिका आलोकन किया था तब राजा के
verses.wordMeaning: By means of the (ray) named Susumna, the sun develops the m(x>n in the bright iinlf day by day ami makes it complete (on the full moon day). He propitiates the Devas by means of the nectar. Tlic Devas imbibe it during the dark half.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of the (ray) named Susumna, the sun develops the m(x>n in the bright iinlf day by day ami makes it complete (on the full moon day). He propitiates the Devas by means of the nectar. Tlic Devas imbibe it during the dark half.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रपादसौ वह्निर्घृतकुंभनिभः शुचिः । आदत्ते स तु नाडीनां सहस्रेण समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: sahasrapādasau vahnirghṛtakuṃbhanibhaḥ śuciḥ / ādatte sa tu nāḍīnāṃ sahasreṇa samantataḥ
verses.translation: Men conquer (satisfy) hunger by means of food- stuffs and beverages and medicinal herbs developed by means of rain, with waters lifted up and released by means of his rays by the sun.
