verses.hindi: मन में विप्रश्ली की महत्ता कां ज्ञान हुआ था ।३०। जिस समय में राजा नगर में भीतर गमन कर रहा था उस समय में अपने पाव में चरण करने वालों के द्वारा सोधों का वर्ग उसे दिखाया गया था तया वहाँ के ग्रुरुजतों के द्वारा सभी ओर से वह पूज्यमान हो रहा था और उसको विशेष आनम्द प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Men conquer (satisfy) hunger by means of food- stuffs and beverages and medicinal herbs developed by means of rain, with waters lifted up and released by means of his rays by the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men conquer (satisfy) hunger by means of food- stuffs and beverages and medicinal herbs developed by means of rain, with waters lifted up and released by means of his rays by the sun.

verses.sanskrit: नादेयीश्चैव सामुद्रीः कौप्याश्चैव समन्ततः । स्थावरा जङ्गमाश्चैव याश्च कुल्यादिका अपः
verses.transliteration: nādeyīścaiva sāmudrīḥ kaupyāścaiva samantataḥ / sthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva yāśca kulyādikā apaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the sun traverses the quarters by means of his swift chariot with one wheel. The horses arc splendid but they do not have the usual pace* (? Ahamail ).
verses.hindi: था। उस समय में राजा से निवेदन किया गया था कि आप अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sun traverses the quarters by means of his swift chariot with one wheel. The horses arc splendid but they do not have the usual pace* (? Ahamail ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sun traverses the quarters by means of his swift chariot with one wheel. The horses arc splendid but they do not have the usual pace* (? Ahamail ).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रश्मिसहस्रं तु शीतवर्षोष्णनिःस्तवम् । तासां चतुःशता नाड्यो वर्षन्ते चित्र मूर्त्तयः
verses.transliteration: tasya raśmisahasraṃ tu śītavarṣoṣṇaniḥstavam / tāsāṃ catuḥśatā nāḍyo varṣante citra mūrttayaḥ
verses.translation: In the course of a day and night, the sun traverses the earth consisting of the seven continents and oceans by means of his chariot with a single wheel.
verses.hindi: सभी अनुचरों के सहित अपने स्वरूप के अनुरूप मुनिवर के द्वारा इस सपर्या का लाभ प्राप्त कीजिए ।३१। फिर राजा अपने स्वार्थ को तिवत्तित करके प्रकल्पित गृह की और अभिमुख होकर वहाँ से चला था। मार्ग में सभी ओर से अनेक प्रकार की पूजा को सामग्रो हाथों में ग्रहण किये हुए पुरवा-
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of a day and night, the sun traverses the earth consisting of the seven continents and oceans by means of his chariot with a single wheel.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of a day and night, the sun traverses the earth consisting of the seven continents and oceans by means of his chariot with a single wheel.

verses.sanskrit: चन्दनाश्चैव साध्यश्च कूतनाकूतनास्तथा । अमृता नामतः सर्वा रश्मयो वृष्टिसर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: candanāścaiva sādhyaśca kūtanākūtanāstathā / amṛtā nāmataḥ sarvā raśmayo vṛṣṭisarjanāḥ
verses.translation: Surrounded by Valakhilyas, they wander both night and day. The sun is cultised by great sages by means of words (and prayers) of the highest order and composed by themselves.
verses.hindi: सियों ने एकत्रित होकर अपने करों को जोड़कर उसका परमाधिक आतिथ्य सत्कार किया था और पद-पद पर जयकार के शब्दों के घोष से तथा सूर्य की ध्वनि से सभी दिशाओं को बधिर करते हुए उस राज़ा'का नगर निबा- सियों ने विशेष सम्मान किया था । फिर राजा ने क्रम से तीन अन्य कक्षं
verses.wordMeaning: Surrounded by Valakhilyas, they wander both night and day. The sun is cultised by great sages by means of words (and prayers) of the highest order and composed by themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surrounded by Valakhilyas, they wander both night and day. The sun is cultised by great sages by means of words (and prayers) of the highest order and composed by themselves.

verses.sanskrit: हिमोद्गताश्च ताभ्यो ऽन्या रश्मयस्त्रिशताः पुनः । दृश्या मेघाश्च याम्यश्च ह्रदिन्यो हिमसर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: himodgatāśca tābhyo 'nyā raśmayastriśatāḥ punaḥ / dṛśyā meghāśca yāmyaśca hradinyo himasarjanāḥ
verses.translation: The chariot of Soma (the Moon) has three wheels.* His horses have the lustre of Kunda (white Jasmine) flowers. They are ten in number and they are yoked to the lefl as well as to the right. The moon traverses by means of this.
verses.hindi: का अतिक्रमण किया था जिनमें बड़े ही संभ्रम ठाले कञ्चुकी वर्तमान ये ।
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot of Soma (the Moon) has three wheels.* His horses have the lustre of Kunda (white Jasmine) flowers. They are ten in number and they are yoked to the lefl as well as to the right. The moon traverses by means of this.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot of Soma (the Moon) has three wheels.* His horses have the lustre of Kunda (white Jasmine) flowers. They are ten in number and they are yoked to the lefl as well as to the right. The moon traverses by means of this.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रास्ता नामतः प्रोक्ता मिताभास्तु गभस्तयः । शुक्लाश्च कुहकाश्चैव गावो विश्वभृतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: candrāstā nāmataḥ proktā mitābhāstu gabhastayaḥ / śuklāśca kuhakāścaiva gāvo viśvabhṛtastathā
verses.translation: They traverse the stars supported by the Viihi (the path of the firmament). They gain velocity by means of the
verses.wordMeaning: They traverse the stars supported by the Viihi (the path of the firmament). They gain velocity by means of the
verses.commentary: Sense: They traverse the stars supported by the Viihi (the path of the firmament). They gain velocity by means of the

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लास्ता नामतः सर्वस्त्रिशता धर्मसर्जनाः । समं विभज्य नाडीस्तु मनुष्टपितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: śuklāstā nāmataḥ sarvastriśatā dharmasarjanāḥ / samaṃ vibhajya nāḍīstu manuṣṭapitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: This verse practically i>eatt V. 42 in different words.
verses.hindi: 3३२९-३३। उन कञुचुकियों के द्वारा दशक जनों के समूहों को अलग दूर में
verses.wordMeaning: This verse practically i>eatt V. 42 in different words.
verses.commentary: Sense: This verse practically i>eatt V. 42 in different words.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यानौषधेनेह स्वधया तु पितॄनपि । अमृतेन सुरान्सर्वांस्त्रींस्त्रिभिस्तर्पयत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: manuṣyānauṣadheneha svadhayā tu pitṝnapi / amṛtena surānsarvāṃstrīṃstribhistarpayatyasau
verses.translation: It should be known that the chariot of the moon has three wheels with horses on cither side. The chariot is born (i.e. evolved] out of the womb of the waters along with the horses and the charioteer.
verses.hindi: हटा दिया गया था जिस समय में राजा ने अन्दर अवेश किया था + स।
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the chariot of the moon has three wheels with horses on cither side. The chariot is born (i.e. evolved] out of the womb of the waters along with the horses and the charioteer.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the chariot of the moon has three wheels with horses on cither side. The chariot is born (i.e. evolved] out of the womb of the waters along with the horses and the charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: वसंते चैव ग्रीष्मे च शतैः स तपति त्रिभिः । वर्षास्वथो शरदि वै चतुर्भिश्च प्रवर्षति
verses.transliteration: vasaṃte caiva grīṣme ca śataiḥ sa tapati tribhiḥ / varṣāsvatho śaradi vai caturbhiśca pravarṣati
verses.translation: It has three wheels with hundred spokes. It is yoked with ten excellent white horses. Thev arc slim and divine. They arc unimpeded and they have the swiftness of the mind.
verses.hindi: गण बड़े ही आदर से राजा के पदार्णण करने के लिये हाथों से सद्कूत
verses.wordMeaning: It has three wheels with hundred spokes. It is yoked with ten excellent white horses. Thev arc slim and divine. They arc unimpeded and they have the swiftness of the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has three wheels with hundred spokes. It is yoked with ten excellent white horses. Thev arc slim and divine. They arc unimpeded and they have the swiftness of the mind.

verses.sanskrit: हेमन्ते शिशिरे चैव हिम मुत्सृजते त्रिभिः । इन्द्रो धाता भगः पूषा मित्रो ऽथ वरुणोर्ऽयमा
verses.transliteration: hemante śiśire caiva hima mutsṛjate tribhiḥ / indro dhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā mitro 'tha varuṇor'yamā
verses.translation: These (horses) carry the Moon-lord with great dedication (and respect). The moon traverses (its orbit) surrounded by the Devas and the phrs.
verses.hindi: रहे थे। भीतर नगर को कामिनियाँ विद्यमान ओऔ जो..राजा-का अचेन
verses.wordMeaning: These (horses) carry the Moon-lord with great dedication (and respect). The moon traverses (its orbit) surrounded by the Devas and the phrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: These (horses) carry the Moon-lord with great dedication (and respect). The moon traverses (its orbit) surrounded by the Devas and the phrs.

verses.sanskrit: अंशुर्विवस्वास्त्वष्टा च सविता विष्णुरेव च । माघमासे तु वरुणः पूषा चैव तु फलाल्गुने
verses.transliteration: aṃśurvivasvāstvaṣṭā ca savitā viṣṇureva ca / māghamāse tu varuṇaḥ pūṣā caiva tu phalālgune
verses.translation: At the end of the dark half and at the beginning of the bright half, when the sun is steady in the opposite direction, the moon is filled up, and as days pass by (the digits arc reinstilled).
verses.hindi: अदीपदधि-दर्पण-गन्ध-पुष्प-दूर्वा ओर अक्षत आदि से विशेष रूप से कर रहो
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the dark half and at the beginning of the bright half, when the sun is steady in the opposite direction, the moon is filled up, and as days pass by (the digits arc reinstilled).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the dark half and at the beginning of the bright half, when the sun is steady in the opposite direction, the moon is filled up, and as days pass by (the digits arc reinstilled).

verses.sanskrit: चैत्रे मासि तु देत्ॐशुर्धाता वैशाखतापनः । ज्येष्ठमासे भवेदिन्द्रश्चाषाढे सविता रविः
verses.transliteration: caitre māsi tu detoṃśurdhātā vaiśākhatāpanaḥ / jyeṣṭhamāse bhavedindraścāṣāḍhe savitā raviḥ
verses.translation: When the (nectarine) body of the moon has been imbibed by the Devas, it becomes exhausted on the fifteenth
verses.hindi: थो ।३४। फिर राजा उस राजभवन के अन्दर से लीलां के सहित बहुमान
verses.wordMeaning: When the (nectarine) body of the moon has been imbibed by the Devas, it becomes exhausted on the fifteenth
verses.commentary: Sense: When the (nectarine) body of the moon has been imbibed by the Devas, it becomes exhausted on the fifteenth

verses.sanskrit: विवस्वाञ्छ्रावणे मासि प्रोष्ठे मासे भागः स्मृतः । पर्जन्यो ऽश्वयुजे मासि त्वष्टा च कार्तिके रविः
verses.transliteration: vivasvāñchrāvaṇe māsi proṣṭhe māse bhāgaḥ smṛtaḥ / parjanyo 'śvayuje māsi tvaṣṭā ca kārtike raviḥ
verses.translation: By means of the ray called Susumna (the sun) fills a part (of the moon) (digit by digit) every day. On being replenished thus by the Susumna (ray), the white and bright digits increase.
verses.hindi: पूवंक आनन्दित होता हुआ निकला था । बहा पर' सम वयस्क उन पुर की
verses.wordMeaning: By means of the ray called Susumna (the sun) fills a part (of the moon) (digit by digit) every day. On being replenished thus by the Susumna (ray), the white and bright digits increase.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of the ray called Susumna (the sun) fills a part (of the moon) (digit by digit) every day. On being replenished thus by the Susumna (ray), the white and bright digits increase.

verses.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षे भवेन्मित्रः पौषेविष्णुः सनातनः । पञ्चरश्मिसहस्राणि वरुणस्यार्ककर्मणि
verses.transliteration: mārgaśīrṣe bhavenmitraḥ pauṣeviṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ / pañcaraśmisahasrāṇi varuṇasyārkakarmaṇi
verses.translation: During the dark half, the digits become reduced and they are developed (replenished) during the bright half. The moon is thus developed, due to the power of the sun.
verses.hindi: युवतियों कै द्वारा अनेक प्रकार-के रत्नों के प्रवेकः रुचि के जाल से'बिराज-
verses.wordMeaning: During the dark half, the digits become reduced and they are developed (replenished) during the bright half. The moon is thus developed, due to the power of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the dark half, the digits become reduced and they are developed (replenished) during the bright half. The moon is thus developed, due to the power of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: षड्भिः सहस्रैः पूषा तु देवो ऽशुसप्तभिस्तथा । धाताष्टभिः सहस्रैस्तु नवभिस्तु शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍbhiḥ sahasraiḥ pūṣā tu devo 'śusaptabhistathā / dhātāṣṭabhiḥ sahasraistu navabhistu śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: On the full Moon day, it appears bright in a com¬ plete disc. In the bright half, the moon is thus fully replenished
verses.hindi: मान बहुत ही शीक्ष एक उपवेशन करने-के लिए :आसन!/निवेशित किया
verses.wordMeaning: On the full Moon day, it appears bright in a com¬ plete disc. In the bright half, the moon is thus fully replenished
verses.commentary: Sense: On the full Moon day, it appears bright in a com¬ plete disc. In the bright half, the moon is thus fully replenished

verses.sanskrit: सविता दशभिर्याति यात्येकादशभिर्भगः । सप्तभिस्तपते सित्रस्त्वष्टा चैवाष्टभिस्तपेत्
verses.transliteration: savitā daśabhiryāti yātyekādaśabhirbhagaḥ / saptabhistapate sitrastvaṣṭā caivāṣṭabhistapet
verses.translation: On being imbibed gradually by the Pitrs and the Devas at the beginning of the dark half, the digits of the moon which face the sun become reduced gradually.
verses.wordMeaning: On being imbibed gradually by the Pitrs and the Devas at the beginning of the dark half, the digits of the moon which face the sun become reduced gradually.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being imbibed gradually by the Pitrs and the Devas at the beginning of the dark half, the digits of the moon which face the sun become reduced gradually.

verses.sanskrit: अर्यमा दशाभिर्याति पर्जन्यो नवभिस्तपेत् । षड्भी रश्मिसहस्रैस्तु विषणुस्तपति मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration: aryamā daśābhiryāti parjanyo navabhistapet / ṣaḍbhī raśmisahasraistu viṣaṇustapati medinīm
verses.translation: Thirtythrcc, three hundred (?) and three and three thousand and three Devas imbibe {the juice of) the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: Thirtythrcc, three hundred (?) and three and three thousand and three Devas imbibe {the juice of) the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirtythrcc, three hundred (?) and three and three thousand and three Devas imbibe {the juice of) the moon.

verses.sanskrit: वसंते कपिलः सूर्यो ग्रीष्मेर्ऽकः कनकप्रभः । श्वेतवर्णस्तु वर्षासु पाण्डुः शरदि भास्करः
verses.transliteration: vasaṃte kapilaḥ sūryo grīṣmer'kaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ / śvetavarṇastu varṣāsu pāṇḍuḥ śaradi bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: On being sucked thus, tht black digits of the moon increase. Hence, the white digits become reduced and the dark ones become increased.
verses.wordMeaning: On being sucked thus, tht black digits of the moon increase. Hence, the white digits become reduced and the dark ones become increased.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being sucked thus, tht black digits of the moon increase. Hence, the white digits become reduced and the dark ones become increased.

verses.sanskrit: हेमन्ते ताम्रवर्णस्तु शैशिरे लोहितो रविः । इति वर्णाः समा ख्याताः सूर्यस्यर्तुसमुद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: hemante tāmravarṇastu śaiśire lohito raviḥ / iti varṇāḥ samā khyātāḥ sūryasyartusamudbhavāḥ
verses.translation: The nectar of Svadha oozes from its rays on the New Moon day. After drinking that Svadha for their own satisfac* don (to the full) for the period of a month, those (Pitrs) go away.
verses.wordMeaning: The nectar of Svadha oozes from its rays on the New Moon day. After drinking that Svadha for their own satisfac* don (to the full) for the period of a month, those (Pitrs) go away.
verses.commentary: Sense: The nectar of Svadha oozes from its rays on the New Moon day. After drinking that Svadha for their own satisfac* don (to the full) for the period of a month, those (Pitrs) go away.

verses.sanskrit: औषधीषु बलं धत्ते स्वधया च पिदृष्वपि । सूर्यो ऽमरेष्वप्यमृतं त्रयं त्रिषु न यच्छति
verses.transliteration: auṣadhīṣu balaṃ dhatte svadhayā ca pidṛṣvapi / sūryo 'mareṣvapyamṛtaṃ trayaṃ triṣu na yacchati
verses.translation: They arc of three (varieties), the Saumyas, the Barhisads and the Agnisvattas. Those who are mendoned as Kavyas are all Picp.
verses.wordMeaning: They arc of three (varieties), the Saumyas, the Barhisads and the Agnisvattas. Those who are mendoned as Kavyas are all Picp.
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc of three (varieties), the Saumyas, the Barhisads and the Agnisvattas. Those who are mendoned as Kavyas are all Picp.

verses.sanskrit: एवं रश्मिसहस्रं तु सौरं लोकार्थसाधकम् । भिद्यते ऋतुमासाद्य जलशीतोष्णनिस्रवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ raśmisahasraṃ tu sauraṃ lokārthasādhakam / bhidyate ṛtumāsādya jalaśītoṣṇanisravam
verses.translation: The Kavyas are Saiiivatsaras, chose who are remem- be red by the Brahmanas as PaiUdbdAs (the five years). Saumyaa should be known as the tus and Barhisads are remembered as the Mdsas (Months).
verses.wordMeaning: The Kavyas are Saiiivatsaras, chose who are remem- be red by the Brahmanas as PaiUdbdAs (the five years). Saumyaa should be known as the tus and Barhisads are remembered as the Mdsas (Months).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kavyas are Saiiivatsaras, chose who are remem- be red by the Brahmanas as PaiUdbdAs (the five years). Saumyaa should be known as the tus and Barhisads are remembered as the Mdsas (Months).

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतन्मण्डलं शुक्लं भास्वरं सूर्य संज्ञितम् । नक्षत्रग्रहसोमानां प्रतिष्ठा योनिरेव च
verses.transliteration: ityetanmaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ bhāsvaraṃ sūrya saṃjñitam / nakṣatragrahasomānāṃ pratiṣṭhā yonireva ca
verses.translation: The increase and decrease of the moon arc remembered (as occurring) on the sixteenth day at the beginning of a fort¬ night* It is thus that the increase and decrease in the moon occur on account of the sun.
verses.wordMeaning: The increase and decrease of the moon arc remembered (as occurring) on the sixteenth day at the beginning of a fort¬ night* It is thus that the increase and decrease in the moon occur on account of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The increase and decrease of the moon arc remembered (as occurring) on the sixteenth day at the beginning of a fort¬ night* It is thus that the increase and decrease in the moon occur on account of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रऋक्षग्रहाः सर्वे विज्ञेयाः सूर्यसंभवाः । नक्षत्राधिपतिः सोमो ग्रह राजो दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: candraṛkṣagrahāḥ sarve vijñeyāḥ sūryasaṃbhavāḥ / nakṣatrādhipatiḥ somo graha rājo divākaraḥ
verses.translation: Again (i.e. henceforth), I shall describe the chariots of the stars, planets and Ru.
verses.wordMeaning: Again (i.e. henceforth), I shall describe the chariots of the stars, planets and Ru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again (i.e. henceforth), I shall describe the chariots of the stars, planets and Ru.

verses.sanskrit: शेषाः पञ्च ग्रहा ज्ञेया ईश्वराः कामचारिणः । पठ्यते चाग्निरादित्य उदकं चन्द्रमाः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śeṣāḥ pañca grahā jñeyā īśvarāḥ kāmacāriṇaḥ / paṭhyate cāgnirāditya udakaṃ candramāḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Riding in a chariot of black steel (iron) fitted with stroi horses born of the firmament, the Saturn proceeds ahead very slowly.
verses.hindi: बह उदार यश बाला राजा बहुत ही बारीक 'वर्त्राका छादन जिस
verses.wordMeaning: Riding in a chariot of black steel (iron) fitted with stroi horses born of the firmament, the Saturn proceeds ahead very slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Riding in a chariot of black steel (iron) fitted with stroi horses born of the firmament, the Saturn proceeds ahead very slowly.

verses.sanskrit: शेषाणा प्रकृतीः स्मयग्वर्ण्यमाना निबोधत । सुरसेनापतिः स्कन्दः पठ्यते ऽङ्गारको ग्रहः
verses.transliteration: śeṣāṇā prakṛtīḥ smayagvarṇyamānā nibodhata / surasenāpatiḥ skandaḥ paṭhyate 'ṅgārako grahaḥ
verses.translation: All of them are fastened to Dhruva by means of gaseous rays. They are fully developed. While whirling duly they blaze as well.
verses.hindi: पर हो रहा शा ओर नीचे सुवण का विष्टरः जिसमें शा ऐसे; उस परम- मनोहर आसन प्रर अध्यासित, हो गये थे.। है जप ! उस गृह में उसकी पुरन्ध्रियों के समुदाय ने अपने आसन पर शीघ्र ही समासीन राजा का अनेक पूजन के उपचारों से अचंन किया था ।३६। इसके 'उंपरोन्त बाद्यों के
verses.wordMeaning: All of them are fastened to Dhruva by means of gaseous rays. They are fully developed. While whirling duly they blaze as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them are fastened to Dhruva by means of gaseous rays. They are fully developed. While whirling duly they blaze as well.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं बुधं प्राहुर्वेदज्ञानविदो बुधाः । रुद्रो वैवस्वतः साक्षाद्यमो लोकप्रभुः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ budhaṃ prāhurvedajñānavido budhāḥ / rudro vaivasvataḥ sākṣādyamo lokaprabhuḥ svayam
verses.translation: (Repetition) They arc fully developed due to invisible gaseous rays. Being bound (to Dhruva) by means of these, the moon, the sun and the planets revolve in the firmament.
verses.hindi: बादन आदि के द्वारा और भूषण--गन्ध--पुष्प-बस्त्र आदि अलङक्ृतियों से राजा का विशेष आनन्द बढ़ा दिया था । बहाँ पर सम्पूर्ण दिन में होने वाले समुचितः कमं से निवृत्, होकर उस हैहयपति ने अपने मत के अनुसार पूरे दिवस को व्यतीत किया था ।३७। यहाँ पर उस राजा का पूरा दिन अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: (Repetition) They arc fully developed due to invisible gaseous rays. Being bound (to Dhruva) by means of these, the moon, the sun and the planets revolve in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Repetition) They arc fully developed due to invisible gaseous rays. Being bound (to Dhruva) by means of these, the moon, the sun and the planets revolve in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: महाग्रहो द्विजश्रेष्ठो मन्दगामी शनैश्वरः । देवासुरगुरू द्वौ तु भानुमन्तौ महा ग्रहौ
verses.transliteration: mahāgraho dvijaśreṣṭho mandagāmī śanaiśvaraḥ / devāsuragurū dvau tu bhānumantau mahā grahau
verses.translation: There are as many bonds of gaseous rays as there are stars. All of them arc fastened to Dhruva. They whirl them¬ selves and they make others also revolve.
verses.hindi: तरह के आलयन-नर्मवचन-विचित्र आनन्द केलियों और मेली भाति प्रेक्षण आदि के समाचरण से” व्यतीत! हुआ 'थाः। फिर जब संन्ध्यों।का समय हो गया तो उसने दिनान्त में होने वाले उचित कर्मों से-लिबृत्ति प्राप्त की शी और फ़िर बह राजा सभी,ओर से अपने मन्त्रीगश् और सचिवों से अनुगत
verses.wordMeaning: There are as many bonds of gaseous rays as there are stars. All of them arc fastened to Dhruva. They whirl them¬ selves and they make others also revolve.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are as many bonds of gaseous rays as there are stars. All of them arc fastened to Dhruva. They whirl them¬ selves and they make others also revolve.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिसुतावेतावुभौ शुक्रबृहस्पती । आदित्यमूलमखिलं त्रैलोक्यं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatisutāvetāvubhau śukrabṛhaspatī / ādityamūlamakhilaṃ trailokyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Just as the oil-rollers whirl and cause the wheel also to whirl so also do the luminaries fixed (to Dhruva) on all sides by means of gaseous rays.
verses.hindi: हो गया था ।३८। समीप में वत्त मान मुत्यों के करों में अनेक प्रदीप संस्थित थे जिनसे रात्रिका परम गहन अन्धकार शान्त हो गया था। उस समय में 'राजा/अपनो/स भाःमें: प्राप्ततहो गया का वहाँ पर -वहअपने आसन पर बिराजमान हो! गया तथा और सेकड़ों पुरोहित--मन्‍्त्री--सामन्‍्त ःओर
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the oil-rollers whirl and cause the wheel also to whirl so also do the luminaries fixed (to Dhruva) on all sides by means of gaseous rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the oil-rollers whirl and cause the wheel also to whirl so also do the luminaries fixed (to Dhruva) on all sides by means of gaseous rays.

verses.sanskrit: भवत्यस्माज्जगत्कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम् । रुद्रोपेन्द्रेन्द्रचन्द्राणां विप्रेन्द्रास्त्रिदिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: bhavatyasmājjagatkṛtsnaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam / rudropendrendracandrāṇāṃ viprendrāstridivaukasām
verses.translation: Thus the group of planets attached to Dhruva, moves about. This Gangetic porpoise and Dhruva should be known as made up of constellations in the firmament.
verses.hindi: नायकों केःद्वारा समुप्रासित हो रहा -गा॥३९। उस राज सभा में नाताशभ्नाति के'बिनोंदों से बह परम हथित होकर बैठा हुआ भा जिस तरहः केखगणों.से
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the group of planets attached to Dhruva, moves about. This Gangetic porpoise and Dhruva should be known as made up of constellations in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the group of planets attached to Dhruva, moves about. This Gangetic porpoise and Dhruva should be known as made up of constellations in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: द्युतिर्द्युतिमतां कृत्स्नं यत्तेजः सार्वलौकिकम् । सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकेशो महादेवः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: dyutirdyutimatāṃ kṛtsnaṃ yattejaḥ sārvalaukikam / sarvātmā sarvalokeśo mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: On the top of the Meru Mountain, single-handed he whirls when he pulls them with face down. He observes Mcru at the border and circumambulates it.
verses.hindi: २०६   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण समन्वित सुरेन्द्र होवे इसके. अनन्तरः बहुत समय तकत. अनेक वाद्यं का बादन, आमोद-प्रमोद-तृत्य, और ग्रेक्षण में प्रवृत हास्यविलास तथा कथाओं के प्रसझ्ों में वह प्रसक्त हो गया था।४०। वहाँ पर गणिकाजनों के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: On the top of the Meru Mountain, single-handed he whirls when he pulls them with face down. He observes Mcru at the border and circumambulates it.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the top of the Meru Mountain, single-handed he whirls when he pulls them with face down. He observes Mcru at the border and circumambulates it.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य एव त्रिलोकस्य सूलं परमदैवतम् । ततः संजायते सर्वं तत्र चैव प्रलीयते
verses.transliteration: sūrya eva trilokasya sūlaṃ paramadaivatam / tataḥ saṃjāyate sarvaṃ tatra caiva pralīyate
verses.translation: What has been described in details by your honour is about the abodes. Now describe to us how may be the abodes cf gods and how arc the luminaries.
verses.hindi: प्रणय प्रवर्धंक नमें वचन-हास-क्रीड़ा और विलास से उसने अपने चित्त की वृत्ति को परितोषित किया था । इस रीति से क्षत्रियों के स्वामी उस राजा ने भिक्षा के अघंभाग को अत्यधिक रूप से अनेक प्रकार के विहार के वेभव के अनुभवों से व्यतीत किया था ।४१। फिर उस राजा ने अपने अनुगामी
verses.wordMeaning: What has been described in details by your honour is about the abodes. Now describe to us how may be the abodes cf gods and how arc the luminaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: What has been described in details by your honour is about the abodes. Now describe to us how may be the abodes cf gods and how arc the luminaries.

verses.sanskrit: भावाभावौ हि लोकानामादित्यान्निःमृतौ पुरा । जगज्ज्ञेयो ग्रहो विप्रा दीप्तिमान्सुप्रभो रविः
verses.transliteration: bhāvābhāvau hi lokānāmādityānniḥmṛtau purā / jagajjñeyo graho viprā dīptimānsuprabho raviḥ
verses.translation: When this universe rema ned in the form of alt the original (Elements )and the specific particularities (distinc¬
verses.hindi: नरपतियों को रवाना कर स्वयं भी वह अपने अवन में चला गया था। उससे राजा की सेना के जो सॅनिक ये वे सभी उन गृहों में अपने शौयंवीये- सम्पत्-प्रभाव ओर महिमा के ही अनुकून प्राप्त करने वाले ये
verses.wordMeaning: When this universe rema ned in the form of alt the original (Elements )and the specific particularities (distinc¬
verses.commentary: Sense: When this universe rema ned in the form of alt the original (Elements )and the specific particularities (distinc¬

verses.sanskrit: अत्र गच्छन्ति निधनं जायन्ते च पुनः पुनः । क्षणा मुहूर्त्ता दिवसा निशाः पक्षाश्च कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: atra gacchanti nidhanaṃ jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ / kṣaṇā muhūrttā divasā niśāḥ pakṣāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: The fires born of water arc three, viz.: Vaidyut (Lightening) Jdfhara (gastric) and Saura (Solar). It is on account of this, that the sun blazes in the heaven after drinking water by means of his rays.
verses.wordMeaning: The fires born of water arc three, viz.: Vaidyut (Lightening) Jdfhara (gastric) and Saura (Solar). It is on account of this, that the sun blazes in the heaven after drinking water by means of his rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fires born of water arc three, viz.: Vaidyut (Lightening) Jdfhara (gastric) and Saura (Solar). It is on account of this, that the sun blazes in the heaven after drinking water by means of his rays.

verses.sanskrit: मासाः संवत्सराश्चैव ऋतवो ऽथ युगानि च । तदादित्यादृते ह्येषा कालंसख्या न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: māsāḥ saṃvatsarāścaiva ṛtavo 'tha yugāni ca / tadādityādṛte hyeṣā kālaṃsakhyā na vidyate
verses.translation: The (fire) Vdrfya (originating from Var,\d or rain) contained in lighten ng, does not become cool by means of water. The fire that abides within the stomach of human beings does not become cool by means of water.
verses.wordMeaning: The (fire) Vdrfya (originating from Var,\d or rain) contained in lighten ng, does not become cool by means of water. The fire that abides within the stomach of human beings does not become cool by means of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The (fire) Vdrfya (originating from Var,\d or rain) contained in lighten ng, does not become cool by means of water. The fire that abides within the stomach of human beings does not become cool by means of water.

verses.sanskrit: कालादृते न निगमो न दीक्षा नाह्निकक्रमः । ऋतूनामविभागाच्च पुष्पमूलफलं कुतः
verses.transliteration: kālādṛte na nigamo na dīkṣā nāhnikakramaḥ / ṛtūnāmavibhāgācca puṣpamūlaphalaṃ kutaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, the solar fire, the Vaidyuta fire and the gastric fire are fires that have water for their fuel.
verses.hindi: अध्यास्य रत्ननिकरेरति शोभि भद्रं निद्रामसेवत नरेंद्र
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the solar fire, the Vaidyuta fire and the gastric fire are fires that have water for their fuel.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the solar fire, the Vaidyuta fire and the gastric fire are fires that have water for their fuel.

verses.sanskrit: कुतः सस्यविनिष्पत्तिस्तृणौषधिगणो ऽपि वा । अभावो व्यवहाराणां जन्तूनां दिवि चैह च
verses.transliteration: kutaḥ sasyaviniṣpattistṛṇauṣadhigaṇo 'pi vā / abhāvo vyavahārāṇāṃ jantūnāṃ divi caiha ca
verses.translation: The irmatkya fire (i.e. the fire produced by churn¬ ing or friction) has wood for its fuel. That fire is brought under control by means of water.
verses.hindi: के सब सैनिक गण अपने स्वरूप के अनुरूप वेभवों में वेश कीमती वस्श्र-लक् और भूषण आदि के द्वारा अत्यक्चिक मुदित हुए थे। उस राजा के सैनिक विविध प्रकार के अन्न-पान-अच्छे भोकष्य-भोज्य-मधु-मांस-पय और चृत आदि से परम तृप्त हो गये थे। उस नरेन्द्र की पुरी में जैसे देवगण
verses.wordMeaning: The irmatkya fire (i.e. the fire produced by churn¬ ing or friction) has wood for its fuel. That fire is brought under control by means of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The irmatkya fire (i.e. the fire produced by churn¬ ing or friction) has wood for its fuel. That fire is brought under control by means of water.

verses.sanskrit: जगत्प्रतापनमृते भास्करं वारितस्करम् । स एष कालश्चाग्निश्च द्वादशात्मा प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: jagatpratāpanamṛte bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram / sa eṣa kālaścāgniśca dvādaśātmā prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: (The same is the case with) the fire without heat that is in the zone (of the sun). It is white and it illuminates.
verses.hindi: कात्तिक्रैय द्वारा कामधेनु को मांग   २०७ स्वे में सब कुछ प्राप्त किया करते हैं उसी भाति उन्होंने सैनिकों ने भी सुखों के उपभोगों के द्वारा सम्पूर्ण आनन्दप्रद पदार्थों की प्राप्ति की थीं । इस रीति से बे जो उस नृपति के अनुगामी ये वे सब अनेक प्रकार के समु-
verses.wordMeaning: (The same is the case with) the fire without heat that is in the zone (of the sun). It is white and it illuminates.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The same is the case with) the fire without heat that is in the zone (of the sun). It is white and it illuminates.

verses.sanskrit: तपत्येष द्विजश्रेष्ठास्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । स एष तेचसां राशिस्तमो घ्रन्सार्वलौकिकम्
verses.transliteration: tapatyeṣa dvijaśreṣṭhāstrailokyaṃ sacarācaram / sa eṣa tecasāṃ rāśistamo ghransārvalaukikam
verses.translation: When the sun sets, the day enters waters. Hence, during the night, the waters are seen white (and sparkling).
verses.hindi: चित सुखौं के अनुभव से समाश्वस्त हो गये थे ।४४ वे सब परस्पर में एक दूसरे से कह रहे थे कि अपने घर और घन आदि के द्वारा क्या साधन किया जाता है अर्थात् अपने घरों में यहाँ से अधिक कया यहां के समान भी कोई साधन प्राप्त नहीं होते हैं। हम सब तो अब यहां पर निवास करना चाहते
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun sets, the day enters waters. Hence, during the night, the waters are seen white (and sparkling).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun sets, the day enters waters. Hence, during the night, the waters are seen white (and sparkling).

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं मार्गमास्थाय वायोर्भाभिरिदं जगत् । पार्श्वमूर्ध्वमधश्चैव तापयत्येष सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ mārgamāsthāya vāyorbhābhiridaṃ jagat / pārśvamūrdhvamadhaścaiva tāpayatyeṣa sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.hindi: हैं। फिर उस राजा ने भो शबरो का जो भी कुछ विधान भा उसे पूर्ण करके वह भी अपने निवास के भवन में दिव्य शय्या पर पहुँच गये थे । जो शम्पा रत्नों के समुदाय के प्रकाश से अतीब शोभित थो ओर परमोत्तम भी हे नरेन्द्र  निश्चिन्त होकर चिरकाल पर्यन्त निद्रा के सुख का सेवन किया
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रभाकरो दीपोगृहमध्ये ऽवलंबितः । पार्श्वमूर्ध्वमधश्चैव तमो नाशयते समम्
verses.transliteration: yathā prabhākaro dīpogṛhamadhye 'valaṃbitaḥ / pārśvamūrdhvamadhaścaiva tamo nāśayate samam
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वत्सहस्रकिरणो ग्रहराजो जगत्पतिः । सूर्यो गोभिर्जगत्सर्वमादीपयति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tadvatsahasrakiraṇo graharājo jagatpatiḥ / sūryo gobhirjagatsarvamādīpayati sarvataḥ
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: रवे रश्मिसहस्रं यत्प्राङ्मया समुदात्दृतम् । तेषां श्रेष्ठाः पुनः सप्त रश्मयो ग्रहयो नयः
verses.transliteration: rave raśmisahasraṃ yatprāṅmayā samudātdṛtam / teṣāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ punaḥ sapta raśmayo grahayo nayaḥ
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: सुषुम्णो हरिकेशश्च विश्वकर्मा तथैव च । विश्वश्रवाः पुनश्चान्यः संपद्वसुरतः परः
verses.transliteration: suṣumṇo harikeśaśca viśvakarmā tathaiva ca / viśvaśravāḥ punaścānyaḥ saṃpadvasurataḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: अर्वावसुः पुनश्चान्यः स्वराडन्यः प्रकीर्त्तितः । सुषुम्णः सूर्यरश्मिस्तु क्षीण शशिनमेधयेत्
verses.transliteration: arvāvasuḥ punaścānyaḥ svarāḍanyaḥ prakīrttitaḥ / suṣumṇaḥ sūryaraśmistu kṣīṇa śaśinamedhayet
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.hindi: वंसिक्घ जी ने कहा --जिस समय में राजा शयन कर रहे थे और प्रातः कालीन गौने का समय हो गया था तो सूत--मागध और वन्दीगण वहाँ पर आकर उपस्थित हो गये थे । निशा के अवमान में उन्होंने अव्यग्र होते हुए राजा को प्रबोध कराने कें लिये समुच्च स्वर से गायन किया था ।१। बह
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यगूर्ध्वप्रचारो ऽसौ सुषुम्णः परिकीर्त्तितः । हरि केशः पुरस्ताद्य ऋक्षयोनिः स कीत्यते
verses.transliteration: tiryagūrdhvapracāro 'sau suṣumṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥ / hari keśaḥ purastādya ṛkṣayoniḥ sa kītyate
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.hindi: “उनका गाने वीणा-वेणु को ध्वनि से मिला हुआ मधुर और ताल के विस्तार 'के अनुरूप था तथा समस्तों के श्रवण करने में सुश्राव्य था ओर परम प्रशस्त एकं मधुर स्वर वाला था ।२। उनका कष्ठ बहुत ही स्नग्ध था । ऐसे उन्होंने 'विशेष रूप से सुस्पष्ट मूच्छंना और ग्रांम से संयुत था । तार (अत्युच्च) और
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे विश्वकर्मा तु रश्मिन्वर्द्धयते वुधम् । विश्वश्रवास्तु यः पश्चच्छुक्रयोनिः स्मृतो बुधैः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇe viśvakarmā tu raśminvarddhayate vudham / viśvaśravāstu yaḥ paścacchukrayoniḥ smṛto budhaiḥ
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.hindi: ' न्द्र लब से समन्वित बहुत ही मेन को हेरंण करेने वाला गान उन्होंने गाया चाह राजा को जगाने की इच्छा रखने वाले उन सूंतों और मोगधों ने ' सोते हुए उस महान् आत्मा वाले राजा से धोरे-घीरे कहा था ।४। हे राजेन्द्र ! इस समय में यह चन्द्र पराजित होकर अस्त को प्रान हो रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: संपद्वसुस्तु यो रश्मिः स योनिर्लोहितस्य तु । षष्ठस्त्वर्व्वावसू रश्मिर्योनिस्तु स बृहस्पतेः
verses.transliteration: saṃpadvasustu yo raśmiḥ sa yonirlohitasya tu / ṣaṣṭhastvarvvāvasū raśmiryonistu sa bṛhaspateḥ
verses.translation: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि आपकी बढ़ो, हुई मुख कमल , को शोभा से इसका पराजय हो गया है । अब आप प्रबुद्ध होकर इसका अवलोकन कीजिए .।५। है विभो ! इस समय में आपके मुख कमल को देखने के लिये बहुत ही उत्सुक की भांति अन्धकारों का भेदन करता हुआ सूर्य हैवं 'उदय को प्राप्त हो गेये हैं ।६। हे
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that blazes imbibii water by means of his rays, is remembered as the divine iuci (pure) fire that is com¬ bined with the terrestrial fire.

verses.translation: He scorches the three worlds iaclusive of the mobile and immobile beings, O excellent Brahmanas.

verses.wordMeaning: He scorches the three worlds iaclusive of the mobile and immobile beings, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He scorches the three worlds iaclusive of the mobile and immobile beings, O excellent Brahmanas.

verses.wordMeaning: After resorting to the excellent path of the wind, he gives heat to this entire universe by means of his rays, at the sides, above and below, nay, at all sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: After resorting to the excellent path of the wind, he gives heat to this entire universe by means of his rays, at the sides, above and below, nay, at all sides.

verses.wordMeaning: The most excellent among the thousand rays of the sun cited by me before, are the seven rays that are the sources of origin of the planets.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यः सर्वगतो देवस्त्वदृते ऽस्ति समीरण । एष वै जीवलोकस्ते प्रत्यक्षः सर्वतो ऽनिल
verses.transliteration: nānyaḥ sarvagato devastvadṛte 'sti samīraṇa / eṣa vai jīvalokaste pratyakṣaḥ sarvato 'nila
verses.translation: Visvakarman, the ray to the south, right, nur¬ tures Budha(Mercury). Viivairavas the ray to the west, behind, is remembered by learned men as the source of origin of Sukra (the Venus).
verses.hindi: द्वारा उस धेनु को स्वीकार कर ही लेना चाहिए अर्थात् किसी भी रीति से उसको अपने अधिकार में ले ही लेना उचित है। इसका कारण यही है कि आप तो ऐसे रत्नों का सेवन करने वाले हैं। जो तप को ही अपना घैर्न माना कैरते हैं ऐसे तपस्वियों को ऐसे रत्नों के संग्रहण करने का समादेर
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarman, the ray to the south, right, nur¬ tures Budha(Mercury). Viivairavas the ray to the west, behind, is remembered by learned men as the source of origin of Sukra (the Venus).
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarman, the ray to the south, right, nur¬ tures Budha(Mercury). Viivairavas the ray to the west, behind, is remembered by learned men as the source of origin of Sukra (the Venus).

verses.sanskrit: वेत्थ वाचस्पतिं देवं मनोनायकमीश्वरम् । ब्रूहि तत्कण्ठदेशे तु किं कृत्वा रूपविक्रिया
verses.transliteration: vettha vācaspatiṃ devaṃ manonāyakamīśvaram / brūhi tatkaṇṭhadeśe tu kiṃ kṛtvā rūpavikriyā
verses.translation: This U a peculiar way of associating the particular ray of the sun as the source of origin of particular planet:
verses.wordMeaning: This U a peculiar way of associating the particular ray of the sun as the source of origin of particular planet:
verses.commentary: Sense: This U a peculiar way of associating the particular ray of the sun as the source of origin of particular planet:

verses.sanskrit: वचः श्रुत्वा ततस्तेषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम । प्रत्युवाच महातेजा वायुर्ल्लोकनमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: vacaḥ śrutvā tatasteṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanāma / pratyuvāca mahātejā vāyurllokanamaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The divine spheres of the sun and the moon are sparkling and white. They are of the form (or full of) of fire and water. They move about in the firmament. They resemble auspicious round pots.
verses.hindi: कहीँ भी नहीं होता हैं ।१८। वहू तपोधन बल दाला ऋषि तो परम शान्त स्वभाव वाला है और है नृप ! बह आप में प्रीति रखने बाला भौ है। इस कारण से जब भी आपके द्वारा याचना उससे की जायगी तो बह सब प्रकार से उस धेनु को दे देगा ।-६। अयवा यह भी होसकता हैं कि वह कुछ अधिक
verses.wordMeaning: The divine spheres of the sun and the moon are sparkling and white. They are of the form (or full of) of fire and water. They move about in the firmament. They resemble auspicious round pots.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine spheres of the sun and the moon are sparkling and white. They are of the form (or full of) of fire and water. They move about in the firmament. They resemble auspicious round pots.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगे विप्रो वेदनिर्णयतत्परः । वसिष्ठो नाम धर्मात्मा मानसो वै प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayuge vipro vedanirṇayatatparaḥ / vasiṣṭho nāma dharmātmā mānaso vai prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: W. 72-77. Our author takes iatercit in popular etymologies. Here are some specimens:
verses.hindi: इच्छा रखता होवे तो अन्य गौ और सुवर्णे आदि जो-जो भी उसका अभी- प्सित हो वह बहुत-सा घन एकणित करके उसको दे दिया जावे तो बह इस सबके बदले में उस धेनु का प्रतिदान अवश्य ही कर देगा।६०। मेरी बुद्धि तो यही है कि भूति की अभिलाषा रखने बाले राजा के द्वारा ऐसे महान्
verses.wordMeaning: W. 72-77. Our author takes iatercit in popular etymologies. Here are some specimens:
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 72-77. Our author takes iatercit in popular etymologies. Here are some specimens:

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छ कार्त्तिकेयं वै मयूरवरवाहनम् । महिषासुरनारीणां नयनाञ्जनतस्करम्
verses.transliteration: papraccha kārttikeyaṃ vai mayūravaravāhanam / mahiṣāsuranārīṇāṃ nayanāñjanataskaram
verses.translation: All the stars enter the Mak,nairas (abodes meant for constellation) and stars. AU these are the luminary abodes of those who are pious-souled and meritorious.
verses.hindi: रत्न की कभी भी उपेक्षा नहीं करनी चाहिए । आप इस विचारणीय बिषय में कैसा अपना मत रखते हैं ? ।६१। राजा ने मन्त्री के मत का श्रवण करके कहा था - है मर्तिन् ! आप दी यहाँ गमन कीजिए और विशेष रूप से उस चिप्र को प्रसन्न कीजिए तथा जो भी कुछ उसका अभिवान्छित हो उस
verses.wordMeaning: All the stars enter the Mak,nairas (abodes meant for constellation) and stars. AU these are the luminary abodes of those who are pious-souled and meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the stars enter the Mak,nairas (abodes meant for constellation) and stars. AU these are the luminary abodes of those who are pious-souled and meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: महासेनं महात्मनं मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम् । उमामनः प्रहर्षाणां बारकच्छद्मरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: mahāsenaṃ mahātmanaṃ meghastanitanisvanam / umāmanaḥ praharṣāṇāṃ bārakacchadmarūpiṇam
verses.translation: These (abodes) have been created by the self-bom lord (Brahma) at the beginning of a Kalpa and they have begun to function since then. These abodes remain till the annihilation of all living beings (at the end of the world).
verses.hindi: सबको उसे प्रदान करके उस धेनु को यहाँ पर ले आइए ।६२। बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--इस रीति से जब राजा के द्वारा कहा गया थां तो बह मन्त्री भाग्य के विधान से प्रेरित होकर शीध्र ही वापिस होकर जमदग्नि मुनि के आश्रम में चला गया था
verses.wordMeaning: These (abodes) have been created by the self-bom lord (Brahma) at the beginning of a Kalpa and they have begun to function since then. These abodes remain till the annihilation of all living beings (at the end of the world).
verses.commentary: Sense: These (abodes) have been created by the self-bom lord (Brahma) at the beginning of a Kalpa and they have begun to function since then. These abodes remain till the annihilation of all living beings (at the end of the world).

verses.sanskrit: क्रैञ्चजीवितहर्तारं गौरीहृदयनन्दनम् । यदेतद्दृश्यते वर्य शुभ्रं शुभ्राञ्जनोपमम्
verses.transliteration: kraiñcajīvitahartāraṃ gaurīhṛdayanandanam / yadetaddṛśyate varya śubhraṃ śubhrāñjanopamam
verses.translation: Lord 8ukra, belonging to Bhiu clan should be known as the performer of sacrifices on behalf of the Asuras.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord 8ukra, belonging to Bhiu clan should be known as the performer of sacrifices on behalf of the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord 8ukra, belonging to Bhiu clan should be known as the performer of sacrifices on behalf of the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: तत्किमर्थं समुत्पन्नं कण्ठे कण्ठेकुन्देन्दुसप्रभे । एतद्दीप्तांय दान्ताय भक्ताय ब्रूहि पृच्छते
verses.transliteration: tatkimarthaṃ samutpannaṃ kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhekundendusaprabhe / etaddīptāṃya dāntāya bhaktāya brūhi pṛcchate
verses.translation: These arc mentioned as the abodes and those who occupy the abodes are deities.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मन्तृपतिनाउज्नष्तं राजा तु भूवि रत्नभाक् । रत्तभूता च घेनु: सा भवि दोरधरीष्वनुत्तमा
verses.wordMeaning: These arc mentioned as the abodes and those who occupy the abodes are deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: These arc mentioned as the abodes and those who occupy the abodes are deities.

verses.sanskrit: कथां मङ्गलसंयुक्तां पवित्रां पापनाशिनीम् । मत्प्रियार्थंमहाभाग वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kathāṃ maṅgalasaṃyuktāṃ pavitrāṃ pāpanāśinīm / matpriyārthaṃmahābhāga vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The abode of Svarbhanu is Tdmasa (dark). It is the abode of those who cause the distress of all living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of Svarbhanu is Tdmasa (dark). It is the abode of those who cause the distress of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of Svarbhanu is Tdmasa (dark). It is the abode of those who cause the distress of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ततस्तस्य वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजा देवारिबलसूदनः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vākyaṃ tatastasya vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ / pratyuvāca mahātejā devāribalasūdanaḥ
verses.translation: The diameter and extent of the sphere of Bhargava (the Venus) it laid down as one-sixteenth of that of the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: The diameter and extent of the sphere of Bhargava (the Venus) it laid down as one-sixteenth of that of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diameter and extent of the sphere of Bhargava (the Venus) it laid down as one-sixteenth of that of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: शृणुष्व वदतां श्रेष्टकथ्यमानं वचो मम । उमोत्संगोपविष्टेन यथापूर्वं मया श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇuṣva vadatāṃ śreṣṭakathyamānaṃ vaco mama / umotsaṃgopaviṣṭena yathāpūrvaṃ mayā śrutam
verses.translation: Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one- fourth less than the Venus (i.e. three fourths of its size).
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one- fourth less than the Venus (i.e. three fourths of its size).
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one- fourth less than the Venus (i.e. three fourths of its size).

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्या सह संवादः शर्वस्य च महात्मनः । तमहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि त्वत्प्रियार्थं महामुने
verses.transliteration: pārvatyā saha saṃvādaḥ śarvasya ca mahātmanaḥ / tamahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvatpriyārthaṃ mahāmune
verses.translation: The stars and constellations differ in extent from one another by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred and also two hundred Yojanas.
verses.hindi: उस राजा के आश्रम से अपने पुर को ओर चले जाने पर राम भी आकृत व्रण के ही साथ में समिघाओं के लाने के लिए.वन में चला गया था ।६४। इसके अनन्तर बह चन्दरगप्त नामधारी मन्त्री अपनी सेना के सहित जमदग्नि मुनि के आश्रम में पहुँच कर उसने मुनियों में शादूंल के समान
verses.wordMeaning: The stars and constellations differ in extent from one another by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred and also two hundred Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The stars and constellations differ in extent from one another by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred and also two hundred Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासशिखरे रम्ये नानाधातुविचित्रिते । तरुणादित्यसंकाशे तप्तचामीकरप्रभे
verses.transliteration: kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite / taruṇādityasaṃkāśe taptacāmīkaraprabhe
verses.translation: The spheres of the stars are lesser than the earlier ones. There is no star smaller than the ones with one and a half Yojanas.
verses.hindi: जमदग्नि के चरणों में प्रणाम करके वह वचन कहे ये ।६५। चन्द्रगुप्त ने कहा- है ब्रह्मत् ! नृपति ने यह आज्ञा प्रदान की है कि इस भूमण्डल में राजा ही रत्नों का सेवन करने वाला होता है। इस भूमि मैं समस्त दोहन शील घेनुओं में अतीब उत्तम बह धनु रत्नभूता हूँ जो कि इस समय में आप
verses.wordMeaning: The spheres of the stars are lesser than the earlier ones. There is no star smaller than the ones with one and a half Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The spheres of the stars are lesser than the earlier ones. There is no star smaller than the ones with one and a half Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रस्फटिकसोपाने चित्रपादशिलातले । जांबूनदमये दिव्ये नानाधातु विचित्रिते
verses.transliteration: vajrasphaṭikasopāne citrapādaśilātale / jāṃbūnadamaye divye nānādhātu vicitrite
verses.translation: W. 99*126. These vt the ideas of the aode&t Indians abotit the locations, dimerutons and movements of planets and the heavenly bodies -in the preteletcope days. Of Bh. P. V. 22. 8-17.
verses.hindi: के पास है ।६६। इस कारण से आप रत्न अथवा सुवर्णे जो भी समुचित हो उस धेनु का मूल्य वताकर ग्रहेणे कीजिए और गौओं में जो रत्नभूता धेनु है उसको आप मुझको प्रदान करने के योग्य होते हैं ।६७। जमदग्नि मुनि ने कहा--यह तो भेरी होम धेनु है अर्थात् समस्त होम की सामग्री देने याशीं
verses.wordMeaning: W. 99*126. These vt the ideas of the aode&t Indians abotit the locations, dimerutons and movements of planets and the heavenly bodies -in the preteletcope days. Of Bh. P. V. 22. 8-17.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 99*126. These vt the ideas of the aode&t Indians abotit the locations, dimerutons and movements of planets and the heavenly bodies -in the preteletcope days. Of Bh. P. V. 22. 8-17.

verses.sanskrit: नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णे नानापुष्पफलोपगे । हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णे चक्रवाकोपशोभिते
verses.transliteration: nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpaphalopage / haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇe cakravākopaśobhite
verses.translation: Three planets among them which orbit very far away and above all are the Saturn, the Jupiter and the Mars. It should be known that they orbit very slowly.
verses.hindi: है अतथूव मेरे द्वारा यह किसी के लिये भी देने के योग्य नहीं है। येह आपका स्वामी राजा तो बहुत ही बड़ा दानशील है फिर वह किस प्रकार से इस ब्रह्मस्व ' अर्थात् ब्राह्मण के घन को लेने को इच्छा कर रहा है ? ६
verses.wordMeaning: Three planets among them which orbit very far away and above all are the Saturn, the Jupiter and the Mars. It should be known that they orbit very slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three planets among them which orbit very far away and above all are the Saturn, the Jupiter and the Mars. It should be known that they orbit very slowly.

verses.sanskrit: षट्पदोद्गीतबहुले धारासंपातनादिते । मत्तक्रैञ्चमयूराणां नादैर्विक्रुष्टकन्दरे
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭpadodgītabahule dhārāsaṃpātanādite / mattakraiñcamayūrāṇāṃ nādairvikruṣṭakandare
verses.translation: The great planets beneath them are the four fast moving ones, viz. the sun> the moon, the Mercury and the Venus.
verses.hindi: भावनां के कारण से वह आपकी रत्नभूता धेनु'को आकांक्षा करता है। यों हीं बिना किसी मूल्य के नहीं लेना चाहता है। आप दश सहस्र गौओं को ग्रहण करके इस कारण से उस घेनु को उस राजा के लिए देने के योग्य हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The great planets beneath them are the four fast moving ones, viz. the sun> the moon, the Mercury and the Venus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great planets beneath them are the four fast moving ones, viz. the sun> the moon, the Mercury and the Venus.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे किन्नरैरुपशोभिते । जीवं जीवकजातीनां विरावैरुपकूजिते
verses.transliteration: apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe kinnarairupaśobhite / jīvaṃ jīvakajātīnāṃ virāvairupakūjite
verses.translation: There are as many croresof stars all round as there are constellations. The movement of these constellations has been duly regulated by god Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: There are as many croresof stars all round as there are constellations. The movement of these constellations has been duly regulated by god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are as many croresof stars all round as there are constellations. The movement of these constellations has been duly regulated by god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: कोकिलारावबहुले सिद्धचारणसेविते । सौरभेयनिनादाढ्यं मेघस्तनितनिस्वने
verses.transliteration: kokilārāvabahule siddhacāraṇasevite / saurabheyaninādāḍhyaṃ meghastanitanisvane
verses.translation: Hence, in view of the movements of the luminaries, the sun and the moon set and rise at the same time (every day) during the equinotical days.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, in view of the movements of the luminaries, the sun and the moon set and rise at the same time (every day) during the equinotical days.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, in view of the movements of the luminaries, the sun and the moon set and rise at the same time (every day) during the equinotical days.

verses.sanskrit: विनायकभयोद्विग्नकुं जरैर्मुक्तकन्दरैः । वीणावादित्रनिर्घेषैः श्रोत्रेन्द्रियमनोरमैः
verses.transliteration: vināyakabhayodvignakuṃ jarairmuktakandaraiḥ / vīṇāvāditranirgheṣaiḥ śrotrendriyamanoramaiḥ
verses.translation: In the northern paths, the times of rising and setting are different. During the new moon and full moon, they should be understood as following the circle of luminaries.
verses.wordMeaning: In the northern paths, the times of rising and setting are different. During the new moon and full moon, they should be understood as following the circle of luminaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the northern paths, the times of rising and setting are different. During the new moon and full moon, they should be understood as following the circle of luminaries.

verses.sanskrit: दोलालंबितसंघाते वनितासंघसेविते । ध्वजालंबितदोलानां घण्टानां निनदाकुले
verses.transliteration: dolālaṃbitasaṃghāte vanitāsaṃghasevite / dhvajālaṃbitadolānāṃ ghaṇṭānāṃ ninadākule
verses.translation: When the sun orbits through the path of the south* ern transit, it docs so beneath all the planets.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun orbits through the path of the south* ern transit, it docs so beneath all the planets.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun orbits through the path of the south* ern transit, it docs so beneath all the planets.

verses.sanskrit: वल्लकीवेणुबहुले त्रिंशद्बर्हिणसंकुले । मुखमर्द्दलवादित्रैर्वलितास्फोटितैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vallakīveṇubahule triṃśadbarhiṇasaṃkule / mukhamarddalavāditrairvalitāsphoṭitaistathā
verses.translation: The Mercury orbits above all the stars. The Venus orbits above the Mercury. The Mars docs so above the Venus and the Jupiter above the Mars.
verses.hindi: यथा बलेन नीतायां तस्यां त्वं कि करिष्यसि
verses.wordMeaning: The Mercury orbits above all the stars. The Venus orbits above the Mercury. The Mars docs so above the Venus and the Jupiter above the Mars.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mercury orbits above all the stars. The Venus orbits above the Mercury. The Mars docs so above the Venus and the Jupiter above the Mars.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडावेगविवादानां निर्घोषैः पूर्णकन्दरे । हंसैः परावतैश्चैव बकराजैः सुखस्थिते
verses.transliteration: krīḍāvegavivādānāṃ nirghoṣaiḥ pūrṇakandare / haṃsaiḥ parāvataiścaiva bakarājaiḥ sukhasthite
verses.translation: The intervening distance between the stars and the planets high above is two htmdrei thousand Yojanas,
verses.wordMeaning: The intervening distance between the stars and the planets high above is two htmdrei thousand Yojanas,
verses.commentary: Sense: The intervening distance between the stars and the planets high above is two htmdrei thousand Yojanas,

verses.sanskrit: देहबन्धैर्विचित्रैश्चप्रक्रीडितगणेश्वरे । सिंहव्याघ्रमुखैर्घोरवाशितैश्चण्डवेगितैः
verses.transliteration: dehabandhairvicitraiścaprakrīḍitagaṇeśvare / siṃhavyāghramukhairghoravāśitaiścaṇḍavegitaiḥ
verses.translation: The planets, the moon and the sun orbit in the hrmament with divine splendour. In their regular movement, they duly come into contact with the constellations.
verses.wordMeaning: The planets, the moon and the sun orbit in the hrmament with divine splendour. In their regular movement, they duly come into contact with the constellations.
verses.commentary: Sense: The planets, the moon and the sun orbit in the hrmament with divine splendour. In their regular movement, they duly come into contact with the constellations.

verses.sanskrit: मृगमषमुखैश्चान्यैर्गजवाजिमुखैस्तथा । बिडालवदनैश्चोग्रैः क्रोष्टुकाकारसूर्त्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: mṛgamaṣamukhaiścānyairgajavājimukhaistathā / biḍālavadanaiścograiḥ kroṣṭukākārasūrttibhiḥ
verses.translation: The planets, the stars and the sun may be low, high or straight during their mutual contact or when separate, yet they look at the subjects simultaneously.
verses.hindi: जमदग्नि. मुनि ने कहा--भाई, मैं कभी भी किसी भी प्रकार से क्रय ओर विक्रय के करने वाला नहीं ह.। वह घेनु तो मेरी हविर्धानी अर्थात् होम के लिये हुवि के प्रदान करने वाली है ! इसलिए तुरस्त ही मैं उसको, देने का.उत्साह नहीं करता हैं ।७०। मन्त्री ने फिर कहा--हे ब्रह्मच ! , आप
verses.wordMeaning: The planets, the stars and the sun may be low, high or straight during their mutual contact or when separate, yet they look at the subjects simultaneously.
verses.commentary: Sense: The planets, the stars and the sun may be low, high or straight during their mutual contact or when separate, yet they look at the subjects simultaneously.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वैर्दीर्घैश्च सुकृशैर्लंबोदरमहीदरैः । ह्रस्वजङ्घैः प्रलेबोष्ठैस्तालजङ्घैस्तथापरैः
verses.transliteration: hrasvairdīrghaiśca sukṛśairlaṃbodaramahīdaraiḥ / hrasvajaṅghaiḥ praleboṣṭhaistālajaṅghaistathāparaiḥ
verses.translation: These are situated face to face. They come into contact mutually. That their mutual conjunction is without any confusion should be understood by learned men.
verses.hindi: उस राजा के आधे राज्य को ग्रहण करके अथवा सम्पूर्ण राज्य को लेकर भी, इस एक घेनु को दे दीजिए । इससे आपका बहुत बड़ा कल्याण होगा
verses.wordMeaning: These are situated face to face. They come into contact mutually. That their mutual conjunction is without any confusion should be understood by learned men.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are situated face to face. They come into contact mutually. That their mutual conjunction is without any confusion should be understood by learned men.

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णैरेककर्णैश्च महाकर्णैरकर्णकैः । बहुपादैर्महापादैरेकपादैरपादकैः
verses.transliteration: gokarṇairekakarṇaiśca mahākarṇairakarṇakaiḥ / bahupādairmahāpādairekapādairapādakaiḥ
verses.translation: Vivasvn, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, the sun-god, was bom in the constellation Viiakha in the Cakfusa Manvantara.
verses.hindi: जमदग्नि ने.कहा--हे बुष्ट मति.बाले.! मैं जोबित-रहते हुए इस राजा की तो.बात ही कया. है वेवेन्द्र को भी यह धेनु नहीं दू.गा । फिर आपके राजा: के बड़े वचन से याना करता तो सर्वथा व्यर्थ ही है। अर्थात् इससे कुछ भी लाभ नहीं है ।७२। मन्त्री ने कहा--आप ही सौहार्द की भावना से राजा
verses.wordMeaning: Vivasvn, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, the sun-god, was bom in the constellation Viiakha in the Cakfusa Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vivasvn, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, the sun-god, was bom in the constellation Viiakha in the Cakfusa Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनेत्रैर्महानेत्रैरेकनेत्रैरनेत्रकैः । एकदंष्ट्रैर्महादंष्ट्रैर्बहुदंष्ट्रैरदंष्ट्रकैः
verses.transliteration: bahunetrairmahānetrairekanetrairanetrakaiḥ / ekadaṃṣṭrairmahādaṃṣṭrairbahudaṃṣṭrairadaṃṣṭrakaiḥ
verses.translation: Tviicnan, the son of Dharma, the lord moon god, the son of Vasu, the cool-rayed cause of nights was bom in the constellation Kfttika.
verses.hindi: के लिए उस धेनु को दे दीजिए--यही अच्छा है। और ऐसा थाप नहीं करते हैं तो उसको बलपूर्वक ले लेने पर आप कया करेंगे ? ।७३। जमदेग्नि मुनि ने कहा--राजा तो ब्राह्मणों के लिए दान प्रदान करने वाला हुआ करता है। मही यदि ब्रह्मास्व का आहरण करता है तो मैं तो विग्र हूँ मैं स्वेच्छा से
verses.wordMeaning: Tviicnan, the son of Dharma, the lord moon god, the son of Vasu, the cool-rayed cause of nights was bom in the constellation Kfttika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tviicnan, the son of Dharma, the lord moon god, the son of Vasu, the cool-rayed cause of nights was bom in the constellation Kfttika.

verses.sanskrit: एकशीर्षैर्महाशीर्षबहुशीर्षैरशीर्षकैः । एकजिह्वैर्महाजिह्वैर्बहुजिह्वैरजिह्वकैः । एवंरूपैर्महायोगैभूतर्भूतपतिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: ekaśīrṣairmahāśīrṣabahuśīrṣairaśīrṣakaiḥ / ekajihvairmahājihvairbahujihvairajihvakaiḥ / evaṃrūpairmahāyogaibhūtarbhūtapatirvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The planet Brhaspati (the Jupiter) who has twelve fiery flames (rays), who is the son of Angiras and who is the preceptor of the Universe, was born in the Purvaphalguni.
verses.hindi: वितरण करने के बिता उसका क्‍या करूँगा ।७४। बसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--जब इस रीति से उस चनु मन्त्रो से ऋषि के द्वारा कहा गया तो बह पॉप पूर्ण ज्ञान वाला मन्‍्त्रीं बहुत क्रोधित हो गया था । फिर उसने मुनि की उस पयस्विनी धेनु का बलपूर्वक अपहरण करना आरम्भ कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: The planet Brhaspati (the Jupiter) who has twelve fiery flames (rays), who is the son of Angiras and who is the preceptor of the Universe, was born in the Purvaphalguni.
verses.commentary: Sense: The planet Brhaspati (the Jupiter) who has twelve fiery flames (rays), who is the son of Angiras and who is the preceptor of the Universe, was born in the Purvaphalguni.

verses.sanskrit: विशुद्धमुक्तामणिरत्नभूषिते शिलातले स्वर्णमये सुरम्यके । सुखोपविष्टं मदनागनाशनं प्रोवाच वाक्यं गिरिराजपुत्री
verses.transliteration: viśuddhamuktāmaṇiratnabhūṣite śilātale svarṇamaye suramyake / sukhopaviṣṭaṃ madanāganāśanaṃ provāca vākyaṃ girirājaputrī
verses.translation: W. 129-137 give the stan (or coostellatloos) uader which these planets were *bom*.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 129-137 give the stan (or coostellatloos) uader which these planets were *bom*.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 129-137 give the stan (or coostellatloos) uader which these planets were *bom*.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्भूतभव्येश गोवृषाङ्कितशासन । तव कण्ठे महादेव भ्राजतेंबुदसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavanbhūtabhavyeśa govṛṣāṅkitaśāsana / tava kaṇṭhe mahādeva bhrājateṃbudasannibham
verses.translation: Sanaiicara (the Saturn), the son of the sun» was born in the constellation Revaii. He has seven fiery flames.
verses.hindi: प्रसह्य गां मे हरतो पापमाप्स्यसि दुर्मते ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sanaiicara (the Saturn), the son of the sun» was born in the constellation Revaii. He has seven fiery flames.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanaiicara (the Saturn), the son of the sun» was born in the constellation Revaii. He has seven fiery flames.

verses.sanskrit: नात्युल्बणं शुभंशुभ्रे नीलाबुजचयोपमम् । किमिदं दीप्यते देव कण्ठे कामाङ्गनाशन
verses.transliteration: nātyulbaṇaṃ śubhaṃśubhre nīlābujacayopamam / kimidaṃ dīpyate deva kaṇṭhe kāmāṅganāśana
verses.translation: Among fortnights the bright halfand among Tithis (lunar fortnightly days) Pratipat is the first. The day is glorified as the first among the divisions of day, night etc.
verses.wordMeaning: Among fortnights the bright halfand among Tithis (lunar fortnightly days) Pratipat is the first. The day is glorified as the first among the divisions of day, night etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among fortnights the bright halfand among Tithis (lunar fortnightly days) Pratipat is the first. The day is glorified as the first among the divisions of day, night etc.

verses.sanskrit: को हेतुः कारणं किं वा कण्ठे नीलस्त्त्वमीश्वर । एतत्सर्वं यथान्यायं बूहि कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.transliteration: ko hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ vā kaṇṭhe nīlasttvamīśvara / etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ būhi kautūhalaṃ hi me
verses.translation: The Yuga (Era) consisting of five years begins with Dhanistha and ends with Sravana.
verses.wordMeaning: The Yuga (Era) consisting of five years begins with Dhanistha and ends with Sravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yuga (Era) consisting of five years begins with Dhanistha and ends with Sravana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ततस्तस्याः पार्वत्याः पावतीप्रियः । कथां मङ्गलसंयुक्तां कथयामास शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vākyaṃ tatastasyāḥ pārvatyāḥ pāvatīpriyaḥ / kathāṃ maṅgalasaṃyuktāṃ kathayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The learned man should comprehend and retain in belief, by means of scripture, inference, perception, and reasoning after testing intelligently and carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The learned man should comprehend and retain in belief, by means of scripture, inference, perception, and reasoning after testing intelligently and carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The learned man should comprehend and retain in belief, by means of scripture, inference, perception, and reasoning after testing intelligently and carefully.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वर उवाच मथ्यमाने ऽमृते पूर्वं क्षीरोदे सुरदानवैः । अग्रे समुत्थितं घोरं विषङ्कालानलप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: maheśvara uvāca mathyamāne 'mṛte pūrvaṃ kṣīrode suradānavaiḥ / agre samutthitaṃ ghoraṃ viṣaṅkālānalaprabham
verses.translation: O Brahmanas of the most excellent intellect these are five expedients (means) to comprehend the group of lumin¬ aries viz.: eye, scripture, water, picture and calculation.
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas of the most excellent intellect these are five expedients (means) to comprehend the group of lumin¬ aries viz.: eye, scripture, water, picture and calculation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas of the most excellent intellect these are five expedients (means) to comprehend the group of lumin¬ aries viz.: eye, scripture, water, picture and calculation.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सुरसंघस्च दैत्याश्चैव वरानने । विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे गतास्ते ब्रह्मणो ऽन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā surasaṃghasca daityāścaiva varānane / viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve gatāste brahmaṇo 'ntakam
verses.translation: After recounting this (astronomical information in the last chapter) Lord Vayu (The Wind god) of very great intellect and who is (always) engaged in what is conducive to the welfare of the world, commenced the Japa (muttering in an undertone the Mantra) that was to be chanted when the sun reached the middle of the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: After recounting this (astronomical information in the last chapter) Lord Vayu (The Wind god) of very great intellect and who is (always) engaged in what is conducive to the welfare of the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After recounting this (astronomical information in the last chapter) Lord Vayu (The Wind god) of very great intellect and who is (always) engaged in what is conducive to the welfare of the world,…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सुरगणान्भीतान्ब्रह्मोवाच महाद्युतिः । किमर्थं वै महाभागा भीता उद्विग्नचेतनाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā suragaṇānbhītānbrahmovāca mahādyutiḥ / kimarthaṃ vai mahābhāgā bhītā udvignacetanāḥ
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: बद्ध वा तां गां हढे: पाशेविचकर्ण बलान्वितः ॥५.
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: मया त्रिगुणमैश्वर्यं भवतां संप्रकल्पितम् । तेन व्यावर्त्तितैश्वर्या यूयं भो सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: mayā triguṇamaiśvaryaṃ bhavatāṃ saṃprakalpitam / tena vyāvarttitaiśvaryā yūyaṃ bho surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: त्रलोक्यस्येश्वरा यूयं सर्वे वै विगतज्वराः । प्रजासर्गे न सो ऽस्तीह यश्चाज्ञां मे ऽतिवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: tralokyasyeśvarā yūyaṃ sarve vai vigatajvarāḥ / prajāsarge na so 'stīha yaścājñāṃ me 'tivartayet
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: विमानचारिण सर्वे सर्वे स्वच्छन्दगामिनः । आध्यात्मिके चाधिभूते अधिदैवे च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: vimānacāriṇa sarve sarve svacchandagāminaḥ / ādhyātmike cādhibhūte adhidaive ca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाः कर्मविपाकेन शक्ता यूयं प्रवर्त्तितुम् । तत्किमर्थं भयोद्विग्ना मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव
verses.transliteration: prajāḥ karmavipākena śaktā yūyaṃ pravarttitum / tatkimarthaṃ bhayodvignā mṛgāḥ siṃhārditā iva
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: श्री बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--धुनः जमदरिति म्.नि ने क्रोध से समन्वित होते हुए उससे कहा था--एक ज्ञानी पुरुष के द्वारा ब्रह्मस्व का कभी भी अपहरण नहीं करना चाहिए।१। है दुष्टमति वाले ! बलातू मुझ से मेरी गौ का हरण करके तू भहाल् पाप को प्राप्त हो जायगा । यदि तू ऐसा ही
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: किं दुःशं को ऽनुसंतापः कुतो वा भयमागतम् । एतत्सर्वं यथान्यायं शीघ्रमाख्या तुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: kiṃ duḥśaṃ ko 'nusaṃtāpaḥ kuto vā bhayamāgatam / etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śīghramākhyā tumarhatha
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: करेगा तो मैं जानता हैं कि आयु को परिक्षीण कर रहा है।२।बल पूर्वक जो इसको लेने को इच्छा कर रहा है वह किसी भी रीति से नहीं किया जा सकेगा । यदि यही करेगा तो तू स्वयं ही स्रायुज्य को प्राप्त हो जायगा अथवा तेरा राजा विनष्ट हों जायगा ।३। विना दान के तपस्वी ब्राह्मणों की वस्तु
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ततस्तस्य ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः । ऊचुस्ते ऋषिभिः सार्द्धं सुरदैत्येन्द्रदानवाः
