verses.transliteration: śraddhadhānaḥ sadā bhakto rūdralokaṃ sa gacchati / paṭhecca devi bhaktyā ca pāṭhayecca naraḥ sadā
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: दुःखशोकपरीता. हि रेणुका त्वरुदन्मुहः । त्रिःसप्तक्ृटवो हस्ताञ्यामुदर' समताडयत्
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परतरं स्तोत्रं न भूतं न भविष्यति । नापि यक्षाः पिशाचा वा न भूता न विनायकाः । कुर्युर्विघ्नं गृहे तस्य यत्रायं तिष्ठति स्तवः
verses.transliteration: ataḥ parataraṃ stotraṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / nāpi yakṣāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ / kuryurvighnaṃ gṛhe tasya yatrāyaṃ tiṣṭhati stavaḥ
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: हे महाभाग ! आपके समान परम धीर और ज्ञान सम्पन्न पुरुष किसी भी दशा में अत्यधिक शोक नहीँ दिया करते हैं। जो 'धैयंशाली महान् पुरुष हुआ करते हैं बे हानि होने परु बहुत दु:ख 'नहीं कियाःकरते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: मया नु तुष्टेन तवांबुजेक्षणे स्तवस्य माहात्म्यम घौघनाशनम् । निवेदितं पुण्यफलादियुक्तं स्वयं च कीतं चतुराननेन
verses.transliteration: mayā nu tuṣṭena tavāṃbujekṣaṇe stavasya māhātmyama ghaughanāśanam / niveditaṃ puṇyaphalādiyuktaṃ svayaṃ ca kītaṃ caturānanena
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: यह शोक बहुत ही बुरा होता, है जो कि समस्त.इन्बरियों का.परिपोषण.करमे बाला है । है महाबाहो ! अब, आप इस शोक का परित्याग; कर दीजिए । आपके समान पुरुष शोक करने के पात्र नहीं हुआ करते हैं।२३। शोक तो निश्चय ही लोकिक और परमाथिक अयोजनों का-एकान्त अवरोधेक होता
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: कथामिमां पुण्यफलादियुक्तां निवेद्य देव्यै शशिबद्धमूर्द्धजः । वृषस्य पृष्ठेन सहोमया प्रभुजगाम कैलासगुहां गुहप्रियः
verses.transliteration: kathāmimāṃ puṇyaphalādiyuktāṃ nivedya devyai śaśibaddhamūrddhajaḥ / vṛṣasya pṛṣṭhena sahomayā prabhujagāma kailāsaguhāṃ guhapriyaḥ
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: है फिर आप अपने हदय में: ऐसे दुःखद शोक को अवकाश: क्यों दे रहे हैं: ?- ।२४। इस कारण से अब आपः धेये कैं घन वाले होकर अर्थात् घीरज घारण़' करके रुदन करवी हुई और विधवा होने' की-विभीषिका से बुद्धि हीन होकर पड़ी हुईं!अपती माता: को परि सान्त्वना दीजिए २५ इस संसार में जो'भी'
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं मया पापहरं तदन्तिके निवेदितं ते ऽथ मया प्रजापतेः । अधीत्य सर्वं त्वखिलं सलक्षणं प्रयाति चादित्यपदं द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: śrutaṃ mayā pāpaharaṃ tadantike niveditaṃ te 'tha mayā prajāpateḥ / adhītya sarvaṃ tvakhilaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ prayāti cādityapadaṃ dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: वस्तु अतिक्रान्त हो गई है अर्थात् जो प्राणी देह का व्याग कर चल वसा हैः उसका फिर यहाँ उसी" रूप में आगमन कभी भी नहीं होता है । इस कारणः स्ते जो भी व्यतीत" हो गया है'उस सबका त्याग करके आगे जो भीः करनें योग्य कृत्य” हैं उनका ही! परिचिन्तनम आप करिए ।२६।'इस रीति'से'
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages who had assembled there and who had perfect control over their own selves, stood up with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्व भागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे नीलकण्ठनामोत्पत्तिकथनं नाम पञ्चविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः महादेवस्य महात्म्यं प्रभुत्वं च महात्मनः । श्रोतुमिच्छामहे सम्यगैश्वर्यगुणविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrva bhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde nīlakaṇṭhanāmotpattikathanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ mahādevasya mahātmyaṃ prabhutvaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ / śrotumicchāmahe samyagaiśvaryaguṇavistaram
verses.translation: The story of how the lihga of god 8iva appeared is told in difierent JPurftnai like Lidga, 17; KP n 36; VS. The Lidga of Siva u not the phallus
verses.hindi: उसके द्वारा सान्त्वना दिये'ठुए राम'ने'परम दुःख से समन्वित होते हुए भी' धीरे-धीरे अपनीः हीं आत्मा से" अर्थात् अपने ही'आस्म ज्ञान से अपने आपको' संस्तम्भित दिया था।२७। रेणुका तो महान और परम घोर शोक से घिरी” हुईं होकर'बारम्वार रुदन कर रहौ थी ओर उसने अपने दोनों! करोंसे/
verses.wordMeaning: The story of how the lihga of god 8iva appeared is told in difierent JPurftnai like Lidga, 17; KP n 36; VS. The Lidga of Siva u not the phallus
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of how the lihga of god 8iva appeared is told in difierent JPurftnai like Lidga, 17; KP n 36; VS. The Lidga of Siva u not the phallus

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच पूर्वं त्रैलोक्यविजये विष्णुना समुदात्दृ तम् । बलिं बद्ध्वा महावीर्यं त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं पुरा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca pūrvaṃ trailokyavijaye viṣṇunā samudātdṛ tam / baliṃ baddhvā mahāvīryaṃ trailokyādhipatiṃ purā
verses.translation: "This has been declared by Vi?nu formerly in the course of his conquest of the three worlds after binding Bali, the lord of the three worlds, of great prowess.
verses.hindi: इक्कीस'यार अपने वक्षःर्थल' को प्रताड़ित किया था ।रव्त
verses.wordMeaning: "This has been declared by Vi?nu formerly in the course of his conquest of the three worlds after binding Bali, the lord of the three worlds, of great prowess.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This has been declared by Vi?nu formerly in the course of his conquest of the three worlds after binding Bali, the lord of the three worlds, of great prowess.

verses.sanskrit: प्रनष्टेषु तु दैत्येषु प्रहृष्टे तु शचीपतौ । अथाजग्मुः प्रभुं द्रष्टुं सर्वे देवाः सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: pranaṣṭeṣu tu daityeṣu prahṛṣṭe tu śacīpatau / athājagmuḥ prabhuṃ draṣṭuṃ sarve devāḥ sanātanam
verses.translation: "You are the supporter and the maker (of the uni« verse) O Xjord, you create the worlds. It is due to your grace, that the three worlds attain ever*lasting welfare.
verses.wordMeaning: "You are the supporter and the maker (of the uni« verse) O Xjord, you create the worlds. It is due to your grace, that the three worlds attain ever*lasting welfare.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You are the supporter and the maker (of the uni« verse) O Xjord, you create the worlds. It is due to your grace, that the three worlds attain ever*lasting welfare.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रास्ते विश्वरूपात्मा क्षीरोदस्य मसीपतः । सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो यक्षा गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः
verses.transliteration: yatrāste viśvarūpātmā kṣīrodasya masīpataḥ / siddhā brahmarṣayo yakṣā gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: He resembled a hundred thousand suns. He shone by means of his own splendour. He was a four-faced person {Purua) of great Yogic power and golden lustre.
verses.wordMeaning: He resembled a hundred thousand suns. He shone by means of his own splendour. He was a four-faced person {Purua) of great Yogic power and golden lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: He resembled a hundred thousand suns. He shone by means of his own splendour. He was a four-faced person {Purua) of great Yogic power and golden lustre.

verses.sanskrit: नागा देवर्षयश्चैव नद्यः सर्वे च पर्वताः । अभिगम्य महात्मानं स्तुवन्ति पुरुषं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: nāgā devarṣayaścaiva nadyaḥ sarve ca parvatāḥ / abhigamya mahātmānaṃ stuvanti puruṣaṃ harim
verses.translation: In the middle of that massive splendour, we saw the extremely resplendent Lihga of the size of a mere span. It was unmanifest (7) yet endowed with extensive lustre.
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of that massive splendour, we saw the extremely resplendent Lihga of the size of a mere span. It was unmanifest (7) yet endowed with extensive lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of that massive splendour, we saw the extremely resplendent Lihga of the size of a mere span. It was unmanifest (7) yet endowed with extensive lustre.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं धाता त्वं च कर्तासि त्वं लोकान्सृजसि प्रभो । त्वत्प्रसादाच्च कल्याणं प्राप्तं त्रैलोक्यमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ ca kartāsi tvaṃ lokānsṛjasi prabho / tvatprasādācca kalyāṇaṃ prāptaṃ trailokyamavyayam
verses.translation: Then Brahma told me,— "You go quickly beneath. Let us find out the end of this noble-souled Lthga.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्ता रेणुका तेन भृशं दुःखान्विताऽपि सा ।  कृच्छाद्धैयँ समालंब्य तथेति प्रत्यभाषत
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma told me,— "You go quickly beneath. Let us find out the end of this noble-souled Lthga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma told me,— "You go quickly beneath. Let us find out the end of this noble-souled Lthga.

verses.sanskrit: असुराश्च जिताः सर्वे बलिर्बद्धश्च वै त्वया । एवमुक्तः सुरैर्विष्णः सिद्धैश्च परमर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: asurāśca jitāḥ sarve balirbaddhaśca vai tvayā / evamuktaḥ surairviṣṇaḥ siddhaiśca paramarṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, I went far below for a thousand years, but I could not find its end. I became frightened thereby.
verses.hindi: अतृँशोकपरीतांगी रेणुकापि हढब्रता । पुतरान्सर्वान्समाहूय ट्विदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, I went far below for a thousand years, but I could not find its end. I became frightened thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, I went far below for a thousand years, but I could not find its end. I became frightened thereby.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युवाच तदा देवान् सर्वांस्तान्पुरुषोत्तमः । श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि कारणं सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pratyuvāca tadā devān sarvāṃstānpuruṣottamaḥ / śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi kāraṇaṃ surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, Brahma went upwards, but he too did not reach its extremity. He too returned along with me to that vast expanse of water.
verses.hindi: इसी बीच में राम ने अपनी जननी कें समीप में समुपस्थित होकर अपनी आँखों में भरे हुए अश्ुओं से समन्वित होते. हुए एदन करते वाली रेणुका से कहा था कि घीरज घारण करो--इस तरह से अपनी माता को साम्त्यना' दो. थी ।२९। अपने स्वामी के वियोग जन्य शोक में डूबी हुई उस
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, Brahma went upwards, but he too did not reach its extremity. He too returned along with me to that vast expanse of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, Brahma went upwards, but he too did not reach its extremity. He too returned along with me to that vast expanse of water.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्रष्टा सर्वभूतानां कालः कालकरः प्रभुः । येनाहं ब्रह्मणा सार्द्धं सृष्टा लोकाश्च मायया
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ kālaḥ kālakaraḥ prabhuḥ / yenāhaṃ brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ sṛṣṭā lokāśca māyayā
verses.translation: We were surprised and frightened of that great soul. We were deluded by the Miya of that great Being. Our con¬ sciousness got lost and we stayed there (helplessly).
verses.hindi: माला' रेणुका के दु:ख को दूर करते हुए उस राम ने कहा था कि आपने जो यह इस समय में इक्कीस बार अपने वक्षःस्थल को प्रत्ताड़ित किया है
verses.wordMeaning: We were surprised and frightened of that great soul. We were deluded by the Miya of that great Being. Our con¬ sciousness got lost and we stayed there (helplessly).
verses.commentary: Sense: We were surprised and frightened of that great soul. We were deluded by the Miya of that great Being. Our con¬ sciousness got lost and we stayed there (helplessly).

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव च प्रसादेन आदौ सिद्धत्वमागतः । पुरा तमसि चाव्यक्ते त्रैलोक्ये ग्रसिते मया
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva ca prasādena ādau siddhatvamāgataḥ / purā tamasi cāvyakte trailokye grasite mayā
verses.translation: Thereupon, we meditated on the lord with faces on all sides, the imperishable lord who is the source of origin and the cause of dissolution of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: उतनी ही आर संख्या में मैं इस कारण से इस भूमण्डल में सर्वत्र क्षत्रिय जाति का पूर्णरूप से हनन करूगा--यह मैं आपके समक्ष में पूर्णतया सत्यः योल रहा हूँ अर्थात् इस कायं में लेशमात्र भी त्रुटि नहीं होगी ।३१। इसलिए अव आप इस शोक का परित्याग करके अपने हृदय में धेयं धारण कीजिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, we meditated on the lord with faces on all sides, the imperishable lord who is the source of origin and the cause of dissolution of all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, we meditated on the lord with faces on all sides, the imperishable lord who is the source of origin and the cause of dissolution of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: उदरस्थेषु भूतेषु त्वेको ऽहं शयित स्तदा । सहस्रशीर्षा भूत्वा च सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्
verses.transliteration: udarastheṣu bhūteṣu tveko 'haṃ śayita stadā / sahasraśīrṣā bhūtvā ca sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt
verses.translation: We made obeisance, with palms joined in reverence, to the trident-bearing Siva {Servo), the lord of extremely terrific voice, of terrible features and curved fangs, to that great unmanifest lord.
verses.hindi: यह तो निश्चित बात है कि जो वस्तु यहाँ से चली गयी है उसका पुनः यहाँ पर आगमत नहीं होता है अर्थात् मृत प्राणी फिर कितना ही चाहे शोक दुःख किया आंवे वापिस -नहीं आया करता है । अतः फिर इतना अधिके शोक करना व्यर्थ ही है ।३२। उस राम के द्वारा इस प्रकार से समाई हुई
verses.wordMeaning: We made obeisance, with palms joined in reverence, to the trident-bearing Siva {Servo), the lord of extremely terrific voice, of terrible features and curved fangs, to that great unmanifest lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: We made obeisance, with palms joined in reverence, to the trident-bearing Siva {Servo), the lord of extremely terrific voice, of terrible features and curved fangs, to that great unmanifest lord.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः शयितो विमलेंऽभसि । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दूरात्पश्यामि ह्यमितप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śayito vimaleṃ'bhasi / etasminnantare dūrātpaśyāmi hyamitaprabham
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you, O lord of worlds and Devas. Salutations unto you, O lord of Bhutas, O highly noble soul.
verses.hindi: रेणुका असह्य दुःख के भार से समन्वित थी तथापि बड़ी कठिनाई से धेय धारण किया था और अब विशेष शोक मैं नहीं करूंगी-अपने पुत्र राम को उत्तर दिया था ।३३। है राजन् ! इसके उपरान्त राम ने अपने सहोदर भाइयों के साथ विधि पूर्वक अपने पिता के देह को अग्नि में दाह करने के
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you, O lord of worlds and Devas. Salutations unto you, O lord of Bhutas, O highly noble soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you, O lord of worlds and Devas. Salutations unto you, O lord of Bhutas, O highly noble soul.

verses.sanskrit: शतसूर्यप्रतीकाशं ज्वलन्तं स्वेन तेजसा । चतुर्वक्त्रं महायोगं पुरुषं काञ्चनप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: śatasūryapratīkāśaṃ jvalantaṃ svena tejasā / caturvaktraṃ mahāyogaṃ puruṣaṃ kāñcanaprabham
verses.translation: You arc Paramesthin (the highest deity), the supreme Brahman, the imperishable great region; you are the eldest one. You are Vamadeva, Rudra, Skanda and Lord Siva.
verses.hindi: कार्ये का आरम्भ किया था ।३४। अपने अर्ता के वियोग से समुत्पन्न शोक से परीत अङ्गों वाली तथा परम सुदृढ़ पतिब्रत धरम से युक्त रेणुका' ने भी अपने समस्त पुत्रों को बुलाकर उतसे यह वचन कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: You arc Paramesthin (the highest deity), the supreme Brahman, the imperishable great region; you are the eldest one. You are Vamadeva, Rudra, Skanda and Lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc Paramesthin (the highest deity), the supreme Brahman, the imperishable great region; you are the eldest one. You are Vamadeva, Rudra, Skanda and Lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाजिनधरं देवं कमण्डलुविभूषितम् । निमेषान्तरमात्रेण प्राप्तो ऽसौ पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ devaṃ kamaṇḍaluvibhūṣitam / nimeṣāntaramātreṇa prāpto 'sau puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: You are Yajfla; you arc Vasatkara; you are Omkira; you are the subduer of enemies; you are Svahakara, the obeis¬ ance, the consecration of all holy rites.
verses.hindi: रेणुकोवाच-अहं वः पितरं पुत्राः स्वयेतं पुण्यशीलिनम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: You are Yajfla; you arc Vasatkara; you are Omkira; you are the subduer of enemies; you are Svahakara, the obeis¬ ance, the consecration of all holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Yajfla; you arc Vasatkara; you are Omkira; you are the subduer of enemies; you are Svahakara, the obeis¬ ance, the consecration of all holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मामब्रवीद्ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः । कस्त्वं कुतो वा कि चेह तिष्ठसे वद मे विभो
verses.transliteration: tato māmabravīdbrahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ / kastvaṃ kuto vā ki ceha tiṣṭhase vada me vibho
verses.translation: You arc Svadbakara, Yajfia, holy rites and observ¬ ances, the Vedas, the worlds, the Devas—the lord alone is everything all round.
verses.wordMeaning: You arc Svadbakara, Yajfia, holy rites and observ¬ ances, the Vedas, the worlds, the Devas—the lord alone is everything all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc Svadbakara, Yajfia, holy rites and observ¬ ances, the Vedas, the worlds, the Devas—the lord alone is everything all round.

verses.sanskrit: अहं कर्तास्मि लोकानां स्वयंभूर्विश्वतोमुखः । एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणाहमुवाच तम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ kartāsmi lokānāṃ svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ / evamuktastadā tena brahmaṇāhamuvāca tam
verses.translation: You are the quality of sound of the firmament; you are the source of origin and cause of dissolution of all living
verses.wordMeaning: You are the quality of sound of the firmament; you are the source of origin and cause of dissolution of all living
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the quality of sound of the firmament; you are the source of origin and cause of dissolution of all living

verses.sanskrit: अहं कर्त्ता हि लोकानां संहर्ता च पुनः पुनः । एवं संभाषमाणौ तु परस्परजयैषिणौ
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ karttā hi lokānāṃ saṃhartā ca punaḥ punaḥ / evaṃ saṃbhāṣamāṇau tu parasparajayaiṣiṇau
verses.translation: O lord of the Devas, you are the quality (called) touch in Vayu (wind); you form the body of the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the Devas, you are the quality (called) touch in Vayu (wind); you form the body of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the Devas, you are the quality (called) touch in Vayu (wind); you form the body of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरां दिशमास्थाय ज्वालामद्राक्ष्व विष्ठिताम् । ज्वालां ततस्तामालोक्य विस्मितौ च तदानघाः
verses.transliteration: uttarāṃ diśamāsthāya jvālāmadrākṣva viṣṭhitām / jvālāṃ tatastāmālokya vismitau ca tadānaghāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of the Devas» you are knowledge in the in¬ tellect; you are the seed of Prakfti.
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord of the Devas» you are knowledge in the in¬ tellect; you are the seed of Prakfti.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of the Devas» you are knowledge in the in¬ tellect; you are the seed of Prakfti.

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा च बलेनाथ शार्वं ज्योतिः कृताञ्जली । वर्द्धमानां तदा ज्वालामत्यन्तपरमाद्भुताम्
verses.transliteration: tejasā ca balenātha śārvaṃ jyotiḥ kṛtāñjalī / varddhamānāṃ tadā jvālāmatyantaparamādbhutām
verses.translation: You are the annihilator of all the worlds; you are K&la identical with the god of Death, the cause of destruc¬ tion. You sustain the three worlds, O Lord, you alone create them.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नेव काले सु रेणूकां तनयैः सह्।
verses.wordMeaning: You are the annihilator of all the worlds; you are K&la identical with the god of Death, the cause of destruc¬ tion. You sustain the three worlds, O Lord, you alone create them.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the annihilator of all the worlds; you are K&la identical with the god of Death, the cause of destruc¬ tion. You sustain the three worlds, O Lord, you alone create them.

verses.sanskrit: अभिदुद्राव तां ज्वालां ब्रह्मा चाहं च सत्वरौ । दिवं भूमिं च निर्भिद्य तिष्ठन्तं जवालमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: abhidudrāva tāṃ jvālāṃ brahmā cāhaṃ ca satvarau / divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirbhidya tiṣṭhantaṃ javālamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: With your eastern face you assume the form of Indra; with your southern face you withdraw the worlds again.
verses.hindi: रेणुका ने कहा--है पुत्रो ! मैं अब आप लोगों के परमाध्षिक पुण्य शील स्वर्ण में गये हुए पिता का ही मैं अनुगमन यहाँ करना चाहती हैं सो आप लोग सब मुझे ऐता करने की आज्ञा देने के लिए योग्य होते हो
verses.wordMeaning: With your eastern face you assume the form of Indra; with your southern face you withdraw the worlds again.
verses.commentary: Sense: With your eastern face you assume the form of Indra; with your southern face you withdraw the worlds again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या ज्वालस्य मध्ये तु पश्यावो विपुलप्रभम् । प्रादेशमात्रमव्यक्तं लिङ्गं परमदीप्तिमत्
verses.transliteration: tasyā jvālasya madhye tu paśyāvo vipulaprabham / prādeśamātramavyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ paramadīptimat
verses.translation: With your western face you are stationed in Vanina undoubtedly. O excellent one among the Devas, with your northern face you are Soma.
verses.hindi: विवा हो जाने का दुख बहुत ही असत्य होता है उसे सहन करती हुई में कौसे-कैसे रहुँगी और अपने स्वामी के विरह वाली विशेष रूप से निम्दित होकर इस संसार में अपना जीबन प्रवृत्त करूंगो ।३७। इस कारण से मैं अपने परम प्रिय स्व।मी का अनुगमन करूगी अर्यात् उनके ही देह के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: With your western face you are stationed in Vanina undoubtedly. O excellent one among the Devas, with your northern face you are Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: With your western face you are stationed in Vanina undoubtedly. O excellent one among the Devas, with your northern face you are Soma.

verses.sanskrit: न च तत्काञ्चनं मध्ये नशैलं न च राजतम् । अनिर्देश्यमचिन्त्यं च लक्ष्यालक्ष्यं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: na ca tatkāñcanaṃ madhye naśailaṃ na ca rājatam / anirdeśyamacintyaṃ ca lakṣyālakṣyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord endowed with the potential strength and influence of ten thousand sets of ten thousand suns, obeisance be to you, O lord, as white as a thousand moons. Obeisance be to you who hold Vyra (thunderbolt) and Pinaka bow. Obeisance be to you, O lord, with arrows ajod bow in your hands.
verses.hindi: सती हो जाऊंगी जिससे परलोक में भो निरन्तर उनके ही साथ रहः सक्षंगी।३८। जलती हुई इसी अग्नि में प्रवेश करके कुछ ही समय में मैं अपने स्वामी की पितृलोक में श्रिय अतिथि बन जाऊेगी ।३६। है पुरो ! यदि आव लोग भेरे अमोप्सित चाहते हैं अर्थात् मेरे प्यारे बनना चाहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord endowed with the potential strength and influence of ten thousand sets of ten thousand suns, obeisance be to you, O lord, as white as a thousand moons. Obeisance be to you who hold Vyra (thunderbolt) and Pinaka bow. Obeisance be to you, O lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord endowed with the potential strength and influence of ten thousand sets of ten thousand suns, obeisance be to you, O lord, as white as a thousand moons. Obeisance be to you who hold Vyra (thunderbolt) and Pinaka bow. Obeisance be to you, O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालासहस्राढ्यं विस्मयं परमद्भुतम् । महता तेजसायुक्तं वर्दभमानंभृशन्तथा
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ vismayaṃ paramadbhutam / mahatā tejasāyuktaṃ vardabhamānaṃbhṛśantathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, O lord, whose limbs are embellished with Bhasma (sacred ash). Hail to you, O lord, the destroyer of Kama's body.
verses.hindi: -सो अनुवाद कें विना उस कर्म में आप लोगों को प्रतिकूल होकर कुछ भी: नहीं बोलना चाहिए ।४०। इस रीति से इन बचनों को ही कहकर रेणुका सुहढ़ निश्चय वाली हो गयी थी तथा अग्नि में प्रवेश करके अपने स्वामी. का अनुगमन: करने के लिये उसने मन में ठान ली थो ।४१। इसी का्-में
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, O lord, whose limbs are embellished with Bhasma (sacred ash). Hail to you, O lord, the destroyer of Kama's body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, O lord, whose limbs are embellished with Bhasma (sacred ash). Hail to you, O lord, the destroyer of Kama's body.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालाततं न्यस्तं सर्वभूतभयङ्करम् । घोररूपिणमत्यर्थं भिन्दं तमिव रोदसी
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālātataṃ nyastaṃ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaram / ghorarūpiṇamatyarthaṃ bhindaṃ tamiva rodasī
verses.translation: Bow to you, O lord of golden womb. Obeisance to you, O lord of golden navel; Hail to you, O lord of golden
verses.hindi: पुतो के सहितःरेशुका को सम्बोधित करके अर्यन्त गम्भीर बिना शरीरः बाणी अर्थात् अन्तरिक्ष में कही हुई वाणी ने कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to you, O lord of golden womb. Obeisance to you, O lord of golden navel; Hail to you, O lord of golden
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to you, O lord of golden womb. Obeisance to you, O lord of golden navel; Hail to you, O lord of golden

verses.sanskrit: ततो मामब्रवीद्ब्रह्मा अधो गच्छ त्वमाशु वै । अन्तमस्य विजानीवो लिङ्गस्य तु महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tato māmabravīdbrahmā adho gaccha tvamāśu vai / antamasya vijānīvo liṅgasya tu mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you, O lord of golden colour. Salute to you, O lord of golden hair; obeisance be to you, O lord of golden heroism* (?); obeisance be to you, the lord who distributes gold.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to you, O lord of golden colour. Salute to you, O lord of golden hair; obeisance be to you, O lord of golden heroism* (?); obeisance be to you, the lord who distributes gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to you, O lord of golden colour. Salute to you, O lord of golden hair; obeisance be to you, O lord of golden heroism* (?); obeisance be to you, the lord who distributes gold.

verses.sanskrit: अहमूर्ध्वं गमिष्यामि यावदन्तो ऽस्य दृश्यते । तदा तु समयं कृत्वा गत उर्द्ध्वमधश्च हि
verses.transliteration: ahamūrdhvaṃ gamiṣyāmi yāvadanto 'sya dṛśyate / tadā tu samayaṃ kṛtvā gata urddhvamadhaśca hi
verses.translation: Mahadeva of great lustre became filled with pity. He spoke to us as if he was about to swallow the sky with a thousand crores of mouths.
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva of great lustre became filled with pity. He spoke to us as if he was about to swallow the sky with a thousand crores of mouths.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva of great lustre became filled with pity. He spoke to us as if he was about to swallow the sky with a thousand crores of mouths.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वर्षसहस्रं तु ह्यहं पुनरधो गतः । न पश्यामि च तस्यान्तं भीतश्चाहं ततो ऽभवम्
verses.transliteration: tato varṣasahasraṃ tu hyahaṃ punaradho gataḥ / na paśyāmi ca tasyāntaṃ bhītaścāhaṃ tato 'bhavam
verses.translation: The lord had Pinaka in his hand; he held the trident; he was worthy of being worshipped by the Devas; he had serpents as the sacred thread; he was the cause of freedom from fear unto the Devas.
verses.hindi: मा कार्षी: साहसं भद्रे प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रिये तव
verses.wordMeaning: The lord had Pinaka in his hand; he held the trident; he was worthy of being worshipped by the Devas; he had serpents as the sacred thread; he was the cause of freedom from fear unto the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord had Pinaka in his hand; he held the trident; he was worthy of being worshipped by the Devas; he had serpents as the sacred thread; he was the cause of freedom from fear unto the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव ब्रह्मा ह्यूध्व च न चान्तं तस्य लब्धवान् । समागतो मया सार्द्ध तत्रैव च महाभसि
verses.transliteration: tathaiva brahmā hyūdhva ca na cāntaṃ tasya labdhavān / samāgato mayā sārddha tatraiva ca mahābhasi
verses.translation: At that time, he burst unto a laughter, the sound of which was similar to that of Dundubhi (a big drum) and was comparable to the rumbling sound of the cloud. The sound filled the whole universe.
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, he burst unto a laughter, the sound of which was similar to that of Dundubhi (a big drum) and was comparable to the rumbling sound of the cloud. The sound filled the whole universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, he burst unto a laughter, the sound of which was similar to that of Dundubhi (a big drum) and was comparable to the rumbling sound of the cloud. The sound filled the whole universe.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विस्मयमापन्नौ भीतौ तस्य महात्मनः । मायया मोहितौ तेन नष्टसंज्ञै व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: tato vismayamāpannau bhītau tasya mahātmanaḥ / māyayā mohitau tena naṣṭasaṃjñai vyavasthitau
verses.translation: This Brahmi, the grandfather of the worlds is my right hand. Vinu who is never defeated in any battle, is my left hand.
verses.hindi: तस्माद्ध येधना भुत्वा भव त्वं कालकांलिणी ।
verses.wordMeaning: This Brahmi, the grandfather of the worlds is my right hand. Vinu who is never defeated in any battle, is my left hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Brahmi, the grandfather of the worlds is my right hand. Vinu who is never defeated in any battle, is my left hand.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ध्यानरतौ तत्र चेश्वरं सर्वतोमुखम् । प्रभवं निधनं चैव लौकानां प्रभुमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: tato dhyānaratau tatra ceśvaraṃ sarvatomukham / prabhavaṃ nidhanaṃ caiva laukānāṃ prabhumavyayam
verses.translation: Thus the potentiality of that intelligent lord has been recounted to you. 'Fhis is the greatest knowledge. The unman Ifest one is termed Siva (Ample rous).
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the potentiality of that intelligent lord has been recounted to you. 'Fhis is the greatest knowledge. The unman Ifest one is termed Siva (Ample rous).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the potentiality of that intelligent lord has been recounted to you. 'Fhis is the greatest knowledge. The unman Ifest one is termed Siva (Ample rous).

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्वाञ्जलिपुटौ भूत्वा तस्मै शर्वाय शूलिने । महाभैरवनादाय भीमरूपाय दंष्ट्रिणे । अव्यक्तायाथ महते नमस्कारं प्रकुर्वहे
verses.transliteration: prahvāñjalipuṭau bhūtvā tasmai śarvāya śūline / mahābhairavanādāya bhīmarūpāya daṃṣṭriṇe / avyaktāyātha mahate namaskāraṃ prakurvahe
verses.translation: "After hearing this, all the Devas went to their respective abodes, paying homage and respects unto Sankara the great soul.
verses.wordMeaning: "After hearing this, all the Devas went to their respective abodes, paying homage and respects unto Sankara the great soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: "After hearing this, all the Devas went to their respective abodes, paying homage and respects unto Sankara the great soul.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते लोकसुरेश देव नमो ऽस्तु ते भूतपते महात्मन् । नमो ऽस्तु ते शाश्वतसिद्धयोगिने नमोस्तु ते सर्वजगत्प्रतिष्ठित
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te lokasureśa deva namo 'stu te bhūtapate mahātman / namo 'stu te śāśvatasiddhayogine namostu te sarvajagatpratiṣṭhita
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: परमेष्ठी परं ब्रह्म त्वक्षरं परमं पदम् । ज्येष्ठस्त्वं वामदेवश्च रुद्रः स्कन्दः शिवः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: parameṣṭhī paraṃ brahma tvakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam / jyeṣṭhastvaṃ vāmadevaśca rudraḥ skandaḥ śivaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं य५स्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमोङ्कारः परन्तपः । स्वाहाकारो नमस्कारः संस्कारः सर्वकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ ya5stvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamoṅkāraḥ parantapaḥ / svāhākāro namaskāraḥ saṃskāraḥ sarvakarmaṇām
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: हे रेणुके! परम सावधान होकर अपने पुत्रों के सहित मेरी वाणी का श्रवण करो । है भद्रे ! तुम साहस मत करो । मैं आपका प्रिय वचनः कहुँगो'।४३। अपनी आत्मा के हित की अभिलाषो रखने वाले किसी को भी साहस कभी नहीं करना चाहिए। आपको नहीं "मरना चाहिए क्योंकि जो
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधाकारश्च यज्ञश्च व्रतानि नियमास्तथा । वेदा लोकाश्च देवाश्च भगवानेव सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: svadhākāraśca yajñaśca vratāni niyamāstathā / vedā lokāśca devāśca bhagavāneva sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: आणी जीवित रहता है वह शुभ कर्मों को देखा करता है।४४। इसलिए आप घैंयें के घन वाली होकर काल की प्रतीक्षा की आकाङ्क्षा वाली होओ। हे शुचिःस्मितःवालोः! भले ही कुछ' ही निमित्त को अन्तरित बनाकर ऐसा करो।४५।-बहुत ही स्वल्प समय में आपके भर्ता सचेतन हो जाँयंगे अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशस्य च शब्दस्त्वंभूतानां प्रभवाप्ययः । भूमौ गन्धो रसश्चाप्सु तेजोरूपं महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ākāśasya ca śabdastvaṃbhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ / bhūmau gandho rasaścāpsu tejorūpaṃ maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: जीवितः होःजाँयमे ग हेएशोभने ! 'जक उनमें जीवन'सभुस्वन्तम्होः नायगेहलो' ओपकी/कॉमला पूर्णतया प्राप्त हो जायि और फिरे विशेषः अधिककालः पर्थन्तः अंनेके कल्याणों की-भाजन होनेःवाली) होंगी'।४६। वसिछिकी ने कहाःःः इस प्रकार के उसःअन्तरिकःवाणी केःवचेत काः अवण करके रेणुकाःने धैर्य:
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: वायोः स्पर्शश्च देवेश वपुश्चन्द्रमसस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vāyoḥ sparśaśca deveśa vapuścandramasastathā
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धौ ज्ञानं च देवेश प्रकृतेर्बीजमेव च
verses.transliteration: buddhau jñānaṃ ca deveśa prakṛterbījameva ca
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: का आलम्बन ग्रहण किया था । और उसके जो पुत्र थे उन्होंने. भी उसके बचनों के गौरव से परम श्रसन्नता प्राप्त की थो ।४७। इसके पश्चात् उन्होने उस मुनि अपने पिता के मृत शरीर को आश्रम को भीतर ले जाकर रख दिया-ा ओर.उसको बहाँ लिटाकर निवात में वे उसके चारों ओर बैठ गये
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: संहर्त्ता सर्वलोकानां कालो मृत्युमय्ॐऽतकः । त्वं धारयसि लोकांस्त्रींस्त्वमेव सृजसि प्रभो
verses.transliteration: saṃharttā sarvalokānāṃ kālo mṛtyumayoṃ'takaḥ / tvaṃ dhārayasi lokāṃstrīṃstvameva sṛjasi prabho
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: थे ॥४८। जिस समय में जे वहाँ पर बहुत ही खिन्न आत्मा और मतों वाले बैठे हुए थे. तो उस बेला में उनको बहुत से परम शुअ एवं महान् निमित्त हुए
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वेण वदनेन त्वमिन्द्रत्वं प्रकरोषि वै । दक्षिणेन तु वक्त्रेण लोकान्संक्षिपसे पुनः
verses.transliteration: pūrveṇa vadanena tvamindratvaṃ prakaroṣi vai / dakṣiṇena tu vaktreṇa lokānsaṃkṣipase punaḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमेन तु वक्त्रेण वरुणस्थो न संशयः । उत्तरेण तु वक्त्रेण सोमस्त्वं देवसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: paścimena tu vaktreṇa varuṇastho na saṃśayaḥ / uttareṇa tu vaktreṇa somastvaṃ devasattamaḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: निषेदुः संहिता मांत्रा कांक्षंतो जीवितं पितुः
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एकधा बहुधा देव लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययः । आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतश्च सहाश्विनः
verses.transliteration: ekadhā bahudhā deva lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ / ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaśca sahāśvinaḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: साध्या विद्याधरा नागाश्चारणाश्च तपोधनाः । वालखिल्या महात्मानस्तपः सिद्धाश्च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sādhyā vidyādharā nāgāścāraṇāśca tapodhanāḥ / vālakhilyā mahātmānastapaḥ siddhāśca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तः प्रसूता देवेश ये चान्ये नियतव्रताः । उमा सीता सिनीवाली कुहूर्गायत्र्य एव च
verses.transliteration: tvattaḥ prasūtā deveśa ye cānye niyatavratāḥ / umā sītā sinīvālī kuhūrgāyatrya eva ca
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीः कीर्त्तिर्धृतिर्मेधा लज्जा कान्तिर्वपुः स्वधा । तुष्टिः पुष्टिः क्रिया चैव वाचां देवी सरस्वती । त्वत्तः प्रसूता देवेश संध्या रात्रिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīḥ kīrttirdhṛtirmedhā lajjā kāntirvapuḥ svadhā / tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kriyā caiva vācāṃ devī sarasvatī / tvattaḥ prasūtā deveśa saṃdhyā rātristathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यायुतानामयुतप्रभाव नमो ऽस्तु ते चन्द्रसहस्रगौर । नमो ऽस्तु ते वज्रपिनाकधारिणे नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवाससे
verses.transliteration: sūryāyutānāmayutaprabhāva namo 'stu te candrasahasragaura / namo 'stu te vajrapinākadhāriṇe namostu te deva hiraṇyavāsase
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: इस रीति से जब शुभ शकुन दिखाई दिये तो उनके देखने से वे श्रेष् मुनिगण परम आश्वस्त मन वाले/हो गये ये अर्थात् उनको कुछ शुभाशा हुई 'थी। वे सभी अपने पिता के जीवित की आकाङक्षा करते, हुए माता के साथ वहाँ पर बैठ गये ये ।५०। है राजनु ! इसी बीच में भृगु के वंश को
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: नमोस्तु ते भस्मविभूषिताङ्ग नमो ऽस्तु ते कामशरीरनाशन । नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यरेतसे नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवाससे
verses.transliteration: namostu te bhasmavibhūṣitāṅga namo 'stu te kāmaśarīranāśana / namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyaretase namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyavāsase
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: धारण करने वाले मतिमान् मुनि विधि के वल से यदच्छा से ही वहाँ पर समागत हो गये थे ।५१। वे मुनि अथर्व वेद-की साक्षात् विधि के स्वरूप बाले थे और अन्य सभी वेदों लथा वेदोंके अङ्क शास्त्रों के 'प्रारगामी मनीषी
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्ययोने नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यनाभ । नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यरेतसे नमो ऽस्तु ते नेत्रसहस्रचित्र
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyayone namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyanābha / namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyaretase namo 'stu te netrasahasracitra
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: रस्ट   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण थे। वे समस्त शास्त्रों के पारगामी अनीषी थे। के समस्त शास्त्रों के तात्त्विक अथीं के ज्ञाता विद्वान् थे और समस्त असुरों के दवारा वन्दित थे !५२ जो मनिमों के लिये भो अत्यन्त दुर्लभ होती है ऐसी मृत प्राणियों को
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवर्ण नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यकेश । नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवीर नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यदायिने
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyavarṇa namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyakeśa / namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyavīra namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyadāyine
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: भी जीवित कर देने वाली विद्या को जानते थे। जब भी देवों के द्वारा रण अं दानव निकृत हो जाया करते हैं ठो इसी मृत संजीवनी विद्या से उनको उड़ा दिया करते हैं अर्थाद् जीवित बना देते हैं ।५३। जिस महामुनि ने औशनस शास्त्र को प्रणीत किया था जो राजाओं को राज्य के फल को
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यनाथ नमो ऽश्तुते देव हिरण्यनाद । नमो ऽस्तु ते देव पिनाकपाणे नमो ऽश्तुते ते शङ्कर नीलकण्ठ
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyanātha namo 'śtute deva hiraṇyanāda / namo 'stu te deva pinākapāṇe namo 'śtute te śaṅkara nīlakaṇṭha
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करने वाला है और आज भी यहाँ पर नृपगण -जनुजीबिस रहते हैं ।५४। बह महामुनि उस आश्रम में पहुँच कर अन्दर प्रविष्ट हुए थे ओर अन्होंने उस अवम्भा में अवस्थित सबको दुःख से परिप्लुत हुए देखा था
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु व्यक्तो भूत्वा महामतिः । देवदेवो जगद्योनिः सूर्य कोटिसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu vyakto bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ / devadevo jagadyoniḥ sūrya koṭisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर उम सबने बंश के पिता भूगु मुनि का दर्शन प्राप्त करके बड़े ही आनन्द के साथ वे सब खड़े हो गये थे और गोत्रोत्यान देकर सबने उनका बड़ा सतकार किया था तथा प्रणाम करके भृगु मुनि को आसन सम- पित किया था
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: आबभाषे कृपाविष्टो महादेवो महाद्युतिः । वक्त्रकोटिसहस्रेण ग्रसमान इवांबरम्
verses.transliteration: ābabhāṣe kṛpāviṣṭo mahādevo mahādyutiḥ / vaktrakoṭisahasreṇa grasamāna ivāṃbaram
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कंबुग्रीवः सुज ठरो नानाभूषणभूषितः । नानारत्नविचित्राङ्गो नानामाल्यानुलेपनः
verses.transliteration: kaṃbugrīvaḥ suja ṭharo nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ / nānāratnavicitrāṅgo nānāmālyānulepanaḥ

verses.transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā cāvāṃ bhītau mahātmanaḥ / athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto 'haṃ surasattamau

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतां च महायोगं भयं सर्व प्रमुच्यताम् । युवां प्रसूतौ गात्रेभ्यो मम पूर्वं सनातनौ
verses.transliteration: paśyatāṃ ca mahāyogaṃ bhayaṃ sarva pramucyatām / yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: यं मे दक्षिणो बाहुर्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । वामो बाहुश्च मे विष्णुर्नित्यं युद्धेष्वनिर्जितः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ me dakṣiṇo bāhurbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / vāmo bāhuśca me viṣṇurnityaṃ yuddheṣvanirjitaḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: उन महामुनि ने आशीर्वादों के द्वारा सबका अभिनन्दन करके उनसे उन्होने पूछा था कि यह क्या हुआ है ! इस पर उन्होंने पूरा वृत्तान्त जो भी वहाँ पर घटनाएँ चटित हुई थीं भुगुमुनि की सेवा में निवेदित कर दी थीं ५७) यह सारा वृत्तान्त सुनकर मन्त्र शास्त्र के महामनोषी भगु भुनि ने
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतो ऽहं युवयोः सम्यग्वरं दद्यां यथैप्सितम् । ततः प्रहृष्टमनसौ प्रणतौ पादयोः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: prīto 'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyagvaraṃ dadyāṃ yathaipsitam / tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasau praṇatau pādayoḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: बहुत ही शीक्ष जल लेकर यह उच्चारण करते हुए संजीवनी विद्या से उस जमदरिन के देह को अभिषिक्त किया था। यदि मेरे तप का और यक्ष का बीयं शुभ है तो उसके प्रभाव से यह जमदस्नि सोकर उठे हुए के ही समान शीघ्र ही जीवित हो आवें ।५८-५६१ इस प्रकार से इस परम शुभ वाक्य को
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रूतां च महादेवं प्रसादाभिमुखं स्थितम् । यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना यदि देयो वरश्च ते । भक्तिर्भवतु नौ नित्यं त्वयि देव सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: abrūtāṃ ca mahādevaṃ prasādābhimukhaṃ sthitam / yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca te / bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi deva sureśvara
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: साधुकारी भृगु मुनि के द्वारा उच्चारित होने पर शीघ्र ही जमदग्नि साक्षाद् दूसरे देवगुंक के हो सह सभुस्थित हो गया था ।६०। जब उठा तो उसने बहाँ पर संस्थित-बम्दना करने के योग्य अपने पितामह भुगु मुनि का दशेन किया था । है नृपते ! उस जमदग्नि ने भक्ति की भावना से प्रणाम करके
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव उवाच एवमस्तु महाभागौ सृजतां विपुलाः प्रजाः । एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तत्रैवातरधाद्विभुः
verses.transliteration: devadeva uvāca evamastu mahābhāgau sṛjatāṃ vipulāḥ prajāḥ / evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivātaradhādvibhuḥ
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: दोनों हाथों को जोड़कर उनसे कहा था ॥६१। जमदग्नि ने कहा--मैं परम धन्य तथा कृतकृत्य हो गपा हैं और मेरा जीवन आज सफल हो गया है ।६२। जौ सुरगण और असुरो के द्वारा बन्दित आपके चरण कमल हैं उनका आज मैं अपने नेश्रों से अवलोकन कर रहा हूँ । है मान के प्रदान करने वाले
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एष एव मयोक्तो वः प्रभावस्तस्य धीमतः । एतद्धि परमं ज्ञानमव्यक्तं शिवसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa eva mayokto vaḥ prabhāvastasya dhīmataḥ / etaddhi paramaṃ jñānamavyaktaṃ śivasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: भगवन् ! मैं आपकी इस समय में क्या शुषा करूँ ? मुझे आप आशा कीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सूक्ष्ममचिन्त्यं च पश्यन्ति ज्ञ३नचक्षुषः । तस्मै देवाधिदेवाय नमस्कारं प्रकुर्महे । महादेव नमस्ते ऽस्तु महेश्वर नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: etatsūkṣmamacintyaṃ ca paśyanti jña3nacakṣuṣaḥ / tasmai devādhidevāya namaskāraṃ prakurmahe / mahādeva namaste 'stu maheśvara namo 'stu te

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा गताः सर्वे सुराः स्वं स्वं निवेशनम् । नमस्कारं प्रकुर्वाणाः शङ्कराय महात्मने
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca etacchrutvā gatāḥ sarve surāḥ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam / namaskāraṃ prakurvāṇāḥ śaṅkarāya mahātmane
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: साधुबुद्धघा स दुशत्मा कि चकार महामते ।

verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.transliteration: imaṃ stavaṃ paṭhidyastu ceśvarasya mahātmanaḥ / kāmāṃśca labhate sarvān pāpebhyaśca pramucyate

verses.hindi: चिरं ध्यास्वा समालोच्य कारणं प्राह भूपते

verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.

verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ tadā tena na viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / mahādevaprasādena hyuktaṃ brahma sanātanam / etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā māheśvaraṃ balam
verses.translation: He who recites this hymn unto the lord, the great soul, obtains all desires and gets rid of all sins.
