verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे लिङ्गोत्पत्तिकथनं नाम षड्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः भूय षुत महाबुद्धे कथयस्व महात्मनः । महादेवस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुं कौतूहलं च नः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde liṅgotpattikathanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ bhūya ṣuta mahābuddhe kathayasva mahātmanaḥ / mahādevasya māhātmyaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ ca naḥ
verses.translation: Recount once again> O SCta of great intellect, die greatness of Mahadeva. Wc are eager and curious to listen to it.
verses.hindi: भूग्रुर्वाच-छणु तात महाभाग बोजमस्य हि कर्मण: । मश्च वे क्तवान्पापं  सर्वज्ञस्य तवानघ ४६६
verses.wordMeaning: Recount once again> O SCta of great intellect, die greatness of Mahadeva. Wc are eager and curious to listen to it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Recount once again> O SCta of great intellect, die greatness of Mahadeva. Wc are eager and curious to listen to it.

verses.sanskrit: कथं दारुवणे देव-ऋषिसंघनिषेविते । चकार वेषं विकृतं येन बुद्धा महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ dāruvaṇe deva-ṛṣisaṃghaniṣevite / cakāra veṣaṃ vikṛtaṃ yena buddhā maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: How did the lord assume a loathsome form in the forest Daruvana resorted to by the groups of divine sages? The great sages gained wisdom thereby.
verses.hindi: हे विभो ! आप अपने चरणों के जल कणों के द्वारा अपने .ही इस कुल को पुतीत बनाइए । इतना कहकर आनन्द से समन्वित होते हुए सहसा राम के द्वारा .अच्ये लाया था ।६४। भक्तिभाब से अपनी गर्देन सुकाने वाले उस जमदग्नि ने उन भृगु मुनि के चरणों के प्रक्षालनाथ जल समर्पित किया
verses.wordMeaning: How did the lord assume a loathsome form in the forest Daruvana resorted to by the groups of divine sages? The great sages gained wisdom thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the lord assume a loathsome form in the forest Daruvana resorted to by the groups of divine sages? The great sages gained wisdom thereby.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा च ते महादेवं ततो भ्रान्ता ह्यचेतसः । आराधयन्प्रसादार्थं नैषां तुष्टः पुनर्भवः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā ca te mahādevaṃ tato bhrāntā hyacetasaḥ / ārādhayanprasādārthaṃ naiṣāṃ tuṣṭaḥ punarbhavaḥ
verses.translation: All these activities of the lord of the Devas may kindly be recounted to u$ in number as they took place. You are the most excellent one among intelligent persons.**
verses.hindi: था ।  महाघु.यश.बाले उसे जमदग्निः ने अपने समस्त कुटुम्ब के सहित उस अरणों के तीर्थ जल को अपने शिर पर धारण किया था ।६५। इसके उप- रान्त-उनका पर्ण सत्कार करके परम विलय से समर्बित होते हुए भूगु से पूछा था.। है भगवन् ! आप कृपया-बतलाइए कि उस महाभू दुष्ट राजा ने
verses.wordMeaning: All these activities of the lord of the Devas may kindly be recounted to u$ in number as they took place. You are the most excellent one among intelligent persons.**
verses.commentary: Sense: All these activities of the lord of the Devas may kindly be recounted to u$ in number as they took place. You are the most excellent one among intelligent persons.**

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं यथावृत्तं देवदेवेन चेष्टितम् । तत्सर्वं कथयस्वेह त्वं नो बुद्धिमतां वरः
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ devadevena ceṣṭitam / tatsarvaṃ kathayasveha tvaṃ no buddhimatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: 'Xet this righteous activity be heard while I recount it, O alert ones. It is, due to his compassion towards the devotees, that this had been carried out by the lord of the Devas.
verses.hindi: यह क्या पातक किया था ? ।६६। जिसका -आतिथ्य-सत्कार मैंने बड़े ही विधि-विधान से किया था। है महामते ! पैंने यह सब बहुत ही अच्छो बुद्धि से किया.था और मेरे हृदय में कुछ भी कपट का भाव नहीं था। फिर भी उस आत्मा बाले ने मेरे साथ यह ऐसा क्यों दुम्यंवहार किया था
verses.wordMeaning: 'Xet this righteous activity be heard while I recount it, O alert ones. It is, due to his compassion towards the devotees, that this had been carried out by the lord of the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Xet this righteous activity be heard while I recount it, O alert ones. It is, due to his compassion towards the devotees, that this had been carried out by the lord of the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि धर्ममेतमतन्द्रिताः । निर्म्मितं देवदेवेन भक्तानामनुकंपया
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi dharmametamatandritāḥ / nirmmitaṃ devadevena bhaktānāmanukaṃpayā
verses.translation: (This happened) O Brahmanas, formerly on the splendid and auspicious peak of the Himalayas in the Krta- yuga. There is a forest of Devadaru trees which is beautiful and full of many trees and creepers,
verses.hindi: बसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--इस प्रकार से जब जमदग्नि के द्वारा सब कुछ के ज्ञात ईश्वर और महामतिमान् भुगु से पुछा गया तब है भूपते ! भृगु मुनि ने बहुत काल पर्यन्त ध्यान करके" भली भतिं अवलोकन किया'था और फिर इस सब घटना के घटित'होने का जो भी/कुछ कारण! था वह कहा था ।६८।,
verses.wordMeaning: (This happened) O Brahmanas, formerly on the splendid and auspicious peak of the Himalayas in the Krta- yuga. There is a forest of Devadaru trees which is beautiful and full of many trees and creepers,
verses.commentary: Sense: (This happened) O Brahmanas, formerly on the splendid and auspicious peak of the Himalayas in the Krta- yuga. There is a forest of Devadaru trees which is beautiful and full of many trees and creepers,

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगे विप्राः शृङ्गे हिमवतः शुभे । देवदारुवनं रम्यं नानाद्रुमलताकुलम्
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayuge viprāḥ śṛṅge himavataḥ śubhe / devadāruvanaṃ ramyaṃ nānādrumalatākulam
verses.translation: W. 7-9 illustrate the different vows observed by laget while per- forminpenaccc.
verses.hindi: शृगुमुनि ने कहा--हे महाल भाग बाले तात ! इस कुत्सित कमे का जो भी बीज है उसी को आप सुन लीजिए । है अनघ ! जिसने हैहय राजा ने सर्वज्ञ आपका निश्चित रूप से पाप किया था ।६९। बहुत प्राचीन संमय में वसिष्ठ मुनि ने विनाश होने केलिये उस राजाको शाप दे दिया था। 'बह शाप
verses.wordMeaning: W. 7-9 illustrate the different vows observed by laget while per- forminpenaccc.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 7-9 illustrate the different vows observed by laget while per- forminpenaccc.

verses.sanskrit: बहवो मुनयस्तत्र तपस्यन्तो मुनिव्रताः । शैवाल भोजनाः केचित्केचिदन्तर्जलेशयाः
verses.transliteration: bahavo munayastatra tapasyanto munivratāḥ / śaivāla bhojanāḥ kecitkecidantarjaleśayāḥ
verses.translation: At some places he laughed boisterously and terribly. At some places he showed surprise and began to sing. At some places he began to dance expressing amorous sentiment. At some places he began to cry again and again.
verses.hindi: बही था कि है सूढ़ ! द्विज के अपराध-करने से सेरा सब बीये विक्रमः विनाश को प्राप्त हो जायगा
verses.wordMeaning: At some places he laughed boisterously and terribly. At some places he showed surprise and began to sing. At some places he began to dance expressing amorous sentiment. At some places he began to cry again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: At some places he laughed boisterously and terribly. At some places he showed surprise and began to sing. At some places he began to dance expressing amorous sentiment. At some places he began to cry again and again.

verses.sanskrit: केचिदभ्रावकाशास्तु पादाङ्गुष्ठाग्रधिष्ठिताः । दन्तोलूखलिनश्चान्ये त्वश्मकुट्टास्तथा परे
verses.transliteration: kecidabhrāvakāśāstu pādāṅguṣṭhāgradhiṣṭhitāḥ / dantolūkhalinaścānye tvaśmakuṭṭāstathā pare
verses.translation: Deluded and enchanted by him the wives of the sages immediately prevented him from dancing. After coming to the hermitage as a guest, he began to beg again and again.
verses.wordMeaning: Deluded and enchanted by him the wives of the sages immediately prevented him from dancing. After coming to the hermitage as a guest, he began to beg again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded and enchanted by him the wives of the sages immediately prevented him from dancing. After coming to the hermitage as a guest, he began to beg again and again.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानवीरासनाश्चान्ये मृगयर्यारतास्तथा । कालं नयन्ति तपसा तीव्रेण च महाधियः
verses.transliteration: sthānavīrāsanāścānye mṛgayaryāratāstathā / kālaṃ nayanti tapasā tīvreṇa ca mahādhiyaḥ
verses.translation: He created a wife unto himself, similar in form and bedecked in ornaments. He roared and bellowed like a bull and brayed like a donkey.
verses.hindi: एकविशतिवारं वह भू दुःखपरीतया ।- त्रिःसप्तङ्गस्वो निःक्षत्रां करिष्ये पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.wordMeaning: He created a wife unto himself, similar in form and bedecked in ornaments. He roared and bellowed like a bull and brayed like a donkey.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created a wife unto himself, similar in form and bedecked in ornaments. He roared and bellowed like a bull and brayed like a donkey.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषां प्रसादार्थ देवस्तद्वनमागतः । भस्मपाण्डुरदिग्धाङ्गो नग्नो विकृतलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣāṃ prasādārtha devastadvanamāgataḥ / bhasmapāṇḍuradigdhāṅgo nagno vikṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He began to befool them making all the embodied ones laugh. Thereupon, the sages became angry* They were over-whelmed by fury.
verses.wordMeaning: He began to befool them making all the embodied ones laugh. Thereupon, the sages became angry* They were over-whelmed by fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: He began to befool them making all the embodied ones laugh. Thereupon, the sages became angry* They were over-whelmed by fury.

verses.sanskrit: विकृतस्रस्तकेशश्च करालदशनस्तथा । उल्मुकव्यग्रहस्तश्च रक्तपिङ्गललोचनः
verses.transliteration: vikṛtasrastakeśaśca karāladaśanastathā / ulmukavyagrahastaśca raktapiṅgalalocanaḥ
verses.translation: Fascinated by his deluding power (Maya) they approached him in order to curse him. Since you sing (bray) like a (donkey) you will become a donkey.
verses.hindi: स तु राजा महाभागो वृद्धानां पयुं पासिता । दत्तात्रेया द्धरेरं शाल्लब्धबोधो महामतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Fascinated by his deluding power (Maya) they approached him in order to curse him. Since you sing (bray) like a (donkey) you will become a donkey.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fascinated by his deluding power (Maya) they approached him in order to curse him. Since you sing (bray) like a (donkey) you will become a donkey.

verses.sanskrit: शिश्नं सवृषणं तस्य रक्तगैरिकसन्निभम् । मुखमङ्गारवर्णेन शुक्लेन च विभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ tasya raktagairikasannibham / mukhamaṅgāravarṇena śuklena ca vibhūṣitam
verses.translation: These verses describe the Piiupata wny of behaviour or penance. Vide PSiupata SAtra's (with KauodiQva's Com.) Ch III lutras 1-19. Pitiu' patas are iiutrueted to behave in such a way whereby the practitioner of the Vrata is insulted {wmutoft). The snoge behaviour of Siva described in this and subsequent verses is found pre scri bed in Pihpdo*SStrain
verses.wordMeaning: These verses describe the Piiupata wny of behaviour or penance. Vide PSiupata SAtra's (with KauodiQva's Com.) Ch III lutras 1-19. Pitiu' patas are iiutrueted to behave in such a way whereby the practitioner of the Vrata is insulted {wmutoft).…
verses.commentary: Sense: These verses describe the Piiupata wny of behaviour or penance. Vide PSiupata SAtra's (with KauodiQva's Com.) Ch III lutras 1-19. Pitiu' patas are iiutrueted to behave in such a way whereby the practitioner of the Vrata is insulted {wmutoft).…

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्स हसते रौद्रं क्वचिद्गायति विस्मि तः । क्वचिन्नृत्यति शृङ्गारी क्वचिद्रौति मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: kvacitsa hasate raudraṃ kvacidgāyati vismi taḥ / kvacinnṛtyati śṛṅgārī kvacidrauti muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Just as the stars in the sky do not shine on account of refulgence of the sun so also their splendour (power of penance) (became ineffective) on Sankara.
verses.hindi: मुनि तो सबंदा सत्यवक्ता होते हैं अतः उस महामुनि'का वचन किस प्रकार से अन्यथा होगा ।- यहं आपका पुल राम महान वीर्य वाले उस श्रेष्ठ नृप को बल पूर्वक मार देगाः। है महाबाहो ! यह पहिले ही ऐसी प्रतिज्ञा कर चुका है। कारण यह् है कि वियोग के शोक से संतप्त होकर मेरे ही
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the stars in the sky do not shine on account of refulgence of the sun so also their splendour (power of penance) (became ineffective) on Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the stars in the sky do not shine on account of refulgence of the sun so also their splendour (power of penance) (became ineffective) on Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यन्त रुरुधुस्तूर्णं पत्न्यस्तेषां विमोहिताः । आश्रमे ऽभ्यागतो ऽभीक्ष्णं या चते च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: nṛtyanta rurudhustūrṇaṃ patnyasteṣāṃ vimohitāḥ / āśrame 'bhyāgato 'bhīkṣṇaṃ yā cate ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On account of the curse of Bhrgu, Viwu of very supreme prowess and splendour had to take ten births and waa made miserable for ever.
verses.hindi: समक्ष से अपने वक्षःस्थल को प्रताड़ित किया है ।७१-७२! आपने अपने उरः स्थल को बहुत ही दुःख से परीत होकर इक्कीस: बार प्रताड़ित किया है सो शैं मी इक्कीस बार ही इस सम्धूर्ण भूमण्डल को क्षजियों से रहित करूँगा ।७३। है मानद ! इसीलिए पिता आपके द्वारा यह निरन्तर रोके जाने पर
verses.wordMeaning: On account of the curse of Bhrgu, Viwu of very supreme prowess and splendour had to take ten births and waa made miserable for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of the curse of Bhrgu, Viwu of very supreme prowess and splendour had to take ten births and waa made miserable for ever.

verses.sanskrit: भार्या कृता तथारूपा तृणाभरणभूषिता । वृषनादं प्रगर्जन्वै खरनादं ननाद च
verses.transliteration: bhāryā kṛtā tathārūpā tṛṇābharaṇabhūṣitā / vṛṣanādaṃ pragarjanvai kharanādaṃ nanāda ca
verses.translation: Formerly, the penis ofindra along with his scrotum), O sages conversant with Virtue, was made to fall down on the earth by the infuriated sage Gautama.
verses.hindi: भी भविष्य में होने वाले अर्थ के बल से ऐसा अवश्य ही करेगा क्‍योंकि ऐसा ही होनहार है ।७४। बह साक्षात् भक्त और महात्मा है । उसके वध करने में पातक भी होगा । इस रीति सेःकहकर.हे महाराज- -उत ब्रह्माजी के पुत्र भृुमुततिःने फिर यह भी कहा था.कि वह राजा महान भाग वाला है ओर
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the penis ofindra along with his scrotum), O sages conversant with Virtue, was made to fall down on the earth by the infuriated sage Gautama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the penis ofindra along with his scrotum), O sages conversant with Virtue, was made to fall down on the earth by the infuriated sage Gautama.

verses.sanskrit: तथा वञ्चितुमा रब्धो हासयन्सर्वदेहिनः । ततस्ते मुनयः क्रुद्धाः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृताः
verses.transliteration: tathā vañcitumā rabdho hāsayansarvadehinaḥ / tataste munayaḥ kruddhāḥ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The Vasus were forced to stay in the womb on account of a curse. It is on account of the curse of sages that Nahua was turned into a serpent.*
verses.hindi: बुद्धो की --उपासना-करने काला है ।-साक्षात् भगवात्रु हरि के अंश दत्तान्रेम 'मुनि से उसने ज्ञान: प्राप्त किग्रा है. और महती -अति से 'सुसम्पन्त है। ऐसे का "बंध करता भी महान् पातक हैं । इतना:ही कहकर भविष्य में आने वाले कालः के-पर्यत-से ये-निद्वान्-भुगु जसे ही आये थे वैसे ही वहाँ से. चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: The Vasus were forced to stay in the womb on account of a curse. It is on account of the curse of sages that Nahua was turned into a serpent.*
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vasus were forced to stay in the womb on account of a curse. It is on account of the curse of sages that Nahua was turned into a serpent.*

verses.sanskrit: मोहिता मायया सर्वे शपितुं समुपस्थिताः । करवद्गायसे यस्मात्खरस्तस्माद्भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: mohitā māyayā sarve śapituṃ samupasthitāḥ / karavadgāyase yasmātkharastasmādbhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: These and many others underwent much torment excepting Mafaesvara, the lord of the Devas with uneven (three) eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: These and many others underwent much torment excepting Mafaesvara, the lord of the Devas with uneven (three) eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and many others underwent much torment excepting Mafaesvara, the lord of the Devas with uneven (three) eyes.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसो वा पिशाचो वा दानवो वाथ वा तथा । यथा वैच्छंस्तथा सर्वे क्रुद्धास्ते मुनयः समम्
verses.transliteration: rākṣaso vā piśāco vā dānavo vātha vā tathā / yathā vaicchaṃstathā sarve kruddhāste munayaḥ samam
verses.translation: Thus, enchanted by him, they did not recognize Sankara. Thereupon, all those sages spoke to each other.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, enchanted by him, they did not recognize Sankara. Thereupon, all those sages spoke to each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, enchanted by him, they did not recognize Sankara. Thereupon, all those sages spoke to each other.

verses.sanskrit: शेपुः शासैस्तु विविधैस्तं देवं भुवनेश्वरम् । तपांसि तेषां सर्वेषां प्रत्याहन्यन्त शङ्करे
verses.transliteration: śepuḥ śāsaistu vividhaistaṃ devaṃ bhuvaneśvaram / tapāṃsi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyāhanyanta śaṅkare
verses.translation: VR VII 51.11-16 states that Bhrgu cursed si he killed
verses.hindi: यच्चकार महावीर्थ्यो राज्ञः क्रुद्धो हि कमणा
verses.wordMeaning: VR VII 51.11-16 states that Bhrgu cursed si he killed
verses.commentary: Sense: VR VII 51.11-16 states that Bhrgu cursed si he killed

verses.sanskrit: यथादित्यप्रकाशेन तारका नभसि स्थिताः । न द्योतन्ते प्रकाशेन तद्वत्तेजांसि शङ्करे
verses.transliteration: yathādityaprakāśena tārakā nabhasi sthitāḥ / na dyotante prakāśena tadvattejāṃsi śaṅkare
verses.translation: ''This is not the right code of conduct laid down ibr us householders. Nor is it the rite of those engaged in the vow of celibacy or the forest-hermitages.
verses.wordMeaning: ''This is not the right code of conduct laid down ibr us householders. Nor is it the rite of those engaged in the vow of celibacy or the forest-hermitages.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''This is not the right code of conduct laid down ibr us householders. Nor is it the rite of those engaged in the vow of celibacy or the forest-hermitages.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते ऋषिशापेन ब्रह्मणः सुमहात्मनः । समृद्धः श्रेयसां यौनिर्यज्ञो वै नाशमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: śrūyate ṛṣiśāpena brahmaṇaḥ sumahātmanaḥ / samṛddhaḥ śreyasāṃ yauniryajño vai nāśamāptavān
verses.translation: The sun did not shine; the fire became devoid of lustre. The stars and the planets became contrary (to their normal state).
verses.wordMeaning: The sun did not shine; the fire became devoid of lustre. The stars and the planets became contrary (to their normal state).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun did not shine; the fire became devoid of lustre. The stars and the planets became contrary (to their normal state).

verses.sanskrit: भृगोरपि च शापेन विष्णुः परमवियवान् । प्रादुर्भावान्दश प्राप्तो दुःखितश्च सदा कृतः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgorapi ca śāpena viṣṇuḥ paramaviyavān / prādurbhāvāndaśa prāpto duḥkhitaśca sadā kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Kratus (sacrifices?) of the sages who had plenty of resources and who were engaged in activities conducive to the birth of children and who used to approach their wives only at the permitted period alter the days ofmenstruationidid not function properly.
verses.wordMeaning: The Kratus (sacrifices?) of the sages who had plenty of resources and who were engaged in activities conducive to the birth of children and who used to approach their wives only at the permitted period alter the days ofmenstruationidid not function properly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kratus (sacrifices?) of the sages who had plenty of resources and who were engaged in activities conducive to the birth of children and who used to approach their wives only at the permitted period alter the days ofmenstruationidid not function properly.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्यापि हि धर्मज्ञः शिश्नं सवृषणं पुरा । ऋषिणा गौतमेनोर्व्यां क्रुद्धेन विनिपातितम्
verses.transliteration: indrasyāpi hi dharmajñaḥ śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ purā / ṛṣiṇā gautamenorvyāṃ kruddhena vinipātitam
verses.translation: The laget were obviously ignoraat of the Paiupata way of Ufb.
verses.wordMeaning: The laget were obviously ignoraat of the Paiupata way of Ufb.
verses.commentary: Sense: The laget were obviously ignoraat of the Paiupata way of Ufb.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भवासो वसूनां च शापेन विहित स्तथा । ऋषीणां चैव शापेन नहुषः सर्पतां गतः
verses.transliteration: garbhavāso vasūnāṃ ca śāpena vihita stathā / ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva śāpena nahuṣaḥ sarpatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Without tho sense of My-ness (mamatva) and devoid of egotism, they tried to perform the holy rite once again. (But) all their potentiality and all their splendour became lost.
verses.hindi: राजा सगर ने कहा-हे मद्दाभाग ! है अह्पुअं ! अब आप कृपा करके भामेन के चेष्टित का वर्णेन कीजिए । सहान् चीये वाले राम ने राजा के इस कुत्सित कर्म सें छूद्ध होकर जो भी कुछ किया था ११। वसि जी ते कहा--अब महामाग भृगुमुनि वहाँ से चले गये थे तो उस समय में पिता फे
verses.wordMeaning: Without tho sense of My-ness (mamatva) and devoid of egotism, they tried to perform the holy rite once again. (But) all their potentiality and all their splendour became lost.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without tho sense of My-ness (mamatva) and devoid of egotism, they tried to perform the holy rite once again. (But) all their potentiality and all their splendour became lost.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदश्च समुद्रश्च ह्यपेयो ब्राह्मणैः कृतः । धर्मश्चात्र प्रशप्तो वै माण्डव्येन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodaśca samudraśca hyapeyo brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ / dharmaścātra praśapto vai māṇḍavyena mahātmanā
verses.translation: At that time their mind did not become concentrated in Dharma (holy rites etc.). All of them gathered together and went to the region of god Brahma.
verses.hindi: चरशों की सेवा में तत्पर रहने वाले राम ने वारम्वार अत्युष्ण श्वासों का मोचन करते हुए बहुत ही कृद होकर कहा था १९। परशुराम मे कहा-- अही  उत्पथ के गमन करने वाले राजा की मूढता को देखिए जिस कात. वीर्ये ने परम विद्वान् होते हुए आ एक तपस्वी ब्राह्मण के वध करने का
verses.wordMeaning: At that time their mind did not become concentrated in Dharma (holy rites etc.). All of them gathered together and went to the region of god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time their mind did not become concentrated in Dharma (holy rites etc.). All of them gathered together and went to the region of god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवो यातनां च समागताः । वर्जयित्वा विरूपाक्षं देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo yātanāṃ ca samāgatāḥ / varjayitvā virūpākṣaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: After going to the abode of Brahma and on seeing the Lotus*bom deity, at his abode all of them fell at hxs feet and narrated the account about §iva.
verses.hindi: उद्यम किया था ।३। मैं यह बात मानता हूँ कि देव बड़ा बलवाबु होता है
verses.wordMeaning: After going to the abode of Brahma and on seeing the Lotus*bom deity, at his abode all of them fell at hxs feet and narrated the account about §iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going to the abode of Brahma and on seeing the Lotus*bom deity, at his abode all of them fell at hxs feet and narrated the account about §iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि मोहितास्तेन न चाबुद्ध्यन्त शङ्करम् । ततस्ते ऋषयः सर्वे परस्परमथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi mohitāstena na cābuddhyanta śaṅkaram / tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve parasparamathābruvan
verses.translation: 'He is formidable and frightful. His hair is stiff and rough. His teeth are terrific. His hands arc eager to get hold of an owl* (?)
verses.wordMeaning: 'He is formidable and frightful. His hair is stiff and rough. His teeth are terrific. His hands arc eager to get hold of an owl* (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: 'He is formidable and frightful. His hair is stiff and rough. His teeth are terrific. His hands arc eager to get hold of an owl* (?)

verses.sanskrit: न चायं विधिरस्माकं गृहस्थानां विधीयते । ब्रह्मचर्य रतानां च वने वा वनवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: na cāyaṃ vidhirasmākaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ vidhīyate / brahmacarya ratānāṃ ca vane vā vanavāsinām
verses.translation: He alone creates all subjects singly and by means •of his own vigour. He alone is the discus*bearing lord (Viu) -whose chest is characteristically marked by Srlvatsa.
verses.wordMeaning: He alone creates all subjects singly and by means •of his own vigour. He alone is the discus*bearing lord (Viu) -whose chest is characteristically marked by Srlvatsa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone creates all subjects singly and by means •of his own vigour. He alone is the discus*bearing lord (Viu) -whose chest is characteristically marked by Srlvatsa.

verses.sanskrit: यतीनां वा तथा धर्मो नायं दृष्टः कथञ्चन । अनयस्तु महानेष येनायं मोहितो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: yatīnāṃ vā tathā dharmo nāyaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ kathañcana / anayastu mahāneṣa yenāyaṃ mohito dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Three forms of Rudra should be known andrealized by learned men. The Tamos form is Agni, the Rajas form is Brahma and Sativa is Visnu, the illuminator.
verses.wordMeaning: Three forms of Rudra should be known andrealized by learned men. The Tamos form is Agni, the Rajas form is Brahma and Sativa is Visnu, the illuminator.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three forms of Rudra should be known andrealized by learned men. The Tamos form is Agni, the Rajas form is Brahma and Sativa is Visnu, the illuminator.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं प्रपातयस्वैतन्नायं धर्मस्तपस्विनाम् । वदस्व वाचा मधुरं वस्त्रमेकं समाश्रय
verses.transliteration: liṅgaṃ prapātayasvaitannāyaṃ dharmastapasvinām / vadasva vācā madhuraṃ vastramekaṃ samāśraya
verses.translation: Thereupon, you will see the lord of the Devas who can rarely be seen by ignorant and foolish persons who have not mastered their own selves. On seeing him, all ignorance and evils shall be destroyed.''
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, you will see the lord of the Devas who can rarely be seen by ignorant and foolish persons who have not mastered their own selves. On seeing him, all ignorance and evils shall be destroyed.''
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, you will see the lord of the Devas who can rarely be seen by ignorant and foolish persons who have not mastered their own selves. On seeing him, all ignorance and evils shall be destroyed.''

verses.sanskrit: त्याजिते च त्वया लिङ्गे ततः पूजामवाप्स्यसि । ऋषीणां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्भगनेत्रहा
verses.transliteration: tyājite ca tvayā liṅge tataḥ pūjāmavāpsyasi / ṛṣīṇāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānbhaganetrahā
verses.translation: Thereupon, they circumambulated Brahma of immeasured vigour. Becoming devoid of all grief, they returned and settled in the forest ofDevadaru (Himalayan cedar) trees once again.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, they circumambulated Brahma of immeasured vigour. Becoming devoid of all grief, they returned and settled in the forest ofDevadaru (Himalayan cedar) trees once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, they circumambulated Brahma of immeasured vigour. Becoming devoid of all grief, they returned and settled in the forest ofDevadaru (Himalayan cedar) trees once again.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा प्रहसन्निव शङ्करः । न शक्यमिदमस्मा कं लिङ्गं पातयितुं बलात्
verses.transliteration: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā prahasanniva śaṅkaraḥ / na śakyamidamasmā kaṃ liṅgaṃ pātayituṃ balāt
verses.translation: The great God entered that penance-grove and forest wherein many trees and creepers had put forth flowers, where that part of tract had been resonant with the drone of swarms of bees and which was filled with the sweet notes of the cuckoo.
verses.wordMeaning: The great God entered that penance-grove and forest wherein many trees and creepers had put forth flowers, where that part of tract had been resonant with the drone of swarms of bees and which was filled with the sweet notes of the cuckoo.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great God entered that penance-grove and forest wherein many trees and creepers had put forth flowers, where that part of tract had been resonant with the drone of swarms of bees and which was filled with the sweet notes of the cuckoo.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिदैवतैः सर्वैः किमुतान्यैस्तपोधनैः । पातयेयमहं चैतल्लिङ्गं भो द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: brahmādidaivataiḥ sarvaiḥ kimutānyaistapodhanaiḥ / pātayeyamahaṃ caitalliṅgaṃ bho dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance be to Bhava, Bhavya (splendid one), Bhavana (sanctiher) andUdbhava (source of origin). Hail to the lord of spirits, the lord of infinite strength and virility.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to Bhava, Bhavya (splendid one), Bhavana (sanctiher) andUdbhava (source of origin). Hail to the lord of spirits, the lord of infinite strength and virility.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to Bhava, Bhavya (splendid one), Bhavana (sanctiher) andUdbhava (source of origin). Hail to the lord of spirits, the lord of infinite strength and virility.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमे तिष्ठ वा गच्छ वाक्यमित्येव ते ऽब्रुवन् । एवमुक्तो महादेवः प्रत्दृष्टेन्द्रियचेष्टितः
verses.transliteration: āśrame tiṣṭha vā gaccha vākyamityeva te 'bruvan / evamukto mahādevaḥ pratdṛṣṭendriyaceṣṭitaḥ
verses.translation: Bow to the lord of tawny-complexioned body the destroyer, the imperishable one, the changing one. Obei¬ sance to the lord, to the supporter of the current of Ganga water. Bow to the lord who is the support; salutations to the soul of good qualities.
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to the lord of tawny-complexioned body the destroyer, the imperishable one, the changing one. Obei¬ sance to the lord, to the supporter of the current of Ganga water. Bow to the lord who is the support; salutations to the soul of good qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to the lord of tawny-complexioned body the destroyer, the imperishable one, the changing one. Obei¬ sance to the lord, to the supporter of the current of Ganga water. Bow to the lord who is the support; salutations to the soul of good qualities.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां पश्यतामेव तत्रैवान्तर्दधे प्रभुः । अन्तर्हिते भगवति तथा लिङ्गे कृते भवे
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmeva tatraivāntardadhe prabhuḥ / antarhite bhagavati tathā liṅge kṛte bhave
verses.translation: Obeisance to Tryambaka (the three-cyed lord). Hail to the lord who wields the excellent trident. Bow to you (identical with) Kandarpa. Obeisance be to you the Supreme Soul.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Tryambaka (the three-cyed lord). Hail to the lord who wields the excellent trident. Bow to you (identical with) Kandarpa. Obeisance be to you the Supreme Soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Tryambaka (the three-cyed lord). Hail to the lord who wields the excellent trident. Bow to you (identical with) Kandarpa. Obeisance be to you the Supreme Soul.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां प्रादुर्भावो न जायते । व्याकुलं च तदा सर्वं न प्रकाशेत किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ prādurbhāvo na jāyate / vyākulaṃ ca tadā sarvaṃ na prakāśeta kiñcana
verses.translation: Obeisance to Sankara, the bull-bannered one. Hail to the lord ofGanas (groups of goblins, the attendants of Siva). Obeisance to Kalawith the staff in his hands; obeisance to the lord with the noose in his hands.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Sankara, the bull-bannered one. Hail to the lord ofGanas (groups of goblins, the attendants of Siva). Obeisance to Kalawith the staff in his hands; obeisance to the lord with the noose in his hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Sankara, the bull-bannered one. Hail to the lord ofGanas (groups of goblins, the attendants of Siva). Obeisance to Kalawith the staff in his hands; obeisance to the lord with the noose in his hands.

verses.sanskrit: तपते चैव नादित्यो निष्प्रभः पावकस्तथा । नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्चैव विपरीता विजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: tapate caiva nādityo niṣprabhaḥ pāvakastathā / nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva viparītā vijajñire
verses.translation: Obeisance be to Kataihkata (golden-formed one), obeisance to Ru dr a; obeisance to Svahakara. Hail to you, the embodiment of all vital airs; Salute to you the lord with the Gutias for his bodies.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to Kataihkata (golden-formed one), obeisance to Ru dr a; obeisance to Svahakara. Hail to you, the embodiment of all vital airs; Salute to you the lord with the Gutias for his bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to Kataihkata (golden-formed one), obeisance to Ru dr a; obeisance to Svahakara. Hail to you, the embodiment of all vital airs; Salute to you the lord with the Gutias for his bodies.

verses.sanskrit: संतानार्थ प्रवृत्तानामृषीणां विभवात्मनाम् । क्रतवो न व्यवर्त्तन्त ऋतुकालाभिगामिनाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃtānārtha pravṛttānāmṛṣīṇāṃ vibhavātmanām / kratavo na vyavarttanta ṛtukālābhigāminām
verses.translation: Obeisance to Dutgandha (foul-smelling one), to Sugandha (fragrant one); Salute to the lord with the trident in his hands; Obebance to lord Srikantha with the dark-blue tuft. Hail to Nllakaotha, the lord who has applied the ashes in the cremation ground for unguent.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर बह राज नायिका वहाँ पर विराजमान थी जिसका अंकुश ज्वलित या और जो सर्प के ही तुल्य पाश को धारण करने वाली
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Dutgandha (foul-smelling one), to Sugandha (fragrant one); Salute to the lord with the trident in his hands; Obebance to lord Srikantha with the dark-blue tuft. Hail to Nllakaotha, the lord who has applied the ashes in the cremation ground for unguent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Dutgandha (foul-smelling one), to Sugandha (fragrant one); Salute to the lord with the trident in his hands; Obebance to lord Srikantha with the dark-blue tuft. Hail to Nllakaotha, the lord who has applied the ashes in the cremation ground for unguent.

verses.sanskrit: ते चरति पुनर्द्धर्म्मं निर्ममा निरहङ्कृताः । नष्टप्रभाववीर्याश्च नष्टतेजस एव च
verses.transliteration: te carati punarddharmmaṃ nirmamā nirahaṅkṛtāḥ / naṣṭaprabhāvavīryāśca naṣṭatejasa eva ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord identical with the trio of
verses.hindi: थी। मधुर कवणन करने वाला वलय और इशु का धनुष धारण किये हुए ची । उसके आण पांच कुसुमों के ये ।१। उरत सूयं के तेज से भी अत्यधिक
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord identical with the trio of
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord identical with the trio of

verses.sanskrit: धर्मे चैव मतिस्तेषां तदा न व्यवतिष्ठते । ते तुसर्वे समागम्य ब्रह्मलोकमुपागताः
verses.transliteration: dharme caiva matisteṣāṃ tadā na vyavatiṣṭhate / te tusarve samāgamya brahmalokamupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: You are Brahma among the Devas and Nilalo- hita among the Rudras. The soul of all living beings, you are called Purusa by the Skhyas.
verses.hindi: २४० ।  अह्याण्ड पुराण जमदस्नि ने कहा--है राम! अब आप मेरी बात सुनिए। में सत्युद्षों के सनातन (सबंदा से चले आने वाले) धर्म को बतलाऊँगा। ज़िसकी सुनकर सभी मानव धर्मे के करने वाले हो जाया करते हैं ।८। महान
verses.wordMeaning: You are Brahma among the Devas and Nilalo- hita among the Rudras. The soul of all living beings, you are called Purusa by the Skhyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Brahma among the Devas and Nilalo- hita among the Rudras. The soul of all living beings, you are called Purusa by the Skhyas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो भवनं गत्वा दृष्ट्वा पुष्पकसंभवम् । पादयोः पतिताः सर्वे शिववृत्तान्तमूचिरे
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā puṣpakasaṃbhavam / pādayoḥ patitāḥ sarve śivavṛttāntamūcire
verses.translation: You are the great Meru among the mountains and the Moon among the stars. Among the sages you are Vasisha and Vasava (Indra) among the Devas.
verses.hindi: भाग्य .बाले साधुजन होते हैं और जो इस संसार से निरन्तर जन्म-मरण के महान कष्ट से छुटकारा पाने की आकांक्षा रखने बाले हैं वे कभी भी किसी र् प्रकोप नहीं किया करते हैं चाहे कोई उनको प्रताड़ित अथबा निहंत भी क्यों न करे तो भी वे कुपित नहीं हुआ करते हैं।९। जो महाभाग क्षमा'ही
verses.wordMeaning: You are the great Meru among the mountains and the Moon among the stars. Among the sages you are Vasisha and Vasava (Indra) among the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the great Meru among the mountains and the Moon among the stars. Among the sages you are Vasisha and Vasava (Indra) among the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: विकटः स्तब्धकेशश्च करालदशनस्तथा । उलूकव्यग्रहस्तश्च रक्तपिङ्गललोचनः
verses.transliteration: vikaṭaḥ stabdhakeśaśca karāladaśanastathā / ulūkavyagrahastaśca raktapiṅgalalocanaḥ
verses.translation: You are Omkara among the Vedic Mantras, Jyesthasaman among the San Mantras. You are the lion among the beings of the forest. You are the supreme livara.
verses.hindi: को घन मानने वाले हैं तथा परम दमनशील ओर तपस्वी होते हैं उन सांधु कर्म करने वालों के लिए निरन्तर लोक अक्षय होते हैं ।१०। जो महापुरुष है वे दुष्टों के द्वारा दण्ड आदि से ताड़ित होते हुए और बुरे वचनों द्वारा नि्ंत्सित होते हुए भीं कभी मन में क्षोभ नहीं किया करते हैं वे ही पुरुष
verses.wordMeaning: You are Omkara among the Vedic Mantras, Jyesthasaman among the San Mantras. You are the lion among the beings of the forest. You are the supreme livara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Omkara among the Vedic Mantras, Jyesthasaman among the San Mantras. You are the lion among the beings of the forest. You are the supreme livara.

verses.sanskrit: शिश्नं सवृषणं तस्य रक्तं गैरिकमण्डितम् । स्नुषाणां च दुहितॄणां पुत्रीणां च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ tasya raktaṃ gairikamaṇḍitam / snuṣāṇāṃ ca duhitṝṇāṃ putrīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: God Siva b the best one amoog all gO(b etc. Cf. Bh-G. for such a list of excellences and every such excellence b Hb part:
verses.hindi: साधु कहे जाया करते हैं ।११। ताडन करने वाले को जो ताडित किया करता है बह कभो भी साधु नहीं हो सकता हैं प्रत्युत पापःका भागी ही होता है। हम लोग तो ब्राह्मण और साधु हैं क्षमा रखने के ही द्वारा परम पूज्य पद को प्राप्त हुए हैं ।१२। सामान्यजन के वध से भी अधिक एक राजा
verses.wordMeaning: God Siva b the best one amoog all gO(b etc. Cf. Bh-G. for such a list of excellences and every such excellence b Hb part:
verses.commentary: Sense: God Siva b the best one amoog all gO(b etc. Cf. Bh-G. for such a list of excellences and every such excellence b Hb part:

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमानस्ततः पार्श्वे विपरीताभिलाषतः । उन्मत्त इति विज्ञाय सो ऽस्माभिरवमानितः
verses.transliteration: vartamānastataḥ pārśve viparītābhilāṣataḥ / unmatta iti vijñāya so 'smābhiravamānitaḥ
verses.translation: The man of deluded mind who censures them, censure> Mahadeva. He who worships them always worships Sankara. Act like this. Welfare unto you all. You will obtain (achievement of) spiritual power from me."
verses.hindi: के यध करने में महान् पातक होता है क्‍योंकि राजा में भगवान् 'का अंश होता है। इसो कारण से मैं अब आपको निवारित करता हूँ और यह उप- बेश देता हुँ कि क्षमा को क्वारण-करो तथा तपश्चर्या करोः ।१३। बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--तरपनन्दन ! इस रीति से भली भाँति दिये हुए आदेश को समझ
verses.wordMeaning: The man of deluded mind who censures them, censure> Mahadeva. He who worships them always worships Sankara. Act like this. Welfare unto you all. You will obtain (achievement of) spiritual power from me."
verses.commentary: Sense: The man of deluded mind who censures them, censure> Mahadeva. He who worships them always worships Sankara. Act like this. Welfare unto you all. You will obtain (achievement of) spiritual power from me."

verses.sanskrit: आक्रुष्टस्ताडितश्चापि लिङ्गं चाप्यस्य चोद्धृतम् । तस्य क्रोधप्रसादार्थं वयं ते शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: ākruṣṭastāḍitaścāpi liṅgaṃ cāpyasya coddhṛtam / tasya krodhaprasādārthaṃ vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: After understanding the unparalleled and excellent holy rite that is destructive of the great darkness (of ignorance) and that had been recounted by Siva, those people got rid of their fear, greed, delusion and anxiety. They all fell (at his feet), simultaneously and bore (them) by means of their heads.
verses.hindi: कर राम ने परमाधिक क्षमा के स्वभाव वाले और अरियों के दमन करने वाले अपने पिताजी से कहा
verses.wordMeaning: After understanding the unparalleled and excellent holy rite that is destructive of the great darkness (of ignorance) and that had been recounted by Siva, those people got rid of their fear, greed, delusion and anxiety. They all fell (at his feet),…
verses.commentary: Sense: After understanding the unparalleled and excellent holy rite that is destructive of the great darkness (of ignorance) and that had been recounted by Siva, those people got rid of their fear, greed, delusion and anxiety. They all fell (at his feet),…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्कार्यं न जानीमस्तन्नो ब्रूहि पितामह । ऋषीणां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा ध्यानाद्विज्ञाय चेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: etatkāryaṃ na jānīmastanno brūhi pitāmaha / ṛṣīṇāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā dhyānādvijñāya ceśvaram
verses.translation: "Obeisance unto you, O lord with the quarters for your garments (i.e. naked); Bow lo the lord wearing Kiiikinls (small tinkling ornaments or bells); Salutation to the lord half of whose body is female. Obeisance to the lord who promul¬ gated Simkhya and Yoga.
verses.hindi: तस्मादस्य वधः कार्य: कात्तंवीयंस्य चै मया । देह्याज्ञां माननीयाद्य साध्ये वैरमात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance unto you, O lord with the quarters for your garments (i.e. naked); Bow lo the lord wearing Kiiikinls (small tinkling ornaments or bells); Salutation to the lord half of whose body is female. Obeisance to the lord who promul¬ gated Simkhya and Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance unto you, O lord with the quarters for your garments (i.e. naked); Bow lo the lord wearing Kiiikinls (small tinkling ornaments or bells); Salutation to the lord half of whose body is female. Obeisance to the lord who promul¬ gated Simkhya and Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युवाच ततो ब्रह्मा वाक्यं च सुसमा हितः । एष देवो महादेवो विज्ञेयस्तु महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pratyuvāca tato brahmā vākyaṃ ca susamā hitaḥ / eṣa devo mahādevo vijñeyastu maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Bow to the lord dark in colour, with the clouds for his vehicle; Obeisance to the lord wearing the hide of an elephant as his garment. Salute to the lord wearing the skin of an antelope as the upper garment. Obeisance to the lord having a serpent for his sacred thread."
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to the lord dark in colour, with the clouds for his vehicle; Obeisance to the lord wearing the hide of an elephant as his garment. Salute to the lord wearing the skin of an antelope as the upper garment. Obeisance to the lord having a serpent for his sacred thread."
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to the lord dark in colour, with the clouds for his vehicle; Obeisance to the lord wearing the hide of an elephant as his garment. Salute to the lord wearing the skin of an antelope as the upper garment. Obeisance to the lord having a serpent for his sacred thread."

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य परमं किञ्चित्पदं समधिगम्यते । देवानां च ऋषीणां च पितृणां चैव स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: na tasya paramaṃ kiñcitpadaṃ samadhigamyate / devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṛṇāṃ caiva sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance be unto Sankara who has well construc¬ ted and wonderfully variegated ear-rings. Bow be to you with well-wreathed garlands for ornaments. Hail to you with the excellent hide of a lion for garment, O lord wielding a huge axe".
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be unto Sankara who has well construc¬ ted and wonderfully variegated ear-rings. Bow be to you with well-wreathed garlands for ornaments. Hail to you with the excellent hide of a lion for garment, O lord wielding a huge axe".

verses.transliteration: sahasrayugaparyante pralaye sarvadehinām / saṃharatyeṣa bhagavān kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: एष चैव प्रजाः सर्वाः सृजत्येकः स्वतेजसा । एष चिक्री च वक्षोजश्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: eṣa caiva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjatyekaḥ svatejasā / eṣa cikrī ca vakṣojaśrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: W. 106-126 docribe PSiupaoi Vrata according to the author of this Purhoa.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 106-126 docribe PSiupaoi Vrata according to the author of this Purhoa.

verses.sanskrit: येगी कृतयुगे चैव त्रेतायां क्रतुरुच्यते । द्वापरे चैव कालाग्निर्धर्मकेतुः कलौ स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yegī kṛtayuge caiva tretāyāṃ kraturucyate / dvāpare caiva kālāgnirdharmaketuḥ kalau smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: They say that all the worlds have resorted to the fire made and unmade (i.e. artificial and natural). The whole worlds mobile and immobile, is burned many times by fire.
verses.wordMeaning: They say that all the worlds have resorted to the fire made and unmade (i.e. artificial and natural). The whole worlds mobile and immobile, is burned many times by fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that all the worlds have resorted to the fire made and unmade (i.e. artificial and natural). The whole worlds mobile and immobile, is burned many times by fire.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्य मूर्त्तयस्तिस्रो विज्ञेयाश्चापि पण्डितैः । तमो ह्यग्नी रजो ब्रह्मा सत्त्वं विष्णुः प्रकाशकः
verses.transliteration: rudrasya mūrttayastisro vijñeyāścāpi paṇḍitaiḥ / tamo hyagnī rajo brahmā sattvaṃ viṣṇuḥ prakāśakaḥ
verses.translation: Everything can be achieved through Bhasman. It is excellent and sacred. He (the devotee) sprinkles the living beings after assimilating the power and essence of ashes.
verses.wordMeaning: Everything can be achieved through Bhasman. It is excellent and sacred. He (the devotee) sprinkles the living beings after assimilating the power and essence of ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything can be achieved through Bhasman. It is excellent and sacred. He (the devotee) sprinkles the living beings after assimilating the power and essence of ashes.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्तिरेका स्मृता यस्य दिग्वासाश्च शिवाह्वया । यत्र तिष्ठन्ति तद्ब्रह्मयोगेन तु समन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: mūrttirekā smṛtā yasya digvāsāśca śivāhvayā / yatra tiṣṭhanti tadbrahmayogena tu samanvitam
verses.translation: The Pitfs should be known as Dsmapds (Imbibing heat); the Devas are born of Soma (the Soma juice or the moon). The entire universe consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings is constituted by Agni and Soma.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitfs should be known as Dsmapds (Imbibing heat); the Devas are born of Soma (the Soma juice or the moon). The entire universe consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings is constituted by Agni and Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitfs should be known as Dsmapds (Imbibing heat); the Devas are born of Soma (the Soma juice or the moon). The entire universe consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings is constituted by Agni and Soma.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्देवं देवदेवमी शानं प्रभुमव्ययम् । आराधयत विप्रेन्द्रा जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāddevaṃ devadevamī śānaṃ prabhumavyayam / ārādhayata viprendrā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ
verses.translation: I am Agni of great splendour. This my Ambika, is Soma; Agni, Soma and I form ourselves the Purusa whhprakrti.
verses.hindi: परशुराम ने कहा--हे महाम्राश्च तात ! अब आप मेरी विज्ञप्ति का श्रवण कीजिए। आपने जो शाम बतलाया है. वह महान आत्मा वाले जाहः पुरुषों का है। वह शाम साधु पुरुषों के प्रति-दोनजनों पर और ईएबर भावना से संयुत गुरुजनों' में ही करना चाहिए । जो दुष्टजन' हैं उनमें किया
verses.wordMeaning: I am Agni of great splendour. This my Ambika, is Soma; Agni, Soma and I form ourselves the Purusa whhprakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am Agni of great splendour. This my Ambika, is Soma; Agni, Soma and I form ourselves the Purusa whhprakrti.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टं वै यादृशं तस्य लिङ्गमासीन्महात्मनः । तादृक्प्रतिकृतिं कृत्वा शूलपाणिं प्रपद्यत
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ vai yādṛśaṃ tasya liṅgamāsīnmahātmanaḥ / tādṛkpratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā śūlapāṇiṃ prapadyata
verses.translation: The holy rite Pasupatais (not inferior to) Yoga; the holy rite of Kipila is based on Yoga. This Pafupaia rite is laid down before. It is most excellent

verses.transliteration: tato drakṣyatha deveśaṃ durdarśamakṛtātmabhiḥ / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvamajñānamadharmaśca pramaśyati

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् । आस्थिता वीतशोकास्ते देवदारुवने ततः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmāṇamamitaujasam / āsthitā vītaśokāste devadāruvane tataḥ
verses.translation: Deities and the sages are bom only naked. Others, the human beings in the world, all of them are bom without any garment.
verses.hindi: विधु जो भी कहेंगे उसी को आप करना--फिर इसमें. कुछ भी संशय नहीं होगाः।१९। यसिष्ठ. जी ने कहा--जब राम के-पिता के द्वारा इस प्रकार. से: राम से कहा. गया था -तो उस महामति ने. अपने पिता के चरणों में प्रणाम कियाथा और फिर बह ब्रह्माजी के.लोक. को चला: गया था जो लोक.
verses.wordMeaning: Deities and the sages are bom only naked. Others, the human beings in the world, all of them are bom without any garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deities and the sages are bom only naked. Others, the human beings in the world, all of them are bom without any garment.

verses.sanskrit: नदीनां च विचित्रेषु पुलिनेषु शुभेषु च । एवं संवत्सरे पूर्णे वसंते समुपस्थिते । तदेव रूपमास्थाय देवस्तद्वनमागतः
verses.transliteration: nadīnāṃ ca vicitreṣu pulineṣu śubheṣu ca / evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe vasaṃte samupasthite / tadeva rūpamāsthāya devastadvanamāgataḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: कुसुमितबहुपादपालताकं भ्रमरगणै रुपगीयमानखण्डम् । परभृतपरिपूर्णचारुशब्दं प्रविशति तद्वनमाश्रमं महेशः
verses.transliteration: kusumitabahupādapālatākaṃ bhramaragaṇai rupagīyamānakhaṇḍam / parabhṛtaparipūrṇacāruśabdaṃ praviśati tadvanamāśramaṃ maheśaḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.hindi: बहाँ पर उस लोक में अपरिमित ओज से समन्बित विराजमान'

verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वर महादेव यो ऽसि सो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते । स्तुवन्ति त्वां महात्मानो देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viśveśvara mahādeva yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te / stuvanti tvāṃ mahātmāno devadevaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजी का उस राम ने दर्शन किया था । जो परम रम्य रत्नों के सिंहासन पर समासी न ये और रत्नों के ही भूषणों के समलंकृत थे ।२२। उन ब्रह्माजी' को चारों ओर से बड़े-बड़े सिद्धों और मुनीन्द्रों के ध्यान में समासक्त होकर बेर रखा था तथा थ एथा वहाँ पर उनके सामने विद्याधरियों फा भूतय हो
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: नमो भवाय भव्याय भावनायोद्भवाय च । अनन्तबलवीर्याय भूतानां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: namo bhavāya bhavyāya bhāvanāyodbhavāya ca / anantabalavīryāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: रहा था जिस नृत्यको बड़े ही आनन्द के साथ मुस्कराते हुए ब्रह्माजी देख रहे थे बह्माजी उस समय में तपों के फल को प्रदान करने वाले--जगंतों की रचना करने वाले--व्यापक और परिपूर्ण तप ब्रह्म का ध्यान कर रहे थे तथा उनने शपने मंन को नियमन्त्रित कर रक्खा था ।२४। जो वहाँ पर
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: संहर्त्रे कपिशाङ्गाय अव्ययाय व्ययाय च । गङ्गा सलिलधाराय चाधाराय गुणात्मने
verses.transliteration: saṃhartre kapiśāṅgāya avyayāya vyayāya ca / gaṅgā saliladhārāya cādhārāya guṇātmane
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: भक्तों के समुदाय विद्यमान ये उनको निरन्तर परम गोपनीय योग को वे बतला रहे थे । इस रीति से विराजमान अब्यय उन ब्रह्माजी का भक्तिभाव से दर्शन प्राप्त करके उस भृगुकुल सें समुत्पन्न राम ने उनके चरणों में प्रणि- पोत किया था ।२५। उन ब्रह्माजी ने विशेष रूप से नत उस रास को देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यंबकाय त्रिनेत्राय त्रिशूलवरधारिणे । कन्दर्पाय नमस्तुभ्यं नमो ऽस्तु परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: tryaṃbakāya trinetrāya triśūlavaradhāriṇe / kandarpāya namastubhyaṃ namo 'stu paramātmane
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: आंशीरवेचतों के द्वारा उसका अभिनन्दन किया या। फिर उस राम से ब्रह्माजी ने उसका कुजल पूछा था इसके अनन्तर ब्रह्माजी ने राम से कहा था--हे वत्स ! तुमने किस प्रयोजन से यहाँ पर मेरे समीप में आगमत किया है ।२६। जब ब्रह्माजी ने इस रीति से राम से पूछा थातो उसने
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: शकराय वृषाङ्काय गणानां पतये नमः । दण्डहस्ताय कालाय पाशहस्ताय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: śakarāya vṛṣāṅkāya gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ / daṇḍahastāya kālāya pāśahastāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: परशुरामःका शिव लोक गमन  - २४३ आरम्भ से सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्त कहकर उनको सुना दिया था जिसमें -कात्त' वीम राजा के द्वारा जों कुछ किया गया था और महात्मा अपने पिता जसदरिन पर जो कुछ दुःख पड़ा था यह सभी हाल था ।२७। इस सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्त का
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: वेदमन्त्रप्रधानाय शतजिह्वाय ते नमः । भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च स्थावरं चङ्गमं च यत्
verses.transliteration: vedamantrapradhānāya śatajihvāya te namaḥ / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sthāvaraṃ caṅgamaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: श्रवण करके है मानद ! यश्चपि ब्रह्माजी को यह सभी बातें पहिले ही विज्ञात थीं तथापि उन्होने पूछकर सब कुछ सुना था और परिणाम में सुख आवहन करने वाले घर्मिछ राम से कहा था रद
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: तव देहात्समुत्पन्नं देव सर्वमिदं जगत् । शेभो पाहि च भद्रं ते प्रसीद भगवंस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tava dehātsamutpannaṃ deva sarvamidaṃ jagat / śebho pāhi ca bhadraṃ te prasīda bhagavaṃstataḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद्यदि वा ज्ञानाद्यत्किञ्चित्कुरुते नरः । तत्सर्वं भगवानेव कुरुते योगमायया
verses.transliteration: ajñānādyadi vā jñānādyatkiñcitkurute naraḥ / tatsarvaṃ bhagavāneva kurute yogamāyayā
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुत्वा तु मुनयः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना । याचन्ते तपसा युक्ताः पश्यामस्त्त्वां यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutvā tu munayaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā / yācante tapasā yuktāḥ paśyāmasttvāṃ yathā purā
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिस्थं च ते लिङ्गं तथैवास्तु यथा पुरा । नमो दिग्वाससे नित्यं किङ्किणीजालमालिने
verses.transliteration: prakṛtisthaṃ ca te liṅgaṃ tathaivāstu yathā purā / namo digvāsase nityaṃ kiṅkiṇījālamāline
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: विकटाय करालाय करालवदनाय च । अरूपाय सुरूपाय विश्वरूपाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: vikaṭāya karālāya karālavadanāya ca / arūpāya surūpāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: कटङ्कटाय रूद्राय स्वाहाकाराय वै नमः । सर्वप्राणात्मने तुभ्यं गुणदेहाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: kaṭaṅkaṭāya rūdrāya svāhākārāya vai namaḥ / sarvaprāṇātmane tubhyaṃ guṇadehāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: हे वर्स ! आपकी यह प्रतिज्ञा बड़ी ही दुर्लभ है जिसको क्रोध के वंशीभूतं होकर आपने किया है । है बटो! यह सृष्टि तो भगवान् की कृपा: से ही होती है।२९। है तात। यह आपको ज्ञात ही है कि उन्हीं परम प्रभुः की आज्ञा से बड़े ही क्लेश केः द्वारा इस समस्त जगत् का सृजन किया: है:
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्ग्गन्धाय सुगन्धाय शूलहस्ताय वै नमः । स्वयं नीलशिखण्डाय श्रीकण्ठाय नमो नमः । नीलकण्ठाय देवाय चिताभस्माङ्गरागिणे
verses.transliteration: durggandhāya sugandhāya śūlahastāya vai namaḥ / svayaṃ nīlaśikhaṇḍāya śrīkaṇṭhāya namo namaḥ / nīlakaṇṭhāya devāya citābhasmāṅgarāgiṇe
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: और आपने इसी सृष्टि के नाश करने वाली प्रतिज्ञा कर डाली हैं।३७।-आपः तो केवलं एक ही राजा के दोष से तथा अपने पिता के तिरस्कार के होने! से इस भूमि को इक्कीस बार भूषों से रहित करना चाहते हैं १३१। यह सृष्टि" तो ब्राह्मण-क्ष्रिय-वेश्य और शूद्र-इन चारों वों से समन्वित स्वेदा से ही:
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: गुणत्रयात्मने तुभ्यं नमो विश्वाय वेधसे । श्मशानवासिने नित्यं प्रेतरूपाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: guṇatrayātmane tubhyaṃ namo viśvāya vedhase / śmaśānavāsine nityaṃ pretarūpāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवानां रुद्राणां नीललोहितः । आत्मा च सर्वभूतानां सांख्यैः पुरुष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ brahmā sarvadevānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ nīlalohitaḥ / ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ sāṃkhyaiḥ puruṣa ucyate
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतानां महामेरुर्नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः । ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठस्त्वं देवानां वासवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: parvatānāṃ mahāmerurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ / ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭhastvaṃ devānāṃ vāsavastathā

verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
