verses.hindi: वहाँ पर उस रामने देक्षा था कि अतीव भयक्कूर दो द्वारपाल स्थित थे। जितके महदात् कराल मुख और दाँत थे तथा बहुत ही विकृत लाल नेत्र थे ।१२। वे द्रारपाल ऐसे हो प्रतीत हो रहे ये मानों वे दग्ध पर्वत होवें । वे मद्याद् बल और विक्रम से समच्वित ये। उनके शरीरों में विभूति लगी हुईं
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायन्ति ये महादेवं लीनास्तद्भावभाविताः । उत्तरेणाथ पन्थानं ते ऽमृतत्वमवाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyanti ye mahādevaṃ līnāstadbhāvabhāvitāḥ / uttareṇātha panthānaṃ te 'mṛtatvamavāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: थी जिससे उनका अङ्ग विभूषित था और वे व्याध्न के चमों के वस्त्र धारण किये हुए थे ।१३। बे दोनों द्वारपाल त्रिशूल और पट्टिश धारण करने वालि दे तथा ब्रह्मातेज से जाज्वल्यमान हो रहे ये। उन को देखकर राम अपने मन में भय से भीत ठो गया था बहुत ही विनीत होकर उन से कुछ बोला
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणेनाथ पन्थानं ये श्मशानानि भेजिरे । अणिमा महिमा चैव लघिमा प्राप्तिरेव च
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇenātha panthānaṃ ye śmaśānāni bhejire / aṇimā mahimā caiva laghimā prāptireva ca
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.hindi: नमस्करोमि वामीशौ शंकरं रुष्टुमागतः । ईश्वराज्ञां समादाय. मामथाज्ञप्तुतवंथ
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: गरिमा पञ्चमी चैव षष्ठं प्राकाम्यमेव च । ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च ह्यमरत्वं च ते गताः
verses.transliteration: garimā pañcamī caiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ prākāmyameva ca / īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca hyamaratvaṃ ca te gatāḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रादयस्तथा देवाः कामिकं व्रतमास्थिताः । ऐश्वर्यं परमं प्राप्य सर्वे प्रथिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: indrādayastathā devāḥ kāmikaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ / aiśvaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya sarve prathitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: व्यपगतमदमोहमुक्तरागास्तमेरहजदोषविवर्जितस्वभावाः । परिभवमिदमुत्तमं विदित्वा पशुपतिदयितमिदं व्रतं चरध्वम्
verses.transliteration: vyapagatamadamohamuktarāgāstamerahajadoṣavivarjitasvabhāvāḥ / paribhavamidamuttamaṃ viditvā paśupatidayitamidaṃ vrataṃ caradhvam
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेद्वै शुचिर्भूत्वा श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhedvai śucirbhūtvā śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपाद दारुवनप्रवेशभस्मस्नानविधिर्नाम सप्तविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ऋषिरुवाच अगात्कथममावस्यां मासि मासि दिवं नृपः । ऐलः पुरूरवाः सूत कथं वातर्पयत्पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāda dāruvanapraveśabhasmasnānavidhirnāma saptaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣiruvāca agātkathamamāvasyāṃ māsi māsi divaṃ nṛpaḥ / ailaḥ purūravāḥ sūta kathaṃ vātarpayatpitṝn
verses.translation: O Suta I King Pururavas, the son of Ila, used to go to the heaven on the New Moon day in every month. How was it? How did he propitiate the Pitrs (Manes).
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta I King Pururavas, the son of Ila, used to go to the heaven on the New Moon day in every month. How was it? How did he propitiate the Pitrs (Manes).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta I King Pururavas, the son of Ila, used to go to the heaven on the New Moon day in every month. How was it? How did he propitiate the Pitrs (Manes).

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच तस्य ते ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रभावं शांशपायने । ऐलस्यादित्यसंयोगं सोमस्य च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca tasya te 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi prabhāvaṃ śāṃśapāyane / ailasyādityasaṃyogaṃ somasya ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: O Samapayani, I shall narrate his power. I shall narrate tlie contact of the noble-souled son of Ila with the sun as well as with the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: O Samapayani, I shall narrate his power. I shall narrate tlie contact of the noble-souled son of Ila with the sun as well as with the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Samapayani, I shall narrate his power. I shall narrate tlie contact of the noble-souled son of Ila with the sun as well as with the moon.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःसारमयस्येन्दोः पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः । ह्रासवृद्धी पिदृमतः पित्र्यस्य च विनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: antaḥsāramayasyendoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ / hrāsavṛddhī pidṛmataḥ pitryasya ca vinirṇayam
verses.translation: When the sun and the moon come into contact with the star, they stay in Am&v&sya (New Mocm) for a night in the same zone.
verses.hindi: राम से कहा-ईश आप दोनों की सेवा में मेरा प्रणाम स्वीकृत होवे। कैं इस समय में भगवानु शक्कर के दशन प्राप्त करगे के लिए ही यहाँ पर समागत हुआ हूँ । अब भगवाद् ईश्वर की आज्ञा प्राप्त करके मुझे दर्शत कररो के लिए आदेश प्रदान करने को आप योग्य होते हैं ।१५। उन ईश्वर के दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun and the moon come into contact with the star, they stay in Am&v&sya (New Mocm) for a night in the same zone.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun and the moon come into contact with the star, they stay in Am&v&sya (New Mocm) for a night in the same zone.

verses.sanskrit: सोमाच्चैवामृतप्राप्तिं पितॄणां तर्वणं तथा । काव्याग्निष्वात्तमौम्यानां पितॄणाञ्चैव दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: somāccaivāmṛtaprāptiṃ pitṝṇāṃ tarvaṇaṃ tathā / kāvyāgniṣvāttamaumyānāṃ pitṝṇāñcaiva darśanam
verses.translation: Then during every new moon day, he (Pururavas) goes to see the sun-god and the moon-god, his natural and paternal grandfathers.
verses.hindi: अनुचरों ने राम के वचनों का श्रवण करके और फिर शित की आज्ञा को आह करके राम को अन्दर प्रवेश करने के लिये उन्होंने आज्ञा हैदी थी
verses.wordMeaning: Then during every new moon day, he (Pururavas) goes to see the sun-god and the moon-god, his natural and paternal grandfathers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then during every new moon day, he (Pururavas) goes to see the sun-god and the moon-god, his natural and paternal grandfathers.

verses.sanskrit: यथा पुरूरवाश्चैव तर्पयामास वै पितॄन् । एतत्सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि पर्वाणि च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yathā purūravāścaiva tarpayāmāsa vai pitṝn / etatsarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi parvāṇi ca yathākramam
verses.translation: After paying respects to them, he waits there biding his time. He waits for the exudations of nectar from the following moon, for the sake of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: :उ्त राम रे भी उनकी आज्ञा प्राप्त करके बढ़े ही इ॒ं के साथ उस अन्त;पुर में प्रवेश किया था । वहाँ पर उसने एक सभा का स्थल देखा था जो इस द्विज. ने सिद्धों के सप्रुदायों से समाकीर्ण देखा था और जिसमें अगैक प्रकार की बड़ो हो सुन्दर सुगन्ध्र भरी हुई थो तथा बहु बहुत ही सुरम्य था । इस
verses.wordMeaning: After paying respects to them, he waits there biding his time. He waits for the exudations of nectar from the following moon, for the sake of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: After paying respects to them, he waits there biding his time. He waits for the exudations of nectar from the following moon, for the sake of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु चन्द्रसूर्यौं वै नक्षत्रेण समागतौ । अमावस्यां निवसत एकरात्रैकमण्डलौ
verses.transliteration: yadā tu candrasūryauṃ vai nakṣatreṇa samāgatau / amāvasyāṃ nivasata ekarātraikamaṇḍalau
verses.translation: With a desire to perform the monthly Sraddha, Puru¬ ravas, the learned son of I la, worships Soma (the Moon) Pitrmin (one with the Pitfs), after resorting to the heaven,
verses.hindi: सभा-स्यल का अवलोकत करके बड़ा ही विस्मय हो गया था । वहाँ पर फिर उस रामचे परम शाम्त-तीन शेश्र के धारण करने और मस्तक में चन्द्र को धारण किये हुए. भगवान् शिव का दर्शन किया था ३१७-१८ भगवाद्र शंकर के कर में त्रिशूल शोभित हो रहा था और वे ब्याघ्न के चर्म को वस्त्र
verses.wordMeaning: With a desire to perform the monthly Sraddha, Puru¬ ravas, the learned son of I la, worships Soma (the Moon) Pitrmin (one with the Pitfs), after resorting to the heaven,
verses.commentary: Sense: With a desire to perform the monthly Sraddha, Puru¬ ravas, the learned son of I la, worships Soma (the Moon) Pitrmin (one with the Pitfs), after resorting to the heaven,

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छति तदा द्रष्टुं दिवाकरनिशाकरौ । अमावस्याममावास्यां मातामहपितामहौ
verses.transliteration: sa gacchati tadā draṣṭuṃ divākaraniśākarau / amāvasyāmamāvāsyāṃ mātāmahapitāmahau
verses.translation: He propitiates the Pitrs viz. Saumyas, Barhisads, Kavyas and Agnisvattas.
verses.hindi: के स्थान में पढिने हुए थे । उसके सम्पूर्ण अजं में. श्मशान को भस्म लगी हुईं थी और उतका शरोर नागों के यज्ञोपबोत से शोभित था !१९। प्रभू शंकर अपनी ही आरमा में रंमण करने याले थे--पूर्णे काम थे और उनकी सभी कामनाएँ परिपूर्ण थीं और करोड़ों सूर्यो के समान -परमोउज्वल प्रभा
verses.wordMeaning: He propitiates the Pitrs viz. Saumyas, Barhisads, Kavyas and Agnisvattas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He propitiates the Pitrs viz. Saumyas, Barhisads, Kavyas and Agnisvattas.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवाद्य स तौ तत्र कालापेक्षः प्रतीक्षते । प्रस्यन्दमानात्सोमात्तु पित्रर्थं तु परिश्रवान्
verses.transliteration: abhivādya sa tau tatra kālāpekṣaḥ pratīkṣate / prasyandamānātsomāttu pitrarthaṃ tu pariśravān
verses.translation: In Satapatha Br. II 6. 1.7, those who performed a Soma sacrifice are SemoMtUh Piters (probably Saumyas here-oO I those who offered cooked oblations like Can were Barhifadah Pitarab; those who offered no sacrifice
verses.hindi: थी। के पाँच सुखों वाले--इश भुजाओं से शोभित और अपने भक्तों पर परमाधिक अनुग्रह करने बाले ये ।२०१ उस'समय में शिव सिद्धों के लिए तुकं की मुद्रा के द्वारा ओम और हान का विषय बतला रहे ये। बड़े-बड़े योगीन्द्र ओर प्रथमवण बड़े ही आनन्द के साथ उनका स्तवन कर रहे
verses.wordMeaning: In Satapatha Br. II 6. 1.7, those who performed a Soma sacrifice are SemoMtUh Piters (probably Saumyas here-oO I those who offered cooked oblations like Can were Barhifadah Pitarab; those who offered no sacrifice
verses.commentary: Sense: In Satapatha Br. II 6. 1.7, those who performed a Soma sacrifice are SemoMtUh Piters (probably Saumyas here-oO I those who offered cooked oblations like Can were Barhifadah Pitarab; those who offered no sacrifice

verses.sanskrit: ऐलः पुरूरवा विद्वान्मासश्राद्धचिकीर्षया । उपास्ते पितृमन्तं तं सोमं दिवि समास्थितः
verses.transliteration: ailaḥ purūravā vidvānmāsaśrāddhacikīrṣayā / upāste pitṛmantaṃ taṃ somaṃ divi samāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The (seasons) were born of it (i.e. Saihvatsara
verses.wordMeaning: The (seasons) were born of it (i.e. Saihvatsara
verses.commentary: Sense: The (seasons) were born of it (i.e. Saihvatsara

verses.sanskrit: द्विलवां कुहूमात्रां च ते उभे तु विचार्य सः । सिनीवालीप्रमाणेभ्यः सिनीवालीमुपास्य सः
verses.transliteration: dvilavāṃ kuhūmātrāṃ ca te ubhe tu vicārya saḥ / sinīvālīpramāṇebhyaḥ sinīvālīmupāsya saḥ
verses.translation: Thearc grand-fathers. The Mdsas (months) and Ayanas (transits of the sun) are the sons of
verses.wordMeaning: Thearc grand-fathers. The Mdsas (months) and Ayanas (transits of the sun) are the sons of
verses.commentary: Sense: Thearc grand-fathers. The Mdsas (months) and Ayanas (transits of the sun) are the sons of

verses.sanskrit: कुहूमात्रः कलां चैव ज्ञात्वोपास्ते कुहूं तथा । स तदा तामुपासीनः कालापेक्षः प्रपश्यति
verses.transliteration: kuhūmātraḥ kalāṃ caiva jñātvopāste kuhūṃ tathā / sa tadā tāmupāsīnaḥ kālāpekṣaḥ prapaśyati
verses.translation: The Saumyas should be known born of the moon [Somaja), The Kavyas should be known as the sonsof Kavi (Sukra). Upahutas are remembered as Devas. S<>maj<ii are remembered Somapds (Imbibers of Soma)*
verses.wordMeaning: The Saumyas should be known born of the moon [Somaja), The Kavyas should be known as the sonsof Kavi (Sukra). Upahutas are remembered as Devas. S<>maj<ii are remembered Somapds (Imbibers of Soma)*
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saumyas should be known born of the moon [Somaja), The Kavyas should be known as the sonsof Kavi (Sukra). Upahutas are remembered as Devas. S<>maj<ii are remembered Somapds (Imbibers of Soma)*

verses.sanskrit: सुधामृतं तु तत्सोमात्स्रवद्वै मासतृप्तये । दशभिः पञ्चभिश्चैव सुधामृतपरिस्रवैः
verses.transliteration: sudhāmṛtaṃ tu tatsomātsravadvai māsatṛptaye / daśabhiḥ pañcabhiścaiva sudhāmṛtaparisravaiḥ
verses.translation: Ajyapds (Imbibers of oblated ghee) are remembered as Kavyas. The classes of PUrs arc three. They are of three classes namely Kavyas, Barhiads and Agnisvattas.
verses.wordMeaning: Ajyapds (Imbibers of oblated ghee) are remembered as Kavyas. The classes of PUrs arc three. They are of three classes namely Kavyas, Barhiads and Agnisvattas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajyapds (Imbibers of oblated ghee) are remembered as Kavyas. The classes of PUrs arc three. They are of three classes namely Kavyas, Barhiads and Agnisvattas.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे भुजां प्रीत्या दह्यमानां तथांशुभिः । सद्यः प्रक्षरता तेन सौम्येन मधुना तु सः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣe bhujāṃ prītyā dahyamānāṃ tathāṃśubhiḥ / sadyaḥ prakṣaratā tena saumyena madhunā tu saḥ
verses.translation: Those {Pitrs) who imbibe the nectar in the heaven every month on the new moon day, arc remembered as Kavyas Omapas and Divakirtyas.
verses.wordMeaning: Those {Pitrs) who imbibe the nectar in the heaven every month on the new moon day, arc remembered as Kavyas Omapas and Divakirtyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those {Pitrs) who imbibe the nectar in the heaven every month on the new moon day, arc remembered as Kavyas Omapas and Divakirtyas.

verses.sanskrit: निर्वातेष्त्रथ पक्षेषु पित्र्येण विधिना दिवि । सुधामृतेन राजैन्द्रस्तर्प यामास वै पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: nirvāteṣtratha pakṣeṣu pitryeṇa vidhinā divi / sudhāmṛtena rājaindrastarpa yāmāsa vai pitṝn
verses.translation: Thirtyihrce Devas (who arc called) Cchedcnas (Those who cut off?) drink the fifteen digits of the moon gradually in the dark fortnight, (after turning ihein)into watery form.
verses.hindi: भगवाच शिव को भेरव--योगिनियाँ ओर रुद्र के गणों ने चारों ओर से घेर रक्खा था । ऐशी दशा में विराजमान हुए भगवान शिव का दर्शन करके राम ने बड़े ही हयं से अपने शिर को उनके चरणों. ें शुका कर प्रणाम किया था।२२। उनके वाम भाग में स्वामी कात्तिकेय थे ओर दाहिनी
verses.wordMeaning: Thirtyihrce Devas (who arc called) Cchedcnas (Those who cut off?) drink the fifteen digits of the moon gradually in the dark fortnight, (after turning ihein)into watery form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirtyihrce Devas (who arc called) Cchedcnas (Those who cut off?) drink the fifteen digits of the moon gradually in the dark fortnight, (after turning ihein)into watery form.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यान्बर्हिषदः काव्यानग्निष्वात्तांस्तथैव च । ऋतमग्निस्तु यः प्रोक्तः स तु संवत्सरो मतः
verses.transliteration: saumyānbarhiṣadaḥ kāvyānagniṣvāttāṃstathaiva ca / ṛtamagnistu yaḥ proktaḥ sa tu saṃvatsaro mataḥ
verses.translation: Day by day, in due order, a part (a digit) of the moon is developed by the Susumna. The black digits become reduced and the white ones develop it.
verses.hindi: ओर गणनायंक गणेश विराजमान ये तथा उनके सामने नम्दीश्वर-महाकाल और वीरभद्र स्थित हो रहे थे ।२३। शिव की गोद में सो ' भुजाओं वाली जगज्जननी दुर्गा विद्यमान थी । इनका: दशेन' करके रामः ने उनको भी अणाम किया था । इसके अनन्तर विद्वान् राम ने अपनी; गदगद याणी से
verses.wordMeaning: Day by day, in due order, a part (a digit) of the moon is developed by the Susumna. The black digits become reduced and the white ones develop it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Day by day, in due order, a part (a digit) of the moon is developed by the Susumna. The black digits become reduced and the white ones develop it.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञिरे ह्यृतवस्तस्माद्ध्यृतुभ्यश्चार्त्तवास्तथा । आर्तवा ह्यर्द्धमासाख्याः पितरो ह्यृतुसूनवः
verses.transliteration: jajñire hyṛtavastasmāddhyṛtubhyaścārttavāstathā / ārtavā hyarddhamāsākhyāḥ pitaro hyṛtusūnavaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the body of the moon developed by the vigour of the sun, appears sparkling, white and perfectly circular on the full Moon day.
verses.hindi: उन be की स्तुति करने का उपक्रम किया था ।२४।.राम ने. कहा था--मैं ईशान-विभु-व्यापक-अव्यय-भुजङ्गों के भूषणों वाले--उग्र और नरों के कपालों की माला के धारण करने से परमोज्ञ्वल शिव की सेवा में प्रणाम करता हूँ ।२४-२४ा जो विभु समस्त लोकों को सृष्टि स्थिति और विनाश के
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the body of the moon developed by the vigour of the sun, appears sparkling, white and perfectly circular on the full Moon day.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the body of the moon developed by the vigour of the sun, appears sparkling, white and perfectly circular on the full Moon day.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतवः पितामहा मासा अयनाह्यब्दसूनवः । प्रपितामहास्तु वै देवाः पञ्चाब्दा ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: ṛtavaḥ pitāmahā māsā ayanāhyabdasūnavaḥ / prapitāmahāstu vai devāḥ pañcābdā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: Vida cb. XXIV, W. 67-68.
verses.hindi: करने वाले हैं ऐसे ब्रह्मा आदि के स्वरूप को धारण करने वाले-सबसे बड़े उन आप-कपा के सागर को-मैं5जानता  हूँJर्छ।. जिन मन ओऔरूबाणी के आयोचर प्रभु की-स्तुति करने में वेद भो समर्थ नहीं हैं उन- ज्ञान-ओर बुद्धि केदारा साधत के अयोग्य, ठबा बिना आकार वाले प्रभु शिव के -चरणो में
verses.wordMeaning: Vida cb. XXIV, W. 67-68.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vida cb. XXIV, W. 67-68.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यास्तु सोमजा ज्ञेयाः काव्या ज्ञेयाः कवेः सुताः । उपहूताः स्मृता देवाः सोमजाः सोमपाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: saumyāstu somajā jñeyāḥ kāvyā jñeyāḥ kaveḥ sutāḥ / upahūtāḥ smṛtā devāḥ somajāḥ somapāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Just as there are knotty joints in the Sugarcane and bamboo, so also there are dark and bright Parvans in the lunar fortnights.
verses.hindi: मैं नमस्कारःकरता हूँ-(२७। महेन्द्र आदि-देवगण-ऋषिगण-मनु और -असुर
verses.wordMeaning: Just as there are knotty joints in the Sugarcane and bamboo, so also there are dark and bright Parvans in the lunar fortnights.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as there are knotty joints in the Sugarcane and bamboo, so also there are dark and bright Parvans in the lunar fortnights.

verses.sanskrit: आज्यपास्तु स्मृताः काव्यास्तिस्रस्ताः पितृजातयः । काव्या बर्हिषद श्चैव अग्निष्वात्ताश्च तास्त्रिधा
verses.transliteration: ājyapāstu smṛtāḥ kāvyāstisrastāḥ pitṛjātayaḥ / kāvyā barhiṣada ścaiva agniṣvāttāśca tāstridhā
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: २९०  ब्रह्माण्डं पुराणं ये सब जिनके स्वरूप का यथार्थ रूप से नहीं जाना करते हैं उन पर से भी पर प्रभु शिव के लिए मैं प्रणिपात करता है २
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्था ये च यज्वान ऋतुर्बर्हिषदो ध्रुवम् । गृहस्थाश्चाप्ययज्वान अग्निष्वात्तास्तथार्त्तवाः
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthā ye ca yajvāna ṛturbarhiṣado dhruvam / gṛhasthāścāpyayajvāna agniṣvāttāstathārttavāḥ

verses.sanskrit: अष्टकापतयः काव्याः पञ्चाब्दास्तान्निबोधत । तेषां संवत्सरो ह्यग्निः सूयस्तु परिवत्सरः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭakāpatayaḥ kāvyāḥ pañcābdāstānnibodhata / teṣāṃ saṃvatsaro hyagniḥ sūyastu parivatsaraḥ
verses.translation: The period of evenii after Aparaht that has elapsed on the first day of the dark half, is also accepted as part of Paunjam (Full Moon?)
verses.hindi: सोद्ध बॅलोकं सपातालं तं नमामि हरं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: The period of evenii after Aparaht that has elapsed on the first day of the dark half, is also accepted as part of Paunjam (Full Moon?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The period of evenii after Aparaht that has elapsed on the first day of the dark half, is also accepted as part of Paunjam (Full Moon?)

verses.sanskrit: सोम इड्वत्सरः प्रोक्तो वायुश्चैवानुवत्सरः । रुद्रस्तु वत्सरस्तेषां पञ्चाब्दास्ते युगात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: soma iḍvatsaraḥ prokto vāyuścaivānuvatsaraḥ / rudrastu vatsarasteṣāṃ pañcābdāste yugātmakāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that period indicated by the sun, (the wonhipper) moves towards enumeration (?) That is the period for Vajatkriyi. The period is laid down immediately.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that period indicated by the sun, (the wonhipper) moves towards enumeration (?) That is the period for Vajatkriyi. The period is laid down immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that period indicated by the sun, (the wonhipper) moves towards enumeration (?) That is the period for Vajatkriyi. The period is laid down immediately.

verses.sanskrit: काव्याश्चैवोष्मपाश्चैव दिवाकीर्त्याश्च ते स्मृताः । ये ते पिबन्त्यमावस्यां मासिमासि सुधां दिवि
verses.transliteration: kāvyāścaivoṣmapāścaiva divākīrtyāśca te smṛtāḥ / ye te pibantyamāvasyāṃ māsimāsi sudhāṃ divi
verses.translation: The text ii a bit obscure but SOfyasiddhSaUt XI. 1*2 defines Vyatlp&ta more dearly: ''When the moon and the sun are on opposite tides of either solstice and tbdi minutes of declination are the same, it U Vyatjp&ta, The sum of their longitudes is half a drde ie. 180. Normally there are 13 pdSas in a year.
verses.wordMeaning: The text ii a bit obscure but SOfyasiddhSaUt XI. 1*2 defines Vyatlp&ta more dearly: ''When the moon and the sun are on opposite tides of either solstice and tbdi minutes of declination are the same, it U Vyatjp&ta, The sum of their longitudes is half a drde ie. 180.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The text ii a bit obscure but SOfyasiddhSaUt XI. 1*2 defines Vyatlp&ta more dearly: ''When the moon and the sun are on opposite tides of either solstice and tbdi minutes of declination are the same, it U Vyatjp&ta, The sum of their longitudes is half a drde ie. 180.…

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तेन तर्पयामास यावदासीत्पुरूरवाः । यस्मात्प्रस्रवते सोमान्मासि मासि धिनोति च
verses.transliteration: tāṃstena tarpayāmāsa yāvadāsītpurūravāḥ / yasmātprasravate somānmāsi māsi dhinoti ca
verses.translation: Since the Pitrs along with the Devas approve of it> the period previous (?) to the Purnima (i.e. the 14th Titht with which it is mixed) is remembered as Anumati,

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सुधामृतं तद्वै पितॄणां सोमपायिनाम् । एवं तदमृतं सौम्यं सुधा च मदु चैव ह
verses.transliteration: tasmātsudhāmṛtaṃ tadvai pitṝṇāṃ somapāyinām / evaṃ tadamṛtaṃ saumyaṃ sudhā ca madu caiva ha
verses.translation: When the moon and the sun stay in the same star together {amd —close to, near by) on the 6ftecnth night from Rdkd (the full moon day) it is regarded as Amavasya.
verses.hindi: हर्ता पुना रद्रवपुस्तथांते तं कालरूपं शरणं प्रपश्चे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: When the moon and the sun stay in the same star together {amd —close to, near by) on the 6ftecnth night from Rdkd (the full moon day) it is regarded as Amavasya.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the moon and the sun stay in the same star together {amd —close to, near by) on the 6ftecnth night from Rdkd (the full moon day) it is regarded as Amavasya.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे यथा वेन्दोः कलाः पञ्चदश क्रमात् । पिबन्त्यंबुमयं देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तु छन्दनाः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣe yathā vendoḥ kalāḥ pañcadaśa kramāt / pibantyaṃbumayaṃ devāstrayastriṃśattu chandanāḥ
verses.translation: After ending or separating (?) that Amavasya day» the sun and the moon see each other after coming together. When this happens it is called (the New Moon day).
verses.hindi: इस्येबमुक्त॒ बा स तु भागंवो मुदा पपात
verses.wordMeaning: After ending or separating (?) that Amavasya day» the sun and the moon see each other after coming together. When this happens it is called (the New Moon day).
verses.commentary: Sense: After ending or separating (?) that Amavasya day» the sun and the moon see each other after coming together. When this happens it is called (the New Moon day).

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वार्द्धमासं गच्छन्ति चतुर्दश्यां सुधामृतम् । इत्येवं पीयमानैस्तु देवैः सर्वैर्निशाकरः
verses.transliteration: pītvārddhamāsaṃ gacchanti caturdaśyāṃ sudhāmṛtam / ityevaṃ pīyamānaistu devaiḥ sarvairniśākaraḥ
verses.translation: (Defective Text upon 59).
verses.hindi: उत्थाप्य तँ वामकरेण लीलया दध्रो तदा मूध्नि
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Text upon 59).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Text upon 59).

verses.sanskrit: समागच्छत्यमावस्यां भागे पञ्चदशे स्थितः । सुषुम्णाप्यायितं चैव ह्यमावस्यां यथा क्रमम्
verses.transliteration: samāgacchatyamāvasyāṃ bhāge pañcadaśe sthitaḥ / suṣumṇāpyāyitaṃ caiva hyamāvasyāṃ yathā kramam

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्ति द्विलवं कालं पितरस्ते सुधामृतम् । पीतक्षयं ततः सोमं सूर्यो ऽसावेकरश्मिना
verses.transliteration: pibanti dvilavaṃ kālaṃ pitaraste sudhāmṛtam / pītakṣayaṃ tataḥ somaṃ sūryo 'sāvekaraśminā
verses.translation: When the moon wastes away during the dark half, Amavasya is a Parvan by day time. That is why the sun is eclipsed {GrkU —is caught) during the day time on the Amvy& day.
verses.hindi: कस्त्वं वटो कस्य कुले प्रसूतः कि कार्यमुद्श्य
verses.wordMeaning: When the moon wastes away during the dark half, Amavasya is a Parvan by day time. That is why the sun is eclipsed {GrkU —is caught) during the day time on the Amvy& day.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the moon wastes away during the dark half, Amavasya is a Parvan by day time. That is why the sun is eclipsed {GrkU —is caught) during the day time on the Amvy& day.

verses.sanskrit: आप्याययत्सुषुम्णातः पुनस्तान्सोमपायिनः । निः शेषायां कलायां तु सोममाप्याययत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: āpyāyayatsuṣumṇātaḥ punastānsomapāyinaḥ / niḥ śeṣāyāṃ kalāyāṃ tu somamāpyāyayatpunaḥ
verses.translation: By that path alone it (? the moom) comes out of the solar sphere gradually. The moon touches (remains in contact with) the sun for the whole of the day and night except for a period of two Lavas.
verses.hindi: जिन पूज्य देव के अशों के भी अंशों के द्वारा चर और अचर समस्त लोक सृजित हुआ केरले हैँ और फिर जिसमें ही ये सब लीन हो ज़ायो करते
verses.wordMeaning: By that path alone it (? the moom) comes out of the solar sphere gradually. The moon touches (remains in contact with) the sun for the whole of the day and night except for a period of two Lavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: By that path alone it (? the moom) comes out of the solar sphere gradually. The moon touches (remains in contact with) the sun for the whole of the day and night except for a period of two Lavas.

verses.sanskrit: सुषुम्णाप्यायमानस्य भागं भागमहः क्रमात् । कलाः क्षीयन्ति ताः कृष्णाः शुक्ला चाप्याययन्ति तम्
verses.transliteration: suṣumṇāpyāyamānasya bhāgaṃ bhāgamahaḥ kramāt / kalāḥ kṣīyanti tāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ śuklā cāpyāyayanti tam
verses.translation: When, in the middle of the Vyadpaia
verses.hindi: हैं उतत जगन्मंस प्रभु को मैं नमस्कार करता है ।२। जिन प्रभु-के बहुंत-ही अल्प को से संपरत्पन्न हुआ अस्नि ऊध्वेलोक और पाताल के सहित सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: When, in the middle of the Vyadpaia
verses.commentary: Sense: When, in the middle of the Vyadpaia

verses.sanskrit: एवं सूर्यस्य वीर्येण चन्द्रस्याप्यायिता तनुः । दृश्यते पौर्णमास्यां वै शुक्लः संपूर्णमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sūryasya vīryeṇa candrasyāpyāyitā tanuḥ / dṛśyate paurṇamāsyāṃ vai śuklaḥ saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: The human Pitps are those other than they and they are remembered as Laukikas namely father, grandfather and the great-grandfather
verses.wordMeaning: The human Pitps are those other than they and they are remembered as Laukikas namely father, grandfather and the great-grandfather
verses.commentary: Sense: The human Pitps are those other than they and they are remembered as Laukikas namely father, grandfather and the great-grandfather

verses.sanskrit: संसिद्धिरेवं सोमस्य पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः । इत्येवं पितृमान्सोमः स्मृत इड्वत्सरात्मकः
verses.transliteration: saṃsiddhirevaṃ somasya pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ / ityevaṃ pitṛmānsomaḥ smṛta iḍvatsarātmakaḥ
verses.translation: Those who perform Yajfias by means of Saman Mantras are remembered as Somao<mts. Those who perform Havxryajnas are remembered as Barhisads.
verses.hindi: इस विश्व को दग्ध कर देतः है उन हर की सेवा में जो पर हैं मैं प्रभाम हैं ।३०। जिसकी पृथ्वी-पवन-अस्ति-जल-नभ-यज्वा-चन्द्र और भास्कर में आठ मूत्तियाँ जगतू की पूज्य है उन यज्ञ स्वरूप देव को मैं नमस्कार करता हुँ ।३१। जो काल के स्वरूप वाले इस सम्पूर्णे अगत् के आदि करने
verses.wordMeaning: Those who perform Yajfias by means of Saman Mantras are remembered as Somao<mts. Those who perform Havxryajnas are remembered as Barhisads.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who perform Yajfias by means of Saman Mantras are remembered as Somao<mts. Those who perform Havxryajnas are remembered as Barhisads.

verses.sanskrit: क्रान्तः पञ्चदशैः सार्द्धं सुधामृतपरिस्रवैः । अतः पर्वाणि वक्ष्यामि वर्वणां संधयश्च ये
verses.transliteration: krāntaḥ pañcadaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ sudhāmṛtaparisravaiḥ / ataḥ parvāṇi vakṣyāmi varvaṇāṃ saṃdhayaśca ye
verses.translation: The Homins (those who perform homos) who per- foxm YajSas on behalf of Aydjyas (those unworthy of Yajfias) are remembered as Agnivdlios, The Sdyiagas (those who attain the salvation of complete identity) are also remembered among them by the Brahmatias on account of the similarity in Dhamos (holy rites).
verses.hindi: बाले अर्थात् स्रष्टा हैं इसका पालन करने बाले हैं ओर अपना यहे जगन्मय रूप धारण किया करते हैं। फिर रुद्र का स्वरूप घारण करके अन्त में इस सबका संहार करने वाले हैं उन काल के रूप वाले भगवानु शंकर की मैं शरणामति में प्राप्त होता हैं ।३२। वहू भार्गव राम इस रीति से इतना ही
verses.wordMeaning: The Homins (those who perform homos) who per- foxm YajSas on behalf of Aydjyas (those unworthy of Yajfias) are remembered as Agnivdlios,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homins (those who perform homos) who per- foxm YajSas on behalf of Aydjyas (those unworthy of Yajfias) are remembered as Agnivdlios,…

verses.sanskrit: ग्रन्थिमन्ति यथा पर्वाणीक्षुवे ण्वोर्भवन्त्युत । तथार्द्धमासि पर्वाणि शुक्लकृष्णानि चैव हि
verses.transliteration: granthimanti yathā parvāṇīkṣuve ṇvorbhavantyuta / tathārddhamāsi parvāṇi śuklakṛṣṇāni caiva hi
verses.translation: Those who are welUversed in the paths of the holy duties pertaining to their Aframas (stages in life) and are en* dowed with faith in rituals do not become weary and exhausted in the end (i.e. at the times of death).
verses.hindi: सतयन करके बड़े हो आनन्द से उन शिव के चरणों के समीप परमाधिक आतुर होकर गिर पड़ा था । तब कृपा के सागर भगवान् शंकर ते अपने बाय करकमल से लीला से ही उसको उठाकर उसके भस्तक पर अपनाकर रख दिया था ।३३। अनेक आशीवंचनों के द्वारा उसका अभिनन्दन करके
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are welUversed in the paths of the holy duties pertaining to their Aframas (stages in life) and are en* dowed with faith in rituals do not become weary and exhausted in the end (i.e. at the times of death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are welUversed in the paths of the holy duties pertaining to their Aframas (stages in life) and are en* dowed with faith in rituals do not become weary and exhausted in the end (i.e. at the times of death).

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णामावस्ययोर्भेदौ ग्रन्थयः संधयश्च वै । अर्द्धमासं तु पर्वाणि द्वितीयाप्रभृतीनि तु
verses.transliteration: pūrṇāmāvasyayorbhedau granthayaḥ saṃdhayaśca vai / arddhamāsaṃ tu parvāṇi dvitīyāprabhṛtīni tu
verses.translation: Those who do not reach the place of torture, those who fall and drop down in five ways attain the state of
verses.hindi: बड़े ही आदर के साथ अपने प्रिय आत्मज गणेश के आगे उसको बिठा दिया भा। फिर अपली बासा उम्रा का अभिवीक्षण करके समस्त काममाओं. के पूर्ण करने वाले शिव से कृपा हृष्टि से उससे कहा था ।३४। शिव ने कहा--है बटो ! आप यह बताइए कि आप कौन हैं ओर किसके बंश में
verses.wordMeaning: Those who do not reach the place of torture, those who fall and drop down in five ways attain the state of
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not reach the place of torture, those who fall and drop down in five ways attain the state of

verses.sanskrit: अन्वाधानक्रिया यस्मात्क्रियते पर्वसंधिषु । तस्मात्तु पर्वणामादौ प्रतिपत्सर्वसंधिषु
verses.transliteration: anvādhānakriyā yasmātkriyate parvasaṃdhiṣu / tasmāttu parvaṇāmādau pratipatsarvasaṃdhiṣu
verses.translation: Kumara (god Skanda) recounted these different things after seeing them with his divine eyes. He is conversant with Che departures and arrivals of the dead ones as well as the acquisition of Sr&ddha by them.
verses.hindi: आपसे जन्म भ्रहण किया है और आप किस कार्य के कराने का उद्देशय लेकर यहाँ पर समागत हुए हैं--यह सभी कुछ सूचित कीजिए मैं आपकी इस प्रकार की भक्ति को भावना से आपके ऊपर परम प्रसन्न हो गया हूँ तथा जो भी कुछ भापके मन का अभीप्सित है उस सबको मैं आपके लिए
verses.wordMeaning: Kumara (god Skanda) recounted these different things after seeing them with his divine eyes. He is conversant with Che departures and arrivals of the dead ones as well as the acquisition of Sr&ddha by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kumara (god Skanda) recounted these different things after seeing them with his divine eyes. He is conversant with Che departures and arrivals of the dead ones as well as the acquisition of Sr&ddha by them.

verses.sanskrit: सायाह्ने ऽह्यनुमत्यादौ कालो द्विलव उच्यते । लवौ द्वावेव राकायां कालो ज्ञेयो ऽपराह्णकः
verses.transliteration: sāyāhne 'hyanumatyādau kālo dvilava ucyate / lavau dvāveva rākāyāṃ kālo jñeyo 'parāhṇakaḥ
verses.translation: They are remembered as Bahlikas, Umapas and Divaklrtyas. The dark fortnight is their day and the bright fortnight is the night for their sleep.
verses.wordMeaning: They are remembered as Bahlikas, Umapas and Divaklrtyas. The dark fortnight is their day and the bright fortnight is the night for their sleep.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are remembered as Bahlikas, Umapas and Divaklrtyas. The dark fortnight is their day and the bright fortnight is the night for their sleep.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपत्कृष्णपक्षस्य काले ऽतीते ऽपराह्णके । सायाह्ने प्रतिपन्ने च स कालः पौर्णमासिकः
verses.transliteration: pratipatkṛṣṇapakṣasya kāle 'tīte 'parāhṇake / sāyāhne pratipanne ca sa kālaḥ paurṇamāsikaḥ
verses.translation: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and the Devas are the Pitfs. The Rtus (seasons), Artavas and Ardhamasas (half mopths) are remembered as Pitrs mutually.
verses.hindi: तं प्रसाधय विश्वेश वांछितं काममेव मे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and the Devas are the Pitfs. The Rtus (seasons), Artavas and Ardhamasas (half mopths) are remembered as Pitrs mutually.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and the Devas are the Pitfs. The Rtus (seasons), Artavas and Ardhamasas (half mopths) are remembered as Pitrs mutually.

verses.sanskrit: व्यतीपाते स्थिते सूर्ये लेखार्द्धे तु युगान्तरे । युगान्तरोदिते चैव लेशार्द्धे शशिनः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vyatīpāte sthite sūrye lekhārddhe tu yugāntare / yugāntarodite caiva leśārddhe śaśinaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: Thus these Pitrs, Devas and human Piers become pleased when the holy rites are accompanied by faith* When they are pleased the descendants also are pleased.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these Pitrs, Devas and human Piers become pleased when the holy rites are accompanied by faith* When they are pleased the descendants also are pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these Pitrs, Devas and human Piers become pleased when the holy rites are accompanied by faith* When they are pleased the descendants also are pleased.

verses.sanskrit: पौर्णमासी व्यतीपाते यदीक्षेतां परस्परम् । यस्मिन्काले समौ स्यातां तौ व्यतीपात एव सः
verses.transliteration: paurṇamāsī vyatīpāte yadīkṣetāṃ parasparam / yasminkāle samau syātāṃ tau vyatīpāta eva saḥ
verses.translation: Thus this search for and investigation into the nature of the Pitrs who imbibe Soma (has been completed). It is this principle of tne Pitrs that has been decisively recounted in the Puranas.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus this search for and investigation into the nature of the Pitrs who imbibe Soma (has been completed). It is this principle of tne Pitrs that has been decisively recounted in the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus this search for and investigation into the nature of the Pitrs who imbibe Soma (has been completed). It is this principle of tne Pitrs that has been decisively recounted in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: तं कालं सूर्यनिर्द्देश्यं दृष्ट्वा संख्यां तु सर्पति । स वै वषटाक्रियाकालः सद्यः कालं विधीयते
verses.transliteration: taṃ kālaṃ sūryanirddeśyaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃkhyāṃ tu sarpati / sa vai vaṣaṭākriyākālaḥ sadyaḥ kālaṃ vidhīyate
verses.translation: W. 68-91 justify the performaxm of 8r&ddhai*
verses.hindi: आतिथ्यं क़ृतबाद देव जमदस्निः पिता मम
verses.wordMeaning: W. 68-91 justify the performaxm of 8r&ddhai*
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 68-91 justify the performaxm of 8r&ddhai*

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णन्दोः पूर्णपक्षे तु रात्रिसंधिश्च पूर्णिमा । ततो विरज्यते नक्तं पौर्णमास्यां निशाकरः
verses.transliteration: pūrṇandoḥ pūrṇapakṣe tu rātrisaṃdhiśca pūrṇimā / tato virajyate naktaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ niśākaraḥ
verses.translation: I wish to hear about the nature and principle (or reality) of those sets offourYugas, which were before in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.hindi: राजा तं स बनाल्लो मात्पातयामास मन्दधीः ।
verses.wordMeaning: I wish to hear about the nature and principle (or reality) of those sets offourYugas, which were before in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to hear about the nature and principle (or reality) of those sets offourYugas, which were before in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: यदीक्षेते व्यतीपाते दिवा पूर्णे परस्परम् । चन्द्रार्कावपराह्णे तु पूर्णात्मानौ तु पूर्णिमा
verses.transliteration: yadīkṣete vyatīpāte divā pūrṇe parasparam / candrārkāvaparāhṇe tu pūrṇātmānau tu pūrṇimā
verses.translation: What I have already described in the context of (the description of) the Earih etc, the set of four Yugas is among them. I shall recount it. (All of you listen and) under¬ stand.
verses.hindi: सा प्रेनुस्तं मृतं इवा गतां लोकं जगाम ह
verses.wordMeaning: What I have already described in the context of (the description of) the Earih etc, the set of four Yugas is among them. I shall recount it. (All of you listen and) under¬ stand.
verses.commentary: Sense: What I have already described in the context of (the description of) the Earih etc, the set of four Yugas is among them. I shall recount it. (All of you listen and) under¬ stand.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्तामनुमन्यन्ते पितरो दैवतैः सह । तस्मादनुमतिर्नाम पूर्णिमा प्रथमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: yasmāttāmanumanyante pitaro daivataiḥ saha / tasmādanumatirnāma pūrṇimā prathamā smṛtā
verses.translation: Though this Purliu f<o]lowcd the vedie tradition and regarded a Yuga-period as contizxg of five years (Wde S\ipTa ch. 21.131-132 and Note thereon), here the author follows Manu 1.61-74, 79-86. According to him the 1st Yuga, Ktta extends over 4000 yean of gods with a twilight period {uutdhyd) of 400 Divine (of god's) yean before its actual advent and a transitional period to the next Yuga (Sandhyitha) of 400 celestial years. The three other Yugas via I'reta, Dvipara and Kali coosiit respectively of a period of 3000, 2000 and 1000 divine yean preceded by and followed by and each extending over a period of 300, 200 and 100
verses.wordMeaning: Though this Purliu f<o]lowcd the vedie tradition and regarded a Yuga-period as contizxg of five years (Wde S\ipTa ch. 21.131-132 and Note thereon), here the author follows Manu 1.61-74, 79-86. According to him the 1st Yuga,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Though this Purliu f<o]lowcd the vedie tradition and regarded a Yuga-period as contizxg of five years (Wde S\ipTa ch. 21.131-132 and Note thereon), here the author follows Manu 1.61-74, 79-86. According to him the 1st Yuga,…

verses.sanskrit: अत्यर्थं भ्राजते यस्माद्व्योम्न्यस्यां वै निशाकरः । रञ्जनाच्चैव चन्द्रस्य राकेति कवयो ऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: atyarthaṃ bhrājate yasmādvyomnyasyāṃ vai niśākaraḥ / rañjanāccaiva candrasya rāketi kavayo 'bruvan
verses.commentary: Sense: ch. 41, Mbb. Vana cht 149, 188, V 3, Vi. P. chs 21, 22. 57, 58.

verses.sanskrit: अमावसेतामृक्षे तु यदा चन्द्रदिवाकरौ । राका पञ्चदशी रात्रिरमावास्या ततः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: amāvasetāmṛkṣe tu yadā candradivākarau / rākā pañcadaśī rātriramāvāsyā tataḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: After calculating the human year by means of worldly reckoning, I shall mention the set of four Yugas cal¬ culating the same by means of human years.
verses.wordMeaning: After calculating the human year by means of worldly reckoning, I shall mention the set of four Yugas cal¬ culating the same by means of human years.
verses.commentary: Sense: After calculating the human year by means of worldly reckoning, I shall mention the set of four Yugas cal¬ culating the same by means of human years.

verses.sanskrit: व्युच्छिद्य तममावस्यां पश्यतस्तौ समागतौ । अन्योन्यं चन्द्रसूर्यौं तौ यदा तद्वर्श उच्यते
verses.transliteration: vyucchidya tamamāvasyāṃ paśyatastau samāgatau / anyonyaṃ candrasūryauṃ tau yadā tadvarśa ucyate
verses.translation: Fifteen make <me KHthd. Thirty Kil,shds
verses.hindi: जब इस रीति से थह भृगु कुलोद्कूत दाम सम्पूर्ण विश्व की आसति के हरण करने वाले महात्मा शम्भु फे द्वारा बड़े ही आदर के साथ कहा गया था तब तो'उत देवों के स्व।मो और कृपा के सागर गुरु की सेवा में उस राम ने फिर एक बार प्रणाम करके बहुत ही  शीक्ल निवेदन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Fifteen make <me KHthd. Thirty Kil,shds
verses.commentary: Sense: Fifteen make <me KHthd. Thirty Kil,shds

verses.sanskrit: द्वौ द्वौ लवावमावास्या स कालः पर्वसंधिषु । द्व्यक्षर कुहुमात्रश्च पर्वकालास्त्रयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: dvau dvau lavāvamāvāsyā sa kālaḥ parvasaṃdhiṣu / dvyakṣara kuhumātraśca parvakālāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Three hundred and sixty human months make one year of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: परशुराम मे कहा--हे भगवन् ! मैं भूगु मुनि के कुल में समुत्पन्न हुआ हैं और है बिभो ! जमदस्ति ऋषि का युत्र हूँ । मेरा नामः छोटा' सा रामः यह् है'। आप तो समस्त'जगत् की यन्दना करने के योग्य हैं। मैं ऐसे समय में आपकी शरणागति में प्रपन्न हुआ हूँ'।३७। है नाथ ! जिस कार्य के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: Three hundred and sixty human months make one year of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three hundred and sixty human months make one year of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टचन्द्रा त्वमावस्या या मध्याङ्नात्प्रवर्त्तते । दिवसार्द्धेन रात्र्या च सूर्यं प्राप्य तु चन्द्रमाः
verses.transliteration: naṣṭacandrā tvamāvasyā yā madhyāṅnātpravarttate / divasārddhena rātryā ca sūryaṃ prāpya tu candramāḥ
verses.translation: W. 5-21 give the divisions of Time adopted in calculating Yugas. The smallest unit of time is the period required for winking of the eye and is called
verses.hindi: मैं आपकी सन्निति में समागत हुआ हूँ । है विश्वेश्वर"! उसको आप कृपां कर प्रसाधित कीजिए और मेरी कामना है कि अब आप मेरा बांछित जो भी है उसे मुझे प्रदात कीजिए !३८। मेरे पिता जभदस्तिने है देव' ! मृषय' के लिए बन में आये हुए राजा काल वीयं का वहुत अच्छी तरह से भातिध्म-
verses.wordMeaning: W. 5-21 give the divisions of Time adopted in calculating Yugas. The smallest unit of time is the period required for winking of the eye and is called
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 5-21 give the divisions of Time adopted in calculating Yugas. The smallest unit of time is the period required for winking of the eye and is called

verses.sanskrit: सूर्येण सह सामुद्रं गत्वा प्रातस्तनात्स वै । द्वौ कालौ संगमं चैव मध्याह्ने नियतं रविः
verses.transliteration: sūryeṇa saha sāmudraṃ gatvā prātastanātsa vai / dvau kālau saṃgamaṃ caiva madhyāhne niyataṃ raviḥ
verses.translation: A hundred years according to human calcu¬ lation are considered to be equal to three years and ten montha of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: सरकार किया था ।३६। उस महानन्द मति वाले राजा ने लोभ के वशीभूत होकर बलपूर्वक मेरे पिता को भार डाला था। जो एक धेनु'यी जिसके ग्रहण करने क्रा लालच राजा के मन में हो गया था वहःहोमधेमु भी मेरे पिता को मरा हुआ देखकर गो-लोक में चली गयी बी ।४०। राजा मे
verses.wordMeaning: A hundred years according to human calcu¬ lation are considered to be equal to three years and ten montha of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hundred years according to human calcu¬ lation are considered to be equal to three years and ten montha of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपच्छुक्लपक्षस्य चन्द्रमाः सूर्य मण्डलात् । विमुच्यमानयोर्मध्ये तयोर्मण्डलयोस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: pratipacchuklapakṣasya candramāḥ sūrya maṇḍalāt / vimucyamānayormadhye tayormaṇḍalayostu vai
verses.translation: The year of Dhruvais remembered as equal to nine thousand and ninety years according to human calculation.
verses.hindi: निरपराध मेरे पिता को मृत्यु के विचय भें कुछ भी चिन्ता नहीं की थी और फिर वह अपने नगर में चला गया था। इसके पीछे मेरी माता रेणुका अत्यन्त कदन कर रही थी ।४१। इस- घटना का ज्ञान प्राप्त करके लोक के बुत के जाता हमारे पितामह छुमुमुनि है महादेव ! बहाँ पर आ गये थे ।
verses.wordMeaning: The year of Dhruvais remembered as equal to nine thousand and ninety years according to human calculation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The year of Dhruvais remembered as equal to nine thousand and ninety years according to human calculation.

verses.sanskrit: स तदा ह्याहुतेः कालो दर्शस्य तु वषट्क्रिया । एतदृतुमुखं ज्ञेयममा वास्यास्य पर्वणः
verses.transliteration: sa tadā hyāhuteḥ kālo darśasya tu vaṣaṭkriyā / etadṛtumukhaṃ jñeyamamā vāsyāsya parvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thirty six thousand years according to the human reckoning should be known as equal to a hundred years. This is remembered as divine reckoning.
verses.hindi: मैं समिधा लेने के लिए उस समय में वन में गया हुआ था सो मैं भी इसो बीच में बढ़ाँ पर समासत हो मया या धरा
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty six thousand years according to the human reckoning should be known as equal to a hundred years. This is remembered as divine reckoning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty six thousand years according to the human reckoning should be known as equal to a hundred years. This is remembered as divine reckoning.

verses.sanskrit: दिवापर्व ह्यमावास्या क्षीणेन्दौ बहुले तु वै । तस्माद्दिवा ह्यमावास्यां गृह्यते ऽसौ दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: divāparva hyamāvāsyā kṣīṇendau bahule tu vai / tasmāddivā hyamāvāsyāṃ gṛhyate 'sau divākaraḥ
verses.translation: Wise persons and sages have said that there arc foui Yugas in Bharata subcontinent. They arc Krta, TrclA, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.wordMeaning: Wise persons and sages have said that there arc foui Yugas in Bharata subcontinent. They arc Krta, TrclA, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wise persons and sages have said that there arc foui Yugas in Bharata subcontinent. They arc Krta, TrclA, Dvapara and Kali.

verses.sanskrit: गृह्यते तु दिवा तस्मादमावास्यां दिवि क्षयाम् । कलानामपि चैतासां वृद्धिहान्या जलात्मनः
verses.transliteration: gṛhyate tu divā tasmādamāvāsyāṃ divi kṣayām / kalānāmapi caitāsāṃ vṛddhihānyā jalātmanaḥ
verses.translation: It b strange that Yugas should be restricted to India (Bh&rata)
verses.wordMeaning: It b strange that Yugas should be restricted to India (Bh&rata)
verses.commentary: Sense: It b strange that Yugas should be restricted to India (Bh&rata)

verses.sanskrit: तिथीनां नामधेयानि विद्वद्भिः संज्ञितानि वै । दर्शयेतामथात्मानं सूर्याचन्द्रमसावुभौ
verses.transliteration: tithīnāṃ nāmadheyāni vidvadbhiḥ saṃjñitāni vai / darśayetāmathātmānaṃ sūryācandramasāvubhau
verses.translation: Tugasaitkkyd (the total number of years in all the four Yugas together) is mentioned as twelve thousand (divine) yean for the four yugas viz. Kfta, Treta» Dvapara and Kali.
verses.wordMeaning: Tugasaitkkyd (the total number of years in all the four Yugas together) is mentioned as twelve thousand (divine) yean for the four yugas viz. Kfta, Treta» Dvapara and Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tugasaitkkyd (the total number of years in all the four Yugas together) is mentioned as twelve thousand (divine) yean for the four yugas viz. Kfta, Treta» Dvapara and Kali.

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रामत्यथ तेनैव क्रमशः सूर्यमण्डलात् । द्विलवोनमहोरात्रं भास्करं स्पृशते शशी
verses.transliteration: niṣkrāmatyatha tenaiva kramaśaḥ sūryamaṇḍalāt / dvilavonamahorātraṃ bhāskaraṃ spṛśate śaśī
verses.translation: In this connection the years are found to be as follows in accordance with the human calculation: I shall mention the number of years in the Krta Yuga. Understand it,
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection the years are found to be as follows in accordance with the human calculation: I shall mention the number of years in the Krta Yuga. Understand it,
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection the years are found to be as follows in accordance with the human calculation: I shall mention the number of years in the Krta Yuga. Understand it,

verses.sanskrit: स तदा ह्याहुतेः कालोदर्शस्य तु वषट्क्रिया । कुहेति कोकिलेनोक्तो यः स कालः समाप्यते
verses.transliteration: sa tadā hyāhuteḥ kālodarśasya tu vaṣaṭkriyā / kuheti kokilenokto yaḥ sa kālaḥ samāpyate
verses.translation: The Krta Yuga consists of one million four hundred and forty thousatid human yean.
verses.hindi: इल्मेचं परिपूर्णा मे कर्त्ता देवो जगत्पतिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Krta Yuga consists of one million four hundred and forty thousatid human yean.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Krta Yuga consists of one million four hundred and forty thousatid human yean.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कालसंमिता यस्मादमावास्या कुहूः स्मृता । सिनीवालीप्रमाणस्तु क्षीणशेषो निशाकरः
verses.transliteration: tatkālasaṃmitā yasmādamāvāsyā kuhūḥ smṛtā / sinīvālīpramāṇastu kṣīṇaśeṣo niśākaraḥ
verses.translation: According to this Parana the period of Yugas is as follows Tuga Tears
verses.wordMeaning: According to this Parana the period of Yugas is as follows Tuga Tears
verses.commentary: Sense: According to this Parana the period of Yugas is as follows Tuga Tears

verses.sanskrit: आमावस्यां विशत्यर्कस्सिनी वालीततः स्मृता । अनुमत्याश्चराकायाः सिनीवाल्याः कुहूंविना
verses.transliteration: āmāvasyāṃ viśatyarkassinī vālītataḥ smṛtā / anumatyāścarākāyāḥ sinīvālyāḥ kuhūṃvinā
verses.translation: Thus the sets of four Yugas numbering leventyonc are called Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sets of four Yugas numbering leventyonc are called Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sets of four Yugas numbering leventyonc are called Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: एतासां द्विलवः कालः कुहूमात्रङ्कुहूःस्मृताः । चन्द्रसूर्यव्यतीपाते संगते पूर्णिमान्तरे
verses.transliteration: etāsāṃ dvilavaḥ kālaḥ kuhūmātraṅkuhūḥsmṛtāḥ / candrasūryavyatīpāte saṃgate pūrṇimāntare
verses.translation: No matter can be mentioned in two ways simulta¬ neously (?) Though it lias come traditionally in due order, these two Yias have not been recounted to vou before.
verses.hindi: उस समय में मैं रुदन कर रहा था और अपनो माता फे साथ मेरे सबन भाई भी क्रन्दन कर रहे थे। उस मन्त्र शास्त्र के ज्ञाता मुनि ने सबको सारस्थना देकर मेरे मृत पित! जमदस्नि को संजोवनी विद्या से जीवित कर दिया था ।४३। जव तक शगु मुनि वहाँ परनहीं' आये थे उसःबीच में में
verses.wordMeaning: No matter can be mentioned in two ways simulta¬ neously (?) Though it lias come traditionally in due order, these two Yias have not been recounted to vou before.
verses.commentary: Sense: No matter can be mentioned in two ways simulta¬ neously (?) Though it lias come traditionally in due order, these two Yias have not been recounted to vou before.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपत्प्रतिपद्येत पर्वकालो द्विमात्रकः । कालः कहूसिनीवाल्योः सामुद्रस्य तु मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: pratipatpratipadyeta parvakālo dvimātrakaḥ / kālaḥ kahūsinīvālyoḥ sāmudrasya tu madhyataḥ
verses.translation: W. 43-92 describe the Tugadharma of the Treta Yuga:
verses.hindi: माता के येघव्य.के दुःख से बहुत ही कुपित हो गया था। है देवः! मैंने अपनी माता को साण्स्यता देते हुए एक प्रतिक्षा कर डाली थी (४४ मेरी गाता ने करूण क्रन्दन करते हुई ने जो इक्कीस बार अपना उरःस्थल ताडित किया या उसी गणना को लेकर ही मैंने यह प्रतिज्ञा की थी कि इंवकीस
verses.wordMeaning: W. 43-92 describe the Tugadharma of the Treta Yuga:
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 43-92 describe the Tugadharma of the Treta Yuga:

verses.sanskrit: अर्काग्नि मण्डले सोमे पर्वकालः कलासमः । एवं स शुक्लपक्षे वै रजन्यां पर्वसंधिषु
verses.transliteration: arkāgni maṇḍale some parvakālaḥ kalāsamaḥ / evaṃ sa śuklapakṣe vai rajanyāṃ parvasaṃdhiṣu
verses.translation: The Rk, Yajus, Saman and Atharvan Mantras were uttered by the seven sages and Manu expounded the Smarta Dharnia (Dharma as laid down in Srnrtis).
verses.hindi: आर ही मैं इस पृथ्वी को ककियों से रहित कर दू या ।४५। यह इस रीति से की हुई मेरो प्रतिज्ञा परिपूर्ण हो जावे--इसके पूर्ण करने वाले जंगतू के पति देवेश्वर आप ही हैं । आप तो सब से बड़े देव हैं। है ताथ! इसीलिए मैं अब आपके चरणों की सन्निधि में यहाँ पर जाया हूँ ।४६। वसिछजी ने कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: The Rk, Yajus, Saman and Atharvan Mantras were uttered by the seven sages and Manu expounded the Smarta Dharnia (Dharma as laid down in Srnrtis).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Rk, Yajus, Saman and Atharvan Mantras were uttered by the seven sages and Manu expounded the Smarta Dharnia (Dharma as laid down in Srnrtis).

verses.sanskrit: संपूर्ममण्डलः श्रीमांश्चन्द्रमा उपरज्यते । यस्मादा दाप्यायते सोमः पञ्चदश्यां तु पूर्णिमा
verses.transliteration: saṃpūrmamaṇḍalaḥ śrīmāṃścandramā uparajyate / yasmādā dāpyāyate somaḥ pañcadaśyāṃ tu pūrṇimā
verses.translation: In the beginning of Treta, the undivided compact Vedas alone were the bridges (i.c. the sole authority) unto Dharma. But owing to the contraction in the period of longe¬ vity they are abandoned in;hc Dvaparas.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकर ने इस प्रकार से उस राम के वचनों का श्रवण करके जग- ज्जननी दुर्गा के मुख को ओर देस्या था और उस समय में एक क्षण के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of Treta, the undivided compact Vedas alone were the bridges (i.c. the sole authority) unto Dharma. But owing to the contraction in the period of longe¬ vity they are abandoned in;hc Dvaparas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of Treta, the undivided compact Vedas alone were the bridges (i.c. the sole authority) unto Dharma. But owing to the contraction in the period of longe¬ vity they are abandoned in;hc Dvaparas.

verses.sanskrit: दशभिः पञ्चभिश्चैव कलाभिर्दिवसक्रमात् । तस्मात्कलाः पञ्चदश सोमेनास्य तु षोडशी
verses.transliteration: daśabhiḥ pañcabhiścaiva kalābhirdivasakramāt / tasmātkalāḥ pañcadaśa somenāsya tu ṣoḍaśī
verses.translation: Though they are the same in meaning, righteousness, holy rites and ancillary subjects, they undergo changes in every Yuga.
verses.wordMeaning: Though they are the same in meaning, righteousness, holy rites and ancillary subjects, they undergo changes in every Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though they are the same in meaning, righteousness, holy rites and ancillary subjects, they undergo changes in every Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सोमस्य भवति पञ्चदश्याप्रपां क्षयः । इत्येते पितरो देवाः सोमपाः सोमवर्द्धनाः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsomasya bhavati pañcadaśyāprapāṃ kṣayaḥ / ityete pitaro devāḥ somapāḥ somavarddhanāḥ
verses.translation: TheKsatriyas have Arombhas (enterprises) as their Yajfla (sacrifice); the Vaiiyas have Havis (offerings of ghee etc,) forYajfia; the Sudras have service for Yajfta and excel¬ lent Brahma have Japa (chanting of Mantras) for Yfta.
verses.hindi: नीचे को ओर अपना मुख करके चिन्तन करने वाले प्रभु शंकर हो गये ये
verses.wordMeaning: TheKsatriyas have Arombhas (enterprises) as their Yajfla (sacrifice); the Vaiiyas have Havis (offerings of ghee etc,) forYajfia; the Sudras have service for Yajfta and excel¬ lent Brahma have Japa (chanting of Mantras) for Yfta.
verses.commentary: Sense: TheKsatriyas have Arombhas (enterprises) as their Yajfla (sacrifice); the Vaiiyas have Havis (offerings of ghee etc,) forYajfia; the Sudras have service for Yajfta and excel¬ lent Brahma have Japa (chanting of Mantras) for Yfta.

verses.sanskrit: आर्तवा ऋतवो ह्यृद्धा देवास्तान्भावयन्ति वै । अतः पितॄन्प्रवक्ष्यामि मासश्राद्धभुजस्तु ये
verses.transliteration: ārtavā ṛtavo hyṛddhā devāstānbhāvayanti vai / ataḥ pitṝnpravakṣyāmi māsaśrāddhabhujastu ye
verses.translation: Then, in the Treta Yuga, people of all castes were
verses.hindi: गयी थीं । और है महाराज ! बैर के साधक उस भागंव राम से बोली
verses.wordMeaning: Then, in the Treta Yuga, people of all castes were
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, in the Treta Yuga, people of all castes were

verses.sanskrit: तेषां गतिं सतत्त्वां च प्राप्तिं श्राद्धस्य चैव हि । न मृतानां गतिः शक्या ज्ञातुं न पुनरागतिः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ gatiṃ satattvāṃ ca prāptiṃ śrāddhasya caiva hi / na mṛtānāṃ gatiḥ śakyā jñātuṃ na punarāgatiḥ
verses.translation: Katriyas obeyed the Brahmanas. The Vai syas obeyed the Ktriyas. The Sudras obeyed the Vaiiyas. The people co¬ operated with one another.
verses.hindi: जगदम्बा ने कहा था कि है तपस्विन् ! द्विज के पुत्र ! कया तुम इस भूमण्डल को भूपों से विहीन . करने की इच्छा कर रहे हो ? और वह भी एक-दो वार नहीं प्रत्युत कोप से इक्कीस बार ऐसा करना चाहते हो। हे बटो ! यह तो आपका एक बहुत ही महान साहस है
verses.wordMeaning: Katriyas obeyed the Brahmanas. The Vai syas obeyed the Ktriyas. The Sudras obeyed the Vaiiyas. The people co¬ operated with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Katriyas obeyed the Brahmanas. The Vai syas obeyed the Ktriyas. The Sudras obeyed the Vaiiyas. The people co¬ operated with one another.

verses.sanskrit: तपसापि प्रसिद्धेन किंपुनर्मासचक्षुषा । अनुदेवपितॄनेते पितरो लौकिकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: tapasāpi prasiddhena kiṃpunarmāsacakṣuṣā / anudevapitṝnete pitaro laukikāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Their activities were auspicious; so also were their castes and stages of life. They were pure in the thoughts of the mind, in the utterance of words and in their physical activiry.
verses.wordMeaning: Their activities were auspicious; so also were their castes and stages of life. They were pure in the thoughts of the mind, in the utterance of words and in their physical activiry.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their activities were auspicious; so also were their castes and stages of life. They were pure in the thoughts of the mind, in the utterance of words and in their physical activiry.

verses.sanskrit: देवाः सौम्याश्च काव्याश्च अयज्वानो ह्यचोनिजाः । देवास्ते पितरः सर्वे देवास्तान्वादयन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: devāḥ saumyāśca kāvyāśca ayajvāno hyaconijāḥ / devāste pitaraḥ sarve devāstānvādayantyuta
verses.translation: Again, the subjects out of delusion kept up those Dharmas(but) with mutual antagonism. They then approached Manu.
verses.hindi: न चान्यः शंक रात्पु् सत्काये कत्त मीश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Again, the subjects out of delusion kept up those Dharmas(but) with mutual antagonism. They then approached Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again, the subjects out of delusion kept up those Dharmas(but) with mutual antagonism. They then approached Manu.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यपितरश्चैव तेभ्यो ऽन्ये लौकिकाः स्मृताः । पिता पितामहश्चापि तथा यः प्रपितामहः
verses.transliteration: manuṣyapitaraścaiva tebhyo 'nye laukikāḥ smṛtāḥ / pitā pitāmahaścāpi tathā yaḥ prapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Sv&yambhuva Manu, the Prajapati (lord of the subjects) saw the reality of situation. After meditation, he begot two sons of Satarupa.
verses.hindi: अथ देव्या अनुमति प्राप्य शंभु याणंव: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sv&yambhuva Manu, the Prajapati (lord of the subjects) saw the reality of situation. After meditation, he begot two sons of Satarupa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sv&yambhuva Manu, the Prajapati (lord of the subjects) saw the reality of situation. After meditation, he begot two sons of Satarupa.

verses.sanskrit: यज्वानो ये तु सामेन सोमवन्तस्तु ते स्मृताः । ये यज्वानो हविर्यज्ञे ते वै बर्हिषदः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: yajvāno ye tu sāmena somavantastu te smṛtāḥ / ye yajvāno haviryajñe te vai barhiṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They were Priyavrala and Uttanapada. They were the first kings. Thereafter, kings were bom. They wielded the staff of Law and Order.
verses.wordMeaning: They were Priyavrala and Uttanapada. They were the first kings. Thereafter, kings were bom. They wielded the staff of Law and Order.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Priyavrala and Uttanapada. They were the first kings. Thereafter, kings were bom. They wielded the staff of Law and Order.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्वात्ताः स्मृतास्तेषां होमिनो ऽयाज्ययाजिनः । तेषां तु धर्मसाधर्म्यात्स्मृताः सायुज्यगा द्विजैः
verses.transliteration: agniṣvāttāḥ smṛtāsteṣāṃ homino 'yājyayājinaḥ / teṣāṃ tu dharmasādharmyātsmṛtāḥ sāyujyagā dvijaiḥ
verses.translation: Those kings were called Rdjaris because they delighted and pacified the subjects. Those with hidden sins could not be controlled by those kings.
verses.wordMeaning: Those kings were called Rdjaris because they delighted and pacified the subjects. Those with hidden sins could not be controlled by those kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those kings were called Rdjaris because they delighted and pacified the subjects. Those with hidden sins could not be controlled by those kings.

verses.sanskrit: ये चाप्याश्रमधर्माणां प्रस्थानेषु व्यवस्थिताः । अन्ते तु नावसीदन्ति श्रद्धायुक्तास्तु कर्मसु
verses.transliteration: ye cāpyāśramadharmāṇāṃ prasthāneṣu vyavasthitāḥ / ante tu nāvasīdanti śraddhāyuktāstu karmasu
verses.translation: Yama, king of Dharma and son of the Sun-god is remembered as their chastiser. The classifications of castes are said to have been begun in the Treta.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त वा शंकरस्तस्मै ददौ मंत्रं सुदुर्लभम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Yama, king of Dharma and son of the Sun-god is remembered as their chastiser. The classifications of castes are said to have been begun in the Treta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama, king of Dharma and son of the Sun-god is remembered as their chastiser. The classifications of castes are said to have been begun in the Treta.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण यज्ञेन प्रजया च वै । श्राद्धेन विद्यया चैव प्रदानेन च सप्तधा
verses.transliteration: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñena prajayā ca vai / śrāddhena vidyayā caiva pradānena ca saptadhā
verses.translation: At the end of a thousand Righteous activities, the Dharma of nonviolence begins to function. It is then that heroes are born with great strength and span of life.
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of a thousand Righteous activities, the Dharma of nonviolence begins to function. It is then that heroes are born with great strength and span of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of a thousand Righteous activities, the Dharma of nonviolence begins to function. It is then that heroes are born with great strength and span of life.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मस्वेतेषु ये युक्ता भवन्त्यादेहपातनात् । दैवैस्तैः पितृभिः सार्द्धं सूक्ष्मजैः सोमयाजनैः
verses.transliteration: karmasveteṣu ye yuktā bhavantyādehapātanāt / daivaistaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ sūkṣmajaiḥ somayājanaiḥ
verses.translation: They had renounced punishments. They were ex¬ tremely fortunate and highly righteous. They were expounders of Brahman. Their eyes were extensive like the petals of a lotus. They had broad, wide chests and their limbs were well-knit together.
verses.hindi: उस राजा सहस्राजुन -का बिना ही शस्त्रों वाले होते हुए तुम हनन करने की इच्छा कर रहे हो जिसने अपनी भ्र.भङ्ग की लीला से अर्थात् जरा सी भृकुटी तिरछी करके रावण जैसे महापराक्रमी को भी निराहत कर दिया था अर्थात् अपने सामने निंराहत. केरके भगा दिया था ।५०। उस
verses.wordMeaning: They had renounced punishments. They were ex¬ tremely fortunate and highly righteous. They were expounders of Brahman. Their eyes were extensive like the petals of a lotus. They had broad, wide chests and their limbs were well-knit together.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had renounced punishments. They were ex¬ tremely fortunate and highly righteous. They were expounders of Brahman. Their eyes were extensive like the petals of a lotus. They had broad, wide chests and their limbs were well-knit together.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गता दिवि मोदन्ते पितृवत्त उपासते । तेषां निवापे दत्ते तु तत्कुलीनैश्च बन्धुभिः
verses.transliteration: svargatā divi modante pitṛvatta upāsate / teṣāṃ nivāpe datte tu tatkulīnaiśca bandhubhiḥ
verses.translation: The sovereigns of the world in ihc Trcta Yuga were capable of agonizing even lions; they were extremely vigorous. Their mode of walking was like that of intoxicated elephants. They were great wielders of bow (great experts in archery).
verses.hindi: राजा को तो पहिले दत्तात्रेय मुनि ने श्री हरि का कवच प्रदान किया था और अत्यन्त बोय से समन्बित एके भर्ति भो उसके लिए दी थी। उसको
verses.wordMeaning: The sovereigns of the world in ihc Trcta Yuga were capable of agonizing even lions; they were extremely vigorous. Their mode of walking was like that of intoxicated elephants. They were great wielders of bow (great experts in archery).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sovereigns of the world in ihc Trcta Yuga were capable of agonizing even lions; they were extremely vigorous. Their mode of walking was like that of intoxicated elephants. They were great wielders of bow (great experts in archery).

verses.sanskrit: मासश्राद्धभुजस्तृप्तिं लभन्ते सोमलौकिकाः । एते मनुष्यपितरो मासश्राद्धभुजस्तु ये
verses.transliteration: māsaśrāddhabhujastṛptiṃ labhante somalaukikāḥ / ete manuṣyapitaro māsaśrāddhabhujastu ye
verses.translation: The following seven things viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a spouse, a treasure, a horse and an elephant—these arc considered to be the seven jeweb of emperors.
verses.wordMeaning: The following seven things viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a spouse, a treasure, a horse and an elephant—these arc considered to be the seven jeweb of emperors.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following seven things viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a spouse, a treasure, a horse and an elephant—these arc considered to be the seven jeweb of emperors.

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो ऽपरे तु ये ऽप्यन्ये संकीर्णाः कर्मयोनिषु । भ्रष्टाश्चाश्रमधर्मेभ्यः स्वधास्वाहाविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo 'pare tu ye 'pyanye saṃkīrṇāḥ karmayoniṣu / bhraṣṭāścāśramadharmebhyaḥ svadhāsvāhāvivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: They say that the following seven are the inanimate jewels of the sovereign over the world, viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a sword. The excellent shield is the fifth, the flag and the treasure.
verses.hindi: तुम किस प्रकार से मार देना चाहते हो ? ।५१। भगवान् शंकर तो करुणा के अथाह सागर हैं और करुणा से ही सिद्ध हो जाते हैं । यह विभु तो परम समर्थ हैं सभी कुछ अन्यथा भी कर सकते हैं। है पुत्र ! भगवान् शंकर के के अतिरिक्त अन्य कोई भी इस कार्य के करने में समर्थ नहीं है ।५२। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: They say that the following seven are the inanimate jewels of the sovereign over the world, viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a sword. The excellent shield is the fifth, the flag and the treasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that the following seven are the inanimate jewels of the sovereign over the world, viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a sword. The excellent shield is the fifth, the flag and the treasure.

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नदेहा दुरात्मानः प्रेतभूता यमक्षये । स्वकर्माण्य नुशोचन्तो यातनास्थानमागताः
verses.transliteration: bhinnadehā durātmānaḥ pretabhūtā yamakṣaye / svakarmāṇya nuśocanto yātanāsthānamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: (The seven jewels of an Emperor) having life are mentioned as follows: The Queen, the family priest, the com- mander-in-chief, the chariot-maker, the minuter, the horae and the elephant.
verses.hindi: अनेन्तर देवी के इन वचनों से दया के सागर भगवान् शम्भु ने दुर्गा देवी कीः भी अनुमति पराम कर लीं थी और फिर विभु शम्भु ने जमदग्नि के पुत्र से परम भद्र वाणी के द्वारा कहा था ।५३। भगवान शिव ने कहां-हे विप्र ! आज से लेकरं तुम मेरे पुत्र कार्तिकेय के समान हो जाओगे । 'हे महाम् मति
verses.wordMeaning: (The seven jewels of an Emperor) having life are mentioned as follows: The Queen, the family priest, the com- mander-in-chief, the chariot-maker, the minuter, the horae and the elephant.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The seven jewels of an Emperor) having life are mentioned as follows: The Queen, the family priest, the com- mander-in-chief, the chariot-maker, the minuter, the horae and the elephant.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घायुषो ऽतिशुष्काश्च श्मश्रुलाश्च विवाससः । क्षुत्पिपासापरीताश्च विद्रवन्तस्ततस्ततः
verses.transliteration: dīrghāyuṣo 'tiśuṣkāśca śmaśrulāśca vivāsasaḥ / kṣutpipāsāparītāśca vidravantastatastataḥ
verses.translation: These jewels are divine ones. They have been (naturally) acquired by the noble«uled ones. These fourteen (jewels) should be assigned to all Emperors.
verses.hindi: वाले ! मैं आपको परम दिव्य मन्त्र और कवच दे दूग। ।५४। यही विनाही किसी आयास के लीला ही से जिनके प्रसाद के प्रभाव से आप कास बीर्य का हनन कर दोगे और जैसी तुम्हारी प्रतिज्ञा है वह भी पूर्ण होगी और इक्कीस बार इस पृथ्वी को भी भूपों से रहित तुम कर दोगे ।५५। इतना यह
verses.wordMeaning: These jewels are divine ones. They have been (naturally) acquired by the noble«uled ones. These fourteen (jewels) should be assigned to all Emperors.
verses.commentary: Sense: These jewels are divine ones. They have been (naturally) acquired by the noble«uled ones. These fourteen (jewels) should be assigned to all Emperors.

verses.sanskrit: सरित्सरस्तडागानि वापीश्चाप्युपलिप्सवः । परान्नानि च लिप्संतः काल्यमानास्ततस्ततः
verses.transliteration: saritsarastaḍāgāni vāpīścāpyupalipsavaḥ / parānnāni ca lipsaṃtaḥ kālyamānāstatastataḥ
verses.translation: W. 74-77 describe two lists of seven 'jewris* of an eonperui {Cckrt perlui) Here 14 jewels are mentioned. A similar list of royal jewris is ibood in P&li literature. The represenuUofi of the 2itd cent B.C. of a Cakravtrtm at Jigayyetta shows these jewels* and one more fcaturat the touch of Coboporh' band above (towards the sky) it shows gold mni.
verses.hindi: इस रीति से कहकर भगवाच शम्भु ते उस परशुराम के लिए सुदुर्लभ मन्त प्रदान कर दिया था और तीनों लोकों का विजय करने वाला परम अदभुत कवच भी उसे दे दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: W. 74-77 describe two lists of seven 'jewris* of an eonperui {Cckrt perlui) Here 14 jewels are mentioned. A similar list of royal jewris is ibood in P&li literature. The represenuUofi of the 2itd cent B.C.…
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 74-77 describe two lists of seven 'jewris* of an eonperui {Cckrt perlui) Here 14 jewels are mentioned. A similar list of royal jewris is ibood in P&li literature. The represenuUofi of the 2itd cent B.C.…

verses.sanskrit: स्थानेषु पात्यमानाश्च यातनाश्च पुनः पुनः । शाल्मले वैतरण्यां च कुंभीपाके तथैव च
verses.transliteration: sthāneṣu pātyamānāśca yātanāśca punaḥ punaḥ / śālmale vaitaraṇyāṃ ca kuṃbhīpāke tathaiva ca
verses.translation: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, emperors are bom on the Earth from a pare of Visnu.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, emperors are bom on the Earth from a pare of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, emperors are bom on the Earth from a pare of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: करंभवालुकायां च असिपत्रवने तथा । शिला संपेषणे चैव पात्यमानाः स्वकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: karaṃbhavālukāyāṃ ca asipatravane tathā / śilā saṃpeṣaṇe caiva pātyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: Emperors arc bom in the Trcta Yuga of all the Manvantaras of ihe past> present and future.
verses.wordMeaning: Emperors arc bom in the Trcta Yuga of all the Manvantaras of ihe past> present and future.
verses.commentary: Sense: Emperors arc bom in the Trcta Yuga of all the Manvantaras of ihe past> present and future.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रस्थानां हि तेषां वै दुः खितानामनाशिनाम् । तेषां लोकान्तरस्थानां बान्धवैर्नाम गोत्रतः
verses.transliteration: tatrasthānāṃ hi teṣāṃ vai duḥ khitānāmanāśinām / teṣāṃ lokāntarasthānāṃ bāndhavairnāma gotrataḥ
verses.translation: The following four shall be very wonderful and excellent in regard to those kings:—viz. strength (or army), Dharma (virtue, piety), happiness and wealth.
verses.wordMeaning: The following four shall be very wonderful and excellent in regard to those kings:—viz. strength (or army), Dharma (virtue, piety), happiness and wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following four shall be very wonderful and excellent in regard to those kings:—viz. strength (or army), Dharma (virtue, piety), happiness and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: भूमावसव्यं दर्भेषु दत्ताः पिण्डास्त्रयस्तु वै । यान्ति तास्तर्पयन्ते च प्रेतस्थानेष्वधिष्ठितान्
verses.transliteration: bhūmāvasavyaṃ darbheṣu dattāḥ piṇḍāstrayastu vai / yānti tāstarpayante ca pretasthāneṣvadhiṣṭhitān
verses.translation: Wealth, dharma, love, fameand victory are acquired by the kings on a par with one anotlter and without coining into conflict.
verses.hindi: निहत्य कार्तवीर्यं तं ससैन्यं सकुलं मुदा ।
verses.wordMeaning: Wealth, dharma, love, fameand victory are acquired by the kings on a par with one anotlter and without coining into conflict.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wealth, dharma, love, fameand victory are acquired by the kings on a par with one anotlter and without coining into conflict.

verses.sanskrit: अप्राप्ता यातनास्थानं प्रभ्रष्टा य च पञ्चधा । पश्चाद्ये स्थावरान्ते वै जाता नीचैः स्वकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: aprāptā yātanāsthānaṃ prabhraṣṭā ya ca pañcadhā / paścādye sthāvarānte vai jātā nīcaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: They over-power even the sages by means of Ariima (minuteness) and other AUvaiyas, the power of lordship, learning and penance.
verses.wordMeaning: They over-power even the sages by means of Ariima (minuteness) and other AUvaiyas, the power of lordship, learning and penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They over-power even the sages by means of Ariima (minuteness) and other AUvaiyas, the power of lordship, learning and penance.

verses.sanskrit: नानारूपासु जायन्ते तिर्यग्योनिष्वयोनिषु । यदाहारा भवन्त्येते तासु तास्विह योनिषु
verses.transliteration: nānārūpāsu jāyante tiryagyoniṣvayoniṣu / yadāhārā bhavantyete tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तस्मिंस्तदाहारे श्राद्धं दत्तं प्रतिष्ठते । काले न्यायागतं पात्रे विधिना प्रतिपादितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstasmiṃstadāhāre śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ pratiṣṭhate / kāle nyāyāgataṃ pātre vidhinā pratipāditam
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.hindi: जुम्भणा भी प्रदत्त कर दिया थो । तैथा गदा-शक्ति-शूल-उत्तम' दण्ड उसको
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोत्यन्नं यथादत्तं जन्तुर्यत्रावतिष्ठते । यथा गोषु प्रनष्टामु वत्सो विन्दति मातरम्
verses.transliteration: prāpnotyannaṃ yathādattaṃ janturyatrāvatiṣṭhate / yathā goṣu pranaṣṭāmu vatso vindati mātaram
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.hindi: दे दिया का. इवा. इस तरह सम्पूर्ण शस्त्रों और अस्त्रों के समूह को पाकर खम-बहुत ही ्रसन्त हुआ का । फिर उस परशुराम ने परम शान्त शिव: को“-दुर्गा देवीः को --स्वामी कात्तिकेय को और गणेश्वर की सेवा में.प्रणि- पात करके तथा इन, सबकी परिक्रमा करके फिर वह राम परमोत्तम तीथं
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: तथा श्राद्धेषु दत्तान्नं मन्त्रः प्रापयते पितॄन् । एवं ह्यविफलं श्राद्धं श्रद्धादत्तं तु मन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: tathā śrāddheṣu dattānnaṃ mantraḥ prāpayate pitṝn / evaṃ hyaviphalaṃ śrāddhaṃ śraddhādattaṃ tu mantrataḥ
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.hindi: पुष्कर को बहाँ से चला गया था. और वहाँ पर संस्थिति करते हुए. भगवानु शिव के द्वारा बताये हुए.उत्तम: मन्त्र को ओर कवच को सिद्ध किया घा ।५९।-९०। फिर भृगु नन्दन ने बड़े ही आनन्द से सम्पूर्ण कुल और सेना के सहित राजा कात्त'वीयं का निइनम करके अपना पूर्ण कार्य साधित किया
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तत्कुमारः प्रोवाच पश्यन्दिव्येन चक्षुषा । गतागतज्ञः प्रेतानां प्राप्तिं श्राद्धस्य तैः सह
verses.transliteration: tattatkumāraḥ provāca paśyandivyena cakṣuṣā / gatāgatajñaḥ pretānāṃ prāptiṃ śrāddhasya taiḥ saha
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.hindi: था.। फिर बह राग अपने पिता के घर.को बिनिवृत्त होकर चला गया
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
