verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्लीकाश्चोष्मपाश्चैव दिवाकीर्त्याश्च ते स्मृताः । कृष्णपक्षस्त्वहस्तेषां शुक्लः स्वप्नाय शर्वरी
verses.transliteration: bāhlīkāścoṣmapāścaiva divākīrtyāśca te smṛtāḥ / kṛṣṇapakṣastvahasteṣāṃ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते पितरो देवा देवाश्च पितरश्च वै । ऋत्वर्तवार्द्धमासास्तु अन्योन्यं पितरः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ityete pitaro devā devāśca pitaraśca vai / ṛtvartavārddhamāsāstu anyonyaṃ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येत पितरो देवा मनुष्यपितरश्च ये । प्रीतेषु तेषु प्रीयन्ते श्राद्धयुक्तेषु कर्मसु
verses.transliteration: ityeta pitaro devā manuṣyapitaraśca ye / prīteṣu teṣu prīyante śrāddhayukteṣu karmasu
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष विचयः प्रोक्तः पितॄणां सोमपायिनाम् । एवं पितृसतत्त्वं हि पुराणे निश्चयं गतम्
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa vicayaḥ proktaḥ pitṝṇāṃ somapāyinām / evaṃ pitṛsatattvaṃ hi purāṇe niścayaṃ gatam
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यर्कपितृसोमानामैलस्य च समागमः । सुधामृतस्य च प्राप्तिः पितॄणां चैव तर्प्पणम्
verses.transliteration: ityarkapitṛsomānāmailasya ca samāgamaḥ / sudhāmṛtasya ca prāptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ caiva tarppaṇam
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.hindi: कृपापात्रं स दत्तस्य राजा रामः शिवस्य च ।
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णा मावास्ययोः कालो यातनास्थानमेव च । समासात्कीर्तितस्तुभ्यमेष सर्गः मनातनः
verses.transliteration: pūrṇā māvāsyayoḥ kālo yātanāsthānameva ca / samāsātkīrtitastubhyameṣa sargaḥ manātanaḥ
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वरूप्यं तु सर्गस्य कथितं ह्येकदैशिकम् । न शक्यं परिसंख्यातुं श्रद्धेयं भूतिमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: vaiśvarūpyaṃ tu sargasya kathitaṃ hyekadaiśikam / na śakyaṃ parisaṃkhyātuṃ śraddheyaṃ bhūtimicchatā
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवस्य हि ह्येष सर्गः क्रान्तो मया तु वै । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च भूयः किं वर्णयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuvasya hi hyeṣa sargaḥ krānto mayā tu vai / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca bhūyaḥ kiṃ varṇayāmyaham
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.hindi: चकार साधनं तस्य भक्ता फ्रमया युतः
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे अमावस्याश्राद्धे पितृविचयोनामाष्टाविंशति तमो ऽध्यायः ऋषिरुवाच चतुर्युगानि यान्यासन्पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे । तेषां निसर्गं तत्त्वं च श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde amāvasyāśrāddhe pitṛvicayonāmāṣṭāviṃśati tamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣiruvāca caturyugāni yānyāsanpūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / teṣāṃ nisargaṃ tattvaṃ ca śrotumicchāmi vistarāt
verses.translation: You are Omkara among the Vedic Mantras, Jyesthasaman among the San Mantras. You are the lion among the beings of the forest. You are the supreme livara.
verses.wordMeaning: You are Omkara among the Vedic Mantras, Jyesthasaman among the San Mantras. You are the lion among the beings of the forest. You are the supreme livara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Omkara among the Vedic Mantras, Jyesthasaman among the San Mantras. You are the lion among the beings of the forest. You are the supreme livara.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच पृथिव्यादिप्रसंगेन यन्मया प्रागुदीरितम् । तेषां चतुर्युगं ह्येतत्तद्वक्ष्यामि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca pṛthivyādiprasaṃgena yanmayā prāgudīritam / teṣāṃ caturyugaṃ hyetattadvakṣyāmi nibodhata
verses.translation: God Siva b the best one amoog all gO(b etc. Cf. Bh-G. for such a list of excellences and every such excellence b Hb part:
verses.hindi: राजा सगर ने कह--हे' ब्रह्माजी के पुन ! आप तो महाचू -भाम वाले हैं! मेरे ऊपर आपने बड़ा भारी अनुग्रह किया है कि यह कवच जो कि अनामय है, मेरे सामने आपने अकाशित कर दिया है १। कृतास्त्र में औरच के द्वारा अनुग्रहीत हुआ हूँ । है विभो ! इस समय में तो मैं आपंकी कृपा का
verses.wordMeaning: God Siva b the best one amoog all gO(b etc. Cf. Bh-G. for such a list of excellences and every such excellence b Hb part:
verses.commentary: Sense: God Siva b the best one amoog all gO(b etc. Cf. Bh-G. for such a list of excellences and every such excellence b Hb part:

verses.sanskrit: संख्ययेह प्रसंख्याय विस्तराच्चैव सर्वशः । युगं च युगभेदश्च युगधर्मस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: saṃkhyayeha prasaṃkhyāya vistarāccaiva sarvaśaḥ / yugaṃ ca yugabhedaśca yugadharmastathaiva ca
verses.translation: The man of deluded mind who censures them, censure> Mahadeva. He who worships them always worships Sankara. Act like this. Welfare unto you all. You will obtain (achievement of) spiritual power from me."
verses.hindi: पाज बन गया हूँ ।रा है गुरुदेव ! भार्गवेस्दर परशुराम मे राजा कार्तवीर्य को जो बड़ा ही वीर बा जिस प्रकार से समाप्त किया था वह सब विस्तार के साथ मेरे सामने वर्णन करके सुनाइए ।३। वह राजा ठो दत्तात्रेय मुनि फी कृपा का पात्र था और राम भगवान शिव की अनुकम्पा का भाजत था । हे
verses.wordMeaning: The man of deluded mind who censures them, censure> Mahadeva. He who worships them always worships Sankara. Act like this. Welfare unto you all. You will obtain (achievement of) spiritual power from me."
verses.commentary: Sense: The man of deluded mind who censures them, censure> Mahadeva. He who worships them always worships Sankara. Act like this. Welfare unto you all. You will obtain (achievement of) spiritual power from me."

verses.sanskrit: युगसंध्यांशकश्चैव युगसंधानमेव च । षट्प्रकाशयुगाख्यैषा ता प्रवक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: yugasaṃdhyāṃśakaścaiva yugasaṃdhānameva ca / ṣaṭprakāśayugākhyaiṣā tā pravakṣyāmi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: After understanding the unparalleled and excellent holy rite that is destructive of the great darkness (of ignorance) and that had been recounted by Siva, those people got rid of their fear, greed, delusion and anxiety. They all fell (at his feet), simultaneously and bore (them) by means of their heads.
verses.hindi: गुरुवर ! ये दोनों हो महात् वीर थे । समर लेन में किस प्रकार से इन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: After understanding the unparalleled and excellent holy rite that is destructive of the great darkness (of ignorance) and that had been recounted by Siva, those people got rid of their fear, greed, delusion and anxiety. They all fell (at his feet),…
verses.commentary: Sense: After understanding the unparalleled and excellent holy rite that is destructive of the great darkness (of ignorance) and that had been recounted by Siva, those people got rid of their fear, greed, delusion and anxiety. They all fell (at his feet),…

verses.sanskrit: लौकिकेन प्रमाणेन निष्पाद्याब्दं तु मानुषम् । तेनाब्देन प्रसंख्यायै वक्ष्यामीह वतुर्युगम् । निमेषकाल तुल्यं हि विद्याल्लघ्वक्षरं च यत्
verses.transliteration: laukikena pramāṇena niṣpādyābdaṃ tu mānuṣam / tenābdena prasaṃkhyāyai vakṣyāmīha vaturyugam / nimeṣakāla tulyaṃ hi vidyāllaghvakṣaraṃ ca yat
verses.translation: "Obeisance unto you, O lord with the quarters for your garments (i.e. naked); Bow lo the lord wearing Kiiikinls (small tinkling ornaments or bells); Salutation to the lord half of whose body is female. Obeisance to the lord who promul¬ gated Simkhya and Yoga.
verses.hindi: युद्ध किया था ।४। बसिछ जी मे कहा--हे राजन् ! अब आप श्रवणा कीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance unto you, O lord with the quarters for your garments (i.e. naked); Bow lo the lord wearing Kiiikinls (small tinkling ornaments or bells); Salutation to the lord half of whose body is female. Obeisance to the lord who promul¬ gated Simkhya and Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance unto you, O lord with the quarters for your garments (i.e. naked); Bow lo the lord wearing Kiiikinls (small tinkling ornaments or bells); Salutation to the lord half of whose body is female. Obeisance to the lord who promul¬ gated Simkhya and Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठा निमेषा दश पञ्च चैव त्रिशच्च काष्ठा गणयेत्कलां तु । त्रिंशत्कलाश्चापि भवेन्मुहूर्त्तस्तै स्त्रिंशता रात्र्यहनी समे ते
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhā nimeṣā daśa pañca caiva triśacca kāṣṭhā gaṇayetkalāṃ tu / triṃśatkalāścāpi bhavenmuhūrttastai striṃśatā rātryahanī same te
verses.translation: Bow to the lord dark in colour, with the clouds for his vehicle; Obeisance to the lord wearing the hide of an elephant as his garment. Salute to the lord wearing the skin of an antelope as the upper garment. Obeisance to the lord having a serpent for his sacred thread."
verses.hindi: मैं इस चरित को वतलाऊमा क्योंकि यह चरित तो पापों का विनाश कर देने बाला है। यह चरित महान् यलशाली राजा कात्त वीर्ये का तथा महात् आत्मा बाले परशुराम के महायुद्ध का है।५। उन परशुराम ने गुरुदेव के मुख से इस कवच और मन्त्र की दीक्षा प्रहण को थी फिर उन परशुराम ने
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to the lord dark in colour, with the clouds for his vehicle; Obeisance to the lord wearing the hide of an elephant as his garment. Salute to the lord wearing the skin of an antelope as the upper garment. Obeisance to the lord having a serpent for his sacred thread."
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to the lord dark in colour, with the clouds for his vehicle; Obeisance to the lord wearing the hide of an elephant as his garment. Salute to the lord wearing the skin of an antelope as the upper garment. Obeisance to the lord having a serpent for his sacred thread."

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रौ विभजते सूर्यो मानुषलौकिकौ
verses.transliteration: ahorātrau vibhajate sūryo mānuṣalaukikau
verses.translation: Obeisance be unto Sankara who has well construc¬ ted and wonderfully variegated ear-rings. Bow be to you with well-wreathed garlands for ornaments. Hail to you with the excellent hide of a lion for garment, O lord wielding a huge axe".
verses.hindi: बड़ी भारी भक्ति से होकर इनको सिद्ध किया था ।६। भूमि पर इन्ही“ णयन् किया था--तीतों कालों में सन्ध्योपासना की थी और यह सनान त॑था सम्ध्या में परायण हो गये थे ! इस प्रकार में यह सब साधना करते हुए राम बहुत ही समाहित होकर एक सो बषे तक पुष्कर में रहे थे अर्धात् पुष्कर
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be unto Sankara who has well construc¬ ted and wonderfully variegated ear-rings. Bow be to you with well-wreathed garlands for ornaments. Hail to you with the excellent hide of a lion for garment, O lord wielding a huge axe".
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be unto Sankara who has well construc¬ ted and wonderfully variegated ear-rings. Bow be to you with well-wreathed garlands for ornaments. Hail to you with the excellent hide of a lion for garment, O lord wielding a huge axe".

verses.sanskrit: तत्राहः कर्मचेष्टायां रात्रिः स्वप्नाय कल्पते । पित्र्ये रात्र्यहनी मासः प्रविभागस्तयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatrāhaḥ karmaceṣṭāyāṃ rātriḥ svapnāya kalpate / pitrye rātryahanī māsaḥ pravibhāgastayoḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: shall explain this to you. I shall mention the
verses.wordMeaning: shall explain this to you. I shall mention the
verses.commentary: Sense: shall explain this to you. I shall mention the

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षस्त्वहस्तेषां शुक्लः स्वप्नाय शर्वरी । त्रिंशद्ये मानुषा मासाः पित्र्यो मासस्तु सः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣastvahasteṣāṃ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī / triṃśadye mānuṣā māsāḥ pitryo māsastu saḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: W. 106-126 docribe PSiupaoi Vrata according to the author of this Purhoa.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 106-126 docribe PSiupaoi Vrata according to the author of this Purhoa.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 106-126 docribe PSiupaoi Vrata according to the author of this Purhoa.

verses.sanskrit: शतानि त्रीणि मासानां षष्ट्या चाप्यधिकानि वै । पित्र्यः संवत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: śatāni trīṇi māsānāṃ ṣaṣṭyā cāpyadhikāni vai / pitryaḥ saṃvatsaro hyeṣa mānuṣeṇa vibhāvyate
verses.translation: They say that all the worlds have resorted to the fire made and unmade (i.e. artificial and natural). The whole worlds mobile and immobile, is burned many times by fire.
verses.wordMeaning: They say that all the worlds have resorted to the fire made and unmade (i.e. artificial and natural). The whole worlds mobile and immobile, is burned many times by fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that all the worlds have resorted to the fire made and unmade (i.e. artificial and natural). The whole worlds mobile and immobile, is burned many times by fire.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषे णैव मानेन वर्षाणां यच्छतं भवेत् । पितॄणां त्रीणि वर्षाणि संख्यातानीह तानि वै
verses.transliteration: mānuṣe ṇaiva mānena varṣāṇāṃ yacchataṃ bhavet / pitṝṇāṃ trīṇi varṣāṇi saṃkhyātānīha tāni vai
verses.translation: Everything can be achieved through Bhasman. It is excellent and sacred. He (the devotee) sprinkles the living beings after assimilating the power and essence of ashes.
verses.wordMeaning: Everything can be achieved through Bhasman. It is excellent and sacred. He (the devotee) sprinkles the living beings after assimilating the power and essence of ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything can be achieved through Bhasman. It is excellent and sacred. He (the devotee) sprinkles the living beings after assimilating the power and essence of ashes.

verses.sanskrit: दश चैवाधिका मासाः पितृसंख्येह संज्ञिताः । लौकिकेनैव मानेन हृब्दो यो मानुषः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: daśa caivādhikā māsāḥ pitṛsaṃkhyeha saṃjñitāḥ / laukikenaiva mānena hṛbdo yo mānuṣaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Pitfs should be known as Dsmapds (Imbibing heat); the Devas are born of Soma (the Soma juice or the moon). The entire universe consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings is constituted by Agni and Soma.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitfs should be known as Dsmapds (Imbibing heat); the Devas are born of Soma (the Soma juice or the moon). The entire universe consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings is constituted by Agni and Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitfs should be known as Dsmapds (Imbibing heat); the Devas are born of Soma (the Soma juice or the moon). The entire universe consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings is constituted by Agni and Soma.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दिव्यमहोरात्रं शास्त्रे स्यान्निश्चयो गतः । दिव्ये रात्र्यहनी वर्ष प्रविभागस्तयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: etaddivyamahorātraṃ śāstre syānniścayo gataḥ / divye rātryahanī varṣa pravibhāgastayoḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: I am Agni of great splendour. This my Ambika, is Soma; Agni, Soma and I form ourselves the Purusa whhprakrti.
verses.hindi: हे भूप ! अकतब्रण प्रतिदित उस भृगुवंशज परशुराम के लिए बन से समिधा पुष्प और कुशा आदि ब्रथ्यों को लाकर दिया करता था ।५। मति- सानों में परम श्रेष्ठ परशुराम निरन्तर ध्यान में संलग्न होकर समस्त कल्मयों के विनाश करने वाले विभु श्रीकृष्ण की आराधना किया करता
verses.wordMeaning: I am Agni of great splendour. This my Ambika, is Soma; Agni, Soma and I form ourselves the Purusa whhprakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am Agni of great splendour. This my Ambika, is Soma; Agni, Soma and I form ourselves the Purusa whhprakrti.

verses.sanskrit: अहस्तत्रोदगयनं रात्रिः स्याद्दक्षिणायनम् । ये ते रात्र्यहनी दिव्ये प्रसंख्यानं तयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ahastatrodagayanaṃ rātriḥ syāddakṣiṇāyanam / ye te rātryahanī divye prasaṃkhyānaṃ tayoḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: The holy rite Pasupatais (not inferior to) Yoga; the holy rite of Kipila is based on Yoga. This Pafupaia rite is laid down before. It is most excellent
verses.hindi: था ।९। है जगतीपते ! इस रीति से यजन करते हुए और कहाँ पर नित्य ही ध्यात में से सक्त रहने वाले परशुराम को एक सी बर्ष व्यतीत हो गये थे ।१०। है महाराज ! एक बार बह महान राम स्नान करने के लिए मध्यम पुष्कर में गया था और बहाँ पर उसने उत्तम आश्चर्य का अवलोकन किया
verses.wordMeaning: The holy rite Pasupatais (not inferior to) Yoga; the holy rite of Kipila is based on Yoga. This Pafupaia rite is laid down before. It is most excellent
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy rite Pasupatais (not inferior to) Yoga; the holy rite of Kipila is based on Yoga. This Pafupaia rite is laid down before. It is most excellent

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशद्यानि तु वर्षाणि दिप्यो मासस्तु स स्मृतः । यन्मानुषं शतं विद्धि दिव्या मासास्त्रयस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: triṃśadyāni tu varṣāṇi dipyo māsastu sa smṛtaḥ / yanmānuṣaṃ śataṃ viddhi divyā māsāstrayastu te
verses.translation: All the remaining Airmins {pcT%on$ of various stages in life) have been created afterwards by the self-bom lord (Brahmi). This creation which is of the nature of bashftilness,
verses.hindi: था ।११ एक भृग भगी के साथ दोड़ा हुआ वहाँ पर आया था जो एक च्याध कौ मृगया को प्राप्त हो रहा था तथा धाम से सन्तप्त होकर अत्यस्तः पोड़ित भा।१२। है महाभाग ! बहुत ही प्यासा था और जलपान करने के सिए बड़ा ही उत्सुक हो रहा था परशुराम उसको देख रहे थे कि बहाँ पर
verses.wordMeaning: All the remaining Airmins {pcT%on$ of various stages in life) have been created afterwards by the self-bom lord (Brahmi). This creation which is of the nature of bashftilness,
verses.commentary: Sense: All the remaining Airmins {pcT%on$ of various stages in life) have been created afterwards by the self-bom lord (Brahmi). This creation which is of the nature of bashftilness,

verses.sanskrit: दश चैव तथाहानि दिव्यो ह्येष विधिः स्मृतः । त्रीणि वर्षशतान्येव षष्टिवर्षाणि यानि तु । दिव्यः संवत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण प्रकीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: daśa caiva tathāhāni divyo hyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ / trīṇi varṣaśatānyeva ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇi yāni tu / divyaḥ saṃvatsaro hyeṣa mānuṣeṇa prakīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: Deities and the sages are bom only naked. Others, the human beings in the world, all of them are bom without any garment.
verses.hindi: उस सरोबर कें तट पर समागत हो गया था।१३। इसके पी छे-पीछे मृगी भी बहाँ पर आ गयी थी जो बहुत ही डरी हुई थी और उसके नेत्र चकित हो रहे थे । वे दोनों ही बहुत शक्क्कित सन वाले होते हुए यहाँ पर जलपान कर रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Deities and the sages are bom only naked. Others, the human beings in the world, all of them are bom without any garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deities and the sages are bom only naked. Others, the human beings in the world, all of them are bom without any garment.

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि वर्ष सहस्राणि मानुषाणि प्रमाणतः । त्रिंशदन्यानि वर्षाणि मतः सप्तर्षिवत्सरः
verses.transliteration: trīṇi varṣa sahasrāṇi mānuṣāṇi pramāṇataḥ / triṃśadanyāni varṣāṇi mataḥ saptarṣivatsaraḥ
verses.translation: Even the persons who are covered with a silken garment are (no better than) naked, should the sense-organs be unconquered. They are well hidden (covered) if they are duly subdued. It is not the garment that is the real reason (about nudity and non nudity).
verses.wordMeaning: Even the persons who are covered with a silken garment are (no better than) naked, should the sense-organs be unconquered. They are well hidden (covered) if they are duly subdued. It is not the garment that is the real reason (about nudity and non nudity).
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the persons who are covered with a silken garment are (no better than) naked, should the sense-organs be unconquered. They are well hidden (covered) if they are duly subdued. It is not the garment that is the real reason (about nudity and non nudity).

verses.sanskrit: नव यानि सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु । अन्यानि नवतिश्चैव ध्रुवः संवत्सरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nava yāni sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi tu / anyāni navatiścaiva dhruvaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, absence of attachment to all (worldly things) and equal indiflerence to both honour and dishonour—these constitute the excellent covering garment.

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशतिसहस्राणि वर्षाणि मानुषाणि तु । वर्षाणां तु शतं ज्ञेयं दिव्यो ह्येष विधिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi mānuṣāṇi tu / varṣāṇāṃ tu śataṃ jñeyaṃ divyo hyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O Suta I King Pururavas, the son of Ila, used to go to the heaven on the New Moon day in every month. How was it? How did he propitiate the Pitrs (Manes).
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta I King Pururavas, the son of Ila, used to go to the heaven on the New Moon day in every month. How was it? How did he propitiate the Pitrs (Manes).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta I King Pururavas, the son of Ila, used to go to the heaven on the New Moon day in every month. How was it? How did he propitiate the Pitrs (Manes).

verses.sanskrit: त्रीण्येव नियुतान्याहुर्वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु
verses.transliteration: trīṇyeva niyutānyāhurvarṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi tu
verses.translation: O Samapayani, I shall narrate his power. I shall narrate tlie contact of the noble-souled son of Ila with the sun as well as with the moon.
verses.hindi: उसी समय में घनुष धारण किये हुए हाय में बाण ग्रहण कर वहां पर व्याध भी आ गया था । उस व्याघ ने यहाँ पर विराजमान परशुराम को देखा था ।१५। उस राम ही समीप में अकृत व्रण भी बेठा हुआ था । वह व्याध हूर तक अपनी दृष्टि डाले हुए वहीँ पर ठहर गया था और उस व्याध
verses.wordMeaning: O Samapayani, I shall narrate his power. I shall narrate tlie contact of the noble-souled son of Ila with the sun as well as with the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Samapayani, I shall narrate his power. I shall narrate tlie contact of the noble-souled son of Ila with the sun as well as with the moon.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि संख्यातानि तु संख्याया । दिव्यवर्षसहस्र तु प्राहुः संख्याविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi saṃkhyātāni tu saṃkhyāyā / divyavarṣasahasra tu prāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ
verses.translation: When the sun and the moon come into contact with the star, they stay in Am&v&sya (New Mocm) for a night in the same zone.
verses.hindi: का मन भृगुनन्दन राम से उस समय में शंकित हो गया था और विचार किया था ।१६। यह परशुराम तो महान वीर हैं ओर दुष्टों का विनाश कर देने वाला है। अब मैं इसके देखते हुए इन दोनों शिकार बालें 'मृगी और मृग का हनन करू ।१७। है राजन्यों मैं परम शरे ! यह व्याध इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun and the moon come into contact with the star, they stay in Am&v&sya (New Mocm) for a night in the same zone.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun and the moon come into contact with the star, they stay in Am&v&sya (New Mocm) for a night in the same zone.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमृषिभिर्गीतं दिव्यया संख्याया त्विह । दिव्येनैव प्रमाणेन युगसंख्याप्रकल्पनम्
verses.transliteration: ityevamṛṣibhirgītaṃ divyayā saṃkhyāyā tviha / divyenaiva pramāṇena yugasaṃkhyāprakalpanam
verses.translation: Then during every new moon day, he (Pururavas) goes to see the sun-god and the moon-god, his natural and paternal grandfathers.
verses.hindi: से चिन्ता में डूबा हुआ परशुराम के भय से संत्रस्त मन बालां होकर बहीं पर स्थित हो गया था ।१५। परशुराम ने उन दोनों भृगों को देखा था कि बड़े ही भय के साथ वहाँ पर जल पी रहे थे। उस मेधावी राम ने मन में विचारं किया था कि यहाँ पर इनके लिए भय होने का क्या कारण है
verses.wordMeaning: Then during every new moon day, he (Pururavas) goes to see the sun-god and the moon-god, his natural and paternal grandfathers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then during every new moon day, he (Pururavas) goes to see the sun-god and the moon-god, his natural and paternal grandfathers.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि भारते वर्षे युगानि कवयो ऽबुवन् । कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चेति चतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: catvāri bhārate varṣe yugāni kavayo 'buvan / kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti catuṣṭayam
verses.translation: After paying respects to them, he waits there biding his time. He waits for the exudations of nectar from the following moon, for the sake of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: यहाँ पर किसी व्याघ्र की गर्जना की ध्वनि भी नहीं है और न यहाँ पर कोई व्याध ही दिखाई दे रहा है किर किस कारण से ये दोनों मृग शंकित नेत्रों वाले तथा चकित इष्टि से युक्त हो रहे हैं-यह बड़े आश्‍्नये की बात है ।२०। अथवा यही कारण. हो सकता है कि इन मृगों की जाति ही स्वा-
verses.wordMeaning: After paying respects to them, he waits there biding his time. He waits for the exudations of nectar from the following moon, for the sake of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: After paying respects to them, he waits there biding his time. He waits for the exudations of nectar from the following moon, for the sake of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्व कृतयुकं नाम ततस्त्रेती विधीयते । द्वापरं च कलिश्चैव युगान्येतानि कल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: pūrva kṛtayukaṃ nāma tatastretī vidhīyate / dvāparaṃ ca kaliścaiva yugānyetāni kalpayet
verses.translation: With a desire to perform the monthly Sraddha, Puru¬ ravas, the learned son of I la, worships Soma (the Moon) Pitrmin (one with the Pitfs), after resorting to the heaven,
verses.hindi: भाविक रूप से चकित नेत्रों बाली हुआ करती है! इस कारण से ही ये दोनों जलपान करने में भी चकित नेत्रों वाले होते हुए देख रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: With a desire to perform the monthly Sraddha, Puru¬ ravas, the learned son of I la, worships Soma (the Moon) Pitrmin (one with the Pitfs), after resorting to the heaven,
verses.commentary: Sense: With a desire to perform the monthly Sraddha, Puru¬ ravas, the learned son of I la, worships Soma (the Moon) Pitrmin (one with the Pitfs), after resorting to the heaven,

verses.sanskrit: चत्वार्याहुः सहस्राणि वर्षाणां च कृत युगम् । तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशः संध्याया समः
verses.transliteration: catvāryāhuḥ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ ca kṛta yugam / tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaḥ saṃdhyāyā samaḥ
verses.translation: He propitiates the Pitrs viz. Saumyas, Barhisads, Kavyas and Agnisvattas.
verses.wordMeaning: He propitiates the Pitrs viz. Saumyas, Barhisads, Kavyas and Agnisvattas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He propitiates the Pitrs viz. Saumyas, Barhisads, Kavyas and Agnisvattas.

verses.sanskrit: इतरेषु ससंध्येषु ससंध्यांशेषु च त्रिषु । एकन्यायेन वर्तन्ते सहस्राणि शतानि च
verses.transliteration: itareṣu sasaṃdhyeṣu sasaṃdhyāṃśeṣu ca triṣu / ekanyāyena vartante sahasrāṇi śatāni ca
verses.translation: In Satapatha Br. II 6. 1.7, those who performed a Soma sacrifice are SemoMtUh Piters (probably Saumyas here-oO I those who offered cooked oblations like Can were Barhifadah Pitarab; those who offered no sacrifice
verses.wordMeaning: In Satapatha Br. II 6. 1.7, those who performed a Soma sacrifice are SemoMtUh Piters (probably Saumyas here-oO I those who offered cooked oblations like Can were Barhifadah Pitarab; those who offered no sacrifice
verses.commentary: Sense: In Satapatha Br. II 6. 1.7, those who performed a Soma sacrifice are SemoMtUh Piters (probably Saumyas here-oO I those who offered cooked oblations like Can were Barhifadah Pitarab; those who offered no sacrifice

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि द्वे च सहस्राणि त्रेताद्वापरयोः क्रमात् । त्रिशती द्विशती संध्ये संध्यांशौ चापि तत्समौ
verses.transliteration: trīṇi dve ca sahasrāṇi tretādvāparayoḥ kramāt / triśatī dviśatī saṃdhye saṃdhyāṃśau cāpi tatsamau
verses.translation: The (seasons) were born of it (i.e. Saihvatsara
verses.wordMeaning: The (seasons) were born of it (i.e. Saihvatsara
verses.commentary: Sense: The (seasons) were born of it (i.e. Saihvatsara

verses.sanskrit: कलिं वर्षसरस्रं तु युगमाहुर्द्विजोत्तमाः । तस्यैकशतिका संध्या संध्यांशः संध्यया समः
verses.transliteration: kaliṃ varṣasarasraṃ tu yugamāhurdvijottamāḥ / tasyaikaśatikā saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaḥ saṃdhyayā samaḥ
verses.translation: Thearc grand-fathers. The Mdsas (months) and Ayanas (transits of the sun) are the sons of
verses.hindi: रामं दष्ट्वा महात्मानं: कर्था तौ चक्रतुमु दा
verses.wordMeaning: Thearc grand-fathers. The Mdsas (months) and Ayanas (transits of the sun) are the sons of
verses.commentary: Sense: Thearc grand-fathers. The Mdsas (months) and Ayanas (transits of the sun) are the sons of

verses.sanskrit: तेषां द्वादशसाहस्री युगसंख्या प्रकीर्त्तिता । कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चैव चतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ dvādaśasāhasrī yugasaṃkhyā prakīrttitā / kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliścaiva catuṣṭayam
verses.translation: The Saumyas should be known born of the moon [Somaja), The Kavyas should be known as the sonsof Kavi (Sukra). Upahutas are remembered as Devas. S<>maj<ii are remembered Somapds (Imbibers of Soma)*
verses.wordMeaning: The Saumyas should be known born of the moon [Somaja), The Kavyas should be known as the sonsof Kavi (Sukra). Upahutas are remembered as Devas. S<>maj<ii are remembered Somapds (Imbibers of Soma)*
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saumyas should be known born of the moon [Somaja), The Kavyas should be known as the sonsof Kavi (Sukra). Upahutas are remembered as Devas. S<>maj<ii are remembered Somapds (Imbibers of Soma)*

verses.sanskrit: अत्र संवत्सरा दृष्टा मानुषेण प्रमाणतः । कृतस्य तावद्वक्ष्यामि वर्षाणि च निबोधत
verses.transliteration: atra saṃvatsarā dṛṣṭā mānuṣeṇa pramāṇataḥ / kṛtasya tāvadvakṣyāmi varṣāṇi ca nibodhata
verses.translation: Ajyapds (Imbibers of oblated ghee) are remembered as Kavyas. The classes of PUrs arc three. They are of three classes namely Kavyas, Barhiads and Agnisvattas.
verses.wordMeaning: Ajyapds (Imbibers of oblated ghee) are remembered as Kavyas. The classes of PUrs arc three. They are of three classes namely Kavyas, Barhiads and Agnisvattas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajyapds (Imbibers of oblated ghee) are remembered as Kavyas. The classes of PUrs arc three. They are of three classes namely Kavyas, Barhiads and Agnisvattas.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणां शतान्याहुश्चतुर्दश हि संख्याया । चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि तथान्यानि कृतं युगम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇāṃ śatānyāhuścaturdaśa hi saṃkhyāyā / catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi tathānyāni kṛtaṃ yugam
verses.translation: Those {Pitrs) who imbibe the nectar in the heaven every month on the new moon day, arc remembered as Kavyas Omapas and Divakirtyas.
verses.wordMeaning: Those {Pitrs) who imbibe the nectar in the heaven every month on the new moon day, arc remembered as Kavyas Omapas and Divakirtyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those {Pitrs) who imbibe the nectar in the heaven every month on the new moon day, arc remembered as Kavyas Omapas and Divakirtyas.

verses.sanskrit: तथा शतसहस्राणि वर्षाणि दशसंख्याया । अशीतिश्च सहस्राणि कालस्त्रेतायुगस्य सः
verses.transliteration: tathā śatasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi daśasaṃkhyāyā / aśītiśca sahasrāṇi kālastretāyugasya saḥ
verses.translation: Thirtyihrce Devas (who arc called) Cchedcnas (Those who cut off?) drink the fifteen digits of the moon gradually in the dark fortnight, (after turning ihein)into watery form.
verses.hindi: यहाँ पर इतन! ही कारण नहीं है किल्शु ये दोनों तो बड़े खेद और भय से आतुर हो रहे हैं--ऐसे ही दिखलाई दे रहे हैं । क्‍योंकि इनफे सभी अङ्ग खिन्नता से संयुत हैं और ये दोनों ही कम्प से प्रकम्वित हो रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thirtyihrce Devas (who arc called) Cchedcnas (Those who cut off?) drink the fifteen digits of the moon gradually in the dark fortnight, (after turning ihein)into watery form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirtyihrce Devas (who arc called) Cchedcnas (Those who cut off?) drink the fifteen digits of the moon gradually in the dark fortnight, (after turning ihein)into watery form.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तैव नियुतान्याहुर्वर्षाणां मानुषेण तु । विंशतिश्च सहस्रामि कालः स द्वापरस्य च
verses.transliteration: saptaiva niyutānyāhurvarṣāṇāṃ mānuṣeṇa tu / viṃśatiśca sahasrāmi kālaḥ sa dvāparasya ca
verses.translation: Day by day, in due order, a part (a digit) of the moon is developed by the Susumna. The black digits become reduced and the white ones develop it.
verses.hindi: इस तरह से चिन्तन करके मतिमाय् वह परशुराम भध्य पुष्कर में संस्थित हो गया था और उसके साथ में शिष्य भी था! वह राम जळ तक बहाँ कड़ा रहा. था तब तक वे दोनों मृग भी वहाँ पर संस्थित रहे थे ।२३। जल- पान केरकें वे दोनों भृग एक वृक्ष की छाया का आश्रय ग्रहण करके बेठ गये
verses.wordMeaning: Day by day, in due order, a part (a digit) of the moon is developed by the Susumna. The black digits become reduced and the white ones develop it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Day by day, in due order, a part (a digit) of the moon is developed by the Susumna. The black digits become reduced and the white ones develop it.

verses.sanskrit: तथा शतसहस्राणि वर्षाणां त्रीणि संख्यया । षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि कालः कलियुगस्य तु
verses.transliteration: tathā śatasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ trīṇi saṃkhyayā / ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi kālaḥ kaliyugasya tu
verses.translation: Thus the body of the moon developed by the vigour of the sun, appears sparkling, white and perfectly circular on the full Moon day.
verses.hindi: थे । उस महान आत्मा वाले परशुराम का दशेन करके उन दोनों ने बड़े ही आनन्द कें साथ आपस में बातचीत को थी ।२४। मृगी ने मृग से कहा-है कान्त ! हम दोनों यहाँ पर स्थित रहेंगे जब तक यह परशुराम यहाँ पर संस्थित रहते हैं । इस वीर. के समीप में हम दोनों को कोई भय नहीं होगा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the body of the moon developed by the vigour of the sun, appears sparkling, white and perfectly circular on the full Moon day.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the body of the moon developed by the vigour of the sun, appears sparkling, white and perfectly circular on the full Moon day.

verses.sanskrit: एवं चतुर्युगे काल ऋतैः संध्यांशकैः स्मृतः । नियुतान्येव षडिंशान्निरसानि युगानि वै
verses.transliteration: evaṃ caturyuge kāla ṛtaiḥ saṃdhyāṃśakaiḥ smṛtaḥ / niyutānyeva ṣaḍiṃśānnirasāni yugāni vai
verses.translation: Vida cb. XXIV, W. 67-68.
verses.hindi: ।२५। यदि यहाँ पर भी व्याश्ष आकर रूप दोनों पर प्रह्दौर करेगा तो इस मुनि के द्वारा केबल देखने ही से वह भस्मीसूत है जप्या !२६। परशुराम के दर्शेन करने से परम संस्तुष्ट-भुगी के द्वारा इस प्रकार सेयह वचन कहने पर बह मृग भी बढ़ेःही-हुफ-से समाविष्ट द्वोकर अपनी शिया हे. बोखा था
verses.wordMeaning: Vida cb. XXIV, W. 67-68.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vida cb. XXIV, W. 67-68.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत्तथा त्रीणि नियुता नीह संख्यया । विंशतिश्च सहस्राणि स संध्यांशश्चतुर्युगः
verses.transliteration: catvāriṃśattathā trīṇi niyutā nīha saṃkhyayā / viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi sa saṃdhyāṃśaścaturyugaḥ
verses.translation: Just as there are knotty joints in the Sugarcane and bamboo, so also there are dark and bright Parvans in the lunar fortnights.
verses.hindi: ।२७। है महाभागे ! यह बात तो इसी प्रकार की है। है भाभिनि ! आप यह बात निश्चित ही कह रहीं है। में भी परम भहाव आत्मा वाले राम के प्रभाव को अच्छी-तरह से जानतः हैं रा
verses.wordMeaning: Just as there are knotty joints in the Sugarcane and bamboo, so also there are dark and bright Parvans in the lunar fortnights.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as there are knotty joints in the Sugarcane and bamboo, so also there are dark and bright Parvans in the lunar fortnights.

verses.sanskrit: एवं चतुर्युगाख्यानां साधिका ह्येकसप्ततिः । कृतत्रेतादियुक्तानां मनोरन्तरमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ caturyugākhyānāṃ sādhikā hyekasaptatiḥ / kṛtatretādiyuktānāṃ manorantaramucyate
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरस्य संख्यां तु वर्षाग्रेण निबोधत । त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तु वर्षाणां मानुषेण प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: manvantarasya saṃkhyāṃ tu varṣāgreṇa nibodhata / triṃśatkoṭyastu varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣeṇa prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त षष्टिस्तथान्यानि नियुतान्यधिकानि तु । विशतिश्च सहस्राणि कालो ऽयं साधिकं विना
verses.transliteration: sapta ṣaṣṭistathānyāni niyutānyadhikāni tu / viśatiśca sahasrāṇi kālo 'yaṃ sādhikaṃ vinā
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरस्य संख्यैषा संख्या विद्भिर्द्विजैः स्मृता । मन्वन्तरस्य कालो ऽयं युगैः सार्द्धं च कीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: manvantarasya saṃkhyaiṣā saṃkhyā vidbhirdvijaiḥ smṛtā / manvantarasya kālo 'yaṃ yugaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca kīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: स ब्रह्मा दिष्टवांश्चैनं शिवलोकं व्रजेति ह ।
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: चतुः साहस्रयुक्तं वै प्राकृतं तत्कृतं युगम् । त्रेताशिष्टं प्रवक्ष्यामि द्वापरं कलिमेव च
verses.transliteration: catuḥ sāhasrayuktaṃ vai prākṛtaṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam / tretāśiṣṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi dvāparaṃ kalimeva ca
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: युगपत्समयेनार्थो द्विधा वक्तुं न शक्यते । क्रमागतं मया ह्येतत्तुभ्यं नोक्त युग द्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yugapatsamayenārtho dvidhā vaktuṃ na śakyate / kramāgataṃ mayā hyetattubhyaṃ nokta yuga dvayam
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: जो इस महापुरुष के समीप में अकृतद्रण नाम वाला एक शिष्य दिखाई दे रहा है उसको इसी महापुरुष ले ही व्याघ्र के भय से.)जब यह आतुर हो गया तो इसकी व्याघ् से सुरक्षा की थी ।२६। है महाभागे ! यह राम है जो जमदब्नि मुनि का पुत्र है। इसने ही अपने पिता को राजा
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिवंशप्रसंगेन व्याकुलत्वात्तथैव च । अत्र त्रेतायुगस्यादौ मनुः सप्तर्षयश्च ये
verses.transliteration: ṛṣivaṃśaprasaṃgena vyākulatvāttathaiva ca / atra tretāyugasyādau manuḥ saptarṣayaśca ye
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: कातवीर्य के द्वारा निराकृत किया हुआ देखा था और उस समय में इसने अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध होकर नृपों के विघात करने की'प्रतिज्ञा की थी जौर उस प्रतिज्ञा की पूत्ति की, कामना वाला यह पहिले ब्रह्म लोक में! गया था ।३०- ३१। वहाँ पर इसको यह निर्देश किया था कि यह शिवलोक में चला जावे ।
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: श्रौत स्मार्त्त च ते धर्म ब्रह्मणानुप्रचौदितम् । दाराग्निहोत्रसंबन्धमृग्यजुः सामसंहितम्
verses.transliteration: śrauta smārtta ca te dharma brahmaṇānupracauditam / dārāgnihotrasaṃbandhamṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃhitam
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: उन ब्रह्माजी की आज्ञा को प्राप्त करके फिर यह राम भगवान् शिव की सम्निधि में प्राप्त करके फिर यह राम भगवान् शिव की सन्निधि में प्राप्त हुआ ।३२। ओर वहाँ पर इसने भगवान् शम्भु के समझ राज को, पिता का और अपता सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्त निवेदित किया था । वे महाहैवःबहुत ही कृपालु
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिलक्षणं श्रौतं धर्म सप्तर्षयो ऽब्रुवन् । परंपरागतं धर्म स्मार्त्तं चाचारलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: ityādilakṣaṇaṃ śrautaṃ dharma saptarṣayo 'bruvan / paraṃparāgataṃ dharma smārttaṃ cācāralakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: थे उम्होने इस छृुनन्दन का स्वागत किया था।३३। फिर उन शबर अफ ने कृष्ण का एक उत्तम मन्त्र और न भेदन करने के योग्य एक कवच इसको
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाचारयुतं मनुः स्वायंभुवो ऽब्रवीत् । सत्येन ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रुतेन तपसा च वै
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramācārayutaṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo 'bravīt / satyena brahmacaryeṇa śrutena tapasā ca vai
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु तप्ततपसा आर्षेणोपक्रमेण तु । सप्तर्षीणां मनोश्चैव ह्याद्ये त्रेतायुगे तथा
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu taptatapasā ārṣeṇopakrameṇa tu / saptarṣīṇāṃ manoścaiva hyādye tretāyuge tathā
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: अदान कर दिया था तथा-अपना पाशुपत अस्त्र और अन्यान्य: बहुत से अस्त्रों का समुदाय इसको प्रदान किये ये ।३४। बड़े आदर के साथ प्रीति से इन सब शस्त्रास्‍्त्रों को प्रदात करके भगवान् जिव ने वहाँ से विदा किया था । है भद्रे ! बही राम इस समय में मन्त्रों कीं साधना में तत्पर होता
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: अबुद्धिपूर्वकं तेषामक्रियापूर्वमेव च । अभिव्यक्तास्तु ते मन्त्रास्तारकाद्यैर्निदर्शनैः
verses.transliteration: abuddhipūrvakaṃ teṣāmakriyāpūrvameva ca / abhivyaktāstu te mantrāstārakādyairnidarśanaiḥ
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: हुआ यहाँ पर समागत हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.transliteration: āraṃbhayajñāḥ kṣatrāśca haviryajñā viśastathā / paricārayajñāḥ śūdrāstu japayajñā dvijottamāḥ

verses.hindi: सुधी. यहः धर्मात्मा परशुराम नित्य ही भगवाद् श्रीकृष्ण के कवच का यहाँ पर जप कर रहा है । इस महात्मा को-जाप करते'हुए एक सौ वर्ष तो श्यतीत-हो-गये हैं 4३६ है भद्े-! यह मन्त्र की साना तो कर रहा है किन्तु

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रमुदिता वर्णास्त्रेतायां धर्मपालिताः । क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तः समृद्धाः सुखिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tadā pramuditā varṇāstretāyāṃ dharmapālitāḥ / kriyāvantaḥ prajāvantaḥ samṛddhāḥ sukhinastathā

verses.hindi: इसको उसकी सिद्धि नहीं हों रही है । इस साधना में मुख्य कारण भक्ति ही होता है। वह भक्ति तीन प्रकार की होती है, ऐसा माना गया है ।३७। है चञ्चल नेत्रो बाली प्रिये ! उस भक्ति के उत्तम-मध्यम और कनि'्त-ये तीन भेद हुआ करते हैं। अब यह बतलाता हूँ कि उत्तमा भक्ति किन-किन
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाननुर्त्तन्ते क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियान्विशः । वैश्यानुवर्त्तिनः शुद्राः परस्परमनुव्रताः

verses.hindi: महापुरुषों में विद्यमान. है--मगवान्'शिव-देयधि नारद-महात्मा शुकदेव- राजधि अम्बरीष-राजा रन्तिदेव-पवनसुत हनुमानू-राजा बलि-दानव विभी- षण और महात्मा प्रहलाद-इन में परमोत्तमा भक्ति होती है।३०-३९। अज की गोपियों में और उद्धव में भी उत्तम प्रकार की ही भक्ति विद्यमान है!।

verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare devairyajñastaiḥ prākpravarttitaḥ / satyaṃ japastapo dānaṃ tretāyā dharma ucyate

verses.hindi: ही से समुत्पन्न हो गया है । यह भाग॑ंव महान् पुष्यात्मा हैं और यह भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण के परम भक्त तथा अपनी इन्द्रियों को जीत लेने वाले हैं ।४४। हे भाभिनि ! यह राम अपने गुरु की शुश्रूषा करने वाले हैं और प्रतिदिन नित्य कर्मों तथा नैमित्तिक कर्मों में बड़ा आदर करने वाले हैं। इसलिए

verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: तदा धर्म्मसहस्रान्ते ऽहिंसाधर्मः प्रवर्त्तते । जायन्ते च तदा शूरा आयुष्मन्तो महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: tadā dharmmasahasrānte 'hiṃsādharmaḥ pravarttate / jāyante ca tadā śūrā āyuṣmanto mahābalāḥ

verses.hindi: आज हीं इस महापुरुष के दर्शन से मेरे-हृदय में यह अद्भुत ज्ञान समुत्पल्त हो गया है ।४६। यह मेरा ज्ञान ऐसा है जो इस त्रिभुवन में संस्थित जीव हैं उन सबके शुभ और अशुभ कर्मों को बता देने वाला है और आज ही मुझे महास्माःइस परशुराम का भी पूर्ण चरितः विदित हो गया' है।४७। इसका
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: व्यस्तदण्डा महाभागा धर्मिष्ठा ब्रह्मवादिनः । पद्मपत्रायताक्षाश्च पृथूरस्काः सुसंहताः
verses.transliteration: vyastadaṇḍā mahābhāgā dharmiṣṭhā brahmavādinaḥ / padmapatrāyatākṣāśca pṛthūraskāḥ susaṃhatāḥ

verses.hindi: चरित बहुत'ही'पुण्य का देने वाला है और समस्त पापों,का विनाशक है । अब तुम इसका श्रवण करो । यह राम भविष्य में जो-जो भी कर्म करेंगे बहू भी सब मेरे ज्ञान का गोचर हो रहा है अर्थात् मुझे सब ज्ञात हो गया है ।४८। मैंने जो आपके सामने उत्तमं प्रकार कीः भक्ति का वर्णन किया था

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्मा न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डलाः । न्यग्रोधौ तु स्मृतौ बाहू व्यामो न्यग्रोध उच्यते

verses.sanskrit: व्यामे नैवोछ्रयो यस्य सम ऊर्द्धं तु देहिनः । समोछ्रयपरीणाहो ज्ञेयो न्यग्रोधमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: vyāme naivochrayo yasya sama ūrddhaṃ tu dehinaḥ / samochrayaparīṇāho jñeyo nyagrodhamaṇḍalaḥ

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं रथो मणिर्भार्या निधिरश्वो गजस्तथा । सप्तैतानि च रत्नानि सर्वेषां चक्रवर्तिनाम
verses.transliteration: cakraṃ ratho maṇirbhāryā nidhiraśvo gajastathā / saptaitāni ca ratnāni sarveṣāṃ cakravartināma

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं रथो मणिः खड्गश्चर्मरत्नं च पञ्चमम् । केतुर्निधिश्च सप्तैव प्राणहीनानि चक्षते

verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: ततः संसिद्धकवचो -राजानं हैहयाधिपम् त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो निभूं पां करिष्यत्यवनीं प्रिये ॥५४'

verses.sanskrit: रत्नान्येतानि दिव्यानि संसिद्धानि महात्मनाम् । चतुर्दश विधेयानि सर्वेषां चक्रवर्त्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ratnānyetāni divyāni saṃsiddhāni mahātmanām / caturdaśa vidheyāni sarveṣāṃ cakravarttinām

verses.hindi: यदि यह भागव परशुराम है भद्दे ! अगस्त्य मुनि की.कृपा को प्राप्त कर लेवे तो इसको सिद्धि हो सकती है । अगस्त्य मुनि उत्तम भक्ति के देने बाले कष्ण प्रेमामृत नाम का स्तोत्र जानते हैं ।५०। उन महामुनि की कृपा से यदि उस स्तोत्र का ज्ञान प्राप्त कर लेवे तो उसको जानकर यह मन्त्र की और कवच की सिद्धि को प्राप्त कर; लेगा  वह अगस्त्य मुनि, तो तत्त्वों के अर्थ को जाने हुए हैं और बे बहुत ही दयालु तथा अभय के प्रदान करने बाले हैं ।५१। वे मुनि उस आनन्द-प्रद तत्त्व ज्ञान का इस राम के लिये उप- देश कर देंगे क्योंकि भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण का सम्पूर्ण चरित उनके सुनामों से ही
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरंशेन जायन्ते पृथिव्यां चक्रवर्त्तिनः । मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह

verses.hindi: इस मोदिनी. को निश्चित रूप से इककीस बार क्षत्रिय राजाओं से रहित. कर देगा--इसमें कुछ भी संशय नहीं है। श्री बसिष्ठजी ने कहा-इतना यह् सब अपनी प्रिया मुंगी से कहकर है राजन् ! फिर बह मूग शान्त हो गया था और उसने मूग होने के भाग के कारण को भी उस समय में जान लिया. मुने परमतत्त्वज्ञ ध्यानज्ञानार्थंकोविद।
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: भद्राणीमानि तेषां वै भवन्तीह महीक्षिताम् । अत्यद्भुतानि चत्वारि बलं धर्मः सुखं धनम्

verses.hindi: रहे हैं। उस मुंगी ने अपने स्वामी मूंग के मुख से भार्गव परशुराम का. सम्पूर्ण बिनेष्टित अकण करके तथा भूत-बत्त॑मान और भविष्य में होने वाले रामायण की कथा से संमन्वित बुत कां सरवण करके है नाथ ! उसने पुनः क्या पूछा था--यह पूणं बिस्तार के सहित हमारे सामने बर्णन करने की कृपा कीजिए । १-३ वसिछ्तजी ने कहा -हे राजन् ! मैं आपके आगे उस मृग का जो महान ' चरिंत है उसे भली भाँति बतलाऊगा । आप उसका श्रवण कीजिए । जिस प्रकार से जो भी उस मृगी ने उस मृग से पूछा या उस सबको तत्त्ों के ज्ञाता उसने उस मृगी के समक्ष में वणेन कर दिया था

verses.sanskrit: आजानुबाहवस्छैव तदाम्रहस्ताः कटौ कृशाः । न्यग्रोधपरिणाहाश्च सिंहस्कन्धास्तु मेहनाः
verses.transliteration: ājānubāhavaschaiva tadāmrahastāḥ kaṭau kṛśāḥ / nyagrodhapariṇāhāśca siṃhaskandhāstu mehanāḥ
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: पशुराम का अगस्त्याश्रम में आगमन   २६७ कृतां हैं-- इसमें लेशमात्र भी संशय नहों है कि आज इन परशुराम के दर्शन करने से आपको ऐसा ज्ञान उत्पन्न हो गया है जो इन्द्रियों की पहुँच. से भी दूर है।६ा इसीलिए इसके पश्चात् अपनी आत्मा का सम्पूर्ण कारण मुझे भी क्पा करके बतलाइए। है प्रभो ! ऐसा वह कया कर्म हमने किया

verses.sanskrit: गजेद्रगतयश्चैव महाहनव एव च । पादयोश्चक्रमत्स्योन्तु शङ्खपद्मौ तुहस्तयोः
verses.transliteration: gajedragatayaścaiva mahāhanava eva ca / pādayoścakramatsyontu śaṅkhapadmau tuhastayoḥ
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: था जिसके कारण से हम दोनों ले यह पशु की तियंग् योनि परापत की है

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशीतिसहस्राणि ते राजन्त्यजरा नृपाः । असंगगतयस्तेषां चतस्रश्चक्रवर्त्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: pañcāśītisahasrāṇi te rājantyajarā nṛpāḥ / asaṃgagatayasteṣāṃ catasraścakravarttinām
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: इति वाक्यं समाकार्ष्य प्रियाया:स मृगः स्वयम् । संसारेऽस्मिन्महा भागे भावोऽय भवकारणम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षे समुद्रि च पाताले पर्वतेषु च । इज्या दानं तपः सत्यं त्रेतायां धर्म उच्यते
verses.transliteration: antarikṣe samudri ca pātāle parvateṣu ca / ijyā dānaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ tretāyāṃ dharma ucyate
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
