verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रवर्त्तते धर्मो वर्णाश्रमविभागशः । मर्यादास्थापनार्थं च दण्डनीतिः प्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: tadā pravarttate dharmo varṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ / maryādāsthāpanārthaṃ ca daṇḍanītiḥ pravarttate
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठो रामोऽनुजस्तस्य धर्मस्तस्यानुजः पृथुः वेदान ध्यापयामास सांगांश्च सरहस्यकाच् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: त्दृष्टपुष्टाः प्रजाः सर्वा अरोगाः पूर्णमानसाः । एको वेदश्चतुष्पादस्त्रेतायुगविधौस्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tdṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ prajāḥ sarvā arogāḥ pūrṇamānasāḥ / eko vedaścatuṣpādastretāyugavidhausmṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: उस मृग ने इस अपनी प्रिया के वाक्य का श्रवण करके स्वयं ही उस समय में अपना और अपनी प्रिया मुशी का चरित वर्णन किया था ।०। मुग ने कहा--हे महाभाग बाली प्रिये! अब आप सुनिए कि जिस प्रकार से हम तुम दोनों उस मृग की जाति में देह धारण करने वाले हुए हैं । है महां-
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि तदा जीवन्ति मानवाः । पुत्रपौत्रसमाकीर्णा म्रियन्ते च क्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi tadā jīvanti mānavāḥ / putrapautrasamākīrṇā mriyante ca krameṇa tu
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: भागे ! “इस संसार में इस भवं अर्थात् जन्म के ग्रहण करने का कारण एक मात्र भाव ही हुआ करता हैं। तात्पर्ये यह है कि जैसी भावना जिसकी होगी वह 'वेसा ही उसके अनुरूप जन्म धारण किया शरता है।६। जो भीं जीव के सदू और अनतु कमं होते हैं उनसे ही यह स्मृति को प्राप्त होता है। रष्क  ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: एष त्रेतायुगे धर्मस्त्रेतासंध्यां निबोधत । त्रेतायुगस्वभावानां संध्या पादेन वर्त्तते । संध्यापादः स्वभावस्तु स्ॐऽशपदेन तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: eṣa tretāyuge dharmastretāsaṃdhyāṃ nibodhata / tretāyugasvabhāvānāṃ saṃdhyā pādena varttate / saṃdhyāpādaḥ svabhāvastu soṃ'śapadena tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.hindi: बहुत वहिले अनेक प्रकार की ऋड्धियों से पूर्ण द्रविड़ देश में कौ शिके गोश कॉले ब्राह्मणों के कुल'मे मैंने जन्म ग्रहण किया था । मेरे पिता नाम से शिव दत्त हुये जो कि शास्त्रों के अच्छे विद्वान् थे १०-११ उन शिवदत्त नॉम- घारी विप्र के परम श्रेष्ठ द्विज हम चार पुत्र समुत्पन्न हुए थे। सबमें बड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences between the full Moon and the New Moon arc the knots and joints. Tlie lunar days beginning with Dvitiyi constituting the fortnight arc the Parvans.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे संख्यावर्त्तो नामैकोनत्रिशत्तमो ऽध्यायः शांशापायनिरुवाच कथं त्रेतायुगमुखे यज्ञस्य स्यात्प्रवर्त्तनम् । पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे सर्गे यथावत्तच्च ब्रूहि मे
verses.transliteration: iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde saṃkhyāvartto nāmaikonatriśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ śāṃśāpāyaniruvāca kathaṃ tretāyugamukhe yajñasya syātpravarttanam / pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve sarge yathāvattacca brūhi me
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me. (They started the YajAa) alongwith all the gods and with all the requisites gathered together. The great sages came to his horse-sacrifice which was being lavishly performed.
verses.hindi: राम था, उससे छोटा भाई घम था और उससे भी छोटा भाई पुथु-नाम बाला हुआ था ।१२। है प्रियेः! चौथा भाई मैं उत्पन्‍्त हुआ था जो सूरि-- इस नाम से प्रसिद्ध था । महा ,यशरवी उस शिवदत्त ने क्रम से सबका उप- नयन संस्कार करा दिया था ।१३। ओर फिर उसने हम सबको रहस्य के सहित तथा समस्त वेद के अङ्ग शास्त्रों के साथ वेदों कां अध्यापत किया था अर्थात् साङ्ग सम्पूर्णं वेदों को पढ़ाया था
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me. (They started the YajAa) alongwith all the gods and with all the requisites gathered together.…
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me. (They started the YajAa) alongwith all the gods and with all the requisites gathered together.…

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हितायां संध्यायां सार्द्धं कृतयुगेन वै । कालाख्यायां प्रवृत्तायां प्राप्ते त्रेतायुगे तदा
verses.transliteration: antarhitāyāṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ sārddhaṃ kṛtayugena vai / kālākhyāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ prāpte tretāyuge tadā
verses.translation: This bhighly unrighteous and sinful. It (this sacri¬ fice) has been spread (performed) with a desire for rites involv¬ ing violence to life). In your Yajfla, O excellent god, the killing of animals is involved. An evil thing has been started for the destruction of Dharma on account of this injury to the animals. This is not Dharma; it is Adharma (sin). Violence is not called as Dharma (Righteous).
verses.wordMeaning: This bhighly unrighteous and sinful. It (this sacri¬ fice) has been spread (performed) with a desire for rites involv¬ ing violence to life). In your Yajfla, O excellent god, the killing of animals is involved.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This bhighly unrighteous and sinful. It (this sacri¬ fice) has been spread (performed) with a desire for rites involv¬ ing violence to life). In your Yajfla, O excellent god, the killing of animals is involved.…

verses.sanskrit: औषधीषु च जातासु प्रवृत्ते वृष्टिसर्जने । प्रतिष्ठितायां वार्त्तायां गृहाश्रमपरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: auṣadhīṣu ca jātāsu pravṛtte vṛṣṭisarjane / pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ vārttāyāṃ gṛhāśramapare punaḥ
verses.translation: If your honour wishes to perform the Yajfta in accordance with the scriptures, perform the Yajfta by means of Dharma that does not in fringe established institutions. Per¬ form the Yajfta according to the injunctions laid down (in scriptures). Then a great argument took place between Indra and the great sages—** By what means should the Yajfta be performed—by mobile (living) beings or immobile articles?*'
verses.hindi: गत्वाऽरण्यं 'फलान्यं्रुसमित्करुशम्रृदोऽन्वहम् एकदा तु; बयं-सेर्वे संप्राप्ता पवते वने
verses.wordMeaning: If your honour wishes to perform the Yajfta in accordance with the scriptures, perform the Yajfta by means of Dharma that does not in fringe established institutions. Per¬ form the Yajfta according to the injunctions laid down (in scriptures).…
verses.commentary: Sense: If your honour wishes to perform the Yajfta in accordance with the scriptures, perform the Yajfta by means of Dharma that does not in fringe established institutions. Per¬ form the Yajfta according to the injunctions laid down (in scriptures).…

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थानं कृतवन्तश्च संख्यया । संभारांस्तांस्तु मंभृत्य कथं यज्ञः प्रवर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ kṛtavantaśca saṃkhyayā / saṃbhārāṃstāṃstu maṃbhṛtya kathaṃ yajñaḥ pravarttitaḥ
verses.translation: After stating the principle the great sages became dejected on account of the argument. After coming to terms with Indra, they asked Vasu who was movii about in the firmament. "O king of great intellect, how (what) is the proce¬ dure for Yajfta found out by you. O lord, son of Uttnapada explain and dispel our doubts'*.
verses.wordMeaning: After stating the principle the great sages became dejected on account of the argument. After coming to terms with Indra, they asked Vasu who was movii about in the firmament. "O king of great intellect, how (what) is the proce¬ dure for Yajfta found out by you. O lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After stating the principle the great sages became dejected on account of the argument. After coming to terms with Indra, they asked Vasu who was movii about in the firmament. "O king of great intellect, how (what) is the proce¬ dure for Yajfta found out by you. O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छुत्वाब्रवीत्सूतः श्रूयतां शांशपायने । यथा त्रेतायुगमुखे यज्ञस्य स्यात्प्रवर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: etacchutvābravītsūtaḥ śrūyatāṃ śāṃśapāyane / yathā tretāyugamukhe yajñasya syātpravartanam
verses.translation: On hearing their words, Vasu, without considering the pros and cons recollected the Vedas and Scriptural texts. W. 16-21 record the Brahnumtcal protest animt toimal-sacn- fices. They state that the seeds which are 3 yeari old and incisable of gennination should be used initead of animab io sacrifice.
verses.hindi: सरलाजुं नपूगैश्च' खजू रैनारिकेलके: । जंबूभिः सहकारेश्च कटुफलैवृं हतीदुमैः १६.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words, Vasu, without considering the pros and cons recollected the Vedas and Scriptural texts. W. 16-21 record the Brahnumtcal protest animt toimal-sacn- fices.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, Vasu, without considering the pros and cons recollected the Vedas and Scriptural texts. W. 16-21 record the Brahnumtcal protest animt toimal-sacn- fices.…

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे सर्गे तद्वक्ष्याम्यानुपूर्व्यतः । अन्तर्हितायां संध्यायां सार्द्धं कृतयुगेन तु
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve sarge tadvakṣyāmyānupūrvyataḥ / antarhitāyāṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ sārddhaṃ kṛtayugena tu
verses.translation: "Sacrifice should be performed with whatever is duly brought*' said the king. Sacrifice should be performed by means of animals worthy of being sacrificed or by means of seeds and fruits. After being answered to in this manner, those saints with souls united with Brahman of unified.souls, realized the inevitability and hence restrained their speech.
verses.wordMeaning: "Sacrifice should be performed with whatever is duly brought*' said the king. Sacrifice should be performed by means of animals worthy of being sacrificed or by means of seeds and fruits. After being answered to in this manner,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Sacrifice should be performed with whatever is duly brought*' said the king. Sacrifice should be performed by means of animals worthy of being sacrificed or by means of seeds and fruits. After being answered to in this manner,…

verses.sanskrit: कालाख्यायां प्रवृत्तायां प्रप्ते त्रेतायुगे तदा । औषधीषु च जातासु प्रवृत्ते वृष्टिसर्जने
verses.transliteration: kālākhyāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ prapte tretāyuge tadā / auṣadhīṣu ca jātāsu pravṛtte vṛṣṭisarjane
verses.translation: Immediately after saying this, the king entered Rasatala (nether worlds). After being a traverser of the upper regions Vasu (now) came to be a traverser of the nether- worlds.* By means of that statement he had been a resident of the (nether) surface of the world. King Vasu who tried to dispel doubts in regard to Dharma, went down.
verses.hindi: गजेंद्र: -शर्भाद्येश्व सेवितं कन्द रागतः हम सभी-भाई गुरु की शुभा में निरत रहा करते ये ओर बहुत हो ज्ञानः में, परायण हो गये थे । प्रतिदिने वन में जाकर फल--जल-समिधा- कुशा और मृतिका. लाया करते थे ।१५। ये सब वस्तुएँ वन से लाकर अपने पिता को: विद्या करते थे और फिर इसके अनन्तर अपना अध्ययन ही किया
verses.wordMeaning: Immediately after saying this, the king entered Rasatala (nether worlds). After being a traverser of the upper regions Vasu (now) came to be a traverser of the nether- worlds.* By means of that statement he had been a resident of the (nether) surface of the world.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately after saying this, the king entered Rasatala (nether worlds). After being a traverser of the upper regions Vasu (now) came to be a traverser of the nether- worlds.* By means of that statement he had been a resident of the (nether) surface of the world.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठितायां वार्त्तायां गृहश्रमपरेषु च । वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थानं कृत्वा मन्त्रांस्तु संहतान्
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ vārttāyāṃ gṛhaśramapareṣu ca / varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ kṛtvā mantrāṃstu saṃhatān
verses.translation: Hence, even though one may be conversant with many things, one should not express anything by way of clari¬ fication of doubts when alone and single-handed. Dharma has many an opening. Its way is subtle and it goes a long way. Hence, nothing definite can be stated by anyone in the matter of Dharma including the Devas and the sages but excepting Svayambhuva Manu.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, even though one may be conversant with many things, one should not express anything by way of clari¬ fication of doubts when alone and single-handed. Dharma has many an opening. Its way is subtle and it goes a long way. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, even though one may be conversant with many things, one should not express anything by way of clari¬ fication of doubts when alone and single-handed. Dharma has many an opening. Its way is subtle and it goes a long way. Hence,…

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रांस्तान्योजयित्वाथ इहामुत्र च कर्मसु । तदा विश्वभुगिन्द्रश्च यज्ञं प्रावर्त्तयत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: mantrāṃstānyojayitvātha ihāmutra ca karmasu / tadā viśvabhugindraśca yajñaṃ prāvarttayatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Hence, nonviolence has been declared by great sages Hence, Yajfta does not follow it (penance) anywhere. This (world) is regarded as based on penance.
verses.hindi: करते थे। एक बार ऐसा हुआ'या' कि हम सब बन में पर्वंत पर पहुँच गये ।१६। है चङचल नेरों वाली ! कृतमाला. नदी के तट पर ओढुभि नाम बाला वहाँ स्थित था । हम सबने प्रात:काल की वेला में उसी नदी में स्नान देव को अर्ध्यं दियां था और जाप करके हम सब उस उत्तम पयंत पर सका- रूढ़ हो गये ये। अब वहां की वृणावली की प्राकृतिक छटा का वर्णन किया जाता है--कह स्थल ऐसा अत्यधिक रमणीय था कि वहाँ पर शाल-तमाल- प्रियक-पनस-को विदा र-सरल-अजु न-पूग-खंजूर-नारिकेल-जम्बू-स हका र-कंटू'
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, nonviolence has been declared by great sages Hence, Yajfta does not follow it (penance) anywhere. This (world) is regarded as based on penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, nonviolence has been declared by great sages Hence, Yajfta does not follow it (penance) anywhere. This (world) is regarded as based on penance.

verses.sanskrit: दैवतैः सहितैः सर्वैः सर्वसंभारसंभृतैः । तस्याश्वमेधे वितते समाजग्मुर्महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: daivataiḥ sahitaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaiḥ / tasyāśvamedhe vitate samājagmurmaharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: One attains the Devas by means of Yajfta and Vairaja by means of penance. Brahmin!cal holy rites (are achieved) by means of renunciation and the victory over Frakrti through Vairagya (absence of passionate attachment). W. 35-48 establish the superionty of Jftina nirga over Karma- mSrga, including animal aacriftcet.
verses.hindi: फल और् बृहती के वृक्ष लगे थे ।१८-१६। इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य भी वहाँ पर अनेक प्रकार के तरुवर थे जो दूसरों के अर्थ का प्रतिपादन करने बाले थे । अर्थात्, पुष्प-फलादि से द्वारा दूसरे जीवों का उपकार करने वाले ये  उन वृक्षों की छाया बहुत ही घनी थी और उन पर दूर-दूर से पक्षी गण उन
verses.wordMeaning: One attains the Devas by means of Yajfta and Vairaja by means of penance. Brahmin!cal holy rites (are achieved) by means of renunciation and the victory over Frakrti through Vairagya (absence of passionate attachment). W.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One attains the Devas by means of Yajfta and Vairaja by means of penance. Brahmin!cal holy rites (are achieved) by means of renunciation and the victory over Frakrti through Vairagya (absence of passionate attachment). W.…

verses.sanskrit: यजन्तं पशुभिर्मे ध्यैरूचुः सर्वे समागताः । कर्मव्यग्रेषु ऋत्विक्षु संतते यज्ञकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: yajantaṃ paśubhirme dhyairūcuḥ sarve samāgatāḥ / karmavyagreṣu ṛtvikṣu saṃtate yajñakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Henerforth) I shall recount the position of the Dva* para Age once again When Treta Yuga passes by» Dvapara Sets in. The Siddhi that the subjects had in the Treta Yuga becomes defunct along with the subjects, when Treta Yuga elapses at the beginning of Dvapara.
verses.hindi: पर समाबृष्ट हौकर अपना कलख कर रहे थे ।२०। उस पबंतीय महारण्प में विविध प्रकार के वन्य हिस्र जीव भी भ्रमण कर रहेथे। शादू'ल-भल्ल- कन्वरा में निबास करते हुए उसका सेबन कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Henerforth) I shall recount the position of the Dva* para Age once again When Treta Yuga passes by» Dvapara Sets in. The Siddhi that the subjects had in the Treta Yuga becomes defunct along with the subjects, when Treta Yuga elapses at the beginning of Dvapara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henerforth) I shall recount the position of the Dva* para Age once again When Treta Yuga passes by» Dvapara Sets in. The Siddhi that the subjects had in the Treta Yuga becomes defunct along with the subjects, when Treta Yuga elapses at the beginning of Dvapara.

verses.sanskrit: संप्रगीथेषु सर्वेषु सामगेष्वथ सुस्वग्म् । परिक्रान्तेषु लघुषु ह्यध्वर्युवृषभेषु च
verses.transliteration: saṃpragītheṣu sarveṣu sāmageṣvatha susvagm / parikrānteṣu laghuṣu hyadhvaryuvṛṣabheṣu ca
verses.translation: In Dvapara the mixture and combination of the castes begins to take place among the subjects. All activities are affected adversely (and get inverted).
verses.wordMeaning: In Dvapara the mixture and combination of the castes begins to take place among the subjects. All activities are affected adversely (and get inverted).
verses.commentary: Sense: In Dvapara the mixture and combination of the castes begins to take place among the subjects. All activities are affected adversely (and get inverted).

verses.sanskrit: आलब्धेषु च मेध्येषु तथा पशुगणेषु च । हविष्यग्नौ हूयमाने ब्राह्मणैश्चाग्निहोत्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: ālabdheṣu ca medhyeṣu tathā paśugaṇeṣu ca / haviṣyagnau hūyamāne brāhmaṇaiścāgnihotribhiḥ
verses.translation: The Dharma that had been in existence in the first Krta Yuga continues to function in Treta Yuga. After becoming agitated and intensely affected in Dvapara, it becomes extinct in the Kali Yuga. This chapter depicts the state of the society, religioa, religioiis texts etc. in the DvSpara Age. The deterioration and confusion of social, religious other conditions provide a back*ground to the Chaos in the Kali Age.
verses.wordMeaning: The Dharma that had been in existence in the first Krta Yuga continues to function in Treta Yuga. After becoming agitated and intensely affected in Dvapara, it becomes extinct in the Kali Yuga. This chapter depicts the state of the society, religioa, religioiis texts etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Dharma that had been in existence in the first Krta Yuga continues to function in Treta Yuga. After becoming agitated and intensely affected in Dvapara, it becomes extinct in the Kali Yuga. This chapter depicts the state of the society, religioa, religioiis texts etc.…

verses.sanskrit: आहूतेषु च सर्वेषु यज्ञभाक्षु क्रमात्तदा । य इन्द्रियात्मका देवास्तदा ते यज्ञभागिनः
verses.transliteration: āhūteṣu ca sarveṣu yajñabhākṣu kramāttadā / ya indriyātmakā devāstadā te yajñabhāginaḥ
verses.translation: Owing to the difference between Sruti and Smrti no definite conclusion can be arrived at. Because of the absence of definiteness, there is no (clear-cut) principle of Dharma.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्तंतरे चेका मृगी ह्यागात्पिपासिता । निर्झरापात शिरसि पातुकामा जलं प्रिये २६ तस्याः पिबंत्यास्तु जलं शादूं लोऽति्यंकरः ।;
verses.wordMeaning: Owing to the difference between Sruti and Smrti no definite conclusion can be arrived at. Because of the absence of definiteness, there is no (clear-cut) principle of Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Owing to the difference between Sruti and Smrti no definite conclusion can be arrived at. Because of the absence of definiteness, there is no (clear-cut) principle of Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: तद्यचन्ते तदा देवान्कल्पादिषु भवन्ति ये । अध्वर्यवः प्रैषकाले व्यत्थिता वै महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: tadyacante tadā devānkalpādiṣu bhavanti ye / adhvaryavaḥ praiṣakāle vyatthitā vai maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmanas, Kalpa-Sutras and Mantra Pravaca* nas (different scriptural texts) and other texts as well have a similar plight. Others follow these but some oppose it and stand apart. They begin to ffmetion in Dvipara Age and recede during the Kali Yuga.
verses.hindi: ३७०   ब्रह्माण्डः पुराण: बहाँ बन में अनेक सुन्दर एवं सुरभित सुमनों वाले द्रुम और लताए भी समुत्पन्न हुए ये. जिनमें कदम्ब-मल्लिका-पाटल-कुन्द-कणिकार आदि थे। इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य भी ऐसे वृक्ष ये जिनके पराग वायु से उड़ रहा था और बह बन सुगर्घित. उन गुल्मलता और दुमों से समाकीर्णं था
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanas, Kalpa-Sutras and Mantra Pravaca* nas (different scriptural texts) and other texts as well have a similar plight. Others follow these but some oppose it and stand apart. They begin to ffmetion in Dvipara Age and recede during the Kali Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmanas, Kalpa-Sutras and Mantra Pravaca* nas (different scriptural texts) and other texts as well have a similar plight. Others follow these but some oppose it and stand apart. They begin to ffmetion in Dvipara Age and recede during the Kali Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: महर्षयस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा दीनान्पशुगणांस्तदा । प्रपच्छुरिद्रं संभूय को ऽयं यज्ञ विधिस्तव
verses.transliteration: maharṣayastu tāndṛṣṭvā dīnānpaśugaṇāṃstadā / prapacchuridraṃ saṃbhūya ko 'yaṃ yajña vidhistava
verses.translation: Effects of these contrary happenings take place in Dvapara—effects such as absence of rain, then death and sickness and other calamities.
verses.hindi: उस पर्बत में अनेक नील-सित-पीत अरुण बणे वाली मणियाँ थीं। उसकी शिखरें इतनी अधिक उच्च थीं कि वे मानों व्योम में पहुँच कुछ उल्लेख कर रही दों । इस तरह ले वह पवत बहुत से कोलुकों से समन्बित था
verses.wordMeaning: Effects of these contrary happenings take place in Dvapara—effects such as absence of rain, then death and sickness and other calamities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Effects of these contrary happenings take place in Dvapara—effects such as absence of rain, then death and sickness and other calamities.

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मो बलवानेष हिंसाधर्मेप्सया ततः । ततः पशुवधश्चैष तव यज्ञे सुरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: adharmo balavāneṣa hiṃsādharmepsayā tataḥ / tataḥ paśuvadhaścaiṣa tava yajñe surottama
verses.translation: On account of miseries verbal, mental and physical, they have despondency and absence of interest in worldly matters. Due to despondency and dcjcctedncss, they begin to ponder over modes of relief from misery. Through the ponderings they attain disintcrcsird-
verses.hindi: यहाँ बहुत ही ऊंचाई से गिरने के कारण घोर गम्भीर ध्वनि बाले अनेक झरने थे । ऐसा प्रतीत हो रहा था मानो कन्दराओं में स्थित ब्यालादि मुगों और पक्षियों की गर्जना से बह संसक्त है ।२४। वहाँ पर अत्यधिक कौतुकों से युक्त बह. स्थल था । मैंने अपनी आत्मा से अपने आपको स्मरण नहीं किया था अर्थात् मैं अपने अको बूम गया था तथा हम सब परस्पर में एक दूसरे से विमुक्त हो गये थे क्योंकि हम सब भाई बहाँ अत्यधिक कोतुकों से हृष्ट हृष्टि वाले हो गयै थे ।२५। इसी बीच में वहाँ पर एक मुंगी बहुत ही प्यासी आ गयी थी । है प्रिये ! वह मृगी जहाँ पर एक झरना गिर रहा था
verses.wordMeaning: On account of miseries verbal, mental and physical, they have despondency and absence of interest in worldly matters. Due to despondency and dcjcctedncss, they begin to ponder over modes of relief from misery. Through the ponderings they attain disintcrcsird-
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of miseries verbal, mental and physical, they have despondency and absence of interest in worldly matters. Due to despondency and dcjcctedncss, they begin to ponder over modes of relief from misery. Through the ponderings they attain disintcrcsird-

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मो धर्मघाताय प्रारब्धः पशुहिसया । नायं धर्मो ह्यधर्मो ऽयं न हिंसा धर्म उच्यते
verses.transliteration: adharmo dharmaghātāya prārabdhaḥ paśuhisayā / nāyaṃ dharmo hyadharmo 'yaṃ na hiṃsā dharma ucyate
verses.translation: To those Ajfldmns (ignorant persons) in the first Svayambhuva Manvantara in the Dvapara Yuga, enemies of the scriptural texts crop up.
verses.hindi: उसके ही णिर में वह् जलपोन करने की इच्छा वाली थी ।२६। वह विचारी जब जल पी रही थी तो बहा पर एक महाल भयङ्कर शादू'ल आ पहुँचा था जो अपनी ही इच्छा से घूमता हुआ आ निकला था ओर उसने भय से पीड़ित उस हिरनी को पकड लिया था।२७। मैंने जब यह देखा कि शादूल
verses.wordMeaning: To those Ajfldmns (ignorant persons) in the first Svayambhuva Manvantara in the Dvapara Yuga, enemies of the scriptural texts crop up.
verses.commentary: Sense: To those Ajfldmns (ignorant persons) in the first Svayambhuva Manvantara in the Dvapara Yuga, enemies of the scriptural texts crop up.

verses.sanskrit: आगमेन भवान्यज्ञं करोतु यदिहेच्छति । विधिदृष्टेन यज्ञेन धर्मेणाव्यपसेतुना
verses.transliteration: āgamena bhavānyajñaṃ karotu yadihecchati / vidhidṛṣṭena yajñena dharmeṇāvyapasetunā
verses.translation: There arc uncertainties and indecisive alternatives in the science of Ayurveda, in the Ahgas (ancillary subjects), in the Jyoti 9 a (Astronomy and Astrology) in the Anliasastra (Economics) and in Hetu-Sastra (Science of dialectics), In the Kali age, the subjects die at various ages Some one dies even as a child in the womb. Another dies in the prime of youth. Some people die as old men while some people die during their childhood.
verses.hindi: ने उसका ग्रहण कर लिया है तो मुझे भी बड़ा भय उत्पन्न हो गया था और मैं वहाँ से भाग दिया'था। उस तरह से भयभीत होकर जब मैं बेतहाशा भागा था तो एक बहुत ही उच्च स्थल से नीचे गिर गया था और डस शार्दूल के द्वारा पकड़ी हुई हिरणी का अनुम्मरण करते हुए गिरते- सा मृता त्वं मृगी जाता मृगस्त्वाहमनुस्म रन् । जातो भद्रो न जाने बै कक गल्ला 'भ्रातरोऽप्रजाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: There arc uncertainties and indecisive alternatives in the science of Ayurveda, in the Ahgas (ancillary subjects), in the Jyoti 9 a (Astronomy and Astrology) in the Anliasastra (Economics) and in Hetu-Sastra (Science of dialectics), In the Kali age,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There arc uncertainties and indecisive alternatives in the science of Ayurveda, in the Ahgas (ancillary subjects), in the Jyoti 9 a (Astronomy and Astrology) in the Anliasastra (Economics) and in Hetu-Sastra (Science of dialectics), In the Kali age,…

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञबीचैः सुरेश्रष्ठ येषु हिंसा न विद्यते । त्रिवर्षं परमं कालमुषितैरप्ररोहिभिः
verses.transliteration: yajñabīcaiḥ sureśraṣṭha yeṣu hiṃsā na vidyate / trivarṣaṃ paramaṃ kālamuṣitairaprarohibhiḥ
verses.translation: Vytsa, * arranger* (of Vedie Mantras into different Saihhitis) is a designation. Every Dvapara has a dlffereot Vy&sa. Puraias mention 29 Vy&sas.
verses.hindi: भूतं भविष्यं च तथा श्रृणु भद्रे वदाम्यहम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Vytsa, * arranger* (of Vedie Mantras into different Saihhitis) is a designation. Every Dvapara has a dlffereot Vy&sa. Puraias mention 29 Vy&sas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vytsa, * arranger* (of Vedie Mantras into different Saihhitis) is a designation. Every Dvapara has a dlffereot Vy&sa. Puraias mention 29 Vy&sas.

verses.sanskrit: एष धर्मो महाप्राज्ञ विरञ्चिविहितः पुरा । एवं विश्वभुगिन्द्रस्तु ऋषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: eṣa dharmo mahāprājña virañcivihitaḥ purā / evaṃ viśvabhugindrastu ṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: Almost all Purai depict a gloomy picture of the Kali Age. Vide Mbh. Ktna ch. 180, 190, Bt. P. chi 229>2$0, Mt. 32-47, Bh.P. Xtl. 1-2, VP. VI. 1. It appears that that was probably the state of the society when these Pur&Qai came to be written, thou unfortunately much of that dea- cripdon applies even today. Vioknee, deception, malicious jealousy, anger, envy and intolerance occur in men in the Kali age. There is passion and greediness everywhere in every creature.
verses.hindi: परशुराम का अगस्त्याअम में आगमन  . २७१ प्राणांस्त्यक्त, वा विधानेन म्वर्गेलोकं गमिष्यति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Almost all Purai depict a gloomy picture of the Kali Age. Vide Mbh. Ktna ch. 180, 190, Bt. P. chi 229>2$0, Mt. 32-47, Bh.P. Xtl. 1-2, VP. VI. 1. It appears that that was probably the state of the society when these Pur&Qai came to be written,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Almost all Purai depict a gloomy picture of the Kali Age. Vide Mbh. Ktna ch. 180, 190, Bt. P. chi 229>2$0, Mt. 32-47, Bh.P. Xtl. 1-2, VP. VI. 1. It appears that that was probably the state of the society when these Pur&Qai came to be written,…

verses.sanskrit: तदा विवादः सुमहानिन्द्रस्यासीन्महर्षिभिः । जङ्गमस्थावरैः कैर्हि यष्टव्यमिति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: tadā vivādaḥ sumahānindrasyāsīnmaharṣibhiḥ / jaṅgamasthāvaraiḥ kairhi yaṣṭavyamiti cocyate
verses.translation: After reaching the Kali Yuga a great excitement is aroused At that time, the maximum age is when a thousand years are completed* (?)
verses.hindi: आवाभ्यां तु जलं पीतं मध्यमे पुष्करे त्विह
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the Kali Yuga a great excitement is aroused At that time, the maximum age is when a thousand years are completed* (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the Kali Yuga a great excitement is aroused At that time, the maximum age is when a thousand years are completed* (?)

verses.sanskrit: ते तु खिन्ना विवादेन तत्त्वमुत्त्वा महर्षयः । सन्धाय वाक्यमिन्द्रेण पप्रच्छुः खेचरं वसुम्
verses.transliteration: te tu khinnā vivādena tattvamuttvā maharṣayaḥ / sandhāya vākyamindreṇa papracchuḥ khecaraṃ vasum
verses.translation: The twicc-bom people neither study the Vedas nor worship by Yajflas. Men arc annihilated, the K?atriyas and the Vaisyas in due order. At that time, the kings are mainly Sudras who set in vogue all sorts of heresies. The subjects become devoid of good qualities.
verses.hindi: संहशे भागंवश्चायं साक्षाद्विष्णुस्वरूपधुक् । गमिष्यावः. शुभाल्लोकान्येषु गत्वा, न शोचति
verses.wordMeaning: The twicc-bom people neither study the Vedas nor worship by Yajflas. Men arc annihilated, the K?atriyas and the Vaisyas in due order. At that time, the kings are mainly Sudras who set in vogue all sorts of heresies. The subjects become devoid of good qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The twicc-bom people neither study the Vedas nor worship by Yajflas. Men arc annihilated, the K?atriyas and the Vaisyas in due order. At that time, the kings are mainly Sudras who set in vogue all sorts of heresies. The subjects become devoid of good qualities.

verses.sanskrit: सहाप्राज्ञ कथं दृष्टस्त्वया यज्ञविधिर्नृप । औत्तानपादे प्रब्रूहि संशयं नो नुद प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sahāprājña kathaṃ dṛṣṭastvayā yajñavidhirnṛpa / auttānapāde prabrūhi saṃśayaṃ no nuda prabho
verses.translation: Alliances and associations of the Sudras and Anlja- yonis (Lowest-born) with Bralimaiias take place in the Kali Yuga, in regard to bed, scats and food-sluffs.
verses.hindi: बह जो हिरणी शादूल के द्वारा पकड़ी जाने पर मर गयी थी वही तू अब पुनः इस जन्म में मृगी हुई है । और वैं द्विज सुत जो मरती हुई तेरा अनुस्मरण करते प्राणों का गिरकर परित्याग करने वाला था वही अब मृग होकर जन्म लेने वाला हूँ । यह मृत्यु के समय में भावना. का ही कारण है
verses.wordMeaning: Alliances and associations of the Sudras and Anlja- yonis (Lowest-born) with Bralimaiias take place in the Kali Yuga, in regard to bed, scats and food-sluffs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Alliances and associations of the Sudras and Anlja- yonis (Lowest-born) with Bralimaiias take place in the Kali Yuga, in regard to bed, scats and food-sluffs.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाक्यं वसुस्तेषाम विचार्य बलाबलम् । वेदशास्त्रमनुस्मृत्य यज्ञतत्त्वमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vākyaṃ vasusteṣāma vicārya balābalam / vedaśāstramanusmṛtya yajñatattvamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Span of life, intellect, strength, beauty and prestige of the family dwindle down and become extinct. The Sudras take to the conduct of life of the Brahmanas and the Brabnanas behave and act like Sudras. Thieves adopt the customs and conventions of kings, and kings behave and live like thieves. When the close of the Yuga is mminent, it is only these servants who survive.
verses.hindi: कि हम तुम दोनों इस तियंग् योनि से समुत्पन्न हए हैं । मैं यह नहीं जानता हूँ कि मेरे अन्य तोन भाई जो मुझसे बड़े थे कह! पर गये है ।२६। यह मेरा अपना और तुम्हारा चरित मेरी स्मृति में विद्यमान है । है भद्दे ! जो व्यतीत हो गया है और जो आगे होने वाला है उसको मैं बतलाता हूँ । तुम उसका श्रवण करो ।३०। जो यह व्याध पीछे की ओर लगा हुआ. दूर. में खड़ा था ओर थम का उसको भय हो रहा था । उसका भी इस समय में एक सिंह ने भक्षण कर लिया है।३१। उसका ऐसा ही विधान है उससे वह अपने श्राणों का त्याग करके स्वर्गलोक में चला जायया और यहाँ पर मध्यम पुष्कर में
verses.wordMeaning: Span of life, intellect, strength, beauty and prestige of the family dwindle down and become extinct. The Sudras take to the conduct of life of the Brahmanas and the Brabnanas behave and act like Sudras. Thieves adopt the customs and conventions of kings,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Span of life, intellect, strength, beauty and prestige of the family dwindle down and become extinct. The Sudras take to the conduct of life of the Brahmanas and the Brabnanas behave and act like Sudras. Thieves adopt the customs and conventions of kings,…

verses.sanskrit: यथोपनीर्तैर्यष्टव्यमिति होवाच पार्थिवः । यष्टव्यं पशुभिर्मे ध्यैरथ बीजैः फलैरपि
verses.transliteration: yathopanīrtairyaṣṭavyamiti hovāca pārthivaḥ / yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhirme dhyairatha bījaiḥ phalairapi
verses.translation: At the close of the Yuga, O excellent sage, the women become false and unfaithful. They misbehave. They become addicted to liquor and meat and become deceitful.
verses.hindi: इमः तुम" दोनों ने जल पिया- है ।३२। यहाँ पर इन भागंग, परशुराम का भलो भांति दर्शत किया गया है । इससे अनेक जन्मों में किये हुए भी पातक. नाश को आरम हो गये हं क्योंकि बह भाराव साक्षात्. भगवान् विष्णु के ही स्वरूप को धारण करने बाले हैं ।३३। अब -महामुनीन्दर अगस्त्य के दर्शन्
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of the Yuga, O excellent sage, the women become false and unfaithful. They misbehave. They become addicted to liquor and meat and become deceitful.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of the Yuga, O excellent sage, the women become false and unfaithful. They misbehave. They become addicted to liquor and meat and become deceitful.

verses.sanskrit: हिंसास्वभावो यज्ञस्य इति मे दर्शनागमौ । यथेह देवता मन्त्रा हिंसालिङ्गा महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: hiṃsāsvabhāvo yajñasya iti me darśanāgamau / yatheha devatā mantrā hiṃsāliṅgā maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: At the close of the Yuga, O excellent sage, the faithful wives do not survive. Beasts of prey llourish and the Know that at the close of that Yuga, good people turn back and keep aloof. Dharma of great consequence rooted
verses.hindi: श्राप्त करके तथा सङ्गति अदायकं स्तोत्र का श्रवण करके इम तुम दोनों ही परम शुभ लोकों में गमन करेगे जिनमें गमन करके श्राणी को किसी भी अकार को-चिन्ता.नहों रहा करती है अर्यात् कोई पीढ़ा होती ही नहीं है २७२  . ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण ।३४। इस तरह से यह इतना! अपनी प्रिया से कहकर बह प्रिय दर्शन मृग चुप हो गया था और अनातुर होकर राम का दर्शन करते हुए बह बहुत ही असन्न आत्मा बाला हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of the Yuga, O excellent sage, the faithful wives do not survive. Beasts of prey llourish and the Know that at the close of that Yuga, good people turn back and keep aloof. Dharma of great consequence rooted
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of the Yuga, O excellent sage, the faithful wives do not survive. Beasts of prey llourish and the Know that at the close of that Yuga, good people turn back and keep aloof. Dharma of great consequence rooted

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घेण तपसा युक्तैर्दर्शनैस्तारकादिभिः । तत्प्रामाण्यान्मया चोक्तं तस्मात्स प्राप्तुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: dīrgheṇa tapasā yuktairdarśanaistārakādibhiḥ / tatprāmāṇyānmayā coktaṃ tasmātsa prāptumarhatha
verses.translation: The kings will not be protectors but the enjoyers of their share in the offerings (taxesetc.).At the close of the Yuga, they will be eagerly devoted to the act of protecting themselves,
verses.hindi: अध्यद्ध योजनं गत्वा कनिष्ठ पुष्करं प्रति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The kings will not be protectors but the enjoyers of their share in the offerings (taxesetc.).At the close of the Yuga, they will be eagerly devoted to the act of protecting themselves,
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings will not be protectors but the enjoyers of their share in the offerings (taxesetc.).At the close of the Yuga, they will be eagerly devoted to the act of protecting themselves,

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रमाणं तान्येव मन्त्रवाक्यानि वै द्विजाः । तथा प्रवततां यज्ञो ह्यन्यथा वो ऽनृतं वचः
verses.transliteration: yadi pramāṇaṃ tānyeva mantravākyāni vai dvijāḥ / tathā pravatatāṃ yajño hyanyathā vo 'nṛtaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Kings will cease to be protectors. Brahmanas will be dependent on Sudras. All excellent twice-born ones will make obeisance to the Sudras. The common people begin to sell boiled and cooked rice; the Brahmarias begin to sell the Vedas. Young women begin to sell their bodies when the close of the Yuga is imminent.
verses.hindi: स्नात्वा माध्याष्टिनकीं सन्ध्यां चकारातिमुदान्वितः ॥ पुष्करे' लु' जलं  पीत्वाभिषिच्यात्मतनु' जलैः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Kings will cease to be protectors. Brahmanas will be dependent on Sudras. All excellent twice-born ones will make obeisance to the Sudras. The common people begin to sell boiled and cooked rice; the Brahmarias begin to sell the Vedas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Kings will cease to be protectors. Brahmanas will be dependent on Sudras. All excellent twice-born ones will make obeisance to the Sudras. The common people begin to sell boiled and cooked rice; the Brahmarias begin to sell the Vedas.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृतोत्तरास्ते वै युक्तात्मानस्तपोधनाः । अवश्यभावितं दृष्ट्वा तमथो वाग्यताभवन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtottarāste vai yuktātmānastapodhanāḥ / avaśyabhāvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tamatho vāgyatābhavan
verses.translation: In this Kali age> even excellent Brihmanas be* come the sellers of the benefits of their penance and perform¬ ance of sacrifices. Many people will turn into ascetics.
verses.wordMeaning: In this Kali age> even excellent Brihmanas be* come the sellers of the benefits of their penance and perform¬ ance of sacrifices. Many people will turn into ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this Kali age> even excellent Brihmanas be* come the sellers of the benefits of their penance and perform¬ ance of sacrifices. Many people will turn into ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तमात्रे नृपतिः प्रविवेश रसातलम् । ऊर्ध्वचारी वसुर्भूत्वा रसातलचरो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: ityuktamātre nṛpatiḥ praviveśa rasātalam / ūrdhvacārī vasurbhūtvā rasātalacaro 'bhavat
verses.translation: People will begin to sell merchandise through false weights and measures. The whole society will be surrounded by hunter-like people and heretics of evil habits and conduct of life. When the Yuga wanes away there will not be any¬ one who helps in return for another's help. There will not be any one who does not injure and spoil others, whose words are not harsh; who is straight-forward and who is not malicious.
verses.hindi: भाग॑व परशुराम ने अपने शिष्य के सहित इस तरह से उस मृग के दोरा कही हुई बातों को सुना था और इसको 'सुनकर उसको बड़ा भारीः विस्मय हो गया था। हैं राजेन्द्र ! फिर उस परशुराम ने उसी भांतिशेः गंमन करने के लिये अपनी बुद्धि बना ली थी ।३६। उस भार्गेव ने सर्वप्रथम स्नोन कियां था और फिर अपनी जो नित्य क्रिया थी उसको समाप्त किया: था। इसके पश्चात् मन में अत्यधिक हषित होकर अक्कत ब्रण नामधारी के- साथ संयुते दोकर अगस्त्य मुनि के आश्रम की ओर उसने प्रस्थान कर' दिया था ।३७। जिस सेमेय में रामागमनं कर रहे थे तब मार्ग में अरे हुए व्याध
verses.wordMeaning: People will begin to sell merchandise through false weights and measures. The whole society will be surrounded by hunter-like people and heretics of evil habits and conduct of life. When the Yuga wanes away there will not be any¬ one who helps in return for another's help.…
verses.commentary: Sense: People will begin to sell merchandise through false weights and measures. The whole society will be surrounded by hunter-like people and heretics of evil habits and conduct of life. When the Yuga wanes away there will not be any¬ one who helps in return for another's help.…

verses.sanskrit: वसुधा तलवासी तु तेन वाक्येन सो ऽभवत् । धर्माणां संशयच्छेत्ता राजा वसुरधोगतः
verses.transliteration: vasudhā talavāsī tu tena vākyena so 'bhavat / dharmāṇāṃ saṃśayacchettā rājā vasuradhogataḥ
verses.translation: When the close of tiie Yuga sets in, its characteris¬ tic feature is apprehension of danger etc. Then the earth will be void without wealth.
verses.hindi: को देखा था. जो कि सिंह के द्वारा किये हुए सम्प्रहार से ही मर गया था + उसको देखकर उस महान्" आत्मा वाले को बड़ा विस्मयं हो गया था"।३दा फिर आगे आधे योजन तक चलकर कनिष्ठ पुष्कर था । वहाँ पहुँचकर रामः
verses.wordMeaning: When the close of tiie Yuga sets in, its characteris¬ tic feature is apprehension of danger etc. Then the earth will be void without wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the close of tiie Yuga sets in, its characteris¬ tic feature is apprehension of danger etc. Then the earth will be void without wealth.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्न वाच्यमेकेन बहुज्ञेनापि संशये । बहुद्वारस्य धर्मस्य सूक्ष्मा दूरतरा गतिः
verses.transliteration: tasmānna vācyamekena bahujñenāpi saṃśaye / bahudvārasya dharmasya sūkṣmā dūratarā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Rulers will not be protectors (hough they are (ex¬ pected) to be protectors. They will take away jewels (and valuables) of others and molest their men's wives. People will be lustful in their minds. They will be evil-fflindedt base and foobhardy, addicted to criminal and reckless acts. They will be roguish with all good activities
verses.hindi: परशुराम का अगस्त्याश्रम में आगमन   २७३ ने स्नानः किया था और परम हर्ष से संयुत होकर वहाँ पर मध्याह्नः काल अं होने वाली सन्ध्या 'की उपासना की थी इ॥ उस समय में वह-यही विचार कर रहा था "उर मृग ने मेराअपना हित कहा था । तब तक बह यह देखता है कि पीछे लगा उस मृग और मृणी का जोड़ा वहाँ पर उपागत
verses.wordMeaning: Rulers will not be protectors (hough they are (ex¬ pected) to be protectors. They will take away jewels (and valuables) of others and molest their men's wives. People will be lustful in their minds. They will be evil-fflindedt base and foobhardy,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Rulers will not be protectors (hough they are (ex¬ pected) to be protectors. They will take away jewels (and valuables) of others and molest their men's wives. People will be lustful in their minds. They will be evil-fflindedt base and foobhardy,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्न निश्चयाद्वक्तुं धर्मः शक्यस्तु केनचित् । देवानृषीनुपादाय स्वायंभुवमृते मनुम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānna niścayādvaktuṃ dharmaḥ śakyastu kenacit / devānṛṣīnupādāya svāyaṃbhuvamṛte manum
verses.translation: In the Kali Yuga, all the Vedas are seen and not seen (i.e. not read and understood clearly). YajAas afflicted only by sins and evils, become spoiled.
verses.hindi: हों गया था ।४०। उस मृग और मृगीं के जोड़ेः ने पुष्कर में जल का पान किया था और उसके जल से अपने शरीरों का अभिषिङचन किया था । भार्गव परशुराम यह देख ही रहे ये कि उनके देखते-देखते वह मृग-मृगी का जोड़ा अगस्त्य मुनि आश्रमः के सम्मुख चला गया था।४१। राम: ने भी
verses.wordMeaning: In the Kali Yuga, all the Vedas are seen and not seen (i.e. not read and understood clearly). YajAas afflicted only by sins and evils, become spoiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kali Yuga, all the Vedas are seen and not seen (i.e. not read and understood clearly). YajAas afflicted only by sins and evils, become spoiled.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादहिंसा धर्मस्य द्वारमुक्तं महर्षिभिः । ऋषिकोटिसहस्राणि स्वतपोभिर्दिवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tasmādahiṃsā dharmasya dvāramuktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ / ṛṣikoṭisahasrāṇi svatapobhirdivaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: After the advent of (he Kali age, many types of heretics crop up. They may be Buddhists wearing ochre-coloured robes, Jainas, Kapalikas and others who sell the Vedas. Still others are those who sell holy centres of pilgrimage. There are others who are the enemies of the system and discipline of the castes and stages of life. All these heretics are bom when the Kali Age steps in.
verses.hindi: अपती सन्ध्योपासना को पूर्ण करके नेत्यिक कर्म से निवृति, की 'थी. और चह भी अगस्त्य मुनि'के आश्रम को चलां गया था। यह परमोदार मत्त वाला विपद्गत पुष्कर का दशन करते ही चला जा रहा था यच्च ब्रह्मसुता राजन्सम।माता सरस्वती
verses.wordMeaning: After the advent of (he Kali age, many types of heretics crop up. They may be Buddhists wearing ochre-coloured robes, Jainas, Kapalikas and others who sell the Vedas. Still others are those who sell holy centres of pilgrimage.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After the advent of (he Kali age, many types of heretics crop up. They may be Buddhists wearing ochre-coloured robes, Jainas, Kapalikas and others who sell the Vedas. Still others are those who sell holy centres of pilgrimage.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्न दानं यज्ञं वा प्रशंसंति महर्षयः । उञ्छमूलफलं शाकमुदपात्रं तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: tasmānna dānaṃ yajñaṃ vā praśaṃsaṃti maharṣayaḥ / uñchamūlaphalaṃ śākamudapātraṃ tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Then Sudras become experts in interpreting affairs concerning religious activities and they study the Vedas. Kings
verses.wordMeaning: Then Sudras become experts in interpreting affairs concerning religious activities and they study the Vedas. Kings
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Sudras become experts in interpreting affairs concerning religious activities and they study the Vedas. Kings

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दत्वा विभवतः स्वर्गे लोके प्रतिष्ठिताः । अद्रोहश्चाप्य लोभश्च तपो भुतदया दमः
verses.transliteration: etaddatvā vibhavataḥ svarge loke pratiṣṭhitāḥ / adrohaścāpya lobhaśca tapo bhutadayā damaḥ
verses.translation: Then the subjects accomplish something either by killing women, children and cows or by killing one another or by robbing one another. At that time the practice of killing children in the womb comes into vogue due to enmity. Hence> span of life> strength and beauty become reduced after (he advent of Kali Yuga.
verses.hindi: मृगः सिंहैः सहगते: सेवितं शांतमोनसँः । कुटरैरजु ने: पारिभद्रधवेगुहैः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the subjects accomplish something either by killing women, children and cows or by killing one another or by robbing one another. At that time the practice of killing children in the womb comes into vogue due to enmity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the subjects accomplish something either by killing women, children and cows or by killing one another or by robbing one another. At that time the practice of killing children in the womb comes into vogue due to enmity.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यं तथा सत्यमनुक्रोशः क्षमा धृतिः । सनातनस्य धर्मस्य मूलमेतद्दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryaṃ tathā satyamanukrośaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ / sanātanasya dharmasya mūlametaddurāsadam
verses.translation: At that time, men attain Siddhi within a short time. Blessed and excellent twice-bom ones will practise piety and devotion at the close of the Yuga,
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, men attain Siddhi within a short time. Blessed and excellent twice-bom ones will practise piety and devotion at the close of the Yuga,
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, men attain Siddhi within a short time. Blessed and excellent twice-bom ones will practise piety and devotion at the close of the Yuga,

verses.transliteration: śrūyante hi tapaḥsiddhā brahmakṣatrādayo 'naghāḥ / priyavratottānapādau dhruvo medhātithirvasuḥ
