verses.sanskrit: सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खः पाण्ड्यज एव च । प्राजीनबर्हिः पर्जन्यो हविर्धानादयो नृपः
verses.transliteration: sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhaḥ pāṇḍyaja eva ca / prājīnabarhiḥ parjanyo havirdhānādayo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: They were agitated and bewildered. They lefl their houses, wives and relatives. They never cared for (heir lives. (They were not hopeful about their ability to survive). Even without reason, they became very miserable.
verses.wordMeaning: They were agitated and bewildered. They lefl their houses, wives and relatives. They never cared for (heir lives. (They were not hopeful about their ability to survive). Even without reason, they became very miserable.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were agitated and bewildered. They lefl their houses, wives and relatives. They never cared for (heir lives. (They were not hopeful about their ability to survive). Even without reason, they became very miserable.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवः स्वैस्तपोभिर्दिवं गताः । राजर्षयो महासत्त्वा येषां कीर्त्तिः प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ svaistapobhirdivaṃ gatāḥ / rājarṣayo mahāsattvā yeṣāṃ kīrttiḥ pratiṣṭhitā
verses.translation: When the Dharma based on Sruti and Smrti became extinct, the people killed one another, devoid of bounds of decency, affection, shame and fiiends and allies. When virtue ceased to exist, the people were affiic* ted and they were reduced to a size of twentyftve (as against 52 Aiigulas in height). Agitated and distressed they found their sen8eK>rgans out of gear. They had to forsake their children and wives (and run away).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजीः की पुत्री सरस्वती विधि के अग्निहोत्र के तीतों कुण्डों को पूरित करने के लिए समायात हुई थी ।४४ बहाँ पर उसी सरस्वती के तत्पर परम पुनीत ओर शुभ तथा महाश्चयं से युक्त कुम्भज ऋषि के आश्रम को भागंव ने देखा था जो अनेक मुनिगणों के द्वारा नियेवित था ।४४। वह आश्रम वरम' शान्त था और उसमें मृग और सिंह अपनः स्वाभाविक वैर त्यागः कर परम शान्त भन वाले एक i रहा करते ये। ऐसे सभी पशुओं का यहाँ पर निवास था। उस आश्रम में अनेक प्रकार के परम सुन्दर तरुवर लगे हुए' थे जिनमें कुटर-अजु'न-विम्ब-पारिभद्र-ध्व-हङ्ग .द-खदिरासन-
verses.wordMeaning: When the Dharma based on Sruti and Smrti became extinct, the people killed one another, devoid of bounds of decency, affection, shame and fiiends and allies. When virtue ceased to exist,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Dharma based on Sruti and Smrti became extinct, the people killed one another, devoid of bounds of decency, affection, shame and fiiends and allies. When virtue ceased to exist,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विशिष्यते यज्ञात्तपः सर्वैस्तु कारणः । ब्रह्मणा तपसा सृष्टं जगद्विश्वमिदं पुरा
verses.transliteration: tasmādviśiṣyate yajñāttapaḥ sarvaistu kāraṇaḥ / brahmaṇā tapasā sṛṣṭaṃ jagadviśvamidaṃ purā
verses.translation: People oppressed by drought had to abandon their agricultural activities. They were miserable. Leaving their own native lands they began to stay in the bordering districts.
verses.hindi: खज र और बदरी आदि के अकृत ब्रण से संयुतः होकर प्रवेश किया था । ४५-४६-४७ प्रवेश करके राम ने बिराजमान और परमशान्त मन वाले मुनिवर अगस्त्यजी का दर्शन प्राप्त किया था जो स्वेथा एकदम रुके हुए शान्त जल से भरे हुए सरोवर के ही समान ये तथा शाश्वत ब्रह्म का ध्यान
verses.wordMeaning: People oppressed by drought had to abandon their agricultural activities. They were miserable. Leaving their own native lands they began to stay in the bordering districts.
verses.commentary: Sense: People oppressed by drought had to abandon their agricultural activities. They were miserable. Leaving their own native lands they began to stay in the bordering districts.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्नान्वेति तद्यज्ञस्तपोमूलमिदं स्मृतम् । द्रव्यमन्त्रात्मको यज्ञस्तपस्त्वनशनात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānnānveti tadyajñastapomūlamidaṃ smṛtam / dravyamantrātmako yajñastapastvanaśanātmakam
verses.translation: They were compelled to resort to rivers, marshy places, near the seas and mountainous regions. Extremely miserable, they sustained themselves by means of meat, roots and fruits. They were oppressed with old age» sickness and hunger. Owing to misery, they reached a stage of abject dejec¬ tedness. From this dejected slate, they reached the state of pondering over the same. Pondering took them to a state of equanimity.
verses.hindi: कर रहे थे ।४८। वहाँ पर लताओं ओर द्र,मों के पत्तों से एक उटज (झाँचड़ी) बनी हुई थी उस उटज में अगस्त्य भुनि कौश्य--वृष्य तथा मृग चर्म को परिधान किये हुए विराजमान ये  है महाराज ! यहाँ पर भागव राम ने अपने नाम का उच्यारण करते हुए अगस्स्य मुनि के चरणों में प्रणि- मृरश्चेको मया दशो मध्यमे पुष्करे विभो.।
verses.wordMeaning: They were compelled to resort to rivers, marshy places, near the seas and mountainous regions. Extremely miserable, they sustained themselves by means of meat, roots and fruits. They were oppressed with old age» sickness and hunger. Owing to misery,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were compelled to resort to rivers, marshy places, near the seas and mountainous regions. Extremely miserable, they sustained themselves by means of meat, roots and fruits. They were oppressed with old age» sickness and hunger. Owing to misery,…

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेन देवानाप्नोति वैराजं तपसा पुनः । ब्राह्मं तु कर्म संन्यासाद्वैराग्यात्प्रकृतेर्जयम्
verses.transliteration: yajñena devānāpnoti vairājaṃ tapasā punaḥ / brāhmaṃ tu karma saṃnyāsādvairāgyātprakṛterjayam
verses.translation: Through the state of equanimity, they had the realisation of the Atman. Through this knowledge, they acquir¬ ed piety and devotion. Thus those who survived the last stage of the Kali age, acquired tranquility and control of sense.
verses.wordMeaning: Through the state of equanimity, they had the realisation of the Atman. Through this knowledge, they acquir¬ ed piety and devotion. Thus those who survived the last stage of the Kali age, acquired tranquility and control of sense.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through the state of equanimity, they had the realisation of the Atman. Through this knowledge, they acquir¬ ed piety and devotion. Thus those who survived the last stage of the Kali age, acquired tranquility and control of sense.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानात्प्राप्नोति कैवल्यं पञ्चैतागतयः स्मृताः । एवं विवादः सुमहान्य ज्ञस्यासीत्प्रवर्त्तने
verses.transliteration: jñānātprāpnoti kaivalyaṃ pañcaitāgatayaḥ smṛtāḥ / evaṃ vivādaḥ sumahānya jñasyāsītpravarttane
verses.translation: When the Dharmas of rauta and Smdrta varieties had been pointed out to the people of Kfta Yuga, some of them remained tUl the close of the Yuga for the sake of establishing Dharma. Happiness, span of life, strength, beauty, virtue, wealth and love—these arc reduced to three-fourths in each of the succeeding Yugas.
verses.hindi: राम ने अगस्त्य मुनि के चरणों की सन्निधि में समुपस्थित होकर उनसे निवेदन किया था कि मैं जमदग्नि का आत्मज राम हैं और यहाँ पर आपके दर्शन करने के लिए समागत हुआ हूँ । है लोकों पर कृपा करने वाले मुनिवर ! मैं आपकी सेवा में प्रणिपात कर रहा हुँ उसे आप स्वीकार कीजिए ।५०। जब राम ने इस रीति से प्रार्थना की थी तो ऐसे कहने वाले राम को उन्होने धीरे से ध्यानावस्था में मुदे हुए नेत्रों को खोलकर देखा था और फिर आपका स्वागत है-- ऐसा उच्चारण करके उनको आसन पर उपविष्ट हो जाने की आज्ञा भदान की थी ।५१। उन मुनियों में परम आठ
verses.wordMeaning: When the Dharmas of rauta and Smdrta varieties had been pointed out to the people of Kfta Yuga, some of them remained tUl the close of the Yuga for the sake of establishing Dharma. Happiness, span of life, strength, beauty, virtue,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Dharmas of rauta and Smdrta varieties had been pointed out to the people of Kfta Yuga, some of them remained tUl the close of the Yuga for the sake of establishing Dharma. Happiness, span of life, strength, beauty, virtue,…

verses.sanskrit: देवतानामृषीणां च पूर्व स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे । ततस्तमृषयो दृष्ट्वा हतं धर्मबलेन तु
verses.transliteration: devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pūrva svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / tatastamṛṣayo dṛṣṭvā hataṃ dharmabalena tu
verses.translation: The achievement of piety of the Yugas becomes re¬ duced in the SandhydfhSas Thus is the Pralisandhi (transition between the two Yugas) that- had been mentioned by me (before), O Brahmaas.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य जी ने शिष्य के द्वारा मधुपर्क मेंगाकर राम को प्रदान किया था। फिर तपश्च! और कुल की क्षेम-कुशल उससे प्रूछी थी ।५२। उन मुनिवर केद्वारा जब राम से इस रीति से पूछा गया था तो उस समय में रामने अगस्त्य मुनि से कहा था! है ईश ! अब आपके चरणों के दर्शन से मेरो
verses.wordMeaning: The achievement of piety of the Yugas becomes re¬ duced in the SandhydfhSas Thus is the Pralisandhi (transition between the two Yugas) that- had been mentioned by me (before), O Brahmaas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The achievement of piety of the Yugas becomes re¬ duced in the SandhydfhSas Thus is the Pralisandhi (transition between the two Yugas) that- had been mentioned by me (before), O Brahmaas.

verses.sanskrit: वसोर्वाक्यमना दृत्य जगमुः सर्वे यथागतम् । गतेषु मुनिसंघेषु देवा यज्ञं समाप्नुवन्
verses.transliteration: vasorvākyamanā dṛtya jagamuḥ sarve yathāgatam / gateṣu munisaṃgheṣu devā yajñaṃ samāpnuvan
verses.translation: Just as the repetitions of the Yugas had come into vogue since a long time owii to the intrinsic nature of the Yuga, so also the living world (world of living beings) being transformed through decrease and increase does not remain (the same permanently). 71 leu of four Yugsi cofuUtute a ManvaDUta. The verses that follow constitute an elucidation of DhM oludpjfct. (l*he creator
verses.hindi: सभी प्रकार का क्षेम-कुशल है ।५३। है निभो ! मुझे एक संशय हो गया है। उसका छेदन आष करपा कर अपने अभृत रूपी वचनों के द्वारा कर दीजिए । मैंने एक मृग को मध्यम पुष्कर में देखा था ।५३। उस. मृग ने मेरा अतीत और अनागत सम्पूर्ण वृत्त बतला दिया था । इसका श्रवण करके में अधिक विस्मय से आविष्ट हो गया हूँ और अब आपके चरण कमलों की शरण में समागत हुआ हूँ ।५५। अपनी स्वाभाविक अनुकम्पा से मेरा परित्राण कीजिए । और है नाथ ! महामन्त्र की सिद्धि कराइये । है गुरो ! भगवान शिव ने जो कवच मुझे प्रदान किया है उसको सिद्ध कराइये । इसमें आपकी
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the repetitions of the Yugas had come into vogue since a long time owii to the intrinsic nature of the Yuga, so also the living world (world of living beings) being transformed through decrease and increase does not remain (the same permanently).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the repetitions of the Yugas had come into vogue since a long time owii to the intrinsic nature of the Yuga, so also the living world (world of living beings) being transformed through decrease and increase does not remain (the same permanently).…

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञप्रवर्त्तनं ह्येवमासीत्स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे । ततः प्रभृति यज्ञो ऽयं युगैः सह विवर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: yajñapravarttanaṃ hyevamāsītsvāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / tataḥ prabhṛti yajño 'yaṃ yugaiḥ saha vivarttitaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas of eight classes who are the lords in this Manvantara, the sages and the Manus—all these arc equal in regard to the purpose (served by them).
verses.hindi: वरमानुकम्पा मेरे दास के ऊपर होगी
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas of eight classes who are the lords in this Manvantara, the sages and the Manus—all these arc equal in regard to the purpose (served by them).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas of eight classes who are the lords in this Manvantara, the sages and the Manus—all these arc equal in regard to the purpose (served by them).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे यज्ञप्रवर्त्तनं नाम त्रिशत्तमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अत ऊर्द्धं प्रवक्ष्यामि द्वापरस्य विधिं पुनः । तत्र त्रेतायुगे क्षीणे द्वापरं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde yajñapravarttanaṃ nāma triśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca ata ūrddhaṃ pravakṣyāmi dvāparasya vidhiṃ punaḥ / tatra tretāyuge kṣīṇe dvāparaṃ pratipadyate
verses.translation: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and the Devas are the Pitfs. The Rtus (seasons), Artavas and Ardhamasas (half mopths) are remembered as Pitrs mutually.
verses.hindi: एवं प्रश्‍न समाकर्ण्य रामस्य सुमहात्मनः । २७६   अहसाण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and the Devas are the Pitfs. The Rtus (seasons), Artavas and Ardhamasas (half mopths) are remembered as Pitrs mutually.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and the Devas are the Pitfs. The Rtus (seasons), Artavas and Ardhamasas (half mopths) are remembered as Pitrs mutually.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरादौ प्रजानां तु सिद्धिस्त्रेतायुगे तु या । परिवृत्ते युगे तस्मिंस्ततस्ताभिः प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: dvāparādau prajānāṃ tu siddhistretāyuge tu yā / parivṛtte yuge tasmiṃstatastābhiḥ praṇaśyati
verses.translation: Thus these Pitrs, Devas and human Piers become pleased when the holy rites are accompanied by faith* When they are pleased the descendants also are pleased.
verses.hindi: श्रोतु कृष्णामृतं स्तोत्र सर्वं तत्कारणं मुनि: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these Pitrs, Devas and human Piers become pleased when the holy rites are accompanied by faith* When they are pleased the descendants also are pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these Pitrs, Devas and human Piers become pleased when the holy rites are accompanied by faith* When they are pleased the descendants also are pleased.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवर्त्तते तासां प्रजानां द्वापरे पुनः । संभेदश्चैव वर्णानां कार्याणां च विपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravarttate tāsāṃ prajānāṃ dvāpare punaḥ / saṃbhedaścaiva varṇānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ ca viparyayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus this search for and investigation into the nature of the Pitrs who imbibe Soma (has been completed). It is this principle of tne Pitrs that has been decisively recounted in the Puranas.
verses.hindi: इस श्रीकृष्ण के .मन्त्र की साधना करते हुए भुझे एक सो वषं से भी अधिक काल व्यतीत हो गया है तो भी मुझे इसकी सिद्धि प्राप्त नहीं हुई है। इसका क्या. कारण है। यह आप मुझे अपनी परमाधिक कपा करके बतलाइएं ।५७। श्री वसिष्ठ मुनि ने कहा--इस प्रकार का जो प्रश्न महात्मा राम नै. किया.था उसका श्रवण करके है महाराज ! उस महामुनि ने एक क्षण भर कुछ ध्यान किया था और फिर जो कुछ भी उस झृ ने कहा था अस़को, उस समय में उन्होंने अपने ध्यान ले जान लिया था ।५८५। अपनी मृगी के साथ अपने आश्रम में आये हुए उस मुग को भी उन्होंने जान लिया
verses.wordMeaning: Thus this search for and investigation into the nature of the Pitrs who imbibe Soma (has been completed). It is this principle of tne Pitrs that has been decisively recounted in the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus this search for and investigation into the nature of the Pitrs who imbibe Soma (has been completed). It is this principle of tne Pitrs that has been decisively recounted in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञावधारणं दण्डो मदो दंभः क्षमा बलम् । एषा रजस्तमोयुक्ता प्रवृत्तिर्द्वापरे स्मृता
verses.transliteration: yajñāvadhāraṇaṃ daṇḍo mado daṃbhaḥ kṣamā balam / eṣā rajastamoyuktā pravṛttirdvāpare smṛtā
verses.translation: W. 68-91 justify the performaxm of 8r&ddhai*
verses.hindi: था जो, कि श्रीकृष्णामृत. स्तोत्र का श्रवण करने के लिए ही बहाँ पर समागत हुआ.था । मुनि ने उस सबका कारण भी समक्ष लिया था। इस सबका विचार करके उन महामुनि अगस्त्य जी ने उस भागव राम को अपने अमृत रूपी बचनों के द्वारा आश्वासन दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: W. 68-91 justify the performaxm of 8r&ddhai*
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 68-91 justify the performaxm of 8r&ddhai*

verses.sanskrit: आद्ये कृते यो धर्मो ऽस्ति स त्रेतायां प्रवर्त्तते । द्वापरे व्याकुलीभूत्वा प्रणश्यति कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: ādye kṛte yo dharmo 'sti sa tretāyāṃ pravarttate / dvāpare vyākulībhūtvā praṇaśyati kalau yuge
verses.translation: I wish to hear about the nature and principle (or reality) of those sets offourYugas, which were before in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.hindi: आगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमासृत स्तोत्र. का कथन. अवगत्य स वै सर्व कारणं प्रीतमानसः ।
verses.wordMeaning: I wish to hear about the nature and principle (or reality) of those sets offourYugas, which were before in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to hear about the nature and principle (or reality) of those sets offourYugas, which were before in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णानां विपरिध्वंसः संकीयत तथाश्रमाः । द्वैविध्यं प्रतिपद्येतेयुगे तस्मिञ्छ्रुति स्मृती
verses.transliteration: varṇānāṃ viparidhvaṃsaḥ saṃkīyata tathāśramāḥ / dvaividhyaṃ pratipadyeteyuge tasmiñchruti smṛtī
verses.translation: What I have already described in the context of (the description of) the Earih etc, the set of four Yugas is among them. I shall recount it. (All of you listen and) under¬ stand.
verses.wordMeaning: What I have already described in the context of (the description of) the Earih etc, the set of four Yugas is among them. I shall recount it. (All of you listen and) under¬ stand.
verses.commentary: Sense: What I have already described in the context of (the description of) the Earih etc, the set of four Yugas is among them. I shall recount it. (All of you listen and) under¬ stand.

verses.sanskrit: द्वैधात्तथा श्रुतिस्मृत्योर्निश्चयो नाधिगम्यते । अनिश्चयाधिगमनाद्धर्मतत्त्वं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: dvaidhāttathā śrutismṛtyorniścayo nādhigamyate / aniścayādhigamanāddharmatattvaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: Though this Purliu f<o]lowcd the vedie tradition and regarded a Yuga-period as contizxg of five years (Wde S\ipTa ch. 21.131-132 and Note thereon), here the author follows Manu 1.61-74, 79-86. According to him the 1st Yuga, Ktta extends over 4000 yean of gods with a twilight period {uutdhyd) of 400 Divine (of god's) yean before its actual advent and a transitional period to the next Yuga (Sandhyitha) of 400 celestial years. The three other Yugas via I'reta, Dvipara and Kali coosiit respectively of a period of 3000, 2000 and 1000 divine yean preceded by and followed by and each extending over a period of 300, 200 and 100
verses.hindi: सनकादा नारदश्च गौतमो जाजलिः कतुः अगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमामुत स्तोत्र का कथन   २७७
verses.wordMeaning: Though this Purliu f<o]lowcd the vedie tradition and regarded a Yuga-period as contizxg of five years (Wde S\ipTa ch. 21.131-132 and Note thereon), here the author follows Manu 1.61-74, 79-86. According to him the 1st Yuga,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Though this Purliu f<o]lowcd the vedie tradition and regarded a Yuga-period as contizxg of five years (Wde S\ipTa ch. 21.131-132 and Note thereon), here the author follows Manu 1.61-74, 79-86. According to him the 1st Yuga,…

verses.sanskrit: धर्मासत्त्वेन मित्राणां मतिभेदो भवेन्नृणाम् । परस्परविभिन्नैस्तैदृष्टीनां विभ्रमेण च
verses.transliteration: dharmāsattvena mitrāṇāṃ matibhedo bhavennṛṇām / parasparavibhinnaistaidṛṣṭīnāṃ vibhrameṇa ca
verses.hindi: महामुनि वसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--उस सम्पूर्ण कारण को भली भाति समश कर कुम्भ से समुत्पन्न अगस्त्य मुनि ने अपने मन परम प्रीति करकें भागव राम से कहा था ।१। अगस्त्य मुनि ने कहा--हे परशुराम ! आप तो महान् भाग बाले हैं। मैं अब आपके हितः क्री बात कहता हूँ उसका आप
verses.commentary: Sense: ch. 41, Mbb. Vana cht 149, 188, V 3, Vi. P. chs 21, 22. 57, 58.

verses.sanskrit: अयं धर्मो ह्ययं नेति निश्चयो नाधिगम्यते । कारणानां च वैकल्प्यात्कार्याणां चाप्यनिश्चयात्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ dharmo hyayaṃ neti niścayo nādhigamyate / kāraṇānāṃ ca vaikalpyātkāryāṇāṃ cāpyaniścayāt
verses.translation: After calculating the human year by means of worldly reckoning, I shall mention the set of four Yugas cal¬ culating the same by means of human years.
verses.hindi: श्रवण कीजिए । जिनके द्वारा आप बहुत ही शीघ्र इस महामन्त. की सिद्धि की प्रापि कर लेंगे ।२। है महती मति वाले ! यह भक्ति तीन प्रकार की होती है । उस भक्ति के तीनों प्रकारों के लक्षणों का ज्ञान प्रात करके जो मनुष्य फिर यत्न किया करता है वह बहुत ही शीध्च पूर्ण सिद्धि प्राप्त कर लिया करता है ।३। एक बार मैं स्वर्यं भगवान् अनन्त देव के दर्शेन प्राप्त करने की आकांक्षा से पाताल लोक में गया था जो कि परमानन्द के साथ बड़े-बड़े नाग राजों से सुशोभित था ।४। है महाभाग ! यहाँ पर मैंने देखा था कि चारों ओर बड़े-बड़े सिद्ध महापुरुष विराजमान थे । वहाँ सनकादिक
verses.wordMeaning: After calculating the human year by means of worldly reckoning, I shall mention the set of four Yugas cal¬ culating the same by means of human years.
verses.commentary: Sense: After calculating the human year by means of worldly reckoning, I shall mention the set of four Yugas cal¬ culating the same by means of human years.

verses.sanskrit: मतिभेदेन तेषां वै दृष्टीनां विभ्रमो भवेत् । ततो दृष्टिविभन्नैस्तु कृतं शास्त्राकुलं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: matibhedena teṣāṃ vai dṛṣṭīnāṃ vibhramo bhavet / tato dṛṣṭivibhannaistu kṛtaṃ śāstrākulaṃ tvidam
verses.translation: Fifteen make <me KHthd. Thirty Kil,shds
verses.hindi: चारों महासिद्ध-देवधि नारद-गौतम-जा जलि-कतु-क मु-हंस-अरुणि-वाल्मी कि- शक्ति-आसुरि प्रभृति सभी मुनीन्द्रगण और ऋषियों के समुदाय विद्यमान थे। है द्विज ! ये सब और अन्य भी वात्स्यायन जिनमें प्रमुख थे महान सिद्धगण वहाँ पर बैठे हुए बे ।५-६। ये सभी वहाँ पर बैठे हुए ज्ञान की पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Fifteen make <me KHthd. Thirty Kil,shds
verses.commentary: Sense: Fifteen make <me KHthd. Thirty Kil,shds

verses.sanskrit: एको वेदश्चतुष्पाद्धि त्रेतास्विह विधीयते । संक्षयादायुपश्चैव व्यस्यते द्वापरेषु च
verses.transliteration: eko vedaścatuṣpāddhi tretāsviha vidhīyate / saṃkṣayādāyupaścaiva vyasyate dvāpareṣu ca
verses.translation: Three hundred and sixty human months make one year of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: प्राप्ति के लिये फणि नायक शेषराज की उपासना कर रहे थे। वहाँ पर सबके साथ फणीन्द्र नायक शेष महाराज की सेवा में मैंने बड़े आवर के साथ प्रणिपात किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Three hundred and sixty human months make one year of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three hundred and sixty human months make one year of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिमन्त्रात्पुनर्भेदाद्भिद्यते दृष्टिविभ्रमैः । मन्त्रब्राह्मणविन्यासैः स्वरवर्णविपर्ययैः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣimantrātpunarbhedādbhidyate dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ / mantrabrāhmaṇavinyāsaiḥ svaravarṇaviparyayaiḥ
verses.translation: W. 5-21 give the divisions of Time adopted in calculating Yugas. The smallest unit of time is the period required for winking of the eye and is called
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमामृत स्तोत्र का कथन   २७८
verses.wordMeaning: W. 5-21 give the divisions of Time adopted in calculating Yugas. The smallest unit of time is the period required for winking of the eye and is called
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 5-21 give the divisions of Time adopted in calculating Yugas. The smallest unit of time is the period required for winking of the eye and is called

verses.sanskrit: संहिता ऋग्यजुःसाम्नां संपठ्यन्ते महर्षिभिः । सामान्या वैकृताश्चैव दृष्टिभिन्ने क्वचित्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: saṃhitā ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ saṃpaṭhyante maharṣibhiḥ / sāmānyā vaikṛtāścaiva dṛṣṭibhinne kvacitkvacit
verses.translation: A hundred years according to human calcu¬ lation are considered to be equal to three years and ten montha of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: वाराहाद्यवताराणां चरितं पापनाशनम् सुखदं मोक्षदं चैव ज्ञानविज्ञानकारणम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: A hundred years according to human calcu¬ lation are considered to be equal to three years and ten montha of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hundred years according to human calcu¬ lation are considered to be equal to three years and ten montha of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणं कल्पसूत्राणि मन्त्रप्रवचनानि च । अन्ये ऽपि प्रस्थितास्तान्वै केचित्तान्प्रत्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaṃ kalpasūtrāṇi mantrapravacanāni ca / anye 'pi prasthitāstānvai kecittānpratyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: The year of Dhruvais remembered as equal to nine thousand and ninety years according to human calculation.
verses.wordMeaning: The year of Dhruvais remembered as equal to nine thousand and ninety years according to human calculation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The year of Dhruvais remembered as equal to nine thousand and ninety years according to human calculation.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरेषु प्रवर्त्तन्ते निवर्त्तन्ते कलौ युगे । एकमाध्वर्यवं त्वासीत्पुनर्द्वैधमजायत
verses.transliteration: dvāpareṣu pravarttante nivarttante kalau yuge / ekamādhvaryavaṃ tvāsītpunardvaidhamajāyata
verses.translation: Thirty six thousand years according to the human reckoning should be known as equal to a hundred years. This is remembered as divine reckoning.
verses.hindi: मैं वहाँ पर बड़े ही आनन्द से भगवान् विष्णु देव की कथाओं का श्रवण करता हुआ बैठ गया था  है महाभाग ! यह भूमि भी जो समस्त भूतों की धात्री स्वरूप वालो है वहीं पर उन शेष भगवान् के आगे बेठी हुई थी भौर बहुत ही प्रीति के साय सदा कथाओं का श्रवण किया करती थी । बह भूमि साक्षात् इस मही के धारण करने बाले शेष भगवान् से जो-जो भी पूछा करती है उसको समस्त ऋषिगण वहीं पर संस्थित होकर उनके ही अनुग्रह् के होने से श्रवण किया करते हैं। है वत्स ! मैंने भो वहां परम शुभ कृष्ण परमामृत का श्रवण किया था ।८-१०। उस स्तोत्र को मैं अब आपको
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty six thousand years according to the human reckoning should be known as equal to a hundred years. This is remembered as divine reckoning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty six thousand years according to the human reckoning should be known as equal to a hundred years. This is remembered as divine reckoning.

verses.sanskrit: सामान्यविपरीतार्थैः कृतशास्त्राकुलं त्विदम् । आध्वर्यवस्य प्रस्थानैर्बहुधा व्याकुलीकृतैः
verses.transliteration: sāmānyaviparītārthaiḥ kṛtaśāstrākulaṃ tvidam / ādhvaryavasya prasthānairbahudhā vyākulīkṛtaiḥ
verses.translation: Wise persons and sages have said that there arc foui Yugas in Bharata subcontinent. They arc Krta, TrclA, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.hindi: बतलाऊगा जिसको प्राप्त करने के लिये तुम यहाँ पर आये हो । इस स्तोत्र में बाराह आदि भगवातू के अवतारों का चरित है जो समस्त प्रकार के पापों का विनाश कर देने वाला होता है।११। यह चरित परमाधिक सुख-सौ भाग्य के प्रदान करने बाला है--परलोक में जाकर इस भोतिक शरीर के त्याग
verses.wordMeaning: Wise persons and sages have said that there arc foui Yugas in Bharata subcontinent. They arc Krta, TrclA, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wise persons and sages have said that there arc foui Yugas in Bharata subcontinent. They arc Krta, TrclA, Dvapara and Kali.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवाथर्वऋक्साम्नां विकल्पैश्चापि संज्ञया । व्याकुलेद्वापरे नित्यं क्रियते भिन्न दर्शनैः
verses.transliteration: tathaivātharvaṛksāmnāṃ vikalpaiścāpi saṃjñayā / vyākuledvāpare nityaṃ kriyate bhinna darśanaiḥ
verses.translation: It b strange that Yugas should be restricted to India (Bh&rata)
verses.hindi: करने के पश्चात् मोक्ष का भी देने वाला है जिससे इस संसार में बारम्बार जन्म-मरण के महान् कष्टों से छुटकारा मिल जाया करता है। और यह चरित ऐसा अद्भुत है कि जो पूर्ण ज्ञान और विशेष ज्ञान का भी कारण होना है । इस बसुन्धरा देवी ने इन सव का श्रवण किया था और यह बहुत ही अधिक प्रसन्त हुई थी, है वत्स ! फिर धराके धारण करने वाले अनन्त भगवान् से बोली थी ।१२। परम प्रणत होकर इस भूमि ने फिर भगवान् कृष्ण की सोला को जानने के लिए भ्रायंना की थी । धरणी ने कहा-भग- वान् श्री कुष्ण चन्द्र जो ने नन्द गोपराज के ब्रज में निवास करने वाले ब्रज-
verses.wordMeaning: It b strange that Yugas should be restricted to India (Bh&rata)
verses.commentary: Sense: It b strange that Yugas should be restricted to India (Bh&rata)

verses.sanskrit: तेषां भेदाः प्रतीभेदा विकल्पाश्चापि संख्याया । द्वापरे संप्रवर्त्तते विनश्यन्ति ततः कलौ
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ bhedāḥ pratībhedā vikalpāścāpi saṃkhyāyā / dvāpare saṃpravarttate vinaśyanti tataḥ kalau
verses.translation: Tugasaitkkyd (the total number of years in all the four Yugas together) is mentioned as twelve thousand (divine) yean for the four yugas viz. Kfta, Treta» Dvapara and Kali.
verses.hindi: वासी मनुष्यों का भी जन्म अपना अवतार धारण कर अनेक अदभूत लीला-
verses.wordMeaning: Tugasaitkkyd (the total number of years in all the four Yugas together) is mentioned as twelve thousand (divine) yean for the four yugas viz. Kfta, Treta» Dvapara and Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tugasaitkkyd (the total number of years in all the four Yugas together) is mentioned as twelve thousand (divine) yean for the four yugas viz. Kfta, Treta» Dvapara and Kali.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां विपर्ययोत्पन्ना भवन्ति द्वापरे पुनः । अवृष्टिर्मरणं चैव तथैव व्याध्युपद्रवाः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ viparyayotpannā bhavanti dvāpare punaḥ / avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathaiva vyādhyupadravāḥ
verses.translation: In this connection the years are found to be as follows in accordance with the human calculation: I shall mention the number of years in the Krta Yuga. Understand it,
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमामृत स्तोत्र का कथन   २७६ 'बिहारों से अलंकृत कर दिया था ।१३। अपनी लीला से ही विग्रह (मानवीय शरीर) धारण करने बाले उन श्री कृष्ण देव के जय की अनेक उपाच्चियों से नियुक्त अनेक शुभ नाम है
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection the years are found to be as follows in accordance with the human calculation: I shall mention the number of years in the Krta Yuga. Understand it,
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection the years are found to be as follows in accordance with the human calculation: I shall mention the number of years in the Krta Yuga. Understand it,

verses.sanskrit: वाङ्मनः कर्मर्जेदुःखैर्निर्वेदो जायते पुनः । निर्वेदाज्जायते तेषां दुःखमोक्षविचारणा
verses.transliteration: vāṅmanaḥ karmarjeduḥkhairnirvedo jāyate punaḥ / nirvedājjāyate teṣāṃ duḥkhamokṣavicāraṇā
verses.translation: The Krta Yuga consists of one million four hundred and forty thousatid human yean.
verses.wordMeaning: The Krta Yuga consists of one million four hundred and forty thousatid human yean.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Krta Yuga consists of one million four hundred and forty thousatid human yean.

verses.sanskrit: विचारणाच्च वैराग्यं वैराग्याद्दोषदर्शनम् । दोषदर्शनतस्चैव द्वापरे ऽज्ञानसंभवः
verses.transliteration: vicāraṇācca vairāgyaṃ vairāgyāddoṣadarśanam / doṣadarśanatascaiva dvāpare 'jñānasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: According to this Parana the period of Yugas is as follows Tuga Tears
verses.hindi: तत्तानि ब्रूहि नामानि वासुदेवस्य वासुके नात: परतरं पुण्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते ।
verses.wordMeaning: According to this Parana the period of Yugas is as follows Tuga Tears
verses.commentary: Sense: According to this Parana the period of Yugas is as follows Tuga Tears

verses.sanskrit: तेषाम ज्ञानिनां पूर्वमाद्ये स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे । उत्पद्यन्ते हि शास्त्राणां द्वापरे परिपन्थिनः
verses.transliteration: teṣāma jñānināṃ pūrvamādye svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / utpadyante hi śāstrāṇāṃ dvāpare paripanthinaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the sets of four Yugas numbering leventyonc are called Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sets of four Yugas numbering leventyonc are called Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sets of four Yugas numbering leventyonc are called Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्वेदविकल्पश्च ह्यगानां ज्योतिषस्य च । अर्थशास्त्रविकल्पाश्च हेतुशास्त्रविकल्पनम्
verses.transliteration: āyurvedavikalpaśca hyagānāṃ jyotiṣasya ca / arthaśāstravikalpāśca hetuśāstravikalpanam
verses.translation: No matter can be mentioned in two ways simulta¬ neously (?) Though it lias come traditionally in due order, these two Yias have not been recounted to vou before.
verses.hindi: समस्तजपयज्ञानां फलदं पापनाशनम् । अणु देवि प्रवक्यामि नाम्नामष्टोत्तरं शतम्
verses.wordMeaning: No matter can be mentioned in two ways simulta¬ neously (?) Though it lias come traditionally in due order, these two Yias have not been recounted to vou before.
verses.commentary: Sense: No matter can be mentioned in two ways simulta¬ neously (?) Though it lias come traditionally in due order, these two Yias have not been recounted to vou before.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्रियाकल्पसूत्राणां भाष्यविद्याविकल्पनम् । स्मृतिशास्त्रप्रभेदश्च प्रस्थानानि पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: prakriyākalpasūtrāṇāṃ bhāṣyavidyāvikalpanam / smṛtiśāstraprabhedaśca prasthānāni pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: W. 43-92 describe the Tugadharma of the Treta Yuga:
verses.wordMeaning: W. 43-92 describe the Tugadharma of the Treta Yuga:
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 43-92 describe the Tugadharma of the Treta Yuga:

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरेष्वभिवर्त्तन्ते मतिभेदाश्रयान्नृणाम् । मनसा कर्मणा वाचा कृच्छ्राद्वार्ता प्रसिद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: dvāpareṣvabhivarttante matibhedāśrayānnṛṇām / manasā karmaṇā vācā kṛcchrādvārtā prasiddhyati
verses.translation: The Rk, Yajus, Saman and Atharvan Mantras were uttered by the seven sages and Manu expounded the Smarta Dharnia (Dharma as laid down in Srnrtis).
verses.hindi: नाम्तामष्टोत्तरशतस्याइमेव ऋषिः प्रिये श्रीकृष्ण: कमलानाथो वासुदेवः सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Rk, Yajus, Saman and Atharvan Mantras were uttered by the seven sages and Manu expounded the Smarta Dharnia (Dharma as laid down in Srnrtis).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Rk, Yajus, Saman and Atharvan Mantras were uttered by the seven sages and Manu expounded the Smarta Dharnia (Dharma as laid down in Srnrtis).

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरे सर्वभूतानां कायक्लेशपुरस्कृता । लोभो वृत्तिर्वणिक्पूर्वा तत्त्वानामविनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: dvāpare sarvabhūtānāṃ kāyakleśapuraskṛtā / lobho vṛttirvaṇikpūrvā tattvānāmaviniścayaḥ
verses.translation: In the beginning of Treta, the undivided compact Vedas alone were the bridges (i.c. the sole authority) unto Dharma. But owing to the contraction in the period of longe¬ vity they are abandoned in;hc Dvaparas.
verses.hindi: उन श्रीकृष्ण के नामों में जो बहुत ही प्रमुख उनके नाम हैं उनके
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of Treta, the undivided compact Vedas alone were the bridges (i.c. the sole authority) unto Dharma. But owing to the contraction in the period of longe¬ vity they are abandoned in;hc Dvaparas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of Treta, the undivided compact Vedas alone were the bridges (i.c. the sole authority) unto Dharma. But owing to the contraction in the period of longe¬ vity they are abandoned in;hc Dvaparas.

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रप्रणयनं धर्माणां संकरस्तथा । वर्णाश्रमपरिध्वंसः कामक्रोधौ तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstrapraṇayanaṃ dharmāṇāṃ saṃkarastathā / varṇāśramaparidhvaṃsaḥ kāmakrodhau tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Though they are the same in meaning, righteousness, holy rites and ancillary subjects, they undergo changes in every Yuga.
verses.hindi: श्रवण करने को कामना वाली मैं बहुत अधिक समय से हो रही है दे भगवन्वासुके ! भगवान् वासुदेव के उन परम शुभ नामों को अब कृपा करके मेरे आगे वतलाइए ।१४। क्योंकि इस संसार में इससे परतर अर्थात् बड़ा अन्य कोई भी पुण्य नहीं है । तात्पर्य तह है कि भगवान् श्रौकृष्ण के परम शुभ नामों का स्मरण और श्रवण लोक में सबसे अधिक पुण्य कार्यं है । भगवान् शेष ने कहा--हे परम श्रेष्ठ आरोह वाली वसुन्धरे ! भगवान् श्री कृष्ण के एक सो आठ नामों का एक शतक स्तोत्र है और बह मानवों के लिए मुक्ति के प्रदात करने वाला है ।१६। यह शतक समी प्रकार कें मङ्गल
verses.wordMeaning: Though they are the same in meaning, righteousness, holy rites and ancillary subjects, they undergo changes in every Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though they are the same in meaning, righteousness, holy rites and ancillary subjects, they undergo changes in every Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरेषु प्रवर्त्तन्ते रागो लोभो वधस्तथा । वेदं व्यासश्चतुर्द्धा तु व्यस्यते द्वापरादिषु
verses.transliteration: dvāpareṣu pravarttante rāgo lobho vadhastathā / vedaṃ vyāsaścaturddhā tu vyasyate dvāparādiṣu
verses.translation: TheKsatriyas have Arombhas (enterprises) as their Yajfla (sacrifice); the Vaiiyas have Havis (offerings of ghee etc,) forYajfia; the Sudras have service for Yajfta and excel¬ lent Brahma have Japa (chanting of Mantras) for Yfta.
verses.hindi: कार्यों में शिरोमणि है तया लौकिक साधारण वैभवों की प्रापि की तो बात
verses.wordMeaning: TheKsatriyas have Arombhas (enterprises) as their Yajfla (sacrifice); the Vaiiyas have Havis (offerings of ghee etc,) forYajfia; the Sudras have service for Yajfta and excel¬ lent Brahma have Japa (chanting of Mantras) for Yfta.
verses.commentary: Sense: TheKsatriyas have Arombhas (enterprises) as their Yajfla (sacrifice); the Vaiiyas have Havis (offerings of ghee etc,) forYajfia; the Sudras have service for Yajfta and excel¬ lent Brahma have Japa (chanting of Mantras) for Yfta.

verses.sanskrit: निःशेषे द्वापरे तस्मिंस्तस्य संध्या तु यादृशी । प्रतिष्ठते गुणैर्हीनो धर्मो ऽसौ द्वापरस्य तु
verses.transliteration: niḥśeṣe dvāpare tasmiṃstasya saṃdhyā tu yādṛśī / pratiṣṭhate guṇairhīno dharmo 'sau dvāparasya tu
verses.translation: Then, in the Treta Yuga, people of all castes were
verses.hindi: रद   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण ही क्या है यह तो अणिमा-महिमा आदि जो आठ सिद्धियाँ हैं उनको भी देने वाला है। बड़े-बड़े महान् जो करोड़ों प्रकार के पातक हैं उनका भी विनाश कर देने वाला और समस्त तीयोँ' के स्तान-ध्यान तथा अटन का जो पुण्यफल टू आ करता है उनके प्रदात कर देने वाला होता है ।१७। सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Then, in the Treta Yuga, people of all castes were
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, in the Treta Yuga, people of all castes were

verses.sanskrit: तथैव संध्या पादेन ह्यङ्गः संध्या इतीष्यते । द्वापरस्यावशेषेण तिष्यस्य तु निबोधत
verses.transliteration: tathaiva saṃdhyā pādena hyaṅgaḥ saṃdhyā itīṣyate / dvāparasyāvaśeṣeṇa tiṣyasya tu nibodhata
verses.translation: Katriyas obeyed the Brahmanas. The Vai syas obeyed the Ktriyas. The Sudras obeyed the Vaiiyas. The people co¬ operated with one another.
verses.hindi: तरह के अश्वमेधादि यज्ञों एवं जपों का जो भी फल होता है उसके देने बाला है और सभी पापों के नाश करने वाला है। है देवि! अब आप उस नामों के शतक को सुनिए, मैं आपको बतलाता हूँ जो एक सौ आठ भगवान् के नामों वाला है ।१८। परम पुण्यमय अन्य सहस्र नामों की तीन बार
verses.wordMeaning: Katriyas obeyed the Brahmanas. The Vai syas obeyed the Ktriyas. The Sudras obeyed the Vaiiyas. The people co¬ operated with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Katriyas obeyed the Brahmanas. The Vai syas obeyed the Ktriyas. The Sudras obeyed the Vaiiyas. The people co¬ operated with one another.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरस्याशसेषण प्रतिपत्तिः कलेरपि । हिंसासूयानृतं माया वधश्चैव तपस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: dvāparasyāśaseṣaṇa pratipattiḥ kalerapi / hiṃsāsūyānṛtaṃ māyā vadhaścaiva tapasvinām
verses.translation: Their activities were auspicious; so also were their castes and stages of life. They were pure in the thoughts of the mind, in the utterance of words and in their physical activiry.
verses.hindi: आवृत्ति के करने से जो फल प्राप्त होता है वह पुण्य-फल भगवान् श्रो कृष्ण के नाम की एक ही आवृत्ति के द्वारा एक ही नाम दिया करता. है.।१९। इसे कारण से यह स्तोत्र विशेष पुण्य बाला है और पातकों का विनाशक है। हे प्रिये ! इस परम शुभ नामों के अष्टोत्तर शत का में हीं ऋषि हँ इसका छन्द अनुष्टुप् है और इसका देवता श्री कृष्ण के प्रियका आवहन करने वाला योग है + अब यहाँ से आगे बह, अष्टोत्तर शतक का आरम्भ होता है--श्रोकृष्ण-कमला (महालक्ष्मी) के नाथ-बसुदेव के पुत वासुदेव और सनातन अर्थात् सदा सर्वदा से चले आने वाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Their activities were auspicious; so also were their castes and stages of life. They were pure in the thoughts of the mind, in the utterance of words and in their physical activiry.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their activities were auspicious; so also were their castes and stages of life. They were pure in the thoughts of the mind, in the utterance of words and in their physical activiry.

verses.sanskrit: एते स्वभावास्तिष्यस्य साधयन्ति च वै प्रजाः । एष धर्मः कृतः कृत्स्नो धर्मश्च परिहीयते
verses.transliteration: ete svabhāvāstiṣyasya sādhayanti ca vai prajāḥ / eṣa dharmaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛtsno dharmaśca parihīyate
verses.translation: Again, the subjects out of delusion kept up those Dharmas(but) with mutual antagonism. They then approached Manu.
verses.wordMeaning: Again, the subjects out of delusion kept up those Dharmas(but) with mutual antagonism. They then approached Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again, the subjects out of delusion kept up those Dharmas(but) with mutual antagonism. They then approached Manu.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा कर्मणा स्तुत्या वार्ता सिध्यति वा न वा । कलौ प्रमारकी रोगः सततं क्षुद्भयानि च
verses.transliteration: manasā karmaṇā stutyā vārtā sidhyati vā na vā / kalau pramārakī rogaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayāni ca
verses.translation: Sv&yambhuva Manu, the Prajapati (lord of the subjects) saw the reality of situation. After meditation, he begot two sons of Satarupa.
verses.wordMeaning: Sv&yambhuva Manu, the Prajapati (lord of the subjects) saw the reality of situation. After meditation, he begot two sons of Satarupa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sv&yambhuva Manu, the Prajapati (lord of the subjects) saw the reality of situation. After meditation, he begot two sons of Satarupa.

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिभयं घोरं देशानां च विपर्ययः । न प्रमाणं स्मृतेरस्ति तिष्ये लोकेषु वै युगे
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ / na pramāṇaṃ smṛterasti tiṣye lokeṣu vai yuge
verses.translation: They were Priyavrala and Uttanapada. They were the first kings. Thereafter, kings were bom. They wielded the staff of Law and Order.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमामुत का कथन   २५
verses.wordMeaning: They were Priyavrala and Uttanapada. They were the first kings. Thereafter, kings were bom. They wielded the staff of Law and Order.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Priyavrala and Uttanapada. They were the first kings. Thereafter, kings were bom. They wielded the staff of Law and Order.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थो म्रियते कश्चिद्यौव नस्थस्तथापरः । स्थविराः के ऽपि कौमारे म्रियन्ते वै कलौ प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: garbhastho mriyate kaścidyauva nasthastathāparaḥ / sthavirāḥ ke 'pi kaumāre mriyante vai kalau prajāḥ
verses.translation: Those kings were called Rdjaris because they delighted and pacified the subjects. Those with hidden sins could not be controlled by those kings.
verses.hindi: वसुदेव को पुत्र--परम पुण्यमय--लीला ही से मानुष शरीर के धारण करने वाले हैं । श्रीवत्स का चिह्न ओर कोस्तुभ मणि धारण के करने वाले-यशोदा के वत्सल और हरि हैं। हरि का अर्थ होता है पापों के हरण करने वाले हैं ।२२। चार भुजाओं :में सुदर्शन चक्र, कोसोदकी गदा, शङ्क ओर असि आदि आयुधों के धारण करने वाले हैं। देवको के नन्दन- श्रीदेवी के स्पामी और नन्दगोप की ग्रिया यशोदा के आत्मज अर्थात् पुत्र हैं ।२३। यमुना के वेग का संहार करने वाले  बलभद्रजी परम प्रिय अनुज अर्थात् छोटे भाई हैं । पूतना के जोवन का हुरण करने वाले तथा शकटासुर
verses.wordMeaning: Those kings were called Rdjaris because they delighted and pacified the subjects. Those with hidden sins could not be controlled by those kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those kings were called Rdjaris because they delighted and pacified the subjects. Those with hidden sins could not be controlled by those kings.

verses.sanskrit: दुरिष्टैर्दुरधीतैश्च दुष्कृतैश्च दुरागमैः । विप्राणां कर्मदोषैस्तैः प्रजानां जायते भयम्
verses.transliteration: duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca duṣkṛtaiśca durāgamaiḥ / viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaistaiḥ prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam
verses.translation: Yama, king of Dharma and son of the Sun-god is remembered as their chastiser. The classifications of castes are said to have been begun in the Treta.
verses.hindi: का हनन करने वाले हैं ।२४। नन्दगोप ब्रह्मजन अर्थात् ब्रजवासी मनुष्यों को आनन्द देने वाले ओर सत्-चित् (ज्ञान) तथा आनन्द के शरीर बाले हैं अर्थात् सत्-चित् और आनन्द ये तीनों ही वस्तुएं उनके शरीर में बिद्यमान हैं। नवनीत (मक्खन) से विलिप्त अ्गों वाले हैं जिस समय में यशोदाजी
verses.wordMeaning: Yama, king of Dharma and son of the Sun-god is remembered as their chastiser. The classifications of castes are said to have been begun in the Treta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama, king of Dharma and son of the Sun-god is remembered as their chastiser. The classifications of castes are said to have been begun in the Treta.

verses.sanskrit: हिंसा माया तथेर्ष्या च क्रोधो ऽसूया क्षमा नृषु । तिष्ये भवन्ति जन्तूनां रागो लोभश्च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: hiṃsā māyā tatherṣyā ca krodho 'sūyā kṣamā nṛṣu / tiṣye bhavanti jantūnāṃ rāgo lobhaśca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: At the end of a thousand Righteous activities, the Dharma of nonviolence begins to function. It is then that heroes are born with great strength and span of life.
verses.hindi: दधि मन्थन कर रही थो उस समय में दधिभाण्ड का भयंकर नवनीत. अपने समस्त अङ्गों में लपेट लिया था  नबओत के लिए नट हैं अर्थात् थोड़ा सा नबनीत पाने के लिए गोपा ङ्गनाओं के यहाँ अनेक नृत्य आदि की लोलायें करने बाले हैं । अनघ अर्थात् निष्पाप स्वरूप बाले हैं ।२५। नवनीत के घोड़े से भाग का आहार करने बाले हैं अर्थात् दधि और मकखन' के विक्रय. करने बाली ब्रजाङ््नाओं को मार्ग में रोककर नवनीत का आहार किया करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of a thousand Righteous activities, the Dharma of nonviolence begins to function. It is then that heroes are born with great strength and span of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of a thousand Righteous activities, the Dharma of nonviolence begins to function. It is then that heroes are born with great strength and span of life.

verses.sanskrit: संक्षोभो जायते ऽत्यथै करिमासाद्य वै युगम् । पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे वै परमायुस्तदा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣobho jāyate 'tyathai karimāsādya vai yugam / pūrṇe varṣasahasre vai paramāyustadā nṛṇām
verses.translation: They had renounced punishments. They were ex¬ tremely fortunate and highly righteous. They were expounders of Brahman. Their eyes were extensive like the petals of a lotus. They had broad, wide chests and their limbs were well-knit together.
verses.hindi: राजा मुचुकुन्द के ऊपर कृपा करने वाले हैं। जिस समय जरासन्ध से युद्ध हो रहा था तब स्ववं भाग कर वहाँ पर पहुँच गये ये जहाँ पर विद्रित सुचुकुन्द गुफा में यह् वरदान लेकर सो रहा था कि उसे जो भी जगायेगा चह भस्म हो जायगा । उस पर अपनी पीताम्बर डालकर आप छिप गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: They had renounced punishments. They were ex¬ tremely fortunate and highly righteous. They were expounders of Brahman. Their eyes were extensive like the petals of a lotus. They had broad, wide chests and their limbs were well-knit together.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had renounced punishments. They were ex¬ tremely fortunate and highly righteous. They were expounders of Brahman. Their eyes were extensive like the petals of a lotus. They had broad, wide chests and their limbs were well-knit together.

verses.sanskrit: नाधीयते तदा वेदान्न यजं ते द्विजातयः । उत्सीदन्ति नराश्चैव क्षत्रियाश्च विशः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: nādhīyate tadā vedānna yajaṃ te dvijātayaḥ / utsīdanti narāścaiva kṣatriyāśca viśaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: The sovereigns of the world in ihc Trcta Yuga were capable of agonizing even lions; they were extremely vigorous. Their mode of walking was like that of intoxicated elephants. They were great wielders of bow (great experts in archery).
verses.hindi: जरासन्ध ने उसे श्रीकृष्ण समझ कर जगाया और भस्म हो गया था फिर भगवाचू ने दर्शन देकर उसको प्रसन्न किया था । सोलह सहसत स्त्रियों के स्वामी हैँ-ज्रिभङ्गी.हैं अर्थात्. चरण-कटि और ग्रोवा तीनों को तिरछा करके बंशी बादन करने वाले हैं तथा परमाधिक मधुर आकृति से समन्वित है ।२६। अमृत के समान जो शुकदेव की वाणी रूपी सागर है उसके आप चन्द्र हैं अर्थात् शुकदेव जी के द्वारा श्रीमदुभायवत की रचना हुई , उसके प्रकाशन चन्द्र हैँ । गोविन्दों के पति हैं । जब आप बालक थे तब ब्रज में गोवत्सों का पालन करने के लिए वन में सङचरण करने वाले हैं तथा घेनुक नामक कंस.
verses.wordMeaning: The sovereigns of the world in ihc Trcta Yuga were capable of agonizing even lions; they were extremely vigorous. Their mode of walking was like that of intoxicated elephants. They were great wielders of bow (great experts in archery).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sovereigns of the world in ihc Trcta Yuga were capable of agonizing even lions; they were extremely vigorous. Their mode of walking was like that of intoxicated elephants. They were great wielders of bow (great experts in archery).

verses.sanskrit: शूद्राणामन्त्ययोनेस्तु संबन्धा ब्राह्मणैः सह । भवन्तीह कलौ तस्मिञ्छयनासनभोजनैः
verses.transliteration: śūdrāṇāmantyayonestu saṃbandhā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha / bhavantīha kalau tasmiñchayanāsanabhojanaiḥ
verses.translation: The following seven things viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a spouse, a treasure, a horse and an elephant—these arc considered to be the seven jeweb of emperors.
verses.hindi: रबर   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण के द्वारा प्रेषित असुर का मर्देन करने चाले हैं ।२७। तृणावत्त असुर को तूण के समान हनन करके डाल दिया है और जो दो अजु न वृक्षों का जोड़ा शाप बश वृक्ष हो गये ये उनका भंजन कर बृक्षों की योनि छुड़ा देने वाले हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: The following seven things viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a spouse, a treasure, a horse and an elephant—these arc considered to be the seven jeweb of emperors.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following seven things viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a spouse, a treasure, a horse and an elephant—these arc considered to be the seven jeweb of emperors.

verses.sanskrit: राजानः शूद्रभूयिष्ठाः पाखण्डानां प्रवर्त्तकाः । गुणहीनाः प्रजाश्चैव तदा वै संप्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: rājānaḥ śūdrabhūyiṣṭhāḥ pākhaṇḍānāṃ pravarttakāḥ / guṇahīnāḥ prajāścaiva tadā vai saṃpravarttate
verses.translation: They say that the following seven are the inanimate jewels of the sovereign over the world, viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a sword. The excellent shield is the fifth, the flag and the treasure.
verses.hindi: बहुत ही ऊंचे तालों के भेदन करने वाले हैं तथा तमाल बृक्षों के सहश श्यामल आकृति वाले हैं ।२८ा गोपगोपीश्वरो तोगी सूर्यकोटिसमप्र'
verses.wordMeaning: They say that the following seven are the inanimate jewels of the sovereign over the world, viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a sword. The excellent shield is the fifth, the flag and the treasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that the following seven are the inanimate jewels of the sovereign over the world, viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a sword. The excellent shield is the fifth, the flag and the treasure.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्मेधा बलं रूपं कुलं चैव प्रणश्यति । शूद्राश्च ब्राह्मणाचाराः शूद्राचाराश्च ब्राह्मणाः
verses.transliteration: āyurmedhā balaṃ rūpaṃ kulaṃ caiva praṇaśyati / śūdrāśca brāhmaṇācārāḥ śūdrācārāśca brāhmaṇāḥ
verses.translation: (The seven jewels of an Emperor) having life are mentioned as follows: The Queen, the family priest, the com- mander-in-chief, the chariot-maker, the minuter, the horae and the elephant.
verses.wordMeaning: (The seven jewels of an Emperor) having life are mentioned as follows: The Queen, the family priest, the com- mander-in-chief, the chariot-maker, the minuter, the horae and the elephant.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The seven jewels of an Emperor) having life are mentioned as follows: The Queen, the family priest, the com- mander-in-chief, the chariot-maker, the minuter, the horae and the elephant.

verses.sanskrit: राजवृत्ताः स्थिताश्चोरा श्चोराचाराश्च पार्थिवाः । भृत्या एते ह्यसुभृतो युगान्ते समवस्थिते
verses.transliteration: rājavṛttāḥ sthitāścorā ścorācārāśca pārthivāḥ / bhṛtyā ete hyasubhṛto yugānte samavasthite
verses.translation: These jewels are divine ones. They have been (naturally) acquired by the noble«uled ones. These fourteen (jewels) should be assigned to all Emperors.
verses.hindi: बनमाली पीतवासाः पारिजातापहारकः । अजो निरंजनः कामजनक कंजलोचनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: These jewels are divine ones. They have been (naturally) acquired by the noble«uled ones. These fourteen (jewels) should be assigned to all Emperors.
verses.commentary: Sense: These jewels are divine ones. They have been (naturally) acquired by the noble«uled ones. These fourteen (jewels) should be assigned to all Emperors.

verses.sanskrit: अशीलिन्यो ऽनृताश्चैव स्त्रियो मद्यामिषप्रियाः । मायाविन्यो भविष्यन्ति युगान्ते मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: aśīlinyo 'nṛtāścaiva striyo madyāmiṣapriyāḥ / māyāvinyo bhaviṣyanti yugānte munisattama
verses.translation: W. 74-77 describe two lists of seven 'jewris* of an eonperui {Cckrt perlui) Here 14 jewels are mentioned. A similar list of royal jewris is ibood in P&li literature. The represenuUofi of the 2itd cent B.C. of a Cakravtrtm at Jigayyetta shows these jewels* and one more fcaturat the touch of Coboporh' band above (towards the sky) it shows gold mni.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 74-77 describe two lists of seven 'jewris* of an eonperui {Cckrt perlui) Here 14 jewels are mentioned. A similar list of royal jewris is ibood in P&li literature. The represenuUofi of the 2itd cent B.C.…
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 74-77 describe two lists of seven 'jewris* of an eonperui {Cckrt perlui) Here 14 jewels are mentioned. A similar list of royal jewris is ibood in P&li literature. The represenuUofi of the 2itd cent B.C.…

verses.sanskrit: एकपत्न्यो न शिष्यन्ति युगान्ते मुनिसत्तम । श्वापदप्रबलत्वं च गवां चैव ह्युपक्षयः
verses.transliteration: ekapatnyo na śiṣyanti yugānte munisattama / śvāpadaprabalatvaṃ ca gavāṃ caiva hyupakṣayaḥ
verses.translation: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, emperors are bom on the Earth from a pare of Visnu.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, emperors are bom on the Earth from a pare of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, emperors are bom on the Earth from a pare of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: साधूनां विनिवृत्तिं च विद्यास्तस्मिन्युगक्षये । तदा धर्मो महोदर्के दुर्लभो दानमूलवान्
verses.transliteration: sādhūnāṃ vinivṛttiṃ ca vidyāstasminyugakṣaye / tadā dharmo mahodarke durlabho dānamūlavān
verses.translation: Emperors arc bom in the Trcta Yuga of all the Manvantaras of ihe past> present and future.
verses.wordMeaning: Emperors arc bom in the Trcta Yuga of all the Manvantaras of ihe past> present and future.
verses.commentary: Sense: Emperors arc bom in the Trcta Yuga of all the Manvantaras of ihe past> present and future.

verses.sanskrit: चातुराश्रमशैथिल्यो धर्मः प्रविचरिष्यति । तदा ह्यल्पफला भूमिः क्वचिच्चापि महाफला
verses.transliteration: cāturāśramaśaithilyo dharmaḥ pravicariṣyati / tadā hyalpaphalā bhūmiḥ kvaciccāpi mahāphalā
verses.translation: The following four shall be very wonderful and excellent in regard to those kings:—viz. strength (or army), Dharma (virtue, piety), happiness and wealth.
verses.hindi: ब्रज में समस्त गोप और जो गोपियां थीं उन संबके ईश हैं महा योगी और करोड़ों सूयो को प्रभा के समान प्रदीप्त प्रभा से समन्वितं हैं। इला के पति--परम ज्योति स्वरूप यादवों में प्रमुख और यदु कुल के उद्द- हून करने वाले हैं ।२९। वनमाला के धारण करने वाले-पीत वणं के वस्त्रों के पहिनने वाले तथा पारिजात का महेन्द्रपुरी से आहरण करने वाले हैं-- गोवद्धनं गिरि के उद्बर्ता अर्थात् अपनी अ गुलि पर उठाने वाले-गौओं के पॉलन-पोषण करने वाले और समस्त चरअचरों के पालक हूँ ।३०। अजन्मा- निरंजन्-कामदेव के जन्म दाता तथा कमलों के सहश लोचनों वाले हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The following four shall be very wonderful and excellent in regard to those kings:—viz. strength (or army), Dharma (virtue, piety), happiness and wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following four shall be very wonderful and excellent in regard to those kings:—viz. strength (or army), Dharma (virtue, piety), happiness and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: न रक्षितारो बोक्तारो बलिभागस्य पार्थिवाः । युगान्ते च भविष्यन्ति स्वरक्षणपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: na rakṣitāro boktāro balibhāgasya pārthivāḥ / yugānte ca bhaviṣyanti svarakṣaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Wealth, dharma, love, fameand victory are acquired by the kings on a par with one anotlter and without coining into conflict.
verses.hindi: मंधुं नामेक बैतमे के हनन कर्ता--मथुरापुरी के नाथ-द्वा रंको के स्वामी और
verses.wordMeaning: Wealth, dharma, love, fameand victory are acquired by the kings on a par with one anotlter and without coining into conflict.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wealth, dharma, love, fameand victory are acquired by the kings on a par with one anotlter and without coining into conflict.

verses.sanskrit: अरक्षितारो राजानो विप्राः शूद्रोपजीविनः । शूद्राभिवादिनः सर्वे युगान्ते द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: arakṣitāro rājāno viprāḥ śūdropajīvinaḥ / śūdrābhivādinaḥ sarve yugānte dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: They over-power even the sages by means of Ariima (minuteness) and other AUvaiyas, the power of lordship, learning and penance.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमामृत का कथंन   २५३ बलशाली हैं ।३१। बृन्दावन के मध्य में सञ्चरण करने वाले-तुलसी की माला से सुशोभित अर्थात् तुलसी की माला के भूषण वाले हैं। स्यमन्तक नाम वाली मणि को जाम्बवान् से हरण करने वाले तथा नर और नारायण के स्वरूपधारो हैं ।३२। कुब्जा जो कंस नृष की चन्दन सेविका थी वह थी
verses.wordMeaning: They over-power even the sages by means of Ariima (minuteness) and other AUvaiyas, the power of lordship, learning and penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They over-power even the sages by means of Ariima (minuteness) and other AUvaiyas, the power of lordship, learning and penance.

verses.sanskrit: अदृशूला जनपदाः शिवशूला द्विजास्तथा । प्रमदाः केशशूलाश्च युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: adṛśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlā dvijāstathā / pramadāḥ keśaśūlāśca yugānte samupasthite
verses.translation: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.hindi: तो परम सुन्दरी किन्तु टेड़े-मेड़ो शरीर वाली थी। उसके द्वारा समाकृष्ट बस्तों के घारण करने वाले हैं। कुष्जा श्रीकृष्ण पर मोहित हो गयी थी- यह तात्पर्ये है । मायो ओर परम पुरुष हैं । कंस के मल्ल चाणूर और मुष्टिक असुर थे उनके साथ यस्त्र युद्ध में परम कोविद हैं ।३३। इस संसार के वेरी
verses.wordMeaning: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.
verses.commentary: Sense: (They overpower) Devas, Danavas and human beings by means of strength and austerity.

verses.sanskrit: तपोयज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजोत्तमाः । यतयश्च भविष्यन्ति बहवो ऽस्मिन्कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ / yatayaśca bhaviṣyanti bahavo 'sminkalau yuge
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: हैं अर्थात् संसार में होने वाले दुःखों के विनाशक हैं-कंस के निपात करने बाले-मुर देश्य कें नाशक मौर नरक नामक असुर के अन्त कर देने वाले. हैं। अनादि ब्रह्मचारी हैं अर्थात् ऐसे ब्रह्मचारी हैं जिनका कभी कोई आदि. नहीं है तथा कृष्ण-द्रौपदी के व्यसन के अपकर्षण करने वाले हैं अर्थात्, दुःशासन के द्वारा चीर खींचकर दुर्योधन की सभा में उसको लज्जित किया जा रहा था उस समय चीर का वर्धन करके उसकी लज्जा की रक्षा करने बाले हैं ।३४। राजा शिशुपाल के शिर के छेदन करने वाले हैं और राजा; कौरवेश्वर दुर्योधन के कुल का अन्त कर देने वाले हैं। विदुर और अक्र,र
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रवर्षी यदा देवस्तदा प्राहुर्युगक्षयम् । सर्वे वाणिजकाश्चा पि भविष्यन्त्यधमे युगे
verses.transliteration: citravarṣī yadā devastadā prāhuryugakṣayam / sarve vāṇijakāścā pi bhaviṣyantyadhame yuge
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: ह वरदानों के प्रदाता हैं और विश्वरूप अर्थात् विराद् स्वरूप के प्रदशेक

verses.sanskrit: भूयिष्ठं कूटमानैश्च पण्यं विक्रीणते जनाः । कुशीलचर्यापाखण्डैर्व्याधरूपैः समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: bhūyiṣṭhaṃ kūṭamānaiśca paṇyaṃ vikrīṇate janāḥ / kuśīlacaryāpākhaṇḍairvyādharūpaiḥ samāvṛtam

verses.transliteration: puruṣālpaṃ bahustrīkaṃ yugānte samupasthite / bāhuyācanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparam

verses.transliteration: avyākartā krūravākyā nārjavo nānasūyakaḥ / na kṛte pratikarttā ca yuge kṣīṇe bhaviṣyati

verses.hindi: दामोदरो यज्ञ भोक्ता दानवेद्रविनाशनः नारायणः परं ब्रह्म पन्नगाशनवाहनः ।

verses.transliteration: aśaṅkā caiva patite yugānte tasya lakṣaṇam / tataḥ śūnya vasumatī bhaviṣyati vasundharā
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: गोप्तारश्चाप्यगोप्तारः प्रभविष्यन्ति शासकाः । हर्त्तारः पररत्नानां परदारविमर्शकाः
verses.transliteration: goptāraścāpyagoptāraḥ prabhaviṣyanti śāsakāḥ / harttāraḥ pararatnānāṃ paradāravimarśakāḥ

verses.hindi: ब्ध  ˆ ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण इत्येवं. कू९णदेवस्य नाम्नामष्टोत्तर' शतम् ।

verses.sanskrit: कामात्मानो दुरात्मानो ह्यधमाः साहसप्रियाः । प्रनष्टचेष्टना धूर्त्ता मुक्तकेशास्त्त्वशूलिनः
verses.transliteration: kāmātmāno durātmāno hyadhamāḥ sāhasapriyāḥ / pranaṣṭaceṣṭanā dhūrttā muktakeśāsttvaśūlinaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: सदा सत्य वचनों वाले तथा सत्य संकल्पों बाले हैं । सत्यभामा नामः वाली अपनी पट रानी में रति रखने वाले और जयशील हैं सुभद्रा के बड़े भाई हैं--भगवान् साक्षात् विष्णु का स्वरूप हैं तया भोष्मपितामह को मुक्ति देने वाले हैं ।३५। इस सम्पूणं जगत् के गुरु हैं--इस अगत् के नाथ हैं ओर

verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: ऊनषोडशवर्षाश्च प्रजा यन्ते युगक्षये । शुक्लदन्ता जिताक्षाश्च मुण्डाः काषायवाससः
verses.transliteration: ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣāśca prajā yante yugakṣaye / śukladantā jitākṣāśca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: वेणु (बंणों) के वादन करने में महापंडित हैं । वृषभासुर के विध्वंस करने बाले हैं--वकासुर के निहन्ता और बाणासुर को बाहुओं के कत्तन करने वाले हैं ।३७। राजा युधिष्तिर को राज्य गद्दी पर प्रतिष्ठित करने बाले हैं और मयूर की पंख के भूषण वाले हैं । पार्थे पृथा के पुत्र अजुन के रथ के बहुन कराने वाले सारथि हैं। इनका ऐसा स्वरूप है जो अव्यक्त है अर्थात् जिसको कोई पहिचान ही नहीं सकता है-बीता के उपदेशों से जो कि अमृत के समान हैं यह महोदधि हैं । जेवे अभृत समुद्र से उत्पन्न हुआ था बैसे ही गीता के उपदेश इनके हो हृदय से निकले हैं ।३८। कालिय नाग के मस्तक
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रा धर्मं चरिष्यति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते । सस्यचोरा भविष्यन्ति तथा चैलापहारिणः
verses.transliteration: śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyati yugānte samupasthite / sasyacorā bhaviṣyanti tathā cailāpahāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: पर नृत्य करने से माणिक्य मणि से रञ्जित श्रीपद कमल वाले हैं। दाम से बद्ध' उदर वाले हैं । दधिमन्थन के महाभाण्ड का भङ्ग कर देने पर यशोदा माता ने पकड़कर डोरी से बांध दिया था तभी से दामोदर नाम हुआ है । यों के भोक्त और दानबेन्द्रों के विनाशक है ।३९। आप साक्षात्
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: चोराच्चोराश्च हर्त्तारो हर्तुर्हर्त्ता तथापरः । ज्ञानकर्मम्युपरते लोके निष्क्रियतां गते
verses.transliteration: corāccorāśca harttāro harturharttā tathāparaḥ / jñānakarmamyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: क्षीरणायी नारायण--परं ब्रह्म ओर पन्नगों के अशन करने बाले गरुण के बाहन वाहो हैं। यमुना के जल में दिगम्बर होकर क्रीड़ा करने बालो ब्रज वाला गोपियों के वस्त्रों का अपहरण करने वाले हैं । आप पुण्य अर्थात् परम पुनीत यश वाले हैं-तीर्थ के-समान चरणों. बाले वेदों के द्वारा जानने के योग्य और दया के निधि हैं । समस्त तीथों के स्वरूप बाले--सब प्रहों से रूप वालो और पर से भी पर हूँ ।४०-४१। इस प्रकार से ख्रीकृष्ण देव के एक सो आठ नामों का यह शतक है । श्रीकृष्ण के भक्त कृष्ण ने अर्थात् वेद ब्यासी ने पहिले गौतांमृत का अबण दिया था धरा
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.transliteration: kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān / abhīkṣṇaṃ kṣemamārogyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā

verses.transliteration: kauśikānprativatsyanti deśāḥ kṣudbhayapīḍitāḥ / duḥkhenābhiplutānāṃ ca paramāyuḥ śataṃ tadā

verses.hindi: अंगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमामृत का कयन   २६५ पठतां श्वृष्वतां चेव कोटिकोटिगुणं भवेत् ।

verses.transliteration: dṛśyante ca na dṛśyante vedā kaliyuge 'khilāḥ / tatsīdante tathā yajñāḥ kevalādharmapīḍitāḥ

verses.transliteration: adhīyate tadā vedāñchūdrā dharmārtha kovidāḥ / yajante cāśvamedhena rājānaḥ śūdrayonayaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: कृष्ण कवं पायन महामुनि ने यह श्रीकृष्ण के प्रिय को करने वाला स्तोत्र रचित किया था। उन्हीं से इसका श्रवण मैंने किया था । यहु श्रीकृष्ण प्रेभामृत तामक स्तोत्र परमाधिक आनन्द के प्रदान करने वाला है ।४३। यह अत्यधिक उपद्रव और दुःखों का हनन करने वाला है तथा इसके श्रवण और पटन से अधिकाधिका आयु का वर्धेन होता है । इस लोक में जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीबालगोवधं कृत्वा हत्वान्ये च परस्परम् । अपहत्य तथान्योन्यं साधयन्ति तदा प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: strībālagovadhaṃ kṛtvā hatvānye ca parasparam / apahatya tathānyonyaṃ sādhayanti tadā prajāḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: ग्रहण करके जो भी कुछ दान-त्रत-तप-तीथे आदि किया है वह सभी इस परम पुनीत स्तोत्र के पढ़ने वालों तथा श्रवण विद्या है वह सभी इस परम पुनीत स्तोत्र के पढ़ते वालों तथा ख्रवण करने बालों को करोड़ों गुना फल देने वाला होती है । जो पुत्रों से रहित हैं उनको यह पुत्रों के प्रदान करने
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखप्रवचनाल्पायुर्देहाल्पायुश्च रोगतः । अधर्माभिनिवेशित्वात्तमोवृत्तं कलौ स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhapravacanālpāyurdehālpāyuśca rogataḥ / adharmābhiniveśitvāttamovṛttaṃ kalau smṛtam
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: बःला है तथा जिनकी सद्गति का कोई भी साधन नहीं है उनको सुगति अर्थात् उद्धार के प्रदान करने बाला है ।४४-४५। जो धन से महीन महान् दरिद्र है उनको धन का वहन कराने वाला है और जो सर्वत्र. युद्ध स्थल में अपनी विजय के इच्छ,क हैं उनको जय देने वाला है। यह स्तोत्र शिशुओं की और गोकुलों की पुष्टि का बढ़ाने वाला है।४६। बालरोग ऑर ग्रहों आदि का शमन करने वाला तथा मरम शान्ति के करने वाला है। यह समय में श्रीकृष्ण को स्मृति का देने वाला तथा संसार के तीनों (आध्या- रिमिक-आविभौतिक-आधिदेविक) तापों का अपहरण करने वाला है
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजासु भ्रूणहत्या च तदा वैरात्प्रवर्त्तते । तस्मादायुर्बलं रूपं कलिं प्राप्य प्रहीयते
verses.transliteration: prajāsu bhrūṇahatyā ca tadā vairātpravarttate / tasmādāyurbalaṃ rūpaṃ kaliṃ prāpya prahīyate
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: दे भद्रे ! यह स्तोत्र अपने असिद्ध जप आदि के साधन करने वाला अर्थात् सिद्धि कारक है । पादवेन्द्र-्ञान की मुद्रा वाले-योगो--रुक्मिणी के स्वामी-
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: तदा चाल्पेन कालेन सिद्धिं गच्छन्ति मानवाः । धन्या धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tadā cālpena kālena siddhiṃ gacchanti mānavāḥ / dhanyā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: र   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण बेदान्त के वेदी नाय श्री कृष्ण के लिए नमस्कार है--हे महादेवि ! यह भन्त्र है इसका अहर्तिश जाप करते रहना चाहिए एतावदुक्तो भगवाननंतो मूत्तिस्तु संकषंणसंज्ञिता विभो
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्मं ये चरन्त्यनसूयकाः । त्रेतायामाब्दिको धर्मो द्वापरे मासिकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ ye carantyanasūyakāḥ / tretāyāmābdiko dharmo dvāpare māsikaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: ततस्तु सर्वे सनकादयो ये समास्थितास्तत्परितः कथादृताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: यथाशक्ति चरन्प्राज्ञस्तदह्ना प्राप्नुयात्कलौ । एषा कलियुगावस्था संध्यांशं तु निबोधत
verses.transliteration: yathāśakti caranprājñastadahnā prāpnuyātkalau / eṣā kaliyugāvasthā saṃdhyāṃśaṃ tu nibodhata
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: कृष्णामृतं नः परिपायितं विभो विधूतपापा एवं नमस्कृत्य फणीश पादयोर्मनोविधायाखिलकामपूरयोः ।
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: युगेयुगे तु हीयन्ते त्रित्रिपादास्तु सिद्धयः । युगस्वभावात्संध्यासु तिष्ठन्तीह तु यादृशः
verses.transliteration: yugeyuge tu hīyante tritripādāstu siddhayaḥ / yugasvabhāvātsaṃdhyāsu tiṣṭhantīha tu yādṛśaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: इस परमोत्तम एवं दिव्य स्तोत्र का सेबन करने वाला पुरुष समस्त. ग्रहों के अनुग्रह को प्राप्त करने वाला हो जाता है और वह सभी का परम प्रिय बन जाया करता है । इस अष्टोत्तर शतक कृष्ण स्तोत्र के श्रवण तथा पठन करने से भजन पुत्र-पोत्रादि झे पहिबरृत होता है ओर उसके सभी.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यास्वभावाः स्वांशेषु पादशेषाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । एवं संध्यांशके काले संप्राप्ते तु युगान्तिके
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyāsvabhāvāḥ svāṃśeṣu pādaśeṣāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ / evaṃ saṃdhyāṃśake kāle saṃprāpte tu yugāntike
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: प्रकार की सिद्धियों को समृद्धि हों जाया करती है ।५०। वह मनुष्य इस लोक में सब प्रकार के सुखों का उपभोग करके भी अन्त समय में भगवान् स्री. अगस्त्य द्वारा श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमामृत का कयन   २८७
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां शास्ता ह्यसाधूनां भृगूणां निधनोत्थितः । गोत्रेण वै चन्द्र मसो नाम्ना प्रमतिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ śāstā hyasādhūnāṃ bhṛgūṇāṃ nidhanotthitaḥ / gotreṇa vai candra maso nāmnā pramatirucyate
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: कुष्ण के सायुज्य की प्राप्ति किया करता है। अगस्त्य मुनि ने कहा--हे विभो ! इतना कहकर भगवान् अनन्त देव चुप हो गये थे जो कि संकर्षण की संज्ञा वाली मुत्ति थी । यह भगवानु समस्त जगतों की इस धरा के धारण करने में पूर्णतया समर्थ थे । मान के देने बाले प्रभु ने पुनः घरा के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: माधवस्य तु स्ॐऽशेन पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे । समाः सविंशतिः पूर्णाः पर्यटन्वै वसुंधराम्
verses.transliteration: mādhavasya tu soṃ'śena pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / samāḥ saviṃśatiḥ pūrṇāḥ paryaṭanvai vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: निर्देश किया था । इसके अनन्तर कथा का आदर करने वाले सनकादिक सुनिगण सब जो उनको चारों ओर से घेरकर समवस्थित थे आतन्द से परि- पूर्णे सागर में निमग्न हो गये थे और उन सबने अहीशवर शज को सभाजित किया था ।५१-५१। ऋषिगणों ने कहा-हे प्रभो ! आप इस सम्पूर्ण बिश्व पर अनुकम्पा करते हुए इसका परिपालन किया करते हैं । है अव्यय स्वरूप थाले ! आप तो शरण में समागत अपने भक्तों की आत्ति के हरण करने वाले हैं आपके लिए हमारा सबका बारम्बार प्रणाम है। आप इस धरा के धारण करने वाले होते हुए भी परम कृपा के सागर हैं और आप
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: अनुकर्षन्स वै सेनां सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् । प्रगृहीतायुधैर्विप्रैः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: anukarṣansa vai senāṃ savājirathakuñjarām / pragṛhītāyudhairvipraiḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: समग्र विश्व की समुल्पात्त करने वाले हैं। ऐसे शेष भगवानु आपकी सेवा में हमारा प्रणिपात है ।५३। है विमो ! आपने हम सबको श्रीकृष्ण के नामों का जो अश्टोत्तर शतक रूपी अमृत है उसका भली भाति से पान कराया है और आपने हुम सबको पापों से रहित कर दिया है। है विभो ! आप
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: स तदा तैः परिवृतो म्लेच्छान्हन्ति स्मसर्वशः । सह वा सर्वशश्चैव राज्ञस्ताञ्छूद्रयोनिजान्
verses.transliteration: sa tadā taiḥ parivṛto mlecchānhanti smasarvaśaḥ / saha vā sarvaśaścaiva rājñastāñchūdrayonijān
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: सरीसे महापुरुष ही दीनों पर दया की बृष्टि करने बाले होते हैं जो कि अपने चरणों की शरण में समागत अपने भक्तों का भली भाति उद्धार किया करते हैं ।५४। इस रीति से नमस्कार करके और समस्त कामनाओं को पूर्ण करगे वाले भगवान् शेष के चरणों में मन लगाकर तथा धराधर को परिक्रमा करके हम सब अपने-अपसे निवात स्थातों को उपागत हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: पारवण्डास्तु ततः सर्वान् निः शेषं कृतवान्विभुः । नात्यर्थ धार्मिका ये च तान्सर्वान्हन्ति सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: pāravaṇḍāstu tataḥ sarvān niḥ śeṣaṃ kṛtavānvibhuḥ / nātyartha dhārmikā ye ca tānsarvānhanti sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णव्यत्यासजाताश्च ये च ताननुजीविनः । उदीच्यान्मध्यदेश्यांश्च पवतीयांस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: varṇavyatyāsajātāśca ye ca tānanujīvinaḥ / udīcyānmadhyadeśyāṃśca pavatīyāṃstathaiva ca
