verses.hindi: त्रै लोक्ये तानि सर्वाणि सिद्धय त्येवास्य शीलनात् । यावढ्यर सीत्स मुनिस्तावत्स्वर्यानमागतम्
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: प्राच्यान्प्रतीच्यांश्च तथा विन्ध्यपृष्ठचरानपि । तथैव दाक्षिणात्यांश्च द्रविडान्सिंहलैः सह
verses.transliteration: prācyānpratīcyāṃśca tathā vindhyapṛṣṭhacarānapi / tathaiva dākṣiṇātyāṃśca draviḍānsiṃhalaiḥ saha
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: गान्धारान्पारदांश्चैव पह्लवान्यव नाञ्शकान् । तुषारान्बर्बरांश्चीनाञ्छूलिकान्दरदान् खशान्
verses.transliteration: gāndhārānpāradāṃścaiva pahlavānyava nāñśakān / tuṣārānbarbarāṃścīnāñchūlikāndaradān khaśān
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: चतुभिरदृभुततः सिद्धेः कामरूपेमेनोजवेः । गतौ च वेष्णवं लोकं स्ंदेवनमस्कृतम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: लंपाकारान्सकतकान्किरातानां च जातयः । प्रवृत्तचक्रो बलवान्म्लेच्छानामन्तकृत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: laṃpākārānsakatakānkirātānāṃ ca jātayaḥ / pravṛttacakro balavānmlecchānāmantakṛtprabhuḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य महामुनि ने कहा कि है राम ! श्री राधा के कान्त-परिपूर्ण भगवाच श्रीकृष्ण का यह समस्त सिद्धियों का प्रदान कर देते वाला प्रेमामृत नाम वाला स्तोत्र मैंने आपको बता दिया है ।५६। है महाभाग राम ! यह स्तोत्र अत्यन्त दुलं भ है । मैंने कथाओं का वर्णन करले हुए साक्षात् भगवातु
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: अदृष्टः सर्वभूतानां चचाराथ वसुन्धराम् । माधवस्य तु स्ॐऽशेन देवस्येह विजज्ञिवान्
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ cacārātha vasundharām / mādhavasya tu soṃ'śena devasyeha vijajñivān
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: शेष के हो मुख से इसका श्रवण किया है ।५७। इस लोक में जितने भी मन्शों के समूह है तथा स्तोत्र ओर कवच आदि हैं इस भिभुवन में वे सभी इस स्तोत्र फे ही परिशोलन करणे से सिद्ध हो जाया करते हैं। वसिष्ठजी ने कहा--हे महाराज ! इस रीति से श्रीकृष्ण त्रेमामूत स्तव को बतलाकर जब तक अगस्त्य मुनि बिरत हुए ये तभी तक वहाँ स्वर्ग से एक यान आ गया 'था।५८-५९। उस मान में चार स्वेच्छया स्वरूप धारण करने वाले--मन के ही. समान वेग से समन्वित और अतीब अद्भुत सिद्धों से युक्त था। इसके अनन्तर वे दोनों हरिण और हरिणी. स्त्री एवं पुरुष के स्वरूप में होकर
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मनि विख्यातः प्रमतिर्न्नाम वीर्यवान् । गोत्रतो वै चन्द्रमसः पूर्वे कलियुगे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pūrvajanmani vikhyātaḥ pramatirnnāma vīryavān / gotrato vai candramasaḥ pūrve kaliyuge prabhuḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य मुनि को प्रणाम करके उस समय में परम हर्ष से उछल कर उस यान में समारूढ़ हो गये ।६०। वे दोनों परम दिव्य देह के घारण करने बाले. हो गये थे जो शङ्ख-चक्र आदि भगवास् के चिहनों से संयुत खे) इसके पश्चात् ये समस्त देवमणों के द्वारा वन्दित भगवान् विष्णु के लोक में चले
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: द्वात्रिंशे ऽभ्युदिते वर्षे प्रक्रान्तो विंशतीः समाः । विनिघ्नन्सर्वभूतानि मानवानेव सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: dvātriṃśe 'bhyudite varṣe prakrānto viṃśatīḥ samāḥ / vinighnansarvabhūtāni mānavāneva sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: गये थे । उस समय इस विलक्षण घटना को वहाँ पर संस्थित सभी प्राणी तथा भार्गव राम और अगस्त्य मुनि भी देख रहे ये उन सबकी आँखों के ही सामने ऐसा हुआ था तच्छूत्वा भगवान्साक्षादगस्त्यः कु भसंभवः ।
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा बीजावशेषं तु पृथ्व्यां कूरेण कर्मणा । परस्पर निमित्तेन कोपेनाकस्मिकेन तु
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā bījāvaśeṣaṃ tu pṛthvyāṃ kūreṇa karmaṇā / paraspara nimittena kopenākasmikena tu
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: सुसाधयित्वा वृषलान्प्रायशस्तानधर्मिकान् । गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये निष्ठां प्राप्तः सहानुगः
verses.transliteration: susādhayitvā vṛṣalānprāyaśastānadharmikān / gaṅgāyamunayormadhye niṣṭhāṃ prāptaḥ sahānugaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: पदाग्रात्क्रमतो लोकाँस्तदवलेस्तु विनिग्रहे श्री बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--उस समय में परशुराम ने इस महान आश्चयं
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: ततो व्यतीते कल्पे तु सामान्ये सहसैनिकः । उत्साद्य पार्थिवान्सर्वान्मलेच्छांश्चैव सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tato vyatīte kalpe tu sāmānye sahasainikaḥ / utsādya pārthivānsarvānmalecchāṃścaiva sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: को देखकर उत दोनों हरिण-हरिणियों का सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्त जैसा भी सुना गया था आगस्त्य मुनि से कह दिया था।१। साक्षात् कुम्भ से समुत्पत्ति ग्रहण करने बाले अगस्त्य भगवान् ने इस वृत्तान्त का श्रवण करके बहुत ही अधिक प्रसन्न होते हुए अपने समक्ष में संस्थित भगव राम से यह कहा
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र संध्यांशके काले संप्राप्ते तु युगान्तके । स्थितास्वल्पावशिष्टासु प्रजास्विह क्वचित्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: tatra saṃdhyāṃśake kāle saṃprāpte tu yugāntake / sthitāsvalpāvaśiṣṭāsu prajāsviha kvacitkvacit
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: था ।२। अगस्त्य जी ने कहा--है राम ! आप तो महान् भाग बाले हो और क्या करना चाहिए और क्या नहीं करना चाहिए--इस विषय में आप बहुत विद्वान हैं । आज मैं जो आपके हित को बात है उसको आपको बतलाता हुं । उसे आप बहुत ही सावधान होते हुए कर डालिए ।३। इस स्थल से विशेष दुरो पर भगवान विष्णु का परमः दुलंभ एक बड़ा भारी स्थान है जहाँ पर भगवान् के कमनीय कोमल चरणों के चिह्न दिखलाई दिया करते हैं जहाँ पर महान् आत्मा वाले प्रभु ने उन अपने "चरणों को रक्खा 'था)४ यह वह स्थल है जहाँ पर प्रभु ने वामन का अवतार लेकर राजा बलिःको
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: अपग्रहास्ततस्ता वै लोभाविष्टास्तु वृन्दशः । उपहिसंति चान्योन्यं पोथयन्तः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: apagrahāstatastā vai lobhāviṣṭāstu vṛndaśaḥ / upahisaṃti cānyonyaṃ pothayantaḥ parasparam
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: बिनिगृहीत करने के कार्य में अपने चरण के अग्रभाग से सभी लोकों को समाक्रान्त कर लिया था॥ उस समय में ब्रह्माजी ने भगवान के चरणों को प्रक्षालितःकिया था और जहाँ पर महात्मा वामन के चरणों के जलसे गङ्गा
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: अराजके युगवशात्संक्षये समुपस्थिते । प्रजास्ता वै ततः सर्वाः परस्परभयार्द्दिताः
verses.transliteration: arājake yugavaśātsaṃkṣaye samupasthite / prajāstā vai tataḥ sarvāḥ parasparabhayārdditāḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: २९०   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण का समुदुभव हुआ था ।५। अब आप उसी स्थल में जाकर अनन्य बुद्धि वाले होते इए एक मास तक इस स्तोत्र का पाठ करो और पूर्ण नियम से ही नियत तथा नियत अशन (भोजन) वाले होकर रहो ।६। आपने सिद्धि की इच्छा रखते हुए जिस कवच का पूर्वं में अभ्यास किया था और अपने समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: व्याकुलाश्च परिभ्रान्तास्त्यक्त्वा दारान्गृहाणि च । स्वान्प्रणाननपेक्षन्तो निष्कारणसुदुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: vyākulāśca paribhrāntāstyaktvā dārāngṛhāṇi ca / svānpraṇānanapekṣanto niṣkāraṇasuduḥkhitāḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: शत्रुओं के निग्रह करने की कामना से ही किया था वही अब आपको सिद्धि के देने वाला हो जायगा
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टे श्रौते स्मृतौ धर्मे परस्परहतास्तदा । निर्मर्यादा निराक्रन्दा निःस्नेहा निरपत्रपाः
verses.transliteration: naṣṭe śraute smṛtau dharme parasparahatāstadā / nirmaryādā nirākrandā niḥsnehā nirapatrapāḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: नमस्कृत्य मुनि शांतं निर्जगाश्रमाद्बहिः बसिष्ठजी ने कहा--इस प्रकार से शत्रुओं के निबर्हण करने बाले राम से जव अगस्त्य मुनि के द्वारा कहा गया थातो फिर राम ने मुनि को नमस्कार करके जो महा मुनि परम शान्त स्वभाव वाले ये उस आशम से राम बाहिर निकलकर चला गया था ।८। है भूप ! फिर उसी मागं से वह
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टे धर्मे प्रतिहता ह्रस्वकाः पञ्चविंशतिम् । हित्वा पुत्रांश्च दारांश्च विषादव्याकुलेद्रियाः
verses.transliteration: naṣṭe dharme pratihatā hrasvakāḥ pañcaviṃśatim / hitvā putrāṃśca dārāṃśca viṣādavyākuledriyāḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: बहुत शीघ्र वहाँ पर पहुँच गया था जहाँ पर उत्तर पद के न्यास से स्वर्ग गङ्गा निकली थी ।६। उस स्वल पर उस परशुराम ने अकृतब्रण के साथ ही रहकर निवास करने का अपने मन में श्ंकल्प किया था और श्रीकृष्ण प्रेमा-
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिहताश्चैव वार्त्तामुत्सृज्य दुःखिताः । प्रत्यन्तांस्ता निषेवन्ते हित्वा जनपदान्स्वकान्
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭihatāścaiva vārttāmutsṛjya duḥkhitāḥ / pratyantāṃstā niṣevante hitvā janapadānsvakān

verses.hindi: मृत नामक दिव्य स्तव का भली-भाति अभ्यास किया था ।१०। है भूपते ! ब्ज कें स्वामी उन भगवान श्रीकृ'ण उस पर परम प्रसन्न हो गये थे ओर उन्होंने जमदरिनि के पुत्र के लिए अपना दर्शन दिया था ।११। अब भगवान के स्वरूप का वर्णन किया जाता है जिस रूप से राम को उन्होंते दर्शन दिया था--उनके नेत्र कमलों के समान परम सुन्दर थे--भगवान कृष्ण साक्षात् चतुब्यू'हों के अधिप ये-सू्य के वण के सहश जाज्वल्यमान किरीट और दोनों कानों में कुण्डलों की शोभा से समन्वित ये ।१२। वक्षःस्थल में कोस्तुभ महामणि धारण किये हुए वे जिसकी प्रभा से उनका उरःस्थल समु-

verses.sanskrit: सरितः सागरानूपान्सेवन्ते पर्वतांस्तथा । मांसैर्मूलफलैश्चैव वर्तयन्तः सुदुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: saritaḥ sāgarānūpānsevante parvatāṃstathā / māṃsairmūlaphalaiścaiva vartayantaḥ suduḥkhitāḥ

verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: चीरपत्राचिनधरा निष्क्रिया निष्परिग्रहाः । वर्णाश्रमपरिभ्रष्टाः संकरं घोरमास्थिताः । एतां काष्ठामनुप्राप्ता अल्पशेषाः प्रजास्ततः
verses.transliteration: cīrapatrācinadharā niṣkriyā niṣparigrahāḥ / varṇāśramaparibhraṣṭāḥ saṃkaraṃ ghoramāsthitāḥ / etāṃ kāṣṭhāmanuprāptā alpaśeṣāḥ prajāstataḥ

verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: जराव्याधिक्षुधा विष्टा दुःखान्निर्वेदमागमन् । विचारणा तु निर्वेदात्साम्यावस्था विचारणात्
verses.transliteration: jarāvyādhikṣudhā viṣṭā duḥkhānnirvedamāgaman / vicāraṇā tu nirvedātsāmyāvasthā vicāraṇāt
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: यं वेदवादेविविधप्रकारंनि्णेतुमीशानमुखा न शक्नुयुः तँ त्वामनिर्देश्यमजं पुराणमनंतमीडे भव मे दयोपरः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: साम्यावस्थात्मको बोधः संबोधाद्धर्मशीलता । तासूपशमयुक्तासु कलिशिष्टासु वै स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sāmyāvasthātmako bodhaḥ saṃbodhāddharmaśīlatā / tāsūpaśamayuktāsu kaliśiṣṭāsu vai svayam
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: यस्त्वेक ईशो निजवांछ्वितप्रदो धत्ते तनूर्लोकविहाररक्षणे । नाताविधा देवमनुष्यनियेग्यादःसु 'भूमेमंरवा रणाय॥। १७. २९२   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रं तदा तासां युगान्ते परिवर्त्तिनि । चित्तसंमोहनं कृत्वा तासां वै सुप्तमत्तवत्
verses.transliteration: ahorātraṃ tadā tāsāṃ yugānte parivarttini / cittasaṃmohanaṃ kṛtvā tāsāṃ vai suptamattavat
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: तं देवदेवं भजतामभीप्सितप्रदं निरीहं गुणर्वाजितं च
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: भाविनोर्ऽथस्य च बलात्ततः कृतमवर्त्तत । प्रवृत्ते तु ततस्तस्मिन्पूते कृतयुगे तु वै
verses.transliteration: bhāvinor'thasya ca balāttataḥ kṛtamavarttata / pravṛtte tu tatastasminpūte kṛtayuge tu vai
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: तपंति तापैविविष्यैः स्वदेहमन्ये तु यज्ञैविविध्र्यजं ति। परशुराम ने कहा--भकतों की सुरक्षा करने के कारणों से शरीर धारण करने वाले--अपनी शरणागति में सम्प्राप जनों का प्रतिपालन करने वाले और सुरगणों की पोड़ा का हरण करने बाले आपके लिए मेरा बार- स्वार नमस्कार है। ब्रह्मा-शिव-विष्णु और इन्द्र जिनमें प्रमुख हैं ऐसे समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नाः कलिशिष्टासु प्रजाः कार्तयुगास्तदा । तिष्ठन्ति चेह ये सिद्धा अदृष्टा विचरन्ति च
verses.transliteration: utpannāḥ kaliśiṣṭāsu prajāḥ kārtayugāstadā / tiṣṭhanti ceha ye siddhā adṛṣṭā vicaranti ca
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: देवगणों के द्वारा जिनका स्तवन किया गया है ऐसे परमेश्वर प्रभु के लिए मैं नित्य ही प्रणाम निवेदन करने वाला हैं ।१५। शिव आदि प्रमुख देव भी अनेक भ्रकार के वेदों के वादों के द्वारा जिनके स्वरूप का निर्णय करने में समर्थ नहीं हुआ करते हैं उन निर्देशन करने के योग्य-अजन्मान्पुराण पुरुष
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: सह सप्तर्षिभिश्चैव तत्र ते च व्यवस्थिताः । ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशः शूद्रा बीजार्थं ये स्मृता इह
verses.transliteration: saha saptarṣibhiścaiva tatra te ca vyavasthitāḥ / brahmakṣatraviśaḥ śūdrā bījārthaṃ ye smṛtā iha
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: तथा अनन्त प्रभु का मैं स्तबन करता हूं । आप मेरे ऊपर दया में परायण हो जाइए ।१६। जो एक ही ईश हैं ओर नित्य हो अपने भक्तों के मतोबाडि'छतों को प्रदान करने वाले हैं वे आप इस भूमि के भार को उतारँने के लिए लोकों में विहार और उनकी रक्षा करने के वास्ते अनेक प्रकार के देव- मनुष्य-तियँग् सथा जल जीवों में शरीर धारण करके अवतार ग्रहण किया .करते हैं ।१७। ऐसे उन प्रभु आपको मैं स्वयं साक्षात् देख रहा हूँ जो अपने ही भक्तों में अनुराग रखने वाले हैं और इन्दिरा आदि में भी अत्यन्त विरक्त रहते हैं तथा व्यभिचार से दुष्ट चित्त वालियों में भी प्रेम से निवद्ध मन वाले
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: कलिजैः सह ते संति निर्विशेषास्तदाभवन् । तेषां सप्तर्षयो धर्मं कथयन्तीतरेषु च
verses.transliteration: kalijaiḥ saha te saṃti nirviśeṣāstadābhavan / teṣāṃ saptarṣayo dharmaṃ kathayantītareṣu ca

verses.hindi: हैं ।१८। है ईश्वर ! जिन आपके स्वरूप की प्राप्ति परम प्रसन्न होते हुए सम्पूर्ण अपने देह-स्त्री-सन्‍्तति और बेभव की ममता का त्यागकर असुर- सुर-नर-किन्नर-और तिर्यग् योनि वाले भी कर चुके है।१६। उन्हीं देवों के भी देव-भजन करने वालों के लिये अभीप्सित श्रदान करने बाले-निरीह
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाचारयुक्तः श्रौतः स्मार्त्तो द्विधा तु सः । ततस्तेषु क्रियावत्सु वर्तन्ते वै प्रजाः कृते
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramācārayuktaḥ śrautaḥ smārtto dvidhā tu saḥ / tatasteṣu kriyāvatsu vartante vai prajāḥ kṛte
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: गुणों से रहित अर्थात् रजोगुणादि से रहित-न चिन्तन करने के योग्य-अव्यक्त और अघों के समुदायों के बिनाश करने वाले-अरण तथा ग्म के निधान भागेव-करिक्र (१)   २९३

verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: श्रौतस्मार्त्ते कृतानां च धर्मे सप्तर्षिदर्शिते । केचिद्धर्मव्यवस्थार्थं तिष्ठन्तीहायुगक्षयात्
verses.transliteration: śrautasmārtte kṛtānāṃ ca dharme saptarṣidarśite / keciddharmavyavasthārthaṃ tiṣṭhantīhāyugakṣayāt
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: आपको वैते आदर से इस समय साक्षात् प्राप्न कर खया है ।२७। अन्य जन तो नाता भांति के तपश्लर्या जनित तापों से अपने देह को संतप्त किया करते हैँ और विविध यज्ञो के द्वारा आपका यजन किया करते है। है विभो ! इस प्रकार के परम किलिष्ट विधानों के करते हुए भी वे सब किसी प्रयोजनों
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तराधिकारेषु तिष्ठन्ति मुनयस्तु वै । यथा दावप्रदग्धेषु तृणेष्विह तपेन तु
verses.transliteration: manvantarādhikāreṣu tiṣṭhanti munayastu vai / yathā dāvapradagdheṣu tṛṇeṣviha tapena tu
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.transliteration: vanānāṃ prathamaṃ vṛṣṭyā teṣāṃ mūleṣu saṃbhavaḥ / tathā kārtayugānāṃ tu kalijaṣviha saṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: एवं युगो युगस्येह संतानस्तु परस्परम् । वर्त्तते ह्यव्यवच्छेदाद्यावन्मन्वन्तरक्षयः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yugo yugasyeha saṃtānastu parasparam / varttate hyavyavacchedādyāvanmanvantarakṣayaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सुखमायुर्बलं रूपन्धर्मोर्ऽथः काम एव च । युगेष्वेतानि हीयन्ते त्रित्रिपादाः क्रमेण च
verses.transliteration: sukhamāyurbalaṃ rūpandharmor'thaḥ kāma eva ca / yugeṣvetāni hīyante tritripādāḥ krameṇa ca
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: ससंध्याशेषु हीयन्ते युगानान्धर्मसिद्धयः । इत्येष प्रतिसंधिर्यः कीर्त्तितस्तु मया द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sasaṃdhyāśeṣu hīyante yugānāndharmasiddhayaḥ / ityeṣa pratisaṃdhiryaḥ kīrttitastu mayā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: कुतकार्यो द्विजञ्च ष्ठ तं समापय मानद क्षए८ शश्व   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्युगानां सर्वेषामेतेनैव प्रसाधनम् । एषा चतुर्युगावृत्तिरासहस्रद्गुणीकृता
verses.transliteration: caturyugānāṃ sarveṣāmetenaiva prasādhanam / eṣā caturyugāvṛttirāsahasradguṇīkṛtā
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: 'जो-जो भी भक्तगण आपके चरणाम्बुजों का इस संसार के बारम्बार जन्म-मरण के घोर श्रम से वैराग्य वाले होकर विधि के साथ स्मरण किया करते हैं--भक्ति की परम पूत भावना से नमन करते है और. आपके चरणों का-भली भाति अचेन किया करते हैं तथा ,परस्पर में एक-दूसरे सभा में
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्तदहः प्रोक्तं रात्रिश्चैतावती स्मृता । अत्रार्जवं जडीभावो भूतानामायुगक्षयात्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇastadahaḥ proktaṃ rātriścaitāvatī smṛtā / atrārjavaṃ jaḍībhāvo bhūtānāmāyugakṣayāt
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: इनका वणेन किया करते हैं ।९२। उस रीति से आपके चरण कमल में'एक जन्म में समुत्पन्न पङ के भेदन करने में प्रसक्त चित्त थालो भक्तजन स्वयं तर जाते हैं और दूसरों को तार दिया करते हैं। है ईश! आपका परम पुनीत नाम निश्चित रूप से इस साँसारिक रोग के दूर करने के लिए अभृत स्वरूप महौषध है ।२३। है प्रमो ! मैं तो कुछ कामना से'निबद्े चित्त वाला बाला हूँ । मैंने पस खे तम आपकी  विधिपूर्वक प्रबल प्रयस्नों के साथ आराधना की थी । है नाय ! आप तो स्वयं ही इसके अभिज्ञ हैं अर्थात् आपको सभी कुछ ज्ञात है। आपके लिए इस लोक में क्या बात विज्ञापित
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव तु सर्वेषां युगानां लक्षणं स्मृतम् । एषा चतुर्युगानां च गुणिता ह्येकसप्ततिः
verses.transliteration: etadeva tu sarveṣāṃ yugānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ smṛtam / eṣā caturyugānāṃ ca guṇitā hyekasaptatiḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: करने के योग्य है? अर्थात् कुछ भी नहीं है ।२४। वसि जी ने कहा-- इस प्रकार से स्तवन करते हुए अपने चरणों में आगे प्रणत होने वाले परशुराम से माया से मोहित करते हुए के समान ही अगाध बाणो से प्रभु ले कहा था ।२५। ख्रीकुष्ण चन्द्र भगवान् से कहा--बड़ी ही प्रसन्नता की बात है है
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेण परिवृत्ता तुमनोरन्तरमुच्यते । चतुर्युगे यथैकस्मिन्भवतीह यथा तु यत्
verses.transliteration: krameṇa parivṛttā tumanorantaramucyate / caturyuge yathaikasminbhavatīha yathā tu yat
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: राम ! आप महान् भाग्य वाले हो । आपका उत्तम कारय सिद्ध हो गया है । इसकी सिद्धि क्च और स्तव के ही भ्रभाव से हुई है--इसको मन में समझ लीजिए ।२६। बहुत हो बं से युक्त मन वाहो राजा कत्त वीर्ये को हनन करके अपने पिता के साथ किये हुए कुर्सित व्यवहार के बैर का बदला लोकर इस भूमि को क्षत्रियो से रहित कर डालिए ।२७। इस धरातल में यह कार्तवीर्य मेरे हो चक्र का अवतार है है मानद द्विजस्रोछ्ठ ! उसको समाप्त करके आप सफल हो जाइए
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: तथा चान्येषु भवति पुनस्तद्वद्यथाक्रमम् । सर्गे सर्गे तथा भेदा उत्पद्यन्ते तथैव तु
verses.transliteration: tathā cānyeṣu bhavati punastadvadyathākramam / sarge sarge tathā bhedā utpadyante tathaiva tu
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: अद्य ति लोकेऽस्मिन्नंशावे शेन मे भवाय ।
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चत्रिंशत्परिमिता न न्यूना नाधिकाः स्मृताः । तथा कल्पा युगैः मार्द्धं भवन्ति सह लक्षणैः । मन्वन्तराणां सर्वेषामेतदेव तु लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: pañcatriṃśatparimitā na nyūnā nādhikāḥ smṛtāḥ / tathā kalpā yugaiḥ mārddhaṃ bhavanti saha lakṣaṇaiḥ / manvantarāṇāṃ sarveṣāmetadeva tu lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: चरि यथाकालं कर्ता हर्ता स्ययं प्रभुः २६ कोसल्यानन्दजनको राज्ञो दशरथादहमू ।
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: यथा युगानां परिवर्त्तनानि चिरप्रवृत्तानि युगस्वभावात् । तथा न संतिष्ठति जीवलोकः क्षयोदयाभ्यां परिवर्त्तमानः
verses.transliteration: yathā yugānāṃ parivarttanāni cirapravṛttāni yugasvabhāvāt / tathā na saṃtiṣṭhati jīvalokaḥ kṣayodayābhyāṃ parivarttamānaḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येत ल्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं युगानां वै समासतः
verses.transliteration: ityeta llakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yugānāṃ vai samāsataḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: आज से ही आरम्भ करके आप इस लोक में मेरे ही अंश के वेश से चरण करेंगे ओर यथा समय आप स्वयं ही कर्ता और हर्ता प्रभु हो जॉयगे ।२९। है वत्स ! आगे चौवीस्वें युग में जब त्रेतायुग होगा तब मैं राजा रघु के बंश में चतुब्यू'ह सनातन राम नाम वाला होऊगा अर्थात् मेरः रामा- बतार होगा ।३०१ मैं राजा दशरथ के वीये से उसकी रानी कौशल्या के गर्भ से जन्म ग्रहण कर उसके आनन्द को उत्पन्न करने याला आत्मज होऊँगा। उस समय में लक्ष्मण-के साथ कौणिक  विश्वामित्र महधि के यज्ञ को पूर्ण कराकर जिसमें दानव बाधा डाल रहे ये मैं फिर है महाभागे  राजा जनक
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागतानां हि सर्वमन्वन्तरोष्विह । मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि वै
verses.transliteration: atītānāgatānāṃ hi sarvamanvantaroṣviha / manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi vai
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: के महान् नगर को जाऊंगा । यहाँ पर घनुषशाला में समस्त वीर नृपों के मध्यमे भिवे के धनुष का भर्जन करके विदेह की पुत्री जानकी “के साथः बिवाह करू'गा।३१-३२ा उस समय में अपनी राजधानी अयोध्यापुरी के लिये गमन करते हुए आपके उत्मदतेज का हनन कर दूरगा 3: वसिष्ठ जी. ने
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातानीह विजानीध्वं कल्पं कल्पेन चैव ह । अनागतेषु तद्वच्च तर्कः कार्यो विजानता
verses.transliteration: khyātānīha vijānīdhvaṃ kalpaṃ kalpena caiva ha / anāgateṣu tadvacca tarkaḥ kāryo vijānatā
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: फहा--इस रीति से भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण ने जमदग्नि के पुर परशुराम 'को' अपना आवेश भलीन्भाति देकर जो कि राम तप की निधि ये । वहीं पर महात्मा राम के देखते-देखते हुए ही भगवान् कृष्ण अन्तहित हो गये थे यत्र पापहरा पुण्या .नर्मदा सरितां वरा ६ पुनाति दर्शनादेव प्राणिन:-पापिनों ह्यपि
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह । तुल्याभिमानिनः सर्वे नामरूपैर्भवन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣviha / tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve nāmarūpairbhavantyuta
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ह्यष्टविधा ये वा इह मन्वन्तरेश्वराः । ऋषयो मनवश्चैव सर्वे तुल्याः प्रयोजनैः
verses.transliteration: devā hyaṣṭavidhā ye vā iha manvantareśvarāḥ / ṛṣayo manavaścaiva sarve tulyāḥ prayojanaiḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: तत्र कि बण्यंते पुण्यं नृणां देवस्वरूपिणाम् । नमश्चकार सुप्रीतः शत्रुसाधनतत्परः । नमोऽतु नमंदे तुभ्यं हरदेहसमुद्भवे
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वर्णाश्रमाणां तु प्रविभागं पुरा युगे । युगस्वभावांश्च तथा विधत्ते वै सदा प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ varṇāśramāṇāṃ tu pravibhāgaṃ purā yuge / yugasvabhāvāṃśca tathā vidhatte vai sadā prabhuḥ
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमविभागाश्च युगानि युगसिद्धयः । अनुषङ्गात्समाख्याताः सृष्टिसर्गं निबोधत । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च स्थितिं वक्ष्ये युगेष्विह
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavibhāgāśca yugāni yugasiddhayaḥ / anuṣaṅgātsamākhyātāḥ sṛṣṭisargaṃ nibodhata / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca sthitiṃ vakṣye yugeṣviha
verses.translation: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.hindi: श्री बसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--भगवान् श्री कृष्ण के अन्तर्द्धान हो जाने पर सुमहान् यश वाले परशुराम ने इसके उपरान्त अपने आपको श्रीकृष्ण चन्द्र के अनुभाव समुद्रिक्त मान लिया था अर्थात् अपने आपको उच्चस्तरीय व्यक्ति मान लिया था ।१। अकृतव्रण से समन्वित होकर जलती हुई अग्नि के ही समान जलता हुआ यह् भागंव राम माहिष्मती नगरी की ओर आ गया था।।३। यह पुरी वहाँ पर थी जहाँ पर समस्त सरिताओं में परमा श्रोष्ठ-पुण्य! प्रवा और पापों का हरण करने वाली नमदा नाम वाली नदी बहती है। यह नदी बहती है । यह् नदी केवल दर्शन मात्र ही से महापापी
verses.wordMeaning: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: How could Yajha begin to function formerly in the Svyambhuva Manvantara, at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. Narrate it factually to me.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे चतुर्युगाख्यानं नामैकत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच युगेषु यास्तु जायन्ते प्रजास्ता मे निबोधत । आसुरी सर्पगान्धर्वा पैशाची यक्षराक्षसी
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde caturyugākhyānaṃ nāmaikatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca yugeṣu yāstu jāyante prajāstā me nibodhata / āsurī sarpagāndharvā paiśācī yakṣarākṣasī
verses.translation: This cbter records the belief that there has been a continiMus deterioratioo ia height or physical buUt and other edacities of all the subjects of creation, be they go, mm or serpenti. ArcbaeologioaJ otcavationa have not substanliMsd this bef.
verses.hindi: प्राणियों को पुनीत बना दिया करती है ।३। है महीपते ! प्राचीन काल में ज्रिपुर के हनन करने बाले भगवान् शम्भु ने भी जो कि महान् आत्मा वाले हैं यहीं पर निविष्ट होते हुए त्रिपुरासुर के विनाश के लिये यत्न किया था

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्युगे च संभूति स्तासां यावच्च जीवितम् । पिशाचासुरगन्धर्वां यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः
verses.transliteration: yasminyuge ca saṃbhūti stāsāṃ yāvacca jīvitam / piśācāsuragandharvāṃ yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ
verses.translation: This height of human beings becomes reduced in the Tugditiiaka (transitional period between two Yugas) in all the Yuga periods past and future.
verses.hindi: हैं। उनके महान् पुण्य का कया वर्णन किया जावे अर्थात् उनका पुण्य तो अवर्णनीय है। उस भागय परशुराम ने जो अपने कुल को. अभिनन्दित करने वाले थे, है भूप ! उस पुण्यमयी परम पावनी नदी का दर्शन किया था ।४। फिर राम ने जो अपने महाशक्ु कात्तवीयं के साधन करते में परा- यण थे परम-प्रीनिमान् होकर नर्मदा: को प्रणाम किया था ओर सविनय प्रार्थना की थी कि है नर्मदे! आप तो साक्षात् भगवान् शङ्कर के देह से शरीर धारण करने वाली हैं । आपकी सेवा में मेरा प्रणिपात स्वीकार होवे ।६। है शोभने ! मेरा यही विनञ्ज निवेदन है कि आप मेरे शत्रुओं का बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: This height of human beings becomes reduced in the Tugditiiaka (transitional period between two Yugas) in all the Yuga periods past and future.
verses.commentary: Sense: This height of human beings becomes reduced in the Tugditiiaka (transitional period between two Yugas) in all the Yuga periods past and future.

verses.sanskrit: परिणाहोच्छ्रयैस्तुल्या जायन्ते ह कृते युगे । षण्णवत्यङ्गुलो त्सेधो ह्यष्टानां देवजन्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: pariṇāhocchrayaistulyā jāyante ha kṛte yuge / ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulo tsedho hyaṣṭānāṃ devajanmanām
verses.translation: Man is regarded to be eight spans high with his own fingers as unit.
verses.hindi: ही शीघ्र विनाश करने की मेरें ऊपर अनुकम्पा कीजिए और मेरे लिए वर-
verses.wordMeaning: Man is regarded to be eight spans high with his own fingers as unit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Man is regarded to be eight spans high with his own fingers as unit.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेनाङ्गुलप्रमाणेन निष्पन्नेन च पौष्टिकात् । एतत्स्वाभाविकं तेषां प्रमाणमिति कुर्वते
verses.transliteration: svenāṅgulapramāṇena niṣpannena ca pauṣṭikāt / etatsvābhāvikaṃ teṣāṃ pramāṇamiti kurvate
verses.translation: The constitution of the bodies of the Dcvas is similar to that of the body of human beings. It is realised, if we ponder over reality.
verses.hindi: दान देने वाली हो जाइए इस प्रकार से अभ्यर्धना करते हुए उस परशुराम ने पापों के विनाश कर देने बाली नर्मदा के लिए नमस्कार की थी।छा दूरां प्रस्थापयामास कार्त्तवीर्याजु नं प्रति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The constitution of the bodies of the Dcvas is similar to that of the body of human beings. It is realised, if we ponder over reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The constitution of the bodies of the Dcvas is similar to that of the body of human beings. It is realised, if we ponder over reality.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्या वर्तमानास्तु युगं संध्याशकेष्विह । देवासुरप्रमाणं तु सप्तसप्तङ्गुलादसत्
verses.transliteration: manuṣyā vartamānāstu yugaṃ saṃdhyāśakeṣviha / devāsurapramāṇaṃ tu saptasaptaṅgulādasat
verses.translation: The word Sat indicates the Btahman. Those who possess it are called ontr due to their similarity with the Brakman.
verses.hindi: दूत राजा त्वया वाच्यो यदहं वच्मि तेऽनघ
verses.wordMeaning: The word Sat indicates the Btahman. Those who possess it are called ontr due to their similarity with the Brakman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Sat indicates the Btahman. Those who possess it are called ontr due to their similarity with the Brakman.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलानां शतं पूर्णमष्टपञ्चाशदुत्तरम् । देवासुरप्रमाणं तु उच्छ्रयात्कलिजैः स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: aṅgulānāṃ śataṃ pūrṇamaṣṭapañcāśaduttaram / devāsurapramāṇaṃ tu ucchrayātkalijaiḥ smṛtam
verses.translation: Inasmuch as Brahmaas, Kauriyas and Vaijyas are engaged in general religious rites as well as in special rites, they arc the twice-born castes.
verses.hindi: न संदेहस्त्वया कार्यो दूत: क्वापि न वध्यते.। यद्बलं. तु समाश्रित्य जमदर्निमुनि नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: Inasmuch as Brahmaas, Kauriyas and Vaijyas are engaged in general religious rites as well as in special rites, they arc the twice-born castes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Inasmuch as Brahmaas, Kauriyas and Vaijyas are engaged in general religious rites as well as in special rites, they arc the twice-born castes.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारश्चाप्यशीतिश्च कलिजैरङ्गुलैः स्मृतः । स्वेनाङ्गुलिप्रमाणेन ऊर्द्ध्वमापादमस्तकात्
verses.transliteration: catvāraścāpyaśītiśca kalijairaṅgulaiḥ smṛtaḥ / svenāṅgulipramāṇena ūrddhvamāpādamastakāt
verses.translation: One who adheres to the religious duties prescribed for one's caste and stage of life and one who is happy in practis-
verses.hindi: भागँबं त्गं समासाद्य गच्छ लोकांतरं त्वरा ।
verses.wordMeaning: One who adheres to the religious duties prescribed for one's caste and stage of life and one who is happy in practis-
verses.commentary: Sense: One who adheres to the religious duties prescribed for one's caste and stage of life and one who is happy in practis-

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष मानुषोत्सेधो ह्रसतीह युगांशके । सर्वेषु युगकालेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa mānuṣotsedho hrasatīha yugāṃśake / sarveṣu yugakāleṣu atītānāgateṣviha
verses.translation: W. 20*26 give (he cbaracierutics saints sidhus and kaowers of Dhanai.
verses.hindi: इत्येबमुक्त्वा राजानं श्रुत्वा तस्य.वचस्तथा तेनंबमुक्तो दूतस्तु गतो हैहयभूपतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: W. 20*26 give (he cbaracierutics saints sidhus and kaowers of Dhanai.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 20*26 give (he cbaracierutics saints sidhus and kaowers of Dhanai.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेनाङ्गुलिप्रमाणेन अष्टतालः स्मृतो नरः । आपादतलमस्तिष्को नवतालो भवेत्तु यः
verses.transliteration: svenāṅgulipramāṇena aṣṭatālaḥ smṛto naraḥ / āpādatalamastiṣko navatālo bhavettu yaḥ
verses.translation: A religious student who works for the welfare of his preceptor is called S&dhu (good one) because he strives for the achievement of learning. A householder is called Sitdhu because he gathers together the requbites for his housc-hold.
verses.wordMeaning: A religious student who works for the welfare of his preceptor is called S&dhu (good one) because he strives for the achievement of learning. A householder is called Sitdhu because he gathers together the requbites for his housc-hold.
verses.commentary: Sense: A religious student who works for the welfare of his preceptor is called S&dhu (good one) because he strives for the achievement of learning. A householder is called Sitdhu because he gathers together the requbites for his housc-hold.

verses.sanskrit: संहता जानुबाहुस्तु स सुरैरपि पूज्यते । गवाश्वहस्तिनां चैव महिष स्यावरात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhatā jānubāhustu sa surairapi pūjyate / gavāśvahastināṃ caiva mahiṣa syāvarātmanām
verses.translation: Thus the religious student, the householder, the forest-dwelling hermit and the recluse are all called as Sidhus because they achieve the Dharmas of their respective stages of life.
verses.hindi: चुक्रोध श्रूत्वा वाच्यं तद्दूत मुत्तरमावहत् । कात्तंवीर्य उवाच-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the religious student, the householder, the forest-dwelling hermit and the recluse are all called as Sidhus because they achieve the Dharmas of their respective stages of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the religious student, the householder, the forest-dwelling hermit and the recluse are all called as Sidhus because they achieve the Dharmas of their respective stages of life.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणैतेन विज्ञेये ह्रासवृद्धी युगे युगे । षट्सप्तत्यङ्गुलोत्सेधः पशूनां ककुदस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: karmaṇaitena vijñeye hrāsavṛddhī yuge yuge / ṣaṭsaptatyaṅgulotsedhaḥ paśūnāṃ kakudastu vai
verses.translation: Neither the Devas nor the Pitrs, neither the sages nor the human beings understand the point 'This is Dharma — This is not", because of different points of view (?)
verses.hindi: उसके अनन्तर बही से एक दूत को कात्तं बीयंजुन के राजा के पास भेजा था । उन्होंने उस वूत से कहा था कि है दूत !तुमको-वहाँ पहुँच कर उस राजा कात्त बीय॑ से मह कहना चाहिए है अनघ ! अर्थात् निष्पाप ! जो कुछ भी वैं इस समय में तुमको बोल रहा हैँ ।=। ऐसे कहने में तुमको डरना
verses.wordMeaning: Neither the Devas nor the Pitrs, neither the sages nor the human beings understand the point 'This is Dharma — This is not", because of different points of view (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither the Devas nor the Pitrs, neither the sages nor the human beings understand the point 'This is Dharma — This is not", because of different points of view (?)

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलाष्टशतं पूर्णमुत्सेधः करिणां स्मृतः । अङ्गुलानां सहस्रं तु चत्वारिंशाङ्गुलैर्विना
verses.transliteration: aṅgulāṣṭaśataṃ pūrṇamutsedhaḥ kariṇāṃ smṛtaḥ / aṅgulānāṃ sahasraṃ tu catvāriṃśāṅgulairvinā
verses.translation: The words Dharma and Adharma mentioned here refer to the rites. Auspicious rite b remembered as Dharma. Inauspicious rite is declared as Adharma.
verses.hindi: नहीं चाहिए और अपने लिये पाये जाने वाले किसी तरह के दण्ड का हृदय में कुछ भी सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए क्योंकि राजाओं के यहाँ पर ऐसा नियम है कि जो. दूत बनकर आता है वह चाहे.कंसी ही सूचना लेकर क्‍यों न आया हो उसका वध किसी भी दशा में कहीं पर भी नहीं किया जाता है। उस राजा से तुम कह देना कि है नृप ! जिस बल का समाश्रय लेकर तू ने जमदरिन महामुनि का महान् तिरस्कार किया था है मूढ़ ! उसी मुनि का पुत्र तुझसे युद्ध करके बदला लेने के लिए समागत हुंमा -है। है मन्द
verses.wordMeaning: The words Dharma and Adharma mentioned here refer to the rites. Auspicious rite b remembered as Dharma. Inauspicious rite is declared as Adharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The words Dharma and Adharma mentioned here refer to the rites. Auspicious rite b remembered as Dharma. Inauspicious rite is declared as Adharma.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशता यवानां च उत्सेधः शाखिनां स्मृतः । मानुषस्य शरीरस्य सन्निवेशस्तु यादृशः
verses.transliteration: pañcāśatā yavānāṃ ca utsedhaḥ śākhināṃ smṛtaḥ / mānuṣasya śarīrasya sanniveśastu yādṛśaḥ
verses.translation: That Dharma which takes us to what we desire (and what is good for us) is taught by the preceptors. It is abo taught by the preceptors that Adharma has adverse and undesir¬ able fruits.
verses.hindi: आत्मा वाले! अब तनिक भी बिलम्ब न करके बहुत ही शीघ्र अपनी नगरी से बाहर निकलकर जा जाओ ओर राम के साथ युद्ध करो ।€-१०।'उस भागंब राम के समीप में पहुंचकर शीघ्र हो दूसरे लोक को गमन कर अर्थात् मृत्यु के मुख में चला जा । इस तरह से स्पष्टतया उस राजा से कह
verses.wordMeaning: That Dharma which takes us to what we desire (and what is good for us) is taught by the preceptors. It is abo taught by the preceptors that Adharma has adverse and undesir¬ able fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Dharma which takes us to what we desire (and what is good for us) is taught by the preceptors. It is abo taught by the preceptors that Adharma has adverse and undesir¬ able fruits.

verses.sanskrit: तल्लक्षणस्तु देवानां दृश्येत तत्त्वदर्शनात् । बुद्ध्यातिशययुक्तश्च देवानां काय उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tallakṣaṇastu devānāṃ dṛśyeta tattvadarśanāt / buddhyātiśayayuktaśca devānāṃ kāya ucyate
verses.translation: They call these persons Acaryas* (preceptors) viz,— old men devoid of greadiness, Self-possessed persons devoid of arrogance and straight-forward persons who have been edu¬ cated and well disciplined.
verses.hindi: देना और वह इसका उत्तर क्‍या देता है उसके वचनों का ख़्बण करना ।११। है दूत ! तुम बहुत ही शीघ्र वापिस आ जाना । तुम्हारा इसमें ही ही कल्याण होगा । इस कोय में बिलम्ब बिल्कुल भी न होये= इसी में तुम्हारी प्रशंसा है । जब इस रोलि से उस दूत से कहा गया था तो वह दूत तुरन्त हो हैहय भूपति के समीप में वहाँ से चला गया था ।१२। उस राजा की सभा में उस दूत ने जेसा भी जो कुछ परशूराम के द्वारा गया था वह सब उसी प्रकार से उसने राजा को सुना दिया था । बहू राजा कात्तंबीय तो दत्तात्रेय महामुनि को परम भक्त था-इसका भी उसको बड़ा अभिमान था
verses.wordMeaning: They call these persons Acaryas* (preceptors) viz,— old men devoid of greadiness, Self-possessed persons devoid of arrogance and straight-forward persons who have been edu¬ cated and well disciplined.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call these persons Acaryas* (preceptors) viz,— old men devoid of greadiness, Self-possessed persons devoid of arrogance and straight-forward persons who have been edu¬ cated and well disciplined.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सातिशयस्छैव मानुषः काय उच्यते । इत्येते वै परिक्रान्ता भावा ये दिव्यमानुषाः
verses.transliteration: tathā sātiśayaschaiva mānuṣaḥ kāya ucyate / ityete vai parikrāntā bhāvā ye divyamānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: W. 2-30 and 33-36 eibia the coneept of Dbanna sod what is Srauta and Smftru Dharma? A detailed eluddaiion of various virtues coosti- tutiog Dharma are given in VV. 43-57.
verses.hindi: और बह महान् बल-पराक्रम से भी संयुत था।१३। जब उसने दूत के द्वारा परशुराम का कहा हुआ सन्देश सुना तो उसको बहुत ही अधिक क्रोध आ गया था और उसने उस दूत को इसका उत्तर दिया था। कात्त वीरय राजा ने कहा--मैंने इस सम्पूर्ण मेदिनी को दत्तात्रेय के द्वारा प्रदान किये हुए
verses.wordMeaning: W. 2-30 and 33-36 eibia the coneept of Dbanna sod what is Srauta and Smftru Dharma? A detailed eluddaiion of various virtues coosti- tutiog Dharma are given in VV. 43-57.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 2-30 and 33-36 eibia the coneept of Dbanna sod what is Srauta and Smftru Dharma? A detailed eluddaiion of various virtues coosti- tutiog Dharma are given in VV. 43-57.

verses.sanskrit: पशूनां पक्षिणां चैव स्थावराणां च सर्वशः । गावो ह्यजावयो ऽश्वाश्च हस्तिनः पक्षिणो नगाः
verses.transliteration: paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva sthāvarāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / gāvo hyajāvayo 'śvāśca hastinaḥ pakṣiṇo nagāḥ
verses.translation: W. 31-32 mocioB the qualifications of an Ac&rya (preceptor).
verses.hindi: अपनी भुजाओं के ही बल-पराक्रम से अपने अधिकार में किया है इत्युक्त्वा विससर्ज्जाशु दूतं हैहयभूपतिः
verses.wordMeaning: W. 31-32 mocioB the qualifications of an Ac&rya (preceptor).
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 31-32 mocioB the qualifications of an Ac&rya (preceptor).

verses.sanskrit: उपयुक्ताः क्रियास्वेते यज्ञियास्विह सर्वशः । देवस्थानेषु जायन्ते तद्रूपा एव ते पुनः
verses.transliteration: upayuktāḥ kriyāsvete yajñiyāsviha sarvaśaḥ / devasthāneṣu jāyante tadrūpā eva te punaḥ
verses.translation: He himself practices (Dharma). He establishes the code of good behaviour and he gathers together (and masters) the various scriptural texts—he is therefore, called Acdrya,
verses.wordMeaning: He himself practices (Dharma). He establishes the code of good behaviour and he gathers together (and masters) the various scriptural texts—he is therefore, called Acdrya,
verses.commentary: Sense: He himself practices (Dharma). He establishes the code of good behaviour and he gathers together (and masters) the various scriptural texts—he is therefore, called Acdrya,

verses.sanskrit: यथाशयोपभोगास्तु देवानां शुभमूर्त्तयः । तेषां रूपानुरूपैस्तु प्रमाणैः स्थाणुजङ्गमैः
verses.transliteration: yathāśayopabhogāstu devānāṃ śubhamūrttayaḥ / teṣāṃ rūpānurūpaistu pramāṇaiḥ sthāṇujaṅgamaiḥ
verses.translation: The Yajus and theSman constitute the Sruti. They are the limbs of the Veda. It was after remembering the code of conduct of life in the previous Manvantara that Manu expounded his Smrti.
verses.hindi: सज्जं कुरु गहाभाग सेन्यं मे वीरसंमतः  एवमुक्तो महावीरः सेनाध्यक्षः प्रतापनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Yajus and theSman constitute the Sruti. They are the limbs of the Veda. It was after remembering the code of conduct of life in the previous Manvantara that Manu expounded his Smrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yajus and theSman constitute the Sruti. They are the limbs of the Veda. It was after remembering the code of conduct of life in the previous Manvantara that Manu expounded his Smrti.

verses.sanskrit: मनोज्ञैस्तत्र भावैस्ते सुखिनो ह्युपपेदिरे । अतः शिष्टान्प्रवक्ष्यामि सतः साधूंस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: manojñaistatra bhāvaiste sukhino hyupapedire / ataḥ śiṣṭānpravakṣyāmi sataḥ sādhūṃstathaiva ca
verses.translation: The study of the three Vedas, agricultural opera¬ tion, administration of justice performance of sacrifice, special duties of the people of different castes and stages of life are practised by Sifas again and again.
verses.hindi: सैन्य सज्जं समाकण्ये कार्तवीर्यो नृपो मुदा ।
verses.wordMeaning: The study of the three Vedas, agricultural opera¬ tion, administration of justice performance of sacrifice, special duties of the people of different castes and stages of life are practised by Sifas again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The study of the three Vedas, agricultural opera¬ tion, administration of justice performance of sacrifice, special duties of the people of different castes and stages of life are practised by Sifas again and again.

verses.sanskrit: सदिति ब्रह्मणः शब्दस्तद्वन्तो ये भवन्त्युत । साजात्याद्ब्रह्मणस्त्वेते तेन सन्तः प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: saditi brahmaṇaḥ śabdastadvanto ye bhavantyuta / sājātyādbrahmaṇastvete tena santaḥ pracakṣate
verses.translation: Since they have been practised by the previous persons they are SistSadra and righteous activity as well.
verses.wordMeaning: Since they have been practised by the previous persons they are SistSadra and righteous activity as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they have been practised by the previous persons they are SistSadra and righteous activity as well.

verses.sanskrit: दशात्मके ये विषये कारणे चाष्टलक्षणे । न क्रुध्यन्ति न त्दृष्यन्ति जितात्मानस्तु ते स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: daśātmake ye viṣaye kāraṇe cāṣṭalakṣaṇe / na krudhyanti na tdṛṣyanti jitātmānastu te smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: W. 37-43 give a peculiar defioiLivo of and explanation of
verses.wordMeaning: W. 37-43 give a peculiar defioiLivo of and explanation of
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 37-43 give a peculiar defioiLivo of and explanation of

verses.sanskrit: सामान्येषु तु धर्मेषु तथा वैशेषिकेषु च । ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशो यस्माद्युक्तास्तस्मा द्द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: sāmānyeṣu tu dharmeṣu tathā vaiśeṣikeṣu ca / brahmakṣatraviśo yasmādyuktāstasmā ddvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: Celibacy, chanting of Mantras, vow of silence and observance of fast—these constitute the form of ra/or (Penance). It is extremely terrible and very difficult to achieve.
verses.hindi: मैंने इस समस्त भूमि को जीत लिया है ओर बलात् समस्त'भूपालों को बाँधकर अपने पुर में मैं ले आया हूँ । वह सभी बल मुझमें विद्यमान है। एतएव अब मैं तुम्हारे साथ युद्ध अवश्य करूँगा ।१५। इतना कहकर उस हैहय पति ने उस दूत को अपने यहाँ से शीघ्र ही विदाकर दिया था । और फिर बोलने वालों में परम शरेष्ठ ने अपनी समस्त सेना के अध्यक्ष को बुला कर उसको आदेश दिया था ।१६। है महाभाग ! आप तो महानु" वीरो के द्वारा माने हुए. बीर हैं। इसी समय भेरी अपनी सब सेना को सज्जित करिए ।- मैं अभो, भृगु राम के साथ युद्ध करूगा अतः इस कायं में बिलम्ब
verses.wordMeaning: Celibacy, chanting of Mantras, vow of silence and observance of fast—these constitute the form of ra/or (Penance). It is extremely terrible and very difficult to achieve.
verses.commentary: Sense: Celibacy, chanting of Mantras, vow of silence and observance of fast—these constitute the form of ra/or (Penance). It is extremely terrible and very difficult to achieve.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमेषु युक्तस्य स्वर्गतौ सुखचारिमः । श्रौतस्मार्तस्य धर्मस्य ज्ञानाद्धर्मज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: varṇāśrameṣu yuktasya svargatau sukhacārimaḥ / śrautasmārtasya dharmasya jñānāddharmajña ucyate
verses.translation: The collection of sacrificial materials, Harir(ghee) offerings, Saman and Yajur Mantras, tviks (sacrificial priests) and Dakids (monetary gifts and fees] is called Yajfta.
verses.hindi: न.ह्ोवे।१७।. जब इस रीति से शीघ्र ही सेना के सुसज्जित करने के लिये सैनाध्यक्ष से कहा गया था तो उस प्रतापन नामक सैनाध्यक्ष ने चतुरङ्गिणी सेना को बहुत ही शीक्र सज्जित करके राजा से निवेदन कर दिया था कि सब सेना प्रस्तुत है ।१८। है विशांपते ! जिस समय में कात्त'बीयें नृप ने
verses.wordMeaning: The collection of sacrificial materials, Harir(ghee) offerings, Saman and Yajur Mantras, tviks (sacrificial priests) and Dakids (monetary gifts and fees] is called Yajfta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The collection of sacrificial materials, Harir(ghee) offerings, Saman and Yajur Mantras, tviks (sacrificial priests) and Dakids (monetary gifts and fees] is called Yajfta.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यायाः साधनात्साधुर्ब्रह्मचारी गुरोर्हितः । गृहाणां साधनाच्चैव गृहस्थः साधुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: vidyāyāḥ sādhanātsādhurbrahmacārī gurorhitaḥ / gṛhāṇāṃ sādhanāccaiva gṛhasthaḥ sādhurucyate
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: आनन्द से युक्त होते हुए अपनी सेना को पूर्णतया सुसज्जित सुना था तो वे सारथि के द्वारा लाये हुए अपने रथ पर समाछ्ळ हो गये ये ।१९। उस राजा कार्तवीर्य के चारों ओर अनेक अक्षौहिणीयों से समन्वित होकर बड़े-बड़े सामन्त मंडलेश्‍्वर उस राजा को परिवारित करके स्थित हो गये थे हे महाराज ! वहाँ पर सेना में करोड़ों को संख्या में हाथी-अश्व-रथ ओर पेदल सैनिज थे जिनकी कोई भी संख्या नहीं थी और वह सेना एक महान् सागर के ही सहश थी
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: साधनात्तपसो ऽरण्ये साधुर्वैखानसः स्मृतः । यतमानो यतिः साधुः स्मृतो योगस्य साधनात्
verses.transliteration: sādhanāttapaso 'raṇye sādhurvaikhānasaḥ smṛtaḥ / yatamāno yatiḥ sādhuḥ smṛto yogasya sādhanāt
verses.translation: If a person, on being scolded or struck does not old or strike in retaliation either verbally, mentally or phy¬ sically—this attitude is remembered as TiHkd (forbearance) and Kama (patience).
verses.wordMeaning: If a person, on being scolded or struck does not old or strike in retaliation either verbally, mentally or phy¬ sically—this attitude is remembered as TiHkd (forbearance) and Kama (patience).
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person, on being scolded or struck does not old or strike in retaliation either verbally, mentally or phy¬ sically—this attitude is remembered as TiHkd (forbearance) and Kama (patience).

verses.sanskrit: एवमाश्रमधर्माणां साधनात्साधवः स्मृताः । गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थो यतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: evamāśramadharmāṇāṃ sādhanātsādhavaḥ smṛtāḥ / gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho yatistathā
verses.translation: Refraining from taking other man's belongings well protected by their owners but abandoned in their excitement, is glorified as Alobha (absence of greed).
verses.hindi: नानालंका रसंयुक्ता मत्ता दानविभूषिताः ३०  ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Refraining from taking other man's belongings well protected by their owners but abandoned in their excitement, is glorified as Alobha (absence of greed).
verses.commentary: Sense: Refraining from taking other man's belongings well protected by their owners but abandoned in their excitement, is glorified as Alobha (absence of greed).

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवा न पितरो मुनयो न च मानुषाः । अयं धर्मो ह्ययं नेति विन्दते भिन्नदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: atha devā na pitaro munayo na ca mānuṣāḥ / ayaṃ dharmo hyayaṃ neti vindate bhinnadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: If man's sense*organ$ do not function falsely cither for his own sake or for others' sake that is the sign of Santa (Quiescence and Restraint of passions).
verses.wordMeaning: If man's sense*organ$ do not function falsely cither for his own sake or for others' sake that is the sign of Santa (Quiescence and Restraint of passions).
verses.commentary: Sense: If man's sense*organ$ do not function falsely cither for his own sake or for others' sake that is the sign of Santa (Quiescence and Restraint of passions).

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्माविहप्रोक्तौ शब्दावेतौ क्रियात्मकौ । कुशलाकुशलं कर्म धर्माधर्माविह स्मृताम्
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmāvihaproktau śabdāvetau kriyātmakau / kuśalākuśalaṃ karma dharmādharmāviha smṛtām
verses.translation: If a person feels that he must give away unto a deserving person whatever is desired most by him, or the money that has come down to him duly and justly, that is the charac¬ teristic sign of Ddna (charitable offering).
verses.hindi: यदा प्रचलितं सैन्ये कात्तंबीर्याजु नस्य वे । वहाँ पर उस सेना में अनेक बंशों में समुत्पन्न हुए भूपाल दिखलाई दे रहे थे जो परम महान् वीर-बड़े विशाल शरोर को धारण करने वाले तथा अनेक प्रकार के युद्ध करने के कौणल में विशारद थे ।२२। वे सब नृप विविध प्रकार के शस्त्रों और अस्तरों के चलाने में प्रवीण थे और बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: If a person feels that he must give away unto a deserving person whatever is desired most by him, or the money that has come down to him duly and justly, that is the charac¬ teristic sign of Ddna (charitable offering).
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person feels that he must give away unto a deserving person whatever is desired most by him, or the money that has come down to him duly and justly, that is the charac¬ teristic sign of Ddna (charitable offering).

verses.sanskrit: धारणर्थो धृतिश्चैव धातुः शब्दे प्रकीर्त्तितः । अधारणामहत्त्वे च अधर्म इति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇartho dhṛtiścaiva dhātuḥ śabde prakīrttitaḥ / adhāraṇāmahattve ca adharma iti cocyate
verses.translation: Ddna is of three types, Kanis/ha (base) Jytftha (superior) and Madhyama (middling). Among them, that which is conducive to salvation is the superior one. That which is only for the sake of achieving ones' own selfish ends is the base one. Sliaring (of one's possessions) with ail living beings out of sympathy is the middling.
verses.hindi: के वाहनों से युक्त थे । ये सब नृप नाना भांति के अलक्ारों से भूषित थे । हस सेना में बड़े मदमत्त हाथी थे जो मद से विभूषित थे ।२३। उस सेना में अनेक प्रकार के नाग णोभा दे रहे थे । जिनका उह श बड़े-बड़े कार्य करना ही था। विविध प्रकार की ज्ञात्रियों में समुत्पन्न होने याले अश्‍व ये जिनकी
verses.wordMeaning: Ddna is of three types, Kanis/ha (base) Jytftha (superior) and Madhyama (middling). Among them, that which is conducive to salvation is the superior one. That which is only for the sake of achieving ones' own selfish ends is the base one.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ddna is of three types, Kanis/ha (base) Jytftha (superior) and Madhyama (middling). Among them, that which is conducive to salvation is the superior one. That which is only for the sake of achieving ones' own selfish ends is the base one.…

verses.sanskrit: अथेष्टप्रापको धर्म आचार्यैरुपदिश्यते । अधर्मश्चानिष्टफलोह्याचार्यैरुपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: atheṣṭaprāpako dharma ācāryairupadiśyate / adharmaścāniṣṭaphalohyācāryairupadiśyate
verses.translation: Rk, Yajusand Saman (are assigned to different Manvantaras) in the same manner as deities are assigned. In spite of the procedure of annihilation of all living beings, atarudriya the procedure of Hotra as well as Sioira (Hymn, Prayer) function as before.
verses.hindi: गति का वेग वायु के ही सहश था ।२४। है भूपाल ! उन अश्वों को उनके साईशों के द्वारा ऐसी शिक्षा दी गयी थी कि वे प्लवन करते हुए शोभा दे रहे थे। उस सेना में बड़े-बड़े सुविशाल और लम्बे-चौड़े रथ में जिनमें ऐसे थोड़े जुड़े हुए ये जो बड़ी ही शीघ्रता से गमन किया करते थे ।२५। रथों के पहियों के चलने के समय में बड़ी जोरदार ध्वनि होती थी जो ऐसे ही प्रतीत हो रहें थे मानों वर्षा काल के मेघ गजंते चले जा रहे होवे। है तृप ! जो पैदल सैनिक ये वे सब ढ़ाल और तलव्रार धारण करने वाले थे
verses.wordMeaning: Rk, Yajusand Saman (are assigned to different Manvantaras) in the same manner as deities are assigned. In spite of the procedure of annihilation of all living beings, atarudriya the procedure of Hotra as well as Sioira (Hymn, Prayer) function as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rk, Yajusand Saman (are assigned to different Manvantaras) in the same manner as deities are assigned. In spite of the procedure of annihilation of all living beings, atarudriya the procedure of Hotra as well as Sioira (Hymn, Prayer) function as before.

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धाश्चालोलुपाश्चैव त्वात्मवन्तो ह्यदांभिकाः । सम्यग्विनीता ऋजवस्तानाचार्यान्प्रजक्षते
