verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच जनकस्याश्वमेधे तु महानासीत्समागमः । ऋषीणां हि सहस्राणि तत्राजग्मुरनेकशः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca janakasyāśvamedhe tu mahānāsītsamāgamaḥ / ṛṣīṇāṃ hi sahasrāṇi tatrājagmuranekaśaḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: उस संग्राम भूमि में परशुराम नृत्य करते हुए जेसे परमाधिक शोभा कोश्रप्त हुए थे और एक सो वे काल बां के पुत्र फिरते हुए चारों ओर णोभित हो रहे थे । उस समय में उन सब की शोभा ऐसी हो रही थी जैसी नित्य विहार स्थल वृन्दावन की निकुडजों में बजा ज़ूना गोपियों के समुदाय के मध्य में महारास के समय में भगवान् त्रो कृष्ण विराजमान थे और उनके चारों ओर गोषाङ्गताए' परिश्रमण कर रही थीं उनकी शोभा हो रही ।८। उस समय सब जिनमें द्रुहिण प्रमुख थे अपने-अपने विमानों पर समवस्थित होकर वहाँ पर समागत हो गये थे ओर उन अहीनवीयें वाले
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: राजर्षेर्जनकस्याथ तं यज्ञं हि दिदृक्षवः । आगतान्ब्राह्मणान्दृष्ट्वा जिज्ञासास्याभवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: rājarṣerjanakasyātha taṃ yajñaṃ hi didṛkṣavaḥ / āgatānbrāhmaṇāndṛṣṭvā jijñāsāsyābhavattataḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: परशुराम के ऊपर सब ओर से नन्दन बन के कमनोय कुसुमों की ' वर्षा कर रहे थे ।९। इस प्रकार जो शस्त्रों का पात उनके ऊपर हो रहा था तब वे परशुराम उस शरों की वृष्टि में उठकर खड़े हो गये थे ओर उनकी ध्वनि हुङ्कार करने वालो थी तब ऐसा श्रतीत हो रहा था मानों वे स्वगं का ही
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: को न्वेषां ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठः कथं मे निश्चयो भवेत् । इति निश्चित्य मनसा बुद्धिं चक्रे जनाधिपः
verses.transliteration: ko nveṣāṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ me niścayo bhavet / iti niścitya manasā buddhiṃ cakre janādhipaḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: स्पर्श कर रहे होवें । उनके शरों के क्षत ऐसे मालूम हो रहे थे जंसे तृत्यगीत करने वाले के दन्तों ओर नखों के पातों के ही चिन्ह दिखाई दे रहे हों बे शस्त्रो से क्षत विक्षत अङ्कों बाले क्रन्दन कर रहे थे मानों कोई गीतों के गान में विज्ञ पुरुष गान कर रहे होंवे । इसी रीति से उन नृपों के साथ युद्ध का मण्डल अबृत्त हुआ था जिसको देवगण अत्यन्त विस्मित नेत्रं वाले होकर देख रहे थे ।११। इसके अनन्तरः प्रभु राम ने धनुष प्रहण करके विविध अस्त्रों
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: गवां सहस्रमादाय सुवर्णमधिकं ततः । ग्रामान्रत्नानि दासीस्छ मुनीन्प्राह नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ sahasramādāya suvarṇamadhikaṃ tataḥ / grāmānratnāni dāsīscha munīnprāha narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: के समुदाय से उन राजा के पुत्रों का रण में हनन करने की इच्छा वाला होकर यद्यपि बे अतीव बलवान् थे तो भो उनको उस मण्डल से विच्छिन्न करके पंक्ति से पृथक् कर दिया था।१२। वे सौ वीर थे उनमें से एक-एक को पकड़कर उन्होंने मार. डाला था । उस समय में केवल उतमें से पांच ही
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानहं प्रपन्नो वः शिरसा श्रेष्ठभागिनः । यदेतदाहृतं वित्तं यो वा श्रेष्ठतमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvānahaṃ prapanno vaḥ śirasā śreṣṭhabhāginaḥ / yadetadāhṛtaṃ vittaṃ yo vā śreṣṭhatamo bhavet
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: बच गये ये जो वहां से भाग गये थे। उन पांचों का धेयं टूट गया था। उनके नाम शूर-बुषास्य-बृष-शूरसेन ओर जयध्वज ये थे ।१३। वे पांचों नूप पृथक् होकर हो चले गये थे ओर के सब नृप अपने प्राणों के बचाने की इच्छा वाले थे । उन में से अत्यन्त आत होकर किसी ने भी किन को भी बहा नहीं देखा था । तात्पर्य यहु है कि सबको अपनी रक्षा को पड़ी थी और कोई भो किसी को न देख पाया था
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै तदुपनीतं मे वित्त वित्तं द्विजोत्तमाः । जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ऋषयस्ते श्रुतिक्षमाः
verses.transliteration: tasmai tadupanītaṃ me vitta vittaṃ dvijottamāḥ / janakasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣayaste śrutikṣamāḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा धनं महासारं धनगृध्ना जिघृक्षवः । आह्वयाञ्चक्रिरे ऽन्योन्यं वेदज्ञानमदोल्बणान्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ mahāsāraṃ dhanagṛdhnā jighṛkṣavaḥ / āhvayāñcakrire 'nyonyaṃ vedajñānamadolbaṇān
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: कृतकार्यो मुदा युक्तः कंलासं प्राप्य तत्क्षणम् । ददर्शे तत्र नगरीं महतीमलकाभिधाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: मनसा गतवित्तास्ते ममैतद्धनमित्युत । ममैतन्न तवेत्यन्यो ब्रूहि वा किं विकत्थसे
verses.transliteration: manasā gatavittāste mamaitaddhanamityuta / mamaitanna tavetyanyo brūhi vā kiṃ vikatthase
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं धनदोषेण वादांश्चकुरनेकशः । अथान्यस्तत्रवै विद्वान्ब्रह्मणस्तु सुतः कविः
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ dhanadoṣeṇa vādāṃścakuranekaśaḥ / athānyastatravai vidvānbrahmaṇastu sutaḥ kaviḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: नानाव्क्षसमाको णै्वेनंश्रौ पवनँयु' ताम् । दीघिकाभिः सुदीर्घाभिस्तडागंग्रोपशोभिताम्
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवल्क्यो महातेजास्तपस्वी ब्रह्मवित्तमः । ब्रह्मण्ॐऽशसमुत्पन्नो वाक्यं प्रोवाच सुस्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yājñavalkyo mahātejāstapasvī brahmavittamaḥ / brahmaṇoṃ'śasamutpanno vākyaṃ provāca susvaram
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यं ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठं धनमेतद्गृहाण वै । नयस्व च गृहंवत्स ममैतन्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyaṃ brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhanametadgṛhāṇa vai / nayasva ca gṛhaṃvatsa mamaitannātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: भगवान् परशुराम ने भी उस रण में उस सम्पूर्ण सूपों के चक्र का हनन कर दिया था तथा जो राजा की सहायता करने के लिये वहाँ उपागत हुआ था उसका भी हनन कर डाला था। फिर यह अकृतब्रण' के साथ रहकर नमेदा नदी के समीप में समागत हुए ये और उस नदी में इन्होंने स्नान किया था ।१५। वहाँ पर स्नान करके अपना देनिक कृत्य समाप्त किया था तथा फिर भगवानु वृषभध्वज का भली भांति अचंन किया था । इसके उप- 'रान्ते कॅलाश के निवासी प्रभु शिव का दशंन प्राप्त करने के लिये चहा से परशुराम जीने प्रस्थान किया था ।१६। अपने मन के ही समान शीघ्र गमन
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववादेष्वहं वक्ता नान्यः कश्चित्तु मत्समः । यो वा न प्रीयते विद्वान्समाह्वयतु माचिरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvavādeṣvahaṃ vaktā nānyaḥ kaścittu matsamaḥ / yo vā na prīyate vidvānsamāhvayatu māciram
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: करने वाले परशुराम जो अपने पालित अङृते्रण शिष्य के साथ गुरु पत्नी जगदम्बा उमा देवी-और उनके दोनों पुत्र स्कन्द और विनायक के द्ेनार्थ बह महात्मा वहाँ पर गये थे ।१७। अपने सम्पूणं कार्यों में सफल होकर समस्त क्षत्रिय शत्रुओं को निहत करके बडी ही प्रसन्नता से युक्त होते हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: ततो ब्रह्मार्णवः क्षुब्दः समुद्र इव संप्लवे । तानुवाच ततः स्वस्थो याज्ञवल्क्यो हसन्निव
verses.transliteration: tato brahmārṇavaḥ kṣubdaḥ samudra iva saṃplave / tānuvāca tataḥ svastho yājñavalkyo hasanniva
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: उसी क्षण में कैलास गिरि पर पहुंच गये थे और भगवान् शद्धुर की अलका नाम वाली नगरी को देखा था जो नगरी बहुत ही विशाल थी ।१८। उस नगरी की छटा का वर्णन किया जाता है--उस नगरी में अनेक भवन ऐसे बने हुए थे जो नाना भाँति के रत्नों से संयुत थे, उन भवनों की शोभा से वहे परम सुशोभित थी  उसमें बहत से यक्ष विद्यमान ये जो विचित्र प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधं मा कार्ष्ट विद्वांसो भवन्तः सत्यवादिनः । वदामहे यथाशक्ति जिज्ञासंतः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: krodhaṃ mā kārṣṭa vidvāṃso bhavantaḥ satyavādinaḥ / vadāmahe yathāśakti jijñāsaṃtaḥ parasparam
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: के भूषणों के धारण करते बाले तथा विविध स्वरूपों वाले थे। इनसे भी उसकी बड़ी शोभा हो रही यो।१९। उस नगरी में बहुत तरह के बन और उपयन थे जिनमें अनेक प्रकार के वृक्ष थे । बह नगरी अनेक विशाल वापियों (वाबड़ियों) से तथा तालाबों से भी परम सुशोभित थी ।२०। उस पुरी का
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽभ्युपगतास्तेषां वादाः शब्दैरनेकशः । सहस्रधा शुभैरर्थैः सुक्ष्मदर्शनसंभवैः
verses.transliteration: tato 'bhyupagatāsteṣāṃ vādāḥ śabdairanekaśaḥ / sahasradhā śubhairarthaiḥ sukṣmadarśanasaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: बाहिरी सब भोर से सीता और अलकनन्दा नाम बाली सुन्दर सरिताओं'से समावृत था । बहाँ पर देवों की आङ्गनाएँ स्तान-कर रही थीं जिससे उनके अद्धों में लगा हुआ कु कुम छूटकर उनके जल में प्रवाहित हो रहा था तृषाविरहिताश्भांभः पिबन्ति करिणो मुदा ।
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: लोके वेदे तथाध्यात्मविद्यास्थानैरलङ्कृतैः । संत्युत्तमगुणैर्युक्ता नृपस्यापि परीक्षकाः
verses.transliteration: loke vede tathādhyātmavidyāsthānairalaṅkṛtaiḥ / saṃtyuttamaguṇairyuktā nṛpasyāpi parīkṣakāḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: वादाः समभवंस्तत्र धनहेतोर्महात्मनाम् । ऋषयस्त्वेकतः सर्वे याज्ञवल्क्यस्तथैकतः
verses.transliteration: vādāḥ samabhavaṃstatra dhanahetormahātmanām / ṛṣayastvekataḥ sarve yājñavalkyastathaikataḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: तस्याधस्ताद्वरावासं सुसेव्यं सिद्धसंयुतम् । ददर्श तत्र प्राकारं शतयोजनमंडलम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ते मुनयस्तेन याज्ञवल्क्येन धीमता । एकैकशस्ततः पृष्टा नैवोत्तरमथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: sarve te munayastena yājñavalkyena dhīmatā / ekaikaśastataḥ pṛṣṭā naivottaramathābruvan
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: स विजित्य मुनीन्सर्वान् ब्रह्मराशिर्महामतिः । शाकल्यमिति होवाच वादकर्त्तारमञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: sa vijitya munīnsarvān brahmarāśirmahāmatiḥ / śākalyamiti hovāca vādakarttāramañjasā
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: उन सरिताओं में तृषा से विरहित करी बड़े ही आनन्द से उनका जल पी रहे थे। वहाँ पर जहाँ-तहाँ संगीत की परम मधुर ध्वनियां सुनाई दे रही थी ।२२। वहाँ पर बहुत से गन्धर्वे गण अव्सराओं को अपने साथ में ३३४ । र ब्रह्यॉघ्ट पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: शाकल्य वद वक्तव्यं किं ध्यायन्नवतिष्ठसे । पणस्तु यजमानेन बद्धो नीतो यथा धृतः
verses.transliteration: śākalya vada vaktavyaṃ kiṃ dhyāyannavatiṣṭhase / paṇastu yajamānena baddho nīto yathā dhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: लिए हुए निरन्तर रंगरेंलियाँ कर रहे ये । भागंव श्री परशुराम जी ने जिस समय में उस परम सुन्दरपुरी का अवलोकन किया उनको अत्यन्त हषं हुआ था ।२३। इसके अनन्तर के उसके ऊपर गये ये जिस शिखर पर भगवान् शिव का परम सुरम्य निवास करने का गृह था । है राजेन्द्र ! वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: एवं स धर्षितस्तेन रोषात्ताम्रास्यलोचनः । प्रोवाच याज्ञवल्क्यं सपुरुषं मुनिसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa dharṣitastena roṣāttāmrāsyalocanaḥ / provāca yājñavalkyaṃ sapuruṣaṃ munisannidhau
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: पर एक महान विशाल बहुत ही घनी छाया वाला बट का वृक्ष उन्होंने! देखा आरा ।२४। उस वट वृक्ष के नीचे एक आवास गृह बना हुआ था जो भली भाँति सेवन 'करने के योग्य था और बड़े-बड़े महाव् सिद्धगणों से समन्वित था  वहाँ पर उसका एक प्रकार (चहार दीवारी) उन्होंने देखा. था जिसका मण्डल (घेरा) एक सो योजन बाला था ।२५। उस नगर में अनेक प्रकार के रत्न खचित हो रहे थे तथा परम रम्य और चार प्रधान द्वारों से बहू सम- स्वित था । वहाँ पर गण सब ओर थे। अब उन प्रधान गणों में नरदीश्वर- महाकाल-रक्ताक्ष ओर विकटोदर थे ।२६। इनके अतिरिक्त पिंगलाक्ष-

verses.sanskrit: ततः समभवद्वादस्तयोर्ब्रह्मविदोर्महान् । साग्रं प्रश्नसहस्रं तु शाकल्यः सो ऽकरोत्तदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samabhavadvādastayorbrahmavidormahān / sāgraṃ praśnasahasraṃ tu śākalyaḥ so 'karottadā

verses.hindi: भी थे ।२९। बहाँ उस शिव को नगरो में यक्ष-किम्पुरुष-डाकिनी और योगि- नियाँ भी थीं । इन सबको वहाँ पर परशरामजी ने अवलोकन किया था । भगवान् णङ्भुर के रई और स्वामो कात्तिकेय और उनके दाई ओर विघ्नेश्वर बिनायक विराजमान डो। भाग वेन्द्र ने उन दोनों को प्रणाम किया था क्‍योंकि ये दोनों शिव के पुत्र शङ्कर के हो समान पराक्रम बाले थो। इससे पूर्व परशुरामजी ने नन्दी की आज्ञा ग्रहण करके ही उस पुर के अन्दर प्रवेश किया था। अन्दर प्रवेश करने की आज्ञा पाकर उनको बहुत ही प्रसन्नता हुईं थी । वहाँ पर भुबनों से सदावृत शिवजी के भन्दिर का
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवल्क्यो ऽब्रवीत्सर्वमृषीणां शृण्वतां तदा । शाकल्यस्त्वास निर्वादो याज्ञवल्क्यस्तमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: yājñavalkyo 'bravītsarvamṛṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā / śākalyastvāsa nirvādo yājñavalkyastamabravīt

verses.hindi: अवलोकन किया था । यह मन्दिर चार योजन के विस्तार वाला था ।३०- ३१-३२ वहाँ पर परम श्र पाषंद ओर लेत्रपाल भी समवस्थित थी ये लोग रत्न जहित सिहासनों पर रनों के विविध भूषणों मे विभूषित होकर विराजम!न थे ।३३। जिस समय में भार्गेव शिव मन्दिर में प्रवेश कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: प्रश्नमेकं ममापि त्वं शाकल्य वद कामिकम् । पणप्राप्यस्य वादस्य ब्रुवतोर्मृत्युरत्र वै
verses.transliteration: praśnamekaṃ mamāpi tvaṃ śākalya vada kāmikam / paṇaprāpyasya vādasya bruvatormṛtyuratra vai

verses.hindi: तब उन सथने इनसे पूछा था है महाराज ! उस समय में विनायक ने उनसे यही कहा था कि एकक्षण माल आप यहीं पर ठहरिए ।३४। इस संमेय में महादेव जी अपनी प्रिय पत्नी जगदम्य्रा उमा के साथ शयन किये हुए हैं । मैं एक ही क्षण भर में ईश्वर की आशषा प्राप्त करके यहीं पर समागत होता पार्वतीशंकरौ सद्यो यास्यामि निजमंदिरम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.transliteration: evaṃ smṛtaḥ sa śākalyaḥ praśnavyākhyānapīḍitaḥ / evaṃ vivādaḥ sumahānāsītteṣāṃ dhanārthinām

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणामृषिभिः सार्द्धं याज्ञवल्क्यस्य चैव हि । याज्ञवल्क्यो धनं गृह्य यशो विख्याय चात्मनः । जगाम वै गृहं स्वच्छं शिष्यैः परिवृतो वशी
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāmṛṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ yājñavalkyasya caiva hi / yājñavalkyo dhanaṃ gṛhya yaśo vikhyāya cātmanaḥ / jagāma vai gṛhaṃ svacchaṃ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto vaśī
verses.translation: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.hindi: कैं फिर है भाई ! आपको साथ हो लेकर आपका प्रबेश वहाँ पर अभी करा दगा । अतएव यहाँ पर कुछ समय तक आप रकिए । भार्गेव नन्दन ने विनायक के इस वचन का श्रवण करके बड़ो ही शीघ्रता से युक्त होकर श्री गणेशजी से कुछ कथन करने का उपक्रम किया था। राम ने कहा--हे भाई ! आप अन्तः पुर में जाकर उन दोनों जगदीश्वरो को प्रणाम करिए अर्थात् मेरा प्रणिपात निवेदित कर दीजिए । पाबंती और शङ्कुर इन दोनों को भ्रणाम करके मैं तुरन्त ही अपने मन्दिर को गमन करूंगा । कात्तंवीयं और सुचन्द्र जो अपने पुत्रों-सेनिकों और बाश्वों के सहित थे
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect vision of impartiality between oneself and all living beings whether for welfare or distress—is remem¬ bered as Dajfd (Mercy, Sympathy).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे व्यासशिष्योत्पत्तिवर्णनं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच देवमित्रश्च शाकल्यो महात्मा द्विजपुङ्गवः । चकार संहिताः पञ्च बुद्धिमान्वेदवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde vyāsaśiṣyotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca devamitraśca śākalyo mahātmā dvijapuṅgavaḥ / cakāra saṃhitāḥ pañca buddhimānvedavittamaḥ

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च तस्याभवञ्छिष्या मुद्गलो गोखलस्तथा । खलीयान्सुतपा वत्सः शैशिरेयश्च पञ्चमः
verses.transliteration: pañca tasyābhavañchiṣyā mudgalo gokhalastathā / khalīyānsutapā vatsaḥ śaiśireyaśca pañcamaḥ
verses.translation: The last question of Yljfiavalkyst to 6&kalya in the Bfhed. Vpa was about Avpmieeda Pvna ud not about the superiority of Ute path of SIhkhya (spiritual wisdom) or Yoga (path of meditation) as in this Purina.
verses.hindi: ३५-३९ मैंने भगवान् भम्भु की ही कृपा से तथा परिपूर्ण प्रसाद से युद्ध में सबका निहनन किया है । अतएव अब मैं उन्हीं प्रभु के चरणों में प्रणाम करके फिर अपने घर को चला जाऊंगा ।४०। इतना निवेदन करके परशु- राम वहाँ पर गणपति के आगे स्थित हो गये शे । फिर उन गणाधिप प्रभु ने भागंव से बहुत मधुर स्वर में कहा था ।४१। विनायक ने कहा- है महा- भाग ! एक मात्र आप यहाँ पर ठहरिए आपको भगयाध् शङ्कुर का दर्शन हो जायगा । है भाई ! आज वे विश्वेश्वर प्रभु भवानी के साथ में विद्यमान हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The last question of Yljfiavalkyst to 6&kalya in the Bfhed. Vpa was about Avpmieeda Pvna ud not about the superiority of Ute path of SIhkhya (spiritual wisdom) or Yoga (path of meditation) as in this Purina.
verses.commentary: Sense: The last question of Yljfiavalkyst to 6&kalya in the Bfhed. Vpa was about Avpmieeda Pvna ud not about the superiority of Ute path of SIhkhya (spiritual wisdom) or Yoga (path of meditation) as in this Purina.

verses.wordMeaning: He had five disciples viz. Mudgala, Gokhala, Khally&n, Sutapas and the fifth his dear (child) Saisireya.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had five disciples viz. Mudgala, Gokhala, Khally&n, Sutapas and the fifth his dear (child) Saisireya.

verses.sanskrit: बाष्कलिस्तु भरद्वाजस्तिस्रः प्रोवाच संहिताः । त्रयस्तस्याभवञ्च्छिष्या महात्मानो गुणान्विताः
verses.transliteration: bāṣkalistu bharadvājastisraḥ provāca saṃhitāḥ / trayastasyābhavañcchiṣyā mahātmāno guṇānvitāḥ
verses.translation: The excellent Brahmana (?) expounded three Sarhhitas viz. ka, Vaiia and Rathitara. He composed a fourth (work) the Ninikta.
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Brahmana (?) expounded three Sarhhitas viz. ka, Vaiia and Rathitara. He composed a fourth (work) the Ninikta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent Brahmana (?) expounded three Sarhhitas viz. ka, Vaiia and Rathitara. He composed a fourth (work) the Ninikta.

verses.sanskrit: धीमांश्च त्वापनापश्च पान्नगारिश्च बुद्धिमान् । तृतीयश्चार्जवस्ते च तपसा शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: dhīmāṃśca tvāpanāpaśca pānnagāriśca buddhimān / tṛtīyaścārjavaste ca tapasā śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: He had four disciples viz. Paila, Iksalaka, Satabalaka the intelligent and Gaja, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: निविकारस्य च शिशोनं दोषः कश्चिदेव हि। यथाहष्ट' करिष्यामि तत्र यत्समयोचितम्
verses.wordMeaning: He had four disciples viz. Paila, Iksalaka, Satabalaka the intelligent and Gaja, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had four disciples viz. Paila, Iksalaka, Satabalaka the intelligent and Gaja, O excellent Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागा महातेजाः संहिताज्ञानपारगाः । इत्येते बहूवृचाः प्रोक्ताः संहिता यैः प्रवर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: vītarāgā mahātejāḥ saṃhitājñānapāragāḥ / ityete bahūvṛcāḥ proktāḥ saṃhitā yaiḥ pravartitāḥ
verses.translation: Bharadvaja, son of Bi>kala, expounded three Sarhhitks. He had three noblesouled disciples endowed with good <iualities.
verses.hindi: हे तात ! पति और पत्नी जब एक ही आसन पर संस्थित होकर संयुक्त होवें और साय में निरत होबें.उस-समय में जो कोई भी सुरत-सुख का भङ्ग किया करता है यह निश्चय हो नरक में गमन किया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Bharadvaja, son of Bi>kala, expounded three Sarhhitks. He had three noblesouled disciples endowed with good <iualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharadvaja, son of Bi>kala, expounded three Sarhhitks. He had three noblesouled disciples endowed with good <iualities.

verses.sanskrit: वैशंपायनशिष्यो ऽसौ यजुर्वेदमकल्पयत् । षडशीतिस्तु तेनोक्ताः संहिता यजुषां शुभाः
verses.transliteration: vaiśaṃpāyanaśiṣyo 'sau yajurvedamakalpayat / ṣaḍaśītistu tenoktāḥ saṃhitā yajuṣāṃ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: They were, Tvapanapa the intelligent, Pannagkri the wise one and the third one Arjava. All of them were praise* worthy, of holy observances due to the power of penance.
verses.hindi: जो कोई अपने पिता-गुरु अथवा भूपति को जबकि वे रहस्य में समुपासीन हों तो इतको कभी भी: बाघा डालते हुए नहीं देखना चाहिए--यह निश्चित सिद्धान्त की बात है ।४४। चाहे इच्छा से या बिना ही इच्छा के कहीं पर भी सुरत क्रीड़ा में उन्मुख पति-पत्नी को जो कोई देखता है अर्थात् देखा करता है उसकी स्त्री का बिच्छेद सात जन्मों तक हो जाया करता है यह परम निश्चित है।४५। जो पराई स्त्री के श्रोणि-बक्ष: स्थल'और मुख को देखता है'तात्पर्यं यह है कि बुरी दृष्टि से देखा करता है'बह'चाहे'अपनी माता हो- भगिनी हो या दुहिता हो इनमें कोई भी हो तो वह नरों में बड़ा ही अधमः
verses.wordMeaning: They were, Tvapanapa the intelligent, Pannagkri the wise one and the third one Arjava. All of them were praise* worthy, of holy observances due to the power of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were, Tvapanapa the intelligent, Pannagkri the wise one and the third one Arjava. All of them were praise* worthy, of holy observances due to the power of penance.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्येभ्यः प्रददौ ताश्च जगूहुस्ते विधानतः । एकस्तत्र परित्यक्तो या५वल्क्यो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyebhyaḥ pradadau tāśca jagūhuste vidhānataḥ / ekastatra parityakto yā5valkyo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: They were devoid of passion. They had great splend¬ our. They were perfect masters of the Sarhhit&s.
verses.hindi: होता है ।४६। भागव ने कहा--आज मैंने आपके मुख से निकले हुए अपूव ही वचन सुने हैं। ये वचन रान्ति से ही निकल गये हैं अथवा आपने हास्य के ही लिये कहे हैं ? ।४७। यह तो सब विकारों से युक्त काभियों के शास्त्र को निदशंन है अर्थात् कामवासना से वासित अन्तःकरण वाले ही ऐसे विषय,
verses.wordMeaning: They were devoid of passion. They had great splend¬ our. They were perfect masters of the Sarhhit&s.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were devoid of passion. They had great splend¬ our. They were perfect masters of the Sarhhit&s.

verses.sanskrit: षडशीतिस्तथा शिष्याः संहितानां विकल्पकाः । सर्वेषामेव तेषां वै त्रिधा भेदाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaśītistathā śiṣyāḥ saṃhitānāṃ vikalpakāḥ / sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ vai tridhā bhedāḥ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: In continuation of note 1. the spiritual or academik genealogy of Paila from kalya onwards is as followi:
verses.hindi: कीं चर्चा किया करते हैं। आप तो विकारों से रहित है और शिशु हैं क्या आपको ऐसा कथन करने से कोई दोष नहीं होता है ? ।४० है भाई ! मैं तो अन्तः पुर में जाऊंगा । आप तो बालक हैं, आपको इस बात से क्‍या ३   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: In continuation of note 1. the spiritual or academik genealogy of Paila from kalya onwards is as followi:
verses.commentary: Sense: In continuation of note 1. the spiritual or academik genealogy of Paila from kalya onwards is as followi:

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा भेदास्तु ते वेदभेदे ऽस्मिन्नवमे शुभे । उदीच्या मध्यदेश्याश्च प्राच्यश्चैव पृथग्विधाः
verses.transliteration: tridhā bhedāstu te vedabhede 'sminnavame śubhe / udīcyā madhyadeśyāśca prācyaścaiva pṛthagvidhāḥ
verses.translation: Gf. hht<U bktufonii CVS P. SI.
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. hht<U bktufonii CVS P. SI.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. hht<U bktufonii CVS P. SI.

verses.sanskrit: श्यामायनिरुदीच्यानां प्रधानः संबभूव ह । मध्यदेशप्रतिष्ठाता चासुरिः प्रथमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śyāmāyanirudīcyānāṃ pradhānaḥ saṃbabhūva ha / madhyadeśapratiṣṭhātā cāsuriḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: There were ehtysix disciples, the propounders of diverse Samhitas and there were three different kinds in every one of them.
verses.hindi: तं हशूवा गजाननो भृगुवरं कोधात्क्षिपंतं त्वरां स्वात्मार्थं परशु' तदा निजकरेणोदृधृत्य वेगेन तु ।
verses.wordMeaning: There were ehtysix disciples, the propounders of diverse Samhitas and there were three different kinds in every one of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were ehtysix disciples, the propounders of diverse Samhitas and there were three different kinds in every one of them.

verses.sanskrit: आलंबिरादिः प्राच्यानां त्रयोदेश्यादयस्तु ते । इत्येते चरकाः प्रोक्ताः संहिता वादिनो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ālaṃbirādiḥ prācyānāṃ trayodeśyādayastu te / ityete carakāḥ proktāḥ saṃhitā vādino dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The three kinds in the splendid last variety of Veda are the (1) Northern (2) of the mkldle region and (3) the eaitern one.
verses.hindi: भूर्लोकं भुवः स्वरपि तस्योर्ध्वं महर्वेजचं लोकं
verses.wordMeaning: The three kinds in the splendid last variety of Veda are the (1) Northern (2) of the mkldle region and (3) the eaitern one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three kinds in the splendid last variety of Veda are the (1) Northern (2) of the mkldle region and (3) the eaitern one.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः चरकाध्वर्यवः केन कारणं ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः । किं चीर्णं कस्य वा हेतोश्चरकत्वं हि भेजिरे
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ carakādhvaryavaḥ kena kāraṇaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ / kiṃ cīrṇaṃ kasya vā hetoścarakatvaṃ hi bhejire
verses.translation: Why are they (called) Carakddlwaryus? Tell the reason factually. What is the (rite) observed (by them)? For what reason did they attain the status of Caraka.
verses.hindi: तस्योध्वं च निदशंयन्भृगुवरं गोलोकमीशात्मजो निष्पात्या धरलोक सप्तकमपत्थि दर्शयामास च ।
verses.wordMeaning: Why are they (called) Carakddlwaryus? Tell the reason factually. What is the (rite) observed (by them)? For what reason did they attain the status of Caraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why are they (called) Carakddlwaryus? Tell the reason factually. What is the (rite) observed (by them)? For what reason did they attain the status of Caraka.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच कार्यमासीदृषीणां च किञ्चिद्ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः । मेरुपृष्ठं समासाद्य तैस्तदा त्विति मन्त्रितम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca kāryamāsīdṛṣīṇāṃ ca kiñcidbrāhmaṇasattamāḥ / merupṛṣṭhaṃ samāsādya taistadā tviti mantritam
verses.translation: The sages had some work to do, O excellent Br&hmana. After reaching the top of the Meru, they conferred with One another as follows:
verses.hindi: वहो पर माता जगदम्बा हैं और पिता भगवान शंकर हैं, आपने दोनों के नाम निरूपित कर ही दिये हैं। वे पावंती और परमेश्वर तो सम्पूर्ण जगतों के पिता-माता हैं ।१०। है राजन ! इतना भर कहकर भागव राम अन्दर जाने के लिए उद्यत हो गये थे। उसी समय में विनायक ने
verses.wordMeaning: The sages had some work to do, O excellent Br&hmana. After reaching the top of the Meru, they conferred with One another as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages had some work to do, O excellent Br&hmana. After reaching the top of the Meru, they conferred with One another as follows:

verses.sanskrit: यो वात्र सप्तरात्रेण नागच्छेद्द्विजसत्तमः । स कुर्याद्ब्रह्महत्यां वै समयो नः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: yo vātra saptarātreṇa nāgaccheddvijasattamaḥ / sa kuryādbrahmahatyāṃ vai samayo naḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: any excellent Brahmana docs not turn up here within seven days, he shall (have to) perform (expiation for) BrahmaQa-slaughter (Brahma-Hatyd). This is proclaimed as our stipulated condition.'*
verses.hindi: शीघ्र ही उठकर उनका कारण कर दिया था अर्थात् अन्तः पुर में जाने से रोक दिया था ५१ पहिले तो उन दोनों का वाग्युद्ध अर्थात् कह्दा सुनी हुई और फिर हाथों को खींच तान हुईं, जब कात्तिकेय जी ने देखा तो उनको बहुत सम्श्रान्ति हुईं थी और उस समय में उन्होंने दोनों को समझाया थाः ।१२। स्वामी स्कन्द ने अपनी बाहुओं से पकड़कर उन दोनों को अलग-अलग.
verses.wordMeaning: any excellent Brahmana docs not turn up here within seven days, he shall (have to) perform (expiation for) BrahmaQa-slaughter (Brahma-Hatyd). This is proclaimed as our stipulated condition.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: any excellent Brahmana docs not turn up here within seven days, he shall (have to) perform (expiation for) BrahmaQa-slaughter (Brahma-Hatyd). This is proclaimed as our stipulated condition.'*

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते सगणाः सर्वे वैशंपायनवर्जिताः । प्रययुः सप्तरात्रेण यत्र संधिः कृतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tataste sagaṇāḥ sarve vaiśaṃpāyanavarjitāḥ / prayayuḥ saptarātreṇa yatra saṃdhiḥ kṛto 'bhavat
verses.translation: Thereafter, all o( them excepting Vaimpayana went to the place where the assemblage had been fixed. (They attended along with all the members of their groups).
verses.hindi: कर दिया था। इसके अनन्तर शत्रु वीरों के हतन करने वाले भगव गणेश जी पर बहुत क्रुद्ध हो गये थे ओर अपनी परशु. लेकर उसका प्रहार करने के लिए उद्यत हो गये थे ।५३। गजानन ने जब यह देखा था कि भृगुवर बड़ी शीघ्रता से क्रोध में भरकर अपने लिए परशु को भ्रक्षिप्त कर रहे "हैं तो
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, all o( them excepting Vaimpayana went to the place where the assemblage had been fixed. (They attended along with all the members of their groups).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, all o( them excepting Vaimpayana went to the place where the assemblage had been fixed. (They attended along with all the members of their groups).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणानां तु वचनाद्ब्रह्महत्यां चकार सः । शिष्यानथ समानीय स वैशंपायनो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇānāṃ tu vacanādbrahmahatyāṃ cakāra saḥ / śiṣyānatha samānīya sa vaiśaṃpāyano 'bravīt
verses.translation: As stated ia the fooiootf on Ch. XXIII, the list of Carakai it eat in the CVS.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने उसी समय में बड़े ही वेग से अपने हाथ से परशराम को ऊपर उठा कर भूर्लोक-धुबर्लोक-स्वर्लोक-आऔर उसके भी ऊपर महर्लोक-जनलोक तप- लोकःसत्यलोक और दूसरे . बैकुण्ठ लोक में ले आये ये ।५४। उन भगवान झम्भु के पुत्र गजानन ने उन भृगुवर उसके ऊपर गोलोक को दिखाते हुए फिर गिराकर नीचे के सातों अतल-वितल-सुतल-तला-तल-रसातल-भहातल और पाताल लोकों को दिखा दिया था। फिर नीचे के लोकों से ऊपर उठाकर सलिल के गर्भ में शीघ्रता से प्रस्षिप्त किया था । जब यह देखा कि बहू भयभीत होकर अपने प्राणों की रक्षा करने की इच्छा बाले हैं तो फिर्
verses.wordMeaning: As stated ia the fooiootf on Ch. XXIII, the list of Carakai it eat in the CVS.
verses.commentary: Sense: As stated ia the fooiootf on Ch. XXIII, the list of Carakai it eat in the CVS.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यां चरध्वं वै मत्कृते द्विजसत्तमाः । सर्वे यूयं समागम्य ब्रूत कामं हितं वचः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāṃ caradhvaṃ vai matkṛte dvijasattamāḥ / sarve yūyaṃ samāgamya brūta kāmaṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: "Perform (the expiation of) BrahmaHatyS on my behalf O excellent Brahmaas. AU of you gather together and utter the words conducive to welfare as desired*
verses.hindi: बहा पर उनको साकर खड़ा कर दिया था जहां पर वे पहिले स्थित
verses.wordMeaning: "Perform (the expiation of) BrahmaHatyS on my behalf O excellent Brahmaas. AU of you gather together and utter the words conducive to welfare as desired*
verses.commentary: Sense: "Perform (the expiation of) BrahmaHatyS on my behalf O excellent Brahmaas. AU of you gather together and utter the words conducive to welfare as desired*

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच अहमेकश्चरिष्यामि तिष्ठन्तु मुनयस्त्विमे । बलेनोत्थापयिष्यामि तपसा स्वेन भावितः
verses.transliteration: yājñavalkya uvāca ahamekaścariṣyāmi tiṣṭhantu munayastvime / balenotthāpayiṣyāmi tapasā svena bhāvitaḥ
verses.translation: "I shall perform it single-handed. Let these sages stand by. Purified by my own penance, I shall lift it up with my powcr".
verses.hindi: गणेशं चाभितो वीक्ष्य निविकारमवस्थितम् । क्रोधाविष्टो भृशं भूत्वा प्राक्षिपरस्वपरश्वधम् अमोघं क्त् कामस्वुः वामे तं दशनेऽग्रहीत्
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall perform it single-handed. Let these sages stand by. Purified by my own penance, I shall lift it up with my powcr".
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall perform it single-handed. Let these sages stand by. Purified by my own penance, I shall lift it up with my powcr".

verses.sanskrit: एव मुक्तस्ततः क्रुद्धो या५वल्क्यम थात्यजत् । उवाच यत्त्वयाधीतं सर्वं प्रत्यर्पयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: eva muktastataḥ kruddho yā5valkyama thātyajat / uvāca yattvayādhītaṃ sarvaṃ pratyarpayasva me
verses.translation: On being told thus, he (Vai jam pay ana) became angry and expelled Yajflavalkya. He said "Return to me every thing that has been learned by you".
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, he (Vai jam pay ana) became angry and expelled Yajflavalkya. He said "Return to me every thing that has been learned by you".
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, he (Vai jam pay ana) became angry and expelled Yajflavalkya. He said "Return to me every thing that has been learned by you".

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः सरूपाणि यजूंषि गुरवे ददौ । रुधिरेण तथाक्तानि च्छर्दित्वा ब्रह्मवित्तमाः
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ sarūpāṇi yajūṃṣi gurave dadau / rudhireṇa tathāktāni ccharditvā brahmavittamāḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, (the sage) the most excellent one among the knowers of Brahman, vomited out the Yajur Mantras that had perceptible forms and had been smeared with blood.
verses.hindi: ३४०   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण हाहाकारो" महानासीह वानां दिवि पश्यताम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, (the sage) the most excellent one among the knowers of Brahman, vomited out the Yajur Mantras that had perceptible forms and had been smeared with blood.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, (the sage) the most excellent one among the knowers of Brahman, vomited out the Yajur Mantras that had perceptible forms and had been smeared with blood.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स ध्यानमास्थाय सर्यमाराधयद्द्विजः । सूर्ये ब्रह्म यदुत्पन्नं तं गत्वा प्रतितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa dhyānamāsthāya saryamārādhayaddvijaḥ / sūrye brahma yadutpannaṃ taṃ gatvā pratitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Thereafter, the Brahma meditated upon the sun- god and propitiated him. The Veda that had come up went over to the sun and stayed there.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the Brahma meditated upon the sun- god and propitiated him. The Veda that had come up went over to the sun and stayed there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the Brahma meditated upon the sun- god and propitiated him. The Veda that had come up went over to the sun and stayed there.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यानि गतान्यूर्ध्वं यजूष्यादित्यमडलम् । तानि तस्मै ददौ तुष्टः सूर्यो वै ब्रह्मरातये
verses.transliteration: tato yāni gatānyūrdhvaṃ yajūṣyādityamaḍalam / tāni tasmai dadau tuṣṭaḥ sūryo vai brahmarātaye
verses.translation: As contrasted with the Mbh and other Purioai, here it is Y&jfia- valkya who assumes the form of a horse aud not the Sun-god, while receiving the new Veda.
verses.hindi: अथ कोलाहलं श्रुत्वा दंतपातध्वनि तथा । पार्वतीशंकरी तत्र समाजग्मतुरीश्वरौ
verses.wordMeaning: As contrasted with the Mbh and other Purioai, here it is Y&jfia- valkya who assumes the form of a horse aud not the Sun-god, while receiving the new Veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: As contrasted with the Mbh and other Purioai, here it is Y&jfia- valkya who assumes the form of a horse aud not the Sun-god, while receiving the new Veda.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वरूपाय मार्त्तण्डो याज्ञवक्ल्याय धीमते । यजूंष्यधीयते तानि ब्राह्मणा येन केनचित्
verses.transliteration: aśvarūpāya mārttaṇḍo yājñavaklyāya dhīmate / yajūṃṣyadhīyate tāni brāhmaṇā yena kenacit
verses.translation: The Brihmaaas who performed penance for warding off the siii of BrahM-hatyft of their guru are called CarnUf—a popular etymology.
verses.hindi: बसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--हे भूपते ! इस रीति से गणाधीश के द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The Brihmaaas who performed penance for warding off the siii of BrahM-hatyft of their guru are called CarnUf—a popular etymology.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brihmaaas who performed penance for warding off the siii of BrahM-hatyft of their guru are called CarnUf—a popular etymology.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वरूपाय दत्तानि ततस्ते वाजिनो ऽमवन् । ब्रह्महत्या तु यैश्चीर्णा चरणाच्चरकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: aśvarūpāya dattāni tataste vājino 'mavan / brahmahatyā tu yaiścīrṇā caraṇāccarakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Jaimini taught his son Sumantu.* Sumantu taught his son Sutvan.
verses.hindi: परशुराम भली भाँति भ्रमित किये गये थे । तब उनको बहुत से अद्भुत लोकों के दर्शन से हषे हुआ था ओर अपने बल पराक्रम की तुच्छता समझ कर बड़ा भारी शोक भी हुआ था ऐसे हषं और शोक से समाविष्ट होकर उन्होंने अपने पराभव का चिन्तन किया था ।१। उस समय में गणेश जी को सामते देखा था कि वें बिना विकार वाले अवस्थित हैं तो फिर अत्यम्त क्रोध में भरकर परशुरामजो ने अपने परश, को फेंककर चलाया था
verses.wordMeaning: Jaimini taught his son Sumantu.* Sumantu taught his son Sutvan.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jaimini taught his son Sumantu.* Sumantu taught his son Sutvan.

verses.sanskrit: वैशंपायनशिष्यास्ते चरकाः समुदाहृताः । इत्येते चरकाः प्रोक्ता वाजिनस्तु निबोधत
verses.transliteration: vaiśaṃpāyanaśiṣyāste carakāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ / ityete carakāḥ proktā vājinastu nibodhata
verses.translation: Gf. the list of iisciples of Y&jftavalkya in CVS. aa that list somewhat differs from the list in the Bd. P.
verses.hindi: गणेशजी ने यह देखा था कि वह परश, अपने पिताजी केद्वारा राम को दिया गया था । उस परश, के प्रहार को अमोघ अर्थात् सफल करने की ही इच्छा वाले गणेशजी ने उस परश्, को अपने वाये दाँत पर ग्रहण कर लिया था ।३। गणेश जी का वह बाँया दाँत उस कुठार से विच्छिन्न होकर भूतल
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. the list of iisciples of Y&jftavalkya in CVS. aa that list somewhat differs from the list in the Bd. P.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. the list of iisciples of Y&jftavalkya in CVS. aa that list somewhat differs from the list in the Bd. P.

verses.sanskrit: या५वल्क्यस्य शिष्यास्ते कण्वो बौधेय एव च । मध्यन्दिनस्तु सापत्यो वैधेयश्चाद्धबौद्धकौ
verses.transliteration: yā5valkyasya śiṣyāste kaṇvo baudheya eva ca / madhyandinastu sāpatyo vaidheyaścāddhabauddhakau
verses.translation: W. $U55 give the genealogy ofS&maveda Teachers. It is different from that in CVS. Our text gives it as follows:
verses.hindi: पर गिर गया था । सुधिर से संदिग्ध (लथपथ) वह दांत भूमि पर एक पंत के ही समान गिर गया था ।४। उस दाँत का पात ऐसा भीषण हुआ था कि सम्पूर्ण सागरों और द्वीपों के सहित यह घरातल विध्वस्त हो गया था और प्रशिवीपाल काँप उठे ये तथा सभी लोकों को बड़ा भारी त्रास उत्पन्न हो गया था ।५। स्वर्गे में जो देवगण देख रहे थे उनमें बड़ा भारी हाहाकार मच गया था और वहाँ पर कात्तिकेय आदि जो सब थे वे सभी अत्यन्त आतुर होकर क्रन्दन करने लगे शे ।६। इसके अनन्तर जब बड़ा भारी वहाँ पर कोलाहल हो गया था तो उस दाँत के गिरने की ध्वनि को
verses.wordMeaning: W. $U55 give the genealogy ofS&maveda Teachers. It is different from that in CVS. Our text gives it as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: W. $U55 give the genealogy ofS&maveda Teachers. It is different from that in CVS. Our text gives it as follows:

verses.sanskrit: तापनीयश्च वत्साश्च तथा जाबालकेवलौ । आवटी च तथा पुण्ड्रो वैणोयः सपराशरः
verses.transliteration: tāpanīyaśca vatsāśca tathā jābālakevalau / āvaṭī ca tathā puṇḍro vaiṇoyaḥ saparāśaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, for the sake of his disciples he perform¬ ed Protest fast unto death (Prayopaveiana). On seeing him furious, Indra granted him a boon.
verses.hindi: सुनकर ईश्वर पावती तथा भगवान् शङ्कर वहाँ पर समागत हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, for the sake of his disciples he perform¬ ed Protest fast unto death (Prayopaveiana). On seeing him furious, Indra granted him a boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, for the sake of his disciples he perform¬ ed Protest fast unto death (Prayopaveiana). On seeing him furious, Indra granted him a boon.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते वाजिनः प्रोक्ता दशपञ्च च सत्तमाः । शतमेकाधिकं ज्ञेयं यजुषां ये विकल्पकाः
verses.transliteration: ityete vājinaḥ proktā daśapañca ca sattamāḥ / śatamekādhikaṃ jñeyaṃ yajuṣāṃ ye vikalpakāḥ
verses.translation: "You will have two disciples of great vigour and unequalled splendour. Let those two extremely intelligent (disciples) study the thousand Samhit.
verses.hindi: पप्रच्छ स्कन्दं पावंती-किमोतदिति कारणम्! ८ स तु पृष्टस्तदा मात्रा सेनानीः सवंमादितः।
verses.wordMeaning: "You will have two disciples of great vigour and unequalled splendour. Let those two extremely intelligent (disciples) study the thousand Samhit.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You will have two disciples of great vigour and unequalled splendour. Let those two extremely intelligent (disciples) study the thousand Samhit.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रमध्यापयामास सुमन्तुमथ जैमिनिः । सुमन्तुश्चापि सुत्वानं पुत्रमध्यापयत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: putramadhyāpayāmāsa sumantumatha jaiminiḥ / sumantuścāpi sutvānaṃ putramadhyāpayatpunaḥ
verses.translation: The splendid disciples of Pausyaftji were known by the name Udicya Samans. Kauiilya studied five Samhitas called Sattvas* (?)
verses.wordMeaning: The splendid disciples of Pausyaftji were known by the name Udicya Samans. Kauiilya studied five Samhitas called Sattvas* (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The splendid disciples of Pausyaftji were known by the name Udicya Samans. Kauiilya studied five Samhitas called Sattvas* (?)

verses.sanskrit: सुकर्माणं ततः सुन्वान्पुत्रमध्यापयत्पुनः । स सहस्रमधीत्याशु सुकर्माप्यथ संहिताः
verses.transliteration: sukarmāṇaṃ tataḥ sunvānputramadhyāpayatpunaḥ / sa sahasramadhītyāśu sukarmāpyatha saṃhitāḥ
verses.translation: The dbciples of Hiranyanabha are remembered as Pr&cya Samagas. The four disciples of Pausyaftji were Laug- &ksi, Kujumi, KuIdi and Langali. Now understand the different branches of these.
verses.hindi: त्वत्तो लब्ध्वा परं तेजो वमं त्रेलोक्यजिद्विभो कात्त वीर्याजु नं संख्ये जितवानूजितं नृपस् +
verses.wordMeaning: The dbciples of Hiranyanabha are remembered as Pr&cya Samagas. The four disciples of Pausyaftji were Laug- &ksi, Kujumi, KuIdi and Langali. Now understand the different branches of these.
verses.commentary: Sense: The dbciples of Hiranyanabha are remembered as Pr&cya Samagas. The four disciples of Pausyaftji were Laug- &ksi, Kujumi, KuIdi and Langali. Now understand the different branches of these.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाचाथ सहस्रस्य सुकर्मा सूर्यवर्चसः । अनध्यायेष्वधीयानांस्तञ्जघान शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: provācātha sahasrasya sukarmā sūryavarcasaḥ / anadhyāyeṣvadhīyānāṃstañjaghāna śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: Vaina, Pracinayoga and Surala were excellent Brahmanai. Kauthuma Paraiarya (son of Parasara) expounded six Samhitas.
verses.hindi: स्वकार्यं साधयित्वा तु प्रादात्तभ्यं च दक्षिणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Vaina, Pracinayoga and Surala were excellent Brahmanai. Kauthuma Paraiarya (son of Parasara) expounded six Samhitas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaina, Pracinayoga and Surala were excellent Brahmanai. Kauthuma Paraiarya (son of Parasara) expounded six Samhitas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायोपवेशमकरोत्ततो ऽसौ शिष्यकारमात् । क्रुद्धं दृष्ट्वा ततः शक्रोवरं सो ऽथ पुनर्ददौ
verses.transliteration: prāyopaveśamakarottato 'sau śiṣyakāramāt / kruddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ śakrovaraṃ so 'tha punardadau
verses.translation: Asurayana and Vaishya were devotedly attached to the elderly Vcdic scholars.
verses.hindi: तव कार्याणि सर्वाणि साधयिष्यति सद्गुरोः । भगवान शङ्कुर ने गणेशजी को अपने सामने देखा था जिनका मुख तिरछा हो गया था और केवल एक ही दाँत था । पार्वतीजी ने स्वामी कात्तिकेय से पूछा था कि इस दुर्घटना के घटित होते का क्या कारण था ।४। माताजी द्वारा जब स्वामी कात्तिकेय से पूछा गया तो सेनानी ने आदि
verses.wordMeaning: Asurayana and Vaishya were devotedly attached to the elderly Vcdic scholars.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asurayana and Vaishya were devotedly attached to the elderly Vcdic scholars.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यतो महावीर्यौं शिष्यौ ते ऽतुलवर्चसौ । अधीयातां महाप्राज्ञौ सहस्रं संहिता उभौ
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyato mahāvīryauṃ śiṣyau te 'tulavarcasau / adhīyātāṃ mahāprājñau sahasraṃ saṃhitā ubhau
verses.translation: The branches of (the school of) Kauthuma, son of Parasara are remembered as six. Langa la (otherwise known as) Salihotra expounded six Samhit.
verses.hindi: से सम्पूर्णे वृत्तान्त माताजी को कहकर सुना दिया शा । उस समय में वहाँ पर परशुराम भी इसको सुन ही रहे ये ।६। है नृप ! जग़तों की जननी पार्वेतीजी ने पूर्ण समाचार श्रवण करके रुष्ट होती हुई अपने प्राणनायक भगवान शङ्कुर से बोलीं ।१०। पावंतीजी ने कहा--हे शम्भो ! यह भागव
verses.wordMeaning: The branches of (the school of) Kauthuma, son of Parasara are remembered as six. Langa la (otherwise known as) Salihotra expounded six Samhit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The branches of (the school of) Kauthuma, son of Parasara are remembered as six. Langa la (otherwise known as) Salihotra expounded six Samhit.

verses.sanskrit: एते सुरा महाभागाः संक्रुद्धा द्विजसत्तम । इत्युक्त्वा वासवः श्रीमान्सुकर्माणं यशस्विनम्
verses.transliteration: ete surā mahābhāgāḥ saṃkruddhā dvijasattama / ityuktvā vāsavaḥ śrīmānsukarmāṇaṃ yaśasvinam
verses.translation: H&lini, Jyamahani, Jaimini, Lomagayani, Kandu and Kohala—these six are remembered as the followers of Langala.
verses.hindi: तो आपका ही शिष्य है और पुत्र के ही समान हुआ था । है विभो ! इसने आप ही से ऐसा परम तेज और त्रैलोक्य को जीतने वाला वम प्राप्त किया है ।११। इसने महान अजित कार्त्तवीर्याजु न नृप को युद्ध में जीत लिया है यह आप ही के द्वारा प्रदत्त बलविक्रम से इसको बिजय हुई है। इसने अपने कार्य को साधित करके अर्थात् अपने शत्रु का निहनन करके अब यह आपकी सेवा में दक्षिणा दी है ।१२। बह यही तो दक्षिणा है कि आप ही के पुत्र के दाँत को अपने कुठार से तोड़कर नीचे गिरा दिया है। आप इसी कार्ये से कृतार्थ होंगे--इसमें लेशमात्र भी संशय नहीं है ।१३। है शम्भो ! आप इस
verses.wordMeaning: H&lini, Jyamahani, Jaimini, Lomagayani, Kandu and Kohala—these six are remembered as the followers of Langala.
verses.commentary: Sense: H&lini, Jyamahani, Jaimini, Lomagayani, Kandu and Kohala—these six are remembered as the followers of Langala.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तक्रोधं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा क्षिप्रमन्तर धात्प्रभुः । तस्य शिष्यो ऽभवद्धीमान् पौष्यञ्जिर्द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śāntakrodhaṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣipramantara dhātprabhuḥ / tasya śiṣyo 'bhavaddhīmān pauṣyañjirdvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: These were the disciples of Laiigali and Samhit&s
verses.hindi: परम श्रेष्ठ अपने छात्र तथा शिष्य की रक्षा कीजिए । आप इसके बड़े ही अच्छे गुरु हैं अत्र आपके समस्त कार्यो को यह ही सिद्ध करेगा
verses.wordMeaning: These were the disciples of Laiigali and Samhit&s
verses.commentary: Sense: These were the disciples of Laiigali and Samhit&s

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यनाभः कौशल्यो द्वितीयो ऽभून्नराधिपः । अध्यापयत पौष्याञ्जिः सहस्रार्द्धं तुसंहिताः

verses.transliteration: gautamaścājabastaśca somarājāyanastataḥ / puṣṭiśca parikṛṣṭaśca ulūkhalaka eva ca

verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्ण और श्रीराधा चरणों में प्रणाम किया था । इसके उपरान्त परशु- राम भी वहीं पर पहुँच गये थे और अपनी गरदन को नीचे की ओर झुकाये हुए आकुलित मन वाले होकर पार्वती जी के चरणों के समीप में ही भूमि में गिर गये थे । किन्तु जब अपने आगे प्रणिपात करते हुए भार्गव को पार्वती जी ने अभिनन्दित नहीं किया था तो यह भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण ते स्वयं उनके हृद्गत अमर्ष का अवलोकन किया था ।२५-२६। उस समय जगतों के नाथ प्रभु श्रीकृष्ण ने अपनी परम मधुर वाणी से पार्वती जी को प्रसन्न करते इए उनसे कहा था ।२७। श्रीकृष्ण ने कहा--अयि ! नगराज की पुन्षि ! आप
verses.wordMeaning: Traditionally there are fourteen tmfyds (lores or sciences) but by adding four subsidiary Vedas, they are rarded as eighteen. CVS, givea the following relations between vedas and upavedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Traditionally there are fourteen tmfyds (lores or sciences) but by adding four subsidiary Vedas, they are rarded as eighteen. CVS, givea the following relations between vedas and upavedas.

verses.sanskrit: यवीयसस्तु वै शालीरङ्गुलीयश्च कौशिकः । शालिमञ्जरिपाकश्च शधीयः कानिनिश्च यः
verses.transliteration: yavīyasastu vai śālīraṅgulīyaśca kauśikaḥ / śālimañjaripākaśca śadhīyaḥ kāniniśca yaḥ
verses.translation: The kings bom of the family ofManu, the fomily of Pururavas, the scions of the families of Ikvaku and Nab* haga—these should be known as Rajar$is (saintly kings).
verses.hindi: तो इतने अधिक सुन्दर मुख वाली हैं कि जिसकी छटा के सामने चन्द्र भी तुच्छ है। आपके अन्दर तो अनन्त गुण गण विद्यमान हैं। अब आप इस जमदग्नि के पुत्र परशुराम को अपने कर कमलों से इसका मस्तक पकड़ कर अपनी गोद में बिठा लीजिए ।२८ा
verses.wordMeaning: The kings bom of the family ofManu, the fomily of Pururavas, the scions of the families of Ikvaku and Nab* haga—these should be known as Rajar$is (saintly kings).
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings bom of the family ofManu, the fomily of Pururavas, the scions of the families of Ikvaku and Nab* haga—these should be known as Rajar$is (saintly kings).

verses.sanskrit: पाराशर्यस्तु धर्मात्मा इति क्रान्तास्तु सामगाः । सामगानां तु सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठौ द्वौ परिकीर्त्तितौ
verses.transliteration: pārāśaryastu dharmātmā iti krāntāstu sāmagāḥ / sāmagānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭhau dvau parikīrttitau
verses.translation: Since they approach the subjects befriending and delighting them, they are called Rajarsis.
verses.hindi: भवभयहारिणि शंभुविहारिणि कल्मषनाशिनि कु भिगते । शृणु देवि महाभागे वेदोक्त' वचनं मम ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since they approach the subjects befriending and delighting them, they are called Rajarsis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they approach the subjects befriending and delighting them, they are called Rajarsis.

verses.sanskrit: पौष्यञ्जिश्च कृतश्चैव संहितानां विकल्पकौ । अथर्वाणं द्विधा कृत्वा सुमन्तुरददाद्द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pauṣyañjiśca kṛtaścaiva saṃhitānāṃ vikalpakau / atharvāṇaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā sumanturadadāddvijāḥ
verses.translation: The splendid Devarsis should be known as those who are well established in the world of the Devas.
verses.hindi: यं कामः क्रोध उद्वेगो भयं नाविशते कदा ।
verses.wordMeaning: The splendid Devarsis should be known as those who are well established in the world of the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The splendid Devarsis should be known as those who are well established in the world of the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कबन्धाय पुनः कृष्णं स च विद्वान्यथाश्रुतम् । कबन्धस्तु द्विधा कृत्वा पथ्यायैकं पुनर्ददौ
verses.transliteration: kabandhāya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sa ca vidvānyathāśrutam / kabandhastu dvidhā kṛtvā pathyāyaikaṃ punardadau
verses.translation: W.89-103 define the termi BrshmsrH Devsrii, Kfjarti, enume¬ rate thdr namci and describe their powen, competence etc.
verses.hindi: वेदस्मृतिपुराणेषु संहितासु च भामिनि तेषामीशस्त्वयं यस्माद्गणेशस्तेन कीत्तितः ।
verses.wordMeaning: W.89-103 define the termi BrshmsrH Devsrii, Kfjarti, enume¬ rate thdr namci and describe their powen, competence etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.89-103 define the termi BrshmsrH Devsrii, Kfjarti, enume¬ rate thdr namci and describe their powen, competence etc.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं देवदर्शायस चतुर्धाकरोत्प्रभुः । मोदो ब्रह्मबलश्चैव पिप्पलादस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ devadarśāyasa caturdhākarotprabhuḥ / modo brahmabalaścaiva pippalādastathaiva ca
verses.translation: In Krta and the other Yugas, at the very outset the establishment of the four castes and stages of life is carried out by all of them.
verses.wordMeaning: In Krta and the other Yugas, at the very outset the establishment of the four castes and stages of life is carried out by all of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Krta and the other Yugas, at the very outset the establishment of the four castes and stages of life is carried out by all of them.

verses.sanskrit: शौल्कायनिश्च धर्मज्ञश्चतुर्थस्तपसि स्थितः । देवदर्शस्य चत्वारः शिष्या ह्येते दृढव्रताः
verses.transliteration: śaulkāyaniśca dharmajñaścaturthastapasi sthitaḥ / devadarśasya catvāraḥ śiṣyā hyete dṛḍhavratāḥ
verses.translation: In the early years of the advent of Treta-Yuga again, these seven sages introduce and establish the division of social classes {Vandas) and stages of life everywhere.
verses.hindi: यः स्थिरो देवयोगेन च्छिन्नं संयोजितं पुनः । हे शम्भु के साय बिहार करने बाली देवि ! आप तो समस्त सांसा-
verses.wordMeaning: In the early years of the advent of Treta-Yuga again, these seven sages introduce and establish the division of social classes {Vandas) and stages of life everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the early years of the advent of Treta-Yuga again, these seven sages introduce and establish the division of social classes {Vandas) and stages of life everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च त्रिविधं विद्धि पथ्यानां भेदमुत्तमम् । जाजलिः कुमुदादिश्च तृतीयः शौनकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: punaśca trividhaṃ viddhi pathyānāṃ bhedamuttamam / jājaliḥ kumudādiśca tṛtīyaḥ śaunakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: These (householders) resort to the Pitryana to the South of Aryaman (Sun). They take wives unto themselves and perform Agnihotra sacrifices and they are remembered as causes of progeny,
verses.hindi: रिक भयों को दूर करने वाली हैं और सभी प्रकार के कल्मषों का विनाश कर देने वाली हैं । है कुम्भिगते ! अर्थात् मत्तकरिणी के समान मन्द गति बाली ! यह परशुराम अब आपके चरणों में पड़ा हुआ आप को प्रणिपात कर रहा है। यद्यपि इसने निरन्तर आपके अपराध रूपी पाप किया है
verses.wordMeaning: These (householders) resort to the Pitryana to the South of Aryaman (Sun). They take wives unto themselves and perform Agnihotra sacrifices and they are remembered as causes of progeny,
verses.commentary: Sense: These (householders) resort to the Pitryana to the South of Aryaman (Sun). They take wives unto themselves and perform Agnihotra sacrifices and they are remembered as causes of progeny,

verses.sanskrit: शौनकस्तु द्विधा कृत्वा ददावेकान्तु बभ्रवे । द्द्वितीयां संहितां धीमान्सैन्धवायनसंज्ञि ते
verses.transliteration: śaunakastu dvidhā kṛtvā dadāvekāntu babhrave / ddvitīyāṃ saṃhitāṃ dhīmānsaindhavāyanasaṃjñi te
verses.translation: The householders are inniunerable. They resort to cremation grounds. Eightyeight thousand of them are placed in the Northern path.
verses.hindi: तथापि इसको क्षमा करके अब वरदान दे दीजिए ।२९। है देवि! आप तो महाभू भाग. वाली हैं। अब आप मेरे वेदों में कहे हुए वचन का श्रवण कीजिए । मुझे पूर्ण विश्वास है कि उस मेरे वचन को सुनकर आप निश्चय ही परम हृषित हो जायगी । इसमें लेशमाअ भी संशय नहीं है । यह विना- यक (गणेश) आपका पुत्र है और यह महान् आत्मा वाले तथा महान् पुरुषों में भी शिरोमणि महान् पुरुषों में भी शिरोमणि महान् हैं।३०। इनके हृदय में कभो भी काम-क्रोध-उद्ोग और भय आदि का प्रवेश नहीं हुआ करता है। है भामिनि ! वेदों में स्मृतियों में पुराणों में तथा संहिताओं में सर्वत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The householders are inniunerable. They resort to cremation grounds. Eightyeight thousand of them are placed in the Northern path.
verses.commentary: Sense: The householders are inniunerable. They resort to cremation grounds. Eightyeight thousand of them are placed in the Northern path.

verses.sanskrit: सैन्धवो मुञ्जकेश्यश्च भिन्नामाधाद्द्विधा पुनः । नक्षत्रकल्पो वैतानस्तृतीयः संहिताविधिः
verses.transliteration: saindhavo muñjakeśyaśca bhinnāmādhāddvidhā punaḥ / nakṣatrakalpo vaitānastṛtīyaḥ saṃhitāvidhiḥ
verses.translation: W. 104-108 describe the ipeclsl qualifications and charactem- tici of Saptanis (Seven Sages) as it is their job to create law, order and dharma at the beginning of a Yuga and establish a well organised society.
verses.hindi: इनके शुभमानों का वर्णन य १। बड़े-बड़े महात्माओं के द्वारा सुपुण्यमय इनके नामों का उपदेश दिया गया है। वे इनके परम शुभ नाम समस्त अघों के दुर कर देने बाले हैं। ओ भो वेनाम हैं उनको मैं अभी आपको बतला दूंगा।३२। जो भी भ्रमथों के गण हैं जिनके विविध स्वरूप हैं और जो
verses.wordMeaning: W. 104-108 describe the ipeclsl qualifications and charactem- tici of Saptanis (Seven Sages) as it is their job to create law, order and dharma at the beginning of a Yuga and establish a well organised society.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 104-108 describe the ipeclsl qualifications and charactem- tici of Saptanis (Seven Sages) as it is their job to create law, order and dharma at the beginning of a Yuga and establish a well organised society.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थ्ॐऽगिरसः कल्पः शान्तिकल्पश्च पञ्चमः । श्रेष्ठास्त्वथर्वणामेते संहितानां विकल्पकाः
verses.transliteration: caturthoṃ'girasaḥ kalpaḥ śāntikalpaśca pañcamaḥ / śreṣṭhāstvatharvaṇāmete saṃhitānāṃ vikalpakāḥ
verses.translation: The vcdas were classified twenty-eight times by the great sages. During the first Dvapara, the Vedas were classified by the self-bom lord himself.
verses.hindi: महान् बल वाले हैँ । उन सबके यह गणेश स्वामी हैं। यहो कारण है कि इनका नाम “गणेश” यह संसार में कहा जाया करता है ।३३। जितने भी जो भी भविष्य में होने वाले हैं और समस्त जो भी ब्रह्माण्ड हैं जिनमें यहीँ लम्बोदर हैं अर्थात् लम्बे विशाल उदर वाले यही हैं ।३४। जो भी इस समये में स्थिर है यह पहिले एक बार देव के योग से इनका मस्तक छिन्न हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: The vcdas were classified twenty-eight times by the great sages. During the first Dvapara, the Vedas were classified by the self-bom lord himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The vcdas were classified twenty-eight times by the great sages. During the first Dvapara, the Vedas were classified by the self-bom lord himself.

verses.sanskrit: खड्गः कृत्वा मया युक्तं पुराणमृषिसत्तमाः । आत्रेयः सुमतिर्धीमान्काश्यपो ह्यकृतव्रणः
verses.transliteration: khaḍgaḥ kṛtvā mayā yuktaṃ purāṇamṛṣisattamāḥ / ātreyaḥ sumatirdhīmānkāśyapo hyakṛtavraṇaḥ
verses.translation: Sarasvata in the ninth, Tridhaman in the tenth; Trivar in the eleventh and Sanadvaja (was the Vyasa) there* after (i.c. in the 12th),
verses.hindi: ३४६   अह्ाष्क पुराण था और फिर उसको संयोजित किया था जो कि एक गज के शिर से ही जोड़ दिया गया था । है देति ! इसीलिए यह गजानन नाम वाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Sarasvata in the ninth, Tridhaman in the tenth; Trivar in the eleventh and Sanadvaja (was the Vyasa) there* after (i.c. in the 12th),
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarasvata in the ninth, Tridhaman in the tenth; Trivar in the eleventh and Sanadvaja (was the Vyasa) there* after (i.c. in the 12th),

verses.sanskrit: भारद्वाजो ऽग्निवर्चाश्च वासिष्ठा मित्रयुश्च यः । सावर्णिः सोमदत्तिश्च सुशर्मा शांशपायनः
verses.transliteration: bhāradvājo 'gnivarcāśca vāsiṣṭhā mitrayuśca yaḥ / sāvarṇiḥ somadattiśca suśarmā śāṃśapāyanaḥ
verses.translation: Brhaspati, 5. Savitr, 6. Mrtyu, 7. Indra, 8. Vasistha, 9. Sarasvata, 10. Tridhaman 11. Trivara, 12. Sanadvija, 13. Aatarlkfa, 14. Dharma, 15 TraiyUru, 16. Dhanafijaya, 17. Krtaiijaya, 18. Rjha, 19. BbaradvSja,
verses.hindi: शप्तः पूरा सप्तभिस्तु मुनिभिः संक्षयं गतः । पूरा देवासुरे युद्धो पूजितो दिविषद्गणेः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaspati, 5. Savitr, 6. Mrtyu, 7. Indra, 8. Vasistha, 9. Sarasvata, 10. Tridhaman 11. Trivara, 12. Sanadvija, 13. Aatarlkfa, 14. Dharma, 15 TraiyUru, 16. Dhanafijaya, 17. Krtaiijaya, 18. Rjha, 19. BbaradvSja,
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati, 5. Savitr, 6. Mrtyu, 7. Indra, 8. Vasistha, 9. Sarasvata, 10. Tridhaman 11. Trivara, 12. Sanadvija, 13. Aatarlkfa, 14. Dharma, 15 TraiyUru, 16. Dhanafijaya, 17. Krtaiijaya, 18. Rjha, 19. BbaradvSja,

verses.sanskrit: एते शिष्या मम प्रोक्ताः पुराणेषु धृतव्रताः । त्रिभिस्तत्र कृतास्तिस्रः संहिताः पुनरेव हि
verses.transliteration: ete śiṣyā mama proktāḥ purāṇeṣu dhṛtavratāḥ / tribhistatra kṛtāstisraḥ saṃhitāḥ punareva hi
verses.translation: Gautama, 21. Uttama, 22. Haryavana, 23. Vena, 20. VSjairavaoa
verses.hindi: अद्यायं देवि रामेण कुठारेण निपात्य च ।
verses.wordMeaning: Gautama, 21. Uttama, 22. Haryavana, 23. Vena, 20. VSjairavaoa
verses.commentary: Sense: Gautama, 21. Uttama, 22. Haryavana, 23. Vena, 20. VSjairavaoa

verses.sanskrit: काश्यपः संहिता कर्त्ता सावर्णिः शांशपायनः । मामिका तु चतुर्थी स्याच्चतस्रो मूलसंहिताः
verses.transliteration: kāśyapaḥ saṃhitā karttā sāvarṇiḥ śāṃśapāyanaḥ / māmikā tu caturthī syāccatasro mūlasaṃhitāḥ
verses.translation: Somamukhy&yaoa, 26. Trtabindu, 27. Tata, 28. Sakti, 29. Paraiara
verses.hindi: दशनं हैवतो भद्रे ह्येकदंत: कृतोऽमुना भविष्यत्यथ पर्याये ब्रह्मणो हरवल्लभे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Somamukhy&yaoa, 26. Trtabindu, 27. Tata, 28. Sakti, 29. Paraiara
verses.commentary: Sense: Somamukhy&yaoa, 26. Trtabindu, 27. Tata, 28. Sakti, 29. Paraiara

verses.sanskrit: सर्वास्ता हि चतुष्पादाः सर्वाश्चैकार्थवाचिकाः । पाठान्तरे वृथाभूता वेदशाखा यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvāstā hi catuṣpādāḥ sarvāścaikārthavācikāḥ / pāṭhāntare vṛthābhūtā vedaśākhā yathā tathā
verses.translation: J&tukam Dvaipliyuu, 32. Future Vyftsa V DraU 9 i(Aivatth&niaa), It is strange that 31 Vyisas should be mcntiMied instead of die prescribed no. 28. Moreover, there are discrepancies in the lists of Vyisas in other Purixtas. For example K 52 gives the foUowingUiftmnt names of Vyisas 11. Bfabba,
