verses.sanskrit: चतुः साहस्रिकाः सर्वाः शांशपायनिकामृते । लौमहर्षणिका मूला ततः काश्यपिका परा
verses.transliteration: catuḥ sāhasrikāḥ sarvāḥ śāṃśapāyanikāmṛte / laumaharṣaṇikā mūlā tataḥ kāśyapikā parā
verses.translation: Sutqas, 14. Sucak, 22. Niriyaa, 24. Vilmlki.
verses.hindi: मयास्मं तु वरो दत्तः सवदेवाग्रपूजने तिथि में चन्द्रमा उदित हुआ था और दर्भो के द्वारा इसको
verses.wordMeaning: Sutqas, 14. Sucak, 22. Niriyaa, 24. Vilmlki.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sutqas, 14. Sucak, 22. Niriyaa, 24. Vilmlki.

verses.sanskrit: सावर्णिका तृतीयासावृजुवाक्यार्थमण्डिता । शांशपायनिका चान्या नोदनार्थविभूषिता
verses.transliteration: sāvarṇikā tṛtīyāsāvṛjuvākyārthamaṇḍitā / śāṃśapāyanikā cānyā nodanārthavibhūṣitā
verses.translation: Antarik (was Vyisa) in the thirteenth; Dharma in the fourteenth; Traiyarui in the fifteenth and Dhanafljaya in the sixteenth.
verses.hindi: शाप दे दिया गया था तब यह अत्यन्त आतुर हो गया था। उस समय में इन्हीं गणेश ने इसको अपने माल में धारण कर लिया था । तभी से इसका नाम भाल चन्द्र कहा गया है ।३६। प्राचीन काल में पहिले सात मुनियों ने एक बार इसको शाप दे दिया थां । इसी कारण से यह क्षीणता को प्राप्त हो
verses.wordMeaning: Antarik (was Vyisa) in the thirteenth; Dharma in the fourteenth; Traiyarui in the fifteenth and Dhanafljaya in the sixteenth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Antarik (was Vyisa) in the thirteenth; Dharma in the fourteenth; Traiyarui in the fifteenth and Dhanafljaya in the sixteenth.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि ऋचां चाष्टौ षट्शतानि तथैव च । एताः पञ्चदशान्याश्च दशान्या दशभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇi ṛcāṃ cāṣṭau ṣaṭśatāni tathaiva ca / etāḥ pañcadaśānyāśca daśānyā daśabhistathā
verses.translation: Perpetual and repeated obeisance unto that Supreme Brahman. In the ICrta Yuga (as) there is no religious rite, how can there be persons who have not done their reli¬ gious duties?
verses.hindi: गया था । इनके द्वारा एक वार जातवेदा (अग्नि) दीपित किया गया था । इसी कारण से तभी से इनका शुपकर्णक नाम हो गया था ।३७। पहिले समय में देवों और असुरों का महान् भीषण देवासुर संग्राम हुआ था उसमें देवगणों के द्वारा इनकी बड़ी अचेना हुई थी । उससे परम प्रसन्न होकर इन्होंने सभो. विघ्नों का. निवारण कर दिया घा । फिर तभी से इनका विघ्न नाश--यह शुभ नाम पड़ गमा था ।३८। है देवि ! आज परशुराम के डरा इसके ऊपर अपने कुठार का भ्रह्मार किया गया है है मद्रे ! इससे हैववशात् इनका एक
verses.wordMeaning: Perpetual and repeated obeisance unto that Supreme Brahman. In the ICrta Yuga (as) there is no religious rite, how can there be persons who have not done their reli¬ gious duties?
verses.commentary: Sense: Perpetual and repeated obeisance unto that Supreme Brahman. In the ICrta Yuga (as) there is no religious rite, how can there be persons who have not done their reli¬ gious duties?

verses.sanskrit: सवालखिल्याः सप्तैताः ससुपर्णाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः । अष्टौ सामसहस्राणि सामानि च चतुर्द्दश
verses.transliteration: savālakhilyāḥ saptaitāḥ sasuparṇāḥ prakīrttitāḥ / aṣṭau sāmasahasrāṇi sāmāni ca caturddaśa
verses.translation: Sages are repeatedly bora in the Yugas again and again. They compose various Saihhitis as they are born of each other.
verses.hindi: दाँत टूटकर गिर गया है। इसीलिये इनने इसको एकदन्त कर दिया है ।३६। है हर ! बल्लमे ! इसके अनन्तर यहु ब्रह्म के पर्य्याय में होगे । कुठार के ही प्रहार से इनका मुख कुछ वक सा हो गया है तभी से बुधों के द्वारा इनको वक्रतुण्ड कहा गया है ।५०। है पार्वति ! इसो भांति से आपके इस
verses.wordMeaning: Sages are repeatedly bora in the Yugas again and again. They compose various Saihhitis as they are born of each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages are repeatedly bora in the Yugas again and again. They compose various Saihhitis as they are born of each other.

verses.sanskrit: सारण्यकं सहोहं च एतद्गायन्ति सामगाः । द्वादशैव सहस्राणि च्छन्द आध्वर्यवं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sāraṇyakaṃ sahohaṃ ca etadgāyanti sāmagāḥ / dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi cchanda ādhvaryavaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: In every Yuga» those Vakhas are classified again and again by those who resorted to cremation grounds and the Southern path.
verses.hindi: पुत्र (गणेश) के अनेक नाम हैं। जिनका तीनों कालों में अर्थात् प्रातः- मध्याह्न और सायंकाल में स्मरण करने वाले होते हैं ।४१। इस त्रयोदशी कस्प से पूर्व कदमी भव में मैंने ही इनको यह वरदान दे दिया था कि समस्त देवों के पूजन के पहिले इन्हीं का स्ं्रथम पूजन हुआ करेगा जातकर्मादिसंस्कारे गर्भाधानादिकेऽपि च ।
verses.wordMeaning: In every Yuga» those Vakhas are classified again and again by those who resorted to cremation grounds and the Southern path.
verses.commentary: Sense: In every Yuga» those Vakhas are classified again and again by those who resorted to cremation grounds and the Southern path.

verses.sanskrit: यजुषां ब्राह्मणानां च तथा व्यासो व्यकल्पयत् । सग्राम्यारण्यकं तस्मात्समन्त्रकरणं तथा
verses.transliteration: yajuṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tathā vyāso vyakalpayat / sagrāmyāraṇyakaṃ tasmātsamantrakaraṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: In all the Dvapara Yugas, the Saihhitas (are classi¬ fied) by the Srutarsis. These Sakhas are in vogue again and again in their Gotras (families).
verses.hindi: यात्रायां च वणिज्यादौ युद्धो देवाचंने शुभे ।
verses.wordMeaning: In all the Dvapara Yugas, the Saihhitas (are classi¬ fied) by the Srutarsis. These Sakhas are in vogue again and again in their Gotras (families).
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the Dvapara Yugas, the Saihhitas (are classi¬ fied) by the Srutarsis. These Sakhas are in vogue again and again in their Gotras (families).

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं कथानं तु पूर्वा इति विशेषणम् । ग्राम्यारण्यं समन्त्रं तदृग्ब्राह्मणयजुः स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ kathānaṃ tu pūrvā iti viśeṣaṇam / grāmyāraṇyaṃ samantraṃ tadṛgbrāhmaṇayajuḥ smṛtam
verses.translation: There are classifications of Sakhas in all the Manvantaras. They have passed by in the past Manvantaras; they exist in the current Manvantara. Whatever is going to take place will take place in the future Manvantaras. The succeeding one should be understood by means of the preced¬ ing one, and both should be understood by means of the current one.
verses.hindi: संकष्टे काम्यसिद्धघर्थं पूजयेद्यो गजाननम् । तस्य सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्धत्येव न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: There are classifications of Sakhas in all the Manvantaras. They have passed by in the past Manvantaras; they exist in the current Manvantara. Whatever is going to take place will take place in the future Manvantaras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There are classifications of Sakhas in all the Manvantaras. They have passed by in the past Manvantaras; they exist in the current Manvantara. Whatever is going to take place will take place in the future Manvantaras.…

verses.sanskrit: तथा हारिद्रवीर्याणां खिलान्युपखिलानितु । तथैव तैत्तिरीयाणां परक्षुद्रा इति स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: tathā hāridravīryāṇāṃ khilānyupakhilānitu / tathaiva taittirīyāṇāṃ parakṣudrā iti smṛtam
verses.translation: The decisive (knowledge) regarding the Man¬ vantara is in the same manner. Thus the Devas, the the
verses.wordMeaning: The decisive (knowledge) regarding the Man¬ vantara is in the same manner. Thus the Devas, the the
verses.commentary: Sense: The decisive (knowledge) regarding the Man¬ vantara is in the same manner. Thus the Devas, the the

verses.sanskrit: द्वे सहस्रे शतन्यूने वेदे वाजसनेयके । ऋग्गमः परिसंख्यातो ब्राह्मणं तु चतुर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: dve sahasre śatanyūne vede vājasaneyake / ṛggamaḥ parisaṃkhyāto brāhmaṇaṃ tu caturguṇam
verses.translation: This puri repeatedly emphsiiitt the belief that everything takes place in the manner by the same persons as in the previous Manvantara vide ftV X. 190.3 £>hdt4 There is little that is
verses.hindi: द्विधा भिन्नौ प्रकाशेते प्रपंचेस्मिद यथा तथा तवं चाहमावयोर्देवि भेवो नँवास्ति कश्चन ।
verses.wordMeaning: This puri repeatedly emphsiiitt the belief that everything takes place in the manner by the same persons as in the previous Manvantara vide ftV X. 190.3 £>hdt4 There is little that is
verses.commentary: Sense: This puri repeatedly emphsiiitt the belief that everything takes place in the manner by the same persons as in the previous Manvantara vide ftV X. 190.3 £>hdt4 There is little that is

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ सहस्राणि शतानि वाष्टावशीतिरन्यान्यधिकानि वा च । एतत्प्रमाणं यजुषामृचां च सशुक्रियं सखिलं याज्ञवल्क्यम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau sahasrāṇi śatāni vāṣṭāvaśītiranyānyadhikāni vā ca / etatpramāṇaṃ yajuṣāmṛcāṃ ca saśukriyaṃ sakhilaṃ yājñavalkyam
verses.translation: Thus thousands of Deva*Yugas have passed by. They face death in the Brahmaloka along with the sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus thousands of Deva*Yugas have passed by. They face death in the Brahmaloka along with the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus thousands of Deva*Yugas have passed by. They face death in the Brahmaloka along with the sages.

verses.sanskrit: तथा चारणविद्यानां प्रमाणसहितं शृणु । षट्सहस्रमृचामुक्तमृचः षड्विंशतिं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tathā cāraṇavidyānāṃ pramāṇasahitaṃ śṛṇu / ṣaṭsahasramṛcāmuktamṛcaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Tlui h another way of stmtiiig the eternal nature of tme.
verses.hindi: शिवस्य हृदये विष्णुर्भवत्या रूपमास्थितः । जातकर्म आदि षोडश संस्कारों के कराने के समय में तथा गर्म के
verses.wordMeaning: Tlui h another way of stmtiiig the eternal nature of tme.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tlui h another way of stmtiiig the eternal nature of tme.

verses.sanskrit: एतावदधिकं तेषां यजुः कि मपि वक्ष्यते । एकादशसहस्राणि ऋचश्चान्या दशोत्तराः
verses.transliteration: etāvadadhikaṃ teṣāṃ yajuḥ ki mapi vakṣyate / ekādaśasahasrāṇi ṛcaścānyā daśottarāḥ
verses.translation: The lord has said that the period of Manu't reign consists of seventy one sets of four Yugas along with the extra years (of the Sandhyis and Sandhyiihlas).
verses.hindi: आधान आदि कर्मों मे-यात्रा के करते के समय में वाणिज्य आदि च्यसायीं के करने के काल में-संग्राम के आरंम्भ करने के समय में एवं किसी भी
verses.wordMeaning: The lord has said that the period of Manu't reign consists of seventy one sets of four Yugas along with the extra years (of the Sandhyis and Sandhyiihlas).
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord has said that the period of Manu't reign consists of seventy one sets of four Yugas along with the extra years (of the Sandhyis and Sandhyiihlas).

verses.sanskrit: ऋचां दशसहस्राणि ह्यशीतिस्त्रिंशदेव तु । सहस्रमेकं मन्त्राणामृचामुक्तं प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: ṛcāṃ daśasahasrāṇi hyaśītistriṃśadeva tu / sahasramekaṃ mantrāṇāmṛcāmuktaṃ pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: Thus, the characteristic feature of all the Manvan¬ taras past and future has been described by means of the present (current) one.
verses.hindi: ३४८   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण शुभ कार्य के करने के समय में तया सङ्कूट के आ पड़ने पर और किसी भी कामना से युक्त कार्य की सिद्धि के लिए जो भी कोई इन गजानन प्रभु का पूजन करेगा उस पुरुष के समस्त कार्य अवश्यमेव सिद्ध हो जाया करते हैं-- इनमें कुछ भी संशय नहीं है ।४३-४४ श्री वसिष्ठजी ने कहा--परम शुभ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the characteristic feature of all the Manvan¬ taras past and future has been described by means of the present (current) one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the characteristic feature of all the Manvan¬ taras past and future has been described by means of the present (current) one.

verses.sanskrit: एतावानृचि विस्तारो ह्यन्यच्चाथर्विकं बहु । ऋचामथर्वणां पञ्चसहस्राणीति निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: etāvānṛci vistāro hyanyaccātharvikaṃ bahu / ṛcāmatharvaṇāṃ pañcasahasrāṇīti niścayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, the creation of Svayambhuva Manu has been recounted to you. I shall mention its Pratbandhi as well as that of the other.
verses.hindi: मुख वाली जगतों की स्वामिनी पार्वती श्रीकृष्ण महानु आत्मा वाले प्रभु के द्वारा इस प्रकार से कहे हुए बचन का श्रवण करके अत्यन्त विस्मित हो गयी थीं ।४५। जब भगवान् शिव की सन्निधि में पाबंतीजी ने कुछ भी उत्तर नहीं दिया था उस समय में सनातनी शिव के स्वरूप वाली राधा जी ने
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the creation of Svayambhuva Manu has been recounted to you. I shall mention its Pratbandhi as well as that of the other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the creation of Svayambhuva Manu has been recounted to you. I shall mention its Pratbandhi as well as that of the other.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रमन्यद्विज्ञेयमृषि भिर्विशतिं विना । एतदङ्गिरसां प्रोक्तं तेषामारण्यकं पुनः
verses.transliteration: sahasramanyadvijñeyamṛṣi bhirviśatiṃ vinā / etadaṅgirasāṃ proktaṃ teṣāmāraṇyakaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: A Manvantara duly repeats itself as before along with the sages and the Devas on account of the inevitability of events.
verses.hindi: देवी से कहा था ।४६। श्री राघाजी ने कहा--जिस रीति से इस अपण्च में पुरुष और प्रकृति दोनों परस्पर में एक दूसरे के आश्रम में विग्रहों (स्वरूपों) को रखने वाले हैं और दो रूपों में भिन्न प्रकाशित हुआ करते हैं उसी रीति से है देबि! भूपः ओर में दोनों में दो रूप तो हैं किन्तु बस्तुत कोई भी भेद नहीं है । तुम कु और अही णिव है और द्विगुणता को आल हुआ है ।४७-४०। भगवान् शिव के हृदय में विष्णु आपके रूप में समास्थित हैं और मेरे रूप में समास्थित होकर भगवान् विष्णु के हृदय में शिव है
verses.wordMeaning: A Manvantara duly repeats itself as before along with the sages and the Devas on account of the inevitability of events.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Manvantara duly repeats itself as before along with the sages and the Devas on account of the inevitability of events.

verses.sanskrit: इति संख्या प्रसंख्याता शाखाभेदास्तथैव तु । कर्तारशचैव शाखानां भेदहेतूंस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: iti saṃkhyā prasaṃkhyātā śākhābhedāstathaiva tu / kartāraśacaiva śākhānāṃ bhedahetūṃstathaiva ca
verses.translation: The lords of the three worlds, the seven sages, the Devas, the Pitrs and the Manus who had been in existence earlier in this Manvantara, realise the imnunence of their death at the time when the period of Manvantara along with the extra years becomes complete. They know that their reign has come to an end. On realising this, they become sad and all of them are eager to go to hharloka.
verses.wordMeaning: The lords of the three worlds, the seven sages, the Devas, the Pitrs and the Manus who had been in existence earlier in this Manvantara, realise the imnunence of their death at the time when the period of Manvantara along with the extra years becomes complete.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lords of the three worlds, the seven sages, the Devas, the Pitrs and the Manus who had been in existence earlier in this Manvantara, realise the imnunence of their death at the time when the period of Manvantara along with the extra years becomes complete.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमन्वन्तरेष्वेवं शाखाभेदाः समाश्रिताः । प्राजापत्या श्रुतिर्नित्या तद्विकल्पास्त्विमे स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sarvamanvantareṣvevaṃ śākhābhedāḥ samāśritāḥ / prājāpatyā śrutirnityā tadvikalpāstvime smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: W. 176 ff. describe the prandhiiht transiiioo from oae Yuga to anoiker and from one Maovantara to another.
verses.hindi: क्रोडीचकार सुध्रीता मुध्न्यू पाध्वाय पाबेती । एवं तयोस्तु सत्कारं दृष्ट्वा रामगणेशयोः
verses.wordMeaning: W. 176 ff. describe the prandhiiht transiiioo from oae Yuga to anoiker and from one Maovantara to another.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 176 ff. describe the prandhiiht transiiioo from oae Yuga to anoiker and from one Maovantara to another.

verses.sanskrit: अनित्यभावाद्देवानां मन्त्रोत्पत्तिः पुनः पुनः । द्वापरेषु पुनर्भेदाः श्रुतीनां परिकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: anityabhāvāddevānāṃ mantrotpattiḥ punaḥ punaḥ / dvāpareṣu punarbhedāḥ śrutīnāṃ parikīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: Then those who have survived among them viz. the seven sages and Manu begin to expound the behaviour and conduct of life of good men at the beginning of the Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: Then those who have survived among them viz. the seven sages and Manu begin to expound the behaviour and conduct of life of good men at the beginning of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then those who have survived among them viz. the seven sages and Manu begin to expound the behaviour and conduct of life of good men at the beginning of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वेदं तदाप्यस्य भगवानृषिसत्तमः । शिष्चेब्यश्च प्रदत्त्वा तु तपस्तप्तु वन गतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vedaṃ tadāpyasya bhagavānṛṣisattamaḥ / śiṣcebyaśca pradattvā tu tapastaptu vana gataḥ
verses.translation: After establishing the three Vedas» the process of agricultural operation, administration of justice pious rites, duties and the practice of all castes of stages of life and after building hermitages {for penance), they thought of departing to the heaven.
verses.hindi: हे महाभागे ! यह वेष्णव परशुराम शैवता को प्राप्त हुआ है अर्थात् शिव के स्वरूप को श्राप्त होजाने बाला हो गया है। और साक्षात् यह गणेश शिव हैं जो बेष्णवत्व को भ्राप्त हुआ है अर्थात् विष्णु के स्वरूप में समास्थित है । इन हम दोनों प्रभुओं का भी भेद दिखलाई नहीं दिया करता है । इस प्रकार से कहकर श्री राधा ने अपनी गोद में गजानन को बेठा लिया था ।५०-५१। फिर गणेशजी का मस्तक सुंघ कर अपने हाथ से उनके कपोलों का स्पशं किया था। उनके केवल कर कमल के स्पर्श करते ही तत्क्षण जो भी दाँत के दूट जाने से क्षत हो गयां था वह भरकर ठीक हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: After establishing the three Vedas» the process of agricultural operation, administration of justice pious rites, duties and the practice of all castes of stages of life and after building hermitages {for penance), they thought of departing to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: After establishing the three Vedas» the process of agricultural operation, administration of justice pious rites, duties and the practice of all castes of stages of life and after building hermitages {for penance), they thought of departing to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शिष्यप्रशिष्यैस्तु शाखाभेदास्त्विमे कृताः । अङ्गानि वेदाश्चत्वारो मीमांसा न्यायविस्तरः
verses.transliteration: tasya śiṣyapraśiṣyaistu śākhābhedāstvime kṛtāḥ / aṅgāni vedāścatvāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ
verses.translation: When the earlier Devas were thus eager to proceed to heaven all of those gods who established themselves perfectly in religion stayed perfectly virtuous.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर श्री राधा जी के द्वारा अनुनय की गयी पावेतीजी भी परम प्रसन्न हो गयी थीं ओर अपने चरणों में मस्तक तवाकर पड़े हुए परशुराम को उन्होंने भी अपने करकमल से पकड़ कर उठा लिया था । पावंती जी ने परम प्रसन्न होकर उसको अपनी गौद में बिठाकर उसके शिर का उपध्राण
verses.wordMeaning: When the earlier Devas were thus eager to proceed to heaven all of those gods who established themselves perfectly in religion stayed perfectly virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the earlier Devas were thus eager to proceed to heaven all of those gods who established themselves perfectly in religion stayed perfectly virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मशास्त्रं पुराणं च विद्याश्चेमाश्चतुर्दश । आयुर्वेदो धनुर्वेदो गान्धर्वश्चेति ते त्रयः
verses.transliteration: dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca vidyāścemāścaturdaśa / āyurvedo dhanurvedo gāndharvaśceti te trayaḥ
verses.translation: When the Manvantara has passed by> they leave off all their abodes and go along with Mantras to the Mahar* loka that is free from ailments.
verses.hindi: किया था । आयं संस्कृति में बृद्ध एवं बड़े लोग अपने छोटे बालकों का शिर सूघ कर उनकी आयु की वृद्धि किया करते थे। इस रीति से उन दोनों राम और गणेश का सत्कार भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण ने अपने नेश्ों से देखा था। तब श्रीकृष्ण ने भी स्कम्द को अपनी ओर उठाकर बहुत ही प्रेम के साथ अपनी गोद में बैठा लिया था । इसके अनन्तर भगवान् शम्भु ले भी परम असन्न होकर वहाँ पर समुपस्थित श्रीदामा को अपनी गोद में संस्थापित कर लिया था और मान प्रदान करने बाले प्रभु ने उसका बड़ा सत्कार किया
verses.wordMeaning: When the Manvantara has passed by> they leave off all their abodes and go along with Mantras to the Mahar* loka that is free from ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Manvantara has passed by> they leave off all their abodes and go along with Mantras to the Mahar* loka that is free from ailments.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थशास्त्रं चतुर्थं तु विद्या ह्यष्टादशैव हि । ज्ञेया ब्रह्मर्षयः पूर्वं तेभ्यो देवर्षयः पुनः
verses.transliteration: arthaśāstraṃ caturthaṃ tu vidyā hyaṣṭādaśaiva hi / jñeyā brahmarṣayaḥ pūrvaṃ tebhyo devarṣayaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: They had returned from their authoritative positions. They had acquired mental Siddhis. With perfect control over their sensenrgans, they remain waiting for the total annihilation of all the bhUtas (t.e. the end of the universe).
verses.wordMeaning: They had returned from their authoritative positions. They had acquired mental Siddhis. With perfect control over their sensenrgans, they remain waiting for the total annihilation of all the bhUtas (t.e. the end of the universe).
verses.commentary: Sense: They had returned from their authoritative positions. They had acquired mental Siddhis. With perfect control over their sensenrgans, they remain waiting for the total annihilation of all the bhUtas (t.e. the end of the universe).

verses.sanskrit: राजर्षयः पुनस्तेभ्य ऋषिप्रकृतयस्त्रिधा । काश्यपेषु वसिष्ठेषु तथा भृग्वङ्गिरो ऽत्रिषु
verses.transliteration: rājarṣayaḥ punastebhya ṛṣiprakṛtayastridhā / kāśyapeṣu vasiṣṭheṣu tathā bhṛgvaṅgiro 'triṣu
verses.translation: The characteristic lture of the traniitional stage of the previous Manvantarat of the past and future has been mentioned by Sv&yambhuva (son of the self-bom lord} i.e. (by what is mentioned about the Sv&yambhuva Manvantara).
verses.hindi: भामा पातु मां पूर्णकामा ॥ प्रकटितगुण मानं कालसंख्याविधानं सकलभवनिदानं
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic lture of the traniitional stage of the previous Manvantarat of the past and future has been mentioned by Sv&yambhuva (son of the self-bom lord} i.e. (by what is mentioned about the Sv&yambhuva Manvantara).
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic lture of the traniitional stage of the previous Manvantarat of the past and future has been mentioned by Sv&yambhuva (son of the self-bom lord} i.e. (by what is mentioned about the Sv&yambhuva Manvantara).

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चस्वेतेषु जायन्ते गोत्रेषु ब्रह्मवादिनः । यस्मादृषन्ति ब्रह्माणं ततो ब्रह्मर्षयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: pañcasveteṣu jāyante gotreṣu brahmavādinaḥ / yasmādṛṣanti brahmāṇaṃ tato brahmarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The achievements (happenings) of the future Manvantaras depends upon the past Manvantarat. Thus, the unbroken line of progeny continues till the annihilation of al) living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: The achievements (happenings) of the future Manvantaras depends upon the past Manvantarat. Thus, the unbroken line of progeny continues till the annihilation of al) living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The achievements (happenings) of the future Manvantaras depends upon the past Manvantarat. Thus, the unbroken line of progeny continues till the annihilation of al) living beings.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्याथ पुलस्त्यस्य क्रतोश्च पुलहस्य च । प्रत्यूषस्य च देवस्य कश्यपस्य तथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: dharmasyātha pulastyasya kratośca pulahasya ca / pratyūṣasya ca devasya kaśyapasya tathā punaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective Verses). The changes of the Manvan* tar as are invariably continuous in tht Maharloka. The people of the Mahar and Jana worlds proceed to (and establish in) SatyaLoka.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Verses). The changes of the Manvan* tar as are invariably continuous in tht Maharloka. The people of the Mahar and Jana worlds proceed to (and establish in) SatyaLoka.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Verses). The changes of the Manvan* tar as are invariably continuous in tht Maharloka. The people of the Mahar and Jana worlds proceed to (and establish in) SatyaLoka.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षयः सुतास्तेषां नामतस्तान्निबोधत । देवार्षी धर्मपुत्रौ तु नरनारायणवुभौ
verses.transliteration: devarṣayaḥ sutāsteṣāṃ nāmatastānnibodhata / devārṣī dharmaputrau tu naranārāyaṇavubhau
verses.translation: By the vision of the (future) happenings there and by the knowledge of the evident manifold ness, those who are established in Satya Loka remain steady there on account of its permanence when there is a change in the period of transi¬ tion of Manvantaras.
verses.wordMeaning: By the vision of the (future) happenings there and by the knowledge of the evident manifold ness, those who are established in Satya Loka remain steady there on account of its permanence when there is a change in the period of transi¬ tion of Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the vision of the (future) happenings there and by the knowledge of the evident manifold ness, those who are established in Satya Loka remain steady there on account of its permanence when there is a change in the period of transi¬ tion of Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: वालखिल्याः क्रतोः पुत्राः कर्दमः पुलहस्य तु । कुबेरश्चैव पौलस्त्यः प्रत्यूषस्य दलः सुत
verses.transliteration: vālakhilyāḥ kratoḥ putrāḥ kardamaḥ pulahasya tu / kuberaścaiva paulastyaḥ pratyūṣasya dalaḥ suta
verses.translation: With the changes of the Manvantara, they leave the Satya-loka in ultimate end (?). Then on account of earnest devotion and abandonment of Viqjfcs (objects of sense) they enter lord N&r&yaa alone.
verses.hindi: हरकृतब्रहुमानो गोपिकेशेकतातो विदितबहुविधानो जायतां कीतिहा नो
verses.wordMeaning: With the changes of the Manvantara, they leave the Satya-loka in ultimate end (?). Then on account of earnest devotion and abandonment of Viqjfcs (objects of sense) they enter lord N&r&yaa alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the changes of the Manvantara, they leave the Satya-loka in ultimate end (?). Then on account of earnest devotion and abandonment of Viqjfcs (objects of sense) they enter lord N&r&yaa alone.

verses.sanskrit: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव कश्यपस्यात्मजावुभौ । ऋषन्ति वेदान्यस्मात्ते तस्माद्देवर्षयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva kaśyapasyātmajāvubhau / ṛṣanti vedānyasmātte tasmāddevarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: मानवे चैव ये वंशे ऐलवंशे च ये नृपाः । ये च ऐक्ष्वाकनाभागा ज्ञेया राजर्षयस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: mānave caiva ye vaṃśe ailavaṃśe ca ye nṛpāḥ / ye ca aikṣvākanābhāgā jñeyā rājarṣayastu te
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: सकलगुणगरिष्ठो राधिकांके निविष्टो मम श्री बसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--हे भूपते ! इस रीति से उन सबके परमा- धिक स्नेह से युक्त चित्त याले हो जाने पर समबस्थित हुए देखा था तो परशुराम मवानी की गोद से उतर कर दोनों हाथों को जोड़कर पूर्णतया प्रणत हो गये ये ।१। फिर परम प्रयत्नशील होकर विशेषता से रहित की
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषन्ति रञ्जनाद्यस्मात्प्रजा राजर्षयस्ततः । ब्रह्मलोकप्रतिष्ठास्तु समृता ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣanti rañjanādyasmātprajā rājarṣayastataḥ / brahmalokapratiṣṭhāstu samṛtā brahmarṣayo 'malāḥ
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: भी बिशेष की भाँति स्तुति की थी । आप द्वत से रहित होते हुए भी अर्थात् एक ही स्वरूप वाले होकर भी इस समय में द्वत भात्र को प्राप्त हो रहे हैं अर्थात् दो स्वरूपों में दशन दे रहे हैं । बाम्तब में आप गुणों से रहित हैं तो भी अब सगुण स्वरूप से संयुत हैं ।२। परशुराम ने कहा--यह सम्पूर्ण विश्व
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: देवलोकप्रतिष्ठास्तु ज्ञेया देवर्षयः शुभाः । इन्द्रलोकप्रतिष्ठास्तु सर्वे राजर्षयो मताः
verses.transliteration: devalokapratiṣṭhāstu jñeyā devarṣayaḥ śubhāḥ / indralokapratiṣṭhāstu sarve rājarṣayo matāḥ
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: प्रकृति के विकारों से ही समुत्पन्ने हुआ हैं  इसकी रचना करने के लिए जो भी आपका वैभव है उसके जानने के लिये मेरा ज्ञान कितना है अर्थात् मैं बहुत ही तुच्छ ज्ञान बाला उसको नहीं जान सकता हूँ । आपका स्वरूप और नाम किसी को भो विदित नहीं हैं किन्तु फिर भी आप अभीष्ट वस्तुओं के एक ही घाम हैं। आप भगवान् शङ्कर को भामिनी हैं ओर पूर्ण काम बाली
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: अभिजात्याथ तपसा मन्त्रव्याहरणैस्तथा । ये च ब्रह्मर्षयः प्रोक्ता दिव्या देवर्षयश्च ये
verses.transliteration: abhijātyātha tapasā mantravyāharaṇaistathā / ye ca brahmarṣayaḥ proktā divyā devarṣayaśca ye
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: हैं । आप मेरी रक्षा कीजिए ।३। सत्त्व-रज और तम-इन गुणों का ज्ञान करने वाला--काल की सख्या का विधान करने वाला--इस सम्पूर्ण संसार का जो मूल कारण है यह प्रधान-इस नाम से कीत्तित किया जाया करता है बह यहाँ पर पूर्णतया कृतकृतक निपात वाला उक्षपात जिससे हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: राजर्षयस्तथा चैव तेषां वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम् । भूतं भव्यं भवज्ज्ञानं सत्याभि व्यात्दृतं तथा
verses.transliteration: rājarṣayastathā caiva teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavajjñānaṃ satyābhi vyātdṛtaṃ tathā
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.

verses.transliteration: kṛtādiṣu yugākhyāsu sarvaireva punaḥ punaḥ / varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ kriyate prathamaṃ tu vai

verses.hindi: वसिष्ठजी ने कहा--इसके अनन्तर भगवान श्रीकृष्ण शिव और तग- राज की पुत्री को अनुशापित फरके श्रीराधा ओर श्री दामा के साथ अपने गोलोक धाम को चले गये थे ।२६। इसके पश्चात् घ्मात्मा राम ने भी भंग- बान शिव और जगदम्या का मली-भाँति अर्चन करके और अभिवादन करके इसके अनन्तर उन्होने प्रदक्षिणा करने का उपक्रम किया था ।३०। है भूपते ! फिर राम ने गणेशजी और स्वामी कत्तिकेय की सेवा में प्रणिपात करके तथा उनसे पूछकर उस गृह के मध्य भाग से बाहिर निष्क्रमण किया था ।३१। है राजन् ! जिस बेला में राम वहाँ से बाहर निकल कर जा रहे पे

verses.hindi: करके यहाँ पर स्थित द्विजों के बालकों ने जय-जयकार और नमस्कार की घ्वनियों को प्रोच्चारण किया था और विग्रों के द्वारा भागंवेन्द्र राम का बड़ा ही अधिक सम्मान-सत्कार किया गया था। इस रीति से अपने स्वागत- समादर को देखते हुए राम को परमाधिक हषं हुआ था ।९। उस आश्रम के अन्दर अपने गृह में जब राम ने प्रवेश किया था तो वहाँ पर परशुराम जी ने तपस्या के परम निधि अपने पिताश्री जमदग्नि महामुनि का दर्शन किया था ।१०। वे जमदग्नि मुनि साक्षात् अपने पूर्व पुरुष भृगु मुनि के समान वहाँ पर विराजमान थे जो अपने तपोबल से विग्रह और अनुग्रह करने की विशाल

verses.sanskrit: आवर्त्तमाना ऋषयो युगाख्यासु पुनः पुनः । कुर्वन्ति संहिता ह्येते जायमानाः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: āvarttamānā ṛṣayo yugākhyāsu punaḥ punaḥ / kurvanti saṃhitā hyete jāyamānāḥ parasparam

It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: सामध्यं धारण करने बाले ये । उनके समीप में पहुँचकर रास ने उनके चरण कमलों के निकट में अपने आठों अङ्ों से भूमि का आलिङ्गन करते हुए गिर गये थे अर्थात् भूमि पड़कर साष्टाङ्ग प्रणाम किया था ।११। हे भूपते ! परशुराम ने प्रणिपात करते हुए--मैं आपका दासानुदास राम है--

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि श्रुतर्षीणां समृतानि वै । अतीतेषु व्यतीतानि वर्त्तन्ते पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi śrutarṣīṇāṃ samṛtāni vai / atīteṣu vyatītāni varttante punaḥ punaḥ

verses.hindi: आपकी सेत्रा में मेरा सादर प्रणाम निवेदित है--ऐसा मुख से उच्चारण करते हुए उस सज्जनों में प्रमुख राम ने प्रणाम करने की विधि से साथ पिताश्नी के दोनों चरणों का ग्रहण किया था।१२। इसके अनन्तर उन्होंने अपनी माता श्री के चरणों में करबद्ध होते हुए अभिवादन किया था । फिरु परम प्रणत होकर उन दोनों माता-पिता के अतीव हर्ष का कारण स्वरूप दाय कहा था ।१३। राम ने कहा--हे पिताजी, आपके परम दुरासद तप के प्रभाव से हो मैंने बड़े बलवान काते वीर्ये राजा का पुत्रों-सैनिकों और वाहनों के सहित हनन कर दिया है । इस निवेदन का तात्पर्य यही है कि
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रिता दक्षिणपन्थानं ये श्मशानानि भेजिरे । युगे युगे तु ताः शाखा व्यस्यन्ते तै पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: śritā dakṣiṇapanthānaṃ ye śmaśānāni bhejire / yuge yuge tu tāḥ śākhā vyasyante tai punaḥ punaḥ

verses.hindi: उस इतने बलगालो णू, के निपातन करने में मेरा पुरुषाय कुछ भी नहीं है यह सब कुछ आपके ही तप का प्रभाव है जिस से मेरे द्वारा वह दुष्ट मारा गया है

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरेष्विह सर्वेषु संहितास्तु श्रुतर्षिभिः । तेषां गोत्रेष्विमाः शाखा भवन्ति हि पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: dvāpareṣviha sarveṣu saṃhitāstu śrutarṣibhiḥ / teṣāṃ gotreṣvimāḥ śākhā bhavanti hi punaḥ punaḥ

verses.hindi: ब्रज स्वकार्येसिद्धधर्थं शिवलोकं सनातनम् । गतवाञ्छिवलोकं वे हरदर्शनकांक्षया

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैः सहोर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति ह्यावर्त्तन्ते च तैः सह । जनलोकात्सुराः सर्वे दशकल्पान्पुनः पुनः

verses.hindi: यह वही अधम राजा था । जिसने अपने परम दुष्ट मन्त्री की प्रेरणा से प्रेरित होकर आपका महान् अपराध किया था । उस अपराध का दण्ड मेरे,द्वारा उसको दे दिया गया है। है मुनियों में परम श्रेष्ठ ! मैंने बलपूर्वक उसको दण्डित किया है । मैंने जिस रीति से अब तक जो कुछ भी किया है

verses.sanskrit: पर्यायकाले संप्राप्ते संभूता निधनस्य ते । अवश्यभाविनार्ऽथेन संभध्यन्ते तदा तु ते
verses.transliteration: paryāyakāle saṃprāpte saṃbhūtā nidhanasya te / avaśyabhāvinār'thena saṃbhadhyante tadā tu te

verses.hindi: उसका पूर्णे विवरण क्रमानुसार मैं आपकी सन्निधि में निवेदित करता हूँ ।१५। मैंते आपको नमस्कार करके सर्वप्रथम ब्रह्माजी के समीप मेंगमन किया था क्योंकि समस्त सृष्टि ब्रह्मा जी के ही द्वारा हुई हैं। अतः उनको डसके निपातन से कुछ बुरा प्रतीत न हो, उनकी आज्ञा प्राप्त करता न्यायो- चित एवं आवश्यक था । मैंने वहाँ जाकर उनको विधि के साथ प्रणिपात किया था और अंपना सङ्कूल्पित कार्य उनसे निवेदित कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते दोषवज्जन्म पश्यन्तो रोगपूर्वकम् । निवर्त्तते तदा वृत्तिः सा तेषां दोषदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: tataste doṣavajjanma paśyanto rogapūrvakam / nivarttate tadā vṛttiḥ sā teṣāṃ doṣadarśanāt

verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजी ने आरम्भ से लेकर सम्पूणे वृत्तान्त सुना था और मुझसे कहा था। समस्त क्षशियगण भगवान् शिव के परम भक्त हैं अतः अपने कार्य की सिद्धि के लिए सनातन शिवलोक में जाना चाहिए ।१७। है तात ! पितामह के इस वचन का श्रवण करके ब्रह्माजी को नमस्कार करके भगवान् शिव के
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं देवयुगानीह दशकृत्वो विवर्त्य वै । जनलोकात्तपोलोकं गच्छन्तीहानिवर्त्तकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ devayugānīha daśakṛtvo vivartya vai / janalokāttapolokaṃ gacchantīhānivarttakam

verses.hindi: दर्शन की आकाङ्क्षा से फिर मैं शिवजी के लोक में गया 'था।१दा है भग- चन् ! यहां पर शिव लोक में प्रवेश करके उमा देवी,के सहित भगवाल् शिव को नमस्कार किया था। भगवान् शिब तो ऐसे देव हैं जो सबके लिए वाञ्छित अर्च का प्रदान कर दिया करते हैं ।१६। उन प्रभु के सामने मैंने अपना पूरा वृत्तान्त आवेदित कर दिया था । जो भी उनकी सेवा में निये- दित किया था उस सबको उन्होंने परम समाहित बुद्धि से उस सबका श्रवण भी किया था। उस सम्पूण वृत्तान्त-का श्रवण करके उन्होंने एक क्षण तक विचार किया था और फिर परमाधिक कृपा से समन्वित होकर समस्त

verses.hindi: उस कवचन की सिद्धि पुष्कर तीयं में बतलायी थी अतएब मैने उस को प्राप्तकर भगवानु शद्कुर को प्रणाम किया और मैं फिर उसकी सिद्धि के लिये पुष्कर में समागत हो गया था । वहाँ पर मैंने उस कवच की सिद्धि प्राप्त कर ली थी । और उसे साधित करके. मेरे मन में बड़ी प्रसन्नता हुई ची ।२२। फिर संग्राम भूमि में कात्तवीर्य का निपातन करके मैं पुनः शिव

verses.hindi: युक्त होकर अन्दर प्रविष्ट होने वाले मुझ को देखकर गणेश जी ने रोक दिया था ।२४। उन्होंने मुझ से यही कह मुझको अन्दर प्रवेश करने से सहसा रोका था कि आज अन्दर गमन करने का अबसर नहीं है । है पिताजी ! उस समय में मेरा उन गणेश जो के साथ पहिले तो वास्युद्ध अर्थात् अच्छी तरह से कहा सुनी हुई थी ओर फिर हाथों का कर्षण अर्थात् मेरा हाथ पकड़कर खींचातानी हुई थी ।२५। उस समय में गणेश जी ने यह देखा कि भगु नन्दन् अपने परशु का प्रहार करने वॉला हो रहां णा । उन्होने यह जानकर मुझको पकड़ लिया था और ऊपर उठाकर: नीचे की ओर कर दिया. था

verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमन्वन्तराणां तु प्रतिसंधानलक्षणम् । अतीतानागतानां वै प्रोक्तं स्वायंभुवेन तु
verses.transliteration: pūrvamanvantarāṇāṃ tu pratisaṃdhānalakṣaṇam / atītānāgatānāṃ vai proktaṃ svāyaṃbhuvena tu
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: होने वाले अनेक हष्टान्तों के द्वारा परशुराम जी के उस महान शोक को अकृत व्रण ने शमित कर दिया था ।४। उस अकृत ब्रण के द्वारा सान्त्वना दिए गए परशुराम ने धेये का अवलम्बन लिया था क्योंकि वह बहुत अधिक मेघावी थे । इकके अनन्तर परशुरामजी अपने सखा अकृत व्रण के साथ अपने भाइगों के देखने की इच्छा से अपने गृह की ओर चल दिये थे
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेष्वतीतेषु भविष्याणां तु साधनम् । एवं संतत्यविच्छेदो भवत्याभूतसंप्लवात्
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣvatīteṣu bhaviṣyāṇāṃ tu sādhanam / evaṃ saṃtatyavicchedo bhavatyābhūtasaṃplavāt
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: वहाँ पर भार्गव ने जाकर अभिवादन किया था और इन सबको परम दुःखित देखकर परशुरामजी को भी अत्यधिक दु:ख हुआ था । उन सबके साथ में पुनः उस शोक का नवीनीकरण हो गया था और परम शोक में मग्न होकर वह वहाँ तीन दिन तक स्थित रहे ये ।६। इसके अनन्तर अपरे
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तराणां परिवर्त्तनानि ह्येकान्ततस्तानि महर्गतानि । महाजनं चैव जनान्तपश्च चैकान्तगानि प्रभवन्ति सत्ये
verses.transliteration: manvantarāṇāṃ parivarttanāni hyekāntatastāni mahargatāni / mahājanaṃ caiva janāntapaśca caikāntagāni prabhavanti satye
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: पिता श्रो के तिधन का स्मरण करते हुए उनको महान क्रोध उत्पन्न हो गा आ और तुरन्त ही बह सम्पूणं लोक के संहार कर देने में समथं हो दृढीचकार हृदये सर्वक्षत्रवघोद्धतः
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: तद्भाविनां तत्र तु दर्शनेन नानात्वदृष्टेन च प्रत्ययेन । स्त्ये स्थिता नित्यतया तु नित्यं प्राप्ते विकारे प्रतिसर्ग काले
verses.transliteration: tadbhāvināṃ tatra tu darśanena nānātvadṛṣṭena ca pratyayena / stye sthitā nityatayā tu nityaṃ prāpte vikāre pratisarga kāle
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तराणां परिवर्त्तनानि मुञ्चन्ति सत्यं तु ततो ऽपरान्त । ततो ऽभियोगा विषयप्रहाणाद्विशन्ति नारायणमेव देवम्
verses.transliteration: manvantarāṇāṃ parivarttanāni muñcanti satyaṃ tu tato 'parānta / tato 'bhiyogā viṣayaprahāṇādviśanti nārāyaṇameva devam
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: ज्याघोषं च चकारोच्चं रोदसी कंपयन्निव । माता रेणुका ने. अपने पति के वियोग में विलाप करते हुए इक्कोस बार अपने वक्षःस्थल को पीटा था अतः परशुरामो ने उसी समय में यह प्रतिज्ञा की थी कि मेरे पिता को क्षत्रिय जातीय नृप ने निहत किया है इसलिए मैं भी इक्कोस बार भूमण्डल को संहार करके क्षत्रियों से रहित
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तराणां परिवर्त्तनेषु चिरप्रवृत्तेषु विधिस्वभावात् । क्षणं न वै तिष्ठति जीवलोकः क्षयोदयाभ्यां परिवर्तमानः
verses.transliteration: manvantarāṇāṃ parivarttaneṣu cirapravṛtteṣu vidhisvabhāvāt / kṣaṇaṃ na vai tiṣṭhati jīvalokaḥ kṣayodayābhyāṃ parivartamānaḥ
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: कर दूगा--माता के लिए की हुई इस प्रतिज्ञा को सत्यवादी दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्यन्तराण्येवमृषिस्तुतानां धर्मात्मनां दिव्यदृशां मनूनाम् । वायुप्रणीतान्युपलभ्य दृश्याद् दिव्यौजसां व्याससमासयोगैः
verses.transliteration: ityantarāṇyevamṛṣistutānāṃ dharmātmanāṃ divyadṛśāṃ manūnām / vāyupraṇītānyupalabhya dṛśyād divyaujasāṃ vyāsasamāsayogaiḥ
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: ने समस्त क्षत्रियों के वध करने के लिये समुत होकर हृदय में सुहढ़ फर भागंवेन्द्र ने ऐसा निश्चय कर लिया था कि क्षत्रियों के वंश में समुत्पन्न सबका निहनन करके उनके शरीरों के रुघिर से मैं अपने माता-पिता का तपँण करूँगा ।६। अपने समस्त भाइयों से यह अपना समीहित सत्य संकल्प कहकर अपने पिताजी की संस्थित क्रिया को पूर्ण करके भाइयों की आशो प्राप्त करके परशुराम चले गये थे ।१०। फिर अकृतव्रण को साथ में लेकर माहिष्मती नगरी में स्थित होकर उन्होंने महोदर (श्रीगणेश जी) का स्मरण किया था ।११। उग्होंने तुरन्त ही राम के लिए रथ-चाप आदि सभी
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाणि राजर्षिसुरर्थिमन्ति ब्रह्मर्षिदेवोरगवन्ति चैव । सुरेशसप्तर्षिपितृप्रजेशैर्युक्तानि सम्यक् परिवर्त्तनानि
verses.transliteration: sarvāṇi rājarṣisurarthimanti brahmarṣidevoragavanti caiva / sureśasaptarṣipitṛprajeśairyuktāni samyak parivarttanāni
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: आयुधों तथा अश्वों आदि को भेज दिया था ।१२। फिर परशुराम प्रभु भी उस रथ पर समारूढ़ होकर सन्नद्ध हो गये थे ओर शत्रुओं पर विजय पाने वाले ने शरके सहित धनुष का ग्रहण कर लिया था तथा भगवान रुद्र के द्वारा प्रदत्त शंख की ध्वनि करके उससे सम्पूर्ण भाग को पूरित कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: उदारवंशाभिजन श्रुतीनां प्रकृष्टमेधाभिसमेधितानाम् । कीर्तिद्युतिख्यातिभिरर्चितानां पुण्यं हि विश्यापनमीश्वराणाम्
verses.transliteration: udāravaṃśābhijana śrutīnāṃ prakṛṣṭamedhābhisamedhitānām / kīrtidyutikhyātibhirarcitānāṃ puṇyaṃ hi viśyāpanamīśvarāṇām
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: था ।१३। अपने धनुष की प्रत्यंचा की टकार से अन्तरिक्ष ओर भूमण्डल को प्रकम्पित करते हुए बड़ा ही उच्च घोष किया था । सारथियों में परम श्रेष् सहसाह ने उनके रथ का सारथि होने का कार्य ग्रहण किया था अथ पंचरयाः शूराः शूरसेनादयो नृप ।
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गीयमेतत्परमं पवित्रं पुत्रीयमेतच्च परं रहस्यम् । जप्यं महापर्वसु चैतदग्र्यं दुःखापशान्तिप्रदमायुषीयम्
verses.transliteration: svargīyametatparamaṃ pavitraṃ putrīyametacca paraṃ rahasyam / japyaṃ mahāparvasu caitadagryaṃ duḥkhāpaśāntipradamāyuṣīyam
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रजशदवर्षिमनुप्रधानां पुण्यां प्रसूतिं प्रथितामजस्य । ममापि विख्यापयतः समासात्सिद्धिं प्रजेशाः प्रदिशन्तु युक्ताः
verses.transliteration: prajaśadavarṣimanupradhānāṃ puṇyāṃ prasūtiṃ prathitāmajasya / mamāpi vikhyāpayataḥ samāsātsiddhiṃ prajeśāḥ pradiśantu yuktāḥ
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: निवार्य तानापतितो रथेनेकेन भार्गेवः । ततः स सूरसेनादीन्हत्वा सबलवाहनाच् ।
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदन्तरं प्रोक्तं मनोः स्वायंभुवस्य च । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च भूयः किं वर्णयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: ityetadantaraṃ proktaṃ manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya ca / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca bhūyaḥ kiṃ varṇayāmyaham
verses.translation: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment. It is due to the characteristic feature of the Fate that the world of living beings undeigoes change by way of decrease and increase.
verses.hindi: अपने माता और पिता दोनों के वघ हो जाने से परशुरामजी को बड़ा भारी क्रोध हो गया था । जब परम क्र,द्ध भार्गव के रथ प्रत्यञचा और शंख के नाद हुए तो इनसे उस नूप की समस्त नगरी और नर तथा द्विप सभी अत्यन्त संक्षुब्ध हो गये थे ।१४। उन नृप के पुत्रों ने जब यह समझ
verses.wordMeaning: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the repeated changes of the Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (still or the same) even for a moment.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुष्गपादे वेदव्यसनाख्यानं स्वायंभुवमन्वन्तरवर्णनं च नाम पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः शांशपायन उवाच मन्वन्तराणि शेषाणि श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यनुक्रमात् । मन्वन्तराधिपांश्चैव शक्रदेवपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣgapāde vedavyasanākhyānaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamanvantaravarṇanaṃ ca nāma pañcatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ śāṃśapāyana uvāca manvantarāṇi śeṣāṇi śrotumicchāmyanukramāt / manvantarādhipāṃścaiva śakradevapurogamān
verses.translation: I wish to hear about the remaining Manvantaras in the proper sequence and also about the rulers of the Manvan- taras as well as those whose leaders are Sakra (Indra) and (other) Devas.
verses.hindi: लिया था कि सब क्षथियों के कुसों का अन्त कर देने वाले परशुराम समा- गत हरो गये हैं तो वे बहुत ही कषुन्ध हुए ये और फिर उन्होंने राम के साथ संग्राम करने के लिए उद्योग किया था ।१६। इसके अनन्तर है गृप ! पञ्च- रथ शूरसेन प्रभृति शूरो ने अनेक अन्य राजाओं के सगथ परशुरामणी युद्ध “करने के लिए उद्यम किया था ।१७। इसके उपरान्त वे श्रेष्ठ क्षत्रिय अपनी चतुरङ्गिणी सेनाओं से समन्वित हुए ये और सब राम के पास प्राप्त हो गये थे । जिस तरह पावक पर गिरने वाले पतङ्गों को अग्नि भस्मसात् करके निवारित कर दिया करता है उसी भाति भागेवेन्द्र ने अपने एक ही रथ के
verses.wordMeaning: I wish to hear about the remaining Manvantaras in the proper sequence and also about the rulers of the Manvan- taras as well as those whose leaders are Sakra (Indra) and (other) Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to hear about the remaining Manvantaras in the proper sequence and also about the rulers of the Manvan- taras as well as those whose leaders are Sakra (Indra) and (other) Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच मन्वन्तराणि यानि स्युरतीतानागतानि ह । समासा द्विस्तराच्चैव ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca manvantarāṇi yāni syuratītānāgatāni ha / samāsā dvistarāccaiva bruvato me nibodhata
verses.translation: Understand even as I recount succinctly and in detail about those Manvantaras which have gone by and which arc yet to come.
verses.hindi: द्वारा उस पर संस्थित होकर अपने ऊपर चारों ओर से आक्रमण करके आपतन करने वालों को निवारित कर दिया था । अपरिमित बल-विक्रम से सुसम्पन्न राम ने समराङ्कण में उन सभी नृपों के साथ घोर मुद्ध किया था ।१८-१६। इसके अनन्तर फिर भागंब का युद्ध राजाओं के साथ हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Understand even as I recount succinctly and in detail about those Manvantaras which have gone by and which arc yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand even as I recount succinctly and in detail about those Manvantaras which have gone by and which arc yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवो मनुः पूर्वं मनुः स्वारोचिषस्तथा । उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ manuḥ svārociṣastathā / uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā

verses.hindi: और उस उदार बुद्धि वाले परशुराम ने उन सो राजाओं का वध कर दिया था ।२०। फिर शूरसेन आदि नृपों का सेना और वाहनों के सहित हनन करके एक ही क्षण में उस पूर्ण क्षत्रियों के मण्डल को भूमि पर गिरा दिया था ततः क्रोधपरीतात्मा दग्धुकामोऽखिलां पुरीम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Jiist ss in the 1st ManvanUra, Svayambhuva (the «on of god Brahm) wu the presiding Manu, YAmaa were the gods, YaJAa, the incamadon of Vifpu officiated as Indra and the seven sages were Marid, Atri, AAgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Pulaitya and Va&ftlu were the Saptarsia, W.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Jiist ss in the 1st ManvanUra, Svayambhuva (the «on of god Brahm) wu the presiding Manu, YAmaa were the gods, YaJAa, the incamadon of Vifpu officiated as Indra and the seven sages were Marid, Atri, AAgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Pulaitya and Va&ftlu were the Saptarsia, W.…

verses.sanskrit: षडेते मनवो ऽतीता वक्ष्याम्यष्टावनागतान् । सावर्णिश्चैव रौच्यश्च भौत्यो वैवस्वतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍete manavo 'tītā vakṣyāmyaṣṭāvanāgatān / sāvarṇiścaiva raucyaśca bhautyo vaivasvatastathā
verses.translation: The twentyfour gods were the Smapdf (Imbibers, of Soma juice) then. Their Indra then was Vipaicit, well- known all over the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: The twentyfour gods were the Smapdf (Imbibers, of Soma juice) then. Their Indra then was Vipaicit, well- known all over the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The twentyfour gods were the Smapdf (Imbibers, of Soma juice) then. Their Indra then was Vipaicit, well- known all over the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: वक्ष्याम्येतान्पुरस्तात्तु मनोर्वेवस्वतस्य च । मनवः पञ्च ये ऽतीता मानसांस्तान्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: vakṣyāmyetānpurastāttu manorvevasvatasya ca / manavaḥ pañca ye 'tītā mānasāṃstānnibodhata
verses.translation: These four viz. Manu, the seven sages, the Devas. and the Pitrs—constitute the root (the basis) of a Manvantara and their descendants are the subjects.
verses.hindi: ज्वालाकवलिताशेषपुरप्राका रमालिनीम् । प्राशयानोऽखिलान् लोकाव् साक्षात्काल इवांतकः
verses.wordMeaning: These four viz. Manu, the seven sages, the Devas. and the Pitrs—constitute the root (the basis) of a Manvantara and their descendants are the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: These four viz. Manu, the seven sages, the Devas. and the Pitrs—constitute the root (the basis) of a Manvantara and their descendants are the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरं मया वो ऽध्य क्रान्तं स्वायंभुवस्य ह । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि मनाः स्वारोचिषस्य ह
verses.transliteration: manvantaraṃ mayā vo 'dhya krāntaṃ svāyaṃbhuvasya ha / ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi manāḥ svārociṣasya ha
verses.translation: The Ksatriyas and the Vaiiyas (were bom) of Manu< and the Brahmanas of the seven sages. Thus the Manvantara. has been recounted succinctly and not in details.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर वे समस्त नृप भग्न सङ्कल्य बाले हो गये थे और उनके सैनिक तथा सब बाहन हाथी घोड़े आदि नष्ट हो गये थे। जो भी नूप हनन करने से बच गये ये वे भय से भीत होकर सब दिशाओं की ओर इधर-उधर भाग गये ।२२॥ इस रीति से सम्पूर्ण सेना के सैनिकों को थदेड
verses.wordMeaning: The Ksatriyas and the Vaiiyas (were bom) of Manu< and the Brahmanas of the seven sages. Thus the Manvantara. has been recounted succinctly and not in details.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Ksatriyas and the Vaiiyas (were bom) of Manu< and the Brahmanas of the seven sages. Thus the Manvantara. has been recounted succinctly and not in details.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजासर्गं समासेन द्वितीयस्य महात्मनः । आसन्वै तुषिता देवा मनोः स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: prajāsargaṃ samāsena dvitīyasya mahātmanaḥ / āsanvai tuṣitā devā manoḥ svārociṣe 'ntare
verses.translation: They were the sons of Uttama» the Prajapati, the. Angiras ( 7). The India (leader) of those Devas was well-known by the name Sui&nti.
verses.hindi: कर तथा हनन करके भागंवेन्द्र ने युद्ध में बिजय प्राप्त की थी और अपने बाणों की असनि के द्वारा सेकड़ों शूर नृपों का वध कर दिया था ।२३। फिर महाच् क्रोध से भरी हुई आत्मा याले परशुराम ने उस पुरी को वग्ध करने की इच्छा की थी तथा भागंव ने कालाग्नि अपने अस्त्र को छोड़ दिया था ।२४। उस अस्त्र की अग्नि ने उस नगरो को जिसमें सभी हाथी-घोड़े और मनुष्य ये जला दिया था और बह पुरी अस्त्राग्नि के जल कर ज्वालाओं से उसके पुरप्राकार आदि की माला से कवलित हो गयी थी अर्थात् उस महाच् अवीप्त असनि ने सबको स्वाहा कर दिया था और वहाँ पर कुछ भी शेष
verses.wordMeaning: They were the sons of Uttama» the Prajapati, the. Angiras ( 7). The India (leader) of those Devas was well-known by the name Sui&nti.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the sons of Uttama» the Prajapati, the. Angiras ( 7). The India (leader) of those Devas was well-known by the name Sui&nti.

verses.sanskrit: पारावताश्च विद्वांसो द्वावेव तु गणौ स्मृतौ । तुषितायां समुत्पन्नाः क्रतोः पुत्राः स्वरोचिषः
verses.transliteration: pārāvatāśca vidvāṃso dvāveva tu gaṇau smṛtau / tuṣitāyāṃ samutpannāḥ kratoḥ putrāḥ svarociṣaḥ
verses.translation: Va&9tha had seven sons well known as Vasithas* •All those were the seven sages in the Manvantara of Uttama.
verses.hindi: नहीं रहा था।२५। उस समस्त पुरी को जलती हुई देखकर अपने भ्राणों की रक्षा में तत्पर वीतिहोत्र भय से आठुर होकर वहाँ से जीबन के परित्राण
verses.wordMeaning: Va&9tha had seven sons well known as Vasithas* •All those were the seven sages in the Manvantara of Uttama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va&9tha had seven sons well known as Vasithas* •All those were the seven sages in the Manvantara of Uttama.

verses.sanskrit: पारावताश्च वासिष्ठा द्वादश द्वौ गणौ स्मृतौ । छन्दजाश्च चतुर्विंशद्देवास्ते वै तदा स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: pārāvatāśca vāsiṣṭhā dvādaśa dvau gaṇau smṛtau / chandajāśca caturviṃśaddevāste vai tadā smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: These were the progenitors of the race of Kfatriyas. This is the third Manvantara. Thus the creation of Uttama has been recounted along with that of Sv&rocifa*
verses.hindi: ३७२  ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण करने के लिये शीघ्र ही चला गया था ।२६। अपनी अस्त्र की अग्नि से उस सम्पूर्ण नगरी को जलाकर तथा सब झत्रुओं का हनन करके उस समय में भार्गबेन्द्र राम समस्त लोकों का विनाश करते हुए साक्षात् अन्त कर देने बाले काल की ही भाँति हो गये थे ।२७। फिर अकृतब्रण के सहित और
verses.wordMeaning: These were the progenitors of the race of Kfatriyas. This is the third Manvantara. Thus the creation of Uttama has been recounted along with that of Sv&rocifa*
verses.commentary: Sense: These were the progenitors of the race of Kfatriyas. This is the third Manvantara. Thus the creation of Uttama has been recounted along with that of Sv&rocifa*

verses.sanskrit: दिवस्पर्शो ऽथ जामित्रो गोपदो भासुरस्तथा । अजश्च भगवाश्चैव द्रविणश्य महा बलः
verses.transliteration: divasparśo 'tha jāmitro gopado bhāsurastathā / ajaśca bhagavāścaiva draviṇaśya mahā balaḥ
verses.translation: Svarocisa, Uttama, Tamasa and Raivata—these four Manus are considered as belonging to the family of Priyavrata.
verses.hindi: सहसाह से समन्वित होकर अपने रथ के महान घोष से सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वी को कम्पित करते हुए वहाँ से गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Svarocisa, Uttama, Tamasa and Raivata—these four Manus are considered as belonging to the family of Priyavrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Svarocisa, Uttama, Tamasa and Raivata—these four Manus are considered as belonging to the family of Priyavrata.

verses.sanskrit: आयश्चापि महाबाहुर्महौजाश्चापि वीर्यवान् । चिकित्वान्विश्रुतो यस्तु चांशो यश्चैव पठ्यते
verses.transliteration: āyaścāpi mahābāhurmahaujāścāpi vīryavān / cikitvānviśruto yastu cāṃśo yaścaiva paṭhyate
verses.translation: W. 66-81 five the outline of the 6th—Glkruia Manvantara.
verses.hindi: महेंद्रादि ययौ रामस्तपसे घृतमानसः जघान भूमौ निःशेषं साक्षात्काल इवांतकः ।
verses.wordMeaning: W. 66-81 five the outline of the 6th—Glkruia Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 66-81 five the outline of the 6th—Glkruia Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतश्चद्वादशस्तेषां तुषिताः परिकीर्त्तिताः । इत्येते क्रतुपुत्रास्तु तदासन्सोमपायिनः
verses.transliteration: ṛtaścadvādaśasteṣāṃ tuṣitāḥ parikīrttitāḥ / ityete kratuputrāstu tadāsansomapāyinaḥ
verses.translation: They were the grandsons of Araya (?) the Praja- pati; who was the son of Atri. Each of these groups is remembered as comprising of eight Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the grandsons of Araya (?) the Praja- pati; who was the son of Atri. Each of these groups is remembered as comprising of eight Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the grandsons of Araya (?) the Praja- pati; who was the son of Atri. Each of these groups is remembered as comprising of eight Devas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रचेताश्चैव यो देवो विश्वदेवस्तथैव च । समञ्जो विश्रुतो यस्तु ह्यजिह्मश्चारिमर्द्दनः
verses.transliteration: pracetāścaiva yo devo viśvadevastathaiva ca / samañjo viśruto yastu hyajihmaścārimarddanaḥ
verses.translation: Antarlkj Vasu, Havya Atithii Priyavrata, Srot&» Manta and Anumanta—these are glorified as Adyas.
verses.hindi: इस पृथ्वी तल पर क्षत्रियों का निहनन करते-हुए पूर्णतया इस भूमि पर शान्ति स्थापित करके फिर भार्गव राम तपश्चर्या करने के लिये मन में निश्चय करके महेन्द्र पंत पर वहाँ से चले गये थे ।२६। उसमें जितना भी क्षज्रियों का समुद्रय था बारह ये उनके प्रति भी आकर फिर उनकें हनन करने के वास्ते ब्रत धारण करने बाले परशुराम बढ़ दीक्षा वाले हुए ये ।३०। ओर द्विजों ने क्षत्रियों के क्षेत्रों में फिर क्षत्रियों का उत्पादन कर दिया था। जब परशुर/मजी को क्षत्रियों की उत्पत्ति का ज्ञान हुआथा कि अभी और भी क्षत्रिय समुत्पन्न हो गये हैं तो पुनः उन्होंने सैकड़ों और
verses.wordMeaning: Antarlkj Vasu, Havya Atithii Priyavrata, Srot&» Manta and Anumanta—these are glorified as Adyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Antarlkj Vasu, Havya Atithii Priyavrata, Srot&» Manta and Anumanta—these are glorified as Adyas.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्दानो महामानो दिव्यमानस्तथैव च । अजेयश्च महाभागो यवीयांश्च महाबलः
verses.transliteration: āyurdāno mahāmāno divyamānastathaiva ca / ajeyaśca mahābhāgo yavīyāṃśca mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: W. 82-102 trace the genealogy of Cilcfusa Maau from Atri Uttinapida Dhruva etc*
verses.hindi: सहो क्षत्रिय नपों का भूमि पर हनन कर दिया था ।३१। फिर भी दो वर्षों में इस भूमि को क्षत्रियों का बध करके क्षत्रियों से रहित बना दिया था ओर फिर दश बर्षों के लम्बे समय तक तपस्या का तपन किया था ।३२। है राजत ! जब फिर भी उनको यह ज्ञान हुआ था कि ब्राह्मणों से क्षत्रियों को
verses.wordMeaning: W. 82-102 trace the genealogy of Cilcfusa Maau from Atri Uttinapida Dhruva etc*
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 82-102 trace the genealogy of Cilcfusa Maau from Atri Uttinapida Dhruva etc*

verses.sanskrit: होता यज्वा तथा ह्येते परिक्रान्ताः परावताः । इत्येता देवता ह्यासन्मनोः स्वारोचिषान्तरे
verses.transliteration: hotā yajvā tathā hyete parikrāntāḥ parāvatāḥ / ityetā devatā hyāsanmanoḥ svārociṣāntare
verses.translation: Listen to the succinct account, O Br&hmarias of the creation of Caksu in whose family was born Pthu the valorous son of Vena.
verses.hindi: अपने तपोबल से समुस्यन्त कर-दिया हैतो फिर भी उन्होंने-साक्षात् विनाश करले वाले काल के ही समान इस भूमण्डल में क्षत्रियों को मार-काटकर समाप्त कर दिया था ।३३। उतने में समय में फिर क्षत्रिय लोग समुत्पन्न हो गये थे तब दो वर्ष पर्यन्त निरन्तर पृथ्वी पर उन सबका हनन करते भागवेन्द्र शे किया था ।३४। हैं राजेन्द्र ! अपने पिताश्नी के क्षात्रियों के द्वारा निधन का स्मरण करते हुए पूर्ण रूप से उन्होंने इककीस बार इस भूमि को इसी रीति से क्षत्रियों से रहित कर दिया था। उनकी माता रेणुका ने अपरे पति के वियोग के शोक में रुदन करते हुए इक्कीस बार अपने वक्षःस्थल
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to the succinct account, O Br&hmarias of the creation of Caksu in whose family was born Pthu the valorous son of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the succinct account, O Br&hmarias of the creation of Caksu in whose family was born Pthu the valorous son of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: सोमपास्तु तदा ह्येताश्चतुर्विशति देवताः । तेषामिन्द्रस्तदा ह्यासीद्विपश्चिल्लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: somapāstu tadā hyetāścaturviśati devatāḥ / teṣāmindrastadā hyāsīdvipaścillokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Utt&napada begot the sons Dhruva, Klrtiman, Ayujman and Vasu. He begot two daughten of sparkling smiles viz. Svara and Manasvinl. The sons of these two ladies (have already been) mentioned.
verses.hindi: को करों से प्रताड़ित किया था उतनी ही बार परशुरामजी ने इस भूमण्डल क्षणियों से रहित कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Utt&napada begot the sons Dhruva, Klrtiman, Ayujman and Vasu. He begot two daughten of sparkling smiles viz. Svara and Manasvinl. The sons of these two ladies (have already been) mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: Utt&napada begot the sons Dhruva, Klrtiman, Ayujman and Vasu. He begot two daughten of sparkling smiles viz. Svara and Manasvinl. The sons of these two ladies (have already been) mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जा वसिष्ठपुत्रश्च स्तंबः काश्यप एव च । भार्गवश्च तधा प्राम ऋषभ्ॐऽङ्गिरसस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ūrjā vasiṣṭhaputraśca staṃbaḥ kāśyapa eva ca / bhārgavaśca tadhā prāma ṛṣabhoṃ'ṅgirasastathā
verses.translation: Bhumt (the queen ofDhruva) gave birth to the two kings, Sfsti and Bhavya, (the sons of) Dhruva.
verses.hindi: ततो राजसहस्राणि गृहीत्वा मुनिभिः सह । स जगाम महातेजा: कुरुक्षेत्र तपोमयम् ३७४   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Bhumt (the queen ofDhruva) gave birth to the two kings, Sfsti and Bhavya, (the sons of) Dhruva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhumt (the queen ofDhruva) gave birth to the two kings, Sfsti and Bhavya, (the sons of) Dhruva.

verses.sanskrit: पौलस्त्यश्चैव दत्तो ऽत्रिरात्रेयो निश्चलस्तथा । पौलहो ऽथार्वरीवांश्च एते सप्तर्षयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: paulastyaścaiva datto 'trirātreyo niścalastathā / paulaho 'thārvarīvāṃśca ete saptarṣayastathā
verses.translation: Srsti begot of Ghaya (His spouse, the shadow) Hve sons devoid of sins via. Pracinagarbha, Vrabha, Vrka» Vfkala and Dhfti.
verses.hindi: श्री बसिष्ठ जी ने कहा--इसके अनन्तर अपरिमित तेज, वाले मूद्धा- सिषिक्त अर्थात् सवं शिरोमणि बारह सहल्न राजाओं का परशुरामजी ने जीवनो का ग्रहण किया था अर्थात् मार गिराया था।१। इसके अनन्तर एक सहन्र,राजाओं को पकड़ कर मुनिगणों के साथ महान् तेजस्वी वे परशु-
verses.wordMeaning: Srsti begot of Ghaya (His spouse, the shadow) Hve sons devoid of sins via. Pracinagarbha, Vrabha, Vrka» Vfkala and Dhfti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srsti begot of Ghaya (His spouse, the shadow) Hve sons devoid of sins via. Pracinagarbha, Vrabha, Vrka» Vfkala and Dhfti.

verses.sanskrit: चैत्रः किंपुरुष श्चैव कृतान्तो विभृतो रविः । बृहदुक्थो नवः सेतुः श्रुतश्चेति नव स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: caitraḥ kiṃpuruṣa ścaiva kṛtānto vibhṛto raviḥ / bṛhaduktho navaḥ setuḥ śrutaśceti nava smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Bhadra gave birth to Divafijaya, the son of Udi«- radhi. Var&hgl gave birth to Ripu (the son) of Divafljaya who- was a conqueror of his enemies.
verses.hindi: राम जी तपोमय कुरुक्षेत्र में गसन कर गये ये ।२। भूगुदरह ने वहाँ पर पाँच सरोवर खुदवा कर उनको सब ओर परम सुख का आवाहन करने बाले तीथं कर'दिया था ।३। बहीं पर उन सहस्र नृपों का हनन किया था और उतके णरीरों से निकले हुए रुधिर से भार्गब ने उन पांचों सरोवरों को भर दिया था ।४। परमाधिक प्रतापी जमदग्नि के पुत्र ने न्यायानुसार उन सरोबरों में स्नान किया था और तन्ब्रा से रहित होकर शास्त्रोक्त विधान से अपने पितरों को तृप्त किया था अर्थात् पितृशणों के लिए तपृण किया था ।५। है राजेन्द्र ! वहीं पर परशुरामजी ने जैसा भी शास्त्र में कहा गया, है यही
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadra gave birth to Divafijaya, the son of Udi«- radhi. Var&hgl gave birth to Ripu (the son) of Divafljaya who- was a conqueror of his enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadra gave birth to Divafijaya, the son of Udi«- radhi. Var&hgl gave birth to Ripu (the son) of Divafljaya who- was a conqueror of his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: मनोः स्वारोचिषस्यैते पुत्रा वंशकराः प्रभो । पुराणे परिसंख्याता द्वितीयं वै तदन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: manoḥ svārociṣasyaite putrā vaṃśakarāḥ prabho / purāṇe parisaṃkhyātā dvitīyaṃ vai tadantaram
verses.translation: Brhati gave birth to Caksus with all splendour (as the son) of Ripu. Manu, the great Kholar, who made the race* of Brahmanas and Katriyas function, was his son. Pukarii (otherwise known as) Varu gave birth to Caksua Manu.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणों के साथ रहकर अपने मृत पिता का और माता का श्राद्ध आदि पूर्ण रूप से सुसम्पन्न किया था ।इ। इस रीति से पितऋण से उत्तीणं होने वाले उन्होंने उस तप से परिपूर्ण कुर्क्षेत्र में पितृगणों की अर्चना में तत्पर होते हुए अतन्द्रित रहकर भली भाँति निवास किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Brhati gave birth to Caksus with all splendour (as the son) of Ripu. Manu, the great Kholar, who made the race* of Brahmanas and Katriyas function, was his son. Pukarii (otherwise known as) Varu gave birth to Caksua Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhati gave birth to Caksus with all splendour (as the son) of Ripu. Manu, the great Kholar, who made the race* of Brahmanas and Katriyas function, was his son. Pukarii (otherwise known as) Varu gave birth to Caksua Manu.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षयो मनुर्देवाः पितरश्च चतुष्टयम् । मूलं मन्वन्तरस्यैते तेषां चैवान्वयाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: saptarṣayo manurdevāḥ pitaraśca catuṣṭayam / mūlaṃ manvantarasyaite teṣāṃ caivānvayāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Udaka, the son of Aranya, attained the status of Vanina. Therefore, she was known as Varuni. She became well-known thus, on account of her brother.
verses.hindi: स्यमंतपंचकमिति स्थानं त्रेलोक्यविश्रुतम् । अवापुरक्षयां तृष्ति पितृलोकं च शाश्वतम् 4
verses.wordMeaning: Udaka, the son of Aranya, attained the status of Vanina. Therefore, she was known as Varuni. She became well-known thus, on account of her brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: Udaka, the son of Aranya, attained the status of Vanina. Therefore, she was known as Varuni. She became well-known thus, on account of her brother.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां देवताः पुत्राः पितरो देवसूनवः । ऋषयो देवपुत्राश्च इति शास्त्रे विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ devatāḥ putrāḥ pitaro devasūnavaḥ / ṛṣayo devaputrāśca iti śāstre viniścayaḥ
verses.translation: Ten splendid sons were born of Manu and Nadvala, the daughter of Vi raja, the Prajapati. They were of great vigour and vitality.
verses.hindi: समंतपंचकं नाम तीथं लोके परिश्र् तम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ten splendid sons were born of Manu and Nadvala, the daughter of Vi raja, the Prajapati. They were of great vigour and vitality.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ten splendid sons were born of Manu and Nadvala, the daughter of Vi raja, the Prajapati. They were of great vigour and vitality.

verses.sanskrit: मनोः क्षत्रं विशश्चैव सप्तर्षिभ्यो द्विजा तयः । एतन्मन्वन्तरं प्रोक्तं समासाच्च न विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: manoḥ kṣatraṃ viśaścaiva saptarṣibhyo dvijā tayaḥ / etanmanvantaraṃ proktaṃ samāsācca na vistarāt
verses.translation: They were Oru, Puru, Satyadyumna, Tapas-- vin, Satyavik, Kfti, Agnispit, Atiratra, Sudyumna (these nine) and Abhimanyu the tenth. These were the sons of Manu and Nadvala.
verses.wordMeaning: They were Oru, Puru, Satyadyumna, Tapas-- vin, Satyavik, Kfti, Agnispit, Atiratra, Sudyumna (these nine) and Abhimanyu the tenth. These were the sons of Manu and Nadvala.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Oru, Puru, Satyadyumna, Tapas-- vin, Satyavik, Kfti, Agnispit, Atiratra, Sudyumna (these nine) and Abhimanyu the tenth. These were the sons of Manu and Nadvala.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवे न विस्तारो ज्ञेयः स्वारोचिषस्य च । न शक्यो विस्तरस्तस्य वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuve na vistāro jñeyaḥ svārociṣasya ca / na śakyo vistarastasya vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi
verses.translation: Being milked in the different vessels, Vasun- dhari (the Earth containing rich deposits) yielded them milk as desired by them. The subjects sustained their lives thereby.
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् है राजन् ! तपश्चर्या करने के उस बन कुरुक्षेत्र में जमदरिन के पुत्र के द्वारा किया हुआ वह कुरु क्षेत्रधाम तभी से आरम्भ करके तीर्थों से सबसे परम श्रेष्ठ तीचं वत गया था ।८। वह स्थान सस्मय- अन्तक--इस नाम से तीनों लोकों में प्रब्यात हो गया था। क्योंकि वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Being milked in the different vessels, Vasun- dhari (the Earth containing rich deposits) yielded them milk as desired by them. The subjects sustained their lives thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being milked in the different vessels, Vasun- dhari (the Earth containing rich deposits) yielded them milk as desired by them. The subjects sustained their lives thereby.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरुक्तबहुत्वात्तु प्रजानां वै कुलेकुले । तृतीये त्वथ पर्याये उत्तमस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: punaruktabahutvāttu prajānāṃ vai kulekule / tṛtīye tvatha paryāye uttamasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: I shall recount to you, O Brahmaras, the birth of Prthu, the son of Vena. Listen to it with concentration and purity of mind, O excellent Brahrnaias.
verses.hindi: पर परशुरामजी ने अपने पितृगणों की अक्षय तृप्ति की थी ।६। वहाँ पर उन्होंने पितरों को बहुत ही अच्छी तरह से स्नान-दान-तप-होम-बिग्रों के लिए भोजन ओर तर्षेण आदि के द्वारा सस्तृष्त कर दिया था ।१०। और पितृग्रणों के लोक ने निरन्तर अक्षय तृप्ति प्राप्त की थी । स्यमन्तक नाम बाला तीर्थ लोक से परिश्र,त है ।११। यह तीर्थ समस्त पापों के क्षय का करने याला है और महान थुण्य से उपबृहन्ति है । जहाँ पर समागत हुए मनुष्यों के सम्पूणं से उपत्रृहस्ति है । जहाँ पर समागत हुए मनुष्यों के सम्पूर्ण पार दूर से ही बायु में शुष्क पत्रों की ही भाति उपगत हो जाता करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount to you, O Brahmaras, the birth of Prthu, the son of Vena. Listen to it with concentration and purity of mind, O excellent Brahrnaias.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount to you, O Brahmaras, the birth of Prthu, the son of Vena. Listen to it with concentration and purity of mind, O excellent Brahrnaias.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च देवगणा प्रोक्तास्तान्वक्ष्यामि निबोधत । सुधामानश्च ये देवा ये चान्ये वशवर्त्तिनः
verses.transliteration: pañca devagaṇā proktāstānvakṣyāmi nibodhata / sudhāmānaśca ye devā ye cānye vaśavarttinaḥ
verses.translation: This Brahman (i.e. the story as sacred as the Vedas) should not be comnmnicated to one who is not pure, to one who is a sinner, to one who is not a disciple, to one who is antagonistic and under no circumstances to one who does not observe holy rites.
verses.hindi: मनुष्यों का जो असत् है उनकी चर्या तथा गमन बड़ी ही कठिनाई से प्राप्त हुआ करता है.। यह है महाराज ! कभी भी सौ में जन्मों भी प्राप्त नहीं करता है। स्यमन्तक पंचक. तीर्थ कुरुक्षेत्र में बहुत ही अधिक पावन है
verses.wordMeaning: This Brahman (i.e. the story as sacred as the Vedas) should not be comnmnicated to one who is not pure, to one who is a sinner, to one who is not a disciple, to one who is antagonistic and under no circumstances to one who does not observe holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Brahman (i.e. the story as sacred as the Vedas) should not be comnmnicated to one who is not pure, to one who is a sinner, to one who is not a disciple, to one who is antagonistic and under no circumstances to one who does not observe holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतर्दनाः शिवाः सत्यागणा द्वादशकाः स्मृताः । सत्यो धृतिर्दमो दान्तः क्षमः क्षामो ध्वनिः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: pratardanāḥ śivāḥ satyāgaṇā dvādaśakāḥ smṛtāḥ / satyo dhṛtirdamo dāntaḥ kṣamaḥ kṣāmo dhvaniḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: That king brought to a standstill (prohibited) holy rites and devout practice. Transgressing the (injunction of the) Vedas, and scriptures he became engaged in sinful activities.
verses.hindi: उवास तत्र नियतः कंचित्कालं महामतिः । ३७६   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: That king brought to a standstill (prohibited) holy rites and devout practice. Transgressing the (injunction of the) Vedas, and scriptures he became engaged in sinful activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king brought to a standstill (prohibited) holy rites and devout practice. Transgressing the (injunction of the) Vedas, and scriptures he became engaged in sinful activities.

verses.sanskrit: इषोर्ज्जश्च तथा श्रेष्ठः सुपर्णो द्वादशस्तथा । इत्येते द्वादश प्रोक्ताः सुधामानस्तु नामभिः
verses.transliteration: iṣorjjaśca tathā śreṣṭhaḥ suparṇo dvādaśastathā / ityete dvādaśa proktāḥ sudhāmānastu nāmabhiḥ
