verses.translation: **No YajAa should be performed. No monetary or other gills should be ofered* this was the cruel solemn dec¬ laration of that Prajapati, when hb (utter) ruin was imminent.
verses.hindi: पितृतृप्तिकरं क्षेत्रं ताहग्लोके न विद्यते । यत्राचिताः स्वकुलजैयंथाशक्ति मनागपि
verses.wordMeaning: **No YajAa should be performed. No monetary or other gills should be ofered* this was the cruel solemn dec¬ laration of that Prajapati, when hb (utter) ruin was imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: **No YajAa should be performed. No monetary or other gills should be ofered* this was the cruel solemn dec¬ laration of that Prajapati, when hb (utter) ruin was imminent.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रधारो विश्वायुः समितारो वृहद्वसुः । विश्वधा विश्वकर्मा च मानसस्तु विराजसः
verses.transliteration: sahasradhāro viśvāyuḥ samitāro vṛhadvasuḥ / viśvadhā viśvakarmā ca mānasastu virājasaḥ
verses.translation: As he exceeded the bounds of decency (because) he had many heroic acts to fab credit, all the great sages with Marlci as their leader spoke to him then.
verses.hindi: ददौ च विधिवह्पिडं पिठृभक्तिसमन्वितः । ततस्तत्पितरः सर्वे पितृलोकादुपागताः ॥२ १
verses.wordMeaning: As he exceeded the bounds of decency (because) he had many heroic acts to fab credit, all the great sages with Marlci as their leader spoke to him then.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he exceeded the bounds of decency (because) he had many heroic acts to fab credit, all the great sages with Marlci as their leader spoke to him then.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिश्चैव विभासश्च कीर्त्तिता वंशवर्तिनः । अवध्यो ऽवरतिर्देवो वसुर्धिष्ण्यो विभावसुः
verses.transliteration: jyotiścaiva vibhāsaśca kīrttitā vaṃśavartinaḥ / avadhyo 'varatirdevo vasurdhiṣṇyo vibhāvasuḥ
verses.translation: kii. we are going to initiate a religious rite lasting for a hundred years. Do not commit any slniul deed. Thbb not the eternal Dharma.
verses.hindi: बह तीर्थी ऐसा महिमामय है कि जहाँ पर स्नान कर लेने वाला
verses.wordMeaning: kii. we are going to initiate a religious rite lasting for a hundred years. Do not commit any slniul deed. Thbb not the eternal Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: kii. we are going to initiate a religious rite lasting for a hundred years. Do not commit any slniul deed. Thbb not the eternal Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: वित्तः क्रतुः सुधर्मा च धृतधर्मा यशस्विजः । रथोर्मिः केतुमाञ्छ्चैव कीर्त्तितास्तु प्रतर्दनाः
verses.transliteration: vittaḥ kratuḥ sudharmā ca dhṛtadharmā yaśasvijaḥ / rathormiḥ ketumāñchcaiva kīrttitāstu pratardanāḥ
verses.translation: You are bom in the family of the god of death. Undoubtedly you are a Prajapati. Formerly, you had entered into a contract stipulating, shall protect the subjects.*'
verses.hindi: संसार के समस्त तीथों के स्नान का पुण्य फल प्राप्त कर लेने वाला हो जाता है। इसके अनन्तर राम अपने सब करयो को पूर्ण कर लेने वाले मति वाले नियत होकर कुछ काल तक निवासी हो गये ये । फिर सम्बस्सर के अन्त में यशी ब्राह्मणों के सहित पितृगणों के लिए पिणु समर्पित करने के लिये जमदरिनि के पुत्र गया गये थे। वहाँ पर जाकर शत्रुओं के दमन करने बाले ने शास्त्र को पद्धति के ही अनुसार श्राद्ध किया था ।१६-१७। उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: You are bom in the family of the god of death. Undoubtedly you are a Prajapati. Formerly, you had entered into a contract stipulating, shall protect the subjects.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: You are bom in the family of the god of death. Undoubtedly you are a Prajapati. Formerly, you had entered into a contract stipulating, shall protect the subjects.*'

verses.sanskrit: हंसस्वारौ वदान्यौ च प्रतर्दनयशस्करौ । सुदानो वसुदानश्च सुमञ्जसविषावुभौ
verses.transliteration: haṃsasvārau vadānyau ca pratardanayaśaskarau / sudāno vasudānaśca sumañjasaviṣāvubhau
verses.translation: He became a person endowed with endless ex¬ ploits and established the community of Nias (tribal people, hunters). Moreover he created the Dhlvaras (fishermen) origi¬ nating from the sins of Vena.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध से अपने पितृगणों का उद्देश्य ग्रहण करके ब्राह्मणों का सत्कार किया था और उनको संतृप्त किया था । उसके आगे शैव स्थान है जो चन्द्रपाद नाम से कहा गया है।१८। पिंतृगणों की तृप्ति करने याला उसके समान लोक में अन्य कोई भी क्षेत्र नहीं है। यह ऐसा स्थान है जहाँ पर अपने
verses.wordMeaning: He became a person endowed with endless ex¬ ploits and established the community of Nias (tribal people, hunters). Moreover he created the Dhlvaras (fishermen) origi¬ nating from the sins of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: He became a person endowed with endless ex¬ ploits and established the community of Nias (tribal people, hunters). Moreover he created the Dhlvaras (fishermen) origi¬ nating from the sins of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: यमो वह्निर् यतिश्चैव सुचित्रः सुतपास्तथा । शिवा ह्येते तु विज्ञेया यज्ञिया द्वादशापराः
verses.transliteration: yamo vahnir yatiścaiva sucitraḥ sutapāstathā / śivā hyete tu vijñeyā yajñiyā dvādaśāparāḥ
verses.translation: Other tribal people who have their abodes on the Vindhya, viz. the Tamburas, the Tuburas, the Khavas and others with special interest in sinful activities—Understand them as persons born of the sins of Vena.
verses.hindi: कुल में समुत्पन्न मानवों के द्वारा शक्ति के अनुसार अत्यल्प रूप से भी अचित हुए पितृगण पिण्ड दानादिक के द्वारा अक्षय गति को प्राप्त कर लेगे। बहाँ पर पिठृगणों का उद्देश्य लेकर ।द्जातियों को तृप्त किया था । जब बे पूर्णतया तृप्त हो गये थे तो पिठृगण के प्रति भक्तिभाव से समन्वित होकर विधि पूर्वेक पिण्डदान दिया था। इसके अनन्तर सभी पिठूलोक से वहीं पर उपागत हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Other tribal people who have their abodes on the Vindhya, viz. the Tamburas, the Tuburas, the Khavas and others with special interest in sinful activities—Understand them as persons born of the sins of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other tribal people who have their abodes on the Vindhya, viz. the Tamburas, the Tuburas, the Khavas and others with special interest in sinful activities—Understand them as persons born of the sins of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यानामपि नामानि निबोधत यथातथम् । दिक्पतिर्वाक्पतिश्चैव विश्वः शंभुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: satyānāmapi nāmāni nibodhata yathātatham / dikpatirvākpatiścaiva viśvaḥ śaṃbhustathaiva ca
verses.translation: Again the infuriated great sages whose anger had been aroused, churned the right hand of Vena as though it was the Arai (the piece of wood used to kindle the sacred fire by means of attrition).
verses.wordMeaning: Again the infuriated great sages whose anger had been aroused, churned the right hand of Vena as though it was the Arai (the piece of wood used to kindle the sacred fire by means of attrition).
verses.commentary: Sense: Again the infuriated great sages whose anger had been aroused, churned the right hand of Vena as though it was the Arai (the piece of wood used to kindle the sacred fire by means of attrition).

verses.sanskrit: स्वमृडीको दिविश्चैव वर्चोधामा बृहद्वपुः । अश्वश्चैव सदश्वश्च क्षेमानन्दौ तथैव च
verses.transliteration: svamṛḍīko diviścaiva varcodhāmā bṛhadvapuḥ / aśvaścaiva sadaśvaśca kṣemānandau tathaiva ca
verses.translation: VV. 156*173. As usual the author gives the popular etymologies of seta and MSgadha, and records the duties allotted to them. The relation, between Migadhaa and their hoine*Und Magadha is clear but not so about SQta and AnCpa (south Malwa).
verses.hindi: क्षत्रहत्यां हि कृत्वा तु कुतकर्माभवद्यत: । तस्मात्त्वं वीरहत्यादिपापप्रशमनाय हि
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 156*173. As usual the author gives the popular etymologies of seta and MSgadha, and records the duties allotted to them. The relation, between Migadhaa and their hoine*Und Magadha is clear but not so about SQta and AnCpa (south Malwa).
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 156*173. As usual the author gives the popular etymologies of seta and MSgadha, and records the duties allotted to them. The relation, between Migadhaa and their hoine*Und Magadha is clear but not so about SQta and AnCpa (south Malwa).

verses.sanskrit: सत्या ह्येते परिक्रान्ता यज्ञिया द्वादशापराः । इत्येता देवता ह्यासन्नौत्तमस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: satyā hyete parikrāntā yajñiyā dvādaśāparāḥ / ityetā devatā hyāsannauttamasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: All the sages cold those two —*'Lci this king be eulogised. This is a job befitting you and this ruler of men is a deserving person'*.
verses.hindi: जमदग्नि जिनमें आग्रगामी ये ऐसे उन सब पितृगणों ने वहाँ पर
verses.wordMeaning: All the sages cold those two —*'Lci this king be eulogised. This is a job befitting you and this ruler of men is a deserving person'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the sages cold those two —*'Lci this king be eulogised. This is a job befitting you and this ruler of men is a deserving person'*.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामिन्द्रस्तु देवानां सुशान्तिर्नाम विश्रुतः । पुत्रास्त्तवङ्गिरसस्ते वै उत्तमस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmindrastu devānāṃ suśāntirnāma viśrutaḥ / putrāsttavaṅgirasaste vai uttamasya prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: This (king) is always devotedly engaged in his duty. He is truthful in speech. He has perfect control over his sense-organs. He is habituated to the wise pursuit of knowledge. He is liberal-minded and charitably disposed. He is never defeated in battles.
verses.hindi: आकर उसके द्वारा की गयी पूजा का ग्रहण किया था और वे सब भुगुनन्दन आकाश में स्थित होते हुए अदृश्य होकर ही उससे कहा था। पितृगण ने कहा--हे वीर ! तुमने बहुत ही बड़ा कार्य किया हैं जो कि अन्य जनों के द्वारा कभी भी नहीं हो सकता है अर्थात्-महाच कठिन है ।२३। आपने न्याय पूर्वक बहुत ही अच्छी तरह से सन्तृप्त किया है तो भी हमारी कभी क्षीण न
verses.wordMeaning: This (king) is always devotedly engaged in his duty. He is truthful in speech. He has perfect control over his sense-organs. He is habituated to the wise pursuit of knowledge. He is liberal-minded and charitably disposed. He is never defeated in battles.
verses.commentary: Sense: This (king) is always devotedly engaged in his duty. He is truthful in speech. He has perfect control over his sense-organs. He is habituated to the wise pursuit of knowledge. He is liberal-minded and charitably disposed. He is never defeated in battles.

verses.sanskrit: वशिष्ठपुत्राः सप्तासन्वाशिष्ठा इति विश्रुताः । सप्तर्षयस्तु ते सर्व उत्तमस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: vaśiṣṭhaputrāḥ saptāsanvāśiṣṭhā iti viśrutāḥ / saptarṣayastu te sarva uttamasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: 'This ruler of men, the son of Vena, shall offer you means of sustenance'Thereupon, the subjects eagerly rushed to the highly fortunate son of Vena.
verses.hindi: होने वाली प्रीति तुमने हमको नहीं दी है ।२४। कारण यह है कि आपने समस्त क्षत्रियों को हत्या करके ही आप कमं करने वाले हुए हैं। यह तो इस क्षेत्र का ही प्रभाव है कि हमने आपको दर्शन दिया है तथा भक्ति भी इसका एक कारण है।२४। हम लोग यहाँ पर पूजित तो अवश्य हुए हैं
verses.wordMeaning: 'This ruler of men, the son of Vena, shall offer you means of sustenance'Thereupon, the subjects eagerly rushed to the highly fortunate son of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'This ruler of men, the son of Vena, shall offer you means of sustenance'Thereupon, the subjects eagerly rushed to the highly fortunate son of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: आचश्च परशुश्चैव दिव्यो दिव्यौषधिर्नयः । देवाम्वुजश्चाप्रतिमौ महोत्साहो गजस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ācaśca paraśuścaiva divyo divyauṣadhirnayaḥ / devāmvujaścāpratimau mahotsāho gajastathā
verses.translation: See note I, p. $70 above. As sted therein, this U an elaboration of a Vedie legend.
verses.hindi: किन्तु फिर भी अक्षय फल के भागी नहीं हुए हैं । इस कारण से आपको. उस महातु पाप के निवारण करने के लिये कुछ अवश्य ही कुछ करना ही होगा जो कि बड़े-बड़े वीरों की हत्या के प्रशमन के लिये होना चाहिए रद्द अब आपका कत्तव्य है कि न्याय के अनुरूप इसका प्रायश्चित और निरन्तर रहने वाला घमं का कर्म करो। तथा इससे आगे भविष्य झले क्षत्रियों के वघ करने के कार्य से दूर हो जाओ । अर्थातु क्षत्रियों की हत्या
verses.wordMeaning: See note I, p. $70 above. As sted therein, this U an elaboration of a Vedie legend.
verses.commentary: Sense: See note I, p. $70 above. As sted therein, this U an elaboration of a Vedie legend.

verses.sanskrit: विनीतश्च सुकेतुश्च सुमित्रः सुमतिः श्रुतिः । उत्तमस्य मनोः पुत्रास्त्रयोदश महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: vinītaśca suketuśca sumitraḥ sumatiḥ śrutiḥ / uttamasya manoḥ putrāstrayodaśa mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Even after killing me, Oking, you cannot protect the subjects (If you kill me, you will become incompetent to protect the subjects). I shall be present within. O lustrous one, get rid of your anger.
verses.wordMeaning: Even after killing me, Oking, you cannot protect the subjects (If you kill me, you will become incompetent to protect the subjects). I shall be present within. O lustrous one, get rid of your anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after killing me, Oking, you cannot protect the subjects (If you kill me, you will become incompetent to protect the subjects). I shall be present within. O lustrous one, get rid of your anger.

verses.sanskrit: एते क्षत्रप्रणेतारस्तृतीयं चैतदन्तरम् । औत्तमः परिसंख्यातः सर्गः स्वारोचिषेण तु
verses.transliteration: ete kṣatrapraṇetārastṛtīyaṃ caitadantaram / auttamaḥ parisaṃkhyātaḥ sargaḥ svārociṣeṇa tu
verses.translation: O protector of the Earth, they say that females, even from among the lower categories of animals, should not be killed. It does not behove you to abandon righteous beha¬ viour, in the case of living beings'*.
verses.hindi: करना बन्द कर दो।२७। इन विचारों के द्वारा तुम्हारे पिता का कोई भी अपराध नहीं किया गया है क्योंकि यह जगत् स्वतन्त्र नहीं हैं अर्थात् जगत् के प्राणी स्वेच्छा से ही कर्मों के करने में कभी भी स्वतन्त्र नहीं हुआ करते हैं। पहिले आपके पिता का जो मरण हुआ हैं उसके यह कोई भी निमित्त नहीं है क्यों कि स्वाधीनता किसी में भी कर्मों के करने की हुआ ही नही
verses.wordMeaning: O protector of the Earth, they say that females, even from among the lower categories of animals, should not be killed. It does not behove you to abandon righteous beha¬ viour, in the case of living beings'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: O protector of the Earth, they say that females, even from among the lower categories of animals, should not be killed. It does not behove you to abandon righteous beha¬ viour, in the case of living beings'*.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च तामसस्य निबोधत । चतुर्थे त्वथ पर्याये तामसस्यातरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: vistareṇānupūrvyā ca tāmasasya nibodhata / caturthe tvatha paryāye tāmasasyātare manoḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these diverse statements of the Earth the magnanimous noble-souled king controlled his anger and spoke to the Earth thus:—
verses.hindi: हंतु' कं कः समर्थ: स्याल्लोके रक्षितुमेव वा ।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these diverse statements of the Earth the magnanimous noble-souled king controlled his anger and spoke to the Earth thus:—
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these diverse statements of the Earth the magnanimous noble-souled king controlled his anger and spoke to the Earth thus:—

verses.sanskrit: सत्याः सुरूपाः सुधियो हरयश्च गणाः स्मृताः । पुलस्त्यपुत्रास्ते देवास्तामसस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: satyāḥ surūpāḥ sudhiyo harayaśca gaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / pulastyaputrāste devāstāmasasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: *If anyone were to kill one or more for the sake of one whether it be himself or another, then his action is sinful.
verses.hindi: ध्रुवं कर्मानुरूपं ते चेष्टंते सवं एव हि । कालानुवृत्तं बलवान्तु लोको नात्र संशयः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: *If anyone were to kill one or more for the sake of one whether it be himself or another, then his action is sinful.
verses.commentary: Sense: *If anyone were to kill one or more for the sake of one whether it be himself or another, then his action is sinful.

verses.sanskrit: गणस्तु तेषां देवानामेकैकः पञ्चविंशकः । इन्द्रियाणां प्रतीयेत ऋषयः प्रतिजानते
verses.transliteration: gaṇastu teṣāṃ devānāmekaikaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ / indriyāṇāṃ pratīyeta ṛṣayaḥ pratijānate
verses.translation: But O gentle, splendid lady, in case many flourish happily when a single person is killed, there is neither major nor minor sin in the act of his killing.
verses.hindi: शक्यते वत्स सर्वोऽपि यतः शक्ता स्वकर्मकृत्
verses.wordMeaning: But O gentle, splendid lady, in case many flourish happily when a single person is killed, there is neither major nor minor sin in the act of his killing.
verses.commentary: Sense: But O gentle, splendid lady, in case many flourish happily when a single person is killed, there is neither major nor minor sin in the act of his killing.

verses.sanskrit: सप्रमाणास्तु शीर्षण्यं मनश्चैवाष्टमं तथा । इन्द्रियाणि तथा देवा मनोस्तस्यान्तरे स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sapramāṇāstu śīrṣaṇyaṃ manaścaivāṣṭamaṃ tathā / indriyāṇi tathā devā manostasyāntare smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, O Vasundhara (Earch), I will kill you for the sake of subjects, if you do not carry out my request that is conducive to the welfare of the world.
verses.hindi: तपसे धृतसंकल्पो बभूव स महामनाः इस लोक में कोन है जो किसी का हनन या रक्षण करने की सामर्थ्य रखता हो । तात्पर्य यही है कि किसी में भी किसी के मारने या रक्षा करने की शक्ति नहीं है। मरण और संरक्षण इन दोनों के विषय में सभी केवल इस लोक में एक निमित्त ही हुआ करते हैं ओर वस्तुतः स्वयं कोई भी हट
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, O Vasundhara (Earch), I will kill you for the sake of subjects, if you do not carry out my request that is conducive to the welfare of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, O Vasundhara (Earch), I will kill you for the sake of subjects, if you do not carry out my request that is conducive to the welfare of the world.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां बभूव देवानां शिबिरिन्द्रः प्रतापवान् । सप्तर्षय्ॐऽतरे ये च तान्निबोधत सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ babhūva devānāṃ śibirindraḥ pratāpavān / saptarṣayoṃ'tare ye ca tānnibodhata sattamāḥ
verses.translation: If you turn your face against my behest, I will kill you presently with a single arrow. Establishing my prestige thus, I shall myself sustain the subjects.
verses.hindi: करने वाला नत्रीं होता है ।२६। जो भी कोई यहाँ पर किया करते: हैं वे सभी प्र निश्चय है कि अपने पूर्व कृत कर्मों के ही अनुसार चेष्टा किया करते हैँ। तास्पयं यही हैं कि जैसा भी जिसका कर्म पूर्व में किया हुआ होता
verses.wordMeaning: If you turn your face against my behest, I will kill you presently with a single arrow. Establishing my prestige thus, I shall myself sustain the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you turn your face against my behest, I will kill you presently with a single arrow. Establishing my prestige thus, I shall myself sustain the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: काव्य आङ्गिरसश्चैव काश्यपः पृथुरेव च । अत्रेयस्त्वग्निरित्येव ज्योतिर्धामा च भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: kāvya āṅgirasaścaiva kāśyapaḥ pṛthureva ca / atreyastvagnirityeva jyotirdhāmā ca bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: In compliance of my instructions, O the most excellent one among the up-holders of Dharma (piety), enliven and nourish the subjects perpetually. Indeed, you are capable of it. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: है वही करने के लिए सबको यहाँ पर विवश होना हो पड़ता है। यहाँ पर मानवगण काल के ही अनुसार चला करते हैं। यह निस्सन्देह सत्य है कि नृलोक बलवान है ।३०। इस भूमण्डल में कोई भी है वत्स! विधि के बिना प्राणियों को कोई बाधा पहुँचा कर शक्ति के द्वारा सामर्थ्य नहीं रखा करता है कारण यही है कि यहाँ पर सभो अपने कृत कमों के अनुसार ही सब किया करते हैं । तात्पर्य यही है कि कमं ही बड़ा बलवान् है जिसके वशीभूत होकर प्राणी कार्य करने:को प्रेरित होता है ।३१। आपने जो क्षत्रियों के वध करने का क्रोध किया है उसको अब त्याग दो यदि आपके मन में हमारे प्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: In compliance of my instructions, O the most excellent one among the up-holders of Dharma (piety), enliven and nourish the subjects perpetually. Indeed, you are capable of it. There is no doubt about it.
verses.commentary: Sense: In compliance of my instructions, O the most excellent one among the up-holders of Dharma (piety), enliven and nourish the subjects perpetually. Indeed, you are capable of it. There is no doubt about it.

verses.sanskrit: पौलहश्चरकश्चात्र वाशिष्ठः पीवरस्तथा । चैत्रस्तथैव पौलस्त्य ऋषयस्तामसेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: paulahaścarakaścātra vāśiṣṭhaḥ pīvarastathā / caitrastathaiva paulastya ṛṣayastāmaseṃ'tare
verses.translation: Adopt also the status of my dathter. In that case I shall withdraw this terrific-looking arrow wliich 1 have raised up for slaying you**.
verses.hindi: करने की अभिलाषा है। अब आप शम को ग्रहण करो । इस भूमण्डल में इसी शम से आपका श्रेय होगा । यह शम तो हमारा बड़ा भारी बल हैँ ।३२। चसिष्ठजी ने कहा--उन भृगुनन्दन जी से इतना ही कहकर सब पितृ- गण अम्तहित हो गये ये। फिर उन परणुरामजी ने भी बहुत ही आदर के
verses.wordMeaning: Adopt also the status of my dathter. In that case I shall withdraw this terrific-looking arrow wliich 1 have raised up for slaying you**.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adopt also the status of my dathter. In that case I shall withdraw this terrific-looking arrow wliich 1 have raised up for slaying you**.

verses.sanskrit: जानुजङ्घस्तथा शान्तिर्नरः ख्यातिः शुभस्तथा । प्रियभृत्यो परीक्षिच्च प्रस्थलो ऽथ दृढेषुधिः
verses.transliteration: jānujaṅghastathā śāntirnaraḥ khyātiḥ śubhastathā / priyabhṛtyo parīkṣicca prasthalo 'tha dṛḍheṣudhiḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon the Earth who had been told thus, replied to the son of Vena:—
verses.hindi: साथ उनके उस वचन का ग्रहण किया था ।३३। अकृत्रण को अपने साथ में लेकर परंमाधिक प्रसन्नता से संयुत होकर उसी समय में परशुराम वहाँ से, सिद्धों के बन में स्थित आश्रम को चले गये थे ।३४। महान् विशाल मन बाले राम उस आश्रम में समवस्थित होकर जहाँ कि बहुत से ब्राह्मण भी उनके साथ में ये है नृप ! फिर बे तप करने के लिए मन में सङ्कल्प धारण, करने वाले हो गये ये
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon the Earth who had been told thus, replied to the son of Vena:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon the Earth who had been told thus, replied to the son of Vena:—

verses.sanskrit: कृशाश्वः कृतबन्धुश्च तामसस्य मनोः सुताः । पञ्चमेत्वथ पर्याये मनोः स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: kṛśāśvaḥ kṛtabandhuśca tāmasasya manoḥ sutāḥ / pañcametvatha paryāye manoḥ svārociṣeṃ'tare
verses.translation: We have heard that at that time their sustenance was maintained with great difficulty. Every tiling was made available in this world even since the days of the son of Vena.
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard that at that time their sustenance was maintained with great difficulty. Every tiling was made available in this world even since the days of the son of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard that at that time their sustenance was maintained with great difficulty. Every tiling was made available in this world even since the days of the son of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: गुणास्तु ये समाख्याता देवानां तान्निबोधत । अमिताभा भूतरयो वैकुण्ठाः ससुमेधसः
verses.transliteration: guṇāstu ye samākhyātā devānāṃ tānnibodhata / amitābhā bhūtarayo vaikuṇṭhāḥ sasumedhasaḥ
verses.translation: After adopting Caksusa Manu as the calf, lord Prthu milked plants and vegetables from the Earth on its own surface.
verses.hindi: परीत्य पृथिवीं सर्वा पितृदेवादिपूजकः परिचक्राम राजेंद्र लोकवृत्तमनुग्रतः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After adopting Caksusa Manu as the calf, lord Prthu milked plants and vegetables from the Earth on its own surface.
verses.commentary: Sense: After adopting Caksusa Manu as the calf, lord Prthu milked plants and vegetables from the Earth on its own surface.

verses.sanskrit: वरिष्ठाश्च शुभाः पुत्रा वसिष्ठस्य प्रजापतेः । चतुर्दश तु चत्वारो गणास्तेषां सुभास्वराः
verses.transliteration: variṣṭhāśca śubhāḥ putrā vasiṣṭhasya prajāpateḥ / caturdaśa tu catvāro gaṇāsteṣāṃ subhāsvarāḥ
verses.translation: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रः प्रज्ञो ऽग्निभावश्च प्रज्योतिश्चामृतस्तथा । सुमतिर्वा विरावश्च धामा नादः श्रवास्तथा
verses.transliteration: ugraḥ prajño 'gnibhāvaśca prajyotiścāmṛtastathā / sumatirvā virāvaśca dhāmā nādaḥ śravāstathā
verses.translation: It is heard chat the Earth was again milked by the Pitra by means of a Silver Vessel. The yield was Svadha and it was conducive to their immediate contentment. Yama the valorous son of Vivasvan was their calf. The power¬ ful god Antaka (the god of death) was the milkman of the Pitrs.
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard chat the Earth was again milked by the Pitra by means of a Silver Vessel. The yield was Svadha and it was conducive to their immediate contentment. Yama the valorous son of Vivasvan was their calf.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard chat the Earth was again milked by the Pitra by means of a Silver Vessel. The yield was Svadha and it was conducive to their immediate contentment. Yama the valorous son of Vivasvan was their calf.…

verses.sanskrit: वृत्तिराशी च वादश्च शबरश्च चतुर्दश । अमिताभाः स्मृता ह्येते देवाः स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: vṛttirāśī ca vādaśca śabaraśca caturdaśa / amitābhāḥ smṛtā hyete devāḥ svārociṣeṃ'tare
verses.translation: Mt. 25 reads here Vararud (or Vasuruci as the milk-man and N&tya Veda was the milk:
verses.wordMeaning: Mt. 25 reads here Vararud (or Vasuruci as the milk-man and N&tya Veda was the milk:
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 25 reads here Vararud (or Vasuruci as the milk-man and N&tya Veda was the milk:

verses.sanskrit: मतिश्च सुमतिश्चैव ऋतसत्यौ तथैधनः । अधृतिर्विधृतिश्चैव दमो नियम एव च
verses.transliteration: matiśca sumatiścaiva ṛtasatyau tathaidhanaḥ / adhṛtirvidhṛtiścaiva damo niyama eva ca
verses.translation: As per traditional report, the Vasudhi (the Earth) was extended here with oceans as its limits. It is glorified in. songs as Vasudhi becatise it. holds (within its bowels) riches ( Vasu).
verses.hindi: ददृशुस्ते मुनिगणास्तपस्यासक्तमानसम् । क्षात्रं कक्षमशेषेण दग्ध्वा शांतमिकानलम्
verses.wordMeaning: As per traditional report, the Vasudhi (the Earth) was extended here with oceans as its limits. It is glorified in. songs as Vasudhi becatise it. holds (within its bowels) riches ( Vasu).
verses.commentary: Sense: As per traditional report, the Vasudhi (the Earth) was extended here with oceans as its limits. It is glorified in. songs as Vasudhi becatise it. holds (within its bowels) riches ( Vasu).

verses.sanskrit: व्रतो विष्णुः सहश्चैव द्युतिमान्सुश्रवास्तथा । इत्येतानीह नामानि आभूतयसां विदुः
verses.transliteration: vrato viṣṇuḥ sahaścaiva dyutimānsuśravāstathā / ityetānīha nāmāni ābhūtayasāṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, on its attainment of the status of the daughter of the intelligent king Pfthu, the son of Vena, it came to be cited as Prthivi.
verses.hindi: उस समय में परशुरामजी ने रथ के सहित सहसाह को और धनुष
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, on its attainment of the status of the daughter of the intelligent king Pfthu, the son of Vena, it came to be cited as Prthivi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, on its attainment of the status of the daughter of the intelligent king Pfthu, the son of Vena, it came to be cited as Prthivi.

verses.sanskrit: वृषो भेत्ता जयो भीमः शुचिर्दान्तो यशो दमः । नाथो विद्वानजेयश्च कृशो गौरो ध्रुवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vṛṣo bhettā jayo bhīmaḥ śucirdānto yaśo damaḥ / nātho vidvānajeyaśca kṛśo gauro dhruvastathā
verses.translation: W. 12b*20 give the list of peno&s who 'milked'* the eirlh an esdi Manvutara. lo a way each *Wlkhag*' represenu advancement in human dvilixation.
verses.hindi: तथा समस्त आयुधं को पुनः आवश्यकता पड़ने पर आगमन का संकेत करके बहाँ से प्रस्थापित कर दिया था ।३६। इसके पश्चात् उन्होंने सभी तीथा में अतन्द्रित होकर स्नान किया था और पितृगण तथा देवों का पूजन रीति से है राजैस्द ! भृगुनन्दन ने लोक ग्रत का अनुवत्तान करते हुए तीन बार सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वी का परिक्रमण किया था ।३८। है राजन् ! इसके अनन्तर उन्होने ब्राह्मणों से अभिसंबृत होकर फिर तपस्या करने के लिए महेन्द्र पर्बेत पर जो कि पर्वतोमें परमश्र छ था आगमन किया था ।३९। है राजन् ! धर्म के ज्ञाता उन्होंने मुनिगण और सिद्ध-समुदायों के द्वारा सेबित उस
verses.wordMeaning: W. 12b*20 give the list of peno&s who 'milked'* the eirlh an esdi Manvutara. lo a way each *Wlkhag*' represenu advancement in human dvilixation.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 12b*20 give the list of peno&s who 'milked'* the eirlh an esdi Manvutara. lo a way each *Wlkhag*' represenu advancement in human dvilixation.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्त्तितास्तु विकुण्ठा वै सुमेधांस्तु निबोधत । मेधा मेधा तिथिश्चैव सत्यमेधास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kīrttitāstu vikuṇṭhā vai sumedhāṃstu nibodhata / medhā medhā tithiścaiva satyamedhāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: On account of his strength, learning, penance and virility, he was the sole monarch of the Earth. His Darbha grasses had their tips towards the East.* Hence, he was known as Pracinabarhis.
verses.hindi: पर्बत पर अधिक समय तक अपने निवास करने का विचार कर लिया था ।४०। फिर वहाँ पर समस्त कैत्रों के निवासो नियत और ब्रह्मवादी मुलियों ने तपश्चर्या करने वाले उन भागंवेन्द्र के दर्शन करने की कामना रखकर वहाँ पर समागमन किया था ।४१। उन मुनिगणों ने तपश्चर्या में समासक्त
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his strength, learning, penance and virility, he was the sole monarch of the Earth. His Darbha grasses had their tips towards the East.* Hence, he was known as Pracinabarhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his strength, learning, penance and virility, he was the sole monarch of the Earth. His Darbha grasses had their tips towards the East.* Hence, he was known as Pracinabarhis.

verses.sanskrit: पृश्निमेधाल्पमेधाश्च भूयोमेधाश्च यः प्रभुः । दीप्तिमेधा यशोमेधा स्थिरमेधास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: pṛśnimedhālpamedhāśca bhūyomedhāśca yaḥ prabhuḥ / dīptimedhā yaśomedhā sthiramedhāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: After a great penance, thatPraj&pati married Savarna the daughter of the ocean.
verses.hindi: उनका पूर्ण रूप से क्षत्रियों के कक्ष को दस्ध करके परम शास्त अग्नि की कृतकौशलसंप्रश्नपूर्वकाः सुमहोदयाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: After a great penance, thatPraj&pati married Savarna the daughter of the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a great penance, thatPraj&pati married Savarna the daughter of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमेधा सुमेधाश्च प्रतिमेधाश्च यः स्मृतः । मेधजा मेधहन्ता च कीर्त्तितास्ते सुमेधसः
verses.transliteration: sarvamedhā sumedhāśca pratimedhāśca yaḥ smṛtaḥ / medhajā medhahantā ca kīrttitāste sumedhasaḥ
verses.translation: Performing piotisrites (collectively) without being separated from one another, they underwent severe penance for ten thousand years lying down within the waters of the ocean.
verses.hindi: तेषामनुमते कृत्वा काश्यपं गुरुमात्मनः । वाजिमेध्रं ततो राजन्नाजहार महाक्तुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Performing piotisrites (collectively) without being separated from one another, they underwent severe penance for ten thousand years lying down within the waters of the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing piotisrites (collectively) without being separated from one another, they underwent severe penance for ten thousand years lying down within the waters of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: विभुरिन्द्रस्तथा तेषामासीद्वि क्रान्तपौरुषः । पौलस्त्यो दवबाहुश्च सुधामा नाम काश्यपः
verses.transliteration: vibhurindrastathā teṣāmāsīdvi krāntapauruṣaḥ / paulastyo davabāhuśca sudhāmā nāma kāśyapaḥ
verses.translation: While they were performing the penance, the trees
verses.hindi: तस्या भूरकाश्यपोऽश्वयु रुदृगाता गौतमो मुनिः विशवामित्रोऽभवद्धोता रामस्य विदितात्मनः अह्यत्वमकरोत्तस्य मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः । 'भरद्वाजास्निवेश्याद्या वेदबेदांगपारगाः ।॥
verses.wordMeaning: While they were performing the penance, the trees
verses.commentary: Sense: While they were performing the penance, the trees

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यरोमाङ्गिरसो वेदश्रीश्चैव भार्गवः । ऊर्ध्वबाहुश्च वाशिष्ठः पर्जन्यः पौलहस्तथा
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaromāṅgiraso vedaśrīścaiva bhārgavaḥ / ūrdhvabāhuśca vāśiṣṭhaḥ parjanyaḥ paulahastathā
verses.translation: Gf. Vp. I 14.4. This speciality u attributed u> the kiog'i perforaiance of many sacrifices.
verses.hindi: भागवेन्द्र मुनि ने जिस समय में उन समस्त परम दिव्य तप से परि-
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vp. I 14.4. This speciality u attributed u> the kiog'i perforaiance of many sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vp. I 14.4. This speciality u attributed u> the kiog'i perforaiance of many sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यनेत्रस्तथात्रेय ऋषयो रैवतेंऽतरे । महावीर्यः सुसंभाव्यः सत्यको हरहा शुचिः
verses.transliteration: satyanetrastathātreya ṛṣayo raivateṃ'tare / mahāvīryaḥ susaṃbhāvyaḥ satyako harahā śuciḥ
verses.translation: This happened when the C&ksu$a Manvantara passed by. The whole finnament became enveloped by the trees and hence the wind was unable to blow.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण भुनियों को वहां पर समागत हुए देखा था तो उन्होने अर्घ्यं आदि सब उपचारों के द्वारा सहपं उत्तका अचन किया था ।४३। उन समस्त महोदयों ने सवं प्रथम तो लेम-कुशल का प्रश्तोल्तर किया था फिर उन सबकी ओर मागव की परस्पर में परम पुण्यमय मनोहर कथाएं हुई थी ।४४। इसको उपरान्त भावित आत्मा वाले उन्हें मुनियों की अनुमति से भृगुनन्दन ने महायज्ञ के आहरण करने का उपक्रम दिया था ।४५। इसके अनन्तर हे नृप ! ओर्यादि तथा मिशबामि्र-भरद्वाज और मार्कण्डेय आदि के सहित यज्ञ के उपयुक्त समस्त संभारों का संग्रह किया गया घा ।४६। फिर उन्हीं
verses.wordMeaning: This happened when the C&ksu$a Manvantara passed by. The whole finnament became enveloped by the trees and hence the wind was unable to blow.
verses.commentary: Sense: This happened when the C&ksu$a Manvantara passed by. The whole finnament became enveloped by the trees and hence the wind was unable to blow.

verses.sanskrit: बलबन्धुर्निरामित्रः कंबुः शृगो धृतव्रतः । रैवतस्य च पुत्रास्ते पञ्चमं वै तदन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: balabandhurnirāmitraḥ kaṃbuḥ śṛgo dhṛtavrataḥ / raivatasya ca putrāste pañcamaṃ vai tadantaram
verses.translation: This fair-complexioned daughter of the trees has become the crest-jewel all women. This girl has been held (and nurtured) in the womb by me, as I had already known the future events.
verses.hindi: सबकी अनुमति हो जाने पर भृगुनन्दन ने काश्यप को अपना गुरु बनाकर हे राजन् ! फिर बाजिमेध महान ऋतु का समाहरण किया था ।४७। विदित आत्मा बाले भृगुनन्दन के गुरु तो काश्यप हुए ये ओर उद्गाता गौतम मुनि हुए थे और उस यज्ञ में विश्वामित्र ऋषि होता हुए ये ।४८। महासुनि
verses.wordMeaning: This fair-complexioned daughter of the trees has become the crest-jewel all women. This girl has been held (and nurtured) in the womb by me, as I had already known the future events.
verses.commentary: Sense: This fair-complexioned daughter of the trees has become the crest-jewel all women. This girl has been held (and nurtured) in the womb by me, as I had already known the future events.

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषश्चोत्तमो ऽपि तामसो रैवतस्तथा । प्रियव्रतान्वया ह्येते चत्वारो मनवः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: svārociṣaścottamo 'pi tāmaso raivatastathā / priyavratānvayā hyete catvāro manavaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेय ने वहां पर ब्रह्मा के पद को ग्रहण किया था । भरद्वाज-अस्निवेश्य आदि जो भी वेदों तथा वेदों के अङ्ग शास्त्रों के पारगामी प्रकाण्ड पण्डित थे मुतयश्चक्रन्याति कर्माण्यन्ये यथाक्रमम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठे खल्वपि पर्याये देवा ये चाक्षुषेंऽतरे । आद्याः प्रसूता भाव्यश्च पृथुकाश्च दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhe khalvapi paryāye devā ye cākṣuṣeṃ'tare / ādyāḥ prasūtā bhāvyaśca pṛthukāśca divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, at the instance of Soma, those Pracetas controlled their anger and as per religious procedure accepted from the trees, the girl Marisa as their wife.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, at the instance of Soma, those Pracetas controlled their anger and as per religious procedure accepted from the trees, the girl Marisa as their wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, at the instance of Soma, those Pracetas controlled their anger and as per religious procedure accepted from the trees, the girl Marisa as their wife.

verses.sanskrit: महानुभावा लेखास्छ पञ्च देवगणाः स्मृताः । दिवौकसः सर्व एव प्रोच्यन्ते मातृनामभिः
verses.transliteration: mahānubhāvā lekhāscha pañca devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / divaukasaḥ sarva eva procyante mātṛnāmabhiḥ
verses.translation: After mentally creatiz the mobile and immobile beings and the bipeds and quadrupeds, Daksa created women.
verses.hindi: सादस्यमकरोद्राजन्नन्यैश्च मुनिभिः सह । स तै' सहाखिलं कर्म समाप्य भृगुपु गनः
verses.wordMeaning: After mentally creatiz the mobile and immobile beings and the bipeds and quadrupeds, Daksa created women.
verses.commentary: Sense: After mentally creatiz the mobile and immobile beings and the bipeds and quadrupeds, Daksa created women.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेः पुत्रस्य नप्तारो ह्यारण्यस्य प्रजापतेः । गणस्तु तेषां देवानामेकैको ह्यष्टकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: atreḥ putrasya naptāro hyāraṇyasya prajāpateḥ / gaṇastu teṣāṃ devānāmekaiko hyaṣṭakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He gave ten daughten to Dharma; thirteen to Kaiyapa and twentyseven (daughters) who were suitable for passing (calculation) of the time (i.e. the Constellations) to (the Moon) god.
verses.wordMeaning: He gave ten daughten to Dharma; thirteen to Kaiyapa and twentyseven (daughters) who were suitable for passing (calculation) of the time (i.e. the Constellations) to (the Moon) god.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave ten daughten to Dharma; thirteen to Kaiyapa and twentyseven (daughters) who were suitable for passing (calculation) of the time (i.e. the Constellations) to (the Moon) god.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षो वसुर्हव्यो ह्यतिथिश्च प्रियव्रतः । श्रोता मन्तानुमन्ता च त्वाद्या ह्येते प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: antarikṣo vasurhavyo hyatithiśca priyavrataḥ / śrotā mantānumantā ca tvādyā hyete prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: Creation and annihilation, O excellent ones, do happen perpetually among the living beings. Hie sages and those
verses.hindi: आहूय भृगुशादूलः सशैलवनकाननाम् डैदर  ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Creation and annihilation, O excellent ones, do happen perpetually among the living beings. Hie sages and those
verses.commentary: Sense: Creation and annihilation, O excellent ones, do happen perpetually among the living beings. Hie sages and those

verses.sanskrit: श्येनभद्रस्तथा चैव श्वेतचक्षुर्महायशाः । सुमनाश्च प्रचेताश्च वनेनः सुप्रचेत्सौ
verses.transliteration: śyenabhadrastathā caiva śvetacakṣurmahāyaśāḥ / sumanāśca pracetāśca vanenaḥ supracetsau
verses.translation: AH these, Dak and others, are born in every Yuga. They are annihilated again. A learned man does not become confused in this matter.
verses.wordMeaning: AH these, Dak and others, are born in every Yuga. They are annihilated again. A learned man does not become confused in this matter.
verses.commentary: Sense: AH these, Dak and others, are born in every Yuga. They are annihilated again. A learned man does not become confused in this matter.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिश्चैव महासत्त्वः प्रसूताः परिकीर्त्तिताः । विजयः सुजयश्चैव मनस्योदौ तथैव च
verses.transliteration: muniścaiva mahāsattvaḥ prasūtāḥ parikīrttitāḥ / vijayaḥ sujayaścaiva manasyodau tathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who comprehends this creation of C&ksu con¬ sisting of the mobile and immobile beings, shall become one endowed with progeny. He shall cross the life-span. He will be honoured in the heaven (after his death).
verses.hindi: पुराः समाप्य यज्ञांते तथा चावभृथाप्लुतः इन समस्त मुनियों ने तथा अन्यों ने क्रम के अनुसार अन्यान्य जो
verses.wordMeaning: He who comprehends this creation of C&ksu con¬ sisting of the mobile and immobile beings, shall become one endowed with progeny. He shall cross the life-span. He will be honoured in the heaven (after his death).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who comprehends this creation of C&ksu con¬ sisting of the mobile and immobile beings, shall become one endowed with progeny. He shall cross the life-span. He will be honoured in the heaven (after his death).

verses.sanskrit: मतिः परिमतिश्चैव विचेताः प्रियनिश्चयः । भव्या ह्येते स्मृता देवाः पृथुकांश्च निबोधत
verses.transliteration: matiḥ parimatiścaiva vicetāḥ priyaniścayaḥ / bhavyā hyete smṛtā devāḥ pṛthukāṃśca nibodhata
verses.translation: During the Seventh Manvantara of Vaivasvata Manu, the Devas and the great lages were bom of Kajyapa, the son of Marici
verses.hindi: भी कर्म उस यज्ञाला में थे उनको किया था । उस यज्ञ में भगवान् भृगु भी अपने पुत्रों-शिष्यों और प्रशिष्यों के सहित पधारे ये । उन्होंने अभ्यात्य मुनियों के साथ है राजत् ! यज्ञ की सदस्यता की थी अर्थात् सब सदस्य बन गये थे और उन सबके साथ मिलकर भृगुपुङ्गव परशुरामजी ने उस सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: During the Seventh Manvantara of Vaivasvata Manu, the Devas and the great lages were bom of Kajyapa, the son of Marici
verses.commentary: Sense: During the Seventh Manvantara of Vaivasvata Manu, the Devas and the great lages were bom of Kajyapa, the son of Marici

verses.sanskrit: ओजिष्ठः शकुनो देवो वानत्दृष्टस्तथैव च । सत्कृतः सत्यदृष्टिश्च जिगीषुर्विजयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ojiṣṭhaḥ śakuno devo vānatdṛṣṭastathaiva ca / satkṛtaḥ satyadṛṣṭiśca jigīṣurvijayastathā
verses.translation: The following are remembered as the eight groups of Devas: (1) Adityas (2) Vasus (3) Rudras (4) S&dhyas (5) Vivedevas (6) Maruts (7) Bhfgus and (8) Angiras.
verses.hindi: कर्म को सुसम्पन्न किया था ।५०-११। जब सम्पूर्ण कर्म समाप्त हो गया था यथा रीति अपने गुरुदेव के ही साथ ब्रह्माजी का पूजन किया था । फिर रूप लावण्य बाली मही कन्या को महामूल्यवान् आभूषणों से समलंकृत किया था ।५२। फिर उस मही कन्या को जो सहस्नों पुरों और ग्रामों से समन्वित'एबं सागरों और अम्बर की माला बाली थी तथा उसमें अनेकों शैल-वन और कानन भी थे। उन मुनि शादू'ल ने उसको अपने समीप में बुला लिया था ।५३। फिर सम्पूर्ण उसको काश्यप मुनि को दे दिया था केवल उस उत्तम महेन्द्र पर्वत को नहीं दिया था जिस पर वे स्वयं निवास किया करते थे
verses.wordMeaning: The following are remembered as the eight groups of Devas: (1) Adityas (2) Vasus (3) Rudras (4) S&dhyas (5) Vivedevas (6) Maruts (7) Bhfgus and (8) Angiras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are remembered as the eight groups of Devas: (1) Adityas (2) Vasus (3) Rudras (4) S&dhyas (5) Vivedevas (6) Maruts (7) Bhfgus and (8) Angiras.

verses.sanskrit: अजितश्च महाभागः पृथुकास्ते दिवौकसः । लेशास्तथा प्रवक्ष्यामि नामतस्तान्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: ajitaśca mahābhāgaḥ pṛthukāste divaukasaḥ / leśāstathā pravakṣyāmi nāmatastānnibodhata
verses.translation: All these too will meet death after the efHux of time. Thus the current splendid creation should be known as that of the son of Marici.
verses.hindi: क्यों कि परशुरामजी ने उस पर्वत को अपने ही निवास करने के लिए कल्पित कर लिया था ।५४। तभी से लेकर है राजेन्द्र ! शास्त्रानुसार सुवणे- रत्न-वस्त्र-अश्व-गौ-गज आदि के द्वारा उसका पूजन किया था । पहिले इस सब कर्म को समाप्त करके फिर यज्ञ के अवसान समय में वे यज्ञान्त अवभूय
verses.wordMeaning: All these too will meet death after the efHux of time. Thus the current splendid creation should be known as that of the son of Marici.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these too will meet death after the efHux of time. Thus the current splendid creation should be known as that of the son of Marici.

verses.sanskrit: मनोजवः प्रघासश्च प्रचेताश्च महायशाः । ध्रुवो ध्रुवक्षितिश्चैव अत्युतश्चैव वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: manojavaḥ praghāsaśca pracetāśca mahāyaśāḥ / dhruvo dhruvakṣitiścaiva atyutaścaiva vīryavān
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: स्नान से आप्लुत हुए थे और उसी अवसर पर उन समस्त महा मुनियों के के अनुमति से फिर द्रव्य का परित्याग कर दिया था गतेषु तेषु भगवानकृतब्रणसंयुतः॥
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: युवना बृहस्पतिश्चैव लेखाः संपरिकीर्त्तिताः । मनोजवो महावीर्यस्तेषामिन्द्रस्तदाभवत्
verses.transliteration: yuvanā bṛhaspatiścaiva lekhāḥ saṃparikīrttitāḥ / manojavo mahāvīryasteṣāmindrastadābhavat
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमो भार्गवश्चैव हविष्मानङ्गिरःसुतः । सुधामा काश्यपश्चैव वशिष्ठो विरजास्तथा
verses.transliteration: uttamo bhārgavaścaiva haviṣmānaṅgiraḥsutaḥ / sudhāmā kāśyapaścaiva vaśiṣṭho virajāstathā
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: तन्न दीपप्रतिष्ठाख्यब्रतं विष्णुमुखोदितम् ॥ प्रभावः कात्तंवीयंस्य लोके प्रथिततेजसः ।
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: अतिनामा च पौलस्त्यः सहिष्णुः पौलहस्तथा । मधुरात्रेय इत्येते सप्त वै चाक्षुषेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: atināmā ca paulastyaḥ sahiṣṇuḥ paulahastathā / madhurātreya ityete sapta vai cākṣuṣeṃ'tare
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् भृगुनम्बन ने समस्त प्राणियों के लिए अभय का दान दे दिया था ओर बहा हो उस पबंत पर तपस्या करने का आरम्भ कर दिया था ।५७। इसके अनन्तर जो भी यज्ञ में समागत सदस्य तथा ऋत्विज थे उन्होंने एवं शंसित व्रतों वाले मुनियों ने सभी ने जैसे-जैसे जहाँ से वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: ऊरुः पुरुः शतद्युम्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवाक्कृतिः । अग्निष्टुदतिरात्रश्च सुद्युम्नशचेति ते नव
verses.transliteration: ūruḥ puruḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavākkṛtiḥ / agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaśaceti te nava
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: आगमन किया वैसे ही विदा होकर चले गये थे ।५८। उन सबके चले जाने पर भगवान ने अक्कृतद्रण से संयुत होकर महान तप में समास्थित होकर सुख से सम्पन्न उसी स्थान पर निवास किया करते ये ।५६। इसके पश्चात् जानना'था काश्यपी भूमि ने अनेक प्रकार के समस्त दुःखों की'प्रशान्ति के लिए मारीच की अनुमति से एक त्रत किया था ।६०। वहाँ पर दीप प्रतिष्ठा नाम वाला ब्रत जो कि भगवान “विष्णु के मुख से कहा गया शा उसको धरणी ने भली भांति किया था और फिर समस्त दुःखों से मुक्त हो गयी शी ।६१। वह भगवान जामदस्न्य का प्रादुर्भाव सब बता दिया गया है जिसके
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्युश्च दशमो नाड्वलेया मनोः सुताः । चाक्षुषस्य सुताः ह्येते षष्ठं चैव तदन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: abhimanyuśca daśamo nāḍvaleyā manoḥ sutāḥ / cākṣuṣasya sutāḥ hyete ṣaṣṭhaṃ caiva tadantaram
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: श्रवण करने पर मनुष्य समस्त पातकों से मुक्त हो जाया करता. है
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेन संख्यातस्तत्सर्गः सांप्रतेन तु । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatena saṃkhyātastatsargaḥ sāṃpratena tu / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: अपरिमित तेज वाले कातंवीर्य का लोक में जो प्रवल प्रभाव था वह भी असङ्ग से दिया गया था जो न तो अति संझिप्त था और न विशेष बिस्तृत एवंप्रभावः स चपः कात्तंवीर्योऽभवद्भुवि ।
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः चाक्षुषः कस्य दायादः संभूतः सक्य वान्वये । तस्यान्ववाये ये ऽप्यन्येतान्नो ब्रूहि यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ cākṣuṣaḥ kasya dāyādaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ sakya vānvaye / tasyānvavāye ye 'pyanyetānno brūhi yathātatham
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच चाक्षुषस्य विसर्गं तु समासाच्छृणुत द्विजाः । यस्यान्ववाये संभूतः पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca cākṣuṣasya visargaṃ tu samāsācchṛṇuta dvijāḥ / yasyānvavāye saṃbhūtaḥ pṛthurvainyaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: कालं महांतमवसद्धिमाद्रिवनगहवरे वह सूप कार्तवीर्य इस भूमण्डल में इस प्रकार के प्रभाव वाला हुआ थरा कि उस प्रकार का कोई भी पुरुष न कभी हुआ और न भविष्य में भी होगा तथा न कभी सुना ही गया है ।६४। उसने दत्तात्रेय मुनीन्द्र से यह बरदान प्राप्त किया था कि उसकी मृत्यु किसी महान उत्तम पुरुष से होवे।
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानां पतयश्चान्ये दक्षः प्राचेतसस्तथा । उत्तानपादं जग्राह पुत्रमत्रिप्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: prajānāṃ patayaścānye dakṣaḥ prācetasastathā / uttānapādaṃ jagrāha putramatriprajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: रण से वह परशुरामजी के द्वारा निहत होकर पहिले मुक्ति को प्राप्त दो गया था ।६५। उस राजा का पाचयां पुत्र प्रख्यात था जिसका नाम जयध्बज था । है नृप ! उसका पुत्र महाबाहु तालजङ्घा हुआ था ।६६। उसके भी उत्तम धनुर्धारी सौ पुत्र हुए थे । उन सबके नाम तालजङ् था उनमें वीतिः
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: दत्तकः स तु पुत्रो ऽस्य राजा ह्यासीत्प्रजापतिः । स्वायंभुवेन मनुना दत्तो ऽत्रेः कारणं प्रति
verses.transliteration: dattakaḥ sa tu putro 'sya rājā hyāsītprajāpatiḥ / svāyaṃbhuvena manunā datto 'treḥ kāraṇaṃ prati
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: होत्र सेबमें बड़ा भाई था ।६७। वह वीतिहोत्र प्रभृति पुं. के तथा हैहय बंगश तृपों के सहित उस हिमाद्रि पर्वत के बन गहदर में बहुत लम्बे समय तक उसने निवास किया या ।६८। जो पहिले राम के बाण के द्वारा भागता हुआ भी पृष्ठ माग में प्रताड़ित हो गया था । फिर बह तालजक्ु' गहरी बेदना से युक्त होकर मूर्च्छा को प्राप्त हो गया था और भूमि पर गिर. गयाः था ।६९। भाग्यवश उसको भागते हुए बीतिहोत्र ने देखा था। बड़े ही वेग से उसको रथ पर समारोपित करके बह भाग जाने में तत्पर हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरमथासाद्य भविष्यच्चाक्षुषस्य ह । षष्ठं तदनु वक्ष्यामि उपोद्धातेन वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: manvantaramathāsādya bhaviṣyaccākṣuṣasya ha / ṣaṣṭhaṃ tadanu vakṣyāmi upoddhātena vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपादाच्चतुरः सूनृतासूत भामिनी । धर्मस्य कन्या सुश्रोणी सूनृता नाम विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: uttānapādāccaturaḥ sūnṛtāsūta bhāminī / dharmasya kanyā suśroṇī sūnṛtā nāma viśrutā
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: वे सभी भागते हुए आकर भय से बहुत पीड़ित हो गये ये और हिमाद्रि पर्वत में बस गये थे । उन सबको महान कष्ट प्राप्त हुआ था ओर बहाँ पर वे सब्र शाक-मूल और फलों का अशन करने वाले हुए थे ।७१। जब वहाँ पर परशुराम परत शान्ति को प्रान हो जाने पर केवल तपस्या में ही आसक्त मन वाले हो गये वेओर फिर उनका कोई भी. भय नहीं रहा था तो तालजच्च ने अपने पुत्रों के सहित अपना राज्य कर लिया'था-।७२। उस श्रेष्ठ राजा ने फिर पूर्व की ही भाँति अपनी नगरी को सन्तिवेशित करके उस समय में वहीं पर निवास करते हुए उस अरिन्दमः ने अपने राज्यका
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्ना जापि धर्मेम ध्रुवस्य जननी शुभा । धर्मस्य पत्न्यां लक्ष्मयां वै उत्पन्ना सा शुचिस्मिता
verses.transliteration: utpannā jāpi dharmema dhruvasya jananī śubhā / dharmasya patnyāṃ lakṣmayāṃ vai utpannā sā śucismitā
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: परिपालन किया था ।७३। है महाराज ! सुन्दर पुत्र वाले ओर अपने /अनु- चरों तथा सेना से युक्त होकर उस तालजच्ध ने पूव बैर का अनुस्मर करके बह तालजङ्क आपके पुर में अभ्यागत हो गया था ।७४। “वह चतुरस्किणी सेना से संयुत होकर भूमि को कंपाता हुआ जैसे हो चला था। जब वह
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवं च कीर्त्तिमन्तं च त्वायुष्मन्तं वसुं तथा । उत्तानपादो ऽजनयत्कन्ये द्वे च शुचिस्मिते
verses.transliteration: dhruvaṃ ca kīrttimantaṃ ca tvāyuṣmantaṃ vasuṃ tathā / uttānapādo 'janayatkanye dve ca śucismite
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: अयोध्या नगरी में पहुँचा तो वह राजा रोने लयर गया झ्तर ७४। इसके पश्चातु आपके पिता के पास बहुत कम साधन ये तो भी-वह नगर से निकल ३०६  ह्माण्ड पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: स्वरामनस्विनी चैव तयोः पुत्राः प्रकीर्त्तिताः । ध्रुवो वर्षसहस्राणि दश दिव्यानि वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: svarāmanasvinī caiva tayoḥ putrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ / dhruvo varṣasahasrāṇi daśa divyāni vīryavān
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: आये थे और उन समस्त तृपों के साथ बृद्ध होते हुए भी तकण पुरष के ही समान उसने घोर युद्ध किया था ।७६। उसके बहुत से द्वाथी-अश्ब-रथ ओर सैनिक जंब निहत हो गये थे तो वह् शत्र,ओं के द्वारा निजित हो गया था और फिर बह वृद्ध वहां से भागने लग गया
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तेपे निराहारः प्रार्थयन्विपुलं यशः । त्रेतायुगे तु प्रथमे पौत्रः स्वायंभुवस्य तु
verses.transliteration: tapastepe nirāhāraḥ prārthayanvipulaṃ yaśaḥ / tretāyuge tu prathame pautraḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: त्यक्तवा स नगरं राज्यं सकोशत्रलवाहनम् । शोकामषंसमायिष्टो वृद्धभावेन च स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं धारयन्योगान्प्रार्थयन्सुमहद्यशः । तस्मै ब्रह्मा ददौ प्रीतो ज्योतिषां स्थानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ dhārayanyogānprārthayansumahadyaśaḥ / tasmai brahmā dadau prīto jyotiṣāṃ sthānamuttamam
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: आभूतसंप्लवाद्दिव्यमस्तोदयविवार्जितम् । तस्यातिमात्रामृद्धिं च महिमानं निरीक्ष्य तु
verses.transliteration: ābhūtasaṃplavāddivyamastodayavivārjitam / tasyātimātrāmṛddhiṃ ca mahimānaṃ nirīkṣya tu
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: अनाथ इव राजेन्दर स्वर्गलोकमितो गतः । अनणनादिदुःखेन भत्तु व्यंसनकर्शिता ।
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: दैत्या सुराणामाचार्यः श्लोकमप्युशाना जगौ । अहो ऽस्य तपसो वीर्यमहो श्रुतमहो व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: daityā surāṇāmācāryaḥ ślokamapyuśānā jagau / aho 'sya tapaso vīryamaho śrutamaho vratam

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा यदेनमुपरि ध्रुवं सप्तर्षयः स्थिताः । द्रुवे त्रिदिवमासक्तमीश्वरः स दिवस्पतिः

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवात्सृष्टिं च भव्यं च भूमिस्तौ सुषुवे नृपौ । स्वां छायामाह वै सृष्टिर्भवनारीति तां प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dhruvātsṛṣṭiṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca bhūmistau suṣuve nṛpau / svāṃ chāyāmāha vai sṛṣṭirbhavanārīti tāṃ prabhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: सत्याभिव्यहृतेस्तस्य सद्यः स्त्री साभवत्तदा । दिव्यसंहनना छाया दिव्याभरणभूषिता
verses.transliteration: satyābhivyahṛtestasya sadyaḥ strī sābhavattadā / divyasaṃhananā chāyā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā

verses.hindi: भाता विचारी पति वियोग के महा दुःख ओर शोक से समन्वित हो गयी थीत फिर करुण क्न्दन करती हुईं उसने स्वामी के मृत शरीर को चिता पर समारोपित कर दिया था।5:। पति के मृत हो जाने पर उसने. कुछ भी खाया नहीं था--शोक हृदय में बैठा ही था--ऐसे दुःखों से अपने स्वामी से वियोग के दुःख से बह बहुत कशित हो गयी थी। अतः - उसने भी अपने आपको भी अग्ति में पति के हो शव के साथ श्रवेश कर सती हो जाने का

verses.sanskrit: छायायां सृष्टिराधत्त पञ्च पुत्रानकल्मषान् । प्राजीनगर्भं वृषभं वृकञ्च वृकलं धृतिम्
verses.transliteration: chāyāyāṃ sṛṣṭirādhatta pañca putrānakalmaṣān / prājīnagarbhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vṛkañca vṛkalaṃ dhṛtim
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: सुहढ़ निश्चय कर लिया था ।८२। औरव॑ महामुनि ने यह सम्पूर्ण समाचार सुना तो वे महामुनि स्वयं ही अपने आश्रम से बाहिर निकलकर आ.गये थे और उससे यह वचन कहा या।८३। है राज्ञि ! तुमको इस समय में पति के साथ प्राणत्थाग नहीं करना चाहिए कारण यह है कि तुम्हारे उदर में

verses.transliteration: patnī prācīnagarbhasya suvarcā suṣuve nupam / nāmnodāradhiyaṃ putramindro yaḥ pūrvajanmani

verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ prajāpateḥ sutā kasmādvāruṇī procyate 'nagha / etadācakṣva tatvena kuśalo hyasi vistare

verses.hindi: समन्ततन्त्रं लोकेषु सर्वलोकफलप्रदम् । तुम्हारी मनस्विनी -माता ने इस उस मुनि के वचन का अवण किया था तो फिर वह सती होकर दस्ध होने से कायं से विरत हो गयी थी और फिर उसको वह मुनि अपने आश्रम में ले आये थे । इसके पश्चात् उसने सब दुःखों की ओर से अपने मन को नियमित कर लिया था तथा उसे गर्भस्थ

verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca araṇyasyodakaḥ putro varuṇatvamupāgataḥ / tena sā vāruṇī jñeyā bhrātrā khyātimupāgatā

verses.sanskrit: मनोरजायन्त दश नड्वलायां सुताः शुभाः । कन्यायां सुमहावीर्या विरजस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ sutāḥ śubhāḥ / kanyāyāṃ sumahāvīryā virajasya prajāpateḥ

verses.transliteration: ūruḥ puruḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavākkṛtiḥ / agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaśceti vai nava

verses.hindi: हे अरिन्दम ! इसके पश्चात् जो मी कुछ हुआ है वह आपको सव ज्ञात ही है । इस प्रकार के प्रभाव वाला राजा कात्तंवीर्ये इस भूमण्डल परं हुआ था ।८८। इसी ब्रत के प्रभाव से बह लोकों में प्रख्यात हुआ है । जिसके बंश में समुपत्न होने वालों के द्वारा आपके पिता को' युद्ध में जीत लिया गया है

verses.transliteration: abhimanyuśca daśamo naḍvalāyāṃ manoḥ sutāḥ / ūrorajanayatputrānṣaḍāgneyī mahāprabhān
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: और बन में चले गये ये ।८९। उसका सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्त मैने आपको कहकर सुना दिया है और यह सब बरतो में उत्तम ब्रत मैंने आपक्रो बतला दिया है ।९०। यह ऐसा ब्रत है कि लोकों में मन्त्रों और तन्त्रों के सहित सब ही लोकिक फल को प्रदान कर देने बाला है। जो इस ब्रत को राजा किया करता है उसको चारों (धर्म-अर्थ--काम -मोअ) पुरुषार्थो की प्राप्ति हो जाया करती है

verses.sanskrit: अब्रु वंस्त्वेष वो राजा ऋषयो मुदिताः प्रजाः । स धन्वी कवची जज्ञे तेजसा निर्दहन्निव
verses.transliteration: abru vaṃstveṣa vo rājā ṛṣayo muditāḥ prajāḥ / sa dhanvī kavacī jajñe tejasā nirdahanniva
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: इत्युक्तस्तेन राज्ञा तु तथेत्युक्त्वा महामुनिः दीक्षयामास राजानं शास्त्रोक्त नेव वर्त्मना ।

verses.transliteration: vṛttīnāmeṣa vo dātā bhaviṣyati narādhipaḥ / pṛthurvainyastadā lokānrarakṣa kṣatrapūrvajaḥ

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयाभिषिक्तानामाद्यस्स वसुधाधिपः । तस्य स्तवार्थमुत्पन्नौ निपुणौ सूतमागधौ
verses.transliteration: rājasūyābhiṣiktānāmādyassa vasudhādhipaḥ / tasya stavārthamutpannau nipuṇau sūtamāgadhau
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: अथानुज्ञाप्य राजाने वसिष्ठो भगवान् पिः फिर इन तीनों भुवनों में कुछ भी ऐसी अभीप्सित वस्तु नहीं है जिसका प्राप्त करना दुर्लेभ हो अर्थात् सभी कुछ प्राप्त हो जाया करता है। यह हैहय राजा का व्रत पैंने सरक्षेप से कह दिया है और अब जमदरिन के पुत्र परशुराम मुनि के विषय में मैं आपको कष्या बतलाऊ ? ।६२। जैमिनि
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: तेनेयं गौर्महाराज्ञा दुग्धा सस्यानि धीमता । प्रजानां वृत्तिकामानां देवैश्चर्षिगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: teneyaṃ gaurmahārājñā dugdhā sasyāni dhīmatā / prajānāṃ vṛttikāmānāṃ devaiścarṣigaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: ने कहा-इसके अनन्तर राजा सगर अपने हाथों की अञ्जलि को जोड़कर मुनिवर से कहने लगा था।९३। उसते कहा--हे भगवन् ! मैं इस' ब्रत के करने की इच्छा करता हैं सो आप भली भाति उपदेश के द्वारा इसके करने में मुझे अपनो अनुज्ञा प्रदान कीजिए ।३४। है विप्रे ! इस कम से मैं कृतार्थ
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: पितृभिर् दानवैश्चैव गन्धर्वैश्चाप्सरोगणैः । सर्पैः पुण्यजनैश्चैव पर्वतैर्वृक्षवीरुधैः
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhir dānavaiścaiva gandharvaiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ / sarpaiḥ puṇyajanaiścaiva parvatairvṛkṣavīrudhaiḥ
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: हो एया हैं -इसमें लेशमात्र भी संशय नहीं है । जब राजा के द्वारा इस रीति से प्रार्थना की गयी तो उस मुनि ने भी ऐसा ही होगा--यह कह दिया था । फिर उस मुनि ने शास्त्रोक्त मार्ग के द्वारा उसः राजां को दीक्षा दी थी और श्रेष्ठ राजा सगर बसिष्ठ मुनि केद्वारा दीक्षित होगया था ।९५-६६। फिर समस्त द्रव्यो को मंगा कर विधि-विधान के साथ उस शुभ ब्रतका समाचरण किया था । राजा ने उसी विधि से भगवान् जगन्नाथ .का पूजन किया ।६७। यथा योग्य उसको सङ्ग समाप्त करके फिर अपने गुरुदेव की आजा प्राप्त की थी और उस राजा ने उस सर्वोत्तम व्रत के करने की हढ़
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: तेषु तेषु तु पात्रेषु दुह्यमाना वसुंधरा । प्रादाद्यथेप्सि तं क्षीरं तेन प्राणानधारयन्
verses.transliteration: teṣu teṣu tu pātreṣu duhyamānā vasuṃdharā / prādādyathepsi taṃ kṣīraṃ tena prāṇānadhārayan
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: प्रतिज्ञा की थी ।६८। महामति उस नूप ने यही प्रतिज्ञा की थी कि मैं इस ब्रत को जब तक मेरा जोवन रहेगा तब तक धारण करूंगा और यत्न पूर्वक करता रहुँगा । फिर भगवान् वसिष्ठ ऋषि ने उस राजा को अपनी आज्ञा प्रदान कर दो थी ।६६। फिर अपने पीछे अनुगमन करने वाले राजा को
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: शांशपायन उवाच विस्तरेण पृथोर्जन्म कीर्त्तयस्व महाव्रत । यथा महात्मना तेन पूर्वं दुग्धा वसुंधरा
verses.transliteration: śāṃśapāyana uvāca vistareṇa pṛthorjanma kīrttayasva mahāvrata / yathā mahātmanā tena pūrvaṃ dugdhā vasuṃdharā
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.hindi: वापिस लौटाकर वसिष्ठ जी अपने आश्रम को चले गये थे ३६०   अह्माण्ड:पुराण
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवैश्च नागैश्च यथा ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सह । यक्षै राक्षसगन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिर्यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: yathā devaiśca nāgaiśca yathā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha / yakṣai rākṣasagandharvairapsarobhiryathā purā
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा च वै सूत विधिना येन येन च । तेषां पात्रविशेषांश्च दोग्धारं क्षीरमेव च
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā ca vai sūta vidhinā yena yena ca / teṣāṃ pātraviśeṣāṃśca dogdhāraṃ kṣīrameva ca

verses.hindi: वयसेव स बालोऽभूत्कमणा वृद्धसंमतः श्वा राजा स्वराज्यं निजगुरुमवजित्यारिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
verses.commentary: Sense: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu

verses.sanskrit: तथा वत्सविशेषांश्च त्वंनः प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम् । यथा क्षीरविशेषांश्च सर्वानेवानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: tathā vatsaviśeṣāṃśca tvaṃnaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām / yathā kṣīraviśeṣāṃśca sarvānevānupūrvaśaḥ

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिंश्च कारणे पाणिर्वनस्य मथितः पुरा । कुद्धैर्महर्षिभिः पूर्वैः कारणं ब्रूहि तद्धि नः
verses.transliteration: yasmiṃśca kāraṇe pāṇirvanasya mathitaḥ purā / kuddhairmaharṣibhiḥ pūrvaiḥ kāraṇaṃ brūhi taddhi naḥ

verses.hindi: अनेकरथसाहङ् गंजाश्वरथसेनिक: । सर्वेतः संवृतो राजा निश्चक्राम पुरोत्तामात्

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच कथयिष्यामि वो विप्राः पृथोर्वैन्यस्य संभवम् । एकाग्राः प्रयताश्चैव शुश्रूषध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca kathayiṣyāmi vo viprāḥ pṛthorvainyasya saṃbhavam / ekāgrāḥ prayatāścaiva śuśrūṣadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: While meditating upon the names (i.e. what names should be given to the worlds), this (name viz. bkuh) was uttered at the outset by god Brahma. As the word Bhu
