verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these diverse statements of the Earth the magnanimous noble-souled king controlled his anger and spoke to the Earth thus:—
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these diverse statements of the Earth the magnanimous noble-souled king controlled his anger and spoke to the Earth thus:—

verses.sanskrit: वत्सं स्वारोचिषं कृत्वा दुग्धा सस्यानि मेदिनी । उत्तमेन तु तेनापि दुग्धा देवानु जेन तु
verses.transliteration: vatsaṃ svārociṣaṃ kṛtvā dugdhā sasyāni medinī / uttamena tu tenāpi dugdhā devānu jena tu
verses.translation: *If anyone were to kill one or more for the sake of one whether it be himself or another, then his action is sinful.
verses.hindi: ही भुनुकम्पा से हुआ है । मैं स्वयं ही.
verses.wordMeaning: *If anyone were to kill one or more for the sake of one whether it be himself or another, then his action is sinful.
verses.commentary: Sense: *If anyone were to kill one or more for the sake of one whether it be himself or another, then his action is sinful.

verses.sanskrit: मनुं कृत्वोत्तमं वत्सं सर्वसस्यानि धीमता । पुनश्च पञ्चमे पृथ्वी तामसस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: manuṃ kṛtvottamaṃ vatsaṃ sarvasasyāni dhīmatā / punaśca pañcame pṛthvī tāmasasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: But O gentle, splendid lady, in case many flourish happily when a single person is killed, there is neither major nor minor sin in the act of his killing.
verses.hindi: ह्माण्ड पुराण बसिष्ठे तु गते राजा सगरः प्रीतमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: But O gentle, splendid lady, in case many flourish happily when a single person is killed, there is neither major nor minor sin in the act of his killing.
verses.commentary: Sense: But O gentle, splendid lady, in case many flourish happily when a single person is killed, there is neither major nor minor sin in the act of his killing.

verses.sanskrit: दुग्धेयं तामसं वत्सं कृत्वा वै बलबन्धुना । चारिष्टवस्य वै षष्ठे संप्राप्ते चान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: dugdheyaṃ tāmasaṃ vatsaṃ kṛtvā vai balabandhunā / cāriṣṭavasya vai ṣaṣṭhe saṃprāpte cāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, O Vasundhara (Earch), I will kill you for the sake of subjects, if you do not carry out my request that is conducive to the welfare of the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, O Vasundhara (Earch), I will kill you for the sake of subjects, if you do not carry out my request that is conducive to the welfare of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, O Vasundhara (Earch), I will kill you for the sake of subjects, if you do not carry out my request that is conducive to the welfare of the world.

verses.sanskrit: दुग्धा मही पुराणेन वत्सं चारिष्टवं प्रति । चाक्षुषे चापि संप्राप्ते तदा मन्वन्तरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: dugdhā mahī purāṇena vatsaṃ cāriṣṭavaṃ prati / cākṣuṣe cāpi saṃprāpte tadā manvantare punaḥ
verses.translation: If you turn your face against my behest, I will kill you presently with a single arrow. Establishing my prestige thus, I shall myself sustain the subjects.
verses.hindi: सुमतिकेशिनी चोभे विकसद्दनांबुजे । नील कु चितकेगाढ्ये सर्वाभरणभूषिते
verses.wordMeaning: If you turn your face against my behest, I will kill you presently with a single arrow. Establishing my prestige thus, I shall myself sustain the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you turn your face against my behest, I will kill you presently with a single arrow. Establishing my prestige thus, I shall myself sustain the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: दुग्धा मही पुराणेन वत्सं कृत्वा तु चाक्षुषम् । चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे ऽतीते प्राप्ते वैवस्वते पुनः
verses.transliteration: dugdhā mahī purāṇena vatsaṃ kṛtvā tu cākṣuṣam / cākṣuṣasyāntare 'tīte prāpte vaivasvate punaḥ
verses.translation: In compliance of my instructions, O the most excellent one among the up-holders of Dharma (piety), enliven and nourish the subjects perpetually. Indeed, you are capable of it. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: प्रिये सन्निहिते तस्य नित्यं प्रियहिते रते
verses.wordMeaning: In compliance of my instructions, O the most excellent one among the up-holders of Dharma (piety), enliven and nourish the subjects perpetually. Indeed, you are capable of it. There is no doubt about it.
verses.commentary: Sense: In compliance of my instructions, O the most excellent one among the up-holders of Dharma (piety), enliven and nourish the subjects perpetually. Indeed, you are capable of it. There is no doubt about it.

verses.sanskrit: वैन्येनेयं पुरा दुग्धा यथा ते कथितं मया । एतैर्दुग्धा पुरा पृथ्वी व्यतीतेष्वन्तरेषु वै
verses.transliteration: vainyeneyaṃ purā dugdhā yathā te kathitaṃ mayā / etairdugdhā purā pṛthvī vyatīteṣvantareṣu vai
verses.translation: Adopt also the status of my dathter. In that case I shall withdraw this terrific-looking arrow wliich 1 have raised up for slaying you**.
verses.hindi: फिर वह मुनि नृप सगर से आज्ञा भ्रहण करके अपने आश्रम को चले गये थे । वसिष्ठ मुनि के गमन कर जाने पर राजा के मन में परम हषं हुआ था ।५७। बह राजा फिर अयोध्या पुरी अपनी राजधानी में निब।स करता था और उसने समस्त भूमण्डल पर प्रशासन किया था । दोनों भार्याओं को भी अपने पांस में रखता था जो रूप लावण्य, शील स्वभाव और गुण गण
verses.wordMeaning: Adopt also the status of my dathter. In that case I shall withdraw this terrific-looking arrow wliich 1 have raised up for slaying you**.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adopt also the status of my dathter. In that case I shall withdraw this terrific-looking arrow wliich 1 have raised up for slaying you**.

verses.sanskrit: देवादिभिर्मनुष्यैश्च ततो भूतादिभिश्च ह । एवं सर्वेषु विज्ञेया अतीतानागतेष्विह
verses.transliteration: devādibhirmanuṣyaiśca tato bhūtādibhiśca ha / evaṃ sarveṣu vijñeyā atītānāgateṣviha
verses.translation: Thereupon the Earth who had been told thus, replied to the son of Vena:—
verses.hindi: आदि से सुसम्पन्न भीं ।५३। उस राजा सगर ने ग्राम्य विषयों के सुख का पूर्ण अपनी इच्छा के अनुरूप हो उपभोग किया था। सुमति और केशिनी ये दोनों ही विकसित कमल के समान परम सुन्दर मुखो बाली थीं ।५३। सुन्दर स्वरूप के साथ-साथ इन दोनों पत्नियों में विशाल उदारता भी थी । इनके
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon the Earth who had been told thus, replied to the son of Vena:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon the Earth who had been told thus, replied to the son of Vena:—

verses.sanskrit: देवा मन्वन्तरे स्वस्थाः पृथोस्तु शृणुत प्रजाः । पृथोस्तु पुत्रौ विक्रान्तौ जज्ञाते ऽन्तर्द्धिपाषनौ
verses.transliteration: devā manvantare svasthāḥ pṛthostu śṛṇuta prajāḥ / pṛthostu putrau vikrāntau jajñāte 'ntarddhipāṣanau
verses.translation: We have heard that at that time their sustenance was maintained with great difficulty. Every tiling was made available in this world even since the days of the son of Vena.
verses.hindi: उरोज युग्म परिपृष्ट वृत्ताकर एवं समुन्नत थे । इनके केशपाश नील वर्ण के कुञ्चित अर्थात् छल्लेदार परम सुहाबने ये। ये सभी आभरणों से विभूषित रहा करती थीं ।६०। नूतन यौवन के उद्गम में दिखलाई देने वाली नारियों में जो गुण गण हुआ करते हैं । उन सभा से ये दोनों रानिया सुसम्पन्न थीं। ये दोनों बहुत ही प्रिय भीं ओर सदा राजा के समीप में रहा करती थीं तथा नित्य ही अपने परम प्रिय स्वामी के हित कायं में रतिं रखने वाली थीं ।६१। इन दोनों के अपने आचरण राजा के प्रति इतने सुन्दर ये वे अपने हाव-भाव और चेष्टाओं के द्वारा निरन्तर ही राजा के मत को अपनी ओर
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard that at that time their sustenance was maintained with great difficulty. Every tiling was made available in this world even since the days of the son of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard that at that time their sustenance was maintained with great difficulty. Every tiling was made available in this world even since the days of the son of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डिनी हविर्धानमन्तर्द्धानाव्द्यजायत । हविर्धानात्षडाग्नेयी धिषणाजनयत्सुतान्
verses.transliteration: śikhaṇḍinī havirdhānamantarddhānāvdyajāyata / havirdhānātṣaḍāgneyī dhiṣaṇājanayatsutān
verses.translation: After adopting Caksusa Manu as the calf, lord Prthu milked plants and vegetables from the Earth on its own surface.
verses.hindi: आकर्षित रक्खा करती थीं । बह् राजा भी उन दोनों के भरण के उत्कषं से
verses.wordMeaning: After adopting Caksusa Manu as the calf, lord Prthu milked plants and vegetables from the Earth on its own surface.
verses.commentary: Sense: After adopting Caksusa Manu as the calf, lord Prthu milked plants and vegetables from the Earth on its own surface.

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीनबर्हिषं शुक्लं गयं कृष्णं प्रजाचिनौ । प्राचीनबर्हिर्भगवान्महानासीत्प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: prācīnabarhiṣaṃ śuklaṃ gayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prajācinau / prācīnabarhirbhagavānmahānāsītprajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.hindi: समर की दिग्विजय   ४११ रममाणो यथाकामं सह ताभ्यां पुरेड्बसत् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: बलश्रुततपोवीर्यैः पृथिव्यामेकराडसौ । प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास्तस्य तस्मात्प्राचीनबर्ह्यसौ
verses.transliteration: balaśrutatapovīryaiḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍasau / prācīnāgrāḥ kuśāstasya tasmātprācīnabarhyasau
verses.translation: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.hindi: ऽपि घर्मे: सततं यथा भवति भानसे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रतनयायां तु कृतदारः स वै प्रभुः । महतस्तपसः पारे सवर्णायां प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: samudratanayāyāṃ tu kṛtadāraḥ sa vai prabhuḥ / mahatastapasaḥ pāre savarṇāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.hindi: राजस्तस्यार्थकामौ तु न तथा मिधुलावपि । अलुब्धमानसोञ्च॑ च भेजे धर्ममपीडयन्
verses.wordMeaning: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: सवर्णाधत्त सामुद्री दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः । सर्वान्प्रचेतसो नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगान्
verses.transliteration: savarṇādhatta sāmudrī daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ / sarvānpracetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragān
verses.translation: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: अपृथग्धर्मचरणास्ते ऽतप्यन्त महात्तपः । दशवर्ष सहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयाः
verses.transliteration: apṛthagdharmacaraṇāste 'tapyanta mahāttapaḥ / daśavarṣa sahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ

verses.hindi: डे. रु जिरे पुत्र नहीं होता है बहे सुकत के प्रभो 'रे कैंद्वार सेक हीं पहुँचे पाता हैं और फिर पुत्रहीन के लिए देवगण सवंग कारु नहीं: खोला करके हैं और अन्दर अवेश नहीं कर पाता है। पिता 'लीरदोतों लोकों में जोर उसके फ्ति।मह स्वर्गलोक को दोनों वंशों में सत्पुत्र 'के समुंश्परंन हीने परे हो जय प्रौप्त करेगे । मैं लो सन्तान हीन होने से पुश्र लो की' जो गंतिं होती है उसको मैं निश्चय ही प्राप्त नहीं करूँगा क्योंकि तरही के लिए बह गति अतीव दुर्लभ है । इन्द्र के पद से अभिन्‍नयह् “अखण्ड और समृद्ध राज्य' भी व्यथे ही है ।२५-२७। पुण्यहीन मेरा यह सब
verses.wordMeaning: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those virtuous subjects began to sustain themselves by means of that food ever since then. It is heard that the Earth was once again milked by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे चाक्षुषसर्गवर्णनं नाम सप्तत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच सप्तम त्वथ पर्याये मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य ह । मारीचात्कश्यपाद्देवा जज्ञिरे परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde cākṣuṣasargavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca saptama tvatha paryāye manorvaivasvatasya ha / mārīcātkaśyapāddevā jajñire paramarṣayaḥ
verses.translation: It is heard chat the Earth was again milked by the Pitra by means of a Silver Vessel. The yield was Svadha and it was conducive to their immediate contentment. Yama the valorous son of Vivasvan was their calf. The power¬ ful god Antaka (the god of death) was the milkman of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: कुछ यहाँ पर निष्फलता हो ही पाह हो रहा है । यह राज्यासने जिसलप्पर मेरे पूर्वज पुरुष विराजमान हुए बे,सना व्यर्थ ही है।। हैक 7. पका
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard chat the Earth was again milked by the Pitra by means of a Silver Vessel. The yield was Svadha and it was conducive to their immediate contentment. Yama the valorous son of Vivasvan was their calf.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard chat the Earth was again milked by the Pitra by means of a Silver Vessel. The yield was Svadha and it was conducive to their immediate contentment. Yama the valorous son of Vivasvan was their calf.…

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवी रुद्राः साध्या विश्वे मरुद्गणाः । भृगव्ॐऽगिरसश्चैव ते ऽष्ठौ देवगणाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ādityā vasavī rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ / bhṛgavoṃ'girasaścaiva te 'ṣṭhau devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Mt. 25 reads here Vararud (or Vasuruci as the milk-man and N&tya Veda was the milk:
verses.hindi: तस्मादौर्वाक्षममह )मसँवा'तं - मुनिपुज्णवभ। 8 कष) 7" स थश्वक्ष्यति तद्व, करिष्ये, नात्र संशय, ।
verses.wordMeaning: Mt. 25 reads here Vararud (or Vasuruci as the milk-man and N&tya Veda was the milk:
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 25 reads here Vararud (or Vasuruci as the milk-man and N&tya Veda was the milk:

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या मरुतो रुद्रा विज्ञेयाः कश्यपात्मजाः । साध्याश्य वसवो विश्वे धर्मपुत्रास्त्रयो गणाः
verses.transliteration: ādityā maruto rudrā vijñeyāḥ kaśyapātmajāḥ / sādhyāśya vasavo viśve dharmaputrāstrayo gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: As per traditional report, the Vasudhi (the Earth) was extended here with oceans as its limits. It is glorified in. songs as Vasudhi becatise it. holds (within its bowels) riches ( Vasu).
verses.wordMeaning: As per traditional report, the Vasudhi (the Earth) was extended here with oceans as its limits. It is glorified in. songs as Vasudhi becatise it. holds (within its bowels) riches ( Vasu).
verses.commentary: Sense: As per traditional report, the Vasudhi (the Earth) was extended here with oceans as its limits. It is glorified in. songs as Vasudhi becatise it. holds (within its bowels) riches ( Vasu).

verses.sanskrit: भृगोस्तु भृगवो देवा ह्यङ्गिरस्ॐऽगिरः सुताः । वैवस्वतेंऽतरे ह्यस्मिन्नित्ये ते छन्दजा मताः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgostu bhṛgavo devā hyaṅgirasoṃ'giraḥ sutāḥ / vaivasvateṃ'tare hyasminnitye te chandajā matāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, on its attainment of the status of the daughter of the intelligent king Pfthu, the son of Vena, it came to be cited as Prthivi.
verses.hindi: वृक्षान्पुष्पफलोपेतान्विलोक्य' मुदितोऽभवत् ॥ ई ४ +++ «जिब/मेरे कोई पुत्र ही नहीं है तो इस सिहासन पर भविष्य में कौन बेडेगा अड़े दुख का डिपय है यहे भो आये किसी “दूसरे की हीं अधोनेता ममें'चला जायेग्रा  इसलिए मैं अक ओरं मुनि के समीप में जाकर सउमेसे ही त्नियों, के सहित बहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, on its attainment of the status of the daughter of the intelligent king Pfthu, the son of Vena, it came to be cited as Prthivi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, on its attainment of the status of the daughter of the intelligent king Pfthu, the son of Vena, it came to be cited as Prthivi.

verses.sanskrit: एते ऽपि च गमिष्यन्ति महान्तं कालपर्ययात् । एवं सर्गस्तु मारीचो विज्ञेयः सांप्रतः शुभः
verses.transliteration: ete 'pi ca gamiṣyanti mahāntaṃ kālaparyayāt / evaṃ sargastu mārīco vijñeyaḥ sāṃprataḥ śubhaḥ
verses.translation: W. 12b*20 give the list of peno&s who 'milked'* the eirlh an esdi Manvutara. lo a way each *Wlkhag*' represenu advancement in human dvilixation.

verses.wordMeaning: W. 12b*20 give the list of peno&s who 'milked'* the eirlh an esdi Manvutara. lo a way each *Wlkhag*' represenu advancement in human dvilixation.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 12b*20 give the list of peno&s who 'milked'* the eirlh an esdi Manvutara. lo a way each *Wlkhag*' represenu advancement in human dvilixation.

verses.sanskrit: तेजस्वी सांप्रतस्तेषामिन्द्रो नाम्ना महाबलः । अतीतानागता ये च वर्त्तन्ते सांप्रतं च ये
verses.transliteration: tejasvī sāṃpratasteṣāmindro nāmnā mahābalaḥ / atītānāgatā ye ca varttante sāṃprataṃ ca ye
verses.translation: On account of his strength, learning, penance and virility, he was the sole monarch of the Earth. His Darbha grasses had their tips towards the East.* Hence, he was known as Pracinabarhis.
verses.hindi: करता ही उचित है ।३९। बे इ? सभी मैं करू गा इसमें तत्तिक भी बिच्चार अपने मन, में किया, था भार सौंपकर फिर वव में चल दियो था ।३१-३१२। बड़ो असः पहितयों फो साथा मे लेकर रृब,पर, समारु हो गया था और बहा सँ चल दिया. ब । ,जित सायय पे. उसका रथ चता है उसका ऐसा महान घो' हुआ शा कि. मग्रे को मेषों को ग़ज़ ता की, शंका हो, गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his strength, learning, penance and virility, he was the sole monarch of the Earth. His Darbha grasses had their tips towards the East.* Hence, he was known as Pracinabarhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his strength, learning, penance and virility, he was the sole monarch of the Earth. His Darbha grasses had their tips towards the East.* Hence, he was known as Pracinabarhis.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे मन्वन्तरेद्रास्ते विज्ञेयास्तुल्यलक्षणाः । भूतभव्यभवन्नाथाः सहस्राक्षाः पुरन्दराः
verses.transliteration: sarve manvantaredrāste vijñeyāstulyalakṣaṇāḥ / bhūtabhavyabhavannāthāḥ sahasrākṣāḥ purandarāḥ
verses.translation: After a great penance, thatPraj&pati married Savarna the daughter of the ocean.
verses.hindi: कोसी में मयूरो ने एकट होकर, उसको देखा यो नेतो बालले,मयूरों को ओर संकेत करके, अपनी, इस तरह से दृष्टि करये को दिगखरात जा ,रदा था 4३४। उन बन्य एकक्षण तक तो क्पर को ओर, अपय. मुख , किये थे, और फि
verses.wordMeaning: After a great penance, thatPraj&pati married Savarna the daughter of the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a great penance, thatPraj&pati married Savarna the daughter of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: सघवन्तश्चते सर्वे शृङ्गिणो वज्रपाणयः । सर्वैः क्रतुशतेनेष्टं पृथक्छतगुणेन तु
verses.transliteration: saghavantaścate sarve śṛṅgiṇo vajrapāṇayaḥ / sarvaiḥ kratuśateneṣṭaṃ pṛthakchataguṇena tu
verses.translation: Performing piotisrites (collectively) without being separated from one another, they underwent severe penance for ten thousand years lying down within the waters of the ocean.
verses.hindi: पल्नाणत करत मैं, तशर गये मे बध भाँति के पुषं से, भर फ़बों ,खे ते. दए वृ चूताग्रपल्लवास्वदुस्त्िःब्कंटपिका, रखे.) ... +7
verses.wordMeaning: Performing piotisrites (collectively) without being separated from one another, they underwent severe penance for ten thousand years lying down within the waters of the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing piotisrites (collectively) without being separated from one another, they underwent severe penance for ten thousand years lying down within the waters of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्ये यानि सत्त्वानि गतिमन्ति ध्रुवाणि च । अभिभूयावतिष्ठन्ति धर्माद्यैः कारणैरपि
verses.transliteration: trailokye yāni sattvāni gatimanti dhruvāṇi ca / abhibhūyāvatiṣṭhanti dharmādyaiḥ kāraṇairapi
verses.translation: While they were performing the penance, the trees
verses.wordMeaning: While they were performing the penance, the trees
verses.commentary: Sense: While they were performing the penance, the trees

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा तपसा बुद्ध्या बलश्रुतपराक्रमैः । भूतभव्यभवन्नाथा यथा ते प्रभविष्णवः
verses.transliteration: tejasā tapasā buddhyā balaśrutaparākramaiḥ / bhūtabhavyabhavannāthā yathā te prabhaviṣṇavaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vp. I 14.4. This speciality u attributed u> the kiog'i perforaiance of many sacrifices.
verses.hindi: उन्मत्तणिखिसारं गकृजत्पक्षिंगकाच्तित म् गायढिदयाध रबधूमीतिकासखुमत्नोहूरम् । दंससारसचज्राहककाराण्डवशुक्रादिभिः। ..«
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vp. I 14.4. This speciality u attributed u> the kiog'i perforaiance of many sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vp. I 14.4. This speciality u attributed u> the kiog'i perforaiance of many sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत । भूतभव्यभवद्ध्येत त्समृतं लोकत्रयं द्विजैः
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bruvato me nibodhata / bhūtabhavyabhavaddhyeta tsamṛtaṃ lokatrayaṃ dvijaiḥ
verses.translation: This happened when the C&ksu$a Manvantara passed by. The whole finnament became enveloped by the trees and hence the wind was unable to blow.
verses.wordMeaning: This happened when the C&ksu$a Manvantara passed by. The whole finnament became enveloped by the trees and hence the wind was unable to blow.
verses.commentary: Sense: This happened when the C&ksu$a Manvantara passed by. The whole finnament became enveloped by the trees and hence the wind was unable to blow.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोको ऽयं स्मृतो भूतमन्तरिक्षं भवत्स्मृतम् । भव्यं स्मृतं दिवं ह्येतत्तेषां वक्ष्यामि साधनम्
verses.transliteration: bhūrloko 'yaṃ smṛto bhūtamantarikṣaṃ bhavatsmṛtam / bhavyaṃ smṛtaṃ divaṃ hyetatteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi sādhanam
verses.translation: This fair-complexioned daughter of the trees has become the crest-jewel all women. This girl has been held (and nurtured) in the womb by me, as I had already known the future events.
verses.hindi: शनैः परिवहन्मंदमारुतापूर्णेदिङ मुखम् बह अरण्य वृक्षों से घिरा हुआ था जिनमें अनेक अम्लान पुष्प थैं--
verses.wordMeaning: This fair-complexioned daughter of the trees has become the crest-jewel all women. This girl has been held (and nurtured) in the womb by me, as I had already known the future events.
verses.commentary: Sense: This fair-complexioned daughter of the trees has become the crest-jewel all women. This girl has been held (and nurtured) in the womb by me, as I had already known the future events.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायता लोकनामानि ब्रह्मणाग्रे विभाषितम् । भूरिति व्याहृतं पूर्वं भूर्लोको ऽयमभूत्तदा
verses.transliteration: dhyāyatā lokanāmāni brahmaṇāgre vibhāṣitam / bhūriti vyāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūrloko 'yamabhūttadā
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: पन्नों की छाया से सब वृक्ष संयुत थे।३६। वहाँ पर सभी ओर कानों को श्रवण करने में परम प्रिय लगाने बाली आम्र बूं के कोमल पत्रों के खाने से स्निग्ध कण्ठों वाली कोमलों को मधुर ध्वनि थी इससे वह वल सुष्ट हो रहा था ।३७। उसमें सभी ऋतुओं के कुसुम खिल रहे थे जिन पर भ्रमर
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: भू सत्तायां स्मृतो धातुस्तथासौ लोकदर्शने । भूतत्वाद्दर्शनाच्चैव भूर्लोको ऽयमभूत्ततः
verses.transliteration: bhū sattāyāṃ smṛto dhātustathāsau lokadarśane / bhūtatvāddarśanāccaiva bhūrloko 'yamabhūttataḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: गुळ्जार करते हुए झल रहे थे । बहुत सो लताएँ ब्रूमों से' लिपटी' हुई थीं जो अपने ही प्रमूनों के गुच्छों के भार से नीचे की ओर झुक रही थीं ।३्। नह महारण्य ऐसा ही सुषमा सम्पन्न वा कि वहाँ के वृक्षों पर सैकड़ों वानरों के शुण्ड बैठे हुए ये और उस वन में उन्मत्त शिखी- सारङ्ग भ्रमण कर रहे थे तथा पक्षियों का कल कु जन चहं ओर हो रहा था ।३६। उस बन में विद्या- घरों की बधूटियां गीत गा रही थीं जिससे बह वन मभ का हरण करने वाला हो रहा था । उस परम गहन बन में किस्नर-किस्तरियों के जोड़ें सूझ्चरण करते हुए शोभित हो रहे ये ।४०। उस बन गें बहुत से सरोवर थें
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: अतो ऽयं प्रथमो लोको भूतत्वाद्भूर्द्वजैः स्मृतः । भूते ऽस्मिन्भवदित्युक्तं द्वितीयं ब्रह्मणा पुनः
verses.transliteration: ato 'yaṃ prathamo loko bhūtatvādbhūrdvajaiḥ smṛtaḥ / bhūte 'sminbhavadityuktaṃ dvitīyaṃ brahmaṇā punaḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: जिनसे चारों ओर बन घिरा हुआ था जिनका उपान्त सुस्वरों वाले हंस: सारस-चक्रवाक-कारण्डव और शुक आदि से समाबृत हो रहा था॥४१। उन सरोबरों में कमल-कल्द्वार-कुमुद और उत्पल बहुत अधिक परिमाण में बिक- सित हो रहे थे । वहाँ पर मन्द मारुत के परिवहन से सभी दिशायें पूरित
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: भवदित्यत्पद्यमाने काले शब्दो ऽयमुच्यते । भवनात्तु भुवल्लोको निरुत्तया हि निरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhavadityatpadyamāne kāle śabdo 'yamucyate / bhavanāttu bhuvalloko niruttayā hi nirucyate

verses.hindi: आससादाश्रमोपांतं महकेर्भावितास्मनः ॥।४५' स श्रृत्वा मुनिजिष्येभ्यः कृतनित्यक्रियादरम्†

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षं भवत्तस्माद्द्वितीयो लोक उच्यते । उत्पन्ने तु तथा लोके द्वितीये ब्रह्मणा पुनः
verses.transliteration: antarikṣaṃ bhavattasmāddvitīyo loka ucyate / utpanne tu tathā loke dvitīye brahmaṇā punaḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: भव्येति व्याहृतं पश्चाद्भव्यो लोकस्ततो ऽभवत् । अनागते भव्य इत शब्द एष विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: bhavyeti vyāhṛtaṃ paścādbhavyo lokastato 'bhavat / anāgate bhavya ita śabda eṣa vibhāvyate

verses.hindi: मुनिमध्ये समासीनसूषियृ देः समन्वितम् । ननाम शिरसा राजा भार्याभ्यां सहितो. मुदा
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्भव्यो ह्यसौ लोको नामतस्त्रिदिवं स्मृतम् । भूरितीयं स्मृता भूमिरन्तरिक्षं भुवः स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādbhavyo hyasau loko nāmatastridivaṃ smṛtam / bhūritīyaṃ smṛtā bhūmirantarikṣaṃ bhuvaḥ smṛtam

verses.sanskrit: दिवं स्मृतं तथा भव्यं त्रलोक्यस्यैष निर्णयः । त्रैलोक्ययुक्तैर्व्याहारैस्तिस्रो व्याहृतयो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: divaṃ smṛtaṃ tathā bhavyaṃ tralokyasyaiṣa nirṇayaḥ / trailokyayuktairvyāhāraistisro vyāhṛtayo 'bhavan
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: अष्येपादयादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयित्वा महामुनि. । इस प्रकार के गुणों से सुसम्पन्न उस तपोवन का अधिगाहन कः र के दरारा गमन करते हुए नृप सगर को परमाधिक प्रसन्नता प्राप्त हुई थी ।४३। उपशासत आशय के मण्डल में परचकर फिर श्री सम्पन्न वह राजा अपने यान से नीचे उतर गया चा ।४४। उस नृप ने सारथि से कहा था कि
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: नाथ इत्येष धातुर्वै धातुज्ञैः पालने स्मृतः । यस्माद्भूतस्य लोकस्य भव्यस्य भवतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nātha ityeṣa dhāturvai dhātujñaiḥ pālane smṛtaḥ / yasmādbhūtasya lokasya bhavyasya bhavatastathā
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: इन अश्यों को विश्राम करने दो और फिर भावितात्मा महधि के आश्रम के सपान्त में पहुँच गया या ।४५। उस राजा ने यह मुनि के शिष्यों रो सुल लिया था कि मूनिवर नित्य क्रिया कर चुके हैं तभी उस विनीत आत्मा बाले. मुप ने मुनि के दर्शन करते के लिए उस आश्रम में प्रवेश किया था।
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: लोकत्रयस्य नाथास्ते तस्मादिन्द्राद्विजैः स्मृताः । प्रधानभूता देवेन्द्रा गुणभूतास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: lokatrayasya nāthāste tasmādindrādvijaiḥ smṛtāḥ / pradhānabhūtā devendrā guṇabhūtāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: ।४६। थे भद्गाभुनोंद्र अनेक भुनियों के मध्य में विराजमान थो और चारों ओर ऋषियों के समुदाय बड़ाँ पर सस्थित थो । उसी समय में राजाने आार्याओं के साथ बड़ों दवी प्रमन्नता से मुनिवर के चरणों में शिर क्ुकाकर अंणाम किया श्रा ।४७ जब राजा ने प्रणाम किया या तो प्रताप बस और्व॑ चषि ने बड़े प्रन से दोतों पत्तियों कै सहित उस नप को 'बैठ जाओ! यह आज्ञा दी थो ।४८। उन भद्दामुति ने समागत उस अतिथि तपवा भारतीय मंस्कृति की मयदिवुलारता से अस्य॑ पाडा आदि से भलीमाँति' अर्चन करके भाय के सहित उस नप को बन्य आतिथ्य सत्कारं से
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु ये देवा यज्ञभाजो भवन्ति हि । यज्ञगन्धर्वरक्षांसि पिशाचो रगमानुषाः
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣu ye devā yajñabhājo bhavanti hi / yajñagandharvarakṣāṃsi piśāco ragamānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: महिमानः स्मृता ह्येते देवेन्द्राणां तु सर्वशः । देवेन्द्रा गुरवो नाथा राजानः पितरो हि ते
verses.transliteration: mahimānaḥ smṛtā hyete devendrāṇāṃ tu sarvaśaḥ / devendrā guravo nāthā rājānaḥ pitaro hi te
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: अपि धर्मेभ सकज्रा: प्रजास्त्वं परिरक्षसि ! अपि जेतुः त्रिवर्ग स्वमुयाये: सम्यगीहसे ।
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षन्तीमाः प्रजा ह्येते धर्मेणेह सुरोत्तमाः । इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं देवेन्द्राणां समासतः
verses.transliteration: rakṣantīmāḥ prajā hyete dharmeṇeha surottamāḥ / ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ devendrāṇāṃ samāsataḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: दिष्ट्या च सकलं राज्यं त्वया धर्मेण रक्ष्यते
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षीन्संप्रवक्ष्यामि सांप्रतं ये दिवं श्रिताः । गाधिजः कौशिको धीमान्विश्वामित्रो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: saptarṣīnsaṃpravakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ ye divaṃ śritāḥ / gādhijaḥ kauśiko dhīmānviśvāmitro mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: धर्म एव स्थितियां तेषो नास्त्यत्र विप्लवः । न तं रक्षति कि धर्म: स्वयं येना! नसः 4४

verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवो जमदग्निश्च ह्यौर्वपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । बृहस्पतिसुतश्चापि भरद्वाजो महा यशाः
verses.transliteration: bhārgavo jamadagniśca hyaurvaputraḥ pratāpavān / bṛhaspatisutaścāpi bharadvājo mahā yaśāḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: औतथ्यो गौतमो विद्वाञ्शरद्वान्नाम धार्मिकः । स्वायंभुवो ऽत्रिर्भगवान्ब्रह्मकोशः सपञ्चमः
verses.transliteration: autathyo gautamo vidvāñśaradvānnāma dhārmikaḥ / svāyaṃbhuvo 'trirbhagavānbrahmakośaḥ sapañcamaḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: तैमिनिरव्ाच- एबसुक्तस्तु मुनिना सगरो राजसः क्रतां जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्राह तं मधुर वचः सके अनन्तर, आतिथ्य और् विश्वान्ति हो. जाने परं आगे विरा मान ऋषि,को प्रण/म्त करते के पश्चात् औव॑ महामुनि ने राजा से धौरे-धौरे मृदु बचत कहे थे ।५०। है राड़न ! आपके राज्य में बाहिर और भीतर सब प्रकार, का कुशल-क्षे मु:तो है,न ? और तो,घर्मके साथ अपनी, मस्तर्क प्रज।
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठो वसिष्ठपुत्रस्तु वसुमांल्लोकविश्रुतः । वत्सरः काश्यपश्यैव सप्तैते साधुसंमताः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭho vasiṣṭhaputrastu vasumāṃllokaviśrutaḥ / vatsaraḥ kāśyapaśyaiva saptaite sādhusaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: कर, ही रहे हैं न? ।५९ आप तीनों बंगों को जीतने के लिए गरा अच्छी तरह से अमलाय करते हैं त,?
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्तर्षयश्योक्ता वर्त्तन्ते सांप्रतेंऽतरे । इक्ष्वाकुश्च नृगश्चैव धृष्टः शर्यातिरेब च
verses.transliteration: ete saptarṣayaśyoktā varttante sāṃprateṃ'tare / ikṣvākuśca nṛgaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireba ca
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: नू.पश्नो्ठ.! यह तो बड़े ही विज्ञय प्राप्त क्र ली है.। यह भी बड़े हो प्रसन्नता है कि आत धर्म सम्पूर्ण .राउय की सुरक्षा किया करते हैँ।५३। जितकी धर्म में ही स्थिति होती. है उत्तकों मडालोक् में, कोई ,भो..विप्लंत, नहरी: हुआ करता है,। जब बह शर्म: जिसके दरा अभिरज्षित होता है तो क्या बढ़ स्वयं हो उसकी रक्षा नहीं किया करता है ? अवश्य घर्मे उसकी खुरक्षित होकर रक्षा,करता है
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: नरिष्यन्तश्चविख्यातो नाभागो दिष्ट एव च । करूषश्च पृषध्रश्च पांशुश्चनवमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nariṣyantaścavikhyāto nābhāgo diṣṭa eva ca / karūṣaśca pṛṣadhraśca pāṃśuścanavamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: ।५४ यह तो पू मैं ही गुत लिया... कि आपके सम्पण, ब्सुश्रा "र बिजय प्राप्त करके अपने वल. के साथ धप्रतीक अपनी, नगरी में प्राप्त हो गये हैं ।५५। राजाओं का ठो गरही पूरमश्रो छ धर्म होता है कि इनके द्वारा अपनी प्रजा का परिपालन किया जाता है। ऐसे ही न,प॒ निश्चय ही इस
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यैते नव पुत्राः सुधार्मिकाः । कीर्तिता वै तथा ह्येते सप्तमं चैतदन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: manorvaivasvatasyaite nava putrāḥ sudhārmikāḥ / kīrtitā vai tathā hyete saptamaṃ caitadantaram
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: लोक में और परलोक में मुखी हुआ करते हैं ।५६। हिमे राजा आप हैं फिर राज्य के भरण को, त्यागे करके” हसे समय मैं मेरे; समीप में समागत हए हैं ओर दोनों परिनियों को भी सोथ में लेकर आये है।। राजन् ! क्या कारण है मे !'आफइसः आममन को जो भी कारण ज्हो बतलाइसे जमिनी मनि -ने, कहा --उस' सुनि के द्वारा;डस - रीकि से -राज़ा से हुछा था
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष ह मया पादो द्वितीयः कथितोद्विजाः । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च भूयः किं कथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa ha mayā pādo dvitīyaḥ kathitodvijāḥ / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca bhūyaḥ kiṃ kathayāmyaham
verses.translation: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.hindi: उस परम श्र क्च नउ सगर, ने; दोनों करों.को जोड़कर उनसे मश्चुर वचर्तों में निवेदन किया था।।५द। , EE + FY
verses.wordMeaning: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half of your splendour and with half of mine, the scholarly Prajapati, Dak will be bom of her.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे मन्वन्तरवर्णनं नामाष्टात्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः समाप्तो ऽयं ब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणपूर्वभागः श्रीगणेशाय नमः अथ ब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणमध्यभागप्रारम्भः । शांशपायन उवाच पादः शेक्तो द्वितीयस्तु अनुषङ्गेन नस्त्वया । तृतीयं विस्तरात्पादं सोपोद्धातं प्रवर्त्तय
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde manvantaravarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāpto 'yaṃ brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇapūrvabhāgaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ atha brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇamadhyabhāgaprārambhaḥ / śāṃśapāyana uvāca pādaḥ śekto dvitīyastu anuṣaṅgena nastvayā / tṛtīyaṃ vistarātpādaṃ sopoddhātaṃ pravarttaya
verses.translation: "I shall narrate to you all the Third Pdda ( called ) Upodghdta in details and in aggregate, O Brahmanas. Under- stand it even as I recite.
verses.hindi: त्वं मे गुरुः सुहृद्देवं बंधमित्रं च केवलम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall narrate to you all the Third Pdda ( called ) Upodghdta in details and in aggregate, O Brahmanas. Under- stand it even as I recite.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall narrate to you all the Third Pdda ( called ) Upodghdta in details and in aggregate, O Brahmanas. Under- stand it even as I recite.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच कीर्त्तयिष्ये तृतीयं वः सोपोद्धातं सविस्तरम् । पादं समुच्चयाद्विप्रा गदतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca kīrttayiṣye tṛtīyaṃ vaḥ sopoddhātaṃ savistaram / pādaṃ samuccayādviprā gadato me nibodhata
verses.translation: Listen to the present creative activity of the noble- souled Vaivasvata Manu in details and in the proper order, O Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: राजा सगर ने कहा-हे महषें ! मेरे यहाँ सर्वत्र कुशल है--इसमें तो कुछ भो संशय नहीं है जिस मेरे विषय में भागंव श्रेष्ठ आप शमका
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to the present creative activity of the noble- souled Vaivasvata Manu in details and in the proper order, O Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the present creative activity of the noble- souled Vaivasvata Manu in details and in the proper order, O Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: मनोर्वैवस्वतस्येमं सांप्रतं तु महात्मनः । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च निसर्गं शृणुत द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: manorvaivasvatasyemaṃ sāṃprataṃ tu mahātmanaḥ / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca nisargaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The seven great sages, who were the initiators of creation formerly in the first Manvantara namely Svayambhuva Manvantara, passed away. When the Cak$u$a Manvantara was over and the Vaivasvata Manvantara set in, owing to the curse of Lord Siva, there was the re-birth of Dak§a and those (spiri-
verses.hindi: अनुध्यान करने वाले विद्यमान हैं । जिसको पूवं में ही शस्त्रास्त्रों के प्रयोग करने की भली भात शिक्षा-दीक्षा दे दी गयी है वह मैं इस समय समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: The seven great sages, who were the initiators of creation formerly in the first Manvantara namely Svayambhuva Manvantara, passed away. When the Cak$u$a Manvantara was over and the Vaivasvata Manvantara set in, owing to the curse of Lord Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven great sages, who were the initiators of creation formerly in the first Manvantara namely Svayambhuva Manvantara, passed away. When the Cak$u$a Manvantara was over and the Vaivasvata Manvantara set in, owing to the curse of Lord Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्युगैकस प्तत्या संख्यातं पूर्वमेव तु । मह देवगणैश्चैव ऋषिभिर्दानवैस्सह
verses.transliteration: caturyugaikasa ptatyā saṃkhyātaṃ pūrvameva tu / maha devagaṇaiścaiva ṛṣibhirdānavaissaha
verses.translation: O excellent one! Please narrate (explain) to us how the seven sages, who were previously born as mental sons of god Brahma, were made his own sons (again by Brahma).
verses.hindi: १७   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण शत्रुओं के विनिग्रह करने में कैसे असमथ हो सकता है ।१-२। आप तो मेरे गुरुदेव हैं- सुहृत्-देव-वन्धु और मित्र हैं। केवल आप ही मेरे सब कुछ हैं। मैं तो आपके अतिरिक्त अन्य किसी को भी मेरा पिता नहीं जानता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one! Please narrate (explain) to us how the seven sages, who were previously born as mental sons of god Brahma, were made his own sons (again by Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one! Please narrate (explain) to us how the seven sages, who were previously born as mental sons of god Brahma, were made his own sons (again by Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: पितृगन्धर्वयक्षैश्च रक्षोभूतमहोरगैः । मानुषैः पशुभिश्चैव पक्षिभिः स्थावरैः सह
verses.transliteration: pitṛgandharvayakṣaiśca rakṣobhūtamahoragaiḥ / mānuṣaiḥ paśubhiścaiva pakṣibhiḥ sthāvaraiḥ saha
verses.translation: There were the eight sons of Brahma1 — viz. Bhrgu, Angiras, Marici, Pulastya, Pulalia, Kratu, Atri and Vasistha.
verses.hindi: आपके द्वारा उपदेश किये गये अस्त्र से ही मैंने सव नृपों पर विजय प्राप्त की है जिनके स्मरण से ही पूर्ण विजय मेरी हुई है यह आपके ही तप की शक्ति है। यहाँ पर उसका एक देश भी विस्मय देने वाला दिखलाई देता है ।४-६। देखिये, मृग का शिशु बचपन से ही सिंहासन पर समीप में आकर
verses.wordMeaning: There were the eight sons of Brahma1 — viz. Bhrgu, Angiras, Marici, Pulastya, Pulalia, Kratu, Atri and Vasistha.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were the eight sons of Brahma1 — viz. Bhrgu, Angiras, Marici, Pulastya, Pulalia, Kratu, Atri and Vasistha.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वादिकं भविष्यान्तमाख्यानैर्बहुभिर्युतम् । वक्ष्ये वैवस्वतं सर्गं नमस्कृत्य विवस्वते
verses.transliteration: manvādikaṃ bhaviṣyāntamākhyānairbahubhiryutam / vakṣye vaivasvataṃ sargaṃ namaskṛtya vivasvate
verses.translation: Yajurveda endowed with (relevant) metres brilli- ant with Omkara as its mouth (face) was stationed here along with the Suktas, Brahmanas and Mantras and intermingled with the Arthas (objects, purposes) of the Yajna.
verses.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन् ! धीरे-धीरे जल पी रहा है ओर बह आपके इस तपोवन में बिल्कुल ही निःशन्जु अर्थात् भय से रहित है
verses.wordMeaning: Yajurveda endowed with (relevant) metres brilli- ant with Omkara as its mouth (face) was stationed here along with the Suktas, Brahmanas and Mantras and intermingled with the Arthas (objects, purposes) of the Yajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yajurveda endowed with (relevant) metres brilli- ant with Omkara as its mouth (face) was stationed here along with the Suktas, Brahmanas and Mantras and intermingled with the Arthas (objects, purposes) of the Yajna.

verses.sanskrit: आद्ये मन्वन्तरे ऽतीताः सर्गप्रावर्त्तकास्तु ये । स्वायंभुवेंऽतरे पूर्वं सप्तासन्ये महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: ādye manvantare 'tītāḥ sargaprāvarttakāstu ye / svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare pūrvaṃ saptāsanye maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Samaveda endowed with relevant metres and with
verses.wordMeaning: Samaveda endowed with relevant metres and with
verses.commentary: Sense: Samaveda endowed with relevant metres and with

verses.sanskrit: चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे ऽतीते प्राप्ते वैवस्वते पुनः । दक्षस्य च ऋषीणां च भृग्वादीनां महौजसाम्
verses.transliteration: cākṣuṣasyāntare 'tīte prāpte vaivasvate punaḥ / dakṣasya ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca bhṛgvādīnāṃ mahaujasām
verses.translation: Apart from the discrepancy in number (here actually eight sons of Brahma are enumerated instead of seven under Sap tarsia), the names of the Saptar.sis of this Manvantara as given Supra I. ii 38. 26-29 are different viz. Visvamitra, Jamadagni, Bharadvaja, Saradvana (of Gautama gotra), Atri alias Brahma Kosa, Vasuman (son of Vasi§tha), Vatsara (son of Kafyapa). V. 30 thereof states: these seven sages enumerated now exist in the present (Vaivasvata) Manvantara (ete Saptar$aya$cokta variant* s&mpraie'ntare / )
verses.wordMeaning: Apart from the discrepancy in number (here actually eight sons of Brahma are enumerated instead of seven under Sap tarsia), the names of the Saptar.sis of this Manvantara as given Supra I. ii 38. 26-29 are different viz. Visvamitra, Jamadagni, Bharadvaja,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Apart from the discrepancy in number (here actually eight sons of Brahma are enumerated instead of seven under Sap tarsia), the names of the Saptar.sis of this Manvantara as given Supra I. ii 38. 26-29 are different viz. Visvamitra, Jamadagni, Bharadvaja,…

verses.sanskrit: शापान्महेश्वरस्यासीत्प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनाम् । भूयः सप्तर्षयस्त्वेवमुत्पन्नाः सप्त मानसाः
verses.transliteration: śāpānmaheśvarasyāsītprādurbhāvo mahātmanām / bhūyaḥ saptarṣayastvevamutpannāḥ sapta mānasāḥ
verses.translation: The AV consists of two sets of Mantras: the auspicious one
verses.wordMeaning: The AV consists of two sets of Mantras: the auspicious one
verses.commentary: Sense: The AV consists of two sets of Mantras: the auspicious one

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रत्वे कल्पिताश्चैव स्वयमेव स्वयंभुवा । प्रजासंतानकृद्भिस्तैरुत्पदद्भिर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: putratve kalpitāścaiva svayameva svayaṃbhuvā / prajāsaṃtānakṛdbhistairutpadadbhirmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The following ( technical details about thfe recitation of Veda) were present (in their bodily forms): Lakfand (use of a cognate word for another), Vistara (extension, elongation),
verses.wordMeaning: The following ( technical details about thfe recitation of Veda) were present (in their bodily forms): Lakfand (use of a cognate word for another), Vistara (extension, elongation),
verses.commentary: Sense: The following ( technical details about thfe recitation of Veda) were present (in their bodily forms): Lakfand (use of a cognate word for another), Vistara (extension, elongation),

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रवर्त्तितः सर्गो यथापूर्वं यथाक्रमम् । तेषां प्रसूतिं वक्ष्यामि विशुद्धज्ञानकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ pravarttitaḥ sargo yathāpūrvaṃ yathākramam / teṣāṃ prasūtiṃ vakṣyāmi viśuddhajñānakarmaṇām
verses.translation: (The following divinities were present in person there) The goddess Ila (the Earth) of brilliant form, the quarters and the lords of quarters, celestial girls ( devakanyd ), wives and mothers of gods.
verses.hindi: न क्वापि दृश्यते ब्रह्म स्त्वामृते भुवि दुलेभा
verses.wordMeaning: (The following divinities were present in person there) The goddess Ila (the Earth) of brilliant form, the quarters and the lords of quarters, celestial girls ( devakanyd ), wives and mothers of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The following divinities were present in person there) The goddess Ila (the Earth) of brilliant form, the quarters and the lords of quarters, celestial girls ( devakanyd ), wives and mothers of gods.

verses.sanskrit: समासव्यासयोगाभ्यां यथावदनुपूर्वशः । येषामन्वयसंभूतैलर् एको ऽयं सचराचरः । पुनरापूरितः सर्वो ग्रहनक्षत्रमण्डितः
verses.transliteration: samāsavyāsayogābhyāṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ / yeṣāmanvayasaṃbhūtailar eko 'yaṃ sacarācaraḥ / punarāpūritaḥ sarvo grahanakṣatramaṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: All these, in their beautiful embodied forms arrived at the sacrifice when god Varuna assuming a physical body was performing the sacrifice. They were all endowed with beauty and splendour.
verses.hindi: वह अत्यन्त दुबली हरिणी भी अत्यधिक विश्राम के साथ अपने स्तन
verses.wordMeaning: All these, in their beautiful embodied forms arrived at the sacrifice when god Varuna assuming a physical body was performing the sacrifice. They were all endowed with beauty and splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these, in their beautiful embodied forms arrived at the sacrifice when god Varuna assuming a physical body was performing the sacrifice. They were all endowed with beauty and splendour.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कथं सप्तर्षयः पूर्वमुत्पन्नाः सप्त मनसाः । पुत्रत्वे कल्पिताश्चैव तन्नो निगद सत्तम
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ saptarṣayaḥ pūrvamutpannāḥ sapta manasāḥ / putratve kalpitāścaiva tanno nigada sattama
verses.translation: On seeing them the semen of the self-born lord
verses.hindi: को पिला रही है । हरिण मृग छोना के गण्डों को भङ्ग के अग्रनाग से खुजला रहा है ।८। नव प्रसूता अर्थात् हाल ही में श्रसव करने दाली हरिणी को मारकर बृत्ति के लिए दूसरे दन में बही व्याप्नो आप के इस तपस्या के आश्रम में उसके शिशुओं के पोषण कर रही है ।६। एक सिह एक हाथी के
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them the semen of the self-born lord
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them the semen of the self-born lord

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच पूर्वं सप्तर्षयः प्रोक्ता ये वै स्वायंभुवेंऽतरे । मनोरन्तरमासाद्य पुनर्वैवस्वतं किल
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca pūrvaṃ saptarṣayaḥ proktā ye vai svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare / manorantaramāsādya punarvaivasvataṃ kila
verses.translation: Pitamaha held it with both the hands and performed the Homa. He held it by means of the Sruva (sacrificial ladle) and performed the Homa as it oozed out. He performed the Homa chanting the Mantras ( simultaneously).
verses.wordMeaning: Pitamaha held it with both the hands and performed the Homa. He held it by means of the Sruva (sacrificial ladle) and performed the Homa as it oozed out. He performed the Homa chanting the Mantras ( simultaneously).
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitamaha held it with both the hands and performed the Homa. He held it by means of the Sruva (sacrificial ladle) and performed the Homa as it oozed out. He performed the Homa chanting the Mantras ( simultaneously).

verses.sanskrit: भवाभिशाप संविद्धा अप्राप्तास्ते तदा तपः । उपपन्ना जने लोके सकृदागमनास्तु त
verses.transliteration: bhavābhiśāpa saṃviddhā aprāptāste tadā tapaḥ / upapannā jane loke sakṛdāgamanāstu ta
verses.translation: Then Prajapati (Lord of the subjects) created. the collection of Bhtitas (Living beings or Elements). From his lower tejas (Brilliance), the Taijasa Brahman was born in the worlds.
verses.hindi: पीछे आक्रमण करके जव यहाँ पर मा गया है तो प्रवेश करते ही अनुसरण करते हुए वे दोनों सिंह और गज आपके ही भय से एक हो स्थान में स्थित हो रहे हैं ।१०। जो स्वभाव से ही आपस में शत्रु होते है वे सभी नकुल- मूषक-मार्जार-मयूर-शश-सपं-वृक-सूकर--ज्ञादू ल--शरभ--प्लव जू म--
verses.wordMeaning: Then Prajapati (Lord of the subjects) created. the collection of Bhtitas (Living beings or Elements). From his lower tejas (Brilliance), the Taijasa Brahman was born in the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Prajapati (Lord of the subjects) created. the collection of Bhtitas (Living beings or Elements). From his lower tejas (Brilliance), the Taijasa Brahman was born in the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुः सर्वे सदान्योन्यं जनलोके महार्षयः । एत एव महाभागा वरुणे वितते ऽध्वरे
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ sarve sadānyonyaṃ janaloke mahārṣayaḥ / eta eva mahābhāgā varuṇe vitate 'dhvare
verses.translation: (Defective Text) The Apyatva (Liquidity) is possible by means of Tamas, Sattva and Rajas. He held his own semen in the Ajyasthdli (Ghee-pan) and performed the Homa.
verses.hindi: खुगाल-- गवय--गो हरिण ओर महिष ये सभी एक-एक के शत्रु होते हुए भी इस बन में अपने स्वाभाविक बेर को भूलकर परस्पर मंत्री के भाव को प्राप्त हो गये हैं ।११-१२। इस प्रकार की यह आपकी ही शक्ति है जो लोगों को बड़ा ही विस्मय देने वाली है । है ब्रह्मन् ! आपके बिना लोक में इस
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Text) The Apyatva (Liquidity) is possible by means of Tamas, Sattva and Rajas. He held his own semen in the Ajyasthdli (Ghee-pan) and performed the Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Text) The Apyatva (Liquidity) is possible by means of Tamas, Sattva and Rajas. He held his own semen in the Ajyasthdli (Ghee-pan) and performed the Homa.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वयं प्रसूयामश्चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः । पितामहात्मजाः सर्वे तन्नः श्रेयो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sarve vayaṃ prasūyāmaścākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ / pitāmahātmajāḥ sarve tannaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: When the semen was once poured into the fire by way of Homa, Kavi came out of the flame. On seeing him coming out after splitting the flame, Hiranyagarbha (i.e. Brahma) said — "You are Bhrgu". Since it was said, so he became Bhrgu.
verses.hindi: भूमि पर ऐसी दुर्लभ शक्ति अन्यत्र कहीं पर भी दिखलाई नहीं देती है
verses.wordMeaning: When the semen was once poured into the fire by way of Homa, Kavi came out of the flame. On seeing him coming out after splitting the flame, Hiranyagarbha (i.e. Brahma) said — "You are Bhrgu". Since it was said, so he became Bhrgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the semen was once poured into the fire by way of Homa, Kavi came out of the flame. On seeing him coming out after splitting the flame, Hiranyagarbha (i.e. Brahma) said — "You are Bhrgu". Since it was said, so he became Bhrgu.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः । स्वायंभुवेन्तरे प्राप्ताः सृष्ट्यर्थं ते भवेन तु
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu te sarve cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ / svāyaṃbhuventare prāptāḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ te bhavena tu
verses.translation: Hence Bhrgus are Varunas (those pertaining to the race of Varuna). That lord is his child.
verses.hindi: रिपुओं को ध्वस्त करके अपने राज्य में प्राप्त हुआ हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: Hence Bhrgus are Varunas (those pertaining to the race of Varuna). That lord is his child.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence Bhrgus are Varunas (those pertaining to the race of Varuna). That lord is his child.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञिरे ह पुनस्ते वै जनलोकादिहागताः । देवस्य महतो यज्ञे वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: jajñire ha punaste vai janalokādihāgatāḥ / devasya mahato yajñe vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum
verses.translation: 'It was I who bestowed the semen upon thee* Hence, let this second one be my (son).' "Let it be so", thus Sadasasfiati (the fire-god) was replied to by Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: 'It was I who bestowed the semen upon thee* Hence, let this second one be my (son).' "Let it be so", thus Sadasasfiati (the fire-god) was replied to by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'It was I who bestowed the semen upon thee* Hence, let this second one be my (son).' "Let it be so", thus Sadasasfiati (the fire-god) was replied to by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो जुह्वतः शुक्रमग्रौ पूर्वं प्रजेप्सया । ऋषयो जज्ञिरे दीर्घे द्वितीयमिति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo juhvataḥ śukramagrau pūrvaṃ prajepsayā / ṛṣayo jajñire dīrghe dvitīyamiti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: (The fourth sage) was born with overspreading hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulastya. (The fifth sage) was born with long hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulaha.
verses.wordMeaning: (The fourth sage) was born with overspreading hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulastya. (The fifth sage) was born with long hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulaha.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The fourth sage) was born with overspreading hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulastya. (The fifth sage) was born with long hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulaha.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वङ्गिरा मरीचिश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । अत्रिश्चैव वसिष्ठश्च ह्यष्टौ ते ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvaṅgirā marīciśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / atriścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca hyaṣṭau te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: (The sixth sage) was bom from among the Vasus artd was himself self-controlled and master of Vasu (wealth).
verses.wordMeaning: (The sixth sage) was bom from among the Vasus artd was himself self-controlled and master of Vasu (wealth).
verses.commentary: Sense: (The sixth sage) was bom from among the Vasus artd was himself self-controlled and master of Vasu (wealth).

verses.sanskrit: तथास्य वितते यज्ञे देवाः सर्वे समागताः । यज्ञाङ्गानि च सर्वाणि वषठ्कारश्च मूर्त्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: tathāsya vitate yajñe devāḥ sarve samāgatāḥ / yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi vaṣaṭhkāraśca mūrttimān
verses.translation: They are Amartas, Aprakasas and the renowned Jyotismants. Their king is Lord Yania who has got rid of all sins by means of Yamas (the famous ten qualities of restiaining influence such as celibacy, non-violence, non-stealth etc. (Brahmacarya, Ahimsa, Asteya, etc.)
verses.wordMeaning: They are Amartas, Aprakasas and the renowned Jyotismants. Their king is Lord Yania who has got rid of all sins by means of Yamas (the famous ten qualities of restiaining influence such as celibacy, non-violence, non-stealth etc. (Brahmacarya, Ahimsa, Asteya, etc.)
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Amartas, Aprakasas and the renowned Jyotismants. Their king is Lord Yania who has got rid of all sins by means of Yamas (the famous ten qualities of restiaining influence such as celibacy, non-violence, non-stealth etc. (Brahmacarya, Ahimsa, Asteya, etc.)

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्तिमन्ति च सामानि यजूंषि च सहस्रशः । ऋग्वेदश्चाभवत्तत्र यश्च क्रमविभूषितः
verses.transliteration: mūrttimanti ca sāmāni yajūṃṣi ca sahasraśaḥ / ṛgvedaścābhavattatra yaśca kramavibhūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: The groups of sages (called) Vaikhanasas are earn- estly devoted to penance and higher Vedic learning.
verses.wordMeaning: The groups of sages (called) Vaikhanasas are earn- estly devoted to penance and higher Vedic learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: The groups of sages (called) Vaikhanasas are earn- estly devoted to penance and higher Vedic learning.

verses.sanskrit: यजुर्वेदश्च वृत्ताढ्य ओङ्कारवदनोज्ज्वलः । स्थितो यज्ञार्थसंपृक्तः सूक्तब्राह्मणमन्त्रवान्
verses.transliteration: yajurvedaśca vṛttāḍhya oṅkāravadanojjvalaḥ / sthito yajñārthasaṃpṛktaḥ sūktabrāhmaṇamantravān
verses.translation: They know that the birth of Rksarajas was from the movement of his eyes. Other Prajapatis were born of his cars.
verses.hindi: मेरे सभो अभार्य बस्य हैं और तीनों बगा में भी मैं यथायोग्य आदर प्राप्त करने बाला ह । आपके ही द्वारा जो उपदेश प्राप्त किया है उसी मार्ग से मैंने अच्छी तरह से राज्य का परिपालन किया है ।१४। इसी रीति से मैं
verses.wordMeaning: They know that the birth of Rksarajas was from the movement of his eyes. Other Prajapatis were born of his cars.
verses.commentary: Sense: They know that the birth of Rksarajas was from the movement of his eyes. Other Prajapatis were born of his cars.

verses.sanskrit: सामवेदश्च वृत्ताढ्यः सर्वगेयपुरः सरः । विश्वावस्वादिभिः सार्द्धं गन्धर्वैः संभृतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: sāmavedaśca vṛttāḍhyaḥ sarvageyapuraḥ saraḥ / viśvāvasvādibhiḥ sārddhaṃ gandharvaiḥ saṃbhṛto 'bhavat
verses.translation: Let all of them resort to Brahman, the truthful and the greatest penance on the Earth. All of us and these are, O lord, your own progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: Let all of them resort to Brahman, the truthful and the greatest penance on the Earth. All of us and these are, O lord, your own progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let all of them resort to Brahman, the truthful and the greatest penance on the Earth. All of us and these are, O lord, your own progeny.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मवेदस्तथा घोरैः कृत्वा विधिभिरन्वितः । प्रत्यङ्गिरसयोगैश्च द्विशरीरशिरो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: brahmavedastathā ghoraiḥ kṛtvā vidhibhiranvitaḥ / pratyaṅgirasayogaiśca dviśarīraśiro 'bhavat
verses.translation: Thinking that, Brahman, the Brahmarias, the worlds consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings, the
verses.hindi: अवृत्त हो रहा हैं और अपने राज्य पर स्थित हैं किन्तु है भृगु श्रेष्ठ मेरी इच्छा आपके दर्शन प्राप्त करने की हुईं थी जो कि कुछ अपेक्षा से समन्वित है ।१६। आज मुझमें आपके प्रसाद से सभी कुछ पर्या प्राप्त हुआ है किन्तु मेरो कोई सन्तति नहीं है । इसी कारण से मुझे इस भूमि का संरक्षण करना
verses.wordMeaning: Thinking that, Brahman, the Brahmarias, the worlds consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings, the
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking that, Brahman, the Brahmarias, the worlds consisting of the mobile and the immobile beings, the

verses.sanskrit: लक्षणा विस्तराः स्तोभा निरुक्तस्वर भक्तयः । आश्रयस्तु वषट्कारो निग्रहप्रग्रहावपि
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṇā vistarāḥ stobhā niruktasvara bhaktayaḥ / āśrayastu vaṣaṭkāro nigrahapragrahāvapi
verses.translation: The Brahmanas shall thus establish the beginnings and ends of the Yugas".
verses.hindi: और पितृगण को पिण्डो का देना दुष्कर सा हो रहा है ।१७। यही मुझे बड़ा भारी घोर दुःख है जो मेरे मन में बेठा हुआ है और निवारण के योग्य नहीं है। इस लोक में मेरे इस दुःख का अपहरण करने वाला आपको छोड़कर अन्य कोई भी नहीं है। अतएव मैं आपकी सन्निधि में प्राप्त हुआ हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanas shall thus establish the beginnings and ends of the Yugas".
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmanas shall thus establish the beginnings and ends of the Yugas".

verses.sanskrit: दीप्तिमूर्त्तिरिलादेवी दिशश्चसदिगीश्वराः । देवकन्याश्च पत्न्यश्च तथा मातर एव च
verses.transliteration: dīptimūrttirilādevī diśaścasadigīśvarāḥ / devakanyāśca patnyaśca tathā mātara eva ca
verses.translation: Of them, 1 shall narrate at the outset the race of the nobJe-souled Bhrgu who was the first Prajapati. I shall narrate it in detail and in due order.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से जब सगर तृप के द्वारा उस मुनि से कहा गया था तो वह मुनिं एक क्षण तक मन ही मन में सोचते हुए स्थित रहे ये और फिर औवं भगवान् ने निदेश पूर्वक यह वचन राजा से कहा था ।१९। आप नियमित रहकर अपनी दोनों पत्नियों के साथ कुछ समय तक यहों पर निवास करें।
verses.wordMeaning: Of them, 1 shall narrate at the outset the race of the nobJe-souled Bhrgu who was the first Prajapati. I shall narrate it in detail and in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of them, 1 shall narrate at the outset the race of the nobJe-souled Bhrgu who was the first Prajapati. I shall narrate it in detail and in due order.

verses.sanskrit: आययुः सर्व एवैते देवस्य यजतो मखे । मूर्तिमन्तः सुरूपाख्या वरुणस्य वपुर्भृतः
verses.transliteration: āyayuḥ sarva evaite devasya yajato makhe / mūrtimantaḥ surūpākhyā varuṇasya vapurbhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The mental daughter of the Manes named Somapas (imbibers of the Soma juice) was well-known by the name of Gau. She became the wife of Sukra and gave birth to his four sons.
verses.hindi: फिर आपका जो भी अभीप्सित है उसको आप अवश्य ही प्राप्त कर लेंगे-- इसमें कुछ भी संशय नहीं है ।२०। फिर वह राजा भी सेवा में तत्पर होकर बहीं पर निवास करने लगा था। उसको परम प्रसन्नता हुई थी । उस समय में दोनों पत्नियों के साथ धमं में युक्त तथा भक्तिभाव से समन्वित होकर
verses.wordMeaning: The mental daughter of the Manes named Somapas (imbibers of the Soma juice) was well-known by the name of Gau. She became the wife of Sukra and gave birth to his four sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mental daughter of the Manes named Somapas (imbibers of the Soma juice) was well-known by the name of Gau. She became the wife of Sukra and gave birth to his four sons.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयंभु वस्तु ता दृष्ट्वा रेतः समपतद्भुवि । ब्रह्मर्षिभाविनोर्ऽथस्य विधानाच्च न संशयः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃbhu vastu tā dṛṣṭvā retaḥ samapatadbhuvi / brahmarṣibhāvinor'thasya vidhānācca na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: They were Tvastr, Varatrin, San<ja and Marka. In splendour they resembled the Sun and in prowess they were as good as god Brahma.
verses.hindi: ही चिरकाल पर्यन्त वहाँ निवास किया था
verses.wordMeaning: They were Tvastr, Varatrin, San<ja and Marka. In splendour they resembled the Sun and in prowess they were as good as god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Tvastr, Varatrin, San<ja and Marka. In splendour they resembled the Sun and in prowess they were as good as god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: धृत्वा जुहाव हस्ताभ्यां स्रुवेण परिगृह्य च । आस्रवज्जुहुयां चक्रे मन्त्रवच्च पितामहः
verses.transliteration: dhṛtvā juhāva hastābhyāṃ sruveṇa parigṛhya ca / āsravajjuhuyāṃ cakre mantravacca pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The following were the sons of Varatrin viz. — Rajata, Pfthu, Rasmi and the scholarly Brhamgiras. They were the priests performing the Yajfias of the Daityas. They were extremely skilled in sacred knowledge. «*
verses.hindi: राजपत्न्यौ च ते तस्य सवंकालमतंद्रिते । मुनेरतनुतां प्रीति विनयाचारभक्तिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The following were the sons of Varatrin viz. — Rajata, Pfthu, Rasmi and the scholarly Brhamgiras. They were the priests performing the Yajfias of the Daityas. They were extremely skilled in sacred knowledge. «*
verses.commentary: Sense: The following were the sons of Varatrin viz. — Rajata, Pfthu, Rasmi and the scholarly Brhamgiras. They were the priests performing the Yajfias of the Daityas. They were extremely skilled in sacred knowledge. «*

verses.sanskrit: ततः स जनयामास भूतग्रामं प्रजापतिः । तस्यार्वाक्तेजसश्चैव जज्ञे लोकेषु तैजसम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa janayāmāsa bhūtagrāmaṃ prajāpatiḥ / tasyārvāktejasaścaiva jajñe lokeṣu taijasam
verses.translation: In order to destroy the holy rite of Ijya (sacrifice), they approached Manu and began to perform Yajfias (in a distorted manner). On seeing Dharma vitiated, Indra said to Manu*
verses.wordMeaning: In order to destroy the holy rite of Ijya (sacrifice), they approached Manu and began to perform Yajfias (in a distorted manner). On seeing Dharma vitiated, Indra said to Manu*
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to destroy the holy rite of Ijya (sacrifice), they approached Manu and began to perform Yajfias (in a distorted manner). On seeing Dharma vitiated, Indra said to Manu*

verses.sanskrit: तमसा भावि याप्यत्वं यथा सत्त्वं तथा रजः । आज्यस्थाल्यामुपादाय स्वशुक्रं हुतवांश्च ह
verses.transliteration: tamasā bhāvi yāpyatvaṃ yathā sattvaṃ tathā rajaḥ / ājyasthālyāmupādāya svaśukraṃ hutavāṃśca ha
verses.translation: "I shall make these people alone properly perform your Yajna". On hearing those words of Indra, they (the sons of Varatrin) slipped away from that place.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा तेऽप्युभे तं महामुनिम् । ऊचनुर्भगवान्पुत्रान्कामयावेति सादरम्
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall make these people alone properly perform your Yajna". On hearing those words of Indra, they (the sons of Varatrin) slipped away from that place.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall make these people alone properly perform your Yajna". On hearing those words of Indra, they (the sons of Varatrin) slipped away from that place.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रे हु ते ऽथ तस्मिंस्तु प्रादुर्भूता महर्षयः । ज्वलन्तो वपुषा युक्ताः सप्रभावैः स्वकैर्गुणैः
verses.transliteration: śukre hu te 'tha tasmiṃstu prādurbhūtā maharṣayaḥ / jvalanto vapuṣā yuktāḥ saprabhāvaiḥ svakairguṇaiḥ
verses.translation: When they disappeared, Indra came to Manu's wife who had become senseless and freed her from the evil planet. Then he pursued them.
verses.hindi: ततस्ते भगवानाह भवतीभ्यां मया पुन. । राज्ञश्च प्रियकामेन वरो दत्तोऽयमीप्सितः
verses.wordMeaning: When they disappeared, Indra came to Manu's wife who had become senseless and freed her from the evil planet. Then he pursued them.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they disappeared, Indra came to Manu's wife who had become senseless and freed her from the evil planet. Then he pursued them.

verses.sanskrit: हुते चाग्नौ सकृच्छुक्रे ज्वालाया निसृतः कविः । हिरण्यगर्भस्तं दृष्ट्वा ज्वालां भित्त्वा विनिर्गतम्
verses.transliteration: hute cāgnau sakṛcchukre jvālāyā nisṛtaḥ kaviḥ / hiraṇyagarbhastaṃ dṛṣṭvā jvālāṃ bhittvā vinirgatam
verses.translation: Thereafter, those sages began to strive for the des- truction of Indra. On seeing those vicious persons come, Indra laughed derisively.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, those sages began to strive for the des- truction of Indra. On seeing those vicious persons come, Indra laughed derisively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, those sages began to strive for the des- truction of Indra. On seeing those vicious persons come, Indra laughed derisively.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुस्त्वमिति चोवाच यस्मात्तस्मात्स वै भृगुः । महादेवस्तथोद्भूतो दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्माणमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgustvamiti covāca yasmāttasmātsa vai bhṛguḥ / mahādevastathodbhūto dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇamabravīt
verses.translation: Divya gave birth to a daughter, the younger sister of lord Sukra (Kavya). Twelve resplendent (godly) sons were born to Bhfgu and they were known as Bhrgus ( or Bhfgu gods ) •
verses.hindi: उत दोनों राजा की पत्नियों ने सदा ही अतन्द्रित होकर उस मुनि
verses.wordMeaning: Divya gave birth to a daughter, the younger sister of lord Sukra (Kavya). Twelve resplendent (godly) sons were born to Bhfgu and they were known as Bhrgus ( or Bhfgu gods ) •
verses.commentary: Sense: Divya gave birth to a daughter, the younger sister of lord Sukra (Kavya). Twelve resplendent (godly) sons were born to Bhfgu and they were known as Bhrgus ( or Bhfgu gods ) •

verses.sanskrit: ममैष पुत्रकामस्य दीक्षितस्य त्वया प्रभो । विजज्ञे प्रथमं देव मम पुत्रो भवत्वयम्
verses.transliteration: mamaiṣa putrakāmasya dīkṣitasya tvayā prabho / vijajñe prathamaṃ deva mama putro bhavatvayam
verses.translation: Mt. P. gives a different list of these 12 Deva Yjilika Bhfgus in the list of Gotras and Pravaras.
verses.hindi: की विनय--आचार और भक्ति से प्रीति को बढ़ा दिया था ।२२। उस भक्ति और शुभूषा से मुनिवर बहुत हो अधिक सन्तुष्ट हो गये थे और फिर उन्होने दोनों राजा को पत्नियों को अपने समीप में बुलाकर उन से यह वचन कहा था--आप दोनों हो हमसे किसी भो वरदान का वरण करो जो भी तुम्हारी
verses.wordMeaning: Mt. P. gives a different list of these 12 Deva Yjilika Bhfgus in the list of Gotras and Pravaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. P. gives a different list of these 12 Deva Yjilika Bhfgus in the list of Gotras and Pravaras.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति समनुज्ञातो महादेवः स्वयंभुवा । पुत्रत्वे कल्पयामास महादेव स्तदा भृगुम्
verses.transliteration: tatheti samanujñāto mahādevaḥ svayaṃbhuvā / putratve kalpayāmāsa mahādeva stadā bhṛgum
verses.translation: That scion of the family of Bhrgu begot two sons of Sukanya. Those two sons, viz. Apravana and Dadhica were honoured by good people.
verses.hindi: इच्छा हो ओर तुमको अभीप्सित हो। मैं उसी को तुम्हारे लिए दे दूगा- इसमें कुछ भो सन्देह नहीं है यद्यपि बह बरदान बहुत दुलंभ भी क्‍यों न होवे ।२३-२४। इसके अनम्तर उन दोनों ने मस्तक टेक कर प्रणाम किया था और उन महामुनि से कहा था-हे भगवान् ! हम दोनों हो आदर के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: That scion of the family of Bhrgu begot two sons of Sukanya. Those two sons, viz. Apravana and Dadhica were honoured by good people.
verses.commentary: Sense: That scion of the family of Bhrgu begot two sons of Sukanya. Those two sons, viz. Apravana and Dadhica were honoured by good people.

verses.sanskrit: वारुणा भृगवस्तस्मात्तदपत्यं च स प्रभुः । द्वितीयं च ततः शुक्रमङ्गारेष्वजुहोत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: vāruṇā bhṛgavastasmāttadapatyaṃ ca sa prabhuḥ / dvitīyaṃ ca tataḥ śukramaṅgāreṣvajuhotprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Now, listen to the family of Angiras, the intelli- gent son of Agni. It was in his family that Bharadvajas along with Gautamas were bom.
verses.hindi: पुत्रों की कामना करती हैं ।२५। इसके अनन्तर ओवं भगवान् ने कहा--आप दोनों के लिये राजा के प्रिय की कामना बाले मैंने यह अभीष्ट बरदान दे दिया है ।२६। है महाभाग वालियो ! मेरे प्रसाद से तुम दोनों ही पुत्रों वाली होओगी और अन्य भो एक वचन परम घव है, उसका भी श्रवण कीजिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Now, listen to the family of Angiras, the intelli- gent son of Agni. It was in his family that Bharadvajas along with Gautamas were bom.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गारेष्वङ्गिरो ऽङ्गानि संहतानि ततोङ्गिराः । संभूतिं तस्य तां दृष्ट्वा वह्निर्ब्रह्माणमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: aṅgāreṣvaṅgiro 'ṅgāni saṃhatāni tatoṅgirāḥ / saṃbhūtiṃ tasya tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vahnirbrahmāṇamabravīt
verses.translation: In Mbh. Adi 177 we are told that when Haihayas tried a genocide of Bhfgus, Bhrgu women fled to hills. But while running Cyavana's wife Aru?I concealed her foetus in her thigh. When informed of this, Haihaya warriors arrested her to execute her but the child — a son — broke through her mother's thigh and blinded all the Haihayas by his supreme brilliance. As this child broke through his mother's thigh, he was called Aurva (one bom out of the thigh).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे ऋषिसर्गवर्णनं नाम प्रथमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच विनिवृत्ते प्रजासर्गे षष्ठे वै चाक्षुषस्य ह । प्रजाः सृजेति व्यदिष्टः स्वयं दक्षः स्वयंभुवा
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde ṛṣisargavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca vinivṛtte prajāsarge ṣaṣṭhe vai cākṣuṣasya ha / prajāḥ sṛjeti vyadiṣṭaḥ svayaṃ dakṣaḥ svayaṃbhuvā
verses.translation: When the sixth creation of subjects i.e. that of Caksusa (Manvantara) had been (annihilated and) withdrawn, Daksa was commanded by the self-born lord himself— "Create the Subjects".
verses.hindi: जाने पर तमस्त देव-असुर और महोरग अत्यव्रिक क्षोभ को प्राप्त-हो गये थे

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज सर्वभूतानि गतिमन्ति ध्रुवाणि च । मानसानि च भूतानि स पूर्वमसृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sasarja sarvabhūtāni gatimanti dhruvāṇi ca / mānasāni ca bhūtāni sa pūrvamasṛjatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: He (i.e. Daksa) created all the living beings, the mobile ones as well as the immobile ones. At the outset, the lord created mental living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: He (i.e. Daksa) created all the living beings, the mobile ones as well as the immobile ones. At the outset, the lord created mental living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He (i.e. Daksa) created all the living beings, the mobile ones as well as the immobile ones. At the outset, the lord created mental living beings.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीन्देवांश्च गन्धर्वान्मनुष्योरगराक्षसान् । यक्षभूतपिशाचांश्च वयः पशुमृगांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīndevāṃśca gandharvānmanuṣyoragarākṣasān / yakṣabhūtapiśācāṃśca vayaḥ paśumṛgāṃstathā
verses.translation: He created (mentally) the sages, the Devas, the Gandharvas, the human beings, the serpents, the Raksasas, the Yaksas, the Bhutas (goblins), the Piidcas (ghosts, evil spirits) the birds, the animals and the cattle.
verses.wordMeaning: He created (mentally) the sages, the Devas, the Gandharvas, the human beings, the serpents, the Raksasas, the Yaksas, the Bhutas (goblins), the Piidcas (ghosts, evil spirits) the birds, the animals and the cattle.
