verses.sanskrit: यदास्य मनसा सृष्टा न व्यवर्द्धन्त ताः प्रजाः । अपध्याता भगवता महादेवेन धीमता
verses.transliteration: yadāsya manasā sṛṣṭā na vyavarddhanta tāḥ prajāḥ / apadhyātā bhagavatā mahādevena dhīmatā
verses.translation: When those subjects created mentally by him did not multiply, they were cursed mentally by the great intelligent lord of great splendour and dignity.
verses.hindi: देवाः शृणुत भद्र वो वाणीमवहिता मम ।
verses.wordMeaning: When those subjects created mentally by him did not multiply, they were cursed mentally by the great intelligent lord of great splendour and dignity.
verses.commentary: Sense: When those subjects created mentally by him did not multiply, they were cursed mentally by the great intelligent lord of great splendour and dignity.

verses.sanskrit: स मैथुनेन भावेन सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः । असिक्रीमावहद्भार्यां वीरणस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: sa maithunena bhāvena sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ / asikrīmāvahadbhāryāṃ vīraṇasya prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the one million serpents went away in due course. Daksa, the son of Pracetas, married Asikni the daughter of Virana there.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the one million serpents went away in due course. Daksa, the son of Pracetas, married Asikni the daughter of Virana there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the one million serpents went away in due course. Daksa, the son of Pracetas, married Asikni the daughter of Virana there.

verses.sanskrit: सुतां सुमहता युक्तां तपसा लोक धारिणीम् । यया धृतमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: sutāṃ sumahatā yuktāṃ tapasā loka dhāriṇīm / yayā dhṛtamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: "How were the sons of Prajapati formerly destroyed by the divine sage Narada? I wish to know this factually (in details)."
verses.wordMeaning: "How were the sons of Prajapati formerly destroyed by the divine sage Narada? I wish to know this factually (in details)."
verses.commentary: Sense: "How were the sons of Prajapati formerly destroyed by the divine sage Narada? I wish to know this factually (in details)."

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमौ श्लोकौ प्राचेतसां प्रति । दक्षस्योद्वहतो भार्यांमसिक्रीं वैरणीं पुरा
verses.transliteration: atrāpyudāharantīmau ślokau prācetasāṃ prati / dakṣasyodvahato bhāryāṃmasikrīṃ vairaṇīṃ purā
verses.translation: Haryaivas, the sons of Daksa, were desirous of caus- ing the subjects to flourish. Those sons of great virility assembl- ed. Narada spoke to them.
verses.hindi: यह वदुन्धरा अचला है तयापि उस समय में सगर के पुत्रों के द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Haryaivas, the sons of Daksa, were desirous of caus- ing the subjects to flourish. Those sons of great virility assembl- ed. Narada spoke to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haryaivas, the sons of Daksa, were desirous of caus- ing the subjects to flourish. Those sons of great virility assembl- ed. Narada spoke to them.

verses.sanskrit: कृपानां नियुतं दक्षं सर्पिणां साभिमानिनाम् । नदीगिरिष्बसज्जन्तं पृष्ठतो ऽनुययौ प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: kṛpānāṃ niyutaṃ dakṣaṃ sarpiṇāṃ sābhimāninām / nadīgiriṣbasajjantaṃ pṛṣṭhato 'nuyayau prabhum
verses.translation: "Alas, all of you are childish. You do not know the surface of the Earth internally nor do you know the space above or below. How will you create the subjects?"
verses.hindi: आक्गान्त होकर चलायमान हो गयी थो । उस समय में धरा की चलगति को देखकर बड़े-बड़े तपस्वियों की समाधि टूट गयी थी और तपश्चर्या कर भंग हो गया था ।=। देवगण भी के साथ अपने हुब्य-कब्य से जो भी उनके लिए समर्पित किए जाते थे उनसे परिभ्रष्ट हो गए थे और उनको
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas, all of you are childish. You do not know the surface of the Earth internally nor do you know the space above or below. How will you create the subjects?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas, all of you are childish. You do not know the surface of the Earth internally nor do you know the space above or below. How will you create the subjects?"

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा ऋषिभिः प्रोक्तं प्रतिष्ठास्यति वै प्रजाः । प्रथमो ऽत्र द्वितीयस्तु दक्षः स हि प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ pratiṣṭhāsyati vai prajāḥ / prathamo 'tra dvitīyastu dakṣaḥ sa hi prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: According to Mbh. Adi. 75. 7-8, N&rada instructed this first batch of 1 000 sons of Daksa in S&Akhya philosophy. There-by all of them became recluses leading to the frustration of Dak?a*s mission of populating the world. Here (VV. 20-27 ) N&rada advised them to know the magnitude of the earth and diverted two batches of Daksa's sons — the Haryaivas and $abal&4vas elsewhere (Bh. P. VI ch. 5). Being frustrated in his plan of populating the world, he cursed Nirada to perish and reborn again.
verses.hindi: महान दुःख हो गया था तया वे सभी अत्यन्त उत्पोड़ित होकर ब्रह्माजी के भवन पर गए थे ।९। वहाँ पर समस्त देवगण जिनमें शिव अग्रणी थे जाकर
verses.wordMeaning: According to Mbh. Adi. 75. 7-8, N&rada instructed this first batch of 1 000 sons of Daksa in S&Akhya philosophy. There-by all of them became recluses leading to the frustration of Dak?a*s mission of populating the world. Here (VV.…
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Mbh. Adi. 75. 7-8, N&rada instructed this first batch of 1 000 sons of Daksa in S&Akhya philosophy. There-by all of them became recluses leading to the frustration of Dak?a*s mission of populating the world. Here (VV.…

verses.sanskrit: अथागच्छद्यथाकालं प्रहीनां नियुतं तु यत् । असिक्रीं वैरणीं तत्र दक्षः प्राचेतसो ऽवहत्
verses.transliteration: athāgacchadyathākālaṃ prahīnāṃ niyutaṃ tu yat / asikrīṃ vairaṇīṃ tatra dakṣaḥ prācetaso 'vahat
verses.translation: On hearing his words, they went away in all direc- tions. Till today they have not returned like the rivers that have fallen into the Ocean.
verses.hindi: २२   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण न्याय के अनुरूप उन्होने ब्रह्माजी ते तियेदन किया था कि सगर नृप के पुत्रों की भूमि पर कैसी कुचेशायें हो रही हैं ।१०। सब लोकों,के पितामह अह्याजो उनके कहे वचनों कर श्रवण करके एक क्षण के अन्दर विचार वाले
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, they went away in all direc- tions. Till today they have not returned like the rivers that have fallen into the Ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, they went away in all direc- tions. Till today they have not returned like the rivers that have fallen into the Ocean.

verses.sanskrit: अथ पुत्रसहस्रं स वैरण्याममितौजसम् । असिक्न्यां जनयामास दक्षः प्राचे तसः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: atha putrasahasraṃ sa vairaṇyāmamitaujasam / asiknyāṃ janayāmāsa dakṣaḥ prāce tasaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: When they were lost, lord Daksa, the son of Pracetas, once again begot a thousand sons of Vairani.
verses.hindi: हुए शे ओर इसके पश्चात् सुरों में शे षठ ब्रह्माजी ने उनसे कहा-।११। है देवगणो ! आप सबका कल्याण होते । अब आप लोग सावधान हो 5र मेरी वाणौ का श्रवण कीजिए जो भी कुछ मैं आपके सामने इस समय में कह रहा है-ये सगर के पुत्र सवके सब विनष्ट हो जायेगे-यह सर्वथा सत्य है
verses.wordMeaning: When they were lost, lord Daksa, the son of Pracetas, once again begot a thousand sons of Vairani.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were lost, lord Daksa, the son of Pracetas, once again begot a thousand sons of Vairani.

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा महातेजाः स विवर्द्धयिषुः प्रजाः । देवर्षिप्रियसंवादो नारदो ब्रह्मणः सुतः
verses.transliteration: tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā mahātejāḥ sa vivarddhayiṣuḥ prajāḥ / devarṣipriyasaṃvādo nārado brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: These sons (known as) Sabalasvas, were desirous of causing the subjects to flourish. They were told once again by Narada the same words uttered by him before.
verses.hindi: इसमें कुछ भी संशय नहीं है ।१२। कुछ काल पर्यन्त प्रतीक्षा करो। समय के ही द्वारा सब नियमित हो जाया करता है । यह काल बड़ा बलवान है। अन्य तो केवल निमित्त हो हुआ करते हैं करने बाला तो वास्तव में काल ही होता है । यह हो सबको खाने बाला होला है । इसके सामने सब बल-
verses.wordMeaning: These sons (known as) Sabalasvas, were desirous of causing the subjects to flourish. They were told once again by Narada the same words uttered by him before.
verses.commentary: Sense: These sons (known as) Sabalasvas, were desirous of causing the subjects to flourish. They were told once again by Narada the same words uttered by him before.

verses.sanskrit: नाशाय वचनं तेषां शापयैवात्मनो ऽब्रवीत् । यः कश्यपसुतस्याथ परमेष्ठी व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: nāśāya vacanaṃ teṣāṃ śāpayaivātmano 'bravīt / yaḥ kaśyapasutasyātha parameṣṭhī vyajāyata
verses.translation: They too went in all directions along the same path, desirous of getting at the magnitude and extent of the Earth. They have not returned till today.
verses.hindi: वैभव और प्रताप धूल में मिल जाया करते हैं ।१३। है सुरश्रेष्ठो ! मैं आप सभी के हित-सम्पादन होने के लिए जो भो कुछ कहूँगा बही अब आप सब को अतन्द्रित होकर कर डालना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: They too went in all directions along the same path, desirous of getting at the magnitude and extent of the Earth. They have not returned till today.
verses.commentary: Sense: They too went in all directions along the same path, desirous of getting at the magnitude and extent of the Earth. They have not returned till today.

verses.sanskrit: मानसः कश्यपस्यासीद्दक्षशापवशात्पुनः । तस्मात्स काश्यपस्याथ द्वितीयो मानसो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: mānasaḥ kaśyapasyāsīddakṣaśāpavaśātpunaḥ / tasmātsa kāśyapasyātha dvitīyo mānaso 'bhavat
verses.translation: Thereafter, if a brother goes in search of his (lost) brother he perishes himself quickly. That should not be under- taken by a person who knows this.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, if a brother goes in search of his (lost) brother he perishes himself quickly. That should not be under- taken by a person who knows this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, if a brother goes in search of his (lost) brother he perishes himself quickly. That should not be under- taken by a person who knows this.

verses.sanskrit: स हि पूर्वं समुत्पन्नो नारदः परमेष्ठिनः । तेन वृक्षस्य पुत्रा वै हर्यश्वा इति विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: sa hi pūrvaṃ samutpanno nāradaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / tena vṛkṣasya putrā vai haryaśvā iti viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: When the Sabalasvas too perished, lord Daksa be- came infuriated. He cursed Narada thus — "Become perished. Stay in a womb."
verses.wordMeaning: When the Sabalasvas too perished, lord Daksa be- came infuriated. He cursed Narada thus — "Become perished. Stay in a womb."
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Sabalasvas too perished, lord Daksa be- came infuriated. He cursed Narada thus — "Become perished. Stay in a womb."

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थं नाशिताः सर्वे विधिना च न संशयः । तस्योद्यतस्तदा दक्षः क्रुद्धः शापाय वै प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dharmārthaṃ nāśitāḥ sarve vidhinā ca na saṃśayaḥ / tasyodyatastadā dakṣaḥ kruddhaḥ śāpāya vai prabhuḥ
verses.translation: When they were destroyed, that noble-souled lord Daksa begot of Vairani herself sixty well known daughters.
verses.hindi: प्रसीद नो मुनिश्रेष्ठ वयं त्वां शरणं गताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: When they were destroyed, that noble-souled lord Daksa begot of Vairani herself sixty well known daughters.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were destroyed, that noble-souled lord Daksa begot of Vairani herself sixty well known daughters.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षीन्वै पुरस्कृत्य याचितः परमेष्ठिना । ततो ऽभिसंधिं चक्रे वै दक्षश्च परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣīnvai puraskṛtya yācitaḥ parameṣṭhinā / tato 'bhisaṃdhiṃ cakre vai dakṣaśca parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: Kasyapa, Dharma, Soma, the lord (Moon) and other great sages took those daughters as wives.
verses.hindi: अयणीलों में श्रेष्ठ भगवान् कपिल मुनि भगवान विष्णु के ही अश से
verses.wordMeaning: Kasyapa, Dharma, Soma, the lord (Moon) and other great sages took those daughters as wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kasyapa, Dharma, Soma, the lord (Moon) and other great sages took those daughters as wives.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यायां नारदो मह्यं तव पुत्रो भवेदिति । ततो दक्षः सुतां प्रदात् प्रियां वै परमेष्ठिने । तस्मात्स नारदो जज्ञे भूयः शापभयदृषिः
verses.transliteration: kanyāyāṃ nārado mahyaṃ tava putro bhavediti / tato dakṣaḥ sutāṃ pradāt priyāṃ vai parameṣṭhine / tasmātsa nārado jajñe bhūyaḥ śāpabhayadṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: इस जगत के हित के लिए समतोर्ण हुए है। यह विष्णु भगवान का ही अ'शादतार है और भूमण्डन में योगीन्द्रं में परम श्रेष्ठ हैं ।१५। अगस्त्य मुनि के द्वारा इस विशाल सागर का जल पी लेने पर दिव्य सौ वर्षो की अवधि हो गयी है वे इसी अम्भोधि में वहां पर किसी स्थल में इस समय में
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: शांशपायन उवाच कथं वै नाशिताः पूर्वं नारदेन सुरर्षिणा । प्रजापतिसुतास्ते वै श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: śāṃśapāyana uvāca kathaṃ vai nāśitāḥ pūrvaṃ nāradena surarṣiṇā / prajāpatisutāste vai śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: इस समय में ध्यान करने बाले स्थित हैं ।१६। मेरा यह अण्देश है कि आप लोग भुनियों में परम श्रे ष्ठ कपिलजो के समीप में चले जाओ। जब उनकी घ्यानावस्था का अन्त होदे तब तक इच्छा रखने वाले आप लोग वहीँ उप- गहवर में संस्थित रहें ।१७। जव उनकी समाधि समाप्त हो जावे तभी आप
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच दक्षपुत्राश्च हर्यश्वा विवर्धयिषवः प्रजाः । समागता महावीर्या नारदस्तानुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca dakṣaputrāśca haryaśvā vivardhayiṣavaḥ prajāḥ / samāgatā mahāvīryā nāradastānuvāca ha
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: अपना अभिप्राय पूर्ण रूप से नमस्कार करके उनको बतला देवें । बही ऐसे शक्तिशाली हैं कि वे आप लोगों का कल्याण कर देंगे ।१८। है देवगणो ! जिस भो रीति से उन मुनिवर की समाधि का भङ्ग सगर के पुत्रों द्वारा किया हुआ होये आप लोगों को वेसी ही प्रवृत्ति करनी चाहिए। इसी से
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: बालिशा बत यूयं वै न प्रजानीथ भूतलम् । अन्तरूर्ध्वमधश्चैव कथं स्रक्ष्यथ वै प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: bāliśā bata yūyaṃ vai na prajānītha bhūtalam / antarūrdhvamadhaścaiva kathaṃ srakṣyatha vai prajāḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: आप का कार्य सुसम्पन्न हो जायगा ।१९। जैमिनि मुनि ने कहा--पितामह के द्वारा जब देवगणों से इस तरह से कहा था तो वे सब पितामह को प्रणाम करके उन देवों मैं श्रेष्ठ मुनिवर के समीप में चले गये थे और हाय जोड़कर उन्होंने उनसे कहा था ।२०। देवों ने कहा-हे मुनिश्नेष्ठ ! आप हमारे
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: ते तु तद्वचन श्रुत्वा प्याताः सर्वतो दिशम् । अधापि म निवर्त्तन्ते समुद्रस्था इवापगाः
verses.transliteration: te tu tadvacana śrutvā pyātāḥ sarvato diśam / adhāpi ma nivarttante samudrasthā ivāpagāḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: ऊपर प्रसन्न हो जाइए । हम लोग आपको भरणागति में प्राप्त हुए हैं। राजा सगर के पुत्रों ने जगत् में बड़ा उपद्रव मचा दिया है और ऐसा हो गया है कि यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् विनष्ट हो हो जायगा
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तेषु प्रणष्टेषु दक्षः प्राचे तसः पुनः । वैरण्यामेव पुत्राणां सहस्रमसृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: atha teṣu praṇaṣṭeṣu dakṣaḥ prāce tasaḥ punaḥ / vairaṇyāmeva putrāṇāṃ sahasramasṛjatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजा विवर्द्धयिषवः शबलाश्वाः पुनस्तु ते । पूर्वमुक्तं वचस्तद्वै श्राविता नारदेन ह
verses.transliteration: prajā vivarddhayiṣavaḥ śabalāśvāḥ punastu te / pūrvamuktaṃ vacastadvai śrāvitā nāradena ha
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यमूचुस्ते सर्वे सम्यगाह ऋषिः स्वयम् । भ्रातॄणां पदवीं चैव गन्तव्या नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: anyonyamūcuste sarve samyagāha ṛṣiḥ svayam / bhrātṝṇāṃ padavīṃ caiva gantavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा प्रमाणं पृथ्व्या वै सुखं स्रक्ष्यामहे प्रजाः । प्रकाशाः स्वस्थमनसा यथावदनुशासिताः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā pramāṇaṃ pṛthvyā vai sukhaṃ srakṣyāmahe prajāḥ / prakāśāḥ svasthamanasā yathāvadanuśāsitāḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण प्रयाताः सर्वतो दिशम् । अद्यापि न निवर्त्तन्ते विस्तारायमलिप्सवः
verses.transliteration: te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa prayātāḥ sarvato diśam / adyāpi na nivarttante vistārāyamalipsavaḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: ननु वे सात्विकी चेष्टा भवतीह भवादुशाम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति वै भ्राता भ्रातुरन्वेषणे रतः । प्रयतो नश्यति क्षिप्रं तन्न कार्यं विजानता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti vai bhrātā bhrāturanveṣaṇe rataḥ / prayato naśyati kṣipraṃ tanna kāryaṃ vijānatā
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टेषु शबलाश्वेषु दक्षः क्रुद्धो ऽशपद्विभुः । नारदं नाशमेहीति गर्भवासं वसेति च
verses.transliteration: naṣṭeṣu śabalāśveṣu dakṣaḥ kruddho 'śapadvibhuḥ / nāradaṃ nāśamehīti garbhavāsaṃ vaseti ca
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तेष्वपि नष्टेषु महात्मा स प्रभुः किल । षष्टिं दक्षो ऽसृजत्कन्या वैरण्यामेव विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: tadā teṣvapi naṣṭeṣu mahātmā sa prabhuḥ kila / ṣaṣṭiṃ dakṣo 'sṛjatkanyā vairaṇyāmeva viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: आप तो समस्त लोकों की स्थिति और संहार के कारण हैं। आप तो
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: तास्तदा प्रतिजग्राह पत्न्यर्थं कश्यपः सुताः । धर्मः सोमश्च भगवांस्तथा चान्ये महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: tāstadā pratijagrāha patnyarthaṃ kaśyapaḥ sutāḥ / dharmaḥ somaśca bhagavāṃstathā cānye maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: भगवान् विष्णु के अ'न से ही अवतीण हुए हैं और इस भूमण्डल में योगीन्द के स्वरूप को धारण करके समवस्थित हैं।२२। आप कोई महात् श्रेष्ठ तपस्वी ही नहीं हैं। आपने तो अपने इस देह को अपनी ही इच्छा मे धारण किया है और यह भो केवल तीनों तापों से अत्यधिक आत्तं पुरुषों की
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: इमां विसृष्टिं दक्षस्य कृत्स्नां यो वेद तत्त्वतः । आयुष्मान्कीर्त्तिमान्धन्यः प्रजावाश्च भवत्युत
verses.transliteration: imāṃ visṛṣṭiṃ dakṣasya kṛtsnāṃ yo veda tattvataḥ / āyuṣmānkīrttimāndhanyaḥ prajāvāśca bhavatyuta
verses.translation: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.hindi: आत्ति पुरुषों की आति के हो विनाश के लिए धारण किया हे।२३। हे ब्रह्मन् ! अप तो एसे अद्भुत शक्तिशाली हैं कि अपने मत से ही इस सम्पूर्ण जगत् का सुजन, संस्थिति और संहार अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार बिना किसी संय के कर सकते है ।२४। आप तो हमारे धाता और
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows factually this creation of Daksa entirely shall become blessed, well renowned and long-lived. He shall have progeny.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे प्रजापतिवंशानुकीर्त्तनं नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचु । देवानां दानवानां च दैत्यानां चैव सर्वशः । उत्पत्तिं विस्तरेणैव ग्रूहि वैवस्वतेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde prajāpativaṃśānukīrttanaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcu / devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca daityānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ / utpattiṃ vistareṇaiva grūhi vaivasvateṃ'tare
verses.translation: Twelve Sadhyas were born as the sons of Sadhya and Dharma. Those conversant with the Devas affirm that they are superior to other Devas.
verses.hindi: विधाता हैं तथा आप गु हैं और परायण हैं। आप हमारा परित्राण भी करने वाले हैं। अब आप हमारी इस वतत पाल आपदा को दूर भगाइए।
verses.wordMeaning: Twelve Sadhyas were born as the sons of Sadhya and Dharma. Those conversant with the Devas affirm that they are superior to other Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twelve Sadhyas were born as the sons of Sadhya and Dharma. Those conversant with the Devas affirm that they are superior to other Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच धर्म्मस्यैव प्रवक्ष्यामि निसर्गन्तं निबोधत । अरुन्धतीवसुर्जामालंबा भानुर्मरुत्वती
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca dharmmasyaiva pravakṣyāmi nisargantaṃ nibodhata / arundhatīvasurjāmālaṃbā bhānurmarutvatī
verses.translation: These are the gods called Jay a, created from the mouth of Brahma* with a desire for progeny. All are remem- bered as Devas with Mantras as their bodies, in all the Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: की रक्षा करने बाले होइए । हम तीनों लोकों में निवासी सगर के पुत्रों के द्वारा वह्यपान हो रहे हैं ।२६। है सुवत ! इस लोक मैं आप जैसे महापुरुषों की सात्विकी चेष्टा हुआ करतो है । इसलिए आप समस्त लोकों की और हमारी रक्षा करने के योग्य हैं ।२७। है भगवान् ! यदि आप ही हम सबकी
verses.wordMeaning: These are the gods called Jay a, created from the mouth of Brahma* with a desire for progeny. All are remem- bered as Devas with Mantras as their bodies, in all the Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the gods called Jay a, created from the mouth of Brahma* with a desire for progeny. All are remem- bered as Devas with Mantras as their bodies, in all the Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पा च मुहूर्त्ता च साध्या विश्वा तथैव च । धर्मस्य पत्न्यो दश ता दक्षः प्राचेतसो ददौ
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpā ca muhūrttā ca sādhyā viśvā tathaiva ca / dharmasya patnyo daśa tā dakṣaḥ prācetaso dadau
verses.translation: W. 8-14 emphasise how the same persons (gods, sages etc.) are bom in every Manvantara with a difference in their names.
verses.hindi: रक्षा नहीं करेंगे तो यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् अकाल में ही विनष्ट हो जायगा । जैमिनि मुनि ने कहा-जब इस प्रकार से सब देवगणों ने अध्यर्थना की थी तो कपिल मुनि ने धोरे से अपने दोनों नेत्रों को खोला था
verses.wordMeaning: W. 8-14 emphasise how the same persons (gods, sages etc.) are bom in every Manvantara with a difference in their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 8-14 emphasise how the same persons (gods, sages etc.) are bom in every Manvantara with a difference in their names.

verses.sanskrit: साध्यापुत्रास्तु धर्मस्य साध्या द्वादशजज्ञिरे । देवेभ्यस्तान्परान्देवान्दैवज्ञाः परिचक्षते
verses.transliteration: sādhyāputrāstu dharmasya sādhyā dvādaśajajñire / devebhyastānparāndevāndaivajñāḥ paricakṣate
verses.translation: They had originally been Vipascit and Indra, as well as Satya and Hari. Formerly, in the Svarocisa Manvantara, they were the sons of Tusita.
verses.wordMeaning: They had originally been Vipascit and Indra, as well as Satya and Hari. Formerly, in the Svarocisa Manvantara, they were the sons of Tusita.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had originally been Vipascit and Indra, as well as Satya and Hari. Formerly, in the Svarocisa Manvantara, they were the sons of Tusita.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा वै मुखात्सृष्टा जया देवाः प्रजेप्सया । सर्वे मन्त्रशरीरस्ते समृता मन्वन्तरेष्विह
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇā vai mukhātsṛṣṭā jayā devāḥ prajepsayā / sarve mantraśarīraste samṛtā manvantareṣviha
verses.translation: This had been in the Svayambhuva Manvantara (?) formerly. Again in the Svarocisa Manvantara the following were the names of the Tusitas. Understand them.
verses.wordMeaning: This had been in the Svayambhuva Manvantara (?) formerly. Again in the Svarocisa Manvantara the following were the names of the Tusitas. Understand them.
verses.commentary: Sense: This had been in the Svayambhuva Manvantara (?) formerly. Again in the Svarocisa Manvantara the following were the names of the Tusitas. Understand them.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शश्च पौर्णमासश्च बृहद्यच्च रथन्तरम् । वित्तिश्चैव विवित्तिश्च आकूतिः कूतिरेव च
verses.transliteration: darśaśca paurṇamāsaśca bṛhadyacca rathantaram / vittiścaiva vivittiśca ākūtiḥ kūtireva ca
verses.translation: Prana, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vyana, Caksus, Srotram, Rasa, Ghrana, Spar£a, Buddhi and Manas.
verses.hindi: काले प्राप्ते तु युष्माभिः स तावत्परिपाल्यताम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Prana, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vyana, Caksus, Srotram, Rasa, Ghrana, Spar£a, Buddhi and Manas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prana, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vyana, Caksus, Srotram, Rasa, Ghrana, Spar£a, Buddhi and Manas.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाता चैव विज्ञातो मनो यज्ञस्तथैव च । नामान्येतानि तेषां वै यज्ञानां प्रथितानि च
verses.transliteration: vijñātā caiva vijñāto mano yajñastathaiva ca / nāmānyetāni teṣāṃ vai yajñānāṃ prathitāni ca
verses.translation: The sons of Dhara were Dravina, Hutahavya and Rajas. O dear one, the son of Dhruva was Kala who impels the worlds. ( Lokaprakdlana ).
verses.hindi: अहं तु कारणं तेषां विनाशाय दुरात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Dhara were Dravina, Hutahavya and Rajas. O dear one, the son of Dhruva was Kala who impels the worlds. ( Lokaprakdlana ).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Dhara were Dravina, Hutahavya and Rajas. O dear one, the son of Dhruva was Kala who impels the worlds. ( Lokaprakdlana ).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मशापेन तेजाताः पुनः स्वायंभुवे जिताः । स्वारोचिषे वै तुषिताः सत्यश्चैवोत्तमे पुनः
verses.transliteration: brahmaśāpena tejātāḥ punaḥ svāyaṃbhuve jitāḥ / svārociṣe vai tuṣitāḥ satyaścaivottame punaḥ
verses.translation: The five sons of Soma (the Moon) were lord Varcas, Budha, Graha Bod h ana, Dharormin and Kalila.
verses.wordMeaning: The five sons of Soma (the Moon) were lord Varcas, Budha, Graha Bod h ana, Dharormin and Kalila.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five sons of Soma (the Moon) were lord Varcas, Budha, Graha Bod h ana, Dharormin and Kalila.

verses.sanskrit: तामसे हरयो नाम वैकुण्ठा रेवतान्तरे । ते साध्याश्चाक्षुषे नाम्ना छन्दजा जज्ञिरे सुराः
verses.transliteration: tāmase harayo nāma vaikuṇṭhā revatāntare / te sādhyāścākṣuṣe nāmnā chandajā jajñire surāḥ
verses.translation: This verse and W. 35-54 contain ancient astronomy. The literature on Muhurta is enormous as it means "time fit for performance of auspicious acts" and as such is of vital importance to everyone. Names of muhurtas in Brahman as and Smrtis are different. The names 15 muhurtas of the day and 15 muhurtas of the night as given here in W. 39-46 agree with the list in VS. 40-44. Out of these Brahma is Abhijit of which he is the presiding deity. Prajapatya is Rauhigeya as Prajapati is the presiding deity of Rohixif. Mt. 8-9 mentions only eight auspicious muhurtas for beginning a work. Pur&nas regard muhurtas as deities probably because every muhUrta has a pre- siding deity.
verses.wordMeaning: This verse and W. 35-54 contain ancient astronomy. The literature on Muhurta is enormous as it means "time fit for performance of auspicious acts" and as such is of vital importance to everyone. Names of muhurtas in Brahman as and Smrtis are different.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This verse and W. 35-54 contain ancient astronomy. The literature on Muhurta is enormous as it means "time fit for performance of auspicious acts" and as such is of vital importance to everyone. Names of muhurtas in Brahman as and Smrtis are different.…

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपुत्रा महाभागाः साध्या ये द्वादशामराः । पूर्वं समनुसूयन्ते चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: dharmaputrā mahābhāgāḥ sādhyā ye dvādaśāmarāḥ / pūrvaṃ samanusūyante cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: All the objects on the Earth were born of Arundhati. This is the scholarly permanent creation of Dharma. It has been thus narrated.
verses.wordMeaning: All the objects on the Earth were born of Arundhati. This is the scholarly permanent creation of Dharma. It has been thus narrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the objects on the Earth were born of Arundhati. This is the scholarly permanent creation of Dharma. It has been thus narrated.

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे ऽतीता देवा ये वै महौजसः । तुषिता नाम ते ऽन्योन्यमूचुर्वै चाक्षुषेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: svārociṣeṃ'tare 'tītā devā ye vai mahaujasaḥ / tuṣitā nāma te 'nyonyamūcurvai cākṣuṣeṃ'tare
verses.translation: O sages of excellent holy rites, I shall narrate the Muhurta along with the substitutes of the Tithis (lunar days). Even as I mention them by their names, understand them.
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of excellent holy rites, I shall narrate the Muhurta along with the substitutes of the Tithis (lunar days). Even as I mention them by their names, understand them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of excellent holy rites, I shall narrate the Muhurta along with the substitutes of the Tithis (lunar days). Even as I mention them by their names, understand them.

verses.sanskrit: किञ्चिच्छिष्टे तदा तस्मिन्देवा वै तुषिताब्रुवन् । एतामेव महाभागां वयं साध्यां प्रविश्य वै
verses.transliteration: kiñcicchiṣṭe tadā tasmindevā vai tuṣitābruvan / etāmeva mahābhāgāṃ vayaṃ sādhyāṃ praviśya vai
verses.translation: The division of day and night has the stars for its basis. The Muhurtas and the constellations cause the divisions in days and nights.
verses.wordMeaning: The division of day and night has the stars for its basis. The Muhurtas and the constellations cause the divisions in days and nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: The division of day and night has the stars for its basis. The Muhurtas and the constellations cause the divisions in days and nights.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरे भविष्यामस्तन्नः श्रेयो भविष्यति । एवमुक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: manvantare bhaviṣyāmastannaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati / evamuktvā tu te sarve cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: More than cightysix Kalas of the day and night are remembered. They occur in all the seasons, every day, due to the special movement of the Sun.
verses.wordMeaning: More than cightysix Kalas of the day and night are remembered. They occur in all the seasons, every day, due to the special movement of the Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: More than cightysix Kalas of the day and night are remembered. They occur in all the seasons, every day, due to the special movement of the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां द्वादश संभूता धर्मात्स्वायंभुवात्पुनः । नरनारायणो तत्र जज्ञाते पुनरेव हि
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ dvādaśa saṃbhūtā dharmātsvāyaṃbhuvātpunaḥ / naranārāyaṇo tatra jajñāte punareva hi
verses.translation: Therefore, those who are conversant with the vedas accept this movement during the Parvan days (full moon, new moon, etc.). If no apparent peculiarity is perceived in the periods, it should be known on the basis of Sun.
verses.hindi: किर उघ सबका अवलोकन करके कपिल भगवान ने यह परम मुनुत
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, those who are conversant with the vedas accept this movement during the Parvan days (full moon, new moon, etc.). If no apparent peculiarity is perceived in the periods, it should be known on the basis of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, those who are conversant with the vedas accept this movement during the Parvan days (full moon, new moon, etc.). If no apparent peculiarity is perceived in the periods, it should be known on the basis of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: विपश्चिदिन्द्रो यश्चाभूत्तथा सत्यो हरिश्च तौ । स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे पूर्वमास्तां तौ तुषितासुतौ
verses.transliteration: vipaścidindro yaścābhūttathā satyo hariśca tau / svārociṣeṃ'tare pūrvamāstāṃ tau tuṣitāsutau
verses.translation: W. 47-53 give the distribution of different nakfatras (constella- tions) to different Vithis (divisions of planetary sphere comprising of three asterisms e.g. Alvin!, Bharazp and Krttiki constitute NdgavUhi; RohiI; Mrga; Ardri make Gqjarvfthi etc.
verses.hindi: वचन कहा था । ये सगर के पुत्र सत्र अपने ही कर्म से निर्दर होकर बिनष्ट होकर यितष्ट हो जायेंगे ।२९। जव भी इनके विनाश का काल प्राप्त होगा तभी नाण होगा । तब तक उस काल की आप सब लोग प्रतीक्षा कीजिए । और मैं तो उन दुष्ट आत्मा वालों के दिना करने का कारण बनू गा
verses.wordMeaning: W. 47-53 give the distribution of different nakfatras (constella- tions) to different Vithis (divisions of planetary sphere comprising of three asterisms e.g. Alvin!, Bharazp and Krttiki constitute NdgavUhi; RohiI; Mrga; Ardri make Gqjarvfthi etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 47-53 give the distribution of different nakfatras (constella- tions) to different Vithis (divisions of planetary sphere comprising of three asterisms e.g. Alvin!, Bharazp and Krttiki constitute NdgavUhi; RohiI; Mrga; Ardri make Gqjarvfthi etc.

verses.sanskrit: तुषितानां तु साध्यात्वे नामान्येतानि चक्षते । मनो ऽनुमन्ता प्राणश्च नरो ऽपानश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: tuṣitānāṃ tu sādhyātve nāmānyetāni cakṣate / mano 'numantā prāṇaśca naro 'pānaśca vīryavān
verses.translation: Fourteen other girls of great nobility and fortune, KaSyapa accepted as his wives. All of them are mothers of the worlds.1
verses.hindi: हे सुरश्रे "ठो ! आप लोगों के अं की सिद्धि के लिए केवल मैं कारण स्वरूप बनू'गा । महापापी ये सगर के पुत्र मेरे क्रोध की अस्ति से विप्लुष्ट होकर भस्मीभूत हो जायेंगे ।३१। ऐसा ही काल होगा कि इन सबको बुद्धि उपहृत हो जायगी और चिरकाल में इनका विनाश होगा। इसलिए सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Fourteen other girls of great nobility and fortune, KaSyapa accepted as his wives. All of them are mothers of the worlds.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Fourteen other girls of great nobility and fortune, KaSyapa accepted as his wives. All of them are mothers of the worlds.1

verses.sanskrit: वितिर्नयो हयश्चैव हंसो नारायणस्तथा । विभुश्चापि प्रभुश्चापि साध्या द्वादश जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: vitirnayo hayaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā / vibhuścāpi prabhuścāpi sādhyā dvādaśa jajñire
verses.translation: Since they were attached to (the worldly objects such as) sound, etc. of the worldly as well as Vedic tradition, and since they were entangled in the eightfold (Super human powers) like Animd (minuteness) etc., those Devas were reborn.
verses.hindi: देवों का दुःख दूर हो जायगा और सभी लोक सभी ओर से भयहीन हो जाँयगे ।३२। वे सभो बुरे आचरण वाले हो जायेंगे । इसलिए अब आप लोग सब निर्भय होकर अपनो पुरी की ओर गमन कीजिए ।३३। आप लोगों को कुछ काल की प्रतीक्षा अब्श्य हो करनी होगी । तभी आप अपने अभीप्सित
verses.wordMeaning: Since they were attached to (the worldly objects such as) sound, etc. of the worldly as well as Vedic tradition, and since they were entangled in the eightfold (Super human powers) like Animd (minuteness) etc., those Devas were reborn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they were attached to (the worldly objects such as) sound, etc. of the worldly as well as Vedic tradition, and since they were entangled in the eightfold (Super human powers) like Animd (minuteness) etc., those Devas were reborn.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवैंऽतरे पूर्वं ततः स्वारो चिषे पुनः । नामान्यासन्पुनस्तानि तुषितानां निबोधत
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuvaiṃ'tare pūrvaṃ tataḥ svāro ciṣe punaḥ / nāmānyāsanpunastāni tuṣitānāṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: VV. 55 give credit to Kasyapa for the creation of beings from his fourteen wives — ail daughters of Dak?a. This is another way of classifying the beings in the world in 14 classes or categories.
verses.hindi: की प्राप्ति करेंगे । जब इस प्रकार से कपिल मुनि के द्वारा देवगणों से कहा गया था तो इन्द्र के सहित सब देवों ने उनका अभिवादन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 55 give credit to Kasyapa for the creation of beings from his fourteen wives — ail daughters of Dak?a. This is another way of classifying the beings in the world in 14 classes or categories.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 55 give credit to Kasyapa for the creation of beings from his fourteen wives — ail daughters of Dak?a. This is another way of classifying the beings in the world in 14 classes or categories.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणापानावुदानश्च समानो व्यान एव च । चक्षुः श्रोत्रं रसो घ्राणं स्पर्शो बुद्धिर्मनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: prāṇāpānāvudānaśca samāno vyāna eva ca / cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ raso ghrāṇaṃ sparśo buddhirmanastathā
verses.translation: Thus, the. attachment to the worldly pleasures is remembered as the cause of rebirth. The Devas, named Jayas were born as Jitas in the Svayambhuva Manvantara due to the curse of Brahma. They were bom as Tusitas in the Svarocisa Manvantara; Satyas in the Uttama Manvantara. Those Devas were born as Haris in the Tamasa Manvantara; in the Man- vantara Arista va (Raivata), they were born as Vaikunthas; as Sadhyas in the Caksusa Manvantara, and as Adityas in the seventh (i.e. Vaivasvata) Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the. attachment to the worldly pleasures is remembered as the cause of rebirth. The Devas, named Jayas were born as Jitas in the Svayambhuva Manvantara due to the curse of Brahma. They were bom as Tusitas in the Svarocisa Manvantara; Satyas in the Uttama Manvantara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the. attachment to the worldly pleasures is remembered as the cause of rebirth. The Devas, named Jayas were born as Jitas in the Svayambhuva Manvantara due to the curse of Brahma. They were bom as Tusitas in the Svarocisa Manvantara; Satyas in the Uttama Manvantara.…

verses.sanskrit: नामान्येतानि वै पूर्वं तुषितानां स्मृतानि च । वसोस्तु वसवः पुत्राः साध्यानामनुजाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: nāmānyetāni vai pūrvaṃ tuṣitānāṃ smṛtāni ca / vasostu vasavaḥ putrāḥ sādhyānāmanujāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The noble lady, Surabhi, gave birth to two daughters also, viz. Rohlni of excellent loveliness and Gandharvi of great reputation.
verses.hindi: फिर उन मुनोश्वर को प्रणाम करके परम समाश्वस्त होकर उन सबने स्वर्ग की ओर प्रस्थान क्तिया था । इसो बोच में पृथिवी के स्वामी राजा सगर ने एक महान् यज्ञ करने का विचार मन में किया था
verses.wordMeaning: The noble lady, Surabhi, gave birth to two daughters also, viz. Rohlni of excellent loveliness and Gandharvi of great reputation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The noble lady, Surabhi, gave birth to two daughters also, viz. Rohlni of excellent loveliness and Gandharvi of great reputation.

verses.sanskrit: धरो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च आयुश्चैवानलो ऽनिलः । प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवो ऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āyuścaivānalo 'nilaḥ / pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo 'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Four daughters well-known in the worlds were bom of Rohinl. They were Surupa, Harhsakalf, Bhadra and Kamadugha.
verses.wordMeaning: Four daughters well-known in the worlds were bom of Rohinl. They were Surupa, Harhsakalf, Bhadra and Kamadugha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four daughters well-known in the worlds were bom of Rohinl. They were Surupa, Harhsakalf, Bhadra and Kamadugha.

verses.sanskrit: धरस्य पुत्रो द्रविणो हुतहव्यो रजस् तथा । ध्रुवपुत्रो ऽभवत्तात कालो लोकाप्रकालनः
verses.transliteration: dharasya putro draviṇo hutahavyo rajas tathā / dhruvaputro 'bhavattāta kālo lokāprakālanaḥ
verses.translation: Kamadugha gave birth to cows. Surupa gave birth to two sons. Haihsakall gave birth to buffaloes and species of sheep were born of Bhadra.
verses.wordMeaning: Kamadugha gave birth to cows. Surupa gave birth to two sons. Haihsakall gave birth to buffaloes and species of sheep were born of Bhadra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kamadugha gave birth to cows. Surupa gave birth to two sons. Haihsakall gave birth to buffaloes and species of sheep were born of Bhadra.

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य भगवान्वर्चा बुधश्च ग्रहबौधनः । धरोर्मी कलिलश्चैव पञ्च चन्द्रमसः सुताः
verses.transliteration: somasya bhagavānvarcā budhaśca grahabaudhanaḥ / dharormī kalilaścaiva pañca candramasaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: Horses of great splendour are the reputed sons of Gandharvi. They are Uccaissravas and others. They have the velocity of the mind and they traverse the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: Horses of great splendour are the reputed sons of Gandharvi. They are Uccaissravas and others. They have the velocity of the mind and they traverse the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Horses of great splendour are the reputed sons of Gandharvi. They are Uccaissravas and others. They have the velocity of the mind and they traverse the sky.

verses.sanskrit: आयस्य पुत्रो वैतण्ड्यः शमः शान्तस्तथैव च । स्कन्दः सनत्कुमारश्च जज्ञे पादेन तेजसः
verses.transliteration: āyasya putro vaitaṇḍyaḥ śamaḥ śāntastathaiva ca / skandaḥ sanatkumāraśca jajñe pādena tejasaḥ
verses.translation: The horses with Gandharvi as their mother (source of origin) are said to be the vehicles of the Devas. They are white, red, tawny, spotted, green, and grey in colour.
verses.wordMeaning: The horses with Gandharvi as their mother (source of origin) are said to be the vehicles of the Devas. They are white, red, tawny, spotted, green, and grey in colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses with Gandharvi as their mother (source of origin) are said to be the vehicles of the Devas. They are white, red, tawny, spotted, green, and grey in colour.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेः पुत्रं कुमारं तु स्वाहा जज्ञे श्रिया षृतम् । तस्य शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेयश्च प्रष्टजाः
verses.transliteration: agneḥ putraṃ kumāraṃ tu svāhā jajñe śriyā ṣṛtam / tasya śākho viśākhaśca naigameyaśca praṣṭajāḥ
verses.translation: Those three bodies of the self-born lord, it is remembered, exist in the three worlds. He adopts different forms and situations of his Kalas. with the various purposes in view.
verses.hindi: उस समय में वसिष्ठ मुनि की अनुरति से सगर नृपति ने अश्वमेध
verses.wordMeaning: Those three bodies of the self-born lord, it is remembered, exist in the three worlds. He adopts different forms and situations of his Kalas. with the various purposes in view.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those three bodies of the self-born lord, it is remembered, exist in the three worlds. He adopts different forms and situations of his Kalas. with the various purposes in view.

verses.sanskrit: अनिलस्य शिवा भार्या तस्याः पुत्रो मनोजवः । अविज्ञान गतिश्चैव द्वौ पुत्रावनिलस्य च
verses.transliteration: anilasya śivā bhāryā tasyāḥ putro manojavaḥ / avijñāna gatiścaiva dvau putrāvanilasya ca
verses.translation: He creates, blesses (i.e. maintains) and annihilates the subjects. Thus are remembered the three bodies of the self- born lord.
verses.hindi: नामक एक महान् यज्ञ के करने का मन में मनोरथ किया था और उस यज्ञ कार्य के सम्मादन करने के लिये सभी सम्मारों का समाहरण किया गया था ।३६। उस समय में और्व आदि जो विप्र बे उनके द्वारा राजा विधि-विधान के साथ दीक्षित हुआ था । जब राजा ने दीक्षा लेकर यज्ञ का समाचरण
verses.wordMeaning: He creates, blesses (i.e. maintains) and annihilates the subjects. Thus are remembered the three bodies of the self- born lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: He creates, blesses (i.e. maintains) and annihilates the subjects. Thus are remembered the three bodies of the self- born lord.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यूषस्य विदुः पुत्रमृषिं नाम्नाथ देवलम् । द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि क्षमावन्तौ मनीषिणौ
verses.transliteration: pratyūṣasya viduḥ putramṛṣiṃ nāmnātha devalam / dvau putrau devalasyāpi kṣamāvantau manīṣiṇau
verses.translation: These subjects are the same with the divine bodies) by means of unity and difference due to separateness. Those who perceive the different objects say "This is great (or different). This is not the same**.
verses.hindi: करने के लिये दीक्षा में प्रविष्ट हो गया था तो उसमें जो अश्व छोड़ा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: These subjects are the same with the divine bodies) by means of unity and difference due to separateness. Those who perceive the different objects say "This is great (or different). This is not the same**.
verses.commentary: Sense: These subjects are the same with the divine bodies) by means of unity and difference due to separateness. Those who perceive the different objects say "This is great (or different). This is not the same**.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेश्तु भगिनी भुवना ब्रह्मवादिनी । योगसिद्धा जगत्कृत्स्नमशक्ता चरति स्म ह
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspateśtu bhaginī bhuvanā brahmavādinī / yogasiddhā jagatkṛtsnamaśaktā carati sma ha
verses.translation: The persons (thus engaged in philosophical specu- lation) are influenced by their knowledge. They are confused in their minds as they are attached to unlucky omens* (?) They say these things after observing the Sattva (inherent strength), Kdla(t ime), DeSa (place), Kdrya (effect) and Karman (activity).
verses.hindi: है उसके भली भांति चारण करने के लिये नियुक्ति को थी ।३७। महा यशस्वी सगर ने उत सत्र सहस्र पुत्रों को अपने समीप में बुलाकर उनको
verses.wordMeaning: The persons (thus engaged in philosophical specu- lation) are influenced by their knowledge. They are confused in their minds as they are attached to unlucky omens* (?) They say these things after observing the Sattva (inherent strength), Kdla(t ime), DeSa (place),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The persons (thus engaged in philosophical specu- lation) are influenced by their knowledge. They are confused in their minds as they are attached to unlucky omens* (?) They say these things after observing the Sattva (inherent strength), Kdla(t ime), DeSa (place),…

verses.sanskrit: प्रभासस्य तु भार्या सा वसूनामष्टमस्य ह । विश्वकर्मा सुतस्तस्याः प्रजापतिपतिर्विभुः
verses.transliteration: prabhāsasya tu bhāryā sā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ha / viśvakarmā sutastasyāḥ prajāpatipatirvibhuḥ
verses.translation: These deities are remembered as the cause of the different affairs. A person who praises one, praises all.
verses.hindi: आदेश दिया था । इस अश्व को इस पृथ्वी तल में चारों ओर चारण कराने को गमन करो ।३८! फिर है पुत्रो ! शीघ्र ही आप लोग घुमाकर इस अश्व को फिर मेरे पास ले आओ । जेमिनि मुनि ने कहा--इसके अनन्तर उन
verses.wordMeaning: These deities are remembered as the cause of the different affairs. A person who praises one, praises all.
verses.commentary: Sense: These deities are remembered as the cause of the different affairs. A person who praises one, praises all.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवास्तु विश्वाया जज्ञिरे दश विश्रुताः । क्रतुर्दक्षः श्रवः सत्यः कालः मुनिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: viśvedevāstu viśvāyā jajñire daśa viśrutāḥ / kraturdakṣaḥ śravaḥ satyaḥ kālaḥ munistathā
verses.translation: He who censures one censures all. Hence, no one who knows these, should have hatred towards the deities.
verses.hindi: रों ने अपने पी आज्ञा से उस अश्व को वहाँसे अपने साथ में ले लिया था ।३९। उन्होंने उस अश्व को समस्त प्रथिबी तल में चारों ओर घुमाया था । दिधि को प्रेरणा से ही बह अश्व भूमि में परिवत्तित हो गया था ।४०। उस राजा ने अश्व को दिग्विजय करने के लिये तथा करों का
verses.wordMeaning: He who censures one censures all. Hence, no one who knows these, should have hatred towards the deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who censures one censures all. Hence, no one who knows these, should have hatred towards the deities.

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरवो मार्द्रवसो रोचमानश्च ते दश । धर्मपुत्राः सुरा एते विश्वायां जज्ञिरे शुभाः
verses.transliteration: purūravo mārdravaso rocamānaśca te daśa / dharmaputrāḥ surā ete viśvāyāṃ jajñire śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Isvaras (gods) who are well established in their prowess and majesty cannot be understood perfectly. From unity (the lord) assumed three forms and confounded the subjects.
verses.hindi: आदान करने के लिये तो छोड़ा ही नहीं था क्योंकि समस्त नुषों को तो
verses.wordMeaning: Isvaras (gods) who are well established in their prowess and majesty cannot be understood perfectly. From unity (the lord) assumed three forms and confounded the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Isvaras (gods) who are well established in their prowess and majesty cannot be understood perfectly. From unity (the lord) assumed three forms and confounded the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वत्यां मरुत्वन्तो भानवो भानुजाः स्मृताः । मुहूर्ताश्च मुहूर्ताया घोषलंबा ह्यजायत
verses.transliteration: marutvatyāṃ marutvanto bhānavo bhānujāḥ smṛtāḥ / muhūrtāśca muhūrtāyā ghoṣalaṃbā hyajāyata
verses.translation: People try to find out the difference amongst these three. Those who are desirous of knowing wish ( for' knowledge). They are attached. They are vicious. They are confounded in their minds.
verses.hindi: नृषों को समर में कर देने वाले वन) लिया था । इसके पश्चात् जब वह अश्व दिखाई नहीं दिया था तो फिर उन समस्त राजपुत्रो ने जल से रहित क्षार सागर के पास गमन किया था ।४२। उस अश्व को परिवारित करके उन सबने भूतल के अन्दर प्रसम्न होकर प्रवेश किया था
verses.wordMeaning: People try to find out the difference amongst these three. Those who are desirous of knowing wish ( for' knowledge). They are attached. They are vicious. They are confounded in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: People try to find out the difference amongst these three. Those who are desirous of knowing wish ( for' knowledge). They are attached. They are vicious. They are confounded in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पायां तु संजज्ञे विद्वान्संकल्प एव तु । नव वीथ्यस्तु जामायाः पथत्रयमुपाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpāyāṃ tu saṃjajñe vidvānsaṃkalpa eva tu / nava vīthyastu jāmāyāḥ pathatrayamupāśritāḥ
verses.translation: They see diversity because they say, "This is different. This is *not" ( the same) in their overeagemess and
verses.hindi: विचित्य पृथिवीं ते तु स पृराचज्तकाननाम् । अपश्यंतो यज्ञपश्' दुःखं महदवाण्नुवन्
verses.wordMeaning: They see diversity because they say, "This is different. This is *not" ( the same) in their overeagemess and
verses.commentary: Sense: They see diversity because they say, "This is different. This is *not" ( the same) in their overeagemess and

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी विषयं सर्वमरुन्धत्यामजायत । एष सर्गः समाख्यातो विद्वान्धर्मस्य शाश्वतः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivī viṣayaṃ sarvamarundhatyāmajāyata / eṣa sargaḥ samākhyāto vidvāndharmasya śāśvataḥ
verses.translation: (The supreme lord) is one but remains separate deluding the subjects by means of his bodies consisting of the Gunas.
verses.hindi: ततोऽयोध्यां समासाच ऋषिभिः परिवारिताम् । ईष्टवा प्रणम्य पितरं तस्मे सवं न्यवेदयन् ।
verses.wordMeaning: (The supreme lord) is one but remains separate deluding the subjects by means of his bodies consisting of the Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The supreme lord) is one but remains separate deluding the subjects by means of his bodies consisting of the Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्ताश्चैव तिथ्याश्च प्रतिभिः सह सुव्रताः । नामतः संप्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: muhūrtāścaiva tithyāśca pratibhiḥ saha suvratāḥ / nāmataḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bruvato me nibodhata
verses.translation: He who worships one among them, worships all the three. Hence, these three Devas (i.e. deities) are well establish- ed closely without difference.
verses.wordMeaning: He who worships one among them, worships all the three. Hence, these three Devas (i.e. deities) are well establish- ed closely without difference.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who worships one among them, worships all the three. Hence, these three Devas (i.e. deities) are well establish- ed closely without difference.

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रविभागश्च नक्षत्राणि समाश्रितः । मुहुर्त्ताः सर्वनक्षत्रा अहोरात्रभिदस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ahorātravibhāgaśca nakṣatrāṇi samāśritaḥ / muhurttāḥ sarvanakṣatrā ahorātrabhidastathā
verses.translation: Hence, he creates, blesses (i.e. protects) and swallows in all respects. He is, therefore, called one when there is no identification with the Gunas.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, he creates, blesses (i.e. protects) and swallows in all respects. He is, therefore, called one when there is no identification with the Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, he creates, blesses (i.e. protects) and swallows in all respects. He is, therefore, called one when there is no identification with the Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रकलानां तु षडशीत्यधिकाः स्मृताः । रवेर्गति विशेषेण सर्वर्त्तुषु च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: ahorātrakalānāṃ tu ṣaḍaśītyadhikāḥ smṛtāḥ / ravergati viśeṣeṇa sarvarttuṣu ca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: The three bodies viz. Prajapatya, Raudri and Vai§navi recur again and again in different Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: जैमिनि मुनि ने कहा--वे सगर के पुत्र जव वहाँ प्रविष्ट हो गये ये तो इसके अनन्तर इन्द्रदेव के द्वारा प्रेरणा प्राप्त करके वायु ने उसी क्षण में उस अश्व का हरण करके रसातल में पहुँचा दिया था।१। जब उन सगर पुत्रों ने वहाँ कहीं पर भी उत्त अश्व को नहीं देखा था । वायु देव ने उसका
verses.wordMeaning: The three bodies viz. Prajapatya, Raudri and Vai§navi recur again and again in different Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three bodies viz. Prajapatya, Raudri and Vai§navi recur again and again in different Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वेदविदश्चैतां गतिमिच्छन्ति पर्वसु । अविशेषेषु कालेषु ज्ञेयः सवितृमानतः
verses.transliteration: tato vedavidaścaitāṃ gatimicchanti parvasu / aviśeṣeṣu kāleṣu jñeyaḥ savitṛmānataḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, these bodies of Brahma again and again re-appeared for the purpose of creation (etc. ) in all the three units of time (past, present, future), here in different Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: अपहरण करके है राजन् ! उसी मागे से कपिल मुनि के समीप में पहुँचा दिया था ।२। उस अश्व के वहाँ पर न दिखलाई देने पर सब नृप के पुत्र बहुत ही अधिक वेवेत हो गये ये और सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वी परिक्रमा लगाकर उस अश्व को खोज कर रहे ये ।३। उन्होंने पहिले सम्पूर्ण भूतल पर उस अश्व
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, these bodies of Brahma again and again re-appeared for the purpose of creation (etc. ) in all the three units of time (past, present, future), here in different Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, these bodies of Brahma again and again re-appeared for the purpose of creation (etc. ) in all the three units of time (past, present, future), here in different Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रः सार्पस्तथा मैत्रः पित्र्यो वासव एव च । आप्यो ऽथ वैश्वदेवश्च ब्राह्मो मध्याह्नसंश्रितः
verses.transliteration: raudraḥ sārpastathā maitraḥ pitryo vāsava eva ca / āpyo 'tha vaiśvadevaśca brāhmo madhyāhnasaṃśritaḥ
verses.translation: All the subjects, both mobile and immobile, are bom once simultaneously at the beginning of the Yugas in all the Manvantaras and they continue to stay till their destruc- tion and withdrawal (at the time of Pralaya).
verses.hindi: को ढूढ़ा था फिर सव नगर-पर्वंत और बनो में उसकी खोज की थी । जब उन्होंने कहीं पर भो उक यज्ञ के पशु अश्व को नहीं देखा था तो उन सबके हृदयों में बड़ा भारी दु:ख हुआ था ।४। फिर वे सब अनेक ऋषियों से घिरो हुई अयोध्या पुरो में समागत हो गये थे । अपने पिता सगर का दर्शन
verses.wordMeaning: All the subjects, both mobile and immobile, are bom once simultaneously at the beginning of the Yugas in all the Manvantaras and they continue to stay till their destruc- tion and withdrawal (at the time of Pralaya).
verses.commentary: Sense: All the subjects, both mobile and immobile, are bom once simultaneously at the beginning of the Yugas in all the Manvantaras and they continue to stay till their destruc- tion and withdrawal (at the time of Pralaya).

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यस्तथैवेन्द्र इन्द्राग्नी निरृतिस्तथा । वारुणश्च यथार्यम्णो भगश्चापि दिनश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyastathaivendra indrāgnī nirṛtistathā / vāruṇaśca yathāryamṇo bhagaścāpi dinaśritāḥ
verses.translation: Whenever the Kalpa comes to an end, Rudra annihilates the subjects. It is after becoming Kala again that Rudra, the soul of the Yugas, annihilates the subjects).
verses.hindi: कर उन्होंने प्रणाम करके समी घटित घटना के विषय में अपने पिता से निवेदन किया था ।५। उन्होंते कहा--हम सबने पूरो पृथ्वी की परिक्रमा करके फिर वरुणालय (सागर) में प्रवेश किया था । हम उस अश्व को बरा- बर देखते रहे थे किन्तु हमारे द्वारा रक्षा किया हुआ भो बह अश्व को किसी
verses.wordMeaning: Whenever the Kalpa comes to an end, Rudra annihilates the subjects. It is after becoming Kala again that Rudra, the soul of the Yugas, annihilates the subjects).
verses.commentary: Sense: Whenever the Kalpa comes to an end, Rudra annihilates the subjects. It is after becoming Kala again that Rudra, the soul of the Yugas, annihilates the subjects).

verses.sanskrit: एते दिनमुहूर्ताश्च दिवाकरविनिर्मिताः । शङ्कुच्छाया विशेषेण वेदितव्याः प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: ete dinamuhūrtāśca divākaravinirmitāḥ / śaṅkucchāyā viśeṣeṇa veditavyāḥ pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: When the end of the Kalpa arrives, the sun of seven rays assumes the form of S&rhvartakaditya (the sun of final annihilation) and bums down the three worlds.
verses.hindi: के द्वारा सहसा हरणकर लिया गया है ।६। जब इस रीति से उनके द्वारा राजा सगर से कहा गया था तो यह सुनकर उसको बड़ा भारी क्रोध हो गया था ओर उस उत्तमनृप ने उन सबसे यह कहा था-सुम सव बड़े पापो हो, महाँ से इसी समय निकलकर चले जाओ और फिर लौटकर
verses.wordMeaning: When the end of the Kalpa arrives, the sun of seven rays assumes the form of S&rhvartakaditya (the sun of final annihilation) and bums down the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the end of the Kalpa arrives, the sun of seven rays assumes the form of S&rhvartakaditya (the sun of final annihilation) and bums down the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यः पूषाश्वियमदेवताः । आग्नेयश्चापि विज्ञेयः प्राजापत्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pūṣāśviyamadevatāḥ / āgneyaścāpi vijñeyaḥ prājāpatyastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Visnu protects the subjects always. He is the bestower of blessings on the subjects. In different situations, he causes the (requisite) reasons to be produced (for the same ).
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu protects the subjects always. He is the bestower of blessings on the subjects. In different situations, he causes the (requisite) reasons to be produced (for the same ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu protects the subjects always. He is the bestower of blessings on the subjects. In different situations, he causes the (requisite) reasons to be produced (for the same ).

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यश्चापि तथादित्यो बार्हस्पत्यश्च वैष्मवः । सावित्रश्च तथा त्वाष्ट्रो वायव्यश्चेति संग्रहः
verses.transliteration: saumyaścāpi tathādityo bārhaspatyaśca vaiṣmavaḥ / sāvitraśca tathā tvāṣṭro vāyavyaśceti saṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: By means of three steps. Lord Visnu incarnated as Trivikrama, conquered all these (three worlds) and handed them over to Indra accompanied by all the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: By means of three steps. Lord Visnu incarnated as Trivikrama, conquered all these (three worlds) and handed them over to Indra accompanied by all the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of three steps. Lord Visnu incarnated as Trivikrama, conquered all these (three worlds) and handed them over to Indra accompanied by all the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एते रात्रेर्मुहूर्त्ताः स्युः क्रमोक्ता दश पञ्च च । इन्दोर्गत्युदया ज्ञेया नाडिका आदितस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ete rātrermuhūrttāḥ syuḥ kramoktā daśa pañca ca / indorgatyudayā jñeyā nāḍikā āditastathā
verses.translation: Thus these bodies were bom seven times in the course of the seven Manvantaras that have passed by and the subjects have been protected by these bodies.
verses.hindi: तुम सबने जीवित रहते हुए ही किस तरह से उस अश्व को श्लो दिया हे! तुम बड़े डरपोक हो । जब बह अश्व हो नहीं हैं तो उसके बिना आप सबका यहाँ पर आगमन सचमुच नहीं होना चाहिए ।=। इसके अनन्तर वे सब इकट्ठे होकर वहाँ से प्रयाण कर गये ये और परस्पर में कहते थे कि
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these bodies were bom seven times in the course of the seven Manvantaras that have passed by and the subjects have been protected by these bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these bodies were bom seven times in the course of the seven Manvantaras that have passed by and the subjects have been protected by these bodies.

verses.sanskrit: कालावस्थास्त्विमास्त्वेते मुहूर्त्ता देवताः स्मृताः । सर्वग्रहाणां त्रीण्येव स्थानानि विहितानि च
verses.transliteration: kālāvasthāstvimāstvete muhūrttā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ / sarvagrahāṇāṃ trīṇyeva sthānāni vihitāni ca
verses.translation: W. 112-123 give' the different incarnations of Viu in different manvantaras and his accomplishment as Trivikrama.
verses.hindi: अभी तक भो बहू अश्‍ब कही पर भी दिखलाई नहीं दे रहा है। हम अब क्या करें ।६। हमने सम्पूर्ण बसुधा तो देख डालो है और पर्वत-वन और कानन भी देख लिये हैं किन्तु वह अश्‍व कहीं पर भी दिखाई नहीं दे रहा है । अश्व का दिखाई देना तो दूर रहा, उसको कहीं पर चर्चा भी नहीं हो
verses.wordMeaning: W. 112-123 give' the different incarnations of Viu in different manvantaras and his accomplishment as Trivikrama.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 112-123 give' the different incarnations of Viu in different manvantaras and his accomplishment as Trivikrama.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणोत्तरमध्यानि तानि विद्याद्यथाक्रमम् । स्थानं जारद्गवं सध्ये तथैरावतमुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇottaramadhyāni tāni vidyādyathākramam / sthānaṃ jāradgavaṃ sadhye tathairāvatamuttaram
verses.translation: They are anterior to me (i.e. Suta). Hence, they are more potential lords. Just as the persons who point out the Truth, so also they make use of these bases (?).
verses.hindi: रही है कि बह कहाँ पर होकर निकला था ।१०। इसलिए समुद्र से आरम्भ करके पाताल पर्यन्त इस भूमि का विभाजन कर खोद डालें और पाताल में उस अश्व की खोज करें।१। फिर लगर के पुत्रों ने यही अपना विचार बना लिया था और उन सबका यह बड़ा ही कूर निश्चय था। उन सबने
verses.wordMeaning: They are anterior to me (i.e. Suta). Hence, they are more potential lords. Just as the persons who point out the Truth, so also they make use of these bases (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: They are anterior to me (i.e. Suta). Hence, they are more potential lords. Just as the persons who point out the Truth, so also they make use of these bases (?).

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरं दक्षिणतो निर्दिष्टमिह तत्त्वतः । अश्विनी कृत्तिका याम्यं नागवीथीति विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānaraṃ dakṣiṇato nirdiṣṭamiha tattvataḥ / aśvinī kṛttikā yāmyaṃ nāgavīthīti viśrutā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: समुद्र के तट से आरम्भ करके सब आर से उस भूमि को खोदना आरम्भ कर दिया था ।२१। उनके द्वारा खोदो जाने वाली भूमि बहुत ही बेचैन होती हुई उत्पोड़ित हुई थी । उन सबके इस महान भीषण कृत्य को देखकर समस्त प्राणी रोने लग गये ये ।१३। इसके पश्चात उन्होने भूमण्डल में
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं सौम्यं तथार्द्रा च गजवीथीति शब्दिता । पुष्याश्लेषे तथादित्यं वीथी चैरावती मता
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṃ saumyaṃ tathārdrā ca gajavīthīti śabditā / puṣyāśleṣe tathādityaṃ vīthī cairāvatī matā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: भारतखण्ड को खोदकर संक्षिप्त कर दिया था ओर भूमि के एक सहस्र योजन भाग को सागर के स्वरूप में योजित कर दिया था जिससे यह भूभाग कम हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.transliteration: hastaścitrā tathā svātī govīthīti tu śabditā / jyeṣṭhā viśākhānurādhā vīthī jāradgavī matā

verses.sanskrit: एतास्तु वीथयस्तिस्रो मध्यमो मार्ग उच्यते । मूलं पूर्वोत्तराषाढे अजवीथ्याभिशब्दिते
verses.transliteration: etāstu vīthayastisro madhyamo mārga ucyate / mūlaṃ pūrvottarāṣāḍhe ajavīthyābhiśabdite

verses.sanskrit: श्रवणं च धनिष्ठा च मार्गी शतभिषक्तथा । वैश्वानरी भाद्रपदे रेवती चैव कीर्त्तिता
verses.transliteration: śravaṇaṃ ca dhaniṣṭhā ca mārgī śatabhiṣaktathā / vaiśvānarī bhādrapade revatī caiva kīrttitā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: एतास्तु वीथयस्तिस्रो दक्षिणे मार्ग उच्यते । अष्टाविशति याः कन्या दक्षः सोमाय ता ददौ
verses.transliteration: etāstu vīthayastisro dakṣiṇe mārga ucyate / aṣṭāviśati yāḥ kanyā dakṣaḥ somāya tā dadau
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वा नक्षत्रनाम्न्यस्ता ज्यौतिषे परिकीर्त्तिताः । तासामपत्यान्यभवन्दीप्तयो ऽमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: sarvā nakṣatranāmnyastā jyautiṣe parikīrttitāḥ / tāsāmapatyānyabhavandīptayo 'mitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: उन तृप के पुत्रों ने उस समय भूमि को खोदते हुए पाताल लोक के तसे तक खोद डाला था और उसके अन्दर पाताल में फिर उस अश्व को देखा था ।१५। फिर जब उनको वह यज्ञ का अश्व वहाँ दिखाई पड़ गया तो सब चारों ओर से एकत्रित होकर वहुत अधिक प्रसन्न हुए थे । उनका
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: यास्तु शेषास्तदा कन्याः प्रतिजग्राह कश्यपः । चतुर्दशा महाभागाः सर्वास्ता लोकमातरः
verses.transliteration: yāstu śeṣāstadā kanyāḥ pratijagrāha kaśyapaḥ / caturdaśā mahābhāgāḥ sarvāstā lokamātaraḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: बहुत अधिक सन्तोष हो गया था । उनमें कुछ तो बहुत अधिक हॅसने लगे थे और कुछ परमानन्दित होते हुए नाचने लग गये ये ।१६। वहाँ पर महान आत्मा बाले कपिल मुनि का देन किया था जो कि परम वृद्ध थे और तेज से देदीप्यमान हो रहे ये । उन्होने पद्मासन बांध रक्खा या । इस तरह से
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्दितिर्दनुः काष्ठारिष्टानायुः खशा तथा । सुरभिर्विनता ताम्रा मुनिः क्रोधवशा तथा
verses.transliteration: aditirditirdanuḥ kāṣṭhāriṣṭānāyuḥ khaśā tathā / surabhirvinatā tāmrā muniḥ krodhavaśā tathā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: बेठकर अपने नेत्रों को नासिका के अग्रमाग लगाकर ध्यान में योग क्रिया के अनुसार मग्न हो रहे ये ।१७। उनका मिर और गरीवा एकदम सीधे ये और आगे की ओर उनका वक्षःस्थल विष्टवत्र या । उनका परिपूर्ण तेज सभी ओर मे अभिसरण कर रहा था अर्थात् उतका अपना आत्म तेज उनके चारों ओर
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूर्माता च नागानां प्रजास्तासां निबोधत । स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे तात ये द्वादश सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kadrūrmātā ca nāgānāṃ prajāstāsāṃ nibodhata / svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare tāta ye dvādaśa surottamāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: एक मण्डलाकार में उद्दोप्त होकर दिखाई दे रहा था ।१८। जिस तरह से निर्वात स्थान में एक रस दीपक की सौ प्रकाशित हुआ करती है कि उसी भाँति से सब ओर उनका तेज प्रकाशित होता हुआ दिखाई दे रहा था। उनके अपने अन्तःकरण में प्रकाशित जो विज्ञान था उसी से परिपूर्ण उतका
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठा नाम ते साध्या बभूवुश्चाक्षुषेंऽतरे । उपस्थितेंऽतरे ह्यस्मिन्पुनर्वैवस्वतस्य ह
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭhā nāma te sādhyā babhūvuścākṣuṣeṃ'tare / upasthiteṃ'tare hyasminpunarvaivasvatasya ha
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: कलेवर या ।१६। समाधि में उनका संलग्त चित्त छिपे हुए समुद्र के ही
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: आराधिता आदित्या ते समेत्योचुः परस्परम् । एतामेव महाभागामदितिं संप्रविश्य वै
verses.transliteration: ārādhitā ādityā te sametyocuḥ parasparam / etāmeva mahābhāgāmaditiṃ saṃpraviśya vai
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: समान था ओर बे विधि के साथ योगाभ्यास में समाझ्ड़ होकर अपने ध्येय. परब्रह्म में संलग्न मन वाले ये ।२०। उन्होंने परम शाम्त योगीन्द्रं में अधिक श्रेष्ठ मुनि का अवलोकन किया तो ऐसा उस समय में आभास हो रहा था कि यह कोई जनतो हुई ज्वालाओं को मालाओं से परिपूर्ण साक्षात् अग्नि
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेंऽतरे ह्यस्मिन्योगादर्द्धेन तेजसा । गच्छेम पुत्रतामस्यास्तन्नः श्रेयो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: vaivasvateṃ'tare hyasminyogādarddhena tejasā / gacchema putratāmasyāstannaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati

verses.hindi: का ही स्वरूप है। जब उनको समाधि स्थित सबने देखा था तो सव आपस में विजार करने लगे चे कि यह अत्यधिक तेजस्वी कौन महापुरुष है
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu te sarve varttamāneṃ'tare tadā / jajñire dvādaśādityā mārīyātkaśyapātpunaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: शतक्रतुश्च विष्णुश्च जज्ञाते पुनरेव हि । वैवस्वतेंऽतरे ह्यस्मिन्नरनारायणौ तदा
verses.transliteration: śatakratuśca viṣṇuśca jajñāte punareva hi / vaivasvateṃ'tare hyasminnaranārāyaṇau tadā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामपि हि देवानां निधनोत्पत्तिरुच्यते । यथा सूर्यस्य लोके ऽस्मिन्नुदयास्तमयावुभौ
verses.transliteration: teṣāmapi hi devānāṃ nidhanotpattirucyate / yathā sūryasya loke 'sminnudayāstamayāvubhau
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭānuśravike yasmātsaktāḥ śabdādilakṣaṇe / aṣṭātmake 'ṇimādye ca tasmātte jajñire surāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष विषये रागः संभूत्याः कारणं स्मृतम् । ब्रह्मशापेन संभूता जयाः स्वायंभुवे जिताः
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa viṣaye rāgaḥ saṃbhūtyāḥ kāraṇaṃ smṛtam / brahmaśāpena saṃbhūtā jayāḥ svāyaṃbhuve jitāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषे वै तुषिताः सत्यश्चैवोत्तमे पुनः । तामसे हरयो देवा जाताश्चा रिष्टवे तु वै
verses.transliteration: svārociṣe vai tuṣitāḥ satyaścaivottame punaḥ / tāmase harayo devā jātāścā riṣṭave tu vai
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठाश्चाश्रुषे साध्या आदित्याः सप्तमे पुनः । धातार्यमा च मित्रश्च वरुण्ॐऽशो भगस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭhāścāśruṣe sādhyā ādityāḥ saptame punaḥ / dhātāryamā ca mitraśca varuṇoṃ'śo bhagastathā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो विवस्वान्पूषा च पर्जन्यो दशमः स्मृतः । ततस्त्वष्टा ततो विष्णुरजघन्यो जघन्यजः
verses.transliteration: indro vivasvānpūṣā ca parjanyo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ / tatastvaṣṭā tato viṣṇurajaghanyo jaghanyajaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: हे राजन ! मुहूर्त मात्र समय तक तो दङ्ग से होकर रह गये ये और उनको बड़ा भारी डर लगा था । फिर भावी को प्रबलता से प्रेरित होकर उन सगर के पुत्रों ने बही निश्चय बना लिवा कि हो न हो यही इस अश्व के हरण करने वाला है ।२२। उन दुष्ट आत्माओं वालों ने परम श्रेष्ठ मुनि
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते द्वादशादित्याः कश्यपस्य सुता विभोः । सुरभ्यां कश्यपाद्रुद्रा एकादश विजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: ityete dvādaśādityāḥ kaśyapasya sutā vibhoḥ / surabhyāṃ kaśyapādrudrā ekādaśa vijajñire
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: कपिल को चारों ओर पेर लिया द्या और घेरा डालकर उन्होने कहा था- यही चोर है-इसमें लेश भर भो संशय नहीं हैं।२३। क्योंकि इसने अश्‍व का अपहरण किया है इसलिए इस बुरे विचार वाले का हमको वध कर
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवप्रसादेन तपसा भाविता सती । अङ्गारकं तथा सर्पं निरृतिं सदसत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: mahādevaprasādena tapasā bhāvitā satī / aṅgārakaṃ tathā sarpaṃ nirṛtiṃ sadasatpatim
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
