verses.sanskrit: अचैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यौ द्वावेकं च ज्वरं तथा । भुवनं चेश्वरं मृत्युं कपालीति च विशुतम्
verses.transliteration: acaikapādahirbudhnyau dvāvekaṃ ca jvaraṃ tathā / bhuvanaṃ ceśvaraṃ mṛtyuṃ kapālīti ca viśutam
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: डालना चाहिए । उन सबकी बुद्धि तो होनहार के व क्षीण हो गयी थी और उनकी मृत्यु निकट में प्राप्त हो रहो यी ' उन सबने योगासीन उस मुनि को एक साधारण मनुष्य के हो समान सहसा धर्षित किया था अर्थात् डाट- फटकार सगाना आरम्भ कर दिया था । जेमिनो मुनि ने कहा--इसके
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: देवानेकादशैतांस्तु रुद्रांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् । तपसोग्रेण महाता सुरभिस्तानजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: devānekādaśaitāṃstu rudrāṃstribhuvaneśvarān / tapasogreṇa mahātā surabhistānajījanat
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: पश्चात् यह हुआ या कि जब उन सबने बहुत शोर मचाया तो मुनि का ध्यान टूट गया था और अत्युच्च आत्मा बाले मुनि कपिल प्रधषित हो गये ये ।२४-२५। उस समय में ध्यान के भङ्ग हो जाने से कपिल मुनि को महान् क्रोध हो गया था ओर उस समय में विष्ट उनके हृदय में बड़ा भारी क्षोभ
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुहितरावन्ये सुरभिर्देव्यजायत । रोहिणी चैव सुभगां गान्धवी च यशस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration: tato duhitarāvanye surabhirdevyajāyata / rohiṇī caiva subhagāṃ gāndhavī ca yaśasvinīm
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: हो गया था । वे तो इतने तेजस्वो ये कि उनके ऊपर किसी का भी प्रभाव नहीं पड़ सकता था और उनका दबा देना महान कठिन था। जब उन दुरात्माओं ने धषित करने का प्रयास किया था तो वे संचलित हो गये थे । उस समय में कपिल मुनि ऐसे ही करोधवेज़ में देदीप्यमान दिखाई पड़ रहे
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: रोहिण्या जज्ञिरे कन्याश्चतस्रो लोकविश्रुताः । सुरूपा हंसकाली च भद्रा कामदुघा तथा
verses.transliteration: rohiṇyā jajñire kanyāścatasro lokaviśrutāḥ / surūpā haṃsakālī ca bhadrā kāmadughā tathā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: थे जेसे कल्प के अन्त में सर्व संहारक वासे प्रेरित अग्नि होता है । उस समय में समुद्र के समान परभ गम्भीर उनके शरीर से कोपाग्ि निकल रही थी ।२६-२७। बह सर्वसंहारक क्रोधारित पाताल लोकों को दग्ध करने बाले के ही समान था और धर्षंण अर्थात् फटकार से जो क्रोध उत्पन्न हो
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सुषुवे गाः कामदुघा सुरूपा तनयद्वयम् । हंसकाली तु महिषान्भद्रायस्त्वविजातयः
verses.transliteration: suṣuve gāḥ kāmadughā surūpā tanayadvayam / haṃsakālī tu mahiṣānbhadrāyastvavijātayaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: गया था उसके होने से अत्यधिक प्रदीप्न होकर वह शोभित हो रहा था
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: विश्रुतास्तु महाभागा गान्धर्व्या वाजिनः सुताः । उच्चैःश्रवादयो जाताः खेचरास्ते मनोजवाः
verses.transliteration: viśrutāstu mahābhāgā gāndharvyā vājinaḥ sutāḥ / uccaiḥśravādayo jātāḥ khecarāste manojavāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: उन्मीलयत्तदा नेत्रे वहिनचक्रसमद्य ति: । तबाक्षिणी क्षणं राजन्राजेतां सुभृशारुणे
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेताः शोणाः पिशङ्गास्च सारङ्गा हरि तार्जुनाः । उक्ता देवोपवाह्यास्ते गान्धर्वियोनयो हयाः
verses.transliteration: śvetāḥ śoṇāḥ piśaṅgāsca sāraṅgā hari tārjunāḥ / uktā devopavāhyāste gāndharviyonayo hayāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: भूयो जज्ञे सुरभ्यास्तु श्रीमांश्चन्द्रप्रभो वृषः । स्रग्वी ककुद्मान्द्युतिमा नमृतालयसंभवः
verses.transliteration: bhūyo jajñe surabhyāstu śrīmāṃścandraprabho vṛṣaḥ / sragvī kakudmāndyutimā namṛtālayasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: क्र द्वस्य तस्य नेत्राभ्यां सहसा पावकाचिषः
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सुरभ्यनुमते दत्तो ध्वजो माहेश्वरस्तु सः । इत्येते कश्यपसुता रुद्रादित्याः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: surabhyanumate datto dhvajo māheśvarastu saḥ / ityete kaśyapasutā rudrādityāḥ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपु पुत्राः स्मृताः साध्या विश्वे च वसवस्तथा । यथेन्धनवशाद्वह्निरेकस्तु बहुधा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmapu putrāḥ smṛtāḥ sādhyā viśve ca vasavastathā / yathendhanavaśādvahnirekastu bahudhā bhavet
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: भवत्येकस्तथा तद्वन्मूर्त्तीनां स पिता महः । एको ब्रह्मान्तकश्चैव पुरुषश्चैति तत्र यः
verses.transliteration: bhavatyekastathā tadvanmūrttīnāṃ sa pitā mahaḥ / eko brahmāntakaścaiva puruṣaścaiti tatra yaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्यैताः स्मृतास्तिस्रस्तनवस्तु स्वयंभुवः । ब्राह्मी च पौरुषी चैव कालाख्या चेति ताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ekasyaitāḥ smṛtāstisrastanavastu svayaṃbhuvaḥ / brāhmī ca pauruṣī caiva kālākhyā ceti tāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: उस समय में कपिल मुनि ने अग्नि मण्डल के समान अपने नेत्रों को खोला था । है राजन् ! उनकी दोनों आँखें अण भर तो अत्यधिक अरुण
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: या तत्र राजसी तस्य तनुः सा वै प्रजाकरी । मता सा या तु कालाख्या प्रजाक्षयकरी तु सा
verses.transliteration: yā tatra rājasī tasya tanuḥ sā vai prajākarī / matā sā yā tu kālākhyā prajākṣayakarī tu sā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: में समुदित अम्बर में दो पुष्यो के ही सहन प्रतीत हो रहे ये । इसके अनम्तर ही उन्होंने अपने खुले हुए नेतरो को उन सब नृप सगर के पुत्रों पर डाला था ।३०। संहार के समय में यमराज के हो तुल्य अत्यन्त गम्मोर मुनि ने नृप सुतों को ओर देखा था । अत्यधिक रोध तो समाधि के भज होने से
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकी पौरुषी या तु सा तनुः पालिका स्मृता । राजसी ब्रह्मणो या तु मारीचः कश्यपो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: sāttvikī pauruṣī yā tu sā tanuḥ pālikā smṛtā / rājasī brahmaṇo yā tu mārīcaḥ kaśyapo 'bhavat
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: उनको हो ही रहा या । परम क़ उनके नेत्रं से अग्नि की ज्वालायें निकल रही थीं ।३१। ओर वे ज्वालाएं कालाग्नि के ही समान दिशाओं में सभी ओर फली हुई थो । यूम के समूहों से युक्त वे ज्वालाएः अत्यन्त आगे की ओर बढ़ रहो थीं और बारम्बार उनमें से अग्ति के कण छूटकर निकल रहे
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: तामसी चान्तकृद्या तु तदंशो विष्णुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tāmasī cāntakṛdyā tu tadaṃśo viṣṇurucyate
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: थे ।३२। क्रोधारित को ज्ञालाओं ने सभी ओर दिशाओं को व्याप्त कर दिया था । उनके नेत्रो से निकलने वालो क्रोबाग्नि की ज्वालाए' कालोदर के उग्र कुहरो वाली थीं तात्प यह है कि ज्यालाओं के मण्डल की ऐसी व्याप्ति हो गयी थी । उस समय में कुहरे के समान कुछ भी दिखलाई नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्ये ताः स्मृतास्तिस्रस्तनवो वै प्रजाकरी । मता सा या तु कालाख्या प्रजाक्षयकरी तु सा
verses.transliteration: trailokye tāḥ smṛtāstisrastanavo vai prajākarī / matā sā yā tu kālākhyā prajākṣayakarī tu sā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: दे रहा था ।३३। है सुमहाराज ! उनके क्रोधाग्नि की ज्वालाएं छिपे हुए समुद्र को बड़वारित की ज्वालाओं के हो समान शोभित हो रहो थो और उन कपिल मुनि की क्रोधारित ने सभी दिशाओं के अन्तर को व्याप्त कर रक्‍खा था वह सर्वत्र फेल गया था ।३४। उस क्रोधारिनि ने पूर्ण नभन
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सृजत्यथानुगृह्णाति तथा संहरति प्रजाः । एवमेताः स्मृतास्तिस्रस्तनवो हि स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: sṛjatyathānugṛhṇāti tathā saṃharati prajāḥ / evametāḥ smṛtāstisrastanavo hi svayaṃbhuvaḥ

verses.hindi: स्तल को आवृत करते हुए उन समस्त सगर के साठ सहन पुत्रों को दग्ध करके भस्मीभूत कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.transliteration: prājāpatyā ca raudrā ca vaiṣṇavī ceti tāstridhā / etāstanvaḥ smṛtā devā dharmaśāstre purātane
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सांख्ययोगरतैर्धीरैः पृथगेकार्थदर्शिभिः । अभिजातिप्रभावज्ञैर्मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyayogaratairdhīraiḥ pṛthagekārthadarśibhiḥ / abhijātiprabhāvajñairmunibhistattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.transliteration: ekatvena pṛthaktvena tāsu bhinnāḥ prajāstvimāḥ / idaṃ paramidaṃ neti bruvate bhinnadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.transliteration: idaṃ paramidaṃ neti saṃraṃbhādbhinnadarśinaḥ / yātudhānā viśeṣā ye piśācāścaiva nāntaram

verses.sanskrit: तेष्वेकं यजते यो वै स तदा यजते त्रयम् । तस्माद्देवास्त्रयो ह्येते नैरन्तर्येणधिष्टताः
verses.transliteration: teṣvekaṃ yajate yo vai sa tadā yajate trayam / tasmāddevāstrayo hyete nairantaryeṇadhiṣṭatāḥ

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पृथक्त्वमेकत्वं संख्या संख्ये गतागतम् । अल्पत्वं वा बहुत्वं वा तेषु को ज्ञातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: tasmātpṛthaktvamekatvaṃ saṃkhyā saṃkhye gatāgatam / alpatvaṃ vā bahutvaṃ vā teṣu ko jñātumarhati
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: सरर-सरर करती हुई महाध्वनि से परिपूर्ण बड़ी जोरदार हवा के प्रकोप से चारों ओर फंली हुई अग्नि को धु'आ के गुब्बारों से और अत्य- घिक ऊपर की ऑर उठकर उड़ती हुई भूमि की धूलि के सम्पूर्णे लोक ढक सा गया था और बहुत ही अधिक लोक में विकलता हो गयी

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सृष्ट्वानुगृह्णति ग्रसते चैव सर्वशः । गुणात्मकत्ववै कल्पये तस्मादेकः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmātsṛṣṭvānugṛhṇati grasate caiva sarvaśaḥ / guṇātmakatvavai kalpaye tasmādekaḥ sa ucyate

verses.hindi: यो ।३६। इसके पश्चात् वह अन्न वायु के वेग से समाहत शिखाओ से जो घूम-घुम करके ऊपर की ओर उठ रहीं थीं नभस्त में मानों वे कुछ लिख रहीं होवे चारों ओर फली हुई थी । उन्होंने उन सुरगण के शत्रु तूप के पुत्रों को पूर्णतया तुरन्त ही प्रदग्ध कर दिया था ।३७। समग्र लोक का
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रं ब्रह्माणमिन्द्रं च लोकपालानृषीन्मनून् । देवं तमेकं बहुधा प्राहुर्नारायणं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: rudraṃ brahmāṇamindraṃ ca lokapālānṛṣīnmanūn / devaṃ tamekaṃ bahudhā prāhurnārāyaṇaṃ dvijāḥ

verses.hindi: विनाश करने वाले उन सगर के पुत्रों का पूर्णतया उस कपिल मुनि की क्रोधारित ने दाह करके राख की ढेरियां अना दिया था और उस यज्ञ के अश्व को छोड़ दिया था ।३८। नीरस सूखे हुए वृक्ष तुरन्त ही दान की अग्नि से जल जाया करते हैं उसी भाँति पुण्य रस बिहीन पापात्मा के सगर सुत

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्या च रौद्री च तनुर्या चैव वैष्णवी । मन्वन्तरेषु वै तिस्र आवर्त्तन्ते पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyā ca raudrī ca tanuryā caiva vaiṣṇavī / manvantareṣu vai tisra āvarttante punaḥ punaḥ

verses.hindi: तुरन्त हो जल गये ये ।३९। इस रोति से उन महान् दष्ट सगर सुतों का निधन का अवलोकन करके सभी देवगण अत्यन्त विस्मय को प्राप्त हो गये थे और परस्पर में ऋषियों के साथ एक दूसरे से कहने लगे थे ।४०। अहो ! बड़े आश्चर्य को बात है कि महात् दारुण पाप करने बालों के पापों का

verses.transliteration: jāyante tatsamāścaiva tānapīmānnibodhata / rājasyā brahmaṇoṃ'śena mārīcaḥ kaśyapo 'bhavat

verses.hindi: कार पवंतों के सहश था और कितनी अधिक संख्या में ये इस समय में तृण

verses.hindi: में लगी हुई अग्नि के ही समान तुरन्त ही एक ही साथ बिलय को पराप्त हो गये हैं मानों हुए हो नहीं ये । आप उनका नाम माव ही रह गया है

verses.transliteration: triṣu kāleṣu tasyaitā brahmamastanavo dvijāḥ / manvantareṣviha sraṣṭumāvarttante punaḥ punaḥ

verses.hindi: विक्रोश्य सर्वभूतानि संप्रयाताः स्वकर्मभिः । ब्रह्मदंडहताः पापा निरयं शाश्वतीः समाः

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्ते प्राप्ते तु कल्पान्ते रुद्रः संहरति प्रजाः । कालो भूत्वा युगात्मासौ रुद्रः संहरते पुनः
verses.transliteration: prāpte prāpte tu kalpānte rudraḥ saṃharati prajāḥ / kālo bhūtvā yugātmāsau rudraḥ saṃharate punaḥ

verses.hindi: तस्मात्सहैव कत्त व्यं कर्म पु सां मनीषिणाम् । दृरतंश्च परित्याज्यमित रल्लोकनिदितम्

verses.transliteration: viṣṇuḥ prajānugrahakṛtsadā pālayati prajāḥ / tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ tata utpādya kāraṇam

verses.transliteration: sattvodriktā tu yā proktā brahmaṇaḥ pauruṣī tanuḥ / tasyāśena ca vijñeyo manoḥ svāyaṃbhuventare
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
