verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: आकृत्यां मनसा देव उत्पन्नः प्रथमं विभुः । ततः पुनः स वै देवः प्राप्ते स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: ākṛtyāṃ manasā deva utpannaḥ prathamaṃ vibhuḥ / tataḥ punaḥ sa vai devaḥ prāpte svārociṣe 'ntare
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: तुषितायां समुत्पन्नो ह्यजितस्तुषितैः सह । औत्तमे ह्यन्तरे वापि ह्यजितस्तु पुनः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tuṣitāyāṃ samutpanno hyajitastuṣitaiḥ saha / auttame hyantare vāpi hyajitastu punaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यायामभवत्सत्यः सह सत्यैः सुरोत्तमैः । तामसस्यातरे चापि स देवः पुनरेव हि
verses.transliteration: satyāyāmabhavatsatyaḥ saha satyaiḥ surottamaiḥ / tāmasasyātare cāpi sa devaḥ punareva hi
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: भयभीतास्ततो देवाः समेत्य दिवि संस्थिताः । वष्टूवृस्ते महात्मानं क्रोधाग्निशमनाथिनः
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: हरिण्यां हरिभिः सार्द्धं हरिरेव बभूव ह । वैवस्वतेन्तरे चापि हरिर्देवेः पुनस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: hariṇyāṃ haribhiḥ sārddhaṃ harireva babhūva ha / vaivasvatentare cāpi harirdeveḥ punastu saḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: ये सभी प्राणियों के लिए उद्र ग करने वाले ये और सत्पुरुषों के द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठो नामतो जज्ञे विधूतरजसैः सह । मरीचात्कश्यपाद्विष्णुरदित्यां संबभूव ह
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭho nāmato jajñe vidhūtarajasaiḥ saha / marīcātkaśyapādviṣṇuradityāṃ saṃbabhūva ha
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: मझे जाया करते ये। ये जीउन जब तक इनका रहा किया करते ये । अब बहुत ही अच्छा हुआ कि सबके
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिः क्रमैरिमांल्लोकञ्जित्वा विष्णुस्त्रिविक्रमः । प्रत्यपादयदिन्द्राय दैवतैश्चैव स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tribhiḥ kramairimāṃllokañjitvā viṣṇustrivikramaḥ / pratyapādayadindrāya daivataiścaiva sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: सब विनाश को प्राप्त हो गवे हैं। यह तो एक प्रसन्नता की ही बात हुई है।
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतास्तनवो जाता व्यतीताः सप्तसप्तसु । मन्वन्तरेष्वतीतेषु याभिः संरक्षिताः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: ityetāstanavo jātā vyatītāḥ saptasaptasu / manvantareṣvatīteṣu yābhiḥ saṃrakṣitāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्विश्वमिदं सर्वं जायते लीयते पुनः । यस्यांशेनामराः सर्वे जायन्ते त्रिदिवेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yasmādviśvamidaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate līyate punaḥ / yasyāṃśenāmarāḥ sarve jāyante tridiveśvarāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: ४३। जो निरन्तर ही दूसरे प्राणियों को उपताप दिया करता है तथा सदा ही सवंत्र जिसकी लोग निन्दा किया करते हैं ऐसा इस लोक में परमाशुम कर्मों को करके कोन सा पुरुष है जो सुख प्राप्त करता है अर्थात् ऐसा कोई भी सुख नहीं प्राप्त करता है ।४८। सब प्राणियों को सता कर अपने ही
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: वर्द्धन्ते तेजसा बुद्ध्या श्रुतेन च बलेन च । यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा
verses.transliteration: varddhante tejasā buddhyā śrutena ca balena ca / yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: कुमो के दोरा इस लोक से विदा होकर चल बसे हैं । ब्राह्माण के अपराध का दण्ड पाकर निहत हो गये हैं। ये महापापी सगर सुत निरन्तर सैकड़ों वर्षों तक नरक में रहेंगे ।४६॥ इस कारण से मनीषो पुरुषों को सर्वदा सत् कर्म ही करन! चाहिए और जो दूसरे लोगों के द्वारा बिनिन्दित कर्म हो
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तदेवावगच्छध्वं विष्णोस्तेज्ॐऽशसंभवम् । स एव जायतेंऽशेन केचिदिच्छन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tattadevāvagacchadhvaṃ viṣṇostejoṃ'śasaṃbhavam / sa eva jāyateṃ'śena kecidicchanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: उसका तो दूर से हा परित्याग कर देना नाहिए ।४६। मानव का परम कलं व्य है कि जब तक भी उसका जीवन रहे सदा श्रेय के ही यत्न करना चाहिए क्योंकि उसको यह ज्ञान होना चाहिए कि शुभ कमं ही सफल होता है और सदा बुरे कमों का बुरा ही परिणाम हुआ करता है कभी भी किसी
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: एके विवदमानास्तु दृष्टान्ताच्च ब्रुवन्ति हि । एषां न विद्यते भेदस्त्रयाणां द्युसदामिह
verses.transliteration: eke vivadamānāstu dṛṣṭāntācca bruvanti hi / eṣāṃ na vidyate bhedastrayāṇāṃ dyusadāmiha
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: के साथ द्रोह का समाचरण नहों करे क्योंकि जिस जीवन में द्रोह करता है बही जीवन अनित्य है फिर द्रोह का पाप क्‍यों अजित किया जावे ।४७। यह देह तो सदा ही अनित्य है कोई चाहे कंसा भो क्यों न हो यहां सदा नहीं रहता है न रहा है और न कभी रहेगा । जिस सम्पदा के लिये मानव बड़े-
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: जायन्ते पोहयन्त्यं शैरीश्वरा योगमायया
verses.transliteration: jāyante pohayantyaṃ śairīśvarā yogamāyayā
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: बड़े कुत्सित कर्म किया करता है वह सम्पदा भो अत्यन्त चञ्चल है और कभी किसो के पास स्थिर नहीं रहा करती है । यह संसार अति निस्सार है अर्थात् समो सांसारिक कर्मों में पारमार्थिक श्रेय नहीं हैं जो सार कहा जा सके । समां यहाँ को बातें यहों समाप्त हो जाया करती हैं फिर भी
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तेषां प्रचारे तु युक्तायुक्तं न विद्यते । भूतानुवादिना माद्या मध्यस्था भूतवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātteṣāṃ pracāre tu yuktāyuktaṃ na vidyate / bhūtānuvādinā mādyā madhyasthā bhūtavādinām
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: आश्चर्य यहो है कि बुध पुरुष भो केसे इसमें विश्‍वास किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: भूतानुवादिनः सक्तस्त्रयश्चैव प्रवादिनाम् । परीक्ष्य चानुगृह्णन्ति निगृह्णन्ति खलान्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtānuvādinaḥ saktastrayaścaiva pravādinām / parīkṣya cānugṛhṇanti nigṛhṇanti khalānsvayam
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: इस रीति से सुरगण और मुनिगण परस्पर में कह रहे ये और नृप सगर के पुत्र सब के साब कपिल मुनि के क्रोध में इन्धन होकर विनष्ट हो गये थे। ।४९। ने सागर के पुत्र अपने ही कर्मों से दग्ध देहों वाले होकर साहुसा भस्म के रूप में भूमि में मिल गये ये और तुरन्त हो नरक में पहुँच गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: मत्तः पूर्व्वे च ते तस्मात्प्रभवश्च ततो ऽधिकाः । तथाधिकरणैरतैर्यथा तत्त्वनिदर्शकाः
verses.transliteration: mattaḥ pūrvve ca te tasmātprabhavaśca tato 'dhikāḥ / tathādhikaraṇairatairyathā tattvanidarśakāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.hindi: मुनि के क्रोध को अग्नि ने पूर्ण ल्प से उन सगर पुत्रो को दग्ध करके फिर बह अग्नि तुरन्त ही समस्त लोकों को दग्ध करने के लिये उद्यत हो गयी थी ।५१। तब सब देवगण भय से भीत हो गये ये और दिवलोक में हो संस्थित रहते हुए उस क्रोधाग्नि कें शमन की इच्छा वालों ने उन महात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: देवानां देवभूताश्च ते वै सर्वप्रवर्त्तकाः । कर्म्मणां महतां ते हि कर्त्तारो जगदीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ devabhūtāśca te vai sarvapravarttakāḥ / karmmaṇāṃ mahatāṃ te hi karttāro jagadīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिज्ञैः कारणैरेतैश्चतुर्भिः परिकीर्त्तिताः । बालिशास्ते न जानन्ति दैवतानि प्रभागशः
verses.transliteration: śrutijñaiḥ kāraṇairetaiścaturbhiḥ parikīrttitāḥ / bāliśāste na jānanti daivatāni prabhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्र श्लोकं योगेश्वरान्प्रति । कुर्याद्योगबलं प्राप्य तैश्च सर्वैर्महांश्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ codāharantyatra ślokaṃ yogeśvarānprati / kuryādyogabalaṃ prāpya taiśca sarvairmahāṃścaret
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुयाद्विषयांश्चैव पुनश्चोर्द्ध्व तपश्चरेत् । संहरेत पुनः सर्व्वान्सूर्य्यो ज्योतिर्गणानिव
verses.transliteration: prāpnuyādviṣayāṃścaiva punaścorddhva tapaścaret / saṃhareta punaḥ sarvvānsūryyo jyotirgaṇāniva
verses.translation: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the lords of the Universe. They are Devas of Devas. They make others function. They are the achievers of great tasks.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे स्वयंभूत्रैगुण्यस्वरूपवर्णनं नाम तृतीयो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच ब्रह्मणा वै मुखात्सृष्टा जया देवाः प्रजेप्सया । सर्वे मन्त्रशरीरास्ते स्मृता मन्वन्तरेष्विह
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde svayaṃbhūtraiguṇyasvarūpavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca brahmaṇā vai mukhātsṛṣṭā jayā devāḥ prajepsayā / sarve mantraśarīrāste smṛtā manvantareṣviha
verses.translation: The Dcvas (called) Jayas were created by Brahma out of his mouth, due to a desire for progeny. All of them are remembered as having Mantras for their bodies in the different Manvantaras.
verses.wordMeaning: The Dcvas (called) Jayas were created by Brahma out of his mouth, due to a desire for progeny. All of them are remembered as having Mantras for their bodies in the different Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Dcvas (called) Jayas were created by Brahma out of his mouth, due to a desire for progeny. All of them are remembered as having Mantras for their bodies in the different Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शश्च पौर्णमासश्च बृहत्साम रथन्तरम् । चितिश्च सुचितिश्चैव ह्याकूतिः कूतिरेव च
verses.transliteration: darśaśca paurṇamāsaśca bṛhatsāma rathantaram / citiśca sucitiścaiva hyākūtiḥ kūtireva ca
verses.translation: After telling them (i.e. Jayas) thus, the lord vanished
verses.wordMeaning: After telling them (i.e. Jayas) thus, the lord vanished
verses.commentary: Sense: After telling them (i.e. Jayas) thus, the lord vanished

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञातश्चैव विज्ञाता मना यज्ञश्च द्वादशः । दाराग्निहोत्रसंबन्धं वितत्य यजतेति च
verses.transliteration: vijñātaścaiva vijñātā manā yajñaśca dvādaśaḥ / dārāgnihotrasaṃbandhaṃ vitatya yajateti ca
verses.translation: After observing defects in the Karmans ( holy rites ■etc.), they discarded Karmans as well as the Vdsand s (desires or unconscious impressions) born of Karmans. They began to adhere strictly to Yamas (Restraints, self-controls, etc.).
verses.wordMeaning: After observing defects in the Karmans ( holy rites ■etc.), they discarded Karmans as well as the Vdsand s (desires or unconscious impressions) born of Karmans. They began to adhere strictly to Yamas (Restraints, self-controls, etc.).
verses.commentary: Sense: After observing defects in the Karmans ( holy rites ■etc.), they discarded Karmans as well as the Vdsand s (desires or unconscious impressions) born of Karmans. They began to adhere strictly to Yamas (Restraints, self-controls, etc.).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु तान्ब्रह्मा तत्रैवान्तरधात्प्रभुः । ततस्ते नाभ्यनन्दन्त तद्वाक्यं परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu tānbrahmā tatraivāntaradhātprabhuḥ / tataste nābhyanandanta tadvākyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: They observed the fruit of Karmans as attended with excess of destruction 'and deterioration. They entertained contempt for progeny. They became Nissattvas (free from in- born nature or natural characteristics) and Nirmamas( free from the desire of possession).
verses.wordMeaning: They observed the fruit of Karmans as attended with excess of destruction 'and deterioration. They entertained contempt for progeny. They became Nissattvas (free from in- born nature or natural characteristics) and Nirmamas( free from the desire of possession).
verses.commentary: Sense: They observed the fruit of Karmans as attended with excess of destruction 'and deterioration. They entertained contempt for progeny. They became Nissattvas (free from in- born nature or natural characteristics) and Nirmamas( free from the desire of possession).

verses.sanskrit: संन्यस्येह च कर्माणि वासनाः कर्मजाश्च वै । यमेष्वंवावन्तिष्ठन्ते दोषं दृष्ट्वा तु कर्मसु
verses.transliteration: saṃnyasyeha ca karmāṇi vāsanāḥ karmajāśca vai / yameṣvaṃvāvantiṣṭhante doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu karmasu
verses.translation: Desirous of Liberation (literally absence of birth, cessation of birth), they got rid of them after observing the defects (in Karmans). They abandoned Artha (wealth), Dharma (customary observances of castes) and Kdma (Love), and stabilised themselves on Moksa, the last Purusartha).
verses.hindi: जैमिनी मुनि ने कहा-देवों ने कपिल मुनि से प्राथना की थो-- विप्रेन्द्र ! आप इस क्रोध को महान् भीषण अग्नि का तुरन्त ही संहार करने के योग्य हैं । यदि इसका संहरण नहो किया गया तो उससे अकाल में ही यह सम्पूर्ण लोक दाह को प्राप्त होता जा रहा है।१। आपकी महिमा तो
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of Liberation (literally absence of birth, cessation of birth), they got rid of them after observing the defects (in Karmans). They abandoned Artha (wealth), Dharma (customary observances of castes) and Kdma (Love), and stabilised themselves on Moksa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of Liberation (literally absence of birth, cessation of birth), they got rid of them after observing the defects (in Karmans). They abandoned Artha (wealth), Dharma (customary observances of castes) and Kdma (Love), and stabilised themselves on Moksa,…

verses.sanskrit: क्षयाति शययुक्तं च ते दृष्ट्वा कर्मणां फलम् । जुगुप्संतः प्रसूतिं च निःसत्त्वा निर्ममाभवन्
verses.transliteration: kṣayāti śayayuktaṃ ca te dṛṣṭvā karmaṇāṃ phalam / jugupsaṃtaḥ prasūtiṃ ca niḥsattvā nirmamābhavan
verses.translation: Sadhyas (C&kfufa); 7. Xdltyas (Vaivasvata).
verses.hindi: इसो से देखी जा चुकी है जो कि इस चराचर में व्याप्त थी। है विश्रों में परम श्रेष्ठ ! अब क्षमा कोजिए और अपने क्रोध का सांहरण कीजिए। आपकी सेवा में हेम सबका प्रणाम है ।२। इस रीति से जब देवों के द्वारा उनकी स्तुति को गयो थो तो भगवान कपिल मुनि ने उस अत्यधिक भैरव
verses.wordMeaning: Sadhyas (C&kfufa); 7. Xdltyas (Vaivasvata).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sadhyas (C&kfufa); 7. Xdltyas (Vaivasvata).

verses.sanskrit: अजन्म काङ्क्षमाणास्ते निर्मुक्ता दोषदर्शिनः । अर्थं धर्मं च कामं च हित्वा ते वै व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ajanma kāṅkṣamāṇāste nirmuktā doṣadarśinaḥ / arthaṃ dharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca hitvā te vai vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: They adopted the great knowledge and established themselves very well after condensing (assimilating) it (?). On coming to know of their intention, Brahma became infuriated.
verses.hindi: क्रोधारित का क्षय कर दिया था ।३। फिर यह समस्त चराचर जगत् प्रशान्त
verses.wordMeaning: They adopted the great knowledge and established themselves very well after condensing (assimilating) it (?). On coming to know of their intention, Brahma became infuriated.
verses.commentary: Sense: They adopted the great knowledge and established themselves very well after condensing (assimilating) it (?). On coming to know of their intention, Brahma became infuriated.

verses.sanskrit: परमं ज्ञानमास्थाय तत्संक्षिप्य सुसंस्थिताः । तेषां तु तमभिप्रायं ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मा तु कोपितः
verses.transliteration: paramaṃ jñānamāsthāya tatsaṃkṣipya susaṃsthitāḥ / teṣāṃ tu tamabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā brahmā tu kopitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, Brahma spoke to those Devas lacking in enthusiasm: — "It is for the sake of progeny that you have been created by me and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: हो गया या और सब देवगण तथा तपस्वी गण दुःख से रहित हो गये वे अर्थात् इन सबका सन्ताप दूर हो गया था ।४। इस्रो समय में देवषि भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Brahma spoke to those Devas lacking in enthusiasm: — "It is for the sake of progeny that you have been created by me and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, Brahma spoke to those Devas lacking in enthusiasm: — "It is for the sake of progeny that you have been created by me and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: तानब्रवीत्ततो ब्रह्मा निरुत्साहान्सुरानथ । प्रजार्थमिह यूयं वै मया सृष्टाः स्थ नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: tānabravīttato brahmā nirutsāhānsurānatha / prajārthamiha yūyaṃ vai mayā sṛṣṭāḥ stha nānyathā
verses.translation: Moreover, I have already told you formerly this — Procreate in plenty and perform sacrifices. You disregarded my instruction and adopted Vair&gya (detachment).
verses.wordMeaning: Moreover, I have already told you formerly this — Procreate in plenty and perform sacrifices. You disregarded my instruction and adopted Vair&gya (detachment).
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, I have already told you formerly this — Procreate in plenty and perform sacrifices. You disregarded my instruction and adopted Vair&gya (detachment).

verses.sanskrit: प्रसूयध्वं यजध्वं चेत्युक्तवानस्मि वः पुरा । यस्माद्वाक्यमनादृत्य मम वैराग्यमास्थिताः
verses.transliteration: prasūyadhvaṃ yajadhvaṃ cetyuktavānasmi vaḥ purā / yasmādvākyamanādṛtya mama vairāgyamāsthitāḥ
verses.translation: "O great lord, forgive our faults of the nature of ignorance."
verses.hindi: नारद मुनि स्वेच्छा से ही देवलोक से विचरण करते हुए अयोध्या पुरी में समागत हो गये ये ।५। राजा सगर ने जब भगवान् नारदजी को वहाँ पर प्राष्त हुए देखा तो शास्त्रानुसार अध्ये-पाच आदि से भलो भाँति उनका अचंन किया था ।६। नारदजी ने उसकी पूजा को ग्रहण करके आसन पर
verses.wordMeaning: "O great lord, forgive our faults of the nature of ignorance."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great lord, forgive our faults of the nature of ignorance."

verses.sanskrit: जुगुप्समानाः स्वं जन्म संततिं नाभ्यनन्दत । कर्मणां न कृतो ऽभ्यासो ह्यमृतत्वाभिकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: jugupsamānāḥ svaṃ janma saṃtatiṃ nābhyanandata / karmaṇāṃ na kṛto 'bhyāso hyamṛtatvābhikāṅkṣayā
verses.translation: Thereupon, the lord who has no fear from anywhere vanished after adopting the original Dharana accompanied by yogic power.
verses.hindi: संस्थिति की थी और फिर उन्होंने उस तृप शादू'ल से वह वचन कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the lord who has no fear from anywhere vanished after adopting the original Dharana accompanied by yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the lord who has no fear from anywhere vanished after adopting the original Dharana accompanied by yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यूयमिहावृत्तिं सप्तकृत्वो ह्यवाप्स्यथ । ते शप्ता ब्रह्मणा देवा जयास्तं वै प्रसादयन्
verses.transliteration: tasmādyūyamihāvṛttiṃ saptakṛtvo hyavāpsyatha / te śaptā brahmaṇā devā jayāstaṃ vai prasādayan
verses.translation: Then those twelve Ajitas were angrily cursed by him. Thus those who were called Jayas were rendered just the opposite*** (i.e. the "Victorious ones" were 'defeated').
verses.wordMeaning: Then those twelve Ajitas were angrily cursed by him. Thus those who were called Jayas were rendered just the opposite*** (i.e. the "Victorious ones" were 'defeated').
verses.commentary: Sense: Then those twelve Ajitas were angrily cursed by him. Thus those who were called Jayas were rendered just the opposite*** (i.e. the "Victorious ones" were 'defeated').

verses.sanskrit: क्षमास्माकं महादेव यदज्ञानात्मकं प्रभो । प्रणतान्वै सानुनयं ब्रह्मा तानब्रवीत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: kṣamāsmākaṃ mahādeva yadajñānātmakaṃ prabho / praṇatānvai sānunayaṃ brahmā tānabravītpunaḥ
verses.translation: All those twelve Devas (called) Tusitas were born of Harinl then. Those Devas in the name of Haris became the partakers of Yajna.
verses.wordMeaning: All those twelve Devas (called) Tusitas were born of Harinl then. Those Devas in the name of Haris became the partakers of Yajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those twelve Devas (called) Tusitas were born of Harinl then. Those Devas in the name of Haris became the partakers of Yajna.

verses.sanskrit: लोके ऽप्यथानुभुञ्जीत कः स्वातन्त्र्यमिहार्हति । मयागतं तु सर्वं हि कथमच्छन्दतो मम
verses.transliteration: loke 'pyathānubhuñjīta kaḥ svātantryamihārhati / mayāgataṃ tu sarvaṃ hi kathamacchandato mama
verses.translation: When the Aristava Manvantara (? i.e. Raivata) arrived those excellent Devas called Haris were born of Vikuntha.
verses.wordMeaning: When the Aristava Manvantara (? i.e. Raivata) arrived those excellent Devas called Haris were born of Vikuntha.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Aristava Manvantara (? i.e. Raivata) arrived those excellent Devas called Haris were born of Vikuntha.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपत्स्यन्ति भूतानि शुभं वा यदि वोत्तरम् । लोके यदपि किञ्चिद्वैशं वा शं वा व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: pratipatsyanti bhūtāni śubhaṃ vā yadi vottaram / loke yadapi kiñcidvaiśaṃ vā śaṃ vā vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: समीपे तस्य योगींद्र कपिलं च महामुनिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्यात्मना मया व्याप्तं को मां लोके ऽतिवर्त्तयेत् । भूताना मीहितं यच्च यच्चाप्येषां विचिन्तितम्
verses.transliteration: buddhyātmanā mayā vyāptaṃ ko māṃ loke 'tivarttayet / bhūtānā mīhitaṃ yacca yaccāpyeṣāṃ vicintitam
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: तथोपचरितं यच्च तत्सर्वं विदितं मम । मया बद्धमिदं सर्वं चजगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: tathopacaritaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ viditaṃ mama / mayā baddhamidaṃ sarvaṃ cajagatsthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: आशामयेन बन्धेन कस्तं छेत्तुमिहोत्सहेत् । यस्माद्वहति दृप्तो वै सर्वार्थमिह नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: āśāmayena bandhena kastaṃ chettumihotsahet / yasmādvahati dṛpto vai sarvārthamiha nānyathā
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: श्री नारदजी ने कहा-हे राजन् ! यज्ञ के अश्व के सळ्चारण के लिए आपके पुत्रों ने सं्रयाण किया था । है श्रेष्ठ नूप ! ने सब बह्म-दण्ड से हत होकर विनष्ट हो गये हैं ।८। उन सबके द्वारा भली भाँति रक्षा किया भी वह यज्ञिय अश्व किसी के द्वारा अलक्षित कर दिया गया था और भाग्य
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: इति कर्माण्यनारभ्य कामं छन्दाद्विमोक्षते । एवं संभाष्य तान्देवान् जयानध्यात्मचेतसः
verses.transliteration: iti karmāṇyanārabhya kāmaṃ chandādvimokṣate / evaṃ saṃbhāṣya tāndevān jayānadhyātmacetasaḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: वश दिव में वह ले जाया गया था।। फिर जब वह अश्‍व विनष्ट अर्थात् खोया हुआ हो गया था उन्होंने महीतल में खोज की थी किन्तु उमहोने
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: अथ वीक्ष्य पुनश्चाह ध्रुवं दड्यान्प्रजापतिः । यस्मान्मानभिसंधाय सन्यासादिः कृतः सुराः
verses.transliteration: atha vīkṣya punaścāha dhruvaṃ daḍyānprajāpatiḥ / yasmānmānabhisaṃdhāya sanyāsādiḥ kṛtaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स विपुलायत्तो व्यापारस्त्वथ मत्कृतः । भविता च सुखोदर्के दिव्यभावेन जायताम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsa vipulāyatto vyāpārastvatha matkṛtaḥ / bhavitā ca sukhodarke divyabhāvena jāyatām
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: उसको कहीं पर मी प्राप्त नहीं किया था और वह किस ओर गया है--यह भी बहुत समय तक उनको ज्ञात नहीं हुआ था ।१०। इसके पश्चात् उन्होंने इस बसुन्धरा के नीचे उस अश्व की खोज करने निश्चय किया -था। उन आपके पुत्रों ने समारम्भ करके इस वसुधा के तल भाग को खोद डाला था
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: आत्मच्छन्देन वो जन्म भविष्यति सुरोत्तमाः । मन्वन्तरेषु संसिद्धाः सप्तस्वाविर्भविष्यथ
verses.transliteration: ātmacchandena vo janma bhaviṣyati surottamāḥ / manvantareṣu saṃsiddhāḥ saptasvāvirbhaviṣyatha
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: ।११। जब वे लगातर पृथ्वी को खोदते ही चले गये तो है नूप ! उन्होंने पाताल में उस अश्व को देखा था जिस अश्व के हो समीप में योगीन्द्र महा- मुनि कपिल जी समाधि में स्थित हुए उनको दिखाई दिये थे ।१२। उन महामुनि को वहाँ देखकर पापपूर्ण कमो वाले उन सबने काल को गति से
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतान्तेषु सुरास्तथा स्वायंभुवादिषु । एवं च ब्रह्मणा तत्र श्लोको गीतः पुरातनः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatānteṣu surāstathā svāyaṃbhuvādiṣu / evaṃ ca brahmaṇā tatra śloko gītaḥ purātanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: प्रेरित होकर उन कपिल देव के ही ऊपर बड़ा कोप किया था और यह ही इस अण्व के हरण करने वाला है- यह कहा था ।१३। इसके अनन्तर उन मुनि को क्रोध उत्पन्न हो गया था ओर उससे संभूत नेत्रों की अग्नि से जो दशों दिशाओं को दग्ध कर रही थी आपके समस्त पुत्र इन्धन हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: त्रयी विद्या ब्रह्ममयप्रसूतिः श्राद्धं तपो यज्ञमनुप्रदानम् । एतानि नित्यैः महसा रजोभिर्भूत्वा विभुर्वसते ऽन्यत्प्रशस्तम्
verses.transliteration: trayī vidyā brahmamayaprasūtiḥ śrāddhaṃ tapo yajñamanupradānam / etāni nityaiḥ mahasā rajobhirbhūtvā vibhurvasate 'nyatpraśastam
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: और जल भुनकर उसके देह भस्मोभूत हो गये ये तया सब नष्ट हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: एवं श्लोकार्थमुक्त्वा तु जयान्देवानथाब्रवीत् । वैवस्वतेंऽतरेतीते मत्समीपमिहैष्यथ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ ślokārthamuktvā tu jayāndevānathābravīt / vaivasvateṃ'taretīte matsamīpamihaiṣyatha
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवस्तिरोभूत ईश्वरो ङ्यकुतोभयः । प्रपन्नाधारणामाद्यां युक्त्वा योगबलान्विताम्
verses.transliteration: tato devastirobhūta īśvaro ṅyakutobhayaḥ / prapannādhāraṇāmādyāṃ yuktvā yogabalānvitām
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेन रुषा शप्तास्ते ऽभवन्द्वादशाजिताः । जया इति समाख्याताः कृता एवं विसन्निभाः
verses.transliteration: tatastena ruṣā śaptāste 'bhavandvādaśājitāḥ / jayā iti samākhyātāḥ kṛtā evaṃ visannibhāḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वायंभुवे तस्मिन्सर्गे ऽतीते तु वै सुराः । पुनस्ते तुषिता देवा जाताः स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svāyaṃbhuve tasminsarge 'tīte tu vai surāḥ / punaste tuṣitā devā jātāḥ svārociṣeṃ'tare
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमस्य मनोः पुत्राः सत्यायां जज्ञिरे तदा । ततः सत्याः स्मृता देवा औत्तमे चान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: uttamasya manoḥ putrāḥ satyāyāṃ jajñire tadā / tataḥ satyāḥ smṛtā devā auttame cāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: हरिण्यां नाम तुषिता जज्ञिरे द्वादशेव तु । हरयोनाम ते देवा यज्ञभाजस्तदाभवन्
verses.transliteration: hariṇyāṃ nāma tuṣitā jajñire dvādaśeva tu / harayonāma te devā yajñabhājastadābhavan
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: वे सव आपके पुत्र अत्यन्त कूर वे--पाप कर्मों का समाचरण करने वाले तथा समस्त लोकों के उपरोधक ये । क्योंकि ऐसे ही जघन्य थे अतः हे राजेन्द्र ! अव आप उनके लिए शोक करने के योग्य नहीं हैं ।१५। आप तो धैर्य को ही धन मानने बाले हैं अतएव आपको धीरज की रक्षा करनी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते हरयो देवाः प्राप्ते चारिष्ठवेन्तरे?॥ विकुण्ठायां पुनस्ते वै वरिष्ठा जज्ञिरे सुराः
verses.transliteration: tataste harayo devāḥ prāpte cāriṣṭhaventare?// vikuṇṭhāyāṃ punaste vai variṣṭhā jajñire surāḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: चाहिए । जो भी कुछ भवितव्यता होतो है तथा नष्ट हो जाता है और व्यतीत हो जाता है उसको पण्डित लोग नहीं सोचा करते हैं ।१६। इस कारण से अब इस अपने अशुभान् पौव को जो महान् मतिमान् है है तूप श्रोष्ठ ! उस अण्व को लाने के कार्य में नियुक्त करो ।१७। समस्त सदस्य
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठा नाम ते देवाः पञ्चमस्यान्तरे मानोः । ततस्ते वै पुनर्देवा वैकुण्ठाः प्राप्य चाक्षुषम्
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭhā nāma te devāḥ pañcamasyāntare mānoḥ / tataste vai punardevā vaikuṇṭhāḥ prāpya cākṣuṣam
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: और ऋत्विजों से युक्‍त उस गृप शादू ल से यही कहकर सभी के देखते हुए एक ही क्षण में नारदजी अन्तर्धान हो गये बे ॥१८। फिर उस राजा ने नारदजी के कहे हुए उन बचनों का श्रवण करके भी महान् दुःख और शोक मे पूर्णतया घिरा हुआ होकर उस उदार बुद्धि वाले ने बहुत काल तरु
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते वै पुनः साध्याः संक्षीणे चाक्षुषेन्तरे । उपस्थिते पुनः सर्गे मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य ह
verses.transliteration: tataste vai punaḥ sādhyāḥ saṃkṣīṇe cākṣuṣentare / upasthite punaḥ sarge manorvaivasvatasya ha
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: चिन्तन किया था ।१९। उस समय में राजा सभा में नीचे की ओर मुख वाला होकर बेठे हुए थे । उसी समय में देश ओर काल के ज्ञाता वसिष्ठजी ने आकर राजा को सास्त्वना देते हुए कहा था ।२०। आप तो धेयं को बहुत महत्त्व देने वाले हैं फिर आप जैसे महान् पुरुषों को यह ऐसा अवसर क्यों
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: अंशेन साध्यास्ते ऽदित्यां मारीचात्कश्यपात्पुनः । जज्ञिरे द्वादशादित्या वर्त्तमानेन्तरं सुराः
verses.transliteration: aṃśena sādhyāste 'dityāṃ mārīcātkaśyapātpunaḥ / jajñire dvādaśādityā varttamānentaraṃ surāḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: प्राप्त हो रहा है । यदि आपके हृदय में भी शोक ने स्थान ग्रहण कर लिया है तो धीरता से ज्या फल होता है । अर्थात् फिर तो धेये व्यथे हो है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: यदा चैते समुत्पन्नाश्चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः । शप्ताः स्वयंभुवा साध्या जज्ञिरे द्वादशामराः
verses.transliteration: yadā caite samutpannāścākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ / śaptāḥ svayaṃbhuvā sādhyā jajñire dvādaśāmarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: एवं शृणोति यो मर्त्योजयस्तस्य भवेत्सदा । जयानां श्रद्धया युक्तः प्रत्यध्यायं तु गच्छति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ śṛṇoti yo martyojayastasya bhavetsadā / jayānāṃ śraddhayā yuktaḥ pratyadhyāyaṃ tu gacchati
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: इत्येता वृत्तयः सप्त देवानां जन्मलक्षणाः । परिक्रान्ता मया वो ऽद्या किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: ityetā vṛttayaḥ sapta devānāṃ janmalakṣaṇāḥ / parikrāntā mayā vo 'dyā kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha
verses.translation: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus are the seven Vrttis (activities) characterised by the births of the Devas. That account has been narrated to you today. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: इति ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यामभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे जयाभिव्याहारो नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः ऋषिरुवाच दैत्यानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । सर्पभूतापिशा चानां वसूनां पक्षिवीरुधाम्
verses.transliteration: iti brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyāmabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde jayābhivyāhāro nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣiruvāca daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām / sarpabhūtāpiśā cānāṃ vasūnāṃ pakṣivīrudhām
verses.translation: "Two sons and a very powerful daughter were born to Diti. Those two sons of Kasyapa are remembered as the. eldest of all.
verses.wordMeaning: "Two sons and a very powerful daughter were born to Diti. Those two sons of Kasyapa are remembered as the. eldest of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Two sons and a very powerful daughter were born to Diti. Those two sons of Kasyapa are remembered as the. eldest of all.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्तिं निधनं चैव विस्तारात्कथयस्व नः । एवमुक्तस्तदा सूतः प्रत्युवाचर्षिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: utpattiṃ nidhanaṃ caiva vistārātkathayasva naḥ / evamuktastadā sūtaḥ pratyuvācarṣisattamam
verses.translation: "O holy lord, narrate in detail the name, nativity and prowess of the noble-souled Daitya Hiranyakaiipu.''
verses.hindi: आप इस मन की उदासो को शिथिल करके यह सोच लीजिये कि यह सभी कुछ भाग्य के कारण से ही हुआ है ओर इसमें अन्य किसी का भी कुछ वण नहीं चलता है । ऐसा ही मानकर बिना किसी संशय के जो भी कुछ पीछे करने का कृत्य है उसको ही करना अब उचित है।२२। वसिष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord, narrate in detail the name, nativity and prowess of the noble-souled Daitya Hiranyakaiipu.''
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord, narrate in detail the name, nativity and prowess of the noble-souled Daitya Hiranyakaiipu.''

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच दितेः पुत्रद्वयं जज्ञे कन्या चैका महाबला । कश्यपस्यात्मजौ तौ तु सर्वेभ्यः पूर्वजौ स्मृतौ
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca diteḥ putradvayaṃ jajñe kanyā caikā mahābalā / kaśyapasyātmajau tau tu sarvebhyaḥ pūrvajau smṛtau
verses.translation: In the holy place of pilgrimage named Pu$kara, Kaiyapa performed a horse-sacrifice. It had been adorned by their presence by the sages, Devas, and Gandharvas.
verses.hindi: जी के द्वारा इस रीति से कहा जाने पर कार्यो के अथं के तत्वों के ज्ञाता राजा सगर ने धेये का सहारा लिया था और मुनि से वही सब कुछ करने के लिये प्रार्थना की थी ।२३। फिर नृप सगर ने अपने विनय शाली पौत्र अंशुमान् को अपने पास बुलाकर विष्रों और क्षत्रियो की सभा के मध्य में
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy place of pilgrimage named Pu$kara, Kaiyapa performed a horse-sacrifice. It had been adorned by their presence by the sages, Devas, and Gandharvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy place of pilgrimage named Pu$kara, Kaiyapa performed a horse-sacrifice. It had been adorned by their presence by the sages, Devas, and Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: सौत्ये ऽहन्यतिरा त्रस्य कश्यपस्याश्वमेधिकाः । हिरण्यकशिपुर्नाम प्रथितं पृथगासनम्
verses.transliteration: sautye 'hanyatirā trasya kaśyapasyāśvamedhikāḥ / hiraṇyakaśipurnāma prathitaṃ pṛthagāsanam
verses.translation: A popular etymology of Hiranyakasipu. It is endorsed only in V&. 51.
verses.hindi: धीरे से उससे कहा था (२४ है वेटा ! तुम्हारे सभी पितृगण ब्रह्मदण्ड से निहत हो गये हैं और वे पाप कर्मों के करने वाले सैकड़ों वर्षों के लिए नरक में पतित हो गये हैं ।३४। इस समय में तो मेरे अन्य सभी पुत्रों का विनाश हो गया है मेरी केवल एक तुम ही सन्तति नेष रहे हो जो कि इस मेरे
verses.wordMeaning: A popular etymology of Hiranyakasipu. It is endorsed only in V&. 51.
verses.commentary: Sense: A popular etymology of Hiranyakasipu. It is endorsed only in V&. 51.

verses.sanskrit: दित्या गर्भाद्विनिः सृत्य तत्रासीनः समन्ततः । हिरण्य कशिपुस्तस्मात् कर्मणा तेन स समृतः
verses.transliteration: dityā garbhādviniḥ sṛtya tatrāsīnaḥ samantataḥ / hiraṇya kaśipustasmāt karmaṇā tena sa samṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He alone became the wind and blew continuously all over the world. He alone was the cowherd, shepherd and farmer.
verses.hindi: विशाल राज्य के रक्षा करने बाले हो । अब तो इस लोक में और परलोक में मेरे पूर्ण श्रेय को करना तुम्हारे ही अधीन है ।२६। बह आप ही अब मेरी आज्ञा से पाताल लोक में कपिल मुनि के समीप में गमन करो । और महान् यसन से उस यज्ञ के अश्व को यहाँ पर ले आओ ।२७। आप वहाँ पर
verses.wordMeaning: He alone became the wind and blew continuously all over the world. He alone was the cowherd, shepherd and farmer.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone became the wind and blew continuously all over the world. He alone was the cowherd, shepherd and farmer.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः हिरण्यकशिपोर्जन्म नाम चैव महात्मनः । प्रभावं चैव दैत्यस्य विस्ताराद्ब्रूहि नः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ hiraṇyakaśiporjanma nāma caiva mahātmanaḥ / prabhāvaṃ caiva daityasya vistārādbrūhi naḥ prabho
verses.translation: All the Devas and Asuras became the imbibers of the Soma juice through him. This Daitya had such a power. Learn further about him.
verses.hindi: पहुँच कर उन मुनिवर से विधि के साथ प्रार्थना करना और विशेष रूप से उनको प्रसन्न कर लेना । फिर उस अश्व को अपने साथ लेकर है वत्स । तुम बहुत ही शीघ्रता से यहाँ पर वापिस आ जाओ
verses.wordMeaning: All the Devas and Asuras became the imbibers of the Soma juice through him. This Daitya had such a power. Learn further about him.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Devas and Asuras became the imbibers of the Soma juice through him. This Daitya had such a power. Learn further about him.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच कश्यपस्याश्वमेधो ऽभूत्पुण्ये वै पुष्करे तदा । ऋषिभिदेंवताभिश्च गन्धर्वैरुपशोभितः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca kaśyapasyāśvamedho 'bhūtpuṇye vai puṣkare tadā / ṛṣibhideṃvatābhiśca gandharvairupaśobhitaḥ
verses.translation: 'The Devas along with the great sages made obeis- ance to that quarter to which king Hiranyakasipu looked at.
verses.wordMeaning: 'The Devas along with the great sages made obeis- ance to that quarter to which king Hiranyakasipu looked at.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'The Devas along with the great sages made obeis- ance to that quarter to which king Hiranyakasipu looked at.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सृष्टे स्वे च विधिना आख्यानादौ यथाविधि । आसनान्युपकॢप्तानि सौवर्णानि तु पञ्च वै
verses.transliteration: utsṛṣṭe sve ca vidhinā ākhyānādau yathāvidhi / āsanānyupakḷptāni sauvarṇāni tu pañca vai
verses.translation: It was Visnu (in the form of) Narasiriiha (man- lion) who brought about the death of that (Daitya) formerly. Since the lord had the form of Nara (man), he is being sung about as Narasimha by those who expound the Vedas.
verses.wordMeaning: It was Visnu (in the form of) Narasiriiha (man- lion) who brought about the death of that (Daitya) formerly. Since the lord had the form of Nara (man), he is being sung about as Narasimha by those who expound the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was Visnu (in the form of) Narasiriiha (man- lion) who brought about the death of that (Daitya) formerly. Since the lord had the form of Nara (man), he is being sung about as Narasimha by those who expound the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: कुलस्पदापि? त्रीण्यत्र कूर्चः फलकमेव च । मुख्यर्त्विजस्तु चत्वारस्तेषां तान्युपकल्पयन्
verses.transliteration: kulaspadāpi? trīṇyatra kūrcaḥ phalakameva ca / mukhyartvijastu catvārasteṣāṃ tānyupakalpayan
verses.translation: That infuriated lord split that leader of the Daityas of great strength by means of his nails (claws) in the course of his hand-to-hand fight. For, the nails are neither wet nor dry.
verses.hindi: त्वयि क्रद्धे जगत्सवं प्रकाशमुपयास्यति । प्रशांतिमुपयाह्याशु लोकाः संतु गतव्यथाः
verses.wordMeaning: That infuriated lord split that leader of the Daityas of great strength by means of his nails (claws) in the course of his hand-to-hand fight. For, the nails are neither wet nor dry.
verses.commentary: Sense: That infuriated lord split that leader of the Daityas of great strength by means of his nails (claws) in the course of his hand-to-hand fight. For, the nails are neither wet nor dry.

verses.sanskrit: कॢप्त तत्रासनं चैकं होतुरर्थे हिरण्यम् । निषसाद सगर्भो ऽत्र तत्रासीनः शशंस च
verses.transliteration: kḷpta tatrāsanaṃ caikaṃ hoturarthe hiraṇyam / niṣasāda sagarbho 'tra tatrāsīnaḥ śaśaṃsa ca
verses.translation: Their sons and grandsons along with their clans are remembered as Daityas. Hundreds and thousands of those Daityas were killed in the Tarakamaya (i.e. the fight against Tarakasura ).
verses.wordMeaning: Their sons and grandsons along with their clans are remembered as Daityas. Hundreds and thousands of those Daityas were killed in the Tarakamaya (i.e. the fight against Tarakasura ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Their sons and grandsons along with their clans are remembered as Daityas. Hundreds and thousands of those Daityas were killed in the Tarakamaya (i.e. the fight against Tarakasura ).

verses.sanskrit: आख्यानमानुपूर्व्येण महर्षिः कश्यपो यथा । तं दृष्ट्वा ऋषयस्तस्य नाम कुर्वन्ति वर्द्धितम्
verses.transliteration: ākhyānamānupūrvyeṇa maharṣiḥ kaśyapo yathā / taṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayastasya nāma kurvanti varddhitam
verses.translation: Those two great heroic demons were destroyers of Brahmanas. Muka too was a heir and successor of Hrada. Marica, son of Sunda, was born to Tadaka.
verses.wordMeaning: Those two great heroic demons were destroyers of Brahmanas. Muka too was a heir and successor of Hrada. Marica, son of Sunda, was born to Tadaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those two great heroic demons were destroyers of Brahmanas. Muka too was a heir and successor of Hrada. Marica, son of Sunda, was born to Tadaka.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुस्तस्मात्कर्मणा तेन स स्मृतः । हिरण्यक्षो ऽनुजस्तस्य सिंहिका तस्य चानुजा
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipustasmātkarmaṇā tena sa smṛtaḥ / hiraṇyakṣo 'nujastasya siṃhikā tasya cānujā
verses.translation: I wish for a son who will kill Sakra (Indra) and who will be obtained by me due to long penance. I shall perform the severe penance. It behoves you to make me pregnant.
verses.wordMeaning: I wish for a son who will kill Sakra (Indra) and who will be obtained by me due to long penance. I shall perform the severe penance. It behoves you to make me pregnant.
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish for a son who will kill Sakra (Indra) and who will be obtained by me due to long penance. I shall perform the severe penance. It behoves you to make me pregnant.

verses.sanskrit: राहोः सा जननी देवी विप्र चित्तेः परिग्रहः । हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यश्चचार परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: rāhoḥ sā jananī devī vipra citteḥ parigrahaḥ / hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaścacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 45-81 tell the story of the birth of Maruts when Indra during the impure state of Diti entered her womb and split his prospective killer foetus into 49 parts. Cf VP. I. 21. 32-41, Mt. P. Chapter 7.
verses.hindi: जैमिनि मुनि ने कहा--जब राजा के द्वारा अपने पौत्र अंशुमान् से इस प्रकार से कहा गया था तो महान् बुद्धिमान उसने पिता फे पिता को प्रणाम किया था ओर मैं ऐसा हो करूंगा-यह कहकर वह कपिल मुनि फे समीप में चला गया था ।२६। उसके समीप में प्राप्त होकर उसने विधि के
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 45-81 tell the story of the birth of Maruts when Indra during the impure state of Diti entered her womb and split his prospective killer foetus into 49 parts. Cf VP. I. 21. 32-41, Mt. P. Chapter 7.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 45-81 tell the story of the birth of Maruts when Indra during the impure state of Diti entered her womb and split his prospective killer foetus into 49 parts. Cf VP. I. 21. 32-41, Mt. P. Chapter 7.

verses.sanskrit: शतं वर्षसहस्राणां निराहारो ह्यधःशिराः । वरयामास ब्रह्माणं तुष्टं दैत्यो वरेण तु
verses.transliteration: śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ nirāhāro hyadhaḥśirāḥ / varayāmāsa brahmāṇaṃ tuṣṭaṃ daityo vareṇa tu
verses.translation: "I am pleased with you, O excellent one among the Suras. O dear son, only ten more years remain, welfare unto you. Thereafter, you will see your brother.
verses.hindi: साथ उनके प्रणाम किया था और फिर बुद्धि के अनुसार विनम्रता से अव- नत होकर धीरे से उनसे कहा था ।३०। है विप्रशादू ल ! मुझ पर कृपया प्रसस्न होइए पैं तो आपके चरणों की शरण में समागत हुआ ह । आपके हृदय में जो कोप समुत्पन्न हो गया है उसका संहरण शीघ्र ही कर लीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: "I am pleased with you, O excellent one among the Suras. O dear son, only ten more years remain, welfare unto you. Thereafter, you will see your brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am pleased with you, O excellent one among the Suras. O dear son, only ten more years remain, welfare unto you. Thereafter, you will see your brother.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वामरत्वमवधं सर्वभूतेभ्य एव हि । योगद्देवान् विनिर्जित्य सर्वदेवत्वमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: sarvāmaratvamavadhaṃ sarvabhūtebhya eva hi / yogaddevān vinirjitya sarvadevatvamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: I shall place him at your service even as he is desirous of victory on your behalf. You will enjoy the conquest of the tluce worlds along with him, O my son.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि आपका यह कोप समस्त लोकों के विनाश कर देने वाला है
verses.wordMeaning: I shall place him at your service even as he is desirous of victory on your behalf. You will enjoy the conquest of the tluce worlds along with him, O my son.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall place him at your service even as he is desirous of victory on your behalf. You will enjoy the conquest of the tluce worlds along with him, O my son.

verses.sanskrit: कारये ऽहमिहैश्वर्यं बलवीर्यसमन्वितः । दानवास्त्वसुराश्चैव देवाश्च सह चारणैः
verses.transliteration: kāraye 'hamihaiśvaryaṃ balavīryasamanvitaḥ / dānavāstvasurāścaiva devāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Having considered the whole reason, this thought struck him that a defect was seen in the noble lady (giving him an opportunity) to destroy the child in the womb.
verses.hindi: आपके र. हो जाने पर तो यह समग्र जगत विनाश को ही प्राप्त हो जायगा । अब आप प्रशान्त को शीघ्र प्राप्त हो जाइए । जिससे इन सब लोकों की व्यया दूर हो जावे ।३२। है महाभाग ! आप हमारे ऊपर प्रसन्न हो जाइए । सौम्य नेवों से हमको देखिए । जो आपके क्रोध की अग्नि से
verses.wordMeaning: Having considered the whole reason, this thought struck him that a defect was seen in the noble lady (giving him an opportunity) to destroy the child in the womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having considered the whole reason, this thought struck him that a defect was seen in the noble lady (giving him an opportunity) to destroy the child in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तु वशगाः सर्वे मत्समीपानुभोजनाः । आर्द्रशुष्कैरवध्यश्च दिवा रात्रौ तथैव च । एवमुक्तस्तदा ब्रह्मानुजज्ञे सांतरं वरम्
verses.transliteration: bhavantu vaśagāḥ sarve matsamīpānubhojanāḥ / ārdraśuṣkairavadhyaśca divā rātrau tathaiva ca / evamuktastadā brahmānujajñe sāṃtaraṃ varam
verses.translation: Indra split the foetus into seven parts and each of them into seven more parts by means of his thunderbolt. At that time Diti woke up.
verses.hindi: संदग्ध हो गये हैं उन्हीं की सन्तति मुझे आप समझिए ।३३। मेरा नाम अंशु- मान है और मैं राजा सगर का नाती हूँ । वह मैं राजा के ही नियोग से आपकी प्रसन्नता की अभिकांक्षा से ही मैं यहाँ पर समागत हुआ हूँ ।३४। मैं तो उस यज्ञ के अश्व के ले जाने के ही लिए आया हूँ यदि कृपा कर मुझे
verses.wordMeaning: Indra split the foetus into seven parts and each of them into seven more parts by means of his thunderbolt. At that time Diti woke up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra split the foetus into seven parts and each of them into seven more parts by means of his thunderbolt. At that time Diti woke up.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । महानयं वरस्तात वृतो दितिसुत त्वया । एही दानीं प्रतिज्ञानं भविष्यत्येवमेव तु
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca / mahānayaṃ varastāta vṛto ditisuta tvayā / ehī dānīṃ pratijñānaṃ bhaviṣyatyevameva tu
verses.translation: Diti said thus — "He (the child in the womb) should not be killed. He should not be killed." Thereupon, Indra jumped out, out of deference to his mother's words.
verses.hindi: देगे । जैमिनि मुनि ने कहा--उस अंशुमान के इस वचन को सुनकर योगीन्र अवर मुनि ने अंशुमान का अवलोकन किया ओर परम प्रसन्न होकर यह वचन उससे कहा या
verses.wordMeaning: Diti said thus — "He (the child in the womb) should not be killed. He should not be killed." Thereupon, Indra jumped out, out of deference to his mother's words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Diti said thus — "He (the child in the womb) should not be killed. He should not be killed." Thereupon, Indra jumped out, out of deference to his mother's words.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा चाभिमतं तस्मै तत्रेवान्तरधादथ । सो ऽपि दैत्यस्तदा सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: dattvā cābhimataṃ tasmai tatrevāntaradhādatha / so 'pi daityastadā sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: When that foetus became fruitless, Diti was extremely distressed. She thereupon spoke to the invincible thousand- eyed lord Indra in a pacifying note: —
verses.wordMeaning: When that foetus became fruitless, Diti was extremely distressed. She thereupon spoke to the invincible thousand- eyed lord Indra in a pacifying note: —
verses.commentary: Sense: When that foetus became fruitless, Diti was extremely distressed. She thereupon spoke to the invincible thousand- eyed lord Indra in a pacifying note: —

verses.sanskrit: महिम्ना व्याप्य संतस्थे बहुमूर्त्तिरमित्रजित् । स एव तपति व्योम्नि चन्द्रसूर्यत्वमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: mahimnā vyāpya saṃtasthe bahumūrttiramitrajit / sa eva tapati vyomni candrasūryatvamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: "Ifitwasdue to my default that this foetus was rendered ineffective by you, it is not your fault, O lord of the Devas, O son of great strength.
verses.wordMeaning: "Ifitwasdue to my default that this foetus was rendered ineffective by you, it is not your fault, O lord of the Devas, O son of great strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Ifitwasdue to my default that this foetus was rendered ineffective by you, it is not your fault, O lord of the Devas, O son of great strength.

verses.sanskrit: स एव वायुर्भूत्वा च ववौ जगति सर्वदा । स गोपालो ऽविपालश्च कर्षकश्च स एव ह
verses.transliteration: sa eva vāyurbhūtvā ca vavau jagati sarvadā / sa gopālo 'vipālaśca karṣakaśca sa eva ha
verses.translation: This pur&iic classification of seven strata or levels of the higher atmosphere or space and the assignment of the Marut-godji to each is psuedo — scientific but is found in other pur&nas also.
verses.wordMeaning: This pur&iic classification of seven strata or levels of the higher atmosphere or space and the assignment of the Marut-godji to each is psuedo — scientific but is found in other pur&nas also.
verses.commentary: Sense: This pur&iic classification of seven strata or levels of the higher atmosphere or space and the assignment of the Marut-godji to each is psuedo — scientific but is found in other pur&nas also.

verses.sanskrit: स ज्ञाता सर्वलोकेषु मन्त्रव्याख्याकरस्तथा । नेता गोप्ता गोपयिता दीक्षितो याजकः स तु
verses.transliteration: sa jñātā sarvalokeṣu mantravyākhyākarastathā / netā goptā gopayitā dīkṣito yājakaḥ sa tu
verses.translation: After giving these names, Diti said to Indra, Let these brothers, my sons, traverse these Vdtaskandhas.
verses.hindi: पापानां मरणं त्वेषां न च जोचितुमह॑सि
verses.wordMeaning: After giving these names, Diti said to Indra, Let these brothers, my sons, traverse these Vdtaskandhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving these names, Diti said to Indra, Let these brothers, my sons, traverse these Vdtaskandhas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाः सुराः सर्वे तदासन्सोमपायिनः । एवंप्रभावो दैत्यो ऽसावतो भूयो निबोधत
verses.transliteration: tasya devāḥ surāḥ sarve tadāsansomapāyinaḥ / evaṃprabhāvo daityo 'sāvato bhūyo nibodhata
verses.translation: By becoming as said by you, these noble-souled bachelors (?) will be honoured by the world. Along with the Devas they will participate (have their share in the oblations) in the Yajnas.
verses.wordMeaning: By becoming as said by you, these noble-souled bachelors (?) will be honoured by the world. Along with the Devas they will participate (have their share in the oblations) in the Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: By becoming as said by you, these noble-souled bachelors (?) will be honoured by the world. Along with the Devas they will participate (have their share in the oblations) in the Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै सर्वे नमस्कारं कुर्वन्तीज्यः स एव च । हिरण्यकशिपोर्दैत्यैः श्लोको गीतः पुरा त्विह
verses.transliteration: tasmai sarve namaskāraṃ kurvantījyaḥ sa eva ca / hiraṇyakaśipordaityaiḥ śloko gītaḥ purā tviha
verses.translation: Hence, these Maruts are Devas. All of them were excellent younger brothers of Indra. All those powerful and speedy sons of Diti should be known as immortal ones."
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, these Maruts are Devas. All of them were excellent younger brothers of Indra. All those powerful and speedy sons of Diti should be known as immortal ones."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, these Maruts are Devas. All of them were excellent younger brothers of Indra. All those powerful and speedy sons of Diti should be known as immortal ones."

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपू राजा यां यामाशां निरैक्षत । तस्यै तस्यै तदा देवा नमश्चक्रुर्महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipū rājā yāṃ yāmāśāṃ niraikṣata / tasyai tasyai tadā devā namaścakrurmaharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Those two, the son and the mother came to this
verses.hindi: हे वत्स ! आपका स्वागत है । बड़े ही हर्ष की बात है कि आप यहाँ पर आ गये हो ।३६। अब बहुत शीघ्र जाओ यह अश्व राजा सगर के समीप में ले जाओ । पूर्व से ही संग्रवृत्त हुआ इस राजा का यज्ञ रुक गया है उसको पूर्ण करो ।३७। और आपके मन में जो भी कुछ हो वह वरदान अब मुझसे
verses.wordMeaning: Those two, the son and the mother came to this
verses.commentary: Sense: Those two, the son and the mother came to this

verses.sanskrit: तस्यासीन्नरसिंहस्तु मृत्युर्विष्णुः पुरा किल । नरात्तु यस्माज्जन्मास्य नरमूर्त्तिश्च यत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tasyāsīnnarasiṃhastu mṛtyurviṣṇuḥ purā kila / narāttu yasmājjanmāsya naramūrttiśca yatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त कर लो। में तुम्हारी भक्ति से बहुत ही परितुष्ट हो गया हूँ यदि तुम्हारा वर परम दुलंभ भी होगा तो भी मैं तुमको दे ही दू'गा ।३८। अब तुम इन साठ सहस्न नृप के पुत्रों का विनाश हो गया है-यह राजा से कह देना । ये महान पापी ये अतः इनके मरण के विषय में राजा से कह देना
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स नरसिंहो वै गीयते वेदवादिभिः । सागरस्य च वेलायामुच्छ्रित स्तपसो विभुः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsa narasiṃho vai gīyate vedavādibhiḥ / sāgarasya ca velāyāmucchrita stapaso vibhuḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: कि कोई शोक न करें ।३६। फिर उन योगीन्द्र मुनि को प्रणाम करके अ'शु- मान ने उनसे यह कहा था । है मुने ! आप यदि मुझको वरदान देने की इच्छा करते हैं तो मैं आपसे वर का वरुण करू ।४०। यदि मैं वर पाने के योग्य हैं तो आपसे वरदान प्राप्त करू किन्तु वह वरदान आप सुप्रसन्न
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं तस्य देवस्य ह्यासीद्देवमयं प्रभो । नाम्ना सुदर्शनं चैव विश्रुतश्च महाबलः
verses.transliteration: śarīraṃ tasya devasya hyāsīddevamayaṃ prabho / nāmnā sudarśanaṃ caiva viśrutaśca mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: होकर ही मुझे दीजिए। आपके रोष को अग्नि से मेरे सभी पितृगण संप्लुष्ट हो गये हैं ।४१। है ब्रह्मन् ! क्योंकि उन्होंने आपका महान अपराध किया
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स बाहुयुद्धेन दैत्येन्द्रं तं महाबलम् । नखैर्बिभद संक्रुद्धो नार्द्राः शुष्का नखा इति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bāhuyuddhena daityendraṃ taṃ mahābalam / nakhairbibhada saṃkruddho nārdrāḥ śuṣkā nakhā iti
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: डॅड   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण था इससे वे सभी बहुत वर्षों तक नरक में जायेंगे । क्योंकि वे सब ब्रह्मदण्ड से हत हैं अतएव उनकी पिण्डोदक क्रिया भी कुछ नही हो सकती है
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्याक्षसुताः पञ्च विक्रान्ताः सुमहाबलाः । शंबरः शकुनिश्चैव कालनाभस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyākṣasutāḥ pañca vikrāntāḥ sumahābalāḥ / śaṃbaraḥ śakuniścaiva kālanābhastathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: महानाभः सुविक्रान्तो सुत संतापनस्तथा । हिरण्यक्षसुता ह्येते देवैरपि दुरासदाः
verses.transliteration: mahānābhaḥ suvikrānto suta saṃtāpanastathā / hiraṇyakṣasutā hyete devairapi durāsadāḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च दैतेयाः सगणाः स्मृताः । स शतानि सहस्राणि निहतास्तारकामये
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca daiteyāḥ sagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / sa śatāni sahasrāṇi nihatāstārakāmaye
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राश्चत्वारः सुमहाबलाः । प्रह्लादः पूर्वजस्तेषामनुह्ना दस्तथापरः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāścatvāraḥ sumahābalāḥ / prahlādaḥ pūrvajasteṣāmanuhnā dastathāparaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.transliteration: saṃhrādaścaiva hrādaśca hrādaputrau nibodhata / suṃdo nisundaśca tathā hrādaputau babhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्यघ्नौ तौ महावीरौ मूकस्तु ह्राददायकः । मारीचः सुन्दपुत्रस्तु ताडकायामजायत
verses.transliteration: brahyaghnau tau mahāvīrau mūkastu hrādadāyakaḥ / mārīcaḥ sundaputrastu tāḍakāyāmajāyata
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डके निहतः सो ऽथ राघवेण बलीयसा । मूको विनिहतश्चापि कैराते सव्यसाचिना
verses.transliteration: daṇḍake nihataḥ so 'tha rāghaveṇa balīyasā / mūko vinihataścāpi kairāte savyasācinā
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: संह्रादस्य तु दैत्यस्य निवातकवचाः कुले । उत्पन्ना महता चैव तपसा भाविताः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhrādasya tu daityasya nivātakavacāḥ kule / utpannā mahatā caiva tapasā bhāvitāḥ svayam
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
