verses.sanskrit: अरयो देवतानां ते जंभस्य शतदुन्दुभिः । तथा दक्षो सुरश्चण्डश्चत्वारो देत्यनायकाः
verses.transliteration: arayo devatānāṃ te jaṃbhasya śatadundubhiḥ / tathā dakṣo suraścaṇḍaścatvāro detyanāyakāḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: बाष्कलस्य सुता ह्येते काल नेमेः सुताञ्छृणु । ब्रह्मजित्क्रतुजिच्चैव देवान्तकनरान्तकौ
verses.transliteration: bāṣkalasya sutā hyete kāla nemeḥ sutāñchṛṇu / brahmajitkratujiccaiva devāntakanarāntakau
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: हे महामुने ! इस लोक में जिनकी पिष्डोदक क्रिया नहीं होती है वे पितृगण के लोक में उनका सालोकय प्राप्त नहीं कर सकते हैं-ऐसा श्रुति सम्मत प्रमाण है ।४३। अब मेरा यही वर मुझे प्रदान कीजिए कि आपके प्रसाद से उनको अक्षय स्वगे का निवास प्राप्त होवे। है भगवान ! इस
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: कालनेमिसुता ह्येते शभोस्तु शृणुत प्रजाः । राजाजश्चैव गोमश्च शंभोः पुत्रौ प्रकीर्त्तितौ
verses.transliteration: kālanemisutā hyete śabhostu śṛṇuta prajāḥ / rājājaścaiva gomaśca śaṃbhoḥ putrau prakīrttitau
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: बरदान से मैं कृत-कृत्य हो जाऊंगा ।४४। सो आप प्रसन्न हो जाइए और उनके स्वर्ग में गमन करने का कारण बता दीजिए। जिसके करने से उनका कोप की अग्नि से उद्धार डो जावे ।४१। इसके अनन्तर योगीन्र प्रसन्न चित्त से उससे बोले--हे वत्स ! उनका नरक से उद्धार तुम्हारे द्वारा नहीं किया
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: विरोजनस्य पुत्रश्च बलिरेकः प्रतापवान् । बलेः पुत्रशतं जज्ञे राजानः सर्व एव ते
verses.transliteration: virojanasya putraśca balirekaḥ pratāpavān / baleḥ putraśataṃ jajñe rājānaḥ sarva eva te
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: जा सकता है ।४६। पाप कर्मों के करने वालों को तब तक नरक में वास करना ही होगा । उस समय की प्रतीक्षा करो जब तक तुम्हारे यहाँ पौत्र
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां प्रधानाश्चत्वारो विक्रान्ताः सुमहाबलाः । सहस्रबाहुः श्रेष्ठो ऽभूद्बाणो राजा प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ pradhānāścatvāro vikrāntāḥ sumahābalāḥ / sahasrabāhuḥ śreṣṭho 'bhūdbāṇo rājā pratāpavān
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: जन्म ग्रहण करे ।४७। कुछ काल के पश्चाद् है वत्स ! तुम्हारा एक महामति पौत्र होगा । उसका शुभ नाम राजा भगीरच होगा जो समस्त धर्मों के
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: कुंभगर्त्तो दयो भोजः कुञ्चिरित्येवमा दयः । शकुनी पूतना चैव कन्ये द्वे तु बलेः स्मृते
verses.transliteration: kuṃbhagartto dayo bhojaḥ kuñcirityevamā dayaḥ / śakunī pūtanā caiva kanye dve tu baleḥ smṛte
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: बलेः पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । बालेया नाम विख्याता गणा विक्रान्तपौरुषाः
verses.transliteration: baleḥ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / bāleyā nāma vikhyātā gaṇā vikrāntapauruṣāḥ

verses.hindi: अथां के तत्त्वो का ज्ञाता होगा।४८। वह अपने पितरों के गौरव से सुसमन्वित होगा और महान यत्न से परम घोर तप करके निश्चय ही स्वग से यहाँ पर गङ्गा को लावेगा
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: बाणस्य चैन्द्रधन्वा तु लोहिन्यामुदपद्यत । दितिर्विहितपुत्रा वै तोषयामास कश्यपम्
verses.transliteration: bāṇasya caindradhanvā tu lohinyāmudapadyata / ditirvihitaputrā vai toṣayāmāsa kaśyapam
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तां कश्यपः प्रसन्नात्मा सम्यगाराधितस्त्वथ । वरेण छन्दयामास सा च वव्रे वरं तत
verses.transliteration: tāṃ kaśyapaḥ prasannātmā samyagārādhitastvatha / vareṇa chandayāmāsa sā ca vavre varaṃ tata
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यै वरं प्रादात्प्रार्थितो भगवान्पुनः । उक्ते वरे तु मा तुष्टा दितिस्तं समभाषत
verses.transliteration: atha tasyai varaṃ prādātprārthito bhagavānpunaḥ / ukte vare tu mā tuṣṭā ditistaṃ samabhāṣata
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: मारीचं कण्यपं देवी भर्त्तारं प्राञ्जलिस्तदा । हतपुत्रास्मि भगवन्नादित्यैस्तव सूनुभिः
verses.transliteration: mārīcaṃ kaṇyapaṃ devī bharttāraṃ prāñjalistadā / hataputrāsmi bhagavannādityaistava sūnubhiḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: उस पतित पावनी गङ्का के पुनीत जल से उन सबके गात्र-अस्थि और भस्म के पवित्र हो जाने पर वे समस्त आपके ,पितृगण स्वगं में गति को प्राप्त करेगे ।१०। है नृपनन्दन उस गजा का माहात्म्य ही ऐसा अदुभुत है। राजा भगीरथ के द्वारा यहाँ लाने से इस लोक में उसका नाम भागीरथी
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रहन्तारमिच्छमि पुत्रं दीर्घतपो ऽर्जितम् । साहं तपश्चरिष्यामि गर्भमाधातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: śakrahantāramicchami putraṃ dīrghatapo 'rjitam / sāhaṃ tapaścariṣyāmi garbhamādhātumarhasi
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: प्रसिद्ध होगा ।५१। गङ्गा का बड़ा अदुभुत माहात्म्य होता है कि उसके जल में किसी भी प्राणी की अस्थि-भस्म-नख आदि कोई भी भाग जब प्लावित हो जाता है तो वह प्राणी नरक की यातनाओं से भी मुक्त होकर अक्षय स्वर्गलोक में चला जाया करता है ।२। इस कारण से अब आप यहाँ से
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रमिन्द्रवधे युक्तं त्वं मै वै दातुमर्हसि । तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मारीचः कश्यपस्तदा
verses.transliteration: putramindravadhe yuktaṃ tvaṃ mai vai dātumarhasi / tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā mārīcaḥ kaśyapastadā
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: चले जाइए--आपका कल्याणं होगा-आपको कुछ भी शोक नहीं करना चाहिए । अपने पितामह को यहँ अश्व ले जाकर दे दो ।१३। जेमिनि
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युवाच महातेजा दितिं परमदुः खितः । एवं भवतु गर्भे तु शुचिर्भव तपोधने
verses.transliteration: pratyuvāca mahātejā ditiṃ paramaduḥ khitaḥ / evaṃ bhavatu garbhe tu śucirbhava tapodhane
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: जनयिष्यसि पुत्रं त्वं शक्रहन्तारमाहवे । पूर्णं वर्षसहस्रं तु शुचिर्यदि भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: janayiṣyasi putraṃ tvaṃ śakrahantāramāhave / pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu śuciryadi bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: ने कहा--इसके अनन्तर उस महामति ने- ऐसा हो करूंगा-यह कहकर उनको भक्ति से प्रणाम किया था और उनकी आज्ञा प्राप्त कर साकेत नगरी को ओर वहाँ से गमन किया था ।३४ राजा सगर के समीप में पहुँच कर उसने क्रमानुसार उनको प्रणाम किया या और फिर उन सबका--मुनि का
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं त्रिलोकप्रवरं मन्मथं जनयिष्यसि । एवमुक्त्वा महातेजास्तथा समभावत्तदा
verses.transliteration: putraṃ trilokapravaraṃ manmathaṃ janayiṣyasi / evamuktvā mahātejāstathā samabhāvattadā
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: और अपना सम्पूर्णे वृत्तान्त राजा से निवेदन कर दिया था ।५५। और बह अश्व भी राजा को दे दिया या । जिसको वह बडे प्रयत्न से लाया था। फिर राजा की सेवा में परार्थता की थो कि अब आगे मुझे क्या सेवा करनी चाहिए--यह अपनी आज्ञा प्रदान कीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तामालभ्य स्वभवनं जगाम भगवानृषिः । गते भर्त्तरि सा देवी दितिः परमहर्षिता
verses.transliteration: tāmālabhya svabhavanaṃ jagāma bhagavānṛṣiḥ / gate bharttari sā devī ditiḥ paramaharṣitā
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: उपाक्रमत तं यज्ञं विधिबद्व दपा रगँः
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: कुशप्लवनमासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् । शक्रस्तु समुपश्रुत्य संवादं तं तयोः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kuśaplavanamāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam / śakrastu samupaśrutya saṃvādaṃ taṃ tayoḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: कुशप्लवनमागम्य दितिं वाक्यमभाषत । शुश्रूषां ते करिष्यामि मानुज्ञां दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: kuśaplavanamāgamya ditiṃ vākyamabhāṣata / śuśrūṣāṃ te kariṣyāmi mānujñāṃ dātumarhasi
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: सुसमृद्ध यथाशास्त्रं यज्ञे सर्व बभुव ह
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: समिधश्चाहरिष्यामि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च । यथा त्वं मन्यसे वत्स सुश्रूषाभिरतो भव
verses.transliteration: samidhaścāhariṣyāmi puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca / yathā tvaṃ manyase vatsa suśrūṣābhirato bhava
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: एवं प्रवत्तितं यज्ञमृत्विजः सर्व एव ते । क्रमात्समापयामामुर्यज मानपुरस्सरा:
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकर्मसु निष्णात आत्मनो हितमाचर । वरं श्रुत्वा तु त द्वाक्यं मातुः शक्रः प्रहर्षितः
verses.transliteration: sarvakarmasu niṣṇāta ātmano hitamācara / varaṃ śrutvā tu ta dvākyaṃ mātuḥ śakraḥ praharṣitaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: समापयित्वा तं यज्ञं राजा विधिविदां वर: । यथावद्दक्षिणां चेव ऋत्विजां प्रददौ तदा
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषाभिरतो भूत्वा कलुषेणान्तरात्मना । शुश्रूषते तु तां शक्रः सर्वकालमनुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: śuśrūṣābhirato bhūtvā kaluṣeṇāntarātmanā / śuśrūṣate tu tāṃ śakraḥ sarvakālamanuvrataḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: फलपुष्पाण्युपादाय समिधश्च दृढव्रतः । गात्रसंवाहनं काले श्रमापनयने तथा
verses.transliteration: phalapuṣpāṇyupādāya samidhaśca dṛḍhavrataḥ / gātrasaṃvāhanaṃ kāle śramāpanayane tathā
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रः सर्वेषु कालेषु दितिं परिचचार ह । किञ्चिच्छिष्टे व्रते देवी तुष्टा शक्रमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: śakraḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu ditiṃ paricacāra ha / kiñcicchiṣṭe vrate devī tuṣṭā śakramuvāca ha
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: जेमिनी मुनि ने कहा--इसके अनन्तर राजा सगर ने प्रेम से विह्वल होकर अपने पोत्र का परिध्वजन किया था ओर अत्यधिक आशीबंचनों से उसका अभिनन्दन करके बहुत ही अधिक लाड़ करते हुए उसकी प्रशसा की थो ।१। इसके उपरान्त सब ऋत्विजों और सदस्यों के सहित उस नृप श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतीताहं ते सुरश्रेष्ठ दशवर्षाणि पुत्रक । अवशिष्ठानि भद्रं ते भ्रातरं द्रक्ष्यसे ततः
verses.transliteration: pratītāhaṃ te suraśreṣṭha daśavarṣāṇi putraka / avaśiṣṭhāni bhadraṃ te bhrātaraṃ drakṣyase tataḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: ने वेदों के पारगामी विप्रं कै द्वारा उस यज्ञ का विधि सहित उपक्रम किया चा ।२। इसके अनन्तर सब प्रकार की सम्पत्ति और गुणों से संयुत वह यज्ञ आरम्भ हुआ था जिसका समारम्भ ओवं ओर वसिष्ठ आदि मुनियों के द्वारा भली भांति सम्प्रवत्तित किया गया था ।३। उस यज्ञ की वेदी सुवर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तमहं त्वत्कृते पुत्र सह धास्ये जयैषिणम् । त्रैलोक्यविजयं पुत्र भोक्ष्यसे सह तेन वै
verses.transliteration: tamahaṃ tvatkṛte putra saha dhāsye jayaiṣiṇam / trailokyavijayaṃ putra bhokṣyase saha tena vai
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: से निमित की गयी थी तथा उसके उपयुक्त सभी छोटे- पाज अत्युत्तम जुटाये गये ये । उस यज्ञ में शास्त्र के अनुसार सभी बस्तुए सुसमृद्ध थी
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं पुत्राभिजानामि मद्भक्तिगतमानसम् । एवमुक्त्वा दितिः शक्रं मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ putrābhijānāmi madbhaktigatamānasam / evamuktvā ditiḥ śakraṃ madhyaṃ prāpte divākare
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: निद्रयापहृता दवी शिरः कृत्वा तु जानुनि । केशान्कृत्वा तु पादस्थान्सा सुष्वाप च देवता
verses.transliteration: nidrayāpahṛtā davī śiraḥ kṛtvā tu jānuni / keśānkṛtvā tu pādasthānsā suṣvāpa ca devatā

verses.hindi: सदस्य-प्राह्मण तथा याचकों के लिए सबको जो भो उनका आकांक्षित या उस से अधिक घन दिया था

verses.sanskrit: अधस्ताद्यत्तु नाभेर्वै सर्वं तदशुचि स्मृतम् । ततस्तामशुचिं ज्ञात्वा स्ॐतरं तदमन्यत
verses.transliteration: adhastādyattu nābhervai sarvaṃ tadaśuci smṛtam / tatastāmaśuciṃ jñātvā soṃtaraṃ tadamanyata
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु कारणं सर्वं तस्य बुद्धिरजायत । गर्भं निहन्तु वै देव्या स हि दोषो ऽत्र दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tasya buddhirajāyata / garbhaṃ nihantu vai devyā sa hi doṣo 'tra dṛśyate

verses.sanskrit: ततो विवेश दित्या वै ह्युपस्थेनोदरं वृषा । प्रविश्य चापि तं दृष्ट्वा गभमिन्द्रो महौजसम्
verses.transliteration: tato viveśa dityā vai hyupasthenodaraṃ vṛṣā / praviśya cāpi taṃ dṛṣṭvā gabhamindro mahaujasam
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: भीतस्तं सप्तधा गभ बिभेद रिपुमात्मनः । म गर्भो भिद्यमानस्तु वज्रणशतपर्वणा
verses.transliteration: bhītastaṃ saptadhā gabha bibheda ripumātmanaḥ / ma garbho bhidyamānastu vajraṇaśataparvaṇā
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से विभुगण आदि की दक्षिणाओं से भली-भाँति तृष्ति करके क्रम के अनुसार गुरुवो को और सदस्यों को प्रणिपात करके उनसे क्षमा की याचना की थी ।८। फिर वह राजा शोभा यात्रा के स्वरूप में सरयू के तट पर गया था। उसके साथ ब्राह्मण आदि समो वर्णो वाले लोग तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: रुरोद सुस्वरं भीमं वेपमानः पुनः पुनः । मारोद मारोद इति गर्भं शक्रो ऽभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: ruroda susvaraṃ bhīmaṃ vepamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / māroda māroda iti garbhaṃ śakro 'bhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: ऋत्बिज गण थे और जो मागं में रोकथाम करने बाले लोग थे उनके
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तं गर्भं सप्तधा कृत्वा ह्येकैकं सप्तधा पुनः । कुलिशेन बिभेदेन्द्रस्ततो दितिरबुध्यता
verses.transliteration: taṃ garbhaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā hyekaikaṃ saptadhā punaḥ / kuliśena bibhedendrastato ditirabudhyatā
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: को साथ में लेकर अपनी पत्नियों के सहित राजा वहां से चला था जिसके उपर श्वेत छत्र शोभित था । उसके दोनों और चमर दुराये जा रहे ये तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्य इत्येवं दितिरब्रवीत् । निष्पपात ततो वज्री मातुर्वचनगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: na hantavyo na hantavya ityevaṃ ditirabravīt / niṣpapāta tato vajrī māturvacanagauravāt
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: थे जिनकी तुमुल ध्वनि से सभी दिशाओं कुछ भी सुनाई नहीं दे रहा था । इस रोति से वह शास्त्र के कथनानुसार विधिपूबंक सरयू पर प्राप्त हो गया था ।११। समस्त बन्धु-बास्ख्वों के साथ परम प्रसम्न होकर अवशृथ अर्थात् यज्ञान्त स्नान राजा ने किया था । इस रीति के पत्नियों के सहित सुहूदुगण
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: प्राञ्जलिर्वज्रसहितो दितिं शक्रो ऽभ्यभाषत । अशुचिर्देवि सुप्तासि पादयोर्गतमूर्द्धजा
verses.transliteration: prāñjalirvajrasahito ditiṃ śakro 'bhyabhāṣata / aśucirdevi suptāsi pādayorgatamūrddhajā

verses.hindi: और बिगरों के साथ स्नान करके वहाँ से राजा बापिस चला था ।१२। उस समय में बीणा-वेणु-म्ृदज़ आदि अनेक बाजे रहे थे ओर माङ्गलिक वेद- मन्त्रों की भी ध्वनि हो रहो थो जिन मन्त्रं को ब्राह्मण बोल रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तदं तरमनुप्राप्य गर्भं हेतारमाहवे । भिन्नवानहमेतं ते बहुधा क्षन्तुमर्हसि

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तु विफले गर्भे दितिः परमदुःखिता । सहस्राक्षं दुराधर्षं वाक्यं सानुनयाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstu viphale garbhe ditiḥ paramaduḥkhitā / sahasrākṣaṃ durādharṣaṃ vākyaṃ sānunayābravīt

verses.sanskrit: ममापराधाद्गर्भो ऽयं यदि ते विफलीकृतः । नापराधो ऽस्ति देवेश तव पुत्र महाबल

verses.hindi: केलासाद्रिप्रकाजाभिरुज्ज्वलां सौधपक्तिभि: । स तत्रागरुधपोत्थंधा मोदितदिङ मुखम्

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: शत्रोर्वधे न दोषो ऽस्ति भेतव्यं न च ते विभो । प्रियं तु कृतमिच्छामि श्रेयो गर्भस्य मे कुतः
verses.transliteration: śatrorvadhe na doṣo 'sti bhetavyaṃ na ca te vibho / priyaṃ tu kṛtamicchāmi śreyo garbhasya me kutaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: बिकीयंमाणः परितः पौरनारीजनेमू हुः । लाजवर्षेण सानंदं वीक्षमाणश्च नागरे:

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तु मम पुत्राणां सप्त स्थानानि वै दिवि । वातस्कन्धानिमान्सप्त चरन्तु मम पुत्रकाः
verses.transliteration: bhavantu mama putrāṇāṃ sapta sthānāni vai divi / vātaskandhānimānsapta carantu mama putrakāḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: उपदाभिरनेकाभिस्तत्र तत्र वणिग्जनेः । संभाऽव्यमानः शनकंजंगाम स्वपुरं प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: मरुतस्ते तु विख्याता गतास्ते सप्तसप्तकाः । पृथिव्यां प्रथमस्कन्धो द्वितीयश्चापि भास्करे
verses.transliteration: marutaste tu vikhyātā gatāste saptasaptakāḥ / pṛthivyāṃ prathamaskandho dvitīyaścāpi bhāskare
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: सोमे तृतीयो विज्ञेयश्चतुर्थो ज्योतिषां गणे । ग्रहेषु पञ्चमस्चैव षष्ठः सप्तर्षिमण्डले
verses.transliteration: some tṛtīyo vijñeyaścaturtho jyotiṣāṃ gaṇe / graheṣu pañcamascaiva ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptarṣimaṇḍale
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवे तु सप्तमश्चैव वातस्कन्धाश्चसप्त ये । तानेते विचरन्त्वद्य कालेकाले ममात्मजाः
verses.transliteration: dhruve tu saptamaścaiva vātaskandhāścasapta ye / tānete vicarantvadya kālekāle mamātmajāḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: उस पुरी की शोभा का बर्णन किया जाता है कि उसमें सर्वत्र छत्र
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: वातस्कन्धाधिपा भूत्वा चरन्तु मम पुत्रकाः । पृथिव्यां प्रथमस्कन्ध आ मेघेब्यो य आवहः
verses.transliteration: vātaskandhādhipā bhūtvā carantu mama putrakāḥ / pṛthivyāṃ prathamaskandha ā meghebyo ya āvahaḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: पताका-ध्व जाओं को मालावें दिखाई दे रहो थीं सवंत्र पुरो का भूभाग संमा- जित तथा संसिकत था और उसमें दुकान और बाजारों की भी अतीव अद्- भुत शोभा हो रही थो ।१५। उस पुरी में बड़े-बड़े भवनों की की पंक्तियाँ थी जो बहुत ही ऊँचे थे ओर जिनमें प्रकाश हो रहा था । वे ऐसे ही प्रतीत
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: चरन्तु मम पुत्रास्ते सप्त ये प्रथमे गणे । द्वितीयश्चापि मेघेभ्य आसूर्यात्प्रवहस्ततः
verses.transliteration: carantu mama putrāste sapta ye prathame gaṇe / dvitīyaścāpi meghebhya āsūryātpravahastataḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: हो रहे थे मानों उज्ज्वल केलाश मिरि के शिखर हों । वहाँ पर अगुरु की धूप की गर्छ चारों ओर फंल रही थी जिससे सभी दिशाओं के मुख आमो- दित हो रहे ये ।१६। नगर निवासिनी नारियों का समुदाय सभी ओर बार- म्बार खीलो की वर्षा राजा के ऊपर कर रहा था और नगर निवासी पुरुष
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: वातस्कन्धो हि विज्ञेयो द्वितीयश्चरतां गणः । सूर्यादूर्ध्वमधः सोमादुद्वहो ऽथ स वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vātaskandho hi vijñeyo dvitīyaścaratāṃ gaṇaḥ / sūryādūrdhvamadhaḥ somādudvaho 'tha sa vai smṛtaḥ

verses.transliteration: caturtho mama putrāṇāṃ gaṇastu caratāṃ vibho / ṛkṣebhyaśca tathaivorddhvamā grahādvivahastu yaḥ

verses.transliteration: citrajyotiśca jyotiṣmān sutapaścaitya eva ca / prathamo 'yaṃ gaṇaḥ prokto dvitīyaṃ tu nibodhata

verses.hindi: हो गया था ।२३। जिस तरह से शुल्क पक्ष के आदि में अचिरोदित अर्थात् तुरन्त ही उगे हुए चन्द्रमा को जो कि नवीन होता है सभी उसका दर्शने करके परम प्रसन्न हुआ करते हैं ठीक उसी भाति से वह राजा वालक था और अपरिमित ओज से समन्वित था अतः उसको बहुत प्यार किया करती

verses.sanskrit: एवं तौ निश्चयं कृत्वा मातापुत्रौ तपोवने । जग्मतुस्त्रिदिवं त्दृष्टौ शक्रमाभूद्गतज्वरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tau niścayaṃ kṛtvā mātāputrau tapovane / jagmatustridivaṃ tdṛṣṭau śakramābhūdgatajvaraḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: पुत्रों ने उस यज्ञ के अश्व की खोज करते हुए एक सहस्र योजन खोदकर आठ ही बिनिपातित किये हैं ।३। क्योंकि सगर के पुत्रों के द्वारा बह समुद्र बढ़ा दिया गया है। तभी से लेकर इसका सागर यह नाम प्राप्त हो गया है ।४॥ तीर्थो और काननों तथा क्षेत्रों के सहित ब्रह्म पाद की अवधि तक इस
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: मरुतां च शुभं जन्म शृणुयाद्यः पठेच्च वा । वादे विजयमाप्नोति लब्धात्मा च भवत्युत
verses.transliteration: marutāṃ ca śubhaṃ janma śṛṇuyādyaḥ paṭhecca vā / vāde vijayamāpnoti labdhātmā ca bhavatyuta
verses.translation: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.hindi: मही को समुद्र ने अपने जल से परिक्षिप्त करके संक्रामित कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to the auspicious birth of the Maruts or he who reads this, shall attain victory in argument. He shall regain his lost soul.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सूत उवाच अभवन्दनुपुत्रास्तु वंशे ख्याता महासुराः । विप्रचित्तिप्रधा नास्ते ऽचिन्तनीयपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sūta uvāca abhavandanuputrāstu vaṃśe khyātā mahāsurāḥ / vipracittipradhā nāste 'cintanīyaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: The sons of Danu were great Asuraswell known in their race. The most important among them was Vipracitti. They possessed unimaginable exploits and valour.
verses.hindi: फिर सब निलय-देव-असुर और मानब्र महान् दुःख से संयुत होते हुए इधर- उधर हो गये थे ।६। पश्चिम समुद्र के तट पर हुए योजन विस्तार वाला गोकर्ण नामक क्षेत्र विख्यात था जो समी सुरों के द्वारा अचित घा
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Danu were great Asuraswell known in their race. The most important among them was Vipracitti. They possessed unimaginable exploits and valour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Danu were great Asuraswell known in their race. The most important among them was Vipracitti. They possessed unimaginable exploits and valour.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे लब्धवराश्चैव ते तप्ततपसस्तथा । सत्यसंधाः पराक्रान्ताः क्रूरा मायाविनश्च ते
verses.transliteration: sarve labdhavarāścaiva te taptatapasastathā / satyasaṃdhāḥ parākrāntāḥ krūrā māyāvinaśca te
verses.translation: All of them were persons who had performed great penances and had obtained boons. They were truthful, aggres- sive against enemies and cruel. They were experts in the use of Maya.-
verses.wordMeaning: All of them were persons who had performed great penances and had obtained boons. They were truthful, aggres- sive against enemies and cruel. They were experts in the use of Maya.-
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them were persons who had performed great penances and had obtained boons. They were truthful, aggres- sive against enemies and cruel. They were experts in the use of Maya.-

verses.sanskrit: महाबलास्ते जवना ब्रह्मिष्ठा ये च साग्नयः । कीर्त्यमानान्मया सर्वान्प्राधान्येन निबोधत
verses.transliteration: mahābalāste javanā brahmiṣṭhā ye ca sāgnayaḥ / kīrtyamānānmayā sarvānprādhānyena nibodhata
verses.translation: They possessed great strength and were swift in move- ment. They were engrossed in the study of the Vedas ( Brahmitfha ) and maintained holy fires. Understand them even as they are being glorified in accordance with their prominence.
verses.wordMeaning: They possessed great strength and were swift in move- ment. They were engrossed in the study of the Vedas ( Brahmitfha ) and maintained holy fires. Understand them even as they are being glorified in accordance with their prominence.
verses.commentary: Sense: They possessed great strength and were swift in move- ment. They were engrossed in the study of the Vedas ( Brahmitfha ) and maintained holy fires. Understand them even as they are being glorified in accordance with their prominence.

verses.sanskrit: द्विमूर्द्धा शंबरश्चैव तथा शङ्कुरथो विभुः । शङ्कुकर्णो विपादश्च गविष्ठो दुन्दुभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dvimūrddhā śaṃbaraścaiva tathā śaṅkuratho vibhuḥ / śaṅkukarṇo vipādaśca gaviṣṭho dundubhistathā
verses.translation: Thus the Asuras, Daityas and Danavas have beea recounted.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Asuras, Daityas and Danavas have beea recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Asuras, Daityas and Danavas have beea recounted.

verses.sanskrit: अयोमुखस्तु मघवान्कपिलो वामनो मयः । मरीचिरसिपाश्चैव महा मायो ऽशिरा भृशी
verses.transliteration: ayomukhastu maghavānkapilo vāmano mayaḥ / marīcirasipāścaiva mahā māyo 'śirā bhṛśī
verses.translation: The following fourteen* great Asuras are called Saimhikeyas. They were born of Simhika as the sons of Vipracitti: —
verses.wordMeaning: The following fourteen* great Asuras are called Saimhikeyas. They were born of Simhika as the sons of Vipracitti: —
verses.commentary: Sense: The following fourteen* great Asuras are called Saimhikeyas. They were born of Simhika as the sons of Vipracitti: —

verses.sanskrit: विक्षोभश्च सुकेतुश्च केतुवीर्यशताह्वयौ । इन्द्रजिद्विविदश्चैव तथा भद्रश्च देवजित्
verses.transliteration: vikṣobhaśca suketuśca ketuvīryaśatāhvayau / indrajidvividaścaiva tathā bhadraśca devajit
verses.translation: These sons of Simhika were unapproachable (in- vincible) even to the Devas. Their family itself was very awful. All of them were cruel and slayers of the Brahmanas.
verses.wordMeaning: These sons of Simhika were unapproachable (in- vincible) even to the Devas. Their family itself was very awful. All of them were cruel and slayers of the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These sons of Simhika were unapproachable (in- vincible) even to the Devas. Their family itself was very awful. All of them were cruel and slayers of the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: एकचक्रो महा बाहुस्तारकश्च महाबलः । वैश्वानरः पुलोमा च प्रापणो ऽथ महाशिराः
verses.transliteration: ekacakro mahā bāhustārakaśca mahābalaḥ / vaiśvānaraḥ pulomā ca prāpaṇo 'tha mahāśirāḥ
verses.translation: The groups of Saimhikeyas are remembered as consisting of ten thousands. They were killed by the powerful Bhargava (Paras'urama) son of Jamadagni..
verses.hindi: हे तृप ! पहिले वहां पर उस क्षेत्र में अगणित तीथं मुनियों और देवों के आलय और सिद्धों के संघ निवास किया करते ये ।८। यह क्षेत्र लोक में विख्यात था और परम शुभ समस्त पापों के हरण करने वाला था । वह तीथं समुद्र के दक्षिण भाग में गिर गया था ।६। जहाँ पर सब मुनिगण तप-
verses.wordMeaning: The groups of Saimhikeyas are remembered as consisting of ten thousands. They were killed by the powerful Bhargava (Paras'urama) son of Jamadagni..
verses.commentary: Sense: The groups of Saimhikeyas are remembered as consisting of ten thousands. They were killed by the powerful Bhargava (Paras'urama) son of Jamadagni..

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च पुरुण्डश्च महासुरः । धृतराष्ट्रश्च सूर्यश्चचन्द्रमा इन्द्रतापनः
verses.transliteration: svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca puruṇḍaśca mahāsuraḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sūryaścacandramā indratāpanaḥ
verses.translation: Vai$vanara had two daughters viz. Puloma and Kalika. Nahusa was the son of Prabha and Jayanta the son of &aci.
verses.hindi: श्चर्या करके संशित व्रत वाले हुए थे और वे सब निर्वाण पद को प्राप्त हो गये थे जिस पद पर पहुँच कर इस लोक में पुनः आवृत्ति नहीं होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Vai$vanara had two daughters viz. Puloma and Kalika. Nahusa was the son of Prabha and Jayanta the son of &aci.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vai$vanara had two daughters viz. Puloma and Kalika. Nahusa was the son of Prabha and Jayanta the son of &aci.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मश्चैव निचन्द्रश्च चूर्णनाभो महागिरिः । असिलोमा सुकेशश्च शठश्च मूलकोदरः
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmaścaiva nicandraśca cūrṇanābho mahāgiriḥ / asilomā sukeśaśca śaṭhaśca mūlakodaraḥ
verses.translation: Sarmistha gave birth to Puru and Upadanavi to Dusyanta. VaiSvanara's daughters were these two viz. Puloma and Kalaka.
verses.hindi: उस क्षेत्र का ऐसा प्रभाव था कि उसी के कारण से भगवान् शङ्कर बड़ी ही प्रीति से अपनी प्रिया देवी-सकल देवगण और भूत गणों के साथ निवास किया करते हैं ।११। इसी का उद्देश्य करके तीर्थ यात्रा करने वाले मनुष्यों के समस्त अघ तेज वायु में शुष्क पुत्रों के ही समान शीघ्र ही विनष्ट हो
verses.wordMeaning: Sarmistha gave birth to Puru and Upadanavi to Dusyanta. VaiSvanara's daughters were these two viz. Puloma and Kalaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarmistha gave birth to Puru and Upadanavi to Dusyanta. VaiSvanara's daughters were these two viz. Puloma and Kalaka.

verses.sanskrit: जम्भो गगनमूर्द्धा चकुंभमानो महोदकः । प्रमदो ऽद्मश्च कुपथो ह्यश्वग्रीवश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: jambho gaganamūrddhā cakuṃbhamāno mahodakaḥ / pramado 'dmaśca kupatho hyaśvagrīvaśca vīryavān
verses.translation: Both these daughters had many children. They were the wives of Marica. Both of them had between them sixty thousand children. They were the leaders of the Danavas.
verses.hindi: जाया करते हैं।१२। जो उसके समीप में हो निवास करने वाले दुरात्मा मनुष्य होते हैं ओर वहीं पर निवासी हैं उनको कभी भी उस क्षेत्र के सेवन करने की रति नहीं हुआ करती है ॥१३। है राजन् यह एक महान् सुकृत हो तभी उस क्षेत्र के गमन में रति हुआ करती है । यदि कोई महान् पुण्यों का
verses.wordMeaning: Both these daughters had many children. They were the wives of Marica. Both of them had between them sixty thousand children. They were the leaders of the Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both these daughters had many children. They were the wives of Marica. Both of them had between them sixty thousand children. They were the leaders of the Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: वैमृगः सविरूपाक्षः सुपथश्च हला हलौ । अक्षो हिरण्मयश्चैव शतग्रीवश्च शंबरः
verses.transliteration: vaimṛgaḥ savirūpākṣaḥ supathaśca halā halau / akṣo hiraṇmayaścaiva śatagrīvaśca śaṃbaraḥ
verses.translation: There were fourteen thousand more, those of the residents of Hiranyapura. Paulomas and Kalakeyas were Danavas of great strength.
verses.wordMeaning: There were fourteen thousand more, those of the residents of Hiranyapura. Paulomas and Kalakeyas were Danavas of great strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were fourteen thousand more, those of the residents of Hiranyapura. Paulomas and Kalakeyas were Danavas of great strength.

verses.sanskrit: शरभः श्वलभश्चैव सूर्याचन्द्रमसावुभौ । असुराणां स्मृतावेतौ सुराणां च प्रभाविणौ
verses.transliteration: śarabhaḥ śvalabhaścaiva sūryācandramasāvubhau / asurāṇāṃ smṛtāvetau surāṇāṃ ca prabhāviṇau
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: उदय नहीं तो फिर मानवों के हृदय में किसी भी प्रकार से उस क्षेत्र के सेवन करने की रति समुत्पस्न नहों हुआ करती है (१४
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: इति पुत्रा दनोर्वंशप्रधानाः परिकीर्त्तिताः । तेषामपरिसंख्येयं पुत्रपौत्रमनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: iti putrā danorvaṃśapradhānāḥ parikīrttitāḥ / teṣāmaparisaṃkhyeyaṃ putrapautramanantakam
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येत असुराः तक्रान्ता दैतेया दानवास्तथा । सुत्वानस्तु स्मृता दैत्या असुत्वानो दनोः सुताः
verses.transliteration: ityeta asurāḥ takrāntā daiteyā dānavāstathā / sutvānastu smṛtā daityā asutvāno danoḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: इमे च वंशानुगता दनोः पुत्रान्वयाः स्मृताः । एकाक्षेश्वप्रभारिष्टः प्रलंबनरकावपि
verses.transliteration: ime ca vaṃśānugatā danoḥ putrānvayāḥ smṛtāḥ / ekākṣeśvaprabhāriṣṭaḥ pralaṃbanarakāvapi
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रबाधनकेशी च पुरुषः शेषवानुरुः । गरिष्ठश्च गवाक्षश्च तालकेतुश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: indrabādhanakeśī ca puruṣaḥ śeṣavānuruḥ / gariṣṭhaśca gavākṣaśca tālaketuśca vīryavān
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: एते मनुष्या वध्यास्तु दनुपुत्रान्वयाः स्मृताः । दैत्यदानवसंयोगे जाता भीमपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: ete manuṣyā vadhyāstu danuputrānvayāḥ smṛtāḥ / daityadānavasaṃyoge jātā bhīmaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहिकायामथोत्पन्ना विप्रचित्तेः सुता इमे । सैंहिकेयाः समाख्याताश्चतुर्दश महासुराः
verses.transliteration: siṃhikāyāmathotpannā vipracitteḥ sutā ime / saiṃhikeyāḥ samākhyātāścaturdaśa mahāsurāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: शलश्च शलभश्चैव सव्यसिव्यस्तथैव च । इल्वलो नमुचिश्चैव वातापिस्तु सुपुञ्जिकः
verses.transliteration: śalaśca śalabhaścaiva savyasivyastathaiva ca / ilvalo namuciścaiva vātāpistu supuñjikaḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: रहकल्पः कालनाभो भौमश्च कनकस्तथा । राहुर्ज्येष्ठस्तु तेषां वै सूर्यचन्द्रप्रमर्द्दनः
verses.transliteration: rahakalpaḥ kālanābho bhaumaśca kanakastathā / rāhurjyeṣṭhastu teṣāṃ vai sūryacandrapramarddanaḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: हे नृप ! जो स्थावर या जंगम प्राणी निर्वन्ध होने के कारण से वहां पर अपना प्राण परित्याग किया करते हैं वे तुरन्त ही शाश्वत स्वर्ग की प्राप्ति कर लिया करते हैं । यद्यपि स्वगे का निवास सावधिक होता है और पुष्य क्षीण हो जाने पर वहां से हटना होता है परन्तु इस क्षेत्र के प्रभाव से

verses.sanskrit: इत्योते सिंहिकापुत्रा देवैरपि दुरासदाः । दारुणाभिजनाः क्रूराः सर्वे ब्रह्महणश्च ते
verses.transliteration: ityote siṃhikāputrā devairapi durāsadāḥ / dāruṇābhijanāḥ krūrāḥ sarve brahmahaṇaśca te

verses.hindi: सदा ही स्वर्ग निवास होता है ।१५॥ इसकी ऐसी अद्भुत महिमा है कि यदि इसकी स्मृति भी कोई कर लेवे तो स्मरण मात्र से ही मनुष्य सब पापों से मुक्त हो जाया करता है । यह सभी क्षेत्रों में उत्तम क्षेत्र है और सब ती्षों का निकेतन है ।१६। कुछ मुनिगण तो इन ठीथों में स्नान करके सदा ही
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: दश तानि सहस्राणिसैंहिकेया गणाः स्मृताः । निहता जामदग्न्येन भार्गवेण बलीयसा
verses.transliteration: daśa tāni sahasrāṇisaiṃhikeyā gaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / nihatā jāmadagnyena bhārgaveṇa balīyasā

verses.hindi: शिव का यजन करते हुए सिद्धि की कामना वाले यहाँ पर निवास किया करते ये ।१७। जो मनुष्य काम और क्रोध से रहित होकर मत्सरता को त्याग कर उसमें निवास किया करते हैं वे थोड़े ही समय में सिद्धि को प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्भानोस्तु प्रभा कन्या पुलोम्नस्तु शची सुता । उपदानवी सदस्याथ शर्मिष्ठा वृषपर्वणः
verses.transliteration: svarbhānostu prabhā kanyā pulomnastu śacī sutā / upadānavī sadasyātha śarmiṣṭhā vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: पुलोमा कालिका चैव वैश्वानरसुते उभे । प्रभायां नहुषः पुत्रो जयन्तस्तु शचीसुतः
verses.transliteration: pulomā kālikā caiva vaiśvānarasute ubhe / prabhāyāṃ nahuṣaḥ putro jayantastu śacīsutaḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: कर लिया करते हैं ।१5। मन्त्रों के जाप करने तथा हवन करने में जो निरत रहते हुए परम थाम्त-नियत तथा ब्रह्मचर्य पालन करने वाले इसमें निवास करते हैं वे भी अभीष्ट सिद्धि को प्राप्त कर लिया करते हैं ।१९। है तृप ! दान-होम-जप और पितृगण तथा देवगण एवं द्विजों का अचंन आदि सभौ
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुं जज्ञे ऽथ शर्मिष्ठा दुष्यन्तसुपदानवी । वैश्वानरसुते एते पुलोमा कालका तथा
verses.transliteration: puruṃ jajñe 'tha śarmiṣṭhā duṣyantasupadānavī / vaiśvānarasute ete pulomā kālakā tathā
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: धामिक कृत्यों का फल इसमें करने से अस्य स्थल से करोड़ों गुता अधिक हुआ करता है ।२०। अति पावन उस क्षेत्र के समुद्र के जल में निमग्न हो जाने पर जो मुनिगण अपने महान तप से युक्त ये और वहाँ पर निवास किया करते ये वे पर्वत पर चले गये ये

verses.sanskrit: बह्वपत्ये उभे कन्ये मारीचस्य परिग्रहः । तयोः पुत्रसहस्राणि षष्टिर्दानवपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: bahvapatye ubhe kanye mārīcasya parigrahaḥ / tayoḥ putrasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭirdānavapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दश तथान्यानि हिरण्यपुरवासिनाम् । पौलोमाः कालकेयाश्च दानवाः सुमरा बलाः
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa tathānyāni hiraṇyapuravāsinām / paulomāḥ kālakeyāśca dānavāḥ sumarā balāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्या देवतानां ते निहताः सव्यमाचिना । मयस्य जाता रंभायां पुत्राः षट् च महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: avadhyā devatānāṃ te nihatāḥ savyamācinā / mayasya jātā raṃbhāyāṃ putrāḥ ṣaṭ ca mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: मायावी दुन्दुभिश्चैव पुत्रश्च महिषस्तथा । कालिकश्चाजकर्णश्चकन्या मन्दोदरी तथा
verses.transliteration: māyāvī dundubhiścaiva putraśca mahiṣastathā / kālikaścājakarṇaścakanyā mandodarī tathā
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यानां दानवानां च सर्ग एष प्रकीर्त्तितः । अनायुषायाः पुत्रास्ते स्मृताः पञ्च महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sarga eṣa prakīrttitaḥ / anāyuṣāyāḥ putrāste smṛtāḥ pañca mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: अररुर्बलवृत्रौ च विज्वरश्च वृषस्तथा । अररोस्तनयः क्रूरो धुन्धुर्नाम महासुरः
verses.transliteration: ararurbalavṛtrau ca vijvaraśca vṛṣastathā / ararostanayaḥ krūro dhundhurnāma mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: निहतः कुवलाश्वेन उत्तङ्कवचनाद्बिले । बलपुत्रौ महावीर्यौं तेजसाप्रतिमावुभौ
verses.transliteration: nihataḥ kuvalāśvena uttaṅkavacanādbile / balaputrau mahāvīryauṃ tejasāpratimāvubhau
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने परम श्रं ष्ठ सह्य पवंत पर निवास के लिए समारोहण किया था । वहाँ पर ही सब निवास करने लगे थे और उन्होंने परस्पर में निश्चय किया था ।२२। महेर्द पर्वत पर जो राम तपस्या कर रहे बे वहाँ पर गमन

verses.sanskrit: निकुंभश्चक्रवर्मा च स कर्णः पूर्वजन्मनि । विजरस्यापि पुत्रौ द्वौ कालकश्च खरश्च तौ
verses.transliteration: nikuṃbhaścakravarmā ca sa karṇaḥ pūrvajanmani / vijarasyāpi putrau dvau kālakaśca kharaśca tau
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: वृषस्य तु पुनः पुत्राश्चत्वारः क्रूरकर्मणः । श्राद्धादो यज्ञहा चैव ब्रह्महा पशुहा तथा
verses.transliteration: vṛṣasya tu punaḥ putrāścatvāraḥ krūrakarmaṇaḥ / śrāddhādo yajñahā caiva brahmahā paśuhā tathā
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: करने का उन्होंने उपक्रम किया था । राजा ने कहा--जब अगस्त्य मुनि ने समुद्र के जल का पात कर लिया था और सभी ओर सगर पुत्रों ने उसका खनन किया था तथा सभी तीर्थ-क्षेत्र ओर कानन नीचे की ओर गिरा दिये गये ये और अस्य पुरप्ाम तथा आकर आदि भू भाग एवं देश विनाशित हो
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: क्रान्ता ह्यनायुषः पुत्रा वृत्र स्यापि निबोधत । जज्ञिरे ऽसुमहाघोरा वृत्रस्येन्द्रेण युध्यता
verses.transliteration: krāntā hyanāyuṣaḥ putrā vṛtra syāpi nibodhata / jajñire 'sumahāghorā vṛtrasyendreṇa yudhyatā
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: गये चे जो भी समुद्र के समीप में विद्यमान वे है मुनिश्र 8 ! वहाँ पर पतरों वाले मनुष्यों ने फिर क्‍या किया था? ।२३-२५॥ वे सब वहीं पर बस गये थे अथवा:बड़ी कठिनाई से कहीं अन्य स्थलों में प्रस्थान कर गये थे? फिर कितने समय में यह समुद्र परिपूर्ण हो गया या ? है ह् ! यह किस
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: बका नाम समाख्याता राक्षसाः सुमहाबलाः । शतं तानि सहस्राणि महेन्द्रानुचराः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: bakā nāma samākhyātā rākṣasāḥ sumahābalāḥ / śataṃ tāni sahasrāṇi mahendrānucarāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.
verses.hindi: प्रकार से सब हुआ था--यह आप अब कृपया मुझे बतलाइये ।९६। जैमिनि मुनि ने कहा--जब दुरात्माओं के द्वारा सभी अनूप प्रदेश नष्ट कर दिये गये थे तब वहाँ पर रहने वाले सभी जन इधर-उधर प्रयाण कर गये ये। कुछ क्षेत्र के निवासी बड़ी कठिनाई से वहीं पर निवास करने लगे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ब्रह्मविदः सौम्या धार्मिकाः सूक्ष्ममूर्त्तयः । प्रजास्वन्तर्गताः सर्वे निवसंति क्रुधावृताः
verses.transliteration: sarve brahmavidaḥ saumyā dhārmikāḥ sūkṣmamūrttayaḥ / prajāsvantargatāḥ sarve nivasaṃti krudhāvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधा त्वप्रतिमान्पुत्रान् जज्ञे वै गायनोत्तमान् । सिद्धः पूर्णश्च वह्वीच पूर्णाशश्चैव वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: krodhā tvapratimānputrān jajñe vai gāyanottamān / siddhaḥ pūrṇaśca vahvīca pūrṇāśaścaiva vīryavān

verses.hindi: वभूव भुवि धर्मात्मा दिलीप इति विश्रुतः

verses.transliteration: brahmacārī śataguṇaḥ suparṇaścaiva maptamaḥ / viśvāvasuśca bhānuśca sucandro daśamastathā / ityete devagandharvāḥ krodhāyāḥ parirīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a had four sons of very cruel activities. They were Sraddhada, Yajriaha, Brahmaha and Pasuha.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे दनुवंशकीर्त्तनं नाम षष्ठो ऽध्याय सूत उवाच गन्धर्वाप्सरसः पुत्रा मौनेयास्तान्निबोधत । भीमसेनेग्रसेनौ च सुपर्णो वरुणस्तथा
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde danuvaṃśakīrttanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāya sūta uvāca gandharvāpsarasaḥ putrā mauneyāstānnibodhata / bhīmasenegrasenau ca suparṇo varuṇastathā
verses.translation: This chapter enumerates the prominent members of clans of Gan* dharvas, Apsaras, birds, serpents, Yaks as, Rak$asas, Pisacas, Yatudhanas and other species with super-natural powers.
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter enumerates the prominent members of clans of Gan* dharvas, Apsaras, birds, serpents, Yaks as, Rak$asas, Pisacas, Yatudhanas and other species with super-natural powers.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter enumerates the prominent members of clans of Gan* dharvas, Apsaras, birds, serpents, Yaks as, Rak$asas, Pisacas, Yatudhanas and other species with super-natural powers.

verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्रश्च गोमांश्च सूर्यवर्चास्तथैव च॥ पत्रवानर्कपर्णश्च प्रयुतश्च तथैव हि
verses.transliteration: dhṛtarāṣṭraśca gomāṃśca sūryavarcāstathaiva ca// patravānarkaparṇaśca prayutaśca tathaiva hi
verses.translation: W. 1-29 enumerate the children of Muni, viz the clans of Gan- dharvas and the 14 groups of Apsaras with their sub-groups like Laukika, celestial, their kins and descendants. It is note-worthy that ten Apsaras were the expounders of Brahman and were Paflca-cu4as (having five plaits of hair). Apsaras bom of different gods are enumerated in W 20-24.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 1-29 enumerate the children of Muni, viz the clans of Gan- dharvas and the 14 groups of Apsaras with their sub-groups like Laukika, celestial, their kins and descendants.…
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 1-29 enumerate the children of Muni, viz the clans of Gan- dharvas and the 14 groups of Apsaras with their sub-groups like Laukika, celestial, their kins and descendants.…

verses.sanskrit: भीमश्चित्ररथश्चैव विख्यातः सर्वजीद्वशी । त्रयोदशः शालिशिराः पर्जन्यश्च चतुर्दशः
verses.transliteration: bhīmaścitrarathaścaiva vikhyātaḥ sarvajīdvaśī / trayodaśaḥ śāliśirāḥ parjanyaśca caturdaśaḥ
verses.translation: These brilliant groups of Apsaras numbering many thousands are the wives and mothers of the Dcvas, and the sages.
verses.wordMeaning: These brilliant groups of Apsaras numbering many thousands are the wives and mothers of the Dcvas, and the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: These brilliant groups of Apsaras numbering many thousands are the wives and mothers of the Dcvas, and the sages.

verses.sanskrit: कलिः पञ्च दशस्तेषां नारदश्चैव षोडशः । इत्येते देवगन्धर्वा मौनेयाः परिकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: kaliḥ pañca daśasteṣāṃ nāradaścaiva ṣoḍaśaḥ / ityete devagandharvā mauneyāḥ parikīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: The (vedic) metres are those beginning with Gayatrl. The birds arc born ofSuparna (Garuda)
verses.hindi: राज्येऽभिषिच्य तं राजा दिलीपोऽपि वनं ययौ ।
verses.wordMeaning: The (vedic) metres are those beginning with Gayatrl. The birds arc born ofSuparna (Garuda)
verses.commentary: Sense: The (vedic) metres are those beginning with Gayatrl. The birds arc born ofSuparna (Garuda)

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशाश्चावरजास्तेषामप्सरसः शुभाः । अरुणा चानपाया च विमनुष्या वरांबरा
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśāścāvarajāsteṣāmapsarasaḥ śubhāḥ / aruṇā cānapāyā ca vimanuṣyā varāṃbarā
verses.translation: W. 31-37 enumerate the children of Kadru viz. serpents.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 31-37 enumerate the children of Kadru viz. serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 31-37 enumerate the children of Kadru viz. serpents.

verses.sanskrit: मिश्रकेशी तथाचासिपर्णिनी चाप्यलुंबुषा । मरीचिः शुचिका चैव विद्युत्पर्णा तिलोत्तमा
verses.transliteration: miśrakeśī tathācāsiparṇinī cāpyaluṃbuṣā / marīciḥ śucikā caiva vidyutparṇā tilottamā
verses.translation: Khasa gave birth to two deformed sons of very rough modes of life; the elder was born at dusk and the younger at dawn.1
verses.wordMeaning: Khasa gave birth to two deformed sons of very rough modes of life; the elder was born at dusk and the younger at dawn.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Khasa gave birth to two deformed sons of very rough modes of life; the elder was born at dusk and the younger at dawn.1

verses.sanskrit: अद्रिका लक्ष्मणा क्षेमा दिव्या रंभा मनोभवा । असिता च सुबाहूश्च सुप्रिया सुभुजा तथा
verses.transliteration: adrikā lakṣmaṇā kṣemā divyā raṃbhā manobhavā / asitā ca subāhūśca supriyā subhujā tathā
verses.translation: VV. 38-72 describe how the clans of Yak?as and R&k*asas came into being from Khasa.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 38-72 describe how the clans of Yak?as and R&k*asas came into being from Khasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 38-72 describe how the clans of Yak?as and R&k*asas came into being from Khasa.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकाजगन्धा च सुदती सुरसा तथा । तथैवास्याः सुबाहूश्च विख्यातौ च हहाहुहू
verses.transliteration: puṇḍarīkājagandhā ca sudatī surasā tathā / tathaivāsyāḥ subāhūśca vikhyātau ca hahāhuhū
verses.translation: Immediately after their birth, they increased in size. All their limbs became efficient in their respective functions.
verses.wordMeaning: Immediately after their birth, they increased in size. All their limbs became efficient in their respective functions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately after their birth, they increased in size. All their limbs became efficient in their respective functions.

verses.sanskrit: तुंबुरुश्चेति चत्वारः स्मृतागन्धर्वसत्तमाः । गन्धर्वाप्सरसो ह्येते मौनेयाः परिकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: tuṃburuśceti catvāraḥ smṛtāgandharvasattamāḥ / gandharvāpsaraso hyete mauneyāḥ parikīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: With their limbs grown in size and power imme- diately after their birth, they began to drag their mother. The elder one of the two was very cruel and he pulled his mother.
verses.hindi: इसी समय में है राजन् ! अशुमःन का सुत परम धर्मात्मा दिलीप
verses.wordMeaning: With their limbs grown in size and power imme- diately after their birth, they began to drag their mother. The elder one of the two was very cruel and he pulled his mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their limbs grown in size and power imme- diately after their birth, they began to drag their mother. The elder one of the two was very cruel and he pulled his mother.

verses.sanskrit: हंसा सरस्वती चैव सूता च कमलाभया । सुमुखी हंसपादी च लौकिक्यो ऽप्सरसः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: haṃsā sarasvatī caiva sūtā ca kamalābhayā / sumukhī haṃsapādī ca laukikyo 'psarasaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He said — "O mother, we are tormented due to hunger. In order to save ourselves we shall devour you". But the younger one attempted to forbid him.
verses.hindi: इस नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुआ था। अर्थात् दिलीप ने भूमि में जन्म ग्रहण
verses.wordMeaning: He said — "O mother, we are tormented due to hunger. In order to save ourselves we shall devour you". But the younger one attempted to forbid him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said — "O mother, we are tormented due to hunger. In order to save ourselves we shall devour you". But the younger one attempted to forbid him.

verses.sanskrit: हंसो ज्योतिष्टमो मध्य आचारस्त्विह दारुणः । वरूथो ऽथ वरेण्यश्य ततो वसुरुचिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: haṃso jyotiṣṭamo madhya ācārastviha dāruṇaḥ / varūtho 'tha vareṇyaśya tato vasuruciḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Seizing him (i.e. the cider one) with his pair of hands, he spoke to (his brother in front of) his mother — "Indeed you arc the person to render service to your ancestors and preserve their welfare. Protect (at least) your own mother."
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing him (i.e. the cider one) with his pair of hands, he spoke to (his brother in front of) his mother — "Indeed you arc the person to render service to your ancestors and preserve their welfare. Protect (at least) your own mother."
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing him (i.e. the cider one) with his pair of hands, he spoke to (his brother in front of) his mother — "Indeed you arc the person to render service to your ancestors and preserve their welfare. Protect (at least) your own mother."

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमः सुरुचिस्तेषां ततो विश्वा वसुः स्मृतः । सुषुवे सा महाभागा रिष्टा देवर्षिपूजिता
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamaḥ surucisteṣāṃ tato viśvā vasuḥ smṛtaḥ / suṣuve sā mahābhāgā riṣṭā devarṣipūjitā
verses.translation: At that very instant, their father appeared before them. On seeing both these (children) of deformed features, he spoke to Khasa.
verses.hindi: किया या ।२६। समस्त सांसारिक भोगों के उपभोग करने वाले अ शुमान नु ने राज्यासन पर उस अपने पुत्र को अभिषिक्त करा दिया था और मेधा सम्पन्न वह तपश्चर्या करने का संकल्प मन में करके वन में चला गया था ।३०। फिर श्री सम्पन्न राजा दिलीप ने समस्त शत्रुओं को परास्त
verses.wordMeaning: At that very instant, their father appeared before them. On seeing both these (children) of deformed features, he spoke to Khasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that very instant, their father appeared before them. On seeing both these (children) of deformed features, he spoke to Khasa.

verses.sanskrit: अरूपां सुभगां भासीमिति त्रेधा व्यजायत । मनुवन्ती सुकेशी च तुंबरोस्तु सुते शुभे
verses.transliteration: arūpāṃ subhagāṃ bhāsīmiti tredhā vyajāyata / manuvantī sukeśī ca tuṃbarostu sute śubhe
verses.translation: On seeing their father the two sons became frighten- ed and became one. By means of their Maya, they became merged into the limbs of their mother.
verses.hindi: करके इस सम्पूर्ण भूमि का परिपालन धमं पूर्वक किया था।३१। इस दिलीप का पुत्र भगीरथ हुआ था। जो लोक में परम प्रख्यात था सभी धर्म-अर्थ में महाकुशल और श्रीमात् अपरिमित बल-विक्रम से समन्वित था ।३२ वह दिलीप भी अवसर आने पर राज्यासन पर भगीरथ का
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing their father the two sons became frighten- ed and became one. By means of their Maya, they became merged into the limbs of their mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing their father the two sons became frighten- ed and became one. By means of their Maya, they became merged into the limbs of their mother.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चचूडास्त्विमा विद्यादेवमप्सरसो दश । मेनका सहजन्या च पर्णिनी पुञ्जिकस्थला
verses.transliteration: pañcacūḍāstvimā vidyādevamapsaraso daśa / menakā sahajanyā ca parṇinī puñjikasthalā
verses.translation: Then the sage said to his wife — "What is it that you have been told by these two boys? Report to me everything factually. This is your own transgression.
verses.hindi: अभिषेक कराकर वन में गमन कर गया या । उस भागीरथ ने भी भूमि का परिपालन अच्छी तरह से किया था और उसने भूमि के सभी कष्टकों को हत कर दिया था ।३३। स्वगेलोक में देवाघीश्वर को ही भाँति नाना प्रकार भोगों का उपभोग करके परम प्रसन्न हुआ था। उस राजा ने पहिले अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Then the sage said to his wife — "What is it that you have been told by these two boys? Report to me everything factually. This is your own transgression.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sage said to his wife — "What is it that you have been told by these two boys? Report to me everything factually. This is your own transgression.

verses.sanskrit: कृतस्थला द्यृताची च विश्वाची पूर्वचित्त्यपि । प्रम्लोचेत्यभिविख्यातानुम्लोचैव तु ता दश
verses.transliteration: kṛtasthalā dyṛtācī ca viśvācī pūrvacittyapi / pramlocetyabhivikhyātānumlocaiva tu tā daśa
verses.translation: A son or a daughter will be like the mother, * at the time of their birth. A son will have the same ( character and habit) as his mother.
verses.hindi: पृवंजो की जो दशा हुई थी उसका पूरा वृत्तान्त सुन लिया था ।३४। विप्र के कोप से महान घोर नरक में पूर्वजों का पतन हुआ है और उसके सभी 'पितृगण ग्रह्मवण्ड से मारे गये हैं--यह सब सुतकर उसको बहुत अधिक दुःख
verses.wordMeaning: A son or a daughter will be like the mother, * at the time of their birth. A son will have the same ( character and habit) as his mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: A son or a daughter will be like the mother, * at the time of their birth. A son will have the same ( character and habit) as his mother.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिनिधनस्याथ जज्ञे नारायणस्य या । कुलोचितानवद्याङ्गी उर्वश्चेकादशी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: anādinidhanasyātha jajñe nārāyaṇasya yā / kulocitānavadyāṅgī urvaścekādaśī smṛtā
verses.translation: He gave them those names the root meaning of which befitted their activities as reported by their mother, and as inferred by him independently.
verses.hindi: स मंत्रि वरे राज्यं विन्यस्य तपसे बनम्
verses.wordMeaning: He gave them those names the root meaning of which befitted their activities as reported by their mother, and as inferred by him independently.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave them those names the root meaning of which befitted their activities as reported by their mother, and as inferred by him independently.

verses.sanskrit: मेनस्य मेनका कन्या जज्ञे सर्वाङ्गसुंदरी । सर्वाश्च ब्रह्मवादिन्यो महाभागाश्च ताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: menasya menakā kanyā jajñe sarvāṅgasuṃdarī / sarvāśca brahmavādinyo mahābhāgāśca tāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The elder one had said "O mother, we shall eat (you)." (The root Yak$) is used in the sense of chewing and eating. Hence he became Yaksa.
verses.wordMeaning: The elder one had said "O mother, we shall eat (you)." (The root Yak$) is used in the sense of chewing and eating. Hence he became Yaksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The elder one had said "O mother, we shall eat (you)." (The root Yak$) is used in the sense of chewing and eating. Hence he became Yaksa.

verses.sanskrit: गणास्त्वप्सरसां ख्याताः पुण्यास्ते वै चतुर्दश । आहृत्यः शोभवत्यश्च वेगवत्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: gaṇāstvapsarasāṃ khyātāḥ puṇyāste vai caturdaśa / āhṛtyaḥ śobhavatyaśca vegavatyastathaiva ca
verses.translation: After their father had departed, those two cruel (brothers) who are terrible by nature indulged in all kinds of adverse activities. They were ungrateful and they harassed all living creatures.
verses.hindi: गंगा का पृथ्वी पर आगमन  xs
verses.wordMeaning: After their father had departed, those two cruel (brothers) who are terrible by nature indulged in all kinds of adverse activities. They were ungrateful and they harassed all living creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: After their father had departed, those two cruel (brothers) who are terrible by nature indulged in all kinds of adverse activities. They were ungrateful and they harassed all living creatures.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ज्जाश्चैव युवत्यश्च स्रुचस्तु कुरवस्तथाश्च । वर्हयश्चामृताश्चैव मुदाश्च मृगवो रुचः
verses.transliteration: ūrjjāścaiva yuvatyaśca srucastu kuravastathāśca / varhayaścāmṛtāścaiva mudāśca mṛgavo rucaḥ
verses.translation: Etymology of Yak fa and R&kfasa,
verses.wordMeaning: Etymology of Yak fa and R&kfasa,
verses.commentary: Sense: Etymology of Yak fa and R&kfasa,

verses.sanskrit: भीरवः शोभयन्त्यश्च गाणा ह्येते चतुर्दश । ब्रह्मणो मानसाहृत्यः शोभवत्यो मरुत्सुताः
verses.transliteration: bhīravaḥ śobhayantyaśca gāṇā hyete caturdaśa / brahmaṇo mānasāhṛtyaḥ śobhavatyo marutsutāḥ
verses.translation: They were extremely powerful and # had great inherent vitality. They had huge bodies and were unassailable. They were conversant with Maya (power of illusion or witch- craft). They could be invisible. Both of them could vanish even as they were moving about.
verses.hindi: फिर तो राजा भगीरथ को उस विज्ञाल अपने राज्य में-वस्थु- बान्धवों में तथा सुखोपभोगों में परम वैराग्य उत्पन्न हो गया था अर्थात् उसे कुछ भी नहीं सुहाता शा और सबको उसने निस्सार ही समझ सिया था । उसने फिर अपने एक परमश्रेष्ठ मन्त्री को राज्य शासन का भार सौंप
verses.wordMeaning: They were extremely powerful and # had great inherent vitality. They had huge bodies and were unassailable. They were conversant with Maya (power of illusion or witch- craft). They could be invisible. Both of them could vanish even as they were moving about.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were extremely powerful and # had great inherent vitality. They had huge bodies and were unassailable. They were conversant with Maya (power of illusion or witch- craft). They could be invisible. Both of them could vanish even as they were moving about.

verses.sanskrit: वेगवत्यश्च रिष्टाया ऊर्ज्जाश्चैवाग्निसंभवाः । युवत्यश्च तथा सूर्यरश्मिजाताः सुशोभनाः
verses.transliteration: vegavatyaśca riṣṭāyā ūrjjāścaivāgnisaṃbhavāḥ / yuvatyaśca tathā sūryaraśmijātāḥ suśobhanāḥ
verses.translation: Both of them could assume any form they desired. They were terrible by nature and free from all ailments. They roamed about with all sorts of activities befitting their forms and features. They harassed everyone.
verses.hindi: दिया था और तप करने के लिए वन में चला गया था ।३६। उसकी उत्कट इच्छा यही थी कि वह श्रेष्ठ नृप अपने पितरों को नरक की घोर यातना से मुक्त कर स्वर्ग वासी बना देवे। सर्वप्रथम उसने महान तप के द्वारा आयु के द्वारा आयु के लिए ब्रह्माजी की समाराखना की थी ।३७। उनकी आरा-
verses.wordMeaning: Both of them could assume any form they desired. They were terrible by nature and free from all ailments. They roamed about with all sorts of activities befitting their forms and features. They harassed everyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of them could assume any form they desired. They were terrible by nature and free from all ailments. They roamed about with all sorts of activities befitting their forms and features. They harassed everyone.

verses.sanskrit: गभस्तिभिश्च सोमस्य जज्ञिरे कुरवः शुभाः । यज्ञोत्पन्ना स्रुचो नाम कुशवत्यां च बर्हयः
verses.transliteration: gabhastibhiśca somasya jajñire kuravaḥ śubhāḥ / yajñotpannā sruco nāma kuśavatyāṃ ca barhayaḥ
verses.translation: W. 73-101 describe the marital relation between Pi&cas and Jt&kfasas and their progeny out of 8 forms of marriage. Pai&ca is the lowest form.
verses.hindi: घना से भगीरथ ने अपनी अभीष्ट आयु प्राप्त करली यी । फिर है महाराज ! गजला की आराधना की थी और गङ्गा को अपने ऊपर प्रसन्न कर लिया था ।३८। भगीरथने स्वर्ग से गङ्गा का भूमि पर समागमन करने का वरदान प्राप्त किया शा । फिर उस स्वर्ग से समापतन करने वाली गंगा की विशाल
verses.wordMeaning: W. 73-101 describe the marital relation between Pi&cas and Jt&kfasas and their progeny out of 8 forms of marriage. Pai&ca is the lowest form.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 73-101 describe the marital relation between Pi&cas and Jt&kfasas and their progeny out of 8 forms of marriage. Pai&ca is the lowest form.

verses.sanskrit: वारिजा ह्यमृतोत्पन्ना अमृता नामतः स्मृताः । वायूत्पनाना मुदा नाम भूमिजा मृगवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vārijā hyamṛtotpannā amṛtā nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ / vāyūtpanānā mudā nāma bhūmijā mṛgavastathā
verses.translation: Aja then announced the assets (of his daughter). "This girl with the insects clinging to all the limbs like hair is
verses.hindi: धारा को अपने शिर पर धारण करने की कृपा करें-इसलिए शिव की आराधना तप द्वारा की थी । क्योंकि अन्य किसी की भी ऐसी शक्ति नहीं थी जो गंगा के बेग को सह सके ।३६। शिव भी भक्तों पर कृपा करने वाले हैं। उन्होंने भी यह बरदान दे दिया था । मेरु पर्वत की शिखर से समापतन
verses.wordMeaning: Aja then announced the assets (of his daughter). "This girl with the insects clinging to all the limbs like hair is
verses.commentary: Sense: Aja then announced the assets (of his daughter). "This girl with the insects clinging to all the limbs like hair is

verses.sanskrit: विद्युतो ऽत्र रुचो नाम मृत्योः कन्याश्च भीरवः । शोभयन्त्यश्च कामस्य गणाः प्रोक्ताश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: vidyuto 'tra ruco nāma mṛtyoḥ kanyāśca bhīravaḥ / śobhayantyaśca kāmasya gaṇāḥ proktāścaturdaśa
verses.translation: Thus the two daughters of Pisacas gave birth to children. Know them as I recount their creation of progeny.
verses.hindi: करती हुई गंगा देवी को अपने शिर पर जगनों के स्वामी ने ग्रहण किया था जिसमें बड़े-बड़े प्रह-तक्र और मकर आदि सभी जल के जीव विद्यमान ये । बह गंगा उनके शिर पर सम्प्राप्त हुई थी जिसमें महान् प्रवाह का येग विद्यमान था ।४०-४१। किन्तु बह गंगा अति गहन परम शुभ शिव के जटा-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the two daughters of Pisacas gave birth to children. Know them as I recount their creation of progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the two daughters of Pisacas gave birth to children. Know them as I recount their creation of progeny.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते बहुसाहस्रा भास्वरा अप्सरोगणाः । देवतानामृषीणां च पत्न्यश्च मातरश्च ह
verses.transliteration: ityete bahusāhasrā bhāsvarā apsarogaṇāḥ / devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca patnyaśca mātaraśca ha
