verses.translation: Cruel serpents and Raksasas were born in the family of Sarpa (mentioned as Surya in V. 90). Yatudhanas have been narrated in full. Now understand the Brahmadhanas.
verses.hindi: जूटों का मण्डल था उसमें ही विलीन हो गयी थी । प्रभु शम्भु के शिर में वह ऐसे ही विलीन हो गयी थी जैसे एक चुल्लू जल विहीन हो जाया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Cruel serpents and Raksasas were born in the family of Sarpa (mentioned as Surya in V. 90). Yatudhanas have been narrated in full. Now understand the Brahmadhanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cruel serpents and Raksasas were born in the family of Sarpa (mentioned as Surya in V. 90). Yatudhanas have been narrated in full. Now understand the Brahmadhanas.

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धाश्चाथ निष्पन्दा सर्वाश्चाप्सरसः समाः । संप्रयोगस्तु कामेन माद्यं दिवि हरं विना
verses.transliteration: sugandhāścātha niṣpandā sarvāścāpsarasaḥ samāḥ / saṃprayogastu kāmena mādyaṃ divi haraṃ vinā
verses.translation: The sons of Bralunadharia were nine viz. Yajfiapeta,
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Bralunadharia were nine viz. Yajfiapeta,
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Bralunadharia were nine viz. Yajfiapeta,

verses.sanskrit: तासां देवर्षि संस्पर्शा जाताः साधारणा यतः । पर्वतस्तत्र संभूतो नारदश्चैव तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ devarṣi saṃsparśā jātāḥ sādhāraṇā yataḥ / parvatastatra saṃbhūto nāradaścaiva tāvubhau
verses.translation: VV. 101-131 describe the progeny of Semi-divine clans Yaksas, Punyajanas, Guhyakas. 9
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 101-131 describe the progeny of Semi-divine clans Yaksas, Punyajanas, Guhyakas. 9
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 101-131 describe the progeny of Semi-divine clans Yaksas, Punyajanas, Guhyakas. 9

verses.sanskrit: ततो यवीयसी चैव तृतीयारुन्धती स्मृता । देवर्षिभ्यस्तयोर्जन्म यस्मान्नारदपर्वतौ
verses.transliteration: tato yavīyasī caiva tṛtīyārundhatī smṛtā / devarṣibhyastayorjanma yasmānnāradaparvatau
verses.translation: He thought thus — "All living beings resent me because 1 am noxious and hurtful. Hence, how shall I acquire that lady of fascinating limbs?"
verses.wordMeaning: He thought thus — "All living beings resent me because 1 am noxious and hurtful. Hence, how shall I acquire that lady of fascinating limbs?"
verses.commentary: Sense: He thought thus — "All living beings resent me because 1 am noxious and hurtful. Hence, how shall I acquire that lady of fascinating limbs?"

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तौ तत्सनामानौ स्मृतौ नारदपर्वतौ । विनतायाश्च पुत्रौ द्वौ अरुणौ गरुडश्च ह
verses.transliteration: tasmāttau tatsanāmānau smṛtau nāradaparvatau / vinatāyāśca putrau dvau aruṇau garuḍaśca ha
verses.translation: He increased in size immediately in height as well as girth. He shone by means of his brilliance. "I am Nabhi(?) and I am a king," he said and saluted his father.
verses.wordMeaning: He increased in size immediately in height as well as girth. He shone by means of his brilliance. "I am Nabhi(?) and I am a king," he said and saluted his father.
verses.commentary: Sense: He increased in size immediately in height as well as girth. He shone by means of his brilliance. "I am Nabhi(?) and I am a king," he said and saluted his father.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्र्यादीनि छन्दांसि सौपर्णेयानि पक्षिणाः । व्यवहार्याणि सर्वाणि ऋजुसन्निहितानि च
verses.transliteration: gāyatryādīni chandāṃsi sauparṇeyāni pakṣiṇāḥ / vyavahāryāṇi sarvāṇi ṛjusannihitāni ca
verses.translation: The father said to him in reply, "You are Rajatana- bha." A son is born resembling his mother in forms and features and his father in vigour and strength.
verses.hindi: स तु राजऋषिः संक्रुद्धो यज्ञथाटेऽखिले तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The father said to him in reply, "You are Rajatana- bha." A son is born resembling his mother in forms and features and his father in vigour and strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: The father said to him in reply, "You are Rajatana- bha." A son is born resembling his mother in forms and features and his father in vigour and strength.

verses.sanskrit: क्रद्रूर्नागसहस्रं वै विजज्ञे धरणीधरम् । अनेकशिरसां तेषां खेचराणां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: kradrūrnāgasahasraṃ vai vijajñe dharaṇīdharam / anekaśirasāṃ teṣāṃ khecarāṇāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: The two splendid sisters named Punyajani and Deva- jani, the daughters of Kratusthala became their wives.
verses.hindi: राजा भगीरथ ने जब ऐसा देखा तो उस गङ्गा देवी के प्रमीक्षण के
verses.wordMeaning: The two splendid sisters named Punyajani and Deva- jani, the daughters of Kratusthala became their wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two splendid sisters named Punyajani and Deva- jani, the daughters of Kratusthala became their wives.

verses.sanskrit: बहुत्वान्नामधेयानां प्रधानांश्च निबोधत । तेषां प्रधाना नागानां शेषवासुकितक्षकाः
verses.transliteration: bahutvānnāmadheyānāṃ pradhānāṃśca nibodhata / teṣāṃ pradhānā nāgānāṃ śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ
verses.translation: W. 132-151 enumerate the 'leading figures in R&k$aaa dans such as Alambeya, K&pileyas and others (bom from Kha&'s daughters). Some dans are follower! of god Siva.
verses.hindi: लिये पुनः भगवान् शङ्कर की आराधना की थी । फिर भगवादू शिव के प्रसाद से राजा भगोरथ ने गङ्का को भूमि पर लाते का कार्य सम्पन्न किया था ।४३। राजा भगीरथ उस गङ्गा को उसी दिशा की ओर लाये थे जहाँ पर सगर सुत दश्ध हुए ये । वह ग'गा राजा भगोरथ के पीछे ही अनुगगन
verses.wordMeaning: W. 132-151 enumerate the 'leading figures in R&k$aaa dans such as Alambeya, K&pileyas and others (bom from Kha&'s daughters). Some dans are follower! of god Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 132-151 enumerate the 'leading figures in R&k$aaa dans such as Alambeya, K&pileyas and others (bom from Kha&'s daughters). Some dans are follower! of god Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अकर्णो हस्तिकर्णश्च पिजरश्चार्यकस्तथा । ऐरावतो महापद्मः कंबलाश्वतरावुभौ
verses.transliteration: akarṇo hastikarṇaśca pijaraścāryakastathā / airāvato mahāpadmaḥ kaṃbalāśvatarāvubhau
verses.translation: W. 152-166 enumerate the different clans of Bhumi-Raksasas and of Kaumara Grahas.
verses.hindi: कर रही थी कि उसके मार्ग में एक राजधि यज्ञ का यजन कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: W. 152-166 enumerate the different clans of Bhumi-Raksasas and of Kaumara Grahas.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 152-166 enumerate the different clans of Bhumi-Raksasas and of Kaumara Grahas.

verses.sanskrit: एलापत्रश्च शङ्खश्च कर्केटकधनञ्जयौ । महाकर्णमहानीलौ धृतराष्ट्रबलाहकौ
verses.transliteration: elāpatraśca śaṅkhaśca karkeṭakadhanañjayau / mahākarṇamahānīlau dhṛtarāṣṭrabalāhakau
verses.translation: VV. 166-170 describe the gradations (in descending order) of the divine and semi-divine beings.
verses.hindi: ग'गा देवी ते उसके यज्ञ स्थल को सभी ओर से पूर्णतया प्लावित कर दिया वह राजधि बहुत ही अधिक क्व हो गया था जबकि गगा के द्वारा उसका सब यज्ञ वाट निमग्न हो गया था । उस राजधि ने एक कुल्ली के ही समान उस सम्पूर्ण ग'गा का पान कर लिया चा । फिर बहुत ही सावधान होकर
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 166-170 describe the gradations (in descending order) of the divine and semi-divine beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 166-170 describe the gradations (in descending order) of the divine and semi-divine beings.

verses.sanskrit: करवीरः पुष्पदंष्ट्रः सुमुखो दुर्मुखस्तथा । सूनामुखो दधिमुखः कालियश्चालिपिण्डकः
verses.transliteration: karavīraḥ puṣpadaṃṣṭraḥ sumukho durmukhastathā / sūnāmukho dadhimukhaḥ kāliyaścālipiṇḍakaḥ
verses.translation: Krodha gave birth to twelve daughters bom of her own bosom. They became the wives of Pulaha. Understand them through their names.1
verses.hindi: भगीरथ ने सौ वर्षो तक उस राजि की शुश्रूषा की थी ।४५-४६। फिर जब बह् राजघि प्रसन्न हुए तो भगीरथ ने उन महान् आत्मा वाले से गङ्का की प्राप्ति की थी । बहुत समय पर्यन्त निवास करके फिर उनके जटा से ग'गा निकली थी । इसीलिए सभी से जहनु के उदर से निकलने से ही उनका
verses.wordMeaning: Krodha gave birth to twelve daughters bom of her own bosom. They became the wives of Pulaha. Understand them through their names.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Krodha gave birth to twelve daughters bom of her own bosom. They became the wives of Pulaha. Understand them through their names.1

verses.sanskrit: कपिलश्चांबरीषश्च अक्रूरश्च कपित्थकः । प्रह्रादस्तु ब्रह्मणाश्च गन्धर्वो ऽथ मणिस्थकः
verses.transliteration: kapilaścāṃbarīṣaśca akrūraśca kapitthakaḥ / prahrādastu brahmaṇāśca gandharvo 'tha maṇisthakaḥ
verses.translation: W. 171-179 describe the creation of the*, animal-world through the daughters of Krodhd.
verses.hindi: भूमण्डल में जाहनवी-यह नाम प्रख्यात हो गया या। फिर भागीरथ के पीछे अनुगमन करने वाली होकर उसके समस्त पितरों का उसने उद्धार कर दिया था ।४७-४८। फिर सुर नदी ने अपने परम पुनीत जल से सगर सुतों की अस्थियों और भस्म का सेवन किया था। ग'गा जल के सेचन होने
verses.wordMeaning: W. 171-179 describe the creation of the*, animal-world through the daughters of Krodhd.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 171-179 describe the creation of the*, animal-world through the daughters of Krodhd.

verses.sanskrit: नहुषः कररोमा च मणिरित्येवमादयः । काद्रवेयाः समाख्याताः खशायास्तु निबोधत
verses.transliteration: nahuṣaḥ kararomā ca maṇirityevamādayaḥ / kādraveyāḥ samākhyātāḥ khaśāyāstu nibodhata
verses.translation: w. 185-273 give again the special treatment of Vanaras (monkeys) in 319-323. It shows the influence of R&mAyapa as the history of Vfili and Sugriva is narrated succinctly here.
verses.hindi: पर जो उनकी अस्थियां ओर भस्म पर हुआ था उसी क्षण में उन सबका उद्धार हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: w. 185-273 give again the special treatment of Vanaras (monkeys) in 319-323. It shows the influence of R&mAyapa as the history of Vfili and Sugriva is narrated succinctly here.
verses.commentary: Sense: w. 185-273 give again the special treatment of Vanaras (monkeys) in 319-323. It shows the influence of R&mAyapa as the history of Vfili and Sugriva is narrated succinctly here.

verses.sanskrit: खशा विजज्ञे द्वौ पुत्रौ विकृतौ परुषव्रतौ । श्रेष्ठं पश्चिमसंध्यायां पूर्वस्यां च कनीयसम्
verses.transliteration: khaśā vijajñe dvau putrau vikṛtau paruṣavratau / śreṣṭhaṃ paścimasaṃdhyāyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ ca kanīyasam
verses.translation: Among all animals they have no mean or insigni- ficant position. They arc devotedly attached to the Devas and Brahmanas. They never become pale and faded. They are truthful. They speak volubly on many matters.
verses.wordMeaning: Among all animals they have no mean or insigni- ficant position. They arc devotedly attached to the Devas and Brahmanas. They never become pale and faded. They are truthful. They speak volubly on many matters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among all animals they have no mean or insigni- ficant position. They arc devotedly attached to the Devas and Brahmanas. They never become pale and faded. They are truthful. They speak volubly on many matters.

verses.sanskrit: विलोहितैककर्णं च पूर्वं साजनयत्सुतम् । चतुर्भुजं चतुष्पादं किञ्चित्स्पन्दं द्विधागतिम्
verses.transliteration: vilohitaikakarṇaṃ ca pūrvaṃ sājanayatsutam / caturbhujaṃ catuṣpādaṃ kiñcitspandaṃ dvidhāgatim
verses.translation: Similarly, the sun-god too begot of her in secret his son, a part of himself. He was Sugrlva the leader of the herds of monkeys.
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the sun-god too begot of her in secret his son, a part of himself. He was Sugrlva the leader of the herds of monkeys.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the sun-god too begot of her in secret his son, a part of himself. He was Sugrlva the leader of the herds of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वङ्गकेशं स्थूलाङ्गं शुभनासं महोदरम् । स्वच्छशीर्षं महाकर्णं मुञ्जकेशं महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṅgakeśaṃ sthūlāṅgaṃ śubhanāsaṃ mahodaram / svacchaśīrṣaṃ mahākarṇaṃ muñjakeśaṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: On seeing both the sons endowed with strength, beauty of form and glorious splendour, Rk$a, the leader of the herds of all the monkeys, had a great deal of delight.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing both the sons endowed with strength, beauty of form and glorious splendour, Rk$a, the leader of the herds of all the monkeys, had a great deal of delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing both the sons endowed with strength, beauty of form and glorious splendour, Rk$a, the leader of the herds of all the monkeys, had a great deal of delight.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वास्यं दीर्घजिह्वं च बहुदंष्ट्रं महाहनुम् । रक्तपिङ्गाक्षपादं च स्थूलभ्रूदीर्घनासिकम्
verses.transliteration: hrasvāsyaṃ dīrghajihvaṃ ca bahudaṃṣṭraṃ mahāhanum / raktapiṅgākṣapādaṃ ca sthūlabhrūdīrghanāsikam
verses.translation: After finding out very beautiful wives for them the powerful Sugriva stayed beside Vali along with his monkey followers.
verses.wordMeaning: After finding out very beautiful wives for them the powerful Sugriva stayed beside Vali along with his monkey followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: After finding out very beautiful wives for them the powerful Sugriva stayed beside Vali along with his monkey followers.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्यकं शितिकण्ठं च महापादं महामुखम् । एवंविधं खशापुत्रं जज्ञे ऽसावतिभीषणम्
verses.transliteration: guhyakaṃ śitikaṇṭhaṃ ca mahāpādaṃ mahāmukham / evaṃvidhaṃ khaśāputraṃ jajñe 'sāvatibhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: Thus these monkeys have been enumerated in view of their real importance. Since the names are many, they cannot be described in full.
verses.hindi: गोकर्णेमिति च क्षेत्रं पर्व प्रोक्त तृ यत्तव ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these monkeys have been enumerated in view of their real importance. Since the names are many, they cannot be described in full.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these monkeys have been enumerated in view of their real importance. Since the names are many, they cannot be described in full.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यानुजं द्वितीयं सा ह्युषस्यन्ते व्यजायत । त्रिशीर्षं च त्रिपादं च त्रिहस्तं कृष्णलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: tasyānujaṃ dvitīyaṃ sā hyuṣasyante vyajāyata / triśīrṣaṃ ca tripādaṃ ca trihastaṃ kṛṣṇalocanam
verses.translation: Prapitamaha (the great grandfather, Brahma) created more brilliance in it. It is considered that what were the two egg-shells, had got very great powet (i.e. the strength of the egg-shells was great).
verses.wordMeaning: Prapitamaha (the great grandfather, Brahma) created more brilliance in it. It is considered that what were the two egg-shells, had got very great powet (i.e. the strength of the egg-shells was great).
verses.commentary: Sense: Prapitamaha (the great grandfather, Brahma) created more brilliance in it. It is considered that what were the two egg-shells, had got very great powet (i.e. the strength of the egg-shells was great).

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्द्ध्वकेशं हरिच्छ्मश्रुं शिलासंहननं दृढम् । ह्रस्वकायं प्रबाहुं च महाकाय महारवम्
verses.transliteration: ūrddhvakeśaṃ haricchmaśruṃ śilāsaṃhananaṃ dṛḍham / hrasvakāyaṃ prabāhuṃ ca mahākāya mahāravam
verses.translation: The lord placed them separately in her navel and gave them to Iravatl. With a wish for procreation, he stuffed them into her belly.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord placed them separately in her navel and gave them to Iravatl. With a wish for procreation, he stuffed them into her belly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord placed them separately in her navel and gave them to Iravatl. With a wish for procreation, he stuffed them into her belly.

verses.sanskrit: आकर्णदारितास्यं च बलवत्सथूलनासिकम् । स्थूलौष्ठमष्टदंष्ट्र च जिह्मास्यं शङ्कुकर्णकम्
verses.transliteration: ākarṇadāritāsyaṃ ca balavatsathūlanāsikam / sthūlauṣṭhamaṣṭadaṃṣṭra ca jihmāsyaṃ śaṅkukarṇakam
verses.translation: Thereupon, four lordly elephants were born to Iravatl. They were very powerful and they became the befitting vehicles of Dcvas. They were honoured by the worlds.
verses.hindi: नरकों में जो घोर यातना पा रहे ये वे समी सगर के पुत्र समस्त पापों के नष्ट होने से नरक से उसी क्षण में स्वग' लोक में चले गये ये । इस रीति से उस महा नदी ने सव सगर सुतों को स्वग में पहुँचा कर फिर बहत करने लगी थी ।५०। उसी मार्ग से बड़े वेग से उसले पूर्व सागर की
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, four lordly elephants were born to Iravatl. They were very powerful and they became the befitting vehicles of Dcvas. They were honoured by the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, four lordly elephants were born to Iravatl. They were very powerful and they became the befitting vehicles of Dcvas. They were honoured by the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पिङ्गलोद्वत्तनयनं जटिलं द्वन्द्वपिण्डकम् । महास्कन्धं महोरस्कं पृथुघोणं कृशोदरम्
verses.transliteration: piṅgalodvattanayanaṃ jaṭilaṃ dvandvapiṇḍakam / mahāskandhaṃ mahoraskaṃ pṛthughoṇaṃ kṛśodaram
verses.translation: They were Airavana, Kumuda, Anjana and Vamana. I shall describe them unto you in detail later on.
verses.hindi: ओर प्रयाण किया था । मेरु प्त के मस्तक से चार भेद होकर वह चारों दिशाओं में गमन कर गयी थी ।५१। उसके चार भेद होने से उसके नाम भी चार हो गये थे। वे नाम में हैं-सीता--अलक नन्दा- सुचक्षु और भद्रवती ये चार नाम हुए हैं ।१२। अगस्त्य मुनि के द्वारा जल पीये जाने पर
verses.wordMeaning: They were Airavana, Kumuda, Anjana and Vamana. I shall describe them unto you in detail later on.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Airavana, Kumuda, Anjana and Vamana. I shall describe them unto you in detail later on.

verses.sanskrit: अस्थूलं लोहितं ग्रीवलंबमेढ्राण्डपिडकम् । एवंविधं कुमारं सा कनिष्ठं समसूयत
verses.transliteration: asthūlaṃ lohitaṃ grīvalaṃbameḍhrāṇḍapiḍakam / evaṃvidhaṃ kumāraṃ sā kaniṣṭhaṃ samasūyata
verses.translation: The merit that one acquires after listening to the
verses.hindi: बहुत समय तक जल के शुष्क ही जाने वाले चारों समुद्र भी ग'गा के जल से पुनः परिपूर्ण जल वाले हो गये ये ।५३। समुद्र के पूरित होने पर और सगर सुतों के द्वारा परिवद्धित हो जाने पर उसके समीप में स्थित बहुत से
verses.wordMeaning: The merit that one acquires after listening to the
verses.commentary: Sense: The merit that one acquires after listening to the

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः प्रसूतमात्रौ तौ विवृद्धौ च प्रमादतः । उपयौगसमर्थाभ्यां शरीराभ्यां व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ prasūtamātrau tau vivṛddhau ca pramādataḥ / upayaugasamarthābhyāṃ śarīrābhyāṃ vyavasthitau
verses.translation: If the story of the birth of Martanda is in anyone's house, if the story is narrated in anyone's house, under- stand that he is one who has no equal. His children will never die prematurely.
verses.hindi: ६०   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण देश थे वे सब लुप्त हो गये थे अर्थात् समुद्र में लीन हो गये थे ।५४। समुद्र के समीप में रहने वाले समस्त क्षेत्र सभी ओर से निमग्न हो गये थे और हे नृप ! वहाँ पर जो भी जन निवास करते थे वे सभी इधर-उधर चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: If the story of the birth of Martanda is in anyone's house, if the story is narrated in anyone's house, under- stand that he is one who has no equal. His children will never die prematurely.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the story of the birth of Martanda is in anyone's house, if the story is narrated in anyone's house, under- stand that he is one who has no equal. His children will never die prematurely.

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातौ विवृद्धाङ्गौ मातरं पर्यकर्षताम् । तयोः पूर्वस्तु यः क्रूरो मातरं सो ऽभ्य कर्षत
verses.transliteration: sadyojātau vivṛddhāṅgau mātaraṃ paryakarṣatām / tayoḥ pūrvastu yaḥ krūro mātaraṃ so 'bhya karṣata
verses.translation: W. 299-304 enumerate the important members of the Species of bears.
verses.hindi: थे ।५५। गोकणं नाम वाला क्षेत्र है जिसके विषय में पूर्व में ही आपसे कहा गया था । वह समुद्र के ही समीप में विद्यमान होने से समुद्र के ही अन्दर में छिप गया था ।५६। इसके अनन्तर उसके विनाश करने वाले सब उसके उद्धार की आकाइकषा वाले ये और सह्य अदि पर भृगुशादूल की देखने की
verses.wordMeaning: W. 299-304 enumerate the important members of the Species of bears.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 299-304 enumerate the important members of the Species of bears.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रुवंश्च मातर्भक्षाव रक्षार्थं क्षुधयार्दितः । न्यषेधयत्पुनर्ह्येनं स्वयं स तु कनिष्ठकः
verses.transliteration: bruvaṃśca mātarbhakṣāva rakṣārthaṃ kṣudhayārditaḥ / nyaṣedhayatpunarhyenaṃ svayaṃ sa tu kaniṣṭhakaḥ
verses.translation: They stay in villages, parts of forests, hollows of trees, caves, houses and inner apartments of abodes.
verses.hindi: इच्छा बाले है तूप ! बे साब वहाँ गये ये
verses.wordMeaning: They stay in villages, parts of forests, hollows of trees, caves, houses and inner apartments of abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: They stay in villages, parts of forests, hollows of trees, caves, houses and inner apartments of abodes.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वेषां क्षेमकृत्त्वं वै रक्षैतां मातरं स्वकाम् । बाहुभ्यां परिगृह्यैनं मातरं सो ऽभ्यभाषयत्
verses.transliteration: pūrveṣāṃ kṣemakṛttvaṃ vai rakṣaitāṃ mātaraṃ svakām / bāhubhyāṃ parigṛhyainaṃ mātaraṃ so 'bhyabhāṣayat
verses.translation: They move about by means of different modes of walking; they are clever, they arc seen in villages; they move about in forests. They stay (in both the places) naturally.
verses.wordMeaning: They move about by means of different modes of walking; they are clever, they arc seen in villages; they move about in forests. They stay (in both the places) naturally.
verses.commentary: Sense: They move about by means of different modes of walking; they are clever, they arc seen in villages; they move about in forests. They stay (in both the places) naturally.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु प्रादुर्भूतस्तयोः पिता । तौ दृष्ट्वा विकृता कारौ खशां तामभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu prādurbhūtastayoḥ pitā / tau dṛṣṭvā vikṛtā kārau khaśāṃ tāmabhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Two sons were born to Sarama. They were brave and extremely unbearable. They were Syama and &abala. They are remembered as the attendants of Yama.
verses.wordMeaning: Two sons were born to Sarama. They were brave and extremely unbearable. They were Syama and &abala. They are remembered as the attendants of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two sons were born to Sarama. They were brave and extremely unbearable. They were Syama and &abala. They are remembered as the attendants of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: तौ सुतौ पितरं दृष्ट्वा ह्येकभूतौ भयान्वितौ । मातुरेव पुनश्चाङ्गे प्रलीयेतां स्वमायया
verses.transliteration: tau sutau pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyekabhūtau bhayānvitau / mātureva punaścāṅge pralīyetāṃ svamāyayā
verses.translation: Their sons were unassailable. They were blessed with sons and grandsons. Their race became well renowned for ever among Sarameyas (Dogs).
verses.hindi: ऋद्धि इष्टवा तु यज्ञस्य कर् दवस्तस्य वृहस्पतिः । संवर्तेन तते यज्ञे चुकोप स भृशं तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Their sons were unassailable. They were blessed with sons and grandsons. Their race became well renowned for ever among Sarameyas (Dogs).
verses.commentary: Sense: Their sons were unassailable. They were blessed with sons and grandsons. Their race became well renowned for ever among Sarameyas (Dogs).

verses.sanskrit: अथाब्रवीदृषिर्भार्यां किमाभ्यामुक्तवत्यसि । सर्वमाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन तवैवायं व्यतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: athābravīdṛṣirbhāryāṃ kimābhyāmuktavatyasi / sarvamācakṣva tattvena tavaivāyaṃ vyatikramaḥ
verses.translation: In the course of the battles between the Devas and the Asuras, he was the violent slayer of the terrible and powerful Asuras who would rather get slain (than submit), because they were perpetually self-respecting.
verses.hindi: लोकानां स हि नाशाय देवतेहि प्रसादितः । भरुत्तश्चक्रवत्ती स नरिष्यंतमवासवाव्
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of the battles between the Devas and the Asuras, he was the violent slayer of the terrible and powerful Asuras who would rather get slain (than submit), because they were perpetually self-respecting.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of the battles between the Devas and the Asuras, he was the violent slayer of the terrible and powerful Asuras who would rather get slain (than submit), because they were perpetually self-respecting.

verses.sanskrit: मातृतुल्यश्च जनने पुत्रो भवति कन्यका । यथाशीला भवेन्माता तथाशीलो भवेत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: mātṛtulyaśca janane putro bhavati kanyakā / yathāśīlā bhavenmātā tathāśīlo bhavetsutaḥ
verses.translation: W. 324-358 describe the different types of elephants, their cha- racteristics and their favourite haunts.
verses.hindi: श्री सृतजी ने कहा--अव आप मनु के पुत्रों का विसर्ग विस्तार के साथ समझ लीजिए । पृष राति में गुरुदेव की गौ की हिंसा करके उसके क्षय होने पर महात्मा च्यवन के शाप से शूद्रता को प्राप्त हो गया था । करुष
verses.wordMeaning: W. 324-358 describe the different types of elephants, their cha- racteristics and their favourite haunts.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 324-358 describe the different types of elephants, their cha- racteristics and their favourite haunts.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वर्णा तु भवेद्भूमिस्तद्वर्णं सलिलं ध्रुवम् । मातॄणां शीलदोषेण तथा रूपगुणैः पुनः
verses.transliteration: yadvarṇā tu bhavedbhūmistadvarṇaṃ salilaṃ dhruvam / mātṝṇāṃ śīladoṣeṇa tathā rūpaguṇaiḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Those elephants are tawny-coloured with white hairs and nails. They have various other colours also.
verses.hindi: के कारुष क्षत्रिय हुए वे जो युद्ध करने में दुर्मद थे ।१-२। यह एक सहर क्षत्रियों का समुदाय या जो बहुत ही अधिक विकान्त हुआ था दिष्ट पुत्र नाभाग या और. भलन्दन विद्वान था ।३। इस भलन्दन का पुत्र महान् बल- बानु प्रांगु नाम वाला हुआ था । प्रांशु का एक ही पुव 'हुआ था जो नृप
verses.wordMeaning: Those elephants are tawny-coloured with white hairs and nails. They have various other colours also.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those elephants are tawny-coloured with white hairs and nails. They have various other colours also.

verses.sanskrit: विभिन्नास्तु प्रजाः सर्वास्तथा ख्यातिवशेन च । इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवान्खशामप्रतिमस्तदा
verses.transliteration: vibhinnāstu prajāḥ sarvāstathā khyātivaśena ca / ityevamuktvā bhagavānkhaśāmapratimastadā
verses.translation: Elephants with lips hanging down, beautiful to behold, are born in his race. Their skin, tongue and trunk are dark -coloured. Their faces (heads) are large and stout.
verses.hindi: प्रजापति के हो समान था ।४। उसको सुहृतु और वान्धवो के साथ संवत्त' के द्वारा स्वग में ले जाया गया था । इस विषय में संवत्त का और वृहस्पति का बड़ा भारी विवाद हुआ था ।५। उसके यज्ञ की ऋड्धि का अवलोकन करके वृहस्पति क्रुद्ध हो गये ये । संवत्त केद्वारा यज्ञ के विस्तृत होने पर
verses.wordMeaning: Elephants with lips hanging down, beautiful to behold, are born in his race. Their skin, tongue and trunk are dark -coloured. Their faces (heads) are large and stout.
verses.commentary: Sense: Elephants with lips hanging down, beautiful to behold, are born in his race. Their skin, tongue and trunk are dark -coloured. Their faces (heads) are large and stout.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रावाहूय साम्ना वै चक्रे ताभ्यां तु नामनी । पुत्राभ्यां यत्कृतं तस्यास्तदाचष्ट खशा तदा
verses.transliteration: putrāvāhūya sāmnā vai cakre tābhyāṃ tu nāmanī / putrābhyāṃ yatkṛtaṃ tasyāstadācaṣṭa khaśā tadā
verses.translation: Vamadeva, Anjana, Syama and Vamana were born of Saman. His wife is Afijana and Nilavan and Laksana are the sons.
verses.hindi: उस समय में वह अत्यधिक कुपित हो गया था ।६। लोकों के विनाश करने के लिए देवगणों के द्वारा वह प्रसन्न किया था। मरुत चक्रवत्तीं उसने नरिष्यम्त को बसाया था
verses.wordMeaning: Vamadeva, Anjana, Syama and Vamana were born of Saman. His wife is Afijana and Nilavan and Laksana are the sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vamadeva, Anjana, Syama and Vamana were born of Saman. His wife is Afijana and Nilavan and Laksana are the sons.

verses.sanskrit: माता यथा समाख्याता तर्माभ्यां च पृथक्पृथक् । तेन धात्वर्थयोगेन तत्तदर्थे चकार ह
verses.transliteration: mātā yathā samākhyātā tarmābhyāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak / tena dhātvarthayogena tattadarthe cakāra ha
verses.translation: Elephants of the following type are bom in his family. They arc very enormously big and fierce. Their necks and heads are beautiful. They are broad-chested and swift. They are fettered from below (i.e. by means of feet).
verses.wordMeaning: Elephants of the following type are bom in his family. They arc very enormously big and fierce. Their necks and heads are beautiful. They are broad-chested and swift. They are fettered from below (i.e. by means of feet).
verses.commentary: Sense: Elephants of the following type are bom in his family. They arc very enormously big and fierce. Their necks and heads are beautiful. They are broad-chested and swift. They are fettered from below (i.e. by means of feet).

verses.sanskrit: मातर्भक्षेत्यथोक्तो वै खादने भक्षणे च सः । भक्षावेत्युक्तवानेष तस्माद्यक्षो ऽभवत्त्वयम्
verses.transliteration: mātarbhakṣetyathokto vai khādane bhakṣaṇe ca saḥ / bhakṣāvetyuktavāneṣa tasmādyakṣo 'bhavattvayam
verses.translation: With the removal of his deformity Supratika attain- ed the same form as that of Saman. He had three sons viz. — Prahari, Sampati, and Prthu.
verses.wordMeaning: With the removal of his deformity Supratika attain- ed the same form as that of Saman. He had three sons viz. — Prahari, Sampati, and Prthu.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the removal of his deformity Supratika attain- ed the same form as that of Saman. He had three sons viz. — Prahari, Sampati, and Prthu.

verses.sanskrit: रक्ष इत्येष धातुर्यः पालने स विभाव्यते । उक्तवांश्चैष यस्मात्तु रक्षेमां मातरं स्वकाम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣa ityeṣa dhāturyaḥ pālane sa vibhāvyate / uktavāṃścaiṣa yasmāttu rakṣemāṃ mātaraṃ svakām
verses.translation: Elephants of the following type were born in his family. Their heads are remarkably divided into two (Here partition of the head is referred to). They resemble the glossy clouds. They are pleasing to look at. Their bodies are well-built. They have the luster of lotus. They have proportionate girth of the body, globular in shape. They are brave and they have stout and large faces.
verses.wordMeaning: Elephants of the following type were born in his family. Their heads are remarkably divided into two (Here partition of the head is referred to). They resemble the glossy clouds. They are pleasing to look at. Their bodies are well-built. They have the luster of lotus.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Elephants of the following type were born in his family. Their heads are remarkably divided into two (Here partition of the head is referred to). They resemble the glossy clouds. They are pleasing to look at. Their bodies are well-built. They have the luster of lotus.…

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना रक्षो ऽपरस्तस्माद्भविष्यति तवात्मजः । स तदा तद्विधां दृष्ट्वा विक्रियां च तयोः पिता
verses.transliteration: nāmnā rakṣo 'parastasmādbhaviṣyati tavātmajaḥ / sa tadā tadvidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikriyāṃ ca tayoḥ pitā
verses.translation: The turning away of their tongues (i.e. inabi- lity to speak or cessation of the power of speech) has been mentioned as originating from the curse of Agni (firegod). The fact that an elephant cannot be aware of its own inherent strength and that its scrotum lies hidden within its body — these two should be known as resulting from the curse of the Suras.
verses.wordMeaning: The turning away of their tongues (i.e. inabi- lity to speak or cessation of the power of speech) has been mentioned as originating from the curse of Agni (firegod).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The turning away of their tongues (i.e. inabi- lity to speak or cessation of the power of speech) has been mentioned as originating from the curse of Agni (firegod).…

verses.sanskrit: तदा भाविनमर्थं च बुद्ध्वा मात्रा कृतं तयोः । तावृभौ क्षुधितौ दृष्ट्वा विस्मितः परिमृष्टधीः
verses.transliteration: tadā bhāvinamarthaṃ ca buddhvā mātrā kṛtaṃ tayoḥ / tāvṛbhau kṣudhitau dṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ parimṛṣṭadhīḥ
verses.translation: The king of these (elephants) is Abhramu. It should be understood that the habitat of Afijana of a single tusk (Ekamula?) is that forest region north of the Kausiki and the Ganga extending as far as the ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: The king of these (elephants) is Abhramu. It should be understood that the habitat of Afijana of a single tusk (Ekamula?) is that forest region north of the Kausiki and the Ganga extending as far as the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of these (elephants) is Abhramu. It should be understood that the habitat of Afijana of a single tusk (Ekamula?) is that forest region north of the Kausiki and the Ganga extending as far as the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः प्रादिशदाहारं खशापतिरसृग्वसे । पिता तौ क्षुधितौ दृष्ट्वा वर मेतं तयोर्ददौ
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ prādiśadāhāraṃ khaśāpatirasṛgvase / pitā tau kṣudhitau dṛṣṭvā vara metaṃ tayordadau
verses.translation: Some of them are very terrible and they walk about during twilight hours; some of them are very gentle and they
verses.wordMeaning: Some of them are very terrible and they walk about during twilight hours; some of them are very gentle and they
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them are very terrible and they walk about during twilight hours; some of them are very gentle and they

verses.sanskrit: युवयोर्हस्तसंस्पर्शाद्रक्तधाराश्च सर्वशः । सृङ्मांसवसाभूता भविष्यन्तीह कामतः
verses.transliteration: yuvayorhastasaṃsparśādraktadhārāśca sarvaśaḥ / sṛṅmāṃsavasābhūtā bhaviṣyantīha kāmataḥ
verses.translation: All of them meditate upon lord Bhava as the greatest God, in their minds. None of these has a wife or sons.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them meditate upon lord Bhava as the greatest God, in their minds. None of these has a wife or sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them meditate upon lord Bhava as the greatest God, in their minds. None of these has a wife or sons.

verses.sanskrit: नक्ताहारविहारौ च द्विजदेवादिभोजनौ । नक्तं चैव बलीयांसौ दिवा वै निर्बलौ युवाम्
verses.transliteration: naktāhāravihārau ca dvijadevādibhojanau / naktaṃ caiva balīyāṃsau divā vai nirbalau yuvām
verses.translation: There are hundred thousand Bhutas with yogic powers in their souls. They are the attendants of Bhava.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred thousand Bhutas with yogic powers in their souls. They are the attendants of Bhava.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred thousand Bhutas with yogic powers in their souls. They are the attendants of Bhava.

verses.sanskrit: मातरं रक्षत इमां धर्मश्चैवानुशिष्यते । इत्युक्त्वा काश्यपः पुत्रौ तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: mātaraṃ rakṣata imāṃ dharmaścaivānuśiṣyate / ityuktvā kāśyapaḥ putrau tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: Kusmandas2 were born of Kapisa again and again in the form of twins. They are PiSacas with tawny colour.
verses.hindi: नरिष्यस्त का दायाद दण्डधर राजा दम था। उसका पुत्र परम विज्ञान राष्ट्र वर्धन राजा हुआ था।८। उसका पुत्र सुधृति हुआ था और फिर सुधृति से नर पुत्र ने जत्म ग्रहण किया या । केवल का पुत्र तो एक
verses.wordMeaning: Kusmandas2 were born of Kapisa again and again in the form of twins. They are PiSacas with tawny colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kusmandas2 were born of Kapisa again and again in the form of twins. They are PiSacas with tawny colour.

verses.sanskrit: गते पितरि तौ क्रूरौ निसर्गादेव दारुणौ । विपर्ययेषु वर्त्तेते ऽकृतज्ञौ प्राणिहिंसकौ
verses.transliteration: gate pitari tau krūrau nisargādeva dāruṇau / viparyayeṣu varttete 'kṛtajñau prāṇihiṃsakau
verses.translation: On account of their tawny colour (we can infer) that all the Pisacas are flesh-eaters. These pairs (of Pi£acas)
verses.wordMeaning: On account of their tawny colour (we can infer) that all the Pisacas are flesh-eaters. These pairs (of Pi£acas)
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of their tawny colour (we can infer) that all the Pisacas are flesh-eaters. These pairs (of Pi£acas)

verses.sanskrit: महाबलौ महासत्त्वौ महाकायौ दुरासदौ । मायाविदावदृश्यौ तावन्तर्धानगतावुभौ
verses.transliteration: mahābalau mahāsattvau mahākāyau durāsadau / māyāvidāvadṛśyau tāvantardhānagatāvubhau
verses.translation: W. 374-384 describe the goblins called Kilmndas. They are mixed up with Pis&cas.
verses.hindi: केवलात्मज बन्धुमाव हुआ या ।ह। है तृप ! फिर बनधुमानू के यहाँ धर्मात्मा गयान् ने पुत्र के रूप में जन्म धारण किया था । वेगवान् का पुत्र बुध हुआ चा ओर बुध का पुढ तृण बन्धु उत्पन्न हुआ था ॥१०) तृतीय त्ता के मुख में राजा हुआ था ! उसको कन्या इडविडा थी जो विश्ववा को माता थी
verses.wordMeaning: W. 374-384 describe the goblins called Kilmndas. They are mixed up with Pis&cas.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 374-384 describe the goblins called Kilmndas. They are mixed up with Pis&cas.

verses.sanskrit: तौ कामरूपिणौ घोरौ नीरुजौ च स्वभावतः । रूपा नुरूपैराचारैः प्रचरन्तौ प्रबाधकौ
verses.transliteration: tau kāmarūpiṇau ghorau nīrujau ca svabhāvataḥ / rūpā nurūpairācāraiḥ pracarantau prabādhakau
verses.translation: Thus the members of the families of Kusmandas have been recounted. Those male Pisacas and the female Pisacas are born in the family.
verses.hindi: और प्रख्यात बोर्य तथा ओज वाला था जिसने विज्ञाल का निर्माण किया था ।१२। इस विशाल का पुत्र महावलान् हेमचन्द्र उत्पन्न हुआ था। इस हेमचन्द्र के अनन्तर सुचन्द्र लाः विख्यात हुआ था ।१३। सुचन्द्र का पुत्र राजा घूज़ाश्व हुआ या ओ प्रसिद्ध था और बूजाश्‍्व का पुत्र परम
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the members of the families of Kusmandas have been recounted. Those male Pisacas and the female Pisacas are born in the family.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the members of the families of Kusmandas have been recounted. Those male Pisacas and the female Pisacas are born in the family.

verses.sanskrit: देवानृषीन्पितॄंश्चैव गन्धर्वान्किन्नरानपि । पिशाचांश्चमनुष्यांश्चपन्नगान्पक्षिणः पशून्
verses.transliteration: devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva gandharvānkinnarānapi / piśācāṃścamanuṣyāṃścapannagānpakṣiṇaḥ paśūn
verses.translation: Those Pisacas1 called Ajamukhas have hairs all over their body. Their eyes are round. They have curved fang- like teeth and clawlike nails. Their limbs are crooked and oblique. They diffuse harshness.
verses.wordMeaning: Those Pisacas1 called Ajamukhas have hairs all over their body. Their eyes are round. They have curved fang- like teeth and clawlike nails. Their limbs are crooked and oblique. They diffuse harshness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Pisacas1 called Ajamukhas have hairs all over their body. Their eyes are round. They have curved fang- like teeth and clawlike nails. Their limbs are crooked and oblique. They diffuse harshness.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षार्थमिह लिप्संतौ चेरतुस्तौ निशाचरौ । इन्द्रस्यानुचरौ चैव क्षुब्धौ दृष्ट्वा ह्यतिष्ठताम्
verses.transliteration: bhakṣārthamiha lipsaṃtau ceratustau niśācarau / indrasyānucarau caiva kṣubdhau dṛṣṭvā hyatiṣṭhatām
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Kusandikas have no ear. They are devoid of hair and garments. They (sometimes) wear skins and hides as garments. They are fond of food that always consists of meat.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Kusandikas have no ear. They are devoid of hair and garments. They (sometimes) wear skins and hides as garments. They are fond of food that always consists of meat.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Kusandikas have no ear. They are devoid of hair and garments. They (sometimes) wear skins and hides as garments. They are fond of food that always consists of meat.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसं तं कदाचिद्वै निशीथे ह्येक मीश्वरम् । आहारं स परीप्सन्वै शब्देनानुससार ह
verses.transliteration: rākṣasaṃ taṃ kadācidvai niśīthe hyeka mīśvaram / āhāraṃ sa parīpsanvai śabdenānusasāra ha
verses.translation: It should be known that Piiacas called Vakras can assume any form they wish. They walk crookedly. All their limbs, hands and feet are bent and crooked. Their habits and opinions are fradulent.
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that Piiacas called Vakras can assume any form they wish. They walk crookedly. All their limbs, hands and feet are bent and crooked. Their habits and opinions are fradulent.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that Piiacas called Vakras can assume any form they wish. They walk crookedly. All their limbs, hands and feet are bent and crooked. Their habits and opinions are fradulent.

verses.sanskrit: आससाद पिशाचौ वै त्वजः शण्ढश्च ताबुभौ । कपिपुत्रौ महावीर्यौं कूष्माडौ पूर्वजावुभौ
verses.transliteration: āsasāda piśācau vai tvajaḥ śaṇḍhaśca tābubhau / kapiputrau mahāvīryauṃ kūṣmāḍau pūrvajāvubhau
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Nituridakas are portly and pot- bellied. They have snout-like noses. Their bodies, heads and arms are very short. Their staple diet is gingelly seeds. They
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Nituridakas are portly and pot- bellied. They have snout-like noses. Their bodies, heads and arms are very short. Their staple diet is gingelly seeds. They
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Nituridakas are portly and pot- bellied. They have snout-like noses. Their bodies, heads and arms are very short. Their staple diet is gingelly seeds. They

verses.sanskrit: पिङ्गाक्षावूर्द्ध्वरोमाणौ वृत्ताक्षौ च सुदारुणौ । कन्याभ्यां सहितौ तौ तु ताभ्यां भर्तुश्चिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: piṅgākṣāvūrddhvaromāṇau vṛttākṣau ca sudāruṇau / kanyābhyāṃ sahitau tau tu tābhyāṃ bhartuścikīrṣayā
verses.translation: VV. 386-400 describe the various tribes of Pis&cas mentioned in W. 381-383 above.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 386-400 describe the various tribes of Pis&cas mentioned in W. 381-383 above.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 386-400 describe the various tribes of Pis&cas mentioned in W. 381-383 above.

verses.sanskrit: ते कन्ये कामरूपिण्यौ तदाचारमुभे च तम् । आहारार्थे समीहन्तौ सकन्यौ तु बुभुक्षितौ
verses.transliteration: te kanye kāmarūpiṇyau tadācāramubhe ca tam / āhārārthe samīhantau sakanyau tu bubhukṣitau
verses.translation: The PiSacas called Arkamarkas (or Akarmakas as in V. 379 above) have the forms of monkeys. They are garrulous* They move about leaping and galloping. They are fond of eating cooked rice and staying on trees.
verses.hindi: कन्यया सह श्रुत्वा च गांधवं ब्रह्मणोंऽतिके
verses.wordMeaning: The PiSacas called Arkamarkas (or Akarmakas as in V. 379 above) have the forms of monkeys. They are garrulous* They move about leaping and galloping. They are fond of eating cooked rice and staying on trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: The PiSacas called Arkamarkas (or Akarmakas as in V. 379 above) have the forms of monkeys. They are garrulous* They move about leaping and galloping. They are fond of eating cooked rice and staying on trees.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यतां रक्षसं तौ कामरूपिणमग्रतः । सहसा सन्निपातेन दृष्ट्वा चैव परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: apaśyatāṃ rakṣasaṃ tau kāmarūpiṇamagrataḥ / sahasā sannipātena dṛṣṭvā caiva parasparam
verses.translation: The PiSacas called Pamsus discharge dust from their limbs. They keep their arms lifted up. Their hairs stand up erect. Their eyes appear as though they have been taken out. They take to anything as their abode.
verses.hindi: इस सृ जय का जो पुत्र समुत्पन्न हुआ था वह खी सम्पन्न और प्रताप बाला सहदेब था । सहदेव के पुत्र का नाम कुशाश्व था। यह भी परम घाभिक् हुआ था ।१४। कुलाश३ का तनय सोमदत्त हुआ था जो महान तेज वाला था और परम प्रतापी या। राजि सोमदत्त के यहां जनमेजय ने पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The PiSacas called Pamsus discharge dust from their limbs. They keep their arms lifted up. Their hairs stand up erect. Their eyes appear as though they have been taken out. They take to anything as their abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: The PiSacas called Pamsus discharge dust from their limbs. They keep their arms lifted up. Their hairs stand up erect. Their eyes appear as though they have been taken out. They take to anything as their abode.

verses.sanskrit: ईक्षमाणाः स्थितान्योन्यं परस्परजिघृक्षवः । पितरावूचतुः कन्ये युवा मानयत द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: īkṣamāṇāḥ sthitānyonyaṃ parasparajighṛkṣavaḥ / pitarāvūcatuḥ kanye yuvā mānayata drutam
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Upavlras have their permanent abode in burning grounds. They resemble bees. They are dry. They are armed with tridents and wear bark garments.
verses.hindi: के रूप में जन्म धारण किया था ।१६। इस जनमेजय का पत्र प्रमति नाम वाला बहुत हो परडयात हुआ था । तुणविन्दु के प्रभाव से ये सब वंशालक नृप हुए ये।१७। ये समी सुदीर्ष आयु वाले--महान् समुच्च आत्माओं वाले- बल--बीय॑ से सुसमस्वित और बहुत ही अधिक धार्मिक वृत्ति वाले हुए ये ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Upavlras have their permanent abode in burning grounds. They resemble bees. They are dry. They are armed with tridents and wear bark garments.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Upavlras have their permanent abode in burning grounds. They resemble bees. They are dry. They are armed with tridents and wear bark garments.

verses.sanskrit: जीवग्राहं निगृह्यैनं विस्फुरन्तं पदेपदे । ततस्तमभिसृत्यैनं कन्ये जगृहतुस्तदा
verses.transliteration: jīvagrāhaṃ nigṛhyainaṃ visphurantaṃ padepade / tatastamabhisṛtyainaṃ kanye jagṛhatustadā
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Ulukhalas have motionless eyes and large tongues with which they constantly lick the sides of their mouth. Mortars constitute their ornaments. They are roguish. They scatter jewels as if in a continuous stream.
verses.hindi: शर्याति के एक जोड़ा हुआ था जो आनत के नाम विधुत था ।१८। एक पुत्र था और एक सुकन्या नाम वाली कन्या थी जो च्यवन ऋषि की भार्या थी । उस आनत्त के दायको ग्रहण करने वाला पुत्र रेव नामक हुआ था जो बड़ा वीयं वाला था ।१६। आंनत्त का देश या जिसको कुशस्थलो नाम वाली
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Ulukhalas have motionless eyes and large tongues with which they constantly lick the sides of their mouth. Mortars constitute their ornaments. They are roguish. They scatter jewels as if in a continuous stream.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Ulukhalas have motionless eyes and large tongues with which they constantly lick the sides of their mouth. Mortars constitute their ornaments. They are roguish. They scatter jewels as if in a continuous stream.

verses.sanskrit: संगृहीत्वा तु हस्ताभ्यामानीतः पितृसंसदि । ताभ्यां कन्यागृहीतं तं पिशाचौ वीक्ष्य रक्षसम्
verses.transliteration: saṃgṛhītvā tu hastābhyāmānītaḥ pitṛsaṃsadi / tābhyāṃ kanyāgṛhītaṃ taṃ piśācau vīkṣya rakṣasam
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Panipatras have the oblations offered by people as their food. They have stout heads like those of elephants and camels. Their calves are plump and curved.
verses.hindi: पुरी थी । रेव का पुत्र रंवत ककुदूमो नाम वाला बड़ा धार्मिक हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Panipatras have the oblations offered by people as their food. They have stout heads like those of elephants and camels. Their calves are plump and curved.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Panipatras have the oblations offered by people as their food. They have stout heads like those of elephants and camels. Their calves are plump and curved.

verses.sanskrit: अपृच्छतां च कस्य त्वं स च सर्वमभाषत । तस्य कर्माभिजाती च श्रुत्वा तौ रक्षसस्तदा
verses.transliteration: apṛcchatāṃ ca kasya tvaṃ sa ca sarvamabhāṣata / tasya karmābhijātī ca śrutvā tau rakṣasastadā
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Kumbhapatras eat invisible food- stuffs. They are subtle, hairy and tawny-coloured. They walk about sometimes visible and sometimes invisible.
verses.hindi: यह सौ भाइयों में सबसे बड़ा था । इसने हो कुशस्थली के राज्य को प्राप्त क्रिया था । ब्रह्माजी के समीप में कन्या का अवण करके उसके साथ गध ज्ञान कर लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Kumbhapatras eat invisible food- stuffs. They are subtle, hairy and tawny-coloured. They walk about sometimes visible and sometimes invisible.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Kumbhapatras eat invisible food- stuffs. They are subtle, hairy and tawny-coloured. They walk about sometimes visible and sometimes invisible.

verses.sanskrit: अजः शण्डश्च तस्मै ते कन्यके प्रत्यपादयत् । तौ तुष्टौ कर्मणा तस्य कन्ये ते ददतुस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: ajaḥ śaṇḍaśca tasmai te kanyake pratyapādayat / tau tuṣṭau karmaṇā tasya kanye te dadatustu vai
verses.translation: The Pilacas called Nipurias move about without associates (i.e. singly). Their mouths appear to be divided extending upto their ears. Their brows hang down and their noses arc thick.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pilacas called Nipurias move about without associates (i.e. singly). Their mouths appear to be divided extending upto their ears. Their brows hang down and their noses arc thick.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pilacas called Nipurias move about without associates (i.e. singly). Their mouths appear to be divided extending upto their ears. Their brows hang down and their noses arc thick.

verses.sanskrit: पैशाचैन विवाहेन रुदन्त्यावुद्ववाह सः । अजः शण्डः सुताभ्यां तु तदा श्रावयतां धनम्
verses.transliteration: paiśācaina vivāhena rudantyāvudvavāha saḥ / ajaḥ śaṇḍaḥ sutābhyāṃ tu tadā śrāvayatāṃ dhanam
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Puranas are fond of vacant horses and apartments. They are stout and short in stature. Their hands and feet cover up their snouts. Their eyes are directed towards the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Puranas are fond of vacant horses and apartments. They are stout and short in stature. Their hands and feet cover up their snouts. Their eyes are directed towards the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Puranas are fond of vacant horses and apartments. They are stout and short in stature. Their hands and feet cover up their snouts. Their eyes are directed towards the ground.

verses.sanskrit: इयं ब्रह्मधना नाम कन्या या सहिता शुभा । ब्रह्म तस्यापराहार इति शण्डो ऽभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ brahmadhanā nāma kanyā yā sahitā śubhā / brahma tasyāparāhāra iti śaṇḍo 'bhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Baladas frequently resort to the lying-in-chamber. Their hands and feet are directed backwards. They have the velocity of the wind and they run backwards.
verses.hindi: कन्यां तु बलदेवाय सुद्रतां नाम रेवतीम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Baladas frequently resort to the lying-in-chamber. Their hands and feet are directed backwards. They have the velocity of the wind and they run backwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Baladas frequently resort to the lying-in-chamber. Their hands and feet are directed backwards. They have the velocity of the wind and they run backwards.

verses.sanskrit: इयं जन्तुधना नाम कन्या सर्वाङ्गजन्तिला । जन्तुभाव धनादाना इत्यजौऽश्रावयद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ jantudhanā nāma kanyā sarvāṅgajantilā / jantubhāva dhanādānā ityajau'śrāvayaddhanam
verses.translation: The Pis&cas called Vipadakas drink blood during battles. They are naked. 'They don't have any abode. Their penis, scrotum and the calves hang down dangling.
verses.hindi: रेमे रामश्च धर्मात्मा रेवत्या सहितः किल ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Pis&cas called Vipadakas drink blood during battles. They are naked. 'They don't have any abode. Their penis, scrotum and the calves hang down dangling.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pis&cas called Vipadakas drink blood during battles. They are naked. 'They don't have any abode. Their penis, scrotum and the calves hang down dangling.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गकेशापाशा च कन्या जन्तुधना तु या । यातुधानप्रसूता सा कन्या चैव महारवा
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgakeśāpāśā ca kanyā jantudhanā tu yā / yātudhānaprasūtā sā kanyā caiva mahāravā
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Skandins and others called Ucche$anadins (those who habitually eat food remnants)
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Skandins and others called Ucche$anadins (those who habitually eat food remnants)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Skandins and others called Ucche$anadins (those who habitually eat food remnants)

verses.sanskrit: अरुणा चाप्यलोमा च कन्या ब्रह्मधना तु या । ब्रह्मधानप्रसूता सा कन्या चैव महारवा
verses.transliteration: aruṇā cāpyalomā ca kanyā brahmadhanā tu yā / brahmadhānaprasūtā sā kanyā caiva mahāravā
verses.translation: After assigning all these to the Pi £acas,# Brahma gave all the goblins and Pisacas an overlord viz — the trident- bearing Girisa.
verses.hindi: न जरा क्षुत्पिपासे वा न च मृत्युभयं ततः ।
verses.wordMeaning: After assigning all these to the Pi £acas,# Brahma gave all the goblins and Pisacas an overlord viz — the trident- bearing Girisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: After assigning all these to the Pi £acas,# Brahma gave all the goblins and Pisacas an overlord viz — the trident- bearing Girisa.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पिशाचकन्ये ते मिथुने द्वे प्रसूयताम् । तयोः प्रजानिसर्गं च कथयिष्ये निबोधत
verses.transliteration: evaṃ piśācakanye te mithune dve prasūyatām / tayoḥ prajānisargaṃ ca kathayiṣye nibodhata
verses.translation: The beautiful lady, Damstra gave birth to lions and tigers as her sons. Leopards and other carnivorus beasts of prey are also her sons.
verses.hindi: न च रोगः प्रभवति ब्रह्मलोकं गतस्य ह्
verses.wordMeaning: The beautiful lady, Damstra gave birth to lions and tigers as her sons. Leopards and other carnivorus beasts of prey are also her sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The beautiful lady, Damstra gave birth to lions and tigers as her sons. Leopards and other carnivorus beasts of prey are also her sons.

verses.sanskrit: हेतिः प्रहेतिरुग्रश्च पौरुषेयौ वधस्तथा । विद्युत्स्फूर्जश्च वातश्च आयो प्याघ्रस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: hetiḥ prahetirugraśca pauruṣeyau vadhastathā / vidyutsphūrjaśca vātaśca āyo pyāghrastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Understand completely the creation of progeny of Rsa also. She had five daughters. Listen to their names from me.
verses.wordMeaning: Understand completely the creation of progeny of Rsa also. She had five daughters. Listen to their names from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand completely the creation of progeny of Rsa also. She had five daughters. Listen to their names from me.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यश्च राक्षसा ह्येते यातुधानात्मजा दश । माल्यवांश्च सुमाली च प्रहेतितनयौ शृणु
verses.transliteration: sūryaśca rākṣasā hyete yātudhānātmajā daśa / mālyavāṃśca sumālī ca prahetitanayau śṛṇu
verses.translation: They should be known as follows: — Mina, Amina, Vrtta, Parivrtta and Anuvrtta. Listen to their progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: They should be known as follows: — Mina, Amina, Vrtta, Parivrtta and Anuvrtta. Listen to their progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: They should be known as follows: — Mina, Amina, Vrtta, Parivrtta and Anuvrtta. Listen to their progeny.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहेतितनयः श्रीमानपुलोमा नाम विश्रुतः । मधुः परो महोग्रस्तु लवणस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: prahetitanayaḥ śrīmānapulomā nāma viśrutaḥ / madhuḥ paro mahograstu lavaṇastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Crocodiles with thousand fangs, the species of fish known as Pathinas, Timis and Rohitas, these and others are mentioned as Maina group (i.e. children of Mina). They are very vast (in number).
verses.hindi: हे विभो ! वह समय देवों के देव का तो एक हो मुहूर्त था और मनुष्यों का बह समय बहुत से युगों के बराबर था । फिर बह युवा यादवों के समुदायों से घिरी हुई अपनी पुरी में आ गया था ।२२। बह पुरी द्वारवती नाम वाली की गयो थी जिसमें बहुत से द्वार थे और यह परम मनोहर थी।
verses.wordMeaning: Crocodiles with thousand fangs, the species of fish known as Pathinas, Timis and Rohitas, these and others are mentioned as Maina group (i.e. children of Mina). They are very vast (in number).
verses.commentary: Sense: Crocodiles with thousand fangs, the species of fish known as Pathinas, Timis and Rohitas, these and others are mentioned as Maina group (i.e. children of Mina). They are very vast (in number).

verses.sanskrit: महायोगबलोपेतो महा देवमुपस्थितः । उग्रस्य पुत्रौ विक्रान्तो वज्रहा नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: mahāyogabalopeto mahā devamupasthitaḥ / ugrasya putrau vikrānto vajrahā nāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Grahas (Alligators) should be known classified into four groups viz — Madguras, Sahkus, Ugras and Siiumdras. It was Amina who gave birth to these.
verses.hindi: भोज-वृषिण ओर अस्धक जो यादवों के विभिन्न भेद ये जिममें वसुदेव अग्र गामी थे-इन सबने उसकी रक्षा को थो ।२३। अरियों के दमन करने बाले रैवत ने ठोक तात्विक रूप से उस कया का श्रवण किया भौर फिर उसने अपनी सुन्दर ब्रत वाली रेवतो नाम वाली कन्या को बलदेवजो के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: Grahas (Alligators) should be known classified into four groups viz — Madguras, Sahkus, Ugras and Siiumdras. It was Amina who gave birth to these.
verses.commentary: Sense: Grahas (Alligators) should be known classified into four groups viz — Madguras, Sahkus, Ugras and Siiumdras. It was Amina who gave birth to these.

verses.sanskrit: पौरुषेयसुताः पञ्च पुरुषादा महाबलाः । कूरश्च विकृतश्चैव रुधिरादस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: pauruṣeyasutāḥ pañca puruṣādā mahābalāḥ / kūraśca vikṛtaścaiva rudhirādastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Vrtta gave birth to (different species of) tortoises and many other aquatic creatures and diverse kinds of conchs.
verses.hindi: समापित करके बह फिर मेरु पर्वत के शिखर तप चला गया था और वहां पर करने में संस्थित हो गया था।२४। फिर वलरामजी भी जो परम धर्मात्मा थे, अपनो प्रिय पत्नो रेवती के साथ रमण किया करते थे । इस कथा को ऋषियों ने श्रवण करके इसके पश्चात उन्होंने पूछा था
verses.wordMeaning: Vrtta gave birth to (different species of) tortoises and many other aquatic creatures and diverse kinds of conchs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vrtta gave birth to (different species of) tortoises and many other aquatic creatures and diverse kinds of conchs.

verses.sanskrit: मेदाशश्चवपाशश्च नामभिः परिकीर्त्तिताः । वधपुत्रौ दुराचारौ विघ्नश्च शामनश्च ह
verses.transliteration: medāśaścavapāśaśca nāmabhiḥ parikīrttitāḥ / vadhaputrau durācārau vighnaśca śāmanaśca ha
verses.translation: Anuvrtta gave birth to the various forms of frogs, of black does and Sambukas ( bivalve shells and noxious insects).
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कहा--हे महामते ! बहुत युगों वाले काल के व्यतीत जाने पर भी रेवती को और ककुद्मो रेवत को जरावस्या किस कारण से प्राप्त नहीं हुई थी ? इस सबके श्रवण करने को इच्छा वालों को बह गान्धर्व क्या है- यह भी बतलाने की कृपा कीजिए ।२६। श्रीसूतजी ने कहा-जो प्राणी बरह्म
verses.wordMeaning: Anuvrtta gave birth to the various forms of frogs, of black does and Sambukas ( bivalve shells and noxious insects).
verses.commentary: Sense: Anuvrtta gave birth to the various forms of frogs, of black does and Sambukas ( bivalve shells and noxious insects).

verses.sanskrit: विद्युत्पुत्रो दुराचारो रसनो नाम राक्षसः । स्फूर्जक्षेत्रे निकुंभस्तु जातो वै ब्रह्मराक्षसः
verses.transliteration: vidyutputro durācāro rasano nāma rākṣasaḥ / sphūrjakṣetre nikuṃbhastu jāto vai brahmarākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, lice, nits etc are born of the bodies moistened by sweat. The creatures called U£ana are born of the dirt and residue of human sweat.
verses.hindi: लोक में गमन कर जाया करता है उसको न तो कोई रोग ही होता है और उसको त मृत्यु का भय रहता है। वहां पर जरा और भूच प्यास भी नहीं सताया करती हैं ।२५। है श्रंछ मुनिगणो ! आपने जो मुझसे गान्धर्व के
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, lice, nits etc are born of the bodies moistened by sweat. The creatures called U£ana are born of the dirt and residue of human sweat.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, lice, nits etc are born of the bodies moistened by sweat. The creatures called U£ana are born of the dirt and residue of human sweat.

verses.sanskrit: वातपुत्रो विरोधस्तु तथा यस्य जनातकः । व्याघ्र पुत्रो निरानन्दः क्रतूनां विघ्नकारकः
verses.transliteration: vātaputro virodhastu tathā yasya janātakaḥ / vyāghra putro nirānandaḥ kratūnāṃ vighnakārakaḥ
verses.translation: There are many groups of ants of different species; there are worms with many feet; there are varieties of products of conchs and stones smaller than pms.
verses.wordMeaning: There are many groups of ants of different species; there are worms with many feet; there are varieties of products of conchs and stones smaller than pms.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are many groups of ants of different species; there are worms with many feet; there are varieties of products of conchs and stones smaller than pms.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्य चान्वये जाता पूराः सर्पाश्च राक्षसाः । यातुधानाः परिक्रान्ता ब्रह्म धानान्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: sarvasya cānvaye jātā pūrāḥ sarpāśca rākṣasāḥ / yātudhānāḥ parikrāntā brahma dhānānnibodhata
verses.translation: These and others are the numerous groups of earthly (creatures) bom of sweat. Many of these creatijres are bom of waters heated by the sun etc. as well as from rain.
verses.wordMeaning: These and others are the numerous groups of earthly (creatures) bom of sweat. Many of these creatijres are bom of waters heated by the sun etc. as well as from rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and others are the numerous groups of earthly (creatures) bom of sweat. Many of these creatijres are bom of waters heated by the sun etc. as well as from rain.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञापेतो धृतिः क्षेमो ब्रह्मपेतश्च यज्ञहा । श्वात्ॐऽबुकः केलिसर्पौं ब्रह्मधानात्मजा नव
verses.transliteration: yajñāpeto dhṛtiḥ kṣemo brahmapetaśca yajñahā / śvātoṃ'bukaḥ kelisarpauṃ brahmadhānātmajā nava
verses.translation: The creatures Naladas (? varieties of shrimps) of many feet arc the worms born of the water stagnating near the roots of the Kasa grass. They are stated to be of three kinds — Simhalas, Romalas (hairy) and Picchilas (Slimy).
verses.hindi: अग्नि च पौषा वे देव इष्ट्वा कांच यथाक्रम:
verses.wordMeaning: The creatures Naladas (? varieties of shrimps) of many feet arc the worms born of the water stagnating near the roots of the Kasa grass. They are stated to be of three kinds — Simhalas, Romalas (hairy) and Picchilas (Slimy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The creatures Naladas (? varieties of shrimps) of many feet arc the worms born of the water stagnating near the roots of the Kasa grass. They are stated to be of three kinds — Simhalas, Romalas (hairy) and Picchilas (Slimy).

verses.sanskrit: स्वसारो ब्रह्मराक्षस्यस्तेषां चेमाः सुदारुणाः । रक्तकर्णी महाजिह्वा क्षमा चेष्टापहारिणी
verses.transliteration: svasāro brahmarākṣasyasteṣāṃ cemāḥ sudāruṇāḥ / raktakarṇī mahājihvā kṣamā ceṣṭāpahāriṇī
verses.translation: These and other groups and species are remembered as born of water as well as sweat. Similarly, worms are bom from the pods of black gram and green gram and other pulses.
verses.wordMeaning: These and other groups and species are remembered as born of water as well as sweat. Similarly, worms are bom from the pods of black gram and green gram and other pulses.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and other groups and species are remembered as born of water as well as sweat. Similarly, worms are bom from the pods of black gram and green gram and other pulses.

verses.sanskrit: एतासामन्वये जाताः पृथिव्यां ब्रह्मराक्षसाः । इत्येते राक्षसाः क्रान्ता यक्षस्यविनिबोधत
verses.transliteration: etāsāmanvaye jātāḥ pṛthivyāṃ brahmarākṣasāḥ / ityete rākṣasāḥ krāntā yakṣasyavinibodhata
verses.translation: Creatures arc born of horses etc. and poisons etc. If cowdung is put (into pits etc) and left there for many days creatures are born of it.
verses.wordMeaning: Creatures arc born of horses etc. and poisons etc. If cowdung is put (into pits etc) and left there for many days creatures are born of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Creatures arc born of horses etc. and poisons etc. If cowdung is put (into pits etc) and left there for many days creatures are born of it.

verses.sanskrit: चकमे सरसं यक्षः पञ्चचूडां क्रतुस्थलाम् । तल्लिप्सुश्चिन्तयानः स देवोद्यानानि मार्गते
verses.transliteration: cakame sarasaṃ yakṣaḥ pañcacūḍāṃ kratusthalām / tallipsuścintayānaḥ sa devodyānāni mārgate
verses.translation: Worms are born, O Brahmanas, wholly from timber and wooden logs. Scorpions are born of dry cowdung, produced by sweat.
verses.hindi: सात तो स्वर होते हैं-तीन ग्राम हैं और इबकीस मूच्छंनाए' होती हैं। और तान उनचास हैं--यह सम्पूर्ण स्वर मण्डल होता है।२६। सात स्वरों के नाम बताये जाते हैं-पड्ज-ऋषभ-गान्धार मध्यम-घैवत और निषाद ये सात स्वर हैं ।३०। सौबीरा-मध्यमा और हरिणा--ये तीन ग्राम
verses.wordMeaning: Worms are born, O Brahmanas, wholly from timber and wooden logs. Scorpions are born of dry cowdung, produced by sweat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worms are born, O Brahmanas, wholly from timber and wooden logs. Scorpions are born of dry cowdung, produced by sweat.

verses.sanskrit: वैभ्राजं सुरभिं चैव तथा चैत्ररथं च यत् । विशोकं सुमनं चैव नन्दनं च वनोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vaibhrājaṃ surabhiṃ caiva tathā caitrarathaṃ ca yat / viśokaṃ sumanaṃ caiva nandanaṃ ca vanottamam
verses.translation: Offsprings of mosquitoes and black bees generally live in stagnating water and slushy mud.
verses.hindi: ह।३१। उसके कालायनोपेता चतुर्या शुद्ध मध्यमा है। है देव ! क्रमानुसार नब्ति-पौषा और कांच ये देखकर होती हैं ।३२। ये मध्य ग्रामिका कही गयी है। अब षड्ज ग्रामा को समझ लोजिए । उत्तर -मन्द्रा-रजनी और वाचो-
verses.wordMeaning: Offsprings of mosquitoes and black bees generally live in stagnating water and slushy mud.
verses.commentary: Sense: Offsprings of mosquitoes and black bees generally live in stagnating water and slushy mud.

verses.sanskrit: बहूनि रमणीयानि मार्गते जातलालसः । दृष्ट्वा तां नन्दने सो ऽथ अप्सरोभिः सहासिनीम्
verses.transliteration: bahūni ramaṇīyāni mārgate jātalālasaḥ / dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nandane so 'tha apsarobhiḥ sahāsinīm
verses.translation: Clusters of seven varieties of nits (? Puttikd-Putra sap takas) are born of cows. ( Defective text). Vyalas (? serpents) arc remembered as Manicchedas (?). Thus insects produced from foetus with no enveloping membrane have been recounted.
verses.hindi: गान्धारग्रामिका-श्यामा अब कीत्तिमाना होती है उसको समझलों
verses.wordMeaning: Clusters of seven varieties of nits (? Puttikd-Putra sap takas) are born of cows. ( Defective text). Vyalas (? serpents) arc remembered as Manicchedas (?). Thus insects produced from foetus with no enveloping membrane have been recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Clusters of seven varieties of nits (? Puttikd-Putra sap takas) are born of cows. ( Defective text). Vyalas (? serpents) arc remembered as Manicchedas (?). Thus insects produced from foetus with no enveloping membrane have been recounted.

verses.sanskrit: नोपायं विन्दते तत्र तस्या लाभाय चिन्तयन् । दूषितः स्वेन रूपेण कर्मणा चैव दूषितः
verses.transliteration: nopāyaṃ vindate tatra tasyā lābhāya cintayan / dūṣitaḥ svena rūpeṇa karmaṇā caiva dūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: These scions of the family ofKasyapa consisting of the mobile and immobile beings, have been explained. The whole universe is stretched (i.e. thickly covered) with their sons and grandsons.
verses.wordMeaning: These scions of the family ofKasyapa consisting of the mobile and immobile beings, have been explained. The whole universe is stretched (i.e. thickly covered) with their sons and grandsons.
verses.commentary: Sense: These scions of the family ofKasyapa consisting of the mobile and immobile beings, have been explained. The whole universe is stretched (i.e. thickly covered) with their sons and grandsons.

verses.sanskrit: ममोद्विजन्ति हिंस्रस्य तथाभूतानि सर्वशः । तत्कथं नाम चार्वगीं प्राप्नुयामहमङ्गनाम्
verses.transliteration: mamodvijanti hiṃsrasya tathābhūtāni sarvaśaḥ / tatkathaṃ nāma cārvagīṃ prāpnuyāmahamaṅganām
verses.translation: This part of a section of creation has been mentioned by me. The Creative activity pertaining to Marlci's son (i.e. Kasyapa) has been succinctly recounted to you.
verses.wordMeaning: This part of a section of creation has been mentioned by me. The Creative activity pertaining to Marlci's son (i.e. Kasyapa) has been succinctly recounted to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: This part of a section of creation has been mentioned by me. The Creative activity pertaining to Marlci's son (i.e. Kasyapa) has been succinctly recounted to you.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वोपायं ततः सो ऽथ शीघ्रकारी व्यवर्त्तयत् । कृत्वा रूपं वसुरुचेर्गन्धर्वस्य च गुह्यकः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvopāyaṃ tataḥ so 'tha śīghrakārī vyavarttayat / kṛtvā rūpaṃ vasurucergandharvasya ca guhyakaḥ
verses.translation: Arista habitually indulged in singing. Kha£a habit- ually followed cruel pursuits. Kadru was habitually fiery in temper (and indulged in angry outbursts). Krodha habitually engaged herself in cleanliness.
verses.wordMeaning: Arista habitually indulged in singing. Kha£a habit- ually followed cruel pursuits. Kadru was habitually fiery in temper (and indulged in angry outbursts). Krodha habitually engaged herself in cleanliness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arista habitually indulged in singing. Kha£a habit- ually followed cruel pursuits. Kadru was habitually fiery in temper (and indulged in angry outbursts). Krodha habitually engaged herself in cleanliness.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सो ऽप्सरसां मध्ये ता जचग्राह क्रतुस्थलाम् । बुद्ध्वा वसुरुचिं तं सा भावेनैवाभ्यावर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: tataḥ so 'psarasāṃ madhye tā jacagrāha kratusthalām / buddhvā vasuruciṃ taṃ sā bhāvenaivābhyāvarttata
verses.translation: They were Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Yak$as, R&k?asas, serpents, Pisacas, animals, deer birds and creepers.
verses.wordMeaning: They were Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Yak$as, R&k?asas, serpents, Pisacas, animals, deer birds and creepers.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Yak$as, R&k?asas, serpents, Pisacas, animals, deer birds and creepers.

verses.sanskrit: संभूतः स तया सार्द्धं दृश्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः । जगाम मैथुनं यक्षः पुत्रार्थं स तया सह
verses.transliteration: saṃbhūtaḥ sa tayā sārddhaṃ dṛśyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ / jagāma maithunaṃ yakṣaḥ putrārthaṃ sa tayā saha
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यमानो ऽप्सरो लिप्सुः शङ्कां नैव चकार सः । ततः संसिद्धकारणः सद्यो जातः सुतस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: dṛśyamāno 'psaro lipsuḥ śaṅkāṃ naiva cakāra saḥ / tataḥ saṃsiddhakāraṇaḥ sadyo jātaḥ sutastu vai
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: उछ्रयात्परिणाहेन सद्यो वृद्धः श्रिया ज्वलन् । राजाहमिति नाभिर्हि पितरं सो ऽभ्यवादयत्
verses.transliteration: uchrayātpariṇāhena sadyo vṛddhaḥ śriyā jvalan / rājāhamiti nābhirhi pitaraṃ so 'bhyavādayat
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: भवान् रजतनाभेति पिता तं प्रत्युवाच ह । मात्रानुरूपो रूपेम पितुर्वीर्येणजायते
verses.transliteration: bhavān rajatanābheti pitā taṃ pratyuvāca ha / mātrānurūpo rūpema piturvīryeṇajāyate
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: जाते तस्मिन्कुमारे तु स्वरुपं प्रयपद्यत । स्वरूपं प्रतिपद्यन्ते गूहन्तो यक्षराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: jāte tasminkumāre tu svarupaṃ prayapadyata / svarūpaṃ pratipadyante gūhanto yakṣarākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सक्त गौसवना ओर महावृष्टिकता अष्टमा है और प्रह्मदान नवग है। इसके अनन्तर प्राजापत्य है । नागयक्षाश्रय बिद्वाच और तदुगोत्तर तथा है ।३६। पदकरान्त-मृगक्रान्त-विषणुङ्रान्त-मनोहरा । सूर्यकान्त धरेण्या-सन्त कोकिलविश्रू त है तेनवा नित्यपवशपिशा चा-अतोवनही -सावित्र-अधं सावित्र
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सुप्ता म्रियन्तः क्रुद्धाश्च भीतास्ते हर्षितास्तथा । ततो ऽब्रवीत्सो ऽप्सरसं स्मयमानस्तु गुह्यकः
verses.transliteration: suptā mriyantaḥ kruddhāśca bhītāste harṣitāstathā / tato 'bravītso 'psarasaṃ smayamānastu guhyakaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: और सबंतोभद् है ।३७-३०। मनोहर-अधात्र्य और गन्धर्वानृपत है । अलम्वु- दष्ट-विष्गु और वंणवर ये दो हैं ।३६। सागरा विजय ओर सर्वशूत मनोहर- हृतोत्वृष्-सकस्ध और प्रिय जान लेना चाहिए ।४०। जो मनोहर अधाश््य तथा गन्बर्वानृपत है । अलम्बुषेष्ट की और नारद प्रिय है ।४१। नगरातान-
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गृहं मे गच्छ भद्रं ते सपुत्रा त्वं वरानने । इत्युक्त्वा सहसा तत्र दृष्ट्वा स्वं रूपमास्थितम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhaṃ me gaccha bhadraṃ te saputrā tvaṃ varānane / ityuktvā sahasā tatra dṛṣṭvā svaṃ rūpamāsthitam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्रिय भीमसेन के द्वारा कहा गया है । बिकलोपनीत बिनता श्री नाम वाला भागंब को प्रिय है
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विभ्रान्ताः प्रद्रुताः सर्वाः समेत्याप्सरसस्तदा । गच्छन्तीमन्वगच्छत्तां पुत्रस्तप्तां त्वयन्शिरा
verses.transliteration: vibhrāntāḥ pradrutāḥ sarvāḥ sametyāpsarasastadā / gacchantīmanvagacchattāṃ putrastaptāṃ tvayanśirā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाप्सरसां मध्ये नयित्वा स न्यवर्त्तत । तां च दृष्ट्वा समुत्पत्तिं यक्षस्याप्सरसां गणाः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāpsarasāṃ madhye nayitvā sa nyavarttata / tāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā samutpattiṃ yakṣasyāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाणां तु जनित्री त्वं इत्यूचुस्तां क्रतुस्थलाम् । जगाम सह पुत्रेण ततो यक्षः स्वमालयम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣāṇāṃ tu janitrī tvaṃ ityūcustāṃ kratusthalām / jagāma saha putreṇa tato yakṣaḥ svamālayam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: मूछ ना हरिणा ते वै चन्द्रस्यास्याधिदेवतम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधो रोहिणो नाम्ना शेरते तत्र गुह्यकाः । तस्मिन्निवासो यक्षाणां न्यग्रोधे रोहिणे स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nyagrodho rohiṇo nāmnā śerate tatra guhyakāḥ / tasminnivāso yakṣāṇāṃ nyagrodhe rohiṇe smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: यक्षो रजतनाभश्च गुह्यकानां पितामहः । अनुह्रादस्य दैत्यस्य भद्रां मणिवरां सुताम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣo rajatanābhaśca guhyakānāṃ pitāmahaḥ / anuhrādasya daityasya bhadrāṃ maṇivarāṃ sutām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: उपयेमे ऽनवद्याङ्गीं तस्यां मणिवरो वशी । जज्ञे सा मणिभद्रं च शक्रतुल्यपराक्रममम्
verses.transliteration: upayeme 'navadyāṅgīṃ tasyāṃ maṇivaro vaśī / jajñe sā maṇibhadraṃ ca śakratulyaparākramamam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तयोः पत्न्यौ भगिन्यौ च क्रतुस्थस्यात्मजे शुभे । नाम्ना पुण्यजनी चैव तथा देवजनी च या
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ patnyau bhaginyau ca kratusthasyātmaje śubhe / nāmnā puṇyajanī caiva tathā devajanī ca yā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
