verses.sanskrit: विजज्ञे पणिभद्रातु पुत्रान्पुण्यजनी शुभा । सिद्धार्थं सूर्यतेजश्च सुमनं नन्दनं तथा
verses.transliteration: vijajñe paṇibhadrātu putrānpuṇyajanī śubhā / siddhārthaṃ sūryatejaśca sumanaṃ nandanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मण्डूकं रुचकं चैव मणिमन्तं वसुं तथा । सर्वानुभूतं शङ्खं च पिङ्गाक्षं भीरुमेव च
verses.transliteration: maṇḍūkaṃ rucakaṃ caiva maṇimantaṃ vasuṃ tathā / sarvānubhūtaṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca piṅgākṣaṃ bhīrumeva ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: असोमं दूरसोमं च पद्मं चन्द्रप्रभं तथा । मेघवर्णं सुभद्रं च प्रद्योतं च महाद्युतिम्
verses.transliteration: asomaṃ dūrasomaṃ ca padmaṃ candraprabhaṃ tathā / meghavarṇaṃ subhadraṃ ca pradyotaṃ ca mahādyutim
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: यहाँ पर चतुर्द और पञ्चदश की नारद इच्छा किया करते हैं? ससोबीरा ओर सुसोदीरा ब्रह्माजी की उपगीत की आती हैं।४३। और उत्तरादि स्वर है । ब्रह्मा तीन देवता हैं । हरि देश में समुत्पन्ना हरिण की हुई बी ।४४। जो मूच्छ ना हरिणा है वे इस चन्द्रकी अधिदेवत हैं। निवृत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: द्युति मन्तं केतुमन्तं दर्शनीयं सुदर्शनम् । चत्वारो विंशतिश्चैव पुत्राः पुण्यजनीभवाः
verses.transliteration: dyuti mantaṃ ketumantaṃ darśanīyaṃ sudarśanam / catvāro viṃśatiścaiva putrāḥ puṇyajanībhavāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: में करोपनोत स्वरमण्डल में अनुद्रि है । ४५५ साकलोपनता है इसलिये मत उसका अस्नदेवत है । मनुदेशा समुत्पन्ना मूच्छंना आत्मा से शुद्ध है
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञिरे मणिभद्रस्य सर्वे ते पुण्यलक्षणाः । तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च यक्षाः पुण्यजनाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: jajñire maṇibhadrasya sarve te puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ / teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca yakṣāḥ puṇyajanāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: इससे मृगामार्गी मृगेर्त्र इसका अधिदेवता है । बह अनेक पोश्वा नखों को समुद्य,म्ना है ।४७। यह मूच्छ ना योजना रजसारजनोत से होतो है । उनको उत्तरमद्रांस सपद्ग देवत जाननो चाहिए ।४। इस कारण से जब तक उत्त- रता हो तब तक इस स्वायम जानना चाहिए । इस देयता तमोदुत्तर मन्द्रोम
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विजज्ञे वै देवजनी पुत्रान्मणिवराञ्छुभा । पूर्णभद्रं हैमवन्तं मणिमन्त्रविवर्द्धनौ
verses.transliteration: vijajñe vai devajanī putrānmaṇivarāñchubhā / pūrṇabhadraṃ haimavantaṃ maṇimantravivarddhanau
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कुसुं चरं पिशङ्गं च स्थूलकर्णं महामुदम् । स्वेतं च विमलं चैव पुष्पदन्तं चयावहम्
verses.transliteration: kusuṃ caraṃ piśaṅgaṃ ca sthūlakarṇaṃ mahāmudam / svetaṃ ca vimalaṃ caiva puṣpadantaṃ cayāvaham
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पद्मवर्णं सुचन्द्रं च पक्षञ्च बलकं तथा । कुमुदाक्षं सुकमलं वर्द्धमानं तथा हितम्
verses.transliteration: padmavarṇaṃ sucandraṃ ca pakṣañca balakaṃ tathā / kumudākṣaṃ sukamalaṃ varddhamānaṃ tathā hitam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पद्मनाभं सुगन्धं च सुवीरं विजयं कृतम् । पूर्ममासं हिरण्याक्षं सारणं चैव मानसम्
verses.transliteration: padmanābhaṃ sugandhaṃ ca suvīraṃ vijayaṃ kṛtam / pūrmamāsaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ sāraṇaṃ caiva mānasam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: पक्षिणां मूछं नाः शरुत्वा पक्ोका सूछ ना: स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रा मणिवरस्यैते यक्षा वै गुह्यकाः स्मृताः । सुरुपाश्च सुवेषाश्च स्रग्विणः प्रियदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: putrā maṇivarasyaite yakṣā vai guhyakāḥ smṛtāḥ / surupāśca suveṣāśca sragviṇaḥ priyadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अपामदुत्तरत्ब होने से अवधेवत का उत्तरायण हैं। यह इजमूच्छना है और पितर श्राद्ध देवता होते हैं।५०। शुद्ध षड्ज स्वर करके जिससे अग्नि महृधि हैं। इससे प्राप्त होता है अतः शुद्धयच्छिकरा सभा नहीं जानती चाहिए ।५१। ये इतनी मूच्छना करके जिममें जैसा भी भाव हो । पक्षियों
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । खशायास्त्वपरे पुत्रा राक्षसाः कामरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / khaśāyāstvapare putrā rākṣasāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: की मुच्छना का श्रवण करके पक्षी का मूच्छ ता कहो गयी है। नानाहष्टि विषा गीता वडवा त्रिविद होती हैं ५२-५३
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तेषां यथा प्रधानान्वै वर्ण्यमा नान्निबोधत । लालाविः क्रथनो भीमः सुमाली मधुरेव च
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ yathā pradhānānvai varṇyamā nānnibodhata / lālāviḥ krathano bhīmaḥ sumālī madhureva ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विस्फूर्जनो बृहज्जिह्वो मातङ्गो धूम्रितस्तथा । चन्द्रार्कभीकरो बुध्नः कपिलोमा प्रहासकः
verses.transliteration: visphūrjano bṛhajjihvo mātaṅgo dhūmritastathā / candrārkabhīkaro budhnaḥ kapilomā prahāsakaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ६८   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण अलंकारास्तु वक्तव्या: स्वैः स्वैवंणे: प्रहेतव: । संस्थानयोगंश्र॒ तथा सदा नाट्याद्यवेक्षया
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पीडापरस्त्रिनाभश्च वक्राक्षश्च निशाचरः । त्रिशिराः शतदंष्ट्रश्च तुण्डकोशश्च राक्षसः
verses.transliteration: pīḍāparastrinābhaśca vakrākṣaśca niśācaraḥ / triśirāḥ śatadaṃṣṭraśca tuṇḍakośaśca rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: वाक्यार्थपदयोगार्थरलंकारेश्च पूरणम् । पदानि गीतकस्याहु: पुरस्तात्पृष्टतोऽ वा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अश्वश्चाकंपनश्चैव दुर्मुखश्च निशाचरः । इत्येते राक्षसवारा विक्रान्ता गणरूपिमः
verses.transliteration: aśvaścākaṃpanaścaiva durmukhaśca niśācaraḥ / ityete rākṣasavārā vikrāntā gaṇarūpimaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकचरास्ते तु त्रिदशानां समक्रमाः । सप्त चान्या दुहितरस्ताः शृणुध्वं यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalokacarāste tu tridaśānāṃ samakramāḥ / sapta cānyā duhitarastāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: श्री सूतजी ने कहा--मैं अपने पूर्व में होने वाले आवायों के मत को समझ कर क्रम से आरम्भ से अन्त तक बताऊँगा जो भी अलंकार परम प्रसिद्ध हैं उनको मुझ से आप लोग अब श्रवण कीजिए ।१। जो अपने-अपने बर्णो से प्रकृष्ट हेतुओं वाले हैं वे ही अलंकार बताने चाहिए । और जो नादय
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: यासां च यः प्रजासर्गो येन चोत्पादिता गणाः । आलंबा उत्कचोत्कृष्टा निरृता कपिला शिवा
verses.transliteration: yāsāṃ ca yaḥ prajāsargo yena cotpāditā gaṇāḥ / ālaṃbā utkacotkṛṣṭā nirṛtā kapilā śivā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: आदि के अवेक्षण से संस्थान योगों से सदा समन्वित हुआ करते हैं।२। जहाँ पर वाक्य-अथं-पद-योग-अथं ओर जलकारों से पूति होती है वे गीत के पद आगे अथवा पीछे कहे गये हैं ।३। स्वातोनित्रीनर-नीड्डीमनः कण्ठ और
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: केशिनी च महाभागा भगिन्यः सप्त याः स्मृताः । ताभ्यो लोकनिकायस्य हन्तारो युद्धदुर्मदाः
verses.transliteration: keśinī ca mahābhāgā bhaginyaḥ sapta yāḥ smṛtāḥ / tābhyo lokanikāyasya hantāro yuddhadurmadāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: शिर में स्थित-इन तीन स्थानों में जो विधि है बहो उत्तम होती है
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: उदीर्णा राक्षसगणा इमे चोत्पादिताः शुभाः । आलंबेयो गणः क्रूर औत्कचेयो गणस्तथा
verses.transliteration: udīrṇā rākṣasagaṇā ime cotpāditāḥ śubhāḥ / ālaṃbeyo gaṇaḥ krūra autkaceyo gaṇastathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्रकृति में चार वर्ण हैं और प्रविचार के चार-प्रकार के हैं। आठ प्रकार से
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तथौ त्कार्ष्टेयशैवेयौ रक्षसां ह्युत्तमा गणाः । तथैव नैरृतो नाम त्र्यंबकानुचरेण ह
verses.transliteration: tathau tkārṣṭeyaśaiveyau rakṣasāṃ hyuttamā gaṇāḥ / tathaiva nairṛto nāma tryaṃbakānucareṇa ha
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: विकल्प है । इसको देव १६ प्रकार का जानते हैं।५। वर्ण प्रसंचारी सृजन किया गया है । तीसरा अवरोहण होता है । चौथा आरोहण है--इस तरह से वर्णों के ज्ञाता वर्ण को जानते हैं ।६। वहाँ पर संचर स्थायी है और संचर तो चर होगया है । जो अवरोह वर्ण हैं उनका अवरोह विनिदिष्ट करना
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: उत्पादितः प्रजाकर्गे गणेश्वरवरेण तु । विक्रान्ताः शौर्यसंपन्ना नैरृता देवराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: utpāditaḥ prajākarge gaṇeśvaravareṇa tu / vikrāntāḥ śauryasaṃpannā nairṛtā devarākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.hindi: वर्ण स्यान प्रयोग खे--कला मात्रा के प्रमाण से सस्थान-प्रमाण-और लक्षण हैं।२२। इस तरह से चार प्रकार का यह अल कारों का प्रयोजन सम- झना चाहिए । जिस प्रकार से शरीर पर विपर्यस्त अर्थात् उचित स्थान के विपरीत अल कार बिगहित हुआ करता है ।२३। यह वर्ण को अल कृत करने

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधायाः कन्यका जज्ञे द्वादशैवात्मसंभवाः । ता भार्या पुलहस्यासन्नामतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: krodhāyāḥ kanyakā jajñe dvādaśaivātmasaṃbhavāḥ / tā bhāryā pulahasyāsannāmato me nibodhata

verses.hindi: के बास्ते हैं और आत्मा में होने वाले बिषग हैं। ये नाना आभरणों के संयोग हैं जिस तरह से नारी के भूषण हुआ करते हैं ।२४। वर्ण का ही पह अल कार आत्मा की विभूषा होते हैं। अल कार का एक उचित स्थान होता है तभी बहु अल कारण किया करता है जैसे चरण में कभी कुण्डल नहीं देखा गया

verses.transliteration: mṛgī ca mṛgamandā ca haribhadrā tvirāvatī / bhūtā ca kapiśā daṃṣṭrā ṛṣā tiryā tathaiva ca

verses.hindi: है और कण्ठ में रसना नहीं दिखाई दिया करती हैं ।२५। इसी प्रकार से अल कार में भी विपरोतता बुरी होती है और उसमें शोभाधायकता नहीं हुआ करती है। किया हुआ भी अव कार कोई भो शोभा नहीं दिखाता है ।२६। जिस रीति से अहृष्ट कर्तव्य मार्ग का लक्षण किया जाता है और जो

verses.sanskrit: दशार्बुदानि कोटीनां षष्टिकोटिस्तथैव च । अर्बुदानां च लक्षं तु कोटीशतमथापरम्
verses.transliteration: daśārbudāni koṭīnāṃ ṣaṣṭikoṭistathaiva ca / arbudānāṃ ca lakṣaṃ tu koṭīśatamathāparam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: मद्रकोदक्षिणस्यापि यथोक्ता वत्त ते कला । सबंमेवानुयोगं तु द्वितीयं बुद्धिमिष्यते ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दश पद्मानि चान्यानि महापद्मानि वै नव । संख्यातानि कुलीनानां वानराणां तरस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: daśa padmāni cānyāni mahāpadmāni vai nava / saṃkhyātāni kulīnānāṃ vānarāṇāṃ tarasvinām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे तेजस्विनः शूराः कामरूपा महा बलाः । दिव्याभरणवेषाश्च ब्रह्मण्याश्चाहितग्नयः
verses.transliteration: sarve tejasvinaḥ śūrāḥ kāmarūpā mahā balāḥ / divyābharaṇaveṣāśca brahmaṇyāścāhitagnayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: यष्टारः सर्वयज्ञानां सहस्रशतदक्षिणाः । मुकुटैः कुण्डलैर्हारैः केयूरैः समलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: yaṣṭāraḥ sarvayajñānāṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇāḥ / mukuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalairhāraiḥ keyūraiḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तथा भानुसौममक में अगदर्शन है-यह कहते हैं। द्वितीय मास मात्राओं से सब प्रतिष्ठित हैं ।३६। इस प्रकार से प्रकृति से उत्तरा की भाति माता ब्रह्म तलायत है । तथा हृतारोपीडक में जहाँ पर माया निवृत्त हो जाया करती है ।३७। एक पाद से माया का पादोना में अति चारी होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वेदवेदाङ्गविद्वांसो नीतिशास्त्रविचक्षणाः । अस्त्राणां मोचने चापि तथा संहारकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: vedavedāṅgavidvāṃso nītiśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ / astrāṇāṃ mocane cāpi tathā saṃhārakarmaṇi
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सख्यापनोय हूत वितत्र पान--यह कहा गया है ।३८। और द्वितीय पाद भङ्ग ग्रह में नाम प्रतिक्षित है । पूर्वे अष्ट तीर तोन द्वितीय अपरान्तिकों से होता है (३५-३६ पदभाग सपाद तो प्रकृति में संस्थित प्राप्त होता है। चतुर्थ उत्तर इस प्रकार से पान और मद्रक को वित करता था ।४०। दक्षिण की
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यमं त्रपुरस्कारा दिव्यमन्त्रपुरस्कृताः । समर्था बलिनः शूराः सर्वशस्त्रप्रहारिणः
verses.transliteration: divyamaṃ trapuraskārā divyamantrapuraskṛtāḥ / samarthā balinaḥ śūrāḥ sarvaśastraprahāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: भी मद्रका यथोक्त कला होती है । सम्पूणं अनुयोग द्वितीय हैं जो को अभीष्ट किया करती है ।४१। और पादों का हो आहरण होता है और यहाँ पर पार नहीं होता है। है द्विजोत्तम ! दोनों का जो-जो भी है वह अनुयोग का एकत्व है ।४२। अनेकों का जो समवाय है वह पातक हरण कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यरूपधराः सौम्या जरामरणवर्जिताः । कुलानां च सहस्राणि दश तेषां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: divyarūpadharāḥ saumyā jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ / kulānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi daśa teṣāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तीनों वृत्तियों का वृत्ति में और वृत्त में दक्षिण है ।४३॥ आठ समवाय तो तथा वीरा संमूण्छ'ना होती है। कस्यना सुतरा स्वर शाखा कीत्तित की
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्षु मेरुपार्श्वेषु हेमकूटे हिमाह्वये । नीले श्वेतनगे चैव निषधे गन्धमादने
verses.transliteration: caturṣu merupārśveṣu hemakūṭe himāhvaye / nīle śvetanage caiva niṣadhe gandhamādane
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपेषु सप्तसु तथा या गुहा ते च पर्वताः । निलयास्तेषु ते प्रोक्ता विश्वकर्मकृता स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: dvīpeṣu saptasu tathā yā guhā te ca parvatāḥ / nilayāsteṣu te proktā viśvakarmakṛtā svayam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पुरैश्च विविधाकारैः प्रकारैश्च विभूषिताः । सर्वर्तुरमणीयास्ते ह्युद्यानानि च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: puraiśca vividhākāraiḥ prakāraiśca vibhūṣitāḥ / sarvarturamaṇīyāste hyudyānāni ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गृहभूमिषु शय्यासु पुष्पगन्धसुखोदिताः । आलेपनैश्च विविधैर्दिव्यभक्तिकृतैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: gṛhabhūmiṣu śayyāsu puṣpagandhasukhoditāḥ / ālepanaiśca vividhairdivyabhaktikṛtaistathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सर्वरत्नसमाकीर्णा मानसीं सिद्धिमास्थिताः । वानरा वानरीभिस्ते दिव्याभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvaratnasamākīrṇā mānasīṃ siddhimāsthitāḥ / vānarā vānarībhiste divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्तो मधु माध्वीकं सुधाभक्षानुमिश्रितम् । क्रियामयाः समुदिता दिवि देवगणा इव
verses.transliteration: pibanto madhu mādhvīkaṃ sudhābhakṣānumiśritam / kriyāmayāḥ samuditā divi devagaṇā iva
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्रलयं चेव लोकानां ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: देवगन्धर्वमुख्यानां पुत्रास्ते वै सुखे रताः । धार्मिकाश्च वरोत्सिक्ता युद्धशैण्डा महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: devagandharvamukhyānāṃ putrāste vai sukhe ratāḥ / dhārmikāśca varotsiktā yuddhaśaiṇḍā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: परम धोभान् थी सूतजी के द्वारा वणित तृतीय पाद का श्रवण करके परम श्रेष्ठ ऋषियों ने फिर उनसे चतुर्थ पाद के बिषय में पूछा था
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अक्षुद्राः सर्वसत्त्वानां देवद्विजपरायणाः । अम्लानिनः सत्यसंधा नानार्थे बहुजल्पिनः
verses.transliteration: akṣudrāḥ sarvasattvānāṃ devadvijaparāyaṇāḥ / amlāninaḥ satyasaṃdhā nānārthe bahujalpinaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कहा--हे भगवन् ! आपने हमारे समक्ष में अनुष॑ग से यह तीसरा पाद तो भली माति वर्णत करके सुना दिया है। अब आप कृपा करके चतुषं पाद का जो संहार हो उसका परिकीत्तंत कीजिए ।२। पूर्व में जो सब मन्बभ्तर हुए हैं तथा दूसरे जो भी मन्वस्तर हैं उन्हीं के साथ इन सप्तषियों
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मितभाषाः क्षमावन्तो ह्याचारपरिनिष्ठिताः । वनालङ्कारभूतो हि सृष्टा वै ब्रह्मणा स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: mitabhāṣāḥ kṣamāvanto hyācārapariniṣṭhitāḥ / vanālaṅkārabhūto hi sṛṣṭā vai brahmaṇā svayam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: का वर्णन कीजिए और वत्तंमान समय में जो भो मस्वन्तर है उसको बत- लाइए ।३। इस महान् आत्मा दाले विसग' का अवयवों के सहित विस्तार बतलाइए । ओर सभी कुछ विस्तार के साथ तया आनृपूर्वी से अर्थात् क्रमश: आरम्भ से अन्त तक हृअको बतलाइए ।४। श्री सूतजी ने कहा--मैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या निमित्तं लोकेषु रामस्यार्थे गुणाकरः । कपीनामवतारो ऽयं सर्वपापविनाशनः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā nimittaṃ lokeṣu rāmasyārthe guṇākaraḥ / kapīnāmavatāro 'yaṃ sarvapāpavināśanaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: आपके सामने अब सभी कुछ यार्था से वर्णन करूँगा । है श्रेष्ठ मुनि- गणो ! अव मैं इल चतुर्थ पाद का संहार के सहित वर्णन करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: धन्यः पुण्यो यशस्यश्च रमणीयः सुखावहः । तदेव कीर्तयिष्यामि तच्छृणुध्वमतन्द्रिताः
verses.transliteration: dhanyaḥ puṇyo yaśasyaśca ramaṇīyaḥ sukhāvahaḥ / tadeva kīrtayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇudhvamatandritāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: वर्तमान में महात्मा वेठस्वत मनु का भी जो निसय' है उसका भी वर्णन विस्तार के साथ आरम्भ से अन्त तक क्रम से करूंगा। आप लोग इस सबका श्रवण करिए ।६। है द्विजो ! सभी मन्बन्तरों का संक्षेप जो भी भविष्य में होने वाले सात मन्वन्तर हैं उनके ही साथ में वर्णन करूंगा और
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्द्ध्वदृष्टेश्च तनयो प्याघ्रो नामाभवद्भली । व्याघ्रस्य भ्रातरः पञ्च स्वसारश्च तथास्य वै
verses.transliteration: ūrddhvadṛṣṭeśca tanayo pyāghro nāmābhavadbhalī / vyāghrasya bhrātaraḥ pañca svasāraśca tathāsya vai
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: लोकों का जो प्रत्यय होगा उसको भी वतलाऊंगा । बता देने वाले मुझसे यह सभी भली भाँति समझ लीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तथा स्वानुरूपेषु वानरेषु कृतात्मसु । प्रतिपादिता स्वयं भ्रात्रा भातृदारास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tāṃstathā svānurūpeṣu vānareṣu kṛtātmasu / pratipāditā svayaṃ bhrātrā bhātṛdārāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रस्य तु सुतो जज्ञे शरभोलोकविश्रुतः । शरभस्यापि विद्धांसो भ्रातरो वीर्यसंमताः
verses.transliteration: vyāghrasya tu suto jajñe śarabholokaviśrutaḥ / śarabhasyāpi viddhāṃso bhrātaro vīryasaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
