verses.sanskrit: राजानो वानराणां च सर्वधर्मप्रतिष्ठिताः । शरभस्य सुतो धीमाञ्शुको नाम महाबलः
verses.transliteration: rājāno vānarāṇāṃ ca sarvadharmapratiṣṭhitāḥ / śarabhasya suto dhīmāñśuko nāma mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापि पुत्रो बलवान्व्यघ्री जठरसंभवः । संमतः सर्वशूराणां चक्रवर्ति दुरासदः
verses.transliteration: tasyāpi putro balavānvyaghrī jaṭharasaṃbhavaḥ / saṃmataḥ sarvaśūrāṇāṃ cakravarti durāsadaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षोनाम महातेजाः सर्ववानरयूथपः । इन्ता सदैव शत्रूणां सर्वास्त्रविधिपारगः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣonāma mahātejāḥ sarvavānarayūthapaḥ / intā sadaiva śatrūṇāṃ sarvāstravidhipāragaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ये सात मन्वन्लर तो मैने आपको बता दिये हैं ओर भली भांति कह कर सुना दिये हैं । अब प्रजा सातों में जो होगी वे अनागत मन्बन्तर जो आगे आने बाले हैं उनको सक्षेप से बतलाता हूँ । आप लोग श्रवण कीजिए ।८' अब सावणं वेवरदत मनु के विषय में बताऊभा। यह भविष्य में होने
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै तादृग्विशिष्टाय सुतां गुणगणैर्युताम् । प्रजापतिरुपादाय कन्यां हेमविभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: tasmai tādṛgviśiṣṭāya sutāṃ guṇagaṇairyutām / prajāpatirupādāya kanyāṃ hemavibhūṣitām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विरजौ विरजां तस्मै प्रत्यपादयदं जसा । पाणिं जग्राह तस्यास्तु ऋक्षो वानरयूथपः
verses.transliteration: virajau virajāṃ tasmai pratyapādayadaṃ jasā / pāṇiṃ jagrāha tasyāstu ṛkṣo vānarayūthapaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: वाला है। इसका भविष्य मैं संक्षेप से कहुँगा । आप लोग समझ लीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनीयानवद्याङ्गी सा कन्या चारुहासिनी । चकमे तां महेन्द्रस्तु दृष्ट्वा वै प्रियदर्शनाम्
verses.transliteration: darśanīyānavadyāṅgī sā kanyā cāruhāsinī / cakame tāṃ mahendrastu dṛṣṭvā vai priyadarśanām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: परम शुभ नाम ये हैं-कौशिक-गालव-जामदग्त्य-भाग'व-हँ पायन- वसि--कृप--शारद्वत--आज्रेय--दीप्तिवानू--ऋष्यश्य ग--काश्यप-भर-
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तेन तस्यां सुतो जातो वाली विक्रमपौरुषः । विरजायां महेन्द्रेण महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tena tasyāṃ suto jāto vālī vikramapauruṣaḥ / virajāyāṃ mahendreṇa mahendrasamavikramaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: परमधिगण आगे होने बाले हैं । वे सब सुन्दर तप वाले--अपरिमित आभा से सुसम्पन्न और सुखद तीस गण हैं ।६०-१२। उन देवों का गण एक-एक विशक कहा गया है। मैं अब उनके नाम बताते हुए कहूंगा । आप लोग बहुत ही सावधान होकर उनका श्रवण कीजिए और भली भाँति समझ
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तथा स्वांशो भानुना वै तस्यामेव यधाविधि । रहस्युत्पादितः पुत्रः सुग्रीवो हरियूथपः
verses.transliteration: tathā svāṃśo bhānunā vai tasyāmeva yadhāvidhi / rahasyutpāditaḥ putraḥ sugrīvo hariyūthapaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षो दृष्ट्वा तु तनयौ बलरूपश्रिया युतौ । हर्ष चक्रे सुविपुलं सर्ववानरयूथपः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣo dṛṣṭvā tu tanayau balarūpaśriyā yutau / harṣa cakre suvipulaṃ sarvavānarayūthapaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अिष्मान् द्योतनो भानुर्येशः कीत्तिबुं धो धृतिः
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽब्यषिञ्चत्सुतं ज्येष्ठं वालिनं हेममालिनम् । अभिषिक्तस्ततो वाली सुग्रीवानुगतो बली
verses.transliteration: so 'byaṣiñcatsutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ vālinaṃ hemamālinam / abhiṣiktastato vālī sugrīvānugato balī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कारयामास राज्यं च दिवि देवेश्वरो यथा । सुषेणास्य सुता चापि भार्या तस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kārayāmāsa rājyaṃ ca divi deveśvaro yathā / suṣeṇāsya sutā cāpi bhāryā tasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: देही मुनिरिनः पोष्टा समः सत्यश्च विश्रतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तारा नाम महाप्राज्ञा ताराधिपनिभानना । सुषुवे सापि तनयमङ्गदं कनकाङ्गदम्
verses.transliteration: tārā nāma mahāprājñā tārādhipanibhānanā / suṣuve sāpi tanayamaṅgadaṃ kanakāṅgadam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गदस्यापि तनयो जातो भीमपरा क्रमः । मैन्दस्य च्येष्ठकन्यायां ध्रुवो नाम महायशाः
verses.transliteration: aṅgadasyāpi tanayo jāto bhīmaparā kramaḥ / maindasya cyeṣṭhakanyāyāṃ dhruvo nāma mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सुग्रीवस्य रुमा भार्या पनसस्य सुता शुभा । तस्यापि च सुता जातास्त्रयः परमकीर्त्तयः
verses.transliteration: sugrīvasya rumā bhāryā panasasya sutā śubhā / tasyāpi ca sutā jātāstrayaḥ paramakīrttayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तेषां दारांस्तथासाद्य सुस्वरूपान्बली ततः । वालिनः पार्श्वतो ऽतिष्ठत्सुग्रीवः सह वानरैः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ dārāṃstathāsādya susvarūpānbalī tataḥ / vālinaḥ pārśvato 'tiṣṭhatsugrīvaḥ saha vānaraiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अधिष्मान-चोतन-भावु-यश कोत्ति-बुध-भृति-।१४ ये सुन्दर तपों बाले हैं । इनकी विशति है जो नाम बताकर कीत्तित कर दिये गये हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बहून्वर्षगणानग्रो भ्रात्रा सह यथामरः । केसरी कुञ्जरस्याथ सुतां भार्यामविन्दत
verses.transliteration: bahūnvarṣagaṇānagro bhrātrā saha yathāmaraḥ / kesarī kuñjarasyātha sutāṃ bhāryāmavindata
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: महान् मह॒ समाख्यात हुआ है । देही-मुनि-इन-पोष्टा-सम-सत्य-विश्रुत
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जना नाम सुभागा गत्वा पुंसवने शुचिः । पर्युपास्ते च तां वायुर्यौंवनादेव गर्विताम्
verses.transliteration: añjanā nāma subhāgā gatvā puṃsavane śuciḥ / paryupāste ca tāṃ vāyuryauṃvanādeva garvitām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ये सब अमित आभा से सम्पन्न ये । इनकी भी बिशति कही गयी है अर्थात् इन बोसों का समुदाय बताया गया है। अब अन्य विशति भो वतायी जातीं है--दम-दानो-ऋत-सोम-वेद्यायम-नि धि-होम-हव्य-हुत-दान-देय-दाता-तप- शम-प्रू व-स्थान-विधान और नियम-ये विशति होती हैं ।१०-१९। ये सब
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां जातस्तु हनुमान्वायुना जगदायुना । ये ह्यन्ये केसरिसुता विख्याता दिवि चेह वै
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ jātastu hanumānvāyunā jagadāyunā / ye hyanye kesarisutā vikhyātā divi ceha vai
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सावप्यं मस्वन्तर में सुख बताये गये हैँ । वे सब मारीच काश्यप के ही पुत्र हं जो महान् आत्मा वाले ये ।२०! इसके अन्तर में वत्त मान् काल के साठ देवता होगे । सावर्णा मनु के पुत्र तो नौ ही होगे
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठस्तु हनुमांस्तेषां मतिमांस्तु ततः स्मृतः । श्रुतिमान्केतुमांश्चैव मतिमान्धृतिमानपि
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhastu hanumāṃsteṣāṃ matimāṃstu tataḥ smṛtaḥ / śrutimānketumāṃścaiva matimāndhṛtimānapi
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: हनुमद्भ्रातरो ये वै ते दारैः सुप्रतिष्ठताः । स्वानरूपैः सुताः पित्रा पुत्रपौत्रसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: hanumadbhrātaro ye vai te dāraiḥ supratiṣṭhatāḥ / svānarūpaiḥ sutāḥ pitrā putrapautrasamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी च हनुमान्नासौदारैश्च योजितः । सर्वलोकानपि रणे यो योद्धुं च समुत्सहेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī ca hanumānnāsaudāraiśca yojitaḥ / sarvalokānapi raṇe yo yoddhuṃ ca samutsahet
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: जवे जवे च वितते वैनतेय इवापरः । अग्निपुत्रश्च बलवान्नलः परमदुर्ज्जयः
verses.transliteration: jave jave ca vitate vainateya ivāparaḥ / agniputraśca balavānnalaḥ paramadurjjayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रे कनकबिन्दोस्तु जातो वानरपुङ्गवः । तथात्वन्ये महाभागा बलवन्तश्च वानराः
verses.transliteration: kṣetre kanakabindostu jāto vānarapuṅgavaḥ / tathātvanye mahābhāgā balavantaśca vānarāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सप्रधानास्तु विज्ञेया हरियूथप यूथपाः । तारश्च कुसुमश्चैव पनसो गन्धमादनः
verses.transliteration: sapradhānāstu vijñeyā hariyūthapa yūthapāḥ / tāraśca kusumaścaiva panaso gandhamādanaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: विरजा-चावंरीवान् तथा दूसरे निर्मोक आद्य अन्य सावणं अन्तरों में नौ बतलाऊंगा ।२२। अन्य सावण मनु ब्रह्माजी के पुत्र होने वाले हैं। वे मेर सावणि से लेकर चार दिव्य इष्टि बाले हैं ।२३। वे सब प्रजापति दक्ष के दोहि हैं और क्रिया नाम वाली उसकी दुहिता के पुत्र हैं। ये सब महान्
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: रूपश्रीर्विभवश्चैव गवयो विकटः सरः । सुषेणः सुधनुश्चैव सुबन्धुः शतदुन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: rūpaśrīrvibhavaścaiva gavayo vikaṭaḥ saraḥ / suṣeṇaḥ sudhanuścaiva subandhuḥ śatadundubhiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तप से युक्त ये ।२४। वे सब ब्रह्मादि के द्वारा तथा धीमान् दक्ष के द्वारा जनित हुए हैं। महलोक को गये ये और वृत्त भविष्य मेरु पर्वत पर समा- श्रित थे ।२४। वे महानुभाव पूर्व में समुत्पन्न हुए ये । जिस समय में चाक्षुष
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विकचः कपिलो रौद्रः परियात्रः प्रभञ्जनः । कुञ्जरः शरभो दंष्ट्री कालमूर्तिर्महासुखः
verses.transliteration: vikacaḥ kapilo raudraḥ pariyātraḥ prabhañjanaḥ / kuñjaraḥ śarabho daṃṣṭrī kālamūrtirmahāsukhaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नन्दः कन्दरसेनश्च नलो वारुणिरेव च । चिरवः करवस्ताम्रश्चित्रयोधी रथीतरः
verses.transliteration: nandaḥ kandarasenaśca nalo vāruṇireva ca / ciravaḥ karavastāmraścitrayodhī rathītaraḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: मस्वस्तर या । वे सब मनु भविष्य अनागत अस्तर में संमृत्पस्न हुए ये
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: भीमः शतबलिश्चैव कालचक्रो ऽनलो नलः । यक्षास्यो गहनश्चैव धूम्रः पञ्चरथस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhīmaḥ śatabaliścaiva kālacakro 'nalo nalaḥ / yakṣāsyo gahanaścaiva dhūmraḥ pañcarathastathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: जो मनुगण घावेतस दक्ष के दोहि थे । वे नाम से पाँच तो सावण बे ओर चार परमधि से समुत्पन्न हुए थे ।२७। संज्ञा का पुत्र एक सावणि तथा वेव- स्वत था । सबसे बड़ा संज्ञा का पुर प्रभु वैवस्वत मनु पा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पारिजातो महादीप्तः सुतपा बलसागरः । श्रुतायुर्विजयाकाङ्क्षी गुरुसेवी यथार् थकः
verses.transliteration: pārijāto mahādīptaḥ sutapā balasāgaraḥ / śrutāyurvijayākāṅkṣī gurusevī yathār thakaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: चतुर्हैशेते मनवः कीर्तिता: कोतितद्ध वेदे स्मृतौ पुराणे च सर्वे ते प्रभविष्णवः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: धर्मचेतास्सुहोत्रश्च शालिहोत्रो ऽथ सर्पगः । पुण्ड्रश्चावरगात्रश्च चारुरूपश्च शतुजित्
verses.transliteration: dharmacetāssuhotraśca śālihotro 'tha sarpagaḥ / puṇḍraścāvaragātraśca cārurūpaśca śatujit
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: मन्वंतराधिकारेषु वत्तर्नेषव सकृत्यकृत । विनित्ृत्ताधिका रास्ते महर्लोक समाश्चिता:
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विकटः कवटो मैन्दो बिन्दुकारो ऽसुरान्तकः । मन्त्री भीमरथः संगो विभ्रान्तश्चारुहासवान्
verses.transliteration: vikaṭaḥ kavaṭo maindo bindukāro 'surāntakaḥ / mantrī bhīmarathaḥ saṃgo vibhrāntaścāruhāsavān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ये शिष्टास्तान््रवक्ष्यामि सह देवधिदानरवैः । सह प्रजानिसर्गेण सर्वांस्तेऽनागतान्ट्रिजः
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: क्षणक्षणामताहारी दृढभक्तिः प्रमर्दनः । जाजलिः पञ्चमुकुटो बलबन्धुः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇakṣaṇāmatāhārī dṛḍhabhaktiḥ pramardanaḥ / jājaliḥ pañcamukuṭo balabandhuḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: बेवस्वत मनु के अन्तर प्राप्त हो जाने पर उन दोनों को समुत्पत्ति परम शुम हुई यो । हमने ये चौदह मनुओं का वर्णन कर दिया है जोकि परमाधिक कीति का वर्धन करने बाले हुए हैं ।२8। वेद में-- स्मृति में और पुराण में वे सभी बहुत ही होनद्वार बताय गये हैं । ये सभी प्रजाओं के तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पयः कीर्त्तिः शुभः क्षेत्रो बिन्दुकेतुः सहस्रपात् । नवाक्षे हरिनेत्रश्च जीमूतो ऽथ बलाहकः
verses.transliteration: payaḥ kīrttiḥ śubhaḥ kṣetro binduketuḥ sahasrapāt / navākṣe harinetraśca jīmūto 'tha balāhakaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्राणियों के स्वामी हुए है ।३०। उन्हीं नरेश्बरो के द्वारा पूरे सहस्र युगो तक यह सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वी सा!तों द्वोपों से समन्वित ओर बड़े-बड़े बिशाल गरों से युक्त परिपालन करने के योग्य है ।३६। प्रजाओं के द्वारा तथा तप से जो उनका बिस्तार है बहू सब भो बताया जा रहा है । ये चोदह सर्ग स्वायम्भुव
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गजो गवयनामा च सुबाहुश्च गुणाकरः । वीरबाहुः कृती कुण्डो कृतकृत्यः शुभेक्षणः
verses.transliteration: gajo gavayanāmā ca subāhuśca guṇākaraḥ / vīrabāhuḥ kṛtī kuṇḍo kṛtakṛtyaḥ śubhekṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: आदि के हैं सभा जान लेने के यास्य हैं (३२ यह्वा पर मख्बन्तरों के अधि- कारों मैं एक-एक बार यह होता ह । जब अधिकार विनिवृत्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: द्विविदः कुमुदो भासः सुमुखः सुरुवुर्वृकः । विकटः कवकश्चैव जवसेनो वृषाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: dvividaḥ kumudo bhāsaḥ sumukhaḥ suruvurvṛkaḥ / vikaṭaḥ kavakaścaiva javaseno vṛṣākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तो वे सब जाकर महर्लोक में समाश्रय वाले हो जाते हैं ।३३। उनमें जो आट थे बे व्यतीत हो चुके ये और छं दूसरे ये । पूर्व में होने बालों में यह वत्त मान में होने बाला यह वैवस्वत प्रभु शासन कर रहे हैं ।३४। जो भी शिष्ट रहे हैं उनको देव-ऋषि और दानवों के ही साथ अब बतलाऊँगा । हे
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गवाक्षो नरदेवश्च सुकेतुर्विमलाननः । सहस्वारः शुभक्षेत्रः पुष्पध्वंसो विलोहितः
verses.transliteration: gavākṣo naradevaśca suketurvimalānanaḥ / sahasvāraḥ śubhakṣetraḥ puṣpadhvaṃso vilohitaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हिज ! सम्पूर्ण प्रजा की सृष्टि के साथ ही उन सभी अनायतों को बतलाया जायगा अर्थात् आगे होने वाले हैं उनको कहेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नवचन्द्रो बहुगुणः सप्तहोत्रो मरीचिमान् । गोधामा च धनेशश्च गोलाङ्गूलश्च नेत्रवान्
verses.transliteration: navacandro bahuguṇaḥ saptahotro marīcimān / godhāmā ca dhaneśaśca golāṅgūlaśca netravān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: दक्षस्य कन्या धर्मिष्ठा सुब्रता नाम विश्रुता ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते हरयः क्रान्ताः प्राधान्येन यथार्थतः । बहुत्वान्नामधेयानां न शक्यमभिवर्णितुम्
verses.transliteration: ityete harayaḥ krāntāḥ prādhānyena yathārthataḥ / bahutvānnāmadheyānāṃ na śakyamabhivarṇitum
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: गृहोत्वा ता पिता कन्यां जगाम ब्रह्मणोंःतिके ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नागकोटीदशबले एकैकस्य प्रतिष्ठितम् । सर्ववानरसैन्यस्य सप्तद्वीपस्थितस्य तु
verses.transliteration: nāgakoṭīdaśabale ekaikasya pratiṣṭhitam / sarvavānarasainyasya saptadvīpasthitasya tu
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: किष्किन्धामाश्रितो वाली राजासीच्छत्रुतापनः । रणे निगूङ्य वामेन भुजेन स महाबलः
verses.transliteration: kiṣkindhāmāśrito vālī rājāsīcchatrutāpanaḥ / raṇe nigūṅya vāmena bhujena sa mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणो वचनं शरुत्वा दक्षो धर्मो भवस्तदा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विष्टभ्य पार्श्वेसंस्थाप्य रावणन्ध्यानमस्थितः । मौहूर्तिकीं गतिं गत्वा चतुः परशर्वानुपस्पृशन्
verses.transliteration: viṣṭabhya pārśvesaṃsthāpya rāvaṇandhyānamasthitaḥ / mauhūrtikīṃ gatiṃ gatvā catuḥ paraśarvānupaspṛśan
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: बेबस्वत मनु के विसग से उनका भी विस्तार जान लेना चाहिए । कारण यह है कि वे सव बँवस्बत मनुदेन तो अन्यून हैं और न उससे अति- रिक्त ही हैं ।३६। बे बहुत हैं इसलिए और उतका दूसरी बार कथन होने से उनके विषम में बिस्तार नहीं कहुँगा । जो भी पहिले हो गये हैं तथा जो
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रं दक्षणं पूर्वपश्चिमं च तथोत्तरम् । मनोवायुगतिर्भूत्वा वाली व्यपगतक्रमः
verses.transliteration: samudraṃ dakṣaṇaṃ pūrvapaścimaṃ ca tathottaram / manovāyugatirbhūtvā vālī vyapagatakramaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: भविष्य में होने बाले हैं उन सनी के विषय में अधिक विस्तार नहीं कहा जायगा ।३७। इस कारण से कुल-कुल में विभाग से हो निसग समझ लेने चाहिए । उन्हीं की सिद्धि के लिए विस्तार से और क्रम से कहता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: स निर्जित्य महावीर्यो रावणं लोकरावणम् । वाली बाहुविनिर्मुक्तं विह्वलं नष्टचेतसम्
verses.transliteration: sa nirjitya mahāvīryo rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam / vālī bāhuvinirmuktaṃ vihvalaṃ naṣṭacetasam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्रजापति दक्ष की कन्या बड़ी ही घस्मिक्ष थो तया उसका नाम सुद्रता
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षमूलप्रदेशे च स्थापयित्वा बलोत्कटः । सिच्यांभसा सुशीतेन ह्यापादतलमस्तकात्
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣamūlapradeśe ca sthāpayitvā balotkaṭaḥ / sicyāṃbhasā suśītena hyāpādatalamastakāt
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: स च तं लब्धसंज्ञं च कृत्वा विस्मयमास्थितः । उवाच रणचण्डं तं राक्षसेंद्रं कपीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa ca taṃ labdhasaṃjñaṃ ca kṛtvā vismayamāsthitaḥ / uvāca raṇacaṇḍaṃ taṃ rākṣaseṃdraṃ kapīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्रसिद्ध या । समस्त कन्याओं में बहुत श्रेष्ठ ज्वेष्ठा थी जो वैरिणी का सुता दो ।३६। पिता उस कन्या को लेकर ब्रह्माजी के समीप में गया या । ब्रह्मा- जी बंराज मे समत्रस्थित थे और धमं तथा मन के द्वारा उपासीन थे
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: भो भो राक्षसाजेन्द्र महेन्द्रसमविक्रम । असंख्येयं बलं जित्वा यमं ससचिवं रणे
verses.transliteration: bho bho rākṣasājendra mahendrasamavikrama / asaṃkhyeyaṃ balaṃ jitvā yamaṃ sasacivaṃ raṇe
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: जब दक्ष भव और धर्म के समीप में स्थित थे तव उनसे ब्रह्माजी ने कहा था--हे दक्ष ! आपकी यह सुब्रत कम्य चार मनुओं को जन्म देगी जो इसके पुत्र चारों वर्णो के करने वाले परम शुभ होंगे । ब्रह्माजी के इस वचन को सुनकर दक्ष-धरर्म ओर भव उस समय मे यह किया था
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वरुणं च कुबेरं च शशिनं भास्करं तथा । मरुद्गणं तथा रुद्रानादित्यानश्विनौ वसून्
verses.transliteration: varuṇaṃ ca kuberaṃ ca śaśinaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathā / marudgaṇaṃ tathā rudrānādityānaśvinau vasūn
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तां कन्यां मनस! जग्मुस्त्रयस्ते ब्रह्मणा सह् ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दैतेयान्कालकेयांश्च दानवान्सुमहाबलान् । सिद्धांस्तथैव गन्धर्वान्यक्षरक्षोभुजङ्गमान्
verses.transliteration: daiteyānkālakeyāṃśca dānavānsumahābalān / siddhāṃstathaiva gandharvānyakṣarakṣobhujaṅgamān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिणां प्रवरांश्चैव ग्रहनक्षत्रतारकाः । तथा भूतपिशाचांश्च विवृद्धबलदर्पितान्
verses.transliteration: pakṣiṇāṃ pravarāṃścaiva grahanakṣatratārakāḥ / tathā bhūtapiśācāṃśca vivṛddhabaladarpitān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मानुषाणां नृपांश्चैव शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । कथमीदृग्गुणो भूत्वा मनोवायुसमो जवे
verses.transliteration: mānuṣāṇāṃ nṛpāṃścaiva śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / kathamīdṛgguṇo bhūtvā manovāyusamo jave
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शक्तो ऽसि चालनि मेरोः कृतान्त इव दुर्जयः । विद्राव्य सर्व्ॐल्लोकेषु वीरान्परपुरञ्ज्यः
verses.transliteration: śakto 'si cālani meroḥ kṛtānta iva durjayaḥ / vidrāvya sarvoṃllokeṣu vīrānparapurañjyaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: उस समय ब्रह्माजो के साथ ही मन से उन तीनों ने उस कन्या को गमन किया था । सत्याभि श्रायो उनकी कन्या के तुरन्त ही समुत्पन्न किया चा । अर्थात् रूप से उन्हीं के सहश चार कुमारों को जन्म दिया था वे कार्यों के करने में संसिद्ध थे तथा श्रो ते समन्वित हुए थे ।४४। उनके तुरन्त
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बलैरशनिकल्पैश्च समीकृत्य च पर्वतान् । विक्षोभ्य सागरान्सप्त सप्तकृत्वो महारथः
verses.transliteration: balairaśanikalpaiśca samīkṛtya ca parvatān / vikṣobhya sāgarānsapta saptakṛtvo mahārathaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ही समुत्पन्न शरीर सभी उपभोगों के लिए समयं थे। स्वयं ही समुत्पन्न उन कुमारों शे देखकर वे जो उस समय ब्रह्म के ब्यापारी थे आपस में बहुत ही संरम्भ वाले होकर खो चातानी करने लगे कि यह मेरा पुत्र है--
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: निर्विकारो जयप्रेप्सुः स्मयमानो बलाद्बली । दुर्बलेन मया क्रान्तो वानरेण विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: nirvikāro jayaprepsuḥ smayamāno balādbalī / durbalena mayā krānto vānareṇa viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: यह मेरा पुत्र है--ऐसा ही कह रहे थे । फिर उन्होंने आपस में कहा था कि ये अभिध्यान से आत्मा से ही समुत्पन्न हैं ।०१-४६। अतएव जो भी जिसके शरीर के तुल्य हो वह उसी को अपना सुत मान लेवे । जो भी जिसके रूप- बीयें ओर मात में सह होवे अथवा वर्ण से जो जिसके समान हो उसी को
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थमीदृशं शप्तो बलवानपि दुर्जयः । प्रब्रूहि हेतुना केन ब्रह्मन्राक्षसपुङ्गव
verses.transliteration: kimarthamīdṛśaṃ śapto balavānapi durjayaḥ / prabrūhi hetunā kena brahmanrākṣasapuṅgava
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: बह ग्रहण कर लेवे-इसो में आप का कल्याण टै। यह तो निश्चित ही है कि पुत्र पिता के रूप को सर्वदा ग्रहण किया करता है ।४७-४८। इसलिए पिता और माता के वीयं से पुत्र सदा आत्मा के ही समान हुआ करता है। उस प्रकार से उन्होंने समझोता करके सब सुतों का ग्रहण किया था
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अभयं ते मया दत्तं विश्वस्तो भव ते न भीः । वयनं वालिनः श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: abhayaṃ te mayā dattaṃ viśvasto bhava te na bhīḥ / vayanaṃ vālinaḥ śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भयसंविग्नः सांत्वपूर्वमिदं वचः । असंशयं जिताः सर्वे मया देवासुरा रणे
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhayasaṃvignaḥ sāṃtvapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ / asaṃśayaṃ jitāḥ sarve mayā devāsurā raṇe
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एवं विधस्तु बलवान्न मयासादितः क्वचित् । तदिच्छामि त्वया सार्द्धं सौहृदं भयवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vidhastu balavānna mayāsāditaḥ kvacit / tadicchāmi tvayā sārddhaṃ sauhṛdaṃ bhayavarjitam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मत्तो भवेन्न ते वीर कदाचिद्वै रणाजिरम् । एवमुक्तो ऽब्रवीद्वाली भवत्येतद्वचस्तव
verses.transliteration: matto bhavenna te vīra kadācidvai raṇājiram / evamukto 'bravīdvālī bhavatyetadvacastava
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: चाक्षुष मन्वन्तर के ब्यतोत हो जाने पर और वैवस्त मन्वन्तर के सम्प्राप्त होने पर प्रजापति का रुचि से एक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ था जिसका नाम रौच्य हुआ था ।५०। जो भूति के गर्भ से उत्पन्न किया गया था उस पुत्र का नाम भौत्य हुआ था और यंह कवि का पुत्र था । वेवस्वत मन्वन्तर
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: समये स्थापयित्वा तु रावणो वालिनं पुरा । जगाम लङ्कां सगणः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: samaye sthāpayitvā tu rāvaṇo vālinaṃ purā / jagāma laṅkāṃ sagaṇaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वाली विजित्य बलवान् पुष्करे राक्षसेश्वरम् । आजहार बहून्यज्ञानन्नपानसमावृतान्
verses.transliteration: vālī vijitya balavān puṣkare rākṣaseśvaram / ājahāra bahūnyajñānannapānasamāvṛtān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: में विवस्वत के दो मनु उत्पन्न हुए थे ।११। और जो वैवस्वत मन था और जो सादणे नाम मे विश्रुत या । प्रभु वेवस्वत मनु संज्ञा का ही पुत्र जानना चाहिए । यह पर विद्वान् थे !५२। सवर्णा का अन्य सुत था वैवस्वत मनु कहा गया है । और जो सावणं मनु हैं वे चार महूषियों से जन्म ग्रहण बाले
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणाभिः प्रवृद्धाभिः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । अग्निष्टोमाश्वमेधांश्च राजसूयान्नृमेधकान्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇābhiḥ pravṛddhābhiḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / agniṣṭomāśvamedhāṃśca rājasūyānnṛmedhakān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हैं ।५३। वे निश्चित रूप से तपश्चर्या से सम्भृत आत्माओं बाले हुए थे ओर अपने मम्वन्तरों में हो हुए थो । आगे होने वालों में सभी कार्यो' के अर्थो' का साधन करने वाले होगे ।५४। प्रथम मेरु सावण में दक्ष प्रजापति के पुत्र मनु के मरा मरीचि गभे और सुधर्माण ये तीन घे । वे सब महान आत्माओं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमेधानपि बहून्सर्वदानसमन्वितान् । तर्पयित्वाथ देवांश्च देवेन्द्रंबहुभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvamedhānapi bahūnsarvadānasamanvitān / tarpayitvātha devāṃśca devendraṃbahubhistathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: बाले बेबरबत मन्वन्तर में समुत्पन्न हुए रो ।५५। बे दक्ष के पुन्न प्रजापति रोहित के पुत्र ये । जो आगे होने बाले हैं वे होंगे। एक-एक द्वादश गण हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं तेषयित्वा च हुत्वाग्रिं बहुवार्षिकम् । सुग्रीवेण सह भ्रात्रा सुखी भूत्वा यवीयसा
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ teṣayitvā ca hutvāgriṃ bahuvārṣikam / sugrīveṇa saha bhrātrā sukhī bhūtvā yavīyasā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं च पालयित्वा स कपीनामकुतोभयः । ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मपरमो धर्मसेतुः क्रियापरः
verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ ca pālayitvā sa kapīnāmakutobhayaḥ / brahmaṇyo brahmaparamo dharmasetuḥ kriyāparaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बहून्वर्षगणान्रेमे सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः । यस्य देवमुनिर्गाथां जगौ यज्ञेषु नारदः
verses.transliteration: bahūnvarṣagaṇānreme sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ / yasya devamunirgāthāṃ jagau yajñeṣu nāradaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: न यज्ञहवने दानेजवेनापि पराक्रमे । तुल्यो ऽस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु वालिनोहेममालिनः
verses.transliteration: na yajñahavane dānejavenāpi parākrame / tulyo 'sti triṣu lokeṣu vālinohemamālinaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शांशपायन उवाच अहो महाप्रभा वस्तु महेन्द्रतनयो बली । वाली यज्ञसहस्राणां यज्वा परमदुर्जयः
verses.transliteration: śāṃśapāyana uvāca aho mahāprabhā vastu mahendratanayo balī / vālī yajñasahasrāṇāṃ yajvā paramadurjayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: चक्रवर्त्ती महाप्राज्ञे वाली च कथितस्त्वया । मार्त डस्य तु नो ब्रूहि कथं मार्त्तण्डता स्मृता । निरुक्तमस्य तु विभो याथातथ्येन सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: cakravarttī mahāprājñe vālī ca kathitastvayā / mārta ḍasya tu no brūhi kathaṃ mārttaṇḍatā smṛtā / niruktamasya tu vibho yāthātathyena suvrata
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: मेधांतिथिश्च पौलस्त्यो बसु. काश्यप एव च
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच सृत्यमानेषु भूतेषु प्रजापतिरथ स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca sṛtyamāneṣu bhūteṣu prajāpatiratha svayam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ऐश्‍वर-ब्रह-राहु-वाकु-बंश- ये पारा बारह हैं जो जान सेने चाहिए ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्याद्यत्परं तेजस्तदाहृत्यादितेर्त्दृदि । प्रवेशायामास तदा योगेन महता वृताः
verses.transliteration: trailokyādyatparaṃ tejastadāhṛtyāditertdṛdi / praveśāyāmāsa tadā yogena mahatā vṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अब उत्तर जो है उनको भी जान लो ॥५७। वाजिप-्वाजिजितु-प्रभूति- ककुदी-दघिक्रावा-प्रगीत-विजय-मधुन्डतव्छ-उत्तमक ये दो हैं-ये द्वादश
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमण्डं तु भगवानस्याश्चक्रे तथोदरे । तत्रावर्त्तत गर्भो वै अण्डस्याभ्यन्तरे बली
verses.transliteration: pūrvamaṇḍaṃ tu bhagavānasyāścakre tathodare / tatrāvarttata garbho vai aṇḍasyābhyantare balī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: मरीचि हैं । युधर्माण को बतलाऊ गा । उनको नाम से समझ लो
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वर्द्धमानो ऽतिमात्रं वै देवा निस्तेजसो ऽभवन् । सर्वतो निर्मितं ज्ञात्वा गर्भं ते त्दृततेजसः
verses.transliteration: varddhamāno 'timātraṃ vai devā nistejaso 'bhavan / sarvato nirmitaṃ jñātvā garbhaṃ te tdṛtatejasaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: वर्णे अथगर्ती-भुरण्य-ब्र ज उ -अभित-दरवकेतु-जम्भ-आज-णक्रक-सुनेमि-द्य तय-- ये सत्र सुधर्माण कोत्तित किये गये हैं । उस समय में उनका जो होने वाला इन्द है उसका नाम अद्भूत है ।६-६१। स्करद-पाबंतीय-कात्तिकेय-पावकि- मेश्वातिबि-पोलस्ट्य बसु-काश्य' योतिष्यान्-भागेव-च्तिमान्-अङ्गिरा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुः प्रजापतिं भीता कथं नो भविता त्विदम् । बलं तेजो ऽस्य भविता निर्मितस्याधिकं विभो
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ prajāpatiṃ bhītā kathaṃ no bhavitā tvidam / balaṃ tejo 'sya bhavitā nirmitasyādhikaṃ vibho
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नुनं कथं भविष्यामो नूनं नष्टा हि शाश्वत । सर्वभूतानि यानीह स्यावराणि चरणि च
verses.transliteration: nunaṃ kathaṃ bhaviṣyāmo nūnaṃ naṣṭā hi śāśvata / sarvabhūtāni yānīha syāvarāṇi caraṇi ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: पृथुश्रवास्तथाऽनीको भूरिद्यम्नो दृहणः । प्रथमस्य तु सावणेनंब पुत्रा: प्रकीतिता:
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तानि दग्धानि न चिराद्भविष्यन्ति न संशयः । यदेडे स्थापितं तेजो बलं च द्विजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tāni dagdhāni na cirādbhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ / yadeḍe sthāpitaṃ tejo balaṃ ca dvijasattama
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्राणानां यच्छतं प्रोक्तः ऋषिभिः पुरुषेति वे । देवास्ते वै भविष्यन्ति धर्मपुत्रस्य वें मनोः
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तत्संहर विचिन्त्येह यन्नः श्रेय स्करं भवेत् । श्रुतितेजः प्रभावश्च धक्षते सर्वत्ॐऽजसा
verses.transliteration: tatsaṃhara vicintyeha yannaḥ śreya skaraṃ bhavet / śrutitejaḥ prabhāvaśca dhakṣate sarvatoṃ'jasā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: स चिन्तयित्वा भगवान्प्रजापतिरथाक्षिपत् । बलं चाण्डे चकाराथ ततस्त्वण्डान्तरे शिशुः
verses.transliteration: sa cintayitvā bhagavānprajāpatirathākṣipat / balaṃ cāṇḍe cakārātha tatastvaṇḍāntare śiśuḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: यदण्डं तद्बलं प्राहुर्यत्तेजः स शिशुर्मतः । तत्तूदराद्विनिष्क्रान्तं मृतपिण्डोपमं स तु
verses.transliteration: yadaṇḍaṃ tadbalaṃ prāhuryattejaḥ sa śiśurmataḥ / tattūdarādviniṣkrāntaṃ mṛtapiṇḍopamaṃ sa tu
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: नुसपा-पोलह- ये सात रोहितेतर हैं । धृतिकेतु-दीप्तिकेतु-शाव-हस्त निरामय ।६४। पृदृधवा-अनीक-भूरिच स्त-बृहयम--ये प्रथम सावणि के नौ पुत्र बताये गये हैं ।६४। इसके अनन्तर दषम पर्याय में धर्म के पुत्र द्वितीय साबण मनु के जो आगे होने वाला है उस मनु के अन्तर मैं ।६४। सुधामान
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिस् ततो दृष्ट्वा तदण्डं वै द्विधाकरोत् । शकले द्वे समास्थाय स एकस्मिन्नपश्यत
verses.transliteration: prajāpatis tato dṛṣṭvā tadaṇḍaṃ vai dvidhākarot / śakale dve samāsthāya sa ekasminnapaśyata
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: और विरुद्ध--ये दो ही गण कहे गये हैं । वे सभी दीप्तिमान् थे और वे सम शत संख्या वाले ये ।६७। ऋषियों ने प्राणों के शत को पुरुष -यह कहा है । वे धर्म के पुत्र मनु के देवगण होगे ॥६८! उनका इन्द्र भविष्य विद्वान् हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गर्भं दुर्बलभावेन युक्तं तेजोमयं सकृत् । तत्समुद्यम्य चोत्थायादिन्युत्संगे निवेद्य च
verses.transliteration: garbhaṃ durbalabhāvena yuktaṃ tejomayaṃ sakṛt / tatsamudyamya cotthāyādinyutsaṃge nivedya ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: उवाचादित्यभावच्च यस्मादण्डेन वै स्मृतः । तेन मार्त्तण्ड इति वै कथ्यते सविता बुधैः
verses.transliteration: uvācādityabhāvacca yasmādaṇḍena vai smṛtaḥ / tena mārttaṇḍa iti vai kathyate savitā budhaiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: शास्ति नाम वाला कहा जाता है । हृविष्मान्-पोलह-श्रीमाचु-सुकोति-भागंव- आयोमूत्ति-आत्रेय-वसिष्ठ-अपव-पीलस्त्य-अप्रति म-गाभाग-काश्यप
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तेजश्चैवाधिकं तस्मै निर्ममे प्रपितामहः । ये ते अण्डकपाले द्वे तद्बलं परमं मतम्
verses.transliteration: tejaścaivādhikaṃ tasmai nirmame prapitāmahaḥ / ye te aṇḍakapāle dve tadbalaṃ paramaṃ matam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.transliteration: airāvaṇo 'tha kumudau hyañjano vāmanastathā / uttaratra ca vo bhūyasteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi vistaram

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽयं प्रधानो लोके ऽस्मिन्नधिकेनामितौजसा । भगवान्सविता साक्षात्प्रभासयति रश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: yo 'yaṃ pradhāno loke 'sminnadhikenāmitaujasā / bhagavānsavitā sākṣātprabhāsayati raśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: निरालोकं जगदिदं लोकालोकान्तरं द्विजाः । बाह्यं तमोवृतं सर्वं तत्प्रमाणमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: nirālokaṃ jagadidaṃ lokālokāntaraṃ dvijāḥ / bāhyaṃ tamovṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tatpramāṇamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्तं मया सर्वं यथावद्द्विजसत्तमाः । श्रुतं भगवतो व्यासात्पाराशर्यान्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: etaduktaṃ mayā sarvaṃ yathāvaddvijasattamāḥ / śrutaṃ bhagavato vyāsātpārāśaryānmahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: एते हि ब्रह्मण पुत्रा मविष्या मानवाः स्मृताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारेण पुरा प्रोक्तं वै वायुना पुरा । विमृश्य बहुधा तत्तु पुनरन्यैः पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāreṇa purā proktaṃ vai vāyunā purā / vimṛśya bahudhā tattu punaranyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अभिमन्यु--आज़िरस--गे सात परम ऋषि अर्थात् सर्वोत्तम सात ऋषि हैं। सुक्षेत-उत्तमौजा-भूरिसेन-वीर्यवान् --शतानीक-निरामित्र- दृषसेन-जयद्रथ-भूरिसेन-सुवर्चा--ये दण मानव कहे गये हैं ।७१-७२। एका- दश पर्याय में तीसरे सावर्ण में निर्माण रति बाले देवगण हैं जो स्वेच्छा से
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पुराणामृतकं श्रुत्वा पुण्यं सर्वार्थसाधकम् । अभयो विचरत्येव जात्यन्तरशतं गतः
verses.transliteration: purāṇāmṛtakaṃ śrutvā puṇyaṃ sarvārthasādhakam / abhayo vicaratyeva jātyantaraśataṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: गमन करने बाले हैं और मन के ही तुल्य बेग से समन्वित है।७३। महान् आत्माओं बाले देवताओं वाले देवताओं के ये तीन गण विख्यात हैं। उन स्वगंवासियों एक-एक तीन सो गण हैं।७४ एक मास के तीस होते हैं जिनको कविगण जानते हैं। निर्याण (मोक्ष) में रति अर्यात् अनुराग रखने
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मार्तण्डजननं ह्येतद्गेहे यस्य व्यवस्थितम् । कथ्यते वा कथा यस्य न तं विद्धि समानकम्
verses.transliteration: mārtaṇḍajananaṃ hyetadgehe yasya vyavasthitam / kathyate vā kathā yasya na taṃ viddhi samānakam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: बाले हैं और रातिर्या तो विहङ्गम (पक्षो) हैं।७५। तीसरा गण जो कहा गया है बह देवताओं का होगा । मन के वेग ओर मुहू ये देव कीतित किये गये हैं ।७६। ये सब वह्याजी के पुत्र होते वाले हैँ जो कि मानव कहे गये हैं। फिर उनका इन्द्र वृषा नाम वाला सुरराट् होने वाला है
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: न चाकाले म्रियन्ते ऽस्य बाला अपि कदाचन । ऋक्षस्य भगिनी रक्षा वानरस्य बलीयसः
verses.transliteration: na cākāle mriyante 'sya bālā api kadācana / ṛkṣasya bhaginī rakṣā vānarasya balīyasaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिसकाशात्सा जज्ञे शूरपरिग्रहम् । ऋक्षराजं महाप्राज्ञं जांबवन्तं यशस्विनम्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatisakāśātsā jajñe śūraparigraham / ṛkṣarājaṃ mahāprājñaṃ jāṃbavantaṃ yaśasvinam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: पौलहो ह्यतितेजाश्च देवा ह्येकादशेतरे । संवेगः सुधर्मा च देवानीकः पुरोवहः-॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तस्य जांबवती नाम सुता व्याध्र्यामजायत । वासुदेवस्य सा दत्ता पित्रा राजीवलोचना
verses.transliteration: tasya jāṃbavatī nāma sutā vyādhryāmajāyata / vāsudevasya sā dattā pitrā rājīvalocanā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: क्षेमधर्मा ग्रहेषुश्च आदशः पौंडूको मरुः । सावर्णस्य तु ते पुत्राः प्राजापत्यस्य वे नव ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तथान्ये ऋक्षराजस्य सुता जाता महाबलाः । जयन्तो ऽथ च सर्वज्ञो मृगराट् संकृतिर्जयः
verses.transliteration: tathānye ṛkṣarājasya sutā jātā mahābalāḥ / jayanto 'tha ca sarvajño mṛgarāṭ saṃkṛtirjayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
