verses.transliteration: mārjāro balibāhuśca lakṣaṇajñaḥ śrutārthakṛt / bhojo rākṣasajiccaiva piśācavanagocarau
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: पंचेव तु गणा: प्रोक्ता देवतानामनागशाः । हरिता रोहिताश्चेव देवाः सुमनसस्तथा ।

verses.sanskrit: शरभः शलभश्चैव व्याघ्रः सिंहस्तथैव च । तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva vyāghraḥ siṃhastathaiva ca / teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

verses.hindi: सुकर्माणः सुतारश्च विद्वांश्चैव सहस्रदः । प्वेतोऽनुचरश्चैव अपाशश्च मनोजवः

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षाणामेव तु गणो देवदानवपूजितः । मार्जारस्य तु मार्जारा वाद्याः पुत्रा महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣāṇāmeva tu gaṇo devadānavapūjitaḥ / mārjārasya tu mārjārā vādyāḥ putrā mahābalāḥ

verses.hindi: उनके जो सप्त ऋषिगण होंगे वे भी वतलाये जा रहे हैं। उनको भली

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुः शतसाहस्राः सर्वे वीर्यसमन्विताः । आचार्याः श्वापदादीनां शरभाणां महौजसः
verses.transliteration: babhūvuḥ śatasāhasrāḥ sarve vīryasamanvitāḥ / ācāryāḥ śvāpadādīnāṃ śarabhāṇāṃ mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सब प्राजापत्य सावर्ण के नो पुत्र हैं ।5१। अब बारह वे पर्याय में रुदर के पुत्र मनु के चतुर्थ रुद्र सावर्ण है । उसके अन्तर में जो देवगण हैं उनका भी आप लोग श्रवण कर लेवे ।=२। जो अभी नहीं आगत हुए हैं वे देवताओं के पाँच ही गण कहे गये हैं । देव हारित -रोहित तथा सुमनस होते हैं।८३। सुक-
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: स्वादकाः पृषतादीनां मूषिकाणां च पक्षिणाम् । लाघवे प्लवने युक्ताः सर्वसत्त्वावसादकाः
verses.transliteration: svādakāḥ pṛṣatādīnāṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇām / lāghave plavane yuktāḥ sarvasattvāvasādakāḥ

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामेषु वनशण्डेषु कोटरेषु गुहासु च । गृहेषु गृहगर्भेषु गृहवासावलंबिनः
verses.transliteration: grāmeṣu vanaśaṇḍeṣu koṭareṣu guhāsu ca / gṛheṣu gṛhagarbheṣu gṛhavāsāvalaṃbinaḥ

verses.hindi: विक्रमश्च क्रमश्चैव विभृतः कांत एय च
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.hindi: वर्ना -जो बन्धु कहा गया है ।७५। रज-राज-स्वर्णवाद-पुष्टि और विधि ये दण देव रोहित संज्ञा वाले कहे गये हैं ।८६। जो तृषित आदि देव हैं वे तेतीस बताये गए हैं । बे सुमनस जानने के योग्य होते हैं । अब सुकमंण संज्ञा वालों को समझलो ।८७। मुपर्वा-वृषभ-पध्टा-कपिश,म्न-विपश्चित्-

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपिनः शरभाः सिंहा व्याघ्रा नीलाश्च शल्यकाः । ऋक्षा मार्जारलोहासा वानरा मायवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dvīpinaḥ śarabhāḥ siṃhā vyāghrā nīlāśca śalyakāḥ / ṛkṣā mārjāralohāsā vānarā māyavastathā

verses.sanskrit: एता एकादश मता वानराणां तु जातयः । एषां प्रणेता सर्वेषां वाली राजा प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: etā ekādaśa matā vānarāṇāṃ tu jātayaḥ / eṣāṃ praṇetā sarveṣāṃ vālī rājā pratāpavān

verses.sanskrit: देवासुरविमर्देषु जिघ्नता नित्यमानिनाम् । प्रसह्य हन्ता रौद्राणामसुराणां बलीयसाम्

verses.sanskrit: उत्सिक्तबलनाशाय विचिन्त्य तु महात्मना । पक्ष एष समुद्दिष्टो महेन्द्रस्य सहायवान्

verses.hindi: जो तेतीस देव है उनको पृथक रूप से समझ लो । सुन्रामाण प्रष्ट रूप से यजन के योग्य होते हैं क्योंकि वे इस समय में आज्य (घृत) की आशा बाले होते हैं ।६९। सुकर्माण जो देवता हैं वे पश्चात् यजन करने वाले नामों के हैं क्योंकि वे पृषदाज्य के अशन करने बाले होते हैं। सुकर्माण देव

verses.sanskrit: चपलो ऽरिष्टसंज्ञश्च तस्याष्टौ जज्ञिरे सुताः । उदग्रभावेनो पेता जायन्ते तस्य चान्वये
verses.transliteration: capalo 'riṣṭasaṃjñaśca tasyāṣṭau jajñire sutāḥ / udagrabhāveno petā jāyante tasya cānvaye

verses.hindi: त्रिभुवन में जो भी जीव गतिमान् ओर घव है ।११०। वे इन्द्र सभी प्रकार से अपने गुणों के दवारा उनका अभिभव किया करते हैं। भूतापवादी हुष्ट- मध्य में स्थित और भूतवादी है ।१११। भूतों के अभिवादी प्रवादियों के लिए तीन बेद ही शक्ति वाले होते है । अग्नी ध्र-काश्यप-पौलस्त्य और जो
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतबालनखाः पिङ्गा वर्षावन्तो मतङ्गजाः । सामजांस्तु प्रवक्ष्यामि नागानन्यानपि क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: śvetabālanakhāḥ piṅgā varṣāvanto mataṅgajāḥ / sāmajāṃstu pravakṣyāmi nāgānanyānapi kramāt
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सावर्णा मनबो ह्येते चत्वारो ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कपिलः पुण्डरीकश्च सुनामानौ रथन्तरात् । जातौ नाम्ना श्रुतौ ताभ्यां सुप्रतीकप्रमर्दनौ
verses.transliteration: kapilaḥ puṇḍarīkaśca sunāmānau rathantarāt / jātau nāmnā śrutau tābhyāṃ supratīkapramardanau
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शूराः स्थूलशिरोदन्ताः शुद्धबालनखास्तथा । बलिनः शङ्किताश्चैव स्मृतास्तद्वंशिनो गजाः
verses.transliteration: śūrāḥ sthūlaśirodantāḥ śuddhabālanakhāstathā / balinaḥ śaṅkitāścaiva smṛtāstadvaṃśino gajāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पदन्तो बृहत्साम्नः षड्दन्तः पद्मपुच्छवान् । ताम्र पर्णश्च तत्पुत्राः संघचारिविषाणिनः
verses.transliteration: puṣpadanto bṛhatsāmnaḥ ṣaḍdantaḥ padmapucchavān / tāmra parṇaśca tatputrāḥ saṃghacāriviṣāṇinaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सप्तैते भार्गवा देवा अंते मन्वंतरे तदा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अन्वये चास्य जायन्ते लंबोष्ठाश्चारुदर्शनाः । श्यामत्वग्रसनाशुण्डा नागाः पीनायता ननाः
verses.transliteration: anvaye cāsya jāyante laṃboṣṭhāścārudarśanāḥ / śyāmatvagrasanāśuṇḍā nāgāḥ pīnāyatā nanāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वामदेव्ॐऽजनः श्यामः साम्नो जज्ञे ऽथ वामनः । भार्या चैवाङ्गना तस्य नीलवल्लक्षणौ सुतौ
verses.transliteration: vāmadevoṃ'janaḥ śyāmaḥ sāmno jajñe 'tha vāmanaḥ / bhāryā caivāṅganā tasya nīlavallakṣaṇau sutau
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: श्वाजित कहे गये हैं। इसके बाद में जो मनु के पुत्र हैं उसका श्रवण करो । उए- ky -गम्भी र-बुद्ध-शुद्ध-शुचि-क़ तो -ऊर्जस्वी-सुबल-ये सब मौन्य मनु के पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: चण्डाश्चारु शिरोग्रीवा व्यूढोरस्कास्तरस्विनः । नीचैर्बद्धाः कुले तस्य जायन्ते निबिडा गजाः
verses.transliteration: caṇḍāścāru śirogrīvā vyūḍhoraskāstarasvinaḥ / nīcairbaddhāḥ kule tasya jāyante nibiḍā gajāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सावभ मनु हैं और चारों ब्रह्माजी के पुत्र हैं।११३-११५। एक बैव- स्वत ही सावर्ण मनु कहा जाता है । रोच्य ओर मौर्य जो ये दो हैं वे पोलह और भार्गव माने गए हैं। भौत्य के ही आधिपत्य में तू कल्प पूर्ण हो जाता है ।११६। श्री सूतजी ने कहा--यहाँ पर जव सभी मन्वन्तर निःशेष
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रतीकस्तु वैरूप्यात्साम्नः सारूप्य मागतः । तस्य प्रहारी संपातिः पृथुश्चेति सुतास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: supratīkastu vairūpyātsāmnaḥ sārūpya māgataḥ / tasya prahārī saṃpātiḥ pṛthuśceti sutāstrayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हो जाते हैं ।११७। तब अनेक युगों के क्षीण हो जाने पर अन्त में संहार कहा जाया करता है । उस समय के अन्त में मन्वन्तर में ये सात भागंव देव होते हैं।११० ये त्रेलोक्य के मध्य में संस्थित हुए भोग करते !हैं। युगों की आख्या एकहत्तर होती है । उस समप में पितरों और मनुओं के साथ मन्व-
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: प्रांशवो दीर्घताल्वोष्ठाः सुविभक्तशिरोरुहाः । जायन्ते मृदुसंभोगा वंशे तस्य मतङ्गजाः
verses.transliteration: prāṃśavo dīrghatālvoṣṭhāḥ suvibhaktaśiroruhāḥ / jāyante mṛdusaṃbhogā vaṃśe tasya mataṅgajāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जनादञ्जनः साम्नो विजज्ञे जाञ्जनावती । सुतौ जातौ तयोश्चापि प्रमाथिपुरुषौ स्मृतौ
verses.transliteration: añjanādañjanaḥ sāmno vijajñe jāñjanāvatī / sutau jātau tayoścāpi pramāthipuruṣau smṛtau
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अनाधारमिदं सर्वं त्रौ लोक्यं वे भविष्यति ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: महाविभक्तशिरसः स्निग्धजीमूतसन्निभाः । सुदर्शनाः सुवर्ष्माणः पद्माभाः परिमण्डलाः
verses.transliteration: mahāvibhaktaśirasaḥ snigdhajīmūtasannibhāḥ / sudarśanāḥ suvarṣmāṇaḥ padmābhāḥ parimaṇḍalāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शूरा दीनायतमुखा गजास्तस्यान्वये ऽभवन् । जज्ञे चान्द्रमसः साम्नः कुमुदः कुमुदद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: śūrā dīnāyatamukhā gajāstasyānvaye 'bhavan / jajñe cāndramasaḥ sāmnaḥ kumudaḥ kumudadyutiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पिङ्गलायां सुतौ तस्य महापद्मोर्मिमालिनौ । शैलजीमूतसंकाशान्सुबुद्धान्बलिनो वरान्
verses.transliteration: piṅgalāyāṃ sutau tasya mahāpadmormimālinau / śailajīmūtasaṃkāśānsubuddhānbalino varān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: हस्तियुद्धप्रियान्नागान्विद्धि तस्य कुलोद्भवान् । एतान्देवासुरे युद्धे जयार्थं जगृहुः सुराः
verses.transliteration: hastiyuddhapriyānnāgānviddhi tasya kulodbhavān / etāndevāsure yuddhe jayārthaṃ jagṛhuḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कृतार्थैश्च विसृष्टास्ते पूर्वोक्ताः प्रययुर्द्दिशः । एतेषां चान्वये जातान्विनीतांस्त्रिदशा ददुः
verses.transliteration: kṛtārthaiśca visṛṣṭāste pūrvoktāḥ prayayurddiśaḥ / eteṣāṃ cānvaye jātānvinītāṃstridaśā daduḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गाय लोमपादाय सूत्रकाराय वै द्विपान् । द्विरदो रदनद्वाभ्यां हस्ती हस्तात्करात्करी
verses.transliteration: aṅgāya lomapādāya sūtrakārāya vai dvipān / dvirado radanadvābhyāṃ hastī hastātkarātkarī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वारणो वारणाद्दन्ती दन्ताभ्यां गर्जनाद्गजः । कुञ्जरः कुञ्जचारित्वान्नागो नगम्यमस्य यत्
verses.transliteration: vāraṇo vāraṇāddantī dantābhyāṃ garjanādgajaḥ / kuñjaraḥ kuñjacāritvānnāgo nagamyamasya yat
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: देवेषु च गतेषूद्ध बं सायुज्यं कल्पवासिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मत्तं यातीति मातङ्गो द्विपो द्वाभ्यां पिबन्स्मृतः । सामजः सामजातत्वादिति निर्वचनक्रमः
verses.transliteration: mattaṃ yātīti mātaṅgo dvipo dvābhyāṃ pibansmṛtaḥ / sāmajaḥ sāmajātatvāditi nirvacanakramaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एषां जिह्वापरावृत्तिर्ह्युक्ता वै चाग्निशापजा । बलस्यानवबोधो यो या चैषां गूढमुष्कता
verses.transliteration: eṣāṃ jihvāparāvṛttirhyuktā vai cāgniśāpajā / balasyānavabodho yo yā caiṣāṃ gūḍhamuṣkatā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तब यह सम्पूर्ण त्र॑लोक्य आधार से रहित होता है। फिर जो भी स्थानीयों के परम शुभ्र स्थान हैं वे सभी नष्ट भ्रष्ट हो जाते हैं ।१२०। ये सभी तारे और नक्षत्र तथा ग्रहों द्वारा विमुक्त होते हुए विनष्ट हो जाया करते हैं। फिर अब ये सभी व्यतीत हो जाया करते हैं जो इन तीनों लोकों
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: उभयं दन्तिनामेतज्ज्ञेयं तु सुरशापजम् । देवदानगन्धर्वपिशाचोरगरक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: ubhayaṃ dantināmetajjñeyaṃ tu suraśāpajam / devadānagandharvapiśācoragarakṣasām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: के स्वामी तथा संचलक होते हैं ।१२१। जिसमें जो भी कल्पवासी अर्थात् पूरे कल्पों तक रहने वाले हैं वे सभी महर्लोक में चले जाया करते हैं । जहाँ पर अजित आदि गण हैं और ये चौदह आयुष्मान हैं ।१२२। सभी मन्वन्तरों में
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कन्यासु जाता दिग्नागैर्नानासत्त्वास्ततो गजाः । संभूतिश्च प्रसूतिश्च नामनिर्वचनं तथा
verses.transliteration: kanyāsu jātā dignāgairnānāsattvāstato gajāḥ / saṃbhūtiśca prasūtiśca nāmanirvacanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: यायियों के साथ ही में शरीरों के सहित जनलोक में निवास किया करते हैं ।१२३। इस तरह से महर्लोक से जनलोक की ओर सभी देवों के व्यतीत हो जाने पर और स्थावरों के अन्त पर्यन्त सब भूतादि के अवशिष्ट होने पर ।१२४। भूलोक से लेकर महलोंक तक जितने भी लोक स्थान हैं वे सब शून्य
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एतद्गजानां विज्ञेयमेषां राजा स चाभ्रमः । कौशिक्या ह्यासमुद्रात्तु गङ्गायश्च यदुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: etadgajānāṃ vijñeyameṣāṃ rājā sa cābhramaḥ / kauśikyā hyāsamudrāttu gaṅgāyaśca yaduttaram
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हो जाते हैं । सभी वेद भी कल्पवासियों कें समीप में ऊपर की ओर चले जाया करते हैं ।१२५। इसके अनन्तर ब्रह्माजी उन सबका देव-ऋषि-पितृ- और दानवों का संहार करके युग क्षय में दिन को देखकर फिर सगे को संस्थापित किया करते हैं।१२६। एक सहस्र चारों युगों की चौकडी का जब
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जनस्यैकमूलस्य विज्ञेयं गहनं तु तत् । उत्तरं चैव विध्यस्य गङ्गाया दक्षिणं च यत्
verses.transliteration: añjanasyaikamūlasya vijñeyaṃ gahanaṃ tu tat / uttaraṃ caiva vidhyasya gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अन्त हो जाता है तब ब्रह्माजी का दिन हुआ करता है और इसी रीति से एक सहस्र चारों युगों की चौकड़ी का जब अन्त होता है तब ब्रह्माजी की एक रात्रि हुआ करती है । ऐसे पितामह का अहोरात्र होता है
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोद्भेदे सकेरुभ्यः सुप्रतीकस्य पत्तनम् । अपरेणोत्कलं चैव कावेरीभ्यश्च पश्चिमम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgodbhede sakerubhyaḥ supratīkasya pattanam / apareṇotkalaṃ caiva kāverībhyaśca paścimam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एकसूकात्मजस्यैतद्वामनस्यवनंस्मृतम् । अपरेणतु लौहित्यमासिंधोः पश्चिमेन तु
verses.transliteration: ekasūkātmajasyaitadvāmanasyavanaṃsmṛtam / apareṇatu lauhityamāsiṃdhoḥ paścimena tu
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पद्मस्यैतद्वनं प्रोक्तमनुपर्वतमेव तत् । भूता विजज्ञे भूतांस्तु रुद्रस्यानुचरानिह
verses.transliteration: padmasyaitadvanaṃ proktamanuparvatameva tat / bhūtā vijajñe bhūtāṃstu rudrasyānucarāniha
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलान्कृशांश्च दीर्घांश्च वामनान्ह्रस्वकान्समान् । लंबकर्णान्प्रलंबौष्ठान् लंबजिह्वांस्तनूदरान्
verses.transliteration: sthūlānkṛśāṃśca dīrghāṃśca vāmanānhrasvakānsamān / laṃbakarṇānpralaṃbauṣṭhān laṃbajihvāṃstanūdarān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एकनेत्रान्विरूपांश्च लंबस्फिक्स्थूलपिण्डिकान् । सकृष्णगौरान्नीलांश्च श्वेतान्वै लोहिताननान्
verses.transliteration: ekanetrānvirūpāṃśca laṃbasphiksthūlapiṇḍikān / sakṛṣṇagaurānnīlāṃśca śvetānvai lohitānanān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रून्वै शबलान्धूम्रान्विकद्रून्नासमारूणान् । मुञ्जकेशान्त्दृष्टरोम्णः सर्वयज्ञोपवीतिनः
verses.transliteration: babhrūnvai śabalāndhūmrānvikadrūnnāsamārūṇān / muñjakeśāntdṛṣṭaromṇaḥ sarvayajñopavītinaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बहुशीर्षान्विपादांश्च ह्येकशीर्षानशीर्षकान् । चण्डांश्च विकटांश्चैव निर्मितांश्च द्विजिह्वकान्
verses.transliteration: bahuśīrṣānvipādāṃśca hyekaśīrṣānaśīrṣakān / caṇḍāṃśca vikaṭāṃścaiva nirmitāṃśca dvijihvakān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: यह समस्त प्राणियों का सञ्चर तीन प्रकार का हुआ करता है-- अर्थानुसार एक नैमित्तिक होता है-दूसरा प्राकृतिक है और तीसरा आत्या- स्तिक होता है ।१२० ब्रह्माजी का जो नेमिलिक है वह प्रसंयम कल्पदाह है। प्रत्येक भूतों के सगं में प्राकृत करना क्षय होता है ।१२९। ज्ञान से अत्यधिक
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मुण्डांश्च जटिलांश्चैव कुब्जान्वक्रान्सवामनान् । सरः श्रेष्ठसमुद्राद्रिनदीपुलिनसेविनः
verses.transliteration: muṇḍāṃśca jaṭilāṃścaiva kubjānvakrānsavāmanān / saraḥ śreṣṭhasamudrādrinadīpulinasevinaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: कहा गया है जहाँ पर कारणों की कोई सम्भवता नहीं होती है । इसके आनन्तर ब्रह्माजो उन समस्त त्रेलोक्य के निवासी देवों का संहार किया करते हैं ।१३०। फिर प्रहर के अन्त में सगं का प्रलय किया करते हैं । भग- वानू ब्रह्माजी जब शयन करने की इच्छा वाले होते हैं उसी समय में समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एककर्णान्महाकर्णाञ्छङ्कुकर्णानकर्णकान् । दंष्ट्रिणो नखिनश्चैव निर्दन्तांश्च विजिह्वकान्
verses.transliteration: ekakarṇānmahākarṇāñchaṅkukarṇānakarṇakān / daṃṣṭriṇo nakhinaścaiva nirdantāṃśca vijihvakān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्रजाओं का संहार किया करते हैं ।१३१। फिर चारों युगों की एक सहस चौकड़ो का अन्त हो जाता है ओर युगों का क्षय श्राप्त होता है उस काल में बही प्रजापति समस्त प्रजाओं को अपनी ही आत्मा में स्थित करने के लिए समुद्यत हो जाया करते हैं । उस समय में जो महान् प्रजाओं का संहार होता
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एकहस्तान्द्विहस्तांश्च त्रिहस्तांश्चाप्यहस्तकान् । एकपादान्द्विपादांश्च त्रिपादान्बहुपादकान्
verses.transliteration: ekahastāndvihastāṃśca trihastāṃścāpyahastakān / ekapādāndvipādāṃśca tripādānbahupādakān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: है उसका आरम्भ इस तरह से हुआ करता है कि सबसे पूर्व तो वर्षा का एकदम निरन्तर रहने वाला अभाव सौ वर्षों तक होता है। उस समय में जल के एकदम सर्वथा न रहने दो जो बहुत अल्प सार वाले जीव हैं ओर इस पृथ्वी तल में निवास करते हैं वे सभी न£ हो जाया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: महायोगान्महासत्त्वान्सुमनस्कान्महाबलान् । सर्वत्रगातप्रतिघातब्रह्मज्ञान्कामरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: mahāyogānmahāsattvānsumanaskānmahābalān / sarvatragātapratighātabrahmajñānkāmarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तान्येवात्र प्रलीयंसे भूमित्वमुपयांति च । सप्तरश्मिरथो भूत्वा उदतिष्ठद्विमावसु:
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: घोरान्क्रूरांश्च मेध्यांश्च मद्यमेध्यान्सुधार्मिकान् । कूटदन्तान्महाजिह्वान्विकेशान्विकृताननान्
verses.transliteration: ghorānkrūrāṃśca medhyāṃśca madyamedhyānsudhārmikān / kūṭadantānmahājihvānvikeśānvikṛtānanān
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: हस्तादांश्च मुखादांश्च शिरोदांश्च कपालिनः । धन्विनो मुद्गरधरा नसिशूलधरांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: hastādāṃśca mukhādāṃśca śirodāṃśca kapālinaḥ / dhanvino mudgaradharā nasiśūladharāṃstathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दिग्वाससश्चित्रवेषांश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनान् । अन्नादान्पिशितादांश्च सुरापान्सोमपांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: digvāsasaścitraveṣāṃścitramālyānulepanān / annādānpiśitādāṃśca surāpānsomapāṃstathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: उस जलाभाव में वे ही जीव प्रलीन होकर भूमि में मिल जाया करते हैं। फिर सूर्यदेव सात रश्मियों वाले होकर अर्थात् सात गुने तेजस्वी होकर उदित हुआ करते हैं।१३४। उस सभय में सूर्ये भगवान् न सहन करने के योग्य किरणों बाले हो जाया करते हैं और वे अपनो किरणों से भूमि गत
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: केचित्संध्याचरा घोराः केचित्सौम्या दिवाचराः । नक्तञ्चराः खरस्पर्शा घोरास्तेषां निशाचराः
verses.transliteration: kecitsaṃdhyācarā ghorāḥ kecitsaumyā divācarāḥ / naktañcarāḥ kharasparśā ghorāsteṣāṃ niśācarāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सम्पूणं जल को पो जाया करते हैं। उस सूर्य को संप्तति हरित रश्मियाँ दौप्ममान हो जाती हैं ।१३५॥ फिर नभोगण्डल को व्याप्त करती हुई धीरे बढ़ती हैं। भूमि का काष्ठेस्धन बहुत ही तेज युक्त होकर दीप्त होता है जो जल के ही कारण से हो जाता है ।१३६। इसी कारण से जन के भरने वाला
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: परत्वेन भवं देवं सर्वे ते गतमानसाः । नैषां भार्यास्ति पुत्रा वा सर्वे ते ह्यूर्ध्वरेतसः
verses.transliteration: paratvena bhavaṃ devaṃ sarve te gatamānasāḥ / naiṣāṃ bhāryāsti putrā vā sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सूर्ये तपता है--यही कहा जाया करता है । सूर्य अवृष्टि से नहीं तपा करता है ओर अवृष्टि ते सूर्य परिषिक्त भो नहीं होता है।१३७। अवृष्टि से सूर्य परिवृष्ट नहीं होता है प्रत्युत जल के ही द्वारा रवि दीप्त हुआ करता है। इसी कारण से जो जलों का पान करता रहता है वही रवि अम्बर में दीप्त
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शतं तानि सहस्राणि भूतानामात्मयोगिनाम् । भवपारिषदास्ते वै सर्वे भूताः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: śataṃ tāni sahasrāṇi bhūtānāmātmayoginām / bhavapāriṣadāste vai sarve bhūtāḥ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हुआ करता है।१३८। उस सूर्य की सात रश्मियाँ (किरणें) महा सागर से जल का पान किया करती हैं । उसी आहार से सात सूय प्रदीप्त होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कपिशायाश्च कूष्माण्डा जज्ञिरे च पुनः पुनः । मिथुनेन पिशाचांश्च वर्णेन कपिशेन तु
verses.transliteration: kapiśāyāśca kūṣmāṇḍā jajñire ca punaḥ punaḥ / mithunena piśācāṃśca varṇena kapiśena tu
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: होती हुई उस समय में वे अग्नियाँ इन चारों लोकों को दग्ध किया करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कपिशत्वात्पिशाचास्ते सर्वे च पिशिताशनाः । युग्मानि षोडशाद्यानि वर्त्तमानस्तदन्वयः
verses.transliteration: kapiśatvātpiśācāste sarve ca piśitāśanāḥ / yugmāni ṣoḍaśādyāni varttamānastadanvayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नामतस्तान्प्रवक्ष्यामि रूपतश्च तदन्वयम् । छगलश्छगला चैव वक्रो वक्रमुखी तथा
verses.transliteration: nāmatastānpravakṣyāmi rūpataśca tadanvayam / chagalaśchagalā caiva vakro vakramukhī tathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दुष्पूरः पूरणा चैव सूची सूचीमुखस्तथा । विपादश्च विपादी च ज्वाला चाङ्गारकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: duṣpūraḥ pūraṇā caiva sūcī sūcīmukhastathā / vipādaśca vipādī ca jvālā cāṅgārakastathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कुंभपात्रश्च कुंभी च प्रतुन्दश्च प्रतुन्दिका । उपवीरश्च वीरा च ह्युलूखल उलूखली
verses.transliteration: kuṃbhapātraśca kuṃbhī ca pratundaśca pratundikā / upavīraśca vīrā ca hyulūkhala ulūkhalī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अकर्मकः कर्मकी च कुषण्डश्च कुषण्डिका । पाणिपात्रः पाणिपात्री पांशुः पांशुमती तथा
verses.transliteration: akarmakaḥ karmakī ca kuṣaṇḍaśca kuṣaṇḍikā / pāṇipātraḥ pāṇipātrī pāṃśuḥ pāṃśumatī tathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: उन रश्मियों के द्वारा ऊपर की ओर तथा नीचे की ओर अग्निरा आह होती हैं युग के अन्त में प्रताप देने बाले सात सूर्य दीप्त हुआ करते हैं ।१४१। सहुन्न रश्मियों की बाहुए' दारि के ही द्वारा ही प्रदीप्त होती हैं। वे आकाश को समावृत करके ही सम्पूर्ण वसुर्धरा का निर्दहन करती हुई"
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नितुन्दश्च नितुन्दी च निपुणो निपुणी तथा । बालादः केषणादी च प्रस्कन्दः स्कन्दिका तथा
verses.transliteration: nitundaśca nitundī ca nipuṇo nipuṇī tathā / bālādaḥ keṣaṇādī ca praskandaḥ skandikā tathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: स्थिर रहा करती हैं ।१४२। इसके पश्चात् उनके परिताप से दहन को प्राप्त होती हुई सम्पूर्ण बसुन्धरा पर्वत-नदी और समुद्रो के सहित यह पृथ्वी स्नेह (द्रव जल) से रहित हो गयी थी ।१४३। निरन्तर विद्यमान रहने वाली- सुदीक्ष और बिचित्रता से चारों ओर युक्त सम्पूर्ण भूमि ऊपर-नीचे और
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: षोडशानां पिशाचानां गणाः प्रोक्तास्तु षोडश । अजामुखा पक्रमुखाः पूरणः स्कन्दिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśānāṃ piśācānāṃ gaṇāḥ proktāstu ṣoḍaśa / ajāmukhā pakramukhāḥ pūraṇaḥ skandinastathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तिरछी ओर सूर्य की किरणों से संरुद्ध हो गयो थों ।१४४। प्रवृद्ध हुई भोर परस्पर में संसृष्ट हुई सूर्य को अग्नियाँ एक स्वरूप को प्राप्त होकर एक ही विशाल ज्वाला हो जाती है ।१४५। वह अग्नि अनुमण्डल वाली होकर समस्त लोकों का प्रणाश किया करता है और इन चारों लोकों का सबका
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विपादाङ्गारिकाश्चैव कुंभपात्राः प्रतुन्दकाः । उपवीरोलूखलिका अर्कमर्काः कुषण्डिकाः
verses.transliteration: vipādāṅgārikāścaiva kuṃbhapātrāḥ pratundakāḥ / upavīrolūkhalikā arkamarkāḥ kuṣaṇḍikāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: बहुत हो शीघ्र तेज के द्वारा निदंहन कर देती है ।१४६। इसके अनन्तर इस सम्पूणं स्थावर और जङ्गम के प्रलीन होने पर यह समग्र पृथ्वी वृक्षों से रहित बिना तृणों वाली कछुए को पीठ के ही समान यह जैसी हो गयी थी और उस पर कुछ भो शेष नहीं रह गया था
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पांशवः पाणिपत्राश्च नैतुन्दा निपुणास्तथा । सूजीमुखोच्छेषणादाः कलान्येतानि षोडश
verses.transliteration: pāṃśavaḥ pāṇipatrāśca naitundā nipuṇāstathā / sūjīmukhoccheṣaṇādāḥ kalānyetāni ṣoḍaśa
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: इत्येता ह्यभि जातास्तु कूष्माण्डानां प्रकीर्त्तिताः । पिशाचास्ते पिशाच्यस्ताः सकुल्याः संप्रजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: ityetā hyabhi jātāstu kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ prakīrttitāḥ / piśācāste piśācyastāḥ sakulyāḥ saṃprajajñire
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बीभत्सं विकृताकारं पुत्रपौत्रमनेतकम् । अतस्तेषां पिशाचानां लक्षणानि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: bībhatsaṃ vikṛtākāraṃ putrapautramanetakam / atasteṣāṃ piśācānāṃ lakṣaṇāni nibodhata
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: यह सब जगत् उस समय में अम्बरीष के ही समान आभात होता था। और यह सम्पूर्ण उस अग्नि की अचियों से पूर्ण घन प्रज्वलित हो रहा था ।१४८। इस भूतल में जितने भी प्राणी थे तथा महासागर में जो भी सत्व थे वे सबके सब प्रलीन हो जाते हैं और भूमि को मिट्टी में मिल जाया
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गकेशा वत्ताक्षा दंष्ट्रिणो नखिनस्तथा । तिर्य्यगङ्गाः पारुषदाः पिशाचास्ते ह्यजामुखाः
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgakeśā vattākṣā daṃṣṭriṇo nakhinastathā / tiryyagaṅgāḥ pāruṣadāḥ piśācāste hyajāmukhāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: करते हैं ।१४६। समस्त द्वीप--पर्वत--वर्ष ओर महासागर इन सभी को उस स्वात्मा पावक ने जलाकर भस्म के तुल्य ही बना दिया था ।१५०। इस भूमि में रहने वाला वह परमाधिक प्रदीप्त अग्नि जलता हुआ होकर समुद्रों से-नदियों से और पातालों से सभी जगह से जल का पान किया करता है,
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अकर्णका ह्यरोमाणो ऽवाससश्चर्मवाससः । कुषण्डिकपिशाचास्ते प्रियभक्षाः सदामिषाः
verses.transliteration: akarṇakā hyaromāṇo 'vāsasaścarmavāsasaḥ / kuṣaṇḍikapiśācāste priyabhakṣāḥ sadāmiṣāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: होकर शैलों और ग्रहों का अतिक्रमण करके परम दीक्ष होता हुआ समस्त लोकों का संहार किया करता है ।१५२॥ इसके पश्चात् वह भीषण अनल इस पृथ्वी का भेदन करके रसातल में पहुँच कर उसका भी शोषण कर देता है। अन्त में पाताल लोक को निर्द् करके फिर वायु लोक को दग्ध कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वक्राङ्गहस्तापादाश्च वक्रशीलमतास्तथा । ज्ञेया वक्राः पिशाचास्ते वक्रगाः कामरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: vakrāṅgahastāpādāśca vakraśīlamatāstathā / jñeyā vakrāḥ piśācāste vakragāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: था ।१५३। नीचे पृथ्वी का दाह करके और ऊपर की ओर स्वर्ग लोक को
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: लंबोदरास्तुण्डनासा ह्रस्वकाय शिरोभुजाः । नितुन्दकाः पिशाचास्ते तिलभक्षाः प्रियासृजाः
verses.transliteration: laṃbodarāstuṇḍanāsā hrasvakāya śirobhujāḥ / nitundakāḥ piśācāste tilabhakṣāḥ priyāsṛjāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वानराकृतयश्चैव वाचालाः प्लुतगामिनः । पिशाचार् कमर्कास्ते वृक्षवासोदनप्रियाः
verses.transliteration: vānarākṛtayaścaiva vācālāḥ plutagāminaḥ / piśācār kamarkāste vṛkṣavāsodanapriyāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: दग्ध कर दिया था । सहस्रं तथा प्रयुतो और अबुंदों योजन पर्यन्त उस कालानल की ज्वालाए' ऊचो उठ रहीं थो
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वबाहूर्द्ध्वरोमाण उद्धृताक्षा यथालयाः । मुञ्चन्ति पांशुमङ्गेभ्यः पिशाचाः पांशवस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvabāhūrddhvaromāṇa uddhṛtākṣā yathālayāḥ / muñcanti pāṃśumaṅgebhyaḥ piśācāḥ pāṃśavastu te
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: उदतिष्ठझिगखास्तस्य वह्वयः संवत्तंकस्य तु । गन्धर्वांश्च पिशाचाँश्च समहारगराक्षसान्
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमरीसन्निभाः शुष्कासशूलाश्चीरवाससः । उपवीराः पिशाचास्ते श्मशानायतनाः सदा
verses.transliteration: bhramarīsannibhāḥ śuṣkāsaśūlāścīravāsasaḥ / upavīrāḥ piśācāste śmaśānāyatanāḥ sadā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: भूलोंकं च भुवर्लोकं स्वर्लोकं च महस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: निष्टब्धाक्षा महाजिह्वा लेलिहाना ह्युलूखलाः । उलूखलैराभरणा रत्नधाराश्च ते खलाः
verses.transliteration: niṣṭabdhākṣā mahājihvā lelihānā hyulūkhalāḥ / ulūkhalairābharaṇā ratnadhārāśca te khalāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: घोरो दहति कालाग्निरेवं लोकचतुष्टयम् । व्याप्तेषु तेषु लोकेषु ति्यगूद्व,वेमथाग्निना ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पाणिपात्राः पिशाचास्ते निसृष्टबलिभोजनाः । हस्त्युष्ट्रस्थूलशिरसो विनतोद्धतपिण्डिकाः
verses.transliteration: pāṇipātrāḥ piśācāste nisṛṣṭabalibhojanāḥ / hastyuṣṭrasthūlaśiraso vinatoddhatapiṇḍikāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पिशाचाः कुंभपात्रास्ते अदृष्टान्नानि भुञ्जते । सूक्ष्मास्तु रोमशाः पिङ्गा दृष्टादृष्टाश्चरन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: piśācāḥ kuṃbhapātrāste adṛṣṭānnāni bhuñjate / sūkṣmāstu romaśāḥ piṅgā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭāścaranti ye
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ततो गजकुलाकारास्तडिद्िभिः समलंकृताः । उत्तिष्ठन्ति तदा घोरा व्योम्नि संवतंका घना:
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्तान्प्रचरन्तीह निपुणास्ते पिशाचकाः । आकर्णाद्दारितास्याश्च लंबभ्रूस्थूलनासिकाः
verses.transliteration: ayuktānpracarantīha nipuṇāste piśācakāḥ / ākarṇāddāritāsyāśca laṃbabhrūsthūlanāsikāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: केचिन्नीलोत्पलश्यामा: केचित्कुमुदसन्निभाः । केचिद्व डूय॑संका शा इन्द्रनीलनिभाः परे
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शून्यागारप्रियाः स्थूलाः पिशाचास्ते तु पूरणाः । हस्तपादाक्रान्ततुण्डा ह्रस्वकाः क्षितिदृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: śūnyāgārapriyāḥ sthūlāḥ piśācāste tu pūraṇāḥ / hastapādākrāntatuṇḍā hrasvakāḥ kṣitidṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बालादास्ते पिशाचा वै सूतिकागृहसेविनः । पृष्ठतः पाणि पादाश्च पृष्ठतो वातरंहसः
verses.transliteration: bālādāste piśācā vai sūtikāgṛhasevinaḥ / pṛṣṭhataḥ pāṇi pādāśca pṛṣṭhato vātaraṃhasaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: उस सम्बर्तक अनल की शिखाऐ बहुत सी ऊपर की ओर उठ रही थीं और वे ज्वालाए' ऊपर में संस्थित गन्धवों--पिशाचों और महोरगों तथा राक्षसों को निर्द्र कर रही यं ।१५५। उस समय में यह संदीप्त अनल सभी ओर से गोलक को दग्ध कर देता है। भूलोक-भुवलोंक--स्व रलॉक
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: विपादकाः पिशाचास्ते संग्रामे रुधिराशनाः । नग्नका ह्यनिकेताश्च लंबशेफ आण्डपिडकाः
verses.transliteration: vipādakāḥ piśācāste saṃgrāme rudhirāśanāḥ / nagnakā hyaniketāśca laṃbaśepha āṇḍapiḍakāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: और महलॉक को भी जला देता है ।१६। यह परम कालग्नि इस रीति से चारों लोकों को निर्दग्ध कर दिया करता है। तिरछा और ऊपर की ओर इस प्रकार से उन समस्त लोकों में इसके व्याप्त हो जाने पर सभी को भस्म- साद् कर देता है ।१५७। धोरे-धीरे यह तेज इस सम्पूर्ण जगत मैं सम्प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पिशाचाः स्कन्दिनस्ते वै अन्य उच्छेषणादिनः । षोडशैता हि जात्यस्ताः पिशाचानां प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: piśācāḥ skandinaste vai anya uccheṣaṇādinaḥ / ṣoḍaśaitā hi jātyastāḥ piśācānāṃ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हो जाता है । उस समय में यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् एक परमाधिक संतप्त लोहे के गोले के हो समान प्रकाशित हुआ करता है ।१५८। इसके उपरान्त उस समय प्रें नभोमंडल में हाथियों के समूह के आकार वाले विद्युल्लता से समलङ्कृत परम घोर सम्वत्तंक मेघ उमड़ कर उठते हैं ।१५६। उन मेघों
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधान्पिशाचांस्तु दीनान्दृष्ट्वानुकंपया । ब्रह्मा तेभ्यो वरं प्रादात्कारुण्यादल्पचेतसः
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhānpiśācāṃstu dīnāndṛṣṭvānukaṃpayā / brahmā tebhyo varaṃ prādātkāruṇyādalpacetasaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: में कुछ तो नोल कमलों के सहस आकार वाले होते हैं और कुछ कुमुदो के तुल्य हुआ करते हैं । कुछ बेटू्यमणि के समान होते हैं तो दूसरे इन्द्रनील मणि के तुल्य हुआ करते हैं ।१६०। कुछ शङ्क और कुन्द पुष्प के सहश श्वेत होते हैं तथा कुछ जाती और अञ्जन के समान हुआ करते हैं। कुछ मेघों
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्धानं प्रजायां हि कामरूपित्वमेव च । संध्ये उभे प्रचारं च स्थानान्याजीवमेव च
verses.transliteration: antardhānaṃ prajāyāṃ hi kāmarūpitvameva ca / saṃdhye ubhe pracāraṃ ca sthānānyājīvameva ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: का वर्ण धू के समान होता है तथा कुछ पयोधर पोतवर्ण बाले होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गृहाणि यानि भग्नानि शून्यान्यल्पजलानि च । विध्वस्तानि च यानि स्युरनाचारोषिता नि च
verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇi yāni bhagnāni śūnyānyalpajalāni ca / vidhvastāni ca yāni syuranācāroṣitā ni ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: असंमृष्टोपलिप्तानि संस्कारैर्वर्जितानि तु । राजमार्गोपरथ्याश्च निष्कुटाश्चत्वराणि च
verses.transliteration: asaṃmṛṣṭopaliptāni saṃskārairvarjitāni tu / rājamārgoparathyāśca niṣkuṭāścatvarāṇi ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: द्वाराण्यट्टालकांश्चैव निर्गमास्संक्रमास्तथा । पथो नद्यो ऽथ तीर्थानि चैत्यवृक्षा महापथम्
verses.transliteration: dvārāṇyaṭṭālakāṃścaiva nirgamāssaṃkramāstathā / patho nadyo 'tha tīrthāni caityavṛkṣā mahāpatham
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पिशाचा विनिविष्टा वै स्थानेष्वेतेषु सर्वशः । अधार्मिको जनस्तेषामा जीवो विहितः सुरैः
verses.transliteration: piśācā viniviṣṭā vai sthāneṣveteṣu sarvaśaḥ / adhārmiko janasteṣāmā jīvo vihitaḥ suraiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाः संकरिकाः कारुशिल्पिजनास्तथा । प्रकृतोपधिसंधानाश्चोरा विश्वासघातिनः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramāḥ saṃkarikāḥ kāruśilpijanāstathā / prakṛtopadhisaṃdhānāścorā viśvāsaghātinaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिरन्यायोपार्जितैरपि । आरभ्यन्ते क्रियायास्तु पिशाचास्तत्र दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: etairanyaiśca bahubhiranyāyopārjitairapi / ārabhyante kriyāyāstu piśācāstatra daivatam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
