verses.sanskrit: मधुमांसोदनैर्दध्ना तिलचूर्णैः सुरासवैः । धूपैर्हारिद्रकृसरैस्तिलभक्षगुडौदनैः
verses.transliteration: madhumāṃsodanairdadhnā tilacūrṇaiḥ surāsavaiḥ / dhūpairhāridrakṛsaraistilabhakṣaguḍaudanaiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णानि चैव वासांसि धूपः सुमनमो ऽक्षयः । एवसुक्तास्तु बलयस्त्वेषां वै पर्वसंधिषु
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi dhūpaḥ sumanamo 'kṣayaḥ / evasuktāstu balayastveṣāṃ vai parvasaṃdhiṣu
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: कुछ मेथों का वर्ण रामभ (गधा) के सहज होता है तथा कुछ लाख के रस के सहश हुआ करते है । दूसरे कुछ मैनसिल के सहश एकदम सुखं होते हैं तथा कुछ कबूतरों के ममान वर्णो बले होते हैं ।१६२। कुछ इन्द्र गोप फे सहग हैं तो कुछ हरिताल के समान र्ग बाले हुआ करते है । उस समय
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पिशाचानामनुज्ञाय ब्रह्मा चाधिपतिं ददौ । सर्वभूतपिशाचानां गिरीणां शूलपाणिनाम्
verses.transliteration: piśācānāmanujñāya brahmā cādhipatiṃ dadau / sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ girīṇāṃ śūlapāṇinām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: में अन्तरिक्ष में चाष के पत्रों के ही सदश मेघ उमड़कर उठा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्रा त्वजनयत्पुत्रान्सिंहान्व्याघ्रांश्च भामिनी । द्वीपिनश्च सुतास्तस्याः श्वापदाश्चामिषाशिनः
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrā tvajanayatputrānsiṃhānvyāghrāṃśca bhāminī / dvīpinaśca sutāstasyāḥ śvāpadāścāmiṣāśinaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: कुछ घन श्रेष्ठ पुर के आकार बाले हैं तो कुछ द्विज (पक्षी) कुलों के सहश हुआ करते हैं। कुछ धन तो उस समय में विशाल पर्वतों के समान आकार वाले होते हैं तथा कुछ ऐसे प्रतीत होते हैं मानों स्यत हो होवें ।१६४। कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ऋषायास्त्वपि कार्त्स्न्ये प्रजासर्गं निबोधत । तस्या दुहितरः पञ्च तासां नामानि मे शृणु
verses.transliteration: ṛṣāyāstvapi kārtsnye prajāsargaṃ nibodhata / tasyā duhitaraḥ pañca tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ९८   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण मेष क्रीड़ा ग्रहों के तुल्य होते हैं तो कुछ मीनों के समुद्यम के सदृश दिखलाई दिया करते हैं । उस समय में मेधों के अनेक स्वरूप दिखाई दिया करते हैं। उनका स्वरूप परमाधिक घोर होता है और वे भयखूर गर्जन किया करते
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मीनामीना तथा वृत्ता परि वृत्ता तथैव च । अनुवृत्ता च विज्ञेया तासां वै शृणुत प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: mīnāmīnā tathā vṛttā pari vṛttā tathaiva ca / anuvṛttā ca vijñeyā tāsāṃ vai śṛṇuta prajāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हैं ।१६४। उत्त समय जलधर आकर नभस्तल को एक साथ समाच्छादित कर देते हैं । इसके अनन्तर वे मेघ परम भीषण घोष किया करते हैं और भास्कर के हो स्वरूप वाले होते हैं ।१६६। सात स्वख्पों में संवृत होते वाले बे मेघ उस परम चोर अग्नि का शमन कर दिया करते हैं। इसके उपरान्त
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रदंष्ट्रा मकराः पाठीनास्तिमिरोहिताः । इत्येवमादिर्हि गणो मैनो विस्तीर्ण उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sahasradaṃṣṭrā makarāḥ pāṭhīnāstimirohitāḥ / ityevamādirhi gaṇo maino vistīrṇa ucyate
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: दे मेघ महान् घोर मूसलाधार वर्षा किया करते हैं ।१६७। परम घोर अशिव उस अग्नि का विनाश कर दिया करते हैं और अत्यधिक वर्षा के द्वारा जल से सम्पूण जगत् को भर दिया करते हैं।१६का
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: ग्राहाश्चतुर्विधा ज्ञेया मद्गुराःशङ्कवस्तथा । उग्राश्च शिशुमाराश्चामीनाश्चैतान्व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: grāhāścaturvidhā jñeyā madgurāḥśaṅkavastathā / ugrāśca śiśumārāścāmīnāścaitānvyajāyata
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वृत्ता कर्मविकाराणि नैकानि जलचारिणाम् । तथा शङ्खविकाराणि जनयामास नैकशः
verses.transliteration: vṛttā karmavikārāṇi naikāni jalacāriṇām / tathā śaṅkhavikārāṇi janayāmāsa naikaśaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मण्डूकानां विकाराणि ह्यनुवृत्ता व्यजायत । ऐणेयानां विकाराणि शंबूकानां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: maṇḍūkānāṃ vikārāṇi hyanuvṛttā vyajāyata / aiṇeyānāṃ vikārāṇi śaṃbūkānāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तथा शुक्तिविकारणि वराटविकृतानि च । तथा शङ्खविकाराणि परिवृत्ता व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: tathā śuktivikāraṇi varāṭavikṛtāni ca / tathā śaṅkhavikārāṇi parivṛttā vyajāyata
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अथ भूमिजेलं खं च वायुश्चेकाणेवे तदा
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कालकण्ठविकाराणि जलूकाविकृतानि च । इत्येष हि ऋषावंशः पञ्चशाखः प्रकीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: kālakaṇṭhavikārāṇi jalūkāvikṛtāni ca / ityeṣa hi ṛṣāvaṃśaḥ pañcaśākhaḥ prakīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तिर्याहेतुक मप्याहुर्वहुलं वंशविस्तरम् । संस्वेदजविकाराणि यथा येभ्यो भवन्ति ह
verses.transliteration: tiryāhetuka mapyāhurvahulaṃ vaṃśavistaram / saṃsvedajavikārāṇi yathā yebhyo bhavanti ha
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: उस समय में तेज से समुदुभूत बह अग्नि जलों के द्वारा परिभूरित होकर फिर जल में प्रवेश कर जाया करती है। जब वर्षा से वहु अग्नि
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: स्वेदक्लिन्नशरीरेभ्यो यूकालिक्षादिका द्विजाः । मनुष्यस्वेदमलजा उशना नाम जन्तवः
verses.transliteration: svedaklinnaśarīrebhyo yūkālikṣādikā dvijāḥ / manuṣyasvedamalajā uśanā nāma jantavaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: विनष्ट हो जाती है तो यपोद भी पावकोदुभव हो जाया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नानापिपीलिकगणाः कीटका बहुपादकाः । शङ्खोपलविकाराणि कीलकावरकाणि च
verses.transliteration: nānāpipīlikagaṇāḥ kīṭakā bahupādakāḥ / śaṅkhopalavikārāṇi kīlakāvarakāṇi ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: बिशाल जलों उप्लवों से सम्पूणं जगतु प्लावित कर देते हैं ओर स्वयम्भु के
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमादिबहुलाः स्वेदजाः पार्थिवा गणाः । यथा घर्मदितप्पाभ्यश्चाभ्द्यो वृष्टिभ्य एव
verses.transliteration: ityevamādibahulāḥ svedajāḥ pārthivā gaṇāḥ / yathā gharmaditappābhyaścābhdyo vṛṣṭibhya eva

verses.hindi: द्वारा प्रेरित होते हुए अपनी धाराओं से इस जगत् को भर दिया करते हैं ।१७० कुछ अन्य मेघ अपने जलों के समुदायों से वेला को भी अभिभूत कर दिया करते हैं । सातों ढीपों के अन्दर जो भी जल था उसका पान कर लिया था और वह जल अभ्यत्र स्थित था ।१४१। फिर बही जल आकाण से
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नैका मृगशरीरेभ्यो जायन्ते जन्तवस्त्विमे । मक्षिकाः पिच्छला देशास्तथा तित्तिरिपुत्तिकाः
verses.transliteration: naikā mṛgaśarīrebhyo jāyante jantavastvime / makṣikāḥ picchalā deśāstathā tittiriputtikāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: नीचे भूमि में गिर रहा था । उस काल में आकाश में परम घोर स्वरूप बाला वायु सभो ओर से ढक लिया करता है ।१७२। उस समय में केवल परम घोर एक समुद्र ही दिखाई दिया करता है तथा अन्य स्थावर और जंगम स्वरूप पूणंतया वित£ हो जाता है। पूणं जब एक सहर बुगों की
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: नीलाचत्राश्च जायन्ते मलजा बहुविस्तराः । जलजाः स्वेदजाश्चैव जायन्ते जन्तस्त्विमे
verses.transliteration: nīlācatrāśca jāyante malajā bahuvistarāḥ / jalajāḥ svedajāścaiva jāyante jantastvime
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: चौकडी होती है तमी निःशेष कल्प कहा जाया करता है ।१७३। इसके अनन्तर जब जल के द्वारा यह लोक समावृत होजाता है तो बुध जन इसको एक मात्र सागर ही कहा करते हैं। इसके अनन्तर भूमि-जल--आकाश ओर वायु-इन सबका एक ही सागर हो जाता है ।१७४। अनल के नष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: काशतोयजकाः कीटा नलदा बहुपादकाः । सिंहला रोमलाश्चैव पिच्छिलाः परिकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: kāśatoyajakāḥ kīṭā naladā bahupādakāḥ / siṃhalā romalāścaiva picchilāḥ parikīrttitāḥ

verses.hindi: होने पर एकदम अन्धकार हो जाता है और उस समय में अन्य कुछ भी नहीं दिखाई देता है । पाथिब--अर्थात् पृथ्वी के भाग तथा सामुद्र अर्थात् समुद्र के भाग ये सभी ओर से हैव्य जल ही जल दिखाई दिया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमादिर्हि गणो जलजस्वेदजः स्मृतः । शिंबिभ्यो माषमुद्गानां जायन्ते कृमयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ityevamādirhi gaṇo jalajasvedajaḥ smṛtaḥ / śiṃbibhyo māṣamudgānāṃ jāyante kṛmayastathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: बिल्वजं ब्वाम्रपूमेभ्यः फलेभ्यश्चैव जन्तवः । मुद्गेभ्यः पनसेभ्यश्च तण्डुलेभ्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: bilvajaṃ bvāmrapūmebhyaḥ phalebhyaścaiva jantavaḥ / mudgebhyaḥ panasebhyaśca taṇḍulebhyastathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: एकार्णवे तदा ह्यो बै न शीन्नस्तेन ता नराः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तथा कोटरशुष्केभ्यो निहितेभ्यो भवन्ति हि । अन्येभ्यो ऽपि च जायन्ते न हि तेभ्यश्चिरं सदा
verses.transliteration: tathā koṭaraśuṣkebhyo nihitebhyo bhavanti hi / anyebhyo 'pi ca jāyante na hi tebhyaściraṃ sadā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: जन्तवस्तुरगादिभ्यो विषादिभ्यस्तथैव च । बहून्यहानि निक्षिप्ते संभवन्ति च गोमये
verses.transliteration: jantavasturagādibhyo viṣādibhyastathaiva ca / bahūnyahāni nikṣipte saṃbhavanti ca gomaye
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: जायन्ते कृमयो विप्राः काष्ठेभ्यश्चापि सर्वशः । संस्वेदजाश्च जायन्ते वृश्चिकाः शुष्कगोमयात्
verses.transliteration: jāyante kṛmayo viprāḥ kāṣṭhebhyaścāpi sarvaśaḥ / saṃsvedajāśca jāyante vṛścikāḥ śuṣkagomayāt
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गोभ्यो हि महिषेभ्यश्च तथान्येभ्यश्च जन्तवः । मत्स्याद्यिश्च विविधा अन्नकूटे विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: gobhyo hi mahiṣebhyaśca tathānyebhyaśca jantavaḥ / matsyādyiśca vividhā annakūṭe viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तदा स भवति ब्रह्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वैकारिकाश्च जायन्ते तथा गाजकुलानि च । तथन्यानि च सक्ष्माणि जलौकादीनि जातयः
verses.transliteration: vaikārikāśca jāyante tathā gājakulāni ca / tathanyāni ca sakṣmāṇi jalaukādīni jātayaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कपोतकुररादिभ्यः सूक्ष्माः शूकास्तथैव च । माक्षिकाणां विकाराणि जायन्ते जातयो ऽपरे
verses.transliteration: kapotakurarādibhyaḥ sūkṣmāḥ śūkāstathaiva ca / mākṣikāṇāṃ vikārāṇi jāyante jātayo 'pare
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: इनका सरण संथा नही होता है और सब एक रूपता को प्राप्त हो जाया करती हैं जिसका नाम सलिल ही होता है। बहू आगत और आग- तिक जो भी है वह सब सलिल ही कहा गया है।१७६। वह अर्णव नाम वाला जल इस समग्र पृथ्वी को प्रचुछादित कर लिया करता है। क्योंकि
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: प्रायेणानुवसंत्यस्मिन्नुच्छिष्टोदककर्द्दमे । मशकानां विकाराणि भ्रमराणां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: prāyeṇānuvasaṃtyasminnucchiṣṭodakakarddame / maśakānāṃ vikārāṇi bhramarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: उसकी भाओं से वहू आमात होता है । यहाँ भी शब्द व्याप्ति और दीप्ति में आया है ।१७७। वह सब भस्म को अनृप्राप्त करके ही--हुआ है अतएव अम्भ कहा जाया करता है । नानात्व में और शोत्र में अरधातु कही जाती है ।१७८। उस समय में एकाणंव में कल है और शीघ्र नहीं है इसीलिए वे
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गोभ्यः समभिजायन्ते पुत्तिकापुत्रसप्तकाः । मणिच्छेदाः स्मृता व्यालाः पोतजाः परिकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: gobhyaḥ samabhijāyante puttikāputrasaptakāḥ / maṇicchedāḥ smṛtā vyālāḥ potajāḥ parikīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: नरा हैं। उस एक सहत चारों की चौकडी के अन्त में ब्रह्माजी का एक दिन ब्पतीत होने पर उसने काल पर्यन्त यह जगत् एकाणंब के रूप में रहता है। बह समय ऐसा होता है कि उसमें प्रजापति के सभी व्यापार अर्थात् काये- शीलता निवृत्त हो जाते हैं ।१८०। उस समय में जब सभी स्थावर और
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शतवेरिविकाराणि करीषेभ्यो भवन्ति हि । एवमादिरसंख्यातो गणः संस्वेदजो मया
verses.transliteration: śataverivikārāṇi karīṣebhyo bhavanti hi / evamādirasaṃkhyāto gaṇaḥ saṃsvedajo mayā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: जंगम विनष्ट हो जाया करते हैं और एकमात्र अणंन हो रहता है तो एक ही ब्रह्माजी रहा करते हैं जो अनेक नेप्रों और चरणों बाले हैं ६८१ सहं मस्तकों बाले--सुन्दर मन से सम्पन्त--अनेक चरणों सहसौ्रों चक्षुओं से युक्त और अनेकों वाणियों वाले एवं सहस्र बाहुओं से संयुत प्रथम प्रजापति
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: समासाभिहितो ह्येष प्राक्कर्मवशजः स्मृतः । ये चान्ये नैरृताः सत्त्वास्ते स्मृता उपसर्गजाः
verses.transliteration: samāsābhihito hyeṣa prākkarmavaśajaḥ smṛtaḥ / ye cānye nairṛtāḥ sattvāste smṛtā upasargajāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अयीमय है जो पुरुष-इस नाम से कहा जाया करता है अर्थात बही परम पुरुष हैं

verses.sanskrit: भूतास्तु योनिजाः केचित्केचिदौत्पत्तिकाः स्मृताः । प्रायेण देवाः सर्वे वै विज्ञेया ह्युपपत्तिजाः
verses.transliteration: bhūtāstu yonijāḥ kecitkecidautpattikāḥ smṛtāḥ / prāyeṇa devāḥ sarve vai vijñeyā hyupapattijāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.transliteration: kecittu yonijā devāḥ keciddevā nimittataḥ / dullolakaṃ lalohaṃ ca saramā dvau vyajāyata

verses.sanskrit: त्योरपत्यं चत्वारो विज्ञेयाः सृमरादयः । श्यामाश्च शबलाश्चैव लोहिता अञ्जनास्तथा
verses.transliteration: tyorapatyaṃ catvāro vijñeyāḥ sṛmarādayaḥ / śyāmāśca śabalāścaiva lohitā añjanāstathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णधूम्ररुणास्चैव दुल्लो लस्याष्ट कद्रुकाः । सर्पाणां सुरसा जज्ञे शन्त नैकशिरोभृताम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇadhūmraruṇāscaiva dullo lasyāṣṭa kadrukāḥ / sarpāṇāṃ surasā jajñe śanta naikaśirobhṛtām

verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पुलहस्यात्मजः सर्गस्ताम्रायास्तु निबोधत । षट् कन्यास्त्वभिविख्यातास्ता म्रायाश्च विजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: pulahasyātmajaḥ sargastāmrāyāstu nibodhata / ṣaṭ kanyāstvabhivikhyātāstā mrāyāśca vijajñire
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गृध्री भासी शुकी क्रैञ्ची श्येनी च धृतराष्ट्रिका । अरुणस्य च गृद्री तु वीर्यवन्तौ महाबलौ
verses.transliteration: gṛdhrī bhāsī śukī kraiñcī śyenī ca dhṛtarāṣṭrikā / aruṇasya ca gṛdrī tu vīryavantau mahābalau
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: संपातिं च जटायुं च प्रसूता पक्षिसत्तमौ । संपातेर्विजयाः पुत्रा द्विरास्याः प्रसहश्च ये
verses.transliteration: saṃpātiṃ ca jaṭāyuṃ ca prasūtā pakṣisattamau / saṃpātervijayāḥ putrā dvirāsyāḥ prasahaśca ye

verses.sanskrit: जटायुषः पुराः पुत्राः ककगृध्राश्च कर्णिकाः । भार्या गरुत्मतश्चैव भासी क्रैञ्ची तथा शुकी
verses.transliteration: jaṭāyuṣaḥ purāḥ putrāḥ kakagṛdhrāśca karṇikāḥ / bhāryā garutmataścaiva bhāsī kraiñcī tathā śukī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्री तथा श्येनी तास्वपत्यानि वच्मिते । शुकीगरुत्मतः पुत्रान्सुषुवे षट् परिश्रुतान्
verses.transliteration: dhṛtarāṣṭrī tathā śyenī tāsvapatyāni vacmite / śukīgarutmataḥ putrānsuṣuve ṣaṭ pariśrutān

verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर सबकी रचना करने वाले महान तेजस्वी ने सब कुछ को अपनी ही आत्मा में रखकर फिर रात्रि में ही उस एकाणंव स्वरूप जल में निवास किया करता है ।१६०। फिर उस रात्रि का क्षय प्राप्त हो जाने पर प्रजापति जागते हैं और सृष्टि के सृजन करने की इच्छा से संयुत करने
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सुखं सुनेत्रं विशिखं सुरूपं सुरसं बलम् । तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च गरुडानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: sukhaṃ sunetraṃ viśikhaṃ surūpaṃ surasaṃ balam / teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca garuḍānāṃ mahātmanām

verses.hindi: के लिए मन किया करते हैं ।१९१। इसी रीति से वह लोक निवृ'त होता है जबकि प्रजापति उपशान्त हो जाघा करते हैं । वह प्रसंयम ब्राह्म और तैमि- तिक कल्पित होता है ।१६२। उसमें जीवों का अपने देहों से पूर्णतया वियोग कहा गया है । फिर सूर्य देव को परमाधिक संतप्त रश्मियों के द्वारा समस्त

verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi purāṇāṃ pannagāśinām / putrapautravisargācca teṣāṃ vai vaṃśavistaraiḥ
