verses.hindi: प्राणियों के दग्ध हो जाने पर सरंक्षय हो जाता है ।१९३। उस जल प्लावन में उस समय में देव-क्हूषि-मनुष्य-गस्घर्व-पिश्ञाच आदि जीव सभी यहाँ से जनलोक में निवास किया करते हैं तथा नरकगामी हैं उन सबका भी विनाश हो जाया करता है ।१९४-१९४। उस समय में वे भी पापों से रहित
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्तानि यानि स्थानानि तानि वक्ष्ये यथाक्रमम् । शाल्मलिद्वीपमखिलं देवकूटं च पर्वतम्
verses.transliteration: vyāptāni yāni sthānāni tāni vakṣye yathākramam / śālmalidvīpamakhilaṃ devakūṭaṃ ca parvatam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: होकर सब निर्दग्ध हो जाया करते हैं और वे सभी जब तक यह सम्पूर्ण जगत जलमय रहता है जल में ही निमग्न हो जाया करते हैं अर्थात् जल ही के रूप में पहले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मणिमन्तं च शैलेन्द्रं महस्रशिखरं तथा । पर्णमालं सुकेशं च शतशृङ्गं तथाचलम्
verses.transliteration: maṇimantaṃ ca śailendraṃ mahasraśikharaṃ tathā / parṇamālaṃ sukeśaṃ ca śataśṛṅgaṃ tathācalam
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: कौररं पञ्चशिखरं हेमकूटं च पर्वतम् । प्रचण्डवायुप्रजवैर्दीपितैः पद्मरागिभिः
verses.transliteration: kauraraṃ pañcaśikharaṃ hemakūṭaṃ ca parvatam / pracaṇḍavāyuprajavairdīpitaiḥ padmarāgibhiḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: यथा सूर्यस्य लोकेऽस्मिन्तुदयास्तमने स्मृते । तथा जन्मनिरोधश्च भूतानामिह इश्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: शैलशृङ्गाणि व्याप्तानि गारुडैस्तैर्महात्मभिः । भासीपुत्राः स्मृता भासा उलूकाः काककुक्कुटाः
verses.transliteration: śailaśṛṅgāṇi vyāptāni gāruḍaistairmahātmabhiḥ / bhāsīputrāḥ smṛtā bhāsā ulūkāḥ kākakukkuṭāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हृष्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा ब्रह्मद्युरात्रिषु । प्रत्याहारे विसर्गे च गतिमंति ध्रुवाणि च
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: मयूराः कलविङ्काश्च कपोतालावतित्तिराः । क्रैञ्चा वाध्रीणसाः श्येनाः कुरराः सारसा बकाः
verses.transliteration: mayūrāḥ kalaviṅkāśca kapotālāvatittirāḥ / kraiñcā vādhrīṇasāḥ śyenāḥ kurarāḥ sārasā bakāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: निष्क्रमन्ते विशंते च प्रजाः काले प्रजापतिम् । बरह्माणं सर्वभूतानि महायोगं महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमादयो ऽन्ये ऽपि क्रव्यादा ये च पक्षिणः । धृतराष्ट्री तु हंसाश्च कलहंसांश्च भामिनी
verses.transliteration: ityevamādayo 'nye 'pi kravyādā ye ca pakṣiṇaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsāśca kalahaṃsāṃśca bhāminī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: जिस समय में यह महानिशा नष्ट हो जाती है तब अव्यक्त योनि बाले ब्रह्म से वे सभी भूत पूर्ण रूप से फिर समुत्पन्न हो जाया करते हैं ।१९७। ऋषिगण-मनुगण-देवगण और सब चारों प्रकार की प्रजा और उन्हीं सिद्धों की निधनोत्पत्ति कही जाया करती हैं ।१६८। जिस प्रकार से इस
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: चक्रवाकांश्च विहगान्सर्वांश्चैवौदकान्द्विचान् । श्येन्यनन्तं विजज्ञे तु पुत्रपौत्रं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: cakravākāṃśca vihagānsarvāṃścaivaudakāndvicān / śyenyanantaṃ vijajñe tu putrapautraṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: लोक में सूयंदेब के उदय ओर अस्तमन कहे गये हैं उसी तरह से इन समस्त प्राणियों का जन्म और निरोध भी हुआ करता है जो कि सबको दिखाई दिया करता है। आत्मा तो नित्य है, उसका शरीर से वियोग ही निधन और संयोग जन्म कहा जाया करता है ।१६६। उस समस्त प्राणियों की जल
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गरुडस्यात्मजाः प्रोक्ता इरायाः शृणुत प्रजाः । इरा विजज्ञे कन्या वै तिस्रः कमललोजनाः
verses.transliteration: garuḍasyātmajāḥ proktā irāyāḥ śṛṇuta prajāḥ / irā vijajñe kanyā vai tisraḥ kamalalojanāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: तिमग्नता से उत्पन्न हो जाना ही संसार कहा जाया करता है। जेसे वर्षा होने पर यहाँ पर सब भूतों के साहित्य समुत्पन्न हुआ करते हैं ।२००। स्था- वर आदि सब प्रत्येक कल्प में तथा समरत प्रजा जेसे ऋतु काल में सभी ऋतु के चिहन नाना रूप वाले हो जाया करते हैं और बदल जाते हैं वसे
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वनस्पतीनां वृक्षाणां वीरुधां चैव मातरः । लता चैवालता चैति वीरुधा चैति तत्र या
verses.transliteration: vanaspatīnāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vīrudhāṃ caiva mātaraḥ / latā caivālatā caiti vīrudhā caiti tatra yā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ही सब समुत्पन्न होते हैं ।२०१। जिस तरह ते ब्रह्मा के दिन और रात्रि में हैं वही सबके सब दिखलाई दिया करते हैं । जब प्रत्याहरण होता है और विसगे होता है। उस समय में सभी निश्चित रूप से गतिमान् हुम करते हैं।२०२। समय के समुपस्थित हो जाने पर अपने ही आप ये सव प्रजाजन
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: लता वनस्पतिर्ज्जज्ञेपुष्पादपि फलावहान् । पुष्पैः फलग्रहैर्वृक्षानलता समसूयत
verses.transliteration: latā vanaspatirjjajñepuṣpādapi phalāvahān / puṣpaiḥ phalagrahairvṛkṣānalatā samasūyata
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: प्रजापति में प्रवेश और निष्क्रमण किया करते हैं। समस्त भूत ब्रह्माजी में
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गुल्मास्तथा लतावल्ल्यस्त्वकूसारास्तृणजातयः । वीरुधस्तदपत्यं हि वंशश्चात्र समाप्यते
verses.transliteration: gulmāstathā latāvallyastvakūsārāstṛṇajātayaḥ / vīrudhastadapatyaṃ hi vaṃśaścātra samāpyate
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: १०४   अह्याण्ड पुराण तथा महेश्वर में महायोग किया करते हैं अर्थात् सृजन काल में ब्रह्माजी में तथा संहरण काल में महेश्वर में इन सबका महान योग होता है
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एते कश्यपदायादा व्याख्याताः स्थाणुजङ्गमाः । तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च यैरिदं संततं जगत्
verses.transliteration: ete kaśyapadāyādā vyākhyātāḥ sthāṇujaṅgamāḥ / teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca yairidaṃ saṃtataṃ jagat
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: एष सर्गैकदेशस्य कीर्तितो ऽवयवो मया । मारीचो वः प्रजासर्गः समासेन प्रकीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: eṣa sargaikadeśasya kīrtito 'vayavo mayā / mārīco vaḥ prajāsargaḥ samāsena prakīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: ये चापि देवा मनवः प्रजेशा अन्येऽपि ये स्वगंगताश्र सिद्धाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यं व्यासतो वक्तुं वर्षाणां च शतैरपि । अदितिर्धर्मशीला तु बलशीला दितिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: na śakyaṃ vyāsato vaktuṃ varṣāṇāṃ ca śatairapi / aditirdharmaśīlā tu balaśīlā ditistathā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: तपःशीला तु सुरभिर्मायाशीला दनुस्तथा । गन्धशीला मुनिश्चैव क्रोधाध्यायनशीलिनी
verses.transliteration: tapaḥśīlā tu surabhirmāyāśīlā danustathā / gandhaśīlā muniścaiva krodhādhyāyanaśīlinī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: गीतशीला ह्यरिष्टा तु क्रूरशीला खशा स्मृता । क्रोधशीला तथा कदूः क्रोधा च शुचिशीलिनी
verses.transliteration: gītaśīlā hyariṣṭā tu krūraśīlā khaśā smṛtā / krodhaśīlā tathā kadūḥ krodhā ca śuciśīlinī
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: वाहशीला तु विनता ताम्रा वै घातशीलिनी । इरानुग्रहशीला तु ह्यनायुर्भक्षणे रता
verses.transliteration: vāhaśīlā tu vinatā tāmrā vai ghātaśīlinī / irānugrahaśīlā tu hyanāyurbhakṣaṇe ratā
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: करुपों के आदि काल में बार-बार समस्त प्राणियों का वही सृजन करने बाला हुआ करता है। महादेव का स्वरूप व्यक्‍त और अव्यक्त है और उसी का यह सम्पूर्ण जगत हुआ करता है ।२०४ जिसके ही द्वारा ये सबं प्रथम सृष्ट हुए हैं वे जल समग्र इसी महीतल में मागं के द्वारा चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: अभवंल्लोकमातॄणां शीलान्येतानि सर्वशः । धर्मतः शीलतो बुद्ध्या क्षमया बलरूपतः
verses.transliteration: abhavaṃllokamātṝṇāṃ śīlānyetāni sarvaśaḥ / dharmataḥ śīlato buddhyā kṣamayā balarūpataḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: हैं। जैसे पूर्व में यह गमन कर गये हैं उसी मार्ग से फिर भी स्वगं में चले आते हैं ।२०४। जो भी उनका कमं शुभ अथवा अशुभ होता है उसी के अनुसार वे वहाँ-वहाँ अन्य देहों में स्थित रहते हुए सूयं के वंश में रहकर ऊध्वं में अर्थात् देवलोक में और अघो माग में अर्थात् नरकों में सञ्चरण
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: रजः सत्त्व तमोद्रिक्ता धार्मिकाधार्मिकाश्च वै । मातुस्तुल्याभिजाताश्च कश्यपस्यात्मजाः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: rajaḥ sattva tamodriktā dhārmikādhārmikāśca vai / mātustulyābhijātāśca kaśyapasyātmajāḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: किया करते हैं ।२०६। और जो भी देवगण और मनुगण हैं--भ्रवेश और अन्य भी जो स्वग में गये हुए सिद्ध है वे सब उसी से होने वाले तथा ख्याति के वश होने से धर्म से मुक्‍त होते हुए प्राणी फिर विसमे के द्वारा हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: देवतासुरगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः । पिशाचाः पशवश्चैव मृगाः पतगवीरुधः
verses.transliteration: devatāsuragandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ / piśācāḥ paśavaścaiva mṛgāḥ patagavīrudhaḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: करते हैं ।२०७। इसके आगे आभूत संप्लव अर्थात् समस्त प्राणियों को जल- मग्न हो जाना मैं उस काल के विषय में वर्णन करू'गा । है द्विजो ! जो-जो भी मन्वन्तर होते हैं। उन सबको मैंने बतला ही दिया है ।२०८। प्रजाओं के निसर्ग और देवों के साथ चतुर्दश होते हैं। वह सहस्र युगाख्या है उसी में
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्दाक्षायणीष्वेते जज्ञिरे मानुषीष्पिह । मनुष्यप्रकृतीस्तस्माद्देवादींश्च विजानते
verses.transliteration: yasmāddākṣāyaṇīṣvete jajñire mānuṣīṣpiha / manuṣyaprakṛtīstasmāddevādīṃśca vijānate
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: सभी अन्तर होते हैं ।२०९। इस गुगारुया के जब पूर्ण हो सहस्र होते हैं तब विशेष कल्प कहा जाया करता है । यही ब्रह्माजी का दिन समझना चाहिए। उसकी संख्या को भी समझ लो
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: यस्माच्च संभवः कृत्स्नो देवानां मानुषेष्विह । मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठास्तु मानुषाः
verses.transliteration: yasmācca saṃbhavaḥ kṛtsno devānāṃ mānuṣeṣviha / manvantareṣu sarveṣu tasmācchreṣṭhāstu mānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां मानुषाः साधकास्तु वै । ततोर्ऽवाक्स्रोतसस्ते वै उत्पद्यन्ते सुरासुराः
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāḥ sādhakāstu vai / tator'vāksrotasaste vai utpadyante surāsurāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: नव क्षणस्तु पंचव विशस्काष्ठा त् ते त्रय: ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: जायन्ते कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं मानुषेषु पुनः पुनः । इत्येष वंशप्रभवः प्रसंख्यातस्तु विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: jāyante kāryasiddhyarthaṃ mānuṣeṣu punaḥ punaḥ / ityeṣa vaṃśaprabhavaḥ prasaṃkhyātastu vistarāt
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: सुराणामसुराणां च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा । यक्षरक्षः पिशाचानां सुपर्णोरगपक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca gandharvāpsarasāṃ tathā / yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācānāṃ suparṇoragapakṣiṇām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: अहोरात्रं कलानां तु अधिकानि शतानि षट् ।
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: व्यालानां शिखिनां चैव औषधीनां च सर्वशः । कृमिकीटपतङ्गानां क्षुद्राणां जलचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: vyālānāṃ śikhināṃ caiva auṣadhīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ kṣudrāṇāṃ jalacāriṇām
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: पशूनां ब्राह्मणानां च श्रीमतां पुण्यलक्षणः । आयुष्यश्चैव धन्यश्च श्रीमान् हितसुखावहः । श्रोतव्यश्चैव सततं ग्राह्यश्चैवानसूयतः
verses.transliteration: paśūnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śrīmatāṃ puṇyalakṣaṇaḥ / āyuṣyaścaiva dhanyaśca śrīmān hitasukhāvahaḥ / śrotavyaścaiva satataṃ grāhyaścaivānasūyataḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: क्षण के लाभ से निमेष की मात्रा होती है। मनुष्य की आँखों की पलकें जो चलती हैं उसी काल को निमेष कहा जाता है। ऐसे पन निमेषों की एक काष्ठा होती है । नौ और पाँच क्षण ही बीस काष्ठा है । वे तीन तथा साधिक सात प्रस्थोदक लव कहा गया है ।२११-२१२। तीस लब
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: इमं तु वंशं नियमेन यः पठेन्महात्मनां ब्राह्मणवन्द्यसंसदि । अपत्यलाभं लभते च पुष्कलं प्रियं धनं प्रेत्य च शोभनां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ tu vaṃśaṃ niyamena yaḥ paṭhenmahātmanāṃ brāhmaṇavandyasaṃsadi / apatyalābhaṃ labhate ca puṣkalaṃ priyaṃ dhanaṃ pretya ca śobhanāṃ gatim
verses.translation: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.hindi: की एक कला होती है और तीस कला का-एक मुह॒त्त होता है । यही स्थिति हुआ करती है ।२१२। कलाओं का अहोरात्र साधिक शत और छे है । वे ही संख्या से जेसी चन्द्र और सूर्य की गति होती है जान लेनी
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads about the race of the noble souls in the honoured assembly of Brahmanas attains good progeny, plenty of wealth and splendid goal after death/'

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे काश्यपेयवर्णनं नाम सप्तमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एवं प्रजासु सृष्टासु कश्यपेन महात्मना । प्रतिष्ठितासु सर्वासु चरासु स्थावरासु च
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde kāśyapeyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca evaṃ prajāsu sṛṣṭāsu kaśyapena mahātmanā / pratiṣṭhitāsu sarvāsu carāsu sthāvarāsu ca
verses.translation: He installed as king Soma, iti the kingdom of Brahmanas, creepers, constellations, planets, Yajfias and austerities.
verses.wordMeaning: He installed as king Soma, iti the kingdom of Brahmanas, creepers, constellations, planets, Yajfias and austerities.
verses.commentary: Sense: He installed as king Soma, iti the kingdom of Brahmanas, creepers, constellations, planets, Yajfias and austerities.

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिच्याधिपत्येषु तेषां मुख्यान्प्रजापतिः । ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि आदेष्टुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: abhiṣicyādhipatyeṣu teṣāṃ mukhyānprajāpatiḥ / tataḥ krameṇa rājyāni ādeṣṭumupacakrame
verses.translation: He gave the overlordship of all the Angiras to Bfhaspati. He anointed Kavya (i.e. Sukra) as the ruler over the kingdom ofBhrgus.
verses.hindi: चाहिए ।२१४। पन्द्रह निमेष काष्ठा है और तीस काष्ठाओं की कला होती है। तीस कला का मूह होता है। दशभाग हो कला कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: He gave the overlordship of all the Angiras to Bfhaspati. He anointed Kavya (i.e. Sukra) as the ruler over the kingdom ofBhrgus.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave the overlordship of all the Angiras to Bfhaspati. He anointed Kavya (i.e. Sukra) as the ruler over the kingdom ofBhrgus.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजानां वीरुधां चैव नक्षत्राणां ग्रहैः सह । यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोमं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: dvijānāṃ vīrudhāṃ caiva nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahaiḥ saha / yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva somaṃ rājye 'bhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: Then he made Visnu, the leader of the Adityas, Pavaka ( fire-god ) as the leader of Vasiis, Daksa chief of the Prajapatis and Vasava (Indra), as the head of Maruts.
verses.hindi: चालीस कलाओं के पाँच मुहूत्त' संज्ञा होती है । ये मूह और लव प्रमाणो के ज्ञाताओं के द्वारा कल्पित किये हैं। उसी भाँति से इसके द्वारा जल के भी तरह पल होते हैं। मागध मान से भी जल प्रस्थ किया जाता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then he made Visnu, the leader of the Adityas, Pavaka ( fire-god ) as the leader of Vasiis, Daksa chief of the Prajapatis and Vasava (Indra), as the head of Maruts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he made Visnu, the leader of the Adityas, Pavaka ( fire-god ) as the leader of Vasiis, Daksa chief of the Prajapatis and Vasava (Indra), as the head of Maruts.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिं तु विश्वेषां ददावङ्गिरसां पतिम् । भृगूणामधिपं चैव काव्यं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiṃ tu viśveṣāṃ dadāvaṅgirasāṃ patim / bhṛgūṇāmadhipaṃ caiva kāvyaṃ rājye 'bhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: He made Prahlada, the delighter of Diti, the king of Daityas, Narayana, of the Sadhyas and the bull-bannered god as the king of Rudras.
verses.wordMeaning: He made Prahlada, the delighter of Diti, the king of Daityas, Narayana, of the Sadhyas and the bull-bannered god as the king of Rudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Prahlada, the delighter of Diti, the king of Daityas, Narayana, of the Sadhyas and the bull-bannered god as the king of Rudras.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यानां पुनर्विष्णुं वसूनामथ पावकम् । प्रजापतीनां दक्षं च मरुतामथ वासवम्
verses.transliteration: ādityānāṃ punarviṣṇuṃ vasūnāmatha pāvakam / prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ ca marutāmatha vāsavam
verses.translation: He made the trident-bearing Giriia, the lord of all Bhutas (goblins) and the Pisacas (ghosts); mount Himavan; the leader of all mountains and the ocean, the king of rivers.
verses.hindi: समाहति च रात्रौ च मुहूर्ता वै द्विनालिका: ।
verses.wordMeaning: He made the trident-bearing Giriia, the lord of all Bhutas (goblins) and the Pisacas (ghosts); mount Himavan; the leader of all mountains and the ocean, the king of rivers.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made the trident-bearing Giriia, the lord of all Bhutas (goblins) and the Pisacas (ghosts); mount Himavan; the leader of all mountains and the ocean, the king of rivers.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यानामथ राजानं प्रह्रादं दितिनन्दनम् । नारायणं तु साध्यानां रुद्रणां च वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: daityānāmatha rājānaṃ prahrādaṃ ditinandanam / nārāyaṇaṃ tu sādhyānāṃ rudraṇāṃ ca vṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: He made Citraratha the overlord of Gandharvas, and crowned Uccais£ravas as the king of horses.
verses.wordMeaning: He made Citraratha the overlord of Gandharvas, and crowned Uccais£ravas as the king of horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Citraratha the overlord of Gandharvas, and crowned Uccais£ravas as the king of horses.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रचित्तिं च राजानं दानवानामथादिशत् । अपां च वरुणं राज्ये राज्ञां वैश्रवणं तथा
verses.transliteration: vipracittiṃ ca rājānaṃ dānavānāmathādiśat / apāṃ ca varuṇaṃ rājye rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: He made Sardula (tiger) the king of all deer or animals in genera], and Govfsa (Bull) the king of all animals having humps. He made Garuda, the most excellent one among those who fly, the king of all birds.
verses.hindi: यदहो ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्तः दिव्या कोटी तु सा स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: He made Sardula (tiger) the king of all deer or animals in genera], and Govfsa (Bull) the king of all animals having humps. He made Garuda, the most excellent one among those who fly, the king of all birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Sardula (tiger) the king of all deer or animals in genera], and Govfsa (Bull) the king of all animals having humps. He made Garuda, the most excellent one among those who fly, the king of all birds.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पार्थिवानां धनस्य च । वैवस्वतं पितॄणां च यमं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca pārthivānāṃ dhanasya ca / vaivasvataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca yamaṃ rājye 'bhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: He made Vayu the most excellent of all powerful ones, the leader of fragrant smells, Maruts and unembodied living beings who have (however) great strength at the same time.
verses.hindi: ये धारा घलुत प्रस्थ नालिकोञ्चय चार हैं । चार अ'गुल चार हेम- माषों से कृतच्छिद्र है (२१८ सम दिन में ओर राभि में द्विजालि का मुहुत्त होते हैं । नित्य ही इन सबों में रवि की गति बिशेष से होते हैं ।२१६। और अधिक छं सो कलाओं का प्रविधान किया जाता है । वह मनुष्यो का दिन
verses.wordMeaning: He made Vayu the most excellent of all powerful ones, the leader of fragrant smells, Maruts and unembodied living beings who have (however) great strength at the same time.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Vayu the most excellent of all powerful ones, the leader of fragrant smells, Maruts and unembodied living beings who have (however) great strength at the same time.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतपिशाचाना गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम् । शैलानां हिमवन्तं च नदीनामथ सागरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtapiśācānā giriśaṃ śūlapāṇinam / śailānāṃ himavantaṃ ca nadīnāmatha sāgaram
verses.translation: He made §e$a the leader of all those who have fangs, Vasuki the leader of Nagas (snakes ) and Taksaka the leader of Sansrpas (reptiles), Sarpas (Cobras) and Pannagas (serpents).
verses.hindi: समझना चाहिए ओर जो नक्षत्र है वह दशाधिक होता है ।२२१। इस दिन से जो संख्या होती है वह मास-ऋतु-अयन बोर वर्ष की होती है। उस समय में यह बद्धज्ञान संज्ञा के द्वारा उपलक्षित होता है ।२२२। कलाओं का जो परिमाण है वह कला--इस नाम ये कहा जाया करता है । जो ब्रह्माजी
verses.wordMeaning: He made §e$a the leader of all those who have fangs, Vasuki the leader of Nagas (snakes ) and Taksaka the leader of Sansrpas (reptiles), Sarpas (Cobras) and Pannagas (serpents).
verses.commentary: Sense: He made §e$a the leader of all those who have fangs, Vasuki the leader of Nagas (snakes ) and Taksaka the leader of Sansrpas (reptiles), Sarpas (Cobras) and Pannagas (serpents).

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाणामधिपतिं चक्रे चित्ररथं तथा । उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां राजानं चाभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: gandharvāṇāmadhipatiṃ cakre citrarathaṃ tathā / uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ rājānaṃ cābhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: He installed Paijanya, one of the Adityas, as the lord of oceans, rivers, clouds and the showering rains.
verses.hindi: का दिन कहा गया है वह दिव्य कोटी कही गयी है।२२३। शतों के सहस्र दश ही से गुणित होते हैं नब्बे सहस्र और उसो भाँति जो अन्य हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He installed Paijanya, one of the Adityas, as the lord of oceans, rivers, clouds and the showering rains.
verses.commentary: Sense: He installed Paijanya, one of the Adityas, as the lord of oceans, rivers, clouds and the showering rains.

verses.sanskrit: मृगाणामथ शार्दूलं गोवृषं च ककुद्मिनाम् । पक्षिणामथ सर्वेषां गरुडं पततां वरम्
verses.transliteration: mṛgāṇāmatha śārdūlaṃ govṛṣaṃ ca kakudminām / pakṣiṇāmatha sarveṣāṃ garuḍaṃ patatāṃ varam
verses.translation: This entire earth consisting of seven continents and along with the cities is being protected righteously by them within their respective territories.
verses.wordMeaning: This entire earth consisting of seven continents and along with the cities is being protected righteously by them within their respective territories.
verses.commentary: Sense: This entire earth consisting of seven continents and along with the cities is being protected righteously by them within their respective territories.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धानां मरुतां चैव भूतानामशरीरिणाम् । समकालबलानां च वायुं बलवतां वरम्
verses.transliteration: gandhānāṃ marutāṃ caiva bhūtānāmaśarīriṇām / samakālabalānāṃ ca vāyuṃ balavatāṃ varam
verses.translation: They were formerly crowded in Svayambhuva Manvantara by Brahma. Those who become Manu are anoin- ted as kings. In those Manvantaras which have gone by, these kings had ruled and had gone away. When another Man- vantara comes, others will be crowned. All the rulers (of Man- vantaras whether) gone by or yet to come are declared as the overlords of the Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: तेषां श्रवा स देवस्तु वायुर्लोकहिते रतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: They were formerly crowded in Svayambhuva Manvantara by Brahma. Those who become Manu are anoin- ted as kings. In those Manvantaras which have gone by, these kings had ruled and had gone away. When another Man- vantara comes, others will be crowned.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were formerly crowded in Svayambhuva Manvantara by Brahma. Those who become Manu are anoin- ted as kings. In those Manvantaras which have gone by, these kings had ruled and had gone away. When another Man- vantara comes, others will be crowned.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां दंष्ट्रिणां शेषं नागानामथ वासुकिम् । सरीसृपाणां सर्पाणां पन्नगानां च तक्षकम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ śeṣaṃ nāgānāmatha vāsukim / sarīsṛpāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ pannagānāṃ ca takṣakam
verses.translation: Nidhruvas, Santfilas and Raibhyas — these are the three branches of the line of Kafyapa. The thunderbolt-wield- ing Indra and other Devas are among the children (of Kafyapa).
verses.hindi: एते रात्र्यहनी पूर्व कीतिते त्विह लौकिके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Nidhruvas, Santfilas and Raibhyas — these are the three branches of the line of Kafyapa. The thunderbolt-wield- ing Indra and other Devas are among the children (of Kafyapa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Nidhruvas, Santfilas and Raibhyas — these are the three branches of the line of Kafyapa. The thunderbolt-wield- ing Indra and other Devas are among the children (of Kafyapa).

verses.sanskrit: सागराणां नदीनां च मेघानां वर्षितस्य च । आदित्यानामन्यतमं पर्जन्यमभिषिक्तवान्
verses.transliteration: sāgarāṇāṃ nadīnāṃ ca meghānāṃ varṣitasya ca / ādityānāmanyatamaṃ parjanyamabhiṣiktavān
verses.translation: (Their birth took place) when the Dvapara Yuga began to function after the eleventh set of four Yugas of Manu, the lord of the Manvantara had elapsed.
verses.hindi: तासां संख्याथ वर्षाग्र' ब्राह्मो वक्ष्याम्यहः क्षये
verses.wordMeaning: (Their birth took place) when the Dvapara Yuga began to function after the eleventh set of four Yugas of Manu, the lord of the Manvantara had elapsed.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Their birth took place) when the Dvapara Yuga began to function after the eleventh set of four Yugas of Manu, the lord of the Manvantara had elapsed.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाप्सरोगणानां च कामदेवं तथा प्रभुम् । ऋतूनामथ मासानामार्त्तवानां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: sarvāpsarogaṇānāṃ ca kāmadevaṃ tathā prabhum / ṛtūnāmatha māsānāmārttavānāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: He became king in the beginning of the third Tret&- yuga. Ilavila born of the womb of Alambu§a was his daughter.
verses.wordMeaning: He became king in the beginning of the third Tret&- yuga. Ilavila born of the womb of Alambu§a was his daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He became king in the beginning of the third Tret&- yuga. Ilavila born of the womb of Alambu§a was his daughter.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाणां च विपक्षाणां मुहूर्त्तानां च पर्वणाम् । कलाकाष्ठाप्रमाणानां गतेरयनयोस्तथा
verses.transliteration: yakṣāṇāṃ ca vipakṣāṇāṃ muhūrttānāṃ ca parvaṇām / kalākāṣṭhāpramāṇānāṃ gaterayanayostathā
verses.translation: Kaikasi gave birth to Ravana, Kumbhakarna and
verses.hindi: द्वाभिशच्च तया कोटयः संख्याताः संख्यया द्विजैः
verses.wordMeaning: Kaikasi gave birth to Ravana, Kumbhakarna and
verses.commentary: Sense: Kaikasi gave birth to Ravana, Kumbhakarna and

verses.sanskrit: गणितस्याथ योगस्य चक्रे संवत्सरं प्रभुम् । प्रजापतेर्विरजसः पूर्वस्यां दिशि विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: gaṇitasyātha yogasya cakre saṃvatsaraṃ prabhum / prajāpatervirajasaḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi viśrutam
verses.translation: W. 47-54. The author if familiar with the traditional Rama story but his description of R£va$a is peculiar.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 47-54. The author if familiar with the traditional Rama story but his description of R£va$a is peculiar.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 47-54. The author if familiar with the traditional Rama story but his description of R£va$a is peculiar.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं नाम्ना सुधन्वानं राजानं सो ऽभ्यषेचयत् । दक्षिणास्यां दिशि तथा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: putraṃ nāmnā sudhanvānaṃ rājānaṃ so 'bhyaṣecayat / dakṣiṇāsyāṃ diśi tathā kardamasya prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Thus these ten Raksasas, the descendants of Pulastya, were of very cruel activities. They are of very terrible pursuits ever since their birth. All of these were unassailable even to the Devas.
verses.hindi: अशीतिश्च सहस्राणि एप कालः प्लवस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these ten Raksasas, the descendants of Pulastya, were of very cruel activities. They are of very terrible pursuits ever since their birth. All of these were unassailable even to the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these ten Raksasas, the descendants of Pulastya, were of very cruel activities. They are of very terrible pursuits ever since their birth. All of these were unassailable even to the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रां शङ्खपदं नाम राजानं सोभ्यषेचयत् । पस्चिमस्यां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: putrāṃ śaṅkhapadaṃ nāma rājānaṃ sobhyaṣecayat / pascimasyāṃ diśi tathā rajasaḥ putramacyutam
verses.translation: He had ten beautiful wives who were very chaste.1 All those ten were the children of Bhadra£va begot of Ghrtaci the celestial damsel.
verses.wordMeaning: He had ten beautiful wives who were very chaste.1 All those ten were the children of Bhadra£va begot of Ghrtaci the celestial damsel.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had ten beautiful wives who were very chaste.1 All those ten were the children of Bhadra£va begot of Ghrtaci the celestial damsel.

verses.sanskrit: केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं चाभ्यषेचयत् । तथा हिरण्यरोमाणं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: ketumantaṃ mahātmānaṃ rājānaṃ cābhyaṣecayat / tathā hiraṇyaromāṇaṃ parjanyasya prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: W. 74-86 describe the descendants of Atri, the 3rd PriyApati
verses.wordMeaning: W. 74-86 describe the descendants of Atri, the 3rd PriyApati
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 74-86 describe the descendants of Atri, the 3rd PriyApati

verses.sanskrit: उदीच्यां दिशि दुर्द्धर्षपुत्रं राज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत् । मनुष्याणामधिपतिं चक्रे वैवस्वतं मनुम्
verses.transliteration: udīcyāṃ diśi durddharṣaputraṃ rājye 'bhyaṣecayat / manuṣyāṇāmadhipatiṃ cakre vaivasvataṃ manum
verses.translation: Among the descendants of his (i.e. Atri) four are well renowned on the earth. viz. Syavasvas, Mudgalas, Vagbhu- takas and Gavi$fhiras.
verses.hindi: समस्त ऋषियों ने जब यह मुना तो उनको बहुत ही अधिक आश्चर्य हुआ था। उस समय में पुनः इस संख्या के संमजन के ज्ञान को पूछा था
verses.wordMeaning: Among the descendants of his (i.e. Atri) four are well renowned on the earth. viz. Syavasvas, Mudgalas, Vagbhu- takas and Gavi$fhiras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the descendants of his (i.e. Atri) four are well renowned on the earth. viz. Syavasvas, Mudgalas, Vagbhu- takas and Gavi$fhiras.

verses.sanskrit: तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपत्तना । यथाप्रदेशमद्यापि धर्मेण परिपाल्यते
verses.transliteration: tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā / yathāpradeśamadyāpi dharmeṇa paripālyate
verses.translation: The following lour (also) are remembered as be- longing to the side (family) of Atris. They are of very great power. They are Kasyapa, Narada, Parvata and Arundhati.
verses.hindi: सम्मत होता है । अब हम लोग मान के द्वारा संक्षेपार्थ पदाक्षर को श्रवण करने की इच्छा करते हैं ।२२६। उनके इस वचन को सुनकर लोगों के हित में रति रखने वाले वायु देव ने जो प्रमु दिव्य चक, वाले ये यह वचन बोले
verses.wordMeaning: The following lour (also) are remembered as be- longing to the side (family) of Atris. They are of very great power. They are Kasyapa, Narada, Parvata and Arundhati.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following lour (also) are remembered as be- longing to the side (family) of Atris. They are of very great power. They are Kasyapa, Narada, Parvata and Arundhati.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवेन्तरे पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा ते ऽभिषेचिताः । नृपाश्चैते ऽभिषिच्यन्ते मनवो ये भवन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuventare pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā te 'bhiṣecitāḥ / nṛpāścaite 'bhiṣicyante manavo ye bhavanti vai
verses.translation: These were the mental progeny (of Atri). Undec- stand ( the progeny) of Arundhati.
verses.hindi: हैं और यहाँ पर माने जाते हैं वे तो अपने पूवं में ही वर्णन कर दिए है। उनकी सख्या और इसके पश्चात् वर्षाग्र ब्राह्म क्षय में बताऊ गा
verses.wordMeaning: These were the mental progeny (of Atri). Undec- stand ( the progeny) of Arundhati.
verses.commentary: Sense: These were the mental progeny (of Atri). Undec- stand ( the progeny) of Arundhati.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेष्वतीतेषु गता ह्येतेषु पार्थिवाः । एवमन्ये ऽभिषिच्यन्ते प्राप्ते मन्वन्तरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣvatīteṣu gatā hyeteṣu pārthivāḥ / evamanye 'bhiṣicyante prāpte manvantare punaḥ
verses.translation: By means of his penance the intelligent Vasistha enlivened the subjects by making the medicinal herbs.
verses.hindi: १०८   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण चार सौ करोड़ मानवों के वर्ष तथा बत्तीस करोड़ द्विजों के द्वारा संख्या से सं्यात हैं ।२२६। उसी भांति एकत सौ सहस्र और फिर उन्यासी अस्सो सहस्र यह उस महान् प्लव का काल होता है ।२३०। यह आभूत संप्लव का
verses.wordMeaning: By means of his penance the intelligent Vasistha enlivened the subjects by making the medicinal herbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his penance the intelligent Vasistha enlivened the subjects by making the medicinal herbs.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागताः सर्वे स्मृता मन्वन्तरेश्वराः । राजसूये ऽभिषिक्तश्च पृथु रेभिर्नरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: atītānāgatāḥ sarve smṛtā manvantareśvarāḥ / rājasūye 'bhiṣiktaśca pṛthu rebhirnarottamaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: काल मानुष नामक संख्या से गिनकर बताया गया है । जिसमें समस्त आणियों का संक्षय होकर सर्वत्र जल ही जल हो जाता है उस्ती को आभूत संप्लव कहा जाया करता है । सात सूर्यो के द्वारा उस समय में उन लोकों के प्रदग्ध होने पर चारों प्रकार की सम्पूणं प्रजा महाभूतो में लीन हो जाया
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: वेददृष्टेन विधिना ह्यधिराजः प्रतापवान् । एतानुत्पाद्य पुत्रांस्तु प्रजासन्तानकारणात्
verses.transliteration: vedadṛṣṭena vidhinā hyadhirājaḥ pratāpavān / etānutpādya putrāṃstu prajāsantānakāraṇāt
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: करती है  जरायुज--स्वेदज--अण्डज और उद्भिज--ये प्रजा के चार प्रकार होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरेव महा भागः प्रजानां पतिरीश्वरः । कश्यपो गोत्रकामस्तु चचार परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: punareva mahā bhāgaḥ prajānāṃ patirīśvaraḥ / kaśyapo gotrakāmastu cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रौ गोत्रकरौ मह्यं भवेतामिति चिन्तयन् । तस्यप्रध्यायमानस्य कश्यपस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: putrau gotrakarau mahyaṃ bhavetāmiti cintayan / tasyapradhyāyamānasya kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: निरालोके प्रदो तु नेशेत तमसा वृते
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मण्ॐऽशौ सुतौ पश्चात्प्रादुर्भूतौ महौजसौ । वत्सारश्चासितश्चैव तावुभौ ब्रह्म वादना
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇoṃ'śau sutau paścātprādurbhūtau mahaujasau / vatsāraścāsitaścaiva tāvubhau brahma vādanā
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सारान्निध्रुवो जज्ञे रेभ्यश्च सुहमायशाः । रेभ्यस्य रैभ्यो विज्ञेयो निध्रुवस्य निबोधत
verses.transliteration: vatsārānnidhruvo jajñe rebhyaśca suhamāyaśāḥ / rebhyasya raibhyo vijñeyo nidhruvasya nibodhata
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: च्यवनस्य सुकन्याया सुमेधाः समपद्यत । निध्रुवस्य तु या पत्नी माता वै कुण्डपायिराम्
verses.transliteration: cyavanasya sukanyāyā sumedhāḥ samapadyata / nidhruvasya tu yā patnī mātā vai kuṇḍapāyirām
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: असितस्यैकपर्णायां ब्रह्मिष्ठः समपद्यत । शाण्डिल्यानां वरः श्रीमान् देवलः सुमहायशाः
verses.transliteration: asitasyaikaparṇāyāṃ brahmiṣṭhaḥ samapadyata / śāṇḍilyānāṃ varaḥ śrīmān devalaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: तरलोक्ये यानि सत्वानि गतिमंति ध्रुवाणि च
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: निध्रुवाः शाण्डिला रैभ्यास्त्रयः पक्षास्तु काश्यपाः । वज्रिप्रभृतयो देवा देवास्तस्य प्रजा स्विमाः
verses.transliteration: nidhruvāḥ śāṇḍilā raibhyāstrayaḥ pakṣāstu kāśyapāḥ / vajriprabhṛtayo devā devāstasya prajā svimāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्युगे त्वतिक्रान्ते मनोर्ह्येकादशे प्रभोः । अथावशिष्टे तस्मिंस्तु द्वापरे संप्रर्त्तिते
verses.transliteration: caturyuge tvatikrānte manorhyekādaśe prabhoḥ / athāvaśiṣṭe tasmiṃstu dvāpare saṃprarttite
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: उस समय में सम्पूर्ण लोक जल से समाप्लुत होकर नष्ट हो जाया करता है और सभी स्थावर तथा ज्म विनष्ट हो जाया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्तस्य नरिष्यं तस्तस्य पुत्रो दमः किल । राज्यवर्द्धनकस्तस्य सुधृतिस्तत्सुतो नरः
verses.transliteration: maruttasya nariṣyaṃ tastasya putro damaḥ kila / rājyavarddhanakastasya sudhṛtistatsuto naraḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: समग्र संहार के समीप हो जाने पर और प्रजापति के उपशान्त होने पर तथा सत्र प्रकाश से रहित एवं द्ध तया राजि के अन्धकार से आदृत होने पर
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: केवलश्च ततस्तस्य बन्धुमान्वेगवांस्ततः । बुधस्तस्या भवद्यस्या तृणबिन्दुर्महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: kevalaśca tatastasya bandhumānvegavāṃstataḥ / budhastasyā bhavadyasyā tṛṇabindurmahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: और सवत्र एक ही अणंब था । यह तब तक एकाणंव का स्वरूप था जब
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: त्रेतायुगमुखे राजा तृतीये स बभूव ह । तस्य चेलविला कन्यालंबुषागर्भसंभवा
verses.transliteration: tretāyugamukhe rājā tṛtīye sa babhūva ha / tasya celavilā kanyālaṃbuṣāgarbhasaṃbhavā
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: उसी को दिन कहा गया है । इसी रोति से इनका अहोरात्र क्रम से परिव- त्तित हुआ करता है ।२३५॥ यह आभूत संप्लव प्रभु का अहोरात्र कह गया है । इन तीनों लोकों में जो भो प्राणो हैं वे सभी गतिमान् और ध्र. हैं ।२३६। जितने भी भूत हैं वे समी प्रलीन होते हैं इसी कारण से इसका
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां जातो विश्रवास्तु वौलस्त्यकुलवर्द्धनः । बृहस्पतिबृर्हत्कीर्तिर्देवाचार्यस्तु कीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ jāto viśravāstu vaulastyakulavarddhanaḥ / bṛhaspatibṛrhatkīrtirdevācāryastu kīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: नाम आभूत संप्लव होता है । जो व्यतीत हो चुके हैं--जो भी वत्तंमान है और जो प्रजा अनागत हैं और अपराधं से गुणी वृत हैं। पराधं द्विगुण है और यही परम आयु कोतित की गयी है
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यां तस्योपयेमे स नाम्ना वै देववर्णिनीम् । पुष्पोत्कटां च वाकां च सुते माल्यवतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kanyāṃ tasyopayeme sa nāmnā vai devavarṇinīm / puṣpotkaṭāṃ ca vākāṃ ca sute mālyavatastathā
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: कैकसीं मालिनः कन्यां तासां तु शृणुत प्रजाः । ज्येष्ठं वैश्रवणं तस्य सुषुवे देववर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: kaikasīṃ mālinaḥ kanyāṃ tāsāṃ tu śṛṇuta prajāḥ / jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tasya suṣuve devavarṇinī
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्येन विधिना युक्तमार्षेण च श्रुतेन च । राक्षसेन च रूपेण आसुरेण बलेन च
verses.transliteration: divyena vidhinā yuktamārṣeṇa ca śrutena ca / rākṣasena ca rūpeṇa āsureṇa balena ca
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपादं सुमहा कायं स्थूलशीर्षं महाहनुम् । अष्टदंष्ट्रं हरिछ्मश्रुं शङ्कुकर्णं विलोहितम्
verses.transliteration: tripādaṃ sumahā kāyaṃ sthūlaśīrṣaṃ mahāhanum / aṣṭadaṃṣṭraṃ harichmaśruṃ śaṅkukarṇaṃ vilohitam
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वबाहुं प्रबाहुं च पिगलं सुद्विभीषणम् । वैवर्त्तज्ञानसंपन्नं संबुद्धं चैव संभवात्
verses.transliteration: hrasvabāhuṃ prabāhuṃ ca pigalaṃ sudvibhīṣaṇam / vaivarttajñānasaṃpannaṃ saṃbuddhaṃ caiva saṃbhavāt
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: समासेन समाख्यातो भूयः कि वर्णयामि वः
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: पिता दृष्ट्वाब्रवीत्तं तु कुबेरो ऽयमिति स्वयम् । कुत्सायां क्विति शब्दो ऽयं शरीरं बेरमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: pitā dṛṣṭvābravīttaṃ tu kubero 'yamiti svayam / kutsāyāṃ kviti śabdo 'yaṃ śarīraṃ beramucyate
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: कुबेरः कुशरीरत्वान्नाम्ना वै तेन स्ॐऽकितः । यस्माद्विश्रवसो ऽपत्यं सादृश्याद्विश्रवा इव
verses.transliteration: kuberaḥ kuśarīratvānnāmnā vai tena soṃ'kitaḥ / yasmādviśravaso 'patyaṃ sādṛśyādviśravā iva
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: उस अजन्मा प्रजापति का इतना ही स्थिति का काल होता है । उस परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माजी का स्थिति का अन्त और प्रति सगं होता है ।२३९। जिस प्रकार से वायु के प्रवेग से दीप की शिखा उपशान्त हो जाया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्वैश्रवणो नाम नाम्ना तेन भविष्यति । ऋद्रयां कुबेरो ऽजनयद्विश्रुतं नलकूबरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādvaiśravaṇo nāma nāmnā tena bhaviṣyati / ṛdrayāṃ kubero 'janayadviśrutaṃ nalakūbaram
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: उसी भांति महदादि महेश्वर के अपने प्रति संसृष्ट होने पर महिमा है। जो भी कोई इसको नित्य धारण किया करता है अथवा इसका बारम्बार श्रवण किया करता है अथवा इसका कोत्तन किया करता है या वर्णन करता है बह मानव बड़ो भारी सिद्धि को प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: रावणं कुम्भकर्णं च कन्यां शूर्पणखीं तथा । विभीषणचतुर्थांस्तु कैकस्यजनयत्सुतान्
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ ca kanyāṃ śūrpaṇakhīṃ tathā / vibhīṣaṇacaturthāṃstu kaikasyajanayatsutān
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कुकर्णो दशग्रीवः पिङ्गलो रक्तमूर्द्धजः । चतुष्पाद्विंशतिभुजो महाकायो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkukarṇo daśagrīvaḥ piṅgalo raktamūrddhajaḥ / catuṣpādviṃśatibhujo mahākāyo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणः स्थितिकाले त, क्षीणे तस्मिस्तदा प्रभोः
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: जात्यञ्ज ननिभो दंष्ट्री लोहितग्रीव एव च । राक्षसेनौजसा युक्तो रूपेण च बलेन च
verses.transliteration: jātyañja nanibho daṃṣṭrī lohitagrīva eva ca / rākṣasenaujasā yukto rūpeṇa ca balena ca
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: पुरांतद्व्यण् काआनां संपूर्णे कल्पसंक्षये । उपस्थिते महाघोरे हयप्रत्यक्ष तु कस्याचित् ।
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वबुद्धिजितैर्चङ्क्षरा असैरेव रावणः । विसर्गदारुणः क्रूरो रावणो द्रावणस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: sattvabuddhijitaircaṅkṣarā asaireva rāvaṇaḥ / visargadāruṇaḥ krūro rāvaṇo drāvaṇastu saḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: महदादिविकारस्य विशेषांतस्य संक्ष ये । स्वभावकारिटो तस्मिस्प्तत्ते संचरे
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुर्ह्यासीद्रावणः पूर्वजन्मनि । चतुर्युगानि राजाभूत् त्रयोदश स राक्षसः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipurhyāsīdrāvaṇaḥ pūrvajanmani / caturyugāni rājābhūt trayodaśa sa rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: श्री सृतजी ने कहा--पर के अस्त में स्वयम्भू का प्रत्याहार मैं
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: ताः पञ्चकोट्यो वर्षाणां संख्याताः संख्यया द्विजाः । नियुतान्येकषष्टिं च शरदां गणितानि वै
verses.transliteration: tāḥ pañcakoṭyo varṣāṇāṃ saṃkhyātāḥ saṃkhyayā dvijāḥ / niyutānyekaṣaṣṭiṃ ca śaradāṃ gaṇitāni vai
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: कहुँगा । प्रु बरह्म के स्थिति के काल में ओर उस समय में उसके क्षीण हो जाने पर ।१। जैसे ईश्वर इस सुसूक्ष्म व्यक्त विश्व की रचना , करता है  अत्याहार के समय में इस अव्यक्त को व्यक्त ग्रस लिया करता है और पूर्ण-
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिं चैव सहस्राणि वर्षाणां वै स रावणः । देवतानामृषीणां च घोरं कृत्वा प्रजागरम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭiṃ caiva sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ vai sa rāvaṇaḥ / devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca ghoraṃ kṛtvā prajāgaram
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: यह प्रस्त हो जाता है ।२। पुरान्त द्वयणुक आदि का सम्पूर्ण कल्प
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: त्रेतायुगे चतुर्विंशे रावणस्तपसः क्षयात् । रामं दाशरथिं प्राप्य सगणः क्षयमीयिवान्
verses.transliteration: tretāyuge caturviṃśe rāvaṇastapasaḥ kṣayāt / rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ prāpya sagaṇaḥ kṣayamīyivān
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: संक्षय होने पर ।३। अन्त में उस समय में पश्चिम दुम मनु के . सम्प्राप्त होने पर अन्त में उस कलियुग के क्षीण हो जाने परु संहार कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: महोदरः प्रहस्तश्च महापार्श्वः खरस्तथा । पुष्पोत्कटायाः पुत्रास्ते कन्या कुम्भीनसी तथा
verses.transliteration: mahodaraḥ prahastaśca mahāpārśvaḥ kharastathā / puṣpotkaṭāyāḥ putrāste kanyā kumbhīnasī tathā
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: उस समय में वृत्त के सक्षाल होने पर और प्रत्याहार के उपस्थित होने पर उस काल में प्रत्याहार में भूतो और तन्मात्राओं का संक्षय हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशिरा दूषणश्चैव विद्युज्जिह्वः सराक्षसः । कन्यानुपालिका चैव वाकायाः प्रसवः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: triśirā dūṣaṇaścaiva vidyujjihvaḥ sarākṣasaḥ / kanyānupālikā caiva vākāyāḥ prasavaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: महत् तत्व आदि जो प्रकृति के विकार हैं विशेषान्त पर्यन्ते सबका संक्षय हो जाता है । यह सभो कुछ स्वभाव से ही किया जाता है तंब यह प्रति सञ्चरः
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते क्रूर कर्माणः पौलस्त्या राक्षसा दश । दारुणाभिजनाः सर्वे देवैरपि दुरासदाः
verses.transliteration: ityete krūra karmāṇaḥ paulastyā rākṣasā daśa / dāruṇābhijanāḥ sarve devairapi durāsadāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: प्रवृत होता है ।६। सर्म प्रथम जल भूमि का जो विशेष गुण गन्ध है उसको अस लिया करते हैं । इसके अनन्तर गन्ध होन भूमि प्रलय को ही प्राप्त हो जाया करती है »
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे लब्धवराः शूराः पुत्रपौत्रैः समन्विताः । यक्षाणां चैव सर्वेषां पौलस्त्या चे च राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: sarve labdhavarāḥ śūrāḥ putrapautraiḥ samanvitāḥ / yakṣāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ paulastyā ce ca rākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: आगस्त्यवैश्वामित्राणां क्रूराणां ब्रह्मरक्षसाम् । वेदाध्ययनशीलानां तपोव्रतनिषेविणाम्
verses.transliteration: āgastyavaiśvāmitrāṇāṃ krūrāṇāṃ brahmarakṣasām / vedādhyayanaśīlānāṃ tapovrataniṣeviṇām

verses.sanskrit: तेषामैडविडो राजा पौलस्त्यः सव्यपिङ्गलः । इतरे ये यज्ञजुषस्ते वै रक्षोगणास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmaiḍaviḍo rājā paulastyaḥ savyapiṅgalaḥ / itare ye yajñajuṣaste vai rakṣogaṇāstrayaḥ

verses.hindi: गन्ध की तन्मात्रा जब प्रणष्ट हो जाती है तो यह समस्त पृथ्वी जल की ही अवस्था वाली हो जाया करती है ओर भूमि का अस्तित्व ही सवथा लुप्त हो जाता है। उस समय में यह जल बड़े भीषण घोष ओर वेग से समन्वित होकर प्रविष्ट हो जाया करते हैं।=। ये जल सबको आपूरित करके

verses.sanskrit: यातुधाना ब्रह्मधाना वार्त्ताश्चैव दिवाचराः । निशाचरगणास्तेषां चत्वारः कविभिः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: yātudhānā brahmadhānā vārttāścaiva divācarāḥ / niśācaragaṇāsteṣāṃ catvāraḥ kavibhiḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: ही स्थित हो जाया करते हैं तया विचरण किया करते हैं। फिर जल का जो विशेष गुण रस है वह तेज में लीन हो जाता है ।६। जब रस की तन्माता का विनाश हो जाता करता है। तेज की तीव्रता से जल के रस के अपहत हो जाने पर वह जल तेज के ही स्वरूप को प्राप्त हो जाया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: पौलस्त्या नैरृताश्चैव आगस्त्याः कौशिकास्तथा । इत्येताः सप्त तेषां वै जातयो राक्षसाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: paulastyā nairṛtāścaiva āgastyāḥ kauśikāstathā / ityetāḥ sapta teṣāṃ vai jātayo rākṣasāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: ।१०। तेज के द्वारा जल के ग्रस्त हो जाने पर वही तेज सभी और दिखाई दिया करता है । इसके पश्चातु सभी ओर व्याप्त हुआ अग्नि उस समय में
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां रुपं प्रवक्ष्यामि स्वाभाव्येन व्यवस्थितम् । वृत्ताक्षाः पिङ्गलाश्चैव महाकाया महोदराः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ rupaṃ pravakṣyāmi svābhāvyena vyavasthitam / vṛttākṣāḥ piṅgalāścaiva mahākāyā mahodarāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टदंष्ट्राः शङ्कुकार्णा ऊर्द्ध्वरोमाण एव च । आकर्णा हारितस्याश्च मुञ्जधूम्रोर्ध्वमूर्धजाः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭadaṃṣṭrāḥ śaṅkukārṇā ūrddhvaromāṇa eva ca / ākarṇā hāritasyāśca muñjadhūmrordhvamūrdhajāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: उस जल को अपने ही स्वरूप ले लेता है ।११। बीरे-धीरे यह सव जगत् अग्नि (तेज) को ज्वालाओं से सम्पूरित हो जाता है। वे सब अक्षयां ऊपर-तीचे और तिरछी ओर सबत्र व्याप्त हो जाती हैं ।१२। इस तेज का विशेष गुण रूप होता है जो कि इसका प्रकाश करने वाला है । इस रूप को
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलशीर्षाः सिताभाश्च ह्रस्वसक्थिप्रबाहवः । ताम्रास्या लंबजिह्वोष्ठा लंबभ्रूस्थूलनासिकाः
verses.transliteration: sthūlaśīrṣāḥ sitābhāśca hrasvasakthiprabāhavaḥ / tāmrāsyā laṃbajihvoṣṭhā laṃbabhrūsthūlanāsikāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: वायु भक्षण कर जाता है । उस समय में वह तेज की ज्वालाओं वायु में दोप की शिखा के हो समान प्रलीन हो जाया करती है। जब रूप की तन्मात्रा विनष्ट हो जाती है तो वह अग्नि रूप से रहित हो जाता है। तेज तो फिर उपशान्त हो जाता है ओर केवल बायु ही महान् स्वरूप को धारण करके
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: नीलाङ्गा लोहितग्रीवा गंभीराक्षा विभीषणाः । महाघोरस्वराश्चैव विकटोद्बद्धपिण्डिकाः
verses.transliteration: nīlāṅgā lohitagrīvā gaṃbhīrākṣā vibhīṣaṇāḥ / mahāghorasvarāścaiva vikaṭodbaddhapiṇḍikāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: धूम धाम से संत्र बहन किया करता है (१३-१४

verses.transliteration: sthūlāśca tuṅganāsāśca śilāsaṃhananā dṛḍhāḥ / dāruṇābhijanāḥ krūrāḥ prāyaśaḥ kliṣṭakarmiṇaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: निरालोके तदा लोके वायुभूते च तेजसि ।
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: सकुण्डलाङ्गदापीडा मुकुटोष्णीषधारिणः । विचित्राभरणाश्चित्रमाल्यगन्धानुलेपनाः
verses.transliteration: sakuṇḍalāṅgadāpīḍā mukuṭoṣṇīṣadhāriṇaḥ / vicitrābharaṇāścitramālyagandhānulepanāḥ

verses.hindi: वायोरपि गुणं स्पशंमाकाशं ग्रसते च तत्

verses.transliteration: annādāḥ piśitādāśca puruṣādāśca te smṛtāḥ / ityetadrūpasādharmyaṃ rākṣasānāṃ smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: न समास्ते बले बुद्धौ युद्धे माया कृते तदा । पुलहस्य मृगाः पुत्राः सर्वे व्यालाश्च दंष्ट्रिणः
verses.transliteration: na samāste bale buddhau yuddhe māyā kṛte tadā / pulahasya mṛgāḥ putrāḥ sarve vyālāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: भूताः सर्प्पाः पिशाचाश्च सृमरा हस्तिनस्तथा । वानराः किन्नराश्चेव मायुः किंपुरुषास्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhūtāḥ sarppāḥ piśācāśca sṛmarā hastinastathā / vānarāḥ kinnarāśceva māyuḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागप्येते परिक्रान्ता मया क्रोधवशान्वयाः । अनपत्यः क्रतुर्ह्यस्मिन्स्मृतो वैवस्वतेंऽतरे

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य पत्न्यः पुत्रा वा तेजः संक्षिव्य च स्थितः । अत्रेर्वशं प्रवक्ष्यामि तृतीयस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: na tasya patnyaḥ putrā vā tejaḥ saṃkṣivya ca sthitaḥ / atrervaśaṃ pravakṣyāmi tṛtīyasya prajāpateḥ

verses.hindi: तेज को जब वायु ने ग्रस लिया था तो प्रकाशक रूप के अभाव होने से लोक में आलोक संथा नहीं रहा था क्योंकि तेज तो वायु के ही रूप में लीन हो गया था। इसके पश्चात् वायु अपने सम्बन्ध भूत को प्राप्त करके

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्न्यस्तु सुन्दर्य्ॐ दशैवासन्पतिव्रताः । बद्राश्वस्य घृताच्यां वै दशाप्सरसि सूनवः
verses.transliteration: tasya patnyastu sundaryoṃ daśaivāsanpativratāḥ / badrāśvasya ghṛtācyāṃ vai daśāpsarasi sūnavaḥ

verses.hindi: किया करता है। इस वायु का विशेष गुण स्पर्श होता है उस स्पर्श को

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रा शूद्रा च मद्रा च शालभा मलदा तथा । बला हला च सप्तैता या च गोचपलाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: bhadrā śūdrā ca madrā ca śālabhā maladā tathā / balā halā ca saptaitā yā ca gocapalāḥ smṛtāḥ

verses.hindi: आकाश ग्रस लिया करता है ।१९। उस समय में वायु भी अस्तित्व खोकर प्रशान्त हो जाता है ओर केवल आकाश ही अनावृत होकर स्थित रहा करता है । न तो इसके रूप है जोर न रस-स्पर्श-गन्ध तथा मूत्ति हैं । ऐसा आकाश रहा करता है ।१७। आकाश का विशेष गुण शब्द है। वह इसी से
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तामरसा चैव रत्नकूटा च तादृशः । तत्र यो वंशकृच्चासौ तस्य नाम प्रभाकरः
verses.transliteration: tathā tāmarasā caiva ratnakūṭā ca tādṛśaḥ / tatra yo vaṃśakṛccāsau tasya nāma prabhākaraḥ

verses.hindi: सबको पूरित करके बहुत विशाल दिखाई देता है। तात्पर्य यही है कि इसी का अस्तित्व होता है । वायु में भी लीन होने पर केवल अवशिष्ट आकाश ही होता है जिसका लक्षण ही शब्द होता है ।१८। उस समय में केवल शब्द ही जिसमें शेष रह गया था ऐसा आकाश सबको ढककर स्थित था । वहां
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: मद्रायां जनयामास सोमं पुत्रं यशस्विनम् । स्वर्भानुना हते सूर्ये पतमाने दिवो महीम्
verses.transliteration: madrāyāṃ janayāmāsa somaṃ putraṃ yaśasvinam / svarbhānunā hate sūrye patamāne divo mahīm

verses.hindi: पर जो उसका गुण शब्द था उसको भूतादि गरस लेते हं ।१६। भूतेरिद्ियों में एक साथ भूतादि के संस्थित होने पर यहू अभिमान के ही स्वरूप वाला भूतादि तमस कहा गया है ।२०। बुद्धि के लक्षण वाला यह महानू भूतादि का ग्रसन कर लेता है, महान के स्वरूप वाला यह व्यवसाय करने वाला
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तमो ऽभिभूते लोके ऽस्मिन्प्रभा येन प्रवर्त्तिता । स्वस्ति तेस्त्विति चौक्तो वै पतन्निह दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: tamo 'bhibhūte loke 'sminprabhā yena pravarttitā / svasti testviti caukto vai patanniha divākaraḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षेर्वचनात्तस्य न पपात दिवो महीम् । अत्रिश्रेष्ठानि गोत्राणि यश्चकार महातपाः
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣervacanāttasya na papāta divo mahīm / atriśreṣṭhāni gotrāṇi yaścakāra mahātapāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेष्वनिधनं चैव सुरैर्यस्य प्रवर्तितम् । स तासु जनयामास पुत्रानात्मसमानकान्
verses.transliteration: yajñeṣvanidhanaṃ caiva surairyasya pravartitam / sa tāsu janayāmāsa putrānātmasamānakān

verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: दश तान्वै सुमहता तपसा भावितः प्रभुः । स्वस्त्यात्रेया इति ख्याता ऋषयो वेदपारगाः
verses.transliteration: daśa tānvai sumahatā tapasā bhāvitaḥ prabhuḥ / svastyātreyā iti khyātā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ

verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
