verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ dvau khyātayaśasau brahmiṣṭhau sumahaujasau / datto hyanumato jyeṣṭho durvāsāstasya cānujaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: तत्त्वप्रसंयमो ह्य ष स्मृतो ह्यावर्तको द्विजाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: यवीयसी सुता तेषामबला ब्रह्मवादिनी । अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमं श्लोकं पौराणिकाः पुरा
verses.transliteration: yavīyasī sutā teṣāmabalā brahmavādinī / atrāpyudāharantīmaṃ ślokaṃ paurāṇikāḥ purā
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्म तपो ज्ञानं शुभं सत्यानृते तथा
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेः पुत्रं महात्मानं शान्तात्मानमकल्मषम् । दत्तात्रेयं तनुं विषणोः पुराणज्ञाः प्रजक्षते
verses.transliteration: atreḥ putraṃ mahātmānaṃ śāntātmānamakalmaṣam / dattātreyaṃ tanuṃ viṣaṇoḥ purāṇajñāḥ prajakṣate
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: प्रकृत्यां चंत्र तत्सर्वं पुण्यं पापः प्रतिष्ठति
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य गोत्रान्वयज्जाताश्चत्वारः प्रथिता भुवि । श्यावाश्वा मुद्गलाश्चैव वाग्भूतकगवि स्थिराः
verses.transliteration: tasya gotrānvayajjātāścatvāraḥ prathitā bhuvi / śyāvāśvā mudgalāścaiva vāgbhūtakagavi sthirāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: एते ऽत्रीणां तु चत्वारः स्मृताः पक्षा महौजसः । काश्यपो नारदश्चैव पर्वतो ऽरुन्धती तथा
verses.transliteration: ete 'trīṇāṃ tu catvāraḥ smṛtāḥ pakṣā mahaujasaḥ / kāśyapo nāradaścaiva parvato 'rundhatī tathā
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: ३१४   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण जो तत्वों का चिन्तन करने वाले महा मनीषी हैं वे उसको बुद्धि
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञिरे मानसा ह्येते ऽरुधत्यास्तन्निबोधत । नारदस्तु वसिष्ठायारुन्धती प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: jajñire mānasā hyete 'rudhatyāstannibodhata / nāradastu vasiṣṭhāyārundhatī pratyapādayat
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: मन-लिङ्ग-महान् और अक्षर--इन पर्याय वाचक शब्दों के द्वारा कहा करते हैं।२२। जब ये सब भूतादिक भली भाँति से प्रलीन हो जाया करते हैं तब गुणों की (सत्व-राज-तम) समता हो जाती है और उस में वह गुणों का साम्य लीन हो जाता है तया अपने ही स्वरूप में अवस्थित रहा करता है
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्द्ध्वरेता महातेजा दक्षशापात्तु नारदः । पुरा देवासुरे तस्मिन्संग्रामे तारकामये
verses.transliteration: ūrddhvaretā mahātejā dakṣaśāpāttu nāradaḥ / purā devāsure tasminsaṃgrāme tārakāmaye
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: ।२३। समस्त भूतों के कारण प्रसङ्ग में लीन हो जाया करते हैं। यही तत्त्वो का कारणों के साथ संयम होता है ।२४ है द्विजो ! यह तत्त्वों का प्रसंयम आवत्त'क कहा गया है । धर्म और अधमं, शुभ ज्ञान, सत्य और मिथ्या-- ऊर्ध्वेभाव और अधोभाव--सुख और दुःख-प्रिय और अप्रिय-यह सभी
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्ट्या हते लोके व्यग्रे शस्ते सुरैः सह । वसिष्ठस्तपसा धीमाञ्जीवयामास वै प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭyā hate loke vyagre śaste suraiḥ saha / vasiṣṭhastapasā dhīmāñjīvayāmāsa vai prajāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: कुछ प्रपञ्च में स्थित गुणमात्र के स्वरूप बाला कहा गया है।२५-२६। बिना इन्द्रियों बाले ज्ञातियों का उस समय में जो भी शुभ और अशुभ कमं है वह सब पुण्य और पाप प्रकृति में प्रतिष्ठित होता है ।२७। और यही अवस्था होती है जो देह धारियों की कही जाया करती है और जन्तुओं का जो भी
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकफलमूलिन्य औषधीश्च प्रवर्तयन् । तास्तेन जीवयामास कारुण्यादौषधेन सः
verses.transliteration: anekaphalamūlinya auṣadhīśca pravartayan / tāstena jīvayāmāsa kāruṇyādauṣadhena saḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: कुछ पुण्य और पाप है वह प्रकृति में प्रतिक्षित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धत्यां वसिष्टस्तु शक्तिमुत्पादय त्सुतम् । स्वाङ्गज जनयच्छक्तिरदृश्यन्त्यां पराशरम्
verses.transliteration: arundhatyāṃ vasiṣṭastu śaktimutpādaya tsutam / svāṅgaja janayacchaktiradṛśyantyāṃ parāśaram
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: काल्यां पराशराज्जज्ञे कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः । द्वैपायनादरण्यां वै शुको जज्ञे गुणान्वितः
verses.transliteration: kālyāṃ parāśarājjajñe kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ / dvaipāyanādaraṇyāṃ vai śuko jajñe guṇānvitaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: उदपद्यन्त षडिमे पीवर्यां शुकसूनवः । भूरिश्रवाः प्रभुः शंभुः कृष्णो गौरश्च पञ्चमः
verses.transliteration: udapadyanta ṣaḍime pīvaryāṃ śukasūnavaḥ / bhūriśravāḥ prabhuḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṛṣṇo gauraśca pañcamaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: कन्या कीर्तिमती चैव योगमाता धृतव्रता । जननी ब्रह्मदत्तस्य पत्नी सा त्वणुहस्य च
verses.transliteration: kanyā kīrtimatī caiva yogamātā dhṛtavratā / jananī brahmadattasya patnī sā tvaṇuhasya ca
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेताः कृष्णाश्च पौराश्च श्यामधूम्राश्च चण्डिनः । ऊष्मादा दारिकाश्चैव नीलाश्चैव पराशराः
verses.transliteration: śvetāḥ kṛṣṇāśca paurāśca śyāmadhūmrāśca caṇḍinaḥ / ūṣmādā dārikāścaiva nīlāścaiva parāśarāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: राजसी तामसो चंव सात्विकी चैव वृत्तयः
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: पराशराणामष्टौ ते पक्षाः प्रोक्ता महात्मनाम् । अत ऊर्द्ध्व निबोध त्वमिन्द्रप्रमति संभवम्
verses.transliteration: parāśarāṇāmaṣṭau te pakṣāḥ proktā mahātmanām / ata ūrddhva nibodha tvamindrapramati saṃbhavam
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: तयोः प्रवर्त्तकं मध्ये इहैवावत्त कं रजः ।
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठस्य कपिञ्जल्यां घृताच्यामुदपद्यत । कुणीति यः समाख्यात इन्द्रप्रमतिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya kapiñjalyāṃ ghṛtācyāmudapadyata / kuṇīti yaḥ samākhyāta indrapramatirucyate
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: पृथोः सुतायां संभूतः पुत्रस्तस्याभवद्वसुः । उपमन्युः सुतस्तस्य यस्येमे ह्यौपमन्यवः
verses.transliteration: pṛthoḥ sutāyāṃ saṃbhūtaḥ putrastasyābhavadvasuḥ / upamanyuḥ sutastasya yasyeme hyaupamanyavaḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणयोश्चैव कुण्डिनेयाः परिश्रुताः । एकार्षेयास्तथा चान्ये वसिष्ठा नाम विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: mitrāvaruṇayoścaiva kuṇḍineyāḥ pariśrutāḥ / ekārṣeyāstathā cānye vasiṣṭhā nāma viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: उस अवस्था में स्थित हो वे ही सब पाप और पुण्य जन्तुओं को पुनः परस्व से उसी प्रकार से देहो के साय योजित किया करते हैं अर्थात् उन्हीं पुण्य पापों के अनुसार जीव देहो को प्राप्त किया करते हैं ।२३। जीवों के धर्म और अधर्म दोनों ही गुण मात्रों के स्वरूप बाले होते है । जन्तुओ के द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: एते पक्षा वसिष्ठानां स्मृता ह्येकादशैव तु । इत्येते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा मानसा अष्ट विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: ete pakṣā vasiṣṭhānāṃ smṛtā hyekādaśaiva tu / ityete brahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasā aṣṭa viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: अपने ही कारणों से कायं के रूप में परिणत होकर बढ़ जाया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातरः सुमहाभागा येषां वंशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । त्रींल्लोकान्धारयन्तीमान्देवर्षिगणसंकुलान्
verses.transliteration: bhrātaraḥ sumahābhāgā yeṣāṃ vaṃśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ / trīṃllokāndhārayantīmāndevarṣigaṇasaṃkulān
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: कषेत्रज्ञ (आत्मा) में अधिष्ठित गुण चेतन के सहित धलीन होते हैं। इस संसार में सगे में सब जन्तु होते हैं ।३१। राजसी तामसो और सात्त्विकी बृत्तियां संयुक्त होती हैं-वियुक्त होती हैं ओर कारणों के हारा सङ्चरण किया करती हैं ।३२। पुरुषों में अधिष्ठित केबल गुण ही प्रवृत्त हुआ करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । व्याप्ता येस्तु त्रयो लोकाः सूर्यस्येव गभस्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / vyāptā yestu trayo lokāḥ sūryasyeva gabhastibhiḥ
verses.translation: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.hindi: और तीन प्रकार से होते हैं । ऊध्वं दशात्मक सत्व है--और अधोभागात्मक तम है ।३३। इन दोनों का मध्य प्रवत्तेक रजोगुण चेत इसी रीति से यहाँ पर है और ये तीनों परिवत्तित हुआ करते हैं ।३४। लोको में समस्त भूतो के कार्य को जानने वाले को बह नहीं करना चाहिए। मानबों के द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 90-100 describe the race of Vasiftha.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे ऋषिवंशवर्णनं नामाष्टमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ८॥ ऋषय ऊचुः कथं द्विवारावुत्पन्ना भवानी प्राक्सती तु या । आसीद्दाक्षायणी पूर्वमुमा कथमजायत
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde ṛṣivaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 8// ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ dvivārāvutpannā bhavānī prāksatī tu yā / āsīddākṣāyaṇī pūrvamumā kathamajāyata
verses.translation: The king of the mountains begot her of Mena, the daughter of the Pitrs, Who are these Pitrs of whom Mena became the mental daughter?
verses.hindi: अविद्या के विश्वास से ही सभी का आरम्भ किया जाया करता है । तात्पर्य यही है कि सबका आरम्भ अविद्या के ही विश्वास से हुआ करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The king of the mountains begot her of Mena, the daughter of the Pitrs, Who are these Pitrs of whom Mena became the mental daughter?
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of the mountains begot her of Mena, the daughter of the Pitrs, Who are these Pitrs of whom Mena became the mental daughter?

verses.sanskrit: मेनायां पितृकन्यायां जनयञ्छैलराट् स्वयम् । के वै ते पितरो नाम येषां मेना तु मानसी
verses.transliteration: menāyāṃ pitṛkanyāyāṃ janayañchailarāṭ svayam / ke vai te pitaro nāma yeṣāṃ menā tu mānasī
verses.translation: A comparison of the race of sages with those given in other Pur&nas (for example) the Matsya shows many dissimilarities in names, though some of the gotras and pravaras are common.
verses.wordMeaning: A comparison of the race of sages with those given in other Pur&nas (for example) the Matsya shows many dissimilarities in names, though some of the gotras and pravaras are common.
verses.commentary: Sense: A comparison of the race of sages with those given in other Pur&nas (for example) the Matsya shows many dissimilarities in names, though some of the gotras and pravaras are common.

verses.sanskrit: मैनाकश्चैव दोहित्रो दौहित्री च तथा ह्युमा । एकपर्णा तथा चैव तथा चैवैकपाटला
verses.transliteration: mainākaścaiva dohitro dauhitrī ca tathā hyumā / ekaparṇā tathā caiva tathā caivaikapāṭalā
verses.translation: Ghs. IX to XX of the present Pur&pa describe the Sr&ddha - Kalpa or the procedure of ancestor-worship in ancient India* It is an important topic and forms an integral part of Hindu Dharma S&stra. It is rooted in the belief in after-death survival of the deceased ancestors and their residence in a particular region or world called Pitf-loka, This belief Is pre-Vcdic as it dates
verses.wordMeaning: Ghs. IX to XX of the present Pur&pa describe the Sr&ddha - Kalpa or the procedure of ancestor-worship in ancient India* It is an important topic and forms an integral part of Hindu Dharma S&stra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ghs. IX to XX of the present Pur&pa describe the Sr&ddha - Kalpa or the procedure of ancestor-worship in ancient India* It is an important topic and forms an integral part of Hindu Dharma S&stra.…

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा चापि सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा सर्वासां पूर्वजा तथा । सर्वमेतत्वयोद्दिष्टं निर्देशं तस्य नो वद
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā cāpi saricchreṣṭhā sarvāsāṃ pūrvajā tathā / sarvametatvayoddiṣṭaṃ nirdeśaṃ tasya no vada
verses.translation: Thinking that they (gods) will worship me that lord Brabjpa created the Devas.1 But they forsook him and worship-
verses.hindi: इत्येते वै त्रयः प्रोक्ता बंधा हृयज्ञानहेतुकाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thinking that they (gods) will worship me that lord Brabjpa created the Devas.1 But they forsook him and worship-
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking that they (gods) will worship me that lord Brabjpa created the Devas.1 But they forsook him and worship-

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतुमिच्छामि भद्रं ते श्राद्धस्य च विधिं परम् । पुत्राश्च के स्मृतास्तेषां कथं च पितरस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: śrotumicchāmi bhadraṃ te śrāddhasya ca vidhiṃ param / putrāśca ke smṛtāsteṣāṃ kathaṃ ca pitarastu te
verses.translation: The proper name of Indra in this Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: The proper name of Indra in this Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The proper name of Indra in this Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: कथं वा ते समुत्पन्नाः किंना मानः किमात्मकाः । स्वर्गे वै पितरो ह्येते देवानामपि देवताः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ vā te samutpannāḥ kiṃnā mānaḥ kimātmakāḥ / svarge vai pitaro hyete devānāmapi devatāḥ
verses.translation: They were cursed by Brahma — "You will become deluded and devoid of consciousness. Hence, you do not know anything. Become deluded in the worlds."
verses.wordMeaning: They were cursed by Brahma — "You will become deluded and devoid of consciousness. Hence, you do not know anything. Become deluded in the worlds."
verses.commentary: Sense: They were cursed by Brahma — "You will become deluded and devoid of consciousness. Hence, you do not know anything. Become deluded in the worlds."

verses.sanskrit: एवं वेदितुमिच्छामि पितॄणां सर्गमुत्तममा । यथा च दत्तमस्माभिः सार्द्धं प्रीणाति वै पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ veditumicchāmi pitṝṇāṃ sargamuttamamā / yathā ca dattamasmābhiḥ sārddhaṃ prīṇāti vai pitṝn
verses.translation: Again and again all of them bowed down to him and requested god Brahma (for pardon). In order to bless the worlds, the lord spoke to them again.
verses.wordMeaning: Again and again all of them bowed down to him and requested god Brahma (for pardon). In order to bless the worlds, the lord spoke to them again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again and again all of them bowed down to him and requested god Brahma (for pardon). In order to bless the worlds, the lord spoke to them again.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थं ते न दृश्यन्ते तत्र किं कारणं स्मृतम् । स्वर्गे तु के च वर्त्तन्ते पितरो नरके व के
verses.transliteration: yadarthaṃ te na dṛśyante tatra kiṃ kāraṇaṃ smṛtam / svarge tu ke ca varttante pitaro narake va ke
verses.translation: "Make atonement as a sin of transgression has been committed by you all. Ask your sons. Therefrom you will acquire knowledge and wisdom."
verses.hindi: ये तीन हो गतियां होती हैं जो शुभ और पापात्मिक कही गयी हैँ ।
verses.wordMeaning: "Make atonement as a sin of transgression has been committed by you all. Ask your sons. Therefrom you will acquire knowledge and wisdom."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Make atonement as a sin of transgression has been committed by you all. Ask your sons. Therefrom you will acquire knowledge and wisdom."

verses.sanskrit: अभिसंभाष्य पितरं पितुश्च पितरं तथा । प्रतितामहं तथा चैव त्रिषु पिण्डेषु नामतः
verses.transliteration: abhisaṃbhāṣya pitaraṃ pituśca pitaraṃ tathā / pratitāmahaṃ tathā caiva triṣu piṇḍeṣu nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, desirous of comprehending the (mode of) atonement (and to perform it) they asked their sons in secret with their selves duly well controlled.
verses.hindi: तमोगुण से अभिभूत होकर यह जीवात्मा यथार्थता को प्राप्न नहीं हुआ करता है ।३६। तत्व के दर्शन न करने से ही वह जोवातमा यहाँ पर अनेक अकार से बद्ध हो जाया करता है। वह बन्धन तत्व वेकारिक ओर प्राकृत है ।३७। तृतीय दक्षिणओं में बद्ध हुआ यह अत्यन्त ही विवत्तित हो जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, desirous of comprehending the (mode of) atonement (and to perform it) they asked their sons in secret with their selves duly well controlled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, desirous of comprehending the (mode of) atonement (and to perform it) they asked their sons in secret with their selves duly well controlled.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना दत्तानि श्राद्धानि कथं गच्छन्ति वै पितॄन् । कथं च शक्तास्ते दातुं नरकस्थाः फलं पुनः
verses.transliteration: nāmnā dattāni śrāddhāni kathaṃ gacchanti vai pitṝn / kathaṃ ca śaktāste dātuṃ narakasthāḥ phalaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: To them the sons conversant with, virtue and piety and possessed of complete control of their sou Is, explained the different kinds of atonement of sins originating from the mind, words and actions.
verses.hindi: है । ये ही तीन इस जीवात्मा के बन्धन होते हैं जो केबल अज्ञान के हो कारण से हुआ करते हैं ।३८। यह जीवात्मा जो वस्तु अनित्य है उनमें नित्य होने का ज्ञान रखता है जो कि सर्वधा गलत है । जो दुःखमय है उसमें हो सुख का दर्शन किया करता है । जो वस्तुतः अपना नहीं है उसको हो
verses.wordMeaning: To them the sons conversant with, virtue and piety and possessed of complete control of their sou Is, explained the different kinds of atonement of sins originating from the mind, words and actions.
verses.commentary: Sense: To them the sons conversant with, virtue and piety and possessed of complete control of their sou Is, explained the different kinds of atonement of sins originating from the mind, words and actions.

verses.sanskrit: के च ते पितरो नाम कान्यजामो वयं पुनः । देवा अपि पितॄन् स्वर्गे यजन्तीति हि नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: ke ca te pitaro nāma kānyajāmo vayaṃ punaḥ / devā api pitṝn svarge yajantīti hi naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: V. 22 explains the paradox why Pitrs who were the Sons of gods became the 'fathers of their own fathers*. Manu III. 201 differs from this text and states that Pitrs sprang from Sages and from the Pitrs were born gods and human beings. *
verses.hindi: अपना समझता है और जो वास्तव में अशुचि अर्थात् अपवित्र है उसको पवित्र जानता है ।३६। ज्ञान की विपरीतता होने ही से ये सब दोष समुत्पन्न हुआ करते हैं और जिनमें ये होते हैं वे सब उनके मन के ही दोष हैं। जिसके मन में सांसारिक वस्तुओं के प्रति राग द्वेष की निवृत्ति दोती है,
verses.wordMeaning: V. 22 explains the paradox why Pitrs who were the Sons of gods became the 'fathers of their own fathers*. Manu III. 201 differs from this text and states that Pitrs sprang from Sages and from the Pitrs were born gods and human beings. *
verses.commentary: Sense: V. 22 explains the paradox why Pitrs who were the Sons of gods became the 'fathers of their own fathers*. Manu III. 201 differs from this text and states that Pitrs sprang from Sages and from the Pitrs were born gods and human beings. *

verses.sanskrit: एतदिच्छामि वै श्रोतुं विस्तरेण बहुश्रुतम् । स्पष्टाभिधान मपि वै तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: etadicchāmi vai śrotuṃ vistareṇa bahuśrutam / spaṣṭābhidhāna mapi vai tadbhavānvaktumarhasi
verses.translation: clIf anyone were to perform the Sraddha rites with undesirable Pitrs, the Rak$asas and the Danavas will attain the fruit thereof.
verses.hindi: उसी का नाम ज्ञान कहा गया है, किलत वास्तविक रूप से ऐसा होता नहीं है, दिखाने और कहने को भले ही कोई कुछ भी किया करे ।४०। यह अशान जो होता है उसका मूल तमोगुण की ही अधिकता है । ज्ञान का होना ओर अज्ञान का जमा रहना ये दोनों ही रजोगुण का परिणाम हैं। सभी जानते
verses.wordMeaning: clIf anyone were to perform the Sraddha rites with undesirable Pitrs, the Rak$asas and the Danavas will attain the fruit thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: clIf anyone were to perform the Sraddha rites with undesirable Pitrs, the Rak$asas and the Danavas will attain the fruit thereof.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच अत्र वो कीर्तयिष्यामि यथाप्रज्ञं यथाश्रुतम् । मन्वन्तरेषु जायन्ते पितरो देवसूनवः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca atra vo kīrtayiṣyāmi yathāprajñaṃ yathāśrutam / manvantareṣu jāyante pitaro devasūnavaḥ
verses.translation: On being developed by means of the Sraddhas, and strengthening further the imperishable moon day by day, all the Pitrs will increase.
verses.hindi: हैं कि कुछ भी साथ नहीं जाता है फिर भी सांसारिक बर्तुओं में प्रबल मोह नहीं छूटता है । यह देह तो कर्मों ही से प्राप्त होता है और फिर भी बही अज्ञान इसमें भरा ही रहता है तो यह महान् दुःख का भागी होता है ।४९। विषयों के प्रति बड़ी भारी तृषा बनी रहती है । यही तृषा पुनः संसार
verses.wordMeaning: On being developed by means of the Sraddhas, and strengthening further the imperishable moon day by day, all the Pitrs will increase.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being developed by means of the Sraddhas, and strengthening further the imperishable moon day by day, all the Pitrs will increase.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागताः श्रेष्ठाः कनिष्ठाः क्रमशस्तु वै । देवैः सार्द्धं पुरातीताः पितरो ऽन्येन्तरेषु वै
verses.transliteration: atītānāgatāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kaniṣṭhāḥ kramaśastu vai / devaiḥ sārddhaṃ purātītāḥ pitaro 'nyentareṣu vai
verses.translation: Soma, the moon god, strengthened and developed by means of the &raddhas, will develop the people too and the entire world along with the mountains and forests, surrounded by the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: में फॅसाये रखने बाली होती है जो कमों के कारण दुःख से होती है। कानों में समुत्पश्न--नेत्रों से सम्भूत-त्वचा, रसना और नासिका से उत्पर्न यह विषयों के आस्वादन की पिपासा हुआ करती है
verses.wordMeaning: Soma, the moon god, strengthened and developed by means of the &raddhas, will develop the people too and the entire world along with the mountains and forests, surrounded by the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma, the moon god, strengthened and developed by means of the &raddhas, will develop the people too and the entire world along with the mountains and forests, surrounded by the mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तन्ते सांप्रतं चे तु तान्वै पक्ष्यामि निश्चयात् । श्राद्धक्रियां मनुश्चैषां श्राद्धदेवः प्रवर्त्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: vartante sāṃprataṃ ce tu tānvai pakṣyāmi niścayāt / śrāddhakriyāṃ manuścaiṣāṃ śrāddhadevaḥ pravarttayet
verses.translation: If men, desirous of nourishment and development, were to perform Sraddhas, the Pitrs will always bestow on them nourishment and progeny.
verses.wordMeaning: If men, desirous of nourishment and development, were to perform Sraddhas, the Pitrs will always bestow on them nourishment and progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: If men, desirous of nourishment and development, were to perform Sraddhas, the Pitrs will always bestow on them nourishment and progeny.

verses.sanskrit: देवान्सृजत ब्रह्मा मां यक्ष्यन्तीति च प्रभुः । तमुत्सृज्य तदात्मानमयजंस्ते फलार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: devānsṛjata brahmā māṃ yakṣyantīti ca prabhuḥ / tamutsṛjya tadātmānamayajaṃste phalārthinaḥ
verses.translation: Thereby all these viz. charitable gift, self-study of the Vedas and power of penance can be achieved. There is no doubt about this that the Pitrs are the bestowers of wisdom on you all.
verses.hindi: इत्येष वैषयो रागः संभूत्याः कारणं समृतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereby all these viz. charitable gift, self-study of the Vedas and power of penance can be achieved. There is no doubt about this that the Pitrs are the bestowers of wisdom on you all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereby all these viz. charitable gift, self-study of the Vedas and power of penance can be achieved. There is no doubt about this that the Pitrs are the bestowers of wisdom on you all.

verses.sanskrit: ते शप्ता ब्रह्मणा मूढा नष्टसंज्ञा भविष्यथ । तस्मात्किञ्चिन्न जानीत ततो लोकेषु मुह्यत
verses.transliteration: te śaptā brahmaṇā mūḍhā naṣṭasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatha / tasmātkiñcinna jānīta tato lokeṣu muhyata
verses.translation: Thus these Pitrs are the Devas and the Devas are the Pitrs. The Devas and the Pitrs are mutually the Pitrs (fathers) of one another.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these Pitrs are the Devas and the Devas are the Pitrs. The Devas and the Pitrs are mutually the Pitrs (fathers) of one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these Pitrs are the Devas and the Devas are the Pitrs. The Devas and the Pitrs are mutually the Pitrs (fathers) of one another.

verses.sanskrit: ते भूयः प्रणताः सर्वे याचन्ति स्म पितामहम् । अनुग्रहाय लोकानां पुनस्तानब्रवीत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: te bhūyaḥ praṇatāḥ sarve yācanti sma pitāmaham / anugrahāya lokānāṃ punastānabravītprabhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Brahma from Suta who had completely understood the Brahman ( Atman), all those sages once again asked Suta as follows.
verses.hindi: वाल तृष्णा के सहित होता है और अपने ही द्वारा किये हुए कर्मों के फलों से तेल पीड़क की भाँति उसी में परिबत्तित हुआ करता है अर्थात् जैसे तेल निकालने की घानी में कोई पिरता है उसी तरह से इस संसार के चक्र में जीव घुमा करता है ।५३। इस कारण से अनयों का मूल अज्ञान ही
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of Brahma from Suta who had completely understood the Brahman ( Atman), all those sages once again asked Suta as follows.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Brahma from Suta who had completely understood the Brahman ( Atman), all those sages once again asked Suta as follows.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं चरध्वं वै व्यभिचारो हि वः कृतः । पुत्रान्स्वान्परिपृच्छध्वं ततो ज्ञानमवाप्स्यथ
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ caradhvaṃ vai vyabhicāro hi vaḥ kṛtaḥ / putrānsvānparipṛcchadhvaṃ tato jñānamavāpsyatha
verses.translation: How many are the groups of Sages* (Muni-gan&h*)? At what time did those groups (come into existence?). They
verses.hindi: बताया जाया करता है। उसी एक अज्ञान को अपना शमु मानकर ज्ञान के प्राप्त करने में ही पूर्ण प्रयत्न करना चाहिए ।४४। मन से सब कुछ का त्याग किया जाता है और त्याग जब होता है तो उभ त्याग से बुद्धि में वैराग्य हो जाया करता है अर्थात् फिर संसार की सभी वस्तु सार हीन और हेय
verses.wordMeaning: How many are the groups of Sages* (Muni-gan&h*)? At what time did those groups (come into existence?). They
verses.commentary: Sense: How many are the groups of Sages* (Muni-gan&h*)? At what time did those groups (come into existence?). They

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त स्वसुतांश्चैव प्रयश्चित्तजि घृक्षवः । अपृच्छन्संयतात्मानो विधिवच्च मिथो मिथः
verses.transliteration: tatasta svasutāṃścaiva prayaścittaji ghṛkṣavaḥ / apṛcchansaṃyatātmāno vidhivacca mitho mithaḥ
verses.translation: Unto you all, I shall relate this most excellent crea- tion of the Pitrs, about which Sarny u formerly asked his father Brhaspati.
verses.hindi: प्रतीत हुआ करती हैं । वैराग्य से घुड़ि हो जाय! करती है तथा शुद्ध सत्व से युक्‍त हो जाता है ।४५। अब इसके आगे हम उस राग के विषय में बत- लायेंगे जो भूतों का अपहरण करने वाला होता है, विषयों में अवण आत्मा वाले का अभिष्यज के लिए योग हुआ करता है ।४६। अनिष्ट-इष्ट-अप्रीति-
verses.wordMeaning: Unto you all, I shall relate this most excellent crea- tion of the Pitrs, about which Sarny u formerly asked his father Brhaspati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unto you all, I shall relate this most excellent crea- tion of the Pitrs, about which Sarny u formerly asked his father Brhaspati.

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यस्ते नियतात्मानः पुत्राः शंसुरनेकधा । प्रयश्चित्तानि धर्मज्ञावाङ्मनः कर्मजानि च
verses.transliteration: tebhyaste niyatātmānaḥ putrāḥ śaṃsuranekadhā / prayaścittāni dharmajñāvāṅmanaḥ karmajāni ca
verses.translation: The son Samyu equipped with the good quality of modesty, put this question to Brhaspati who was seated nearby and who was an expert in all the subjects worthy of being known.1
verses.hindi: प्रीति-ताप--विषाद--दुःखों के लाभ में ताप होता है और सुखों का अनु- स्मरण नहीं हुआ करता है ।४५। इतना यही विषयों में रहने वाला राग है और संभूति कारण यही राग बताया गया है । जो दहा से आदि लेकर स्थावर पर्यन्त इस आधिभौतिक संसार में होता है ।४८। यह सव अज्ञान
verses.wordMeaning: The son Samyu equipped with the good quality of modesty, put this question to Brhaspati who was seated nearby and who was an expert in all the subjects worthy of being known.1
verses.commentary: Sense: The son Samyu equipped with the good quality of modesty, put this question to Brhaspati who was seated nearby and who was an expert in all the subjects worthy of being known.1

verses.sanskrit: ते पुत्रानब्रुवन्प्रीता लब्धसंज्ञा दिवौकसः । यूयं वै पितरो ऽस्माकं यैर्वयं प्रतिबोधिताः
verses.transliteration: te putrānabruvanprītā labdhasaṃjñā divaukasaḥ / yūyaṃ vai pitaro 'smākaṃ yairvayaṃ pratibodhitāḥ
verses.translation: "Who are these beings called Pitrs? How many are they? What are their (respective) names? How were they born? How did they attain the status of the Pitrs?
verses.hindi: पूर्वक अर्थात् अज्ञान से ही होता है । इस कारण से अज्ञान को परिवजित कर देता चाहिए । जिसका आषंग्रन्यो में कोई प्रमाण नहीं है ओर जो शिष्ट पुरुषों का आचरण भी नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: "Who are these beings called Pitrs? How many are they? What are their (respective) names? How were they born? How did they attain the status of the Pitrs?
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who are these beings called Pitrs? How many are they? What are their (respective) names? How were they born? How did they attain the status of the Pitrs?

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं ज्ञानं च वैराग्यं को वरो वः प्रदीयताम् । पुस्तानब्रवीद्ब्रह्मा यूयं वै सत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ ko varo vaḥ pradīyatām / pustānabravīdbrahmā yūyaṃ vai satyavādinaḥ
verses.translation: Wherefore do the Pitrs perpetually nurture and develop the Yajfia? All the holy rites of noble souls have the Sraddha rite at the outset (why is it so?).
verses.hindi: एष मार्गो हि निरये तिर्स्यभ्योनौ च कारणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Wherefore do the Pitrs perpetually nurture and develop the Yajfia? All the holy rites of noble souls have the Sraddha rite at the outset (why is it so?).
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherefore do the Pitrs perpetually nurture and develop the Yajfia? All the holy rites of noble souls have the Sraddha rite at the outset (why is it so?).

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यदुक्तं युष्माभिस्तत्तथा न तदन्यथा । उक्तं च पितरो ऽस्माकं चेति वै तनयाः स्वकाः
verses.transliteration: tasmādyaduktaṃ yuṣmābhistattathā na tadanyathā / uktaṃ ca pitaro 'smākaṃ ceti vai tanayāḥ svakāḥ
verses.translation: To whom are the Sraddha offerings to be given? What is the great benefit when they are offered? What are those holy centres and rivers where Sraddha performance is everlasting in merit.
verses.wordMeaning: To whom are the Sraddha offerings to be given? What is the great benefit when they are offered? What are those holy centres and rivers where Sraddha performance is everlasting in merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: To whom are the Sraddha offerings to be given? What is the great benefit when they are offered? What are those holy centres and rivers where Sraddha performance is everlasting in merit.

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्ते भविष्यन्ति तेभ्यो ऽयं दीयतां वरः । तेनैव वचसा ते वै ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: pitaraste bhaviṣyanti tebhyo 'yaṃ dīyatāṃ varaḥ / tenaiva vacasā te vai brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: What are those places where an excellent Braha- mana attains everything after performing Sraddha? What is the prescribed hour for the rite of Sraddha? What is the injunc- tion that governs it?
verses.hindi: तिय्यंग्योनिगत' चेव कारणं तत्त्रिरुच्यत । त्रिविधो यातनास्थाने तियय योनी च पड्विधे
verses.wordMeaning: What are those places where an excellent Braha- mana attains everything after performing Sraddha? What is the prescribed hour for the rite of Sraddha? What is the injunc- tion that governs it?
verses.commentary: Sense: What are those places where an excellent Braha- mana attains everything after performing Sraddha? What is the prescribed hour for the rite of Sraddha? What is the injunc- tion that governs it?

verses.sanskrit: पुत्राः पितृत्वमाजग्मुः पुत्रत्वं पितरः पुनः । तस्मात्ते पितरः पुत्राः पितृत्वं तेषु तत्स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: putrāḥ pitṛtvamājagmuḥ putratvaṃ pitaraḥ punaḥ / tasmātte pitaraḥ putrāḥ pitṛtvaṃ teṣu tatsmṛtam
verses.translation: O holy lord, I wish that what has been enquired by me is explained in detail and in the proper sequence."
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, I wish that what has been enquired by me is explained in detail and in the proper sequence."
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, I wish that what has been enquired by me is explained in detail and in the proper sequence."

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्मृत्वा पितॄन्पुत्राः पुत्रांश्चैव पितॄंस्तथा । व्याजहार पुनर्ब्रह्मा वितॄनात्मविवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: evaṃ smṛtvā pitṝnputrāḥ putrāṃścaiva pitṝṃstathā / vyājahāra punarbrahmā vitṝnātmavivṛddhaye
verses.translation: "O dear one, I shall explain the solemn excellent question which you, with due propriety, ask me with proper humility.
verses.hindi: तेन बद्धस्य बै बंधो मोक्षो मुक्तस्य तेन च
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear one, I shall explain the solemn excellent question which you, with due propriety, ask me with proper humility.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear one, I shall explain the solemn excellent question which you, with due propriety, ask me with proper humility.

verses.sanskrit: यो ह्य निष्टान्पितॄञ्श्राद्धि क्रियां काञ्चितकरिष्यति । राक्षसा दानवाश्बैव फलं प्राप्स्यन्ति तस्य तत्
verses.transliteration: yo hya niṣṭānpitṝñśrāddhi kriyāṃ kāñcitakariṣyati / rākṣasā dānavāśbaiva phalaṃ prāpsyanti tasya tat
verses.translation: In order to explain the full procedipe of the performance of Srftddha Samyu is shown to have raised the points in W 40-44.
verses.hindi: जो कार्य वर्णो और आश्रमो के विरुद्ध है और जो शिष्ट शास्त्रों के
verses.wordMeaning: In order to explain the full procedipe of the performance of Srftddha Samyu is shown to have raised the points in W 40-44.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to explain the full procedipe of the performance of Srftddha Samyu is shown to have raised the points in W 40-44.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धैराप्यायिताश्चैव पितरः सोममव्ययम् । आप्यायमाना युष्माभिर्वर्द्धयिष्यन्ति नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhairāpyāyitāścaiva pitaraḥ somamavyayam / āpyāyamānā yuṣmābhirvarddhayiṣyanti nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Once again, Samyu spoke to his father who was the most excellent one among persons conversant with Brahman, who had mastered and performed all the Vedic rites and who was the most excellent among those who know everything that should be known. "Of what sort was the penance which Prajapati, the lord of all living beings, performed?'*
verses.hindi: विरोध करने बाला है--यह ऐसा ही मार्ग है जिसमें गमन करने वाला नरक में जाता है और तियंग् योनि में प्राप्त होने का भौ यही कारण होता है । ।५०। तियंग् योनि में रहने वाचा जो कारण है वह तोन कहे जाते हैं। यातना स्थान में तीन प्रकार का है और छं प्रकार का तियंग् योनि में होता
verses.wordMeaning: Once again, Samyu spoke to his father who was the most excellent one among persons conversant with Brahman, who had mastered and performed all the Vedic rites and who was the most excellent among those who know everything that should be known.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Once again, Samyu spoke to his father who was the most excellent one among persons conversant with Brahman, who had mastered and performed all the Vedic rites and who was the most excellent among those who know everything that should be known.…

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धैराप्यायितः सोमो लोकानाप्याययिष्यति । कृत्स्नं सपर्वतवनं जङ्गमाजङ्गमैर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhairāpyāyitaḥ somo lokānāpyāyayiṣyati / kṛtsnaṃ saparvatavanaṃ jaṅgamājaṅgamairvṛtam
verses.translation: Those worlds are called Santanaka. It is in them that the brilliant ones well known as Vairaja gods abide. They are the gods of the gods in the heaven.
verses.hindi: है ।५१। कारण में और विषय में सभी ओर प्रतिघात है। वह सब अनैश्वर्य प्रतिधात है। यह सव अनेश्व्य प्रतियात के स्वरूप वाला कहा गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: Those worlds are called Santanaka. It is in them that the brilliant ones well known as Vairaja gods abide. They are the gods of the gods in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those worlds are called Santanaka. It is in them that the brilliant ones well known as Vairaja gods abide. They are the gods of the gods in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धानि पुष्टिकामाश्च ये करिष्यन्ति मानवाः । तेभ्यः पुष्टिं प्रजाश्चैव दास्यन्ति पितरः सदा
verses.transliteration: śrāddhāni puṣṭikāmāśca ye kariṣyanti mānavāḥ / tebhyaḥ puṣṭiṃ prajāścaiva dāsyanti pitaraḥ sadā
verses.translation: Even as the outset, Lord Brahma, equipped with the power of Yoga and penance had created the Devas, the eternal ones, endowed with Yogic potentiality.
verses.hindi: चित्त सत्वस्य मात्रक होता है तथा सत्व प्रदर्शन से होता है यथा 'सत्व प्रद- शत से होता है ५३) ओर तत्वं का यथा तत्व देखकर तत्व प्रदर्शन से होता है । तत्व-क्षेत्रज का नानात्व जो है यही नानायं प्रदर्शन हैं ।५४॥ नानात्व का दशन ज्ञान है ओर ज्ञान से योग कहा जाया करता है उससे वद्ध का
verses.wordMeaning: Even as the outset, Lord Brahma, equipped with the power of Yoga and penance had created the Devas, the eternal ones, endowed with Yogic potentiality.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the outset, Lord Brahma, equipped with the power of Yoga and penance had created the Devas, the eternal ones, endowed with Yogic potentiality.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे येभ्यः प्रदास्यन्ति त्रीन्पिण्डान्नामगोत्रतः । सर्वत्र वर्तमानास्ते पितरः प्रपितामहाः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe yebhyaḥ pradāsyanti trīnpiṇḍānnāmagotrataḥ / sarvatra vartamānāste pitaraḥ prapitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: They arc well known as Adidevas (the primordial Devas). They have great inherent strength and vigour. They are worthy of being worshipped by the Devas, the D&navas and the hitman beings.
verses.hindi: बन्ध और मुक्त का मोक्ष भी उसी से होता है ।५४। इस संसार के विशेष निवृत्त होने पर लिक से मुक्त हो जाया करता है। नि सम्बन्ध अचेतन्य अपनी ही आत्मा में अवस्थित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: They arc well known as Adidevas (the primordial Devas). They have great inherent strength and vigour. They are worthy of being worshipped by the Devas, the D&navas and the hitman beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: They arc well known as Adidevas (the primordial Devas). They have great inherent strength and vigour. They are worthy of being worshipped by the Devas, the D&navas and the hitman beings.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामाप्याययिष्यन्ति श्राद्धदानेन वै प्रजाः । एवमाज्ञा कृता पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: teṣāmāpyāyayiṣyanti śrāddhadānena vai prajāḥ / evamājñā kṛtā pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: The three sets (Bh&uamQrtis) who have conceptual forms (i.e. formless ones) are above. Beneath them are the four sets of subtle forms (, SUk$mamQrtis ).
verses.wordMeaning: The three sets (Bh&uamQrtis) who have conceptual forms (i.e. formless ones) are above. Beneath them are the four sets of subtle forms (, SUk$mamQrtis ).
verses.commentary: Sense: The three sets (Bh&uamQrtis) who have conceptual forms (i.e. formless ones) are above. Beneath them are the four sets of subtle forms (, SUk$mamQrtis ).

verses.sanskrit: तेनैतत्सर्वथा सिद्धं दानमध्ययनं तपः । ते तु ज्ञानप्रदातारः पितरो वो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tenaitatsarvathā siddhaṃ dānamadhyayanaṃ tapaḥ / te tu jñānapradātāraḥ pitaro vo na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter are the Dcvas and thereafter is this earth. This is the series of the worlds. They shower water on this world. It is in them that the clouds take their origin.
verses.hindi: स चापि त्रिविधः प्रोक्तो मोक्षो बं तत्वदर्शिमिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter are the Dcvas and thereafter is this earth. This is the series of the worlds. They shower water on this world. It is in them that the clouds take their origin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter are the Dcvas and thereafter is this earth. This is the series of the worlds. They shower water on this world. It is in them that the clouds take their origin.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते पितरो देवा देवाश्च पितरः पुनः । अन्योन्यपितरो ह्येते देवाश्च पितरश्च ह
verses.transliteration: ityete pitaro devā devāśca pitaraḥ punaḥ / anyonyapitaro hyete devāśca pitaraśca ha
verses.translation: Propitiated in the Sraddha, the Pitre adopt their yogic power and through that yogic power develop and strength- en the Soma whereby the three worlds sustain their lives.
verses.wordMeaning: Propitiated in the Sraddha, the Pitre adopt their yogic power and through that yogic power develop and strength- en the Soma whereby the three worlds sustain their lives.
verses.commentary: Sense: Propitiated in the Sraddha, the Pitre adopt their yogic power and through that yogic power develop and strength- en the Soma whereby the three worlds sustain their lives.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्ब्रह्मवचः श्रुत्वा सूतस्य विदितात्मनः । पप्रच्छुर्मुनयो भूयः सूतं तस्माद्यदुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: etadbrahmavacaḥ śrutvā sūtasya viditātmanaḥ / papracchurmunayo bhūyaḥ sūtaṃ tasmādyaduttaram
verses.translation: Hence Srdddhas should be offered with great effort (for the acquisition) of the yogic power. Indeed Yoga is the source of the strength of the Pitrs. Soma (the moon) functions through the Yogic power.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence Srdddhas should be offered with great effort (for the acquisition) of the yogic power. Indeed Yoga is the source of the strength of the Pitrs. Soma (the moon) functions through the Yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence Srdddhas should be offered with great effort (for the acquisition) of the yogic power. Indeed Yoga is the source of the strength of the Pitrs. Soma (the moon) functions through the Yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कियन्तो वै मुनिगणाः कस्मिन्काले च ते गणाः । पूर्वे तु देवप्रवरा देवानां सोमवर्द्धनाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kiyanto vai munigaṇāḥ kasminkāle ca te gaṇāḥ / pūrve tu devapravarā devānāṃ somavarddhanāḥ
verses.translation: One may feed a hundred thousand Brahmanas1 or
verses.wordMeaning: One may feed a hundred thousand Brahmanas1 or
verses.commentary: Sense: One may feed a hundred thousand Brahmanas1 or

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच एतद्वो ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि पितृसर्गमनुत्तमम् । शंयुः पप्रच्छ यत्पूर्वं पितरं वै बृहस्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca etadvo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi pitṛsargamanuttamam / śaṃyuḥ papraccha yatpūrvaṃ pitaraṃ vai bṛhaspatim
verses.translation: W. 67-74 describe the importance of feeding a Yogin — a point emphasized again by him in the following chapters.
verses.hindi: बह अपने ही स्वरूप में अवस्थित होता हुआ भी विरूपाश्मा के द्वारा लिखा जाता है । यह इतना ही संक्षेप से ज्ञान और मोक्ष का लक्षण कहा गया है ।५७। बह् मोक्ष भो तत्व दक्षियों के द्वारा तोन प्रकार का कहा गया है। पूर्व ज्ञान वियोग-दूसरे में राग का संक्षय से होता है।५८। तृष्णा के
verses.wordMeaning: W. 67-74 describe the importance of feeding a Yogin — a point emphasized again by him in the following chapters.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 67-74 describe the importance of feeding a Yogin — a point emphasized again by him in the following chapters.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिमुपासीनं सर्वज्ञानार्थकोविदम् । पुत्रः शंयुरिमं प्रश्नं पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatimupāsīnaṃ sarvajñānārthakovidam / putraḥ śaṃyurimaṃ praśnaṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: One may feed many of these Mantrajhas who may come (to his house). But one Sndtaka (i.e. an initiated house- holder) who is propitiated, hear me, deserves all of them (i.e. feeding a Sndtaka is on a par with feeding many Mantrajnas) •
verses.hindi: क्षप से तीसरा मोक्ष का कारण कहा गया है। लिङ्ग के अभाव से कंबत्य होता है और कैवल्य से निरञ्जन होता है । निरज्जनत्व होने से शुद्ध होता है। अन्य कोई भी नेता नहीं होता है । इसके आगे हम दोषों के देखने से जो वेराम्य होता है उसको बतलायेंगे ।५९-६०। दिव्य और मानुष पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: One may feed many of these Mantrajhas who may come (to his house). But one Sndtaka (i.e. an initiated house- holder) who is propitiated, hear me, deserves all of them (i.e. feeding a Sndtaka is on a par with feeding many Mantrajnas) •
verses.commentary: Sense: One may feed many of these Mantrajhas who may come (to his house). But one Sndtaka (i.e. an initiated house- holder) who is propitiated, hear me, deserves all of them (i.e. feeding a Sndtaka is on a par with feeding many Mantrajnas) •

verses.sanskrit: क एते पितरो नाम कियन्तः के च नामतः । समुद्भूताः कथं चैते पितृत्वं समुपागताः
verses.transliteration: ka ete pitaro nāma kiyantaḥ ke ca nāmataḥ / samudbhūtāḥ kathaṃ caite pitṛtvaṃ samupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: If a thousand Mantrajfias or a hundred Snatakas or a single master of Yoga, are fed what is taken in by them saves one from a great danger [a master of Yoga is so great that he is on par with a hundred of Snatakas etc.]
verses.hindi: लक्षणों वाला विषय हूँ उसमें अप्रद्ष ष और अनभिष्वङ्क दोषों के देखने से करना चाहिए ।६१। ताप प्रीति और विष आदि का अच्छी तरह से परि- वर्जन कर देना चाहिए । उस तरह से वैराग्य में समास्थित होकर यह शरीरघारी ममता मे रहित हो जाया करता है ।६२। बुद्धि से ऐसा अनुचिन्तन
verses.wordMeaning: If a thousand Mantrajfias or a hundred Snatakas or a single master of Yoga, are fed what is taken in by them saves one from a great danger [a master of Yoga is so great that he is on par with a hundred of Snatakas etc.]
verses.commentary: Sense: If a thousand Mantrajfias or a hundred Snatakas or a single master of Yoga, are fed what is taken in by them saves one from a great danger [a master of Yoga is so great that he is on par with a hundred of Snatakas etc.]

verses.sanskrit: कस्माच्च पितरः पूर्वं यज्ञं पुष्णन्ति नित्यशः । क्रियाश्च सर्वा वर्त्तन्ते श्राद्धपूर्वा महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: kasmācca pitaraḥ pūrvaṃ yajñaṃ puṣṇanti nityaśaḥ / kriyāśca sarvā varttante śrāddhapūrvā mahātmanām
verses.translation: Yoga alone (i.e. a man equipped with Yogic power) excels a thousand householders, a hundred Vdnaprasthas (forest dweller hermits) and a thousand Brahmacarins (the celibate religious students).
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए कि यह दुःख अनित्य और अशिव है। सत्व की ही अति- निषेवा से संथा परम विशुद्ध कार्यों को करे
verses.wordMeaning: Yoga alone (i.e. a man equipped with Yogic power) excels a thousand householders, a hundred Vdnaprasthas (forest dweller hermits) and a thousand Brahmacarins (the celibate religious students).
verses.commentary: Sense: Yoga alone (i.e. a man equipped with Yogic power) excels a thousand householders, a hundred Vdnaprasthas (forest dweller hermits) and a thousand Brahmacarins (the celibate religious students).

verses.sanskrit: कस्मै श्राद्धानि देयानि किं च दत्ते महाफलम् । केषु चाप्यक्षयं श्राद्धं तीर्थेषु च नदीषु च
verses.transliteration: kasmai śrāddhāni deyāni kiṃ ca datte mahāphalam / keṣu cāpyakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ tīrtheṣu ca nadīṣu ca
verses.translation: Prajapati has said.' An atheist, an evil-doer, a person mixed of castes or a thief cannot have redemption from anything else except ( by offering) a charitable gift unto those who have Yogic power.
verses.wordMeaning: Prajapati has said.' An atheist, an evil-doer, a person mixed of castes or a thief cannot have redemption from anything else except ( by offering) a charitable gift unto those who have Yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajapati has said.' An atheist, an evil-doer, a person mixed of castes or a thief cannot have redemption from anything else except ( by offering) a charitable gift unto those who have Yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: केषु वै सर्वमाप्तोति श्राद्धं कृत्वा द्विजोत्तमः । कश्च कालो भवेच्छ्राद्धे विधिः कश्चानुवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: keṣu vai sarvamāptoti śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā dvijottamaḥ / kaśca kālo bhavecchrāddhe vidhiḥ kaścānuvarttate
verses.translation: If the son or a grandson feeds a Dhydnin (one who meditates), the Pitrs become delighted like the farmers who become delighted when there is plenty of rain.
verses.wordMeaning: If the son or a grandson feeds a Dhydnin (one who meditates), the Pitrs become delighted like the farmers who become delighted when there is plenty of rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the son or a grandson feeds a Dhydnin (one who meditates), the Pitrs become delighted like the farmers who become delighted when there is plenty of rain.

verses.sanskrit: एतदिच्छामि भगवन्विस्तरेण यथा तथा । व्याख्यातमानुपूर्व्येण यत्र चोदाहृतं मया
verses.transliteration: etadicchāmi bhagavanvistareṇa yathā tathā / vyākhyātamānupūrvyeṇa yatra codāhṛtaṃ mayā
verses.translation: If persons engrossed in meditation are not available one should feed a Brahmac&rin. If he is not available one may feed a householder who is Uddsina (indifferent to worldly pleasures ).
verses.wordMeaning: If persons engrossed in meditation are not available one should feed a Brahmac&rin. If he is not available one may feed a householder who is Uddsina (indifferent to worldly pleasures ).
verses.commentary: Sense: If persons engrossed in meditation are not available one should feed a Brahmac&rin. If he is not available one may feed a householder who is Uddsina (indifferent to worldly pleasures ).

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरिदं सम्यगेवं पृष्टो महामतिः । व्याजहारानुपूर्व्येण प्रश्नं प्रश्नविदां वरः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiridaṃ samyagevaṃ pṛṣṭo mahāmatiḥ / vyājahārānupūrvyeṇa praśnaṃ praśnavidāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Listen attentively. I shall tell their worlds as well as creation. I shall recount those who are their daughters and those who are regarded as their grandsons (daughters* sons).
verses.wordMeaning: Listen attentively. I shall tell their worlds as well as creation. I shall recount those who are their daughters and those who are regarded as their grandsons (daughters* sons).
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen attentively. I shall tell their worlds as well as creation. I shall recount those who are their daughters and those who are regarded as their grandsons (daughters* sons).

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच कथ यिष्यामि ते तात यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि । विनयेन यथान्यायं गम्भीरं प्रश्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca katha yiṣyāmi te tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi / vinayena yathānyāyaṃ gambhīraṃ praśnamuttamam
verses.translation: In those worlds named Santanakas the formless yet brilliant groups of Pitrs abide. They are the sons ofPrajapati.
verses.hindi: जब मनुष्य परिपकब कषाय बाला होता है अर्थात् सांसारिक दु.खों के भोगों से परिपक्व होता है। ऐसा मनुष्य सभी दोषों का अवलोकन किया करता है । इसके अनन्तर प्रयाण के समय में नैमित्तिक दोषों से इस शरीर में तव वायु से प्रेरित ऊकमा प्रकुपित होकर शरीर में उपाश्रय प्रहण
verses.wordMeaning: In those worlds named Santanakas the formless yet brilliant groups of Pitrs abide. They are the sons ofPrajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those worlds named Santanakas the formless yet brilliant groups of Pitrs abide. They are the sons ofPrajapati.

verses.sanskrit: द्यौरंरिक्षं पृथिवी नक्षत्राणि दिशस्त था । सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ चैव तथाहोरात्रमेव च
verses.transliteration: dyauraṃrikṣaṃ pṛthivī nakṣatrāṇi diśasta thā / sūryācandramasau caiva tathāhorātrameva ca
verses.translation: They are the sons of Viraja the Prajapati. Hence they are well known as Vairajas. They are excellent Brahmanas. These are the Pitrs, O dear one, who increase the yogic power of the yogins.
verses.hindi: करके समस्त दोषों का अवरोध कर दिया करता है ।६४-६५। वह प्राण के स्थानों का भेदन करता हुआ तथा मर्म स्थलों में अतिक्रमण करके उन का छेदन किया करता है और शैत्य से प्रकुपित हुआ बायु फिर ऊपर की ओर उत्क्रमण किया करता है ।६६। और वही यह समस्त प्राणियों के प्राण के
verses.wordMeaning: They are the sons of Viraja the Prajapati. Hence they are well known as Vairajas. They are excellent Brahmanas. These are the Pitrs, O dear one, who increase the yogic power of the yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the sons of Viraja the Prajapati. Hence they are well known as Vairajas. They are excellent Brahmanas. These are the Pitrs, O dear one, who increase the yogic power of the yogins.

verses.sanskrit: न बभूवुस्तदा तात तमोभूतमभूज्जगत् । ब्रह्मैको दुश्चरं तत्र तताप परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: na babhūvustadā tāta tamobhūtamabhūjjagat / brahmaiko duścaraṃ tatra tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: They perpetually develop the Yogic powers (of others) by means of their own Yogic power. Strengthened and developed by means of Sraddhas, they develop the Soma ( the moon god ). Soma who is thus strengthened and developed strengthens and develops the worlds.
verses.hindi: स्थानों में अवस्थित होता है । संक्षेप से ज्ञान के संवृत हो जाने पर सभी कर्म भी संबृत्त हो जाते हैं ।६७। वह जीव अपने पूर्व में किये हुए कर्मों से अभ्यधि- घान नहीं होता है। फिर वह अष्टाङ्ग प्राण बृत्ति को भी विच्यावित कर दिया करता है ।६५। वह अस्त में इस पाञ्चभोतिक शरीर का त्याग करता
verses.wordMeaning: They perpetually develop the Yogic powers (of others) by means of their own Yogic power. Strengthened and developed by means of Sraddhas, they develop the Soma ( the moon god ). Soma who is thus strengthened and developed strengthens and develops the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They perpetually develop the Yogic powers (of others) by means of their own Yogic power. Strengthened and developed by means of Sraddhas, they develop the Soma ( the moon god ). Soma who is thus strengthened and developed strengthens and develops the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: शंयुस्तमब्रवीद्भूयः पितरं ब्रह्मवित्तमम् । सर्ववेदव्रतस्नातः सर्वज्ञानविदां वरः । कीदृशं सर्वभूतेशस्तपस्तेपे प्रजा पतिः
verses.transliteration: śaṃyustamabravīdbhūyaḥ pitaraṃ brahmavittamam / sarvavedavratasnātaḥ sarvajñānavidāṃ varaḥ / kīdṛśaṃ sarvabhūteśastapastepe prajā patiḥ
verses.translation: Two of them had places of shelter viz. — Ekapama took shelter under a Nyagrodha tree and Ekapafala under a Patala ( trumpet-flower tree). Aparna was without any abode. They performed penance.
verses.hindi: हुआ फिर विना श्वासों वाला हो जाया करता है । इस रीति से प्राणों के द्वारा परित्यक्त होता हुआ वह मानव मर गया है--यही कहा जाया करता है ६४ जिस तरह से इस लोक में स्वप्न में इधर से उघर नीयमान होता है। उसके विधेय का रञ्जन है उससे अन्य नहीं होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Two of them had places of shelter viz. — Ekapama took shelter under a Nyagrodha tree and Ekapafala under a Patala ( trumpet-flower tree). Aparna was without any abode. They performed penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two of them had places of shelter viz. — Ekapama took shelter under a Nyagrodha tree and Ekapafala under a Patala ( trumpet-flower tree). Aparna was without any abode. They performed penance.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच सर्वेषां तपसां यत्तत्तपो योगमनुत्तमम् । ध्यायंस्तदा स भगवांस्तेन लोकानवासृजत्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ yattattapo yogamanuttamam / dhyāyaṃstadā sa bhagavāṃstena lokānavāsṛjat
verses.translation: Cf. Pd. P. V. 9.2-3, Vft. 1,73,.60 for similar seven divisions of Pitfs into those having forms and formless ones. One of them (had performed penance) without taking food. Her mother who was pained on account of her motherly love forbade her (from performing penance) saying 'U ma* (O daughter do not).1
verses.hindi: तृष्णाक्षयस्तृतीयस्तु व्याख्यातं मोक्षलक्षणम् । शददाद्यो विषये दोषदृष्टि्वे पचलक्षणे
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Pd. P. V. 9.2-3, Vft. 1,73,.60 for similar seven divisions of Pitfs into those having forms and formless ones. One of them (had performed penance) without taking food.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Pd. P. V. 9.2-3, Vft. 1,73,.60 for similar seven divisions of Pitfs into those having forms and formless ones. One of them (had performed penance) without taking food.…

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानानि भूतभव्यानि लोका वेदाश्च सर्वशः । योगामृतास्तदा सृष्टा ब्रह्मणा लोकचक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: jñānāni bhūtabhavyāni lokā vedāśca sarvaśaḥ / yogāmṛtāstadā sṛṣṭā brahmaṇā lokacakṣuṣā
verses.translation: The gentle lady Aparna who performed a penance very difficult to be performed ( by others) on being addressed
verses.wordMeaning: The gentle lady Aparna who performed a penance very difficult to be performed ( by others) on being addressed
verses.commentary: Sense: The gentle lady Aparna who performed a penance very difficult to be performed ( by others) on being addressed

verses.sanskrit: लोकाः संतानका नाम यत्र तिष्ठन्ति भास्वराः । वैराजा इति विख्याता देवानां दिवि देवता। ॥ ५२॥ योगेन तपसा युक्तः पूर्वमेव तदा प्रभुः । देवानसृजत ब्रह्मा योगयुक्तान्सनातनान्
verses.transliteration: lokāḥ saṃtānakā nāma yatra tiṣṭhanti bhāsvarāḥ / vairājā iti vikhyātā devānāṃ divi devatā/ // 52// yogena tapasā yuktaḥ pūrvameva tadā prabhuḥ / devānasṛjata brahmā yogayuktānsanātanān
verses.translation: She became well known by that name on account of her activity expressed in the words of such a derivation. This world with its mobile and immobile living beings had such (splendid) triad of virgins. What had been created by the power of pcnancc of these three virgins will hold good as long as the earth exists. All those three (virgins) were equipped with Yogic power. Penance sustained their physical bodies.
verses.wordMeaning: She became well known by that name on account of her activity expressed in the words of such a derivation. This world with its mobile and immobile living beings had such (splendid) triad of virgins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She became well known by that name on account of her activity expressed in the words of such a derivation. This world with its mobile and immobile living beings had such (splendid) triad of virgins.…

verses.sanskrit: आदिदेवा इति ख्याता महासत्त्वा महौजसः । सर्वकामप्रदाः पूज्या देवादानवमानवैः
verses.transliteration: ādidevā iti khyātā mahāsattvā mahaujasaḥ / sarvakāmapradāḥ pūjyā devādānavamānavaiḥ
verses.translation: All of them had excellent and great fortune. All of them possessed permanent youth. All of them were expounders of the Brahman. All of them had sublimated their sexual urge and potentiality.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them had excellent and great fortune. All of them possessed permanent youth. All of them were expounders of the Brahman. All of them had sublimated their sexual urge and potentiality.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them had excellent and great fortune. All of them possessed permanent youth. All of them were expounders of the Brahman. All of them had sublimated their sexual urge and potentiality.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सप्त समाख्याता गणास्त्रैलोक्यपूजिताः । अमूर्त्तयस्त्रयस्तेषां चत्वारस्तु समूर्त्तयः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ sapta samākhyātā gaṇāstrailokyapūjitāḥ / amūrttayastrayasteṣāṃ catvārastu samūrttayaḥ
verses.translation: You go everywhere. (You are free to go anywhere). Hence, there can't be any blame on you." On being instructed thus, the instruction was duly carried out by the firegod. The lord left Uma and discharged the semen on the ground. Instantly, the firegod was cursed by the annoyed and infuriated Uma.
verses.wordMeaning: You go everywhere. (You are free to go anywhere). Hence, there can't be any blame on you." On being instructed thus, the instruction was duly carried out by the firegod. The lord left Uma and discharged the semen on the ground. Instantly,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You go everywhere. (You are free to go anywhere). Hence, there can't be any blame on you." On being instructed thus, the instruction was duly carried out by the firegod. The lord left Uma and discharged the semen on the ground. Instantly,…

verses.sanskrit: उपरिष्टात् त्रयस्तेषां वर्त्तन्ते भावमूर्त्तयः । तेषामधस्ताद्वर्त्तन्ते चत्वारः सूक्ष्ममूर्त्तयः
verses.transliteration: upariṣṭāt trayasteṣāṃ varttante bhāvamūrttayaḥ / teṣāmadhastādvarttante catvāraḥ sūkṣmamūrttayaḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhas and Caranas moving about in the sky discharged showers of flowers. The Gandharva chieftains began to sing here and there (everywhere).
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas and Caranas moving about in the sky discharged showers of flowers. The Gandharva chieftains began to sing here and there (everywhere).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas and Caranas moving about in the sky discharged showers of flowers. The Gandharva chieftains began to sing here and there (everywhere).

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवास्ततो भूमिरेषा लोकपरंपरा । लोके वर्षन्ति ते ह्यस्मिंस्तेभ्यः पर्जन्यसंभवः
verses.transliteration: tato devāstato bhūmireṣā lokaparaṃparā / loke varṣanti te hyasmiṃstebhyaḥ parjanyasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: That lordly son born of Rudra and resembling the rising, sun was surrounded by them with great affection as though by his own real mothers. W. 40*45 explain why Skanda got six faces. The Mbh. account differs.
verses.wordMeaning: That lordly son born of Rudra and resembling the rising, sun was surrounded by them with great affection as though by his own real mothers. W. 40*45 explain why Skanda got six faces. The Mbh. account differs.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lordly son born of Rudra and resembling the rising, sun was surrounded by them with great affection as though by his own real mothers. W. 40*45 explain why Skanda got six faces. The Mbh. account differs.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं भवति वै वृष्ट्या लोकानां संभवस्ततः । आप्याययन्ति ते यस्मात्सोमं चान्नं च योगतः
verses.transliteration: annaṃ bhavati vai vṛṣṭyā lokānāṃ saṃbhavastataḥ / āpyāyayanti te yasmātsomaṃ cānnaṃ ca yogataḥ
verses.translation: Since that ancient lord, the slayer of the Asuras, was (breast-fed and) nurtured by Kfttikas he became well known as Karttikeya.
verses.hindi: तीसरा तृष्णा का क्षय है जो कि मोक्ष का लक्षण व्याख्यान किया गया है । शब्दादि पञ्च लक्षण विषय में दोष दृष्टि होती है ।७४। अप्र ष- अभिष्वङ्ग-प्रीति ताप का विवर्जा ये ही प्रकृतियों का और लय का वैराग्य का कारण हैं ।७२। आठ पूर्व में बित क्रमानुसार प्रकृतियाँ जाननी चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Since that ancient lord, the slayer of the Asuras, was (breast-fed and) nurtured by Kfttikas he became well known as Karttikeya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since that ancient lord, the slayer of the Asuras, was (breast-fed and) nurtured by Kfttikas he became well known as Karttikeya.

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुस्तान्वै पितॄंस्त स्माल्लोकानां लोकसत्तमाः । मनोजवाः स्वधाभक्ष्यः सर्वकामपरिष्कृताः
verses.transliteration: ūcustānvai pitṝṃsta smāllokānāṃ lokasattamāḥ / manojavāḥ svadhābhakṣyaḥ sarvakāmapariṣkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: When that enemy of the Daityas yawned, his (wea- pon) Sakti (Spear) (named) Aparajita (unvanquished) came out of his mouth emitting brilliant flames of fire. Those Pitrs had never before been seen by her. She
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तादि और भूतान्त प्रकृति से उद्भूत समझने चाहिए ।७३। वर्णो
verses.wordMeaning: When that enemy of the Daityas yawned, his (wea- pon) Sakti (Spear) (named) Aparajita (unvanquished) came out of his mouth emitting brilliant flames of fire. Those Pitrs had never before been seen by her. She
verses.commentary: Sense: When that enemy of the Daityas yawned, his (wea- pon) Sakti (Spear) (named) Aparajita (unvanquished) came out of his mouth emitting brilliant flames of fire. Those Pitrs had never before been seen by her. She

verses.sanskrit: लोभमोहभयोपेता निश्चिन्ताः शोक वर्जिताः । एते योगं परित्यज्य प्राप्ता लोकान्सुदर्शनान्
verses.transliteration: lobhamohabhayopetā niścintāḥ śoka varjitāḥ / ete yogaṃ parityajya prāptā lokānsudarśanān
verses.translation: The distressed river falling headlong cried out "Ye save me!"
verses.hindi: से समस्वित-शिष्ट और शास्त्रों का विरोध न करते वाला यह वर्णाश्रमों का देवों के स्थानों में कारण होता है ।३४। ब्रह्मा से आदि लेकर पिशाचों के अन्त पर्यन्त ये आठ स्यान ही देवता हैं। ऐश्‍वर्य और अणिमादि आठ लक्षण ही कारण हैं।७५। शुक्रादि के लक्षण वाले अप्रतिघात के दृष्ट होने पर
verses.wordMeaning: The distressed river falling headlong cried out "Ye save me!"
verses.commentary: Sense: The distressed river falling headlong cried out "Ye save me!"

verses.sanskrit: दिव्याः पुण्या विपाप्मानो महात्मानो भवन्त्युत । ततो युगसहस्रान्ते जायन्ते ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: divyāḥ puṇyā vipāpmāno mahātmāno bhavantyuta / tato yugasahasrānte jāyante brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: After giving birth to all these, you will once again attain these worlds. Due to your transgression of the Pitrs you will have a despicable birth. You will become the daughter of that very same king and Adrika. After taking birth as their daughter, you will attain these worlds once again."
verses.hindi: निमित्त हैं । ये क्रमानुसार आठ प्राकृत रूप हैं।७६। ये गुण मात्रात्मक क्षेत्रज्ञों में अनुसज्जित होते हैं । जिस तरह से नेत्रों वाले मनुष्य वर्षा काल में मेघ को पृथक् देखा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After giving birth to all these, you will once again attain these worlds. Due to your transgression of the Pitrs you will have a despicable birth. You will become the daughter of that very same king and Adrika. After taking birth as their daughter,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving birth to all these, you will once again attain these worlds. Due to your transgression of the Pitrs you will have a despicable birth. You will become the daughter of that very same king and Adrika. After taking birth as their daughter,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिलभ्य पुनर्योगं मोक्षं गच्छन्त्यमूर्त्तयः । व्यक्ताव्यक्तं परित्यज्य महायोगबलेन च
verses.transliteration: pratilabhya punaryogaṃ mokṣaṃ gacchantyamūrttayaḥ / vyaktāvyaktaṃ parityajya mahāyogabalena ca
verses.translation: The worlds named "Virajas" are in the firmament The groups of Pitrs remembered by the name *Agni$vattas* live there. They have the lustre of the sun.
verses.wordMeaning: The worlds named "Virajas" are in the firmament The groups of Pitrs remembered by the name *Agni$vattas* live there. They have the lustre of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The worlds named "Virajas" are in the firmament The groups of Pitrs remembered by the name *Agni$vattas* live there. They have the lustre of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: नश्यन्त्युल्केव गगने क्षणद्विद्युत्प्रभेव च । उत्सृज्य देहजालानि महायोगबलेन च
verses.transliteration: naśyantyulkeva gagane kṣaṇadvidyutprabheva ca / utsṛjya dehajālāni mahāyogabalena ca
verses.translation: Groups of Danayas, Yak?as, R&k?asas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Bhutas, serpents and Pi£acas who seek benefit worship them. These sons of Pulaha, the Prajapati, have been recounted. Their mental daughter is well known by the name Pivari.
verses.hindi: जीवः प्राणस्तथा लिगं करणं च चतुष्टयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Groups of Danayas, Yak?as, R&k?asas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Bhutas, serpents and Pi£acas who seek benefit worship them. These sons of Pulaha, the Prajapati, have been recounted. Their mental daughter is well known by the name Pivari.
verses.commentary: Sense: Groups of Danayas, Yak?as, R&k?asas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Bhutas, serpents and Pi£acas who seek benefit worship them. These sons of Pulaha, the Prajapati, have been recounted. Their mental daughter is well known by the name Pivari.

verses.sanskrit: निराख्योपास्यता यान्ति सरितं सागरं यथा । क्रियया गुरुपूजाभिर्यागं कुर्वन्ति यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: nirākhyopāsyatā yānti saritaṃ sāgaraṃ yathā / kriyayā gurupūjābhiryāgaṃ kurvanti yatnataḥ
verses.translation: VV 53-74 give the previous birth of Satyavatf, mother of Vy&sa and then the queen of Santanu.
verses.wordMeaning: VV 53-74 give the previous birth of Satyavatf, mother of Vy&sa and then the queen of Santanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV 53-74 give the previous birth of Satyavatf, mother of Vy&sa and then the queen of Santanu.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे प्रीतास्ततः सोमं पितरो योगमास्थिताः । आप्याययन्ति योगेन त्रैलोक्यं येन जीवति
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe prītāstataḥ somaṃ pitaro yogamāsthitāḥ / āpyāyayanti yogena trailokyaṃ yena jīvati
verses.translation: He will become a great sage who can go every* where. He will be a liberated one adopting the Apunarmdrga (the pathway from which no one returns i.e. moksa) endowed with the rays of the sun. These three sets (of Pitrs) have been recounted. Understand the remaining four. I shall describe the sets (of Pitrs) having Prabh£ (lustre) as their forms, O excellent Brahmana (?)
verses.wordMeaning: He will become a great sage who can go every* where. He will be a liberated one adopting the Apunarmdrga (the pathway from which no one returns i.e. moksa) endowed with the rays of the sun. These three sets (of Pitrs) have been recounted. Understand the remaining four.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He will become a great sage who can go every* where. He will be a liberated one adopting the Apunarmdrga (the pathway from which no one returns i.e. moksa) endowed with the rays of the sun. These three sets (of Pitrs) have been recounted. Understand the remaining four.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छ्राद्धानि देयानि योगानां यत्नतः सदा । पितॄणां हि बलं योगो योगात्सोमः प्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: tasmācchrāddhāni deyāni yogānāṃ yatnataḥ sadā / pitṝṇāṃ hi balaṃ yogo yogātsomaḥ pravarttate
verses.translation: Those Kavyas, the sons of Agni Kavi (?), are the Pitrs born of Svadha. They arc the Pitrs in the celestial worlds shining with the luminary bodies. They have great brilliance.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार के सिद्ध पुरुष जोव को दिव्य चक्षुके द्वारा देखा करते हैं तथा उनको जो अन्न को खाते हैं और पान किया करते हैं तथा योनियों में प्रवेश किया करते हैं ।७८। ऊपर-नीचे और तिरछा दौड़ता हुआ भी जो क्रम के ही अनुरूप उसका धावन होता है उस दशा में भी उसके जीव-प्राण-लिङ्ग
verses.wordMeaning: Those Kavyas, the sons of Agni Kavi (?), are the Pitrs born of Svadha. They arc the Pitrs in the celestial worlds shining with the luminary bodies. They have great brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Kavyas, the sons of Agni Kavi (?), are the Pitrs born of Svadha. They arc the Pitrs in the celestial worlds shining with the luminary bodies. They have great brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशतविप्रान्वै भोजयेद्यावदागतान् । एकस्तानपि मन्त्रज्ञः सर्वानर्हति तच्छृणु
verses.transliteration: sahasraśataviprānvai bhojayedyāvadāgatān / ekastānapi mantrajñaḥ sarvānarhati tacchṛṇu
verses.translation: In holy rites causing the development and flourish- ing progress and fulfilment of all desires the Brahmanas worship them. Their mental daughter is well known as Yogotpatti. The Pitrs named Sukalas are the sons of the noble- souled Vasistha, son of Hiranyagarbha (Brahma). The Sudras worship them.
verses.hindi: ओर करण-ये चार वस्तुए' विद्यमान हैं॥७६। ये चारों पर्याय वाचक अर्थात समानायंक हैं तो भी एकार्थ वाले शद्धों से वह अभिलषित होता है। व्यक्त और अव्यक्त प्रमाण वाला यह है और वह पूर्णतया भोगता है
verses.wordMeaning: In holy rites causing the development and flourish- ing progress and fulfilment of all desires the Brahmanas worship them. Their mental daughter is well known as Yogotpatti. The Pitrs named Sukalas are the sons of the noble- souled Vasistha, son of Hiranyagarbha (Brahma).…
verses.commentary: Sense: In holy rites causing the development and flourish- ing progress and fulfilment of all desires the Brahmanas worship them. Their mental daughter is well known as Yogotpatti. The Pitrs named Sukalas are the sons of the noble- souled Vasistha, son of Hiranyagarbha (Brahma).…

verses.sanskrit: एतानेव च मन्त्रज्ञान्भोजयेद्यः समागतान् । एकस्तान्स्नातकः प्रितः सर्वानर्हति तच्छृणु
verses.transliteration: etāneva ca mantrajñānbhojayedyaḥ samāgatān / ekastānsnātakaḥ pritaḥ sarvānarhati tacchṛṇu
verses.translation: Those worlds where they stay in the heaven are Manasa by name. Their mental daughter is Narmada, the most excellent river.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त के अनुग्रह के अन्त वाला है और जो क्षेत्रज्ञ में अधिष्ठित है।इस प्रकार से ज्ञान प्राप्त करके शुचि होकर ज्ञान से ही निश्चित रूप से विमुक्ति को परापत हुआ करता है ८१ तत्वों के दशं में तत्व जैसे ही नष्ट होता है फिर भिन्न तुनिवृ'त देह में औसा भो इष्ट हो बह परितिर्याण किया करता
verses.wordMeaning: Those worlds where they stay in the heaven are Manasa by name. Their mental daughter is Narmada, the most excellent river.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those worlds where they stay in the heaven are Manasa by name. Their mental daughter is Narmada, the most excellent river.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रज्ञानां सहस्रेण स्नातकानां शतेन च । योगाचार्येण यद्भुक्तं त्रायते महातो भयात्
verses.transliteration: mantrajñānāṃ sahasreṇa snātakānāṃ śatena ca / yogācāryeṇa yadbhuktaṃ trāyate mahāto bhayāt
verses.translation: She sanctifies the living beings as she proceeds along the Dak$inapatha (southern tract and territory). She was the wife of Purukutsa and the mother of Trasaddasyu. He sponsors the rites ofSraddha in the case of every- one in the order of the Pitrs, O excellent Brahmanas. Hence <£raddha must be offered with faith in accordance with one's own Dharma ( religious duty).
verses.hindi: है ।८२। फिर अव्यक्त ज्ञानी का करण भी विद्यमान होता है । वह प्राणादि गुण शरीर से सब प्रकार से मुक्त ही हो जाता है।८३। फिर बह अन्य शरीर को ग्रहण नहीं किया करता है क्योंकि जोसे जब बीज ही दग्ध हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: She sanctifies the living beings as she proceeds along the Dak$inapatha (southern tract and territory). She was the wife of Purukutsa and the mother of Trasaddasyu. He sponsors the rites ofSraddha in the case of every- one in the order of the Pitrs, O excellent Brahmanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She sanctifies the living beings as she proceeds along the Dak$inapatha (southern tract and territory). She was the wife of Purukutsa and the mother of Trasaddasyu. He sponsors the rites ofSraddha in the case of every- one in the order of the Pitrs, O excellent Brahmanas.…

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थानां सहस्रेण वानप्रस्थशतेन च । ब्रह्मचारिसहस्रेण योग एव विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthānāṃ sahasreṇa vānaprasthaśatena ca / brahmacārisahasreṇa yoga eva viśiṣyate
verses.translation: In all cases (i.e. all castes and creeds) the Sraddha (ablation) offered to the Manes in silver vessels or those set with silver propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: तो बीजांकुर भी समाप्न हो जाया करता है ओर ज्ञानी जो है वह तो सर्ग संसाराविज्ञ शारीर मानस होता है अर्थात् सभो संसार के द्वारा उसका
verses.wordMeaning: In all cases (i.e. all castes and creeds) the Sraddha (ablation) offered to the Manes in silver vessels or those set with silver propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all cases (i.e. all castes and creeds) the Sraddha (ablation) offered to the Manes in silver vessels or those set with silver propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: नास्तिको वाप्यधर्मो वा संकीर्मस्तस्करो ऽपि वा । नान्यत्र तारणं दानं योगेष्वाह प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: nāstiko vāpyadharmo vā saṃkīrmastaskaro 'pi vā / nānyatra tāraṇaṃ dānaṃ yogeṣvāha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Devas honour them and offer them Sraddhas scrupulously and devoutly. All of them join their palms in reverence. All of them along with Indra worship them with their minds concentrated on them. Vairajas Mena, Wife of Himavan, mother of Um&,
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas honour them and offer them Sraddhas scrupulously and devoutly. All of them join their palms in reverence. All of them along with Indra worship them with their minds concentrated on them. Vairajas Mena, Wife of Himavan, mother of Um&,
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas honour them and offer them Sraddhas scrupulously and devoutly. All of them join their palms in reverence. All of them along with Indra worship them with their minds concentrated on them. Vairajas Mena, Wife of Himavan, mother of Um&,

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्तस्य तुष्यन्ति सुवृष्टेनैव कर्षकाः । पुत्रो वाप्यथ वा पौत्रो ध्यानिनं भोजयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: pitarastasya tuṣyanti suvṛṣṭenaiva karṣakāḥ / putro vāpyatha vā pautro dhyāninaṃ bhojayiṣyati
verses.translation: Barhi$ads Acchoda (river) adopted king Amavasu
verses.wordMeaning: Barhi$ads Acchoda (river) adopted king Amavasu
verses.commentary: Sense: Barhi$ads Acchoda (river) adopted king Amavasu

verses.transliteration: alābhe dhyānaniṣṭhānāṃ bhojayedbrahmacāriṇam / tadalābhe udasīnaṃ gūhasthamapi bhojayet
verses.translation: Agnisvattas PIvarl, married to £uka, Vyasa's son. Kavyas (Sons of Agni and Yogotpatti alias Eka-$rAg&, married
