verses.sanskrit: यस्तिष्ठेदेकपादेन वायुभक्षः शतं समाः । ध्यानयोगी परस्तस्मादिति ब्रह्मानुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: yastiṣṭhedekapādena vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ samāḥ / dhyānayogī parastasmāditi brahmānuśāsanam
verses.translation: Upahutas (Sons of Ahgiras) Yasoda, married to king Khafvariga
verses.wordMeaning: Upahutas (Sons of Ahgiras) Yasoda, married to king Khafvariga
verses.commentary: Sense: Upahutas (Sons of Ahgiras) Yasoda, married to king Khafvariga

verses.sanskrit: आद्य एष गणः प्रोक्तः पितॄणाममितौजसाम् । भावयन्सर्वलोकान्वै स्थित एष गणः सदा
verses.transliteration: ādya eṣa gaṇaḥ proktaḥ pitṝṇāmamitaujasām / bhāvayansarvalokānvai sthita eṣa gaṇaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Ajyap&s (Sons of Pulaha) Virajk, married to king Nahu$a, mother Suk&la Narmadi (The river), wife of Purukutra
verses.wordMeaning: Ajyap&s (Sons of Pulaha) Virajk, married to king Nahu$a, mother Suk&la Narmadi (The river), wife of Purukutra
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajyap&s (Sons of Pulaha) Virajk, married to king Nahu$a, mother Suk&la Narmadi (The river), wife of Purukutra

verses.sanskrit: अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वानपि गणान्पुनः । संततिं संस्थितिं चैव भावनां च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvānapi gaṇānpunaḥ / saṃtatiṃ saṃsthitiṃ caiva bhāvanāṃ ca yathākramam
verses.translation: The Phalafruti — Reward* offered by Pitfs jo the performers of •Sriddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The Phalafruti — Reward* offered by Pitfs jo the performers of •Sriddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Phalafruti — Reward* offered by Pitfs jo the performers of •Sriddha.

verses.sanskrit: एति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे पितृकल्पो नाम नवमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ९॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच सप्तैते जयतां श्रेष्ठाः स्वर्गे पितृगणाः स्मृताः । चत्वारो मुर्त्तिमन्तश्च त्रयस्तेषाममूर्त्तयः
verses.transliteration: eti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde pitṛkalpo nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 9// bṛhaspatiruvāca saptaite jayatāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ svarge pitṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / catvāro murttimantaśca trayasteṣāmamūrttayaḥ
verses.translation: One should send it up in the sky or put it in the water facing the southern quarter. The abode of the Pitrs is in the sky or the southern quarter.
verses.wordMeaning: One should send it up in the sky or put it in the water facing the southern quarter. The abode of the Pitrs is in the sky or the southern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should send it up in the sky or put it in the water facing the southern quarter. The abode of the Pitrs is in the sky or the southern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां लोकान्विसर्गं च कीर्त्तयिष्ये निबोधत । यावै दुहितरस्तेषां दौहित्राश्चेव ये स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ lokānvisargaṃ ca kīrttayiṣye nibodhata / yāvai duhitarasteṣāṃ dauhitrāśceva ye smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Some Brahmanas say thus — "After being permitted by those Brahmanas who say — "Let it be freely lifted up'* — the devotee shall lift up the rice balls at the outset (or from the tips ).
verses.hindi: ज्ञान से चार प्रकार की दशा से बद्ध प्रकृति में स्थित निवृत्त हो जाता है। यह प्रकृति तो सत्य ही कही जाती है इस से जो भी विकार होता है वही मिथ्या बताया जाया करता है।८५। जो असदुभाव वाला है वही अनृत समझना चाहिए और जो सद्भाव होता है वह सत्य कहा जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Some Brahmanas say thus — "After being permitted by those Brahmanas who say — "Let it be freely lifted up'* — the devotee shall lift up the rice balls at the outset (or from the tips ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Brahmanas say thus — "After being permitted by those Brahmanas who say — "Let it be freely lifted up'* — the devotee shall lift up the rice balls at the outset (or from the tips ).

verses.sanskrit: लोकाः संतानका नाम यत्र तिष्ठन्ति भास्वराः । अमूर्त्तयः पितृगणास्ते वै पुत्राः प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: lokāḥ saṃtānakā nāma yatra tiṣṭhanti bhāsvarāḥ / amūrttayaḥ pitṛgaṇāste vai putrāḥ prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: One shall take out the tips (uppermost part) of flowers, fruits, foodstuffs and rice and perform Homa in the fire with all those things.
verses.hindi: यह क्षेत्रज्ञ नाम और रूप से रहित होता है । यह तो क्षेत्रश्ञ इसो नाम से बोला जाया करता है।८६। क्षेत्रज्ञ इसका नाम इसीलिए होता है कि यह क्षेत्र को जानता है । जिस कारण से यह कत्र को विश्‍वस्त मानता है इसी से क्षेत्रज्ञ परम शुभ कहा जाता है ।८३ क्षेत्रज्ञ का स्मरण किया जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: One shall take out the tips (uppermost part) of flowers, fruits, foodstuffs and rice and perform Homa in the fire with all those things.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall take out the tips (uppermost part) of flowers, fruits, foodstuffs and rice and perform Homa in the fire with all those things.

verses.sanskrit: विराजस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठा वैराजा इति विश्रुताः । एते वै पितरस्तात योगानां योगवर्धनाः
verses.transliteration: virājasya dvijaśreṣṭhā vairājā iti viśrutāḥ / ete vai pitarastāta yogānāṃ yogavardhanāḥ
verses.translation: After performing Homa in the fire with the food- stuffs, cooked rice, beverage, roots and fruits he should offer the Pindas facing the southern quarter.
verses.hindi: इसी कारण से उसके ज्ञाताओं के द्वारा विमास्यमान होता है। क्षेत्र तो त्वत्प्रत्यय वाला देखा गया है और सदा ही क्षेत्रज्ञ प्रत्यय होता है ।८। अब यह बताते हैं कि क्षेत्र बह नाम इसका क्‍यों हुआ है-इसका शयन होता है
verses.wordMeaning: After performing Homa in the fire with the food- stuffs, cooked rice, beverage, roots and fruits he should offer the Pindas facing the southern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing Homa in the fire with the food- stuffs, cooked rice, beverage, roots and fruits he should offer the Pindas facing the southern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: अप्याययन्ति ये नित्यं योगायोगबलेन तु । श्राद्धैराप्यायितास्ते वै सोममाप्याययन्ति च
verses.transliteration: apyāyayanti ye nityaṃ yogāyogabalena tu / śrāddhairāpyāyitāste vai somamāpyāyayanti ca
verses.translation: After performing Homa to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama) and Soma, after offering Pindas along with the libation of water, one should feed the Brahmanas
verses.wordMeaning: After performing Homa to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama) and Soma, after offering Pindas along with the libation of water, one should feed the Brahmanas
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing Homa to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama) and Soma, after offering Pindas along with the libation of water, one should feed the Brahmanas

verses.sanskrit: आप्यायितस्ततः सोमो लोकानाप्याययत्युत । एतेषां मानसी कन्या मेना नाम महागिरेः
verses.transliteration: āpyāyitastataḥ somo lokānāpyāyayatyuta / eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā menā nāma mahāgireḥ
verses.translation: W. 31-35 refer to the disposal of Pindas. Cf. Mbh. AmU&sana 125- 38-40, Bm 150-52 for similar views. %
verses.hindi: एक तो यही कारण है और दुसरा कारण यह है कि क्षत का त्राणात्व वाला है । यह भोज्यत्व वाला है तया इसमें विषय भी होता है । इसी लिये क्षेत्र के ज्ञाता इसको क्षेत्र कहा करते हैं ।८६। महत तत्व से आरम्भ करके अर्थात् महत तत्व जिसमें आदि है और विशेष के अन्त पर्यन्त में एक परम विल-
verses.wordMeaning: W. 31-35 refer to the disposal of Pindas. Cf. Mbh. AmU&sana 125- 38-40, Bm 150-52 for similar views. %
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 31-35 refer to the disposal of Pindas. Cf. Mbh. AmU&sana 125- 38-40, Bm 150-52 for similar views. %

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी हिमवतः पुत्रो यस्या मैनाक उच्यते । पर्वतप्रवरः सो ऽथ क्रैञ्चश्चास्य गिरेः सुतः
verses.transliteration: patnī himavataḥ putro yasyā maināka ucyate / parvatapravaraḥ so 'tha kraiñcaścāsya gireḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, he should propitiate the Brahxnana in the proper order consistent with his capacity, with hot and glossy ( mixed with ghee) foodstuffs and cooked rice smelling sweet (with ghee and spices).
verses.hindi: क्षण विलूपता रहा करती है । वह विकार का लक्षण है किन्तु वह अक्षर होता है और क्षरता को प्राप्त हो जाता है ।६०। कारण यह है कि उसी अनुविकार को फिर क्षरित करता है और उसी कारण से यह क्षर--इस नाम से पुकारा जाया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he should propitiate the Brahxnana in the proper order consistent with his capacity, with hot and glossy ( mixed with ghee) foodstuffs and cooked rice smelling sweet (with ghee and spices).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he should propitiate the Brahxnana in the proper order consistent with his capacity, with hot and glossy ( mixed with ghee) foodstuffs and cooked rice smelling sweet (with ghee and spices).

verses.sanskrit: तिस्रः कन्यास्तु मेनायां जनयामास शैलाराट् । अपर्णामेकपर्णां च तृतीयामेकपाटलाम्
verses.transliteration: tisraḥ kanyāstu menāyāṃ janayāmāsa śailārāṭ / aparṇāmekaparṇāṃ ca tṛtīyāmekapāṭalām
verses.translation: The man obtains all that he desires if he serves them with concentration and purity (mental and physical). He shall stand by them with palms joined in reverence. He shall be loyal, faithful and devoted to them.
verses.hindi: संसारे नरकेभ्यश्च त्रायते पुरुषं च यत् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The man obtains all that he desires if he serves them with concentration and purity (mental and physical). He shall stand by them with palms joined in reverence. He shall be loyal, faithful and devoted to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man obtains all that he desires if he serves them with concentration and purity (mental and physical). He shall stand by them with palms joined in reverence. He shall be loyal, faithful and devoted to them.

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधमे कपर्णा तु पाठलं त्वेकपाटला । आशिते द्वे अपर्णा तु ह्यनिकेता तपो ऽचरत्
verses.transliteration: nyagrodhame kaparṇā tu pāṭhalaṃ tvekapāṭalā / āśite dve aparṇā tu hyaniketā tapo 'carat
verses.translation: The grandfathers (manes) bestow these qualities — viz. Akfudratva (the state of not being mean and low) grate- fulness, chivalry, refined speech, power of penance, Yajfias and charitable gifts.
verses.wordMeaning: The grandfathers (manes) bestow these qualities — viz. Akfudratva (the state of not being mean and low) grate- fulness, chivalry, refined speech, power of penance, Yajfias and charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grandfathers (manes) bestow these qualities — viz. Akfudratva (the state of not being mean and low) grate- fulness, chivalry, refined speech, power of penance, Yajfias and charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: शतं वर्षसहस्राणां दुश्चरं देवदानवैः । आहारमेकपर्णेन ह्येकपर्णा समाचरत्
verses.transliteration: śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ duścaraṃ devadānavaiḥ / āhāramekaparṇena hyekaparṇā samācarat
verses.translation: Hereafter listen, even as I recount, to the auspicious procedure which is carried out in the proper order after the Brahmanas have taken their food.
verses.hindi: न क्षीयते न क्षरति विकारप्रसृत' तु तत् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Hereafter listen, even as I recount, to the auspicious procedure which is carried out in the proper order after the Brahmanas have taken their food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hereafter listen, even as I recount, to the auspicious procedure which is carried out in the proper order after the Brahmanas have taken their food.

verses.sanskrit: पाटलेनैव चैकेन व्यदधादेकपाटला । पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे द्वे चाहारं वै प्रजक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: pāṭalenaiva caikena vyadadhādekapāṭalā / pūrṇe varṣasahasre dve cāhāraṃ vai prajakratuḥ
verses.translation: The performer of Sraddha devoutly attached to the Pitrs, shall at the outset sprinkle the ground and lift (a particle). Then he scatters the rice in accordance with the injunctions.
verses.wordMeaning: The performer of Sraddha devoutly attached to the Pitrs, shall at the outset sprinkle the ground and lift (a particle). Then he scatters the rice in accordance with the injunctions.
verses.commentary: Sense: The performer of Sraddha devoutly attached to the Pitrs, shall at the outset sprinkle the ground and lift (a particle). Then he scatters the rice in accordance with the injunctions.

verses.sanskrit: एका तत्र निराहारा तां माता प्रत्यभाषत । निषेधयन्ती सोमेति मातृस्रेहेन दुःखिता
verses.transliteration: ekā tatra nirāhārā tāṃ mātā pratyabhāṣata / niṣedhayantī someti mātṛsrehena duḥkhitā
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: सा तथोक्ता तदापर्णा देवी दुश्चरचारिणी । उमेति हि महाभागा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: sā tathoktā tadāparṇā devī duścaracāriṇī / umeti hi mahābhāgā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā
verses.translation: Mrtyu (god of death) has no access to that place nor do the Asuras and Raksasas have it. As long as the earth exists there is no fear and no Alaksmi (loss of splendour and prosperity) there.
verses.wordMeaning: Mrtyu (god of death) has no access to that place nor do the Asuras and Raksasas have it. As long as the earth exists there is no fear and no Alaksmi (loss of splendour and prosperity) there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mrtyu (god of death) has no access to that place nor do the Asuras and Raksasas have it. As long as the earth exists there is no fear and no Alaksmi (loss of splendour and prosperity) there.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव नाम्ना तेनासौ निरुक्तोक्तेन कर्मणा । एतत्तु त्रिकुमारीकं जगत्स्थावरजङ्ग मम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva nāmnā tenāsau niruktoktena karmaṇā / etattu trikumārīkaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅga mam
verses.translation: On account of his power of penance and brilliant splendour that excellent mountain always shines like the Sarhvar- taka (i.e. the all-destroying fire at the time of annihilation of the universe) on the peak of Malyavan.
verses.hindi: जो इस परमाधिक दुःखमय संसार में नरकों से पुरुष का परित्राण किया करता है और फिर भी दुःखों के त्राण से इसका नाम क्षेत्र यह कहा जाता है ।६२। इसमें सुख-दुःख और अहंभाव विद्यमान रहता है अतएव इसको भोज्य--इस नाम से भी पुकारा जाया करता है। इसमें अचेतना
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his power of penance and brilliant splendour that excellent mountain always shines like the Sarhvar- taka (i.e. the all-destroying fire at the time of annihilation of the universe) on the peak of Malyavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his power of penance and brilliant splendour that excellent mountain always shines like the Sarhvar- taka (i.e. the all-destroying fire at the time of annihilation of the universe) on the peak of Malyavan.

verses.sanskrit: एतासां तपसा सृष्टं यावद्भूमिर्द्धरिष्यति । तपःशरीरास्ताः सर्वास्थिस्रो योगबलान्विताः
verses.transliteration: etāsāṃ tapasā sṛṣṭaṃ yāvadbhūmirddhariṣyati / tapaḥśarīrāstāḥ sarvāsthisro yogabalānvitāḥ
verses.translation: To the south of the Narmada, the Ku£a grasses are well reputed all around. They are soft, fragrant and very plea- sing to behold. They have a tranquil golden lustre.
verses.hindi: होती है इसीलिए यह विषय है ओर उसले विधर्मा होता है अतएव यह न तो क्षोण होता है और न इसका क्षरण ही होता है ओर विकार से प्रसृत
verses.wordMeaning: To the south of the Narmada, the Ku£a grasses are well reputed all around. They are soft, fragrant and very plea- sing to behold. They have a tranquil golden lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the south of the Narmada, the Ku£a grasses are well reputed all around. They are soft, fragrant and very plea- sing to behold. They have a tranquil golden lustre.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वास्ताः सुमहाभागाः सर्वाश्च स्थिरयौवनाः । सर्वाश्च ब्रह्मवादिन्यः सर्वाश्चैवोर्ध्वरेतसः
verses.transliteration: sarvāstāḥ sumahābhāgāḥ sarvāśca sthirayauvanāḥ / sarvāśca brahmavādinyaḥ sarvāścaivordhvaretasaḥ
verses.translation: While performing theAgnihotra, the highly resplend- ent holy lord Angiras used those excellent Kusa grasses for the sake of spreading round the altar formerly. He then saw the steps leading to the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: While performing theAgnihotra, the highly resplend- ent holy lord Angiras used those excellent Kusa grasses for the sake of spreading round the altar formerly. He then saw the steps leading to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: While performing theAgnihotra, the highly resplend- ent holy lord Angiras used those excellent Kusa grasses for the sake of spreading round the altar formerly. He then saw the steps leading to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: उमा तासां वरिष्ठा च श्रेष्ठा च वरवर्णिनी । महायोगबलोपेता महादेवमुपस्थिता
verses.transliteration: umā tāsāṃ variṣṭhā ca śreṣṭhā ca varavarṇinī / mahāyogabalopetā mahādevamupasthitā
verses.translation: Holy places have a deep psychological effect on religious-minded persons. Sr&ddha is to be performed in one's own house. But as KPJI.22.17 states, holy places are no one's private property. And a list of such holy spots is recommended in different Pur&pas like KP.II.20-32-36, V&.P. Ch. 77, Mt.P. ch. 22. Not that these lists agree, but there is a great deal of overlapping as a number of holy spots like Gaya, V&raoasi, Pray&ga, Pufkara command respect from most of Hindus. Here is the list recommended by our Text.
verses.hindi: केद्वारा उस प्रकार से आत्मा को दिया करता है । वहां पर प्रकृति में कारण में अपनो आत्मा में ही उपस्थित होता है ।१०१। अस्ति--नास्ति--इससे बह अन्य है अबवा यहाँ पर अथवा परलोक में फिर होता है । एकत्व है अथवा पृथक्त्व हैमन है अथवा पुरुष है ।१०२। वह आत्मा है या
verses.wordMeaning: Holy places have a deep psychological effect on religious-minded persons. Sr&ddha is to be performed in one's own house. But as KPJI.22.17 states, holy places are no one's private property. And a list of such holy spots is recommended in different Pur&pas like KP.II.20-32-36,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Holy places have a deep psychological effect on religious-minded persons. Sr&ddha is to be performed in one's own house. But as KPJI.22.17 states, holy places are no one's private property. And a list of such holy spots is recommended in different Pur&pas like KP.II.20-32-36,…

verses.sanskrit: दत्तकश्चोशान्स्तस्याः पुत्रो वै भृगुनन्दनः । असितस्यैकपर्णा तु पत्नी साध्वी पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: dattakaścośānstasyāḥ putro vai bhṛgunandanaḥ / asitasyaikaparṇā tu patnī sādhvī pativratā
verses.translation: A mountain in Bilaspur District of Madhya Pradeia (Vi 10-1 1 and 15.16). VifQu Dh. S. 85.6 highly glorifies the performance of Sr&ddha on this mountain. Our Text gives the credit of this sanctity to the penance of Afigiras on this. n
verses.hindi: निरात्मा है । चेतन है या अचेतन है। वह कर्ता है या अकर्त्ता है-बह भोक्ता है या भोज्य हो है ।१०३। जहाँ पर पहुँच कर फिर वहां से वापिस नहीं लौटता है सेत्रन्ञ निरञ्जन है । उसका कोई भी आख्यान नहीं होता है इसलिये वह अवाच्य है ओर वाद के हेतुओं के द्वारा अग्राह्य है
verses.wordMeaning: A mountain in Bilaspur District of Madhya Pradeia (Vi 10-1 1 and 15.16). VifQu Dh. S. 85.6 highly glorifies the performance of Sr&ddha on this mountain. Our Text gives the credit of this sanctity to the penance of Afigiras on this. n
verses.commentary: Sense: A mountain in Bilaspur District of Madhya Pradeia (Vi 10-1 1 and 15.16). VifQu Dh. S. 85.6 highly glorifies the performance of Sr&ddha on this mountain. Our Text gives the credit of this sanctity to the penance of Afigiras on this. n

verses.sanskrit: दत्ता हिमवता तस्मै योगाचार्याय धीमते । देवलं सुषुवे सा तु ब्रह्मिष्ठं ज्ञानसंयुता
verses.transliteration: dattā himavatā tasmai yogācāryāya dhīmate / devalaṃ suṣuve sā tu brahmiṣṭhaṃ jñānasaṃyutā
verses.translation: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelli- gent man who offers Pincjas on those Darbha grasses even on a single occasion on the mountain Amarakantaka.
verses.hindi: चिन्तन न करने के योग्य होने से वह प्रतर्क के योग्य नहीं है। अवार्य योग्य नहीं है ओर मन के साथ भी अप्राप्त है
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelli- gent man who offers Pincjas on those Darbha grasses even on a single occasion on the mountain Amarakantaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelli- gent man who offers Pincjas on those Darbha grasses even on a single occasion on the mountain Amarakantaka.

verses.sanskrit: या वै तासां कुमारीणां तृतीया चैकपाटला । पुत्रं शतशलाकस्य जैगीषव्यमुपस्थिता
verses.transliteration: yā vai tāsāṃ kumārīṇāṃ tṛtīyā caikapāṭalā / putraṃ śataśalākasya jaigīṣavyamupasthitā
verses.translation: That Sraddha becomes one of everlasting benefit. It increases the pleasures of the Pitrs. On reaching that holy centre, they always vanish.
verses.wordMeaning: That Sraddha becomes one of everlasting benefit. It increases the pleasures of the Pitrs. On reaching that holy centre, they always vanish.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Sraddha becomes one of everlasting benefit. It increases the pleasures of the Pitrs. On reaching that holy centre, they always vanish.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापि शङ्खलिशितौ स्मृतौ पुत्रावयोनिजौ । इत्येता वै महाभागाः कन्या हिमवतः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: tasyāpi śaṅkhaliśitau smṛtau putrāvayonijau / ityetā vai mahābhāgāḥ kanyā himavataḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: During the Parvan days, a holy lake ofbrilhant flames is seen there. The river there, is ViSalyakarani (one that removes pain due to the pricking of darts) of animals with bony spikes (like porcupine).
verses.wordMeaning: During the Parvan days, a holy lake ofbrilhant flames is seen there. The river there, is ViSalyakarani (one that removes pain due to the pricking of darts) of animals with bony spikes (like porcupine).
verses.commentary: Sense: During the Parvan days, a holy lake ofbrilhant flames is seen there. The river there, is ViSalyakarani (one that removes pain due to the pricking of darts) of animals with bony spikes (like porcupine).

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राणी सा तु प्रवरा स्वैर्गुणैरतिरिच्यते । अन्योन्यप्रीतमनसोरुमाशङ्करयोरथ
verses.transliteration: rudrāṇī sā tu pravarā svairguṇairatiricyate / anyonyaprītamanasorumāśaṅkarayoratha
verses.translation: On the peak of the lordly mountain Malyavan, in the hinder half of the country of Kalinga, there is a pool on that very excellent mountain. It has an eddy stretching towards the south-east.
verses.wordMeaning: On the peak of the lordly mountain Malyavan, in the hinder half of the country of Kalinga, there is a pool on that very excellent mountain. It has an eddy stretching towards the south-east.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the peak of the lordly mountain Malyavan, in the hinder half of the country of Kalinga, there is a pool on that very excellent mountain. It has an eddy stretching towards the south-east.

verses.sanskrit: श्लेषं संसक्तयोर्ज्ञात्वा शङ्कितः किल वृत्रहा । ताभ्यां मैथुनशक्ताभ्यामपत्योद्भवभीरुणा
verses.transliteration: śleṣaṃ saṃsaktayorjñātvā śaṅkitaḥ kila vṛtrahā / tābhyāṃ maithunaśaktābhyāmapatyodbhavabhīruṇā
verses.translation: "Blessed are those persons in the world who are devotedly attached to the Pitrs and who will propitiate the Pitrs by means of Sraddha after reaching the Amarakantaka.
verses.wordMeaning: "Blessed are those persons in the world who are devotedly attached to the Pitrs and who will propitiate the Pitrs by means of Sraddha after reaching the Amarakantaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Blessed are those persons in the world who are devotedly attached to the Pitrs and who will propitiate the Pitrs by means of Sraddha after reaching the Amarakantaka.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः सकाशमिन्द्रेण प्रेषितो हव्यवाहनः । अनायो रतिविघ्नं च त्वमाचर हुताशन
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ sakāśamindreṇa preṣito havyavāhanaḥ / anāyo rativighnaṃ ca tvamācara hutāśana
verses.translation: Those who worship even once in the Amarakantaka go to heaven. There is no doubt that they attain spiritual achievement with a very little penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who worship even once in the Amarakantaka go to heaven. There is no doubt that they attain spiritual achievement with a very little penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who worship even once in the Amarakantaka go to heaven. There is no doubt that they attain spiritual achievement with a very little penance.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र गत एव त्वं न दोषो विद्यते तव । इत्येवमुक्ते तु तदा वह्निना च तथा कृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra gata eva tvaṃ na doṣo vidyate tava / ityevamukte tu tadā vahninā ca tathā kṛtam
verses.translation: After performing the yogic exercises on the summit of V&il&ta the divine vision begins to function (in the performer). The devotee becomes unassailable and invin- cible to all living beings. He walks over the earth lika a Deva.
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the yogic exercises on the summit of V&il&ta the divine vision begins to function (in the performer). The devotee becomes unassailable and invin- cible to all living beings. He walks over the earth lika a Deva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the yogic exercises on the summit of V&il&ta the divine vision begins to function (in the performer). The devotee becomes unassailable and invin- cible to all living beings. He walks over the earth lika a Deva.

verses.sanskrit: उमां देवः समुत्सृज्य शुक्रं भूमौ व्यसर्जयत् । ततो रुषितया सद्यः शप्तो ऽग्निरुमया तया
verses.transliteration: umāṃ devaḥ samutsṛjya śukraṃ bhūmau vyasarjayat / tato ruṣitayā sadyaḥ śapto 'gnirumayā tayā
verses.translation: A mountain range from Orissa to Madura (including a part of Eastern Ghats) but the name is serially applied to the range of hills separating the Mah&-nadi from Ganjam dist. It is regarded as the resort of Parasur&ma.
verses.wordMeaning: A mountain range from Orissa to Madura (including a part of Eastern Ghats) but the name is serially applied to the range of hills separating the Mah&-nadi from Ganjam dist. It is regarded as the resort of Parasur&ma.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mountain range from Orissa to Madura (including a part of Eastern Ghats) but the name is serially applied to the range of hills separating the Mah&-nadi from Ganjam dist. It is regarded as the resort of Parasur&ma.

verses.sanskrit: इदं चोक्तवती वह्निं रोषगद्गदया गिरा । यस्मान्नाववितृप्ताभ्यां रतिविघ्नं हुताशन
verses.transliteration: idaṃ coktavatī vahniṃ roṣagadgadayā girā / yasmānnāvavitṛptābhyāṃ rativighnaṃ hutāśana
verses.translation: By taking a holy dip in the Saptagodavari1 and the penance grove of Gokarna2 by giving charitable gifts, one obtains the benefit of a horse sacrifice.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्रज्ञके निगु' ण--शुद्ध-ज्ान्त-क्षोण--निरञ्जन-अपेत अर्थात् रहित सुब दुःख वाले--निरुद्ध और शान्ति को प्राप्न होने वाले और निरा- त्मक होने पर फिर उसमें वाच्य और अवाच्य नहीं रहता है। ये दो संहार और विस्तार और फिर व्यक्त और अव्यक्त होते हैं ।१०६-१०७। सुजन
verses.wordMeaning: By taking a holy dip in the Saptagodavari1 and the penance grove of Gokarna2 by giving charitable gifts, one obtains the benefit of a horse sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking a holy dip in the Saptagodavari1 and the penance grove of Gokarna2 by giving charitable gifts, one obtains the benefit of a horse sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: कृतवानस्य कर्त्तव्यं तस्मात्त्वमसि दुर्मतिः । यदेवं विगतं गर्भं रौद्रं शुक्रं महाप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtavānasya karttavyaṃ tasmāttvamasi durmatiḥ / yadevaṃ vigataṃ garbhaṃ raudraṃ śukraṃ mahāprabham
verses.translation: After reaching the holy spot "Dhutapapa**,3 if a man takes a holy dip, he becomes sanctified. Rudra, the great l€vara, the lord of the Devas, had performed a penance there.
verses.hindi: किया जाता है ग्रसन होता है और व्यक्त पर्यवस्थित होते है । सब क्षेत्रज्ञ में अधिष्ठित फिर सगे में प्रवृत्त हुआ करता है ।१०८। उसके अन्त में बुद्धि पूर्वक अधिष्ठान को प्रपन्न हो जाता है । उन दोनों का संयोग साधम्यं ओर वेधम्ये के द्वारा किया हुआ विदित होता है । महापुरुष से समुत्पन्न संयोग अना-
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the holy spot "Dhutapapa**,3 if a man takes a holy dip, he becomes sanctified. Rudra, the great l€vara, the lord of the Devas, had performed a penance there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the holy spot "Dhutapapa**,3 if a man takes a holy dip, he becomes sanctified. Rudra, the great l€vara, the lord of the Devas, had performed a penance there.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भे त्वं धारयस्वैवमेषा ते दण्डधारणा । स शापदोषाद्रुद्राण्या अन्तर्गर्भो हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: garbhe tvaṃ dhārayasvaivameṣā te daṇḍadhāraṇā / sa śāpadoṣādrudrāṇyā antargarbho hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: A proof has been placed in the Gokarna by the Devas, in order to convince atheists (that they are wrong). If a non-Brahmana recitqs Savitrl Mantra there, he perishes (while reciting?)
verses.hindi: दिमान् कहा गया है ।१०६। और जबतक सर्गे और प्रतिसगं काल होता है तब तक जगत संनिरुद्ध होकर स्थित रहा करता है और उसके पूर्व में ही बुद्धिपूर्वक उसका पुरुषार्थ हो प्रवृत्त होता है ।११०। यह विसर्ग और प्रतिसर्ग पूर्व वाली प्राधानिकी अर्थात् प्रधान (प्रकृति) के द्वारा की हुई या ईश्वर की
verses.wordMeaning: A proof has been placed in the Gokarna by the Devas, in order to convince atheists (that they are wrong). If a non-Brahmana recitqs Savitrl Mantra there, he perishes (while reciting?)
verses.commentary: Sense: A proof has been placed in the Gokarna by the Devas, in order to convince atheists (that they are wrong). If a non-Brahmana recitqs Savitrl Mantra there, he perishes (while reciting?)

verses.sanskrit: बहून्वर्षगणान्गर्भं धारयामास वै द्विज । स गङ्गामभिगम्याह श्रूयतां सरिदुत्तमे
verses.transliteration: bahūnvarṣagaṇāngarbhaṃ dhārayāmāsa vai dvija / sa gaṅgāmabhigamyāha śrūyatāṃ sariduttame
verses.translation: If a person climbs the peak Devarsibhavana (Abode of the celestial sage), frequented by Siddhas and Caranas and regularly continues the observances of holy rites, he goes to the heaven.
verses.hindi: कराई हुई है । यह ऐसी है जिसका न आदि है और न अन्त ही है और यह अभिमान के साथ इस जगत को नित्रस्त करती हुई ही प्राप्त हुआ करती है
verses.wordMeaning: If a person climbs the peak Devarsibhavana (Abode of the celestial sage), frequented by Siddhas and Caranas and regularly continues the observances of holy rites, he goes to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person climbs the peak Devarsibhavana (Abode of the celestial sage), frequented by Siddhas and Caranas and regularly continues the observances of holy rites, he goes to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सुमहान्परिखेदो मे जायते गर्भधारणात् । मद्धितार्थ मथो गर्भमिमं धारय निम्नगे
verses.transliteration: sumahānparikhedo me jāyate garbhadhāraṇāt / maddhitārtha matho garbhamimaṃ dhāraya nimnage
verses.translation: (There is a garden ) beautified by celestial sandal trees and other heavenly trees. Water mixed with sandal powder continuously flows from it.
verses.hindi: कहा गया है तब अत्यन्त काल का ज्ञान प्राप्त करके ही प्राणी प्रसक्त हुआ करता है ।११२। यही प्रतिसर्गे है जो तीन प्रकार का होता है जिसका वर्णन चैने आपके सामने किया है। मैंने इसका विस्तार से और आनृपूर्वी से अर्थात् क्रम से आदि से अम्त पर्यन्त कह दिया है । अब फिर मैं क्या बताऊ--यह
verses.wordMeaning: (There is a garden ) beautified by celestial sandal trees and other heavenly trees. Water mixed with sandal powder continuously flows from it.
verses.commentary: Sense: (There is a garden ) beautified by celestial sandal trees and other heavenly trees. Water mixed with sandal powder continuously flows from it.

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसादाच्च तनयो वरदस्ते भविष्यति । तथेत्युक्त्वा तदा सा तु संप्रत्दृष्टा महानदी
verses.transliteration: matprasādācca tanayo varadaste bhaviṣyati / tathetyuktvā tadā sā tu saṃpratdṛṣṭā mahānadī
verses.translation: A river named TamraparnI4 flows from that water collection. From the great forest of sandal trees, it flows towards the southern ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: A river named TamraparnI4 flows from that water collection. From the great forest of sandal trees, it flows towards the southern ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: A river named TamraparnI4 flows from that water collection. From the great forest of sandal trees, it flows towards the southern ocean.

verses.sanskrit: तं गर्भं धारयामास दह्यमानेन चेतसा । सापि कृच्छ्रेण महता खिद्यमाना महानदी
verses.transliteration: taṃ garbhaṃ dhārayāmāsa dahyamānena cetasā / sāpi kṛcchreṇa mahatā khidyamānā mahānadī
verses.translation: Oyster shells from where pearls are produced are the conchs washed down to the great sea, carried by the river Tamra (TamraparnI).
verses.hindi: श्रुत' सुमहदाख्यानं भवता परिकीत्तितम् । प्रजानां मनुभिः साद्ध देवानामृषिभिः सह
verses.wordMeaning: Oyster shells from where pearls are produced are the conchs washed down to the great sea, carried by the river Tamra (TamraparnI).
verses.commentary: Sense: Oyster shells from where pearls are produced are the conchs washed down to the great sea, carried by the river Tamra (TamraparnI).

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृष्टं व्यसृजद्गर्भं दीप्यमान मिवानलम् । रुद्राग्निगङ्गातनयस्तत्र जातो ऽरुणप्रभः
verses.transliteration: prakṛṣṭaṃ vyasṛjadgarbhaṃ dīpyamāna mivānalam / rudrāgnigaṅgātanayastatra jāto 'ruṇaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: If devotees bring water containing conchs and pearls, they become free from mental agonies and physical ailments. They go to the celestial city Amaravati.
verses.wordMeaning: If devotees bring water containing conchs and pearls, they become free from mental agonies and physical ailments. They go to the celestial city Amaravati.
verses.commentary: Sense: If devotees bring water containing conchs and pearls, they become free from mental agonies and physical ailments. They go to the celestial city Amaravati.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यशतसंकाशो महातेजाः प्रतापवान् । तस्मिञ्जाते महाभागे कुमारे जाह्नवीसुते
verses.transliteration: ādityaśatasaṃkāśo mahātejāḥ pratāpavān / tasmiñjāte mahābhāge kumāre jāhnavīsute
verses.translation: (The charitable gifts) of pearls and conchs produced from sandalwood cause the redemption of Pitrs even though they be perpetrators of sinful activities as mentioned in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: अप्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि विविधा धर्मनिश्चयाः । विचित्राश्च कथायोगा जन्म चाग्र्यमनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: (The charitable gifts) of pearls and conchs produced from sandalwood cause the redemption of Pitrs even though they be perpetrators of sinful activities as mentioned in the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The charitable gifts) of pearls and conchs produced from sandalwood cause the redemption of Pitrs even though they be perpetrators of sinful activities as mentioned in the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: विमानयानैराकाशं पतत्र्रिभिरिवावृतम् । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुराकाशे मधुरस्वनाः
verses.transliteration: vimānayānairākāśaṃ patatrribhirivāvṛtam / devadundubhayo nedurākāśe madhurasvanāḥ
verses.translation: A tributary of the Garig& at V&ragasl.
verses.wordMeaning: A tributary of the Garig& at V&ragasl.
verses.commentary: Sense: A tributary of the Garig& at V&ragasl.

verses.sanskrit: मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्षं च खेचराः सिद्धचारणाः । जगुर्गन्धर्वमुख्याश्च सर्वशस्तत्र तत्र ह
verses.transliteration: mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ ca khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ / jagurgandharvamukhyāśca sarvaśastatra tatra ha
verses.translation: River rising in Agastya-Kufa-Mountain Malaya flowing through old P&gya country to the Sea (the gulf of Manar) celebrated for pearl fishery. De. 203,HD.IV. 812.
verses.wordMeaning: River rising in Agastya-Kufa-Mountain Malaya flowing through old P&gya country to the Sea (the gulf of Manar) celebrated for pearl fishery. De. 203,HD.IV. 812.
verses.commentary: Sense: River rising in Agastya-Kufa-Mountain Malaya flowing through old P&gya country to the Sea (the gulf of Manar) celebrated for pearl fishery. De. 203,HD.IV. 812.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षा विद्याधराः सिद्धाः किन्नराश्चैव सर्वशः । महानागसहस्राणि प्रवराश्च पतत्र्रिणः
verses.transliteration: yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhāḥ kinnarāścaiva sarvaśaḥ / mahānāgasahasrāṇi pravarāśca patatrriṇaḥ
verses.translation: The holy rites performed in the holy centres of the Srlparvata and the mountain Vaikrta fructify from the beginning to the end.
verses.wordMeaning: The holy rites performed in the holy centres of the Srlparvata and the mountain Vaikrta fructify from the beginning to the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy rites performed in the holy centres of the Srlparvata and the mountain Vaikrta fructify from the beginning to the end.

verses.sanskrit: उपतस्थुर्महाभागमाग्नेयं शङ्करात्मजम् । प्रभावेण हतास्तेन दैत्यवानरराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: upatasthurmahābhāgamāgneyaṃ śaṅkarātmajam / prabhāveṇa hatāstena daityavānararākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: Birds that could move as they wish, go to heaven after taking bath in that sin-destroyi tank of Matanga on the Kailasa mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: Birds that could move as they wish, go to heaven after taking bath in that sin-destroyi tank of Matanga on the Kailasa mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Birds that could move as they wish, go to heaven after taking bath in that sin-destroyi tank of Matanga on the Kailasa mountain.

verses.sanskrit: स हि सप्तर्षिभार्याभिरारादेवाग्निसंभवः । अभिषेकप्रयाताभिर्दृष्टो वर्ज्य त्वरुन्धतीम्
verses.transliteration: sa hi saptarṣibhāryābhirārādevāgnisaṃbhavaḥ / abhiṣekaprayātābhirdṛṣṭo varjya tvarundhatīm
verses.translation: In the following holy centres viz — the sacred spot of Saurparaka2, the mountain Palamafijara3 in the well of Pandukupa near the sea and the banks of the Pidaraka* which is free from sins and impurities, one shall perform the rite of
verses.hindi: इस सर्ग की प्रवृत्ति होने की कया रीति होती है-यही अब हम पूछते हैं उसको आप कृपा करके हमको बतला दीजिए इस तरह से भब लोम हर्णण सूतजी से पूछा गया था तो फिर उन्होंने पुनः उस सर्ग की जैसे प्रकृति हुआ करती है उसकी व्याख्या करने का उपक्रम किया था और उन्होंने कहा

verses.transliteration: tābhiḥ sa bālārkanibho raudraḥ parivṛtaḥ prabhuḥ / snihyamānābhiratyarthaṃ svakabhiriva mātṛbhiḥ
verses.translation: Sri Sailam in Kurnool District in Andhra Pradesh. One of the Twelve Jyotir-liAgas.

verses.transliteration: yugapatsarvadevībhirdidhitsurjāhnavīṃ sutaḥ / ṣaṇmukhānyasṛjacchrīmāṃstenāyaṃ ṣaṇmukhaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Sopara, 4 miles NW. of Bassein in Thana District of Maharashtra — De. 197.
verses.hindi: बाणी की पहुँच नहीं हैं और मन भी बहा तक नहीं पहुँचता है । वह अव्यक्त के ही समान परोक्ष है अतएव बहुत ही गहन और दुरासद है।११। विकारों के साथ प्रति संसृष्ट होता हुआ गुण समता से रहता है । प्रधान पुरुषों के साधर्म्म से ही स्थित रहा करता है ।१२। प्राणियों के सदा धर्म और अधर्म
verses.wordMeaning: Sopara, 4 miles NW. of Bassein in Thana District of Maharashtra — De. 197.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sopara, 4 miles NW. of Bassein in Thana District of Maharashtra — De. 197.

verses.sanskrit: तेन जातेन महाता देवानामसहिष्णवः । स्कन्दिता दानवगणास्तस्मात्स्कन्दः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: tena jātena mahātā devānāmasahiṣṇavaḥ / skanditā dānavagaṇāstasmātskandaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: Near Suxparaka — HD IV 787.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त में प्रलीन हो जाते हैं । उस समय में सत्व मात्रात्मक अर्थात् केवल सत्व स्वरूप वाला धर्म सत्वगुण में प्रतिष्ठित होता है ।१३। तमो मात्रात्मक घर्म तमोगुण में प्रतिष्ठित होता है । ये दोनों ही बिना ही विभाग के गुणों की समता में स्थित रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Near Suxparaka — HD IV 787.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near Suxparaka — HD IV 787.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्तिकाभिस्तु यस्मात्स वर्द्धितो हि पुरातनः । कार्त्तिकेय इति ख्यातस्तस्मादसुरसूदनः
verses.transliteration: kṛttikābhistu yasmātsa varddhito hi purātanaḥ / kārttikeya iti khyātastasmādasurasūdanaḥ
verses.translation: The Sraddha performed at Puskara2 yields everlast- ing benefit. The penance performed there yields great fruit. One shall point out the same thing in the same manner on the shore of the great ocean and at Prabhasa3.
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha performed at Puskara2 yields everlast- ing benefit. The penance performed there yields great fruit. One shall point out the same thing in the same manner on the shore of the great ocean and at Prabhasa3.

verses.sanskrit: जृंभतस्तस्य दैत्यारेर्ज्वाला मालाकुला तदा । मुखाद्विनिर्गता तस्य स्वशक्तिरपराजिता
verses.transliteration: jṛṃbhatastasya daityārerjvālā mālākulā tadā / mukhādvinirgatā tasya svaśaktiraparājitā
verses.translation: Somanathapattana in Saurashtra — one of the sacredmost Jyotir- lingas. It was demolished by Mahmud of Gazni but was reconstructed after Independence of India.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडार्थं चैव स्कन्दस्य विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना । गरुडादतिसृष्टौ हि पक्षिणौ द्वौ प्रभद्रकौ
verses.transliteration: krīḍārthaṃ caiva skandasya viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / garuḍādatisṛṣṭau hi pakṣiṇau dvau prabhadrakau
verses.translation: The Pit rs become directly worshipped by him. In this world he will be one with perfect self-control. After death he becomes honoured in the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pit rs become directly worshipped by him. In this world he will be one with perfect self-control. After death he becomes honoured in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: मयूरः कुक्कुटश्चैव पताका चैव वायुना । यस्य दत्ता सरस्वत्या महावीणा महास्वना
verses.transliteration: mayūraḥ kukkuṭaścaiva patākā caiva vāyunā / yasya dattā sarasvatyā mahāvīṇā mahāsvanā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.transliteration: ajaḥ svayaṃbhuvā datto meṣo dattaśca śaṃbhunā / māyāviharaṇe vipra girau kraiñce nipātite
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कहा --आपके द्वारा बणित यह महान आख्यान हमने सुन लिया है। इसमें मनुओं के साथ प्रजाओं का तथा ऋषियों के सहित देवों का-पितरों का -गन्धवॉ. का--भूतों का--पिशाच-उरग और राक्षसों का-हैत्यों का--दानवों का--यक्षों का और पक्षियों का वर्णन है । इन

verses.transliteration: tārake cāsuravare samudīrṇe nipātite / seṃdropendrairmahābhāgairdevairagnisutaḥ prabhuḥ

verses.transliteration: senāpatyena daityārirabhiṣiktaḥ pratāpavān / devasenāpatistveṣa paṭhyate suranāyakaḥ

verses.transliteration: devāriskandanaḥ skandaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ / pramathairvidhairdevastathā bhūtagaṇairapi

verses.transliteration: mātṛbhirvividhābhiśca vināyakagaṇaistataḥ / lokāḥ somapadā nāma marīceryatra vai sutāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: और प्रकृति के तीनों गुणों में साम्यावस्या होती है और यह सर्वत्र अन्धकार ले परिपूर्ण होता है। समस्त विकार अविसृष्ट होते हैं तथा अव्यक्त आत्मा में स्थित होता है। उस समय में योज्यगों के द्वारा सहसा ब्रह्माजी के अप्र- वृत्त होने पर यह सर्ग कंसे होता है

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या अच्छोदा नाम निम्नगा । अच्छौदं नाम तद्दिव्यं सरो यस्मात्समुत्थिता
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā acchodā nāma nimnagā / acchaudaṃ nāma taddivyaṃ saro yasmātsamutthitā

verses.transliteration: sā tvanyaṃ pitaraṃ vavre tānatikramya vai pitṝn / amāvasumiti khyātamailaputraṃ nabhaścaram
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: अद्रिकाप्सरसा युक्तं विमानाधिष्ठितं दिवि । सा तेन व्यभिचारेण गगने नाप्रजारिणी
verses.transliteration: adrikāpsarasā yuktaṃ vimānādhiṣṭhitaṃ divi / sā tena vyabhicāreṇa gagane nāprajāriṇī
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: यह् सभी कायं बुद्धिपूर्वक प्रधान का ही होग। । पह क्षेत्रज्ञ अबुद्धि पूवंक उन गुणों में अधिष्ठित होगा ।१५। इस प्रकार से उस समय में फिर अभिमान के साथ उनको प्राप्त होगा । जिस समय में क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ इन दोनों का प्रवृत होना चाहिए ।१६। वे दोनों ही को भोज्य और भोक्तृत्व के
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पितरं प्रार्थयित्वान्यं योगभ्रष्टा पपात ह । त्रीण्यवश्यद्विमानानि पतन्ती सा दिवश्च्युता
verses.transliteration: pitaraṃ prārthayitvānyaṃ yogabhraṣṭā papāta ha / trīṇyavaśyadvimānāni patantī sā divaścyutā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: सम्बन्ध प्राप्त होगे । इससे गुणात्मक अक्षर अव्यक्त समता में स्थित होता है।१७। वहाँ पर वह क्षेत्रत्र में अधिष्ठित विषमता को प्राप्त होता है । फिर दोनों क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ को व्यक्त प्राप्त होगा ।१। क्षेत्रज्ञ में अधिष्ठित सत्व बिकार को उत्पन्न कर देगा । वह विकार महत् तत्व से लेकर विशेष के
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: त्रसरेणुप्रमाणानि तेषु चावस्थितान्पितॄन् । सुसूक्ष्मानपरिव्यक्तानग्नीनग्निष्विवाहितान्
verses.transliteration: trasareṇupramāṇāni teṣu cāvasthitānpitṝn / susūkṣmānaparivyaktānagnīnagniṣvivāhitān
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: अन्त तक चौबीस गुणों के स्वरूप वाला है ।१६। क्षेत्रज्ञ का प्रधान का और पुरुष का प्रवृत्त होंगे । जो आदि देब हैं वे प्रधान के ही ऊपर अनुग्रह करने वाले कहे जाते हैं। वे दोनों अनादि और श्रेष्ठ उत्पाद तथा सूक्ष्म कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: त्रायध्वमित्युवाचार्ता पतती चाप्यवाक्शिराः । तैरुका सा तु मा भैषी रित्यतो ऽधिष्ठिताभवत्
verses.transliteration: trāyadhvamityuvācārtā patatī cāpyavākśirāḥ / tairukā sā tu mā bhaiṣī rityato 'dhiṣṭhitābhavat
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसादयत्सा वै सीदन्ती त्वनया गिरा । ऊचुस्ते पितरः कन्यां भ्रष्टैश्वर्यां व्यतिक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasādayatsā vai sīdantī tvanayā girā / ūcuste pitaraḥ kanyāṃ bhraṣṭaiśvaryāṃ vyatikramāt
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रष्टैश्वर्यां स्वदोषेण पतसि त्वं शुचिस्मिते । यैराचरन्ति कर्मणि शरीरैरिह देवताः
verses.transliteration: bhraṣṭaiśvaryāṃ svadoṣeṇa patasi tvaṃ śucismite / yairācaranti karmaṇi śarīrairiha devatāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: तैरेव तत्कर्मभलं प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा स्म ह । सद्यः फलन्ति कर्माणि देवत्वे प्रेत्य मानुषे
verses.transliteration: taireva tatkarmabhalaṃ prāpnuvanti sadā sma ha / sadyaḥ phalanti karmāṇi devatve pretya mānuṣe
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स्वतपसः पुत्रि प्रेत्य संप्राप्स्यसे फलम् । इत्युक्तया तु पितरः पुनस्ते तु प्रसादिताः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsvatapasaḥ putri pretya saṃprāpsyase phalam / ityuktayā tu pitaraḥ punaste tu prasāditāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: ६५ ॥ सोमपाः पितरः कन्यां रज्ञो ऽस्यैव त्वमावसोः । उत्पन्नस्य पृथिव्यां तु मानुषेषु महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: 65 // somapāḥ pitaraḥ kanyāṃ rajño 'syaiva tvamāvasoḥ / utpannasya pṛthivyāṃ tu mānuṣeṣu mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: कन्या भूत्वा त्विमांल्लोकान्पुनः प्राप्स्यसि भामिनि । अष्टाविंशे भवित्री त्वं द्वापरे मत्स्ययोनिजा
verses.transliteration: kanyā bhūtvā tvimāṃllokānpunaḥ prāpsyasi bhāmini / aṣṭāviṃśe bhavitrī tvaṃ dvāpare matsyayonijā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: उस समय में अबुद्धि पूवंक युक्त है और अशक्त पर हैं यह प्रत्यय रहित और अमोघ हैं और जल में मछली के ही समान स्थित हैं ।२२। पूर्व में वे दोनों ही पूर्व की प्रवृत्ति बाले हैं फिर सवं को प्राप्त हो जायगा । जो अजञ हैं वे रज-सत्व और तम नामों बाले गुणों से प्रवृत्त हुआ करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैव राज्ञो दुहिता ह्यद्रिकायाममावसोः । पराशरस्य दायादमृषिं त्वं जनयिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: asyaiva rājño duhitā hyadrikāyāmamāvasoḥ / parāśarasya dāyādamṛṣiṃ tvaṃ janayiṣyasi
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: यह मनुष्य प्रवृत्ति के समय से रजोगुण से अभिपन्न होता है और महू आदि की विशेषता और इन्द्रियतता की विशेषता को गुणामुखी के निमित्तों के साथ ध्यायी के ये रज-सत्व ओर तम पर स्वर में विधर्मी होते हुए व्यक्त होते हैं ।२४-२५। आद्यन्त सभी ओर अज्ञम्बु क्षेत्र में प्राप्त हो
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: स वेदमेकं ब्रह्मर्षि श्चतुर्द्धा विभजिष्यति । महाभिषस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ शन्तनोः कीर्त्तिवर्द्धनौ
verses.transliteration: sa vedamekaṃ brahmarṣi ścaturddhā vibhajiṣyati / mahābhiṣasya putrau dvau śantanoḥ kīrttivarddhanau
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: जाँयगे । फिर संसिद्ध कार्य और करण वाले अभिमानी उत्पन्च हुआ करते हैं ।२६। सभी सत्व अब्यक्त से पूर्व ही प्रसन्न होते हैं । पूर्व में होने वाली सृति में जो भी प्राणधारी हैं वे चाहे साधक होवे या असाधक होने ।२७। वे सभी स्थान प्रकरणों के साथ असंशाम्त हैं। वे सब कार्यों को प्राप्त करेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रवीर्यं धर्मज्ञं त्वमेवोत्पादयिष्यसि । चित्राङ्गदं च राजानं सर्वसत्त्वबलान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: vicitravīryaṃ dharmajñaṃ tvamevotpādayiṣyasi / citrāṅgadaṃ ca rājānaṃ sarvasattvabalānvitam
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: एतानुत्पादयित्वाथ पुनर्लोकानवा प्स्यसि । व्यभिचारात्पितॄणां त्वं प्राप्स्यसे जन्म कुत्सितम्
verses.transliteration: etānutpādayitvātha punarlokānavā psyasi / vyabhicārātpitṝṇāṃ tvaṃ prāpsyase janma kutsitam
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव राज्ञस्त्वं कन्या अद्रिकायां भविष्यसि । कन्या भूत्वा ततश्च त्वमिमांल्लोकानवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva rājñastvaṃ kanyā adrikāyāṃ bhaviṣyasi / kanyā bhūtvā tataśca tvamimāṃllokānavāpsyasi
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुकत्वा तु दाशेयी जाता सत्यवती तु सा । अद्रिकायाः सुता मत्स्या सुता जाता ह्यमावसोः
verses.transliteration: evamukatvā tu dāśeyī jātā satyavatī tu sā / adrikāyāḥ sutā matsyā sutā jātā hyamāvasoḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: अदिकामत्स्यसंभूता गङ्गायमुनसंगमे । तस्या राज्ञो हि सा कन्या राज्ञो वीर्येण चैव हि
verses.transliteration: adikāmatsyasaṃbhūtā gaṅgāyamunasaṃgame / tasyā rājño hi sā kanyā rājño vīryeṇa caiva hi
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: विरजानाम ते लोका दिवि रोचन्ति ते गणाः । अग्निष्वात्ताः स्मृतास्तत्र पितरो भास्करप्रभाः पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः । एतेषां मानसी कन्या पीवरी नाम विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: virajānāma te lokā divi rocanti te gaṇāḥ / agniṣvāttāḥ smṛtāstatra pitaro bhāskaraprabhāḥ pulahasya prajāpateḥ / eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā pīvarī nāma viśrutā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनी योगपत्नी च योगमाता तथैव च । भविता द्वापरं प्राप्य अष्टाविंशतिमेव तु
verses.transliteration: yoginī yogapatnī ca yogamātā tathaiva ca / bhavitā dvāparaṃ prāpya aṣṭāviṃśatimeva tu
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमान्व्यासो महायोगी योगस्तस्मिन्द्विजोत्तमाः । व्यासादरण्यां संभूतो विधूम इव पावकः
verses.transliteration: śrīmānvyāso mahāyogī yogastasmindvijottamāḥ / vyāsādaraṇyāṃ saṃbhūto vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: अमे और अधमं परस्पर में केबल गुण के ही स्वरूप वाले होते हैं और बे एक दूसरे के वर के द्वारा या अनुग्रह के द्वारा आरम्भ हुआ करते हैं ।२९। इसके उपरान्त तुल्य प्रसूष्टि शव सगं के आदि काल में विक्रिया को प्राप्त होता है। गण इस कारण से उसका प्रतिधान किया करते हैं वह
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरकुलोद्भूतः शुको नाम महातपाः । स तस्यां पितृकन्यायां पीवर्यां जनयद्विभुः
verses.transliteration: parāśarakulodbhūtaḥ śuko nāma mahātapāḥ / sa tasyāṃ pitṛkanyāyāṃ pīvaryāṃ janayadvibhuḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: उसको अच्छा लगता है।३०। वे गूण जो भी कमं कर्म पूर्व की सृष्टि में प्रतिपन्न हुए थे वे ही बार-बार सृज्यमान होते हुए प्रतिपन्न हुआ करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्पञ्च योगचर्यापरिबुर्णान्परिश्रुतान् । कृष्णा गौरं प्रभुं शंभुं तथा भूरिश्रुतं च वै
verses.transliteration: putrānpañca yogacaryāpariburṇānpariśrutān / kṛṣṇā gauraṃ prabhuṃ śaṃbhuṃ tathā bhūriśrutaṃ ca vai
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: प्रिय लगता है उसो भाव से भावित होते हुए प्रसन्न हुआ करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यां कीर्तिमतीं चैव योगिनीं योगमातरम् । ब्रह्मदत्तस्य चननी महिषी त्वणुहस्य सा
verses.transliteration: kanyāṃ kīrtimatīṃ caiva yoginīṃ yogamātaram / brahmadattasya cananī mahiṣī tvaṇuhasya sā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: महाभूतों में अनेक रूपता-इन्द्रियों के विषयों में तथा मूत्तियों में अनेक रूपता-इन्द्रियों के विषयों में तथा मूत्तियों में अनेकता होती है और प्राणियों के विप्रयोग गुणों से ही प्रवृत्त हुआ करते हैं ।३३। मैंने यह सर्ग, आपको बहुत ही संक्षेप से बता दिया है । अब ब्रह्माजी का उद्भव भी मैं बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यकिरणोपेतमपुनर्मार्गमास्थितः । सर्वव्यापी विनिर्मुक्तो भविष्यति महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: ādityakiraṇopetamapunarmārgamāsthitaḥ / sarvavyāpī vinirmukto bhaviṣyati mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: संक्षेप से वर्णन करूँगा ।३४। उसी अव्यक्त कारण से जो सत् ओर असत् स्वरूप बाला है । प्रधान से और पुरुष से महेश्वर जन्म ग्रहण किया करते
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: त्रय एते गाणाः प्रोक्ताश्चतुः शेषान्निबोधत । तान्वक्ष्यामि द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रभामूर्त्तिमतो गणान्
verses.transliteration: traya ete gāṇāḥ proktāścatuḥ śeṣānnibodhata / tānvakṣyāmi dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prabhāmūrttimato gaṇān
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नास्तु स्वधायां ते काव्या ह्यग्नेः कवेः सुताः । पितरो देवलोकेषु ज्योतिर्भासिषु भास्वराः
verses.transliteration: utpannāstu svadhāyāṃ te kāvyā hyagneḥ kaveḥ sutāḥ / pitaro devalokeṣu jyotirbhāsiṣu bhāsvarāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु द्विजास्तान्भावयन्त्युत । एतेषां मानसी कन्या योगोत्पत्तिरितिश्रुता
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddheṣu dvijāstānbhāvayantyuta / eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā yogotpattiritiśrutā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: दत्ता सनत्कुमारेण शुक्रस्य महिषी तु या । एकशृङ्गेति विख्याता भृगूणां कीर्तिवर्द्धिनी
verses.transliteration: dattā sanatkumāreṇa śukrasya mahiṣī tu yā / ekaśṛṅgeti vikhyātā bhṛgūṇāṃ kīrtivarddhinī
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: एतच्छू त्वा नै मिषेयास्तदानीं लोकोत्पत्ति सुस्थिति
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचि गर्भास्ते लोकाः समावृत्य दिवि स्थिताः । एते ह्यङ्गिरसः पुत्राः साध्यैः संवर्द्धिताः पुरा
verses.transliteration: marīci garbhāste lokāḥ samāvṛtya divi sthitāḥ / ete hyaṅgirasaḥ putrāḥ sādhyaiḥ saṃvarddhitāḥ purā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: यथा यूयं विधिना देवतादीनिष्ट्वा चंवावभृथं प्राप्य शुद्धाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: उपहूताः स्मृतास्ते वै पितरो भास्वरा दिवि । तान्क्षत्रियगणाः सप्त भावयन्ति फलार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: upahūtāḥ smṛtāste vai pitaro bhāsvarā divi / tānkṣatriyagaṇāḥ sapta bhāvayanti phalārthinaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: त्यक्तवा देहानायुषोंऽते क्रतार्था: पुण्यं लोकं प्राप्य
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या यशोदा नाम विश्रुता । मता या जननी देवी खट्वाङ्गस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā yaśodā nāma viśrutā / matā yā jananī devī khaṭvāṅgasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: वे ही फिर सम्मान करने वाला ब्रह्म के नाम वाले हो जाते हैं। और फिर यही ब्रह्माजी अभिमान और गुणात्मक लोकों का सृजन करते हैं ।३६। महत् तत्व से अहंकार की उत्पत्ति होती है और फिर अहंकार से भूतों का उद्भव हुआ करता है। मे भूत और इन्द्रिया एक हो साथ
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञे यस्य पुरा गीता गाथागीतैर्महर्षिभिः । अग्नेर्जन्म तदा दृष्ट्वा शाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yajñe yasya purā gītā gāthāgītairmaharṣibhiḥ / agnerjanma tadā dṛṣṭvā śāṇḍilyasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: सम्प्रवृत्त हुआ करते हैं ।३७। इन भूतों से अन्य भूतो के भेद होते हैं- इस तरह से सर्ग' प्रवृत्त हुआ करता है । उनका विस्तार और अवयव जैसी प्रज्ञा है ओर जैसा भी सुना है मैंने आपको पूर्व में बता दिया है उसी प्रकार से इनका अवधारण आप कर लीजिये ।३८। इसको नैमिष क्षेत्र में रहने वालों
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: यजमानं दिलीपं ये पश्यन्त्यत्र समाहिताः । सत्यव्रतं महात्मानं ते ऽपि स्वर्गजितो नराः
verses.transliteration: yajamānaṃ dilīpaṃ ye paśyantyatra samāhitāḥ / satyavrataṃ mahātmānaṃ te 'pi svargajito narāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: ने श्रवण करके जो उस समय में लोकों की उत्पत्ति और संहार कहा गया था उस सबमें अवभृथ को प्राप्त करके शुद्ध इए ऋषिगण--पुण्य लोक को आप्त हो जाते हैं ।३९। जिस रीति से आप लोग विधि पूर्वक यजन करके और देव आदि का अर्चन करके तथा अवशृथ को प्राप्त करके शुद्ध हुए हो ।
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: आज्यपा नाम पितरः कर्दमस्य प्रजा पतेः । समुत्पन्नस्य पुलहादुत्पन्नास्तस्य ते सुताः
verses.transliteration: ājyapā nāma pitaraḥ kardamasya prajā pateḥ / samutpannasya pulahādutpannāstasya te sutāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: फिर आयु के समाप्त होने पर शरीरों का त्याग करके इताथं हुई हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: लकिषु तेषु वैवर्ताः कामगोषु विहङ्गमाः । एतान्वैश्यगणाः श्राद्धे भाव यन्ति फलार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: lakiṣu teṣu vaivartāḥ kāmagoṣu vihaṅgamāḥ / etānvaiśyagaṇāḥ śrāddhe bhāva yanti phalārthinaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां मानसी कन्या विरजा नाम विश्रुता । ययातेर्जननी साध्वी पत्नी सा नहुषस्य च
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā virajā nāma viśrutā / yayāterjananī sādhvī patnī sā nahuṣasya ca
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: परम पुण्यलोक को प्राप्त करके इस भ्रकार से आनन्दित हो रहे हैं ।४०। ये वे भी नैमिषेय अर्यात् नैमिष क्षेत्र में रहने वाले सत्री देखकर को और स्पशं करके उस समय में अवभृथ स्नान किये हुए सबके सब स्वर्गलोक को गमन कर गये थे ।४१। है विप्रो ! उसी प्रकार से आप लोगों ने भी बहुत प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: सुकाला नाम पितरो वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः । हैरण्यगर्भस्य सुताः शूद्रास्तां भावयन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: sukālā nāma pitaro vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ / hairaṇyagarbhasya sutāḥ śūdrāstāṃ bhāvayantyuta
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: के यज्ञं के द्वारा यजन किया है। है उतम द्विजगणो ! फिर जब आपकी आयु का अवसान होगा तब आप भी सब स्वर्ग में गमन कर जाँयगे
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: मानसा नाम ते लोका वर्तन्ते यत्र ते दिवि । एतेषां मानसी कन्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा
verses.transliteration: mānasā nāma te lokā vartante yatra te divi / eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā narmadā saritāṃ varā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: सा भावयति भूतानि दक्षिणापथगामिनी । जननी सात्रसद्दस्योः पुरुकुत्सपरिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sā bhāvayati bhūtāni dakṣiṇāpathagāminī / jananī sātrasaddasyoḥ purukutsaparigrahaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषामभ्युपगमान्मनुर्मन्वन्तरेश्वरः । मन्वन्तरादौ श्राद्धानि प्रवर्तयति सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: eteṣāmabhyupagamānmanurmanvantareśvaraḥ / manvantarādau śrāddhāni pravartayati sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणामानुपूर्व्येण सर्वेषां द्विजसत्तमाः । तस्मादेतत्स्वधर्मेण देयं श्राद्धं च श्रद्धया
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāmānupūrvyeṇa sarveṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ / tasmādetatsvadharmeṇa deyaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca śraddhayā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां राजतैः पात्रैरपि वा रजतान्वितैः । दत्तं स्वधां पुरोधाय श्राद्धं प्रीणाति वै पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ rājataiḥ pātrairapi vā rajatānvitaiḥ / dattaṃ svadhāṃ purodhāya śrāddhaṃ prīṇāti vai pitṝn
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यायने वाग्रयणे ह्यश्वमेधं तदप्नुयात् । सोमश्चाप्यायनं कृत्वा ह्यगनेर्वेवस्वतस्य च
verses.transliteration: saumyāyane vāgrayaṇe hyaśvamedhaṃ tadapnuyāt / somaścāpyāyanaṃ kṛtvā hyaganervevasvatasya ca
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄन्प्रीणाति यो वंश्यः पितरः प्रीणयन्ति तम् । पितरः पुष्टिकामस्य प्रजाकामस्य वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: pitṝnprīṇāti yo vaṃśyaḥ pitaraḥ prīṇayanti tam / pitaraḥ puṣṭikāmasya prajākāmasya vā punaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्टिं प्रजास्तथा स्वर्गं प्रयच्छन्ति न संशयः । देवकार्यादपि सदा पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: puṣṭiṃ prajāstathā svargaṃ prayacchanti na saṃśayaḥ / devakāryādapi sadā pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: इस महा पुराण में चार पाद हैं-सर्म प्रथम प्रक्रिया है जो कि प्रथम पाद है-फिर कथा का परिग्रह है । फिर अनुध्बंग है और अन्त में उपो- द्वात तथा उपसंहार है ।४३। इसी रीति से चार पादों वाला यह पुराण लोक सम्मत है । इस पुराण को लोकों के हित में रति रखने वाले भगवानु वायु
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: देवताभ्यः पितॄणां हि पूर्वमाप्यायनं स्मृतम् । न हि योग गतिः सूक्ष्मा पितॄणां न पितृक्षयः
verses.transliteration: devatābhyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ hi pūrvamāpyāyanaṃ smṛtam / na hi yoga gatiḥ sūkṣmā pitṝṇāṃ na pitṛkṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: देव ने ही साक्षात् रूप से इसको कहा है ।४४ है शरेऊतम मुने ! नैमिष क्षेत्र में एक सत्र (यज्ञ) को प्राक्त करके मुनिगण एकत्रित हुए ये तभी उनसे कहा उसका प्रसाद संसिद्ध हो गया जो भूतों की उत्पत्ति और तप से संयुत है ।४४। इस प्राधिनिकी अर्थात् प्रधान के द्वारा की हुई तथा ईश्बर कें द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
