verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा विप्रसिद्धेन दृश्यते मासचक्षुषा । इत्येते पितरश्चैव लोका दुहितरश्च वै
verses.transliteration: tapasā viprasiddhena dṛśyate māsacakṣuṣā / ityete pitaraścaiva lokā duhitaraśca vai
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: करायी हुई सृष्टि को भली भाँति जानकर मेधावी पुरुष कभी भी मोह को प्राप्त नहीं होता है।४६। जो भी कोई विद्वान विप्र इस ब्रह्माजी के परम पुरातन इतिहास का श्रवण करता है अथवा श्रवण कराता है और इसका ध्यान भी करता है वह महेन्द्र देव के स्थानों में अनन्त वर्षों पर्यन्त आनन्द
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: दौहित्रा यजमानाश्च प्रोक्ता ये भावयन्ति यान् । चत्वारो मूर्तिमन्तस्तु त्रयस्तेषाममूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: dauhitrā yajamānāśca proktā ye bhāvayanti yān / catvāro mūrtimantastu trayasteṣāmamūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त किया करता है और ब्रह्म के सायुज्य को प्राप्त करके ब्रह्म के साथ आनन्दित होता है ।४७-४८। उन प्रजाओ के स्वामी महात्माओं तथा कीत्ति- मानों की कीत्ति को जो कि इस पृथिवी के ईश हैं संसार में प्रथित करके ब्रह्म के ही समान हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यः श्राद्धानि सत्कृत्य देवाः कुर्वन्ति यत्नतः । भक्त्या प्राञ्जलयः सर्वेसेंद्रास्तद्गतमानसाः
verses.transliteration: tebhyaḥ śrāddhāni satkṛtya devāḥ kurvanti yatnataḥ / bhaktyā prāñjalayaḥ sarveseṃdrāstadgatamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे च सिकताश्चैव पृश्निजाः शृङ्गिणस्तथा । कृष्णाः श्वेतांबुजाश्चैव विधिव त्पूजयन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: viśve ca sikatāścaiva pṛśnijāḥ śṛṅgiṇastathā / kṛṣṇāḥ śvetāṃbujāścaiva vidhiva tpūjayantyuta
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशस्ता वातरसना दिवाकृत्यास्तथैव च । मेघाश्च मरुतश्चैव ब्रह्माद्याश्च दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: praśastā vātarasanā divākṛtyāstathaiva ca / meghāśca marutaścaiva brahmādyāśca divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रिभृग्वङ्गिराद्याश्च ऋषयः सर्व एव ते । यक्षा नागाः सुपर्णाश्च किन्नरा राक्षसैः सह
verses.transliteration: atribhṛgvaṅgirādyāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te / yakṣā nāgāḥ suparṇāśca kinnarā rākṣasaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: स सर्बेमु च्यते पापे पुण्यं च महदाप्नुयात् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄंस्ते ऽपूजयन्सर्वे नित्यमेव फलार्थिनः । एवमेते महात्मानः श्राद्धे सत्कृत्य पूजिताः
verses.transliteration: pitṝṃste 'pūjayansarve nityameva phalārthinaḥ / evamete mahātmānaḥ śrāddhe satkṛtya pūjitāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छन्ति शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । हित्वा त्रैलोक्यसंसारं जरामृत्युमयं तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvānkāmānprayacchanti śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / hitvā trailokyasaṃsāraṃ jarāmṛtyumayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षं योगमथैश्वर्यं सूक्ष्मदेहमदेहिनाम् । कृत्स्नं वैराग्यमानन्त्यं प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: mokṣaṃ yogamathaiśvaryaṃ sūkṣmadehamadehinām / kṛtsnaṃ vairāgyamānantyaṃ prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: एश्वर्यं विहितं योगमेश्वर्यं योग उच्यते । योगैश्वर्यमृते मोक्षः कथञ्चिन्नोपपद्यते
verses.transliteration: eśvaryaṃ vihitaṃ yogameśvaryaṃ yoga ucyate / yogaiśvaryamṛte mokṣaḥ kathañcinnopapadyate
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: अपक्षस्येव गमनं गगने पक्षिणो यथा । वरिष्ठः सर्वधर्माणां मोक्षधर्मः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: apakṣasyeva gamanaṃ gagane pakṣiṇo yathā / variṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ mokṣadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: यह पुराण परम धन्य है--यश की वृद्धि करने वाला है--आयु के बढ़ाने वाला--परम स्मरूप और वेदों की समानता रखने बाला है। यह पुराण ब्रह्मवादी श्रीकृष्ण पायन ने ही कहा है ।५९। जो मनुष्य इस मन्वन्तरों की कीत्ति को प्रथित करता है तथा देवों की और भूरि द्रविण
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणां हि प्रसादेन प्राप्यते स महात्मनाम् । मुक्तावैडूर्यवासांसि वाजिनागायुतानि च
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāṃ hi prasādena prāpyate sa mahātmanām / muktāvaiḍūryavāsāṃsi vājināgāyutāni ca
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: तेज वाले ऋषियों की कीत्ति को फॅलाता है वह सभी प्रकार के पापों से छूट जाता है और महान पुष्य का लाम प्राप्त किया करता है और जो विद्वान प्रत्येक पर्व पर इसका अवण कराता है और इस अन्तिम पाद को धाद्ध में ब्राह्मणों को सुनाता है वह अक्षय और सर्वकामनाओं की पूर्ति करने बाला
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: किङ्किणीजालनद्धानि सदा पुष्पफलानि च । विमानानां सहस्राणि युक्तान्यप्सरसां गणैः
verses.transliteration: kiṅkiṇījālanaddhāni sadā puṣpaphalāni ca / vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇi yuktānyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धानि प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः । प्रजां पुष्टिं स्मृतिं मेधां राज्यमारोग्यमेव च । प्रीता नित्यं प्रयच्छन्ति मानुषाणां पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhāni prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ / prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ rājyamārogyameva ca / prītā nityaṃ prayacchanti mānuṣāṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: पितृगणो के समीप में उपस्थित होता है। कारण यही है कि पहिले यह उसी के द्वारा कहा जाता है ।५१-५४। जो पुरुष इसकी निठक्ति को जानता है वह सभी पापों से मुकत हो जाता है । उसी भांति तीनों वों में जो मनुष्य इसको पढ़ते हैं इस इतिहास का श्रवण करके धर्म की बुद्धि हो जाती
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिशश्चापि रत्नानिप्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः । हंसबर्हिणयुक्तनि मुक्तावैढूर्यवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: koṭiśaścāpi ratnāniprayacchanti pitāmahāḥ / haṃsabarhiṇayuktani muktāvaiḍhūryavanti ca
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: है और शरीर में जितने भी करोड़ रोमों के छिद्र हैं उतने ही वर्ष वह सर्ग में निवास करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे पितृराज्य कल्पो नाम दशमो ऽध्यायः ॥ १०॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच राजतं राजताक्तं वा पितॄणां पात्रमुच्यते । राजतस्य कथावापि दर्शनं दान मेव वा
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde pitṛrājya kalpo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 10// bṛhaspatiruvāca rājataṃ rājatāktaṃ vā pitṝṇāṃ pātramucyate / rājatasya kathāvāpi darśanaṃ dāna meva vā
verses.translation: Formerly, when the earth (in the form of a cow) was milked, it was in a silver vessel that Svadhd was milked by them. Whether it is Svadha or anything else, O dear one, whatever is offered in that (silver vessel) by those who seek (benefit), brings everlasting benefit.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, when the earth (in the form of a cow) was milked, it was in a silver vessel that Svadhd was milked by them. Whether it is Svadha or anything else, O dear one, whatever is offered in that (silver vessel) by those who seek (benefit), brings everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, when the earth (in the form of a cow) was milked, it was in a silver vessel that Svadhd was milked by them. Whether it is Svadha or anything else, O dear one, whatever is offered in that (silver vessel) by those who seek (benefit), brings everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तमक्षयं स्वर्गे राजते दानमुच्यते । पितॄनेतेन दानेन सत्पुत्रास्तारयन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: anantamakṣayaṃ svarge rājate dānamucyate / pitṝnetena dānena satputrāstārayantyuta
verses.translation: The very existence nearby the skin of the black antelope, or its sight or its gift is destructive of demons. It is conducive to the achievement of Brahminical splendour. It accomplishes the redemption of animals and sons.
verses.wordMeaning: The very existence nearby the skin of the black antelope, or its sight or its gift is destructive of demons. It is conducive to the achievement of Brahminical splendour. It accomplishes the redemption of animals and sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The very existence nearby the skin of the black antelope, or its sight or its gift is destructive of demons. It is conducive to the achievement of Brahminical splendour. It accomplishes the redemption of animals and sons.

verses.sanskrit: राजते हि स्वधा दुग्धा पात्रे तैः पृथिवी पुरा । स्वधां वा पार्थिभिस्तात तस्मिन् दत्तं तदक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: rājate hi svadhā dugdhā pātre taiḥ pṛthivī purā / svadhāṃ vā pārthibhistāta tasmin dattaṃ tadakṣayam
verses.translation: The gold vessel, the silver vessel, the sesamum seed* the eighth Muhurta of the day, the Kufa grass, the white gingelly seeds and the bundle of three staffs (in the hands of a Sannyasin) — these are the sacred objects that sanctify other things.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं पवित्रं च यशस्वि च।
verses.wordMeaning: The gold vessel, the silver vessel, the sesamum seed* the eighth Muhurta of the day, the Kufa grass, the white gingelly seeds and the bundle of three staffs (in the hands of a Sannyasin) — these are the sacred objects that sanctify other things.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gold vessel, the silver vessel, the sesamum seed* the eighth Muhurta of the day, the Kufa grass, the white gingelly seeds and the bundle of three staffs (in the hands of a Sannyasin) — these are the sacred objects that sanctify other things.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाजिनस्य सांनिध्यं दर्शनं दानमेव च । रक्षोघ्नं ब्रह्म वर्चस्यं पशून्पुत्रांश्च तारयेत्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇājinasya sāṃnidhyaṃ darśanaṃ dānameva ca / rakṣoghnaṃ brahma varcasyaṃ paśūnputrāṃśca tārayet
verses.translation: One shall allot the south eastern corner for the con- struction of the altar. It should be a square with the sides equal to an Aratni ( the distance between the tip of the little finger and the elbow). It must be well situated.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall allot the south eastern corner for the con- struction of the altar. It should be a square with the sides equal to an Aratni ( the distance between the tip of the little finger and the elbow). It must be well situated.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall allot the south eastern corner for the con- struction of the altar. It should be a square with the sides equal to an Aratni ( the distance between the tip of the little finger and the elbow). It must be well situated.

verses.sanskrit: कनकं राजतं पात्रं दौहित्रं कुतुपस्तिलाः । वस्तूनि पावनीयानि त्रिदण्डीयोग एव वा
verses.transliteration: kanakaṃ rājataṃ pātraṃ dauhitraṃ kutupastilāḥ / vastūni pāvanīyāni tridaṇḍīyoga eva vā
verses.translation: I shall mention duly the spot of the Pitrs as ordained (by the sacred literature). It is conducive to the attainment of
verses.hindi: शरीर में स्थित रोम क्ृपो के समान उतने हो सहन्न वर्षों तक स्वर्ग में आननद प्राप्त किया करता है । फिर ब्रह्म के सायुज्य में गमन करने वाला होकर देवों के साथ में परमानन्दित हुआ करता है ।१७। यह महापुराण सभी पापों के हरण करने वाला--पुष्य स्वरूप--पवित्र और यश वाला
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention duly the spot of the Pitrs as ordained (by the sacred literature). It is conducive to the attainment of
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention duly the spot of the Pitrs as ordained (by the sacred literature). It is conducive to the attainment of

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकर्मण्ययं श्रेष्ठो विधिर्ब्राह्मः सनातनः । आयुःकीर्तिप्रजैश्वर्यप्रज्ञासंततिवर्द्धनः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhakarmaṇyayaṃ śreṣṭho vidhirbrāhmaḥ sanātanaḥ / āyuḥkīrtiprajaiśvaryaprajñāsaṃtativarddhanaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Vi?nu Dh. S. 79. 14-15. Y&jftavalkyal. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf. also V&. 1-2; Mt. 19-22.
verses.hindi: है। ब्रह्माजी ने ही इस शास्त्र पुराण को वायु देव के लिये दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Vi?nu Dh. S. 79. 14-15. Y&jftavalkyal. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf. also V&. 1-2; Mt. 19-22.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Vi?nu Dh. S. 79. 14-15. Y&jftavalkyal. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf. also V&. 1-2; Mt. 19-22.

verses.sanskrit: दिशिदक्षिणपूर्वस्यां वेदिस्थानं निवेदयेत् । सर्वतो ऽरत्निमात्रं च चतुरस्रं सुसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: diśidakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ vedisthānaṃ nivedayet / sarvato 'ratnimātraṃ ca caturasraṃ susaṃsthitam
verses.translation: Three pits and three poles of Khadira wood should be made. The length of the poles should be an Aratni each. They must be embellished with silver bands.
verses.hindi: उस वासुदेव से इसकी प्राप्ति उशना ने की यी । उशना से देव गुरु बृहस्पति
verses.wordMeaning: Three pits and three poles of Khadira wood should be made. The length of the poles should be an Aratni each. They must be embellished with silver bands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three pits and three poles of Khadira wood should be made. The length of the poles should be an Aratni each. They must be embellished with silver bands.

verses.sanskrit: वक्ष्यामि विधिवत्स्थानं पितॄणामनुशासितम् । धन्यमायुष्यमारोग्यं बलवर्णविवर्द्धनमा
verses.transliteration: vakṣyāmi vidhivatsthānaṃ pitṝṇāmanuśāsitam / dhanyamāyuṣyamārogyaṃ balavarṇavivarddhanamā
verses.translation: Those pits should be Vitasti (the span or distance between the tips of the thumb and the little finger when they are extended on either side) in depth. The four sides should be four Angulas each. One should make pit facing towards the south-east. They should be firm and free from holes.
verses.wordMeaning: Those pits should be Vitasti (the span or distance between the tips of the thumb and the little finger when they are extended on either side) in depth. The four sides should be four Angulas each. One should make pit facing towards the south-east.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those pits should be Vitasti (the span or distance between the tips of the thumb and the little finger when they are extended on either side) in depth. The four sides should be four Angulas each. One should make pit facing towards the south-east.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गर्तास्त्रयः कायार्स्त्रयो दण्डाश्च खादिराः । अरत्निमात्रास्ते कार्या रजतैः प्रविभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: tatra gartāstrayaḥ kāyārstrayo daṇḍāśca khādirāḥ / aratnimātrāste kāryā rajataiḥ pravibhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: One should repeat this Mantra with great concen- tration at the time of offering the rice balls (to Pitrs). The pitrs arrive instantly and the demons flee.
verses.hindi: जीने प्राप्त किया था । वृहस्पति ने फिर सविता को बताया था।श६। सविता ने मृत्यु को दिया था और मृत्यु ने फिर इन्द्र को दिया था । इन्द्र ने बसि मुनि को बताया या और वसिष्ठजी सारस्वत को दिया या
verses.wordMeaning: One should repeat this Mantra with great concen- tration at the time of offering the rice balls (to Pitrs). The pitrs arrive instantly and the demons flee.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should repeat this Mantra with great concen- tration at the time of offering the rice balls (to Pitrs). The pitrs arrive instantly and the demons flee.

verses.sanskrit: ते वितस्त्यायता गर्त्ताः सर्वतश्चतुरङ्गुलाः । प्राग्दक्षिणमुखान्कुर्यात्स्थिरानशुषिरांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: te vitastyāyatā garttāḥ sarvataścaturaṅgulāḥ / prāgdakṣiṇamukhānkuryātsthirānaśuṣirāṃstathā
verses.translation: On being regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by the expounders of Brahman, this Mantra redeems everyone connected with the Pitrs in the three units of time (past, present and future).
verses.hindi: सारस्वत ने विधामा को दिया था और त्रिधामा ने शरद्वात् को दिया था । शरद्वन् ने त्रिविष्ट को दिया ओर उसने अन्तरिक्ष को दिया था ।६१। अन्त- रिक्ष ने चर्षी को बतलाया ओर उसने त्रम्याइण को दिया था । त्रस्पार्ण ने धनङ्जय को दिया था उसने कृताञ्जय को दिया था ।६२। कृतञ्जय से
verses.wordMeaning: On being regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by the expounders of Brahman, this Mantra redeems everyone connected with the Pitrs in the three units of time (past, present and future).
verses.commentary: Sense: On being regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by the expounders of Brahman, this Mantra redeems everyone connected with the Pitrs in the three units of time (past, present and future).

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिः पवित्रयुक्ताभिः पावयेत्सततं शुचिः । पयसा ह्याज गव्येन शोधनं चाद्भिरेव च
verses.transliteration: adbhiḥ pavitrayuktābhiḥ pāvayetsatataṃ śuciḥ / payasā hyāja gavyena śodhanaṃ cādbhireva ca
verses.translation: I shall now impart the Saptarcis Mantra which is splendid, which yields all desires and by chanting which regularly one can propitiate the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: तृणङ्जय को मिला था और इससे भरद्वाज को प्राप्त हुआ था। ' भरद्वाज ने गौतम को दिया था और उसने फिर निय्वंन्तर को दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now impart the Saptarcis Mantra which is splendid, which yields all desires and by chanting which regularly one can propitiate the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now impart the Saptarcis Mantra which is splendid, which yields all desires and by chanting which regularly one can propitiate the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: सततं तर्पणं ह्येतत्तृप्तिर्भवति शास्वती । इह वामुत्र य वशी सर्वकामसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: satataṃ tarpaṇaṃ hyetattṛptirbhavati śāsvatī / iha vāmutra ya vaśī sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The Saptarcis Mantra a: — I shall always bow down to the Pitrs both Amtirtis (formless) and Samurtis (endowed with forms) who are full of brilliant splendour, who habitually meditate and have the Yogic vision.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saptarcis Mantra a: — I shall always bow down to the Pitrs both Amtirtis (formless) and Samurtis (endowed with forms) who are full of brilliant splendour, who habitually meditate and have the Yogic vision.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saptarcis Mantra a: — I shall always bow down to the Pitrs both Amtirtis (formless) and Samurtis (endowed with forms) who are full of brilliant splendour, who habitually meditate and have the Yogic vision.

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्रिषवणस्नातो योर्ऽचयेत्प्रयतः पितॄन् । मन्त्रेण विधिवत्सम्यगश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ triṣavaṇasnāto yor'cayetprayataḥ pitṝn / mantreṇa vidhivatsamyagaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: They are the leaders of (gods like) Indra and others of (Prajapatis like) Daksa and Marica (i.e. Kafyapa), of the seven sages and of the (other) Pitrs. I shall bow down to them who bestow all desires.
verses.wordMeaning: They are the leaders of (gods like) Indra and others of (Prajapatis like) Daksa and Marica (i.e. Kafyapa), of the seven sages and of the (other) Pitrs. I shall bow down to them who bestow all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the leaders of (gods like) Indra and others of (Prajapatis like) Daksa and Marica (i.e. Kafyapa), of the seven sages and of the (other) Pitrs. I shall bow down to them who bestow all desires.

verses.sanskrit: तान्स्थापयेदमावास्यां गर्त्तान्वै चतुरङ्गुलान् । त्रिःसप्तसंस्थास्ते यज्ञास्त्रैलोक्यं धार्यते तु यः
verses.transliteration: tānsthāpayedamāvāsyāṃ garttānvai caturaṅgulān / triḥsaptasaṃsthāste yajñāstrailokyaṃ dhāryate tu yaḥ
verses.translation: Hem&dri regards this as Saptarcis Mantra (vide G.G. ( Caturuarga Cintdmapi, Sr&ddha, p & 1208). This mantra is found in V5u 15-18, Skanda P. VII. 1.206; 11-116, GP. (Ac&ra) 218.6. Our Text however regards W. 23-29 as Saptarci Mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: Hem&dri regards this as Saptarcis Mantra (vide G.G. ( Caturuarga Cintdmapi, Sr&ddha, p & 1208). This mantra is found in V5u 15-18, Skanda P. VII. 1.206; 11-116, GP. (Ac&ra) 218.6. Our Text however regards W. 23-29 as Saptarci Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hem&dri regards this as Saptarcis Mantra (vide G.G. ( Caturuarga Cintdmapi, Sr&ddha, p & 1208). This mantra is found in V5u 15-18, Skanda P. VII. 1.206; 11-116, GP. (Ac&ra) 218.6. Our Text however regards W. 23-29 as Saptarci Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुष्टिस्तथैश्वर्यमायुः संततिरेव च । दिवि च भ्राजतेलक्ष्म्या मोक्षं च लभते क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tasya puṣṭistathaiśvaryamāyuḥ saṃtatireva ca / divi ca bhrājatelakṣmyā mokṣaṃ ca labhate kramāt
verses.translation: As noted above, seven verses from 23 to 29 constitute the Saptarci Mantra and Vft. 21-27 agrees in Mo with our text. This is rather a eulogy ■of the Pitrs in details. As against Hem&dri our Pur&pa states that This is what i* called the Saptarci'* Mantra* (V. 30).
verses.wordMeaning: As noted above, seven verses from 23 to 29 constitute the Saptarci Mantra and Vft. 21-27 agrees in Mo with our text. This is rather a eulogy ■of the Pitrs in details. As against Hem&dri our Pur&pa states that This is what i* called the Saptarci'* Mantra* (V. 30).
verses.commentary: Sense: As noted above, seven verses from 23 to 29 constitute the Saptarci Mantra and Vft. 21-27 agrees in Mo with our text. This is rather a eulogy ■of the Pitrs in details. As against Hem&dri our Pur&pa states that This is what i* called the Saptarci'* Mantra* (V. 30).

verses.sanskrit: पाप्मापहं पावनीयं ह्यश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । अश्वमेधफलं ह्येत्तद्द्विजैः संस्कृत्य पूजितम्
verses.transliteration: pāpmāpahaṃ pāvanīyaṃ hyaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / aśvamedhaphalaṃ hyettaddvijaiḥ saṃskṛtya pūjitam
verses.translation: I shall pay obeisance to the grandfathers. # They are the leaders of celestial sages. They are bowed down to by all worlds. They are the saviours of all living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall pay obeisance to the grandfathers. # They are the leaders of celestial sages. They are bowed down to by all worlds. They are the saviours of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall pay obeisance to the grandfathers. # They are the leaders of celestial sages. They are bowed down to by all worlds. They are the saviours of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रं वक्ष्याम्यहं तस्मादमृतं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् । देंवतेभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च महायोगिभ्य एव च
verses.transliteration: mantraṃ vakṣyāmyahaṃ tasmādamṛtaṃ brahmanirmitam / deṃvatebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca mahāyogibhya eva ca
verses.translation: With the palms folded in reverence I shall always bow down to the Yogesvaras (lords of the Yoga), to Soma (the moon-god), to Yama, to Prajapati, to the cows and to the fire- god.
verses.hindi: निय्य॑न्तर ने बाजश्रव को यह बताया था और उसने सोम शुष्म को दिया था फिर उसने तृण बिन्दु के लिए दिया था ।६४। तृण विन्दु ने दक्ष को दिया था और उसने फिर शक्ति को बताया था । शवित से गर्भ में ही स्थित पराशर मुनि ने इसका श्रवण किया था ।६४। पराशर से जातुक्य ने
verses.wordMeaning: With the palms folded in reverence I shall always bow down to the Yogesvaras (lords of the Yoga), to Soma (the moon-god), to Yama, to Prajapati, to the cows and to the fire- god.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the palms folded in reverence I shall always bow down to the Yogesvaras (lords of the Yoga), to Soma (the moon-god), to Yama, to Prajapati, to the cows and to the fire- god.

verses.sanskrit: नमः स्वाहयै स्वधायै नित्यमेव भवत्युत । आद्धे ऽवसाने श्राद्धस्य त्रिरावृत्तं जपेत्सदा
verses.transliteration: namaḥ svāhayai svadhāyai nityameva bhavatyuta / āddhe 'vasāne śrāddhasya trirāvṛttaṃ japetsadā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Salutation to Brahma, the self-born lord with the Yogic
verses.hindi: प्राप्त किया था फिर उससे प्रभु द्व पायन ने प्राप्त किया था । दे द्विजोत्तम !
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Salutation to Brahma, the self-born lord with the Yogic
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Salutation to Brahma, the self-born lord with the Yogic

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डनिर्वपणे वापि जपेदेतं समाहितः । क्षिप्रमायान्ति पितरो रक्षांसि प्रद्रवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: piṇḍanirvapaṇe vāpi japedetaṃ samāhitaḥ / kṣipramāyānti pitaro rakṣāṃsi pradravanti ca
verses.translation: A man who adopts this in accordance with the injunction obtains three excellent blessings (viz. food-grains, longevity and sons). The Pitrs bestow (on men) on the earth (in this very life) plenty of food, long life and good sons.
verses.wordMeaning: A man who adopts this in accordance with the injunction obtains three excellent blessings (viz. food-grains, longevity and sons). The Pitrs bestow (on men) on the earth (in this very life) plenty of food, long life and good sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who adopts this in accordance with the injunction obtains three excellent blessings (viz. food-grains, longevity and sons). The Pitrs bestow (on men) on the earth (in this very life) plenty of food, long life and good sons.

verses.sanskrit: पित्र्यं तु त्रिषु कालेषु मन्त्रो ऽयं तारयत्युत । पठ्यमानः सदा श्राद्धे नियतैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: pitryaṃ tu triṣu kāleṣu mantro 'yaṃ tārayatyuta / paṭhyamānaḥ sadā śrāddhe niyatairbrahmavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: If a person chants the Saptarcis Mantra everyday with great faith, full devotion, perfect conquest of the sense- organs and with great concentration of the mind, he shall become the sole ruler over the earth consisting of seven conti- nents and oceans.
verses.hindi: द्वैपायन मुनि से इस महापुराण को मैने प्राप्त किया था ।६६। फिर मैंने अमित बुद्धि पुत्र को दिया था । यह इतना वाक्य ब्रह्मा से आदि लेकर गुरु वर्गों का मैंने बता दिया है ।६७। मनीषियोँ को प्रयत्न से इन गरु वर्णों के लिए नमस्कार करना चाहिए। यह पुराण यशस्य--आयुष्य--पुण्य और
verses.wordMeaning: If a person chants the Saptarcis Mantra everyday with great faith, full devotion, perfect conquest of the sense- organs and with great concentration of the mind, he shall become the sole ruler over the earth consisting of seven conti- nents and oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person chants the Saptarcis Mantra everyday with great faith, full devotion, perfect conquest of the sense- organs and with great concentration of the mind, he shall become the sole ruler over the earth consisting of seven conti- nents and oceans.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यकामो जपेदेतं सदा मन्त्रमतन्द्रितः । वीर्यशौर्यार्थसत्त्वाशीरायुर्बुद्धिविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: rājyakāmo japedetaṃ sadā mantramatandritaḥ / vīryaśauryārthasattvāśīrāyurbuddhivivarddhanam
verses.translation: VV. 34b-40 enumerate the different trees, the leaves (i.e. the cups of the leaves) of which (if used for oblations to Pitrs) confer different benefits* The Sraddha Sfitra of K&tyayaaa recommends the use of (cups of leaves of) sacrificial trees for Argkjra. Though Pur&Qas strongly recommend the use of vessels of metals, cups of leaves are also allowed, (vide PdtP. Srfti 8 9.142-43#
verses.hindi: सब अर्था का साधक है ।६८। यह पापों के हनन करने वाला है । ब्राह्मणों को सदा ही इसका श्रवण करना चाहिए। इस पुराण को जो अशुचि हो-- पापी हो तथा जो एक वर्षे से भी कम वास करने वाला हो उसको नहीं बताना चाहिए ।६९। जिसमें इसके प्रति श्रद्धा न हो उसको--अविद्वान् को
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 34b-40 enumerate the different trees, the leaves (i.e. the cups of the leaves) of which (if used for oblations to Pitrs) confer different benefits* The Sraddha Sfitra of K&tyayaaa recommends the use of (cups of leaves of) sacrificial trees for Argkjra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 34b-40 enumerate the different trees, the leaves (i.e. the cups of the leaves) of which (if used for oblations to Pitrs) confer different benefits* The Sraddha Sfitra of K&tyayaaa recommends the use of (cups of leaves of) sacrificial trees for Argkjra.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रीयन्ते पितरो येन जपेन नियमेन च । सप्तर्चिषं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: prīyante pitaro yena japena niyamena ca / saptarciṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: The Kasmarl vessel (i.e. the cup made of the leaf of KaSmari or Gambhari is said to be destructive of demons and conducive to renown.
verses.hindi: और पुत्रहीन को भी कभी नहीं बताना चाहिए। यह परम पवित्र तथा उत्तम है अतः जो अपना हित न हो उसको भी नहीं देना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The Kasmarl vessel (i.e. the cup made of the leaf of KaSmari or Gambhari is said to be destructive of demons and conducive to renown.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kasmarl vessel (i.e. the cup made of the leaf of KaSmari or Gambhari is said to be destructive of demons and conducive to renown.

verses.sanskrit: अमूर्त्तीनां समूर्त्तिनां पितॄणां दीप्ततेजसाम् । नमस्यामि सदा तेषां ध्यानिनां योगचक्षुषाम्
verses.transliteration: amūrttīnāṃ samūrttināṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām / namasyāmi sadā teṣāṃ dhyānināṃ yogacakṣuṣām
verses.translation: Keeping (oblation) in Phalgu (a kind of fig tree) vessels one shall obtain all desires. In the sun-plant the benefit is excessive lustre and bright illumination in particular.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त' वै यस्य योनि वदंति व्यक्त देहं कालमेतं गति च।
verses.wordMeaning: Keeping (oblation) in Phalgu (a kind of fig tree) vessels one shall obtain all desires. In the sun-plant the benefit is excessive lustre and bright illumination in particular.
verses.commentary: Sense: Keeping (oblation) in Phalgu (a kind of fig tree) vessels one shall obtain all desires. In the sun-plant the benefit is excessive lustre and bright illumination in particular.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रादीनां च नेतारो दशमारीचयोस्तथा । सप्तर्षीणां पितॄणां च तान्नमस्यामि कामदान्
verses.transliteration: indrādīnāṃ ca netāro daśamārīcayostathā / saptarṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tānnamasyāmi kāmadān
verses.translation: Keeping the oblation in a Bilva vessel one shall always obtain wealth, intellect and longevity.
verses.hindi: वाचो वेदा अंतरिक्षं शरीरं क्षितिः पादास्तारका रोमकूपाः।
verses.wordMeaning: Keeping the oblation in a Bilva vessel one shall always obtain wealth, intellect and longevity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Keeping the oblation in a Bilva vessel one shall always obtain wealth, intellect and longevity.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वादिनां च नेतारः सूर्याचन्द्रमसोस्तथा । तान्नमस्कृत्य सर्वान्वै पितृमत्सु विधिष्वपि
verses.transliteration: manvādināṃ ca netāraḥ sūryācandramasostathā / tānnamaskṛtya sarvānvai pitṛmatsu vidhiṣvapi
verses.translation: There will be brilliance (all around him) on the earth on account of his lustre, renown and splendour and strength. He will shine in the Heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: There will be brilliance (all around him) on the earth on account of his lustre, renown and splendour and strength. He will shine in the Heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: There will be brilliance (all around him) on the earth on account of his lustre, renown and splendour and strength. He will shine in the Heaven.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्राणां ग्रहाणां च वाय्वग्न्योश्च पितॄनथ । द्यावापृथिव्योश्च सदा नामस्यामि कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca vāyvagnyośca pitṝnatha / dyāvāpṛthivyośca sadā nāmasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Invariably during the occasions of the Sraddha ceremony, the Pitamahas (grandfathers i.e, the manes) assume gaseous forms1 and penetrate the excellent &rhhmanas. Hence I say this to you.
verses.hindi: तं देवदेवं जननं जनानां यज्ञात्मकं सत्यलोकप्रतिष्ठम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Invariably during the occasions of the Sraddha ceremony, the Pitamahas (grandfathers i.e, the manes) assume gaseous forms1 and penetrate the excellent &rhhmanas. Hence I say this to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Invariably during the occasions of the Sraddha ceremony, the Pitamahas (grandfathers i.e, the manes) assume gaseous forms1 and penetrate the excellent &rhhmanas. Hence I say this to you.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षीणां च नेतारः सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः । त्रातारः सर्वभूतानां नमस्यामि पितामहान्
verses.transliteration: devarṣīṇāṃ ca netāraḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ / trātāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ namasyāmi pitāmahān
verses.translation: One shall worship, honour and propitiate excellent Brahmanas by means of garments, gifts of jewels, food -stuffs, beverages, cows, horses and villages.
verses.hindi: वरं वराणां वरदं महेश्वरं ब्रह्माणमादि प्रयतो नमस्ये
verses.wordMeaning: One shall worship, honour and propitiate excellent Brahmanas by means of garments, gifts of jewels, food -stuffs, beverages, cows, horses and villages.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall worship, honour and propitiate excellent Brahmanas by means of garments, gifts of jewels, food -stuffs, beverages, cows, horses and villages.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतेर्गवां वह्नेः सोमाय च यमाय च । योगेश्वरेभ्यश्च सदा नमस्यामि कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatergavāṃ vahneḥ somāya ca yamāya ca / yogeśvarebhyaśca sadā namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: If the Brahmanas are honoured and worshipped, the Pitrs become delighted. Hence, one should always endeavour to worship the Brahmanas duly.
verses.hindi: जिसकी योनि अव्यक्त है-व्यक्त जिसका देह है-यह काल ही गति है--अग्नि मुख हैं--चन्द्र और सूर्य ही नेत्र है-दिशायें जिसके श्रोत्र हैं और वायु घाण है ।७१। वाणी जिसकी वेद हैं-अन्तरिक्ष ही शरीर है- क्षितिहो पाद हैं-तारे रोम कय है--द्यो मस्तक है-विद्या अधोभाग है और
verses.wordMeaning: If the Brahmanas are honoured and worshipped, the Pitrs become delighted. Hence, one should always endeavour to worship the Brahmanas duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the Brahmanas are honoured and worshipped, the Pitrs become delighted. Hence, one should always endeavour to worship the Brahmanas duly.

verses.sanskrit: पितृगणेभ्यः सप्तभ्यो नमो लोकेषु सप्तसु । स्वयंभुवे नमश्चैव ब्रह्मणे योगचक्षुषे
verses.transliteration: pitṛgaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu / svayaṃbhuve namaścaiva brahmaṇe yogacakṣuṣe
verses.translation: W. 49-51 state why Brihmagas are to be worshipped, fed and gifted at the time of Sr&ddha. Cf. AuSanasa Smfti V. 4-5 endorsing the belief of Pitrs entering the bodies of invited Brahmins, in gaseous form.
verses.hindi: उपनिषदु जिसकी कूप है ।७२। उस देवों के भी देव को और जनों के जन्म स्थल को--यज्ञ स्वरूप तया सत्यलोक में प्रतिष्ठित को-वरों के देने वालों के श्रेष्ठ वर को आदि महेश्वर ब्रह्माजो को प्रणत होकर नमस्कार करता
verses.wordMeaning: W. 49-51 state why Brihmagas are to be worshipped, fed and gifted at the time of Sr&ddha. Cf. AuSanasa Smfti V. 4-5 endorsing the belief of Pitrs entering the bodies of invited Brahmins, in gaseous form.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 49-51 state why Brihmagas are to be worshipped, fed and gifted at the time of Sr&ddha. Cf. AuSanasa Smfti V. 4-5 endorsing the belief of Pitrs entering the bodies of invited Brahmins, in gaseous form.

verses.sanskrit: ३० ॥ एतेन विधिना युक्तस्त्रीन्वरांल्लभते नरः । अन्नमायुः सुताश्चैव ददते पितरो भुवि
verses.transliteration: 30 // etena vidhinā yuktastrīnvarāṃllabhate naraḥ / annamāyuḥ sutāścaiva dadate pitaro bhuvi
verses.translation: (Defective text) One Pavilra{ a ring of Darbha grass) should be worn in the hand. By means of the Caila mantra, the Pindas (rice-balls) shall be sprinkled once for each of the Pitjrs after showing the mirror over the skin of the black antelope (?).
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) One Pavilra{ a ring of Darbha grass) should be worn in the hand. By means of the Caila mantra, the Pindas (rice-balls) shall be sprinkled once for each of the Pitjrs after showing the mirror over the skin of the black antelope (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) One Pavilra{ a ring of Darbha grass) should be worn in the hand. By means of the Caila mantra, the Pindas (rice-balls) shall be sprinkled once for each of the Pitjrs after showing the mirror over the skin of the black antelope (?).

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या परमया युक्तः श्रद्धधानो जितेन्द्रियः । सप्तार्चि षं जपेद्यस्तु नित्यमेव समाहितः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ śraddhadhāno jitendriyaḥ / saptārci ṣaṃ japedyastu nityameva samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The performer of Sraddha earnestly devoted to the Pitis should always offer on the ground three Pinzas (balls of rice) mixed with gingelly seeds and ghee. He should place the the knee on the ground and wear the sacred thread in the normal manner.
verses.hindi: अस्तु नः श्रेयसे नित्यं वस्तु वामाङ्गसुन्दरम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The performer of Sraddha earnestly devoted to the Pitis should always offer on the ground three Pinzas (balls of rice) mixed with gingelly seeds and ghee. He should place the the knee on the ground and wear the sacred thread in the normal manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: The performer of Sraddha earnestly devoted to the Pitis should always offer on the ground three Pinzas (balls of rice) mixed with gingelly seeds and ghee. He should place the the knee on the ground and wear the sacred thread in the normal manner.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रायां पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत् । यत्किञ्चित्पच्यते गेहे भक्ष्यं वा भोज्यमेव वा
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet / yatkiñcitpacyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ vā bhojyameva vā
verses.translation: He should invoke the father, the grandfather and the great grandfather as well as the other Pitrs of yore.
verses.wordMeaning: He should invoke the father, the grandfather and the great grandfather as well as the other Pitrs of yore.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should invoke the father, the grandfather and the great grandfather as well as the other Pitrs of yore.

verses.sanskrit: अनिवेद्य न भोक्तव्यं तस्मिन्नयतने सदा । क्रमशः कीर्तयिष्यामि बलिपात्राण्यतः परम्
verses.transliteration: anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ tasminnayatane sadā / kramaśaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi balipātrāṇyataḥ param
verses.translation: He should discharge the first Pinda towards the south with both hands repeating alertly the Mantra beginning with Namo vah pitarah $o$tya * * etc.
verses.wordMeaning: He should discharge the first Pinda towards the south with both hands repeating alertly the Mantra beginning with Namo vah pitarah $o$tya * * etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should discharge the first Pinda towards the south with both hands repeating alertly the Mantra beginning with Namo vah pitarah $o$tya * * etc.

verses.sanskrit: येषु यच्च फलं प्रोक्तं तन्मे निगदतः श्रुणु । पलाशे ब्रह्मवर्चस्त्वमश्वत्थे वसुभावना
verses.transliteration: yeṣu yacca phalaṃ proktaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śruṇu / palāśe brahmavarcastvamaśvatthe vasubhāvanā
verses.translation: ( Defective text). Repeating the Mantra beginning with uNamo vafr pitarah saumyah" (Obeisance to ye all, O
verses.wordMeaning: ( Defective text). Repeating the Mantra beginning with uNamo vafr pitarah saumyah" (Obeisance to ye all, O
verses.commentary: Sense: ( Defective text). Repeating the Mantra beginning with uNamo vafr pitarah saumyah" (Obeisance to ye all, O

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूताधिपत्यं च प्लक्षे नित्यभुदात्दृतम् । पुष्टिः प्रजाश्च न्यग्रोधे बुद्धिः प्रज्ञा धृतिः स्मृतिः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtādhipatyaṃ ca plakṣe nityabhudātdṛtam / puṣṭiḥ prajāśca nyagrodhe buddhiḥ prajñā dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The line of Mortar (?) should be sprinkled with water from the water-pot. A new thread of silk, jute or cotton should be offered.
verses.wordMeaning: The line of Mortar (?) should be sprinkled with water from the water-pot. A new thread of silk, jute or cotton should be offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: The line of Mortar (?) should be sprinkled with water from the water-pot. A new thread of silk, jute or cotton should be offered.

verses.sanskrit: रशोध्नं च यशस्यं च काश्मरीपात्रमुच्यते । सौभाग्यमुत्तमं लोके माधूके समुदात्दृतम्
verses.transliteration: raśodhnaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca kāśmarīpātramucyate / saubhāgyamuttamaṃ loke mādhūke samudātdṛtam
verses.translation: One should avoid woven silk, coloured cloth and Kauseya (a variety of silk). In the Yajna, one should avoid sprinkling water even with an unwashed (i.e. fresh from the loom) cloth (?)
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid woven silk, coloured cloth and Kauseya (a variety of silk). In the Yajna, one should avoid sprinkling water even with an unwashed (i.e. fresh from the loom) cloth (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid woven silk, coloured cloth and Kauseya (a variety of silk). In the Yajna, one should avoid sprinkling water even with an unwashed (i.e. fresh from the loom) cloth (?)

verses.sanskrit: फलगुपात्रेषु कुर्वाणः सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् । परां द्युतिमथार्केतु प्राकाश्यं च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: phalagupātreṣu kurvāṇaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt / parāṃ dyutimathārketu prākāśyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: These things do not please (the Pitrs). They say that the collyriumof theTrikakuda type (?) is always excellent.
verses.hindi: हे इस जगत् की एक ही जननि ! आपकी सेवा में मेरा सादर प्रणाम निवेदित हैं । आप चार भुजाओं वाली हैं आपके मस्तक में चन्द्रमा की कला का भूषण विद्यमान है--आपके अत्यन्त उन्नत उरोज हैं-आपका वर्णे कुकुम के राग के सदृश रक्त है-पुष्ड़-इक्ष, पाश-अ'कुश और पुष्पों
verses.wordMeaning: These things do not please (the Pitrs). They say that the collyriumof theTrikakuda type (?) is always excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: These things do not please (the Pitrs). They say that the collyriumof theTrikakuda type (?) is always excellent.

verses.sanskrit: बैल्वे लक्ष्मीन्तथा मेधां नित्यमायुस्तथैव च । क्षेत्रारामतडागेषु सर्वसस्येषु चैव ह
verses.transliteration: bailve lakṣmīntathā medhāṃ nityamāyustathaiva ca / kṣetrārāmataḍāgeṣu sarvasasyeṣu caiva ha
verses.translation: All the wild flowers equipped with sweet scent and beautiful form are excellent. So also the flowers with Na4ls (long tubes) as well as the yellow Amaranth flower.
verses.hindi: का वाण आपके करों में सुशोभित है ।१। आपके वाम अङ्क में परम सुन्दर बस्तु हमारे नित्य ही कल्याण के लिए होवे । जिससे विद्वानों में तीसरे और तृतीय परम तेज विद्यमान है ।२। वह अगस्त्य नाम वाले देवि हैं जो वेदों और वेदाङ्क शास्त्रों के पारगामी विद्वन् हैं। वे सब सिद्धान्तों के सार के
verses.wordMeaning: All the wild flowers equipped with sweet scent and beautiful form are excellent. So also the flowers with Na4ls (long tubes) as well as the yellow Amaranth flower.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the wild flowers equipped with sweet scent and beautiful form are excellent. So also the flowers with Na4ls (long tubes) as well as the yellow Amaranth flower.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षत्य जस्रं पर्जन्यो वेणुपात्रेषु कुर्वतः । एतेष्वेव सुपात्रेषु भोजनाग्रमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: varṣatya jasraṃ parjanyo veṇupātreṣu kurvataḥ / eteṣveva supātreṣu bhojanāgramaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Mantra: "I destroy everything that has impurity in it. The Asuras and Danavas have been killed by me. The Raksasas, the Yaksas along with the groups of Pisacas, and Yatudhanas have been killed by me".
verses.hindi: ज्ञाता हैं और ब्रह्मानन्द के रस के ही स्वरूप बाले हैं ।३। अबुभुतता के हेतु स्वरूप तीर्थो का और पवित्र आयतनों का जिन्होंने सञ्चरण किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Mantra: "I destroy everything that has impurity in it. The Asuras and Danavas have been killed by me. The Raksasas, the Yaksas along with the groups of Pisacas, and Yatudhanas have been killed by me".
verses.commentary: Sense: Mantra: "I destroy everything that has impurity in it. The Asuras and Danavas have been killed by me. The Raksasas, the Yaksas along with the groups of Pisacas, and Yatudhanas have been killed by me".

verses.sanskrit: सदा दद्यात्स यज्ञानां सर्वेषां फलमाप्नुयात् । पितृभ्यः पुष्पमाल्यानि सुगन्धानि च तत्परः
verses.transliteration: sadā dadyātsa yajñānāṃ sarveṣāṃ phalamāpnuyāt / pitṛbhyaḥ puṣpamālyāni sugandhāni ca tatparaḥ
verses.translation: The devotee should restrain himself and repeat the above Mantra while scrubbing the altar once. The wise per- former (of Sraddha), the Brahmana who is desirous of auspi- cious wisdom should certainly go towards the north and throw (Darbha grass).
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee should restrain himself and repeat the above Mantra while scrubbing the altar once. The wise per- former (of Sraddha), the Brahmana who is desirous of auspi- cious wisdom should certainly go towards the north and throw (Darbha grass).
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee should restrain himself and repeat the above Mantra while scrubbing the altar once. The wise per- former (of Sraddha), the Brahmana who is desirous of auspi- cious wisdom should certainly go towards the north and throw (Darbha grass).

verses.sanskrit: सदा दद्यात्क्रियायुक्तः श विभाति दिवाकरः । गुग्गुलादींस्तथा धूपान्पितृभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: sadā dadyātkriyāyuktaḥ śa vibhāti divākaraḥ / guggulādīṃstathā dhūpānpitṛbhyo yaḥ prayacchati
verses.translation: The Asuras avoid that person who has seen (i.e. adopted and repeated) the Pitrs Mantra. Raksasas avoid that place where this Mantra is recited.
verses.hindi: तथा समस्त शेल-अरण्य-नदियाँ आदि प्रमुख स्थलों का एवं जनपदों का भी जिन्होंने परिभ्रमण किया है।४। उन-उन स्थलों में जहाँ-जहाँ पर उन्होंने परिश्रमण किया था वहाँ पर सभी जन्तुओं को ज्ञान से शून्य तथा अत्यन्त ही अन्धकार से समन्वित एक केवल उदर पूति तथा काम वासना
verses.wordMeaning: The Asuras avoid that person who has seen (i.e. adopted and repeated) the Pitrs Mantra. Raksasas avoid that place where this Mantra is recited.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asuras avoid that person who has seen (i.e. adopted and repeated) the Pitrs Mantra. Raksasas avoid that place where this Mantra is recited.

verses.sanskrit: संयुक्तान्मधुसर्पिर्भ्यं सो ऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् । धूपं गन्धगुणोपेतं कृत्वा पितृपरायणः
verses.transliteration: saṃyuktānmadhusarpirbhyaṃ so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet / dhūpaṃ gandhaguṇopetaṃ kṛtvā pitṛparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He shbuld neither see nor touch nor give unclean varieties of cooked rice that are rotten. If the man does not have
verses.hindi: में परायण देश्वा था। उन्होंने यह बुरो दशा देखकर उनके विषय में चिन्तन किया था ।५। वे इसी प्रकार से चिन्तन करते हुए संचरण कर रहे थे और इस भूमि पर विचर रहे ये कि उन्हें काञ्ची नगर मिला था जो महान पुण्यमय ओर अत्युत्तम था ।६। वहाँ पर इन आत्मवान् अगस्त्यजी ने
verses.wordMeaning: He shbuld neither see nor touch nor give unclean varieties of cooked rice that are rotten. If the man does not have
verses.commentary: Sense: He shbuld neither see nor touch nor give unclean varieties of cooked rice that are rotten. If the man does not have

verses.sanskrit: लभते च सुशर्माणि इह चामुत्र चोभयोः । दद्यादेवं पितृभ्यास्तु नित्यमेव ह्यतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: labhate ca suśarmāṇi iha cāmutra cobhayoḥ / dadyādevaṃ pitṛbhyāstu nityameva hyatandritaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Gobhila Snap 1.21.
verses.hindi: बारण शेल के स्वामी और एकाग्र ध्वान में तल्लोन भगवान् शिव का तथा कलियुग के दोषों का हनन करने वाली देवी कामाक्षी का अचंन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Gobhila Snap 1.21.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Gobhila Snap 1.21.

verses.sanskrit: दीपं पितृभ्यः प्रयतः सदा यस्तु प्रयच्छति । गतिं चाप्रतिमं चक्षुस्तस्मात्सलभते शुभम्
verses.transliteration: dīpaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ prayataḥ sadā yastu prayacchati / gatiṃ cāpratimaṃ cakṣustasmātsalabhate śubham
verses.translation: If a person always performs the Sraddha strictly in accordance with this injunction, the grandfathers (manes) shall bestow on him whatever he desires in his mind.
verses.wordMeaning: If a person always performs the Sraddha strictly in accordance with this injunction, the grandfathers (manes) shall bestow on him whatever he desires in his mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person always performs the Sraddha strictly in accordance with this injunction, the grandfathers (manes) shall bestow on him whatever he desires in his mind.

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा यशसा चैव कान्त्या चापि बलेन च । भुवि प्रकाशो भवति ब्राजते च त्रिविष्टपे
verses.transliteration: tejasā yaśasā caiva kāntyā cāpi balena ca / bhuvi prakāśo bhavati brājate ca triviṣṭape
verses.translation: The following should always be avoided in the Sraddlia ceremonies: Sudras, milk of Avi (a variety of sheep), the varieties of grass named Balbaja, Virana and Otuvala,
verses.wordMeaning: The following should always be avoided in the Sraddlia ceremonies: Sudras, milk of Avi (a variety of sheep), the varieties of grass named Balbaja, Virana and Otuvala,
verses.commentary: Sense: The following should always be avoided in the Sraddlia ceremonies: Sudras, milk of Avi (a variety of sheep), the varieties of grass named Balbaja, Virana and Otuvala,

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोभिः परिवृतो विमानाग्रे च मोदते । गन्धपुष्पैश्च धूपैश्व जपाहुतिभिरेव च
verses.transliteration: apsarobhiḥ parivṛto vimānāgre ca modate / gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśva japāhutibhireva ca
verses.translation: For the fulfilment of the holy rite one should perform Homa. For Homa the sacred fire Daksinagni should be used scrupulously. For other purposes the ordinary lire can
verses.wordMeaning: For the fulfilment of the holy rite one should perform Homa. For Homa the sacred fire Daksinagni should be used scrupulously. For other purposes the ordinary lire can
verses.commentary: Sense: For the fulfilment of the holy rite one should perform Homa. For Homa the sacred fire Daksinagni should be used scrupulously. For other purposes the ordinary lire can

verses.sanskrit: फलमूलनमस्कारैः पितॄणां प्रयतः शुचिः । पूजां कृत्वा द्विजान्पश्चात्पूजयेदन्नसंपदा
verses.transliteration: phalamūlanamaskāraiḥ pitṝṇāṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ / pūjāṃ kṛtvā dvijānpaścātpūjayedannasaṃpadā
verses.translation: The offering should always be made to Agni in the south, to Soma in the north and to Vaivasvata (Yama) in between the two.
verses.wordMeaning: The offering should always be made to Agni in the south, to Soma in the north and to Vaivasvata (Yama) in between the two.
verses.commentary: Sense: The offering should always be made to Agni in the south, to Soma in the north and to Vaivasvata (Yama) in between the two.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकालेषु नियतं वायुभूताः पितामहाः । आविशन्ति द्विजाञ्छ्रेष्ठांस्तस्मादेतद्ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration: śrāddhakāleṣu niyataṃ vāyubhūtāḥ pitāmahāḥ / āviśanti dvijāñchreṣṭhāṃstasmādetadbravīmi te
verses.translation: For the fulfilment of the holy rite, one should perform Homa in the sacred fire that has plenty of ghee and fuel, that is made to blaze, well in particular, that has no smoke and that has tongues of flame shooting up all round.
verses.wordMeaning: For the fulfilment of the holy rite, one should perform Homa in the sacred fire that has plenty of ghee and fuel, that is made to blaze, well in particular, that has no smoke and that has tongues of flame shooting up all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the fulfilment of the holy rite, one should perform Homa in the sacred fire that has plenty of ghee and fuel, that is made to blaze, well in particular, that has no smoke and that has tongues of flame shooting up all round.

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्रै रत्नप्रदानैश्च भक्ष्यैः पेयैस्तथैव च । गोभिरश्वैस्तथा ग्रामैः पूजयेद्द्विजसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: vastrai ratnapradānaiśca bhakṣyaiḥ peyaistathaiva ca / gobhiraśvaistathā grāmaiḥ pūjayeddvijasattamān
verses.translation: If the Yajamana (the sponsor of Sraddha) performs Homa in the fire that is not blazing well or that has not been kindled well, he will become blind here and hereafter. Indeed, this has been heard by us.
verses.wordMeaning: If the Yajamana (the sponsor of Sraddha) performs Homa in the fire that is not blazing well or that has not been kindled well, he will become blind here and hereafter. Indeed, this has been heard by us.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the Yajamana (the sponsor of Sraddha) performs Homa in the fire that is not blazing well or that has not been kindled well, he will become blind here and hereafter. Indeed, this has been heard by us.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति पितरः प्रीताः पूजितेषु द्विजातिषु । तस्माद्यत्नेन विधिवत्पूजयेत द्विजान्सदा
verses.transliteration: bhavanti pitaraḥ prītāḥ pūjiteṣu dvijātiṣu / tasmādyatnena vidhivatpūjayeta dvijānsadā
verses.translation: That fire ceases to yield benefit which has only very little fuel, which has no flames shooting up all round, which is very unpleasant to the eye or which has flames and smoke curling anticlockwise.
verses.hindi: लोकों के कारण से दया से आद्र (पसीजे हुए हृदय वाले)-परमधी- मान् ओर वारम्वार चिन्तन करने वाले उन अगस्त्य मुनि के अधिक समय तक किये हुए तप से भगवान् असन्न हो गये थे ।८। हयग्रोव के शरीर को
verses.wordMeaning: That fire ceases to yield benefit which has only very little fuel, which has no flames shooting up all round, which is very unpleasant to the eye or which has flames and smoke curling anticlockwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: That fire ceases to yield benefit which has only very little fuel, which has no flames shooting up all round, which is very unpleasant to the eye or which has flames and smoke curling anticlockwise.

verses.sanskrit: सव्योत्तराभ्यां पाणिभ्यां कुर्यादुल्लेखनं द्विजाः । प्रोक्षणं च ततः कुर्याच्छ्राद्धकर्मण्यतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kuryādullekhanaṃ dvijāḥ / prokṣaṇaṃ ca tataḥ kuryācchrāddhakarmaṇyatandritaḥ
verses.translation: (The devotee) obtains the perpetual honour and Teverence from groups of men and women. The Pitrs and the sacred fires should be worshipped by him for an everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: बलय और पुस्तक के धारण करने से समुज्ञ्वल बाहुओं वाली तथा अपने देह से समुत्पन्न प्रभा से सम्पूर्ण जगतु जगत् को पूरित करने वाली अपने अपरिमित तेज से मुनि के आगे प्रादुर्भूत हुई थो ।९-१०। उनका दर्शन प्राप्त करके आनन्द से भरे हुए ऋषि ने उनको वारम्वार प्रणाम किया था
verses.wordMeaning: (The devotee) obtains the perpetual honour and Teverence from groups of men and women. The Pitrs and the sacred fires should be worshipped by him for an everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The devotee) obtains the perpetual honour and Teverence from groups of men and women. The Pitrs and the sacred fires should be worshipped by him for an everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: दर्भान्पिण्डांस्तथा भक्ष्यान्पुष्पाणि विविधानि च । गन्धदानमलङ्कारमेकैकं निर्वपेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: darbhānpiṇḍāṃstathā bhakṣyānpuṣpāṇi vividhāni ca / gandhadānamalaṅkāramekaikaṃ nirvaped budhaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: और विनय से अवनत होकर जगत् के पति को भली भांति स्तुति की थी ।११। इसके अनन्तर जगन्नाथ प्रभ, ने कहा था-हे भूसुरों में श्रेष्ठ! मैं आपके तप से सन्तुष्ट हो गया हूं आप किसी भी वरदान का वरण करो । तुम्हारा कल्याण होगा ।१२! जय भगवान् के द्वारा इस रीति से पूछा गया
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पेषयित्वाञ्जनं सम्यग्विश्वेषामुत्तरोत्तरम् । अभ्यङ्गं दर्भविञ्जूलैस्त्रिभिः कुर्याद्यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: peṣayitvāñjanaṃ samyagviśveṣāmuttarottaram / abhyaṅgaṃ darbhaviñjūlaistribhiḥ kuryādyathāvidhi
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: तो श्रेष्ठ मुनि ने कहा--है भगवन् ! यदि परम सन्तुष्ट है तो यही मुझे बतलाइए कि ये पामर जन्तुगण किस उपाय से मुक्त होगे। जब इस रीति से द्विज के द्वारा पूछा गया था तो देवों के भा देव जतादंत ने कहा था--
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अपसव्यं वितृभयश्च दद्यादञ्जनमुत्तमम् । निपात्य जानु सर्वेषां वस्त्रार्थं सूत्रमेव वा
verses.transliteration: apasavyaṃ vitṛbhayaśca dadyādañjanamuttamam / nipātya jānu sarveṣāṃ vastrārthaṃ sūtrameva vā
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: अयमेव कृतः प्रश्नो ब्रह्मणा तु ततः परम्
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: खण्डनं प्रोक्षणं चैव तथैवोल्लेखनं द्विजः । सकृद्देवपितॄणां स्यात्पितॄणां त्रिभिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: khaṇḍanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva tathaivollekhanaṃ dvijaḥ / sakṛddevapitṝṇāṃ syātpitṝṇāṃ tribhirucyate
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: एकं पवित्रं हस्तेन पितॄनसर्वान्सकृत्सकृत् । चैलमन्त्रेण पिण्डेभ्यो दत्त्वादर्शाञ्जिने हि तम्
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ pavitraṃ hastena pitṝnasarvānsakṛtsakṛt / cailamantreṇa piṇḍebhyo dattvādarśāñjine hi tam
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: सदा सर्पिस्तिलैर्युक्तांस्त्रीन्पिण्डान्निर्वपेद्भुवि । जानु कृत्वा तथा सव्यं भूमौ पितृपरायणः
verses.transliteration: sadā sarpistilairyuktāṃstrīnpiṇḍānnirvapedbhuvi / jānu kṛtvā tathā savyaṃ bhūmau pitṛparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄन्पितामहांश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहान् । आहूय च पितॄन्प्राञ्चः पितृतीर्थेन यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pitṝnpitāmahāṃścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahān / āhūya ca pitṝnprāñcaḥ pitṛtīrthena yatnataḥ

verses.hindi: एवं भूतस्य मे ब्रह्म स्त्रिजगद्र् पधारिणः
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डान्परिक्षिपेत्सम्यगपसव्यमतन्द्रितः । अन्नाद्यैरेव मुख्यैश्चभक्ष्यैश्चैव पृथग्विधैः
verses.transliteration: piṇḍānparikṣipetsamyagapasavyamatandritaḥ / annādyaireva mukhyaiścabhakṣyaiścaiva pṛthagvidhaiḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पृथङ्मातामहानां तु केचिदिच्छन्ति मानवाः । त्रीन्पिण्डानानुपूर्व्येण सांगुष्ठान्पुष्टिवर्द्धनान्
verses.transliteration: pṛthaṅmātāmahānāṃ tu kecidicchanti mānavāḥ / trīnpiṇḍānānupūrvyeṇa sāṃguṣṭhānpuṣṭivarddhanān
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: यह ही प्रश्‍न बहुत पहिले शिवजी ने मुझसे किया था । इसके पीछे
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: जान्वन्तराभ्यां यत्नेन पिण्डान्दद्याद्यथाक्रमम् । सव्योत्तराभ्यां पाणिभ्यां धारार्थं मन्त्रमुच्चरन्
verses.transliteration: jānvantarābhyāṃ yatnena piṇḍāndadyādyathākramam / savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ dhārārthaṃ mantramuccaran
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: ऐसा ही प्रश्‍न ब्रह्माजी ने भो किया था ।१५। इसके अनन्तर दुर्वासा मुनि ने यह प्रश्‍न किया था । इसके बाद में अब आपने भी यह् प्रश्‍न मुझ से किया
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वः पितरः शोषायेति सर्वमतन्द्रितः । दक्षिणस्यां तु पाणिभ्यां प्रथमं पिण्डमुत्सृजेत्
verses.transliteration: namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śoṣāyeti sarvamatandritaḥ / dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu pāṇibhyāṃ prathamaṃ piṇḍamutsṛjet
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वः पितरः सौम्यः पठन्नेवमतन्द्रितः । सव्योत्तराभ्यां पाणिभ्यां धर्मेर्ऽधं समतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: namo vaḥ pitaraḥ saumyaḥ paṭhannevamatandritaḥ / savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ dharmer'dhaṃ samatandritaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: है ॥१६) यह प्रश्न जो आपने किया है इसका कारण यही है कि आप महान् आत्मा बाले हैं और समस्त प्राणियों के गुरु के ही समान है । लोकों में मेरा उपदेश ही परम प्रसिद्ध बर है ।१० मैं समस्त प्राणियों में आदि हूँ और में हो आदि कर्ता प्रभु हूं ओं स्वयं ही हुआ हू । इस सोक की सृष्टि-स्थिति
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: उलूखलस्य लेखायामुदपात्रावसेचनम् । क्षौमं सूत्रं नवं दद्याच्छाणं कार्पासकं तथा
verses.transliteration: ulūkhalasya lekhāyāmudapātrāvasecanam / kṣaumaṃ sūtraṃ navaṃ dadyācchāṇaṃ kārpāsakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: और संहार के करने वाला भी सबका मैं ही हू ।१८। मैं ही तीन मूततियां वाला हू' अर्थात् बह्मा-विष्णु ओर महादेव--ये तीन मूत्तियां मेरी ही हैं जो कि मैं गुणों से पर-मुणो से रहित और गुणों का समाश्रय भी हू
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पत्रोर्णं पट्टसूत्रं च कौशेयं परिवर्जयेत् । वर्जयेद्यक्षणं यज्ञे यद्यप्यहतवस्त्रजाम्
verses.transliteration: patrorṇaṃ paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kauśeyaṃ parivarjayet / varjayedyakṣaṇaṃ yajñe yadyapyahatavastrajām
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: मैं समस्त भूतों को आत्मा हू ओर में अपनो ही इच्छा से बिहार करने बाला हूँ । है ब्रह्मन् ! इस प्रकार के जगत् में सोन रूप धारण करने बाला है ।२०। मेरा ही रूप दो प्रकार का है एक पुरुष और दूसरा प्रधान मोरा जो प्रधान नामक रूप है वह सब (सत्व-रज-तम) गुणों के ही स्वरूप वाला
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: न प्रीणन्ति तथैतानि दातु श्चाप्यहितं भवेत् । श्रेष्ठमाहुस्त्रिककुदमञ्जनं नित्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: na prīṇanti tathaitāni dātu ścāpyahitaṃ bhavet / śreṣṭhamāhustrikakudamañjanaṃ nityameva ca
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णेभ्यश्च तेलैस्तैलं यत्नात्सुपरिरक्षितम् । चन्दनागुरुणी चोभे तमालोशीरपद्मकम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇebhyaśca telaistailaṃ yatnātsuparirakṣitam / candanāguruṇī cobhe tamālośīrapadmakam
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: धूपश्च गुग्गलः श्रेष्टस्तुरुष्कः श्वेत एव च । शुक्लाः सुमनसः श्रेष्ठास्तथा पद्मोत्पलानि च
verses.transliteration: dhūpaśca guggalaḥ śreṣṭasturuṣkaḥ śveta eva ca / śuklāḥ sumanasaḥ śreṣṭhāstathā padmotpalāni ca
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धरूपोपपन्नानि चारण्यानि च कृत्स्नशः । तथा हि सुमना नाडीरूपिकास्मकुरण्डिका
verses.transliteration: gandharūpopapannāni cāraṇyāni ca kṛtsnaśaḥ / tathā hi sumanā nāḍīrūpikāsmakuraṇḍikā
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पाणि वर्जनीयानि श्राद्धकर्मणि नित्यशः । यथा गन्धादपेतानि चोग्रगन्धानि यानि च
verses.transliteration: puṣpāṇi varjanīyāni śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ / yathā gandhādapetāni cogragandhāni yāni ca
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: दूसरा मेरा स्वरूप सब गुणों से परे है ओर पर से भो अधिक पर हैं तथा महान है। इस रोति से उन दोंनों के स्वरूप का ज्ञान प्राप्त करके वे दोनों ही मुक्त हो जाते हैं ।२२। चिरकाल पर्यन्त कियें हुए तप-यम और
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जनीयानि पुष्पाणि पुष्टिमन्विच्चता सदा । द्विजातयो यथोद्दिष्टा नियताः स्युरुदङ्मुखाः
verses.transliteration: varjanīyāni puṣpāṇi puṣṭimanviccatā sadā / dvijātayo yathoddiṣṭā niyatāḥ syurudaṅmukhāḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: नियम तथा त्याग से दुष्कर्मों के विनाश होते के अन्त में बहुत ही शोध मुक्ति प्राप्ति हो जाया करती है ।२३। जो रूप जिस गुण से युक्‍त होता है उन गुणों को एकता से प्राप्त किया जाता है । अन्य समस्त जगत् के स्वपव वाला है जो कर्म--भोग और पराक्रम से संयुत होता है ।२४। जो कर्मों के द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेद्यजमानस्तु विधिवद्यक्षिणामुखः । तेषामभिमुखो दद्याद्दर्भत्पिण्डांश्च यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pūjayedyajamānastu vidhivadyakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / teṣāmabhimukho dadyāddarbhatpiṇḍāṃśca yatnataḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त किया जाता है वह कर्मो के त्याग से भो पाया जाया करता है। हे तपस्विन् ! सभी के द्वारा उन दोनों का त्याग करना बड़ा हो कठिन होता है ॥२५ सत् ओर असत कर्मों को प्रत्यक्ष रूप से जान लेना निविध्न और सुगम होता है ।२६। आत्मा में स्थित गुण से जो सत् हो या असत् हो ।
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना साक्षादर्चिताः स्युः पितामहाः । हरिता वै स पिञ्जालाः पुष्टाः स्निग्धाः समाहिताः
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā sākṣādarcitāḥ syuḥ pitāmahāḥ / haritā vai sa piñjālāḥ puṣṭāḥ snigdhāḥ samāhitāḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: आत्मा के साथ एकता से जो भी ज्ञान है वह समस्त सिद्धियों के देने बाला होता है ।२७। तीन वरणो से जो होन हैं और महान् पापी हैं ऐसे मनुष्यों को भो जिसके केवल ध्यान से हो दुष्कृत भी सुकृत के स्वरूप में परिणत हो जाया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: रत्निमात्राः प्रमाणेन वितृतीर्थेन संस्मृताः । उपमूले तथा नीला विष्टरार्थं कुशोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: ratnimātrāḥ pramāṇena vitṛtīrthena saṃsmṛtāḥ / upamūle tathā nīlā viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśottamāḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: तथा श्यामाकनीवारा दूर्वा च समुदाहृता । पूर्वं कीर्त्तिमतां श्रेष्ठो बभूवाश्वः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tathā śyāmākanīvārā dūrvā ca samudāhṛtā / pūrvaṃ kīrttimatāṃ śreṣṭho babhūvāśvaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य बाला निपतिता भूमौ काशत्वामागताः । तस्माद्देयाः सदा काशाः श्राद्धकर्मसु पूजिताः
verses.transliteration: tasya bālā nipatitā bhūmau kāśatvāmāgatāḥ / tasmāddeyāḥ sadā kāśāḥ śrāddhakarmasu pūjitāḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डनिर्वपणं तेषु कर्त्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता । प्रजाः पुष्टिद्युतिप्रज्ञाकीर्त्तिकान्तिसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ teṣu karttavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā / prajāḥ puṣṭidyutiprajñākīrttikāntisamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति रुचिरा नित्यं विपाप्मानो ऽघवर्जिताः । सकृदेवास्तरेद्यर्भान्पिण्डार्थे दक्षिणामुखः
verses.transliteration: bhavanti rucirā nityaṃ vipāpmāno 'ghavarjitāḥ / sakṛdevāstaredyarbhānpiṇḍārthe dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्दक्षिणाग्रान्नियतो विधि चाप्यत्र वक्ष्यति । न दीनो नापि वा क्रुद्धो न चैवान्यमना नरः । एकत्र चाधाय मनः श्राद्धं कुर्यात्समाहितः
verses.transliteration: prāgdakṣiṇāgrānniyato vidhi cāpyatra vakṣyati / na dīno nāpi vā kruddho na caivānyamanā naraḥ / ekatra cādhāya manaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: निहन्मि सर्वं यदमेध्यवद्भवेद्धतश्च सर्वे सुरदानवा मया । रक्षांसि यक्षाः सपिशाचसंघा हता मया यातुधानाश्च सर्वे
verses.transliteration: nihanmi sarvaṃ yadamedhyavadbhaveddhataśca sarve suradānavā mayā / rakṣāṃsi yakṣāḥ sapiśācasaṃghā hatā mayā yātudhānāśca sarve
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: एतेन मन्त्रेण तु संयतात्मा तां वै वेदिं सकृदुल्लिख्य धीरः । शिवां हि बुद्धिं ध्रुवमिच्छमानः क्षिपेद्द्विचातिर्दिशमुत्तरां गतः
verses.transliteration: etena mantreṇa tu saṃyatātmā tāṃ vai vediṃ sakṛdullikhya dhīraḥ / śivāṃ hi buddhiṃ dhruvamicchamānaḥ kṣipeddvicātirdiśamuttarāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: जो मानव पराशक्ति का अर्चेन किया करते हैं चाहे वे विधि के साय करें या विना हो विजि से करें वे संसारी नहीं होते हैं अर्थात् बारम्बार जीवन--मरण की घोर यातनाए सहन करने वाले नहों रहते हैं और निश्चय ही वे मुक्त हो जाया करते हैं- इसमें लेशमात्र भी जिसको आरा-
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
