verses.sanskrit: एवं पित्र्यं दृष्टमन्त्रं हि यस्यतस्यासुरा वर्जयन्तीह सर्वे । यस्मिन्देशे पठ्यते मन्त्र एष तं वै देशं राक्षसा वर्जयन्ति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pitryaṃ dṛṣṭamantraṃ hi yasyatasyāsurā varjayantīha sarve / yasmindeśe paṭhyate mantra eṣa taṃ vai deśaṃ rākṣasā varjayanti
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: धता करके ओर ध्यान तथा योग के बल से अचंना करके ईश्वर भी जो सभी सिद्धों के स्वामी हैं अर्धनारीश्वर हो गये थे ।२६-३०। अन्य देव भी जिनमें अब्ज प्रमुख हैं उसके ध्यान के ही वैभव से ही सिद्ध हो गये हैं। इस कारण से यह सिद्ध होता है कि समस्त लोगों को त्रिपुरदेव का ही आराधन
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नप्रकारानशुचीनसाधून्संवीक्षते नो स्पृशंश्वापि दद्यात् । पवित्रपाणिश्च भवेन्न वा हि यः पुमान्न कार्यस्य फलं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: annaprakārānaśucīnasādhūnsaṃvīkṣate no spṛśaṃśvāpi dadyāt / pavitrapāṇiśca bhavenna vā hi yaḥ pumānna kāryasya phalaṃ samaśnute
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: मुख्य है । इसके विना कुछ भी नहीं होता है ।३१। सुखों का उपभोग और मोक्ष दोनों ही एक साथ किसी भी प्रकार से नहीं प्राप्त हुआ करते हैं। उनमें ही मन के लगाने वाला--उसमें अपने प्राणों को संलग्न रखने वाला- उसका ही यजन करने वाला तथा अपनी इच्छा को उसमें ही केन्द्रित करने
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना नित्यं श्राद्धं कुर्याद्धि यः सदा । मनसा काङ्क्षते यद्यत्तत्तद्यद्युः पितमहाः
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā nityaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāddhi yaḥ sadā / manasā kāṅkṣate yadyattattadyadyuḥ pitamahāḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: वाला मालव तादात्म्य भाव से अर्थात् उसमें ही सबंतोभाव से एकता धारण करने वाला पुरुष कर्मों को करता हुआ मुक्ति को प्राप्त कर लेगा। यही रहस्य मैने सबके हित की कामना से कह दिया है ।३२-३३। है मुनियों परम श्रेष्ठ ! मैं आपके तप से परम सन्तुष्ट हो गया हूँ । इसी से मैंने आपको
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पितरो हृष्टमनसो रक्षांसि विमनांसि च । भवन्त्येवं कृते श्राद्धे नित्यमेव प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pitaro hṛṣṭamanaso rakṣāṃsi vimanāṃsi ca / bhavantyevaṃ kṛte śrāddhe nityameva prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: यह बतला दिया है। देवगण-मुनिमष्डल-सिद्धसमुदाय--मनुष्य तथा दूसरे लोग आपके मुख कमल से भी पर से भो पर सिद्धि को प्राप्त कर लेवें
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्राः श्राद्धेष्वविक्षीरं बल्वजा उपलास्तथा । विरणाश्चोतुवालाश्च लड्वा वर्ज्याश्च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: śūdrāḥ śrāddheṣvavikṣīraṃ balvajā upalāstathā / viraṇāścotuvālāśca laḍvā varjyāśca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: भगवान् हयग्रीव शारङ्गी के इस ववन का श्रवण करके अगस्त्य मुनि ने उनको प्रणिपात किया था और फिर मधुसूदन प्रभु से कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीन्ययज्ञानि तृणानि परिवर्जयेत् । अञ्जनाभ्यजनं गन्धान्सूत्रप्रणयनं तथा
verses.transliteration: evamādīnyayajñāni tṛṇāni parivarjayet / añjanābhyajanaṃ gandhānsūtrapraṇayanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: भगवन्कीहर्श रूपं भवता यत्पुरोदितप् । किविहारं किप्रभावमेतन्मे वक्तुमहंसि
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: काशेः पुनर्भवैः कार्यमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । काशाः पुनर्भवा ये च बर्हिणो ह्युपबर्हिणः
verses.transliteration: kāśeḥ punarbhavaiḥ kāryamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / kāśāḥ punarbhavā ye ca barhiṇo hyupabarhiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: एषोंऽशभूतो देवर्षे हयग्रीवो ममापरः । श्रोतुमिच्छसि यद्यत्त्व तत्सवं वक्तुमहुंति
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते पितरो देवा देवाश्च पितरः पुनः । पुष्पगन्धविभूषाणामेष मन्त्र उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: ityete pitaro devā devāśca pitaraḥ punaḥ / puṣpagandhavibhūṣāṇāmeṣa mantra udāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: आहृत्य दक्षिणाग्निं तु होमार्थं वै प्रयत्नतः । अन्यार्थे लौकिकं वापि जुहुयात्कर्मसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: āhṛtya dakṣiṇāgniṃ tu homārthaṃ vai prayatnataḥ / anyārthe laukikaṃ vāpi juhuyātkarmasiddhaye
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: आप मुझको बतलाइए ।३६। हयग्रीव जी ने कहा--है देवष : यह अशभूत मेरा अपर हयग्रीव है। आप जो-जो भी श्रवण करना चाहते हैं वही यह कहने के योग्य होता है । जगन्नाथ प्रभु इतना ही तपोधन हयग्रीव को आदेश देकर अगरत्य मुनि के ही आगे अन्तहित हो गये थे ।३७-३५। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्विधाय समिधस्ततो दीप्तो विधीयते । समाहितेन मनसा प्रणीयाग्निं समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: antarvidhāya samidhastato dīpto vidhīyate / samāhitena manasā praṇīyāgniṃ samantataḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: पश्चात् अगस्त्य मुनि बड़े ही विस्मित हुए और उनके रोम-रोम प्रसन्नता से उद्गत हो गये थे। फिर वे तप के ही मन वाले मुनि हयग्रीव मुनि के साथ अपने आश्रम में प्राप्त हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नये कव्यवाहाय स्वधा अङ्गिरसे नमः । सोमाय वै पितृमते स्वधा अङ्गिरसे पुनः
verses.transliteration: agnaye kavyavāhāya svadhā aṅgirase namaḥ / somāya vai pitṛmate svadhā aṅgirase punaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: भगवन्सवंधर्मज्ञ सर्वसिद्धान्तवित्तम । लोकाभ्युदयहेतुहि दर्शनं हि भवादृशाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: यमाय वैवस्वतये स्वधानम इति ध्रुवम् । इत्येते होममन्त्रास्तु त्रयाणामनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: yamāya vaivasvataye svadhānama iti dhruvam / ityete homamantrāstu trayāṇāmanupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: आविभविं महादेव्यास्तस्या रूपान्तराणि च । विहाराश्चेव मुख्या ये तान्नो विस्तरतो बद
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणेनाग्नये नित्यं सोमायोत्तरतस्तथा । एतयोरन्तरे नित्यं जुहुयाद्वै विवस्वते
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇenāgnaye nityaṃ somāyottaratastathā / etayorantare nityaṃ juhuyādvai vivasvate
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: उपहारः स्वधाकारस्तथैवोल्लेखनं च यत् । होमजप्ये नमस्कारः प्रोक्षणं च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: upahāraḥ svadhākārastathaivollekhanaṃ ca yat / homajapye namaskāraḥ prokṣaṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर उनको परम अद्भुत आसन पर बिठाकर फिर हयानन के समीप में उपस्थित होकर आगस्त्य जी ने यह वाक्य कहा था ।
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: बहुहव्येन्धने चाग्नौ सुसमिद्धे तथैव च । अञ्जनाब्यञ्जनं चैव पिण्डनिर्वपणं तथा
verses.transliteration: bahuhavyendhane cāgnau susamiddhe tathaiva ca / añjanābyañjanaṃ caiva piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधफलं चैतत्समिद्धे यत्कृतं द्विजैः । क्रिया सर्वा यथोद्दिष्टाः प्रयत्नेन समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhaphalaṃ caitatsamiddhe yatkṛtaṃ dvijaiḥ / kriyā sarvā yathoddiṣṭāḥ prayatnena samācaret
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: ।१॥ है भगवन् ! आप तो समी थमो के ज्ञाता हैं ओर समस्त सिद्धान्तों के परम श्रेष्ठ जानने वाले हैं। आप सरीखे महापुरुषों का दशन तो लोकों के अभ्युदय का ही हेतु हुआ करता है।२। महादेवी का आविर्भाव और उनके अस्य स्वरूप तथा मुख्य बिहार जो भी हैं उनको अब मेरे समक्ष में विस्तार
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: बहुहव्येन्धने चाग्नौ सुसमिद्धे विशेषतः । विधूमे लेलिहाने च होतव्यं कर्मसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: bahuhavyendhane cāgnau susamiddhe viśeṣataḥ / vidhūme lelihāne ca hotavyaṃ karmasiddhaye
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: से वर्णन कीजिए ।३। श्री हयग्रीवजी ने कहा-सत् ओर असत् कर्मों के रूप बाली जो पूणं धारा है वह अनादि है । ध्यान के हो अङ्गों वाली-विद्या ही जिसका शरीर है और उसका हृदय ही निवास का स्थल है वह ध्यान के ही द्वारा देखने के योग्य है । बहुत काल पर्यन्त अनुष्ठान के गौरव से जव
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रबुद्धे समिद्धे वा जुहुयाद्यो हुताशने । यजमानो भवे दन्धः सो ऽमुत्रेति हि नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: aprabuddhe samiddhe vā juhuyādyo hutāśane / yajamāno bhave dandhaḥ so 'mutreti hi naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: अपनी आत्मा के साय उसकी एकता हो जाती है तभी वह प्रकट हुआ करती है ।४-४। आदि कास में ब्रह्माजी के ध्यान के योग से वह शक्ति प्रादुभू'त हुई थो । उसका प्रकृति-यह नाम विख्यात हुआ था जो देवों के इष्ट की सिद्धि देने वाली थी ।६। उसका दूसरा स्वरूप उस समय में उद्भूत
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पेन्धनो वा रूक्षो ऽग्निर्वस्फुलिङ्गश्च सर्वशः । ज्वालाधूमापसव्यश्च स तु वह्निरसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: alpendhano vā rūkṣo 'gnirvasphuliṅgaśca sarvaśaḥ / jvālādhūmāpasavyaśca sa tu vahnirasiddhaye
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: हुआ था जिस समय में देवों और असुरों के द्वारा अमृत के प्राप्त करने के लिये समुद्र का मन्थन करना प्रवृत्त हुमा था। जो भगवान् शिव को भी मोह उत्पन्न करने बाला था जो कि वाशी ओर मन के भी अगोचर हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गन्धश्चैव नीलश्च कृष्णश्चैव विशेषतः । भूमिं वगाहते यत्र तत्र विद्यात्पराभवत्
verses.transliteration: durgandhaścaiva nīlaśca kṛṣṇaścaiva viśeṣataḥ / bhūmiṃ vagāhate yatra tatra vidyātparābhavat
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चिष्मान् पिण्डितशिखः सर्प्पिकाञ्जनसन्निभः । स्निग्धः प्रदक्षिणश्चैव वह्निः स्यात्कार्यसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: arciṣmān piṇḍitaśikhaḥ sarppikāñjanasannibhaḥ / snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇaścaiva vahniḥ syātkāryasiddhaye
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: नरनारीगणेभ्यश्च पूजां प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीम् । अक्षयं पूजितास्तेन भवन्ति पितरो ऽग्नयः
verses.transliteration: naranārīgaṇebhyaśca pūjāṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīm / akṣayaṃ pūjitāstena bhavanti pitaro 'gnayaḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: कंलासशिखराकारं गज द्रमधिर्ह्य सः । चचाराखिललोकेषु पूज्यमानोऽखिलँरपि ।
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: बिल्वोदुंबरपत्राणि फलानि समिधस्तथा । श्राद्धे महापवित्राणि मेध्यानि च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: bilvoduṃbarapatrāṇi phalāni samidhastathā / śrāddhe mahāpavitrāṇi medhyāni ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रं च द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शुद्धये जन्मकर्मणाम् । पात्रेषु फलमुद्दिष्टं यन्मया श्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: pavitraṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śuddhaye janmakarmaṇām / pātreṣu phalamuddiṣṭaṃ yanmayā śrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: जिसके दशन करने से ईश्वर जो सवंज्ञ हैं वे भो विमोहित हो गये थे । उन्होंने पाबंती जी को भी त्याग करके शीघ्रता से उसके द्वारा रुद्ध होकर रति का विस्तार किया था ।८। उसमें असुरों के भर्दन करने वाले एक शासक को उसने उत्पन्न किया था ।६। अगस्त्यजी ने कहा--शिव तो
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: तदेव कृत्स्नं विज्ञेयं समित्सु च यथाक्रमम् । कृत्वा समाहितं चित्तमाग्नेयं वै करोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tadeva kṛtsnaṃ vijñeyaṃ samitsu ca yathākramam / kṛtvā samāhitaṃ cittamāgneyaṃ vai karomyaham
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: समस्त प्राणियों के स्वामी हैं तया वशी और कामदेव को भो भस्मीभूत कर देने वाले हैं फिर वे कंसे देवो के द्वारा विमोहित हो गये ये और उन्होंने उसमें एक पुत्र को भी जन्म ग्रहण करा दिया था ?।१०। हयग्रीव ने कहा-- पहिले समय में अमर पुर का स्वामी विजय की श्रो तथा समृद्धि से समन्वित
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अनुज्ञातः कुरुष्वेति तथैव द्विजसत्तमैः । घृतमादाय पात्रे च जुहुयाद्धव्यवाहने
verses.transliteration: anujñātaḥ kuruṣveti tathaiva dvijasattamaiḥ / ghṛtamādāya pātre ca juhuyāddhavyavāhane
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: था और देव-असुर और मनुष्यों के समुदाय से युक्त त्रेलोक्य का पालन हिया करता था ।११। वह कंलास के शिखर के समान समुच्च आकार वाले गजेन्द्र पर समारूढ़ होकर सभी लोकों में विचरण करने लग गया था ओर सवके द्वारा उसकी पूजा की जाती थी । भवानी को पति ने उसको प्रमत्त
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पलाशप्लक्षन्यग्रोधप्लक्षाश्वत्थविकङ्कताः । उदुंबरस्तथाबिल्वश्चन्दनो यज्ञियाश्च ये
verses.transliteration: palāśaplakṣanyagrodhaplakṣāśvatthavikaṅkatāḥ / uduṃbarastathābilvaścandano yajñiyāśca ye
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: जानकर जो कि अविनाशी हैं उसके मद का हनन करने की इच्छा की थी । फिर दुर्वासा मुनि को बुलाकर उसके समीप में भेजा था । जो खण्ड मृगचर्म के धारण करने वाले ये और दण्डधारी ये। उनका सव शरीर धूल से मदीला हो रहा था । उनका स्वरूप उन्मत्त जैसा था । वे विद्याधरों के मार्ग
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: सरलो देवदारुश्च शालश्च कदिरस्तथा । समिदर्थे प्रशस्ताः स्युरेते वृक्षा विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: saralo devadāruśca śālaśca kadirastathā / samidarthe praśastāḥ syurete vṛkṣā viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: से गये ये ।१२-१३। इसी बोच में उस समय में कोई विद्याधर की अङ्ना वहाँ पर यहच्छा से उसके ही आगे समागत हो गयी थी । जिसकी आकृति
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: ग्राम्याः कण्टकिनश्चैव याज्ञिया ये च केचन । पूजिताः समिदर्थं ते पितॄणां वचनं यथा
verses.transliteration: grāmyāḥ kaṇṭakinaścaiva yājñiyā ye ca kecana / pūjitāḥ samidarthaṃ te pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ yathā
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: समिद्भिः षट्फलेयाभिर्जुहुयाद्यो हुताशनम् । फलं यत्कर्मणस्तस्य तन्मे निगदतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: samidbhiḥ ṣaṭphaleyābhirjuhuyādyo hutāśanam / phalaṃ yatkarmaṇastasya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं सर्वकामीयमश्वमेधफलं हि तत् । श्लेष्मान्तको नक्तमालः कपित्थः शाल्मलिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: akṣayaṃ sarvakāmīyamaśvamedhaphalaṃ hi tat / śleṣmāntako naktamālaḥ kapitthaḥ śālmalistathā
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: नीपो विभीतकश्चैव श्राद्धकर्मणि गर्हिताः । चिरबिल्वस्तथा कोलस्तिदुकः श्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: nīpo vibhītakaścaiva śrāddhakarmaṇi garhitāḥ / cirabilvastathā kolastidukaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: बल्वजः कोविदारश्च वर्जनीयाः समन्ततः । शकुनानां निवासांश्च वर्जयेत महीरुहान्
verses.transliteration: balvajaḥ kovidāraśca varjanīyāḥ samantataḥ / śakunānāṃ nivāsāṃśca varjayeta mahīruhān
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: कराभ्यां तत्समादाय कृतार्थोऽस्मीति सत्वरम् । दधौ स्वशिरसा भक्तघा तामुवाचातिहषितः
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यांश्चैवंविधान्सर्वान्नयज्ञीयांश्च वर्जयेत् । स्वधेति चैव मन्त्राणां पितॄणां वचनं यथा । स्वाहेति चैव देवानां यज्ञकर्मण्युदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: anyāṃścaivaṃvidhānsarvānnayajñīyāṃśca varjayet / svadheti caiva mantrāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ yathā / svāheti caiva devānāṃ yajñakarmaṇyudāhṛtam
verses.translation: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मादीनामलभ्यं यत्तल्लब्धं भाग्यतो मया । भक्तिरस्तु पदांभोजे देव्यास्तव समुज्ज्वला
verses.wordMeaning: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leaves, fruits and twigs of Bilva and Udumbara trees are very sacred, pure and worthy of being used in a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे समिद्वर्णन नामैकादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ ११॥ सूत उवाच देवाश्चपितरश्चैव अन्योन्यं नियताः स्मृताः । आथर्वणस्त्वेष विधिरित्युवाच बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe samidvarṇana nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 11// sūta uvāca devāścapitaraścaiva anyonyaṃ niyatāḥ smṛtāḥ / ātharvaṇastveṣa vidhirityuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: One should worship the Pitrs first and the Devas after. Indeed, even the Devas scrupulously worship the Pitrs at the outset.
verses.wordMeaning: One should worship the Pitrs first and the Devas after. Indeed, even the Devas scrupulously worship the Pitrs at the outset.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should worship the Pitrs first and the Devas after. Indeed, even the Devas scrupulously worship the Pitrs at the outset.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेत पितॄन्पूर्वं देवांश्च तदनन्तरम् । देवा अपि पितॄन्पूर्वमर्च्चयन्ति हि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pūjayeta pitṝnpūrvaṃ devāṃśca tadanantaram / devā api pitṝnpūrvamarccayanti hi yatnataḥ
verses.translation: They were well-renowned in the three worlds. They were bowed down to by all the worlds. All those noble-souled ones performed a great and severe penance.
verses.hindi: उस अंगना ने बहुत लम्बे समय तक तप करके परा अभ्विका को प्रसन्न कर लिया था ओर उस अम्बिका केद्वारा अपित एक माला को प्राप्त किया था तथा उससे बह परम सम्तुष्ट मन बाली सुप्रसन्न थो
verses.wordMeaning: They were well-renowned in the three worlds. They were bowed down to by all the worlds. All those noble-souled ones performed a great and severe penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were well-renowned in the three worlds. They were bowed down to by all the worlds. All those noble-souled ones performed a great and severe penance.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य दुहिता नाम्ना विश्वा नामेति विश्रुता । विश्वाख्यास्तु सुतास्तस्यां धर्मतो जज्ञिरे दश
verses.transliteration: dakṣasya duhitā nāmnā viśvā nāmeti viśrutā / viśvākhyāstu sutāstasyāṃ dharmato jajñire daśa
verses.translation: They performed their penance on the charming summit of the Himalaya, frequented by the groups of celestial sages. Delighted by their pure mind, the Pitrs then spoke ( to* them).
verses.hindi: उस हिरन के समीप सुन्दर नेत्रों वाली को देखकर मुनिश्रेष्ठ ने उससे कहा था-हे भीरु ! आप कहां जा रही हो ? और आपने यह कहाँ ते प्राप्त की है ? ।१६। उसने महात्माजी को प्रणाम करके नग्नता से कहा-हे ब्राह्मण ! बहुत समय तक तपश्चर्या करने से देवी ने प्रसन्न होकर मुझे यह दी है
verses.wordMeaning: They performed their penance on the charming summit of the Himalaya, frequented by the groups of celestial sages. Delighted by their pure mind, the Pitrs then spoke ( to* them).
verses.commentary: Sense: They performed their penance on the charming summit of the Himalaya, frequented by the groups of celestial sages. Delighted by their pure mind, the Pitrs then spoke ( to* them).

verses.sanskrit: प्रख्याता स्त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः । समस्तास्ते महात्मानश्चेरुरुग्रं महत्तपः
verses.transliteration: prakhyātā striṣu lokeṣu sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ / samastāste mahātmānaścerurugraṃ mahattapaḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed by Brahma, the creator of the Uni- verse, those Vi$ve-Devas collectively spoke to Brahma, the sanctifier (or the creator) of the world.
verses.hindi: उसके वचन को सुनकर फिर उसने उस उत्तम माला के वावत पूछा था । केवल पूछने ही से परम प्रसन्न हो गयी थो और फिर उस माला को उस महात्मा को दिया था ॥१८। उस महात्मा ने उसको अपने दोनों हाथों से लेकर यह कहते हुए कि मैं कृतार्थ हो गया उसको भक्तिभाव अपने शिर में
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by Brahma, the creator of the Uni- verse, those Vi$ve-Devas collectively spoke to Brahma, the sanctifier (or the creator) of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by Brahma, the creator of the Uni- verse, those Vi$ve-Devas collectively spoke to Brahma, the sanctifier (or the creator) of the world.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये देवर्षिगणसेविते । शुद्धेन मन्सा प्रीता ऊचुस्तान्पितरस्तदा
verses.transliteration: himavacchikhare ramye devarṣigaṇasevite / śuddhena mansā prītā ūcustānpitarastadā
verses.translation: "Let us too have a share in the Sraddha. This is the boon desired by us." Thereupon, Brahma who is honoured by the Devas, replied to them.
verses.hindi: धारण कर लिया था और फिर अति तषित होकर उससे कहा था ।१६। जो ब्रह्मादिक के लिए भी अलभ्य है वह आज मैंने भाग्य से प्राप्त की है। आपकी देवी के चरण कमलों में समुज्ज्वल भक्ति होवे ।२०। है सोम्ये ! परम शोभन आकार बाली आप हैं अब सुद्ध पूर्वक गमन करें । उस अंगना
verses.wordMeaning: "Let us too have a share in the Sraddha. This is the boon desired by us." Thereupon, Brahma who is honoured by the Devas, replied to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Let us too have a share in the Sraddha. This is the boon desired by us." Thereupon, Brahma who is honoured by the Devas, replied to them.

verses.sanskrit: वरं वृणीध्वं प्रीताः स्म कं कामं कखामहे । एवमुक्ते तु पितृभिस्तदा त्रैलोक्यभावनः
verses.transliteration: varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ prītāḥ sma kaṃ kāmaṃ kakhāmahe / evamukte tu pitṛbhistadā trailokyabhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: "The boon desired by you shall become so" (materi- alised). "So be it" said thePitis. It is hence that there is no doubt.
verses.hindi: ने भी मुनि को प्रणाम करके और चरणों में शिर रखकर वह जैसे आई थी प्रसन्न होती हुई चली गई थी
verses.wordMeaning: "The boon desired by you shall become so" (materi- alised). "So be it" said thePitis. It is hence that there is no doubt.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The boon desired by you shall become so" (materi- alised). "So be it" said thePitis. It is hence that there is no doubt.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच महातेजास्तपसा तैस्तु तोषितः । प्रीतो ऽस्मि तपसानेन कं कामं करवाणि वः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca mahātejāstapasā taistu toṣitaḥ / prīto 'smi tapasānena kaṃ kāmaṃ karavāṇi vaḥ
verses.translation: They attain the region pertaining to Brahma, a place that is free from fear, devoid of Rajas quality, griefless, free from pain and exhaustion and honoured by all the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: They attain the region pertaining to Brahma, a place that is free from fear, devoid of Rajas quality, griefless, free from pain and exhaustion and honoured by all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They attain the region pertaining to Brahma, a place that is free from fear, devoid of Rajas quality, griefless, free from pain and exhaustion and honoured by all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्तदा विश्वे ब्रह्मणा विश्वकर्मणा । ऊचुस्ते सहिताः सर्वे ब्रह्माणां लोकभावनम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktāstadā viśve brahmaṇā viśvakarmaṇā / ūcuste sahitāḥ sarve brahmāṇāṃ lokabhāvanam
verses.translation: These five Yajfias must be performed by a Sudra also but without the Mantras. If anyone takes food without performing them, he actually partakes of debts for ever.
verses.wordMeaning: These five Yajfias must be performed by a Sudra also but without the Mantras. If anyone takes food without performing them, he actually partakes of debts for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: These five Yajfias must be performed by a Sudra also but without the Mantras. If anyone takes food without performing them, he actually partakes of debts for ever.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे ऽस्माकं भवेदंशो ह्येष नः काङ्क्षितो वरः । प्रत्युवाच ततो ब्रह्मा तान्वै त्रिदशपूजितः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe 'smākaṃ bhavedaṃśo hyeṣa naḥ kāṅkṣito varaḥ / pratyuvāca tato brahmā tānvai tridaśapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective text) The cow's urine should be taken in a pot made of the hollow horn. A thread shall be placed in it and offered as oblation*. That rice ball shall be Naivedya (food offering) to one who is alive among the Pitis.
verses.hindi: स्वकरस्थां ततो मालां शक्राय प्रददौ मुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) The cow's urine should be taken in a pot made of the hollow horn. A thread shall be placed in it and offered as oblation*. That rice ball shall be Naivedya (food offering) to one who is alive among the Pitis.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) The cow's urine should be taken in a pot made of the hollow horn. A thread shall be placed in it and offered as oblation*. That rice ball shall be Naivedya (food offering) to one who is alive among the Pitis.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यत्येवमेवं तु काङ्क्षितो वो वरस्तु यः । पितृभिश्च तथेत्युक्तमेवमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyatyevamevaṃ tu kāṅkṣito vo varastu yaḥ / pitṛbhiśca tathetyuktamevametanna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: One should feed him with desired food, rice and other types of foodstuffs in accordance with the injunctions. Some wish Naivedya should be scrupulously offered even to a person who is alive.
verses.wordMeaning: One should feed him with desired food, rice and other types of foodstuffs in accordance with the injunctions. Some wish Naivedya should be scrupulously offered even to a person who is alive.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should feed him with desired food, rice and other types of foodstuffs in accordance with the injunctions. Some wish Naivedya should be scrupulously offered even to a person who is alive.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्माभिस्तु भोक्तव्यं यत्किं चिद्दृश्यते त्विह । अस्माकं कल्पिते श्राद्धे युष्मानप्राशनं हि वै
verses.transliteration: sahasmābhistu bhoktavyaṃ yatkiṃ ciddṛśyate tviha / asmākaṃ kalpite śrāddhe yuṣmānaprāśanaṃ hi vai
verses.translation: The Pitrs are gods of the gods and noble-souled. Hence, some preceptors wish that the worship of the Brahmanas should be carried out always in the beginning and the rice- balls should be offered afterwards.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs are gods of the gods and noble-souled. Hence, some preceptors wish that the worship of the Brahmanas should be carried out always in the beginning and the rice- balls should be offered afterwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs are gods of the gods and noble-souled. Hence, some preceptors wish that the worship of the Brahmanas should be carried out always in the beginning and the rice- balls should be offered afterwards.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति मनुष्येषु सत्यमे तद्ब्रुवामहे । माल्यैर्गन्धैस्तथान्नेन युष्मानग्रे ऽर्च्चयिष्यति ।१ १२।१२॥ अग्रे दत्त्वा तु युष्माकमस्माकं दास्यते ततः । विसर्जनमथास्माकं पूर्वं पश्चात्तु दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati manuṣyeṣu satyame tadbruvāmahe / mālyairgandhaistathānnena yuṣmānagre 'rccayiṣyati /1 12.12// agre dattvā tu yuṣmākamasmākaṃ dāsyate tataḥ / visarjanamathāsmākaṃ pūrvaṃ paścāttu daivatam
verses.translation: These Pitrs strengthen and develop the Soma (Moon). They abide by their Yogic power. Hence, one should offer the Pinzas to the Yogic souls retaining personal purity and concen- trated devotion to them.
verses.hindi: महादेव्या धृता या तु ब्रह्मादयः पूञ्यते हि सा
verses.wordMeaning: These Pitrs strengthen and develop the Soma (Moon). They abide by their Yogic power. Hence, one should offer the Pinzas to the Yogic souls retaining personal purity and concen- trated devotion to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Pitrs strengthen and develop the Soma (Moon). They abide by their Yogic power. Hence, one should offer the Pinzas to the Yogic souls retaining personal purity and concen- trated devotion to them.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षणं चैव श्राद्धस्य आतिथ्यस्य विधिद्वयम् । भूतानां देवतानां च पितॄणां चैव कर्मणि
verses.transliteration: rakṣaṇaṃ caiva śrāddhasya ātithyasya vidhidvayam / bhūtānāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ caiva karmaṇi
verses.translation: This shall be a direct Hauis offering to the Pitjrs. If a person abiding by Yogic power is fed, it is as fruitful as feeding a thousand Brahmanas. Just as a boat enables us to cross an expanse of water, so also (the offering of oblations)
verses.wordMeaning: This shall be a direct Hauis offering to the Pitjrs. If a person abiding by Yogic power is fed, it is as fruitful as feeding a thousand Brahmanas. Just as a boat enables us to cross an expanse of water, so also (the offering of oblations)
verses.commentary: Sense: This shall be a direct Hauis offering to the Pitjrs. If a person abiding by Yogic power is fed, it is as fruitful as feeding a thousand Brahmanas. Just as a boat enables us to cross an expanse of water, so also (the offering of oblations)

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते सम्यगेतत्सर्वमेव भविष्यति । एवं दत्त्वा वरं तेषां ब्रह्मा पितृगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛte samyagetatsarvameva bhaviṣyati / evaṃ dattvā varaṃ teṣāṃ brahmā pitṛgaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: One who seeks intellect, fame and renown consigns it to the waters. One who seeks a long life offers it to the crows.
verses.wordMeaning: One who seeks intellect, fame and renown consigns it to the waters. One who seeks a long life offers it to the crows.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who seeks intellect, fame and renown consigns it to the waters. One who seeks a long life offers it to the crows.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमानुग्रहकृद्देवः संचकार यथोदितम् । वेदे पञ्च महायज्ञा नराणां समुदाहृताः
verses.transliteration: kṣamānugrahakṛddevaḥ saṃcakāra yathoditam / vede pañca mahāyajñā narāṇāṃ samudāhṛtāḥ
verses.translation: One who wishes for a graceful tenderness ( of the body) offers it to the cocks. Thus the benefit of offering the rice-balls has been recounted.
verses.hindi: उस अङ्ना को वहाँ से विदा करके वह मुनि फिर विद्याघरों के
verses.wordMeaning: One who wishes for a graceful tenderness ( of the body) offers it to the cocks. Thus the benefit of offering the rice-balls has been recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who wishes for a graceful tenderness ( of the body) offers it to the cocks. Thus the benefit of offering the rice-balls has been recounted.

verses.sanskrit: एतान्पञ्च महायज्ञान्निर्वपेत्सततं नरः । यत्र स्थास्यन्ति दातारस्तत्स्थानं वै निबोधत
verses.transliteration: etānpañca mahāyajñānnirvapetsatataṃ naraḥ / yatra sthāsyanti dātārastatsthānaṃ vai nibodhata
verses.translation: One should send it up in the sky or put it in the water facing the southern quarter. The abode of the Pitrs is in the sky or the southern quarter.
verses.hindi: मागे से गये ये । विद्याधर की वधू के हाथ से वल्लकी का प्रतिप्रहण किया
verses.wordMeaning: One should send it up in the sky or put it in the water facing the southern quarter. The abode of the Pitrs is in the sky or the southern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should send it up in the sky or put it in the water facing the southern quarter. The abode of the Pitrs is in the sky or the southern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: निर्भयं विरजस्कं च निःशोकं निर्व्यथक्लमम् । ब्राह्मं स्थानमवाप्नोति सर्वलोकपुरस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: nirbhayaṃ virajaskaṃ ca niḥśokaṃ nirvyathaklamam / brāhmaṃ sthānamavāpnoti sarvalokapuraskṛtam
verses.translation: Some Brahmanas say thus — "After being permitted by those Brahmanas who say — "Let it be freely lifted up'* — the devotee shall lift up the rice balls at the outset (or from the tips ).
verses.hindi: ग्रहण किये ये । कहीं पर तो इनको घारण कर लेते ये और कहीं पर हाथों में हो ग्रहण करते ये-कहीं पर गान करते जाते थे और कभी हँसते जाते चे।२३। अपनी ही इच्छा से विहार करने वाले वह मुनि वहाँ पर पहुँचे ये जहाँ पुरन्दर विराजमान थे । फिर उस मुनि ने अपने करों में स्थित उस
verses.wordMeaning: Some Brahmanas say thus — "After being permitted by those Brahmanas who say — "Let it be freely lifted up'* — the devotee shall lift up the rice balls at the outset (or from the tips ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Brahmanas say thus — "After being permitted by those Brahmanas who say — "Let it be freely lifted up'* — the devotee shall lift up the rice balls at the outset (or from the tips ).

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रेणापि च कर्त्तव्याः पञ्चैते मन्त्रवर्जिताः । अतो ऽन्यथा तु यो भुङ्क्ते स ऋणं नित्यमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: śūdreṇāpi ca karttavyāḥ pañcaite mantravarjitāḥ / ato 'nyathā tu yo bhuṅkte sa ṛṇaṃ nityamaśnute
verses.translation: One shall take out the tips (uppermost part) of flowers, fruits, foodstuffs and rice and perform Homa in the fire with all those things.
verses.hindi: आला को इन्द्रदेव को समपित कर दी थी ।२४। उसको ग्रहण करके देवराज ने उस माला को हाथी के कन्ये पर स्थापित कर दिया। उस गज ने उसको लेकर भूतल में भेज दिया या ।२५। उस समय में उस माला को भूतल में प्रेषित की हुई देखकर तपस्वी को बड़ा क्रोध आ गया था ओर उसने कहा
verses.wordMeaning: One shall take out the tips (uppermost part) of flowers, fruits, foodstuffs and rice and perform Homa in the fire with all those things.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall take out the tips (uppermost part) of flowers, fruits, foodstuffs and rice and perform Homa in the fire with all those things.

verses.sanskrit: ऋणं भुङ्क्ते स पापात्मा यः पचेदात्मकारणात् । तस्मान्निर्वर्तयेत्पञ्च महायज्ञान्सदा बुधः
verses.transliteration: ṛṇaṃ bhuṅkte sa pāpātmā yaḥ pacedātmakāraṇāt / tasmānnirvartayetpañca mahāyajñānsadā budhaḥ
verses.translation: After performing Homa in the fire with the food- stuffs, cooked rice, beverage, roots and fruits he should offer the Pindas facing the southern quarter.
verses.hindi: था कि मेरे द्वारा समपित की हुई माला को इन्द्र देव ने शिर पर धारण किया है।२६। त्रेलोक्य के ऐश्वर्य से प्रमत्त आपने मेरी दी हुई माला का अपमान किया है। जिस माला को महादेवी ने घारण किया था और वहू बरह्मा आदि के द्वारा पूजी जाया करती है ।२७ तूने देव असुर और मनुष्यों
verses.wordMeaning: After performing Homa in the fire with the food- stuffs, cooked rice, beverage, roots and fruits he should offer the Pindas facing the southern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing Homa in the fire with the food- stuffs, cooked rice, beverage, roots and fruits he should offer the Pindas facing the southern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: उदक्पूर्वे बलिं कुर्यादुदकान्ते तथैव च । बलिं सुविहितं कुर्या दुच्चैरुच्चतरं क्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: udakpūrve baliṃ kuryādudakānte tathaiva ca / baliṃ suvihitaṃ kuryā duccairuccataraṃ kṣipet
verses.translation: After performing Homa to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama) and Soma, after offering Pindas along with the libation of water, one should feed the Brahmanas
verses.hindi: का लोक शासित किया है वह अब मेरे शाप से अशोभन तेज से रहित हो आयगा
verses.wordMeaning: After performing Homa to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama) and Soma, after offering Pindas along with the libation of water, one should feed the Brahmanas
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing Homa to Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama) and Soma, after offering Pindas along with the libation of water, one should feed the Brahmanas

verses.sanskrit: परशृङ्गं गवां मूत्रं बलिं सूत्रं समुत्क्षिपेत् । तन्निवेद्यो भवेत्पिण्डः पितॄणां यस्तु जीवति
verses.transliteration: paraśṛṅgaṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ baliṃ sūtraṃ samutkṣipet / tannivedyo bhavetpiṇḍaḥ pitṝṇāṃ yastu jīvati
verses.translation: W. 31-35 refer to the disposal of Pindas. Cf. Mbh. AmU&sana 125- 38-40, Bm 150-52 for similar views. %
verses.wordMeaning: W. 31-35 refer to the disposal of Pindas. Cf. Mbh. AmU&sana 125- 38-40, Bm 150-52 for similar views. %
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 31-35 refer to the disposal of Pindas. Cf. Mbh. AmU&sana 125- 38-40, Bm 150-52 for similar views. %

verses.sanskrit: इष्टेनान्नेन भक्ष्यैश्च भोजयेच्च यथाविधि । निवेद्यं केचिदिच्छन्ति जीवन्त्यपि हि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: iṣṭenānnena bhakṣyaiśca bhojayecca yathāvidhi / nivedyaṃ kecidicchanti jīvantyapi hi yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, he should propitiate the Brahxnana in the proper order consistent with his capacity, with hot and glossy ( mixed with ghee) foodstuffs and cooked rice smelling sweet (with ghee and spices).
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he should propitiate the Brahxnana in the proper order consistent with his capacity, with hot and glossy ( mixed with ghee) foodstuffs and cooked rice smelling sweet (with ghee and spices).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he should propitiate the Brahxnana in the proper order consistent with his capacity, with hot and glossy ( mixed with ghee) foodstuffs and cooked rice smelling sweet (with ghee and spices).

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवा महात्मानो ह्येते पितर इत्युत । इच्छन्ति केचिदाचार्यः पश्चात्पिण्डनिवेदनम्
verses.transliteration: devadevā mahātmāno hyete pitara ityuta / icchanti kecidācāryaḥ paścātpiṇḍanivedanam
verses.translation: The man obtains all that he desires if he serves them with concentration and purity (mental and physical). He shall stand by them with palms joined in reverence. He shall be loyal, faithful and devoted to them.
verses.hindi: विजयश्वीस्ततस्तस्य हैत्यं तु बलिमन्वगात् । नित्यश्रीनित्यपुरुषं वासुदेवमथान्वगात्
verses.wordMeaning: The man obtains all that he desires if he serves them with concentration and purity (mental and physical). He shall stand by them with palms joined in reverence. He shall be loyal, faithful and devoted to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man obtains all that he desires if he serves them with concentration and purity (mental and physical). He shall stand by them with palms joined in reverence. He shall be loyal, faithful and devoted to them.

verses.sanskrit: पूजनं चैव विप्रणां पूर्वमेवेह नित्यशः । तद्धिधर्मार्थकुशलो नेत्युवाच बृहस्मतिः
verses.transliteration: pūjanaṃ caiva vipraṇāṃ pūrvameveha nityaśaḥ / taddhidharmārthakuśalo netyuvāca bṛhasmatiḥ
verses.translation: The grandfathers (manes) bestow these qualities — viz. Akfudratva (the state of not being mean and low) grate- fulness, chivalry, refined speech, power of penance, Yajfias and charitable gifts.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रोऽपि स्वपुरं गत्वा सवंदेवसमन्वितः । विषण्णचेता निःश्रीकञ्चिन्तयामास देवराट्
verses.wordMeaning: The grandfathers (manes) bestow these qualities — viz. Akfudratva (the state of not being mean and low) grate- fulness, chivalry, refined speech, power of penance, Yajfias and charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grandfathers (manes) bestow these qualities — viz. Akfudratva (the state of not being mean and low) grate- fulness, chivalry, refined speech, power of penance, Yajfias and charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं निवेदयेत्पिण्डान्पश्चाद्विप्रांश्च भोजयेत् । योगात्मानो महात्मानः पितरो योग संभवाः
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ nivedayetpiṇḍānpaścādviprāṃśca bhojayet / yogātmāno mahātmānaḥ pitaro yoga saṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: Hereafter listen, even as I recount, to the auspicious procedure which is carried out in the proper order after the Brahmanas have taken their food.
verses.wordMeaning: Hereafter listen, even as I recount, to the auspicious procedure which is carried out in the proper order after the Brahmanas have taken their food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hereafter listen, even as I recount, to the auspicious procedure which is carried out in the proper order after the Brahmanas have taken their food.

verses.sanskrit: सोममाप्याययन्त्येते पितरो योगसंस्थिताः । तस्माद्दद्याच्छुचिः पिण्डान्योगेभ्यस्तत्परायणः
verses.transliteration: somamāpyāyayantyete pitaro yogasaṃsthitāḥ / tasmāddadyācchuciḥ piṇḍānyogebhyastatparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The performer of Sraddha devoutly attached to the Pitrs, shall at the outset sprinkle the ground and lift (a particle). Then he scatters the rice in accordance with the injunctions.
verses.hindi: किफलानि च तानि स्युरुपायो वाऽय कीदृशः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The performer of Sraddha devoutly attached to the Pitrs, shall at the outset sprinkle the ground and lift (a particle). Then he scatters the rice in accordance with the injunctions.
verses.commentary: Sense: The performer of Sraddha devoutly attached to the Pitrs, shall at the outset sprinkle the ground and lift (a particle). Then he scatters the rice in accordance with the injunctions.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणां हि भवेदेतत्साक्षादिव हुतं हविः । ब्रह्मणानां सहस्रस्य योगस्थं ग्रासयेद्यदि
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāṃ hi bhavedetatsākṣādiva hutaṃ haviḥ / brahmaṇānāṃ sahasrasya yogasthaṃ grāsayedyadi
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: यजमानं च भोक्तॄंश् च नौरिवाम्भसि तारयेत् । असतां प्रग्रहो यत्र सतां चैव विमानता
verses.transliteration: yajamānaṃ ca bhoktṝṃś ca naurivāmbhasi tārayet / asatāṃ pragraho yatra satāṃ caiva vimānatā
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डो दैवकृतस्तत्र सद्यः पतति दारुणः । इत्वा मम सधर्माणं बालिशं यस्तु भोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: daṇḍo daivakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ / itvā mama sadharmāṇaṃ bāliśaṃ yastu bhojayet
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: कृतस्य कमंणो राजन्कल्पकोटिशतेरपि । प्रायश्चित्तोपमोगाध्यां विना नाशो न जायते
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: आदिकर्म समुत्सृज्य दाता तत्र विनश्यति । पिण्डमग्नौ सदा दद्यद्भोगार्थी प्रथमं नरः
verses.transliteration: ādikarma samutsṛjya dātā tatra vinaśyati / piṇḍamagnau sadā dadyadbhogārthī prathamaṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: इस रीति से शाप देकर जब वह शाम्त हुए तो विनीत उस इन्द्र ने उनका पूजन भी किया था किन्तु है बह्मत् ! आगे होने वाले कायं का अनु- स्मरण करते हुए बह चुपचाप चले गये ये ।२६। इसके अनन्तर उस इन्द्र की जो विजय की श्री थी वह असुरराज बलि का अनुगमन कर गयी थी और
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: दद्यात्प्रजार्थी यत्नेन मध्यमं मन्त्रपूर्वकम् । उत्तमां कान्तिमन्विच्छन्गोषु नित्यं प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: dadyātprajārthī yatnena madhyamaṃ mantrapūrvakam / uttamāṃ kāntimanvicchangoṣu nityaṃ prayacchati
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: और जो नित्य श्री थी वह नित्य पुरुष वासुदेव के समीप में चली गयी थी ।३०। इन्द्र भी अपने पुर में पहुँच कर सब देवगणों से युक्त होता हुआ श्री से निहीन होकर ही निषाद से युक्‍त चित्त वाला हो गया था और वह चिन्ता करने लगा था ।३१ इसके पश्चात् उस देवों के पुर में परमाशुभ
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्ञां चैव यशः कीर्त्तिमप्सु वै संप्रयच्छति । प्रार्थयन्दीर्घामायुश्च वायसेभ्यः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: prajñāṃ caiva yaśaḥ kīrttimapsu vai saṃprayacchati / prārthayandīrghāmāyuśca vāyasebhyaḥ prayacchati
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: निमित्तों को उसने देखा था । फिर अपने गुरु वृहस्पतिजी को बुलाकर यह वाक्य उनसे कहा--।३२। है भगवान् ! आप तो सभी घमों के ज्ञाता हैं और तीनों कालों के ज्ञान के महान् पंडित हैं । अब तो ऐसे अशुभ निमित्त दिखलाई दे रहे हैं जो पहिले कभी भो गही देखे गये ये । इन सबका वया
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: सोकुमार्यमथान्विच्छन्कुक्कुटेभ्यः प्रयच्छति । एवमेतत्समुद्दिष्टं पिण्डनिर्वपणे फलम्
verses.transliteration: sokumāryamathānvicchankukkuṭebhyaḥ prayacchati / evametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇe phalam
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: फल होगा और इनका कया कैसा भी कोई उपाय भी है? वृहस्पतिजी ने देवराज के इस वाकय का श्रवण कर फिर उन्होंने धर्माथं के सहित परम शुभ वाकय में उत्तर दिया था ।३३-३४। है राजन् ! किये हुए कर्मों का फल सैकड़ों करोड़ कल्यों में भी बिना प्रायश्चित्त मर उपभोगों के कभी भी
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशे गमयेद्वापि अप्सु वा दक्षिणामुखः । पितॄणां स्थानमाकाशं दक्षिणा चैव दिग्भेवेत्
verses.transliteration: ākāśe gamayedvāpi apsu vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / pitṝṇāṃ sthānamākāśaṃ dakṣiṇā caiva digbhevet
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: एके विप्राः पुनः प्राहुः पिण्डोद्धरणमग्रतः । अनुज्ञातस्तु तैर्विप्रैः कामसुद्ध्रियतामित्
verses.transliteration: eke viprāḥ punaḥ prāhuḥ piṇḍoddharaṇamagrataḥ / anujñātastu tairvipraiḥ kāmasuddhriyatāmit
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: कर्म वा कीटशं ब्रह्मस्प्रायश्वितं च कीहशम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पाणां च फलानां च भक्ष्याणामन्नतस्तथा । अग्रमुद्धृत्य सर्वेषां जुहुयाद्धव्यवाहने
verses.transliteration: puṣpāṇāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca bhakṣyāṇāmannatastathā / agramuddhṛtya sarveṣāṃ juhuyāddhavyavāhane
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: भङ्यमन्नं तथा पेयं मूलानि च फलानि च । हुत्वाग्नौ च ततः पिण्डान्निर्वपेद्दक्षिणा मुखः
verses.transliteration: bhaṅyamannaṃ tathā peyaṃ mūlāni ca phalāni ca / hutvāgnau ca tataḥ piṇḍānnirvapeddakṣiṇā mukhaḥ
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वताय सोमाय हुत्वा पिण्डान्निवेद्य च । उदकान्नयनं कृत्वा पश्चाद्विप्रांश्च भोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatāya somāya hutvā piṇḍānnivedya ca / udakānnayanaṃ kṛtvā paścādviprāṃśca bhojayet
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: अनुपूर्वं ततो विप्रान्भक्ष्यैरन्नैश्च शक्तितः । स्निग्धैरुष्णैः सुगन्धैश्च तर्पयेत्तान्रसैरपि
verses.transliteration: anupūrvaṃ tato viprānbhakṣyairannaiśca śaktitaḥ / snigdhairuṣṇaiḥ sugandhaiśca tarpayettānrasairapi
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: एकाग्रः पर्युपासीनः प्रयतः प्राञ्जलिः स्थितः । तत्परः श्रद्दधानश्च कामानाप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: ekāgraḥ paryupāsīnaḥ prayataḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitaḥ / tatparaḥ śraddadhānaśca kāmānāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षुद्रत्वं कृतज्ञत्वं दाक्षिण्यं संस्कृतं वचः । तपो यज्ञांश्च दानं च प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: akṣudratvaṃ kṛtajñatvaṃ dākṣiṇyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ vacaḥ / tapo yajñāṃśca dānaṃ ca prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं विधिं सौम्यं भुक्तवत्सु द्विजातिषु । आनुपूर्व्येण विहितं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ vidhiṃ saumyaṃ bhuktavatsu dvijātiṣu / ānupūrvyeṇa vihitaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्ष्य भूमिमथोद्धृत्य पूर्वं पितृपरायणः । ततो ऽन्निविकिरं कुर्याद्विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: prokṣya bhūmimathoddhṛtya pūrvaṃ pitṛparāyaṇaḥ / tato 'nnivikiraṃ kuryādvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: इन्हृदेव ने कहा-हे ब्रह्मे ! वह कमं किस प्रकार का है और प्रायश्चित्त कंसा है ? वह सब में सुनने का इच्छुक हूं । वह मुझे विस्तार के साथ बतलाइए ।३६। बृहस्पति जी ने कहा--राजा के लिये पांच तरह के दुष्छत कहे गये हैं-किसी का हनन करना--स्तेय (चोरी)--हिसा--
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधा वाच्य ततो विप्रान् विधिवद्भूरितक्षिणान् । अन्नशेषमनुज्ञाप्य सत्कृत्य द्विजसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: svadhā vācya tato viprān vidhivadbhūritakṣiṇān / annaśeṣamanujñāpya satkṛtya dvijasattamān
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.hindi: मदिरा पान ओर अन्य अङ्कना के साथ में रति करना ।३७। ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतश्चैव अनुगम्य विसर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: prāñjaliḥ prayataścaiva anugamya visarjayet
verses.translation: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring the excellent Brahmanas thus, he shall follow them with palms joined in reverence. With purity in mind he shall bid them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे द्वादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ १२॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच सकृदभ्यर्चिताः प्रीता भवन्ति पितरो ऽव्ययाः । योगात्मानो महात्मानो विपाप्मानो महौजसः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 12// bṛhaspatiruvāca sakṛdabhyarcitāḥ prītā bhavanti pitaro 'vyayāḥ / yogātmāno mahātmāno vipāpmāno mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Mrtyu (god of death) has no access to that place nor do the Asuras and Raksasas have it. As long as the earth exists there is no fear and no Alaksmi (loss of splendour and prosperity) there.
verses.hindi: अनास्थिक ये योनियां हैं-इनमें अयुत, सहल-शत-दक्ष-दश, पाँच, तीन, एक और आधा क्रम से आरम्भ से अन्त से अन्त तक जन्म धारण करना पड़ता है ।३८-३९। ब्राह्मण-क्षत्रिय-बैश्य और स्त्रियों का ऊपर में कहे हुए अर्थ में पाप समादिष्ट होता है । पिता-माता-गुरू-स्वामी और पुत्रों की निष्कृति होती
verses.wordMeaning: Mrtyu (god of death) has no access to that place nor do the Asuras and Raksasas have it. As long as the earth exists there is no fear and no Alaksmi (loss of splendour and prosperity) there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mrtyu (god of death) has no access to that place nor do the Asuras and Raksasas have it. As long as the earth exists there is no fear and no Alaksmi (loss of splendour and prosperity) there.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेत्य च स्वर्गलोकाय कामैश्च बहुलं भुवि । येषु वाप्यनुगृह्णन्ति मोक्षप्राप्तिः क्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: pretya ca svargalokāya kāmaiśca bahulaṃ bhuvi / yeṣu vāpyanugṛhṇanti mokṣaprāptiḥ krameṇa tu
verses.translation: On account of his power of penance and brilliant splendour that excellent mountain always shines like the Sarhvar- taka (i.e. the all-destroying fire at the time of annihilation of the universe) on the peak of Malyavan.
verses.hindi: है ।४०। गुरु की आज्ञा से कृत पाप उसकी आज्ञालंघन में अर्थ पाता है । राजा को दश ब्राह्मणों की भृति (भरण) के लिए चाहिए कि एक द्विजका हनन कर देवे । तात्पयं यह है कि यदि दक्ष ब्राह्मणों की जीविका की रक्षा होती है तो एक ढिज का हनन कर देना चाहिए ।४१। सौ ब्राह्मणों की भूति
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his power of penance and brilliant splendour that excellent mountain always shines like the Sarhvar- taka (i.e. the all-destroying fire at the time of annihilation of the universe) on the peak of Malyavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his power of penance and brilliant splendour that excellent mountain always shines like the Sarhvar- taka (i.e. the all-destroying fire at the time of annihilation of the universe) on the peak of Malyavan.

verses.sanskrit: तानि वक्ष्याम्यहं सौम्य सरांसि सरितस्तथा । तीर्थानि चैव पुण्यानि देशांश्छैलांस्तथाश्रमान्
verses.transliteration: tāni vakṣyāmyahaṃ saumya sarāṃsi saritastathā / tīrthāni caiva puṇyāni deśāṃśchailāṃstathāśramān
verses.translation: To the south of the Narmada, the Ku£a grasses are well reputed all around. They are soft, fragrant and very plea- sing to behold. They have a tranquil golden lustre.
verses.hindi: के लिए अथवा ब्राह्मण को ब्राह्मण तथा पाँच ब्रह्म (वेद) के ज्ञाताओं के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: To the south of the Narmada, the Ku£a grasses are well reputed all around. They are soft, fragrant and very plea- sing to behold. They have a tranquil golden lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the south of the Narmada, the Ku£a grasses are well reputed all around. They are soft, fragrant and very plea- sing to behold. They have a tranquil golden lustre.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यो हि त्रिषु लोकेषु सदैवामरकण्टकः । पर्वतप्रवरः पुण्यः सिद्धयारणसेवितः
verses.transliteration: puṇyo hi triṣu lokeṣu sadaivāmarakaṇṭakaḥ / parvatapravaraḥ puṇyaḥ siddhayāraṇasevitaḥ
verses.translation: While performing theAgnihotra, the highly resplend- ent holy lord Angiras used those excellent Kusa grasses for the sake of spreading round the altar formerly. He then saw the steps leading to the heaven.
verses.hindi: एक वैश्य को दण्ड राजा को दे देना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: While performing theAgnihotra, the highly resplend- ent holy lord Angiras used those excellent Kusa grasses for the sake of spreading round the altar formerly. He then saw the steps leading to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: While performing theAgnihotra, the highly resplend- ent holy lord Angiras used those excellent Kusa grasses for the sake of spreading round the altar formerly. He then saw the steps leading to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वर्षसहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च । तपः सुदुश्चरं तेपे भगवानङ्गिराः पुरा
verses.transliteration: yatra varṣasahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca / tapaḥ suduścaraṃ tepe bhagavānaṅgirāḥ purā
verses.translation: Holy places have a deep psychological effect on religious-minded persons. Sr&ddha is to be performed in one's own house. But as KPJI.22.17 states, holy places are no one's private property. And a list of such holy spots is recommended in different Pur&pas like KP.II.20-32-36, V&.P. Ch. 77, Mt.P. ch. 22. Not that these lists agree, but there is a great deal of overlapping as a number of holy spots like Gaya, V&raoasi, Pray&ga, Pufkara command respect from most of Hindus. Here is the list recommended by our Text.
verses.hindi: तेषां च दर्शनविधौ नमने च कार्ये शुश्रूषणेऽपि चरतां सहशांश्च तेषाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Holy places have a deep psychological effect on religious-minded persons. Sr&ddha is to be performed in one's own house. But as KPJI.22.17 states, holy places are no one's private property. And a list of such holy spots is recommended in different Pur&pas like KP.II.20-32-36,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Holy places have a deep psychological effect on religious-minded persons. Sr&ddha is to be performed in one's own house. But as KPJI.22.17 states, holy places are no one's private property. And a list of such holy spots is recommended in different Pur&pas like KP.II.20-32-36,…

verses.sanskrit: यत्र मृत्योर्गतिर्न्नास्ति तथैवासुररक्षसाम् । न भयं नैव चालक्ष्मीर्यावद्भूमिर्द्धरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yatra mṛtyorgatirnnāsti tathaivāsurarakṣasām / na bhayaṃ naiva cālakṣmīryāvadbhūmirddhariṣyati
verses.translation: A mountain in Bilaspur District of Madhya Pradeia (Vi 10-1 1 and 15.16). VifQu Dh. S. 85.6 highly glorifies the performance of Sr&ddha on this mountain. Our Text gives the credit of this sanctity to the penance of Afigiras on this. n
verses.hindi: दश वैश्यों की सुरक्षा के लिये एक वेश्य अथवा वैश्यों को दण्ड दे
verses.wordMeaning: A mountain in Bilaspur District of Madhya Pradeia (Vi 10-1 1 and 15.16). VifQu Dh. S. 85.6 highly glorifies the performance of Sr&ddha on this mountain. Our Text gives the credit of this sanctity to the penance of Afigiras on this. n
verses.commentary: Sense: A mountain in Bilaspur District of Madhya Pradeia (Vi 10-1 1 and 15.16). VifQu Dh. S. 85.6 highly glorifies the performance of Sr&ddha on this mountain. Our Text gives the credit of this sanctity to the penance of Afigiras on this. n

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तेजसा तस्य भ्रजते स नगोत्तमः । शृङ्गे माल्यवतो नित्यं वह्निः संवर्त्तको यथा
verses.transliteration: tapasā tejasā tasya bhrajate sa nagottamaḥ / śṛṅge mālyavato nityaṃ vahniḥ saṃvarttako yathā
verses.translation: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelli- gent man who offers Pincjas on those Darbha grasses even on a single occasion on the mountain Amarakantaka.
verses.hindi: देना चाहिए। अथवा शत (सो) वैश्यों का हित सम्पादन होता हो तो एक द्विज को दण्ड दे देना चाहिए ।४३। सहस्न शूद्रो के लिए अथवा ब्राह्मण को दण्डित करे। उसके शतार्ध वेश्य को या उसका दशाधं शूद्र को दण्ड देवे
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelli- gent man who offers Pincjas on those Darbha grasses even on a single occasion on the mountain Amarakantaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelli- gent man who offers Pincjas on those Darbha grasses even on a single occasion on the mountain Amarakantaka.

verses.sanskrit: मृदवस्तु सुगन्धाश्च हेमाभाः प्रियदर्शनाः । शान्ताःकुशा इति ख्याताः परिदक्षिणनर्मदाम्
verses.transliteration: mṛdavastu sugandhāśca hemābhāḥ priyadarśanāḥ / śāntāḥkuśā iti khyātāḥ paridakṣiṇanarmadām
verses.translation: That Sraddha becomes one of everlasting benefit. It increases the pleasures of the Pitrs. On reaching that holy centre, they always vanish.
verses.hindi: और कलत्र तया पुत्र के लिए भी तीन भाग अर्थ का करे अपनी आत्मा के लिए कुछ भी न करे।४४। जो आत्मा को अर्थात् अपने को हृनत करना आरम्भ करे वह चाहे ब्राह्मण-क्षत्रिय वेश्य कोई भी हो अथवा अश्‍व--गौ या अन्य को मारता हो तो उसका हनन करके भी दोषों से लिप्त नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: That Sraddha becomes one of everlasting benefit. It increases the pleasures of the Pitrs. On reaching that holy centre, they always vanish.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Sraddha becomes one of everlasting benefit. It increases the pleasures of the Pitrs. On reaching that holy centre, they always vanish.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टवान्स्वर्गसोपानं भगवानङ्गिराः पुरा । अग्निहोत्रे महातेजाः प्रस्तारार्थं कुशोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭavānsvargasopānaṃ bhagavānaṅgirāḥ purā / agnihotre mahātejāḥ prastārārthaṃ kuśottamān
verses.translation: During the Parvan days, a holy lake ofbrilhant flames is seen there. The river there, is ViSalyakarani (one that removes pain due to the pricking of darts) of animals with bony spikes (like porcupine).
verses.hindi: है ।४६। है डिज श्रेष्ठ ! अपनी स्त्री-पुत्र-भाई और बन्धु का हनन करने में दशगुना दोष होता है और रक्षा करने में उतना ही फल भी होता है
verses.wordMeaning: During the Parvan days, a holy lake ofbrilhant flames is seen there. The river there, is ViSalyakarani (one that removes pain due to the pricking of darts) of animals with bony spikes (like porcupine).
verses.commentary: Sense: During the Parvan days, a holy lake ofbrilhant flames is seen there. The river there, is ViSalyakarani (one that removes pain due to the pricking of darts) of animals with bony spikes (like porcupine).

verses.sanskrit: तेषु दर्भेषु यः पिण्डान्मरकण्टटकपर्वते । दद्यात्सकृदपि प्राज्ञस्तस्य वक्ष्यामि यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: teṣu darbheṣu yaḥ piṇḍānmarakaṇṭaṭakaparvate / dadyātsakṛdapi prājñastasya vakṣyāmi yatphalam
verses.translation: On the peak of the lordly mountain Malyavan, in the hinder half of the country of Kalinga, there is a pool on that very excellent mountain. It has an eddy stretching towards the south-east.
verses.hindi: राजा--द्विज--श्रोत्रिय--वेदवेत्ता -ध्रती-वेदान्त ज्ञाता और वेदों के मनीषी के विनाश करने में एक-दो-पचास और अयुत गुनी निष्कृति (प्रायश्चित्त) होता है--ऐसा सम्त पुरुष कहते हैं ।४८। और इनकी रक्षा करने की विधि में और दान करने में पूर्व में जो कहा है उससे उत्तर गुना पुण्य कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On the peak of the lordly mountain Malyavan, in the hinder half of the country of Kalinga, there is a pool on that very excellent mountain. It has an eddy stretching towards the south-east.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the peak of the lordly mountain Malyavan, in the hinder half of the country of Kalinga, there is a pool on that very excellent mountain. It has an eddy stretching towards the south-east.

verses.sanskrit: तद्भवत्यक्षयं श्राद्धं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम् । अन्तर्द्धानं च गच्छन्ति क्षेत्रमासाद्य तत्सदा
verses.transliteration: tadbhavatyakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam / antarddhānaṃ ca gacchanti kṣetramāsādya tatsadā
verses.translation: "Blessed are those persons in the world who are devotedly attached to the Pitrs and who will propitiate the Pitrs by means of Sraddha after reaching the Amarakantaka.
verses.hindi: उनके दर्शन की विधि में तथा नमन करने में तया इनको सुश्रूषा करने में और इनके सहन समाचरण करने वालों की भी शुआ,वा आदि करते में भी वैसा ही फल होता है
verses.wordMeaning: "Blessed are those persons in the world who are devotedly attached to the Pitrs and who will propitiate the Pitrs by means of Sraddha after reaching the Amarakantaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Blessed are those persons in the world who are devotedly attached to the Pitrs and who will propitiate the Pitrs by means of Sraddha after reaching the Amarakantaka.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ज्वालासरः पुण्यं दृश्यते चापि पर्वसु । सशल्यानां च सत्त्वानां विशल्यकरणी नदी
verses.transliteration: tatra jvālāsaraḥ puṇyaṃ dṛśyate cāpi parvasu / saśalyānāṃ ca sattvānāṃ viśalyakaraṇī nadī
verses.translation: Those who worship even once in the Amarakantaka go to heaven. There is no doubt that they attain spiritual achievement with a very little penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who worship even once in the Amarakantaka go to heaven. There is no doubt that they attain spiritual achievement with a very little penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who worship even once in the Amarakantaka go to heaven. There is no doubt that they attain spiritual achievement with a very little penance.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्दक्षिणायतावर्त्ता वापी सा सुनगोत्तमे । कलिङ्गदेशपश्चार्द्धे शृङ्गे माल्यवतो विभोः
verses.transliteration: prāgdakṣiṇāyatāvarttā vāpī sā sunagottame / kaliṅgadeśapaścārddhe śṛṅge mālyavato vibhoḥ
verses.translation: After performing the yogic exercises on the summit of V&il&ta the divine vision begins to function (in the performer). The devotee becomes unassailable and invin- cible to all living beings. He walks over the earth lika a Deva.
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the yogic exercises on the summit of V&il&ta the divine vision begins to function (in the performer). The devotee becomes unassailable and invin- cible to all living beings. He walks over the earth lika a Deva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the yogic exercises on the summit of V&il&ta the divine vision begins to function (in the performer). The devotee becomes unassailable and invin- cible to all living beings. He walks over the earth lika a Deva.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धिक्षेत्रमृषिश्रेष्ठा यदुक्तं परमं भुवि । संमतं देवदैत्यानां श्लोकं चाप्युशना जगौ
verses.transliteration: siddhikṣetramṛṣiśreṣṭhā yaduktaṃ paramaṃ bhuvi / saṃmataṃ devadaityānāṃ ślokaṃ cāpyuśanā jagau
verses.translation: A mountain range from Orissa to Madura (including a part of Eastern Ghats) but the name is serially applied to the range of hills separating the Mah&-nadi from Ganjam dist. It is regarded as the resort of Parasur&ma.
verses.wordMeaning: A mountain range from Orissa to Madura (including a part of Eastern Ghats) but the name is serially applied to the range of hills separating the Mah&-nadi from Ganjam dist. It is regarded as the resort of Parasur&ma.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mountain range from Orissa to Madura (including a part of Eastern Ghats) but the name is serially applied to the range of hills separating the Mah&-nadi from Ganjam dist. It is regarded as the resort of Parasur&ma.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास्ते पुरुषा लोके ये प्राप्यामरकण्टकम् । पितॄन्संतर्पयिष्यन्तिश्राद्धे पितृपरायणाः
