verses.transliteration: dhanyāste puruṣā loke ye prāpyāmarakaṇṭakam / pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyantiśrāddhe pitṛparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: By taking a holy dip in the Saptagodavari1 and the penance grove of Gokarna2 by giving charitable gifts, one obtains the benefit of a horse sacrifice.
verses.hindi: देवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा पचमानो न लिप्यते
verses.wordMeaning: By taking a holy dip in the Saptagodavari1 and the penance grove of Gokarna2 by giving charitable gifts, one obtains the benefit of a horse sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking a holy dip in the Saptagodavari1 and the penance grove of Gokarna2 by giving charitable gifts, one obtains the benefit of a horse sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पेन तपसा सिद्धिं गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः । सकृदेवार्चितास्तत्र स्वर्गमामरकण्टके
verses.transliteration: alpena tapasā siddhiṃ gamiṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ / sakṛdevārcitāstatra svargamāmarakaṇṭake
verses.translation: After reaching the holy spot "Dhutapapa**,3 if a man takes a holy dip, he becomes sanctified. Rudra, the great l€vara, the lord of the Devas, had performed a penance there.
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the holy spot "Dhutapapa**,3 if a man takes a holy dip, he becomes sanctified. Rudra, the great l€vara, the lord of the Devas, had performed a penance there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the holy spot "Dhutapapa**,3 if a man takes a holy dip, he becomes sanctified. Rudra, the great l€vara, the lord of the Devas, had performed a penance there.

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रःपर्वतः पुण्यो रम्यः शक्रनिषेवितः । तत्रारुह्य भवेत्पूतः श्राद्धं चैव महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: mahendraḥparvataḥ puṇyo ramyaḥ śakraniṣevitaḥ / tatrāruhya bhavetpūtaḥ śrāddhaṃ caiva mahāphalam
verses.translation: A proof has been placed in the Gokarna by the Devas, in order to convince atheists (that they are wrong). If a non-Brahmana recitqs Savitrl Mantra there, he perishes (while reciting?)
verses.wordMeaning: A proof has been placed in the Gokarna by the Devas, in order to convince atheists (that they are wrong). If a non-Brahmana recitqs Savitrl Mantra there, he perishes (while reciting?)
verses.commentary: Sense: A proof has been placed in the Gokarna by the Devas, in order to convince atheists (that they are wrong). If a non-Brahmana recitqs Savitrl Mantra there, he perishes (while reciting?)

verses.sanskrit: वैलाटशिखरे युक्त्वा दिव्यं चक्षुः प्रवर्तते । अधृष्यश्चैव भूतानां देववच्चरते महीम्
verses.transliteration: vailāṭaśikhare yuktvā divyaṃ cakṣuḥ pravartate / adhṛṣyaścaiva bhūtānāṃ devavaccarate mahīm
verses.translation: If a person climbs the peak Devarsibhavana (Abode of the celestial sage), frequented by Siddhas and Caranas and regularly continues the observances of holy rites, he goes to the heaven.
verses.hindi: सिह-व्याघ्र और मृग आदि जो लोगों की हिसा करने वाले हैं उनको
verses.wordMeaning: If a person climbs the peak Devarsibhavana (Abode of the celestial sage), frequented by Siddhas and Caranas and regularly continues the observances of holy rites, he goes to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person climbs the peak Devarsibhavana (Abode of the celestial sage), frequented by Siddhas and Caranas and regularly continues the observances of holy rites, he goes to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तगोदावरे चैव गोकर्णे च तपोवने । अश्वमेधफलं स्नात्वा तत्र दत्त्वा भवेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: saptagodāvare caiva gokarṇe ca tapovane / aśvamedhaphalaṃ snātvā tatra dattvā bhavettataḥ
verses.translation: (There is a garden ) beautified by celestial sandal trees and other heavenly trees. Water mixed with sandal powder continuously flows from it.
verses.hindi: राजा देवों के तया ब्राह्मणों के लिए निरन्तर हनन कर सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: (There is a garden ) beautified by celestial sandal trees and other heavenly trees. Water mixed with sandal powder continuously flows from it.
verses.commentary: Sense: (There is a garden ) beautified by celestial sandal trees and other heavenly trees. Water mixed with sandal powder continuously flows from it.

verses.sanskrit: धूतपापस्थलं प्राप्य पूतः स्नात्वा भवेन्नरः । रुद्रस्तत्र तपस्तेपे देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dhūtapāpasthalaṃ prāpya pūtaḥ snātvā bhavennaraḥ / rudrastatra tapastepe devadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: A river named TamraparnI4 flows from that water collection. From the great forest of sandal trees, it flows towards the southern ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: A river named TamraparnI4 flows from that water collection. From the great forest of sandal trees, it flows towards the southern ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: A river named TamraparnI4 flows from that water collection. From the great forest of sandal trees, it flows towards the southern ocean.

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णे निहितं देवैर् नास्तिकानां निदर्शनम् । अब्राह्मणस्य सावित्रीं पठतस्तु प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: gokarṇe nihitaṃ devair nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam / abrāhmaṇasya sāvitrīṃ paṭhatastu praṇaśyati
verses.translation: Oyster shells from where pearls are produced are the conchs washed down to the great sea, carried by the river Tamra (TamraparnI).
verses.hindi: आवृत्ति के समय में अपने लिए भो हनन करके मेघों (पवित्रो) का भक्षण कर तेवे।५१। अपने अन्न का पाचन न करे ओर पशुओं का भी पाचन नहीं करना चाहिए। देवों तथा ब्राह्मणों के लिये यदि पकाया भी जावे तो शेष से लिप्त नहीं होता है ।५२। पहिले इस जगत् के उज्जीवन की ओर प्रवृत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Oyster shells from where pearls are produced are the conchs washed down to the great sea, carried by the river Tamra (TamraparnI).
verses.commentary: Sense: Oyster shells from where pearls are produced are the conchs washed down to the great sea, carried by the river Tamra (TamraparnI).

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिभवने शृङ्गे सिद्धचारणसेविते । आरुह्यतं निय मवांस्ततो याति त्रिविष्टपम्
verses.transliteration: devarṣibhavane śṛṅge siddhacāraṇasevite / āruhyataṃ niya mavāṃstato yāti triviṣṭapam
verses.translation: If devotees bring water containing conchs and pearls, they become free from mental agonies and physical ailments. They go to the celestial city Amaravati.
verses.hindi: बाली भगवती माया ने देवों-असुरों और मानवों का सृजन किया था। उनकी रक्षा के लिए चौदह पशुओं की मी रचना की थी उसी भाति यज्ञों की तथा उनके विधानों की भी रचना करके इनको बताया था
verses.wordMeaning: If devotees bring water containing conchs and pearls, they become free from mental agonies and physical ailments. They go to the celestial city Amaravati.
verses.commentary: Sense: If devotees bring water containing conchs and pearls, they become free from mental agonies and physical ailments. They go to the celestial city Amaravati.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यैश्चन्दनवृक्षैश्च पादपैरुपशोभितम् । आपश्चन्दनसंयुक्ताः स्पन्देति सततं ततः
verses.transliteration: divyaiścandanavṛkṣaiśca pādapairupaśobhitam / āpaścandanasaṃyuktāḥ spandeti satataṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: (The charitable gifts) of pearls and conchs produced from sandalwood cause the redemption of Pitrs even though they be perpetrators of sinful activities as mentioned in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: पापानामधिकं पापं हननं जीवजातिनाम् । एतस्मादधिकं पापं विश्वस्ते शरणं गते
verses.wordMeaning: (The charitable gifts) of pearls and conchs produced from sandalwood cause the redemption of Pitrs even though they be perpetrators of sinful activities as mentioned in the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The charitable gifts) of pearls and conchs produced from sandalwood cause the redemption of Pitrs even though they be perpetrators of sinful activities as mentioned in the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: नदी प्रवर्तते ताभ्यस्ताम्रपर्णीति नामतः । या चन्दनमहाखण्डाद्दक्षिणं याति सागरम्
verses.transliteration: nadī pravartate tābhyastāmraparṇīti nāmataḥ / yā candanamahākhaṇḍāddakṣiṇaṃ yāti sāgaram
verses.translation: A tributary of the Garig& at V&ragasl.
verses.hindi: विश्वस्य हत्वा पापिष्ठं शूद्रं वाप्यंत्यजातिजम् । ब्रह्महत्याधिक पापं तस्मान्नास्त्यस्य निष्कृतिः
verses.wordMeaning: A tributary of the Garig& at V&ragasl.
verses.commentary: Sense: A tributary of the Garig& at V&ragasl.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यास्तस्याश्च ताम्रायास्तूह्यमाना महोदधौ । शङ्खा भवन्ति शुक्त्यश्च जायते यासु मौक्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: nadyāstasyāśca tāmrāyāstūhyamānā mahodadhau / śaṅkhā bhavanti śuktyaśca jāyate yāsu mauktikam
verses.translation: River rising in Agastya-Kufa-Mountain Malaya flowing through old P&gya country to the Sea (the gulf of Manar) celebrated for pearl fishery. De. 203,HD.IV. 812.
verses.hindi: विश्वस्तद्रव्यहरणं तस्याप्यधिकमुच्यते । विश्वस्ते वाप्यविश्वस्ते न दरिद्रधनं हरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: River rising in Agastya-Kufa-Mountain Malaya flowing through old P&gya country to the Sea (the gulf of Manar) celebrated for pearl fishery. De. 203,HD.IV. 812.
verses.commentary: Sense: River rising in Agastya-Kufa-Mountain Malaya flowing through old P&gya country to the Sea (the gulf of Manar) celebrated for pearl fishery. De. 203,HD.IV. 812.

verses.sanskrit: उदकानयनं कृत्वा शङ्खमौक्तिकसंयुतम् । आधिभिर्व्याधिभिश्चैव मुक्ता यान्त्यमरावतीम्
verses.transliteration: udakānayanaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhamauktikasaṃyutam / ādhibhirvyādhibhiścaiva muktā yāntyamarāvatīm
verses.translation: The holy rites performed in the holy centres of the Srlparvata and the mountain Vaikrta fructify from the beginning to the end.
verses.hindi: ततो देवद्विजातीनां हेमरत्नापहारकम् । यो हन्यादविचारेण सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: The holy rites performed in the holy centres of the Srlparvata and the mountain Vaikrta fructify from the beginning to the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy rites performed in the holy centres of the Srlparvata and the mountain Vaikrta fructify from the beginning to the end.

verses.sanskrit: चन्दनेभ्यः प्रसूतानां शङ्खानां मौक्तिकस्य वा । पापकर्त्तॄनपि पितॄंस्तारयन्ति यथाश्रुति
verses.transliteration: candanebhyaḥ prasūtānāṃ śaṅkhānāṃ mauktikasya vā / pāpakarttṝnapi pitṝṃstārayanti yathāśruti
verses.translation: Birds that could move as they wish, go to heaven after taking bath in that sin-destroyi tank of Matanga on the Kailasa mountain.
verses.hindi: गुरुदेवद्विजसुहृतपुत्रस्वात्मसुखेषु च । स्तेयादधः क्रमेणेव दशोत्तरगणं स्वघम्
verses.wordMeaning: Birds that could move as they wish, go to heaven after taking bath in that sin-destroyi tank of Matanga on the Kailasa mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Birds that could move as they wish, go to heaven after taking bath in that sin-destroyi tank of Matanga on the Kailasa mountain.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रतीर्थे कुमार्यां च कावेरीप्रभवे क्षये । श्रीपर्वतस्य तीर्थेषु वैकृते च तथा गिरौ
verses.transliteration: candratīrthe kumāryāṃ ca kāverīprabhave kṣaye / śrīparvatasya tīrtheṣu vaikṛte ca tathā girau
verses.translation: In the following holy centres viz — the sacred spot of Saurparaka2, the mountain Palamafijara3 in the well of Pandukupa near the sea and the banks of the Pidaraka* which is free from sins and impurities, one shall perform the rite of
verses.hindi: इन्द्र देव ने कहा-हे भगवन् ! आपने हिसादि का सम्पूर्ण लक्षण बता दिया है । अब स्तेय का क्या लक्षण है--यह भी आप मेरे सामने विस्तार के साथ वर्णन कीजिए ।१। समस्त पापों में अधिक पाप जीव जातियों का हनन करना ही होता है। इससे भी अधिक पाप उसके हतन
verses.wordMeaning: In the following holy centres viz — the sacred spot of Saurparaka2, the mountain Palamafijara3 in the well of Pandukupa near the sea and the banks of the Pidaraka* which is free from sins and impurities, one shall perform the rite of
verses.commentary: Sense: In the following holy centres viz — the sacred spot of Saurparaka2, the mountain Palamafijara3 in the well of Pandukupa near the sea and the banks of the Pidaraka* which is free from sins and impurities, one shall perform the rite of

verses.sanskrit: एकस्था यत्र दृश्यन्ते वृक्षाह्यौशीरपर्वते । पलाशाः खदिरा बिल्वाः प्लक्षाश्वत्थविकङ्कताः
verses.transliteration: ekasthā yatra dṛśyante vṛkṣāhyauśīraparvate / palāśāḥ khadirā bilvāḥ plakṣāśvatthavikaṅkatāḥ
verses.translation: Sri Sailam in Kurnool District in Andhra Pradesh. One of the Twelve Jyotir-liAgas.
verses.hindi: करते का होता है जो विश्‍वस्त होवे तथा शरण में समागत हो गया हो
verses.wordMeaning: Sri Sailam in Kurnool District in Andhra Pradesh. One of the Twelve Jyotir-liAgas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sri Sailam in Kurnool District in Andhra Pradesh. One of the Twelve Jyotir-liAgas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं द्विमण्डलाविद्धं विज्ञेयं द्विजसत्तमाः । अस्मिंस्त्यक्त्वा जन्ॐऽगाति क्षिप्रं यात्यमरावतीम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dvimaṇḍalāviddhaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ / asmiṃstyaktvā janoṃ'gāti kṣipraṃ yātyamarāvatīm
verses.translation: Sopara, 4 miles NW. of Bassein in Thana District of Maharashtra — De. 197.
verses.hindi: विश्वास देकर पावि शूद्र वा अस्त्य जातिज हो जो उसका हनन करता है बह ब्रह्म हत्या से भो अधिक पाप होता है जिसका कोई भी प्रायश्चित्त ही नहीं होता है ।३। जो ब्रह्मज्ञ हो-दरिद्र हो और बड़ी ही कठिनाई से जिसने धन का अजन किया हो तया बहुत पुत्रों ओर कलवर वाला हो एवं उसी
verses.wordMeaning: Sopara, 4 miles NW. of Bassein in Thana District of Maharashtra — De. 197.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sopara, 4 miles NW. of Bassein in Thana District of Maharashtra — De. 197.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीपर्वतस्य तीर्थे तु वैकृते च तथा गिरौ । कर्माणि तु प्रयुक्ता नि सिद्ध्यन्ति प्रभवाप्यये
verses.transliteration: śrīparvatasya tīrthe tu vaikṛte ca tathā girau / karmāṇi tu prayuktā ni siddhyanti prabhavāpyaye
verses.translation: Near Suxparaka — HD IV 787.
verses.hindi: धन से जो जोवित रहने की इच्छा रखता हो उसके द्रव्य की चोरी इतना महान दोष होता है कि फिर उसका कोई भी प्रायश्चित नहीं होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Near Suxparaka — HD IV 787.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near Suxparaka — HD IV 787.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्प्रयुक्ता हि पितृषु सुप्रयोगा भवन्त्युत । पितॄणां दुहिता पुण्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा
verses.transliteration: duṣprayuktā hi pitṛṣu suprayogā bhavantyuta / pitṝṇāṃ duhitā puṇyā narmadā saritāṃ varā
verses.translation: The Sraddha performed at Puskara2 yields everlast- ing benefit. The penance performed there yields great fruit. One shall point out the same thing in the same manner on the shore of the great ocean and at Prabhasa3.
verses.hindi: जो विश्‍वस्त हो उसके द्रव्य के हरण करने का पाप उससे भी अधिक होता है विश्‍वस्त हो अथवा अविशवस्त हो दरिद्र के घन का हरण कभी नहीं करना चाहिए ।५। देवों और द्विजतियों के सुबर्ण तथा रत्नों के अपहरण करने बाले को जो विना ही विचार किये मार डालता है उसको अश्वमेघ
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha performed at Puskara2 yields everlast- ing benefit. The penance performed there yields great fruit. One shall point out the same thing in the same manner on the shore of the great ocean and at Prabhasa3.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha performed at Puskara2 yields everlast- ing benefit. The penance performed there yields great fruit. One shall point out the same thing in the same manner on the shore of the great ocean and at Prabhasa3.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र श्राद्धानि दत्तांनि ह्यक्षयाणि भवन्त्युत । माठरस्य वने पुण्ये सिद्धचारणसेविते
verses.transliteration: yatra śrāddhāni dattāṃni hyakṣayāṇi bhavantyuta / māṭharasya vane puṇye siddhacāraṇasevite
verses.translation: Somanathapattana in Saurashtra — one of the sacredmost Jyotir- lingas. It was demolished by Mahmud of Gazni but was reconstructed after Independence of India.
verses.hindi: यज्ञ का पुष्य फल प्राप्त होता है ।६। गुरु-देव-द्विज-पुत्र-ओर आत्म सुख के इनकी करता है उसका अध:क्रम से ही दश गुना उत्तर अघ होता
verses.wordMeaning: Somanathapattana in Saurashtra — one of the sacredmost Jyotir- lingas. It was demolished by Mahmud of Gazni but was reconstructed after Independence of India.
verses.commentary: Sense: Somanathapattana in Saurashtra — one of the sacredmost Jyotir- lingas. It was demolished by Mahmud of Gazni but was reconstructed after Independence of India.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्द्धानेन गच्छन्ति युक्त्वा तस्मिन्महा गिरौ । विन्ध्ये चैव गिरौ पुण्ये धर्माधर्मनिदर्शनीम्
verses.transliteration: antarddhānena gacchanti yuktvā tasminmahā girau / vindhye caiva girau puṇye dharmādharmanidarśanīm
verses.translation: The Pit rs become directly worshipped by him. In this world he will be one with perfect self-control. After death he becomes honoured in the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pit rs become directly worshipped by him. In this world he will be one with perfect self-control. After death he becomes honoured in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pit rs become directly worshipped by him. In this world he will be one with perfect self-control. After death he becomes honoured in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: धारां पापा न पश्यन्ति धारां पश्यन्ति साधवः । तत्र तद्दृश्यते पापं केषां चित्पापकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: dhārāṃ pāpā na paśyanti dhārāṃ paśyanti sādhavaḥ / tatra taddṛśyate pāpaṃ keṣāṃ citpāpakarmaṇām
verses.translation: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.hindi: पुरा कांचीपुरे जातो वञ्ाख्यो नाम चोरकः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the Madravas are holy. So also is the eddy named Siva. There the lake named Vyasa Saras is holy. So also is the divine Brahmahrada.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासे या मतङ्गस्य वापी पापनिषूदनी । स्नात्वा तस्या दिवं यान्ति कामचारा विहङ्गमाः
verses.transliteration: kailāse yā mataṅgasya vāpī pāpaniṣūdanī / snātvā tasyā divaṃ yānti kāmacārā vihaṅgamāḥ
verses.translation: The following have been created by the self-born lord — the Tirthas (named after) the Rk, Yajus and Saman, the Kapotas ( doves) and Puspas&hvayas (having the same name as flower) the fifth veda (characterised by) narratives i.e. the Puranas*.
verses.wordMeaning: The following have been created by the self-born lord — the Tirthas (named after) the Rk, Yajus and Saman, the Kapotas ( doves) and Puspas&hvayas (having the same name as flower) the fifth veda (characterised by) narratives i.e. the Puranas*.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following have been created by the self-born lord — the Tirthas (named after) the Rk, Yajus and Saman, the Kapotas ( doves) and Puspas&hvayas (having the same name as flower) the fifth veda (characterised by) narratives i.e. the Puranas*.

verses.sanskrit: शौर्पारके तथा तीर्थे पर्वते पालमञ्जरे । पाण्डुकूपे समुद्रान्ते पिण्डारकतटे तथा
verses.transliteration: śaurpārake tathā tīrthe parvate pālamañjare / pāṇḍukūpe samudrānte piṇḍārakataṭe tathā
verses.translation: A Brahmana who visits these places and resorts to fire becomes rid of his sins. The Sraddha performed in these
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who visits these places and resorts to fire becomes rid of his sins. The Sraddha performed in these
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who visits these places and resorts to fire becomes rid of his sins. The Sraddha performed in these

verses.sanskrit: विमले च विपापे च संकल्पं प्राप्य चाक्षयम् । श्रीवृक्षे चित्रकूटे च जंबूमार्गे च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: vimale ca vipāpe ca saṃkalpaṃ prāpya cākṣayam / śrīvṛkṣe citrakūṭe ca jaṃbūmārge ca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: In Aparanta as per HD.IV.815.
verses.wordMeaning: In Aparanta as per HD.IV.815.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Aparanta as per HD.IV.815.

verses.sanskrit: असितस्य गिरौ पुण्ये योगाचार्यस्य धीमतः । तत्रापि श्राद्धमानन्त्यमसितायां च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: asitasya girau puṇye yogācāryasya dhīmataḥ / tatrāpi śrāddhamānantyamasitāyāṃ ca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: In the great holy centre Pundarika the benefit is on a par with the white lotus (?). O highly intelligent one, the benefit in the Brahmatirtha is on a par with the performance of all Yajnas.
verses.wordMeaning: In the great holy centre Pundarika the benefit is on a par with the white lotus (?). O highly intelligent one, the benefit in the Brahmatirtha is on a par with the performance of all Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the great holy centre Pundarika the benefit is on a par with the white lotus (?). O highly intelligent one, the benefit in the Brahmatirtha is on a par with the performance of all Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करेष्वक्षयं श्राद्धं तपश्चैव महाफलमा । महोदधौ प्रभासे च तद्वदेव विनिर्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: puṣkareṣvakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ tapaścaiva mahāphalamā / mahodadhau prabhāse ca tadvadeva vinirdiśet
verses.translation: Sraddha must be offered in the Saptanada or parti- cularly in the Manasa. So also on the Mahakuta, the moun- tains Ananta and Trikakuda.
verses.hindi: अन्स्यज-शूदर-वेश्य-क्षत्रिय और ब्राह्मण से भी दश गुणोत्तर पापों से घन के हरण करने वाला लिप्त हुआ करता है ।८। इस विषय में एक पुराना इतिहास उदाहृत करते हैं । यह रहस्यों का भी अधिक रहस्य है और पापों का विनाश कर देने बाला है ।६। प्राचीन काल में काञ्चीपुर में एक बज
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha must be offered in the Saptanada or parti- cularly in the Manasa. So also on the Mahakuta, the moun- tains Ananta and Trikakuda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha must be offered in the Saptanada or parti- cularly in the Manasa. So also on the Mahakuta, the moun- tains Ananta and Trikakuda.

verses.sanskrit: देविकायां वृषो नाम कूपः सिद्धनिषेवितः । समुत्पतन्ति तस्यापो गवां शब्देन नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: devikāyāṃ vṛṣo nāma kūpaḥ siddhaniṣevitaḥ / samutpatanti tasyāpo gavāṃ śabdena nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: After resorting to them one by one in the evenings day by day, Sraddha should always be offered to the Pitts who seek everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: नाम वाला चोर उत्पन्न हुआ था । वह पुर ऐसा था कि वहां पर बड़ी रम्यता थी और वहाँ के निवासी जन सभी प्रकार के ऐश्वयं से युक्त नौरोग--दान्त-सुखो-ओर दयाचित ये ।१०। यह नगर सब तरह के ऐश्बयं से समन्वित था उससे बह तस्कर ने स्तोकास्तोक अर्थात् न्यूनाधिक क्रम से
verses.wordMeaning: After resorting to them one by one in the evenings day by day, Sraddha should always be offered to the Pitts who seek everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: After resorting to them one by one in the evenings day by day, Sraddha should always be offered to the Pitts who seek everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: योगेश्वरैः सदा जुष्टः सर्वपापबहिष्कृतः । दद्याच्छ्राद्धं तु यस्तस्मिंस्तस्य वक्ष्यामि यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: yogeśvaraiḥ sadā juṣṭaḥ sarvapāpabahiṣkṛtaḥ / dadyācchrāddhaṃ tu yastasmiṃstasya vakṣyāmi yatphalam
verses.translation: The seven sages had gone to the heaven after casting off their bark garments here. Even today those bark garments are seen in the waters.
verses.hindi: बहुत से धन का अपहरण किया था ।११। उसको वह जङ्गल में एक गड्ढा बनाकर लोभ से रख दिया करता था। उसका गोपन आधी रात में किया करता था। जब धन रख चला गया था तब किसी किरात ने वहाँ आकर उसको देखा था उसका दशम भाग उसमें से किरात ने ले लिया था । वह
verses.wordMeaning: The seven sages had gone to the heaven after casting off their bark garments here. Even today those bark garments are seen in the waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven sages had gone to the heaven after casting off their bark garments here. Even today those bark garments are seen in the waters.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं सर्वकामीयं श्राद्धं प्रीणाति वै पितॄन् । जातवेदः शिला तत्र साक्षादग्नेः सनातनात्
verses.transliteration: akṣayaṃ sarvakāmīyaṃ śrāddhaṃ prīṇāti vai pitṝn / jātavedaḥ śilā tatra sākṣādagneḥ sanātanāt
verses.translation: By taking the holy dip in that excellent holy river a man attains heaven. There is a well known shrine of Nandin which is resorted to by the Siddhas.
verses.hindi: तस्कर इसको नहीं जान पाया था । वह किरात तो काष्ठ का भार लेकर चला गया या ।१२-१३। वह तस्कर भो एक शिला से उस गड्ढे को ढक करा और मिट्टो से भरकर फिर उसी नगर में धन को तृष्णा से चला गथा था
verses.wordMeaning: By taking the holy dip in that excellent holy river a man attains heaven. There is a well known shrine of Nandin which is resorted to by the Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking the holy dip in that excellent holy river a man attains heaven. There is a well known shrine of Nandin which is resorted to by the Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धानि चाग्निकार्यं च तत्र कुर्यात्सदा क्षयम् । यस्त्वग्निं प्रविशेत्तत्र नाकपृष्ठे स मोदते
verses.transliteration: śrāddhāni cāgnikāryaṃ ca tatra kuryātsadā kṣayam / yastvagniṃ praviśettatra nākapṛṣṭhe sa modate
verses.translation: Devotees who circumambulate them become de- lighted and go to the heaven. The land all over Kuruksetra1 is especially a very good holy centre.
verses.hindi: मया काष्ठं समाहतु' गच्छता पथि निजने ।
verses.wordMeaning: Devotees who circumambulate them become de- lighted and go to the heaven. The land all over Kuruksetra1 is especially a very good holy centre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devotees who circumambulate them become de- lighted and go to the heaven. The land all over Kuruksetra1 is especially a very good holy centre.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निशान्तः पुनर्जातस्तत्र दत्तं ततो ऽक्षयम् । दशाश्वमेधिके तीर्थे तीर्थे पञ्चाश्वमेधिके
verses.transliteration: agniśāntaḥ punarjātastatra dattaṃ tato 'kṣayam / daśāśvamedhike tīrthe tīrthe pañcāśvamedhike
verses.translation: The holy sister of Yama and the splendid daughter of the sun (i.e. the Yamuna) is a sacred river. The oraddha there is always of everylasting benefit. This has been glorified formerly by the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: नित्यं संचरते विप्रो मामकानां गृहेषु यः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The holy sister of Yama and the splendid daughter of the sun (i.e. the Yamuna) is a sacred river. The oraddha there is always of everylasting benefit. This has been glorified formerly by the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy sister of Yama and the splendid daughter of the sun (i.e. the Yamuna) is a sacred river. The oraddha there is always of everylasting benefit. This has been glorified formerly by the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: यथोद्दिष्टफलं तेषां क्रतूनां नात्र संशयः । ख्यातं हयशिरो नाम तीर्थं सद्यो वरप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yathoddiṣṭaphalaṃ teṣāṃ kratūnāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / khyātaṃ hayaśiro nāma tīrthaṃ sadyo varapradam
verses.translation: By taking a holy dip in the eddy of Brahmakuna one becomes a iBrahmana instantly. The Sraddha (performed) there gives infinite bliss. So also are the Japa> Homa and penance.
verses.wordMeaning: By taking a holy dip in the eddy of Brahmakuna one becomes a iBrahmana instantly. The Sraddha (performed) there gives infinite bliss. So also are the Japa> Homa and penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking a holy dip in the eddy of Brahmakuna one becomes a iBrahmana instantly. The Sraddha (performed) there gives infinite bliss. So also are the Japa> Homa and penance.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं तत्र सदाक्षय्यं दाता स्वर्गे च मोदते । श्राद्धं सुंदनिसुंदे च देयं पापनिषू दनम्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ tatra sadākṣayyaṃ dātā svarge ca modate / śrāddhaṃ suṃdanisuṃde ca deyaṃ pāpaniṣū danam
verses.translation: Vasistha of great penance performed his austerities there standing still like a stump. Even today trees with jewels for their leaves are seen there.
verses.wordMeaning: Vasistha of great penance performed his austerities there standing still like a stump. Even today trees with jewels for their leaves are seen there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha of great penance performed his austerities there standing still like a stump. Even today trees with jewels for their leaves are seen there.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं तत्राक्षयं प्रोक्तं जपहोमतपांसि च । जतुङ्गे शुभे तीर्थे तर्पयेत्सततं पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ proktaṃ japahomatapāṃsi ca / jatuṅge śubhe tīrthe tarpayetsatataṃ pitṝn
verses.translation: The balance that indicated virtue and evil is also seen there. By means of that, the excellent benefit of the holy centres was weighed by the Brahmaras.
verses.wordMeaning: The balance that indicated virtue and evil is also seen there. By means of that, the excellent benefit of the holy centres was weighed by the Brahmaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The balance that indicated virtue and evil is also seen there. By means of that, the excellent benefit of the holy centres was weighed by the Brahmaras.

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यते पर्वसु च्छाया यत्र नित्यं दिवौकसाम् । पृथिव्यामक्षयं दत्तं विरजा यत्र पादपः
verses.transliteration: dṛśyate parvasu cchāyā yatra nityaṃ divaukasām / pṛthivyāmakṣayaṃ dattaṃ virajā yatra pādapaḥ
verses.translation: The source of the river Sarasvati in the hills of Sirmur in the Siwalik range of the Himalayas — De 180.
verses.hindi: इस रीति से बहुत सा धन चोर कर वज् ने भूमि में रख दिया उस किरात ने भो घर में आकर प्रसन्न होते हुए अपनो पत्नो से कहा या
verses.wordMeaning: The source of the river Sarasvati in the hills of Sirmur in the Siwalik range of the Himalayas — De 180.
verses.commentary: Sense: The source of the river Sarasvati in the hills of Sirmur in the Siwalik range of the Himalayas — De 180.

verses.sanskrit: योगेश्वरैः सदा जुष्टः सर्वपापबहिष्कृतः । दद्याच्छ्राद्धं तु यस्तस्मिंस्तस्य वक्ष्यामि यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: yogeśvaraiḥ sadā juṣṭaḥ sarvapāpabahiṣkṛtaḥ / dadyācchrāddhaṃ tu yastasmiṃstasya vakṣyāmi yatphalam
verses.translation: (The &raddha) in the Nanda which is on the North- eastern quarter of the VedI, yields the benefit oiAnivartana (non- return to samsara). It is the spot of spiritual achievement, resorted to by the gods after reaching which one never returns (i.e. attains liberation from samsara).
verses.hindi: मैने काष्ठ का समाहरण करने के लिए वन में गमन करते हुए मागे में यह धन प्राप्त किया है । है भीरु ! आपको तो धन की इच्छा है इसे अब अपने पास रक्खो ।१६। यह श्रवण करके उसने उस घन को ले लिया था और घर में अन्दर रख दिया था। फिर मन में कुछ गिन्तन करती हुई उसने अपने
verses.wordMeaning: (The &raddha) in the Nanda which is on the North- eastern quarter of the VedI, yields the benefit oiAnivartana (non- return to samsara). It is the spot of spiritual achievement, resorted to by the gods after reaching which one never returns (i.e. attains liberation from samsara).
verses.commentary: Sense: (The &raddha) in the Nanda which is on the North- eastern quarter of the VedI, yields the benefit oiAnivartana (non- return to samsara). It is the spot of spiritual achievement, resorted to by the gods after reaching which one never returns (i.e. attains liberation from samsara).

verses.sanskrit: अर्चितास्तेन वै साक्षाद्भवन्ति पितरः सदा । अस्मिंल्लोके वशी च स्यात्प्रेत्य स्वर्गे मही यते
verses.transliteration: arcitāstena vai sākṣādbhavanti pitaraḥ sadā / asmiṃlloke vaśī ca syātpretya svarge mahī yate
verses.translation: Mahadeva, the intelligent deity, imprinted his foot in the shrine Mahalaya for the purpose of merciful blessing of all living beings and as a proof of its efficacy for atheists ( to convince them that they are wrong).
verses.hindi: पति से यह वाक्य कहा था ।१७। जो यह बिभ्र हमारे घरों में नित्य ही सञ्चरण किया करता है । बह मुझ को देखकर कि यह थोड़े ही समय में बहुत भाग्य बाली हो गई है । चारों वर्णों की नारियों में यह यदि राज
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva, the intelligent deity, imprinted his foot in the shrine Mahalaya for the purpose of merciful blessing of all living beings and as a proof of its efficacy for atheists ( to convince them that they are wrong).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva, the intelligent deity, imprinted his foot in the shrine Mahalaya for the purpose of merciful blessing of all living beings and as a proof of its efficacy for atheists ( to convince them that they are wrong).

verses.sanskrit: प्रायशो मद्रवा पुण्या शिवो नाम ह्रदस्तथा । तत्र व्याससरः पुण्यं दिव्यो ब्रह्मह्रदस्तथा
verses.transliteration: prāyaśo madravā puṇyā śivo nāma hradastathā / tatra vyāsasaraḥ puṇyaṃ divyo brahmahradastathā
verses.translation: A lake at the foot of mount Candraprabha. The river Acchoda takes its rise from this lake. If identical with Acchoda-sarovara in Bina's. Kadambari, it is Acchavat, six miles from M&rtanda in Kashmir.
verses.hindi: पुरुष में वाल्मीकि के शापसे यह लक्ष्मी अधिक समथ तक नहों स्थित रहा करती है ।१८-१९। तो भी बहुत भाग्य वाले पुष्यं के पात्र के लिए यह वाक्य पूर्व में देखा गया है और यह कभी भो वृथा नहीं होता ।२०। अथवा जो घत अपने प्रयास से कष्ट के साय प्राप्त किया जाता है वह ही धन
verses.wordMeaning: A lake at the foot of mount Candraprabha. The river Acchoda takes its rise from this lake. If identical with Acchoda-sarovara in Bina's. Kadambari, it is Acchavat, six miles from M&rtanda in Kashmir.
verses.commentary: Sense: A lake at the foot of mount Candraprabha. The river Acchoda takes its rise from this lake. If identical with Acchoda-sarovara in Bina's. Kadambari, it is Acchavat, six miles from M&rtanda in Kashmir.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ज्जन्तः पर्वतः पुण्यो यत्र योगेश्वरालयः । अत्रैव चाश्रमः पुण्यो वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: ūrjjantaḥ parvataḥ puṇyo yatra yogeśvarālayaḥ / atraiva cāśramaḥ puṇyo vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Variously identified with a country round Jaipur in Orissa (ii)
verses.hindi: स्थिर होता है और अधिक समय पर्यन्त ठहरता है । इसके अतिरिक्त जो अनायास मिल जाता है वह कुछ ही समय में चला जाया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Variously identified with a country round Jaipur in Orissa (ii)
verses.commentary: Sense: Variously identified with a country round Jaipur in Orissa (ii)

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुः सामशिरसः कपोताः पुष्पसाह्वयाः । आख्यान पञ्चमा वेदाः सृष्टा ह्येते स्वयंभुवा
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥ sāmaśirasaḥ kapotāḥ puṣpasāhvayāḥ / ākhyāna pañcamā vedāḥ sṛṣṭā hyete svayaṃbhuvā
verses.translation: A place near the source of the Gandak, the place where Sage Pulaha and Bhar&ta performed penance.
verses.wordMeaning: A place near the source of the Gandak, the place where Sage Pulaha and Bhar&ta performed penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: A place near the source of the Gandak, the place where Sage Pulaha and Bhar&ta performed penance.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वैतान्मुच्यते पापद्द्विजो वह्निं समाश्रयन् । श्राद्धं चानन्त्यमेतेषु जपहोमतपांसि च
verses.transliteration: gatvaitānmucyate pāpaddvijo vahniṃ samāśrayan / śrāddhaṃ cānantyameteṣu japahomatapāṃsi ca
verses.translation: Due to its mention of K&ntipura (ancient name of Kathmandu) and its protection by Kir&tas, it may be located on the spurs of the Himalayas- to the North-East of Kathmandu (Nepal).
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its mention of K&ntipura (ancient name of Kathmandu) and its protection by Kir&tas, it may be located on the spurs of the Himalayas- to the North-East of Kathmandu (Nepal).
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its mention of K&ntipura (ancient name of Kathmandu) and its protection by Kir&tas, it may be located on the spurs of the Himalayas- to the North-East of Kathmandu (Nepal).

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीके महातीर्थे पुण्डरीकसमं फलम् । ब्रह्मतीर्थे महाप्राज्ञ सर्वयज्ञसमं फलम्
verses.transliteration: puṇḍarīke mahātīrthe puṇḍarīkasamaṃ phalam / brahmatīrthe mahāprājña sarvayajñasamaṃ phalam
verses.translation: In the forest called Devadaruvana1, there is a water- fall which is a proof of the removal of sins. The original sins of noble souls of good meritorious deeds are seen as they are being washed away.
verses.wordMeaning: In the forest called Devadaruvana1, there is a water- fall which is a proof of the removal of sins. The original sins of noble souls of good meritorious deeds are seen as they are being washed away.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the forest called Devadaruvana1, there is a water- fall which is a proof of the removal of sins. The original sins of noble souls of good meritorious deeds are seen as they are being washed away.

verses.sanskrit: सिंधुसागरसंभेदे तथा पञ्चनदे क्षयम् । विरजायां तथा पुण्यं मद्रवायां च पर्वते
verses.transliteration: siṃdhusāgarasaṃbhede tathā pañcanade kṣayam / virajāyāṃ tathā puṇyaṃ madravāyāṃ ca parvate
verses.translation: Sraddha should be scrupulously offered (with effort) in the city of Varanasi. The lord of the Yogic cult is always present there. What is offered there is of everlasting benefit.
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha should be scrupulously offered (with effort) in the city of Varanasi. The lord of the Yogic cult is always present there. What is offered there is of everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha should be scrupulously offered (with effort) in the city of Varanasi. The lord of the Yogic cult is always present there. What is offered there is of everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: देयं सप्तनदे श्राद्धं मानसे वा विशेषतः । महाकूटे ह्यनन्ते च गिरौ त्रिककुदे तथा
verses.transliteration: deyaṃ saptanade śrāddhaṃ mānase vā viśeṣataḥ / mahākūṭe hyanante ca girau trikakude tathā
verses.translation: By going to these holy centres one shall become endowed with the merit of pious liberality and gets sanctified. The Sraddha is of everlasting benefit. Whatever is performed, whether Japa, Homa or meditation shall become well done and meritorious.
verses.wordMeaning: By going to these holy centres one shall become endowed with the merit of pious liberality and gets sanctified. The Sraddha is of everlasting benefit. Whatever is performed, whether Japa, Homa or meditation shall become well done and meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: By going to these holy centres one shall become endowed with the merit of pious liberality and gets sanctified. The Sraddha is of everlasting benefit. Whatever is performed, whether Japa, Homa or meditation shall become well done and meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यायां च महानद्यां दृश्यते महादद्भुतम् । अश्रद्दधानं नाभ्येति सा चाभ्येति धृतव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyāyāṃ ca mahānadyāṃ dṛśyate mahādadbhutam / aśraddadhānaṃ nābhyeti sā cābhyeti dhṛtavratam
verses.translation: In the holy centres of Lauhitya2 Vaitarani, and
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy centres of Lauhitya2 Vaitarani, and
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy centres of Lauhitya2 Vaitarani, and

verses.sanskrit: संश्रयित्वैकमेकेन सायाह्नं प्रति नित्यशः । तस्मिन्देयं सदा श्राद्धं पितॄणामक्षयार्थिनाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃśrayitvaikamekena sāyāhnaṃ prati nityaśaḥ / tasmindeyaṃ sadā śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayārthinām
verses.translation: These are identified as follows: Prayaga (Allahabad); K&laftjara (Kalinjar in Badausa Sub-Division of Banda District, Bundelkhand (M.P. ); Dasarna (Eastern N. Malwa, including Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh, Vidiia was its capital); Naimisa (Nimsar, 45 miles NW of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh); Kurujangala (a forest country situated in Sirhind, NW of Hastinapur — De.
verses.wordMeaning: These are identified as follows: Prayaga (Allahabad); K&laftjara (Kalinjar in Badausa Sub-Division of Banda District, Bundelkhand (M.P. ); Dasarna (Eastern N. Malwa, including Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh, Vidiia was its capital); Naimisa (Nimsar, 45 miles NW of Lucknow,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These are identified as follows: Prayaga (Allahabad); K&laftjara (Kalinjar in Badausa Sub-Division of Banda District, Bundelkhand (M.P. ); Dasarna (Eastern N. Malwa, including Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh, Vidiia was its capital); Naimisa (Nimsar, 45 miles NW of Lucknow,…

verses.sanskrit: कृतात्मा वाकृतात्मा च यत्र विज्ञायते नरः । स्वर्गमार्गप्रदं नाम तीर्थं सद्यो वरप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtātmā vākṛtātmā ca yatra vijñāyate naraḥ / svargamārgapradaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ sadyo varapradam
verses.translation: The Sraddha offered at Dharmaprstha the lake of BrahmS. and Grdhravata is of great benefit.
verses.hindi: यह धन तो बिता ही श्रम के आपके पास आगया है ! इसका तो धर्माथं आपको विनियोग करना चाहिए । अतः आप इस धन से शुभ कमं वावड़ी-कूप और तालाब आदि के निर्माण करने में ब्यय कर दीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha offered at Dharmaprstha the lake of BrahmS. and Grdhravata is of great benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha offered at Dharmaprstha the lake of BrahmS. and Grdhravata is of great benefit.

verses.sanskrit: चीराण्युत्सृज्य यस्मिंस्तु दिवं सप्तर्षयो गाताः । अद्यापि तानि दृश्यन्ते चीराण्यंभोगतानि तु
verses.transliteration: cīrāṇyutsṛjya yasmiṃstu divaṃ saptarṣayo gātāḥ / adyāpi tāni dṛśyante cīrāṇyaṃbhogatāni tu
verses.translation: Snow falls there five Yojanas all around. The forest of the holy hermitage ofBharata is remembered as extremely meritorious.
verses.hindi: अपनी पत्नी के इस वचन का श्रवण करके जो कि आगे होने वाले भाग्य को सुबोधित करने बाला था उस किरात ने जहाँ-तहाँ पर देखा था कि सभी स्थल अधिक जल वाले ये ।२३। फिर ऐन्द्री दिशा में उसने एक विमल उदक बाला तलाब जो बहुत अधिक धन से बनाये जाने वाला था बनवाया था
verses.wordMeaning: Snow falls there five Yojanas all around. The forest of the holy hermitage ofBharata is remembered as extremely meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Snow falls there five Yojanas all around. The forest of the holy hermitage ofBharata is remembered as extremely meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा स्वर्गमवाप्नोति तस्मिंस्तीर्थेत्तमे नरः । ख्यातमायतनं तत्र नन्दिनः सिद्धसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā svargamavāpnoti tasmiṃstīrthettame naraḥ / khyātamāyatanaṃ tatra nandinaḥ siddhasevitam
verses.translation: The &raddha offered on the Trtiya (third) day of the lunar fortnight at the foot or in the circular zone of Niradha(?) or in the great eddy of the KausikI is of great benefit.
verses.hindi: जिसमें जल कभो भो क्षोण नहीं होता था ।२४ सः लबा बड काम करने बालों को दे देने पर भी वह काम अपूर्ण देखकर बहू से बेचैन हो गया था।२५। उसने सोचा कि उस वच्य नामक चोर के पीछे उसके बिना जाने हुए मैं गमन करूँ । उसने ही प्रायः भूमि में अधिक धन डाला ही
verses.wordMeaning: The &raddha offered on the Trtiya (third) day of the lunar fortnight at the foot or in the circular zone of Niradha(?) or in the great eddy of the KausikI is of great benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The &raddha offered on the Trtiya (third) day of the lunar fortnight at the foot or in the circular zone of Niradha(?) or in the great eddy of the KausikI is of great benefit.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वरस्य सा मूर्त्तिर्निराचारैर्नदृश्यते । दृश्यन्ते काञ्चना युपास्त्वर्चिषो भास्करोदये
verses.transliteration: nandīśvarasya sā mūrttirnirācārairnadṛśyate / dṛśyante kāñcanā yupāstvarciṣo bhāskarodaye
verses.translation: Here, a righteously inclined man casts of his sins within a short while, just like the serpent that quickly casts off its old slough.
verses.hindi: होगा ।२६। वहां-वह। से ही योड़ा-योड़ा करके बहुत-सा धन हरण करूँगा । ऐसा ही मन में निश्चय करके वह उसके बिना जाने हुए उसी के पीछे गया था ।२७। उसी भाँति से उसने उस धन का आहरण किया था और उस सेतु को पूर्ण कर दिया था । उस तालाब के मध्य में जिसके चारों ओर जल
verses.wordMeaning: Here, a righteously inclined man casts of his sins within a short while, just like the serpent that quickly casts off its old slough.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here, a righteously inclined man casts of his sins within a short while, just like the serpent that quickly casts off its old slough.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं तांस्तु गच्छन्त्यानन्दिता दिवम् । सर्वतश्च कुरुक्षेत्रं सुतीर्थं तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tāṃstu gacchantyānanditā divam / sarvataśca kurukṣetraṃ sutīrthaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Dandakaranya probably comprised all forests from Bundelkhand or Bhopal right down to the Godavari or the Krishna river. HD. IV.
verses.hindi: था, एक भगवान् विष्णु का प्रासाद भी बनवाया था
verses.wordMeaning: Dandakaranya probably comprised all forests from Bundelkhand or Bhopal right down to the Godavari or the Krishna river. HD. IV.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dandakaranya probably comprised all forests from Bundelkhand or Bhopal right down to the Godavari or the Krishna river. HD. IV.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यं सनत्कुमारस्य योगेशस्य महात्मनः । कीर्त्यते च तिलान्दत्त्वा पितृभ्योवै सदाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: puṇyaṃ sanatkumārasya yogeśasya mahātmanaḥ / kīrtyate ca tilāndattvā pitṛbhyovai sadākṣayam
verses.translation: A branch of the Narmada — Dc 39.
verses.wordMeaning: A branch of the Narmada — Dc 39.
verses.commentary: Sense: A branch of the Narmada — Dc 39.

verses.sanskrit: उक्तमेवाक्षयं श्राद्धं धर्मराजनिषेवितम् । श्राद्धं दत्तममावास्यां विधिना च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: uktamevākṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ dharmarājaniṣevitam / śrāddhaṃ dattamamāvāsyāṃ vidhinā ca yathākramam
verses.translation: A hill situated on the Western bank of the Phalgu river at Gaya HD.IV.827.
verses.wordMeaning: A hill situated on the Western bank of the Phalgu river at Gaya HD.IV.827.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hill situated on the Western bank of the Phalgu river at Gaya HD.IV.827.

verses.sanskrit: पुंसः सन्निहितायां तु कुरूक्षेत्रे विशेषतः । अर्चयित्वा पितॄंस्तत्र स पुत्रस्त्वनृणो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: puṃsaḥ sannihitāyāṃ tu kurūkṣetre viśeṣataḥ / arcayitvā pitṝṃstatra sa putrastvanṛṇo bhavet
verses.translation: It causes delight to the Siddhas. It is terrible to the sinners. It is protected by very terrible great serpents with their tongues moving up and down for licking.
verses.wordMeaning: It causes delight to the Siddhas. It is terrible to the sinners. It is protected by very terrible great serpents with their tongues moving up and down for licking.
verses.commentary: Sense: It causes delight to the Siddhas. It is terrible to the sinners. It is protected by very terrible great serpents with their tongues moving up and down for licking.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्यां विनशने प्लक्षप्रश्रवणे तथा । व्यासतीर्थे दृषद्वत्यां त्रिप्लक्षे च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyāṃ vinaśane plakṣapraśravaṇe tathā / vyāsatīrthe dṛṣadvatyāṃ triplakṣe ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: By taking their holy dip there, men go to heaven along with their physical bodies. It is cited that the Sraddha offered there is always of everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: काश्यपस्य ततों जज्ञे दित्यां दनुरिति स्मृत: ।
verses.wordMeaning: By taking their holy dip there, men go to heaven along with their physical bodies. It is cited that the Sraddha offered there is always of everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking their holy dip there, men go to heaven along with their physical bodies. It is cited that the Sraddha offered there is always of everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: देयमोङ्कारपवने श्राद्धमक्षयमिच्छता । शक्रावतारे गङ्गायां मैनाके च नगोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: deyamoṅkārapavane śrāddhamakṣayamicchatā / śakrāvatāre gaṅgāyāṃ maināke ca nagottame
verses.translation: By taking a holy dip there, a man redeems his body from its threefold indebtedness. One should perform Sraddha after taking bath in the Manasa lake.
verses.wordMeaning: By taking a holy dip there, a man redeems his body from its threefold indebtedness. One should perform Sraddha after taking bath in the Manasa lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking a holy dip there, a man redeems his body from its threefold indebtedness. One should perform Sraddha after taking bath in the Manasa lake.

verses.sanskrit: यमुनाप्रभवे चैव सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । अत्युष्णाश्चातिशीताश्च आपस्तस्मिन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: yamunāprabhave caiva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / atyuṣṇāścātiśītāśca āpastasminnidarśanam
verses.translation: The Candrabhaga (the* Ghinab ) and the Sindhu are two splendid rivers originating from the Manasa (lake). They flow into the western ocean. The divine Sindhu river is a big river.
verses.hindi: ततः पूर्वे च काले तु सुधर्मायां त्वयि स्थिते ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Candrabhaga (the* Ghinab ) and the Sindhu are two splendid rivers originating from the Manasa (lake). They flow into the western ocean. The divine Sindhu river is a big river.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Candrabhaga (the* Ghinab ) and the Sindhu are two splendid rivers originating from the Manasa (lake). They flow into the western ocean. The divine Sindhu river is a big river.

verses.sanskrit: यमस्य भगिनी पुष्या मार्त्तण्डदुहिता शुभा । तत्राक्षयं सदा श्राद्धं पितृभिः पूर्वकीर्त्तितम्
verses.transliteration: yamasya bhaginī puṣyā mārttaṇḍaduhitā śubhā / tatrākṣayaṃ sadā śrāddhaṃ pitṛbhiḥ pūrvakīrttitam
verses.translation: One who takes bath there, lives for ten thousand years. The Srdddha offered there is of limitless benefit and great rise (prosperity).
verses.wordMeaning: One who takes bath there, lives for ten thousand years. The Srdddha offered there is of limitless benefit and great rise (prosperity).
verses.commentary: Sense: One who takes bath there, lives for ten thousand years. The Srdddha offered there is of limitless benefit and great rise (prosperity).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मतुण्डह्रदे स्नात्वा सद्दयो भवति ब्राह्मणः । तस्मिंस्तु श्राद्धमानन्त्यं जपहोमतपांसि च
verses.transliteration: brahmatuṇḍahrade snātvā saddayo bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ / tasmiṃstu śrāddhamānantyaṃ japahomatapāṃsi ca
verses.translation: The Srdddha always redeems ten generations of predecessors and ten generations of successors.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र देव ने कहा--हे भगवन् ! आप तो सभी धर्मों के ज्ञान रखने बाले हैं और भूत वत्त मान और भविष्य के ज्ञान वाले हैं। आपने दुष्कृत और उसका प्रतीकार भली भाँति से वणित कर दिया है ।१। अब आप मुझे यही बताने की कृपा करें मुझे यह आपत्ति किस कर्म के विपाक से प्राप्त हुई
verses.wordMeaning: The Srdddha always redeems ten generations of predecessors and ten generations of successors.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Srdddha always redeems ten generations of predecessors and ten generations of successors.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाणुभूतो ऽचरत्तत्र वसिष्टो वै महातपाः । अद्यापि तत्र दृश्यन्ते पादपा मणिबर्हणाः
verses.transliteration: sthāṇubhūto 'carattatra vasiṣṭo vai mahātapāḥ / adyāpi tatra dṛśyante pādapā maṇibarhaṇāḥ
verses.translation: All the oceans and the rivers flowing into the oceans are sacred all round. A learned man should perform Srdddha in the holy centres like these and others.
verses.hindi: है और इसका प्रायश्चित्त क्या हो सकता है ? आप तो बोलने वालों में भी परम श्रेष्ठ हैं ।२। बृहस्पतिजी ने कहा--काश्यप मुनि की पत्नी दिति में दनु नाम वालो कन्या ने जन्म ग्रहण किया चा । वह कन्या रूपकतों थी। पिता ने उसको धाता फो दी थी ।३। उसका पुत्र फिर महतो द्य ति वाला विश्व-
verses.wordMeaning: All the oceans and the rivers flowing into the oceans are sacred all round. A learned man should perform Srdddha in the holy centres like these and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the oceans and the rivers flowing into the oceans are sacred all round. A learned man should perform Srdddha in the holy centres like these and others.

verses.sanskrit: तुला तु दृश्यते तत्र धर्मान्धर्मनिधर्शिनी । यथा वै तोलितं विप्रैस्तीर्थानां फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tulā tu dṛśyate tatra dharmāndharmanidharśinī / yathā vai tolitaṃ vipraistīrthānāṃ phalamuttamam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: रूप उत्पन्न हुमा था वह भगवान नारायण में ही परायण था तथा वेद बैदाजूों का पारगामी विद्वान था ।४। इसके उपरान्त उस देत्येश्वर ने भृगु के पुत्र पुरोहितजी से कहा था कि आप देवों में वासव की हो भांति राज्य में अधिकृत हैं।५। फिर पूबंकाल में देवों को सभा में आप जब स्थित थे तब
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणां दुहिता योगा गन्धकालीति विश्रुता । चतुर्थो ब्रह्मणस्त्वंशः पराशरकुलोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāṃ duhitā yogā gandhakālīti viśrutā / caturtho brahmaṇastvaṃśaḥ parāśarakulodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: आपने ऋषियों को सन्निधि में कोई प्रश्न किया था ।६। संसार अथवा तीथं यात्रा इन दोनों में कौन अधिक गुण बाला है । अब आप मेरे पर अनुग्रह करके उसका निश्चय करके मुझे बतलाइए
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: व्यसिष्यति चतुर्द्धा वै वेदं धीमान्महामुनिः । महायोगं महात्मानं या व्यासं जनयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: vyasiṣyati caturddhā vai vedaṃ dhīmānmahāmuniḥ / mahāyogaṃ mahātmānaṃ yā vyāsaṃ janayiṣyati
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: अच्छोदकं नामसरस्तत्राच्छोदासमुद्भवः । मत्स्ययोनौ पुनर्जाता नियोगात्कारणेन तु
verses.transliteration: acchodakaṃ nāmasarastatrācchodāsamudbhavaḥ / matsyayonau punarjātā niyogātkāraṇena tu
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्त्वाद्याश्रमे पुण्ये पुण्यकृद्भिर्निषेविते । दत्तं सकृदपि श्राद्धमक्षयं समुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāstvādyāśrame puṇye puṇyakṛdbhirniṣevite / dattaṃ sakṛdapi śrāddhamakṣayaṃ samudāhṛtam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: कर्मभूमि व्रजेः शीघ्रः दारिद्र्येण मिती: मुत: ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यां योगसमाधानं दत्तं युगपदुद्भवेत् । कुबेरतुङ्गे पापघ्नं व्यासतीर्थेतथैव च
verses.transliteration: nadyāṃ yogasamādhānaṃ dattaṃ yugapadudbhavet / kuberatuṅge pāpaghnaṃ vyāsatīrthetathaiva ca
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: एवं प्रकुपितं: शप्तः खिन्न: कांची समाविशम्
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यायां ब्रह्मणो वेद्यां श्राद्धमानन्त्यमिष्यते । सिद्धैस्तु सेविता नित्यं दृश्यते तु कृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: puṇyāyāṃ brahmaṇo vedyāṃ śrāddhamānantyamiṣyate / siddhaistu sevitā nityaṃ dṛśyate tu kṛtātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: अनिवर्तनं तु नन्दायां वेद्याः प्रागुत्तरदिशि । सिद्धिक्षेत्रं सुरैर्जुष्टं यत्प्राप्य न निवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: anivartanaṃ tu nandāyāṃ vedyāḥ prāguttaradiśi / siddhikṣetraṃ surairjuṣṭaṃ yatprāpya na nivarttate
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: स्वस्रीयो दानवानां त्, देवानां च पुरोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: महालये पदं न्यस्तं महादेवेन धीमता । भूतानामनुकंपार्थं नास्तिकानां निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: mahālaye padaṃ nyastaṃ mahādevena dhīmatā / bhūtānāmanukaṃpārthaṃ nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: विरजे त्वक्षयं श्राद्धं पूर्वमेव महालये । नन्दायां विरजे चैव तथैव च महालये
verses.transliteration: viraje tvakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ pūrvameva mahālaye / nandāyāṃ viraje caiva tathaiva ca mahālaye
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: उस प्रश्‍न का उत्तर बताने के लिए उनने सबने उपक्रम किया था। उसके प्व ही मैंने विधाता के बल से पूब में ही शीघ्र कहा था कि तीथंयात्रा संसार से समधिक है । यह सुनकर वे सब ऋषिगण शत प्रकुपित हो गये थे और उन्होंने मुझको शाप दे दिया था ।८-६। कर्म भूमि में मित सुतों के
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं तारयन्तीह दशपूर्वान्दशापरान् । काकह्रदे जातिस्मर्यं सुवर्णममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ tārayantīha daśapūrvāndaśāparān / kākahrade jātismaryaṃ suvarṇamamitaujasam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: सहित दरिद्रता से युक्त होकर गमन कर जाओ । इस तरह कुपित ऋषियों के द्वारा शाप दिया हुआ मैं काळ्जो में प्रवेश कर गया था ।१०। चिन्ता से विकल पुरोहितजी ने हीन पुरी का अवलोकन करके आपके द्वारा देवों के सहित बड़े हो आदर से पौरोहित्य कमं के लिए उनसे प्रार्थना की गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: कौमारं च सरः पुण्यं नागभोगाभिरक्षितम् । कुमारतीर्थे स्नात्वा तु त्रिदिवं याति मानवः
verses.transliteration: kaumāraṃ ca saraḥ puṇyaṃ nāgabhogābhirakṣitam / kumāratīrthe snātvā tu tridivaṃ yāti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: ।११। तापसो में श्रेष्ठ विश्व रूप से जब प्रार्थना की गयी थी तो वहु दानबों का तो बहिन का पुत्र था और देवों का पुरोहित था ।१२। उस महान तपस्वी ने बैत्यों में भो अत्यधिक बेर नहीं किया था। उस समय में देत्येन्द्र और इन्द्र दोनों तुल्य बल वाले हुए ये ।१३। इसके पश्चात् है राजन् ! दानवेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: देवालये तपस्तस्वा एकपादेन दुश्चरम् । निराहारो युगं दिव्यमुमातुङ्गो स्थितो ज्वलन्
verses.transliteration: devālaye tapastasvā ekapādena duścaram / nirāhāro yugaṃ divyamumātuṅgo sthito jvalan
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: के स्वल्लोय पर आप कुपित हो गये ये ओर उसका हनन करने की इच्छा रखते हुए औीध्र हो तप के साधन वन में चला गया था
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: उमातुङ्गे भृगोस्तुङ्गे ब्रह्मतुङ्गे महालये । तत्र श्राद्धानि देयानि नित्यमक्षयमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: umātuṅge bhṛgostuṅge brahmatuṅge mahālaye / tatra śrāddhāni deyāni nityamakṣayamicchatā
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं तु सदा श्राद्धं शालग्रामे समन्ततः । दुष्कृतं दृश्यते तत्र प्रत्यक्षमकृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: akṣayaṃ tu sadā śrāddhaṃ śālagrāme samantataḥ / duṣkṛtaṃ dṛśyate tatra pratyakṣamakṛtātmanām
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यदेशो ह्यशिष्टानां शिष्टानां च विशेषतः । तत्र देवह्रदः पुण्यो ब्रह्मणो नागराट् शुचिः
verses.transliteration: pratyadeśo hyaśiṣṭānāṃ śiṣṭānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / tatra devahradaḥ puṇyo brahmaṇo nāgarāṭ śuciḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: तेन पापेन संयुक्त: पीडितश्च मुहुमु हु: ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डं गृह्णति हि सतां न गृह्णात्यसतां सदा । अतिप्रदीप्तैर्भुजगैर्भोक्तुमन्नं न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: piṇḍaṃ gṛhṇati hi satāṃ na gṛhṇātyasatāṃ sadā / atipradīptairbhujagairbhoktumannaṃ na śakyate
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: ततस्तस्य वचः श्रूत्वा ज्ञात्वा तु मुनिवाक्यतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यते धर्मस्तीर्थयोर्नतयोर्द्वयोः । कारवत्यां च शाण्डिल्यां गुहायां वामनस्य च
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate dharmastīrthayornatayordvayoḥ / kāravatyāṃ ca śāṇḍilyāṃ guhāyāṃ vāmanasya ca
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा चैतानि पूतःस्याच्छ्रदद्धमक्षयमेव च । जपो होमस्तपो ध्यानं यत्किञ्चित्सुकृतं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: gatvā caitāni pūtaḥsyācchradaddhamakṣayameva ca / japo homastapo dhyānaṃ yatkiñcitsukṛtaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: निः श्रीको भवतु क्षिप्र मम शापेन बासवः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यं च यौ धत्ते गुरुभक्तिं शतं समाः । एवमाद्यास्सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा यत्स्नानादघमोक्षणम् । कुमारधारा तत्रैव दृष्टा पापं प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryaṃ ca yau dhatte gurubhaktiṃ śataṃ samāḥ / evamādyāssaricchreṣṭhā yatsnānādaghamokṣaṇam / kumāradhārā tatraiva dṛṣṭā pāpaṃ praṇaśyati
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानासनं तु तत्रैव व्यासस्याद्यापि दृश्यते । शैलः कान्तिपुराभ्याशे प्रागुदीच्यां दिशि स्थितः
verses.transliteration: dhyānāsanaṃ tu tatraiva vyāsasyādyāpi dṛśyate / śailaḥ kāntipurābhyāśe prāgudīcyāṃ diśi sthitaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: त्वया मया च रहिताः सर्वे देवाः पलायिताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्य पुष्करिणी तत्र किरातगणरक्षिता । यस्यां स्नात्वा सकृद्विप्रः कामानाप्नोति शाश्वतान्
verses.transliteration: puṇya puṣkariṇī tatra kirātagaṇarakṣitā / yasyāṃ snātvā sakṛdvipraḥ kāmānāpnoti śāśvatān
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां देववच्चरते महीम्
verses.transliteration: adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ devavaccarate mahīm
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: काश्यपस्य महातीर्थं कालसर्पिरिति श्रुतम् । तत्र श्राद्धानि देयानि नित्यमक्षयमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: kāśyapasya mahātīrthaṃ kālasarpiriti śrutam / tatra śrāddhāni deyāni nityamakṣayamicchatā
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: मुनियों के साथ आसन पर स्थित उसको तोन शिखरों बाले पर्वत के समान बेदत्रयी से दिशाओं का भाग मुखरित हो रहा था और वह ब्रह्मानन्द में एकनिष्ठ था तथा सब भूतों का हितकर था उसको ऐसा मान कर ईशानुकूलित या । आपने ही एक साथ उसके शिरों को काट दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: देवदारुवने वापि धारायास्तु निदर्शनम् । निर्धूतानि तु पापानि दृश्यन्ते सुकृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: devadāruvane vāpi dhārāyāstu nidarśanam / nirdhūtāni tu pāpāni dṛśyante sukṛtātmanām
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: जाकर बहुत वर्षों तक रहा या ।१७। इसके अनन्तर उसके बचन का श्रवण करके और मुनि के वाकय से जान प्राप्त करके पुत्र शोक से सन्तप्त होकर क्रोध से समन्वित उसने आपको शाप दे दिया था ।१८। इन्द्र मेरे शाप से शीक ही श्री से विहीन हो जावे । फिर सभी देवगण बिना नाथ वाले हो
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: भागीरथ्यां प्रयागे तु नित्यमक्षयमुच्यते । कालञ्जरे दशार्णायां नैमिषे कुरुजाङ्गले
verses.transliteration: bhāgīrathyāṃ prayāge tu nityamakṣayamucyate / kālañjare daśārṇāyāṃ naimiṣe kurujāṅgale
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: गथे थे ओर विषाद से युक्त हो गये थे तथा दंत्यों के द्वारा उत्पीडित हो गये ये।१९। तुम्हारे ढवारा और मेरे द्वारा रहित सभी देव भाग गये थे । वे सब देवगण ब्रह्माजी के निवास स्थान में जाकर प्रणाम करके सम्पूणं वृत्त उनसे कह् दिया था ।२०। इसके पश्चातु ब्रह्माजी ने उसके पाप की प्रतिक्रिया का
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यां नगर्यां च देयं श्राद्धं प्रयत्नतः । तत्र योगेश्वरो नित्यं तस्यां दत्तमथाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasyāṃ nagaryāṃ ca deyaṃ śrāddhaṃ prayatnataḥ / tatra yogeśvaro nityaṃ tasyāṃ dattamathākṣayam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: चिन्तन किया था किन्तु उस समय में ब्रह्माजी उसकी कोई भी प्रतिक्रिया न जान सके थे
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा चैतानि पूर्तः स्याच्छ्राद्धमक्षय्यमेव च । जबो होमस्तथा ध्यानं यत्किञ्चित्सुकृतं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: gatvā caitāni pūrtaḥ syācchrāddhamakṣayyameva ca / jabo homastathā dhyānaṃ yatkiñcitsukṛtaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: लौहित्ये वैतरण्यां चस्वर्गवेद्यां तथैव च । सा तु देवी समुद्रान्ते दृश्यते चैव नामभिः
verses.transliteration: lauhitye vaitaraṇyāṃ casvargavedyāṃ tathaiva ca / sā tu devī samudrānte dṛśyate caiva nāmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: गयायां धर्मवृष्ठे तु सरसि ब्रह्मणस्तथा । गयां गृध्रवटे चैव श्राद्धं दत्तं महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: gayāyāṃ dharmavṛṣṭhe tu sarasi brahmaṇastathā / gayāṃ gṛdhravaṭe caiva śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ mahāphalam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: हिमं च पतते तत्र समन्तात्पञ्चयो जनम् । भरतस्याश्रमे पुण्ये ऽरण्यं पुण्यतमं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: himaṃ ca patate tatra samantātpañcayo janam / bharatasyāśrame puṇye 'raṇyaṃ puṇyatamaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: मतङ्गस्य वनं तत्र दृश्यते सर्वमानुषैः । स्थापितं धर्मसर्वस्वं लोकस्यास्य निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: mataṅgasya vanaṃ tatra dṛśyate sarvamānuṣaiḥ / sthāpitaṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ lokasyāsya nidarśanam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: मम शापो वृथा न स्यादस्तु कालांतरे भुने
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: यद्दण्डकवनं पुण्यं पुण्यकृद्भिर्निषेवितम् । यस्मिन्प्राहुर्विशल्येति तीर्थं सद्यो निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: yaddaṇḍakavanaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyakṛdbhirniṣevitam / yasminprāhurviśalyeti tīrthaṃ sadyo nidarśanam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर जब कोई भो प्रतिक्रिया समश में नहीं आयी तो ब्रह्माजी
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: तुलामानैस्तथा चापि शास्त्रैश्च विविधैस्तथा । उन्मच्चन्ति तथा लग्न ये वै पापकृतो जनाः
verses.transliteration: tulāmānaistathā cāpi śāstraiśca vividhaistathā / unmaccanti tathā lagna ye vai pāpakṛto janāḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: देवों से घिरे हुए ही भगवान् नारासण के समोप में पहुँचे थे ।२२। सर्व प्रथम उन्होंने नारायण को प्रणाम किया था फिर स्तुति की थी और इसके उपरान्त यह वृत्तान्त उनकी सेवा में कहा था । उन लोकों के नायक प्रभु ने कृपाकर बहुत विचिन्तिन करके विचार किया था ।२३। उसके अघ को
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयायां तथा पादे निराधायां तु मण्डले । महाह्रदे च कौशिक्यां दत्तं श्राद्धं महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā pāde nirādhāyāṃ tu maṇḍale / mahāhrade ca kauśikyāṃ dattaṃ śrāddhaṃ mahāphalam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: तीत भागों में विभक्त करने तीन स्यातों में अपित कर दिया था। स्त्रियों में--बृक्षा में और भूमि में उसको रख दिया था और उनको वरदान भी दिया था। उस अघ के देने के बदले में हो तीनों को तीन वरदान दिये थे । ।२४ उस समय में जब ऋतुकाल हो तो स्वामी के साथ संयोग से पुत्र की
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: मुण्डपृष्टे पदं न्यस्तं महादेवेन धीमता । बहुदेवयुगांस्तप्त्वा तपस्तीव्रं सुदश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: muṇḍapṛṣṭe padaṃ nyastaṃ mahādevena dhīmatā / bahudevayugāṃstaptvā tapastīvraṃ sudaścaram
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: आप्ति हो जायगी । वृक्षों का छेदन में पुनः जन्म धारण कर लेना हो जायगा ।२४। भूमि में गत्त कर दिया जाये तो वह अपने आप ही कुछ समय में भर जायगा--ये तीनों को तीन बरदान मधुसूदन प्रभु ने दिये ये । उसका अघ शीघ्र ही तीनों में प्रभूत हो गया था--स्त्रियों ये रजोदशंत-
