verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पेनाप्यत्र कालेन नरो धर्मपरायणः । पाप्मानमुत्सृजत्याशु जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः
verses.transliteration: alpenāpyatra kālena naro dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / pāpmānamutsṛjatyāśu jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: वृक्षों में गोद और भूमि में ऊपर में उसी अघ के कारण हुआ था ।२६। तुम इन्द्र उस गहन अघ से निकल गये ये और देव नायक के फिर परमेष्ठी के प्रसाद से राज्य की श्री को प्राप्न करने वाले हो गये थे ।२७। उसके द्वारा धाता को इस प्रकार सान्त्वना दी थी और ननादंन अमु से कहा या! हे
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धानां प्रीतिजननं पपानां च भयङ्करम् । लेलिहानैर्महाघोरै रक्ष्यते सुमहोरगैः
verses.transliteration: siddhānāṃ prītijananaṃ papānāṃ ca bhayaṅkaram / lelihānairmahāghorai rakṣyate sumahoragaiḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: मुने ! मेरा शाप वृथा नहीं होगा और अन्य काल में होगा ।२ना
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना कनकनन्दीति तीर्थं जगति विश्रुतम् । उदीच्यां मुण्डपृष्टस्य ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: nāmnā kanakanandīti tīrthaṃ jagati viśrutam / udīcyāṃ muṇḍapṛṣṭasya brahmarṣigaṇasevitam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवंयान्ति स्वशरीरेण मानवाः । दत्तं वापि सदा श्राद्धमक्षय्यं समुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā divaṃyānti svaśarīreṇa mānavāḥ / dattaṃ vāpi sadā śrāddhamakṣayyaṃ samudāhṛtam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: ऋणैस्त्रिभिस्ततः स्नात्वा निष्क्रीणाति नरस्तनुम् । मानसे सरसि स्नात्वा श्राद्धंनिर्वर्त्तयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: ṛṇaistribhistataḥ snātvā niṣkrīṇāti narastanum / mānase sarasi snātvā śrāddhaṃnirvarttayettataḥ

verses.hindi: स्ंज्ञेन शिवेनाथ : पितो भगवान्मुनिः । दर्वासास्त्वन्मदश्रंशं कत्त्'कामा शशाप ह
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: तीरे तु सरसस्तस्य देवस्या यतनं महत् । आरुह्य तु जपंस्तत्र सिद्धो याति दिवं ततः
verses.transliteration: tīre tu sarasastasya devasyā yatanaṃ mahat / āruhya tu japaṃstatra siddho yāti divaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरं मानसं गत्वासिद्धिं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् । स्नात्वा तस्मिन्सरश्रेष्ठे दृश्यते महादद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: uttaraṃ mānasaṃ gatvāsiddhiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām / snātvā tasminsaraśreṣṭhe dṛśyate mahādadbhutam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: न यज्ञाः संप्रवत्तंते न दानानि च वासव ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: दिवश्च्युता महाभागा ह्यन्तरिक्षे विराजते । गङ्गा त्रिपथगा देवी विष्णुपादाच्च्युता सती
verses.transliteration: divaścyutā mahābhāgā hyantarikṣe virājate / gaṅgā tripathagā devī viṣṇupādāccyutā satī
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशे दृश्यते तत्र तोरणं सूर्यसन्निभम् । जांबूनदमयं पुण्यं स्वगद्वारमिवायतम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśe dṛśyate tatra toraṇaṃ sūryasannibham / jāṃbūnadamayaṃ puṇyaṃ svagadvāramivāyatam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवर्त्तते भूयः सर्वसागरमण्डिका । पावनी सर्वभूतानां धर्मज्ञानां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravarttate bhūyaḥ sarvasāgaramaṇḍikā / pāvanī sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmajñānāṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रभागा च सिद्धुश्च शुभे मानससंभवे । सागरं पश्चिमं यातो दिव्यः सिंधुनदो वरः
verses.transliteration: candrabhāgā ca siddhuśca śubhe mānasasaṃbhave / sāgaraṃ paścimaṃ yāto divyaḥ siṃdhunado varaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: उन अपरिमित तेज बाले मुनि के इस वचन का श्रवण करके भग- वान उस समय में चुप चाप ही वहां से चले गये ये क्योंकि ये तो आगे होने वाले कार्य का ज्ञान रखने वाले ये।२९। आप इतने समय तक त्रिलोकी का पालन करते हुए ऐश्वयं के मद से मत्तता होने के कारण से आपने
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतो हिमवान्नाम नानाधातुविभूषितः । आयतो वै सहस्राणि योजनानां बहुनि तु
verses.transliteration: parvato himavānnāma nānādhātuvibhūṣitaḥ / āyato vai sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ bahuni tu
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: कैलाश पर्वत को पीड़ित किया था ।३०। इसके अनन्तर सर्वज्ञ भगवान शिव ने भगवान मुनि को भेजा था । दुर्वासा जी ने आपके मद को भश करने की ही इच्छा से शाप दिया था ।३१। इन दोनों शापों का एक फल हुआ है । अब देखिए यह त्रेलोक्य श्री से रहित हो गया ।३२। है वासव !
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णा देवर्षिगणसेविता । तत्र पुष्करिणी रम्या सुषुम्णा नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇā devarṣigaṇasevitā / tatra puṣkariṇī ramyā suṣumṇā nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: न तो अब यज्ञ संप्रवृत्त हो हो रहे हैं और न दान ही दिये जा रहे हैं और इस समय में तो कहीं पर भो यम-नियम और तपश्‍चर्या कुछ भी नहीं हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि तस्यां स्नातस्तु जीवति । श्राद्धं भवति चानन्तं तत्र दत्तं महोदयम्
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tasyāṃ snātastu jīvati / śrāddhaṃ bhavati cānantaṃ tatra dattaṃ mahodayam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: कि इनका चित्त उपहृत सा हो गया है । इनमें सत्व नाम मात्र को भी नहीं है--ये बेयं से हीन हो गये हैं तथा बहुधा ये सब नास्तिक हो गये हैं। जो ईष्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास नहीं रखते हैं बे नास्तिक होते हैं ।३४। यह
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: तारयेच्च सदा श्राद्धे दशपूर्वान्दशापरान् । सर्वत्र हिमवान्पुण्यो गङ्गा पुण्या समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: tārayecca sadā śrāddhe daśapūrvāndaśāparān / sarvatra himavānpuṇyo gaṅgā puṇyā samantataḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रगाः समुद्राश्च सर्वे पुण्याः समन्ततः । एवमादिषु चान्येषु श्राद्धं निर्वर्तयेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: samudragāḥ samudrāśca sarve puṇyāḥ samantataḥ / evamādiṣu cānyeṣu śrāddhaṃ nirvartayedbudhaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: भूमि ओषधिवों के रस से विोन है ओर अधिकतया वोये होना हो गयो है। यह सूर्य भी धूसर आकार वाला है तथा चन्द्रमा में कान्ति का अमाव दिखाई देना है ३५ निस्तेजस्को हविर्भोक्ता मरुद्धूलिकृताकृति: ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: पुतो भवति वै स्नात्वा हुत्वा दत्त्वा तथैव च । शेलसानुषु शृङ्गेषु कन्दरेषु गुहासु च
verses.transliteration: puto bhavati vai snātvā hutvā dattvā tathaiva ca / śelasānuṣu śṛṅgeṣu kandareṣu guhāsu ca
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: दुबंला देवताः सर्वा विभांत्यन्यादृशा इव । विनष्टप्रायमेवास्ति त्रेलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: उपह्वरनितंबेषु तथा प्रस्रवणेषु च । पुलिनेष्वापगानां च तथैव प्रभवेषु च
verses.transliteration: upahvaranitaṃbeṣu tathā prasravaṇeṣu ca / pulineṣvāpagānāṃ ca tathaiva prabhaveṣu ca
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: महोदधौ गवां गोष्टे संगमेषु वनेषु च । सुसंमृष्टोपलिप्तेषु त्दृद्येषु सुरभिष्वथ
verses.transliteration: mahodadhau gavāṃ goṣṭe saṃgameṣu vaneṣu ca / susaṃmṛṣṭopalipteṣu tdṛdyeṣu surabhiṣvatha
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: गोमयेनोपलिप्तेषु विविक्तेषु गृहेषु च । कुर्याच्छ्राद्धमथैतेषु नित्यमेव यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: gomayenopalipteṣu vivikteṣu gṛheṣu ca / kuryācchrāddhamathaiteṣu nityameva yathāvidhi
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्दक्षिणां दिशं गत्वा सर्वकामचिकीर्षया । एवमेतेषु सर्वेषु श्राद्धं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: prāgdakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ gatvā sarvakāmacikīrṣayā / evameteṣu sarveṣu śrāddhaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: एतेष्वेव तु मेधावी ब्राह्मीं सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् । त्रैवर्णविहितैः स्थाने धर्मे वर्णाश्रमे रतैः
verses.transliteration: eteṣveva tu medhāvī brāhmīṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt / traivarṇavihitaiḥ sthāne dharme varṇāśrame rataiḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: कौपस्थानं च संत्यागात्प्राप्यते पितृपूजनम् । तीर्थान्यनुसरन्वीरः श्रद्दधानः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: kaupasthānaṃ ca saṃtyāgātprāpyate pitṛpūjanam / tīrthānyanusaranvīraḥ śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: हवि का भोक्ता अग्नि तेजसे शून्य है तथा मरुत् धूलि कृत आकृति वाला है । समस्त दिशायें प्रसन्न नहीं हैं और नभो मण्डल में निर्मलता का अभाव है ।३६। सब देवगण भी परम दुबल कुछ और हो जैसे विभात हो रहे हैं । यह पूणं चराचर त्रेलोक्य विनष्ट युग्म सा हो हो गया है ।३७। हय-
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: कृतपापो ऽपि शुध्येत किं पुनः शुभकर्मकृत् । तिर्यग्योनिं न गच्छेच्च कुदेशे च न जायते
verses.transliteration: kṛtapāpo 'pi śudhyeta kiṃ punaḥ śubhakarmakṛt / tiryagyoniṃ na gacchecca kudeśe ca na jāyate
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: ओवी ने कहा--इस रीति से वृहस्पति और महेन्द्र आलाप कर ही रहे ये कि महान देत्यों ने स्वर्ग को बाधित कर दिया था ।३८। बल के गवं वाले देतयों ने नन्दन वन को पूर्णतया छेदन कर दिया था । जो उद्यान के पालक थे उन सबको हैत्यों ने आयुधों से प्रताडित किया था ।३९। जो स्वगे के चारों
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गी भवति विप्रो वै मोक्षोपायं च विन्दति । अश्रद्दधानः पापायुर्नास्तिको ऽच्छिन्नसंशयः
verses.transliteration: svargī bhavati vipro vai mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati / aśraddadhānaḥ pāpāyurnāstiko 'cchinnasaṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: ओर प्राकार भित्ति थो उसका भेदन करके नगर के भीतर भ्रवेश कर गये थे। अन्दर जो मन्दिरों में संस्थित देवगण ये उनको अत्यन्त ही पीड़ित
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: हेतुनिष्ठश्च पञ्चैते न तीर्थे फलभागिनः । गुरुतीर्थे परा सिद्धिस्तीर्थानां परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: hetuniṣṭhaśca pañcaite na tīrthe phalabhāginaḥ / gurutīrthe parā siddhistīrthānāṃ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: किया था ।४०। विशेष रूप से जो रत्नों के समान अप्सराए' थीं उनका हरण कर लिया था । इसके उपरान्त सभी डेवगथ बहुत ही बाधित कर दिए थे ।४१। उस प्रकार का जो बड़ा भारी शोर हुआ था उसको सुनकर इन्द्र ने अपता आसन त्याग दिया था ओर सब देवों के साथ में वहां से भाग जाने
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं तीर्थं परं तस्माद्ब्रह्मतीर्थं सनातनम् । उपवासात्परं ध्यानमिन्द्रियाणां निवर्त्तनम्
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ tasmādbrahmatīrthaṃ sanātanam / upavāsātparaṃ dhyānamindriyāṇāṃ nivarttanam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: में तत्पर हो गया या डर!
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासनिबद्धैर्हि प्राणैरेव पुनः पुनः । प्राणापानौ वशे कृत्वा वशगानीन्दियाणि च
verses.transliteration: upavāsanibaddhairhi prāṇaireva punaḥ punaḥ / prāṇāpānau vaśe kṛtvā vaśagānīndiyāṇi ca
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिं मनसि संयम्य सर्वेषां तु निवर्त्तनम् । प्रत्याहारं कृतं विद्धि मोक्षोपायमसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: buddhiṃ manasi saṃyamya sarveṣāṃ tu nivarttanam / pratyāhāraṃ kṛtaṃ viddhi mokṣopāyamasaṃśayam
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां मनो घोरं बुद्ध्यादीनां विवर्त्तनम् । अना हारो क्षयं याति विद्यादनशनं तपः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ mano ghoraṃ buddhyādīnāṃ vivarttanam / anā hāro kṣayaṃ yāti vidyādanaśanaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: निग्रहे बुद्धिमन्सोरन्यबुद्धिर्न जायते । क्षीणेषु सर्वदोषेषु क्षीणेष्वेवेन्द्रियेषु च
verses.transliteration: nigrahe buddhimansoranyabuddhirna jāyate / kṣīṇeṣu sarvadoṣeṣu kṣīṇeṣvevendriyeṣu ca
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त, बा तेन सहितः स्वयं ब्रह्मा पितामहः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: परिनिर्वाति शुद्धात्मा यथा वह्निरनिधनः । कारणेभ्यो गुणेभ्यश्च व्यक्ताव्यक्ताच्च कुत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: parinirvāti śuddhātmā yathā vahniranidhanaḥ / kāraṇebhyo guṇebhyaśca vyaktāvyaktācca kutsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: नियोजयति क्षेत्रज्ञं तेभ्योयोगेन योगवित् । तस्य नास्ति गतिः स्थानं व्यक्ताव्यक्ते च सर्वशः । न सन्नासन्न सदसन्नैव किञ्चिदवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: niyojayati kṣetrajñaṃ tebhyoyogena yogavit / tasya nāsti gatiḥ sthānaṃ vyaktāvyakte ca sarvaśaḥ / na sannāsanna sadasannaiva kiñcidavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.hindi: अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवा भगवंतं जनाद नम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alert devotee should perform Sraddha thus in all these places after going to the south-east quarter, with the desire for doing everything desirable.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे पुण्यदेशानुकीर्त्तनं नाम त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः ॥ १३॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वदानफलानि च । श्राद्धकर्मणि मेध्यानि वर्जनीयानि यानि च
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe puṇyadeśānukīrttanaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 13// bṛhaspatiruvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvadānaphalāni ca / śrāddhakarmaṇi medhyāni varjanīyāni yāni ca
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall recount the benefits of all (kinds of) charitable gifts. I shall mention things considered pure and worthy for the Sraddha rite and those which should be avoided therein.
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall recount the benefits of all (kinds of) charitable gifts. I shall mention things considered pure and worthy for the Sraddha rite and those which should be avoided therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall recount the benefits of all (kinds of) charitable gifts. I shall mention things considered pure and worthy for the Sraddha rite and those which should be avoided therein.

verses.sanskrit: हिमप्रपतने कुर्यादा हरेद्वा हिमं ततः । अग्निहोत्रमुपायुष्यं पवित्रं परमं हितम्
verses.transliteration: himaprapatane kuryādā haredvā himaṃ tataḥ / agnihotramupāyuṣyaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ hitam
verses.translation: One should perform Agnihotra on a steep snow-capped precipice or fetch snow from there (?). That is sacred and conducive to great welfare as well as longevity.
verses.wordMeaning: One should perform Agnihotra on a steep snow-capped precipice or fetch snow from there (?). That is sacred and conducive to great welfare as well as longevity.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should perform Agnihotra on a steep snow-capped precipice or fetch snow from there (?). That is sacred and conducive to great welfare as well as longevity.

verses.sanskrit: नक्तं तु वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात् । सर्वस्वेनापि कर्त्तव्यङ्क्षिप्रं वै राहुदर्शने
verses.transliteration: naktaṃ tu varjayecchrāddhaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt / sarvasvenāpi karttavyaṅkṣipraṃ vai rāhudarśane
verses.translation: One should avoid performance of a Sraddha at night1 because Rahu is seen elsewhere(?). As soon as Rahu is seen Sr&ddha must be performed with all of one's assets.
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid performance of a Sraddha at night1 because Rahu is seen elsewhere(?). As soon as Rahu is seen Sr&ddha must be performed with all of one's assets.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid performance of a Sraddha at night1 because Rahu is seen elsewhere(?). As soon as Rahu is seen Sr&ddha must be performed with all of one's assets.

verses.sanskrit: उपरागे न कुर्याद्यः पङ्के गौरिव सीदति । कुर्वाणस्तत्तरेत्पापं सती नौरिव सागरे
verses.transliteration: uparāge na kuryādyaḥ paṅke gauriva sīdati / kurvāṇastattaretpāpaṃ satī nauriva sāgare
verses.translation: He who does not perform ( Sraddha ) at the time of eclipse becomes dejected like a cow sinking into the mud. He who performs it (at the time of eclipse) shall surmount sins like a good boat in the sea.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजी के धाम में जाकर विषाद से युक्त मुख वाले इन्द्र ते जो कुछ भी हैत्यों ने किया था वह सभी ज्यों का त्यो कह दिया था ।४३। विधाता भी उसको सुनकर सब देवों के सहित और हतश्री वाले हरिहय को देखकर यह बोले ये ।४४। है इन्द्र ! अब आप सव देवों के साथ भगवान मुकुन्द की
verses.wordMeaning: He who does not perform ( Sraddha ) at the time of eclipse becomes dejected like a cow sinking into the mud. He who performs it (at the time of eclipse) shall surmount sins like a good boat in the sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not perform ( Sraddha ) at the time of eclipse becomes dejected like a cow sinking into the mud. He who performs it (at the time of eclipse) shall surmount sins like a good boat in the sea.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वदेवं च सौम्यं च खड्गमांसं परं हविः । विषाणवर्जं खड्गस्य मात्सर्यान्नाशयामहे
verses.transliteration: vaiśvadevaṃ ca saumyaṃ ca khaḍgamāṃsaṃ paraṃ haviḥ / viṣāṇavarjaṃ khaḍgasya mātsaryānnāśayāmahe
verses.translation: (Defective text) In Vaisvadeva and Soma sacrifices, the flesh of a rhinoceros (or a buffalo) is the greatest offering. It is not through rivalry that we feed with the flesh of a rhinoceros (buffalo) excluding the horns.
verses.hindi: शरण में चले जाओ । बही देत्यों के विनाशक ओर इस जगत के कर्ता हैं और बही तुम्हारा कल्याण करेंगे ।४१। इतना कहकर पितामह ब्रह्माजी उसके तथा समस्त देवों के सहित क्षीर सागर में गये ये ।४६। इसके अनन्तर बरह्मा आदि देवों ने भगवान जनादन की जो सब लोकों के महेश्वर है बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) In Vaisvadeva and Soma sacrifices, the flesh of a rhinoceros (or a buffalo) is the greatest offering. It is not through rivalry that we feed with the flesh of a rhinoceros (buffalo) excluding the horns.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) In Vaisvadeva and Soma sacrifices, the flesh of a rhinoceros (or a buffalo) is the greatest offering. It is not through rivalry that we feed with the flesh of a rhinoceros (buffalo) excluding the horns.

verses.sanskrit: त्वाष्ट्रा वै यजमानेन देवेशेन महात्मना । पिबञ्छचीपतिः सोमं पृथिव्यां मध्यगः पुरा
verses.transliteration: tvāṣṭrā vai yajamānena deveśena mahātmanā / pibañchacīpatiḥ somaṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyagaḥ purā
verses.translation: (Defective text) — Once Tvastr was the Yajamana ( performer of a sacrifice) when the noble-soulcd lord of Devas was the presiding deity. While the consort of Saci (i.e. Indra) was drinking the Soma juice, a few drops fell. in the middle on the ground. Syamakas (a kind of rice) grew there. They are successfully used for (propitiating) the Pitrs. The sprays of the Soma juice sticking to and coming out of his nostrils became Ik$u ( Sugarcane). Hence, sugarcane is phleg- matic, cool, smooth and sweet. One should perform all the Pity rites for the fulfilment of desire with Syamaka and sugar* cane. He who performs Agrayana i.e. the first soma libation at the Agnistoma Sacrifice (with Syamaka and Ik?u) attains the fulfilment of desires quickly.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) — Once Tvastr was the Yajamana ( performer of a sacrifice) when the noble-soulcd lord of Devas was the presiding deity. While the consort of Saci (i.e. Indra) was drinking the Soma juice, a few drops fell. in the middle on the ground.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) — Once Tvastr was the Yajamana ( performer of a sacrifice) when the noble-soulcd lord of Devas was the presiding deity. While the consort of Saci (i.e. Indra) was drinking the Soma juice, a few drops fell. in the middle on the ground.…

verses.sanskrit: श्यामाकास्तत्र उत्पन्नाः पित्रर्थमपरजिताः । विप्रुषस्तस्य नासाभ्यामासक्ताभ्यां तथेक्षवः
verses.transliteration: śyāmākāstatra utpannāḥ pitrarthamaparajitāḥ / vipruṣastasya nāsābhyāmāsaktābhyāṃ tathekṣavaḥ
verses.translation: Gf« KJP.IL16.8.
verses.hindi: ही श्रेष्ठ वाणियों के द्वारा स्तुति की थी ।४७। इसके अनन्तर सनातन वासु- देव भगवान प्रसन्न हुए ये और इस जगत की रक्षा करने में विशेष संसक्त प्रभू ने सम्पूर्ण देवों से कहा था ।४८। श्री भगवान ने कहा--आप लोगों का उपवृ'हण में तेज के हो द्वारा कर दूँगा । अब मेरे द्वारा जो भी कहा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Gf« KJP.IL16.8.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf« KJP.IL16.8.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेष्मलाः शीतलाः स्निग्धा मधुराश्च तथेक्षवः । श्यामाकैरिक्षुभिश्चैव पितॄणां सर्वकामिकम्
verses.transliteration: śreṣmalāḥ śītalāḥ snigdhā madhurāśca tathekṣavaḥ / śyāmākairikṣubhiścaiva pitṝṇāṃ sarvakāmikam
verses.translation: Mahdyavas, Ni$pdvasy Madhulikas (a kind of Citron?) Black rice and black metals are censurable (and hence prohi- bited) in the Sraddha rite.
verses.hindi: है आप लोगों को वह करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Mahdyavas, Ni$pdvasy Madhulikas (a kind of Citron?) Black rice and black metals are censurable (and hence prohi- bited) in the Sraddha rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahdyavas, Ni$pdvasy Madhulikas (a kind of Citron?) Black rice and black metals are censurable (and hence prohi- bited) in the Sraddha rite.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यादाग्रयणं यस्तु स शीघ्रं सिद्धिमाप्नुयात् । श्यामाकास्तु द्विनामानो विहिता यजनेस्मृते
verses.transliteration: kuryādāgrayaṇaṃ yastu sa śīghraṃ siddhimāpnuyāt / śyāmākāstu dvināmāno vihitā yajanesmṛte
verses.translation: For list of food, fruits, vegetables etc. recommended for Sraddha. Cf. Vi?ijtu Dh. S. 79.17.
verses.wordMeaning: For list of food, fruits, vegetables etc. recommended for Sraddha. Cf. Vi?ijtu Dh. S. 79.17.
verses.commentary: Sense: For list of food, fruits, vegetables etc. recommended for Sraddha. Cf. Vi?ijtu Dh. S. 79.17.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्तेदेवसृष्टास्तु तस्मात्ते चाक्षयाः स्मृताः । प्रसातिकाः प्रियङ्गुश्च मुद्गाश्च हरितास्तथा
verses.transliteration: yasmāttedevasṛṣṭāstu tasmātte cākṣayāḥ smṛtāḥ / prasātikāḥ priyaṅguśca mudgāśca haritāstathā
verses.translation: LaJuna (garlic), Grnjana (carrot ), Pal&niu (a kind of onion ), Pinifam Ulaka (globular radish) Karambha (groats or flour mixed with curds) and other things that are devoid of taste and smell are to be avoided in the Sraddha rite. The reason for the same is mentioned.1
verses.wordMeaning: LaJuna (garlic), Grnjana (carrot ), Pal&niu (a kind of onion ), Pinifam Ulaka (globular radish) Karambha (groats or flour mixed with curds) and other things that are devoid of taste and smell are to be avoided in the Sraddha rite. The reason for the same is mentioned.1
verses.commentary: Sense: LaJuna (garlic), Grnjana (carrot ), Pal&niu (a kind of onion ), Pinifam Ulaka (globular radish) Karambha (groats or flour mixed with curds) and other things that are devoid of taste and smell are to be avoided in the Sraddha rite. The reason for the same is mentioned.1

verses.sanskrit: एतान्यपि समानानि श्यामाकानां गुणैस्तु तैः । कृष्णमाषास्तिलाश्चैव श्रेष्ठास्तु यवशालयः
verses.transliteration: etānyapi samānāni śyāmākānāṃ guṇaistu taiḥ / kṛṣṇamāṣāstilāścaiva śreṣṭhāstu yavaśālayaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, red exudations and salts found in arid lands should be avoided in the rite of Sraddha. Women in their monthly periods should also be avoided.
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, red exudations and salts found in arid lands should be avoided in the rite of Sraddha. Women in their monthly periods should also be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, red exudations and salts found in arid lands should be avoided in the rite of Sraddha. Women in their monthly periods should also be avoided.

verses.sanskrit: महायवाश्च निष्पावास्तथैव च मधूलिकाः । कृष्णाश्चैवान्नलोहाश्च गर्ह्याः स्युः श्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: mahāyavāśca niṣpāvāstathaiva ca madhūlikāḥ / kṛṣṇāścaivānnalohāśca garhyāḥ syuḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Water emitting foul smell, water having froth and foams, water from a wayside puddle, water whereby a cow is dissatisfied and water drawn and kept during the night (should be avoided).
verses.hindi: इस क्षीर सागर में आप लोग असुरों के भी साथ में सग्धि अर्थात् मेल-जोल करके सब उनके भी साथ में समस्त परम श्रेष्ठ औषधियाँ डाल दो ।५०। ओर मन्दराचल को मन्थान बनाकर अर्थात् मन्थन करने का साधन बनाकर तथा वासुकि नामक सपंराज को योक्त अर्थात् मथने की डोरी
verses.wordMeaning: Water emitting foul smell, water having froth and foams, water from a wayside puddle, water whereby a cow is dissatisfied and water drawn and kept during the night (should be avoided).
verses.commentary: Sense: Water emitting foul smell, water having froth and foams, water from a wayside puddle, water whereby a cow is dissatisfied and water drawn and kept during the night (should be avoided).

verses.sanskrit: राजमाषास्तथान्ये वै वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः । मसूराश्चैव पुण्याश्च कुसुंभं श्रीनिकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: rājamāṣāstathānye vai varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ / masūrāścaiva puṇyāśca kusuṃbhaṃ śrīniketanam
verses.translation: The following milk should be avoided by a person with wisdom — the milk of a sheep, that of a deer, that of a camel, that of all animals with a single (i.e. not cloven) hoofs, that of a buffalo and that of Camara deer*
verses.hindi: करके सब देवमण मेरे सहायक होने पर अभृत का सथन करो अर्थात् अभृत तिकालो ।५१। सान्त्वना के साथ आपको समस्त दानवों से भी इस कार्य को
verses.wordMeaning: The following milk should be avoided by a person with wisdom — the milk of a sheep, that of a deer, that of a camel, that of all animals with a single (i.e. not cloven) hoofs, that of a buffalo and that of Camara deer*
verses.commentary: Sense: The following milk should be avoided by a person with wisdom — the milk of a sheep, that of a deer, that of a camel, that of all animals with a single (i.e. not cloven) hoofs, that of a buffalo and that of Camara deer*

verses.sanskrit: वर्षास्वतियवा नित्यं तथा वृषकवासकौ । बिल्वामलकमृद्वीकापनसाम्रातदाडिमाः
verses.transliteration: varṣāsvatiyavā nityaṃ tathā vṛṣakavāsakau / bilvāmalakamṛdvīkāpanasāmrātadāḍimāḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall mention the places that should be scrupulously avoided, the persons by whom the Sraddha rite should not be seen and the entire procedure regarding cleanli- ness and pollution.
verses.hindi: सम्पन्न कराने के लिए कहना चाहिए। यह उन्हें बताओ कि इसके करने से जो भी कुछ फल होगा वह तो हम और आपको सभी को सामान्य ही होगा अर्थात् उसको हम और आप सभी प्राप्त करेंगे ।५२। इस क्षीरसागर के मन्थन किये जाने पर जो सुधा उत्पन्न होगी उस अमृत के पान करने से
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall mention the places that should be scrupulously avoided, the persons by whom the Sraddha rite should not be seen and the entire procedure regarding cleanli- ness and pollution.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall mention the places that should be scrupulously avoided, the persons by whom the Sraddha rite should not be seen and the entire procedure regarding cleanli- ness and pollution.

verses.sanskrit: तवशोलंयताक्षौद्रखर्जूराम्रलानि च । खशेरुकोविदार्यश्च तालकन्दं तथा विसम्
verses.transliteration: tavaśolaṃyatākṣaudrakharjūrāmralāni ca / khaśerukovidāryaśca tālakandaṃ tathā visam
verses.translation: Cf. Vi. 12 and 15; also Smxti candrikd — Sraddha, p -416*
verses.hindi: आप लोग बलशाली और न मरण वाले हो जाओगे ।५३। जिस प्रकार से ये हैत्यगण उस अमृत को किञ्चिन मात्र भी न प्राप्त कर पावेंगे और केवल मन्थन करने में क्लेश वाले ही होंगे उस प्रकार का उपाय तो मैं कर दू'गा ।५४। यह भगवान् वासुदेव के द्वारा समस्त सुरगणों में कहा गया था तब
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Vi. 12 and 15; also Smxti candrikd — Sraddha, p -416*
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Vi. 12 and 15; also Smxti candrikd — Sraddha, p -416*

verses.sanskrit: तमालं शतकन्दं च मद्वसूचान्तकान्दिकी । कालेयं कालशाकं च भूरिपूर्णा सुवर्चला
verses.transliteration: tamālaṃ śatakandaṃ ca madvasūcāntakāndikī / kāleyaṃ kālaśākaṃ ca bhūripūrṇā suvarcalā
verses.translation: With great faith one should perform Sraddha by means of fruits, roots and foodstuff available in the forest. He then attains royal position as well as infinite heavenly bliss.
verses.hindi: सब सुरगणों ने उन अतुल देत्यों के साथ सन्धि की थी । फिर अनेक प्रकार की औषधियां सुरो और असुरों ने एकत्रित करके वहाँ पर प्राप्त की थी
verses.wordMeaning: With great faith one should perform Sraddha by means of fruits, roots and foodstuff available in the forest. He then attains royal position as well as infinite heavenly bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great faith one should perform Sraddha by means of fruits, roots and foodstuff available in the forest. He then attains royal position as well as infinite heavenly bliss.

verses.sanskrit: मांसाक्षं दुविशाकं च बुबुचेता कुरस्तथा । कफालकं कणा द्राक्षा लकुचं चोचमेव च
verses.transliteration: māṃsākṣaṃ duviśākaṃ ca bubucetā kurastathā / kaphālakaṃ kaṇā drākṣā lakucaṃ cocameva ca
verses.translation: In the Sraddha rite, one should avoid a ground with undesirable noise, which is narrow or impure, pervaded by insects, muddy and dirty and which emits foul smell.1
verses.hindi: मन्दराचल को मन्थन करने का साधन और वासुकि सर्प को उसको डोरी बनाया था । फिर सभी ने मिल-जुलकर क्षीर सागर के मन्थन करने का कार्ये बड़े ही प्रबल प्रयत्न से प्रारम्भ कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: In the Sraddha rite, one should avoid a ground with undesirable noise, which is narrow or impure, pervaded by insects, muddy and dirty and which emits foul smell.1
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Sraddha rite, one should avoid a ground with undesirable noise, which is narrow or impure, pervaded by insects, muddy and dirty and which emits foul smell.1

verses.sanskrit: अलाबुं ग्रीवकं वीरं कर्कन्धूमधुसाह्वयम् । वैकङ्कतं नालिकेरशृङ्गज पकरूषकम्
verses.transliteration: alābuṃ grīvakaṃ vīraṃ karkandhūmadhusāhvayam / vaikaṅkataṃ nālikeraśṛṅgaja pakarūṣakam
verses.translation: The territories of Karaskaras (Karakal in south Kanara), Kalingas, the northern region of the Sindhu as well as the countries where the discipline and virtuous practice of the various stages of life is not in vogue, should be scrupulously avoided.2
verses.wordMeaning: The territories of Karaskaras (Karakal in south Kanara), Kalingas, the northern region of the Sindhu as well as the countries where the discipline and virtuous practice of the various stages of life is not in vogue, should be scrupulously avoided.2
verses.commentary: Sense: The territories of Karaskaras (Karakal in south Kanara), Kalingas, the northern region of the Sindhu as well as the countries where the discipline and virtuous practice of the various stages of life is not in vogue, should be scrupulously avoided.2

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पली मरिचं चैव पठोलं बृहतीफलम् । सुगन्धमांसपीवन्ति कषायाः सर्व एव च
verses.transliteration: pippalī maricaṃ caiva paṭholaṃ bṛhatīphalam / sugandhamāṃsapīvanti kaṣāyāḥ sarva eva ca
verses.translation: The Nagnas* (naked) and other persons must not see the well-arranged Sraddha rite. The Sraddha viewed by these do not reach the Pitrs or thePitamahas (grandfathers).
verses.wordMeaning: The Nagnas* (naked) and other persons must not see the well-arranged Sraddha rite. The Sraddha viewed by these do not reach the Pitrs or thePitamahas (grandfathers).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nagnas* (naked) and other persons must not see the well-arranged Sraddha rite. The Sraddha viewed by these do not reach the Pitrs or thePitamahas (grandfathers).

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि चान्यानि वराणि मधुराणि च । नागरं चात्र वै देयं दीर्घमूलकमव च
verses.transliteration: evamādīni cānyāni varāṇi madhurāṇi ca / nāgaraṃ cātra vai deyaṃ dīrghamūlakamava ca
verses.translation: O holy lord, recount to me the Nagnas 3 (nudes) and other persons even as I ask you earnestly.
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, recount to me the Nagnas 3 (nudes) and other persons even as I ask you earnestly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, recount to me the Nagnas 3 (nudes) and other persons even as I ask you earnestly.

verses.sanskrit: वंशः करीरः सुरसः सर्जकं भूस्तृणानि च । वर्जनीयानि वक्ष्यामि श्राद्धकर्मणि नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: vaṃśaḥ karīraḥ surasaḥ sarjakaṃ bhūstṛṇāni ca / varjanīyāni vakṣyāmi śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ

verses.sanskrit: लशुनं गृञ्जनं चैव तथा वै पल्वलोदकम् । करंभाद्यानि चान्यानि हीनानि रसगन्धतः
verses.transliteration: laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva tathā vai palvalodakam / karaṃbhādyāni cānyāni hīnāni rasagandhataḥ
verses.translation: The explanation in W. 35 ff below shows that the term Nagna includes Jainas, Buddhists, Jivakas (i.e. Ajivakas, the followers of Mankhali Gbs&la) and such other sects who did not follow Brahmanism. It includes also apostate Brahman as, atheists and the committers of gross sins (Mah&- patakas). Cf. Vi*$u Dh. S. 82.3 ff, Mbh. AnuJdsana 91.43-44 V&. & 31,
verses.wordMeaning: The explanation in W. 35 ff below shows that the term Nagna includes Jainas, Buddhists, Jivakas (i.e. Ajivakas, the followers of Mankhali Gbs&la) and such other sects who did not follow Brahmanism. It includes also apostate Brahman as,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The explanation in W. 35 ff below shows that the term Nagna includes Jainas, Buddhists, Jivakas (i.e. Ajivakas, the followers of Mankhali Gbs&la) and such other sects who did not follow Brahmanism. It includes also apostate Brahman as,…

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकर्मणि वर्ज्यानि कारणं चात्र वक्ष्यते । पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे निर्जितस्य बलेः सुरैः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhakarmaṇi varjyāni kāraṇaṃ cātra vakṣyate / purā devāsure yuddhe nirjitasya baleḥ suraiḥ
verses.translation: One shall discard the very sight of these viz — the Brahmana slayer, the ungrateful one, the atheist, the defiler of the preceptor's bed, the robber and the ruthless person.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall discard the very sight of these viz — the Brahmana slayer, the ungrateful one, the atheist, the defiler of the preceptor's bed, the robber and the ruthless person.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall discard the very sight of these viz — the Brahmana slayer, the ungrateful one, the atheist, the defiler of the preceptor's bed, the robber and the ruthless person.

verses.sanskrit: शरैस्तु विक्षतादङ्गात्पतिता रक्तबिन्दवः । तत एतानि जातानि लशुनादीनि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: śaraistu vikṣatādaṅgātpatitā raktabindavaḥ / tata etāni jātāni laśunādīni sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The Pitrs were honoured in the Krta Yuga; the Suras were worshipped in the Tretayuga. Wars were always worshipped in the Dvapara Yuga and the heretics were respected in the Kaliyuga.
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs were honoured in the Krta Yuga; the Suras were worshipped in the Tretayuga. Wars were always worshipped in the Dvapara Yuga and the heretics were respected in the Kaliyuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs were honoured in the Krta Yuga; the Suras were worshipped in the Tretayuga. Wars were always worshipped in the Dvapara Yuga and the heretics were respected in the Kaliyuga.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव रक्तनिर्यासा लवणान्यौषरणि च । श्रद्धकर्मणि वर्ज्यानि याश्च नार्यो रजस्वलाः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva raktaniryāsā lavaṇānyauṣaraṇi ca / śraddhakarmaṇi varjyāni yāśca nāryo rajasvalāḥ
verses.translation: By merely looking at Sraddhas, all these destroy them viz — one who has no honour, one who is cast off and discarded, the domestic pig and the dog.
verses.wordMeaning: By merely looking at Sraddhas, all these destroy them viz — one who has no honour, one who is cast off and discarded, the domestic pig and the dog.
verses.commentary: Sense: By merely looking at Sraddhas, all these destroy them viz — one who has no honour, one who is cast off and discarded, the domestic pig and the dog.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गन्धं फेनिलं चैव तथा वै पल्वलोदकम् । लभेद्यत्र न गौस्तृप्तिं नक्तं यच्चैव गुह्यते
verses.transliteration: durgandhaṃ phenilaṃ caiva tathā vai palvalodakam / labhedyatra na gaustṛptiṃ naktaṃ yaccaiva guhyate
verses.translation: The food offerings that these (above-mentioned ones) look at do not deserve to be used for Havya or Kavya. They are to be abandoned. In emergency cases they are to be consecrated by means of important things.
verses.wordMeaning: The food offerings that these (above-mentioned ones) look at do not deserve to be used for Havya or Kavya. They are to be abandoned. In emergency cases they are to be consecrated by means of important things.
verses.commentary: Sense: The food offerings that these (above-mentioned ones) look at do not deserve to be used for Havya or Kavya. They are to be abandoned. In emergency cases they are to be consecrated by means of important things.

verses.sanskrit: आविकं मार्गमौष्ट्रं च सर्वमेकशफं च यत् । माहिषं चामरं चैव पयो वर्ज्यं विजानता
verses.transliteration: āvikaṃ mārgamauṣṭraṃ ca sarvamekaśaphaṃ ca yat / māhiṣaṃ cāmaraṃ caiva payo varjyaṃ vijānatā
verses.translation: (Defective text) The Havis offerings (if they are
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) The Havis offerings (if they are
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) The Havis offerings (if they are

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि वर्ज्यान्देशान्प्रयत्नतः । न द्रष्टव्यं च यैः श्राद्धं शौचाशौचं च कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi varjyāndeśānprayatnataḥ / na draṣṭavyaṃ ca yaiḥ śrāddhaṃ śaucāśaucaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: Or it can be spread over with white mustard or black gingelly seeds. Or with efforts it should have the sight of view of the preceptor, sun, fire or such sacred things *.
verses.wordMeaning: Or it can be spread over with white mustard or black gingelly seeds. Or with efforts it should have the sight of view of the preceptor, sun, fire or such sacred things *.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or it can be spread over with white mustard or black gingelly seeds. Or with efforts it should have the sight of view of the preceptor, sun, fire or such sacred things *.

verses.sanskrit: वन्यमूलफलैर्भक्ष्यैः श्राद्धं कुर्यात्तु श्रद्धया । राजनिष्ठामवाप्नोति स्वर्गमक्षयमेव च
verses.transliteration: vanyamūlaphalairbhakṣyaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryāttu śraddhayā / rājaniṣṭhāmavāpnoti svargamakṣayameva ca
verses.translation: There are some persons who profess to be very great wise men merely by speaking against the Vedas. Those recluses (without sacrifices) (Ayajna yatayah)* certainly destroy (a Sraddha) like the dust particles.
verses.hindi: वासुकि सपं के पूछ के भाग में तो हित के साथ समस्त देवगण और उसके शिर के हिस्से में सब देत्यगण भगवान् ने ही नियुक्त किये थे ।,७। यद्यपि हैत्यगण बहुत बलवान् ये तो भी उस सपं के मुख के उच्छ्वासों को अग्नि से उनके समस्त शरीर निदंग्ध हो गये ये ओर उस समय में वे
verses.wordMeaning: There are some persons who profess to be very great wise men merely by speaking against the Vedas. Those recluses (without sacrifices) (Ayajna yatayah)* certainly destroy (a Sraddha) like the dust particles.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are some persons who profess to be very great wise men merely by speaking against the Vedas. Those recluses (without sacrifices) (Ayajna yatayah)* certainly destroy (a Sraddha) like the dust particles.

verses.sanskrit: अनिष्टशब्दां संकीर्णां जन्तुप्याप्तामथाविलाम् । पूतिगन्धां तथा भूमिं वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: aniṣṭaśabdāṃ saṃkīrṇāṃ jantupyāptāmathāvilām / pūtigandhāṃ tathā bhūmiṃ varjayecchrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: The process of purification of all types of earthen pots is burning them once again. The same is the process of purification of vessels of precious gems, pearls, corals and shells.
verses.hindi: बिल्कुल ही तेज से क्षीण हो गये ये ।५८। भगवानु विष्णु के द्वारा प्रेरित अनुकूल वायु से पूछ के भाग का कर्षण करते हुए देवगण बार-बार आप्या- यित (सन्तृप्त) हो रहे ये ।१६। भगवान् आदि कूर्म के आकार वाले वनकर क्षोरसागर के मध्य में भ्रमण करते हुए मन्दर पर्त के अधिष्ठान बन गये ये
verses.wordMeaning: The process of purification of all types of earthen pots is burning them once again. The same is the process of purification of vessels of precious gems, pearls, corals and shells.
verses.commentary: Sense: The process of purification of all types of earthen pots is burning them once again. The same is the process of purification of vessels of precious gems, pearls, corals and shells.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यः सागरपर्यन्ता द्वारं दक्षिणपूर्वतः । त्रिशङ्कोर्वर्जयेद्देशं सर्वं द्वादश योजनम्
verses.transliteration: nadyaḥ sāgaraparyantā dvāraṃ dakṣiṇapūrvataḥ / triśaṅkorvarjayeddeśaṃ sarvaṃ dvādaśa yojanam
verses.translation: The purification of all types of hair and wool shall be through the Kalkas (powdered particles) of white mustard and gingelly seeds.
verses.hindi: जिस पर वह पंत टिक रहा था । मध्य में सब देवों के दूसरे स्वरूप से माधव दिखाई दे रहे थे । दूसरे रूप से हैत्यों के मध्य में उन्होंने भी बड़े वेग से वासुकि का कर्षण किया था। ब्रह्म के रूप से जिसने सागर को आक्रास्त कर दिया था उस शेल को घारण किया था और एक दूसरे रूप से
verses.wordMeaning: The purification of all types of hair and wool shall be through the Kalkas (powdered particles) of white mustard and gingelly seeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purification of all types of hair and wool shall be through the Kalkas (powdered particles) of white mustard and gingelly seeds.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरेण महानद्या दक्षिणेन च वैकटम् । देशास्त्रिशङ्कवो नाम वर्ज्या वै श्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: uttareṇa mahānadyā dakṣiṇena ca vaikaṭam / deśāstriśaṅkavo nāma varjyā vai śrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: The purification of the earth (i.e. ground) is by various means. Water can be sprinkled. It can be smeared with cowdung. It can be scraped and scratched. Water can be poured over it in plenty. A cow can be made to tread over it. A por- tion can be burned or dug.
verses.hindi: देवधि ने महान् तेज के द्वारा देवों को सबल बना दिया था ।६०-६२। भग- बानू ने देवों का लवरधंन किया था जिसके वे बली बने रहें और फिर बलात्कारके सहन करने वाले तेज से सभी को कार्य सम्पन्न करने की शक्ति प्रदान की थी
verses.wordMeaning: The purification of the earth (i.e. ground) is by various means. Water can be sprinkled. It can be smeared with cowdung. It can be scraped and scratched. Water can be poured over it in plenty. A cow can be made to tread over it. A por- tion can be burned or dug.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purification of the earth (i.e. ground) is by various means. Water can be sprinkled. It can be smeared with cowdung. It can be scraped and scratched. Water can be poured over it in plenty. A cow can be made to tread over it. A por- tion can be burned or dug.

verses.sanskrit: कारस्कराः कलिङ्गश्च सिधोरुत्तरमेव च । प्रनष्टाश्रमधर्माश्च वर्ज्या देशाः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: kāraskarāḥ kaliṅgaśca sidhoruttarameva ca / pranaṣṭāśramadharmāśca varjyā deśāḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: He must do it in a very secluded spot after covering the ground with white glass, or leaves, or wood or pieces of bamboo sticks.
verses.wordMeaning: He must do it in a very secluded spot after covering the ground with white glass, or leaves, or wood or pieces of bamboo sticks.
verses.commentary: Sense: He must do it in a very secluded spot after covering the ground with white glass, or leaves, or wood or pieces of bamboo sticks.

verses.sanskrit: नग्नादयो न पश्येयुः श्राद्धकर्म व्यवस्थितम् । गच्छन्त्येतैस्तु दृष्टानि न पितॄंश्च पितामहांन
verses.transliteration: nagnādayo na paśyeyuḥ śrāddhakarma vyavasthitam / gacchantyetaistu dṛṣṭāni na pitṝṃśca pitāmahāṃna
verses.translation: During the daytime, he should face the north and during the night he should face the south. After finishing the work of evacuating the bowels, he should take up some mud and the pot of water without uttering any word.
verses.hindi: मुदं जग्मुस्तदा देवा द॑ तेयाश्च तपोधन
verses.wordMeaning: During the daytime, he should face the north and during the night he should face the south. After finishing the work of evacuating the bowels, he should take up some mud and the pot of water without uttering any word.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the daytime, he should face the north and during the night he should face the south. After finishing the work of evacuating the bowels, he should take up some mud and the pot of water without uttering any word.

verses.sanskrit: शंयुरुवाच नग्नादीन्भगवन्सम्यगाचक्ष्व परिपृच्छतः । बृहस्पतिरुवाच सर्वेषामेव भूतानां त्रयीसंवरणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: śaṃyuruvāca nagnādīnbhagavansamyagācakṣva paripṛcchataḥ / bṛhaspatiruvāca sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ trayīsaṃvaraṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: He should take the water pot with the right hand and wash the anus with the left hand. He should apply clay to the anus three times.
verses.hindi: मथ्यमाने पुनस्तस्मिनक्षीराब्धौ देवदानवेः । किमेतदिति सिद्धानां दिवि चितयता तदा
verses.wordMeaning: He should take the water pot with the right hand and wash the anus with the left hand. He should apply clay to the anus three times.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should take the water pot with the right hand and wash the anus with the left hand. He should apply clay to the anus three times.

verses.sanskrit: तां ये त्यजन्ति संमोहात्ते वै नग्नादयो जनाः । प्रलीयते वृषो यस्मिन्निरालंबश्च यो बृषे
verses.transliteration: tāṃ ye tyajanti saṃmohātte vai nagnādayo janāḥ / pralīyate vṛṣo yasminnirālaṃbaśca yo bṛṣe
verses.translation: He should then apply clay to the feet and wash them. He shall then perform the Acamana (ritualistic sipping of water ) rite in accordance with the injunctions. The first three
verses.hindi: उत्थिता वारुणी देवी मदाल्लोलविलोचना । असुराणां पुरस्तात्सा स्मयमाना व्यतिष्ठत
verses.wordMeaning: He should then apply clay to the feet and wash them. He shall then perform the Acamana (ritualistic sipping of water ) rite in accordance with the injunctions. The first three
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then apply clay to the feet and wash them. He shall then perform the Acamana (ritualistic sipping of water ) rite in accordance with the injunctions. The first three

verses.sanskrit: वृषं यस्तु परित्यज्य मोक्षमन्यत्र मार्गति । वृषो वेदाश्रमस्तस्मिन्यो वै सम्यङ्न पश्यति
verses.transliteration: vṛṣaṃ yastu parityajya mokṣamanyatra mārgati / vṛṣo vedāśramastasminyo vai samyaṅna paśyati
verses.translation: VV. 70-96 below deal with the topic of purification of man — physical, mental and ritual. The defilement due to Aiauca (whether due to birth or death) technically pertains to eligibility for ritualistic performances.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 70-96 below deal with the topic of purification of man — physical, mental and ritual. The defilement due to Aiauca (whether due to birth or death) technically pertains to eligibility for ritualistic performances.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 70-96 below deal with the topic of purification of man — physical, mental and ritual. The defilement due to Aiauca (whether due to birth or death) technically pertains to eligibility for ritualistic performances.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यो वृषलः स न संशयः । पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे निर्जितैरसुरैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo vṛṣalaḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ / purā devāsure yuddhe nirjitairasuraistathā
verses.translation: One should always keep two Kamandalus (water- pots ) ready at hand. They must not have holes ( as the water will leak out). It is only with the remaining water that one should duly wash one's feet.
verses.wordMeaning: One should always keep two Kamandalus (water- pots ) ready at hand. They must not have holes ( as the water will leak out). It is only with the remaining water that one should duly wash one's feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should always keep two Kamandalus (water- pots ) ready at hand. They must not have holes ( as the water will leak out). It is only with the remaining water that one should duly wash one's feet.

verses.sanskrit: पाशण्डा वै कृतास्तात तेषां सृष्टिः प्रजायते । वृद्धश्रावकिनिर्ग्रन्थाः शाक्या जीवककार्पटाः
verses.transliteration: pāśaṇḍā vai kṛtāstāta teṣāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate / vṛddhaśrāvakinirgranthāḥ śākyā jīvakakārpaṭāḥ
verses.translation: ( Partially defective text). There is a second type of Acamana in respect to the rites of the Devas. Fasting for three nights is cited ( as the rite of expiation? ) when one is freed from wicked persons (?)
verses.wordMeaning: ( Partially defective text). There is a second type of Acamana in respect to the rites of the Devas. Fasting for three nights is cited ( as the rite of expiation? ) when one is freed from wicked persons (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: ( Partially defective text). There is a second type of Acamana in respect to the rites of the Devas. Fasting for three nights is cited ( as the rite of expiation? ) when one is freed from wicked persons (?)

verses.sanskrit: ये धर्मं नानुवर्त्तन्ते ते वै नग्नादयो जनाः । वृथा जटी वृथा मुण्डी वृथा नग्नश्च यो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: ye dharmaṃ nānuvarttante te vai nagnādayo janāḥ / vṛthā jaṭī vṛthā muṇḍī vṛthā nagnaśca yo dvijaḥ
verses.translation: In respect to protracted cases (? Viprakrtesu*) the rite of Krccha is cited for expiation. After touching a dog or a Candala one shall perform expiation rite of Tapta- Krcchra.
verses.wordMeaning: In respect to protracted cases (? Viprakrtesu*) the rite of Krccha is cited for expiation. After touching a dog or a Candala one shall perform expiation rite of Tapta- Krcchra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In respect to protracted cases (? Viprakrtesu*) the rite of Krccha is cited for expiation. After touching a dog or a Candala one shall perform expiation rite of Tapta- Krcchra.

verses.sanskrit: वृथा व्रती वृथा जापी ते वै नग्नादयो जनाः । कुलधर्मातिगाः शश्वद्वृथा वृत्तिकलत्रकाः
verses.transliteration: vṛthā vratī vṛthā jāpī te vai nagnādayo janāḥ / kuladharmātigāḥ śaśvadvṛthā vṛttikalatrakāḥ
verses.translation: After touching human bones, one should observe fast for the sake of purification. If the bones are oily (slimy) it is said that the fast must be for three nights. Otherwise only for one night.
verses.hindi: सर्वेशक्ति शाली जनार्दन प्रभु ने उस नाग दामुकि की भी शक्ति का वर्धन किया था। फिर देवों और दानयों के द्वारा क्षीरसागर के मन्थन किये जाने पर ।६४ फिर आगे अर्थात् सबसे पूव सुरों की पूजित सुरभि प्राविभू त हुई ची । है तपोधन ! उसका अवलोकन करके उस समय में
verses.wordMeaning: After touching human bones, one should observe fast for the sake of purification. If the bones are oily (slimy) it is said that the fast must be for three nights. Otherwise only for one night.
verses.commentary: Sense: After touching human bones, one should observe fast for the sake of purification. If the bones are oily (slimy) it is said that the fast must be for three nights. Otherwise only for one night.

verses.sanskrit: कृतकर्मदिशस्त्वेते कुपथाः परिकीर्त्तिताः । एतैर्हि दत्तं दृष्टं वै श्राद्धं गच्छति दानवान्
verses.transliteration: kṛtakarmadiśastvete kupathāḥ parikīrttitāḥ / etairhi dattaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vai śrāddhaṃ gacchati dānavān
verses.translation: By going to all the holy lakes, rivers and waterfalls, he may be freed from sins. He enjoys infinite bliss in heaven.
verses.hindi: देवगण और देत्यगण सभी प्रसन्तता से भर गये थे ।६५। फिर उस क्षीर सागर के मन्यत करने पर जो कि देवों और दानवों के द्वारा किया गया था, उस समय में सिद्धगण यही चिन्तन कर रहे ये कि यह कया वस्तु है ।६६। तव उस क्षीर सागर से वारुणी देवी उत्थित हुई थी जिसके मद के
verses.wordMeaning: By going to all the holy lakes, rivers and waterfalls, he may be freed from sins. He enjoys infinite bliss in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: By going to all the holy lakes, rivers and waterfalls, he may be freed from sins. He enjoys infinite bliss in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नश्च कृतघ्नश्च नास्तिको गुरुतल्पगः । दस्युश्चैव नृशंसश्च दर्णने तान्विसर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmaghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca nāstiko gurutalpagaḥ / dasyuścaiva nṛśaṃsaśca darṇane tānvisarjayet
verses.translation: The purificatory rite in the above case is as follows. If it is a Brahmana, he must take a bath along with his clothes. He will be pure by the application of clay twelve times. This alone is the purificatory rite after indulging in sexual intercourse or after vomiting.
verses.hindi: कारण परम चञ्चल नेत्र ये । वह असुरों के आगे मुस्कुराती हुई संस्थित हो षयो थी ।६७। देत्यों ने उसका ग्रहण नहीं किया था। तभी से वे असुर हो गये थे क्योंकि सुरा ग्रहण करने वाले नहीं हुए ये जिनके पास सुरा नहीं है उसी मे वे असुर शब्द से कहे गये ये ।६८। इसके पश्चात् वह समस्त देवों
verses.wordMeaning: The purificatory rite in the above case is as follows. If it is a Brahmana, he must take a bath along with his clothes. He will be pure by the application of clay twelve times. This alone is the purificatory rite after indulging in sexual intercourse or after vomiting.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purificatory rite in the above case is as follows. If it is a Brahmana, he must take a bath along with his clothes. He will be pure by the application of clay twelve times. This alone is the purificatory rite after indulging in sexual intercourse or after vomiting.

verses.sanskrit: पतिताः क्रूरकर्माणः सर्वांस्तान्परिवर्जयेत् । देवतानामृषीणां च विवादे प्रवदन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: patitāḥ krūrakarmāṇaḥ sarvāṃstānparivarjayet / devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca vivāde pravadanti ye
verses.translation: In washing the feet, one should apply clay three times to each of his feet. This is the purificatory rite in the forest. Henceforth, I shall mention the process of purification pertaining to (i.e. while residing in) the village.
verses.hindi: के सामने स्थित हो गयी थी । परमेष्ठी के द्वारा संकेतित होकर उन देवों ने बड़े ही आनन्द के साथ उसको ग्रहण कर लिया था । सुरा के ही ग्रहण करने से ये लोग सुर शब्द से कीत्तित हुए ये ।६९। फिर मन्यन किये जाने पर महान् दुम परिजात प्रकट हुआ था जो अपनी सुगन्ध से सम्पूणं जगत,
verses.wordMeaning: In washing the feet, one should apply clay three times to each of his feet. This is the purificatory rite in the forest. Henceforth, I shall mention the process of purification pertaining to (i.e. while residing in) the village.
verses.commentary: Sense: In washing the feet, one should apply clay three times to each of his feet. This is the purificatory rite in the forest. Henceforth, I shall mention the process of purification pertaining to (i.e. while residing in) the village.

verses.sanskrit: देवांश्च ब्राह्मणांश्चैव आम्नायं यस्तु निन्दति । असुरान्यातुधानांश्च दृष्टमेभिर्व्रजत्युत
verses.transliteration: devāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścaiva āmnāyaṃ yastu nindati / asurānyātudhānāṃśca dṛṣṭamebhirvrajatyuta
verses.translation: Application of clay fifteen times particularly on hands etc. is purification. One should apply the clay once over and above the prescribed number of times. After the application of the clay one shall wash it with water.
verses.wordMeaning: Application of clay fifteen times particularly on hands etc. is purification. One should apply the clay once over and above the prescribed number of times. After the application of the clay one shall wash it with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Application of clay fifteen times particularly on hands etc. is purification. One should apply the clay once over and above the prescribed number of times. After the application of the clay one shall wash it with water.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं कृतयुगं प्रोक्तं त्रेता तु क्षत्र्रियं युगम् । वैश्यं द्वापरमित्याहुः शूद्रं कलियुगं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatrriyaṃ yugam / vaiśyaṃ dvāparamityāhuḥ śūdraṃ kaliyugaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Articles brought by others must be purified by the Abhyuk$an.a rite after placing them down. Otic must not touch anything if it is not consecrated by the ritualistic sprinkling of water. Whether the rite is Sraddha or it is a rite for the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: Articles brought by others must be purified by the Abhyuk$an.a rite after placing them down. Otic must not touch anything if it is not consecrated by the ritualistic sprinkling of water. Whether the rite is Sraddha or it is a rite for the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Articles brought by others must be purified by the Abhyuk$an.a rite after placing them down. Otic must not touch anything if it is not consecrated by the ritualistic sprinkling of water. Whether the rite is Sraddha or it is a rite for the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कृते ऽपूज्यन्त पितरस्त्रेतायां तु सुरास्तथा । युद्धानि द्वापरे नित्यं पाखण्डाश्च कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: kṛte 'pūjyanta pitarastretāyāṃ tu surāstathā / yuddhāni dvāpare nityaṃ pākhaṇḍāśca kalau yuge
verses.translation: An article must be received from the northern side and disposed off on the southern side. A Yajamana (sponsorer of a Sraddha) shall perform every Sraddha in a secluded spot.
verses.wordMeaning: An article must be received from the northern side and disposed off on the southern side. A Yajamana (sponsorer of a Sraddha) shall perform every Sraddha in a secluded spot.
verses.commentary: Sense: An article must be received from the northern side and disposed off on the southern side. A Yajamana (sponsorer of a Sraddha) shall perform every Sraddha in a secluded spot.

verses.sanskrit: अपमानापविद्धश्च कुक्कुटो ग्रामसूकरः । श्वा चैव हन्ति श्राद्धानि दर्शनादेव सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: apamānāpaviddhaśca kukkuṭo grāmasūkaraḥ / śvā caiva hanti śrāddhāni darśanādeva sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: W. 101-106 state the importance of Acamana (sipping of water) and circumstance under which this purificatory rite be performed.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 101-106 state the importance of Acamana (sipping of water) and circumstance under which this purificatory rite be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 101-106 state the importance of Acamana (sipping of water) and circumstance under which this purificatory rite be performed.

verses.sanskrit: श्वसूकरोप संसृष्टं दीर्घरोगिभिरेव च । पतितैर्मलिनैश्चैव न द्रष्टव्यं कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: śvasūkaropa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dīrgharogibhireva ca / patitairmalinaiścaiva na draṣṭavyaṃ kathañcana
verses.translation: One who has no faith in the purificatory rite is bom among the Mlecchas (barbarians).
verses.wordMeaning: One who has no faith in the purificatory rite is bom among the Mlecchas (barbarians).
verses.commentary: Sense: One who has no faith in the purificatory rite is bom among the Mlecchas (barbarians).

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं पश्येयुरेते यत्तन्नार्हं हव्यकव्ययोः । उत्स्रष्टव्याः प्रधा नार्थैः संस्कारस्त्वापदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: annaṃ paśyeyurete yattannārhaṃ havyakavyayoḥ / utsraṣṭavyāḥ pradhā nārthaiḥ saṃskārastvāpado bhavet
verses.translation: A person who does not perform any Yajfta, a sinner or a person born as a low animal attains liberation by perform- ing the purificatory rite. The man becomes a dweller of the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: A person who does not perform any Yajfta, a sinner or a person born as a low animal attains liberation by perform- ing the purificatory rite. The man becomes a dweller of the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who does not perform any Yajfta, a sinner or a person born as a low animal attains liberation by perform- ing the purificatory rite. The man becomes a dweller of the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: हविषां संहतानां च पूर्वमेव विवर्जयेत् । सृष्टं युक्ताभिरद्भिश्च प्रोक्षणं च विधीयते
verses.transliteration: haviṣāṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca pūrvameva vivarjayet / sṛṣṭaṃ yuktābhiradbhiśca prokṣaṇaṃ ca vidhīyate
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धार्थकैः कृष्णतिलैः कार्यं वाप्यपवारणम् । गुरुसूर्याग्निवास्राणां दर्शनं वापि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: siddhārthakaiḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryaṃ vāpyapavāraṇam / gurusūryāgnivāsrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ vāpi yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: फिर है देवर्षे ! अत्यधिक सुन्दर आकृति बाली सब लोकों में मन को हरण करने वाली धीर अप्सराओं के गण आविधू'त हुए ये ।७१। इसके पश्चात् शीतांशु (चन्द्रमा) प्रकट हुआ था जिसको महेश्वर भगवान् ने मस्तक पर धारण करने के सिये ग्रहण कर लिया था। फिर महा कालकूट
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: आसनारूढमन्नाद्यं पादोपहतमेव च । अमेध्यैर्जङ्गमैर्दृष्टं शुष्कं पर्युषितं च यत्
verses.transliteration: āsanārūḍhamannādyaṃ pādopahatameva ca / amedhyairjaṅgamairdṛṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: बिष उत्पन्न हुआ था जिसका ग्रहण नाग जातियों ने किया था ।७२। इसके अनन्तर कौस्तुभ मणि जिसका नाम है बह रत्न निकला था उसको भगवान् जनार्दन ने ले लिया था । इसके पश्चात् अपने पत्रों की गन्ध से मद उत्पन्न करती हुई एक महोषधि आविभू'त हुई थी उसका विजया नाम रक्खा गया
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: अस्विन्नं परिदग्धं च तथैवाग्नावलेहितम् । शर्कराकीटपाषाणैः केशैर्यच्चाप्यु पाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: asvinnaṃ paridagdhaṃ ca tathaivāgnāvalehitam / śarkarākīṭapāṣāṇaiḥ keśairyaccāpyu pāhṛtam
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: था और भेर ने उसका उपादान किया ।७३। इसके उपरान्त परम दिव्य व शस्त्रों के धारण करने वाले देव आविभू'त हुए थे जो स्वयं ही घस्वस्तरि ये अपने कर में एक अमृत से परिपूर्ण कमंडल लिए हुए ही उपस्थित हुए थे
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्याकं मथितं चैव तथा तिलयवादिषु । सिद्धीकृताश्च ये भक्ष्याः प्रत्यक्षलवणीकृताः
verses.transliteration: piṇyākaṃ mathitaṃ caiva tathā tilayavādiṣu / siddhīkṛtāśca ye bhakṣyāḥ pratyakṣalavaṇīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: असन्न मन वाले तथा परम सन्तुष्ट हुए ये ।७४। इसके बाद उत्फुल्ल कमलों के अस्दर निवास करने वाली--वरदान देने वाली-हाथों में पद्म धारण किये हुए श्री देवी उस क्षीर सागर से उठकर बाहिर आयी थी ।७६। फिर तो सभी मुनिगणों ने उस परा देवी भी का श्रोसूक्त के द्वारा स्तवन किया
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा चैव तथा दोषोपात्तश्वोपहतं तथा । वाससा चावधूतानि वर्ज्यानि श्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā caiva tathā doṣopāttaśvopahataṃ tathā / vāsasā cāvadhūtāni varjyāni śrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: अप्सराओं के समूह ने श्री देवी के आगे नृत्य किया था। गंगा आदि जो
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: संति वेदविरोधेन केचिद्विज्ञाभिमानिनः । अयज्ञय तयो नाम ते ध्वंसंति यथा रजः
verses.transliteration: saṃti vedavirodhena kecidvijñābhimāninaḥ / ayajñaya tayo nāma te dhvaṃsaṃti yathā rajaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: परम पुण्यमयी सरिताए थी वे सभी स्नान के लिए समुपस्थित हो गयी
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: दधिशाकं तथा भक्ष्यं तथा चौषधिवर्जितम् । वार्त्ताकं वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धे सर्वानभिषवानपि । सैन्धवं लवणं चैव तथा मानससंभवम्
verses.transliteration: dadhiśākaṃ tathā bhakṣyaṃ tathā cauṣadhivarjitam / vārttākaṃ varjayecchrāddhe sarvānabhiṣavānapi / saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva tathā mānasasaṃbhavam
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रे परमे ह्येते प्रत्यक्षमपि वर्तिते । अग्नौ प्रक्षिप्य गृङ्णीयाद्धस्तौ प्रक्षिप्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pavitre parame hyete pratyakṣamapi vartite / agnau prakṣipya gṛṅṇīyāddhastau prakṣipya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: तुलसी तु धृता तेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ।
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
