verses.sanskrit: गमयेन्मस्तकं चैव ब्रह्मतीर्थं हि तत्स्मृतम् । द्रव्याणां प्रोक्षणं कार्यं तथैवावपनं पुनः
verses.transliteration: gamayenmastakaṃ caiva brahmatīrthaṃ hi tatsmṛtam / dravyāṇāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tathaivāvapanaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: पश्यति स्म च सा देवी विष्णुवक्षःस्थलालया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: निधाय चाद्भिः सिंचेत्त त्तथा चासु निवेशनम् । अश्ममूलफलेक्षूणां रज्जूनां चर्मणामपि
verses.transliteration: nidhāya cādbhiḥ siṃcetta ttathā cāsu niveśanam / aśmamūlaphalekṣūṇāṃ rajjūnāṃ carmaṇāmapi
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: वैदलानां च सर्वेषां पूर्ववच्छौचमिष्यते । तथा दन्तास्थि दारुणां शृङ्गाणां चावलेखनम्
verses.transliteration: vaidalānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pūrvavacchaucamiṣyate / tathā dantāsthi dāruṇāṃ śṛṅgāṇāṃ cāvalekhanam
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: आठ जो दिग्गज हैं अर्थात् आठों दिशाओं को बाँध कर रोकने वाले आठ वस्ती हैं। वे सब पवित्र पात्रों में जल भरकर उस पदुमों में निवास करते वाली श्री स्तपन करा रहे थे ।७६। मूत्तिमात् क्षीर सागर ने हरि के साथ श्रेय को प्राप्त हुई समुत्पन्न तुलसी को तथा पद्य की माला उस देवी के
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां मृन्मयानां च पुनर्दाहो विधीयते । मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां जलजानां च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ mṛnmayānāṃ ca punardāho vidhīyate / maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ jalajānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: लिये अपित की थो।८०। विश्वकर्मा ने परमादुभुत एवं दिव्य भूषण उसकेलिए समर्पित किये थे । परम उत्तम माला और वस्त्रों के धारण करने वाली एवं दिव्य भूषणों से विभूषिता बह श्री देवी सबके देखते-देखते भगवान् के वक्षःस्थल में चली गयी थी ।८?। प्रभविष्णु श्री विष्णु ने तुलसी को तो
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धार्थकानां कल्केन तिलकल्केन वा पुनः । स्याच्छौचं सर्वबालानामाविकानां च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: siddhārthakānāṃ kalkena tilakalkena vā punaḥ / syācchaucaṃ sarvabālānāmāvikānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: श्रारण कर लिया था। भगवान् के वक्षःस्थल में आलय वाली वह देवी देखती थी । सब लोकों की महेश्वरी देवी को दया से आईं हृष्टि से देखा चा
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: द्विपदां चैव सर्वेषां मृद्भिरद्भिर्विधीयते । आद्यन्तयोस्तु शौचानामद्भिः प्रक्षालनं विधिः
verses.transliteration: dvipadāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ mṛdbhiradbhirvidhīyate / ādyantayostu śaucānāmadbhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ vidhiḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: तथा कार्पासिकानां च भस्मना समुदाहृतम् । फलपुष्पपलाशानां प्लावनं चाद्भिरिष्यते
verses.transliteration: tathā kārpāsikānāṃ ca bhasmanā samudāhṛtam / phalapuṣpapalāśānāṃ plāvanaṃ cādbhiriṣyate
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षणं ह्युपलेपश्च भूमेश्चैवावलेखनम् । निषेको गोक्रमो दाहः खननं शुद्धिरिष्यते
verses.transliteration: prokṣaṇaṃ hyupalepaśca bhūmeścaivāvalekhanam / niṣeko gokramo dāhaḥ khananaṃ śuddhiriṣyate
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रमो ऽध्वगतो ग्रामाद्वायुपूता वसुंधरा । पुंसां चतुष्पदां चव मृद्भिः शौचं विधीयते
verses.transliteration: niṣkramo 'dhvagato grāmādvāyupūtā vasuṃdharā / puṃsāṃ catuṣpadāṃ cava mṛdbhiḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव समुद्दिष्टः शौचानां विधिरुत्तमः । अनिर्दिष्टमतो यद्यत्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: evameva samuddiṣṭaḥ śaucānāṃ vidhiruttamaḥ / anirdiṣṭamato yadyattanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातर्गृहाद्दक्षिणपश्चिमेन गत्वा चेषुक्षेपमात्रं पदं वै । कुर्यात्पुरीषं हि शिरो ऽवगुण्ठ्य न वै स्पृशेज्जातु शिरः करेण
verses.transliteration: prātargṛhāddakṣiṇapaścimena gatvā ceṣukṣepamātraṃ padaṃ vai / kuryātpurīṣaṃ hi śiro 'vaguṇṭhya na vai spṛśejjātu śiraḥ kareṇa
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लैस्तृणैर्वा कार्ष्ठैर्वा पर्णैर्वेणुदलैन च । सुसंवृत्ते प्रदेशे च णन्तर्धाय वसुंधराम्
verses.transliteration: śuklaistṛṇairvā kārṣṭhairvā parṇairveṇudalaina ca / susaṃvṛtte pradeśe ca ṇantardhāya vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्योदकमादाय मृत्तिकां चैव वाग्यतः । दिवा उदङ्मुखः कुर्याद्रात्रौ वै दक्षिणामुखः
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtyodakamādāya mṛttikāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ / divā udaṅmukhaḥ kuryādrātrau vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणेन तु हस्तेन गृहीत्वाथ कमण्डलुम् । शौचं वामेन हस्तेन गुदे तिस्रस्तु मृत्तिकाः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇena tu hastena gṛhītvātha kamaṇḍalum / śaucaṃ vāmena hastena gude tisrastu mṛttikāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: दश चापि शनैर्दद्याद्वामहस्ते क्रमेण तु । उभाभ्यां वा पुनर्दद्याद्द्वाभ्यां सप्त तु मृत्तिकाः
verses.transliteration: daśa cāpi śanairdadyādvāmahaste krameṇa tu / ubhābhyāṃ vā punardadyāddvābhyāṃ sapta tu mṛttikāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: मृदा प्रक्षाल्य पादौ तु आचम्य च यथाविधि । आपस्त्वाद्यास्त्रयश्चैव सुर्याग्न्यनिलदेवताः
verses.transliteration: mṛdā prakṣālya pādau tu ācamya ca yathāvidhi / āpastvādyāstrayaścaiva suryāgnyaniladevatāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात्संनिहितो नित्यमच्छिद्रे द्वे कमण्डलू । ःंसवार्यवनैरेव यथावत्पादधावनम्
verses.transliteration: kuryātsaṃnihito nityamacchidre dve kamaṇḍalū / ḥṃsavāryavanaireva yathāvatpādadhāvanam
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: आचमनं द्वितीयं च देवकार्ये ततो ऽपरम् । उपवासस्त्रिरात्रं तु दुष्टमुक्ते ह्युदात्दृतः
verses.transliteration: ācamanaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca devakārye tato 'param / upavāsastrirātraṃ tu duṣṭamukte hyudātdṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: श्री हयग्रीव ने कहा-इसके अनन्तर महेन्द्र आदि देवों को भगवानु प्रभविषणु विष्णु ने जग अंगाकार कर लिया था तो महाधीर वे परम प्रसन्नता को प्राप्न हुए ये।१। मलक आदि वे सब हैत्य भगवान् बिष्णु के पराङ्मुख हो गये थे। जब श्री देवी के द्वारा वे संत्यक्त हो गये थे तो वे
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रकृष्टेषु कृच्छ्रं च प्राय श्चित्तमुदाहृतम् । स्पृष्ट्वा श्वानं श्वपाकं च तप्तकृच्छ्रं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: viprakṛṣṭeṣu kṛcchraṃ ca prāya ścittamudāhṛtam / spṛṣṭvā śvānaṃ śvapākaṃ ca taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त अधिक उद्विग्न होगये ये ।२। इसके उपरान्त उन हैत्यों ने धन्वन्तरि भगवान् के कर में स्थित सुवे निमित परमामृत के सार से युक्त कलश को से लिया था अर्थात् हरण कर लिया था। इसके अनन्तर देवों का और असुरों का परस्पर में कलह उत्पन्न हो गया था ।३। इसी बोच में समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषास्थीनि संस्पृश्य उपोष्यं शुचिकारणात् । त्रिरात्रमुक्तं सस्नेहान्येकरात्रमतो ऽन्यथा
verses.transliteration: mānuṣāsthīni saṃspṛśya upoṣyaṃ śucikāraṇāt / trirātramuktaṃ sasnehānyekarātramato 'nyathā
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: लोकों के एक ही रक्षा करने वाले विष्णु भगवान् ने अपने साथ एक रूप बालो ललिता की भली भांति आराधना की थी ।४। सुरों और असुरों का परम दारुण युद्ध देखकर ब्रह्माजी अपने स्यान पर चले गये ये ओर शम्भु कलास पबंतपर समास्थित होगये ये।५॥इन्दर ने देत्यो के अधिप मलक से युद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: कारस्कराः कलिङ्गाश्च तथान्ध्रशबरादयः । पीत्वा चापोभूतिलपा गत्वा चापि युगं धरम्
verses.transliteration: kāraskarāḥ kaliṅgāśca tathāndhraśabarādayaḥ / pītvā cāpobhūtilapā gatvā cāpi yugaṃ dharam
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: किया या। समस्त सुरों से असुरों के साथ युद्ध किया था ।६। योगीन्द्र भगवान् से भी महेश्वरो की समाराधना की थी । उन्होंने महेश्वरी का ध्यान योग से द्वारा करके एकता के साथ उसी रूप को प्राप्त हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: सिंधोरुत्तरपर्यन्तं तथोदीच्यन्तरं नरः । पापदेशाश्च ये केचित्पापैरध्युषिता जनैः
verses.transliteration: siṃdhoruttaraparyantaṃ tathodīcyantaraṃ naraḥ / pāpadeśāśca ye kecitpāpairadhyuṣitā janaiḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्टैस्तु वर्जिता ये वै ब्राह्मणैल्वेदपारगैः । गच्छतां रागसंमोहात्तेषां पापं न गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śiṣṭaistu varjitā ye vai brāhmaṇailvedapāragaiḥ / gacchatāṃ rāgasaṃmohātteṣāṃ pāpaṃ na gacchati
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा देशानपुण्यांस्तु कृत्स्नं पापं समश्नुते । आरुह्य भृगुतुङ्गं तु गत्वा पुण्यां सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā deśānapuṇyāṃstu kṛtsnaṃ pāpaṃ samaśnute / āruhya bhṛgutuṅgaṃ tu gatvā puṇyāṃ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: बह देवी तो सबका संमोहन करने वाली थी और वह साक्षात् खंगार की नायिका यी । वह सम्पूर्ण श्रृंगार के वेषवाली थी और अमुरों का जो अतीब उल्वण युद्ध था । उसका निवारण करके अपने मन्दस्मित के द्वारा देत्यों की मोहित करती हुई वह बोली ।८-६। अब यह युद्ध समाप्त करो,
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: आपगां च नदीं रम्यां गङ्गां देवीं महानदीम् । हिमवत्प्रभवा नद्यो याश्चान्या ऋषिपूचिताः
verses.transliteration: āpagāṃ ca nadīṃ ramyāṃ gaṅgāṃ devīṃ mahānadīm / himavatprabhavā nadyo yāścānyā ṛṣipūcitāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: मर्म स्थानों के विभेदन करने बाले शास्त्रों से कया लाभ होगा । और परम निष्ठुर व्यथं के इन अलापों से भी अया लाभ है जो कि केवल कण्ठों के शोषण करने के कारण स्वरूप ही है ।१०। मैं ही आपके और देवों के मध्य में स्थित हैं इसमें जसा कि इस समय में आप लोग कर रहे हैं आप लोग
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्तीर्थानि सर्वाणि नदीः प्रस्रवणानि च । गत्वैतान्मुच्यते पापैः स्वर्गे चात्यन्तमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: sarastīrthāni sarvāṇi nadīḥ prasravaṇāni ca / gatvaitānmucyate pāpaiḥ svarge cātyantamaśnute
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: तथा ये देवगण अत्यन्त ही बलेश के भागी होंगे ।११। मैं आप सभी के लिए आज इस अद्भूत अमृत को बराबर-बराबर दे दूंगी । अव आप लोग इस उत्तम सुधा के पात्र को मेरे हाथ में दे दोजिए।१२। इस उस महादेवी के वचन का श्रवण करके हैत्य विमोहित हो गये ये क्योंकि उसका वाक्य ही
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: दशरात्रमशौचं तु प्रोक्तं मृतकमूतके । ब्रह्मणस्य द्वादशाहं क्षत्रियस्य विधीयते
verses.transliteration: daśarātramaśaucaṃ tu proktaṃ mṛtakamūtake / brahmaṇasya dvādaśāhaṃ kṣatriyasya vidhīyate

verses.hindi: इस प्रकार था । मुख्य चित्त वाले उन्होंने वह अमृत का कलश उस देवी को दे दिया था ।१३। सम्पूर्ण इस जगत् के मोहन करने वाली उस देवी ने उस अमृत के कलश को ले लिया था और फिर उसने सुरों की तथा असुरों की
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: अर्द्धमासं तु वैश्यस्य मासं शूद्रस्य चैव ह । उदक्या सर्ववर्णानां चतूरात्रेण शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: arddhamāsaṃ tu vaiśyasya māsaṃ śūdrasya caiva ha / udakyā sarvavarṇānāṃ catūrātreṇa śudhyati
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: उदक्यां सूतिकां चैव श्वानमन्तावसायिनम् । नग्नादीन्मृतहारांश्च स्पृष्ट्वा शौचं विधीयते
verses.transliteration: udakyāṃ sūtikāṃ caiva śvānamantāvasāyinam / nagnādīnmṛtahārāṃśca spṛṣṭvā śaucaṃ vidhīyate

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा सचैलो मृद्भिस्तु शुद्धो द्वादशभिर्द्विजः । एतदेव भवेच्छौचं मैथुने वमने तथा
verses.transliteration: snātvā sacailo mṛdbhistu śuddho dvādaśabhirdvijaḥ / etadeva bhavecchaucaṃ maithune vamane tathā

verses.sanskrit: मृदा प्रक्षाल्यहस्तौ तु कुर्याच्छौचं च मानवः । प्रक्षाल्य चाद्भिः स्नात्वा तु हस्तौ चैव पुनर्मृदा
verses.transliteration: mṛdā prakṣālyahastau tu kuryācchaucaṃ ca mānavaḥ / prakṣālya cādbhiḥ snātvā tu hastau caiva punarmṛdā
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिः कृत्वा द्वादशान्तानि यथा लेपस्तथा भवेत् । एवं शौचविधिर्दृष्टः सर्वकृत्येषु नित्यदा
verses.transliteration: triḥ kṛtvā dvādaśāntāni yathā lepastathā bhavet / evaṃ śaucavidhirdṛṣṭaḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu nityadā
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: परिदद्यान्मृदस्तिस्रस्तिस्रः पादावसेचने । अरण्ये शौचमेतत्तु ग्राम्यं वक्ष्याम्यतः परम्
verses.transliteration: paridadyānmṛdastisrastisraḥ pādāvasecane / araṇye śaucametattu grāmyaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param

verses.transliteration: mṛdaḥ pañcadaśāmedhyā hastādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ / atiriktamṛdaṃ dadyānmṛdante tvadbhireva ca

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिरव्यक्तके शौचमेतच्चैतेषु कृत्स्नशः । कण्ठं शिरो वा आवृत्य रथ्यापणगतो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: adbhiravyaktake śaucametaccaiteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ / kaṇṭhaṃ śiro vā āvṛtya rathyāpaṇagato 'pi vā

verses.transliteration: akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucamācānto 'pyaśucirbhavet / pakṣālya pātraṃ nikṣipya ācamyābhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्यस्यान्यस्य तु तथा कुर्यादभ्युक्षणं ततः । पुष्पादीनां तृणानां च प्रोक्षणं हविषां तथा
verses.transliteration: dravyasyānyasya tu tathā kuryādabhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ / puṣpādīnāṃ tṛṇānāṃ ca prokṣaṇaṃ haviṣāṃ tathā
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: उन दोनों पंक्तियों के मध्य में स्थित होकर उन समस्त सुरों और असुरों से उसने कहा था । आप सब लोग बिल्कुल चुपचाप रहें-मेरे द्वारा आप सडको ककम से ही यह अमृत दिया जाता है ।१५। उन सभी ने जो समबायां थे उस देवी के उस वाक्य की स्वोकृत कर लिया था। वह तो
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: परात्दृतानां द्रव्याणां निधायाभ्युक्षणं तथा । नाप्रोक्षितं स्पृशेत्किञ्चिच्छ्रद्धे दैवे ऽथ वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: parātdṛtānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ nidhāyābhyukṣaṇaṃ tathā / nāprokṣitaṃ spṛśetkiñcicchraddhe daive 'tha vā punaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: सभी लोकों को संभोहित करने वाली थी । फिर उस देवी ने देने का उप- क्रम किया था ।१६। उस समय में उसके सुवर्ण की करघनी बबणित हो रही थो तथा उसके करों के कळूण भी क्वणित हो रहे ये जो परम मंगल स्वरूप थे । वह परम कमनीय भूया से समन्वित थी । उस समय में वह परमाधिक
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरोणाहरेद्द्रव्यं दक्षिणेन विसर्जयेत् । संवृते यजमानस्तु सर्वश्राद्धे समाहरेत्
verses.transliteration: uttaroṇāhareddravyaṃ dakṣiṇena visarjayet / saṃvṛte yajamānastu sarvaśrāddhe samāharet
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: मधुर मूत्ति सुशोभित हो रहो थो ।१७। परम सुन्दर वाम कर कमल में तो बह उज्ज्वल सुधा का कलश था, उस सुधा को उसने दर्बी से प्रथम देवों की पंक्ति में ही देना आरम्भ किया था ।१०। बह बहाँ पर क्रम से देती हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: उच्छिष्टे स्याद्विपर्यासोदैवे पित्र्येतथैव च । दक्षिणेन तु हस्तेन दक्षिणां वेदिमालभेत्
verses.transliteration: ucchiṣṭe syādviparyāsodaive pitryetathaiva ca / dakṣiṇena tu hastena dakṣiṇāṃ vedimālabhet
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: देखतो जा रही थो । उस समय में मध्य में सैंहिकेय स्थित था जिसकी सूचना संकेत द्वारा चन्द्र ओर सूर्य ने उसको दे दी थी । अतः द्वो के कर से उसका उस देवी ने छेदन कर दिया था । वह अमृत का पान कर चुका था अतएव उसका केवल शिर आकाशे चला गया था।१६।उसको देखकर वदा
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: कराभ्यामेव देवानां पितॄणां विकरं तथा । क्षरणं स्वप्नयोश्चैव तथा मूत्रपुरीषयो
verses.transliteration: karābhyāmeva devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vikaraṃ tathā / kṣaraṇaṃ svapnayoścaiva tathā mūtrapurīṣayo
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: पर जो असुर थे वे विमोहित हुए चुप थे । इसी प्रकार से क्रमसे उस देवी वह सम्पूर्ण अभृत देवों के लिए बितीणं कर दिया था और असुरों के आगे उस खाली पात्र को रखकर वह तिरोहित हो गयी थी ।२०। उन सब हैत्य दानवों ने उस खाली पात्र को देखा था और युद्ध करने की इच्छा से उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: निष्ठीविते तथाभ्यङ्गे भुत्क्वा विपरिधाय च । उच्छिष्टानां च संस्पर्शे तथा पादावसेचने
verses.transliteration: niṣṭhīvite tathābhyaṅge bhutkvā viparidhāya ca / ucchiṣṭānāṃ ca saṃsparśe tathā pādāvasecane
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: उच्छिष्टस्य च संभाषादशित्वा प्रयतस्य वा । संदेहेषु च सर्वेषु शिखां मुक्त्वा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ucchiṣṭasya ca saṃbhāṣādaśitvā prayatasya vā / saṃdeheṣu ca sarveṣu śikhāṃ muktvā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: विना यज्ञोपवीतेन मोघं तत्समुपस्पृशेत् । उष्ट्रस्यावेश्च संस्पर्शे दर्शने ऽवाच्यवाचिनाम्
verses.transliteration: vinā yajñopavītena moghaṃ tatsamupaspṛśet / uṣṭrasyāveśca saṃsparśe darśane 'vācyavācinām
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: जिह्वया चैव संस्वृश्य देतासक्तं तथैव च । सशब्दमेगुलीभिर्वा पतितं वा विलोकयन्
verses.transliteration: jihvayā caiva saṃsvṛśya detāsaktaṃ tathaiva ca / saśabdamegulībhirvā patitaṃ vā vilokayan
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: स्थितो यश्चाचमेन्मोहदाचान्तो ऽप्यशुचिर्भवेत् । उपविश्य शुचौ देशे प्रयतः प्रागुदङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: sthito yaścācamenmohadācānto 'pyaśucirbhavet / upaviśya śucau deśe prayataḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: पादौ प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ च अन्तर्जानु त्वपः स्पृशेत् । प्रसन्नस्त्रिः पिबेद्वारि प्रयतः सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: pādau prakṣālya hastau ca antarjānu tvapaḥ spṛśet / prasannastriḥ pibedvāri prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: द्विरेव मार्जनं कुर्यात्सकृदभ्युक्षणं ततः । खानि मूर्द्धानमात्मानं हस्तौ पादौ तथैव च
verses.transliteration: dvireva mārjanaṃ kuryātsakṛdabhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ / khāni mūrddhānamātmānaṃ hastau pādau tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: विस्मित: कामचारी तु कैलासं नारदो गतः
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्युक्षयेत्ततस्तस्य यद्यन्मीमांसित भवेत् । एवमाचमतस्तस्य वेदा यज्ञास्तपांसि च
verses.transliteration: abhyukṣayettatastasya yadyanmīmāṃsita bhavet / evamācamatastasya vedā yajñāstapāṃsi ca
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र आदि समस्त सुरगण सुध के पान से विशेष बलवान् होकर दुबल असुरों के साथ आयुधों को लेकर भली भांति लड़े थे ।२२। उन उत्तम सुरों के द्वारा वे दानवेन्द्र सेकडों बार विध्यमान हुए थे उनमें से कुछ तो अन्म दिशाओं में चले गये ये ओर कुछ पाताल लोक में चले गये शे
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: दानानि व्रतचर्याश्च भवन्ति सफलानि वै । क्रियां यः कुरुते मोहादनासम्येह नास्तिकः
verses.transliteration: dānāni vratacaryāśca bhavanti saphalāni vai / kriyāṃ yaḥ kurute mohādanāsamyeha nāstikaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र देव ने अलक नाम वाले दंस्य का जीत लिया था और
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति हि वृथा तस्य क्रिया ह्येता न संशयः । वाक्कायबुद्धिपूतानि अस्पृष्टं वाप्यनिन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: bhavanti hi vṛthā tasya kriyā hyetā na saṃśayaḥ / vākkāyabuddhipūtāni aspṛṣṭaṃ vāpyaninditam
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञेयान्येतानि मेध्यानि दुष्टमेध्यो विपर्यये । मनोवाक्कायमग्निश्च कालश्चैवोपलेखनम्
verses.transliteration: jñeyānyetāni medhyāni duṣṭamedhyo viparyaye / manovākkāyamagniśca kālaścaivopalekhanam
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: उसने अपनी श्री का आहरण कर लिया या ।२४। सुरगणो के द्वारा सेवित महेन्द्र देव ने फिर अपने सिंहासन को प्राप्त कर लिय! था और पूर्व की ही भाँति पूर्व देव जित् ने त्रेलोकय का परिपालन किया था ।२१। फिर समस्त देवगण निर्भय होकर इस चराचर त्रिलोकी में सवदा प्रसन्न चित्त होते हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: विख्यापनं च शौचानां नित्यमज्ञानमेव वा । अतो ऽन्यथा तु यः कुर्यान्मोहाच्छौचस्य संकरम्
verses.transliteration: vikhyāpanaṃ ca śaucānāṃ nityamajñānameva vā / ato 'nyathā tu yaḥ kuryānmohācchaucasya saṃkaram
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार सञ्चरण किया करते थे।२६। उस समय सम्पूर्ण मोहिनी के चरित को देखकर मुनि नारद बहुत ही आश्‍्चर्यान्वित होकर स्वेच्छा से चरण करने वाले कंत्राध गिरि पर चले गये थो
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: पिशाचान्यातुधानांश्च फलं गच्छत्यसंशयम् । शौचे चाश्रद्दधानो हि म्लेच्छजातिषु जायते १४।११३॥ अयज्वा चैव पापश्च तिर्यग्योनिगतो ऽपि च । शौचेन मोक्षं कुर्वाणः स्वर्गवासी भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: piśācānyātudhānāṃśca phalaṃ gacchatyasaṃśayam / śauce cāśraddadhāno hi mlecchajātiṣu jāyate 14.113// ayajvā caiva pāpaśca tiryagyonigato 'pi ca / śaucena mokṣaṃ kurvāṇaḥ svargavāsī bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: बहाँ पर नन्दी से आज्ञा पाकर उन्होंने परमेश्वर को प्रणाम किया था। शिव परभु के द्वारा भली भांति आदर प्राप्त करके परम तुष्ट हुए थो और आसन पर समवस्थित हो गये से
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: शुचिकामा हि देवा वै देवैश्चैतदुदाहृतम् । बीभत्सानशुचींश्चैव वर्जयन्ति सुराः सदा
verses.transliteration: śucikāmā hi devā vai devaiścaitadudāhṛtam / bībhatsānaśucīṃścaiva varjayanti surāḥ sadā
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि शौचानि कुर्वन्ति न्यायतः शुभकर्मिणः । ब्रह्मण्यायाति थेयाय शौचयुक्ताय धीमते
verses.transliteration: trīṇi śaucāni kurvanti nyāyataḥ śubhakarmiṇaḥ / brahmaṇyāyāti theyāya śaucayuktāya dhīmate
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: कलहम्रिय देवर्षे कि वृत्तं तत्र नाकिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: पितृभक्ताय दान्ताय सानुक्रोशाय च द्विजाः । तस्मै देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति पितरः श्रीविवर्द्धनाः । मनसाकाङ्क्षितान्कामांस्त्रैलोक्यप्रवरानपि
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhaktāya dāntāya sānukrośāya ca dvijāḥ / tasmai devāḥ prayacchanti pitaraḥ śrīvivarddhanāḥ / manasākāṅkṣitānkāmāṃstrailokyapravarānapi
verses.translation: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.hindi: कि वाच्यमृतवृत्तांतं विष्णुना वापि कि कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the Devas desire purity. This is declared by the Devas. The gods always avoid odious and unclean fellows.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे ऽशौचविधिर्नाम चतुर्दशो ऽध्योयः ॥ १४॥ ऋषय ऊचुः अहो धन्यस्त्वया सूत श्राद्धकल्पः प्रकीर्तितः । श्रुता नः श्राद्धकल्पास्तु ऋषिभिर्ये प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe 'śaucavidhirnāma caturdaśo 'dhyoyaḥ // 14// ṛṣaya ūcuḥ aho dhanyastvayā sūta śrāddhakalpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / śrutā naḥ śrāddhakalpāstu ṛṣibhirye prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: C*I shall recount, O Br&hmanas, what the opinion of that sage was, regarding Srdddha. Even as I recount it in detail listen to it, O fortunate one.
verses.wordMeaning: C*I shall recount, O Br&hmanas, what the opinion of that sage was, regarding Srdddha. Even as I recount it in detail listen to it, O fortunate one.
verses.commentary: Sense: C*I shall recount, O Br&hmanas, what the opinion of that sage was, regarding Srdddha. Even as I recount it in detail listen to it, O fortunate one.

verses.sanskrit: अतीव विस्तरो ह्यस्य विशेषेण तु कीर्त्तितः । देवाशेषं महाप्राज्ञ ऋषेस्तस्य मतं यथा
verses.transliteration: atīva vistaro hyasya viśeṣeṇa tu kīrttitaḥ / devāśeṣaṃ mahāprājña ṛṣestasya mataṃ yathā
verses.translation: The following verses describe the qualifications, learning, character etc. of Brdhmapas worthy of being invited for a Srdddha, as the antecedents etc. of invitees for rites pertaining to Devos and Pitrs must be scrupulously investi- gated (w. 5-6 below). Heredity, personality, Vedic learning, character were some of the main considerations of such invitees. Gf. Mt. 8-10, NP.I.28. 6-10, KP.II.21 and Smr.C. (Smrti Candrikd) III. (Srdddha Kdtfa), p -394. The ancient Smtis insisted on purity of conduct, good character. Declares Menu (11.118) "A Brdhmana who knows only the Gdyatri Mantra, but is self- controlled is preferable to the Brdhmana who knows three Vedas but lacks in self-control, eats every-thing and sells any- thing (forbidden by Dhama )'*.
verses.wordMeaning: The following verses describe the qualifications, learning, character etc. of Brdhmapas worthy of being invited for a Srdddha, as the antecedents etc. of invitees for rites pertaining to Devos and Pitrs must be scrupulously investi- gated (w. 5-6 below). Heredity, personality,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following verses describe the qualifications, learning, character etc. of Brdhmapas worthy of being invited for a Srdddha, as the antecedents etc. of invitees for rites pertaining to Devos and Pitrs must be scrupulously investi- gated (w. 5-6 below). Heredity, personality,…

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच कीर्त्तयिष्यामि वो विप्रा ऋषेस्तस्य मतं तु यत् । श्राद्धं प्रति महाभागस्तन्मे श्रुणुत विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca kīrttayiṣyāmi vo viprā ṛṣestasya mataṃ tu yat / śrāddhaṃ prati mahābhāgastanme śruṇuta vistarāt
verses.translation: Srdddha has been detailed by me before. The injunctions and rules of procedure in Srdddha rite have also been fhentioned. I shall ( now) explain the tests for selecting the deserving Brahmanas which has remained to be mentioned.
verses.wordMeaning: Srdddha has been detailed by me before. The injunctions and rules of procedure in Srdddha rite have also been fhentioned. I shall ( now) explain the tests for selecting the deserving Brahmanas which has remained to be mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srdddha has been detailed by me before. The injunctions and rules of procedure in Srdddha rite have also been fhentioned. I shall ( now) explain the tests for selecting the deserving Brahmanas which has remained to be mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: उक्तं श्राद्धंमया पूर्वं विधिश्च श्राद्धकर्मणि । परिशिष्टं प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रह्मणानां परिक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: uktaṃ śrāddhaṃmayā pūrvaṃ vidhiśca śrāddhakarmaṇi / pariśiṣṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇānāṃ parikṣaṇam
verses.translation: Brahmanas should not be investigated upon and examined on all occasions. But in the rites regarding the Devas and the Pitrs the method of testing them is invariably laid down as sacred and excellent.
verses.hindi: परम स्वच्छ स्फटिक मणि के सहश स्वरूप वाले पावंती के स्वामी
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas should not be investigated upon and examined on all occasions. But in the rites regarding the Devas and the Pitrs the method of testing them is invariably laid down as sacred and excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas should not be investigated upon and examined on all occasions. But in the rites regarding the Devas and the Pitrs the method of testing them is invariably laid down as sacred and excellent.

verses.sanskrit: न मीमांस्याः सदा विप्राः पवित्रंह्येतदुत्तमम् । दैवे पित्र्ये च नियतं श्रूयते वै परीक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: na mīmāṃsyāḥ sadā viprāḥ pavitraṃhyetaduttamam / daive pitrye ca niyataṃ śrūyate vai parīkṣaṇam
verses.translation: The person in whom defects are found is excluded from the rites. One shall scrupulously avoid that person whose faults one knows, due to the fact of staying together.
verses.hindi: श्री महादेवजी ने आसन पर विराजमान नारदजीजी से जो कि अपनी ही इच्छा से विहार करने वाले थे पूछा या ।२६। है भगवान् ! आपने इस
verses.wordMeaning: The person in whom defects are found is excluded from the rites. One shall scrupulously avoid that person whose faults one knows, due to the fact of staying together.
verses.commentary: Sense: The person in whom defects are found is excluded from the rites. One shall scrupulously avoid that person whose faults one knows, due to the fact of staying together.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्दोषाः प्रदृश्येरम्स हि कार्येषु वर्जितः । जानीयाद्वापि संवासाद्वर्जयेत्तं प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: yasmindoṣāḥ pradṛśyeramsa hi kāryeṣu varjitaḥ / jānīyādvāpi saṃvāsādvarjayettaṃ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: A learned man should not investigate (too deeply) into a totally unknown Brdhmaiia stranger in regard to the Srdddha rite. For, many Siddhas wander over this Earth in the guise of Brahmanas.1
verses.hindi: करने वाला है। अब यह बतलाइये कि उन स्वगेबासी देवगणों का क्‍या हाल है ? ।३०। सुरों का अथठा असुरों का विजय हुआ है ? अथवा उस अमृत का क्या हुआ- यह भी वृत्तान्त बतलाइए तथा भगवान बिष्णु ने उसमें कया किया था? ।३१ इस तरह से महेश प्रभु के द्वारा पूछे गये
verses.wordMeaning: A learned man should not investigate (too deeply) into a totally unknown Brdhmaiia stranger in regard to the Srdddha rite. For, many Siddhas wander over this Earth in the guise of Brahmanas.1
verses.commentary: Sense: A learned man should not investigate (too deeply) into a totally unknown Brdhmaiia stranger in regard to the Srdddha rite. For, many Siddhas wander over this Earth in the guise of Brahmanas.1

verses.sanskrit: अविज्ञातं द्विजं श्राद्धे न परीक्षेत पण्डितः । सिद्धा हि विप्ररूपेण चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: avijñātaṃ dvijaṃ śrāddhe na parīkṣeta paṇḍitaḥ / siddhā hi viprarūpeṇa caranti pṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: Hence, when a guest approaches one, one should welcome him with palms joined in reverence. One should worship and honour him with articles of worship, water for washing feet as well as oil bath and meal.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ठ नारदजी ने परम विस्मय से आविष्ट होकर प्रसम्न मुख और नेणों बाले नारदजी ने कहा था ।३२। है भगबनु ! आप तो सभी कुछ जानते हैं क्योंकि आप स्वयं सवज्ञ हैं । तो भी क्योंकि आपने मुझसे पूछा है अतः मैं अब वह सब बतलाता हूँ ।३३। उस प्रकार का महान् घोर जब देत्यों और
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, when a guest approaches one, one should welcome him with palms joined in reverence. One should worship and honour him with articles of worship, water for washing feet as well as oil bath and meal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, when a guest approaches one, one should welcome him with palms joined in reverence. One should worship and honour him with articles of worship, water for washing feet as well as oil bath and meal.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादतिथिमायान्तमभिगच्छेत्कृताञ्जलिः । पूजयेच्चार्घ्यपाद्याभ्यां तथाभ्यञ्जनभोजनैः
verses.transliteration: tasmādatithimāyāntamabhigacchetkṛtāñjaliḥ / pūjayeccārghyapādyābhyāṃ tathābhyañjanabhojanaiḥ
verses.translation: Devas and lords of Yogic cult and practice assuming different guises always move about over the vast Earth extend- ing up to the Seas on all sides. While doing so they make the common people maintain virtue and piety.
verses.hindi: देवों का युद्ध शुरू हो गया था तो उस समय में आदि नारायण ने जो परम श्री सम्पन्न हैं मोहिनी का स्वरूप धारण कर लिया था ।३४। उस मोहिनी का विलोकन करते हो जो परमोज्ज्वल विभूषा से सुसम्पन्न थीं और मूति- मती शार की देवता थी सभो सुर और असुर युद्ध के उद्यम से विरत हो
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and lords of Yogic cult and practice assuming different guises always move about over the vast Earth extend- ing up to the Seas on all sides. While doing so they make the common people maintain virtue and piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and lords of Yogic cult and practice assuming different guises always move about over the vast Earth extend- ing up to the Seas on all sides. While doing so they make the common people maintain virtue and piety.

verses.sanskrit: उर्वी सागरपर्यन्तां देवा योगेश्वरः सदा । नानारूपैश्चरन्त्येते प्रजा धर्मेण योजयन्
verses.transliteration: urvī sāgaraparyantāṃ devā yogeśvaraḥ sadā / nānārūpaiścarantyete prajā dharmeṇa yojayan
verses.translation: If he honours the guest by offering milk, he attains the benefit of Agniftoma sacrifice, if he honours the guest with milk pudding, he attains the benefit of %Uktha\ if he honours the guest with ghee, he attains the benefit of $o<jlaii Satra and if he honours the guest with honey he attains the benefit of Atir&tra.2
verses.wordMeaning: If he honours the guest by offering milk, he attains the benefit of Agniftoma sacrifice, if he honours the guest with milk pudding, he attains the benefit of %Uktha\ if he honours the guest with ghee,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If he honours the guest by offering milk, he attains the benefit of Agniftoma sacrifice, if he honours the guest with milk pudding, he attains the benefit of %Uktha\ if he honours the guest with ghee,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्दद्यात्सदा दान्तः समभ्यार्च्यातिथिं नरः । व्यञ्जनानि तु वक्ष्यामि फलं तेषां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tasmāddadyātsadā dāntaḥ samabhyārcyātithiṃ naraḥ / vyañjanāni tu vakṣyāmi phalaṃ teṣāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: If a man feeds Brihmanas and gives them every thing they desire, that rite alone bestows on him all wealth. The host
verses.wordMeaning: If a man feeds Brihmanas and gives them every thing they desire, that rite alone bestows on him all wealth. The host
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man feeds Brihmanas and gives them every thing they desire, that rite alone bestows on him all wealth. The host

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमं पयसा प्राप्नुयाद्वै फलं तथोक्थस्य च पायसेन । सषोडशी सत्रफलं घृतेन मध्वातिरात्रस्य फलं तथैव
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭomaṃ payasā prāpnuyādvai phalaṃ tathokthasya ca pāyasena / saṣoḍaśī satraphalaṃ ghṛtena madhvātirātrasya phalaṃ tathaiva
verses.translation: The Devas reject and discard the person like an accursed destitute — the person who insults and dishonours the guest who approaches him at the time of Sr&ddha rite or in a rite pertaining to the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas reject and discard the person like an accursed destitute — the person who insults and dishonours the guest who approaches him at the time of Sr&ddha rite or in a rite pertaining to the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas reject and discard the person like an accursed destitute — the person who insults and dishonours the guest who approaches him at the time of Sr&ddha rite or in a rite pertaining to the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तथाप्नुयाच्छ्रद्दधा नो नरो वै सर्वैः कामैर्भोजयेद्यस्तु विप्रान् । सर्वार्थदं सर्वविप्रातिथेयं फलं च भुङ्क्ते सर्वमेधस्य नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpnuyācchraddadhā no naro vai sarvaiḥ kāmairbhojayedyastu viprān / sarvārthadaṃ sarvaviprātitheyaṃ phalaṃ ca bhuṅkte sarvamedhasya nityam
verses.translation: For the sake of blessing the worlds, the invisible Devas and the Pilrs enter the Brdhmanas and partake of the meal.
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of blessing the worlds, the invisible Devas and the Pilrs enter the Brdhmanas and partake of the meal.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of blessing the worlds, the invisible Devas and the Pilrs enter the Brdhmanas and partake of the meal.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु श्राद्धे ऽतिथिं प्राप्तं दैवे चाप्यवमन्यते । तं वै देवा निरस्यन्ति हतो यद्वत्परावसुः
verses.transliteration: yastu śrāddhe 'tithiṃ prāptaṃ daive cāpyavamanyate / taṃ vai devā nirasyanti hato yadvatparāvasuḥ
verses.translation: The following persons cannot be received as Atithi (guests). A person who does not keep up views and observances of rites, a man of mixed caste, a person without learning, a person who does not possess specialised knowledge, a person who is tied to his children (?),3 4 a person who does not believe in the Devas1 and a sinner.
verses.wordMeaning: The following persons cannot be received as Atithi (guests). A person who does not keep up views and observances of rites, a man of mixed caste, a person without learning, a person who does not possess specialised knowledge,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following persons cannot be received as Atithi (guests). A person who does not keep up views and observances of rites, a man of mixed caste, a person without learning, a person who does not possess specialised knowledge,…

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च पितरश्चैव तेमेवान्तर्हिता द्विजम् । आविश्य विप्रं मोक्ष्यन्ति लोकानुग्रहकारणात्
verses.transliteration: devāśca pitaraścaiva temevāntarhitā dvijam / āviśya vipraṃ mokṣyanti lokānugrahakāraṇāt
verses.translation: A guest who has already wandered a lot, who is thirsty, who is tired, and who is very hungry should be received
verses.wordMeaning: A guest who has already wandered a lot, who is thirsty, who is tired, and who is very hungry should be received
verses.commentary: Sense: A guest who has already wandered a lot, who is thirsty, who is tired, and who is very hungry should be received

verses.sanskrit: अपूजितो दहत्येष दिशेत्कामांश्च पूजितः । सर्वस्वेनापि तस्माद्धि पूजयेदतिथिं सदा
verses.transliteration: apūjito dahatyeṣa diśetkāmāṃśca pūjitaḥ / sarvasvenāpi tasmāddhi pūjayedatithiṃ sadā
verses.translation: Who t*enders no service (Sttrf in V&.P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Who t*enders no service (Sttrf in V&.P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Who t*enders no service (Sttrf in V&.P.)

verses.sanskrit: वानप्रस्थो गृहस्थश्च सतामभ्यागतो यथा । वालखिल्यो यतिश्चैव विज्ञेयो ह्यतिथिः सदा
verses.transliteration: vānaprastho gṛhasthaśca satāmabhyāgato yathā / vālakhilyo yatiścaiva vijñeyo hyatithiḥ sadā
verses.translation: In Sr&ddha rites one should always feed the following types of persons: — A person who is not tormented or inconsis- tent, who has no wound, who practises Yoga, who has slender means of subsistence but who is not a regular beggar and an intelligent person habituated to solitude.
verses.hindi: उस मोहिनी की माया से मोहित होते हुए देत्यों से जब सुधा का पात्र माँगा गया था तो उन्होंने उसी मोहिनी को मध्यस्थ बनाकर तुरन्त ही बह पात्र उसको दे दिया था ।३६। मन्द मुस्कान से परम मनोहर उस देवी ने उसी समय में उस पात्र को ले लिया था । उसने इस सम्पूर्ण सुधा
verses.wordMeaning: In Sr&ddha rites one should always feed the following types of persons: — A person who is not tormented or inconsis- tent, who has no wound, who practises Yoga, who has slender means of subsistence but who is not a regular beggar and an intelligent person habituated to solitude.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Sr&ddha rites one should always feed the following types of persons: — A person who is not tormented or inconsis- tent, who has no wound, who practises Yoga, who has slender means of subsistence but who is not a regular beggar and an intelligent person habituated to solitude.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यागतः पाकचारदतिथिः स्यादपावकः । अतिथेरतिथिः प्रोक्तः सो ऽतिथिर्योग उच्यते
verses.transliteration: abhyāgataḥ pākacāradatithiḥ syādapāvakaḥ / atitheratithiḥ proktaḥ so 'tithiryoga ucyate
verses.translation: The wicked person who says "I will not give him" will never free himself from the sin even if he takes hundred births.
verses.hindi: को देवों के ही लिए बॉटकर खाली कर दिया या ।३७। जब उन्होंने देखा चा कि वह मोहिनी तो तिरोहित हो गयी है ओर बह सुधा का पात्र खाली है तो क्रोध से उन सबका मुख लाल हो गया था और वे हैत्य फिर युद्ध करने के लिए समुद्यत हो गये थे ।३८। अमृत के खाने से वे देवगण तो अमर
verses.wordMeaning: The wicked person who says "I will not give him" will never free himself from the sin even if he takes hundred births.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wicked person who says "I will not give him" will never free himself from the sin even if he takes hundred births.

verses.sanskrit: नाव्रती न च संकीर्णो नाविद्यो नाविशेषवित् । न च संतानसंबद्धो न देवी नागसे ऽतिथिः
verses.transliteration: nāvratī na ca saṃkīrṇo nāvidyo nāviśeṣavit / na ca saṃtānasaṃbaddho na devī nāgase 'tithiḥ
verses.translation: The excellent Br&hmana who studies the five sacred books viz. the Vedas and the Itih&sas should be seated after a person who is well- versed in Yoga, by the intelligent host.
verses.hindi: हो गये थे और उनका पराक्रम भी बहुत ही उल्वण हो गया था । उन्होंने उस युद्ध में हैत्यों को पराजित कर दिया था फिर वे महादेत्य नष्ट होते हुए पाताल लोक में चले गये शे ।३६। अविनाशी भवानी के स्वामी ने इस वृत्तान्त का श्रवण करके नारदजी को तो विदा कर दिया था और उसी
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Br&hmana who studies the five sacred books viz. the Vedas and the Itih&sas should be seated after a person who is well- versed in Yoga, by the intelligent host.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent Br&hmana who studies the five sacred books viz. the Vedas and the Itih&sas should be seated after a person who is well- versed in Yoga, by the intelligent host.

verses.sanskrit: पिपासिताय श्रान्ताय भ्रान्तायातिबुभुक्षते । तस्मै सत्कृत्य दातव्यं यज्ञम्य फलमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: pipāsitāya śrāntāya bhrāntāyātibubhukṣate / tasmai satkṛtya dātavyaṃ yajñamya phalamicchatā
verses.translation: A person who has studied three Vedas comes after him: a person of two Vedas be seated next; after that comes the man who has studied one Veda and Up&dhy&ya (ordinary priest) thereafter,
verses.hindi: वृत्तान्त का निरन्तर स्मरण करने लगे थे ।४०। स्कम्द-नन्दी भौर विनायक इन समस्त गणों के द्वारा अज्ञात होते हुए बड़े ही आश्चयं से समन्वित होकर केवल पार्वती को साथ में लेकर भगवान बिष्णु के समीप में आ गये थे ।४१। क्षीर सागर के तट पर अपनी प्रिया के साथ भगवान शम्भु का
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has studied three Vedas comes after him: a person of two Vedas be seated next; after that comes the man who has studied one Veda and Up&dhy&ya (ordinary priest) thereafter,
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has studied three Vedas comes after him: a person of two Vedas be seated next; after that comes the man who has studied one Veda and Up&dhy&ya (ordinary priest) thereafter,

verses.sanskrit: न वक्तव्यं सदा विप्र क्षुधिते नास्ति किञ्चन । तस्मै सत्कृत्य दातव्यं सदापचितिरेव सः
verses.transliteration: na vaktavyaṃ sadā vipra kṣudhite nāsti kiñcana / tasmai satkṛtya dātavyaṃ sadāpacitireva saḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention those persons who are considered sanctifying (the row of diners) in this connection. Understand. Those who are mentioned before have been mentioned in the proper order (of their importance).
verses.hindi: दर्शन करके शेष की शय्या से समुस्थित होकर भगवान विष्णु तुरन्त ही वहाँ पर समागत हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention those persons who are considered sanctifying (the row of diners) in this connection. Understand. Those who are mentioned before have been mentioned in the proper order (of their importance).
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention those persons who are considered sanctifying (the row of diners) in this connection. Understand. Those who are mentioned before have been mentioned in the proper order (of their importance).

verses.sanskrit: अक्लिष्ट मव्रणं युक्तं कृशवृत्तिमयाचकम् । एकान्तशीलं धीमन्तं सदा श्राद्धेषु भोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: akliṣṭa mavraṇaṃ yuktaṃ kṛśavṛttimayācakam / ekāntaśīlaṃ dhīmantaṃ sadā śrāddheṣu bhojayet
verses.translation: The following five persons should be understood as Panktip&vanas * (those who sanctify the row of diners) viz. One
verses.wordMeaning: The following five persons should be understood as Panktip&vanas * (those who sanctify the row of diners) viz. One
verses.commentary: Sense: The following five persons should be understood as Panktip&vanas * (those who sanctify the row of diners) viz. One

verses.sanskrit: नो ददामि तमित्येवं ब्रूयाद्यो वै दुरात्मवान् । अपि जातिशतं गत्वा न स मुच्येत किल्बिषात्
verses.transliteration: no dadāmi tamityevaṃ brūyādyo vai durātmavān / api jātiśataṃ gatvā na sa mucyeta kilbiṣāt
verses.translation: If a Brdhmana who had been invited for a Srdddha feast indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in that semen virile for the whole of that month (?)
verses.hindi: अवश्यं दर्शेनीयं मे त्वं हि भ्राथितकामधुक्
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brdhmana who had been invited for a Srdddha feast indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in that semen virile for the whole of that month (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brdhmana who had been invited for a Srdddha feast indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in that semen virile for the whole of that month (?)

verses.sanskrit: समोदं भोजयेद्विप्रानेकपङ्क्त्यां तु यो नरः । नियुक्तो ह्यनि युक्तो वा पङ्क्त्या हरति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: samodaṃ bhojayedviprānekapaṅktyāṃ tu yo naraḥ / niyukto hyani yukto vā paṅktyā harati kilbiṣam
verses.translation: Charitable gifts should be given to a person strictly engrossed in meditation or one who is sympathetic and one who is intelligent. One should feed a recluse or a Valakhilya in the
verses.wordMeaning: Charitable gifts should be given to a person strictly engrossed in meditation or one who is sympathetic and one who is intelligent. One should feed a recluse or a Valakhilya in the
verses.commentary: Sense: Charitable gifts should be given to a person strictly engrossed in meditation or one who is sympathetic and one who is intelligent. One should feed a recluse or a Valakhilya in the

verses.sanskrit: पाप्मानं गृह्यते क्षिप्रमिष्टापूर्त्तं च नश्यति । यतिस्तु सर्वविप्राणां सर्वेषामग्रतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pāpmānaṃ gṛhyate kṣipramiṣṭāpūrttaṃ ca naśyati / yatistu sarvaviprāṇāṃ sarveṣāmagrato bhavet
verses.translation: Sages are honoured through worshipping a forest- hermit, Indra is honoured through the Vdlakhilyas. If the worship of Sannydsins is performed, Brahmd is directly worshipped thereby.
verses.wordMeaning: Sages are honoured through worshipping a forest- hermit, Indra is honoured through the Vdlakhilyas. If the worship of Sannydsins is performed, Brahmd is directly worshipped thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages are honoured through worshipping a forest- hermit, Indra is honoured through the Vdlakhilyas. If the worship of Sannydsins is performed, Brahmd is directly worshipped thereby.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च वेदान्सेतिहासान्यः पठेद्द्विजसत्तमः । योगादनन्तरं सो ऽथ नियोक्तव्यो विजानता
verses.transliteration: pañca vedānsetihāsānyaḥ paṭheddvijasattamaḥ / yogādanantaraṃ so 'tha niyoktavyo vijānatā
verses.translation: No charitable gift should be given to those who are outside the limits of the four ASramas. A person beyond the pale of the four Airamas may remain with only air for his diet and perform a penance, but, since he does not belong to any Afratna, one should not invite him there (i.e. in a Sraddha ).
verses.hindi: भगवान शिव वाहन से उतर कर पार्वती के सहित विष्णु भगवान के समीप में पहुँचे और संस्थित भगवान की बड़े आनन्द से पूजा की और अघ्यं अपित किया था ।४३। भगवान अच्युत ने भवानी के पति का स्नेह के साथ गाढालिंगन किया था । विष्णु भगवान ने उनके समागमन का कारण
verses.wordMeaning: No charitable gift should be given to those who are outside the limits of the four ASramas. A person beyond the pale of the four Airamas may remain with only air for his diet and perform a penance, but, since he does not belong to any Afratna,…
verses.commentary: Sense: No charitable gift should be given to those who are outside the limits of the four ASramas. A person beyond the pale of the four Airamas may remain with only air for his diet and perform a penance, but, since he does not belong to any Afratna,…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवेदो ऽनन्तरं तस्य द्विवेदस्तदनन्तरम् । एकवेदस्ततः पश्चादुपाध्यायस्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: trivedo 'nantaraṃ tasya dvivedastadanantaram / ekavedastataḥ paścādupādhyāyastataḥ param
verses.translation: There are certain persons possessing obnoxiously severe penance; others profess to know much and argue in various ways, still others censure the Brahmanas— But all these are defilers of the row (of diners).
verses.hindi: पूछा था ।४४। महादेवजी ने भगवान से कहा--आप तो उत्तम पुरुष है और महान योगेश्वर हैं । आपने श्री सम्पन्न--सभी प्रकार के सौभाग्य से परम सुन्दर तथा सबको संमोह का पैदा करने वाला जो वाणी और मन से कभी गोचर नहीं हो सकता है कंसा स्वरूप आपने धारण किया था। उस स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: There are certain persons possessing obnoxiously severe penance; others profess to know much and argue in various ways, still others censure the Brahmanas— But all these are defilers of the row (of diners).
verses.commentary: Sense: There are certain persons possessing obnoxiously severe penance; others profess to know much and argue in various ways, still others censure the Brahmanas— But all these are defilers of the row (of diners).

verses.sanskrit: पावना ये ऽत्र संख्यातास्तान्प्रवक्ष्ये निबोधत । य एते पूर्वनिर्द्दिष्टाः सर्वे ते ह्यनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: pāvanā ye 'tra saṃkhyātāstānpravakṣye nibodhata / ya ete pūrvanirddiṣṭāḥ sarve te hyanupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The Aupavastas (certain people over-obsessed with fasting), the Sdrfikhyas, the atheists, those who find fault with the Vedas, those people who censure meditation — all these are defilers of the row (of diners).
verses.hindi: का प्रदर्शन मुझे भी क्रपाकर कराइए ।४५-४६। मैं आपके--उस स्वरूप का दर्शन करना चाहता हूँ जो कि ह्यृंगार का अधिष्ठात्री देवता है । मुझे वह अवश्य दिखाना चाहिए । आप तो ग्राथित पदार्थों के प्रदान करने वाले कामधेनु ही हैं ।४७। इस प्रकार से महादेवजी के द्वारा बराबर भगवान
verses.wordMeaning: The Aupavastas (certain people over-obsessed with fasting), the Sdrfikhyas, the atheists, those who find fault with the Vedas, those people who censure meditation — all these are defilers of the row (of diners).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Aupavastas (certain people over-obsessed with fasting), the Sdrfikhyas, the atheists, those who find fault with the Vedas, those people who censure meditation — all these are defilers of the row (of diners).

verses.sanskrit: षडङ्गविद्ध्यानयोगौ सर्वतत्रस्तथैव च । यायावरश्च पञ्चैते विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaṅgaviddhyānayogau sarvatatrastathaiva ca / yāyāvaraśca pañcaite vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ
verses.translation: Those who purposelessly shave off their heads, those who aimlessly keep their hairs matted and all.those who maintain themselves by carrying sacred waters, are defilers of
verses.hindi: विषण् की प्रार्थना की गयी थी । जिनके ध्यान के वैभव से अहत ओर अद्भुत रूप प्राप्त किया था ।४८। उसो का अनन्यमन से ध्यान करके और कुछ हसकर उन्होने कहा-ऐसा ही होगा--और फिर महोयोगेश्बर हरि तिरोहित हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Those who purposelessly shave off their heads, those who aimlessly keep their hairs matted and all.those who maintain themselves by carrying sacred waters, are defilers of
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who purposelessly shave off their heads, those who aimlessly keep their hairs matted and all.those who maintain themselves by carrying sacred waters, are defilers of

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकल्पे भवेद्यस्तु सन्निपत्य तु पावनः । चतुर्दशानां विद्यानामेकस्यामपि पारगाः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhakalpe bhavedyastu sannipatya tu pāvanaḥ / caturdaśānāṃ vidyānāmekasyāmapi pāragāḥ
verses.translation: W.40-56 give a list of persons who are defilers of row of diners
verses.wordMeaning: W.40-56 give a list of persons who are defilers of row of diners
verses.commentary: Sense: W.40-56 give a list of persons who are defilers of row of diners

verses.sanskrit: यथावद्वर्त्तमानाश्च सर्वे ते पङ्क्तिपावनाः । असंदेहस्तु सौपर्णाः पञ्चाग्नेयाश्च सामगाः
verses.transliteration: yathāvadvarttamānāśca sarve te paṅktipāvanāḥ / asaṃdehastu sauparṇāḥ pañcāgneyāśca sāmagāḥ
verses.translation: One should not feed the following persons with oblations meant for gods or Pitrs: viz. Kdrukas (a Saiva sect) and others not abiding by rules of good conduct, those who are excommunicated from the ordinary society as well as the Vedic one, the professional singers and those who sell the Vedas as means of subsistence.
verses.wordMeaning: One should not feed the following persons with oblations meant for gods or Pitrs: viz. Kdrukas (a Saiva sect) and others not abiding by rules of good conduct, those who are excommunicated from the ordinary society as well as the Vedic one,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not feed the following persons with oblations meant for gods or Pitrs: viz. Kdrukas (a Saiva sect) and others not abiding by rules of good conduct, those who are excommunicated from the ordinary society as well as the Vedic one,…

verses.sanskrit: यश्चरेद्विधिवद्विप्र समा द्वादश संततः । त्रिनाचिकेतस्त्रै विद्यो यश्च धर्मान्द्विजः पठेत्
verses.transliteration: yaścaredvidhivadvipra samā dvādaśa saṃtataḥ / trināciketastrai vidyo yaśca dharmāndvijaḥ paṭhet
verses.translation: He who has social and other contacts with these, attains black complexion (taint). He who takes food along with a Sudra is a defiler of the row.
verses.wordMeaning: He who has social and other contacts with these, attains black complexion (taint). He who takes food along with a Sudra is a defiler of the row.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has social and other contacts with these, attains black complexion (taint). He who takes food along with a Sudra is a defiler of the row.

verses.sanskrit: बार्हस्पत्ये महाशास्त्रे यश्च पारङ्गतो द्विजः । सर्वे ते पावना विप्राः पङ्क्तीनां समुदात्दृताः
verses.transliteration: bārhaspatye mahāśāstre yaśca pāraṅgato dvijaḥ / sarve te pāvanā viprāḥ paṅktīnāṃ samudātdṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Ploughing, tilling, killing of animals, agriculture, marketing, breeding of cattle and serving the enemy or any one except the preceptor — all these activities are forbidden to Brahmanas.
verses.wordMeaning: Ploughing, tilling, killing of animals, agriculture, marketing, breeding of cattle and serving the enemy or any one except the preceptor — all these activities are forbidden to Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ploughing, tilling, killing of animals, agriculture, marketing, breeding of cattle and serving the enemy or any one except the preceptor — all these activities are forbidden to Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: आमन्त्रितस्तु यः श्राद्धे योषितं सेवते द्विजः । पितरस्तस्य तन्मासं तस्मिन्रितसि शेरते
verses.transliteration: āmantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe yoṣitaṃ sevate dvijaḥ / pitarastasya tanmāsaṃ tasminritasi śerate
verses.translation: If any one out of delusion gives it away like that, the food does not reach the Pitjrs. Hence, foodstuffs and other remnants of a Srdddha site should not be given away.
verses.wordMeaning: If any one out of delusion gives it away like that, the food does not reach the Pitjrs. Hence, foodstuffs and other remnants of a Srdddha site should not be given away.
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one out of delusion gives it away like that, the food does not reach the Pitjrs. Hence, foodstuffs and other remnants of a Srdddha site should not be given away.

verses.sanskrit: ध्याननिष्ठाय दातव्यं सानुक्रोशाय धीमते । यतिं वा वालखिल्यं वा भोजयेच्छ्राद्दकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: dhyānaniṣṭhāya dātavyaṃ sānukrośāya dhīmate / yatiṃ vā vālakhilyaṃ vā bhojayecchrāddakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Whatever remains except curds and ghee should be given to the son and not to others. The remnants should be given — particularly the cooked rice and other food-s tuffs.
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever remains except curds and ghee should be given to the son and not to others. The remnants should be given — particularly the cooked rice and other food-s tuffs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever remains except curds and ghee should be given to the son and not to others. The remnants should be given — particularly the cooked rice and other food-s tuffs.

verses.sanskrit: वानप्रस्थाय कुर्वाणः पूजामात्रेण तुष्यते । गृहस्थं भोजयेद्यस्तु विश्वेदेवास्तु पूजिताः
verses.transliteration: vānaprasthāya kurvāṇaḥ pūjāmātreṇa tuṣyate / gṛhasthaṃ bhojayedyastu viśvedevāstu pūjitāḥ
verses.translation: Those who always abide by good conduct, those who have perfect knowledge, those who meditate, the devotees of the lord and noble-souled one shall sanctify even by mere sight.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who always abide by good conduct, those who have perfect knowledge, those who meditate, the devotees of the lord and noble-souled one shall sanctify even by mere sight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who always abide by good conduct, those who have perfect knowledge, those who meditate, the devotees of the lord and noble-souled one shall sanctify even by mere sight.

verses.sanskrit: वानप्रस्थेन ऋषयो वालखिल्यैः पुरन्दरः । यतीनां तु कृता पूजा साक्षाद्ब्रह्मा तुं पूजितः
verses.transliteration: vānaprasthena ṛṣayo vālakhilyaiḥ purandaraḥ / yatīnāṃ tu kṛtā pūjā sākṣādbrahmā tuṃ pūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:
verses.wordMeaning: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:
verses.commentary: Sense: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमो ऽपावनो यस्तु पञ्चमस्संकरात्मकः । चत्वारस्त्वाश्रमाः पूच्याः श्राद्धे देवे तथैव च
verses.transliteration: āśramo 'pāvano yastu pañcamassaṃkarātmakaḥ / catvārastvāśramāḥ pūcyāḥ śrāddhe deve tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:
verses.hindi: भगवान शिव ने भी सभी ओर अपनी इष्टि डालते हुए देखा था तो
verses.wordMeaning: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:
verses.commentary: Sense: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:

verses.sanskrit: चतुराश्रमबाह्येभ्य स्तेभ्यः श्राद्धे न दापयेत् । यस्तिष्ठेद्वायुभक्षश्च चातुराश्रमबाह्यतः
verses.transliteration: caturāśramabāhyebhya stebhyaḥ śrāddhe na dāpayet / yastiṣṭhedvāyubhakṣaśca cāturāśramabāhyataḥ
verses.translation: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:

verses.transliteration: ugreṇa tapasā yuktā bahujñāścitravādinaḥ / nindanti ca dvijātibhyaḥ sarve te paṅktidūṣakāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:

verses.transliteration: aupavastāstathā sāṃkhyā nāstikā vedanindakāḥ / dhyānaṃ nindanti ye kecitsarve te paṅktidūṣakāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:

verses.transliteration: vṛthā muṇḍāśca jaṭilāḥ sarve kārpaṭikāstathā / nirghṛṇānbhinnavṛttāṃśca sarvabhakṣāṃśca varjayet

verses.transliteration: etaistu varttayedyastu kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ sa gacchati / yo 'śnāti saha śūdreṇā sarve te paṅktidūṣaṇāḥ

verses.transliteration: vaktā vedaphalādbhraśyeddātā dānaphalāttathā / bhṛtako 'dhyāpayedyastu bhṛtakādhyāpitastu yaḥ

verses.transliteration: nārhatastāvapi śrāddhe brahmāṇaḥ krayavikrayī / krayaśca vikrayaścaivājīvitārthe vigarhitau

verses.commentary: Sense: Offers of gifts should be made to those who have tufts, who have attachment to the essential ingredients and who have the three staffs:

verses.wordMeaning: The knower of Yajfias who gives the sacred thread at the time of §raddha obtains that benefit of Brahmadana (gift of Vedic learning) which sanctifies all Brahmanas.

verses.translation: If at the time of Sraddha a person gives the Brah- manas a full Kamandalu (water-pot), it will reach the donor along with honey, milk, ghee and curds.

verses.wordMeaning: If at the time of Sraddha a person gives the Brah- manas a full Kamandalu (water-pot), it will reach the donor along with honey, milk, ghee and curds.
verses.commentary: Sense: If at the time of Sraddha a person gives the Brah- manas a full Kamandalu (water-pot), it will reach the donor along with honey, milk, ghee and curds.
