verses.commentary: Sense: He who, at the time of §raddha gives a Kamarujalu fitted with wheels (?) obtains a divine cow that can be milked easily and that yields plenty of milk.*

verses.sanskrit: व्यचनं तालवृन्तं च दत्त्वा विप्राय सत्कृतम् । प्राप्नुयात्सर्वपुष्पाणि सुगन्धीनि मृदूनि च
verses.transliteration: vyacanaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca dattvā viprāya satkṛtam / prāpnuyātsarvapuṣpāṇi sugandhīni mṛdūni ca
verses.translation: He who at the time of Sraddha rite gives two sandals
verses.hindi: वामांसेन बिषांगं च सृष्टवान्दुष्टशेखरभ् । धूमिनीनामधेयां च भगिनीं भंडदानवः
verses.wordMeaning: He who at the time of Sraddha rite gives two sandals
verses.commentary: Sense: He who at the time of Sraddha rite gives two sandals

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे ह्युपानहौ दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सदा बुधः । दिव्यं स लभते यानं वाजियुक्तं नवं तथा
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe hyupānahau dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadā budhaḥ / divyaṃ sa labhate yānaṃ vājiyuktaṃ navaṃ tathā
verses.translation: By giving a Brahmana a fan made of palm leaf after duly honouring him, one obtains all types of soft fragrant flowers.
verses.wordMeaning: By giving a Brahmana a fan made of palm leaf after duly honouring him, one obtains all types of soft fragrant flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving a Brahmana a fan made of palm leaf after duly honouring him, one obtains all types of soft fragrant flowers.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे छत्रं तु यो दद्यात्पुष्पमालान्वितं तथा । प्रासादो ह्युत्तमो भूत्वा गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe chatraṃ tu yo dadyātpuṣpamālānvitaṃ tathā / prāsādo hyuttamo bhūtvā gacchantamanugacchati
verses.translation: By giving a pair of shoes to the Brahmana at the time of &raddha, the learned man always obtains a vehicle yoked with horses.
verses.hindi: बरह्मविष्णुमहेशाश्च तं दृष्ट्वा दीप्ततेजसम् । पलायनपराः सद्य: स्वे स्वे धाम्नि सदा बसत्
verses.wordMeaning: By giving a pair of shoes to the Brahmana at the time of &raddha, the learned man always obtains a vehicle yoked with horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving a pair of shoes to the Brahmana at the time of &raddha, the learned man always obtains a vehicle yoked with horses.

verses.sanskrit: शरणं रत्नसंपूर्णं सशय्याभोजनं बुधः । श्राद्धे दत्त्वा यतिभ्यस्तु नाकपृष्ठे महीयते
verses.transliteration: śaraṇaṃ ratnasaṃpūrṇaṃ saśayyābhojanaṃ budhaḥ / śrāddhe dattvā yatibhyastu nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate
verses.translation: If, at the time of Sraddha a person gives an umbrella along with a garland of flowers, it becomes an excellent palace
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर है लोपा मुद्रापते ! मैं एक अति अद्भुत बात बत- लाऊगा। उसका आप श्रवण कीजिए । जिसको मैंने किसी को भी अब तक नहीं कहा था और यह मेरे हृदय में ही स्थित है ।55) बहुत पुराने समय में भण्डासुर नामक हैत्य था जो समस्त हैत्यों का शिरोमणि था । वह इतना
verses.wordMeaning: If, at the time of Sraddha a person gives an umbrella along with a garland of flowers, it becomes an excellent palace
verses.commentary: Sense: If, at the time of Sraddha a person gives an umbrella along with a garland of flowers, it becomes an excellent palace

verses.sanskrit: सुक्तावैदूर्यवासांसि रत्नानि विविधानि च । वाहनानि च दिव्यानि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च
verses.transliteration: suktāvaidūryavāsāṃsi ratnāni vividhāni ca / vāhanāni ca divyāni prayutānyarbudāni ca
verses.translation: By giving at the time of Sraddha a platter full of jewels along with bed and meal, to Tatis (Asceties), the learned man is honoured in the heaven.
verses.hindi: कुशल था कि उसने पहिले अपनी ही इच्छा से बहुत से देवों का शास्ता हुआ था ।७९। सने विशुक्र नाम वाले देतेय को जो सबके संरक्षण में समर्थ था। चह शुक्र के हो समान विचारज्ञ था उसको दक्ष के अंश से उसने सृजन किया
verses.wordMeaning: By giving at the time of Sraddha a platter full of jewels along with bed and meal, to Tatis (Asceties), the learned man is honoured in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving at the time of Sraddha a platter full of jewels along with bed and meal, to Tatis (Asceties), the learned man is honoured in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सुमहद्व्योमगं पुण्यं सर्वकामसमन्वितम् । चन्द्रसूर्यनिभं दिव्यं विमानं लभते ऽक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: sumahadvyomagaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam / candrasūryanibhaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ labhate 'kṣayam
verses.translation: A man who with great efforts gives during the winter a fire with plenty of wood, obtains the brilliance of the fire of his body, splendour and good fortune.
verses.hindi: था ।८०। उसने वामां से दुष्ट शिरोमणि विषाङ्ग को सृजित किया था। भण्ड दानव ने धूमिनी नाम वाली घेया भगिनी का भी सृजन किया था । ।४९। उम्रवीय वाले भाइयों के साथ अपने अहित को निहित करने वाला था। शोयं और वीयं से समुच्छि,त उसने पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्ड को खण्डित कर
verses.wordMeaning: A man who with great efforts gives during the winter a fire with plenty of wood, obtains the brilliance of the fire of his body, splendour and good fortune.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who with great efforts gives during the winter a fire with plenty of wood, obtains the brilliance of the fire of his body, splendour and good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोभिः परिवृतं कामगं सुमनोजवम् । वसेत्स तु विमानाग्रे स्तूयमानः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: apsarobhiḥ parivṛtaṃ kāmagaṃ sumanojavam / vasetsa tu vimānāgre stūyamānaḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: If, at the advent of the winter, a man gives fuel to the Brahmanas he always becomes victorious in battle. He is reborn, richly endowed with glory.
verses.hindi: दिया या ।८२। बहा, विष्णु और महेश दीप्त तेज वाले उसको देखकर ही भागने में तत्पर हो गये ये और तुरन्त ही अपने-अपने धाम में ही उसकी भुजा के द्वारा संद से बेहोज हुए देवों के गण श्वास सेने में भो कुशल नहीं हुए थे । अर्थात् श्वास भी न ले सके ये
verses.wordMeaning: If, at the advent of the winter, a man gives fuel to the Brahmanas he always becomes victorious in battle. He is reborn, richly endowed with glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: If, at the advent of the winter, a man gives fuel to the Brahmanas he always becomes victorious in battle. He is reborn, richly endowed with glory.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यैःपुष्पैश्चितश्चाहुर्दानानां परमं बुधाः । सुश्लक्ष्मानि सुवर्णानि श्राद्धे पात्राणि दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: divyaiḥpuṣpaiścitaścāhurdānānāṃ paramaṃ budhāḥ / suślakṣmāni suvarṇāni śrāddhe pātrāṇi dāpayet
verses.translation: The promise of the fruit of sacrifices for ddna ( religious gifts) must have resulted as a dis-incentive for performing sacrifice, and these Brahmanical writers get the dubious credit of adversely affecting the ancient Vedic institution of sacrifice.
verses.wordMeaning: The promise of the fruit of sacrifices for ddna ( religious gifts) must have resulted as a dis-incentive for performing sacrifice, and these Brahmanical writers get the dubious credit of adversely affecting the ancient Vedic institution of sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The promise of the fruit of sacrifices for ddna ( religious gifts) must have resulted as a dis-incentive for performing sacrifice, and these Brahmanical writers get the dubious credit of adversely affecting the ancient Vedic institution of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: रसास्तमुपतिष्ठन्ति भक्ष्यं सौभाग्यमेव च । तिलानिक्षूंस्तथा श्राद्धे द्विजेभ्यः संप्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: rasāstamupatiṣṭhanti bhakṣyaṃ saubhāgyameva ca / tilānikṣūṃstathā śrāddhe dvijebhyaḥ saṃprayacchati
verses.translation: He who gives in Sraddha, fresh plants after duly and scrupulously honouring (the Brahmanas) attains all worldly pleasures and is honoured after he goes to the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives in Sraddha, fresh plants after duly and scrupulously honouring (the Brahmanas) attains all worldly pleasures and is honoured after he goes to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives in Sraddha, fresh plants after duly and scrupulously honouring (the Brahmanas) attains all worldly pleasures and is honoured after he goes to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: मित्राणि लभते लोके स्त्रीषु सौभाग्यमेव च । यः पात्रं तैजसं दद्यान्मनोज्ञ श्राद्धभोजनैः
verses.transliteration: mitrāṇi labhate loke strīṣu saubhāgyameva ca / yaḥ pātraṃ taijasaṃ dadyānmanojña śrāddhabhojanaiḥ
verses.translation: Worlds are stabilised on account of cooked food. Its benefit is that of the gift of the world. Cooked food is Prajapati himself. All the visible worlds are pervaded by it.
verses.wordMeaning: Worlds are stabilised on account of cooked food. Its benefit is that of the gift of the world. Cooked food is Prajapati himself. All the visible worlds are pervaded by it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worlds are stabilised on account of cooked food. Its benefit is that of the gift of the world. Cooked food is Prajapati himself. All the visible worlds are pervaded by it.

verses.sanskrit: पात्रं भवति कामाना रूपस्य च धनस्य च । राजतं काञ्चनं वापि यो दद्याच्छ्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: pātraṃ bhavati kāmānā rūpasya ca dhanasya ca / rājataṃ kāñcanaṃ vāpi yo dadyācchrāddhakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणं पद्मनाभं च रुद्रं वज्जिणमेव च ।
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: दानात्तु लभते कामान्प्राकाश्यं धनमेव च । धेनुं श्राद्धे तु यो दद्याद्गृष्टिं कुम्भापदोहनीम्
verses.transliteration: dānāttu labhate kāmānprākāśyaṃ dhanameva ca / dhenuṃ śrāddhe tu yo dadyādgṛṣṭiṃ kumbhāpadohanīm
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: गावस्तमुपतिष्ठन्ति नरं पुष्टिस्तथैव च । दद्याद्यः शिशिरे चाग्निं बहुकाष्ठं प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: gāvastamupatiṣṭhanti naraṃ puṣṭistathaiva ca / dadyādyaḥ śiśire cāgniṃ bahukāṣṭhaṃ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: अथ मंडासुर' हंतु' त्रेलोक्यं चापि रक्षितुम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: कायाग्निदीप्तिं प्राकाश्यं सौभाग्यं तभते नरः । इन्धनानि तु यो दद्या द्द्विजेभ्यः शिशिरागमे
verses.transliteration: kāyāgnidīptiṃ prākāśyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ tabhate naraḥ / indhanāni tu yo dadyā ddvijebhyaḥ śiśirāgame
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं जयति संग्रामे श्रिया जुष्टस्तु जायते । सुरभीणि च माल्यानि गन्धवन्ति तथैव च
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ jayati saṃgrāme śriyā juṣṭastu jāyate / surabhīṇi ca mālyāni gandhavanti tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वा तु पात्रेभ्यः श्राद्धे सत्कृत्य दापयेत् । गन्धमाल्यं महात्मानं सुखानि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvā tu pātrebhyaḥ śrāddhe satkṛtya dāpayet / gandhamālyaṃ mahātmānaṃ sukhāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: दातारमुपतिष्ठन्ति युवत्यश्च पतिव्रताः । शयनासनयानानि भूमयो वाहनानि च
verses.transliteration: dātāramupatiṣṭhanti yuvatyaśca pativratāḥ / śayanāsanayānāni bhūmayo vāhanāni ca
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: जब स्वर्ग लोक में देवों में भगदड़ मची थी तो उनमें से कुछ तो पाताल लोक में भागकर जा छिपे ये-कुछ महासागर के जल में चले गये चे--कुछ दूर दिशाओं के छोर में चले गये ये और कुछ पर्वतं की कुञ्जं में चले गये वे ।०५। वे सब बहुत हो भयभीत होते हुए अपने सुत दारा और
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धेष्वेतानि यो दद्यादश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । श्राद्धकाले गुणवति विप्रे वै समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: śrāddheṣvetāni yo dadyādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / śrāddhakāle guṇavati vipre vai samupasthite
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: स्त्रियों को वहाँ पर ही छोड़ कर परम समर्थ भी अधिकारों से भ्रष्ट होकर छिपे हुए वेष में इधर-उधर विचरण करने लगे थे ।८६। यक्ष-महोरग-सिद्ध- साध्य सबको जो समर के बड़े दुमंद ये तवा ब्रहमा-सुद्र और विष्णु को भी, समस्त लोकों को तिनके के समान समाचरण वाले समझकर वह भण्ड ही
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: इष्टद्रव्यं च यो दद्यात्स्मृतिं मेधां च विन्दति । सर्पिःपूर्णानि पात्राणि श्राद्धे सत्कृत्य दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: iṣṭadravyaṃ ca yo dadyātsmṛtiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati / sarpiḥpūrṇāni pātrāṇi śrāddhe satkṛtya dāpayet
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भोपदोहगृष्टीनां बह्वीनां फलमश्नुते । श्राद्धे यथेप्सितं दत्त्वा पुण्डरीकफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: kumbhopadohagṛṣṭīnāṃ bahvīnāṃ phalamaśnute / śrāddhe yathepsitaṃ dattvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: सब पर शासन करने लगा था ।८३ है मुने ! इसके अनन्तर उस महान वली भण्डासुर का हनन करने के लिए तया तीनों लोकों की संरक्षा करने के बास्ते महायाग को अग्नि से एक तीसरा ही स्वरूप समुद्भूत हुआ था ।८८। जिस स्वरूप के धारण करने वालो को ललिता नाम से लोग कहा करते थे जो
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: वनं पुष्पफलोपेतं दत्त्वा गोसवमश्नुते । कूपारामतडागानि क्षेत्रगोष्ठगृहाणि च
verses.transliteration: vanaṃ puṣpaphalopetaṃ dattvā gosavamaśnute / kūpārāmataḍāgāni kṣetragoṣṭhagṛhāṇi ca
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: पर देवता थो । उसके चारों करों में पाश--अंकुश-धनुष और बाण ये आयुध बे ।८३। बह देवी परमाधिक शक्ति बाली थी और दह साक्षात् पर- अहा के स्वरूप वाली यो । युद्ध करने में महा विशारद उसने उस भण्ड देरयेनद्र को युद्ध में मार गिराया था
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा मोदन्ति ते स्वर्गे नित्यमाचन्द्रतारकम् । स्वास्तीर्णं शयनं दत्त्वा श्राद्धेरत्नविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: dattvā modanti te svarge nityamācandratārakam / svāstīrṇaṃ śayanaṃ dattvā śrāddheratnavibhūṣitam
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: कथं भंडासुरो जातः कथं वा त्रिपुरांविका । कथं बभंज तं संख्ये तत्सर्वं वद विस्त रात्
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्तस्य तुष्यन्ति स्वर्गलोकं समशनुते । अस्मिंल्लोके च संपन्नं स्यन्दनं च सुवाहनैः
verses.transliteration: pitarastasya tuṣyanti svargalokaṃ samaśanute / asmiṃlloke ca saṃpannaṃ syandanaṃ ca suvāhanaiḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाभिः पूज्यते चात्र धनधान्यैश्च वर्द्धते । पर्णकौशेयपट्टोर्णे तथा प्रावारकंबलौ
verses.transliteration: aṣṭābhiḥ pūjyate cātra dhanadhānyaiśca varddhate / parṇakauśeyapaṭṭorṇe tathā prāvārakaṃbalau
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: अजिनं काञ्चनं पट्टं प्रवेणीं मृगलोमकम् । दद्यादेतानि विप्राणां भोजयित्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: ajinaṃ kāñcanaṃ paṭṭaṃ praveṇīṃ mṛgalomakam / dadyādetāni viprāṇāṃ bhojayitvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोति श्रद्धधानस्तु वाजपेयफलं नरः । बहुभार्याः सुरूपाश्च पुत्रा भृत्याश्च किङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: prāpnoti śraddhadhānastu vājapeyaphalaṃ naraḥ / bahubhāryāḥ surūpāśca putrā bhṛtyāśca kiṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: स शैलो नारदाच्छू त्वा रुद्राणीति स्वकन्यकाम् । तस्य शुश्रूषणार्थाय स्थापयामास चांतिके
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: वशे तिष्ठन्ति भूतानि लोके चास्मिन्निरामयम् । कौशेयं क्षौमकार्पासं दुकूलं गहनं तथा
verses.transliteration: vaśe tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni loke cāsminnirāmayam / kauśeyaṃ kṣaumakārpāsaṃ dukūlaṃ gahanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवास्तारकेण हि पीडिताः । ब्रह्मणोक्ताः समाहुय मदनं चेदमब्रुवन्
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे चैतानि यो दद्यात्कामानाप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् । अलक्ष्मीं नाशयन्त्येते तमः सूर्योदयो यथा
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe caitāni yo dadyātkāmānāpnotyanuttamān / alakṣmīṃ nāśayantyete tamaḥ sūryodayo yathā
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्य मुनि ने कहा--यह भष्डासुर कसे समुत्पन्न हुआ था अथवा
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: भ्राजते य विमानाग्रे नक्षत्रेष्विव चन्द्रमाः । वासो हि सर्वदैवत्ये सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुतम्
verses.transliteration: bhrājate ya vimānāgre nakṣatreṣviva candramāḥ / vāso hi sarvadaivatye sarvadevairabhiṣṭutam
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: यह त्रिपुराम्बिका देवो केसे श्रादुभू त हुई बी । उसने समरागण में उस महा- हैत्य को कैसे मारा था--यह सम्पूर्ण वृत्त मेरे सामने विस्तार के साथ वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्राभावे क्रिया नास्ति य५दानतपांसि च । तस्माद्वस्त्राणि देयानि श्राद्धकाले तु नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: vastrābhāve kriyā nāsti ya5dānatapāṃsi ca / tasmādvastrāṇi deyāni śrāddhakāle tu nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: कीजिए ।१। हयग्रीव जी ते कहा -पहिले दाक्षायणी का त्याग करके पिता के यज्ञ का विध्वंस हुआ था ।२। अपनी आत्मा से आत्मा को देखते हुए ज्ञान और आनन्द के रस के स्वरूप वाले जो कि अढन्द गुण के लक्षण वाले थे- मुनिगणों के द्वारा उपास्यमान ये ।३। वे प्रभु उस समय में हिमवान् परंत
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: तानि सर्वाण्यवाप्नोति श्राद्धे दत्त्वा तु मानवः । नित्यश्राद्धे तु यो दद्यात्प्रयतस्तत्परायणः
verses.transliteration: tāni sarvāṇyavāpnoti śrāddhe dattvā tu mānavaḥ / nityaśrāddhe tu yo dadyātprayatastatparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: के अन्दर एक भीतरी भाग में प्रवेश कर गये ये। उस मनस्विनी ने भी बहुत लम्बे समय तक भगवान् शंकर की समाराधना की थी ।४। उस जग- दस्वा ने भी योग के द्वार। अपने कलेवर का त्याग कर दिया था और फिर वह हिमवान् गिरिराज की पुत्री होकर प्रादुभू'त हुई थी ।५। उस शैल राज
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामानवाप्नोति राज्यं स्वगे तथव च । सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmānavāpnoti rājyaṃ svage tathava ca / sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: ने देवर्षि नारद जी से यह सुना था कि उसकी कन्या साक्षात् रुद्राणी होगी । अतएब उस हिंगवान् ने उस अपनी कल्या को समीप में ही भगवात् शिवकी शुभूषा करने के लिए स्थापित कर दिया था । अर्थात् शिव की आराधना करने की आज्ञा दे दी थी ।६। इसी बीच पें तारक नामक महा देत्य के
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यजातं तु सुकृतं स्वस्तिकाद्यं सशर्करम् । कृसर मधुसर्पिश्च पयः पायसमेव च
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyajātaṃ tu sukṛtaṃ svastikādyaṃ saśarkaram / kṛsara madhusarpiśca payaḥ pāyasameva ca
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: दवारा देवों को उत्पीड़ित किया गया था । ब्रह्माजी से जब देवों ने प्रार्थनाकी थी तो उन्होने कामदेव को बुलाया या और उपसे यह कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: स्निग्धप्रायाश्च यो दद्यादग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् । दधिगव्यमसंसृष्टं भक्ष्यान्नानाविधांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: snigdhaprāyāśca yo dadyādagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet / dadhigavyamasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ bhakṣyānnānāvidhāṃstathā
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा न शोचते श्राद्धे वर्षासु च मघासु च । घृतेन भोजयेद्विप्रान्घृतं भूमौ समुत्सृजोत्
verses.transliteration: dattvā na śocate śrāddhe varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca / ghṛtena bhojayedviprānghṛtaṃ bhūmau samutsṛjot
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: छायायां हस्तिनश्चैव दत्त्वा श्राद्धेन शोचते । ओदनं पायसं सर्पिर्मधुमूलफलानि च
verses.transliteration: chāyāyāṃ hastinaścaiva dattvā śrāddhena śocate / odanaṃ pāyasaṃ sarpirmadhumūlaphalāni ca
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान्दत्त्वा परत्रेह च मोदते । शर्कराक्षीरसंयुक्ताः पृथुका नित्यमक्षयाः
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyāṃśca vividhāndattvā paratreha ca modate / śarkarākṣīrasaṃyuktāḥ pṛthukā nityamakṣayāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: स्यात्तु संवत्सरं प्रीतिः शाकैर्मांसरसेन च । सक्तुलाजास्तथापूपाः कुल्माषा व्यञ्जनैः सह
verses.transliteration: syāttu saṃvatsaraṃ prītiḥ śākairmāṃsarasena ca / saktulājāstathāpūpāḥ kulmāṣā vyañjanaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पिःस्निग्धानि सर्वाणि दध्ना संस्कृत्य भोजयेत् । श्राद्धेष्वेतानि यो दद्यात्पद्मं स लभते निधिम्
verses.transliteration: sarpiḥsnigdhāni sarvāṇi dadhnā saṃskṛtya bhojayet / śrāddheṣvetāni yo dadyātpadmaṃ sa labhate nidhim
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: नवसस्यानियो दद्याच्छ्राद्धे सत्कृत्य यत्नतः । सर्वभोगानवाप्नोति पूज्यते च दिवं गतः
verses.transliteration: navasasyāniyo dadyācchrāddhe satkṛtya yatnataḥ / sarvabhogānavāpnoti pūjyate ca divaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्यानि पेयानि चोष्यलेङ्यवराणि च । भोजनाग्रासनं दत्त्वा अतिथिभ्यः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyabhojyāni peyāni coṣyaleṅyavarāṇi ca / bhojanāgrāsanaṃ dattvā atithibhyaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वयज्ञक्रतूनां हि फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् । क्षिप्रमत्युष्णमक्लिष्टं दद्यादन्नं बुभुक्षते
verses.transliteration: sarvayajñakratūnāṃ hi phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam / kṣipramatyuṣṇamakliṣṭaṃ dadyādannaṃ bubhukṣate
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: एष दत्तवरो ब्रह्मा त्वयि विन्यस्य तद्भरम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: सव्यञ्जनं तथा स्निग्धं भक्त्या सत्कृत्य यत्नतः । तरुणादित्यसंकाशं विमानं हंसवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: savyañjanaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ bhaktyā satkṛtya yatnataḥ / taruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ vimānaṃ haṃsavāhanam
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: जब इस जगत् का सृजन आरम्भ किया था उसके आदि काल में भगवान् ब्रह्माजी ने समस्त प्रजाका सृजन करना चाहा था किन्तु उनके मन में किसी भी समय में सम्तोष नहीं हुआ था । तब उन्होंने बहुत समय पर्यम्त मन-वाणी और शरीर से तपश्‍चर्या की थी ।८। तब भगवान् उन पर परम
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदो लभते नित्यं कन्याकोटीस्तथैव च । अन्नदानात्परं दानं नान्यत्किञ्चित्तु विद्यते
verses.transliteration: annado labhate nityaṃ kanyākoṭīstathaiva ca / annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ nānyatkiñcittu vidyate
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न हुए ये जो कि जनार्दन प्रभु अपनी प्रिया लक्ष्मी के ही साथ में आकर प्रसन्न हो गये थे । समस्त देहश्वारियों को बर देने वाले प्रभु ने उनको भी बरदान देकर सन्तुष्ट किया था।३। ब्रह्माजी ने प्रार्थना की थो--हे भगवत् ! यदि आव मुझ पर प्रसन्न हैं तो मुझे यही बरदान दोजिए कि मैं बिना ही
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नाद्भूतानि जायन्ते जीवन्ति प्रभवन्ति च । जीवदानात्परं दानं नान्यत्किञ्चन विद्यते
verses.transliteration: annādbhūtāni jāyante jīvanti prabhavanti ca / jīvadānātparaṃ dānaṃ nānyatkiñcana vidyate
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: किसी आयास के इस चराचर जगत् का आपकी कृपा से सृजन कर दू"
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नाल्लोकाः प्रतिष्ठन्ति लोकदानस्य तत्फलम् । अन्नं प्रजापतिः साक्षात्ते न सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: annāllokāḥ pratiṣṭhanti lokadānasya tatphalam / annaṃ prajāpatiḥ sākṣātte na sarvamidaṃ tatam
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: जब इस रोति से ब्रह्माजो ने प्रार्थना की थी तो उन्होंने महालक्ष्मी की ओर देखा था । उसी समय में आप माईत हुए थे जो कि इस जगत् को मोहित करने वाले स्वरूप को धारण करने वाले थे।११। आपके आयुध के लिये उन्होंने आपको इक्षु का धनुष और पुष्पों का वाण प्रदात किया था । परम
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादन्नसमं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति । यानि रत्नानि मेदिन्यां वाहनानि स्त्रियस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmādannasamaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / yāni ratnāni medinyāṃ vāhanāni striyastathā
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न हरि ने विजयो होना भो प्रदान किया था।१२। यही कामदेव भूतों का सृजन अपने ही कर्म के कारण के द्वारा किया करेगा । आप अपने जन से साक्षिमूत होकर निवृति का समाश्रय ग्रहण करें। कामदेव ही आपके सूजन का कार्य करता रहेगा ।१३। ब्रह्माजी को यह वरदान जब दिया गया
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्रं प्राप्नोति तत्सर्वं पितृभक्तस्तु यो नरः । प्रतिश्रयं च यो दद्यादतिथिब्यः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: kṣipraṃ prāpnoti tatsarvaṃ pitṛbhaktastu yo naraḥ / pratiśrayaṃ ca yo dadyādatithibyaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.hindi: था तो उन्होंने सूजन का सब भार तुम पर छोड़कर है मग्मथ ! ब्रहाजी सन्तुष्ट होकर आज भो स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: देवास्तं संप्रतीच्छन्ति दिव्यातिथ्यैः सहस्रशः । सर्वाण्येतानि यो दद्यात्पृथिव्यामेकराड्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: devāstaṃ saṃpratīcchanti divyātithyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ / sarvāṇyetāni yo dadyātpṛthivyāmekarāḍbhavet
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिर्द्वाभ्यामथैकेन दानेन तु सुखी भदेत् । दानानि परमो धर्मः सद्भिः सत्कृत्य पूजितः
verses.transliteration: tribhirdvābhyāmathaikena dānena tu sukhī bhadet / dānāni paramo dharmaḥ sadbhiḥ satkṛtya pūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यस्या धिपत्यं हि दानेनैव ध्रुवं स्थितम् । अराजा लभते राज्यमधनश्चोत्तमं धनम् । क्षीणायुर्लभते चायुः पितृभक्तः सदा नरः
verses.transliteration: trailokyasyā dhipatyaṃ hi dānenaiva dhruvaṃ sthitam / arājā labhate rājyamadhanaścottamaṃ dhanam / kṣīṇāyurlabhate cāyuḥ pitṛbhaktaḥ sadā naraḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Va. 54-57. In fact the whole of that chapter in V&.P. is textually identical with this text.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे दानप्रशंसा नाम षोडशो ऽध्यायः ॥ १६॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच अत ऊर्द्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्राद्धकर्मणि पूजितम् । काम्यं नैमित्तिकाजस्रं श्राद्धकर्मणि नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe dānapraśaṃsā nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 16// bṛhaspatiruvāca ata ūrddhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrāddhakarmaṇi pūjitam / kāmyaṃ naimittikājasraṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: The word Affakd affan according to Vdrttika 9 on Pdpini VI 1.3.45 means 'a rite with Pitrs as deities. Aivaldyana Gr.S.II.4.1 states that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta — and Sitira are Aakas i.e. there are four A?tak£s. But most other Grhya Sfltras differ and regard the 8th day
verses.hindi: स्वक राच्च भवेत्कार्यं भवतो नान्यतः क्वचित्
verses.wordMeaning: The word Affakd affan according to Vdrttika 9 on Pdpini VI 1.3.45 means 'a rite with Pitrs as deities. Aivaldyana Gr.S.II.4.1 states that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta — and Sitira are Aakas i.e. there are four A?tak£s.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Affakd affan according to Vdrttika 9 on Pdpini VI 1.3.45 means 'a rite with Pitrs as deities. Aivaldyana Gr.S.II.4.1 states that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta — and Sitira are Aakas i.e. there are four A?tak£s.…

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रदारनिमित्ताः स्युरष्टकास्तिस्न एव तु । कृष्णपक्षे वरिष्ठा हि पूर्वाखण्डलदेवता
verses.transliteration: putradāranimittāḥ syuraṣṭakāstisna eva tu / kṛṣṇapakṣe variṣṭhā hi pūrvākhaṇḍaladevatā
verses.translation: The other one, that is the fourth type of Srdddha on a new moon day (? ) should be performed always with special care. A learned man performing Sraddha in all these ( Tithis ) even by sacrificing his entire possession, immediately attains welfare and rejoices both here and hereafter.
verses.wordMeaning: The other one, that is the fourth type of Srdddha on a new moon day (? ) should be performed always with special care. A learned man performing Sraddha in all these ( Tithis ) even by sacrificing his entire possession,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The other one, that is the fourth type of Srdddha on a new moon day (? ) should be performed always with special care. A learned man performing Sraddha in all these ( Tithis ) even by sacrificing his entire possession,…

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्या द्वितीया स्यात्तृतीया वैश्वदेविका । आद्यापूपैः सदाकार्या मांसैरन्या सदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyā dvitīyā syāttṛtīyā vaiśvadevikā / ādyāpūpaiḥ sadākāryā māṃsairanyā sadā bhavet
verses.translation: He who performs (Sraddha) on the second Tilhi shall become the overlord of all bipeds.
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs (Sraddha) on the second Tilhi shall become the overlord of all bipeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs (Sraddha) on the second Tilhi shall become the overlord of all bipeds.

verses.sanskrit: शाकैः कार्या तृतीया स्यादेवं द्रव्यगतो विधिः । अत्रापीष्टं पितॄणां वै नित्यमेव विधीयते
verses.transliteration: śākaiḥ kāryā tṛtīyā syādevaṃ dravyagato vidhiḥ / atrāpīṣṭaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vai nityameva vidhīyate
verses.translation: He who performs {Sraddha) on the fifth day attains great glory and splendour.
verses.hindi: एवमभ्यथितो देवैः स्तूयमानो मुहुमु हु: । जगामात्मविनाशाय यतो हिमवतस्तटम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs {Sraddha) on the fifth day attains great glory and splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs {Sraddha) on the fifth day attains great glory and splendour.

verses.sanskrit: या चाप्यन्या चतुर्थी स्यात्तां च कुर्याद्विशेषतः । आसु श्राद्धं बुधः कुर्वन्सर्वस्वेनापि नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: yā cāpyanyā caturthī syāttāṃ ca kuryādviśeṣataḥ / āsu śrāddhaṃ budhaḥ kurvansarvasvenāpi nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: VV.9-20 state the fruit of performance of Sr&ddha on each Tithh
verses.hindi: आपका बलबीये तो अमोघ है और आपका पराक्रम भी मोघ नहीं है।१५। आपके अस्त्र भो कुसुम परम सुकुमार है तथा वे सदा ही अमोघ हैं। अब यह तारक नाम का दानव ब्रह्माजी के ही द्वारा वरदान प्राप्त कर लेने वाला है ।१६। यह समस्त लोकों को बाधा दे रहा है और हमको तो
verses.wordMeaning: VV.9-20 state the fruit of performance of Sr&ddha on each Tithh
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.9-20 state the fruit of performance of Sr&ddha on each Tithh

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्रमाप्नोति हि श्रेयः परत्रेह च मोदते । पितरः पर्वकालेषु तिथिकालेषु देवताः
verses.transliteration: kṣipramāpnoti hi śreyaḥ paratreha ca modate / pitaraḥ parvakāleṣu tithikāleṣu devatāḥ
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: विशेष रूप से सता रहा है। इसको भगवानु शिव के पुत्र के विना अन्य किसी से भी कुछ भय नहीं है अर्थात् इसका वध शिव का हो पुत्र कर सकता है ।१७। यह एक महान् कायं है । आपके विना कोई भी अन्य इसको नहीं कर सकता है चाहे किसो से भा कहा जावे । यह तो आपके हो अपने
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषु पुरुषा यान्ति निपातमिव धेनवः । मासांते प्रतिगच्छेयुरष्टकासु ह्यपूजिताः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣu puruṣā yānti nipātamiva dhenavaḥ / māsāṃte pratigaccheyuraṣṭakāsu hyapūjitāḥ
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: कर से होगा और अन्य किसो से भी कभी नहीं हो सकता है।१८। आत्मा की एकता के ध्यान में निरत भगवान् शिव इस समय में है और गौरी भी यहाँ पर बिद्यमान हैं ये परम रम्य हिमाचल के तल में है और मुनिगण से घिरे हैं ।१६। है महान् बलवाले ! आप उन शिव को गौरी में नियोजित कर
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: मोघास्तस्य भवन्त्याशाः परत्रेह च सर्वशः । पूजकानां समुत्कर्षो नास्तिकानामधोगतिः
verses.transliteration: moghāstasya bhavantyāśāḥ paratreha ca sarvaśaḥ / pūjakānāṃ samutkarṣo nāstikānāmadhogatiḥ
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: दो । उस का सुत जन्म धारण करेगा । यह एक छोटा सा हमारा कायं है । इस को आप करके हमारी सुरक्षा कोजिए ।२०। इस तरह से देवों के द्वारा कामदेव से बार-बार प्रार्थना की गयी थी और बहुत स्तवन भी उसका किया गया था । तब वह अपनी आत्मा के विनाश के लिए वहाँ से कामदेव
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: देवास्तु दायिनो यान्ति तिर्यग्गच्छन्त्यदायिनः । पुष्टिं प्रजां स्मृतिं मेधां पुत्रानैश्वर्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: devāstu dāyino yānti tiryaggacchantyadāyinaḥ / puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ putrānaiśvaryameva ca
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: हिमवाच् के तट पर गया था
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वाणः पूजनं चासु सर्वं पूर्णं समश्नुते । प्रतिपद्धनलाभाय लब्धं चास्य न नश्यति
verses.transliteration: kurvāṇaḥ pūjanaṃ cāsu sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ samaśnute / pratipaddhanalābhāya labdhaṃ cāsya na naśyati
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयायां तु यः कुर्याद्द्विपदाधिंपतिर् भवेत् । वरार्थिनां तृतीया तु शत्रुघ्नी पापनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: dvitīyāyāṃ tu yaḥ kuryāddvipadādhiṃpatir bhavet / varārthināṃ tṛtīyā tu śatrughnī pāpanāśinī

verses.hindi: विस्मृत्य स हि कार्याणि वाणविद्धोंशतिके स्थिताम् ।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थ्यां तु प्रकुर्वाणः शत्रुच्छिद्राणि पश्यति । पञ्चम्यां चापिकुर्वाणः प्राप्नोति महतीं श्रियम्
verses.transliteration: caturthyāṃ tu prakurvāṇaḥ śatrucchidrāṇi paśyati / pañcamyāṃ cāpikurvāṇaḥ prāpnoti mahatīṃ śriyam

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठ्यां श्राद्धानि कुर्वाणः संपूज्यः स्यात्प्रयत्नतः । कुरुते यस्तु सप्तम्यां श्राद्धानि सततं नरः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhāni kurvāṇaḥ saṃpūjyaḥ syātprayatnataḥ / kurute yastu saptamyāṃ śrāddhāni satataṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: तं इृश्वा कुपितः शूली त्रेलोक्यदहनक्ष मः ।
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: महीशत्वमवाप्नोति गणानां चाधिपो भवेत् । संपूर्णामृद्धिमाप्नोति यो ऽष्टम्यां कुरुते नरः
verses.transliteration: mahīśatvamavāpnoti gaṇānāṃ cādhipo bhavet / saṃpūrṇāmṛddhimāpnoti yo 'ṣṭamyāṃ kurute naraḥ
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
