verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं नवम्यां कर्त्तव्यमैश्वर्यं स्त्रीश्च काङ्क्षता । कुर्वन्दशम्यां तु नरो ब्राह्मीं श्रियमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ navamyāṃ karttavyamaiśvaryaṃ strīśca kāṅkṣatā / kurvandaśamyāṃ tu naro brāhmīṃ śriyamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: कुसुमों के बाणों बाले आयुध लिये हुए कामदेव ने वहाँ पर भगवान् णिव को देखा था जो कुछ को समाराधना करके ध्यान में नेश्ों को बन्द किये हुए समाधिस्थ संस्थित थे ।२२। इसी बीच में यह भो उसने देखा था कि हिमवान् की पुत्रों वातो मी भगवात् शिव को आराधना की इच्छा
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: वेदांश्चैवाप्नुयात्सर्वान्विप्राणां समतां व्रजेत् । एकादश्यां परं दानमैश्वर्य सततं तथा
verses.transliteration: vedāṃścaivāpnuyātsarvānviprāṇāṃ samatāṃ vrajet / ekādaśyāṃ paraṃ dānamaiśvarya satataṃ tathā
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: बाली वहाँ पर आ गयी थी जो अत्यद्मुत स्वरूप से सुसम्पन्न थी
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां जयलाभं च राज्यमायुर्वसूनि च । प्रजावृद्धिं पशून्मेधां स्वातन्त्र्यं पुष्टिमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśyāṃ jayalābhaṃ ca rājyamāyurvasūni ca / prajāvṛddhiṃ paśūnmedhāṃ svātantryaṃ puṣṭimuttamām
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: अति बलवान् मदन ने वहाँ देखा था कि यह पार्वती णम्भु के समीप में पहुँच कर गन्ध-पुष्प और उपहारों के द्वारा शिव को Fe में संलग्न बी ।२४। वह मदन समस्त प्राणियो के द्वारा अदृश्य था और उनके समीप में ही संस्थित होकर उसने अत्युत्तम पुष्पो के वाणों से महेश्वर के हृदय को
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घमायुरथैश्वर्यं कुर्वाणस्तु त्रयोदशीम् । युवानश्च गृहे यस्य मृतास्तेभ्यः प्रदापयेत्
verses.transliteration: dīrghamāyurathaiśvaryaṃ kurvāṇastu trayodaśīm / yuvānaśca gṛhe yasya mṛtāstebhyaḥ pradāpayet
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: बेधा था ।२५। मन्मथ के द्वारा आविष्ट चेतना बाले उस भगवान् शिव ने समस्त ध्यान करने के कार्यों को भुलाकर काम के बाणों से विद्ध होकर समीप में स्थित गौरी की ओर देखा था ।२६। फिर उन्होंने धेये का समाश्रय ग्रहण किया था और मन में चिन्तन कर रहे ये कि यह विकार क्यों और
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: शस्त्रेण वा हता ये च तेषां दद्याच्चतुर्दशीम् । अमावास्यां प्रयत्नेन श्राद्धं कुर्यात्सदा शुचिः
verses.transliteration: śastreṇa vā hatā ye ca teṣāṃ dadyāccaturdaśīm / amāvāsyāṃ prayatnena śrāddhaṃ kuryātsadā śuciḥ
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.hindi: कैसे हो रहा है । उसी समय में उन्होंने देखा था कि कामदेव कुसुमों के आयुध वाला आगे ससद है ।२७। उसको देखकर जिशूली प्रभु बहुत हो कद हो गये ये जो कि तोनों लोकों को दग्ध कर देने में समर्थ ये । उन्होने अपना मस्तक में स्थित तोसरा नेत्र खोल दिया था और उसी क्षण में मकरध्वज
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामानवाप्नोति स्वर्गं चानन्तमश्नुते । तथाविषमजातानां यमलानां च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmānavāpnoti svargaṃ cānantamaśnute / tathāviṣamajātānāṃ yamalānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं दद्यादमावास्यां सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् । मघासु कुर्वञ्छ्राद्धानि सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ dadyādamāvāsyāṃ sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt / maghāsu kurvañchrāddhāni sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षमर्चितास्तेन भवन्ति पितरस्तदा । पितृदवा मघा यस्मात्तस्मात्तास्वक्षयं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣamarcitāstena bhavanti pitarastadā / pitṛdavā maghā yasmāttasmāttāsvakṣayaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.wordMeaning: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: (One who performs Sraddha) on the twelfth day acquires victory, kingdoms, longevity, wealth, increase in the progeny, cattle, wealth, intellect, freedom and excellent nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे तिथिश्राद्धवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः ॥ १७॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच यमस्तु यानि श्राद्धानि प्रोवाच शशबिन्दवे । तानि मे शृणु कार्याणि नक्षत्रेषु पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe tithiśrāddhavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 17// bṛhaspatiruvāca yamastu yāni śrāddhāni provāca śaśabindave / tāni me śṛṇu kāryāṇi nakṣatreṣu pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: "Listen from me to the details of the Sraddhas that should be separately performed under different constellations. These had been recounted to Sasabindu by Yama.
verses.wordMeaning: "Listen from me to the details of the Sraddhas that should be separately performed under different constellations. These had been recounted to Sasabindu by Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Listen from me to the details of the Sraddhas that should be separately performed under different constellations. These had been recounted to Sasabindu by Yama.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं यः कृत्तिकायोगं कुरुते सततं नरः । अग्नीनाधाय स स्वर्गे राजते सुदृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kṛttikāyogaṃ kurute satataṃ naraḥ / agnīnādhāya sa svarge rājate sudṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: The man who always performs the Sraddha under the Krttika constellation after gathering the sacred fires, shines in the heaven. He must strictly adhere to the obervances of these holy rites.
verses.hindi: स्तुहि बाल महादेवं स तु सर्वार्थसिद्धिदः
verses.wordMeaning: The man who always performs the Sraddha under the Krttika constellation after gathering the sacred fires, shines in the heaven. He must strictly adhere to the obervances of these holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who always performs the Sraddha under the Krttika constellation after gathering the sacred fires, shines in the heaven. He must strictly adhere to the obervances of these holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: अपत्यकामो रोहिण्यां सौम्ये तेजस्विना भवेत् । प्रायशः क्रूरकर्माणि आर्द्रायां श्राद्धमाचरन्
verses.transliteration: apatyakāmo rohiṇyāṃ saumye tejasvinā bhavet / prāyaśaḥ krūrakarmāṇi ārdrāyāṃ śrāddhamācaran
verses.translation: He who desires children should perform Sraddha' under Rohini constellation.
verses.wordMeaning: He who desires children should perform Sraddha' under Rohini constellation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who desires children should perform Sraddha' under Rohini constellation.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रभागी भवेत्पुत्री श्राद्धं कृत्वा पुनर्वसौ । पुष्टिकामः पुनस्तिष्ये श्राद्धं कुर्वीत मानवः
verses.transliteration: kṣetrabhāgī bhavetputrī śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā punarvasau / puṣṭikāmaḥ punastiṣye śrāddhaṃ kurvīta mānavaḥ
verses.translation: By performing &radd ha under Punarvasu constellation one inherits a share in fields (agricultural lands) and becomes blessed with sons.
verses.hindi: शिव के द्वारा अवज्ञात हुई शल कन्या बहुत ही दुःखित हुई थी । फिर भाता-सिता की आज्ञा से वह तपश्चर्या करने के लिए वन में चली गयी थी । इसके उपरान्त उस कामदेव की भस्म को देखकर गणेश्वर चित्रकर्मा उस भस्म से चित्र के आकार वाला पुरुष कर दिया था ।३०। भगवान रुद्र ने
verses.wordMeaning: By performing &radd ha under Punarvasu constellation one inherits a share in fields (agricultural lands) and becomes blessed with sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing &radd ha under Punarvasu constellation one inherits a share in fields (agricultural lands) and becomes blessed with sons.

verses.sanskrit: आश्लेषासु पितॄनर्चन्वीरान्पुत्रानवाप्नुयात् । जातीनां भवति श्रेष्ठो मघासु श्राद्धमाचरन्
verses.transliteration: āśleṣāsu pitṝnarcanvīrānputrānavāpnuyāt / jātīnāṃ bhavati śreṣṭho maghāsu śrāddhamācaran
verses.translation: One who worships the Pitrs under Ailesa constel- lation shall attain heroic sons.
verses.hindi: विचित्र शरीर बाले पुरुष को अपने आगे देखा था । उसी क्षण में समुत्पन्न जीव वाला होगया था और ऐसा सुन्दर था । बह उसी क्षण में समुत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: One who worships the Pitrs under Ailesa constel- lation shall attain heroic sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who worships the Pitrs under Ailesa constel- lation shall attain heroic sons.

verses.sanskrit: फाल्गुनीषु पितॄनर्चन्सौभाग्यं लभते नरः । प्रदानशीलः सापत्य उत्तरासु करोति यः
verses.transliteration: phālgunīṣu pitṝnarcansaubhāgyaṃ labhate naraḥ / pradānaśīlaḥ sāpatya uttarāsu karoti yaḥ
verses.translation: The man who worships the Pitrs under Purva Phalguni constellation obtains good fortune.
verses.hindi: होंगे । वह महान् बलवाला और अत्यन्त मब्याहत के सूयं की सी प्रभा बाला तेजस्वी शा ।३१। चित्रकर्मा ने उसका अपनो बाहुओं से आलिङ्गन किया था और बहुत प्रसन्न हुआ था । चित्रकर्मा ने उससे;कहा था है बाल  भगवान् शिव की स्तुति करो क्योंकि वे समस्त अयो की सिद्धि के दाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The man who worships the Pitrs under Purva Phalguni constellation obtains good fortune.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who worships the Pitrs under Purva Phalguni constellation obtains good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: संसत्सु मुख्यो भवति हस्ते ऽभ्यर्च्य पितॄनपि । चित्रायां चैव यः कुर्यात्पश्येद्रूपवतः सुतान्
verses.transliteration: saṃsatsu mukhyo bhavati haste 'bhyarcya pitṝnapi / citrāyāṃ caiva yaḥ kuryātpaśyedrūpavataḥ sutān
verses.translation: By worshipping the Pitrs under the constellation Hasta, one becomes the chief man in the assemblies.
verses.hindi: दिया था उसने शतरुद्रिय का जाप करते हुए सो बार भगवान् रुद्र को प्रणाम किया था ।३३। इसके अनन्तर वृषध्वज महादेव जी परम प्रसन्न हुए थे । उन्होंने वरमांगने को आज्ञा दी थी और उस बालक ने यह वरदान माँगा
verses.wordMeaning: By worshipping the Pitrs under the constellation Hasta, one becomes the chief man in the assemblies.
verses.commentary: Sense: By worshipping the Pitrs under the constellation Hasta, one becomes the chief man in the assemblies.

verses.sanskrit: स्वातिना चैव यः कुर्याद्वाणिज्ये लाभमाप्नुयात् । पुत्रार्थी तु विशाखासु श्राद्धमीहेत मालवः
verses.transliteration: svātinā caiva yaḥ kuryādvāṇijye lābhamāpnuyāt / putrārthī tu viśākhāsu śrāddhamīheta mālavaḥ
verses.translation: He who performs § raddha under Svati constellation shall acquire profit in trade.
verses.hindi: १९२   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण था ।३४। मेरे प्रतिद्दन्दी के बल के लिए मेरे बल से योजित करेंगे ओर उस मेरे प्रतिइ्द्वी के जो भी अस्त्र-शस्त्र होगे वे व्यर्थ हो जायेंगे और मेरे नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs § raddha under Svati constellation shall acquire profit in trade.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs § raddha under Svati constellation shall acquire profit in trade.

verses.sanskrit: अनुराधासु कुर्वाणो नरश्चक्रं प्रवर्त्तयेत् । आधिपत्यं भवेच्छ्रेष्ठं ज्येष्ठायां सततं तु यः
verses.transliteration: anurādhāsu kurvāṇo naraścakraṃ pravarttayet / ādhipatyaṃ bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhāyāṃ satataṃ tu yaḥ
verses.translation: One who performs Sr&ddha under the constellation Anuradha shall be able to exercise the sovereignty of a realm. He who always performs Sr&ddha under Jyestha constellation shall acquire excellent overlordship.
verses.hindi: यदुवाच ततो नाम्ना भंडो लोकेषु कथ्यते
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs Sr&ddha under the constellation Anuradha shall be able to exercise the sovereignty of a realm. He who always performs Sr&ddha under Jyestha constellation shall acquire excellent overlordship.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs Sr&ddha under the constellation Anuradha shall be able to exercise the sovereignty of a realm. He who always performs Sr&ddha under Jyestha constellation shall acquire excellent overlordship.

verses.sanskrit: मूलेनारोग्यमिच्छन्ति ह्याषाढासु महद्यशः । उत्तरासु तु कुर्वाणो वीतशोको भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: mūlenārogyamicchanti hyāṣāḍhāsu mahadyaśaḥ / uttarāsu tu kurvāṇo vītaśoko bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: They who wish for freedom from illness should perform Sr&ddha under Mula constellation.
verses.hindi: दत्त्वाइस्त्राणि च शस्त्राणि तत्रैवांत राच्च सः
verses.wordMeaning: They who wish for freedom from illness should perform Sr&ddha under Mula constellation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They who wish for freedom from illness should perform Sr&ddha under Mula constellation.

verses.sanskrit: श्रवणेन तु लोकेषु प्राप्नुयात्परमां गतिम् । राज्यभागी धनिष्ठासु प्राप्नुया द्विपुलं धनम्
verses.transliteration: śravaṇena tu lokeṣu prāpnuyātparamāṃ gatim / rājyabhāgī dhaniṣṭhāsu prāpnuyā dvipulaṃ dhanam
verses.translation: By performing Sr&ddha under the constellation per- taining to Varuna (i.e. constellation &atabhisak) one conquers the worlds by means of the Sraddhas, attains (the mastery of) the Vedas along with the ancillary subjects and obtains the greatest achievements of physicians.
verses.hindi: ऐसा ही सब होगा--यह कहकर फिर प्रभु ते कुछ विचार करके साठ सहस्र वर्ष तक इसको राज्य भी दे दिया था।३६। इस चरित को देखकर धाता ने भण्डिति-भण्डिति-यह कहा था इसीलिये वह सोक में भण्ड--इस नाम से ही कहा जाया करता है।३७। यह वरदान उस को देकर मुनिगणों
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sr&ddha under the constellation per- taining to Varuna (i.e. constellation &atabhisak) one conquers the worlds by means of the Sraddhas, attains (the mastery of) the Vedas along with the ancillary subjects and obtains the greatest achievements of physicians.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sr&ddha under the constellation per- taining to Varuna (i.e. constellation &atabhisak) one conquers the worlds by means of the Sraddhas, attains (the mastery of) the Vedas along with the ancillary subjects and obtains the greatest achievements of physicians.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धनिर्जितलोकश्च वेदान् सांगानवाप्नुयात् । नक्षत्रैर्वारुणैः कुर्वन्भिषक्सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhanirjitalokaśca vedān sāṃgānavāpnuyāt / nakṣatrairvāruṇaiḥ kurvanbhiṣaksiddhimavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: One who performs Sr&ddha under the excellent constellation Revatl acquires much wealth by means of metals other than silver and gold.
verses.hindi: से समावृत बहू अस्य देकर वह पर ही तिरोहित हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs Sr&ddha under the excellent constellation Revatl acquires much wealth by means of metals other than silver and gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs Sr&ddha under the excellent constellation Revatl acquires much wealth by means of metals other than silver and gold.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वप्रौष्ठ पदे कुर्वन्विन्देताजीविकान्बहून् । उत्तरास्वनतिक्रम्य विन्देद्गा वै सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: pūrvaprauṣṭha pade kurvanvindetājīvikānbahūn / uttarāsvanatikramya vindedgā vai sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.
verses.hindi: रुद्रकोपानलाउजातो यतो भण्डो महाबल: । तस्माद्रौद्रस्वमावो हि दानवश्चाभवत्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.

verses.sanskrit: बहुकुप्यकृतं द्रव्यं विन्देत्कुर्वन्सुरेवतीम् । अश्वानश्वयुजा भक्तो भरण्यां साधुसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: bahukupyakṛtaṃ dravyaṃ vindetkurvansurevatīm / aśvānaśvayujā bhakto bharaṇyāṃ sādhusattamaḥ
verses.translation: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.
verses.hindi: यत्र स्थित्वा तु देत्येन्द्र स्त्रैलोक्यं शासितं पुरा । तद्गत्वा शोणितपुरं कुरुष्व त्वं यथापुरम्
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.

verses.sanskrit: इमं श्राद्धविधिं कुर्वञ्छशबिन्दुर्महीमिमाम् । कृत्स्नां बलेन सो ऽक्लिष्ठो लभ्ध्वा च प्रशशास ह
verses.transliteration: imaṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ kurvañchaśabindurmahīmimām / kṛtsnāṃ balena so 'kliṣṭho labhdhvā ca praśaśāsa ha
verses.translation: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.
verses.hindi: अथामिविक्तः शुक्रेण हैतेयेश्व महावले: । शुशुभे परया लक्ष्म्या तेजसा च समन्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sr&ddhas,.in accordance with these injunctions regarding Sraddhas, Sa£abindu acquired the entire earth through his prowess with ease (lit. without any strain) and ruled over it.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्री ब्रहामाण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे नक्षत्रश्राद्धं नाम अष्टादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ १८॥ शंयुरुवाच किं स्विद्दत्तं पितॄणां तु तृप्तिदं वदतां वर । किंस्वित्स्याच्चिररात्राय किं वानन्त्याय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: iti śrī brahāmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe nakṣatraśrāddhaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 18// śaṃyuruvāca kiṃ sviddattaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu tṛptidaṃ vadatāṃ vara / kiṃsvitsyāccirarātrāya kiṃ vānantyāya kalpate
verses.translation: "What, O excellent one among the eloquent persons, when offered to the Pitrs, yields satisfaction (unto them)? What shall be beneficent for a long time? What is conducive to infinite bliss?"
verses.hindi: हिरण्याय तु यदत्त किरीटं ब्रह्मणा पुरा ।
verses.wordMeaning: "What, O excellent one among the eloquent persons, when offered to the Pitrs, yields satisfaction (unto them)? What shall be beneficent for a long time? What is conducive to infinite bliss?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "What, O excellent one among the eloquent persons, when offered to the Pitrs, yields satisfaction (unto them)? What shall be beneficent for a long time? What is conducive to infinite bliss?"

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच हवीषि श्राद्धकल्पे तु यानि श्राद्धविदो विदुः । तानि मे शृणु सर्वाणि फलं चैषां यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca havīṣi śrāddhakalpe tu yāni śrāddhavido viduḥ / tāni me śṛṇu sarvāṇi phalaṃ caiṣāṃ yathātatham
verses.translation: Listen from me to all those offerings which those who are conversant with the ritualistic details of Sraddha know. Listen to their due benefits as well.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen from me to all those offerings which those who are conversant with the ritualistic details of Sraddha know. Listen to their due benefits as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen from me to all those offerings which those who are conversant with the ritualistic details of Sraddha know. Listen to their due benefits as well.

verses.sanskrit: तिलैर्व्रीहियवैमाषैरद्भिर्मूलफलैस्तथा । दत्तेन मासं प्रीयन्ते श्राद्धेन हि पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: tilairvrīhiyavaimāṣairadbhirmūlaphalaistathā / dattena māsaṃ prīyante śrāddhena hi pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: If gingelly seeds, grains of rice, barleys, pulses, water libations, roots and fruits were offered in Sraddha the grand- fathers are pleased for the period of a month.1
verses.hindi: क्योंकि भण्ड भगवान रुद्र की कोषाग्नि से समुत्पन्न हुआ था अत एब वह महा बलवान् था और उसका स्वभाव भी परम रोद्र हुआ था। ऐसा ही यह दानव या ।१। इसके पश्चात महा तेजस्वी हैत्यों के पुरोहित शुक्रा- चायं वहां पर आये ये और सैकड़ों महाबली हैतेय भी समागत हुए थे
verses.wordMeaning: If gingelly seeds, grains of rice, barleys, pulses, water libations, roots and fruits were offered in Sraddha the grand- fathers are pleased for the period of a month.1
verses.commentary: Sense: If gingelly seeds, grains of rice, barleys, pulses, water libations, roots and fruits were offered in Sraddha the grand- fathers are pleased for the period of a month.1

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यैः प्रीणन्ति द्वौ मासौ त्रीन्मासान्हारिणेन तु । शाशेन चतुरो मासान्पञ्च प्रीणाति शाकुनैः
verses.transliteration: matsyaiḥ prīṇanti dvau māsau trīnmāsānhāriṇena tu / śāśena caturo māsānpañca prīṇāti śākunaiḥ
verses.translation: They are satisfied for two months, if Sraddha is offered with different kinds of fish. They are satisfied for three months, if the Sraddha is offered with venison (deer's flesh).
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त भण्ड ने देत्यों के वंश में होने वाले आदि शिल्पी मय को बुलाया था । भृगु के पुत्र के द्वारा नियुक्त होते हुए उसने उस शिल्पी से अथं युक्त वचन कहा था ।३। जहाँ पर स्थित होकर पहिले देत्यों के स्वामी ने लोक्य का शासन किया था वहाँ पर जाकर जैसा भी पुर होता है गेसा
verses.wordMeaning: They are satisfied for two months, if Sraddha is offered with different kinds of fish. They are satisfied for three months, if the Sraddha is offered with venison (deer's flesh).
verses.commentary: Sense: They are satisfied for two months, if Sraddha is offered with different kinds of fish. They are satisfied for three months, if the Sraddha is offered with venison (deer's flesh).

verses.sanskrit: वाराहेण तु षण्मासाञ्छागलं सप्तमासिकम् । अष्टमासिकमित्युक्तं यच्च पार्वतकं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vārāheṇa tu ṣaṇmāsāñchāgalaṃ saptamāsikam / aṣṭamāsikamityuktaṃ yacca pārvatakaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: VV 3-11 give the vegetarian and non- vegetarian articles of food liked by and therefore recommended to serve to Brahmins while dining at a Sraddha. The Apastamba Dh.S. (600 B.C.) prescribes flesh-eating as obliga- tory at Sraddha and enumerates the animals the flesh of which gratifies Pitrs for what period e.g. the flesh of a cow offered in Sraddha gratifies the Pitrs for a year ( Samvatsaram gavayena prltih ) and for other animals etc. see Apas- tainba Dh. S. II. 7. 16.25; II.7.17.3. A refusal to accept non-vegetarian food at Sraddha is punished by going to hell ( Visyudharmottara 1.140.49-50, also Manu V 35; KP.II.17.40).
verses.hindi: शोगित पुर का निर्माण करी ।४। यह वचन श्रवण करके उस शिल्पी ने जाकर एक महान पुर की रचना को थी । वह पुर मन से ही ईक्षण के द्वारा अमरपुर के समान था ।५। इसके अनन्तर शुक्राचायं के द्वारा तथा महाबली हैत्यों के साथ अभिषेक किया गया था । बहू परोष्कृष्ट लक्ष्मी से शोभित
verses.wordMeaning: VV 3-11 give the vegetarian and non- vegetarian articles of food liked by and therefore recommended to serve to Brahmins while dining at a Sraddha. The Apastamba Dh.S.…
verses.commentary: Sense: VV 3-11 give the vegetarian and non- vegetarian articles of food liked by and therefore recommended to serve to Brahmins while dining at a Sraddha. The Apastamba Dh.S.…

verses.sanskrit: रौरवेण तु प्रीयन्ते नव मासान्पितामहाः । गवयस्य तु मांसेन तृप्तिः स्याद्दशमासिकी
verses.transliteration: rauraveṇa tu prīyante nava māsānpitāmahāḥ / gavayasya tu māṃsena tṛptiḥ syāddaśamāsikī
verses.translation: They are pleased for six months if Sraddha is per- formed with boar's flesh.
verses.hindi: हुआ था तथा तेज से भी समन्वित था ।६। पहिले हिरण्य के लिए जो किरीट ब्रह्माजी ने प्रदान किया था वह सजोब और विनाशन होने के योग्य था तथा हैत्येन्दों के भी द्वारा भूषित या । उसको भृगु सुत के द्वारा उत्सृष्ट जो था भण्ड ने धारण किया था । यह किरीट बाल सूर्य के ही सहश था । इसके
verses.wordMeaning: They are pleased for six months if Sraddha is per- formed with boar's flesh.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are pleased for six months if Sraddha is per- formed with boar's flesh.

verses.sanskrit: औरभ्रेण च मांसेन मासानेकादशैव तु । श्राद्धे च तृप्तिदं गव्यं पयः संवत्सरं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: aurabhreṇa ca māṃsena māsānekādaśaiva tu / śrāddhe ca tṛptidaṃ gavyaṃ payaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The grandfathers are delighted for n'ne months with the flesh of Ruru variety of deer.
verses.hindi: उपरान्त बह सिहासन पर समासीन हुआ था और सभी आभरणों से विभू- वित हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: The grandfathers are delighted for n'ne months with the flesh of Ruru variety of deer.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grandfathers are delighted for n'ne months with the flesh of Ruru variety of deer.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्त्याय भवेत्तद्वत्खड्गमांसं पितृक्षये । पायसं मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां छायायां कुञ्जरस्य च
verses.transliteration: ānantyāya bhavettadvatkhaḍgamāṃsaṃ pitṛkṣaye / pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ chāyāyāṃ kuñjarasya ca
verses.translation: The satisfaction lasts for eleven months if sheep's flesh is offered in the Sraddha. O Brahmanas, cow's milk offered in the Sraddha, yields satisfaction (to the Pitrs) fora year.
verses.wordMeaning: The satisfaction lasts for eleven months if sheep's flesh is offered in the Sraddha. O Brahmanas, cow's milk offered in the Sraddha, yields satisfaction (to the Pitrs) fora year.
verses.commentary: Sense: The satisfaction lasts for eleven months if sheep's flesh is offered in the Sraddha. O Brahmanas, cow's milk offered in the Sraddha, yields satisfaction (to the Pitrs) fora year.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णच्छागस्य मासेन तृप्तिर्भवति शाश्वती । अत्र गाथाः पितृगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇacchāgasya māsena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī / atra gāthāḥ pitṛgītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ
verses.translation: The flesh of the rhinoceros shall be conducive to infinite bliss in the abode of the Pitrs. Milk pudding offered along with honey and ghee at the time of Gajacchdya 1 yields per- petual satisfaction.
verses.wordMeaning: The flesh of the rhinoceros shall be conducive to infinite bliss in the abode of the Pitrs. Milk pudding offered along with honey and ghee at the time of Gajacchdya 1 yields per- petual satisfaction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The flesh of the rhinoceros shall be conducive to infinite bliss in the abode of the Pitrs. Milk pudding offered along with honey and ghee at the time of Gajacchdya 1 yields per- petual satisfaction.

verses.sanskrit: तास्ते ऽहं कीर्त्तयिष्यामि यथावत्सन्निबोध मे । अपि नः स कुले यायाद्यो नो दद्यात् त्रयोदशीम्
verses.transliteration: tāste 'haṃ kīrttayiṣyāmi yathāvatsannibodha me / api naḥ sa kule yāyādyo no dadyāt trayodaśīm
verses.translation: "O dear father, recount to me who ask, the fruit of Gaya etc; mention fully the merits to the donors**.
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear father, recount to me who ask, the fruit of Gaya etc; mention fully the merits to the donors**.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear father, recount to me who ask, the fruit of Gaya etc; mention fully the merits to the donors**.

verses.sanskrit: आजेन सर्वलोहेन वर्षासु च मघासु च । एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येको ऽपि गयां व्रजेत् । गौरीं वाप्युद्वहेद्भार्यां नालं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत्
verses.transliteration: ājena sarvalohena varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca / eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko 'pi gayāṃ vrajet / gaurīṃ vāpyudvahedbhāryāṃ nālaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet
verses.translation: "The Sraddha at Gaya is of everlasting benefit. So also the Japas, Homas, the penances. It is in the abode of the Pitrs, O son, and therefore the Sraddha there is remember- ed as yielding an everlasting benefit.
verses.wordMeaning: "The Sraddha at Gaya is of everlasting benefit. So also the Japas, Homas, the penances. It is in the abode of the Pitrs, O son, and therefore the Sraddha there is remember- ed as yielding an everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The Sraddha at Gaya is of everlasting benefit. So also the Japas, Homas, the penances. It is in the abode of the Pitrs, O son, and therefore the Sraddha there is remember- ed as yielding an everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: शंयुरुवाच गयादीनां फलं तात ब्रूहि मे परिपृच्छतः । दातॄणां चैव यत्पुण्यं निखिलेन प्रवीहि मे
verses.transliteration: śaṃyuruvāca gayādīnāṃ phalaṃ tāta brūhi me paripṛcchataḥ / dātṝṇāṃ caiva yatpuṇyaṃ nikhilena pravīhi me
verses.translation: The son begot of a Gauri type of a girl after she had completed her twentyfirst year shall perform great sacri- fices. (?) This is remembered as its fruit.
verses.wordMeaning: The son begot of a Gauri type of a girl after she had completed her twentyfirst year shall perform great sacri- fices. (?) This is remembered as its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son begot of a Gauri type of a girl after she had completed her twentyfirst year shall perform great sacri- fices. (?) This is remembered as its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच गयायामक्षयं श्राद्धञ्जपहोमतपांसि च । पितृक्षये हि तत्पुत्र तस्मात्तत्राक्षयं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca gayāyāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhañjapahomatapāṃsi ca / pitṛkṣaye hi tatputra tasmāttatrākṣayaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: W.14-19 describe the reward one gets by discharging a bull on the occasion «f
verses.hindi: दो चमर भी चन्द्रमा के समान थे जो सजीव ये और ब्रह्माजी के ही द्वारा निमित हुए ये । इसके निषेवण करने का यह प्रभाव था कि सेवन करने वाले कोई भी रोग ओर दुःख नहीं हुआ करता शा। उनको भी इसने धारण किया था ।=। उसका जो आतपत्र (छत्र) भी पहिले ही निमित
verses.wordMeaning: W.14-19 describe the reward one gets by discharging a bull on the occasion «f
verses.commentary: Sense: W.14-19 describe the reward one gets by discharging a bull on the occasion «f

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णायामेकविंशं तु गौर्यामुत्पादितः सुतः । महामहांश्च जुहुयादिति तस्य फलं स्मृतम् । फलं वृषस्य वक्ष्यामि गदतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: pūrṇāyāmekaviṃśaṃ tu gauryāmutpāditaḥ sutaḥ / mahāmahāṃśca juhuyāditi tasya phalaṃ smṛtam / phalaṃ vṛṣasya vakṣyāmi gadato me nibodhata
verses.translation: If a person gives during the Sraddha rite gingelly seeds mixed with jaggery, honey, or something myced with honey — everything becomes everlasting in yielding benefits.
verses.hindi: किया हुआ ब्रह्माजी ने हो प्रदान किया था जिसकी छाया में जो भी उप- बिष्ट होते हैं उनको करोड़ों अस्त्र भी कुछ बाधा नहीं दिया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: If a person gives during the Sraddha rite gingelly seeds mixed with jaggery, honey, or something myced with honey — everything becomes everlasting in yielding benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person gives during the Sraddha rite gingelly seeds mixed with jaggery, honey, or something myced with honey — everything becomes everlasting in yielding benefits.

verses.sanskrit: वृषोत्स्रष्टा पुनात्येव दशातीतान्दशावरान्
verses.transliteration: vṛṣotsraṣṭā punātyeva daśātītāndaśāvarān
verses.translation: (Charitable gifts) should always be given by men. One should not test the Brahmana. It is heard (i.e. it is laid down in the Vedas) that a Brahmana is to be tested in rites pertaining to the Pitrs and gods.1
verses.hindi: विजय नामक धभुष और रिपुं का घात करने वाला शंख था । उनके अतिरिक्त अन्य-अभ्य भी बहुत कीमती भूषण प्रदान किये थे ।१०। उसको जो सिंहासन प्रदान किया था बह अक्षय था ओर सूये के समान था उस पर बह बैठकर उत्तेजित रत्न के ही सदृश अतीव तेजस्वी हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: (Charitable gifts) should always be given by men. One should not test the Brahmana. It is heard (i.e. it is laid down in the Vedas) that a Brahmana is to be tested in rites pertaining to the Pitrs and gods.1
verses.commentary: Sense: (Charitable gifts) should always be given by men. One should not test the Brahmana. It is heard (i.e. it is laid down in the Vedas) that a Brahmana is to be tested in rites pertaining to the Pitrs and gods.1

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चित्स्पृशते तोयमवतीर्णो नदीजले । वृषोत्सर्ग्गत्पितॄणां तु ह्यक्षयं समुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: yatkiñcitspṛśate toyamavatīrṇo nadījale / vṛṣotsarggatpitṝṇāṃ tu hyakṣayaṃ samudāhṛtam
verses.translation: If a person honours those who are well established in yogic rites and Brahmanas worthy of being invited for Sraddha rites, the three deities Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara are thereby worshipped by him.
verses.hindi: उसके आठ देतेय महा बलबान हुए थे-उनके नाम ये बे-इनद्र शत्रु-- अभिश्रघ्न-बिदयन्भाली-विभोषण--उग्र कर्मा--उम्रधस्वा--विजय--अुति- पारग ।१९। उसकी चार प्रिय दंन बालो पत्नियां थी जिनके नाम ये हैं-- सुमोहिनी--कुमुदिनी--चित्रांगो और सुन्दरी ।१३। काल के ज्ञान रखने
verses.wordMeaning: If a person honours those who are well established in yogic rites and Brahmanas worthy of being invited for Sraddha rites, the three deities Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara are thereby worshipped by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person honours those who are well established in yogic rites and Brahmanas worthy of being invited for Sraddha rites, the three deities Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara are thereby worshipped by him.

verses.sanskrit: येनयेन स्पृशेत्तोयं लाङ्गूलादिभिरङ्गशः । सर्वं तदक्षयं तस्य पितॄणां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yenayena spṛśettoyaṃ lāṅgūlādibhiraṅgaśaḥ / sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ tasya pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 21-28 mention the qualifications of Brahmanas to whom gifts may be given. The Togadharma was regarded as the foremost among Dharmas and hence naturally Yogis got a preference.
verses.hindi: वाले इन्द्र के सहित सभी देवगणों ने उसकी सेवा की थी। उसके पास सहस्रों ही रथ--अश्व--गज और पदाति सैनिक ये
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 21-28 mention the qualifications of Brahmanas to whom gifts may be given. The Togadharma was regarded as the foremost among Dharmas and hence naturally Yogis got a preference.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 21-28 mention the qualifications of Brahmanas to whom gifts may be given. The Togadharma was regarded as the foremost among Dharmas and hence naturally Yogis got a preference.

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गैः खुरैर्वा भूमिं यामुल्लिखत्यनिशं वृषः । मधुकुल्याः पितॄंस्तस्य ह्यक्षयाश्च भवन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: śṛṅgaiḥ khurairvā bhūmiṃ yāmullikhatyaniśaṃ vṛṣaḥ / madhukulyāḥ pitṝṃstasya hyakṣayāśca bhavanti vai
verses.translation: A rogue, one who drinks liquor, one who keeps ani- mals, one who has been banished, one who works as the common servant of all the villagers, one whose profession is usury, one who does business in the bazar.
verses.wordMeaning: A rogue, one who drinks liquor, one who keeps ani- mals, one who has been banished, one who works as the common servant of all the villagers, one whose profession is usury, one who does business in the bazar.
verses.commentary: Sense: A rogue, one who drinks liquor, one who keeps ani- mals, one who has been banished, one who works as the common servant of all the villagers, one whose profession is usury, one who does business in the bazar.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रनल्वमात्रेण तडागेन यथास्रुतिः । तृप्तिस्तु या पितॄणां वै सा वृषेणेह कल्पते
verses.transliteration: sahasranalvamātreṇa taḍāgena yathāsrutiḥ / tṛptistu yā pitṝṇāṃ vai sā vṛṣeṇeha kalpate
verses.translation: One who burns houses, one who gives poison, a Sudra, a common priest of the village performing a Yajna (on behalf of anyone and everyone), a Kandaprha (a Brahmana who lives by making arrows and other weapons), a Kundasin ( a pander, a pimp), one who imbibes liquor, one who sells Soma juice.
verses.wordMeaning: One who burns houses, one who gives poison, a Sudra, a common priest of the village performing a Yajna (on behalf of anyone and everyone), a Kandaprha (a Brahmana who lives by making arrows and other weapons), a Kundasin ( a pander, a pimp), one who imbibes liquor,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One who burns houses, one who gives poison, a Sudra, a common priest of the village performing a Yajna (on behalf of anyone and everyone), a Kandaprha (a Brahmana who lives by making arrows and other weapons), a Kundasin ( a pander, a pimp), one who imbibes liquor,…

verses.sanskrit: यो ददाति गुडोन्मिश्रतिलानि श्राद्धकर्मणि । मधु वामधुमिश्रं वा सर्वमेवाक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yo dadāti guḍonmiśratilāni śrāddhakarmaṇi / madhu vāmadhumiśraṃ vā sarvamevākṣayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: One who has gone overseas, a person who works as a servant, a back-biter, one guilty of perjury, one who argues with his father, one who keeps his wife's paramour in his own house.
verses.hindi: गृहे गृहे च यज्ञाश्च संबभूकुः समंततः
verses.wordMeaning: One who has gone overseas, a person who works as a servant, a back-biter, one guilty of perjury, one who argues with his father, one who keeps his wife's paramour in his own house.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who has gone overseas, a person who works as a servant, a back-biter, one guilty of perjury, one who argues with his father, one who keeps his wife's paramour in his own house.

verses.sanskrit: न ब्राह्मणं परिक्षेत सदा देयं हि मानवैः । दैवेकर्मणि पित्र्ये च श्रूयते वै परीक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: na brāhmaṇaṃ parikṣeta sadā deyaṃ hi mānavaiḥ / daivekarmaṇi pitrye ca śrūyate vai parīkṣaṇam
verses.translation: An AbhiSasta (a wicked and cursed fellow), a thief, one who maintains himself by means of arts and crafts, a
verses.wordMeaning: An AbhiSasta (a wicked and cursed fellow), a thief, one who maintains himself by means of arts and crafts, a
verses.commentary: Sense: An AbhiSasta (a wicked and cursed fellow), a thief, one who maintains himself by means of arts and crafts, a

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववेदव्रतस्नाताः पङ्क्तीनां पावना द्विजाः । ये च भाषाविदः केचिद्ये च व्याकरणे रताः
verses.transliteration: sarvavedavratasnātāḥ paṅktīnāṃ pāvanā dvijāḥ / ye ca bhāṣāvidaḥ kecidye ca vyākaraṇe ratāḥ
verses.translation: A one-eyed fellow, a lame man, an atheist, one who has discarded the study of the Vedas, a mad fellow, a eunuch, one who has killed a child in the womb, a person who defiles the preceptor's bed.
verses.wordMeaning: A one-eyed fellow, a lame man, an atheist, one who has discarded the study of the Vedas, a mad fellow, a eunuch, one who has killed a child in the womb, a person who defiles the preceptor's bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: A one-eyed fellow, a lame man, an atheist, one who has discarded the study of the Vedas, a mad fellow, a eunuch, one who has killed a child in the womb, a person who defiles the preceptor's bed.

verses.sanskrit: अधीयते पुराणं वै धर्मशास्त्रमथापि च । त्रिणाचिकेतः पञ्चाग्निः स सौपर्णः षडङ्गवित्
verses.transliteration: adhīyate purāṇaṃ vai dharmaśāstramathāpi ca / triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgniḥ sa sauparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit
verses.translation: One who maintains himself with the help of a physi- cian, a glutton, one who commits adultery, one who sells Brahminical holy rites and observance* — all these are the defilers of rows.
verses.wordMeaning: One who maintains himself with the help of a physi- cian, a glutton, one who commits adultery, one who sells Brahminical holy rites and observance* — all these are the defilers of rows.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who maintains himself with the help of a physi- cian, a glutton, one who commits adultery, one who sells Brahminical holy rites and observance* — all these are the defilers of rows.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदेवसुतश्चैव च्छन्दोगो ज्येष्ठसामगः । पुण्येषु यश्च तीर्थेषु कृतस्नानः कृतव्रतः
verses.transliteration: brahmadevasutaścaiva cchandogo jyeṣṭhasāmagaḥ / puṇyeṣu yaśca tīrtheṣu kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtavrataḥ
verses.translation: W. 29-35 give the list of persons unfit for invitation to Srdddha Cf. K I.2 1.25-43.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 29-35 give the list of persons unfit for invitation to Srdddha Cf. K I.2 1.25-43.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 29-35 give the list of persons unfit for invitation to Srdddha Cf. K I.2 1.25-43.

verses.sanskrit: मखेषु ये च सर्वेषु भवन्त्यवभृथाप्लुताः । ये च सत्यव्रता नित्यं स्वधर्मनिरताश्च ये
verses.transliteration: makheṣu ye ca sarveṣu bhavantyavabhṛthāplutāḥ / ye ca satyavratā nityaṃ svadharmaniratāśca ye
verses.translation: VV. 36-42 enumerate peisons who are unworthy of receiving dana (religious gift at the time of Sr&ddhd).
verses.hindi: तामुवाच ततो मायां देवदेवो जनाद नः
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 36-42 enumerate peisons who are unworthy of receiving dana (religious gift at the time of Sr&ddhd).
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 36-42 enumerate peisons who are unworthy of receiving dana (religious gift at the time of Sr&ddhd).

verses.sanskrit: अक्रोधना लोभपरास्ताञ्छ्राद्धेषु निमन्त्रयेत् । एतेभ्यो दत्तमक्षय्यमेते वै पङ्क्तिपावनाः
verses.transliteration: akrodhanā lobhaparāstāñchrāddheṣu nimantrayet / etebhyo dattamakṣayyamete vai paṅktipāvanāḥ
verses.translation: Since very early times — since the period of Dharma Sutras (600 A.D.) — food for Srdddha and other sacred purposes was not allowed to be polluted even by sight by certain animals and classes of persons such as dogs, Candalas, the committers of Mahapatakas, women in menses or sonless women or by a person suffering from white leprosy. When our author gives a list of such unworthies in W. 43-44, he is echoing Gautama Dh.S. (15.25-28), Man it IH239-242, and Purarias like K 22.34-35, Va. 26-40 and VP. III. 16-12-14 to mention a few.
verses.hindi: उसके सभी दानव भृगुपुत्र के मत का अनुगमत करने वाले थे और इन सबके कलेवर बहुत विशाल थे और ये जितकाशी थे ।१५। ये सबके सव महादेवजी का अर्चन किया करते थे और सर्वदा शिव के ही शासन में समास्थित रहते थे । वहाँ पर जो भो दानव गण ये वे सब पुत्रों-पोत्रों और
verses.wordMeaning: Since very early times — since the period of Dharma Sutras (600 A.D.) — food for Srdddha and other sacred purposes was not allowed to be polluted even by sight by certain animals and classes of persons such as dogs, Candalas, the committers of Mahapatakas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since very early times — since the period of Dharma Sutras (600 A.D.) — food for Srdddha and other sacred purposes was not allowed to be polluted even by sight by certain animals and classes of persons such as dogs, Candalas, the committers of Mahapatakas,…

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धीया ब्रह्मणा ये तु योगव्रतसुनिष्ठिताः । त्रयो ऽपि पूजितास्तेन ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhīyā brahmaṇā ye tu yogavratasuniṣṭhitāḥ / trayo 'pi pūjitāstena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: A pig destroys (Sraddha) merely by seeing it; a cock destroys it with the wind from its wings. The Sraddha is destroyed by the touch of a woman in her menses. It is also destroyed if the person offers it in angry mood.
verses.hindi: धन से सुम्पन्न ये और घर-घर में चारों और यज्ञ दमा करते ये
verses.wordMeaning: A pig destroys (Sraddha) merely by seeing it; a cock destroys it with the wind from its wings. The Sraddha is destroyed by the touch of a woman in her menses. It is also destroyed if the person offers it in angry mood.
verses.commentary: Sense: A pig destroys (Sraddha) merely by seeing it; a cock destroys it with the wind from its wings. The Sraddha is destroyed by the touch of a woman in her menses. It is also destroyed if the person offers it in angry mood.

verses.sanskrit: पितृभिः सह लोकाश्च यो ह्येतान्पूजयेन्नरः । पवित्राणां पवित्रं च मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhiḥ saha lokāśca yo hyetānpūjayennaraḥ / pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam
verses.translation: The grandfathers arc pleased with what is given on the beautiful banks of rivers, on lakes and in secluded places.
verses.hindi: शास्त्र उस समय में प्रत्येक घर में पुनः प्रवृत्त हो गये थे ।१७। मुनियों के और द्विजों के मुख्य आश्रमों में तथा यज्ञं में जो कि देत्यों के ये ह्य के भोजन करने बाले भोजन किया करते ये ।१८। इस रीति से करने वाले. जित काशी मंड के सहस्र वर्ष आधे क्षण के ही समान व्यतीत हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: The grandfathers arc pleased with what is given on the beautiful banks of rivers, on lakes and in secluded places.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grandfathers arc pleased with what is given on the beautiful banks of rivers, on lakes and in secluded places.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमः सर्वधर्माणां योगधर्मो निगद्यते । अपाङ्क्तेयान्प्रवक्ष्यमि गदतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: prathamaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ yogadharmo nigadyate / apāṅkteyānpravakṣyami gadato me nibodhata
verses.translation: One should make offerings unto the Pitrs on the ground or in the open sunshine or on Darbha grasses spread like a bed.
verses.hindi: ।१६। तप से और बल के द्वारा बढ़ते हुए इस भण्ड देत्य को और क्षीण होने वाले बल से मुक्त इन्द्र को देखकर कमलापति ने माया के रचना करने का विचार किया था ।२०। और तुरन्त ही लोको का बिमोहन करने वाली कोई एक माया का सृजन किया था । फिर देवों के भी देव जनार्दन प्रभु ने
verses.wordMeaning: One should make offerings unto the Pitrs on the ground or in the open sunshine or on Darbha grasses spread like a bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should make offerings unto the Pitrs on the ground or in the open sunshine or on Darbha grasses spread like a bed.

verses.sanskrit: कितवो मद्यपो यश्च पशुपालो निराकृतः । ग्रामप्रेष्यो वार्धुषिको ह्यापणो वणिजस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kitavo madyapo yaśca paśupālo nirākṛtaḥ / grāmapreṣyo vārdhuṣiko hyāpaṇo vaṇijastathā
verses.translation: Since the times of Vasistha Dh.S. (XI. 17), Tatis (recluses), Yogis had a special place of honour among the invitees to Sraddha. During the Purana period the honour became a blind faith. As stated in Supra 9.70, feeding a yogi came to be regarded as more meritorious than feeding thousands of Br&hmapas. Hence, here in VV.58b-64 even speaking ill of Yogins is prohibited as a sin.
verses.wordMeaning: Since the times of Vasistha Dh.S. (XI. 17), Tatis (recluses), Yogis had a special place of honour among the invitees to Sraddha. During the Purana period the honour became a blind faith. As stated in Supra 9.70,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the times of Vasistha Dh.S. (XI. 17), Tatis (recluses), Yogis had a special place of honour among the invitees to Sraddha. During the Purana period the honour became a blind faith. As stated in Supra 9.70,…

verses.sanskrit: अगार दाही गरदो वृषलो ग्रामयाजकः । काण्डपृष्ठो ऽथ कुण्डाशी मधुपः सोमविक्रयी
verses.transliteration: agāra dāhī garado vṛṣalo grāmayājakaḥ / kāṇḍapṛṣṭho 'tha kuṇḍāśī madhupaḥ somavikrayī
verses.translation: One who listens to the abuse of leading Yogins who are sclf-controllcd, will become immersed in hell for a long time. There is no doubt in this matter. They will be roasted in the hell Kumbhlpaka again and again. Their tongues shall be cut again and again.
verses.hindi: विचरस्व यथाकामं त्वां न ज्ञास्यति कश्चन
verses.wordMeaning: One who listens to the abuse of leading Yogins who are sclf-controllcd, will become immersed in hell for a long time. There is no doubt in this matter. They will be roasted in the hell Kumbhlpaka again and again. Their tongues shall be cut again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who listens to the abuse of leading Yogins who are sclf-controllcd, will become immersed in hell for a long time. There is no doubt in this matter. They will be roasted in the hell Kumbhlpaka again and again. Their tongues shall be cut again and again.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रान्तरितो भृत्यः पिशुनः कूटसाक्षिकः । पित्रा विवदमानश्च यस्य चोपपतिर्गृहे
verses.transliteration: samudrāntarito bhṛtyaḥ piśunaḥ kūṭasākṣikaḥ / pitrā vivadamānaśca yasya copapatirgṛhe
verses.translation: Those men will undergo disaster like a lump of
verses.wordMeaning: Those men will undergo disaster like a lump of
verses.commentary: Sense: Those men will undergo disaster like a lump of

verses.sanskrit: अभिशस्तस्तथा स्तेनः शिल्पं यश्चोपजीवति । स्तवकः सूपकारश्च यश्च मित्राणि निन्दति
verses.transliteration: abhiśastastathā stenaḥ śilpaṃ yaścopajīvati / stavakaḥ sūpakāraśca yaśca mitrāṇi nindati
verses.translation: A person who has mastered (various subjects) docs not gain mastery over himself. Due to his own actions, he wanders within the three worlds. Even one who has mastered the Rg Mantras, Yajus Mantras, Saman Mantras and their various ancillary subjects does not attain the Brahman devoid of changes and aberrations and therefore becomes distressed.
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has mastered (various subjects) docs not gain mastery over himself. Due to his own actions, he wanders within the three worlds. Even one who has mastered the Rg Mantras, Yajus Mantras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has mastered (various subjects) docs not gain mastery over himself. Due to his own actions, he wanders within the three worlds. Even one who has mastered the Rg Mantras, Yajus Mantras,…

verses.sanskrit: काणश्च खञ्जकश्चैव नास्तिको वेदवर्जितः । उन्मत्तो ऽप्यथ षण्ढश्च भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पगः
verses.transliteration: kāṇaśca khañjakaścaiva nāstiko vedavarjitaḥ / unmatto 'pyatha ṣaṇḍhaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ
verses.translation: One who has mastered all created things, the products of Prakrti (the nature known as Avidya), one who has mastered the good features in the three Vedas, one who has mastered the three Gunas (Sattva etc.) and one who has mastered the twentyfour principles is the person who has cross- ed the sariisara to the other shore and is the master of academic studies.1
verses.wordMeaning: One who has mastered all created things, the products of Prakrti (the nature known as Avidya), one who has mastered the good features in the three Vedas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One who has mastered all created things, the products of Prakrti (the nature known as Avidya), one who has mastered the good features in the three Vedas,…

verses.sanskrit: भिषग्जीवी प्राशनिकः परस्त्रीं यश्च सेवते । विक्रीणाति च यो ब्रह्मव्रतानि नियमांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhiṣagjīvī prāśanikaḥ parastrīṃ yaśca sevate / vikrīṇāti ca yo brahmavratāni niyamāṃstathā
verses.translation: The knower of Yoga obtains i.e. comprehends everything that has to be comprehended in the Vedas and that which has to be realized i.e. the Brahman. Those who have known Vedas call him master of the Vedas.
verses.wordMeaning: The knower of Yoga obtains i.e. comprehends everything that has to be comprehended in the Vedas and that which has to be realized i.e. the Brahman. Those who have known Vedas call him master of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of Yoga obtains i.e. comprehends everything that has to be comprehended in the Vedas and that which has to be realized i.e. the Brahman. Those who have known Vedas call him master of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टं स्यान्नास्तिके दत्तं व्रतघ्ने चापवर्जितम् । यच्चवाणिजके दत्तं नेह नामुत्र संभवेत्
verses.transliteration: naṣṭaṃ syānnāstike dattaṃ vrataghne cāpavarjitam / yaccavāṇijake dattaṃ neha nāmutra saṃbhavet

verses.sanskrit: निक्षेपहारके चैव कृतघ्ने विदवर्जिते । तथा पाणविके वै च कारुके धर्मवर्जिते
verses.transliteration: nikṣepahārake caiva kṛtaghne vidavarjite / tathā pāṇavike vai ca kāruke dharmavarjite
verses.translation: The belief in the omniscience of Yogins is still found all over India.
verses.wordMeaning: The belief in the omniscience of Yogins is still found all over India.
verses.commentary: Sense: The belief in the omniscience of Yogins is still found all over India.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीणाति यो ह्यपण्यानि विक्रीणाति प्रशंसति । अन्यत्रास्य समाधानं न वणिकूछ्राद्धमर्हति
verses.transliteration: krīṇāti yo hyapaṇyāni vikrīṇāti praśaṃsati / anyatrāsya samādhānaṃ na vaṇikūchrāddhamarhati
verses.translation: He who regularly studios this Sruddha Kalpa with faith achieves all these as well as the benefits of visiting holy centres and offering charitable gifts.
verses.hindi: तू तो अतीव अद्भुत प्रभाव वाली है। तू अपने ही ओज से समस्त प्राणियों का मोहन किया करती है। अब तू अपनी ही इच्छा के अनुसार विचरण कर ओर तुमको कोई भी नहीं जान सकेगा ।२२। अब तू यहाँ से शीघ्र ही जाकर हैत्यो के नायक अण्ड के समीप में पहुँच जा । और तुरन्त
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly studios this Sruddha Kalpa with faith achieves all these as well as the benefits of visiting holy centres and offering charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly studios this Sruddha Kalpa with faith achieves all these as well as the benefits of visiting holy centres and offering charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मनीव हुतं हव्यं दत्तं पौनर्भवे द्विजः । षष्टिं काणः शतं षण्ढः श्वित्री पञ्चशतान्यपि
verses.transliteration: bhasmanīva hutaṃ havyaṃ dattaṃ paunarbhave dvijaḥ / ṣaṣṭiṃ kāṇaḥ śataṃ ṣaṇḍhaḥ śvitrī pañcaśatānyapi
verses.translation: If a person reads this procedure (of Sraddha) with
verses.hindi: ही उसको मोहित कर दे कि विषयों को उपयोग करेगा ।२३। इस प्रकार का वरदान प्राप्त करके उस माया ने जनादन प्रमु को प्रणाम किया था। फिर उस माया ने भगवान् से सहायता करने के लिए कुछ प्रमुख अप्सराओं के प्राप्त करने की याचना की थी।२४ जब माया के द्वारा प्रार्थना की गयी
verses.wordMeaning: If a person reads this procedure (of Sraddha) with
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person reads this procedure (of Sraddha) with

verses.sanskrit: पापरोगी सहस्रं वै दातुर्नाशयते फलम् । भ्रश्येद्धि स फलात्तस्मात्प्रदाता यस्तु बालिशः
verses.transliteration: pāparogī sahasraṃ vai dāturnāśayate phalam / bhraśyeddhi sa phalāttasmātpradātā yastu bāliśaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: थी तो प्रभु ने कुछ अप्सराएं भेजी थीं उन अप्सराओं में विश्‍वाची आदि प्रमुख थीं। उस सबके साथ बह मृगेक्षणा माया वहाँ से प्रस्थान कर गयी थी । बहु मानसरोवर के उत्तम तट पर गयी शी जहाँ पर उत्तम दुम लगे हुए थे ।२४। वह ऐसा सुरम्य स्थल था कि बह देत्यराज बहाँ पर अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: यद्विष्टितशिरा भुङ्क्ते यद्भुङ्क्ते दक्षिणामुखः । सोपानत्कश्च यद्भुङ्क्ते यच्च दत्तमसत्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yadviṣṭitaśirā bhuṅkte yadbhuṅkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / sopānatkaśca yadbhuṅkte yacca dattamasatkṛtam
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: नारियों से युक्त होकर विहार की क्रीड़ा किया करता था । उसी स्थल में बहू मृग के शावक के समान नेत्रों बाली माया एक चम्पक वृक्ष के मूल में निवास करने लगी भी और परम सुरम्य मधुर स्वर के कुछ गाया करती
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तदसुरेद्राय ब्रह्मा भागमकल्पयत् । श्वा चैव ब्रह्महा चैव नावेक्षेत कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ tadasuredrāya brahmā bhāgamakalpayat / śvā caiva brahmahā caiva nāvekṣeta kathañcana
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: थी ।२६। इसके अनन्तर बह हैत्यराज अपने मन्त्रियों के सहित वहाँ पर आ गया था । उसने वीणा की परम मधुर ध्वनि का श्रवण किया था और फिर उस वराज़ुना को भी देखा था ।२७। उस सुन्दर अ'गों वाली को देख कर दूसरी विद्यूत् की लेखा के ही समान थी वह मदन नामक माया से
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्परिवृतैर्दद्यात्तिलैश्चान्नं विकीर्य च । राक्षसानां तिलाः प्रोक्ताः शुनां परिवृतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmātparivṛtairdadyāttilaiścānnaṃ vikīrya ca / rākṣasānāṃ tilāḥ proktāḥ śunāṃ parivṛtāstathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: परिपूर्ण महादू गत्ते में गिर गया था
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात्सूकरो हन्ति पक्षवातेन कुक्कुटः । रजस्वलायाः स्पर्शेन क्रुद्धोयश्च प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: darśanātsūkaro hanti pakṣavātena kukkuṭaḥ / rajasvalāyāḥ sparśena kruddhoyaśca prayacchati
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: नदीतीरेषु रम्येषु सरित्सु च सरस्सु च । विविक्तेषु च प्रीयन्ते दत्तेनेह पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: nadītīreṣu ramyeṣu saritsu ca sarassu ca / vivikteṣu ca prīyante datteneha pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: नासव्यंपातयेज्जानु न युक्तो वाचमीरयेत् । तस्मात्परिवृतेनेह विधिवद्दर्भपाणिना
verses.transliteration: nāsavyaṃpātayejjānu na yukto vācamīrayet / tasmātparivṛteneha vidhivaddarbhapāṇinā
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: पित्रोराराधनं कार्यमेवं प्रीणयते पितॄन् । अनुमान्य द्विजान्पूर्वमर्गौं कुर्याद्यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: pitrorārādhanaṃ kāryamevaṃ prīṇayate pitṝn / anumānya dvijānpūrvamargauṃ kuryādyathāvidhi
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणां निर्वपेद्भूमौ सूर्ये वा दर्भसंस्तरे । शुक्लपक्षे च पूर्वाङ्णे श्राद्धं कुर्याद्यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāṃ nirvapedbhūmau sūrye vā darbhasaṃstare / śuklapakṣe ca pūrvāṅṇe śrāddhaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे ऽपरङ्णे तु रौहिणं वै न लङ्घयेत् । एवमेते महात्मानो महायोगा महौजसः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣe 'paraṅṇe tu rauhiṇaṃ vai na laṅghayet / evamete mahātmāno mahāyogā mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: सदा वै पितरः पूज्याः सं प्राप्तौ देशकालयोः । पितृभक्त्यैव तु नरो योगं प्राप्नोति दुर्ल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: sadā vai pitaraḥ pūjyāḥ saṃ prāptau deśakālayoḥ / pitṛbhaktyaiva tu naro yogaṃ prāpnoti durllabham
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानेन मोक्षं गच्छेद्धि हित्वा कर्म शुभाशुभम् । यज्ञहेतोस्तदुद्धृत्य मोहयित्वा जगत्तथा
verses.transliteration: dhyānena mokṣaṃ gaccheddhi hitvā karma śubhāśubham / yajñahetostaduddhṛtya mohayitvā jagattathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर उसके मन्त्रीगण भी उनका स्मरण करने वाले के साथ ही थे ।२६। उस देत्यों के स्वामी ने बहुत समय तक उस सती से प्रार्थना की थी। उनके द्वारा जब भली भाँति उनसे प्रार्थना की गयी थी तो उन्होने भी तुर्त ही प्रति श्रवण किया था ।३०। जो बड़े-बड़े यज्ञों के
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: गुहायां निहितं ब्रह्म कश्यपेन महात्मना । अमृतं गुह्यमुद्धृत्य योगे योगविदां वराः
verses.transliteration: guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ brahma kaśyapena mahātmanā / amṛtaṃ guhyamuddhṛtya yoge yogavidāṃ varāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: द्वारा जैसे अश्‍व मेधादिक यज्ञ हैं इनके द्वारा भी अलभ्य होती हैं उनको जिनमें मोहिनी मुख्य थी प्राप्त करके उनको बहुत ही अधिक आनन्द प्राप्त हुआ था ।३१। फिर तो उन सबने उस समय में भोग विलास के आनन्द में निमग्न होकर वेदों को भुला दिया था ओर उमापति देव का जो अर्चन था
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्तः सनत्कुमारेण महातो ब्रह्मणः पदम् । देवानां परमं गुह्यमृषीणां च परायणम्
verses.transliteration: proktaḥ sanatkumāreṇa mahāto brahmaṇaḥ padam / devānāṃ paramaṃ guhyamṛṣīṇāṃ ca parāyaṇam
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: बह भी छोड़ दिया था। यज्ञादिक की जो भी अन्य परम शुभ के देने वासी क्रियाए' थी उनका भी परित्याग कर दिया था ।३२। फिर तो उनके जो
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: पितृभक्त्या प्रयत्नेन प्राप्य ते तन्मनीषिभिः । पितृभक्तः समासेन पितृपूर्वपरश्च यः
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhaktyā prayatnena prāpya te tanmanīṣibhiḥ / pitṛbhaktaḥ samāsena pitṛpūrvaparaśca yaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: १९   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण पुरोहित ये उनका भी अपमान करके उन्हें छोड़ दिया था। उनके सहस्नों अर्ष एक महत्त के ही समान व्यतीत हो गये ये ।३३। उन समस्त हैत्यों के बिमोहित हो जाने पर इन्द्रदेव के सहित सब देवगण है ब्रहम् ! विमुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: अयत्नात्प्राप्नुयादेव सर्वमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ayatnātprāpnuyādeva sarvametanna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: उपद्रव वाले होकर परम आनन्द को प्राप्त हो गये ये ।३४। इसके अनन्तर किसी समय में देवेन्द्र को अपने सिंहासन पर विराजमान देखकर जो कि समस्त देवों से घिरा हुआ अवस्थित था नारद मुनि बहाँ पर समागत हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच यस्मैश्राद्धानि देयानि यच्च दत्तं महत्फलम् । येषु चाप्यक्षयं श्राद्धं तीर्थेषु च गुहासु च
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca yasmaiśrāddhāni deyāni yacca dattaṃ mahatphalam / yeṣu cāpyakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ tīrtheṣu ca guhāsu ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: येषु स्वर्गमवाप्नोति तत्ते प्रोक्तं ससंग्रहम् । श्रुत्वेमं श्राद्धकल्पं च न कुर्याद्यस्तु मानवः
verses.transliteration: yeṣu svargamavāpnoti tatte proktaṃ sasaṃgraham / śrutvemaṃ śrāddhakalpaṃ ca na kuryādyastu mānavaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: स मज्जेन्नरके घोरे नास्तिकस्तमसावृते । परिवादो न कर्त्तव्यो योगिनां तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sa majjennarake ghore nāstikastamasāvṛte / parivādo na karttavyo yogināṃ tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: परिवादात्क्रिमिर्भूत्वा तत्रैव परिवर्त्तते । योगान्परिवदेद्यस्तु ध्यानिनो मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: parivādātkrimirbhūtvā tatraiva parivarttate / yogānparivadedyastu dhyānino mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छेन्नरकं घोरं श्रोताप्यस्य न संशयः । आवृतं तमसः सर्वं नरकं घोरदर्शनम् । योगीश्वरपरीवादान्न स्वर्गं याति मानवः
verses.transliteration: sa gacchennarakaṃ ghoraṃ śrotāpyasya na saṃśayaḥ / āvṛtaṃ tamasaḥ sarvaṃ narakaṃ ghoradarśanam / yogīśvaraparīvādānna svargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: योगेश्वराणामा क्रोशं शृणुयाद्यो यतात्मनाम् । सहि कालं चिरं मज्जेन्नरके नात्र संशयः । कुंभीपाकेषु पच्यन्ते जिह्वाच्छेदे पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: yogeśvarāṇāmā krośaṃ śṛṇuyādyo yatātmanām / sahi kālaṃ ciraṃ majjennarake nātra saṃśayaḥ / kuṃbhīpākeṣu pacyante jihvācchede punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: अथ संमोहितो भंडो द॑ तयंद्रो विष्णु मायया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रे च यथा लोषटस्तद्बत्सीदन्ति ते नराः । मनसा कर्मणा वाचा द्वेषं योगेषु वर्जयेत् । प्रोत्यानन्तं फलं भुङ्क्त इह वापि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: samudre ca yathā loṣaṭastadbatsīdanti te narāḥ / manasā karmaṇā vācā dveṣaṃ yogeṣu varjayet / protyānantaṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkta iha vāpi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: न पारगो विन्दति परमात्मनस्त्रिलोकमध्ये चरति स्वकर्ममिः । ऋचो यजुः साम तदङ्गपारगे ऽविकारमेतं ह्यनवाप्य सीदति
verses.transliteration: na pārago vindati paramātmanastrilokamadhye carati svakarmamiḥ / ṛco yajuḥ sāma tadaṅgapārage 'vikārametaṃ hyanavāpya sīdati
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: विकारपारं प्रकृतेश्च पारगस्त्रयीगुणाना त्रिगुणस्य पारगः । यः स्याच्चतुर्विशतितत्त्वपारगः स पारगो नाध्ययनस्य पारगः
verses.transliteration: vikārapāraṃ prakṛteśca pāragastrayīguṇānā triguṇasya pāragaḥ / yaḥ syāccaturviśatitattvapāragaḥ sa pārago nādhyayanasya pāragaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्स्नं यथावत्समुपैति तत्परस्तथैव भूयः प्रलयत्वमात्मनः । प्रत्याहरेद्योगपथं न यो द्विजो न सर्वपार क्रमपारगोचरः
verses.transliteration: kṛtsnaṃ yathāvatsamupaiti tatparastathaiva bhūyaḥ pralayatvamātmanaḥ / pratyāharedyogapathaṃ na yo dvijo na sarvapāra kramapāragocaraḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: वेदस्य वेदितव्यं च वेद्यं विन्दति योगवित् । तं वै वेदविदः प्राहुस्तमाहुर्वेदपारगम्
verses.transliteration: vedasya veditavyaṃ ca vedyaṃ vindati yogavit / taṃ vai vedavidaḥ prāhustamāhurvedapāragam
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: जाज्वल्यमान अग्नि के समान परम तेजस्वी मुनि शादू ल को प्रणाम करके अपने दोनों हाथों को जोड़ कर देवेन्द्र ने यह वाकय कहा था ।३६। है भगवन ! आप तो सभी धर्मों के ञान रखने वाले हैं ओर आप परावर के ज्ञाताओं में भी परम थे हैं । आपका गमन तो वहाँ पर हुआ करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: वेदं च वेदितव्यं च विदित्वा वै यथास्थितः । एवं वेदविदः प्राहुरन्यं वै वेदपारगम्
verses.transliteration: vedaṃ ca veditavyaṃ ca viditvā vai yathāsthitaḥ / evaṃ vedavidaḥ prāhuranyaṃ vai vedapāragam
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: जिसको आप धन्य बनाना चाहते हैं ।३७। आपके शुभ आगमन का कारण भविष्य को परम शुभ बताने वाला होता है। है मुनीश्वर ! श्रवणों को परमानन्द उपजाने वाले आपके मुख से नि:सुम वाक्य को सुनकर मैं समस्त दुःखों को पार करके परम कृताथ होऊेगा ।३८। श्री नारदजी ने कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञान्वेदांस्तथा कामांस्तपांसि विविधानि च । प्राप्नोत्यायुः प्रजाश्चैव पितृभक्तो न सशयः
verses.transliteration: yajñānvedāṃstathā kāmāṃstapāṃsi vividhāni ca / prāpnotyāyuḥ prajāścaiva pitṛbhakto na saśayaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: देत्यों का स्वामी भण्ड विष्णु को माया से सम्मोहित हो गया है। उसके द्वारा विमुक्त हुआ बह तीनों लोकों को दूसरी अग्नि के ही समान दहन करता है ।३६। वह तेजों से-अस्त्रो से और मायाकें बलसे आपसे भी अधिक है । उस अत्यधिक वलवान् के तेज का अपहरण अवश्य ही करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया श्राद्धकल्पं तु यस्त्विमं नियतः पठेत् । सर्वाण्येतानि वाप्नोति तीर्थदानफलानि च
verses.transliteration: śraddhayā śrāddhakalpaṃ tu yastvimaṃ niyataḥ paṭhet / sarvāṇyetāni vāpnoti tīrthadānaphalāni ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: ।४०। है इन्द्र ! पराशक्ति देवो की आराधना के बिना किसी भी अन्य तप से सैकड़ों करोड़ बल्पों में भी उसके अति वल का अपहरण नहीं हो सकता है ।४१ है मूखों ! उदीयमान शत्रु के पूर्व में ही आराधना करो अर्थात् श्र जैसे ही बढ़ रहा हो उसी समय में पहिले ही आराधना करनी चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: स पङ्क्तिपावनश्चैव द्विजानामग्रभुग्भवेत् । आश्राव्य च द्विजान्सो ऽथ सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात्
