verses.transliteration: sa paṅktipāvanaścaiva dvijānāmagrabhugbhavet / āśrāvya ca dvijānso 'tha sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.hindi: आराधना की हुई वह भगवती तुम्हारा श्रेय कर देगी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नित्यम न्यांश्च श्रावयेद्द्विजः । अनसूयुर्जितक्रोधो लोभमोहविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityama nyāṃśca śrāvayeddvijaḥ / anasūyurjitakrodho lobhamohavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थादीनां फलं प्राप्य दानादीनां च सर्वशः । मोक्षोपायं लभेच्छ्रेष्ठं स्वर्गोपायं न संशयः । इह चापि परा पुष्ठिस्तस्मात्कुर्वीत नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: tīrthādīnāṃ phalaṃ prāpya dānādīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / mokṣopāyaṃ labhecchreṣṭhaṃ svargopāyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / iha cāpi parā puṣṭhistasmātkurvīta nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: इमं विधिं यो हि पठेदतन्द्रितः समाहितः संसदि पर्वसंधिषु । अपत्यभागी च परेण तेजसा दिवौकसां स व्रजते सलोकताम्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ vidhiṃ yo hi paṭhedatandritaḥ samāhitaḥ saṃsadi parvasaṃdhiṣu / apatyabhāgī ca pareṇa tejasā divaukasāṃ sa vrajate salokatām
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: येन प्रोक्तस्त्वयं कल्पो नमस्तस्मै स्वयंभुवे । महायोगेश्वरेभ्यश्च सदा च प्रणतो ऽस्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: yena proktastvayaṃ kalpo namastasmai svayaṃbhuve / mahāyogeśvarebhyaśca sadā ca praṇato 'smyaham
verses.translation: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that selfborn Lord by whom this trea- tise has been recounted. I bow down always to the great leaders of the Yoga cult.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे ब्रह्मणपरीक्षा नाम एकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ १९॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच इत्येते पितरो देवा देवानामपि देवताः । सप्तस्वेते स्थिता नित्यं स्थानेषु पितरो ऽव्ययाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe brahmaṇaparīkṣā nāma ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 19// bṛhaspatiruvāca ityete pitaro devā devānāmapi devatāḥ / saptasvete sthitā nityaṃ sthāneṣu pitaro 'vyayāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, these Pitrs1 are Dcvas; they are the deities of even the Devas. These Pitrs who have no change or decay are always stationed in seven abodes.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, these Pitrs1 are Dcvas; they are the deities of even the Devas. These Pitrs who have no change or decay are always stationed in seven abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, these Pitrs1 are Dcvas; they are the deities of even the Devas. These Pitrs who have no change or decay are always stationed in seven abodes.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिसुता ह्येते सर्वेषां तु महात्मनाम् । आद्यो गणस्तु योगानामनुयोगविवर्द्धनः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatisutā hyete sarveṣāṃ tu mahātmanām / ādyo gaṇastu yogānāmanuyogavivarddhanaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas worship these Pitis who abide by all kinds of knowledge. The four Asramas (stages oflife) worship them in the due order.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas worship these Pitis who abide by all kinds of knowledge. The four Asramas (stages oflife) worship them in the due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas worship these Pitis who abide by all kinds of knowledge. The four Asramas (stages oflife) worship them in the due order.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयो देवतानां तु तृतीयो दानवादिनाम् । शेषास्तु वर्णिंनां ज्ञेया इति सर्वे प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyo devatānāṃ tu tṛtīyo dānavādinām / śeṣāstu varṇiṃnāṃ jñeyā iti sarve prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: All the four castes worship them in accordance with the scriptures. Similarly, persons of the mixed castes as well as the Barbarians worship them.
verses.hindi: उस महामुनि के द्वारा इस प्रकार से जब देवगणों के स्वामी को सम्बोधित किया गया था तो उस इन्द्र ने सद देवों के सहित मुनि का पूजन किया था और तपश्‍चर्या करने के लिये तैयारी करने वाला बहु हैमवान् के तट पर चला गया था ।४३। वहाँ पर सब ऋतुओं के कुसुमं पै समुज्ज्वल
verses.wordMeaning: All the four castes worship them in accordance with the scriptures. Similarly, persons of the mixed castes as well as the Barbarians worship them.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the four castes worship them in accordance with the scriptures. Similarly, persons of the mixed castes as well as the Barbarians worship them.

verses.sanskrit: देवास्छैतान्यजन्ते वै सर्वज्ञानेष्ववस्थितान् । आश्रमश्च यजन्त्येनांश्चत्वारस्तु यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: devāschaitānyajante vai sarvajñāneṣvavasthitān / āśramaśca yajantyenāṃścatvārastu yathākramam
verses.translation: It is laid down in the Smrti that the Pitrs.should be propitiated before the Devas. Indeed the subtle movement of the Yogic power of the Pitrs is not comprehended by men even by means of well-reputed penance. What then by means of the Physical eye?
verses.hindi: भागीरथी गंगा के तीर पर समस्त सुरगणों के साथ उस इन्द्र ने उस परा शक्ति की महा पूजा की थी । उस समय से ही लेकर अखिल सिद्धियों का प्रदान करने वाला वह स्थल इन्द्रप्रस्थ नाम वाला हो गया था ।४४। ब्रह्माजी के पुत्र नारदजी के द्वारा उपदेश की गयी विधि से जप और ध्यान में निरत
verses.wordMeaning: It is laid down in the Smrti that the Pitrs.should be propitiated before the Devas. Indeed the subtle movement of the Yogic power of the Pitrs is not comprehended by men even by means of well-reputed penance. What then by means of the Physical eye?
verses.commentary: Sense: It is laid down in the Smrti that the Pitrs.should be propitiated before the Devas. Indeed the subtle movement of the Yogic power of the Pitrs is not comprehended by men even by means of well-reputed penance. What then by means of the Physical eye?

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वर्णा यजन्त्येनांश्चत्वारस्तु यथागमम् । तथा संकरजात्यश्च म्लेच्छाश्चापि यजन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: sarve varṇā yajantyenāṃścatvārastu yathāgamam / tathā saṃkarajātyaśca mlecchāścāpi yajanti vai
verses.translation: Pits were originally three generations of ancestors in the Vedic times. But later on in Puranic times Pitrs were divided as heavenly viz. Vasus, Rudras and Adityas and humans (laukika) viz. father, grand-father and great- grand-father. In later Puranaa the number of classes of Pitrs increased to seven as here. Our text echoes the division of Pitrs as given in V&. , VarSha , 16 ff, Pd.P. Sr?ti 9.2-4.
verses.hindi: आत्मा वालों की उस देवीं की महती परा पूजा करने वालों को बहुत समय व्यतीत हो गया था ।४५॥ वे सभी परम उग्र तप में संस्थित थे तथा अन्य किसी में भी उनका चित्त न लगकर उसी में निरत था । ऐसे उनको करते हुए दश सहस्र बषं और दश दिन बीत गये ये ।४६। इधर महामति भृगु के
verses.wordMeaning: Pits were originally three generations of ancestors in the Vedic times. But later on in Puranic times Pitrs were divided as heavenly viz. Vasus, Rudras and Adityas and humans (laukika) viz. father, grand-father and great- grand-father.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pits were originally three generations of ancestors in the Vedic times. But later on in Puranic times Pitrs were divided as heavenly viz. Vasus, Rudras and Adityas and humans (laukika) viz. father, grand-father and great- grand-father.…

verses.sanskrit: पितृंस्तु यो यजेद्भक्त्या पितरः प्रीणयन्ति ते । पितरः पुष्टिकामस्य प्रजाकामस्य वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: pitṛṃstu yo yajedbhaktyā pitaraḥ prīṇayanti te / pitaraḥ puṣṭikāmasya prajākāmasya vā punaḥ
verses.translation: "The divine creation of the Pitrs has been recounted by you, O dear father. Their worlds, their daughters and their grandsons have been heard.
verses.hindi: ने उन समस्त हैत्यों को मोहित देखकर वह भण्डासुर के समीप में पहुँचे ये और उससे पुरोहित जी ने कहा था ।४७। है राजेन्द्र ! आपका ही समाश्रय लेकर सदा ही सब दानव गण निर्भय होकर तीनों लोकों में चरण किया करते हैं और अपनी इच्छा से ही विहार करते हैं ।४८। हरि भगवान् तो
verses.wordMeaning: "The divine creation of the Pitrs has been recounted by you, O dear father. Their worlds, their daughters and their grandsons have been heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The divine creation of the Pitrs has been recounted by you, O dear father. Their worlds, their daughters and their grandsons have been heard.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्टिं प्रजां तु स्वर्गं च प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः । देवकार्यादपि तथा पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ tu svargaṃ ca prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ / devakāryādapi tathā pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate
verses.translation: Formerly, in the Sattra, Brahma the great soul took the initiation. There itself excellent food was given to the Pitrs who seek everlasting benefit of the worlds."
verses.hindi: आपकी पूर्ण जाति का ही हनन किया करते हैं और सदा सबका विनाश करते हैं। उन्हीं के द्वारा इस माया की रचना की गयी है जिसके द्वारा आप समो हित हो गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, in the Sattra, Brahma the great soul took the initiation. There itself excellent food was given to the Pitrs who seek everlasting benefit of the worlds."
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, in the Sattra, Brahma the great soul took the initiation. There itself excellent food was given to the Pitrs who seek everlasting benefit of the worlds."

verses.sanskrit: देवतानां हि पितरः पूर्वमाप्यायनं स्मृताः । न हि योगगतिः सूक्ष्मा पितॄणां ज्ञायते नरैः
verses.transliteration: devatānāṃ hi pitaraḥ pūrvamāpyāyanaṃ smṛtāḥ / na hi yogagatiḥ sūkṣmā pitṝṇāṃ jñāyate naraiḥ
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: तपसा हि प्रसिद्धेन किं पुनर्मांसचक्षुषा । सर्वेषां राजतं पात्रमथ वा रजतान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā hi prasiddhena kiṃ punarmāṃsacakṣuṣā / sarveṣāṃ rājataṃ pātramatha vā rajatānvitam
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: पावनं ह्युत्तमं प्रोक्तं देवानां पितृभिः सह । येषां दास्यन्ति पिण्डांस्त्रीन्बान्धवा नामगोत्रतः
verses.transliteration: pāvanaṃ hyuttamaṃ proktaṃ devānāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha / yeṣāṃ dāsyanti piṇḍāṃstrīnbāndhavā nāmagotrataḥ
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ कुशोत्तरायां च अपसव्यविधानतः । सर्वत्र वर्त्तमानास्ते पिण्डाः प्रीणन्ति वै पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: bhūmau kuśottarāyāṃ ca apasavyavidhānataḥ / sarvatra varttamānāste piṇḍāḥ prīṇanti vai pitṝn
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: यदाहारो भवेज्जन्तुराहारः सो ऽस्य जायते । यथा गोष्ठे प्रनष्टां वै वत्सो विन्दति मातरम्
verses.transliteration: yadāhāro bhavejjanturāhāraḥ so 'sya jāyate / yathā goṣṭhe pranaṣṭāṃ vai vatso vindati mātaram
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: काले तु भोगः कत्तुंव्यो दुःखस्य च सुखस्य वा
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: तथा तं नयते मन्त्रो जन्तुर्यत्रावतिष्ठति । नामगोत्रं च मन्त्रं च दत्तमन्नं नयन्ति तम्
verses.transliteration: tathā taṃ nayate mantro janturyatrāvatiṣṭhati / nāmagotraṃ ca mantraṃ ca dattamannaṃ nayanti tam
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: अपि योनिशतं प्राप्तांस्तृप्तिस्ताननुगच्छति । एवमेषा स्थिता सत्ता ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: api yoniśataṃ prāptāṃstṛptistānanugacchati / evameṣā sthitā sattā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: जब आप मोहित हो गये हैं तो ऐसो अवस्था में आपको देखकर छिद्रों की खोज में परायण इन्द्र आपके ऊपर विजय प्राप्त करने के लिये महान् तप कर रहा है।५०। यदि जगत् की घांत्री देवी प्रसन्न हो गयी तो फिर उसी की विजय होगी । इसलिए इस मायामयी को छोड़कर मत्त्रियो
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणमादिसर्गेतु लोकानामक्षयार्थिनाम् । इत्येते पितरश्चैव लोका दुहितरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇamādisargetu lokānāmakṣayārthinām / ityete pitaraścaiva lokā duhitarastathā
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: के साथ अन्य है मवन्त पर्त पर जाओ और उन देवों के नृप में विध्न पैदा करो ।५१ श्री गुरुदेव के द्वारा जब इस रीति से कहा गया था तब हैत्येन्ह ने अपना उत्तम पर्यक त्याग दिया था और वृद्ध मस्स्रियों को बुलाकर को भी बृत्त था बह सय कह सुनाया था ।५२। इसका श्रवण करके श्रुतवर्मा ने
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: दौहित्रा यजमानश्च प्रोक्ताश्चैव मयानघ । कीर्त्तिताः पितरस्ते वै तव पुत्र यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: dauhitrā yajamānaśca proktāścaiva mayānagha / kīrttitāḥ pitaraste vai tava putra yathākramam
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: विचार करके राजा से कहा था । आपका राज्य शासन साठ हजार वर्षों तक ही शिव ने आपको प्रदान किया था ।५३। है वीर ! अब तो उसने समय से भी अधिक समय व्यतीत हो चुका है और अनेकों वर्ष निकल गये हैं। यह समय तो भगवान् शिव के द्वारा ही दिया गया था । अव इसका कोई
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: शंयुरुवाच अहो दिव्यस्त्वया तात पितृसर्गस्तु कीर्तितः । लोका दुहितरश्चैव दोहित्राश्च श्रुतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: śaṃyuruvāca aho divyastvayā tāta pitṛsargastu kīrtitaḥ / lokā duhitaraścaiva dohitrāśca śrutāstathā
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: भी प्रतीकार नहीं किया जा सकता है (५४ अब उनके ही अभ्यर्चना के बिना यह राज्य का रहना असम्भव है और इसका कोई भी प्रतिकार नहीं हो सकता है । यह तो काल है इसमें तो मुख और दुःख का भोग करना होगा ।५५। इसके अनन्तर जो भीमकर्मा नाम वाला मन्धो था उसने
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: दानानि सह शौचेन कीर्त्तितानि फलानि च । अक्षय्यत्वं द्विजांश्चैव सर्वमेतदुदाहृतम् । अद्यप्रभृति कर्त्तास्मि सर्वमेतद्यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: dānāni saha śaucena kīrttitāni phalāni ca / akṣayyatvaṃ dvijāṃścaiva sarvametadudāhṛtam / adyaprabhṛti karttāsmi sarvametadyathātatham
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: जहाँ तक बल है शत्र, की कभी भो उपेक्षा नहीं करनी चाहिए । हम लोगों के द्वारा जब क्रिया का विघ्न किया जायेगा तो ऐसा करने पर आपका ही बिजय होगा
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच इत्येतदङ्गिराः पूर्वमृषीणामुक्तवान्प्रभुः । पृष्टश्च संशयान्सर्वानृषीनाह नृसंसदि
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca ityetadaṅgirāḥ pūrvamṛṣīṇāmuktavānprabhuḥ / pṛṣṭaśca saṃśayānsarvānṛṣīnāha nṛsaṃsadi
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: सत्रे तु वितते पूर्वं तथा वर्षसहस्रके । यस्मिन्सदस्पतिस्नातो ब्रह्मा सीद्देवताप्रभुः
verses.transliteration: satre tu vitate pūrvaṃ tathā varṣasahasrake / yasminsadaspatisnāto brahmā sīddevatāprabhuḥ
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: गतानि तत्र वर्षाणां पञ्चाशच्च शतानि वै । श्लोकाश्चात्र पुरा गीता ऋषिभिर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: gatāni tatra varṣāṇāṃ pañcāśacca śatāni vai / ślokāścātra purā gītā ṛṣibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: दीक्षितस्य पुरा सत्रे ब्रह्ममः परमात्मनः । तत्रैव दत्तमन्नाग्रं पितॄणामक्षयर्थिनाम् । लोकानां च हितार्थाय ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: dīkṣitasya purā satre brahmamaḥ paramātmanaḥ / tatraiva dattamannāgraṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayarthinām / lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: एतदहृष्ट्वा तु हैत्येंद्रो विषण्णः स्वपुरं ययौ
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच एवं बृहस्पतिः पूर्वं पृष्टः पुत्रेण धीमता । प्रोवाच पितृसर्गं तु यश्चैव समुदाहृत
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca evaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ pūrvaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ putreṇa dhīmatā / provāca pitṛsargaṃ tu yaścaiva samudāhṛta
verses.translation: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.hindi: तां च दृष्ट्या जगद्धात्रीं दृष्टवा प्राकारमुज्ञ्वलम् । भयाद्िव्यथिरे देवा विमुक्तसकलक्रियाः
verses.wordMeaning: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being asked formerly by his intelligent son, Brhaspati thus recounted the creation of the Pitrs. It has been cited now by me."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पो नाम विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ २०॥ समाप्तश्चायं श्राद्धकल्पः । वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्थं प्रवर्त्तमानस्य जमदग्नेर्महात्मनः । वर्षाणि कतिचिद्राजन्व्यतीयुरमितौजसः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpo nāma viṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 20// samāptaścāyaṃ śrāddhakalpaḥ / vasiṣṭha uvāca itthaṃ pravarttamānasya jamadagnermahātmanaḥ / varṣāṇi katicidrājanvyatīyuramitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: As the noble-souled Jamadagni of immense strength,, went on working like this, O king, several years elapsed.
verses.hindi: हे महाराज ! आपके युद्ध में परों के बल के हरण करने वाली विद्या भगवान् शिव ने ही प्रदान की है इसलिए आपकी सदा ही विजय होगी ।५७। दानवों के नायक भण्ड ने उसके वाकय को मान लिया था और सेनाओं के साथ वह निकल कर हैमबत के तट पर चला मया था ।५८। जगम्बिका
verses.wordMeaning: As the noble-souled Jamadagni of immense strength,, went on working like this, O king, several years elapsed.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the noble-souled Jamadagni of immense strength,, went on working like this, O king, several years elapsed.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि नृपशार्दूल सर्वधर्मभृतां वरः । वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi nṛpaśārdūla sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Working like this, O king, Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent men, spent a number of years in rendering service to his parents.
verses.hindi: ने तपश्चर्या के अन्दर विघ्न डालने बालों को देखा था उसने आगे उज्ज्बल जो महा प्रकार था उसको न लाँघने के योग्य बना दिया था ।५६। उसको देखकर वह दानवेन्द्र भी यह क्या हे--इस बात से अत्यधिक विस्मित हो गया था। वह अधिक क्रुद्ध होगया था और उसने दानवास्त्र के द्वारा उसको
verses.wordMeaning: Working like this, O king, Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent men, spent a number of years in rendering service to his parents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Working like this, O king, Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent men, spent a number of years in rendering service to his parents.

verses.sanskrit: पित्रोश्चकार शुश्रूषां विनीतात्मा महामतिः । प्रीतिं च निजचेष्टाभिरन्वहं पर्यवर्त्तयत्
verses.transliteration: pitroścakāra śuśrūṣāṃ vinītātmā mahāmatiḥ / prītiṃ ca nijaceṣṭābhiranvahaṃ paryavarttayat
verses.translation: Touching the feet of his parents with his head, that noble scion of the family of Bhrgu, with his palms folded in reverence, addressed these words with great humility.
verses.hindi: भंग करना चाहा था ।६०। वह फिर भी उसके आगे गया था किन्तु वह सभी दानवों के द्वारा न लाँधने के योग्य हो गया था । और उस धोर ने दानवास्त्र के द्वारा उसका भंग किया था और बड़ी गजना भी की थो
verses.wordMeaning: Touching the feet of his parents with his head, that noble scion of the family of Bhrgu, with his palms folded in reverence, addressed these words with great humility.
verses.commentary: Sense: Touching the feet of his parents with his head, that noble scion of the family of Bhrgu, with his palms folded in reverence, addressed these words with great humility.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं प्रवर्त्तमानस्य वर्षाणि कतिचिन्नृप । पित्रोः शुश्रूषयानैषीद्रामो मतिमतां वरः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ pravarttamānasya varṣāṇi katicinnṛpa / pitroḥ śuśrūṣayānaiṣīdrāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: "O dear father, I wish to submit a certain matter now to you and mother. It behoves both of you to hear it from me.
verses.hindi: बारम्बार भी ऐसा करने से वह भस्म फिर समुत्पन्न हो गयी थी ओर उपस्थित हो गयी यी । यह देखकर वह दानवेन्द्र परम विषाद से युक्त होकर अपने पुर को चला गया था ।६२। देवों ने उस जगत् की धात्री का दर्शन किया था और उस उज्ज्वल प्राकार को भी देखा था । देवगण भय
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear father, I wish to submit a certain matter now to you and mother. It behoves both of you to hear it from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear father, I wish to submit a certain matter now to you and mother. It behoves both of you to hear it from me.

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिन्महातेजाः पितामह गुहं प्रति । गन्तुं व्यवसितो राजन्दैवेन च नियोजितः
verses.transliteration: sa kadācinmahātejāḥ pitāmaha guhaṃ prati / gantuṃ vyavasito rājandaivena ca niyojitaḥ
verses.translation: For a long time I have been eager to see my grand- fat her. Hence, with your permission, I shall go to him.
verses.hindi: से बहुत ही व्ययित हो गये ये और उन्होंने समस्त क्रियाओं को छोड़ दिया या
verses.wordMeaning: For a long time I have been eager to see my grand- fat her. Hence, with your permission, I shall go to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: For a long time I have been eager to see my grand- fat her. Hence, with your permission, I shall go to him.

verses.sanskrit: निपीड्य शिरसा पित्रोश्चरणौ भृगुपुङ्गवः । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूतवा सप्रश्रयमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration: nipīḍya śirasā pitroścaraṇau bhṛgupuṅgavaḥ / uvāca prāñjalirbhūtavā sapraśrayamidaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: My loving grand-mother wishes to see me. She has invited me eagerly many times through various persons.
verses.wordMeaning: My loving grand-mother wishes to see me. She has invited me eagerly many times through various persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: My loving grand-mother wishes to see me. She has invited me eagerly many times through various persons.

verses.sanskrit: कञ्चिदर्थमहं तात मातरं त्वां च साम्प्रतम् । विज्ञापयितुमिच्छामि मम तच्छ्रोतुमर्हथः
verses.transliteration: kañcidarthamahaṃ tāta mātaraṃ tvāṃ ca sāmpratam / vijñāpayitumicchāmi mama tacchrotumarhathaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, seeing one's parents and grand-father is very pleasing. Hence, permit me to go to him."
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, seeing one's parents and grand-father is very pleasing. Hence, permit me to go to him."
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, seeing one's parents and grand-father is very pleasing. Hence, permit me to go to him."

verses.sanskrit: पितामहमहं द्रष्टुमुत्कण्ठितमनाश्चिरम् । तस्मात्तत्पार्श्वमधुना गमिष्ये वामनुज्ञया
verses.transliteration: pitāmahamahaṃ draṣṭumutkaṇṭhitamanāściram / tasmāttatpārśvamadhunā gamiṣye vāmanujñayā
verses.translation: "On hearing these words which he uttered with emotional excitement, both of them became extremely delighted. Their eyes became filled with tears of joy.
verses.wordMeaning: "On hearing these words which he uttered with emotional excitement, both of them became extremely delighted. Their eyes became filled with tears of joy.
verses.commentary: Sense: "On hearing these words which he uttered with emotional excitement, both of them became extremely delighted. Their eyes became filled with tears of joy.

verses.sanskrit: आहूतश्चासकृत्तात सोत्कण्ठं प्रीयमाणया । पितामह्या बहुमुखैरिच्छन्त्या मम दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: āhūtaścāsakṛttāta sotkaṇṭhaṃ prīyamāṇayā / pitāmahyā bahumukhairicchantyā mama darśanam
verses.translation: They embraced that highly fortunate (dignified) son and lovingly sniffed at his head. After blessing and congratulating their dear son, they said thus:
verses.wordMeaning: They embraced that highly fortunate (dignified) son and lovingly sniffed at his head. After blessing and congratulating their dear son, they said thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: They embraced that highly fortunate (dignified) son and lovingly sniffed at his head. After blessing and congratulating their dear son, they said thus:

verses.sanskrit: पितॄन्पितामहस्यापि प्रियमेव प्रदर्शनम् । सदीयं तेन तत्पार्श्वं गन्तुं मामनुजानत
verses.transliteration: pitṝnpitāmahasyāpi priyameva pradarśanam / sadīyaṃ tena tatpārśvaṃ gantuṃ māmanujānata
verses.translation: "Dear son, go to your grand-father's house with pleasure for meeting and delighting your grand- father and grand-mother.
verses.hindi: हृतेषु सवंगांसेषु पादेषु च करेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: "Dear son, go to your grand-father's house with pleasure for meeting and delighting your grand- father and grand-mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dear son, go to your grand-father's house with pleasure for meeting and delighting your grand- father and grand-mother.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा संभ्रान्तं समुदीरितम् । हर्षेण महता युक्तौ साश्रुनेत्रौ बभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā saṃbhrāntaṃ samudīritam / harṣeṇa mahatā yuktau sāśrunetrau babhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: After going there stay in their house for some time, serving them duly and delighting them, O dear son.
verses.wordMeaning: After going there stay in their house for some time, serving them duly and delighting them, O dear son.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going there stay in their house for some time, serving them duly and delighting them, O dear son.

verses.sanskrit: तमालिङ्ग्य महाभागं मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय सादरम् । अभिनन्द्याशिषा तात ह्युभौ ताविदमाहतुः
verses.transliteration: tamāliṅgya mahābhāgaṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya sādaram / abhinandyāśiṣā tāta hyubhau tāvidamāhatuḥ
verses.translation: O highly fortunate one, do not stay there for a very long time. With their permission come back safe and sound. Of course, you will be eager to see us again.
verses.wordMeaning: O highly fortunate one, do not stay there for a very long time. With their permission come back safe and sound. Of course, you will be eager to see us again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly fortunate one, do not stay there for a very long time. With their permission come back safe and sound. Of course, you will be eager to see us again.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहगृहं तात प्रयाहि त्वं यथासुखम् । पितामहपितामह्योः प्रीतये दर्शनाय च
verses.transliteration: pitāmahagṛhaṃ tāta prayāhi tvaṃ yathāsukham / pitāmahapitāmahyoḥ prītaye darśanāya ca
verses.translation: We cannot remain even for half a moment without seeing our dear son. Hence, do not stay in your grand-father's abode for a very long time.
verses.wordMeaning: We cannot remain even for half a moment without seeing our dear son. Hence, do not stay in your grand-father's abode for a very long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: We cannot remain even for half a moment without seeing our dear son. Hence, do not stay in your grand-father's abode for a very long time.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा यथान्यायं तं शुश्रूषा परायणः । कञ्चित्कालं तयोर्वत्स प्रीतये वस तद्गृहे
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā yathānyāyaṃ taṃ śuśrūṣā parāyaṇaḥ / kañcitkālaṃ tayorvatsa prītaye vasa tadgṛhe
verses.translation: Or even if you go to your great-grand-father's presence at his ( your grand-father's) bidding, return quickly in due course but certainly with his permission."
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् इन्द्र देब ने उन देवगणो से कहा था कि यह देत्येन्द यहाँ पर आ गया है ओर इसको इन सभी लोग भी जीतने में युद्ध में अस- मर्थ है ॥६४ अगरे हम सब लोग यहाँ से भागते भी हैं तो भी हमारी कहीं पर भी अन्य कोई गति नहीं है । एक योजनके विस्तार वाला कुण्ड बनाकर
verses.wordMeaning: Or even if you go to your great-grand-father's presence at his ( your grand-father's) bidding, return quickly in due course but certainly with his permission."
verses.commentary: Sense: Or even if you go to your great-grand-father's presence at his ( your grand-father's) bidding, return quickly in due course but certainly with his permission."

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा नातिचिरं कालं तयोर्भूयो ऽप्यनुशय । अत्रागच्छ महाभाग क्षेमेणास्मद्दिदृक्षया
verses.transliteration: sthitvā nāticiraṃ kālaṃ tayorbhūyo 'pyanuśaya / atrāgaccha mahābhāga kṣemeṇāsmaddidṛkṣayā
verses.translation: After entering the fascinating hermitage O leading king, Rama saw in front of him, Rcika his grandfather sitting on his seat.
verses.hindi: जो बहुत ही अच्छा और सुन्दर हो हम सब यज्ञ का कार्य सम्पन्न करें
verses.wordMeaning: After entering the fascinating hermitage O leading king, Rama saw in front of him, Rcika his grandfather sitting on his seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering the fascinating hermitage O leading king, Rama saw in front of him, Rcika his grandfather sitting on his seat.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणार्द्धमपि शक्ताः स्थो न विना पुत्रदर्शनम् । तस्मात्पितामह गृहे न चिरात्स्थातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇārddhamapi śaktāḥ stho na vinā putradarśanam / tasmātpitāmaha gṛhe na cirātsthātumarhasi
verses.translation: "Who is this boy honoured (i.e. endowed with) all the requisite auspicious characteristics. He appears to be a huge mass of austerities. Although still a boy, he appears to be very powerful, due to his majestic demeanour coupled with humility."
verses.hindi: महायाग का जो भी बिधान है उसी से हुताशन का प्रणिधान करें । हम सब सुरगण महा मांसो से इस परमा शक्ति का ही इस समय में यजन करे
verses.wordMeaning: "Who is this boy honoured (i.e. endowed with) all the requisite auspicious characteristics. He appears to be a huge mass of austerities. Although still a boy, he appears to be very powerful, due to his majestic demeanour coupled with humility."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who is this boy honoured (i.e. endowed with) all the requisite auspicious characteristics. He appears to be a huge mass of austerities. Although still a boy, he appears to be very powerful, due to his majestic demeanour coupled with humility."

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञयाथ वा पुत्र प्रपितामहसन्निधिम् । गतो ऽपि शीघ्रमागच्छ क्रमेण तदनुज्ञया
verses.transliteration: tadājñayātha vā putra prapitāmahasannidhim / gato 'pi śīghramāgaccha krameṇa tadanujñayā
verses.translation: Even as they were thinking thus with delight and curiosity in their hearts, Rama slowly came to their vicinity, full of perfect humility.
verses.hindi: हम सब लोग ऐसा करने से ब्रह्मभूत हो जाँयगे अथवा स्वर्ग लोक का भोग करेंगे । इस प्रकार से जव सब देवों से कहा गया था तो इन्द्र ही जिनमें अग्रणी या वे सभी देवगण प्रस्तुत हो गये ये ।६७। फिर उन्होने मन्त्रों के द्वारा काट-काट कर विधि पूर्वक मांसों से हवन किया था। शरीरों के
verses.wordMeaning: Even as they were thinking thus with delight and curiosity in their hearts, Rama slowly came to their vicinity, full of perfect humility.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as they were thinking thus with delight and curiosity in their hearts, Rama slowly came to their vicinity, full of perfect humility.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्तस्तौ परिक्रम्य प्रणम्य च महामतिः । पितरावप्यनुज्ञाप्य पितामहगृहं ततः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktastau parikramya praṇamya ca mahāmatiḥ / pitarāvapyanujñāpya pitāmahagṛhaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: The intelligent sage Rama reported his name and lineage. With great joy, he touched the feet of his grand-father and grand-mother with his head, as well as the hands and paid respects to them thus.
verses.hindi: समस्त मांस का हवन करने पर तथा चरणों और करों का भी होम करने
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent sage Rama reported his name and lineage. With great joy, he touched the feet of his grand-father and grand-mother with his head, as well as the hands and paid respects to them thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent sage Rama reported his name and lineage. With great joy, he touched the feet of his grand-father and grand-mother with his head, as well as the hands and paid respects to them thus.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा भृगुवर्यस्य ऋचीकस्य महात्मनः । प्रविवेशाश्रमं रामो मुनिशिष्योपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā bhṛguvaryasya ṛcīkasya mahātmanaḥ / praviveśāśramaṃ rāmo muniśiṣyopaśobhitam
verses.translation: Then both of them were delighted in their minds. They lifted up the excellent grandson and showered him with blessings. They congratulated him severally.
verses.hindi: पर जब उन्होंने अपना सम्पूर्ण शरीर ही हवन कर देने की इच्छा को थी तो उसी समय एक परम उत्तम तेज का पुञ्ज प्रादुभू'त हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Then both of them were delighted in their minds. They lifted up the excellent grandson and showered him with blessings. They congratulated him severally.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then both of them were delighted in their minds. They lifted up the excellent grandson and showered him with blessings. They congratulated him severally.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायघोषैर्विपुलैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादितम् । प्रशान्तवैर सत्त्वाढ्यं सर्वसत्त्वमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: svādhyāyaghoṣairvipulaiḥ sarvataḥ pratināditam / praśāntavaira sattvāḍhyaṃ sarvasattvamanoharam
verses.translation: They embraced him and made him sit on their laps.
verses.wordMeaning: They embraced him and made him sit on their laps.
verses.commentary: Sense: They embraced him and made him sit on their laps.

verses.sanskrit: स प्रविश्यश्रमं रम्यमृचीकं स्थितमासने । ददर्श रामो राजेन्द्र स पितामहमग्रतः
verses.transliteration: sa praviśyaśramaṃ ramyamṛcīkaṃ sthitamāsane / dadarśa rāmo rājendra sa pitāmahamagrataḥ
verses.translation: ctDear boy, we hope your parents are quite well. Arc your brothers quite well? We hope you sustain yourself without any undue strain."
verses.hindi: उस तेज के पुञज के मध्य से एक चक्र के समान आकार का पदार्थ समुत्पन्न हुआ था और उसके मध्य में समुदित सूर्ये के सहश प्रभा से समन्वित देवी प्रकट हुई थी
verses.wordMeaning: ctDear boy, we hope your parents are quite well. Arc your brothers quite well? We hope you sustain yourself without any undue strain."
verses.commentary: Sense: ctDear boy, we hope your parents are quite well. Arc your brothers quite well? We hope you sustain yourself without any undue strain."

verses.sanskrit: जाज्वल्यमानं तपसा धिष्ण्यस्थमिव पावकम् । उपासितं सत्यवत्या यथा दक्षिणायऽध्वरम्
verses.transliteration: jājvalyamānaṃ tapasā dhiṣṇyasthamiva pāvakam / upāsitaṃ satyavatyā yathā dakṣiṇāya'dhvaram
verses.translation: Thus, O great king, Rama stayed in the house of the parents of his father delighted at the good things that issued forth, due to the affection of those two elderly persons.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O great king, Rama stayed in the house of the parents of his father delighted at the good things that issued forth, due to the affection of those two elderly persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O great king, Rama stayed in the house of the parents of his father delighted at the good things that issued forth, due to the affection of those two elderly persons.

verses.sanskrit: स्वसमीपमुपायान्तं राममालोक्य तौ नृप । सुचिरं तं विमर्शेतां समाज्ञापूर्वदर्शनौ
verses.transliteration: svasamīpamupāyāntaṃ rāmamālokya tau nṛpa / suciraṃ taṃ vimarśetāṃ samājñāpūrvadarśanau
verses.translation: He stayed there for a few months giving delight to the minds and eyes of all loving beings and spending time rendering service ( to his grand-father and grand-mother) eagerly.
verses.wordMeaning: He stayed there for a few months giving delight to the minds and eyes of all loving beings and spending time rendering service ( to his grand-father and grand-mother) eagerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: He stayed there for a few months giving delight to the minds and eyes of all loving beings and spending time rendering service ( to his grand-father and grand-mother) eagerly.

verses.sanskrit: को ऽयमेष तपोराशिः सर्वलत्रणपूजितः । बालो ऽयं बलवान्भातिगांभीर्यात्प्रश्रयेण च
verses.transliteration: ko 'yameṣa taporāśiḥ sarvalatraṇapūjitaḥ / bālo 'yaṃ balavānbhātigāṃbhīryātpraśrayeṇa ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, the noble-minded scion of the family of Bhrgus took leave of both of them, O king, and desired to go to the hermitage that was the resort of the parents of his grand- father.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the noble-minded scion of the family of Bhrgus took leave of both of them, O king, and desired to go to the hermitage that was the resort of the parents of his grand- father.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the noble-minded scion of the family of Bhrgus took leave of both of them, O king, and desired to go to the hermitage that was the resort of the parents of his grand- father.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तयोश्चिन्तयतोः सहर्षं हृदि कौतुकात् । आससाद शनै रामः समीपे विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tayościntayatoḥ saharṣaṃ hṛdi kautukāt / āsasāda śanai rāmaḥ samīpe vinayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: After duly prostrating at the feet of Cyavana1?) (Rama) of excessive austerities went to the hermitage ofBhrgu on being permitted by him (i.e. Cyavana) with great delight.
verses.wordMeaning: After duly prostrating at the feet of Cyavana1?) (Rama) of excessive austerities went to the hermitage ofBhrgu on being permitted by him (i.e. Cyavana) with great delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: After duly prostrating at the feet of Cyavana1?) (Rama) of excessive austerities went to the hermitage ofBhrgu on being permitted by him (i.e. Cyavana) with great delight.

verses.sanskrit: स्वनामगोत्रे मतिमानुक्त्वा पित्रोर्मुदान्वितः । संस्पृशंश्चरणौ मूर्ध्ना हस्ताभ्यां चाभ्यवादयत्
verses.transliteration: svanāmagotre matimānuktvā pitrormudānvitaḥ / saṃspṛśaṃścaraṇau mūrdhnā hastābhyāṃ cābhyavādayat
verses.translation: After proceeding ahead he saw the penance-grove of Bhrgu the chief of all sages surrounded by sages of tranquil minds.
verses.wordMeaning: After proceeding ahead he saw the penance-grove of Bhrgu the chief of all sages surrounded by sages of tranquil minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: After proceeding ahead he saw the penance-grove of Bhrgu the chief of all sages surrounded by sages of tranquil minds.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तौ प्रीतमनसौ समुथाप्य च सत्तमम् । आशीर्भिरभिनन्देतां पृथक् पृथगुभावपि
verses.transliteration: tatastau prītamanasau samuthāpya ca sattamam / āśīrbhirabhinandetāṃ pṛthak pṛthagubhāvapi
verses.translation: The hermitage had been rid of all kinds of sins due to the fragrance of smoke arising from the sacred fires; while Ahutis (ghee-offerings) were being oblated to the accompani- ment of chantings of Mantras during the performance of Homos. The fragrance was wafted everywhere within the forest (by gentle breezes thus wiping out all sins thereof).
verses.hindi: तां विलोक्य महादेवी देवा: सर्वे सवासवा: ।
verses.wordMeaning: The hermitage had been rid of all kinds of sins due to the fragrance of smoke arising from the sacred fires; while Ahutis (ghee-offerings) were being oblated to the accompani- ment of chantings of Mantras during the performance of Homos.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The hermitage had been rid of all kinds of sins due to the fragrance of smoke arising from the sacred fires; while Ahutis (ghee-offerings) were being oblated to the accompani- ment of chantings of Mantras during the performance of Homos.…

verses.sanskrit: तमाश्लिष्याङ्कमारोप्य हर्णाश्रुप्लुतलोचनौ । वीक्षन्तौ तन्मुखांभोजं परं हर्षमवापतुः
verses.transliteration: tamāśliṣyāṅkamāropya harṇāśruplutalocanau / vīkṣantau tanmukhāṃbhojaṃ paraṃ harṣamavāpatuḥ
verses.translation: On all sides, O king, the pcnancc-grovc was rendered splendid by the handsome sons of sages who were fetching sacrificial twigs and Darbha grass and who were embellished with their stavas, girdles and antelope skins.
verses.wordMeaning: On all sides, O king, the pcnancc-grovc was rendered splendid by the handsome sons of sages who were fetching sacrificial twigs and Darbha grass and who were embellished with their stavas, girdles and antelope skins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On all sides, O king, the pcnancc-grovc was rendered splendid by the handsome sons of sages who were fetching sacrificial twigs and Darbha grass and who were embellished with their stavas, girdles and antelope skins.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुखोपविष्टं तमात्मवंशसमुद्वहम् । अनामयमपृच्छेतां तावुभौ दंपती तदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sukhopaviṣṭaṃ tamātmavaṃśasamudvaham / anāmayamapṛcchetāṃ tāvubhau daṃpatī tadā
verses.translation: Here and there the daughters of sages could be seen moving about with vessels (and baskets) filled with water and flowers and rendering those places beautiful.
verses.wordMeaning: Here and there the daughters of sages could be seen moving about with vessels (and baskets) filled with water and flowers and rendering those places beautiful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here and there the daughters of sages could be seen moving about with vessels (and baskets) filled with water and flowers and rendering those places beautiful.

verses.sanskrit: पितरौ ते कुशलिनो वत्स किंभ्रातरस्तथा । अनायासेन ते वृत्तिर्वर्तते चाथ कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: pitarau te kuśalino vatsa kiṃbhrātarastathā / anāyāsena te vṛttirvartate cātha karhicit
verses.translation: Herds of hinds along with their fawns were taking rest in the shade of trees bordering the court-yard of the huts. They were free from fear about their safety, due to their faith and confidence in the sanctity of the penance grove.
verses.wordMeaning: Herds of hinds along with their fawns were taking rest in the shade of trees bordering the court-yard of the huts. They were free from fear about their safety, due to their faith and confidence in the sanctity of the penance grove.
verses.commentary: Sense: Herds of hinds along with their fawns were taking rest in the shade of trees bordering the court-yard of the huts. They were free from fear about their safety, due to their faith and confidence in the sanctity of the penance grove.

verses.sanskrit: समस्ताभ्यां ततो राजन्नाचचक्षे यथोदितः । तथा स्वानुगतं पित्रोर्भ्रातॄणां चैव चेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: samastābhyāṃ tato rājannācacakṣe yathoditaḥ / tathā svānugataṃ pitrorbhrātṝṇāṃ caiva ceṣṭitam
verses.translation: Peacocks and pea-hens of sweet notes had begun graceful dances even as the herds of Rsya deer indulged in chewing die cud and stood as witnesses. The peacocks gave them great pleasure.
verses.hindi: अब उस महादेवी के स्वरूप का वर्णन किया जाता है--वह देवी इस
verses.wordMeaning: Peacocks and pea-hens of sweet notes had begun graceful dances even as the herds of Rsya deer indulged in chewing die cud and stood as witnesses. The peacocks gave them great pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Peacocks and pea-hens of sweet notes had begun graceful dances even as the herds of Rsya deer indulged in chewing die cud and stood as witnesses. The peacocks gave them great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तयोर्महाराज सत्प्रीतिजनितैगुणैः । प्रीयमाणो ऽवसद्रामः पितुः पित्रोर्न्निवेशने
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tayormahārāja satprītijanitaiguṇaiḥ / prīyamāṇo 'vasadrāmaḥ pituḥ pitrornniveśane
verses.translation: Bits of Nivdra (a kind of rice) grains were scattered about in that penance-grove and heaps of Nivara grains were being dried in the sun as well as in shade. They were not eaten by the young ones of the deer moving about nearby.
verses.hindi: जगत् के उज्जीवन करने वाली थी और ब्रहा- विष्णु और शिव के स्वरूप वाली थी । उसका स्वरूप सौन्दर्य के सार की सीमा ही था। और वह आनन्द के रस का सागर थी ।७१। उसका कलेवर जपा के पुष्पों के सहश था और उसके वस्त्र दाडिमी के कुसुमों के समान वर्ण वाले वे । वह सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Bits of Nivdra (a kind of rice) grains were scattered about in that penance-grove and heaps of Nivara grains were being dried in the sun as well as in shade. They were not eaten by the young ones of the deer moving about nearby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bits of Nivdra (a kind of rice) grains were scattered about in that penance-grove and heaps of Nivara grains were being dried in the sun as well as in shade. They were not eaten by the young ones of the deer moving about nearby.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्मिन्सर्वभूतानां मनोनयननन्दनः । उवास कतिचिन्मासांस्तच्छुश्रूषापरायणः
verses.transliteration: sa tasminsarvabhūtānāṃ manonayananandanaḥ / uvāsa katicinmāsāṃstacchuśrūṣāparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: All the Smrti texts were being read. The meanings of the Sruti texts were being discussed. The worship of the Pitrs
verses.hindi: आभरणों से भूषित थी तथा शृङ्गार रस का एक स्थल स्वरूप वह थी
verses.wordMeaning: All the Smrti texts were being read. The meanings of the Sruti texts were being discussed. The worship of the Pitrs
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Smrti texts were being read. The meanings of the Sruti texts were being discussed. The worship of the Pitrs

verses.sanskrit: अथानुज्ञाप्य तौ राजन्भृगुवर्यो महामनाः । पितामहगुरोर्गन्तुमियेषाश्रयमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: athānujñāpya tau rājanbhṛguvaryo mahāmanāḥ / pitāmahagurorgantumiyeṣāśrayamāśramam
verses.translation: (Defective text). He was seated cross-legged with the right leg supported by the left shank (from ankle to the knee) and vice versa. The leading sage had got his body covered with Togapaffa (the cloth used to cover the body of ascetics while in abstract meditation). The right palm was brilliant like a lotus expressing Mudrd (Gesture) of explanation by means of the Angers and the palm. His radiant left hand had been placed above the Togapaffa. The subtle meanings of the Aranyaka (Upanisadic) texts were being explained to leading sages by the ascetic.
verses.hindi: कृपा से तरंगित अपांगो वाले नेत्र से प्रकाश करने वाली वह कौमुदी थी । उसके करों में पाग-अंकुश-इक्ु-को दण्ड ओर पांच बाण थे जिससे बह परम सुशोभित थी ।७३। उस महादेवी का दर्शन करके इन्द्र के सहित समस्त देवगणों ने बारम्बार प्रसन्न मनों वाले होकर उस अखिलात्मिका के
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text). He was seated cross-legged with the right leg supported by the left shank (from ankle to the knee) and vice versa. The leading sage had got his body covered with Togapaffa (the cloth used to cover the body of ascetics while in abstract meditation).…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text). He was seated cross-legged with the right leg supported by the left shank (from ankle to the knee) and vice versa. The leading sage had got his body covered with Togapaffa (the cloth used to cover the body of ascetics while in abstract meditation).…

verses.sanskrit: स ताभ्यां प्रीतियुक्ताभ्यामाशीर्भिरभिनन्दितः । यथा चाभ्यां प्रदिष्टेन यया वौर्वाश्रमं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sa tābhyāṃ prītiyuktābhyāmāśīrbhirabhinanditaḥ / yathā cābhyāṃ pradiṣṭena yayā vaurvāśramaṃ prati
verses.translation: With their permission, the intelligent sage (Rama) seated himself on the ground. After Ram'a had been seated and duly congratulated and blessed, Bhrgu looked at him again and asked him about his health and happiness.
verses.hindi: चरणोंमें प्रणाम किया था ।७४। उसके द्वारा अवरलो त होकर सभी टेवगण दुःख रहित हो गये थे। उनके सव अग पूर्ण हो गये ये ओर बहुत अधिक सुहढ़-वज्ज के समान देहों बाले तथा महान् बल से सम्पन्न हो गये थे । सब कुछ देने वाली उस अम्बिका महादेवी का उन्होंने स्तवन किया
verses.wordMeaning: With their permission, the intelligent sage (Rama) seated himself on the ground. After Ram'a had been seated and duly congratulated and blessed, Bhrgu looked at him again and asked him about his health and happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their permission, the intelligent sage (Rama) seated himself on the ground. After Ram'a had been seated and duly congratulated and blessed, Bhrgu looked at him again and asked him about his health and happiness.

verses.sanskrit: तं नमस्कृत्य विधिवच्च्यवनं च महातपाः । सप्रहर्षं तदाज्ञातः प्रययावाश्रमं भृगोः
verses.transliteration: taṃ namaskṛtya vidhivaccyavanaṃ ca mahātapāḥ / sapraharṣaṃ tadājñātaḥ prayayāvāśramaṃ bhṛgoḥ
verses.translation: You have to go to the great mountain Himav&n for the welfare of all the worlds, for your own sake as well as for our sake.
verses.wordMeaning: You have to go to the great mountain Himav&n for the welfare of all the worlds, for your own sake as well as for our sake.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have to go to the great mountain Himav&n for the welfare of all the worlds, for your own sake as well as for our sake.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वामुनिमुख्यस्य भृगोराश्रममण्डलम् । ददर्श शान्तचेतोभिर्मुनिभिः सर्वतो वृतम्
verses.transliteration: sa gatvāmunimukhyasya bhṛgorāśramamaṇḍalam / dadarśa śāntacetobhirmunibhiḥ sarvato vṛtam
verses.translation: With due observance of holy rites propitiate Mahadeva by means of penance. With a devotion not to be found elsewhere, cause pleasure unto him ere long.
verses.wordMeaning: With due observance of holy rites propitiate Mahadeva by means of penance. With a devotion not to be found elsewhere, cause pleasure unto him ere long.
verses.commentary: Sense: With due observance of holy rites propitiate Mahadeva by means of penance. With a devotion not to be found elsewhere, cause pleasure unto him ere long.

verses.sanskrit: सुस्निग्धशीतलच्छायैः सर्वर्तुकगुणान्वितैः । तरुभिः संवृतं प्रीतः फलपुष्पोत्तरान्वितैः
verses.transliteration: susnigdhaśītalacchāyaiḥ sarvartukaguṇānvitaiḥ / tarubhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ prītaḥ phalapuṣpottarānvitaiḥ
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: जयकारि च वामाक्षि जय कामाक्षि सुन्दरि ।
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: नानाखगकुलारावैर्मनःश्रोत्रसुखावहैः । ब्रह्मघोषैश्च विविधैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: nānākhagakulārāvairmanaḥśrotrasukhāvahaiḥ / brahmaghoṣaiśca vividhaiḥ sarvataḥ pratināditam
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: समन्त्राहुतिहोमोत्थधूमगन्धेन सर्वतः । निरस्तनिखिलाघौघं वनान्तरविसर्पिणा
verses.transliteration: samantrāhutihomotthadhūmagandhena sarvataḥ / nirastanikhilāghaughaṃ vanāntaravisarpiṇā
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: समित्कुशाहरैर्दण्डमेखलाजिनमण्डितैः । अभितः शोभितं राजन्रम्यैर्मुनिकुमारकैः
verses.transliteration: samitkuśāharairdaṇḍamekhalājinamaṇḍitaiḥ / abhitaḥ śobhitaṃ rājanramyairmunikumārakaiḥ
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसूनजलसंपूर्मपात्रहस्ताभिरन्तरा । शोभितं मुनिकल्याभिश्चरन्तीभिरितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: prasūnajalasaṃpūrmapātrahastābhirantarā / śobhitaṃ munikalyābhiścarantībhiritastataḥ
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.transliteration: sapotahariṇīyūthairvisraṃbhādaviśaṅkibhiḥ / uṭajāṅgaṇaparyantatarucchāyāsvadhiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: रोमन्थतः परामृष्टियूथ साक्षिकमुत्प्रदैः । प्रारब्धताण्डवं केकीमयूरैर्मधुरस्वरैः
verses.transliteration: romanthataḥ parāmṛṣṭiyūtha sākṣikamutpradaiḥ / prārabdhatāṇḍavaṃ kekīmayūrairmadhurasvaraiḥ
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविकीर्णकणोद्देशं मृगशब्दैः समीपगैः । अनालीढातपच्छायाशुष्यन्नीवारराशिभिः
verses.transliteration: pravikīrṇakaṇoddeśaṃ mṛgaśabdaiḥ samīpagaiḥ / anālīḍhātapacchāyāśuṣyannīvārarāśibhiḥ
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: देवों ने कहा-हे परसे भी परे ! है देवि ! आप तो इस समस्त जगत् को माता हैं, आपकी जय हो । आप तो सबके कल्याण करने का स्थल हैं ओर आप काम कला का स्वल्प वाली है, आपकी जय हो ।१। है परम सुन्दर नेत्रं वाली ! है कागाक्षि ! है सुन्दरि ! आप जय करने वाली हैँ ।
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: हूयमानानलं काले पूज्यमानातिथिव्रजम् । अभ्यस्यमानच्छन्दौघं चिन्त्यमानगमोदितम्
verses.transliteration: hūyamānānalaṃ kāle pūjyamānātithivrajam / abhyasyamānacchandaughaṃ cintyamānagamoditam
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: आप समस्त सुरों की आराधन करने के योग्य हैं। है कामेशि ! आप मान देने वाली हैं आपकी जय हो-जय हो ।२। है ब्रह्ममये ! है देवि ! आप तो ब्रह्मात्मक रस के स्वरूप वाली हैं। है नारायणि ! आप परा हैं जो सम्पूर्ण सवर्ग वासियों के द्वारा वन्दित हैं ।३। आप श्री कण्ठ (जिव) को दायिता हैं
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: पठ्यमानाखिलस्मार्त्तं श्रौतार्थप्रविचारणम् । प्रारब्धपितृदेवेज्यं सर्वभूतमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: paṭhyamānākhilasmārttaṃ śrautārthapravicāraṇam / prārabdhapitṛdevejyaṃ sarvabhūtamanoharam
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: आपकी जय हो । है श्री ललिताम्बिके ! है देवि ! आप श्री की विजय तथा श्री की समृद्धि का प्रदान करने वाली है।४। है पर से भी परे ! जो जन्म धारण कर चुका है और जन्म लेने बाला ह आप उसके इष्टा पृत्त' की हेतु

verses.sanskrit: तपस्विजनभूयिष्ठमाकापुरुषसेवितम् । तपोवृद्धिकरं पुण्यं सर्वसत्त्वसुखास्पदम्

verses.sanskrit: तपोधनानन्दकरं ब्रह्मलोकमिवापरम् । प्रसूनसौरभभ्राम्यन्मधुपारावनादितम्
verses.transliteration: tapodhanānandakaraṃ brahmalokamivāparam / prasūnasaurabhabhrāmyanmadhupārāvanāditam
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: हैं। तीनों जगतों को पालन करने बाली उन आपके लिए हमारा सबका नमस्कार है !५॥ कला-काछा-मुहूर्त-दिन-मास-ऋतु और वर्षों के स्वरूप बाली आप हैं। सहु शीर्ष-मुख और लोचनों वाली आपके लिए हमारा प्रणाम है ।६। आप सहस्न हाथ--चरण कमलों से परम शोभित हैं। आप
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतो वीज्यमानेन विविधेन नभस्वता । एवंविधगुणोपेतं पश्यन्नाश्रममुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvato vījyamānena vividhena nabhasvatā / evaṃvidhaguṇopetaṃ paśyannāśramamuttamam
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: अणु तथा महान् से भी अधिक महान् से भो अधिक महान् है। है देवि ! आपके लिए हमारा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: प्रविवेश विनीतात्मा सुकृतीवामरालयम् । संप्रविश्यश्रमोपान्तं रामः स्वप्रपितामहम्
verses.transliteration: praviveśa vinītātmā sukṛtīvāmarālayam / saṃpraviśyaśramopāntaṃ rāmaḥ svaprapitāmaham
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.transliteration: dadarśa parito rājanmuniśiṣyaśatāvṛtam / vyākhyānavedikāmadhye niviṣṭaṃ kuśaviṣṭare / sitaśmaśrujaṭākūrcabrahmasūtropaśobhitam

verses.hindi: कीडा ते लोकरचना सखा ते चिन्मयः शिव: ।

verses.transliteration: vāmetarorumadhyāsta vāmajaṅghena jānunā

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कामवापुर्मुनयो दूरादेवाखिला नृप । तावदूभृगुरमेयात्मा तदागमनतोषितः

verses.hindi: आपका हृदय है ।९। चन्द-सूर्य और अग्नि आपके नेत्र हैं। वायु आपके अच्छूवास हैं और श्रुति (कान) आपकी बाणी है ।१०। यह समस्त लोकों की रचना आपको क्रीड़ा है और ज्ञान से परिपूर्ण भगवान् शिव ही आपके सखा हैं। सवंदा आनन्द का रहना हो आपका आहार हैं तथा आपका

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तान्यकथालापस्तं पश्यन्नास पार्थिव । रामो ऽपि तमुपागम्य विनयावनताननः
verses.transliteration: nivṛttānyakathālāpastaṃ paśyannāsa pārthiva / rāmo 'pi tamupāgamya vinayāvanatānanaḥ
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: निवास स्थल सत्पुरुषों का हृदय है ।११। ये समस्त भुवन ही आपके देखने के योग्य और अहश्य रूप हैं । ये घन ही आपके केश हैं तथा तारागण आपके केशों में लगे हुए पुष्प हैं ।१२। ये धमं आदि सब आपकी भुजाए हैं और अधर्म आदि सब आपके आयुध हैं। समस्त यम ओर नियम आपके कर
