verses.transliteration: hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ tava cāsmākameva ca / gaccha putra mamādeśāddhimavantaṃ mahāgirim
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: का रूप धारण किया था तथा इस सबको स्वयं एक ही ने धारण किया था उस देवी के लिए अनेक वार प्रणाम है
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: अधुनैवाश्रमादस्मात्तपसे धृतमानसः । तत्रगत्वा महाभाग कृत्वाश्रमापदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: adhunaivāśramādasmāttapase dhṛtamānasaḥ / tatragatvā mahābhāga kṛtvāśramāpadaṃ śubham
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: आराधय महादेवं तपसा नियमेन च । प्रीतिमुत्पाद्य तस्य त्वं भक्त्यानन्यगया चिरात्
verses.transliteration: ārādhaya mahādevaṃ tapasā niyamena ca / prītimutpādya tasya tvaṃ bhaktyānanyagayā cirāt
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयो महदवाप्नोषि नात्र कार्या विजारणा । तरसा तव भक्त्या च प्रीतो भवति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: śreyo mahadavāpnoṣi nātra kāryā vijāraṇā / tarasā tava bhaktyā ca prīto bhavati śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: यतरांतमेति काले तु तस्ये देव्ये नमोनमः
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: करिष्यति च ते सर्वं मनसा यद्यदिच्छसि । तुष्टे तस्मिञ्जगन्नाथे शङ्करे भक्तवत्सले
verses.transliteration: kariṣyati ca te sarvaṃ manasā yadyadicchasi / tuṣṭe tasmiñjagannāthe śaṅkare bhaktavatsale
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रग्राममशेषं त्वं वणु पुत्र यथेप्सितम् । त्वया हितार्थं देवानां करणीयं सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: astragrāmamaśeṣaṃ tvaṃ vaṇu putra yathepsitam / tvayā hitārthaṃ devānāṃ karaṇīyaṃ suduṣkaram
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: नमोनमस्ते तमसे हरायै नमोनमो निगु णतः शिवाये
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यते ऽभ्यधिकं कर्म शस्त्रसाध्यमनेकशः । तस्मात्त्वं देवदेवेशं समाराधय शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: vidyate 'bhyadhikaṃ karma śastrasādhyamanekaśaḥ / tasmāttvaṃ devadeveśaṃ samārādhaya śaṅkaram
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या परमया युक्तस्ततो ऽभीष्टमवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā paramayā yuktastato 'bhīṣṭamavāpsyasi
verses.translation: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.hindi: जिसने इस धरणी को धारण किया है ओर जिस अमेया ने इस
verses.wordMeaning: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: You will attain great bliss and felicity before long. There is no doubt about it. With your devotion, Sankara will become delighted quickly. He will do whatever you wish in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे एकविंशति तमौध्यायः ॥ २१॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्येवमुक्तो भृगुणा तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रणम्य च । रामस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातश्चकार गमने मनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde ekaviṃśati tamaudhyāyaḥ // 21// vasiṣṭha uvāca ityevamukto bhṛguṇā tathetyuktvā praṇamya ca / rāmastenābhyanujñātaścakāra gamane manaḥ
verses.translation: He duly circumambulated Bhrgu and Khyati and bowed to them. He was embraced and greeted with blessings by both of them.
verses.hindi: आकाश को धारण किया है जिसमें सविता समुदित होता है उस महादेवी
verses.wordMeaning: He duly circumambulated Bhrgu and Khyati and bowed to them. He was embraced and greeted with blessings by both of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: He duly circumambulated Bhrgu and Khyati and bowed to them. He was embraced and greeted with blessings by both of them.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुं ख्यातिं च विधिवत्परिक्रम्य प्रणम्यच । परिष्वक्तस्तथा ताभ्यामाशीर्भिराभिनन्दितः
verses.transliteration: bhṛguṃ khyātiṃ ca vidhivatparikramya praṇamyaca / pariṣvaktastathā tābhyāmāśīrbhirābhinanditaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, at the behest of his sire, Rama of exalted mind, went to the Himavan, the most excellent among moun- tains, along the path mentioned by Bhrgu.
verses.hindi: यह अन्त का रापत हा जाता टं उत्त दवा के (लए बार-बार नमस्कार निव- दित है ।२३। आप रजो रूपा भवा के लिए मेरा नमस्कार है तथा सात्विक संस्थिता के लिए नमस्कार है । तमोरूपहरा आपको नमस्कार है। निगुण स्वरूपा शिवा आपको प्रणाम है ॥२४ आप इस सम्पूर्ण जात् की एक ही
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, at the behest of his sire, Rama of exalted mind, went to the Himavan, the most excellent among moun- tains, along the path mentioned by Bhrgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, at the behest of his sire, Rama of exalted mind, went to the Himavan, the most excellent among moun- tains, along the path mentioned by Bhrgu.

verses.sanskrit: मुनींश्च तान्नमस्कृत्य तैः सर्वैरनुमोदितः । निश्चक्रमाश्रमात्तस्मात्तपसे कृतनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: munīṃśca tānnamaskṛtya taiḥ sarvairanumoditaḥ / niścakramāśramāttasmāttapase kṛtaniścayaḥ
verses.translation: He crossed different countries, mountains, rivers and
verses.hindi: माता हैं ऐसी आपको बारम्बार नमस्कार है । इस जगत् की आप ही एक- मात्र पिता अर्थात् जनक हैं ऐसी आपके लिए अनेक बार नमस्कार हैं। आपका यह सम्पूर्ण स्वल्थ तन्त्र है तथा आप अखिल यन्त्र रूपा हैं ऐसी आप की सेवा में अनेकशः हमारा प्रणाम निवेदित है ।२५। आप लोक गुरु
verses.wordMeaning: He crossed different countries, mountains, rivers and
verses.commentary: Sense: He crossed different countries, mountains, rivers and

verses.sanskrit: ततो गुरुनियोगेन तदुक्तेनैव वर्त्मना । हिमवन्तं गिरिवरं ययौ रामो महामनाः
verses.transliteration: tato guruniyogena taduktenaiva vartmanā / himavantaṃ girivaraṃ yayau rāmo mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: On the way he halted and stayed at the abodes of sages here and there. Or on other occasions he stayed in the holy centres and shrines of great importance. Thus, he went along slowly.
verses.hindi: प्रधान हैं ऐसी अखिल वाग् की विभूति के लिए हमारा बार-बार प्रणाम है । लक्ष्मी के लिए तथा जगत की एक तुष्टि के लिए हमारा बारम्बार नमस्कार है । है शाम्मवि ! सर्वशक्ति आपको प्रणाम है ।२६। है अम्ब ! आपका प्रभाव अत्युत्तम है तथा अनादि मध्यान्त हैं--अपाञ्च भौतिक है--
verses.wordMeaning: On the way he halted and stayed at the abodes of sages here and there. Or on other occasions he stayed in the holy centres and shrines of great importance. Thus, he went along slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the way he halted and stayed at the abodes of sages here and there. Or on other occasions he stayed in the holy centres and shrines of great importance. Thus, he went along slowly.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽतीत्य विविधान्देशान्पर्वतान्सरितस्तथा । वनानि मुनिमुख्यानामावासांश्चात्यगाच्छनैः
verses.transliteration: so 'tītya vividhāndeśānparvatānsaritastathā / vanāni munimukhyānāmāvāsāṃścātyagācchanaiḥ
verses.translation: After reaching that place, he saw the excellent mountain abounding in different trees and creepers. It appeared to scrape the sky by its huge peaks.
verses.hindi: बाणी मन से अगम्य है और अप्रतक्यं वैभव बाला है। वह रूप तथा द्वन्द पे रहित है एवं दृष्टिगोचर नहीं है, मैं किस प्रकार से इसका वर्णेन करू ।२७। है विश्वेश्वरि ! है विश्व वन्दिते ! है वेदों के स्वरूप बाली ! आप सन्न होइये । है मायामयि ! है मन्त्रों के विग्रह वाली ! है सर्वेश्वरि ! हे
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching that place, he saw the excellent mountain abounding in different trees and creepers. It appeared to scrape the sky by its huge peaks.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching that place, he saw the excellent mountain abounding in different trees and creepers. It appeared to scrape the sky by its huge peaks.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रतत्र निवासेषु मुनीनां निवसन्पथि । तीर्थेषु क्षेत्रमुख्येषु निवसन्वा ययौ शनैः
verses.transliteration: tatratatra nivāseṣu munīnāṃ nivasanpathi / tīrtheṣu kṣetramukhyeṣu nivasanvā yayau śanaiḥ
verses.translation: In some places the forests were blazing due to the fire originating from the friction of dry trees clashing together on account of violent gusts of wind. The flame was further enhanced due to the blowing winds.
verses.hindi: इति स्तुत्वा महादेवीं देवां: सर्वे सवासवाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the forests were blazing due to the fire originating from the friction of dry trees clashing together on account of violent gusts of wind. The flame was further enhanced due to the blowing winds.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the forests were blazing due to the fire originating from the friction of dry trees clashing together on account of violent gusts of wind. The flame was further enhanced due to the blowing winds.

verses.sanskrit: अतीत्य सुबहून्देशान्पश्यन्नपि मनोरमान् । आससादच लश्रेष्ठं हिमवन्तमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: atītya subahūndeśānpaśyannapi manoramān / āsasādaca laśreṣṭhaṃ himavantamanuttamam
verses.translation: In some places, the sun-stone came into contact with the rays of the sun and began to emit fires. Due to these fires the snow and bitumen got melted and the water thus formed quelled the forest fires.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रसन्ना सा देवी प्रणतं वीक्ष्य वासवम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the sun-stone came into contact with the rays of the sun and began to emit fires. Due to these fires the snow and bitumen got melted and the water thus formed quelled the forest fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the sun-stone came into contact with the rays of the sun and began to emit fires. Due to these fires the snow and bitumen got melted and the water thus formed quelled the forest fires.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा पर्वतवरं नानाद्रुमलतास्थितम् । ददर्श विपुलैः शृङ्गैरुल्लिखन्तमिवांबरम्
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā parvatavaraṃ nānādrumalatāsthitam / dadarśa vipulaiḥ śṛṅgairullikhantamivāṃbaram
verses.translation: In some places, the forests got illuminated through beams of light reflected from crystalline collyrium, silver and heaps of gold through the rays of the sun. Their mutual rays of
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the forests got illuminated through beams of light reflected from crystalline collyrium, silver and heaps of gold through the rays of the sun. Their mutual rays of
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the forests got illuminated through beams of light reflected from crystalline collyrium, silver and heaps of gold through the rays of the sun. Their mutual rays of

verses.sanskrit: नानाधातुविचित्रैश्च प्रदेशैरुपशोभितम् । रत्नौषधीभिरभितः स्फुरद्भिरभिशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: nānādhātuvicitraiśca pradeśairupaśobhitam / ratnauṣadhībhirabhitaḥ sphuradbhirabhiśobhitam
verses.translation: VV.8-43 constitute a beautiful description of the Himalayas.
verses.wordMeaning: VV.8-43 constitute a beautiful description of the Himalayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.8-43 constitute a beautiful description of the Himalayas.

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्संघट्टनाघृष्टनीरसांघ्रिपजन्मना । सानिलेनानलेनोच्छैर्दह्यमानं नवं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: marutsaṃghaṭṭanāghṛṣṭanīrasāṃghripajanmanā / sānilenānalenocchairdahyamānaṃ navaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: In some places, the forests were brightened by groups of Siddhas who had been wet due to snowfall and so were bask- ing in the early morning sunlight over the rocks, at the feet of the mountain.
verses.hindi: निर्भया म् दिता: सन्तु सर्वे देवगणास्तथा । ये स्तोष्यन्ति च मां भक्तूया स्तवेनानेन मानवाः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the forests were brightened by groups of Siddhas who had been wet due to snowfall and so were bask- ing in the early morning sunlight over the rocks, at the feet of the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the forests were brightened by groups of Siddhas who had been wet due to snowfall and so were bask- ing in the early morning sunlight over the rocks, at the feet of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्रविकरामर्शज्वलदर्केपलाग्निभिः । द्रवद्धिमाशिलाजातुजलशान्तदवानलम्
verses.transliteration: kvacidravikarāmarśajvaladarkepalāgnibhiḥ / dravaddhimāśilājātujalaśāntadavānalam
verses.translation: In some places, the caves were filled with the piteous cries of herds of deer that had been agitated when hyaenas jumped up after coming out of the caves.
verses.hindi: इति लब्धवरा देवा दे वेंद्रोऽपि महाबलः
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the caves were filled with the piteous cries of herds of deer that had been agitated when hyaenas jumped up after coming out of the caves.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the caves were filled with the piteous cries of herds of deer that had been agitated when hyaenas jumped up after coming out of the caves.

verses.sanskrit: स्फटिकाञ्जनदुर्वर्णस्वर्णराशिप्रभाकरैः । स्फुरत्परस्परच्छायाशरैर्द्दीप्तवनं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: sphaṭikāñjanadurvarṇasvarṇarāśiprabhākaraiḥ / sphuratparasparacchāyāśarairddīptavanaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: In some places the huge shining rocks and sloping sides of the trees had been scraped suddenly when the leaders of the herds of boars and tigers fought each other.
verses.hindi: आमोद' परमं जग्मुस्तां विलोक्य मुहुम् हुः
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the huge shining rocks and sloping sides of the trees had been scraped suddenly when the leaders of the herds of boars and tigers fought each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the huge shining rocks and sloping sides of the trees had been scraped suddenly when the leaders of the herds of boars and tigers fought each other.

verses.sanskrit: उपत्यकशिलापृष्ठवालातपनिषेविभिः । तुषारक्लिन्नसिद्धौघौरुद्भासितवनं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: upatyakaśilāpṛṣṭhavālātapaniṣevibhiḥ / tuṣāraklinnasiddhaughaurudbhāsitavanaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: In some places the forests abounded in smashed pieces of rocky boulders, because the highly excited elephants in their rut had been fighting one another for the sake of a female elephant.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से बहुत से बहुत लम्बी स्तुति करके इन्द्र के सहित समस्त देवगण महादेवी को बार-बार प्रणाम करके तुरन्त ही जगदम्बा के शरण में चले गये ये ।२६। फिर वह देवी परम प्रसन्न हो गयी थी और उसने इन्द्र को अपने चरणों में प्रणत देखा था । फिर समस्त देहणारियों को
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the forests abounded in smashed pieces of rocky boulders, because the highly excited elephants in their rut had been fighting one another for the sake of a female elephant.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the forests abounded in smashed pieces of rocky boulders, because the highly excited elephants in their rut had been fighting one another for the sake of a female elephant.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिदर्काशुसंभिन्नश्चामीकरशिलाश्रितैः । यक्षौघैर्भासितोपान्तं विशद्भिरिवपावकम्
verses.transliteration: kvacidarkāśusaṃbhinnaścāmīkaraśilāśritaiḥ / yakṣaughairbhāsitopāntaṃ viśadbhirivapāvakam
verses.translation: In some places, the rocky slabs had been split by the claws of lions treading upon them, as they pursued the elephants, when their anger had been roused on hearing the roaring trumpeting sound of those elephants.
verses.hindi: बरदान देने वाली देवी ने उसको वरदान देने के लिए कहा था ।३०। इन्द्र ने कहा--हे कल्याणि ! यदि आप मुझ पर सुप्रसन्न हैं तो मैं तो देत्येख से पोड़ित हूँ । मुझे यही वरदान देवें कि मेरा दुघंर जीवित होवे । हम लोग आपकी शरण में समागत हैं ।३१ श्री देवो ने कहा--मै स्वयं ही देत्य कुल
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the rocky slabs had been split by the claws of lions treading upon them, as they pursued the elephants, when their anger had been roused on hearing the roaring trumpeting sound of those elephants.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the rocky slabs had been split by the claws of lions treading upon them, as they pursued the elephants, when their anger had been roused on hearing the roaring trumpeting sound of those elephants.

verses.sanskrit: दरीमुखविनिष्क्रान्ततरक्षूत्पतनाकुलैः । मृगयूथार्त्तसन्नादैरापूरितगुहं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: darīmukhaviniṣkrāntatarakṣūtpatanākulaiḥ / mṛgayūthārttasannādairāpūritaguhaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: In some places, the forests were filled with the loud lamenting cries of elephants whose temples had been pierced by the claws of the lions suddenly pouncing upon them.
verses.hindi: में समुत्पन्न भण्ड को विनिजित करके धरा से लेकर तीनों लोकों को जिसमें सभी चर-अचर है तुझको दे दूंगी ।३२। फिर समस्त देवगण निर्भय और प्रसन्न होंगे और जो मनुष्य सदा ही घमं-श्री और यश के भाजन होंगे तथा बे नीरोग-विद्या तथा विनय से सम्पन्न और दीर्घ जीबन होंगे ।३४। वे मेरे
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the forests were filled with the loud lamenting cries of elephants whose temples had been pierced by the claws of the lions suddenly pouncing upon them.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the forests were filled with the loud lamenting cries of elephants whose temples had been pierced by the claws of the lions suddenly pouncing upon them.

verses.sanskrit: युद्ध्यद्वराहशार्दूलयूथपैरित स्तेरम् । प्रसभोन्मृष्टकान्तोरुशिलातरुतटं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: yuddhyadvarāhaśārdūlayūthapairita steram / prasabhonmṛṣṭakāntoruśilātarutaṭaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: In some places, there were deep caves, the rocks of which appeared to be split by the terrible cries of the lions whose manes had been violently pulled by the eight-footed ( fabulous animal ) Sarabha.
verses.hindi: अनुग्रह से पुत्र-मित्र और कलत्र से सुसम्पन्न होंगे । इस रीति से देवगण और महान बलवान देवेन्द्र भी वर प्राप्त करने वाले होगये थे ओर वारम्वार उस जगदम्बा का दर्शन करके परमाधिक आनन्द को प्राप्त हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, there were deep caves, the rocks of which appeared to be split by the terrible cries of the lions whose manes had been violently pulled by the eight-footed ( fabulous animal ) Sarabha.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, there were deep caves, the rocks of which appeared to be split by the terrible cries of the lions whose manes had been violently pulled by the eight-footed ( fabulous animal ) Sarabha.

verses.sanskrit: कलभोन्मेषणाकृष्टकरिणीभिरनुद्रुतैः । गवयैः खुरसंक्षुण्णशिलाप्रस्थतटङ्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: kalabhonmeṣaṇākṛṣṭakariṇībhiranudrutaiḥ / gavayaiḥ khurasaṃkṣuṇṇaśilāprasthataṭaṅkvacit
verses.translation: In some places, the rocks and pebbles had been broken upas the excited and infuriated hosts of Sabaras (hillmen)
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । आजगामाथ देवेशीं द्रष्टुकामो महषिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the rocks and pebbles had been broken upas the excited and infuriated hosts of Sabaras (hillmen)
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the rocks and pebbles had been broken upas the excited and infuriated hosts of Sabaras (hillmen)

verses.sanskrit: वासितर्थे ऽभिसंवृद्धमदोन्मत्तमतङ्गजैः । युद्ध्यद्भिश्चूर्णितानेकगण्डशैलवनं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: vāsitarthe 'bhisaṃvṛddhamadonmattamataṅgajaiḥ / yuddhyadbhiścūrṇitānekagaṇḍaśailavanaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: In some places, the female elephants and tuskers were found sporting about in the bower-like bushes on the mountain. In some places the excited elephants in rut were seen pursuing the she-elcphants throughout the forests.
verses.wordMeaning: In some places, the female elephants and tuskers were found sporting about in the bower-like bushes on the mountain. In some places the excited elephants in rut were seen pursuing the she-elcphants throughout the forests.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places, the female elephants and tuskers were found sporting about in the bower-like bushes on the mountain. In some places the excited elephants in rut were seen pursuing the she-elcphants throughout the forests.

verses.sanskrit: बृंहितश्रवणामर्षान्मातं गानभिधावताम् । सिंहानां चरणक्षुण्णनखभिन्नोपरं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: bṛṃhitaśravaṇāmarṣānmātaṃ gānabhidhāvatām / siṃhānāṃ caraṇakṣuṇṇanakhabhinnoparaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: The mountain Himalaya had hundreds of caves filled with gusts of wind formed by the breaths of sleeping lions. In the forests of that mountain deer wandered about despite their great fear being suspicious of danger.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Himalaya had hundreds of caves filled with gusts of wind formed by the breaths of sleeping lions. In the forests of that mountain deer wandered about despite their great fear being suspicious of danger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Himalaya had hundreds of caves filled with gusts of wind formed by the breaths of sleeping lions. In the forests of that mountain deer wandered about despite their great fear being suspicious of danger.

verses.sanskrit: सहसा निपतत्सिंहनखनिर्भिन्नमस्तकैः । गजैराक्रन्दनादेन पूर्यमामं वनं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: sahasā nipatatsiṃhanakhanirbhinnamastakaiḥ / gajairākrandanādena pūryamāmaṃ vanaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: Herds of Camari dear moved about here and there very slowly while sporting, because they were afraid of their tail getting split as a result of being entangled in the thorny bushes.
verses.wordMeaning: Herds of Camari dear moved about here and there very slowly while sporting, because they were afraid of their tail getting split as a result of being entangled in the thorny bushes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Herds of Camari dear moved about here and there very slowly while sporting, because they were afraid of their tail getting split as a result of being entangled in the thorny bushes.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टपादबलाकृष्टकेसरा दारुणाखैः । भेद्यमानाखिलशिलागंभीरकुहरं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭapādabalākṛṣṭakesarā dāruṇākhaiḥ / bhedyamānākhilaśilāgaṃbhīrakuharaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: The ground had been marked by the red-lac-dyed wet feet of the sylvan deities moving about here and there.
verses.wordMeaning: The ground had been marked by the red-lac-dyed wet feet of the sylvan deities moving about here and there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ground had been marked by the red-lac-dyed wet feet of the sylvan deities moving about here and there.

verses.sanskrit: संरब्धा नेकशबरप्रसक्तैरृयूथपैः । इतरेतरसंमर्दं विप्रभग्नदृषत्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: saṃrabdhā nekaśabaraprasaktairṛyūthapaiḥ / itaretarasaṃmardaṃ viprabhagnadṛṣatkvacit
verses.translation: All round activities of dance had been initiated by groups of peacocks and pea-hens, whose notes were musically sweet and whose plumes had been raised up and spread.
verses.wordMeaning: All round activities of dance had been initiated by groups of peacocks and pea-hens, whose notes were musically sweet and whose plumes had been raised up and spread.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round activities of dance had been initiated by groups of peacocks and pea-hens, whose notes were musically sweet and whose plumes had been raised up and spread.

verses.sanskrit: गिरिकुञ्जेषु संक्रीडत्करिणीमद्विपं क्वचित् । करेणुमाद्रवन्मत्तगजाकलितकाननम्
verses.transliteration: girikuñjeṣu saṃkrīḍatkariṇīmadvipaṃ kvacit / kareṇumādravanmattagajākalitakānanam
verses.translation: The region bordering upon the mountain had been abounding in the Mango trees and they were filled with the tumultuous cooing of male cuckoos that had be- come excessively elated by tasting the juice of the season Spring.
verses.wordMeaning: The region bordering upon the mountain had been abounding in the Mango trees and they were filled with the tumultuous cooing of male cuckoos that had be- come excessively elated by tasting the juice of the season Spring.
verses.commentary: Sense: The region bordering upon the mountain had been abounding in the Mango trees and they were filled with the tumultuous cooing of male cuckoos that had be- come excessively elated by tasting the juice of the season Spring.

verses.sanskrit: स्वपत्सिंहमुखश्वासमरुत्पुर्मदरीशतम् । गहनेषु गुरुत्राससाशङ्कविहरन्मृगम्
verses.transliteration: svapatsiṃhamukhaśvāsamarutpurmadarīśatam / gahaneṣu gurutrāsasāśaṅkaviharanmṛgam
verses.translation: The mountain had been resonant with the musical notes of bees that had been maddened by imbibing nectar from different kinds of flowers. The forests therein had become deafened, due to the chirping sounds of many birds.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain had been resonant with the musical notes of bees that had been maddened by imbibing nectar from different kinds of flowers. The forests therein had become deafened, due to the chirping sounds of many birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain had been resonant with the musical notes of bees that had been maddened by imbibing nectar from different kinds of flowers. The forests therein had become deafened, due to the chirping sounds of many birds.

verses.sanskrit: कण्टाकश्लिष्टलाङ्गूललोमत्रुटनकातरैः । क्रीडितं चमरीयूथैर्मन्दमन्दविचारिभिः
verses.transliteration: kaṇṭākaśliṣṭalāṅgūlalomatruṭanakātaraiḥ / krīḍitaṃ camarīyūthairmandamandavicāribhiḥ
verses.translation: The surface of the ground had become filled and thickly bedecked with a number of fresh flowers wet with honey. They had been blown therein by the breezes of the forest and scattered about;
verses.wordMeaning: The surface of the ground had become filled and thickly bedecked with a number of fresh flowers wet with honey. They had been blown therein by the breezes of the forest and scattered about;
verses.commentary: Sense: The surface of the ground had become filled and thickly bedecked with a number of fresh flowers wet with honey. They had been blown therein by the breezes of the forest and scattered about;

verses.sanskrit: गिरिकन्दरसंसक्तकिन्नरीसमुदीरितैः । सतालनादैरुदिनैर्भृताशेषदिशामुखम्
verses.transliteration: girikandarasaṃsaktakinnarīsamudīritaiḥ / satālanādairudinairbhṛtāśeṣadiśāmukham
verses.translation: The region all round had been deafened by the loud sound of springs and water-falls that cascaded down from great heights upon narrow defiles abounding in rugged rocky pebbles.
verses.wordMeaning: The region all round had been deafened by the loud sound of springs and water-falls that cascaded down from great heights upon narrow defiles abounding in rugged rocky pebbles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The region all round had been deafened by the loud sound of springs and water-falls that cascaded down from great heights upon narrow defiles abounding in rugged rocky pebbles.

verses.sanskrit: अरण्यदेवतानां च चरेतीनामितस्ततः । अलक्तकरसक्लिन्नचरणाङ्कितभूतलम्
verses.transliteration: araṇyadevatānāṃ ca caretīnāmitastataḥ / alaktakarasaklinnacaraṇāṅkitabhūtalam
verses.translation: It had rendered melodious the quarters through the chirpings of different birds.
verses.hindi: हयग्रीव ने कहा--इसी समय में लोकों के पितामह--श्रह्माजी उस देवेशी के दर्शन करने की इच्छा वाले महषियों के साथ वहाँ पर समागत हो गये ये । इसके पश्चात् भगवान विष्णु की गरुड़ पर समारूढ़ होकर वहाँ पर आ गये ये । भगवान शिव भी वृष पर सवार होकर अखिलेश्वरी के
verses.wordMeaning: It had rendered melodious the quarters through the chirpings of different birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had rendered melodious the quarters through the chirpings of different birds.

verses.sanskrit: मयूरकेकिरीवृन्दैः संगीत मधुरस्वरैः । प्रवृत्तनृत्तं परितो विततोदग्रबर्हिभिः
verses.transliteration: mayūrakekirīvṛndaiḥ saṃgīta madhurasvaraiḥ / pravṛttanṛttaṃ parito vitatodagrabarhibhiḥ
verses.translation: He worshipped the lord of Devas, O king, with intense mental concentration. During the rainy season he had neither abode nor a shelter. During the winter he resorted to chill water. During the summer he stayed among five fires (i.e. four fires on four sides and the blazing sun above). He performed penance in this manner for a long time.
verses.hindi: दर्शनार्थ आ गये ये ।१-२। नारद आदि देवधिगण महेश्वरी के समीप में समागत हो गये ये। सभी अप्सराओं के समुदाय भी महादेवी के दर्शना आ गये ये ।३। विश्वावसु आदि गन्ध्रवं ओर यक्ष भी वहाँ पर आये थे। ब्रह्माजी के द्वारा आदेश पाकर विशांपति विश्वकर्मा ने एक दिव्य तगर की
verses.wordMeaning: He worshipped the lord of Devas, O king, with intense mental concentration. During the rainy season he had neither abode nor a shelter. During the winter he resorted to chill water. During the summer he stayed among five fires (i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped the lord of Devas, O king, with intense mental concentration. During the rainy season he had neither abode nor a shelter. During the winter he resorted to chill water. During the summer he stayed among five fires (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: जलस्थलरुहानेककुसुमोत्करवर्षिभिः । गात्राह्लादकरैर्मन्दं वीज्यमानं वनानिलैः
verses.transliteration: jalasthalaruhānekakusumotkaravarṣibhiḥ / gātrāhlādakarairmandaṃ vījyamānaṃ vanānilaiḥ
verses.translation: The sage of great self-control rendered the vital airs steady within the physical body by means of PrdQ&ydma (Breath-control). He was able to seat himself in the lotus pose with great ease. He observed perfect silence. The great sage kept his mind steady and stabilised.
verses.hindi: रचना की थी जेसा कि साक्षात अमर पुर ही होवे । इसके पश्चात् सब
verses.wordMeaning: The sage of great self-control rendered the vital airs steady within the physical body by means of PrdQ&ydma (Breath-control). He was able to seat himself in the lotus pose with great ease. He observed perfect silence. The great sage kept his mind steady and stabilised.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage of great self-control rendered the vital airs steady within the physical body by means of PrdQ&ydma (Breath-control). He was able to seat himself in the lotus pose with great ease. He observed perfect silence. The great sage kept his mind steady and stabilised.

verses.sanskrit: भूतार्त्तवरसास्वादमाद्यत्पुंस्कोकिलारवैः । आकुलीकृतपर्यन्तसहकारवनान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtārttavarasāsvādamādyatpuṃskokilāravaiḥ / ākulīkṛtaparyantasahakāravanāntaram
verses.translation: The six distressful 'waves* in the life are: hunger, thirst, decay, death, gnef and illusion (MW 222.3). &KD.I.282 enumerates the following 'waves of existence' viz. old age and death (of the body), greediness and vision of the mind and hunger and thirst (of life).
verses.hindi: ब्राह् आदि समस्त माठृगण अपने-अपने भूतगणों क॑ साथ समावृत होकर वहाँ पर आयी थीं ।४-६। अणिमा-महिमा आदि आठ सिद्धियाँ और करोड़ों योगिनियों वहाँ पर आ गयी थीं । भरव और केत्रपाल-महाशास्ता गणों के अग्रणी वहाँ समागत हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The six distressful 'waves* in the life are: hunger, thirst, decay, death, gnef and illusion (MW 222.3). &KD.I.282 enumerates the following 'waves of existence' viz. old age and death (of the body), greediness and vision of the mind and hunger and thirst (of life).
verses.commentary: Sense: The six distressful 'waves* in the life are: hunger, thirst, decay, death, gnef and illusion (MW 222.3). &KD.I.282 enumerates the following 'waves of existence' viz. old age and death (of the body), greediness and vision of the mind and hunger and thirst (of life).

verses.sanskrit: नानापुष्पासवोन्माद्यद्भृङ्गसंगीतनादितम् । अनेकविहगारावबधिरीकृतकाननम्
verses.transliteration: nānāpuṣpāsavonmādyadbhṛṅgasaṃgītanāditam / anekavihagārāvabadhirīkṛtakānanam
verses.translation: Devoted to the practice of Praty&hdra (withdrawing the sense-organs from external stimulii, sensual feelings and objects), he controlled the sense-organs. Self-possessed that he was, he could stabilise the usually unsteady mind by means of Dh&raqd (Retention of perception of the supreme deity).
verses.wordMeaning: Devoted to the practice of Praty&hdra (withdrawing the sense-organs from external stimulii, sensual feelings and objects), he controlled the sense-organs. Self-possessed that he was,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Devoted to the practice of Praty&hdra (withdrawing the sense-organs from external stimulii, sensual feelings and objects), he controlled the sense-organs. Self-possessed that he was,…

verses.sanskrit: मधुद्रवार्द्राविरलप्रत्यग्रकुसुमोत्करैः । वनान्तमारुताकीर्णैरलङ्कृतमहीतलम्
verses.transliteration: madhudravārdrāviralapratyagrakusumotkaraiḥ / vanāntamārutākīrṇairalaṅkṛtamahītalam
verses.translation: He had the vision of Parameivara, the lord of Devas, by means of meditation. His inner mind was in a stable quiet state. He was a Maitra ( an exalted Brahmana who had arrived at the highest state of human perfection due to close contact with the supreme Being). He was free from all sorts of obstacles.
verses.wordMeaning: He had the vision of Parameivara, the lord of Devas, by means of meditation. His inner mind was in a stable quiet state. He was a Maitra ( an exalted Brahmana who had arrived at the highest state of human perfection due to close contact with the supreme Being).…
verses.commentary: Sense: He had the vision of Parameivara, the lord of Devas, by means of meditation. His inner mind was in a stable quiet state. He was a Maitra ( an exalted Brahmana who had arrived at the highest state of human perfection due to close contact with the supreme Being).…

verses.sanskrit: उपरिष्टान्निपततां विषमोपलसंकटे । निर्झराणां महारावैः समन्ताद्बधिरीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: upariṣṭānnipatatāṃ viṣamopalasaṃkaṭe / nirjharāṇāṃ mahārāvaiḥ samantādbadhirīkṛtam
verses.translation: The scion of the family of Bhrgu meditated upon that aspect of the lord of the Devas, O mighty king. For a long time he had the feeling "I am He (i.e. the Supreme
verses.wordMeaning: The scion of the family of Bhrgu meditated upon that aspect of the lord of the Devas, O mighty king. For a long time he had the feeling "I am He (i.e. the Supreme
verses.commentary: Sense: The scion of the family of Bhrgu meditated upon that aspect of the lord of the Devas, O mighty king. For a long time he had the feeling "I am He (i.e. the Supreme

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तमृषयः सर्वे तपोनिर्धूतकल्मषाः । ज्ञानकर्मवयोवृद्धा महान्तः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tamṛṣayaḥ sarve taponirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ / jñānakarmavayovṛddhā mahāntaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: Having praised his most arduous penance and his knowledge of the highest order in the world, they returned to their respective hermitages.
verses.hindi: स्वयं युता होती है । काल क्रीता बेश्या होती है जो कुछ काल तक उपभोग के काम आती है । क्रयक्रीता दासी होती है जिसको जीवन भर भोग के लिए खरीद लिया जाया करता है । गान्धर्वं विवाह से अर्थात् दोनों ही रजा मन्दी से प्रेम करके नारी बना लेते हैं यह स्वसंयुता होती है और जो भार्या होती
verses.wordMeaning: Having praised his most arduous penance and his knowledge of the highest order in the world, they returned to their respective hermitages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having praised his most arduous penance and his knowledge of the highest order in the world, they returned to their respective hermitages.

verses.sanskrit: दिदृक्षवः समाजग्मुः कुतूहलसमन्विताः । ख्यापयन्तस्तपः श्रेष्ठं तस्य राजन्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: didṛkṣavaḥ samājagmuḥ kutūhalasamanvitāḥ / khyāpayantastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tasya rājanmahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Desirous of knowing the depth of his devotion unto him, Lord Sankara, assumed the guise of a hunter of deer O king, and went near him.
verses.hindi: है वह तो कन्या को पिता दास किया करता है, यही वितृदत्ता है ।५। समान धर्म बाली भार्यायुक्त होती है जो पिता के वशंबदा होती है और पिता जिसको भी योग्य वर समझता है उसे ही अपनी कन्या को दे दिया करता है। जो ब्रह्म अद्वत है ओर खदसदुमाव से वजित है वह चिदानन्द स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of knowing the depth of his devotion unto him, Lord Sankara, assumed the guise of a hunter of deer O king, and went near him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of knowing the depth of his devotion unto him, Lord Sankara, assumed the guise of a hunter of deer O king, and went near him.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वत्रिक्रतुजाबालिवामदेवमृकण्डवः । संभावयन्तस्ते रामं मुनयो वृद्धसंमताः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvatrikratujābālivāmadevamṛkaṇḍavaḥ / saṃbhāvayantaste rāmaṃ munayo vṛddhasaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: He assumed the guise of a youthful hunter who had the lustre of broken (heap of) collyrium, whose wide eyes were red in their extremities, who was very tall with his body, hard as adamant and who held bow and arrows.

verses.wordMeaning: He assumed the guise of a youthful hunter who had the lustre of broken (heap of) collyrium, whose wide eyes were red in their extremities, who was very tall with his body, hard as adamant and who held bow and arrows.

verses.sanskrit: आजग्मुराश्रमं तस्य रामस्य तपसस्तपः । दूरादेव महान्तस्ते पुण्यक्षेत्रनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: ājagmurāśramaṃ tasya rāmasya tapasastapaḥ / dūrādeva mahāntaste puṇyakṣetranivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: I am the lord of this region along with the living beings, trees and creepers therein. I move about here with the flesh of different animals for my diet. I am impartial towards all in this region viewing everyone equally in my mind.
verses.hindi: त्वमेवानादिरखिला कार्यकारणरूपिणी । त्वामेव सि विचिन्वंति योगिनः सनकादयः
verses.wordMeaning: I am the lord of this region along with the living beings, trees and creepers therein. I move about here with the flesh of different animals for my diet. I am impartial towards all in this region viewing everyone equally in my mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the lord of this region along with the living beings, trees and creepers therein. I move about here with the flesh of different animals for my diet. I am impartial towards all in this region viewing everyone equally in my mind.

verses.sanskrit: गरीयः सर्वलोकेषु तपो ऽग्र्यं ज्ञानमेव च । प्रशस्य तस्य ते सर्वेप्रययुः स्वं स्वमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: garīyaḥ sarvalokeṣu tapo 'gryaṃ jñānameva ca / praśasya tasya te sarveprayayuḥ svaṃ svamāśramam
verses.translation: I am equally kind to all living beings. I have no one related to me such as parents and others. I do not pay any attention to any of the objects desired by me whether they be unworthy of being eaten or drunk or whether they be unworthy of approach.
verses.wordMeaning: I am equally kind to all living beings. I have no one related to me such as parents and others. I do not pay any attention to any of the objects desired by me whether they be unworthy of being eaten or drunk or whether they be unworthy of approach.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am equally kind to all living beings. I have no one related to me such as parents and others. I do not pay any attention to any of the objects desired by me whether they be unworthy of being eaten or drunk or whether they be unworthy of approach.

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्त्ततस्तस्य रामस्य भगवाञ्छिवः । प्रसन्नचेता नितरां बभूव नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravarttatastasya rāmasya bhagavāñchivaḥ / prasannacetā nitarāṃ babhūva nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Nor do I devote any particular attention to rites worthy of being pursued or not. I do not tolerate the approach and stay of any one in this forest.
verses.hindi: सदसत्कमंखूपां च व्यक्ताव्यक्तो दयात्मिकाम् । स्वामेव हि प्रशंसंति पञ्चन्रह्मस्वरूपिणीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Nor do I devote any particular attention to rites worthy of being pursued or not. I do not tolerate the approach and stay of any one in this forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nor do I devote any particular attention to rites worthy of being pursued or not. I do not tolerate the approach and stay of any one in this forest.

verses.sanskrit: जिज्ञासुस्तस्य भगवान् भक्तिमात्मनि शङ्करः । मृगव्याधवपुर्भूत्वा ययौ राजंस्तदन्तिकम्

verses.translation: With my strength, I do not permit even Indra (to come here). There is no doubt about it. All the people know this since this region is dependent upon me.
verses.wordMeaning: With my strength, I do not permit even Indra (to come here). There is no doubt about it. All the people know this since this region is dependent upon me.
verses.commentary: Sense: With my strength, I do not permit even Indra (to come here). There is no doubt about it. All the people know this since this region is dependent upon me.

verses.wordMeaning: On being addressed thus by him, Rama, of great splendour, stood, for a while smiling silently. With his face bent down, he thought thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus by him, Rama, of great splendour, stood, for a while smiling silently. With his face bent down, he thought thus:

verses.sanskrit: उत्तुङ्गहनुबाह्वंसः पिङ्गलश्मश्रुमूर्द्धजः । मांसविस्रवसागन्धी सर्वप्राणिविहिंसकः
verses.transliteration: uttuṅgahanubāhvaṃsaḥ piṅgalaśmaśrumūrddhajaḥ / māṃsavisravasāgandhī sarvaprāṇivihiṃsakaḥ
verses.translation: "Who is this unassailable man with a deep resonant voice like the thunder-clap of clouds full of water?. He speaks excessively in words lull of clarity in meaning, sounds and letters.
verses.hindi: पपात कण्ठदेशे हि तदा कामेशवरस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: "Who is this unassailable man with a deep resonant voice like the thunder-clap of clouds full of water?. He speaks excessively in words lull of clarity in meaning, sounds and letters.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who is this unassailable man with a deep resonant voice like the thunder-clap of clouds full of water?. He speaks excessively in words lull of clarity in meaning, sounds and letters.

verses.sanskrit: सकण्टकुलतास्पर्शक्षतारूषितविग्रहः । सामटक्संचर्वमाणश्च मांसखण्डमनेकशः
verses.transliteration: sakaṇṭakulatāsparśakṣatārūṣitavigrahaḥ / sāmaṭaksaṃcarvamāṇaśca māṃsakhaṇḍamanekaśaḥ
verses.translation: But his body causes great doubt in me, because it belongs to a low caste, just as shafts though beautiful are deadly.*'
verses.wordMeaning: But his body causes great doubt in me, because it belongs to a low caste, just as shafts though beautiful are deadly.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: But his body causes great doubt in me, because it belongs to a low caste, just as shafts though beautiful are deadly.*'

verses.sanskrit: मांसभारद्वयालंबिविधानानतकन्धरः । आरुजंस्तरसा वृक्षानूरुवेगेन संघशः
verses.transliteration: māṃsabhāradvayālaṃbividhānānatakandharaḥ / ārujaṃstarasā vṛkṣānūruvegena saṃghaśaḥ
verses.translation: Even ■ as Rama thought thus, good omens occurred both on the ground as well as on his person (such as throbb- ings of the right arm) — omens which were portentous enough to grant him his desired object.
verses.hindi: हे देवि ! आप ही अखिला-अनारादि और कायं का रण दोनों के स्वरूप वाली हैं । सनकादि योगीजन आपको ही खोजा करते हैं।८। सत् और असत् कर्मों के स्वरूप वाली व्यक्त तया अन्यक्त-दया से स्वरूप वाली आप ही की पर ब्रह्म स्वरूप वाली की सव प्रशंसा किया करते हैं। आप ही
verses.wordMeaning: Even ■ as Rama thought thus, good omens occurred both on the ground as well as on his person (such as throbb- ings of the right arm) — omens which were portentous enough to grant him his desired object.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even ■ as Rama thought thus, good omens occurred both on the ground as well as on his person (such as throbb- ings of the right arm) — omens which were portentous enough to grant him his desired object.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यवर्त्तत तं देशं पादचारीव पर्वतः । आसाद्य सरसस्तस्य तीरं कुसुमितद्रुमम्
verses.transliteration: abhyavarttata taṃ deśaṃ pādacārīva parvataḥ / āsādya sarasastasya tīraṃ kusumitadrumam
verses.translation: Thereafter, the leading descendant of Bhrgu mentally pondered over and over again and slowly addressed these affably courteous words to the hunter.
verses.hindi: आरम्भ में सुजन किया करती हैं और आप ही क्षण भर में परिपालन किया करती हैं । अब लोकों पर अनुग्रह करते की आकाङ्क्षा से ही आप किसी भी पुरुष का सेवन करिये ।९-१०॥ इस प्रकार से ब्रह्माजी तथा समस्त सुरों के द्वारा जब वह देवी विज्ञापित की गयी थो तो उसने अपने हाथ से एक
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the leading descendant of Bhrgu mentally pondered over and over again and slowly addressed these affably courteous words to the hunter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the leading descendant of Bhrgu mentally pondered over and over again and slowly addressed these affably courteous words to the hunter.

verses.sanskrit: न्यदधान्मासभारं च स मूले कस्यचित्तरोः । निषसाद क्षणन्तत्र तरुच्छायामुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: nyadadhānmāsabhāraṃ ca sa mūle kasyacittaroḥ / niṣasāda kṣaṇantatra tarucchāyāmupāśritaḥ
verses.translation: "I am the son of Jamadagni, called Rama. I am a descendant of Bhrgu. Welfare unto thee. I have now come here to perform penance at the bidding of my preceptor.
verses.hindi: माला उठाकर नभ मण्डल के मध्य में प्रक्षिप्त कर दी थी ।११। उस देवी के द्वारा ऊपर की ओर प्रक्षिप्त को हुई बह माला आकाश मण्डल को सुशोभित करती हुई उस समय में कामेश्वर प्रभु के कण्ठ भाग में आकर गिर गयी थो ।१२। फिर तो ब्रह्मा ओर विष्णु जिनमें अग्रणी ये ऐसे समस्त देवगणः
verses.wordMeaning: "I am the son of Jamadagni, called Rama. I am a descendant of Bhrgu. Welfare unto thee. I have now come here to perform penance at the bidding of my preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am the son of Jamadagni, called Rama. I am a descendant of Bhrgu. Welfare unto thee. I have now come here to perform penance at the bidding of my preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्तं सरसस्तीरे सो ऽपश्यद्भृगुनन्दनम् । ततः स शीघ्रमुत्थाय समीपमुपसृत्य च
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhantaṃ sarasastīre so 'paśyadbhṛgunandanam / tataḥ sa śīghramutthāya samīpamupasṛtya ca
verses.translation: For a long time, I have been endeavouring to propitiate the lord of all the worlds by means of penance, devotion, and holy observances.
verses.hindi: बहुत प्रसन्न हुए थे और मन्द वायु से सम्प्रेरित मेघो ते पुष्पों की वर्षा की. थी ।१३। इसके अनन्तर विधाता ने भगवान् जनादन से कहा--हे हरे ! अबः इन दोनों शिव और शिवा का उद्वाह वैदिक विधान से करा देना चाहिए ।
verses.wordMeaning: For a long time, I have been endeavouring to propitiate the lord of all the worlds by means of penance, devotion, and holy observances.
verses.commentary: Sense: For a long time, I have been endeavouring to propitiate the lord of all the worlds by means of penance, devotion, and holy observances.

verses.sanskrit: रामाय सेषुचापाभ्यां कराभ्यां विदधेंऽजलिम् । सजलांभोदसन्नादगंभीरेण स्वरेण च
verses.transliteration: rāmāya seṣucāpābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ vidadheṃ'jalim / sajalāṃbhodasannādagaṃbhīreṇa svareṇa ca
verses.translation: I have decided in my mind that I will stay here until Lord Hara who takes pity on his devotees, manifests himself to me.
verses.wordMeaning: I have decided in my mind that I will stay here until Lord Hara who takes pity on his devotees, manifests himself to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have decided in my mind that I will stay here until Lord Hara who takes pity on his devotees, manifests himself to me.

verses.sanskrit: जगाद भृगुशार्दूलं गुहान्तरविसर्पिणा । तोषप्रवर्षव्याधो ऽहं वसाम्यस्मिन्महावने
verses.transliteration: jagāda bhṛguśārdūlaṃ guhāntaravisarpiṇā / toṣapravarṣavyādho 'haṃ vasāmyasminmahāvane
verses.translation: Or I deserve respect from you with devotion as I am a guest from another land. I am an ascetic and a sage and have come to your place of residence.
verses.wordMeaning: Or I deserve respect from you with devotion as I am a guest from another land. I am an ascetic and a sage and have come to your place of residence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or I deserve respect from you with devotion as I am a guest from another land. I am an ascetic and a sage and have come to your place of residence.

verses.sanskrit: ईशो ऽहमस्य देशस्य सप्राणितरुवीरुधः । चरामि समचित्तात्मा नानासत्त्वा मिषाशनः
verses.transliteration: īśo 'hamasya deśasya saprāṇitaruvīrudhaḥ / carāmi samacittātmā nānāsattvā miṣāśanaḥ
verses.translation: If I live in your vicinity it will be conducive only to sin. Resorting to my vicinity will result only in your unhappiness.
verses.wordMeaning: If I live in your vicinity it will be conducive only to sin. Resorting to my vicinity will result only in your unhappiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If I live in your vicinity it will be conducive only to sin. Resorting to my vicinity will result only in your unhappiness.

verses.sanskrit: समश्च सर्वभूतेषु न च पित्रादयो ऽपि मे । अभक्ष्यागम्यपेयादिच्छन्दवस्तुषु कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: samaśca sarvabhūteṣu na ca pitrādayo 'pi me / abhakṣyāgamyapeyādicchandavastuṣu kutracit
verses.translation: Hence, leave off loitering about in the precincts of my penance-grove. Be happy thereby in both the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, leave off loitering about in the precincts of my penance-grove. Be happy thereby in both the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, leave off loitering about in the precincts of my penance-grove. Be happy thereby in both the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्याकृत्यविधौचैव न विशेषितधीरहम् । प्रपन्नो नाभिगमनं निवासमपि कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: kṛtyākṛtyavidhaucaiva na viśeṣitadhīraham / prapanno nābhigamanaṃ nivāsamapi kasyacit
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the hunter became agitated with his eyes assuming copper colour due to anger. He replied thus to the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu whose eyes too were red (due to excitement).
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words, the hunter became agitated with his eyes assuming copper colour due to anger. He replied thus to the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu whose eyes too were red (due to excitement).
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words, the hunter became agitated with his eyes assuming copper colour due to anger. He replied thus to the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu whose eyes too were red (due to excitement).

verses.sanskrit: शक्रस्यापि बलेनाहमनुमन्ये न संशयः । जानते तध्यथा सर्वे देशो ऽयं मदुपाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: śakrasyāpi balenāhamanumanye na saṃśayaḥ / jānate tadhyathā sarve deśo 'yaṃ madupāśrayaḥ
verses.translation: "O Brahmana, why do you now extremely hate and shun my staying near you, like that of an ungrateful fellow?
verses.hindi: ददी तस्ये विध्रानेन प्रीत्या तां शङ्कराय तु ।
verses.wordMeaning: "O Brahmana, why do you now extremely hate and shun my staying near you, like that of an ungrateful fellow?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Brahmana, why do you now extremely hate and shun my staying near you, like that of an ungrateful fellow?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्न कश्चिदायाति ममात्रानुमतिं विना । इत्येष मम वृत्तान्तः कार्त्स्न्येन कथितस्तव
verses.transliteration: tasmānna kaścidāyāti mamātrānumatiṃ vinā / ityeṣa mama vṛttāntaḥ kārtsnyena kathitastava
verses.translation: Have I done any disservice to you or to any one else anywhere in this world? Who will despise and disrespect a man of control over his sense-organs who has never com- mitted any sin?
verses.wordMeaning: Have I done any disservice to you or to any one else anywhere in this world? Who will despise and disrespect a man of control over his sense-organs who has never com- mitted any sin?
verses.commentary: Sense: Have I done any disservice to you or to any one else anywhere in this world? Who will despise and disrespect a man of control over his sense-organs who has never com- mitted any sin?

verses.sanskrit: त्वं च मे ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन निजवृत्तमशेषतः । कस्त्वं कस्मादिहायातः किमर्थमिह धिष्ठितः । उद्यतो ऽन्यत्र वा गन्तुं किं वा तव चिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ ca me brūhi tattvena nijavṛttamaśeṣataḥ / kastvaṃ kasmādihāyātaḥ kimarthamiha dhiṣṭhitaḥ / udyato 'nyatra vā gantuṃ kiṃ vā tava cikīrṣitam
verses.translation: On hearing his words, O king, the leading scion of
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, O king, the leading scion of
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, O king, the leading scion of

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्येवमुक्तः प्रहसंस्तेन रामो महाद्युतिः । तूष्णीं क्षणमिव स्थित्वा दध्यौ किञ्चिदवाङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityevamuktaḥ prahasaṃstena rāmo mahādyutiḥ / tūṣṇīṃ kṣaṇamiva sthitvā dadhyau kiñcidavāṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: "The very tribe of hunters is ruthless. It strikes terror into all living beings. It is always engaged in wicked activities. Hence, it is despised and held in contempt by alt living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: "The very tribe of hunters is ruthless. It strikes terror into all living beings. It is always engaged in wicked activities. Hence, it is despised and held in contempt by alt living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The very tribe of hunters is ruthless. It strikes terror into all living beings. It is always engaged in wicked activities. Hence, it is despised and held in contempt by alt living beings.

verses.sanskrit: को ऽयमेव दुराधर्षः सजलांभोदनिस्वनः । ब्रवीति च गिरो ऽत्यर्थं विस्पष्टार्थपदाक्षराः
verses.transliteration: ko 'yameva durādharṣaḥ sajalāṃbhodanisvanaḥ / bravīti ca giro 'tyarthaṃ vispaṣṭārthapadākṣarāḥ
verses.translation: You are bom of that tribe. You are a sinner. You harm and harass all living beings. Why then, O evil-minded one, do you not deserve to be shunned by good people?
verses.hindi: अङ कुशं च ददौ ताभ्यां विश्वकर्मा विशांपतिः
verses.wordMeaning: You are bom of that tribe. You are a sinner. You harm and harass all living beings. Why then, O evil-minded one, do you not deserve to be shunned by good people?
verses.commentary: Sense: You are bom of that tribe. You are a sinner. You harm and harass all living beings. Why then, O evil-minded one, do you not deserve to be shunned by good people?

verses.sanskrit: किं तु मे महतीं शङ्कां तनुरस्य तनोति वै । विजातिसंश्रयत्वेन रमणीया तथा शराः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tu me mahatīṃ śaṅkāṃ tanurasya tanoti vai / vijātisaṃśrayatvena ramaṇīyā tathā śarāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, comprehend this that. you belong to a low caste and soon get away from here to another place. You are
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, comprehend this that. you belong to a low caste and soon get away from here to another place. You are
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, comprehend this that. you belong to a low caste and soon get away from here to another place. You are

verses.sanskrit: एवं चिन्तयतस्तस्य निमित्तानि शुभानि वै । बभूवुर्भुवि देहे च स्वाभिप्रेतार्थदान्यलम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ cintayatastasya nimittāni śubhāni vai / babhūvurbhuvi dehe ca svābhipretārthadānyalam
verses.translation: For sustaining your own life, you will not stop to kill all other living beings. How can you prevent yourself being considered censurable by good people?
verses.wordMeaning: For sustaining your own life, you will not stop to kill all other living beings. How can you prevent yourself being considered censurable by good people?
verses.commentary: Sense: For sustaining your own life, you will not stop to kill all other living beings. How can you prevent yourself being considered censurable by good people?

verses.sanskrit: ततो विमृश्य बहुशो मनसाभृगुपुङ्गवः । उवाच शनकैर्व्याधं वचनं सूनृताक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: tato vimṛśya bahuśo manasābhṛgupuṅgavaḥ / uvāca śanakairvyādhaṃ vacanaṃ sūnṛtākṣaram
verses.translation: Hence, go soon, O basest one among all men, there will not be dereliction of duty on my part and the subsequent loss thereof, on account of you.
verses.hindi: अब देव से सम्प्राप्त जगत् का मङ्गल करने वाला मुहूत्त' प्राप्त हो गया है । यह महादेवी आपके ही स्वरूप वाली है और आप भी सहज ही हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, go soon, O basest one among all men, there will not be dereliction of duty on my part and the subsequent loss thereof, on account of you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, go soon, O basest one among all men, there will not be dereliction of duty on my part and the subsequent loss thereof, on account of you.

verses.sanskrit: जामदग्न्यो ऽस्मि भद्रं ते रामो नाम्ना तु भार्गवः । तपश्चर्तुमिहायातः सांप्रतं गुरुशासनात्
verses.transliteration: jāmadagnyo 'smi bhadraṃ te rāmo nāmnā tu bhārgavaḥ / tapaścartumihāyātaḥ sāṃprataṃ guruśāsanāt
verses.translation: If you do not go away from here yourself, I shall, by using force, generate in you the inclination to move away.
verses.hindi: इस कल्याणी को आप देने के योग्य होते हैं और इन काम रूप शिव के लिये प्रदान कर दीजिए । देवों के देव त्रिविक्रम भगवान् ने यह श्रवण करके उस देवी का दान करने का उपक्रम किया था ।१६। उन देवगण योगिगण सव देव-ऋषि और पितृगणो के मध्य में भगवान् विष्णु ने उस देवी को बैदिक
verses.wordMeaning: If you do not go away from here yourself, I shall, by using force, generate in you the inclination to move away.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you do not go away from here yourself, I shall, by using force, generate in you the inclination to move away.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा सर्वलोकेशं भक्त्या च नियमेन च । आराधयितुमस्मिंस्तु चिरायाहं समुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: tapasā sarvalokeśaṃ bhaktyā ca niyamena ca / ārādhayitumasmiṃstu cirāyāhaṃ samudyataḥ
verses.translation: O sinner, your stay here even for half a moment is not conducive to your welfare. How can a hater of virtue, a person who always acts contradictory to the dictates of Dharma attain welfare?**
verses.hindi: विधि से भगवान् शङ्कर को प्रदान किया था और बड़ी प्रसन्नता से बह कन्यादान किया था ।१७। आदि केशव प्रभु ने उन दोनों शिवा और शिव का कल्याण करा दिया था और समस्त ब्रह्मादिक सुरगणोंने बहुतसें उपायन समपित किये थे ।१५। ब्रह्माजी ने तो इशु चाप दिया था श्री अविनाशो ओर
verses.wordMeaning: O sinner, your stay here even for half a moment is not conducive to your welfare. How can a hater of virtue, a person who always acts contradictory to the dictates of Dharma attain welfare?**
verses.commentary: Sense: O sinner, your stay here even for half a moment is not conducive to your welfare. How can a hater of virtue, a person who always acts contradictory to the dictates of Dharma attain welfare?**

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्मर्वेश्वरं सर्वशरण्यमभयप्रदम् । त्रिनेत्रं पापदमनं शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātmarveśvaraṃ sarvaśaraṇyamabhayapradam / trinetraṃ pāpadamanaṃ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Rama, lord Sankara, the wielder of the Pinaka bow, who had assumed the form of a hunter said to him these words as though he was infuriated, despite the fact that he was delighted.
verses.hindi: बज के समान सार बाला था । भगवान् श्रीहरि ने उन दोनों पति-पत्नी को अविनाशी और अम्लान कुसुमों का आयुध समापित किया था ।१६। जल सागरों के स्वामी वरुण ने उन दोनों के लिए नाग पाश दिया था और निशापति विश्वकर्मा ने उन दोनों के लिए अंकुश अपित किया था
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Rama, lord Sankara, the wielder of the Pinaka bow, who had assumed the form of a hunter said to him these words as though he was infuriated, despite the fact that he was delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Rama, lord Sankara, the wielder of the Pinaka bow, who had assumed the form of a hunter said to him these words as though he was infuriated, despite the fact that he was delighted.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तोषयिष्यामि सर्वज्ञं त्रिपुरान्तकम् । आश्रमे ऽस्मिनसरस्तीरे नियमं समुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tapasā toṣayiṣyāmi sarvajñaṃ tripurāntakam / āśrame 'sminasarastīre niyamaṃ samupāśritaḥ
verses.translation: "I consider all this endeavour on your part to be futile. How is it that you are the first wise man, whence Is Sambhu and whence is the penance?
verses.wordMeaning: "I consider all this endeavour on your part to be futile. How is it that you are the first wise man, whence Is Sambhu and whence is the penance?
verses.commentary: Sense: "I consider all this endeavour on your part to be futile. How is it that you are the first wise man, whence Is Sambhu and whence is the penance?

verses.sanskrit: भक्तानुकंपी भगवान्यावत्प्रत्यक्षतां हरः । उपैति तावदत्रैव स्थास्यामीति मतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: bhaktānukaṃpī bhagavānyāvatpratyakṣatāṃ haraḥ / upaiti tāvadatraiva sthāsyāmīti matirmama
verses.translation: O muddle-headed fellow, why do you take the trouble of performing penance now 7 Certainly Safikara will not be pleased with you, since you are of misguided conduct.
verses.hindi: अग्नि देव ने किरीट समर्पित किया या और चन्द्र तथा भास्कर देवों ने दो ताटंक दिये थे । रत्नाकर ने स्वयं समुपस्थित होकर नौ प्रकार के रत्नों से परिपूणे भूषा प्रदान की ची
verses.wordMeaning: O muddle-headed fellow, why do you take the trouble of performing penance now 7 Certainly Safikara will not be pleased with you, since you are of misguided conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: O muddle-headed fellow, why do you take the trouble of performing penance now 7 Certainly Safikara will not be pleased with you, since you are of misguided conduct.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादितस्त्वयाद्यैव गन्तुमन्यत्र युज्यते । न चेद्भवति मे हानिः स्वकृतेर्नियमस्य च
verses.transliteration: tasmāditastvayādyaiva gantumanyatra yujyate / na cedbhavati me hāniḥ svakṛterniyamasya ca
verses.translation: Sambhu (god Siva) has activities contradictory to the ways ' of the world, O evil-minded one. Excepting you, which unwise man will perform penance for propitiating him?
verses.wordMeaning: Sambhu (god Siva) has activities contradictory to the ways ' of the world, O evil-minded one. Excepting you, which unwise man will perform penance for propitiating him?
verses.commentary: Sense: Sambhu (god Siva) has activities contradictory to the ways ' of the world, O evil-minded one. Excepting you, which unwise man will perform penance for propitiating him?

verses.sanskrit: माननीयो ऽथ वाहं ते भक्त्या देशान्तरातिथिः । स्वनिवासमुपायातस्तपस्वी च तथा मुनिः
verses.transliteration: mānanīyo 'tha vāhaṃ te bhaktyā deśāntarātithiḥ / svanivāsamupāyātastapasvī ca tathā muniḥ
verses.translation: By cutting off the head of Brahma, the I*arame$thin the grand-father of the worlds, Sambhu incurred the sin of Brahm in - slaugh ter.
verses.wordMeaning: By cutting off the head of Brahma, the I*arame$thin the grand-father of the worlds, Sambhu incurred the sin of Brahm in - slaugh ter.
verses.commentary: Sense: By cutting off the head of Brahma, the I*arame$thin the grand-father of the worlds, Sambhu incurred the sin of Brahm in - slaugh ter.

verses.sanskrit: त्वतसंनिधौ निवासो मे भवेत्पापाय केवलम् । तव चाप्यसुखोदर्कं मत्समीपनिषेवणम्
verses.transliteration: tvatasaṃnidhau nivāso me bhavetpāpāya kevalam / tava cāpyasukhodarkaṃ matsamīpaniṣevaṇam
verses.translation: I think, O sage, that within a short while the fulfilment of penance has been achieved by you now on account of the identity of qualities between you and Rudra.
verses.wordMeaning: I think, O sage, that within a short while the fulfilment of penance has been achieved by you now on account of the identity of qualities between you and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: I think, O sage, that within a short while the fulfilment of penance has been achieved by you now on account of the identity of qualities between you and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वंमदाश्रमोपान्ते परिचङ्क्रमणादिकम् । परित्यज्य सुखीभूया लोकयोरुभयोरपि
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṃmadāśramopānte paricaṅkramaṇādikam / parityajya sukhībhūyā lokayorubhayorapi
verses.translation: By killing your own mother, you have been repudi- ated and expelled by almost all the people of the world. Under the pretext of performing a penance, you confine your activi- ties to the dense forest devoid of people.
verses.wordMeaning: By killing your own mother, you have been repudi- ated and expelled by almost all the people of the world. Under the pretext of performing a penance, you confine your activi- ties to the dense forest devoid of people.
verses.commentary: Sense: By killing your own mother, you have been repudi- ated and expelled by almost all the people of the world. Under the pretext of performing a penance, you confine your activi- ties to the dense forest devoid of people.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स भूयो भृगुपुङ्गवम् । उवाच रोषताम्राक्षस्ताम्राक्षमिदमुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa bhūyo bhṛgupuṅgavam / uvāca roṣatāmrākṣastāmrākṣamidamuttaram
verses.translation: There are means of expiation and atonement for other types of sins. But understand that there is no expiation (from sin) to those who injure and hurt their mothers.
verses.hindi: सुरणणों के अधिप महेन्द्र ने उस समय में एक अक्षय मधुपात्र दिया था । उस समय में कुवेर ने एक माना दी थो जो चिन्तामणियों से निमित की हुई थो ।२२। लक्ष्मी के स्वामी नारायण ने स्वयं ही एक साम्राज्य का सूचक छत्र अपित किया था । गङ्गा और यमुना ने उनको चन्द्र के ही समान
verses.wordMeaning: There are means of expiation and atonement for other types of sins. But understand that there is no expiation (from sin) to those who injure and hurt their mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are means of expiation and atonement for other types of sins. But understand that there is no expiation (from sin) to those who injure and hurt their mothers.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन् किमिदमत्यर्थं समीपे वसतिं मम । परिगर्हयसे येन कृतघ्नस्येव कांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: brahman kimidamatyarthaṃ samīpe vasatiṃ mama / parigarhayase yena kṛtaghnasyeva kāṃpratam
verses.translation: If, O Rama, the main characteristic feature of virtue is considered to be non-violence by you, why did you cut off the head of your mother with your own hand?
verses.hindi: भास्कर दो चमर दिए ये।२३। आठ वसुगण रुदगण-आदित्य-अश्‍विनी-
verses.wordMeaning: If, O Rama, the main characteristic feature of virtue is considered to be non-violence by you, why did you cut off the head of your mother with your own hand?
verses.commentary: Sense: If, O Rama, the main characteristic feature of virtue is considered to be non-violence by you, why did you cut off the head of your mother with your own hand?

verses.sanskrit: किं मयापकृतं लोके भवतो ऽन्यस्य वा क्वचित् । अनागस्कारिणं दान्तं को ऽवमन्येत नामतः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ mayāpakṛtaṃ loke bhavato 'nyasya vā kvacit / anāgaskāriṇaṃ dāntaṃ ko 'vamanyeta nāmataḥ
verses.translation: After committing the terrible murder of your own mother, ( a sin) despised by all the worlds, you profess to be a righteous man and you censure others as you please.
verses.hindi: तोषित होते हुए अपने-अपने आयुध उस महादेवी के लिए समपित किये ये
verses.wordMeaning: After committing the terrible murder of your own mother, ( a sin) despised by all the worlds, you profess to be a righteous man and you censure others as you please.
verses.commentary: Sense: After committing the terrible murder of your own mother, ( a sin) despised by all the worlds, you profess to be a righteous man and you censure others as you please.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निधिः परिहर्त्तव्यो यदि मे विप्रपुङ्गव । दर्शनं सह संवासः संभाषणमथापि च
verses.transliteration: sannidhiḥ pariharttavyo yadi me viprapuṅgava / darśanaṃ saha saṃvāsaḥ saṃbhāṣaṇamathāpi ca
verses.translation: Without knowing one's own positive (irremediable) fault (sin) and by seeing and laughing (on your part), I regard it incompetent for you to criticise the faults of others.
verses.hindi: न्वित थे एवं नीरोग उष्ट्र (ऊट) और अश्व जो क्षुधा और प्यास से रहित
verses.wordMeaning: Without knowing one's own positive (irremediable) fault (sin) and by seeing and laughing (on your part), I regard it incompetent for you to criticise the faults of others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without knowing one's own positive (irremediable) fault (sin) and by seeing and laughing (on your part), I regard it incompetent for you to criticise the faults of others.

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्मताधुनैवास्मादपसर्त्तव्यमाश्रमात् । स्वसंश्रयं परित्यज्य क्वाहं यास्ये बुभुक्षितः
verses.transliteration: āyuṣmatādhunaivāsmādapasarttavyamāśramāt / svasaṃśrayaṃ parityajya kvāhaṃ yāsye bubhukṣitaḥ
verses.translation: If I were to forsake my duty ( dharma ) and remain care-free without fear from any quarter, then you can yourself mentally scrutinize and despise me as you please.
verses.wordMeaning: If I were to forsake my duty ( dharma ) and remain care-free without fear from any quarter, then you can yourself mentally scrutinize and despise me as you please.
verses.commentary: Sense: If I were to forsake my duty ( dharma ) and remain care-free without fear from any quarter, then you can yourself mentally scrutinize and despise me as you please.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाधिवासं परित्यज्य भवता योदितः कथम् । इतो ऽन्यस्मिन् गामिष्यामि दूरे नाहं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: svādhivāsaṃ parityajya bhavatā yoditaḥ katham / ito 'nyasmin gāmiṣyāmi dūre nāhaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Along with my family, I sustain myself day by day with meat because it is my duty. This is the avocation formerly laid down by the creator for me.
verses.hindi: चे एवं वस्र की उपमा के आकार वाले ये तथा आयुधों के सहित एवं परि- च्छदों से युक्त थे दिए थे ।२५॥ इसके अनन्तर उन दोनों शिवा और शिव का परम मंगल अभिषेक किया था। इसके उपरान्त एक विमान बनवाया था जिसका नाम कुसुमाकर या ।२६। इसकी रचना विधाता ने की थी जो कि
verses.wordMeaning: Along with my family, I sustain myself day by day with meat because it is my duty. This is the avocation formerly laid down by the creator for me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with my family, I sustain myself day by day with meat because it is my duty. This is the avocation formerly laid down by the creator for me.

verses.sanskrit: गम्यतां भवतान्यत्र स्थीयतामत्र वेच्छया । नाहं चालयितुं शक्यः स्थानादस्मात्कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: gamyatāṃ bhavatānyatra sthīyatāmatra vecchayā / nāhaṃ cālayituṃ śakyaḥ sthānādasmātkathañcana
verses.translation: If I kill (more animals and have with me more) meat than what is sufficient to nourish my parents and others, then I may incur sin.
verses.hindi: अम्लान मालाओं वाला था तथा नित्य हो आयुधों के द्वारा अभेद्य था । यह इच्छा के अनुरूप दिवलोक ओर भूलोक में गमन करने बाला तथा सुसमृद्धि से समन्वित था ।२७। जिसके केवल गन्ध से ही भ्रान्तिक्षुधा-रोग और आत्ति सब नष्ट हो जाया करती हैं और यह मन के आहलाद को करने वाला तथा
verses.wordMeaning: If I kill (more animals and have with me more) meat than what is sufficient to nourish my parents and others, then I may incur sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: If I kill (more animals and have with me more) meat than what is sufficient to nourish my parents and others, then I may incur sin.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य किञ्चित्कोपसमन्वितः । तमुवाच पुनर्वाक्यमिदं राजन्भृगूद्वहः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kiñcitkopasamanvitaḥ / tamuvāca punarvākyamidaṃ rājanbhṛgūdvahaḥ
verses.translation: We cannot be censured for killing to the extent necessary for sustenance. Praise or censure me after reflecting over this.
verses.wordMeaning: We cannot be censured for killing to the extent necessary for sustenance. Praise or censure me after reflecting over this.
verses.commentary: Sense: We cannot be censured for killing to the extent necessary for sustenance. Praise or censure me after reflecting over this.

verses.sanskrit: व्याधजातिरियं क्रूरा सर्वसत्त्वभयावहा । खलकर्मरता नित्यं धिक्कृता सर्वजन्तुभिः
verses.transliteration: vyādhajātiriyaṃ krūrā sarvasattvabhayāvahā / khalakarmaratā nityaṃ dhikkṛtā sarvajantubhiḥ
verses.translation: Carefully examine with your own intellect, the difference between you and me. As for me, I am engaged in the sustenance of my parents and others whole-heartedly.
verses.wordMeaning: Carefully examine with your own intellect, the difference between you and me. As for me, I am engaged in the sustenance of my parents and others whole-heartedly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Carefully examine with your own intellect, the difference between you and me. As for me, I am engaged in the sustenance of my parents and others whole-heartedly.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां जातो ऽसि पापीयान्सर्वप्राणिविहिंसकः । स कथं न परित्याज्यः सुजनैः स्यात्तु दुर्मते
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ jāto 'si pāpīyānsarvaprāṇivihiṃsakaḥ / sa kathaṃ na parityājyaḥ sujanaiḥ syāttu durmate
verses.translation: But you have forsaken your aged father and killed your mother. Still you profess to be righteous and you have come down here to perform penance.
verses.wordMeaning: But you have forsaken your aged father and killed your mother. Still you profess to be righteous and you have come down here to perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: But you have forsaken your aged father and killed your mother. Still you profess to be righteous and you have come down here to perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विहीनजातीयं विदित्वात्मानमब्यथ । शीघ्रमस्माद्व्रजान्यत्र नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: tasmādvihīnajātīyaṃ viditvātmānamabyatha / śīghramasmādvrajānyatra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Those who know the root cause, those who have clear vision about things are not able to move their tongue to give expression to what they desire at will.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who know the root cause, those who have clear vision about things are not able to move their tongue to give expression to what they desire at will.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who know the root cause, those who have clear vision about things are not able to move their tongue to give expression to what they desire at will.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरत्राणकारुण्यात्समीपं नोपसर्पसि । यथा त्वं कण्टकादीनामसहिष्णुतया व्यथाम्
verses.transliteration: śarīratrāṇakāruṇyātsamīpaṃ nopasarpasi / yathā tvaṃ kaṇṭakādīnāmasahiṣṇutayā vyathām
verses.translation: I know perfectly well every thing about you, O scion of the family of Bhrgu. Hence, enough of your futile penance.
verses.wordMeaning: I know perfectly well every thing about you, O scion of the family of Bhrgu. Hence, enough of your futile penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know perfectly well every thing about you, O scion of the family of Bhrgu. Hence, enough of your futile penance.

verses.sanskrit: तथावेहि समस्तानां प्रियाः प्राणाः शरीरिणाम् । व्यथा चाभिहतानां तु विद्यते भवतो ऽन्यथा
verses.transliteration: tathāvehi samastānāṃ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ śarīriṇām / vyathā cābhihatānāṃ tu vidyate bhavato 'nyathā
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: उस विमान पर ये दोनों शुम दम्पती समारूढ़ होकर नृप मन्दिर से बाहिर निकले ये । इस विमान में चमर-व्यजन-छत्र-ध्वजा आदि से परम
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सर्वभूतानामिति धर्मः सनातनः । एतद्विरुद्धाचरणान्नित्यं सद्भिर्विगर्हितः
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāmiti dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ / etadviruddhācaraṇānnityaṃ sadbhirvigarhitaḥ
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मप्राणाभिरक्षार्थं त्वमशेषशरीरिणः । हनिष्यसि कथं सत्सुनाप्नोषि वचनीयताम्
verses.transliteration: ātmaprāṇābhirakṣārthaṃ tvamaśeṣaśarīriṇaḥ / haniṣyasi kathaṃ satsunāpnoṣi vacanīyatām
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मादामिषेणाहं सकुटुम्बो दिनेदिने । वर्त्तामि सापि मे वृत्तिर्विधात्रा विहिता पुरा
verses.transliteration: svadharmādāmiṣeṇāhaṃ sakuṭumbo dinedine / varttāmi sāpi me vṛttirvidhātrā vihitā purā
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: मांसेन यावता मे स्यान्नित्यं पित्रादि पोषणम् । हनिष्ये चेत्तदधिकं तर्हि युज्येयमेनसा
verses.transliteration: māṃsena yāvatā me syānnityaṃ pitrādi poṣaṇam / haniṣye cettadadhikaṃ tarhi yujyeyamenasā
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: अयं भंडोऽसुरो देवि बावते जगतां त्रयम् ।
