verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्पोषणघातेन न वयं स्याम निन्दिताः । तदेतत्संप्रधार्य त्वं निन्दवा मां प्रशंस वा
verses.transliteration: yāvatpoṣaṇaghātena na vayaṃ syāma ninditāḥ / tadetatsaṃpradhārya tvaṃ nindavā māṃ praśaṃsa vā
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से सब पर स्नेह एवं प्यार करने वाली वह देवी थी और अन्यत्र ऐसा कहीं भी नहीं था । उस देवी ने समस्त जनों को निरन्तर अत्यधिक अनुराग से सन्तुष्ट कर रका था।४३। इप महान भूलोक में बह् राज्ञो राजा हों चाहे विद्वान होवें सकल की ईप्सा रखने बाले समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: साधु वासाधु वा कर्म यस्य यद्विहितं पुरा । तदेव तेन कर्त्तव्यमापद्यपि कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: sādhu vāsādhu vā karma yasya yadvihitaṃ purā / tadeva tena karttavyamāpadyapi kathañcana
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: भूतल के निवासीजनों के अभीष्ट पदार्थों का दोहन किया करती थी
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: निरूपय स्वभुद्ध्या त्वमात्मनो मम चान्तरम् । अहं तु सर्वभावेन मित्रादिभरणे रतः
verses.transliteration: nirūpaya svabhuddhyā tvamātmano mama cāntaram / ahaṃ tu sarvabhāvena mitrādibharaṇe rataḥ
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: तीनों लोकों के एक ही महीपाल अम्बिका के सहित काम श्भा के होने पर दश सहस्र वर्ष एक ही क्षण के समान व्यतोत हो गये ये।४५। इसके अनन्तर देवर्षि नारद जो भगवान किसो समय में बहाँ पर समागत हुए थे और उस परमा शक्ति को प्रणाम करके उन्होंने विनय से समन्वित होकर कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: संत्यज्य पितरं वृद्धं विनिहत्य च मातरम् । भूत्वा तु धार्मिकस्त्वं तु तपश्चर्तुमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: saṃtyajya pitaraṃ vṛddhaṃ vinihatya ca mātaram / bhūtvā tu dhārmikastvaṃ tu tapaścartumihāgataḥ
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: था।४६। आपतो परब्रह्म-परघाम और पवित्र हैं । है परमेश्वरि ! आप सद- असत् भावों के कलत के स्वरूप वाली हैं ।४७। इस जगत के अभ्युदय के ही लिए आप इस व्यक्तभाव को प्राप्त हुई हैं । आप इस लोक में असज्जनों के विनाश के लिए और सज्जनों के अभ्युदय करने वाली हैं। है कल्याणि !
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: ये तु मूलविदस्तेषां विस्पष्टं यत्र दर्शनम् । यथाजिह्वं भवेन्नात्र वचसापि समीहितुम्
verses.transliteration: ye tu mūlavidasteṣāṃ vispaṣṭaṃ yatra darśanam / yathājihvaṃ bhavennātra vacasāpi samīhitum
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: आपकी जो प्रवृत्ति है बह साधु पुरुषों के रक्षण के ही सिए हैं।४८। यह एक भण्डासुर है है देवि ! यह तीनों लोकोंको बाधा दे रहा है । यह केवल आप ही के द्वारा जीता जा सकता है ऐसी एक ही आप हैं और दूसरे सुरों के द्वारा तो यह कभी भी जीता नहीं जा सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: अहं तु सम्यग्जानामि तव वृत्तमशेषतः । तस्मादलं ते तपसा निष्फलेन भृगूद्वह
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tu samyagjānāmi tava vṛttamaśeṣataḥ / tasmādalaṃ te tapasā niṣphalena bhṛgūdvaha
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: सुखमिच्छसि चेत्त्यक्त्वा कायक्लेशकरं तपः । याहि राम त्वमन्यत्र यत्र वा न विदुर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: sukhamicchasi cettyaktvā kāyakleśakaraṃ tapaḥ / yāhi rāma tvamanyatra yatra vā na vidurjanāḥ
verses.translation: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.hindi: त्वदाज्ञया गमिष्यंति स्वानि स्वानि पुराणि तु
verses.wordMeaning: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you desire happiness, O Rama, leave off this penance that causes pain and distress to your body. Go elsewhere, O Rama where people do not know you.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे त्रयोविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्तस्तेन भूपाल रामो मतिमतां वरः । निरूप्य मनसा भूयस्तमुवाचाभिविस्मितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde trayoviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktastena bhūpāla rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ / nirūpya manasā bhūyastamuvācābhivismitam
verses.translation: On being told thus by him, O Protector of the Earth y Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, scrutinized and pondered over him and inquired of him in surprise.
verses.hindi: एबं विज्ञापिता देवी नारदेनाखिलेश्‍वरी । स्वस्ववासनिवासाय प्रेषयामास चामरान्
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by him, O Protector of the Earth y Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, scrutinized and pondered over him and inquired of him in surprise.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by him, O Protector of the Earth y Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, scrutinized and pondered over him and inquired of him in surprise.

verses.sanskrit: राम उवाच कस्त्वं ब्रूहि महाभाग न वै प्राकृतपूरुषः । इन्द्रस्येवानुभावेन वपुरालक्ष्यते तव
verses.transliteration: rāma uvāca kastvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga na vai prākṛtapūruṣaḥ / indrasyevānubhāvena vapurālakṣyate tava
verses.translation: "Who are You, O extremely fortunate one, tell me. You are indeed no barbarous person. Your body appears to be equipped, as it were, with the grandeur and majesty of Indra.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणं च हरि शम्भुः वानवादीन्दिशां पतीच् । यथाह पूजयित्वा तु प्रेषयामास चांबिका
verses.wordMeaning: "Who are You, O extremely fortunate one, tell me. You are indeed no barbarous person. Your body appears to be equipped, as it were, with the grandeur and majesty of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who are You, O extremely fortunate one, tell me. You are indeed no barbarous person. Your body appears to be equipped, as it were, with the grandeur and majesty of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रार्थपदौदार्यगुणगांभीर्यजातिभिः । सर्वज्ञस्यैव ते वाणी श्रूयते ऽतिमनोहरा
verses.transliteration: vicitrārthapadaudāryaguṇagāṃbhīryajātibhiḥ / sarvajñasyaiva te vāṇī śrūyate 'timanoharā
verses.translation: Your speech sounds to be very charming as though it were that of the omniscient Lord. It is enriched, by words of diverse meaning having the qualities of lucidity, clarity and depth and majesty of the highest class.
verses.wordMeaning: Your speech sounds to be very charming as though it were that of the omniscient Lord. It is enriched, by words of diverse meaning having the qualities of lucidity, clarity and depth and majesty of the highest class.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your speech sounds to be very charming as though it were that of the omniscient Lord. It is enriched, by words of diverse meaning having the qualities of lucidity, clarity and depth and majesty of the highest class.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो वह्निर्यमो धाता वरुणो वा धनाधिपः । ईशानस्तपनो ब्रह्मा वायुः सोमो गुरुर्गुहः
verses.transliteration: indro vahniryamo dhātā varuṇo vā dhanādhipaḥ / īśānastapano brahmā vāyuḥ somo gururguhaḥ
verses.translation: Are You Indra, Vahni (the fire-god), Yama, Dhdtr (the Creator), Varuna, Kubera the lord of wealth, ISdna> Tapana ( the Sun), Brahma y Vayu (the Wind god), Soma (the Moon- god), Guru (Jupiter) or Guha (Lord Skanda)?
verses.wordMeaning: Are You Indra, Vahni (the fire-god), Yama, Dhdtr (the Creator), Varuna, Kubera the lord of wealth, ISdna> Tapana ( the Sun), Brahma y Vayu (the Wind god), Soma (the Moon- god), Guru (Jupiter) or Guha (Lord Skanda)?
verses.commentary: Sense: Are You Indra, Vahni (the fire-god), Yama, Dhdtr (the Creator), Varuna, Kubera the lord of wealth, ISdna> Tapana ( the Sun), Brahma y Vayu (the Wind god), Soma (the Moon- god), Guru (Jupiter) or Guha (Lord Skanda)?

verses.sanskrit: एषामन्यतमः प्रायो भवान्भवितुमर्हति । अनुभावेन जातिस्ते हृदिशङ्कां तनोति मे
verses.transliteration: eṣāmanyatamaḥ prāyo bhavānbhavitumarhati / anubhāvena jātiste hṛdiśaṅkāṃ tanoti me
verses.translation: Due to your grandeur and majesty, you deserve to be almost one of these. But your caste (low birth) causes doubt in my heart.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to your grandeur and majesty, you deserve to be almost one of these. But your caste (low birth) causes doubt in my heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to your grandeur and majesty, you deserve to be almost one of these. But your caste (low birth) causes doubt in my heart.

verses.sanskrit: मायावी भगवान्विष्णुः श्रूयते पुरुषोत्तमः । को वा त्वं वपुषानेन ब्रूहि मां समुपागतः
verses.transliteration: māyāvī bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śrūyate puruṣottamaḥ / ko vā tvaṃ vapuṣānena brūhi māṃ samupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Lord Visnu, the most excellent among all persons, is reputed to be a Maydvx (one who wields illusive powers). Who are you that have come here with such a body a$ this? Please do tell me.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Visnu, the most excellent among all persons, is reputed to be a Maydvx (one who wields illusive powers). Who are you that have come here with such a body a$ this? Please do tell me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Visnu, the most excellent among all persons, is reputed to be a Maydvx (one who wields illusive powers). Who are you that have come here with such a body a$ this? Please do tell me.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वा जगतां नाथः सर्वज्ञः परमेश्वरः । परमात्मात्मसंभूतिरात्मारामः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: atha vā jagatāṃ nāthaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ / paramātmātmasaṃbhūtirātmārāmaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: In this world, a body equipped with such potentiality and influence cannot belong to any one else. Your speech is endued
verses.hindi: ये समस्त देवगण चिरकाल से यहाँ पर ही निवास किये हुए हैं भौर ये आपको सेवा में तत्पर हो रहे हैं । ये आपकी ही आज्ञा से अपने-अपने पुरं में जायेंगे ।५०। इनके सब पुर इस समय में शून्य और मङ्गल से रहित हो रहे हैं। ऐसी कृपा कीजिए कि ये सब समृद्ध अर्थो वाले हो जावे । इस
verses.wordMeaning: In this world, a body equipped with such potentiality and influence cannot belong to any one else. Your speech is endued
verses.commentary: Sense: In this world, a body equipped with such potentiality and influence cannot belong to any one else. Your speech is endued

verses.sanskrit: स्वच्छन्दचारी भगवाञ्छिवः सर्वजगन्मयः । वपुषानेन संयुक्ते भवान्भवितुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: svacchandacārī bhagavāñchivaḥ sarvajaganmayaḥ / vapuṣānena saṃyukte bhavānbhavitumarhati
verses.translation: I believe that out of feelings of endearment towards his devotee, lord Hara has become visible with this body. There is no doubt that he has come to test me.
verses.hindi: रीति से जब नारद मुनि के द्वारा देवी को बताया गया था तो उस अखिलेशवरी देवी ने देवों को अपने-अपने निवास स्थानों को भेज दिया शा
verses.wordMeaning: I believe that out of feelings of endearment towards his devotee, lord Hara has become visible with this body. There is no doubt that he has come to test me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I believe that out of feelings of endearment towards his devotee, lord Hara has become visible with this body. There is no doubt that he has come to test me.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यस्येदृग्भवेल्लोके प्रभावानुगतं वपुः । जात्यर्थसौष्ठवोपेता वाणी चौदार्यशालिनी
verses.transliteration: nānyasyedṛgbhavelloke prabhāvānugataṃ vapuḥ / jātyarthasauṣṭhavopetā vāṇī caudāryaśālinī
verses.translation: You are not a mere hunter. Those hunters will not have such a shapely figure as yours. Hence, obeisance to you. So reveal your real excellent form.
verses.hindi: दिक्पाल देवों का कशोचित पूजन करके विदा कर दिया था ।५२। फिर अपराध का त्याग करने के भी लिए सुरगण प्रोषित किए थे आदि पिता- माता-शिवा-शिव की अपने-अपने अशो से सेवा भी करते थे।५३। यह आण्यात आयु की वृद्धि करने वाला है--यह सभी प्रकार के मरङ्गलों की
verses.wordMeaning: You are not a mere hunter. Those hunters will not have such a shapely figure as yours. Hence, obeisance to you. So reveal your real excellent form.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are not a mere hunter. Those hunters will not have such a shapely figure as yours. Hence, obeisance to you. So reveal your real excellent form.

verses.sanskrit: मन्ये ऽहं भक्तवात्सल्याद्वानेन वपुषाहरः । प्रत्यक्षतामुपगतो संदेहो ऽस्मत्परीक्षया
verses.transliteration: manye 'haṃ bhaktavātsalyādvānena vapuṣāharaḥ / pratyakṣatāmupagato saṃdeho 'smatparīkṣayā
verses.translation: Be pleased now and destroy the delusion of my intellect in every respect, by assuming your original form.
verses.hindi: कारण है-उस महादेवी का आविर्भाव का होना तथा उसके राज्यासन पर अभिषेचन का होना मङ्गल प्रद है ५४ जो कोई पुरुष प्रातःकाल में उठकर भक्तिभाव से शंयुत होकर विद्वन् श्रद्धालु बनकर इसका जाप किया करता है बह धन से समृद्ध हो जाता है और उसकी वाणो धुधा के सदृश ही परम
verses.wordMeaning: Be pleased now and destroy the delusion of my intellect in every respect, by assuming your original form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased now and destroy the delusion of my intellect in every respect, by assuming your original form.

verses.sanskrit: न केवलं भवान् व्याधस्तेषां नेदृग्विधाकृतिः । तस्मात्तुभ्यं नमस्तस्मै सुरुपं संप्रदर्शय
verses.transliteration: na kevalaṃ bhavān vyādhasteṣāṃ nedṛgvidhākṛtiḥ / tasmāttubhyaṃ namastasmai surupaṃ saṃpradarśaya
verses.translation: O highly fortunate one, I pray unto you, bowing down my head several times. Who are you please? Reveal yourself. Here I have joined my palms in reverence to you".
verses.hindi: मधुर हो जाया करती है ।५५। उस धीमान का इस लोक में और परलोक में कहीं पर भी कुछ भी अशुभ नहीं होता है। बहू विपुल यश को प्राप्त किया करता है-उसका मान बढ़ता है तथा वह उत्तमता का लाभ किया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: O highly fortunate one, I pray unto you, bowing down my head several times. Who are you please? Reveal yourself. Here I have joined my palms in reverence to you".
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly fortunate one, I pray unto you, bowing down my head several times. Who are you please? Reveal yourself. Here I have joined my palms in reverence to you".

verses.sanskrit: आविष्कुर्वन्प्रसीदात्ममहिमानुगुणं वपुः । ममानेकविधा शङ्कामुच्येत येन मानसी
verses.transliteration: āviṣkurvanprasīdātmamahimānuguṇaṃ vapuḥ / mamānekavidhā śaṅkāmucyeta yena mānasī
verses.translation: After saying this to that highly exalted one and being desirous of comprehending him, the scion of the family of Bhrgu sat on the ground and began to meditate with great concentration.
verses.hindi: सेना सहित विजय यात्रा  I च
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this to that highly exalted one and being desirous of comprehending him, the scion of the family of Bhrgu sat on the ground and began to meditate with great concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to that highly exalted one and being desirous of comprehending him, the scion of the family of Bhrgu sat on the ground and began to meditate with great concentration.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद सर्वभावेन बुद्धिमोहौ ममाधुना । प्रणाशय स्वरूपस्य ग्रहणादेव केवलम्
verses.transliteration: prasīda sarvabhāvena buddhimohau mamādhunā / praṇāśaya svarūpasya grahaṇādeva kevalam
verses.translation: He seated himself in the lotus pose. He became silent. He controlled his speech, body and mind. He restrained the movement of the vital airs. Thus the sage of high intellect meditated for a long time.
verses.wordMeaning: He seated himself in the lotus pose. He became silent. He controlled his speech, body and mind. He restrained the movement of the vital airs. Thus the sage of high intellect meditated for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seated himself in the lotus pose. He became silent. He controlled his speech, body and mind. He restrained the movement of the vital airs. Thus the sage of high intellect meditated for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थयेत्वां महाभाग प्रणम्य शिरसासकृत् । कस्त्वं मे दर्शयात्मानं बद्धो ऽयं ते मयाञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: prārthayetvāṃ mahābhāga praṇamya śirasāsakṛt / kastvaṃ me darśayātmānaṃ baddho 'yaṃ te mayāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: By means of his inner eye in combination with the soul, he beheld the lord of the universe who had assumed the form of a hunter of deer and who confers blessings upon his devotees.
verses.hindi: उसकी श्री चञ्चल होते हुए भी अचल हो जाती है और उसको पद-पद पर श्रेय होता है । उसको भय तो किसी भी समय में होता ही नहीं है और बहुत तेजस्बी लथा बीये बाला हो जाता है ।५७। उसको तीनों प्रकार के ताप नहीं रहा करते हैं । जाच्यात्मिक-आधिभौतिक और आधि-
verses.wordMeaning: By means of his inner eye in combination with the soul, he beheld the lord of the universe who had assumed the form of a hunter of deer and who confers blessings upon his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his inner eye in combination with the soul, he beheld the lord of the universe who had assumed the form of a hunter of deer and who confers blessings upon his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा तं महाभाग ज्ञातुमिच्छन्भृगूद्वहः । उपविश्य ततो भूमौ ध्यानमास्ते समाहितः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā taṃ mahābhāga jñātumicchanbhṛgūdvahaḥ / upaviśya tato bhūmau dhyānamāste samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter Rama, the descendant of Bhrgu, got up quickly and opened his eyes. He saw the lord standing in front of him in the self-same physical body.
verses.hindi: देविक--ये तीन ताप होते हैं और वह पुरुष पुरुषार्थो से परिपूरित होता या करता है । तीनों समयों में (श्रात:-मध्याहन-सायस्) जो नित्य ही इसका जाप किया करता है और सिहासनेश्वरो का ध्यान करता है वह उत्तम जापक छै मास में हो महतो लक्ष्मी को प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Rama, the descendant of Bhrgu, got up quickly and opened his eyes. He saw the lord standing in front of him in the self-same physical body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Rama, the descendant of Bhrgu, got up quickly and opened his eyes. He saw the lord standing in front of him in the self-same physical body.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धपद्मासनो मौनी यतवाक्कायमानसः । निरुद्धप्राणसंचारो दध्यौ चिरमुदारधीः
verses.transliteration: baddhapadmāsano maunī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ / niruddhaprāṇasaṃcāro dadhyau ciramudāradhīḥ
verses.translation: With words choking his throat and faltering due to excitement, O king, he uttered several times "O Sarva, O Sankara, be refuge upto me."
verses.wordMeaning: With words choking his throat and faltering due to excitement, O king, he uttered several times "O Sarva, O Sankara, be refuge upto me."
verses.commentary: Sense: With words choking his throat and faltering due to excitement, O king, he uttered several times "O Sarva, O Sankara, be refuge upto me."

verses.sanskrit: सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं मनो हृदि निरुध्य च । चिन्तयामास देवेशं ध्यानदृष्ट्या जगद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: sanniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ mano hṛdi nirudhya ca / cintayāmāsa deveśaṃ dhyānadṛṣṭyā jagadgurum
verses.translation: Then lord Sambhu who assumed his form on being satisfied at his devotion, lifted up Rama who had bowed down in obeisance on the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: Then lord Sambhu who assumed his form on being satisfied at his devotion, lifted up Rama who had bowed down in obeisance on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Sambhu who assumed his form on being satisfied at his devotion, lifted up Rama who had bowed down in obeisance on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यच्च जगन्नाथमात्मसंधानचक्षुषा । स्वभक्तानुग्रहकरं मृगव्याधस्वरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: apaśyacca jagannāthamātmasaṃdhānacakṣuṣā / svabhaktānugrahakaraṃ mṛgavyādhasvarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Raised up by the creator of the universe himself with his own hands, the scion of the family of Bhrgu eulogised the lord of the chiefs of the Devas, standing in front of him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: चकार मर्देलाकारानंभो राशींस्तु सप्त ते । प्रभूतमद्देलध्वाने: पूरयामासुर बरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Raised up by the creator of the universe himself with his own hands, the scion of the family of Bhrgu eulogised the lord of the chiefs of the Devas, standing in front of him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Raised up by the creator of the universe himself with his own hands, the scion of the family of Bhrgu eulogised the lord of the chiefs of the Devas, standing in front of him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: तत उन्मील्य नयने शीघ्रमुत्थाय भार्गवः । ददर्श देवं तेनैव वपुषा पुरतः स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tata unmīlya nayane śīghramutthāya bhārgavaḥ / dadarśa devaṃ tenaiva vapuṣā purataḥ sthitam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the lord of the Devas, to Sankara of primordial form. Obeisance to Sarva, the quiescent oney obeisance, obeisance to the eternal one.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the lord of the Devas, to Sankara of primordial form. Obeisance to Sarva, the quiescent oney obeisance, obeisance to the eternal one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the lord of the Devas, to Sankara of primordial form. Obeisance to Sarva, the quiescent oney obeisance, obeisance to the eternal one.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनो ऽनुग्रहार्थाय शरण्यं भक्तवत्सलम् । आविर्भूतं महाराज दृष्ट्वा रामः ससंभ्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ātmano 'nugrahārthāya śaraṇyaṃ bhaktavatsalam / āvirbhūtaṃ mahārāja dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ sasaṃbhramam
verses.translation: Hail to you the blue-throated Lord, one in the form of Nilalohita (the bluish-red god). Obeisance to you the lord of the living beings. Bow to you, the abode of all living beings.
verses.hindi: आनकाः पणवाश्चेव गोमु खाश्चार्धच द्विकाः । यवमध्या मुष्टिमध्या मद््देलाडिडिमा अपि
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to you the blue-throated Lord, one in the form of Nilalohita (the bluish-red god). Obeisance to you the lord of the living beings. Bow to you, the abode of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to you the blue-throated Lord, one in the form of Nilalohita (the bluish-red god). Obeisance to you the lord of the living beings. Bow to you, the abode of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: रोमाञ्छोद्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो हर्षाश्रुप्लुतलोचनः । पपात पादयोर्भूमौ भक्त्या तस्य महामतिः
verses.transliteration: romāñchodbhinnasarvāṅgo harṣāśruplutalocanaḥ / papāta pādayorbhūmau bhaktyā tasya mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to the great lord of manifest and unmanifest form. Obeisance to the most bountiful, to Siva of many forms. Obeisance to the three-eyed God.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to the great lord of manifest and unmanifest form. Obeisance to the most bountiful, to Siva of many forms. Obeisance to the three-eyed God.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to the great lord of manifest and unmanifest form. Obeisance to the most bountiful, to Siva of many forms. Obeisance to the three-eyed God.

verses.sanskrit: स गद्गदमुवाचैनं संभ्रमाकुलया गिरा । शरणं भव शर्वेति शङ्करेत्यसकृन्नृप
verses.transliteration: sa gadgadamuvācainaṃ saṃbhramākulayā girā / śaraṇaṃ bhava śarveti śaṅkaretyasakṛnnṛpa
verses.translation: Be my shelter and refuge, O Sarva I am your devotee, O lord of the Universe. Mostly, you alone are the greatest and ultimate resort of those who have no other support.
verses.hindi: हु कारा काकतुण्डाश्च वाद्यभेदास्तथापरे । दध्वनुः शक्तिसेनाभिराहताः समरोद्यमे
verses.wordMeaning: Be my shelter and refuge, O Sarva I am your devotee, O lord of the Universe. Mostly, you alone are the greatest and ultimate resort of those who have no other support.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be my shelter and refuge, O Sarva I am your devotee, O lord of the Universe. Mostly, you alone are the greatest and ultimate resort of those who have no other support.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वरुपधृक् शंभुस्तद्भक्तिपरितोषितः । राममुत्थापयामास प्रणा मावनतं भुवि
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svarupadhṛk śaṃbhustadbhaktiparitoṣitaḥ / rāmamutthāpayāmāsa praṇā māvanataṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: Unknowingly, O lord, I have misbehaved towards you. O Sankara, I have uttered evil words. O lord, it behoves, you to forgive it.
verses.hindi: संपत्करी नाम देवी चचाल सह शक्तिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Unknowingly, O lord, I have misbehaved towards you. O Sankara, I have uttered evil words. O lord, it behoves, you to forgive it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unknowingly, O lord, I have misbehaved towards you. O Sankara, I have uttered evil words. O lord, it behoves, you to forgive it.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थापितो जगद्धात्रा स्वहस्ताभ्यां भृगूद्वहः । तुष्टाव देवदेवेशं पुरः स्थित्वा कृताजलिः
verses.transliteration: utthāpito jagaddhātrā svahastābhyāṃ bhṛgūdvahaḥ / tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ puraḥ sthitvā kṛtājaliḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O Sankara, be pleased with me in every respect. I have no other goal to reach. Obeisance to you. My repeated obeisance, bows unto you again and again."
verses.hindi: इसके अनभ्तर बह जगतो को माता परमेश्वरो ललिता तीनों लोकों के कण्टक भण्ड दय को जीतने के लिए वहां से विर्गत हुई थी ।१। बढ़ा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Sankara, be pleased with me in every respect. I have no other goal to reach. Obeisance to you. My repeated obeisance, bows unto you again and again."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Sankara, be pleased with me in every respect. I have no other goal to reach. Obeisance to you. My repeated obeisance, bows unto you again and again."

verses.sanskrit: राम उवाच नमस्ते देवदेवाय शङ्करायादिमूर्त्तये । नमः शर्वाय शान्ताय शाश्वताय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: rāma uvāca namaste devadevāya śaṅkarāyādimūrttaye / namaḥ śarvāya śāntāya śāśvatāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: On being eulogised thus, Lord Siva who was delighted in his mind and who has permeated the Universe said to Rama who was standing in front of him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: हुआ जो मदुर्दलों का घोष था उसने उससे आकाश को मी पूरित कर दिया था ।२। मृदंग-मुरज-पटह-अनुकुली गण-सेलुका-झल्लरी-रप्चा-हुडुका-हुण्ड्क घटा-आनक-पणव-गोमुख-अ्धे चन्द्रिका-तममध्य मद्दंख-डिण्डिम - स्थ र- बरीत-इ ग्यातिग्य भेदज-उद्धक-एड हुण्ड-निःसाण-बबरहुकार-काकतुण्ड
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogised thus, Lord Siva who was delighted in his mind and who has permeated the Universe said to Rama who was standing in front of him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogised thus, Lord Siva who was delighted in his mind and who has permeated the Universe said to Rama who was standing in front of him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते नीलकण्ठाय नीललोहितमूर्त्तये । नमस्ते भूतनाथाय भूतवासाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namaste nīlakaṇṭhāya nīlalohitamūrttaye / namaste bhūtanāthāya bhūtavāsāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: "I am pleased with you, O dear one. O the most excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu, I am delighted with this penance as well as your devotion that has no blemish whatsoever.
verses.hindi: तथा ये सब वाद्य और अन्य वाद्यों को उस समर के आरम्भ में शक्ति की सेनाओं के द्वारा आहत किया गया था और ये सभी बजाये गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: "I am pleased with you, O dear one. O the most excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu, I am delighted with this penance as well as your devotion that has no blemish whatsoever.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am pleased with you, O dear one. O the most excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu, I am delighted with this penance as well as your devotion that has no blemish whatsoever.

verses.sanskrit: व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपाय महादेवाय मीढुषे । शिवाय बहुरूपाय त्रिनेत्राय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: vyaktāvyaktasvarūpāya mahādevāya mīḍhuṣe / śivāya bahurūpāya trinetrāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: I shall give you everything you desire and every- thing solicited by you. You arc the greatest devotee of mine. There is not ot in this respect at all.
verses.hindi: परमोशानी ललिता के अ कु शास्त्र से समुद्गता सम्पत्करी नाम की देवी अपनी शक्तियों के साथ चलित हो गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: I shall give you everything you desire and every- thing solicited by you. You arc the greatest devotee of mine. There is not ot in this respect at all.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall give you everything you desire and every- thing solicited by you. You arc the greatest devotee of mine. There is not ot in this respect at all.

verses.sanskrit: शरणं भव मे शर्व त्वद्भक्तस्य जगत्पते । भूयो ऽनन्याश्रयाणां तु त्वमेव हि परायणम्
verses.transliteration: śaraṇaṃ bhava me śarva tvadbhaktasya jagatpate / bhūyo 'nanyāśrayāṇāṃ tu tvameva hi parāyaṇam
verses.translation: After traversing the entire earth and purifying your body by taking holy baths in all the holy centres in the due order, you will acquire all the miraculous weapons.**
verses.wordMeaning: After traversing the entire earth and purifying your body by taking holy baths in all the holy centres in the due order, you will acquire all the miraculous weapons.**
verses.commentary: Sense: After traversing the entire earth and purifying your body by taking holy baths in all the holy centres in the due order, you will acquire all the miraculous weapons.**

verses.sanskrit: यन्मयापकृतं देव दुरुक्तं वापि शङ्कर । अजानता त्वां भगवन्मम तत्क्षन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: yanmayāpakṛtaṃ deva duruktaṃ vāpi śaṅkara / ajānatā tvāṃ bhagavanmama tatkṣantumarhasi
verses.translation: When the lord of the universe disappeared, R&ma bowed down to Sankara and decided to perform holy baths in sacred places, after roaming all over the Earth.
verses.wordMeaning: When the lord of the universe disappeared, R&ma bowed down to Sankara and decided to perform holy baths in sacred places, after roaming all over the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord of the universe disappeared, R&ma bowed down to Sankara and decided to perform holy baths in sacred places, after roaming all over the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यवेद्यरुपस्य सद्भावमिहकः पुमान् । त्वामृते तव सर्वेश सम्यक् शक्रोति वेदितुम्
verses.transliteration: ananyavedyarupasya sadbhāvamihakaḥ pumān / tvāmṛte tava sarveśa samyak śakroti veditum
verses.translation: Thereafter, he traversed all over the earth in due order. Self-possessed that he was, he took holy baths in all the sacred places in accordance with the injunction.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he traversed all over the earth in due order. Self-possessed that he was, he took holy baths in all the sacred places in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he traversed all over the earth in due order. Self-possessed that he was, he took holy baths in all the sacred places in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वं सर्वभावेन प्रसीद मम शङ्कर । नान्यास्ति मे गतिस्तुभ्यं नमो भूयो नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvaṃ sarvabhāvena prasīda mama śaṅkara / nānyāsti me gatistubhyaṃ namo bhūyo namo namaḥ
verses.translation: In all the holy centres, in all the important shrines and sacred temples, he untiringly propitiated the Pitrs and Devos duly.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the holy centres, in all the important shrines and sacred temples, he untiringly propitiated the Pitrs and Devos duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the holy centres, in all the important shrines and sacred temples, he untiringly propitiated the Pitrs and Devos duly.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इति संस्तूयमानस्तु कृताञ्जलिपुटं पुरः । तिष्ठन्तमाह भगवान्प्रसन्नात्मा जगन्मयः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca iti saṃstūyamānastu kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ puraḥ / tiṣṭhantamāha bhagavānprasannātmā jaganmayaḥ
verses.translation: Duly performing such holy rites as fast, penance, homos, japas, holy baths etc. in the holy centres he travelled all over the earth.
verses.wordMeaning: Duly performing such holy rites as fast, penance, homos, japas, holy baths etc. in the holy centres he travelled all over the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Duly performing such holy rites as fast, penance, homos, japas, holy baths etc. in the holy centres he travelled all over the earth.

verses.sanskrit: भगवानुवाच प्रीतो ऽस्मि भवते तात तपसानेन सांप्रतम् । भक्त्या चैवानपायिन्या ह्यपि भार्गवसत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhagavānuvāca prīto 'smi bhavate tāta tapasānena sāṃpratam / bhaktyā caivānapāyinyā hyapi bhārgavasattama
verses.translation: By performing holy dips in the sacred centres in due order, and slowly circumambulating the earth,* O king, he became purified in his body.
verses.wordMeaning: By performing holy dips in the sacred centres in due order, and slowly circumambulating the earth,* O king, he became purified in his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing holy dips in the sacred centres in due order, and slowly circumambulating the earth,* O king, he became purified in his body.

verses.sanskrit: दास्ये चाभि मतं सवे भवते ऽहं त्वया वृतम् । भक्तो हि मे त्वमत्यर्थं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: dāsye cābhi mataṃ save bhavate 'haṃ tvayā vṛtam / bhakto hi me tvamatyarthaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Having traversed thus all over the earth at the behest of god Sainbhu, the descendant of Bhrgu went again to that land where he had been living before for penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Having traversed thus all over the earth at the behest of god Sainbhu, the descendant of Bhrgu went again to that land where he had been living before for penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having traversed thus all over the earth at the behest of god Sainbhu, the descendant of Bhrgu went again to that land where he had been living before for penance.

verses.sanskrit: मयैवावगतं सर्वं त्दृदि वत्ते ऽद्यवर्त्तते । तस्माद्ब्रवीमि यत्त्वाहं तत्कुरुष्वाविशङ्कितम्
verses.transliteration: mayaivāvagataṃ sarvaṃ tdṛdi vatte 'dyavarttate / tasmādbravīmi yattvāhaṃ tatkuruṣvāviśaṅkitam
verses.translation: After going there, O king, and staying there itself, he devoutly worshipped lord Umapati (the spouse of Uma) by means of austerities and holy observances.
verses.wordMeaning: After going there, O king, and staying there itself, he devoutly worshipped lord Umapati (the spouse of Uma) by means of austerities and holy observances.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going there, O king, and staying there itself, he devoutly worshipped lord Umapati (the spouse of Uma) by means of austerities and holy observances.

verses.sanskrit: नास्त्राणां धारणे वत्स विद्यते शक्तिरद्य ते । रौद्राणां तेन भूयो ऽपि तपो घोरं समाचर
verses.transliteration: nāstrāṇāṃ dhāraṇe vatsa vidyate śaktiradya te / raudrāṇāṃ tena bhūyo 'pi tapo ghoraṃ samācara
verses.translation: Thereupon, the excessively powerful Asuras defeated the gods and acquired the glory and riches of the Devas. They had nothing to fear from anywhere.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the excessively powerful Asuras defeated the gods and acquired the glory and riches of the Devas. They had nothing to fear from anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the excessively powerful Asuras defeated the gods and acquired the glory and riches of the Devas. They had nothing to fear from anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: परीत्य पृथिवीं सर्वां सर्वतीर्थेषु च क्रमात् । स्रात्वा पवित्रदेहस्त्तवं सर्वाण्यस्त्राण्यवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: parītya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu ca kramāt / srātvā pavitradehasttavaṃ sarvāṇyastrāṇyavāpsyasi
verses.translation: The Devas who had been defeated in the war — Vasava (Indra) and all the others whose assets and magnificent glory had been seized by their enemies — sought refuge in oankara.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who had been defeated in the war — Vasava (Indra) and all the others whose assets and magnificent glory had been seized by their enemies — sought refuge in oankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who had been defeated in the war — Vasava (Indra) and all the others whose assets and magnificent glory had been seized by their enemies — sought refuge in oankara.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवस्तेनैव वपुषा विभुः । रामस्य पश्यतो राजन्क्षणेन भवभागकृत्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvāntardadhe devastenaiva vapuṣā vibhuḥ / rāmasya paśyato rājankṣaṇena bhavabhāgakṛt
verses.translation: After propitiating the lord of the universe by means of obeisances and eulogies about his victory, the Devas re- quested the Pinaka-wielding lord (Siva) to destroy the Asuras.
verses.hindi: अनेकों करोड़ गज--अश्व ओर रथों की पंक्तियों के द्वारा सेबित सम्पदीश्वरो तरुण सूये के समान पाटल थी ।८। शेल के सहश मत्त सुदण्ड संग्राम में रसिक रण कोलाहल तामक एक गज पर बह समा रूढ़ हुई थी ।९। परम घोर राग बाली बड़ी भारी. सेना उसके पीछे अनुगमन करने
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating the lord of the universe by means of obeisances and eulogies about his victory, the Devas re- quested the Pinaka-wielding lord (Siva) to destroy the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating the lord of the universe by means of obeisances and eulogies about his victory, the Devas re- quested the Pinaka-wielding lord (Siva) to destroy the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हिते जगन्नाथे रामो नत्वा तु शङ्करम् । परीत्यवसुधां सर्वां तीर्थस्नाने ऽकरोन्मनः
verses.transliteration: antarhite jagannāthe rāmo natvā tu śaṅkaram / parītyavasudhāṃ sarvāṃ tīrthasnāne 'karonmanaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, O king, Sambhu, the bestower of boons on the Devas, promised to them the slaughter of the Danavas, and spoke thus to Mahodara.
verses.hindi: बाली थो ओर परम चञ्चल केलुओ की मालाओं से वह सेना घनों को उल्लिसित करती हुई जा रही थी।१०। उस सम्पदा की स्वामिनी का पीन
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, O king, Sambhu, the bestower of boons on the Devas, promised to them the slaughter of the Danavas, and spoke thus to Mahodara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, O king, Sambhu, the bestower of boons on the Devas, promised to them the slaughter of the Danavas, and spoke thus to Mahodara.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स पृथिवीं सर्वां परिक्रम्य यथाक्रमम् । चकार सर्वतीर्थेषु स्नानं विधिवदात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ parikramya yathākramam / cakāra sarvatīrtheṣu snānaṃ vidhivadātmavān
verses.translation: "In the southern sector of Himalayas, a sage's son of great penance, named Rama, is performing penance directed towards me. He is very brilliant.
verses.wordMeaning: "In the southern sector of Himalayas, a sage's son of great penance, named Rama, is performing penance directed towards me. He is very brilliant.
verses.commentary: Sense: "In the southern sector of Himalayas, a sage's son of great penance, named Rama, is performing penance directed towards me. He is very brilliant.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थेषु क्षेत्रमुख्येषु तथा देवालयेषु च । पितॄन्देवांश्च विधिवदतर्पयदतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: tīrtheṣu kṣetramukhyeṣu tathā devālayeṣu ca / pitṝndevāṃśca vidhivadatarpayadatandritaḥ
verses.translation: Go there now itself, O Mahodara and convey my behest to him. Even as he is performing penance, let him be brought here without delay".
verses.hindi: (स्थुल) स्तनों में सुसंकट घन के समान कंटक वक्ष: स्थल में स्थित शोभित हो रहा था ।११। उसके कर में घरी हुई कापती हुई खड्गलता शोभायुक्त हो रही थी जो काल नाथ की परम भयंकर कुटिला भूकुटी के ही समान थी ।१२। उत्वातों के बात की सम्पात बालो चलायमान पतों के ही सहश
verses.wordMeaning: Go there now itself, O Mahodara and convey my behest to him. Even as he is performing penance, let him be brought here without delay".
verses.commentary: Sense: Go there now itself, O Mahodara and convey my behest to him. Even as he is performing penance, let him be brought here without delay".

verses.sanskrit: उपवासतपोहोमजपस्नानादिसुक्रियाः । तीर्थेषु विधिवत्कुर्वन्परिचक्राम मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration: upavāsatapohomajapasnānādisukriyāḥ / tīrtheṣu vidhivatkurvanparicakrāma medinīm
verses.translation: On being ordered thus, Mahodara bowed down to the lord after saying "So be it", and went with the velocity of the Wind to the place where Rama was settled down.
verses.hindi: करोड़ों की संख्या वाले उत्तम कुञ्जर उस सम्पत्करी के पीछे अनुगमन करने वाले थे ।१३। इसके अनन्तर श्रीललिता देवी के श्रीपाशायुध से
verses.wordMeaning: On being ordered thus, Mahodara bowed down to the lord after saying "So be it", and went with the velocity of the Wind to the place where Rama was settled down.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being ordered thus, Mahodara bowed down to the lord after saying "So be it", and went with the velocity of the Wind to the place where Rama was settled down.

verses.sanskrit: एवं क्रमेण तीर्थेषु स्नात्वा चैव वसुंधराम् । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य शनैः शुद्धदेहो ऽभवन्नृप
verses.transliteration: evaṃ krameṇa tīrtheṣu snātvā caiva vasuṃdharām / pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śanaiḥ śuddhadeho 'bhavannṛpa
verses.translation: After reaching that spot and seeing Rama the great sage performing penance, he humbly spoke these words.
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching that spot and seeing Rama the great sage performing penance, he humbly spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching that spot and seeing Rama the great sage performing penance, he humbly spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: परीत्यैवं वसुमतीं भार्गवः शंभुशासनात् । जगाम् भूयस्तं देशं यत्र पूर्वमुवास सः
verses.transliteration: parītyaivaṃ vasumatīṃ bhārgavaḥ śaṃbhuśāsanāt / jagām bhūyastaṃ deśaṃ yatra pūrvamuvāsa saḥ
verses.translation: "O excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu lord Sambhu wishes to see you. I have come here at his behest. Hence, come to the presence of his lotus-like feet".
verses.wordMeaning: "O excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu lord Sambhu wishes to see you. I have come here at his behest. Hence, come to the presence of his lotus-like feet".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu lord Sambhu wishes to see you. I have come here at his behest. Hence, come to the presence of his lotus-like feet".

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा राजन्सतत्रैव स्थित्वा देवमुमापतिम् । भक्त्या संपूजयामास तपोभिर्न्नियमैरपि
verses.transliteration: gatvā rājansatatraiva sthitvā devamumāpatim / bhaktyā saṃpūjayāmāsa tapobhirnniyamairapi
verses.translation: On hearing his woids, Bhargava got up quickly, received his behest approvingly with his head (bowed down), and replied — "So be it'*.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his woids, Bhargava got up quickly, received his behest approvingly with his head (bowed down), and replied — "So be it'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his woids, Bhargava got up quickly, received his behest approvingly with his head (bowed down), and replied — "So be it'*.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवानामसुरैः सह । बभूव सुचिरं राजन्संग्रामो रोमहर्षणः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu devānāmasuraiḥ saha / babhūva suciraṃ rājansaṃgrāmo romaharṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, Mahodara with great speed led Rama immediately to a place by the side of Sambhu on the Kailasa, the excellent mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Mahodara with great speed led Rama immediately to a place by the side of Sambhu on the Kailasa, the excellent mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, Mahodara with great speed led Rama immediately to a place by the side of Sambhu on the Kailasa, the excellent mountain.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवान्पराजित्य युद्धे ऽतिबलिनो ऽसुराः । अवापुरमरैश्वर्यमशेषमकुतोभयाः
verses.transliteration: tato devānparājitya yuddhe 'tibalino 'surāḥ / avāpuramaraiśvaryamaśeṣamakutobhayāḥ
verses.translation: The most excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu saw Sankara who endears himself to his devotees, accompanied bv the goblins as well as Indra and other immortal beings (i.e. gods).
verses.wordMeaning: The most excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu saw Sankara who endears himself to his devotees, accompanied bv the goblins as well as Indra and other immortal beings (i.e. gods).
verses.commentary: Sense: The most excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu saw Sankara who endears himself to his devotees, accompanied bv the goblins as well as Indra and other immortal beings (i.e. gods).

verses.sanskrit: युद्धे पराजिता देवाः सकला वासवादयः । शङ्करं शरणं चग्मुर्हतैश्वर्या ह्यरातिभिः
verses.transliteration: yuddhe parājitā devāḥ sakalā vāsavādayaḥ / śaṅkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ cagmurhataiśvaryā hyarātibhiḥ
verses.translation: The lord was being eulogised by Narad a and other ascetics whose wealth was penance. He was being attended upon by the Gandharvas who were singing, and by the groups of Apsaras who were dancing. The lord of the Dcvas had the hide of an elephant for his garment and had smeared the entire body with the holy ashes. The three-eyed moon-crcstcd lord had the tawny-matted hair over his head. He had adorned himself with serpents serving the purpose of ornaments. His lips and arms were long. He was gentle. His lotus-like face appeared delighted. O king, he was seated on a golden slap in the midst of the assembly of the Devas.
verses.hindi: उस देवी के साथ ऐसी सेना थी जिसमें प्रायः अश्‍व थे जितकी हिनहिनाहट से वह तरज्ञिंत थी । उन अश्वं के खुरों की टापों से सम्पूर्ण महीतल विदीर्ण हो रहा था । ऐसी सेना चली थी ।१४। उस सेना में विभिन्न प्रकार की जाति के अश्‍व विद्यमान ये । उनमें बनायुज-काम्बोज-
verses.wordMeaning: The lord was being eulogised by Narad a and other ascetics whose wealth was penance. He was being attended upon by the Gandharvas who were singing, and by the groups of Apsaras who were dancing.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord was being eulogised by Narad a and other ascetics whose wealth was penance. He was being attended upon by the Gandharvas who were singing, and by the groups of Apsaras who were dancing.…

verses.sanskrit: तोषयित्वा जगन्नाथं प्रणामजय संस्तवैः । प्रार्थयामासुरसुरान्हन्तुं देवाः पिनाकिनम्
verses.transliteration: toṣayitvā jagannāthaṃ praṇāmajaya saṃstavaiḥ / prārthayāmāsurasurānhantuṃ devāḥ pinākinam
verses.translation: "These Girvanas (Devas) have been attacked by the hosts of Daityas. They were dislodged from their abodes. Unable to kill them they have approached me.
verses.hindi: पारद--सिल्धु देश में उतपनन होने बाले-टकण-पर्वतीय-पारसीक ये
verses.wordMeaning: "These Girvanas (Devas) have been attacked by the hosts of Daityas. They were dislodged from their abodes. Unable to kill them they have approached me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "These Girvanas (Devas) have been attacked by the hosts of Daityas. They were dislodged from their abodes. Unable to kill them they have approached me.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषां प्रतिश्रुत्य दानवानां वधं नृप । देवानां वरदः शंभुर्महो दरमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣāṃ pratiśrutya dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ nṛpa / devānāṃ varadaḥ śaṃbhurmaho daramuvāca ha
verses.translation: Hence, at my behest as well as with a desire to do
verses.hindi: हूय थे ।१७। उन अश्वों में कुछ प्राम्देशज थ करात तथा भ्रान्त देशोद्भव
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, at my behest as well as with a desire to do
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, at my behest as well as with a desire to do

verses.sanskrit: हिमद्रेर्दक्षिणे भागे रामो नाम महातपाः । मुनिपुत्रो ऽतितेजस्वी मामुद्दिश्य तपस्यति
verses.transliteration: himadrerdakṣiṇe bhāge rāmo nāma mahātapāḥ / muniputro 'titejasvī māmuddiśya tapasyati
verses.translation: Then Rama bowed down to Sarva. Even as all the Devas stood listening, Rama spoke these words very humbly, with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: २९७  ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण थे । ये सब अश्व बड़े ही विनोत-अच्छी तरह से वहन करने वाले-वेगगति से समन्वित और स्थिर चित्तों बाले थो ।१८। वे अश्व सभी ऐसे थो जो अपने स्वामी के मन का भाव जानने वाले थे और महान् युद्ध में परम
verses.wordMeaning: Then Rama bowed down to Sarva. Even as all the Devas stood listening, Rama spoke these words very humbly, with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Rama bowed down to Sarva. Even as all the Devas stood listening, Rama spoke these words very humbly, with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वात्वमद्यैव निवेद्य मम शासनम् । महोदर तपस्यन्तं तमिहानय माचिरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvātvamadyaiva nivedya mama śāsanam / mahodara tapasyantaṃ tamihānaya māciram
verses.translation: "O lord, you are omniscient. You are the immanent soul of everyone. Hence, is not (what I am going to say) known to you (already)? Still, listen to the words I submit.
verses.hindi: सहिष्णु रहने वाले थे । उनमें बहुत से अच्छे-अच्छे लक्षण विद्यमान थो तथा ये सभी क्रोध को जीत लेने बाले ओर परमाधिक परिश्रमी थे
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, you are omniscient. You are the immanent soul of everyone. Hence, is not (what I am going to say) known to you (already)? Still, listen to the words I submit.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, you are omniscient. You are the immanent soul of everyone. Hence, is not (what I am going to say) known to you (already)? Still, listen to the words I submit.

verses.sanskrit: इत्याज्ञप्रस्तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रणभ्येशं महोदरः । जगाम वायुवेगेन यत्र रामो व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: ityājñaprastathetyuktvā praṇabhyeśaṃ mahodaraḥ / jagāma vāyuvegena yatra rāmo vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: I am ignorant of miraculous missiles, O lord of the Devas. I am not an expert in warfare. How can I kill all the enemies of the Devas without any weapon whatsoever?"
verses.hindi: पञ्च धाराओं में शिक्षित-विनीत और प्लवन से संयुत थो ।२०। ये फल क्ति की श्री से सम्पन्न तथा श्वेत शुक्ति से समन्बि ये । उनमें देव प्च
verses.wordMeaning: I am ignorant of miraculous missiles, O lord of the Devas. I am not an expert in warfare. How can I kill all the enemies of the Devas without any weapon whatsoever?"
verses.commentary: Sense: I am ignorant of miraculous missiles, O lord of the Devas. I am not an expert in warfare. How can I kill all the enemies of the Devas without any weapon whatsoever?"

verses.sanskrit: समासाद्य स तं देशं दृष्ट्वा रामं महामुनिम् । तपस्यन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: samāsādya sa taṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ mahāmunim / tapasyantamidaṃ vākyamuvāca vinayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: On being told by him thus, the lord of the Devas transferred to that noble-soul ed Rama white lustrous splendour of Siva, full of miraculous missiles, as brilliant as the fire of Death.
verses.hindi: हैव मणि और देव स्वस्तिक ये सुम्दर लक्षण विद्यमान थे
verses.wordMeaning: On being told by him thus, the lord of the Devas transferred to that noble-soul ed Rama white lustrous splendour of Siva, full of miraculous missiles, as brilliant as the fire of Death.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told by him thus, the lord of the Devas transferred to that noble-soul ed Rama white lustrous splendour of Siva, full of miraculous missiles, as brilliant as the fire of Death.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुमिच्छति शम्भुस्त्वां भृगुवर्यं तदाज्ञया । आगतो ऽहं तदागच्छ तत्पादांबुजसन्निधिम्
verses.transliteration: draṣṭumicchati śambhustvāṃ bhṛguvaryaṃ tadājñayā / āgato 'haṃ tadāgaccha tatpādāṃbujasannidhim
verses.translation: After handing over his own axe that could overpower all other weapons, the Lord delighted within himself, said to Rama even as the Devas stood listening.
verses.wordMeaning: After handing over his own axe that could overpower all other weapons, the Lord delighted within himself, said to Rama even as the Devas stood listening.
verses.commentary: Sense: After handing over his own axe that could overpower all other weapons, the Lord delighted within himself, said to Rama even as the Devas stood listening.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य शीघ्रमुत्थाय भार्गवः । तदाज्ञां शिरसानन्द्य तथेति प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya śīghramutthāya bhārgavaḥ / tadājñāṃ śirasānandya tatheti pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: "Due to my grace, O gentle one, may there be sufficient power in you enabling you to kill all the enemies of the Devas, and be unassailable to all your enemies.
verses.wordMeaning: "Due to my grace, O gentle one, may there be sufficient power in you enabling you to kill all the enemies of the Devas, and be unassailable to all your enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Due to my grace, O gentle one, may there be sufficient power in you enabling you to kill all the enemies of the Devas, and be unassailable to all your enemies.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामं त्वरोपेतः शंभुपार्श्वं महोदरः । प्रापयामास सहसा कैलासे नागसत्तमे
verses.transliteration: tato rāmaṃ tvaropetaḥ śaṃbhupārśvaṃ mahodaraḥ / prāpayāmāsa sahasā kailāse nāgasattame
verses.translation: Go ahead with this weapon alone and fight with your enemies. You yourself will duly come to know and possess the skill in war."
verses.wordMeaning: Go ahead with this weapon alone and fight with your enemies. You yourself will duly come to know and possess the skill in war."
verses.commentary: Sense: Go ahead with this weapon alone and fight with your enemies. You yourself will duly come to know and possess the skill in war."

verses.sanskrit: सहितं सकलैर्भूतैरिन्द्राद्यैश्च सहामरैः । ददर्श भार्गवश्रेष्ठः शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम्
verses.transliteration: sahitaṃ sakalairbhūtairindrādyaiśca sahāmaraiḥ / dadarśa bhārgavaśreṣṭhaḥ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam
verses.translation: On being instructed thus by Sambhu, Rama bowed down to him, and accepted the axe pertaining to Siva, and was bent upon the slaughter of the enemies of the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: On being instructed thus by Sambhu, Rama bowed down to him, and accepted the axe pertaining to Siva, and was bent upon the slaughter of the enemies of the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being instructed thus by Sambhu, Rama bowed down to him, and accepted the axe pertaining to Siva, and was bent upon the slaughter of the enemies of the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तूयमानं मुनिभिर्नारदाद्यैस्तपोधनैः । गन्धर्वैरुपगायद्भिर्नृत्यद्भिश्चाप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: saṃstūyamānaṃ munibhirnāradādyaistapodhanaiḥ / gandharvairupagāyadbhirnṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Permitted by the three-eyed lord and accompanied
verses.wordMeaning: Permitted by the three-eyed lord and accompanied
verses.commentary: Sense: Permitted by the three-eyed lord and accompanied

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यमानं देवेशं गजचर्मधृताम्बरम् । भस्मोद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: upāsyamānaṃ deveśaṃ gajacarmadhṛtāmbaram / bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam
verses.translation: Thereupon, once again there broke out the war of the Devas with the Asuras, O king. They were endeavouring to conquer the three worlds. Hence the war was extremely terrible.
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त उनमें स्वस्तिक शुक्ति-गडुर ओर पुष्प गणिका-ये परम शुभ चिहन विद्यमान ये जो जय और राज्य के प्रदान कराने वाले थे। ऐसे अश्व गण थे जो बहन करने वाले-वायु के समान वेग वाले थे । ऐसे अश्व उस देवी के पीछे गमन करने बाले बे।२२। वह देवी एक ऐसे
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, once again there broke out the war of the Devas with the Asuras, O king. They were endeavouring to conquer the three worlds. Hence the war was extremely terrible.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, once again there broke out the war of the Devas with the Asuras, O king. They were endeavouring to conquer the three worlds. Hence the war was extremely terrible.

verses.sanskrit: धृतपिङ्गजटाभारं नागाभरमभूषितम् । प्रलम्बोष्ठभुजं सौम्यं प्रसन्नमुखपङ्कजम्
verses.transliteration: dhṛtapiṅgajaṭābhāraṃ nāgābharamabhūṣitam / pralamboṣṭhabhujaṃ saumyaṃ prasannamukhapaṅkajam
verses.translation: Killing the Daityas in thousands by means of strokes resembling the thunderbolt, the infuriated Rama moved about in the battlefield like another god of Death.
verses.hindi: अश्व समारूढ़ थी जो अत्यन्त तेजस्वी था और अपराजित उसका नाम था
verses.wordMeaning: Killing the Daityas in thousands by means of strokes resembling the thunderbolt, the infuriated Rama moved about in the battlefield like another god of Death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Killing the Daityas in thousands by means of strokes resembling the thunderbolt, the infuriated Rama moved about in the battlefield like another god of Death.

verses.sanskrit: आस्थितं काञ्चने पट्टे गीर्वाणसमितौ नृप । उपासर्पत्तु देवेशं भृगुवर्यः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: āsthitaṃ kāñcane paṭṭe gīrvāṇasamitau nṛpa / upāsarpattu deveśaṃ bhṛguvaryaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: After killing all the Daityas in a trice, Rama the most excellent one among those who strike (with a weapon) exterminated them and gratified all the Devas.
verses.hindi: सेना सहित विजय-यात्रा   २२९ एवं बड़ा चञ्चल था। उस अश्व का कलेवर बहुत ही ऊँचा था और उसके मुख में लगाम शोभित हो रती थी ।२३। उस अश्व के दोनों ओर केशरों का मण्डल स्फुरित हो रहा था । उसकी पूछ बहुत ही स्वूल थी जिसके
verses.wordMeaning: After killing all the Daityas in a trice, Rama the most excellent one among those who strike (with a weapon) exterminated them and gratified all the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing all the Daityas in a trice, Rama the most excellent one among those who strike (with a weapon) exterminated them and gratified all the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकण्ठदर्शनोद्वत्तरोमाञ्चाञ्चितविग्रहः । बाष्पत्तु सिक्तकायेन स तु गत्वा हरान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: śrīkaṇṭhadarśanodvattaromāñcāñcitavigrahaḥ / bāṣpattu siktakāyena sa tu gatvā harāntikam
verses.translation: Everyone among the Daityas and the Danavas was being struck at by Rama. '.Those who survived the slaughter saw Rama everywhere and became frightened.
verses.hindi: दिक्षेप से पयोधर क्षिप्पमाण हो रहे ये ।२४। जंघाओं के भाग में समुस्तद् मणियों को धीमी किन किनाहट की ध्वनि से भासुर था । उसके खुरों के निष्ठुर कुहनों से जो बहुत ही तेज थे वादन सा कर रहा वा ।२४। मानों ऐसा प्रतीत हो रहा था कि विजय की समृद्धि के ही लिए यह महान् वाद्य
verses.wordMeaning: Everyone among the Daityas and the Danavas was being struck at by Rama. '.Those who survived the slaughter saw Rama everywhere and became frightened.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyone among the Daityas and the Danavas was being struck at by Rama. '.Those who survived the slaughter saw Rama everywhere and became frightened.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या ससंभ्रमं वाचा हर्षगद्गदयासकृत् । नमस्ते देवदेवेति व्यालपन्नाकुलाक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā sasaṃbhramaṃ vācā harṣagadgadayāsakṛt / namaste devadeveti vyālapannākulākṣaram
verses.translation: When the entire hosts of the Asuras were either killed or routed, the Devas took leave of Rama and went again to the Heaven.
verses.hindi: बजाया जा रहा था बार-बार गति के क्रम से छोटा करता हुआ वह संदशित हो रहा था ।२६। चञ्चल पूछ जो उसकी बार-बार ऊपर की ओर
verses.wordMeaning: When the entire hosts of the Asuras were either killed or routed, the Devas took leave of Rama and went again to the Heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the entire hosts of the Asuras were either killed or routed, the Devas took leave of Rama and went again to the Heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पपात संस्पृशन्मूर्ध्ना चरणौ पुरविद्विषः । पश्यतां देववृन्दानां मध्ये भृगुकुलोद्वहम्
verses.transliteration: papāta saṃspṛśanmūrdhnā caraṇau puravidviṣaḥ / paśyatāṃ devavṛndānāṃ madhye bhṛgukulodvaham
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: जा रहे हों। वह अश्व मनोहर भाण्डों से युक्त था और ध्री के जाल से समलंकृत था ।२७। इनकी जो महाध्वनि हो रही थी उससे ऐसा प्रतीत हो रहा था मानों वह सभी अमुरों को हुंकार की तर्जना दे रही थी । यह महा देवी अश्व पर समारूढ़ होकर वहां से गमन कर रही थी
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तमुत्थाप्य शिवः प्रीतः प्रसन्नमुखपङ्कजम् । रामं मधुरया वाचा प्रहसन्नाह सादरम्
verses.transliteration: tamutthāpya śivaḥ prītaḥ prasannamukhapaṅkajam / rāmaṃ madhurayā vācā prahasannāha sādaram
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: इमे दैत्यगणैः क्रान्ताः स्वाधिष्ठानात्परिच्युताः । अशक्रुवन्तस्तान्हन्तुं गीर्वाणा मामुपागताः
verses.transliteration: ime daityagaṇaiḥ krāntāḥ svādhiṣṭhānātparicyutāḥ / aśakruvantastānhantuṃ gīrvāṇā māmupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्ममाज्ञया राम देवानां च प्रियेप्सया । जहि दैत्यगणान्सर्वान्समर्थस्त्वं हि मे मतः
verses.transliteration: tasmānmamājñayā rāma devānāṃ ca priyepsayā / jahi daityagaṇānsarvānsamarthastvaṃ hi me mataḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामो ऽब्रवीच्छर्वं प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः । शृण्वतां सर्वदेवानां सप्रश्रयमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration: tato rāmo 'bravīccharvaṃ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ / śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sapraśrayamidaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिन्न विदितं किं ते सर्वज्ञस्याखिलात्मनः । तथापि विज्ञापयतो वचनं मे ऽवधारय
verses.transliteration: svāminna viditaṃ kiṃ te sarvajñasyākhilātmanaḥ / tathāpi vijñāpayato vacanaṃ me 'vadhāraya
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: यदि शक्रादिभिर्देवैरखिलैरमरारयः । न शक्या हन्तुमेकस्य शक्याः स्यस्ते कथं मम
verses.transliteration: yadi śakrādibhirdevairakhilairamarārayaḥ / na śakyā hantumekasya śakyāḥ syaste kathaṃ mama
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: अनस्त्रज्ञो ऽस्मि देवेश युद्धानामप्यकोविदः । कथं हनिष्ये सकलान्सुरशत्रूननायुधः
verses.transliteration: anastrajño 'smi deveśa yuddhānāmapyakovidaḥ / kathaṃ haniṣye sakalānsuraśatrūnanāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तेन देवेशः सितं कालाग्निसप्रभम् । शैवमस्त्रमयं तेजो ददौ तस्मै महात्मने
verses.transliteration: ityuktastena deveśaḥ sitaṃ kālāgnisaprabham / śaivamastramayaṃ tejo dadau tasmai mahātmane
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मीयं परशुं दत्वा सर्वशस्त्राभिभावकम् । रामपाह प्रसन्नात्मा गीर्वाणानां तु शृण्वतम्
verses.transliteration: ātmīyaṃ paraśuṃ datvā sarvaśastrābhibhāvakam / rāmapāha prasannātmā gīrvāṇānāṃ tu śṛṇvatam
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसादेन सकलान्सुरशत्रून्विनिघ्नतः । शक्तिर्भवतु ते सौम्य समस्तारिदुरासदा
verses.transliteration: matprasādena sakalānsuraśatrūnvinighnataḥ / śaktirbhavatu te saumya samastāridurāsadā
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: अत्यधिक विक्रम की शोभा वाली वह महा देवी अपने चारों करों में पाश--अ कुश-नेन्र और अश्व की वल्गा को लिये हुईं थीं ।२६। तरुण सूर्य के समान जाज्वल्यमान चमकती हुई काञ्ची की तरङ्ग वाली वह अपने अश्व को नचाती हुई-सी अश्‍व पर समारूढ़ वह वहाँ से चली थी ।३०। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैवायुधेन त्वं गच्छ युध्यस्व शत्रुभिः । स्वयमेव च वेत्सि त्वं यथावद्युद्धकौशलम्
verses.transliteration: anenaivāyudhena tvaṃ gaccha yudhyasva śatrubhiḥ / svayameva ca vetsi tvaṃ yathāvadyuddhakauśalam
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: अनन्तर श्री दण्ड स्वामिनी की जो निर्माण के पटहकी ध्वनि हो रही थी बह परम उद्दण्ड सागर के घोष के हो समान थी जो कि सम्पूर्ण जगत् को वधिर कर रही थी ।३१। बहुत सी शक्तियां उसके आगे चल रही थीं जो कठोर वच्ञोपम वाणों के द्वारा दशों दिशाओं का विहनन कर रही थीं ।
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच एवमुक्तस्ततो रामः शंभुना तं प्रणम्य च । जग्राह परशुं शैव विबुधारिवधोद्यतः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca evamuktastato rāmaḥ śaṃbhunā taṃ praṇamya ca / jagrāha paraśuṃ śaiva vibudhārivadhodyataḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: उनकी भुजाए' अतीव उद्धत अशम के समान थीं और परम उच्छित कोई अद्भुत शक्तियाँ थी ।३२। कुछ शक्तियाँ उस श्री दण्ड नाया के सेना नासीर के साथ थीं । ये परम चण्ड शक्तियाँ खड्ग को और फलक को लेकर उछाल खा रही थीं ।३३। सैकड़ों ही नेत्रो के सम्ताइनों से उस सेना की जो सम्बाधा
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शुशुभे रामो विष्णुतेर्ञ्जो ऽशसंभवः । रुद्रभक्त्या समायुक्तो द्युत्येव सवितुर्महः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa śuśubhe rāmo viṣṇuterñjo 'śasaṃbhavaḥ / rudrabhaktyā samāyukto dyutyeva saviturmahaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: थी उसका क्षेत्रिणी निवारण करती हुई शक्तियाँ ऊपर की ओर चल रही चो ।३४। इसके पश्चात् ऐसी शक्तियाँ आगे चली थी जो तुझ ध्वजाओं की श्रेणी और महिष के चिन्हो वाली थां तथा शृगों के चिह्लो को और सिंह के अङ्गों को धारण करने वाली थीं।३५। इसके पश्चात् कुछ ऐसी शक्तियाँ थी
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽनुज्ञातस्त्रिनेत्रेण देवैः सर्वैः समन्वितः । जगाम हन्तुमसुरान्युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: so 'nujñātastrinetreṇa devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ / jagāma hantumasurānyuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: जो श्रीदण्ड नाथा के सहस्रं छत्रों को जो श्वेत थे धारण करके चल रहीं थीं जित छत्रों से उनके कर कमल स्फुरित हो रहे ये
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽभवत्पुनर्युद्धं देवानामसुरैः सह । त्रैलोक्यविजयोद्युक्तै राजन्नतिभयङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'bhavatpunaryuddhaṃ devānāmasuraiḥ saha / trailokyavijayodyuktai rājannatibhayaṅkaram
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रामो महाबाहुस्तस्मिन्युद्धे सुदारुणे । कुद्धः परशुना तेन निजघान महासुरान्
verses.transliteration: atha rāmo mahābāhustasminyuddhe sudāruṇe / kuddhaḥ paraśunā tena nijaghāna mahāsurān
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहारैरशनिप्रख्यैर्निघ्नन्दैत्यान्सहस्रशः । चचार समरे रामः क्रुद्धः काल इवापरः
verses.transliteration: prahārairaśaniprakhyairnighnandaityānsahasraśaḥ / cacāra samare rāmaḥ kruddhaḥ kāla ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा तु सकलान्दैत्यान्देवान्सर्वानहर्षयत् । क्षणेन नाशयामास रामः प्रहरतां वरः
verses.transliteration: hatvā tu sakalāndaityāndevānsarvānaharṣayat / kṣaṇena nāśayāmāsa rāmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: दहत्य इव हैत्यौचांस्तीक्णे मरगिणवहिनभिः । प्रचेलुदंडनाथायास्सेना नासीरधाविताः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: रामेण हन्यमा नास्तु समस्ता दैत्यदानवाः । ददृशुः सर्वतो रामं हतशेषा भयान्विताः
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa hanyamā nāstu samastā daityadānavāḥ / dadṛśuḥ sarvato rāmaṃ hataśeṣā bhayānvitāḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: हतेष्वसुरसंघेषु विद्रुतेषु च कृत्स्नशः । राममामन्त्र्य विबुधाः प्रययुस्त्रिदिवं पुनः
verses.transliteration: hateṣvasurasaṃgheṣu vidruteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ / rāmamāmantrya vibudhāḥ prayayustridivaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि हत्वा दितिजानभ्यनुज्ञाप्य चामरान् । स्वमाश्रमं समापेदे तपस्यासक्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi hatvā ditijānabhyanujñāpya cāmarān / svamāśramaṃ samāpede tapasyāsaktamānasaḥ
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: इस दण्डनाथा का जो विशेष निर्माण हुआ था उसमें संख्यातीत अर्थात् अगणित छत्र थे जिनकी श्वेत प्रभा थी। उनसे नभोण्डल ऐसा शोभित हो रहा था मानों उसमें अगणित चन्द्रमा उदित हो गये होवें ।१। वे परम धवल छत्र एक दूसरे से परस्पर में सट से रहे थे जिनसे उनका
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: मृगव्याधप्रतिकृतिं कृत्वा शम्भोर्महामतिः । भक्त्या संपूजयामास स तस्मिन्नाश्रमेवशी
verses.transliteration: mṛgavyādhapratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā śambhormahāmatiḥ / bhaktyā saṃpūjayāmāsa sa tasminnāśramevaśī
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: अन्तर बहुत ही घना हो गया था । उनके समुदाय में जो मणियाँ थीं उनकी कान्ति से अन्धकार का विनाश हो गया घा ।२। उस बल में वच्च की प्रभा को भी पराजित करने वाली कान्ति से समस्त दिशाओं के मुखों को पूरित करने वाले सैकड़ों ही प्रकार के क्रोड मुख्य ताल वृन्त चले थे ।३। उस
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा हृद्यैर्नैवेद्यैरभिवन्दनैः । स्तोत्रैश्च विधिवद्भक्त्या परां प्रीतिमुपानयत्
verses.transliteration: gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā hṛdyairnaivedyairabhivandanaiḥ / stotraiśca vidhivadbhaktyā parāṃ prītimupānayat
verses.translation: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.hindi: दण्डनाथा की सेनाए' नासीर रो धावित होती हुई वहाँ से चली थीं उसमें
