verses.wordMeaning: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the sons of Diti and bidding farewell to the Devas, Rama resorted to his hermitage with his mind attached to the activities of penance.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने चतुर्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ २४॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच ततस्त द्रक्तियोगेन स प्रीतात्मा जगत्पतिः । प्रत्यक्षमगमत्तस्य सर्वैः सह मरुद्गणैः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne caturviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 24// vasiṣṭha uvāca tatasta draktiyogena sa prītātmā jagatpatiḥ / pratyakṣamagamattasya sarvaiḥ saha marudgaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Rising up and bowing 'down his head several times, Rama eulogised the lord of the universe with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: में शूल लिये हुए ये । वे जलते हुए केशों के समान पिशंग आभा से समन्वित थे तथा तडित् के समान भासुर ये जिनसे सभी दिशाए” भी मासुर हो रही थीं। अपनी परम तीक्ष्ण बाणों की अग्नि से देत्यों के समूहों को दग्ध कर रहीं थीं ।४-५। इसके अनन्तर बहुत-सी शक्तिय! भी उसमें चं थीं जो
verses.wordMeaning: Rising up and bowing 'down his head several times, Rama eulogised the lord of the universe with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rising up and bowing 'down his head several times, Rama eulogised the lord of the universe with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रशेखरम् । वृषेन्द्रवाहनं शंभुं भूतकोटिसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam / vṛṣendravāhanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ bhūtakoṭisamanvitam
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you, O lord of the chiefs of the Devas. Hail to you O Paramesvara. Obeisance to you, O lord of the Universe. Bow to you, O destroyer of the three Puras.1
verses.hindi: पोत्री मुखो वाली थीं और उसी के समान आकृति और भूषणों से संयुत थी। उसी के समान उनके करों में आयुध ये तथा उसी के तुल्य उनके अपने बाहन भी ये ।६। उनकी बहुत तोदण दाढ" थी जिनसे बे वहिन और धूम को निकाल रहीं थी जिससे सम्पूर्ण आकाश परिवृत हो गया था।
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you, O lord of the chiefs of the Devas. Hail to you O Paramesvara. Obeisance to you, O lord of the Universe. Bow to you, O destroyer of the three Puras.1
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you, O lord of the chiefs of the Devas. Hail to you O Paramesvara. Obeisance to you, O lord of the Universe. Bow to you, O destroyer of the three Puras.1

verses.sanskrit: ससंभ्रमं समुत्थाय हर्षेणाकुललोचनः । प्रणाममकरोद्भक्त्या शर्वाय भुवि भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: sasaṃbhramaṃ samutthāya harṣeṇākulalocanaḥ / praṇāmamakarodbhaktyā śarvāya bhuvi bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: Salute to you O lord presiding over every thing. Obeisance to you, O lord endearing himself to his devotee s. Hail to you O lord of all living beings. Obeisance to you, O bull-bannered lord.
verses.hindi: तमाल वृक्ष के समान उनका श्यामल आकार था तथा कपिल और छूर नेत्रों वाली थीं
verses.wordMeaning: Salute to you O lord presiding over every thing. Obeisance to you, O lord endearing himself to his devotee s. Hail to you O lord of all living beings. Obeisance to you, O bull-bannered lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salute to you O lord presiding over every thing. Obeisance to you, O lord endearing himself to his devotee s. Hail to you O lord of all living beings. Obeisance to you, O bull-bannered lord.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थायोत्थाय देवेशं प्रणम्य शिरसासकृत् । कृताञ्जलिपुटो रामस्तुष्टाव च जगत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: utthāyotthāya deveśaṃ praṇamya śirasāsakṛt / kṛtāñjalipuṭo rāmastuṣṭāva ca jagatpatim
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the overlord of everything. Bow to you, O merciful lord. Obeisance to you, O abode of everyone, Obeisance to you, O Lord of bluish-red complexion.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the overlord of everything. Bow to you, O merciful lord. Obeisance to you, O abode of everyone, Obeisance to you, O Lord of bluish-red complexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the overlord of everything. Bow to you, O merciful lord. Obeisance to you, O abode of everyone, Obeisance to you, O Lord of bluish-red complexion.

verses.sanskrit: राम उवाच नमस्ते देवदेवेश नमस्ते परमेश्वर । नमस्ते जगतो नाथ नमस्ते त्रिपुरान्तक
verses.transliteration: rāma uvāca namaste devadeveśa namaste parameśvara / namaste jagato nātha namaste tripurāntaka
verses.translation: Obeisance to the trident-bearing lord, the destroyer of the hosts of the enemies of the Devas. Salute to you, Kapalin (one holding the skull), the sole protector of all the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the trident-bearing lord, the destroyer of the hosts of the enemies of the Devas. Salute to you, Kapalin (one holding the skull), the sole protector of all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the trident-bearing lord, the destroyer of the hosts of the enemies of the Devas. Salute to you, Kapalin (one holding the skull), the sole protector of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते सकलाध्यक्ष नमस्ते भक्तवत्सल । नमस्ते सर्वभूतेश नमस्ते वृषभध्वज
verses.transliteration: namaste sakalādhyakṣa namaste bhaktavatsala / namaste sarvabhūteśa namaste vṛṣabhadhvaja
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord who resides perpetually in the cremation ground; obeisance to the lord who dwells on the Kailasa mountain. Obeisance be to you, the wielder of the noose; Bow to the lord who swallowed poison KalakUta.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord who resides perpetually in the cremation ground; obeisance to the lord who dwells on the Kailasa mountain. Obeisance be to you, the wielder of the noose; Bow to the lord who swallowed poison KalakUta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord who resides perpetually in the cremation ground; obeisance to the lord who dwells on the Kailasa mountain. Obeisance be to you, the wielder of the noose; Bow to the lord who swallowed poison KalakUta.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते सकलाधीश नमस्ते करुणाकर । नमस्ते सकलावास नमस्ते नीललोहित
verses.transliteration: namaste sakalādhīśa namaste karuṇākara / namaste sakalāvāsa namaste nīlalohita
verses.translation: Obeisance to the all-pervading lord worthy of being saluted by the Devas. Hail to you, the self-born lord, obeisance to &ambhu who is the witness to the activities of the entire universe.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the all-pervading lord worthy of being saluted by the Devas. Hail to you, the self-born lord, obeisance to &ambhu who is the witness to the activities of the entire universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the all-pervading lord worthy of being saluted by the Devas. Hail to you, the self-born lord, obeisance to &ambhu who is the witness to the activities of the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: नमः सकलदेवारिगणनाशाय शूलिने । कपालिने नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वलोकैकपालिने
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sakaladevārigaṇanāśāya śūline / kapāline namastubhyaṃ sarvalokaikapāline
verses.translation: The three cities of gold, silver and iron in the sky, air and earth were built by Maya for demons. These were burnt down along with the demon-residents by god Siva. **
verses.wordMeaning: The three cities of gold, silver and iron in the sky, air and earth were built by Maya for demons. These were burnt down along with the demon-residents by god Siva. **
verses.commentary: Sense: The three cities of gold, silver and iron in the sky, air and earth were built by Maya for demons. These were burnt down along with the demon-residents by god Siva. **

verses.sanskrit: श्मशानवासिने नित्यं नमः कैलासवासिने । नमो ऽस्तु पाशिने तुभ्यं कालकूटविषाशिने
verses.transliteration: śmaśānavāsine nityaṃ namaḥ kailāsavāsine / namo 'stu pāśine tubhyaṃ kālakūṭaviṣāśine
verses.translation: Obeisance to the destroyer of the three demon cities. Obeisance to the annihilator of Daksa's sacrifice; obeis- ance to the lord whose broad chest is dyed with the saffron from the breasts of the daughter of the mountain Himalaya.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the destroyer of the three demon cities. Obeisance to the annihilator of Daksa's sacrifice; obeis- ance to the lord whose broad chest is dyed with the saffron from the breasts of the daughter of the mountain Himalaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the destroyer of the three demon cities. Obeisance to the annihilator of Daksa's sacrifice; obeis- ance to the lord whose broad chest is dyed with the saffron from the breasts of the daughter of the mountain Himalaya.

verses.sanskrit: विभवे ऽमरवन्द्याय प्रभवे ते स्वयंभुवे । नमो ऽखिलजगत्कर्मसाक्षिभूताय शंभवे
verses.transliteration: vibhave 'maravandyāya prabhave te svayaṃbhuve / namo 'khilajagatkarmasākṣibhūtāya śaṃbhave
verses.translation: Hail to the great lord Mahadeva; obeisance to you that have the elephant hide, for your robes. Bow to Siva whose form is meditated upon by the Yogins. Obeisance to the lord of inconceivable refulgence.
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the great lord Mahadeva; obeisance to you that have the elephant hide, for your robes. Bow to Siva whose form is meditated upon by the Yogins. Obeisance to the lord of inconceivable refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the great lord Mahadeva; obeisance to you that have the elephant hide, for your robes. Bow to Siva whose form is meditated upon by the Yogins. Obeisance to the lord of inconceivable refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्त्रिपथ गाफेनभासिगार्द्धन्दुमौलिने । महाभोगीन्द्रहाराय शिवाय परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: namastripatha gāphenabhāsigārddhandumauline / mahābhogīndrahārāya śivāya paramātmane
verses.translation: Obeisance to you that abide in the middle of the pericarp of the lotus-like heart of your own devotees. Bow to you that have the main principle, and essence of all the Vedas (and Agamas) as your form.
verses.hindi: उद्देगं बहुलं प्राप त्र लोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you that abide in the middle of the pericarp of the lotus-like heart of your own devotees. Bow to you that have the main principle, and essence of all the Vedas (and Agamas) as your form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you that abide in the middle of the pericarp of the lotus-like heart of your own devotees. Bow to you that have the main principle, and essence of all the Vedas (and Agamas) as your form.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मसंच्छन्नदेहाय नमोर्ऽकाग्नीन्दुचक्षुषे । कपर्दिने नमस्तुभ्यमन्धकासुरमर्द्दिने
verses.transliteration: bhasmasaṃcchannadehāya namor'kāgnīnducakṣuṣe / kapardine namastubhyamandhakāsuramarddine
verses.translation: Obeisance to the awakener of the leading Yogins. Hail to the nectar-souled one, obeisance to Sankara whose grandeur pervades everything. Bow to the Supreme Soul.
verses.hindi: कि वा मुसलघातेन भूमि द्वेधा करिष्यति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the awakener of the leading Yogins. Hail to the nectar-souled one, obeisance to Sankara whose grandeur pervades everything. Bow to the Supreme Soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the awakener of the leading Yogins. Hail to the nectar-souled one, obeisance to Sankara whose grandeur pervades everything. Bow to the Supreme Soul.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपुरध्वंसिने दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसिने नमः । गिरिजाकुचकाश्मीरविरञ्जितमहोरसे
verses.transliteration: tripuradhvaṃsine dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsine namaḥ / girijākucakāśmīravirañjitamahorase
verses.translation: Obeisance to Sarva the quiescent lord. The Brahman having the cosmic form. Obeisanee to the lord without begin- ning, middle and end; obeisance to the eternal lord of unmani- fest form.
verses.hindi: सूकर के समान जिनका मुख था ऐसी अनेक शक्तियां सहस्रो गहिषों पर समारूढ़ होकर वहाँ पर चली थीं । इसके अनन्तर वह श्रीदण्डनाथा देवी अपने करिचक्र उत्तम रथ से नीचे उतरीं औप अपने प्रमुख वाहन महासिंह के ऊपर समारूढ़ हो गयी थीं। उसका नाम बज्र घोर प्रसिद्ध था
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Sarva the quiescent lord. The Brahman having the cosmic form. Obeisanee to the lord without begin- ning, middle and end; obeisance to the eternal lord of unmani- fest form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Sarva the quiescent lord. The Brahman having the cosmic form. Obeisanee to the lord without begin- ning, middle and end; obeisance to the eternal lord of unmani- fest form.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवाय मह ते नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे । योगिध्येयस्वरूपाय शिवायाचिन्त्यतेजसे
verses.transliteration: mahādevāya maha te namaste kṛttivāsase / yogidhyeyasvarūpāya śivāyācintyatejase
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord whose feet are worshipped with flowers (as well as) heads of groups of Suras and Asuras. Obeisance to Srlkanfha, the creator of the universe. Repeated obeisance unto the maker of the worlds.
verses.hindi: जो अपने केसरों के मण्डल को कम्पित कर रहा या । इसका मुख खुला हुआ था तथा परम भीषण आकार वाला था एवं उसके लोचन विकट थे । वह अपनी दाढ़ों को कटकटा रहा था जिसकी कटकटा हट से सभी दिशाएं वधिरीभूत हो गयी थीं ।८-१०। उसकी अस्थियाँ आदि करम के
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord whose feet are worshipped with flowers (as well as) heads of groups of Suras and Asuras. Obeisance to Srlkanfha, the creator of the universe. Repeated obeisance unto the maker of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord whose feet are worshipped with flowers (as well as) heads of groups of Suras and Asuras. Obeisance to Srlkanfha, the creator of the universe. Repeated obeisance unto the maker of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभक्तहृदयांभोजकर्णिकामध्यवर्त्तिने । सकलागमसिद्धान्तसाररूपाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: svabhaktahṛdayāṃbhojakarṇikāmadhyavarttine / sakalāgamasiddhāntasārarūpāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the lord with the Rajas Guna in his heart while creating the Universe in the formofHiranyagarbha. Obeisance to Hara the primordial (lord and the cause of) the universe.
verses.hindi: सहश कठोर थीं और उसके नख खपंर के समान विशाल थे । जो पाताल तक निमञ्जित होकर इस भूमण्डल को पी से रहे थे ।११। यह तीन योजन तक ऊंचा था और बड़े वेग से अपनी पू'छ को हिला रहा था । ऐसे अपने सिह के वाहन पर समारूढ़ होकर वह महादेवी दण्ड नायिका चली थीं
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the lord with the Rajas Guna in his heart while creating the Universe in the formofHiranyagarbha. Obeisance to Hara the primordial (lord and the cause of) the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the lord with the Rajas Guna in his heart while creating the Universe in the formofHiranyagarbha. Obeisance to Hara the primordial (lord and the cause of) the universe.

verses.sanskrit: नमो निखिलयोगेन्द्रबोधनायामृतात्मने । शङ्करायाखिलव्याप्तमहिम्ने परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: namo nikhilayogendrabodhanāyāmṛtātmane / śaṅkarāyākhilavyāptamahimne paramātmane
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord who assumes transformation of the Tamas Guna while performing the duty of the annihilation of the Universe. Obeisance to the lord who has the form of Rudra at the end of the Kalpa. Obeisance to the lord who knows th t para and Apara (the great and non-great or remote to proximate).
verses.hindi: समस्त असुरों के संहार करने में जब वह श्रवृत्त हुई थी तो उस समय में उसकी क्रोध प्रज्वलित हो गया था ओर उसके प्रभाव से चराचर तीनों
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord who assumes transformation of the Tamas Guna while performing the duty of the annihilation of the Universe. Obeisance to the lord who has the form of Rudra at the end of the Kalpa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord who assumes transformation of the Tamas Guna while performing the duty of the annihilation of the Universe. Obeisance to the lord who has the form of Rudra at the end of the Kalpa.…

verses.sanskrit: नमः शर्वाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे विश्वरुपिणे । आदिमध्यान्तहीनाय नित्यायाव्यक्तमूर्त्तये
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śarvāya śāntāya brahmaṇe viśvarupiṇe / ādimadhyāntahīnāya nityāyāvyaktamūrttaye
verses.translation: Obeisance to the eternal lord without any change or transformation. Obeisance to the lord of the nature of Sat and Asat. Obeisance to the lord who awakens every intellect. Hail to the lord who causes changes in the intellect and sense-organs.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the eternal lord without any change or transformation. Obeisance to the lord of the nature of Sat and Asat. Obeisance to the lord who awakens every intellect. Hail to the lord who causes changes in the intellect and sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the eternal lord without any change or transformation. Obeisance to the lord of the nature of Sat and Asat. Obeisance to the lord who awakens every intellect. Hail to the lord who causes changes in the intellect and sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपाय स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मने नमः । नमो वेदान्तवेद्याय विश्वविज्ञानरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: vyaktāvyaktasvarūpāya sthūlasūkṣmātmane namaḥ / namo vedāntavedyāya viśvavijñānarūpiṇe
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to that lord by whose Maya the Devas have diverse minds [forms(?)] such as the Vasus, the Adityas, the Maruts, the Sadhyas, the Rudras and the Asvins.
verses.hindi: लोक बड़े भारी उद्वेग को प्राप्त हो गये ये ।१३। सभी लोग यह कह रहे ये किया यह पोत्रिणी अपने क्रोध से आज ही सबको दग्ध कर देगी अथवा अपने मुसस की चोट से इस भूमण्डल के दो टुकड़े कर देगी ?
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to that lord by whose Maya the Devas have diverse minds [forms(?)] such as the Vasus, the Adityas, the Maruts, the Sadhyas, the Rudras and the Asvins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to that lord by whose Maya the Devas have diverse minds [forms(?)] such as the Vasus, the Adityas, the Maruts, the Sadhyas, the Rudras and the Asvins.

verses.sanskrit: नमः सुरासुरश्रेणिमौलिपुष्पार्चिताङ्घ्रये । श्रीकण्ठाय जगद्धात्रे लोककर्त्रे नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ surāsuraśreṇimaulipuṣpārcitāṅghraye / śrīkaṇṭhāya jagaddhātre lokakartre namonamaḥ
verses.translation: You have an unborn, eternal subtle form that has no aberi ations and that is incomparable. Even the Yogins who are always devoid of impurities do not know that.
verses.wordMeaning: You have an unborn, eternal subtle form that has no aberi ations and that is incomparable. Even the Yogins who are always devoid of impurities do not know that.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have an unborn, eternal subtle form that has no aberi ations and that is incomparable. Even the Yogins who are always devoid of impurities do not know that.

verses.sanskrit: रजोगुणात्मने तुभ्यं विश्वसृष्टिविधायिने । हिरण्यगर्भरूपाय हराय जगदादये
verses.transliteration: rajoguṇātmane tubhyaṃ viśvasṛṣṭividhāyine / hiraṇyagarbharūpāya harāya jagadādaye
verses.translation: Whether a scholar or an irrational person, one conti- nues to wander in the worldly existence as long as one does not approach your feet since you alone are the destroyer of ignorance.
verses.wordMeaning: Whether a scholar or an irrational person, one conti- nues to wander in the worldly existence as long as one does not approach your feet since you alone are the destroyer of ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether a scholar or an irrational person, one conti- nues to wander in the worldly existence as long as one does not approach your feet since you alone are the destroyer of ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: नमो विश्वात्मने लोकस्थितिव्या पारकारिणे । सत्त्वविज्ञानरुपाय पराय प्रत्यगात्मने
verses.transliteration: namo viśvātmane lokasthitivyā pārakāriṇe / sattvavijñānarupāya parāya pratyagātmane
verses.translation: On account of its being extremely subtle, your exist- of the nature of the three Vedas is due to its extreme
verses.hindi: कानि द्वादशनामानि तस्या देव्या वद प्रभो । अश्वान महाप्राज्ञ येषु मे कोतुकं महत्
verses.wordMeaning: On account of its being extremely subtle, your exist- of the nature of the three Vedas is due to its extreme
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of its being extremely subtle, your exist- of the nature of the three Vedas is due to its extreme

verses.sanskrit: तमोगुणविकाराय जगत्संहारकारिणे । क्ल्पान्ते रुद्ररूपाय परापर विदे नमः
verses.transliteration: tamoguṇavikārāya jagatsaṃhārakāriṇe / klpānte rudrarūpāya parāpara vide namaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, though out of ignorance (i.e. Ignorant though I am) you have been eulogised by me with (genuine) devotion. O lord of the Devas, do become pleased. Indeed you are fond of your devotees and endear yourself to them".
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, though out of ignorance (i.e. Ignorant though I am) you have been eulogised by me with (genuine) devotion. O lord of the Devas, do become pleased. Indeed you are fond of your devotees and endear yourself to them".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, though out of ignorance (i.e. Ignorant though I am) you have been eulogised by me with (genuine) devotion. O lord of the Devas, do become pleased. Indeed you are fond of your devotees and endear yourself to them".

verses.sanskrit: अविकाराय नित्याय नमः सदसदात्मने । बुद्धिबुद्धिप्रबोधाय बुद्धीन्द्रियविकारिणे
verses.transliteration: avikārāya nityāya namaḥ sadasadātmane / buddhibuddhiprabodhāya buddhīndriyavikāriṇe
verses.translation: On being eulogised thus with great devotion by Rama, Sankara spoke to him smilingly with words deep and resonant like the rumble of the cloud.
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogised thus with great devotion by Rama, Sankara spoke to him smilingly with words deep and resonant like the rumble of the cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogised thus with great devotion by Rama, Sankara spoke to him smilingly with words deep and resonant like the rumble of the cloud.

verses.sanskrit: वस्वादित्यमरुद्भिश्च साध्यरुद्राश्विभेदतः । यन्मायाभिन्नमतयो देवास्तस्मै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: vasvādityamarudbhiśca sādhyarudrāśvibhedataḥ / yanmāyābhinnamatayo devāstasmai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: "O Rama, I am extremely pleased with the heroism you possess, your penance, your devotion towards me and particularly with this eulogy.
verses.hindi: तथा समयसंकेता वाराही पोत्रिणी तथा । वार्ताली च महासेनाप्याज्ञा चक्रेश्वरी तथा
verses.wordMeaning: "O Rama, I am extremely pleased with the heroism you possess, your penance, your devotion towards me and particularly with this eulogy.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Rama, I am extremely pleased with the heroism you possess, your penance, your devotion towards me and particularly with this eulogy.

verses.sanskrit: अविकारमजं नित्यं सूक्ष्मरूपमनौपमम् । तव यत्तन्न जानन्ति योगिनो ऽपि सदामलाः
verses.transliteration: avikāramajaṃ nityaṃ sūkṣmarūpamanaupamam / tava yattanna jānanti yogino 'pi sadāmalāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, do choose your boon. Whatever you wish mentally I shall bestow it upon you, without keeping back any thing'*.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, do choose your boon. Whatever you wish mentally I shall bestow it upon you, without keeping back any thing'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, do choose your boon. Whatever you wish mentally I shall bestow it upon you, without keeping back any thing'*.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामविज्ञाय दुर्ज्ञेयं सम्यग्ब्रह्मादयो ऽपि हि । संसरन्ति भवे नूनं न तत्कर्मात्मकाश्चिरम्
verses.transliteration: tvāmavijñāya durjñeyaṃ samyagbrahmādayo 'pi hi / saṃsaranti bhave nūnaṃ na tatkarmātmakāściram
verses.translation: On being told thus by the Lord of the Devas, O king, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu bowed down to him. With palms joined in reverence he spoke thus —
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by the Lord of the Devas, O king, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu bowed down to him. With palms joined in reverence he spoke thus —
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by the Lord of the Devas, O king, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu bowed down to him. With palms joined in reverence he spoke thus —

verses.sanskrit: यावन्नोपैति चरणौ तवाज्ञानविघातिनः । तावद्भ्रमति संसारे पण्डितो ऽचेतनो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: yāvannopaiti caraṇau tavājñānavighātinaḥ / tāvadbhramati saṃsāre paṇḍito 'cetano 'pi vā
verses.translation: "O lord if you are pleased and if I deserve a boon, then I wish to be endowed with all the miraculous missiles from you.
verses.hindi: अथवा यह अपने हल के निर्घात से समुद्रों को क्षुब्ध कर देगी । इस प्रकार से सभी स्वगे वासियों के गण डरे हुए हृदय बाले गयन मण्डल में संस्थित ये ।१५। बड़े ही त्रास के साथ शीघ्र ही दूर से विमानों के द्वारा गये हुओं ने देखा था । फिर उन देवगणों ने दोनों करों को जोड़कर उसके लिए
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord if you are pleased and if I deserve a boon, then I wish to be endowed with all the miraculous missiles from you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord if you are pleased and if I deserve a boon, then I wish to be endowed with all the miraculous missiles from you.

verses.sanskrit: स एव दक्षः स कृती स मुनिः स च पण्डितः । भवतश्चरणांभोजे येन बुद्धिः स्थिरीकृता
verses.transliteration: sa eva dakṣaḥ sa kṛtī sa muniḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ / bhavataścaraṇāṃbhoje yena buddhiḥ sthirīkṛtā
verses.translation: Due to your favour, there should not be anyone superior to me in miraculous missiles, weapons and in the sacred scriptures. There should not be anyone in all the worlds to defeat me in battles.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to your favour, there should not be anyone superior to me in miraculous missiles, weapons and in the sacred scriptures. There should not be anyone in all the worlds to defeat me in battles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to your favour, there should not be anyone superior to me in miraculous missiles, weapons and in the sacred scriptures. There should not be anyone in all the worlds to defeat me in battles.

verses.sanskrit: सुसूक्ष्मत्वेन गहनः सद्भावस्ते त्रयीमयः । विदुषामपि मूढेन स मया ज्ञायते कथम्
verses.transliteration: susūkṣmatvena gahanaḥ sadbhāvaste trayīmayaḥ / viduṣāmapi mūḍhena sa mayā jñāyate katham
verses.translation: Sankara who stood in front of him with satisfaction made Rama take up the four types of miraculous weapons along with the modes of their discharge as well as their withdrawal.
verses.hindi: वन्दना की थी । वे बार-बार उसके द्वादश नामों का नभस्तल में कीत्त न कर रहे थे ।१६। अगस्त्य जी ने कहा-हे प्रभो ! वे उस देवीके बारह नाम कौन से हैं उनको कृपया बतलाइए। है अश्वानन ! आप तो महान् विद्वान् हैं । मेरे हृदय में इनके ज्ञात प्राप्त करने का बड़ा भारी कोतुक विद्यमान है।
verses.wordMeaning: Sankara who stood in front of him with satisfaction made Rama take up the four types of miraculous weapons along with the modes of their discharge as well as their withdrawal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sankara who stood in front of him with satisfaction made Rama take up the four types of miraculous weapons along with the modes of their discharge as well as their withdrawal.

verses.sanskrit: अशब्दगोजरत्वेन महिम्नस्तव सांप्रतम् । स्तोतुमप्यनलं सम्यक्त्वा महं जडधीर्यतः
verses.transliteration: aśabdagojaratvena mahimnastava sāṃpratam / stotumapyanalaṃ samyaktvā mahaṃ jaḍadhīryataḥ
verses.translation: Sankara gave Rama an excellent chariot of unobs- tructed speed and velocity, with white horses and beautiful banner. He gave him two inexhaustible quivers of arrows.
verses.hindi: नामों का श्रवण कीजिए जिन नामों के केवल श्रवण करने ही से वह परम श्रसन्त हो जाया करती है। पञ्चमी--दण्डनाथा-संकेता--समयेश्वरी-- समय संकेता-वाराही--पोत्रिणी-वार्ताली-महासेना--आज्ञा-चक़् श्वरी --और अरिध्वनी--हे मुने ! ये ही उस देवी के द्ादश नाम हैं जिनको मैंने
verses.wordMeaning: Sankara gave Rama an excellent chariot of unobs- tructed speed and velocity, with white horses and beautiful banner. He gave him two inexhaustible quivers of arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sankara gave Rama an excellent chariot of unobs- tructed speed and velocity, with white horses and beautiful banner. He gave him two inexhaustible quivers of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादज्ञानतो वापि मया भक्त्यैव संस्तुतः । प्रीतश्च भव देवेश ननु त्वं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: tasmādajñānato vāpi mayā bhaktyaiva saṃstutaḥ / prītaśca bhava deveśa nanu tvaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: He gave him an unaging (ever-new) unbreakable divine bow (named) Vijaya, with firm bowstring. He gave him a costly wonderful coat of mail that can withstand all types of weapons.
verses.hindi: आपके सामने कहकर बता दिया है । यह द्वादश नामों का एक वजू का पण्जर है। इसके मध्य में रहने वाला अर्थात् इन बारह नामों का पाठ करने वाला बहुत हो सुरक्षित रहता है जैसे मानों कह बज निभित पञ्जर में बैठा होते । वह मानब संकट में भी कभी दुःख नहीं पाता है। इन्हीं
verses.wordMeaning: He gave him an unaging (ever-new) unbreakable divine bow (named) Vijaya, with firm bowstring. He gave him a costly wonderful coat of mail that can withstand all types of weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave him an unaging (ever-new) unbreakable divine bow (named) Vijaya, with firm bowstring. He gave him a costly wonderful coat of mail that can withstand all types of weapons.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इति स्तुतस्तदा तेन भक्त्या रामेण शङ्करः । मेघगंभीरया वाचा तमुवाच हसन्निव
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca iti stutastadā tena bhaktyā rāmeṇa śaṅkaraḥ / meghagaṃbhīrayā vācā tamuvāca hasanniva
verses.translation: O king, he granted him invincibility in battle, heroism without a parallel on the earth and the ability to hold his vital airs as long as he wished.
verses.hindi: नामों के द्वारा गगन में संस्थित देवों ने उस देवी संकेता की बहुत स्तुति की थी। उन सब पर अनुग्रह करने के लिए उसका हृदय पसीज गया था और फिर वह प्रचलायमान हो उठी थी
verses.wordMeaning: O king, he granted him invincibility in battle, heroism without a parallel on the earth and the ability to hold his vital airs as long as he wished.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, he granted him invincibility in battle, heroism without a parallel on the earth and the ability to hold his vital airs as long as he wished.

verses.sanskrit: भगवानुवाच रामाहं सुप्रसन्नो ऽस्मि शोर्ंयशालितया तव । तपसा मयि भक्त्या च स्तोत्रेण च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: bhagavānuvāca rāmāhaṃ suprasanno 'smi śorṃyaśālitayā tava / tapasā mayi bhaktyā ca stotreṇa ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: By means of a Bijamantra (incantation) in his name, he granted him renown all over the.vorlds. He granted Bhargava great potentiality for his austerities.
verses.wordMeaning: By means of a Bijamantra (incantation) in his name, he granted him renown all over the.vorlds. He granted Bhargava great potentiality for his austerities.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of a Bijamantra (incantation) in his name, he granted him renown all over the.vorlds. He granted Bhargava great potentiality for his austerities.

verses.sanskrit: वरं वरय तस्मात्त्वं यद्यदिच्छसि चेतसा । तुभ्यं तत्तदशेषेण दास्याम्यहमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ yadyadicchasi cetasā / tubhyaṃ tattadaśeṣeṇa dāsyāmyahamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Saying "So be it", Mahodara departed. The most excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu felt satisfied (in having fulfilled his duty) and desired to go to see his elders.
verses.wordMeaning: Saying "So be it", Mahodara departed. The most excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu felt satisfied (in having fulfilled his duty) and desired to go to see his elders.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying "So be it", Mahodara departed. The most excellent one among the descendants of Bhrgu felt satisfied (in having fulfilled his duty) and desired to go to see his elders.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्तो देवदेवेन तं प्रणम्य भृगूद्वहः । कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा राजन्निदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityukto devadevena taṃ praṇamya bhṛgūdvahaḥ / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā rājannidamuvāca ha
verses.translation: There he saw a boy, the son of a Brahmana, crying like one who was extremely frightened as he was chased by a tiger. He was (as if) holding his vital airs (with great difficulty).
verses.wordMeaning: There he saw a boy, the son of a Brahmana, crying like one who was extremely frightened as he was chased by a tiger. He was (as if) holding his vital airs (with great difficulty).
verses.commentary: Sense: There he saw a boy, the son of a Brahmana, crying like one who was extremely frightened as he was chased by a tiger. He was (as if) holding his vital airs (with great difficulty).

verses.sanskrit: यदि देव प्रसन्नस्त्वं वारर्हे ऽस्मि च यद्यहम् । भवतस्तदभीप्सामि हेतुमस्त्राण्यशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yadi deva prasannastvaṃ vārarhe 'smi ca yadyaham / bhavatastadabhīpsāmi hetumastrāṇyaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Chasing him with great speed, the scion of the family of Bhrgu, caught up the extremely terrible tiger in the forest after a long time.
verses.wordMeaning: Chasing him with great speed, the scion of the family of Bhrgu, caught up the extremely terrible tiger in the forest after a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chasing him with great speed, the scion of the family of Bhrgu, caught up the extremely terrible tiger in the forest after a long time.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रे शस्त्रे च शास्त्रे च न मत्तो ऽभ्यधिको भवेत् । लोकेषु मांरणेजेता न भवेत्त्वत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: astre śastre ca śāstre ca na matto 'bhyadhiko bhavet / lokeṣu māṃraṇejetā na bhavettvatprasādataḥ
verses.translation: Rama had his eyes turned red due to anger. With a desire to redeem the Brahmana boy he took up a small blade of grass and chanted mantras over it as though it were a missile of Kusa grass.
verses.wordMeaning: Rama had his eyes turned red due to anger. With a desire to redeem the Brahmana boy he took up a small blade of grass and chanted mantras over it as though it were a missile of Kusa grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama had his eyes turned red due to anger. With a desire to redeem the Brahmana boy he took up a small blade of grass and chanted mantras over it as though it were a missile of Kusa grass.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच तथेत्युक्त्वा ततः शंभुरस्त्रशस्त्राण्यशेषतः । ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतः समन्त्राणि क्रमान्नृप
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca tathetyuktvā tataḥ śaṃbhurastraśastrāṇyaśeṣataḥ / dadau rāmāya suprītaḥ samantrāṇi kramānnṛpa
verses.translation: In the meantime the hyaena (tiger) of great power ran after the Brahmana boy. On seeing him fallen, he roared loudly making the heaven and earth tremble.
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime the hyaena (tiger) of great power ran after the Brahmana boy. On seeing him fallen, he roared loudly making the heaven and earth tremble.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the hyaena (tiger) of great power ran after the Brahmana boy. On seeing him fallen, he roared loudly making the heaven and earth tremble.

verses.sanskrit: सप्रयोगं ससंहारमस्त्रग्रामं चतुर्विधम् । प्रसादाभिमुखो रामं ग्राहयामास शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: saprayogaṃ sasaṃhāramastragrāmaṃ caturvidham / prasādābhimukho rāmaṃ grāhayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: With the fire of his missile, he burned the tiger who was striking with the tips of his claws. He thus released the Brahmana boy who was not at all wounded.
verses.wordMeaning: With the fire of his missile, he burned the tiger who was striking with the tips of his claws. He thus released the Brahmana boy who was not at all wounded.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the fire of his missile, he burned the tiger who was striking with the tips of his claws. He thus released the Brahmana boy who was not at all wounded.

verses.sanskrit: असंगवेगं शुभ्राश्वं सुध्वजं च रथोत्तमम् । इषुधी चाक्षयशरौ ददौ रामाय शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: asaṃgavegaṃ śubhrāśvaṃ sudhvajaṃ ca rathottamam / iṣudhī cākṣayaśarau dadau rāmāya śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: That sinful (hyena) whose body had been burned completely due to the Brahminical fire, assumed the body of a Gandharva. Rising on to the sky, he spoke thus to Rama with great respect.
verses.wordMeaning: That sinful (hyena) whose body had been burned completely due to the Brahminical fire, assumed the body of a Gandharva. Rising on to the sky, he spoke thus to Rama with great respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: That sinful (hyena) whose body had been burned completely due to the Brahminical fire, assumed the body of a Gandharva. Rising on to the sky, he spoke thus to Rama with great respect.

verses.sanskrit: अभेद्यमजरं दिव्यं दृढज्यं विजयं धनुः । सर्वशस्त्रसहं चित्रं कवचं च महाधनम्
verses.transliteration: abhedyamajaraṃ divyaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ vijayaṃ dhanuḥ / sarvaśastrasahaṃ citraṃ kavacaṃ ca mahādhanam
verses.translation: "O sage, formerly, as I had been cursed by a Brahmana I attained the state of a tiger. Redeemed now from the effects of that curse, I am going to heaven".
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त संकेत योगिनी की मन्त्र नाथा चरणों के स्पशे करने बाली तथा निर्याण की सूचना करने वाली दिवलोक में काहली बजी थी। ।२२ श्रज्ञार प्राय भूषा बाली--शादू'ल श्यामल कान्ति वाली--वोणा से संयत करों वाली शक्तियों की सेता निकल गयी थी ।२३। उनमें कुछ तो
verses.wordMeaning: "O sage, formerly, as I had been cursed by a Brahmana I attained the state of a tiger. Redeemed now from the effects of that curse, I am going to heaven".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O sage, formerly, as I had been cursed by a Brahmana I attained the state of a tiger. Redeemed now from the effects of that curse, I am going to heaven".

verses.sanskrit: अजेयत्वं च युद्धेषु शौर्यं चाप्रतिमं भुवि । स्वेच्छया धारणे शाक्तिं प्राणानां च नराधिप
verses.transliteration: ajeyatvaṃ ca yuddheṣu śauryaṃ cāpratimaṃ bhuvi / svecchayā dhāraṇe śāktiṃ prāṇānāṃ ca narādhipa
verses.translation: When he went away hastily after saying thus, Rama who was wonderstruck sympathetically lifted up the fallen Brahmana boy.
verses.hindi: गान करती हैं जिनकी ध्वति मत्त कोकिलों के समान थी--कुछ नृत्य करती हैं। वीणा-वेणु और मृदंग आदि तिये हुई थीं ओर उनका चरणों का वित्यास का कम बिलास से युक्त था ।२४। जगत के जनों को हूषित करती हुईं श्यामा शक्तियाँ वहाँ से चल दी थीं । कुछ का बाहन मयूर था और कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: When he went away hastily after saying thus, Rama who was wonderstruck sympathetically lifted up the fallen Brahmana boy.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he went away hastily after saying thus, Rama who was wonderstruck sympathetically lifted up the fallen Brahmana boy.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातिं च बीजमेत्रेण तन्नाम्ना सर्वलौकिकीम् । तपः प्रभावं च महत्प्रददौ भार्गवाय सः
verses.transliteration: khyātiṃ ca bījametreṇa tannāmnā sarvalaukikīm / tapaḥ prabhāvaṃ ca mahatpradadau bhārgavāya saḥ
verses.translation: Sitting near the Brahmana boy he said the following words — "Do not be afraid", O king. Slowly he stroked his limbs, reviving his life (and spirits).
verses.hindi: हंसों को बाहन बनाये हुई थी २४) कुछ नकुल पर समारूढ़ थीं और कुछ कोकिलों पर विराजमान थीं । ये सभी श्यामल आकार वाली थी । इनमें कुछ कर्णी रथों पर सब संस्थित थीं ।२६। ये कादम्ब मधु मत्ता थीं और कुछ सैन्ध्वों पर समारूढ़ थीं । मस्त्रनाथ को अपने आगे करके ही वहाँ से रवाना
verses.wordMeaning: Sitting near the Brahmana boy he said the following words — "Do not be afraid", O king. Slowly he stroked his limbs, reviving his life (and spirits).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sitting near the Brahmana boy he said the following words — "Do not be afraid", O king. Slowly he stroked his limbs, reviving his life (and spirits).

verses.sanskrit: भक्ति चात्मनि रामाय दत्त्वा राजन्यथोचिताम् । सहितः सकलैर्भूतैश्चामरैश्चन्द्रशेखरः
verses.transliteration: bhakti cātmani rāmāya dattvā rājanyathocitām / sahitaḥ sakalairbhūtaiścāmaraiścandraśekharaḥ
verses.translation: Lifted up thus by Rama, he opened his eyes and looked around. He saw the most excellent one among the members of the family of Bhrgu in front of him.
verses.hindi: हो गयीं थीं ।२७। इसके उपरान्त समुत्त् गध्वजा वाले रथ पर आरूढ होकर बाल सूर्य के वर्ण के समात कवच वाली तथा मद से आलोल लोचनों वाली
verses.wordMeaning: Lifted up thus by Rama, he opened his eyes and looked around. He saw the most excellent one among the members of the family of Bhrgu in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lifted up thus by Rama, he opened his eyes and looked around. He saw the most excellent one among the members of the family of Bhrgu in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव वपुषा शंभुः क्षिप्रमन्तरधाद्धरः । कृतकृत्यस्ततो रामो लब्ध्वा सर्वमभीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: tenaiva vapuṣā śaṃbhuḥ kṣipramantaradhāddharaḥ / kṛtakṛtyastato rāmo labdhvā sarvamabhīpsitam
verses.translation: He became surprised on seeing the tiger reduced to ashes. With his fear dispelled he said thus — "Who are you, please? How did you come here?
verses.wordMeaning: He became surprised on seeing the tiger reduced to ashes. With his fear dispelled he said thus — "Who are you, please? How did you come here?
verses.commentary: Sense: He became surprised on seeing the tiger reduced to ashes. With his fear dispelled he said thus — "Who are you, please? How did you come here?

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यतां गते शर्वे महोदरमुवाच ह । महोदर मदर्थे त्वमिदं सर्वमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: adṛśyatāṃ gate śarve mahodaramuvāca ha / mahodara madarthe tvamidaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: I consider you to be everyone — my father, mother, friend and preceptor since you brought me back to life when I had met with the greatest of mishaps.
verses.hindi: समस्तमपि तत्सेन्यं शक्तीनामुद्धतोद्धतम् । पिच्छत्रिकोणच्छत्रेण विरुदेन महीयसा
verses.wordMeaning: I consider you to be everyone — my father, mother, friend and preceptor since you brought me back to life when I had met with the greatest of mishaps.
verses.commentary: Sense: I consider you to be everyone — my father, mother, friend and preceptor since you brought me back to life when I had met with the greatest of mishaps.

verses.sanskrit: रथचापादिकं तावत्परिरक्षितुमर्हसि । यदा कृत्यं ममैतेन तदानीं त्वं मया स्मृतः । रथचापादिकं सर्वं प्रहिणु त्वं मदन्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: rathacāpādikaṃ tāvatparirakṣitumarhasi / yadā kṛtyaṃ mamaitena tadānīṃ tvaṃ mayā smṛtaḥ / rathacāpādikaṃ sarvaṃ prahiṇu tvaṃ madantikam
verses.translation: From there I proceeded to the mountain Gandhar madana, desirous of visiting the holy penance grove ofBadarika resorted to by many groups of sages.
verses.wordMeaning: From there I proceeded to the mountain Gandhar madana, desirous of visiting the holy penance grove ofBadarika resorted to by many groups of sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: From there I proceeded to the mountain Gandhar madana, desirous of visiting the holy penance grove ofBadarika resorted to by many groups of sages.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच तथेत्युक्त्वा गते तस्मिन्भृगुवर्यो महोदरे । कृतकृत्यो गुरुजनं द्रष्टुं गन्तुमियेष सः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca tathetyuktvā gate tasminbhṛguvaryo mahodare / kṛtakṛtyo gurujanaṃ draṣṭuṃ gantumiyeṣa saḥ
verses.translation: Desirous of going further, I lost my way on the Himalaya mountain. Entering a fascinating forest, I got con- fused while viewing the different regions.
verses.hindi: संगीतयोगिनी श्यामा श्यामला मन्त्रनायिका। मन्त्रिणी सचिवेशी च प्रधानेशी शुकप्रिया
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of going further, I lost my way on the Himalaya mountain. Entering a fascinating forest, I got con- fused while viewing the different regions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of going further, I lost my way on the Himalaya mountain. Entering a fascinating forest, I got con- fused while viewing the different regions.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्नथ तदासौ तु हिमाद्रिवनगह्वरे । विवेश कन्दरं रामो भाविकर्मप्रचोदितः
verses.transliteration: gacchannatha tadāsau tu himādrivanagahvare / viveśa kandaraṃ rāmo bhāvikarmapracoditaḥ
verses.translation: I went a distance of a Krosa (three Kms) towards the east. As ill luck would have it, I was afflicted with fear and I had to run.
verses.wordMeaning: I went a distance of a Krosa (three Kms) towards the east. As ill luck would have it, I was afflicted with fear and I had to run.
verses.commentary: Sense: I went a distance of a Krosa (three Kms) towards the east. As ill luck would have it, I was afflicted with fear and I had to run.

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र ददृशे बालं धृतप्राणमनुद्रुतम् । व्याघ्रेण विप्रतनयं रुदन्तं भीतभीतवत्
verses.transliteration: sa tatra dadṛśe bālaṃ dhṛtaprāṇamanudrutam / vyāghreṇa vipratanayaṃ rudantaṃ bhītabhītavat
verses.translation: When I had fallen down I have been lifted up now from the ground with great love and mercifulness by you like a son, by his father. Thus my story has been wholly narrated to you".
verses.wordMeaning: When I had fallen down I have been lifted up now from the ground with great love and mercifulness by you like a son, by his father. Thus my story has been wholly narrated to you".
verses.commentary: Sense: When I had fallen down I have been lifted up now from the ground with great love and mercifulness by you like a son, by his father. Thus my story has been wholly narrated to you".

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वानुकंपहृदयस्तत्परित्राणकातरः । तिष्ठतिष्ठेति तं व्याघ्रं वदन्नुच्चैरथान्वयात्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvānukaṃpahṛdayastatparitrāṇakātaraḥ / tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti taṃ vyāghraṃ vadannuccairathānvayāt
verses.translation: On being asked thus by him, O leading king, Rama narrated his story entirely to him in due order.
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked thus by him, O leading king, Rama narrated his story entirely to him in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked thus by him, O leading king, Rama narrated his story entirely to him in due order.

verses.sanskrit: तमनुद्रुत्य वेगेन चिरादिव भृगूद्वहः । आससाद वने घोरं शार्दूलमतिभीषणम्
verses.transliteration: tamanudrutya vegena cirādiva bhṛgūdvahaḥ / āsasāda vane ghoraṃ śārdūlamatibhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: Mutually conversing thus they were delighted very much. He did not stay there for a long time thereafter. Ihen he desired to proceed ahead.
verses.hindi: थोडी २ प्रस्वेद की कणिकाओं से मनोहर मुख कमल वाली-कुछ चुकटियों को नवाकर कटाक्ष पातोसे प्रेक्षण करती हुईथो।२९। उन शक्तियों का सम्पूर्ण उद्धत भी उद्धत सैन्यबल था जो पिच्छ त्रिकोण महान विरुद वाले छत्र से संयुत था ।३०। इनके और अन्यों के मध्य में अर्थात् शक्तियों के बीच
verses.wordMeaning: Mutually conversing thus they were delighted very much. He did not stay there for a long time thereafter. Ihen he desired to proceed ahead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mutually conversing thus they were delighted very much. He did not stay there for a long time thereafter. Ihen he desired to proceed ahead.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रेणानुद्रुतः सो ऽपि पलायन्वनगह्वरे । निपपात द्विजसुतस्त्रस्तः प्राणभयातुरः
verses.transliteration: vyāghreṇānudrutaḥ so 'pi palāyanvanagahvare / nipapāta dvijasutastrastaḥ prāṇabhayāturaḥ
verses.translation: Followed by him, Rama came out of that cave with great joy and started towards the residence of his parents.
verses.hindi: में 'उज्वल उदय वाली-घन के समान श्यामला मन्त्र नायिका निकली थी। ।३श स्वगंवासियों ने उसका भी सोलह नामों के द्वारा स्तवन किया था । है कुम्भोद्भव ! उन सोलह नामों का भी अब मुझसे श्रवण कर लो
verses.wordMeaning: Followed by him, Rama came out of that cave with great joy and started towards the residence of his parents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Followed by him, Rama came out of that cave with great joy and started towards the residence of his parents.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि क्रोधरक्ताक्षो विप्रपुत्रपरीप्सया । तृणमूलं समादाय कुशास्त्रेणाभ्यमन्त्रयत्
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi krodharaktākṣo vipraputraparīpsayā / tṛṇamūlaṃ samādāya kuśāstreṇābhyamantrayat
verses.translation: A place near the source of the Ga$4aka where Bharata and sage
verses.hindi: संगीत योगिनी-शयामा-श्यामल-मन्त्र नायिका--मन्त्रिशी- सचिवेशी-- प्रधानेशी- शुक्र प्रिया--वीणावती --वैणिकी-मुद्रिणी--प्रियक प्रिया--नीप
verses.wordMeaning: A place near the source of the Ga$4aka where Bharata and sage
verses.commentary: Sense: A place near the source of the Ga$4aka where Bharata and sage

verses.sanskrit: तावत्तरक्षुर्बलवानाद्रवत्पतितं द्विजम् । दृष्ट्वा ननादसुभृशं रोदसी कम्पयन्निव
verses.transliteration: tāvattarakṣurbalavānādravatpatitaṃ dvijam / dṛṣṭvā nanādasubhṛśaṃ rodasī kampayanniva
verses.translation: Ever since then, he became a great friend and fol- lower of Rama in every situation like a shadow on the ground when there is sunlight.
verses.hindi: नाम हैं। इनके द्वारा जो सदा शरीरधारी एक बार सचिवेशानी की स्तुति किया करता है उसके हाथ में सम्पूर्ण त्रैलोक्य निःसंशय स्थित रहा करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, he became a great friend and fol- lower of Rama in every situation like a shadow on the ground when there is sunlight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, he became a great friend and fol- lower of Rama in every situation like a shadow on the ground when there is sunlight.

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध्वा त्वस्त्राग्निना व्याघ्रं प्रहरन्तं नखाङ्कुरैः । अकृतव्रणमेवाशु मोक्षयामास तं द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: dagdhvā tvastrāgninā vyāghraṃ praharantaṃ nakhāṅkuraiḥ / akṛtavraṇamevāśu mokṣayāmāsa taṃ dvijam
verses.translation: Followed by him, O king, Rama came to the presence of Bhrgu. He saw Khyati, approached her and bowed down to her humbly.
verses.wordMeaning: Followed by him, O king, Rama came to the presence of Bhrgu. He saw Khyati, approached her and bowed down to her humbly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Followed by him, O king, Rama came to the presence of Bhrgu. He saw Khyati, approached her and bowed down to her humbly.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि ब्रह्माग्निनिर्दग्धदेहः पाप्मा नभस्तले । गान्धर्वं वपुरास्थाय राममाहेति सादरम्
verses.transliteration: so 'pi brahmāgninirdagdhadehaḥ pāpmā nabhastale / gāndharvaṃ vapurāsthāya rāmamāheti sādaram
verses.translation: The highly intelligent Rama paid his respects to him and was congratulated and blessed by him, O king. Due to Aurva's affection, he remained there for a few days.
verses.wordMeaning: The highly intelligent Rama paid his respects to him and was congratulated and blessed by him, O king. Due to Aurva's affection, he remained there for a few days.
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly intelligent Rama paid his respects to him and was congratulated and blessed by him, O king. Due to Aurva's affection, he remained there for a few days.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रशापेन भोपूर्वमहं प्राप्तस्तरक्षुताम् । गच्छामि मोचितः शापात्त्वयाहमधुना दिवम्
verses.transliteration: vipraśāpena bhopūrvamahaṃ prāptastarakṣutām / gacchāmi mocitaḥ śāpāttvayāhamadhunā divam
verses.translation: After being permitted to go by him very slowly, Bhargava of great glory, accompanied by Akrtavrana, joyously started towards the abode of Rclka.
verses.wordMeaning: After being permitted to go by him very slowly, Bhargava of great glory, accompanied by Akrtavrana, joyously started towards the abode of Rclka.
verses.commentary: Sense: After being permitted to go by him very slowly, Bhargava of great glory, accompanied by Akrtavrana, joyously started towards the abode of Rclka.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा तु गते तस्मिन्रामो वेगेन विस्मितः । पतितं द्विजपुत्रं तं कृपया व्यवपद्यत
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā tu gate tasminrāmo vegena vismitaḥ / patitaṃ dvijaputraṃ taṃ kṛpayā vyavapadyata
verses.translation: After bowing down at the feet of the parents of his father, separately he saluted them. They two, O king, blessed him with their good wishes, due to his delight.
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down at the feet of the parents of his father, separately he saluted them. They two, O king, blessed him with their good wishes, due to his delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down at the feet of the parents of his father, separately he saluted them. They two, O king, blessed him with their good wishes, due to his delight.

verses.sanskrit: माभैरेवं वदन्वाणीमारादेव द्विजात्मजम् । परमृशत्तदङ्गानि शनैरुज्जीवयन्नृप
verses.transliteration: mābhairevaṃ vadanvāṇīmārādeva dvijātmajam / paramṛśattadaṅgāni śanairujjīvayannṛpa
verses.translation: On being asked by them, O leading king, the liberal-
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked by them, O leading king, the liberal-
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked by them, O leading king, the liberal-

verses.sanskrit: रामेणोत्थापितश्चैवं स तदोन्मील्य लोचने । विलोकयन्ददर्शाग्रे भृगुश्रेष्ठमवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇotthāpitaścaivaṃ sa tadonmīlya locane / vilokayandadarśāgre bhṛguśreṣṭhamavasthitam
verses.translation: After staying there for a few days he went to the abode of his parents with their permission. He was delighted extremely.
verses.hindi: बह मस्वनाचा जहाँ-जहाँ पर अपने कटाक्ष को विकीर्ण किया करती है वहाँ पर शत्रू, को सेना गताशंक होकर पूर्णतया पतन को प्राप्त हो जाया करती है ।३६। परमेशानी ललिता को जितनी भी राज्य चर्चा होती है और उसकी शक्तियों की जो चर्चा है वह सर्वत्र विजय के प्रदान करने बाली होती
verses.wordMeaning: After staying there for a few days he went to the abode of his parents with their permission. He was delighted extremely.
verses.commentary: Sense: After staying there for a few days he went to the abode of his parents with their permission. He was delighted extremely.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मीकृतं च शार्दूलं दृष्टवा विस्मयमागतः । गतभीराह कस्त्वं भोः कथं वेह समागतः
verses.transliteration: bhasmīkṛtaṃ ca śārdūlaṃ dṛṣṭavā vismayamāgataḥ / gatabhīrāha kastvaṃ bhoḥ kathaṃ veha samāgataḥ
verses.translation: When he bowed down at their feet, they eagerly and respectfully lifted him up, embraced him and sprinkled him with tears from their eyes.
verses.hindi: है ।३७। इसके अनन्तर संगोत योगिनी के कर में स्थित शुक पोत (शिशु) से सज्जित शरासन का बहन करता हुआ धनुर्वेद निकला था ।३५। बह चार बाहुओं से संयुत था-तीन उसके शिर ये और उस बीर के तीन ही नेत्र थे । उसने प्रधानेशी को प्रणिपात करके यह उस भक्तिमान ने प्रार्थना को
verses.wordMeaning: When he bowed down at their feet, they eagerly and respectfully lifted him up, embraced him and sprinkled him with tears from their eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he bowed down at their feet, they eagerly and respectfully lifted him up, embraced him and sprinkled him with tears from their eyes.

verses.sanskrit: केन वायं निहन्तुं मामुद्यतो भस्मसात्कृतः । तरक्षुर्भीषणाकारः साक्षान्मृत्युरिवापरः
verses.transliteration: kena vāyaṃ nihantuṃ māmudyato bhasmasātkṛtaḥ / tarakṣurbhīṣaṇākāraḥ sākṣānmṛtyurivāparaḥ
verses.translation: They congratulated him with blessings. They kept him on their laps. They looked at his face again and again. Stroking his limbs, they derived great joy.
verses.hindi: थी ।३९। है मस्त्रिताविके ! है देवि ! इस समय में आप भण्डासर््र के साथ युद्ध करने के लिए प्रवृत्त हो रही हैं। अतएव मेरे द्वारा आपकी सहायता करनी चाहिए ।४०। है जगतों की जननि ! यह चित्र जीव नाम वाला को दण्ड बहुत ही अधिक महान् है । यह समस्त दानवों का निबहुंण करने वाला
verses.wordMeaning: They congratulated him with blessings. They kept him on their laps. They looked at his face again and again. Stroking his limbs, they derived great joy.
verses.commentary: Sense: They congratulated him with blessings. They kept him on their laps. They looked at his face again and again. Stroking his limbs, they derived great joy.

verses.sanskrit: भयसंमूढमनमो ममाद्यापि महामते । हते ऽपि तस्मिन्नखिला भान्ति वै तन्मया दिशः
verses.transliteration: bhayasaṃmūḍhamanamo mamādyāpi mahāmate / hate 'pi tasminnakhilā bhānti vai tanmayā diśaḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: है । इसको आप ग्रहण कोजिए ।४१। ये दोनों तूणीर हैं जिनमें कभी भी बाणों का क्षय नहीं होता है और ये स्वर्ण से चित्रित हैं इनको भी आप केवल मुक पर अनुग्रह करने के लिए ही ग्रहण कीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: त्वामेव मन्ये सकलं पिता माता सुत्दृद्गुरू । परमापदमापन्नं त्वं मां समुपजीवयन्
verses.transliteration: tvāmeva manye sakalaṃ pitā mātā sutdṛdgurū / paramāpadamāpannaṃ tvaṃ māṃ samupajīvayan
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: आसीन्मुनिवरः कश्चिच्छान्तो नाम महातपाः । पुत्रस्तस्यास्मि तीर्थार्थी शालग्राममयासिषम्
verses.transliteration: āsīnmunivaraḥ kaścicchānto nāma mahātapāḥ / putrastasyāsmi tīrthārthī śālagrāmamayāsiṣam
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: यंत्रिणी तंत्रिणी चेति द्वे तस्याः परिचारिके ।
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्संप्रस्थितश्शैलं दिदृक्षुर्गन्धमादनम् । नानामुनिगणैर्जुष्टं पुण्यं बदरिकाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsaṃprasthitaśśailaṃ didṛkṣurgandhamādanam / nānāmunigaṇairjuṣṭaṃ puṇyaṃ badarikāśramam
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: शुकं वीणां च सहसा वह त्यो परिचेरतु:
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.transliteration: gantukāmo 'pahāyāhaṃ panthānaṃ tu himācale / praviśangahanaṃ ramyaṃ pradeśālokanākulam

verses.sanskrit: दिशंप्राचीं समुद्दिश्य क्रोशमात्रमयासिषम् । ततो दिष्टवशेनाहं प्राद्रवं भयपीडितः
verses.transliteration: diśaṃprācīṃ samuddiśya krośamātramayāsiṣam / tato diṣṭavaśenāhaṃ prādravaṃ bhayapīḍitaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: पतितश्च त्वया भूयोभूमेरुत्थापितो ऽधुना । पित्रेव नितरां पुत्रः प्रेम्णात्यर्थं दयालुना । इत्येष मम वृत्तान्तः साकल्येनोदितस्तव
verses.transliteration: patitaśca tvayā bhūyobhūmerutthāpito 'dhunā / pitreva nitarāṃ putraḥ premṇātyarthaṃ dayālunā / ityeṣa mama vṛttāntaḥ sākalyenoditastava
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इति पृष्टस्तदा तेन स्ववृत्तान्तमशेषतः । कथयामास राजेन्द्र रामस्तस्मै यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca iti pṛṣṭastadā tena svavṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ / kathayāmāsa rājendra rāmastasmai yathākramam
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तौ प्रीतिसंयुक्तौ कथयन्तौ परस्परम् । स्थित्वा नातिचिरं कालमथ गन्तुमियेष सः
verses.transliteration: tatastau prītisaṃyuktau kathayantau parasparam / sthitvā nāticiraṃ kālamatha gantumiyeṣa saḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: अन्वीयमानस्तेनाथ रामस्तस्माद्गुहामुखात् । निष्क्रम्यावसथं पित्रोः संप्रतस्थे मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: anvīyamānastenātha rāmastasmādguhāmukhāt / niṣkramyāvasathaṃ pitroḥ saṃpratasthe mudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: अकृतव्रण एवासौ व्याघ्रेण भुवि पातितः । रामेण रक्षितश्चाभुद्यस्माद्ध्याघ्रं विनिघ्नता
verses.transliteration: akṛtavraṇa evāsau vyāghreṇa bhuvi pātitaḥ / rāmeṇa rakṣitaścābhudyasmāddhyāghraṃ vinighnatā
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से प्रार्थना पूर्वक धनुर्वेद ने भक्ति भाव से प्रार्थना की थी और शिर टेककर प्रणाम किया था तया चाप और तूणीर समपित किये थे। उनको प्रियक प्रिया ने सादर ग्रहण कर लिया था ।४३। उस शुकप्रिया ने उस महाचाप को ग्रहण कर जिसका नाम चित्रग्रीव था उसका विस्फार
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तदेव नामास्य बभूव प्रथितं भुवि । विप्रपुत्रस्य राजेन्द्र तदेतत्सो ऽकृतव्रणः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttadeva nāmāsya babhūva prathitaṃ bhuvi / vipraputrasya rājendra tadetatso 'kṛtavraṇaḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: समुत्पन्न किया था ओर बिपुल रूप उसको मुर्वी का उद्घादन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रभृति रामस्य च्छायेवातपगा भुवि । बभूव मित्रमत्यर्थं सर्वावस्थासु पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti rāmasya cchāyevātapagā bhuvi / babhūva mitramatyarthaṃ sarvāvasthāsu pārthiva
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: उस संगीत योगिनी ने चाप को ध्वनि से सम्पूणं जगत् को पूरित कर दिया था । वह देवों के मन और नयनों के आनन्द की सम्पदा थी ।४५। मन्त्रिणी और तन्त्रिणो--ये दो उसकी परिचारिकाए' थों । वे शुक और वीणा का बहन करती हुई सहसा उसकी परिचर्या किया करती थीं ।४६। थोड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: स तेनानुगतो राजन्भृगोरासाद्य सन्निधिम् । दृष्ट्वा ख्यातिं च सो ऽभ्येत्य विनयेनाभ्यवादयत्
verses.transliteration: sa tenānugato rājanbhṛgorāsādya sannidhim / dṛṣṭvā khyātiṃ ca so 'bhyetya vinayenābhyavādayat
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: चञ्चल अर्थात् हिलने वाला जो वलय था उसके क्वणन से बढ़ने के स्वभाव बाला गुणों का निःस्वन था । वह धन के सहश श्यामा उसको धारण करती हुई अति मनोहर ध्वनि कर रही थी ।४७। गीतयोगिनी चित्र जीव नामक शरासन से परम भूषित हो रही ची और कदम्ब छत्र कामूंका कदम्बिनी
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: स ताभ्यां प्रियमाणाभ्यामाशीर्भिरभिनन्दितः । दिनानि कतिचित्तत्र न्यवसत्तत्प्रियेप्सया
verses.transliteration: sa tābhyāṃ priyamāṇābhyāmāśīrbhirabhinanditaḥ / dināni katicittatra nyavasattatpriyepsayā
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: की ही भांति शोभित हुई थी ।४८। काली के कटाक्ष के सहश परम तीक्षण नृत्य करता हुआ भुजंग भीषण दक्षिण कर में उल्लासित होता हुआ शिली- मुख विलास कर रहा था ।४९। गेय चक्र वाले रथ पर समारूढ़ उसका पीछे सेवा कर रहे ये । उसी के समान श्यामल और शोभा से समन्वित वाण
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तयोरनुमते च्यवनस्य महामुनेः । आश्रमं प्रतिचक्राम शिष्यसंघैः समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: tatastayoranumate cyavanasya mahāmuneḥ / āśramaṃ praticakrāma śiṣyasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtam
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.hindi: और धनुष को धारण करने बाली देवियां थीं ।५०। ये तीव्र नेगवाली ओर महालसा थीं जिनकी संख्या एक सहस्र अक्षौहिणी थी । परम मधुर जो किल किल की ध्वनि थी उससे दिशा पूरित कर रहीं थीं
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: नियन्त्रितान्तः करणं तं च संशान्तमानसम् । सुकन्याचापि तद्भार्यामवन्दत महामनाः
verses.transliteration: niyantritāntaḥ karaṇaṃ taṃ ca saṃśāntamānasam / sukanyācāpi tadbhāryāmavandata mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां च प्रीतियुक्ताभ्यां रामः समभिनन्दितः । और्वाश्रमं समापेदे द्रष्टुकामस्तपोनिधिम्
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ ca prītiyuktābhyāṃ rāmaḥ samabhinanditaḥ / aurvāśramaṃ samāpede draṣṭukāmastaponidhim
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: तं चाभिवाद्य मेधावी तेन च प्रतिनन्दितः । उवास तत्र तत्प्रीत्या दिनानि कतिचिन्नृप
verses.transliteration: taṃ cābhivādya medhāvī tena ca pratinanditaḥ / uvāsa tatra tatprītyā dināni katicinnṛpa

verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: विसृष्टस्तेन शनकैरृचीकभवनं मुदा । प्रतस्थे भार्गवः श्रीमानकृतव्रणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: visṛṣṭastena śanakairṛcīkabhavanaṃ mudā / pratasthe bhārgavaḥ śrīmānakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: अवन्दत पितुः पित्रोर्नत्वा पादौ पृथक् पृथक् । तौ च तं नृप संहर्षाच्चाशिषा प्रत्यनन्दताम्
verses.transliteration: avandata pituḥ pitrornatvā pādau pṛthak pṛthak / tau ca taṃ nṛpa saṃharṣāccāśiṣā pratyanandatām
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: पृष्टश्च ताभ्यामखिलं निजवृत्तमुदारधीः । कथयामास राजेन्द्र यथावृत्तमनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭaśca tābhyāmakhilaṃ nijavṛttamudāradhīḥ / kathayāmāsa rājendra yathāvṛttamanukramāt
