verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा दिनानि कतिचित्तत्रापि तदनुज्ञया । जगामावसथं पित्रोर्मुदा परमया युतः
verses.transliteration: sthitvā dināni katicittatrāpi tadanujñayā / jagāmāvasathaṃ pitrormudā paramayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: अभ्येत्य पितरौ राजन्नासी नावाश्रमोत्तमे । अवन्दत तयोः पादौ यथावद्भृगुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: abhyetya pitarau rājannāsī nāvāśramottame / avandata tayoḥ pādau yathāvadbhṛgunandana
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: पादप्रणामावनतं समुत्थाप्य च सादरम् । आश्लिष्य नेत्रसलिलैर्नन्दन्तौ पर्यषिञ्चताम्
verses.transliteration: pādapraṇāmāvanataṃ samutthāpya ca sādaram / āśliṣya netrasalilairnandantau paryaṣiñcatām
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: आशीर्भिरभिनन्द्याङ्के समारोप्य सुहुर्मुखम् । विक्षन्तौ तस्य चाङ्गानि परिस्पृश्यापतुर्मुदम्
verses.transliteration: āśīrbhirabhinandyāṅke samāropya suhurmukham / vikṣantau tasya cāṅgāni parispṛśyāpaturmudam
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: अपृच्छताञ्च तौ रामं कलेनैतावता त्वया । किं कृतं पुत्र को वायं कुत्र वा त्वमुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: apṛcchatāñca tau rāmaṃ kalenaitāvatā tvayā / kiṃ kṛtaṃ putra ko vāyaṃ kutra vā tvamupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: कथं सह सकाशे त्वमास्थितो वात्र वागतः । त्वयेतदखिलं वत्स कथ्यतां तथ्यमावयोः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ saha sakāśe tvamāsthito vātra vāgataḥ / tvayetadakhilaṃ vatsa kathyatāṃ tathyamāvayoḥ
verses.translation: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.wordMeaning: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked Rama — "What has been done by you, dear son, so long? Who is this boy? Where were you staying?

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने भार्गवचरिते पञ्चविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ २५॥ वशिष्ठ उवाच इति पृष्टस्तदा ताभ्यां रामो राजन्कृताञ्जलिः । तयोरकथयत्सर्वमात्मना यदनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne bhārgavacarite pañcaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 25// vaśiṣṭha uvāca iti pṛṣṭastadā tābhyāṃ rāmo rājankṛtāñjaliḥ / tayorakathayatsarvamātmanā yadanuṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Then, on being asked thus by them both, O king,. Rama, with palms joined in reverence, mentioned to them everything that had been done by himself.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, on being asked thus by them both, O king,. Rama, with palms joined in reverence, mentioned to them everything that had been done by himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, on being asked thus by them both, O king,. Rama, with palms joined in reverence, mentioned to them everything that had been done by himself.

verses.sanskrit: निदेशाद्वै कुलगुरोस्तपश्चरणमात्मनः । शंभोर्निदेशात्तीर्थानामटनं च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: nideśādvai kulagurostapaścaraṇamātmanaḥ / śaṃbhornideśāttīrthānāmaṭanaṃ ca yathākramam
verses.translation: He told them in due order how he performed pen- * ance on being directed by the oldest living member of his
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर वह राज नायिका वहाँ पर विराजमान थी जिसका अंकुश ज्वलित या और जो सर्प के ही तुल्य पाश को घारण करने वाली
verses.wordMeaning: He told them in due order how he performed pen- * ance on being directed by the oldest living member of his
verses.commentary: Sense: He told them in due order how he performed pen- * ance on being directed by the oldest living member of his

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञयैव दैत्यनां वधं चामरकारणात् । हरप्रसादादत्रापि ह्यकृतव्रणदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: tadājñayaiva daityanāṃ vadhaṃ cāmarakāraṇāt / haraprasādādatrāpi hyakṛtavraṇadarśanam
verses.translation: He told them about the slaughter of the Daityas on behalf of the Devas and his meeting with Akftavrana, due to the grace of Hara.
verses.hindi: 'थी। मधुर कवणन करने वाला बलय और इक्षु का धनुष धारण किये हुए थो । उसके बाण पांच कुसुमों के ये ।१। उदित सूये के तेज से भी अत्यधिक
verses.wordMeaning: He told them about the slaughter of the Daityas on behalf of the Devas and his meeting with Akftavrana, due to the grace of Hara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He told them about the slaughter of the Daityas on behalf of the Devas and his meeting with Akftavrana, due to the grace of Hara.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वमशेषेण यदन्यच्चात्मना कृतम् । कथयामास तद्रामः पित्रोः संप्रीयमाणयोः
verses.transliteration: etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa yadanyaccātmanā kṛtam / kathayāmāsa tadrāmaḥ pitroḥ saṃprīyamāṇayoḥ
verses.translation: All these as well as whatever else has been carried out by himself, Rama narrated to his parents who felt delighted to hear it.
verses.hindi: पाटल उसका अपना कलेकर या जिससे प्रभा झर रही थी । वहू अपने मुख को कान्तियों को दिशाओं में कोण कर रही थी । ऐसा प्रतीत होता था मानो वह अध्रमण्डल को चन्द्रं से परिपूर्ण बना रही हो ।२। शशि मण्डल की सखिता को प्राप्न होने वाला उसका परम धवल आतपत्र था जिसका
verses.wordMeaning: All these as well as whatever else has been carried out by himself, Rama narrated to his parents who felt delighted to hear it.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these as well as whatever else has been carried out by himself, Rama narrated to his parents who felt delighted to hear it.

verses.sanskrit: तौ च तेनोदितं सर्वं श्रुत्वा तत्कर्म विस्तरम् । हृष्टौ हर्षान्तरं भूयो राजन्नाप्नुवतावुभौ
verses.transliteration: tau ca tenoditaṃ sarvaṃ śrutvā tatkarma vistaram / hṛṣṭau harṣāntaraṃ bhūyo rājannāpnuvatāvubhau
verses.translation: On hearing everything mentioned by him and the details of his activities, both of them were delighted, O king. Both of them attained the acme of happiness.
verses.hindi: आयतन दशयोजन था ओर तीनों लोकों का अमिवरण करने वाला था। उसका स्वरूप परम स्वच्छ मौक्तिक के सहश था । ऐसे घबल छत्र से वह परमाधिक भासुर हो रही थो ।३। विजया आदि प्रमुख परिचारिकाओं के समुदाय के द्वारा चार चमरों से वहु अभिवीजित हो रही थी जो चमर मणि
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing everything mentioned by him and the details of his activities, both of them were delighted, O king. Both of them attained the acme of happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing everything mentioned by him and the details of his activities, both of them were delighted, O king. Both of them attained the acme of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पित्रोर्महाराज शुश्रूषां भृगुपुङ्गवः । प्रकुर्वंस्तद्विधेयात्मा भ्रातॄणां चाविशेषतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pitrormahārāja śuśrūṣāṃ bhṛgupuṅgavaḥ / prakurvaṃstadvidheyātmā bhrātṝṇāṃ cāviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Rendering service thus to his parents, O great king, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu remained obedient to them as well as to his brothers, without differentiating between them.
verses.hindi: के समान कान्ट और शोभा वाले थे तथा नवीन चन्द्रिका की लहरी की कान्ति एवं चार कदालियों की कान्ति के समान ये ।४। वह अपनी शक्ति से एक ही राज्य की पवी को अभिसूचित कर रही थी और सैकड़ों साम्राज्य के चिन्हों से उसका सैन्य देश मण्डित था । देवांगनाओं के संगीत और वादा
verses.wordMeaning: Rendering service thus to his parents, O great king, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu remained obedient to them as well as to his brothers, without differentiating between them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rendering service thus to his parents, O great king, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu remained obedient to them as well as to his brothers, without differentiating between them.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कदाचिद्धैहयेश्वरः । इत्येष मृगयां गान्तुं चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu kadāciddhaihayeśvaraḥ / ityeṣa mṛgayāṃ gāntuṃ caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, the lord of Haihaya once desired to go on a hunting expedition accompanied by his army of four constituents (i.e. elephants, chariots, horses and foot- soldiers ).
verses.hindi: रचनाओं के द्वारा उसके वेभव का संस्तवन किया जा रहा था एवं वह परम विशद प्रकाश वाली थी ।५। उसका शक्ति वेभव बाणी के तो अगोचर था ही किन्तु बह बुद्धि के भी अगोचर या । वह ऐसी है-इस तरह कथन के योग्य तथा बुद्धि में बैठने के योग्य नहीं है और उसकी तुल्यता रखने वाला
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, the lord of Haihaya once desired to go on a hunting expedition accompanied by his army of four constituents (i.e. elephants, chariots, horses and foot- soldiers ).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, the lord of Haihaya once desired to go on a hunting expedition accompanied by his army of four constituents (i.e. elephants, chariots, horses and foot- soldiers ).

verses.sanskrit: संरज्यमाने गगने बन्धूककुसुमारुणैः । ताराजालद्युतिहरैः समन्तादरुणांशुभिः
verses.transliteration: saṃrajyamāne gagane bandhūkakusumāruṇaiḥ / tārājāladyutiharaiḥ samantādaruṇāṃśubhiḥ
verses.translation: The birds taking shelter in their nests on the trees growing on the banks of the Narmada were chirping, making chaotic notes, pleasing to the ears and the mind.
verses.hindi: कोई भी नहीं है ।६। तीनों लोकों के मध्य में परिपूरित शक्ति चक्र और साम्राज्य की सम्पदा है उसके अभिमान का अभिस्पशंन करती हुई थी । पंक्तियों बद्ध तथा दोनों करों को विपुल भक्तिभाव में जोड़कर मस्तकों पर लगाने वाले देवगण समीप में प्रथम पहुँचकर सेवा करू--ऐसी रीति से
verses.wordMeaning: The birds taking shelter in their nests on the trees growing on the banks of the Narmada were chirping, making chaotic notes, pleasing to the ears and the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The birds taking shelter in their nests on the trees growing on the banks of the Narmada were chirping, making chaotic notes, pleasing to the ears and the mind.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दं वीजति प्रोद्धूतकेतकीवनराजिभिः । प्राभातिके गन्धवहे कुमुदाकरसंस्पृशि
verses.transliteration: mandaṃ vījati proddhūtaketakīvanarājibhiḥ / prābhātike gandhavahe kumudākarasaṃspṛśi
verses.translation: The chiefs of sages habituated to the performance of holy rites, were going back to their hermitages returning from the banks of the river, after duly answering the calls of nature.
verses.wordMeaning: The chiefs of sages habituated to the performance of holy rites, were going back to their hermitages returning from the banks of the river, after duly answering the calls of nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chiefs of sages habituated to the performance of holy rites, were going back to their hermitages returning from the banks of the river, after duly answering the calls of nature.

verses.sanskrit: वयांसि नर्मदातीरतरुनीडाश्रयेषु च । व्याहरन्स्वाकुला वाचो मनःश्रोत्रसुखावहाः
verses.transliteration: vayāṃsi narmadātīratarunīḍāśrayeṣu ca / vyāharansvākulā vāco manaḥśrotrasukhāvahāḥ
verses.translation: Every one of the wives of the heroic soldiers (vira- patniftt, probably muni-patntsu € wives of sages' (?) eagerly engag- ed in the domestic duties. The cows were being milked for the purpose of Homa, by the daughters of sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Every one of the wives of the heroic soldiers (vira- patniftt, probably muni-patntsu € wives of sages' (?) eagerly engag- ed in the domestic duties. The cows were being milked for the purpose of Homa, by the daughters of sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every one of the wives of the heroic soldiers (vira- patniftt, probably muni-patntsu € wives of sages' (?) eagerly engag- ed in the domestic duties. The cows were being milked for the purpose of Homa, by the daughters of sages.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातीरतीर्थं तदवतीर्याघहारिणि । तत्तोये मुनिवृन्देषु गृणात्सुब्रह्म शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: narmadātīratīrthaṃ tadavatīryāghahāriṇi / tattoye munivṛndeṣu gṛṇātsubrahma śāśvatam
verses.translation: The sons of sages were taking milk to the proper places. The people were eager to perform Agnihotra. The tinje was pleasant to all living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of sages were taking milk to the proper places. The people were eager to perform Agnihotra. The tinje was pleasant to all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of sages were taking milk to the proper places. The people were eager to perform Agnihotra. The tinje was pleasant to all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: विधिवत्कृतमैत्रेषु सन्निवृत्य सरित्तटात् । आशमं प्रति गच्छत्सु मुनिमुख्येषु कर्मिषु
verses.transliteration: vidhivatkṛtamaitreṣu sannivṛtya sarittaṭāt / āśamaṃ prati gacchatsu munimukhyeṣu karmiṣu
verses.translation: With the rumbling sound of his chariots, the king made the quarters resound. He went ahead covering the sky with the dust particles of the ground trodden under the feet of the hosts of his armies. The sky appeared to be crowded with hundreds of aerial chariots.
verses.wordMeaning: With the rumbling sound of his chariots, the king made the quarters resound. He went ahead covering the sky with the dust particles of the ground trodden under the feet of the hosts of his armies. The sky appeared to be crowded with hundreds of aerial chariots.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the rumbling sound of his chariots, the king made the quarters resound. He went ahead covering the sky with the dust particles of the ground trodden under the feet of the hosts of his armies. The sky appeared to be crowded with hundreds of aerial chariots.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्येकं वीरपत्नीषु व्यग्रासु गृहकर्मसु । होमार्थं मुनिकल्पाभिर्दुह्यमानासु धेनुषु
verses.transliteration: pratyekaṃ vīrapatnīṣu vyagrāsu gṛhakarmasu / homārthaṃ munikalpābhirduhyamānāsu dhenuṣu
verses.translation: "O great sage, grant me permission. I shall go to my city. Since 1 am having the full complement of my vehicles and armies, O great sage, it is impossible for you to extend hospitality, because you sustain yourself in the forest only with the products of the forest.
verses.wordMeaning: "O great sage, grant me permission. I shall go to my city. Since 1 am having the full complement of my vehicles and armies, O great sage, it is impossible for you to extend hospitality, because you sustain yourself in the forest only with the products of the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great sage, grant me permission. I shall go to my city. Since 1 am having the full complement of my vehicles and armies, O great sage, it is impossible for you to extend hospitality, because you sustain yourself in the forest only with the products of the forest.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाने मुनिकुमारेषु तं दोहं हि नयत्सु च । अग्निहोत्राकुले जाते सर्वभूतसुखावहे
verses.transliteration: sthāne munikumāreṣu taṃ dohaṃ hi nayatsu ca / agnihotrākule jāte sarvabhūtasukhāvahe
verses.translation: Thereupon, the hermitage of the leading member of the family of Bhfgu, became resplendent like the abode of the king of the Devas.1 Due to the power of the holy cow, it assumed a form that could not be imagined. On account of the different articles of richness it was something that could not have been achieved by anyone else.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the hermitage of the leading member of the family of Bhfgu, became resplendent like the abode of the king of the Devas.1 Due to the power of the holy cow, it assumed a form that could not be imagined.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the hermitage of the leading member of the family of Bhfgu, became resplendent like the abode of the king of the Devas.1 Due to the power of the holy cow, it assumed a form that could not be imagined.…

verses.sanskrit: विकसत्सु सरोजेषु गायत्सु भ्रमरेषु च । वाशत्सु नीडान्निष्पत्य पतत्रिषु समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: vikasatsu sarojeṣu gāyatsu bhramareṣu ca / vāśatsu nīḍānniṣpatya patatriṣu samantataḥ
verses.translation: It shone with various abodes made of the following things severally or by amalgamating two or more of these viz. bellmetal, brass, brass with copper, gold, silver, plaster and mortar, bricks, wood and mud. They were pleasing to the mind and the eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: It shone with various abodes made of the following things severally or by amalgamating two or more of these viz. bellmetal, brass, brass with copper, gold, silver, plaster and mortar, bricks, wood and mud. They were pleasing to the mind and the eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: It shone with various abodes made of the following things severally or by amalgamating two or more of these viz. bellmetal, brass, brass with copper, gold, silver, plaster and mortar, bricks, wood and mud. They were pleasing to the mind and the eyes.

verses.sanskrit: अनति व्यग्रमत्तेभतुरङ्गरथगामिनाम् । गात्राल्हादविवर्द्धन्यां वेलायां मन्दवायुना
verses.transliteration: anati vyagramattebhaturaṅgarathagāminām / gātrālhādavivarddhanyāṃ velāyāṃ mandavāyunā
verses.translation: There were golden daises and platforms shining brilliantly on account of extremely valuable gems and jewels. There were pleasure groves. There were steps leading to pin- nacles with rest-houses in the middle. They shone with sloping beams, rafts, doorways, bolts, walls, thresholds, terrace halls and courtyards.
verses.wordMeaning: There were golden daises and platforms shining brilliantly on account of extremely valuable gems and jewels. There were pleasure groves. There were steps leading to pin- nacles with rest-houses in the middle. They shone with sloping beams, rafts, doorways, bolts, walls,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There were golden daises and platforms shining brilliantly on account of extremely valuable gems and jewels. There were pleasure groves. There were steps leading to pin- nacles with rest-houses in the middle. They shone with sloping beams, rafts, doorways, bolts, walls,…

verses.sanskrit: गच्छत्सु चाश्रमोपान्तं प्रसूनजलहारिषु । स्वाध्या यदक्षैर्बहुभिरजिनांबरधारिभिः
verses.transliteration: gacchatsu cāśramopāntaṃ prasūnajalahāriṣu / svādhyā yadakṣairbahubhirajināṃbaradhāribhiḥ
verses.translation: W. 56-62 and W. 1-19 of the next chapter form one piece. They contain description of the city created by Jamadagni*s holy cow. The whole
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माविष्णु और शम्भु जिनमें प्रमुख ये ऐसे देवों के मुखों को जो
verses.wordMeaning: W. 56-62 and W. 1-19 of the next chapter form one piece. They contain description of the city created by Jamadagni*s holy cow. The whole
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 56-62 and W. 1-19 of the next chapter form one piece. They contain description of the city created by Jamadagni*s holy cow. The whole

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक् प्रयोज्यमानेषु मन्त्रेषूच्चावचेषु च । प्रैषेषूच्चार्यमाणेषु हूयमानेषु वह्निषु
verses.transliteration: samyak prayojyamāneṣu mantreṣūccāvaceṣu ca / praiṣeṣūccāryamāṇeṣu hūyamāneṣu vahniṣu
verses.translation: W. 56-62 and W. 1-19 of the next chapter form one piece. They contain description of the city created by Jamadagni*s holy cow. The whole
verses.hindi: बराबर स्तुति कर रहे ये अपने कृपा कटाक्ष से देख रही थी । अतीव उदीप कुसुमों के पाँच शरों से समुत्थित प्रकाशों से सहसा ज्योतिमंय त्रिधुवत को धारण करने वाली है ।८। विद्युल्लता के समान कान्तिमती अप्सराओं के समुदाय के द्वारा जय और मङ्गल के लिए लाजाओं की वर्षा जिसके ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: W. 56-62 and W. 1-19 of the next chapter form one piece. They contain description of the city created by Jamadagni*s holy cow. The whole
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 56-62 and W. 1-19 of the next chapter form one piece. They contain description of the city created by Jamadagni*s holy cow. The whole

verses.sanskrit: यथा वन्मन्त्रतन्त्रोक्तक्रियासु विततासु च । ज्वलदग्निशिखाकारे तमस्तपनतेजसि

verses.transliteration: uccāvacai ratnavarairvicitrasuvarṇasiṃhāsanapīṭhikādyaiḥ / sa bhakṣyabhojyādibhi rannapānairupetabhāṇḍopagataikadeśaiḥ

verses.transliteration: gṛhairamartyocitasarvasaṃpatsamanvitairnetramano 'bhirāmaiḥ / tasyāśramaṃ sannagaropamānaṃ babhau vadhūbhiścamanoharābhiḥ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने षड्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ २६॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच तस्मिन्पुरे सन्तुलितामरेद्रपुरीप्रभावे मुनिवर्यधेनुः । विनिर्ममे तेषु गृहेषु पश्चात्तद्योग्यनारीनरवृन्दजातम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 26// vasiṣṭha uvāca tasminpure santulitāmaredrapurīprabhāve munivaryadhenuḥ / vinirmame teṣu gṛheṣu paścāttadyogyanārīnaravṛndajātam
verses.translation: The women had bedecked their bodies with different kinds of dresses, ornaments, flowers, fragrant scents and silk garments. They were endowed with Havas (coquettish gestures etc. to excite amorous behaviour), Bhdvas (feelings of love), magnanimous behaviour and conduct, splendour, brilliance, beauty and good qualities.
verses.wordMeaning: The women had bedecked their bodies with different kinds of dresses, ornaments, flowers, fragrant scents and silk garments. They were endowed with Havas (coquettish gestures etc. to excite amorous behaviour), Bhdvas (feelings of love), magnanimous behaviour and conduct,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The women had bedecked their bodies with different kinds of dresses, ornaments, flowers, fragrant scents and silk garments. They were endowed with Havas (coquettish gestures etc. to excite amorous behaviour), Bhdvas (feelings of love), magnanimous behaviour and conduct,…

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रवेषाभरणप्रसूनगन्धांशुकालङ्कृतविग्रहाभिः । सहावभावाभिरुदारचेष्टाश्रीकान्तिसौन्दर्यगुणान्विताभिः
verses.transliteration: vicitraveṣābharaṇaprasūnagandhāṃśukālaṅkṛtavigrahābhiḥ / sahāvabhāvābhirudāraceṣṭāśrīkāntisaundaryaguṇānvitābhiḥ
verses.translation: They had surpassed the lustre of the moon by means of their lotus-like faces illuminated by the clusters of rays of their teeth, throbbing gently. Their words in sweet voice were (as if) filled with inebriating liquor of fresh youth. They had the sweet way of ogling with side glances lingering with love and affability.
verses.wordMeaning: They had surpassed the lustre of the moon by means of their lotus-like faces illuminated by the clusters of rays of their teeth, throbbing gently. Their words in sweet voice were (as if) filled with inebriating liquor of fresh youth.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They had surpassed the lustre of the moon by means of their lotus-like faces illuminated by the clusters of rays of their teeth, throbbing gently. Their words in sweet voice were (as if) filled with inebriating liquor of fresh youth.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्दस्फुरद्दन्तमरीचिजाल विद्योतिताननसरोजजितेन्दुभाभिः । प्रत्यग्रयौवनभरासवल्गुगीर्भिः स प्रेममन्थरकटाक्षनिरीक्षणाभिः
verses.transliteration: mandasphuraddantamarīcijāla vidyotitānanasarojajitendubhābhiḥ / pratyagrayauvanabharāsavalgugīrbhiḥ sa premamantharakaṭākṣanirīkṣaṇābhiḥ
verses.translation: Their hearts were delighted with pleasure. They looked extremely brilliant. They were adorned with the flowers of the divine wish-yielding tree (in the form) of the sentiment of love. They were richly endowed with and delighted by good fortune, youthful beauty, graceful charms, bfeauty and sweet*
verses.wordMeaning: Their hearts were delighted with pleasure. They looked extremely brilliant. They were adorned with the flowers of the divine wish-yielding tree (in the form) of the sentiment of love. They were richly endowed with and delighted by good fortune, youthful beauty, graceful charms,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their hearts were delighted with pleasure. They looked extremely brilliant. They were adorned with the flowers of the divine wish-yielding tree (in the form) of the sentiment of love. They were richly endowed with and delighted by good fortune, youthful beauty, graceful charms,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतिप्रसन्नहृदयाभिरतिप्रभाभिः शृङ्गारकल्पतरुपुष्पविभूषिताभिः । देवाङ्गनातुलितसौभगसौकुमार्यरूपाभिलाषमधुराकृतिरञ्जिताभिः
verses.transliteration: prītiprasannahṛdayābhiratiprabhābhiḥ śṛṅgārakalpatarupuṣpavibhūṣitābhiḥ / devāṅganātulitasaubhagasaukumāryarūpābhilāṣamadhurākṛtirañjitābhiḥ
verses.translation: Their waists bent and stooped slightly due to the weight of the pairs of plump breasts comparable to the pots of heated gold. The nails of their toes were rendered red by means of the red juice of lac resembling blood and therefore, they appeared to be filled with exhaustion due to the heavy burden of their buttocks.
verses.hindi: और सर्वयोनि नवमी तथा सर्वत्रिखण्डिका है । सिद्धि ब्राह्मी आदि मुद्रा ये हैं-इतनी शकट शक्तियाँ हैं।१५। भण्डासुर के संहार करने के लिये बह रक्त रथ में संस्थित हुई थी । जो गुप्ता नाम वालो पूव में कही थीं उनके भी नामों का श्रवण अव आप मुझसे कीजिए ।१६। कामकर्षणिका
verses.wordMeaning: Their waists bent and stooped slightly due to the weight of the pairs of plump breasts comparable to the pots of heated gold. The nails of their toes were rendered red by means of the red juice of lac resembling blood and therefore,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their waists bent and stooped slightly due to the weight of the pairs of plump breasts comparable to the pots of heated gold. The nails of their toes were rendered red by means of the red juice of lac resembling blood and therefore,…

verses.sanskrit: उत्तप्तहेमकलशोपमचारुपीनवक्षोरुहद्वयभरानतमध्यमाभिः । श्रोणीभराक्रमणखेदपरिश्रितास्मृगारक्तपावकरसारुणिताङ्घ्रिभूभिः
verses.transliteration: uttaptahemakalaśopamacārupīnavakṣoruhadvayabharānatamadhyamābhiḥ / śroṇībharākramaṇakhedapariśritāsmṛgāraktapāvakarasāruṇitāṅghribhūbhiḥ
verses.translation: They were bedecked in armlets, necklaces, jewels, bangles, golden necklaces, and blemishless (sparkling) ear ornaments. Garlands kissed their tresses and locks of hair. They had girdles and anklets with tinkling bells.
verses.hindi: और बुद्वया-कर्षणिका कला--अहङ्कारा कर्षणिका-शब्दाकवंणिका कला है ।१७। स्पर्शा कर्षणिका नित्या-रूपा कर्षणिका कला । रसा कर्षणिका नित्या नित्या-गन्धाकर्षणिका कला--।१८। चित्ताकर्षणिका नित्या- धैर्या-
verses.wordMeaning: They were bedecked in armlets, necklaces, jewels, bangles, golden necklaces, and blemishless (sparkling) ear ornaments. Garlands kissed their tresses and locks of hair. They had girdles and anklets with tinkling bells.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were bedecked in armlets, necklaces, jewels, bangles, golden necklaces, and blemishless (sparkling) ear ornaments. Garlands kissed their tresses and locks of hair. They had girdles and anklets with tinkling bells.

verses.sanskrit: केयूरहारमणिकङ्कणहेम कण्ठसूत्रामलश्रवणमण्डलमण्डिताभिः । स्रग्दामचुम्बितसकुन्तलकेशपाशकाञ्चीकलापपरिशिञ्जितनूपुराभिः
verses.transliteration: keyūrahāramaṇikaṅkaṇahema kaṇṭhasūtrāmalaśravaṇamaṇḍalamaṇḍitābhiḥ / sragdāmacumbitasakuntalakeśapāśakāñcīkalāpapariśiñjitanūpurābhiḥ
verses.translation: They had ample experience and opportunities of training themselves in such gestures and behaviour as pretended anger, consoling, jocular and witty giggling, playful teasings, sweet speech, reviling and provocation of anger. They were clever in totally dissembling the limits of composure and gravity of persons near and dear to the king himself.
verses.wordMeaning: They had ample experience and opportunities of training themselves in such gestures and behaviour as pretended anger, consoling, jocular and witty giggling, playful teasings, sweet speech, reviling and provocation of anger.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They had ample experience and opportunities of training themselves in such gestures and behaviour as pretended anger, consoling, jocular and witty giggling, playful teasings, sweet speech, reviling and provocation of anger.…

verses.sanskrit: आमृष्टरोषपरिसांत्वननर्महासकेलीप्रियालपनभर्त्सनरोषणेषु । भावेषु पार्थिवनिजप्रियधैर्यबन्धसर्वापहारचतुरेषु कृतान्तराभिः
verses.transliteration: āmṛṣṭaroṣaparisāṃtvananarmahāsakelīpriyālapanabhartsanaroṣaṇeṣu / bhāveṣu pārthivanijapriyadhairyabandhasarvāpahāracatureṣu kṛtāntarābhiḥ
verses.translation: The ladies were languid on account of inebriation. They were excessively efficient in exhibiting coquettish gestures. They were capable of making the minds of their lovers get confused. They were proficient in the practical demonstration of amorous dalliance. They were never wanting in riches and they were endowed with liberal -mindedness, beauty, good qualities and nice behaviour.
verses.hindi: कर्षणिका कला-समृत्याक्षेणिका नित्यानामाकर्षणिका कला ।१६। बीजा- कर्ष णिका नित्या-आत्माकर्षणिका कला-अमृतकधिणी नित्या-शरीराक्िणी कला ।२०। ये षोडश रूप वाली शीतांशु कलाख्पा शक्यां हैं। अष्टम पर्व को सम्प्राप्त ये गुप्ता नामों से कोत्तित की गयी है
verses.wordMeaning: The ladies were languid on account of inebriation. They were excessively efficient in exhibiting coquettish gestures. They were capable of making the minds of their lovers get confused. They were proficient in the practical demonstration of amorous dalliance.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ladies were languid on account of inebriation. They were excessively efficient in exhibiting coquettish gestures. They were capable of making the minds of their lovers get confused. They were proficient in the practical demonstration of amorous dalliance.…

verses.sanskrit: तन्त्रीस्वनोपमितमञ्जुलसौम्यगेयगन्धर्वतारमधुरारवभाषिणीभिः । वीणाप्रवीणतरपाणितलाङ्गुलीभिर्गंभीरचक्रचटुवादरतोत्सुकाभिः
verses.transliteration: tantrīsvanopamitamañjulasaumyageyagandharvatāramadhurāravabhāṣiṇībhiḥ / vīṇāpravīṇatarapāṇitalāṅgulībhirgaṃbhīracakracaṭuvādaratotsukābhiḥ
verses.translation: They were innumerable. Although their minds were eagerly engaged constantly in the various duties and activities of the household, they continued to serve them ( the followers of the king). The houses were filled with men too who had such beauty and splendour as befitted their good qualities. They were brilliant. They moved about in the houses here and there.
verses.hindi: विद्रुमद्रुमसङ्काशा मन्दस्मित मनोहराः । चतुभु जास्विनेवाश्च चन्द्राकंमुकुटोज्ज्वला:
verses.wordMeaning: They were innumerable. Although their minds were eagerly engaged constantly in the various duties and activities of the household, they continued to serve them ( the followers of the king).…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were innumerable. Although their minds were eagerly engaged constantly in the various duties and activities of the household, they continued to serve them ( the followers of the king).…

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीभिर्मदालस तराभिरतिप्रगल्भभावाभिराकुलितकामुकमानसाभिः । कामप्रयोगनिपुणाभिरहीनसंपदौदार्यरूपगुणशीलसमन्विताभिः
verses.transliteration: strībhirmadālasa tarābhiratipragalbhabhāvābhirākulitakāmukamānasābhiḥ / kāmaprayoganipuṇābhirahīnasaṃpadaudāryarūpaguṇaśīlasamanvitābhiḥ
verses.translation: There were innumerable groups of palatial buildings having nothing comparable to them. They were of various colours, dimensions and features. There were many sheds and abodes suitable for garrages, chariots, horses, elephants, mules, camels, bullocks, cows and goats.
verses.hindi: चापबाणौ चमंखड्गौ दधाना दिव्यकान्तयः । भण्डारसुरवधार्थाय प्रवृत्ताः कुम्भसम्भव ।
verses.wordMeaning: There were innumerable groups of palatial buildings having nothing comparable to them. They were of various colours, dimensions and features. There were many sheds and abodes suitable for garrages, chariots, horses, elephants, mules, camels, bullocks, cows and goats.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were innumerable groups of palatial buildings having nothing comparable to them. They were of various colours, dimensions and features. There were many sheds and abodes suitable for garrages, chariots, horses, elephants, mules, camels, bullocks, cows and goats.

verses.sanskrit: संख्यातिगाभिरनिशं गृहकृत्यकर्मव्यग्रात्मकाभिरपि तत्परिचारिकाभिः । पुंभिश्च तद्गुणगणोचितरूपशोभैरुद्भासितैर्गृहचरैः परितः परीतम्
verses.transliteration: saṃkhyātigābhiraniśaṃ gṛhakṛtyakarmavyagrātmakābhirapi tatparicārikābhiḥ / puṃbhiśca tadguṇagaṇocitarūpaśobhairudbhāsitairgṛhacaraiḥ paritaḥ parītam
verses.translation: There were separate houses allotted to the king, his generals, elephant-drivers, horsemen, foot -soldiers, lieutenants and chiefs of armies, the Brahmanas and others, the charioteers and chariot-attendants as well as the bards and poets, heralds- and panegyrists.
verses.hindi: अनंगमालिग्यपरा एता देव्यो जपात्विषः । इक्षुचापं पृष्पशरान्पुष्पकन्दुकमुत्पलम्
verses.wordMeaning: There were separate houses allotted to the king, his generals, elephant-drivers, horsemen, foot -soldiers, lieutenants and chiefs of armies, the Brahmanas and others, the charioteers and chariot-attendants as well as the bards and poets, heralds- and panegyrists.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were separate houses allotted to the king, his generals, elephant-drivers, horsemen, foot -soldiers, lieutenants and chiefs of armies, the Brahmanas and others, the charioteers and chariot-attendants as well as the bards and poets, heralds- and panegyrists.

verses.sanskrit: सराजमार्गापणसौधसद्मसोपानदेवालयचत्वरेषु । पौरैरशेषार्थगुणैः समन्तादध्यास्यमानं परिपूर्णकामैः
verses.transliteration: sarājamārgāpaṇasaudhasadmasopānadevālayacatvareṣu / paurairaśeṣārthaguṇaiḥ samantādadhyāsyamānaṃ paripūrṇakāmaiḥ
verses.translation: There were many big streets, market places and quadrangles of wonderfully distinguished features. Many articles were bought and sold there. There were the splendid houses of courtezans, which were well built and equipped with great wealth, furniture and other appurtenance of daily household needs.
verses.hindi: है कुम्भ सम्भव ! जो भण्डासुर के वध के लिए प्रवृत्त हृई वे विद्रु के बुम के सहश हैं तथा मन्दरिमत से मनोहर हैं। इनकी चार भुजाए हैं और तीन नेत्र हैं एवं चन्द्र और सूर्य इतके उज्वल मुकुट हैं। चाप-वाण- चमे और खङ्ग को धारण करने वाली तथा दिव्यकान्ति से सुसम्पन्न हैं
verses.wordMeaning: There were many big streets, market places and quadrangles of wonderfully distinguished features. Many articles were bought and sold there. There were the splendid houses of courtezans, which were well built and equipped with great wealth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There were many big streets, market places and quadrangles of wonderfully distinguished features. Many articles were bought and sold there. There were the splendid houses of courtezans, which were well built and equipped with great wealth,…

verses.sanskrit: अनेक रत्नोज्ज्वलितैर्विचित्रैः प्रासादसंघैरतुलैरसंख्यैः । रथाश्वमातङ्गखरोष्ट्रगोजायोग्यैरनेकैरपि मन्दिरैश्च
verses.transliteration: aneka ratnojjvalitairvicitraiḥ prāsādasaṃghairatulairasaṃkhyaiḥ / rathāśvamātaṅgakharoṣṭragojāyogyairanekairapi mandiraiśca
verses.translation: There were many beautiful lakes, tanks and vast excellent expanses of waters rendered fragrant by means of the pollen powder of Kalhdra (a variety of white lotus) and other lotuses, lilies white and red and lilies that bloom by night. They were resonant with the various cackling, crowing and chirping sounds of the ruddy geese, swans, ospreys, cranes, storks and water ducks.
verses.hindi: ।२२-२३। सायन्तन के जलते हुए दीप के समान चक्र रथ के सप्तम पव में आवास करने वाली गुप्ततरा नाम वाली हैं ।२४। अनङ्कमदनातुरा के साथ अनञ्जमदना--अनङ्ग लेखा-अनङ्ग वेगा--अनङ्गाकुशा-अनङ्ग॒का आलिङ्गन में परायणा- ये देवियाँ जपा के कुसुम की कान्ति वाली हैं। ये
verses.wordMeaning: There were many beautiful lakes, tanks and vast excellent expanses of waters rendered fragrant by means of the pollen powder of Kalhdra (a variety of white lotus) and other lotuses, lilies white and red and lilies that bloom by night.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There were many beautiful lakes, tanks and vast excellent expanses of waters rendered fragrant by means of the pollen powder of Kalhdra (a variety of white lotus) and other lotuses, lilies white and red and lilies that bloom by night.…

verses.sanskrit: नरेद्रसामन्तनिषादिसादिपदातिसेनपतिनायकानाम् । विप्रादिकानां रथिसारथीनां गृहैस्तथा मागधबन्दिनां च
verses.transliteration: naredrasāmantaniṣādisādipadātisenapatināyakānām / viprādikānāṃ rathisārathīnāṃ gṛhaistathā māgadhabandināṃ ca

verses.sanskrit: महार्हरत्नोज्ज्वलतुङ्गगोपुरैः सह श्वगृध्रव्रजनर्तनालयैः । चित्रैर्ध्वचैश्चापि पताकिकाभिः शुभ्रैः पटैर्मण्डपिकाभिरुन्नतैः
verses.transliteration: mahārharatnojjvalatuṅgagopuraiḥ saha śvagṛdhravrajanartanālayaiḥ / citrairdhvacaiścāpi patākikābhiḥ śubhraiḥ paṭairmaṇḍapikābhirunnataiḥ
verses.translation: The gardens had the fragrance experienced in the different seasons ( all together simultaneously). The gently blowing breeze (appeared to) threaten the summer season. Thus, O leading king, the city had clearly a rich complement of the luxurious pleasure and means of enjoyment fascinating unto the Suras as well as Asuras.

verses.transliteration: cūtapriyālapanasāmramadhūkajaṃbūplakṣairnavaiśca tarubhiśca kṛtālavālaiḥ / paryantaropitamanoramanāgaketakīpunnāgacaṃpakavanaiśca patatrijuṣṭaiḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by his entire army, the excellent king entered the city which was the abode of all enjoyable pleasures and which indicated the capability of the sacred cow of the sage. He surveyed the luxurious prosperity of the city that fascinated the entire world. His face was extremely delight- ed out of pleasure. Though the king himself was a liberal donor and was excessively self-possessed, he was then struck with great wonder along with his army.

Though the king himself was a liberal donor and was excessively self-possessed, he was then struck with great wonder along with his army.

verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his entire army, the excellent king entered the city which was the abode of all enjoyable pleasures and which indicated the capability of the sacred cow of the sage. He surveyed the luxurious prosperity of the city that fascinated the entire world.…

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यमूचुरिति गेहधनादिभिर्वा किं साध्यते वयमिहैव वसाम सर्वे । राजापि शार्वरविधानमथो विधाय निर्वर्त्य वासभवने शयनीयमग्र्यम् । अध्यास्य रत्ननिकरैरति शैभि भद्रं निद्रामसेवत नरेद्र चिरं प्रतीतः
verses.transliteration: anyonyamūcuriti gehadhanādibhirvā kiṃ sādhyate vayamihaiva vasāma sarve / rājāpi śārvaravidhānamatho vidhāya nirvartya vāsabhavane śayanīyamagryam / adhyāsya ratnanikarairati śaibhi bhadraṃ nidrāmasevata naredra ciraṃ pratītaḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by his entire army, the excellent king entered the city which was the abode of all enjoyable pleasures and which indicated the capability of the sacred cow of the sage. He surveyed the luxurious prosperity of the city that fascinated the entire world. His face was extremely delight- ed out of pleasure. Though the king himself was a liberal donor and was excessively self-possessed, he was then struck with great wonder along with his army.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by his entire army, the excellent king entered the city which was the abode of all enjoyable pleasures and which indicated the capability of the sacred cow of the sage. He surveyed the luxurious prosperity of the city that fascinated the entire world.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his entire army, the excellent king entered the city which was the abode of all enjoyable pleasures and which indicated the capability of the sacred cow of the sage. He surveyed the luxurious prosperity of the city that fascinated the entire world.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने सप्तविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ २७॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच स्वपन्तमेत्य राजानं सूतमागधवन्दिनः । प्रवोधयितुमव्यग्रा जगुरुच्चैर्निशात्यये
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne saptaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 27// vasiṣṭha uvāca svapantametya rājānaṃ sūtamāgadhavandinaḥ / pravodhayitumavyagrā jaguruccairniśātyaye
verses.translation: At the close of the night, the heralds, bards and panegyrists approached the sleeping king undistracted and sang aloud in order to awaken the king.
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of the night, the heralds, bards and panegyrists approached the sleeping king undistracted and sang aloud in order to awaken the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of the night, the heralds, bards and panegyrists approached the sleeping king undistracted and sang aloud in order to awaken the king.

verses.sanskrit: वीणावेणुरवोन्मिश्रकलतालततानुगम् । समस्तश्रुतिसुश्राव्यप्रशस्तमधुरस्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vīṇāveṇuravonmiśrakalatālatatānugam / samastaśrutisuśrāvyapraśastamadhurasvaram
verses.translation: They were sweet-throated (in voice) and they sang a very fascinating song as indicated by the clear MUrcchands (the harmonious rise and fall of sounds) in the gamut. The song had cadence and melody along with the Tara (high pitch) and Mandra ( low sound) (as required by the occasion).
verses.hindi: वशिनी चैव कामेशी भोगिनी विमला तथा ।
verses.wordMeaning: They were sweet-throated (in voice) and they sang a very fascinating song as indicated by the clear MUrcchands (the harmonious rise and fall of sounds) in the gamut.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were sweet-throated (in voice) and they sang a very fascinating song as indicated by the clear MUrcchands (the harmonious rise and fall of sounds) in the gamut.…

verses.sanskrit: स्निग्धकण्ठाः सुविस्पष्टमूर्च्छनाग्रामसूचितम् । जगुर्गेयं मनोहारि तारमन्द्रलयान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: snigdhakaṇṭhāḥ suvispaṣṭamūrcchanāgrāmasūcitam / jagurgeyaṃ manohāri tāramandralayānvitam
verses.translation: Desirous of awakening him slowly from his sleep, the heralds and the bards addressed the noble-souled king these words of diverse kinds.
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of awakening him slowly from his sleep, the heralds and the bards addressed the noble-souled king these words of diverse kinds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of awakening him slowly from his sleep, the heralds and the bards addressed the noble-souled king these words of diverse kinds.

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुश्च तं महात्मानं राजानं सूतमागधाः । स्वपन्तं विविधा वाचो बुबोधयिषवः शनेः
verses.transliteration: ūcuśca taṃ mahātmānaṃ rājānaṃ sūtamāgadhāḥ / svapantaṃ vividhā vāco bubodhayiṣavaḥ śaneḥ
verses.translation: "See, 'O leader of kings, this moon is setting now. Indeed it is because he (the moon) has been defeated by the splendour of your lotus-like face that continues to increase.
verses.hindi: सर्वज्ञान से परिपूर्ण देवी--सर्व ्याधि विनाशिनी--सर्वाधार स्व- रूपा--सर्व पाप हरा है ।४३। सर्वानन्दमयी देवी--सबं रक्षा स्वरूपिणी-- और इनमें जो दणमी देवी है वह सर्वेप्सित फल प्रदा जानने के योग्य हैं ।४४। इनकी चार-चार भुजाएं हैं ये वच्ा--शक्ति--तोमर और चक्र को
verses.wordMeaning: "See, 'O leader of kings, this moon is setting now. Indeed it is because he (the moon) has been defeated by the splendour of your lotus-like face that continues to increase.
verses.commentary: Sense: "See, 'O leader of kings, this moon is setting now. Indeed it is because he (the moon) has been defeated by the splendour of your lotus-like face that continues to increase.

verses.sanskrit: पस्यायमस्तमभ्येति राजेन्द्रेन्दुः पराजितः । विवर्द्धमानया नूनं तव वक्त्रांबुजश्रिया
verses.transliteration: pasyāyamastamabhyeti rājendrenduḥ parājitaḥ / vivarddhamānayā nūnaṃ tava vaktrāṃbujaśriyā
verses.translation: As if being desirous of viewing your lotus-like face, O lord, the sun has come to the Udaya mountain (in the East) dispelling the darkness now.
verses.hindi: घारण करने वाली हैं तथा ये सभी उसी भण्डासुर के वध करने के लिए समुद्यत हैं ।४५। ये सब चक्र रथेन्द्र के तीसरे पर्व में संश्रय करने वाली हैं । ये बागधीश्वरा रहस्य योगिनी के नाम से प्रख्यात हैं ।४६। इनकी आभा रक्ताशोक के पुसून के तुल्य है और इनके करों में धनुष वाण रहा करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: As if being desirous of viewing your lotus-like face, O lord, the sun has come to the Udaya mountain (in the East) dispelling the darkness now.
verses.commentary: Sense: As if being desirous of viewing your lotus-like face, O lord, the sun has come to the Udaya mountain (in the East) dispelling the darkness now.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुं त्वदान नांभोजं समुत्सुक इवाधुना । तमांसि भिन्दन्नादित्यः संप्राप्तो ह्युदयं विभो
verses.transliteration: draṣṭuṃ tvadāna nāṃbhojaṃ samutsuka ivādhunā / tamāṃsi bhindannādityaḥ saṃprāpto hyudayaṃ vibho
verses.translation: O king, the crest-jewel of all the members of the Lunar race, please abstain from further sleep. Be pleased to wake up now.
verses.hindi: इनके सम्पूर्ण अंग कबचों से संच्छन्न रहते हैं तथा ये बोणा और प्रस्तकों के धारण करने बाली है ।४७। बशिनो-कामेशो-भोगिनी-विमला-अर्णा- जाविनी-सर्बेशी-कोलिनी-ये आठ देवियाँ असुर के संहार की हेतु कहो गयी हैं और चक्ररवेन्द्र के द्वितीय पवं में समाथित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O king, the crest-jewel of all the members of the Lunar race, please abstain from further sleep. Be pleased to wake up now.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, the crest-jewel of all the members of the Lunar race, please abstain from further sleep. Be pleased to wake up now.

verses.sanskrit: राजन्नखिलशीतांशुवंशमौलिशिखामणे । निद्रया लं महाबुद्धे प्रतिवुध्यस्व सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: rājannakhilaśītāṃśuvaṃśamauliśikhāmaṇe / nidrayā laṃ mahābuddhe prativudhyasva sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Hearing these words of those bards, the lord of the earth woke up in the same manner as the lotus-eyed lord ( Visnu ) did from his serpent-couch (Sesa) in the milky ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: Hearing these words of those bards, the lord of the earth woke up in the same manner as the lotus-eyed lord ( Visnu ) did from his serpent-couch (Sesa) in the milky ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hearing these words of those bards, the lord of the earth woke up in the same manner as the lotus-eyed lord ( Visnu ) did from his serpent-couch (Sesa) in the milky ocean.

verses.sanskrit: इति तेषां वचः शृण्वन्नबुध्यत महीपतिः । क्षीराब्दौ शेषशयनाद्यथापङ्कजलोचनः
verses.transliteration: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śṛṇvannabudhyata mahīpatiḥ / kṣīrābdau śeṣaśayanādyathāpaṅkajalocanaḥ
verses.translation: When his eyes got rid of their sleep, he got up and performed duly and respectfully the daily rites of Japa (Repeti- tion of holy names) etc. with great concentration and care and omitted nothing.
verses.wordMeaning: When his eyes got rid of their sleep, he got up and performed duly and respectfully the daily rites of Japa (Repeti- tion of holy names) etc. with great concentration and care and omitted nothing.
verses.commentary: Sense: When his eyes got rid of their sleep, he got up and performed duly and respectfully the daily rites of Japa (Repeti- tion of holy names) etc. with great concentration and care and omitted nothing.

verses.sanskrit: विनिद्राक्षः समुत्थाय कर्म नैत्यकमादरात् । चकारावहितः सम्यग्जयादिकमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: vinidrākṣaḥ samutthāya karma naityakamādarāt / cakārāvahitaḥ samyagjayādikamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: By that time, all the ministers, vassal kings and generals approached him. With palms joined in reverence, O king, they bowed down to the excellent king.
verses.wordMeaning: By that time, all the ministers, vassal kings and generals approached him. With palms joined in reverence, O king, they bowed down to the excellent king.
verses.commentary: Sense: By that time, all the ministers, vassal kings and generals approached him. With palms joined in reverence, O king, they bowed down to the excellent king.

verses.sanskrit: देवतामभिवन्द्येष्टां गां दिव्यस्रग्गन्धभूषणः । कृत्वा दूर्वाञ्जनादर्शमङ्गल्यालम्बनानि च
verses.transliteration: devatāmabhivandyeṣṭāṃ gāṃ divyasraggandhabhūṣaṇaḥ / kṛtvā dūrvāñjanādarśamaṅgalyālambanāni ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, surrounded by them the king bowed down
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, surrounded by them the king bowed down
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, surrounded by them the king bowed down

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दानानि चार्थिभ्यो नत्वा गोब्रह्मणानपि । निष्क्रम्य च पुरात्तस्मादुपतस्थे च भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: dattvā dānāni cārthibhyo natvā gobrahmaṇānapi / niṣkramya ca purāttasmādupatasthe ca bhāskaram
verses.translation: The leading sage congratulated and blessed the king. As he bowed down with humility he gently told him— "Be pleased to sit".
verses.hindi: ति्न एताः स्मृता देव्यो भण्डे कोपसमन्विता:
verses.wordMeaning: The leading sage congratulated and blessed the king. As he bowed down with humility he gently told him— "Be pleased to sit".
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading sage congratulated and blessed the king. As he bowed down with humility he gently told him— "Be pleased to sit".

verses.sanskrit: तावदभ्याययुः सर्वं मन्त्रिसामन्तनायकाः । रचिताञ्जलयो राजन्नेमुश्च नृपसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tāvadabhyāyayuḥ sarvaṃ mantrisāmantanāyakāḥ / racitāñjalayo rājannemuśca nṛpasattamam
verses.translation: When the king occupied his seat, the great sage who was delighted in his mind said — "I hope, O king, that the night
verses.wordMeaning: When the king occupied his seat, the great sage who was delighted in his mind said — "I hope, O king, that the night
verses.commentary: Sense: When the king occupied his seat, the great sage who was delighted in his mind said — "I hope, O king, that the night

verses.sanskrit: ततः स तैः परिवृतः समुपेत्य तपोनिधिम् । ननाम पादयोस्तस्य किरीटेनार्कवर्चसा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ samupetya taponidhim / nanāma pādayostasya kirīṭenārkavarcasā
verses.translation: The stay of the citizens in the forest is very unbear- able. Indeed, O leading king, every thing that one is not accustom- ed to, is very difficult to do.
verses.wordMeaning: The stay of the citizens in the forest is very unbear- able. Indeed, O leading king, every thing that one is not accustom- ed to, is very difficult to do.
verses.commentary: Sense: The stay of the citizens in the forest is very unbear- able. Indeed, O leading king, every thing that one is not accustom- ed to, is very difficult to do.

verses.sanskrit: आशीर्भिरभिनन्द्याथ राजानं मुनिपुङ्गवः । प्रश्रयावनतं साम्ना तमुवाचास्यतामिति
verses.transliteration: āśīrbhirabhinandyātha rājānaṃ munipuṅgavaḥ / praśrayāvanataṃ sāmnā tamuvācāsyatāmiti
verses.translation: The fact that your majesty had to undergo the sufferings of a residence in the forest along with your followers, several times, certainly enhances your dignity'*.
verses.wordMeaning: The fact that your majesty had to undergo the sufferings of a residence in the forest along with your followers, several times, certainly enhances your dignity'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fact that your majesty had to undergo the sufferings of a residence in the forest along with your followers, several times, certainly enhances your dignity'*.

verses.sanskrit: तमासीनं नरपतिं महार्षिः प्रीतमानसः । उवाच रजनी व्युष्टा सुखेन तव किं नृप
verses.transliteration: tamāsīnaṃ narapatiṃ mahārṣiḥ prītamānasaḥ / uvāca rajanī vyuṣṭā sukhena tava kiṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: "O, what avail are these words, O holy Brahmana? Your real greatness has been seen by us. The entire world is surprised at this.
verses.wordMeaning: "O, what avail are these words, O holy Brahmana? Your real greatness has been seen by us. The entire world is surprised at this.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O, what avail are these words, O holy Brahmana? Your real greatness has been seen by us. The entire world is surprised at this.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमेव राजेन्द्र वने वन्येन जीवताम् । शक्यं मृगसधर्माणां येन केनापि वर्त्तितुम्
verses.transliteration: asmākameva rājendra vane vanyena jīvatām / śakyaṃ mṛgasadharmāṇāṃ yena kenāpi varttitum
verses.translation: My soldiers who have been overwhelmed by the luxurious provisions procured by your miraculous power, O great sage, do not wish to go away from this place.
verses.hindi: भै चाप-वाण--पान वात्र-मातुलु'भ और कृपाणिका धारण करने वाली हैं । ये तीन है और तोन पोडों पर इनका निलय है एवं आठ बाहुओं से सयुक्त है ।५०। पलक-नागपाश महाध्वनि घण्टा को धारण करने बाली हैं । ये मदिरा के पान मे मत्त रहा करती है तथा अति गुप्त रहस्य
verses.wordMeaning: My soldiers who have been overwhelmed by the luxurious provisions procured by your miraculous power, O great sage, do not wish to go away from this place.
verses.commentary: Sense: My soldiers who have been overwhelmed by the luxurious provisions procured by your miraculous power, O great sage, do not wish to go away from this place.

verses.sanskrit: अरण्ये नागराणां तु स्थितिरत्यन्तदुःसहा । अनभ्यस्तं हि राजेन्द्र ननु सर्वं हि दुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: araṇye nāgarāṇāṃ tu sthitiratyantaduḥsahā / anabhyastaṃ hi rājendra nanu sarvaṃ hi duṣkaram
verses.translation: The great achievement of your penance has been observed by us quite well and it is adored by the world. O Brahmana, I shall now go back to my capital. May your honour be pleased to permit me."
verses.hindi: बाली हैं।५१। कामेणी-बञ्े शो-भगमालिनी-ये तीन देवियां कही गयी हैं जो भण्डातुर देत्य पर अत्यधिक क्रोध से समन्वित थीं।५२। इनका माहात्म्य भी ललिता देवो के हो समान था तया ललिता देवी के ही समान ही इनका ओज महान् या । ये देवियाँ नित्य ही श्री देवी की अन्तरंग बतायी गयी हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: The great achievement of your penance has been observed by us quite well and it is adored by the world. O Brahmana, I shall now go back to my capital. May your honour be pleased to permit me."
verses.commentary: Sense: The great achievement of your penance has been observed by us quite well and it is adored by the world. O Brahmana, I shall now go back to my capital. May your honour be pleased to permit me."

verses.sanskrit: वनवासपरिक्लेशं भवान्यत्सानुगो ऽसकृत् । आप्तस्तु भवतो नूनं सा गौरवसमुन्नतिः
verses.transliteration: vanavāsaparikleśaṃ bhavānyatsānugo 'sakṛt / āptastu bhavato nūnaṃ sā gauravasamunnatiḥ
verses.translation: On being respectfully told thus by that king Kartta- virya, the sage honoured him perfectly well and (he permitted him) saying 'yes' — so be it.
verses.hindi: रचित आवास वाली पञ्वदशाक्षरा कही गयी हैं ।५४ ये तिथि नित्या- कालल्पा और विश्वको व्याप्त करके ही संस्थित रहा करती हैं। भण्डासुर आदि जो भी देत्य हैं इनको उन पर प्रज्षुव भूकुटियाँ रहा करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On being respectfully told thus by that king Kartta- virya, the sage honoured him perfectly well and (he permitted him) saying 'yes' — so be it.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being respectfully told thus by that king Kartta- virya, the sage honoured him perfectly well and (he permitted him) saying 'yes' — so be it.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तेन मुनिना स राजा प्रीतिपूर्वकम् । प्रहसन्निव तं भूयो वचनं प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: ityuktastena muninā sa rājā prītipūrvakam / prahasanniva taṃ bhūyo vacanaṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: On being permitted by the sage, the king set off from that hermitage surrounded by his soldiers and proceeded towards his city.
verses.hindi: ये सभी देवी के ही तुल्य आकार वाली हैं और श्रीदेवी के ही समान अपने आयुधों वाली हैं । ये प्रत्येक युग में जन समूहों के उपकार के ही लिए वत्त मान रहा करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On being permitted by the sage, the king set off from that hermitage surrounded by his soldiers and proceeded towards his city.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being permitted by the sage, the king set off from that hermitage surrounded by his soldiers and proceeded towards his city.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन्किमनया ह्युक्त्या दृष्टस्ते यादृशो महान् । अस्माभिमहिमा येन विस्मितं सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: brahmankimanayā hyuktyā dṛṣṭaste yādṛśo mahān / asmābhimahimā yena vismitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: While going on his way, the king thought in his mind thus — "Wonderful is the achievement of this sage by means of penance. It makes the entire world wonder-struck.
verses.hindi: कामेशी भगमाला च नित्यक्लिन्ना तथेव च
verses.wordMeaning: While going on his way, the king thought in his mind thus — "Wonderful is the achievement of this sage by means of penance. It makes the entire world wonder-struck.
verses.commentary: Sense: While going on his way, the king thought in his mind thus — "Wonderful is the achievement of this sage by means of penance. It makes the entire world wonder-struck.

verses.sanskrit: भवत्प्रभावसंजातविभवाहतचेतसः । इतो न गन्तुमिच्छन्ति सैनिका मे महामुने
verses.transliteration: bhavatprabhāvasaṃjātavibhavāhatacetasaḥ / ito na gantumicchanti sainikā me mahāmune
verses.translation: "O mighty king, why are you returning to the city? Of what avail to you is your kingdom or the capital city, though it be well protected?
verses.wordMeaning: "O mighty king, why are you returning to the city? Of what avail to you is your kingdom or the capital city, though it be well protected?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O mighty king, why are you returning to the city? Of what avail to you is your kingdom or the capital city, though it be well protected?

verses.sanskrit: त्वादृशानां जगन्तीह प्रभावैस्तपसां विभो । ध्रियन्ते सर्वदा नूनमचिन्त्यं ब्रह्मवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: tvādṛśānāṃ jagantīha prabhāvaistapasāṃ vibho / dhriyante sarvadā nūnamacintyaṃ brahmavarcasam
verses.translation: As long as the jewel of a cow does not find a place in your abode O lord, your kingdom cannot be considered prosperous. It is a void.
verses.hindi: अक्ररथ पर्वस्थ देवता नाम प्रकाशन  । रग
verses.wordMeaning: As long as the jewel of a cow does not find a place in your abode O lord, your kingdom cannot be considered prosperous. It is a void.
verses.commentary: Sense: As long as the jewel of a cow does not find a place in your abode O lord, your kingdom cannot be considered prosperous. It is a void.

verses.sanskrit: नैव चित्रं तव विभो शक्रोति तपसा भवान् । ध्रुवं कर्त्तुं हि लोकानामवस्थात्रितयं क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: naiva citraṃ tava vibho śakroti tapasā bhavān / dhruvaṃ karttuṃ hi lokānāmavasthātritayaṃ kramāt
verses.translation: Those things, O excellent king, have now got trans- formed into the selfsame Penance grove. What can be difficult to achieve for a person who possesses that cow which has such miraculous powers?
verses.hindi: द्र,ती च त्वरिता देवी नवमीं कुलसुन्दरी
verses.wordMeaning: Those things, O excellent king, have now got trans- formed into the selfsame Penance grove. What can be difficult to achieve for a person who possesses that cow which has such miraculous powers?
verses.commentary: Sense: Those things, O excellent king, have now got trans- formed into the selfsame Penance grove. What can be difficult to achieve for a person who possesses that cow which has such miraculous powers?

verses.sanskrit: सुदृष्टा ते तपःसिद्धिर्महती लोकपूजिता । गमिष्यामि पुरीं ब्रह्मन्ननुजानातु मां भवान्
verses.transliteration: sudṛṣṭā te tapaḥsiddhirmahatī lokapūjitā / gamiṣyāmi purīṃ brahmannanujānātu māṃ bhavān
verses.translation: Hence that cow should be accepted by you, since you have that good capacity of deserving to possess a jewel:
verses.wordMeaning: Hence that cow should be accepted by you, since you have that good capacity of deserving to possess a jewel:
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence that cow should be accepted by you, since you have that good capacity of deserving to possess a jewel:

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्तस्तेनस मुनिः कार्त्तवीर्येण सादरम् । संभावयित्वा नितरां तथेति प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktastenasa muniḥ kārttavīryeṇa sādaram / saṃbhāvayitvā nitarāṃ tatheti pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: "I do not consider this matter in this manner, be- cause it is improper. The property of a Brahmana should not be taken away. Hence, my mind is afraid." *
verses.wordMeaning: "I do not consider this matter in this manner, be- cause it is improper. The property of a Brahmana should not be taken away. Hence, my mind is afraid." *
verses.commentary: Sense: "I do not consider this matter in this manner, be- cause it is improper. The property of a Brahmana should not be taken away. Hence, my mind is afraid." *

verses.sanskrit: मुनिना समनुज्ञातो विनिष्क्रम्य तदाश्रमात् । सैन्यैः परिवृतः सर्वैः संप्रतस्थे पुरीं प्रति
verses.transliteration: muninā samanujñāto viniṣkramya tadāśramāt / sainyaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ saṃpratasthe purīṃ prati
verses.translation: To the king who spoke thus, his preceptor Garga, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, spoke. He appeared to be censuring (those who advocated removal of the cow per force). (He said:) "O king!"
verses.hindi: एताभिः सहिता देवी सदा सेवैक बुद्धिभिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: To the king who spoke thus, his preceptor Garga, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, spoke. He appeared to be censuring (those who advocated removal of the cow per force). (He said:) "O king!"
verses.commentary: Sense: To the king who spoke thus, his preceptor Garga, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, spoke. He appeared to be censuring (those who advocated removal of the cow per force). (He said:) "O king!"

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छंश्चिन्तयामास मनसा पथि पार्थिवः । अहो ऽस्य तपसः सिद्धिर्लोक विस्मयदायिनी
verses.transliteration: sa gacchaṃścintayāmāsa manasā pathi pārthivaḥ / aho 'sya tapasaḥ siddhirloka vismayadāyinī
verses.translation: "The property of a Brahmana should by no means be confiscated by force, even in emergency. There is nothing like the property of a Brahmana, which is difficult to be digested.
verses.hindi: सप्तपर्वाणि चोक्तानि तत्र देव्याश्च ताः शृणु
verses.wordMeaning: "The property of a Brahmana should by no means be confiscated by force, even in emergency. There is nothing like the property of a Brahmana, which is difficult to be digested.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The property of a Brahmana should by no means be confiscated by force, even in emergency. There is nothing like the property of a Brahmana, which is difficult to be digested.

verses.sanskrit: यया लब्धेदृशी धेनुः सर्वकामदुहां वरा । किं मे सकलराज्येन योगर्द्ध्या वाप्यनल्पया
verses.transliteration: yayā labdhedṛśī dhenuḥ sarvakāmaduhāṃ varā / kiṃ me sakalarājyena yogarddhyā vāpyanalpayā
verses.translation: A poison destroys the person who used it and who has been aimed at as the prospective victim, O king of Haiha- yas. But the fire from the Arani wood in the form of property of a Brahmana burns the entire family along with its roots.
verses.wordMeaning: A poison destroys the person who used it and who has been aimed at as the prospective victim, O king of Haiha- yas. But the fire from the Arani wood in the form of property of a Brahmana burns the entire family along with its roots.
verses.commentary: Sense: A poison destroys the person who used it and who has been aimed at as the prospective victim, O king of Haiha- yas. But the fire from the Arani wood in the form of property of a Brahmana burns the entire family along with its roots.

verses.sanskrit: गोरत्नभूता यदियं धेनुर्मुनिवरे स्थिता । अनयोत्पादिता नूनं संपत्स्वर्गसदामपि
verses.transliteration: goratnabhūtā yadiyaṃ dhenurmunivare sthitā / anayotpāditā nūnaṃ saṃpatsvargasadāmapi
verses.translation: (Defective Text). Who else other than you is capable of knowing the evil consequences of your misdeeds? O excel- lent king, you are thinking about Adana (taking away) from Brahmana and not Ddna (charitable gifts to them). Who else except you will desire such a thing?
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Text). Who else other than you is capable of knowing the evil consequences of your misdeeds? O excel- lent king, you are thinking about Adana (taking away) from Brahmana and not Ddna (charitable gifts to them). Who else except you will desire such a thing?
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Text). Who else other than you is capable of knowing the evil consequences of your misdeeds? O excel- lent king, you are thinking about Adana (taking away) from Brahmana and not Ddna (charitable gifts to them). Who else except you will desire such a thing?

verses.sanskrit: ऋद्धमैन्द्रमपि व्यक्तं पदं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् । अस्या धेनोरहं मन्ये कलां नार्हति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: ṛddhamaindramapi vyaktaṃ padaṃ trailokyapūjitam / asyā dhenorahaṃ manye kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: O king of mighty arms, you are a good person like this; please do not commit a sinful act condemned by good people, Indeed, that will lead to the loss of your reputa- tion.
verses.wordMeaning: O king of mighty arms, you are a good person like this; please do not commit a sinful act condemned by good people, Indeed, that will lead to the loss of your reputa- tion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king of mighty arms, you are a good person like this; please do not commit a sinful act condemned by good people, Indeed, that will lead to the loss of your reputa- tion.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं चिन्तयानं तं पश्चादभ्येत्य पार्थिवम् । चन्द्रगुप्तो ऽब्रवीन्मन्त्री कृताञ्जलि पुटस्तदा
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ cintayānaṃ taṃ paścādabhyetya pārthivam / candragupto 'bravīnmantrī kṛtāñjali puṭastadā
verses.translation: You are born of a great family of munificent and generous kings. Do not destroy your reputation now by means of this despicable act.
verses.hindi: है कुम्भज ! अब उनके शुभ नाम भो मुझ से आप अवधारित कर लीजिए । कामेणी-भगमाला-निस्य क्लिन्ना ।५७। मेरुण्डा-बहिनवासिनी-- महावज्ये शवरी-द.ती-स्वरिता- देवी नवमी कुल सुन्दरी है ।५८। नित्या-+ नोलपताका--विजया--ं मंगला --ज्वालामालिका-- चित्रा-- ये परद्रह
verses.wordMeaning: You are born of a great family of munificent and generous kings. Do not destroy your reputation now by means of this despicable act.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are born of a great family of munificent and generous kings. Do not destroy your reputation now by means of this despicable act.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं राजशार्दूल पुरीं प्रतिगमिष्यसि । रक्षितेन च राज्येन पुर्या वा किं फलं तव
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ rājaśārdūla purīṃ pratigamiṣyasi / rakṣitena ca rājyena puryā vā kiṃ phalaṃ tava
verses.translation: Alas! There are some dependent servants prone to an evil course of conduct. Being conceited due to the king's gracious favpur, they make him sink in the ocean of distress.
verses.hindi: कही गयी हैं ।५९। ये सदा ही सेवा की हो बुद्धिवालो रहती है और इनको ही साच में रखकर वह परमेश्वरी भन्डामुर पर बिजय ग्राप्त करने के लिए वहाँ से नित हुईं थी ।६०। महाचक्र में मन्त्र नाथा ओर रथोत्तम चक्र में गीति थी। ये वहां पर सात पर्व हैं जो आपको बतला दिए गए हैं। वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Alas! There are some dependent servants prone to an evil course of conduct. Being conceited due to the king's gracious favpur, they make him sink in the ocean of distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: Alas! There are some dependent servants prone to an evil course of conduct. Being conceited due to the king's gracious favpur, they make him sink in the ocean of distress.

verses.sanskrit: गोरत्नभूता नृपतेर्यावर्धेनुर्न चालये । वर्त्तते नार्द्धमपि ते राज्यं शून्यं तव प्रभो
verses.transliteration: goratnabhūtā nṛpateryāvardhenurna cālaye / varttate nārddhamapi te rājyaṃ śūnyaṃ tava prabho
verses.translation: Like a boat made of iron, the wicked -minded minis- ter who is not familiar with good policies and courses of con- duct will sink into the ocean of evil himself and will make the king too sink in it.
verses.hindi: पर जो श्री देवी की हैं उतका भो श्रवण करिए (६१) गेय चक्र रथ में पर्व के मध्य में पीठ और निकेतन बाली संगोत योगिनो कही गयी है जो श्री देवी की अत्यधिक वल्लभा (प्रिया) है ।६२। वह ही प्रथम पर्व है जो
verses.wordMeaning: Like a boat made of iron, the wicked -minded minis- ter who is not familiar with good policies and courses of con- duct will sink into the ocean of evil himself and will make the king too sink in it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a boat made of iron, the wicked -minded minis- ter who is not familiar with good policies and courses of con- duct will sink into the ocean of evil himself and will make the king too sink in it.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च दृष्टमाश्चर्यं मया राजञ्छृणुष्व तत् । भवनानि मनोज्ञानि मनोज्ञाश्च तथा स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: anyacca dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ mayā rājañchṛṇuṣva tat / bhavanāni manojñāni manojñāśca tathā striyaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O mighty king, it does not behove you to follow the opinion of this extremely evil-minded minister who is deluded and confused in regard to the path of good and just policies."
verses.hindi: द्वितीय पर्व में स्थित ये हैं-
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O mighty king, it does not behove you to follow the opinion of this extremely evil-minded minister who is deluded and confused in regard to the path of good and just policies."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O mighty king, it does not behove you to follow the opinion of this extremely evil-minded minister who is deluded and confused in regard to the path of good and just policies."

verses.sanskrit: प्रासादा विविधाकारा धनं चादृष्टसंक्षयम् । धेनो तस्यां क्षणेनैव विलीनं पश्यतो मम
verses.transliteration: prāsādā vividhākārā dhanaṃ cādṛṣṭasaṃkṣayam / dheno tasyāṃ kṣaṇenaiva vilīnaṃ paśyato mama
verses.translation: "This Brahmana looks only to the benefit of the persons of his own caste. Great affairs of the king and the state cannot be comprehended by Brahmanas.
verses.wordMeaning: "This Brahmana looks only to the benefit of the persons of his own caste. Great affairs of the king and the state cannot be comprehended by Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This Brahmana looks only to the benefit of the persons of his own caste. Great affairs of the king and the state cannot be comprehended by Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तपोवनमेवासीदिदानीं राजसत्तम । एवंप्रभावा सा यस्य तस्य किं दुर्लं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tattapovanamevāsīdidānīṃ rājasattama / evaṃprabhāvā sā yasya tasya kiṃ durlaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: The affairs of the state can be understood only by a king by means of his own intelligence. A Brahmana does not get (into his head) any matter (of importance) except taking food and accepting monetary and charitabte gifts.
verses.wordMeaning: The affairs of the state can be understood only by a king by means of his own intelligence. A Brahmana does not get (into his head) any matter (of importance) except taking food and accepting monetary and charitabte gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The affairs of the state can be understood only by a king by means of his own intelligence. A Brahmana does not get (into his head) any matter (of importance) except taking food and accepting monetary and charitabte gifts.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्रत्नार्हसत्त्वेन स्वीकर्त्तव्या हि गौस्त्वया । यदि ते ऽनुमतं कृत्यमाख्येयमनुजीविभिः
verses.transliteration: tasmādratnārhasattvena svīkarttavyā hi gaustvayā / yadi te 'numataṃ kṛtyamākhyeyamanujīvibhiḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana should not be insulted. He should always be respected and given monetary and charitable gifts. More than this nothing is accomplished anywhere.
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should not be insulted. He should always be respected and given monetary and charitable gifts. More than this nothing is accomplished anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should not be insulted. He should always be respected and given monetary and charitable gifts. More than this nothing is accomplished anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच । एवमेवाहमप्येनां न जानामीत्यसांप्रतम् । ब्रह्मस्वं नापहर्तव्यमिति मे शङ्कते मनः
verses.transliteration: rājovāca / evamevāhamapyenāṃ na jānāmītyasāṃpratam / brahmasvaṃ nāpahartavyamiti me śaṅkate manaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O king, go back to your city only after making that cow your own. If not, abandon your kingdom and go to the forest for the sake of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O king, go back to your city only after making that cow your own. If not, abandon your kingdom and go to the forest for the sake of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O king, go back to your city only after making that cow your own. If not, abandon your kingdom and go to the forest for the sake of penance.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवन्तं राजानमिदमाह पुरोहितः । गर्गो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठो गर्हयन्निव भूपते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvantaṃ rājānamidamāha purohitaḥ / gargo matimatāṃ śreṣṭho garhayanniva bhūpate
verses.translation: Fobearance (is a quality) of the Brahmanas but power (of chastisement) that of a Ksatriya, O king. No sin can befall you in taking away anything by force.
verses.wordMeaning: Fobearance (is a quality) of the Brahmanas but power (of chastisement) that of a Ksatriya, O king. No sin can befall you in taking away anything by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fobearance (is a quality) of the Brahmanas but power (of chastisement) that of a Ksatriya, O king. No sin can befall you in taking away anything by force.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मस्वं नापहर्त्तव्यमापद्यपि कथञ्चन । ब्रह्मस्वसदृशं लोके दुर्जरं नेह विद्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmasvaṃ nāpaharttavyamāpadyapi kathañcana / brahmasvasadṛśaṃ loke durjaraṃ neha vidyate
verses.translation: If you see any defect in forcible confiscation, O king, let the cow of the sage be taken possession of after giving its price (in the form of) other cows, horses etc.
verses.wordMeaning: If you see any defect in forcible confiscation, O king, let the cow of the sage be taken possession of after giving its price (in the form of) other cows, horses etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you see any defect in forcible confiscation, O king, let the cow of the sage be taken possession of after giving its price (in the form of) other cows, horses etc.

verses.sanskrit: विषं हन्त्युपयोक्तारं लक्ष्यभूतं तु हैहय । कुलं समूलं दहति ब्रह्मस्वारणिपावकः
verses.transliteration: viṣaṃ hantyupayoktāraṃ lakṣyabhūtaṃ tu haihaya / kulaṃ samūlaṃ dahati brahmasvāraṇipāvakaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, that cow should be made your own by you, because you are the one that deserve jewels. Wherefore can the ascetics have the desire for collecting jewels?
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, that cow should be made your own by you, because you are the one that deserve jewels. Wherefore can the ascetics have the desire for collecting jewels?
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, that cow should be made your own by you, because you are the one that deserve jewels. Wherefore can the ascetics have the desire for collecting jewels?

verses.sanskrit: अनिवार्यमिदं लोके ब्रह्मस्वन्दुर्जरं विषम् । पुत्रपौत्रान्तफलदं विपाककटु पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: anivāryamidaṃ loke brahmasvandurjaraṃ viṣam / putrapautrāntaphaladaṃ vipākakaṭu pārthiva
verses.translation: Or he will exchange that cow after taking in lieu of it (other) cows, gold etc., or a big sum of money of whatever else he desires.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he will exchange that cow after taking in lieu of it (other) cows, gold etc., or a big sum of money of whatever else he desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he will exchange that cow after taking in lieu of it (other) cows, gold etc., or a big sum of money of whatever else he desires.

verses.sanskrit: एश्वर्यमूढं हि मनः प्रभूममसदात्मनाम् । किन्नामासन्न कुरुते नेत्रास द्विप्रलोभितम्
verses.transliteration: eśvaryamūḍhaṃ hi manaḥ prabhūmamasadātmanām / kinnāmāsanna kurute netrāsa dvipralobhitam
verses.translation: A great gem should never be neglected nor treated with indifference by a king who desires prosperity. This is my thinking (advice). What does your Majesty think?"
verses.wordMeaning: A great gem should never be neglected nor treated with indifference by a king who desires prosperity. This is my thinking (advice). What does your Majesty think?"
verses.commentary: Sense: A great gem should never be neglected nor treated with indifference by a king who desires prosperity. This is my thinking (advice). What does your Majesty think?"

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्यस्त्वामृते को ऽन्यो विना दानान्नृपोत्तम । आदानं चिन्तयानो हि बाह्मणेष्वभिवाञ्छति
verses.transliteration: vedānyastvāmṛte ko 'nyo vinā dānānnṛpottama / ādānaṃ cintayāno hi bāhmaṇeṣvabhivāñchati
verses.translation: "O my dear Minister, be pleased to go to that Brahmana, yourself. Propitiate him with special service. Bring that cow after giving him whatever is desired by him.
verses.wordMeaning: "O my dear Minister, be pleased to go to that Brahmana, yourself. Propitiate him with special service. Bring that cow after giving him whatever is desired by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O my dear Minister, be pleased to go to that Brahmana, yourself. Propitiate him with special service. Bring that cow after giving him whatever is desired by him.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशस्त्वं महाबाहो कर्म सज्जननिन्दितम् । मा कृथास्तद्धि लोकेषु यशोहानिकरं तव
verses.transliteration: īdṛśastvaṃ mahābāho karma sajjananinditam / mā kṛthāstaddhi lokeṣu yaśohānikaraṃ tava
verses.translation: On being told thus by the. king, that minister, induced by fate, returned and hastened to the hermitage of Jamadagni.
verses.hindi: रति-प्रीति-मनोज्ञा हैं जिनके करों में वीणा और कामुक हैं। इनका
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by the. king, that minister, induced by fate, returned and hastened to the hermitage of Jamadagni.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by the. king, that minister, induced by fate, returned and hastened to the hermitage of Jamadagni.

verses.sanskrit: वंशे महति जातस्त्वं वदान्यानां प्रहीभुजाम् । यशांशि कर्मणानेन संप्रतं माव्यनीवशः
verses.transliteration: vaṃśe mahati jātastvaṃ vadānyānāṃ prahībhujām / yaśāṃśi karmaṇānena saṃprataṃ māvyanīvaśaḥ
verses.translation: After the king had departed, Rama too accompanied by Akrtavrana, had started towards the forest for bringing sacrificial twigs.
verses.hindi: वणं तमाल के तुल्य श्यामल है और ये दानवों के उन्मूलन करने में परम समवे हैं ।६४। तीसरे पर्व में संझूढ़ सनोभूवाण देवता हैं। द्राविणी-शोषणी- बंधिती-मोहिनी हैं ।६५। उन्मादिनो ये पाँच हैं जिनके करों में दीप्त कामु'क हैं। बहाँ पर पर्व में नोचे को ओर महान् ओज थाले वत्त'मान हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After the king had departed, Rama too accompanied by Akrtavrana, had started towards the forest for bringing sacrificial twigs.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the king had departed, Rama too accompanied by Akrtavrana, had started towards the forest for bringing sacrificial twigs.

verses.sanskrit: अहो ऽनुजीविनः किञ्चिद्भर्तारं व्यसनार्णवे । तत्प्रसादसमुन्नद्धा मज्जयं त्यनयोन्मुखाः
verses.transliteration: aho 'nujīvinaḥ kiñcidbhartāraṃ vyasanārṇave / tatprasādasamunnaddhā majjayaṃ tyanayonmukhāḥ
verses.translation: It was after that, that the Minister reached the ■ hermitage of Jamadagni, accompanied by the army. After
verses.hindi: कामराज-कन्दपं-मन्मय-मकरध्वज ओर मनोभव--ये पाँच हैं जो प्रेलोक्य के मोहन करते वाते हैं ।६३। ये कम्तूरी के तिलक से उल्लासित भाल वाले तथा मुक्ताओ के तुल्य शोभित हैं । इनके सभी अ'गकबचों से ढके हुए हैं और ये पलाश के पुं के समान कान्ति वाले हैं।६८। ये पाँच काम बताये
verses.wordMeaning: It was after that, that the Minister reached the ■ hermitage of Jamadagni, accompanied by the army. After
verses.commentary: Sense: It was after that, that the Minister reached the ■ hermitage of Jamadagni, accompanied by the army. After

verses.sanskrit: श्रिया विकुर्वन्पुरुषकृत्यचिन्त्ये विचेतनः । तन्मतानुप्रवृत्तिश्च राजा सद्यो विषीदति
