verses.transliteration: śriyā vikurvanpuruṣakṛtyacintye vicetanaḥ / tanmatānupravṛttiśca rājā sadyo viṣīdati
verses.translation: "O holy Brahmana, it has been ordered by the king thus: — On this earth the king is the person who has to take charge of gems. That cow of yours is the most excellent one among all cows yielding milk. Hence, it has become a gem.
verses.hindi: गये हैं जो भन्डासुर के वध के लिए ही हैं । जय चक रथेन्द्र के चतुथ' पर्व॑में संश्रय वाले हैं ।६९। ब्रह्मो जिनमें प्रमुख है पूर्व में वणित चन्डिका अष्टमी परा हैं। वहाँ पर पर्ग में नोचे लक्ष्मो और सरस्वती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy Brahmana, it has been ordered by the king thus: — On this earth the king is the person who has to take charge of gems. That cow of yours is the most excellent one among all cows yielding milk. Hence, it has become a gem.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy Brahmana, it has been ordered by the king thus: — On this earth the king is the person who has to take charge of gems. That cow of yours is the most excellent one among all cows yielding milk. Hence, it has become a gem.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञातमुनयो मन्त्री राजानमनयांबुधौ । आत्मना सह दुर्बुद्धिर्लोहनौरिव मज्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: ajñātamunayo mantrī rājānamanayāṃbudhau / ātmanā saha durbuddhirlohanauriva majjayet
verses.translation: Hence, mention the price of that cow whether it be (ordinary) gems and jewels or gold. It behoves you to give me this jewel of a cow after taking any reasonable price
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, mention the price of that cow whether it be (ordinary) gems and jewels or gold. It behoves you to give me this jewel of a cow after taking any reasonable price
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, mention the price of that cow whether it be (ordinary) gems and jewels or gold. It behoves you to give me this jewel of a cow after taking any reasonable price

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वं राजशार्दूल मूढस्य नयवर्त्मनि । मतमस्य सुदुर्बुद्धेर्नानुवर्त्तितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvaṃ rājaśārdūla mūḍhasya nayavartmani / matamasya sudurbuddhernānuvarttitumarhasi
verses.translation: "This is my sacred cow for the purpose of Hama. It
verses.wordMeaning: "This is my sacred cow for the purpose of Hama. It
verses.commentary: Sense: "This is my sacred cow for the purpose of Hama. It

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि वदतस्तस्य स्वामिश्रेयस्करं वचः । आक्षिप्य मन्त्री राजानमिदं भूयो ह्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi vadatastasya svāmiśreyaskaraṃ vacaḥ / ākṣipya mantrī rājānamidaṃ bhūyo hyabhāṣata
verses.translation: "In virtue of his being the legitimate possessor of a gem ( the best in everything), the king desires the Cow, but only in exchange for ten thousand ordinary cows. Hence it behoves you to give it to him."
verses.wordMeaning: "In virtue of his being the legitimate possessor of a gem ( the best in everything), the king desires the Cow, but only in exchange for ten thousand ordinary cows. Hence it behoves you to give it to him."
verses.commentary: Sense: "In virtue of his being the legitimate possessor of a gem ( the best in everything), the king desires the Cow, but only in exchange for ten thousand ordinary cows. Hence it behoves you to give it to him."

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो ऽयं स्वजातीयहितमेव समीक्षते । महान्ति राजकार्याणि द्विजैर्वेत्तुं न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo 'yaṃ svajātīyahitameva samīkṣate / mahānti rājakāryāṇi dvijairvettuṃ na śakyate
verses.translation: "By no means have I ever been a seller or a purchaser. Hence, I am not inclined to dispose of this cow that provides me with requisites of holy offerings."
verses.wordMeaning: "By no means have I ever been a seller or a purchaser. Hence, I am not inclined to dispose of this cow that provides me with requisites of holy offerings."
verses.commentary: Sense: "By no means have I ever been a seller or a purchaser. Hence, I am not inclined to dispose of this cow that provides me with requisites of holy offerings."

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञैव राजकार्याणि वेद्यानि स्वमनीषया । विना वै भोजनादाने कार्यं विप्रो न विन्दति
verses.transliteration: rājñaiva rājakāryāṇi vedyāni svamanīṣayā / vinā vai bhojanādāne kāryaṃ vipro na vindati
verses.translation: "O holy Brahmana, give away this single cow in exchange for half of the kingdom or for the entire possession of the kingdom. That will be conducive to your welfare."
verses.hindi: रति-प्रीति-की त्ति-शान्ति-पुष्टि-तुष्टि-ये शक्ति रक्त नेत्रों वाली हैं हैं ।७१। है कुम्भ सम्भव ! ये कुमारियां कुन्त चक्रधर कही गयी हैं। पाचगें वर्ग में वामा आदिक दूसरी सोलह समम्राप्त हैं ।७२। गीति चक्र रघेन्द्र की हैं। उनके भी नामों का श्रवण कीजिए जिनको में बता रहा हूँ। वामा-
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy Brahmana, give away this single cow in exchange for half of the kingdom or for the entire possession of the kingdom. That will be conducive to your welfare."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy Brahmana, give away this single cow in exchange for half of the kingdom or for the entire possession of the kingdom. That will be conducive to your welfare."

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो नावमन्तव्यो वन्दनीयश्च नित्यशः । प्रतिसंग्राहयणीयश्च नाधिकं साधितं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyo vandanīyaśca nityaśaḥ / pratisaṃgrāhayaṇīyaśca nādhikaṃ sādhitaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: "As long as I am alive, O evil-minded one, I will never part with this cow even to Indra even if I am to be requested by his preceptor Brhaspati. How then can I give this to your king at your instance?"
verses.hindi: चिनी-अश्वासिनी-बीचि-विदय,न्मालिनी-सुरानन्दा-नाग बुद्धिका-ये सब कुरविन्दकी आभा वाली हैं और सम्पूण जगत् के क्षोभण करने में संलग्न है ।७३-७४। ये पद-पद में महा सरसमन्नाह को धारण करने वाती हैं। ये वज कंकट से संच्छन्न हैं और अट्टहास करने से उज्ज्वल हैं । ये वस-दन्ड-
verses.wordMeaning: "As long as I am alive, O evil-minded one, I will never part with this cow even to Indra even if I am to be requested by his preceptor Brhaspati. How then can I give this to your king at your instance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "As long as I am alive, O evil-minded one, I will never part with this cow even to Indra even if I am to be requested by his preceptor Brhaspati. How then can I give this to your king at your instance?"

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स्वीकृत्य तां धेनुं प्रयाहि स्वपुरं नृप । नोचेद्राज्यं परित्यज्य गच्छस्वतपसे वनम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsvīkṛtya tāṃ dhenuṃ prayāhi svapuraṃ nṛpa / nocedrājyaṃ parityajya gacchasvatapase vanam
verses.translation: "It is better that you, in a friendly manner volun- teer to give the cow to the king. If it were to be taken away by force, what will you do?"
verses.hindi: गतच्नी और भुशुन्डिकाओं को धारण करने वालो हैं ।७६। इसके पश्चात् गीतिरथेन्द् के पष्ठ पर्थ में समाश्रित है । असितांग प्रभृति शस्त्रों से महान
verses.wordMeaning: "It is better that you, in a friendly manner volun- teer to give the cow to the king. If it were to be taken away by force, what will you do?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is better that you, in a friendly manner volun- teer to give the cow to the king. If it were to be taken away by force, what will you do?"

verses.sanskrit: क्षमावत्त्वं ब्राह्मणानां दण्डः क्षत्रस्य पार्थिव । प्रसह्य हरणे वापि नाधर्मस्ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: kṣamāvattvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ daṇḍaḥ kṣatrasya pārthiva / prasahya haraṇe vāpi nādharmaste bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "It is the king who gives gifts to the Brahmanas. If he himself were to take away what can I, a mere Brahmana, do, except giving it up (as if) willingly."
verses.wordMeaning: "It is the king who gives gifts to the Brahmanas. If he himself were to take away what can I, a mere Brahmana, do, except giving it up (as if) willingly."
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is the king who gives gifts to the Brahmanas. If he himself were to take away what can I, a mere Brahmana, do, except giving it up (as if) willingly."

verses.sanskrit: प्रसह्य हरणे दोषं यदि संपश्यसे नृप । दत्त्वा मूल्यं गवाश्वाद्यमृषेर्थेनुः प्रगृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: prasahya haraṇe doṣaṃ yadi saṃpaśyase nṛpa / dattvā mūlyaṃ gavāśvādyamṛṣerthenuḥ pragṛhyatām
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: स्वीकर्तव्या हि सा धेनुस्त्वया त्वं रत्नभागयतः । तपोधनानां हि कुतो रत्नसंग्रहणादरः
verses.transliteration: svīkartavyā hi sā dhenustvayā tvaṃ ratnabhāgayataḥ / tapodhanānāṃ hi kuto ratnasaṃgrahaṇādaraḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: तपोधन बलः शान्तः प्रीतिमान्स नृप त्वयि । तस्मात्ते सर्वथा धेनुं याचितः संप्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: tapodhana balaḥ śāntaḥ prītimānsa nṛpa tvayi / tasmātte sarvathā dhenuṃ yācitaḥ saṃpradāsyati
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वा गोहिरण्यद्यं यदन्यदभिवाञ्छितम् । संगृह्य वित्तं विपुलं धेनुं तां प्रतिदास्यति
verses.transliteration: atha vā gohiraṇyadyaṃ yadanyadabhivāñchitam / saṃgṛhya vittaṃ vipulaṃ dhenuṃ tāṃ pratidāsyati
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: अनुपेक्ष्यं महद्रत्नं राज्ञा वै भूतिमिच्छता । इति मे वर्त्तते बुद्धिः कथं वा मन्यते भवान्
verses.transliteration: anupekṣyaṃ mahadratnaṃ rājñā vai bhūtimicchatā / iti me varttate buddhiḥ kathaṃ vā manyate bhavān
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: वज्रे शक्ति कालदंडमसि पाशं ध्वज तथा
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच । गत्वा त्वमेव तं विप्रं प्रसाद्य च विशेषतः । दत्त्वा चाभीप्सितं तस्मै तां गामानय मन्त्रिक
verses.transliteration: rājovāca / gatvā tvameva taṃ vipraṃ prasādya ca viśeṣataḥ / dattvā cābhīpsitaṃ tasmai tāṃ gāmānaya mantrika
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: त्रिशिख-पानपात्र को धारण करने वाले तथा नील बरचस है।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच एवमुक्तस्ततोराज्ञा स मन्त्री विधिचोदितः । निवृत्य प्रययौ शीघ्रं जमदग्नेरथाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca evamuktastatorājñā sa mantrī vidhicoditaḥ / nivṛtya prayayau śīghraṃ jamadagnerathāśramam
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: भोरव हैं और गीति रे्द्र के सप्तम पबे में संशय वाले हैं ।७८-७६। मातंगी सिद्ध लक्ष्मी-महामातंगिका-महती-सिद्ध लक्ष्मी-भूशोणा-बाणधनुर्शरा-है
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: गते तु नृपतौ तस्मिन्नकृतव्रणसंयुतः । समिदानयनार्थाय रामो ऽपि प्रययौ वनम्
verses.transliteration: gate tu nṛpatau tasminnakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ / samidānayanārthāya rāmo 'pi prayayau vanam
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: उसी पर्व के नीचे गणप तथा क्षेत्रप हैं--दुर्गा अम्बा और वदुक हैं । ये सब करों में शस्त्र धारण करने वाले हैं ।८१। वहाँ पर ही पर्ज के नीचे लक्ष्मी और सरस्वती हैं । शंख-पद्म-निधि हैं । ये सब प्राणियों में शस्त्र वाले हैं ।६२। ये सब लोकों के शत्रू, षण्ड पराकूम वाले भरड के प्रति क्रद्ध हैं। शक्र
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स मन्त्री सबलः समासाद्य तदाश्रमम् । प्रणम्य मुनिशार्दूलमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa mantrī sabalaḥ samāsādya tadāśramam / praṇamya muniśārdūlamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: से आदि लेकर विष्णु भगवान् के अन्त पयंस्त दश दिशाओं के चक्रनायक हैं ।5३। बहाँ पर्ने के नीचे शक्ति रूप वाले संश्रय लेने वाले हैं । ये वज्च-शक्ति- कालवंड-अमि-पाशध्वज के धारण करने वाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रगुप्त उवाच ब्रह्मन्नृपतिनाज्ञप्तं राजा तु भुवि रत्नभाक् । रत्नभूता च धेनुः सा भुवि दोग्ध्रीष्वनुत्तमा
verses.transliteration: candragupta uvāca brahmannṛpatinājñaptaṃ rājā tu bhuvi ratnabhāk / ratnabhūtā ca dhenuḥ sā bhuvi dogdhrīṣvanuttamā
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्रत्नंसुवर्णं वा मूल्यमुक्त्वा यथोचितम् । आदाय गोरत्नभूतां धेनुं मे दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tasmādratnaṃsuvarṇaṃ vā mūlyamuktvā yathocitam / ādāya goratnabhūtāṃ dhenuṃ me dātumarhasi
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: भंडा सुरास्दुदु रूढान्निहंतु विश्वकंटकान् । मन्त्रिनाथाश्रयद्वारा ललिताज्ञापनोत्सुका:
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच होमधेनुरियं मह्यं न दातव्या हि कस्यचित् । राजा वदान्यः स कथं ब्रह्मस्वमभिवाञ्छति
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca homadhenuriyaṃ mahyaṃ na dātavyā hi kasyacit / rājā vadānyaḥ sa kathaṃ brahmasvamabhivāñchati
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: सर्वेषां चैव देवानां मन्त्रिणी द्वारतः कृत: ८७ विज्ञापना महादेव्याः कार्यसिद्धि प्रयच्छति ।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्र्युवाच रत्नभाक्त्वंन नृपतिर्द्धेनुं ते प्रतिकाङ्क्षति । गवायुतेन तस्मात्त्वं तस्मै तां दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: mantryuvāca ratnabhāktvaṃna nṛpatirddhenuṃ te pratikāṅkṣati / gavāyutena tasmāttvaṃ tasmai tāṃ dātumarhasi
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच क्रयविक्रययोर्नाहं कर्त्ता जातु कथञ्चन । हविर्धानीं च वै तस्मान्नोत्सहे दातुमञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca krayavikrayayornāhaṃ karttā jātu kathañcana / havirdhānīṃ ca vai tasmānnotsahe dātumañjasā
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: यथा खलु फलप्राप्तिः सेवाकानां हि जायते ।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्र्युवाच राज्यार्धेनाथ वा ब्रह्मन्सकलेनापि भूभृतः । देहि धेनुमिमामेकां तत्ते श्रेयो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: mantryuvāca rājyārdhenātha vā brahmansakalenāpi bhūbhṛtaḥ / dehi dhenumimāmekāṃ tatte śreyo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच जीवन्नाहं तु दास्यामि वासवस्यापि दुर्मते । गुरुणा याचितं किं ते वचसा नृपतेः पुनः
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca jīvannāhaṃ tu dāsyāmi vāsavasyāpi durmate / guruṇā yācitaṃ kiṃ te vacasā nṛpateḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: सा हि संगींतविद्य ति श्रीदेव्या: अतिबल्लभा ।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्र्युवाच त्वमेव स्वेच्छया राज्ञे देहि धेनुं सुहृत्तया । यथा बलेन नीतायां तस्यां त्वं किं करिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: mantryuvāca tvameva svecchayā rājñe dehi dhenuṃ suhṛttayā / yathā balena nītāyāṃ tasyāṃ tvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच दाता द्विजानां नृपतिः स यद्यप्याहरिष्यति । विप्रो ऽहं किं करिष्यामि स्वेच्छावितरणं विना
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca dātā dvijānāṃ nṛpatiḥ sa yadyapyāhariṣyati / vipro 'haṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi svecchāvitaraṇaṃ vinā
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्येवमुक्तः संक्रुद्धः स मन्त्री पापचेतनः । प्रसह्य नेतुमारेभे मुनेस्तस्य पयस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityevamuktaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ sa mantrī pāpacetanaḥ / prasahya netumārebhe munestasya payasvinīm
verses.translation: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.hindi: य गदा-जिशूल-दर्भास्त्र और बज को धारण किए हैं। ये सब उस
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that infuriated minister of sin- ful nature began to remove the sage's cow by force.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वोयुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे ऽष्टाविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ २८॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच जमदग्निस्ततो भूयस्तमुवाच रुषान्वितः । ब्रह्मस्वं नापहर्त्तव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe voyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde 'ṣṭāviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 28// vasiṣṭha uvāca jamadagnistato bhūyastamuvāca ruṣānvitaḥ / brahmasvaṃ nāpaharttavyaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā
verses.translation: With great anger Jamadagni spoke to him once again — ''The property of a Brahmana should not be taken away by a sensible person.
verses.hindi: मन्तरिनाषा का भक्तिभाव से संयुत होते हुए नित्य ही सेवन किया करते हैं ।८ वदं हढ़--विश्व के कंटक भंडासुरो का निहनन करने के बास्ते मस्ति नाथा के आश्रय के द्वारा ललिता आज्ञापन के उत्सुक रहा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: With great anger Jamadagni spoke to him once again — ''The property of a Brahmana should not be taken away by a sensible person.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great anger Jamadagni spoke to him once again — ''The property of a Brahmana should not be taken away by a sensible person.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसह्य गां मे हरतो पापमाप्स्यसि दुर्मते । आयुर्जाने परिक्षीणं न चेदेतत्करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: prasahya gāṃ me harato pāpamāpsyasi durmate / āyurjāne parikṣīṇaṃ na cedetatkariṣyati
verses.translation: Taking away the cow from me by force, Q evil-mind- ed one, you will incur sin. I think your life has come to an end. Otherwise you would not have done this.
verses.hindi: गीति चक्ररथ के उपान्त में दिकपालों ने इनको संश्रय दिया था।समस्त देवों की मन्त्रिणो द्वार से को गयो थो ।८5। विज्ञापना यह महादेवी के कार्य की सिद्धि किया करती है । राज्ञी और विज्ञापना ये दो प्रधान द्वार पर की गबो हैं ।८५। जैसी भो फल की प्राप्ति होतो है । अन्यथा इनकी बया
verses.wordMeaning: Taking away the cow from me by force, Q evil-mind- ed one, you will incur sin. I think your life has come to an end. Otherwise you would not have done this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking away the cow from me by force, Q evil-mind- ed one, you will incur sin. I think your life has come to an end. Otherwise you would not have done this.

verses.sanskrit: बलादिच्छसि यन्नेतुं तन्न शक्यं कथञ्चन । स्वयं वा यदि सायुच्येद्विनशिष्यति पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: balādicchasi yannetuṃ tanna śakyaṃ kathañcana / svayaṃ vā yadi sāyucyedvinaśiṣyati pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: What you wish to take away by force is impossible anyway. If the cow itself were to join the fray the king will be ruined.
verses.hindi: सामथ्यं है । जो जवलित ओज वालो और अप्रध,ष्य प्रभाव वाली श्री देवी के समीप में सपंण किया जा सके । वह निश्चय ही संगीत विद्या है जो श्री देवी की अतिवल्लभा है ।८६-६०। कार्यों को सिद्धियों में कहीं पर भी उसके कयित का अतिलंघन नहीं करती हैं । श्रीदेवी के शक्ति के सा भ्राज्य में वह
verses.wordMeaning: What you wish to take away by force is impossible anyway. If the cow itself were to join the fray the king will be ruined.
verses.commentary: Sense: What you wish to take away by force is impossible anyway. If the cow itself were to join the fray the king will be ruined.

verses.sanskrit: दानं विनापहरणं ब्राह्मणानां तपस्विनाम् । शतायुषोर्ऽजुनादन्यः को न्विच्छति जिजीविषुः
verses.transliteration: dānaṃ vināpaharaṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām / śatāyuṣor'junādanyaḥ ko nvicchati jijīviṣuḥ
verses.translation: Instead of making gifts, the forcible removal (of the property) of Brahmana ascetics is being pursued. What person desirous of continuing to be alive will desire this, except Arjuna who professes to live for a hundred years?"
verses.hindi: तस्मात्सर्वेऽपि दिक्पालाः श्रीदेव्या जय कांक्षिणः । तस्याः प्रधानभूतायाः सेवामेव वितन्वते
verses.wordMeaning: Instead of making gifts, the forcible removal (of the property) of Brahmana ascetics is being pursued. What person desirous of continuing to be alive will desire this, except Arjuna who professes to live for a hundred years?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Instead of making gifts, the forcible removal (of the property) of Brahmana ascetics is being pursued. What person desirous of continuing to be alive will desire this, except Arjuna who professes to live for a hundred years?"

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तेन संक्रुद्धः स मन्त्रीकालचोदितः । बद्ध्वा तां गां दृढैः पाशैर्विचकर्ष बलान्वितः
verses.transliteration: ityuktastena saṃkruddhaḥ sa mantrīkālacoditaḥ / baddhvā tāṃ gāṃ dṛḍhaiḥ pāśairvicakarṣa balānvitaḥ
verses.translation: On being told this by him, that infuriated powerful minister, urged by god of Death, bound the cow firmly with ropes and dragged.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीललितादेव्याश्चक्रराजरथोत्तमे । पर्वेस्थितानाँ देवोनां नामाति कथितान्यलम्
verses.wordMeaning: On being told this by him, that infuriated powerful minister, urged by god of Death, bound the cow firmly with ropes and dragged.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told this by him, that infuriated powerful minister, urged by god of Death, bound the cow firmly with ropes and dragged.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरथ क्रोधाद्भाविकर्मप्रचोदितः । रुरोध तं यथाशक्ति विकर्षन्तं पायस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration: jamadagniratha krodhādbhāvikarmapracoditaḥ / rurodha taṃ yathāśakti vikarṣantaṃ pāyasvinīm
verses.translation: Urged by his previous actions with their inevitable future results, Jamadagni furiously resisted him with all his might, while he was dragging the cow.
verses.wordMeaning: Urged by his previous actions with their inevitable future results, Jamadagni furiously resisted him with all his might, while he was dragging the cow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by his previous actions with their inevitable future results, Jamadagni furiously resisted him with all his might, while he was dragging the cow.

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्न प्रतिमोक्ष्यामि गामेनामित्यमर्षितः । जग्राह सुदृढं कण्ठे वाहुभ्यां तां महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: jīvanna pratimokṣyāmi gāmenāmityamarṣitaḥ / jagrāha sudṛḍhaṃ kaṇṭhe vāhubhyāṃ tāṃ mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: "As long as I am alive, I will not leave this cow". Thinking thus the great sage whose anger was aroused held on
verses.wordMeaning: "As long as I am alive, I will not leave this cow". Thinking thus the great sage whose anger was aroused held on
verses.commentary: Sense: "As long as I am alive, I will not leave this cow". Thinking thus the great sage whose anger was aroused held on

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रोधपरीतात्मा चन्द्रगुप्तो ऽतिनिर्घृणः । उत्सारयध्वमित्येनमादिदेश स्वसैनिकान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ krodhaparītātmā candragupto 'tinirghṛṇaḥ / utsārayadhvamityenamādideśa svasainikān
verses.translation: Formerly, Jamadagni used to get extremely over- whelmed with anger. But he had been consoled by Rama on behalf of his mother. Thereafter the sage of great penance had been always calm and quiet.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, Jamadagni used to get extremely over- whelmed with anger. But he had been consoled by Rama on behalf of his mother. Thereafter the sage of great penance had been always calm and quiet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Jamadagni used to get extremely over- whelmed with anger. But he had been consoled by Rama on behalf of his mother. Thereafter the sage of great penance had been always calm and quiet.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रधृष्यतमं लोके तमृषिं राजकिङ्कराः । भर्त्राज्ञया प्रसह्यैनं परिवव्रुः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: apradhṛṣyatamaṃ loke tamṛṣiṃ rājakiṅkarāḥ / bhartrājñayā prasahyainaṃ parivavruḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: When the sage fell senseless the evil-minded minister was beset with fear. He ordered his servants to bring the cow quickly with force.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sage fell senseless the evil-minded minister was beset with fear. He ordered his servants to bring the cow quickly with force.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sage fell senseless the evil-minded minister was beset with fear. He ordered his servants to bring the cow quickly with force.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डैः कशाभिर्लकुडैर्विनिघ्नन्तश्च मुष्टिभिः । ते समुत्सारयन् धेनोः सुदूरतरमन्तिकात्
verses.transliteration: daṇḍaiḥ kaśābhirlakuḍairvinighnantaśca muṣṭibhiḥ / te samutsārayan dhenoḥ sudūrataramantikāt
verses.translation: Then they bound the cow along with its calf by means of ropes, O king. They hit it with whips and desirous of taking it away dragged it.
verses.hindi: जो भो कुछ करने का अयवा नहीं करने का है उस सभी को करने में प्रगल्भ होती हैं। कारण से सभी दिक्पाल श्री देवीकी ही जय की कांक्षा बाले रहा करते हैं । प्रधानभूता उसको ही सेवा का विस्तार किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Then they bound the cow along with its calf by means of ropes, O king. They hit it with whips and desirous of taking it away dragged it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they bound the cow along with its calf by means of ropes, O king. They hit it with whips and desirous of taking it away dragged it.

verses.sanskrit: स तथा हन्यमोनो ऽपि व्यथितःक्षमयान्वितः । न चुक्रोधाक्रोधनत्वं सतो हि परमं धनम्
verses.transliteration: sa tathā hanyamono 'pi vyathitaḥkṣamayānvitaḥ / na cukrodhākrodhanatvaṃ sato hi paramaṃ dhanam
verses.translation: On being dragged by many of them and on being hit and hurt with whips and poles by them, the cow gave vent to its anger.
verses.hindi: के नाम वणित कर दिए गए हैं।€३। भंडासुर के संहार में उसके परम दिव्य आयुधों का भी वर्णन कर दिया है । गेय चक्क और पबभी देवी के बणित किए गए हैं। इन समस्त देवियों के नामों का जो भी कोई श्रवण किया करते हैं वे नर समस्त पापों से छुटकारा पाकर विजयो हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On being dragged by many of them and on being hit and hurt with whips and poles by them, the cow gave vent to its anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being dragged by many of them and on being hit and hurt with whips and poles by them, the cow gave vent to its anger.

verses.sanskrit: स च शक्तः स्वतपसा संहर्त्तुमपि रक्षितुम् । जगत्सर्वं क्षयं तस्य चिन्तयन्न प्रचुक्रुधे
verses.transliteration: sa ca śaktaḥ svatapasā saṃharttumapi rakṣitum / jagatsarvaṃ kṣayaṃ tasya cintayanna pracukrudhe
verses.translation: Pained by too much wippings, it became extremely furious. It tugged at the tight ropes and cut them. Thus it released itself.
verses.wordMeaning: Pained by too much wippings, it became extremely furious. It tugged at the tight ropes and cut them. Thus it released itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pained by too much wippings, it became extremely furious. It tugged at the tight ropes and cut them. Thus it released itself.

verses.sanskrit: सपूर्वं क्रोधनो ऽत्यर्थं मातुरर्थे प्रसादितः । रामेणाभूत्ततो नित्यं शान्त एव महातपाः
verses.transliteration: sapūrvaṃ krodhano 'tyarthaṃ māturarthe prasāditaḥ / rāmeṇābhūttato nityaṃ śānta eva mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: It got itself released from the binding ropes but it was surrounded everywhere by the soldiers. Making the sound of Hurfihd (i.$. bellowing sound), it rushed at everyone angrily.
verses.wordMeaning: It got itself released from the binding ropes but it was surrounded everywhere by the soldiers. Making the sound of Hurfihd (i.$. bellowing sound), it rushed at everyone angrily.
verses.commentary: Sense: It got itself released from the binding ropes but it was surrounded everywhere by the soldiers. Making the sound of Hurfihd (i.$. bellowing sound), it rushed at everyone angrily.

verses.sanskrit: स हन्यमानः सुभृशं चूर्णिताङ्गास्थिवन्धनः । निपपात महातेजा धरण्यां गतचेतनः
verses.transliteration: sa hanyamānaḥ subhṛśaṃ cūrṇitāṅgāsthivandhanaḥ / nipapāta mahātejā dharaṇyāṃ gatacetanaḥ
verses.translation: Hitting and lashing at everyone all round by means of its horns, hoofs and tip of the tail, the infuriated cow routed the entire army of the king and his minister.
verses.wordMeaning: Hitting and lashing at everyone all round by means of its horns, hoofs and tip of the tail, the infuriated cow routed the entire army of the king and his minister.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hitting and lashing at everyone all round by means of its horns, hoofs and tip of the tail, the infuriated cow routed the entire army of the king and his minister.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्मुनौ निपतिते स दुरात्मा विशङ्कितः । किङ्करानादिशच्छीघ्रं धेनोरानयने बलात्
verses.transliteration: tasminmunau nipatite sa durātmā viśaṅkitaḥ / kiṅkarānādiśacchīghraṃ dhenorānayane balāt
verses.translation: After routing all the servants quickly, the sacred cow went up to the sky, even as all living beings remained looking on.
verses.wordMeaning: After routing all the servants quickly, the sacred cow went up to the sky, even as all living beings remained looking on.
verses.commentary: Sense: After routing all the servants quickly, the sacred cow went up to the sky, even as all living beings remained looking on.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सवत्सां ता धेनुं बद्ध्वा पाशैर्दृढैर्नृपः । कशाभिरभिहन्यन्त चकृषुश्च निनीषया
verses.transliteration: tataḥ savatsāṃ tā dhenuṃ baddhvā pāśairdṛḍhairnṛpaḥ / kaśābhirabhihanyanta cakṛṣuśca ninīṣayā
verses.translation: Thereafter, those ruthless soldiers who had been
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, those ruthless soldiers who had been
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, those ruthless soldiers who had been

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्यमाणा बहुभिः कशाभिर्लगुडैरपि । हन्यमाना भृशं तैश्च चुक्रुधे च पयस्विनी
verses.transliteration: ākṛṣyamāṇā bahubhiḥ kaśābhirlaguḍairapi / hanyamānā bhṛśaṃ taiśca cukrudhe ca payasvinī
verses.translation: Taking the calf alone without the cow, that sinner (minister) came to the presence of the king along with the servants.
verses.hindi: श्री हयग्रीव जी ने कहा--किरि चक्र रवेन्द्र के पाँच वर्ष में समाश्रित जो देवता हैं उनके नागों का भी अदण कीजिए । है प्राज्ञ ! जिनके श्रवण करने वालों का जय हो हुआ करता है ।१। प्रथम पर्ज बिन्दु नामक हे। जिसमें दंड नायिका सम्प्राप्त है । वहां पर वह जगत के उदंडों के समुदाय
verses.wordMeaning: Taking the calf alone without the cow, that sinner (minister) came to the presence of the king along with the servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the calf alone without the cow, that sinner (minister) came to the presence of the king along with the servants.

verses.sanskrit: व्यथितातिकशापातैः क्रोधेन महातान्विता । आकृष्य पाशान् सुदृढान् कृत्वात्मानममोचयत्
verses.transliteration: vyathitātikaśāpātaiḥ krodhena mahātānvitā / ākṛṣya pāśān sudṛḍhān kṛtvātmānamamocayat
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.hindi: की विताशिका है ।२। यह नाना प्रकार को उवालाओं से जय श्री को नतंन कराया करतो है ।३। उद्दन्ड पौत्र के निर्घात से जिसने उद्धत दानवों को निभिन्न कर दिया है । दंष्ट्रा से गल मृगा्काशु के विभावन करने वाली विभावरी है । वर्षा कालीन मेघों के समूह के समान नील वपु बाली लता
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तपाशवन्धासा सर्वतो ऽभिवृता बलैः । हुंहारवं प्रकुर्वाणा सर्वतो ऽह्यपतद्रुषा
verses.transliteration: vimuktapāśavandhāsā sarvato 'bhivṛtā balaiḥ / huṃhāravaṃ prakurvāṇā sarvato 'hyapatadruṣā
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.hindi: है । बह किरि चक्र रथेन्द्र को वह सदा अलंकार के समान है। पोश्रिणी पुत्रिता के अशेष विश्वके आवर्त की कदम्बिका है ।४-५। उसी रथनाभ के दवितीय पर्छ में संश्रय लेने वाली है । दम्भिनी-मोहिनी और स्तम्भिनी-ये तोन ही हैं। विकसित दाडिमी के समान ओर सभो दानबों के मदन करने
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: विषाणखुरपुच्छाग्रैरभिहत्य समन्ततः । राजमन्त्रिबलं सर्वं व्यद्रावयदमर्षिता
verses.transliteration: viṣāṇakhurapucchāgrairabhihatya samantataḥ / rājamantribalaṃ sarvaṃ vyadrāvayadamarṣitā
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.hindi: वाली हैं ।६। यें अपने कर पल्लवों द्वारा जिनमें देदीप्यमान मणियों के वलय है-मुसल-हल ओर हला पात्र मणिगणों से मपित धारण करने बालों
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: विद्राव्य किङ्करान्सर्वांस्तरसैव पयस्विनी । पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां गगनं प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: vidrāvya kiṅkarānsarvāṃstarasaiva payasvinī / paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ gaganaṃ pratyapadyata
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते भग्नसंकल्पाः संभग्नक्षतविग्रहाः । प्रसह्य बद्ध्वा तद्वत्सं जग्मुरेवातिनिर्घृणाः
verses.transliteration: tataste bhagnasaṃkalpāḥ saṃbhagnakṣatavigrahāḥ / prasahya baddhvā tadvatsaṃ jagmurevātinirghṛṇāḥ
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: पयस्विनीं विना वत्सं गृहीत्वा किङ्करैः सह । स पापस्तरसा राज्ञः सन्निधिं समुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: payasvinīṃ vinā vatsaṃ gṛhītvā kiṅkaraiḥ saha / sa pāpastarasā rājñaḥ sannidhiṃ samupāgamat
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा समीपं नृपतेः प्रणम्यास्मै प्रशंसकृत् । तद्व्रत्तान्तमशेषेण व्याचचक्षे ससाध्वसः
verses.transliteration: gatvā samīpaṃ nṛpateḥ praṇamyāsmai praśaṃsakṛt / tadvrattāntamaśeṣeṇa vyācacakṣe sasādhvasaḥ
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने एकोनत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ २९॥ वासिष्ठ उवाच श्रुस्वैतत्सकलं राजा जमदग्निवधादिकम् । उद्विग्नचेताः सुभृशं चिन्तयामास नैकधा
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne ekonatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 29// vāsiṣṭha uvāca śrusvaitatsakalaṃ rājā jamadagnivadhādikam / udvignacetāḥ subhṛśaṃ cintayāmāsa naikadhā
verses.translation: On hearing the report of the murder of Jamadagni and similar events, the king became very much distressed in his mind. He thought about the various matters concerned.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the report of the murder of Jamadagni and similar events, the king became very much distressed in his mind. He thought about the various matters concerned.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the report of the murder of Jamadagni and similar events, the king became very much distressed in his mind. He thought about the various matters concerned.

verses.sanskrit: अहो मे सुनृसंसस्य लोकयोरुभयोरपि । ब्रह्मस्वहरणे वाञ्छा तद्धत्या चातिगर्हिता
verses.transliteration: aho me sunṛsaṃsasya lokayorubhayorapi / brahmasvaharaṇe vāñchā taddhatyā cātigarhitā
verses.translation: "Alas I have been very wicked in the events concern- ing both the worlds. Firstly my desire to take away the property of a Brahmana and secondly his (Jamadagni's) extremely censurable murder.
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas I have been very wicked in the events concern- ing both the worlds. Firstly my desire to take away the property of a Brahmana and secondly his (Jamadagni's) extremely censurable murder.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas I have been very wicked in the events concern- ing both the worlds. Firstly my desire to take away the property of a Brahmana and secondly his (Jamadagni's) extremely censurable murder.

verses.sanskrit: अहो नाश्रौषमस्याहं ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः । वचनं तर्हि तां जह्यां विमूढात्मा गतत्रपः
verses.transliteration: aho nāśrauṣamasyāhaṃ brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ / vacanaṃ tarhi tāṃ jahyāṃ vimūḍhātmā gatatrapaḥ
verses.translation: Deluded in mv mind and devoid of shame, I did not
verses.wordMeaning: Deluded in mv mind and devoid of shame, I did not
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded in mv mind and devoid of shame, I did not

verses.sanskrit: इति संचितयन्नंव हृदयेन विदूयता । स्वपुरं प्रतिचक्राम सबलः सानुगस्ततः
verses.transliteration: iti saṃcitayannaṃva hṛdayena vidūyatā / svapuraṃ praticakrāma sabalaḥ sānugastataḥ
verses.translation: Thinking thus with a grief-stricken heart, he returned to his city along with his army and followers.
verses.wordMeaning: Thinking thus with a grief-stricken heart, he returned to his city along with his army and followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus with a grief-stricken heart, he returned to his city along with his army and followers.

verses.sanskrit: पुरीं प्रतिगते राज्ञि तस्मिन्सपरिवारके । आश्रमात्सहसा राजन्विनिश्चक्राम रेणुका
verses.transliteration: purīṃ pratigate rājñi tasminsaparivārake / āśramātsahasā rājanviniścakrāma reṇukā
verses.translation: When the king went back towards his city along with his attendants, O king, Reiuka suddenly rushed out of hermitage.
verses.wordMeaning: When the king went back towards his city along with his attendants, O king, Reiuka suddenly rushed out of hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the king went back towards his city along with his attendants, O king, Reiuka suddenly rushed out of hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सक्षतसर्वाङ्गं रुधिरेण परिप्लुतम् । निश्चेष्टं परितं भूमौ ददर्श पतिमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: atha sakṣatasarvāṅgaṃ rudhireṇa pariplutam / niśceṣṭaṃ paritaṃ bhūmau dadarśa patimātmanaḥ
verses.translation: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.
verses.hindi: इनके नेत्र अत्यधिक तोईण एबं कराल है । जिनकी ज्वालाओं से बेत्यों के सैनिकों को दस्धसी कर रहो है और नि:शक होकर सूकरानना की सेना किया करती है ।५। ये किरिचक्र के तीसरे पर्व में समाश्रय लेने बाली हैं । अन्धिनी आदि पाँच देवियां देवी के यन्त्र में अपना आस्पद करने
verses.wordMeaning: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.
verses.commentary: Sense: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा विहतं मत्वा भर्त्तारं गतचेतनम् । अन्वाहतेवाशनिना मूर्छितान्यपतद्भुवि
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā vihataṃ matvā bharttāraṃ gatacetanam / anvāhatevāśaninā mūrchitānyapatadbhuvi
verses.translation: After a long time, she got up from the ground. She became more distressed and miserable. Falling down and getting up again and again, she wept loudly.
verses.hindi: बाली हैं ।६। इनका इतना कठोर अट्टहास होता है जिससे थे तीनों भुबनों का भेदन किया करती हैं। अङ्कना के देष का आश्रय ग्रहण कर कल्पारिन की ज्वालाओं के ही तुल्य होती हैं।१०। भष्डासुर की समस्त सेनाओं की रुधिर के प्लावन को चाटने की इच्छा करती हुई लेलिहान ज्वालाओं की
verses.wordMeaning: After a long time, she got up from the ground. She became more distressed and miserable. Falling down and getting up again and again, she wept loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a long time, she got up from the ground. She became more distressed and miserable. Falling down and getting up again and again, she wept loudly.

verses.sanskrit: चिरादिव पुनर्भूमेरुत्थायातीव दुःखिता । पतित्वोत्थाय सा भूयः सुस्वरं प्ररुरोद ह
verses.transliteration: cirādiva punarbhūmerutthāyātīva duḥkhitā / patitvotthāya sā bhūyaḥ susvaraṃ praruroda ha
verses.translation: With her body becoming dusky-white coloured on account of the dust from the ground, with her face covered with flowing tears, she lamented much. Fallen into the sea of sorrow, she became all the more pitiable.
verses.hindi: जिह्लाओं से उज्जवल ।११। ये सभी अतोब उदण्ड विक्रम बालो दण्डनाथा का निरन्तर सेवन किया करती हैं। किरिचक रथेस्द के चौथे पव' में इनका संश्रय होता है ।१२।बराह्की आदि पांचवी से रहित तथा आठवीं से रहित ये छे ही देविय। धद्चक्र की जलती हुई ज्वालाओों के कलेवर वाली हैं
verses.wordMeaning: With her body becoming dusky-white coloured on account of the dust from the ground, with her face covered with flowing tears, she lamented much. Fallen into the sea of sorrow, she became all the more pitiable.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her body becoming dusky-white coloured on account of the dust from the ground, with her face covered with flowing tears, she lamented much. Fallen into the sea of sorrow, she became all the more pitiable.

verses.sanskrit: विललाप च सात्यर्थं धरणीधूलिधूसरा । अश्रुपूर्ममुखी दीना पतिता शोकसागरे
verses.transliteration: vilalāpa ca sātyarthaṃ dharaṇīdhūlidhūsarā / aśrupūrmamukhī dīnā patitā śokasāgare
verses.translation: "Alas dear lord, fully familiar with all religious rites, ocean of the nectar of civility and courtesy, Fie upon over- quiescence. No one shall desire such a quietude as this.
verses.hindi: महान विक्रम के समुदाय के द्वारा दानवों का पान सा करने वाली हैं। दण्डनाथा की ही आज्ञा से ये उसी प्रदेश की उपासना किया करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas dear lord, fully familiar with all religious rites, ocean of the nectar of civility and courtesy, Fie upon over- quiescence. No one shall desire such a quietude as this.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas dear lord, fully familiar with all religious rites, ocean of the nectar of civility and courtesy, Fie upon over- quiescence. No one shall desire such a quietude as this.

verses.sanskrit: हा नाथ पिय धर्मज्ञ दाक्षिण्यामृतसागर । हा धिगत्यन्तशान्त त्वं नैव काङ्क्षेत चेदृशम्
verses.transliteration: hā nātha piya dharmajña dākṣiṇyāmṛtasāgara / hā dhigatyantaśānta tvaṃ naiva kāṅkṣeta cedṛśam
verses.translation: Friendship and intimacy of good people is said to be Sdptapada (produced when one accompanies another taking seven steps together or when one talks seven words with another). In regard to this, I have been cheated along with you. It behoves you to take me too to the place where you are going alone now.
verses.wordMeaning: Friendship and intimacy of good people is said to be Sdptapada (produced when one accompanies another taking seven steps together or when one talks seven words with another). In regard to this, I have been cheated along with you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Friendship and intimacy of good people is said to be Sdptapada (produced when one accompanies another taking seven steps together or when one talks seven words with another). In regard to this, I have been cheated along with you.…

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमादभिनिष्क्रान्तः सहसा व्यसानर्णवे । क्षिप्त्वानाथामगाधे मां क्व च यातो ऽसि मानद
verses.transliteration: āśramādabhiniṣkrāntaḥ sahasā vyasānarṇave / kṣiptvānāthāmagādhe māṃ kva ca yāto 'si mānada
verses.translation: She lamented thus. She wept again and again. Over- whelmed with ocean of excessive misery, she cried out "O Rama, O Rama."
verses.hindi: उसी पवे के नीचे त्वरिता स्थान के समा श्रित हँ । यक्षिणी-शंखनी- लाकिन-हाकिनी ।१५। शाकिनी-डाकिनो--उनकी एकता के स्वरूप वाली हाकिनी सातवों हैं--ये प्रचंड दोदेन्डों के विक्रम वाली हैं ।१६। ये समस्त भूतों को पान सा करती हैं तथा सम्पूर्ण मेदिनी का पान सा करती हुई हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: She lamented thus. She wept again and again. Over- whelmed with ocean of excessive misery, she cried out "O Rama, O Rama."
verses.commentary: Sense: She lamented thus. She wept again and again. Over- whelmed with ocean of excessive misery, she cried out "O Rama, O Rama."

verses.sanskrit: सतां साप्तपदे मैत्रे मुषिताहं त्वया सह । यासि यत्र त्वमेकाकी तत्र मां नेतुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: satāṃ sāptapade maitre muṣitāhaṃ tvayā saha / yāsi yatra tvamekākī tatra māṃ netumarhasi
verses.translation: In the meantime, Rama too returned to the hermitage, from the forest, accompanied by Akrtavraa and bearing the burden of the sacrificial twigs.
verses.hindi: ल्वचा-रक्त-मास-मेद और विरोधियों को अस्थियों को तथा मज्जा और शुक्र को विकट मुखों बाली पान सा करती हुई थीं। उनके अत्यधिक कठोर शिहनाद ये जिनसे वे दशों दिशाओं को पूरित कर रही थीं
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, Rama too returned to the hermitage, from the forest, accompanied by Akrtavraa and bearing the burden of the sacrificial twigs.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, Rama too returned to the hermitage, from the forest, accompanied by Akrtavraa and bearing the burden of the sacrificial twigs.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा त्वामीदृशावस्थमचिराद्धृदयं मम । न दीर्यते महाभाग कठिनाः खलु योषितः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tvāmīdṛśāvasthamacirāddhṛdayaṃ mama / na dīryate mahābhāga kaṭhināḥ khalu yoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: On the way he had seen many ill omens indica- ting fear from danger. On seeing them, he had become distres- sed in his heart. The holy lord then came to th$ hermitage immediately.
verses.hindi: अणिमा आदि आठों सिद्धियों को प्रदान करने वाली वे धातुनाथा कही हैं । दृष्ट देत्यो के मोहन-म।रण-स्तम्भन-ताइन भक्षण और आमूल निहृन्तन में परम पंडित और भक्ति शालियों के विषय में समस्त बिपदाओं का खंडन करने बाली थीं ।१६-२०। समस्त धातुओं में संस्थित बे धातुनाथा बतायी
verses.wordMeaning: On the way he had seen many ill omens indica- ting fear from danger. On seeing them, he had become distres- sed in his heart. The holy lord then came to th$ hermitage immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the way he had seen many ill omens indica- ting fear from danger. On seeing them, he had become distres- sed in his heart. The holy lord then came to th$ hermitage immediately.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं विलपन्ती सा रुदती च मुहुर्मुहुः । चुक्रोश रामरामेति भृशं दुःखपरिप्लुता
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ vilapantī sā rudatī ca muhurmuhuḥ / cukrośa rāmarāmeti bhṛśaṃ duḥkhapariplutā
verses.translation: Extremely afflicted on account of her separation from her husband, she beat her belly (?) with both of her hands, in front of Rama, O king.
verses.hindi: गयी हैं। अपनी तरङ्ों की मालाओं से अम्बर को चुम्बित करने वाले सातों सागरों में संस्थित थी
verses.wordMeaning: Extremely afflicted on account of her separation from her husband, she beat her belly (?) with both of her hands, in front of Rama, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Extremely afflicted on account of her separation from her husband, she beat her belly (?) with both of her hands, in front of Rama, O king.

verses.sanskrit: तावद्रामो ऽपि स वनात्समिद्भारसमन्वितः । अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः स्वाश्रमाय न्यवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: tāvadrāmo 'pi sa vanātsamidbhārasamanvitaḥ / akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ svāśramāya nyavarttata
verses.translation: Rama had already come to know the report in full on the way itself. Seeing his mother dejected on account of sorrow like a female osprey, he too became miserable.
verses.wordMeaning: Rama had already come to know the report in full on the way itself. Seeing his mother dejected on account of sorrow like a female osprey, he too became miserable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama had already come to know the report in full on the way itself. Seeing his mother dejected on account of sorrow like a female osprey, he too became miserable.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यद्भयशंसीनि निमित्तानि बहूनि सः । पश्यन्नुद्विग्नहृदयस्तूर्णं प्रापाश्रमं विभुः
verses.transliteration: apaśyadbhayaśaṃsīni nimittāni bahūni saḥ / paśyannudvignahṛdayastūrṇaṃ prāpāśramaṃ vibhuḥ
verses.translation: Though overwhelmed by misery and sorrow, the intelligent sage (i.e. Rama) regained his courage. With both the eyes filled with tears, he stood on the ground with his face directed downwards.
verses.wordMeaning: Though overwhelmed by misery and sorrow, the intelligent sage (i.e. Rama) regained his courage. With both the eyes filled with tears, he stood on the ground with his face directed downwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though overwhelmed by misery and sorrow, the intelligent sage (i.e. Rama) regained his courage. With both the eyes filled with tears, he stood on the ground with his face directed downwards.

verses.sanskrit: तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य रुदती सा भृशातुरा । नविभूतेव शोकेन प्रारुदद्रेणुका पुनः
verses.transliteration: tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya rudatī sā bhṛśāturā / navibhūteva śokena prārudadreṇukā punaḥ
verses.translation: Nowhere do people like you, O highly fortunate one, bewail too much. Great men with fortitude are never miserable over a loss.
verses.wordMeaning: Nowhere do people like you, O highly fortunate one, bewail too much. Great men with fortitude are never miserable over a loss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nowhere do people like you, O highly fortunate one, bewail too much. Great men with fortitude are never miserable over a loss.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्य पुरतो राजन्भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता । उभाभ्यामपि हस्ताभ्यामुदरं समताडयत्
verses.transliteration: rāmasya purato rājanbhartṛvyasanapīḍitā / ubhābhyāmapi hastābhyāmudaraṃ samatāḍayat
verses.translation: Hence, be pleased to regain your wealth of courage and console your mother who is weeping profusely, because her mind is upset by the suspicion of immediate widowhood.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, be pleased to regain your wealth of courage and console your mother who is weeping profusely, because her mind is upset by the suspicion of immediate widowhood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, be pleased to regain your wealth of courage and console your mother who is weeping profusely, because her mind is upset by the suspicion of immediate widowhood.

verses.sanskrit: मार्गे विदितवृत्तान्तः सम्यग्रामो ऽपि मातरम् । कुररीमिव शोकार्त्ता दृष्ट्वा दुःखमुपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: mārge viditavṛttāntaḥ samyagrāmo 'pi mātaram / kurarīmiva śokārttā dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamupeyivān
verses.translation: An object that has passed off never returns. Hence, forget everything that has taken place and think about your duty."
verses.hindi: नित्यमेव च सेवन्ते पोत्रिणीं द डनायिकाम्
verses.wordMeaning: An object that has passed off never returns. Hence, forget everything that has taken place and think about your duty."
verses.commentary: Sense: An object that has passed off never returns. Hence, forget everything that has taken place and think about your duty."

verses.sanskrit: धैर्यमारोप्य मेधावी दुःशशोकपरिप्लुतः । नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां तस्थौ भूमावर्धोमुखः
verses.transliteration: dhairyamāropya medhāvī duḥśaśokapariplutaḥ / netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṃ tasthau bhūmāvardhomukhaḥ
verses.translation: On being appeased by him thus, Rama steadied his soul by his own efforts, slowly.
verses.hindi: क्रोधिनी स्तंमिनी ख्याते वतेते देवते उभे
verses.wordMeaning: On being appeased by him thus, Rama steadied his soul by his own efforts, slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being appeased by him thus, Rama steadied his soul by his own efforts, slowly.

verses.sanskrit: तं तथागतमालोक्य रामं प्राहाकृतव्रणः । किमिदं भृगुशार्दूल नैतत्वय्युपपाद्यते
verses.transliteration: taṃ tathāgatamālokya rāmaṃ prāhākṛtavraṇaḥ / kimidaṃ bhṛguśārdūla naitatvayyupapādyate
verses.translation: Overwhelmed by sorrow and misery, Renuka wept again and again. She beat her belly (?) twentyone times with the pair of her hands.
verses.wordMeaning: Overwhelmed by sorrow and misery, Renuka wept again and again. She beat her belly (?) twentyone times with the pair of her hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Overwhelmed by sorrow and misery, Renuka wept again and again. She beat her belly (?) twentyone times with the pair of her hands.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वादृशा महाभाग भृशं शोचन्ति कुत्रचित् । धृतिमन्तो महान्तस्तु दुःखं कुर्वति न व्यये
verses.transliteration: na tvādṛśā mahābhāga bhṛśaṃ śocanti kutracit / dhṛtimanto mahāntastu duḥkhaṃ kurvati na vyaye
verses.translation: Meanwhile with tears welling up in his eyes, Rama came near her and consoled his weeping mother, saying — "Enough, mother".
verses.wordMeaning: Meanwhile with tears welling up in his eyes, Rama came near her and consoled his weeping mother, saying — "Enough, mother".
verses.commentary: Sense: Meanwhile with tears welling up in his eyes, Rama came near her and consoled his weeping mother, saying — "Enough, mother".

verses.sanskrit: शोकः सर्वेन्द्रियाणां हि परिशोषप्रदायकः । त्यज शोकं महाबाहो न तत्पात्रं भवदृशाः
verses.transliteration: śokaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ hi pariśoṣapradāyakaḥ / tyaja śokaṃ mahābāho na tatpātraṃ bhavadṛśāḥ
verses.translation: On being consoled thus by him, Renuka regained her courage with great difficulty despite her inordinate misery, and said "So be it" in reply.
verses.wordMeaning: On being consoled thus by him, Renuka regained her courage with great difficulty despite her inordinate misery, and said "So be it" in reply.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being consoled thus by him, Renuka regained her courage with great difficulty despite her inordinate misery, and said "So be it" in reply.

verses.sanskrit: एहिकामुष्मिकार्थानां नूनमेकान्तरोधकः । शोकस्तस्यावकाशं त्वं कथं त्दृदि नियच्छसि
verses.transliteration: ehikāmuṣmikārthānāṃ nūnamekāntarodhakaḥ / śokastasyāvakāśaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ tdṛdi niyacchasi
verses.translation: Then, along with his brothers, Rama of long power- ful arms, made preparations for the cremation of his father's body by means of fire, in accordance with the injunc- tions, O king.
verses.hindi: इन सब समुबरों को आधे ही क्षण में पान करने में इनका बहुत अधिक साहस निष्पन्न था । इनके दांत शकट के समान आकार वाले थे और इनके मुख बहुत ही विकराल थे एवं परम भीषण लोचन ये ।२२। ये अपनी स्वा- मिनी से द्रोह करने वाले और अपने समय के द्रोहियो के तथा वेदिक रोहण
verses.wordMeaning: Then, along with his brothers, Rama of long power- ful arms, made preparations for the cremation of his father's body by means of fire, in accordance with the injunc- tions, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, along with his brothers, Rama of long power- ful arms, made preparations for the cremation of his father's body by means of fire, in accordance with the injunc- tions, O king.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वं धैर्यधनो भूत्वा परिसांत्वय मातरम् । रुदतीं बत वैधव्यशं कापहतचेतनाम्
verses.transliteration: tattvaṃ dhairyadhano bhūtvā parisāṃtvaya mātaram / rudatīṃ bata vaidhavyaśaṃ kāpahatacetanām
verses.translation: Renuka of steadfast holy rites, whose body was overwhelmed with sorrow for her husband, called all her sons together and spoke these words:
verses.hindi: से द्रोही बीर बेरियों के एवं यज्ञों से द्रोह करने वाले परम दुष्ट देत्यो के भक्षण करने में ये सब समान थीं । ये नित्य ही पोत्रिणी दण्ड नायिका का सेवन किया करती हैं ।२३-२४। उसी पर्व के पाशवं में द्वितीय दिव्य मन्दिर में रोधिनी और स्तम्भिनी प्रसिद्ध हैं और ये दो देवता बत्तमान रहती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Renuka of steadfast holy rites, whose body was overwhelmed with sorrow for her husband, called all her sons together and spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Renuka of steadfast holy rites, whose body was overwhelmed with sorrow for her husband, called all her sons together and spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: नैवागमनमस्तीह व्यतिक्रान्तस्य वस्तुनः । तस्मादतीतमखिलं त्यक्त्वा कृत्यं विचिन्तय
verses.transliteration: naivāgamanamastīha vyatikrāntasya vastunaḥ / tasmādatītamakhilaṃ tyaktvā kṛtyaṃ vicintaya
verses.translation: O my sons, I wish to follow your father who has gone to Heaven and who was by nature meritorious. It behoves you all to allow me to do so.
verses.hindi: हैं जिनमें उनके कडूण भी हिलते रहा करते हैं। ये दें के शत्रुओं की सेना के रक्त और हाला के पान करने में मदोद्धत हैं ।२६। इनके नेत्र दित्य ही विधूणित हैं और इनके मुखों पर प्रहास रहा करता है। इसके अनन्तर रथे के किरि के दोनों पाश्वों में आवास करने वाला उत्तम आयुधों का
verses.wordMeaning: O my sons, I wish to follow your father who has gone to Heaven and who was by nature meritorious. It behoves you all to allow me to do so.
verses.commentary: Sense: O my sons, I wish to follow your father who has gone to Heaven and who was by nature meritorious. It behoves you all to allow me to do so.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं सांत्वमानश्च तेन दुःशसमन्वितः । रामः संस्तंभयामास शनैरात्मानमात्मना
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ sāṃtvamānaśca tena duḥśasamanvitaḥ / rāmaḥ saṃstaṃbhayāmāsa śanairātmānamātmanā
verses.translation: Hence, I shall follow my beloved husband so that I shall proceed along with him without interruption for ever in the other world.
verses.hindi: दन्द्र-हल-मुसल देवता के रूप में समास्थित है
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, I shall follow my beloved husband so that I shall proceed along with him without interruption for ever in the other world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, I shall follow my beloved husband so that I shall proceed along with him without interruption for ever in the other world.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखशोकपरीता हि रेणुका त्वरुदन्मुहः । त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो हस्ताभ्यामुदरं समताडयत्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhaśokaparītā hi reṇukā tvarudanmuhaḥ / triḥsaptakṛtvo hastābhyāmudaraṃ samatāḍayat
verses.translation: By entering this burning pyre, I will be slightly after a long time, the dear guest of my husband in the world of the
verses.wordMeaning: By entering this burning pyre, I will be slightly after a long time, the dear guest of my husband in the world of the
verses.commentary: Sense: By entering this burning pyre, I will be slightly after a long time, the dear guest of my husband in the world of the

verses.sanskrit: तावत्तदन्तिकं रामः समभ्येत्याश्रुलोचनः । रुदतीमलमंबेति सांत्वयामास मातरम्
verses.transliteration: tāvattadantikaṃ rāmaḥ samabhyetyāśrulocanaḥ / rudatīmalamaṃbeti sāṃtvayāmāsa mātaram
verses.translation: After saying these words with firm decision, Renuka decided to follow her husband by entering the fire.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying these words with firm decision, Renuka decided to follow her husband by entering the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying these words with firm decision, Renuka decided to follow her husband by entering the fire.

verses.sanskrit: उवाचापनयन्दुःखाद्भर्तृशोकपरायणाम् । त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो यदिदं त्वया वक्षः समाहतम्
verses.transliteration: uvācāpanayanduḥkhādbhartṛśokaparāyaṇām / triḥsaptakṛtvo yadidaṃ tvayā vakṣaḥ samāhatam
verses.translation: At that very juncture an incorporeal speech uttered thus, addressing Repuka along with her sons.
verses.wordMeaning: At that very juncture an incorporeal speech uttered thus, addressing Repuka along with her sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that very juncture an incorporeal speech uttered thus, addressing Repuka along with her sons.

verses.sanskrit: तावतसंख्यमहं तस्मात्क्षत्त्रजारमशेषतः । हनिष्ये भुवि सर्वत्र सत्यमेतद्ब्रविमि ते
verses.transliteration: tāvatasaṃkhyamahaṃ tasmātkṣattrajāramaśeṣataḥ / haniṣye bhuvi sarvatra satyametadbravimi te
verses.translation: "O Renuka, listen attentively to my words, along
verses.hindi: सदा संसेवते देवीं पश्यन्नेब हि फोत्रिणीम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O Renuka, listen attentively to my words, along
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Renuka, listen attentively to my words, along

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वं शोकमुत्सृज्य धैर्यमातिष्ट सांप्रतम् । नास्त्येव नूनमायातमतिक्रान्तस्य वस्तुनः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvaṃ śokamutsṛjya dhairyamātiṣṭa sāṃpratam / nāstyeva nūnamāyātamatikrāntasya vastunaḥ
verses.translation: No rash and reckless act should be committed by anyone who desires his own welfare. You must not die. If one continues to live, one is sure to see happiness.
verses.wordMeaning: No rash and reckless act should be committed by anyone who desires his own welfare. You must not die. If one continues to live, one is sure to see happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: No rash and reckless act should be committed by anyone who desires his own welfare. You must not die. If one continues to live, one is sure to see happiness.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ता रेणुका तेन भृशं दुःखान्वितापि सा । कृच्छ्राद्धैर्यं समालंब्य तथेति प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: ityuktā reṇukā tena bhṛśaṃ duḥkhānvitāpi sā / kṛcchrāddhairyaṃ samālaṃbya tatheti pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Hence, O lady of bright smiles, sustain your asset of fortitude. Bide your time screening yourself behind an inevi- table cause.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O lady of bright smiles, sustain your asset of fortitude. Bide your time screening yourself behind an inevi- table cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O lady of bright smiles, sustain your asset of fortitude. Bide your time screening yourself behind an inevi- table cause.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामो महाबाहुः पितुः सह सहोदरैः । अग्नौ सत्कर्त्तुमारेभे देहं राजन्यथविधि
verses.transliteration: tato rāmo mahābāhuḥ pituḥ saha sahodaraiḥ / agnau satkarttumārebhe dehaṃ rājanyathavidhi
verses.translation: Ere long your husband will regain consciousness. O splendid lady, when he is resuscitated you will realize your desires. You will be the recipient of much weal lasting for a long time."
verses.hindi: अपने मुकुट के स्थान में स्वकीय आयुधों के विग्रह को धारण करते हुए जगत् के नाशक का देवगणों ने स्मरण किया था ।२९। इसको आयुधों के जोड़े से दण्ड नायिका ललिता विषजू नामदानह संग्राम का खण्डन कर देगी ।३०। दण्डनाथा के उसी पर्व की अग्र सीमा में वत्त मान महान् भीम-
verses.wordMeaning: Ere long your husband will regain consciousness. O splendid lady, when he is resuscitated you will realize your desires. You will be the recipient of much weal lasting for a long time."
verses.commentary: Sense: Ere long your husband will regain consciousness. O splendid lady, when he is resuscitated you will realize your desires. You will be the recipient of much weal lasting for a long time."

verses.sanskrit: भर्तृशोकपरिताङ्गी रेणुकापि दृढव्रता । पुत्रान्सर्वान्समाहूय त्विदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: bhartṛśokaparitāṅgī reṇukāpi dṛḍhavratā / putrānsarvānsamāhūya tvidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Having heard those words (of the incorporeal speech) Renuka regained fortitude. Out of respect and high value of that (Divine speech), the sons became delighted.
verses.hindi: लिह वत्तंमान है जो अपनी गर्जना से नभो मण्डल को ध्वनित कर रहा था ।३९ वह अपने दांतों को कटकटा रहा था जिस कट कटाहटसे सब दिशाओं में वधिरता छा गयी थी यह चंडोच्चंड- इस नाम ने विख्यात था और यह हाथ का तथा तीन लोचनों बाला था ।३२। यह शूल-खंग-ग्रेत और पां
verses.wordMeaning: Having heard those words (of the incorporeal speech) Renuka regained fortitude. Out of respect and high value of that (Divine speech), the sons became delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having heard those words (of the incorporeal speech) Renuka regained fortitude. Out of respect and high value of that (Divine speech), the sons became delighted.

verses.sanskrit: रेणुकोवाच । अहं व-पितरं पुत्राः स्वर्गतं पुण्यशीलिनम् । अनुगन्तुमिहेच्छामि तन्मे ऽनुज्ञातुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: reṇukovāca / ahaṃ va-pitaraṃ putrāḥ svargataṃ puṇyaśīlinam / anugantumihecchāmi tanme 'nujñātumarhatha
verses.translation: Thereafter, • they took the body of the sage, their father, to the inner apartments of the hermitage. Laying it in a place sheltered from the wind, they sat all around it.
verses.hindi: को घारण करने वाला तथा परम दीप्त विग्रह था । यह सदा ही पोभिणी की ओर ही देखता हुआ देवी की सेवा किया करता है ।३३। किरिचक्र रथेन्द के ष्ठ पर्वे पर समाश्रय लेने वाली बार्तालो--आदि आठ देवियाँ हैं जो आठों दिशाओं मे उपविशत हैं ।३४। ये आठ पर्वतों के निष्पात से परम
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, • they took the body of the sage, their father, to the inner apartments of the hermitage. Laying it in a place sheltered from the wind, they sat all around it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, • they took the body of the sage, their father, to the inner apartments of the hermitage. Laying it in a place sheltered from the wind, they sat all around it.

verses.sanskrit: असह्यदुःशं वैधव्यं सहमाना कथं पुनः । भर्त्रा विरहिता तेन प्रवर्त्तिष्ये विनिन्दिता
verses.transliteration: asahyaduḥśaṃ vaidhavyaṃ sahamānā kathaṃ punaḥ / bhartrā virahitā tena pravarttiṣye vininditā
verses.translation: He knew the mystic lore of MrtasaHjivini1 whereby
verses.hindi: घोर निर्धात के घोष वाली थी । आठ नागों के स्फुरित भूषा से समुत तथा न नष्ठ होने वाले बल ओर तेज बाली थो
verses.wordMeaning: He knew the mystic lore of MrtasaHjivini1 whereby
verses.commentary: Sense: He knew the mystic lore of MrtasaHjivini1 whereby

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनुगमिष्यामि भर्त्तारं दयितं मम । यथा तेन प्रवर्त्तिष्ये परत्रापि सहानिशम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādanugamiṣyāmi bharttāraṃ dayitaṃ mama / yathā tena pravarttiṣye paratrāpi sahāniśam
verses.translation: That great sage arrived at the hermitage. On entering it he saw them all in the same miserable plight over- whelmed with sorrow.
verses.wordMeaning: That great sage arrived at the hermitage. On entering it he saw them all in the same miserable plight over- whelmed with sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great sage arrived at the hermitage. On entering it he saw them all in the same miserable plight over- whelmed with sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलन्तमिममेवाग्निं संप्रविश्य चिरादिव । भर्तुर्मम भविष्यामि पितृलोकप्रियातिथिः
verses.transliteration: jvalantamimamevāgniṃ saṃpraviśya cirādiva / bharturmama bhaviṣyāmi pitṛlokapriyātithiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Bhrgu, the original sire of their family, they joyously stood up, honoured him and offered him the most excellent seat:
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Bhrgu, the original sire of their family, they joyously stood up, honoured him and offered him the most excellent seat:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Bhrgu, the original sire of their family, they joyously stood up, honoured him and offered him the most excellent seat:

verses.sanskrit: अनुवादमृते पुत्रा भवद्भिस्तत्र कर्मणि । प्रतिभूय न वक्तव्यं यदि मत्प्रियमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: anuvādamṛte putrā bhavadbhistatra karmaṇi / pratibhūya na vaktavyaṃ yadi matpriyamicchatha
verses.translation: The great sage congratulated and blessed them all. He asked them — "What has happened here?** They narrated everything to him.
verses.wordMeaning: The great sage congratulated and blessed them all. He asked them — "What has happened here?** They narrated everything to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sage congratulated and blessed them all. He asked them — "What has happened here?** They narrated everything to him.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं रेणुका दृढनिश्चया । अग्निं प्रविश्य भर्त्तारमनुगन्तुं मनोदधे
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ reṇukā dṛḍhaniścayā / agniṃ praviśya bharttāramanugantuṃ manodadhe
verses.translation: "If the prowess of my performance of sacrifice and Tapas (penance) is auspicious, let this (sage Jamadagni) come to life thereby. Let him get up like one who had gone to sleep".
verses.wordMeaning: "If the prowess of my performance of sacrifice and Tapas (penance) is auspicious, let this (sage Jamadagni) come to life thereby. Let him get up like one who had gone to sleep".
verses.commentary: Sense: "If the prowess of my performance of sacrifice and Tapas (penance) is auspicious, let this (sage Jamadagni) come to life thereby. Let him get up like one who had gone to sleep".

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रेणुकां तनयैः सह । समाभाष्यातिगंभीरा वागुवाचाशरीरीणी
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu reṇukāṃ tanayaiḥ saha / samābhāṣyātigaṃbhīrā vāguvācāśarīrīṇī
verses.translation: On seeing Bhrgu, his own respectable grandfather1 standing there, O king, he bowed down to him devoutly. With palms joined in reverence he said —
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Bhrgu, his own respectable grandfather1 standing there, O king, he bowed down to him devoutly. With palms joined in reverence he said —
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Bhrgu, his own respectable grandfather1 standing there, O king, he bowed down to him devoutly. With palms joined in reverence he said —

verses.sanskrit: हे रेणुके स्वतनयैर्गिरं मे ऽवहिता शृणु । मा कार्षीः साहसं भद्रे प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रियं तव
verses.transliteration: he reṇuke svatanayairgiraṃ me 'vahitā śṛṇu / mā kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ bhadre pravakṣyāmi priyaṃ tava
verses.translation: On being asked thus, O king, the intelligent sage Bhrgu, the omniscient holy lord, meditated and thought for a long time and explained the reason.
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked thus, O king, the intelligent sage Bhrgu, the omniscient holy lord, meditated and thought for a long time and explained the reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked thus, O king, the intelligent sage Bhrgu, the omniscient holy lord, meditated and thought for a long time and explained the reason.

verses.sanskrit: साहसो नैव कर्त्तव्यः केनाप्यात्महितैषिणा । न मर्त्तव्यन्त्वया सर्वो जीवन्भद्राणि पश्यति
verses.transliteration: sāhaso naiva karttavyaḥ kenāpyātmahitaiṣiṇā / na marttavyantvayā sarvo jīvanbhadrāṇi paśyati
verses.translation: Listen, O highly fortunate and dear one, listen to the cause of this act whereby, O sinless one, he committed an evil offence towards you, the omniscient one.
verses.hindi: परम प्रकृष्ट बाहुओं की प्रकांड ऊधष्मा में करोड़ों दानव हुत हो रहे थे । ऐसी ये देवियाँ अहनिण दण्डनाथा श्री ललिता देवी की सेवा किया करती हैं । उनकी आख्या तो परम विख्यात है। है कुम्भज ! उसका आप श्रवण कीजिए। वार््ाली-वाराही-बाराह मुखी--अन्धिनी--जुम्भिणी--
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O highly fortunate and dear one, listen to the cause of this act whereby, O sinless one, he committed an evil offence towards you, the omniscient one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O highly fortunate and dear one, listen to the cause of this act whereby, O sinless one, he committed an evil offence towards you, the omniscient one.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धैर्यधना भूत्वा भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी । निमित्तमन्तरीकृत्य किञ्चिदेव शुचिस्मिते
verses.transliteration: tasmāddhairyadhanā bhūtvā bhava tvaṃ kālakāṅkṣiṇī / nimittamantarīkṛtya kiñcideva śucismite
verses.translation: He had been cursed formerly by Vasistha1 for the
verses.hindi: मोहिनी- स्तम्भिनी-ये हैं जो शत्रुओं के क्षोभ और स्तम्भन तथा उच्चा- टन करने में परम समर्थ है ।३६-३८। इनकी संस्थिति पव के वाम भाग में निरन्तर रहा करती है । उस दंडनाथा का उप वाह्य कासर हैं जिसको धूसर आकृति हैं ।३९। यह आधे कोश के बराबर आयत है । इसके दो सींग
verses.wordMeaning: He had been cursed formerly by Vasistha1 for the
verses.commentary: Sense: He had been cursed formerly by Vasistha1 for the

verses.sanskrit: अचिरेणैव भर्त्ता ते भविष्यति सचेतनः । उत्पन्नजीवितेन त्वं कामं प्राप्स्यसि शोभने । भवित्री चिररात्राय बहुकल्याण भाजनम्
verses.transliteration: acireṇaiva bharttā te bhaviṣyati sacetanaḥ / utpannajīvitena tvaṃ kāmaṃ prāpsyasi śobhane / bhavitrī cirarātrāya bahukalyāṇa bhājanam
verses.translation: Hence, though he may be warded off continuously by you, his father, O bestower of honour, he will surely carry it out with all his might, due to the force of the inevitable future.
verses.hindi: है और एक कोश के बराबर बिग्रह वाला है । इसके जो केश हैं वे खड्ग के समान कठोर हैं जिनसे इसका कलेवर ढका हुआ है ।४०। कालडंड के तुल्य उच्चंड बालों के कांड से बड़ा ही भयंकर है । यह नीले आनन के पयत के समान परम विकट और उन्नत रुष्ट भू वाला है ।४१। महानील गिरि के
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, though he may be warded off continuously by you, his father, O bestower of honour, he will surely carry it out with all his might, due to the force of the inevitable future.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, though he may be warded off continuously by you, his father, O bestower of honour, he will surely carry it out with all his might, due to the force of the inevitable future.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा धृतिमालंब्य रेणुका । तद्वाक्यगौरवाद्धर्षमवापुस्तनयाश्च ते
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhṛtimālaṃbya reṇukā / tadvākyagauravāddharṣamavāpustanayāśca te
verses.translation: O highly fortunate son of Brahm&, recount unto me the activities of Paraiurama. What did that highly vigorous sage do, when he got extremely enraged by the act of the king?
verses.hindi: समान गरिष्ठ एके श्रेष्ठ स्कन्धं के मंडल वाला है। प्रभूत ऊष्मा से युक्त निश्वास के प्रसार से सागर को भी प्रकम्पित करने वाला है
verses.wordMeaning: O highly fortunate son of Brahm&, recount unto me the activities of Paraiurama. What did that highly vigorous sage do, when he got extremely enraged by the act of the king?
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly fortunate son of Brahm&, recount unto me the activities of Paraiurama. What did that highly vigorous sage do, when he got extremely enraged by the act of the king?

verses.sanskrit: ततोनीत्वा पितुर्देहमाश्रमाभ्यन्तरं मुनेः । शाययित्वा निवाते तु परितः समुपाविशन्
verses.transliteration: tatonītvā piturdehamāśramābhyantaraṃ muneḥ / śāyayitvā nivāte tu paritaḥ samupāviśan
verses.translation: After that highly fortunate sage Bhrgu had departed, the infuriated sage Rama who was devoted to his father, spoke thus, having hevy sighs again and again.
verses.wordMeaning: After that highly fortunate sage Bhrgu had departed, the infuriated sage Rama who was devoted to his father, spoke thus, having hevy sighs again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After that highly fortunate sage Bhrgu had departed, the infuriated sage Rama who was devoted to his father, spoke thus, having hevy sighs again and again.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तत्रोपविष्टानामप्रहृष्टात्मचेतसाम् । निमत्तानि शुभान्यासन्ननेकानि महान्ति च
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tatropaviṣṭānāmaprahṛṣṭātmacetasām / nimattāni śubhānyāsannanekāni mahānti ca
verses.translation: Alas, see the foolishness of king Karttavirya who has
verses.wordMeaning: Alas, see the foolishness of king Karttavirya who has
verses.commentary: Sense: Alas, see the foolishness of king Karttavirya who has

verses.sanskrit: तेन ते किञ्चिदाश्वस्तचेतसो मुनिपुङ्गवाः । निषेदुः सहिता मात्रा काङ्क्षन्तो जीवितं पितुः
verses.transliteration: tena te kiñcidāśvastacetaso munipuṅgavāḥ / niṣeduḥ sahitā mātrā kāṅkṣanto jīvitaṃ pituḥ
verses.translation: Let all the sages hear (as witness) the vow that is' taken by me. I shall avenge my father by killing Karttavirya in the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Let all the sages hear (as witness) the vow that is' taken by me. I shall avenge my father by killing Karttavirya in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let all the sages hear (as witness) the vow that is' taken by me. I shall avenge my father by killing Karttavirya in the battle.
