verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन्भृगुवंशधरो मुनिः । विधेर्बलेन मतिमांस्तत्रागच्छद्यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare rājanbhṛguvaṃśadharo muniḥ / vidherbalena matimāṃstatrāgacchadyadṛcchayā
verses.translation: Even if the king were to be defended by Indra and other Devas as well as by Danavas, I shall certainly kill him. It won't be otherwise."
verses.wordMeaning: Even if the king were to be defended by Indra and other Devas as well as by Danavas, I shall certainly kill him. It won't be otherwise."
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if the king were to be defended by Indra and other Devas as well as by Danavas, I shall certainly kill him. It won't be otherwise."

verses.sanskrit: अथर्वणां विधिः सा क्षाद्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । सर्वशास्त्रार्थवित्प्राज्ञः सकलासुरवन्दितः
verses.transliteration: atharvaṇāṃ vidhiḥ sā kṣādvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / sarvaśāstrārthavitprājñaḥ sakalāsuravanditaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words thus spoken by Rama, the noble-souled sage Jamadagni said to his son who had spoken so boldly and daringly.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words thus spoken by Rama, the noble-souled sage Jamadagni said to his son who had spoken so boldly and daringly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words thus spoken by Rama, the noble-souled sage Jamadagni said to his son who had spoken so boldly and daringly.

verses.sanskrit: मृतसंजीविनीं विद्यां यो वेद मुनिदुर्लभाम् । यथाहतान्मृतान्देवैरुत्थापयति दानवान्
verses.transliteration: mṛtasaṃjīvinīṃ vidyāṃ yo veda munidurlabhām / yathāhatānmṛtāndevairutthāpayati dānavān
verses.translation: Listen Rama. I shall recount the eternal virtue of good men. On paying heed to this, all men become virtuous.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen Rama. I shall recount the eternal virtue of good men. On paying heed to this, all men become virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen Rama. I shall recount the eternal virtue of good men. On paying heed to this, all men become virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रमोशनसं येन राज्ञां राज्यफलप्रदम् । प्रणीतमनुजीवन्ति सर्वे ऽद्यापीह पार्थिवाः
verses.transliteration: śāstramośanasaṃ yena rājñāṃ rājyaphalapradam / praṇītamanujīvanti sarve 'dyāpīha pārthivāḥ
verses.translation: Good persons of exalted fortune who are desirous of ultimate freedom from the worldly existence, do not become excessively furious with anyone, although they are condemned and beaten.
verses.wordMeaning: Good persons of exalted fortune who are desirous of ultimate freedom from the worldly existence, do not become excessively furious with anyone, although they are condemned and beaten.
verses.commentary: Sense: Good persons of exalted fortune who are desirous of ultimate freedom from the worldly existence, do not become excessively furious with anyone, although they are condemned and beaten.

verses.sanskrit: स तदाश्रममासाद्य प्रविष्टो ऽन्तर्महामुनिः । ददर्श तदवस्थांस्तान्सर्वान्दुःखपरिप्लुतान्
verses.transliteration: sa tadāśramamāsādya praviṣṭo 'ntarmahāmuniḥ / dadarśa tadavasthāṃstānsarvānduḥkhapariplutān
verses.translation: Those ascetics of exalted fortune exercise full control over their sense-organs. To such men of perpetual good actions are the worlds of never-ending pleasure.
verses.hindi: इसकी ध्वनि घर्घराहट कालरूपो महिष का भी उपहास सा कर रही थी । इसके खुरों के निक्षेष से पुष्कल आवत्त वारिद हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Those ascetics of exalted fortune exercise full control over their sense-organs. To such men of perpetual good actions are the worlds of never-ending pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those ascetics of exalted fortune exercise full control over their sense-organs. To such men of perpetual good actions are the worlds of never-ending pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ते तु भृगुं दृष्ट्वा वंशम्य पितरं मुदा । उत्थायास्मै ददुश्चापि सत्कृत्य परमासनम्
verses.transliteration: atha te tu bhṛguṃ dṛṣṭvā vaṃśamya pitaraṃ mudā / utthāyāsmai daduścāpi satkṛtya paramāsanam
verses.translation: He who retaliates by beating a person who beats him is not a S&dhu. He is a sinner. We are S&dkus and Brdhmanas who have attained a venerable status, due to forbearance.
verses.hindi: उसके हो पव के नोचे को ओर चित्रालयों में संस्थिति करने बाले इनर आदि अनेक दों वाले दिशाओं के आठ देवता ये ।४८। ये सबललिता में कार्यों की सिद्धि के हो विज्ञापन करने के लिये वहाँ पर समागत हुए ये । इन्द्र और अप्सराए सब चौसठ करोड़ थे ।४५। सिद्ध-अग्नि-साध्य-विण्वे-
verses.wordMeaning: He who retaliates by beating a person who beats him is not a S&dhu. He is a sinner. We are S&dkus and Brdhmanas who have attained a venerable status, due to forbearance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who retaliates by beating a person who beats him is not a S&dhu. He is a sinner. We are S&dkus and Brdhmanas who have attained a venerable status, due to forbearance.

verses.sanskrit: स चाशीर्भिस्तु तान्सर्वानभिनन्द्य महामुनिः । पप्रच्छ किमिदं वृत्तं तत्सर्वं ते न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: sa cāśīrbhistu tānsarvānabhinandya mahāmuniḥ / papraccha kimidaṃ vṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ te nyavedayan
verses.translation: A very great sin may result if the king is slain, O dear one: Hence, I restrain you now. Accord forgiveness and perform a penance."
verses.hindi: देवा-विश्‍वकर्मा-भय--वलोन्नत मातृगण--रद्ध-परिचार--रद्र--पिशाच- राक्षसों के नाम तथा बहुत राक्षस क्रन्दन करते हैं ।४६-४७। वहां पर मित्र- गस्धव' सदा ही गान करने में परायण थे। विश्वा वसु आदि सब जो विख्यात हैं उसके आगे गमन करने बाले थे ।४८। उसी भांति से भूतगण--
verses.wordMeaning: A very great sin may result if the king is slain, O dear one: Hence, I restrain you now. Accord forgiveness and perform a penance."
verses.commentary: Sense: A very great sin may result if the king is slain, O dear one: Hence, I restrain you now. Accord forgiveness and perform a penance."

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा स भृगुः शीघ्रं जलमादाय मन्त्रवित् । संजीविन्या विनया तं सिषेच प्रोच्चरन्निदम्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā sa bhṛguḥ śīghraṃ jalamādāya mantravit / saṃjīvinyā vinayā taṃ siṣeca proccarannidam
verses.translation: After understanding fully what had been commanded thus by his father, O prince, Rama, the suppressor of enemies, spoke to his father habitually inclined to forget and forgive.
verses.hindi: जो आगे-आगे गमन कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: After understanding fully what had been commanded thus by his father, O prince, Rama, the suppressor of enemies, spoke to his father habitually inclined to forget and forgive.
verses.commentary: Sense: After understanding fully what had been commanded thus by his father, O prince, Rama, the suppressor of enemies, spoke to his father habitually inclined to forget and forgive.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य तपसो वीय ममापि शुभमस्ति चेत् । तेनासौ जीवताच्छीघ्रं प्रसुप्त इवचोत्थितः
verses.transliteration: yajñasya tapaso vīya mamāpi śubhamasti cet / tenāsau jīvatācchīghraṃ prasupta ivacotthitaḥ
verses.translation: O dear father of great intellect, listen now to my humble submission. Peace and restraint have been advocated by you for i Sadhus of noble souls.
verses.wordMeaning: O dear father of great intellect, listen now to my humble submission. Peace and restraint have been advocated by you for i Sadhus of noble souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear father of great intellect, listen now to my humble submission. Peace and restraint have been advocated by you for i Sadhus of noble souls.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते शुभे वाक्ये भृगुणा साधुकारिणा । समुत्तस्थावथार्चीकः साक्षाद्ग्ररुरिवापरः
verses.transliteration: evamukte śubhe vākye bhṛguṇā sādhukāriṇā / samuttasthāvathārcīkaḥ sākṣādgrarurivāparaḥ
verses.translation: That procedure of peace and restraint should be
verses.wordMeaning: That procedure of peace and restraint should be
verses.commentary: Sense: That procedure of peace and restraint should be

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तत्र स्थितं वन्द्यं भृगुं स्वस्य पितामहम् । ननाम भक्त्या नृपते कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tatra sthitaṃ vandyaṃ bhṛguṃ svasya pitāmaham / nanāma bhaktyā nṛpate kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha
verses.translation: Hence, Karttavlrya should be slain by me. O vener- able one, permit me. Let me fulfil my enmity (let me take proper revenge).**
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, Karttavlrya should be slain by me. O vener- able one, permit me. Let me fulfil my enmity (let me take proper revenge).**
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, Karttavlrya should be slain by me. O vener- able one, permit me. Let me fulfil my enmity (let me take proper revenge).**

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच धन्यो ऽहं कृतकृत्यो ऽहं सफलं जीवितं च मे
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca dhanyo 'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo 'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ ca me
verses.translation: "Listen to my words attentively, O Rama, O highly fortunate one. You shall act in accordance with the inevitable future. It cannot be otherwise at all.
verses.wordMeaning: "Listen to my words attentively, O Rama, O highly fortunate one. You shall act in accordance with the inevitable future. It cannot be otherwise at all.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Listen to my words attentively, O Rama, O highly fortunate one. You shall act in accordance with the inevitable future. It cannot be otherwise at all.

verses.sanskrit: यत्पश्ये चरणौ ते ऽद्य सुरासुरनमस्कृतौ । भगवन्किं करोम्यद्य शुश्रूषां तव मानद
verses.transliteration: yatpaśye caraṇau te 'dya surāsuranamaskṛtau / bhagavankiṃ karomyadya śuśrūṣāṃ tava mānada
verses.translation: Go to god Brahma from here. Ask him, O dear one, what is conducive to your welfare and what is not. You shall do what that holy lord says. There is no doubt in this."
verses.hindi: अनंतो वासुकिस्तक्षः कर्कोटः पद्म एव च
verses.wordMeaning: Go to god Brahma from here. Ask him, O dear one, what is conducive to your welfare and what is not. You shall do what that holy lord says. There is no doubt in this."
verses.commentary: Sense: Go to god Brahma from here. Ask him, O dear one, what is conducive to your welfare and what is not. You shall do what that holy lord says. There is no doubt in this."

verses.sanskrit: पुनीह्यात्मकुलं स्वस्य चरणांबुकणैर्विभो । इत्युक्त्वा सहसाऽनीतं रामेणार्ध्यं मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: punīhyātmakulaṃ svasya caraṇāṃbukaṇairvibho / ityuktvā sahasā'nītaṃ rāmeṇārdhyaṃ mudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, that highly intelligent sage bowed down to his father and went to the world of Brahma where ordinary people have no access at all.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, that highly intelligent sage bowed down to his father and went to the world of Brahma where ordinary people have no access at all.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, that highly intelligent sage bowed down to his father and went to the world of Brahma where ordinary people have no access at all.

verses.sanskrit: प्रददौ पादयोस्तस्य भक्त्यान मितकन्धरः । तज्जलं शिरसाधत्त सकुटुंबो महामनाः
verses.transliteration: pradadau pādayostasya bhaktyāna mitakandharaḥ / tajjalaṃ śirasādhatta sakuṭuṃbo mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: He saw the world of Brahma made of gold. It had the ramparts of gold. It was embellished with pillars studded with jewels.
verses.wordMeaning: He saw the world of Brahma made of gold. It had the ramparts of gold. It was embellished with pillars studded with jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw the world of Brahma made of gold. It had the ramparts of gold. It was embellished with pillars studded with jewels.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सत्कृत्य स भृगुं पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः । भगवन् किं कृतं तेन राज्ञा दुष्टेन पातकम्
verses.transliteration: atha satkṛtya sa bhṛguṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ / bhagavan kiṃ kṛtaṃ tena rājñā duṣṭena pātakam
verses.translation: There he saw Brahma of unmeasured prowess, seat- ed on a beautiful throne set with gems and jewels. He was adorned with ornaments set with gems and jewels.
verses.wordMeaning: There he saw Brahma of unmeasured prowess, seat- ed on a beautiful throne set with gems and jewels. He was adorned with ornaments set with gems and jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: There he saw Brahma of unmeasured prowess, seat- ed on a beautiful throne set with gems and jewels. He was adorned with ornaments set with gems and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यातिथ्यं हि कृतवानहं सम्यग्विधानतः । साधुबुद्ध्यास दुष्टात्मा किं चकार महामते
verses.transliteration: yasyātithyaṃ hi kṛtavānahaṃ samyagvidhānataḥ / sādhubuddhyāsa duṣṭātmā kiṃ cakāra mahāmate
verses.translation: He saw Brahma, the giver of benefits of penance, the lord and creator of the worlds, meditating on the perfect Brahman, with perfect mental control.
verses.hindi: तत्रेव देवताश्चक्र चक्राकारा मरुदिशः । आश्नित्य किल वतंते तदधिष्ठातृदेवता:
verses.wordMeaning: He saw Brahma, the giver of benefits of penance, the lord and creator of the worlds, meditating on the perfect Brahman, with perfect mental control.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw Brahma, the giver of benefits of penance, the lord and creator of the worlds, meditating on the perfect Brahman, with perfect mental control.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच एवं स पृष्टो मतिमान्भृगुः सर्वविदीश्वरः । चिरं ध्यात्वा समालोच्य कारणं प्राह भूपते
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca evaṃ sa pṛṣṭo matimānbhṛguḥ sarvavidīśvaraḥ / ciraṃ dhyātvā samālocya kāraṇaṃ prāha bhūpate
verses.translation: On seeing Rama with his head bent down, he congratulated and blessed him and enquired about his happi- ness— "O dear child, what have you come here for?"
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Rama with his head bent down, he congratulated and blessed him and enquired about his happi- ness— "O dear child, what have you come here for?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Rama with his head bent down, he congratulated and blessed him and enquired about his happi- ness— "O dear child, what have you come here for?"

verses.sanskrit: भृगुरुवाच शृणु तात महाभाग बीजमस्य हि कर्मणः । यश्च वै कृतवान्पापं सर्वज्ञस्य तवानघ
verses.transliteration: bhṛguruvāca śṛṇu tāta mahābhāga bījamasya hi karmaṇaḥ / yaśca vai kṛtavānpāpaṃ sarvajñasya tavānagha
verses.translation: On being asked by the Creator, Rama recounted everything from the beginning, the interlude of Karttavirya and his noble-soulcd father.
verses.hindi: यज्ञेशवर-समस्त देवगणों के सहित कमला के स्वामी भगवान् गोविन्द-- जगत् चक्र के भक्षण करने वाले भीषण शूलपाणि ईशान--बरह्मा-अश्विनी कुमार जो कि मेद्य के विशारद ये--भगवाबू धन्वन्तरि और अन्य गणों के नायक भो पुरोगामी ये ।५०-५२। इनके कटस्थलों से जो मद गिर रहा था
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked by the Creator, Rama recounted everything from the beginning, the interlude of Karttavirya and his noble-soulcd father.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked by the Creator, Rama recounted everything from the beginning, the interlude of Karttavirya and his noble-soulcd father.

verses.sanskrit: शप्तः पुरा वसिष्ठेन नाशार्थं स महीपतिः । द्विजापराधतो मूढ वीर्यं ते विनशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: śaptaḥ purā vasiṣṭhena nāśārthaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ / dvijāparādhato mūḍha vīryaṃ te vinaśiṣyate
verses.translation: On hearing everything, O bestower of honour, Brahma who had already understood everything, spoke to the highly righteous Rama something that would ultimately lead to happy consequences.
verses.hindi: उस पर भ्रमर झूम रहे ये। अनन्त-वासुकि- तक्षक--कर्कोट--पदुम-- महापद्म शंखपाल- गुलिक--सुबल--ये सब नागेश्वर थे जो करोड़ों नागों से समावृत होते हुए पुरोगमन कर रहे थे ।५३-५४। इस प्रकार वाले बहुत--से देवगण जाग्रत हो रहे थे। और पूर्व आदि दिशाओं से समारम्भ
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing everything, O bestower of honour, Brahma who had already understood everything, spoke to the highly righteous Rama something that would ultimately lead to happy consequences.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing everything, O bestower of honour, Brahma who had already understood everything, spoke to the highly righteous Rama something that would ultimately lead to happy consequences.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कथं वचनं तस्य भविष्यत्यन्यथा मुनेः । अयं रामो महावीर्यं प्रसह्यनृपपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: tatkathaṃ vacanaṃ tasya bhaviṣyatyanyathā muneḥ / ayaṃ rāmo mahāvīryaṃ prasahyanṛpapuṅgavam
verses.translation: "Difficult to accomplish indeed is the vow that you have taken out of anger. O Brahmacarin, this creation originates, due to the grace of the Lord.
verses.hindi: करके चारों ओर अपना निवास स्थल बनाये हुए थे ।५५। वहीं पर देवताओं ने मरत् दिशा को चक्राकार कर दिया था। और उस दिशा का समाश्रवण करके वे सब अधिष्ठान देवता हो रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: "Difficult to accomplish indeed is the vow that you have taken out of anger. O Brahmacarin, this creation originates, due to the grace of the Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Difficult to accomplish indeed is the vow that you have taken out of anger. O Brahmacarin, this creation originates, due to the grace of the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: हनिष्यति महाबाहो प्रतिज्ञां कृतवान्पुरा । यस्मादुरः प्रतिहतं त्वया मातर्ममाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: haniṣyati mahābāho pratijñāṃ kṛtavānpurā / yasmāduraḥ pratihataṃ tvayā mātarmamāgrataḥ
verses.translation: You wish to make the Earth rid of kings twentyone times on account of the fault of a singleking, as well as the discomfiture of your father.
verses.hindi: कपालं च गदां बिश्रदृध्वंकेशो महावपुः । पातालतलजंबालबहुलाकारकालिमा
verses.wordMeaning: You wish to make the Earth rid of kings twentyone times on account of the fault of a singleking, as well as the discomfiture of your father.
verses.commentary: Sense: You wish to make the Earth rid of kings twentyone times on account of the fault of a singleking, as well as the discomfiture of your father.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशतिवारं हि भृशं दुःखपरीतया । त्रिः सप्तकृत्वो निःक्षत्रां करिष्ये पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: ekaviṃśativāraṃ hi bhṛśaṃ duḥkhaparītayā / triḥ saptakṛtvo niḥkṣatrāṃ kariṣye pṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: The eternal creation along with the Brahmanas Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras has come out of Hari and merged into him again and again.
verses.wordMeaning: The eternal creation along with the Brahmanas Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras has come out of Hari and merged into him again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal creation along with the Brahmanas Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras has come out of Hari and merged into him again and again.

verses.sanskrit: अतो ऽयं वार्यमाणो ऽपि त्वाया पित्रा निरन्तरम् । भाविनोर्ऽथस्य च बलात्करिष्यत्येव मानद
verses.transliteration: ato 'yaṃ vāryamāṇo 'pi tvāyā pitrā nirantaram / bhāvinor'thasya ca balātkariṣyatyeva mānada
verses.translation: O dear boy, take from your preceptor Hara, a Kavoca 1 (coat of mail) having the Mantra of Srlkrsna. The splendour of Vi snu is difficult to be transgressed but Siva's power will conquer it.
verses.hindi: फूत्कारीत्रिपुरायुकतं फणिपाशं करे बहने । क्षेत्रपाल: सदा भाति सेवमानः किटीश्वरीम्
verses.wordMeaning: O dear boy, take from your preceptor Hara, a Kavoca 1 (coat of mail) having the Mantra of Srlkrsna. The splendour of Vi snu is difficult to be transgressed but Siva's power will conquer it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear boy, take from your preceptor Hara, a Kavoca 1 (coat of mail) having the Mantra of Srlkrsna. The splendour of Vi snu is difficult to be transgressed but Siva's power will conquer it.

verses.sanskrit: स तु राजा महाभागो वृद्धानां पर्युपासिता । दत्तात्रेयाद्धरेरंशाल्लब्धबोधो महामतिः
verses.transliteration: sa tu rājā mahābhāgo vṛddhānāṃ paryupāsitā / dattātreyāddhareraṃśāllabdhabodho mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: The Kavaca named Trailokya-Vijaya (conquest of the three worlds) is extremely miraculous and wonderful. By pleading and entreating to Sankara somehow try to get this {Kavaca) which is difficult to be obtained.
verses.hindi: तस्यैव च समीपस्थस्तस्या वाहनकेसरी । यमाहह्य प्रववृते भंडासुरव्ध षिणी
verses.wordMeaning: The Kavaca named Trailokya-Vijaya (conquest of the three worlds) is extremely miraculous and wonderful. By pleading and entreating to Sankara somehow try to get this {Kavaca) which is difficult to be obtained.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kavaca named Trailokya-Vijaya (conquest of the three worlds) is extremely miraculous and wonderful. By pleading and entreating to Sankara somehow try to get this {Kavaca) which is difficult to be obtained.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाद्भक्तो महात्मा च तद्वधे पातकं भवेत् । एवमुक्त्वा महाराज स भृगुर्ब्रह्मणः सुतः । यथागतं ययौ विद्वान्भविष्यत्कालपर्ययात्
verses.transliteration: sākṣādbhakto mahātmā ca tadvadhe pātakaṃ bhavet / evamuktvā mahārāja sa bhṛgurbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ / yathāgataṃ yayau vidvānbhaviṣyatkālaparyayāt
verses.translation: Delighted by your good qualities, the compassion- ate lord who endears himself to those who are in a wretched condition, will definitely give even the divine Pasupata missile without any doubt.
verses.wordMeaning: Delighted by your good qualities, the compassion- ate lord who endears himself to those who are in a wretched condition, will definitely give even the divine Pasupata missile without any doubt.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted by your good qualities, the compassion- ate lord who endears himself to those who are in a wretched condition, will definitely give even the divine Pasupata missile without any doubt.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्याभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३०॥ सगर उवाच ब्रह्मपुत्र महाभाग वद भार्गवचेष्टितम् । यच्चकार महावीर्य्यो राज्ञः क्रुद्धो हि कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite triṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 30// sagara uvāca brahmaputra mahābhāga vada bhārgavaceṣṭitam / yaccakāra mahāvīryyo rājñaḥ kruddho hi karmaṇā
verses.translation: When the sage fell senseless the evil-minded minister was beset with fear. He ordered his servants to bring the cow quickly with force.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sage fell senseless the evil-minded minister was beset with fear. He ordered his servants to bring the cow quickly with force.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sage fell senseless the evil-minded minister was beset with fear. He ordered his servants to bring the cow quickly with force.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच गते तस्मिन्महाभागे भृगो पितृपरायणः । रामः प्रोवाच संक्रुद्धो मुञ्चञ्छ्वासान्मुहर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca gate tasminmahābhāge bhṛgo pitṛparāyaṇaḥ / rāmaḥ provāca saṃkruddho muñcañchvāsānmuharmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Then they bound the cow along with its calf by means of ropes, O king. They hit it with whips and desirous of taking it away dragged it.
verses.wordMeaning: Then they bound the cow along with its calf by means of ropes, O king. They hit it with whips and desirous of taking it away dragged it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they bound the cow along with its calf by means of ropes, O king. They hit it with whips and desirous of taking it away dragged it.

verses.sanskrit: परशुराम उवाच अहो पश्यत मूढत्वंराज्ञो ह्युत्पथगामिनः । कार्त्तवीर्यस्य यो विद्वांश्चक्रे ब्रह्मवधोद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: paraśurāma uvāca aho paśyata mūḍhatvaṃrājño hyutpathagāminaḥ / kārttavīryasya yo vidvāṃścakre brahmavadhodyamam
verses.translation: On being dragged by many of them and on being hit and hurt with whips and poles by them, the cow gave vent to its anger.
verses.hindi: जम्मिणी-- स्तम्भिनी--मोहिनी ये तीनों ही उसी पं के प्रान्त में जो कि भासुर किरि, चक्र रथं था, विद्यमान थे।५७।' अब क्षेत्र पाल के स्वरूप का वर्णन कियो जाता है- क्षेत्रपाल कपाल और गंदा को करौं मै धारण किये हुए है--इसके केश ऊपर की ओर उडे हुए हैं तथां इसको बपु
verses.wordMeaning: On being dragged by many of them and on being hit and hurt with whips and poles by them, the cow gave vent to its anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being dragged by many of them and on being hit and hurt with whips and poles by them, the cow gave vent to its anger.

verses.sanskrit: दैवं हि बलवन्मन्ये यत्प्रभावाच्छरीरिणः । शुभं वाप्यशुभं सर्वे प्रकुर्वन्ति विमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: daivaṃ hi balavanmanye yatprabhāvāccharīriṇaḥ / śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ sarve prakurvanti vimohitāḥ
verses.translation: Pained by too much wippings, it became extremely furious. It tugged at the tight ropes and cut them. Thus it released itself.
verses.hindi: महा है है । पाताल तल में जो जम्बाल है उसके समान आकार वाली इसमें है ।५=। इसका अट्टहोसं बज के ही तुल्य है जिससे परण राड मंडल विदीर्ण हो जाता है। यह अपने डमरु के वोषों से रीदसी की कन्दे! राओं के उदर को भेद रहा है १६) कूत्कार (कुमकार) करने बोली पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: Pained by too much wippings, it became extremely furious. It tugged at the tight ropes and cut them. Thus it released itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pained by too much wippings, it became extremely furious. It tugged at the tight ropes and cut them. Thus it released itself.

verses.sanskrit: शृणवन्तु ऋषयः सर्वे प्रतिज्ञा क्रियते मया । कार्त्तवीर्यं निहत्याजौ पितुर्वैरं प्रसाधये
verses.transliteration: śṛṇavantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve pratijñā kriyate mayā / kārttavīryaṃ nihatyājau piturvairaṃ prasādhaye
verses.translation: It got itself released from the binding ropes but it was surrounded everywhere by the soldiers. Making the sound of Hurfihd (i.$. bellowing sound), it rushed at everyone angrily.
verses.hindi: से युक्त नागों के पाश को कर मैं वहन कर रही था । ऐसा' क्षेत्रपाल किटीशव री, की सेवा करता हुआ संदा ही शोभित होता है (६९) उसके हीं समीप मैं स्थित उसका वाहून केसरी था जिस पर समारोहण करके भंडासुर के बघ को इच्छा बालो प्रवृत हुई यौ ।६१। देवी के वाहन सिह का लक्षणे
verses.wordMeaning: It got itself released from the binding ropes but it was surrounded everywhere by the soldiers. Making the sound of Hurfihd (i.$. bellowing sound), it rushed at everyone angrily.
verses.commentary: Sense: It got itself released from the binding ropes but it was surrounded everywhere by the soldiers. Making the sound of Hurfihd (i.$. bellowing sound), it rushed at everyone angrily.

verses.sanskrit: यदि राजा सुरैः सर्वैरिन्द्राद्दैर्दानवैस्तथा । रक्षिष्यते तथाप्येनं संहरिष्यामि नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: yadi rājā suraiḥ sarvairindrāddairdānavaistathā / rakṣiṣyate tathāpyenaṃ saṃhariṣyāmi nānyathā
verses.translation: Hitting and lashing at everyone all round by means of its horns, hoofs and tip of the tail, the infuriated cow routed the entire army of the king and his minister.
verses.hindi: तो पूर्ग में ही कड दिया गया है । उसी पर्व के नीचे दंडनाथा के समात ही कास्ति वाली सहस्रो अस्य देवियाँ तथा देवता ये (६२) ये सभी दंडनाथां के ही तुल्य समस्त भूषणों और आयुघ्तों से मंडिते. ये। ये जम्या-क्रोंडातना-
verses.wordMeaning: Hitting and lashing at everyone all round by means of its horns, hoofs and tip of the tail, the infuriated cow routed the entire army of the king and his minister.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hitting and lashing at everyone all round by means of its horns, hoofs and tip of the tail, the infuriated cow routed the entire army of the king and his minister.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तं समाकर्ण्य रामेण समुहात्मना । जमदग्निरुवाचेदं पुत्रं साहसभाषिणम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktaṃ samākarṇya rāmeṇa samuhātmanā / jamadagniruvācedaṃ putraṃ sāhasabhāṣiṇam
verses.translation: After routing all the servants quickly, the sacred cow went up to the sky, even as all living beings remained looking on.
verses.wordMeaning: After routing all the servants quickly, the sacred cow went up to the sky, even as all living beings remained looking on.
verses.commentary: Sense: After routing all the servants quickly, the sacred cow went up to the sky, even as all living beings remained looking on.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच श्रुणु राम प्रवक्ष्यामि सतां धर्मं सनातनम् । यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवाः सर्वे जायन्ते धर्मकारिणः
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca śruṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi satāṃ dharmaṃ sanātanam / yacchrutvā mānavāḥ sarve jāyante dharmakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, those ruthless soldiers who had been
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, those ruthless soldiers who had been
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, those ruthless soldiers who had been

verses.sanskrit: साधवो ये महाभागाः संसारान्मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाः । न कस्मैचित्प्रकुप्यन्ति निन्दितास्ताडिता अपि
verses.transliteration: sādhavo ye mahābhāgāḥ saṃsārānmokṣakāṅkṣiṇāḥ / na kasmaicitprakupyanti ninditāstāḍitā api
verses.translation: Taking the calf alone without the cow, that sinner (minister) came to the presence of the king along with the servants.
verses.wordMeaning: Taking the calf alone without the cow, that sinner (minister) came to the presence of the king along with the servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the calf alone without the cow, that sinner (minister) came to the presence of the king along with the servants.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमाधना महाभागा ये च दान्तास्तपस्विनः । तेषां चैवाक्षया लोकाः सततं साधुकारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: kṣamādhanā mahābhāgā ye ca dāntāstapasvinaḥ / teṣāṃ caivākṣayā lokāḥ satataṃ sādhukāriṇām
verses.translation: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the king and bowing down to him the sycophant minister narrated everything to him feeling greatly agitated and afraid.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु दुष्टैस्तु दण्डाद्यैर्वचसापि च ताडितः । न च क्षोभमवाप्नोति स साधुः परिकीर्त्थते
verses.transliteration: yastu duṣṭaistu daṇḍādyairvacasāpi ca tāḍitaḥ / na ca kṣobhamavāpnoti sa sādhuḥ parikīrtthate
verses.translation: On hearing the report of the murder of Jamadagni and similar events, the king became very much distressed in his mind. He thought about the various matters concerned.
verses.hindi: इसके कर में हल ओर मुसल था तथा ये बार-बार धूर्णन कर रही थीं जो भी ललिता देवी के द्रोही-श्यामा के दोही और स्वामिनी के साथ डोह करने वाले थे उन्हीं को घूर रहीं थीं ।६४। उमड़े हुए रक्‍त के स्रोतों से कपालो को भर रहीं थी । इनके भूषण अपने भक्तों के साथ द्रोह करने
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the report of the murder of Jamadagni and similar events, the king became very much distressed in his mind. He thought about the various matters concerned.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the report of the murder of Jamadagni and similar events, the king became very much distressed in his mind. He thought about the various matters concerned.

verses.sanskrit: ताडयेत्ताडयन्तं यो न च साधुः स पापभाक् । क्षमयार्ऽहणतां प्राप्ताः साधवो ब्राह्मणा वयम्
verses.transliteration: tāḍayettāḍayantaṃ yo na ca sādhuḥ sa pāpabhāk / kṣamayār'haṇatāṃ prāptāḥ sādhavo brāhmaṇā vayam
verses.translation: "Alas I have been very wicked in the events concern- ing both the worlds. Firstly my desire to take away the property of a Brahmana and secondly his (Jamadagni's) extremely censurable murder.
verses.hindi: बालों की मन्त्रों की मालाएं ही थे ॥६५॥ अपनी गोष्ठी के समय पर आक्षेप करने वालों के मुख मंडलों अर्थात् मुडों से जिनसे रक्त खाव हो रहा है अपने उर:स्थल पर मालाए धारण कर रहीं थीं।६६। ऐसे उस किटीश्वरी की सेवा करते हुए सहस्रो ही देवता बताये गये हैं ।६७। है कुम्भ सम्भव !
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas I have been very wicked in the events concern- ing both the worlds. Firstly my desire to take away the property of a Brahmana and secondly his (Jamadagni's) extremely censurable murder.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas I have been very wicked in the events concern- ing both the worlds. Firstly my desire to take away the property of a Brahmana and secondly his (Jamadagni's) extremely censurable murder.

verses.sanskrit: नरनाथवधे तात पातकं सुमहद्भवेत् । तस्मान्निवारये त्वाद्य क्षमां कुरु तपश्चर
verses.transliteration: naranāthavadhe tāta pātakaṃ sumahadbhavet / tasmānnivāraye tvādya kṣamāṃ kuru tapaścara
verses.translation: Deluded in mv mind and devoid of shame, I did not
verses.hindi: दंडिनी की उनके सबके नाम सहस्र नामाध्याय में कहेंगे अतः अब फिर नहीं कहते है ।६८। कोलास्य उन देवताओं के समीप में ही कृष्ण सारंग वाहन दंडिती के समय में स्थित था। यह आधे कोश तक तो आयत था श्युग में और उससे आधा आयत मुख में था और एक कोण के प्रमाण बाले
verses.wordMeaning: Deluded in mv mind and devoid of shame, I did not
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded in mv mind and devoid of shame, I did not

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच एवं पित्रा समादिष्टं विज्ञाय नृपनन्दन । रामः प्रोवाच पितरं क्षमाशीलमरिन्दमम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca evaṃ pitrā samādiṣṭaṃ vijñāya nṛpanandana / rāmaḥ provāca pitaraṃ kṣamāśīlamarindamam
verses.translation: Thinking thus with a grief-stricken heart, he returned to his city along with his army and followers.
verses.hindi: पाद थे और उसकी पूछ तो सदा ही उद्धत रहा करती थी
verses.wordMeaning: Thinking thus with a grief-stricken heart, he returned to his city along with his army and followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus with a grief-stricken heart, he returned to his city along with his army and followers.

verses.sanskrit: परशुराम उवाच शृणु तात महाप्राज्ञ वि५प्तिं मम सांप्रतम् । भवता शम उद्दिष्टः साधूनां सुमहात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: paraśurāma uvāca śṛṇu tāta mahāprājña vi5ptiṃ mama sāṃpratam / bhavatā śama uddiṣṭaḥ sādhūnāṃ sumahātmanām
verses.translation: When the king went back towards his city along with his attendants, O king, Reiuka suddenly rushed out of hermitage.
verses.wordMeaning: When the king went back towards his city along with his attendants, O king, Reiuka suddenly rushed out of hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the king went back towards his city along with his attendants, O king, Reiuka suddenly rushed out of hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: म शमः साधुदीनेषु गुरुष्वीश्वरभावनैः । कर्त्तव्यो दुष्टचेष्टेषु न शमः सुखदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ma śamaḥ sādhudīneṣu guruṣvīśvarabhāvanaiḥ / karttavyo duṣṭaceṣṭeṣu na śamaḥ sukhado bhavet
verses.translation: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.
verses.wordMeaning: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.

verses.transliteration: trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam / yathākathaṃ ca vijñāpya śaṅkaraṃ labhadurlabham
verses.translation: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नः स गुणैस्तुभ्यं कृपालुर्दीनवत्सलः । दिव्यपाशुपतं चापि दास्यत्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: prasannaḥ sa guṇaistubhyaṃ kṛpālurdīnavatsalaḥ / divyapāśupataṃ cāpi dāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.
verses.hindi: उस संग्राम में वहाँ के देवताओं के समूहों के दारो बहुत से दानव
verses.wordMeaning: As her husband lay senseless, she thought that he had been killed. Thereupon, she fell down on thegrouna and fainted as though struck by a thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते एकत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३१॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा स प्रणम्य जगद्गुरुम् । प्रसन्नचेताः सुभृशं शिवलोकं जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ekatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 31// vasiṣṭha uvāca brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā sa praṇamya jagadgurum / prasannacetāḥ subhṛśaṃ śivalokaṃ jagāma ha
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, Rama became much delighted in his mind. After bowing down to the preceptor of the Universe, he went to Siva's region.
verses.hindi: मारे जायेंगे और रुधिरु को बृष्टि का पान कियाः जायगा १६५) इस प्रकार से प्क में स्थितदेवताओं के'गर्णो के द्वारा बहुत. तरह का.परिवाण होगा सथा कंड नेत्री: किस्विक्रःचला-था ।८६। जहाँ पर चक्र राज रथ था वहाँ पर ही गेयः ख्थोल मबा ओर जहाँ जहां पर गेय रयोत्तम था वहाँ पर ही किरि-
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Brahma, Rama became much delighted in his mind. After bowing down to the preceptor of the Universe, he went to Siva's region.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma, Rama became much delighted in his mind. After bowing down to the preceptor of the Universe, he went to Siva's region.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षयोजनमूर्द्ध्वं च ब्रह्मलोका द्विलक्षणम् । अथनिर्वचनीयं च योगिगम्यं परात्परम्
verses.transliteration: lakṣayojanamūrddhvaṃ ca brahmalokā dvilakṣaṇam / athanirvacanīyaṃ ca yogigamyaṃ parātparam

verses.hindi: चक्र रथोत्तमः था।८७।-इनाभ्रक्तार से-वहां पर! तीन रथ थे ।'ऐसा प्रतीत होता! था मानों जेलोकय हो जंगम हे'। इसके" अन्दर सहस्रो शक्ति सेनाओं का शुभ संचार उस/समय में हो रहा था ।८८। ऐसा: मालूम होता'था मानों मेयश्मत्वर/ओर। विन्ध्य पबंतों का समवाय ही हो गया होवे । उस शक्तियों

verses.commentary: Sense: Mantra though derived from y/man by Nirukta. (vii. 12) later on came to be traced in Tantra works to two roots — man — 'to think* or 'meditate* and — trot — 'to protect*.…

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठो दक्षिणे यस्माद्गौरीलोकश्च वामतः । यदधो ध्रुवलोकश्च सर्वलोकपरस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭho dakṣiṇe yasmādgaurīlokaśca vāmataḥ / yadadho dhruvalokaśca sarvalokaparastu saḥ
verses.translation: Rama who could go there due to the power of his penance, saw the world of Siva which was unparalleled and which was full of many things generating curiosity and wonder.
verses.hindi: के सेन्य मंडल:में उस समय/में: महान ' घोष प्रवृत्त हो! गया-था।। उस!समय में.उत्तःरथों के चक्रों की श्यति से सम्पूर्ण -बसुधा। हिल गयी थी:।८६। रथवाक की चक्रांज-नाम ब्रालोःललिता' हो कोत्तित की गयो है । उनमें, छे सारथि ये जो उदण्ड पाशो के ग्रहण में जड़े. को विदः ये ।६०। जहां पर ही ग रथ
verses.wordMeaning: Rama who could go there due to the power of his penance, saw the world of Siva which was unparalleled and which was full of many things generating curiosity and wonder.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama who could go there due to the power of his penance, saw the world of Siva which was unparalleled and which was full of many things generating curiosity and wonder.

verses.sanskrit: तपोवीर्यगती रामः शिवलोकं ददर्श च । उपमानेन रहितं नानाकौतुकसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: tapovīryagatī rāmaḥ śivalokaṃ dadarśa ca / upamānena rahitaṃ nānākautukasaṃyutam
verses.translation: Leading Yogins, Siddhas, auspicious and holy Pasu- patas (Devotees ofPasupati i.e. Siva) etc. live there. So also people of quietude, devoid of enmity and having the meritori- ous benefits of austerities of ten million Kalpas.
verses.hindi: था वहाँ-वहां-पर किरिष्यक्र उत्तम रअ्र था। प्रथभ तो. देवी  शी फिर उसी
verses.wordMeaning: Leading Yogins, Siddhas, auspicious and holy Pasu- patas (Devotees ofPasupati i.e. Siva) etc. live there. So also people of quietude, devoid of enmity and having the meritori- ous benefits of austerities of ten million Kalpas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Leading Yogins, Siddhas, auspicious and holy Pasu- patas (Devotees ofPasupati i.e. Siva) etc. live there. So also people of quietude, devoid of enmity and having the meritori- ous benefits of austerities of ten million Kalpas.

verses.sanskrit: वसंति यत्र योगीन्द्राः सिद्धाः पाशुपताः शुभाः । कोटिकल्पतपः पुण्याः शान्ता निर्मत्सरा जनाः
verses.transliteration: vasaṃti yatra yogīndrāḥ siddhāḥ pāśupatāḥ śubhāḥ / koṭikalpatapaḥ puṇyāḥ śāntā nirmatsarā janāḥ
verses.translation: "I bow down to you two, O Lords. I have come here to see lord Sankara. It behoves vou to let me in after
verses.hindi: का वल्लभ था । सारस पाचवं भा. तथा अपरा चामुष्दा थी
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to you two, O Lords. I have come here to see lord Sankara. It behoves vou to let me in after
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to you two, O Lords. I have come here to see lord Sankara. It behoves vou to let me in after

verses.sanskrit: पारिजातमुखैर्वृक्षैः शोभितं कामधेनुभिः । योगेन योगिना सृष्टं स्वेच्छया शङ्करेण हि
verses.transliteration: pārijātamukhairvṛkṣaiḥ śobhitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ / yogena yoginā sṛṣṭaṃ svecchayā śaṅkareṇa hi
verses.translation: On hearing his words, those two followers of the lord went in and got permission of Siva. Then they gave him permission to go within.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, those two followers of the lord went in and got permission of Siva. Then they gave him permission to go within.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, those two followers of the lord went in and got permission of Siva. Then they gave him permission to go within.

verses.sanskrit: शिल्पिनां गुरुणा स्वप्ने न दृष्टं निश्वकर्मणा । सरोवरशतैर्दिव्यैः पद्मरागविराजितैः
verses.transliteration: śilpināṃ guruṇā svapne na dṛṣṭaṃ niśvakarmaṇā / sarovaraśatairdivyaiḥ padmarāgavirājitaiḥ
verses.translation: His hand appeared rendered splendid by a trident. He had excellent garment of tiger's skin. His limbs were smeared with holy ashes and made beautiful. A serpent served the pur- pose of sacred thread.
verses.wordMeaning: His hand appeared rendered splendid by a trident. He had excellent garment of tiger's skin. His limbs were smeared with holy ashes and made beautiful. A serpent served the pur- pose of sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: His hand appeared rendered splendid by a trident. He had excellent garment of tiger's skin. His limbs were smeared with holy ashes and made beautiful. A serpent served the pur- pose of sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: शोभितं चातिरम्यं च संयुक्तं मणिवेदिभिः । सुवर्णरत्नरचितप्राकारेण समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: śobhitaṃ cātiramyaṃ ca saṃyuktaṃ maṇivedibhiḥ / suvarṇaratnaracitaprākāreṇa samāvṛtam
verses.translation: "I bow down to Lord Siva, Isana, the eternal ( imperishable) all-pervasive lord, lord Ugra with serpents for
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to Lord Siva, Isana, the eternal ( imperishable) all-pervasive lord, lord Ugra with serpents for
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to Lord Siva, Isana, the eternal ( imperishable) all-pervasive lord, lord Ugra with serpents for

verses.sanskrit: अत्यूर्द्ध्वमंबरस्पर्शि स्वच्छं क्षीरनिभंपरम् । चतुर्द्वारसमायुक्तं शोभितं मणिवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: atyūrddhvamaṃbarasparśi svacchaṃ kṣīranibhaṃparam / caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ maṇivedibhiḥ
verses.translation: I know you as that lord of all the worlds, who creates, sustains and annihilates the worlds, who assumes the forms of Brahma and others, who is the eldest of all and who is an ocean of mercy.
verses.wordMeaning: I know you as that lord of all the worlds, who creates, sustains and annihilates the worlds, who assumes the forms of Brahma and others, who is the eldest of all and who is an ocean of mercy.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know you as that lord of all the worlds, who creates, sustains and annihilates the worlds, who assumes the forms of Brahma and others, who is the eldest of all and who is an ocean of mercy.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तसोपानयुक्तैश्च रत्नस्तंभकपाटकैः । नानाचित्रविचित्रैश्च शोभितैः सुमनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: raktasopānayuktaiśca ratnastaṃbhakapāṭakaiḥ / nānācitravicitraiśca śobhitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ
verses.translation: I bow down to Kara that great lord from whose slightest anger bursts forth that fire which burns down every- thing including the upper worlds as well as the Nether worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Kara that great lord from whose slightest anger bursts forth that fire which burns down every- thing including the upper worlds as well as the Nether worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Kara that great lord from whose slightest anger bursts forth that fire which burns down every- thing including the upper worlds as well as the Nether worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मधये भवनं रम्यं सिंहद्वारोपशोभितम् । ददर्शरामो धर्मात्मा विचित्रमिव संगतः
verses.transliteration: tanmadhaye bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ siṃhadvāropaśobhitam / dadarśarāmo dharmātmā vicitramiva saṃgataḥ
verses.translation: The following eight Murtis1 (forms of Siva) are worthy of being worshipped by the entire world viz. the Earth, wind, fire, water, ether, Yajvan (sacrificial priest), moon and sun. I bow down to that Yajna ( the lord identical w'ith Yajfia).
verses.hindi: इनमें बहाँ पर देवता ही उन रथों के सारथि थे ऐसा बताया गया है । जो गेय रथचक्र शा उसको सारथि हसन्तिका थी ।६३। किरिचक्र रघेन्द्र की स्तम्भिनो सारशि कही है । ललिता का उत्तम श्रेष्ठ रण दश
verses.wordMeaning: The following eight Murtis1 (forms of Siva) are worthy of being worshipped by the entire world viz. the Earth, wind, fire, water, ether, Yajvan (sacrificial priest), moon and sun. I bow down to that Yajna ( the lord identical w'ith Yajfia).
verses.commentary: Sense: The following eight Murtis1 (forms of Siva) are worthy of being worshipped by the entire world viz. the Earth, wind, fire, water, ether, Yajvan (sacrificial priest), moon and sun. I bow down to that Yajna ( the lord identical w'ith Yajfia).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थितौ द्वार पालौ ददर्शातिभयङ्करौ । महाकरालदन्तास्यौ विकृतारक्तलोचनौ
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitau dvāra pālau dadarśātibhayaṅkarau / mahākarāladantāsyau vikṛtāraktalocanau
verses.translation: I seek refuge in that lord who has the form of Kdla (Time, god of death), who is the primordial creator of the Universe in the form of Kdla; who is the protector (of the Universe) by assuming a separate form and by being identical with the universe, and who in the end annihilates everything by assuming the physical form of Rudra."
verses.hindi: षद् योजन ऊंचा है मुने ! किरिचक्र रश था ।६५। महान मुक्ताओं से विनि- मित आतपत्र (छत्र) दशयोजन विस्तार वाला या । ललितेणानी का रथ ही ऐसा था और अन्य का वहीं शा १६६) और वह ही शक्ति के साम्राज्य का सूचक कीतित किया गया है। सामान्य छत्र तो अन्य दोनों पर भी ये
verses.wordMeaning: I seek refuge in that lord who has the form of Kdla (Time, god of death), who is the primordial creator of the Universe in the form of Kdla; who is the protector (of the Universe) by assuming a separate form and by being identical with the universe,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I seek refuge in that lord who has the form of Kdla (Time, god of death), who is the primordial creator of the Universe in the form of Kdla; who is the protector (of the Universe) by assuming a separate form and by being identical with the universe,…

verses.sanskrit: दग्धशैलप्रतीकाशौ महाबलपराक्रमौ । विभूतिभूषिताङ्गौ च व्याघ्रचर्मांबरौ च तौ
verses.transliteration: dagdhaśailapratīkāśau mahābalaparākramau / vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgau ca vyāghracarmāṃbarau ca tau
verses.translation: After saying this, sage Bhargava joyously and enthusiastically fell down near his (Siva's) feet. The ocean of mercy (the lord) sportingly lifted him up with his left hand and placed his right hand on his head.
verses.hindi: महान साम्राज्य की पदवीं पर समारूदृ शी ।९८। बह चंड हैत्य के क्षय की सिद्धि की अभिकांक्षा वाली वहाँ से चली शी । सभी दिशाए उस समय में शब्दायमान हो रही थीं और वसुधा प्रकम्पित हो रही शी
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, sage Bhargava joyously and enthusiastically fell down near his (Siva's) feet. The ocean of mercy (the lord) sportingly lifted him up with his left hand and placed his right hand on his head.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, sage Bhargava joyously and enthusiastically fell down near his (Siva's) feet. The ocean of mercy (the lord) sportingly lifted him up with his left hand and placed his right hand on his head.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलपट्टिशधरौ ज्वलन्तौ ब्रह्मतेजसा । तौ दृष्ट्वा मनसा भीतः किञ्चिदाह विनीतवत्
verses.transliteration: triśūlapaṭṭiśadharau jvalantau brahmatejasā / tau dṛṣṭvā manasā bhītaḥ kiñcidāha vinītavat
verses.translation: He eagerly congratulated and blessed him. He placed him in front of Ganesa. With his eyes wet with compas- sion, the lord who fulfils the desires of everyone, glanced at his wife Uma and spoke.
verses.wordMeaning: He eagerly congratulated and blessed him. He placed him in front of Ganesa. With his eyes wet with compas- sion, the lord who fulfils the desires of everyone, glanced at his wife Uma and spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: He eagerly congratulated and blessed him. He placed him in front of Ganesa. With his eyes wet with compas- sion, the lord who fulfils the desires of everyone, glanced at his wife Uma and spoke.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्करोमि वामीशौ शङ्करं द्रष्टुमागतः । ईश्वराज्ञां समादाय मामथाज्ञप्तुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: namaskaromi vāmīśau śaṅkaraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ / īśvarājñāṃ samādāya māmathājñaptumarhatha
verses.translation: "O boy, who are you? In whose family were you bom? What is the purpose for which you have come here? Tell us about it. Delighted by your devotional attitude, I shall grant whatever you have in your mind."
verses.wordMeaning: "O boy, who are you? In whose family were you bom? What is the purpose for which you have come here? Tell us about it. Delighted by your devotional attitude, I shall grant whatever you have in your mind."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O boy, who are you? In whose family were you bom? What is the purpose for which you have come here? Tell us about it. Delighted by your devotional attitude, I shall grant whatever you have in your mind."

verses.sanskrit: तौतु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गृहीत्वाज्ञां शिवस्य च । प्रवेष्टुमाज्ञां ददतुरीश्वरानुचरौ च तौ
verses.transliteration: tautu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gṛhītvājñāṃ śivasya ca / praveṣṭumājñāṃ dadaturīśvarānucarau ca tau
verses.translation: On being told thus eagerly by the able-souled Hara, the dispeller of the distress of the whole Universe, (the scion of the family of) Bhrgu, once again bowed down to the lord of the Devas, the preceptor, the ocean of mercy and spoke imme- diately.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus eagerly by the able-souled Hara, the dispeller of the distress of the whole Universe, (the scion of the family of) Bhrgu, once again bowed down to the lord of the Devas, the preceptor, the ocean of mercy and spoke imme- diately.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus eagerly by the able-souled Hara, the dispeller of the distress of the whole Universe, (the scion of the family of) Bhrgu, once again bowed down to the lord of the Devas, the preceptor, the ocean of mercy and spoke imme- diately.

verses.sanskrit: स तदाज्ञामनुप्राप्य विवेशान्तः पुरं मुदा । तत्रातिरम्यां सिद्धौघैः समाकीर्णां सभां द्विजः
verses.transliteration: sa tadājñāmanuprāpya viveśāntaḥ puraṃ mudā / tatrātiramyāṃ siddhaughaiḥ samākīrṇāṃ sabhāṃ dvijaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, I am born as the son of Jamadagni in the family of Bhrgu. My name is Rama. I seek refuge in you, who are worthy of being honoured by the whole universe.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, I am born as the son of Jamadagni in the family of Bhrgu. My name is Rama. I seek refuge in you, who are worthy of being honoured by the whole universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I am born as the son of Jamadagni in the family of Bhrgu. My name is Rama. I seek refuge in you, who are worthy of being honoured by the whole universe.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमापेदे सुगन्धबहुलां विभोः । तत्रापश्यच्छिवं शान्तं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpede sugandhabahulāṃ vibhoḥ / tatrāpaśyacchivaṃ śāntaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam
verses.translation: O lord of the Universe, fulfil my cherished desire for the work of which I have come to your presence, O lord.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the Universe, fulfil my cherished desire for the work of which I have come to your presence, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the Universe, fulfil my cherished desire for the work of which I have come to your presence, O lord.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलशोभितकरं व्याघ्रचर्मवरांबरम् । विभूतिभूषिताङ्गं च नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम्
verses.transliteration: triśūlaśobhitakaraṃ vyāghracarmavarāṃbaram / vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgaṃ ca nāgayajñopavītinam
verses.translation: Jamadagni, my father, O lord, accorded hospitable reception to king Karttavirya who had been on a hunting expedition.
verses.hindi: जिस समय ईशानी ललिता देवो का विनिर्गम हुआ या उस समय में सभी प्राणी महान क्षुब्ध हो गये ये । देवगण दुन्दुभियाँ बजाने लगे थे तथा पुष्षों को वर्षा कर रहे वे ।१००। विश्वाबयु प्रभृति गनधर्वगण जो सुरों के यहाँ गायक थे-तुम्बरु भौर नारद तया साक्षात् सरस्वती देवी सब विजय
verses.wordMeaning: Jamadagni, my father, O lord, accorded hospitable reception to king Karttavirya who had been on a hunting expedition.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jamadagni, my father, O lord, accorded hospitable reception to king Karttavirya who had been on a hunting expedition.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मारामं पूर्णकामं कोटिसूर्यसमप्रभम् । पञ्चाननं दशभुजं भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: ātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham / pañcānanaṃ daśabhujaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham
verses.translation: Out of greed that silly and foolish king struck that sage down by using force. On seeing him killed, the cow went away to the world of cows.
verses.hindi: के मंगल पद्यो का बहुत सुन्दर गोतों में पाठ कर रहे ये। सबके हर्ष से मुख खिले हुए ये तया रोमाळ्यों के भूषण स्फुरित हो रहे ये । सभी बारम्बार जय हो-जय हो-इस प्रकार से ललितेश्वरी का स्तवन कर रहे ये ।१०१- १०२। सभी कदम कदम पर हषं से युक्त ओर मद से उन्मत्त हो रहे ये तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Out of greed that silly and foolish king struck that sage down by using force. On seeing him killed, the cow went away to the world of cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of greed that silly and foolish king struck that sage down by using force. On seeing him killed, the cow went away to the world of cows.

verses.sanskrit: योगज्ञाने प्रब्रुवन्तं सिद्धेभ्यस्तर्कमुद्रया । स्तूयमानं च योकीन्द्रैः प्रमथप्रकरैर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: yogajñāne prabruvantaṃ siddhebhyastarkamudrayā / stūyamānaṃ ca yokīndraiḥ pramathaprakarairmudā
verses.translation: Without feeling any remorse for the death of my innocent father the king returned to his city. Afterwards, my mother lamented very bitterly.
verses.hindi: नृत्य कर रहे ये । सप्तषिगण जिनमें वसिष्ठ आदि महा मुनिगण ये वे ऋग्वेद- यजुर्वेद-सामवेद ओर अथर्गवेद के मन्त्रों से जय श्री का वणेन कर रहे ये। जिस तरह से हवि से महा वहिन को शिखा अत्यन्त पाविनो होती हैं गेसे ही ये सभी उत्तम ऋषिगण महान आशोबांद से वर्धन कर रहे थे। उनके
verses.wordMeaning: Without feeling any remorse for the death of my innocent father the king returned to his city. Afterwards, my mother lamented very bitterly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without feeling any remorse for the death of my innocent father the king returned to his city. Afterwards, my mother lamented very bitterly.

verses.sanskrit: भैरवैर्योगिनीभिश्च वृतं रुद्रगणैस्तथा । मूर्ध्ना नमाम तं दृष्ट्वा रामः परमया मुदा
verses.transliteration: bhairavairyoginībhiśca vṛtaṃ rudragaṇaistathā / mūrdhnā namāma taṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ paramayā mudā
verses.translation: On coming to know of it, our great-grandfather Bhrgu who is aware of the events of the world, came there, O great lord. Indeed I too came back from th forest.
verses.hindi: द्वारा इस प्रकार से स्तवन को गयो ललिता उस उत्तम रथ में विराजमान हो रही थों। वह देवो परम उद्दण्ड सैनिकों के साथ भंडासुर पर विजय प्राप्त करने को रबाना हुई थी
verses.wordMeaning: On coming to know of it, our great-grandfather Bhrgu who is aware of the events of the world, came there, O great lord. Indeed I too came back from th forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know of it, our great-grandfather Bhrgu who is aware of the events of the world, came there, O great lord. Indeed I too came back from th forest.

verses.sanskrit: वामभागे कार्त्तिकेयं दक्षिणे च गणेश्वरम् । नन्दीश्वरं महाकालं वीरभद्रं च तत्पुरः
verses.transliteration: vāmabhāge kārttikeyaṃ dakṣiṇe ca gaṇeśvaram / nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca tatpuraḥ
verses.translation: After consoling the extremely distressed brothers of mine along with me and my mother, that sage who is con- versant with Mantras resuscitated my father back to life.
verses.wordMeaning: After consoling the extremely distressed brothers of mine along with me and my mother, that sage who is con- versant with Mantras resuscitated my father back to life.
verses.commentary: Sense: After consoling the extremely distressed brothers of mine along with me and my mother, that sage who is con- versant with Mantras resuscitated my father back to life.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोडे दुर्गां शतभुजां दृष्ट्वा नत्वाथ तामपि । स्तोतुं प्रचक्रमे विद्वान्गिरा गद्गदया विभुम्
verses.transliteration: kroḍe durgāṃ śatabhujāṃ dṛṣṭvā natvātha tāmapi / stotuṃ pracakrame vidvāngirā gadgadayā vibhum
verses.translation: Before the arrival of Bhrgu, I had been highly infuriated by the grief of my mother. Consoling my mother, O lord, I had taken a vow.
verses.wordMeaning: Before the arrival of Bhrgu, I had been highly infuriated by the grief of my mother. Consoling my mother, O lord, I had taken a vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Before the arrival of Bhrgu, I had been highly infuriated by the grief of my mother. Consoling my mother, O lord, I had taken a vow.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ये शिवमीशानं विभुं व्यापकमव्ययम् । भुजङ्गभूषणं चोग्रं नृकपालस्रगुज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: namasye śivamīśānaṃ vibhuṃ vyāpakamavyayam / bhujaṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ cograṃ nṛkapālasragujjvalam
verses.translation: Since her chest had been beaten twentyone times
verses.wordMeaning: Since her chest had been beaten twentyone times
verses.commentary: Sense: Since her chest had been beaten twentyone times

verses.sanskrit: यो विभुः सर्वलोकानां सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशकृत् । ब्रह्मादिरूपधृग्ज्येष्ठस्तं त्वां वेद कृपार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: yo vibhuḥ sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisthitivināśakṛt / brahmādirūpadhṛgjyeṣṭhastaṃ tvāṃ veda kṛpārṇavam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of his and glancing at the face of Durga, Hara remained absorbed in thought for a moment with his face bent down.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of his and glancing at the face of Durga, Hara remained absorbed in thought for a moment with his face bent down.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of his and glancing at the face of Durga, Hara remained absorbed in thought for a moment with his face bent down.

verses.sanskrit: वेदा न शक्ता यं स्तोतु मवाङ्मनसगोचरम् । ज्ञानबुद्ध्योरसाध्यं च निराकारं नमाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: vedā na śaktā yaṃ stotu mavāṅmanasagocaram / jñānabuddhyorasādhyaṃ ca nirākāraṃ namāmyaham
verses.translation: In the meantime surprised as she was, DurgS, laughed a lot, O great king and said to Bhargava who was bent on wreaking revenge.
verses.hindi: अकाले एवं निमिन्ना- भित्तयो दे त्यपत्तने ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime surprised as she was, DurgS, laughed a lot, O great king and said to Bhargava who was bent on wreaking revenge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime surprised as she was, DurgS, laughed a lot, O great king and said to Bhargava who was bent on wreaking revenge.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रादयः सुरगणा ऋषयो मनवो ऽसुराः । न यं विदुर्यथातत्त्वं तं नमामि परात्परम्
verses.transliteration: śakrādayaḥ suragaṇā ṛṣayo manavo 'surāḥ / na yaṃ viduryathātattvaṃ taṃ namāmi parātparam
verses.translation: ''O ascetic, O son of a Brahmana, out of anger you wish to make this Earth devoid of kings twentyone times. Great indeed is your daring rashness, O boy.
verses.wordMeaning: ''O ascetic, O son of a Brahmana, out of anger you wish to make this Earth devoid of kings twentyone times. Great indeed is your daring rashness, O boy.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O ascetic, O son of a Brahmana, out of anger you wish to make this Earth devoid of kings twentyone times. Great indeed is your daring rashness, O boy.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यांशांशेन सृजयन्ते लोकाः सर्वे चराचराः । लीयन्ते च पुनर्यस्मिंस्तं नमामि जगन्मयम्
verses.transliteration: yasyāṃśāṃśena sṛjayante lokāḥ sarve carācarāḥ / līyante ca punaryasmiṃstaṃ namāmi jaganmayam
verses.translation: Without any weapon you wish to kill Arjuna, the king with a thousand arms, by whom even Ravana was con- temptuously discomfited by a sportive knitting of his eyebrows.
verses.wordMeaning: Without any weapon you wish to kill Arjuna, the king with a thousand arms, by whom even Ravana was con- temptuously discomfited by a sportive knitting of his eyebrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without any weapon you wish to kill Arjuna, the king with a thousand arms, by whom even Ravana was con- temptuously discomfited by a sportive knitting of his eyebrows.

verses.sanskrit: यस्येषत्कोपसंभूतो हुताशो दहते ऽखिलम् । सोर्द्ध्वलोकं सपातालं तं नमामि हरं परम्
verses.transliteration: yasyeṣatkopasaṃbhūto hutāśo dahate 'khilam / sorddhvalokaṃ sapātālaṃ taṃ namāmi haraṃ param
verses.translation: To him the coat of mail of Lord Visnu had been given as also the Sakti (Divine javelin) of excessive poten- tiality. How do you aspire to kill him?.
verses.hindi: 7७! श्री ललिता देवी को यात्रा के निगम के घोष का श्रवण करके, भंडा; सुर के पुर में निवास, करने वाले. बडे भारी क्षोभ को प्राप्त, होगये, ये.) १ जहॉ पर दुराश-और दुष्ट मति वाले. भड ,का नपार , है. बह, महे पर्वत के जपास्त में और महाणंब के तट पर है ।२। बहु. तो , शूम्यक के. ताम से, ही
verses.wordMeaning: To him the coat of mail of Lord Visnu had been given as also the Sakti (Divine javelin) of excessive poten- tiality. How do you aspire to kill him?.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him the coat of mail of Lord Visnu had been given as also the Sakti (Divine javelin) of excessive poten- tiality. How do you aspire to kill him?.

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वीपवन वह्न्यभभोनभोयज्वेन्दुभास्कराः । मूर्त्तयो ऽष्टौ जगत्पूज्यास्तं यज्ञं प्रणमाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthvīpavana vahnyabhabhonabhoyajvendubhāskarāḥ / mūrttayo 'ṣṭau jagatpūjyāstaṃ yajñaṃ praṇamāmyaham
verses.translation: Thereupon, after obtaining the consent of the god- dess (by the previous hint) Lord Sambhu, the ocean of mercy
verses.hindi: तीनों भुकनों में विळ्यात है:। वहाँ: पर. विषंगाग्रज दंत्य का ,सदा ही, आवास हुआ: था ।३। सो योजन के, बिस्तार, बाले. उसके उको, पुर में वित्रसुर सूर स श्री देवी के आगम के संक्रम/से सो मोज़न बिस्तोर्ण वह. सम्पूर्ण असुरों का पुर बार-बार उत्पातों से. समुत्पन्न धूमो से आवृत के ही. समान, हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, after obtaining the consent of the god- dess (by the previous hint) Lord Sambhu, the ocean of mercy
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, after obtaining the consent of the god- dess (by the previous hint) Lord Sambhu, the ocean of mercy

verses.sanskrit: यः कालरूपो जगदादिकर्त्ता पाता पृथग्रूपधरो जगन्मयः । रर्त्ता पुना रुद्रवपुस्तथान्ते तं कालरूपं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kālarūpo jagadādikarttā pātā pṛthagrūpadharo jaganmayaḥ / rarttā punā rudravapustathānte taṃ kālarūpaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: From today onwards O Br&hmana, you shall be like Skanda to me. O highly intelligent one, I shall give you the divine coat of mail and teach you the mantra thereof.
verses.hindi: या.॥४८५॥ अकाल में हो उस हैत्य के नगर में सिल्तियाँ निमित, होगय़ी ध्रीं.। गगन स्थल से घूर्णमान महोल्का गिरा करते ये ।६। उत्पातों का सवसे प्रथम होते. बाला भूकम्प हुआ था । वहां घर. उर शून्यक , फलन में सस्पूण भूमि
verses.wordMeaning: From today onwards O Br&hmana, you shall be like Skanda to me. O highly intelligent one, I shall give you the divine coat of mail and teach you the mantra thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: From today onwards O Br&hmana, you shall be like Skanda to me. O highly intelligent one, I shall give you the divine coat of mail and teach you the mantra thereof.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा स तु भार्गवो मुदा पषात तस्याङ्घ्रि समीप आतुरः । उत्थाप्य तं वामकरेण लीलया दध्रे तदा मूर्ध्नि करं कृपार्णवः
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvā sa tu bhārgavo mudā paṣāta tasyāṅghri samīpa āturaḥ / utthāpya taṃ vāmakareṇa līlayā dadhre tadā mūrdhni karaṃ kṛpārṇavaḥ
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: आशीर्भिरेनं ह्यभिनन्द्य सादरं निवेशयामास गणेशपूर्वतः । उवाच वामामभिवीक्ष्य चाप्युमां कृपार्द्रदृष्ट्याखिलकामपूरकः
verses.transliteration: āśīrbhirenaṃ hyabhinandya sādaraṃ niveśayāmāsa gaṇeśapūrvataḥ / uvāca vāmāmabhivīkṣya cāpyumāṃ kṛpārdradṛṣṭyākhilakāmapūrakaḥ
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच कस्त्वं वटो कस्यकुले प्रसूतः किं कार्यमुद्दिश्य भवानिहागतः । विनिर्द्दिशाहं तव भक्तिभावतः प्रीतः प्रदद्यां भवतो मनोगतम्
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca kastvaṃ vaṭo kasyakule prasūtaḥ kiṃ kāryamuddiśya bhavānihāgataḥ / vinirddiśāhaṃ tava bhaktibhāvataḥ prītaḥ pradadyāṃ bhavato manogatam
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: यत्कार्यार्थमहं नाथ तव सांनिध्यमागतः । तं प्रसाधय विश्वेश वाञ्छितं काममेव मे

verses.sanskrit: मृगयामागतस्यापि कार्त्तवीर्यस्य भूपतेः । आतिथ्यं कृतवान् देव जमदग्निः पिता मम

verses.transliteration: rājā taṃ sa balāllobhātpātayāmāsa mandadhīḥ / sā dhenustaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā gavāṃ lokaṃ jagāma ha
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: राजा न शोचन्मरणं पितुर्मम निरागसः । जगाम स्वपुरं पश्चान्माता मे प्रारुदद्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: rājā na śocanmaraṇaṃ piturmama nirāgasaḥ / jagāma svapuraṃ paścānmātā me prārudadbhṛśam
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: तज्ज्ञात्वा लोकवृत्तज्ञो भृगुर्नः प्रपितामहः । आजगाम महादेव ह्यहमप्यागतो वनात्
verses.transliteration: tajjñātvā lokavṛttajño bhṛgurnaḥ prapitāmahaḥ / ājagāma mahādeva hyahamapyāgato vanāt
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: मया मह सुदुःखार्त्तान्भ्रातॄन्मात्रासहैव मे । सांत्वयित्वा स मन्त्रज्ञो ऽजीवयत्पितरं मम
verses.transliteration: mayā maha suduḥkhārttānbhrātṝnmātrāsahaiva me / sāṃtvayitvā sa mantrajño 'jīvayatpitaraṃ mama
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: के पुर में निवास करने बाले लोग अकाल में हीं हृदय के
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: आनागते भृगौ मातुर्दुःखेनाहं प्रकोपितः । प्रतिज्ञां कृतवान्देव सात्वयन्मातरंस्वकाम्
verses.transliteration: ānāgate bhṛgau māturduḥkhenāhaṃ prakopitaḥ / pratijñāṃ kṛtavāndeva sātvayanmātaraṃsvakām
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: त होगये थे । ध्वजाओं के आगे रहने वाले ' कके गृधे-वेक ओर
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो यदुरस्ताडितं मातुरात्मनः । तावत्संख्यमहं पृथ्वीं करिष्ये क्षत्रवर्जिताम्
verses.transliteration: triḥsaptakṛtvo yadurastāḍitaṃ māturātmanaḥ / tāvatsaṃkhyamahaṃ pṛthvīṃ kariṣye kṣatravarjitām
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: पक्षो आदित्य मंडल में देख-देंखकर बड़े ऊँचे स्वर से क्रन्दने करने लगे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं परिपूर्णा मे कर्त्ता देवो जगत्पतिः । महादेवो ह्यतो नाथ त्वत्सकाणमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ paripūrṇā me karttā devo jagatpatiḥ / mahādevo hyato nātha tvatsakāṇamihāgataḥ
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: बहाँ पर बहुत से (कव्पाद राक्रस) गण ये जो नेत्रो के द्वारा /दिखलाई नहीं दिये गये थे । ८-६४ बार-बार आकाश वाणियों के द्वारा बोलते. यरे और सभी ओर दिशाओं पे केतु बहुत हो मलिन दिखलाई दे रहे ये.।१९। वे सब धूमा- अमान: हो रहे के ओर॒.वेल्यो, तया. राक्षसो. के हृदयों में. बडे. भारी क्षोभ को
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्येवं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा दुर्गामुखं हरः । बभूवानम्रवदनस्छिन्तयानः क्षणं तदा
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityevaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā durgāmukhaṃ haraḥ / babhūvānamravadanaschintayānaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: उत्पन्तत करते बाले. बे । ओर असमय में हो देल्यो की स्त्रियों के भूषण और सालापे' अष्ट होकर गिर रहे ये; ।३१। हा;हा -श्वनि करके अश्रू पात करती हुई कुदत की ध्वनि में सब रो रहीं थी । वहाँ, पर, दर्षण-वर्म ध्यजा: खंग़ और सम्पदाहे' एक पणि तथा वस्त्रो में बार-बार मलिनता हो गयी
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दुर्गा विस्मिता प्राहसद्भृशम् । उवाच च महाराज भार्गवं वैरसाधकम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare durgā vismitā prāhasadbhṛśam / uvāca ca mahārāja bhārgavaṃ vairasādhakam
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: श्री । सौकरं में:चरद्र णालाओं मे. और. सभी ओर केलि करने के गृही में महात् भीषण घोष, खुनाई दिया करता था ।१२:१३। अट्टालिकाओं में-- मोको पें--बिपणों में और सभा भवनों में -चतुभ्किकाओ में-अलिस्दों में- अप्रोवों में।और बलो में.सवंत्र महान् अशुभ, एव, कठोर, घोष सुनाई बैता
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: तपस्विन्द्विजपुत्र क्ष्मां निर्भूपां कर्त्तुमिच्छसि । त्रिः सप्तकृत्वः कोपेन साहसस्ते महान्बटो
verses.transliteration: tapasvindvijaputra kṣmāṃ nirbhūpāṃ karttumicchasi / triḥ saptakṛtvaḥ kopena sāhasaste mahānbaṭo
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: हन्तुमिच्छसि निःशस्त्रः सहस्रार्जुनमीश्वरम् । भ्रूभङ्गलीलया येन रावणो ऽपि निराकृतः
verses.transliteration: hantumicchasi niḥśastraḥ sahasrārjunamīśvaram / bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā yena rāvaṇo 'pi nirākṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: शिथिली सवंत जाता घोरपेर्णा भयानका । करटेः कटुकालापेरवेलोकिं दिव!करं- । आराविष कंरोटीचां कोटेयश्चांपततम्भुवि १ हिं८'

verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै प्रदत्तं दत्तेन श्रीहरेः कवचं पुरा । शक्तिरत्यर्थवीर्या च तं कथं हन्तुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: tasmai pradattaṃ dattena śrīhareḥ kavacaṃ purā / śaktiratyarthavīryā ca taṃ kathaṃ hantumicchasi

verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.transliteration: śaṅkaraḥ karuṇāsiddhaḥ karttuṃ cāpyanyathā vibhuḥ / na cānyaḥ śaṅkarātputra satkāryaṃ karttumīśvaraḥ
