verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: अथ देव्या अनुमतिं प्राप्य शंभुर्द्दयार्णवः । अभ्यधाद्भद्रया वाया जमदग्निसुतं विभुः
verses.transliteration: atha devyā anumatiṃ prāpya śaṃbhurddayārṇavaḥ / abhyadhādbhadrayā vāyā jamadagnisutaṃ vibhuḥ
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच अद्यप्रभृति विप्र त्वं मम स्कन्दसमो भव । दास्यामि मन्त्रं दिव्यं ते कवचं च महामते
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca adyaprabhṛti vipra tvaṃ mama skandasamo bhava / dāsyāmi mantraṃ divyaṃ te kavacaṃ ca mahāmate
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: सवंतोभद्रवासों में- नन्द्यावत्तों-घरों में-विच्छन्दकों में और अव- रोधन पालियों ये साबंत्र बिक्षोभ हो रहा था । स्वस्तिकों में और समस्त गर्भागार पुरों में--गो पुरो में-कपाटों में और बलभियों की सीमाओं में- बातायनों में-कक्ष्याओं में और खलों में-सभी जगह देत्यों के नगर में
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: लीलया यत्प्रसादेन कार्त्तवीर्यं हनिष्यसि । त्रिः सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां महीं चापि करिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: līlayā yatprasādena kārttavīryaṃ haniṣyasi / triḥ saptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ mahīṃ cāpi kariṣyasi
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: निवासी जनों के मण्डलों के द्वारा द्वारा कहे हुए परम कठोर महान् घोष सुनाई दे रहे ये ।१५-१७। शि का भूत होते हुए घोरपर्ण और भया- नक हो गये थे तथा कटु आलाप बाले करटों के द्वारा दिवाकर देखा गया था । आरावियों में करोटियों की कोटियाँ भूमि में गिर गई थी
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तस्मै ददौ मन्त्रं सुदुर्लभम् । त्रैलोक्यविजयं नाम कवचं परमाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā śaṅkarastasmai dadau mantraṃ sudurlabham / trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: बेदियों के मध्य में शोणित मिश्रित जल की बिन्दुऐ' गिर रहीं थीं और केशौधक सभी ओर घूम से घूसर होकर गिर गये ये ।१९। भूमि में होने वाले-अन्तरिक्ष में और दिवलोक में होने वाले उत्पातों के समुदायों को देखकर सभी तगर के निवासोजन अत्यधिक भयभीत हो गये थे। इन सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: नागपाशं पाशुपतं ब्रह्मास्त्रं च सुदुर्ल्लभम् । नारायणास्त्रमाग्नेयं वायव्यं वारुणं तथा
verses.transliteration: nāgapāśaṃ pāśupataṃ brahmāstraṃ ca sudurllabham / nārāyaṇāstramāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.hindi: ने परम प्रसिद्ध ओज वाले भण्डासुर से इस दृश्यमान भीषणता के विषय में निबेदन किया था ।२०। और बह भष्डासुर को इन परम प्रचण्ड उत्पातों के समुदायों से भी धीरज का भ्रण नहों हुआ था ओर वह मन्त्र स्थान को सम्प्राप्त हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: घान्धर्वं गारुडं चैव जृंभणास्त्रं महाद्भुतम् । गदां शक्तिं च परशुं शूलं दण्डमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ghāndharvaṃ gāruḍaṃ caiva jṛṃbhaṇāstraṃ mahādbhutam / gadāṃ śaktiṃ ca paraśuṃ śūlaṃ daṇḍamanuttamam
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: शस्त्रास्त्रग्राममखिलं प्रहृष्टः संबभूव ह । नमस्कृत्य शिवं शान्तं दुर्गां स्कन्दं गणेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: śastrāstragrāmamakhilaṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ saṃbabhūva ha / namaskṛtya śivaṃ śāntaṃ durgāṃ skandaṃ gaṇeśvaram
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: परिक्रम्य ययौ रामः पुष्करं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । सिद्धं कृत्वा शिवोक्तं तु मन्त्रं कवचमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: parikramya yayau rāmaḥ puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam / siddhaṃ kṛtvā śivoktaṃ tu mantraṃ kavacamuttamam
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: साधयामास निखिलं स्वकार्यं भृगुनन्दनः । निहत्य कार्त्तवीर्यं तं ससैन्यं सकुलं मुदा । विनिवृत्तो गृहं प्रागात्पितुः स्वस्य भृगूद्वहः
verses.transliteration: sādhayāmāsa nikhilaṃ svakāryaṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ / nihatya kārttavīryaṃ taṃ sasainyaṃ sakulaṃ mudā / vinivṛtto gṛhaṃ prāgātpituḥ svasya bhṛgūdvahaḥ
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते द्वात्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३२॥ सगर उवाच श्रुतं सर्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कीर्त्यमानं त्वया विभो । कवचं वद सर्वत्र त्रैलोक्यविजयप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite dvātriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 32// sagara uvāca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ muniśreṣṭha kīrtyamānaṃ tvayā vibho / kavacaṃ vada sarvatra trailokyavijayapradam
verses.translation: Everything glorified by you, O holy lord, O excellent sage has been heard. Recount to me the Kavaca (Protective Mantra) which grants the conquest of the three worlds, everywhere.
verses.hindi: न तेन शिरसा तस्य मृदुनंती पादपीठिकाम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Everything glorified by you, O holy lord, O excellent sage has been heard. Recount to me the Kavaca (Protective Mantra) which grants the conquest of the three worlds, everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything glorified by you, O holy lord, O excellent sage has been heard. Recount to me the Kavaca (Protective Mantra) which grants the conquest of the three worlds, everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि कवचं परमाद्भुतम् । मन्त्र च सिद्धिद शश्वत्साधकानां सुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ paramādbhutam / mantra ca siddhida śaśvatsādhakānāṃ sukhāvaham
verses.translation: Listen, O dcarcne, I shall recount to you the ex- tremely miraculous Kavaca. I shall teach you the Mantra also that bestows spiritual attainment and which always brings happiness to those who aspire to achieve it and practise it.
verses.hindi: वहाँ पर मेरु पर्वत के समान बघु बाले तथा बहुत से रत्नों से चित्रित
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O dcarcne, I shall recount to you the ex- tremely miraculous Kavaca. I shall teach you the Mantra also that bestows spiritual attainment and which always brings happiness to those who aspire to achieve it and practise it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O dcarcne, I shall recount to you the ex- tremely miraculous Kavaca. I shall teach you the Mantra also that bestows spiritual attainment and which always brings happiness to those who aspire to achieve it and practise it.

verses.sanskrit: गोपीजनपदस्यात वल्लभाय समुच्चरेत् । स्वाहान्तो ऽयं महामन्त्रो दशार्णो भुक्तिमुक्तिदः
verses.transliteration: gopījanapadasyāta vallabhāya samuccaret / svāhānto 'yaṃ mahāmantro daśārṇo bhuktimuktidaḥ
verses.translation: At the end of the word Gopijana one shall utter the word Vallabhdya. Ending with Svdhd, this great Mantra (viz. Gopijana-Vallabhaya Svdhd meaning 'Svaha unto the lover of cowherdess folks' ) of ten syllables is the bestower of worldly pleasure as well as salvation.
verses.hindi: त मुकुटं में लगे हुए रत्नों की किरणों से सव दिशाओं को दीपित करता हुआ वहाँ पर समवस्थित हुआ था।२३। उस समय में उसके दो अनुजों के द्वारा बह सेवित हुआ था । वह आस्थान मण्डप महान् था तथा एक योजन के विस्तार से युक्त या । वहाँ पर एक बहुत ही ऊँचा सिहासत
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the word Gopijana one shall utter the word Vallabhdya. Ending with Svdhd, this great Mantra (viz. Gopijana-Vallabhaya Svdhd meaning 'Svaha unto the lover of cowherdess folks' ) of ten syllables is the bestower of worldly pleasure as well as salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the word Gopijana one shall utter the word Vallabhdya. Ending with Svdhd, this great Mantra (viz. Gopijana-Vallabhaya Svdhd meaning 'Svaha unto the lover of cowherdess folks' ) of ten syllables is the bestower of worldly pleasure as well as salvation.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवस्त्वस्य ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उदाहृतम् । देवता कृष्ण उदितो विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये
verses.transliteration: sadāśivastvasya ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtam / devatā kṛṣṇa udito viniyogo 'khilāptaye
verses.translation: 'Obeisance to Gopala; let this Mantra always protect my cheek. 'Klim, obeisance to Krsna'. Let the wish-yielding Kalpa-tree protect my ears.
verses.hindi: था जिस पर यह दानवेन्द्र विराज मान हुआ था ।२४। विशुक्र और विषंग ये दोनों इसके छोटे भाई बड़े हो अधिक बल और पराक्रम वाले ये और ये दोनों तीनों लोकों के लिये कण्डक के ही समान भुजदण्ड वाले तथा भयङ्कुर थे ।३४। ये दोनों ही अपने बड़े भाई की आज्ञा का कभी उल्लंघन नहीं किया
verses.wordMeaning: 'Obeisance to Gopala; let this Mantra always protect my cheek. 'Klim, obeisance to Krsna'. Let the wish-yielding Kalpa-tree protect my ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Obeisance to Gopala; let this Mantra always protect my cheek. 'Klim, obeisance to Krsna'. Let the wish-yielding Kalpa-tree protect my ears.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यविजयस्याथ कवचस्य प्रजापतिः । ऋषिश्छन्दश्च जगती देवो राजेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: trailokyavijayasyātha kavacasya prajāpatiḥ / ṛṣiśchandaśca jagatī devo rājeśvaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: 'Srim, obeisance to Krsna', let this always protect the pair of my lips. Om Svaha unto Goplfa, let this protect the row of my teeth.
verses.hindi: करते थे और उन्होंने त्र॑ लोक्य के विजय करने पें महात् यश प्राप्त किया घा ।२६। उन्होंने अपने शिर को झुकाकर उसको पाद पीठिका को प्रणाम किया था ओर अपने दोनों करों को जोड़कर ये भूमि में बेठ गये ये ।२७। इसके अनन्तर जत्र वह सुरों का महान् शत्रु उस आस्थान मण्डप में समवस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: 'Srim, obeisance to Krsna', let this always protect the pair of my lips. Om Svaha unto Goplfa, let this protect the row of my teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Srim, obeisance to Krsna', let this always protect the pair of my lips. Om Svaha unto Goplfa, let this protect the row of my teeth.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यविजयप्राप्तौ विनियोगः प्रकीर्त्तितः । प्रणवो मेशिरः पातु श्रीकृष्णाय नमः सदा
verses.transliteration: trailokyavijayaprāptau viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ / praṇavo meśiraḥ pātu śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Let this Mantra of three syllables viz. 'Srikrsna'
verses.hindi: हो गया था तो उसका दर्शन करने के लिए उस समय में समस्त सामन्त दंत्यों के साथ वहाँ पर सभुपस्पित हो गये पे
verses.wordMeaning: Let this Mantra of three syllables viz. 'Srikrsna'
verses.commentary: Sense: Let this Mantra of three syllables viz. 'Srikrsna'

verses.sanskrit: पायात्कपालं कृष्णाय स्वाहेति सततं मम । कृष्णेति पातु नेत्रे मे कृष्णस्वाहेति तारकाम्
verses.transliteration: pāyātkapālaṃ kṛṣṇāya svāheti satataṃ mama / kṛṣṇeti pātu netre me kṛṣṇasvāheti tārakām
verses.translation: ' Svdhd unto Rdmefvara (prob. Rdsefvara).* Let this always protect my palate. ' Svdhd unto Rddhikd's lord \ Let this always protect my neck (throat).
verses.wordMeaning: ' Svdhd unto Rdmefvara (prob. Rdsefvara).* Let this always protect my palate. ' Svdhd unto Rddhikd's lord \ Let this always protect my neck (throat).
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Svdhd unto Rdmefvara (prob. Rdsefvara).* Let this always protect my palate. ' Svdhd unto Rddhikd's lord \ Let this always protect my neck (throat).

verses.sanskrit: हरये नम इत्येष भ्रूलतां पातु मे सदा । ॐ गोविन्दाय स्वाहेति नासिकां पातु संततम्
verses.transliteration: haraye nama ityeṣa bhrūlatāṃ pātu me sadā / oṃ govindāya svāheti nāsikāṃ pātu saṃtatam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.

verses.sanskrit: गोपालाय नमो गण्डं पातु मे सततं मनुः । क्लीं कृष्णाय नमः कर्णौं पातु कल्पतरुर्मम
verses.transliteration: gopālāya namo gaṇḍaṃ pātu me satataṃ manuḥ / klīṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ karṇauṃ pātu kalpatarurmama
verses.translation: ' Obeisance to the Lord in the guise of a boy; Svdhd (to Him), (let this Mantra) protect my back. * Obeisance to MukundcC; let this Mantra always protect my belly.
verses.wordMeaning: ' Obeisance to the Lord in the guise of a boy; Svdhd (to Him), (let this Mantra) protect my back. * Obeisance to MukundcC; let this Mantra always protect my belly.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Obeisance to the Lord in the guise of a boy; Svdhd (to Him), (let this Mantra) protect my back. * Obeisance to MukundcC; let this Mantra always protect my belly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीं कृष्णाय नमः पातु नित्यं मे ऽधरयुग्मकम् । ॐ गोपीशाय स्वाहेति दन्तपङ्क्तिं ममावतु
verses.transliteration: śrīṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ pātu nityaṃ me 'dharayugmakam / oṃ gopīśāya svāheti dantapaṅktiṃ mamāvatu
verses.translation: 'Hrim Srim Klim, Svdhd unto Kr$na; let this always protect my hands, 'Om obeisance and Svdhd unto Vi$nu\ let this protect the pair of my arms.
verses.wordMeaning: 'Hrim Srim Klim, Svdhd unto Kr$na; let this always protect my hands, 'Om obeisance and Svdhd unto Vi$nu\ let this protect the pair of my arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Hrim Srim Klim, Svdhd unto Kr$na; let this always protect my hands, 'Om obeisance and Svdhd unto Vi$nu\ let this protect the pair of my arms.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्णेति रदच्छिद्रं पातुमे त्र्यक्षरो मनुः । ॐ श्रीकृष्णाय स्वाहेति जिह्विकां पातु मे सदा
verses.transliteration: śrīkṛṣṇeti radacchidraṃ pātume tryakṣaro manuḥ / oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti jihvikāṃ pātu me sadā
verses.translation: '0m Hrim, Svdhd unto the Lord; let this protect the row of my nails. ' Obeisance to Narayana'; let this protect the cavity beneath the nails of mine.
verses.wordMeaning: '0m Hrim, Svdhd unto the Lord; let this protect the row of my nails. ' Obeisance to Narayana'; let this protect the cavity beneath the nails of mine.
verses.commentary: Sense: '0m Hrim, Svdhd unto the Lord; let this protect the row of my nails. ' Obeisance to Narayana'; let this protect the cavity beneath the nails of mine.

verses.sanskrit: रामेश्वराय स्वाहेति तालुकं पातु मे सदा । राधिकेशाय स्वाहेति कण्ठं मे पातु सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: rāmeśvarāya svāheti tālukaṃ pātu me sadā / rādhikeśāya svāheti kaṇṭhaṃ me pātu sarvadā
verses.translation: 'Orh Hrim Srim obeisance unto Padma-nabha; let this protect always my navel. 'Om Svdhd unto the lord of all', let this always protect my hairs.
verses.wordMeaning: 'Orh Hrim Srim obeisance unto Padma-nabha; let this protect always my navel. 'Om Svdhd unto the lord of all', let this always protect my hairs.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Orh Hrim Srim obeisance unto Padma-nabha; let this protect always my navel. 'Om Svdhd unto the lord of all', let this always protect my hairs.

verses.sanskrit: नमो गोपीगणेशाय ग्रीवां मे पातु सर्वदा । ॐ गोपेशाय स्वाहेति स्कन्धौ पातु सदा मम
verses.transliteration: namo gopīgaṇeśāya grīvāṃ me pātu sarvadā / oṃ gopeśāya svāheti skandhau pātu sadā mama
verses.translation: ' Obeisance to Kr$na, Svdhd { unto him)9, let this even protect the Brahmarandhra ( the aperture on the crown of the head, the outlet for the soul at the time of death). ' Orh Svdhd unto Madhava\ let this always protect my forehead.
verses.wordMeaning: ' Obeisance to Kr$na, Svdhd { unto him)9, let this even protect the Brahmarandhra ( the aperture on the crown of the head, the outlet for the soul at the time of death). ' Orh Svdhd unto Madhava\ let this always protect my forehead.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Obeisance to Kr$na, Svdhd { unto him)9, let this even protect the Brahmarandhra ( the aperture on the crown of the head, the outlet for the soul at the time of death). ' Orh Svdhd unto Madhava\ let this always protect my forehead.

verses.sanskrit: नमः किशोरवेषाय स्वाहा पृष्ठं ममावतु । उदरं पातु मे नित्यं मुकुन्दाय नमो मनुः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kiśoraveṣāya svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ mamāvatu / udaraṃ pātu me nityaṃ mukundāya namo manuḥ
verses.translation: '0m Hrim Srim obeisance to the lord of Rasikas* (those who appreciate beauty and enjoy pleasure)', let this always protect my waist. * Obeisance to the lord of cowherdess-folk9. Let this always protect my thighs.
verses.wordMeaning: '0m Hrim Srim obeisance to the lord of Rasikas* (those who appreciate beauty and enjoy pleasure)', let this always protect my waist. * Obeisance to the lord of cowherdess-folk9. Let this always protect my thighs.
verses.commentary: Sense: '0m Hrim Srim obeisance to the lord of Rasikas* (those who appreciate beauty and enjoy pleasure)', let this always protect my waist. * Obeisance to the lord of cowherdess-folk9. Let this always protect my thighs.

verses.sanskrit: ह्नीं श्रीङ्क्लीङ्कृष्णाय स्वाहा करौ पातु सदा मम । ॐ विष्णवे नमः स्वाहा बाहुयुग्मं ममावतु
verses.transliteration: hnīṃ śrīṅklīṅkṛṣṇāya svāhā karau pātu sadā mama / oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ svāhā bāhuyugmaṃ mamāvatu
verses.translation: 'Orh, obeisance to the destroyer of the Daityas, Svdhd {unto Him) * let this (Mantra) protect my knees. Let the Mantra 'Unto the son of YaSodd ending with Namah {obeisance) protect my calfmuscles.'
verses.wordMeaning: 'Orh, obeisance to the destroyer of the Daityas, Svdhd {unto Him) * let this (Mantra) protect my knees. Let the Mantra 'Unto the son of YaSodd ending with Namah {obeisance) protect my calfmuscles.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Orh, obeisance to the destroyer of the Daityas, Svdhd {unto Him) * let this (Mantra) protect my knees. Let the Mantra 'Unto the son of YaSodd ending with Namah {obeisance) protect my calfmuscles.'

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ह्रींभगवते स्वाहा नखपङ्क्तिं ममावतु । नमो नारायणायेति नखरन्ध्रं ममावतु
verses.transliteration: oṃ hrīṃbhagavate svāhā nakhapaṅktiṃ mamāvatu / namo nārāyaṇāyeti nakharandhraṃ mamāvatu
verses.translation: Let (the Mantra) ending with ' Svdhd unto the person who is fond of beginning the Rasa dance ' protect my modesty and bashfulness. Let (the Mantra), 'Svdhd unto the lover of Vrndd * protect my limbs.

verses.wordMeaning: Let Govinda protect me in the North-West. Let Rasikesvara (Lord of those who enjoy aesthetic pleasure) protect me in the North. Let the lord who sports about in the forest ofVrndavana protect me always in the North-East.

verses.translation: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.
verses.hindi: निवेद्य भण्डद॑ त्यस्य कोघं तस्य व्यवीवृधत्
verses.wordMeaning: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं देयं शिरो देयं प्राणा देयाश्च भूपते । एतत्तु कवचं वत्स न देयं संकटे ऽपि च
verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ prāṇā deyāśca bhūpate / etattu kavacaṃ vatsa na deyaṃ saṃkaṭe 'pi ca
verses.translation: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.
verses.wordMeaning: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.

verses.sanskrit: मया प्रकाशितं यत्ते चैतेषां त्राणकारणात् । ममाज्ञाकरणाच्चैव तद्विद्धि कुलभास्कर । इदं धृत्वा तु कवचं चक्रवर्त्ती भवान्भव
verses.transliteration: mayā prakāśitaṃ yatte caiteṣāṃ trāṇakāraṇāt / mamājñākaraṇāccaiva tadviddhi kulabhāskara / idaṃ dhṛtvā tu kavacaṃ cakravarttī bhavānbhava
verses.translation: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.
verses.hindi: यञचयि वह स्त्री है तो भी उसका अपमान कभी भी नहीं करना चाहिए । जो आत्मज्ञानी हैं उनके द्वारा छोटा भी शत्रु जीतने की इच्छा बालों के द्वारा कभी भी अपमानित नहीं होना चाहिए ।४३। इसलिए उत्सारण के वास्ते किक्कुर अवश्य ही भेज देने चाहिए कि ५ उश मद :
verses.wordMeaning: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand this, O Sun of the family, that this has been revealed to you for the purpose of protecting all these (?) and also because you have carried out my behest. Be an Emperor by wearing this Kavaca.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः सगर उवाच ब्रह्मपुत्र महाभाग महान्मे ऽनुग्रहः कृतः । यदिदं कवचं मह्यं प्रकाशितमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite trayastriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sagara uvāca brahmaputra mahābhāga mahānme 'nugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ / yadidaṃ kavacaṃ mahyaṃ prakāśitamanāmayam
verses.translation: "O highly fortunate son' of Brahma, great is the favour done to me because this Kavaca, devoid of any deficiency, has been revealed to me.
verses.hindi: उदता स्त्री के शिर के केशों को पकड़ कर उसे यहां ले आवें ।./॥
verses.wordMeaning: "O highly fortunate son' of Brahma, great is the favour done to me because this Kavaca, devoid of any deficiency, has been revealed to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O highly fortunate son' of Brahma, great is the favour done to me because this Kavaca, devoid of any deficiency, has been revealed to me.

verses.sanskrit: और्वेणानुगृहीतो ऽहं कृतास्त्रो यदनुग्रहात् । भवतस्तु कृपापात्रं जातो ऽहमधुना विभो
verses.transliteration: aurveṇānugṛhīto 'haṃ kṛtāstro yadanugrahāt / bhavatastu kṛpāpātraṃ jāto 'hamadhunā vibho
verses.translation: I have been blessed by Aurva because it was through his favour that I learnt how to discharge missiles. Now, O holy lord, I have become the object of your grace.
verses.hindi: आपके यहाँ अन्दर अवरोध में रहने वाली जो हरिण के समान नेत्रों ६:ती सुस्दरिया हैं उनकी दासी बनकर बहुत समय तक बह दुष्टा स्त्री उनको सेबा किया करेगी ।४५। हमारे एक-एक योद्धा से ही परिपन्थी की सेनाओं में त्रैलोक्य विशेष खूपसे त्रस्त होकर सम्पूर्ण चराचर शङ्कित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: I have been blessed by Aurva because it was through his favour that I learnt how to discharge missiles. Now, O holy lord, I have become the object of your grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been blessed by Aurva because it was through his favour that I learnt how to discharge missiles. Now, O holy lord, I have become the object of your grace.

verses.sanskrit: रामेण भार्गवेन्द्रेण कार्त्तवीर्यो नृपो गुरो । यथा समापितो वीरस्तन्मे विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa bhārgavendreṇa kārttavīryo nṛpo guro / yathā samāpito vīrastanme vistarato vada
verses.translation: O preceptor, recount to me in detail how the heroic king Karttavirya was slain by Rama, the leading member of the family of Bhfgu.
verses.hindi: हे दानव ! अन्य तो आपका चित्त हो प्रमाण है। ऐसा निवेदन करके उस
verses.wordMeaning: O preceptor, recount to me in detail how the heroic king Karttavirya was slain by Rama, the leading member of the family of Bhfgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O preceptor, recount to me in detail how the heroic king Karttavirya was slain by Rama, the leading member of the family of Bhfgu.

verses.sanskrit: कृपापात्रं स दत्तस्य राजा रामः शिवस्य च । उभौ तौ समरे वीरौ जघटाते कथं गुरो
verses.transliteration: kṛpāpātraṃ sa dattasya rājā rāmaḥ śivasya ca / ubhau tau samare vīrau jaghaṭāte kathaṃ guro
verses.translation: That king enjoyed the favour of Datta and Rama that of Siva. How did these two heroes come together in the battle, O preceptor?
verses.hindi: अंडासुर का कोध और अधिक बढ़ा दिया था ।४७। महादू सत्व वाला जो विंग बह विचक्षण और विचारों का ज्ञाता या। वह अपने बड़े भाई से यह बोला था जो कि उदत दत्य था ।४८। है देव ! आप तो स्वय शप्तुओं के दमन करने बाले हैं आप स्वयं ही सव कार्ये को जानते हैं । आपको किसी
verses.wordMeaning: That king enjoyed the favour of Datta and Rama that of Siva. How did these two heroes come together in the battle, O preceptor?
verses.commentary: Sense: That king enjoyed the favour of Datta and Rama that of Siva. How did these two heroes come together in the battle, O preceptor?

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि चरितं पापनाशनम् । कार्त्तवीर्यस्य भूपस्य रामस्य च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi caritaṃ pāpanāśanam / kārttavīryasya bhūpasya rāmasya ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Listen O king, I shall recount to you the story of king KArttavIrya and the noble-soulcd Rama — the story that dispells sins.
verses.hindi: को भी कुछ भी नहीं बताना चाहिए क्योंकि आप नीति के मार्ग में रहा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "Listen O king, I shall recount to you the story of king KArttavIrya and the noble-soulcd Rama — the story that dispells sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Listen O king, I shall recount to you the story of king KArttavIrya and the noble-soulcd Rama — the story that dispells sins.

verses.sanskrit: स रामः कवचं लब्ध्वा मन्त्रं चैव गुरोर्मुखात् । चकार माधनं तस्य भक्त्या परमया युतः
verses.transliteration: sa rāmaḥ kavacaṃ labdhvā mantraṃ caiva gurormukhāt / cakāra mādhanaṃ tasya bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: After receiving the Kavaca and the Mantra directly from the preceptor, Rama began to practise the same with great devotion.
verses.wordMeaning: After receiving the Kavaca and the Mantra directly from the preceptor, Rama began to practise the same with great devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After receiving the Kavaca and the Mantra directly from the preceptor, Rama began to practise the same with great devotion.

verses.sanskrit: भूमिशागी त्रिषवण स्नानसध्यापरायणः । उवासपुष्करे राम शतवर्षमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: bhūmiśāgī triṣavaṇa snānasadhyāparāyaṇaḥ / uvāsapuṣkare rāma śatavarṣamatandritaḥ
verses.translation: Rama stayed at Puskara for a hundred years regular- ly sleeping down on the bare ground, devoted to the perform- ance of the Sandhya prayers and bath three times a day, and never remaining languid.
verses.wordMeaning: Rama stayed at Puskara for a hundred years regular- ly sleeping down on the bare ground, devoted to the perform- ance of the Sandhya prayers and bath three times a day, and never remaining languid.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama stayed at Puskara for a hundred years regular- ly sleeping down on the bare ground, devoted to the perform- ance of the Sandhya prayers and bath three times a day, and never remaining languid.

verses.sanskrit: समित्पुष्पकुशादीनि द्रव्याण्यहरहर्भृगोः । आनीय काननाद्भूप प्रायच्छदकृतव्रणः
verses.transliteration: samitpuṣpakuśādīni dravyāṇyaharaharbhṛgoḥ / ānīya kānanādbhūpa prāyacchadakṛtavraṇaḥ
verses.translation: Everyday, O king, Akrtavrana, brought materials of worship such as sacrificial twigs, flowers, Kusa grass etc. from the forest and gave them to Rama, the member of the family of Bhrgu.
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday, O king, Akrtavrana, brought materials of worship such as sacrificial twigs, flowers, Kusa grass etc. from the forest and gave them to Rama, the member of the family of Bhrgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday, O king, Akrtavrana, brought materials of worship such as sacrificial twigs, flowers, Kusa grass etc. from the forest and gave them to Rama, the member of the family of Bhrgu.

verses.sanskrit: सततं ध्यानसंयुक्तो रामो मतिमतां वरः । आराधयामास विभुं कृष्णं कल्मषनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: satataṃ dhyānasaṃyukto rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ / ārādhayāmāsa vibhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam
verses.translation: Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent per- sons, was continuously absorbed in meditation. He thus propitiated lord Kisna the destroyer of sins.
verses.wordMeaning: Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent per- sons, was continuously absorbed in meditation. He thus propitiated lord Kisna the destroyer of sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent per- sons, was continuously absorbed in meditation. He thus propitiated lord Kisna the destroyer of sins.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं यजमानस्य रामस्य जगतीपते । गतं वर्षशतं तत्र ध्यानयुक्तस्य नित्यदा
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ yajamānasya rāmasya jagatīpate / gataṃ varṣaśataṃ tatra dhyānayuktasya nityadā
verses.translation: As he continued his worship and his perpetual meditation, O king, a hundred years elapsed.
verses.wordMeaning: As he continued his worship and his perpetual meditation, O king, a hundred years elapsed.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he continued his worship and his perpetual meditation, O king, a hundred years elapsed.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा तु महाराज रामः स्नातुं गतो महान् । मध्यमं पुष्करं तत्र ददर्शाश्वर्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ekadā tu mahārāja rāmaḥ snātuṃ gato mahān / madhyamaṃ puṣkaraṃ tatra dadarśāśvaryamuttamam
verses.translation: Once, O great king, Rama the great sage went to the middle Puskara for taking bath. There he saw an excellent miracle!
verses.hindi: विजयं लभते राजा जाल्मो मक्षु विनश्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Once, O great king, Rama the great sage went to the middle Puskara for taking bath. There he saw an excellent miracle!
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, O great king, Rama the great sage went to the middle Puskara for taking bath. There he saw an excellent miracle!

verses.sanskrit: मृग एकः समायातो मृग्य युक्तः पलायितः । व्याधस्य मृगयां प्राप्तो धर्मतप्तो ऽतिपीडितः
verses.transliteration: mṛga ekaḥ samāyāto mṛgya yuktaḥ palāyitaḥ / vyādhasya mṛgayāṃ prāpto dharmatapto 'tipīḍitaḥ
verses.translation: A stag came there running accompanied by a hind. He was being chased by a hunter. He was extremely afflicted and distressed by the heat.
verses.hindi: नावज्ञा वेरिणां कार्या शक्तेः संत्र सम्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: A stag came there running accompanied by a hind. He was being chased by a hunter. He was extremely afflicted and distressed by the heat.
verses.commentary: Sense: A stag came there running accompanied by a hind. He was being chased by a hunter. He was extremely afflicted and distressed by the heat.

verses.sanskrit: पिपासितो महाभाग जलपानसमुत्सुकः । रामस्य पश्यतस्तत्र सरसस्तटमागतः
verses.transliteration: pipāsito mahābhāga jalapānasamutsukaḥ / rāmasya paśyatastatra sarasastaṭamāgataḥ
verses.translation: "This Rama is a great warrior. He is capable of destroying wicked persons. How can I kill the stag and the hind hunted by me, when he is within sight."
verses.wordMeaning: "This Rama is a great warrior. He is capable of destroying wicked persons. How can I kill the stag and the hind hunted by me, when he is within sight."
verses.commentary: Sense: "This Rama is a great warrior. He is capable of destroying wicked persons. How can I kill the stag and the hind hunted by me, when he is within sight."

verses.sanskrit: पश्चान्मृगी समायाता भीता सा चकितेक्षणा । उभो तौ पिबतस्तत्र जलं शङ्कितमानसौ
verses.transliteration: paścānmṛgī samāyātā bhītā sā cakitekṣaṇā / ubho tau pibatastatra jalaṃ śaṅkitamānasau
verses.translation: Occupied wi th this thought, O excellent king, he remained there itself frightened in his mind on account of Rama.
verses.hindi: जो कुछ भी करता है वह सब विचार करके ही करना चाहिए क्यों- कि भली भाँति विचार का करना हो परम गति है। बिना भली भाँति से विचार के जो भी कुछ किया जाता है वह मूल के सहित ही सम्पूर्ण विनष्ट हो जाया करता है ।१०। शत्रु के कटक में दूत प्रयत्न पूर्वक भेजने चाहिए ।
verses.wordMeaning: Occupied wi th this thought, O excellent king, he remained there itself frightened in his mind on account of Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Occupied wi th this thought, O excellent king, he remained there itself frightened in his mind on account of Rama.

verses.sanskrit: तावत्समागतो व्याधो बाणपाणिर्धनुर्द्धरः । स दृष्ट्वा तत्र संविष्टं रामं भार्गवनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration: tāvatsamāgato vyādho bāṇapāṇirdhanurddharaḥ / sa dṛṣṭvā tatra saṃviṣṭaṃ rāmaṃ bhārgavanandanam
verses.translation: On thinking thus, Rama the intelligent sage stood in the middle Puskara lake accompanied by his disciple, while they too continued to stand there.
verses.hindi: अपनी विजय को सिद्धि को इच्छा रखने वाले को चाहिए कि शत्र, के बल और अबल का पहिले ज्ञान प्राप्त कर लेवे ।५१। जो दूतों के द्वारा ही देखने आला है--जिसकी प्रतिज्ञा सुहढ़ है--जो सदा ही शङ्कित मन वाला है-- जो अशङ्कित आकार बाजा है--जो अपने मन्त्रियों में गुप्त मन्त्रणा वाला
verses.wordMeaning: On thinking thus, Rama the intelligent sage stood in the middle Puskara lake accompanied by his disciple, while they too continued to stand there.
verses.commentary: Sense: On thinking thus, Rama the intelligent sage stood in the middle Puskara lake accompanied by his disciple, while they too continued to stand there.

verses.sanskrit: अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तं तस्थौ दूरकृतेक्षणः । स चिन्तयामास तदा शङ्कितो भृगुनन्दनात्
verses.transliteration: akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaṃ tasthau dūrakṛtekṣaṇaḥ / sa cintayāmāsa tadā śaṅkito bhṛgunandanāt
verses.translation: After drinking water they resorted to the shade of a tree. Even as they continued to look at the noble-souled Rama, they carried on their joyous dialogue.
verses.hindi: होता है । ये छं उपाय हैं इनका प्रयोग करने वाला जो रादा अभ्यहित पद पर स्थित रहता है वही राजा विजय का लाभ प्राप्त किया करता है। जो जाल्म होता है उसका शीघ विनाश हो जाया करता है ।५२-५३। कोई भी कार्य का आरम्भ विना आगा-पीछा सोचे ही कर दिया जाया करता है वह
verses.wordMeaning: After drinking water they resorted to the shade of a tree. Even as they continued to look at the noble-souled Rama, they carried on their joyous dialogue.
verses.commentary: Sense: After drinking water they resorted to the shade of a tree. Even as they continued to look at the noble-souled Rama, they carried on their joyous dialogue.

verses.sanskrit: अयं रामो महावीरो दुष्टानामन्तकारकः । कथमेतस्य हन्म्येतौ पश्यतो मृगयामृगौ
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ rāmo mahāvīro duṣṭānāmantakārakaḥ / kathametasya hanmyetau paśyato mṛgayāmṛgau
verses.translation: ''Darling, we shall continue to stay here as long as Rama stays here. In the presence of this heroic warrior, we need not have any fear.
verses.hindi: यिनाश करने वाला ही हुआ करता है । जिसका मली भाँति विचार करके पीछे जो कर्म किया गया है वह विशेष रूप से जय देने वाला ही हुआ करता है ।५४। यह तियंग् है-र्‍यह नारी है अथवा यह क्षद्रा है-इन बातों से भी राजाओं को कभी भी वैरियों की अवज्ञा नहीं करनी चाहिए क्योंकि शक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: ''Darling, we shall continue to stay here as long as Rama stays here. In the presence of this heroic warrior, we need not have any fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''Darling, we shall continue to stay here as long as Rama stays here. In the presence of this heroic warrior, we need not have any fear.

verses.sanskrit: इति चिन्ता समाविष्टो व्याधो राजन्यसत्तम । तस्थौ तत्रैव रामस्य भयात्संत्रस्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: iti cintā samāviṣṭo vyādho rājanyasattama / tasthau tatraiva rāmasya bhayātsaṃtrastamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Even if the hunter were to come here and strike at us, he will be reduced to ashes on being merely glanced at by. the sage."
verses.hindi: तो ऐसी विलक्षण है कि वह सभी जगह हो सकती हैं । देखिये, ऐतिहासिक
verses.wordMeaning: Even if the hunter were to come here and strike at us, he will be reduced to ashes on being merely glanced at by. the sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if the hunter were to come here and strike at us, he will be reduced to ashes on being merely glanced at by. the sage."

verses.sanskrit: रामस्तु तौ मृग्ॐ दृष्ट्वा पिबन्तौ सभ्यं जलम् । तर्कयामास मेधावी किमत्र भयकारणम्
verses.transliteration: rāmastu tau mṛgoṃ dṛṣṭvā pibantau sabhyaṃ jalam / tarkayāmāsa medhāvī kimatra bhayakāraṇam
verses.translation: When these words were uttered by the hind who was pleased to see Rama, the stag too was delighted. He said to his beloved.
verses.hindi: २७  = ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण टता विद्यमान है--खम्के से समुरपल्न-नेरः ओर: तियं (वशु) -का वपु धारण करने बाले समस्त प्राणियों, का.. श्रुत नरकिह ने , हिरण्यकशिपु जेसे महान् बलवान् को मार डाला था
verses.wordMeaning: When these words were uttered by the hind who was pleased to see Rama, the stag too was delighted. He said to his beloved.
verses.commentary: Sense: When these words were uttered by the hind who was pleased to see Rama, the stag too was delighted. He said to his beloved.

verses.sanskrit: नैवात्र व्याघ्रसेनादो न च व्याधो हि दृश्यते । केनैतौ कारणेनाहो शङ्कितौ चकितेक्षणौ
verses.transliteration: naivātra vyāghrasenādo na ca vyādho hi dṛśyate / kenaitau kāraṇenāho śaṅkitau cakitekṣaṇau
verses.translation: "O highly fortunate and graceful 'lady, what you say is true. I too know the potentiality of the extremely noble- souled Rama.
verses.hindi: पुरा हि चंडिका नाम नारी मायाविजू भिणि ।
verses.wordMeaning: "O highly fortunate and graceful 'lady, what you say is true. I too know the potentiality of the extremely noble- souled Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O highly fortunate and graceful 'lady, what you say is true. I too know the potentiality of the extremely noble- souled Rama.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वा मृगजातिर्हि निसर्गाच्चकितेक्षणा । चेनैतौ जलपाने ऽपि पश्यतश्चकितेक्षणौ
verses.transliteration: atha vā mṛgajātirhi nisargāccakitekṣaṇā / cenaitau jalapāne 'pi paśyataścakitekṣaṇau
verses.translation: Brahma had commanded him, "Go to the region of Siva." On receiving his behest, this sage went to the pre- sence of Siva.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma had commanded him, "Go to the region of Siva." On receiving his behest, this sage went to the pre- sence of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma had commanded him, "Go to the region of Siva." On receiving his behest, this sage went to the pre- sence of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नैतावत्कारणं चात्र किन्तु खेदभयातुरौ । लक्षयेते खिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ कम्पयुक्तौ यतस्त्विमौ
verses.transliteration: naitāvatkāraṇaṃ cātra kintu khedabhayāturau / lakṣayete khinnasarvāṅgau kampayuktau yatastvimau
verses.translation: He joyously bade farewell to him, after giving the weapons eagerly and with due regard. O gentle lady, he has come here eager to practise the Mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: He joyously bade farewell to him, after giving the weapons eagerly and with due regard. O gentle lady, he has come here eager to practise the Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He joyously bade farewell to him, after giving the weapons eagerly and with due regard. O gentle lady, he has come here eager to practise the Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संचिन्त्य मतिमान्स तस्थौ मध्यपुष्करे । शिष्येण संयुतो रामो यावत्तौ चापि संस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃcintya matimānsa tasthau madhyapuṣkare / śiṣyeṇa saṃyuto rāmo yāvattau cāpi saṃsthitau
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा जलं ततस्तौ तु वृक्षच्छायासमाश्रितौ । रामं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं कथां तौ चक्रतुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: pītvā jalaṃ tatastau tu vṛkṣacchāyāsamāśritau / rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ kathāṃ tau cakraturmudā
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्तः स विष गेण को. विचारो महौजसाम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: मृग्युवाच कान्त चात्रैव तिष्ठावो यावद्रामो ऽत्रसंस्थितः । अस्य वीरस्य सांनिध्ये भयं नैवावयोर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mṛgyuvāca kānta cātraiva tiṣṭhāvo yāvadrāmo 'trasaṃsthitaḥ / asya vīrasya sāṃnidhye bhayaṃ naivāvayorbhavet
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्यागत्य चैव्द्याधौ ह्यावयोः प्रहरिष्यति । दृष्टमात्रो हि मुनिना भस्मीभूतो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: atrāpyāgatya caivdyādhau hyāvayoḥ prahariṣyati / dṛṣṭamātro hi muninā bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते वचने मृग्या रामर् शनतुष्टया । मृगश्चोवाच हर्षेण समाविष्टः प्रियां स्वकाम्
verses.transliteration: ityukte vacane mṛgyā rāmar śanatuṣṭayā / mṛgaścovāca harṣeṇa samāviṣṭaḥ priyāṃ svakām
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन समय में-भी चण्डिका नाम वाली एक नारी ही तो यी जिसते रण में निशुम्म-शुम्म और महिष को मार डाला ' था-।५७। उसी के असंग से उसने बहुत से देट्यों का वितताश : कर दिया -या। इसी, कारण से ैं यही बतलाता है कि यह समझ करके केवल स्त्री ही तो है कमी भी अवज्ञा नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव महाभागे यद्वै वदसि भामिनि । जाने ऽहमपि रामस्य प्रभावं सुमहात्मनः
verses.transliteration: evameva mahābhāge yadvai vadasi bhāmini / jāne 'hamapi rāmasya prabhāvaṃ sumahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.hindi: करनी चाहिए ।५८। शक्ति ही सर्वत्र विजय को श्री'का कारण हुआ करतो हैत शक्तिके आधार को प्राप्त हैं उतः-स्त्री ओर: पुरुषों से हम को भय नहीं हैं ।५६। इस सेंसार को स्वभाव से- ही शक्ति ही सर्व ओर विभात हुआ।कर्ती है। सो उस बुरे आशय वाली की क्या प्रवृत्ति है-+आप्र- को; समझ लेना
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽयं संदृश्यते चास्य पार्श्वं शिष्यो ऽकृतव्रणः । सचाने न महाभागस्त्रातो व्याघ्रभयातुरः
verses.transliteration: yo 'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate cāsya pārśvaṃ śiṣyo 'kṛtavraṇaḥ / sacāne na mahābhāgastrāto vyāghrabhayāturaḥ
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.hindi: चाहिए ।६७। है देव! आवको इतत सभी 'दालों का विचर क्रर' लेना चाहिए कि बह। कौन है-किससे.. यह सिसुत्पन्न हुई है-- इसके आचारःवया हैं: इसका ओश्र यक्पा है--इसक। बल कंसा ओर कितत्री है-- इसकी सहायता
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: अयं रामो महाभागे जमदग्निसुतो ऽनुजः । पितरं कार्त्तवीर्येण दृष्ट्वा चैव तिरस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ rāmo mahābhāge jamadagnisuto 'nujaḥ / pitaraṃ kārttavīryeṇa dṛṣṭvā caiva tiraskṛtam
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: चकारातितरां क्रुद्धः प्रतिज्ञां नृपघातिनीम् । तत्पूर्तिकामो ह्यगमद्ब्रह्मलोकं पुरा ह्ययम्
verses.transliteration: cakārātitarāṃ kruddhaḥ pratijñāṃ nṛpaghātinīm / tatpūrtikāmo hyagamadbrahmalokaṃ purā hyayam
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.hindi: करने बाले कोन-कोन हैं ।६६। उस विषंग छोटे भाई के द्वारा जब इस रीति से भंडासुर से कहा गया था तो उसने कहा था कि जो महान् ओज वाले हैं उनके लिए विचार का करने की क्या आवश्यकता है। हमारी सेना में महान् सत्वधारी हैं और सैकड़ों तो अक्षौहिणी सेना के अधिप हैं। वे इतने
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: स ब्रह्मा दिष्टवांश्चैनं शिवलोकं व्रजेति ह । तस्य त्वाज्ञां समादाय गतो ऽसौ शिवसन्निधिम्
verses.transliteration: sa brahmā diṣṭavāṃścainaṃ śivalokaṃ vrajeti ha / tasya tvājñāṃ samādāya gato 'sau śivasannidhim
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.hindi: समर्थ हैं कि जलधि के जल का भी पान कर सकते हैं ओर स्वगे को भी दग्ध कर सकते हैं । अरे ! पापसमाचार ! व्यर्थे ही स्त्रियों के विषय में तू बया ऐसी शङ्का कर रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाचाखिलवृत्तान्त राज्ञश्चप्यात्मनः पितुः । स कृपालुर्महादेवः सभाज्य भृगुनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration: provācākhilavṛttānta rājñaścapyātmanaḥ pituḥ / sa kṛpālurmahādevaḥ sabhājya bhṛgunandanam
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: ददौ कृष्णस्य सन्मन्त्रमभेद्यं कवचं तथा । स्वीयं पाशुपतं चास्त्रमन्यास्त्रग्राममेव च
verses.transliteration: dadau kṛṣṇasya sanmantramabhedyaṃ kavacaṃ tathā / svīyaṃ pāśupataṃ cāstramanyāstragrāmameva ca
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: विसर्जयामास मुदा दत्त्वा शस्त्राणि चादरात् । सो ऽयमत्रागतो भद्रे मेत्रसाधनतत्परः
verses.transliteration: visarjayāmāsa mudā dattvā śastrāṇi cādarāt / so 'yamatrāgato bhadre metrasādhanatatparaḥ
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं जपति धर्मात्मा कृष्णस्य कवचं सुधीः । शतवर्षाणि चाप्यस्य गतानि सुमहात्मनः
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ japati dharmātmā kṛṣṇasya kavacaṃ sudhīḥ / śatavarṣāṇi cāpyasya gatāni sumahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्र साधयतो भद्रे न च तत्सिद्धिरेति हि । आत्रास्ति कारणं भक्तिः साव वै त्रिविधा मता
verses.transliteration: mantra sādhayato bhadre na ca tatsiddhireti hi / ātrāsti kāraṇaṃ bhaktiḥ sāva vai trividhā matā
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमा मध्यमा चैव कनिष्ठा तरलेक्षणे । शिवस्य नारदस्यापि शुकस्य च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: uttamā madhyamā caiva kaniṣṭhā taralekṣaṇe / śivasya nāradasyāpi śukasya ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.transliteration: uttamā bhaktirevāsti gopīnāmuddhavasya ca / vasiṣṭhādimunīśānāṃ manvādīnāṃ śubhekṣaṇe

verses.sanskrit: सेवते गोपिकाधीशं तेन सिद्धिं न चागतः । वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्ता त्वरितं कान्तं सा मृगी हृष्टमानसा
verses.transliteration: sevate gopikādhīśaṃ tena siddhiṃ na cāgataḥ / vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktā tvaritaṃ kāntaṃ sā mṛgī hṛṣṭamānasā

verses.transliteration: punaḥ papraccha bhaktestu lakṣaṇaṃ premadāyakam / mṛgyuvāca sādhukānta mahābhāga vacaste 'laukikaṃ priya / rhadṛg jñānaṃ tava kathaṃ saṃjātaṃ tadvadādhunā
verses.translation: The three types of devotion are (1 ) Uttamd (the highest) (2) MadhyamU (the middle one) and (3) Kaniffhd (the lowest). O lady of tremulous eyes.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३४॥ सगर उवाच मुने परमतत्त्वज्ञध्यानज्ञानार्थकोविद । भगवद्भक्तिसंलीनमानसानुग्रहः कुतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite catustriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 34// sagara uvāca mune paramatattvajñadhyānajñānārthakovida / bhagavadbhaktisaṃlīnamānasānugrahaḥ kutaḥ
verses.translation: Listen, O king, I shall narrate the great story of the stag. The knower of the real principle that he was, he explained to her everything asked by her.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O king, I shall narrate the great story of the stag. The knower of the real principle that he was, he explained to her everything asked by her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O king, I shall narrate the great story of the stag. The knower of the real principle that he was, he explained to her everything asked by her.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयापि हि महाभाग यतः शंससि सत्कथाः । श्रुत्वा मृगमुखात्सर्वं भार्गवस्य विचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: tvayāpi hi mahābhāga yataḥ śaṃsasi satkathāḥ / śrutvā mṛgamukhātsarvaṃ bhārgavasya viceṣṭitam
verses.translation: After hearing the story of the noble-souled scion of the family of Bhrgu, she, out of reverence, asked her husband once again, matters and principles of perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing the story of the noble-souled scion of the family of Bhrgu, she, out of reverence, asked her husband once again, matters and principles of perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the story of the noble-souled scion of the family of Bhrgu, she, out of reverence, asked her husband once again, matters and principles of perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: भूतं भवद्भविष्यं च नारायणकथान्वितम् । पुनः प्रपच्छ किं नाथ तन्मे वद सविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavadbhaviṣyaṃ ca nārāyaṇakathānvitam / punaḥ prapaccha kiṃ nātha tanme vada savistaram
verses.translation: u Very very excellent, O highly fortunate one. Un- doubtedly you have realized your desires because by seeing him (i.e. Bhargava) you have acquired perfect supra-sensuous knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: u Very very excellent, O highly fortunate one. Un- doubtedly you have realized your desires because by seeing him (i.e. Bhargava) you have acquired perfect supra-sensuous knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: u Very very excellent, O highly fortunate one. Un- doubtedly you have realized your desires because by seeing him (i.e. Bhargava) you have acquired perfect supra-sensuous knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि मृगस्य चरितं महत् । यथा पृष्टं तया सो ऽस्यै वर्णयामास तत्त्ववित्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi mṛgasya caritaṃ mahat / yathā pṛṣṭaṃ tayā so 'syai varṇayāmāsa tattvavit
verses.translation: Therefore, tell me everything concerning yourself and me. O lord, tell me the reason, the invisible result of our actions whereby we have been born in the species of lower animals."
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, tell me everything concerning yourself and me. O lord, tell me the reason, the invisible result of our actions whereby we have been born in the species of lower animals."
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, tell me everything concerning yourself and me. O lord, tell me the reason, the invisible result of our actions whereby we have been born in the species of lower animals."

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु चरितं तस्य भार्गवस्य महात्मनः । भूयः प्रपच्छ तं कान्तं ज्ञानतत्त्वार्थमादरात्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu caritaṃ tasya bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ / bhūyaḥ prapaccha taṃ kāntaṃ jñānatattvārthamādarāt
verses.translation: On hearing this speech of his beloved, that stag himself narrated in detail the life story of the hind and himself.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this speech of his beloved, that stag himself narrated in detail the life story of the hind and himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this speech of his beloved, that stag himself narrated in detail the life story of the hind and himself.

verses.sanskrit: मृग्युवाच साधुसाधु महाभाग कृतार्थस्त्वं न संशयः । यदस्य दर्शनात्ते ऽद्य जातं ज्ञानमतीद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: mṛgyuvāca sādhusādhu mahābhāga kṛtārthastvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / yadasya darśanātte 'dya jātaṃ jñānamatīdriyam
verses.translation: "O my beloved of great fortune, hear how we attain- ed the status of a deer. In this world, O highly fortunate one, it is our innate disposition that is the cause of our worldly existence.
verses.wordMeaning: "O my beloved of great fortune, hear how we attain- ed the status of a deer. In this world, O highly fortunate one, it is our innate disposition that is the cause of our worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O my beloved of great fortune, hear how we attain- ed the status of a deer. In this world, O highly fortunate one, it is our innate disposition that is the cause of our worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: अथातश्चात्मनः सर्वं ममापि वद कारणम् । कर्मणा येन संप्राप्तावावां तिर्यग्जनिं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: athātaścātmanaḥ sarvaṃ mamāpi vada kāraṇam / karmaṇā yena saṃprāptāvāvāṃ tiryagjaniṃ prabho
verses.translation: It had many flowering plants such as Mallikd (jas- mine), Pdf aid (the trumpet flower), Kundo. (another variety of jasmine), Karnikaras, Kadambakas (Nauclea cadamba) and other flowers — all sweet-scented having their pollen-powder scattered everywhere by the wind.
verses.wordMeaning: It had many flowering plants such as Mallikd (jas- mine), Pdf aid (the trumpet flower), Kundo. (another variety of jasmine), Karnikaras, Kadambakas (Nauclea cadamba) and other flowers — all sweet-scented having their pollen-powder scattered everywhere by the wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had many flowering plants such as Mallikd (jas- mine), Pdf aid (the trumpet flower), Kundo. (another variety of jasmine), Karnikaras, Kadambakas (Nauclea cadamba) and other flowers — all sweet-scented having their pollen-powder scattered everywhere by the wind.

verses.sanskrit: इति वाक्यं समाकर्ण्य प्रियायाः स मृगः स्वयम् । वर्णयामास चरितं मृग्यश्चैवात्मनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya priyāyāḥ sa mṛgaḥ svayam / varṇayāmāsa caritaṃ mṛgyaścaivātmanastadā
verses.translation: The mountain appeared to be scraping the sky out
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain appeared to be scraping the sky out
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain appeared to be scraping the sky out

verses.sanskrit: मृग उवाच शृणु प्रिये महाभागे यथाऽवां मृगतां गतौ । संसारे ऽस्मिन्नमहाभागे भावो ऽस्य भवकारणम्
verses.transliteration: mṛga uvāca śṛṇu priye mahābhāge yathā'vāṃ mṛgatāṃ gatau / saṃsāre 'sminnamahābhāge bhāvo 'sya bhavakāraṇam
verses.translation: There, our eyes were attracted by diverse curious scenes and we the brothers did not remember even ourselves. We got separated from one another.
verses.wordMeaning: There, our eyes were attracted by diverse curious scenes and we the brothers did not remember even ourselves. We got separated from one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, our eyes were attracted by diverse curious scenes and we the brothers did not remember even ourselves. We got separated from one another.

verses.sanskrit: जीवस्य सदसभ्द्यां हि कर्मभ्यामागतः स्मृतिम् । पुरा द्रविडदेशे तु नानाऋद्धिसमाकुले
verses.transliteration: jīvasya sadasabhdyāṃ hi karmabhyāmāgataḥ smṛtim / purā draviḍadeśe tu nānāṛddhisamākule
verses.translation: In the meantime, O darling, a thirsty hind came there, desirous of drinking water at the top of the water- fall.
verses.hindi: २४   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण पुण्डकेतु--चण्डबाहु--कुक्कु र--जम्बुकाक्ष-- जुम्मण--ती कण भू ज़ू-- त्रिक- ण्टक--चतु गुप्त--चतु्बाहु--चका राक्ष-चतुश्शिरा-- वजघोष-- ऊरध्व केश-
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, O darling, a thirsty hind came there, desirous of drinking water at the top of the water- fall.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, O darling, a thirsty hind came there, desirous of drinking water at the top of the water- fall.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणानां कुले वाहं जातः कौशिकगोत्रिणाम् । पिता मे शिवदत्तो ऽभून्नाम्ना शास्त्रविशारदः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇānāṃ kule vāhaṃ jātaḥ kauśikagotriṇām / pitā me śivadatto 'bhūnnāmnā śāstraviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing the seizure of that hind, I became frightened and I fled. The place being rugged and steep I fell down and died remembering the hind (at the time of death).
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing the seizure of that hind, I became frightened and I fled. The place being rugged and steep I fell down and died remembering the hind (at the time of death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing the seizure of that hind, I became frightened and I fled. The place being rugged and steep I fell down and died remembering the hind (at the time of death).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रा वयं जाताश्चत्वारो द्विजसत्तमाः । ज्येष्ठो रामो ऽनुजस्तस्य धमस्तस्यानु जः पृथुः
verses.transliteration: tasya putrā vayaṃ jātāścatvāro dvijasattamāḥ / jyeṣṭho rāmo 'nujastasya dhamastasyānu jaḥ pṛthuḥ
verses.translation: This story concerning you and myself has come to my memory. Listen, O gentle lady, I shall tell you the past and the future.
verses.wordMeaning: This story concerning you and myself has come to my memory. Listen, O gentle lady, I shall tell you the past and the future.
verses.commentary: Sense: This story concerning you and myself has come to my memory. Listen, O gentle lady, I shall tell you the past and the future.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थो ऽहं प्रिये जातो सूरिरित्यभिविश्रुतः । उपनीय क्रमात्सर्वाञ्छिवदत्तो महायशाः
verses.transliteration: caturtho 'haṃ priye jāto sūrirityabhiviśrutaḥ / upanīya kramātsarvāñchivadatto mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: The hunter who pursued us so closely but kept back far away being afraid of Rama, has now been devoured by a lion.
verses.wordMeaning: The hunter who pursued us so closely but kept back far away being afraid of Rama, has now been devoured by a lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hunter who pursued us so closely but kept back far away being afraid of Rama, has now been devoured by a lion.

verses.sanskrit: वेदानध्यापयामास सांगांश्च सरहस्यकान् । चत्वारो ऽपि वयं तत्र वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: vedānadhyāpayāmāsa sāṃgāṃśca sarahasyakān / catvāro 'pi vayaṃ tatra vedādhyayanatatparāḥ
verses.translation: We shall see Agastya and hear prayer that yields our goal. Hence, we shall go to those auspicious worlds after reaching which one will never bewail (i.e. one is free from sorrows and miseries).
verses.wordMeaning: We shall see Agastya and hear prayer that yields our goal. Hence, we shall go to those auspicious worlds after reaching which one will never bewail (i.e. one is free from sorrows and miseries).
verses.commentary: Sense: We shall see Agastya and hear prayer that yields our goal. Hence, we shall go to those auspicious worlds after reaching which one will never bewail (i.e. one is free from sorrows and miseries).

verses.sanskrit: गुरुशुश्रूषणे युक्ता जाता ज्ञानपरायणाः । गत्वारण्यं फलान्यंबुसमित्कुशमृदो ऽन्वहम्
verses.transliteration: guruśuśrūṣaṇe yuktā jātā jñānaparāyaṇāḥ / gatvāraṇyaṃ phalānyaṃbusamitkuśamṛdo 'nvaham
verses.translation: After saying this to his beloved hind that stag of pleasing appearance, stopped talking. Looking at Rama without any agitation, he became delighted in his mind.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this to his beloved hind that stag of pleasing appearance, stopped talking. Looking at Rama without any agitation, he became delighted in his mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to his beloved hind that stag of pleasing appearance, stopped talking. Looking at Rama without any agitation, he became delighted in his mind.

verses.sanskrit: आनीय पित्रे दत्त्वाथ कुर्मो ऽध्ययनमेव हि । एकदा तु वयं सर्वे संप्राप्ता पर्वते वने
verses.transliteration: ānīya pitre dattvātha kurmo 'dhyayanameva hi / ekadā tu vayaṃ sarve saṃprāptā parvate vane
verses.translation: While going along his path, the hunter was seen lying dead at the attack of the lion, by the noble-souled Rama who was surprised.
verses.hindi: सेनान्यो मे मदोद्त्ता मम पुत्र रनुद्रुताः
verses.wordMeaning: While going along his path, the hunter was seen lying dead at the attack of the lion, by the noble-souled Rama who was surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: While going along his path, the hunter was seen lying dead at the attack of the lion, by the noble-souled Rama who was surprised.

verses.sanskrit: औद्भिदं नाम लोलक्षि कृतमालातटे स्थितम् । सर्वे स्नात्वा महानद्यामुषसि प्रीतमानसाः
verses.transliteration: audbhidaṃ nāma lolakṣi kṛtamālātaṭe sthitam / sarve snātvā mahānadyāmuṣasi prītamānasāḥ
verses.translation: After going more than half a Yojana (1 yojana*- 12 Km.) towards the lower Pu§kara, he took bath and per- formed the midday Sandhya rites with great joy.
verses.hindi: भलक--कशूर--मुल--द्रघण---कोल्लाट--कुजिलाश्‍व--दासेर- वश्चवाहन--हृष्टहास--हृष्केतु--परिक्षेप्ता--अपकड्चुक--महामह--महा- दंष्ट्र--दुगेति--स्वगंमेजय--घट्के तु-- षडूवसु--षड्दन्त--षट्प्रिय-दु:शट- डुविनीत--छिन्त कर्ण--मुषक-- अट्ृहासी-- महाशी-- महाशी पं-मदोतः
verses.wordMeaning: After going more than half a Yojana (1 yojana*- 12 Km.) towards the lower Pu§kara, he took bath and per- formed the midday Sandhya rites with great joy.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going more than half a Yojana (1 yojana*- 12 Km.) towards the lower Pu§kara, he took bath and per- formed the midday Sandhya rites with great joy.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तार्घाः कृतजप्याश्च समारूढा नागोत्तमम् । शालस्तमालैः प्रियकैः पनसैः कोविदारकैः
verses.transliteration: dattārghāḥ kṛtajapyāśca samārūḍhā nāgottamam / śālastamālaiḥ priyakaiḥ panasaiḥ kovidārakaiḥ
verses.translation: Drinking water at the Puskara lake and sprinkling water over their bodies, the stag and the hind came in front of the hermitage of Agastya even as Rama was glancing at them with surprise.
verses.hindi: नासिक--पृतिदस्त--पृति चक्षु-पूत्यास्य--पूतिमेहन--इत्यादिक इस प्रकार से ये शूर हिरण्यकशिपु के ही समान हैं। और मेरे महाबल वाले पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Drinking water at the Puskara lake and sprinkling water over their bodies, the stag and the hind came in front of the hermitage of Agastya even as Rama was glancing at them with surprise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drinking water at the Puskara lake and sprinkling water over their bodies, the stag and the hind came in front of the hermitage of Agastya even as Rama was glancing at them with surprise.

verses.sanskrit: सरलार्जुनपूगैश्च खर्जूरैर्नारिकेलकैः । जंबूभिः सहकारैश्च कट्फलैर्बृहतीद्रुमैः
verses.transliteration: saralārjunapūgaiśca kharjūrairnārikelakaiḥ / jaṃbūbhiḥ sahakāraiśca kaṭphalairbṛhatīdrumaiḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Puskara involved in bad condition(?) the lofty-minded Rama concluded his Sandhya rites and proceeded toward Agastya's hermitage.
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing Puskara involved in bad condition(?) the lofty-minded Rama concluded his Sandhya rites and proceeded toward Agastya's hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing Puskara involved in bad condition(?) the lofty-minded Rama concluded his Sandhya rites and proceeded toward Agastya's hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैर्नानाविधैर्वृक्षैः परार्थप्रतिपादकैः । स्निग्धच्छायैः समाहृष्टनानापक्षिनिनादितैः
verses.transliteration: anyairnānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ parārthapratipādakaiḥ / snigdhacchāyaiḥ samāhṛṣṭanānāpakṣinināditaiḥ
verses.translation: There, on its banks, Bhargava saw the wonderfully auspicious and meritorious hermitage of Agastya resorted to by many sages.
verses.hindi: हिरण्याक्ष के तुल्य हैं ।६५-६०। उनके एक-एक के सँकड़ों से भी अधिक पुत्र हैं बहुत ही शुर उत्पन्न हुए हैं । मेरे सेनानी मदोद्धत्त हैं ओर मेरे पुत्रों के पीछे दौड़ लगाने वाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: There, on its banks, Bhargava saw the wonderfully auspicious and meritorious hermitage of Agastya resorted to by many sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, on its banks, Bhargava saw the wonderfully auspicious and meritorious hermitage of Agastya resorted to by many sages.

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूल हरिभिर्भल्लैर्गण्डकैर्मृगनाभिभिः । गचैन्द्रैः शारभाद्यैश्च सेवितं कन्दरागतैः
verses.transliteration: śārdūla haribhirbhallairgaṇḍakairmṛganābhibhiḥ / gacaindraiḥ śārabhādyaiśca sevitaṃ kandarāgataiḥ
verses.translation: When Rama said this, he opened his eyes slowly and looked at Rama. Uttering words of welcome, he requested him to take seat.
verses.wordMeaning: When Rama said this, he opened his eyes slowly and looked at Rama. Uttering words of welcome, he requested him to take seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Rama said this, he opened his eyes slowly and looked at Rama. Uttering words of welcome, he requested him to take seat.

verses.sanskrit: मल्लिकापाटलाकुन्दकर्णिकारकदंबकैः । सुगन्धिभिर्वृतं चान्यैर्वातोद्धूतपरगिभिः
verses.transliteration: mallikāpāṭalākundakarṇikārakadaṃbakaiḥ / sugandhibhirvṛtaṃ cānyairvātoddhūtaparagibhiḥ
verses.translation: He caused Aiadhup&rka ( material of hospitable recep- tion) to be brought through a disciple. The leading sage offered it to Rama and enquired of him the happiness in his family as well as the excellence of his penance.
verses.wordMeaning: He caused Aiadhup&rka ( material of hospitable recep- tion) to be brought through a disciple. The leading sage offered it to Rama and enquired of him the happiness in his family as well as the excellence of his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He caused Aiadhup&rka ( material of hospitable recep- tion) to be brought through a disciple. The leading sage offered it to Rama and enquired of him the happiness in his family as well as the excellence of his penance.

verses.sanskrit: नानामणिगणाकीर्णैर्नीलपीतसितारुणैः । शृङ्गैः समुल्लिखन्तं च व्योम कौतुकसं युतम्
verses.transliteration: nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇairnīlapītasitāruṇaiḥ / śṛṅgaiḥ samullikhantaṃ ca vyoma kautukasaṃ yutam
verses.translation: After comprehending the entire reason thereof, the pot-born sage Agastya became delighted in his mind and said to Rama, the scion of the family of Bhrgu.
verses.wordMeaning: After comprehending the entire reason thereof, the pot-born sage Agastya became delighted in his mind and said to Rama, the scion of the family of Bhrgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: After comprehending the entire reason thereof, the pot-born sage Agastya became delighted in his mind and said to Rama, the scion of the family of Bhrgu.

verses.sanskrit: अत्युच्चपातध्वनिभिर्निर्झरैः कन्दरोद्गतैः । गर्ज्जतमिव संसक्तं व्यालाद्यैर्मृगपक्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: atyuccapātadhvanibhirnirjharaiḥ kandarodgataiḥ / garjjatamiva saṃsaktaṃ vyālādyairmṛgapakṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Listen, O Rama of great fortune, I shall tell you what is conducive to your welfare, whereby you will attain, ere long, the spiritual attainment and assimilation of the Mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O Rama of great fortune, I shall tell you what is conducive to your welfare, whereby you will attain, ere long, the spiritual attainment and assimilation of the Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O Rama of great fortune, I shall tell you what is conducive to your welfare, whereby you will attain, ere long, the spiritual attainment and assimilation of the Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रातिकौतुकाहृष्टदृष्टयोभ्रातरो वयम् । नास्मार्ष्म चात्मनात्मानं वियुक्ताश्च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tatrātikautukāhṛṣṭadṛṣṭayobhrātaro vayam / nāsmārṣma cātmanātmānaṃ viyuktāśca parasparam
verses.translation: If a person knows the characteristic features of devo- tion that is of three types, O highly intelligent one, and strive* for it, he will realize it quickly.
verses.hindi: जब भी संग्राम होगा तब उसमें ये लोग प्रोद्धत और अधम अमरों का नाश कर देंगे। जो कोई भी युद्ध में कुपित होंगे परम श्रेष्ठ सहस्रों अक्षौहिणी सेनाए' हैं वे सब भस्मीभूत ही हो जाँयगे । हा ! हन्त ! विचारी स्त्रियां वया हैं अर्थात युद्ध में ये कया ठहर सकती हैं ।६२। उसके समर की
verses.wordMeaning: If a person knows the characteristic features of devo- tion that is of three types, O highly intelligent one, and strive* for it, he will realize it quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person knows the characteristic features of devo- tion that is of three types, O highly intelligent one, and strive* for it, he will realize it quickly.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैका मृगी ह्यगात्पिपासिता । निर्झरापात शिरसि पातुकामा जलं प्रिये
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare caikā mṛgī hyagātpipāsitā / nirjharāpāta śirasi pātukāmā jalaṃ priye
verses.translation: Once, with a desire to see Ananta, I had been to the Netherworlds, rendered splendid with great joy by the leading royal serpents.
verses.hindi: सीमा में सभी माया के विलास वाले हैं तथा महामाया के विनोद से सम- न्वित हैं। जब वे मेरे शूर कोप करेंगे तब सम्पूणे बल भस्मसात् हो जायगा ।९३। सो व्यर्थ ही शंका से तुम्हारा मन खिन्न नहीं होबे । इतना यह कहकर भण्डदेत्येन्द्र तृत के आसन से उठकर खड़ा हो गया था ।६४। और महाबली
verses.wordMeaning: Once, with a desire to see Ananta, I had been to the Netherworlds, rendered splendid with great joy by the leading royal serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, with a desire to see Ananta, I had been to the Netherworlds, rendered splendid with great joy by the leading royal serpents.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पिबन्त्यास्तु जलं शार्दूलो ऽतिभयङ्करः । तत्र प्राप्तो यदृच्छातो जगृहे तां भयर्दिताम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ pibantyāstu jalaṃ śārdūlo 'tibhayaṅkaraḥ / tatra prāpto yadṛcchāto jagṛhe tāṃ bhayarditām
verses.translation: There, O Brahmana of great fortune, great men of spiritual achievement were seen by me all round Viz. Sanaka and others, Narada, Gautama, Jajali, Kratu, Rbhu, Hamsa, Aruni, Valmiki, Sakti and Asuri. These and many other great Siddhas beginning with Vatsyayana1 were sitting near the lord of serpents and worshipped him for the sake of knowledge.
verses.hindi: कुटिलाक्ष सेनानी से बोला था। रे उठ जाओ और अपनी समस्त सेना को सव ओर से सर्जत करो ।€५। और शून्य के सब ओर द्वारों पर सेना लगा
verses.wordMeaning: There, O Brahmana of great fortune, great men of spiritual achievement were seen by me all round Viz. Sanaka and others, Narada, Gautama, Jajali, Kratu, Rbhu, Hamsa, Aruni, Valmiki, Sakti and Asuri.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There, O Brahmana of great fortune, great men of spiritual achievement were seen by me all round Viz. Sanaka and others, Narada, Gautama, Jajali, Kratu, Rbhu, Hamsa, Aruni, Valmiki, Sakti and Asuri.…

verses.sanskrit: अहं तद्ग्रहणं पश्यन्भयेन प्रपलायितः । अत्युच्चवत्त्वात्पतितो मृतश्चैणीमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tadgrahaṇaṃ paśyanbhayena prapalāyitaḥ / atyuccavattvātpatito mṛtaścaiṇīmanusmaran
verses.translation: By a simple repetition, a single name of Krsna yields that fruit which is yielded by repeating three times the- thousand holy names.
verses.wordMeaning: By a simple repetition, a single name of Krsna yields that fruit which is yielded by repeating three times the- thousand holy names.
verses.commentary: Sense: By a simple repetition, a single name of Krsna yields that fruit which is yielded by repeating three times the- thousand holy names.

verses.sanskrit: सा मृता त्वं मृगी जाता मृग स्त्वाहमनुस्मरन् । जातो भद्रे न जाने वै क्व गाता भ्रातरो ऽग्रजाः
verses.transliteration: sā mṛtā tvaṃ mṛgī jātā mṛga stvāhamanusmaran / jāto bhadre na jāne vai kva gātā bhrātaro 'grajāḥ
verses.translation: The ensuing prayer mainly contains references to incidents in the life of Kr?na as described in the tenth Skandha of the Bh. P. with a sprinkling of some Vedantic terms to indicate the identity of Kf?ga with Para-Brahman and Vi?nu.
verses.hindi: दो। तू दुर्गों को संग्रहण करो जहां पर सेकडों ही भषेपणिकाए' होवे
verses.wordMeaning: The ensuing prayer mainly contains references to incidents in the life of Kr?na as described in the tenth Skandha of the Bh. P. with a sprinkling of some Vedantic terms to indicate the identity of Kf?ga with Para-Brahman and Vi?nu.

verses.transliteration: etanme smṛtimāpannaṃ caritaṃ tava cātmataḥ / bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tathā śṛṇu bhadre vadāmyaham
verses.translation: (19) Nandavraja-Jananandin (one who delights the people in the cowherds' colony belonging to Nanda),* (20) Sacciddnanda-Vigraha (one whose person is constituted of ex- istence, knowledge and bliss), (21 ) Navanitaviliptdnga (one who has smeared all his limbs with butter), (22) Navanitatiafa (one who dances for the sake of butter), (23) Anagha (sinless).

verses.transliteration: agastyadarśanaṃ labdhvā śrutvā stotraṃ gatipradam / gamiṣyāvaḥ śubhāṃllokānyeṣu gatvā na śocati

verses.hindi: उसने संग्राम के समय में आगे समापतित होकर विजय श्राप्त की है। देवों के सत्त्व से बहुत ही दपं वाली उसको महामूढ़ा को चोटी खींचकर खींच लाओ ।९६। तीन सहस्र के अधिप महानु सत्त्व बाले चमू के नाध कुटिसाक्ष से यह कहकर वह भण्ड अन्तःपुर में चला गया था ।१००। इसके

verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvā sa mṛgaḥ priyāyai priyadarśanaḥ / virarāma prasannātmā paśyanrāmamanā turaḥ
