verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीरे शुभं पुण्यं नानामुनिनिषेवितम् । ददर्श महदाश्चर्यं भार्गवः कुंभजाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīre śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ nānāmuniniṣevitam / dadarśa mahadāścaryaṃ bhārgavaḥ kuṃbhajāśramam
verses.translation: (99) Narayana, (100) Param Brahman (the supreme Brahman) (101) PannagaSanavdhana (one whose vehicle is Garuqla, the devourer of serpents), ( 102) Jfllakri#dsamdsakta- Gopivdstrapahdraka (one who removed the garments of the cowherdesses who were enthusiastically engaged in aquatic sports).
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर श्री ललिता देबी को सेना के निस्सरण की प्रतिध्वनि ने असुरेन्त्रों को उच्चालित कर दिया था जो कि दुनबुभियों की अतीब उद्धत ध्वनि उस समय में हो रही थी ।१। दिशाओं के मदित करने बाली उससे पयोधियों का गमं भी क्षुब्ध हो गया था और समस्त लोक उस महान्

verses.sanskrit: मृगैः सिंहैः सहगतैः सेवितं शान्तमानसैः । कुटरैरर्जुनैर्निंबैः पारिभद्रधवेगुदैः
verses.transliteration: mṛgaiḥ siṃhaiḥ sahagataiḥ sevitaṃ śāntamānasaiḥ / kuṭarairarjunairniṃbaiḥ pāribhadradhavegudaiḥ
verses.translation: (103) Punyafloka (one whose renown is meritorious), (104) Tirthapada (one whose foot is itself a holy spot), (105) Vedavedya (one who can be comprehended through the Vedas), (106) Daydnidhi (Storehouse of mercy), (107) Sarvatirthdtmaka (one who is identical with all holy spots), ( 108) Sanagraharupin (one who has the forms of all planets), one who is greater than the greatest.
verses.hindi: भीषण एवं घोर ध्वनि से बहरा हो गया या। उस समय में तीनों भुवन कांप उठे थे।२। इधर हैत्यों के नि:साण का घोष भी दिशाओं के समूह को भदित कर रहा था तथा पतों की कन्दराओं का भेदन कर रहा था एवं नभो मण्डल में ऊपर उठ गया था ।३। महान् नरसिंह के कोध से निकलने
verses.wordMeaning: (103) Punyafloka (one whose renown is meritorious), (104) Tirthapada (one whose foot is itself a holy spot), (105) Vedavedya (one who can be comprehended through the Vedas), (106) Daydnidhi (Storehouse of mercy),…
verses.commentary: Sense: (103) Punyafloka (one whose renown is meritorious), (104) Tirthapada (one whose foot is itself a holy spot), (105) Vedavedya (one who can be comprehended through the Vedas), (106) Daydnidhi (Storehouse of mercy),…

verses.sanskrit: खदिरासनखर्जूरैः संकुलं बदरीद्रुमैः । तत्र प्रविश्य वै रामो ह्यकृतव्रणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: khadirāsanakharjūraiḥ saṃkulaṃ badarīdrumaiḥ / tatra praviśya vai rāmo hyakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: It brings wealth to the poor people. It brings victory to those who are desirous of yictory. It increases the merit and bestows nourishment of children and herds of cattle.
verses.hindi: बालो हंकार के समान जो उद्धत ध्वनि थी बहु देवों के शत्रुओं की झल्लरी बहुत ही अधिक बिरसता उत्पन्न कर रही थी ।४। इसके उपरान्त किल- किल की ध्वनि से शम्बायमान देत्यों को श्रेणियाँ हो रही थो। वे सभी परमेश्वरी उस देवी के प्रति बहुत हो कुछ होकर सन्नद्ध हुए थे ।५। बह
verses.wordMeaning: It brings wealth to the poor people. It brings victory to those who are desirous of yictory. It increases the merit and bestows nourishment of children and herds of cattle.
verses.commentary: Sense: It brings wealth to the poor people. It brings victory to those who are desirous of yictory. It increases the merit and bestows nourishment of children and herds of cattle.

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श मुनिमासीनं कुम्भजं शान्तमानसम् । स्तिमितोदसरः प्रख्यं ध्यायन्तं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: dadarśa munimāsīnaṃ kumbhajaṃ śāntamānasam / stimitodasaraḥ prakhyaṃ dhyāyantaṃ brahma śāśvatam
verses.translation: It suppresses infantile ailments and evil planets or spirits etc. It causes calmness. In the end, it bestows the memory ofKtsna. It dispels the three types of distresses in the worldly existence.
verses.hindi: अहुत ही ऊ चा रोहणाचल रत्नों से विचित्र कमं (कवच) से ढके हुए शरीर वाला एक जङ्म के हो समान शोभित हो रहा था ।६। कोई भट अपनी अतिधौत कृपाण को जो शस्त्रकार से गोपित थी कालरात्रि के ही समान उदग्र को हिला रहा वा
verses.wordMeaning: It suppresses infantile ailments and evil planets or spirits etc. It causes calmness. In the end, it bestows the memory ofKtsna. It dispels the three types of distresses in the worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: It suppresses infantile ailments and evil planets or spirits etc. It causes calmness. In the end, it bestows the memory ofKtsna. It dispels the three types of distresses in the worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तवन्तं रामं तु उन्मील्य नयने शनैः । दृष्ट्वा स्वागतमुच्चार्य तस्मायासनमादिशत्

verses.translation: "Obeisance, obeisance to you the sanctifier of the entire universe. O lord of the nature of no change and loss, O dispeller of distress of the devotee who resorts to you, Obeisance to the supporter of the Earth, to the ocean of mercy. Obeisance to Sesa the lord of the universe.
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance, obeisance to you the sanctifier of the entire universe. O lord of the nature of no change and loss, O dispeller of distress of the devotee who resorts to you, Obeisance to the supporter of the Earth, to the ocean of mercy. Obeisance to Sesa the lord of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance, obeisance to you the sanctifier of the entire universe. O lord of the nature of no change and loss, O dispeller of distress of the devotee who resorts to you, Obeisance to the supporter of the Earth, to the ocean of mercy. Obeisance to Sesa the lord of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: मधुपर्कं समानीय शिष्येण मुनिपुङ्गवः । ददौ पप्रच्छ कुशलं तपसश्च कुलस्य च

verses.translation: O lord, we have been made to imbibe Kfsnamrta by you. We have been made rid of all sins by you. People like you, O lord, arc sympathetic with the wretched ones. Undoubt- edly. you uplift your own people who bow down to you."

verses.sanskrit: स पृष्टस्तेन वै रामो घटोद्भवमुवाच ह । भवत्संदर्शनादीश कुशलं मम सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: sa pṛṣṭastena vai rāmo ghaṭodbhavamuvāca ha / bhavatsaṃdarśanādīśa kuśalaṃ mama sarvataḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to the feet of the lord of Serpents, after directing the mind to the feet that fulfil all our desires and after circumambulating the supporter of the Earth, all of us went to our respective residences.
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to the feet of the lord of Serpents, after directing the mind to the feet that fulfil all our desires and after circumambulating the supporter of the Earth, all of us went to our respective residences.

verses.translation: This extremely rare prayer has been heard directly from lord Sesa who was recounting the tales of the lord, O Rama of great fortune.
verses.hindi: एक ओर अपने कर के अग्रभाग से भाला हाथ में लिये हुए अश्‍व पर समारूढ़ होकर वीथी में चरण करने वालों को तितर-बितर कर रहा था ।दा कुछ योधागण बहुत ही केचे वपु बाले हाथियों पर समारूढ़ ये जो कि उत्पात वाली वायु के सम्पात से प्रेरित पबंतों के ही तुल्य दिखाई दे रहे थे

verses.translation: This extremely rare prayer has been heard directly from lord Sesa who was recounting the tales of the lord, O Rama of great fortune.
verses.wordMeaning: This extremely rare prayer has been heard directly from lord Sesa who was recounting the tales of the lord, O Rama of great fortune.
verses.commentary: Sense: This extremely rare prayer has been heard directly from lord Sesa who was recounting the tales of the lord, O Rama of great fortune.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवच रिते पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३५॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच अवगत्य स वै सर्वं कारणं प्रीतमानसः । उवाच भार्गवं राममगस्त्यः कुंभसंभवः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavaca rite pañcatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 35// vasiṣṭha uvāca avagatya sa vai sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ prītamānasaḥ / uvāca bhārgavaṃ rāmamagastyaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, I am born as the son of Jamadagni in the family of Bhrgu. My name is Rama. I seek refuge in you, who are worthy of being honoured by the whole universe.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, I am born as the son of Jamadagni in the family of Bhrgu. My name is Rama. I seek refuge in you, who are worthy of being honoured by the whole universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I am born as the son of Jamadagni in the family of Bhrgu. My name is Rama. I seek refuge in you, who are worthy of being honoured by the whole universe.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच शृणु राम महाभाग कथयामि हितं तव । मन्त्रस्य सिद्धिं येन त्वं शीघ्रमेव समाप्नुयाः
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga kathayāmi hitaṃ tava / mantrasya siddhiṃ yena tvaṃ śīghrameva samāpnuyāḥ
verses.translation: O lord of the Universe, fulfil my cherished desire for the work of which I have come to your presence, O lord.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the Universe, fulfil my cherished desire for the work of which I have come to your presence, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the Universe, fulfil my cherished desire for the work of which I have come to your presence, O lord.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तेस्तु लक्षणं ज्ञात्वा त्रिविधाया महामते । यो यतेत नरस्तस्य सिद्धिर्भवति सत्वरम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktestu lakṣaṇaṃ jñātvā trividhāyā mahāmate / yo yateta narastasya siddhirbhavati satvaram
verses.translation: Jamadagni, my father, O lord, accorded hospitable reception to king Karttavirya who had been on a hunting expedition.
verses.wordMeaning: Jamadagni, my father, O lord, accorded hospitable reception to king Karttavirya who had been on a hunting expedition.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jamadagni, my father, O lord, accorded hospitable reception to king Karttavirya who had been on a hunting expedition.

verses.sanskrit: एकदाहमनुप्राप्तो ऽनन्तदर्शनकाङ्क्षया । पातालं नागराचैन्द्रैः शोभितं परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: ekadāhamanuprāpto 'nantadarśanakāṅkṣayā / pātālaṃ nāgarācaindraiḥ śobhitaṃ parayā mudā
verses.translation: Out of greed that silly and foolish king struck that sage down by using force. On seeing him killed, the cow went away to the world of cows.
verses.wordMeaning: Out of greed that silly and foolish king struck that sage down by using force. On seeing him killed, the cow went away to the world of cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of greed that silly and foolish king struck that sage down by using force. On seeing him killed, the cow went away to the world of cows.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दृष्टा महाभाग मया सिद्धाः समन्ततः । सनकाद्या नारदश्च गौतमो जाजलिःक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: tatra dṛṣṭā mahābhāga mayā siddhāḥ samantataḥ / sanakādyā nāradaśca gautamo jājaliḥkratuḥ
verses.translation: Without feeling any remorse for the death of my innocent father the king returned to his city. Afterwards, my mother lamented very bitterly.
verses.wordMeaning: Without feeling any remorse for the death of my innocent father the king returned to his city. Afterwards, my mother lamented very bitterly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without feeling any remorse for the death of my innocent father the king returned to his city. Afterwards, my mother lamented very bitterly.

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुर्हंसो ऽरुणिश्चैव वाल्मीकिः शक्तिरासुरिः । एते ऽन्ये च महासिद्धा वात्स्यायनमुखा द्विज
verses.transliteration: ṛbhurhaṃso 'ruṇiścaiva vālmīkiḥ śaktirāsuriḥ / ete 'nye ca mahāsiddhā vātsyāyanamukhā dvija
verses.translation: On coming to know of it, our great-grandfather Bhrgu who is aware of the events of the world, came there, O great lord. Indeed I too came back from th forest.
verses.wordMeaning: On coming to know of it, our great-grandfather Bhrgu who is aware of the events of the world, came there, O great lord. Indeed I too came back from th forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know of it, our great-grandfather Bhrgu who is aware of the events of the world, came there, O great lord. Indeed I too came back from th forest.

verses.sanskrit: उपासत ह्युपा सीना ज्ञानार्थं फणिनायकम् । तं नमस्कृत्य नागैन्द्रैः सह सिद्धैर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: upāsata hyupā sīnā jñānārthaṃ phaṇināyakam / taṃ namaskṛtya nāgaindraiḥ saha siddhairmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: After consoling the extremely distressed brothers of mine along with me and my mother, that sage who is con- versant with Mantras resuscitated my father back to life.
verses.hindi: भटैयु क्त: स सेनानी ललिताभिमुखे ययौ
verses.wordMeaning: After consoling the extremely distressed brothers of mine along with me and my mother, that sage who is con- versant with Mantras resuscitated my father back to life.
verses.commentary: Sense: After consoling the extremely distressed brothers of mine along with me and my mother, that sage who is con- versant with Mantras resuscitated my father back to life.

verses.sanskrit: उपविष्टः कथात्तत्र शृण्वानो वैष्णवीर्मुदा । येयं भूमिर्महाभाग भूतधात्री स्वरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: upaviṣṭaḥ kathāttatra śṛṇvāno vaiṣṇavīrmudā / yeyaṃ bhūmirmahābhāga bhūtadhātrī svarūpiṇī
verses.translation: Before the arrival of Bhrgu, I had been highly infuriated by the grief of my mother. Consoling my mother, O lord, I had taken a vow.
verses.hindi: परिकल्पिता हस्तों के अग्रवाली वर्भित देत्यों की कोटियाँ हैं। कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: Before the arrival of Bhrgu, I had been highly infuriated by the grief of my mother. Consoling my mother, O lord, I had taken a vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Before the arrival of Bhrgu, I had been highly infuriated by the grief of my mother. Consoling my mother, O lord, I had taken a vow.

verses.sanskrit: निविष्टा पुरतस्तस्य शृण्वन्ती ताः कथाः सदा । यद्यत्पृच्छति सा भूमिः शेषं साक्षान्महीधरम्
verses.transliteration: niviṣṭā puratastasya śṛṇvantī tāḥ kathāḥ sadā / yadyatpṛcchati sā bhūmiḥ śeṣaṃ sākṣānmahīdharam
verses.translation: Since her chest had been beaten twentyone times
verses.hindi: बैठे हुए ये।१५। कुछ ऊटों पर सवार--कुछ वृको पर समारूढ़ तथा इबानों पर सबार ये। काक आदिको पर भी सवार ये तथा गृध्रो पर डर कंकों पर सवार कुछ हो रहे थे ।१६। कुछ व्याध्न आदि पर सवार थे तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Since her chest had been beaten twentyone times
verses.commentary: Sense: Since her chest had been beaten twentyone times

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वन्ति ऋषयः सर्वे तत्रस्था तदनुग्रहात् । मया तत्र श्रुतं वत्स कृष्णप्रेमामृतं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇvanti ṛṣayaḥ sarve tatrasthā tadanugrahāt / mayā tatra śrutaṃ vatsa kṛṣṇapremāmṛtaṃ śubham
verses.translation: On hearing these words of his and glancing at the face of Durga, Hara remained absorbed in thought for a moment with his face bent down.
verses.hindi: पर समाहूढ़ हो रहे थे ।१७। सूकरों पर कुछ दंत्य सवारी किये हुए ये एबं ब्यालों पर और प्रेतों पर कुछ सघार थे। इस रोति से अनेक प्रकार के बाहूनों पर बैठकर हैत्यगण ललिता देवी के प्रति आक्रमण कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of his and glancing at the face of Durga, Hara remained absorbed in thought for a moment with his face bent down.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of his and glancing at the face of Durga, Hara remained absorbed in thought for a moment with his face bent down.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रं तत्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यस्यार्थं त्वमिहागतः । वाराहाद्यवताराणां चरितं पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: stotraṃ tatte pravakṣyāmi yasyārthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ / vārāhādyavatārāṇāṃ caritaṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: In the meantime surprised as she was, DurgS, laughed a lot, O great king and said to Bhargava who was bent on wreaking revenge.
verses.hindi: प्रबल कोध से उनका अपना आशय भी मूच्छित हो रहा था । परम कुटिल दुमद नामक सेनापति को दश अक्षोहिणी सेना से संयुत करके ललितादेवी पर आकूमण करने के लिए भेजा था ।१६। अपने अत्युत्कट बल के द्वारा सम्पूर्ण विश्व को दग्ध करने की इच्छा वाले की तरह ही भटों से युक्त वह
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime surprised as she was, DurgS, laughed a lot, O great king and said to Bhargava who was bent on wreaking revenge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime surprised as she was, DurgS, laughed a lot, O great king and said to Bhargava who was bent on wreaking revenge.

verses.sanskrit: सुखदं मोक्षदं चैव ज्ञानविज्ञान कारणम् । श्रुत्वा सर्वं धरा वत्स प्रत्दृष्टा तं धराधरम्
verses.transliteration: sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva jñānavijñāna kāraṇam / śrutvā sarvaṃ dharā vatsa pratdṛṣṭā taṃ dharādharam
verses.translation: ''O ascetic, O son of a Brahmana, out of anger you wish to make this Earth devoid of kings twentyone times. Great indeed is your daring rashness, O boy.
verses.hindi: सेनानी ललिता देवी के सामने गया था ।२०। बह अपने पटहों के महाघोषों से चौदह भुव्सों का भेदन करता हुआ गया था । वह दुमंद अट्टहास से सम- हवत होकर उस देवी के समक में प्राप्त हुआ चा
verses.wordMeaning: ''O ascetic, O son of a Brahmana, out of anger you wish to make this Earth devoid of kings twentyone times. Great indeed is your daring rashness, O boy.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O ascetic, O son of a Brahmana, out of anger you wish to make this Earth devoid of kings twentyone times. Great indeed is your daring rashness, O boy.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच प्रणता भूयो ज्ञातुं कृष्णविचेष्टितम् । धरण्युवाच अलङ्कृतं जन्म पुंसामपि नन्दव्रजौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca praṇatā bhūyo jñātuṃ kṛṣṇaviceṣṭitam / dharaṇyuvāca alaṅkṛtaṃ janma puṃsāmapi nandavrajaukasām
verses.translation: Without any weapon you wish to kill Arjuna, the king with a thousand arms, by whom even Ravana was con- temptuously discomfited by a sportive knitting of his eyebrows.
verses.wordMeaning: Without any weapon you wish to kill Arjuna, the king with a thousand arms, by whom even Ravana was con- temptuously discomfited by a sportive knitting of his eyebrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without any weapon you wish to kill Arjuna, the king with a thousand arms, by whom even Ravana was con- temptuously discomfited by a sportive knitting of his eyebrows.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवस्य कृष्णस्य लीलाविग्रहधारिणः । जयोपाधिनियुक्तानि संति नामान्यनेकशः
verses.transliteration: tasya devasya kṛṣṇasya līlāvigrahadhāriṇaḥ / jayopādhiniyuktāni saṃti nāmānyanekaśaḥ
verses.translation: To him the coat of mail of Lord Visnu had been given as also the Sakti (Divine javelin) of excessive poten- tiality. How do you aspire to kill him?.
verses.wordMeaning: To him the coat of mail of Lord Visnu had been given as also the Sakti (Divine javelin) of excessive poten- tiality. How do you aspire to kill him?.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him the coat of mail of Lord Visnu had been given as also the Sakti (Divine javelin) of excessive poten- tiality. How do you aspire to kill him?.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु नामानि मुख्यानि श्रोतुकामा चिरादहम् । तत्तानि ब्रूहि नामानि वासुदेवस्य वासुके
verses.transliteration: teṣu nāmāni mukhyāni śrotukāmā cirādaham / tattāni brūhi nāmāni vāsudevasya vāsuke
verses.translation: Thereupon, after obtaining the consent of the god- dess (by the previous hint) Lord Sambhu, the ocean of mercy
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, after obtaining the consent of the god- dess (by the previous hint) Lord Sambhu, the ocean of mercy
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, after obtaining the consent of the god- dess (by the previous hint) Lord Sambhu, the ocean of mercy

verses.sanskrit: नातः परतरं पुण्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते । शेष उवाच वसुंधरे वरारोहे जनानामस्ति मुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: nātaḥ parataraṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate / śeṣa uvāca vasuṃdhare varārohe janānāmasti muktidam
verses.translation: From today onwards O Br&hmana, you shall be like Skanda to me. O highly intelligent one, I shall give you the divine coat of mail and teach you the mantra thereof.
verses.wordMeaning: From today onwards O Br&hmana, you shall be like Skanda to me. O highly intelligent one, I shall give you the divine coat of mail and teach you the mantra thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: From today onwards O Br&hmana, you shall be like Skanda to me. O highly intelligent one, I shall give you the divine coat of mail and teach you the mantra thereof.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमङ्गलमूर्द्धन्यमणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धिदम् । महापातककोटिघ्न सर्वतीर्थफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvamaṅgalamūrddhanyamaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidam / mahāpātakakoṭighna sarvatīrthaphalapradam
verses.translation: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.wordMeaning: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to its favour, you will sportingly kill Kartta- virya and make the earth devoid of kings, twentyone times."

verses.sanskrit: समस्तजपयज्ञानां फलदं पापनाशनम् । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि नाम्नामष्टोतरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: samastajapayajñānāṃ phaladaṃ pāpanāśanam / śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi nāmnāmaṣṭotaraṃ śatam
verses.translation: Everything glorified by you, O holy lord, O excellent sage has been heard. Recount to me the Kavaca (Protective Mantra) which grants the conquest of the three worlds, everywhere.
verses.wordMeaning: Everything glorified by you, O holy lord, O excellent sage has been heard. Recount to me the Kavaca (Protective Mantra) which grants the conquest of the three worlds, everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything glorified by you, O holy lord, O excellent sage has been heard. Recount to me the Kavaca (Protective Mantra) which grants the conquest of the three worlds, everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: महस्रनाम्नां पुण्यानां त्रिरावृत्त्या तु यत्फलम् । एकावृत्त्या तु कृष्णस्य नामैकं तत्प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: mahasranāmnāṃ puṇyānāṃ trirāvṛttyā tu yatphalam / ekāvṛttyā tu kṛṣṇasya nāmaikaṃ tatprayacchati
verses.translation: Listen, O dcarcne, I shall recount to you the ex- tremely miraculous Kavaca. I shall teach you the Mantra also that bestows spiritual attainment and which always brings happiness to those who aspire to achieve it and practise it.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O dcarcne, I shall recount to you the ex- tremely miraculous Kavaca. I shall teach you the Mantra also that bestows spiritual attainment and which always brings happiness to those who aspire to achieve it and practise it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O dcarcne, I shall recount to you the ex- tremely miraculous Kavaca. I shall teach you the Mantra also that bestows spiritual attainment and which always brings happiness to those who aspire to achieve it and practise it.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पुण्यतरं चैतत्स्तोत्रं पातकनाशनम् । नाम्नामष्टोत्तरशतस्याहमेव ऋषिः प्रिये
verses.transliteration: tasmātpuṇyataraṃ caitatstotraṃ pātakanāśanam / nāmnāmaṣṭottaraśatasyāhameva ṛṣiḥ priye
verses.translation: At the end of the word Gopijana one shall utter the word Vallabhdya. Ending with Svdhd, this great Mantra (viz. Gopijana-Vallabhaya Svdhd meaning 'Svaha unto the lover of cowherdess folks' ) of ten syllables is the bestower of worldly pleasure as well as salvation.
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the word Gopijana one shall utter the word Vallabhdya. Ending with Svdhd, this great Mantra (viz. Gopijana-Vallabhaya Svdhd meaning 'Svaha unto the lover of cowherdess folks' ) of ten syllables is the bestower of worldly pleasure as well as salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the word Gopijana one shall utter the word Vallabhdya. Ending with Svdhd, this great Mantra (viz. Gopijana-Vallabhaya Svdhd meaning 'Svaha unto the lover of cowherdess folks' ) of ten syllables is the bestower of worldly pleasure as well as salvation.

verses.sanskrit: छन्दो ऽनुष्टुब्देवता तु योगः कृष्णप्रियावहः । श्रीकृष्णः कमलानाथो वासुदेवः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: chando 'nuṣṭubdevatā tu yogaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāvahaḥ / śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kamalānātho vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: 'Obeisance to Gopala; let this Mantra always protect my cheek. 'Klim, obeisance to Krsna'. Let the wish-yielding Kalpa-tree protect my ears.
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् भंडासुर की आज्ञा पाकर महान बलवान कुटिलाक्ष ने शूस्यक के प्राचीन पुरद्वार पर रक्षा करने के लिए दश अक्षो हिणो सेना से समस्वित तालजंथ को कल्पित किया या ।२२। जो अर्वाचोन तगर का द्वार था उस पर दश अक्षौहिणी सेना से संयुत तालभुज नामक द्य को रक्षण
verses.wordMeaning: 'Obeisance to Gopala; let this Mantra always protect my cheek. 'Klim, obeisance to Krsna'. Let the wish-yielding Kalpa-tree protect my ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Obeisance to Gopala; let this Mantra always protect my cheek. 'Klim, obeisance to Krsna'. Let the wish-yielding Kalpa-tree protect my ears.

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवात्मजः पुण्यो लीलामानुषविग्रहः । श्रीवत्सकौस्तभधरो यशोदावत्सलो हरिः
verses.transliteration: vasudevātmajaḥ puṇyo līlāmānuṣavigrahaḥ / śrīvatsakaustabhadharo yaśodāvatsalo hariḥ
verses.translation: 'Srim, obeisance to Krsna', let this always protect the pair of my lips. Om Svaha unto Goplfa, let this protect the row of my teeth.

verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्ये तानि सर्वाणि सिद्ध्यन्त्येवास्य शीलनात् । वसिष्ठ उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महाराज कृष्णप्रेमामृतं स्तवम् । यावद्व्यरसींत्स मुनिस्तावत्स्वर्यानमागतम्
verses.transliteration: trailokye tāni sarvāṇi siddhyantyevāsya śīlanāt / vasiṣṭha uvāca evamuktvā mahārāja kṛṣṇapremāmṛtaṃ stavam / yāvadvyarasīṃtsa munistāvatsvaryānamāgatam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिरद्भुतैः सिद्धैः कामरूपैर्मनोजवैः । अनुयातमथोत्प्लुत्य स्त्रीपुंसौ हरिणौ तदा । अगस्त्यचरणौ नत्वा समारुरुहतुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: caturbhiradbhutaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmarūpairmanojavaiḥ / anuyātamathotplutya strīpuṃsau hariṇau tadā / agastyacaraṇau natvā samāruruhaturmudā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यदेहधरौ भूत्वा संखचक्रादिचिह्नितौ । गतौ च वैष्णवं लोकं सर्व देवन मस्कृतम् । पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां भार्गवागस्त्ययोस्तथा
verses.transliteration: divyadehadharau bhūtvā saṃkhacakrādicihnitau / gatau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ sarva devana maskṛtam / paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhārgavāgastyayostathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.hindi: उल्लसित फलों बाले भालों से समस्त दिशाओं को अवकीणं कर दिया था और सम्पत्करी देबी की सेना का जो समूह था उसको इसी तरह
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the group of cowherdesses'. Let this always protect my neck. '0m Svdhd unto the lord of the cow- herds', let this always protect my shoulders.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते षट्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३६॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच दृष्ट्वा परशुरामस्तु तदाश्चर्यं महाद्भुतम् । जगाद सर्ववृत्तान्तं मृगयोस्तु यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ṣaṭtriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 36// vasiṣṭha uvāca dṛṣṭvā paraśurāmastu tadāścaryaṃ mahādbhutam / jagāda sarvavṛttāntaṃ mṛgayostu yathāśrutam
verses.translation: On seeing that extremely wonderful miracle, Parasu- rama narrated everything concerning those two deer exactly as he had heard it.
verses.hindi: से ढक दिया था असे मेघ जलों के द्वारा बन को आवृत कर दिया करता है। ।१०। उस दुःसह सत्व बाले के द्वारा बहुत से वाणों से ताड़ित हई संपत्करी
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that extremely wonderful miracle, Parasu- rama narrated everything concerning those two deer exactly as he had heard it.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that extremely wonderful miracle, Parasu- rama narrated everything concerning those two deer exactly as he had heard it.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान्साक्षादगस्त्यः कुंभसंभवः । मोदमान उवाचेदं भार्गवं पुरतः स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā bhagavānsākṣādagastyaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ / modamāna uvācedaṃ bhārgavaṃ purataḥ sthitam
verses.translation: On hearing it, the pot-born sage Agastya who was the Lord himself, joyously spoke to Bhargava who was sitting in front of him.
verses.hindi: देवी को सेना क्षण भर के लिए रणस्थल में स्तम्भित सी ही हो गयी थी ।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing it, the pot-born sage Agastya who was the Lord himself, joyously spoke to Bhargava who was sitting in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, the pot-born sage Agastya who was the Lord himself, joyously spoke to Bhargava who was sitting in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच शृणु राम महाभाग कार्याकार्विशारद । हितं वदामि यत्ते ऽद्य तत्कुरुष्व समाहितः
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga kāryākārviśārada / hitaṃ vadāmi yatte 'dya tatkuruṣva samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: "Listen, O highly fortunate Rama who are expert in discriminating between what has to be done and what should not be done. I am going to tell you now what is conducive to your welfare. Do it with concentration and mental purity.
verses.hindi: दम्बिका रण कोलाहल नामक गज पर समारूढ़ होकर इस दानव के साथ युद्ध करने लगी थी ।५२। कुछ थोड़ा चंचल कद्भुण को कवणन की ध्वनि से विशेष सुन्दर उसके करने उस युद्ध में धनुष की मोर्बी को कानों तक खींचा था ।५३। हाथ के हलकेपन से न तो मौबाँ को खोंचते हुए देखा था और न
verses.wordMeaning: "Listen, O highly fortunate Rama who are expert in discriminating between what has to be done and what should not be done. I am going to tell you now what is conducive to your welfare. Do it with concentration and mental purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Listen, O highly fortunate Rama who are expert in discriminating between what has to be done and what should not be done. I am going to tell you now what is conducive to your welfare. Do it with concentration and mental purity.

verses.sanskrit: इतो विदूरे सुमहत्स्थानं विष्णोः सुदुर्लभम् । पदानि यत्र दृश्यन्ते न्यस्तानि सुमाहात्मना
verses.transliteration: ito vidūre sumahatsthānaṃ viṣṇoḥ sudurlabham / padāni yatra dṛśyante nyastāni sumāhātmanā
verses.translation: At the time of subduing and binding down of Bali, the noble-souled Vamana covered the worlds by means of his steps. It was from the tip of one of these toes that Ganga began to flow.
verses.hindi: उसके छोड़ने को ही देखा था केवल शर के धारण करते ही देखा गया था जो धनुष पर लगाया था ।५४। शीघ्र ही अर्काम्बर के सम्पर्क से प्रतिफलित फल वाले शरसंपत्करी के चाप से गिरे हुए शत्रुओं का सन्दाह कर देते ये ।
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of subduing and binding down of Bali, the noble-souled Vamana covered the worlds by means of his steps. It was from the tip of one of these toes that Ganga began to flow.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of subduing and binding down of Bali, the noble-souled Vamana covered the worlds by means of his steps. It was from the tip of one of these toes that Ganga began to flow.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र गङ्गा समुद्भूता वामस्य महात्मनः । पदाग्रात्क्रमतो लोकांस्तद्बलेस्तु विनिग्रहे
verses.transliteration: yatra gaṅgā samudbhūtā vāmasya mahātmanaḥ / padāgrātkramato lokāṃstadbalestu vinigrahe
verses.translation: Go there and recite this prayer for a month regu-
verses.hindi: परस्पर मैं एक दूसरे के संघट्ट से विस्फुलिंग निकलने वाले वाणों के द्वारा किया गया था
verses.wordMeaning: Go there and recite this prayer for a month regu-
verses.commentary: Sense: Go there and recite this prayer for a month regu-

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा स्तवं चेदं मासमैकमनन्यधीः । पठस्व नियमेनैव नियतो नियताशनः
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā stavaṃ cedaṃ māsamaikamananyadhīḥ / paṭhasva niyamenaiva niyato niyatāśanaḥ
verses.translation: The Kavaca (mystical protective formula or mantra} that had been practised by you formerly with a desire for its full accomplishment thereof in order to kill the enemies,, will yield the benefit to you."
verses.wordMeaning: The Kavaca (mystical protective formula or mantra} that had been practised by you formerly with a desire for its full accomplishment thereof in order to kill the enemies,, will yield the benefit to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kavaca (mystical protective formula or mantra} that had been practised by you formerly with a desire for its full accomplishment thereof in order to kill the enemies,, will yield the benefit to you."

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वया कवचं पूर्वमभ्यस्तं सिद्धिमिच्छता । शत्रूणां निग्रहार्थाय तच्च ते सिद्धिदं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yattvayā kavacaṃ pūrvamabhyastaṃ siddhimicchatā / śatrūṇāṃ nigrahārthāya tacca te siddhidaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: "On being told thus by Agasi ya, Rama, the destroyer of his enemies, bowed down to the quiescent sage and went out of the hermitage.
verses.wordMeaning: "On being told thus by Agasi ya, Rama, the destroyer of his enemies, bowed down to the quiescent sage and went out of the hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being told thus by Agasi ya, Rama, the destroyer of his enemies, bowed down to the quiescent sage and went out of the hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच एव मुक्तो ह्यगस्त्येन रामः शत्रुनिबर्हणः । नमस्कृत्य मुनीं शान्तं निर्जगामाश्रमाद्बहिः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca eva mukto hyagastyena rāmaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ / namaskṛtya munīṃ śāntaṃ nirjagāmāśramādbahiḥ
verses.translation: Again along that self-same route, O king, Rama quickly reached that spot where the celestial river had come out from the last foot-step of Visnu.
verses.wordMeaning: Again along that self-same route, O king, Rama quickly reached that spot where the celestial river had come out from the last foot-step of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again along that self-same route, O king, Rama quickly reached that spot where the celestial river had come out from the last foot-step of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: पुनस्तेनैव मार्गेण संप्राप्तस्तत्र सत्वरम् । यत्रोत्तरात्पदन्यासान्निर्गता स्वर्णदी नृप
verses.transliteration: punastenaiva mārgeṇa saṃprāptastatra satvaram / yatrottarātpadanyāsānnirgatā svarṇadī nṛpa
verses.translation: There this sage built his abode in the company of Aki tavrana and began to practice the divine prayer called Krfiiapremdmrta (nectar in the form of Krsna's love).
verses.wordMeaning: There this sage built his abode in the company of Aki tavrana and began to practice the divine prayer called Krfiiapremdmrta (nectar in the form of Krsna's love).
verses.commentary: Sense: There this sage built his abode in the company of Aki tavrana and began to practice the divine prayer called Krfiiapremdmrta (nectar in the form of Krsna's love).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वासं प्रकल्प्यासावकृतव्रणसंयुतः । समभ्यस्यत्स्तवं दिव्यं कृष्मप्रेमामृताभिधम्
verses.transliteration: tatra vāsaṃ prakalpyāsāvakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ / samabhyasyatstavaṃ divyaṃ kṛṣmapremāmṛtābhidham
verses.translation: He practised the recitation of that prayer of the lord of the Vraja viz. Krsna, every day. Hari became pleased, O king, and revealed himself to the view of the son of Jamadagni.
verses.wordMeaning: He practised the recitation of that prayer of the lord of the Vraja viz. Krsna, every day. Hari became pleased, O king, and revealed himself to the view of the son of Jamadagni.
verses.commentary: Sense: He practised the recitation of that prayer of the lord of the Vraja viz. Krsna, every day. Hari became pleased, O king, and revealed himself to the view of the son of Jamadagni.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं व्रजपतेस्तस्य स्तोत्रं तुष्टो ऽभवद्धरिः । जगाम दर्शनं तस्य जामदग्न्यस्य भूपते
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ vrajapatestasya stotraṃ tuṣṭo 'bhavaddhariḥ / jagāma darśanaṃ tasya jāmadagnyasya bhūpate
verses.translation: On seeing the Lord, the son of Jamadagni gleefully got up at once; he prostrated himself on the ground like a staff and then eulogised the lord with perfect control ( on his sense- organs).
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Lord, the son of Jamadagni gleefully got up at once; he prostrated himself on the ground like a staff and then eulogised the lord with perfect control ( on his sense- organs).
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Lord, the son of Jamadagni gleefully got up at once; he prostrated himself on the ground like a staff and then eulogised the lord with perfect control ( on his sense- organs).

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्व्यूहाधिपः साक्षात्कृष्णः कमललोचनः । किरीटंनार्कवर्णेन कुण्डलाभ्यां च राजितः
verses.transliteration: caturvyūhādhipaḥ sākṣātkṛṣṇaḥ kamalalocanaḥ / kirīṭaṃnārkavarṇena kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca rājitaḥ
verses.translation: "Obeisance, obeisance to one whose body is the cause of the universe; to one who protects those who resort to him; who dispels the distress of gods and is eulogised by gods the chief of whom were Brahma l£a, Visnu, Indra and others. I bow down constantly to the supreme Lord.
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance, obeisance to one whose body is the cause of the universe; to one who protects those who resort to him; who dispels the distress of gods and is eulogised by gods the chief of whom were Brahma l£a, Visnu, Indra and others. I bow down constantly to the supreme Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance, obeisance to one whose body is the cause of the universe; to one who protects those who resort to him; who dispels the distress of gods and is eulogised by gods the chief of whom were Brahma l£a, Visnu, Indra and others. I bow down constantly to the supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: कौस्तुभोद्भासितोरस्कः पीतवासा धनप्रभः । मुरलीवादनपरः साक्षान्मोहनरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: kaustubhodbhāsitoraskaḥ pītavāsā dhanaprabhaḥ / muralīvādanaparaḥ sākṣānmohanarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: I sana and others have been incompetent to specify your nature through the Vedic arguments of diverse kinds. You are the unborn lord who cannot be pointed out and specified. I worship you the ancient, infinite Lord. Be merciful unto me.
verses.hindi: सम्पहेवी ओर उस सुरों के शत्रु के प्रसृत बाणों से सबं प्रथम ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: I sana and others have been incompetent to specify your nature through the Vedic arguments of diverse kinds. You are the unborn lord who cannot be pointed out and specified. I worship you the ancient, infinite Lord. Be merciful unto me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I sana and others have been incompetent to specify your nature through the Vedic arguments of diverse kinds. You are the unborn lord who cannot be pointed out and specified. I worship you the ancient, infinite Lord. Be merciful unto me.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय जामदग्न्यो मुदान्वितः । प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भमौ तुष्टाव प्रयतो विभुम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya jāmadagnyo mudānvitaḥ / praṇamya daṇḍavadbhamau tuṣṭāva prayato vibhum
verses.translation: You are the only Lord who bestow what one desires. You assume different kinds of bodies among the Devas, human beings, lower animals and the aquatic beings in order to pre- vent inordinate burden unto the Earth and to sport about to protect the worlds.
verses.hindi: अन्धकार हो गया था जिसने सूर्य के तेज के आलोक को भी तिरस्कृत कर
verses.wordMeaning: You are the only Lord who bestow what one desires. You assume different kinds of bodies among the Devas, human beings, lower animals and the aquatic beings in order to pre- vent inordinate burden unto the Earth and to sport about to protect the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the only Lord who bestow what one desires. You assume different kinds of bodies among the Devas, human beings, lower animals and the aquatic beings in order to pre- vent inordinate burden unto the Earth and to sport about to protect the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: परशुराम् उवाच नमो नमः कारणविग्रहाय प्रपन्नपालाय सुरार्त्तिहारिणे । ब्रह्मेशविष्ण्विद्रमुखस्तुताय नतो ऽस्मि नित्यं परमेश्वराय
verses.transliteration: paraśurām uvāca namo namaḥ kāraṇavigrahāya prapannapālāya surārttihāriṇe / brahmeśaviṣṇvidramukhastutāya nato 'smi nityaṃ parameśvarāya
verses.translation: I worship you who love devout people, who are extremely unattached even to the Goddess of Wealth (Laksmi) and others and whose heart is bound in love even with those ladies (? the Gowherdesses) whose minds are difiled by the defect of infidelity and transgression in your own presence.
verses.wordMeaning: I worship you who love devout people, who are extremely unattached even to the Goddess of Wealth (Laksmi) and others and whose heart is bound in love even with those ladies (? the Gowherdesses) whose minds are difiled by the defect of infidelity and transgression in your own pre…
verses.commentary: Sense: I worship you who love devout people, who are extremely unattached even to the Goddess of Wealth (Laksmi) and others and whose heart is bound in love even with those ladies (? the Gowherdesses) whose minds are difiled by the defect of infidelity and transgression in your own pre…

verses.sanskrit: यं वेदवादैर्विविधप्रकारैर्निर्णेतुमीशानमुखा न शक्नुयुः । तं त्वामनिर्देश्यमचं पुराममनन्तमीडे भव मे दयापरः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ vedavādairvividhaprakārairnirṇetumīśānamukhā na śaknuyuḥ / taṃ tvāmanirdeśyamacaṃ purāmamanantamīḍe bhava me dayāparaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, the delighted Asuras, Suras, human beings along with the Kinnaras, the lower animals and even Ayonis (those not born of a womb) have shed of! their sense of posses- sion as "my-ness** with regard to their bodies, wives, children and properties and everything and have resorted to your person.
verses.hindi: दिया था ।५७। इसके पश्चात् वाणों के अत्यन्त संघट्ट से समुत्पन्न विस्फुलिग हो गये थे फिर वे विस्फुलिग इधर-उधर भ्रमण करने की चातुरी वाले हो गये थे ।५८। सुन्दर श्रोणी वाली उस देवी के द्वारा अधिरूढ़ गज जो रण कोलाहल नाम वाला था उसने उस संग्राम में बहुत प्रकार का पराक्रम प्रद-
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, the delighted Asuras, Suras, human beings along with the Kinnaras, the lower animals and even Ayonis (those not born of a womb) have shed of! their sense of posses- sion as "my-ness** with regard to their bodies, wives,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, the delighted Asuras, Suras, human beings along with the Kinnaras, the lower animals and even Ayonis (those not born of a womb) have shed of! their sense of posses- sion as "my-ness** with regard to their bodies, wives,…

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वेक ईशो निजवाञ्च्छितप्रदो धत्ते तनूर्लोकविहार रक्षणे । नाना विधा देवमनुष्यतिर्यग्यादः सु भूमेर्भरवारणाय
verses.transliteration: yastveka īśo nijavāñcchitaprado dhatte tanūrlokavihāra rakṣaṇe / nānā vidhā devamanuṣyatiryagyādaḥ su bhūmerbharavāraṇāya
verses.translation: I have attained with respect, that lord of the Devas who grants whatever is desired by those who worship him, who is devoid of desire, and (being transcendental) is bereft of Gunas (the three attributes of Prakrti), is inconceivable, unmanifest, annihilator of sins and a store-house of love.
verses.hindi: शित किया था ।५९। उस गज ने भी कुछ असुरों को तो अपनी सू'ड़ से और कुछ देत्यों को अपने पदों की चोट से तथा कुछ को अपने तीक्ष्य दांतों के मुसलों की चोटों से मार.डाला था ।६०। बालकांड से अन्यों को चोट दी थी तथा अन्यों को फेल्कारों के द्वारा शत्रु को निहत किया था। कुछ को
verses.wordMeaning: I have attained with respect, that lord of the Devas who grants whatever is desired by those who worship him, who is devoid of desire, and (being transcendental) is bereft of Gunas (the three attributes of Prakrti), is inconceivable, unmanifest,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I have attained with respect, that lord of the Devas who grants whatever is desired by those who worship him, who is devoid of desire, and (being transcendental) is bereft of Gunas (the three attributes of Prakrti), is inconceivable, unmanifest,…

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वामहं भक्तजनानुरक्तं विरक्तमत्यन्तमपीन्दिरादिषु । स्वयं समक्षंव्यभिचारदुष्टचित्तास्वपि प्रेमनिबद्धमानसम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ tvāmahaṃ bhaktajanānuraktaṃ viraktamatyantamapīndirādiṣu / svayaṃ samakṣaṃvyabhicāraduṣṭacittāsvapi premanibaddhamānasam
verses.translation: Some people subject their bodies to different kinds of tortures (i.e. austerities); others worship by means of various Tajnas. But, O lord, those whose inclinations and desires are bound up with worldly affairs never see your super-natural form even in their dreams.
verses.hindi: अपने शरीर के द्वारा मदित किया था एअं अन्य शत्रुओं को अपने नखों के प्रहारों से मार डाला था ।६१। कुछ देत्यों को उस गज ने पृथुमानाभिषात से विमरदित कर दिया था। इस तरह से उस सम्पद्देवी के हाथी ने बहुत ही कौशल से पूर्ण अपना चरित दिखाया था ।६२। सुदुर्मद ने परमाधिक क्रोध
verses.wordMeaning: Some people subject their bodies to different kinds of tortures (i.e. austerities); others worship by means of various Tajnas. But, O lord, those whose inclinations and desires are bound up with worldly affairs never see your super-natural form even in their dreams.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some people subject their bodies to different kinds of tortures (i.e. austerities); others worship by means of various Tajnas. But, O lord, those whose inclinations and desires are bound up with worldly affairs never see your super-natural form even in their dreams.

verses.sanskrit: यं वै प्रसन्ना असुराः सुरा नराः सकिन्नरास्तिर्यकेयोनयो ऽपि हि । गताः स्वरूपं निखलं विहाय ते देहस्त्र्यपत्यार्थममत्वमीश्वर
verses.transliteration: yaṃ vai prasannā asurāḥ surā narāḥ sakinnarāstiryakeyonayo 'pi hi / gatāḥ svarūpaṃ nikhalaṃ vihāya te dehastryapatyārthamamatvamīśvara
verses.translation: "When the son of Jamadagni eulogised like this and bowed down to him in front of him, lord Krsna spoke in a deep voice as though he was fascinating every one by means of his Maya.*'
verses.hindi: से लाल होते हुए एक सुहृढ़ बाण से उस सम्पत्करी देवो के मुकट में स्थित एक मणि को गिरा दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: "When the son of Jamadagni eulogised like this and bowed down to him in front of him, lord Krsna spoke in a deep voice as though he was fascinating every one by means of his Maya.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: "When the son of Jamadagni eulogised like this and bowed down to him in front of him, lord Krsna spoke in a deep voice as though he was fascinating every one by means of his Maya.*'

verses.sanskrit: तं देवदेवं भजतामभीप्सितप्रदं निरीहं गुणवर्जितं च । अचिन्त्यमव्यक्तमघौघनाशनं प्राप्तो ऽरणं प्रेमनिधानमादरात्
verses.transliteration: taṃ devadevaṃ bhajatāmabhīpsitapradaṃ nirīhaṃ guṇavarjitaṃ ca / acintyamavyaktamaghaughanāśanaṃ prāpto 'raṇaṃ premanidhānamādarāt
verses.translation: O Rama of great fortune, your excellent work has been achieved. Understand that it is due to the power of the Kaiaca (Protective hymn) and the eulogy.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर क्रोध से लाल नेत्रों वाली उस देवी के द्वारा छोड़े हुए बाणों से शीघ्र ही वक्ष: स्थल में विक्षत हुआ था ओर उस दुमंद ने अपने प्राणों को त्याग दिया था ।६४। इसके अनन्तर शक्ति की श्रेष्ठ सेनाओं ने किल-किल की ध्वनि की थी और उन्होंने उस हैत्य के जो परम श्रेष्ठ अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: O Rama of great fortune, your excellent work has been achieved. Understand that it is due to the power of the Kaiaca (Protective hymn) and the eulogy.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Rama of great fortune, your excellent work has been achieved. Understand that it is due to the power of the Kaiaca (Protective hymn) and the eulogy.

verses.sanskrit: तपन्ति तापैर्विविधैः स्वदेहमन्ये तु यज्ञैर्विविधैर्यजन्ति । स्वप्ने ऽपि ते रूपमलौकिकंविभो पश्यन्ति नैवार्थनिबद्धवासनाः
verses.transliteration: tapanti tāpairvividhaiḥ svadehamanye tu yajñairvividhairyajanti / svapne 'pi te rūpamalaukikaṃvibho paśyanti naivārthanibaddhavāsanāḥ
verses.translation: After killing Karttavirya, the haughty-minded king, and after avenging your father, make the Earth devoid of K$atriyas.
verses.hindi: सेनिक दानव थे उन सबको मार गिराया था ।६५। मरने से बचे हुए जो भी हैत्य थे वे सब शक्ति के बाणों से/चुटेल होकर उस रण की भूमि से भाग गये थे और शुत्यक में जाकर छिप गये ये।६६। उनके द्वारा शक्तिद्वारा किये हुए गुद्धके वृत्तान्त का श्रवण करके वह दानवेश्वर बहुत ही क्र द्ध होगया था
verses.wordMeaning: After killing Karttavirya, the haughty-minded king, and after avenging your father, make the Earth devoid of K$atriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing Karttavirya, the haughty-minded king, and after avenging your father, make the Earth devoid of K$atriyas.

verses.sanskrit: ये वै त्वदीयं चरणं भवश्रमान्निर्विण्मचित्ता विधिवत्स्मरन्ति । नमन्ति भक्त्याथ समर्चयन्ति वै परस्परं संसदि वर्णयन्ति
verses.transliteration: ye vai tvadīyaṃ caraṇaṃ bhavaśramānnirviṇmacittā vidhivatsmaranti / namanti bhaktyātha samarcayanti vai parasparaṃ saṃsadi varṇayanti
verses.translation: From now onwards you will be moving about in this world charged with a part of mine energy. You will do and undo everything at the proper time. You yourself will be the lord.
verses.hindi: उदग्र नेत्रों वाला वह अपने प्रचण्ड प्रभाव से आत्मा से दीप्यमान णेसा हो गया था और उसने युद्ध करने के लिए अपने खड्ग को उठाया था। और उसने समीप में ही स्थित सेनापति कुटिलाक्ष से कहा था ।६८। किस प्रकार से उस महादुष्टा नारी ने बड़े भारी बल वाले दुमंद को युद्ध में मार गिराया
verses.wordMeaning: From now onwards you will be moving about in this world charged with a part of mine energy. You will do and undo everything at the proper time. You yourself will be the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: From now onwards you will be moving about in this world charged with a part of mine energy. You will do and undo everything at the proper time. You yourself will be the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैकजन्मोद्भवपङ्कभेदनप्रसक्तचित्ता भवत्ॐऽघ्रिपद्मे । तरन्ति चान्यानपि तारयन्ति हि भवौषधं नाम सुधा तवेश
verses.transliteration: tenaikajanmodbhavapaṅkabhedanaprasaktacittā bhavatoṃ'ghripadme / taranti cānyānapi tārayanti hi bhavauṣadhaṃ nāma sudhā taveśa
verses.translation: In the twenty-fourth set of four Yugas, in the Trcta Yuga, O dear one, I shall be born in the family of Raghu under the name Rama. I the eternal lord with four Vyuhas (manifestations e.g. Samkarsana etc.), shall be born (along with the three others).
verses.hindi: है। यह विधाता का क्रम बड़ा कष्ट दायक है ।६६। ऐसा महान बल तो न देवों में है और न यक्षं में है और उरमेन्द्रों में मी ऐसा बल विदयमान नहीं है वह तो ऐसा बलवान था कि उसका मारते वाला कोई भी नहीं था, वह दुमेंद भी उस अबला के द्वारा मारा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: In the twenty-fourth set of four Yugas, in the Trcta Yuga, O dear one, I shall be born in the family of Raghu under the name Rama. I the eternal lord with four Vyuhas (manifestations e.g. Samkarsana etc.), shall be born (along with the three others).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twenty-fourth set of four Yugas, in the Trcta Yuga, O dear one, I shall be born in the family of Raghu under the name Rama. I the eternal lord with four Vyuhas (manifestations e.g. Samkarsana etc.), shall be born (along with the three others).

verses.sanskrit: अहं प्रभो कामनिबद्धचित्तो भवन्तमार्यं विविधप्रयत्नैः । आराधयं नाथ भवानभिज्ञः किं ते ह विज्ञाप्यमिहास्ति लोके
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ prabho kāmanibaddhacitto bhavantamāryaṃ vividhaprayatnaiḥ / ārādhayaṃ nātha bhavānabhijñaḥ kiṃ te ha vijñāpyamihāsti loke
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्येवं जामदग्न्यं तु स्तुवन्तं प्रणतं पुरः । उवाचागाधया वाचा मोहयन्निव मायया
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityevaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ tu stuvantaṃ praṇataṃ puraḥ / uvācāgādhayā vācā mohayanniva māyayā
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: कृष्ण उवाच हन्त राम महाभाग सिद्धं ते कार्यमुत्तमम् । कवचस्य स्तवस्यापि प्रभावादवधारय
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa uvāca hanta rāma mahābhāga siddhaṃ te kāryamuttamam / kavacasya stavasyāpi prabhāvādavadhāraya
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा तं कार्त्तवीर्यं हि राजानं दृप्तमानसम् । साधयित्वा पितुर्वैरं कुरु निःक्षत्रियां महीम्
verses.transliteration: hatvā taṃ kārttavīryaṃ hi rājānaṃ dṛptamānasam / sādhayitvā piturvairaṃ kuru niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: मम चक्रावतारो हि कार्त्तवीर्यो धरातले । कृतकार्यो द्विजश्रेष्ट तं समापय मानद
verses.transliteration: mama cakrāvatāro hi kārttavīryo dharātale / kṛtakāryo dvijaśreṣṭa taṃ samāpaya mānada
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.hindi: अब उस परम दुष्टा नारो को जीतने के लिए और उसकी चोटी बल. पूर्वक खींचकर लाने के लिए युद्ध के परम दुमंद कुटिलाख्य सेनापति को शीघ्र मेरे पास भेज दो ।७१। इस प्रकार से उसने कुटिलाक्ष को भेजा था । महान बलवान प्रचण्ड वाहुओं वाले कुरण्ड को स्वामी के सामने बुलाया था
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: अद्य प्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन्नंशावेशेन मे भवान् । चरिष्यति यथा कालं कर्त्ता हर्त्ता स्वयं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛti loke 'sminnaṃśāveśena me bhavān / cariṣyati yathā kālaṃ karttā harttā svayaṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.hindi: ।७२। उस कुरण्ड ने वहाँ आकर स्वामी के लिए प्रणाम किया था और कुटिलाक्ष ने उससे कहा था किं जाओ और सेनिकों को तंयार करो
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विशे युगे वत्स त्रेतायां रघुवंशजः । रामो नाम भविष्यामि चतुर्व्यूहः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: caturviśe yuge vatsa tretāyāṃ raghuvaṃśajaḥ / rāmo nāma bhaviṣyāmi caturvyūhaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.hindi: आप तो माया के फैला देने में बहुत चतुर हैं और विचित्र प्रकार के युद्ध करने में महान पंडित हैं और आप कूट युद्ध करने में भी बहुत निपुण हैं। अब जाकर उस नारो का परिमर्दन करो ७४! इस तरह से स्वामी के हीआगे उस कुटिलाक्ष के द्वारा उसको आदेश दिया गया था । फिर बह चण्ड विक्रम
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: कौसल्यानन्दजनको राज्ञो दशरथादहम् । तदा कौशिकयज्ञं तु साधयित्वा सलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration: kausalyānandajanako rājño daśarathādaham / tadā kauśikayajñaṃ tu sādhayitvā salakṣmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.hindi: वाला कुरण्ड शीक्र ही तगर से निकलकर चला गया था ।७५। वह बीस अक्षौहिणी सेना से परिवृत था और अपने हाथी-अश्व तथा पेदल सैनिकों से इस भूमण्डल को वह मदित कर रहा था । दुमद का बड़ा भाई परम प्रचण्ड कुरन्ड युद्ध स्थल में गया था ।७६। वह धोर मन वाला जब युद्ध स्थल में
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: गमिष्यामि महाभाग जनकस्य पुर महत् । तत्रेशचापं निर्भज्य परिणीय विदेहजाम्
verses.transliteration: gamiṣyāmi mahābhāga janakasya pura mahat / tatreśacāpaṃ nirbhajya pariṇīya videhajām
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.hindi: गया तो इतनी धूलि उड़ने लगी थी कि सभी दिशाए' उससे भर गयी थी । बहू शोक और रोष से भरा हुआ था और बड़े वेग वाले अश्व पर समारूढ़ होकर वहां पर गया था
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: तदा यास्यन्नयोध्यां ते हरिष्ये तेज उन्मदम् । वसिष्ठ उवाच कृष्ण एवं समदिश्य जामदग्न्यं तपोनिधिम् । पश्यत्ॐऽतर्दधे तत्र रामस्य मुमहात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tadā yāsyannayodhyāṃ te hariṣye teja unmadam / vasiṣṭha uvāca kṛṣṇa evaṃ samadiśya jāmadagnyaṃ taponidhim / paśyatoṃ'tardadhe tatra rāmasya mumahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born of king Dasaratha as the delight- er of queen Kausalya. At that time, O sage of great fortune

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रहामाण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भर्गवचरिते सप्तत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३७॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच अन्तर्द्धानं गते कृष्णे रामस्तु सुमहायशाः । समुद्रिक्तमथात्मानं मेने कृष्णानुभावतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahāmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhargavacarite saptatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 37// vasiṣṭha uvāca antarddhānaṃ gate kṛṣṇe rāmastu sumahāyaśāḥ / samudriktamathātmānaṃ mene kṛṣṇānubhāvataḥ
verses.translation: "When Krsna vanished, Rama of very great fame considered himself enhanced in power, due to Krsna*s majestic lustre.
verses.wordMeaning: "When Krsna vanished, Rama of very great fame considered himself enhanced in power, due to Krsna*s majestic lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: "When Krsna vanished, Rama of very great fame considered himself enhanced in power, due to Krsna*s majestic lustre.

verses.sanskrit: अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः प्रदीप्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन् । समायातो भार्गवो ऽसीपुरीं महिष्मतीं प्रति
verses.transliteration: akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ pradīptāgniriva jvalan / samāyāto bhārgavo 'sīpurīṃ mahiṣmatīṃ prati
verses.translation: Blazing like a well-kindled fire, (Rama) the scion of the family of Bhpgu accompanied by Akrtavrana, came to the city of MahismatL1
verses.hindi: पापे मदनुजं हत्वा दुमंदं युद्धुमे दम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Blazing like a well-kindled fire, (Rama) the scion of the family of Bhpgu accompanied by Akrtavrana, came to the city of MahismatL1
verses.commentary: Sense: Blazing like a well-kindled fire, (Rama) the scion of the family of Bhpgu accompanied by Akrtavrana, came to the city of MahismatL1

verses.sanskrit: यत्र पापहरा पुण्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा । पुनाति दर्शनादेव प्राणिनः पापिनो ह्यपि
verses.transliteration: yatra pāpaharā puṇyā narmadā saritāṃ varā / punāti darśanādeva prāṇinaḥ pāpino hyapi
verses.translation: How can the merit of men thereof, who had the form of the Devas, be adequately described?
verses.wordMeaning: How can the merit of men thereof, who had the form of the Devas, be adequately described?
verses.commentary: Sense: How can the merit of men thereof, who had the form of the Devas, be adequately described?

verses.sanskrit: पुरा त्रय हरेणापि निविष्टेन महात्मना । त्रिपुरस्य विनाशाय कृतो यत्नो महीपते
verses.transliteration: purā traya hareṇāpi niviṣṭena mahātmanā / tripurasya vināśāya kṛto yatno mahīpate
verses.translation: "Get my army, O highly fortunate one, honoured by heroes. I will fight with Rama of the family of Bhrgu. Let there be no delay".
verses.hindi: अघुना भोक्ष्यसे दुष्ट पश्य मे भुजयोबंलम्
verses.wordMeaning: "Get my army, O highly fortunate one, honoured by heroes. I will fight with Rama of the family of Bhrgu. Let there be no delay".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Get my army, O highly fortunate one, honoured by heroes. I will fight with Rama of the family of Bhrgu. Let there be no delay".

verses.sanskrit: तत्र किं वर्ण्यते पुण्यं नृणां देवस्वरूपिणाम् । सदृष्ट्वा नर्मदां भूप भर्गवः कुलनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: tatra kiṃ varṇyate puṇyaṃ nṛṇāṃ devasvarūpiṇām / sadṛṣṭvā narmadāṃ bhūpa bhargavaḥ kulanandanaḥ
verses.translation: n On being told thus, the commander-in-chicf, of great exploits, got the army consisting of four constituents ready and informed him.
verses.wordMeaning: n On being told thus, the commander-in-chicf, of great exploits, got the army consisting of four constituents ready and informed him.
verses.commentary: Sense: n On being told thus, the commander-in-chicf, of great exploits, got the army consisting of four constituents ready and informed him.

verses.sanskrit: नमश्चकार सुप्रीतः शत्रुसाधनतत्परः । नमो ऽस्तु नर्मदे तुभ्यं हरदेहसमुद्भवे
verses.transliteration: namaścakāra suprītaḥ śatrusādhanatatparaḥ / namo 'stu narmade tubhyaṃ haradehasamudbhave
verses.translation: All round that king, his vassals and the rulers of the various zones stationed themselves along with many Ak$auhinis (big divisions of armies consisting of all the four sections viz. foot-soldiers, horses, elephants and chariots) and were ready to serve him.
verses.wordMeaning: All round that king, his vassals and the rulers of the various zones stationed themselves along with many Ak$auhinis (big divisions of armies consisting of all the four sections viz. foot-soldiers, horses, elephants and chariots) and were ready to serve him.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round that king, his vassals and the rulers of the various zones stationed themselves along with many Ak$auhinis (big divisions of armies consisting of all the four sections viz. foot-soldiers, horses, elephants and chariots) and were ready to serve him.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्रं नाशय शत्रून्मे वरदा भव शोभने । इत्येवं स नमस्कृत्य नर्मदां पापनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration: kṣipraṃ nāśaya śatrūnme varadā bhava śobhane / ityevaṃ sa namaskṛtya narmadāṃ pāpanāśinīm
verses.translation: In that army resembling an ocean, there were crores of elephants, horses, chariots and foot-soldiers. They were innumerable.
verses.hindi: उसने परमाधिक ऊंची आवाज वाली टंकार से युक्त शाङ्ग घतुष लेकर सम्पत्करी की बड़ो भारी सेना पर शरों की धाराओं की वर्षा की थी ।७८। उसने सम्पत्करो से कहा-हे पाये ! से युद्ध करने में दुमंद मेरे छोटे भाई को हनन करके विक्रान्ति के लवलेश वाले इस महान मद को म्पथं
verses.wordMeaning: In that army resembling an ocean, there were crores of elephants, horses, chariots and foot-soldiers. They were innumerable.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that army resembling an ocean, there were crores of elephants, horses, chariots and foot-soldiers. They were innumerable.

verses.sanskrit: दूतं प्रस्थापयामास कार्त्तवीर्यार्जुनं प्रति । दूत राजात्वया वाच्यो यदहं वच्मि ते ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: dūtaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa kārttavīryārjunaṃ prati / dūta rājātvayā vācyo yadahaṃ vacmi te 'nagha
verses.translation: Kings born of different families, were seen there. They were great warriors of huge bodies. They were experts in different kinds of warfares. They were clever in wielding differ- ent kinds of weapons and missiles. The kings were seated on various kinds of vehicles.
verses.hindi: ही कर रही है ।७६। अब आपको मैं इन नाराचों के मन्डलों से यहीँ पर यमराज की पुरी को पहुँचा दूगा-अब तू मुझको देख ले ।८०। ये रण पूत- नाए' तेरे अतीव स्वादिष्ट-रम्य-तेरे शरीर के बिलों से निकला हुआ-अपूर्व अङ्कना का रुधिर पान करें ।८१। मेरे छोटे भाई के वध से जो तूने बड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: Kings born of different families, were seen there. They were great warriors of huge bodies. They were experts in different kinds of warfares. They were clever in wielding differ- ent kinds of weapons and missiles. The kings were seated on various kinds of vehicles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kings born of different families, were seen there. They were great warriors of huge bodies. They were experts in different kinds of warfares. They were clever in wielding differ- ent kinds of weapons and missiles. The kings were seated on various kinds of vehicles.

verses.sanskrit: न संदेहस्त्वया कार्यो दूतः क्वापि न बध्यते । यद्बलं तु समाश्रित्य जमदग्निमुनिं नृपः
verses.transliteration: na saṃdehastvayā kāryo dūtaḥ kvāpi na badhyate / yadbalaṃ tu samāśritya jamadagnimuniṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: "On this day has been realized my task cherished for a long time, because the wretched king Karttavlrya has come within my vision."
verses.hindi: अनर्थ किया है उसका यही परिणाम है । है दुष्टें ! अब तू उस फल को भागेगी और अव तू मेरी भुजाओं के बल को देख ले ।८२। करिवर विराज- माना उस सम्पत्करी को इस प्रकार फटकारते हुए उसने अपनी सेना को शक्ति की सेना के विमदेन करने के लिए प्रोत्साहन दिया था ।८३। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: "On this day has been realized my task cherished for a long time, because the wretched king Karttavlrya has come within my vision."
verses.commentary: Sense: "On this day has been realized my task cherished for a long time, because the wretched king Karttavlrya has come within my vision."

verses.sanskrit: तिरस्त्वं कृतवान्मूढ तत्पुत्रो योद्धुमागतः । शीघ्रं निर्गच्छ मन्दात्मन्युद्धं रामाय देहि तत्
verses.transliteration: tirastvaṃ kṛtavānmūḍha tatputro yoddhumāgataḥ / śīghraṃ nirgaccha mandātmanyuddhaṃ rāmāya dehi tat
verses.translation: He rose up after saying this. Seizing his weapon, the axe, he stood up to his full height ready for the destruction of his enemies just like an infuriated lion.
verses.hindi: पश्चात् उस चण्डी ने महान भोज बासे कुरम्ड की सेना का विमदंत करने के लिए उद्यूक्त होकर अपनी सेना को उत्साहित किया था
verses.wordMeaning: He rose up after saying this. Seizing his weapon, the axe, he stood up to his full height ready for the destruction of his enemies just like an infuriated lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: He rose up after saying this. Seizing his weapon, the axe, he stood up to his full height ready for the destruction of his enemies just like an infuriated lion.

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवं त्वं समासाद्य गच्छ लोकान्तरं त्वरा । इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं श्रुत्वा तस्य वचस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhārgavaṃ tvaṃ samāsādya gaccha lokāntaraṃ tvarā / ityevamuktvā rājānaṃ śrutvā tasya vacastathā
verses.translation: On seeing Rama in readiness for the destruction of the soldiers, all embodied beings trembled excessively (afraid of) death as it were.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Rama in readiness for the destruction of the soldiers, all embodied beings trembled excessively (afraid of) death as it were.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Rama in readiness for the destruction of the soldiers, all embodied beings trembled excessively (afraid of) death as it were.

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रमागच्छ भद्रं ते विलंबो नेह शस्यते । तेनैवमुक्तो दूतस्तु गतो हैहयभूपतिम्
verses.transliteration: śīghramāgaccha bhadraṃ te vilaṃbo neha śasyate / tenaivamukto dūtastu gato haihayabhūpatim
verses.translation: Wherever the infuriated scion of the family of Bhigu moved about with the velocity of the wind and hurled his axe, the elephants, horses and the heroic warriors fell down with their arms, thighs and necks cut off.
verses.hindi: सखि संपत्करि प्रीत्या मम वाणी निशम्यताम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Wherever the infuriated scion of the family of Bhigu moved about with the velocity of the wind and hurled his axe, the elephants, horses and the heroic warriors fell down with their arms, thighs and necks cut off.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever the infuriated scion of the family of Bhigu moved about with the velocity of the wind and hurled his axe, the elephants, horses and the heroic warriors fell down with their arms, thighs and necks cut off.

verses.sanskrit: रामोदितं तत्सकलं श्रावयामास संसदि । स राजात्रेयभक्तस्तु महाबलपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: rāmoditaṃ tatsakalaṃ śrāvayāmāsa saṃsadi / sa rājātreyabhaktastu mahābalaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: चुक्रोध श्रुत्वा वाच्यं तद्दूतमुत्तरमावहत् । कार्त्तवीर्य उवाच मया भुजबलेनैव दत्तदत्तेन मेदिनी
verses.transliteration: cukrodha śrutvā vācyaṃ taddūtamuttaramāvahat / kārttavīrya uvāca mayā bhujabalenaiva dattadattena medinī
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: उस अपूव युद्ध से समुत्पन्न कौतुक वाली अश्व पर समाशा होती हुई वहाँ आकर स्नेह के सहित यह वचन उससे बोली थी ।८४। है सखि ! है सम्पत्करि ! प्रीति से मेरो वाणी का श्रवण करो । इसके साथ युद्ध मुझे करने दो । मेरा युद्ध करना गुणोत्तर है (८६। क्षणभर के लिए तुम शान्त
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: जिता प्रसह्य भूपालान्बद्ध्वानीय निजं पुरम् । तद्बलं मयि वर्त्तेत युद्धं दास्ये तवाधुना
verses.transliteration: jitā prasahya bhūpālānbaddhvānīya nijaṃ puram / tadbalaṃ mayi vartteta yuddhaṃ dāsye tavādhunā
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: हो जाओ । यह मेरे ही द्वारा युद्ध करेगा आप मेरो सखी हैं इसीलिए यह याचना मैंने की है । इसमें कुछ भी संशय मत करना ।८७। इस प्रकार के सम्पददबी के वचन का थवण कर उस शुचिस्मिता ने क्रन्ड के समक्ष में उठी हुई सेना को वापिष कर दिया था ।८८। इसके उपरान्त बालसूयं की
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: इत्युत्क्वा विससर्ज्जाशु दूतं हैहयभूपतिः । सेनाध्यक्षं समाहूय प्रोवाच वदतां वरः
verses.transliteration: ityutkvā visasarjjāśu dūtaṃ haihayabhūpatiḥ / senādhyakṣaṃ samāhūya provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: आभा वाली शक्तिरों से समंधिष्ठित हूई थी । वायु के समान वेग वाले इसके अश्व समुद्र की तरङ्गों के ही समान थे ।८६। वे अश्व परम प्रखर खुरों के पुढों से भुमि को बार-२ उल्लिखित कर रहे थे और एक ही प्रवाह से उस कुरुत्ड को सेना के सामने आकर उपस्थित हो गये थे ।६०। बल्ग (लगाम)
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: सज्जं कुरु महाभाग सैन्यं मे वीरसंमतः । योत्स्ये रामेण भृगुणा विलंबो मा भवत्विति
verses.transliteration: sajjaṃ kuru mahābhāga sainyaṃ me vīrasaṃmataḥ / yotsye rāmeṇa bhṛguṇā vilaṃbo mā bhavatviti
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: के विभाग कृत्यॉ में-सम्बत्त न और निवत्त॑न में-गतिभेदों में-चारों में पाँच प्रकार का उनके खुरों का पातन था
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महावीरः सेनाध्यक्षः प्रतापनः । सैन्यं सज्जं विधायाशु चतुरङ्ग न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahāvīraḥ senādhyakṣaḥ pratāpanaḥ / sainyaṃ sajjaṃ vidhāyāśu caturaṅga nyavedayat
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: स यत्र यत्रानिलरंहसं भृगुश्चिक्षेप रोषेण युतः परश्वधम् । ततस्ततश्छिन्नभुजोरुकङ्घरा नागा हयाः शूरनरा निपेतुः

verses.sanskrit: यथा गजेन्द्रो मदयुक्समन्ततो नालं वनं भर्द्दयति प्रधावन् । तथैव रामो ऽपि मनोनिलौजा विमर्द्दयामास नृपस्य सेनाम्
verses.transliteration: yathā gajendro madayuksamantato nālaṃ vanaṃ bharddayati pradhāvan / tathaiva rāmo 'pi manonilaujā vimarddayāmāsa nṛpasya senām
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: उस अकुश से निकलो हुई कुछ परम उदुमट पूतनाए" उसकी सेना के पाश से निष्यन्द भक्षण करके क्षय को प्राप्त हो गयीं थों।१०६। बीस अक्षोहिणी सेनाओं के स्वामी उस कुरण्ड के इस प्रकार से निहत हो जाने पर जो भो मरने से बचे हुए देत्यगण ये वे शोत हो बहाँ से भाग गये ये ।
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तमित्थं प्रहरन्तमोजसा रामं रणे शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठम् । उद्यम्य चापं महदास्थितो रथं सृज्यं च कृत्वा किलमन्स्यराजः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tamitthaṃ praharantamojasā rāmaṃ raṇe śastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / udyamya cāpaṃ mahadāsthito rathaṃ sṛjyaṃ ca kṛtvā kilamansyarājaḥ
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: उस युद्ध में छोटे भाई के साथ कुरण्ड को शक्ति की सेनाओं ने मार डाला था । जब यह वृत्तान्त शूम्पक पुर के स्वामी ने मुना था तो वह भी भुजंग के ही तुल्य लम्बी श्वास लेने लगा या
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्य वाणाननलोग्रतेजसः समाकिरन्भार्गवमाससाद । दृष्ट्वा तमायान्तमथो महात्मा रामो गृहीत्वा धनुषं महोग्रम्
verses.transliteration: ākṛṣya vāṇānanalogratejasaḥ samākiranbhārgavamāsasāda / dṛṣṭvā tamāyāntamatho mahātmā rāmo gṛhītvā dhanuṣaṃ mahogram

verses.sanskrit: वायव्यमस्त्रं विदधे रुषाप्लुतो निवारयन्मङ्गलबाणवर्षम् । स चापि राजातिबलो मनस्वी ससर्ज रामाय तु पर्वतास्त्रम्
verses.transliteration: vāyavyamastraṃ vidadhe ruṣāpluto nivārayanmaṅgalabāṇavarṣam / sa cāpi rājātibalo manasvī sasarja rāmāya tu parvatāstram

verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: तस्तंभ तेनातिबलं तदस्त्रं वायव्यमिष्वस्त्रविधानदक्षः । रामो ऽपि तत्रातिबलं विदित्वा तं मत्स्यराजं विविधास्त्रपूगैः
verses.transliteration: tastaṃbha tenātibalaṃ tadastraṃ vāyavyamiṣvastravidhānadakṣaḥ / rāmo 'pi tatrātibalaṃ viditvā taṃ matsyarājaṃ vividhāstrapūgaiḥ
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: किरन्तमाजौ प्रसभं सुमोच नारायणास्त्रं विधिमन्त्रयुक्तम् । नारायणास्त्रे भृगुणा प्रयुक्ते रामेण राजन्नृपतेर्वधाय
verses.transliteration: kirantamājau prasabhaṃ sumoca nārāyaṇāstraṃ vidhimantrayuktam / nārāyaṇāstre bhṛguṇā prayukte rāmeṇa rājannṛpatervadhāya
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
