verses.sanskrit: दिशस्तु सर्वाः सुभृशं हि तेजसा प्रजज्वलुर्मत्स्यपतिश्चकंपे । रामस्तु तस्याथ विलक्ष्य कम्पं बाणैश्चतुर्भिर्निजघान वाहान्
verses.transliteration: diśastu sarvāḥ subhṛśaṃ hi tejasā prajajvalurmatsyapatiścakaṃpe / rāmastu tasyātha vilakṣya kampaṃ bāṇaiścaturbhirnijaghāna vāhān
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर जब अध्वारूढ़ा के द्वारा कुरण्ड इत हो गया या तो अंड दानव ने पुनः युद्ध करने की इच्छा से कु'टेलाक्ष से यह वचन कहा था ।
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: शरेण चैकेन ध्वजं महात्मा चिच्छेद चापं च शरद्वयेन । बाणेन चैकेन प्रसह्य सारथिं निपात्य भूमौ रथमार्द्दयत्त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: śareṇa caikena dhvajaṃ mahātmā ciccheda cāpaṃ ca śaradvayena / bāṇena caikena prasahya sārathiṃ nipātya bhūmau rathamārddayattribhiḥ
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा रथं भूमिगतं च मङ्गलं परश्वधेनाशु जघान मूर्द्धनि । स भिन्नशीर्षो रुधिरं वमन्मुहुर्मर्च्छामवाप्याथ ममार च क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā rathaṃ bhūmigataṃ ca maṅgalaṃ paraśvadhenāśu jaghāna mūrddhani / sa bhinnaśīrṣo rudhiraṃ vamanmuhurmarcchāmavāpyātha mamāra ca kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: इसके कभी जो सुना भी नहीं गया था और जिसकी चित्त में कभी शंका भी नहीं की गयो यो वहो यह कष्ट इस समव में आ पड़ा है।२। कुरन्ड और दुर्मद ये दोनों हो बहुत सत्व शाली भाई ये । इस मायाविनी दुष्ट दासी का कितना अधिक बड़ा प्रभाव है।३। अब रणाङ्न में यहां से आगे करक
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: तत्सैन्यमस्त्रेण च संप्रदग्धं विनाशमायादथ भस्मसात्क्षणात् । तस्मिन्निपतिते राज्ञि चन्द्रवंशसमुद्भवे
verses.transliteration: tatsainyamastreṇa ca saṃpradagdhaṃ vināśamāyādatha bhasmasātkṣaṇāt / tasminnipatite rājñi candravaṃśasamudbhave
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: प्रभृति पाँच सेनाधिनायकों को और अक्षौहिणी सेना को रवाना कर दो
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: मङ्गले नृपतिश्रेष्ठे रामो हर्षमुपागतः
verses.transliteration: maṅgale nṛpatiśreṣṭhe rāmo harṣamupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.hindi: करने बाले हैं। ये लोग पूर्ग रूप से हो उस दुविदग्ध विलासिनी को अवश्य जीत लेंगे ।५। इस भंड के वचन को सुनकर अत्यन्त शीघ्रता से युक्‍त होकर कुटिलाक्ष ने करक आदि सेनापतियों को वहाँ पर बुला लिया था ।६। कुटि- लाक्ष के द्वारा देशित उन्होंने अपने स्वामो को प्रणाम किया था और फिर
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a big elephant in its rut runs all round and tramples down the cluster of reeds, so also Rama of the speed

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यम भागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते अष्टात्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३८॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच मत्स्यराजे निपतिते राजा युद्धविशारदः । राजेन्द्रान्प्रेरयामास कार्त्तवीर्यो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyama bhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite aṣṭātriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 38// vasiṣṭha uvāca matsyarāje nipatite rājā yuddhaviśāradaḥ / rājendrānprerayāmāsa kārttavīryo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: "When the king of Matsya-land fell, the king Karttavfrya who had great strength and who was an expert in war despatched many other leading kings to fight.
verses.hindi: बे इतने अधिक क्रोधान्ध हो गये बे मानों अग्नि में ही से सः मूत हुए होबें। वे सब फिर उस पुर से युद्ध के लिए निकल कर चले गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: "When the king of Matsya-land fell, the king Karttavfrya who had great strength and who was an expert in war despatched many other leading kings to fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: "When the king of Matsya-land fell, the king Karttavfrya who had great strength and who was an expert in war despatched many other leading kings to fight.

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्बलः सोमदत्तो विदर्भो मिथिलेश्वरः । निषधाधिपतिश्चैव मगधाधिपतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bṛhadbalaḥ somadatto vidarbho mithileśvaraḥ / niṣadhādhipatiścaiva magadhādhipatistathā
verses.translation: After killing the entire army in the battle, the son of Jamadagni, of great strength, rushed at Karttavlrya like the fire at the time of final annihilation.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the entire army in the battle, the son of Jamadagni, of great strength, rushed at Karttavlrya like the fire at the time of final annihilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the entire army in the battle, the son of Jamadagni, of great strength, rushed at Karttavlrya like the fire at the time of final annihilation.

verses.sanskrit: आययुः समरे योद्धं भार्गवेद्रेण भूपते । वर्षन्तः शरजालानि नानायुद्धविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: āyayuḥ samare yoddhaṃ bhārgavedreṇa bhūpate / varṣantaḥ śarajālāni nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: Rama, the powerful warrior, fought with them con- tinuously for three days. By means of his exploit, it was easy for him to cut down twelve Akfauhinis of soldiers in no time.
verses.wordMeaning: Rama, the powerful warrior, fought with them con- tinuously for three days. By means of his exploit, it was easy for him to cut down twelve Akfauhinis of soldiers in no time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, the powerful warrior, fought with them con- tinuously for three days. By means of his exploit, it was easy for him to cut down twelve Akfauhinis of soldiers in no time.

verses.sanskrit: वीराभिमानिनः सर्वे हैहयस्याज्ञया तदा । पिनाकहस्तः स भृगुर्ज्वलदग्निशिखोपमः
verses.transliteration: vīrābhimāninaḥ sarve haihayasyājñayā tadā / pinākahastaḥ sa bhṛgurjvaladagniśikhopamaḥ
verses.translation: He was accompanied by a hundred thousand princes and seven Ak$auhinis of soldiers. Many of those great heroic warriors were roaring like thunderous clouds and shaking the earth, O king. They fought with Bhargava.
verses.wordMeaning: He was accompanied by a hundred thousand princes and seven Ak$auhinis of soldiers. Many of those great heroic warriors were roaring like thunderous clouds and shaking the earth, O king. They fought with Bhargava.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was accompanied by a hundred thousand princes and seven Ak$auhinis of soldiers. Many of those great heroic warriors were roaring like thunderous clouds and shaking the earth, O king. They fought with Bhargava.

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षेप नागपाशं च आभिमन्त्र्य शरोत्तमम् । तदस्त्रं भार्गवे द्रेण क्षिप्तं संग्राममूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: cikṣepa nāgapāśaṃ ca ābhimantrya śarottamam / tadastraṃ bhārgave dreṇa kṣiptaṃ saṃgrāmamūrddhani
verses.translation: On seeing that missile which had the lustre of a hundred suns hurled by the intelligent Rama, Sucandra got down from his chariot and bowed to it.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that missile which had the lustre of a hundred suns hurled by the intelligent Rama, Sucandra got down from his chariot and bowed to it.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that missile which had the lustre of a hundred suns hurled by the intelligent Rama, Sucandra got down from his chariot and bowed to it.

verses.sanskrit: चकर्त्त गारुडास्त्रेण सोमदत्तो महाबलः । ततः क्रुद्धो महाभागो रामः शत्रुविदारणः
verses.transliteration: cakartta gāruḍāstreṇa somadatto mahābalaḥ / tataḥ kruddho mahābhāgo rāmaḥ śatruvidāraṇaḥ
verses.translation: That missile evolved by Narayana and worthy of being worshipped by all other missiles, left him undisturbed as he bowed down thus, and went to the presence of Narayana.
verses.wordMeaning: That missile evolved by Narayana and worthy of being worshipped by all other missiles, left him undisturbed as he bowed down thus, and went to the presence of Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: That missile evolved by Narayana and worthy of being worshipped by all other missiles, left him undisturbed as he bowed down thus, and went to the presence of Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रदत्तेन शूलेन सोमदत्तं जघान ह । बृहद्बलं च गदया विदर्भं मुष्टिना तथा
verses.transliteration: rudradattena śūlena somadattaṃ jaghāna ha / bṛhadbalaṃ ca gadayā vidarbhaṃ muṣṭinā tathā
verses.translation: On seeing that great missile ineffective and the king quite hale and hearty, Rama, the slayer of enemies in battle, became surprised.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that great missile ineffective and the king quite hale and hearty, Rama, the slayer of enemies in battle, became surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that great missile ineffective and the king quite hale and hearty, Rama, the slayer of enemies in battle, became surprised.

verses.sanskrit: मैथिलं मुद्गरेणैव शक्त्या च निषधाधिपम् । मागधञ्चरणाघातैरस्त्रजालेन सैनिकान्
verses.transliteration: maithilaṃ mudgareṇaiva śaktyā ca niṣadhādhipam / māgadhañcaraṇāghātairastrajālena sainikān
verses.translation: Then, out of anger, Rama hurled the javelin, the iron rod, the iron mace and a spear with sharp edge, the club and the axe at the head of the king,
verses.wordMeaning: Then, out of anger, Rama hurled the javelin, the iron rod, the iron mace and a spear with sharp edge, the club and the axe at the head of the king,
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, out of anger, Rama hurled the javelin, the iron rod, the iron mace and a spear with sharp edge, the club and the axe at the head of the king,

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य निखिलां सेनां संहाराग्निसमीरणे । दुद्राव कार्त्तवीर्यं च जामदग्न्यो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: nihatya nikhilāṃ senāṃ saṃhārāgnisamīraṇe / dudrāva kārttavīryaṃ ca jāmadagnyo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Bow to Kali, to the goddess who holds a digit of

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं योद्धुमायान्तं राजानो ऽन्ये महारथाः । कार्य्याकार्यविधानज्ञाः पृष्टे कृत्वा च हैहयम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ yoddhumāyāntaṃ rājāno 'nye mahārathāḥ / kāryyākāryavidhānajñāḥ pṛṣṭe kṛtvā ca haihayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the bestower of grace and charm of good learning, to the mother of the universe; to #the goddess who has killed all enemies, to the goddess having the face of a stork, to the bestower of vast happiness, to the goddess who killed different types of Asuras and Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: रामेण युयुधुश्चैव दर्शयन्तश्च सौहृदम् । कान्यकुब्जाश्च शतशः सौराष्ट्रावन्तयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa yuyudhuścaiva darśayantaśca sauhṛdam / kānyakubjāśca śataśaḥ saurāṣṭrāvantayastathā
verses.translation: Hail to the goddess whose creeper-like hands are embellished (by the gestures of) granting boons and freedoms from fear; to the goddess who is bowed down by all the gods (i.e. Devas); to the goddess who has yellow robes, who goes as fast as the wind, who bestows splendid things and who is eulo- gised by oiva.
verses.hindi: ये ।5। सौ अक्षौहिणी सेनाओं के झण्डों की सालाएँ फहरा रही थीं और उस सेना में बड़े ऊचे अश्व ये तथा मदमत्त हाथो भी उसमें ये ।६। बह सेना ऐसो थो कि उसमें हिनहिनाने वाले अश्वों की धूम थी तथा उसमें चोखते हुए भरों का समुदाय भो था--एवं बड़े-बड़े विशालकाय हाथी थे
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the goddess whose creeper-like hands are embellished (by the gestures of) granting boons and freedoms from fear; to the goddess who is bowed down by all the gods (i.e. Devas); to the goddess who has yellow robes, who goes as fast as the wind,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the goddess whose creeper-like hands are embellished (by the gestures of) granting boons and freedoms from fear; to the goddess who is bowed down by all the gods (i.e. Devas); to the goddess who has yellow robes, who goes as fast as the wind,…

verses.sanskrit: चक्रुश्च शरजालानि रामस्य च समन्ततः । शरजालावृतस्तेषां रामः संग्राममूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: cakruśca śarajālāni rāmasya ca samantataḥ / śarajālāvṛtasteṣāṃ rāmaḥ saṃgrāmamūrddhani
verses.translation: Bow to the goddess who goes about on a lion (lit. the enemy of an elephant), who imbibes the juice of the fresh sugarcane, who has shining briliance in her limbs resem- bling the blue mountain, whose steps are quick, who has the name Lalita, who is the suzerain of the Devas and who is an ocean of mercy.
verses.hindi: और गर्जना करते हुए रथों का समुदाय था ऐसी वह सेना वहाँ से रवाना हुईं थी ।१०। रयों के पहियों से खुदी हुईं पृथ्वी की रेणु से जिसकी कान्ति ढक गयी थी ऐसा सूर्य उस समय में ऐसा ही दिखलाई दे रहा था मानों तुहिनासार से ढक गया हो अर्थात् कुहरा में छिप गया होवे ।११। यह पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to the goddess who goes about on a lion (lit. the enemy of an elephant), who imbibes the juice of the fresh sugarcane, who has shining briliance in her limbs resem- bling the blue mountain, whose steps are quick, who has the name Lalita,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to the goddess who goes about on a lion (lit. the enemy of an elephant), who imbibes the juice of the fresh sugarcane, who has shining briliance in her limbs resem- bling the blue mountain, whose steps are quick, who has the name Lalita,…

verses.sanskrit: न चादृश्यत राजेन्द्र तदा स त्वकृतव्रणः । सस्मार रामचरितं यदुक्तं हरिणेन वै
verses.transliteration: na cādṛśyata rājendra tadā sa tvakṛtavraṇaḥ / sasmāra rāmacaritaṃ yaduktaṃ hariṇena vai
verses.translation: Obeisance to the goddess who has tremulous eyes* who is devoid of destruction, whose lotus-like feet are beauti- fied by means of red-lac juice, whose name is Rama, who is deeply enamoured of Rati (sensuous pleasures), who dispels all ailments and who has created everything.
verses.hindi: विश्व का मंडल ही भूलि से परिपूर्ण हो गया था । उस सेना के नि्गेमन की कठोर ध्वनि से चारों ओर घोष ही घोष व्याप्त हो रहा था ।१२। उस समय में धूलि के ऐसे जाल छा गये थे कि समस्त देत्यों के सेनिक इस धूलिसे समाक्रान्त हो गये ये अर्थात् सभी धूलि से भर गये थे। अतएव इयत्ता से
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the goddess who has tremulous eyes* who is devoid of destruction, whose lotus-like feet are beauti- fied by means of red-lac juice, whose name is Rama, who is deeply enamoured of Rati (sensuous pleasures), who dispels all ailments and who has created everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the goddess who has tremulous eyes* who is devoid of destruction, whose lotus-like feet are beauti- fied by means of red-lac juice, whose name is Rama, who is deeply enamoured of Rati (sensuous pleasures), who dispels all ailments and who has created everything.

verses.sanskrit: कुशलं भार्गवेन्द्रस्य याचमानो हरिं मुनिः । एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रामः शस्त्रास्त्रकोविदः
verses.transliteration: kuśalaṃ bhārgavendrasya yācamāno hariṃ muniḥ / etasminneva kāle tu rāmaḥ śastrāstrakovidaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you who bestow kingdoms, who is eager to meet her lover, who has lustre of jewels and whose robes are fascinating. Obeisance, obeisance to you in front, obeisance to you at the sides, beneath and above. Obeisance to you from all sides.
verses.hindi: उसकी संब्या भी परिभावित थी ।१३। उस सेना में बहुत प्रकार की ध्वजायें थीं जो मीन तथा व्याल आदि से चित्रित हो रही थीं । वे सभी सेनाए उस धूलि से परिपूर्ण जाल में महोदधि में मत्स्यों के तुल्य चल रही थी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you who bestow kingdoms, who is eager to meet her lover, who has lustre of jewels and whose robes are fascinating. Obeisance, obeisance to you in front, obeisance to you at the sides, beneath and above. Obeisance to you from all sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you who bestow kingdoms, who is eager to meet her lover, who has lustre of jewels and whose robes are fascinating. Obeisance, obeisance to you in front, obeisance to you at the sides, beneath and above. Obeisance to you from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: विधूय शरजालानि वायव्यास्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् । उदतिष्ठद्रणाकाङ्क्षी नीहारादिव भास्करः
verses.transliteration: vidhūya śarajālāni vāyavyāstreṇa mantravit / udatiṣṭhadraṇākāṅkṣī nīhārādiva bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.transliteration: trirātraṃ samare rāmastaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuyudhe balī / dvādaśākṣauhiṇīstatra ciccheda laghuvikramaḥ

verses.transliteration: rambhāstambhavanaṃ yadvat paraśvadhavarāyudhaḥ / sarvāṃstānbhūpavargāṃśca tadīyaśca mahācamūḥ

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vinihatāṃ tena rāmeṇa sumahātmanā / ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ sucandraḥ sūryavaṃśajaḥ

verses.transliteration: kaṃpayanto bhuvaṃ rājan yuyudhurbhārgaveṇa ca / teḥ prayuktāni śastrāṇi mahāstrāṇi ca bhūpate
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: क्षणेन नाशयामास भार्गवेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् । गृहीत्वा परशुं दिव्यं कालातकयमोपमम्
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇena nāśayāmāsa bhārgavendraḥ pratāpavān / gṛhītvā paraśuṃ divyaṃ kālātakayamopamam
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: जिस सअय में इतनी विशाल सेनाए' घावा करने के लिए ललिता देवी के सैनिक की ओर आ रहो यों तो सभी देवगण शक्तियों कें भङ्ग की शंका से डर गये थे ।११। वे करंक जिनमें प्रमुख था पाँचों सेनापति गण बहुत ही उद्धत ये । उन्होंने सपिणी नाम वाली एक महती माया को उस
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: कालयन्सकला सेनां चिच्छेद भुगुनन्दनः । कर्षकस्तु यथा क्षेत्रे पक्वं धान्यं तथा तृणम्
verses.transliteration: kālayansakalā senāṃ ciccheda bhugunandanaḥ / karṣakastu yathā kṣetre pakvaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā tṛṇam
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: समर स्यल में किया था ।१६। उनके द्वारा उठी हुई वह दुष्टा रणशाम्वरी सपिणी धूसर वर्ण की थी । उसके होठ भो घूज्र वर्ण के ही थे ओर धूम्र ही उसके पयोधर थे ।१७। बह महासागर के हो तुल्य अत्यन्त गम्भीर कुहर उदर वाली थी । वह रणस्थल में मन को भयभीत करती हुई ही शक्तियों
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: निशेषयति दात्रेण तथा रामेण तत्कृतम् । लक्षराजन्यसैन्यं तददृष्ट्वा रामेण दारितम्
verses.transliteration: niśeṣayati dātreṇa tathā rāmeṇa tatkṛtam / lakṣarājanyasainyaṃ tadadṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa dāritam
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: के आगे चली थी ।१८। बह बहुत से सपों के भूषण वाली दूसरी कडू के ही समान थी और बहुत हो दुष्टा ची । वह माया से परिपूर्ण सपो के जनन का स्थान थो ।१९। सेनापतियों के नासोर में महीतल को वेल्लित करती हुई बह जा रही थी  उराका महान घोर शब्द था जिसको वह कर रही थी
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: सुचन्द्रः पृथिवीपालो युयुधे संगरे नृप । तावुभौ तत्र संक्षुब्धौ नानाशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदौ
verses.transliteration: sucandraḥ pṛthivīpālo yuyudhe saṃgare nṛpa / tāvubhau tatra saṃkṣubdhau nānāśastrāstrakovidau
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: और प्रायः उसने उस चक्र को वेल्लित सा कर दिया था।२०। वे पाँचों सेनापति भी पञ्चत्व (मृत्यु) के ही कामुक थे और वे कर'क आदि सब बहुत ही दुरात्मा थे । उसी भाँति से माया के साथ पूर्व में सब असुरेन्द्र अजित हो रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.transliteration: yuyudhāte mahāvīrau munīśanṛpatīśvarau / rāmo 'smai yāni śastrāṇi cikṣepāstrāṇi cāpi hi

verses.hindi: जिनमें बहुत दी चञ्चल दो जीभे लपलपा रहा थी और वे विषों को उस शक्तियों की सेना में फेला रहे थे ।३२। उन सर्पों के दो-दो मुख घूम्रवर्ण के थे और वे सपं बहुत ही अधिक भयंकर थे । उस सपिणी के दोनों नेत्रों से के समुत्यित हुए थे और महान् क्रोध से दीपित थे ।३३। उन सर्प के पीतवर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: सदा च सर्वत्र नमो नमस्ते नमो नमस्ते ऽखिलविग्रहायै । प्रसीद देवेशि मम प्रतिज्ञां पुरा कृतां पालय भद्रकालि
verses.transliteration: sadā ca sarvatra namo namaste namo namaste 'khilavigrahāyai / prasīda deveśi mama pratijñāṃ purā kṛtāṃ pālaya bhadrakāli
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: थे तथा तीन-तीन फण ये। उनको दाढ़ों से उनके मुख बहुत ही विकट ये । उस सर्पिजी के कानों के कुहरों से करोड़ों ही सपं उत्थित हो गये ये
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव जगत्त्रयस्यापि नमो नमस्ते । वसिष्ठ उवाच एवं स्तुता तदा देवी भद्रकाली तरस्विनी
verses.transliteration: tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva jagattrayasyāpi namo namaste / vasiṣṭha uvāca evaṃ stutā tadā devī bhadrakālī tarasvinī
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: बे आगे और पूछो मेणा से समन्वित मुखो को धारण करने वाले थे। आस्याद और नीले शरीरों वाले उस सपिणी के सर्प हुए ये
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भार्गवं प्रीता वरदानकृतोत्सवा । भद्रकाल्युवाच वत्स राम महाभाग प्रीतास्मि तव सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhārgavaṃ prītā varadānakṛtotsavā / bhadrakālyuvāca vatsa rāma mahābhāga prītāsmi tava sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: वरं वरय मत्तो यस्त्वया चाभ्यर्थिता हृदि । राम उवाच मातर्यदि वरो देयस्त्वया मे भक्तव त्सले
verses.transliteration: varaṃ varaya matto yastvayā cābhyarthitā hṛdi / rāma uvāca mātaryadi varo deyastvayā me bhaktava tsale
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: तत्सुचन्द्रं जये युद्धे तवानुग्रहभाजनम् । इति मे ऽभिहितं देवि कुरु प्रीतेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: tatsucandraṃ jaye yuddhe tavānugrahabhājanam / iti me 'bhihitaṃ devi kuru prītena cetasā
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: येन केनाप्युपायेन जगन्मातर्नमो ऽस्तु ते । भद्रकाल्युवाच आग्नेयास्त्रेण राजेन्द्रं सुचन्द्रं नय मद्गृहम्
verses.transliteration: yena kenāpyupāyena jaganmātarnamo 'stu te / bhadrakālyuvāca āgneyāstreṇa rājendraṃ sucandraṃ naya madgṛham
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: ममातिप्रियमद्यैव पार्षदो मे भवत्वयम् । वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्तमाकर्ण्य स भार्गवेन्द्रो देव्याः प्रियं कर्तुमथोद्यतो ऽभूत्
verses.transliteration: mamātipriyamadyaiva pārṣado me bhavatvayam / vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktamākarṇya sa bhārgavendro devyāḥ priyaṃ kartumathodyato 'bhūt
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: प्राणान्नियम्याचमनं च कृत्वा सुचन्द्रमुद्दिश्य च तत्समादधे । अस्त्रं प्रयुक्तं नृपतेर्वधाय रामेण राजन् प्रसभं तदा तत्
verses.transliteration: prāṇānniyamyācamanaṃ ca kṛtvā sucandramuddiśya ca tatsamādadhe / astraṃ prayuktaṃ nṛpatervadhāya rāmeṇa rājan prasabhaṃ tadā tat
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध्वा वपुर्भूतमयं तदीयं निनाय लोकं परदेवतायाः । ततस्तु रामेण कृतप्रणामा सा भद्रकालो जगदादिकर्त्री
verses.transliteration: dagdhvā vapurbhūtamayaṃ tadīyaṃ nināya lokaṃ paradevatāyāḥ / tatastu rāmeṇa kṛtapraṇāmā sā bhadrakālo jagadādikartrī
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: और अन्य-अन्य वर्ण तथा बल से युक्त-चार मुखों वाले-चार पदों बाले उस सपिणी के नासिका के विवर से अत्यन्त उग्र कान्त वाले उद्गत हो गये थे ।३६। लम्बे महासर्प से समावृत स्थूल पयोधरों से और उसकी नाभि के कुण्ड से बहुत से रक्त इरण वाले तथा भयानक उत्पन्न हुए थे
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हिताभूदथ जामदग्न्यस्तस्थौ रणेभूपवधाभिकाङ्क्षी
verses.transliteration: antarhitābhūdatha jāmadagnyastasthau raṇebhūpavadhābhikāṅkṣī
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.hindi: जो स्पे हालाहल को अपने मुखों से बहा रहे थे । ऐसे पन्नगाधिप समु त्पित हो गये थे। बे सब उस शक्तियों की सेना के सैनिकों का दर्शन कर रहे थे ही अग्नियों से दहन कर रहे थे ।३८। वे अपने भोग के पाशों से ध रहे थे और फ्णो के मण्डलों से निहनन भी कर रहे थे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to you everywhere and at all times. Bows to you whose body is identified with everything, O goddess of the Devas, be pleased O Bhadrakali, keep my vow taken formcily (see that it is realised).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते एकोनचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ३९॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच सुचन्द्रे पतिते राजन् राजेन्द्राणां शिरोमणौ । तत्पुत्रः पुष्कराक्षस्तु रामं योद्धुमथागतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ekonacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 39// vasiṣṭha uvāca sucandre patite rājan rājendrāṇāṃ śiromaṇau / tatputraḥ puṣkarākṣastu rāmaṃ yoddhumathāgataḥ
verses.translation: "When the crest-jewel of leading kings, Sucandra fell, his son Puskaraksa came forward to fight with Rama.
verses.hindi: ये ललिता की सेना को अत्यन्त ही समाकुल कर रहे थे।३६। यद्यपि वे शक्तियों के शस्त्रों के द्वारा जो करोड़ों ही थे बारम्बार काटे भी जा रहे थे तो भी काम कर रहे थे ।४०। वे ऊपर-ऊपर में सपिण्ड प्रविसर्पी बढ़ रहे च। उनमें बहुत से सर्प नष्ट हो जाया करते हैं तथापि वे पुनः समुत्पन्न हो
verses.wordMeaning: "When the crest-jewel of leading kings, Sucandra fell, his son Puskaraksa came forward to fight with Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: "When the crest-jewel of leading kings, Sucandra fell, his son Puskaraksa came forward to fight with Rama.

verses.sanskrit: स रथस्थो महावीर्यः सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदः । अभिवीक्ष्य रणेत्युग्रं रामं कालातकोपमम्
verses.transliteration: sa rathastho mahāvīryaḥ sarvaśastrāstrakovidaḥ / abhivīkṣya raṇetyugraṃ rāmaṃ kālātakopamam
verses.translation: After suddenly extricating himself from the bondage of arrows, the extremely powerful leader of the family of Bhrgu, surveyed all round, O great king.
verses.hindi: जाते हैं और दूसरे भी पैदा हो जाया करते हैं ।४१। जब एक का नाश का समय होता है तो अन्य बहुत से पैदा हो जाया करते हैं। कारण यही था कि जो मूल भूता सपिणी थी जिससे वे सब पैदा होते थे वह नष्ट नहीं होती है । अतः उससे बराबर सर्प समुत्पन्न होते चले जाते थे
verses.wordMeaning: After suddenly extricating himself from the bondage of arrows, the extremely powerful leader of the family of Bhrgu, surveyed all round, O great king.
verses.commentary: Sense: After suddenly extricating himself from the bondage of arrows, the extremely powerful leader of the family of Bhrgu, surveyed all round, O great king.

verses.sanskrit: चकार शरजालं च भार्गवेन्द्रस्य सर्वतः । मुहूर्त्तं जामदग्न्यो ऽपि बाणैः संझदितो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: cakāra śarajālaṃ ca bhārgavendrasya sarvataḥ / muhūrttaṃ jāmadagnyo 'pi bāṇaiḥ saṃjhadito 'bhavat
verses.translation: On seeing Puskaraksa the son of Sucandra, Rama was filled with rage, and he resembled the fire that would burn everything.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Puskaraksa the son of Sucandra, Rama was filled with rage, and he resembled the fire that would burn everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Puskaraksa the son of Sucandra, Rama was filled with rage, and he resembled the fire that would burn everything.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निष्कम्य सहसा भार्गवेन्द्रो महाबलः । शरबन्धान्महाराज समुदैक्षत सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tato niṣkamya sahasā bhārgavendro mahābalaḥ / śarabandhānmahārāja samudaikṣata sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Filled with great anger, he discharged the Varuna missile (i.e. one with Varuna for its deity). Then clouds rose up rumbling and roaring with terrible noise.
verses.wordMeaning: Filled with great anger, he discharged the Varuna missile (i.e. one with Varuna for its deity). Then clouds rose up rumbling and roaring with terrible noise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Filled with great anger, he discharged the Varuna missile (i.e. one with Varuna for its deity). Then clouds rose up rumbling and roaring with terrible noise.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं पुष्काराक्षं तु सुचन्द्रतनयं तदा । क्रोधमाहारयामास दिधक्षन्निव पावकः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ puṣkārākṣaṃ tu sucandratanayaṃ tadā / krodhamāhārayāmāsa didhakṣanniva pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: Flooding the Earth, O king, with heavy down-pours of water, they showered continuously. Puskaraksa of great vigour discharged the Vayaviya missile (one with the wind-god for its deity).
verses.wordMeaning: Flooding the Earth, O king, with heavy down-pours of water, they showered continuously. Puskaraksa of great vigour discharged the Vayaviya missile (one with the wind-god for its deity).
verses.commentary: Sense: Flooding the Earth, O king, with heavy down-pours of water, they showered continuously. Puskaraksa of great vigour discharged the Vayaviya missile (one with the wind-god for its deity).

verses.sanskrit: स क्रोधेन समाविष्टो वारुणं समवासृजत् । ततो मेघाः समुत्पन्ना गर्जन्तो भैरवान्नवान्
verses.transliteration: sa krodhena samāviṣṭo vāruṇaṃ samavāsṛjat / tato meghāḥ samutpannā garjanto bhairavānnavān
verses.translation: Thereupon, the clouds vanished immediately. Then extremely infuriated Rama discharged the Brahma missile (one with Brahma for its deity).
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the clouds vanished immediately. Then extremely infuriated Rama discharged the Brahma missile (one with Brahma for its deity).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the clouds vanished immediately. Then extremely infuriated Rama discharged the Brahma missile (one with Brahma for its deity).

verses.sanskrit: ववृषुर्जलधाराभिः प्लावयन्तो धरां नृप । पुष्कराक्षो महावीर्यो वायव्यास्त्रुमवासृजत्
verses.transliteration: vavṛṣurjaladhārābhiḥ plāvayanto dharāṃ nṛpa / puṣkarākṣo mahāvīryo vāyavyāstrumavāsṛjat
verses.translation: When the pieces fell down, at that time, great sur- prise was caused to men who were watching it as well as to the heaven-dwellers in the firmament.
verses.wordMeaning: When the pieces fell down, at that time, great sur- prise was caused to men who were watching it as well as to the heaven-dwellers in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the pieces fell down, at that time, great sur- prise was caused to men who were watching it as well as to the heaven-dwellers in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ते ऽदर्शनं नीताः सद्य एव बलाहकाः । अथ रामो भृशं क्रुद्धो ब्राह्मं तत्राभिसंदधे
verses.transliteration: tena te 'darśanaṃ nītāḥ sadya eva balāhakāḥ / atha rāmo bhṛśaṃ kruddho brāhmaṃ tatrābhisaṃdadhe
verses.translation: After slaying Puskaraksa of great strength, out of anger he burned down his army like the furiously blazing fire that burns down the forest.
verses.hindi: इसीलिये उसके शरीर से समुत्पन्न सर्पों के नाश होने पर भी दूसरे
verses.wordMeaning: After slaying Puskaraksa of great strength, out of anger he burned down his army like the furiously blazing fire that burns down the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: After slaying Puskaraksa of great strength, out of anger he burned down his army like the furiously blazing fire that burns down the forest.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्कराक्षो ऽपि तेनैव विचकर्ष महाबलः । ब्राह्म सो ऽप्याहितं दृष्ट्वा दण्डाहत इवारगः
verses.transliteration: puṣkarākṣo 'pi tenaiva vicakarṣa mahābalaḥ / brāhma so 'pyāhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍāhata ivāragaḥ
verses.translation: Wherever the leader of the members of the family of Bhrgu rushed with the prowess and velocity of the mind and the wind, striking with his axe, horses, chariots, elephants and men fell down in their hundreds with their limbs cut off.
verses.hindi: अन्य सर्पो की समृत्पत्ति हो जाया करती थी । उनके विषाग्नि से शक्तियों की सेनाओं के शरीर दह्यमान हो रहे ये और रण में वे दुःख से विष्लत थे। उन भोगियों के द्वारा शक्तियों के चक्र किकत्तंब्य विमूह गे टो गरे गै ।४३-४४। उन पाँचों दानवों ने बहुत तरह का पराक्रम किण था। वहू
verses.wordMeaning: Wherever the leader of the members of the family of Bhrgu rushed with the prowess and velocity of the mind and the wind, striking with his axe, horses, chariots, elephants and men fell down in their hundreds with their limbs cut off.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever the leader of the members of the family of Bhrgu rushed with the prowess and velocity of the mind and the wind, striking with his axe, horses, chariots, elephants and men fell down in their hundreds with their limbs cut off.

verses.sanskrit: घोरं परशुमादाय निःश्वसंस्तमधावत । रामस्याधावतस्तत्र पुष्कराक्षो धनुर्धरः
verses.transliteration: ghoraṃ paraśumādāya niḥśvasaṃstamadhāvata / rāmasyādhāvatastatra puṣkarākṣo dhanurdharaḥ
verses.translation: The entire army of Puskaraksa consisting of many families of kings and nine Aksauhinis of soldiers, was struck down within a short while by Bhargava. It became highly distressed with all the leaders killed.'
verses.hindi: करीन्द्री सैकड़ों गद॒भों से युक्त एक रथ पर समास्थित था ।४५। उसने अपने चक्क के दारा जिसकी बहुत ही अधिक तीक्ष्णधार थी शक्ति सेना का मर्दन किया था । और एक अन्य वजदन्त नामक भण्डासुर का सेनापति था
verses.wordMeaning: The entire army of Puskaraksa consisting of many families of kings and nine Aksauhinis of soldiers, was struck down within a short while by Bhargava. It became highly distressed with all the leaders killed.'
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire army of Puskaraksa consisting of many families of kings and nine Aksauhinis of soldiers, was struck down within a short while by Bhargava. It became highly distressed with all the leaders killed.'

verses.sanskrit: संदधे पञ्चविशिखान्दीप्तास्यानुरगानिव । एकैकेन च बाणेन हृदि शीर्षे भुजद्वये
verses.transliteration: saṃdadhe pañcaviśikhāndīptāsyānuragāniva / ekaikena ca bāṇena hṛdi śīrṣe bhujadvaye
verses.translation: When Puskaraksa fell, Arjuna ( the son of Krtavlrya) himself, of great power and vigour came there seated on a golden chariot.
verses.hindi: बज्ञवाण के अभिधात के द्वारा उष्ट्र से उसने रण किया था । इसके पश्चात् वजमुख एक अधिक बड़े चक्रिवान् पर समवस्थित था ।४७। वह समारोहण करके भाले की धाराओं से वह शक्तियों की सेना का मर्दन करता था। एक अन्य वदन्त नामक सेनापति बहुत ही बलवान् था ।४०। दो गृधो के
verses.wordMeaning: When Puskaraksa fell, Arjuna ( the son of Krtavlrya) himself, of great power and vigour came there seated on a golden chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Puskaraksa fell, Arjuna ( the son of Krtavlrya) himself, of great power and vigour came there seated on a golden chariot.

verses.sanskrit: शिखायां च क्रमाद्भित्त्वा तस्तंभ भृश मातुरम् । स चैवं पीडीतो रामः पुष्कराक्षेण संयुगे
verses.transliteration: śikhāyāṃ ca kramādbhittvā tastaṃbha bhṛśa māturam / sa caivaṃ pīḍīto rāmaḥ puṣkarākṣeṇa saṃyuge
verses.translation: His hundred sons were extremely powerful and great experts in warfare. They arranged the armies in different Vytihas (battle-arrays) at the behest of their father and stood by in the battlefield.
verses.hindi: रथ पर वह समारूढ़ था और वाणों के द्वारा सेना का निहनन कर रहा चा । बे सेनापति अत्यन्त दुष्ट ये और उनके द्वारा युद्ध में सेना को प्रोत्साहन दिया गया था
verses.wordMeaning: His hundred sons were extremely powerful and great experts in warfare. They arranged the armies in different Vytihas (battle-arrays) at the behest of their father and stood by in the battlefield.
verses.commentary: Sense: His hundred sons were extremely powerful and great experts in warfare. They arranged the armies in different Vytihas (battle-arrays) at the behest of their father and stood by in the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं स्थित्वा भृशं धावन्परशुं मूर्ध्न्यपतयात् । शिखामारभ्य पादान्तं पुथ्कराक्षं द्विधाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā bhṛśaṃ dhāvanparaśuṃ mūrdhnyapatayāt / śikhāmārabhya pādāntaṃ puthkarākṣaṃ dvidhākarot
verses.translation: On seeing Rama equipped with the brilliance of Yama, the god of death and destruction (at the nd of the world ) in the battlefield, Karttavirya, the powerful king, began to fight in earnest.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Rama equipped with the brilliance of Yama, the god of death and destruction (at the nd of the world ) in the battlefield, Karttavirya, the powerful king, began to fight in earnest.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Rama equipped with the brilliance of Yama, the god of death and destruction (at the nd of the world ) in the battlefield, Karttavirya, the powerful king, began to fight in earnest.

verses.sanskrit: पतिते शकले भूमौ तत्कालं पश्यता नृणाम् । आश्चर्यं सुमाहज्जातं दिवि चैव दिवौ कसाम्
verses.transliteration: patite śakale bhūmau tatkālaṃ paśyatā nṛṇām / āścaryaṃ sumāhajjātaṃ divi caiva divau kasām
verses.translation: Bent on vanquishing the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, he held up five hundred arrows in the right hands and five hundred bows in the left hands.
verses.wordMeaning: Bent on vanquishing the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, he held up five hundred arrows in the right hands and five hundred bows in the left hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bent on vanquishing the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, he held up five hundred arrows in the right hands and five hundred bows in the left hands.

verses.sanskrit: विदार्य रामस्तं क्रोधात्पुष्कराक्ष महाबलम् । तत्सैन्यमदहत्क्रुद्धः पावको विपिनं यथा
verses.transliteration: vidārya rāmastaṃ krodhātpuṣkarākṣa mahābalam / tatsainyamadahatkruddhaḥ pāvako vipinaṃ yathā
verses.translation: O heroic king, he showered volley of arrows on Rama, just as the cluster of clouds pours down on a mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: O heroic king, he showered volley of arrows on Rama, just as the cluster of clouds pours down on a mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O heroic king, he showered volley of arrows on Rama, just as the cluster of clouds pours down on a mountain.

verses.sanskrit: यतो यतो धावति भार्गवेन्द्रो मनो ऽनिलौजाः प्रहरन्परश्वधम् । ततस्ततो वाजिरथेभमानवा निकृत्तगात्राः शतशो निपेतुः
verses.transliteration: yato yato dhāvati bhārgavendro mano 'nilaujāḥ praharanparaśvadham / tatastato vājirathebhamānavā nikṛttagātrāḥ śataśo nipetuḥ
verses.translation: Being honoured in the battlefields by that shower of arrows, the delighter of the family of Bhrgu seized his own divine bow and discharged showers of arrows.
verses.wordMeaning: Being honoured in the battlefields by that shower of arrows, the delighter of the family of Bhrgu seized his own divine bow and discharged showers of arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being honoured in the battlefields by that shower of arrows, the delighter of the family of Bhrgu seized his own divine bow and discharged showers of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: रामेण तत्रा तिबलेन संगरे निहन्यमानास्तु परश्वधेन । हा तात मातस्त्विति जल्पमांना भस्मीबभूवुः सुविचूर्णितास्तदा
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa tatrā tibalena saṃgare nihanyamānāstu paraśvadhena / hā tāta mātastviti jalpamāṃnā bhasmībabhūvuḥ suvicūrṇitāstadā
verses.translation: Both of them viz. Bhargava and Haihaya were equally proud (of their ability in) battle and they were enga- ged in an unparalleled tumultuous fight that caused horripila- tion to the beholder.
verses.wordMeaning: Both of them viz. Bhargava and Haihaya were equally proud (of their ability in) battle and they were enga- ged in an unparalleled tumultuous fight that caused horripila- tion to the beholder.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of them viz. Bhargava and Haihaya were equally proud (of their ability in) battle and they were enga- ged in an unparalleled tumultuous fight that caused horripila- tion to the beholder.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्त्तमात्रेण च भार्गवेण तत्पुष्कराक्षस्य बलं समग्रम् । अनेकराजन्यकुलं हतेश्वरं इतं नवाक्षौहिणिकं भृशातुरम्
verses.transliteration: muhūrttamātreṇa ca bhārgaveṇa tatpuṣkarākṣasya balaṃ samagram / anekarājanyakulaṃ hateśvaraṃ itaṃ navākṣauhiṇikaṃ bhṛśāturam
verses.translation: For killing the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, that powerful king holding all kinds of weapons and miraculous missiles, fitted the Brahmastra (the miraculous missile having* Brahma for its deity).
verses.wordMeaning: For killing the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, that powerful king holding all kinds of weapons and miraculous missiles, fitted the Brahmastra (the miraculous missile having* Brahma for its deity).
verses.commentary: Sense: For killing the leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, that powerful king holding all kinds of weapons and miraculous missiles, fitted the Brahmastra (the miraculous missile having* Brahma for its deity).

verses.sanskrit: पतिते पुष्कराक्षे तु कार्त्तवीर्यार्जुनः स्वयम् । आजगाम महावीर्यः सुवर्णरथमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: patite puṣkarākṣe tu kārttavīryārjunaḥ svayam / ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ suvarṇarathamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: It was I who incarnated in the primordial Sarga (creation) for the purpose of granting you boons. Now I have come to kill you. Take courage in your mind. There should be no discussion at all on grief at the time of battle. All the people experience good and bad effects of their own actions brought about by fate, when the fruit of the actions become ripe. No one can bring about any reversal of this good and evil, O Ruler of men.
verses.wordMeaning: It was I who incarnated in the primordial Sarga (creation) for the purpose of granting you boons. Now I have come to kill you. Take courage in your mind. There should be no discussion at all on grief at the time of battle.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was I who incarnated in the primordial Sarga (creation) for the purpose of granting you boons. Now I have come to kill you. Take courage in your mind. There should be no discussion at all on grief at the time of battle.…

verses.sanskrit: नानाशस्त्रसमाकीर्णं नानारत्नपरिच्छदम् । दशनल्वप्रमाणं च शतवाजियुतं नृपः
verses.transliteration: nānāśastrasamākīrṇaṃ nānāratnaparicchadam / daśanalvapramāṇaṃ ca śatavājiyutaṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Aiming it at Rama, he hurled it with his entire strength. The trident fell on the head of Bhargava, O lord of the Earth.
verses.wordMeaning: Aiming it at Rama, he hurled it with his entire strength. The trident fell on the head of Bhargava, O lord of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aiming it at Rama, he hurled it with his entire strength. The trident fell on the head of Bhargava, O lord of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: युते बाहुसहस्रेण नानायुधधरेण च । बभौ स्वर्लोकमारोक्ष्यन्देहति सुकृती यथा
verses.transliteration: yute bāhusahasreṇa nānāyudhadhareṇa ca / babhau svarlokamārokṣyandehati sukṛtī yathā
verses.translation: When Bhargava fell there, all the Devas became agitated due to fear. Keeping Brahma, Visnu and Mahe£vara in front they all came there.
verses.hindi: सौ अक्षौहिणी सेना का एक ही हेला से निपतन हो गया था । बह् सर्पिणी बहुत ही दुष्ट आचार बाली थी और बहुत-सी मायाओं के परिग्रह बाली भी थी ।५०। वह एक-एक क्षण में करोड़ों-करोड़ों सर्पो का सूजन कर रही थी । इसके पश्चात् वह सम्पूणं सेना बेचेन हो गयी थी । ऐसा देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: When Bhargava fell there, all the Devas became agitated due to fear. Keeping Brahma, Visnu and Mahe£vara in front they all came there.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Bhargava fell there, all the Devas became agitated due to fear. Keeping Brahma, Visnu and Mahe£vara in front they all came there.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रास्तस्य महावीर्याः शतं युद्धविशारदाः । सेनाः संव्यूह्य संतस्थुः संग्रामे पितुराज्ञया
verses.transliteration: putrāstasya mahāvīryāḥ śataṃ yuddhaviśāradāḥ / senāḥ saṃvyūhya saṃtasthuḥ saṃgrāme piturājñayā
verses.translation: Lord Sankara who has great knowledge and who is the conqueror of Death, himself resuscitated Bhargava by means of the Sahjivatii Vidyd.
verses.hindi: बह--देवी बहुत ही रोष से युक्त हो गयी थी ।५१। बह नकुली गरुड पर समारुढ़ा उस रणाऊून में आ गयी थी। वह ललिता देवी के तालु से उत्पन्न हुईं थो और तपे हुए सुबर्ण के समान थी ।५२। उसका समस्त बाड्- मय आकार था और उसके दांत वच्य थे । उसने वहां पर अपना बल
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Sankara who has great knowledge and who is the conqueror of Death, himself resuscitated Bhargava by means of the Sahjivatii Vidyd.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Sankara who has great knowledge and who is the conqueror of Death, himself resuscitated Bhargava by means of the Sahjivatii Vidyd.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तवीर्यस्तु बलवान्रामं दृष्ट्वा रणाजिरे । कालान्तकयमप्रख्यं योद्धुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: kārttavīryastu balavānrāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā raṇājire / kālāntakayamaprakhyaṃ yoddhuṃ samupacakrame
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: उस सपिणी के समक्ष में सृजन किया था ।५३। वह गरुड़ भी ऐसा था जिसके बहुत उच्च अश ये ओर वह अपने पंखों से पवंतों को भो विक्षिप्त कर रहा था । वह गरुड़ उस युद्ध में चल दिया था जो साक्षात् जज़ूम सुमेर के हो समान था ।४४ सपिणी की माया से समुत्पन्न परमाधिक भयानक सर्पों
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षे पञ्चशतं बाणान्वामे पञ्चशतं धनुः । जग्रा ह भार्गवेन्द्रस्य समरे जेतुमुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: dakṣe pañcaśataṃ bāṇānvāme pañcaśataṃ dhanuḥ / jagrā ha bhārgavendrasya samare jetumudyataḥ
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: को देखकर स नकुली ने क्रोध से साल नेत्रों वाला अपना मुख खुला हुआ कर दिया था।५५। इसके पश्चात् श्री नकुली देवी की बत्तीस करोड़ सेना नकुलों की समुत्पन्न हो गयी थी और सुवणं की प्रभा वाले नकुल उत्पस्न हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: बाणवर्षं चकाराथ रामस्योपरि भूपते । यथा बलाहको वीर पर्वतोपरि वर्षति
verses.transliteration: bāṇavarṣaṃ cakārātha rāmasyopari bhūpate / yathā balāhako vīra parvatopari varṣati
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: बाणवर्षेण नेनाजौ सत्कृतो भृगुनन्दनः । जग्राह स्वघनुर्दिव्यं बाणवर्षं तथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: bāṇavarṣeṇa nenājau satkṛto bhṛgunandanaḥ / jagrāha svaghanurdivyaṃ bāṇavarṣaṃ tathākarot
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: तावुभौरणसंदृप्तौ तदा भार्गवहैहयौ । चक्रतुर्यद्धमतुलं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tāvubhauraṇasaṃdṛptau tadā bhārgavahaihayau / cakraturyaddhamatulaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मास्त्रं च सभूपालः संदधे रणमूर्द्धनि । वधाय भार्गवेन्द्रस्य सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रधृगबली
verses.transliteration: brahmāstraṃ ca sabhūpālaḥ saṃdadhe raṇamūrddhani / vadhāya bhārgavendrasya sarvaśastrāstradhṛgabalī
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि वार्युपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मं ब्राह्मय संदधे । ततो व्योम्नि सदा सक्ते द्वे चाप्य स्त्रे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi vāryupaspṛśya brahmaṃ brāhmaya saṃdadhe / tato vyomni sadā sakte dve cāpya stre narādhipa
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: ववृधाते जगत्प्रान्ते तेजसा ज्वलनार्कवत् । त्रयो लोकाः सपाताला दृष्ट्वा तन्महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: vavṛdhāte jagatprānte tejasā jvalanārkavat / trayo lokāḥ sapātālā dṛṣṭvā tanmahadadbhutam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: वे नकुल सपिणी के सपों के मण्डल को अपनी दाढ़ों ते विमदेन से उनके विषों का विनाश कर रहे थे तथा उस महान् घोर समर स्थल में इधर-उधर वे नकुल स्वर्ण के समान चमकते हुए विष का नाश करने वाले भ्रमण करने लगे थे ।५७। उन समस्त नकुलों के दोनों कान ऊपर की ओर
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलदस्त्रयुगं तप्ता मेनिरे ऽस्योपसंयमम् । रामस्तदा वीक्ष्य जगत्प्रणाशं जगन्निवासोक्तमथास्मरत्तदा
verses.transliteration: jvaladastrayugaṃ taptā menire 'syopasaṃyamam / rāmastadā vīkṣya jagatpraṇāśaṃ jagannivāsoktamathāsmarattadā
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: उठे हुए थे और क्रोध के सम्पर्क से वे अपने लोमों को उद्ध,लित कर रहे थे। इस तरह से फूले हुए अपने मु'हों को खोले हुए सर्प का विनाश करने बाले हुए थे ।५८। एक-एक माया से निमित सर्प के लिये एक-एक ही नकुल उद्गत हो गया था और ये अपने परमाधिक तीदण दांतों के द्वारा सपों के
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षा विधेयाद्य मयास्य संयमो निवारणीयः परमांशधारिणा । इति व्यवस्य प्रभुरुग्रतेजा नेत्रद्वयेनाथ तदस्त्रयुगमम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣā vidheyādya mayāsya saṃyamo nivāraṇīyaḥ paramāṃśadhāriṇā / iti vyavasya prabhurugratejā netradvayenātha tadastrayugamam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: शरीरों का खण्डन कर रहे थे ।५९। सपों के फो से निकले हुए रुधिर से नकुलों की सृक्किणियाँ लाल हो गयी थीं और वे अपनी जिह्वा से उस रुधिर को चाटते हुए स्वयं भी उस गृद्ध मैं प्लावित हो गये थे ।६०। उन नकुलों के द्वारा काटे गये उनके शरीर अत्यन्त चटुल हो गये थे और
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वातिरामं जगदाकलय्य तस्थौ क्षणं ध्यानगतो महात्मा । ध्यानप्रभावेण ततस्तु तस्य ब्रह्मास्त्रयुग्मं विगतप्रभावम्
verses.transliteration: pītvātirāmaṃ jagadākalayya tasthau kṣaṇaṃ dhyānagato mahātmā / dhyānaprabhāveṇa tatastu tasya brahmāstrayugmaṃ vigataprabhāvam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: बारम्बार सर्पो के कुण्डलित भोगों के साथ वे विचेष्टा कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: पपात भूमौ सहसाथ तत्क्षणं सर्वं जगत्स्वास्थ्यमुपाजगाम । स जामदग्न्यो महातां महीयान्स्रष्टुं तथा पालयितुं निहन्तुम्
verses.transliteration: papāta bhūmau sahasātha tatkṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsvāsthyamupājagāma / sa jāmadagnyo mahātāṃ mahīyānsraṣṭuṃ tathā pālayituṃ nihantum
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: नकुलों के समुदाय के द्वारा काटे गये सर्पो के प्राण जा चुके थे और उनके फणों के भार से निकल कर गिरी हुई मणियाँ उस समराङ्ण में चमक
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: विभुस्तथापीह निजंप्रभावं गोपायितुं लोकविधिं चकार । धनुर्द्धरः शूरतमो महस्वान्सदग्रणीः संसदि तथ्यवक्ता
verses.transliteration: vibhustathāpīha nijaṃprabhāvaṃ gopāyituṃ lokavidhiṃ cakāra / dhanurddharaḥ śūratamo mahasvānsadagraṇīḥ saṃsadi tathyavaktā
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: कलाकलापेषु कृतप्रयत्नो विद्यासु शास्त्रेषु बुधो विधिज्ञः । एवं नृलोके प्रथयन्स्वभावं सर्वाणि कल्यानि करोति नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: kalākalāpeṣu kṛtaprayatno vidyāsu śāstreṣu budho vidhijñaḥ / evaṃ nṛloke prathayansvabhāvaṃ sarvāṇi kalyāni karoti nityam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: रहीं थीं ।६२। उन नकुलों के प्रह।रों के द्वारा सर्पॉ के फणों के समुदाय से निगंत मणियों के समूहों से वे समस्त सपं उस समर स्थल में अग्नियों की ज्वालाओं के ही समान दिखलायी दे रहे ये
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे तु लोका विजितास्तु तेन रामेण राजन्यनिषूदनेन । एवं स रामः प्रथितप्रभावः प्रशामयित्वा तु तदस्त्रयुग्मम्
verses.transliteration: sarve tu lokā vijitāstu tena rāmeṇa rājanyaniṣūdanena / evaṃ sa rāmaḥ prathitaprabhāvaḥ praśāmayitvā tu tadastrayugmam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रवृत्तो निधनं प्रकर्तुं रणागणे हैहयवंशकेतोः । तुणीरतः पत्रियुगं गृहीत्वा पुङ्खे निधायाथ धनुर्ज्यकायाम्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ pravṛtto nidhanaṃ prakartuṃ raṇāgaṇe haihayavaṃśaketoḥ / tuṇīrataḥ patriyugaṃ gṛhītvā puṅkhe nidhāyātha dhanurjyakāyām
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: आलक्ष्य लक्ष्यं नृपकर्णयुग्मं चकर्त्त चूडामणिहर्तुकामः । स कृत्तकर्णो नृपतिर्महात्मा विनिर्जिताशेषजगत्प्रवीरः
verses.transliteration: ālakṣya lakṣyaṃ nṛpakarṇayugmaṃ cakartta cūḍāmaṇihartukāmaḥ / sa kṛttakarṇo nṛpatirmahātmā vinirjitāśeṣajagatpravīraḥ
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: कोधं च तद्विनाशेन प्राप्ताः पञ्च चमूवराः
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: मेने निजं वीर्यमिह प्रणष्टं रामेण भूमीशतिरस्कृतात्मा । क्षणं धराधीशतनुर्विवर्णा गतानुभावा नृपतेर्बभूव
verses.transliteration: mene nijaṃ vīryamiha praṇaṣṭaṃ rāmeṇa bhūmīśatiraskṛtātmā / kṣaṇaṃ dharādhīśatanurvivarṇā gatānubhāvā nṛpaterbabhūva
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: लेख्येव सच्चित्रकरप्रयुक्ता सुदीनचित्तस्य विलक्ष्यते ऽग । ततः स राजा निजवीर्यवैभवं समस्तलोकाधिकतां प्रयातम्
verses.transliteration: lekhyeva saccitrakaraprayuktā sudīnacittasya vilakṣyate 'ga / tataḥ sa rājā nijavīryavaibhavaṃ samastalokādhikatāṃ prayātam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से नकूलों के समुदाय के द्वारा जब सपों के मंडल अव- खण्डित हो गये थे तो मायामय सपों का समूह नष्ट हो जाने पर सपिणी को बड़ा भारी क्रोध हो गया था ।६४। उस सपिणी के साथ उस नकुलीश्वरी ने महान् युद्ध करके उसने अपने शिलीमुख में अत्यधिक क्रूर गरडास्त्र धारण
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: विचिन्त्य पौलस्त्यजयादिलब्धं शोचन्निवासीत्स जयाभिकाङ्क्षीं । दध्यौ पुनर्मीलितलोचनो नृपौ दत्तं तमात्रेयकुलप्रदीपम्
verses.transliteration: vicintya paulastyajayādilabdhaṃ śocannivāsītsa jayābhikāṅkṣīṃ / dadhyau punarmīlitalocano nṛpau dattaṃ tamātreyakulapradīpam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: किगा था ।६५। उस गरडास्त्र ने जिसमें अत्यधिक ज्वालाए निकल रहीं थीं और समस्त दिशाए जिनसे चमक रही थों, सपिणी के देह में प्रवेश किया था और उस सर्पो की माया का शोषण कर दिया था ।६६। जब उसको उस माया की शक्ति का विनाश हो गया था तब वह सपिणी विलीन
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य प्रभावानुगृहीत ओजसा तिरश्चकारा खिललोकपालकान् । यदास्य हृद्येष महानुभावो दत्तः प्रयातो न हि दर्शनं तदा
verses.transliteration: yasya prabhāvānugṛhīta ojasā tiraścakārā khilalokapālakān / yadāsya hṛdyeṣa mahānubhāvo dattaḥ prayāto na hi darśanaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: हो गयी थी ओर उसके विनाश हो जाने से वे जो पाँच सेनापति थे उनको बहुत अधिक क्रोध हो गया था ।६७। वे सेनानी जिसके बल से समस्त सुरों का भी अपमान कर देते घे वह सपिणी के पराक्रम से विनष्ट हो गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: खिन्नो ऽतिमात्रं धरणीपतिस्तदा पुनः पुनर्ध्यानपथं जगाम । स ध्यायमानो ऽपि न चाजगाम दत्तो मनोगोचरमस्य राजन्
verses.transliteration: khinno 'timātraṃ dharaṇīpatistadā punaḥ punardhyānapathaṃ jagāma / sa dhyāyamāno 'pi na cājagāma datto manogocaramasya rājan
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: ३१४ ।  ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण और उसकी केवल कथा ही शेष रह गयी थी ।६८। इसीलिए अपने वल के विनाश हो जाने से वे चमूवर बहुत क्रोधित हुए थे और उन्होंने सबने मिलकर अपने शस्त्रो के समूह से उस नकुली पर प्रबल प्रहार किये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्विनो दान्ततमस्य साधोरनागसो दुष्कृतिकारिणो विभुः । एवं यदात्रेस्तनयो महात्मा दृष्टो न च ध्यानपथे नृपेण
verses.transliteration: tapasvino dāntatamasya sādhoranāgaso duṣkṛtikāriṇo vibhuḥ / evaṃ yadātrestanayo mahātmā dṛṣṭo na ca dhyānapathe nṛpeṇa
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: उस सेना की स्वामिनी अकेली ही थी और ताक्ष्यं के रथ पर समारूढ़ थी । उस अकेली ही ने उन पांचों सेनापतियों के साथ शस्त्रों की वर्षा करने चाली ने बहुत ही हल्के हाथ होने से युद्ध किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: तदातिदुः खेन विदूयमानः शोकेन मोहेन युतो बभूव । तं शोकमग्नं नृपतिं महात्मा रामो जगादाखिलचित्तदर्शी
verses.transliteration: tadātiduḥ khena vidūyamānaḥ śokena mohena yuto babhūva / taṃ śokamagnaṃ nṛpatiṃ mahātmā rāmo jagādākhilacittadarśī
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: मा शोकभावं नृपते प्रयाहि नैवानुशोचन्ति महानुभावाः । यस्ते वरायाभवमादिसर्गे स एव चाहं तंव सादनाय
verses.transliteration: mā śokabhāvaṃ nṛpate prayāhi naivānuśocanti mahānubhāvāḥ / yaste varāyābhavamādisarge sa eva cāhaṃ taṃva sādanāya
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: समागतस्त्वं भवधीरचित्तः संग्रामकाले न विषादचर्चा । सर्वो हि लोकः स्वकृतं भुनक्ति शुभाशुभं दैवकृतं विपाके
verses.transliteration: samāgatastvaṃ bhavadhīracittaḥ saṃgrāmakāle na viṣādacarcā / sarvo hi lokaḥ svakṛtaṃ bhunakti śubhāśubhaṃ daivakṛtaṃ vipāke
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: कर्णेषु दृष्ट् बा नासायामन्ये दशः शिरस्तठे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योनको ऽप्यस्य शुभाशुभस्य विपर्ययं कर्तुमलं नरेश । यत्ते सुपुण्यं बहुजन्मसंचितं तेनेह दत्तस्य वरार्हपात्रम्
verses.transliteration: anyonako 'pyasya śubhāśubhasya viparyayaṃ kartumalaṃ nareśa / yatte supuṇyaṃ bahujanmasaṃcitaṃ teneha dattasya varārhapātram
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: जातो भवानद्य तु दुष्कृतस्य फलं प्रभुङ्क्ष्व त्वमिहार्जितस्य । गुरुर्विमत्यापकृतस्त्वया मे यतस्ततः कर्णनिकृन्तनं ते
verses.transliteration: jāto bhavānadya tu duṣkṛtasya phalaṃ prabhuṅkṣva tvamihārjitasya / gururvimatyāpakṛtastvayā me yatastataḥ karṇanikṛntanaṃ te
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं मया पश्य हरन्तमोजसा चूडामणिं मामपत्दृत्य ते यशः । इत्येवमुक्त्वा स भृगुर्महात्मा नियोज्य बाणं च विकृष्य चापम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ mayā paśya harantamojasā cūḍāmaṇiṃ māmapatdṛtya te yaśaḥ / ityevamuktvā sa bhṛgurmahātmā niyojya bāṇaṃ ca vikṛṣya cāpam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षेप राज्ञः स तु लाघवेन च्छित्त्वा मणिं रामममुपाजगाम । तद्वीक्ष्य कर्मास्य मुनेः सुतस्य स चार्जुनो हैहयवंशधर्त्ता
verses.transliteration: cikṣepa rājñaḥ sa tu lāghavena cchittvā maṇiṃ rāmamamupājagāma / tadvīkṣya karmāsya muneḥ sutasya sa cārjuno haihayavaṃśadharttā
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्यतो ऽभूत्पुनरप्युदायुधस्तं हन्तुमाजौ द्विजमात्मशत्रुम् । शूलशक्तिगदाचक्रखढ्गपट्टिशतोमरैः
verses.transliteration: samudyato 'bhūtpunarapyudāyudhastaṃ hantumājau dvijamātmaśatrum / śūlaśaktigadācakrakhaḍhgapaṭṭiśatomaraiḥ
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: पट्टिश--मुसल और सहस्रो भिन्दिपालों से तथा बजु की शक्ति से
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: नानाप्रहरणैश्चान्यैराजघान द्विजात्मजम् । स रामो लाघवेनैव संप्रक्षिप्तान्यनेन च
verses.transliteration: nānāpraharaṇaiścānyairājaghāna dvijātmajam / sa rāmo lāghavenaiva saṃprakṣiptānyanena ca
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण दाँतों से मर्मस्थलों में दंशन किया था प्रहार किया था ।७१। फिर तो समस्त हैत्यगण हाहाकार की ध्वनि करते हुए उन उदग्र दंशन करने वाले नकूलों के द्वारा वेचेन हो गये ये ।७२। उनमें कुछ तो आकाश से परम घोर चीत्कार करते हुए उत्पन्न कर रहे ये । अत्यन्त क्रोध से युक्त नकूल शत्रुओं
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: शूलादीनि चकर्त्ताशु मध्य एव निजाशुगैः । स राजा वार्युपस्पृश्य ससर्जाग्नेयमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śūlādīni cakarttāśu madhya eva nijāśugaiḥ / sa rājā vāryupaspṛśya sasarjāgneyamuttamam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: की सेना का दंशन कर रहे ये ।७३। उन असुरों की उस समय में बहुत ही बुरी दशा हो गयी थी । कुछ तो कानों में काटे गये ये-कुछ नासिकाओं में और कुछ शिरों में दंशित किउे गये थे एवं कुछ पीठ पर दंशन किये गये
