verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रं रामो वारुणेन शमयामास सत्वरम् । गान्धर्वं विदधे राजा वायव्येनाहनद्विभुम्
verses.transliteration: astraṃ rāmo vāruṇena śamayāmāsa satvaram / gāndharvaṃ vidadhe rājā vāyavyenāhanadvibhum
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: नागास्त्रं गारुडेनापि रामश्चिच्छेद भूपते । दत्तेन दत्तं यच्छूलमव्यर्थं मन्त्रपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: nāgāstraṃ gāruḍenāpi rāmaściccheda bhūpate / dattena dattaṃ yacchūlamavyarthaṃ mantrapūrvakam
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: थे--इस तरह से सब की क्रियाएँ विनष्ट हो गयो थीं ।७४। ऐसे सबके सव वे वेचेन हो गये थे और उनके कवच छिन्न हो गये थो। भय के कारण उन्होंने अपने शस्त्रों को छोड़ दिया था। वे समस्त असुर नकूलों से पराभव को प्राप्त होकर निमलित हो गये थे ।७५। कुछ नकुल तो शत्रुओं के खुले
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: जग्राह समरे राजा भार्गवस्य वधाय च । तच्छूलं शतसूर्याभमनिवार्यं सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: jagrāha samare rājā bhārgavasya vadhāya ca / tacchūlaṃ śatasūryābhamanivāryaṃ surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.hindi: हुए मुखों में प्रवेश करके सपों के मुखों (फो) को खींचकर उनके रसना के तलों को काट रहे थे ।७६। अन्य नकुल शत्रुओं के कानों के छिदं मे प्रवेश करके उन्हें देशित कर रहे थे तथा वे नकुल उनके अनेक छिल्रों में में सूक्ष्म रूपों वाले होकर प्रविष्ट हो रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षेप राममुद्दिश्य समग्रेण बलेन सः । मूर्ध्नि तद्भार्गवस्याथ निपपात महीपते
verses.transliteration: cikṣepa rāmamuddiśya samagreṇa balena saḥ / mūrdhni tadbhārgavasyātha nipapāta mahīpate
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: तेन शूलप्रहारेण व्यथितो भार्गवस्तदा । मूर्च्छामवाप राजेन्द्र पपात च हरिं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: tena śūlaprahāreṇa vyathito bhārgavastadā / mūrcchāmavāpa rājendra papāta ca hariṃ smaran
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: पतिते भार्गवे तत्र सर्वे देवा भयाकुलाः । समाजग्मुः पुरस्कृत्य ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरान्
verses.transliteration: patite bhārgave tatra sarve devā bhayākulāḥ / samājagmuḥ puraskṛtya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्करस्तु महाज्ञानी साक्षान्मृत्युञ्जयः प्रभुः । भार्गवं जीवयामास संजीवन्या स विद्यया
verses.transliteration: śaṅkarastu mahājñānī sākṣānmṛtyuñjayaḥ prabhuḥ / bhārgavaṃ jīvayāmāsa saṃjīvanyā sa vidyayā
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्तु चेतनां प्राप्य ददर्श पुरतः सुरान् । प्रणनाम च राजेन्द्र भक्त्या ब्रह्मादिकांस्तु तान्
verses.transliteration: rāmastu cetanāṃ prāpya dadarśa purataḥ surān / praṇanāma ca rājendra bhaktyā brahmādikāṃstu tān
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: ते स्तुता भार्गवेन्द्रेण सद्यो ऽदर्शनमागताः । स रामो वार्युस्पृश्य जजाप कवचं तु तत्
verses.transliteration: te stutā bhārgavendreṇa sadyo 'darśanamāgatāḥ / sa rāmo vāryuspṛśya jajāpa kavacaṃ tu tat
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थितश्च सुसंरब्धो निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा । स्मृत्वा पाशुपतं चास्त्रं शिवदत्तं स भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: utthitaśca susaṃrabdho nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā / smṛtvā pāśupataṃ cāstraṃ śivadattaṃ sa bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः संहृतवांस्तत्तु कार्त्तवीर्यं महाबलम् । स राजा दत्तभक्तस्तु विष्णोश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम् । प्रविष्टो भस्मसाज्जातं शरीरं बाहुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ saṃhṛtavāṃstattu kārttavīryaṃ mahābalam / sa rājā dattabhaktastu viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam / praviṣṭo bhasmasājjātaṃ śarīraṃ bāhunandana
verses.translation: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his consciousness, Rama saw the Suras in front of him. O leading king, he bowed down to Brahma and other suras with devotibn.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते कार्त्तवीर्यवधो नाम चत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४०॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच दृष्ट्वा पितुर्वधं घोरं तत्पुत्रास्ते शतं त्वरा । वारयामासुरत्युग्रं भार्गवं स्वबलेः पृथक्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite kārttavīryavadho nāma catvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 40// vasiṣṭha uvāca dṛṣṭvā piturvadhaṃ ghoraṃ tatputrāste śataṃ tvarā / vārayāmāsuratyugraṃ bhārgavaṃ svabaleḥ pṛthak
verses.translation: On seeing the terrible killing of their father, the hundred sons of Karttavirya hurriedly resisted the excessively terrible Bhargava severally, by means of their respective armies.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the terrible killing of their father, the hundred sons of Karttavirya hurriedly resisted the excessively terrible Bhargava severally, by means of their respective armies.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the terrible killing of their father, the hundred sons of Karttavirya hurriedly resisted the excessively terrible Bhargava severally, by means of their respective armies.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकाक्षैहिणीयुक्ताः सर्वे ते युद्धदुर्मदाः । संग्रामं तुमुलं चक्रुः संरब्धास्तु पितुर्वधात्
verses.transliteration: ekaikākṣaihiṇīyuktāḥ sarve te yuddhadurmadāḥ / saṃgrāmaṃ tumulaṃ cakruḥ saṃrabdhāstu piturvadhāt
verses.translation: Extremely infuriated at the death of their father all those sons who had an Aksauhini each and who were extreme-
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से अपनी सेनाओं को नकूलों के द्वारा अभिभूत हुई देख कर तथा अपने सैनिकों को दीन अवलोकन करके करडू को बहुत अधिक क्रोध हो गया था ।5। अन्य भी जो सेनानी ये बे भी बहुत ही हल्के हाथों
verses.wordMeaning: Extremely infuriated at the death of their father all those sons who had an Aksauhini each and who were extreme-
verses.commentary: Sense: Extremely infuriated at the death of their father all those sons who had an Aksauhini each and who were extreme-

verses.sanskrit: रामस्तु दृष्ट्वा तत्पुत्राञ्छूरान्रणविशारदान् । परश्वधं समादाय युयुधे तैश्च संगरे
verses.transliteration: rāmastu dṛṣṭvā tatputrāñchūrānraṇaviśāradān / paraśvadhaṃ samādāya yuyudhe taiśca saṃgare
verses.translation: On seeing his herioc sons who were proficient in battle, Rama took up his axe and fought with them in battle.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing his herioc sons who were proficient in battle, Rama took up his axe and fought with them in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing his herioc sons who were proficient in battle, Rama took up his axe and fought with them in battle.

verses.sanskrit: तां सेनां भगवान्रामः शताक्षौहिणिसंमिताम् । निजघान त्वरायुक्तो मुहुर्त्तद्वयमात्रतः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ senāṃ bhagavānrāmaḥ śatākṣauhiṇisaṃmitām / nijaghāna tvarāyukto muhurttadvayamātrataḥ
verses.translation: Within a short period of only two Muhurtas* **, Rama hurriedly slew that army consisting of a hundred Akfauhitiis * *
verses.hindi: बाले और महान बलवान शे ।७६। उनने प्रत्येक नकुल के ऊपर शरों के समूहों की मेघों की भाँति वर्षा की थी । देत्यों के सेनापतियों के परम प्रौढ़ अनुषों से निकले हुए बागों ने नकूलों के करोड़ों दांतों पर अथवा दांतों के कौनों पर अतीव कठोर घटून किया था । अर्थात् जोरदार प्रहार किये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Within a short period of only two Muhurtas* **, Rama hurriedly slew that army consisting of a hundred Akfauhitiis * *
verses.commentary: Sense: Within a short period of only two Muhurtas* **, Rama hurriedly slew that army consisting of a hundred Akfauhitiis * *

verses.sanskrit: निःशेषितं स्वसैन्यं तु कुठारेणैव लीलया । दृष्ट्वा रामेण तेसर्वे युयुधुर्वीर्यसंमताः
verses.transliteration: niḥśeṣitaṃ svasainyaṃ tu kuṭhāreṇaiva līlayā / dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa tesarve yuyudhurvīryasaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing their armies sportingly annihilated with his axe by Rama, all of them of highly esteemed valour, fought with Rama.
verses.hindi: ।५०। सेकड़ों से भी अधिक सेनानियों के बाणों के समुदायों से आहत नकुलो के वज के समान दाँतों से अग्नि की चिनगारियों निकल रही थीं। उन पाँचों सेनापतियों ने एक ही हल्ले में मिलकर सेना का विमर्दन कर दिया था। सेनानियों के द्वारा छोड़े हुए वाणों सें जो करोड़ों की संख्या में शे
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing their armies sportingly annihilated with his axe by Rama, all of them of highly esteemed valour, fought with Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing their armies sportingly annihilated with his axe by Rama, all of them of highly esteemed valour, fought with Rama.

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधानि दिव्यानि प्रहरन्तो महोजसः । परितो मण्डलं चक्रुर्भार्गवस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: nānāvidhāni divyāni praharanto mahojasaḥ / parito maṇḍalaṃ cakrurbhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Striking with different kinds of divine weapons, those sons of great valour and prowess encircled the noblc- souled Bhargava.
verses.hindi: विशीर्ण शरीरों वाले विचारे नकुल इधर-उधर घूमते गए नकुली के आस- पास घिरकर समागत हो गये रो ।८१-८२। इसके अनन्तर वाङ्मय की एक
verses.wordMeaning: Striking with different kinds of divine weapons, those sons of great valour and prowess encircled the noblc- souled Bhargava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Striking with different kinds of divine weapons, those sons of great valour and prowess encircled the noblc- souled Bhargava.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रामो ऽपि बलवांस्तेषां मण्डलमध्यगः । विरेजे भगवान्साक्षाद्यथा नाभिस्तु चक्रगा
verses.transliteration: atha rāmo 'pi balavāṃsteṣāṃ maṇḍalamadhyagaḥ / vireje bhagavānsākṣādyathā nābhistu cakragā
verses.translation: The powerful holy lord Rama, stationed in the middle of their circle, shone like the navel of a wheel.
verses.hindi: ।८३। उस नकूली ने अक्षीण नकुल नामक महास्त्र को जिसका सभी ओर मुख था ओर जो वहिन की ज्वालाओं से घिरे हुए अग्रभाग बाला था उस को अपने धनुष पर चढ़ाया था
verses.wordMeaning: The powerful holy lord Rama, stationed in the middle of their circle, shone like the navel of a wheel.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful holy lord Rama, stationed in the middle of their circle, shone like the navel of a wheel.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यन्निवाचौ विरराज रामः शतं पुनस्ते परितो भ्रमन्तः । रेजुश्च गोपी गणमध्यसंस्थः कृष्णो यथा ताः परितो भ्रमन्त्यः
verses.transliteration: nṛtyannivācau virarāja rāmaḥ śataṃ punaste parito bhramantaḥ / rejuśca gopī gaṇamadhyasaṃsthaḥ kṛṣṇo yathā tāḥ parito bhramantyaḥ
verses.translation: While the hundred princes were encircling him, R&ma (facing each of them) shone as if dancing in the' battle like Lord Krsna in the midst of Gopls (cow-herd girls of Vpida- vana at the time of Rasa dance), and they appeared glorious like the Gopis adance around Krsna.
verses.wordMeaning: While the hundred princes were encircling him, R&ma (facing each of them) shone as if dancing in the' battle like Lord Krsna in the midst of Gopls (cow-herd girls of Vpida- vana at the time of Rasa dance), and they appeared glorious like the Gopis adance around Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: While the hundred princes were encircling him, R&ma (facing each of them) shone as if dancing in the' battle like Lord Krsna in the midst of Gopls (cow-herd girls of Vpida- vana at the time of Rasa dance), and they appeared glorious like the Gopis adance around Krsna.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तु सर्वे द्रुहिणप्रधानाः समागताः स्वस्वविमानसंस्थाः । समाकिरन्नन्दनमाल्यवर्षैः समन्ततो राममहीनवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: tadā tu sarve druhiṇapradhānāḥ samāgatāḥ svasvavimānasaṃsthāḥ / samākirannandanamālyavarṣaiḥ samantato rāmamahīnavīryam
verses.translation: Then the Devas with Brahma as their leader came there seated in their respective aerial chariots. They showered Rama of no unabated vigour, with garlands of flowers from the Nandana garden in the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Devas with Brahma as their leader came there seated in their respective aerial chariots. They showered Rama of no unabated vigour, with garlands of flowers from the Nandana garden in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Devas with Brahma as their leader came there seated in their respective aerial chariots. They showered Rama of no unabated vigour, with garlands of flowers from the Nandana garden in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यः शस्त्रपादादुदतिष्ठत ध्वनिर् हुंकारगर्भो दिवमस्पृशन्स वै । तौर्यत्रिकस्येव शरक्षतानि भान्तीव यद्वन्नखदन्तपाताः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śastrapādādudatiṣṭhata dhvanir huṃkāragarbho divamaspṛśansa vai / tauryatrikasyeva śarakṣatāni bhāntīva yadvannakhadantapātāḥ
verses.translation: The sound produced by the clash of weapons mingled with Huriikaras (sounds of Hum) reached the firmament like that of the triple symphony. The wounds caused by the arrows appeared like those caused by nails and teeth.
verses.wordMeaning: The sound produced by the clash of weapons mingled with Huriikaras (sounds of Hum) reached the firmament like that of the triple symphony. The wounds caused by the arrows appeared like those caused by nails and teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sound produced by the clash of weapons mingled with Huriikaras (sounds of Hum) reached the firmament like that of the triple symphony. The wounds caused by the arrows appeared like those caused by nails and teeth.

verses.sanskrit: क्रन्दन्ति शस्त्रैः क्षतविक्षताङ्गा गायन्ति यद्वत्किल गीतविज्ञाः । एवं प्रवृत्तं नृपयुद्धमण्डलं पश्यन्ति देवा भृशविस्मिताक्षः
verses.transliteration: krandanti śastraiḥ kṣatavikṣatāṅgā gāyanti yadvatkila gītavijñāḥ / evaṃ pravṛttaṃ nṛpayuddhamaṇḍalaṃ paśyanti devā bhṛśavismitākṣaḥ
verses.translation: Desirous of killing the sons of the king in battle by means of different kinds of excellent missiles, Rama, the powerful lord wielding his bow, separated the stronger ones from the group and formed a new line.
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of killing the sons of the king in battle by means of different kinds of excellent missiles, Rama, the powerful lord wielding his bow, separated the stronger ones from the group and formed a new line.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of killing the sons of the king in battle by means of different kinds of excellent missiles, Rama, the powerful lord wielding his bow, separated the stronger ones from the group and formed a new line.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु रामो ऽवनिपालपुत्राञ्जिघांसुराजौ विविधास्त्रपूगैः । पृथक्चकारातिब लांस्तु मण्डलद्विच्छिद्य पङ्क्तिं प्रभुरात्तचापः
verses.transliteration: tatastu rāmo 'vanipālaputrāñjighāṃsurājau vividhāstrapūgaiḥ / pṛthakcakārātiba lāṃstu maṇḍaladvicchidya paṅktiṃ prabhurāttacāpaḥ
verses.translation: He killed those heroic warriors one by one. Out of the hundred, five fled losing all courage viz. Sura, Vrsasya, Vr$asena, Surasena and Jayadhvaja.
verses.wordMeaning: He killed those heroic warriors one by one. Out of the hundred, five fled losing all courage viz. Sura, Vrsasya, Vr$asena, Surasena and Jayadhvaja.
verses.commentary: Sense: He killed those heroic warriors one by one. Out of the hundred, five fled losing all courage viz. Sura, Vrsasya, Vr$asena, Surasena and Jayadhvaja.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकशस्तान्निजघान वीराञ्छतं तदा पञ्च ततः पलायिताः । शूरो वृषास्यो वृषशूरसेनौ जयध्वजश्चापि विभिन्नधैर्याः
verses.transliteration: ekaikaśastānnijaghāna vīrāñchataṃ tadā pañca tataḥ palāyitāḥ / śūro vṛṣāsyo vṛṣaśūrasenau jayadhvajaścāpi vibhinnadhairyāḥ
verses.translation: With their minds filled with great fright and desirous of protecting their lives, those princes went into the forests at the foot of the Himalayas severally (Each entering a separate forest). None of those afflicted and unhappy ones was seen afterwards.
verses.wordMeaning: With their minds filled with great fright and desirous of protecting their lives, those princes went into the forests at the foot of the Himalayas severally (Each entering a separate forest). None of those afflicted and unhappy ones was seen afterwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their minds filled with great fright and desirous of protecting their lives, those princes went into the forests at the foot of the Himalayas severally (Each entering a separate forest). None of those afflicted and unhappy ones was seen afterwards.

verses.sanskrit: महाभयेनाथ परीतचिता हिमाद्रिपादान्तरकाननं च । पृथग्गतास्ते सुपरीप्सवो नृपा न को ऽपि कांस्विद्ददृशे भृशार्त्तः
verses.transliteration: mahābhayenātha parītacitā himādripādāntarakānanaṃ ca / pṛthaggatāste suparīpsavo nṛpā na ko 'pi kāṃsviddadṛśe bhṛśārttaḥ
verses.translation: The propriety of comparison in w. 7 and 8 as well as in w. 10 and 1 1 deserves reconsideration.
verses.wordMeaning: The propriety of comparison in w. 7 and 8 as well as in w. 10 and 1 1 deserves reconsideration.
verses.commentary: Sense: The propriety of comparison in w. 7 and 8 as well as in w. 10 and 1 1 deserves reconsideration.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि हत्वा नृपचक्रमाजौ राज्ञः सहायर्थमुपागतं च । समन्वितो ऽसावकृतव्रणेन सस्नौ मुदागत्य च नर्मदायाम्
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi hatvā nṛpacakramājau rājñaḥ sahāyarthamupāgataṃ ca / samanvito 'sāvakṛtavraṇena sasnau mudāgatya ca narmadāyām
verses.translation: After slaying the other kings also who had gathered there to assist king Karttavlrya, Rama, accompanied by Akrta- vrana joyously came to the river Narmada and took his bath.
verses.wordMeaning: After slaying the other kings also who had gathered there to assist king Karttavlrya, Rama, accompanied by Akrta- vrana joyously came to the river Narmada and took his bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: After slaying the other kings also who had gathered there to assist king Karttavlrya, Rama, accompanied by Akrta- vrana joyously came to the river Narmada and took his bath.

verses.sanskrit: स्रात्वा नित्यक्रियां कृत्वा संपूज्य वृषभध्वजम् । प्रतस्थे द्रष्टुमुर्वीश शिवं कैलासवासिनम्
verses.transliteration: srātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam / pratasthe draṣṭumurvīśa śivaṃ kailāsavāsinam
verses.translation: After taking bath, performing his daily rites and worshipping the bull-emblemed lord, O lord of the Earth, he set off in order to visit Lord Siva, the resident of the Kailasa mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: After taking bath, performing his daily rites and worshipping the bull-emblemed lord, O lord of the Earth, he set off in order to visit Lord Siva, the resident of the Kailasa mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking bath, performing his daily rites and worshipping the bull-emblemed lord, O lord of the Earth, he set off in order to visit Lord Siva, the resident of the Kailasa mountain.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुपत्नीमुमां चापि सुतौ स्कन्दविनायकौ । मनोयायी महात्मासावकृतव्रणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: gurupatnīmumāṃ cāpi sutau skandavināyakau / manoyāyī mahātmāsāvakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: After completing his task, he rejoiced much. Reach- ing the Kailasa mountain instantly, he saw the great city named Alaka.
verses.wordMeaning: After completing his task, he rejoiced much. Reach- ing the Kailasa mountain instantly, he saw the great city named Alaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: After completing his task, he rejoiced much. Reach- ing the Kailasa mountain instantly, he saw the great city named Alaka.

verses.sanskrit: कृतकार्यो मुदा युक्तः कैलासं प्राप्य तत्क्षणम् । ददर्श तत्र नगरीं महतीमलकाभिधम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtakāryo mudā yuktaḥ kailāsaṃ prāpya tatkṣaṇam / dadarśa tatra nagarīṃ mahatīmalakābhidham
verses.translation: The excellent Parsadas (attendants of Siva) and the Ksetrapalas were stationed there. They were adorned with bejewelled ornaments and were seated on thrones set with precious stones and jewels.
verses.hindi: उसके अस्त्र से निकले हुए करोड़ों नकुल बाहिर हुए ये जिनके बज
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Parsadas (attendants of Siva) and the Ksetrapalas were stationed there. They were adorned with bejewelled ornaments and were seated on thrones set with precious stones and jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent Parsadas (attendants of Siva) and the Ksetrapalas were stationed there. They were adorned with bejewelled ornaments and were seated on thrones set with precious stones and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: नानामणिगणाकीर्णभवनैरुपशोभिताम् । नानारुपधरैर्यक्षैः शोभितां चित्रभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇabhavanairupaśobhitām / nānārupadharairyakṣaiḥ śobhitāṃ citrabhūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, Bhargava stood there in front of Ganapati. The lord of Ganas then spoke these sweet words to Bhargava.
verses.hindi: के समान अङ्ग ये-वष्त जैसे ही लोम थे और वज के तुल्य दंष्टाए' थी तथा उनका महान् वेग या ।८१। वे सभी वज्ञ के समसार वाले--निविड और वप्र जाल के सहश भयंकर थे । उनके नख भी वजन जेसे आकार वाले थे उनसे दे इस महीतल की विदीर्णे कर रहे थे ।८५-८६। वे वजू रत्न के
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, Bhargava stood there in front of Ganapati. The lord of Ganas then spoke these sweet words to Bhargava.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Bhargava stood there in front of Ganapati. The lord of Ganas then spoke these sweet words to Bhargava.

verses.sanskrit: नानावृक्षसमाकीणैर्वनैश्चोपवनैर्युताम् । दीर्घिकाभिः सुदीर्घाभिस्तडागैश्चोपशोभिताम्
verses.transliteration: nānāvṛkṣasamākīṇairvanaiścopavanairyutām / dīrghikābhiḥ sudīrghābhistaḍāgaiścopaśobhitām
verses.translation: Whether out of carnal desire or otherwise, if a person sees another person inclined to sexual intercourse, he shall have to suffer certainly separation from his wife in the course of seven births.
verses.hindi: समान प्रकाश वाले नेत्रों से भी शोभा वाले थे ओर जैसे वजू का पात होता है वैसा ही उनका सम्पात भी था। वे अपनी नासिकाओं से चीखें मारने बाले शे ।८७। वे अपने दाँतों के कौनों से असुरों के सेनाओं का मदन करते हैं । निरपराधी उन्होंने अनेक प्रकार के पराक्रम को प्रदर्शित किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Whether out of carnal desire or otherwise, if a person sees another person inclined to sexual intercourse, he shall have to suffer certainly separation from his wife in the course of seven births.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether out of carnal desire or otherwise, if a person sees another person inclined to sexual intercourse, he shall have to suffer certainly separation from his wife in the course of seven births.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतो ऽप्यावृतां बाह्ये सीतयालकनन्दया । तत्र देवाङ्गनास्नानमुक्तकुङ्कुमपिञ्जरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvato 'pyāvṛtāṃ bāhye sītayālakanandayā / tatra devāṅganāsnānamuktakuṅkumapiñjaram
verses.translation: O, unusual and unprecedented words have been heard from your mouth. Have they come out due to your mistake or have you uttered them jocularly?
verses.hindi: कोटियों से वे अधम दानव अपने शरीरों के प्रत्येक अवयवो से विनष्ट हो गये शे ॥८६। इस तरह वजू पूर्ण नकूलों के मण्डलों से देत्यों की सेनाएं छिन्त-भिन्न हो गयो थीं ।६०। सो अक्षो हिणी की संख्या में वे केवल स्वयं ही बचे भे तब तो उनने बड़े क्रोध से ओर अत्यधिक त्रास से उन चमूबरों
verses.wordMeaning: O, unusual and unprecedented words have been heard from your mouth. Have they come out due to your mistake or have you uttered them jocularly?
verses.commentary: Sense: O, unusual and unprecedented words have been heard from your mouth. Have they come out due to your mistake or have you uttered them jocularly?

verses.sanskrit: तृषाविर हिताश्चांभः पिबन्ति करिणो मुदा । यत्र संगीतसंनादा श्रूयन्ते तत्रतत्र ह
verses.transliteration: tṛṣāvira hitāścāṃbhaḥ pibanti kariṇo mudā / yatra saṃgītasaṃnādā śrūyante tatratatra ha
verses.translation: The restriction from the scripture cited by you refers to lovers and passionate ones prone to aberrations. There is no fault in case of an infant or a person devoid of passionate feelings.
verses.hindi: को ग्रहण किया था । अपने धनुषों को खींच कर उन्होंने और अधिक संग्राम किया था
verses.wordMeaning: The restriction from the scripture cited by you refers to lovers and passionate ones prone to aberrations. There is no fault in case of an infant or a person devoid of passionate feelings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The restriction from the scripture cited by you refers to lovers and passionate ones prone to aberrations. There is no fault in case of an infant or a person devoid of passionate feelings.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च सततं सहकारिभिः । तां दृष्ट्वा भार्गवो राजन्मुदा परमया युतः
verses.transliteration: gandharvairapsarobhiśca satataṃ sahakāribhiḥ / tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhārgavo rājanmudā paramayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: I will get into the harem brother. What have you to object to in this matter, O boy. Stand by. I shall do in accordance with what is seen and what is relevant to the occasion, there.
verses.wordMeaning: I will get into the harem brother. What have you to object to in this matter, O boy. Stand by. I shall do in accordance with what is seen and what is relevant to the occasion, there.
verses.commentary: Sense: I will get into the harem brother. What have you to object to in this matter, O boy. Stand by. I shall do in accordance with what is seen and what is relevant to the occasion, there.

verses.sanskrit: ययौ तदूर्ध्वं शिखरं यत्र शेवपरं गृहम् । ततो ददर्श राजेन्द्र स्निग्धच्छायं महावटम्
verses.transliteration: yayau tadūrdhvaṃ śikharaṃ yatra śevaparaṃ gṛham / tato dadarśa rājendra snigdhacchāyaṃ mahāvaṭam
verses.translation: After saying this, O king, Bhargava attempted to go in. Vinayaka got up in a hurry and restrained him.
verses.hindi: काकवाशितमुख्यानां चतुर्णामपि गैरिणाम् । उत्पत्योत्पत्य तार्क्येग व्यलुतादसिता शिरः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, O king, Bhargava attempted to go in. Vinayaka got up in a hurry and restrained him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, O king, Bhargava attempted to go in. Vinayaka got up in a hurry and restrained him.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याधस्ताद्वरावासं सुसेव्यं सिद्धसंयुतम् । ददर्ंश तत्र प्राकारं शतयोजनमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: tasyādhastādvarāvāsaṃ susevyaṃ siddhasaṃyutam / dadarṃśa tatra prākāraṃ śatayojanamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: नानारत्नाचितं रम्यं चतुर्द्वारं गणावृतम् । नन्दीश्वरं महाकालं रक्ताक्षं विकटोदरम्
verses.transliteration: nānāratnācitaṃ ramyaṃ caturdvāraṃ gaṇāvṛtam / nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ raktākṣaṃ vikaṭodaram
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: पिङ्गलाक्षं विशालाक्षं विरूपाक्षं घटोदरम् । मन्दारं भैरवं बाणं रुरुं भैरवमेव च
verses.transliteration: piṅgalākṣaṃ viśālākṣaṃ virūpākṣaṃ ghaṭodaram / mandāraṃ bhairavaṃ bāṇaṃ ruruṃ bhairavameva ca
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.hindi: लोकोत्तरे गुणे इष्ठे कस्य न प्रीतिसंभव: । हतशिष्टा भीतभीता नकलीशरणं गताः
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: वीरकं वीरभद्रं च चण्डं भृङ्गिं रिटिं मुखम् । सिद्धेन्द्रनाथरुद्रांश्च विद्याधरमहोरगान्
verses.transliteration: vīrakaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca caṇḍaṃ bhṛṅgiṃ riṭiṃ mukham / siddhendranātharudrāṃśca vidyādharamahoragān
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: भूतप्रेतपिशाचांश्च कूष्माण्डान्ब्रह्मराक्षसान् । वेतालान्दानवेन्द्रांश्च योगीन्द्रांश्च जटाधरान्
verses.transliteration: bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca kūṣmāṇḍānbrahmarākṣasān / vetālāndānavendrāṃśca yogīndrāṃśca jaṭādharān
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षकिंपुरुषांश्चैव डाकिनीयो गिनीस्तथा । दृष्ट्वा नन्द्या५या तत्र प्रविष्टो ऽन्तर्मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: yakṣakiṃpuruṣāṃścaiva ḍākinīyo ginīstathā / dṛṣṭvā nandyā5yā tatra praviṣṭo 'ntarmudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श तत्र भुवनैरावृतं शिवमन्दिरम् । चतुर्योजनविस्तीर्णं तत्र प्राग्द्वारसंस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: dadarśa tatra bhuvanairāvṛtaṃ śivamandiram / caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ tatra prāgdvārasaṃsthitau
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.hindi: उस नकुलेश्वरी ने उनके साथ अनेक प्रकार से संग्राम करते हुए पट्टिश से करङ्कु का शिर को काट दिया था जो महान कठिन था ।६२। वे चार शत्रु शे जिनमें काकवाशित प्रमुख था । ऊपर की ओर उछाल खा- खाकर ताक्ष्यं खड्ग से उनका शिर काट दिया था ।९३। श्यामलाम्बिका ने
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा वामे कार्त्तिकेय दक्ष चैव विनायकम् । ननाम भार्गवस्तौ द्वौ शिवतुल्यपराक्रमौ
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vāme kārttikeya dakṣa caiva vināyakam / nanāma bhārgavastau dvau śivatulyaparākramau
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.hindi: उस तरह की हाथ की सफाई नकुली की देखो थी और उसको महान सत्व बाली और दुष्ट असुरों के विनाश करने वाली को बहुत मान लिया था । फिर उस श्यामाम्बिका ने अपने अग का जो देव तत्त्व था वह उसको दे दिया था ।६४-६५। जब अलोकिक गुण दिखाई देता है तो किसके हृदय में
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: पार्षदप्रवरास्तत्र क्षेत्रपालाश्च संस्थिताः । रत्नसिंहासनस्थाश्च रत्नभूषमभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: pārṣadapravarāstatra kṣetrapālāśca saṃsthitāḥ / ratnasiṃhāsanasthāśca ratnabhūṣamabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.hindi: प्रीति समुत्यन्न नहीं हुआ करती है । जो भी नकुल मरने से बचे हुए थे वे बहुत ही भयभीत होकर उन बकुली की शरण में गये थे ।६६। उसने भी उनको देखकर कि ये डरे हुए हैं कृपा करके कह! था--डरो मत--और वह हंस गयो थी । उसने कहा था कि आप अपने राजा को इस संग्राम का
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवं प्रविशन्तं तु ह्यपृच्छञ्शिवमन्दिरम् । विनायको महाराज क्षणं तिष्ठेत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: bhārgavaṃ praviśantaṃ tu hyapṛcchañśivamandiram / vināyako mahārāja kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhetyuvāca ha
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.hindi: सब समाचार बतादो।६७। इस रीति से बस देवी के द्वार भेजे गये उनने उस समय में युद्ध भूमि का अवलोकन किया था और वे भय से मुदित होकर फिर सब शून्य का नगरी में भाग कर चले गये थे ।६८। उस समा- चार को सुनकर वह प्रचण्ड भण्डासुर बड़ा कद्ध हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: निद्रितो ह्युमया युक्तो महादेवो ऽधुनेति च । ईश्वराज्ञां गृहीत्वाहमत्रागत्यक्षणान्तरे
verses.transliteration: nidrito hyumayā yukto mahādevo 'dhuneti ca / īśvarājñāṃ gṛhītvāhamatrāgatyakṣaṇāntare
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया सार्द्धं प्रवेक्ष्यामि भ्रातस्तिष्ठात्र सांप्रतम् । विनायकचश्चैवं श्रुत्वा भार्गवनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: tvayā sārddhaṃ pravekṣyāmi bhrātastiṣṭhātra sāṃpratam / vināyakacaścaivaṃ śrutvā bhārgavanandanaḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवक्तुमुपचक्राम गणेशं त्वरयान्वितः । राम उवाच गत्वा ह्यन्तःपुरं भ्रातः प्रणम्य जगदीश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: pravaktumupacakrāma gaṇeśaṃ tvarayānvitaḥ / rāma uvāca gatvā hyantaḥpuraṃ bhrātaḥ praṇamya jagadīśvarau
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वतीशङ्करौ सद्यो यास्यामि निजमन्दिरम् । कार्त्तवीर्यः सुचन्द्रश्च सपुत्रबलबान्धवः
verses.transliteration: pārvatīśaṅkarau sadyo yāsyāmi nijamandiram / kārttavīryaḥ sucandraśca saputrabalabāndhavaḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये सहस्रशो भूपाः कांबोजाः पङ्लवाः शाकाः । कान्यकुब्जाः कोशलेशा मायावन्तो महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: anye sahasraśo bhūpāḥ kāṃbojāḥ paṅlavāḥ śākāḥ / kānyakubjāḥ kośaleśā māyāvanto mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: निहताः समरे सर्वे मया शंभुप्रसादतः । तमिमं प्रणिपत्यैव यास्यामि स्वगृहं प्रति
verses.transliteration: nihatāḥ samare sarve mayā śaṃbhuprasādataḥ / tamimaṃ praṇipatyaiva yāsyāmi svagṛhaṃ prati
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवस्तत्र तस्थौ गणपतेः पुरः । प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं भार्गवे स गणाधिपः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhārgavastatra tasthau gaṇapateḥ puraḥ / provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ bhārgave sa gaṇādhipaḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: विनायक उवाच ज्ञणं तिष्ट महाभाग दर्शनं ते भविष्यति । अद्य विश्वेश्वरो भ्रातर्भवान्या सह वर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: vināyaka uvāca jñaṇaṃ tiṣṭa mahābhāga darśanaṃ te bhaviṣyati / adya viśveśvaro bhrātarbhavānyā saha varttate
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसोर्युक्त योस्तात सहैकासनसंस्थयोः । करोति सुखभङ्गं यो नरकं स व्रजेद्ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: strīpuṃsoryukta yostāta sahaikāsanasaṃsthayoḥ / karoti sukhabhaṅgaṃ yo narakaṃ sa vrajeddhruvam
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतस्तु पितरं गुरुं वा भूपतिं द्विजः । र७स्यं समुपासिनं न पश्येदिति निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: viśeṣatastu pitaraṃ guruṃ vā bhūpatiṃ dvijaḥ / ra7syaṃ samupāsinaṃ na paśyediti niścayaḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोणिं वक्षः स्थलं वक्त्रं यः पश्यति परस्त्रियः । मातुर्वापि भगिन्या वा दुहितुः स नराधमः
verses.transliteration: śroṇiṃ vakṣaḥ sthalaṃ vaktraṃ yaḥ paśyati parastriyaḥ / māturvāpi bhaginyā vā duhituḥ sa narādhamaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: भार्गव उवाच अहो श्रुतमपूर्वं किं वचनं तव वक्त्रतः । ब्रान्त्या विनिर्गतं वापि हास्यार्थमथवोदितम्

verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: कामिनां सविकाराणामेतच्छास्त्रनिदर्शनम् । निर्विकारास्य च शिशोर्न दोषः कश्चिदेव हि
verses.transliteration: kāmināṃ savikārāṇāmetacchāstranidarśanam / nirvikārāsya ca śiśorna doṣaḥ kaścideva hi
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: यास्याम्यन्तः पुरं भ्रातस्तव किं तिष्ठ बालक । यथादृष्टं करिष्यामि तत्र यत्समयोचितम्
verses.transliteration: yāsyāmyantaḥ puraṃ bhrātastava kiṃ tiṣṭha bālaka / yathādṛṣṭaṃ kariṣyāmi tatra yatsamayocitam

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव माता तातश्च त्वया नाम निरूपितौ । जगतां पितरौ तौ च पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: tatraiva mātā tātaśca tvayā nāma nirūpitau / jagatāṃ pitarau tau ca pārvatīparameśvarau
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवो राजन्नन्तर्गन्तुं समुद्यतः । विनायकस्तदोत्थाय वारयामास सत्वरम्

verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: वाग्युद्धं च तयोरासीन्मिथो हस्तविकर्षणम् । दृष्ट्वा सकन्दस्तु संभ्रान्तो बोधयामास तौ तदा
verses.transliteration: vāgyuddhaṃ ca tayorāsīnmitho hastavikarṣaṇam / dṛṣṭvā sakandastu saṃbhrānto bodhayāmāsa tau tadā
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: बाहुभ्यां द्वौ समुद्गृह्य पृथगुत्सारितौ तथा । अथ क्रुद्धो गणेशाय भार्गवः परवीरहा । परश्वधं समादाय सप्रक्षेप्तुं समुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: bāhubhyāṃ dvau samudgṛhya pṛthagutsāritau tathā / atha kruddho gaṇeśāya bhārgavaḥ paravīrahā / paraśvadhaṃ samādāya saprakṣeptuṃ samudyataḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा गजाननो भृगुवरं क्रोधात्क्षिपन्तं त्वरा स्वात्मार्थं परशुं तदा निजकरेणोद्धृत्य वेगेन तु । भूर्लोकं भुवः स्वरपि तस्योर्ध्वं महर्वैजनं लोकं चापि तपो ऽथ सत्यमपरं वैकुण्ठमप्यानयत्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā gajānano bhṛguvaraṃ krodhātkṣipantaṃ tvarā svātmārthaṃ paraśuṃ tadā nijakareṇoddhṛtya vegena tu / bhūrlokaṃ bhuvaḥ svarapi tasyordhvaṃ maharvaijanaṃ lokaṃ cāpi tapo 'tha satyamaparaṃ vaikuṇṭhamapyānayat
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योर्ध्वं च विदर्शयन्भृगुवरं गोलोकमीशात्मजो निष्पात्याधरलोकसप्तक मपीत्थं दर्शयामास च । उद्धृत्याथ ततो हि गर्भसलिले प्रक्षप्तमात्रं त्वरा भीतं प्राणपरिप्सुमानयदथो तत्रैव यत्रास्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasyordhvaṃ ca vidarśayanbhṛguvaraṃ golokamīśātmajo niṣpātyādharalokasaptaka mapītthaṃ darśayāmāsa ca / uddhṛtyātha tato hi garbhasalile prakṣaptamātraṃ tvarā bhītaṃ prāṇaparipsumānayadatho tatraiva yatrāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.wordMeaning: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: He seized both of them with his hands and pushed them away from each other.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते एकचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४१॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच एवं संभ्रामितो रामो गणाधीशेन भूपते । हर्षशोकसमाविष्टो विचिन्त्यात्मपराभवम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ekacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 41// vasiṣṭha uvāca evaṃ saṃbhrāmito rāmo gaṇādhīśena bhūpate / harṣaśokasamāviṣṭo vicintyātmaparābhavam
verses.translation: On seeing Ganesa stationed there unaffected and unconcerned in front of him, Rama became much infuriated. He hurled his axe at him.
verses.hindi: इस रीति से भण्डासुर के द्वारा कहने पर उस कुटिलाक्ष ने परमा-
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Ganesa stationed there unaffected and unconcerned in front of him, Rama became much infuriated. He hurled his axe at him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Ganesa stationed there unaffected and unconcerned in front of him, Rama became much infuriated. He hurled his axe at him.

verses.sanskrit: गणेशं चाभितो वीक्ष्य निर्विकारमवस्थितम् । क्रोधाविष्टो भृशं भूत्वा प्राक्षिपत्स्वपरश्वधम्
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśaṃ cābhito vīkṣya nirvikāramavasthitam / krodhāviṣṭo bhṛśaṃ bhūtvā prākṣipatsvaparaśvadham
verses.translation: Perceiving that the axe had been givn to him by his father, GaneSa became desirous of maning it not to go in vain. Hence, he received it with his left tooth (tusk).
verses.hindi: धिक मदोत्कट बलाहक प्रमुख सात सेनापतियों को बुलाया था ।८/ प्रथम तो वलाहक था--दूसरा सुचीमुख था--अस्य कालमुख था--विकर्ण-- विकटानन--करालायु और करकट--ये सात परमाधिक दीयंशाली थे। उन्होंने भण्डासुर को प्रणाम किया था ये युद्ध के कोतूहल में व सत
verses.wordMeaning: Perceiving that the axe had been givn to him by his father, GaneSa became desirous of maning it not to go in vain. Hence, he received it with his left tooth (tusk).
verses.commentary: Sense: Perceiving that the axe had been givn to him by his father, GaneSa became desirous of maning it not to go in vain. Hence, he received it with his left tooth (tusk).

verses.sanskrit: गणेशस्त्वभिवीक्ष्याथ पित्रा दत्तं परश्वधम् । अमोघं कर्त्तुकामस्तु वामे तं दशने ऽग्रहीत्
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśastvabhivīkṣyātha pitrā dattaṃ paraśvadham / amoghaṃ karttukāmastu vāme taṃ daśane 'grahīt

verses.hindi: ये ।६-१०। कै सब कीकसा के पुत्र ये और सभी परस्पर में भाई घे। ये परस्पर में एक दूसरे के सहायक थे और फिर वे लड़ने के लिए नगर के अन्दर से निकलकर चले गये थे ।११। तीन सो अक्षौहिणी सेनाओं के सेनानीगण भी उस समय में उनके पीछे गये थे । ये अपनी ध्वजाओं के
verses.wordMeaning: Chopped off by the axe, the tusk fell on the ground, covered with blood like a mountain that fell on the ground when struck by Indra's thunderbolt.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chopped off by the axe, the tusk fell on the ground, covered with blood like a mountain that fell on the ground when struck by Indra's thunderbolt.

verses.transliteration: sa tu dantaḥ kuṭhāreṇa vicchinno bhūtale 'patat / bhuvi śoṇitasaṃdigdho vajrāhata ivācalaḥ

verses.sanskrit: दन्तपातेन विद्वस्ता साब्धिद्वीपधरा धरा । चकंपे पृथिवीपाल लोकास्त्रासमुपागताः
verses.transliteration: dantapātena vidvastā sābdhidvīpadharā dharā / cakaṃpe pṛthivīpāla lokāstrāsamupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the crashing sound of the fall of the tooth as well as the chaotic uproar of the people raising a hue and cry, the sovereigns (of the world) Parvatl and Sankara came there.
verses.hindi: आनक का परम घोर घोष हो रहा था और सम्पूर्ण विश्व को शंकायमान करते हुए गमन कर रहे थे । नभ का गुण शब्द है वह पूरा विशव शक्रमण हो रहा था
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the crashing sound of the fall of the tooth as well as the chaotic uproar of the people raising a hue and cry, the sovereigns (of the world) Parvatl and Sankara came there.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the crashing sound of the fall of the tooth as well as the chaotic uproar of the people raising a hue and cry, the sovereigns (of the world) Parvatl and Sankara came there.

verses.sanskrit: हाहाकारो महानासी द्देवानां दिवि पश्यताम् । कार्त्तिकेयादयस्तत्र चुक्रुशुर्भृशमातुराः
verses.transliteration: hāhākāro mahānāsī ddevānāṃ divi paśyatām / kārttikeyādayastatra cukruśurbhṛśamāturāḥ
verses.translation: In front of her, Parvatl saw Heramba (i.e. Ganesa) with bent snout and single tusk. She asked Skanda the reason thereof, saying — "What is this?"
verses.wordMeaning: In front of her, Parvatl saw Heramba (i.e. Ganesa) with bent snout and single tusk. She asked Skanda the reason thereof, saying — "What is this?"
verses.commentary: Sense: In front of her, Parvatl saw Heramba (i.e. Ganesa) with bent snout and single tusk. She asked Skanda the reason thereof, saying — "What is this?"

verses.sanskrit: अथ कोलाहलं श्रुत्वा दन्तपातध्वनिं तथा । पार्वतीशङ्करौ तत्र समाजग्मतुरीश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: atha kolāhalaṃ śrutvā dantapātadhvaniṃ tathā / pārvatīśaṅkarau tatra samājagmaturīśvarau
verses.translation: On being asked by his mother, the Commander-in- chief of the Devas Skanda mentioned detailsjfrom the beginning to his mother, even as Rama was listening to it.
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked by his mother, the Commander-in- chief of the Devas Skanda mentioned detailsjfrom the beginning to his mother, even as Rama was listening to it.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked by his mother, the Commander-in- chief of the Devas Skanda mentioned detailsjfrom the beginning to his mother, even as Rama was listening to it.

verses.sanskrit: हेरम्बं पुरतो दृष्ट्वा वक्रतुण्डैकदन्तिनम् । पप्रच्छ स्कन्दं पार्वती किमेतदिति कारणम्
verses.transliteration: herambaṃ purato dṛṣṭvā vakratuṇḍaikadantinam / papraccha skandaṃ pārvatī kimetaditi kāraṇam
verses.translation: On hearing the detailed report of the incident wholly, O king, Parvatl, the mother of all the worlds, became angry. She spoke to Sankara, her dear husband —
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the detailed report of the incident wholly, O king, Parvatl, the mother of all the worlds, became angry. She spoke to Sankara, her dear husband —

verses.sanskrit: स तु पृष्टस्तदा मात्रा सेनानीः सर्वमादितः । वृत्तान्तं कथयामास मात्रे रामस्य शृण्वतः
verses.transliteration: sa tu pṛṣṭastadā mātrā senānīḥ sarvamāditaḥ / vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa mātre rāmasya śṛṇvataḥ
verses.translation: Protect this Bhargava, your excellent disciple, O Sambhu. He will execute all the tasks of yours, his excellent preceptor.
verses.wordMeaning: Protect this Bhargava, your excellent disciple, O Sambhu. He will execute all the tasks of yours, his excellent preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Protect this Bhargava, your excellent disciple, O Sambhu. He will execute all the tasks of yours, his excellent preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: सा श्रुत्वोदन्तमखिलं जगतां जननी नृप । उवाच शङ्करं रुष्टा पार्वती प्राणनायकम्
verses.transliteration: sā śrutvodantamakhilaṃ jagatāṃ jananī nṛpa / uvāca śaṅkaraṃ ruṣṭā pārvatī prāṇanāyakam
verses.translation: I shall not stay here, O lord, since I have been slighted and dishonoured by you. I shall go to the abode of my own father accompanied by both of my sons.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall not stay here, O lord, since I have been slighted and dishonoured by you. I shall go to the abode of my own father accompanied by both of my sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall not stay here, O lord, since I have been slighted and dishonoured by you. I shall go to the abode of my own father accompanied by both of my sons.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच अयं ते भार्गवः शंभो शिष्यः पुत्रः समो ऽभवत् । त्वत्तोलब्ध्वा परं तेजो वर्म त्रैलोक्यजिद्विभो
verses.transliteration: pārvatyuvāca ayaṃ te bhārgavaḥ śaṃbho śiṣyaḥ putraḥ samo 'bhavat / tvattolabdhvā paraṃ tejo varma trailokyajidvibho
verses.translation: O daughter of the mountain, O goddess of infinite good qualities, O lady of beautiful face that surpasses in beauty the moon, keep this son of Jamadagni on your lap. Let your lotus-like hands be placed on his head.
verses.wordMeaning: O daughter of the mountain, O goddess of infinite good qualities, O lady of beautiful face that surpasses in beauty the moon, keep this son of Jamadagni on your lap. Let your lotus-like hands be placed on his head.
verses.commentary: Sense: O daughter of the mountain, O goddess of infinite good qualities, O lady of beautiful face that surpasses in beauty the moon, keep this son of Jamadagni on your lap. Let your lotus-like hands be placed on his head.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तवीर्यार्जुनं संख्ये जितवानूर्जितं नृपम् । स्वकार्यं साधयित्वा तु प्रादात्तुभ्यं च दक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: kārttavīryārjunaṃ saṃkhye jitavānūrjitaṃ nṛpam / svakāryaṃ sādhayitvā tu prādāttubhyaṃ ca dakṣiṇām
verses.translation: O goddess who removes the fear from worldly existence, O gentle lady with whom Sambhu sports about, O destroyer of sins O beautiful lady with the gait of an elephant, protect (Rama) who has ever fallen at your feet. Grant him boons even if he has committed sins.
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess who removes the fear from worldly existence, O gentle lady with whom Sambhu sports about, O destroyer of sins O beautiful lady with the gait of an elephant, protect (Rama) who has ever fallen at your feet. Grant him boons even if he has committed sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess who removes the fear from worldly existence, O gentle lady with whom Sambhu sports about, O destroyer of sins O beautiful lady with the gait of an elephant, protect (Rama) who has ever fallen at your feet. Grant him boons even if he has committed sins.

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते सुतस्य दशन कुठारेण न्यपातयत् । अनेनैव कृतार्थस्त्वं भविष्यसि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yatte sutasya daśana kuṭhāreṇa nyapātayat / anenaiva kṛtārthastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: There are groups of Pramathas who are very strong and who have various forms and sizes. Since your son is the lord of those groups, he is glorified as GaneSa.
verses.wordMeaning: There are groups of Pramathas who are very strong and who have various forms and sizes. Since your son is the lord of those groups, he is glorified as GaneSa.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are groups of Pramathas who are very strong and who have various forms and sizes. Since your son is the lord of those groups, he is glorified as GaneSa.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिमं भार्गवं शम्भो रक्षान्तेवासिसत्तमम् । तव कार्याणि सर्वाणि साधयिष्यति सद्गुरोः
verses.transliteration: tvamimaṃ bhārgavaṃ śambho rakṣāntevāsisattamam / tava kāryāṇi sarvāṇi sādhayiṣyati sadguroḥ
verses.translation: All the cosmic eggs ( Brakm&ntfas ) of the past, present and future are m him. Hence, he is called Lambodara,
verses.wordMeaning: All the cosmic eggs ( Brakm&ntfas ) of the past, present and future are m him. Hence, he is called Lambodara,
verses.commentary: Sense: All the cosmic eggs ( Brakm&ntfas ) of the past, present and future are m him. Hence, he is called Lambodara,

verses.sanskrit: अह नैवात्र तिष्ठामि यत्त्वया विमता विभो । पुत्राभ्यां सहिता यास्ये पितुः स्वस्य निकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: aha naivātra tiṣṭhāmi yattvayā vimatā vibho / putrābhyāṃ sahitā yāsye pituḥ svasya niketanam
verses.translation: Since his head, O gentle lady, had been cut off accidentally and the head of an elephant had been fitted therein, he is declared as Gaj&nana.
verses.hindi: देव्यास्तु सैनिक यत्र तत्र ते जग्मुरुद्धताः
verses.wordMeaning: Since his head, O gentle lady, had been cut off accidentally and the head of an elephant had been fitted therein, he is declared as Gaj&nana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his head, O gentle lady, had been cut off accidentally and the head of an elephant had been fitted therein, he is declared as Gaj&nana.

verses.sanskrit: संतो भुजिष्यातनयं सत्कुर्वन्त्यात्मपुत्रवत् । भवता तु कृतोनैव सत्कारो वचसापि हि
verses.transliteration: saṃto bhujiṣyātanayaṃ satkurvantyātmaputravat / bhavatā tu kṛtonaiva satkāro vacasāpi hi
verses.translation: The moon that rose up on the fourth day (of the lunar fortnight) was cursed by Darbhin.1 Hence he became sick. But he was held up by this son of yours on his forehead. Therefore, he is remembered as Bhdlacandra.
verses.wordMeaning: The moon that rose up on the fourth day (of the lunar fortnight) was cursed by Darbhin.1 Hence he became sick. But he was held up by this son of yours on his forehead. Therefore, he is remembered as Bhdlacandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The moon that rose up on the fourth day (of the lunar fortnight) was cursed by Darbhin.1 Hence he became sick. But he was held up by this son of yours on his forehead. Therefore, he is remembered as Bhdlacandra.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनस्तनयस्यास्य ततो यास्यामि दुःखिता । वसिष्ठ उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं पार्वत्या भगवान्भवः
verses.transliteration: ātmanastanayasyāsya tato yāsyāmi duḥkhitā / vasiṣṭha uvāca etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ pārvatyā bhagavānbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, on the eve of the battle between the Devas and the Asuras, he was worshipped by the groups of heaven-dwellers. He dispelled the obstacles of his worshippers. Therefore, he is remembered- as Vighnandiaka.
verses.hindi: ये मद से उद्धत कंकसेय तोन सो अक्षोहिणी उस सेना को लेकर इस सम्पूर्ण विश्व में प्रवेश मानों कर रहे बे वहां से रबाना हुए ये ।१४। ये धारण किए हुए क्रोध से लाल हो रहे ये और सूर्यमण्डल के समान उद्दीप्त कंकट थे । ये शस्त्रों के आभरणों से परम उद्दीप्त गो और इनके दीप्त एवं
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, on the eve of the battle between the Devas and the Asuras, he was worshipped by the groups of heaven-dwellers. He dispelled the obstacles of his worshippers. Therefore, he is remembered- as Vighnandiaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, on the eve of the battle between the Devas and the Asuras, he was worshipped by the groups of heaven-dwellers. He dispelled the obstacles of his worshippers. Therefore, he is remembered- as Vighnandiaka.

verses.sanskrit: नोवाच किञ्चिद्वचनं साधु वासाधु भूपते । सस्मार मनसा कृष्णं प्रणतक्लेशनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: novāca kiñcidvacanaṃ sādhu vāsādhu bhūpate / sasmāra manasā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇatakleśanāśanam
verses.translation: Today, O gentle lady, he has been made Ekadanta (Having a single tusk) by this Rama after making the tusk fall off accidentally.
verses.hindi: ऊध्वंकेश शे ऐसे परम घोर ये वहाँ से चल दिये थो ।१६। सम्पूर्ण जगत के विजय करते बाले महान भण्डासुर के द्वारा परम उद्धत इनको समस्त सात लोफों का प्रमथन करने के लिए ही भेजा गया था ।१७। जीतने की कामना बाले सातों लोकों को विमदित करने वाले उसने अपनी दुष्ट बुद्धि से ही
verses.wordMeaning: Today, O gentle lady, he has been made Ekadanta (Having a single tusk) by this Rama after making the tusk fall off accidentally.
verses.commentary: Sense: Today, O gentle lady, he has been made Ekadanta (Having a single tusk) by this Rama after making the tusk fall off accidentally.

verses.sanskrit: गोलोकनाथं गोपीशं नानानुनयकोविदम् । स्मृतमात्रो ऽथ भगवान् केशवः प्रणतार्त्तिहा । आजगाम दयासिंधुर्भक्तवश्यो ऽखिलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: golokanāthaṃ gopīśaṃ nānānunayakovidam / smṛtamātro 'tha bhagavān keśavaḥ praṇatārttihā / ājagāma dayāsiṃdhurbhaktavaśyo 'khileśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O beloved one of Hara, in a future creation of Brahma, his snout shall become bent. Hence, he is remembered by scholars as Vakralunda.
verses.hindi: महान बलवान इनको ललिता देवी की सेना में भेजा था ।१५। ये हाथों में छश्रों को ऊपर उठाते हुए रणस्थल में जा रहे भे ओर फिर शक्ति सेना से सामने बड़े ही क्रोध के साथ घावा बोल दिया था।१६। बार-बार किल- कारियों की ध्वतियों से दों दिशाओं को घोषित कर रहे थे तथा जहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: O beloved one of Hara, in a future creation of Brahma, his snout shall become bent. Hence, he is remembered by scholars as Vakralunda.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beloved one of Hara, in a future creation of Brahma, his snout shall become bent. Hence, he is remembered by scholars as Vakralunda.

verses.sanskrit: मेघश्यामो विशदवदनो रत्नकेयूरहारो विद्युद्वासा मकरसदृशे कुण्डले संदधानः । बर्हापीडं मणिगणयुतं बिभ्रदीषत्स्मितास्यो गोपीनाथो गदितसुयशाः कौस्तुभोद्भासिवक्षाः
verses.transliteration: meghaśyāmo viśadavadano ratnakeyūrahāro vidyudvāsā makarasadṛśe kuṇḍale saṃdadhānaḥ / barhāpīḍaṃ maṇigaṇayutaṃ bibhradīṣatsmitāsyo gopīnātho gaditasuyaśāḥ kaustubhodbhāsivakṣāḥ
verses.translation: Thus there are many names of your son, O Parvatl. On being remembered, they dispel sins of the three units of time (past, present, future).
verses.hindi: पर देवी की सेना थी वहाँ पर उद्धत थे ।२०। ललिता देवी की सेना भी सन्नद्ध थी और शस्त्रास्त्रो से वह सेना परम भीषण थी । देवी की सेना भी अपनी भूकूटी तानकर कठोरता से शत्रु के समक्ष में हो गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus there are many names of your son, O Parvatl. On being remembered, they dispel sins of the three units of time (past, present, future).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus there are many names of your son, O Parvatl. On being remembered, they dispel sins of the three units of time (past, present, future).

verses.sanskrit: राधया सहितः श्रीमान् श्रीदाम्ना चापराजितः
verses.transliteration: rādhayā sahitaḥ śrīmān śrīdāmnā cāparājitaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words uttered by the very noble- souled Krsna, Parvati, the goddess of all the worlds, the lady of splendid face, became surprised.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words uttered by the very noble- souled Krsna, Parvati, the goddess of all the worlds, the lady of splendid face, became surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words uttered by the very noble- souled Krsna, Parvati, the goddess of all the worlds, the lady of splendid face, became surprised.

verses.sanskrit: मुष्णंस्तेजांसि सर्वेषां स्वरुचा ज्ञानवारिधिः । अथैनमागतं दृष्ट्वा शिवः संहृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: muṣṇaṃstejāṃsi sarveṣāṃ svarucā jñānavāridhiḥ / athainamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā śivaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: When Parvati did not offer any reply in the pre- sence of Siva, goddess Radha, identical with the eternal form of Siva spoke thus.
verses.wordMeaning: When Parvati did not offer any reply in the pre- sence of Siva, goddess Radha, identical with the eternal form of Siva spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Parvati did not offer any reply in the pre- sence of Siva, goddess Radha, identical with the eternal form of Siva spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपत्य यथान्यायं पूजयामास चागतम् । प्रवेश्याभ्यन्तरे वेश्मराधया सहितं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ pūjayāmāsa cāgatam / praveśyābhyantare veśmarādhayā sahitaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: In the heart of Siva, Visnu has assumed your form and in the heart of Visnu, Siva has assumed my form.2
verses.wordMeaning: In the heart of Siva, Visnu has assumed your form and in the heart of Visnu, Siva has assumed my form.2
verses.commentary: Sense: In the heart of Siva, Visnu has assumed your form and in the heart of Visnu, Siva has assumed my form.2

verses.sanskrit: रत्नसिंहासने नम्ये सदारं स न्यवेशयत् । थ तत्र गता देवी पार्वती तनयान्विता
verses.transliteration: ratnasiṃhāsane namye sadāraṃ sa nyaveśayat / tha tatra gatā devī pārvatī tanayānvitā
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: ननाम चरणान्प्रभ्वोः पुत्राभ्यां सहिता मुदा । थ रामो ऽपि तत्रैव गत्वा नमितकन्धरः
verses.transliteration: nanāma caraṇānprabhvoḥ putrābhyāṃ sahitā mudā / tha rāmo 'pi tatraiva gatvā namitakandharaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्याश्चरणोपान्ते पपाताकुलमानसः । सा यदा नाभ्यनन्दत्तं भार्गवं प्रणतं पुरः
verses.transliteration: pārvatyāścaraṇopānte papātākulamānasaḥ / sā yadā nābhyanandattaṃ bhārgavaṃ praṇataṃ puraḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: तदोवाच जगन्नाथः पार्वतीं प्रीणयन्गिरा
verses.transliteration: tadovāca jagannāthaḥ pārvatīṃ prīṇayangirā
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्म उवाच अयि नगनं दिनि निन्दितचन्द्रमुखि त्वमिमं जमदग्निसुतम् । नय निजहस्तसरोजसमर्पितम्स्तकमङ्कमनन्तगुणे
verses.transliteration: śrīkṛṣma uvāca ayi naganaṃ dini ninditacandramukhi tvamimaṃ jamadagnisutam / naya nijahastasarojasamarpitamstakamaṅkamanantaguṇe
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: भवभयहारिणि शंभुविहारिणि कल्मषनाशिनि कुंभिगते । तव चरणे पतितं सततं कृतकिल्बिषमप्यव देहि वरम्
verses.transliteration: bhavabhayahāriṇi śaṃbhuvihāriṇi kalmaṣanāśini kuṃbhigate / tava caraṇe patitaṃ satataṃ kṛtakilbiṣamapyava dehi varam
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुणु देवि महाभागे वेदोक्तं वचनं मम । यच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षिता नूनं भविष्यसि न संशयः । विनायकस्ते तनयो महात्मा महतां महान्
verses.transliteration: śruṇu devi mahābhāge vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ mama / yacchrutvā harṣitā nūnaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ / vināyakaste tanayo mahātmā mahatāṃ mahān
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: हे मुने ! उनमें कुछ तो पाशधारिणी थीं--कुछ मुसलों को ग्रहण किये थीं--दूसरी चक्र धारिणी थीं--कुछ के पास मुद्गर थे तो कुछ पट्टिश लिये थीं तथा कुछ धनुष ग्रहण किये थीं ।२२। ललिता की सेना में संगत अनेक प्रकार की शक्तियाँ थीं । वे सहस्रों की संख्या में वहाँ पर समापतित
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: यं कामः क्रोध उद्वेगो भयं नाविशते कदा । वेदस्मृतिपुराणेषु संहितासु च भामिनि
verses.transliteration: yaṃ kāmaḥ krodha udvego bhayaṃ nāviśate kadā / vedasmṛtipurāṇeṣu saṃhitāsu ca bhāmini
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: हो गयीं थी मानो हैत्यों के सागरों का पान ही कर रही थी ।२३। हैत्यगण कह रहे ये--हे दुष्टाओ ! तुम नारियों में महान अधम हो--आओ ! तुम पापिनी हो। जो जड़ आशयों बाले हैं उनको ही तुम लोग अपनी माया के परिग्रहों से मोहित कर लिया करती हो ।२४। आज तो हम लोग तुम सबको
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: नामान्यस्योपदिष्टानि सुपुण्यानि महात्मभिः । यानि तानि प्रवक्ष्यामि निखिलाघहराणि च
verses.transliteration: nāmānyasyopadiṣṭāni supuṇyāni mahātmabhiḥ / yāni tāni pravakṣyāmi nikhilāghaharāṇi ca
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: प्रमराज के घर पर पहुँचा देंगे । हमारे पास ऐसे अत्यन्त भीषण वाण हैं जो फूत्कार मारते हुए भुजंगों के ही तुल्य हैं उन्हीं से तुम मृत्यु प्राप्त करोगी । इस तरह से शक्तियों को भत्संना देते हुए ही उन दानवों ने युद्ध किया था ।२५। किसी शक्ति ने देत्येस्द्र के कष्ठ को पट्टिश के प्रहार ते काट दिया था।
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमथानां गणा ये च नानारूपा महाबलाः । तेषामीशस्त्वयं यस्माद्गणेशस्तेन कीर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: pramathānāṃ gaṇā ye ca nānārūpā mahābalāḥ / teṣāmīśastvayaṃ yasmādgaṇeśastena kīrttitaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: काटने से जो उसके कण्ठ से रुधिर निकला था वह ऊपर की ओर गया था ।२६। वहाँ पर बहुत से गिद्ध लगे हुए थे जिन्होने एक मण्डल सा बना लिया था। उन्हीं के द्वारा यमराज का एक छत्र सा बन गया था ।२७। किसी शक्ति ने रण में मुक्त शक्‍्त्यायुध देत्य को एक ही वाण के द्वारा काट दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: भूतानि च भविष्याणि वर्त्तमानानि यानि च । ब्रह्माण्डान्यखिलान्येव यस्मिंल्लंबोदरः स तु
verses.transliteration: bhūtāni ca bhaviṣyāṇi varttamānāni yāni ca / brahmāṇḍānyakhilānyeva yasmiṃllaṃbodaraḥ sa tu
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: एका तु गजमारूढा कस्यचिद्वैत्यदुर्मते: । उरः स्थले स्वकरिणा वप्राघातमशिक्षयत्
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्थिरो देवयोगेन च्छिन्नं संयोजितं पुनः । गजस्य शिरसा देवितेन प्रोक्तो गजाननः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sthiro devayogena cchinnaṃ saṃyojitaṃ punaḥ / gajasya śirasā devitena prokto gajānanaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
