verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थ्यामुदितश्चन्द्रो दर्भिणा शप्त आतुरः । अनेन विधृतो भाले भालचन्द्रस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: caturthyāmuditaścandro darbhiṇā śapta āturaḥ / anena vidhṛto bhāle bhālacandrastataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: शप्तः पुरा सप्तभिस्तु मुनिभिः संक्षयं गतः । जातवेदा दीपितो ऽभूद्येनासौशूर्पकर्मकः
verses.transliteration: śaptaḥ purā saptabhistu munibhiḥ saṃkṣayaṃ gataḥ / jātavedā dīpito 'bhūdyenāsauśūrpakarmakaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे पूजितो दिविषद्गणैः । विघ्नं निवारयामास विघ्ननाशस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: purā devāsure yuddhe pūjito diviṣadgaṇaiḥ / vighnaṃ nivārayāmāsa vighnanāśastataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यायं देवि रामेण कुठारेण निपात्य च । दशनं दैवतो भद्रे ह्येकदन्तः कृतो ऽमुना
verses.transliteration: adyāyaṃ devi rāmeṇa kuṭhāreṇa nipātya ca / daśanaṃ daivato bhadre hyekadantaḥ kṛto 'munā
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यत्यथ पर्याये ब्रह्मणो हरवल्लभे । वक्रीभविष्यत्तुण्डत्वाद्वक्रतुण्डः स्मृतो बुधैः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyatyatha paryāye brahmaṇo haravallabhe / vakrībhaviṣyattuṇḍatvādvakratuṇḍaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: अभ्यंतरं शत्तिसेना द॑ त्यानां प्रविवेश ह ।
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तवास्य पुत्रस्य संति नामानि पार्वति । स्मरणात्पापहारीणि त्रिकालानुगतान्यपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tavāsya putrasya saṃti nāmāni pārvati / smaraṇātpāpahārīṇi trikālānugatānyapi
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मात्त्रयोदशीकल्पात्पूर्वस्मिन्दशमीभवे । मयास्मै तु वरो दत्तः सर्गदेवाग्रपूजने
verses.transliteration: asmāttrayodaśīkalpātpūrvasmindaśamībhave / mayāsmai tu varo dattaḥ sargadevāgrapūjane
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: एक शक्ति हाथी पर समारूढ़ होकर युद्ध कर रही थी और उसने दुष्ट बुद्धि वाले देत्य के उरःस्थल में अपने हाथी के द्वारा वप्नाघात की शिक्षा दी थी ।२६। किसी शक्ति ने उस हाथी के जिस पर प्रतिभट बैठा हुआ था, कुम्भ स्थल में खंग का प्रहार किया था और उस हाथी के स्वप्रिय को मार
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्मादिसंस्कारे गर्भाधानादिके ऽपि च । यात्रायां च वणिज्यादौ युद्धे देवार्चने शुभे
verses.transliteration: jātakarmādisaṃskāre garbhādhānādike 'pi ca / yātrāyāṃ ca vaṇijyādau yuddhe devārcane śubhe
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: डाला था।३०। अपने हाथ से छोड़े हुए चक्र के द्वारा किसी असुर के धनुष के दो दुकड़े करके स्वञ्ज की प्रतिमा बना दी थो ।३१। अन्य शक्ति के तीण शरों से विरोधियों का वघ कर दिया था । कृपाण पद्मा ने अपनी रोमालि में मुद किया या ।३२। किसी शक्ति ते मुद्गर के प्रहार से विरोधियों का
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: संकष्टे काम्यसिद्ध्यर्थं पूजयेद्यो गजाननम् । तस्य सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्ध्यन्त्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: saṃkaṣṭe kāmyasiddhyarthaṃ pūjayedyo gajānanam / tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: चूर्ण किया था। उस ने अपने रथ के पहिए के नितम्ब का उसके द्वारा मुद किया था अर्थात् आनन्द प्राप्त किया था ।३३। किसी दानवो के स्वामी के रथ के कूबर को अपने उग्र खग के द्वारा छेदन करती हुई अपनी प्रीति का विस्तार किया शा ।३४। शक्ति की सेना दॅत्यों के अन्दर प्रवेश कर गयो
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्तं तु समाकर्ण्य कृष्णेन सुमहात्मना । पार्वती जगतां नाथा विस्मितासीच्छुभानना
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktaṃ tu samākarṇya kṛṣṇena sumahātmanā / pārvatī jagatāṃ nāthā vismitāsīcchubhānanā
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: शी और दुधंर वेत्यों की सेना भी शक्ति सेना के भीतर प्रवेश कर गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: यदा नैवोत्तरं प्रादात्पार्वती शिवसन्निधौ । तदा राधाब्रवीद्देवीं शिवरूपा सनातनी
verses.transliteration: yadā naivottaraṃ prādātpārvatī śivasannidhau / tadā rādhābravīddevīṃ śivarūpā sanātanī
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीराधोवाच । प्रकृतिः पुरुषश्चोभावन्योन्याश्रयविग्रहौ । द्विधा भिन्नौ प्रकाशेते प्रपञ्चे ऽस्मिन् यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: śrīrādhovāca / prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścobhāvanyonyāśrayavigrahau / dvidhā bhinnau prakāśete prapañce 'smin yathā tathā
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं चाहमावयोर्देवि भेदो नैवास्ति कश्चन । विष्णुस्त्वमहमेवास्मि शिवो द्विगुणतां गतः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ cāhamāvayordevi bhedo naivāsti kaścana / viṣṇustvamahamevāsmi śivo dviguṇatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य हृदये विष्णुर्भवत्या रूपमास्थितः । मम रूपं समास्थाय विष्णोश्च हृदये शिवः
verses.transliteration: śivasya hṛdaye viṣṇurbhavatyā rūpamāsthitaḥ / mama rūpaṃ samāsthāya viṣṇośca hṛdaye śivaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: एवं परवृत्ते समरे वीराणां च भयंकरे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: एष रामो महाभागे वैष्णवः शैवतां गतः । गणेशो ऽयं शिवः साक्षाद्वैष्णवत्वं समास्थितः
verses.transliteration: eṣa rāmo mahābhāge vaiṣṇavaḥ śaivatāṃ gataḥ / gaṇeśo 'yaṃ śivaḥ sākṣādvaiṣṇavatvaṃ samāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: एतयोरोवयोः प्रभवोश्चापि भेदो न दृश्यते । एवामुक्त्वा तु सा राधा क्रोडे कृत्वा गजाननम्
verses.transliteration: etayorovayoḥ prabhavoścāpi bhedo na dṛśyate / evāmuktvā tu sā rādhā kroḍe kṛtvā gajānanam
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय पस्पर्श स्वहस्तेन कपोलके । स्पृष्टमात्रे कपोले तु क्षतं पूर्त्तिमुदागतम्
verses.transliteration: mūrdhnyupāghrāya pasparśa svahastena kapolake / spṛṣṭamātre kapole tu kṣataṃ pūrttimudāgatam
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वती मुप्रसन्नाभूदनुनीताथ राधया । पादयोः पतितं राममुत्थाप्य निजपाणिना
verses.transliteration: pārvatī muprasannābhūdanunītātha rādhayā / pādayoḥ patitaṃ rāmamutthāpya nijapāṇinā
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोडीचकार सुप्रीता मूर्ध्न्यु पाघ्राय पार्वती । एवं तयोस्तु सत्कारं दृष्ट्वा रामगणेशयोः
verses.transliteration: kroḍīcakāra suprītā mūrdhnyu pāghrāya pārvatī / evaṃ tayostu satkāraṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmagaṇeśayoḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: नीर और क्षीर के ही समान शक्ति सेना ओर असुरों की सेना एक- दम मिल गयीं थौं । उस समय में युद्ध काल में संकुलाकारता को प्राप्त हो गया था ।३६। शक्तियों के खंगों के पात से देत्यों के गज कटी हुई सूड और दांतों वाले हो गये ये और बे मत्त महान् क्रीड़ों के तुल्य ही हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णः स्कन्दमुपाकृष्य स्वाङ्के प्रेम्णा न्यवेशयत् । अथ शंभुरपि प्रीतः श्रीदामानम् पस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaḥ skandamupākṛṣya svāṅke premṇā nyaveśayat / atha śaṃbhurapi prītaḥ śrīdāmānam pasthitam
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: ।३७। इस प्रकार से वीरों का युद्ध प्रवृत्त हुआ था जो कि कातरता को प्राप्त होने वाले मनुष्य तो उसका स्मरण करने में भी सवंथा असमर्थ हैं और भीषणों का वह शस्त्रों का व्यापार भी महान् भीषण तथा दुर्गम था
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: स्वोत्संगे स्थापयामास प्रेम्णा मत्कृत्य मानदः
verses.transliteration: svotsaṃge sthāpayāmāsa premṇā matkṛtya mānadaḥ
verses.translation: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.hindi: बलाहक महागरृध्र--वज्ञतीक्ष्ण मुख आदिक-कालदण्डोपम--जंघा काण्ड में प्रचण्ड पराक्रम-संसार गुप्त नाम वाला आगे पूर्व में समुत्थित हुआ था । उसका धूम की तरह धूसर आकार घा और पंखों को जब क्षेपण करता था तब बहुत भयंकर हो जाता था ।३६-४०। वह युद्ध करने में दुमंद अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Pur&nas, Bd. P. advocates the- identity of Siva and Vi*nu — a sort of a rapproachement between Vaifpavism and Saivism.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते द्विचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४२॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच एवं सुस्निग्धचित्तेषु तेषु तिष्ठत्सु भूपते । भवान्युत्संगतो रामः समुत्थाय कृताजलिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite dvicatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 42// vasiṣṭha uvāca evaṃ susnigdhacitteṣu teṣu tiṣṭhatsu bhūpate / bhavānyutsaṃgato rāmaḥ samutthāya kṛtājaliḥ
verses.translation: The fact that Pradhana ( the primordial principle of Prakrti) is glorified as one whose qualities become manifest, one that evolves ( units of) time and number one who is the primary cause of Samsara. O mother, let the fail of your vision (i.e. glance) which makes artificial falls, protect me now.
verses.hindi: प्रकार के वाहनों के ऊपर आरोहण करके उसने युद्ध किया था । बह दोनों पंखों को फैला कर मयानक घोषों के द्वारा आधे कोश तक स्थित हुआ शा । अगारों के कुण्ड की भाँति अपनी चौंच को फैलाकर सेना का विदा-
verses.wordMeaning: The fact that Pradhana ( the primordial principle of Prakrti) is glorified as one whose qualities become manifest, one that evolves ( units of) time and number one who is the primary cause of Samsara. O mother, let the fail of your vision (i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The fact that Pradhana ( the primordial principle of Prakrti) is glorified as one whose qualities become manifest, one that evolves ( units of) time and number one who is the primary cause of Samsara. O mother, let the fail of your vision (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव प्रयतो भूत्वा निर्विशेष विशेषवत् । अद्वयं द्वैतमापन्नं निर्गुणं सगुणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā nirviśeṣa viśeṣavat / advayaṃ dvaitamāpannaṃ nirguṇaṃ saguṇātmakam
verses.translation: Let that god who eats with six mouths (i.e. Karttikeya) protect me always — that god who destroys the race of demons, who dispels the distress of the Devas*; who develops the race of the Pramathas (Siva's attendants), who reveals all lores, who made the city of Ka£! all on a sudden, who grants all blessings to the devotees and who conquered Varuna.
verses.wordMeaning: Let that god who eats with six mouths (i.e. Karttikeya) protect me always — that god who destroys the race of demons, who dispels the distress of the Devas*; who develops the race of the Pramathas (Siva's attendants), who reveals all lores,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let that god who eats with six mouths (i.e. Karttikeya) protect me always — that god who destroys the race of demons, who dispels the distress of the Devas*; who develops the race of the Pramathas (Siva's attendants), who reveals all lores,…

verses.sanskrit: राम उवाच प्रकृतिविकृतिजातं विश्वमेतद्विधातुं मम कियदनुभातं वैभवं तत्प्रमातुम् । अविदिततनुनामाभीष्टवस्त्वेकधामाभवदथ भव भामा पातु मां पूर्णकामा
verses.transliteration: rāma uvāca prakṛtivikṛtijātaṃ viśvametadvidhātuṃ mama kiyadanubhātaṃ vaibhavaṃ tatpramātum / aviditatanunāmābhīṣṭavastvekadhāmābhavadatha bhava bhāmā pātu māṃ pūrṇakāmā
verses.translation: Let not (Vighnesvara) be the person who destroys fame — (Vighnesvara) who habitually stays near Hara (Siva), who does the graceful work of serving Krsna, who makes the people who bow down to him, shine, who makes the cowherdess lasses laugh, who is respected even by Hara, who is single- minded by being devoted to the lord of Gowherdesses (i.e. Krsna) and who has understood many types of expedients.
verses.hindi: रण करके वह संहार गुप्त महागिद्ध था जिसके बहुत क्रूर नेत्र थे। रण में धनुष को खींचकर बलाहक को बहुत ऊँचा उठा लिया झा
verses.wordMeaning: Let not (Vighnesvara) be the person who destroys fame — (Vighnesvara) who habitually stays near Hara (Siva), who does the graceful work of serving Krsna, who makes the people who bow down to him, shine, who makes the cowherdess lasses laugh, who is respected even by Hara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let not (Vighnesvara) be the person who destroys fame — (Vighnesvara) who habitually stays near Hara (Siva), who does the graceful work of serving Krsna, who makes the people who bow down to him, shine, who makes the cowherdess lasses laugh, who is respected even by Hara,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रकटितगुणाभानं कालसंख्याविधानं सकलभवनिदानं कीर्त्यते यत्प्रधानम् । तदिह निखिलतातः संबभूवोक्षपातः कृतकृतकनिपातः पातु मामद्य मातः
verses.transliteration: prakaṭitaguṇābhānaṃ kālasaṃkhyāvidhānaṃ sakalabhavanidānaṃ kīrtyate yatpradhānam / tadiha nikhilatātaḥ saṃbabhūvokṣapātaḥ kṛtakṛtakanipātaḥ pātu māmadya mātaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna deserves to forgive my offence though it be too much grievous, Krsna who has restrained his mind and directed it towards the lord (Supreme Lord —;Siva), who has dispelled the obstacles of his devotees, who has removed Multitudes of sins, who is the bestower of knowledge upon those* who have no wealth, who possesses all weighty good qualities and who lies in the lap of Radha.
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna deserves to forgive my offence though it be too much grievous, Krsna who has restrained his mind and directed it towards the lord (Supreme Lord —;Siva), who has dispelled the obstacles of his devotees, who has removed Multitudes of sins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna deserves to forgive my offence though it be too much grievous, Krsna who has restrained his mind and directed it towards the lord (Supreme Lord —;Siva), who has dispelled the obstacles of his devotees, who has removed Multitudes of sins,…

verses.sanskrit: दनुजकुलविनाशीलेखपाताविनाशी प्रथमकुलविकाशी सर्वविद्याप्रकाशी । प्रसभरचितकाशी भक्तदत्ताखिलाशीरवतु विजितपाशी मांसदा षण्मुखाशी
verses.transliteration: danujakulavināśīlekhapātāvināśī prathamakulavikāśī sarvavidyāprakāśī / prasabharacitakāśī bhaktadattākhilāśīravatu vijitapāśī māṃsadā ṣaṇmukhāśī
verses.translation: Let that leader protect me as I bow dovyn to the leader who is glorified as Radha, who is propitiated by the people at the times of outcome, maintenance and annihilation of the Universe, who makes others understand the word that is conducive to the appreciation of the nectar of love exuding from the mouth of the Lord, who is the sovereign of the Rasa dance, who is the goddess oi the Rasikas (who have aesthetic sense) and who delights persons belonging to her fold by means of her strict adherence to the heart of her lover.
verses.wordMeaning: Let that leader protect me as I bow dovyn to the leader who is glorified as Radha, who is propitiated by the people at the times of outcome, maintenance and annihilation of the Universe,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let that leader protect me as I bow dovyn to the leader who is glorified as Radha, who is propitiated by the people at the times of outcome, maintenance and annihilation of the Universe,…

verses.sanskrit: हरनिकट निवासी कृष्णसेवाविलासी प्रणतजनविभासी गोपकन्याप्रहासी । हरकृतबहुमानो गोपिकेशैकतानो विदितबहुविधानो जायतां कीर्तिहा नौ
verses.transliteration: haranikaṭa nivāsī kṛṣṇasevāvilāsī praṇatajanavibhāsī gopakanyāprahāsī / harakṛtabahumāno gopikeśaikatāno viditabahuvidhāno jāyatāṃ kīrtihā nau
verses.translation: Let her ever be pleased, she from whose womb was born the Ativirdf (extremely Superior Being) and of whom,
verses.wordMeaning: Let her ever be pleased, she from whose womb was born the Ativirdf (extremely Superior Being) and of whom,
verses.commentary: Sense: Let her ever be pleased, she from whose womb was born the Ativirdf (extremely Superior Being) and of whom,

verses.sanskrit: प्रभुनियतमाना यो नुन्नभक्तान्तरायो त्दृतदुरितनिकायो ज्ञानदातापरायोः । सकलगुणगरिष्ठो राधिकाङ्केनिविष्टो मम कृतमपराधं क्षन्तुमर्हत्वगाधम्
verses.transliteration: prabhuniyatamānā yo nunnabhaktāntarāyo tdṛtaduritanikāyo jñānadātāparāyoḥ / sakalaguṇagariṣṭho rādhikāṅkeniviṣṭo mama kṛtamaparādhaṃ kṣantumarhatvagādham
verses.translation: Let Krsna be merciful to me, Kr$na who is the lord
verses.wordMeaning: Let Krsna be merciful to me, Kr$na who is the lord
verses.commentary: Sense: Let Krsna be merciful to me, Kr$na who is the lord

verses.sanskrit: या राधा जगदुद्भवस्थितिलयेष्वाराध्यते वा जनैः शब्दं बोधयतीशवक्त्रंविगलत्प्रेमामृतास्वादनम् । रासेशी रसिकेश्वरी रमणत्दृन्निष्ठानिजानन्दिनी नेत्री सा परिपातु मामवनतं राधेति य कीर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: yā rādhā jagadudbhavasthitilayeṣvārādhyate vā janaiḥ śabdaṃ bodhayatīśavaktraṃvigalatpremāmṛtāsvādanam / rāseśī rasikeśvarī ramaṇatdṛnniṣṭhānijānandinī netrī sā paripātu māmavanataṃ rādheti ya kīrtyate
verses.translation: After eulogising thus the Supreme one, the son of Jamadagni stopped. He who had understood the meanings of all principles had the hair of his body standing on their ends
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising thus the Supreme one, the son of Jamadagni stopped. He who had understood the meanings of all principles had the hair of his body standing on their ends
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising thus the Supreme one, the son of Jamadagni stopped. He who had understood the meanings of all principles had the hair of his body standing on their ends

verses.sanskrit: यस्या गर्भसमुद्भवो ह्यतिविराड्यस्यांशभूतो विराट् यन्नाभ्यंबुरुहोद्भवेन विधिनैकान्तोपदिष्टेन वै सृष्टं सर्वमिदं चराचरमयं विश्वं च यद्रोमसु ब्रह्माण्डानि विभान्ति तस्य जननी शश्वत्प्रसन्नास्तु सा
verses.transliteration: yasyā garbhasamudbhavo hyativirāḍyasyāṃśabhūto virāṭ yannābhyaṃburuhodbhavena vidhinaikāntopadiṣṭena vai sṛṣṭaṃ sarvamidaṃ carācaramayaṃ viśvaṃ ca yadromasu brahmāṇḍāni vibhānti tasya jananī śaśvatprasannāstu sā
verses.translation: O prominent member of the family of Bhfgu f You are now a spiritually accomplished person, due to my bless- ings. Now onwards, O dear one, be the most excellent person in this world.
verses.wordMeaning: O prominent member of the family of Bhfgu f You are now a spiritually accomplished person, due to my bless- ings. Now onwards, O dear one, be the most excellent person in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O prominent member of the family of Bhfgu f You are now a spiritually accomplished person, due to my bless- ings. Now onwards, O dear one, be the most excellent person in this world.

verses.sanskrit: पायाद्यः स चराचरस्य जगतो व्यापी विभुः सच्चिदानन्दाब्धिः प्रकटस्थितो विलसति प्रेमान्धया राधया । कृष्णः पूर्णतमो ममोपरि दयाक्लिन्नान्तरः स्तात्सदा येनाहं सुकृती भवामि च भवाम्यानन्दलीनान्तरः
verses.transliteration: pāyādyaḥ sa carācarasya jagato vyāpī vibhuḥ saccidānandābdhiḥ prakaṭasthito vilasati premāndhayā rādhayā / kṛṣṇaḥ pūrṇatamo mamopari dayāklinnāntaraḥ stātsadā yenāhaṃ sukṛtī bhavāmi ca bhavāmyānandalīnāntaraḥ
verses.translation: Kindness should be shown towards the miserable and the wretched ones, by one who wishes for excellent welfare. Yoga should be practised and the destruction of the enemies should be done as well.
verses.wordMeaning: Kindness should be shown towards the miserable and the wretched ones, by one who wishes for excellent welfare. Yoga should be practised and the destruction of the enemies should be done as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kindness should be shown towards the miserable and the wretched ones, by one who wishes for excellent welfare. Yoga should be practised and the destruction of the enemies should be done as well.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच स्तुत्वैवं जामदग्न्यस्तु विरराम ह तत्परम् । विज्ञाताखिलतत्त्वार्थो हृष्टरोमा कृतार्थवत्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca stutvaivaṃ jāmadagnyastu virarāma ha tatparam / vijñātākhilatattvārtho hṛṣṭaromā kṛtārthavat
verses.translation: After reaching your house, render service to your parents; perform penance at the proper time. Thereby achieve- ment of the spiritual goal shall be within your reach'*.
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching your house, render service to your parents; perform penance at the proper time. Thereby achieve- ment of the spiritual goal shall be within your reach'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching your house, render service to your parents; perform penance at the proper time. Thereby achieve- ment of the spiritual goal shall be within your reach'*.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच प्रसन्नात्मा कृष्णः कमललोचनः । भार्गवं प्रणतं भक्त्या कृपापात्रं पुरस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: athovāca prasannātmā kṛṣṇaḥ kamalalocanaḥ / bhārgavaṃ praṇataṃ bhaktyā kṛpāpātraṃ purasthitam
verses.translation: The lord of Rad ha then lifted up Ganesa from the lap of Radha, embraced him closely and made him friendly to Rama.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of Rad ha then lifted up Ganesa from the lap of Radha, embraced him closely and made him friendly to Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Rad ha then lifted up Ganesa from the lap of Radha, embraced him closely and made him friendly to Rama.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्म उवाच सिद्धो ऽसि भार्गवेन्द्र त्वं प्रसादान्मम संप्रतम् । अद्य प्रभृति वत्सास्मिंल्लोके श्रेष्ठतमो भव
verses.transliteration: kṛṣma uvāca siddho 'si bhārgavendra tvaṃ prasādānmama saṃpratam / adya prabhṛti vatsāsmiṃlloke śreṣṭhatamo bhava
verses.translation: At the behest of Krsna, O Suppressor of foes, both Rama and Ganesa, of excessively great fortune became highly delighted.
verses.hindi: एक गिद्ध की पीठ पर स्थिति करने बाला बलाहक शरीर को विधू- नित करता हुआ सपक्ष कुट शेल पर स्थित बलाहक के ही समान हो गया था ।४३। और सूची मुख देतयेग्द्र सूची के तुल्य निष्ठुर पंथों वाले काक वाहन पर समारूढ़ हुआ था और उसने बड़ा हो कठोर युद्ध किया था
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Krsna, O Suppressor of foes, both Rama and Ganesa, of excessively great fortune became highly delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Krsna, O Suppressor of foes, both Rama and Ganesa, of excessively great fortune became highly delighted.

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं वरो मया दत्तः पुरा विष्णुपदाश्रमे । तत्सर्वं क्रमतो भाव्यं समा बह्वीस्त्वया विभो
verses.transliteration: tubhyaṃ varo mayā dattaḥ purā viṣṇupadāśrame / tatsarvaṃ kramato bhāvyaṃ samā bahvīstvayā vibho
verses.translation: In the meantime, goddess Radha, the chaste beloved of Krsna, rejoiced and granted boons to both of them with pleasure evident in her face.
verses.hindi: चह मत्त था और पवत की चोटी की भांति उसकी आभा थी--बह चञ्चु दंड का उद्वहन कर रहा था । वह कालदंड के प्रमाण वाले जंधा कांड से बहुत ही भीषण दिखाई दे रहा था ।४५। जंवाल के सहश छ,ति वाला पुष्प- रवत्त॑क के समान था । उसके दोनों पंख एक कोश के बराबर आयत थे ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, goddess Radha, the chaste beloved of Krsna, rejoiced and granted boons to both of them with pleasure evident in her face.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, goddess Radha, the chaste beloved of Krsna, rejoiced and granted boons to both of them with pleasure evident in her face.

verses.sanskrit: दया विधेया दीनेषु श्रेय उत्तममिच्छता । योगश्च सादनीयो वै शत्रूणां निग्रहस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dayā vidheyā dīneṣu śreya uttamamicchatā / yogaśca sādanīyo vai śatrūṇāṃ nigrahastathā
verses.translation: Your two sons shall be worthy of reverence of all the worlds as well as their delighters. You will become invincible. Particularly you will be my devotees.
verses.hindi: ऐसे पंों का उद्वहन कर रहा था ।४६। सूची मुख पर अधिष्ठित कट्वासित करट शक्तियों के महान् मंडल को चौंच के आघात से विमर्दन कर रहा था ।४७। इसके अनन्तर फलमुख अपने आयुध काल को ग्रहण करके कंक पर समारूढ़ हुआ था और पवंत की भाँति प्रकाशित हो रहा था । विकणे
verses.wordMeaning: Your two sons shall be worthy of reverence of all the worlds as well as their delighters. You will become invincible. Particularly you will be my devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your two sons shall be worthy of reverence of all the worlds as well as their delighters. You will become invincible. Particularly you will be my devotees.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्समो नास्ति लोके ऽस्मिंस्तेजसा च बलेन च । ज्ञानेन यशसा वापि सर्वश्रेष्ठतमो भवान्
verses.transliteration: tvatsamo nāsti loke 'smiṃstejasā ca balena ca / jñānena yaśasā vāpi sarvaśreṣṭhatamo bhavān
verses.translation: If anyone utters your names and begins any task, he shall achieve success in that task. Everything shall be due to my blessings".
verses.hindi: ३२६   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण नामक हैसन्द् सेनापति महु बलवाव् था । उसने भेरुष्ड पतन पर समा- रोहण करके बड़ा भारी युद्ध किया था ।४६-४ह।
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone utters your names and begins any task, he shall achieve success in that task. Everything shall be due to my blessings".
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone utters your names and begins any task, he shall achieve success in that task. Everything shall be due to my blessings".

verses.sanskrit: अथ स्वगृहमासाद्य पित्रोः शुश्रूषणं कुरु । तपश्चर यथाकालं तेन सिद्धिः करस्थिता
verses.transliteration: atha svagṛhamāsādya pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kuru / tapaścara yathākālaṃ tena siddhiḥ karasthitā
verses.translation: "Let it be so, O highly fortunate one. You are the devotee of Bhava ( Siva) and Krsna. Due to my blessings, O sage of holy rites, be long-lived."
verses.wordMeaning: "Let it be so, O highly fortunate one. You are the devotee of Bhava ( Siva) and Krsna. Due to my blessings, O sage of holy rites, be long-lived."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Let it be so, O highly fortunate one. You are the devotee of Bhava ( Siva) and Krsna. Due to my blessings, O sage of holy rites, be long-lived."

verses.sanskrit: राधोत्संगात्समुत्थाप्य गणेशं राधिकेश्वरः । आलिङ्ग्य गाढं रासेण मैत्रीं तस्य चकार ह
verses.transliteration: rādhotsaṃgātsamutthāpya gaṇeśaṃ rādhikeśvaraḥ / āliṅgya gāḍhaṃ rāseṇa maitrīṃ tasya cakāra ha
verses.translation: This Puraria specifically tries to bring together Vai?pavism and Saivism. The boon sought and granted here emphasizes this.
verses.wordMeaning: This Puraria specifically tries to bring together Vai?pavism and Saivism. The boon sought and granted here emphasizes this.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Puraria specifically tries to bring together Vai?pavism and Saivism. The boon sought and granted here emphasizes this.

verses.sanskrit: अथोभावपि संप्रीतौ तदा रामगणेश्वरौ । कृष्णाज्ञया महाभागौ बभूवतुररिन्दम
verses.transliteration: athobhāvapi saṃprītau tadā rāmagaṇeśvarau / kṛṣṇājñayā mahābhāgau babhūvaturarindama
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord of the mountain> the husband of Uma, the lord of the Universe said to the leading member of the family of Bhrgu, who bowed down and who deserved a boon.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the delighted lord of the mountain> the husband of Uma, the lord of the Universe said to the leading member of the family of Bhrgu, who bowed down and who deserved a boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord of the mountain> the husband of Uma, the lord of the Universe said to the leading member of the family of Bhrgu, who bowed down and who deserved a boon.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी राधा कृष्णप्रिया सती । उभाभ्यां च वरं प्रादात्प्रसन्नास्या मुदान्विता
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devī rādhā kṛṣṇapriyā satī / ubhābhyāṃ ca varaṃ prādātprasannāsyā mudānvitā
verses.translation: "O dear one, O Rama, you are my devotee. The boon that I have granted you already shall be entirely fruitful in your case. Truth has been mentioned by me. It shall never be otherwise.
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear one, O Rama, you are my devotee. The boon that I have granted you already shall be entirely fruitful in your case. Truth has been mentioned by me. It shall never be otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear one, O Rama, you are my devotee. The boon that I have granted you already shall be entirely fruitful in your case. Truth has been mentioned by me. It shall never be otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: राधोवाच । सर्वस्य जगतो वन्द्यौ दुराधर्षौं प्रियावहौ । मद्भक्तौ च विशेषेण भवन्तौ भवतां सुतौ
verses.transliteration: rādhovāca / sarvasya jagato vandyau durādharṣauṃ priyāvahau / madbhaktau ca viśeṣeṇa bhavantau bhavatāṃ sutau
verses.translation: From now onwards there shall be no one in this world stronger than you or possess more splendour than you."
verses.hindi: अतीव भयङ्कर प्रचण्ड कुक्कुट ने पट्टित नामक आयुध को ग्रहण करने वाले विकटानन नाम वाले का वहन किया था ।५०। कठ में रहने वाले रोमों को हषित करता हुआ और गर्जना करता हुआ वह शक्ति की सेना को देख रहा था तथा उसके नेत्र जाज्यल्वमान ये ऐसा चरणायुध वहाँ से चल
verses.wordMeaning: From now onwards there shall be no one in this world stronger than you or possess more splendour than you."
verses.commentary: Sense: From now onwards there shall be no one in this world stronger than you or possess more splendour than you."

verses.sanskrit: भवतोर्नाम चौच्चार्य यत्कार्यं यः समारभेत् । सिद्धिं प्रयातु ततसर्वं मत्प्रसादाद्धि तस्य तु
verses.transliteration: bhavatornāma cauccārya yatkāryaṃ yaḥ samārabhet / siddhiṃ prayātu tatasarvaṃ matprasādāddhi tasya tu
verses.translation: After taking permission of Siva and the daughter of the mountain, Uma, Kf?na went back to Goloka accom- panied by Sridaman and Radha.
verses.hindi: दिया था ।११। करालाक् नामक राजा जो छठवां या वह अत्यधिक गरिष्ठद था। ब के समान हो उसका घोष निष्ठुर था और प्रेत के वादन वाला था । वह भी चल दिया था ।५२। उसने पहिले ही श्मशान मन्त्र शूर ने उसको संमाधित कर लिया था । ऐसे भूत समाविष्ट प्रेत ने रण में उसका
verses.wordMeaning: After taking permission of Siva and the daughter of the mountain, Uma, Kf?na went back to Goloka accom- panied by Sridaman and Radha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking permission of Siva and the daughter of the mountain, Uma, Kf?na went back to Goloka accom- panied by Sridaman and Radha.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच जगन्माता भवानी भववल्लभा । वत्स राम प्रसन्नाहं तुभ्यं कं प्रददे वरम् । तं प्रब्रूहि महाभाग भयं त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः । राम उवाच जन्मान्त रसहस्रेषु येषुयेषु व्रजाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: athovāca jaganmātā bhavānī bhavavallabhā / vatsa rāma prasannāhaṃ tubhyaṃ kaṃ pradade varam / taṃ prabrūhi mahābhāga bhayaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ / rāma uvāca janmānta rasahasreṣu yeṣuyeṣu vrajāmyaham
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.hindi: बहन फिया था । नीचे की ओर मुख वाले--लम्बी भुजा वाले- दोनों पैरों को फैलाये हुए प्रेत के वाहनता को मर करके कुटिलाक्ष रवाना हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णयोर्भवयोर्भक्तो भविष्यामीति देहि मे । अभेदेन च पश्यामि कृष्णौ चापि भवौ तथा
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇayorbhavayorbhakto bhaviṣyāmīti dehi me / abhedena ca paśyāmi kṛṣṇau cāpi bhavau tathā
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.hindi: के वाहन वाला था और शक्ति की सेना का मदेन किया था ।५५। वह एक
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच एवमस्तु महाभाग भक्तो ऽसि भवकृष्णयोः । चिरञ्जीवी भवाशु त्वं प्रसादान्मम सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: pārvatyuvāca evamastu mahābhāga bhakto 'si bhavakṛṣṇayoḥ / cirañjīvī bhavāśu tvaṃ prasādānmama suvrata
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच धराधीशः प्रसन्नस्तमुमापतिः । प्रणतं भार्गवेन्द्रं तु वरार्हं जगदीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: athovāca dharādhīśaḥ prasannastamumāpatiḥ / praṇataṃ bhārgavendraṃ tu varārhaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.hindi: योजन तक आयत था वह बेताल ऋ.र नेत्रों वाला था । इस वेताल की भी सिद्धि श्मशान की भूमि में समवस्थित होकर की थी ओर मन्त्र का जाप कर के ही की थी
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच रामभक्तो ऽसि मे वत्स यस्ते दत्तो वरो मया । स भविष्यति कार्त्स्येन सत्यमुक्तं न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: śiva uvāca rāmabhakto 'si me vatsa yaste datto varo mayā / sa bhaviṣyati kārtsyena satyamuktaṃ na cānyathā
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन् भवतो बलवत्तरः । न को ऽपि भवताद्वत्स तेजस्वी च भवत्परः
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti loke 'smin bhavato balavattaraḥ / na ko 'pi bhavatādvatsa tejasvī ca bhavatparaḥ
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच अथ कृष्णो ऽप्यनुज्ञाप्य शिवं च नगनन्दिनीम् । गोलोकं प्रययौ युक्तः श्रीदाम्ना चापि राधया
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca atha kṛṣṇo 'pyanujñāpya śivaṃ ca naganandinīm / golokaṃ prayayau yuktaḥ śrīdāmnā cāpi rādhayā
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.hindi: उसके द्वारा आदेशित होकर उसने शक्ति की सेना का मर्दन किया था । उस वेताल की सीमा में वर्तमान दानव ने शक्ति की सेना के सांथ अनेक प्रकार से युद्ध किया था ।५७। इस प्रकार से महान् खल सात सागरों के समान उन सातों ने जो बहुत ही उद्धत ये शक्ति की सेनाओं को व्याकुल
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रामो ऽपि धर्मात्मा भवानीं च भवं तथा । संपूज्य चाभिवाद्याथ प्रदक्षिणमुपा क्रमीत्
verses.transliteration: atha rāmo 'pi dharmātmā bhavānīṃ ca bhavaṃ tathā / saṃpūjya cābhivādyātha pradakṣiṇamupā kramīt
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.hindi: कर दिया या ।५८। उन सातों ने पहिले तप के द्वारा सविता को प्रसन्न कर लिया था । तपस्या से प्रसन्न होकर सविता ने उनको वरदान दिया था।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: गणेशं कार्त्तिकेयं च नत्वापृच्छ्य च भूपते । अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तो निश्चक्राम गृहान्तरात्
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśaṃ kārttikeyaṃ ca natvāpṛcchya ca bhūpate / akṛtavraṇasaṃyukto niścakrāma gṛhāntarāt
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.hindi: हो गया हुँ । आपका कल्याण होगा । आप लोग कोई भी वरदान माँग लो ।६०। सूर्य देव के द्वारा इस भाँति कहने पर तप से अतिकृत हुए उन कॅक- सेयों ने अत्यन्त दुदन्ति ऐसा बरदान मांगा था ।६१। आप युद्ध स्थल में
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रम्यमाणो रामस्तु नन्दीश्वरमुखैर्गणैः । नमस्कृतो ययौ राजन्स्वगृहं परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: niṣkramyamāṇo rāmastu nandīśvaramukhairgaṇaiḥ / namaskṛto yayau rājansvagṛhaṃ parayā mudā
verses.translation: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the righteous Rama, worshipped Bhavan! and Bhava. After prostrating he circumambulated them.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते त्रिचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४३॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच राजन्नेवं भृगुर्विद्वान्पश्यञ्जनपदान्बहून् । समाजगाम धर्मात्माकृतव्रणसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite tricatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 43// vasiṣṭha uvāca rājannevaṃ bhṛgurvidvānpaśyañjanapadānbahūn / samājagāma dharmātmākṛtavraṇasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Bhargava on the way, everywhere all the Ksatrivas hid themselves in their eagerness and anxiety to save their lives.
verses.hindi: हमारे नेत्रों में और कुज्षियों में आकर विराजमान होवें जिससे शत्रुओं को घोर तेजसे दाह होजावे । है प्रभो ! जब आप तपते हुए हमारी आंखों में सन्निधान करेंगे तो उससे हम जिसको भी देखें वही निश्चेष्ट हो जावे
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing Bhargava on the way, everywhere all the Ksatrivas hid themselves in their eagerness and anxiety to save their lives.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing Bhargava on the way, everywhere all the Ksatrivas hid themselves in their eagerness and anxiety to save their lives.

verses.sanskrit: निलिल्युः क्षत्त्रियाः सर्वे यत्र तत्र निरीक्ष्य तम् । व्रजन्तं भार्गवं मार्गे प्राणरक्षणतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: nililyuḥ kṣattriyāḥ sarve yatra tatra nirīkṣya tam / vrajantaṃ bhārgavaṃ mārge prāṇarakṣaṇatatparāḥ
verses.translation: Then, O leading king, Rama reached the hermitage of his father, that echoed with the sound of the Vedic Mantras and that was abounding in animals of tranquil nature.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, O leading king, Rama reached the hermitage of his father, that echoed with the sound of the Vedic Mantras and that was abounding in animals of tranquil nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O leading king, Rama reached the hermitage of his father, that echoed with the sound of the Vedic Mantras and that was abounding in animals of tranquil nature.

verses.sanskrit: अथाससाद राजेन्द्र रामः स्वपितुराश्रमम् । शान्तसत्त्वसमाकीर्णं वेदध्त्रनिनिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: athāsasāda rājendra rāmaḥ svapiturāśramam / śāntasattvasamākīrṇaṃ vedadhtraninināditam
verses.translation: In the evening hours, the ground there was rendered slushy (?) with water by Brahmanas who used to offer water libations facing the setting Sun.
verses.hindi: ततः स्तब्धेष, शस्तेष्, वीक्षणादेव नः प्रभो ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the evening hours, the ground there was rendered slushy (?) with water by Brahmanas who used to offer water libations facing the setting Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the evening hours, the ground there was rendered slushy (?) with water by Brahmanas who used to offer water libations facing the setting Sun.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सिंहा मृगा गावो नागमार्ज्जारमूषकाः । समं च रन्ति संहृष्टा भयं त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः
verses.transliteration: yatra siṃhā mṛgā gāvo nāgamārjjāramūṣakāḥ / samaṃ ca ranti saṃhṛṣṭā bhayaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas, Scriptures and Sainhitas were joyously recited there, by the resident disciples strictly adhering to the vow of celibacy.
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas, Scriptures and Sainhitas were joyously recited there, by the resident disciples strictly adhering to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas, Scriptures and Sainhitas were joyously recited there, by the resident disciples strictly adhering to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र धूमं समीक्ष्यैव ह्यग्निहोत्रसमुद्भवम् । उन्नदन्ति मयूराश्च नृत्यन्ति च महीपने
verses.transliteration: yatra dhūmaṃ samīkṣyaiva hyagnihotrasamudbhavam / unnadanti mayūrāśca nṛtyanti ca mahīpane
verses.translation: Surveying the luxurious wealth of the hermitage with great delight in his mind, O king, Rama entered it ac- companied by Akitavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: Surveying the luxurious wealth of the hermitage with great delight in his mind, O king, Rama entered it ac- companied by Akitavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surveying the luxurious wealth of the hermitage with great delight in his mind, O king, Rama entered it ac- companied by Akitavrana.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सायन्तने काले सूर्यस्याभिमुखं द्विजैः । जलाञ्जलीन्प्रक्षिपद्भिः क्रियते भूर्चलाविला
verses.transliteration: yatra sāyantane kāle sūryasyābhimukhaṃ dvijaiḥ / jalāñjalīnprakṣipadbhiḥ kriyate bhūrcalāvilā
verses.translation: On being welcomed and honoured by the Brahmanas and their sons who uttered such words as "Be victorious", ''Obeisance to you", Rama became greatly delighted.
verses.wordMeaning: On being welcomed and honoured by the Brahmanas and their sons who uttered such words as "Be victorious", ''Obeisance to you", Rama became greatly delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being welcomed and honoured by the Brahmanas and their sons who uttered such words as "Be victorious", ''Obeisance to you", Rama became greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रान्तेवासिभिर्नित्यं वेदाः शास्त्राणि संहिताः । अभ्यस्यन्ते मुदा युक्तैर्ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितैः
verses.transliteration: yatrāntevāsibhirnityaṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi saṃhitāḥ / abhyasyante mudā yuktairbrahmacaryavrate sthitaiḥ
verses.translation: Entering the inner precincts of the hermitage, his own house, Rama saw his father, Jumadagni, the very store- house of Penance.
verses.hindi: विपक्ष के योधा आपके सन्निधान बाले हमारे नेश्रों से देखे गये होने पर स्तब्ध शस्त्रों वाले हो जाँयगे ।६४। है प्रभो ! फिर जब सभी शस्त्र स्तब्ध होगे ओर हमारे देखने मात्र से ही अवरुद्ध हो जांयगे तो फिर निश्चेष्ट शत्रु हमारे द्वारा आसानी से मारे जाने के योग्य हो जांयगे
verses.wordMeaning: Entering the inner precincts of the hermitage, his own house, Rama saw his father, Jumadagni, the very store- house of Penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Entering the inner precincts of the hermitage, his own house, Rama saw his father, Jumadagni, the very store- house of Penance.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रामः प्रसन्नात्मा पश्यन्नाश्रमसंपदम् । प्रविवेश शनै राजन्नकृतव्रणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: atha rāmaḥ prasannātmā paśyannāśramasaṃpadam / praviveśa śanai rājannakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: "I am Rama, your slave"— Uttering this, O lord of the Earth, Raina, the leader of good people, duly touched his feet.
verses.hindi: यह पूव में ही वर प्राप्त किया था ओर ककसेयों ने सूर्य देव से ही ऐसा बर- दान पा लिया था । इसी वरदान से मदोद्धत वे उस युद्ध में गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: "I am Rama, your slave"— Uttering this, O lord of the Earth, Raina, the leader of good people, duly touched his feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am Rama, your slave"— Uttering this, O lord of the Earth, Raina, the leader of good people, duly touched his feet.

verses.sanskrit: जयशब्दं नमःशब्दं प्रोच्चरद्भिर्द्विजात्मजैः । द्विजैश्च सत्कृतो रामः परं हर्षमुपागतः
verses.transliteration: jayaśabdaṃ namaḥśabdaṃ proccaradbhirdvijātmajaiḥ / dvijaiśca satkṛto rāmaḥ paraṃ harṣamupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Then he made obeisance to the feet of his mother. With palms joined in reverence, he made the following state- ment which made them delighted.
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त सभी शक्तियाँ सूर्य के समाविष्ट नेत्रों द्वारा देखी गयी थी और स्तब्ध शास्त्रों बाली होकर उत्साह हीन हो गयीं शीं ।६७। कीकसा के पुत्र सातों के द्वारा जो कि बड़े ही सत्व थे शक्तियों की सेनाओं के शस्त्रास्त्र बिष्टम्भित कर दिये गये बे और उनका कुछ भी उद्यम नहीं हुआ था ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then he made obeisance to the feet of his mother. With palms joined in reverence, he made the following state- ment which made them delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he made obeisance to the feet of his mother. With palms joined in reverence, he made the following state- ment which made them delighted.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमाभ्यन्तरे तत्र संप्रविश्य निजं गृहम् । ददर्श पितरं रामो जमदग्निं तपोनिधिम्
verses.transliteration: āśramābhyantare tatra saṃpraviśya nijaṃ gṛham / dadarśa pitaraṃ rāmo jamadagniṃ taponidhim
verses.translation: Due to the potentiality of your penance, O father, Karttavirya who was extremely inassailable (to his enemies) was killed in battle along with his sons, armies and vehicles.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the potentiality of your penance, O father, Karttavirya who was extremely inassailable (to his enemies) was killed in battle along with his sons, armies and vehicles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the potentiality of your penance, O father, Karttavirya who was extremely inassailable (to his enemies) was killed in battle along with his sons, armies and vehicles.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाद्भृगुमिवासीनं निग्रहानुग्रहक्षमम् । पपात चरणोपान्ते ह्यष्टाङ्गालिङ्गितावनिः
verses.transliteration: sākṣādbhṛgumivāsīnaṃ nigrahānugrahakṣamam / papāta caraṇopānte hyaṣṭāṅgāliṅgitāvaniḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to you, I approached Brahma. After duly bowing down to him I intimated to him my purpose of seeing him.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् शक्तियाँ कुछ भो न कर सको थो ।६८4 उद्यम किये जाने पर् भी उसका कूछ भी भाव नहीं हुआ सा क्योंकि बड़ा भारी शस्त्रो का स्तम्भन शा। इस विष्टम्म से अभिभूत हुई शक्तियों को चप ही रहना पड़ा था-।
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to you, I approached Brahma. After duly bowing down to him I intimated to him my purpose of seeing him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to you, I approached Brahma. After duly bowing down to him I intimated to him my purpose of seeing him.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽहं तवा दासो ऽस्मि प्रोच्चरन्निति भूपते । जग्राह चरणौ चापि विधिवत्सज्जनाग्रणीः
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'haṃ tavā dāso 'smi proccaranniti bhūpate / jagrāha caraṇau cāpi vidhivatsajjanāgraṇīḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the report from the beginning, that lord advised me. "Go to the eternal region of God Siva for the realization of your object".
verses.hindi: स्वामी की आज्ञा से समन्वित होते हुए देत्यों ने शक्तियों की होता का विमु- देन किया शा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the report from the beginning, that lord advised me. "Go to the eternal region of God Siva for the realization of your object".
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the report from the beginning, that lord advised me. "Go to the eternal region of God Siva for the realization of your object".

verses.sanskrit: अथ मातुश्च चरणवभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः । उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यं तयोः संहर्षकारणम्
verses.transliteration: atha mātuśca caraṇavabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ / uvāca praṇato vākyaṃ tayoḥ saṃharṣakāraṇam
verses.translation: After hearing his words, O father, I bowed down to Pitamaha (god Brahma) and went to Sivaloka with a desire to see Hara.
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing his words, O father, I bowed down to Pitamaha (god Brahma) and went to Sivaloka with a desire to see Hara.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing his words, O father, I bowed down to Pitamaha (god Brahma) and went to Sivaloka with a desire to see Hara.

verses.sanskrit: राम उवाच पितस्तव प्रभावेण तपसो ऽतिदुरासदः । कार्त्तवीर्यो हतो युद्धे समुत्रबलवाहनः
verses.transliteration: rāma uvāca pitastava prabhāveṇa tapaso 'tidurāsadaḥ / kārttavīryo hato yuddhe samutrabalavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: On entering it, O holy Sir, Lord Siva accompanied by his consort Uma, Siva who bestows the objects desired by us, was duly saluted by me.
verses.wordMeaning: On entering it, O holy Sir, Lord Siva accompanied by his consort Uma, Siva who bestows the objects desired by us, was duly saluted by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: On entering it, O holy Sir, Lord Siva accompanied by his consort Uma, Siva who bestows the objects desired by us, was duly saluted by me.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते ऽपराधं कृतवान्दुष्टमन्त्रिप्रचोदितः । तस्य दण्डो मया दत्तः प्रसह्य मुनिपुङ्गव
verses.transliteration: yaste 'parādhaṃ kṛtavānduṣṭamantripracoditaḥ / tasya daṇḍo mayā dattaḥ prasahya munipuṅgava
verses.translation: In his presence the whole of my history was report- ed by me. With great concentration of mind, he heard everything.
verses.wordMeaning: In his presence the whole of my history was report- ed by me. With great concentration of mind, he heard everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: In his presence the whole of my history was report- ed by me. With great concentration of mind, he heard everything.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तं तु नमस्कृत्य गतो ऽहं ब्रह्मण्ॐऽतिकम् । तं नमस्कृत्य विधिवत्स्वकार्यं प्रत्यवेदयम्
verses.transliteration: bhavantaṃ tu namaskṛtya gato 'haṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tikam / taṃ namaskṛtya vidhivatsvakāryaṃ pratyavedayam
verses.translation: Hearing it and pondering over everything, the merciful lord gave me a Kavaca (an esoteric mantra as a coat of mail) named Trailokyavijaya (conqueror of the three worlds). It is the bestower of success in everything.
verses.wordMeaning: Hearing it and pondering over everything, the merciful lord gave me a Kavaca (an esoteric mantra as a coat of mail) named Trailokyavijaya (conqueror of the three worlds). It is the bestower of success in everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hearing it and pondering over everything, the merciful lord gave me a Kavaca (an esoteric mantra as a coat of mail) named Trailokyavijaya (conqueror of the three worlds). It is the bestower of success in everything.

verses.sanskrit: समामुवाच भगवाञ्छ्रुत्वा वृत्तान्तमादितः । व्रज स्वकार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं शिवलोकं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: samāmuvāca bhagavāñchrutvā vṛttāntamāditaḥ / vraja svakāryasiddhyarthaṃ śivalokaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Thereafter, I bowed down to Parvatl and the Supreme Lord Siva, the sovereign of the Devas and have now come to your presence accompanied by Akptavrana."
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, I bowed down to Parvatl and the Supreme Lord Siva, the sovereign of the Devas and have now come to your presence accompanied by Akptavrana."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, I bowed down to Parvatl and the Supreme Lord Siva, the sovereign of the Devas and have now come to your presence accompanied by Akptavrana."

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वाहं तद्वयस्तात नमस्कृत्य पिता महम् । गतवाञ्छिवलोकं वै हरदर्शनकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: śrutvāhaṃ tadvayastāta namaskṛtya pitā maham / gatavāñchivalokaṃ vai haradarśanakāṅkṣayā
verses.translation: After saying this, O lord of the Earth, Rama, the scion of the family of Bhrgu, stopped. Jamadagni then said to Rama, the slayer of enemies.
verses.hindi: वे शक्तियाँ तो उम समय में शत्रू को सेना के द्वारा निरायुध और
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, O lord of the Earth, Rama, the scion of the family of Bhrgu, stopped. Jamadagni then said to Rama, the slayer of enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, O lord of the Earth, Rama, the scion of the family of Bhrgu, stopped. Jamadagni then said to Rama, the slayer of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य तत्र भगवन्नुमया सहितः शिवः । नमस्कृतो मया देवो वाञ्छितार्थ प्रदायकः
verses.transliteration: praviśya tatra bhagavannumayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ / namaskṛto mayā devo vāñchitārtha pradāyakaḥ
verses.translation: You have been affected by the sin of slaughtering Ksatriyas. In order to remove the sin thereof, it behoves you to perform expiation duly".
verses.hindi: निर्व्यापार वालो हो गयी थीं तथा उन देत्यों के असत कङ्कुट भेदी शरों के द्वारा क्षुष्ध हो गयी थीं ।७१। देत्यो के शस्त्रों के समुदायों से विद्ध शरीरों बाली हो गयी थीं और उनके शरीरों से रुधिर बह रहा था । वे रण में सुन्दर पत्तों वाली कड्भोल खताओं की भाति नोभित हो रही थीं ॥७२ वे
verses.wordMeaning: You have been affected by the sin of slaughtering Ksatriyas. In order to remove the sin thereof, it behoves you to perform expiation duly".
verses.commentary: Sense: You have been affected by the sin of slaughtering Ksatriyas. In order to remove the sin thereof, it behoves you to perform expiation duly".

verses.sanskrit: तदग्रे निखिलः स्वीयो वृत्तान्तो विनिवेदितः । मया समाहितधिया स सर्वं श्रुतवानपि
verses.transliteration: tadagre nikhilaḥ svīyo vṛttānto viniveditaḥ / mayā samāhitadhiyā sa sarvaṃ śrutavānapi
verses.translation: On being told thus, Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, requested his father — "It behoves you to point out to me the proper expiation thereof".
verses.hindi: समस्त शक्तियां हाहाकार करती हुई ललिता देवी की शरण में गयी यीं । ये सभी शक्तियां देत्यो के वारा स्तम्भित शस्त्रो वाली होकर रोने लगीं थीं ।७३।इमके अनन्तर देवी की आज्ञा से प्रत्यक रङ्िणी दण्डनाथा तिरसकर-
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, requested his father — "It behoves you to point out to me the proper expiation thereof".
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, Rama, the most excellent one among intelligent persons, requested his father — "It behoves you to point out to me the proper expiation thereof".

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा विचार्य त त्सर्वं ददौ मह्यं कृपान्वितः । त्रैलोक्यविजयं नाम कवचं सर्वसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vicārya ta tsarvaṃ dadau mahyaṃ kṛpānvitaḥ / trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ sarvasiddhidam
verses.translation: "Perform a penance for twelve years making your body emaciated by means of holy rites and observances and subsisting only on greens, roots and fruits for your diet".
verses.wordMeaning: "Perform a penance for twelve years making your body emaciated by means of holy rites and observances and subsisting only on greens, roots and fruits for your diet".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Perform a penance for twelve years making your body emaciated by means of holy rites and observances and subsisting only on greens, roots and fruits for your diet".

verses.sanskrit: तल्लब्ध्वा तं नमस्कृत्य पुष्करं समुपागतः । तत्राहं साधयित्वा तु कवचं हृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: tallabdhvā taṃ namaskṛtya puṣkaraṃ samupāgataḥ / tatrāhaṃ sādhayitvā tu kavacaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.hindi: णिका देवी उस रण स्वल में समुत्यित हो गयी थी ।७४ तमोलिप्त नामक सर्वतोमुख विमान पर महामाया ने समारूढ़ होकर शक्तियों के भय को दूर किया था ।७१। वह रथ श्याम कान्ति वाला था-तम से लिप्त और श्याम तुरङ्गमों वाला था । उस पर तमाल के समान श्यामल आकार वाली तथा
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तवीर्यं निहत्याजौ शिवलोकं पुनर्गतः । तत्र तौ तु मया दृष्टौ द्वारे स्कन्दविनायकौ
verses.transliteration: kārttavīryaṃ nihatyājau śivalokaṃ punargataḥ / tatra tau tu mayā dṛṣṭau dvāre skandavināyakau
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.hindi: श्याम कऊचु को को धारण करने वाली विराजमान थी ।७६। वासन्ती मोहन को अभिडया वाले घनुष को ग्रहण करके ध्वनि के साथ सिहनाद करके सपो के सदृश वाणों की वर्षा उस देवी ने की भी
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: तौनमस्कृत्य धर्मज्ञ प्रवेष्टुं चोद्यतो ऽभवम् । स मामवेक्ष्य गामपो विशन्तं त्वरयान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: taunamaskṛtya dharmajña praveṣṭuṃ codyato 'bhavam / sa māmavekṣya gāmapo viśantaṃ tvarayānvitam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: वारयामास सहसा नाद्यावसर इत्यथ । मम तेन पितस्तत्र वाग्युद्धं हस्तकर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: vārayāmāsa sahasā nādyāvasara ityatha / mama tena pitastatra vāgyuddhaṃ hastakarṣaṇam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जातपरशुक्षेममतो ऽभूद्भृगुनन्दन । स तज्ज्ञात्वा समुद्गृह्य मामधश्चोर्द्ध्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: sañjātaparaśukṣemamato 'bhūdbhṛgunandana / sa tajjñātvā samudgṛhya māmadhaścorddhvameva ca
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: करेण भ्रामयामास पुनश्चानीतवांस्ततः । तं दृष्ट्वातिक्रुधा क्षिप्तः कुठारो हि मया ततः
verses.transliteration: kareṇa bhrāmayāmāsa punaścānītavāṃstataḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvātikrudhā kṣiptaḥ kuṭhāro hi mayā tataḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: दन्तो निपति,स्तस्य ततो देव उपागतः । पार्वती तत्र रुष्टाभूत्तदा कृष्णः समागतः
verses.transliteration: danto nipati,stasya tato deva upāgataḥ / pārvatī tatra ruṣṭābhūttadā kṛṣṇaḥ samāgataḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: राधया सहितस्तेन सानुनीता वरं ददौ । मह्यं कृष्मो जगामाथ तेन मैत्रीं विधाय च
verses.transliteration: rādhayā sahitastena sānunītā varaṃ dadau / mahyaṃ kṛṣmo jagāmātha tena maitrīṃ vidhāya ca
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.hindi: वे देत्यगण कृष्ण स्वरूप से संयुत भुजङ्गं के समान तथा मुसल के सहश मोहनास्त्र से निकाले गये वाणों को सहन न कर सके ये ।७८। इधर- उधर महामाया के वाणों से मदित होते हुए वे खल जिनमें बलाहक प्रधान था परमाधिक प्रकोप को प्राप्त हो गये ये ।७९। अनन्तर में दण्डनाथा के
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशौ पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ । आगतस्तव सान्निध्यमकृतव्रणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya deveśau pārvatīparameśvarau / āgatastava sānnidhyamakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.hindi: आदेश से तिरस्करिणो अम्बा ने शत्रुओं के युद्ध में अन्धनामक महास्वर को छोड़ा था ।८०। सूर्य देव के वर से बड़े ही उद्धत हुए वे बलाहक आदि सातों देत्य उस अच्धास्त्र से अपने नेत्रों को छादित हुए ही घारण किये हुए ये।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्यक्त्वा भार्गवो रामो विरराम च भूपते । जमदग्निरुवाचेदं रामं शत्रुनिबर्हणम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityaktvā bhārgavo rāmo virarāma ca bhūpate / jamadagniruvācedaṃ rāmaṃ śatrunibarhaṇam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच क्षत्रहत्याभिभूतस्त्वं तावद्दोषोपशान्तये । प्रयश्चित्तं ततस्तावद्यथावत्कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca kṣatrahatyābhibhūtastvaṃ tāvaddoṣopaśāntaye / prayaścittaṃ tatastāvadyathāvatkartumarhasi
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.hindi: ।८१। तिरस्करिणी अम्बा के मोहनास्त्र धनुष से निकले हुए बाण के द्वारा उनके नैत्र बम्द हो गये ये ।२। अन्धे बनाये गये वे सातों वहां पर कुछ भी नहीं देख पाते ये । उनके न देखने से वह शस्त्र का स्तम्भन भी क्षीण हो गया था ।८३। करों में आयुध लिये हुए उन्होंने किर सिंहनाद करके हैत्यों
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः प्राह पितरं रामो मतिमतां वरः । प्रायश्चित्तं तु तद्योग्यं त्वं मे निर्देष्टुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ prāha pitaraṃ rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ / prāyaścittaṃ tu tadyogyaṃ tvaṃ me nirdeṣṭumarhasi
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.hindi: के हनन करने की इच्छा से मुद्ध किया था
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच व्रतैश्च नियमैश्चैव कर्षयन्देहमात्मनः । शाकमूलफलाहारो द्वादशाब्दं तपश्चर
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca vrataiśca niyamaiścaiva karṣayandehamātmanaḥ / śākamūlaphalāhāro dvādaśābdaṃ tapaścara
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्यैनं मातरं च भृगूद्वहः । प्रययौ तपसे राजन्नकृतव्रणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ mātaraṃ ca bhṛgūdvahaḥ / prayayau tapase rājannakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा पर्वत वरं महेन्द्रमरिकर्षणः । कृत्वाऽश्रमपदं तस्मिंस्तपस्तेपे सुदुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā parvata varaṃ mahendramarikarṣaṇaḥ / kṛtvā'śramapadaṃ tasmiṃstapastepe suduścaram
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतैस्तपोभिर्नियमैर्देवताराधनैरपि । निन्ये वर्षाणि कति चिद्रामस्तस्मिन्महामनाः
verses.transliteration: vrataistapobhirniyamairdevatārādhanairapi / ninye varṣāṇi kati cidrāmastasminmahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the leading member of the family of Blirgu, bowed down to him as well as to his mother, O king, and went for performing penance accompanied by Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरोपाख्याने भार्गवचरिते चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४४॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच ततः कदाचिद्विपिने चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः । मृगयामगमच्छूरः शूरसेनादिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaropākhyāne bhārgavacarite catuścatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 44// vasiṣṭha uvāca tataḥ kadācidvipine caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ / mṛgayāmagamacchūraḥ śūrasenādibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: Then once Sura (i.e. Karttavirya's son) who had escaped to the Himalayan forests — went to the forest lor hunting along with Surasena and others and accompanied by the armies of four different units.
verses.wordMeaning: Then once Sura (i.e. Karttavirya's son) who had escaped to the Himalayan forests — went to the forest lor hunting along with Surasena and others and accompanied by the armies of four different units.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then once Sura (i.e. Karttavirya's son) who had escaped to the Himalayan forests — went to the forest lor hunting along with Surasena and others and accompanied by the armies of four different units.

verses.sanskrit: ते प्रविश्य महारण्यं हत्वा बहुविधान्मृगान् । जग्मुस्तृषार्त्ता मध्याह्ने सरितं नर्मदामनु
verses.transliteration: te praviśya mahāraṇyaṃ hatvā bahuvidhānmṛgān / jagmustṛṣārttā madhyāhne saritaṃ narmadāmanu
verses.translation: After entering the great forest, they killed different kinds of animals. Overwhelmed by thirst at midday, they went to the river Narmada.
verses.hindi: एषां सेन्यं तु निखिलं नाशयाम उदायुधाः
verses.wordMeaning: After entering the great forest, they killed different kinds of animals. Overwhelmed by thirst at midday, they went to the river Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering the great forest, they killed different kinds of animals. Overwhelmed by thirst at midday, they went to the river Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च वारि नद्या गतश्रमाः । गच्छन्तो ददृशुर्मार्गो जमदग्नेरथाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca vāri nadyā gataśramāḥ / gacchanto dadṛśurmārgo jamadagnerathāśramam
verses.translation: Taking their bath there and drinking the waters of the river, they got rid of their fatigue. While going away they saw the hermitage of Jamadagni on the way.
verses.hindi: उन शक्तियों ने महान् बल वाली उस तिरस्करणी देवी को अपने आगे करके उसके अस्तरीकरण के उपाय के प्रसङ्ग से बहुत ही प्रसन्न होकर युद्ध किया था ।८५। वे सभी शक्तियाँ यह कह रही शीं-हे तिरस्कारिणि ! अम्बिके ! है महाभागे ! बहुत हो अच्छा किया । दुरात्मा इन शत्र ओं को
verses.wordMeaning: Taking their bath there and drinking the waters of the river, they got rid of their fatigue. While going away they saw the hermitage of Jamadagni on the way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking their bath there and drinking the waters of the river, they got rid of their fatigue. While going away they saw the hermitage of Jamadagni on the way.

verses.sanskrit: द्दष्ट्वाश्रमपदं रम्यं मुनीनागच्छतः पथि । कस्येदमिति पप्रच्छुर्भाविकर्मप्रचोदिताः
verses.transliteration: ddaṣṭvāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ munīnāgacchataḥ pathi / kasyedamiti papracchurbhāvikarmapracoditāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the charming hermitage, they asked sages coming that way — "whose hermitage is this?" In that they were urged by the inevitable future result of their actions.
verses.hindi: आपने जो तिरस्कार किया है वह बहुत हो उचित किया है ।८६। आप ही इन दुष्टों के नेत्रो के तिरस्कार करने की महोषध हैं । आपके हारा दृष्टि के अन्द होने ही रो यह हैत्यों का चक्र पराभूत हो रहा है ।=७। है देवि ! यह तो देवकार्य है जो आपने भलीभांति किया है । हम जेसी शक्तियों के द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the charming hermitage, they asked sages coming that way — "whose hermitage is this?" In that they were urged by the inevitable future result of their actions.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the charming hermitage, they asked sages coming that way — "whose hermitage is this?" In that they were urged by the inevitable future result of their actions.

verses.sanskrit: ते प्रोचुरतिशान्तात्मा जमदग्नेर्महातपाः । वसत्यस्मिन्सुतो यस्य रामः शस्त्रभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration: te procuratiśāntātmā jamadagnermahātapāḥ / vasatyasminsuto yasya rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: They replied: "Jamadagni of great penance lives in this hermitage. He is a sage of quiescent soul and his son Rama is the most excellent one among the wielders of weapons."
verses.hindi: अजेय इनमें जो आपने यह व्यसन उत्पन्न कर दिया है ।८०। अब आपके हो
verses.wordMeaning: They replied: "Jamadagni of great penance lives in this hermitage. He is a sage of quiescent soul and his son Rama is the most excellent one among the wielders of weapons."
