verses.commentary: Sense: They replied: "Jamadagni of great penance lives in this hermitage. He is a sage of quiescent soul and his son Rama is the most excellent one among the wielders of weapons."

verses.sanskrit: तछ्रुत्वा भीरभूत्तेषां रामनामानुकीर्त्तनात् । क्रोधं प्रसङ्यानृशंस्यं पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: tachrutvā bhīrabhūtteṣāṃ rāmanāmānukīrttanāt / krodhaṃ prasaṅyānṛśaṃsyaṃ pūrvavairamanusmaran
verses.translation: On hearing it and because Rama's name was men- tioned, they were overcome with fear at the outset.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing it and because Rama's name was men- tioned, they were overcome with fear at the outset.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it and because Rama's name was men- tioned, they were overcome with fear at the outset.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ते प्रोचुरन्योन्यं पितृहन्तुर्वधात्पितुः । वैर निर्यातनं किं तु करिष्यामो दिशाधुना
verses.transliteration: atha te procuranyonyaṃ pitṛhanturvadhātpituḥ / vaira niryātanaṃ kiṃ tu kariṣyāmo diśādhunā
verses.translation: The range of hills extending from Orissa to Madurai district. It includes the Eastern Ghat and the range extending from Northern Gircars to Gondwana — De,
verses.hindi: द्वारा इन महान सात असुरो को निहत हुआ सुनकर ललिता देवी बहुत ही प्रसन्नता को प्राप्त हो गो ।८६। आपके द्वारा ऐसा करने-पर दण्डिनी देवी भी प्रीति को प्राप्त हो जायगी ओर महाभागा मम्विशी देवी भी बहुत अधिक सन्तोष को प्राप्त हो जांयगो ।९०। इस कारण सो अब आप ही इन सातो”
verses.wordMeaning: The range of hills extending from Orissa to Madurai district. It includes the Eastern Ghat and the range extending from Northern Gircars to Gondwana — De,
verses.commentary: Sense: The range of hills extending from Orissa to Madurai district. It includes the Eastern Ghat and the range extending from Northern Gircars to Gondwana — De,

verses.sanskrit: इत्यक्त्वा खड्गहस्तास्ते संप्रविश्य तदाश्रमम् । प्रजाघ्निरे प्रयातेषु मुनिवीरेषु सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: ityaktvā khaḍgahastāste saṃpraviśya tadāśramam / prajāghnire prayāteṣu munivīreṣu sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Then they conferred with one another — "Since our father has been killed by Parasurama, why should we not take revenge by killing the father of the slayer of our father? Direct us now."
verses.hindi: का युद्धा ज्ञण में वध कीजिए । इनकी जो सम्पूर्ण सेना है उसको आयुध ग्रहण कर हम विनष्ट कर देती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Then they conferred with one another — "Since our father has been killed by Parasurama, why should we not take revenge by killing the father of the slayer of our father? Direct us now."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they conferred with one another — "Since our father has been killed by Parasurama, why should we not take revenge by killing the father of the slayer of our father? Direct us now."

verses.sanskrit: तं हत्वास्य शिरो हृत्वा निषादा इव निर्दयाः । प्रययुस्ते दुरात्मानः सबलाः स्वपुरीं प्रति
verses.transliteration: taṃ hatvāsya śiro hṛtvā niṣādā iva nirdayāḥ / prayayuste durātmānaḥ sabalāḥ svapurīṃ prati
verses.translation: After saying this, they entered the hermitage with swords in their hands, as the heroic sages had gone to different places. They killed Jamadagni.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त वा प्रेरिता ताभिः शक्तिभियुद्ध कौतुकाद् ।
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, they entered the hermitage with swords in their hands, as the heroic sages had gone to different places. They killed Jamadagni.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, they entered the hermitage with swords in their hands, as the heroic sages had gone to different places. They killed Jamadagni.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रास्तस्य महात्मानौ दृष्ट्वा स्वपितरं हतम् । परिवार्य महाराज रुरुदुः शोककर्शिताः
verses.transliteration: putrāstasya mahātmānau dṛṣṭvā svapitaraṃ hatam / parivārya mahārāja ruruduḥ śokakarśitāḥ
verses.translation: 'After killing him, they took away his head like the ruthless Nisadas (hunters). Those wicked ones then returned to their capital along with their armies.
verses.wordMeaning: 'After killing him, they took away his head like the ruthless Nisadas (hunters). Those wicked ones then returned to their capital along with their armies.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'After killing him, they took away his head like the ruthless Nisadas (hunters). Those wicked ones then returned to their capital along with their armies.

verses.sanskrit: भर्त्तारं निहतं भूमौ पतितं वीक्ष्य रेणुका । पपात मूर्च्छिता सद्यो लतेवाशनिताडिता
verses.transliteration: bharttāraṃ nihataṃ bhūmau patitaṃ vīkṣya reṇukā / papāta mūrcchitā sadyo latevāśanitāḍitā
verses.translation: On seeing their father killed, the sons of that noble- soulcd sage lamented, O great king. Afflicted by grief they stood surrounding him,
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing their father killed, the sons of that noble- soulcd sage lamented, O great king. Afflicted by grief they stood surrounding him,
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing their father killed, the sons of that noble- soulcd sage lamented, O great king. Afflicted by grief they stood surrounding him,

verses.sanskrit: सा स्वचेतसि संमूच्छ्य शोकपावकदीपिताः । दूरप्रनष्टसंज्ञेव सद्यः प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत
verses.transliteration: sā svacetasi saṃmūcchya śokapāvakadīpitāḥ / dūrapranaṣṭasaṃjñeva sadyaḥ prāṇairvyayujyata
verses.translation: The sons who had regained consciousness saw that she did not utter any word. They became immersed in the ocean of grief and fell down senseless on the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: The sons who had regained consciousness saw that she did not utter any word. They became immersed in the ocean of grief and fell down senseless on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons who had regained consciousness saw that she did not utter any word. They became immersed in the ocean of grief and fell down senseless on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: अनालपन्त्यां तस्यां तु संज्ञां याता हि ते पुनः । न्यपतन्मूर्च्छिता भूमौ निमग्नाः शोकसागरे
verses.transliteration: anālapantyāṃ tasyāṃ tu saṃjñāṃ yātā hi te punaḥ / nyapatanmūrcchitā bhūmau nimagnāḥ śokasāgare
verses.translation: Other sages who were living in that penance-grove, came there. They too were equally grieved but they consoled the sons of the sage.
verses.wordMeaning: Other sages who were living in that penance-grove, came there. They too were equally grieved but they consoled the sons of the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other sages who were living in that penance-grove, came there. They too were equally grieved but they consoled the sons of the sage.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तपोधना ये ऽन्ये तत्त पोवनवासिनः । समेत्याश्वासयामासुस्तुल्यदुःखाः सुतान्मुने
verses.transliteration: tatastapodhanā ye 'nye tatta povanavāsinaḥ / sametyāśvāsayāmāsustulyaduḥkhāḥ sutānmune
verses.translation: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.wordMeaning: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.

verses.sanskrit: सांत्व्यमाना मुनिगणैर्जामदग्न्या यथाविधि । आधक्षुर्वचसा तेषामग्नौ पित्रोः कलेवरे
verses.transliteration: sāṃtvyamānā munigaṇairjāmadagnyā yathāvidhi / ādhakṣurvacasā teṣāmagnau pitroḥ kalevare
verses.translation: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.wordMeaning: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रुरेव तदूर्द्ध्वं वै यत्कर्त्तव्यमनन्तरम् । पित्रोर्मरणदुःखेन पीड्यमाना दिवानिशम्
verses.transliteration: cakrureva tadūrddhvaṃ vai yatkarttavyamanantaram / pitrormaraṇaduḥkhena pīḍyamānā divāniśam
verses.translation: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार से कहे जाने पर उन शक्तियों के द्वारा प्रेरित हुई उस तिरस्करिणी देवी ने युद्ध कोतुक से तमोलिव्त यान के द्वारा बलाहक की सेना में गमन किया था ।६२। उस देवी को आती हुई देखकर उन सातों अधम अधुरा ने फिर भो उसी सूयं देव के दिये हुए वरदान कर हुंरन्त ही
verses.wordMeaning: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.

verses.sanskrit: ततः काले गते रामः समानां द्वादशावधौ । निवृत्तस्तपसः सख्या सहागादाश्रमं पितुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāle gate rāmaḥ samānāṃ dvādaśāvadhau / nivṛttastapasaḥ sakhyā sahāgādāśramaṃ pituḥ
verses.translation: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.hindi: स्मरण किया था ।९३। वह सावित्र वरदन प्रविष्ट भी हुआ था जो कि उसके
verses.wordMeaning: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After being consoled by the groups of sages the sons of Jamadagni duly cremated # the bodies of their parents at their instance.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे सगरोपाख्याने भार्गवचरिते पञ्चचत्वारिंशत्तमोध्यायः ॥ ४५॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच सगच्छन्पथि शुश्राव मुनिभ्यस्त त्त्वमादितः । राजपुत्रव्यवसितं पित्रौः स्वर्गतिमेव च
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge sagaropākhyāne bhārgavacarite pañcacatvāriṃśattamodhyāyaḥ // 45// vasiṣṭha uvāca sagacchanpathi śuśrāva munibhyasta ttvamāditaḥ / rājaputravyavasitaṃ pitrauḥ svargatimeva ca
verses.translation: Through reasons pointed out in the scriptures, through hints of his heroism and capacity and through cogent argu- ments and popular examples he alleviated Rama's grief.
verses.hindi: गया था ।६४। वरदानास्त्र के रोष से अस्या तथा महान बल और पराक्रम
verses.wordMeaning: Through reasons pointed out in the scriptures, through hints of his heroism and capacity and through cogent argu- ments and popular examples he alleviated Rama's grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through reasons pointed out in the scriptures, through hints of his heroism and capacity and through cogent argu- ments and popular examples he alleviated Rama's grief.

verses.sanskrit: पितुस्तु जीवहरणं शिरोहरणमेव च । तन्मृतेरेव मरणं श्रुत्वा मातुश्च केवलम्
verses.transliteration: pitustu jīvaharaṇaṃ śiroharaṇameva ca / tanmṛtereva maraṇaṃ śrutvā mātuśca kevalam
verses.translation: On being consoled, the highly intelligent scion of the family ofBhrgu, regained his courage. He proceeded ahead, desirous of seeing his brothers. He was accompanied by his friend.
verses.wordMeaning: On being consoled, the highly intelligent scion of the family ofBhrgu, regained his courage. He proceeded ahead, desirous of seeing his brothers. He was accompanied by his friend.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being consoled, the highly intelligent scion of the family ofBhrgu, regained his courage. He proceeded ahead, desirous of seeing his brothers. He was accompanied by his friend.

verses.sanskrit: विललाप महाबाहुर्दुःखशोकसमन्वितः । तमथाश्वासयामास तुल्यदुःखो ऽकृतव्रणः
verses.transliteration: vilalāpa mahābāhurduḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ / tamathāśvāsayāmāsa tulyaduḥkho 'kṛtavraṇaḥ
verses.translation: Himself, reduced in physical strength due to misery he saw them (his brothers). He bowed down to them who too were equally miserable. Continuously experiencing grief and anger, he stayed with them for three days.
verses.hindi: वाला वह असुर था । अस्त्र से ओर रोष से अन्घे उस महासुर बलाहक के केशों को पकड़ कर उस देवी ने अपनो ओर खींच लिया था ओर अन्धे बना देने वालो देवो ने उसका शिर तलवार से काट डाला या ।६५। उसका जो बहुन गिद्ध था उसका भी शिर पत्री के द्वारा काटकर वह तिरस्कारिणी
verses.wordMeaning: Himself, reduced in physical strength due to misery he saw them (his brothers). He bowed down to them who too were equally miserable. Continuously experiencing grief and anger, he stayed with them for three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: Himself, reduced in physical strength due to misery he saw them (his brothers). He bowed down to them who too were equally miserable. Continuously experiencing grief and anger, he stayed with them for three days.

verses.sanskrit: हेतुभिः शास्त्रनिर्दिष्टैर् वीर्यसामर्थ्यसूचकैः । युक्तिलौकिकदृष्टान्तैस्तच्छोकं संव्यशामयत्
verses.transliteration: hetubhiḥ śāstranirdiṣṭair vīryasāmarthyasūcakaiḥ / yuktilaukikadṛṣṭāntaistacchokaṃ saṃvyaśāmayat
verses.translation: His fierce wrath (due to the recurring) recollection of the death of his father developed soon so much that it became capable of annihilating the worlds.
verses.hindi: देवी सूची मुख के सामने गयो थीं ।६६॥ उसके शिर को पट्टिश के अद्वार से काट डाला था ओर शेष जो पाँच रहे घे उतके भो सबके शिर धीरे-धीरे उस देवी ने काटकर मौत के घाट सबको उतार दिया था ।६७। उन सातों असुरों के मुण्ड परस्पर में केशों के द्वारा बंधे हुए थे । उनका एक हार सा
verses.wordMeaning: His fierce wrath (due to the recurring) recollection of the death of his father developed soon so much that it became capable of annihilating the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: His fierce wrath (due to the recurring) recollection of the death of his father developed soon so much that it became capable of annihilating the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सांत्वितस्तेन मैधावी धृतिमालंब्य भार्गवः । प्रययौ सहितः सख्या भ्रातॄणां तु दिदृक्षया
verses.transliteration: sāṃtvitastena maidhāvī dhṛtimālaṃbya bhārgavaḥ / prayayau sahitaḥ sakhyā bhrātṝṇāṃ tu didṛkṣayā
verses.translation: Being truthful to his vow, he reaffirmed in his heart the pledge taken by him formerly for the sake of his mother* He prepared himself for the massacre of all Ksatriyas.
verses.hindi: बनाकर गले में डालकर तिरस्करिणी देवो गर्जना कर रहीं थी
verses.wordMeaning: Being truthful to his vow, he reaffirmed in his heart the pledge taken by him formerly for the sake of his mother* He prepared himself for the massacre of all Ksatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being truthful to his vow, he reaffirmed in his heart the pledge taken by him formerly for the sake of his mother* He prepared himself for the massacre of all Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: स तान्दृष्ट्वाभिवाद्यैतान्दुःखितान्दुःखकर्शितः । शोकामषयुतस्तैश्च सह त्स्थौ दिनत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: sa tāndṛṣṭvābhivādyaitānduḥkhitānduḥkhakarśitaḥ / śokāmaṣayutastaiśca saha tsthau dinatrayam
verses.translation: Accompanied by Akftavrana, he went to Mahi§- mati. Standing in a park at the outskirts of that city, he remembered Mahodara.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Akftavrana, he went to Mahi§- mati. Standing in a park at the outskirts of that city, he remembered Mahodara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Akftavrana, he went to Mahi§- mati. Standing in a park at the outskirts of that city, he remembered Mahodara.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्य सुमाहान्क्रोधः स्मरतो निधनं पितुः । बभूव सहसा सर्वलोकसंहरणक्षमः
verses.transliteration: tato 'sya sumāhānkrodhaḥ smarato nidhanaṃ pituḥ / babhūva sahasā sarvalokasaṃharaṇakṣamaḥ
verses.translation: He sent to Rama a chariot, bow etc. and all the necessary requisites for fighting along with Sahasaha.
verses.wordMeaning: He sent to Rama a chariot, bow etc. and all the necessary requisites for fighting along with Sahasaha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He sent to Rama a chariot, bow etc. and all the necessary requisites for fighting along with Sahasaha.

verses.sanskrit: मातुरर्थे कृतां पूर्वं प्रतिज्ञां सत्यसंगरः । दृढीचकार हृदये सर्वक्षत्रवधोद्यतः
verses.transliteration: māturarthe kṛtāṃ pūrvaṃ pratijñāṃ satyasaṃgaraḥ / dṛḍhīcakāra hṛdaye sarvakṣatravadhodyataḥ
verses.translation: Rama, the conqueror of enemies, became ready (for the battle) well-accoutred. He got into the chariot. He took up his bow along with the arrows and blew his conch presented by Rudra.
verses.wordMeaning: Rama, the conqueror of enemies, became ready (for the battle) well-accoutred. He got into the chariot. He took up his bow along with the arrows and blew his conch presented by Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, the conqueror of enemies, became ready (for the battle) well-accoutred. He got into the chariot. He took up his bow along with the arrows and blew his conch presented by Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रवंश्यानशेषेण हत्वा तद्देहलोहितैः । करिष्ये तर्पणं पित्रोरिति निश्चित्य भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: kṣatravaṃśyānaśeṣeṇa hatvā taddehalohitaiḥ / kariṣye tarpaṇaṃ pitroriti niścitya bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: He made a twanging sound with the bowstring, making heaven and Earth tremble as it were. Sahasaha, the most excellent one among the charioteers, drove the chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: He made a twanging sound with the bowstring, making heaven and Earth tremble as it were. Sahasaha, the most excellent one among the charioteers, drove the chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made a twanging sound with the bowstring, making heaven and Earth tremble as it were. Sahasaha, the most excellent one among the charioteers, drove the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातॄणां चैव सर्वेषामाख्यायात्मसमीहितम् । प्रययौ तदनुज्ञातः कृत्वा संस्थांपितुः क्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāmākhyāyātmasamīhitam / prayayau tadanujñātaḥ kṛtvā saṃsthāṃpituḥ kriyām
verses.translation: On account of the sounds of the chariot as well as the bow-string of (Rama) who was furious due to the slaughter of his parents, the entire city, the people and elephants became agitated.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of the sounds of the chariot as well as the bow-string of (Rama) who was furious due to the slaughter of his parents, the entire city, the people and elephants became agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of the sounds of the chariot as well as the bow-string of (Rama) who was furious due to the slaughter of his parents, the entire city, the people and elephants became agitated.

verses.sanskrit: अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः प्राप्य माहिष्मतीं ततः । तद्बाह्योपवने स्थित्वा सस्मार स महोदरम्
verses.transliteration: akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ prāpya māhiṣmatīṃ tataḥ / tadbāhyopavane sthitvā sasmāra sa mahodaram
verses.translation: On coming to know that Rama, the destroyer of all Ksatriyas, had come, the sons of the king became deeply agitat- ed and they made full preparations for fighting with him.
verses.hindi: क्रोध से मूच्छित उन शक्तियों ने उन असुरों की सम्पूर्ण सेना का हनन कर दिया था तथा उनके रुधिर की बहुत से नदियों को प्रवाहित कर दिया था ६६) बलाहक आदि बड़े-बड़े सेनानियों की दृष्टि के रोघत करने के वैभव से जो कि महामाया अम्विका के द्वारा किया गया या वहाँ पर उस समय में
verses.wordMeaning: On coming to know that Rama, the destroyer of all Ksatriyas, had come, the sons of the king became deeply agitat- ed and they made full preparations for fighting with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know that Rama, the destroyer of all Ksatriyas, had come, the sons of the king became deeply agitat- ed and they made full preparations for fighting with him.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्मै रथचापाद्यं सहसाश्वसमन्वितम् । प्रेषयामास रामाय सर्वसंहननानि च
verses.transliteration: sa tasmai rathacāpādyaṃ sahasāśvasamanvitam / preṣayāmāsa rāmāya sarvasaṃhananāni ca
verses.translation: Then, O king, the heroic princes Surasena and others (seated) in five chariots, made their endeavour to fight with Raina. They were accompanied by other kings as well.
verses.hindi: बड़ा आश्चर्य हों गया था ।१००। मरने से जो भो कुछ बच गये ये वे सब बहुत हो भयभीत होकर अधुर बहुत आतं होकर शुम्यकेश्व्र की शरण में रुदन करते हुए पहुँच गये थे ओर वे महामाया दण्डिनो की बारम्बार प्रशंसा कर रहे थे और उस हो दूसरी प्रसन्नता से चक्ष, प्राप्त करके वे प्रसन्न भी
verses.wordMeaning: Then, O king, the heroic princes Surasena and others (seated) in five chariots, made their endeavour to fight with Raina. They were accompanied by other kings as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O king, the heroic princes Surasena and others (seated) in five chariots, made their endeavour to fight with Raina. They were accompanied by other kings as well.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि रथमारुह्य सन्नद्धः सशरं धनुः । गृहीत्वापूरयच्छङ्खं रुद्रदत्तममित्रजित्
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi rathamāruhya sannaddhaḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ / gṛhītvāpūrayacchaṅkhaṃ rudradattamamitrajit
verses.translation: Equipped with armies consisting of four different units, those leading Ksatriyas confronted Rama like the locusts approching fire.
verses.hindi: इए थे ।१०१-१०२। वहाँ पर जो शक्तियां थीं उनने बहुत अच्छा हुआ--यह कहकर अपना शिर हिलाते हुए पद-पद पर तिरस्करिणी देवी की श्लाघा की थी
verses.wordMeaning: Equipped with armies consisting of four different units, those leading Ksatriyas confronted Rama like the locusts approching fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Equipped with armies consisting of four different units, those leading Ksatriyas confronted Rama like the locusts approching fire.

verses.sanskrit: ज्याघोषं च चकारोच्चै रोदसी कंपयन्निव । सहसाहोथ सारथ्यं चक्रे सारथिनां वरः
verses.transliteration: jyāghoṣaṃ ca cakāroccai rodasī kaṃpayanniva / sahasāhotha sārathyaṃ cakre sārathināṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: With his single chariot, Bhargava restrained them as they rushed on. Being a hero of boundless valour, he fought with all the kings in the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: With his single chariot, Bhargava restrained them as they rushed on. Being a hero of boundless valour, he fought with all the kings in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his single chariot, Bhargava restrained them as they rushed on. Being a hero of boundless valour, he fought with all the kings in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: रथज्याशङ्खनादैस्तु वधात्पित्रोरमर्षिणः । तस्याभून्नगरी सर्वा संक्षुब्धाश्च नरद्विपाः
verses.transliteration: rathajyāśaṅkhanādaistu vadhātpitroramarṣiṇaḥ / tasyābhūnnagarī sarvā saṃkṣubdhāśca naradvipāḥ
verses.translation: A battle took place once again between Rama and the kings, wherein the infuriated sage of high intellect, killed a hundred kings.
verses.wordMeaning: A battle took place once again between Rama and the kings, wherein the infuriated sage of high intellect, killed a hundred kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: A battle took place once again between Rama and the kings, wherein the infuriated sage of high intellect, killed a hundred kings.

verses.sanskrit: रामं त्वागतमाज्ञाय सर्वक्षत्रकुलान्तकम् । संक्षुब्धाश्चक्रुरुद्योगं संग्रामाय नृपात्मजाः
verses.transliteration: rāmaṃ tvāgatamājñāya sarvakṣatrakulāntakam / saṃkṣubdhāścakrurudyogaṃ saṃgrāmāya nṛpātmajāḥ
verses.translation: After killing Surasena and others along with their armies and vehicles, he made the entire group of Ksatriyas fall on the ground in a moment.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing Surasena and others along with their armies and vehicles, he made the entire group of Ksatriyas fall on the ground in a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing Surasena and others along with their armies and vehicles, he made the entire group of Ksatriyas fall on the ground in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: अथ पञ्चरथाः शुराः शूरसेनादयो नृप । रामेण योद्धुं सहिता राजभिश्च क्रुरुद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: atha pañcarathāḥ śurāḥ śūrasenādayo nṛpa / rāmeṇa yoddhuṃ sahitā rājabhiśca krurudyamam
verses.translation: The kings who survived, whose wishes had been frustrated and whose vehicles and armies had been killed fled in all directions.
verses.wordMeaning: The kings who survived, whose wishes had been frustrated and whose vehicles and armies had been killed fled in all directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings who survived, whose wishes had been frustrated and whose vehicles and armies had been killed fled in all directions.

verses.sanskrit: चतुरङ्गवलोपेतास्ततस्ते क्षत्रियर्षभाः । राममासादयामासुः पतङ्गा इव पावकम्
verses.transliteration: caturaṅgavalopetāstataste kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ / rāmamāsādayāmāsuḥ pataṅgā iva pāvakam
verses.translation: After routing the armies, killing the enemies and winning the battle, Rama killed hundreds of kings and heroes by means of the fire from his excellent arrows.
verses.hindi: इसके अनम्तर महासुर भंड ने जब महान बलवान और बरदानी उन सातों का वध सुता तो वह उस समय में काले सर्प के ही समान तिश्वास लेने लगा था ।१। महान शौण्डीर्य वह रण में विजय की इच्छा वाला होकर एकान्त में महोबरों को बुलाते हुए उनके साथ भंडासुर ने मन्त्रणा को थी।
verses.wordMeaning: After routing the armies, killing the enemies and winning the battle, Rama killed hundreds of kings and heroes by means of the fire from his excellent arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: After routing the armies, killing the enemies and winning the battle, Rama killed hundreds of kings and heroes by means of the fire from his excellent arrows.

verses.sanskrit: निवार्य तानापततो रथेनैकेन भार्गवः । युयुधे पार्थिवैः सर्वैः समरे ऽमितविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: nivārya tānāpatato rathenaikena bhārgavaḥ / yuyudhe pārthivaiḥ sarvaiḥ samare 'mitavikramaḥ
verses.translation: Overwhelmed with fury and desirous of burnfng the entire city, Bhargava discharged a missile that had a lustre similar to that ofKalagni (the fire of world-destruction).
verses.hindi: ।२२। युवराज भी क्रोध युक्त हुआ था ओर छोटे भाई विषङ्ग के साय वहाँ उपस्थित हुआ था । उसने भंडासुर को नमस्कार किया था और फिर वह् भी मन्त्रणा के स्थान पर प्राप्त हो गया था ।३। वे उसके मन्त्री बहुत ही विश्वास पात्र ये जिनमें कुटिलाक्ष आदि अग्रणी ये । बिगड़े हुए विचार वाले
verses.wordMeaning: Overwhelmed with fury and desirous of burnfng the entire city, Bhargava discharged a missile that had a lustre similar to that ofKalagni (the fire of world-destruction).
verses.commentary: Sense: Overwhelmed with fury and desirous of burnfng the entire city, Bhargava discharged a missile that had a lustre similar to that ofKalagni (the fire of world-destruction).

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनरभूद्युद्धं रामस्य सह राजभिः । जघान यत्र संक्रुद्धो राज्ञां शतमुदारधीः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ punarabhūdyuddhaṃ rāmasya saha rājabhiḥ / jaghāna yatra saṃkruddho rājñāṃ śatamudāradhīḥ
verses.translation: The fire from that missile burned the city along with elephants, horses and men. The flames enveloped the clusters of the entire rampart-wall of the city.
verses.hindi: उस भंड ने उनके साथ ललिता के विजय करने की मन्त्रणा की थी ।४। भंड ने कहा--अहो ! अब तो असुरों के कुल का विनाश ही प्राप्त हो गया है। यह विधि बड़ा बलवान् है इसने हम लोगों की ओर में उपेक्षा ही करने में अपनी प्रवृत्ति करती है ।५। मेरे भृत्यों के नाम से ही देवगण भाग जाया
verses.wordMeaning: The fire from that missile burned the city along with elephants, horses and men. The flames enveloped the clusters of the entire rampart-wall of the city.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire from that missile burned the city along with elephants, horses and men. The flames enveloped the clusters of the entire rampart-wall of the city.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शूरसेनादीन्हत्वा सबलवाहनान् । त्रणेन पातयामास क्षितौ क्षत्रियमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa śūrasenādīnhatvā sabalavāhanān / traṇena pātayāmāsa kṣitau kṣatriyamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: On seeing the city being burned and desirous of sav- ing his own life, Prince Vllihotra became frightened and fled quickly for the sake of life.
verses.hindi: करते हैं। ऐसे हमारा भो इस समय में विपरीत समय उपस्थित हो गया है ।६। यह होनहार ऐसो बलवान है कि यह बलवान को अलीव (नपु सक) और धनवान को भी धनहीन कर दिया करतो है । जो दीघ आयु वाला है उसको आयुहीन कर दिया करती है। इस होनो का प्रहार बड़ा ही कठिन
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the city being burned and desirous of sav- ing his own life, Prince Vllihotra became frightened and fled quickly for the sake of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the city being burned and desirous of sav- ing his own life, Prince Vllihotra became frightened and fled quickly for the sake of life.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते भग्नसंकल्पा हतस्वबलवाहनाः । हतशिष्टा नृपतयो दुद्रुवुः सर्वतोदिशम्
verses.transliteration: tataste bhagnasaṃkalpā hatasvabalavāhanāḥ / hataśiṣṭā nṛpatayo dudruvuḥ sarvatodiśam
verses.translation: After burning the entire city by means of fire from the missile, and after killing the enemies Rama appeared like the god of Death, the destroyer who devours all the worlds.
verses.hindi: अकांड एव विधिना कुतोऽयं निष्ठुरो विधि:
verses.wordMeaning: After burning the entire city by means of fire from the missile, and after killing the enemies Rama appeared like the god of Death, the destroyer who devours all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning the entire city by means of fire from the missile, and after killing the enemies Rama appeared like the god of Death, the destroyer who devours all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विद्राव्य सैन्यानि हत्वा जित्वाथ संयुगे । जघान शतशो राज्ञः शूराञ्छरवराग्निना
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vidrāvya sainyāni hatvā jitvātha saṃyuge / jaghāna śataśo rājñaḥ śūrāñcharavarāgninā
verses.translation: Accompanied by Akrtavrana and Sahasaha he went ahead making the Earth tremble, as it were, by means of the (rumbling) sound of the chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Akrtavrana and Sahasaha he went ahead making the Earth tremble, as it were, by means of the (rumbling) sound of the chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Akrtavrana and Sahasaha he went ahead making the Earth tremble, as it were, by means of the (rumbling) sound of the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रोधपरीतात्मा दग्धुकामो ऽखिलां पुरीम् । उदैरयद्भार्गवो ऽस्त्रं कालाग्निसदृशप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ krodhaparītātmā dagdhukāmo 'khilāṃ purīm / udairayadbhārgavo 'straṃ kālāgnisadṛśaprabham
verses.translation: After killing all the Ksatriyas on the surface of the Earth, Rama became calm. Then he went to the mountain Mahendra determining in his inind that he should perform penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing all the Ksatriyas on the surface of the Earth, Rama became calm. Then he went to the mountain Mahendra determining in his inind that he should perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing all the Ksatriyas on the surface of the Earth, Rama became calm. Then he went to the mountain Mahendra determining in his inind that he should perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालाकवलिताशेषपुरप्राकारमालिनीम् । पुरीं सहस्त्यश्वनरां स ददाहास्त्रपावकः
verses.transliteration: jvālākavalitāśeṣapuraprākāramālinīm / purīṃ sahastyaśvanarāṃ sa dadāhāstrapāvakaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, in thirtytwo years (?) Ksatriyas rose into prominence. 'Therefore, he returned (from penance) and took the vow ofkilling them.
verses.hindi: इमं प्रसंगं वक्तु' च जिह्वा जिह्वेति मामकी ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, in thirtytwo years (?) Ksatriyas rose into prominence. 'Therefore, he returned (from penance) and took the vow ofkilling them.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, in thirtytwo years (?) Ksatriyas rose into prominence. 'Therefore, he returned (from penance) and took the vow ofkilling them.

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमानां पुरीं दृष्ट्वा प्राणत्राणपरायणः । जीवनाय जगामाशु वीतिहोत्रो भयातुरः
verses.transliteration: dahyamānāṃ purīṃ dṛṣṭvā prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ / jīvanāya jagāmāśu vītihotro bhayāturaḥ
verses.translation: Ksatriya kings were begotten of the widowed wives of those Ksatriyas by Brahmanas. Again he (Rama) killed hundreds and thousands of such kings.
verses.wordMeaning: Ksatriya kings were begotten of the widowed wives of those Ksatriyas by Brahmanas. Again he (Rama) killed hundreds and thousands of such kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksatriya kings were begotten of the widowed wives of those Ksatriyas by Brahmanas. Again he (Rama) killed hundreds and thousands of such kings.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्राग्निना पुरीं सर्वां दग्ध्वा हत्वा च शात्रवान् । प्राशयानो ऽखिलान् लोकान् साक्षात्काल इवान्तकः
verses.transliteration: astrāgninā purīṃ sarvāṃ dagdhvā hatvā ca śātravān / prāśayāno 'khilān lokān sākṣātkāla ivāntakaḥ
verses.translation: In two years, Rama made the Earth devoid of Ksatri- yas once again. At the end of it he performed penance of twenty- four years duration once again.
verses.wordMeaning: In two years, Rama made the Earth devoid of Ksatri- yas once again. At the end of it he performed penance of twenty- four years duration once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: In two years, Rama made the Earth devoid of Ksatri- yas once again. At the end of it he performed penance of twenty- four years duration once again.

verses.sanskrit: अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः सहसाहेन चान्वितः । जगामरथघोषेण कंपयन्निव मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration: akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ sahasāhena cānvitaḥ / jagāmarathaghoṣeṇa kaṃpayanniva medinīm
verses.translation: Again, O king, enlightened Ksatriyas were procreat- ed by the Brahmanas. Raina killed them entirely like the god of death, the destroyer on the Earth.
verses.hindi: हमारी भुजाओं का बल तो कहाँ अर्थात् उस कितना विशाल है और यह दुलंलिता वधू कहां है अर्थात् नारी की शक्ति हमारे सामने सर्वथा तुच्छ है। अनवसर में ही विधाता के ऐसा निष्ठुर विधान कर दिया है कि हमारा विनाश इन अबला नारियों द्वारा हो रहा है ।5। दुवंट शूरता वाली सपिणी
verses.wordMeaning: Again, O king, enlightened Ksatriyas were procreat- ed by the Brahmanas. Raina killed them entirely like the god of death, the destroyer on the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again, O king, enlightened Ksatriyas were procreat- ed by the Brahmanas. Raina killed them entirely like the god of death, the destroyer on the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: विनिघ्नन् क्षत्रियान्सर्वान् संशाम्य पृथिवीतले । महेन्द्राद्रिं ययौ रामस्तपसे धतमानसः
verses.transliteration: vinighnan kṣatriyānsarvān saṃśāmya pṛthivītale / mahendrādriṃ yayau rāmastapase dhatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: In the course of so many years some kings were bom. Killing them Rama roamed over the Earth continuously for two years.
verses.hindi: माया के द्वारा बड़े-बड़े उदग्र सेनानी गण संग्राम भूमि में मारे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of so many years some kings were bom. Killing them Rama roamed over the Earth continuously for two years.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of so many years some kings were bom. Killing them Rama roamed over the Earth continuously for two years.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नष्टचतुष्कं च यावत्क्षत्रसमुद्गमम् । प्रत्येत्य भूयस्तद्धत्यै बद्धदीक्षो धृतव्रतः
verses.transliteration: tasminnaṣṭacatuṣkaṃ ca yāvatkṣatrasamudgamam / pratyetya bhūyastaddhatyai baddhadīkṣo dhṛtavrataḥ
verses.translation: Enough (of this repetition of incidents) O leading king. The Earth was rendered Ksattriya-less by Rama who remembered the death of his father. He cleared the earth of Ksattriyas for all twentyonc times.
verses.hindi: इस रीति से उद्दाम दपं से संयुत कोई माया वाली नारी यदि हमारा संहार कर देती है तो हमारी बाहुओ के ढारा जो भी बल अजित किया गया है उसको धिक्कार हो है ।१०। इस प्रसङ्ग को कहने में भी मेरी जिह्वा लज्जित होतो है । क्या यह बुमंद स्त्री हमारी सेना का मर्दन कर देगी
verses.wordMeaning: Enough (of this repetition of incidents) O leading king. The Earth was rendered Ksattriya-less by Rama who remembered the death of his father. He cleared the earth of Ksattriyas for all twentyonc times.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enough (of this repetition of incidents) O leading king. The Earth was rendered Ksattriya-less by Rama who remembered the death of his father. He cleared the earth of Ksattriyas for all twentyonc times.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रक्षेत्रेषु भूयश्च क्षत्रमुत्पादितं द्विजैः । निजघान पुनर्भूमौ राज्ञ शतसहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: kṣatrakṣetreṣu bhūyaśca kṣatramutpāditaṃ dvijaiḥ / nijaghāna punarbhūmau rājña śatasahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.wordMeaning: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1

verses.sanskrit: वर्षद्वयेन भूयो ऽपि कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां महीम् । षट्चतुष्टयवर्षान्तं तपस्तेपे पुनश्च सः
verses.transliteration: varṣadvayena bhūyo 'pi kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm / ṣaṭcatuṣṭayavarṣāntaṃ tapastepe punaśca saḥ
verses.translation: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.hindi: चाहिए । बने दूतों के मुख से सुना है कि उसकी वृत्ति महा वलवती है
verses.wordMeaning: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1

verses.sanskrit: भूयो ऽपि राजन् संबुद्धं क्षत्रमुत्पादितं द्विजैः । जघान भूमौ निःशेषं साक्षात्काल इवान्तकः
verses.transliteration: bhūyo 'pi rājan saṃbuddhaṃ kṣatramutpāditaṃ dvijaiḥ / jaghāna bhūmau niḥśeṣaṃ sākṣātkāla ivāntakaḥ
verses.translation: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.hindi: बह सब सेना के वह पीछे ही रहतो है और उसके आने हाथी-घोड़े और सेनाए' सब चला करती हैं ।१३। अब इसी अवसर पर उसका पाष्णिग्राह करो । इस पाहिणिग्राह में अर्थात् पीछे पहुँचकर उसको पकड़ने में विषद बहुत कुशल है
verses.wordMeaning: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1

verses.sanskrit: कालेन तावता भूयः समुत्पन्नं नृपात्त्वयम् । निघ्नंश्चचार पृथिवीं वर्षद्वयमनारतम्
verses.transliteration: kālena tāvatā bhūyaḥ samutpannaṃ nṛpāttvayam / nighnaṃścacāra pṛthivīṃ varṣadvayamanāratam
verses.translation: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.hindi: दश पञ्च च सेनान्यः सह यांतु युयुत्सया
verses.wordMeaning: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1

verses.sanskrit: अलं रामेण राजेन्द्र स्मरता निधनं पितुः । त्रिः सप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी तेन निःक्षत्रिया कृता
verses.transliteration: alaṃ rāmeṇa rājendra smaratā nidhanaṃ pituḥ / triḥ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī tena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā
verses.translation: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.hindi: अल्पीयसी त्वया साद्ध सेना गच्छतु विक्रमात् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1

verses.sanskrit: त्रिःसप्तकृत्वस्तन्माता यदुरः स्वमताडयत् । तावद्रामेण तस्मात्तु क्षत्रमुत्सादितं भुवि
verses.transliteration: triḥsaptakṛtvastanmātā yaduraḥ svamatāḍayat / tāvadrāmeṇa tasmāttu kṣatramutsāditaṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.wordMeaning: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते षट्चत्वारिंशत्त मो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४६॥ वसिष्ठ उवाच ततो मूर्द्धाभिषिक्तानां राज्ञाममिततेजसाम् । षट्सहस्रद्वयं रामो जीवग्राहं गृहीतवान्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ṣaṭcatvāriṃśatta mo 'dhyāyaḥ // 46// vasiṣṭha uvāca tato mūrddhābhiṣiktānāṃ rājñāmamitatejasām / ṣaṭsahasradvayaṃ rāmo jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhītavān
verses.translation: That sage of great splendour took these thousands of kings along with the sages to the pilgrimage centre Kuru- ksetra which is full of penance (i.e. sages performing penance).
verses.hindi: अक्षौहिण्यश्च सेनानां दश पञ्च चलंतु ते ।
verses.wordMeaning: That sage of great splendour took these thousands of kings along with the sages to the pilgrimage centre Kuru- ksetra which is full of penance (i.e. sages performing penance).
verses.commentary: Sense: That sage of great splendour took these thousands of kings along with the sages to the pilgrimage centre Kuru- ksetra which is full of penance (i.e. sages performing penance).

verses.sanskrit: ततो राजसहस्राणि गृहीत्वा मुनिभिः सह । स जगाम महातेजाः कुरुक्षेत्रं तपोमयम्
verses.transliteration: tato rājasahasrāṇi gṛhītvā munibhiḥ saha / sa jagāma mahātejāḥ kurukṣetraṃ tapomayam
verses.translation: The leading member of the family of Bhrgu caused five lakes to be dug there. All around them, he got built holy bathing ghats of comfortable access.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading member of the family of Bhrgu caused five lakes to be dug there. All around them, he got built holy bathing ghats of comfortable access.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading member of the family of Bhrgu caused five lakes to be dug there. All around them, he got built holy bathing ghats of comfortable access.

verses.sanskrit: सरसां पञ्चकं तत्र खानयित्वा भृगुद्वहः । सुखावगाहतीर्थानि तानि चक्रे समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: sarasāṃ pañcakaṃ tatra khānayitvā bhṛgudvahaḥ / sukhāvagāhatīrthāni tāni cakre samantataḥ
verses.translation: Bhargava killed the kings there. With the blood flowing out of their bodies he filled those five lakes.
verses.hindi: उस विषंग के साथ युद्ध करने की इच्छा से बड़े प्रौढ़ और मदोन्मक्त दश पाँच सेनानी भी जावें ।११। उनके पीछे की ओर कोई परिवार नहीं है । वह बहुत थोड़े से संनिकों के द्वारा रक्षित है अतः सबका निग्रह आसान है ।१६। इसीलिए मदोत्कट तुम बहुत संग्राम न करके गुपत रूप से विषंग को
verses.wordMeaning: Bhargava killed the kings there. With the blood flowing out of their bodies he filled those five lakes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhargava killed the kings there. With the blood flowing out of their bodies he filled those five lakes.

verses.sanskrit: जघान तत्र वै राज्ञः शरीरप्रभवामृजा । सरांसि तानि वै पञ्च पूरयामास भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: jaghāna tatra vai rājñaḥ śarīraprabhavāmṛjā / sarāṃsi tāni vai pañca pūrayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: समाचरण करो ।१७। आपके साथ बहुत थोड़ी सेना जावे ओर. सेनानी सज्जित होकर चलें जो विक्रम से दिक्पालों के भी विज्यं करने से उद्धत हैं १८) पह अक्षौहिणी सेनाएं भो जावे और तुम गु वेष बाले होकर दु उसको मार डालो ।१२। वह ही सम्पूर्ण शक्तियों की बहुत बड़ी मूल
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तेषु यथान्यायं जामदग्नयः प्रतापवान् । पितॄन्संतर्पयामास यथाशास्त्रमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: snātvā teṣu yathānyāyaṃ jāmadagnayaḥ pratāpavān / pitṝnsaṃtarpayāmāsa yathāśāstramatandritaḥ
verses.translation: He performed Sraddha and other rites. O leading king, of his departed father and mother as mentioned in the scriptures in the company of Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: स्वरूप है उसके समूल विनाश से हो सम्पूणे शक्तियों का समुदाय विन हो जायगा ।२७। जिस प्रकार से सरोजिनी के कन्द के उच्छेदन करने,पर जल में उसके दलों का बिनाश हो जाया करता है । सबके पीछे ही जो एक बड़ा भासुर रथ चला करता हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He performed Sraddha and other rites. O leading king, of his departed father and mother as mentioned in the scriptures in the company of Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed Sraddha and other rites. O leading king, of his departed father and mother as mentioned in the scriptures in the company of Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: पितुः प्रेतस्य राजेन्द्र श्राद्धादिकमशेषतः । ब्राह्मणैः सह मातुश्च तत्र चक्रे यथोदितम्
verses.transliteration: pituḥ pretasya rājendra śrāddhādikamaśeṣataḥ / brāhmaṇaiḥ saha mātuśca tatra cakre yathoditam
verses.translation: Surmounting all unfavourable circumstances thus, he stayed in the holy centre ofKuruksetra abounding in austerities. He was alertly engaged in the worship of Pit? s.
verses.wordMeaning: Surmounting all unfavourable circumstances thus, he stayed in the holy centre ofKuruksetra abounding in austerities. He was alertly engaged in the worship of Pit? s.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surmounting all unfavourable circumstances thus, he stayed in the holy centre ofKuruksetra abounding in austerities. He was alertly engaged in the worship of Pit? s.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तीर्णप्रतीकः स कुरुक्षेत्रे तपोमये । उवासातन्द्रितः सम्यक् पितृपूजापरायणः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tīrṇapratīkaḥ sa kurukṣetre tapomaye / uvāsātandritaḥ samyak pitṛpūjāparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thenceforward, the holy spot created by the son of Jamadagni in the penance grove of Kuruksetra became the most excellent of all excellent sacred places.
verses.wordMeaning: Thenceforward, the holy spot created by the son of Jamadagni in the penance grove of Kuruksetra became the most excellent of all excellent sacred places.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thenceforward, the holy spot created by the son of Jamadagni in the penance grove of Kuruksetra became the most excellent of all excellent sacred places.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृत्यभूद्राजंस्तीर्थानामुत्तमोत्तमम् । विहितं जामदग्न्येन कुरुक्षेत्रे तपोवने
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛtyabhūdrājaṃstīrthānāmuttamottamam / vihitaṃ jāmadagnyena kurukṣetre tapovane
verses.translation: The place where the most excellent one among the members of the family of Bhfgu caused the everlasting satisfac- tion to the manes has come to be known as Syamantapancaka or Samantapancaka. It is well known in all the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: The place where the most excellent one among the members of the family of Bhfgu caused the everlasting satisfac- tion to the manes has come to be known as Syamantapancaka or Samantapancaka. It is well known in all the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The place where the most excellent one among the members of the family of Bhfgu caused the everlasting satisfac- tion to the manes has come to be known as Syamantapancaka or Samantapancaka. It is well known in all the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सस्यमं तपञ्चकमिति स्थानं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । यत्र यक्रे भृगुश्रेष्ठः पितॄणां तृप्तिमक्षयाम्
verses.transliteration: sasyamaṃ tapañcakamiti sthānaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / yatra yakre bhṛguśreṣṭhaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimakṣayām
verses.translation: Hence, give up your furious anger towards the Ksatriyas. With a desire to do what is pleasing to us, regain quietism (restraint of passions). That indeed is our great strength. Welfare unto you".
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, give up your furious anger towards the Ksatriyas. With a desire to do what is pleasing to us, regain quietism (restraint of passions). That indeed is our great strength. Welfare unto you".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, give up your furious anger towards the Ksatriyas. With a desire to do what is pleasing to us, regain quietism (restraint of passions). That indeed is our great strength. Welfare unto you".

verses.sanskrit: स्नानदानतपोहोमद्विजभोजनतर्पणैः । भृशमाप्यायितास्तेन यत्र ते पितरो ऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: snānadānatapohomadvijabhojanatarpaṇaiḥ / bhṛśamāpyāyitāstena yatra te pitaro 'khilāḥ
verses.translation: After telling this to Bhargava all the Pitrs vanished. He too respectfully accepted their proposals.
verses.wordMeaning: After telling this to Bhargava all the Pitrs vanished. He too respectfully accepted their proposals.
verses.commentary: Sense: After telling this to Bhargava all the Pitrs vanished. He too respectfully accepted their proposals.

verses.sanskrit: अवापुरक्षयां तृप्तिं पितृलोकं च शाश्वतम् । समन्तपञ्चकं नाम तीर्थं लोके परिश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: avāpurakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṛlokaṃ ca śāśvatam / samantapañcakaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ loke pariśrutam
verses.translation: Accompanied by Akrtavrana, Rama joyfully went from that pface to Siddhavanasrama.
verses.hindi: हबको हुलुमुलूश्च कलसः कक्लिवाहनः । भू एच चंडताहुश्च कुक्करः
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Akrtavrana, Rama joyfully went from that pface to Siddhavanasrama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Akrtavrana, Rama joyfully went from that pface to Siddhavanasrama.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापक्षयकरं महापुण्योपबृंहितम् । मर्त्यानां यत्र यातानामेनांसि निखिलानि तु
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ mahāpuṇyopabṛṃhitam / martyānāṃ yatra yātānāmenāṃsi nikhilāni tu
verses.translation: After staying there along with the Brahmanas, O king, the noble-minded most excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu, resolved to perform penance.
verses.hindi: वह रथ दशयोजन से सम्पन्न अपने कलेवर को ऊंचाई बाला है। सबके ऊपर एक छत्र पर रहा करता है जो बड़े-बड़े मुक्‍्ताओं से विनिमित है और १रिशोभित है ।२२। वह चार चमरों के द्वारा बार-बार बीज्यमान रहता है अर्थात् चार चमर उस पर ढुराये जाया करते हैं। उस पर एक
verses.wordMeaning: After staying there along with the Brahmanas, O king, the noble-minded most excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu, resolved to perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After staying there along with the Brahmanas, O king, the noble-minded most excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu, resolved to perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: दूरादेवापयास्यन्ति प्रवाते शुष्कपर्णवत् । तत्क्षेत्रचर्यागमनं मर्त्यानामसतामिह
verses.transliteration: dūrādevāpayāsyanti pravāte śuṣkaparṇavat / tatkṣetracaryāgamanaṃ martyānāmasatāmiha
verses.translation: He sent off Sahasaha along with his chariot, the bows and other necessary requisites after making him agree to come again (if and when necessary).
verses.hindi: बहुत ऊँची ध्वजा टंगी रहा करती है जो अम्बुदों के मंडल तक पहुँचती है ।२४ ऐसे ही उस रथ पर वह हरिण के समान सुन्दर नेत्रों वाली आया करती है । तुम चुपचाप इसी चिहन से उसको लक्षित कर तेना ओर उस परु धाबा करके उस दुराचारिणी को जीतकर उसके केश खोंचकर मदन
verses.wordMeaning: He sent off Sahasaha along with his chariot, the bows and other necessary requisites after making him agree to come again (if and when necessary).
verses.commentary: Sense: He sent off Sahasaha along with his chariot, the bows and other necessary requisites after making him agree to come again (if and when necessary).

verses.sanskrit: न लभ्यते महाराज जातु जन्मशतैरपि । समन्तपञ्चकं तीर्थं कुरुक्षेत्रे ऽतिपावनम्
verses.transliteration: na labhyate mahārāja jātu janmaśatairapi / samantapañcakaṃ tīrthaṃ kurukṣetre 'tipāvanam
verses.translation: Then once again, O king, he went to Mahendra, the excellent mountain in order to perform penance. He was surrounded by the Brahmanas then.
verses.hindi: करना । आगे सत्वशाली सेना चलने पर बह वधू स्त्रियों के ही द्वारा रक्षित है ॥२४-२५॥ अतः आपके वश में शोक हो आ जायगी । आपकी सहायता.
verses.wordMeaning: Then once again, O king, he went to Mahendra, the excellent mountain in order to perform penance. He was surrounded by the Brahmanas then.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then once again, O king, he went to Mahendra, the excellent mountain in order to perform penance. He was surrounded by the Brahmanas then.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र स्नातः सर्वतीर्थैः स्नातो भवति मानवः । कृतकृत्यस्ततो रामः सम्यक् पूर्णमनोरथः
verses.transliteration: yatra snātaḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ / kṛtakṛtyastato rāmaḥ samyak pūrṇamanorathaḥ
verses.translation: Conversant with Dharma, he made there a perma- nent abode for himself, O king, as it was a place inhabited by Sages and Siddhas.
verses.wordMeaning: Conversant with Dharma, he made there a perma- nent abode for himself, O king, as it was a place inhabited by Sages and Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Conversant with Dharma, he made there a perma- nent abode for himself, O king, as it was a place inhabited by Sages and Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: उवास तत्र नियतः कञ्चित्कालं महामतिः । ततः संवत्सरस्यान्ते ब्राह्मणैः सहितो वशी
verses.transliteration: uvāsa tatra niyataḥ kañcitkālaṃ mahāmatiḥ / tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito vaśī
verses.translation: Sages living in all the holy centres, the expounders of the Brahman with perfect Self-Control, came there desirous of seeing him as he performed penance.
verses.hindi: करने वाले सेनानियों के ये नाम हैं ।२६। सुनिए, आपकी सहायता के कार्ये में जो भो हैं बे पूर्ण सावधान होंगे । पहिला मदनक नामक है-दूसरा दीघ जिह्न है ।२७। हुबक-हुलुमुलु-कक्लस--कल्कि वाहन--शुक्लस--पुण्डू- केतु चण्ड बाहु--कुक्कुर ये सब नामों बाले होगे
verses.wordMeaning: Sages living in all the holy centres, the expounders of the Brahman with perfect Self-Control, came there desirous of seeing him as he performed penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages living in all the holy centres, the expounders of the Brahman with perfect Self-Control, came there desirous of seeing him as he performed penance.

verses.sanskrit: पितृपिण्डप्रदानाय जामदग्न्यो ऽगमद्गयाम् । ततो गत्वा ततः श्राद्धे यथाशास्त्रमरिन्दमः
verses.transliteration: pitṛpiṇḍapradānāya jāmadagnyo 'gamadgayām / tato gatvā tataḥ śrāddhe yathāśāstramarindamaḥ
verses.translation: Those groups of sages saw him with his mind attach- ed to austerities like a fire that had become calm after burning down a forest of dead trees in the form ofKsatriya completely.
verses.wordMeaning: Those groups of sages saw him with his mind attach- ed to austerities like a fire that had become calm after burning down a forest of dead trees in the form ofKsatriya completely.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those groups of sages saw him with his mind attach- ed to austerities like a fire that had become calm after burning down a forest of dead trees in the form ofKsatriya completely.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयामास पितॄनुद्दिश्य सत्कृतान् । शैवं तत्र परं स्थानं चन्द्रपादमिति स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāṃstarpayāmāsa pitṝnuddiśya satkṛtān / śaivaṃ tatra paraṃ sthānaṃ candrapādamiti smṛtam
verses.translation: On seeing those divine sages full of the power of penance come, Bhargava honoured and welcomed them by means of conventional requisites such as Arghya etc.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing those divine sages full of the power of penance come, Bhargava honoured and welcomed them by means of conventional requisites such as Arghya etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing those divine sages full of the power of penance come, Bhargava honoured and welcomed them by means of conventional requisites such as Arghya etc.

verses.sanskrit: पितृतृप्तिकरं क्षेत्रं तादृग्लोके न विद्यते । यत्रार्चिताः स्वकुलजैर्यथाशक्ति मनागपि
verses.transliteration: pitṛtṛptikaraṃ kṣetraṃ tādṛgloke na vidyate / yatrārcitāḥ svakulajairyathāśakti manāgapi
verses.translation: After enquiries about their mutual welfare (they themselves) engaged in fascinating stories and anecdotes that were meritorious and leading to great advancement and prosperity.
verses.wordMeaning: After enquiries about their mutual welfare (they themselves) engaged in fascinating stories and anecdotes that were meritorious and leading to great advancement and prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After enquiries about their mutual welfare (they themselves) engaged in fascinating stories and anecdotes that were meritorious and leading to great advancement and prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: पितरः पिण्डदानाद्यैः प्राप्स्यन्ति गतिमक्षयाम् । पितॄनुद्दिश्य तत्रासौ तर्प्पितेषु द्विजातिषु
verses.transliteration: pitaraḥ piṇḍadānādyaiḥ prāpsyanti gatimakṣayām / pitṝnuddiśya tatrāsau tarppiteṣu dvijātiṣu
verses.translation: Then, with the approval of these sages of purified souls, he began preparations for performing a horse-sacrifice,1 the greatest of all sacrifices.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, with the approval of these sages of purified souls, he began preparations for performing a horse-sacrifice,1 the greatest of all sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, with the approval of these sages of purified souls, he began preparations for performing a horse-sacrifice,1 the greatest of all sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: ददौ च विधिवत्पिण्डं पितृभक्तिसमन्वितः । ततस्तत्पितरः सर्वे पितृलोकादुपागताः
verses.transliteration: dadau ca vidhivatpiṇḍaṃ pitṛbhaktisamanvitaḥ / tatastatpitaraḥ sarve pitṛlokādupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: In that sacrifice of Rama who had realized the Atman, the Adhvaryu was Kasyapa, the Udgatr was the sage Gautama and the Hotr was Visvamitra.
verses.wordMeaning: In that sacrifice of Rama who had realized the Atman, the Adhvaryu was Kasyapa, the Udgatr was the sage Gautama and the Hotr was Visvamitra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that sacrifice of Rama who had realized the Atman, the Adhvaryu was Kasyapa, the Udgatr was the sage Gautama and the Hotr was Visvamitra.

verses.sanskrit: जगृहुस्तत्कृतां पूजां जमदग्निपुरोगमाः । अथ संप्रीतमनसः समेत्य भृगुनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration: jagṛhustatkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ jamadagnipurogamāḥ / atha saṃprītamanasaḥ sametya bhṛgunandanam
verses.translation: The great sage Markandeya did the work of Brahma. Bharadvaja, Agnivesya and other sages who had thoroughly mastered the Vedas and the Vedangas performed other rites in their due order.
verses.wordMeaning: The great sage Markandeya did the work of Brahma. Bharadvaja, Agnivesya and other sages who had thoroughly mastered the Vedas and the Vedangas performed other rites in their due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sage Markandeya did the work of Brahma. Bharadvaja, Agnivesya and other sages who had thoroughly mastered the Vedas and the Vedangas performed other rites in their due order.

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुस्तत्पितरः सर्वे ऽदृश्या भूत्वान्तरिक्षगाः । पितर ऊचुः महत्कर्म कृतं वीर भवतान्यैः सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: ūcustatpitaraḥ sarve 'dṛśyā bhūtvāntarikṣagāḥ / pitara ūcuḥ mahatkarma kṛtaṃ vīra bhavatānyaiḥ suduṣkaram
verses.translation: After giving the promise of freedom from fear to all living beings, the delighter of the family of Bhrgu began to perform penance there itself on the excellent mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: After giving the promise of freedom from fear to all living beings, the delighter of the family of Bhrgu began to perform penance there itself on the excellent mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving the promise of freedom from fear to all living beings, the delighter of the family of Bhrgu began to perform penance there itself on the excellent mountain.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मानपि यथान्यायं सम्यक् तर्पितवानसि । अस्माकमक्षयां प्रीतिं तथापि त्वं न यच्छसि
verses.transliteration: asmānapi yathānyāyaṃ samyak tarpitavānasi / asmākamakṣayāṃ prītiṃ tathāpi tvaṃ na yacchasi
verses.translation: All the sages of praiseworthy holy rites who had acted as Sadasyas ( members of the sacrificial assembly) and sacrificial priests (Rtviks) took leave of him and returned the way they had come.
verses.wordMeaning: All the sages of praiseworthy holy rites who had acted as Sadasyas ( members of the sacrificial assembly) and sacrificial priests (Rtviks) took leave of him and returned the way they had come.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the sages of praiseworthy holy rites who had acted as Sadasyas ( members of the sacrificial assembly) and sacrificial priests (Rtviks) took leave of him and returned the way they had come.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रहत्यां हि कृत्वा तु कृतकर्माभवद्यतः । क्षेत्रस्यास्य प्रभावेण भक्त्या च तव दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: kṣatrahatyāṃ hi kṛtvā tu kṛtakarmābhavadyataḥ / kṣetrasyāsya prabhāveṇa bhaktyā ca tava darśanam
verses.translation: After they had gone, the holy lord (Rama) began the performance of a great penance and lived happily there itself in the company of Akrtavrana.
verses.wordMeaning: After they had gone, the holy lord (Rama) began the performance of a great penance and lived happily there itself in the company of Akrtavrana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After they had gone, the holy lord (Rama) began the performance of a great penance and lived happily there itself in the company of Akrtavrana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्ताःस्म पूजिताः किं तु नाक्षय्यफलभागिनः । त्समात्त्वं वीरहत्यादिपापप्रशमनाय हि
verses.transliteration: prāptāḥsma pūjitāḥ kiṃ tu nākṣayyaphalabhāginaḥ / tsamāttvaṃ vīrahatyādipāpapraśamanāya hi
verses.translation: Thus the appearance of the son of Jamadagni has been narrated. On hearing this story, a man is rid of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the appearance of the son of Jamadagni has been narrated. On hearing this story, a man is rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the appearance of the son of Jamadagni has been narrated. On hearing this story, a man is rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं यथान्यायं कुरु धर्मं च शाश्वतम् । वधाच्च विनिवर्तस्व क्षत्रियाणामतः परम्
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ yathānyāyaṃ kuru dharmaṃ ca śāśvatam / vadhācca vinivartasva kṣatriyāṇāmataḥ param
verses.translation: In the course of the story, the prowess of Karttavfrya whose splendour had become renowned in the world, had been duly narrated without being too brief or too prolix.
verses.hindi: जम्बुकाक्ष--जंभन-तीकषणशृ'ग-त्रिकण्टक--ओर चन्द्रगुकत ये पन्द्रह शो सेनानी हैं ।२९। ये सब एक-एक अक्षोहिणी सेना से समन्वित होकर आपके साथ रहेंगे। महान बल बाले दमन प्रभृति भी सेनानी गण आयेंगे ।३०। तुम्हारी गति को शत्रू की सेना जिस तरह से न जान पावे उसी भांति
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of the story, the prowess of Karttavfrya whose splendour had become renowned in the world, had been duly narrated without being too brief or too prolix.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of the story, the prowess of Karttavfrya whose splendour had become renowned in the world, had been duly narrated without being too brief or too prolix.

verses.sanskrit: पितुर्न्न ते ऽपराध्यन्ते न स्वतन्त्रं यतो जगत् । तन्निमित्तं तु मरणं पितुस्ते विहितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: piturnna te 'parādhyante na svatantraṃ yato jagat / tannimittaṃ tu maraṇaṃ pituste vihitaṃ purā
verses.translation: That king Karttavlrya had such great potentiality and influence on the Earth that there will never be a man like him in future. A man like him has never been heard of in the past.
verses.hindi: परम गुप्त समाचरण वाला होकर पाण्णिग्राह का समाचरण करो ।३१। इस कार्य में महान पुरुषों की प्रौढता का उद्वहन करते हुए ही है विषंग ! परम उत्तम जय सिद्धि को प्राप्त करोगे ।३२। दुर्मन्त्रणा वाले उस भंड ने इस तरह से ऐसी मन्त्रा करते हुए सैन्य पालको के द्वारा रक्षित करके विषंग
verses.wordMeaning: That king Karttavlrya had such great potentiality and influence on the Earth that there will never be a man like him in future. A man like him has never been heard of in the past.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king Karttavlrya had such great potentiality and influence on the Earth that there will never be a man like him in future. A man like him has never been heard of in the past.

verses.sanskrit: हन्तुं कं कः समर्थः स्याल्लोके रक्षितुमेव वा । निमित्तमात्रमेवेह सर्वः सर्वस्य चैतयोः
verses.transliteration: hantuṃ kaṃ kaḥ samarthaḥ syālloke rakṣitumeva vā / nimittamātrameveha sarvaḥ sarvasya caitayoḥ
verses.translation: Since he had formerly solicited from Dattatreya the boon of death ai the hands of Utlamapuru$a (Lord Visnu or an excellent person), he attained salvation on being killed in battle by Rama.
verses.hindi: को भेजा था ।३३। इसके अनन्तर श्री ललिता देवी के पार्ण्णग्राह के उद्योग
verses.wordMeaning: Since he had formerly solicited from Dattatreya the boon of death ai the hands of Utlamapuru$a (Lord Visnu or an excellent person), he attained salvation on being killed in battle by Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he had formerly solicited from Dattatreya the boon of death ai the hands of Utlamapuru$a (Lord Visnu or an excellent person), he attained salvation on being killed in battle by Rama.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवं कर्मानुरूपं ते चेष्टन्ते सर्व एव हि । कालानुवृत्तं बलवान्नृलोको नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dhruvaṃ karmānurūpaṃ te ceṣṭante sarva eva hi / kālānuvṛttaṃ balavānnṛloko nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: His fifth son who had been well-known by the name Jayadhvaja, O king, had a powerful son named Talajangha.
verses.hindi: में युवराजानुज देत्य के होने पर सूर्य अस्ताल पर चला गया था
verses.wordMeaning: His fifth son who had been well-known by the name Jayadhvaja, O king, had a powerful son named Talajangha.
verses.commentary: Sense: His fifth son who had been well-known by the name Jayadhvaja, O king, had a powerful son named Talajangha.

verses.sanskrit: बाधितुं भुवि भूतानि भूतानां न विधिं विना । शक्यते वत्स सर्वो ऽपि यतः शक्त्या स्वकर्मकृत्
verses.transliteration: bādhituṃ bhuvi bhūtāni bhūtānāṃ na vidhiṃ vinā / śakyate vatsa sarvo 'pi yataḥ śaktyā svakarmakṛt
verses.translation: He had a hundred sons who were excellent archers. They were known as 'Talajanghas'. The eldest among them was vltihotra.
verses.hindi: लोक भीषण प्रथम युद्ध के दिवस में पाथ्णिग्राह के करने की इच्छा से उसको अन्धकार हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: He had a hundred sons who were excellent archers. They were known as 'Talajanghas'. The eldest among them was vltihotra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a hundred sons who were excellent archers. They were known as 'Talajanghas'. The eldest among them was vltihotra.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रं प्रति ततो रोषं विमुच्यास्मत्प्रियेप्सया । शममा प्नुहि भद्रं ते स ह्यस्माकं परं बलम्
verses.transliteration: kṣatraṃ prati tato roṣaṃ vimucyāsmatpriyepsayā / śamamā pnuhi bhadraṃ te sa hyasmākaṃ paraṃ balam
verses.translation: The senior Talajangha lived for a long time in the middle of Himalayan forests along with his sons Vltihotra and others as well as Haihaya and other kings.
verses.wordMeaning: The senior Talajangha lived for a long time in the middle of Himalayan forests along with his sons Vltihotra and others as well as Haihaya and other kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The senior Talajangha lived for a long time in the middle of Himalayan forests along with his sons Vltihotra and others as well as Haihaya and other kings.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधुः सर्वे पितरो भृगुनन्दनम् । स चापि तद्वचः सर्वं प्रतिजग्राह सादरम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca ityuktvāntardadhuḥ sarve pitaro bhṛgunandanam / sa cāpi tadvacaḥ sarvaṃ pratijagrāha sādaram
verses.translation: All of them lived on the Himalayas, afflicted by great fear. They had a lot of sufferings and they had only greens, roots and fruits for food.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them lived on the Himalayas, afflicted by great fear. They had a lot of sufferings and they had only greens, roots and fruits for food.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them lived on the Himalayas, afflicted by great fear. They had a lot of sufferings and they had only greens, roots and fruits for food.

verses.sanskrit: अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तो मुदा परमया युतः । प्रययौ च तदा रामस्तस्मात्सिद्धवनाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: akṛtavraṇasaṃyukto mudā paramayā yutaḥ / prayayau ca tadā rāmastasmātsiddhavanāśramam
verses.translation: Thereafter, when Rama calmed down with his mind engrossed in penances, Talajangha along with his sons regained his kingdom.1
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, when Rama calmed down with his mind engrossed in penances, Talajangha along with his sons regained his kingdom.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, when Rama calmed down with his mind engrossed in penances, Talajangha along with his sons regained his kingdom.1

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्स्थित्वा भृगुश्रेष्ठो ब्राह्मणैः सहितो नृप । तपसे धृतसंकल्पो बभूव स महामनाः
verses.transliteration: tasminsthitvā bhṛguśreṣṭho brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito nṛpa / tapase dhṛtasaṃkalpo babhūva sa mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: The excellent king, the suppressor of his enemies, established the city once again as before, stayed there and pro- tected his own kingdom.
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent king, the suppressor of his enemies, established the city once again as before, stayed there and pro- tected his own kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent king, the suppressor of his enemies, established the city once again as before, stayed there and pro- tected his own kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: सरथं सहसाहं च धनुःसंहननानि च । पुनरागमसंकेतं कृत्वा प्रास्थापयत्तदा
verses.transliteration: sarathaṃ sahasāhaṃ ca dhanuḥsaṃhananāni ca / punarāgamasaṃketaṃ kṛtvā prāsthāpayattadā
verses.translation: Recollecting the previous enmity, O great king, Talajangha attacked your city along with his sons, followers and armies.
verses.wordMeaning: Recollecting the previous enmity, O great king, Talajangha attacked your city along with his sons, followers and armies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Recollecting the previous enmity, O great king, Talajangha attacked your city along with his sons, followers and armies.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स सर्वतीर्थेषु चक्रे स्नानमतन्द्रितः । परीत्यपृथिवीं सर्वां पितृदेवादिबूजकः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa sarvatīrtheṣu cakre snānamatandritaḥ / parītyapṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ pitṛdevādibūjakaḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by his army consisting of four units, that king approached the city of Ayodhya, making the Earth tremble as it were and yelled loudly.
verses.hindi: अब उम अस्घकार के स्वरूप का वर्णन किया जाता है जो उस समय में वहाँ छाया हुआ था--बह अन्धकार महिष के स्कन्ध के तुल्य धू श्र आभा वाला था। उसकी कान्ति बन क्रोड़ के वपु सदृश थो-नीलकण्ठ पक्षी के समान उसकी कान्ति थी--ऐसा बहुत हो घना अन्धकार छा गया था
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by his army consisting of four units, that king approached the city of Ayodhya, making the Earth tremble as it were and yelled loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his army consisting of four units, that king approached the city of Ayodhya, making the Earth tremble as it were and yelled loudly.

verses.sanskrit: एवं क्रमेण पृथिवीं त्रिवारं भुगुनन्दनः । परिचक्राम राजेन्द्र लोकवृत्तमनुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ krameṇa pṛthivīṃ trivāraṃ bhugunandanaḥ / paricakrāma rājendra lokavṛttamanuvrataḥ
verses.translation: The rise of the power of Haihayas (Talajanghas) after the retirement of paraiurama from active life, shows the temporary effect of Paras'ur&ma*s conquests. T&lajarighas not only recovered their kingdom but establishing their dominance on the Indo-gangetic plain, they drove out the ruler of Ayodhya who, due to blood relation with Jamadagni, was an ally of Parajurama.
verses.hindi: बह तम कुळ्जों में पिण्डित सा हो रहा था तथा सन्धियों में दौड़ सी लगा रहा था वह अन्धकार सहस्रो भूमि के विवरों से बाहिर की ओर निकल सा रहा था ।३७। पवंतों की कल्दराओं से मानों वह अन्धकार बाहिर निकलकर आरहाथा। कहीं पर बह दीपों की प्रभा के जाल में कातर चेष्टित कर
verses.wordMeaning: The rise of the power of Haihayas (Talajanghas) after the retirement of paraiurama from active life, shows the temporary effect of Paras'ur&ma*s conquests. T&lajarighas not only recovered their kingdom but establishing their dominance on the Indo-gangetic plain,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The rise of the power of Haihayas (Talajanghas) after the retirement of paraiurama from active life, shows the temporary effect of Paras'ur&ma*s conquests. T&lajarighas not only recovered their kingdom but establishing their dominance on the Indo-gangetic plain,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः स पर्वतश्रेष्ठं महेन्द्रं पुनरप्यथ । जगाम तपसे राजन्बाह्मणैरभिसंवृतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa parvataśreṣṭhaṃ mahendraṃ punarapyatha / jagāma tapase rājanbāhmaṇairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Your father, even though of futile authority, came out of the city. Although he was very old, he fought like a young man with all those kings.
verses.hindi: रहा था ।३८। स्त्रियों के कानों के उत्पल की कान्ति में मानों उस तमने
verses.wordMeaning: Your father, even though of futile authority, came out of the city. Although he was very old, he fought like a young man with all those kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your father, even though of futile authority, came out of the city. Although he was very old, he fought like a young man with all those kings.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्मिंश्चिररात्राय मुनि सिद्धनिषेविते । निवासमात्मनो राजन्कल्पयामास धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: sa tasmiṃścirarātrāya muni siddhaniṣevite / nivāsamātmano rājankalpayāmāsa dharmavit
verses.translation: She had become emaciated due to starvation and other miseries, over and above it, she was now agitated over the demise of her husband. Hence, she firmly resolved to immolate herself and to enter into t lie funeral.
verses.wordMeaning: She had become emaciated due to starvation and other miseries, over and above it, she was now agitated over the demise of her husband. Hence, she firmly resolved to immolate herself and to enter into t lie funeral.
verses.commentary: Sense: She had become emaciated due to starvation and other miseries, over and above it, she was now agitated over the demise of her husband. Hence, she firmly resolved to immolate herself and to enter into t lie funeral.

verses.sanskrit: मुनयस्तं तपस्यन्तं सर्वक्षेत्रनिवासिनः । द्रष्टुकामाः समाजग्मुर्नियता ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: munayastaṃ tapasyantaṃ sarvakṣetranivāsinaḥ / draṣṭukāmāḥ samājagmurniyatā brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing about all these, Aurva, the great sage, himself came out of the hermitage. Restraining her from self- immolation he said thus: —
verses.hindi: समाश्म ग्रहण किया था । प्रौड़ दिड्नाग की भांति कज्जल में वह अन्धकार एकीशूत-सां हो रहा था और स्फुरित जाइल के मंडल में मित्रता सी आवड कर रहा या ।३६। स्फुरण करती हुईं असियट्टियो चें प्रिया के आश्लेष सा यह तम कर रहा था । श्याम बनों की पंक्तियों में गुप्त रूप से वह प्रविष्ट-सा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing about all these, Aurva, the great sage, himself came out of the hermitage. Restraining her from self- immolation he said thus: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about all these, Aurva, the great sage, himself came out of the hermitage. Restraining her from self- immolation he said thus: —

verses.sanskrit: ददृशुस्ते मुनिगणास्तपस्यासक्तमानसम् । क्षात्रं कक्षमशेषेण दग्ध्वा शान्तमिवानलम्
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuste munigaṇāstapasyāsaktamānasam / kṣātraṃ kakṣamaśeṣeṇa dagdhvā śāntamivānalam
verses.translation: "You must not die now, O queen. There lies in your womb a son who will be the most excellent one among all Emperors".
verses.hindi: हो रहा था । वह अस्घेरी रात्रि सुन्दर नेत्रो वाली रमणी है जो अपनी नीली कंचुकी की कान्ति से समन्वित है । ऐसे अन्धकार से सम्पूर्ण विश्व समावृत हो गया चा ओर कुछ भी सूक नहीं रहा था । पूरे दृष्ट असुरों को तो रात्रि ही बल देने वाली हुआ करती है
verses.wordMeaning: "You must not die now, O queen. There lies in your womb a son who will be the most excellent one among all Emperors".
verses.commentary: Sense: "You must not die now, O queen. There lies in your womb a son who will be the most excellent one among all Emperors".

verses.sanskrit: अथ तानागतान्दृष्ट्वा मुनीन्दिव्यांस्तपोमयान् । अर्घ्यादिसमुदाचारैः पूजयामास भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: atha tānāgatāndṛṣṭvā munīndivyāṃstapomayān / arghyādisamudācāraiḥ pūjayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: That sage performed all the post-natal holy rites for you. You have been brought up in the hermitage of Aurva. He took pity on you.
verses.wordMeaning: That sage performed all the post-natal holy rites for you. You have been brought up in the hermitage of Aurva. He took pity on you.
verses.commentary: Sense: That sage performed all the post-natal holy rites for you. You have been brought up in the hermitage of Aurva. He took pity on you.

verses.sanskrit: कृतकौशलसंप्रश्नपूर्वकाः सुमहोदयाः । तेषां तस्य च संवृत्ताः कथाः पुण्या मनोहराः
verses.transliteration: kṛtakauśalasaṃpraśnapūrvakāḥ sumahodayāḥ / teṣāṃ tasya ca saṃvṛttāḥ kathāḥ puṇyā manoharāḥ
verses.translation: All details connected with him have been recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: All details connected with him have been recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: All details connected with him have been recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषामनुमते मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । हयमेधं महायज्ञमाहर्तुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣāmanumate munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām / hayamedhaṃ mahāyajñamāhartumupacakrame
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: उन असुरों का यह माया का विलास उस अंधेरी रात्रि में हो बढ़ा करता है। इसके उपरान्त महान् ओज वाले विंषंग के साथ सेना रवाना हुई थी ॥४३) दमन प्रभृति सेनानीगण श्याम कड्भूंट के धारण करने वाले हैँ और अन्धकार की छटा धौत खड्ग की कान्ति को बढ़ाने वाला था ।४४। वे
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: संभृत्य सर्वसंभारानौर्वाद्यैः सहितो नृप । विश्वामित्रभरद्वाजमार्कण्डेयादिभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: saṃbhṛtya sarvasaṃbhārānaurvādyaiḥ sahito nṛpa / viśvāmitrabharadvājamārkaṇḍeyādibhistathā
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: संब श्याम पगडी के धारण करने बाले बे और उनके समस्त परिच्छद भी इयाम वर्ण के ही ये । अत्यधिक अन्धकारे से आवृत हुए वे सब एकता को
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: तेषा मनुमते कृत्वा काश्यपं गुरुमात्मनः । वाजिमेधं ततो राजन्नाजहार महाक्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: teṣā manumate kṛtvā kāśyapaṃ gurumātmanaḥ / vājimedhaṃ tato rājannājahāra mahākratum
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: प्राप्त जैसे हो गये वे।०५। अपने बड़े भाई को नेमस्कोर करने वाले विषंग के पीछे चल दिये थे । वह विषंग इट युद्ध के द्वारा महेश्वरी के जीतने को इच्छा बाला था ।४६। उसने मेघडम्बर नाम वाले कद्भुट को बक्षः स्थल पर धारण किया था। उसके वेष का संग्रह भी निशा के युद्ध के ही अनुरूप था
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: तस्याभूत्काश्यपो ऽध्वर्युरुद्गाता गौतमो मुनिः । विश्वामित्रो ऽभवद्धोता रामस्य विदितात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasyābhūtkāśyapo 'dhvaryurudgātā gautamo muniḥ / viśvāmitro 'bhavaddhotā rāmasya viditātmanaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: थे । उस समय में न तो किसी दुग्दुनि का घोष या ओर त कोई महू लकी ही गर्जना थी !४८। प्रणव-जानक और भेरियों को भो उस समय में धवति नहीं हुई थी। वे सबके सब गुप्त समाचरण आले आकार से समावृत होते हुए रवाना हुए ये
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मत्वमकरोत्तस्य मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः । भरद्वाजाग्निवेश्याद्या वेद वेदाङ्गपारगाः
verses.transliteration: brahmatvamakarottasya mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ / bharadvājāgniveśyādyā veda vedāṅgapāragāḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: मुनयश्चक्रुरन्यानि कर्माण्यन्ये यथाक्रमम् । पुत्त्रैः शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैश्च सहितो भगवान्भृगुः
verses.transliteration: munayaścakruranyāni karmāṇyanye yathākramam / puttraiḥ śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaiśca sahito bhagavānbhṛguḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
