verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: सादस्यमकरोद्राजन्नन्यैश्च मुनिभिः सह । स तैः सहाखिलं कर्म समाप्य भृगुपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: sādasyamakarodrājannanyaiśca munibhiḥ saha / sa taiḥ sahākhilaṃ karma samāpya bhṛgupuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं पूजयामास यथावद्गुरुणा सह । अलङ्कृत्य यथान्याय कन्यां रूपवतीं महीम्
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ pūjayāmāsa yathāvadguruṇā saha / alaṅkṛtya yathānyāya kanyāṃ rūpavatīṃ mahīm
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: पुरग्रामशतोपेतां समुद्रांबरमालिनीम् । आहूय भृगुशार्दूलः सशैलवनकाननाम्
verses.transliteration: puragrāmaśatopetāṃ samudrāṃbaramālinīm / āhūya bhṛguśārdūlaḥ saśailavanakānanām
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: काश्यपाय ददौ सर्वामृते तं शैलमुत्तमम् । आत्मनः सन्निवासार्थं तं रामः पर्यकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: kāśyapāya dadau sarvāmṛte taṃ śailamuttamam / ātmanaḥ sannivāsārthaṃ taṃ rāmaḥ paryakalpayat
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: ये सव ऐसे वहां से चले थे कि दूसरों के द्वारा नं देसे जावें । इन्होने रिष्टियों को म्यानों से निकाल लिया घ्रा । ललिता को सेना के पश्चिम की ओर मुह करके ही ये. गमन कर रहे ये ।५०। आवृत उत्तर. मागे से ने पूर्व भाग का समाश्रय ग्रहण किया था। ये पद-पद पर अपने
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृतिराजेन्द्र पूजयामास शास्त्रतः । हिरण्यरत्नवस्त्रश्वगोगजान्नादिभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛtirājendra pūjayāmāsa śāstrataḥ / hiraṇyaratnavastraśvagogajānnādibhistathā
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: निःश्वासो की ध्वनि को भी चलने में नहीं कर रहे ये ।५१। दानवरण बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: पुरा समाप्य यज्ञान्ते तथा चावभृथाप्लुतः । चक्रे द्रव्यपरित्यागं तेषामनुमते तदा
verses.transliteration: purā samāpya yajñānte tathā cāvabhṛthāplutaḥ / cakre dravyaparityāgaṃ teṣāmanumate tadā
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा च सर्वभूतानामभयं भृगुनन्दनः । तत्रापि पर्वतवरे तपश्चर्तुं समारभत्
verses.transliteration: dattvā ca sarvabhūtānāmabhayaṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ / tatrāpi parvatavare tapaścartuṃ samārabhat
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: ही साबधान होकर पार्ष्णिग्राह के लिए बल दिये ये । फिर पुर के दिग्भाग में जाकर मन्द पराक्रम बाले हो गये ये।१२। ललिता देवो की सेना भी अपने लोगों को सूचना दे रही थो। वे कवचो से डके हुए शरीरों वाले पीछे की ओर चुपचाप आ गये थे ।५३ और उन्होंते ऊंचे तथा मेरु गिरि के
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तं समनुज्ञाय सदस्या ऋत्विजस्तथा । ययुर्यथागतं सर्वे मुनयः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: tatastaṃ samanujñāya sadasyā ṛtvijastathā / yayuryathāgataṃ sarve munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: समान चक्रराज रथ को देखा था जो अत्यधिक प्रदीप्त शक्तियों से परि- बारित था ।५४। वहाँ पर मुक्ता निमित्त आतपत्र (छत्र) के नीचे वह देवी विराजमान थी । सहो सूर्यो के सहश कान्ति वाली ओर पश्चिम की मुख किये हुए स्थित यीं ।५५॥ उस उत्तम रथ में अपने ही समान समृद्धि से संयुत
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: गतेषु तेषु भगवानकृतव्रणसंयुतः । तपो महत्समास्थाय तत्रैव न्यवसत्सुखी
verses.transliteration: gateṣu teṣu bhagavānakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ / tapo mahatsamāsthāya tatraiva nyavasatsukhī
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: कामेश्वरी आदि नित्याओं के साथ नमं आलाप के बिनोद से सेब्पमान हो रहीं थी
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: काश्यपी तु ततो भूमिर्जननाथा ह्यनेकशः । सर्वदुःखप्रशान्त्यर्थं मारीचानुमतेन तु
verses.transliteration: kāśyapī tu tato bhūmirjananāthā hyanekaśaḥ / sarvaduḥkhapraśāntyarthaṃ mārīcānumatena tu
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दीपप्रतिष्ठाख्यव्रतं विष्णुमुखोदितम् । चचार धरणी सम्यक् दुखैर्ःमुक्ताभवच्च सा
verses.transliteration: tatra dīpapratiṣṭhākhyavrataṃ viṣṇumukhoditam / cacāra dharaṇī samyak dukhairḥmuktābhavacca sā
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष जामदग्न्यस्य प्रादुर्भाव उदाहृतः । यस्मिञ्श्रुते नरः सर्वपातकैर्विप्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa jāmadagnyasya prādurbhāva udāhṛtaḥ / yasmiñśrute naraḥ sarvapātakairvipramucyate
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावः कार्त्तवीर्यस्य लोके प्रथिततेजसः । प्रसंगात्कथितः सम्यङ्नातिसंक्षेपविस्तरः
verses.transliteration: prabhāvaḥ kārttavīryasya loke prathitatejasaḥ / prasaṃgātkathitaḥ samyaṅnātisaṃkṣepavistaraḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: एवंप्रभावः स नृपः कार्त्तवीर्यो ऽभवद्भुवि । न तादृशः पुमात्कश्चिद्भावी भूताथवा श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃprabhāvaḥ sa nṛpaḥ kārttavīryo 'bhavadbhuvi / na tādṛśaḥ pumātkaścidbhāvī bhūtāthavā śrutaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: उस प्रकार से वतमान तथा अताइशों की शरणागति के उद्यम बाली को देखा था। उसके सामने महान् सेना कौतुक पूर्वक देख रही थो
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: दत्तात्रेयाद्वरं वव्रे मृतिमुत्तमपूरुषात् । यत्पुरा सो ऽगमन्मुक्तिं रणे रामेण घातितः
verses.transliteration: dattātreyādvaraṃ vavre mṛtimuttamapūruṣāt / yatpurā so 'gamanmuktiṃ raṇe rāmeṇa ghātitaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: है । उस रयेन्द्र के पीछे की ओर में सेनिकों द्वारा घटून किया था ।४८। वहाँ पर अणिमा आदि शक्तियों के परिवार की सेनाओं ने महान् कलकल किया था अणिमा आदिक सैकड़ों से भी अधिक थी ।५६। पट्टिश--दुघण--भिन्वि- पाल--मुशुण्ही -कठोर वच्च के समान निर्घात से निष्ठुर शक्तियों के
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: तस्यासीत्पञ्चमः पुत्रः पख्यातो यो जयध्वजः । पुत्रस्तस्य महाबाहुस्तालजङ्घो ऽभवन्नृप
verses.transliteration: tasyāsītpañcamaḥ putraḥ pakhyāto yo jayadhvajaḥ / putrastasya mahābāhustālajaṅgho 'bhavannṛpa
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: मण्डलों से युद्ध हुआ था ।६०। महात् सत्त्व वाले असुर मर्दन करते हुए उस समर को बहुत मानने लगे ये । उस रय में संस्थित शक्तियों का मण्डल अचानक रणोत्साह के विपयं से आविष्ट विग्रहों वाला हो गया था ओर अनवसर में क्षोभयुत हुआ था । अन्धरकारों ने अहृश्य विपाटों से पाटित कर
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: अभूत्तस्यापि पुत्राणां शतमुत्तमधन्विनाम् । तालजङ्घाभिधा येषां वीतिहोत्रो ऽग्रजो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: abhūttasyāpi putrāṇāṃ śatamuttamadhanvinām / tālajaṅghābhidhā yeṣāṃ vītihotro 'grajo 'bhavat
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: दिया था ।६१-६२। इसके अनन्तर बे नवम चक्र रधे्द्र के पर्व पर संस्थित थे । अदृश्यमान निजव्मों बाले--अह॒श्य शस्त्रो बाले तथा अन्धकार से छन्न स्वरूषों वाले दानवों के वाणों से शक्तियों का मण्डल छन्नवमित की भाति. इधर-उधर बहुत कष्टित हुआ था ।६३-६४ी
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रैः सवीतिहोत्राद्यैर्हैहयाद्यैश्च राजभिः । कालं महान्तमवसद्धिमाद्रिवानगह्वरे
verses.transliteration: putraiḥ savītihotrādyairhaihayādyaiśca rājabhiḥ / kālaṃ mahāntamavasaddhimādrivānagahvare
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: यः पूर्वं राम बाणेन द्रवन्पृष्ठे ऽभिताडितः । तालजङ्घो ऽपतद्भूमौ मूर्छितो गाढवेदनः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ pūrvaṃ rāma bāṇena dravanpṛṣṭhe 'bhitāḍitaḥ / tālajaṅgho 'patadbhūmau mūrchito gāḍhavedanaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श वीतिहोत्रस्तं द्रवन्दैववशादिव । रथमारोप्य वेगेन पलायनपरो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: dadarśa vītihotrastaṃ dravandaivavaśādiva / rathamāropya vegena palāyanaparo 'bhavat
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ते तत्र न्यवसन्सर्वे हिमाद्रौ भयपीडिताः । कृच्छ्रं महान्तमासाद्य शाकमूलफलाशनः
verses.transliteration: te tatra nyavasansarve himādrau bhayapīḍitāḥ / kṛcchraṃ mahāntamāsādya śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ततः शान्तिं गते रामे तपस्यासक्तमानसे । जालजङ्घः स्वकं राज्यं सपुत्रः प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śāntiṃ gate rāme tapasyāsaktamānase / jālajaṅghaḥ svakaṃ rājyaṃ saputraḥ pratyapadyata
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: और उसने ललिता देवी के पास कस्दन किया था। बहाँ पर पुर्व अनुक्रम से महान् भय प्राप्त हो गया था ।६५। कानों-कानों से ललिता देवी
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: सन्निवेश्य पुरीं भूयः पूर्ववन्नृपसत्तमः । वसंस्तदा निजं राज्यमापालयदरिन्दमः
verses.transliteration: sanniveśya purīṃ bhūyaḥ pūrvavannṛpasattamaḥ / vasaṃstadā nijaṃ rājyamāpālayadarindamaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: ३४४  ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण ने सुना तो बड़ा ही अधिक कोप किया था। इसी बीच में दुष्ट मन्त्रियों से अन्त्रणां करके चण्ड भण्ड ने देश अक्षौहिणी से संयृत--महस् ओज वाले कुटिलाक्ष को ललिता की सेना के विनाज्ञ करने के लिये भेजा था
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: सुपुत्रः सानुगबलः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् । अभ्याययौ महाराज तालजङ्घः पुरं तव
verses.transliteration: suputraḥ sānugabalaḥ pūrvavairamanusmaran / abhyāyayau mahārāja tālajaṅghaḥ puraṃ tava
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: जिस रीति से पीछे को ओर कल-कल ध्वनि को सुनकर आगे वाली सेना न आ सके इसी प्रकार से कुटिलाक्ष ने महान् संग्राम (किया था।६८॥ इसी तरह से पीछे और आगे दोनों ओर था वह युद्ध हुआ क्र और वह युद्ध शक्तियों के सैन्ये में महान् तुमुल हुआ था ।६६। रात्रि में सत्त्व वाले देन
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: चतुरङ्गबलोपेतः कंपयन्निव मेदिनीम् । रुरोदाभ्येत्य नगरीमयोध्यां स महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: caturaṅgabalopetaḥ kaṃpayanniva medinīm / rurodābhyetya nagarīmayodhyāṃ sa mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: थे जो तिंमित में समावृत वे और उद्धतों मे कण्टक में शिथिलता को आत कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ततो निष्क्रम्य नगरात्फलगुतन्त्रो ऽपि ते पिता । युयुधे तैर्नृपैः सर्वैर्वृद्धो ऽपि तरुणो यथा
verses.transliteration: tato niṣkramya nagarātphalagutantro 'pi te pitā / yuyudhe tairnṛpaiḥ sarvairvṛddho 'pi taruṇo yathā
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: निहतानेकमातगतुरङ्गरथसैनिकः । शत्रुभिर्निर्जितो वृद्धः पलायनपरो ऽ भवत्
verses.transliteration: nihatānekamātagaturaṅgarathasainikaḥ / śatrubhirnirjito vṛddhaḥ palāyanaparo ' bhavat
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा स नगरं राज्यं सकोशबलवाहनम् । अन्तर्वत्न्या च ते मात्रा सहितो वनमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā sa nagaraṃ rājyaṃ sakośabalavāhanam / antarvatnyā ca te mātrā sahito vanamāviśat
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: तत्र चौर्वाश्रमोपान्ते निवसन्नचिरादिव । शोकामर्षसमाविष्टो वृद्धभावेन च स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra caurvāśramopānte nivasannacirādiva / śokāmarṣasamāviṣṭo vṛddhabhāvena ca svayam
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: विलोक्यमानो मात्रा ते बाष्पगद्गदकण्ठया । अनाथ इव राजेन्द्र स्वर्गलोकमितो गतः
verses.transliteration: vilokyamāno mātrā te bāṣpagadgadakaṇṭhayā / anātha iva rājendra svargalokamito gataḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते जननी राजन्दुःखशोकसमन्विता । चितामारोपयद्भर्तू रुदती सा कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: tataste jananī rājanduḥkhaśokasamanvitā / citāmāropayadbhartū rudatī sā kalevaram
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: अनशनादिदुःखेन भर्त्तुर्व्यसनकर्शिता । चकाराग्निप्रवेशाय सुदृढां मतिमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: anaśanādiduḥkhena bhartturvyasanakarśitā / cakārāgnipraveśāya sudṛḍhāṃ matimātmanaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: और्वस्तदखिलं श्रुत्वा स्वयमेव महामुनिः । निर्गत्य चाश्रमात्तां च वारयन्निदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: aurvastadakhilaṃ śrutvā svayameva mahāmuniḥ / nirgatya cāśramāttāṃ ca vārayannidamabravīt
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: न मर्त्तव्यं त्वया राज्ञि सांप्रतं जठरे तव । पुत्रस्तिष्ठति सर्वेषां प्रवरश्चवर्त्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: na marttavyaṃ tvayā rājñi sāṃprataṃ jaṭhare tava / putrastiṣṭhati sarveṣāṃ pravaraścavarttinām
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: प्रणिपत्य च तां देवीं महाराज्ञीं महोदयाम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा माता तव मनस्विनी । विरराम मृतेस्तां तु मुनिः स्वाश्रममानयत् । ततः सा सर्वदुःखानि नियम्य त्वन्मुखांबुजम्
verses.transliteration: iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mātā tava manasvinī / virarāma mṛtestāṃ tu muniḥ svāśramamānayat / tataḥ sā sarvaduḥkhāni niyamya tvanmukhāṃbujam
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: दिदृक्षुराश्रमोपान्ते तस्यैव न्यवसत्सुखम् । सुषाव च ततः काले सा त्वामौर्वाश्रमे तदा
verses.transliteration: didṛkṣurāśramopānte tasyaiva nyavasatsukham / suṣāva ca tataḥ kāle sā tvāmaurvāśrame tadā
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: बुरे आशय वाले बिषंग ने घमनादि श्रेष्ठ सेनाप तियों के ओर सेनाओं के द्वारा प्रणहित शत्रू को कोटियां निपतित कर दी थीं ।७। उन देत्यो अस्त्रो की मालाओं से वह चक्रराज रथ ढक गया था और वह वक्रं की पंक्तियों से ढके हुए शेल राज को ही भाँति जोभित हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्मादिकं सर्वं भवतः सो ऽकरोन्मुनिः । और्वाश्रमे विवृद्धश्च भवांस्तेनानुकंपितः
verses.transliteration: jātakarmādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavataḥ so 'karonmuniḥ / aurvāśrame vivṛddhaśca bhavāṃstenānukaṃpitaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: आक्रान्त पर्व के नीचे दुरात्मा विषंग के द्वारा छोड़े हुए एक दाण ने देवी के तालवृन्त का चूर्णे कर दिया था ।७३। इसके पश्चात् अव्याहत उसके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव विदितं सर्वमतः परमरिन्दम । एवं प्रभावो नृपतिः कार्त्तवीर्यो ऽभवद्भुवि
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva viditaṃ sarvamataḥ paramarindama / evaṃ prabhāvo nṛpatiḥ kārttavīryo 'bhavadbhuvi
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: शक्तियों का मण्डल हो गया तो ऐसा होने पर कामेश्वरी £ जो नित्याऐ हीं उनको बड़ा भारी क्रोध हो गया था ।७४। थोडा-सा धृकुटियों से संसक्त श्री देवी के मुख कमल को देखकर नित्याओं को बहुत ही उद्वंग हो गया था और उन्होने अत्यधिक श्रम किया था (७५ नित्याए" काल के ही स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतः । यद्वंशजैर्जितो युद्धे पिता ते वनमादिशत्
verses.transliteration: vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa sarvalokeṣu viśrutaḥ / yadvaṃśajairjito yuddhe pitā te vanamādiśat
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: वाली थीं और प्रत्येक तिथि के विग्रह वाली थीं । उन्होंने साम्राज्ञी के क्रोध को देखकर युद्ध करने का विशेष उद्यम किया था ।७६। उने महान् उद्यम से समन्विता उस महाराज्ञी को प्रणिपात करके उस समय भनवसर में उत्यित और युद्ध के कौतुक से गद्गद वाणी कही थी
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: तद्वृत्तान्तमशेषेण मया ते समुदीरितम् । एतच्च सर्वमाख्यातं व्रतानामुत्तमं तव
verses.transliteration: tadvṛttāntamaśeṣeṇa mayā te samudīritam / etacca sarvamākhyātaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ tava
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: समन्त्रतन्त्रं लोकेषु सर्वलोकफलप्रदम् । न ह्यस्य कर्त्तुर्नृपतेः पुरुषार्थचतुष्टये
verses.transliteration: samantratantraṃ lokeṣu sarvalokaphalapradam / na hyasya kartturnṛpateḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: भवत्यभीप्सितं किञ्चिद्दर्ल्लभं भुवनत्रये । संक्षेपेण मयाख्यातं व्रतं हैहयभूभुजः । जामदग्न्यस्य च मुने किमन्यत्कथयामि ते
verses.transliteration: bhavatyabhīpsitaṃ kiñciddarllabhaṃ bhuvanatraye / saṃkṣepeṇa mayākhyātaṃ vrataṃ haihayabhūbhujaḥ / jāmadagnyasya ca mune kimanyatkathayāmi te
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच ततः स सगरो राजा कृताञ्जलिपुटो मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca tataḥ sa sagaro rājā kṛtāñjalipuṭo munim
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: या वह्मिवासिनी नित्या या उवालामालिनी परा ।
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भगवन्नेतत्कर्तुमिच्छाम्यहं व्रतम् । सम्यक्तमुपदेशेन तत्रानुज्ञां प्रयच्छ मे
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhagavannetatkartumicchāmyahaṃ vratam / samyaktamupadeśena tatrānujñāṃ prayaccha me
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणानेन विप्रर्षे कृतार्थो ऽस्मि न संशयः । इत्युक्तस्तेन राज्ञातु तथेत्युक्त्वा महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: karmaṇānena viprarṣe kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ / ityuktastena rājñātu tathetyuktvā mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: दीक्षयामास राजानं शस्त्रोक्तेनैव वर्त्मना । स दीक्षितो वसिष्ठेन सगरो राजसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: dīkṣayāmāsa rājānaṃ śastroktenaiva vartmanā / sa dīkṣito vasiṣṭhena sagaro rājasattamaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्याण्यानीय विधिवत्प्रचचार शुभव्रतम् । पूजयित्वा जगन्नाथं विधिना तेन पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: dravyāṇyānīya vidhivatpracacāra śubhavratam / pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ vidhinā tena pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: समाप्य च यथायोग्यमनुज्ञाय गुरुं ततः । प्रतिज्ञामकरोद्राजा व्रतमेतदनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: samāpya ca yathāyogyamanujñāya guruṃ tataḥ / pratijñāmakarodrājā vratametadanuttamam
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: तिथि नित्याओं ने कहा था--हे देवदेवि ! आप तो महाराज्ञी हैं। आपके आगे प्रेक्षित सेना है जो दण्डिनी और मन्त्रनाथा आदि महान्
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: आजीवान्तं धरिष्यामि यत्नेनेति महामतिः । अथानुज्ञाप्य राजानं वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः
verses.transliteration: ājīvāntaṃ dhariṣyāmi yatneneti mahāmatiḥ / athānujñāpya rājānaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: सन्निवर्त्यानुगच्छन्तं प्रजगाम निजाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: sannivartyānugacchantaṃ prajagāma nijāśramam
verses.translation: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.hindi: शक्तियों से अभिपालित हैं ।७८। ये माया के कपट में परायण दुष्ट ओर कातर हैत्यगण पाणिग्राह युद्ध के द्वारा इस श्रेष्ठ रथ को धषित करने के लिए बाधा पहुँचा रहे हैं ।६। इस कारण से अन्कार से संच्छन्न कलेवरों बाले असुरों के घमण्ड को हम एक हो क्षण में शमन करती हैं--आप देखिये
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this holy rite, O Brahmanical sage, I shall undoubtedly be blessed."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरोपाख्याने वसिष्ठगमनं नाम सप्तचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः जैमिनिरुवाच गते तस्मिन्मुनिवरे सगरो राजसत्तमः । अयोध्यायामधिवस्न्पालयामास मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaropākhyāne vasiṣṭhagamanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ jaiminiruvāca gate tasminmunivare sagaro rājasattamaḥ / ayodhyāyāmadhivasnpālayāmāsa medinīm
verses.translation: After the departure of that excellent sage, Sagara the best of the kings, resided in Ayodhya and ruled over the earth.
verses.hindi: दोनों के द्वारा प्रदीपित युद्ध में वे असुर देखे जा सकते है ।८१। पाण्णिग्राह में अर्थात् पीछे ते घेरा डालकर युद्ध करने में श्रवत हए दत्यो के महान् दर्प को प्रशास्त कर हम लोग तुरन्त ही आपके श्री चरण कमलों की सेवा करने के लिए वापिस आ जायेंगी । है महाराजि ! आप हमको आज्ञा दीजिए कि
verses.wordMeaning: After the departure of that excellent sage, Sagara the best of the kings, resided in Ayodhya and ruled over the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the departure of that excellent sage, Sagara the best of the kings, resided in Ayodhya and ruled over the earth.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसंपद्गणोपेतः सर्वधर्मार्थतत्त्ववित् । वयसैव स बालो ऽभूत्कर्मणा वृद्धसंमतः
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṃpadgaṇopetaḥ sarvadharmārthatattvavit / vayasaiva sa bālo 'bhūtkarmaṇā vṛddhasaṃmataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that his kingdom had been annexed by the enemies after vanquishing his father, that he had fled to the dense forest along with his (king Sagara's) mother and that he had passed away in the same forest, the king became grief- stricken. Habitually, true to his promise, he angrily took the vow of exterminating the entire race of his enemies. A king belonging to the family of Iksvaku is unable to bear the fire of discomfiture.
verses.hindi: हम उन दुरात्माओं का मदन कर डालें ।८२। नित्याओं के द्वारा इस प्रकार से कहने पर उस महादेवो ने कहा था--ऐसा ही करो । इसके पश्चात् नित्या कामेश्वरों ने ललितेश्वरी को प्रणाम किया था ओर उसके द्वारा भेजी हुई” शक्तियों ने धनुष को खोंचकर कुण्डलीकृत बना दिया था ।८३। उसने बाल
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that his kingdom had been annexed by the enemies after vanquishing his father, that he had fled to the dense forest along with his (king Sagara's) mother and that he had passed away in the same forest, the king became grief- stricken. Habitually, true to his promise,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that his kingdom had been annexed by the enemies after vanquishing his father, that he had fled to the dense forest along with his (king Sagara's) mother and that he had passed away in the same forest, the king became grief- stricken. Habitually, true to his promise,…

verses.sanskrit: तथापि न दिवा भुक्तें शेते वा निशि संस्मरन् । सुदीर्घं निःश्वसित्युष्णमुद्विग्नहृदयो ऽनिशम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi na divā bhukteṃ śete vā niśi saṃsmaran / sudīrghaṃ niḥśvasityuṣṇamudvignahṛdayo 'niśam
verses.translation: Once, the king, having celebrated a solemn ceremony, resolved to defeat his enemy and to conquer all the quarters in due order.
verses.hindi: सूर्य के समान क्रोध से लाल अपने गुख करके क्रूर युद्ध करने वाले उन दुष्टात्माओं का हनन करते के लिए घावा वोल दिया था और उनसे कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Once, the king, having celebrated a solemn ceremony, resolved to defeat his enemy and to conquer all the quarters in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, the king, having celebrated a solemn ceremony, resolved to defeat his enemy and to conquer all the quarters in due order.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा राजा स्वराज्यं निजगुरुमवजित्यारिभिः संगृहीतं मात्रा सार्द्धं प्रयान्तं वनमतिगहनंस्वर्गतं तं च तस्मिन् । शोकाविष्टः सरोषं सकलरिपुकुलोच्छित्तये सत्प्रतिज्ञश्चके सद्यः प्रतिज्ञां परिभवमनलं सोढुमिक्ष्वाकुवंश्यः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā rājā svarājyaṃ nijagurumavajityāribhiḥ saṃgṛhītaṃ mātrā sārddhaṃ prayāntaṃ vanamatigahanaṃsvargataṃ taṃ ca tasmin / śokāviṣṭaḥ saroṣaṃ sakalaripukulocchittaye satpratijñaścake sadyaḥ pratijñāṃ paribhavamanalaṃ soḍhumikṣvākuvaṃśyaḥ
verses.translation: Surrounded on all sides by many thousands of chariots and elephants, horses, chariots,* and foot-soldiers, the king set out from his excellent city.
verses.wordMeaning: Surrounded on all sides by many thousands of chariots and elephants, horses, chariots,* and foot-soldiers, the king set out from his excellent city.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surrounded on all sides by many thousands of chariots and elephants, horses, chariots,* and foot-soldiers, the king set out from his excellent city.

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिन्महीपालः कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः । रिपुं जेतुं मनश्चक्रे दिशश्च सकलाः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sa kadācinmahīpālaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ / ripuṃ jetuṃ manaścakre diśaśca sakalāḥ kramāt
verses.translation: In order to destroy his enemies he started with his combined force consisting of six Aftgas 1 (Parts, Units), which appeared like the ocean that is agitated due to different kinds of animals and series of waves, on account of the galloping horses; he appeared to be moving along with the entire world consisting of the groups of Kulagiris 2 on account of the herds of elephants in rut; he appeared to be moving along with the firmament brightened by the good (i.e. white) rays of the moon, on account of the stream of white umbrellas and banners (of the army on march).
verses.wordMeaning: In order to destroy his enemies he started with his combined force consisting of six Aftgas 1 (Parts, Units), which appeared like the ocean that is agitated due to different kinds of animals and series of waves, on account of the galloping horses;…
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to destroy his enemies he started with his combined force consisting of six Aftgas 1 (Parts, Units), which appeared like the ocean that is agitated due to different kinds of animals and series of waves, on account of the galloping horses;…

verses.sanskrit: अनेकरथसाहस्रैर्गजाश्वरथसैनिकैः । सर्वतः संवृतो राजा निश्चक्राम पुरोत्तमात्
verses.transliteration: anekarathasāhasrairgajāśvarathasainikaiḥ / sarvataḥ saṃvṛto rājā niścakrāma purottamāt
verses.translation: As the king proceeded ahead in his campaign, the low lying areas (depressions) of the earth were filled up with the dust particles of the mountain ranges pounded by the feet of the armies of the front ranks. The ground thus raised there, always became a fence like hedge, due to the dust particles raised severally by the armies consisting of the four units.
verses.wordMeaning: As the king proceeded ahead in his campaign, the low lying areas (depressions) of the earth were filled up with the dust particles of the mountain ranges pounded by the feet of the armies of the front ranks. The ground thus raised there, always became a fence like hedge,…
verses.commentary: Sense: As the king proceeded ahead in his campaign, the low lying areas (depressions) of the earth were filled up with the dust particles of the mountain ranges pounded by the feet of the armies of the front ranks. The ground thus raised there, always became a fence like hedge,…

verses.sanskrit: शत्रून्हन्तुं प्रतस्थे निजबलनिवहेनोत्पतद्भिस्तुरङ्गैर्नासत्त्वोर्मिजालाकुलजलनिधिनिभेनाथ षाडङ्गिकेन । मत्तैर्मातङ्गयूथैः सकुलगिरिकुलेनैव भूमण्डलेन श्वेतच्छत्रध्वजौघैरपि शशिसुकराभातखेनैव सार्द्धम्
verses.transliteration: śatrūnhantuṃ pratasthe nijabalanivahenotpatadbhisturaṅgairnāsattvormijālākulajalanidhinibhenātha ṣāḍaṅgikena / mattairmātaṅgayūthaiḥ sakulagirikulenaiva bhūmaṇḍalena śvetacchatradhvajaughairapi śaśisukarābhātakhenaiva sārddham
verses.translation: He killed many haughty warriors confronting the arrays of elephants, horses, and chariots. He wore the splend- our of the moon-crested lord (Siva) who killed the armies of the hordes of Asuras; during the periods of encircling and attacking the cities of the enemies, he used to proclaim from a distance, the duties (of the enemy soldiers) in the case of defeat and mortification; he used to give them sufficient time to move away quickly and he used to assure them of no harm or loss to their lives (he made them confident of the safety to their lives).
verses.hindi: ज्वालामालिनि नित्या च या नित्या वहिनवासिनी ।
verses.wordMeaning: He killed many haughty warriors confronting the arrays of elephants, horses, and chariots. He wore the splend- our of the moon-crested lord (Siva) who killed the armies of the hordes of Asuras; during the periods of encircling and attacking the cities of the enemies,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He killed many haughty warriors confronting the arrays of elephants, horses, and chariots. He wore the splend- our of the moon-crested lord (Siva) who killed the armies of the hordes of Asuras; during the periods of encircling and attacking the cities of the enemies,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्याग्रेसरसैन्ययूथचरणप्रक्षुण्णशैलोच्चयक्षोदापूरितनिम्नभागमवनीपालस्य संयास्यतः । प्रत्येकं चतुरङ्गसैन्यनिकरप्रक्षोदसंभूतभूरेणुप्रावृतिरुत्स्थली समभवद्भूमिस्तु तत्रानिशम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāgresarasainyayūthacaraṇaprakṣuṇṇaśailoccayakṣodāpūritanimnabhāgamavanīpālasya saṃyāsyataḥ / pratyekaṃ caturaṅgasainyanikaraprakṣodasaṃbhūtabhūreṇuprāvṛtirutsthalī samabhavadbhūmistu tatrāniśam
verses.translation: Seven principal mountains such as Mahendra, Malaya, Sahyadri an<i others.
verses.wordMeaning: Seven principal mountains such as Mahendra, Malaya, Sahyadri an<i others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven principal mountains such as Mahendra, Malaya, Sahyadri an<i others.

verses.sanskrit: निघ्नन्दृप्ताननेकान्द्विपतुरगरथव्यूहसंभिन्नवीरान्सद्यः शोभां दधानो ऽसुरनिकरचमूर्निघ्नतश्चन्द्रमौलिः । दूरादेवाभिशंसन्नरिनगरनिरोधेषु कर्माभिषङ्गे तेषां शीघ्रापयानक्षणमभिदिशति प्राणिधैर्यं विधत्ते
verses.transliteration: nighnandṛptānanekāndvipaturagarathavyūhasaṃbhinnavīrānsadyaḥ śobhāṃ dadhāno 'suranikaracamūrnighnataścandramauliḥ / dūrādevābhiśaṃsannarinagaranirodheṣu karmābhiṣaṅge teṣāṃ śīghrāpayānakṣaṇamabhidiśati prāṇidhairyaṃ vidhatte
verses.translation: The kings were rendered helpless with their bodies being burned by the flames of the Bhirgava missile which was discharged by him. The missile which was extremely terrific and which made the three worlds frightened shone brilliantly. Immediately they were rendered blind by the darkness due to the columns of smoke made to whirl round by the Vayu missile (one whose deity is the wind god). They wandered here and
verses.wordMeaning: The kings were rendered helpless with their bodies being burned by the flames of the Bhirgava missile which was discharged by him. The missile which was extremely terrific and which made the three worlds frightened shone brilliantly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings were rendered helpless with their bodies being burned by the flames of the Bhirgava missile which was discharged by him. The missile which was extremely terrific and which made the three worlds frightened shone brilliantly.…

verses.sanskrit: विजिगीषुर्दिशो राजा राज्ञो यस्याभियास्यति
verses.transliteration: vijigīṣurdiśo rājā rājño yasyābhiyāsyati
verses.translation: After defeating all the Haihayas in battle, Sagara the powerful King, had the features of an agitated ocean. He moved against the Kambojas.
verses.hindi: हे पापियो ! ठहरो, माया में संस्थित तुमको मैं कभी छिन्त-मिन्न करे देती तुम लोग अन्धकार को प्राप्त करके इस क्रूर युद्ध में तत्पर हो रहे हो ।८५। इस रीति से उनको फटकारती हुई उससे अपने तूणीर से उत्खात सामक से पर्वावरोहण किया था और क्रोधावेश से उसकी गति प्रस्खलित
verses.wordMeaning: After defeating all the Haihayas in battle, Sagara the powerful King, had the features of an agitated ocean. He moved against the Kambojas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After defeating all the Haihayas in battle, Sagara the powerful King, had the features of an agitated ocean. He moved against the Kambojas.

verses.sanskrit: विषयं स नृपस्तस्य सद्यः प्रणतिमेष्यति । विजित्य नृपतीन्सर्वान्कृत्वा च स्वपदानुगान्
verses.transliteration: viṣayaṃ sa nṛpastasya sadyaḥ praṇatimeṣyati / vijitya nṛpatīnsarvānkṛtvā ca svapadānugān
verses.translation: Kambojas,1 Talajanghas, Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others — his enemies who had offended him formerly, be- came utterly confounded as they lost courage on hearing the sounds of the wardrums and various other musical instruments (of Sagara's army). They immediately abandoned their king- doms, armies, cities and ladies of their harems. They wandered here and there to various directions due to their fear (of a fresh discharge) of his arrows and missiles.
verses.hindi: हो रही थी ।८६। वे कामं कों को हाथों में सजाये हुई थीं और उनके आगे भगमालायें थीं और अन्य नित्याए' पर्वारोहृण करके चल दी थीं
verses.wordMeaning: Kambojas,1 Talajanghas, Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others — his enemies who had offended him formerly, be- came utterly confounded as they lost courage on hearing the sounds of the wardrums and various other musical instruments (of Sagara's army).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Kambojas,1 Talajanghas, Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others — his enemies who had offended him formerly, be- came utterly confounded as they lost courage on hearing the sounds of the wardrums and various other musical instruments (of Sagara's army).…

verses.sanskrit: संकेत गामिनः कांश्चित्कृत्वा राज्ये न्यवर्त्तत । एवं स विसरन्दिक्षु दक्षिणाभिमुखो नृपः
verses.transliteration: saṃketa gāminaḥ kāṃścitkṛtvā rājye nyavarttata / evaṃ sa visarandikṣu dakṣiṇābhimukho nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: The enemies of that king were frightened. Their vision became blinded by the flames of the fire of his valour. T!rhey abandoned their homes, realms etc. along with their sons and others. Being attacked and chased by the armies of their enemies, they fled to the forest region where also they were stunned and stupefied by another enemy who got up from his sleep in the caves of the mountain.
verses.hindi: ज्याला मालिनी नित्या ओर बहिनवासिनी नित्या ये दोनों ही युद्ध में सज्जित हुई थो और इन्होंने अपने तेजों ये रण में प्रदीपन कर दिया था । ।दन। इसके अनन्तर युद्ध मण्डल के प्रदीप्त होने पर वे दुष्ट दनुज प्रकाशित फलेवरों वाले हो गये थे ओर उनको बड़ा क्रोध हो गया था ।८६। कामेश्वरी
verses.wordMeaning: The enemies of that king were frightened. Their vision became blinded by the flames of the fire of his valour. T!rhey abandoned their homes, realms etc. along with their sons and others. Being attacked and chased by the armies of their enemies,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The enemies of that king were frightened. Their vision became blinded by the flames of the fire of his valour. T!rhey abandoned their homes, realms etc. along with their sons and others. Being attacked and chased by the armies of their enemies,…

verses.sanskrit: स्मरन्पूर्वकृतं वैरं हैहयानभ्यवर्त्तत । ततस्तस्य नृपैः सार्द्धं समग्ररथकुञ्जरैः
verses.transliteration: smaranpūrvakṛtaṃ vairaṃ haihayānabhyavarttata / tatastasya nṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ samagrarathakuñjaraiḥ
verses.translation: After exterminating the Talajanghas along with their armies and vehicles, that king, the suppressor of Enemies, gradually destroyed their kingdom.
verses.hindi: प्रभृति नित्या” आयु से सयुत प्रह थीं। वे मिहनादों से ही उन दंटयों का मदन सा हो कर रही थो । इस समय में यहाँ युद्ध में महान् कल-कल हो गया था । वह कलकल ऐसा ही घा मानों मन्दराचल से ्षोभित्त सागर के बिलोडन से तर'गों के मण्डल का हो रहा होवे
verses.wordMeaning: After exterminating the Talajanghas along with their armies and vehicles, that king, the suppressor of Enemies, gradually destroyed their kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: After exterminating the Talajanghas along with their armies and vehicles, that king, the suppressor of Enemies, gradually destroyed their kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: बभूव हैहयैर्वीरैः संग्रामो रोमहर्षणः । राज्ञां यत्र सहस्राणि स बलानि महाहवे
verses.transliteration: babhūva haihayairvīraiḥ saṃgrāmo romaharṣaṇaḥ / rājñāṃ yatra sahasrāṇi sa balāni mahāhave
verses.translation: Kambojas were a people in northern Afghanistan. The Shiaposh tribe which now resides on the Hindukush is said to have been descendants of ancient Kambojas — (De 87). K&mbojas, Sakas, Yavanas were people in the north-west Frontier. But they are blubbed together with Kiratas (tribe from North-eastern India, Tip&rfi, Sikkim (West) and Eastern Nepal and Talajanghas from the Narmada valley.
verses.wordMeaning: Kambojas were a people in northern Afghanistan. The Shiaposh tribe which now resides on the Hindukush is said to have been descendants of ancient Kambojas — (De 87). K&mbojas, Sakas, Yavanas were people in the north-west Frontier.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Kambojas were a people in northern Afghanistan. The Shiaposh tribe which now resides on the Hindukush is said to have been descendants of ancient Kambojas — (De 87). K&mbojas, Sakas, Yavanas were people in the north-west Frontier.…

verses.sanskrit: निजघान महाबाहुः संक्रुद्धः कोसलेश्वरः । जित्वा हैहयभूपालान्भङ्क्त्वा दग्ध्वा च तत्पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: nijaghāna mahābāhuḥ saṃkruddhaḥ kosaleśvaraḥ / jitvā haihayabhūpālānbhaṅktvā dagdhvā ca tatpurīm
verses.translation: Extremely infuriated he slew many of the Yavanas, Kambojas, Kira t as and others as well as Palhavas1 and Paradas.
verses.hindi: जघान दमन दुष्ट कामेशी प्रथमं शरा: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Extremely infuriated he slew many of the Yavanas, Kambojas, Kira t as and others as well as Palhavas1 and Paradas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Extremely infuriated he slew many of the Yavanas, Kambojas, Kira t as and others as well as Palhavas1 and Paradas.

verses.sanskrit: निःशेषशून्या मकरोद्वैरान्तकरणो नृपः । समग्रबलसंमर्द्दप्रमृष्टाशेषभूतलः
verses.transliteration: niḥśeṣaśūnyā makarodvairāntakaraṇo nṛpaḥ / samagrabalasaṃmarddapramṛṣṭāśeṣabhūtalaḥ
verses.translation: On being struck down by him in battle, those kings became frightened. Those who survived the slaughter fled all round in groups.
verses.hindi: कक्लसं वहिनवासा च निजघान शरेः शतैः
verses.wordMeaning: On being struck down by him in battle, those kings became frightened. Those who survived the slaughter fled all round in groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being struck down by him in battle, those kings became frightened. Those who survived the slaughter fled all round in groups.

verses.sanskrit: हैहयानामशेषं तु चक्रे राज्यं रजःसमम् । राज्यं पुरीं चापहाय भ्रष्टैश्वर्या हतत्विषः
verses.transliteration: haihayānāmaśeṣaṃ tu cakre rājyaṃ rajaḥsamam / rājyaṃ purīṃ cāpahāya bhraṣṭaiśvaryā hatatviṣaḥ
verses.translation: "I am the son of that king whose kingdom was taken away by many of you. I am desirous of wreaking revenge. I have come here purposely as I have taken a vow of killing you all forcibly." Thus the king Sagara who had the virility of elephants and the splendour destructive of Ksatriya heroes, made his enemy kings hear his life story. He thus reminded the other kings (of his previous history).
verses.wordMeaning: "I am the son of that king whose kingdom was taken away by many of you. I am desirous of wreaking revenge.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am the son of that king whose kingdom was taken away by many of you. I am desirous of wreaking revenge.…

verses.sanskrit: राजानो हतभूयिष्ठा व्यद्रवन्त समन्ततः । अभिद्रुत्य नृपांस्तांस्तु द्रवमाणान्महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: rājāno hatabhūyiṣṭhā vyadravanta samantataḥ / abhidrutya nṛpāṃstāṃstu dravamāṇānmahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: ''Be our refuge, O Brahmana. Wc are distressed and we desire freedom from fear. Our bodies are being burnt by the fire ofSagara's missiles. We arc about to die.
verses.wordMeaning: ''Be our refuge, O Brahmana. Wc are distressed and we desire freedom from fear. Our bodies are being burnt by the fire ofSagara's missiles. We arc about to die.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''Be our refuge, O Brahmana. Wc are distressed and we desire freedom from fear. Our bodies are being burnt by the fire ofSagara's missiles. We arc about to die.

verses.sanskrit: जघान सानुगान्मत्तः प्रजाः क्रुद्ध इवान्तकः । ततस्तान्प्रति सक्रोधः सगरः समरे ऽरिहा
verses.transliteration: jaghāna sānugānmattaḥ prajāḥ kruddha ivāntakaḥ / tatastānprati sakrodhaḥ sagaraḥ samare 'rihā
verses.translation: Determined in wreaking vengeance, he kills all of us without exception. We are desirous of preserving our lives by coming out of that danger.
verses.wordMeaning: Determined in wreaking vengeance, he kills all of us without exception. We are desirous of preserving our lives by coming out of that danger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Determined in wreaking vengeance, he kills all of us without exception. We are desirous of preserving our lives by coming out of that danger.

verses.sanskrit: मुमोचास्त्रं महारौद्रं भार्गवं रीपुभीषणम् । तेनोत्सृष्टातिरौद्रत्रिभुवनभयदप्रस्फुरद्भार्गवास्त्रज्वालादन्दह्यमानावशतनुततयस्ते नृपाः साद्य एव । वाय्वस्त्रावृत्तधूमोद्गमपटलतमोमुष्टदृष्टिप्रसारा भ्रेमुर्भूपृष्टलोठद्बहुलतमरजोगूढमात्रा मुहूर्त्तम्
verses.transliteration: mumocāstraṃ mahāraudraṃ bhārgavaṃ rīpubhīṣaṇam / tenotsṛṣṭātiraudratribhuvanabhayadaprasphuradbhārgavāstrajvālādandahyamānāvaśatanutatayaste nṛpāḥ sādya eva / vāyvastrāvṛttadhūmodgamapaṭalatamomuṣṭadṛṣṭiprasārā bhremurbhūpṛṣṭaloṭhadbahulatamarajogūḍhamātrā muhūrttam
verses.translation: Our kingdoms have been split. Our pleasures and prosperity have been ruined. Our wives, children and relatives have been separated from us. It is only for saving our life that we are seeking refuge in you.
verses.wordMeaning: Our kingdoms have been split. Our pleasures and prosperity have been ruined. Our wives, children and relatives have been separated from us. It is only for saving our life that we are seeking refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our kingdoms have been split. Our pleasures and prosperity have been ruined. Our wives, children and relatives have been separated from us. It is only for saving our life that we are seeking refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: आगनेयास्त्रप्रतापप्रतिहतगतयो ऽदृष्टमार्गाः समन्ता द्भूपाला नष्टसंघाः परवशतनवो व्याकुलीभूतचित्ताः । भीताः संत्युक्तवस्त्रायुधकवचविभूषादिका मुक्तकेशा विस्पष्टोन्मत्तभावान्भृश तरमनुकुर्वन्त्यग्रतः शात्रवाणाम्
verses.transliteration: āganeyāstrapratāpapratihatagatayo 'dṛṣṭamārgāḥ samantā dbhūpālā naṣṭasaṃghāḥ paravaśatanavo vyākulībhūtacittāḥ / bhītāḥ saṃtyuktavastrāyudhakavacavibhūṣādikā muktakeśā vispaṣṭonmattabhāvānbhṛśa taramanukurvantyagrataḥ śātravāṇām
verses.translation: The Pur&ga distinguishes between Palhavas and Paradas. Paradas were Parthians (probably Pf thus in RVJ.But Dc opines that Paradas dwelt in northern Beluchistan (Ds 148) Palhavas were a tribe in Media (Mada) — a part of the Parthian (ancient Persian) empire. Their country was famous for horses (De. 143)
verses.hindi: अथ नीलपताका च विजया च जयोद्धते ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Pur&ga distinguishes between Palhavas and Paradas. Paradas were Parthians (probably Pf thus in RVJ.But Dc opines that Paradas dwelt in northern Beluchistan (Ds 148) Palhavas were a tribe in Media (Mada) — a part of the Parthian (ancient Persian) empire.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pur&ga distinguishes between Palhavas and Paradas. Paradas were Parthians (probably Pf thus in RVJ.But Dc opines that Paradas dwelt in northern Beluchistan (Ds 148) Palhavas were a tribe in Media (Mada) — a part of the Parthian (ancient Persian) empire.…

verses.sanskrit: विजित्य हैहयान्सर्वान्समरे सगरो बली । संक्षुब्धसागराकारः कांबोजानभ्यवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: vijitya haihayānsarvānsamare sagaro balī / saṃkṣubdhasāgarākāraḥ kāṃbojānabhyavarttata
verses.translation: You had been chosen as the family preceptor of the kings born of the solar race by the kings, his predecessors in the family. Your power and influence is such.
verses.hindi: जम्बुकाक्षं जृ भणं च व्यतन्वातां रणे बलिम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: You had been chosen as the family preceptor of the kings born of the solar race by the kings, his predecessors in the family. Your power and influence is such.
verses.commentary: Sense: You had been chosen as the family preceptor of the kings born of the solar race by the kings, his predecessors in the family. Your power and influence is such.

verses.sanskrit: नानावादित्रघोषाहतपटहरवाकर्णनध्वस्तधैर्याः सद्यः संत्यक्तराज्यस्वबलपुरपुरन्ध्रीसमूहा विमूढाः । कांबोजास्तालजङ्घाः शकयवनकिरातादयः साकमेते भ्रेमुर्भूर्यस्त्रभीत्या दिशि दिशि रिपवो यस्य पूर्वापराधाः
verses.transliteration: nānāvāditraghoṣāhatapaṭaharavākarṇanadhvastadhairyāḥ sadyaḥ saṃtyaktarājyasvabalapurapurandhrīsamūhā vimūḍhāḥ / kāṃbojāstālajaṅghāḥ śakayavanakirātādayaḥ sākamete bhremurbhūryastrabhītyā diśi diśi ripavo yasya pūrvāparādhāḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, restrained by the respect for the greatness of his preceptor, he shall not transgress your behest like the great ocean that does not trespass the boundary of the sea- shore.
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, restrained by the respect for the greatness of his preceptor, he shall not transgress your behest like the great ocean that does not trespass the boundary of the sea- shore.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, restrained by the respect for the greatness of his preceptor, he shall not transgress your behest like the great ocean that does not trespass the boundary of the sea- shore.

verses.sanskrit: भीतास्तस्य नरेश्वरस्य रिपवः केचित्प्रता पानलज्वालामुष्टदृशो विसृज्य वसतिं राज्यं च पुत्रादिभिः । द्विट्सैन्यैः समभिद्रुता वनभुवं संप्राप्य तत्रापि ते ऽस्तैमित्यं समुपागता गिरिगुहासुप्तोत्थितेन द्विषः
verses.transliteration: bhītāstasya nareśvarasya ripavaḥ kecitpratā pānalajvālāmuṣṭadṛśo visṛjya vasatiṃ rājyaṃ ca putrādibhiḥ / dviṭsainyaiḥ samabhidrutā vanabhuvaṃ saṃprāpya tatrāpi te 'staimityaṃ samupāgatā giriguhāsuptotthitena dviṣaḥ
verses.translation: O holy lord, you are our friend, father and mother* You are preceptor of all the people. Hence, O highly fortunate one, it behoves you to save us from this difficult situation".
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, you are our friend, father and mother* You are preceptor of all the people. Hence, O highly fortunate one, it behoves you to save us from this difficult situation".
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, you are our friend, father and mother* You are preceptor of all the people. Hence, O highly fortunate one, it behoves you to save us from this difficult situation".

verses.sanskrit: तालजङ्घान्निहत्याजौ राजा स बलवाहनान् । क्रमेण नाशयामास तद्राज्यमरिकर्षणः
verses.transliteration: tālajaṅghānnihatyājau rājā sa balavāhanān / krameṇa nāśayāmāsa tadrājyamarikarṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of theirs, the holy lordly saint Vasistha slowly surveyed those who sought refuge in him.
verses.hindi: उन नित्याओं ने बड़ा ही उद्धत युद्ध किया था । उन्होंने प्राण को दंड को आकर्षित किया या । प्रहार करने के समय में नित्याओं के करों के वलयों और कडुड़ों का कवणन हो रहा या ।६२। तीन प्रहर तक ऐसा घोर युद्ध हुमा था। नित्याओं के तीकषण बाणो से अक्षोहिणियों का संहार हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of theirs, the holy lordly saint Vasistha slowly surveyed those who sought refuge in him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of theirs, the holy lordly saint Vasistha slowly surveyed those who sought refuge in him.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यवनकांबोजकिरातादीननेकशः । निजघान रुषाविष्टः पल्हवान्पारदानपि
verses.transliteration: tato yavanakāṃbojakirātādīnanekaśaḥ / nijaghāna ruṣāviṣṭaḥ palhavānpāradānapi
verses.translation: On seeing t those persons who were born of royal families, who had survived the general massacre and most of whom were old men, women and children the holy lord who was merciful towards all living beings, became distressed.
verses.hindi: था ।६३। सवं प्रथम कामेशी ने शरों से दुष्ट दमन को निहत किया था भग- माला ने सेनापति दोघं जिह्व को मार डाला था ।६४। नित्य क्लिम्ता और भेण्डा ने हम्वेक ओर हुल्लुमल्लक को वहिवासा ने बलस को तीक्ण रों से निहत कर दिया था ।६५। महा वज्रेश्वरी ने बाणों से केकि वाहन को
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing t those persons who were born of royal families, who had survived the general massacre and most of whom were old men, women and children the holy lord who was merciful towards all living beings, became distressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing t those persons who were born of royal families, who had survived the general massacre and most of whom were old men, women and children the holy lord who was merciful towards all living beings, became distressed.

verses.sanskrit: हन्यमानास्तु ते सर्वे राजानस्तेन संयुगे । दुद्रुवुः संघशो भीता हतशिष्टाः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: hanyamānāstu te sarve rājānastena saṃyuge / dudruvuḥ saṃghaśo bhītā hataśiṣṭāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: After looking at them with due honour, and ment- ally pondering for a long time, the highly intelligent sage revived their lives with the slowly uttered words — ''Do not be afraid".
verses.hindi: मार डाला या और शिव दूती ने पुल्कस को यमपुर भेज दिया या
verses.wordMeaning: After looking at them with due honour, and ment- ally pondering for a long time, the highly intelligent sage revived their lives with the slowly uttered words — ''Do not be afraid".
verses.commentary: Sense: After looking at them with due honour, and ment- ally pondering for a long time, the highly intelligent sage revived their lives with the slowly uttered words — ''Do not be afraid".

verses.sanskrit: युष्माभिर्यस्य राज्यं बहुभिरपत्दृतं तस्य पुत्रो ऽधुनाहं हन्तुं वः सप्रतिज्ञं प्रसभमुपगतो वैरनिर्यातनैषी । इत्युच्चैः श्रावयाणो युधि निजचरितं वैरिभिर्नागवीर्यः क्षत्रैर्विध्वंसितेजाः सगरनरपतिः स्मारयामास भूपः
verses.transliteration: yuṣmābhiryasya rājyaṃ bahubhirapatdṛtaṃ tasya putro 'dhunāhaṃ hantuṃ vaḥ sapratijñaṃ prasabhamupagato vairaniryātanaiṣī / ityuccaiḥ śrāvayāṇo yudhi nijacaritaṃ vairibhirnāgavīryaḥ kṣatrairvidhvaṃsitejāḥ sagaranarapatiḥ smārayāmāsa bhūpaḥ
verses.translation: The highly fortunate one, indued with great sympathy, spoke to them kindly and made those persons who sought their lives to agree to the conditions of the king.
verses.hindi: त्वरिता ने पुण्ड़केतु को पेने बाणों से मार डाला था । कुल सुन्दरिका नित्या ने चंड बाहु और कुक्कुर को मार दिया था ।६७। इसके अनन्तर नील पताका और विजया दोनों हो जय करने में उद्धत थीं इन्होंने, जम्बुकाक्ष और जुम्भण को मार दिया था । सबंमङ्गलिका नित्या ने तीक्ष्ण भृङ्ग का
verses.wordMeaning: The highly fortunate one, indued with great sympathy, spoke to them kindly and made those persons who sought their lives to agree to the conditions of the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly fortunate one, indued with great sympathy, spoke to them kindly and made those persons who sought their lives to agree to the conditions of the king.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा राजवर्यं सकलरिपुकुलप्रक्षयोपात्तदीक्षं भीताः स्त्रीबालपूर्वं शरणमभिययुः स्वासुसरक्षणाय । इक्ष्वाकूणां वसिष्ठं कुलगुरुमभितः सप्त राज्ञां कलेषु प्रख्याताः संप्रसूता नृपवररिपवः पारदाः पल्हवाद्याः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājavaryaṃ sakalaripukulaprakṣayopāttadīkṣaṃ bhītāḥ strībālapūrvaṃ śaraṇamabhiyayuḥ svāsusarakṣaṇāya / ikṣvākūṇāṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ kulagurumabhitaḥ sapta rājñāṃ kaleṣu prakhyātāḥ saṃprasūtā nṛpavararipavaḥ pāradāḥ palhavādyāḥ
verses.translation: In order to fulfil the vow of the king, Vasistha stipu- lated the condition that those persons who had been burned by the anger of the king should be denied all those holy rites laid down for persons of royal families. He went to the excellent king himself. He pacified him slowly in fitting manner. He then requested him for permission to the surviving enemies to go away for good.
verses.hindi: हनन किया था । ज्वाला मालिनिका नित्या ने उग्र त्रिकर्णक का हनत कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: In order to fulfil the vow of the king, Vasistha stipu- lated the condition that those persons who had been burned by the anger of the king should be denied all those holy rites laid down for persons of royal families. He went to the excellent king himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to fulfil the vow of the king, Vasistha stipu- lated the condition that those persons who had been burned by the anger of the king should be denied all those holy rites laid down for persons of royal families. He went to the excellent king himself.…

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठमाश्रमोपान्ते वसंतमृषिभिर्वृतम् । उपगम्याब्रुवन्सर्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटा नृपाः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhamāśramopānte vasaṃtamṛṣibhirvṛtam / upagamyābruvansarve kṛtāñjalipuṭā nṛpāḥ
verses.translation: He made the Sakas shave off half of their heads, he made the Palhavas grow moustache (and beard). He made the Yavanas devoid of the moustache. He made the Kambojas to retain the chin (i.e. the beard).1
verses.wordMeaning: He made the Sakas shave off half of their heads, he made the Palhavas grow moustache (and beard). He made the Yavanas devoid of the moustache. He made the Kambojas to retain the chin (i.e. the beard).1
verses.commentary: Sense: He made the Sakas shave off half of their heads, he made the Palhavas grow moustache (and beard). He made the Yavanas devoid of the moustache. He made the Kambojas to retain the chin (i.e. the beard).1

verses.sanskrit: शरणं भंव नो ब्रह्मन्नार्त्तानामभयैषिणाम् । सगरास्त्राग्निनिर्दग्धशरीराणां मुमूर्षताम्
verses.transliteration: śaraṇaṃ bhaṃva no brahmannārttānāmabhayaiṣiṇām / sagarāstrāgninirdagdhaśarīrāṇāṃ mumūrṣatām
verses.translation: In this manner he made others also born of royal
verses.wordMeaning: In this manner he made others also born of royal
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner he made others also born of royal

verses.sanskrit: स हन्त्यसमानशेषेण वैरान्तकरणोन्मुखः । तस्माद्भयाद्धि निष्क्रान्ता वयं जीवितकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: sa hantyasamānaśeṣeṇa vairāntakaraṇonmukhaḥ / tasmādbhayāddhi niṣkrāntā vayaṃ jīvitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people. These tribes maintain themselves by evil activities and wicked pursuits. But they keep up the vow of the king and prevent it from being broken."
verses.wordMeaning: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people.…

verses.sanskrit: विभिन्नराज्यभोगर्द्धिस्वदारापत्यबान्धवाः । केवलं प्राणरक्षार्थं त्वां त्वयं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: vibhinnarājyabhogarddhisvadārāpatyabāndhavāḥ / kevalaṃ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ tvāṃ tvayaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people. These tribes maintain themselves by evil activities and wicked pursuits. But they keep up the vow of the king and prevent it from being broken."
verses.wordMeaning: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people.…

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यन्यो ऽस्ति पुमांल्लोके सौहृदेन बलेन वा । यस्तं निवर्त्तयित्वास्मान्पालयेन्महतो भयात्
verses.transliteration: na hyanyo 'sti pumāṃlloke sauhṛdena balena vā / yastaṃ nivarttayitvāsmānpālayenmahato bhayāt
verses.translation: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people. These tribes maintain themselves by evil activities and wicked pursuits. But they keep up the vow of the king and prevent it from being broken."
verses.wordMeaning: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people.…

verses.sanskrit: त्वं किलार्कान्वयभुवां राज्ञां कुलगुरुर् वृतः । तद्वंशपूर्वजैर्भूपैस्त्वतप्रभावश्च तादृशः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ kilārkānvayabhuvāṃ rājñāṃ kulagurur vṛtaḥ / tadvaṃśapūrvajairbhūpaistvataprabhāvaśca tādṛśaḥ
verses.translation: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people. These tribes maintain themselves by evil activities and wicked pursuits. But they keep up the vow of the king and prevent it from being broken."
verses.hindi: चित्रा ने चन्द्रगुप्त को और दुश्शील चित्र का विमर्दन किया था । सभी दुरात्मा सेनापतियों के निहत हो जाने पर विषङ्ग युद्ध के लिये चल दिया था ।६६। विषम बड़ा बलवान् था और बहुत क्रुद्ध होकर आगे गया था । इसके बाद रात्रि में एक प्रहर शेष रह गया था जो केवल दो घड़ी का
