verses.commentary: Sense: Released by that king these Sakas, Yavanas, Kiratas and others, immediately abandoned their modes of dress and conduct of life. Their only resorts were mountains, forests, caves and such other places. Even today they are cen- sured by good people.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरोपाख्याने सगरप्रतिज्ञापालनं नामाष्टाचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४८॥ जैमिनिरुवाच अथानुज्ञाय सगरो वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम् । बलेन महता युक्तो विदर्भानभ्यवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaropākhyāne sagarapratijñāpālanaṃ nāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 48// jaiminiruvāca athānujñāya sagaro vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam / balena mahatā yukto vidarbhānabhyavarttata
verses.translation: These were probably the fashions of hairstyles among those tribes which are attributed to king Sagara's orders of punishment.
verses.hindi: को वृत्तांतोऽभवत्तत्र स्वामिन्या कि रणः कृत: । अन्या वा शक्तयस्तत्र चक्रयू दध महासुरं:
verses.wordMeaning: These were probably the fashions of hairstyles among those tribes which are attributed to king Sagara's orders of punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: These were probably the fashions of hairstyles among those tribes which are attributed to king Sagara's orders of punishment.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विदर्भराट् तस्मै स्वसुतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् । केशिन्याख्यामनुपमामनुरूपां न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: tato vidarbharāṭ tasmai svasutāṃ prītipūrvakam / keśinyākhyāmanupamāmanurūpāṃ nyavedayat
verses.translation: Then with great pleasure the king of the Vidarbhas offered to him his daughter whose name was KeSinl. She was unparalleled in beauty etc., and therefore was suitable to him in every respect.
verses.hindi: विम्रश्व्यमिदं कायं प्रवृत्तिस्तत्र कोहणी । महादेव्याश्च हृदये कः प्रसंग: प्रवतंते
verses.wordMeaning: Then with great pleasure the king of the Vidarbhas offered to him his daughter whose name was KeSinl. She was unparalleled in beauty etc., and therefore was suitable to him in every respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with great pleasure the king of the Vidarbhas offered to him his daughter whose name was KeSinl. She was unparalleled in beauty etc., and therefore was suitable to him in every respect.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्या राजशार्दूलो विधिवद्वह्निसाक्षिकम् । शुभे मुहूर्ते केशिन्याः पार्णिं जग्राह भूमिपः
verses.transliteration: sa tasyā rājaśārdūlo vidhivadvahnisākṣikam / śubhe muhūrte keśinyāḥ pārṇiṃ jagrāha bhūmipaḥ
verses.translation: In an auspicious hour, that ruler of the earth, a tiger among kings duly took the hand of Kcsini, in marriage, with the fire god as witness.
verses.hindi: इति शंकाकुलास्तत्र दण्डनाथापुरोगमा: ॥ मंत्रिणीं पुरतः कृत्वा प्रचेलुलेलितां प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: In an auspicious hour, that ruler of the earth, a tiger among kings duly took the hand of Kcsini, in marriage, with the fire god as witness.
verses.commentary: Sense: In an auspicious hour, that ruler of the earth, a tiger among kings duly took the hand of Kcsini, in marriage, with the fire god as witness.

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा दिनानि कतिचिद्गृहे तस्यातिसत्कृतः । विदर्भराज्ञा संमन्त्र्य ततो गन्तुं प्रजक्रमे
verses.transliteration: sthitvā dināni katicidgṛhe tasyātisatkṛtaḥ / vidarbharājñā saṃmantrya tato gantuṃ prajakrame
verses.translation: Honoured extremely well by the king of Vidarbhas, he stayed in his palace for a few days and taking leave of him, he set off from that place.
verses.hindi: अघ प्रथम युद्ध दिवसः--दश अक्षौहिणियों से युक्त वीर्यशाली भी दण्डनाशा के तीक्ष्ण शरों से रण में भग्न होकर भाग गया था। उस देवी ने दश अक्षोहिणी सोना नष्ट कर दी घी।१। भण्डासुर इस वृत्तान्त को सुन- कर वड़ा क्षुब्ध हो गया था । रात्रि में कपटयुक्त संग्राम जो दुष्ट असुरो ने
verses.wordMeaning: Honoured extremely well by the king of Vidarbhas, he stayed in his palace for a few days and taking leave of him, he set off from that place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Honoured extremely well by the king of Vidarbhas, he stayed in his palace for a few days and taking leave of him, he set off from that place.

verses.sanskrit: अनुज्ञातस्ततस्तेन पारिबर्हैश्च सत्कृतः । निष्क्रम्य तत्पुराद्राजा शूरसेनानुपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: anujñātastatastena pāribarhaiśca satkṛtaḥ / niṣkramya tatpurādrājā śūrasenānupeyivān
verses.translation: (He set off from that place) on being permitted by him. Then he was welcomed by the Paribarhas. Coming out of their city, the king approached the Surasenas.
verses.hindi: किया था, इसको सुनकर मन्त्रिणी ओर दण्डनाथा दोनों को बड़ा निर्वेद हुआ था ।२। देत्यों के द्वारा देवी का समागमत का होता बहुत ही कण्ट का विषम हैं। उत्तान बुद्धि वाली हम आगे दूर चल दी शीं ।३। महाचक्र रथेनद्र की रक्षा सौनिकों द्वारा नहीं हुई है । रात्रि में इसी अवसर को पाकर
verses.wordMeaning: (He set off from that place) on being permitted by him. Then he was welcomed by the Paribarhas. Coming out of their city, the king approached the Surasenas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He set off from that place) on being permitted by him. Then he was welcomed by the Paribarhas. Coming out of their city, the king approached the Surasenas.

verses.sanskrit: संभावितस्ततश्चैव यादवैर्मातृसोदरैः । धनौघैस्तर्पितस्तैश्च मधुराया विनिर्ययौ
verses.transliteration: saṃbhāvitastataścaiva yādavairmātṛsodaraiḥ / dhanaughaistarpitastaiśca madhurāyā viniryayau
verses.translation: Thus by conquering the whole of the earth he made all the kings his vassals (literally, "moving at his hint") paying revenues and tributes.
verses.hindi: दुष्टों ने पराकरण किया शा।४। वहाँ पर क्या वृत्तान्त हुआ शा ? क्या स्वामिनी ने युद्ध किया भा ? अथवा अन्य शक्तियों ने असुरों के साथ युद्ध किया ? ।५) यह कायं विज्रष्ट हो गया-बहाँ पर कंसो प्रवृत्ति है भौर महा- देवी के हृदय में कोन सा प्रसंग प्रवृत्त हो रहा है।६। इस रीति सो उन
verses.wordMeaning: Thus by conquering the whole of the earth he made all the kings his vassals (literally, "moving at his hint") paying revenues and tributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus by conquering the whole of the earth he made all the kings his vassals (literally, "moving at his hint") paying revenues and tributes.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स सगरो राजा विजित्य वसुधामिमाम् । करैश्च स नृपान्सर्वांश्चक्रे संकेतगानपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa sagaro rājā vijitya vasudhāmimām / karaiśca sa nṛpānsarvāṃścakre saṃketagānapi
verses.translation: Thereafter, lie permitted the kings to go back to their kingdoms along with their armies. The king then allowed his followers to return.
verses.hindi: शक्तियों ने जिनमें दण्डनाथा अग्रणी थी शंका से बेवेन होकर मस्त्रिणी को अपना अगुआ बनाकर ललिता के समोप में गमन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, lie permitted the kings to go back to their kingdoms along with their armies. The king then allowed his followers to return.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, lie permitted the kings to go back to their kingdoms along with their armies. The king then allowed his followers to return.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽनुमान्य नृपतीन्निजराज्याय सानुगान् । अनुजज्ञे नरपतिः समस्ताननुयायिनः
verses.transliteration: tato 'numānya nṛpatīnnijarājyāya sānugān / anujajñe narapatiḥ samastānanuyāyinaḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by a great army and his royal retinue and camp-followers, he reached his kingdom slowly without afflicting the realms in between.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by a great army and his royal retinue and camp-followers, he reached his kingdom slowly without afflicting the realms in between.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by a great army and his royal retinue and camp-followers, he reached his kingdom slowly without afflicting the realms in between.

verses.sanskrit: ततो बलेन महाता स्कन्धावारसमन्वितः । शनैरपीडयन्देशान्स्वराज्यमुपजग्मिवान्
verses.transliteration: tato balena mahātā skandhāvārasamanvitaḥ / śanairapīḍayandeśānsvarājyamupajagmivān
verses.translation: On coming to know about his arrival, the citizens became enthusiastic over the great festivities and therefore adorned the city.
verses.wordMeaning: On coming to know about his arrival, the citizens became enthusiastic over the great festivities and therefore adorned the city.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know about his arrival, the citizens became enthusiastic over the great festivities and therefore adorned the city.

verses.sanskrit: संभाव्यमानश्च मुहुरुपदाभिरनेकशः । नानाजनपदैस्तूर्ममयोध्यां समुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: saṃbhāvyamānaśca muhurupadābhiranekaśaḥ / nānājanapadaistūrmamayodhyāṃ samupāgamat
verses.translation: Accompanied by both of his wives, he got down from the vehicle and joyously entered the house of his mother* where the people were delighted and well nourished.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by both of his wives, he got down from the vehicle and joyously entered the house of his mother* where the people were delighted and well nourished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by both of his wives, he got down from the vehicle and joyously entered the house of his mother* where the people were delighted and well nourished.

verses.sanskrit: तदागमनमाज्ञाय नागरः सकलो जनः । नगरीं तामलञ्चक्रे महोत्सवसमुत्सुकः
verses.transliteration: tadāgamanamājñāya nāgaraḥ sakalo janaḥ / nagarīṃ tāmalañcakre mahotsavasamutsukaḥ
verses.translation: With humility, he approached his mother who was seated in a couch. Touching her feet with his head, he made. obeisance to her.
verses.wordMeaning: With humility, he approached his mother who was seated in a couch. Touching her feet with his head, he made. obeisance to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: With humility, he approached his mother who was seated in a couch. Touching her feet with his head, he made. obeisance to her.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा नगरी सर्वा कृतकौतुकमङ्गला । सिक्तसंमृष्टभूभागा पूर्णकुम्भशतावृता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā nagarī sarvā kṛtakautukamaṅgalā / siktasaṃmṛṣṭabhūbhāgā pūrṇakumbhaśatāvṛtā
verses.translation: After congratulating him with blessings in words choked with delight, she got up with great excitement and embraced her son.
verses.wordMeaning: After congratulating him with blessings in words choked with delight, she got up with great excitement and embraced her son.
verses.commentary: Sense: After congratulating him with blessings in words choked with delight, she got up with great excitement and embraced her son.

verses.sanskrit: समुच्छ्रितध्वजशता पताकाभिरंलकृता । सर्वत्रागरुधूपाञढ्या विचित्रकुसुमोज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: samucchritadhvajaśatā patākābhiraṃlakṛtā / sarvatrāgarudhūpāñaḍhyā vicitrakusumojjvalā
verses.translation: With great pleasure, she blessed and congratulated both the daughters-in-law. The king honoured her with many a narrative and stayed there for a long time.
verses.wordMeaning: With great pleasure, she blessed and congratulated both the daughters-in-law. The king honoured her with many a narrative and stayed there for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great pleasure, she blessed and congratulated both the daughters-in-law. The king honoured her with many a narrative and stayed there for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: सद्रत्नतोरणोत्तुङ्गगोपुराट्टलभूषिता । प्रसूनलाजवर्षैश्च स्वलङ्कृतमहापथा
verses.transliteration: sadratnatoraṇottuṅgagopurāṭṭalabhūṣitā / prasūnalājavarṣaiśca svalaṅkṛtamahāpathā
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवसमायुक्ता प्रतिगेहमभूत्पुरी । संबूजिताशेषवास्तुदेवतागृहमालिनी
verses.transliteration: mahotsavasamāyuktā pratigehamabhūtpurī / saṃbūjitāśeṣavāstudevatāgṛhamālinī
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: दिक्चक्रजयिनो राज्ञः संदर्शनमुदान्वितैः । पौरजानपदैर्त्दृष्टैः सर्वतः समलङ्कृता
verses.transliteration: dikcakrajayino rājñaḥ saṃdarśanamudānvitaiḥ / paurajānapadairtdṛṣṭaiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṅkṛtā
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वे तथान्तः पुरवासिनः । वारकाताकदबैश्च नगरीभिश्च सवृताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarve tathāntaḥ puravāsinaḥ / vārakātākadabaiśca nagarībhiśca savṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.hindi: शक्तिचक्र को सेना को सत्र स्वामिनो शोधन हो पूजित हुईं और विभावरी रात्रि के व्यतीत होने पर उन्होने रथेन्द्र को चारों ओर से परि- बारित कर लिया था ।८। मन्त्रिणो और दण्ड नायिका दोनों अपने यानों से नीचे उतरी थीं ओर नोचे को ओर सेना को आवेशित करके तब रथ पर
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्याययुस्ततः सर्वे समत्य पुरवासिनः । स तैः समेत्य नृपतिर्लब्धाशीर्वाद सक्त्क्रियः
verses.transliteration: abhyāyayustataḥ sarve samatya puravāsinaḥ / sa taiḥ sametya nṛpatirlabdhāśīrvāda saktkriyaḥ
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.hindi: समारूढ़ हुई थों ।६। क्रम से नो पर्यो को व्यतीत करके शीघ्र क्रमों वे चली थों। उन-उनके सबमत शक्ति चक्र जो सम्यक् रीति से निवेदित थे बे युक्त थीं ।१७। मन्त्रिणी ओर दण्ड नायिका दोनों ने महाराज्ञो का सेवन किया था । उन्होंने देवो के आगे भूमि में साष्टाङ्ग प्रणाम किया था और निवेदित
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: बधिरीकृतदिक्चक्रो जयशब्देन भूरिणा । नानावादित्रसंघोषमिश्रेण मधुरेण च
verses.transliteration: badhirīkṛtadikcakro jayaśabdena bhūriṇā / nānāvāditrasaṃghoṣamiśreṇa madhureṇa ca
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.hindi: किया था ।११। है अम्बिके ! महान प्रमाद हो गया है ऐसा हमने श्रवण किया है । उन अल वेत्यो ने कट युद्ध के प्रकार से आपका अपकार किया है।१२। बह दुष्ट बुरे आचार वाला प्रकाश में युद्ध से डरकर कुहक व्यवहार से जय की सिद्धि चाहता है ।१३। यह तो देव की गति है कि उन सुरों के
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृत्य तान्यथा योगं सहितस्तैर्मुदान्वितैः । आनन्दयन्प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रविवेश पुरोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: satkṛtya tānyathā yogaṃ sahitastairmudānvitaiḥ / ānandayanprajāḥ sarvāḥ praviveśa purottamam
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.hindi: दोहो दुष्टों का हमारो स्वामिनो के शरोर में शर आदि का स्पशं नहीं हुआ और उसो से जीवित विद्यमान हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: रममाणो यथाकामं सह ताभ्यां पुरे ऽवसत् । अन्येषां भुवि राज्ञां तु राजशब्दो न चाप्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: ramamāṇo yathākāmaṃ saha tābhyāṃ pure 'vasat / anyeṣāṃ bhuvi rājñāṃ tu rājaśabdo na cāpyabhūt
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.hindi: चतुर्बाहुश्चको राक्षस्तृतोयस्तु चतुःशिरा । वज्रघोषश्चोध्रकेशो महाकायो महाहनुः
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: गुणेन चाभवत्तस्य सगरस्य महात्मनः । अल्पो ऽपि धर्मः सततं यथा भवति मानसे
verses.transliteration: guṇena cābhavattasya sagarasya mahātmanaḥ / alpo 'pi dharmaḥ satataṃ yathā bhavati mānase
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: रा५स्तस्यार्थकामौ तु न तथा विपुलावपि । अलुब्धमानसोर्ऽथं च भेजे धर्ममपीडयन्
verses.transliteration: rā5stasyārthakāmau tu na tathā vipulāvapi / alubdhamānasor'thaṃ ca bheje dharmamapīḍayan
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.hindi: फिर उसने वहां पर कुटिलाक्ष जिनमें प्रमुख था उन सबके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: तदर्थमेव राजेन्द्र कामं चापीडयंस्तयोः
verses.transliteration: tadarthameva rājendra kāmaṃ cāpīḍayaṃstayoḥ
verses.translation: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.hindi: थी ।४३। उस महान बलवान ने एक हो साथ सामूहिक प्रसार से युद्ध करने के लिए निश्चय किया था और चार समुद्रों के तुल्य जो चतुर्बाहु प्रमुख चार पुत्र ये उनको नियुक्त किया था ।४४। उस दानव ने चारों को बुलाया था और युद्ध के त्यों में नियुक्त किया था । भंडासुर बड़े ही प्रचण्ड क्रोध
verses.wordMeaning: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was attended upon by his vassal kings, the rulers of the various outlying territories. Recounting various tales the excellent king stayed there delightedly along with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरदिग्विजयो नामैकोनपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ४९॥ जैमिनिरुवाच एवं स राजा विधिवत्पालयामास मेदिनीम् । सप्तद्वीपवतीं सम्यक्साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaradigvijayo nāmaikonapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 49// jaiminiruvāca evaṃ sa rājā vidhivatpālayāmāsa medinīm / saptadvīpavatīṃ samyaksākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: ''Thus that king duly protected the earth consisting of seven continents very well, like another Dharma (God of Righteousness).
verses.hindi: से जलता हुआ होकर उसने हमको युद्ध के लिए भेज दिया था ।४५। उसके पुत्र संख्या में तीस थे । इनके विशाल शरीर थे और इनमें महान बल विद्यमान था । है कुम्भज ! उनके सबके ताम भी मैं बतलाऊँगा आप सुनिए ।४६। चतुर्वाहु-चको राक्ष-चतु:शिरा--ब जघोष-ऊः्वेके श-महाकाय-
verses.wordMeaning: ''Thus that king duly protected the earth consisting of seven continents very well, like another Dharma (God of Righteousness).
verses.commentary: Sense: ''Thus that king duly protected the earth consisting of seven continents very well, like another Dharma (God of Righteousness).

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादींस्तथा वर्णान्स्वेस्वे धर्मे पृथक्पृथक् । स्थापयित्वा यथान्यायं ररक्षाव्याहतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇādīṃstathā varṇānsvesve dharme pṛthakpṛthak / sthāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ rarakṣāvyāhatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: He duly established the Brahmanas and other castes in their respective duties separately. He protected them without getting his sense-organs affected adversely.
verses.wordMeaning: He duly established the Brahmanas and other castes in their respective duties separately. He protected them without getting his sense-organs affected adversely.
verses.commentary: Sense: He duly established the Brahmanas and other castes in their respective duties separately. He protected them without getting his sense-organs affected adversely.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाश्च सर्ववर्णेषु यथाश्रेष्ठानुवर्त्तिनः । वर्णाश्चैवानुलोम्येन तद्वदर्थेषु च क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: prajāśca sarvavarṇeṣu yathāśreṣṭhānuvarttinaḥ / varṇāścaivānulomyena tadvadartheṣu ca kramāt
verses.translation: The subjects belonging to all the different castes behaved with due deference to the most excellent among them ( the less distinguished among them followed and obeyed the more distinguished ones). The castes followed the due order of seniority and excellence. They enjoyed the objects of pleasures in due order.
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects belonging to all the different castes behaved with due deference to the most excellent among them ( the less distinguished among them followed and obeyed the more distinguished ones). The castes followed the due order of seniority and excellence.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects belonging to all the different castes behaved with due deference to the most excellent among them ( the less distinguished among them followed and obeyed the more distinguished ones). The castes followed the due order of seniority and excellence.…

verses.sanskrit: न सति स्थविरे बालं मृत्युरभयुपगच्छति । सर्ववर्णेषु भूपाले महीं तस्मिन्प्रशासति
verses.transliteration: na sati sthavire bālaṃ mṛtyurabhayupagacchati / sarvavarṇeṣu bhūpāle mahīṃ tasminpraśāsati
verses.translation: Then the entire nation flourished with all hindrances removed. There were many outlying countries and districts fully inhabited by the people of the four castes.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the entire nation flourished with all hindrances removed. There were many outlying countries and districts fully inhabited by the people of the four castes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the entire nation flourished with all hindrances removed. There were many outlying countries and districts fully inhabited by the people of the four castes.

verses.sanskrit: स्फीतान्यपेतबाधानि तदा राष्ट्राणि कृत्स्नशः । तेष्वसंख्या जनपदाश्चातुर्वर्ण्यजनावृताः
verses.transliteration: sphītānyapetabādhāni tadā rāṣṭrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ / teṣvasaṃkhyā janapadāścāturvarṇyajanāvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: While that king reigned, the whole realm consisted of many hundreds of houses and villages divided into various zones and had many residential apartments.
verses.wordMeaning: While that king reigned, the whole realm consisted of many hundreds of houses and villages divided into various zones and had many residential apartments.
verses.commentary: Sense: While that king reigned, the whole realm consisted of many hundreds of houses and villages divided into various zones and had many residential apartments.

verses.sanskrit: ते चासंख्यागृहग्रामशतोपेता विभागशः । देशाश्चावासभुयिष्टा नृपे तस्मिन्प्रशासति
verses.transliteration: te cāsaṃkhyāgṛhagrāmaśatopetā vibhāgaśaḥ / deśāścāvāsabhuyiṣṭā nṛpe tasminpraśāsati
verses.translation: At that time no Brahmana on the earth was An&f- ramin (one who does not follow the rigorous disciplines of the four stages in life). All the enterprises of all the subjects became fruitful.
verses.wordMeaning: At that time no Brahmana on the earth was An&f- ramin (one who does not follow the rigorous disciplines of the four stages in life). All the enterprises of all the subjects became fruitful.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time no Brahmana on the earth was An&f- ramin (one who does not follow the rigorous disciplines of the four stages in life). All the enterprises of all the subjects became fruitful.

verses.sanskrit: अनाश्रमी द्विजः कश्चिन्न बभूव तदाभुवि । प्रजानां सर्ववर्णेषु प्रारंभाः फलदायिनः
verses.transliteration: anāśramī dvijaḥ kaścinna babhūva tadābhuvi / prajānāṃ sarvavarṇeṣu prāraṃbhāḥ phaladāyinaḥ
verses.translation: Men began only those activities which befitted them. Then the activities of the men were in consonance with the four aims of men in life (i.c. virtue, wealth, love and salvation).
verses.hindi: ये इतने भंडासुर के दुष्ट बुद्धि वाले और दुमद पुत्र पे। ये सभी अपने पिता के ही समान तो बाहुबल वाले थे और पिता के तुल्य ही इतका कलेबर था ।५०। उन सबने भक्ति की भावना से भष्डासुर के चरणों में प्रणाम किया था । उस दानव ने प्रसन्न लोचनों से उनको देखा था ओर
verses.wordMeaning: Men began only those activities which befitted them. Then the activities of the men were in consonance with the four aims of men in life (i.c. virtue, wealth, love and salvation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Men began only those activities which befitted them. Then the activities of the men were in consonance with the four aims of men in life (i.c. virtue, wealth, love and salvation).

verses.sanskrit: स्वोचितान्येव कर्माणि प्रारभन्ते च मानवाः । पुरुषार्थोपपन्नानि कर्माणि च तदा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: svocitānyeva karmāṇi prārabhante ca mānavāḥ / puruṣārthopapannāni karmāṇi ca tadā nṛṇām
verses.translation: People inhabiting the groups of cities and villages were always engaged in great festivities. They were endowed with devotion and loyalty to the king as well as were desirous of the welfare of one another.
verses.hindi: बड़े गौरव के साथ उनसे यह वाक्य बोला था और यह अपने समस्त कुल का घातक था ।५१। है मेरे पुत्रो ! इस भूमण्डल में आपके समान कोई भी नहीं हैं। आप लोगों के ही बल-विक्रम से मैंने पहिले यह समस्त विश्व को जीत लिया था ।५२। तुम सबने युद्धस्थल में कोप से इन्द्र का--अग्नि का--
verses.wordMeaning: People inhabiting the groups of cities and villages were always engaged in great festivities. They were endowed with devotion and loyalty to the king as well as were desirous of the welfare of one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: People inhabiting the groups of cities and villages were always engaged in great festivities. They were endowed with devotion and loyalty to the king as well as were desirous of the welfare of one another.

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवसमुद्युक्ताः पुरग्रामव्रजाकराः । अन्योन्यप्रियकामाश्च राजभक्तिसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: mahotsavasamudyuktāḥ puragrāmavrajākarāḥ / anyonyapriyakāmāśca rājabhaktisamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: People were delighted with other's merits. They were eager to have contacts with good people. They bowed down to elderly people and always indulged in learning good things.
verses.hindi: यम का--निऋ ति का और पाशी के कवचों का क्षण किया था ।५३। आप लोग सब अस्त्रों को भी जानते हैं। अव आप सवके जाग्रत रहते हुए भी यह हमारे कुल का भ्रश आ गया है।५४। कोई दुष्टा-मायाबिनी ओर युद्ध करने में दुमेदा है जो कि अपने ही सहश स्ट्रियों से संयुत होकर हमको मार
verses.wordMeaning: People were delighted with other's merits. They were eager to have contacts with good people. They bowed down to elderly people and always indulged in learning good things.
verses.commentary: Sense: People were delighted with other's merits. They were eager to have contacts with good people. They bowed down to elderly people and always indulged in learning good things.

verses.sanskrit: ननिन्दितो ऽभिशस्तो वा दरिद्रो व्याधितो ऽपि वा । प्रजासु कश्चिल्लुब्धो वा कृपणो वापि नाभवत्
verses.transliteration: nanindito 'bhiśasto vā daridro vyādhito 'pi vā / prajāsu kaścillubdho vā kṛpaṇo vāpi nābhavat
verses.translation: They were afraid of slanderous remarks of others. They were always delighted in the amorous sports with only their own wives. By nature they desisted from associating with wicked people. They adhered to righteous activities.
verses.hindi: रहो है ।५५। सो अब इसको युद्ध में अपने वन में अवश्य ही तुम कर लोरे । आप सब जलते हुए आयुधों को लेकर उसको जीवित ही पकड लेन!
verses.wordMeaning: They were afraid of slanderous remarks of others. They were always delighted in the amorous sports with only their own wives. By nature they desisted from associating with wicked people. They adhered to righteous activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were afraid of slanderous remarks of others. They were always delighted in the amorous sports with only their own wives. By nature they desisted from associating with wicked people. They adhered to righteous activities.

verses.sanskrit: जनाः परगुणप्रीताः स्वसंपर्काभिकाङ्क्षिणाः । गुरुषु प्रणता नित्यं सद्विद्याव्यसनादृताः
verses.transliteration: janāḥ paraguṇaprītāḥ svasaṃparkābhikāṅkṣiṇāḥ / guruṣu praṇatā nityaṃ sadvidyāvyasanādṛtāḥ
verses.translation: His assembly-hall brilliantly illuminated by plenty of gems and jewels shone like that of Sakra (Indra) in heaven. As Indra's assembly was occupied by the Devas on seats decorated with precious stones, so his hall was occupied by hundreds of kings and the overlords of eighteen Masalas (zones or political divisions). They used to visit him in order
verses.wordMeaning: His assembly-hall brilliantly illuminated by plenty of gems and jewels shone like that of Sakra (Indra) in heaven. As Indra's assembly was occupied by the Devas on seats decorated with precious stones,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His assembly-hall brilliantly illuminated by plenty of gems and jewels shone like that of Sakra (Indra) in heaven. As Indra's assembly was occupied by the Devas on seats decorated with precious stones,…

verses.sanskrit: परापवादभीताश्च स्वदाररतयो ऽनिशम् । निसर्गात्खलसंसर्गविरता धर्मतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: parāpavādabhītāśca svadāraratayo 'niśam / nisargātkhalasaṃsargaviratā dharmatatparāḥ
verses.translation: Due to excessive friction of the scries of crowns of kings who were bowing at his feet, the feet of that king appeared to have got scarred thereby.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to excessive friction of the scries of crowns of kings who were bowing at his feet, the feet of that king appeared to have got scarred thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to excessive friction of the scries of crowns of kings who were bowing at his feet, the feet of that king appeared to have got scarred thereby.

verses.sanskrit: आस्तिकाः सर्वशो ऽभूवन् प्रजास्तस्मिन्प्रशासति । एवं सुबाहुतन्ये स्वप्रतापार्जितां महीम्
verses.transliteration: āstikāḥ sarvaśo 'bhūvan prajāstasminpraśāsati / evaṃ subāhutanye svapratāpārjitāṃ mahīm
verses.translation: His assembly hall shone like the cave of Sumeru, due to the precious gems and jewels scattered all round, by the groups of leading kings who had to attend on him.
verses.wordMeaning: His assembly hall shone like the cave of Sumeru, due to the precious gems and jewels scattered all round, by the groups of leading kings who had to attend on him.
verses.commentary: Sense: His assembly hall shone like the cave of Sumeru, due to the precious gems and jewels scattered all round, by the groups of leading kings who had to attend on him.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतवश्च महाभाग यथाकालानुवर्तिनः । शालिभूयिष्ठसस्याढ्या सदैव सकला मही
verses.transliteration: ṛtavaśca mahābhāga yathākālānuvartinaḥ / śālibhūyiṣṭhasasyāḍhyā sadaiva sakalā mahī
verses.translation: Thus righteously ruled that king, the crest-jewel of the solar race, the suppressor of his enemies. He ruled over the earth with no one else to rule it (except king Sagara).
verses.wordMeaning: Thus righteously ruled that king, the crest-jewel of the solar race, the suppressor of his enemies. He ruled over the earth with no one else to rule it (except king Sagara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus righteously ruled that king, the crest-jewel of the solar race, the suppressor of his enemies. He ruled over the earth with no one else to rule it (except king Sagara).

verses.sanskrit: बभूव नृपशार्दूले तस्मिन् राज्यानि शासति
verses.transliteration: babhūva nṛpaśārdūle tasmin rājyāni śāsati
verses.translation: Though king Sagara protected the earth thus, he never had the pleasure that usually results on looking at one's own son.
verses.wordMeaning: Though king Sagara protected the earth thus, he never had the pleasure that usually results on looking at one's own son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though king Sagara protected the earth thus, he never had the pleasure that usually results on looking at one's own son.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याष्टादशमण्डलाधिपतिभिः सेवार्थमभ्यागतैः प्रख्यातोरुपराक्रमैर्नृपशतैर्मूर्द्धाभिषिक्तैः पृथक् । संविष्टैर्मणिविष्टरेषु नितरामध्यास्यमानामरैः शक्रस्येव विराजते दिवि सभा रत्नप्रभोद्भासिता
verses.transliteration: yasyāṣṭādaśamaṇḍalādhipatibhiḥ sevārthamabhyāgataiḥ prakhyātoruparākramairnṛpaśatairmūrddhābhiṣiktaiḥ pṛthak / saṃviṣṭairmaṇiviṣṭareṣu nitarāmadhyāsyamānāmaraiḥ śakrasyeva virājate divi sabhā ratnaprabhodbhāsitā
verses.translation: The king entered the penance-grove. All around it consisted of many trees where the blossoms had not faded, the fruits of which were tasty, that had a grassy grounds all round and which had plenty of tender sprouts and cool shades.
verses.hindi: आप सबका प्रकोप तो अप्रमेय है । आप सब ऐसे वीरों को केवल एक नारी की ओर भेजना उचित नहीं है तथापि यह विधाता का ही ऐसा क्रम है ।५७। यह एक आपकी कीत्ति का बड़ा भारो विपर्यय है उसको आप लोग सहन कर लीजिए क्योंकि आपकी बहुत बड़ी शूरता है और एक
verses.wordMeaning: The king entered the penance-grove. All around it consisted of many trees where the blossoms had not faded, the fruits of which were tasty, that had a grassy grounds all round and which had plenty of tender sprouts and cool shades.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king entered the penance-grove. All around it consisted of many trees where the blossoms had not faded, the fruits of which were tasty, that had a grassy grounds all round and which had plenty of tender sprouts and cool shades.

verses.sanskrit: संकेताविषयान्तराभ्युपगमाः सर्वे ऽपि सोपायनाः कृत्वा सैन्यनिवेशनानि परितः पुर्याः पृथक् पार्थिवाः । द्रष्टुं काङ्क्षितराजकाः सतनयाविज्ञापयन्तो मुहुर्द्वास्थैरेव नरेश्वराय सुचिरं वत्स्यन्तमन्तःपुरे
verses.transliteration: saṃketāviṣayāntarābhyupagamāḥ sarve 'pi sopāyanāḥ kṛtvā sainyaniveśanāni paritaḥ puryāḥ pṛthak pārthivāḥ / draṣṭuṃ kāṅkṣitarājakāḥ satanayāvijñāpayanto muhurdvāsthaireva nareśvarāya suciraṃ vatsyantamantaḥpure
verses.translation: All around, in every quarter, the cuckoos cooed loudly and sweetly, as their throats became clear due to their having tasted the tender sprouts at the tips of the mango trees.
verses.hindi: साधारण नारी पर आक्रमण करना है। यह कह कर उस अण्डासुर ने उन सबको युद्ध में भेजा घा। तथा उनकी सहायता के लिए दो सौ अक्षौहिणी सेनाए भी भेज दी थीं ।५८। बह दो सो अक्षौहिणी सेना भी सबमें शिरो- मणि थो। वे सभी सैनिक क्रोध से अपनी भृकुटियों को ताने हुए थे और
verses.wordMeaning: All around, in every quarter, the cuckoos cooed loudly and sweetly, as their throats became clear due to their having tasted the tender sprouts at the tips of the mango trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: All around, in every quarter, the cuckoos cooed loudly and sweetly, as their throats became clear due to their having tasted the tender sprouts at the tips of the mango trees.

verses.sanskrit: नमन्नरेद्रमुकुटश्रेणीनामतिघर्षणात् । किणीकृतौ विराजेते चरणौ तस्य भूभुजः
verses.transliteration: namannaredramukuṭaśreṇīnāmatigharṣaṇāt / kiṇīkṛtau virājete caraṇau tasya bhūbhujaḥ
verses.translation: The quarters were filled with gentle breezes wafting slowly over the lakes abounding in lotuses and lilies of various sorts.
verses.hindi: हाथों में हथियार लेकर वहाँ से निकले ये ।१६। जब भण्ड के पुत्रो ने निगे- मन किया था उस समय भूमण्डल कांप उठा था । अनेक उत्पात उत्पन्न हुए थे ओर सम्पूणं जगत् भयभीत हो गया था ।६०। उस पुर की प्रौढ स्त्रियों ने बीथियों में थानों के द्वारा चलते हुए महान उलवान उन कुमारों के ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: The quarters were filled with gentle breezes wafting slowly over the lakes abounding in lotuses and lilies of various sorts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The quarters were filled with gentle breezes wafting slowly over the lakes abounding in lotuses and lilies of various sorts.

verses.sanskrit: सेवागतनरेद्रौघविनिकीर्णैः समन्ततः । रत्नैर्भाति सभा तस्य गुहा सोमे रवी यथा
verses.transliteration: sevāgatanaredraughavinikīrṇaiḥ samantataḥ / ratnairbhāti sabhā tasya guhā some ravī yathā
verses.translation: Proceeding ahead thus in his chariot along the penance grove that had the qualities described above, the king attained the greatest delight.
verses.hindi: लाजाओं की वर्षा की यी ।६१। बन्दीगण ओर मागधों ने उन कुमारों का स्तवन किया था और पुरकी अंगनाओं ने द्वारों पर उनकी मंगल कामना से आरती की थी ।६२। उस समय में यह भूमि विद्यमान सो हो रही थी और आकाश आकृष्यमाण-सा हो रहा था। उनके निकलने के समय सागर पूर्ण-
verses.wordMeaning: Proceeding ahead thus in his chariot along the penance grove that had the qualities described above, the king attained the greatest delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Proceeding ahead thus in his chariot along the penance grove that had the qualities described above, the king attained the greatest delight.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स राजा धर्मेण भानुवंशशिखामणिः । अनन्यशासनामुर्वीमन्वशासदरिन्दमः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa rājā dharmeṇa bhānuvaṃśaśikhāmaṇiḥ / ananyaśāsanāmurvīmanvaśāsadarindamaḥ
verses.translation: Having reached the precincts of the hermitage, his mind attained calmness. The glorious king then got down accompanied by his wives.
verses.wordMeaning: Having reached the precincts of the hermitage, his mind attained calmness. The glorious king then got down accompanied by his wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having reached the precincts of the hermitage, his mind attained calmness. The glorious king then got down accompanied by his wives.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं पालयतः पृथ्वीं सगरस्य महीपतेः । न चापपात मुत् पुत्रमुखालोकनजृंभिता
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ pālayataḥ pṛthvīṃ sagarasya mahīpateḥ / na cāpapāta mut putramukhālokanajṛṃbhitā
verses.translation: "Let the horses rest" — so said the king to the charioteer. Then he came to the outskirts of the hermitage of •the great sage of sanctified soul. From the disciples of the sage, he heard that the sage had concluded his daily routine of holy rites. In order to see the sage, he then entered the hermitage with an humble attitude.
verses.wordMeaning: "Let the horses rest" — so said the king to the charioteer. Then he came to the outskirts of the hermitage of •the great sage of sanctified soul. From the disciples of the sage, he heard that the sage had concluded his daily routine of holy rites. In order to see the sage,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Let the horses rest" — so said the king to the charioteer. Then he came to the outskirts of the hermitage of •the great sage of sanctified soul. From the disciples of the sage, he heard that the sage had concluded his daily routine of holy rites. In order to see the sage,…

verses.sanskrit: विना तां दुःखितो ऽत्यर्थं चितयामास नैकधा । अहो कष्टमपुत्रो ऽहमस्मिन्वंशे ध्रुवं तु यत्
verses.transliteration: vinā tāṃ duḥkhito 'tyarthaṃ citayāmāsa naikadhā / aho kaṣṭamaputro 'hamasminvaṃśe dhruvaṃ tu yat
verses.translation: Accompanied by his wives, the king delightfully bowed down his head to the great sage seated in the middle of the sages and accompanied by groups of ascetics.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by his wives, the king delightfully bowed down his head to the great sage seated in the middle of the sages and accompanied by groups of ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his wives, the king delightfully bowed down his head to the great sage seated in the middle of the sages and accompanied by groups of ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयान्ति नूनमस्माकं पितरः पिण्डविप्लवम् । निरयादपि सत्पुत्रे संजाते पितरः किल
verses.transliteration: prayānti nūnamasmākaṃ pitaraḥ piṇḍaviplavam / nirayādapi satputre saṃjāte pitaraḥ kila
verses.translation: Sage Aurva of great power and potentiality, directed the king who bowed down to him along with them (i.e. the two queens) to take his seat saying lovingly — "Sit down". After honouring him very well by means of Arghya, Pddya etc. the great sage pleased him along with his wives by
verses.wordMeaning: Sage Aurva of great power and potentiality, directed the king who bowed down to him along with them (i.e. the two queens) to take his seat saying lovingly — "Sit down". After honouring him very well by means of Arghya, Pddya etc. the great sage pleased him along with his wives by
verses.commentary: Sense: Sage Aurva of great power and potentiality, directed the king who bowed down to him along with them (i.e. the two queens) to take his seat saying lovingly — "Sit down". After honouring him very well by means of Arghya, Pddya etc. the great sage pleased him along with his wives by

verses.sanskrit: प्रीत्या प्रयान्ति तद्गेहं जातकर्मक्रियोत्सुकाः । महता सुकृतेनापि संप्राप्तस्य दिवं किल
verses.transliteration: prītyā prayānti tadgehaṃ jātakarmakriyotsukāḥ / mahatā sukṛtenāpi saṃprāptasya divaṃ kila
verses.translation: After the hospitable reception, the king took rest for a while. Thereupon, he bowed to him and sat in front of him. Aurva then addressed the following gentle words to the king.
verses.wordMeaning: After the hospitable reception, the king took rest for a while. Thereupon, he bowed to him and sat in front of him. Aurva then addressed the following gentle words to the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the hospitable reception, the king took rest for a while. Thereupon, he bowed to him and sat in front of him. Aurva then addressed the following gentle words to the king.

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रस्यामराः स्वर्गे द्वारं नोद्धाटयन्ति हि । पिता तु लोकमुभयोः स्वर्लोकं तत्पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: aputrasyāmarāḥ svarge dvāraṃ noddhāṭayanti hi / pitā tu lokamubhayoḥ svarlokaṃ tatpitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: "I hope that your kingdom is all right externally and internally. I hope that you protect all your subjects righteously. I hope that you yearn properly to win over the trivarga (three aims in life viz. Dharma, Artha and Kdma) by means of proper expedients. I hope ail the expedients in politic (such as alliance, war, diplomacy and others) are well practised by you and they yield proper results to you.
verses.hindi: दो सो अक्षौहिणी सेना को सा में लेकर उस भण्ड के पुत्र नगर से भृकुटियाँ तानकर छूर मुखों वाले होते हुए ही निकल कर चल दिये ये
verses.wordMeaning: "I hope that your kingdom is all right externally and internally. I hope that you protect all your subjects righteously. I hope that you yearn properly to win over the trivarga (three aims in life viz. Dharma, Artha and Kdma) by means of proper expedients.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "I hope that your kingdom is all right externally and internally. I hope that you protect all your subjects righteously. I hope that you yearn properly to win over the trivarga (three aims in life viz. Dharma, Artha and Kdma) by means of proper expedients.…

verses.sanskrit: जेष्यन्ति किल सत्पुत्रे जाते वंशद्वये ऽपि च । अनपत्यतयाहं तु पुत्रिणां या भवेद्गतिः
verses.transliteration: jeṣyanti kila satputre jāte vaṃśadvaye 'pi ca / anapatyatayāhaṃ tu putriṇāṃ yā bhavedgatiḥ
verses.translation: Fortunately, O excellent king, all the enemies have been conquered by you. How glad I am that the entire kingdom is righteously protected by you.
verses.hindi: बे यही कहते हुए चल रहे ये कि हम समस्त शक्तियों की सेनाओं को खा जायेंगे और रणमें एक ही क्षण में अपने तीक्ष्ण बाणों से उनके सभी आयुधों का चूर्ण कर देंगे।६५। उस अग्नि की चहार दीबारी के वलय को भी वेग से शान्त कर देंगे। उस दुविदग्धा ललिता की शी बन्दी बना डालेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: Fortunately, O excellent king, all the enemies have been conquered by you. How glad I am that the entire kingdom is righteously protected by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fortunately, O excellent king, all the enemies have been conquered by you. How glad I am that the entire kingdom is righteously protected by you.

verses.sanskrit: न तां प्राप्क्यामि वै नूनं सुदुर्लभतरा हि सा । पदादैन्द्रात्किलाभिन्नमृद्धं राज्यमखण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: na tāṃ prāpkyāmi vai nūnaṃ sudurlabhatarā hi sā / padādaindrātkilābhinnamṛddhaṃ rājyamakhaṇḍitam
verses.translation: I have already heard that you have arrived at your capital along with your army after conquering the whole of the earth and that you have married. How can I, who have been formerly trained in such a manner in wielding missiles and weapons by you, be incap- able of restraining all the enemies now?
verses.hindi: वे भण्डासुर के पुत्र परस्पर में वीर भाषशो के उद्घोषों से बातचीत करते हुए उस अग्न के प्राकार के समीप में पराप्त हो गये ये ।६७। यौबन से और बड़े बढ़े हुए मद से अभ्धे हो रहे ये ओर उनकी हृष्टि रुद्ध हो गयी थी। उन्होंने अपनी भोहों को तिरछी करके बड़ा भारी सिंहनाद किया था
verses.wordMeaning: I have already heard that you have arrived at your capital along with your army after conquering the whole of the earth and that you have married. How can I, who have been formerly trained in such a manner in wielding missiles and weapons by you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I have already heard that you have arrived at your capital along with your army after conquering the whole of the earth and that you have married. How can I, who have been formerly trained in such a manner in wielding missiles and weapons by you,…

verses.sanskrit: मम यत्तदपुण्यस्य याति निष्फलतामिह । इदं मत्पूर्वजैरेव सिंहासनमधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: mama yattadapuṇyasya yāti niṣphalatāmiha / idaṃ matpūrvajaireva siṃhāsanamadhiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: You arc my preceptor, friend, and well-wisher, deity and kinsman. Nor do I know anyone else as my father except you.
verses.hindi: प्रचण्ड स्पर्श बाले उस सैन्य समुदाय से यह सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्ड विदीर्ण-सा हो गया था। वह सैन्य समुदाय उत्पातजनक मेघों से उत्कृष्ट घोर निर्धात के बेग वाला था ।६६। इस अनुभूत महन् घोष का डम्बर ऐसा था फि उसने शक्तियों के कानों को और मतों को क्षुब्ध कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: You arc my preceptor, friend, and well-wisher, deity and kinsman. Nor do I know anyone else as my father except you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc my preceptor, friend, and well-wisher, deity and kinsman. Nor do I know anyone else as my father except you.

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रत्वेन राज्यं च पराधीनत्वमेष्यति । तस्मादौर्वाश्रममहं गत्वा तं मुनिपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: aputratvena rājyaṃ ca parādhīnatvameṣyati / tasmādaurvāśramamahaṃ gatvā taṃ munipuṅgavam
verses.translation: All the kings were defeated by me through the mis- siles, the use of which has been taught by you. It is the power of your penance, remembering which, all of them had been defeated by me. By means of your penance, you sanctify and protect the entire universe. Undoubtedly you are capable of creating and annihilating it also.
verses.hindi: चतुर्वाहुमुखान्भूत्वा भण्डदेत्यक्मारकान् । आगतान्यु द्वक्गत्याय बाला कौतुहलं दधे
verses.wordMeaning: All the kings were defeated by me through the mis- siles, the use of which has been taught by you. It is the power of your penance, remembering which, all of them had been defeated by me. By means of your penance, you sanctify and protect the entire universe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the kings were defeated by me through the mis- siles, the use of which has been taught by you. It is the power of your penance, remembering which, all of them had been defeated by me. By means of your penance, you sanctify and protect the entire universe.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादयिष्ये पुत्रार्थं भार्याभ्यां सहितो ऽधुना । गत्वा तस्मै त्वपुत्रत्वं विनिवेद्य महात्मने
verses.transliteration: prasādayiṣye putrārthaṃ bhāryābhyāṃ sahito 'dhunā / gatvā tasmai tvaputratvaṃ vinivedya mahātmane
verses.translation: O holy lord, in your penance-grove, ever since its infancy the fawn, slowly but unhesitatingly approaches the seat of the lion and drinks water.
verses.hindi: कुमारी ललितादेव्यास्तस्या निकटवासिनी । समस्तशक्तिचक्ाणां पूज्या विक्रमशालिनी
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, in your penance-grove, ever since its infancy the fawn, slowly but unhesitatingly approaches the seat of the lion and drinks water.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, in your penance-grove, ever since its infancy the fawn, slowly but unhesitatingly approaches the seat of the lion and drinks water.

verses.sanskrit: स यद्वक्ष्यति तत्सर्वं करिष्ये नात्र संशयः । इति सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा सगरोराजसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sa yadvakṣyati tatsarvaṃ kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ / iti sañcintya manasā sagarorājasattamaḥ
verses.translation: Here, due to full confidence, even a slim delicate hind offers her udder to her young one. The Ruru deer removes the itching sensation of its cheek at the tip of the horns of the black deer. In order to sustain itself, a tigress killed a hind which had recently given birth to its fawn, in another forest. But the same tigress nurtures the young ones of that hind in your pen- ance grove.
verses.wordMeaning: Here, due to full confidence, even a slim delicate hind offers her udder to her young one. The Ruru deer removes the itching sensation of its cheek at the tip of the horns of the black deer. In order to sustain itself,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Here, due to full confidence, even a slim delicate hind offers her udder to her young one. The Ruru deer removes the itching sensation of its cheek at the tip of the horns of the black deer. In order to sustain itself,…

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष कृत्यविद्राजन्गन्तुमौर्वाश्रमं प्रति । स मन्त्रिप्रवरे राज्यं प्रतिष्ठाप्य ततो वनम्
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa kṛtyavidrājangantumaurvāśramaṃ prati / sa mantripravare rājyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tato vanam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: प्रययौ रथमारुह्य भार्याभ्यां सहितो मुदा । जगाम रथघोषेण मेघनादातिशङ्किभिः
verses.transliteration: prayayau rathamāruhya bhāryābhyāṃ sahito mudā / jagāma rathaghoṣeṇa meghanādātiśaṅkibhiḥ
verses.translation: Due to your blessings, I have conquered this earth, O Brahmana sage, and have come back to my own realm alongwith my captive enemies. I have all ministers under my control. I have shown sufficient and suitable care and application to the three Vargas (viz. virtue, wealth and love). I have protected the kingdom very well along the path advised by you.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to your blessings, I have conquered this earth, O Brahmana sage, and have come back to my own realm alongwith my captive enemies. I have all ministers under my control. I have shown sufficient and suitable care and application to the three Vargas (viz. virtue,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to your blessings, I have conquered this earth, O Brahmana sage, and have come back to my own realm alongwith my captive enemies. I have all ministers under my control. I have shown sufficient and suitable care and application to the three Vargas (viz. virtue,…

verses.sanskrit: स्तब्धेक्षणैर्लक्ष्यमाणो मार्गोपान्ते शिखण्डिभिः । प्रियाभ्यां दर्शयन्राजन्सारङ्गांस्तिमितेक्षणान्
verses.transliteration: stabdhekṣaṇairlakṣyamāṇo mārgopānte śikhaṇḍibhiḥ / priyābhyāṃ darśayanrājansāraṅgāṃstimitekṣaṇān
verses.translation: As I continued my activities thus and stayed on the kingdom, O leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, there arose in me a desire to see your holiness and that too with a purpose.
verses.hindi: अनेक प्रकार के आयूधों- के गिराने से विमानों की छटा को मूच्छित करते हुए उन्होंने वहाँ. आकर अपने सैनिकों के साथ कलकल ध्वनि कर दी थी ।७१। चतुर्बाहु - जिनमें प्रमुख था ऐसे उन भण्डासुर के कुमारों को आये हुए जानकर जो कि युद्ध के ही लिए समागत हुए थे वाला ने अपने मन में
verses.wordMeaning: As I continued my activities thus and stayed on the kingdom, O leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, there arose in me a desire to see your holiness and that too with a purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: As I continued my activities thus and stayed on the kingdom, O leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, there arose in me a desire to see your holiness and that too with a purpose.

verses.sanskrit: क्षममूर्ध्वमुखान्सद्यः पलायनपरान्पुनः । वृक्षान्पुष्पफलोपेतान्विलोक्य मुदितो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kṣamamūrdhvamukhānsadyaḥ palāyanaparānpunaḥ / vṛkṣānpuṣpaphalopetānvilokya mudito 'bhavat
verses.translation: Will the protection of the Earth alongwith the offerings of balls of rice be restricted to me? (Will it stop with me?) Will it be so due to the fact that I have no issue? On being told thus by Sagara, the holy lord Aurva remained silent for a moment thinking within himself, and spoke these words alongwith his directions.
verses.hindi: कौतूहल किया था ।७२। उस ललिता देवी के निकट में वास करने वाली. कुमारी समस्त शक्तियों के चक्रों की पूज्य और विक्रम वाली थी
verses.wordMeaning: Will the protection of the Earth alongwith the offerings of balls of rice be restricted to me? (Will it stop with me?) Will it be so due to the fact that I have no issue? On being told thus by Sagara, the holy lord Aurva remained silent for a moment thinking within himself,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Will the protection of the Earth alongwith the offerings of balls of rice be restricted to me? (Will it stop with me?) Will it be so due to the fact that I have no issue? On being told thus by Sagara, the holy lord Aurva remained silent for a moment thinking within himself,…

verses.sanskrit: अम्लानकुसुमैः स्वादुफलैः शाद्वलभूमिकैः । सुस्निग्धपल्लवच्छायैरभितः संभृतं नगैः
verses.transliteration: amlānakusumaiḥ svāduphalaiḥ śādvalabhūmikaiḥ / susnigdhapallavacchāyairabhitaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ nagaiḥ
verses.translation: "Observing restraints, you stay on here for some- time along with your wives; thereby you will obtain your desire. No doubt need be entertained about this".
verses.hindi: कुमारी ललित! के ही तुल्य आकार वाली थी । उसने कोप किया था जो सदा नुतन वर्षा के ही समान समस्त विद्याओं की बड़ी खान थी
verses.wordMeaning: "Observing restraints, you stay on here for some- time along with your wives; thereby you will obtain your desire. No doubt need be entertained about this".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Observing restraints, you stay on here for some- time along with your wives; thereby you will obtain your desire. No doubt need be entertained about this".

verses.sanskrit: चूताग्रपल्लवास्वादस्निग्धकण्ठपिकारवैः । श्रोत्राभिरामजनकैस्संघुष्टं सर्वतोदिशम्
verses.transliteration: cūtāgrapallavāsvādasnigdhakaṇṭhapikāravaiḥ / śrotrābhirāmajanakaissaṃghuṣṭaṃ sarvatodiśam
verses.translation: The righteous-souled king stayed there along with his wives. He was delighted and endowed with devotion. He was eagerly engaged in serving him (Aurva) for a long time. By means of their humility, good conduct and devo- tion, the wives of the king accorded great satisfaction to the sage. They were always alert.
verses.hindi: उसकी श्रोणी बालसूयं के तुल्य लाल बर्ण की थी तथा उसका शरीर भी शोण (रक्त) था । बह महाराज्ञी के पाद पीठ पर ही नित्य सन्निधान करने आली. थी ।७५। उसके बाहिर संञ्चरण करने बाले प्राण जो चौथा नेत्र हीः 'था। उसने कहा था उन समागत भड के पुत्रों को मैं शीघ्र मार डाह्लुगी
verses.wordMeaning: The righteous-souled king stayed there along with his wives. He was delighted and endowed with devotion. He was eagerly engaged in serving him (Aurva) for a long time. By means of their humility, good conduct and devo- tion,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The righteous-souled king stayed there along with his wives. He was delighted and endowed with devotion. He was eagerly engaged in serving him (Aurva) for a long time. By means of their humility, good conduct and devo- tion,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वर्तुकुसुमोपेतं भ्रमद्भ्रमरमण्डितम् । प्रसूनस्तबकानम्रबल्लरीवेल्लितद्रुमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvartukusumopetaṃ bhramadbhramaramaṇḍitam / prasūnastabakānamraballarīvellitadrumam
verses.translation: "O gentle ladies, let any boon be chosen from us; whatever you desire. I shall grant it even if it is very difficult to get. There is no doubt about it".
verses.hindi: ।७६। उस बालाम्बरा ने यह निश्चय करके महारानी से कहा या-हे माता ! भंडासुर के पुत्र द्ध करने को आ गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O gentle ladies, let any boon be chosen from us; whatever you desire. I shall grant it even if it is very difficult to get. There is no doubt about it".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O gentle ladies, let any boon be chosen from us; whatever you desire. I shall grant it even if it is very difficult to get. There is no doubt about it".

verses.sanskrit: कपियूथसमाक्रान्तव नस्पतिशतावृतम् । उन्मत्तशिखिसारङ्गकूजत्पक्षिगणान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: kapiyūthasamākrāntava naspatiśatāvṛtam / unmattaśikhisāraṅgakūjatpakṣigaṇānvitam
verses.translation: Then both of them bowed down their heads and respectfully spoke to the great sage — "O holy Lord, we desire sons". Then the saint said to them: • 'Desirous of doing what is pleasing to you both and to the king, this desired boon has been given by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Then both of them bowed down their heads and respectfully spoke to the great sage — "O holy Lord, we desire sons". Then the saint said to them: • 'Desirous of doing what is pleasing to you both and to the king, this desired boon has been given by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then both of them bowed down their heads and respectfully spoke to the great sage — "O holy Lord, we desire sons". Then the saint said to them: • 'Desirous of doing what is pleasing to you both and to the king, this desired boon has been given by me.

verses.sanskrit: गायद्विद्याधरवधूगीतिकासुमनोहरम् । संचरत्किन्नरीद्वन्द्वविराजद्वनगह्वरम्
verses.transliteration: gāyadvidyādharavadhūgītikāsumanoharam / saṃcaratkinnarīdvandvavirājadvanagahvaram
verses.translation: Due to my blessings, both of you shall be fortunate enough to have sons, certainly. Let these further words of mine also be heard.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to my blessings, both of you shall be fortunate enough to have sons, certainly. Let these further words of mine also be heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to my blessings, both of you shall be fortunate enough to have sons, certainly. Let these further words of mine also be heard.

verses.sanskrit: हंससारसचक्राह्वकारण्डवशुकादिभिः । सुस्वरैरावृतोपान्तैः सरोभिः परिवारितम्
verses.transliteration: haṃsasārasacakrāhvakāraṇḍavaśukādibhiḥ / susvarairāvṛtopāntaiḥ sarobhiḥ parivāritam
verses.translation: One of you will bear a single son. He will not be very virtuous. Still he will be alive till the end of Kalpa. The other will give birth to sixty thousand sons. Ere long, all of them will meet with destruction without fulfilling their assigned work.
verses.wordMeaning: One of you will bear a single son. He will not be very virtuous. Still he will be alive till the end of Kalpa. The other will give birth to sixty thousand sons. Ere long, all of them will meet with destruction without fulfilling their assigned work.
verses.commentary: Sense: One of you will bear a single son. He will not be very virtuous. Still he will be alive till the end of Kalpa. The other will give birth to sixty thousand sons. Ere long, all of them will meet with destruction without fulfilling their assigned work.

verses.sanskrit: सरः स्वंबुज कह्लारकुमुदोत्पलराशिषु । शनैः परिवहन्मन्दमारुतापूर्णदिङ्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: saraḥ svaṃbuja kahlārakumudotpalarāśiṣu / śanaiḥ parivahanmandamārutāpūrṇadiṅmukham
verses.translation: These two boons with such characteristic features have been given to you both. Whatever is desired by either of you, may voluntarily be recounted."
verses.wordMeaning: These two boons with such characteristic features have been given to you both. Whatever is desired by either of you, may voluntarily be recounted."
verses.commentary: Sense: These two boons with such characteristic features have been given to you both. Whatever is desired by either of you, may voluntarily be recounted."

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधगुणोपेतमधिगाह्य तपोवनम् । गच्छन्रथेनाथ नृपः प्रहर्षं परमं ययौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhaguṇopetamadhigāhya tapovanam / gacchanrathenātha nṛpaḥ praharṣaṃ paramaṃ yayau
verses.translation: After granting this boon to king Sagara and honour- ing him along with his wives in a suitable manner, the great sage sent him off towards the city. Permitted by the sage, the ruler of the Earth who was satisfied because his desire had been fulfilled, got into the chariot along with his beloved ones and went to the city quickly.
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to king Sagara and honour- ing him along with his wives in a suitable manner, the great sage sent him off towards the city. Permitted by the sage, the ruler of the Earth who was satisfied because his desire had been fulfilled,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to king Sagara and honour- ing him along with his wives in a suitable manner, the great sage sent him off towards the city. Permitted by the sage, the ruler of the Earth who was satisfied because his desire had been fulfilled,…

verses.sanskrit: उपशान्ताशयः सो ऽथ संप्राप्याश्रममण्डलम् । भार्याभ्यां सहितः श्रीमान्वाहादवरुरोह वै
verses.transliteration: upaśāntāśayaḥ so 'tha saṃprāpyāśramamaṇḍalam / bhāryābhyāṃ sahitaḥ śrīmānvāhādavaruroha vai
verses.translation: After entering the beautiful city fully inhabited by delighted and well-nourished people, he stayed there with great joy alongwith the people of the city.
verses.wordMeaning: After entering the beautiful city fully inhabited by delighted and well-nourished people, he stayed there with great joy alongwith the people of the city.
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering the beautiful city fully inhabited by delighted and well-nourished people, he stayed there with great joy alongwith the people of the city.

verses.sanskrit: धुर्यान्विश्रामयेत्युक्त्वा यन्तारमवनीपतिः । आससादाश्रमोपान्तं महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dhuryānviśrāmayetyuktvā yantāramavanīpatiḥ / āsasādāśramopāntaṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ
verses.translation: At the same time, O king, the two queens intimated to the king with great joy the fact that they had conceived. The foetus of the queens developed day by day like the moon in the bright half of the lunar month, along with the wealth of pleasure and contentment of the parents and the citizens.
verses.wordMeaning: At the same time, O king, the two queens intimated to the king with great joy the fact that they had conceived. The foetus of the queens developed day by day like the moon in the bright half of the lunar month,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the same time, O king, the two queens intimated to the king with great joy the fact that they had conceived. The foetus of the queens developed day by day like the moon in the bright half of the lunar month,…

verses.sanskrit: स श्रुत्वा मुनिशिष्येभ्यः कृतनित्यक्रियादरम् । मुनिं द्रष्टुं विनीतात्मा प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा
verses.transliteration: sa śrutvā muniśiṣyebhyaḥ kṛtanityakriyādaram / muniṃ draṣṭuṃ vinītātmā praviveśāśramaṃ tadā
verses.translation: After the due performance ofjatakarman (post-natal holy rite) etc., the king named him Asamafijasa.
verses.hindi: संत्येव समरे कतुं वत्से त्वं कि प्रमाइसि
verses.wordMeaning: After the due performance ofjatakarman (post-natal holy rite) etc., the king named him Asamafijasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the due performance ofjatakarman (post-natal holy rite) etc., the king named him Asamafijasa.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिमध्ये समासीनमृषिवृन्दैः समन्वितम् । ननाम शिरसा राजा भार्याभ्यां सहितो मुदा
verses.transliteration: munimadhye samāsīnamṛṣivṛndaiḥ samanvitam / nanāma śirasā rājā bhāryābhyāṃ sahito mudā
verses.translation: At that time, Sumati too gave birth to a pot-gourd- like foetus. On seeing it being given birth to, the king wished to throw it away. On coming to know of it, the holy sage Aurva came there as though by chance. Welcomed and honoured perfect- ly by the king, he hurriedly spoke to him thus.
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, Sumati too gave birth to a pot-gourd- like foetus. On seeing it being given birth to, the king wished to throw it away. On coming to know of it, the holy sage Aurva came there as though by chance. Welcomed and honoured perfect- ly by the king,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, Sumati too gave birth to a pot-gourd- like foetus. On seeing it being given birth to, the king wished to throw it away. On coming to know of it, the holy sage Aurva came there as though by chance. Welcomed and honoured perfect- ly by the king,…

verses.sanskrit: कृतप्रणामं नृपतिमृषिरौर्वः प्रतापवान् । उपविशेति प्रेम्णा वै सह ताभ्यां समादिशत्
verses.transliteration: kṛtapraṇāmaṃ nṛpatimṛṣiraurvaḥ pratāpavān / upaviśeti premṇā vai saha tābhyāṃ samādiśat
verses.translation: ''This foetus in the form of a pot-gourd, O king* should not be thrown away. It does not desrve to be abandon- ed because it contains the nucleus of your sixty thousand sons.
verses.wordMeaning: ''This foetus in the form of a pot-gourd, O king* should not be thrown away. It does not desrve to be abandon- ed because it contains the nucleus of your sixty thousand sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''This foetus in the form of a pot-gourd, O king* should not be thrown away. It does not desrve to be abandon- ed because it contains the nucleus of your sixty thousand sons.

verses.sanskrit: अर्घ्यपाद्यादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयित्वा महामुनिः । आतिथ्येन च वन्येन सभार्यं तमतोषयत्
verses.transliteration: arghyapādyādibhiḥ samyakpūjayitvā mahāmuniḥ / ātithyena ca vanyena sabhāryaṃ tamatoṣayat
verses.translation: Hence, let it be cut into small pieces and be preserv- ed carefully in pots of ghee covered with lids. The pieces should be kept in separate pots. After saying thus, the saintly lord Aurva vanished
verses.hindi: के कुमारी होते से बड़े कोतुक के साथ उनके साय युद्ध करता चाहती हूँ। इस युद्ध करने की खुजली से मेरी बाहुएं फड़क रही हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, let it be cut into small pieces and be preserv- ed carefully in pots of ghee covered with lids. The pieces should be kept in separate pots. After saying thus, the saintly lord Aurva vanished
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, let it be cut into small pieces and be preserv- ed carefully in pots of ghee covered with lids. The pieces should be kept in separate pots. After saying thus, the saintly lord Aurva vanished

verses.sanskrit: अथातिथ्योपविश्रान्तं प्रणम्या सीनमग्रतः । राजानमब्रवीदौर्वः शनैर्मृद्वक्षरं वचः
verses.transliteration: athātithyopaviśrāntaṃ praṇamyā sīnamagrataḥ / rājānamabravīdaurvaḥ śanairmṛdvakṣaraṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: In this manner the sons of the king were born and brought up in groups, O king, making up the total of sixty thousand.
verses.hindi: आप मुझे इसके लिए निवारित न करें क्योंकि इस निषेध करने से तो मेरी यह क्रीडा का हनन ही हो जायगा। मैं तो छोटी बच्ची हूँ स्वेदा ही क्रीड़ाओं में मेरा अनुराग रहा करता है ।७९। क्षणभर रण करने की क्रीडा से मुझे बड़ी प्रसन्‍तता होगी और चित्त में आनन्द होगा । जब इस तरह से
verses.wordMeaning: In this manner the sons of the king were born and brought up in groups, O king, making up the total of sixty thousand.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner the sons of the king were born and brought up in groups, O king, making up the total of sixty thousand.

verses.sanskrit: कुशलं ननु ते राज्ये बाह्येष्वाभ्यन्तरेषु च । अपिधर्मेण सकलाः प्रजास्त्वं परिरक्षसि
verses.transliteration: kuśalaṃ nanu te rājye bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ca / apidharmeṇa sakalāḥ prajāstvaṃ parirakṣasi
verses.translation: They had great strength and valour. They did not perform any rite separately. (They worked collectively* in every respect). They were unassailable and ruthless in particular. The king, the most excellent among the intelligent ones, was not very much pleased with them. But he considered the holy son of Kesini as his beloved son. He honoured him much.
verses.hindi: देवी से कहा गया था तो ललिता देवी ने उस कुमारिका से कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: They had great strength and valour. They did not perform any rite separately. (They worked collectively* in every respect). They were unassailable and ruthless in particular. The king, the most excellent among the intelligent ones, was not very much pleased with them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They had great strength and valour. They did not perform any rite separately. (They worked collectively* in every respect). They were unassailable and ruthless in particular. The king, the most excellent among the intelligent ones, was not very much pleased with them.…

verses.sanskrit: अपि जेतुं त्रिवर्गं त्वमुपायैः सम्यगीहसे । फलन्ति हि गुणास्तुभ्यं त्वया सम्यक्प्रचोदिताः
verses.transliteration: api jetuṃ trivargaṃ tvamupāyaiḥ samyagīhase / phalanti hi guṇāstubhyaṃ tvayā samyakpracoditāḥ
verses.translation: The king duly celebrated his marriage. He too de- lighted his friends by means of his good qualities.
verses.hindi: है वत्मे ! तुम तो बहुत ही कोमल अज् वाली हो --नौ ही वर्ष की हों और नूतन क्रॅम वाली हो और तुमको नये युद्ध की ही शिक्षा मिली है ऐसी कुमारी तुम मेरी एक ही सैनिका हो ।८१। तुम्हारे बिना मुझे एक क्षण भी निश्वास नहीं होता है। तुम तो मेरे श्वास ही हो अतः तुम इस महान
verses.wordMeaning: The king duly celebrated his marriage. He too de- lighted his friends by means of his good qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king duly celebrated his marriage. He too de- lighted his friends by means of his good qualities.

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्यात्वया जिताः सर्वे रिपवो नृपसत्तम । दिष्ट्या च सकलं राज्यं त्वया धर्मेण रक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyātvayā jitāḥ sarve ripavo nṛpasattama / diṣṭyā ca sakalaṃ rājyaṃ tvayā dharmeṇa rakṣyate
verses.translation: A glorious son well-known by the name of Amsuman was born to that son of Kesini. In the meantime that son of the king, Asamafijasa, was possessed by a certain PUaca (ghost). He became devoid of all good pursuits and activities.
verses.hindi: संग्रामे में मत जाओ ।८२। दडिनी और मस्त्रिणी ऐसी अन्य करोड़ों हीं शक्तियाँ हैं, है वस्से ! जो इस संग्राम में उपस्थित ही रहती हैं। तुम ऐसा. प्रमाद क्‍यों कर रही हो ? ।८३। इस रीति से ललिता देवी के द्वारा उस कुमारी को रोका भी गया था तो भी कुमारावस्था के कौतुक से समाविष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: A glorious son well-known by the name of Amsuman was born to that son of Kesini. In the meantime that son of the king, Asamafijasa, was possessed by a certain PUaca (ghost). He became devoid of all good pursuits and activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: A glorious son well-known by the name of Amsuman was born to that son of Kesini. In the meantime that son of the king, Asamafijasa, was possessed by a certain PUaca (ghost). He became devoid of all good pursuits and activities.

verses.sanskrit: धर्म एव स्थितिर्येषां तेषां नास्त्यत्रविप्लवः । न तं रक्षति किं धर्मः स्वयं येनाभिरक्षितः
verses.transliteration: dharma eva sthitiryeṣāṃ teṣāṃ nāstyatraviplavaḥ / na taṃ rakṣati kiṃ dharmaḥ svayaṃ yenābhirakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, in order to alleviate it, give me beef and at my behest take away this treasure as you please".
verses.hindi: होकर पुनः युद्ध करने को प्राथना उसने की थी
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, in order to alleviate it, give me beef and at my behest take away this treasure as you please".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, in order to alleviate it, give me beef and at my behest take away this treasure as you please".

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमेवाहमश्रौषं विजित्य सकलां महीम् । सबलोनगरीं प्राप्तः कृतदारो भवानिति
verses.transliteration: pūrvamevāhamaśrauṣaṃ vijitya sakalāṃ mahīm / sabalonagarīṃ prāptaḥ kṛtadāro bhavāniti
verses.translation: He promised the same to him saying — "I shall give you beef". Encouraged by the Pisaca, he took possession of the treasure-trove. On account of his foolishness, he did not give the ghost what had been promised. He did not take note of the
verses.wordMeaning: He promised the same to him saying — "I shall give you beef". Encouraged by the Pisaca, he took possession of the treasure-trove. On account of his foolishness, he did not give the ghost what had been promised. He did not take note of the
verses.commentary: Sense: He promised the same to him saying — "I shall give you beef". Encouraged by the Pisaca, he took possession of the treasure-trove. On account of his foolishness, he did not give the ghost what had been promised. He did not take note of the

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञां तु प्रवरो धर्मो यत्प्रजापरिपालनम् । भवन्ति सुखिनो नूनं तेनैवेह परत्र च
verses.transliteration: rājñāṃ tu pravaro dharmo yatprajāparipālanam / bhavanti sukhino nūnaṃ tenaiveha paratra ca
verses.translation: After waiting for a long time with a desire for food, the ghost from whom the wealth had been taken away became distressed due to hunger and died.
verses.wordMeaning: After waiting for a long time with a desire for food, the ghost from whom the wealth had been taken away became distressed due to hunger and died.
verses.commentary: Sense: After waiting for a long time with a desire for food, the ghost from whom the wealth had been taken away became distressed due to hunger and died.

verses.sanskrit: स भवान्राज्य भरणं परित्यज्य मदन्तिकम् । भार्याभ्यां सहितो राजन्समायातो ऽसि मे वद
verses.transliteration: sa bhavānrājya bharaṇaṃ parityajya madantikam / bhāryābhyāṃ sahito rājansamāyāto 'si me vada
verses.translation: The Vaisya attained death at the proper time and was born again as the son and perpetuator of the line of Sagara and Kcsinl. Recollecting the previous enmity, the bodiless one assumed the form of wind, O King, and entered the body of the prince.
verses.wordMeaning: The Vaisya attained death at the proper time and was born again as the son and perpetuator of the line of Sagara and Kcsinl. Recollecting the previous enmity, the bodiless one assumed the form of wind, O King, and entered the body of the prince.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vaisya attained death at the proper time and was born again as the son and perpetuator of the line of Sagara and Kcsinl. Recollecting the previous enmity, the bodiless one assumed the form of wind, O King, and entered the body of the prince.

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना सगरो राजसत्तमः । कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्राह तं मधुरं वचः
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca evamuktastu muninā sagaro rājasattamaḥ / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prāha taṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: On being possessed by the ghost the prince became cruel-hearted. His mental balance was upset on being forcibly attacked by the ghost. Like a merciless fellow, he began to work havoc in the city without any propriety or justice. The wicked fellow began to kill boys, young men, old men and women. After killing them, the merciless one threw their bodies in the Sarayu.1
verses.wordMeaning: On being possessed by the ghost the prince became cruel-hearted. His mental balance was upset on being forcibly attacked by the ghost. Like a merciless fellow, he began to work havoc in the city without any propriety or justice. The wicked fellow began to kill boys, young men,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being possessed by the ghost the prince became cruel-hearted. His mental balance was upset on being forcibly attacked by the ghost. Like a merciless fellow, he began to work havoc in the city without any propriety or justice. The wicked fellow began to kill boys, young men,…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरस्यौर्वाश्रमगमनं नाम पञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५०॥ सगर उवाच कुशलं मम सर्वत्र महर्षे नात्र संशयः । यस्य मे त्वमनुध्याता शमं भार्गवसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagarasyaurvāśramagamanaṃ nāma pañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 50// sagara uvāca kuśalaṃ mama sarvatra maharṣe nātra saṃśayaḥ / yasya me tvamanudhyātā śamaṃ bhārgavasattamaḥ
verses.translation: Rama, the conqueror of enemies, became ready (for the battle) well-accoutred. He got into the chariot. He took up his bow along with the arrows and blew his conch presented by Rudra.
verses.wordMeaning: Rama, the conqueror of enemies, became ready (for the battle) well-accoutred. He got into the chariot. He took up his bow along with the arrows and blew his conch presented by Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, the conqueror of enemies, became ready (for the battle) well-accoutred. He got into the chariot. He took up his bow along with the arrows and blew his conch presented by Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तथा शिक्षितः पूर्वमस्त्रे शस्त्रे च सांप्रतम् । सो ऽहं कथमशक्तः स्यां सकलारिविनिग्रहे
verses.transliteration: yastathā śikṣitaḥ pūrvamastre śastre ca sāṃpratam / so 'haṃ kathamaśaktaḥ syāṃ sakalārivinigrahe
verses.translation: He made a twanging sound with the bowstring, making heaven and Earth tremble as it were. Sahasaha, the most excellent one among the charioteers, drove the chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: He made a twanging sound with the bowstring, making heaven and Earth tremble as it were. Sahasaha, the most excellent one among the charioteers, drove the chariot.
