verses.commentary: Sense: He made a twanging sound with the bowstring, making heaven and Earth tremble as it were. Sahasaha, the most excellent one among the charioteers, drove the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं मे गुरुः सुहृद्दैवं बन्धुर्मित्रं च केवलम् । न ह्यन्यमभिजानामि त्वामृते पितरं च मे
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ me guruḥ suhṛddaivaṃ bandhurmitraṃ ca kevalam / na hyanyamabhijānāmi tvāmṛte pitaraṃ ca me
verses.translation: On account of the sounds of the chariot as well as the bow-string of (Rama) who was furious due to the slaughter of his parents, the entire city, the people and elephants became agitated.
verses.hindi: कि भतू दारिके युद्धे व्यवसायः कृतस्त्वया ।
verses.wordMeaning: On account of the sounds of the chariot as well as the bow-string of (Rama) who was furious due to the slaughter of his parents, the entire city, the people and elephants became agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of the sounds of the chariot as well as the bow-string of (Rama) who was furious due to the slaughter of his parents, the entire city, the people and elephants became agitated.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयोपदिष्टेनास्त्रेण सकला भूभृतो मया । विजिता यदनुस्मृत्या शक्तिः सा तपसस्तव
verses.transliteration: tvayopadiṣṭenāstreṇa sakalā bhūbhṛto mayā / vijitā yadanusmṛtyā śaktiḥ sā tapasastava
verses.translation: On coming to know that Rama, the destroyer of all Ksatriyas, had come, the sons of the king became deeply agitat- ed and they made full preparations for fighting with him.
verses.hindi: अकांडे कि महाराज्ञया प्रेषितासि रणं प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: On coming to know that Rama, the destroyer of all Ksatriyas, had come, the sons of the king became deeply agitat- ed and they made full preparations for fighting with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know that Rama, the destroyer of all Ksatriyas, had come, the sons of the king became deeply agitat- ed and they made full preparations for fighting with him.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा त्वं जगत्सर्वं पुनासि परिपासि च । स्रष्टुं संहर्त्तुमपि च शक्नोष्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tapasā tvaṃ jagatsarvaṃ punāsi paripāsi ca / sraṣṭuṃ saṃharttumapi ca śaknoṣyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O king, the heroic princes Surasena and others (seated) in five chariots, made their endeavour to fight with Raina. They were accompanied by other kings as well.
verses.hindi: श्री ललिता भम्ब्रा मे उस कुमारो का परम हढ़ निश्चय समझकर
verses.wordMeaning: Then, O king, the heroic princes Surasena and others (seated) in five chariots, made their endeavour to fight with Raina. They were accompanied by other kings as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O king, the heroic princes Surasena and others (seated) in five chariots, made their endeavour to fight with Raina. They were accompanied by other kings as well.

verses.sanskrit: महाननन्यसामान्यप्रभावस्तपसश्च ते । इह तस्यैकदेशो ऽपि दृश्यते विस्मयप्रदः
verses.transliteration: mahānananyasāmānyaprabhāvastapasaśca te / iha tasyaikadeśo 'pi dṛśyate vismayapradaḥ
verses.translation: Equipped with armies consisting of four different units, those leading Ksatriyas confronted Rama like the locusts approching fire.
verses.hindi: अपनी बाहुओं से खूब अच्छी तरह समालिज्जन करके उसको युद्ध करने की आज्ञा दी थी ।८५॥ ललिता देवरी ने अपने कवच से एक कवच निकाल कर उसको विया था ओर अपने आयुधों से आयुध देकर उसको विदा किया था ।६६। चाप और बंड से समुद्धृत महाराज्ञी का कर्णी रथ था जो सैकड़ों
verses.wordMeaning: Equipped with armies consisting of four different units, those leading Ksatriyas confronted Rama like the locusts approching fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Equipped with armies consisting of four different units, those leading Ksatriyas confronted Rama like the locusts approching fire.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यसिंहासने बाल्यादुपेत्य मृगपोतकः । पिबत्यंभः शनैर्ब्रह्मन्निःशङ्कं ते तपोवने
verses.transliteration: paśyasiṃhāsane bālyādupetya mṛgapotakaḥ / pibatyaṃbhaḥ śanairbrahmanniḥśaṅkaṃ te tapovane
verses.translation: With his single chariot, Bhargava restrained them as they rushed on. Being a hero of boundless valour, he fought with all the kings in the battle.
verses.hindi: हंसों से युक्त था उस पर कुमारिका ने समारोहण किया था ।८७। उसके रण में प्रवृत्त हो जाने पर सभी पर्वो पर स्थित देवता हाथों को जोड़े हुए असियों को प्रधूत करके प्रणाम करने लगे ये ।८८। उनके द्वारा प्रणाम किये जाने पर वह देवी चक्रराज रथोत्तम से नीचे उतर गयी और बहाँ पर जो सेना.
verses.wordMeaning: With his single chariot, Bhargava restrained them as they rushed on. Being a hero of boundless valour, he fought with all the kings in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his single chariot, Bhargava restrained them as they rushed on. Being a hero of boundless valour, he fought with all the kings in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: धयत्यत्रातिविस्रंभात् कृशापि हरिणी स्तनम् । करोति मृगशृङ्गाग्रे गण्डकण्डूयनं रुरुः
verses.transliteration: dhayatyatrātivisraṃbhāt kṛśāpi hariṇī stanam / karoti mṛgaśṛṅgāgre gaṇḍakaṇḍūyanaṃ ruruḥ
verses.translation: A battle took place once again between Rama and the kings, wherein the infuriated sage of high intellect, killed a hundred kings.
verses.hindi: थी उसका अबगाहन किया था ।८९। इसके अनन्तर उस कुमारी को कोप से. पाटल और आती हुई देखा तो मन्त्रिणी और दंडनाथा ने भययुक्त होकर यह बचन कहे थे ।६०। है भतू दारिके ! कया आपने यद्ध में व्यवसाय किया: है? महाराशी ने अकाण्ड में यह क्या रण की ओर आपको भेज दिया
verses.wordMeaning: A battle took place once again between Rama and the kings, wherein the infuriated sage of high intellect, killed a hundred kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: A battle took place once again between Rama and the kings, wherein the infuriated sage of high intellect, killed a hundred kings.

verses.sanskrit: नवप्रसूतां हरिणीं हत्वा वृत्त्यै वनान्तरे । व्याघ्री त्वत्तपसावासे सैव पुष्णाति तच्छिशून्
verses.transliteration: navaprasūtāṃ hariṇīṃ hatvā vṛttyai vanāntare / vyāghrī tvattapasāvāse saiva puṣṇāti tacchiśūn
verses.translation: After killing Surasena and others along with their armies and vehicles, he made the entire group of Ksatriyas fall on the ground in a moment.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing Surasena and others along with their armies and vehicles, he made the entire group of Ksatriyas fall on the ground in a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing Surasena and others along with their armies and vehicles, he made the entire group of Ksatriyas fall on the ground in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: गजं द्रुतमनुद्रुत्य सिंहो यस्मादिदं वनम् । प्रविष्टो ऽनुसरन्तौ त्वद्भयादेकत्र तिष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: gajaṃ drutamanudrutya siṃho yasmādidaṃ vanam / praviṣṭo 'nusarantau tvadbhayādekatra tiṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: The kings who survived, whose wishes had been frustrated and whose vehicles and armies had been killed fled in all directions.
verses.hindi: त्वं मूर्तं जीवितमसि श्रीदेव्या बालिके यतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The kings who survived, whose wishes had been frustrated and whose vehicles and armies had been killed fled in all directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings who survived, whose wishes had been frustrated and whose vehicles and armies had been killed fled in all directions.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलस्त्वाशुमार्जारमयूरशशपन्नगाः । वृकसूकरशार्दूलशरभर्क्षप्लवङ्गमाः
verses.transliteration: nakulastvāśumārjāramayūraśaśapannagāḥ / vṛkasūkaraśārdūlaśarabharkṣaplavaṅgamāḥ
verses.translation: After routing the armies, killing the enemies and winning the battle, Rama killed hundreds of kings and heroes by means of the fire from his excellent arrows.
verses.wordMeaning: After routing the armies, killing the enemies and winning the battle, Rama killed hundreds of kings and heroes by means of the fire from his excellent arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: After routing the armies, killing the enemies and winning the battle, Rama killed hundreds of kings and heroes by means of the fire from his excellent arrows.

verses.sanskrit: सृगाला गवयागावो हरिणा महिषास्तथा । वने ऽत्र सहजं वैरं हित्वा मैत्रीमुपागताः
verses.transliteration: sṛgālā gavayāgāvo hariṇā mahiṣāstathā / vane 'tra sahajaṃ vairaṃ hitvā maitrīmupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Overwhelmed with fury and desirous of burnfng the entire city, Bhargava discharged a missile that had a lustre similar to that ofKalagni (the fire of world-destruction).
verses.hindi: सहैव तस्या रक्षाथं चेलतुः पार्श्वयो दवेयोः
verses.wordMeaning: Overwhelmed with fury and desirous of burnfng the entire city, Bhargava discharged a missile that had a lustre similar to that ofKalagni (the fire of world-destruction).
verses.commentary: Sense: Overwhelmed with fury and desirous of burnfng the entire city, Bhargava discharged a missile that had a lustre similar to that ofKalagni (the fire of world-destruction).

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधा तपःशक्तिर्लोकविस्मयदायिनी । न क्वापि दृश्यते ब्रह्मंस्त्वामृते भुवि दुर्लभा
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhā tapaḥśaktirlokavismayadāyinī / na kvāpi dṛśyate brahmaṃstvāmṛte bhuvi durlabhā
verses.translation: The fire from that missile burned the city along with elephants, horses and men. The flames enveloped the clusters of the entire rampart-wall of the city.
verses.wordMeaning: The fire from that missile burned the city along with elephants, horses and men. The flames enveloped the clusters of the entire rampart-wall of the city.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire from that missile burned the city along with elephants, horses and men. The flames enveloped the clusters of the entire rampart-wall of the city.

verses.sanskrit: अहं तु त्वत्प्रसादेन विजित्य वसुधामि माम् । रिपुभिः सह विप्रर्षे स्वराज्यं समुपागतः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tu tvatprasādena vijitya vasudhāmi mām / ripubhiḥ saha viprarṣe svarājyaṃ samupāgataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the city being burned and desirous of sav- ing his own life, Prince Vllihotra became frightened and fled quickly for the sake of life.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the city being burned and desirous of sav- ing his own life, Prince Vllihotra became frightened and fled quickly for the sake of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the city being burned and desirous of sav- ing his own life, Prince Vllihotra became frightened and fled quickly for the sake of life.

verses.sanskrit: वश्यामात्यस्त्रिवर्गे ऽपि यथायोग्यकृतादरः । त्वयोपदिष्टमार्गेण सम्यग्राज्यमपालयम्
verses.transliteration: vaśyāmātyastrivarge 'pi yathāyogyakṛtādaraḥ / tvayopadiṣṭamārgeṇa samyagrājyamapālayam
verses.translation: After burning the entire city by means of fire from the missile, and after killing the enemies Rama appeared like the god of Death, the destroyer who devours all the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: After burning the entire city by means of fire from the missile, and after killing the enemies Rama appeared like the god of Death, the destroyer who devours all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning the entire city by means of fire from the missile, and after killing the enemies Rama appeared like the god of Death, the destroyer who devours all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्त्तमानस्य मम राज्ये ऽवतिष्ठतः । भवद्दिदृक्षा संजाता सापेक्षा भृगुपुङ्गव
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravarttamānasya mama rājye 'vatiṣṭhataḥ / bhavaddidṛkṣā saṃjātā sāpekṣā bhṛgupuṅgava
verses.translation: Accompanied by Akrtavrana and Sahasaha he went ahead making the Earth tremble, as it were, by means of the (rumbling) sound of the chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Akrtavrana and Sahasaha he went ahead making the Earth tremble, as it were, by means of the (rumbling) sound of the chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Akrtavrana and Sahasaha he went ahead making the Earth tremble, as it were, by means of the (rumbling) sound of the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: किं त्वद्य मयि पर्याप्तमनपत्यतयैव मे । पितृपिण्डप्रदानेन सह संरक्षणं भुवः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tvadya mayi paryāptamanapatyatayaiva me / pitṛpiṇḍapradānena saha saṃrakṣaṇaṃ bhuvaḥ
verses.translation: After killing all the Ksatriyas on the surface of the Earth, Rama became calm. Then he went to the mountain Mahendra determining in his inind that he should perform penance.
verses.wordMeaning: After killing all the Ksatriyas on the surface of the Earth, Rama became calm. Then he went to the mountain Mahendra determining in his inind that he should perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing all the Ksatriyas on the surface of the Earth, Rama became calm. Then he went to the mountain Mahendra determining in his inind that he should perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: तदिदं दुःशमत्यर्थमनिवार्यं मनोगतम् । नानयो ऽपहर्त्तां लोकंऽस्मिन् ममेति त्वामुपागतः
verses.transliteration: tadidaṃ duḥśamatyarthamanivāryaṃ manogatam / nānayo 'paharttāṃ lokaṃ'smin mameti tvāmupāgataḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, in thirtytwo years (?) Ksatriyas rose into prominence. 'Therefore, he returned (from penance) and took the vow ofkilling them.
verses.hindi: है बालिके ! क्योंकि आप तो श्री देवी के मूत्तिमाब जीवन ही हैं अतएव यह उचित नहीं है जबकि सेनाए' विद्यमान हैं ।६२। आप तो इस समय इस रण करने के उत्साह को त्याग कर लोट जाइए । आपको हमारे प्रणाम किये जाते हैं। इस तरह से उन दोनों के द्वारा प्रार्थना भी की गयी
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, in thirtytwo years (?) Ksatriyas rose into prominence. 'Therefore, he returned (from penance) and took the vow ofkilling them.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, in thirtytwo years (?) Ksatriyas rose into prominence. 'Therefore, he returned (from penance) and took the vow ofkilling them.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः सगरेणाथ स्थित्वा सो ऽतर्मनाः क्षणम् । उवाच भगवानौर्वः सनिदेशमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ sagareṇātha sthitvā so 'tarmanāḥ kṣaṇam / uvāca bhagavānaurvaḥ sanideśamidaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Ksatriya kings were begotten of the widowed wives of those Ksatriyas by Brahmanas. Again he (Rama) killed hundreds and thousands of such kings.
verses.hindi: थी तो भी हढ़ निश्चयं वालो वहाँ चल दीं थी ।६३। मन्त्रिणी और दण्ड
verses.wordMeaning: Ksatriya kings were begotten of the widowed wives of those Ksatriyas by Brahmanas. Again he (Rama) killed hundreds and thousands of such kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksatriya kings were begotten of the widowed wives of those Ksatriyas by Brahmanas. Again he (Rama) killed hundreds and thousands of such kings.

verses.sanskrit: नियम्य सह भार्याभ्यां किञ्चित्कालमिहावस । अवाप्स्यति ततो ऽभीष्टं भवान्नात्र विचारमा
verses.transliteration: niyamya saha bhāryābhyāṃ kiñcitkālamihāvasa / avāpsyati tato 'bhīṣṭaṃ bhavānnātra vicāramā
verses.translation: In two years, Rama made the Earth devoid of Ksatri- yas once again. At the end of it he performed penance of twenty- four years duration once again.
verses.hindi: नायिकां दोनों अत्यधिक विस्मय से समाविष्ट हो गई थीं और उसके दोनों ओर उसी की रक्षां करने के लिए चल दी थीं ।६४। इसके अनन्तर अग्नि
verses.wordMeaning: In two years, Rama made the Earth devoid of Ksatri- yas once again. At the end of it he performed penance of twenty- four years duration once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: In two years, Rama made the Earth devoid of Ksatri- yas once again. At the end of it he performed penance of twenty- four years duration once again.

verses.sanskrit: स च तत्रावसत्प्रीतस्तच्छुश्रूषापरायमः । पत्नीभ्यां सह धर्मात्मा भक्तियुक्तश्चिरं तदा
verses.transliteration: sa ca tatrāvasatprītastacchuśrūṣāparāyamaḥ / patnībhyāṃ saha dharmātmā bhaktiyuktaściraṃ tadā
verses.translation: Again, O king, enlightened Ksatriyas were procreat- ed by the Brahmanas. Raina killed them entirely like the god of death, the destroyer on the Earth.
verses.hindi: के वरण के द्वारा उन दोनों से अनुगता होती हुई जो बहुत सेना से युक्‍त चीं कुमारिका बह वहां से निर्गत हुई थी ।९४। कर्णीरथ पर विराजमान स्वामी के सहित समस्त शक्तियों की सेनाओं पर अनुग्रह करती हुई वह रंबाना हुई थी । उसको मार्ग में सभी प्रणामाञ्जलियाँ कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Again, O king, enlightened Ksatriyas were procreat- ed by the Brahmanas. Raina killed them entirely like the god of death, the destroyer on the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again, O king, enlightened Ksatriyas were procreat- ed by the Brahmanas. Raina killed them entirely like the god of death, the destroyer on the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: राजपत्न्यौ च ते तस्य सर्वकालमतन्द्रिते । मुनेरतनुतां प्रीतिं विनयाचारभक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: rājapatnyau ca te tasya sarvakālamatandrite / muneratanutāṃ prītiṃ vinayācārabhaktibhiḥ
verses.translation: In the course of so many years some kings were bom. Killing them Rama roamed over the Earth continuously for two years.
verses.hindi: शत्रुओं का दमन करने वाली ने भंडासुर के पुत्रों पर आक्रमण कर दिया था। उस कुमारी की प्रादेशिक सेना नहीं थी ।६७। समस्त ललिता की ही सेना हो उसकी सेना हो गयी थो । इसके अनन्तर अतीव उद्धत पराक्रम से संयुत महान् युद्ध प्रवृत्त हो गयां था
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of so many years some kings were bom. Killing them Rama roamed over the Earth continuously for two years.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of so many years some kings were bom. Killing them Rama roamed over the Earth continuously for two years.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या शुश्रूषया चैव तयोस्तुष्टो महामुनिः । राजपत्न्यौ समाहूय इदं वचनम ब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā śuśrūṣayā caiva tayostuṣṭo mahāmuniḥ / rājapatnyau samāhūya idaṃ vacanama bravīt
verses.translation: Enough (of this repetition of incidents) O leading king. The Earth was rendered Ksattriya-less by Rama who remembered the death of his father. He cleared the earth of Ksattriyas for all twentyonc times.
verses.wordMeaning: Enough (of this repetition of incidents) O leading king. The Earth was rendered Ksattriya-less by Rama who remembered the death of his father. He cleared the earth of Ksattriyas for all twentyonc times.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enough (of this repetition of incidents) O leading king. The Earth was rendered Ksattriya-less by Rama who remembered the death of his father. He cleared the earth of Ksattriyas for all twentyonc times.

verses.sanskrit: भवत्यौ वरमस्मत्तो व्रियतां काममीप्सितम् । दास्यामि तं न संदेहो यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: bhavatyau varamasmatto vriyatāṃ kāmamīpsitam / dāsyāmi taṃ na saṃdeho yadyapi syātsudurllabham
verses.translation: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.wordMeaning: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his mother beat her own breast twentyone times, Ksatriyas on the Earth were exterminated by Rarna as manv times.1

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्यशिरसा ते ऽप्युभे तं महामुनिम् । ऊचतुर्भगवान्पुत्रान्कामयावेति सादरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamyaśirasā te 'pyubhe taṃ mahāmunim / ūcaturbhagavānputrānkāmayāveti sādaram
verses.translation: That sage of great splendour took these thousands of kings along with the sages to the pilgrimage centre Kuru- ksetra which is full of penance (i.e. sages performing penance).
verses.wordMeaning: That sage of great splendour took these thousands of kings along with the sages to the pilgrimage centre Kuru- ksetra which is full of penance (i.e. sages performing penance).
verses.commentary: Sense: That sage of great splendour took these thousands of kings along with the sages to the pilgrimage centre Kuru- ksetra which is full of penance (i.e. sages performing penance).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते भगवानाह भवतीभ्यां मया पुनः । राज्ञश्चप्रियकामेन वरो दत्तो ऽयमीप्सितः
verses.transliteration: tataste bhagavānāha bhavatībhyāṃ mayā punaḥ / rājñaścapriyakāmena varo datto 'yamīpsitaḥ
verses.translation: The leading member of the family of Bhrgu caused five lakes to be dug there. All around them, he got built holy bathing ghats of comfortable access.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading member of the family of Bhrgu caused five lakes to be dug there. All around them, he got built holy bathing ghats of comfortable access.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading member of the family of Bhrgu caused five lakes to be dug there. All around them, he got built holy bathing ghats of comfortable access.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रवत्यौ महाभागे भवत्यौ मत्प्रसादतः । भवेतां ध्रुवमन्यच्च श्रूयतां वचनं मम
verses.transliteration: putravatyau mahābhāge bhavatyau matprasādataḥ / bhavetāṃ dhruvamanyacca śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama
verses.translation: Bhargava killed the kings there. With the blood flowing out of their bodies he filled those five lakes.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhargava killed the kings there. With the blood flowing out of their bodies he filled those five lakes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhargava killed the kings there. With the blood flowing out of their bodies he filled those five lakes.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रो भविष्यत्येकस्यामेकः सो ऽनतिधार्मिकः । तथापि तस्य कल्पान्तं संभूतिश्च भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: putro bhaviṣyatyekasyāmekaḥ so 'natidhārmikaḥ / tathāpi tasya kalpāntaṃ saṃbhūtiśca bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणामपरस्यां च जायते । अकृतार्थाश्च ते सर्वे विनङ्क्ष्यन्त्यचिरादिव
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇāmaparasyāṃ ca jāyate / akṛtārthāśca te sarve vinaṅkṣyantyacirādiva
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधगुणेपेतो वरौ दत्तौ मया युवाम् । अभीप्सितं तु यद्यस्याः स्वेच्छया तत्प्रकीर्त्यताम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhaguṇepeto varau dattau mayā yuvām / abhīpsitaṃ tu yadyasyāḥ svecchayā tatprakīrtyatām
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: उस कुमारिका ने अपने बागों के जालों की उन देत्येनदों पर वर्षा
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते तु मुनिना वैदर्भ्यान्वयवर्द्धनम् । वरयामास तनयं पुत्रानन्यास्तथा परा
verses.transliteration: evamukte tu muninā vaidarbhyānvayavarddhanam / varayāmāsa tanayaṃ putrānanyāstathā parā
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: की थी । उन भंडासुर के पुत्रों के साथ उस महाराज्ञी को कुमारिका का जो युद्ध उस समय- में हुआ था वह् सभी सुरों और असुरो के द्वारा स्पृहा करने के ही योग्य था ।६€। कर्णीरय पर स्थित हुई बाणों के. मण्डल को वर्षा करने वाली उस नी वर्ष को कुमारिका को देखकर दंत्यराज के पुत्र अत्यन्त
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: इति दत्त्वा वरं राज्ञे सगराय महामुनिः । सभार्यामनुमान्यैनं विससर्ज पुरीं प्रति
verses.transliteration: iti dattvā varaṃ rājñe sagarāya mahāmuniḥ / sabhāryāmanumānyainaṃ visasarja purīṃ prati
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: अधिक ब्रिस्मित हो गये थे ।१००। प्रतिक्षण उस बालिक। के द्वारा किये जाने बाले युद्ध का समाचार परिचारिकाए' भ्रमण करती हुई' महाराशी को बता इही थी।१०१। मस्त्रिणी और दण्डनायाओं ने उस कुमारिका को कभी भो युद्ध में साय नहीं छोड़ा था । ये दोनों प्रेक्षक थीं और चुप ही हो गयी थीं
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिना समनुज्ञातः कृत कृत्यो महीपतिः । रथमारुह्य वेगेन सप्रियः प्रययौ पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: muninā samanujñātaḥ kṛta kṛtyo mahīpatiḥ / rathamāruhya vegena sapriyaḥ prayayau purīm
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: ।१०२ा सूर्म देव की विम्बमाला के ही तुल्य वह एक ही स्वरूप वाली कुमारी समस्त देत्य के पुत्रों को प्रत्येक को भिन्न दिखाई दे रही थी ।१०३। अग्नि 'चूडाल.बाणों से उनके कमो का भेदन करतो हुई युद्ध कर रहो थी और उसका मुख क्रोध से लाल रक्त कमल के ही समान शोभित हो रहा था
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: स प्रविश्य पुरीं रम्यां त्दृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम् । आनन्दितः पौरजनै रेमे परमया मुदा
verses.transliteration: sa praviśya purīṃ ramyāṃ tdṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtām / ānanditaḥ paurajanai reme paramayā mudā
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: ।१०४। नभ में देवगण देखते हुए बड़ा ही आश्चयं प्रकट कर रहे ये । तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजपत्न्यावुभे नृप । राज्ञे प्रावोचतां गर्भं मुदा परमया युते
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu rājapatnyāvubhe nṛpa / rājñe prāvocatāṃ garbhaṃ mudā paramayā yute
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: ववृधे च तयोर्गर्भः शुक्लपक्षे यथोडुराट् । सह संतोषसंपत्त्या पित्रोः पौरजनस्य च
verses.transliteration: vavṛdhe ca tayorgarbhaḥ śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ / saha saṃtoṣasaṃpattyā pitroḥ paurajanasya ca
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.hindi: लघु हाथों वाली वह कुमारिका पूज्यमान होती हुई युद्ध कर रही वी । उसने युद्ध में दूसरा पूर्ण दिवस भी समाप्त किया था और उस ललिता देवी की पुत्री ने अपने बल को प्रकाशित किया था । वह उन सबको अपने अस्त्रों और प्रत्यस्त्रों से भेदन कर रही थी ।१०६-१०७। उस महाराशी की

verses.sanskrit: सम्यगेवं कृते राजन्भवतो मत्प्रसादतः । यथोक्तसंख्या पत्राणां भविष्यति न संशयः

verses.hindi: कुमारिका ने नारायणास्त्र को छोड़कर दो सो अक्षोहिणी सेनाओं को एक ही क्षण में भस्मसात् कर दिया था।१०5। उन अक्षोहिणी सेनाओं के बिनाश होने से एक ही क्षण में क्रोध को प्राप्त हुए के देत्यराज के पुत्रों ने अपने-अपने धनुषों को खींचा था और वे सब एक ही साथ गिर गये थे
