verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: सतस्मै तत्परिश्रुत्य दास्यामीति गवामिषम् । आदत्त च निधिं तं तु पिशाचेनानुमोदितः
verses.transliteration: satasmai tatpariśrutya dāsyāmīti gavāmiṣam / ādatta ca nidhiṃ taṃ tu piśācenānumoditaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर अपने समस्त पुत्रों के विनष्ट हो जाने पर महान शोक से परिप्लुत होकर भण्डासुर विलाप करने लगा था ओर उसने यह मान लिया था कि अब मेरे कुल का नाश हो गया है।१। वह इस रीति से क्रन्दन करने लगा था--हा ! मेरे पुत्रो ! तुम सब तो बहुत ही उदार गुणों वाले
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: न प्रादाच्च ततो मौढ्यात्तस्मै यत्तत्प्रतिश्रुतम् । प्रतिश्रुताप्रदानोत्थरोषं न श्रद्दधे नृप
verses.transliteration: na prādācca tato mauḍhyāttasmai yattatpratiśrutam / pratiśrutāpradānottharoṣaṃ na śraddadhe nṛpa
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: ल्या सभी मेरी आज्ञा में तत्पर रहे थे-- हा ! आप तो मेरे नेत्रों को सुधा के सूर के ही समान ये और मेरे कुल को बढ़ाने वाले ये ।२। हा ! आप लोग तों सभी देवों के मद का भंजन करने वाले बे-हा ! आप लोग देवाञ्जनाओं के हृदयों को मोहित करने में कामदेव के ही तुल्य थे ।३। मुझे
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: तमेवं सुचिरं कालं प्रतीक्ष्याशनकाङ्क्षया । अपनीतधनः सो ऽपि ममार व्यथितः क्षुधा
verses.transliteration: tamevaṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ pratīkṣyāśanakāṅkṣayā / apanītadhanaḥ so 'pi mamāra vyathitaḥ kṣudhā
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: अपनी प्रीति युक्त बाणी सुनाओ--अब मेरी गोद में आकर बंठा--इस समय यह् घटना हो गयी है कि आप लोग अपने पिता का त्याग करके सुखी हो गये हो ।४ है पुत्रो ! आप सबके बिना यह मेरे राज्य शोभित नहीं हो रहे हैं। मेरे घर सब अव सुने हैं ओर मेरो राज्य सभा भी सूती हो गयी है।
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यो ऽपि बालो मरणं संप्राप्य सगरस्य तु । बभूव काले केशिन्यां तनयो ऽन्वयवर्द्धनः
verses.transliteration: vaiśyo 'pi bālo maraṇaṃ saṃprāpya sagarasya tu / babhūva kāle keśinyāṃ tanayo 'nvayavarddhanaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: मह क्या हुआ ओर आप सभो कंसे दुराशयों वाले एक ही साथ निहत हो गये हैं । जिनकी भुजाओं का बल कोई भी दबा नहीं सकता था ऐसे जो मेरे कुल के अंकुर आप सब थे उत सबको एक ही बार में उस दृष्टा नारी ने युद्ध में कैसे मार डाला था ।५-६। मेरी सब सेनाए नष्ट हो गय और मेरी
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: अशरीरः पिशाचे ऽपि पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् । वायुभूतो ऽविशद्देहं राजपुत्रस्य भूपते
verses.transliteration: aśarīraḥ piśāce 'pi pūrvavairamanusmaran / vāyubhūto 'viśaddehaṃ rājaputrasya bhūpate
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: कुल स्त्रियां भी विन2 हो गयी हैं। इससे आगे कुल के क्षीण हो जाने पर सब साहस और सुख भी विनष्ट हो गये हैं ३
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाविष्टस्ततः सो ऽपि क्रूरचित्तो ऽभवत्तदा । मतिविभ्रंशमासाद्य मुहुस्तेन बलात्कृतः
verses.transliteration: tenāviṣṭastataḥ so 'pi krūracitto 'bhavattadā / mativibhraṃśamāsādya muhustena balātkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: असमञ्जसत्वं नगरे चक्रे सो ऽपि नृशंसवत् । बालांश्च यूनः स्थविरान्योषितश्च सदा खलः
verses.transliteration: asamañjasatvaṃ nagare cakre so 'pi nṛśaṃsavat / bālāṃśca yūnaḥ sthavirānyoṣitaśca sadā khalaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वाहत्वा प्रचिक्षेप सरय्वामतिनिर्दयः । ततः पौरजनाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तस्य कदर्यताम्
verses.transliteration: hatvāhatvā pracikṣepa sarayvāmatinirdayaḥ / tataḥ paurajanāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tasya kadaryatām
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: बहुशो निकृतास्तेन गत्वा राज्ञे व्यजिज्ञापन् । राजा च तदुपश्रुत्य तमाहूय प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: bahuśo nikṛtāstena gatvā rājñe vyajijñāpan / rājā ca tadupaśrutya tamāhūya prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: वारयामास बहुधा दुःखेन महतान्वितः । बहुशः प्रतिषिद्धो ऽपि पित्रा तेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: vārayāmāsa bahudhā duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ / bahuśaḥ pratiṣiddho 'pi pitrā tena mahātmanā
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.hindi: देव कि प्राकृत इव. प्राप्तः शोकस्य वश्यताम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: जले तप्ते च संतप्ताः संबभूवुर्यथा यवाः । नाशकत्तं यदा पापाद्विनिवर्त्तयितुं नृपः
verses.transliteration: jale tapte ca saṃtaptāḥ saṃbabhūvuryathā yavāḥ / nāśakattaṃ yadā pāpādvinivarttayituṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: लोकापवादभीरुत्वाद्विषयानत्यजत्तदा
verses.transliteration: lokāpavādabhīrutvādviṣayānatyajattadā
verses.translation: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Jamadagni duly bathed in them and performed the rite of offering libations to the manes in ac- cordance with the scriptures carefully.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरचरिते ऽसमञ्जसत्यागो नामैकपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५१॥ जैमिनिरुवाच त्यक्त्वा पुत्रं स धर्मात्मा सगरः प्रेम तद्गतम् । धर्मशीले तदा वाले चकारांशुमति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaracarite 'samañjasatyāgo nāmaikapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 51// jaiminiruvāca tyaktvā putraṃ sa dharmātmā sagaraḥ prema tadgatam / dharmaśīle tadā vāle cakārāṃśumati prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "After banishing his son, *he virtuous-souled Lord Sagara transferred his love for him to the child Aiiuhiman whose conduct was righteous.
verses.wordMeaning: "After banishing his son, *he virtuous-souled Lord Sagara transferred his love for him to the child Aiiuhiman whose conduct was righteous.
verses.commentary: Sense: "After banishing his son, *he virtuous-souled Lord Sagara transferred his love for him to the child Aiiuhiman whose conduct was righteous.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सुमत्यास्तनया नृप । ववृधुः सघशः सर्वे परस्परमनुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu sumatyāstanayā nṛpa / vavṛdhuḥ saghaśaḥ sarve parasparamanuvratāḥ
verses.translation: At the very same time, O king, the sons of Sumati grew up collectively. All of them were amiable, devoted and faithful to one another.
verses.wordMeaning: At the very same time, O king, the sons of Sumati grew up collectively. All of them were amiable, devoted and faithful to one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the very same time, O king, the sons of Sumati grew up collectively. All of them were amiable, devoted and faithful to one another.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रसंहननाः क्रूरा निर्दया निरपत्रपाः । अधर्मशीला नितरामेकघर्माण एव च
verses.transliteration: vajrasaṃhananāḥ krūrā nirdayā nirapatrapāḥ / adharmaśīlā nitarāmekagharmāṇa eva ca
verses.translation: They had adamantine bodies. They were cruel, merci- less and shameless. They were habitually evil in their activities. They had the same nature and characteristics.
verses.wordMeaning: They had adamantine bodies. They were cruel, merci- less and shameless. They were habitually evil in their activities. They had the same nature and characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had adamantine bodies. They were cruel, merci- less and shameless. They were habitually evil in their activities. They had the same nature and characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: एककार्याभिनिरताः क्रोधना मूढचेतसः । अधृष्याः सर्वभूतानां जनोपद्रवकारिणः
verses.transliteration: ekakāryābhiniratāḥ krodhanā mūḍhacetasaḥ / adhṛṣyāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ janopadravakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: They co-operated in doing simultaneously the same work. They were deluded in their minds. They were easily irritable. They could not be easily assailed by any living being. They regularly harassed the people.
verses.hindi: आप लोगों के जन्म मैंने पूर पुष्यों के द्वारा ही प्राप्त किये थे आज आप सबका विनाश हो गया है अब तो मैं भी विनष्ट हो हो गया है ।७। हे
verses.wordMeaning: They co-operated in doing simultaneously the same work. They were deluded in their minds. They were easily irritable. They could not be easily assailed by any living being. They regularly harassed the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: They co-operated in doing simultaneously the same work. They were deluded in their minds. They were easily irritable. They could not be easily assailed by any living being. They regularly harassed the people.

verses.sanskrit: विनयाचा रसन्मार्गनिरपेक्षाः समन्ततः । बबाधिरे जगत्सर्वमसुरा इव कामतः
verses.transliteration: vinayācā rasanmārganirapekṣāḥ samantataḥ / babādhire jagatsarvamasurā iva kāmataḥ
verses.translation: They had no concern for humility, good conduct or the path of virtue. They harassed the entire world around as they pleased, like Asuras.
verses.hindi: खोटी तकदीर बाला हो गया ह । इस तरह से बह शोक से ग्रस्त हो गया था और माथे के बालों को खोलकर प्रजाप कर रहा था । उसको मूर्च्छा हो गयी थी और उसकी हूदयगति लुप्त हो गयी थी--बह फिर नृपासन से नीचे गिर पड़ाथा ।६। फिर विणुक-बिफङ्ग और कूटिलकमों ने उस संसद में
verses.wordMeaning: They had no concern for humility, good conduct or the path of virtue. They harassed the entire world around as they pleased, like Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had no concern for humility, good conduct or the path of virtue. They harassed the entire world around as they pleased, like Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: विध्वस्तयज्ञसन्मार्गं भुवनं तैरुपद्रुतम् । निःस्वाध्याय वषट्कारं बभूवार्तं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: vidhvastayajñasanmārgaṃ bhuvanaṃ tairupadrutam / niḥsvādhyāya vaṣaṭkāraṃ babhūvārtaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Attacked and tormented by them, the whole world became distressed and unhappy in particular with Yajnas and paths of virtue destroyed. The people could not have their regular self-study of the Vedas nor could they perform holy rites by uttering the Vakdra mantra.
verses.hindi: भाग्य के कुटिसाओं को कहते हुए भण्डासुर को आश्वासन दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Attacked and tormented by them, the whole world became distressed and unhappy in particular with Yajnas and paths of virtue destroyed. The people could not have their regular self-study of the Vedas nor could they perform holy rites by uttering the Vakdra mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Attacked and tormented by them, the whole world became distressed and unhappy in particular with Yajnas and paths of virtue destroyed. The people could not have their regular self-study of the Vedas nor could they perform holy rites by uttering the Vakdra mantra.

verses.sanskrit: विध्वस्यमाने सुभृशं सागरैर्वरदर्पितैः । प्रक्षोभं परमं जग्मुर्देवासुरमहोरगाः
verses.transliteration: vidhvasyamāne subhṛśaṃ sāgarairvaradarpitaiḥ / prakṣobhaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevāsuramahoragāḥ
verses.translation: The earth overwhelmed by the ocean began to quake though its name is Acald (immovable). There was a break and hindrance in the penance and abstract meditation of the ascetics.
verses.hindi: 'बिशुक ने कहा-हे स्वामिन् ! आप सामान्य मानव के ही समान शोक के वश में वयों प्राप्त हो गये हैं। महान संग्राम में मरे हुए पुत्रो की ओर कया बात कर रहे हैं ।११। वीरों का तो यह युद्ध करते हुए मर जाना धामिक मार्ग ही है और यह निरन्तर होते वाला है । जो युद्ध में मृत्यु को प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: The earth overwhelmed by the ocean began to quake though its name is Acald (immovable). There was a break and hindrance in the penance and abstract meditation of the ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth overwhelmed by the ocean began to quake though its name is Acald (immovable). There was a break and hindrance in the penance and abstract meditation of the ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: धरासा सागराक्रान्ता न चलापि तदा चला । तपः समाधिभङ्गश्च प्रबभूव तपस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: dharāsā sāgarākrāntā na calāpi tadā calā / tapaḥ samādhibhaṅgaśca prababhūva tapasvinām
verses.translation: Depr ved of the Havya and Kavya offerings, the Devas and the Pitrs became oppressed by great sorrow. They went to the abode of Brahma.
verses.hindi: होते हैं बह तो उनकी मृत्यू शोच करने के योग्य नहीं हुआ करती है प्रत्युत पूजित ही हुआ करती है।१२। केवल मही. बात शल्य के समान मसाको
verses.wordMeaning: Depr ved of the Havya and Kavya offerings, the Devas and the Pitrs became oppressed by great sorrow. They went to the abode of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Depr ved of the Havya and Kavya offerings, the Devas and the Pitrs became oppressed by great sorrow. They went to the abode of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: हव्यकव्यपरिभ्रष्टास्त्रिदशाः पितृभिः सह । दुःशेन महाताविष्टा विरिञ्जभवनं ययुः
verses.transliteration: havyakavyaparibhraṣṭāstridaśāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha / duḥśena mahātāviṣṭā viriñjabhavanaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: After going there, the Devas with Sarva* (prob. Sakra) at their head, duly reported to him the entire activities of the sons of Sagara.
verses.wordMeaning: After going there, the Devas with Sarva* (prob. Sakra) at their head, duly reported to him the entire activities of the sons of Sagara.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going there, the Devas with Sarva* (prob. Sakra) at their head, duly reported to him the entire activities of the sons of Sagara.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा यथान्यायं देवाः शर्वपुरोगमाः । शशंसुः सकलं तस्मै सागराणां विचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā yathānyāyaṃ devāḥ śarvapurogamāḥ / śaśaṃsuḥ sakalaṃ tasmai sāgarāṇāṃ viceṣṭitam
verses.translation: — "O Devas, listen, attentively to my words. Welfare unto you. There is no doubt that the sons of Sagara will be destroyed ere long.
verses.hindi: बोडा दे रहोव्है कि स्त्री ने आकर युद्ध में बड़े-बड़े योधाओं का हनन किया है ।१३। उस देत्य के द्वारा ऐसा कहने पर भण्ड ने पुत्रों के शोक का त्याग कर दिया था ओर फिर भण्ड ने प्रचण्ड कालाग्नि के समान क्रोध किया
verses.wordMeaning: — "O Devas, listen, attentively to my words. Welfare unto you. There is no doubt that the sons of Sagara will be destroyed ere long.
verses.commentary: Sense: — "O Devas, listen, attentively to my words. Welfare unto you. There is no doubt that the sons of Sagara will be destroyed ere long.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रत्वा वचनं तेषां ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । क्षणमन्तर्मना भूत्वा जगाद सुरसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tacchratvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / kṣaṇamantarmanā bhūtvā jagāda surasattamaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent Suras, what lam going to say for your welfare should now be carried out by all of you without any slackness.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O excellent Suras, what lam going to say for your welfare should now be carried out by all of you without any slackness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O excellent Suras, what lam going to say for your welfare should now be carried out by all of you without any slackness.

verses.sanskrit: देवाःशृणुत भद्रं वो वाणीमवहिता मम । विनङ्क्ष्यन्त्यचिरेमैव सागरा नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: devāḥśṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo vāṇīmavahitā mama / vinaṅkṣyantyaciremaiva sāgarā nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The holy lord Kapila, the most excellent among victorious ones, the most exalted among the leading Yogins, is born on the earth with a partial power of Visnu, for the welfare of the universe.
verses.wordMeaning: The holy lord Kapila, the most excellent among victorious ones, the most exalted among the leading Yogins, is born on the earth with a partial power of Visnu, for the welfare of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy lord Kapila, the most excellent among victorious ones, the most exalted among the leading Yogins, is born on the earth with a partial power of Visnu, for the welfare of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: कालं कञ्चित्प्रतीक्षध्वं तेन सर्वं नियम्यते । निमित्तमात्रमन्यत्तु स एव सकलेशिता
verses.transliteration: kālaṃ kañcitpratīkṣadhvaṃ tena sarvaṃ niyamyate / nimittamātramanyattu sa eva sakaleśitā
verses.translation: At my behest, all of you go to the leading sage Kapila. Stand near him wishing for the conclusion of his meditation.
verses.wordMeaning: At my behest, all of you go to the leading sage Kapila. Stand near him wishing for the conclusion of his meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: At my behest, all of you go to the leading sage Kapila. Stand near him wishing for the conclusion of his meditation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्युष्मद्धितार्थाय यद्वक्ष्यामि सुरोत्तमाः । सर्वैर्भवद्भिरधुना तत्कर्त्तव्यमतं द्रितैः
verses.transliteration: tasmādyuṣmaddhitārthāya yadvakṣyāmi surottamāḥ / sarvairbhavadbhiradhunā tatkarttavyamataṃ dritaiḥ
verses.translation: At the close of his abstract meditation, you will bow down to him and tell him your purpose in full. He will do what is conducive to your welfare.
verses.hindi: उसने यमराज के तुल्य अपने ड्ग को म्यान से निकाल लिया था जो बड़ा होडुवग्र या। उक्षन अपने नेत्रों को फलाया था और वह तेज से ज्वलित हो गया था ।१५। युद्ध में बन्धुओ के सहित इसी समय में इस खड्ग से उस दुष्टा के खण्ड-२ करके युद्ध में श्रम को प्राप्त करू'गा
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of his abstract meditation, you will bow down to him and tell him your purpose in full. He will do what is conducive to your welfare.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of his abstract meditation, you will bow down to him and tell him your purpose in full. He will do what is conducive to your welfare.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरंशेन भगवान्कपिलो जयतां वरः । जातो जगद्धितार्थाय योगीन्द्रप्रवरो भुवि
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoraṃśena bhagavānkapilo jayatāṃ varaḥ / jāto jagaddhitārthāya yogīndrapravaro bhuvi
verses.translation: O excellent Devas, do something whereby a break in the abstract meditation cf the sage can be caused through the sons of Sagara* \
verses.hindi: इस तरह से रोष से उसका वर्ण स्खलित हो गया था ओर वह सपे के ही तुल् निःश्वास ले रहा था । बह एक मत्त पुरुष के ही समान अपने खड्ग को हिलांता हुआ वहां से चल दिया था ।१७। सभो सम्श्रान्त दानवों ने "उसको राक. दिया था और अत्यधिक कोध से जलते हुए उन्होंने ललिता के
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Devas, do something whereby a break in the abstract meditation cf the sage can be caused through the sons of Sagara* \
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Devas, do something whereby a break in the abstract meditation cf the sage can be caused through the sons of Sagara* \

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यपीतसलिले दिव्यवर्षशतावधि । ध्यायन्नास्ते ऽधुनांऽभोधावेकान्ते तत्र कुत्र चित्
verses.transliteration: agastyapītasalile divyavarṣaśatāvadhi / dhyāyannāste 'dhunāṃ'bhodhāvekānte tatra kutra cit
verses.translation: On being told thus by him, the Devas bowed down to Brahma and went to Kapila, the most excellent among the Brahmanas; with palms joined in reverence, they spoke to him: —
verses.hindi: अति वचन कहने का आरम्भ कर्क दिया या ।१५। है स्वामितु ! उसके लिए आपको ऐसा सम्भ्रव नही करना चाहिए। हम लोभ अपने बलों से समन्वित
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by him, the Devas bowed down to Brahma and went to Kapila, the most excellent among the Brahmanas; with palms joined in reverence, they spoke to him: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by him, the Devas bowed down to Brahma and went to Kapila, the most excellent among the Brahmanas; with palms joined in reverence, they spoke to him: —

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा यूयं ममादेशात्कपिलं मुनिपुङ्गवम् । ध्यानाव सानमिच्छन्तस्तिष्ठध्वं तदुपह्वरे
verses.transliteration: gatvā yūyaṃ mamādeśātkapilaṃ munipuṅgavam / dhyānāva sānamicchantastiṣṭhadhvaṃ tadupahvare
verses.translation: "Be pleased with us, O excellent sage. We have
verses.hindi: होकर रण करने का उत्साह करते हैं ।१६। आपको सामान्य भी आशो पाकर हम लोग सम्पूर्ण भुवन का मर्दन करने में हठ से समर्थ हैं । उस मुग्ध भामिनी को तो बात हो क्या है । अर्थात वह विचारी तारी हमारे सामने बहुत ही तुच्छ ह।२०। क्या हम सातों सागरों का चूष डालें अथवा समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: "Be pleased with us, O excellent sage. We have
verses.commentary: Sense: "Be pleased with us, O excellent sage. We have

verses.sanskrit: समाधिविरतौ तस्य स्वाभिप्रायमशेषतः । नत्वा तस्मै वदिष्यध्वं स वः श्रेयो विधास्यति
verses.transliteration: samādhiviratau tasya svābhiprāyamaśeṣataḥ / natvā tasmai vadiṣyadhvaṃ sa vaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati
verses.translation: A physical body has been voluntarily assumed by you, only for the destruction of the great distress of men afflicted by the three types of agony. Indeed, you are the most excellent among those who perform austerities.
verses.hindi: पर्वतों को खोदकर चूण कर देवे और इन तीनों भुवनों को उठाकर अधर देवें । तात्पर्ये यह है कि हम असम्भव कार्य को भी आपके आदेश से कर सकने की शक्ति रखते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: A physical body has been voluntarily assumed by you, only for the destruction of the great distress of men afflicted by the three types of agony. Indeed, you are the most excellent among those who perform austerities.
verses.commentary: Sense: A physical body has been voluntarily assumed by you, only for the destruction of the great distress of men afflicted by the three types of agony. Indeed, you are the most excellent among those who perform austerities.

verses.sanskrit: समाधिभङ्गश्च मुनेर्यथा स्यात्सागरैः कृतः । कुरुध्वं च तथा यूयं प्रवृत्तिं विबुधोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: samādhibhaṅgaśca muneryathā syātsāgaraiḥ kṛtaḥ / kurudhvaṃ ca tathā yūyaṃ pravṛttiṃ vibudhottamāḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, O Brahmana, you are capable, at your will, to mentally, create the entire universe, sustain it and annihilate it.
verses.wordMeaning: Undoubtedly, O Brahmana, you are capable, at your will, to mentally, create the entire universe, sustain it and annihilate it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly, O Brahmana, you are capable, at your will, to mentally, create the entire universe, sustain it and annihilate it.

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच इत्युक्तास्तेन विबुधास्तं प्रणम्य वितामहम् । गत्वा तं विबुधश्रेष्टं ते कृताञ्जलयो ऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca ityuktāstena vibudhāstaṃ praṇamya vitāmaham / gatvā taṃ vibudhaśreṣṭaṃ te kṛtāñjalayo 'bruvan
verses.translation: You are our creator and dispenser of our destiny. You are our preceptor. You arc our greatest resort. You are our protector. Put an end to our adversity.
verses.wordMeaning: You are our creator and dispenser of our destiny. You are our preceptor. You arc our greatest resort. You are our protector. Put an end to our adversity.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are our creator and dispenser of our destiny. You are our preceptor. You arc our greatest resort. You are our protector. Put an end to our adversity.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः प्रसीद नो मुनिश्रेष्ठ वयं त्वां शरणं गताः । उपद्रुतं जगत्सर्वंसागरैः संप्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ prasīda no muniśreṣṭha vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / upadrutaṃ jagatsarvaṃsāgaraiḥ saṃpraṇaśyati
verses.translation: O leading Brahmana, be the resort and refuge of the leading Brahmanas in particular, who reside in the three worlds and who are being persecuted by the sons of Sagara.
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmana, be the resort and refuge of the leading Brahmanas in particular, who reside in the three worlds and who are being persecuted by the sons of Sagara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmana, be the resort and refuge of the leading Brahmanas in particular, who reside in the three worlds and who are being persecuted by the sons of Sagara.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं किलाखिललोकानां स्थितिसहारकारणः । विष्णोरंशेन योगीन्द्रस्वरूपी भुवि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ kilākhilalokānāṃ sthitisahārakāraṇaḥ / viṣṇoraṃśena yogīndrasvarūpī bhuvi saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: हम समस्त सुरों को छेद डालेगे शोर उनके आलयों को तोड़-फोड़ डालेंगे । हम दिकपालां को पोस डालेंगे । है महामते ! आप हमको अपनी आज्ञा भर दे दोजिए ।२२। इस महान अहंकार मे युक्त वचन को सुनकर लाल नेत्रों वाला भण्ड कद्ध होकर बोला था।२३। है विशुक्र ! माया से
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: पुंसां तापत्रयार्त्तानामार्तिनाशाय केवलम् । स्वेच्छया ते धृतो देहो न तु त्वं तपतां वरः
verses.transliteration: puṃsāṃ tāpatrayārttānāmārtināśāya kevalam / svecchayā te dhṛto deho na tu tvaṃ tapatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: अपने वर्ष्म को छिपाकर आप वहाँ जाकर कटक में शत्रू ओं के जय के विघ्न आले महामन्त्र को करो ।२४ उसके इस वचन को श्रवण करके विशुक्र रोष से भरगयाथा और माया से अपने शरीर को छिपाकर ललिता की सेना
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: मनसैव जगत्सर्वं स्रष्टुं संहर्तुमेव च । विधातुं स्वेच्छया ब्रह्मन्भवाञ्छक्रोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: manasaiva jagatsarvaṃ sraṣṭuṃ saṃhartumeva ca / vidhātuṃ svecchayā brahmanbhavāñchakrotyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो धाता विधाता च त्वं गुरुस्त्वं परायणम् । परित्राता त्वमस्माकं विनिवर्त्तय चापदम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ no dhātā vidhātā ca tvaṃ gurustvaṃ parāyaṇam / paritrātā tvamasmākaṃ vinivarttaya cāpadam
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: में गया था ।२४। जव प्रमाण करने को वह् उद्यत हुआ या तो सूर्य अस्त हो गया था । पर्यस्त किरणों के समुदाय से दिशाए सब पारस वर्ण की हो गयीं थीं १२६ अनुराग वाली सन्ध्या गमन करते हुए भानुमाली पीछे ही चली गयी मानो पाताल की कुञ्ज में वह सूर्य के साथ रमण करने को
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: शरणं भव विप्रेन्द्र विप्रेद्राणां विशेषतः । सागरैर्दह्यमानानां लोकत्रयनिवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: śaraṇaṃ bhava viprendra vipredrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ / sāgarairdahyamānānāṃ lokatrayanivāsinām
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: उत्सुक हो गयो थी । चरमाब्थि के पय के ही समान तारे लोभित हो रहे थे। बड़े वेग से प्रयाण करने वाले सूर्य के देह के सङ्ग से ही वे कण समुत्यित हुए बे ।३७-२८। व
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: ननु वै सात्त्विकी चेष्टा भवतीह भवादृशाम् । त्रातुमर्हसि तस्मात्त्वं लोकानस्मांश्च सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: nanu vai sāttvikī ceṣṭā bhavatīha bhavādṛśām / trātumarhasi tasmāttvaṃ lokānasmāṃśca suvrata
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: न चेदकाले भगवन्विनङ्क्ष्यत्यखिलं जगत् । जैमिनिरुवाच इत्युक्तः सकलैर्देवैरुन्मील्य नयने शनैः
verses.transliteration: na cedakāle bhagavanvinaṅkṣyatyakhilaṃ jagat / jaiminiruvāca ityuktaḥ sakalairdevairunmīlya nayane śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: विलोक्य तानुवाचेदं कपिलः सूनृतं वचः । स्वकर्मणैव निर्दग्धाः प्रविनङ्क्ष्यन्ति सागराः
verses.transliteration: vilokya tānuvācedaṃ kapilaḥ sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ / svakarmaṇaiva nirdagdhāḥ pravinaṅkṣyanti sāgarāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: काले प्राप्ते तु युष्माभिः सतावत्परिपाल्यताम् । अहं तु कारणं तेषां विनाशाय दुरात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: kāle prāpte tu yuṣmābhiḥ satāvatparipālyatām / ahaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ vināśāya durātmanām
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: विलोक्य विस्मयाविष्टो विचार्य च चिर तदा ।
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यामि सुरश्रेष्ठा भवतामर्थसिद्धये । मम क्रोधाग्नि विप्लुष्टाः सागराः पापचेतसः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyāmi suraśreṣṭhā bhavatāmarthasiddhaye / mama krodhāgni vipluṣṭāḥ sāgarāḥ pāpacetasaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर काजल के तुल्य एक दम काला बड़ा भारी अन्धकार प्राप्त हो गया था । असिकी दुर्धी से मानों सवर्णे का साथ करने को ही बहू उद्युक्त हो गया या ।२९। गूढ शावर से संवृत वह हैत्य माया के रथ पर संवार हुआ था और उसने अपना शरीर अदृश्य कर लिया था। फिर वह
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यन्तु चिरेणैव कालोपहतबुद्धयः । तस्माद्गतज्वरा देवा लोकाश्चैवाकुतोभयाः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyantu cireṇaiva kālopahatabuddhayaḥ / tasmādgatajvarā devā lokāścaivākutobhayāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: खल ललिता को सेना में प्राप्त हुआ था ।३०। वहां जाकर उस दुष्ट बुद्धि वाले ने अग्नि का प्राकार मण्डल देखा था जो जलती हुई ज्वालाओं वाला थ्या भौर सौ योजन के विस्तार से समन्वित था ।३१। उसके सब ओर भ्रमण
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तु ते दुराचाराः क्षिप्रं यास्यन्ति संक्षयम् । तद्यूयं निर्भया भूत्वा व्रजध्वं स्वां पुरीं प्रति
verses.transliteration: bhavantu te durācārāḥ kṣipraṃ yāsyanti saṃkṣayam / tadyūyaṃ nirbhayā bhūtvā vrajadhvaṃ svāṃ purīṃ prati
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: करते हुए उसने शाल को अवकाश न पाया था । फिर दक्षिण में द्वार पर पहुँचकर क्षण भर उस उद्धत ने सोचा था।३२। वहाँ पर सावधान-महान बली-हाथों में हथियार उडावे हुए--यानों पर समारूढ़ और संनद्ध वर्मों वाले जो द्वार देश पर स्थित ये, देखे थे ।३३। संदा द्वार की रक्षा कें लिए
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: कालं कञ्चित्प्रतीक्षध्वं ततो ऽभीष्टमवाप्स्यथ । कपिलेनैवमुक्तास्ते देवाः सर्वे सवासवाः
verses.transliteration: kālaṃ kañcitpratīkṣadhvaṃ tato 'bhīṣṭamavāpsyatha / kapilenaivamuktāste devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: दण्डनाथा के द्वारा निदिष्ट बिशति अक्षोहिणी सेना से संयुत स्तम्भिनी प्रमुख शक्तियाँ थीं ।३४। उनको देखकर वह विस्म से समाविष्ट हो गया था और उस समय में उसने विचार बहुत देर तक किया! था । शाल के बाहिर ही स्थित होकर उसने यन्त्र को फॅलाया था
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रणम्य ततो जग्मुः प्रतीताग्निदिवं प्रति । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा सगरः पृथिवीपतिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ praṇamya tato jagmuḥ pratītāgnidivaṃ prati / etasminnantare rājā sagaraḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: वाजिमेधं महायज्ञं कर्तुं चक्रे मनोरथम् । आहृत्य सर्वसंभारान्वसिष्ठानुमते तदा
verses.transliteration: vājimedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kartuṃ cakre manoratham / āhṛtya sarvasaṃbhārānvasiṣṭhānumate tadā
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: और्वाद्यैः सहितो विप्रैर्यथावद्दीक्षितो ऽभवत् । दीक्षां प्रविष्टो नृपतिर्हयसंचारणाय वै
verses.transliteration: aurvādyaiḥ sahito viprairyathāvaddīkṣito 'bhavat / dīkṣāṃ praviṣṭo nṛpatirhayasaṃcāraṇāya vai
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: अलसा कृपणा दीना नितन्द्रा च प्रमीलिका ।
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्सर्वान्समाहूय संदिदेश महयशाः । संचारयित्वा तुरगं परीत्य पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: putrānsarvānsamāhūya saṃdideśa mahayaśāḥ / saṃcārayitvā turagaṃ parītya pṛthivītale
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: क्लीवा च निरहंकारा चेत्यष्टौ देवताः स्मृताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्रं ममान्तिकं पुत्राः पुनराहर्तुमर्हथ । जैमिनिरुवाच ततस्ते पितुरादेशात्तमादाय तुरङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: kṣipraṃ mamāntikaṃ putrāḥ punarāhartumarhatha / jaiminiruvāca tataste piturādeśāttamādāya turaṅgamam
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: परिचङ्क्रमयामासुः सकले क्षितिमण्डले । विधिचोदनयैवाश्वः स भूमौ परिवर्तिततः
verses.transliteration: paricaṅkramayāmāsuḥ sakale kṣitimaṇḍale / vidhicodanayaivāśvaḥ sa bhūmau parivartitataḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: न तु दिग्विजयार्थाय करादानार्थमेव च । पृथिवीभूभुजा तेन पूर्वमेव विनिर्जिता
verses.transliteration: na tu digvijayārthāya karādānārthameva ca / pṛthivībhūbhujā tena pūrvameva vinirjitā
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: नृपाश्चोदारवीर्येण करदाः समरे कृताः । ततस्ते राजतनया निस्तोये लवणांबुधौ
verses.transliteration: nṛpāścodāravīryeṇa karadāḥ samare kṛtāḥ / tataste rājatanayā nistoye lavaṇāṃbudhau
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: भूतले विविशुर्हृष्टाः परिवार्य तुरङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtale viviśurhṛṣṭāḥ parivārya turaṅgamam
verses.translation: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.hindi: उसने आठ देवताओं से युक्त यन्त्र को लिखा था। दो कोश कीं चौड़ाई में और उतने ही निस्तार में एक शिला पट्ट पर जो महान था उस उत्तम यन्त्रको लिया या । वह यन्त्र आठ दिशाओं में आठ शूल संहाराक्षर मीलि से ही लिखा गया था ।३६-३७। उन आठ देवताओं के नाम हैं-अलसा-
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, the activities of people like you will be of Saliva (very good) nature. Hence, O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to save us and all the world.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उवोद्धातपादे सगरवरिते ऽश्वमोचनं नाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५२॥ जैमिनिरुवाच तेषु तत्र निविष्टेषु वासवेन प्रचोदितः । जहारं तुरगं वायुस्तत्क्षणेन रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya uvoddhātapāde sagaravarite 'śvamocanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 52// jaiminiruvāca teṣu tatra niviṣṭeṣu vāsavena pracoditaḥ / jahāraṃ turagaṃ vāyustatkṣaṇena rasātalam
verses.translation: Stealing the horse without being seen by any of them, O king, the windgod carried it away along that path to the vicinity of sage Kapila.
verses.hindi: कृपणा-दीना-नितन्द्रा-त्रमीलिका-क्लीबा-निरहंकारा--ये आठ देवता कहे गये हैं ।३५ा इन देवताओं के अष्टक को शुलाष्टक पुट के ऊ१र नियोजित:
verses.wordMeaning: Stealing the horse without being seen by any of them, O king, the windgod carried it away along that path to the vicinity of sage Kapila.
verses.commentary: Sense: Stealing the horse without being seen by any of them, O king, the windgod carried it away along that path to the vicinity of sage Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: अदृष्टमश्वं तैः सर्वैरपहृत्य सदागतिः । अनयत्तत्पथा राजन्कपिलस्यान्तिकं मुनेः
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭamaśvaṃ taiḥ sarvairapahṛtya sadāgatiḥ / anayattatpathā rājankapilasyāntikaṃ muneḥ
verses.translation: Then they went back to Ayodhya, surrounded by the sagts, met their father, bowed down to him and intimated to him everything.
verses.wordMeaning: Then they went back to Ayodhya, surrounded by the sagts, met their father, bowed down to him and intimated to him everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they went back to Ayodhya, surrounded by the sagts, met their father, bowed down to him and intimated to him everything.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समाकुलाः सर्वे विनष्टे ऽश्वे नृपात्मजाः । परीत्य वसुधां सर्वां प्रमार्गन्तस्तुरगमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samākulāḥ sarve vinaṣṭe 'śve nṛpātmajāḥ / parītya vasudhāṃ sarvāṃ pramārgantasturagamam
verses.translation: "The moment we entered the ocean after wandering over the whole of the earth, the horse was taken away by some one though it was being vigilantly guarded by us who were on the watch."
verses.hindi: कर लिखा गया मन्व था उसको उस मायावी ने भली-भाँति मन्त्रित किया था ।३६। यन्त्र को पूजा करके छागल आदि को बलि दी थी । उस असुर ने समर में चारिकटक में उसका लेप किया था !४०। उस प्राकार के बाहिर के भाग में रहने वाले उल दुष्ट धी ने प्रक्षिप्त किया था और उल्लंघन कर
verses.wordMeaning: "The moment we entered the ocean after wandering over the whole of the earth, the horse was taken away by some one though it was being vigilantly guarded by us who were on the watch."
verses.commentary: Sense: "The moment we entered the ocean after wandering over the whole of the earth, the horse was taken away by some one though it was being vigilantly guarded by us who were on the watch."

verses.sanskrit: विचित्य पृथिवीं ते तु स पुराचलकाननाम् । अपश्यन्तो यज्ञपशुं दुःखं महदवाप्नुवन्
verses.transliteration: vicitya pṛthivīṃ te tu sa purācalakānanām / apaśyanto yajñapaśuṃ duḥkhaṃ mahadavāpnuvan
verses.translation: Then all of them together set-off from that place and said to one another: "Even now the horse is not to be seen, what shall we do?"
verses.hindi: कटक के मध्य के रण में गिरा था ।४१। उस यन्त्र के विकार से कटक में स्थित शक्तियाँ शस्त्रो को छोड़कर दीन मानसों वाली हो गयी थीं
verses.wordMeaning: Then all of them together set-off from that place and said to one another: "Even now the horse is not to be seen, what shall we do?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all of them together set-off from that place and said to one another: "Even now the horse is not to be seen, what shall we do?"

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽयोध्यां समासाद्य ऋषिभिः परिवारिताम् । दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्य पितरं तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: tato 'yodhyāṃ samāsādya ṛṣibhiḥ parivāritām / dṛṣṭvā praṇamya pitaraṃ tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayan
verses.translation: Having decided thus, all those sons of Sagara, of cruel resolve, dug the earth everywhere beginning with the sea- shore.
verses.wordMeaning: Having decided thus, all those sons of Sagara, of cruel resolve, dug the earth everywhere beginning with the sea- shore.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having decided thus, all those sons of Sagara, of cruel resolve, dug the earth everywhere beginning with the sea- shore.

verses.sanskrit: परीत्य पृथ्वीमस्माभिर्निविष्टे वरुणालये । रक्ष्यमाणो ऽपि पश्यद्भिः केनापि तुरगो हृतः
verses.transliteration: parītya pṛthvīmasmābhirniviṣṭe varuṇālaye / rakṣyamāṇo 'pi paśyadbhiḥ kenāpi turago hṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After digging the Bharata sub-continent and casting it off on the ground, they united a thousand Yojanas of the earth to the ocean.
verses.hindi: जयसिद्धफलं कि वा प्राणिहिसा च पापदा
verses.wordMeaning: After digging the Bharata sub-continent and casting it off on the ground, they united a thousand Yojanas of the earth to the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: After digging the Bharata sub-continent and casting it off on the ground, they united a thousand Yojanas of the earth to the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तै रुषाविष्टस्तानुवाच नृपोत्तमः । प्रयास्यध्वमधर्मिष्ठाः सर्वे ऽनावृत्तये पुनः
verses.transliteration: ityuktastai ruṣāviṣṭastānuvāca nṛpottamaḥ / prayāsyadhvamadharmiṣṭhāḥ sarve 'nāvṛttaye punaḥ
verses.translation: Digging the earth upto the netherworlds, the sons of the king saw the horse grazing in the netherworlds.
verses.wordMeaning: Digging the earth upto the netherworlds, the sons of the king saw the horse grazing in the netherworlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Digging the earth upto the netherworlds, the sons of the king saw the horse grazing in the netherworlds.

verses.sanskrit: कथं भवद्भिर्जीवद्भिर्विनष्टो वै दरात्मभिः । तुरगेण विना सत्यं नेहाग मनमस्ति वः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ bhavadbhirjīvadbhirvinaṣṭo vai darātmabhiḥ / turageṇa vinā satyaṃ nehāga manamasti vaḥ
verses.translation: Delighted very much they gathered together and laughed out of contentment. Some of them danced with great
verses.hindi: वृथा कलकलं कृत्वा न फलं यु द्धकर्मणा
verses.wordMeaning: Delighted very much they gathered together and laughed out of contentment. Some of them danced with great
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted very much they gathered together and laughed out of contentment. Some of them danced with great

verses.sanskrit: ततः समेत्य तस्मात्ते सप्रयाताः परस्परम् । ऊचुर्न दृश्यते ऽद्यापि तुरगः किं प्रकुमह
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sametya tasmātte saprayātāḥ parasparam / ūcurna dṛśyate 'dyāpi turagaḥ kiṃ prakumaha
verses.translation: The world became enveloped by the clusters of flames of fire and smoke whirling round and round on account of the angry (i.e. violent) blasts of wind that blew with a loud report. It became filled with the dusts of the earth too, that were blown up excessively. Hence, the world became too much afflicted.
verses.hindi: का स्वामिनी महाराज्ञी का वासौ दण्डनायिका ।
verses.wordMeaning: The world became enveloped by the clusters of flames of fire and smoke whirling round and round on account of the angry (i.e. violent) blasts of wind that blew with a loud report. It became filled with the dusts of the earth too, that were blown up excessively. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The world became enveloped by the clusters of flames of fire and smoke whirling round and round on account of the angry (i.e. violent) blasts of wind that blew with a loud report. It became filled with the dusts of the earth too, that were blown up excessively. Hence,…

verses.sanskrit: वसुधा विचितास्माभिः सशैलवनकानना । न चापि दृश्यते वाजी तद्वार्त्तापि न कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: vasudhā vicitāsmābhiḥ saśailavanakānanā / na cāpi dṛśyate vājī tadvārttāpi na kutracit
verses.translation: All round, the fire appeared to be scraping the firma- ment by means of its flames struck by the velocity of wind.
verses.hindi: का वा सा मन्त्रिणो श्यामा भृत्यत्वं नोऽथ कोहशम्
verses.wordMeaning: All round, the fire appeared to be scraping the firma- ment by means of its flames struck by the velocity of wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round, the fire appeared to be scraping the firma- ment by means of its flames struck by the velocity of wind.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादब्धेः समारभ्य पातालावधि मेदिनीम् । विभज्य रवात्वा पातालं विविशाम तुरङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādabdheḥ samārabhya pātālāvadhi medinīm / vibhajya ravātvā pātālaṃ viviśāma turaṅgamam
verses.translation: Even as all the worlds were watching, the fire of Kapila's anger reduced the Sagaras to ashes completely, sparing only the horse.
verses.wordMeaning: Even as all the worlds were watching, the fire of Kapila's anger reduced the Sagaras to ashes completely, sparing only the horse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as all the worlds were watching, the fire of Kapila's anger reduced the Sagaras to ashes completely, sparing only the horse.

verses.sanskrit: इति कृत्वा मतिं सर्वे सागराः क्रूरनिश्चयाः । निचख्नुर्भूमिमंबोधेस्तटा दारभ्य सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: iti kṛtvā matiṃ sarve sāgarāḥ krūraniścayāḥ / nicakhnurbhūmimaṃbodhestaṭā dārabhya sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Thus the sons of Sagara, of sinful mind, were burned suddenly on account of that fire of anger like the dry trees that get consumed in the forest conflagration.
verses.hindi: वनिता स्वाजिनीकृत्ये कि फलं मोक्ष्यते परम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sons of Sagara, of sinful mind, were burned suddenly on account of that fire of anger like the dry trees that get consumed in the forest conflagration.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sons of Sagara, of sinful mind, were burned suddenly on account of that fire of anger like the dry trees that get consumed in the forest conflagration.

verses.sanskrit: तैः खन्यमाना वसुधा ररास भृशविह्वला । चुक्रुशुश्चापि भूतानि दृष्ट्वा तेषां विचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: taiḥ khanyamānā vasudhā rarāsa bhṛśavihvalā / cukruśuścāpi bhūtāni dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ viceṣṭitam
verses.translation: On seeing the annihilation of those evil-minded Sagaras, the Devas spoke to one another in wonder, along with the Sages.
verses.hindi: युदो मृत्युभेवेदेव इति तत्र प्रमेव का
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the annihilation of those evil-minded Sagaras, the Devas spoke to one another in wonder, along with the Sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the annihilation of those evil-minded Sagaras, the Devas spoke to one another in wonder, along with the Sages.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते भारतं खण्डं खात्वा संक्षिब्य भूतले । भूमेर्योजनसाहस्रं योजयामासुरंबुधौ
verses.transliteration: tataste bhārataṃ khaṇḍaṃ khātvā saṃkṣibya bhūtale / bhūmeryojanasāhasraṃ yojayāmāsuraṃbudhau
verses.translation: They had caused anxiety and torture to all living beings. They were extremely censured by good men throughout their lives. Fortunately, they have met with their destruction.
verses.wordMeaning: They had caused anxiety and torture to all living beings. They were extremely censured by good men throughout their lives. Fortunately, they have met with their destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had caused anxiety and torture to all living beings. They were extremely censured by good men throughout their lives. Fortunately, they have met with their destruction.

verses.sanskrit: आपातालतलं ते तु खनन्तो मेदिनीतलम् । चरन्तमश्वं पाताले ददृशुर्नृपनन्दनाः
verses.transliteration: āpātālatalaṃ te tu khananto medinītalam / carantamaśvaṃ pātāle dadṛśurnṛpanandanāḥ
verses.translation: Which man can attain happiness in this world after committing an inauspicious action that is censured by the worlds and that causes harassment to others?
verses.hindi: उनको ऐसा सन्यास हो गया था कि उनके मनों में ये भाव उत्पन्न हो गये थे कि इन असुरों के मारने से कया कार्य होगा--यह शस्त्रास्त्रो का क्रम भी व्यथं है--जय को सिद्धि से भो क्या फल है । युद्ध में प्राणियों की हिंसा से पाप होगा ।४३। यट देवो के लिए क्या है इससे हमारा भी कया
verses.wordMeaning: Which man can attain happiness in this world after committing an inauspicious action that is censured by the worlds and that causes harassment to others?
verses.commentary: Sense: Which man can attain happiness in this world after committing an inauspicious action that is censured by the worlds and that causes harassment to others?

verses.sanskrit: संप्रहृष्टास्ततः सर्वे समेत्य च समन्ततः । संतोषाज्जहसुः केचिन्ननृतुश्च मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: saṃprahṛṣṭāstataḥ sarve sametya ca samantataḥ / saṃtoṣājjahasuḥ kecinnanṛtuśca mudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: These sinners had made all living beings cry aloud. They have now been struck dead by means of Brahmadanda (the punishing rod of a Biahmana). Hence, on account of their own evil actions, they have gone to hell where they will be spending many many years.
verses.hindi: होगा। कल-२ करना व्यय है और युद्ध के कर्म से कया फल होगा ।४४। कोन तो महाराज्ञी स्वामिनी है और यह दण्ड नायिका क्‍या है। वह मन्त्रिणी श्यामा क्या हैं और हमारा उनका केसा भृत्य होना है ।४५। यहाँ पर हेमे सबने जो भृत्य भूता है एक वनिता को स्वामिनी वना रक्‍्खा है । इससे क्या
verses.wordMeaning: These sinners had made all living beings cry aloud. They have now been struck dead by means of Brahmadanda (the punishing rod of a Biahmana). Hence, on account of their own evil actions, they have gone to hell where they will be spending many many years.
verses.commentary: Sense: These sinners had made all living beings cry aloud. They have now been struck dead by means of Brahmadanda (the punishing rod of a Biahmana). Hence, on account of their own evil actions, they have gone to hell where they will be spending many many years.

verses.sanskrit: ददृशुश्च महात्मानं कपिलं दीप्ततेजसम् । वृद्धं पद्मासनासीनं नासाग्रन्यस्तलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuśca mahātmānaṃ kapilaṃ dīptatejasam / vṛddhaṃ padmāsanāsīnaṃ nāsāgranyastalocanam
verses.translation: Hence, only good actions should be performed by intelligent persons. The other type of actions censured by the world should be cast off far away (i.e. completely avoided).
verses.hindi: परम मोन हागाय४६। दरों के वर्ना के नेशत करते वाले आयुधों को क्यो
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, only good actions should be performed by intelligent persons. The other type of actions censured by the world should be cast off far away (i.e. completely avoided).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, only good actions should be performed by intelligent persons. The other type of actions censured by the world should be cast off far away (i.e. completely avoided).

verses.sanskrit: ऋज्वायतशिरोग्रीवं पुरोविष्टब्धवक्षसम् । स्वतेजसाभिसरता परिबूर्णेन सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: ṛjvāyataśirogrīvaṃ puroviṣṭabdhavakṣasam / svatejasābhisaratā paribūrṇena sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Even as the leading Suras and sages were telling one another thus, the sons of Sagara perished after becoming the fuel to the fire of the anger of the sage.
verses.hindi: आवश्यक्ता है । यह युद्ध जो देश और शस्त्रो की क्षति करते वाला है. अब जास्त हो जाना चाहिए ।४७। और युद्ध में मरण होने बाला है तो हमारा जीबन भी बृषा हो है। युद्ध में तो मोत हो होगी वहां पर प्रमा ही कया है.
verses.wordMeaning: Even as the leading Suras and sages were telling one another thus, the sons of Sagara perished after becoming the fuel to the fire of the anger of the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the leading Suras and sages were telling one another thus, the sons of Sagara perished after becoming the fuel to the fire of the anger of the sage.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाश्यमानं परितो निवातस्थप्रदीपवत् । स्वान्तप्रकाशिताशेषविज्ञानमयविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: prakāśyamānaṃ parito nivātasthapradīpavat / svāntaprakāśitāśeṣavijñānamayavigraham
verses.translation: The sons of Sagara whose bodies were burnt down suddenly, (as if) paralysed the earth with their ashTes and instantaneously fell into hell due to their sinful deeds.
verses.hindi: आलस्य के तुल्य चित्त को विश्वान्ति देने वाला अन्य कोई भी.नहां है
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Sagara whose bodies were burnt down suddenly, (as if) paralysed the earth with their ashTes and instantaneously fell into hell due to their sinful deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Sagara whose bodies were burnt down suddenly, (as if) paralysed the earth with their ashTes and instantaneously fell into hell due to their sinful deeds.

verses.sanskrit: समाधिगतचित्तन्तु निभृतांभोधिसन्निभम् । आरूढयोगं विधिवद्ध्येयसंलीनमानसम्
verses.transliteration: samādhigatacittantu nibhṛtāṃbhodhisannibham / ārūḍhayogaṃ vidhivaddhyeyasaṃlīnamānasam
verses.translation: Afterburning those sons of Sagara entirely, the fire arising from his anger was on the point of burning all the worlds suddenly in a moment.
verses.hindi: एताहणीश्च नो ज्ञात्वा सा राज्ञी कि करिष्यति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Afterburning those sons of Sagara entirely, the fire arising from his anger was on the point of burning all the worlds suddenly in a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterburning those sons of Sagara entirely, the fire arising from his anger was on the point of burning all the worlds suddenly in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: च्दृदद्यत्दद्वड्ढ द्यदृ डद्धठ्ठण्थ्र्ठ्ठदड्डठ्ठ-थ्र्ठ्ठड्डण्न्र्ठ्ठडण्ठ्ठग्ठ्ठ योगीन्द्रप्रवरं शान्तं ज्वालामाल मिवानलम् । विलोक्य तत्र तिष्ठन्तं विमृशन्तः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: cdṛdadyatdadvaḍḍha dyadṛ ḍaddhaṭhṭhaṇthrṭhṭhadaḍḍaṭhṭha-thrṭhṭhaḍḍaṇnrṭhṭhaḍaṇṭhṭhagṭhṭha yogīndrapravaraṃ śāntaṃ jvālāmāla mivānalam / vilokya tatra tiṣṭhantaṃ vimṛśantaḥ parasparam
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.hindi: नष्टसत्त्वा च सा राजी कान्नः शिक्षां करिष्यति ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्त्तमिव ते राजन्साध्वसं परमं गताः । ततो ऽयमश्वहर्त्तेति सागरा कालचोदिताः
verses.transliteration: muhūrttamiva te rājansādhvasaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ / tato 'yamaśvahartteti sāgarā kālacoditāḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: परिवव्रुर्दुरात्मानः कपिलं मुनिसत्तमम् । ततस्तं परिवार्योचुश्वोरो ऽयं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: parivavrurdurātmānaḥ kapilaṃ munisattamam / tatastaṃ parivāryocuśvoro 'yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: अश्वहर्त्ता ततो ऽह्येष वध्यो ऽस्माभिर्दुराशयः । तं प्राकृतवदासीनं ते सर्वे हतवुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: aśvaharttā tato 'hyeṣa vadhyo 'smābhirdurāśayaḥ / taṃ prākṛtavadāsīnaṃ te sarve hatavuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.hindi: हमको ऐसी जानकर वह राज्ञी क्या करेगी । उसको राज्ञी बना देना भी तो हम ही सबने कल्पित किया है।४०। इस रीति मे हमारे द्वारा जब बह उपेक्षित होगी तो वह भी नष्ट बल बालीःःही हो जायगी । जन नष्ट बल बाली राज्ञो होगी तो फिर वह हमको क्या शिक्षा देगी ।५१॥ इसी:
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: आसन्नमरणाश्चक्रुर्धर्षितं मुनिमञ्जसा । जैमिनिरुवाच ततो मुनिरदीनात्मा ध्यानभङ्गप्रधर्षितः
verses.transliteration: āsannamaraṇāścakrurdharṣitaṃ munimañjasā / jaiminiruvāca tato muniradīnātmā dhyānabhaṅgapradharṣitaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
