verses.sanskrit: विक्रोश्य सर्वभूतानि संप्रयाताः स्वकर्मभिः । ब्रह्मदण्डहताः पापा निरयं शाश्वतीः समाः
verses.transliteration: vikrośya sarvabhūtāni saṃprayātāḥ svakarmabhiḥ / brahmadaṇḍahatāḥ pāpā nirayaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.hindi: यहाँ पर जो भी रूप प्राप्त हुआ है है महाराज्ञि! उसको बतलाइए । इतना कहकर वे दोनो दण्डिनी और मन्त्रिणो ने-स्वामिनी को प्रणाम किया था । ।६६। इसके अनन्तर इस ललिता देवी ने कामेश्वर के मुख की ओर अपनी दृष्टि डालो बी और बहुत हँसी थीं उनके अतोब रक्त रदावलि थी
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सदैव कर्त्तव्यं कर्म पुंसां मनीपिणाम् । दुरतश्च परित्याज्यमितरल्लोकनिन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsadaiva karttavyaṃ karma puṃsāṃ manīpiṇām / durataśca parityājyamitarallokaninditam
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.hindi: उनके स्मित की परभा के पुञ्ज वाले मुख में कुञ्जर की आकृति वाला-कोई
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: कर्त्तव्यः श्रेयसे यत्नो यावज्जीवं विजानता । नाचरेत्कस्यचिद्द्रोहमनित्यं जीवनं यतः
verses.transliteration: karttavyaḥ śreyase yatno yāvajjīvaṃ vijānatā / nācaretkasyaciddrohamanityaṃ jīvanaṃ yataḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: अनित्यो ऽयं सदा देहःसपदश्चातिचञ्चलाः । संसारश्चातिनिस्सारस्तत्कथं विश्वसेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: anityo 'yaṃ sadā dehaḥsapadaścāticañcalāḥ / saṃsāraścātinissārastatkathaṃ viśvasedbudhaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.hindi: दिखाई दिया था जिसके कम्मस्यल से मद चू रहा था ।६८। वह जपा पुष्प के समान पाटल्य था-शिर पर बालचन्द्र को धारण किये था और बीज-
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: एवं सुरमुनीन्द्रेषु कथयत्सु परस्परम् । मुनिक्रोधेन्धनीभूता विनेशुः सगरात्मजाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ suramunīndreṣu kathayatsu parasparam / munikrodhendhanībhūtā vineśuḥ sagarātmajāḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.hindi: कुश और रल्नकुम्भ--इनको दश करों में उद्वहन कर रहे ये
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: निर्दगधदेहाः सहसा भुवं विष्टभ्य भस्मना । अवापुर्निरयं सद्यः सागरास्ते स्वकमभिः
verses.transliteration: nirdagadhadehāḥ sahasā bhuvaṃ viṣṭabhya bhasmanā / avāpurnirayaṃ sadyaḥ sāgarāste svakamabhiḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: सागरांस्तानशेषेण दग्धवातत्क्रोधजो ऽनलः । क्षणेन लोकानखिलानुद्यतो दग्धुमञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: sāgarāṃstānaśeṣeṇa dagdhavātatkrodhajo 'nalaḥ / kṣaṇena lokānakhilānudyato dagdhumañjasā
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: भयभीतास्ततो देवाः समेत्य दिवि संस्थिताः । तुष्टुवुस्ते महात्मानं क्रोधाग्निशमनार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: bhayabhītāstato devāḥ sametya divi saṃsthitāḥ / tuṣṭuvuste mahātmānaṃ krodhāgniśamanārthinaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas who became frightened gathered together and stood by in the firmament. Being desirous of suppressing the fire of anger, they eulogised the noble-soulcd sage."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरचरितेसागराविनाशो नाम त्रिपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५३॥ जैमिनिरुवाच क्रोधाग्निमेनं विप्रेन्द्र सद्यः संहर्त्तुमर्हसि । नो चेदकाले लोको ऽयं सकलस्तेन दह्यते
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaracaritesāgarāvināśo nāma tripañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 53// jaiminiruvāca krodhāgnimenaṃ viprendra sadyaḥ saṃharttumarhasi / no cedakāle loko 'yaṃ sakalastena dahyate
verses.translation: "It behoves.you, O Leading Brahmana to restrain immediately this fire of anger. If not, the entire universe is likely to be burnt by it untimely.
verses.wordMeaning: "It behoves.you, O Leading Brahmana to restrain immediately this fire of anger. If not, the entire universe is likely to be burnt by it untimely.
verses.commentary: Sense: "It behoves.you, O Leading Brahmana to restrain immediately this fire of anger. If not, the entire universe is likely to be burnt by it untimely.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टस्ते महिमानेन व्याप्तमासीच्चराचरम् । क्षमस्व संहर क्रोधं नमस्ते विप्रपुङ्गव
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaste mahimānena vyāptamāsīccarācaram / kṣamasva saṃhara krodhaṃ namaste viprapuṅgava
verses.translation: Your greatness has been seen. The whole world including the mobile and the immobile beings has been per- vaded by this fire of your anger. Forbear, please restrain this anger, O leading Brahmana. Obeisance to you."
verses.hindi: उनका पेट बड़ा था--चन्द्र चूड़ा में या और वे मन्द तया वृ हित ध्वनि वाले थे । वे सिद्धि लक्ष्मी से समाश्चिष्ट थे । उनने आकर महेश्वरो को प्रणाम किया था ।७१। देवी ने उनको आशीर्वाद दिया था, वह महान गणनाथ गजानन थे और वे जयविध्त महा यन्त्र का भेदन करने के लिए वेग
verses.wordMeaning: Your greatness has been seen. The whole world including the mobile and the immobile beings has been per- vaded by this fire of your anger. Forbear, please restrain this anger, O leading Brahmana. Obeisance to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: Your greatness has been seen. The whole world including the mobile and the immobile beings has been per- vaded by this fire of your anger. Forbear, please restrain this anger, O leading Brahmana. Obeisance to you."

verses.sanskrit: एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु भगवान्कपिलो मुनिः । तूर्णमेव क्षयं निन्ये क्रोधाग्निमतिभैरवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu bhagavānkapilo muniḥ / tūrṇameva kṣayaṃ ninye krodhāgnimatibhairavam
verses.translation: On being eulogised thus, the saintly lord Kapila, immediately controlled the extremely terrible fire of anger.
verses.hindi: के साथ निकलकर चले गये ये ।3२। शाल के अन्दर ही अमहन्ता बलानन ने चुपचाप कहीं पर लगा हुआ जयविश्त यन्त्र को देखा था ॥७३। उस देव ने घोर निर्षातों वाले कोर दुस्सह दाँतों के पातनों से एक ही क्षण में उस जयविष्न महाशिला का चूर्ण कर दिया था ।७४। उन्होंने उसमें स्थित देव-
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogised thus, the saintly lord Kapila, immediately controlled the extremely terrible fire of anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogised thus, the saintly lord Kapila, immediately controlled the extremely terrible fire of anger.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रशान्तमभवज्जगत्सर्वं चराचरम् । देवास्तपस्विनश्चैव बभूवुर्विगतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praśāntamabhavajjagatsarvaṃ carācaram / devāstapasvinaścaiva babhūvurvigatajvarāḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, the entire universe including the mobile and the immobile beings became calm. Devas and the ascetics became free from distress.
verses.hindi: ताओं के साथ हो जो बड़े दुष्ट थे सबका चूरा करके उस यन्त्र को दिवलोक में फेंक दिया था ।७५॥ इसके किलकिल की ध्वनि करके सब शक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the entire universe including the mobile and the immobile beings became calm. Devas and the ascetics became free from distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the entire universe including the mobile and the immobile beings became calm. Devas and the ascetics became free from distress.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवान्नारदो मुनिः । अयोध्या मगमद्राजन्देवलोकाद्यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu bhagavānnārado muniḥ / ayodhyā magamadrājandevalokādyadṛcchayā
verses.translation: In the meantime, the saintly lord Narada, O King, casually went to Ayodhya from the Devaloka (the world of the Dcvas).
verses.hindi: आलस्य रहित होगयीं थीं और शस्त्र हाथों में लेकर युद्ध करने के लिए उद्यत हो गयी थीं ।७३। उस दन्ति वदन ने जिनके कलित कण्ठ की ध्वनि हो रही थी एक जप यन्त्र का सृजन किया था ओर रात्रि में विनाश कर दिया था जो बाधक था
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, the saintly lord Narada, O King, casually went to Ayodhya from the Devaloka (the world of the Dcvas).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, the saintly lord Narada, O King, casually went to Ayodhya from the Devaloka (the world of the Dcvas).

verses.sanskrit: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नारदं सगरस्तदा । अर्घ्यपाद्यादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयामास शास्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: tamāgatamabhiprekṣya nāradaṃ sagarastadā / arghyapādyādibhiḥ samyakpūjayāmāsa śāstrataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that Narada had arrived, Sagara worship- ped him perfectly in accordance with the injunctions of the scriptures, with Arghya, Padya and other materials of worship.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that Narada had arrived, Sagara worship- ped him perfectly in accordance with the injunctions of the scriptures, with Arghya, Padya and other materials of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Narada had arrived, Sagara worship- ped him perfectly in accordance with the injunctions of the scriptures, with Arghya, Padya and other materials of worship.

verses.sanskrit: परिगृह्य च तत्पूजामासीनः परमासने । नारदो राजशार्दूलमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: parigṛhya ca tatpūjāmāsīnaḥ paramāsane / nārado rājaśārdūlamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Accepting that honour and worship, Narada sat on the exalted seat and spoke these words, O King, to Sagara the tiger among kings.
verses.wordMeaning: Accepting that honour and worship, Narada sat on the exalted seat and spoke these words, O King, to Sagara the tiger among kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accepting that honour and worship, Narada sat on the exalted seat and spoke these words, O King, to Sagara the tiger among kings.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच हयसंचारणार्थाय संप्रयातास्तवात्मजाः । ब्रह्मदण्डहताः सर्वे विनष्टा नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca hayasaṃcāraṇārthāya saṃprayātāstavātmajāḥ / brahmadaṇḍahatāḥ sarve vinaṣṭā nṛpasattama
verses.translation: "Your sons who had gone to take horse around the world, O excellent king, have been struck down by the curse of a Brahrnana. All of them have perished.
verses.wordMeaning: "Your sons who had gone to take horse around the world, O excellent king, have been struck down by the curse of a Brahrnana. All of them have perished.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Your sons who had gone to take horse around the world, O excellent king, have been struck down by the curse of a Brahrnana. All of them have perished.

verses.sanskrit: संरक्ष्यमाणस्तैः सर्वैर्हयस्ते यज्ञियो नृप । केनाप्य लक्षितः क्वापि नीतो विधिवशाद्दिवि
verses.transliteration: saṃrakṣyamāṇastaiḥ sarvairhayaste yajñiyo nṛpa / kenāpya lakṣitaḥ kvāpi nīto vidhivaśāddivi
verses.translation: They began to search for the lost horse all over the earth. For a long time, O king, they did not get any information of its whereabouts.
verses.wordMeaning: They began to search for the lost horse all over the earth. For a long time, O king, they did not get any information of its whereabouts.
verses.commentary: Sense: They began to search for the lost horse all over the earth. For a long time, O king, they did not get any information of its whereabouts.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विनष्टं तुरगं विचिन्वन्तो महीतले । प्रालभन्त न ते क्वापि तत्प्रवृत्तिं चिरान्नृप
verses.transliteration: tato vinaṣṭaṃ turagaṃ vicinvanto mahītale / prālabhanta na te kvāpi tatpravṛttiṃ cirānnṛpa
verses.translation: Thereupon, they decided to search for the horse underneath the earth. Beginning earnestly, those Sagaras dug up the surface of the earth.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, they decided to search for the horse underneath the earth. Beginning earnestly, those Sagaras dug up the surface of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, they decided to search for the horse underneath the earth. Beginning earnestly, those Sagaras dug up the surface of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽवनेरधस्ते ऽश्वं विचेतुं कृतनिश्चयाः । सागरास्ते समारभ्य प्रचख्नुर्वसुधातलम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'vaneradhaste 'śvaṃ vicetuṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ / sāgarāste samārabhya pracakhnurvasudhātalam
verses.translation: While digging the earth, O King, they saw the horse in Patala (Nethcrworlds) and near it they saw the great sage Kapila, the leading Yogin.
verses.wordMeaning: While digging the earth, O King, they saw the horse in Patala (Nethcrworlds) and near it they saw the great sage Kapila, the leading Yogin.
verses.commentary: Sense: While digging the earth, O King, they saw the horse in Patala (Nethcrworlds) and near it they saw the great sage Kapila, the leading Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: खनन्तो वसुधा मश्वं पाताले ददृशुर्नृप । समीपे तस्य योगीन्द्रं कपिलं चमहामुनिम्
verses.transliteration: khananto vasudhā maśvaṃ pātāle dadṛśurnṛpa / samīpe tasya yogīndraṃ kapilaṃ camahāmunim
verses.translation: On seeing him, they committed a sinful deed. All of them being urged by Kala (God* of death), saying — "This is the robber of the horse", they made Kapila sufficiently infuriated.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, they committed a sinful deed. All of them being urged by Kala (God* of death), saying — "This is the robber of the horse", they made Kapila sufficiently infuriated.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, they committed a sinful deed. All of them being urged by Kala (God* of death), saying — "This is the robber of the horse", they made Kapila sufficiently infuriated.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पापकर्माणस्ते सर्वे कालचोदिताः । कपिलं कोपयामासुरश्वहर्त्तायमित्यलम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpakarmāṇaste sarve kālacoditāḥ / kapilaṃ kopayāmāsuraśvaharttāyamityalam
verses.translation: Thereupon, your sons perished with their bodies as fuel to the fire emanating from his eyes and caused by his anger, the fire that burned the quarters.
verses.hindi: इस वृत्तान्त को श्रवण करके भण्ड को बड़ा भारी क्षोभ हुआ था कि जिसने (गणपति ने) अपने ही समान बहुत से दम्तावलातनों का सृजन किया 'घा।७८। उनके कटस्थल से मद निकल रहा था और उसकी गन्ध से बञ्चल श्रमरों के समूह आगे मंडरा रहे ये जो गान सा हो रहा था ।७६। उनकी
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, your sons perished with their bodies as fuel to the fire emanating from his eyes and caused by his anger, the fire that burned the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, your sons perished with their bodies as fuel to the fire emanating from his eyes and caused by his anger, the fire that burned the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्क्रोधसंभूतनेत्राग्नेर्दहतो दिशः । इन्धनीभूतदेहास्ते पुत्राः संक्षयमागताः
verses.transliteration: tatastatkrodhasaṃbhūtanetrāgnerdahato diśaḥ / indhanībhūtadehāste putrāḥ saṃkṣayamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: You need not grieve over them. It does not behove you to grieve over them, O leading King, because they were cruel, of sinful conduct and were creating troubles and impedi- ments to all people.
verses.hindi: कान्ति स्फुरित दड़िम के किजल्क के विक्षेपकर रोचि वाले थे जो सदा ही अनेक सागरों को एक ही बार में पान करने के लिए उद्यत थे।८०। उनमें आमोद प्रमुख था और ऋद्धि जिनमें मुख्य थी ऐसी शक्तियों के द्वारा सेवित ये । ये छे विष्त नायक हैं और सात करोड़ संख्या वासे हेरम्बों के अधीश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: You need not grieve over them. It does not behove you to grieve over them, O leading King, because they were cruel, of sinful conduct and were creating troubles and impedi- ments to all people.
verses.commentary: Sense: You need not grieve over them. It does not behove you to grieve over them, O leading King, because they were cruel, of sinful conduct and were creating troubles and impedi- ments to all people.

verses.sanskrit: क्रूराः पापसमाचाराः सर्वलोकोपरोधकाः । यतस्ते तेन राजेन्द्र न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: krūrāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ sarvalokoparodhakāḥ / yataste tena rājendra na śokaṃ kartumarhasi
verses.translation: Retain your courage as your asset, as the occurrence
verses.hindi: थे। इनके नाम--आमोद--प्रमोद--सुमुख--दुमु ख--अरिष्न ओर बिघ्त कर्त्ता ये ये ।६१-८२। ये सब उन महा गणपति के युद्ध में आगे चल दिये ये।
verses.wordMeaning: Retain your courage as your asset, as the occurrence
verses.commentary: Sense: Retain your courage as your asset, as the occurrence

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं धैर्यधनो भूत्वा भवित व्यतयात्मनः । नष्टं मृतमतीतं च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṃ dhairyadhano bhūtvā bhavita vyatayātmanaḥ / naṣṭaṃ mṛtamatītaṃ ca nānuśocanti paṇḍitāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent king, entrust this boy Amsuman, your grandson of great intellect, with the mission of fetching the horse back."
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O excellent king, entrust this boy Amsuman, your grandson of great intellect, with the mission of fetching the horse back."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O excellent king, entrust this boy Amsuman, your grandson of great intellect, with the mission of fetching the horse back."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पौत्रमिमं बालमंशुमन्तं महामतिम् । तुरगानयनार्थाय नियुङ्क्ष्व नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tasmātpautramimaṃ bālamaṃśumantaṃ mahāmatim / turagānayanārthāya niyuṅkṣva nṛpasattama
verses.translation: After saying this to Sagara, the tiger among kings who was accompanied by the members of the holy assembly and the sacrificial priests, sage Narad a vanished in a trice even as they were watching.
verses.hindi: उस अग्मि प्राकार के वलय से गजानन निकलकर चले थे ।८३। उनके क्रोध पूर्ण हुक्लार से वे परम तुमुल ये और ये सब दानवों के समीप में प्राप्त हो गये थे । फिरे इनकी बड़ी प्रचण्ड फूत्कार शी जिससे विब्टपों को भी वहि- राकर दिया था ८४
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this to Sagara, the tiger among kings who was accompanied by the members of the holy assembly and the sacrificial priests, sage Narad a vanished in a trice even as they were watching.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to Sagara, the tiger among kings who was accompanied by the members of the holy assembly and the sacrificial priests, sage Narad a vanished in a trice even as they were watching.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यक्त्वा राजशार्दूलं सदस्यर्त्विक्समन्वितम् । क्षणेन पश्यतां तेषां नारदो ऽन्तर्दधे मुनिः
verses.transliteration: ityaktvā rājaśārdūlaṃ sadasyartviksamanvitam / kṣaṇena paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ nārado 'ntardadhe muniḥ
verses.translation: On hearing those words of Narada, the excellent king of exalted intellect became afflicted with misery and grief. He remained engrossed in thought for a long time.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words of Narada, the excellent king of exalted intellect became afflicted with misery and grief. He remained engrossed in thought for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of Narada, the excellent king of exalted intellect became afflicted with misery and grief. He remained engrossed in thought for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रत्वा वचन तस्य नारदस्य नृपोत्तमः । दुःखशोकपरातात्मा दध्यौ चिरमुदारधीः
verses.transliteration: tacchratvā vacana tasya nāradasya nṛpottamaḥ / duḥkhaśokaparātātmā dadhyau ciramudāradhīḥ
verses.translation: As he sat in the assembly, pondering over his fate, with his head bent down, Vasistha who was conversant with what should be done at the proper time and place, said to the king consoling him.
verses.wordMeaning: As he sat in the assembly, pondering over his fate, with his head bent down, Vasistha who was conversant with what should be done at the proper time and place, said to the king consoling him.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he sat in the assembly, pondering over his fate, with his head bent down, Vasistha who was conversant with what should be done at the proper time and place, said to the king consoling him.

verses.sanskrit: तं ध्यानयुक्तं सदसि समासीनमवाङ्मुखम् । वसिष्ठः प्राह राजानं सांत्वयन्देशकालवित्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dhyānayuktaṃ sadasi samāsīnamavāṅmukham / vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha rājānaṃ sāṃtvayandeśakālavit
verses.translation: "What is this? If grief were to find place in the heart of courageous people like you, its benefit has not been attained by courage (i.e. courage has become futile).
verses.wordMeaning: "What is this? If grief were to find place in the heart of courageous people like you, its benefit has not been attained by courage (i.e. courage has become futile).
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is this? If grief were to find place in the heart of courageous people like you, its benefit has not been attained by courage (i.e. courage has become futile).

verses.sanskrit: किमिदं धैर्यसाराणामवकाशं भवदृशाम् । लभते हृदि चेच्छोकः प्राप्तं धीर तया फलम्
verses.transliteration: kimidaṃ dhairyasārāṇāmavakāśaṃ bhavadṛśām / labhate hṛdi cecchokaḥ prāptaṃ dhīra tayā phalam
verses.translation: Give up dejection in your mind. Consider that every thing follows the dictates of destiny. Thus it undoubtedly behoves you to carry out the subsequent duties."
verses.wordMeaning: Give up dejection in your mind. Consider that every thing follows the dictates of destiny. Thus it undoubtedly behoves you to carry out the subsequent duties."
verses.commentary: Sense: Give up dejection in your mind. Consider that every thing follows the dictates of destiny. Thus it undoubtedly behoves you to carry out the subsequent duties."

verses.sanskrit: दौर्मनस्यं शिथिलयन्सर्वं दिष्टवशानुगम् । मन्वानो ऽनन्तरं कृत्यं कर्तुमर्हस्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: daurmanasyaṃ śithilayansarvaṃ diṣṭavaśānugam / manvāno 'nantaraṃ kṛtyaṃ kartumarhasyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: On being advised thus by Vasistha, the king who knew the true essential nature of objectives and duties on hand, regained his inherent vitality and fortitude. And he replied — "So be it".
verses.wordMeaning: On being advised thus by Vasistha, the king who knew the true essential nature of objectives and duties on hand, regained his inherent vitality and fortitude. And he replied — "So be it".
verses.commentary: Sense: On being advised thus by Vasistha, the king who knew the true essential nature of objectives and duties on hand, regained his inherent vitality and fortitude. And he replied — "So be it".

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठेनैवमुक्तस्तु राजा कार्यार्थतत्त्ववित् । धृतिं सत्त्वं समालंब्य तथेति प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhenaivamuktastu rājā kāryārthatattvavit / dhṛtiṃ sattvaṃ samālaṃbya tatheti pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: He called his grandson Amsuman who had been habitually modest and slowly spoke to him thus, in the assem- bly of Brahmanas and Ksattriyas.
verses.wordMeaning: He called his grandson Amsuman who had been habitually modest and slowly spoke to him thus, in the assem- bly of Brahmanas and Ksattriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He called his grandson Amsuman who had been habitually modest and slowly spoke to him thus, in the assem- bly of Brahmanas and Ksattriyas.

verses.sanskrit: अंशुमन्तं समाहूय पौत्रं विनयशालिनम् । ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रसभामध्ये शनैरिदमभाषत
verses.transliteration: aṃśumantaṃ samāhūya pautraṃ vinayaśālinam / brahmakṣattrasabhāmadhye śanairidamabhāṣata
verses.translation: ''Dear child, all of your uncles have been struck down by the curse of a Brahmana. Having committed sinful deeds j they have fallen into hell to remain there for many many years.
verses.wordMeaning: ''Dear child, all of your uncles have been struck down by the curse of a Brahmana. Having committed sinful deeds j they have fallen into hell to remain there for many many years.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''Dear child, all of your uncles have been struck down by the curse of a Brahmana. Having committed sinful deeds j they have fallen into hell to remain there for many many years.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदण्डहताः सर्वे पितरस्तव पुत्रक । पतिताः पापकर्माणो निरये शाश्वतीः समाः
verses.transliteration: brahmadaṇḍahatāḥ sarve pitarastava putraka / patitāḥ pāpakarmāṇo niraye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
verses.translation: You alone are the child, a perpetuator of my line. You alone are the protector of this kingdom. My welfare both, here and hereafter is solely and wholly dependent upon you.
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are the child, a perpetuator of my line. You alone are the protector of this kingdom. My welfare both, here and hereafter is solely and wholly dependent upon you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are the child, a perpetuator of my line. You alone are the protector of this kingdom. My welfare both, here and hereafter is solely and wholly dependent upon you.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव संततिर्मह्यं राज्यस्यास्य च रक्षिता । त्वदायत्तमशेषं मे श्रेयो ऽमुत्र परत्र च
verses.transliteration: tvameva saṃtatirmahyaṃ rājyasyāsya ca rakṣitā / tvadāyattamaśeṣaṃ me śreyo 'mutra paratra ca
verses.translation: Hence, you go, at my behest, to the proximity of Kapila at Patala. Take up the great responsibility of fetching back the sacrificial horse. Try strenuously for the same.
verses.hindi: गण चक्र की सेना का समुदाय हैत्यों की सेना में कूद पड़ा था । उन गणनाथ ने अपने तीक्ष्ण बाणों से दानवों को छेद दिया 'था।८५। उस गण- नाथ का महान ओज वाले विशुक् के साथ बड़ा भीषण युद्ध हुआ था जिसमें बहुत उद्धत हुद्धारे हो रहो थीं ओर धनुषों की टंकार की ध्वनि भी थी।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you go, at my behest, to the proximity of Kapila at Patala. Take up the great responsibility of fetching back the sacrificial horse. Try strenuously for the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go, at my behest, to the proximity of Kapila at Patala. Take up the great responsibility of fetching back the sacrificial horse. Try strenuously for the same.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं गच्छ ममादेशात्पाताले कपिलान्तिकम् । तुरगानयनार्थाय यत्नेन महातान्वितः
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṃ gaccha mamādeśātpātāle kapilāntikam / turagānayanārthāya yatnena mahātānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Request him duly. Particularly, take great care to make him pleased. It behoves you, dear one, to return quickly, taking the horse with you".
verses.hindi: बणं के थे । ऐसे उसते गणनाथ के साथ युद्ध किया था ।८७। शस्त्रो के घट्टन के शब्दों से और असुरों की हुद्छारो से तथा हैत्यों की सप्तति की खुरों की कोडा से कुदालियो के कूट घोषों से दिशाए' क्षुब्ध हो रही थीं।
verses.wordMeaning: Request him duly. Particularly, take great care to make him pleased. It behoves you, dear one, to return quickly, taking the horse with you".
verses.commentary: Sense: Request him duly. Particularly, take great care to make him pleased. It behoves you, dear one, to return quickly, taking the horse with you".

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रार्थयित्वा विधिवत्प्रसाद्य च विशेषतः । आदाय तुरगं वत्स शीघ्रमागन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: taṃ prārthayitvā vidhivatprasādya ca viśeṣataḥ / ādāya turagaṃ vatsa śīghramāgantumarhasi
verses.translation: "On being instructed thus by him, Amsuman bowed down to the father of his father and said — "So be it." The highly intelligent boy set off to the proximity of Kapila.
verses.hindi: हिनाने से और रथों के पहियों की ध्वनियों से भो सव दिश'ए? कॉपने लगी थीं ।८३। बनुषों की डोरी की ध्वनियां तथा चक् के चोत्कारे भी उस समय
verses.wordMeaning: "On being instructed thus by him, Amsuman bowed down to the father of his father and said — "So be it." The highly intelligent boy set off to the proximity of Kapila.
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being instructed thus by him, Amsuman bowed down to the father of his father and said — "So be it." The highly intelligent boy set off to the proximity of Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच एवमुक्त्ॐऽशुमांस्तेन प्रणम्य पितरं पितुः । तथेत्युक्त्वा महाबुद्धिः प्रययौ कपिलान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca evamuktoṃ'śumāṃstena praṇamya pitaraṃ pituḥ / tathetyuktvā mahābuddhiḥ prayayau kapilāntikam
verses.translation: He approached the sage duly. He bowed down to him in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras as well as his own mind. Bending down in humility, he spoke thus slowly:
verses.hindi: में हो रही थीं ।९०। बीरों के वचन समूद्दों से तथा शरों के सातकारों के चोष एवं महेन्द्रं के अट्टहास ओर अधिकांश मे सिहनाद भी हो रहे ये
verses.wordMeaning: He approached the sage duly. He bowed down to him in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras as well as his own mind. Bending down in humility, he spoke thus slowly:
verses.commentary: Sense: He approached the sage duly. He bowed down to him in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras as well as his own mind. Bending down in humility, he spoke thus slowly:

verses.sanskrit: तमुपागम्य विधिवन्नमस्कृत्य यथामति । प्रश्रयावनतो भूत्वा शनैरिदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: tamupāgamya vidhivannamaskṛtya yathāmati / praśrayāvanato bhūtvā śanairidamuvāca ha
verses.translation: "Be pleased, O great among Brahmanas. I seek refuge in you. Restrain immediately your anger that has caused destruction of the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: "Be pleased, O great among Brahmanas. I seek refuge in you. Restrain immediately your anger that has caused destruction of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Be pleased, O great among Brahmanas. I seek refuge in you. Restrain immediately your anger that has caused destruction of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद विप्रशार्दूल त्वामहं शरणं गतः । कोपं च संहर क्षिप्रं लोकप्रक्षयकारकम्
verses.transliteration: prasīda vipraśārdūla tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / kopaṃ ca saṃhara kṣipraṃ lokaprakṣayakārakam
verses.translation: If you are furious, the entire universe will meet with destruction. Be pleased to calm down quickly. Let all the worlds be rid of pain and misery.
verses.wordMeaning: If you are furious, the entire universe will meet with destruction. Be pleased to calm down quickly. Let all the worlds be rid of pain and misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you are furious, the entire universe will meet with destruction. Be pleased to calm down quickly. Let all the worlds be rid of pain and misery.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि क्रुद्धे जगत्सर्वं प्रणाशमुपयास्यति । प्रशान्तिमुपयाह्याशुलोकाः संतु गतव्यथाः
verses.transliteration: tvayi kruddhe jagatsarvaṃ praṇāśamupayāsyati / praśāntimupayāhyāśulokāḥ saṃtu gatavyathāḥ
verses.translation: Be pleased with us, O highly fortunate and exalted one. Look at us witli gentle eyes. Know me to be the child in the family of those who have been completely burned down by the fire of your anger.
verses.wordMeaning: Be pleased with us, O highly fortunate and exalted one. Look at us witli gentle eyes. Know me to be the child in the family of those who have been completely burned down by the fire of your anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased with us, O highly fortunate and exalted one. Look at us witli gentle eyes. Know me to be the child in the family of those who have been completely burned down by the fire of your anger.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नो ऽस्मान्महाभाग पश्य सौम्येन चक्षुषा । ये त्वत्क्रोधाग्निनिर्दग्धास्तत्संततिमवेहि माम्
verses.transliteration: prasanno 'smānmahābhāga paśya saumyena cakṣuṣā / ye tvatkrodhāgninirdagdhāstatsaṃtatimavehi mām
verses.translation: My name is Amsuman and I am the grandson of king Sagara. I have come here at his behest as well as with a desire to gain your favour, and* also to take back the horse if you are pleased to return it."
verses.wordMeaning: My name is Amsuman and I am the grandson of king Sagara. I have come here at his behest as well as with a desire to gain your favour, and* also to take back the horse if you are pleased to return it."
verses.commentary: Sense: My name is Amsuman and I am the grandson of king Sagara. I have come here at his behest as well as with a desire to gain your favour, and* also to take back the horse if you are pleased to return it."

verses.sanskrit: नाम्नांशुमन्तं नप्तारं सगरस्य महीपतेः । सो ऽहं तस्य नियोगेन त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: nāmnāṃśumantaṃ naptāraṃ sagarasya mahīpateḥ / so 'haṃ tasya niyogena tvatprasādābhikāṅkṣayā
verses.translation: Hence, be pleased to tell me the means of getting them a place in heaven. Please tell me the ways and means whereby they can be redeemed from the adverse effects of the fire of your anger."
verses.hindi: उस समय में सब दिशाओं में बड़ा क्षोभ छागया था ऐसा बह उद्धत
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, be pleased to tell me the means of getting them a place in heaven. Please tell me the ways and means whereby they can be redeemed from the adverse effects of the fire of your anger."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, be pleased to tell me the means of getting them a place in heaven. Please tell me the ways and means whereby they can be redeemed from the adverse effects of the fire of your anger."

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तो दास्यसि चेद्ब्रह्मंस्तुरगानयनाय च । जैमिनिरुवाच इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा योगीन्द्रप्रवरो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: prāpto dāsyasi cedbrahmaṃsturagānayanāya ca / jaiminiruvāca iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yogīndrapravaro muniḥ
verses.translation: At the end of that period, O dear one, a highly intelligent grandson will be born to you. He will be known by the name of king Bhagiratha. He will be conversant with the principles of Dharma and Artha.
verses.hindi: युद्ध हुआ था । उस दुरात्मा की जो तीस अक्षोहिणी सेना थी । उसमें प्रत्येक से महारथी गणनाथों ने युद्ध किया या । वे दातों से ममो का भेदन कर रहे थे और सू'ड़ से उनका वेष्टन कर रहे ये ।६२-६३। पुष्करावत्त क के समान कानों के तालों से क्रोध करते हुए ओर पुरुष नाक के श्वासों से पताकिनी
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of that period, O dear one, a highly intelligent grandson will be born to you. He will be known by the name of king Bhagiratha. He will be conversant with the principles of Dharma and Artha.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of that period, O dear one, a highly intelligent grandson will be born to you. He will be known by the name of king Bhagiratha. He will be conversant with the principles of Dharma and Artha.

verses.sanskrit: अंशुमन्तं समालोक्य प्रसन्न इदमब्रवीत् । स्वागतं भवतो वत्स दिष्ट्या च त्वमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: aṃśumantaṃ samālokya prasanna idamabravīt / svāgataṃ bhavato vatsa diṣṭyā ca tvamihāgataḥ
verses.translation: Prompted by his reverence to his ancestors, he will put forth great efforts. He will perform a great steady penance and bring Ganga from heaven.
verses.hindi: के अन्दर विक्षेप डालते हुए--पर्वंत के वप्रके तुल्य उर: स्थलों से मदेन करते हुए--पेरों के घात से पोसते हुए--तवा पोन (स्थूल) दरों से हतन करते हुए--शूल से विभेदन करते हुए ओर चको के पातन से काटते हुए और महान शंखों की ध्वनि से सेना को आस देते हुए ऐसे गणनाथ के मुख
verses.wordMeaning: Prompted by his reverence to his ancestors, he will put forth great efforts. He will perform a great steady penance and bring Ganga from heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prompted by his reverence to his ancestors, he will put forth great efforts. He will perform a great steady penance and bring Ganga from heaven.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ शीघ्रं हयश्चायं नीयतां सगरान्तिकम् । अधिक्षिप्तो ऽस्य यज्ञो ऽपि प्रागतः संप्रवर्त्तताम्
verses.transliteration: gaccha śīghraṃ hayaścāyaṃ nīyatāṃ sagarāntikam / adhikṣipto 'sya yajño 'pi prāgataḥ saṃpravarttatām
verses.translation: All your ancestors will attain heavenly goal, when the ashes of their limbs and bones are sanctified by its waters.
verses.hindi: से उत्पन्न महत्रों हो गजबदन वहाँ पर विद्यमान ये। मद से उद्धत उन गों के समान मुख वालों ने उस सेना को सम्पूर्ण को धूल में मिला दिया था ॥९४-९७ इसके अनन्तर अपनी सेना के अग्रणी ने क्रोध में समाविष्ट होकर फिर इसने देव के गजासुर को भेजा था (८
verses.wordMeaning: All your ancestors will attain heavenly goal, when the ashes of their limbs and bones are sanctified by its waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: All your ancestors will attain heavenly goal, when the ashes of their limbs and bones are sanctified by its waters.

verses.sanskrit: व्रियतां च वरो मत्तस्त्वया यस्ते मनोगतः । दास्ये सुदुर्लभमपि त्वद्भक्तिपरितोषितः
verses.transliteration: vriyatāṃ ca varo mattastvayā yaste manogataḥ / dāsye sudurlabhamapi tvadbhaktiparitoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: If the ashes of bones, hairs and nails ofany embodied being are flooded with its waters, it will go to the heavenly world from even hell and remain there permanently.
verses.wordMeaning: If the ashes of bones, hairs and nails ofany embodied being are flooded with its waters, it will go to the heavenly world from even hell and remain there permanently.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the ashes of bones, hairs and nails ofany embodied being are flooded with its waters, it will go to the heavenly world from even hell and remain there permanently.

verses.sanskrit: एषां तु संप्रमाशं हि गत्वा वद पितामहम् । पापानां मरणं त्वेषां न च शोचितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: eṣāṃ tu saṃpramāśaṃ hi gatvā vada pitāmaham / pāpānāṃ maraṇaṃ tveṣāṃ na ca śocitumarhasi
verses.translation: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇāmya cogīndramaṃśumānidamabravīt / varaṃ dadāsi cenmahyaṃ varaye tvāṃ mahāmune

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.sanskrit: वरमर्हामि चेत्त्वत्तः प्रसन्नो दातुमर्हसि । त्वद्रोषपावकप्लुष्टाः पितरो ये ममाखिलाः
verses.transliteration: varamarhāmi cettvattaḥ prasanno dātumarhasi / tvadroṣapāvakapluṣṭāḥ pitaro ye mamākhilāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.transliteration: saṃprayāsyanti te brahmannirayaṃ śāsvatīḥ samāḥ / brahmadaṇḍahatānāṃ tu na hi piṇḍodakakriyāḥ

verses.hindi: कालरात्रिश्च द॑ त्यानां सा रात्रिविरतिं गता ।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डोदकविहीनानामिह लोके महामुने । विद्यते पितृसालोक्यं न खलु श्रुतिचोदितम्
verses.transliteration: piṇḍodakavihīnānāmiha loke mahāmune / vidyate pitṛsālokyaṃ na khalu śruticoditam
verses.translation: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.hindi: उस गणेश्वर ने प्रचण्ड सिंहनाद वाले दुष्टमति सात अक्षोहिणियों से

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयः स्वर्गवासो ऽस्तु तेषां तु त्वत्प्रसादतः । वरेणानेन भगवन्कृतकृत्यो भावाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: akṣayaḥ svargavāso 'stu teṣāṃ tu tvatprasādataḥ / vareṇānena bhagavankṛtakṛtyo bhāvāmyaham
verses.translation: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.hindi: संयुत गजदंत्य के साथ युद्ध किया था ।९६। उस गजासुर की भुजाओं के बल को क्षीण होता हुआ देखकर और उसके बलवीयें को बढ़ा हुआ देखकर यहाँ से विशुक्र भाग गया था ।१००। मूषक का बाहन बाला वह एक ही वीरेन्द्र प्रचलन करता हुआ सातों अक्षौहिणी सेनाओं से युक्त उस गजासुर
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रसीद त्वमेवैषां स्वर्गतेर्वद कारणम् । येनोद्धारणमेतेषां वह्नेः कोपस्य वै भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatprasīda tvamevaiṣāṃ svargatervada kāraṇam / yenoddhāraṇameteṣāṃ vahneḥ kopasya vai bhavet
verses.translation: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.hindi: को मर्दन करने वाला होगया था ।१०१। उस गजासुर के मरने पर और विशुक् के भाग जाने पर वह महा गणपति युद्ध स्थल से ललिता देवी के समीप में उपस्थित हो गये थे ।१०२। और देत्यों की कालरात्रि वह रात समाप्त हो गयी थी । ललिता इस महा गणपति के पराकूम से बहुत ही
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तमाह योगीन्द्रःसुप्रसन्नेन चेतसा । निरयोद्धारणं तेषां त्वया वत्स न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: tatastamāha yogīndraḥsuprasannena cetasā / nirayoddhāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ tvayā vatsa na śakyate
verses.translation: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न होगयी थी ।१०३। परम प्रसन्न उस महाराज्ञी ने गणेशजी की अर्चना समस्त देवं से पूवं में होकर उनको पूर्व पूज्यत्व प्रदान किया शा जो अतीव उत्तम वरदान था
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ भद्रं ते नशोकं कर्त्तुमर्हसि । पितामहाय चैवैनमश्वं संप्रतिपादय
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvaṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te naśokaṃ karttumarhasi / pitāmahāya caivainamaśvaṃ saṃpratipādaya

verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca tataḥ praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā tathetyuktvā mahāmatiḥ / yayau tenābhyanujñātaḥ sāketanagaraṃ prati

verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.sanskrit: प्रददौतुरगं चापि समानीतं प्रयत्नतः । अतः परमनुष्ठेयमब्रवीत्किं मयेति च
verses.transliteration: pradadauturagaṃ cāpi samānītaṃ prayatnataḥ / ataḥ paramanuṣṭheyamabravītkiṃ mayeti ca
verses.translation: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you go. Welfare unto you. You do not deserve to grieve over any thing. Give this horse to your grand-father".

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे कपिलाश्रमस्थाश्वानयनं नाम चतुष्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५४॥ äः अभिनन्द्याशिषात्यर्थं लालयन्प्रशशंस ह
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde kapilāśramasthāśvānayanaṃ nāma catuṣpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 54// äḥ abhinandyāśiṣātyarthaṃ lālayanpraśaśaṃsa ha
verses.translation: Then accompanied by the Jjltviks (sacrificial priests) and the sadasyas (members of the holy assembly) who had mastered the Vedas, the excellent king resumed the Yajfia in accordance with the prescribed injunctions.
verses.wordMeaning: Then accompanied by the Jjltviks (sacrificial priests) and the sadasyas (members of the holy assembly) who had mastered the Vedas, the excellent king resumed the Yajfia in accordance with the prescribed injunctions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then accompanied by the Jjltviks (sacrificial priests) and the sadasyas (members of the holy assembly) who had mastered the Vedas, the excellent king resumed the Yajfia in accordance with the prescribed injunctions.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ऋत्विक्सदस्यैश्च सहितो राजसत्तमः । उपाक्रमत तं यज्ञे विधिवद्वेदपारगैः
verses.transliteration: atha ṛtviksadasyaiśca sahito rājasattamaḥ / upākramata taṃ yajñe vidhivadvedapāragaiḥ
verses.translation: Then the sacrifice endowed with the equipments and articles of good quality, and conducted very well by Vasitha, Aurva and other sages, began to be celebrated.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the sacrifice endowed with the equipments and articles of good quality, and conducted very well by Vasitha, Aurva and other sages, began to be celebrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sacrifice endowed with the equipments and articles of good quality, and conducted very well by Vasitha, Aurva and other sages, began to be celebrated.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते यज्ञः सर्वसंपद्गुणान्वितः । सम्यगौर्ववसिष्ठाद्यैर्मुनिभिः संप्रवर्त्तितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravavṛte yajñaḥ sarvasaṃpadguṇānvitaḥ / samyagaurvavasiṣṭhādyairmunibhiḥ saṃpravarttitaḥ
verses.translation: All the Rtviks with the Yajamana ( the performer of sacrifice) at the head, in due order of procedure, concluded sacrifice that began thus.
verses.wordMeaning: All the Rtviks with the Yajamana ( the performer of sacrifice) at the head, in due order of procedure, concluded sacrifice that began thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Rtviks with the Yajamana ( the performer of sacrifice) at the head, in due order of procedure, concluded sacrifice that began thus.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मयमयी वेदिः पात्राण्युच्चावचानि च । सुसमृद्धं यथाशास्त्रं यज्ञे सर्वं बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmayamayī vediḥ pātrāṇyuccāvacāni ca / susamṛddhaṃ yathāśāstraṃ yajñe sarvaṃ babhūva ha
verses.translation: After concluding the sacrifice, the king, who was the most excellent among those who were conversant with the injunctions of scriptures, offered due Daksinas (monetary gifts) to the Rtviks.
verses.wordMeaning: After concluding the sacrifice, the king, who was the most excellent among those who were conversant with the injunctions of scriptures, offered due Daksinas (monetary gifts) to the Rtviks.
verses.commentary: Sense: After concluding the sacrifice, the king, who was the most excellent among those who were conversant with the injunctions of scriptures, offered due Daksinas (monetary gifts) to the Rtviks.

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्त्तितं यज्ञमृत्विजः सर्व एव ते । क्रमात्समापयामासुर्यजमानपुरस्सराः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravarttitaṃ yajñamṛtvijaḥ sarva eva te / kramātsamāpayāmāsuryajamānapurassarāḥ
verses.translation: Then he distributed money to every one of them more than what he (the receiver of Daksina) expected, to the Rtviks, to the sadasyas and to the Brahmanas who came as suppliants.
verses.wordMeaning: Then he distributed money to every one of them more than what he (the receiver of Daksina) expected, to the Rtviks, to the sadasyas and to the Brahmanas who came as suppliants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he distributed money to every one of them more than what he (the receiver of Daksina) expected, to the Rtviks, to the sadasyas and to the Brahmanas who came as suppliants.

verses.sanskrit: समापयित्वा तं यज्ञं राजा विधिविदां वरः । यथावद्दक्षिणां चैव ऋत्विजां प्रददौ तदा
verses.transliteration: samāpayitvā taṃ yajñaṃ rājā vidhividāṃ varaḥ / yathāvaddakṣiṇāṃ caiva ṛtvijāṃ pradadau tadā
verses.translation: After propitiating the Brahmanas and others thus, in due order, by means of monetary gifts, lie fell at the feet of preceptors and Sadasyas and sought their forgiveness ( tor his acts of omissions and commissions).
verses.hindi: वे प्रोदगत धनृषों को ध्वनियों से दण दिशाओं को भर रहे थे । उन दोनों मातुलों की प्रीति को उन भानजों ने विस्तृत किया था
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating the Brahmanas and others thus, in due order, by means of monetary gifts, lie fell at the feet of preceptors and Sadasyas and sought their forgiveness ( tor his acts of omissions and commissions).
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating the Brahmanas and others thus, in due order, by means of monetary gifts, lie fell at the feet of preceptors and Sadasyas and sought their forgiveness ( tor his acts of omissions and commissions).

verses.sanskrit: अथ ऋत्विक्सदस्यानां ब्राह्मणानां तथार्थिनाम् । तत्काङ्क्षितादभ्यधिकं प्रददौ वसु सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: atha ṛtviksadasyānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tathārthinām / tatkāṅkṣitādabhyadhikaṃ pradadau vasu sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Then, accompanied by his followers and kinsmen, he went to Sarayu and performed the concluding holy bath called Avabhrtha. He was accompanied by the Brahmanas and people of other castes and Rtviks. He was followed by groups of courtesans, heralds, bards and panegyrists. The ladies (of the harem) were* with him. He had all the royal para- phernalia like the white umbrella, chowries and furry fans shaken to and fro. He shone well with all these accompani- ments. The sounds of the different kinds of musical instruments deafened (as it were) the various quarters. He joyously performed the holy valedictory ablution (i.e. Avabhrtha) in accordance with the injunction in the scriptures as well as conventional practice.
verses.hindi: प्रत्येक गहरे अहंकार बाले यानों पर समारूढ़ हुए थे । उन्होंने धनुषों को चढ़ाकर विशुक् के पीछे अनुगमन किया था।६। योबराज्य की प्रभा के चिहन छत्र और चामरों से णोमित वारण पर समारूढ़ होकर विशुक् युद्ध भूमि में प्राप्त हुआ था ।१०। इसके पश्चात् कलकल के घोष को करने वाली
verses.wordMeaning: Then, accompanied by his followers and kinsmen, he went to Sarayu and performed the concluding holy bath called Avabhrtha. He was accompanied by the Brahmanas and people of other castes and Rtviks. He was followed by groups of courtesans, heralds, bards and panegyrists.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, accompanied by his followers and kinsmen, he went to Sarayu and performed the concluding holy bath called Avabhrtha. He was accompanied by the Brahmanas and people of other castes and Rtviks. He was followed by groups of courtesans, heralds, bards and panegyrists.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं संतर्प्य विप्रादीन्दक्षिणाभिर्यथाक्रमम् । क्षमापयामास गुरून्सदस्यान्प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃtarpya viprādīndakṣiṇābhiryathākramam / kṣamāpayāmāsa gurūnsadasyānpraṇipatya ca
verses.translation: There were white fans, good umbrellas and colourful banners, flags and festoons displayed in the city. The grounds, bazaars and other places had been swept and sprinkled clean with water and they appeared very splendid.
verses.hindi: सेना से समावृत विशुक् ने महान भयंकर सिहनाद किया था ।११। उसके क्षो से लुब्ध हृदयों वाली शक्तियाँ संश्रम से उद्धत हो गई थीं ओर पंक्तियाँ बॉधकर वे उस अस्ति के प्राकार के वलय से निकली थी
verses.wordMeaning: There were white fans, good umbrellas and colourful banners, flags and festoons displayed in the city. The grounds, bazaars and other places had been swept and sprinkled clean with water and they appeared very splendid.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were white fans, good umbrellas and colourful banners, flags and festoons displayed in the city. The grounds, bazaars and other places had been swept and sprinkled clean with water and they appeared very splendid.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाद्यैस्ततो वर्णैरृत्विग्भिश्च समन्वितः । वारकीयाकदंबैश्च सूतमागधवन्दिभिः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇādyaistato varṇairṛtvigbhiśca samanvitaḥ / vārakīyākadaṃbaiśca sūtamāgadhavandibhiḥ
verses.translation: The city shone splendidly on account of the rows of mansions, lofty and brilliant like the Kailasa mountain. The quarters were rendered fragrant by means of the sweet scent arising from fumes of Aguru.
verses.hindi: अपनी कान्ति से आकाअ को विद्यत से परिपूर्ण कर रही थीं। रण को उन्मुख उन्होंने व्योम चक् को रक्त कमल के सहश बना दिया शा
verses.wordMeaning: The city shone splendidly on account of the rows of mansions, lofty and brilliant like the Kailasa mountain. The quarters were rendered fragrant by means of the sweet scent arising from fumes of Aguru.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city shone splendidly on account of the rows of mansions, lofty and brilliant like the Kailasa mountain. The quarters were rendered fragrant by means of the sweet scent arising from fumes of Aguru.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वीयमानः सस्त्रीकः श्वेतच्छत्रविराजितः । दोधूयमानचमरो वालव्यजनराजितः
verses.transliteration: anvīyamānaḥ sastrīkaḥ śvetacchatravirājitaḥ / dodhūyamānacamaro vālavyajanarājitaḥ
verses.translation: Being served and attended upon by the kings, the rulers of different countries, Sagara the tiger among kings stayed in there like another Indra.
verses.hindi: इसके वाद भंड के दोनों छोटे भाई वहां पर समागत हो गये थे जो युद्ध दुमंद थे । एक हो साथ युद्ध करने के लिए आये हुए उनको मन्त्रिणी और दण्डनाबिका ने सुना था । हूडा
verses.wordMeaning: Being served and attended upon by the kings, the rulers of different countries, Sagara the tiger among kings stayed in there like another Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being served and attended upon by the kings, the rulers of different countries, Sagara the tiger among kings stayed in there like another Indra.

verses.sanskrit: नानावादित्रनिर्घोषैर्बधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः । स गत्वा सरयूतीरं यथाशाश्त्रं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: nānāvāditranirghoṣairbadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ / sa gatvā sarayūtīraṃ yathāśāśtraṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Having fulfilled his desire thus in the company of his friends and allies, Sagara the most excellent among kings rejoiced there accompanied by his two wives.
verses.wordMeaning: Having fulfilled his desire thus in the company of his friends and allies, Sagara the most excellent among kings rejoiced there accompanied by his two wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having fulfilled his desire thus in the company of his friends and allies, Sagara the most excellent among kings rejoiced there accompanied by his two wives.

verses.sanskrit: चकारावभृथस्नानं मुदितः सहबन्धुभिः । एवं स्नात्वा सपत्नीकः सुहृद्भिर्ब्राह्मणैः सह
verses.transliteration: cakārāvabhṛthasnānaṃ muditaḥ sahabandhubhiḥ / evaṃ snātvā sapatnīkaḥ suhṛdbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: With approval of Vasistha, the king gladly crowned Arhsuman, his grandson, who wras humble and modest, by disposition as the heir-apparent.
verses.wordMeaning: With approval of Vasistha, the king gladly crowned Arhsuman, his grandson, who wras humble and modest, by disposition as the heir-apparent.
verses.commentary: Sense: With approval of Vasistha, the king gladly crowned Arhsuman, his grandson, who wras humble and modest, by disposition as the heir-apparent.

verses.sanskrit: वीणावेणुमृदङ्गादिनानावादित्रनिःस्वनैः । मङ्गल्यैर्वेदघोषैश्च सह विप्रजनेरितैः
verses.transliteration: vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādinānāvāditraniḥsvanaiḥ / maṅgalyairvedaghoṣaiśca saha viprajaneritaiḥ
verses.translation: On account of his exalted liberal qualities, he became a great favourite witli friends, kinsmen and the residents of the city as well as the outlying districts and rural territories, O king.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his exalted liberal qualities, he became a great favourite witli friends, kinsmen and the residents of the city as well as the outlying districts and rural territories, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his exalted liberal qualities, he became a great favourite witli friends, kinsmen and the residents of the city as well as the outlying districts and rural territories, O king.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तूयमानः परितः सूतमागधबन्दिभिः । प्रविवेश पुरीं रम्यां हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतम्
verses.transliteration: saṃstūyamānaḥ paritaḥ sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ / praviveśa purīṃ ramyāṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāyutam
verses.translation: The subjects were delighted with him and they loved him because, though he was a boy, he had unmeasured valour and prowess, just as one loves the fresh crescent of the moon that has risen just at the beginning of the bright half of the lunar month.
verses.hindi: उन दोनों ने रथो में शिरोमणि किरिचक्क और ज्ञेय चक्र रथों पर समारोहण किया था । उन दोनों ने छत्रों को धारण किया था और चमर उन पर हुराये जा रहे वे । बे दोनों ही प्रवृत्त अप्सराओं के द्वारा ले जायी जा रही थौं । बे दोनों ही ललिता देवी को आज्ञा पाकर युद्ध करने के लिए
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects were delighted with him and they loved him because, though he was a boy, he had unmeasured valour and prowess, just as one loves the fresh crescent of the moon that has risen just at the beginning of the bright half of the lunar month.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects were delighted with him and they loved him because, though he was a boy, he had unmeasured valour and prowess, just as one loves the fresh crescent of the moon that has risen just at the beginning of the bright half of the lunar month.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतव्यजन सच्छत्रपताकाध्वजमालिनीम् । सिक्तसंमृष्टभूभागापणशोभासमन्विताम्
verses.transliteration: śvetavyajana sacchatrapatākādhvajamālinīm / siktasaṃmṛṣṭabhūbhāgāpaṇaśobhāsamanvitām
verses.translation: Accompanied by him, his friends and allies as well as the two wives who suited him in every respect, the glorious king rejoiced and lived for a long time.
verses.hindi: वहां से निकल कंर चलों थीं ।१५-१६। श्री चक्रराज रथ की रक्षा के लिए ये निवेशित थौं । इन्होंने सौ अक्षौ हिणी सेना ओर भीषण अस्श्रों को वजित करं दिया था ।१७। अन्य समस्त चमू का जाल के साथ रण को उन्मुखी वह निकल कर चली थी । आगे रथ पर बंटी हुई दंडनाया रवाना हुई थी १८
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by him, his friends and allies as well as the two wives who suited him in every respect, the glorious king rejoiced and lived for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by him, his friends and allies as well as the two wives who suited him in every respect, the glorious king rejoiced and lived for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासाद्रिप्रकाशाभिरुज्ज्वलां सौधपङ्क्तिभिः । स तत्रागरुधूपोत्थगन्धामोदितदिङ्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: kailāsādriprakāśābhirujjvalāṃ saudhapaṅktibhiḥ / sa tatrāgarudhūpotthagandhāmoditadiṅmukham
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.hindi: बह एक ही की ऑंगुली से हलायुध को युमाती हुई और दूसरे हाथ से मुसल को बार-र घुमा रही थी ।१६। तरल चन्र की कला से रन करते हुए पोत्र मुखकमल वाली वह युद्धमें सबसे आगे सदा बह विक्रम से उडत रहती थी ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: विकीर्यमाणः परितः पौरनारीजनैर्मुहुः । लाजवर्षेण सानन्दं वीक्षमाणश्च नागरैः
verses.transliteration: vikīryamāṇaḥ paritaḥ pauranārījanairmuhuḥ / lājavarṣeṇa sānandaṃ vīkṣamāṇaśca nāgaraiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.hindi: इसके पीछे गेय चक्र रथ में विराजमान अनुगमन कर रही थी ।२० यह मद से उद्धत धनुष को ध्वनि से सम्पूर्ण विश्व को भर रही थी उसने अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: उपदाभिरनेकाभिस्तत्रतत्र वणिग्जनैः । संभाव्यमानः शनकैर्जगम स्वपुरं प्रति
verses.transliteration: upadābhiranekābhistatratatra vaṇigjanaiḥ / saṃbhāvyamānaḥ śanakairjagama svapuraṃ prati
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.hindi: ३६   ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण जूड़े की चोटी बनी रको थी । जिसमें चन्द्र की कला शोभित हो रही ची
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: स प्रविश्य गृहं रम्यं सर्वमण्डलमण्डितम् । सम्यक्संभावयामास सुहृदो ब्राह्मणानपि
verses.transliteration: sa praviśya gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ sarvamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam / samyaksaṃbhāvayāmāsa suhṛdo brāhmaṇānapi
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: संसेव्यमानश्च तदा नानादेशेश्वरैर्नृपैः । सभायां राजशार्दूलो रेमे शक्र इवापरः
verses.transliteration: saṃsevyamānaśca tadā nānādeśeśvarairnṛpaiḥ / sabhāyāṃ rājaśārdūlo reme śakra ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सुहृद्भिः सहितः पूरयित्वा मनोरथम् । सगरः सह भार्याभ्यां रेमे नृपवरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ suhṛdbhiḥ sahitaḥ pūrayitvā manoratham / sagaraḥ saha bhāryābhyāṃ reme nṛpavarottamaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: अंशुमन्तं ततः पौत्रं मुदा विनयशालिनम् । वसिष्ठानुमते राजा यौवराज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: aṃśumantaṃ tataḥ pautraṃ mudā vinayaśālinam / vasiṣṭhānumate rājā yauvarājye 'bhyaṣecayat
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: पौरजानपदानां तु बन्धूनां सुहृदामपि । स प्रियो ऽभवदत्यर्थमुदारैश्च गुणैर्नृपः
verses.transliteration: paurajānapadānāṃ tu bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāmapi / sa priyo 'bhavadatyarthamudāraiśca guṇairnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजास्तमन्वरज्यन्त बालमप्यमितौजसम् । नवं च शुक्लपक्षादौशीतांशुमचिरोदितम्
verses.transliteration: prajāstamanvarajyanta bālamapyamitaujasam / navaṃ ca śuklapakṣādauśītāṃśumaciroditam
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.hindi: स्फुरित तीन नेत्रों बाली और सिन्दूर के तिलक की कान्ति वाली देवी ने पदुम के तुल्य सुन्दर और मणियों के कंकण की कान्त से सम्पन्न कर से तुणीर के मुख से खींचे हुए वाण को घुमा रही थी । वहाँ पर वधत हो--वर्धन हो-इसकी ध्वनि चारों ओर हो रही थी ।२२-२३। दिव्य मुनि-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन सहितः श्रीमान्सुत्दृद्भिश्च नृपोत्तमः । भार्याभ्यामनुरूपाभ्यां रममाणो ऽवसच्चिरम्
verses.transliteration: sa tena sahitaḥ śrīmānsutdṛdbhiśca nṛpottamaḥ / bhāryābhyāmanurūpābhyāṃ ramamāṇo 'vasacciram
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.hindi: गण प्रसन्नता से नृत्य करते हुए बचनाझृतो से आशीर्वाद दे रहे ये। गेय चक्र रथेनद्र के पहियों का विघटन हो रहा था ! इससे देत्यों के हृदय के साथ ही भूमि को विदीर्ण कर रही थी । उस समय में गीतों का भी बन्ध्र चल रहा था जो अलौकिक और विश्‍व के मन को मोहन करने वाला था ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: युवैव राजशार्दूलः साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः । पालयामास वसुधां सशैलवनकाननाम्
verses.transliteration: yuvaiva rājaśārdūlaḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ / pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ saśailavanakānanām
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.hindi: बहुत-सी मरीचियां गोत का गान क़र रही थी ।२४-२५। आठ हजार अक्षौ- हिणी सेना समर की उद्धत थी । कल्पान्त में मर्यादा से रहित सागर के
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: एवं महानहिमदीधितिवंशमौलिरत्नाय यमानवपुरुत्तरकोसलेशः । पूर्णेन्दुवत्सकललोकमनो ऽभिरामः सार्द्ध प्रजाभिरखिलाभिरलं जहर्ष
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mahānahimadīdhitivaṃśamauliratnāya yamānavapuruttarakosaleśaḥ / pūrṇenduvatsakalalokamano 'bhirāmaḥ sārddha prajābhirakhilābhiralaṃ jaharṣa
verses.translation: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.hindi: समान हो बह कर्षेण कर रही थो ।२६। उसकी शक्तियों की सेना के चक्र में विविध वेषभुषा वाली शेक्तियाँ विद्यमान थीं । कुछ की कांति तो सुवणे के समानं थी--कुछ दाडिम के तुल्य थीं और कुछ मेघों के तुल्य थीं ।९७। अन्य सिन्दूर जेसी कान्ति वाली थीं--कुछ पाटल वर्ण की थीं--कुछ कांच के
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great lord of the Northern Kosalas whose person shone like a precious gem in the crown of kings of the solar race, delighted the minds of all the worlds like the full moon. Along with all his subjects he rejoiced very well.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सागरोपाख्यानेशुमतो राज्यप्राप्तिर्नाम पञ्चपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५५॥ जैमिनिरुवाच एतत्ते चरितं सर्वं सगरस्य महात्मनः । संक्षेपविस्तराभ्यां तु कथितं पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sāgaropākhyāneśumato rājyaprāptirnāma pañcapañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 55// jaiminiruvāca etatte caritaṃ sarvaṃ sagarasya mahātmanaḥ / saṃkṣepavistarābhyāṃ tu kathitaṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: "The life story of the noble-souled Sagara has been recounted to you in full, elaborately as well as succinctly. This story is conducive to the destruction of sin.
verses.hindi: अम्बरों की महाद्वि के सश थीं और दूसरी श्यामल एवं कोमल थों
verses.wordMeaning: "The life story of the noble-souled Sagara has been recounted to you in full, elaborately as well as succinctly. This story is conducive to the destruction of sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The life story of the noble-souled Sagara has been recounted to you in full, elaborately as well as succinctly. This story is conducive to the destruction of sin.

verses.sanskrit: खण्ड्ॐ ऽयं भारतो नाम दक्षिणोत्तरमायतः । नवयोजनसाहस्रं विस्तारपरिमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: khaṇḍoṃ 'yaṃ bhārato nāma dakṣiṇottaramāyataḥ / navayojanasāhasraṃ vistāraparimaṇḍalam
verses.translation: This subcontinent named Bharata lies extensively from South to North. Its expanse is nine thousand Yojanas (?).
verses.wordMeaning: This subcontinent named Bharata lies extensively from South to North. Its expanse is nine thousand Yojanas (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: This subcontinent named Bharata lies extensively from South to North. Its expanse is nine thousand Yojanas (?).

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रैस्तस्य नरेद्रस्य मृगयद्भिस्तुरङ्गमम् । योजनानां सहस्रं तु खात्वाष्टौ विनिपातिताः
verses.transliteration: putraistasya naredrasya mṛgayadbhisturaṅgamam / yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu khātvāṣṭau vinipātitāḥ
verses.translation: A thousand Yojanas were dug up by the sons of the king Sagara who were in search of the horse. The remaining eight thousand Yojanas were made to fall(?)
verses.wordMeaning: A thousand Yojanas were dug up by the sons of the king Sagara who were in search of the horse. The remaining eight thousand Yojanas were made to fall(?)
verses.commentary: Sense: A thousand Yojanas were dug up by the sons of the king Sagara who were in search of the horse. The remaining eight thousand Yojanas were made to fall(?)

verses.sanskrit: सागरस्य सुतैर्यस्माद्वर्द्धितो मकरालयः । ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु सागराख्यामवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: sāgarasya sutairyasmādvarddhito makarālayaḥ / tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu sāgarākhyāmavāptavān
verses.translation: Since the abode of sharks (i.e. ocean) was dug up and developed by the sons of Sagara, it obtained the name Sagara in the worlds since then.
verses.hindi: विशेषस्तु परं तस्याः साचिव्ये तत्करे स्थितम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since the abode of sharks (i.e. ocean) was dug up and developed by the sons of Sagara, it obtained the name Sagara in the worlds since then.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the abode of sharks (i.e. ocean) was dug up and developed by the sons of Sagara, it obtained the name Sagara in the worlds since then.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मपादावधि महीं सतीर्थक्षेत्रकाननाम् । अब्धिः संक्रमयामास परिक्षिप्य निजांभसा
verses.transliteration: brahmapādāvadhi mahīṃ satīrthakṣetrakānanām / abdhiḥ saṃkramayāmāsa parikṣipya nijāṃbhasā
verses.translation: The ocean splashed its waters all round and flooded the earth including the holy centres, fields and forests upto Brahmapada (the foot of Brahma).
verses.hindi: अन्य हीरे के सहन थीं और कुछ गारुत्मत मणि के समान थीं। विरुद्ध पाँच बाणों से मिश्रित शत कोटियों से कुछ अनेक आयुधों वाली अपनी शारीरिक कान्ति को प्रकाशित कर रही थीं । ऐसी अगणित शक्तियाँ दण्डिनी के सैनिकों के साथ वहाँ पर युद्ध के लिए चली थीं ।२६-३०। हे
verses.wordMeaning: The ocean splashed its waters all round and flooded the earth including the holy centres, fields and forests upto Brahmapada (the foot of Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: The ocean splashed its waters all round and flooded the earth including the holy centres, fields and forests upto Brahmapada (the foot of Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तन्निलयाः सर्वे सदेवासुरमानवाः । इतस्ततश्च संजाता दुःखेन महतान्विताः
verses.transliteration: tatastannilayāḥ sarve sadevāsuramānavāḥ / itastataśca saṃjātā duḥkhena mahatānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Then, all the Devas, Asuras and human beings living there were scattered here and there. They became afflicted with great sorrow.
verses.hindi: कुम्भसम्भव ! जेसा उनका भूषण-वेषादि था और प्रभाव का लक्षण था दसा ही मस्त्रिणी को सेना का मी सन्नाह भी या ।३१। जैसी सदुगुण शालिता थो और जो भी आश्रितों का लक्षण था तथा जैसा भी देत्यों के
verses.wordMeaning: Then, all the Devas, Asuras and human beings living there were scattered here and there. They became afflicted with great sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, all the Devas, Asuras and human beings living there were scattered here and there. They became afflicted with great sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णं नाम विख्यातं क्षेत्रं सर्वसुरार्चितम् । सार्द्धयोजनविस्तारं तीरे पश्चिम वारिधेः
verses.transliteration: gokarṇaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvasurārcitam / sārddhayojanavistāraṃ tīre paścima vāridheḥ
verses.translation: There are innumerable holy spots there. There are abodes of sages and Devas. Many groups of siddhas have been living in that holy centre from the earliest times, O king.
verses.hindi: इवः   बह्माण्ड पुराण समुदाय का संहार था वैसी ही वे सबके द्वारा पूजित भी हुई थीं
verses.wordMeaning: There are innumerable holy spots there. There are abodes of sages and Devas. Many groups of siddhas have been living in that holy centre from the earliest times, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are innumerable holy spots there. There are abodes of sages and Devas. Many groups of siddhas have been living in that holy centre from the earliest times, O king.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासंख्यानि तीर्थानि मुनिदेवालयाश्च वै । वसंति सिद्धसंघाश्च क्षेत्रे तस्मिन्पुरा नृप
verses.transliteration: tatrāsaṃkhyāni tīrthāni munidevālayāśca vai / vasaṃti siddhasaṃghāśca kṣetre tasminpurā nṛpa
verses.translation: If people decide to go on pilgrimage to that holy spot, and make the proposed journey, their sins perish like a dry leaf in a stormy wind.
verses.hindi: महाराज्ञी की जैसी शक्ति थी वैसी ही सम्पूर्ण दंडिनी की भी थी किन्तु विशेषता यही थी कि उसके हाथ में साचिब्य था । महाराज्ञी ने उसकी आज्ञा की मुद्रांगूलीयक वितीर्ण कर दी थी ।३३। मन्त्रिणी और दण्डनाथा की सेना इस प्रकार से चलो थो । उस सेना के भार से यह भूमि भगुर हो
verses.wordMeaning: If people decide to go on pilgrimage to that holy spot, and make the proposed journey, their sins perish like a dry leaf in a stormy wind.
