verses.commentary: Sense: If people decide to go on pilgrimage to that holy spot, and make the proposed journey, their sins perish like a dry leaf in a stormy wind.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रं तल्लोकविख्यातं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् । तत्तीर्थमब्धेरपतद्भागे दक्षिणपश्चिमे
verses.transliteration: kṣetraṃ tallokavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham / tattīrthamabdherapatadbhāge dakṣiṇapaścime
verses.translation: A desire to resort to that holy spot never occurs to the evil-minded ones who may even reside very near it.
verses.hindi: गयी थी ओर वह झूला की तरह हो हिलने लग गयी थी ।३४। इसके अनस्तर महान तुमुल और रोमहर्षण युद्ध प्रवृत्त हो गया था । उस युद्ध में उठी हुई धूलि में जो जम्बाल के हो समान हो गयी थी सातों साथरों के जल को छा लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: A desire to resort to that holy spot never occurs to the evil-minded ones who may even reside very near it.
verses.commentary: Sense: A desire to resort to that holy spot never occurs to the evil-minded ones who may even reside very near it.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सर्वे तपस्तप्त्वा मुनयः संशितव्रताः । निर्वाणं परमं प्राप्ताः पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: yatra sarve tapastaptvā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ / nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ punarāvṛttivarjitam
verses.translation: Only, through great religious merit can men have the desire and pleasure of making a holy pilgrimage to that sacred holy spot. Never otherwise, O king.
verses.wordMeaning: Only, through great religious merit can men have the desire and pleasure of making a holy pilgrimage to that sacred holy spot. Never otherwise, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only, through great religious merit can men have the desire and pleasure of making a holy pilgrimage to that sacred holy spot. Never otherwise, O king.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्रेत्रस्य प्रभावेण प्रीत्या भूतगणैः सह । देव्या च सकलैर्देवैर्नित्यं वसति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tattretrasya prabhāveṇa prītyā bhūtagaṇaiḥ saha / devyā ca sakalairdevairnityaṃ vasati śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: If, out of compulsion, the mobile and the immobile living beings die there, O king, they attain permanent abode in heaven immediately.
verses.hindi: विशुक् ण समं श्यामा विकृष्रमणिकामु का
verses.wordMeaning: If, out of compulsion, the mobile and the immobile living beings die there, O king, they attain permanent abode in heaven immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: If, out of compulsion, the mobile and the immobile living beings die there, O king, they attain permanent abode in heaven immediately.

verses.sanskrit: एनांसि यत्समुद्दिश्य तीर्थयात्रां प्रकुर्वताम् । नृणामाशु प्रणश्यन्ति प्रवाते शुष्कपर्णवत्
verses.transliteration: enāṃsi yatsamuddiśya tīrthayātrāṃ prakurvatām / nṛṇāmāśu praṇaśyanti pravāte śuṣkaparṇavat
verses.translation: Those who are devoid of lust and anger, who live in them without rivalry, attain that Siddhi ere long.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are devoid of lust and anger, who live in them without rivalry, attain that Siddhi ere long.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are devoid of lust and anger, who live in them without rivalry, attain that Siddhi ere long.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षेत्रसेवनरतिर् नैव जात्वभिजायते । समीपे वसमानोनामपि पुंसां दुरात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: tatkṣetrasevanaratir naiva jātvabhijāyate / samīpe vasamānonāmapi puṃsāṃ durātmanām
verses.translation: Those who stay there engaged injapa, and Iloina will attain the desired Siddhi. They must be quiescent, self- restrained and observe the vow of celibacy-
verses.wordMeaning: Those who stay there engaged injapa, and Iloina will attain the desired Siddhi. They must be quiescent, self- restrained and observe the vow of celibacy-
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who stay there engaged injapa, and Iloina will attain the desired Siddhi. They must be quiescent, self- restrained and observe the vow of celibacy-

verses.sanskrit: महाता सुकृतेनैव तत्क्षेत्रगमने रतिः । नृणां संजायते राजन्नान्यथा तु कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: mahātā sukṛtenaiva tatkṣetragamane ratiḥ / nṛṇāṃ saṃjāyate rājannānyathā tu kathañcana
verses.translation: If holy rites such as the worship of the Pitrs, Devas and Brahmanas, charitable gifts, Homas, Japas etc. are performed in this holy spot, O King, the fruit thcrc-of will be ten million times more than that (performance of these acts) in the other holy spots.
verses.wordMeaning: If holy rites such as the worship of the Pitrs, Devas and Brahmanas, charitable gifts, Homas, Japas etc. are performed in this holy spot, O King, the fruit thcrc-of will be ten million times more than that (performance of these acts) in the other holy spots.
verses.commentary: Sense: If holy rites such as the worship of the Pitrs, Devas and Brahmanas, charitable gifts, Homas, Japas etc. are performed in this holy spot, O King, the fruit thcrc-of will be ten million times more than that (performance of these acts) in the other holy spots.

verses.sanskrit: निर्बन्धेन तु ये तस्मिन्प्राणिनः स्थिरजङ्गमाः । म्रियन्ते नृप सद्यस्ते स्वर्गं प्राप्स्यन्ति शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: nirbandhena tu ye tasminprāṇinaḥ sthirajaṅgamāḥ / mriyante nṛpa sadyaste svargaṃ prāpsyanti śāśvatam
verses.translation: The highly intelligent king Amsuman had perfectly enjoyed the worldly pleasures, crowned Dillpa (as the ruler) of the kingdom and went to the forest witli a decision in his mind to perform penance.
verses.wordMeaning: The highly intelligent king Amsuman had perfectly enjoyed the worldly pleasures, crowned Dillpa (as the ruler) of the kingdom and went to the forest witli a decision in his mind to perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly intelligent king Amsuman had perfectly enjoyed the worldly pleasures, crowned Dillpa (as the ruler) of the kingdom and went to the forest witli a decision in his mind to perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्यापि सकलैः पापैर्यस्य मुच्येत मानवः । क्षेत्राणामुत्तमं क्षेत्रं सर्वतीर्थनिकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: smṛtyāpi sakalaiḥ pāpairyasya mucyeta mānavaḥ / kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvatīrthaniketanam
verses.translation: Then the glorious Dillpa protected the entire earth righteously after defeating all the enemies.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the glorious Dillpa protected the entire earth righteously after defeating all the enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the glorious Dillpa protected the entire earth righteously after defeating all the enemies.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा चैतेषु तीर्थेषु यजन्तश्च सदाशिवम् । सिद्धिकामा वसंति स्म मुनयस्तत्र केचन
verses.transliteration: snātvā caiteṣu tīrtheṣu yajantaśca sadāśivam / siddhikāmā vasaṃti sma munayastatra kecana
verses.translation: His son named Bhaglratha became very famous throughout the world. He was clever in comprehending all the topics concerning holy rites and virtue. He was resplendent and liis valour and exploits were unmeasured.
verses.wordMeaning: His son named Bhaglratha became very famous throughout the world. He was clever in comprehending all the topics concerning holy rites and virtue. He was resplendent and liis valour and exploits were unmeasured.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son named Bhaglratha became very famous throughout the world. He was clever in comprehending all the topics concerning holy rites and virtue. He was resplendent and liis valour and exploits were unmeasured.

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधविनिर्मुक्ता ये तस्मिन्वीतमत्सराः । निवसंत्यचिरेणैव तत्सिद्धिंप्राप्नुवन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhavinirmuktā ye tasminvītamatsarāḥ / nivasaṃtyacireṇaiva tatsiddhiṃprāpnuvanti hi
verses.translation: He became frustrated and extremely disinterest- ed in the kingdom, his kinsmen and the enjoyments of all worldly pleasures. He entrusted the kingdom to the care of his excellent minister. The excellent king was desirous of taking his ancestors to heaven and so went to the forest for per- forming penance. At the outset he propitiated the lotus-born lord Brahma by means of great penance for securing longevity. From him he got as long a life as he desired.
verses.hindi: जो अश्वों पर सवार ये उन्होंने घुड सवारों के साथ--एवं हस्तिपकों ने आधोरणों के साथ और पदातियों ने पैदल संनिको से सङ्गत होकर
verses.wordMeaning: He became frustrated and extremely disinterest- ed in the kingdom, his kinsmen and the enjoyments of all worldly pleasures. He entrusted the kingdom to the care of his excellent minister.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He became frustrated and extremely disinterest- ed in the kingdom, his kinsmen and the enjoyments of all worldly pleasures. He entrusted the kingdom to the care of his excellent minister.…

verses.sanskrit: जपहोमरताः शान्ता निपता ब्रह्मचारिणः । वसंति तस्मिन्ये ते हि सिद्धिं प्राप्स्यन्त्यभीप्सिताम्
verses.transliteration: japahomaratāḥ śāntā nipatā brahmacāriṇaḥ / vasaṃti tasminye te hi siddhiṃ prāpsyantyabhīpsitām
verses.translation: The lord who favours his devotees granted that boon to him. As Ganga fell down from the top of Meru along with crocodiles, alligators and sharks, the lord of the worlds (i.e. Siva) caught her by means of his head. Al- though she was flowing with great rapidity, she got merged deep into his resplendent matted hair after reaching his head. By seeing her disappear in the head of the lord Sambhu like water within the cupped palm of the hand, he once again propitiated Hara to get her released.
verses.hindi: खड्गों से युद्ध किया था ।३६। संग्राम में दण्डनाथा ने निषङ्ग के साथ युद्ध था । अपने मणियों के कामुक को खोचकर श्यामा ने विशुक्र के साथ युद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: The lord who favours his devotees granted that boon to him. As Ganga fell down from the top of Meru along with crocodiles, alligators and sharks, the lord of the worlds (i.e. Siva) caught her by means of his head. Al- though she was flowing with great rapidity,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord who favours his devotees granted that boon to him. As Ganga fell down from the top of Meru along with crocodiles, alligators and sharks, the lord of the worlds (i.e. Siva) caught her by means of his head. Al- though she was flowing with great rapidity,…

verses.sanskrit: दानहोमजपाद्यं वै पितृदेवद्विजार्चनम् । अन्यस्मात्कोटिगुणितं भवेत्तस्मिन्फलं नृप
verses.transliteration: dānahomajapādyaṃ vai pitṛdevadvijārcanam / anyasmātkoṭiguṇitaṃ bhavettasminphalaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Ganga received four names due to these four different channels viz. Sita, Alakananda, Sucaksus and Bhadravatl.1
verses.hindi: किया था ।३७। अश्वासढ़ा ने बहुत भारी उलू जितु के साय रण किया था सम्पदीक्षा ने युद्ध की इच्छा से पुरुष के साथ युद्ध ग्रहण किया था ३८ नकुली देवी ने युद्ध करने की इच्छा से निष को बुलाया था । माहमाया ने कु तिषेण के साथ युद्ध किया था ।३६। उन्मत्त भैरवी ने मलद के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: Ganga received four names due to these four different channels viz. Sita, Alakananda, Sucaksus and Bhadravatl.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Ganga received four names due to these four different channels viz. Sita, Alakananda, Sucaksus and Bhadravatl.1

verses.sanskrit: अंभोधिसलिले मग्न तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे ऽतिपावने । महता तपसा युक्ता मुनयस्तन्निवासिनः
verses.transliteration: aṃbhodhisalile magna tasmin kṣetre 'tipāvane / mahatā tapasā yuktā munayastannivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Though their waters had been dried up when Agastya drank up the waters, the four oceans became full with the waters of Ganga, once again.
verses.hindi: संग्राम किया था और लघुश्यामा ने कुशूर के साथ रण किया था १४७ स्वप्नेशी ने मङ्गल के साथ युद्ध किया शा । वाग्वादिनी ने दुषण के साथ रण में भिडन्त की थी ।४१। चण्डकालो ने कोलाट के साथ रण किया था। हैत्यों की अक्षोहिणियों के साथ सो अक्षोहिणी सेनाओं ने परस्पर में बड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: Though their waters had been dried up when Agastya drank up the waters, the four oceans became full with the waters of Ganga, once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though their waters had been dried up when Agastya drank up the waters, the four oceans became full with the waters of Ganga, once again.

verses.sanskrit: सह्यं शिखरिणं श्रेष्ठं निलयार्थं समारुहन् । वसंतस्तत्र ते सर्वे संप्रधार्य परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: sahyaṃ śikhariṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nilayārthaṃ samāruhan / vasaṃtastatra te sarve saṃpradhārya parasparam
verses.translation: When the ocean extended by the sons of Sagara became filled up, many countries lying nearby became sub- merged.
verses.hindi: भारी युद्ध क्रोध में मूच्छित होकर किया था
verses.wordMeaning: When the ocean extended by the sons of Sagara became filled up, many countries lying nearby became sub- merged.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the ocean extended by the sons of Sagara became filled up, many countries lying nearby became sub- merged.

verses.sanskrit: सहेन्द्राद्रौ तपस्यन्तं रामं गन्तुं प्रचक्रमुः । राजोवाच । अगस्त्यपीततोये ऽब्धौ परितो राजनन्दनैः
verses.transliteration: sahendrādrau tapasyantaṃ rāmaṃ gantuṃ pracakramuḥ / rājovāca / agastyapītatoye 'bdhau parito rājanandanaiḥ
verses.translation: M.Ali identifies the rivers as follows:
verses.wordMeaning: M.Ali identifies the rivers as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: M.Ali identifies the rivers as follows:

verses.sanskrit: खात्वाधः पातिते क्षेत्रे सतीर्थाश्रमकानने । भूभागेषु तथान्येषु पुरग्रमाकरादिषु
verses.transliteration: khātvādhaḥ pātite kṣetre satīrthāśramakānane / bhūbhāgeṣu tathānyeṣu puragramākarādiṣu
verses.translation: "Thereafter, Suska, Sumitra, and other sages of praiseworthy holy vows and rites, went towards the mountain Mahendra with a desire to see Bhargava Rama.
verses.wordMeaning: "Thereafter, Suska, Sumitra, and other sages of praiseworthy holy vows and rites, went towards the mountain Mahendra with a desire to see Bhargava Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Thereafter, Suska, Sumitra, and other sages of praiseworthy holy vows and rites, went towards the mountain Mahendra with a desire to see Bhargava Rama.

verses.sanskrit: विनाशितेषु देशेषु समुद्रोपान्तवर्त्तिषु । किमकार्षुर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ जनास्तन्निलयास्ततः
verses.transliteration: vināśiteṣu deśeṣu samudropāntavarttiṣu / kimakārṣurmuniśreṣṭha janāstannilayāstataḥ
verses.translation: Passing through very many countries, forests, rivers etc., those leading sages gradually icachcd the excellent mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: Passing through very many countries, forests, rivers etc., those leading sages gradually icachcd the excellent mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Passing through very many countries, forests, rivers etc., those leading sages gradually icachcd the excellent mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव चावसन्कृच्छ्रात्प्रस्थितान्यत्र वा ततः । कियता चैव कालेन संपूर्णो ऽभूदपांनिधिः । केन वापि प्रकारेण ब्रह्मन्नेतद्वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: tatraiva cāvasankṛcchrātprasthitānyatra vā tataḥ / kiyatā caiva kālena saṃpūrṇo 'bhūdapāṃnidhiḥ / kena vāpi prakāreṇa brahmannetadvadasva me
verses.translation: He appeared like a person engaged in penance for the extenuation of the defect (sin ) of burning the three worlds deliberately at the outset, like the Kdlagni (fire at end of a Kalpa).
verses.hindi: तर्षेण तेन क्वथिते शक्तिसैन्यं विलोक्य सा ।
verses.wordMeaning: He appeared like a person engaged in penance for the extenuation of the defect (sin ) of burning the three worlds deliberately at the outset, like the Kdlagni (fire at end of a Kalpa).
verses.commentary: Sense: He appeared like a person engaged in penance for the extenuation of the defect (sin ) of burning the three worlds deliberately at the outset, like the Kdlagni (fire at end of a Kalpa).

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच अनूपेषु प्रदेशेषु नाशितेषु दुरात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca anūpeṣu pradeśeṣu nāśiteṣu durātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: After approaching the excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu who was engaged in the great vow of sagehood, those sages who were by nature humble in their conduct, saluted him with their heads bowing down, due to devotion.
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching the excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu who was engaged in the great vow of sagehood, those sages who were by nature humble in their conduct, saluted him with their heads bowing down, due to devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching the excellent scion of the family of Bhrgu who was engaged in the great vow of sagehood, those sages who were by nature humble in their conduct, saluted him with their heads bowing down, due to devotion.

verses.sanskrit: जनास्तन्निलयाः सर्वे संप्रयाता इतस्ततः । तत्रैव चावसन्कृच्छ्रात्केचित्क्षेत्रनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: janāstannilayāḥ sarve saṃprayātā itastataḥ / tatraiva cāvasankṛcchrātkecitkṣetranivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing those sages come, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu, respectfully worshipped them very well* with the materials of worship such as Argha, Pddya etc.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing those sages come, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu, respectfully worshipped them very well* with the materials of worship such as Argha, Pddya etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing those sages come, the leading member of the family of Bhrgu, respectfully worshipped them very well* with the materials of worship such as Argha, Pddya etc.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजन्नंशुमतः सुतः । बभूव भुविधर्मात्मा दिलीप इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu rājannaṃśumataḥ sutaḥ / babhūva bhuvidharmātmā dilīpa iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: "Welcome unto you all, O highly exalted ones of great fortune, you have come here. Tell me without hesitation what should be done by us."
verses.hindi: उस युद्ध के प्रवृत्त होने पर दुष्ट दानव विशुक् ने जब यह देखा था कि शक्तियों की सेना बढ़ रही है ओर अपनी क्षीण हो रही है तो क्रोध में भरकर उसने एक बड़ा धनुष खींचा था और उस समस्त शक्तियों की सेना में तृषास्त्र छोड़ दिया या ॥४३-४४ उसने जो दावानल की ज्वाला के समान
verses.wordMeaning: "Welcome unto you all, O highly exalted ones of great fortune, you have come here. Tell me without hesitation what should be done by us."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Welcome unto you all, O highly exalted ones of great fortune, you have come here. Tell me without hesitation what should be done by us."

verses.sanskrit: राज्ये ऽभिषिच्य तं सम्यग्भुक्तभोग्ॐऽशुमान्नृपः । वनं जगाम मेधावी तपसे धृतमानसः
verses.transliteration: rājye 'bhiṣicya taṃ samyagbhuktabhogoṃ'śumānnṛpaḥ / vanaṃ jagāma medhāvī tapase dhṛtamānasaḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to Rama, those sages said thus: — "O excellent sage, understand that we are the sages who had our homes in Gokarna.
verses.hindi: दीप्त था उस बड़ी सेना को मथ दिया था। तीसरे यद्ध के दिन में एक प्रहर मात्र रवि के गत होने पर विशुक्र के द्वारा छोड़े हुए तृषास्त्र से शक्तियां व्याकुल हो उठी थीं ।४५। उन तालु के मूल का शोषण कर रहा था। कानों के छिद्र भी रक्ष हों रहे थे और अज़ों में दुर्बलता हो रही थी
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to Rama, those sages said thus: — "O excellent sage, understand that we are the sages who had our homes in Gokarna.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to Rama, those sages said thus: — "O excellent sage, understand that we are the sages who had our homes in Gokarna.

verses.sanskrit: दिलीपस्तु ततःश्रीमानशेषां पृथिवीमिमाम् । पालयामास धर्मेण विजित्य सकलानरीन्
verses.transliteration: dilīpastu tataḥśrīmānaśeṣāṃ pṛthivīmimām / pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa vijitya sakalānarīn
verses.translation: That great holy place along with the sacred ponds etc. was caused to fall into the waters of the ocean by the sons of Sagara who were digging up Earth for some other reason.
verses.hindi: तथा आयुधों को छोड़कर देहों को भूमि पर गिरा रहा था ।४६-४७। युद्ध में अनुद्यम करने वाले तथा समस्त उत्साह के विरोधी उस तपं के द्वारा क्व- चित शक्तियों की सेना को देखकर वह मन्त्रिणी पोचिणी के साथ बहुत ही चिन्तित हो गयी थीं।४८। अतीव अहित बिशंका बाली उस दण्डनाथा से
verses.wordMeaning: That great holy place along with the sacred ponds etc. was caused to fall into the waters of the ocean by the sons of Sagara who were digging up Earth for some other reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great holy place along with the sacred ponds etc. was caused to fall into the waters of the ocean by the sons of Sagara who were digging up Earth for some other reason.

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथो नाम सुतस्तस्यासील्लोकविश्रुतः । सर्वधर्मार्थकुशलः श्रीमानमितविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: bhagīratho nāma sutastasyāsīllokaviśrutaḥ / sarvadharmārthakuśalaḥ śrīmānamitavikramaḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, we desire and expect from you to regain that holy spot that sanctifies everyone, after causing the waters of the ocean to recede.
verses.hindi: बोली रश में स्थित और रशगता होकर उसके प्रतिकार कर्म के लिए कहा था है सखि ! पोत्रिणि ! यह दृष्ट का तृपास्त्र आ गया है। इसका हमारी सेना पर बहुत ही बुरा प्रभाव हो गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Undoubtedly, we desire and expect from you to regain that holy spot that sanctifies everyone, after causing the waters of the ocean to recede.
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly, we desire and expect from you to regain that holy spot that sanctifies everyone, after causing the waters of the ocean to recede.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ये ऽभिषिच्य तं राजा दिलीपो ऽपि वनं ययौ । स चापि पालयन्नुर्वीं सम्यग्विहतकण्टकाम्
verses.transliteration: rājye 'bhiṣicya taṃ rājā dilīpo 'pi vanaṃ yayau / sa cāpi pālayannurvīṃ samyagvihatakaṇṭakām
verses.translation: It behoves you, O leading Brahmana, to grant that excellent holy spot now, after causing the waters of the ocean to recede, by your own prowess".
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you, O leading Brahmana, to grant that excellent holy spot now, after causing the waters of the ocean to recede, by your own prowess".
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you, O leading Brahmana, to grant that excellent holy spot now, after causing the waters of the ocean to recede, by your own prowess".

verses.sanskrit: मुमुदे विविधैर्भोगैर्दिवि देवपतिर्यथा । स शुश्रावात्मनः पूर्वं पूर्वजानां महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: mumude vividhairbhogairdivi devapatiryathā / sa śuśrāvātmanaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvajānāṃ mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: "All these things are completely known to me, O ascetics. The task that you all have set could. also be carried out by me. No doubt need be entertained about this.
verses.hindi: न कापि कुरते युद्धं न धारयति चायुधम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: "All these things are completely known to me, O ascetics. The task that you all have set could. also be carried out by me. No doubt need be entertained about this.
verses.commentary: Sense: "All these things are completely known to me, O ascetics. The task that you all have set could. also be carried out by me. No doubt need be entertained about this.

verses.sanskrit: निरये पतनं घोरं विप्रकोपसमुद्भवम् । ब्रह्मदण्डहतान्सर्वान्पितञ्छ्रुत्वातिदुःखितः
verses.transliteration: niraye patanaṃ ghoraṃ viprakopasamudbhavam / brahmadaṇḍahatānsarvānpitañchrutvātiduḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: But this task desired and expected by you is exces- sively terrible in the world. Even by me, it can be carried out only by taking up arms and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: एकापि शक्तिर्नेवास्ति या तर्षेण न पीडिता
verses.wordMeaning: But this task desired and expected by you is exces- sively terrible in the world. Even by me, it can be carried out only by taking up arms and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: But this task desired and expected by you is exces- sively terrible in the world. Even by me, it can be carried out only by taking up arms and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ये बन्धुषु भोगे वा निर्वेदं परमं ययौ । स मन्त्रिप्रवरे राज्यं विन्यस्य तपसे वनम्
verses.transliteration: rājye bandhuṣu bhoge vā nirvedaṃ paramaṃ yayau / sa mantripravare rājyaṃ vinyasya tapase vanam
verses.translation: I have granted the boon of freedom from fear to everyone. I have laid down my weapons. I am quiescent now. According to an earlier behest of my father, I have taken up the vow to perform penance.
verses.wordMeaning: I have granted the boon of freedom from fear to everyone. I have laid down my weapons. I am quiescent now. According to an earlier behest of my father, I have taken up the vow to perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have granted the boon of freedom from fear to everyone. I have laid down my weapons. I am quiescent now. According to an earlier behest of my father, I have taken up the vow to perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रययौ स्वपितॄन्नाकं निनीषुर्नृपसत्तमः । तपसा महाता पूर्वमायुषे कमलोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: prayayau svapitṝnnākaṃ ninīṣurnṛpasattamaḥ / tapasā mahātā pūrvamāyuṣe kamalodbhavam
verses.translation: "The taking up of arms for the protection of the good does not make any one go astray from truthfulness (to his vows) as mentioned by Brahma formerly.
verses.hindi: हा ! विधाता का क्या क्रम है। यह अस्त्र तो हमारी सेना को शिथिल कर रहा है । सबके तालुमूल मूख गये हैं और सबके आयुध भ्रष्ट हो गये हैं। इस युद्ध मैं शक्तियों का मण्डल उपेक्षित हो गया है ।४०। न तो कोई भी युद्ध करती है और न कोई आयुध ही ग्रहण कर रही है। हे
verses.wordMeaning: "The taking up of arms for the protection of the good does not make any one go astray from truthfulness (to his vows) as mentioned by Brahma formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The taking up of arms for the protection of the good does not make any one go astray from truthfulness (to his vows) as mentioned by Brahma formerly.

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य तस्माल्लेभे च यावदायुर्निजेप्सितम् । ततो गङ्गां महाराज समाराध्य प्रसाद्य च
verses.transliteration: ārādhya tasmāllebhe ca yāvadāyurnijepsitam / tato gaṅgāṃ mahārāja samārādhya prasādya ca
verses.translation: Hence, for the sake of our welfare, weapons should be taken up by you. Thereby a great righteous action shall be carried out by you."
verses.hindi: आलि ! तालुमूनों के शुष्क हो जाने से ये तो बोलने में भी असमर्थ हो गयी ह ५१ हमारी ऐसी दशा को सुनकर महेश्वरी क्या कहेगी । देत्यों ने तो हमारा बड़ा ही अपकार किया है। इसका कोई उपाय सोचना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, for the sake of our welfare, weapons should be taken up by you. Thereby a great righteous action shall be carried out by you."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, for the sake of our welfare, weapons should be taken up by you. Thereby a great righteous action shall be carried out by you."

verses.sanskrit: वरमागमनं वव्रे दिवस्तस्या महींप्रति । ततस्तां शिरसा धर्त्तु तपसाऽराधयच्छिवम्
verses.transliteration: varamāgamanaṃ vavre divastasyā mahīṃprati / tatastāṃ śirasā dharttu tapasā'rādhayacchivam
verses.translation: The leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, the noble- minded sage Rama descended from Sahya, the excellent mountain and reached the western shore of the lord of rivers.
verses.hindi: हे पोश्रिणि ! सोलह हजार सर्वत्र यहाँ पर अक्षौहिणी हैं। ऐसी एक भी शक्ति नहीं है जो तषं से पीड़ित न होवे ।५३। इसी अवसर सेना को हथि- यारों को. छोड़ते वाली देखकर ये दानव छिटो में परहार करने वाले हैं और बाणों से निहनन कर रहे हैं। यह बड़े ही खेद की बात है ।५४। यहाँ पर
verses.wordMeaning: The leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, the noble- minded sage Rama descended from Sahya, the excellent mountain and reached the western shore of the lord of rivers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading scion of the family of Bhrgu, the noble- minded sage Rama descended from Sahya, the excellent mountain and reached the western shore of the lord of rivers.

verses.sanskrit: स चापि तद्वरं तस्मै प्रददौ भक्तवत्सलः । मेरोर्मूर्ध्नस्ततो गङ्गां पतं ती शिरसात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sa cāpi tadvaraṃ tasmai pradadau bhaktavatsalaḥ / merormūrdhnastato gaṅgāṃ pataṃ tī śirasātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Then Rama got up and stood facing the south. He spoke these words to Varuna in deep resonant tone like the sound of rumbling cloud.
verses.hindi: तुमको और मुझको कोई उपाय करना चाहिए। उस समरोद्यम में कुछ करना ही है। तुम्हारे रथ के पयं में स्थित जो शीत का महाणंव है
verses.wordMeaning: Then Rama got up and stood facing the south. He spoke these words to Varuna in deep resonant tone like the sound of rumbling cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Rama got up and stood facing the south. He spoke these words to Varuna in deep resonant tone like the sound of rumbling cloud.

verses.sanskrit: सग्राहनक्रमकरां जग्राह जगतां पतिः । सा तच्छिरः समासाद्य महावेगप्रवाहिनी
verses.transliteration: sagrāhanakramakarāṃ jagrāha jagatāṃ patiḥ / sā tacchiraḥ samāsādya mahāvegapravāhinī
verses.translation: £< I have come here along with the groups of sages with a desire to see you. Hence, take up your own form O Pracetas, and grant me your vision.'*
verses.hindi: उसको ही शक्तियों की तृषा के छेदन के लिए आदेश दो क्योंकि अल्प पानीय के पानों से उनकी तृषा का क्षय नहीं होगा
verses.wordMeaning: £< I have come here along with the groups of sages with a desire to see you. Hence, take up your own form O Pracetas, and grant me your vision.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: £< I have come here along with the groups of sages with a desire to see you. Hence, take up your own form O Pracetas, and grant me your vision.'*

verses.sanskrit: तज्जटामण्डले शुभ्रे विलिल्ये सातिगह्वरे । चुलकोदकवच्छंभोर्विलीनां शिरसि प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: tajjaṭāmaṇḍale śubhre vililye sātigahvare / culakodakavacchaṃbhorvilīnāṃ śirasi prabhoḥ
verses.translation: Even after hearing these words Varuna, the lord of aquatic beings, O king, did not move from his place. He became bolder.
verses.wordMeaning: Even after hearing these words Varuna, the lord of aquatic beings, O king, did not move from his place. He became bolder.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after hearing these words Varuna, the lord of aquatic beings, O king, did not move from his place. He became bolder.

verses.sanskrit: विलोक्य तत्प्रमोक्षाय पुनराराधयद्धरम् । स तां शर्वप्रसादेन लब्ध्वा तु भुवमागताम्
verses.transliteration: vilokya tatpramokṣāya punarārādhayaddharam / sa tāṃ śarvaprasādena labdhvā tu bhuvamāgatām
verses.translation: Thinking that his request had been disregarded by Varuna, Rama, the most excellent one among the wielders of weapons, looked at him angrily.
verses.wordMeaning: Thinking that his request had been disregarded by Varuna, Rama, the most excellent one among the wielders of weapons, looked at him angrily.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking that his request had been disregarded by Varuna, Rama, the most excellent one among the wielders of weapons, looked at him angrily.

verses.sanskrit: आनिन्ये सागरा दग्धा यत्र तां वै दिशं प्रति । सऽनुव्रजन्ती राजानं राजर्षेर्यजतः पथि
verses.transliteration: āninye sāgarā dagdhā yatra tāṃ vai diśaṃ prati / sa'nuvrajantī rājānaṃ rājarṣeryajataḥ pathi
verses.translation: Being much infuriated, he assumed a form similar to that of agitated ocean and wished to make the ocean devoid of waters by resorting to his own inherent power.
verses.wordMeaning: Being much infuriated, he assumed a form similar to that of agitated ocean and wished to make the ocean devoid of waters by resorting to his own inherent power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being much infuriated, he assumed a form similar to that of agitated ocean and wished to make the ocean devoid of waters by resorting to his own inherent power.

verses.sanskrit: तद्यज्ञवाटमखिलं प्लावयामास सर्वतः । स तु राजऋषिः क्रुद्धो यज्ञवाटे ऽखिले तया
verses.transliteration: tadyajñavāṭamakhilaṃ plāvayāmāsa sarvataḥ / sa tu rājaṛṣiḥ kruddho yajñavāṭe 'khile tayā
verses.translation: His terrifying body seen standing within the circle made by the bow the string of which was drawn upto his ears, became unapproachable to all.
verses.wordMeaning: His terrifying body seen standing within the circle made by the bow the string of which was drawn upto his ears, became unapproachable to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: His terrifying body seen standing within the circle made by the bow the string of which was drawn upto his ears, became unapproachable to all.

verses.sanskrit: मग्ने गण्डूषजलवत्स पपौ तामशेषतः । अतन्द्रितो वर्षशतं शुश्रूषितवा स तं पुनः
verses.transliteration: magne gaṇḍūṣajalavatsa papau tāmaśeṣataḥ / atandrito varṣaśataṃ śuśrūṣitavā sa taṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: His terrible form as he drew the bow was like the halo-encircled disc of the sun, rising at the close of Kalpa.
verses.wordMeaning: His terrible form as he drew the bow was like the halo-encircled disc of the sun, rising at the close of Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: His terrible form as he drew the bow was like the halo-encircled disc of the sun, rising at the close of Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रसन्नान्नृपतिर्लेमे गङ्गां महात्मनः । उषित्वा सुचिरं तस्यनिसृता जठराद्यतः
verses.transliteration: tasmātprasannānnṛpatirleme gaṅgāṃ mahātmanaḥ / uṣitvā suciraṃ tasyanisṛtā jaṭharādyataḥ
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: वही मदिरा का सिन्धु शक्तियों के समूहों को तृप्त करेगा । समर के उत्साह करने वाले महान आत्मा वाले उसी को आदेश दो । बह समस्त तर्ष का प्रशमन करने (वाला है ओर महान बल के बढ़ानेवाला है
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथितं जाह्नवीत्यस्यास्ततो नामाभवद्भुवि । भगीरथानुगा भूत्वा तत्पितॄणामशेषतः
verses.transliteration: prathitaṃ jāhnavītyasyāstato nāmābhavadbhuvi / bhagīrathānugā bhūtvā tatpitṝṇāmaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: हुईं थी चक्रेश्वरो ने रथ में सुधा के सिन्धु को आज्ञा देकर बुलाया था ।५८ वह मद से असस और रक्त नेतरों वाला था-हेम के समान उसकी आभा थी माजाओं से यह भूषित था ।५९। उसकी आज्ञा के पालक उसने दण्डनाथा को प्रणाम किया था ।६०। उसने अनेक प्रकार का
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: निजांभसास्थिभस्मानि सिषेच सुरनिम्नगा । ततस्तदंभसा सिक्तेष्वस्थिभस्मसु तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: nijāṃbhasāsthibhasmāni siṣeca suranimnagā / tatastadaṃbhasā sikteṣvasthibhasmasu tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: अपना स्वरूप बना लिया था-कहीं तो तरुण सूर्य के समान बह पाटल था और कहीं पर तापिच्छ के तुल्य श्यामल था और कहीं पर धवल कान्ति बाला था ।६१। इस सिस्थुराज ने वायु के द्वारा अधिक होकर हाथी के सूड के समान आकार वाली करोड़ों घाराए' वर्षायी थीं ।६२। कल्प के क्षय के
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: निरयात्सागराः सर्वे नष्टपापा दिवं ययुः । एवं सा सागरान्सर्वान्दिवं नीत्वा महान्दी
verses.transliteration: nirayātsāgarāḥ sarve naṣṭapāpā divaṃ yayuḥ / evaṃ sā sāgarānsarvāndivaṃ nītvā mahāndī
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: समय पुष्कलावत्तंक आदि बलाहकों से निषिच्यमान शक्तियों के मध्य में बहू सागर गिरा था
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव मार्गेण जवात्प्रयाता पूर्वसागरम् । सेनोर्मूर्ध्नश्चतुर्भेदा भूत्वा याता चतुर्द्दिशम्
verses.transliteration: tenaiva mārgeṇa javātprayātā pūrvasāgaram / senormūrdhnaścaturbhedā bhūtvā yātā caturddiśam
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भेदतया चाभूत्तस्या नाम्नां चतुष्टयम् । सीता चालकनन्दा च सुचक्षुर्भद्रवत्यपि
verses.transliteration: caturbhedatayā cābhūttasyā nāmnāṃ catuṣṭayam / sītā cālakanandā ca sucakṣurbhadravatyapi
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यपीतसलिलाच्चिरं शुष्कोदका अपि । गङ्गांभसा पुनः पूर्णाश्चत्वारो ऽम्बुधयो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: agastyapītasalilācciraṃ śuṣkodakā api / gaṅgāṃbhasā punaḥ pūrṇāścatvāro 'mbudhayo 'bhavan
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमाणे समुद्रे तु सागरैः परिवर्द्धिते । अन्तर्हिताभवन्देशा बहवस्तत्समीपगाः
verses.transliteration: pūrvamāṇe samudre tu sāgaraiḥ parivarddhite / antarhitābhavandeśā bahavastatsamīpagāḥ
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: जिसकी गनध मात्र से हो मृत प्राणी स्पष्ट उठकर खड़ा हो जाया करता है ओर जो दुर्बल होता है वह प्रवल हो जाया करता है वह सुराम्बुधि वर्षा था ॥६४ परार्थ संख्या से अतीत मधु धाराओं को परम्पराए' थीं उनका पान करती हुईं पिपासा से आत्तंमुखों से उनने पान किया था और
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रोपान्तवर्त्तीनि क्षेत्राणि च समन्ततः । इतस्ततः प्रयाताश्च जनास्तन्निलया नृप
verses.transliteration: samudropāntavarttīni kṣetrāṇi ca samantataḥ / itastataḥ prayātāśca janāstannilayā nṛpa
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: के शक्तियां उठकर खड़ो हो गयो थो ।६५। उस सेना के चारों ओर ऐसा एक प्रकार का मण्डल था कि जिससे वह मदिरा सिन्धु की वृष्टि दरयो पर न जाकर पड़ जावे ।६६। कदम्ब वन वासिनी ने लघु हस्तता से छोड़े गये सहस्रों शरों से विस्मयकरी किया था ।६७। उस कर्मे से सभी मरुत विस्मित
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णमिति च क्षेत्रं पूर्वं प्रोक्तं तु यत्तव । अर्मवोपात्तवर्त्तित्वात्समुद्रे ऽतर्द्धिमागमत्
verses.transliteration: gokarṇamiti ca kṣetraṃ pūrvaṃ proktaṃ tu yattava / armavopāttavarttitvātsamudre 'tarddhimāgamat
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: हो गये थे । इसके अनन्तर उत्त शक्तियों ने रण के मध्य में पान बहुत किया था ।६८। अनेक मदिरा की धाराए' बल ओर उत्साह के बधेन करने वाली थीं । जिस-जिस के मन की जो-जो भी प्रीति थी वेसो-बैसी ही पी थी
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तन्निलयाः सर्वे तदुद्धाराभिकाङ्क्षिणः । सह्याद्रेर्भृगुशार्दूलं द्रष्टुकामा ययुर्नृप
verses.transliteration: tatastannilayāḥ sarve taduddhārābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ / sahyādrerbhṛguśārdūlaṃ draṣṭukāmā yayurnṛpa
verses.translation: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.hindi: तीसरे युद्ध के दिन में दो प्रहर की अवधि तक सुराम्वुधि ने निरन्तर मद्य की धाराओं से वर्षा की धी
verses.wordMeaning: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he shook with anger, his body, which was terrible with its flames like the fire at the end of Kalpa, appeared like the circular face of Visnu's discus.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे गङ्गानयनं नाम षट्पञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः जैमिनिरुवाच ततः शुष्कसुमित्राद्या मुनयः शंसितव्रताः । ययुर्दिदृक्षवो रामं महेन्द्रमचलं प्रति
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde gaṅgānayanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ jaiminiruvāca tataḥ śuṣkasumitrādyā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / yayurdidṛkṣavo rāmaṃ mahendramacalaṃ prati
verses.translation: People were delighted with other's merits. They were eager to have contacts with good people. They bowed down to elderly people and always indulged in learning good things.
verses.hindi: गौडी पैष्टी च माध्वी च वरा कादम्बरी तथा ।
verses.wordMeaning: People were delighted with other's merits. They were eager to have contacts with good people. They bowed down to elderly people and always indulged in learning good things.
verses.commentary: Sense: People were delighted with other's merits. They were eager to have contacts with good people. They bowed down to elderly people and always indulged in learning good things.

verses.sanskrit: अतीत्य सुबहून्देशान्वनानि सरितस्तथा । आसेदुरचलश्रेष्ठं क्रमेण मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: atītya subahūndeśānvanāni saritastathā / āseduracalaśreṣṭhaṃ krameṇa munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: They were afraid of slanderous remarks of others. They were always delighted in the amorous sports with only their own wives. By nature they desisted from associating with wicked people. They adhered to righteous activities.
verses.wordMeaning: They were afraid of slanderous remarks of others. They were always delighted in the amorous sports with only their own wives. By nature they desisted from associating with wicked people. They adhered to righteous activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were afraid of slanderous remarks of others. They were always delighted in the amorous sports with only their own wives. By nature they desisted from associating with wicked people. They adhered to righteous activities.

verses.sanskrit: तमारुह्य शनैस्तस्यख्यातमाश्रममण्डलम् । प्रशान्तक्रूरसत्त्वाढ्यं शुभं मध्ये तपोवनम्
verses.transliteration: tamāruhya śanaistasyakhyātamāśramamaṇḍalam / praśāntakrūrasattvāḍhyaṃ śubhaṃ madhye tapovanam
verses.translation: His assembly-hall brilliantly illuminated by plenty of gems and jewels shone like that of Sakra (Indra) in heaven. As Indra's assembly was occupied by the Devas on seats decorated with precious stones, so his hall was occupied by hundreds of kings and the overlords of eighteen Masalas (zones or political divisions). They used to visit him in order
verses.wordMeaning: His assembly-hall brilliantly illuminated by plenty of gems and jewels shone like that of Sakra (Indra) in heaven. As Indra's assembly was occupied by the Devas on seats decorated with precious stones,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His assembly-hall brilliantly illuminated by plenty of gems and jewels shone like that of Sakra (Indra) in heaven. As Indra's assembly was occupied by the Devas on seats decorated with precious stones,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वर्त्तुफलपुष्पाढ्यतरुखण्डमनोहरम् । स्निग्धच्छायमनौपम्यं स्वामोदिसुखमारुतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvarttuphalapuṣpāḍhyatarukhaṇḍamanoharam / snigdhacchāyamanaupamyaṃ svāmodisukhamārutam
verses.translation: Due to excessive friction of the scries of crowns of kings who were bowing at his feet, the feet of that king appeared to have got scarred thereby.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to excessive friction of the scries of crowns of kings who were bowing at his feet, the feet of that king appeared to have got scarred thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to excessive friction of the scries of crowns of kings who were bowing at his feet, the feet of that king appeared to have got scarred thereby.

verses.sanskrit: तं तदाश्रममासाद्य ब्रह्मघोषेण नादितम् । विविशुर्त्दृष्टमनसो यथावृद्धपुरस्सरम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ tadāśramamāsādya brahmaghoṣeṇa nāditam / viviśurtdṛṣṭamanaso yathāvṛddhapurassaram
verses.translation: His assembly hall shone like the cave of Sumeru, due to the precious gems and jewels scattered all round, by the groups of leading kings who had to attend on him.
verses.wordMeaning: His assembly hall shone like the cave of Sumeru, due to the precious gems and jewels scattered all round, by the groups of leading kings who had to attend on him.
verses.commentary: Sense: His assembly hall shone like the cave of Sumeru, due to the precious gems and jewels scattered all round, by the groups of leading kings who had to attend on him.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मासने सुखासीनं मृदुकृष्णाजिनोत्तरे । शिष्यैः परिवृतं शान्तं ददृशुस्ते तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: brahmāsane sukhāsīnaṃ mṛdukṛṣṇājinottare / śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ śāntaṃ dadṛśuste tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Thus righteously ruled that king, the crest-jewel of the solar race, the suppressor of his enemies. He ruled over the earth with no one else to rule it (except king Sagara).
verses.wordMeaning: Thus righteously ruled that king, the crest-jewel of the solar race, the suppressor of his enemies. He ruled over the earth with no one else to rule it (except king Sagara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus righteously ruled that king, the crest-jewel of the solar race, the suppressor of his enemies. He ruled over the earth with no one else to rule it (except king Sagara).

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्निमिव लोकांस्त्रीन्दग्ध्वा पूर्वं निजेच्छया । तद्दोषशान्त्यै तपसि प्रवृत्तमिव् देहिनम्
verses.transliteration: kālāgnimiva lokāṃstrīndagdhvā pūrvaṃ nijecchayā / taddoṣaśāntyai tapasi pravṛttamiv dehinam
verses.translation: Though king Sagara protected the earth thus, he never had the pleasure that usually results on looking at one's own son.
verses.wordMeaning: Though king Sagara protected the earth thus, he never had the pleasure that usually results on looking at one's own son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though king Sagara protected the earth thus, he never had the pleasure that usually results on looking at one's own son.

verses.sanskrit: ते समेत्य भृगुश्रेष्ठं विनयाचारशालिनः । ववन्दिरे महामौनं भक्तिप्रणतकन्धराः
verses.transliteration: te sametya bhṛguśreṣṭhaṃ vinayācāraśālinaḥ / vavandire mahāmaunaṃ bhaktipraṇatakandharāḥ
verses.translation: The king entered the penance-grove. All around it consisted of many trees where the blossoms had not faded, the fruits of which were tasty, that had a grassy grounds all round and which had plenty of tender sprouts and cool shades.
verses.hindi: सुरा कितनी ही प्रकार की थीं । अब उनके प्रकारों को बताया जाता है-गोड़ी-पष्टी-माध्वी-बरा-कादम्बरी-हैताली-लाङ्लेया- और ताल जाता. सुराए" थी ।७१। कल्प वृक्ष से समुत्पल्त-दिव्या-अनेक देशों में उत्पन्ना थो । ये सुन्दर स्वाद वाली और सौरभ बाली थीं और इनसे शुभ
verses.wordMeaning: The king entered the penance-grove. All around it consisted of many trees where the blossoms had not faded, the fruits of which were tasty, that had a grassy grounds all round and which had plenty of tender sprouts and cool shades.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king entered the penance-grove. All around it consisted of many trees where the blossoms had not faded, the fruits of which were tasty, that had a grassy grounds all round and which had plenty of tender sprouts and cool shades.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तानागतान्दृष्ट्वा मुनीन्भृगुकुलोद्वहः । अर्घपाद्यादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयामास सादरम्
verses.transliteration: tatastānāgatāndṛṣṭvā munīnbhṛgukulodvahaḥ / arghapādyādibhiḥ samyakpūjayāmāsa sādaram
verses.translation: All around, in every quarter, the cuckoos cooed loudly and sweetly, as their throats became clear due to their having tasted the tender sprouts at the tips of the mango trees.
verses.hindi: गन्ध निकलती थी ।७२। बकुल के प्रसवा-आमोदा-ध्वनम्ती-बुदुबुदा-- उज्ज्वला थी । कटुका-कपाया-मधुरा-तिक्तता के स्पर्श वाली थी ।७डी बहुत वर्णो से समाविष्टा-छेदिनो-पिच्छला-ईषद् अम्ला-कट्वम्लार-तथा मधुराम्खा थी ।७४। शस्त्र से होने वाले क्षत के रोग का हनन करने वाली--
verses.wordMeaning: All around, in every quarter, the cuckoos cooed loudly and sweetly, as their throats became clear due to their having tasted the tender sprouts at the tips of the mango trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: All around, in every quarter, the cuckoos cooed loudly and sweetly, as their throats became clear due to their having tasted the tender sprouts at the tips of the mango trees.

verses.sanskrit: तानासीनान्कृतातिथ्यानृषीन्देशान्तरागतान् । उवाच भृगुशार्दूलः स्मितपूर्वमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration: tānāsīnānkṛtātithyānṛṣīndeśāntarāgatān / uvāca bhṛguśārdūlaḥ smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: The quarters were filled with gentle breezes wafting slowly over the lakes abounding in lotuses and lilies of various sorts.
verses.hindi: अस्थियों के सन्धात को देने वालो-लच्ची और कवोष्टका थी ।७४। सन्ताप का हरण करने वालो तथा बारुणी-जय प्रदान करने बाली--इस तरह से उस सुधाेव ने अनेक प्रकार की सुराओं की घोराओं की वर्षा की थी
verses.wordMeaning: The quarters were filled with gentle breezes wafting slowly over the lakes abounding in lotuses and lilies of various sorts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The quarters were filled with gentle breezes wafting slowly over the lakes abounding in lotuses and lilies of various sorts.

verses.sanskrit: स्वागतं वो महाभागा यूयं सर्वे समागताः । करणीयं किमस्माभिर्वदध्वमविचारितम्
verses.transliteration: svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgā yūyaṃ sarve samāgatāḥ / karaṇīyaṃ kimasmābhirvadadhvamavicāritam
verses.translation: Proceeding ahead thus in his chariot along the penance grove that had the qualities described above, the king attained the greatest delight.
verses.hindi: बहाँ पर एक-एक योगिनी ने एक प्रहर तक अविच्छिन्न रूप से ऐरावत करप्रख्या सुरा को धारा को आनन्द के साथ पान किया था ।
verses.wordMeaning: Proceeding ahead thus in his chariot along the penance grove that had the qualities described above, the king attained the greatest delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Proceeding ahead thus in his chariot along the penance grove that had the qualities described above, the king attained the greatest delight.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते मुनयो रामं प्रणम्येदमथाब्रुवन् । अवेह्यस्मान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ गोकर्णनिलयान्मुनीन्
verses.transliteration: tataste munayo rāmaṃ praṇamyedamathābruvan / avehyasmānmuniśreṣṭha gokarṇanilayānmunīn
verses.translation: Having reached the precincts of the hermitage, his mind attained calmness. The glorious king then got down accompanied by his wives.
verses.wordMeaning: Having reached the precincts of the hermitage, his mind attained calmness. The glorious king then got down accompanied by his wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having reached the precincts of the hermitage, his mind attained calmness. The glorious king then got down accompanied by his wives.

verses.sanskrit: खनद्भिः सागरैर्भूमिं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे । सतीर्थं तन्महाक्षेत्रं पतितं सागरांभसि
verses.transliteration: khanadbhiḥ sāgarairbhūmiṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare / satīrthaṃ tanmahākṣetraṃ patitaṃ sāgarāṃbhasi
verses.translation: "Let the horses rest" — so said the king to the charioteer. Then he came to the outskirts of the hermitage of •the great sage of sanctified soul.
verses.wordMeaning: "Let the horses rest" — so said the king to the charioteer. Then he came to the outskirts of the hermitage of •the great sage of sanctified soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Let the horses rest" — so said the king to the charioteer. Then he came to the outskirts of the hermitage of •the great sage of sanctified soul.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सारितार्मवजलं क्षेत्रं तत्सर्वपावनम् । उपलब्धुमभीप्सामो भवतस्तु न संशयः
verses.transliteration: utsāritārmavajalaṃ kṣetraṃ tatsarvapāvanam / upalabdhumabhīpsāmo bhavatastu na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: From the disciples of the sage, he heard that the sage had concluded his daily routine of holy rites. In order to see the sage, he then entered the hermitage with an humble attitude.
verses.wordMeaning: From the disciples of the sage, he heard that the sage had concluded his daily routine of holy rites. In order to see the sage, he then entered the hermitage with an humble attitude.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the disciples of the sage, he heard that the sage had concluded his daily routine of holy rites. In order to see the sage, he then entered the hermitage with an humble attitude.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरंशेन संजातो भवान्भृगुकुले किल । तस्मात्कर्तुमशक्यं ते त्रैलोक्ये ऽपि न किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoraṃśena saṃjāto bhavānbhṛgukule kila / tasmātkartumaśakyaṃ te trailokye 'pi na kiñcana
verses.translation: Accompanied by his wives, the king delightfully bowed down his head to the great sage seated in the middle of the sages and accompanied by groups of ascetics.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by his wives, the king delightfully bowed down his head to the great sage seated in the middle of the sages and accompanied by groups of ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his wives, the king delightfully bowed down his head to the great sage seated in the middle of the sages and accompanied by groups of ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: वाञ्छितार्थप्रदो लोके त्वमेवेत्यनुशुश्रुम । वयं त्वामागताः सर्वे रामैतदभियाचितुम्
verses.transliteration: vāñchitārthaprado loke tvamevetyanuśuśruma / vayaṃ tvāmāgatāḥ sarve rāmaitadabhiyācitum
verses.translation: Sage Aurva of great power and potentiality, directed the king who bowed down to him along with them (i.e. the two queens) to take his seat saying lovingly — "Sit down".
verses.wordMeaning: Sage Aurva of great power and potentiality, directed the king who bowed down to him along with them (i.e. the two queens) to take his seat saying lovingly — "Sit down".
verses.commentary: Sense: Sage Aurva of great power and potentiality, directed the king who bowed down to him along with them (i.e. the two queens) to take his seat saying lovingly — "Sit down".

verses.sanskrit: स त्वमात्मप्रभावेण क्षेत्रप्रवरमद्य तत् । दातुमर्हसि विप्रेन्द्र समुत्सार्यार्मवोदकम्
verses.transliteration: sa tvamātmaprabhāveṇa kṣetrapravaramadya tat / dātumarhasi viprendra samutsāryārmavodakam
verses.translation: After honouring him very well by means of Arghya, Pddya etc. the great sage pleased him along with his wives by
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring him very well by means of Arghya, Pddya etc. the great sage pleased him along with his wives by
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring him very well by means of Arghya, Pddya etc. the great sage pleased him along with his wives by

verses.sanskrit: राम उवाच एतत्सर्वमशेषण विदितं मे तपोधनाः । करणीयं च वः कृत्यं मया नात्र विचारणा
verses.transliteration: rāma uvāca etatsarvamaśeṣaṇa viditaṃ me tapodhanāḥ / karaṇīyaṃ ca vaḥ kṛtyaṃ mayā nātra vicāraṇā
verses.translation: After the hospitable reception, the king took rest for a while. Thereupon, he bowed to him and sat in front of him. Aurva then addressed the following gentle words to the king.
verses.wordMeaning: After the hospitable reception, the king took rest for a while. Thereupon, he bowed to him and sat in front of him. Aurva then addressed the following gentle words to the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the hospitable reception, the king took rest for a while. Thereupon, he bowed to him and sat in front of him. Aurva then addressed the following gentle words to the king.

verses.sanskrit: किं तु युष्मदभिप्रेतं कर्म लोके सुदारुणम् । शस्त्रसंग्रहणाच्छक्यं मयापि न तदन्यथा
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tu yuṣmadabhipretaṃ karma loke sudāruṇam / śastrasaṃgrahaṇācchakyaṃ mayāpi na tadanyathā
verses.translation: "I hope that your kingdom is all right externally and internally. I hope that you protect all your subjects righteously.
verses.hindi: शक्तियों ने अपने मुख को ऊपर की ओर उठाकर चञ्चल रसना बाली होते हुए अपनी आंखों को म् देकर आनन्द से उस चल सुरा कां पान किया था ।७८ इस रीति से उस सुधार्बुद्घि ने बहुत तरह के माध्वी की धाराओं के पातों से तृप्त करके दिव्य रूप में समास्थित हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: "I hope that your kingdom is all right externally and internally. I hope that you protect all your subjects righteously.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I hope that your kingdom is all right externally and internally. I hope that you protect all your subjects righteously.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तसर्वाभयो ऽहं वै न्यस्तशस्त्रः शमान्वितः । तपः समास्थितश्चर्तु प्रागेव पितृ शासनात्
verses.transliteration: dattasarvābhayo 'haṃ vai nyastaśastraḥ śamānvitaḥ / tapaḥ samāsthitaścartu prāgeva pitṛ śāsanāt
verses.translation: I hope that you yearn properly to win over the trivarga (three aims in life viz. Dharma, Artha and Kdma) by means of proper expedients. I hope ail the expedients in politic (such as alliance, war, diplomacy and others) are well practised by you and they yield proper results to you.
verses.hindi: फिर बह सुराम्दुधि दण्डनावा को प्रणाम करके परम स्निख और गम्भीर ध्वनि से उस देवी से यह वाकय बोला था ।८०। है महाराज्ञि ! है देवि ! है दण्ड मण्डलनायिके ! आप देख लीजिए । मैंने मुग्धरूप वाली शक्तियों की सेना को भली-भाति तृप्त कर दिया है ।८१। उनमें कुछ तो नृत्य कर रही
verses.wordMeaning: I hope that you yearn properly to win over the trivarga (three aims in life viz. Dharma, Artha and Kdma) by means of proper expedients. I hope ail the expedients in politic (such as alliance, war,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I hope that you yearn properly to win over the trivarga (three aims in life viz. Dharma, Artha and Kdma) by means of proper expedients. I hope ail the expedients in politic (such as alliance, war,…

verses.sanskrit: न जातु शस्त्रग्रहणं करिष्यामीत्यहं पुरा । प्रतिश्रुत्य सतां मध्ये तपः कर्त्तुमिहानघाः
verses.transliteration: na jātu śastragrahaṇaṃ kariṣyāmītyahaṃ purā / pratiśrutya satāṃ madhye tapaḥ karttumihānaghāḥ
verses.translation: Fortunately, O excellent king, all the enemies have been conquered by you. How glad I am that the entire kingdom is righteously protected by you.
verses.hindi: हैं कुछ कल क्वणित मेखलाओं बाली गान कर रहीं हैं। नृत्य करने वाली शक्तियों के आगे कुछ करों से ताल दे रही हैं ८९) कुछ व्यावल्गबल्गु उरोजमण्डलों वाली हेस रही है । कुछ आनन्दद्रेक में मन्थर होती हुई परस्पर में अ गो में पतन कर रही हैं।८३। कुछ अपनी श्रोणियों पर से
verses.wordMeaning: Fortunately, O excellent king, all the enemies have been conquered by you. How glad I am that the entire kingdom is righteously protected by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fortunately, O excellent king, all the enemies have been conquered by you. How glad I am that the entire kingdom is righteously protected by you.

verses.sanskrit: शस्त्रग्रहणसाध्यत्वाद्युष्मदीप्सितवस्तुनः । किङ्कर्त्तव्यं मयात्रेति मम डोलायते मनः
verses.transliteration: śastragrahaṇasādhyatvādyuṣmadīpsitavastunaḥ / kiṅkarttavyaṃ mayātreti mama ḍolāyate manaḥ
verses.translation: I have already heard that you have arrived at your capital along with your army after conquering the whole of the earth and that you have married.
verses.hindi: गिरते हुए मेखलाम्वरों काली वल्ग कर रही है। कुछ उठाकर सन्नद्ध हो रही हैं और विना हो आयुर्धों के धूर्णन कर रही हं
verses.wordMeaning: I have already heard that you have arrived at your capital along with your army after conquering the whole of the earth and that you have married.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have already heard that you have arrived at your capital along with your army after conquering the whole of the earth and that you have married.

verses.sanskrit: शुष्क उपाच । सतां संरक्षणार्थाय शस्त्रसंग्रहणं तु यत् । तन्नच्यावयते सत्यद्यथोक्तं ब्रह्मणा पुरा
verses.transliteration: śuṣka upāca / satāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya śastrasaṃgrahaṇaṃ tu yat / tannacyāvayate satyadyathoktaṃ brahmaṇā purā
verses.translation: How can I, who have been formerly trained in such a manner in wielding missiles and weapons by you, be incap- able of restraining all the enemies now?
verses.hindi: अवलोक्य भृशं तुश दण्डिनी तमुवाच ह
verses.wordMeaning: How can I, who have been formerly trained in such a manner in wielding missiles and weapons by you, be incap- able of restraining all the enemies now?
verses.commentary: Sense: How can I, who have been formerly trained in such a manner in wielding missiles and weapons by you, be incap- able of restraining all the enemies now?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादस्मद्धितार्थाय भवता ग्राह्यमायुधम् । धर्म एव महांस्तेन चरितस्ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmādasmaddhitārthāya bhavatā grāhyamāyudham / dharma eva mahāṃstena caritaste bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: You arc my preceptor, friend, and well-wisher, deity and kinsman. Nor do I know anyone else as my father except you.
verses.wordMeaning: You arc my preceptor, friend, and well-wisher, deity and kinsman. Nor do I know anyone else as my father except you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc my preceptor, friend, and well-wisher, deity and kinsman. Nor do I know anyone else as my father except you.

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच एवं संप्रार्थ्यमानस्तु मुनिभिर्भृगुपुङ्गवः । तमनुद्रुत्य मेधावी धर्ममुद्दिश्य केवलम्
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca evaṃ saṃprārthyamānastu munibhirbhṛgupuṅgavaḥ / tamanudrutya medhāvī dharmamuddiśya kevalam
verses.translation: All the kings were defeated by me through the mis- siles, the use of which has been taught by you. It is the power of your penance, remembering which, all of them had been defeated by me.
verses.hindi: अतः परं मत्प्रसादादद्वापरे याज्ञिकेर्खे । सोमपानवदत्यंतमुपयोज्यो भविष्यसि
verses.wordMeaning: All the kings were defeated by me through the mis- siles, the use of which has been taught by you. It is the power of your penance, remembering which, all of them had been defeated by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the kings were defeated by me through the mis- siles, the use of which has been taught by you. It is the power of your penance, remembering which, all of them had been defeated by me.

verses.sanskrit: स तैः सह मुनिश्रेष्ठो दिशं दक्षिणपश्चिमाम् । समुद्दिश्य चचौ राजन्द्रष्टुकामः सरित्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: sa taiḥ saha muniśreṣṭho diśaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimām / samuddiśya cacau rājandraṣṭukāmaḥ saritpatim
verses.translation: By means of your penance, you sanctify and protect the entire universe. Undoubtedly you are capable of creating and annihilating it also.
verses.wordMeaning: By means of your penance, you sanctify and protect the entire universe. Undoubtedly you are capable of creating and annihilating it also.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of your penance, you sanctify and protect the entire universe. Undoubtedly you are capable of creating and annihilating it also.

verses.sanskrit: स सह्यमचलश्रेष्ठमवतीर्य भृगूद्वहः । तत्परं सरितां पत्युस्तीरं प्राप महामनाः
verses.transliteration: sa sahyamacalaśreṣṭhamavatīrya bhṛgūdvahaḥ / tatparaṃ saritāṃ patyustīraṃ prāpa mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: O holy lord, in your penance-grove, ever since its infancy the fawn, slowly but unhesitatingly approaches the seat of the lion and drinks water.
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, in your penance-grove, ever since its infancy the fawn, slowly but unhesitatingly approaches the seat of the lion and drinks water.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, in your penance-grove, ever since its infancy the fawn, slowly but unhesitatingly approaches the seat of the lion and drinks water.

verses.sanskrit: स ददर्श महाभागः परितो मारुताकुलम् । आकरं सर्वरत्नानां पूर्यमाणमनारतम्
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa mahābhāgaḥ parito mārutākulam / ākaraṃ sarvaratnānāṃ pūryamāṇamanāratam
verses.translation: Here, due to full confidence, even a slim delicate hind offers her udder to her young one. The Ruru deer removes the itching sensation of its cheek at the tip of the horns of the black deer.
verses.hindi: इस तरह से दिखाई गयीं उन शक्तियों को देखकर जो मैरेय सीधु से आनन्दित हो रही थीं दण्डिनी अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुई थी और उससे कहा था ।=५ है मद्यान्धे ! मैं बहुत ही यदि तुष्ट हुई हैं। आपने हमारी सहायता की है। यह देव कायं है इसको आपने विघ्न रहित कर दिया है ।८६। अब
verses.wordMeaning: Here, due to full confidence, even a slim delicate hind offers her udder to her young one. The Ruru deer removes the itching sensation of its cheek at the tip of the horns of the black deer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here, due to full confidence, even a slim delicate hind offers her udder to her young one. The Ruru deer removes the itching sensation of its cheek at the tip of the horns of the black deer.

verses.sanskrit: अपरिज्ञेयगांभीर्यं महातामिव मानसम् । दुष्पारपारं सर्वस्य विविधग्रहसंहतिम्
verses.transliteration: aparijñeyagāṃbhīryaṃ mahātāmiva mānasam / duṣpārapāraṃ sarvasya vividhagrahasaṃhatim
verses.translation: In order to sustain itself, a tigress killed a hind which had recently given birth to its fawn, in another forest. But the same tigress nurtures the young ones of that hind in your pen- ance grove.
verses.hindi: इससे आगे द्वापर युग में मेरे प्रसाद से म में याज्ञिकों के द्वारा सोम के पान के हो समान आप अत्यन्त उपयोग के योग्य होगे ।5७। समस्त देवगण याग में मन्त्र से पूत करके इसका पान किया करेंगे। यागों में मन्त्र से पवित्र का पात भक्तजन करेंगे ।८८। इसके प्रभाव से सिद्धि-ऋद्धि-स्वगं--अपवर्गं
verses.wordMeaning: In order to sustain itself, a tigress killed a hind which had recently given birth to its fawn, in another forest. But the same tigress nurtures the young ones of that hind in your pen- ance grove.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to sustain itself, a tigress killed a hind which had recently given birth to its fawn, in another forest. But the same tigress nurtures the young ones of that hind in your pen- ance grove.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रधृष्य तमं लोके धातारमिव केवलम् । आत्मानमिव चात्मत्वे न्यक्कृताखिलमुद्धतम्
verses.transliteration: apradhṛṣya tamaṃ loke dhātāramiva kevalam / ātmānamiva cātmatve nyakkṛtākhilamuddhatam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: को प्राप्त करेंगे । सहेश्वरो--महादेव--बलदेव--भागेव--दत्ता त्रेय--विधि- विष्णु--ऐसे महान सिद्धि जन भे तुम्हारा पान करेगे ।८९। याग में सम- वित तू सब प्रकार की प्रदान करोगी ।६०। इस प्रकार से वरदानके द्वारा सुराम्बुधि को तुष्ट किया या
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रयं सर्वसत्त्वानामापगानां च पार्थिवः । अत्यर्थचपलोत्तुगतरङ्गशतमालिनम्
verses.transliteration: āśrayaṃ sarvasattvānāmāpagānāṃ ca pārthivaḥ / atyarthacapalottugataraṅgaśatamālinam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: उपान्तोपलसंघातकुहरान्तरसंश्रयात् । विशीर्यमाणलहरीशतफेनौघसोभितम्
verses.transliteration: upāntopalasaṃghātakuharāntarasaṃśrayāt / viśīryamāṇalaharīśataphenaughasobhitam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: कदम्वगोलकाकारा हृष्टसर्वागहृष्टय: । युवराजस्य सैन्यानि शक्तयः समनाशयन्
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: गंभीरघोषं जलधिं पश्यन्मुनिगणैः सह । संसेव्यमानस्तरलैर्लहरीकणशीतलैः
verses.transliteration: gaṃbhīraghoṣaṃ jaladhiṃ paśyanmunigaṇaiḥ saha / saṃsevyamānastaralairlaharīkaṇaśītalaiḥ
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: थी और फिर शक्तियों का दानवों के साथ युद्ध प्रवृत्त हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्त्तमिव राजेन्द्र तीरेनदनदीपतेः । विशश्रमे महाबाहुर्द्रष्टुकामः प्रचेतसम्
verses.transliteration: muhūrttamiva rājendra tīrenadanadīpateḥ / viśaśrame mahābāhurdraṣṭukāmaḥ pracetasam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नता से अट्टहास जो उन्होंने किया था तो आठों दिशाओं को और धरा को हिला दिया था। नवीन मदिरा से मत्त हो गयो थीं और उनके लोचन पाटल वर्ण के थे। वे शक्तियाँ देत्यो के चक्र में एक ही हल्ला के साथ निपतित हो गयी थों ।६३। मद की श्री से सम्पन्न शक्तियों का युद्ध ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामः समुत्थाय दक्षिणाभिमुखः स्थितः । मेघगंभिरया वाचा वरुणं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tato rāmaḥ samutthāya dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ / meghagaṃbhirayā vācā varuṇaṃ vākyamabravīt

verses.hindi: हुआ था कि दो से दो हो भिड़ गयी थीं और शोभित हुई थीं। मद के राग से तो नेत्र लाल हो गयो थीं ओर देत्यों के रक्‍त से शस्त्र रक्‍त हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: अहं मुनिगणैः सार्द्धमागतस्त्वद्दिदृक्षया । तस्मात्स्वरूपधृङ्मह्यं प्रचेतो देहि दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ munigaṇaiḥ sārddhamāgatastvaddidṛkṣayā / tasmātsvarūpadhṛṅmahyaṃ praceto dehi darśanam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: स्वयं ही प्रजाओं का संहार करता हो ।६५। उनके चरणों के न्यास स्खलित हो रहे ये तथा मद से कुछ रक्‍त वर्ण के नेव हो रहे ये। बीरभाषा भी ऐसी थो कि उनमें अक्षरों का सन्दर्भ स्खलित हो रहा था। ऐसी वे रण में उद्धत हो गयी थीं ।६६। कदम्ब गोलक के आकार से युक्त और दृष्ट सर्वाद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वापि तद्वाक्यं वरुणो यादसां पतिः । न चचाल निजस्थानान्नृप धीरतरस्त्वयम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvāpi tadvākyaṃ varuṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ / na cacāla nijasthānānnṛpa dhīratarastvayam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: दृष्टि बाली शक्तियों ने युवराज की सेनाओं का विना कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पुनश्च रामेण समाहूतो ऽपि तोयराट् । न ददौ दर्शनं तस्मै प्रतिवाच्यं च नाभ्यधात्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ punaśca rāmeṇa samāhūto 'pi toyarāṭ / na dadau darśanaṃ tasmai prativācyaṃ ca nābhyadhāt

verses.hindi: उस दण्डिनो ने वह पर सो अक्षोहिणियों को विदीर्ण कर दिया था औरं डेढ़ सौ अक्षीहिणी का विनाश मन्त्रिणी ने कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्घनीयं तद्वाक्यं वरुणेनावधीरितम् । अत्यन्तमिति कार्यार्थी विदुषा समुपेक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: alaṅghanīyaṃ tadvākyaṃ varuṇenāvadhīritam / atyantamiti kāryārthī viduṣā samupekṣitam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रचेतसा वाक्यं मन्यमानो ऽवधीरितम् । चुकोप तमभिप्रेक्ष्य रामः शस्त्रभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pracetasā vākyaṃ manyamāno 'vadhīritam / cukopa tamabhiprekṣya rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: सम्पत्करी प्रभृतय: शक्तिदण्डाधिनायिकाः । परुवेण मुखान्यन्यान्यवरुद्धा व्यदारयत्
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: संक्षुब्धसागराकारः स तदा स्वबलाश्रयात् । निस्तोयमर्णवं कर्तुमियेष रुषितो भृशम्
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣubdhasāgarākāraḥ sa tadā svabalāśrayāt / nistoyamarṇavaṃ kartumiyeṣa ruṣito bhṛśam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जलमुपस्पृश्य समीपे विजयं धनुः । ततः प्रणम्य मनसा शर्वं रामो महाद्धनुः
verses.transliteration: tato jalamupaspṛśya samīpe vijayaṃ dhanuḥ / tataḥ praṇamya manasā śarvaṃ rāmo mahāddhanuḥ

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वारोपयामास क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । अभिमृश्य धनुःश्रेष्ठं सगुणं भृगुसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvāropayāmāsa krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / abhimṛśya dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ saguṇaṃ bhṛgusattamaḥ

verses.transliteration: paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jyāghoṣamakarottadā / jyāghoṣaḥ śuśruve tasya divispṛgatiniṣṭhuraḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: चचाल निखिलायेन सप्तद्वीपार्मवा मही । ततः सरभसं रामश्चापे कालानलोपमम्
verses.transliteration: cacāla nikhilāyena saptadvīpārmavā mahī / tataḥ sarabhasaṃ rāmaścāpe kālānalopamam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्मपुङ्खं विशिखं संदधे शरसत्तमम् । तस्मिन्नस्त्रं महाघोरं भार्गवं वह्निदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: suvarmapuṅkhaṃ viśikhaṃ saṃdadhe śarasattamam / tasminnastraṃ mahāghoraṃ bhārgavaṃ vahnidaivatam

verses.hindi: मद से अरुण लोचनों वाली अश्बारढ़ा आदि ने डेढ़ सी अक्षोहिणी को यमराज के पुर में भेज दिया था ।६६। अत्यन्त तीक्षण अ कुश से अश्वान रोहिणी ने युद्ध में उलूक जित् का उन्मथन करके उसे परलोक भेज दिया था ।१००। सम्पत्करी प्रभृति शक्ति दण्डाधिनायिओं ने कठोर प्रहार
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: युयोज भृगुशार्दूलः समन्त्राभ्यासमोक्षणम् । ततश्चचाल वसुधा सशैलवनकानना
verses.transliteration: yuyoja bhṛguśārdūlaḥ samantrābhyāsamokṣaṇam / tataścacāla vasudhā saśailavanakānanā

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षोभं परमं जग्मुर्देवासुरमहोरगाः । संधितास्त्रं भृगुश्रेष्ठं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनम्
