verses.sanskrit: त्वरयाभ्यायायौ शीघ्रसायकाद्भीतभीतवत् । अभ्येत्याकृष्टधनुषः स तस्य चरणाब्जयोः
verses.transliteration: tvarayābhyāyāyau śīghrasāyakādbhītabhītavat / abhyetyākṛṣṭadhanuṣaḥ sa tasya caraṇābjayoḥ
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: भारी दिलाप किया था ।६। दिकीणं केलों वाला वह मूच्छित होकर भूमि पर गिर गया था और भाइयों के दु ख से कणित होकर कुछ भो आश्वासन उसने प्राप्त नहीं किया या
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीच्च भृशं भीतः संभ्रमाकुलिताक्षरम् । रक्ष मां भृगुशार्दूल कृपया शरणागतम्
verses.transliteration: abravīcca bhṛśaṃ bhītaḥ saṃbhramākulitākṣaram / rakṣa māṃ bhṛguśārdūla kṛpayā śaraṇāgatam
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: अपराधमिमं राम मया कृतमजानता । स्थितो ऽस्मि तव निर्देशेशाधि किं करवाणि वै
verses.transliteration: aparādhamimaṃ rāma mayā kṛtamajānatā / sthito 'smi tava nirdeśeśādhi kiṃ karavāṇi vai
verses.translation: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.hindi: क्षिप्रं मुहुमु हः सपृष्ट्वा धुन्वान: करवालिकाम्
verses.wordMeaning: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A power of penance like this, striking the world with surprise, is not seen anywhere. O Brahmana, excepting in your case, it is difficult to be found elsewhere in the world.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे मध्यमभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवं प्रति वरुणागमनं नाम सप्तपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५७॥ जैमिनिरुवाच एवं ब्रुवाणं वरुणं विलोक्य पतितं भुवि । संजहार पुनर्धीमानस्त्रं मृगुकुलोद्वहः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe madhyamabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde bhārgavaṃ prati varuṇāgamanaṃ nāma saptapañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 57// jaiminiruvāca evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ varuṇaṃ vilokya patitaṃ bhuvi / saṃjahāra punardhīmānastraṃ mṛgukulodvahaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Varuna who said this and fell on the ground at his feet, the intelligent leading member of the family of Bhrgu, withdrew the missile.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Varuna who said this and fell on the ground at his feet, the intelligent leading member of the family of Bhrgu, withdrew the missile.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Varuna who said this and fell on the ground at his feet, the intelligent leading member of the family of Bhrgu, withdrew the missile.

verses.sanskrit: संत्दृतास्त्रस्ततो रामो वरुणं पुरतः स्थिरम् । विलोक्य बिगतक्रोधस्तमुवाच हसन्निव
verses.transliteration: saṃtdṛtāstrastato rāmo varuṇaṃ purataḥ sthiram / vilokya bigatakrodhastamuvāca hasanniva
verses.translation: After withdrawing the missile, Rama looked at Varuna standing in front of him. Anger having subsided, he said to him smilingly.
verses.wordMeaning: After withdrawing the missile, Rama looked at Varuna standing in front of him. Anger having subsided, he said to him smilingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: After withdrawing the missile, Rama looked at Varuna standing in front of him. Anger having subsided, he said to him smilingly.

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णनिलयाः पूर्वमिमेमां मुनिपुङ्गवाः । समायाता महेन्द्राद्रौ निवसंतं सरित्पते
verses.transliteration: gokarṇanilayāḥ pūrvamimemāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ / samāyātā mahendrādrau nivasaṃtaṃ saritpate
verses.translation: ''These leading sages who had their homes in Gokarna had come to me before, O lord of rivers, while I was staying on the mountain Mahendra.
verses.wordMeaning: ''These leading sages who had their homes in Gokarna had come to me before, O lord of rivers, while I was staying on the mountain Mahendra.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''These leading sages who had their homes in Gokarna had come to me before, O lord of rivers, while I was staying on the mountain Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तोये मेदिनीं पूर्वं खनद्भिः सगरात्मजैः । अधो निपातितं क्षेत्रं गोकर्णमृषिसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: tvattoye medinīṃ pūrvaṃ khanadbhiḥ sagarātmajaiḥ / adho nipātitaṃ kṣetraṃ gokarṇamṛṣisevitam
verses.translation: The holy spot Gokarna inhabited by the sages was caused to fall down into your waters formerly, by the sons of Sagara who were digging the Earth.
verses.hindi: बह बार-बार प्रलविलाप कर रहा था तव कुटिलाक्ष ने उसको आश्वांसन दिया था । जब बहुत कुछ समझाया तो शोक से युक्त उसने क्रोध किया था ।८। उसने अत्यन्त क्रूर फाल को ग्रहण किया था और अपनी भूकुटियों को तिरी करके बहुत हो भीषण हो गया था। उसकी आँखें
verses.wordMeaning: The holy spot Gokarna inhabited by the sages was caused to fall down into your waters formerly, by the sons of Sagara who were digging the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy spot Gokarna inhabited by the sages was caused to fall down into your waters formerly, by the sons of Sagara who were digging the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: उपलब्धुमिमे भूयः क्षेत्रं तद्भववल्लभम् । अधावन्मामुपागम्य मुनयस्तीर्थवासिनः
verses.transliteration: upalabdhumime bhūyaḥ kṣetraṃ tadbhavavallabham / adhāvanmāmupāgamya munayastīrthavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: After having approached me, those sages, the resi- dents of that holy place have rushed down here to regain once again that holy spot which is very dear to Siva.
verses.hindi: अङ्गारो के समान रक्त हो गयो थों और वह काले सर्प को तरह फुद्धारे मार रहा था ।। फिर सब सेनाओं के स्वामी कुटिलाक्ष से शीघ्र ही बोला चा और बार-बार खङ्ग को छूकर उसे घुमाता जा रहा था ।१०। बह क्रोध से हुङार-कर रहा था ओर उत्पात के समय में होने आले मेघों के समान
verses.wordMeaning: After having approached me, those sages, the resi- dents of that holy place have rushed down here to regain once again that holy spot which is very dear to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After having approached me, those sages, the resi- dents of that holy place have rushed down here to regain once again that holy spot which is very dear to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एषामर्थे ततः सो ऽहं महेन्द्रादचलोत्तमात् । भवन्तमागतो द्रष्टुं सहैभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः
verses.transliteration: eṣāmarthe tataḥ so 'haṃ mahendrādacalottamāt / bhavantamāgato draṣṭuṃ sahaibhirmunipuṅgavaiḥ
verses.translation: Hence, for my sake, it behoves you to make your waters recede and restore to them that holy spot in the water as before."
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, for my sake, it behoves you to make your waters recede and restore to them that holy spot in the water as before."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, for my sake, it behoves you to make your waters recede and restore to them that holy spot in the water as before."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मदर्थे सलिलं समुत्सार्यात्मनो भवान् । दातुमर्हति तत्क्षेत्रमेषां तोये च पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: tasmānmadarthe salilaṃ samutsāryātmano bhavān / dātumarhati tatkṣetrameṣāṃ toye ca pūrvavat
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Rama, Varuna the lord of aquatic beings considered everything in his mind and spoke these words to Rama once again.
verses.hindi: गजे रहा था ।११। जिस दुष्ट ते माया के बल से युद्ध में मेरे भाइयों और पुत्रों को मार दिया है जोर सहस्रो सेना पतियों का विनाश कर दिया है उसी स्त्री के जब वह युद्ध में वृत्त होगो तो उसके कण्ठ से निकले हुए रुधिर से भाई और पुत्रों के शोक को अग्नि को मैं शान्त करूँगा ।१२-१श
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of Rama, Varuna the lord of aquatic beings considered everything in his mind and spoke these words to Rama once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Rama, Varuna the lord of aquatic beings considered everything in his mind and spoke these words to Rama once again.

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वरुणो यादसां पतिः । निरूप्य मनसा राममिद भूयो ऽब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā varuṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ / nirūpya manasā rāmamida bhūyo 'bravīdvacaḥ
verses.translation: "My waters cannot be made to recede by anyone. Such is the boon granted to me formerly by Virifici ( i.e. god Brahma).
verses.hindi: रे कुटिलाक्ष ! चले जाओ ओर सेना को तैयार करो । इतना ही कहकर उसने बञ्पात को भी सहन करने वाले कठिन कवच को धारण किया था
verses.wordMeaning: "My waters cannot be made to recede by anyone. Such is the boon granted to me formerly by Virifici ( i.e. god Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: "My waters cannot be made to recede by anyone. Such is the boon granted to me formerly by Virifici ( i.e. god Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: वरुण उवाच न शक्यमुत्सारयितुं मदंभः केनचिद्भवेत् । तथा हि मे वरो दत्तः पुरानेन विरिञ्चिना
verses.transliteration: varuṇa uvāca na śakyamutsārayituṃ madaṃbhaḥ kenacidbhavet / tathā hi me varo dattaḥ purānena viriñcinā
verses.translation: But on account of your brilliant splendour I have given up all my natural courage. I have become afraid, Q Bhargava, and have fallen under your control.
verses.wordMeaning: But on account of your brilliant splendour I have given up all my natural courage. I have become afraid, Q Bhargava, and have fallen under your control.
verses.commentary: Sense: But on account of your brilliant splendour I have given up all my natural courage. I have become afraid, Q Bhargava, and have fallen under your control.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं त्वत्तेजसेदारीं विहाय सहजां धृतिम् । कातरं समुपायातो वशतां तव भार्गव
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ tvattejasedārīṃ vihāya sahajāṃ dhṛtim / kātaraṃ samupāyāto vaśatāṃ tava bhārgava
verses.translation: How can I fail to perform this task, O annihilator of the families of Ksatriyas, after having been especially urged by you for the sake of these sages?
verses.wordMeaning: How can I fail to perform this task, O annihilator of the families of Ksatriyas, after having been especially urged by you for the sake of these sages?
verses.commentary: Sense: How can I fail to perform this task, O annihilator of the families of Ksatriyas, after having been especially urged by you for the sake of these sages?

verses.sanskrit: एषामर्थे विशेषण भवता परिचोदितः । कथं न कुर्यां कर्मेदमहं क्षत्त्रकुलान्तक
verses.transliteration: eṣāmarthe viśeṣaṇa bhavatā paricoditaḥ / kathaṃ na kuryāṃ karmedamahaṃ kṣattrakulāntaka
verses.translation: Hence, I shall hold back on the ground as much of my water as you may have intended in your mind."
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, I shall hold back on the ground as much of my water as you may have intended in your mind."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, I shall hold back on the ground as much of my water as you may have intended in your mind."

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यावत्प्रमाणं मे भवान्संकल्पयिष्यति । तावत्संघारयिष्यामि भूमौ सलिलमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasmādyāvatpramāṇaṃ me bhavānsaṃkalpayiṣyati / tāvatsaṃghārayiṣyāmi bhūmau salilamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Bhargava said "so be it". He broke his bow and threw away his arrow.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, Bhargava said "so be it". He broke his bow and threw away his arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, Bhargava said "so be it". He broke his bow and threw away his arrow.

verses.sanskrit: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तथेत्युक्त्वा स सायकम् । यथागतं प्रचिक्षेप धनुर्निर्भिद्य भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā sa sāyakam / yathāgataṃ pracikṣepa dhanurnirbhidya bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: Then he mentally decided the boundary. Wishing to* point it out, O king, he took up his Sruod (the sacrificial ladle) * The intelligent sage was desirous of throwing it in the ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: Then he mentally decided the boundary. Wishing to* point it out, O king, he took up his Sruod (the sacrificial ladle) * The intelligent sage was desirous of throwing it in the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he mentally decided the boundary. Wishing to* point it out, O king, he took up his Sruod (the sacrificial ladle) * The intelligent sage was desirous of throwing it in the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निरूप्य सीमानं दर्शयानो महीपते । स्रुवं जग्राह मतिमान्क्षप्तुकामो जलाशये
verses.transliteration: tato nirūpya sīmānaṃ darśayāno mahīpate / sruvaṃ jagrāha matimānkṣaptukāmo jalāśaye
verses.translation: Then all those sages became delighted very much Fully contented, they worshipped Rama aud expressed their good wishes for him.
verses.wordMeaning: Then all those sages became delighted very much Fully contented, they worshipped Rama aud expressed their good wishes for him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those sages became delighted very much Fully contented, they worshipped Rama aud expressed their good wishes for him.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नचेतसं रामं गतरोषमथात्मनि । अन्तर्हिते सरिन्नाथे रामः सुवमुदङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: prasannacetasaṃ rāmaṃ gataroṣamathātmani / antarhite sarinnāthe rāmaḥ suvamudaṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: The holy spot emerging from the waters regained its original state, O excellent king. This is the capacity of lord Siva which cannot be adequately thought of.
verses.hindi: ब्म को भुजाओं के मध्यभाग से धारण करके उसने पृष्ठ में तूणीर कहा था । उद्दाम मोर्वी के नि.श्वास से कठोर धनुष को घुमाते हुए कालाग्नि के समान से कू.ध'होकर वह अपने नगर से निकलकर चल दिया था और तालजंघादिक उसके साय ये तथा पूर्व द्वार पर सुरक्षा के लिए भी सेनाओं
verses.wordMeaning: The holy spot emerging from the waters regained its original state, O excellent king. This is the capacity of lord Siva which cannot be adequately thought of.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy spot emerging from the waters regained its original state, O excellent king. This is the capacity of lord Siva which cannot be adequately thought of.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रामयित्वातिवेगेन चिक्षेप लवणार्णवे । क्षिप्तत्वेन समुद्रे तु दिशमुत्तरपश्चिमाम्
verses.transliteration: bhrāmayitvātivegena cikṣepa lavaṇārṇave / kṣiptatvena samudre tu diśamuttarapaścimām
verses.translation: Even today the ocean does not transgress the bound- ary. His great bow was never drawn and kept ready by Rama the great sage.
verses.hindi: को निवेशित किया था ।१५-१६। चार शस्त्रो के समूहों को धारण करने बाले-कवचों को पहिन हुए और उद्धव बोर वहाँ पर ये। पैतीस सेना-
verses.wordMeaning: Even today the ocean does not transgress the bound- ary. His great bow was never drawn and kept ready by Rama the great sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even today the ocean does not transgress the bound- ary. His great bow was never drawn and kept ready by Rama the great sage.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा स्रुवोपतद्राजन्योजनानां शतद्वयम् । तीर्थं शुर्पारकं नाम सर्वपापविमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā sruvopatadrājanyojanānāṃ śatadvayam / tīrthaṃ śurpārakaṃ nāma sarvapāpavimocanam
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: पतियों के सहित जिनमें कुटिलाक्ष नो आगे ये वह चला था ।१३। सब सेना- पतियों का स्वामी कुटिलाक्ष के साथ वह कोध से युक्त हुआ था भंड को भी मिलाकर चालीस चमूबर ये ।१८। इनके आयुध परम दोस थे और इनके केश भी दोप थो ऐसे दोप्त ककट वाले निकल गये ये दो सहस्र अक्षौहिणी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: विश्रुतं यत्त्रिलोकेषु तीरे नदनदीपतेः । तीर्थं तदन्तरीकृत्य स्रुवो रामकराच्च्युतः
verses.transliteration: viśrutaṃ yattrilokeṣu tīre nadanadīpateḥ / tīrthaṃ tadantarīkṛtya sruvo rāmakarāccyutaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: सेना थी और पराधिक पिचातो थीं।१६। शत्रु का मंथन करने को एक ही साथ उसके पोछे गये ये । भंडासुर के निकल कर जाने पर जो सभी सेनाओं से संकुल थी ।२०। उस शून्यक नगर में केवल स्त्रियां ही रह गयी थीं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: निपपात महाराज सूचयन्रामविक्रमम् । यत्राभूद्रामसृष्टाया भुवो निष्ठाथ पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: nipapāta mahārāja sūcayanrāmavikramam / yatrābhūdrāmasṛṣṭāyā bhuvo niṣṭhātha pārthiva
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: से युक्त रथ पर रणोद्धत होकर सवार हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं शूर्पारकं तत्तु श्रीमल्लोकपरिश्रुतम् । उत्सारयित्वा सलिलं समुद्रस्तावदात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ śūrpārakaṃ tattu śrīmallokapariśrutam / utsārayitvā salilaṃ samudrastāvadātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: अतिष्ठदपसृत्योर्वीं दत्त्वा रामाय पार्थिव । अनतिक्रान्तमर्यादो यथाकालं भृगूद्वहः
verses.transliteration: atiṣṭhadapasṛtyorvīṃ dattvā rāmāya pārthiva / anatikrāntamaryādo yathākālaṃ bhṛgūdvahaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: समयं स्वापयामास तस्यैवानुमते भुवि । विज्ञाय पूर्वसीमान्तां भुवमभ्युत्ससर्ज ह
verses.transliteration: samayaṃ svāpayāmāsa tasyaivānumate bhuvi / vijñāya pūrvasīmāntāṃ bhuvamabhyutsasarja ha
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: व्यस्मयन्त सुराः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम् । नगरग्रमसीमानः किञ्चित्किञ्चित्क्वचित्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: vyasmayanta surāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam / nagaragramasīmānaḥ kiñcitkiñcitkvacitkvacit
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: सह्ये तु पूर्ववत्तस्मिन्नब्धेरपसृतेंऽभसि । तत्र दैवात्तथा स्थानान्निम्नत्वात्स प्रलक्ष्य तु
verses.transliteration: sahye tu pūrvavattasminnabdherapasṛteṃ'bhasi / tatra daivāttathā sthānānnimnatvātsa pralakṣya tu
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषां भृगुश्रेष्ठो मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । यथाभिलषितं स्थानं प्रददौ प्रीतिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣāṃ bhṛguśreṣṭho munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām / yathābhilaṣitaṃ sthānaṃ pradadau prītipūrvakam
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे हर्षेण महातान्विताः । कृतकृत्या भृशं राममाशिषा समपूजयन्
verses.transliteration: tataste munayaḥ sarve harṣeṇa mahātānvitāḥ / kṛtakṛtyā bhṛśaṃ rāmamāśiṣā samapūjayan
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: अथैतैरभ्यनुज्ञातो ययौ प्राप्तमनोरथः । गते मुनिवरे रामे देशात्तस्मान्निजाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: athaitairabhyanujñāto yayau prāptamanorathaḥ / gate munivare rāme deśāttasmānnijāśramam
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: इत्थं प्रचलिता तेन समं सर्वेश्व सेनिके: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: संभूय मुनयः सर्वे प्रजग्मुस्तीरमंबुधेः । परिचङ्क्रम्य तां भूमिं यत्नेन महातान्विताः
verses.transliteration: saṃbhūya munayaḥ sarve prajagmustīramaṃbudheḥ / paricaṅkramya tāṃ bhūmiṃ yatnena mahātānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: बह जलती हुई ज्वाला वाले कालाग्नि के तुल्य ही दोपि वाला था। उसके खड्ग का नाम घातक या जो चन्द्रहास अङ्क के ही समान आकृति बाला था ।२२। इधर-उधर चलने वाली सेनाओं से धूलि उड़कर ऊपर उठ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: ददृशुः सर्वतो राजन्ह्यर्मवान्तः स्थितां महीम् । नित्यत्वा त्सर्वदेवानामधिष्ठानतया तथा
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuḥ sarvato rājanhyarmavāntaḥ sthitāṃ mahīm / nityatvā tsarvadevānāmadhiṣṭhānatayā tathā
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: गयी थी । मानों भूमि उन सेनाओं के भार को सम्हाले में असमर्थ होकर ही आकाश में जा रही यो ।२३। उनमें कुछ तो भूमि पर स्यान न पाकर
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: कातमब्धौ निपतितं नष्टतोयं चिरोषितम् । अपि रुद्रप्रभावेम प्रायान्नात्यन्तविप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: kātamabdhau nipatitaṃ naṣṭatoyaṃ ciroṣitam / api rudraprabhāvema prāyānnātyantaviplavam
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तेयनिःसृतं क्षेत्रमभूत्पूर्ववदेव हि । एतद्धि देवसामर्थ्यमचिन्त्यं नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tatteyaniḥsṛtaṃ kṣetramabhūtpūrvavadeva hi / etaddhi devasāmarthyamacintyaṃ nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: व्योम के ही मार्ग से चल दिये थे । कुछ महारथी कुछ लोगों के स्कन्ध पर समारूढ़ होकर चले ये ।२४। जब उस भंडासुर की सेनाएँ चली थीं तो कहीं पर भी स्वान नहों रहा था । एक दूसरे से रगड़ खाकर पीड़ित से होते हुए जा रहे ये । न तो दिशाओं में न भूमि में ओर न नम में वे समाये ये । बड़े
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: एवं रामेण जलधेः पुनः सृष्टा वसुंधरा । दक्षिणोत्तरतो राजनयोजनानां चतुःशतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ rāmeṇa jaladheḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭā vasuṃdharā / dakṣiṇottarato rājanayojanānāṃ catuḥśatam
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: ही दुःख से चल रहे थे ।२५॥ अत्यन्त सेना के संमदं से और रथों के पहियों से चूर्ण होते हुए जा रहे ये। कुछ हाथियों के पैरों से मदित होकर भूमि पर गिर गये थे ।२६। इस रोति से उसके साथ सभो संनिक गमन कर रहे थे और वच्चपात के समान उनने सिहनाद किया था। उस प्रवल और बड़े
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: नातिक्रामति सो ऽद्यापि सीमानं पयसां निधिः । कृतं रामेण महता न तु सज्जं महद्धनुः
verses.transliteration: nātikrāmati so 'dyāpi sīmānaṃ payasāṃ nidhiḥ / kṛtaṃ rāmeṇa mahatā na tu sajjaṃ mahaddhanuḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: भारी सिहनाद से एवं कठोर से जो भंड के मुख से किवा गया था सम्पूर्ण जगत बिदीणं हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रभावो रामो ऽसौ सगरश्च महीपतिः । यस्य पुत्रैरयं खण्डो भारतो ऽब्धौ निपतितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ prabhāvo rāmo 'sau sagaraśca mahīpatiḥ / yasya putrairayaṃ khaṇḍo bhārato 'bdhau nipatitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्रन्तु वर्द्धितश्च महोदधिः । रामेणाभूत्पुनः सृष्टं योजनानां तु षट्शतम्
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasrantu varddhitaśca mahodadhiḥ / rāmeṇābhūtpunaḥ sṛṣṭaṃ yojanānāṃ tu ṣaṭśatam
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: सगरस्य सुतैर्यस्माद्वर्द्धितो मकरालयः । ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु सागराख्यामवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: sagarasya sutairyasmādvarddhito makarālayaḥ / tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu sāgarākhyāmavāptavān
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते ऽभिहितं सम्यङ्महतश्चरितं मया । रामस्य कार्त्तवीर्यस्य सगरस्य महीपतेः
verses.transliteration: etatte 'bhihitaṃ samyaṅmahataścaritaṃ mayā / rāmasya kārttavīryasya sagarasya mahīpateḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.hindi: निश्चित्य ललिता देवी स्वयं योद्धुः प्रचक्रमे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्त मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपाद्धातपादे ऽष्टपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ५८॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच ऋषयस्त्वेव मुक्तास्तु परं हर्षमुपागताः । परं शुश्रूषया भूयः पप्रच्छुस्तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokta madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upāddhātapāde 'ṣṭapañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 58// bṛhaspatiruvāca ṛṣayastveva muktāstu paraṃ harṣamupāgatāḥ / paraṃ śuśrūṣayā bhūyaḥ papracchustadanantaram
verses.translation: "Please narrate the details of the races of kings of unmeasured prowess, their life and their powers and majesty, to us as we ask in the proper order."
verses.hindi: गण आकाश से गिर रहे थे और समस्त पृथ्वी काँप रही थी ।२९। दिवपाल भयभीत हो गये बे और देवगण मूच्छित हो गये वे उस समय में शक्तियों
verses.wordMeaning: "Please narrate the details of the races of kings of unmeasured prowess, their life and their powers and majesty, to us as we ask in the proper order."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Please narrate the details of the races of kings of unmeasured prowess, their life and their powers and majesty, to us as we ask in the proper order."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः वंशानामानुपूर्व्येण राज्ञां चामिततेजसाम् । स्थितिं चैषां प्रभावं च ब्रूहि नः परिपृच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vaṃśānāmānupūrvyeṇa rājñāṃ cāmitatejasām / sthitiṃ caiṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ ca brūhi naḥ paripṛcchatām
verses.translation: Jaya and Vijaya were the sons of Kali. They were extremely valorous. Gh;ni and Muni were the sons of Vaidya. They were very powerful.
verses.hindi: की सेना अकाण्डतास से विह्वल हो गयी सीं ।३०। उस युद्ध में मध्य में किसी प्रकार से प्राणों को धारण किया था । शक्तियों ने भय से विभ्रष्ट आयुर्धो को पुनः धारण किया था (३९) वहिन प्राकार बलय प्रशान्त फिर उत्थित हो गया था । उस हैत्येन्द्र के स्रिहनाद से और सेना यतियों के
verses.wordMeaning: Jaya and Vijaya were the sons of Kali. They were extremely valorous. Gh;ni and Muni were the sons of Vaidya. They were very powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jaya and Vijaya were the sons of Kali. They were extremely valorous. Gh;ni and Muni were the sons of Vaidya. They were very powerful.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्ततस्तैस्तु तदासौ लोमहर्षणः । शृण्वतामुत्तराख्याने ऋषीणां वाक्य कोविदः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastatastaistu tadāsau lomaharṣaṇaḥ / śṛṇvatāmuttarākhyāne ṛṣīṇāṃ vākya kovidaḥ
verses.translation: They used to devour girls given in marriage to them or those who loved them. They devoured one another. After devouring one another, they met with destruction.
verses.hindi: घनुषों को टड्ारों से तथा योद्धाओं के कुन्दनों से समस्त जगत ही शाका- यमान हो गया था । उस महान् नाद से भण्डासुर के समागमन का निश्चय करके ललिता देवी ने स्वयं ही युद्ध करने की इच्छा को थो ।३२-३३। यह महान संग्राम शक्तियों के द्वारा नहीं किया जा सकता है ऐसा विचार करके
verses.wordMeaning: They used to devour girls given in marriage to them or those who loved them. They devoured one another. After devouring one another, they met with destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: They used to devour girls given in marriage to them or those who loved them. They devoured one another. After devouring one another, they met with destruction.

verses.sanskrit: अख्यानकुशलो भूयः परं वाक्यमुवाच ह । ब्रुवतो मे निबोधंश्च ऋषिराह यथा मम
verses.transliteration: akhyānakuśalo bhūyaḥ paraṃ vākyamuvāca ha / bruvato me nibodhaṃśca ṛṣirāha yathā mama
verses.translation: TamasI and Putana were the wives of Bhadrama (or Putana of dark and foul nature was the wife of Bhadrama). Revati was the wife of Vidhama. The sons of these two were thousands in number.
verses.hindi: दष्ट भण्ड देत्य के साथ स्वयं हो युद्ध करने के लिए उद्योग में समास्थित हुई थी ।३४। उसका चक्रराज रथ जो महान हृदय वाला था वहाँ से च दिया था । चारों वेद उसके चक् ये ओर पुरुषार्थ महान भय वाला था
verses.wordMeaning: TamasI and Putana were the wives of Bhadrama (or Putana of dark and foul nature was the wife of Bhadrama). Revati was the wife of Vidhama. The sons of these two were thousands in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: TamasI and Putana were the wives of Bhadrama (or Putana of dark and foul nature was the wife of Bhadrama). Revati was the wife of Vidhama. The sons of these two were thousands in number.

verses.sanskrit: वंशानामानुपूर्व्येण राज्ञां चामिततेजसाम् । स्थितिं चैषां प्रभावं च क्रमतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: vaṃśānāmānupūrvyeṇa rājñāṃ cāmitatejasām / sthitiṃ caiṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ ca kramato me nibodhata
verses.translation: &akuni was the wife of Naka and Ayomukhi the wife of Vighna. Their sons were Raksasas of great vigour and vitality. They used to roam about during the twilight at dusk and dawn.
verses.wordMeaning: &akuni was the wife of Naka and Ayomukhi the wife of Vighna. Their sons were Raksasas of great vigour and vitality. They used to roam about during the twilight at dusk and dawn.
verses.commentary: Sense: &akuni was the wife of Naka and Ayomukhi the wife of Vighna. Their sons were Raksasas of great vigour and vitality. They used to roam about during the twilight at dusk and dawn.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणस्य सपत्नीकान् स्तुता देवी उदाहृता । तस्याः पुत्रौ कलिर्वैद्यः स्तुता च सुरसुंदरी
verses.transliteration: varuṇasya sapatnīkān stutā devī udāhṛtā / tasyāḥ putrau kalirvaidyaḥ stutā ca surasuṃdarī
verses.translation: The sons of Revati and Putana are remembered as Nairrtas by name. All those Raksasas are Grahas (Evil demons attacking children and making them suffer from convulsions) particularly in regard to children.
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Revati and Putana are remembered as Nairrtas by name. All those Raksasas are Grahas (Evil demons attacking children and making them suffer from convulsions) particularly in regard to children.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Revati and Putana are remembered as Nairrtas by name. All those Raksasas are Grahas (Evil demons attacking children and making them suffer from convulsions) particularly in regard to children.

verses.sanskrit: कलिपुत्रौ महावीर्यौं जयश्च विजयश्च ह । वैद्यपुत्रौ घृणिश्चैव मुनिश्चैव महाबलौ
verses.transliteration: kaliputrau mahāvīryauṃ jayaśca vijayaśca ha / vaidyaputrau ghṛṇiścaiva muniścaiva mahābalau
verses.translation: "Indeed, he did not die inside the egg" said Kagyapa fondly but unwittingly. Hence the sun is called Martanda.
verses.hindi: वह रथ आनन्द की ध्वजा से युक्त या ओर उसमें नो परव ये। नो पर्वों पर देवियां स्थित थो जिन्होंने बड़े-बड़े अनुषों को बढ़ा रक्‍्खा था
verses.wordMeaning: "Indeed, he did not die inside the egg" said Kagyapa fondly but unwittingly. Hence the sun is called Martanda.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Indeed, he did not die inside the egg" said Kagyapa fondly but unwittingly. Hence the sun is called Martanda.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्तानामनु कामानामन्योन्यस्य प्रभक्षिणौ । भक्ष्यित्वा तावन्योन्यं विनाशं समवाप्नुतः
verses.transliteration: prattānāmanu kāmānāmanyonyasya prabhakṣiṇau / bhakṣyitvā tāvanyonyaṃ vināśaṃ samavāpnutaḥ
verses.translation: The brilliance and splendour of Vivasvan is always very excessive. It is with that, that the son of Kagyapa scorched the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliance and splendour of Vivasvan is always very excessive. It is with that, that the son of Kagyapa scorched the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliance and splendour of Vivasvan is always very excessive. It is with that, that the son of Kagyapa scorched the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: कलिः सुरायाः संज्ञेयस्तस्य पुत्रो मदः स्मृतः । स्मृता हिंसा कलेर्भार्या श्रेष्ठा या निकृतस्मृतिः
verses.transliteration: kaliḥ surāyāḥ saṃjñeyastasya putro madaḥ smṛtaḥ / smṛtā hiṃsā kalerbhāryā śreṣṭhā yā nikṛtasmṛtiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that form of unbearable splendour of Vivasvan Samjfia could not brook it. She created her own Chaya (shadow) of the same colour and complexion ( Savaryd) as hers.
verses.hindi: परां से अधिक संख्या वाले परिवारों को समृद्धियों से समस्त पर्व स्थानों में सब दिशाओं में उसको सुरक्षा भी थी ।३७ बह रय दश योजन ऊंचा और चार योजन चौड़ा था । ऐसा वह महाराशी का चक्रराज् रथेन्द गमन करता हुआ शोमित हुआ था ।३६। श्यामा और दण्डनाया के द्वारा सेवित
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that form of unbearable splendour of Vivasvan Samjfia could not brook it. She created her own Chaya (shadow) of the same colour and complexion ( Savaryd) as hers.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that form of unbearable splendour of Vivasvan Samjfia could not brook it. She created her own Chaya (shadow) of the same colour and complexion ( Savaryd) as hers.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसूतान्ये कलेः पुत्राश्चत्वारः पुरुषादकाः । नाके विघ्नश्च विख्यातो भद्रमोविधमस्तथा
verses.transliteration: prasūtānye kaleḥ putrāścatvāraḥ puruṣādakāḥ / nāke vighnaśca vikhyāto bhadramovidhamastathā
verses.translation: That lady of great fortune, born out of her shadow, joined her palms in great reverence and purity of mind and spoke to Samjfia.
verses.hindi: वहु रथ रवाना हुआ था। उस बाला के आगे गेय चक्र था ।३६। अस्य शक्तियों के मो वाहुन पराद्ध के नृमिह--उषट्र--दर--ब्याल--मृग--पक्षी और हय ये ।४० हाथी-मेरुष्ड--व्या प्र- दात--मृग ऐसे ओर तिर्यक योनि वाले भी उनके वाहन ये।४१। व'र-वार उच्चादच शक्तियाँ भंडासुर
verses.wordMeaning: That lady of great fortune, born out of her shadow, joined her palms in great reverence and purity of mind and spoke to Samjfia.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lady of great fortune, born out of her shadow, joined her palms in great reverence and purity of mind and spoke to Samjfia.

verses.sanskrit: अशिरस्कतया विघ्नो नाकश्चैवाशरीरवान् । भद्रमश्चैकहस्तो ऽभूद्विधमश्चैकपात्स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: aśiraskatayā vighno nākaścaivāśarīravān / bhadramaścaikahasto 'bhūdvidhamaścaikapātsmṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Samjfia of earthly nature (i.e. the shadow) loved her own sons more than the elder sons.
verses.hindi: के वघ करने के लिए उद्यत हुई शीं । उसका द्वारमंडल भी योजन आयाम विस्तार वाला था जो बहिनप्राकार चक्र के सेनापति को पर्याप्त नहीं था ।
verses.wordMeaning: Samjfia of earthly nature (i.e. the shadow) loved her own sons more than the elder sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samjfia of earthly nature (i.e. the shadow) loved her own sons more than the elder sons.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रमस्य तथापत्नी तामसी पूतना तथा । रेवती विधमस्यापि तयोः पुत्राः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: bhadramasya tathāpatnī tāmasī pūtanā tathā / revatī vidhamasyāpi tayoḥ putrāḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The sun then spoke to Samjna (i.e. to Chaya mistaken by him to be Samjfta) "When all the sons are equal to us, how is it that one is loved by you more than the others."
verses.wordMeaning: The sun then spoke to Samjna (i.e. to Chaya mistaken by him to be Samjfta) "When all the sons are equal to us, how is it that one is loved by you more than the others."
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun then spoke to Samjna (i.e. to Chaya mistaken by him to be Samjfta) "When all the sons are equal to us, how is it that one is loved by you more than the others."

verses.sanskrit: नाकस्य शकुनिः पत्नी विघ्नस्य च अयो मुखी । राक्षसास्तु महावीर्याः संध्याद्वयविचारिमः
verses.transliteration: nākasya śakuniḥ patnī vighnasya ca ayo mukhī / rākṣasāstu mahāvīryāḥ saṃdhyādvayavicārimaḥ
verses.translation: Parrying that question, she did not mention the real situation to Vivasvan. Then he entered into meditation himself and found out the truth by means of his yogic power.
verses.wordMeaning: Parrying that question, she did not mention the real situation to Vivasvan. Then he entered into meditation himself and found out the truth by means of his yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Parrying that question, she did not mention the real situation to Vivasvan. Then he entered into meditation himself and found out the truth by means of his yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: रेवतीपूतनापुत्रा नैऋता नामतः स्मृताः । ग्रहस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे बालानां तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: revatīpūtanāputrā naiṛtā nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ / grahaste rākṣasāḥ sarve bālānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The lord became angry and wished to curse her with utter annihilation. Then she mentioned all the facts to Vivasvan.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord became angry and wished to curse her with utter annihilation. Then she mentioned all the facts to Vivasvan.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord became angry and wished to curse her with utter annihilation. Then she mentioned all the facts to Vivasvan.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दस्तेषामधिपतिर्ब्रह्मणो ऽनुमतः प्रभुः । बृहस्पतेर्या भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मचारिणी
verses.transliteration: skandasteṣāmadhipatirbrahmaṇo 'numataḥ prabhuḥ / bṛhaspateryā bhaginī varastrī brahmacāriṇī
verses.translation: He placed him on the (circular moving) wheel (i.e. a lathe) and pruned (the slices of the irregular superfluous part of) his brilliance — when his refulgence was taken away, the sun had his brilliance uprooted (i.e. reduced).
verses.wordMeaning: He placed him on the (circular moving) wheel (i.e. a lathe) and pruned (the slices of the irregular superfluous part of) his brilliance — when his refulgence was taken away, the sun had his brilliance uprooted (i.e. reduced).
verses.commentary: Sense: He placed him on the (circular moving) wheel (i.e. a lathe) and pruned (the slices of the irregular superfluous part of) his brilliance — when his refulgence was taken away, the sun had his brilliance uprooted (i.e. reduced).

verses.sanskrit: योगसिद्धा जगत्कृत्स्नमसक्ता चरते सदा । प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसूनामष्टमस्य च
verses.transliteration: yogasiddhā jagatkṛtsnamasaktā carate sadā / prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca
verses.translation: Prabhakara (the sun) of splendid appearance wished to see his wife. By resorting to his yogic power, he saw his wife in the form of a mare.
verses.hindi: हृश्यते केवलं हृष्टं रजोमात्र च मूर्छितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Prabhakara (the sun) of splendid appearance wished to see his wife. By resorting to his yogic power, he saw his wife in the form of a mare.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prabhakara (the sun) of splendid appearance wished to see his wife. By resorting to his yogic power, he saw his wife in the form of a mare.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा सुरस्तस्या जातः शिल्पिप्रजापतिः । त्वष्टा विराजो रूपाणि धर्मपौत्र उदारधीः
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā surastasyā jātaḥ śilpiprajāpatiḥ / tvaṣṭā virājo rūpāṇi dharmapautra udāradhīḥ
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: ज्वाला मालिनिका नित्या ने ढारकी अत्यन्त विस्तुति को विस्तृत
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: कर्त्ता शिल्पिसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां तु योगतः । यःसर्वेषां विमानानि देवतानां चकार ह
verses.transliteration: karttā śilpisahasrāṇāṃ tridaśānāṃ tu yogataḥ / yaḥsarveṣāṃ vimānāni devatānāṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: His brother Sanaiscara attained the state of a planet.
verses.hindi: किया था । यहु समस्त वेनाओं की निगम की चाहने वाली थो ।४३। इसके उपरान्त जगतो की माता महोदया महारानी प्रदायिनी बरार से अग्तिपुर
verses.wordMeaning: His brother Sanaiscara attained the state of a planet.
verses.commentary: Sense: His brother Sanaiscara attained the state of a planet.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषाश्चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः । प्रह्रादी विश्रुता तस्य पत्नी त्वष्टुर्विरोचना
verses.transliteration: mānuṣāścopajīvanti yasya śilpaṃ mahātmanaḥ / prahrādī viśrutā tasya patnī tvaṣṭurvirocanā
verses.translation: This creation ofSudarsana, the discus of Vi?riu, from the pruned part of the sun-god is given in Vp.III.2.1 1.
verses.hindi: उस नदी में थे । चक्र से कटे हुए करियों के समुदाय ही उसमें क्रमों की परम्परा थीं !१५१। शक्तियों के द्वारा ध्वस्त महान देत्यों के गलगण्ड ही उस नदी में शिक्षोच्चय थे । जिनके काण्ड विजन होगये हैं ऐथ चमर जो उसमें थे वे ही फेन ये ।५२। तीक्ष्ण जो असियां थो वे ही बल्लरी थीं जिनके कारण
verses.wordMeaning: This creation ofSudarsana, the discus of Vi?riu, from the pruned part of the sun-god is given in Vp.III.2.1 1.
verses.commentary: Sense: This creation ofSudarsana, the discus of Vi?riu, from the pruned part of the sun-god is given in Vp.III.2.1 1.

verses.sanskrit: विरोचनस्य भगिनी माता त्रिशिरसस्तथा । देवाचार्यस्य महतो विश्वरूपस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: virocanasya bhaginī mātā triśirasastathā / devācāryasya mahato viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: The description of dynasties of kings is an integral part of a Purana. Though here the accounts are scattered at different places, they are given here from the beginning of the birth of Vaivasvata Manu to the future Savarnika Manus. The story of the sun-god and his wives Saiftjna and Ch£y& and his progeny from them, the pruning of the sungod and his approach to his mareformed wife and birth of Asvin gods — these are tradi- tional accounts found in the Mbh. Adi 76, Anuidsana 150, Vp. III. 2 and other Purapas with slight variations.
verses.hindi: उस-नदी की तटमूमि निविड़ हो रही थी । हैत्यों. के नेत्रो कें थोणियां ही मुक्ति सम्पुट ये जिससे वह नदी भासुर थी ।४३। हैत्य वाहनों के समुदाय ही उस शोणित की नदी में सेकडों नक् और मछलियां थीं जिनसे वह घिरी हुईं थी। दोनों सेनाओं का बुद्ध होते पर वहाँ धिर को नदी प्रवाहित हो
verses.wordMeaning: The description of dynasties of kings is an integral part of a Purana. Though here the accounts are scattered at different places, they are given here from the beginning of the birth of Vaivasvata Manu to the future Savarnika Manus.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The description of dynasties of kings is an integral part of a Purana. Though here the accounts are scattered at different places, they are given here from the beginning of the birth of Vaivasvata Manu to the future Savarnika Manus.…

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मात्मजश्वैव विश्वकर्मा मयः स्मृतः । सुरेणुरिति विख्याता स्वसा तस्य यवीयसी
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmātmajaśvaiva viśvakarmā mayaḥ smṛtaḥ / sureṇuriti vikhyātā svasā tasya yavīyasī
verses.translation: The description of dynasties of kings is an integral part of a Purana. Though here the accounts are scattered at different places, they are given here from the beginning of the birth of Vaivasvata Manu to the future Savarnika Manus. The story of the sun-god and his wives Saiftjna and Ch£y& and his progeny from them, the pruning of the sungod and his approach to his mareformed wife and birth of Asvin gods — these are tradi- tional accounts found in the Mbh. Adi 76, Anuidsana 150, Vp. III. 2 and other Purapas with slight variations.
verses.hindi: रहो थी ।५४ इसके अनन्तर थी ललिता देवी ओर भण्ड का युद्ध हुआ था। उसमें अस्त्रों और प्रत्यस्त्र का ऐसा संक्षोभ हुआ बा कि समस्त दिशायें तुमुली कृत हो गयो थीं

verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe madhyamabhāge vāyuprokte vaivasvatamanoḥ sṛṣṭirnāma ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 60// sūta uvāca visargaṃ manuputrāṇāṃ vistareṇa nibodhata / pṛṣadhro hiṃsayitvā tu gurorgāṃ niśi tatkṣaye
verses.translation: The glorious Sahadeva of great exploits was the son of Srfljaya. Kfiasva, the son of Sahadeva, was extremely righteous.

verses.translation: On hearing the story with all facts, Revata (Rai- vata) the suppressor of foes gave his daughter of good holy rites named Revatl to Baladcva in marriage. Thereafter, he went to the peak of Mcru and became engaged in penance.

verses.translation: Rama, the noble one, sported with Revati.

verses.translation: Grama: Grama means the group of seven notes. In the Puranas three Gramas are mentioned. They are, the Sadjagrdma, the Madhyama grama and the Gdndhdragrdma. These three were the basic scales. The *£a-scale, the Ma-scale and the GVscale had the notes Sd, Ma and Ga as the starting notes respectively. The.SVi-scale would have notes, Sd, Hi, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni; the A/fl-scalc would have the notes Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni, Sa, Ri, Ga and the Ga-scale would have the notes Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni, Sd, Ri. Out of these three basic scales, the GVt-scalc fell into disuse afterwards. The ancient scholar Dattila states that it is not found in this world. The later scholars say that it went into heaven. The reason of its disappearance is given as it had extremely high and low notes. But from its description given by the later authors like Sarngadcva, it seems that it was not perfect in the aspect of consonance, which was vitally essential for the melodic music of India. Bharata in his Nafya-sdstra describes the Sa-scalc and the A/a-scalc on the bash oi the consonance of the fourth ( Sa-Ma Samvdda) and the consonance of the fifth ( Sa-Pa Samvdda ). In the Sfl-sralc the consonance of the fifth was more prominent {Sa-Pa, Ri-Dha and Ga-Ni) while that of the fourth in the A/fl-Scale {Sa-Ma, and Ri-Pa). verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca na jarā kṣutpipāse vā na ca mṛtyubhayaṃ tataḥ / na ca rogaḥ prabhavati brahmalokaṃ gatasya ha
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: अथ नारायणास्त्रेण सा देवी ललितांबिका । सर्वा अक्षोहिणीस्तस्य भस्मसादकरोद्रणे
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: गान्धर्वं प्रति यच्चापि पृष्टस्तु मुनिसत्तमाः । ततो ऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि याथातथ्येन सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: gāndharvaṃ prati yaccāpi pṛṣṭastu munisattamāḥ / tato 'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yāthātathyena suvratāḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: अथ पाशुपतास्त्रेण दीप्तकालानलत्विषा । चत्वारिशच्चमूनाथान्महाराज्ञी व्यम यत्
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: सप्त स्वरास्त्रयो ग्रामा मूर्छनास्त्वेकविंशतिः । तानाश्चैकोनपञ्चाशदित्येत्स्वरमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: sapta svarāstrayo grāmā mūrchanāstvekaviṃśatiḥ / tānāścaikonapañcāśadityetsvaramaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: यह अश्व पर आरूढ थे और इनकी श्री परदीप्त भी । इनने अट्टहास. किया था । उसकी अञ्च के समान घ्बनि से सभी किरात बेहोश हो गये थे ।१३४ सब मूर्छित होकर तश हो गये थे और शक्तियाँ हृषित हो गयी थों। दशावतारो के नाधों ने इस दुष्कर कमं को करके सम्पन्न किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: षड्जषभौ च गान्धारो मध्यमः पञ्चमस्तथा । धैवतश्चापि विज्ञेयस्तथा चापि निषादकः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍjaṣabhau ca gāndhāro madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā / dhaivataścāpi vijñeyastathā cāpi niṣādakaḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: फिर उस ललिता देवो को नमस्कार करके हाथ जोड़कर उसके आगे स्थित हो'गये थे। प्रत्येक कल्प में मत्स्य आदि भम की रक्षा करने के लिए ललिताम्बा के द्वारा नियुक्त थे बे फिर वैकुण्ठ को चले गये ।१३६। इस रोति से समस्त अस्त्रं के बिनाशित होने पर उस दुराशय ने महामौहास्त्र
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: सौवीरा मध्यमा ग्रामा हरिणाश्च तथैव च
verses.transliteration: sauvīrā madhyamā grāmā hariṇāśca tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: को छोड़ दिया था जिससे समस्त शक्तियां मूच्छित हो गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः कालोयनोपेताश्चतुर्थाशुद्धमध्यमाः । नग्निं च पौषा वै देव दृष्ट्वा काञ्च यथाक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ kāloyanopetāścaturthāśuddhamadhyamāḥ / nagniṃ ca pauṣā vai deva dṛṣṭvā kāñca yathākramaḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: जगदम्वा ने शाम्भक शस्त्र को छोड़कर उस महामोहास्त्र को नष्ट कर दिया था। इस तरह से अस्त्रो और प्रव्यस्तरों की धाराओं से महान युद्ध हुआ था । गमस्तीश अरुण अस्ताचल को जा रहा था। उस समय में ललितादेवी ने अस्त्र का प्रहार किया था।१३८। उस देवी ललिताम्बा ने
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: मध्यमग्रामिकाख्याता षड्जग्रामा निबोधत । उत्तरं मन्द्रा रजनी तथा वाचोन्नरायताः
verses.transliteration: madhyamagrāmikākhyātā ṣaḍjagrāmā nibodhata / uttaraṃ mandrā rajanī tathā vāconnarāyatāḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: नारायणास्त्र से युद्ध में उसकी समस्त अक्षोहिणी सेनाओं को भस्मीभूत कर दिया था ।१३९। इसके अनन्तर दीप्त कालाग्नि के समान कान्ति वाले पाशुपतास्त्र से चालीस सेनानियों को महाराज्ञी ने विमर्दित कर दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: मध्यषड्जा तथा चैव तथान्या चाभिमुद्गणा । गान्धारग्रामिका श्यामा कीर्तिमाना निबोधत
verses.transliteration: madhyaṣaḍjā tathā caiva tathānyā cābhimudgaṇā / gāndhāragrāmikā śyāmā kīrtimānā nibodhata
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमं तु माद्यं तु द्वितीयं वाजपेयिकम् । यवरातसूयस्तु षष्ठवत्तु सुवर्मकम्
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭomaṃ tu mādyaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ vājapeyikam / yavarātasūyastu ṣaṣṭhavattu suvarmakam
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: सप्त गौसवना नाम महावृष्टिकताष्टमाम् । ब्रह्मदानं च नवमं प्राजापत्यमनन्तरम् । नागयक्षाश्रयं विद्वान् तद्गोत्तरतथैव च
verses.transliteration: sapta gausavanā nāma mahāvṛṣṭikatāṣṭamām / brahmadānaṃ ca navamaṃ prājāpatyamanantaram / nāgayakṣāśrayaṃ vidvān tadgottaratathaiva ca
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: पदक्रान्तमृगक्रान्तं विष्णुक्रान्तमनोहरा । सूर्यकान्तधरेण्यैव संतकोकिलविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: padakrāntamṛgakrāntaṃ viṣṇukrāntamanoharā / sūryakāntadhareṇyaiva saṃtakokilaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: तेनवानित्यपवशपिशाचातीवनह्यपि । सावित्रमर्धसावित्रं सर्वतोभद्रमेव च
verses.transliteration: tenavānityapavaśapiśācātīvanahyapi / sāvitramardhasāvitraṃ sarvatobhadrameva ca
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: मनोहरमधात्र्यं च गन्धर्वानुपतश्च यः । अलंबुषेसेष्टमथो विष्णुवैणवरावुभौ
verses.transliteration: manoharamadhātryaṃ ca gandharvānupataśca yaḥ / alaṃbuṣeseṣṭamatho viṣṇuvaiṇavarāvubhau
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: सागराविजयं चैव सर्वभूतमनोहरः । हतोत्सृष्टो विजानीत स्कन्धं तु प्रियमेव च
verses.transliteration: sāgarāvijayaṃ caiva sarvabhūtamanoharaḥ / hatotsṛṣṭo vijānīta skandhaṃ tu priyameva ca
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: मनोहरमधात्र्यं च गन्धर्वानुपतश्च यः । अलंबुसेष्टस्य तथा नारदप्रिय एव च
verses.transliteration: manoharamadhātryaṃ ca gandharvānupataśca yaḥ / alaṃbuseṣṭasya tathā nāradapriya eva ca
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: इसके उपरान्त बह दुष्ट एक हो शेष बच गया था और उसके सब बान्धन मर चुके ये । वह भी क्रोध से प्रज्वलित हो रहा था और इस जगत् के बिप्लब को करने बाला था ।१४१। महान् प्रचण्ड महान् सत्व. युक्त उस महासुर को सहस्र सूयों के समान बचंस् बाले महाकामेश्वरास्त्र से प रमेश्वरी
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: कथितो भीमसेनेन नगरातानयप्रियः । विकलोपनीतविनताश्रीराख्यो भार्गवप्रियः
verses.transliteration: kathito bhīmasenena nagarātānayapriyaḥ / vikalopanītavinatāśrīrākhyo bhārgavapriyaḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: ललिता ने भंड को गत प्राण कर दिया था ।१४२। उसके अस्त्र की ज्वाला से उसका शून्यक नगर भी स्त्रियों--बालों-गोष्ठों और धान्यों के सहित तुर्त ही निर्दय हो गया था । उस भंडासुर के विनाश से तीनों लोक हृषित हुए ये ।१४३-१४४। इस प्रकार से अनिन्द्यशील वाली देवी देवों के
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दश तथा पञ्चदशेच्छन्तीह नारदः । ससौवीरां सुसोवीरा ब्रह्मणो ह्यपगीयते
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa tathā pañcadaśecchantīha nāradaḥ / sasauvīrāṃ susovīrā brahmaṇo hyapagīyate
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: कार्य को करके श्रीचक्रराज रथ के मंडल की श्री वह तीनों जगतों की
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरादिस्वरश्चैव ब्रह्मा वै देवतास्त्रयः । हरिदेशसमुत्पन्ना हरिणस्याव्यजायत
verses.transliteration: uttarādisvaraścaiva brahmā vai devatāstrayaḥ / harideśasamutpannā hariṇasyāvyajāyata
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: जननी वह कामेश्वरी विजय श्री से सुसम्पन्न विद्योतमान वैभव वाली शोभित हुई बी ।१४५। समस्त सेना भी युद्ध कमं में खिन्न हो गयी धी और
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: मूर्छना हरिणा ते वै चन्द्रस्यास्याधिदैवतम् । करोपनीता विवृतावनुद्रिः स्वरमण्डले
verses.transliteration: mūrchanā hariṇā te vai candrasyāsyādhidaivatam / karopanītā vivṛtāvanudriḥ svaramaṇḍale
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: साकलोपनतातस्मान्मनुतस्यान्नदैवतः । मनुदेशाः समुत्पन्ना मूर्च्छनाशुद्धमात्मना
verses.transliteration: sākalopanatātasmānmanutasyānnadaivataḥ / manudeśāḥ samutpannā mūrcchanāśuddhamātmanā
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: भंडासुर के प्रवल बाणों की अग्नि से संतप्त हो गयी थी। सूर्य के अस्त होने पर प्रचित प्रभाव वाली उसने जो श्री देवता थी अपने शिविर में बुला लिया धा ।१४६। है तपोधनेन्द्र ! जो भी कोई पुरुष ललिताम्बा के द्वारा किये गये इस भंडासुर के वध को एक बार भी पढ़ता है उसके सब दुःख
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तस्मान्मृगामर्गीमृगेन्द्रोस्याधिदैवता । सावश्रमसमाद्युम्ना अनेकापौरुषानखान्
verses.transliteration: tasmāttasmānmṛgāmargīmṛgendrosyādhidaivatā / sāvaśramasamādyumnā anekāpauruṣānakhān
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: बिनष्ट हो जाते हैं ओर उसको आठ सिद्धियों की प्राप्ति होती है तथा भुक्ति और मुक्ति दोनों ही उसके हाथ में होती है ।१४७। यह पवित्र ललिता का पराकूम समस्त पापों का नाशक ओर अशेष सिद्धियों का दाता है। जो मनुष्य पुण्य दिनों में इसको पढ़ते हैं वे उत्तम भाग्य की समृद्धि को प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: मूर्च्छनायोजनाह्येषास्याद्रजसारजनीततः । तानि उत्तर मद्रांसपद्गदैवतकं विदुः
verses.transliteration: mūrcchanāyojanāhyeṣāsyādrajasārajanītataḥ / tāni uttara madrāṃsapadgadaivatakaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादुत्तरतायावत्प्रथमं स्वायमं विदुः । तमोदुत्तरमैद्रोयदेवतास्याद्रुवेन च
verses.transliteration: tasmāduttaratāyāvatprathamaṃ svāyamaṃ viduḥ / tamoduttaramaidroyadevatāsyādruvena ca
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: चरितेरनधदेव्याः सुप्रीतोऽस्मि हयानन । श्रुता सा महतो शक्तिर्मत्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: अपामदुत्तरत्वावधैवतस्योत्तरायणः । स्यादिजमूर्छनाह्येच पितरः श्राद्धदेवताः
verses.transliteration: apāmaduttaratvāvadhaivatasyottarāyaṇaḥ / syādijamūrchanāhyeca pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: पश्रात्किमकरोत्तत्र युद्धानंतरमंविका । चवुर्थदिन शर्वर्यां विभातायां हयानन ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धषड्जस्वर कृत्वा यस्मादग्निमहर्षयः । उपैति तस्मान्नजानी याच्छुद्धयच्छिकरासभा
verses.transliteration: śuddhaṣaḍjasvara kṛtvā yasmādagnimaharṣayaḥ / upaiti tasmānnajānī yācchuddhayacchikarāsabhā
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: इत्येता मूर्छनाः कृत्वा यस्यामीदृशभावनः । पक्षिणां मूर्छनाः श्रुत्वा पक्षोका मूर्छनाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ityetā mūrchanāḥ kṛtvā yasyāmīdṛśabhāvanaḥ / pakṣiṇāṃ mūrchanāḥ śrutvā pakṣokā mūrchanāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: अस्मिन्नवसरे देवा भंडमर्दनतोषिता: । सर्वेऽपि सेवितुः प्राप्ता ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: नागादृष्टिविषागीतानोपसर्पन्तिमूर्छनाः । नानासाधारमश्चैववडवात्रिविदस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nāgādṛṣṭiviṣāgītānopasarpantimūrchanāḥ / nānāsādhāramaścaivavaḍavātrividastathā
verses.translation: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.hindi: अगस्त्यजी ने कहा-हे महाव् प्राज्ञ ! है अश्वानन ! आपने यह उत्तम आख्यान सुन लिया है । आपने जो ललिता देवी के विकुम को विशे- बता से युक्‍त वर्णन किया है ।१। है हयानन ! देवी के अनघ चरितों से मैं बहुत प्रसन्न हुआ हैँ और मैने मस्त्रिणी और दंडिनी की भी बड़ी भारी
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure (emended from Va. P.)

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे गान्धर्वमूर्छनालक्षणवर्णनं नामैकषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ६१॥ पूर्वाचार्यमतं बुद्ध्वा प्रवक्ष्याम्यनुपूर्वशः । विख्यातान्वै अलङ्कारांस्तन्मे निगदतः श्रुणु
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde gāndharvamūrchanālakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 61// pūrvācāryamataṃ buddhvā pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ / vikhyātānvai alaṅkārāṃstanme nigadataḥ śruṇu
verses.translation: After knowing the views of earlier teachers, I shall expound the well-known embellishments in music in due order. Please listen to them, while I am explaining.
verses.hindi: शक्ति का श्रवण किया है।२। उस युद्ध के अनन्तर उस अम्बिका ने बया किया था । है हयानन ! चौथे दिन की शर्वरी में विभात में बया किया गया था ।३। हयग्रीव जी ने कहा--हे प्राज्ञ कुम्भज ! आप अब वही सुनिए जो भंडासुर के मरने पर जगदम्बा ने किया था ।४। शक्तियों की सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing the views of earlier teachers, I shall expound the well-known embellishments in music in due order. Please listen to them, while I am explaining.
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing the views of earlier teachers, I shall expound the well-known embellishments in music in due order. Please listen to them, while I am explaining.

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्कारास्तु वक्तव्याः स्वैः स्वैर्वर्णैः प्रहेतवः । संस्था नयोगैश्च तथा सदा नाढ्याद्यवेक्षया
verses.transliteration: alaṅkārāstu vaktavyāḥ svaiḥ svairvarṇaiḥ prahetavaḥ / saṃsthā nayogaiśca tathā sadā nāḍhyādyavekṣayā
verses.translation: The embellishments are to be spoken of along with their Varnas (movements of notes such as 'steady', 'ascending and others) as their specific basis and also alongwith their associat- ed configuration (samrthana), always in regard to dramatic1 performance etc.
verses.hindi: सेना को जो हैत्यों के आयुधों से अदित हो गयी थी अपने अमृत से प्लुत लोचनों के द्वारा पुन: आहलादित किवा था ।५। परमेशानो ललिता देवी के कटाक्षों की अमृत धारा से शक्तियों ने युद्ध की श्रान्ति का त्याग कर दिया था और बे प्रसन्न मानस वाली हो गयी थीं ।६। इस अवसर में देवगण
verses.wordMeaning: The embellishments are to be spoken of along with their Varnas (movements of notes such as 'steady', 'ascending and others) as their specific basis and also alongwith their associat- ed configuration (samrthana), always in regard to dramatic1 performance etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The embellishments are to be spoken of along with their Varnas (movements of notes such as 'steady', 'ascending and others) as their specific basis and also alongwith their associat- ed configuration (samrthana), always in regard to dramatic1 performance etc.

verses.sanskrit: वाक्यार्थपदयोगार्थैरलङ्कारैश्च पूरणम् । पदानि गीतकस्याहुः पुरस्तात्पृष्ठतो ऽथ वा
verses.transliteration: vākyārthapadayogārthairalaṅkāraiśca pūraṇam / padāni gītakasyāhuḥ purastātpṛṣṭhato 'tha vā
verses.translation: Vide N&tya&astra (Baroda) Vol. IV. p -92-
verses.hindi: भंडालुर के मदन से प्रसन्न हुए ये । वे सभी जिनमें ब्रह्मा-विष्णु अगुआ ये उस देवी की सेवा करने के लिए समागत हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Vide N&tya&astra (Baroda) Vol. IV. p -92-
verses.commentary: Sense: Vide N&tya&astra (Baroda) Vol. IV. p -92-

verses.sanskrit: स्थातोनित्रीनरो नीड्डीमनःकण्ठशिरस्थया । एतेषु त्रिषु स्थानेषु प्रवृत्तो विधिरुत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sthātonitrīnaro nīḍḍīmanaḥkaṇṭhaśirasthayā / eteṣu triṣu sthāneṣu pravṛtto vidhiruttamaḥ
verses.translation: Va.P. reading: alahkdrasya accepted.
verses.wordMeaning: Va.P. reading: alahkdrasya accepted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va.P. reading: alahkdrasya accepted.

verses.sanskrit: चत्त्वारः प्रकृतौ वर्णाः प्रविचारस्य नुर्विधा । विकल्पमष्टधा चैव देवाः षोडशधा विदुः
verses.transliteration: cattvāraḥ prakṛtau varṇāḥ pravicārasya nurvidhā / vikalpamaṣṭadhā caiva devāḥ ṣoḍaśadhā viduḥ
verses.translation: Bd. P. reads Sthatonitiraro niddimanah. V&. P. reads: sth&n&ni trioi j&niydt urdh etc.
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. P. reads Sthatonitiraro niddimanah. V&. P. reads: sth&n&ni trioi j&niydt urdh etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. P. reads Sthatonitiraro niddimanah. V&. P. reads: sth&n&ni trioi j&niydt urdh etc.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टो वर्मः प्रसंचारी तृतीयमवरोहणम् । आरोहणं चतुर्थं तु वर्णं वर्मविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭo varmaḥ prasaṃcārī tṛtīyamavarohaṇam / ārohaṇaṃ caturthaṃ tu varṇaṃ varmavido viduḥ
verses.translation: (The names of Varnas:)
verses.wordMeaning: (The names of Varnas:)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The names of Varnas:)

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैकः संचरस्थायी संचरस्तु चरो ऽभवत् । अवरोहणवर्णानामवरोहं विनिर्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: tatraikaḥ saṃcarasthāyī saṃcarastu caro 'bhavat / avarohaṇavarṇānāmavarohaṃ vinirdiśet
verses.translation: There are four embellishments viz. Sthdpaniy Krama - rejana, Pramada and Apramada. I shall explain the characteristics of these.3 4
verses.wordMeaning: There are four embellishments viz. Sthdpaniy Krama - rejana, Pramada and Apramada. I shall explain the characteristics of these.3 4
verses.commentary: Sense: There are four embellishments viz. Sthdpaniy Krama - rejana, Pramada and Apramada. I shall explain the characteristics of these.3 4

verses.sanskrit: आरोहणेन वारोहान्वर्णान्वर्णविदो विदुः । एतेषामेव वर्णानामलङ्कारन्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: ārohaṇena vārohānvarṇānvarṇavido viduḥ / eteṣāmeva varṇānāmalaṅkārannibodhata
verses.translation: (Names of Alahkdras continue as follows:) Visvaray Asfakala which has an interval of one place (from its original place?); Avarta and Kramotpatli — These two should be effected according to their proportion.
verses.hindi: चितामणें चितितदानदसेऽचिन्त्ये चिराकारतरंगमाले । चिवाम्बरे चित्रजगत्प्रसूते चित्राख्यनित्ये सुखदे नमस्ते
verses.wordMeaning: (Names of Alahkdras continue as follows:) Visvaray Asfakala which has an interval of one place (from its original place?); Avarta and Kramotpatli — These two should be effected according to their proportion.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Names of Alahkdras continue as follows:) Visvaray Asfakala which has an interval of one place (from its original place?); Avarta and Kramotpatli — These two should be effected according to their proportion.

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्कारास्तु चत्वारस्थापनी क्रमरेजनः । प्रमादस्याप्रमादश्च तेषां वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: alaṅkārāstu catvārasthāpanī kramarejanaḥ / pramādasyāpramādaśca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: These are referred to only in the Puragas. Later writers do not mention them.
verses.hindi: मोक्षप्रदे मुग्धशशांकचूरे मुग्धस्मिते मोहनभेददके । मुद्रेशवरीचचितराजतन्त्े मुदराश्रिये देवि नमोनमस्ते
verses.wordMeaning: These are referred to only in the Puragas. Later writers do not mention them.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are referred to only in the Puragas. Later writers do not mention them.

verses.sanskrit: विस्वरो ऽष्टकलाश्चैव स्थानं द्व्येकतरागतः । आवर्त्तस्याक्रमो त्वाक्षी वेकार्यां परिमाणतः
verses.transliteration: visvaro 'ṣṭakalāścaiva sthānaṃ dvyekatarāgataḥ / āvarttasyākramo tvākṣī vekāryāṃ parimāṇataḥ
verses.translation: The exigencies of metre have led to the change in the order. The order should have been ( 1 ) Sthayin (i.e. Sd Sd Sd), (2 ) Arohin (e.g. Sd ri ga etc.), Avarohin (e.g. ni dha pa etc.) and (4) Saiiearin (e.g. Sa ri sa ri ga ri sa etc.
verses.wordMeaning: The exigencies of metre have led to the change in the order. The order should have been ( 1 ) Sthayin (i.e. Sd Sd Sd), (2 ) Arohin (e.g. Sd ri ga etc.), Avarohin (e.g. ni dha pa etc.) and (4) Saiiearin (e.g. Sa ri sa ri ga ri sa etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The exigencies of metre have led to the change in the order. The order should have been ( 1 ) Sthayin (i.e. Sd Sd Sd), (2 ) Arohin (e.g. Sd ri ga etc.), Avarohin (e.g. ni dha pa etc.) and (4) Saiiearin (e.g. Sa ri sa ri ga ri sa etc.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारं संपरं विद्धि द्विस्तरं वामनं गतः । एष वै एष चैवस्यकुतरेकः कुलाधिकः
verses.transliteration: kumāraṃ saṃparaṃ viddhi dvistaraṃ vāmanaṃ gataḥ / eṣa vai eṣa caivasyakutarekaḥ kulādhikaḥ
verses.translation: But the anthor has not given them anywhere.
verses.wordMeaning: But the anthor has not given them anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the anthor has not given them anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेत स्वे कातरे जातकलामग्नितरैषितः । तस्मिंश्चैव स्वरे वृद्धिर्निष्टप्ते तद्विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: sveta sve kātare jātakalāmagnitaraiṣitaḥ / tasmiṃścaiva svare vṛddhirniṣṭapte tadvicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The texts of Bd. P. and Va. P. are obscure here.
verses.wordMeaning: The texts of Bd. P. and Va. P. are obscure here.
verses.commentary: Sense: The texts of Bd. P. and Va. P. are obscure here.

verses.sanskrit: स्येनस्तु अपरो हस्त उत्तरः कमलाकलः । प्रमाणघसबिन्दुर्ना जायते विदुरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: syenastu aparo hasta uttaraḥ kamalākalaḥ / pramāṇaghasabindurnā jāyate vidure punaḥ
verses.translation: The Alankdra called Prenkholita has the twelfth place of Kala having one interval. Thus it is endowed with the notes (?)
verses.hindi: ब्रह्या--विष्णु-+रुद्र--शकादि सब देवगण- आदित्य--वसुगण-- मस्द्गण=-साध्य देवता--सिद्ध--किम्पुरुप- यक्ष--निर्ट ति आदि मिशा- चर--प्रहलाद आदि महादेत्य-सभी अ ड में निवास करने वाले वहाँ आकर उपस्थित हुए थे और उन्होने प्रसन्नता से सिंहासनेश्वरी की स्तुति की थी
verses.wordMeaning: The Alankdra called Prenkholita has the twelfth place of Kala having one interval. Thus it is endowed with the notes (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Alankdra called Prenkholita has the twelfth place of Kala having one interval. Thus it is endowed with the notes (?)

verses.sanskrit: कला कार्या तु वर्णानां तदा नुः स्थापितो भवेत् । विपर्ययस्य रोपिस्या द्यस्य प्रादुर्घटी मम
verses.transliteration: kalā kāryā tu varṇānāṃ tadā nuḥ sthāpito bhavet / viparyayasya ropisyā dyasya prādurghaṭī mama
verses.translation: Due to employment of Varna and Sthdna having the measure of Raid and Mdtrd are the configuration, proportion,, modification and characteristics.
verses.hindi: ।८१०। ब्रह्मादिक ने कहा--हे इस जगत की एक मात्र स्वामिनि ! आपको बारम्बार नमस्कार है । है श्री त्रिपुराभिघाने ! आपको नमस्कार अनेक आर है । है महान भंडासुर के हनन करने बाली ! है कामेश्वरि ! है वाम- केशि ! आपकी सेवा में अनेकशः प्रणाम समपित हैं ।११। है चिराकार
verses.wordMeaning: Due to employment of Varna and Sthdna having the measure of Raid and Mdtrd are the configuration, proportion,, modification and characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to employment of Varna and Sthdna having the measure of Raid and Mdtrd are the configuration, proportion,, modification and characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: एकोत्तरः स्वरस्तु स्यात्षड्जतः परमः स्वरः । अक्षेपस्कन्दनाकार्यं काकस्योयचपुष्कलम्
verses.transliteration: ekottaraḥ svarastu syātṣaḍjataḥ paramaḥ svaraḥ / akṣepaskandanākāryaṃ kākasyoyacapuṣkalam
verses.translation: This should be known as the purpose of embel- lishment which is fourfold1. Just as in the case of embellishment if it is used at the wrong place it is censured, similarly to beautify even the Varnas unfavourably, the prociucer by oneself (?) would be blamed.
verses.hindi: तरजूमाले ! आप तो अचिन्तनीय हैं-आप चिन्त'मणि के हो समान हैं तथा जो भी प्राणियों का चिन्तित होता है उसके प्रदान करने में दक्ष हैं। हे चित्राम्बदे ! है चित्र जगत् प्रसूते ! है चित्राख्य नित्ये ! आप सुखों के देने बाली है । आपको बारम्बार नमस्कार है ।१२। आप मोक्ष देने वाली हैं--
verses.wordMeaning: This should be known as the purpose of embel- lishment which is fourfold1. Just as in the case of embellishment if it is used at the wrong place it is censured, similarly to beautify even the Varnas unfavourably, the prociucer by oneself (?) would be blamed.
verses.commentary: Sense: This should be known as the purpose of embel- lishment which is fourfold1. Just as in the case of embellishment if it is used at the wrong place it is censured, similarly to beautify even the Varnas unfavourably, the prociucer by oneself (?) would be blamed.

verses.sanskrit: संतारौ तौनुसर्वाय्यौ कार्यं वा कारणं तथा । आक्षिप्तमवरोह्यासीत्प्रोक्षमद्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: saṃtārau taunusarvāyyau kāryaṃ vā kāraṇaṃ tathā / ākṣiptamavarohyāsītprokṣamadyastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Thus the embellishment if used in a wrong place is censured. When the embellishment is effected, it should indi- cate the Rdga (melody).
verses.hindi: मुग्धशशादू चूडे ! आपका स्मित मोहन करने वाला है और आप मोहन करने वाला है और आप मोहून करने में परम दक्ष हैं। है मुद्रेश्दरी लिच्तित राजतन्त्रे ! आप मुद्रात्रिया हैं। है देवि ! आपको अनेक बार प्रणाम हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the embellishment if used in a wrong place is censured. When the embellishment is effected, it should indi- cate the Rdga (melody).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the embellishment if used in a wrong place is censured. When the embellishment is effected, it should indi- cate the Rdga (melody).

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशे च कलास्थानामेकान्तरगतस् तथा । प्रेशोल्लिखितमलङ्कारमेवस्वरसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: dvādaśe ca kalāsthānāmekāntaragatas tathā / preśollikhitamalaṅkāramevasvarasamanvitā
verses.translation: vide Sangtta-ratn&kara 1.6.64 which enumerates Rakti-l&bha. etc.
verses.hindi: हे कोमलाङ्गो ! आप तो कर अन्तक के ध्वंम करने वाली हैं। आप कोप के अवसरों पर काली का विग्रह धारण कर लेती हैं। आप कोप के अवसरों पर कालो का पालन किया है। है कोड़ी-कृताशेष भये । आपको मेरा नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: vide Sangtta-ratn&kara 1.6.64 which enumerates Rakti-l&bha. etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide Sangtta-ratn&kara 1.6.64 which enumerates Rakti-l&bha. etc.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरस्वरबहुग्रामकाप्रयोष्टनुपत्कला । प्रक्षिप्तमेव कलयाचोपादानारयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: svarasvarabahugrāmakāprayoṣṭanupatkalā / prakṣiptameva kalayācopādānārayo bhavet
verses.translation: The songs which have been mentioned and parti- cularly those of fourfold form (?) should be effected with seven notes and the Kaitiki of sevenfold form.
verses.wordMeaning: The songs which have been mentioned and parti- cularly those of fourfold form (?) should be effected with seven notes and the Kaitiki of sevenfold form.
verses.commentary: Sense: The songs which have been mentioned and parti- cularly those of fourfold form (?) should be effected with seven notes and the Kaitiki of sevenfold form.

verses.sanskrit: द्विकथंवावथाभूतयत्रभाषितमुच्यते । उच्चराद्विश्वरारूढातथायाष्टस्वरातथा
verses.transliteration: dvikathaṃvāvathābhūtayatrabhāṣitamucyate / uccarādviśvarārūḍhātathāyāṣṭasvarātathā
verses.translation: (Va. P) In Uttara songs in the original form, the Matra is thus deleted (the rest is obscure).
verses.wordMeaning: (Va. P) In Uttara songs in the original form, the Matra is thus deleted (the rest is obscure).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Va. P) In Uttara songs in the original form, the Matra is thus deleted (the rest is obscure).

verses.sanskrit: वापः स्यादवरोहेण नारतो भवति ध्रुवम् । एकान्तरं च ह्येतेवैतमेवस्वरसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: vāpaḥ syādavaroheṇa nārato bhavati dhruvam / ekāntaraṃ ca hyetevaitamevasvarasattamaḥ
verses.translation: With one foot in the Matra and deficiency in one foot... when there is the Upahanana (error?) of numbers in it, it is called Y&na.
verses.wordMeaning: With one foot in the Matra and deficiency in one foot... when there is the Upahanana (error?) of numbers in it, it is called Y&na.
verses.commentary: Sense: With one foot in the Matra and deficiency in one foot... when there is the Upahanana (error?) of numbers in it, it is called Y&na.

verses.sanskrit: सक्षिप्रच्छेदनामाचचतुष्कलगणः स्मृतः । अलङ्कारा भवन्त्येते त्रिंशद्देवैः प्रकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: sakṣipracchedanāmācacatuṣkalagaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / alaṅkārā bhavantyete triṃśaddevaiḥ prakīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: In the Uttara and in Mandraka songs in their original form, the Pada-bhdga1 and also along with one and a quarter (of a Pada) (?) is in Uttara and Mandraka.
verses.wordMeaning: In the Uttara and in Mandraka songs in their original form, the Pada-bhdga1 and also along with one and a quarter (of a Pada) (?) is in Uttara and Mandraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Uttara and in Mandraka songs in their original form, the Pada-bhdga1 and also along with one and a quarter (of a Pada) (?) is in Uttara and Mandraka.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णास्थानप्रयोगेण कलामात्राप्रमाणतः । संस्थानं च प्रमाणं च विकारो लक्षणस्तथा
verses.transliteration: varṇāsthānaprayogeṇa kalāmātrāpramāṇataḥ / saṃsthānaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ ca vikāro lakṣaṇastathā
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विधमिदं ज्ञेय मलङ्कारप्रयोजनम् । यथात्मनो ह्यलङ्कारो विपयस्तो विगर्हितः
verses.transliteration: caturvidhamidaṃ jñeya malaṅkāraprayojanam / yathātmano hyalaṅkāro vipayasto vigarhitaḥ
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
