verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: वर्ममेवाप्यलङ्कर्त्तुं विषमाह्यात्मसंभवाः । नानाभरणसंयोगा यथा नार्या विभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: varmamevāpyalaṅkarttuṃ viṣamāhyātmasaṃbhavāḥ / nānābharaṇasaṃyogā yathā nāryā vibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: वर्मस्य चैवालङ्कारो विभूषा ह्यात्मसंभवः । न पादे कुण्डलं दृष्टं न कण्ठे रसना तथा
verses.transliteration: varmasya caivālaṅkāro vibhūṣā hyātmasaṃbhavaḥ / na pāde kuṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na kaṇṭhe rasanā tathā
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: एवमेवाद्यलङ्कारे विपर्यस्तो विगर्हितः । क्रियमाणो ऽप्यलङ्कारो नागं यश्चैव दर्शयत्
verses.transliteration: evamevādyalaṅkāre viparyasto vigarhitaḥ / kriyamāṇo 'pyalaṅkāro nāgaṃ yaścaiva darśayat
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: ब्ह्मामृतस्रोतसि राजहंसि ब्रह्मे शवरि श्रीललिते नमस्ते
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: यथादृष्टस्य मार्गस्यकर्त्तव्यस्यविधीयते । लक्षणंपर्यवस्यापिवर्त्तिका मपिवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: yathādṛṣṭasya mārgasyakarttavyasyavidhīyate / lakṣaṇaṃparyavasyāpivarttikā mapivarttate
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: याथातथ्येन वक्ष्यामि मासोद्भवमुखोद्भव । त्रयोविंशतिशीतिस्तु विज्ञातपवदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: yāthātathyena vakṣyāmi māsodbhavamukhodbhava / trayoviṃśatiśītistu vijñātapavadaivatam
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: नगोनातुपुरस्तानुमध्यमांशस्तु पर्ययः । तयोर्विभागो देवानां लावण्ये मार्गसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: nagonātupurastānumadhyamāṃśastu paryayaḥ / tayorvibhāgo devānāṃ lāvaṇye mārgasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: अनुषङ्गमयो दृष्टं स्वसारं वस्वरातर । विपर्ययः संवर्त्तो च सप्तस्वरपदक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: anuṣaṅgamayo dṛṣṭaṃ svasāraṃ vasvarātara / viparyayaḥ saṃvartto ca saptasvarapadakramam
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: गान्धारसेतुगीयन्ते वरोमद्भगवानिच । पञ्चमंमध्यमञ्चैवधैवतं तु निषादतः
verses.transliteration: gāndhārasetugīyante varomadbhagavānica / pañcamaṃmadhyamañcaivadhaivataṃ tu niṣādataḥ
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: हे ललिते ! आप षडंगदेवी परियार कृष्णा है। है षड़ंगयुक्त श्रुति वाक्यों के द्वारा आप षट्चक् में विराजमाना हैं। है षड्भियुबते ! आप बड्भाव रूपों वाली हैं । आपको हम सबका प्रणाम हैं ।१५। है मुख्ये समस्त नित्ये ! है कामे ! है शिवे ! है कान्तासनान्ते ! आपके नेत्र कमलों के
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: षड्जर्षभश्चजानीमोमद्रकेष्वेवनान्तरे । द्वेव्द्यपरतुकिंविद्याद्द्वयमुष्णन्तिकस्यतु
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍjarṣabhaścajānīmomadrakeṣvevanāntare / dvevdyaparatukiṃvidyāddvayamuṣṇantikasyatu
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: समान हैं। आप कामनाओं के देने बाली हैं । है कामिनि ! आप कामशम्भु की काम्य हैं। है कलाओं की स्वामिनि ! आपको नमस्कार है।१६। है दिव्यौषधादये ! आप नगरीघ रूप वाली हैं। है दिव्ये ! आप दिनाधीश सहो के समान कान्ति वाली हैं । है सनाथे ! आप दया से देदीप्यमाना
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: प्राकृते वैकृते चैव गान्धारः स प्रयुज्यते । पदस्यात्ययरूपन्तुसप्तरूपन्तुकौशिकीम्
verses.transliteration: prākṛte vaikṛte caiva gāndhāraḥ sa prayujyate / padasyātyayarūpantusaptarūpantukauśikīm
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: है। है देवाधिदेव शम्भु की प्रमदे ! आपको हम सबका प्रणाम निनेदित है
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: गान्धारस्येनकार्त्स्येन चायं यस्यविधिः स्मृतः । एषचैवक्रमोद्दिष्टोमध्यमांशस्य मध्यमः
verses.transliteration: gāndhārasyenakārtsyena cāyaṃ yasyavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ / eṣacaivakramoddiṣṭomadhyamāṃśasya madhyamaḥ
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: करने के योग्य हैं आप सदा शिव के आत्मोज्ज्वल मञ्च पर निवास किया करती है । है सदेकालय पादपूज्ये ! है सभ्ये ! आप लोक को रक्षिका है । आप लोक की रिका हैं। आपको बारम्बार नमस्कार है १८) ब्राह्मी जिनमें प्रमुख हैं ऐसी मातृ गर्णो के द्वारा आप सेव्य हैं। आप ब्रह्म प्रिया
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: यानि प्रोक्तानि गीतानिवतुरूपं विशेषतः । ततः सप्तस्वरङ्कार्यंसप्तरूपञ्चकौशिकी
verses.transliteration: yāni proktāni gītānivaturūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ / tataḥ saptasvaraṅkāryaṃsaptarūpañcakauśikī
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: हैं। है ब्राह्मण बस्त्रभेजि ! आप तो ब्रह्मामूत की खोत हैं। है राजहंसि ! आप ब्रह्मा श्वरी हैं । है श्री ललिते ! आपको हमारा प्रणाम है ।१६। संक्षो- भिणी जिनमें प्रधान है उन समस्त मुद्राओं के द्वारा संसेवित आप हैं और संसरण का प्रहनन करने वाली हैं । है संसार लीला ऋतिसार साक्षि ! हे
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: अगदर्शनमित्याहुर्मानुद्वैममकेतथा । द्वितीयामासमात्राणाभिः सर्वाः प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: agadarśanamityāhurmānudvaimamaketathā / dvitīyāmāsamātrāṇābhiḥ sarvāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: संसार लीला कृतिसार खाक्षि ! है अधिनाये ! लसिते.! आपको हमारा नमस्कार है । है अधीशि ! आप नित्या हैं ओर षोडश कला से आकर्षण
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरेवप्रकृत्येवंमाताब्राह्मतलायत । तथाहतानोपिडकेयत्रमायांनिवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: uttarevaprakṛtyevaṃmātābrāhmatalāyata / tathāhatānopiḍakeyatramāyāṃnivarttate
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: पादेनैकेनमायात्रा पादोनामतिवारिमः । संख्यापनोपहूतांवैतत्रपानमिति स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: pādenaikenamāyātrā pādonāmativārimaḥ / saṃkhyāpanopahūtāṃvaitatrapānamiti smṛtam
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: करने वाली हैं तथा प्रम के दवारा सेवन करते के योग्य हैं ।२०। है नित्ये ! आपकी दया का प्रपञ्च निरांतक है । आपके नीले अलकों की श्रेणियां है । आपको वारम्वार नमस्कार है । अनंग पुष्पादि एवं उम्नदा अनंग देवियों के द्वारा आप निरन्तर सेवन के योग्य रहती हैं। है अभव हन्ति! है अक्षर-
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयपादभङ्गञ्चग्रहेनामप्रतिष्ठितम् । पूर्वमष्ठतीटती नद्वितीयं चापरान्तिकैः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyapādabhaṅgañcagrahenāmapratiṣṭhitam / pūrvamaṣṭhatīṭatī nadvitīyaṃ cāparāntikaiḥ
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: राशि रूपे ! आपने समस्त शत्रुओं को निहत कर दिया है। हे. ललिते ! आपको हमारा नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: पादभागसपादं तु प्रकृत्यमपि संस्थितम् । चतुर्थमुत्तरं चैवमद्रवत्पावमद्रकौ
verses.transliteration: pādabhāgasapādaṃ tu prakṛtyamapi saṃsthitam / caturthamuttaraṃ caivamadravatpāvamadrakau
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: मद्रकोदक्षिणस्यापि यथोक्ता वर्त्तते कला । सर्वमेवानुयोगं तु द्वितीयं बुद्धिमिष्यते
verses.transliteration: madrakodakṣiṇasyāpi yathoktā varttate kalā / sarvamevānuyogaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ buddhimiṣyate
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: सर्वज्ञजातप्रथमा्िरन्यदेवीभि रप्याश्रितचक्रभूमे । सर्वामराकांक्षितपूरथित्रि सर्वस्य लोकस्य सवित्रि पाहि
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: पादौवाहरणं चास्यात्पारं नात्र विधीयते । एकत्वं मुनुयोगस्य द्वयोर्यद्यद्द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: pādauvāharaṇaṃ cāsyātpāraṃ nātra vidhīyate / ekatvaṃ munuyogasya dvayoryadyaddvijottama
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: अनेकसमवायस्तु पातका हरिणा स्मृताः । तिसृणां चैव वृत्तीनां वृत्तौ वृत्ते च दक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: anekasamavāyastu pātakā hariṇā smṛtāḥ / tisṛṇāṃ caiva vṛttīnāṃ vṛttau vṛtte ca dakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: कामेशि वज्ञे शि भगेश्य रूपे कन्ये कले कालविलोपदशे । कथाविशेषीङ्गतदेत्यसेन्ये कामेशयांते कमले नमस्ते
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ तु समवायस्तु वीरा संमूर्छना तथा । कस्यनासुतराचैव स्वरशाखा प्रकीर्त्तिता
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau tu samavāyastu vīrā saṃmūrchanā tathā / kasyanāsutarācaiva svaraśākhā prakīrttitā
verses.translation: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.hindi: बिन्दुस्थिते विन्दुकलँकल्पे विद्वात्मिके बृ हितचित्प्रकाशे । बृहृत्कुचांभोजविलोलहारे वृहत्प्रभावे ललिते नमस्ते ॥
verses.wordMeaning: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,
verses.commentary: Sense: There were three Mdrgas (ways of the 7a/a-procedure) namely Citra,

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते गान्धर्वलक्षणं नाम द्विषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ६२॥ सूत उवाच कुकुद्मिननस्तु तं लोकं रैवतस्य गतस्य ह । त्दृता पुण्यजनैः सर्वा राक्षसैः साकुशस्थली
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite gāndharvalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 62// sūta uvāca kukudminanastu taṃ lokaṃ raivatasya gatasya ha / tdṛtā puṇyajanaiḥ sarvā rākṣasaiḥ sākuśasthalī
verses.translation: The hundred brothers of that virtuous and noble- souled king were afflicted by arrows. Therefore, they fled in every direction due to fear.
verses.hindi: आप संक्षोभिणो प्रमृति जिनमें मुख्य हैं ऐसी अचि मालाओं से समां वृत्त उदार महान प्रदीप्त वाली हैं है विश्रमाढ्ये ! आप आत्मा को आवि- भरण करती हैं। आपका शुभ्र आखय है । है शुभ्रपंदे ! आपको नमस्कार है ।२रा शम्भु के सहित सिद्ध आदि शक्तियों से आप. वन्दयमान हैं। आपका
verses.wordMeaning: The hundred brothers of that virtuous and noble- souled king were afflicted by arrows. Therefore, they fled in every direction due to fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hundred brothers of that virtuous and noble- souled king were afflicted by arrows. Therefore, they fled in every direction due to fear.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वै भ्रातृशतं तस्य धार्मिकस्य महात्मनः । निबध्यमानं नाराचैर्विदिशः प्राद्रवद्भयात्
verses.transliteration: tadvai bhrātṛśataṃ tasya dhārmikasya mahātmanaḥ / nibadhyamānaṃ nārācairvidiśaḥ prādravadbhayāt
verses.translation: The Vrttis (styles of rendering songs with accompaniment) were three namely Citrd, Vrtti and Dakfiyd. They were associated with the three Mdrgas: Citra, Vdrtika and Dakfipa, the three Lay as (tempi), and Grahas etc.
verses.hindi: चरण कमल सवैज्ञ के द्वारा हो विज्ञात है । आप सबसे बड़ो हैं--आप सबमें विद्यमान हैं और आप सब  सिद्धियों के प्रदान करने वाली हैं। है श्री
verses.wordMeaning: The Vrttis (styles of rendering songs with accompaniment) were three namely Citrd, Vrtti and Dakfiyd. They were associated with the three Mdrgas: Citra, Vdrtika and Dakfipa, the three Lay as (tempi), and Grahas etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vrttis (styles of rendering songs with accompaniment) were three namely Citrd, Vrtti and Dakfiyd. They were associated with the three Mdrgas: Citra, Vdrtika and Dakfipa, the three Lay as (tempi), and Grahas etc.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु तद्भयक्रान्तक्षत्रियाणां च विद्रुताम् । अन्ववायस्तु सुमहांस्तत्र तत्र द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu tadbhayakrāntakṣatriyāṇāṃ ca vidrutām / anvavāyastu sumahāṃstatra tatra dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahm&nas, the dynasty of these Ksatriyas who fled due to excessive fright, is very great. They are present in different places.1
verses.hindi: ललिते ! आपको प्रणाम है।२३। आप सर्वत्र से समुत्पन्न प्रथम देवियों के द्वारा आश्रित चक्रभूमि वालो हैं । और सब देवों के मनोरथों को पूर्ण करने बाली हैं। आप सम्पूणं लोक की माता हैं । हमारी रक्षा कीजिए ।२४ हे वाशिनी आदि वास्बिभूते ! आप विष्णु चक्र की वाह वाह हैं । आपके केश
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahm&nas, the dynasty of these Ksatriyas who fled due to excessive fright, is very great. They are present in different places.1
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahm&nas, the dynasty of these Ksatriyas who fled due to excessive fright, is very great. They are present in different places.1

verses.sanskrit: शार्याता इति विख्याता दिक्षु सर्वासु धर्मिकाः । धृष्टस्य धर्ष्टिकं सर्वं रणधृष्टं बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: śāryātā iti vikhyātā dikṣu sarvāsu dharmikāḥ / dhṛṣṭasya dharṣṭikaṃ sarvaṃ raṇadhṛṣṭaṃ babhūva ha
verses.translation: They are well-known in all the quarters as Saryatas. They arc righteous. The line of Dhfsta is called Dharstika. All the members were bold and aggressive in battle.
verses.hindi: बलाहक की झि वाले हैं । आप बचनों की सागर हैं। आप बरदान देने वाली हैं। है सुन्दरि ! आप इस विश्व को रक्षा करें ।२४। बाण के आदि विशेष आयुधों की साज्ाज्ञी हैं। आप भंडासुर को सेना के बन लिये दावाग्नि हैं । आप अतीव उग्र तेज से अम्डुराभि को भी ज्वलित करने वाली
verses.wordMeaning: They are well-known in all the quarters as Saryatas. They arc righteous. The line of Dhfsta is called Dharstika. All the members were bold and aggressive in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are well-known in all the quarters as Saryatas. They arc righteous. The line of Dhfsta is called Dharstika. All the members were bold and aggressive in battle.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिसाहस्रं तु स गणः क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम् । नभगस्य च दायादो नाभादो नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: trisāhasraṃ tu sa gaṇaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahātmanām / nabhagasya ca dāyādo nābhādo nāma vīryavān
verses.translation: These were born of Ksatriyas but are remembered as having become Arigiras. The excellent members of Rathitara family were Brahmanas as well as Ksatriyas.
verses.hindi: हैं । आप प्रसंब्यमाना हैं । आपकी सभी ओर से प्रणाम है ।२६। है कामेशि ! वज्योशि ! है भगेशि ! आप रूप रहित हैं । है कन्ये ! है कले ! आप काल के विलोप करने में परम दक्ष हैं । आपने देत्यों की सेनाओं को पूर्णतया समाप्त कर दिया है और अव उनकी केवल कया हो शेष है । कामेशयान्ते !
verses.wordMeaning: These were born of Ksatriyas but are remembered as having become Arigiras. The excellent members of Rathitara family were Brahmanas as well as Ksatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These were born of Ksatriyas but are remembered as having become Arigiras. The excellent members of Rathitara family were Brahmanas as well as Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: अंबरीषस्तु नाभागिर्विरूपस्तस्य चात्मजः । पृषदश्वो विरूपस्य तस्य पुत्रो रथीतरः
verses.transliteration: aṃbarīṣastu nābhāgirvirūpastasya cātmajaḥ / pṛṣadaśvo virūpasya tasya putro rathītaraḥ
verses.translation: Vikuksi, Nimi and Dantja, these three were the most excellent among them. He had fifty sons, the chief of whom was Sakuni.
verses.hindi: हे कमले ! आपको नमस्कार है ।२७। आप बिन्दु में ही संस्थित हैं और आपका रूप विन्दु कला हो एक है । आप बिन्दु के स्वरूप वाली हैं और आपने ज्ञान के बढ़े प्रकाश को किया है । आपके बड़ें कुचों पर हार विलु- लित हो रहा है। आपका प्रभाव बृहत् है । है ललिते ! आपको हम सबका
verses.wordMeaning: Vikuksi, Nimi and Dantja, these three were the most excellent among them. He had fifty sons, the chief of whom was Sakuni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vikuksi, Nimi and Dantja, these three were the most excellent among them. He had fifty sons, the chief of whom was Sakuni.

verses.sanskrit: एते क्षत्रप्रसूता वै पुनश्चाङ्गिरसः स्मृताः । रथीतराणां प्रवराः क्षेत्रोपेता द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: ete kṣatraprasūtā vai punaścāṅgirasaḥ smṛtāḥ / rathītarāṇāṃ pravarāḥ kṣetropetā dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 3-7. Though the present chapter deals mainly with the Iksvaku dynasty, these verses mention the dynastic list in the pre-Yayati period i.r. before Circa 3000 B.C. as per Vedic Age (BVB— Bharatiya Vidya B ha van, Bombay).
verses.hindi: कामेश्व रोत्संगसदानिवासे कालात्मिके देवि कृतानुकम्पे । कल्पावसानोत्थितकालिरूपे कामप्रदे कल्पलते नमस्ते
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 3-7. Though the present chapter deals mainly with the Iksvaku dynasty, these verses mention the dynastic list in the pre-Yayati period i.r. before Circa 3000 B.C. as per Vedic Age (BVB— Bharatiya Vidya B ha van, Bombay).
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 3-7. Though the present chapter deals mainly with the Iksvaku dynasty, these verses mention the dynastic list in the pre-Yayati period i.r. before Circa 3000 B.C. as per Vedic Age (BVB— Bharatiya Vidya B ha van, Bombay).

verses.sanskrit: क्षुवतस्तु मनोः पूर्वमिक्ष्वाकुरभिनिःसृतः । तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीदिक्ष्वाकोर्भूरिदक्षिमम्
verses.transliteration: kṣuvatastu manoḥ pūrvamikṣvākurabhiniḥsṛtaḥ / tasya putraśataṃ tvāsīdikṣvākorbhūridakṣimam
verses.translation: From V. 8, the author describes the dynasty of Ik?v&ku. His three sons Vikuksi, Nimi and Dapa founded dynasties at Ayodhya (U.P.)„ Videha (Bihar) and Danaka (North Deccan).
verses.hindi: नव्यानि सर्वाणि वपू थि कृत्वा हि सांद्रकारुण्यसुधाप्लयैन्नेः। त्वया समस्तं भुवनं सहषं सुजीवितं सुन्दरि सभ्यलभ्ये
verses.wordMeaning: From V. 8, the author describes the dynasty of Ik?v&ku. His three sons Vikuksi, Nimi and Dapa founded dynasties at Ayodhya (U.P.)„ Videha (Bihar) and Danaka (North Deccan).
verses.commentary: Sense: From V. 8, the author describes the dynasty of Ik?v&ku. His three sons Vikuksi, Nimi and Dapa founded dynasties at Ayodhya (U.P.)„ Videha (Bihar) and Danaka (North Deccan).

verses.sanskrit: तेषां श्रेष्ठो विकुक्षिस्तु निमिर्दण्डश्च ते त्रयः । शकुनिप्रमुखास्तस्य पुत्राः पञ्चाशतस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ śreṣṭho vikukṣistu nimirdaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ / śakunipramukhāstasya putrāḥ pañcāśatastu te
verses.translation: "Fetch flesh for the sake of Sr&ddha, O highly power- ful one, after killing animals. The Sr&ddha of As (aka has to be performed by me surely."
verses.wordMeaning: "Fetch flesh for the sake of Sr&ddha, O highly power- ful one, after killing animals. The Sr&ddha of As (aka has to be performed by me surely."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Fetch flesh for the sake of Sr&ddha, O highly power- ful one, after killing animals. The Sr&ddha of As (aka has to be performed by me surely."

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरापथदेशस्य रक्षितारो महीक्षितः । चत्वारिंशत्तथाष्टौ च दक्षिणस्यां तु वै दिशि
verses.transliteration: uttarāpathadeśasya rakṣitāro mahīkṣitaḥ / catvāriṃśattathāṣṭau ca dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu vai diśi
verses.translation: At the instance of the intelligent one, he went for hunting. After killing thousands of animals, the powerful prince became tired.
verses.wordMeaning: At the instance of the intelligent one, he went for hunting. After killing thousands of animals, the powerful prince became tired.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of the intelligent one, he went for hunting. After killing thousands of animals, the powerful prince became tired.

verses.sanskrit: विराटप्रमुखास्ते च दक्षिणापथरक्षिणः । इक्ष्वाकुस्तु विकुक्षिं वै अष्टकायामथा दिशत्
verses.transliteration: virāṭapramukhāste ca dakṣiṇāpatharakṣiṇaḥ / ikṣvākustu vikukṣiṃ vai aṣṭakāyāmathā diśat
verses.translation: Learned men explain the etymological meaning of Aldmsa1 (ilesh) thus: —
verses.hindi: आप कामेश्वर को गोद में ही सदा निवास किया करती हैं भौर आपका काल हो स्वरूप है । है देवि ! आपने बड़ी अनुकम्पा की है। आप कल्प के अन्त में उठो हुई काली के स्वरूप वाली हैं। आप कामनाओं के देने वाली हैं ओर आप साक्षात् कल्पलता है । आपको नमस्कार है। आप
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men explain the etymological meaning of Aldmsa1 (ilesh) thus: —
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men explain the etymological meaning of Aldmsa1 (ilesh) thus: —

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच । मांसमानय श्राद्धे त्वं मृगान्हत्वा महाबल । श्राद्धं मम तु कर्त्तव्यमष्टकानां न संशयः
verses.transliteration: rājovāca / māṃsamānaya śrāddhe tvaṃ mṛgānhatvā mahābala / śrāddhaṃ mama tu karttavyamaṣṭakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Kalidasa, however, explains the epithet Kakutstha (as 'one who occupies a prominent place among kings*, vide Raghuvamia VI. 71 lkfvdku - vamiyah kakudam nrp&nam kakutstha. itydhitalakfapobhut.
verses.hindi: सवारुणा हैं और साखभोतांशु के समान शीतल हैं । आपके नेत्र हरिण के बच्चे के तुल्य हैं और आपका मुख कमल जैसा है। आप सार के भी सार की सदा एक भूमि है। आप समस्त विद्याओं की स्वामिनी हैं। आपको हमारा प्रणिवात है ।२९-३०। आपके प्रभाव से श्री शम्भुनाथ के द्वारा प्रक-
verses.wordMeaning: Kalidasa, however, explains the epithet Kakutstha (as 'one who occupies a prominent place among kings*, vide Raghuvamia VI. 71 lkfvdku - vamiyah kakudam nrp&nam kakutstha. itydhitalakfapobhut.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalidasa, however, explains the epithet Kakutstha (as 'one who occupies a prominent place among kings*, vide Raghuvamia VI. 71 lkfvdku - vamiyah kakudam nrp&nam kakutstha. itydhitalakfapobhut.

verses.sanskrit: स गतो मृगयां चैव वचनात्तस्य धीमतः । मृगान्सहस्रकान्हत्वा परिश्रान्तश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: sa gato mṛgayāṃ caiva vacanāttasya dhīmataḥ / mṛgānsahasrakānhatvā pariśrāntaśca vīryavān
verses.translation: We wish to hear in detail, O sage of great intelli- gence, how Dhundhu was killed, on account of which Kuvalasva came to be called Dhundhumara. #
verses.hindi: डित अग्निजा में चित् है । समर में महान प्रचण्ड भंडासुर प्रभृति सब जो जगत के कंटक ये, मारे गये हैं।३१। सब णरीरों को नवीन करके हमको स्वस्थ वना दिया है और आपने सान्द्र करुणा की सुधा से ही कर दिया था । आपने सभस्त भुवन को हर्ष के साथ जीवित कर दिया है। है सभ्य-
verses.wordMeaning: We wish to hear in detail, O sage of great intelli- gence, how Dhundhu was killed, on account of which Kuvalasva came to be called Dhundhumara. #
verses.commentary: Sense: We wish to hear in detail, O sage of great intelli- gence, how Dhundhu was killed, on account of which Kuvalasva came to be called Dhundhumara. #

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयच्छशकं तत्र विकुक्षिर्मृगयां गतः । आगते हि विकुक्षै तु समांसे महसैनिके
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayacchaśakaṃ tatra vikukṣirmṛgayāṃ gataḥ / āgate hi vikukṣai tu samāṃse mahasainike
verses.translation: Uttarika the Brahminical sage, prevented the great king Brhadasva who was brave, excellent and virtuous, from going to the forest.
verses.hindi: नभ्ये ! आप तो परम सुन्दरी है ।३२। महान् आशय बाले श्री शम्भु के आप द्वितोय तेज के प्रसर के स्वरूप वालो हैं । जो स्थाणु के आश्रम से क्लृप्तता से विरक्त सती के वियोग से बिरस्त भोग वाला है।३३। इससे आदि फे वंश में जम्भ का लाम प्राप्त करने वाली कन्या उमा को योजित करने के
verses.wordMeaning: Uttarika the Brahminical sage, prevented the great king Brhadasva who was brave, excellent and virtuous, from going to the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uttarika the Brahminical sage, prevented the great king Brhadasva who was brave, excellent and virtuous, from going to the forest.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठं चोदयामास मांस प्रोक्षयतामिति । तथेति चोदितो राज्ञा विधिवत्तदुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṃ codayāmāsa māṃsa prokṣayatāmiti / tatheti codito rājñā vidhivattadupasthitam
verses.translation: "The duty of protecting people should be carried out by you. It behoves you to do it. O king, I am unable to perform penance unperturbed.
verses.hindi: लिए सन प्रवृत्त हुए थे । घोर तपस्या में बतं मान उनके समीप में कामदेव को भेजने की प्रेरणा को थो ।३४। उन्होने वेराग्य से किये जाने वाले तप के विघात से जो क्रोध हुआ! था उससे वह कामदेव ललाट की अग्नि से दग्ध कर दिया था। फिर मदन मस्म मात्र रह गया था । वही मदन फिर भंडा-
verses.wordMeaning: "The duty of protecting people should be carried out by you. It behoves you to do it. O king, I am unable to perform penance unperturbed.
verses.commentary: Sense: "The duty of protecting people should be carried out by you. It behoves you to do it. O king, I am unable to perform penance unperturbed.

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वोपहतं मांसं क्रुद्धो राजानमब्रवीत् । अनेनोपहतं मांसं पुत्रेण तव पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvopahataṃ māṃsaṃ kruddho rājānamabravīt / anenopahataṃ māṃsaṃ putreṇa tava pārthiva
verses.translation: Near the precincts of my hermitage, on the other side of Meru, the ocean is filled with sand, O king.
verses.wordMeaning: Near the precincts of my hermitage, on the other side of Meru, the ocean is filled with sand, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near the precincts of my hermitage, on the other side of Meru, the ocean is filled with sand, O king.

verses.sanskrit: शशभक्षाददुष्टं वै नैव मांसं महाद्युते । शशो दुरात्मना पूर्वममना भक्षितो ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: śaśabhakṣādaduṣṭaṃ vai naiva māṃsaṃ mahādyute / śaśo durātmanā pūrvamamanā bhakṣito 'nagha
verses.translation: When he exhales at the end of a year, the ground there quakes and shakes along with the forests.
verses.hindi: ततो वधस्तस्य दुराशयस्य कृतो भवत्या रणदुसे दस्य । अथास्मदर्थे त्वतनुस्सजातस्त्वं कामसंजीवनमाशु कुर्याः
verses.wordMeaning: When he exhales at the end of a year, the ground there quakes and shakes along with the forests.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he exhales at the end of a year, the ground there quakes and shakes along with the forests.

verses.sanskrit: तेन मांसमिदं दुष्टं पितॄणां नृपसत्तम । इक्ष्वाकुस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो विकुक्षिमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tena māṃsamidaṃ duṣṭaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nṛpasattama / ikṣvākustu tataḥ kruddho vikukṣimidamabravīt
verses.translation: Resist him, O king of great powerful arms, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. Your brilliant splendour is already great. Visnu will develop it further by contribution of his own splendour.
verses.wordMeaning: Resist him, O king of great powerful arms, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. Your brilliant splendour is already great. Visnu will develop it further by contribution of his own splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resist him, O king of great powerful arms, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. Your brilliant splendour is already great. Visnu will develop it further by contribution of his own splendour.

verses.sanskrit: पितृकर्मणि निर्दिष्टो मया च मृगयां गतः । शशं भक्षयसे ऽरण्ये निर्घृणः पूर्वमद्य तु
verses.transliteration: pitṛkarmaṇi nirdiṣṭo mayā ca mṛgayāṃ gataḥ / śaśaṃ bhakṣayase 'raṇye nirghṛṇaḥ pūrvamadya tu
verses.translation: Indeed, you alone are capable of slaying him, O lord of the Earth. Let the worlds become happy and relieved with that Asura slain.
verses.hindi: तेनेव वीरेण रणे निरस्य स तारको नाम सुरारिराज:
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, you alone are capable of slaying him, O lord of the Earth. Let the worlds become happy and relieved with that Asura slain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, you alone are capable of slaying him, O lord of the Earth. Let the worlds become happy and relieved with that Asura slain.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्परित्यजामि त्वां गच्छ त्वं स्वेन कर्मणा । एवमिक्ष्वाकुणा त्यक्तो वसिष्ठवचनात्सुतः
verses.transliteration: tasmātparityajāmi tvāṃ gaccha tvaṃ svena karmaṇā / evamikṣvākuṇā tyakto vasiṣṭhavacanātsutaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus by the noble-soulcd Ut tanka, that saintly king gave him Kuvala$va for the task of warding off Dhundhu.
verses.hindi: यो भंडदेत्यस्य दुराशयस्य मित्रं स लोकत्रयधूमकेतुः । श्रीकण्ठपुत्र ण रणे हतश्चेत्प्राणप्रष्ठिव तदा भवेन्नः
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by the noble-soulcd Ut tanka, that saintly king gave him Kuvala$va for the task of warding off Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by the noble-soulcd Ut tanka, that saintly king gave him Kuvala$va for the task of warding off Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकौसंस्थिते तस्मिञ्छशादः पृथिवीमिमाम् । प्राप्तः परगधर्मात्मा स चायोध्याधिपो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākausaṃsthite tasmiñchaśādaḥ pṛthivīmimām / prāptaḥ paragadharmātmā sa cāyodhyādhipo 'bhavat
verses.translation: "O holy lord, I have laid down my arms. This is my son, O excellent Brahmana. He will undoubtedly become the slayer of Dhundhu".
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord, I have laid down my arms. This is my son, O excellent Brahmana. He will undoubtedly become the slayer of Dhundhu".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord, I have laid down my arms. This is my son, O excellent Brahmana. He will undoubtedly become the slayer of Dhundhu".

verses.sanskrit: तदाकरोत्स राज्यं वै वसिष्ठपरिनोदितः । ततस्तेनैनसा पूर्णो राज्यावस्थो महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: tadākarotsa rājyaṃ vai vasiṣṭhaparinoditaḥ / tatastenainasā pūrṇo rājyāvastho mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: He ordered his son to carry out the task of slaying Dhundhu with any step. The king of praiseworthy holy rites, went to the forest itself for the sake of penance.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर आपने दुराशय का जो रण में बहुत ही दुर्मद था वघ किया था और हम लोगों के लिए वह बिना शरीर बाला हो गया है । उस कामदेव के संजीवन को आप शीघ्र ही कर दोजिए ।३६। यह रति बिचारी अपने स्वामी के वियोग से बहुत ही खिन्न है। उसको अत्यन्त बुरा बैध्य
verses.wordMeaning: He ordered his son to carry out the task of slaying Dhundhu with any step. The king of praiseworthy holy rites, went to the forest itself for the sake of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He ordered his son to carry out the task of slaying Dhundhu with any step. The king of praiseworthy holy rites, went to the forest itself for the sake of penance.

verses.sanskrit: कालेन गतवान्सो ऽथ शकृन्मूत्रतरङ्गितम् । ज्ञात्वैवमेतदाख्यानं ना विधिर्भक्षयेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: kālena gatavānso 'tha śakṛnmūtrataraṅgitam / jñātvaivametadākhyānaṃ nā vidhirbhakṣayedbudhaḥ
verses.translation: B.G. Law regards this legend as a natural phenomenon. He con- jectures that this volcanic pit near the western sea was sub-merged with sea water and the volcanic action ceased by the efforts of Kuval&iva ( Tribes in Ancient India, ), while Pargiter regards this as a shallow sand-filled sea in Rajasthan which prevented Aryan expansion (AIHT. p -61).
verses.hindi: प्राप्त हो गया है है श्रोललिते ! फिर आपके द्वारा उत्पन्न किये गये काम- देव के सङ्ग से वह सनाथा होगो ।३७। उसो भाति उस दुष्ट कामदेव ने फिर इन्दुमौलि को पूर्व की हो भाँति संमोहित किया है बह ईश चिरकाल पर्यत अचंन। करने वाली उस पार्वती के साथ शी प्र ही विवाह करेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: B.G. Law regards this legend as a natural phenomenon. He con- jectures that this volcanic pit near the western sea was sub-merged with sea water and the volcanic action ceased by the efforts of Kuval&iva ( Tribes in Ancient India, ),…
verses.commentary: Sense: B.G. Law regards this legend as a natural phenomenon. He con- jectures that this volcanic pit near the western sea was sub-merged with sea water and the volcanic action ceased by the efforts of Kuval&iva ( Tribes in Ancient India, ),…

verses.sanskrit: मांसभक्षयितामुत्र यस्य मांसमिहाद्म्यहम् । एतन्मांसस्य मांसत्वं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: māṃsabhakṣayitāmutra yasya māṃsamihādmyaham / etanmāṃsasya māṃsatvaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: "This king shall become Dhundhumara (slayer of Dhundhu) with effect from today". The Devas showered him all round with divine flowers.
verses.hindi: उन दोनों (पाबंती-शिक) के संयोग से कुमार उत्पन्न होगा जो समस्त देव- गणों की सेता का सेनानी होगा । उस ही बोर के द्वारा रण में असुरों का राजा वह तारक पराजित किया गया ।३६। वह तीनों लोकों का धूमकेतु परम दुष्ट भंडासुर का मित्र था। वह रण में श्रीकष्ठ के पुत्र के द्वारा ही
verses.wordMeaning: "This king shall become Dhundhumara (slayer of Dhundhu) with effect from today". The Devas showered him all round with divine flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This king shall become Dhundhumara (slayer of Dhundhu) with effect from today". The Devas showered him all round with divine flowers.

verses.sanskrit: शशादस्य तु दायादः ककुत्स्थो नाम वीर्यवान् । इन्द्रस्य वृषभूतस्य ककुत्स्थो जयते पुरा
verses.transliteration: śaśādasya tu dāyādaḥ kakutstho nāma vīryavān / indrasya vṛṣabhūtasya kakutstho jayate purā
verses.translation: By means of his Yogic power that great and excellent Asura let flow water like the great ocean blending its currents and waves together at the time of moon-rise.
verses.hindi: मारा गया था । उसी समय में हमारे श्राणों की प्रतिष्ठा हुई थी ।४०। इस कारण से है अम्ब ! है जिपुरे ! जनों के मान के अपहर्ता वोरवर कामदेव को उत्पन्न करके विचारी उस व्याकुल कुन्तला रति के विधवापने को आप बूर कर दीजिए ।४१। यह बिचारी अनाय है और अपने भर्ता के प्रणाश
verses.wordMeaning: By means of his Yogic power that great and excellent Asura let flow water like the great ocean blending its currents and waves together at the time of moon-rise.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his Yogic power that great and excellent Asura let flow water like the great ocean blending its currents and waves together at the time of moon-rise.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमाडीबके युद्धे ककुत्स्थस्तेन संस्मृतः । अनेनास्तु ककुत्स्थस्य पृथुश्चानेन स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pūrvamāḍībake yuddhe kakutsthastena saṃsmṛtaḥ / anenāstu kakutsthasya pṛthuścānena sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: All his sons were burnt down completely; only three survived that battle.
verses.hindi: होने से अत्यन्त कृश अङ्गों वाली आपकी शरणागति में प्राप्त हुई है। हे ज्रिपुराभिधाने ! यह आपको नमस्कार करतो है। अतएव इस बिचारी पर आप करुणा करिए
verses.wordMeaning: All his sons were burnt down completely; only three survived that battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: All his sons were burnt down completely; only three survived that battle.

verses.sanskrit: दृषदश्वः पृथोः पुत्रस्तस्मादन्ध्रस्तु वीर्यवान् । अन्ध्रात्तु युवनाश्वस्तु शावस्तस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣadaśvaḥ pṛthoḥ putrastasmādandhrastu vīryavān / andhrāttu yuvanāśvastu śāvastastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Her son Gaurika (i.e. son of Gaurl) became an emperor. Mandhatr, the son of Yuvanasva, was a king who conquered the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: Her son Gaurika (i.e. son of Gaurl) became an emperor. Mandhatr, the son of Yuvanasva, was a king who conquered the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her son Gaurika (i.e. son of Gaurl) became an emperor. Mandhatr, the son of Yuvanasva, was a king who conquered the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञे श्रावस्तको राजा श्रावस्ती येन निर्मिता । श्रावस्तस्य तु दायादो बृहदश्वो महायशाः
verses.transliteration: jajñe śrāvastako rājā śrāvastī yena nirmitā / śrāvastasya tu dāyādo bṛhadaśvo mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: (Defective text) Tcnadrsya (?) (prob. Trasadasyu) was the son of Anaranya**. Harya£va was Trasadasyu's son. King Sumati was born of Drsadvati and Haryasva.)
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) Tcnadrsya (?) (prob. Trasadasyu) was the son of Anaranya**. Harya£va was Trasadasyu's son. King Sumati was born of Drsadvati and Haryasva.)
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) Tcnadrsya (?) (prob. Trasadasyu) was the son of Anaranya**. Harya£va was Trasadasyu's son. King Sumati was born of Drsadvati and Haryasva.)

verses.sanskrit: बृहदश्वसुतश्चापि कुवलाश्व इति श्रुतः । यस्तु धुन्धुवधाद्राजा धुन्धुमारत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: bṛhadaśvasutaścāpi kuvalāśva iti śrutaḥ / yastu dhundhuvadhādrājā dhundhumāratvamāgataḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, he went out of the city at the instance of the lord, the king. Vasistha, the exalted sage, did not prevent him from going.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, he went out of the city at the instance of the lord, the king. Vasistha, the exalted sage, did not prevent him from going.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, he went out of the city at the instance of the lord, the king. Vasistha, the exalted sage, did not prevent him from going.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः धुन्धोर्वधं महाप्राज्ञ घोतुमिच्छाम विस्तरात् । यदर्थं कुवलाश्वस्य धुन्धुमारत्वमागतम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ dhundhorvadhaṃ mahāprājña ghotumicchāma vistarāt / yadarthaṃ kuvalāśvasya dhundhumāratvamāgatam
verses.translation: On account of this sin, Indra did not shower rain in that country for full twelve years.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of this sin, Indra did not shower rain in that country for full twelve years.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of this sin, Indra did not shower rain in that country for full twelve years.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच कुवलाश्वस्य पुत्राणां सहस्राण्येकविंशतिः । सर्वे विद्यासु निष्णाता बलवन्तो दुरासदाः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca kuvalāśvasya putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ / sarve vidyāsu niṣṇātā balavanto durāsadāḥ
verses.translation: Visvamitra, a sage of great penance, left his wife in the territory of that king and performed extensive* penance in the marshy shores ©f the Sea.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvamitra, a sage of great penance, left his wife in the territory of that king and performed extensive* penance in the marshy shores ©f the Sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvamitra, a sage of great penance, left his wife in the territory of that king and performed extensive* penance in the marshy shores ©f the Sea.

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुर्धार्मिकाः सर्वे यज्वानो भूरिदक्षिणाः । कुवलाश्वं महावीर्यं शूरमुत्तमधार्मिकम्
verses.transliteration: babhūvurdhārmikāḥ sarve yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / kuvalāśvaṃ mahāvīryaṃ śūramuttamadhārmikam
verses.translation: His wife tied her own bosom-born middle son with a rope round his neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows. She wanted to sell him in order to sustain and bring up the remaining sons.
verses.wordMeaning: His wife tied her own bosom-born middle son with a rope round his neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows. She wanted to sell him in order to sustain and bring up the remaining sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife tied her own bosom-born middle son with a rope round his neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows. She wanted to sell him in order to sustain and bring up the remaining sons.

verses.sanskrit: बृहदश्वो ह्यभ्यषिञ्चत्तस्मिन्राज्ये नराधिपः । पुत्रसंक्रामितश्रीस्तु वनं राजा विवेश ह
verses.transliteration: bṛhadaśvo hyabhyaṣiñcattasminrājye narādhipaḥ / putrasaṃkrāmitaśrīstu vanaṃ rājā viveśa ha
verses.translation: That boy who had been tied round the neck became a sage of great penance named Galava. That Kausika
verses.wordMeaning: That boy who had been tied round the neck became a sage of great penance named Galava. That Kausika
verses.commentary: Sense: That boy who had been tied round the neck became a sage of great penance named Galava. That Kausika

verses.sanskrit: बृहदश्वं महाराजं शूरमुत्तमधार्मिकम् । प्रयास्यन्तमुतङ्कस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिः प्रत्यवारयत्
verses.transliteration: bṛhadaśvaṃ mahārājaṃ śūramuttamadhārmikam / prayāsyantamutaṅkastu brahmarṣiḥ pratyavārayat
verses.translation: On account of his (?) holy vow, devotion, mercy and solemn declaration, the king who adhered to rules of discipline, sustained Visvamitra's wife also.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his (?) holy vow, devotion, mercy and solemn declaration, the king who adhered to rules of discipline, sustained Visvamitra's wife also.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his (?) holy vow, devotion, mercy and solemn declaration, the king who adhered to rules of discipline, sustained Visvamitra's wife also.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तङ्क उवाच भवता रक्षणं कार्यं तत्तावत्कर्त्तुमर्हति । निरुद्विग्नस्तपस्छर्तुं न हि शक्रो ऽपि पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: uttaṅka uvāca bhavatā rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tattāvatkarttumarhati / nirudvignastapaschartuṃ na hi śakro 'pi pārthiva
verses.translation: He used to kill deer, boars, buffaloes and aquatic beings and bring their meat near the hermitage of Visvamitra.
verses.wordMeaning: He used to kill deer, boars, buffaloes and aquatic beings and bring their meat near the hermitage of Visvamitra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He used to kill deer, boars, buffaloes and aquatic beings and bring their meat near the hermitage of Visvamitra.

verses.sanskrit: ममाश्रमसमीपेषु मेरोर्हि परितस्तु वै । समुद्रो वालुकापूर्णस्तत्र तिष्ठति भूपते
verses.transliteration: mamāśramasamīpeṣu merorhi paritastu vai / samudro vālukāpūrṇastatra tiṣṭhati bhūpate
verses.translation: On account of his childishness as well as due to the force of inevitable future, Satyavrata bore a grudge against Vasistha due to grief.
verses.hindi: हयगरीवजी ने कहा--उत्तम देव ब्रह्मा आदि ने इस रीति से उस ईशानी की स्तुति की बी और उस रति को बहुत ही मलिन और शोक से कशित थी दिखा दिया था ।४३। वह मुख पर आँसु फैलाती हुई बिखरे हुए केशों वाली ओर धूलि से धूसर और विधवा होने के कारण भूषणों को
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his childishness as well as due to the force of inevitable future, Satyavrata bore a grudge against Vasistha due to grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his childishness as well as due to the force of inevitable future, Satyavrata bore a grudge against Vasistha due to grief.

verses.sanskrit: देवतानामवध्यस्तु महाकायो महाबलः । अन्तर्भूमिगतस्तत्र वालुकान्तर्हितो महान्
verses.transliteration: devatānāmavadhyastu mahākāyo mahābalaḥ / antarbhūmigatastatra vālukāntarhito mahān
verses.translation: The conclusion of the wedding Mantras shall be only at the seventh step ( Saptapadi ). Thinking thus Satya- vrata abducted her (?) at the seventh step.
verses.hindi: त्याग देने वाली उस रति ने उस जगदम्ता की सेवा में प्रणाम किया था ।
verses.wordMeaning: The conclusion of the wedding Mantras shall be only at the seventh step ( Saptapadi ). Thinking thus Satya- vrata abducted her (?) at the seventh step.
verses.commentary: Sense: The conclusion of the wedding Mantras shall be only at the seventh step ( Saptapadi ). Thinking thus Satya- vrata abducted her (?) at the seventh step.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसस्य मधोः पुत्रो धुन्धुर्नाम महासुरः । शेते लोकविनाशाय तप आस्थाय दारुणम्
verses.transliteration: rākṣasasya madhoḥ putro dhundhurnāma mahāsuraḥ / śete lokavināśāya tapa āsthāya dāruṇam
verses.translation: "Despite being conversant with Dharmas, Vasistha wishes for fresh chanting of the Mantras", — saying thus Satyavrata became angry with Vasistha, in his mind.
verses.hindi: कर जगदम्बा के हृदय में करुणा उत्पन्न हो गयी थी और उस परमेश्वरी के कटाक्ष से मुस्कराते हुए मुख वाला कामदेव समुत्पन्न हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: "Despite being conversant with Dharmas, Vasistha wishes for fresh chanting of the Mantras", — saying thus Satyavrata became angry with Vasistha, in his mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Despite being conversant with Dharmas, Vasistha wishes for fresh chanting of the Mantras", — saying thus Satyavrata became angry with Vasistha, in his mind.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरस्य पर्यन्ते स निश्वासं विमुञ्चति । यदा तदा मही तत्र चलति स्म सकानना
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarasya paryante sa niśvāsaṃ vimuñcati / yadā tadā mahī tatra calati sma sakānanā
verses.translation: The Saintly lord Vasistha performed penance for their welfare. But Satyavratra did not understand his secret vow.
verses.hindi: उसके देह की कान्ति पवे के देह से भी अधिक थी ओर वह मद से मेदुर हो गया था। उसको दो बाहू थौं--बह समस्त भूषणों से सम्पन्न था ओर पुष्पों के बाणों बाल़ा तथा कुसुमों के धनुष वाला था ।४६। पूर्वजन्म की प्रिया
verses.wordMeaning: The Saintly lord Vasistha performed penance for their welfare. But Satyavratra did not understand his secret vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saintly lord Vasistha performed penance for their welfare. But Satyavratra did not understand his secret vow.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य निश्वासवातेन रज उद्धूयते महत् । आदित्यपथमावृत्य सप्ताहं भूमिकंपनम्
verses.transliteration: tasya niśvāsavātena raja uddhūyate mahat / ādityapathamāvṛtya saptāhaṃ bhūmikaṃpanam
verses.translation: His wife named Satyavrata, born of the family of Kaikeyas, gave birth to Hari£candra, a sinless son.
verses.hindi: रति को कटाक्ष के द्वारा आनन्दित कर रहा था।वह रति भी महान आनन्द के सागर में मग्न होकर अपने स्वामी को देखती हुई आनन्द को. प्राप्त हुई थो ।४७। महाराज्ञी उत दोनों रति और कामदेव को भक्ति से निर्भर मानस वाले तथा परम प्रसन्न अन्तरात्मा वाले देखकर मन्दस्मित
verses.wordMeaning: His wife named Satyavrata, born of the family of Kaikeyas, gave birth to Hari£candra, a sinless son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife named Satyavrata, born of the family of Kaikeyas, gave birth to Hari£candra, a sinless son.

verses.sanskrit: सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वारं सधूममतिदारुणम् । तेन राजन्न शक्नोमि तस्मिन्स्थातुं स्व आश्रमे
verses.transliteration: savisphuliṅgaṃ sajvāraṃ sadhūmamatidāruṇam / tena rājanna śaknomi tasminsthātuṃ sva āśrame
verses.translation: Vinaya and Sudeva were the two sons of Caficu. Sudeva was the conqueror of all K$atriyas. Hence, he is remembered as Vijaya.
verses.hindi: मुखकमल वाली हुई थी ओर लज्जा से नम्रमुखो उस रति को देखकर श्यामला से यह बोली थी ।४८ है श्यामले ! इसको स्नान कराकर वस्त्रों और कांची आदि भूषणों से भूषित करके पूर्व को ही भाँति शीघ्र यहाँ लाओ
verses.wordMeaning: Vinaya and Sudeva were the two sons of Caficu. Sudeva was the conqueror of all K$atriyas. Hence, he is remembered as Vijaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinaya and Sudeva were the two sons of Caficu. Sudeva was the conqueror of all K$atriyas. Hence, he is remembered as Vijaya.

verses.sanskrit: तं वारय महाबाहो लोकानां हितकाम्यया । तेजस्ते सुमहद्विष्मुस्तेजसाप्याययिष्यति
verses.transliteration: taṃ vāraya mahābāho lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā / tejaste sumahadviṣmustejasāpyāyayiṣyati
verses.translation: Since that king indulged in vice, he was dethroned by the Haihayas, Talajanghas, Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas, Paradas and Pahlavas.
verses.hindi: तदाज्ञां शिरसा धूत्वा श्यामा सवं तथाकरोत् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since that king indulged in vice, he was dethroned by the Haihayas, Talajanghas, Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas, Paradas and Pahlavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since that king indulged in vice, he was dethroned by the Haihayas, Talajanghas, Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas, Paradas and Pahlavas.

verses.sanskrit: लोकाः स्वस्था भवन्त्वद्य तस्मिन्विनिहते सुरे । त्वं हि तस्य वधार्थाय समर्थः पृथिवीपते
verses.transliteration: lokāḥ svasthā bhavantvadya tasminvinihate sure / tvaṃ hi tasya vadhārthāya samarthaḥ pṛthivīpate
verses.translation: It has already been mentioned that the kingdom
verses.wordMeaning: It has already been mentioned that the kingdom
verses.commentary: Sense: It has already been mentioned that the kingdom

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना च वरो दत्तो मम पूर्व यतो ऽनघ । न हि धुन्धुर्महावीर्यस्तेजसाल्पेन शाक्यते
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunā ca varo datto mama pūrva yato 'nagha / na hi dhundhurmahāvīryastejasālpena śākyate
verses.translation: The Yavanas, Paradas, Kambojas. Pahlavas(and Sakas), these five clans (of kings) attacked for and on behalf of the Haihayas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Yavanas, Paradas, Kambojas. Pahlavas(and Sakas), these five clans (of kings) attacked for and on behalf of the Haihayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yavanas, Paradas, Kambojas. Pahlavas(and Sakas), these five clans (of kings) attacked for and on behalf of the Haihayas.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दग्धुं पृथिवीपालैरपि वर्षशतैरपि । वीर्यं हि सुमहत्तस्य देवैरपि दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: nirdagdhuṃ pṛthivīpālairapi varṣaśatairapi / vīryaṃ hi sumahattasya devairapi durāsadam
verses.translation: When he had been deprived of his kingdom, Bahu renounced his abode and entered the forest. Accompanied by his wife, the noblc-souled king performed a penance.
verses.wordMeaning: When he had been deprived of his kingdom, Bahu renounced his abode and entered the forest. Accompanied by his wife, the noblc-souled king performed a penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he had been deprived of his kingdom, Bahu renounced his abode and entered the forest. Accompanied by his wife, the noblc-souled king performed a penance.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु राजर्षिरुत्तङ्केन महात्मना । कुवलाश्वं तु तं प्रादात्तस्मिन् धुन्धुनिवारणे
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu rājarṣiruttaṅkena mahātmanā / kuvalāśvaṃ tu taṃ prādāttasmin dhundhunivāraṇe
verses.translation: Once that king, though disabled, went to fetch water. On account of old age and weakness, he passed away in the middle.
verses.wordMeaning: Once that king, though disabled, went to fetch water. On account of old age and weakness, he passed away in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once that king, though disabled, went to fetch water. On account of old age and weakness, he passed away in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्न्यस्तशस्भो ऽहमयं तु तनयो मम । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ धुन्धुमारो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhagavannyastaśasbho 'hamayaṃ tu tanayo mama / bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha dhundhumāro na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: His wife, a member of the family of Yadu, was pregnant and she had gone after him. Poison had been adminis- tered to her by her co-wife with a desire to kill the child in the womb.
verses.wordMeaning: His wife, a member of the family of Yadu, was pregnant and she had gone after him. Poison had been adminis- tered to her by her co-wife with a desire to kill the child in the womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife, a member of the family of Yadu, was pregnant and she had gone after him. Poison had been adminis- tered to her by her co-wife with a desire to kill the child in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: स तमादिश्य तनयं धुन्धुमाग्णमच्युतम् । जगाम स वनायैव तपसे शंसितव्रतः
verses.transliteration: sa tamādiśya tanayaṃ dhundhumāgṇamacyutam / jagāma sa vanāyaiva tapase śaṃsitavrataḥ
verses.translation: She lit the funeral pyre of her husband and got on to it. On seeing her, Aurva, the grand-son of Bhrgu, made her desist from it out of mercy.
verses.wordMeaning: She lit the funeral pyre of her husband and got on to it. On seeing her, Aurva, the grand-son of Bhrgu, made her desist from it out of mercy.
verses.commentary: Sense: She lit the funeral pyre of her husband and got on to it. On seeing her, Aurva, the grand-son of Bhrgu, made her desist from it out of mercy.

verses.sanskrit: कुवलाश्वस्तु धर्मात्मा पितुर्वचनमाश्रितः । सहक्रैरेकविंशत्या पुत्राणां सह पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: kuvalāśvastu dharmātmā piturvacanamāśritaḥ / sahakrairekaviṃśatyā putrāṇāṃ saha pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: She gave birth to the child developed in her womb along with the poison. She gave birth to a righteous son named Sagara who became very powerful.
verses.hindi: उस महाराज्ञी को आज्ञा को शिर पर धारण करके उस श्यामला ने साब कुछ वैसा ही कर दिया या । वसिष्ठ आदि ब्रह्मियों के द्वारा वैवाहिक विधान किया गया था ।५०। उन दुस्‍्पतियों का पाणिग्रहण का मङ्गल किया गया जो सभी अध्सराओं के द्वारा नृत्य ओर गोत आदि से समन्वित था।
verses.wordMeaning: She gave birth to the child developed in her womb along with the poison. She gave birth to a righteous son named Sagara who became very powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: She gave birth to the child developed in her womb along with the poison. She gave birth to a righteous son named Sagara who became very powerful.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायादुत्तङ्कसहितो धुन्धोस्तस्य निवारणे । तमाविशत्ततो विष्णुर्भगवान्स्वेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: prāyāduttaṅkasahito dhundhostasya nivāraṇe / tamāviśattato viṣṇurbhagavānsvena tejasā
verses.translation: Aurva performed Jalakarman and other post-natal holy rites of the noble-soulcd prince. He taught him Vedas and Sacred scriptures. Thereafter, he taught him how to dis- charge missiles and miraculous weapons.
verses.hindi: ।५१। यह सब कुछ देखकर महेन्द्र आदि देवगण तथा तपोधन ऋषियों ने
verses.wordMeaning: Aurva performed Jalakarman and other post-natal holy rites of the noble-soulcd prince. He taught him Vedas and Sacred scriptures. Thereafter, he taught him how to dis- charge missiles and miraculous weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aurva performed Jalakarman and other post-natal holy rites of the noble-soulcd prince. He taught him Vedas and Sacred scriptures. Thereafter, he taught him how to dis- charge missiles and miraculous weapons.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तङ्कस्य नियोगात्तु लोकानां हितकाम्यया । तस्मिन्प्रयाते दुर्धर्षे दिवि शब्दो महानभूत्
verses.transliteration: uttaṅkasya niyogāttu lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā / tasminprayāte durdharṣe divi śabdo mahānabhūt
verses.translation: On being hit, hurt and killed by the noble-souled, heroic Sagara, all of them sought refuge in Vasistha, desirous of shelter.
verses.wordMeaning: On being hit, hurt and killed by the noble-souled, heroic Sagara, all of them sought refuge in Vasistha, desirous of shelter.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being hit, hurt and killed by the noble-souled, heroic Sagara, all of them sought refuge in Vasistha, desirous of shelter.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य प्रभृत्येष नृपो धुन्धुमारो भविष्यति । दिव्यैः पुष्पैश्च तं देवाः संमतात्समवाकिरन्
verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛtyeṣa nṛpo dhundhumāro bhaviṣyati / divyaiḥ puṣpaiśca taṃ devāḥ saṃmatātsamavākiran
verses.translation: On seeing them filled with humility, the great sage granted them freedom from fear and restrained Sagara.
verses.hindi: अच्छा हुआ-अच्छा हुआ --यह कहकर लखिताम्बा को स्तुति की थी
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them filled with humility, the great sage granted them freedom from fear and restrained Sagara.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them filled with humility, the great sage granted them freedom from fear and restrained Sagara.

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयश्चैव प्रणेदुर्हि तदा भृशम् । स गत्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तनयैः सह वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayaścaiva praṇedurhi tadā bhṛśam / sa gatvā puruṣavyāghrastanayaiḥ saha vīryavān
verses.translation: Remembering his own vow and on hearing the prescriptive words of i his preceptor, Sagara struck off their customary observances of caste and other characteristics, and made them change their guise and garments.
verses.hindi: सबसे-परम सन्तृष्ट होते हुए नमो मडल से पुष्पों की वर्षा थी । बे दोनों भी बहुत परसम्न हुए थे और उन्होंने महा भक्ति से ललितेश्वरी को प्रणाम किया था ।१३। बे दोनों-ललितेश्वरी के समोप में समागत होकर दोनों हाथों को जोड़कर समीप में स्थित हो गये थे ? इसके अनन्तर कामदेव भी महे-
verses.wordMeaning: Remembering his own vow and on hearing the prescriptive words of i his preceptor, Sagara struck off their customary observances of caste and other characteristics, and made them change their guise and garments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Remembering his own vow and on hearing the prescriptive words of i his preceptor, Sagara struck off their customary observances of caste and other characteristics, and made them change their guise and garments.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रं खानयामास वालुकापूर्णमव्ययम् । तस्य पुत्रैः खनद्भिश्च वालुकान्तर्हितस्तदा
verses.transliteration: samudraṃ khānayāmāsa vālukāpūrṇamavyayam / tasya putraiḥ khanadbhiśca vālukāntarhitastadā
verses.translation: After conquering the whole of the Earth by means of righteous victory, the king took initiation for the horse sacrifice and made the sacrificial horse go round the world.
verses.hindi: शवरी को प्रणाम करके भक्ति भाव से परिपूर्ण मन बाला होकर इस वाक्य को बोला था ।५४ हें ललिताम्विके ! शम्भु के नेत्र से जो मेरा शरीर दग्ध हो गया था बह आपके कूपा कटाक्ष ये पुनः प्राप्त हो गया है।५५। मैं आपका ही पुत्र हूँ । किसी भो सेवा में मुझे नियुक्त कीजिए । इस प्रकार से
verses.wordMeaning: After conquering the whole of the Earth by means of righteous victory, the king took initiation for the horse sacrifice and made the sacrificial horse go round the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: After conquering the whole of the Earth by means of righteous victory, the king took initiation for the horse sacrifice and made the sacrificial horse go round the world.

verses.sanskrit: धुन्धुरासादितस्तत्र दिशमाश्रित्य पश्चिमाम् । मुखजेनाग्निना क्रुद्धो लोकानुद्वर्तयन्निव
verses.transliteration: dhundhurāsāditastatra diśamāśritya paścimām / mukhajenāgninā kruddho lokānudvartayanniva
verses.translation: After coming within the path of his vision and being alflicted by its fiery splendour, all those princes were burned; only four sons survived.
verses.hindi: जब परमेशानी से कहा गया था ठो उम देवो ने कामदेव से कहा या
verses.wordMeaning: After coming within the path of his vision and being alflicted by its fiery splendour, all those princes were burned; only four sons survived.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming within the path of his vision and being alflicted by its fiery splendour, all those princes were burned; only four sons survived.

verses.sanskrit: वारि सुस्राव चोगेन महोदधिरिवोदये । सोमस्य सो ऽसुरश्रेष्ठो धारोर्मिकलिलो महान्
verses.transliteration: vāri susrāva cogena mahodadhirivodaye / somasya so 'suraśreṣṭho dhārormikalilo mahān
verses.translation: They were Barhiketu, Suketu, Dharmaratha and the heroic Paficajana. They perpetuated the line of the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: They were Barhiketu, Suketu, Dharmaratha and the heroic Paficajana. They perpetuated the line of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Barhiketu, Suketu, Dharmaratha and the heroic Paficajana. They perpetuated the line of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रास्तु निर्दग्धास्त्रय उर्वरिता मृधे । ततः स राजातिबलो राक्षसं तं महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: tasya putrāstu nirdagdhāstraya urvaritā mṛdhe / tataḥ sa rājātibalo rākṣasaṃ taṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: V V. 138- 139 describe the ways of hair-dressing etc. of these tribes.
verses.wordMeaning: V V. 138- 139 describe the ways of hair-dressing etc. of these tribes.
verses.commentary: Sense: V V. 138- 139 describe the ways of hair-dressing etc. of these tribes.

verses.sanskrit: आससाद महातेजा धुन्धुं बन्धुनिबर्हणम् । तस्य वारिमयं वेगमपि वत्स नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: āsasāda mahātejā dhundhuṃ bandhunibarhaṇam / tasya vārimayaṃ vegamapi vatsa narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: Tell us by what procedure were the numerous, highly mighty and valorous sons of Sagar.i, sixty thousand in number were born.
verses.wordMeaning: Tell us by what procedure were the numerous, highly mighty and valorous sons of Sagar.i, sixty thousand in number were born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tell us by what procedure were the numerous, highly mighty and valorous sons of Sagar.i, sixty thousand in number were born.

verses.sanskrit: योगी योगेन वह्निं च शमयामास वारिणा । निरस्यन्तं महाकायं बलेनोदकराक्षसम्
verses.transliteration: yogī yogena vahniṃ ca śamayāmāsa vāriṇā / nirasyantaṃ mahākāyaṃ balenodakarākṣasam
verses.translation: Sagara had two wives who had dispelled their sins by means of their penance. The elder of the two was the daughter of Vidarbha named Kesinl.
verses.hindi: त्वल्निदां ये करिष्यन्ति त्वयि वा विमुखाशयाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sagara had two wives who had dispelled their sins by means of their penance. The elder of the two was the daughter of Vidarbha named Kesinl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sagara had two wives who had dispelled their sins by means of their penance. The elder of the two was the daughter of Vidarbha named Kesinl.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तङ्कं दर्शयामास कृतकर्मा नराधिपः । उत्तङ्कश्च वरं प्रादात्तस्मै राज्ञे महात्मने
verses.transliteration: uttaṅkaṃ darśayāmāsa kṛtakarmā narādhipaḥ / uttaṅkaśca varaṃ prādāttasmai rājñe mahātmane
verses.translation: The sixty thousand sons emerged from the gourd- like lump of foetus. He then placed them (the pieces of the foetus) in the pot filled with ghee.
verses.wordMeaning: The sixty thousand sons emerged from the gourd- like lump of foetus. He then placed them (the pieces of the foetus) in the pot filled with ghee.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sixty thousand sons emerged from the gourd- like lump of foetus. He then placed them (the pieces of the foetus) in the pot filled with ghee.

verses.sanskrit: ददतश्चाक्षयं वित्तं शत्रुभिश्चाप्य धुष्यताम् । धर्मे रतिं च सततं स्वर्गे वासं तथाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: dadataścākṣayaṃ vittaṃ śatrubhiścāpya dhuṣyatām / dharme ratiṃ ca satataṃ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣayam
verses.translation: For the perpetuation of the line of Iksvaku, Vasi- stha of great brilliance, begot Asmaka of the wife of Kalma- sapada.
verses.hindi: श्री देवी ने कहा-हे वत्स ! आओ, है मनोजजन्मन् आपको. अव कुछ भी कहीं पर भय नहीं है है अव्याहत वाशों बाले ! मेरे प्रसाद से आप सम्पूर्ण जगत को मोहित करो ।७ तुम्हारे बाणों के पातन से धैय के विष्लक होने से शम्भु पर्वत हितवान् की सुता पावंठी को शीघ्र ही व्याह लेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: For the perpetuation of the line of Iksvaku, Vasi- stha of great brilliance, begot Asmaka of the wife of Kalma- sapada.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the perpetuation of the line of Iksvaku, Vasi- stha of great brilliance, begot Asmaka of the wife of Kalma- sapada.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्राणां चाक्षयांल्लोकान्स्वर्गे ये रक्षसा हताः । तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयः शिष्टा दृढाश्वो ज्येष्ठ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: putrāṇāṃ cākṣayāṃllokānsvarge ye rakṣasā hatāḥ / tasya putrāstrayaḥ śiṣṭā dṛḍhāśvo jyeṣṭha ucyate
verses.translation: Rama, Bharata, Satrughna and Laksmana of great strength were the sons of Dasaratha. Rama was heroic, con- versant with Dharma and well-known in the worlds.
verses.hindi: मेरे प्रसाद से तुमसे समुत्पन्न सहस्नों करोड़ कामदेव सबके ?हो में प्रवेश करके उत्तम रति को देंगे ॥५६। मेरे प्रसाद से क्र भो भगवान सम्भु जिनको कि वैराग्य हो गया हे,तुम्हारे देह को द्ध करने में समय नहीं होंगे ।६०। भव को मोहित करने बाला कामदेब सब प्राणियों में अहृश्य
verses.wordMeaning: Rama, Bharata, Satrughna and Laksmana of great strength were the sons of Dasaratha. Rama was heroic, con- versant with Dharma and well-known in the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, Bharata, Satrughna and Laksmana of great strength were the sons of Dasaratha. Rama was heroic, con- versant with Dharma and well-known in the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: भद्राश्वः कपिलाश्वश्च कनीयांसौ तु तौ स्मृतौ । धैन्धुमारिर्दृढाश्वश्च हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: bhadrāśvaḥ kapilāśvaśca kanīyāṃsau tu tau smṛtau / dhaindhumārirdṛḍhāśvaśca haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Satrughna went to Madhuvana and killed Lavana, son of Madhu. There the city of Mathura was founded by Satrughna.
verses.hindi: मृत्ति वाला होकर रहेगा । अपनो भार्या के बिरह को आशंका वाला देह के आधे भाग को दे देता । तुम्हारे बाण से आहत मानस वाले यह कातरात्मा होकर प्रयाण कर गये हैं ।६१॥ आज से लेकर है कन्दर्प ! महान् मेरे प्रसाद से जो तेरी निन्दा करेंगे अथवा तुझसे विमुख विचार वाले होंगे उनको
verses.wordMeaning: Satrughna went to Madhuvana and killed Lavana, son of Madhu. There the city of Mathura was founded by Satrughna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satrughna went to Madhuvana and killed Lavana, son of Madhu. There the city of Mathura was founded by Satrughna.

verses.sanskrit: हर्यश्वस्य निकुंभो ऽभूत्क्षात्रधर्मरतः सदा । संहताश्वो निकुंभस्य सुतो रणविशारदः
verses.transliteration: haryaśvasya nikuṃbho 'bhūtkṣātradharmarataḥ sadā / saṃhatāśvo nikuṃbhasya suto raṇaviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Subahu and Surasena were the sons of Satrughna. They were born of the princess of Vidcha. They ruled over the city of Mathura.
verses.hindi: अवश्य ही नपु सकता जम्म-जन्मों में हो जायगी ।६२। जो पापिष्ठ हैं और मेरे भक्तों के द्रोही हैं उनको अगम्या अर्थात् न गमन करने के योग्य नारियों में गिराकर विनाश करदो
verses.wordMeaning: Subahu and Surasena were the sons of Satrughna. They were born of the princess of Vidcha. They ruled over the city of Mathura.
verses.commentary: Sense: Subahu and Surasena were the sons of Satrughna. They were born of the princess of Vidcha. They ruled over the city of Mathura.

verses.sanskrit: कृशाश्वश्चाकृताश्वश्च संहताश्वसुतावुभौ । तस्य पत्नी हैमवती सती माता दृषद्वती
verses.transliteration: kṛśāśvaścākṛtāśvaśca saṃhatāśvasutāvubhau / tasya patnī haimavatī satī mātā dṛṣadvatī
verses.translation: Angada and Candraketu were the two sons of Laksmana. Their territories at the border of the Himalaya mountain were very prosperous and flourishing.
verses.wordMeaning: Angada and Candraketu were the two sons of Laksmana. Their territories at the border of the Himalaya mountain were very prosperous and flourishing.
verses.commentary: Sense: Angada and Candraketu were the two sons of Laksmana. Their territories at the border of the Himalaya mountain were very prosperous and flourishing.

verses.sanskrit: विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु पुत्रश्चास्य प्रसेनजित् । युवनाश्वसुतस्तस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu putraścāsya prasenajit / yuvanāśvasutastasya triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: In the territory of Karapatha (?) the city of An- gada was called Angada. Candracakra, the splendid city of Candraketu is well known.
verses.wordMeaning: In the territory of Karapatha (?) the city of An- gada was called Angada. Candracakra, the splendid city of Candraketu is well known.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the territory of Karapatha (?) the city of An- gada was called Angada. Candracakra, the splendid city of Candraketu is well known.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तधार्मिका गौरी तस्य पत्नी पतिव्रता । अभिशस्ता तु सा भर्त्रा नदी सा बाहुदा कृता
verses.transliteration: atyantadhārmikā gaurī tasya patnī pativratā / abhiśastā tu sā bhartrā nadī sā bāhudā kṛtā
verses.translation: The heroic Taksa and Puskara were the sons of Bharata. The cities of those two noble souls were situated in the realm of the Gandharvas.
verses.wordMeaning: The heroic Taksa and Puskara were the sons of Bharata. The cities of those two noble souls were situated in the realm of the Gandharvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Taksa and Puskara were the sons of Bharata. The cities of those two noble souls were situated in the realm of the Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तु गौरिकः पुत्रश्चक्रवर्ती बभूव ह । मान्धाता यौवनाश्वो वै त्रैलोक्यविजयी नृपः
verses.transliteration: tasyāstu gaurikaḥ putraścakravartī babhūva ha / māndhātā yauvanāśvo vai trailokyavijayī nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Those people who are conversant with the Puraias sing this Gatha (lyrical verse). It concerns Rama. It consists of facts due to the greatness of that intelligent one.
verses.hindi: बसंतेन च मित्रं ण सेनान्या शीतरोचिया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Those people who are conversant with the Puraias sing this Gatha (lyrical verse). It concerns Rama. It consists of facts due to the greatness of that intelligent one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those people who are conversant with the Puraias sing this Gatha (lyrical verse). It concerns Rama. It consists of facts due to the greatness of that intelligent one.

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमं श्लोकं पौराणिका द्विजाः । यावत्सूर्य उदयते यावच्च प्रतितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: atrāpyudāharantīmaṃ ślokaṃ paurāṇikā dvijāḥ / yāvatsūrya udayate yāvacca pratitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Earlier, proceeding in search of Sita's whereabouts, Rama the bull among men (the powerful leader), the king of great fame slew (Ravana) the descendant of Pulastya, the demon who had committed sins.
verses.wordMeaning: Earlier, proceeding in search of Sita's whereabouts, Rama the bull among men (the powerful leader), the king of great fame slew (Ravana) the descendant of Pulastya, the demon who had committed sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Earlier, proceeding in search of Sita's whereabouts, Rama the bull among men (the powerful leader), the king of great fame slew (Ravana) the descendant of Pulastya, the demon who had committed sins.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तद्यौवनाश्वस्य मान्धातुः क्षेत्रमुच्यते । तस्य चैत्ररथी भार्या शशबिन्दोः सुताभवत्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ tadyauvanāśvasya māndhātuḥ kṣetramucyate / tasya caitrarathī bhāryā śaśabindoḥ sutābhavat
verses.translation: He had Sattva (purest) qualities (or he had great inherent strength). He was richly endowed with good qualities. He shone with his own brilliance. Thus Rama, the son of Dasaratha, shone surpassing the sun and fire.
verses.wordMeaning: He had Sattva (purest) qualities (or he had great inherent strength). He was richly endowed with good qualities. He shone with his own brilliance. Thus Rama, the son of Dasaratha, shone surpassing the sun and fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had Sattva (purest) qualities (or he had great inherent strength). He was richly endowed with good qualities. He shone with his own brilliance. Thus Rama, the son of Dasaratha, shone surpassing the sun and fire.

verses.sanskrit: साध्वी बिन्दुमती नाम रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि । पतिव्रता च ज्येष्ठा च भातॄणामयुतस्य सा
verses.transliteration: sādhvī bindumatī nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi / pativratā ca jyeṣṭhā ca bhātṝṇāmayutasya sā
verses.translation: The two sons of that powerful king were like him. They are well known as Kusa and Lava. Understand their territories.
verses.hindi: जिनके हृदय मेरी पूजा में ओर मेरे भक्तों में आदर करने वाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The two sons of that powerful king were like him. They are well known as Kusa and Lava. Understand their territories.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two sons of that powerful king were like him. They are well known as Kusa and Lava. Understand their territories.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामुत्पादयामास मान्धाता त्रीन्सुतन्प्रभुः । पुरुकुत्समंबरीषं मुचुकुन्दं च विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāmutpādayāmāsa māndhātā trīnsutanprabhuḥ / purukutsamaṃbarīṣaṃ mucukundaṃ ca viśrutam
verses.translation: De identifies it with Ujjain but our text locates it on the ridges, of the Vindhya mountain.
verses.hindi: उनको समस्त कार्य का सुख दो ओर उनका अभीष्ट पूर्ण कर दो ।६४। काम- देव ने इस श्री ललितादेवी के आज्ञा वचन को शिर से ग्रहण करके फिर हाथों को जोड़े हुए वह कामदेव वहाँ से निकल कर चला गया या
verses.wordMeaning: De identifies it with Ujjain but our text locates it on the ridges, of the Vindhya mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: De identifies it with Ujjain but our text locates it on the ridges, of the Vindhya mountain.

verses.sanskrit: अंबरीषस्य दायादो युवनाश्वो ऽपरः स्मृतः । नर्मदायां समुत्पन्नः संभूतस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: aṃbarīṣasya dāyādo yuvanāśvo 'paraḥ smṛtaḥ / narmadāyāṃ samutpannaḥ saṃbhūtastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Atithi, the virtuous-soulcd son of Kusa was fond of entertaining guests. The famous king named Ni$adha was the son of Atithi.
verses.hindi: उस कामदेव के समस्त रोमों के छिद्टों से उठे हुए बहुत से परम शोभन आकार वाले कामदेव सम्पूर्ण विश्व को मोहन करने वाले वे ।६६। कामदेव ने उन बहुत से अनङ्कों के द्वारा इस सम्पूर्ण जगत के मंडल को मोहित कर दिया था और फिर भगवान् घम्भु पर बिजय पाने की इच्छा से स्याणु के
verses.wordMeaning: Atithi, the virtuous-soulcd son of Kusa was fond of entertaining guests. The famous king named Ni$adha was the son of Atithi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Atithi, the virtuous-soulcd son of Kusa was fond of entertaining guests. The famous king named Ni$adha was the son of Atithi.

verses.sanskrit: संभूतस्यात्मजः पुत्रो ङ्यनरण्यः प्रतापवान् । रावणेन हतो येन त्रैलोक्यं विजितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: saṃbhūtasyātmajaḥ putro ṅyanaraṇyaḥ pratāpavān / rāvaṇena hato yena trailokyaṃ vijitaṃ purā
verses.translation: He learned five hundred Samhitas fiom Pausyanji. Yoga was learnt from him by the intelligent Yajfiavalkya.
verses.hindi: आश्रय में प्राप्त हो गया था ।६७। अपने मित्र वसम्त के साथ तथा सेनानी शीतांशु केईमहित पीठमर्द राग से संयुत एवं अन्द बायु के सहित और पु स्को- किल के निकले हुए शब्द की कांकलियों से समंवित-श्रृज्ञार बोर सम्पन्न रति से आलिज़ित वपु वाला कामदेव जयशील धनुष को हिलाता हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: He learned five hundred Samhitas fiom Pausyanji. Yoga was learnt from him by the intelligent Yajfiavalkya.
verses.commentary: Sense: He learned five hundred Samhitas fiom Pausyanji. Yoga was learnt from him by the intelligent Yajfiavalkya.

verses.sanskrit: तेन दृश्योनरण्यस्य हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः । हर्यश्वात्तु दृषद्वत्यां जज्ञे च सुमतिर्नृपः
verses.transliteration: tena dṛśyonaraṇyasya haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ / haryaśvāttu dṛṣadvatyāṃ jajñe ca sumatirnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: अबीरों का अग्रगामी होकर मदन के अरि शिव के समक्ष में पहुँचकर निडर होकर समास्थित हो गया था
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद्राजा त्रिधन्वा नाम धार्मिकः । आसीत्त्रिधन्वनश्चापि विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुणिः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tasya putro 'bhavadrājā tridhanvā nāma dhārmikaḥ / āsīttridhanvanaścāpi vidvāṃstrayyāruṇiḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारो ऽभून्महाबलः । तेन भार्या विदर्भस्य त्दृता हत्वा दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: tasya satyavrato nāma kumāro 'bhūnmahābalaḥ / tena bhāryā vidarbhasya tdṛtā hatvā divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्रेषु निष्टानं प्रापितेष्विह । कामाद्बलाच्च मोहाच्च संहर्षेण बलेन च
verses.transliteration: pāṇigrahaṇamantreṣu niṣṭānaṃ prāpiteṣviha / kāmādbalācca mohācca saṃharṣeṇa balena ca
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: भाविनोर्ऽथस्य च बलात्तत्कृतं तेन धीमता । तमधर्मेण संयुक्तं पिता भय्यारुणो ऽत्यजत्
verses.transliteration: bhāvinor'thasya ca balāttatkṛtaṃ tena dhīmatā / tamadharmeṇa saṃyuktaṃ pitā bhayyāruṇo 'tyajat
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: तपश्चर्या में स्थित भगवान् चनदचूड़ को सायकों से तडिति करने लगा था । इसके पश्चात् काम के बाणों से शम्भु ताडित हुए ये और उन्होने वैराग्य को दूर कर दिया था तथा दुष्कर तप को त्याग दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अपध्वंसेति बहुशो वदन्क्रोधसमन्वितः । पितरं सो ऽब्रवीदेकः क्व गच्छामीति वै मुहुः
verses.transliteration: apadhvaṃseti bahuśo vadankrodhasamanvitaḥ / pitaraṃ so 'bravīdekaḥ kva gacchāmīti vai muhuḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: समस्त नियमों को छोड़कर शम्भु धेये त्याग देने वाले कर दिये गये थे । अब तो उसी पावेतो का ध्यान करके बारम्बार काम से आतुर हो गये थे । ।७२। शिव नि:श्वास ले रहे ये और उनका गंड मंडल पाण्डुर हो गया था। अश्रु निकल रहे थे तथा धेय के विष्लव होने से विरही बहुत ही संताप
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पिता चैनमथोवाच श्वपाकैः सह वर्त्तय । नाहं पुत्रेण पुत्रार्थी त्वयाद्य कुलपांसन
verses.transliteration: pitā cainamathovāca śvapākaiḥ saha varttaya / nāhaṃ putreṇa putrārthī tvayādya kulapāṃsana
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: युक्त हो गये थे । बारम्बार पूवं में देखी हुई गिरि की सुता का अनुस्मरण करने लगे ये ।७३। कामदेव के बाणों को अग्नि से संतप्त होते हुए शिव के दाह को दूर करने में न तो चन्द्रेश्वा और न गंगा समर्थ हुए थे ।७४। नन्दी- भूज़ी--और महाकाल आदि प्रमुखो केद्वारा लाई हुई पुष्पों की शय्या में
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स निराक्रामन्नगराद्वचना द्विभोः । न चैनं वारयामास वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ sa nirākrāmannagarādvacanā dvibhoḥ / na cainaṃ vārayāmāsa vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: शिव बार-बार लोट लगा रहे ये ।७५। नग्दो के हाथ का सहारा ग्रहण करके फिर दूसरी पुष्पों को शय्या पर भो पहुँचे ये । दूसरी पुष्पों की शय्या पर पहुँचकर भी बार-बार विशेष चेष्टा शान्ति पाने के लिए की थो ।७६। किन्तु उनके देह का काम उवरोत्न्न सन्ताप पुष्पों की शय्या से--चन्द्रकला से
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: स तु सत्यव्रतो धीमाञ्श्वपाकावसथान्तिके । पित्रा त्यक्तो ऽवसद्धीरः पिता चास्य वनं ययौ
verses.transliteration: sa tu satyavrato dhīmāñśvapākāvasathāntike / pitrā tyakto 'vasaddhīraḥ pitā cāsya vanaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: निर्गत अभृत से और हिमानो के जल से भो शान्त नहीं हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
