verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तु विषये तस्य नावर्षत्पाकशासनः । समा द्वादश संपूर्मास्तेनाधर्मेण वै तदा
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstu viṣaye tasya nāvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ / samā dvādaśa saṃpūrmāstenādharmeṇa vai tadā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: दारांस्तु तस्य विषये विश्वामित्रो महातपाः । संन्यस्य सागरानूपे चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: dārāṃstu tasya viṣaye viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ / saṃnyasya sāgarānūpe cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्नी गले बद्ध्वा मध्यमंपुत्रमौरसम् । शिष्टानां भरणार्थाय व्यक्रीणाद्गोशतेन वै
verses.transliteration: tasya patnī gale baddhvā madhyamaṃputramaurasam / śiṣṭānāṃ bharaṇārthāya vyakrīṇādgośatena vai
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तं तु बद्धं गले दृष्टवा विक्रयार्थं नरोत्तमः । महर्षिपुत्रं धर्मात्मा मोक्षयामास सुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: taṃ tu baddhaṃ gale dṛṣṭavā vikrayārthaṃ narottamaḥ / maharṣiputraṃ dharmātmā mokṣayāmāsa suvrataḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यव्रतो महाबुद्धिर्भरणं तस्य चाकरोत् । विश्वामित्रस्य तुष्ट्यर्थमनुकंपार्थमेव च
verses.transliteration: satyavrato mahābuddhirbharaṇaṃ tasya cākarot / viśvāmitrasya tuṣṭyarthamanukaṃpārthameva ca
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: ते अपने शरोर की बढ़ो हुई ज्वाला को बार-बार शम भी कर रहे थे और शिला के रू में जो हिम का जल के पट्ट ये उन पर भी शिव जाकर बे थे। यहां पर फिर वे शेल सुता के बित कों तखों ते लिखने लग गये ये ।७८। उक्ष चित्र के आलोकन से बहुत ही कामाति बढ़ गयो थी । उसका
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽभवद्गालवो नाम गले बद्धो महातपाः । महर्षिः कौशिकस्तात तेन वीरेण मोक्षितः
verses.transliteration: so 'bhavadgālavo nāma gale baddho mahātapāḥ / maharṣiḥ kauśikastāta tena vīreṇa mokṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: आलेखन ऐसा किया था जो लज्जा से नीचे को ओर मुख बाली थी और कटाक्ष से देख रही थी ।७६। उस चित्र के पट्ट को शिव ने रोमाडिचत अङ्भों पर प्रक्षिप्त कर लिया या । उस समय बड़ा भारी चिन्ता का सङ्ग था और बहुत ही अधिक रति करते की सम्पत्ति थी। विषमेक्षण बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य व्रतेन भक्त्या च कृपया च प्रतिज्ञया । विश्वामित्रकलत्रं च बभार विनये स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasya vratena bhaktyā ca kṛpayā ca pratijñayā / viśvāmitrakalatraṃ ca babhāra vinaye sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: अधिक मदन के ताप से व्यथित हो गये थे ।६०। शिव पावेतो ही को सब ओर देख रहे थे और उसो में अपना मन लगा लिया था । उन्माद से उप- पन्न उसी के माय संलाप करते थे ।८१। उनके हृदय में केवल पावंती ही थी और वे तच्चित्त और उसी में परायण हो गये ये । उत्त पावंती की कथा
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा मृगान्वराहांश्च महिषांश्च जलेचरान् । विश्वामित्राश्रमाभ्यासे तन्मांसमनयत्ततः
verses.transliteration: hatvā mṛgānvarāhāṃśca mahiṣāṃśca jalecarān / viśvāmitrāśramābhyāse tanmāṃsamanayattataḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: रूपिणी सुधा से सब दिन और पूरो रात व्यतीत की थी।८२। उसके ही शील स्वभाव के वर्णन में वे निरत थे और उसके हो रूप के अवलोकन में उत्सुक हो गये थे । उसके साथ भोग के संकल्यों की माला कर में लेकर सुमालिक हो गये थे । शिव तन्मयता को प्राप्त होकर बहुत ही अधिक
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: उपांशुव्रतमास्थाय दीक्षां द्वादशवार्षिकीम् । पितुर्नियोगादभजन्नृपे तु वनमास्थिते
verses.transliteration: upāṃśuvratamāsthāya dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm / piturniyogādabhajannṛpe tu vanamāsthite
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: संतप्त हुए थे ।८३। बह धूर्जेटि इस कामदेव की वीमारी को जिसकी कोई भी चिकित्सा नहीं थो जब लिव ने देखा था तो फिर वे विवाह करने के लिए बहुत ही अधिक उदयमवान हुए बे
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अयोध्यां चैव राष्ट्रं च तथैवान्तः पुरं पुनिः । याज्योत्थान्यायसंयोगाद्वसिष्ठः पर्यरक्षत
verses.transliteration: ayodhyāṃ caiva rāṣṭraṃ ca tathaivāntaḥ puraṃ puniḥ / yājyotthānyāyasaṃyogādvasiṣṭhaḥ paryarakṣata
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: इत्थं विमोह्य तं देवं कन्दर्पो ललिताज्ञया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यव्रतः सुबाल्यात्तु भाविनोर्ऽथस्य वै बलात् । वसिष्ठे ऽभ्यधिकं मन्युं धारयामास मन्युना
verses.transliteration: satyavrataḥ subālyāttu bhāvinor'thasya vai balāt / vasiṣṭhe 'bhyadhikaṃ manyuṃ dhārayāmāsa manyunā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा तु तं तदा राष्ट्रात्परित्यक्तं स्वमात्मजम् । न वारयामास मुनिर्वसिष्ठः कारणेन वै
verses.transliteration: pitrā tu taṃ tadā rāṣṭrātparityaktaṃ svamātmajam / na vārayāmāsa munirvasiṣṭhaḥ kāraṇena vai
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहममन्त्राणां निष्ठा स्यात्सप्तमे पदे । एवं सत्यव्रतस्तां वै हृतवान्सप्तमे पदे
verses.transliteration: pāṇigrahamamantrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade / evaṃ satyavratastāṃ vai hṛtavānsaptame pade
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: जानन्धर्मान्वसिष्ठस्तु नवमन्त्रानिहेच्छति । इति सत्यव्रतो रोषं वसिष्ठे मनसाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: jānandharmānvasiṣṭhastu navamantrānihecchati / iti satyavrato roṣaṃ vasiṣṭhe manasākarot

verses.hindi: भद्रे त्वं तपसा देवं तोषयित्वा महेश्वरम् ।

verses.sanskrit: गुणबुद्ध्या तु भगवान्वसिष्ठः कृतवांस्तपः । न तु सत्यव्रतो ऽबुध्यदुपांशुव्रतमस्य वै
verses.transliteration: guṇabuddhyā tu bhagavānvasiṣṭhaḥ kṛtavāṃstapaḥ / na tu satyavrato 'budhyadupāṃśuvratamasya vai
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तु परमो रोषः पितुरासीन्महात्मनः । तेन द्वादश वर्षाणि नावर्षत्पाकशासनः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstu paramo roṣaḥ piturāsīnmahātmanaḥ / tena dvādaśa varṣāṇi nāvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: ललिता देवी की आज्ञा से उस कन्दं ने इस तरह से शिव को विमोहित करके फिर उसने पार्वती को अपने बाणों से अभितप्त कर दिया था ।६५। बड़े हुए विरह की ज्वाला से मलिन भ्वासों की वायुओं से उसके अधर दल सूख गये थे और उसके कपोल वाण्डु वर्ण के हो गये थे
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तेन त्विदानीं वहता दीक्षां तां दुर्वहां भुवि । कुलस्य निष्कृतिः स्वस्य सृतेयं च भवेदिति
verses.transliteration: tena tvidānīṃ vahatā dīkṣāṃ tāṃ durvahāṃ bhuvi / kulasya niṣkṛtiḥ svasya sṛteyaṃ ca bhavediti
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: पावती को आहार में--शयन में-- स्नान में कही भी धैय नहीं होता था । सहस्रो सियाँ नित्य ही शीतल उपचारों से उसका सेसन किया करती थीं ।६७। बार-बार तापमान होती हुई वह फिर-फिर कर बेचन हो जाती थी । कामाग्नि से जो अधिक थी वह उस रोग की शान्ति नही प्राप्त कर सकी थी
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वसिष्ठो भगवान्पित्रा त्यक्तं न वारयत् । अभिषेक्ष्याम्यहं नष्टे पश्चादेनमिति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tato vasiṣṭho bhagavānpitrā tyaktaṃ na vārayat / abhiṣekṣyāmyahaṃ naṣṭe paścādenamiti prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: अपने शरीर के सन्तापन से उसने पिता के भी खेद को वढा दिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: स तु द्वादशवर्षाणि दीक्षां तामुद्वहन्बली । अविद्यमाने मांसे तु वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sa tu dvādaśavarṣāṇi dīkṣāṃ tāmudvahanbalī / avidyamāne māṃse tu vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: जिसका कुछ भी प्रतिकार नहीं या ऐसा शिव के विषय में दुहिता के बिरह को देखकर शेलराज को महान दुःख प्राप्त हो गया था ।६०। पिता ने उसको प्रेरणा दी थी कि है भद्रे ! तुम तप के द्वारा महेश्वर को असन्न करो और नको अपना भर्चा श्राप्त करो ।६१। हिमवान् पर्वत के शिक्षर पर एक गौरी
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामदुघां धेनुं स ददर्श नृपात्मजः । तां वै क्रोधाच्च मोहाच्च श्रमच्चैव क्षुधान्वितः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmadughāṃ dhenuṃ sa dadarśa nṛpātmajaḥ / tāṃ vai krodhācca mohācca śramaccaiva kṣudhānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: दस्युधर्मगतो दृष्ट्वा जघान बलिनां वरः । सतु मांसं स्वयं चैव विश्वामित्रस्य चात्मजान्
verses.transliteration: dasyudharmagato dṛṣṭvā jaghāna balināṃ varaḥ / satu māṃsaṃ svayaṃ caiva viśvāmitrasya cātmajān
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: शिखर नाम वाली चोटी है उस पर पावंती ने पति के लाम प्राप्त करने के लिये बड़ा ही महान दुष्कर तफ किया था । शीत में जल में निवास करती थी ओर ग्रीष्म में अग्नि के मध्य में रही यो । सूर्य में इष्टि लगाकर उसने घोर तप किया
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: भोजयामास तच्छ्रुत्वा वसिष्ठस्तं तदात्यजत् । प्रोवाच चैव भगवान्वसिष्ठस्तं नृपात्मजम्
verses.transliteration: bhojayāmāsa tacchrutvā vasiṣṭhastaṃ tadātyajat / provāca caiva bhagavānvasiṣṭhastaṃ nṛpātmajam
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पातयेयमहं क्रूर तव शङ्कुम पोह्य वै । यदि ते त्रीणि शङ्कूनि न स्युर्हि पुरुषाधम
verses.transliteration: pātayeyamahaṃ krūra tava śaṅkuma pohya vai / yadi te trīṇi śaṅkūni na syurhi puruṣādhama
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पितुश्चापारितोषेण गुरोर्देगध्रीवधेन च । अप्रोक्षितोपयोगाच्च त्रिविधस्ते व्यतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: pituścāpāritoṣeṇa gurordegadhrīvadhena ca / aprokṣitopayogācca trividhaste vyatikramaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स त्रीणि शङ्कूनि दृष्ट्वा तस्य महातपाः । त्रिशङ्कुरिति होवाच त्रिशङ्कुस्तेन स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa trīṇi śaṅkūni dṛṣṭvā tasya mahātapāḥ / triśaṅkuriti hovāca triśaṅkustena sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रस्तु दाराणामागतो भरणे कृते । ततस्तस्मै वरं प्रादात्तदा प्रीतस्त्रिशङ्कवे
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitrastu dārāṇāmāgato bharaṇe kṛte / tatastasmai varaṃ prādāttadā prītastriśaṅkave
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: छन्द्यमानो वरेणाथ गुरुं वव्रेनृपात्मजः । सशरीरो व्रजे स्वर्गमित्येवं याचितो वरः
verses.transliteration: chandyamāno vareṇātha guruṃ vavrenṛpātmajaḥ / saśarīro vraje svargamityevaṃ yācito varaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिभये तस्मिञ्जाते द्वादशवार्षिके । अभिषिच्य राज्ये पित्र्ये योजयामास तं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭibhaye tasmiñjāte dvādaśavārṣike / abhiṣicya rājye pitrye yojayāmāsa taṃ muniḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: मिषतां देवतानां च वसिष्ठस्य च कौशिकः । सशरीरं तदा तं वै दिवमारोपयत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: miṣatāṃ devatānāṃ ca vasiṣṭhasya ca kauśikaḥ / saśarīraṃ tadā taṃ vai divamāropayatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: मिषतस्तु वसिष्ठस्य तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् । अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमं श्लोकं पौराणिका जनाः
verses.transliteration: miṣatastu vasiṣṭhasya tadadbhutamivābhavat / atrāpyudāharantīmaṃ ślokaṃ paurāṇikā janāḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: उसी तप से तुष्ट होकर जिव ने उसका सान्निव्य किया था। उस पर्ती को शिव ने वैवाहिक विधि से अपनी भार्या बनाना स्वीकार कर लिया था ।९४ इसके पश्चात शिव ने सप्त्यं के द्वारा प्राथिता उस अहियति के द्वारा प्रदान की हुई नलिनेक्षण पुत्री का उद्वाह कर लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रप्रसादेन त्रिशङ्कुर्दिविराजते । देवैः सार्द्धं महातेजानुग्रहात्तस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitraprasādena triśaṅkurdivirājate / devaiḥ sārddhaṃ mahātejānugrahāttasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: अपने श्वशुर के ही घर में औषधिप्स्व नगर में उन्होंने निवास किया था ।६६। फिर कॅलास पर आ गये थे और प्रमयों के साथ पार्वती को वहाँ ले आये ये तथा शेलराज की प्रीति भी प्राप्त कर ली यी ।९७ केलास में तया अन्दर में उस पार्वती के साथ रमण करते रहे ये । तथा विस्ध्य में--हेमशैल
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्यरता नाम भार्या कैकयवंशजा । कुमारं जनयामास हरिश्चन्द्रमकल्मषम्
verses.transliteration: tasya satyaratā nāma bhāryā kaikayavaṃśajā / kumāraṃ janayāmāsa hariścandramakalmaṣam
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: मे-मलयाचन में और पारियाविक में रमण किया था ।६८। अनेक स्थानों
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: स तु राजा हरिश्चन्द्रस्त्रैशङ्कव इति श्रुतः । अहर्ता राजसूयस्य सम्रडिति परिश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: sa tu rājā hariścandrastraiśaṅkava iti śrutaḥ / ahartā rājasūyasya samraḍiti pariśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: में महेश्वर ने रति प्राप्त को थी । इसके बाद उसमें अपना उम्रवीयं छोड़ा था जिसके सहन करने में वह असमथ हो गयी थी ।६६। इसने भी उस वीर्य को भूमि में--वह्ति मैं--कृतिकाओं 'मॅ--क्षिप्त कर दिया था। उन्होंने गज्जाजल में छोड़ दिया था और उसने शर कानन में छोड़ा था
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रस्य तु सुतो रोहितो नाम वीर्यवान् । हरितो रोहितस्याथ चञ्चुर्हरीत उच्यते
verses.transliteration: hariścandrasya tu suto rohito nāma vīryavān / harito rohitasyātha cañcurharīta ucyate
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: विनयश्च सुदेवश्च चञ्चुपुत्रौ बभूवतुः । चैता सर्वस्य क्षत्रस्य विजयस्तेन स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vinayaśca sudevaśca cañcuputrau babhūvatuḥ / caitā sarvasya kṣatrasya vijayastena sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: रुरुकस्तनयस्तस्य राजा धर्मार्थकोविदः । रुरुकात्तु वृकः पुत्रस्तस्माद्बाहुर्विजज्ञिवान्
verses.transliteration: rurukastanayastasya rājā dharmārthakovidaḥ / rurukāttu vṛkaḥ putrastasmādbāhurvijajñivān
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: हैहयैस्तालजङ्घैश्च निरस्तो व्यसनी नृपः । शकैर्यवनकांबोजैः पारदैः पह्लवैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: haihayaistālajaṅghaiśca nirasto vyasanī nṛpaḥ / śakairyavanakāṃbojaiḥ pāradaiḥ pahlavaistathā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: नात्यर्थं धार्मिको ऽभूत्स धर्म्ये सति युगे तथा । सगरस्तु सुतो बाहोर्जज्ञे सह गरेण वै
verses.transliteration: nātyarthaṃ dhārmiko 'bhūtsa dharmye sati yuge tathā / sagarastu suto bāhorjajñe saha gareṇa vai
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: भृगोराश्रममासाद्य ह्यौर्वैण परिरक्षितः । अग्नेयमस्त्रं लब्ध्वा तु भार्गवात्सगरो नृपः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgorāśramamāsādya hyaurvaiṇa parirakṣitaḥ / agneyamastraṃ labdhvā tu bhārgavātsagaro nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: जघान पृथिवीं गत्वा तालजङ्घान्सहैहयान् । शकानां पह्लवानां च धर्मं निरसदच्युतः
verses.transliteration: jaghāna pṛthivīṃ gatvā tālajaṅghānsahaihayān / śakānāṃ pahlavānāṃ ca dharmaṃ nirasadacyutaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: बतंते जगतामृद्धधं तत्र तां सेवितु' ययौ
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाणां तथा तेषां पारदानां च धर्मवित् । ऋषय ऊचुः कथं स सगरो राजा गरेण सह जज्ञिवान्
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā teṣāṃ pāradānāṃ ca dharmavit / ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ sa sagaro rājā gareṇa saha jajñivān
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: यहां पर महान् सेनानी महावीर षडानन समुत्पन्न हुए ये गज्ञा के समीप में पहुँचाया गया था और धूजेटि वृद्धि को प्राप्त हुए ये ।१०१। वह प्रतिदिन बढ़ने लगे थे और परम तीव्र विक्रम वाले हुए थे । अपने ही पिता के द्वारा उसको शिक्षा दी गयी थी ओर उसने समस्त विद्याएँ प्राप्त कर ली
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं वा शकादीनां क्षत्रियाणां महौजसाम् । धर्मान्कुलोचितान्क्रुद्धो राजा निरसदच्युतः
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ vā śakādīnāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahaujasām / dharmānkulocitānkruddho rājā nirasadacyutaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: थीं ।१०२। इसके पश्चात् पिता की आज्ञा श्राप्त करके देवों के सेनापति का पद ग्रहण कर लिया था। फिर उनने समस्त दानवों के साथ तारक को मार डाला था ।१०३। फिर तारक देत्य के वेध से सन्तोष शाली इन्द्र ने देवों की सेना दी थो ओर गुह देव सेना को प्राप्त हो गये वे । फिर शुक् की
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सुत उवाच बाहोर्व्यसनिनस्तस्य त्दृतं राज्यं पुरा किल । हैहयैस्तालजङ्घैश्च शकैः सार्द्धं समागतैः
verses.transliteration: suta uvāca bāhorvyasaninastasya tdṛtaṃ rājyaṃ purā kila / haihayaistālajaṅghaiśca śakaiḥ sārddhaṃ samāgataiḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: पुत्री देवसेना नाम वाली यशस्विनी ने स्कन्द को अपना स्वामी ग्राप्त करने पर अधिक आनन्द प्राप्त किया था ।१०४-१०५। इस रोति से कामदेव ने
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: यवनाः पारदाश्चैव कांबोजाः पह्लवास्तथा । हैहयार्थं पराक्रान्ता एते पञ्च गणास्तदा
verses.transliteration: yavanāḥ pāradāścaiva kāṃbojāḥ pahlavāstathā / haihayārthaṃ parākrāntā ete pañca gaṇāstadā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: त्दृतराज्यस्तदाबाहुः संन्यस्य स तदा गृहम् । वनं प्रविश्य धर्मात्मा सह पत्न्या तपो ऽचरत्
verses.transliteration: tdṛtarājyastadābāhuḥ saṃnyasya sa tadā gṛham / vanaṃ praviśya dharmātmā saha patnyā tapo 'carat
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण विश्व को संमोहित कर दिया या । बह देवों के इस कार्य को पूर्ण करके फिर श्रीपुर में चला गया था हाँ पर परम पुष्प श्री नगर में परमेश्वरी ललिता जगतो की समृद्धि के वतमान रहती है । उसी की सेवा करने के लिए वह चला गया वा
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिदप्यकल्पः स तोयार्थं प्रस्थितो नृपः । वृद्धत्वाद्दुर्बलत्वाच्च ह्यन्तरा स ममार च
verses.transliteration: kadācidapyakalpaḥ sa toyārthaṃ prasthito nṛpaḥ / vṛddhatvāddurbalatvācca hyantarā sa mamāra ca
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: किमिदं श्रीपूरं नाम केन रूपेण वतंते । केन वा निमितं पूर्व तत्सवं मे निवेदय ।
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी तु यादवी तस्य सगर्भा पृष्ठतो ऽप्यगात् । सपत्न्या तु गरस्तस्यै दत्तो गर्भजिघांसया
verses.transliteration: patnī tu yādavī tasya sagarbhā pṛṣṭhato 'pyagāt / sapatnyā tu garastasyai datto garbhajighāṃsayā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सा तु भर्तुश्चितां कृत्वा वह्निं तं समारोहयत् । और्वस्तं भार्गवो दृष्ट्वा कारुण्याद्धि न्यवर्त्तयत्
verses.transliteration: sā tu bhartuścitāṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ taṃ samārohayat / aurvastaṃ bhārgavo dṛṣṭvā kāruṇyāddhi nyavarttayat
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा वैवाहिकीं लीलां ब्रह्मादयः प्राथिता पुनः । व्यजेष्ट भण्डतामानमसुरं लोककण्टकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्रमे तु गर्भं सा गरेण च तदा सह । व्यजायत महाबाहुं सगरं नाम धर्मिकम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāśrame tu garbhaṃ sā gareṇa ca tadā saha / vyajāyata mahābāhuṃ sagaraṃ nāma dharmikam
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: तदा देवा महेन्द्राद्याः सन्तोषं बहु भेजिरे । अथ कामेश्वरस्यापि ललितायाश्च शोभनम् । निस्योपभोगसर्वार्थ मन्दिरं कतुं पुत्सुका: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: और्वस्तु जातकर्मादीन्कृत्वा तस्य महात्मनः । अध्याप्य वेदाञ्छास्त्राणि ततो ऽस्त्रं प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: aurvastu jātakarmādīnkṛtvā tasya mahātmanaḥ / adhyāpya vedāñchāstrāṇi tato 'straṃ pratyapādayat
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: कुमारा ललितादेव्या ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । वर्धेकि विश्वकर्माणं सुराणां शिल्पकोविदम
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शकान्स यवनान्कांबोजान्पारदांस्तथा । पह्लवांश्चैव निःशेषान्कर्तुं व्यवसितो नृपः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śakānsa yavanānkāṃbojānpāradāṃstathā / pahlavāṃścaiva niḥśeṣānkartuṃ vyavasito nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: ते हन्यमाना वीरेण सगरेण महात्मना । वसिष्ठं शरणं सर्वे संप्राप्ताः शरणैषिणः
verses.transliteration: te hanyamānā vīreṇa sagareṇa mahātmanā / vasiṣṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ sarve saṃprāptāḥ śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्यजी ने कहा--यह श्रीपुर नाम वाला वया है और यह किस स्वरूप से होता है । शव में इसका निर्माण किसने किया था--यह सब आप कृपया मुझको बतला दीजिए ।१। यह श्रीपुर कितना बडा है और इसका कया वर्ण है-हे प्रभो ! बहु सभी कुछ बठलाइए । आप ही एक ऐसे हैं जो
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठो वीक्ष्य तान्युक्तान्विनयोन महामुनिः । सगरं वारयामास तेषां दत्त्वाभयं तथा
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho vīkṣya tānyuktānvinayona mahāmuniḥ / sagaraṃ vārayāmāsa teṣāṃ dattvābhayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: सभी प्रकार से सन्देह के पंक को सुखा देने वाले हैं ।२। श्री हयग्रीवजी ने कहा--जिस प्रकार से पूव में कहे हुए लक्षणों से युक्त चक्ररथ को प्रो करके महाभागानला परमेश्वरी ललिता समुत्पन्न हुई थी ।३। फिर ब्रह्मा आदि के द्वारा प्रार्थना किये जाने पर वैवाहिकी लीला करके उसने लोकों
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सगरः स्वां प्रतिज्ञां च गुरोर्वाक्यं निशम्य च । जघान धर्मं वै तेषां वेषान्यत्वं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: sagaraḥ svāṃ pratijñāṃ ca gurorvākyaṃ niśamya ca / jaghāna dharmaṃ vai teṣāṃ veṣānyatvaṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: के लिए कष्टक भंडासुर पर विजय ग्राप्त की थी ।४। वहाँ पर महेन्द आदि देवगण बहुत ही अधिक स्तुष हुए ये । इसके उपरान्त कामेश्वर का और ललिता का परम शोभन नित्य उपभोग के समस्त अर्थों वाला एक मन्दिर का निर्माण करने के लिए सब देवगण उत्सुक हुए ये ।५। ललिता देवी के
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अर्द्धं शाकानां शिरसो मुण्डयित्वा व्यसर्जयत् । यवनानां शिरः सर्वं कांबोजानां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: arddhaṃ śākānāṃ śiraso muṇḍayitvā vyasarjayat / yavanānāṃ śiraḥ sarvaṃ kāṃbojānāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: कुपार ब्रह्मा-विष्णु और महेश्वर ये । इन्होंने वध्धकि विश्वकर्मा को जो कि शिल्प विश्वा का पण्डित चा !६। और असुरों का शिल्पी मय फो जो भाया में बड़ा कुशल था बुलाया था । इनका सत्कार करके ललिता की आज्ञा से उनसे सबने कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: पारदा मुक्तकेशाश्च पह्लवाः श्मश्रुधारिणः । निःस्वाध्यायवषट्काराः कृतास्तेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: pāradā muktakeśāśca pahlavāḥ śmaśrudhāriṇaḥ / niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārāḥ kṛtāstena mahātmanā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: शका यवन कांबोजाः पह्लवाः पारदैः सह । कलिस्पर्शा महिषिका दार्वस्छोलाः खशास्तथा
verses.transliteration: śakā yavana kāṃbojāḥ pahlavāḥ pāradaiḥ saha / kalisparśā mahiṣikā dārvascholāḥ khaśāstathā

verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ते क्षत्रियगणा धर्मस्तेषां निराकृतः । वसिष्ठवचनात्पूर्वं सगरेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration: sarve te kṣatriyagaṇā dharmasteṣāṃ nirākṛtaḥ / vasiṣṭhavacanātpūrvaṃ sagareṇa mahātmanā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: स धर्मविजयी राजा विजित्येमां वसुन्धराम् । अश्वं वै चारयामास वाजिमेधाय दीक्षितः
verses.transliteration: sa dharmavijayī rājā vijityemāṃ vasundharām / aśvaṃ vai cārayāmāsa vājimedhāya dīkṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चारयतः सो ऽश्वः समुद्रे पूर्वदक्षिणे । वेलासमीपे ऽपहृतो भूमिं चैव प्रवेशितः
verses.transliteration: tasya cārayataḥ so 'śvaḥ samudre pūrvadakṣiṇe / velāsamīpe 'pahṛto bhūmiṃ caiva praveśitaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: स तं देशं सुतैः सर्वैः खानयामास पार्थिवः । आसेदुश्च ततस्तस्मिन्खनन्तस्ते महार्मवे
verses.transliteration: sa taṃ deśaṃ sutaiḥ sarvaiḥ khānayāmāsa pārthivaḥ / āseduśca tatastasminkhanantaste mahārmave
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: इति कारणदेवानां वचनं सुनिशम्य तौ । विश्वकर्म मयौ नत्वा व्यभाषेतां तथास्त्विति
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तमादिपुरुषं देवं हरिं कृष्णं प्रजापतिम् । विष्णुं कपिलरूपेण हंसं नारायणं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tamādipuruṣaṃ devaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prajāpatim / viṣṇuṃ kapilarūpeṇa haṃsaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चक्षुः समासाद्य तेजस्तत्प्रतिपद्यते । दग्धाः पुत्रास्तदा सर्वेचत्वारस्त्ववशेषिताः
verses.transliteration: tasya cakṣuḥ samāsādya tejastatpratipadyate / dagdhāḥ putrāstadā sarvecatvārastvavaśeṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: बर्हिकेतुः सुकेतुश्च तथा धर्मरथश्च यः । शूरः पञ्चजनश्चैव तस्य वंशकराः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: barhiketuḥ suketuśca tathā dharmarathaśca yaḥ / śūraḥ pañcajanaścaiva tasya vaṃśakarāḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादाच्च तस्य भगवान्हरिर्नारायणो वरान् । अक्षयत्वं स्ववंशस्य वाजिमेधशतं तथा
verses.transliteration: prādācca tasya bhagavānharirnārāyaṇo varān / akṣayatvaṃ svavaṃśasya vājimedhaśataṃ tathā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: अधिकारी पुरुषों ने कहा था-हे विश्वकर्मंन ! आप बहुत ही ऊचे शिल्प कमे के ज्ञाता हैं। है महोदय मय ! आप दोनों ही घटना मार्ग के विद्वान् हैं ओर सभी शास्त्रों के भी ज्ञाता हैं? ।८। आप लोग तो केवल संकल्प से ही महान् शिल्प कल्प के विशारद हैं। आप दोनों को ही नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: विभुः पुत्रं समुद्रं च स्वर्गे वासं तथाक्षयम् । तं समुद्रो ऽश्वमादाय ववन्दे सरितांपतिः
verses.transliteration: vibhuḥ putraṃ samudraṃ ca svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣayam / taṃ samudro 'śvamādāya vavande saritāṃpatiḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान की सागर ललितादेवी को श्री नगरियां बनानी चाहिए जो षोडशी क्षेत्र के मध्य में उसके क्षेत्र को समान संख्या से युक्त होंगी । वे श्री नगरी अनेक रत्नों से विभूषित भी बनानी चाहिए ।९-१०। जहाँ पर सोलह प्रकार से भिन्न परमेश्वरी ललिता इस विश्व की रक्षा के लिए अपना निवास
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सागरत्वं च लेभे स कर्मणा तेन तस्य वै । तं चाश्वमेधिकं सो ऽश्वं समुद्रात्प्राप्य पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: sāgaratvaṃ ca lebhe sa karmaṇā tena tasya vai / taṃ cāśvamedhikaṃ so 'śvaṃ samudrātprāpya pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: बनायेगी ।११। यह हमारा भी प्रिय होवे ओर मरुतों का भी प्रिय हो और सवलोक का प्रिय होवे ऐसा यह नाम से ही विरचित करो ।१२। यह कारण देवों का वचन उन दोनों ने श्रवण करके दोनों विश्वकर्माओं ने ऐसा ही होगा-फह कहकर स्वीकार किया था।१३। फिर उनने नमस्कार करके
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: आजहाराश्वमेधानां शतं चैव पुनः पुनः । षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि दग्धान्यस्य रुषा विभो
verses.transliteration: ājahārāśvamedhānāṃ śataṃ caiva punaḥ punaḥ / ṣaṣṭiṃ putrasahasrāṇi dagdhānyasya ruṣā vibho
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: उन कारण देवताओं से पूछा था कि ये श्री नगरियाँ किन क्षेत्रों में बनानी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां नारायणं तेजः प्रविष्टानि महात्मनाम् । पुत्राणां तु सहस्राणि षष्टिस्तु इति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tejaḥ praviṣṭāni mahātmanām / putrāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭistu iti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः सगरस्यात्मजा नाना कथं जाता महाबलाः । विक्रान्ताः षष्टिसाहस्रा विधिना केन वा वद
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sagarasyātmajā nānā kathaṃ jātā mahābalāḥ / vikrāntāḥ ṣaṣṭisāhasrā vidhinā kena vā vada
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सुत उवाच द्वेपत्न्यौ सगरस्यास्तां तपसा दगधकिल्बिषे । ज्येष्ठा विदर्भदुहिता केशिनी नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: suta uvāca dvepatnyau sagarasyāstāṃ tapasā dagadhakilbiṣe / jyeṣṭhā vidarbhaduhitā keśinī nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: कनीयसी तु या तस्यपत्नी परमधर्मिणी । अरिष्टनेमिदुहिता रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि
verses.transliteration: kanīyasī tu yā tasyapatnī paramadharmiṇī / ariṣṭanemiduhitā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: येष, क्षेत्रेष, कलुप्तानि घ्नन्त्या देव्या महासुरान् । नामानि नित्यानाम्नेव प्रथितानि न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: और्वस्ताभ्यां वरं प्रादात्तपसाराधितः प्रभुः । एका जनिष्यते पुत्रं वंशकर्त्तारमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: aurvastābhyāṃ varaṃ prādāttapasārādhitaḥ prabhuḥ / ekā janiṣyate putraṃ vaṃśakarttāramīpsitam
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मादिक से परिपृष्ट हुए उन दोनों शिल्पियों ने कहा था कि क्षेत्रों
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि द्वितीया जनयिष्यति । मुनेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा केशिनी पुत्रमेककम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭiṃ putrasahasrāṇi dvitīyā janayiṣyati / munestu vacanaṃ śrutvā keśinī putramekakam
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: का प्रविभाग यथोचित कल्पित कीजिए ।१४। कारण पुरुषों ने कहा--प्रथम तो भेह के पृष्ठ पर ओर निषध महीधर पर-हेम गिरि पर--हिम कूट पर
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: वंशस्य कारणं श्रेष्ठं जग्राह नृप संसदि । षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि सुपर्णभगिनी तथा
verses.transliteration: vaṃśasya kāraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jagrāha nṛpa saṃsadi / ṣaṣṭiṃ putrasahasrāṇi suparṇabhaginī tathā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: पर ये नो क्षेत्र मौम विदित हैं।१६-१७। जलीय सात ही स्थान हैं जो समस्त सिन्धुओं में बताये गये हैं। लवण सागर--इशुसार सागर-सुरा सागर-- धृत सागर ।१०। दधि सागर-क्षीर सिन्धु है। पूवं में कहे हुए नो मौलेन और पीछे बताये गये सात सिन्धु हैं ।१६। इन सोलह क्षेत्रों का आहरण
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: महाभागा प्रमुदिता जग्राह सुमतिस्तथा । अथ काले गते ज्येष्ठा ज्येष्ठं पुत्रं व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: mahābhāgā pramuditā jagrāha sumatistathā / atha kāle gate jyeṣṭhā jyeṣṭhaṃ putraṃ vyajāyata
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: करके श्री के पुरों की क्‍्लृप्ति के लिए हैं। महान ओज वाली ललिता देवी के जिनमें दिव्य गृह होंगे। आप दोनों ही शिल्पी हैं और दिव्य घटना के महान् पण्डित हैं अतः ऐसा ही निर्माण कीजिए ।२०। जिन क्षेत्रों में असुरों का हनन करने वाली देवी के नाम क्लृप्त हैं वे सब नित्य नाम से ही प्रथित
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: असमञ्ज इति ख्यातं काकुत्स्थं सगरात्मजम् । सुमतिस्त्वपि जज्ञे वै गर्भतुंबं यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: asamañja iti khyātaṃ kākutsthaṃ sagarātmajam / sumatistvapi jajñe vai garbhatuṃbaṃ yaśasvinī
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: हैं-इसमें लेशमात्र भौ संशय नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणां तुंबमध्याद्विनिस्सृताः । घृतपूर्णेषु कुंभेषु तान्गर्भान्यदधात्ततः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇāṃ tuṃbamadhyādvinissṛtāḥ / ghṛtapūrṇeṣu kuṃbheṣu tāngarbhānyadadhāttataḥ

verses.transliteration: yena gaṅgā saricchreṣṭhā vimānairupaśobhitā / ihānītā sureśādvai duhitṛtve ca kalpitā

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमं श्लोकं पौराणिका जनाः । भगीरथस्तु तां गङ्गामानयामास कर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: atrāpyudāharantīmaṃ ślokaṃ paurāṇikā janāḥ / bhagīrathastu tāṃ gaṅgāmānayāmāsa karmabhiḥ

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्भागीरथी गङ्गा कथ्यते वंशवित्तमैः । भगीरथसुतश्चापि श्रुतो नाम बभूवह
verses.transliteration: tasmādbhāgīrathī gaṅgā kathyate vaṃśavittamaiḥ / bhagīrathasutaścāpi śruto nāma babhūvaha

verses.hindi: बह देवी पर) नित्या के स्वरूप से काल की व्यापि करने वाली है । कलनान्तकता से देवी सम्पूर्ण जगत् का कलन करती है ।२२। महाराज्ञी नित्या नाम वाली है जिसमें तदूभिदा भी नित्या नाम ही है । अतएव उसके ही नाम से व्ह पुरी पहिले सनामा प्रिता हुई है ।२३। कामेश्वरी पुरी तया
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागस्तस्य दायादो नित्यं धर्मपरायणः । अम्बरीषः सुतस्तस्य सिंधुद्वीपस्ततो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: nābhāgastasya dāyādo nityaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / ambarīṣaḥ sutastasya siṃdhudvīpastato 'bhavat

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे वंशपुराणज्ञा गायन्तीति परिश्रुतम् । नाभागेरंबरीषस्य भुजाभ्यां परिपालिता
verses.transliteration: pūrve vaṃśapurāṇajñā gāyantīti pariśrutam / nābhāgeraṃbarīṣasya bhujābhyāṃ paripālitā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: है लोपामुद्रापते ! आप श्रवण कीजिए--मैं अब उस श्री पुर का विस्तार और पुर के अधिष्ठातृ देवताओं को बतलाता हूँ ।२७। जो मेरु का अखिला- घार A अनन्तयोजन ऊंचा है चौदह भवनों के चकर में संप्रोत विग्रह वाला है ।२दा
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: बभूव वसुधात्यर्थं तापत्रयविवर्जिता । अयुतायुः सुतस्तस्य सिंधुद्वीपस्य वीर्यवान्

verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजाः क्षेत्रे कल्माषपादके । अश्मकं जनयामास त्विक्ष्वाकुकुलवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhastu mahātejāḥ kṣetre kalmāṣapādake / aśmakaṃ janayāmāsa tvikṣvākukulavṛddhaye

verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अश्मकस्यौरसो यस्तु मूलकस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमं मूलकं वै नृपं प्रति
verses.transliteration: aśmakasyauraso yastu mūlakastatsuto 'bhavat / atrāpyudāharantīmaṃ mūlakaṃ vai nṛpaṃ prati
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: ।३३। वहाँ पर यह प्रविभाग है जो आपको विवेचन! करके दिखाया जाता है। उसका जो प्रथम प्राकार है कालायस से बनाया गया है ।३४। सोलह सहर योजन आयत वेष्टन है। चारों दिशाओं में वह हारों से युक्त है और चार योजन ऊँचा है
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: स हि रामभयाद्राजा स्त्रीभिः परिवृतो ऽवसत् । विवस्त्रस्त्राणमिच्छन्वै नारीकवच ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa hi rāmabhayādrājā strībhiḥ parivṛto 'vasat / vivastrastrāṇamicchanvai nārīkavaca īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: मूलकस्यापि धर्मात्मा राजा शतरथः स्मृतः । तस्माच्छतरथाज्जज्ञे राजा त्विडविडो बली
verses.transliteration: mūlakasyāpi dharmātmā rājā śatarathaḥ smṛtaḥ / tasmācchatarathājjajñe rājā tviḍaviḍo balī
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: आसीत्त्वैडविडः श्रीमान्कृशशर्मा प्रतापवान् । पुत्रो विश्वसहस्रस्य पुत्रीकस्यां व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: āsīttvaiḍaviḍaḥ śrīmānkṛśaśarmā pratāpavān / putro viśvasahasrasya putrīkasyāṃ vyajāyata
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: हे अब्धिप ! शाल वृक्ष के मूल के समान परिणाम वाला है औरं योजनायुत है । शालाग्र के गव्यूति का नद्ध.यायत पृथक् है ।३६। शाल द्वार

verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: दिलीपस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत्खट्वाङ्ग इति विश्रुतः । येन स्वर्गादिहागत्य मुहूर्त्तं प्राप्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: dilīpastasya putro 'bhūtkhaṭvāṅga iti viśrutaḥ / yena svargādihāgatya muhūrttaṃ prāpya jīvitam
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयो ऽभिसंहिता लोका बुद्ध्या सत्येन चैव हि । दीर्घबाहुः सुतस्तस्य रघुस्तस्मादजायत
verses.transliteration: trayo 'bhisaṃhitā lokā buddhyā satyena caiva hi / dīrghabāhuḥ sutastasya raghustasmādajāyata
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: की ऊँचाई एक योजन आधित है। आधी गब्यूति के विस्तार बाले प्रति द्वार में दो किवाड़ हैं।३७। वे एक योजन उन्नद्ध हैं तथा कृष्ण लोह के द्वारा बने हुए हैं। उन दोनों में एक अगंला है जो आधे कोश के बराबर आयत है ।३८। इस प्रकार से चारों द्वारों में समान ही कीत्तित है। है कुम्भ
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अजः पुत्रो रघोश्चापि तस्माज्जज्ञे स वीर्यवान् । राजा दशरथो नाम इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: ajaḥ putro raghoścāpi tasmājjajñe sa vīryavān / rājā daśaratho nāma ikṣvākukulanandanaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: सम्भव ! गोपुर का संस्थान मैं कहता हैं ।३६। पूर्व मे कहे हुए शाल के मूल में जो योजन समित है । दोनों पाश्बों में दो-दो योजन लाकर निमित किये गये हैं ।४०। विस्तार भी द्वारों से युक्त उतना ही सम्प्राप्त है। दोनों पाएवं मध्य में दो योजन हैं जो शाल का योजन है ।४१। है मुने ! प्रमाण से पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: रामो दाशरथिर्वीरो धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः । भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चैव शत्रुघ्नश्च महाबलः
verses.transliteration: rāmo dāśarathirvīro dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ / bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: योजन मिलाकर दोनों पाशवं ढाई कोश से संयुत हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: माधवं लवणं हत्वा गत्वा मधुवनं च तत् । शत्रुघ्रेन पुरी तत्र मथुरा विनिवेशिता
verses.transliteration: mādhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ hatvā gatvā madhuvanaṃ ca tat / śatrughrena purī tatra mathurā viniveśitā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सुबाहुः शूरसे नश्च शत्रुघ्नस्य सुतावुभौ । पालयामासतुस्तौ तु वैदेह्यौ मथुरां पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: subāhuḥ śūrase naśca śatrughnasya sutāvubhau / pālayāmāsatustau tu vaidehyau mathurāṃ purīm
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: उपयु परि वेशस्य ह्लास एव प्रकीत्येते
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गदश्चन्द्रकेतुश्च लक्ष्मणस्यात्मजावुभौ । हिमवत्पर्वतस्यान्ते स्फीतौ जनपदौ तयोः
verses.transliteration: aṅgadaścandraketuśca lakṣmaṇasyātmajāvubhau / himavatparvatasyānte sphītau janapadau tayoḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: मिलाकर पाँच योजन आयत है । इस प्रकार से वहां पर है मुने ! गोपुर की रचना को गई ।५३। इस कारण से गोपुर के मूल का वेड बीस योजनों बाला है । उस वेट के ऊपर-ऊपर में हास बलाया जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गदस्याङ्गदाख्याता देशे कारयते पुरी । चन्द्रकेतोस्तु विख्याता चन्द्रचक्रा पुरी शुभा
verses.transliteration: aṅgadasyāṅgadākhyātā deśe kārayate purī / candraketostu vikhyātā candracakrā purī śubhā
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: उस गोपुर की ऊँचाई पच्चोस योजन की है ऐसा कहा गया है । एक-एक
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: भरतस्यात्मजौ वीरौ तक्षः पुष्कर एव च । गान्धारविषये सिद्धे तयोः पुर्यो महात्मनोः
verses.transliteration: bharatasyātmajau vīrau takṣaḥ puṣkara eva ca / gāndhāraviṣaye siddhe tayoḥ puryo mahātmanoḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: योजन पर द्वार हैं जिनमें बहुत सुन्दर किबाढ़ सगे हुए हैं ।४५। और भूमि- कायें भी उतनी ही हैं जेसी ऊध्वे में हास में युत हैं । गोपुर के आगे का विस्तार एक योजन समाश्रित है ।४६। उसका जायाम भी वहां पर उतना हो है तिमुकुट कहः गया है। है घटोदुभव ! मुकुट का विस्तार एक कोश
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तक्षस्य दिक्षु विख्याता नाम्ना तक्षशिला पुरी । पुष्करस्यापि वीरस्य विख्याता पुष्करावती
verses.transliteration: takṣasya dikṣu vikhyātā nāmnā takṣaśilā purī / puṣkarasyāpi vīrasya vikhyātā puṣkarāvatī
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: के मान वाला है ।४७ है मुने ! गोपुर के ही तुल्य दो कोश समुन्नद्ध हास है। मुकुट के अन्दर की भूमि आधे के बरावर है ।४८। मुकुट पश्चिम-- पूर्व-दक्षिण में द्वार गोपुर में है। दक्षोत्तर मुकुट पश्चिम द्वार गोपुर में है
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: गाथां चैवात्र गायन्ति ये पुराण विदो जनाः । रामेण बद्धां सत्यार्थां महात्म्यात्तस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: gāthāṃ caivātra gāyanti ye purāṇa vido janāḥ / rāmeṇa baddhāṃ satyārthāṃ mahātmyāttasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: श्यामो युवा लोहिताक्षो दीप्तास्यो मीतभाषितः । आजानुबाहुः सुमुखः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः
verses.transliteration: śyāmo yuvā lohitākṣo dīptāsyo mītabhāṣitaḥ / ājānubāhuḥ sumukhaḥ siṃhaskandho mahābhujaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि रामो राज्यमकारयत् । ऋक्सामयजुषां घोषो यो घोषश्च महास्वनः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rāmo rājyamakārayat / ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ ghoṣo yo ghoṣaśca mahāsvanaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अव्युच्छिन्नो ऽभवद्राज्ये दीयतां भुज्यतामिति । जनस्थाने वसन्कार्यं त्रिदशानां चकार सः
verses.transliteration: avyucchinno 'bhavadrājye dīyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti / janasthāne vasankāryaṃ tridaśānāṃ cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: तमागस्कारिणं पूर्वं पौलस्त्यं मनुजर्षभः । सीतायाः पदमन्विच्छन्निजघान महायशाः
verses.transliteration: tamāgaskāriṇaṃ pūrvaṃ paulastyaṃ manujarṣabhaḥ / sītāyāḥ padamanvicchannijaghāna mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्ववान्गुणसंपन्नो दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा । अतिसूर्यं च वह्निं च रामो दाशरथिर्बभौ
verses.transliteration: sattvavānguṇasaṃpanno dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā / atisūryaṃ ca vahniṃ ca rāmo dāśarathirbabhau
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेष महाबाहोस्तस्य पुत्रौ बभूवतुः । कुशो लव इति ख्यातो तयोर्देशौ निबोधत
verses.transliteration: evameṣa mahābāhostasya putrau babhūvatuḥ / kuśo lava iti khyāto tayordeśau nibodhata
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: कुशस्य कोशला राज्यं पुरी चापि कुशस्थली । रम्या निवेशिता तेन विन्ध्यपर्वतसानुषु
verses.transliteration: kuśasya kośalā rājyaṃ purī cāpi kuśasthalī / ramyā niveśitā tena vindhyaparvatasānuṣu
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तराकोशले राज्य लवस्य च महात्मनः । श्रावस्तिर्लोकविख्याता कुशवंशं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: uttarākośale rājya lavasya ca mahātmanaḥ / śrāvastirlokavikhyātā kuśavaṃśaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: कुशस्य पुत्रो धर्मात्मा ह्यतिथिः सुप्रियातिथिः । अतिथेरपि विख्यातो निषधो नाम पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: kuśasya putro dharmātmā hyatithiḥ supriyātithiḥ / atitherapi vikhyāto niṣadho nāma pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: दक्षिण द्वार के समान उत्तर द्वार किरोटिका कही गयी है । पश्चिम द्वार के तुल्य पूव द्वार में मुकुट की योजना है (५०) कालायस शाल के अन्तर में मारत योजन में कांस्यज्ञाल के अन्तर में पूर्व की भाँति गोपुर अन्वित है ।५१। शाल के मूल का श्रेमाण तो पूर्व के ही समान कीत्तित किया
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: निषधस्य नलः पुत्रो नलस्य तु नाभाः सुतः । नभसः पुण्डरीकस्तु क्षेम धन्वा ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: niṣadhasya nalaḥ putro nalasya tu nābhāḥ sutaḥ / nabhasaḥ puṇḍarīkastu kṣema dhanvā tataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: गया है। कास्य शाल भी पूर्व आदि दिशाओं के द्वार से समन्वित है
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेमधन्वसुतो राजा देवानीकः प्रतापवान् । आसीदहीनगुर्नाम देवानीकात्मजः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kṣemadhanvasuto rājā devānīkaḥ pratāpavān / āsīdahīnagurnāma devānīkātmajaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: प्रतिद्वार में पर्व लक्षण वाले गोपुर हैं । कालायस ओर कास्य का जो अन्त-
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: अहीन गोस्तु दायादः पारियात्रो महायशाः । दलस्तस्यात्मजश्चापि तस्माज्जज्ञे बलो नृपः
verses.transliteration: ahīna gostu dāyādaḥ pāriyātro mahāyaśāḥ / dalastasyātmajaścāpi tasmājjajñe balo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.hindi: ४४८  . ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण देंश है वह माता गया है जो चारों ओर है ।५३!१ है कुम्भ सम्भव ! वह नाना वृक्षो का महान् उद्यान कहा गया है । उद्भिञ्ज आदि जितने भी हैं वे सभी वहाँ पर विद्यमान हैं ।५४ सहस्रो से भी अधिक तरुगण जो सदा
verses.wordMeaning: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: उलूको नाम धर्मात्मा बलपुत्रो बभूव ह । वज्रनाभः सुतस्तस्य शङ्खणस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: ulūko nāma dharmātmā balaputro babhūva ha / vajranābhaḥ sutastasya śaṅkhaṇastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Va. 205 calls him Aunkha while in the AIHT list of Ayodhya kings ( ) he is recorded as Uktha.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धात पादे भार्गवचरिते इक्ष्वाकुवंशकीर्त्तनं नाम त्रिषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ६३॥ सूत उवाच अनुजस्य विकुक्षेस्तु निमेर्वंशं निबोघत । यो ऽसौ निवेशयामास पुरं देवपुरोपमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhāta pāde bhārgavacarite ikṣvākuvaṃśakīrttanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 63// sūta uvāca anujasya vikukṣestu nimervaṃśaṃ niboghata / yo 'sau niveśayāmāsa puraṃ devapuropamam
verses.translation: Iksvaku of profound brilliance had a son named Nimi, a highly pious soul who was saluted by all living beings and who became a great king. The noble-souled son of great strength, Devarata was born of Suketu. The pious-souled son well known as Brha- duktha was born of Devarata.
verses.hindi: तक से वृक्ष है ।६१। हरीतकी--अवाक्युष्पी --घोण्टाली--स्वर्गे पुष्पिका-- मल्लातक--खदिर--शाखोट--चन्दन दुम हैं ।६२। कालागुरु द्रुम-- काल-

verses.commentary: Sense: Iksvaku of profound brilliance had a son named Nimi, a highly pious soul who was saluted by all living beings and who became a great king. The noble-souled son of great strength, Devarata was born of Suketu. The pious-souled son well known as Brha- duktha was born of Devarata.

verses.sanskrit: जयन्तमिति विख्यातं गौतमस्याश्रमान्तिकम् । यस्यान्ववाये जज्ञे वै जनको नृपसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: jayantamiti vikhyātaṃ gautamasyāśramāntikam / yasyānvavāye jajñe vai janako nṛpasattamaḥ
verses.translation: Dhr stake tu, the suppressor of his enemies, was the noble-souled son of Sudhrti. The son of Dhrstaketu was well- known by the name Haryasva. Modem Tirhut, also called Janakpur, in Darbhaftgft Dist* Bihar.

verses.transliteration: nimirnāma sudharmātmā sarvasattvanamaskṛtaḥ / āsītputro mahārāja caikṣvākorbhūritejasaḥ
verses.translation: Pargiter records Pratindhaka for this (AIHT. ) The line of the noble-souled scions of the family of Janaka came to a close with him. Thus the Maithilas have been recounted. Understand the line of Soma now.

verses.transliteration: sa śāpena vasiṣṭhasyavidehaḥ samapadyata / tasya putro mithirnāma janitaḥ parvabhistribhiḥ

verses.transliteration: araṇyāṃ mathyamānāyā prādurbhūto mahāyaśāḥ / nāmnā mithiriti khyāto jananājjanako 'bhavat

verses.transliteration: mithirnāma mahāvīryo yenāsau mithilābhavat / rājāsau nāma janako janakāccā pyudāvasuḥ
verses.translation: Kftak? aga in AIHTV

verses.sanskrit: उदावसोस्तु धर्मात्मा जातो ऽसौ नन्दिवर्द्धनः । नन्दिवर्धनतः शूरः सुकेतुर्नाम धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: udāvasostu dharmātmā jāto 'sau nandivarddhanaḥ / nandivardhanataḥ śūraḥ suketurnāma dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: The sage of sanctified soul in the state of Soma rose up to the sky. Ten delighted divine ladies (i.e. ten quariers) gathered there together and duly bore that foetus in their wombs. But they were unable to hold it.
verses.wordMeaning: The sage of sanctified soul in the state of Soma rose up to the sky. Ten delighted divine ladies (i.e. ten quariers) gathered there together and duly bore that foetus in their wombs. But they were unable to hold it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage of sanctified soul in the state of Soma rose up to the sky. Ten delighted divine ladies (i.e. ten quariers) gathered there together and duly bore that foetus in their wombs. But they were unable to hold it.

verses.sanskrit: सुकेतोरपि धर्मात्मा देवरातो महाबलः । देवरातस्य धर्मात्मा बृहदुक्थ इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: suketorapi dharmātmā devarāto mahābalaḥ / devarātasya dharmātmā bṛhaduktha iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: The foetus held up by those ten ladies, the ten quar- ters, fell down illuminating the worlds. It was the cool-rayed moon, the sanctifier of all.
verses.wordMeaning: The foetus held up by those ten ladies, the ten quar- ters, fell down illuminating the worlds. It was the cool-rayed moon, the sanctifier of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The foetus held up by those ten ladies, the ten quar- ters, fell down illuminating the worlds. It was the cool-rayed moon, the sanctifier of all.

verses.sanskrit: बृहदुक्थस्य तनयो महावीर्यः प्रतापवान् । महावीर्यस्य धृतिमान् सुधृति स्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: bṛhadukthasya tanayo mahāvīryaḥ pratāpavān / mahāvīryasya dhṛtimān sudhṛti stasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: When the ten ladies were unable to hold that foetus, the moon fell down to the Earth along with them. Seeing him falling down, Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds, placed him in a chariot, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: When the ten ladies were unable to hold that foetus, the moon fell down to the Earth along with them. Seeing him falling down, Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds, placed him in a chariot, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
