verses.sanskrit: सुधृतेरपि धर्मात्मा धृष्टकेतुः परन्तपः । धृष्टकेतुसुतश्चापि हर्यश्वो नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: sudhṛterapi dharmātmā dhṛṣṭaketuḥ parantapaḥ / dhṛṣṭaketusutaścāpi haryaśvo nāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: By means of that prominent chariot, he circumam- bulated the ocean-encircled Earth twentyone times (and became) excessively famous.
verses.hindi: रहं प्रकार के वृक्ष हैं ।६४। ये सभी वृक्ष अनेक जीव-जन्तुओं से समन्वित हैं जो श्रीदेवी के श्रृंगार के कारण हैं। नाना भाँति के वृक्षों के महान् उस्सेध से युक्त है ऐसे श्रेष्ठशाखी हैं ॥६५॥ कांस्यशाल के अन्तराल में सात- योजन दूर चौकोर ताम्र शोल है जो सिन्धु योजन अनुकल है भर्थात् सात.
verses.wordMeaning: By means of that prominent chariot, he circumam- bulated the ocean-encircled Earth twentyone times (and became) excessively famous.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of that prominent chariot, he circumam- bulated the ocean-encircled Earth twentyone times (and became) excessively famous.

verses.sanskrit: हर्यश्वस्य मरुः पुत्रो मरोः पुत्रः प्रतिंबकः । प्रतिंबकस्य धर्मात्मा राजा कीर्त्तिरथः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: haryaśvasya maruḥ putro maroḥ putraḥ pratiṃbakaḥ / pratiṃbakasya dharmātmā rājā kīrttirathaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The increased and developed refulgence (of the moon) that reached the Earth, created the medicinal herbs. The firmament is ablaze with that brilliance. By means of his own Karman as well as through the joy of those gold-complexioned goddesses who sustain the Universe, lord Soma became famous.
verses.hindi: योजन तक पीछे लगा हुआ है ।६६। इन दोनों की भीतर की पृथ्वी है जो कल्पक वाटों बालो कही गयी है वे दूम ऐसे हैं जो ऐसे हैं जो ऐसे फलों चाले हैं जिनमें कपूर की गन्ध है और सुन्दर रत्नों के बोजो से संयुत हैं । उनकी छाल सुनहली है और परम सुन्दर हैं। इन ढको में पीताम्बर दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: The increased and developed refulgence (of the moon) that reached the Earth, created the medicinal herbs. The firmament is ablaze with that brilliance. By means of his own Karman as well as through the joy of those gold-complexioned goddesses who sustain the Universe,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The increased and developed refulgence (of the moon) that reached the Earth, created the medicinal herbs. The firmament is ablaze with that brilliance. By means of his own Karman as well as through the joy of those gold-complexioned goddesses who sustain the Universe,…

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रः कीर्त्तिरथस्यापि देवमीढ इति श्रुतः । देवमीढस्य विबुधो विबुधस्य महाधृतिः
verses.transliteration: putraḥ kīrttirathasyāpi devamīḍha iti śrutaḥ / devamīḍhasya vibudho vibudhasya mahādhṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Then, O excellent Brahmanas, god Brahma, the most excellent one among those who know Brahman, granted him the kingdom of seeds, medicinal herbs, Brahmanas and waters.
verses.hindi: प्रवाल हैं ।६७-६८। अमृत इनका मधुरस है और पुष्प ही विभूषण हैं। इस प्रकार के बहाँ पर बहुत से कल्य वृक्ष कीत्तित किये गये हैं ।६६। यह दूसरी
verses.wordMeaning: Then, O excellent Brahmanas, god Brahma, the most excellent one among those who know Brahman, granted him the kingdom of seeds, medicinal herbs, Brahmanas and waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O excellent Brahmanas, god Brahma, the most excellent one among those who know Brahman, granted him the kingdom of seeds, medicinal herbs, Brahmanas and waters.

verses.sanskrit: महाधृतिसुतो राजा कीर्त्तिरातः प्रतापवान् । कीर्तिरातात्मजो विद्वान् महारोमेति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: mahādhṛtisuto rājā kīrttirātaḥ pratāpavān / kīrtirātātmajo vidvān mahārometi viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: On being crowned the exceedingly brilliant king of kings who was endowed with great refulgence and who was the most excellent one among those who blazed, sanctified the worlds through his great kingdom. Daksa, the son of Pracetas, gave in marriage to the Moon the twentyseven Daksayanis (daughters of Dak§a) of great holy rites, whom they know as the stars.
verses.hindi: कक्षा है। जिसका नाम कल्मवापी है । फिर उस ताम्रशाल के अन्तराल में नाग शाल कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: On being crowned the exceedingly brilliant king of kings who was endowed with great refulgence and who was the most excellent one among those who blazed, sanctified the worlds through his great kingdom. Daksa, the son of Pracetas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being crowned the exceedingly brilliant king of kings who was endowed with great refulgence and who was the most excellent one among those who blazed, sanctified the worlds through his great kingdom. Daksa, the son of Pracetas,…

verses.sanskrit: महारोम्णस्तु विख्यातः स्वर्णरोमा व्यजायत । स्वर्णरोमात्मजश्चापि ह्रस्वरोमाभवन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: mahāromṇastu vikhyātaḥ svarṇaromā vyajāyata / svarṇaromātmajaścāpi hrasvaromābhavannṛpaḥ
verses.translation: After getting that big kingdom, Soma the lord of those who possess Soma (juice), began a Rajasuya sacrifice where a hundred thousand gold coins were distributed as monetary gifts.
verses.wordMeaning: After getting that big kingdom, Soma the lord of those who possess Soma (juice), began a Rajasuya sacrifice where a hundred thousand gold coins were distributed as monetary gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: After getting that big kingdom, Soma the lord of those who possess Soma (juice), began a Rajasuya sacrifice where a hundred thousand gold coins were distributed as monetary gifts.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वरोमान्मजो विद्वान् सरिद्ध्वज इति श्रुतः । उद्भिन्ना कर्षता येन सीता राज्ञा यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: hrasvaromānmajo vidvān sariddhvaja iti śrutaḥ / udbhinnā karṣatā yena sītā rājñā yaśasvinī
verses.translation: Wc have heard, O Brahmanas, that Soma gave three worlds as monetary gifts to Sadasyas (members of the sacrificial assembly) consisting of important Brahmanical sages. Nine goddesses served him viz. SinI, Kuhu,* Vapsu, Pusti, Prabha, Vasu, Kirti, Dhfti and Lakshmi.
verses.wordMeaning: Wc have heard, O Brahmanas, that Soma gave three worlds as monetary gifts to Sadasyas (members of the sacrificial assembly) consisting of important Brahmanical sages. Nine goddesses served him viz. SinI, Kuhu,* Vapsu, Pusti, Prabha, Vasu, Kirti, Dhfti and Lakshmi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wc have heard, O Brahmanas, that Soma gave three worlds as monetary gifts to Sadasyas (members of the sacrificial assembly) consisting of important Brahmanical sages. Nine goddesses served him viz. SinI, Kuhu,* Vapsu, Pusti, Prabha, Vasu, Kirti, Dhfti and Lakshmi.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्य महिधी साध्वी सुव्रता नियतव्रता । वैशंपायन उवाच कथं सीता समुत्पन्न कृष्यमाण यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: rāmasya mahidhī sādhvī suvratā niyatavratā / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca kathaṃ sītā samutpanna kṛṣyamāṇa yaśasvinī
verses.translation: After undergoing the holy valedictory bath called Avabhrtha, the leading Rajan (i.e. the moon) who was devoid of agitation and who was worshipped by the Devas and sages,
verses.wordMeaning: After undergoing the holy valedictory bath called Avabhrtha, the leading Rajan (i.e. the moon) who was devoid of agitation and who was worshipped by the Devas and sages,
verses.commentary: Sense: After undergoing the holy valedictory bath called Avabhrtha, the leading Rajan (i.e. the moon) who was devoid of agitation and who was worshipped by the Devas and sages,

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं वाकृषद्राजा क्षेत्रं यस्मिन् बभूव ह । सूत उवाच अग्निक्षेत्रे कृष्यमाणे अश्वमेधे महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ vākṛṣadrājā kṣetraṃ yasmin babhūva ha / sūta uvāca agnikṣetre kṛṣyamāṇe aśvamedhe mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: When he acquired that luxurious glory which was difficult to get and which was praised by the sages, O Brah- manas, his mind became involved in unrighteousness and hence went astray from the path of moral discipline. He disregarded the sons of Angiras and suddenly abducted the renowned wife of Brhaspati named Tara.
verses.wordMeaning: When he acquired that luxurious glory which was difficult to get and which was praised by the sages, O Brah- manas, his mind became involved in unrighteousness and hence went astray from the path of moral discipline.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When he acquired that luxurious glory which was difficult to get and which was praised by the sages, O Brah- manas, his mind became involved in unrighteousness and hence went astray from the path of moral discipline.…

verses.sanskrit: विधिना सुप्रयत्नेन तस्मात्सा तु समुत्थिता । सीरध्वजानुजातस्तु भानुमान्नाम मैथिलः
verses.transliteration: vidhinā suprayatnena tasmātsā tu samutthitā / sīradhvajānujātastu bhānumānnāma maithilaḥ
verses.translation: Even after being requested by the Devas and divine sages, he never let-off Tara to Brhaspati, the son of Angiras.
verses.wordMeaning: Even after being requested by the Devas and divine sages, he never let-off Tara to Brhaspati, the son of Angiras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after being requested by the Devas and divine sages, he never let-off Tara to Brhaspati, the son of Angiras.

verses.sanskrit: भ्राता कुशध्वजस्तस्य स काश्यधिपतिर्नृपः । तस्य भानुमतः पुत्रः प्रद्युम्नश्च पतापवान्
verses.transliteration: bhrātā kuśadhvajastasya sa kāśyadhipatirnṛpaḥ / tasya bhānumataḥ putraḥ pradyumnaśca patāpavān
verses.translation: There a well-known battle between the Devas and Danavas took place. It was known as Tarakamaya1 2 (concerning Tara). It was destructive of the worlds. The Devas who survived this battle are remembered
verses.wordMeaning: There a well-known battle between the Devas and Danavas took place. It was known as Tarakamaya1 2 (concerning Tara). It was destructive of the worlds. The Devas who survived this battle are remembered
verses.commentary: Sense: There a well-known battle between the Devas and Danavas took place. It was known as Tarakamaya1 2 (concerning Tara). It was destructive of the worlds. The Devas who survived this battle are remembered

verses.sanskrit: मुनिस्तस्य सुतश्चापि तस्मादूर्जवहः स्मृतः । ऊर्जवहात्सनद्वाजः शकुनिस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: munistasya sutaścāpi tasmādūrjavahaḥ smṛtaḥ / ūrjavahātsanadvājaḥ śakunistasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: The first two viz.: Sini and Kuhu are deities presiding over the day preceding the new moon day on which the moon rises with scarcely visible crescent (Sini vail) and the new moon day when the moon Is invisible (KuhQ).
verses.hindi: इन दोनों का एक तियंग् देश है जो सात योजन वाला है । बहाँ पर
verses.wordMeaning: The first two viz.: Sini and Kuhu are deities presiding over the day preceding the new moon day on which the moon rises with scarcely visible crescent (Sini vail) and the new moon day when the moon Is invisible (KuhQ).
verses.commentary: Sense: The first two viz.: Sini and Kuhu are deities presiding over the day preceding the new moon day on which the moon rises with scarcely visible crescent (Sini vail) and the new moon day when the moon Is invisible (KuhQ).

verses.sanskrit: स्वागतः शकुनेः पुत्रः सुवर्चास्तत्सुतः स्मृतः । सुतोपस्तस्य दायादः सुश्रुतस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: svāgataḥ śakuneḥ putraḥ suvarcāstatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ / sutopastasya dāyādaḥ suśrutastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Out of the twelve wars between Devas and Asuras, this was the 5th war. For other wars see Introduction: Vaippavism, last footnote. Then the grandfather (i.e. Brahm&) himself came there and prevented Usanas and Rudra, from fighting. He restored T&ra to Angiras ( Brhaspati).
verses.hindi: एक सन्तानवाटी है जो कल्प वापी के हो सदृश आकृति बाली होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Out of the twelve wars between Devas and Asuras, this was the 5th war. For other wars see Introduction: Vaippavism, last footnote. Then the grandfather (i.e. Brahm&) himself came there and prevented Usanas and Rudra, from fighting. He restored T&ra to Angiras ( Brhaspati).
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of the twelve wars between Devas and Asuras, this was the 5th war. For other wars see Introduction: Vaippavism, last footnote. Then the grandfather (i.e. Brahm&) himself came there and prevented Usanas and Rudra, from fighting. He restored T&ra to Angiras ( Brhaspati).

verses.sanskrit: सुश्रुतस्य जयः पुत्रो जयस्य विजयः सुतः । विजयस्य क्रतुः पुत्र- क्रतोश्च सुनयः स्मतः
verses.transliteration: suśrutasya jayaḥ putro jayasya vijayaḥ sutaḥ / vijayasya kratuḥ putra- kratośca sunayaḥ smataḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Tara, the lady of moon-like face, pregnant, the Brahmana Brhaspati said — "You cast off the foetus immediately.
verses.hindi: उन दोनों के मध्य में यही बतायो गयी है । जिसका नाम हरि चन्दन वाटिका है । यह भी कल्पबाटी के तुल्य हो आकार वाली है और फलों तथा पुष्पों से घिरी हुई है ।७२। इन समस्त शालों मैं पूर्व की ही भाति द्वारों की कल्पना है और पहिलो भाँति हो गोपुरों का और मुकुटों का भी कल्पन है
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Tara, the lady of moon-like face, pregnant, the Brahmana Brhaspati said — "You cast off the foetus immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Tara, the lady of moon-like face, pregnant, the Brahmana Brhaspati said — "You cast off the foetus immediately.

verses.sanskrit: सुनयाद्वीतहव्यस्तु वीतहव्यात्मजो धृतिः । धृतेस्तु बहुलाश्वो ऽभूद्बहुलाश्वसुतः कृतिः
verses.transliteration: sunayādvītahavyastu vītahavyātmajo dhṛtiḥ / dhṛtestu bahulāśvo 'bhūdbahulāśvasutaḥ kṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Your womb belongs to me and therefore no other child should ever be born there". So Tara discharged the child in the womb that was blazing like fire. . The moment he was born that lord assumed the body of the Devas. Therefore the Suras became suspicious and told Tara.
verses.hindi: प्र्येक द्वार में गोपुर द्वार के ही समान संमिति है आरकूट के अन्तराल में सात योजनों की दूरी वाला एक प्राकार और है ।७४। पञ्च लौह से पूर्ण- शाल है जो पूर्व शाल के समान आकार वाला है । उन दोनों के मध्य में जो मही है वह मन्दार द्र मो को वाटिका वाली है।७५ पाचों लौहों के
verses.wordMeaning: Your womb belongs to me and therefore no other child should ever be born there". So Tara discharged the child in the womb that was blazing like fire. . The moment he was born that lord assumed the body of the Devas. Therefore the Suras became suspicious and told Tara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your womb belongs to me and therefore no other child should ever be born there". So Tara discharged the child in the womb that was blazing like fire. . The moment he was born that lord assumed the body of the Devas. Therefore the Suras became suspicious and told Tara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्संतिष्ठते वंशो चनकानां महात्मनाम् । इत्येते मैथिलाः प्रोक्ताः सोमस्यापि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: tasminsaṃtiṣṭhate vaṃśo canakānāṃ mahātmanām / ityete maithilāḥ proktāḥ somasyāpi nibodhata
verses.translation: The daughter of the king (i.e. Ili) gave birth to his son. Therefore Pururavas, the son of Ila, became his son of great splendour.
verses.hindi: अन्तराल में सात योजनों की दूरी वाला चाँदी का शाल है जो पूर्व के ही सदृश लक्षणों तथा आकृति वाला है ऐसा बताया गया है । सुवर्णे का शाल. पूर्व के ही समान ढ्वारों से सुशोभित्र बताया गया है ।७६। उन दोनों के मध्य में जो महो है वह पारिजात के ह.मो को हो वाटिका है । वह परम दिव्य:
verses.wordMeaning: The daughter of the king (i.e. Ili) gave birth to his son. Therefore Pururavas, the son of Ila, became his son of great splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter of the king (i.e. Ili) gave birth to his son. Therefore Pururavas, the son of Ila, became his son of great splendour.

verses.sanskrit: एति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे निमिवंशानुकीर्तनं नाम चतुःषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ६४॥ सूत उवाच पिता सोमस्य वै विप्रा जज्ञे ऽत्रिर्भगवानृषिः । तत्रात्रिः सर्वलोकानां तस्थौ स्वेनौजसा वृतः
verses.transliteration: eti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde nimivaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 64// sūta uvāca pitā somasya vai viprā jajñe 'trirbhagavānṛṣiḥ / tatrātriḥ sarvalokānāṃ tasthau svenaujasā vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The holy spot emerging from the waters regained its original state, O excellent king. This is the capacity of lord Siva which cannot be adequately thought of.
verses.hindi: गन्ध वाली तथा फन पुष्पों से समन्वित है ७७
verses.wordMeaning: The holy spot emerging from the waters regained its original state, O excellent king. This is the capacity of lord Siva which cannot be adequately thought of.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy spot emerging from the waters regained its original state, O excellent king. This is the capacity of lord Siva which cannot be adequately thought of.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा शुभान्येव समाचरन् । काष्ठकुड्यशिलाभूत ऊर्द्ध्वबाहुर्महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā manasā vācā śubhānyeva samācaran / kāṣṭhakuḍyaśilābhūta ūrddhvabāhurmahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: Even today the ocean does not transgress the bound- ary. His great bow was never drawn and kept ready by Rama the great sage.
verses.wordMeaning: Even today the ocean does not transgress the bound- ary. His great bow was never drawn and kept ready by Rama the great sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even today the ocean does not transgress the bound- ary. His great bow was never drawn and kept ready by Rama the great sage.

verses.sanskrit: सुदुश्चरं नाम तपो येन तप्तं महात्पुरा । त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि दिव्यानीति हि नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: suduścaraṃ nāma tapo yena taptaṃ mahātpurā / trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyānīti hi naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of great men viz. Rama, Karttavirya and king Sagara has been well recounted to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योर्द्ध्वरेतसस्तत्र स्थितस्यानिमिषस्य ह । सोमत्वं तनुरापेदे महाबुद्धिः स वै द्विजः
verses.transliteration: tasyorddhvaretasastatra sthitasyānimiṣasya ha / somatvaṃ tanurāpede mahābuddhiḥ sa vai dvijaḥ
verses.translation: "Please narrate the details of the races of kings of unmeasured prowess, their life and their powers and majesty, to us as we ask in the proper order."
verses.wordMeaning: "Please narrate the details of the races of kings of unmeasured prowess, their life and their powers and majesty, to us as we ask in the proper order."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Please narrate the details of the races of kings of unmeasured prowess, their life and their powers and majesty, to us as we ask in the proper order."

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्द्ध्वमाचक्रमे तस्य सोमत्वं भावितात्मनः । नेत्राभ्या मस्रवत्सोमो दशधा द्योतयन् दिशः
verses.transliteration: ūrddhvamācakrame tasya somatvaṃ bhāvitātmanaḥ / netrābhyā masravatsomo daśadhā dyotayan diśaḥ
verses.translation: Jaya and Vijaya were the sons of Kali. They were extremely valorous. Gh;ni and Muni were the sons of Vaidya. They were very powerful.
verses.hindi: आमो दलोलभृ गालीझंका रे: प् रितोदराः
verses.wordMeaning: Jaya and Vijaya were the sons of Kali. They were extremely valorous. Gh;ni and Muni were the sons of Vaidya. They were very powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jaya and Vijaya were the sons of Kali. They were extremely valorous. Gh;ni and Muni were the sons of Vaidya. They were very powerful.

verses.sanskrit: तं गर्भं विधिना हृष्टा दश देव्यो दधुस्तदा । समेत्य धारयामासुर्न च ताः समशक्नुवन्
verses.transliteration: taṃ garbhaṃ vidhinā hṛṣṭā daśa devyo dadhustadā / sametya dhārayāmāsurna ca tāḥ samaśaknuvan
verses.translation: They used to devour girls given in marriage to them or those who loved them. They devoured one another. After devouring one another, they met with destruction.
verses.wordMeaning: They used to devour girls given in marriage to them or those who loved them. They devoured one another. After devouring one another, they met with destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: They used to devour girls given in marriage to them or those who loved them. They devoured one another. After devouring one another, they met with destruction.

verses.sanskrit: स ताभ्यः सहसैवाथ दिग्भ्यो गर्भः प्रसाधितः । पपात भासयंल्लोकाञ्छीतांशुः सर्वभावनः
verses.transliteration: sa tābhyaḥ sahasaivātha digbhyo garbhaḥ prasādhitaḥ / papāta bhāsayaṃllokāñchītāṃśuḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: TamasI and Putana were the wives of Bhadrama (or Putana of dark and foul nature was the wife of Bhadrama). Revati was the wife of Vidhama. The sons of these two were thousands in number.
verses.hindi: रौष्य शाल के अन्तराल गें सात योजनों के विस्तार वाला हेम शाल कह गया है जो पूर्व की हो भांति द्वारों से शोभित है ।७८। उन दोनों के मध्य में भूमि जो थो वह ऐसी बतलायी गयी है कि उसमें कदम्बों के दुमों की वाटिका वनी है । उसमें परम दिव्यनीपों के वृक्ष हैं जो दो योजन ऊँचाई
verses.wordMeaning: TamasI and Putana were the wives of Bhadrama (or Putana of dark and foul nature was the wife of Bhadrama). Revati was the wife of Vidhama. The sons of these two were thousands in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: TamasI and Putana were the wives of Bhadrama (or Putana of dark and foul nature was the wife of Bhadrama). Revati was the wife of Vidhama. The sons of these two were thousands in number.

verses.sanskrit: यदा न धारणे शक्तास्तस्य गर्भस्य ताः स्त्रियः । ततः सहाभिः शीतांशुर्निपपात वसुंधराम्
verses.transliteration: yadā na dhāraṇe śaktāstasya garbhasya tāḥ striyaḥ / tataḥ sahābhiḥ śītāṃśurnipapāta vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: &akuni was the wife of Naka and Ayomukhi the wife of Vighna. Their sons were Raksasas of great vigour and vitality. They used to roam about during the twilight at dusk and dawn.
verses.hindi: बाले हैं ।७६। वे सदा ही मदिरा का स्पन्दन करने वाले हैं और मेदुर प्रसवों से परम उज्ज्वल हैं । जिनसे कादम्बरी नाम वाली योगिनी भोग देने वाली है ।८०। वह विशेषता से युक्त मदिरोद्याना बाटिका मन्त्रिणो देवी की निर- स्वर प्रिया है । वे नोपों की वृक्षावलियाँ छाया वालो तया सुरम्य पत्र और
verses.wordMeaning: &akuni was the wife of Naka and Ayomukhi the wife of Vighna. Their sons were Raksasas of great vigour and vitality. They used to roam about during the twilight at dusk and dawn.
verses.commentary: Sense: &akuni was the wife of Naka and Ayomukhi the wife of Vighna. Their sons were Raksasas of great vigour and vitality. They used to roam about during the twilight at dusk and dawn.

verses.sanskrit: पतन्तं सोममालोक्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । रथमारोपयामास लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: patantaṃ somamālokya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / rathamāropayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: The sons of Revati and Putana are remembered as Nairrtas by name. All those Raksasas are Grahas (Evil demons attacking children and making them suffer from convulsions) particularly in regard to children.
verses.hindi: पल्लवों से समाकुल रहा करती हैं। उसकी सुरम्य सुगस्ध से परम चञ्चल अमरों की झंकार हुआ करती है जिससे उसका मध्य भाग भरा हुआ रहता है ।८१। वहाँ पर ही मन्त्रिणीनायां का एक बहुत मनोहर मन्दिर है । कदम्बो के वन को वाटिका के विदिशाओं में ज्वलनादि से युक्त है ।८२। उस जादि
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Revati and Putana are remembered as Nairrtas by name. All those Raksasas are Grahas (Evil demons attacking children and making them suffer from convulsions) particularly in regard to children.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Revati and Putana are remembered as Nairrtas by name. All those Raksasas are Grahas (Evil demons attacking children and making them suffer from convulsions) particularly in regard to children.

verses.sanskrit: स हि वेदमयो विप्रा धर्मात्मा सत्यसंगरः । युक्ते वाजिसहस्रेण रथे ऽध्यास्तेति नःश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sa hi vedamayo viprā dharmātmā satyasaṃgaraḥ / yukte vājisahasreṇa rathe 'dhyāsteti naḥśrutam
verses.translation: "Indeed, he did not die inside the egg" said Kagyapa fondly but unwittingly. Hence the sun is called Martanda.
verses.wordMeaning: "Indeed, he did not die inside the egg" said Kagyapa fondly but unwittingly. Hence the sun is called Martanda.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Indeed, he did not die inside the egg" said Kagyapa fondly but unwittingly. Hence the sun is called Martanda.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निपतिते देवाः पुत्रे ऽत्रेः परमात्मनः । तुष्टुवुर्ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा मानसाः सप्त विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: tasminnipatite devāḥ putre 'treḥ paramātmanaḥ / tuṣṭuvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ sapta viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: The brilliance and splendour of Vivasvan is always very excessive. It is with that, that the son of Kagyapa scorched the three worlds.
verses.hindi: शिल्पी ने चार परमोच्च मन्दिर बनाये थे। एक-एक के घर का बिस्तार पाँच योजन का या ।८३। पाँच योजनों का उनका आयाम था और समा- वरण से उनकी स्थिति थो । इकी रोति से अन्य विदिशाओं में सभो जगह प्रियक के हुम वहाँ पर ये । यह श्यामादेबी की परम प्रिय निवास की नगरी
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliance and splendour of Vivasvan is always very excessive. It is with that, that the son of Kagyapa scorched the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliance and splendour of Vivasvan is always very excessive. It is with that, that the son of Kagyapa scorched the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैवाङ्गिरसास्तस्य भृगोश्चैवात्मजास्तथा । ऋग्भिर्यजुर्भिर्बहुभिरथर्वाङ्गिरसैरपि
verses.transliteration: tatraivāṅgirasāstasya bhṛgoścaivātmajāstathā / ṛgbhiryajurbhirbahubhiratharvāṅgirasairapi
verses.translation: On seeing that form of unbearable splendour of Vivasvan Samjfia could not brook it. She created her own Chaya (shadow) of the same colour and complexion ( Savaryd) as hers.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that form of unbearable splendour of Vivasvan Samjfia could not brook it. She created her own Chaya (shadow) of the same colour and complexion ( Savaryd) as hers.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that form of unbearable splendour of Vivasvan Samjfia could not brook it. She created her own Chaya (shadow) of the same colour and complexion ( Savaryd) as hers.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संस्तूयमानस्य तेजः सोमस्य भास्वतः । आप्यायमानं लोकांस्त्रीन्भावयामास सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃstūyamānasya tejaḥ somasya bhāsvataḥ / āpyāyamānaṃ lokāṃstrīnbhāvayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: That lady of great fortune, born out of her shadow, joined her palms in great reverence and purity of mind and spoke to Samjfia.
verses.hindi: श्रीदेग्या नित्यसेवा तु मंत्रिण्या न घटिष्यते ।
verses.wordMeaning: That lady of great fortune, born out of her shadow, joined her palms in great reverence and purity of mind and spoke to Samjfia.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lady of great fortune, born out of her shadow, joined her palms in great reverence and purity of mind and spoke to Samjfia.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन रथमुख्येन सागरान्तां वसुंधराम् । त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो ऽतियशाश्चकाराभिप्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: sa tena rathamukhyena sāgarāntāṃ vasuṃdharām / triḥsaptakṛtvo 'tiyaśāścakārābhipradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Samjfia of earthly nature (i.e. the shadow) loved her own sons more than the elder sons.
verses.hindi: श्रीपुरे मन्त्रिणीदेव्या मन्दिरस्य गृणान्ब हुत् । वर्णेयिष्यति को नाम यो द्विजिहवासहस्रवान् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Samjfia of earthly nature (i.e. the shadow) loved her own sons more than the elder sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samjfia of earthly nature (i.e. the shadow) loved her own sons more than the elder sons.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य यद्वर्द्धितं तेजः पृथिवीमन्वपद्यत । ओषध्यस्ताः समुद्भूतास्तेजसा खं ज्वलत्युत
verses.transliteration: tasya yadvarddhitaṃ tejaḥ pṛthivīmanvapadyata / oṣadhyastāḥ samudbhūtāstejasā khaṃ jvalatyuta
verses.translation: The sun then spoke to Samjna (i.e. to Chaya mistaken by him to be Samjfta) "When all the sons are equal to us, how is it that one is loved by you more than the others."
verses.wordMeaning: The sun then spoke to Samjna (i.e. to Chaya mistaken by him to be Samjfta) "When all the sons are equal to us, how is it that one is loved by you more than the others."
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun then spoke to Samjna (i.e. to Chaya mistaken by him to be Samjfta) "When all the sons are equal to us, how is it that one is loved by you more than the others."

verses.sanskrit: ताभिः पुण्यात्ययं लोकान्प्रजाश्चापि चतुर्विधाः । पोष्टा हि भगवान्सोमो जगतो हि द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tābhiḥ puṇyātyayaṃ lokānprajāścāpi caturvidhāḥ / poṣṭā hi bhagavānsomo jagato hi dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Parrying that question, she did not mention the real situation to Vivasvan. Then he entered into meditation himself and found out the truth by means of his yogic power.
verses.wordMeaning: Parrying that question, she did not mention the real situation to Vivasvan. Then he entered into meditation himself and found out the truth by means of his yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Parrying that question, she did not mention the real situation to Vivasvan. Then he entered into meditation himself and found out the truth by means of his yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: स लब्धतेजास्तपसा संस्तवैस्तैः स्वकर्मभिः । तवस्तेपे महाभागः समानां नवतीर्दश
verses.transliteration: sa labdhatejāstapasā saṃstavaistaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ / tavastepe mahābhāgaḥ samānāṃ navatīrdaśa
verses.translation: The lord became angry and wished to curse her with utter annihilation. Then she mentioned all the facts to Vivasvan.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord became angry and wished to curse her with utter annihilation. Then she mentioned all the facts to Vivasvan.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord became angry and wished to curse her with utter annihilation. Then she mentioned all the facts to Vivasvan.

verses.sanskrit: इरण्यवर्णा या देव्यो धारयन्त्यात्मना जगत् । विभुस्तासां मुदा सोमः प्रख्यातःस्वेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: iraṇyavarṇā yā devyo dhārayantyātmanā jagat / vibhustāsāṃ mudā somaḥ prakhyātaḥsvena karmaṇā
verses.translation: He placed him on the (circular moving) wheel (i.e. a lathe) and pruned (the slices of the irregular superfluous part of) his brilliance — when his refulgence was taken away, the sun had his brilliance uprooted (i.e. reduced).
verses.wordMeaning: He placed him on the (circular moving) wheel (i.e. a lathe) and pruned (the slices of the irregular superfluous part of) his brilliance — when his refulgence was taken away, the sun had his brilliance uprooted (i.e. reduced).
verses.commentary: Sense: He placed him on the (circular moving) wheel (i.e. a lathe) and pruned (the slices of the irregular superfluous part of) his brilliance — when his refulgence was taken away, the sun had his brilliance uprooted (i.e. reduced).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मै ददौ राज्यं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः । बीजौषधीनां विप्राणामपां च द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ / bījauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāmapāṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Prabhakara (the sun) of splendid appearance wished to see his wife. By resorting to his yogic power, he saw his wife in the form of a mare.
verses.hindi: सेना के निवास करने की अन्य नगरी भो थी जो महा पदुमाटबी के स्थल में थी और वहां पर ही इसका गृह था जो बहुत योजनों तक दूर था ।५४। श्री देवी की नित्य सेवा मन्तरिनी के द्वारा नहीं होगी । इसीलिए चिन्ता मणि गृह के ही समीप में भी उसेका भवन बनाया या । उस मन्त्रिणीनाथा
verses.wordMeaning: Prabhakara (the sun) of splendid appearance wished to see his wife. By resorting to his yogic power, he saw his wife in the form of a mare.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prabhakara (the sun) of splendid appearance wished to see his wife. By resorting to his yogic power, he saw his wife in the form of a mare.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽभिषिक्तो महातेजा महाराज्येन राजराट् । लोकान्वै भावयामास तेजस्वी तपतां वरः
verses.transliteration: so 'bhiṣikto mahātejā mahārājyena rājarāṭ / lokānvai bhāvayāmāsa tejasvī tapatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: का विश्वकर्मा और मय ने ही भवन का निर्माण कराया था ।८ह। श्री पुर
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशतिरिन्दोस्तु दाक्षायण्यो महाव्रताः । ददौ प्राचेतसो दक्षो नक्षत्राणीति या विदुः
verses.transliteration: saptaviṃśatirindostu dākṣāyaṇyo mahāvratāḥ / dadau prācetaso dakṣo nakṣatrāṇīti yā viduḥ
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: में मन्त्रिणी देवी के जो प्रचुर दुण ये उनका वर्णन ऐसा कौन है जो कर सकता है जिसके दो सहस्र जिहवायें होवें ।८७। कादम्बरी के मद से लाल लोचनों वाली कल वीणा के द्वारा गायन करती हुई वहाँ पर क्रीड़ा किवा करती है जो कि मान्य मातंगों की बालिकाए हैं ।८८। अगस्त्यजी ने कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: स तत्प्राप्य महाद्राज्यं सोमः सोमवतां प्रभुः । समारेभे राजसूयं सहस्रशतदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: sa tatprāpya mahādrājyaṃ somaḥ somavatāṃ prabhuḥ / samārebhe rājasūyaṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: मतंग नाम वाला यह कोन कहा गया है और उसकी कन्या कैसी थीं जो सवंदा ही मधु से मदालसा होकर मन्त्रिणी नाथा की सेवा किया करती हैं। ।६९ श्री हयप्रोव ने कहा--मतंग नाम वाला एक तपों का समूह तपस्वी था और यह महान् प्रभाव से संयुत था । यह जगत का सुजन करने में बहुत
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भश्चोद्गाता ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मत्वमीयिवान् । सदस्यस्तत्र भगवान्हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaścodgātā brahmā brahmatvamīyivān / sadasyastatra bhagavānharirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: ही लम्पट था।६०। तप की जक्ति से इसमें ऐसी बुद्धि हो गयी थी कि स्त्र आज्ञा का यह प्रवत्त'क था । उसका पुत्र मातग हुआ या । इसकी चोर तपस्या से मसर नायिका मुद्रिणी तष्ट हो गयी थी
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैराद्यैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणामददात्सोमस्त्रींल्लोकानिति नः श्रुतम् । तेभ्यो ब्रह्मर्षिमुख्येभ्यः सदस्येभ्यश्च वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāmadadātsomastrīṃllokāniti naḥ śrutam / tebhyo brahmarṣimukhyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyaśca vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: तं सिनी च कुहूश्चैव वपुः पुष्टिः प्रभा वसुः । कीर्त्तिर्धृतिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च नव देव्यः सिषेविरे

verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: दोनों में गुणों की समता मित्रों में हो तो ठीक है यदि किसी में भी अधिक गुण होते हैं तो एक के कारण से दूसरे में भी स्पृहा हो जाया करती है ।६६। गौरो गुरुत्व को शलाघा के लिए प्राप्ति कामना वाले मैंने तप किया था सो है मन्त्रिणीनाये ! अव आप मेरी पुत्री हो जायें ।१००। क्योंकि मेरे
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तत्पापशमनं चकारात्रिर्महायशाः । स राजयक्ष्मणा मुक्तः श्रीया जजवाल सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: tasya tatpāpaśamanaṃ cakārātrirmahāyaśāḥ / sa rājayakṣmaṇā muktaḥ śrīyā jajavāla sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: नाम से आप विख्यात होंगी-इसमें संशय नहीं है । मातंग महामुनि के इस वचन को सुनकर 'ऐसा ही होगा'--यह कहकर वह तिरोहित हो गयी थीं और यू बहुत प्रसन्न थे ।१०१। उस समय में मातग मुनि के स्वप्न के प्रसन्नता से न्नी तंस से एक तापिच्छ की मंजरी प्रदान की थी।
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सोमस्य वै जन्म कीर्त्तितं द्विजसत्तमाः । वंशं तस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठा कीर्त्यमानं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: etatsomasya vai janma kīrttitaṃ dvijasattamāḥ / vaṃśaṃ tasya dvijaśreṣṭhā kīrtyamānaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: ।१०२। उस स्वप्न के प्रभाव से मातंग की सहक्षमिणो ने जिसका नाम सिद्धि मती था गर्म में लघुश्यामा को धारण किया था ।१०३। उसी से जो समु- त्पन्न हुई थी इसी कारण से मातंगी कही गयो है । वह लघुश्यामा भी कही गयी थी क्योंकि उसकी मूलकन्द भू श्यामा यी ।१०४। मातंग की कन्याए
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यमारोग्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं कल्मषशोधनम् । सौम्यस्य चन्म श्रुत्वैवं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: dhanyamārogyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ kalmaṣaśodhanam / saumyasya canma śrutvaivaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: बड़ी सुन्दर थीं तथा करोड़ों थो । लघुश्यामा-महाश्यामा बृन्द संयुत मातंगी अङ्ग शक्तित्व को प्राप्त हुई प्रियक प्रिया की सेवा किया करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Relaxing at the end of the intercourse she had a suspicion that it was another person (not her husband). Hence, she expelled the Semen Virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सोमसौम्ययोर्जन्मकथनं नाम पञ्चषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ६५॥ सूत उवाच सोमस्य तु बुधः पुत्रो बुधस्य तु पुरूरवाः । तेजस्वी दानशीलश्च यज्वा विपुलदक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde somasaumyayorjanmakathanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 65// sūta uvāca somasya tu budhaḥ putro budhasya tu purūravāḥ / tejasvī dānaśīlaśca yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Setting aside her personal prestige, Urva£I, the reput- ed (celestial damsel), chose as her husband that expounder of Brahman who had complete control of his sense organs, was conversant with dharma, and truthful in speech.
verses.hindi: हे कुम्भसम्भव ! यहो मातंग कम्पाओं को उत्पत्ति है लोहादि से निमित सप्त कक्षा शालाए' भी कह दी गयी हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Setting aside her personal prestige, Urva£I, the reput- ed (celestial damsel), chose as her husband that expounder of Brahman who had complete control of his sense organs, was conversant with dharma, and truthful in speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: Setting aside her personal prestige, Urva£I, the reput- ed (celestial damsel), chose as her husband that expounder of Brahman who had complete control of his sense organs, was conversant with dharma, and truthful in speech.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मवादी पराक्रान्तः शत्रुभिर्युधि दुर्जयः । आहर्त्ता जाग्निहोत्रस्य यज्ञानां च महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: brahmavādī parākrāntaḥ śatrubhiryudhi durjayaḥ / āharttā jāgnihotrasya yajñānāṃ ca mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: The king of great vigour accompanied by Urvagi sported with excessive joy in these important parks and forests frequented by the Suras.
verses.wordMeaning: The king of great vigour accompanied by Urvagi sported with excessive joy in these important parks and forests frequented by the Suras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of great vigour accompanied by Urvagi sported with excessive joy in these important parks and forests frequented by the Suras.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवाग्धर्मबुद्धिश्च कान्तः संवृत्तमैथुनः । अतीव त्रिषु लोकेषु रूपेणाप्रतिमो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: satyavāgdharmabuddhiśca kāntaḥ saṃvṛttamaithunaḥ / atīva triṣu lokeṣu rūpeṇāpratimo 'bhavat
verses.translation: Tell us the misdemeanour of the king for whicli the Gandharva divine lady UrvasI left off the king of human birth and came back to heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: Tell us the misdemeanour of the king for whicli the Gandharva divine lady UrvasI left off the king of human birth and came back to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tell us the misdemeanour of the king for whicli the Gandharva divine lady UrvasI left off the king of human birth and came back to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तं ब्रह्मवादिनं दान्तं धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम् । उर्वशी वरयामास हित्वा मानं यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: taṃ brahmavādinaṃ dāntaṃ dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam / urvaśī varayāmāsa hitvā mānaṃ yaśasvinī
verses.translation: Overwhelmed with the curse of a Brahmana (or of Brahma), she came to the world of human beings. For the sake of getting herself released from the curse, she stipulated certain conditions.
verses.wordMeaning: Overwhelmed with the curse of a Brahmana (or of Brahma), she came to the world of human beings. For the sake of getting herself released from the curse, she stipulated certain conditions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Overwhelmed with the curse of a Brahmana (or of Brahma), she came to the world of human beings. For the sake of getting herself released from the curse, she stipulated certain conditions.

verses.sanskrit: तया सहावसद्राजा दश वर्षाणि चाष्ट च । सप्त षट्सप्त चाष्टौ च दश चाष्टौ च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: tayā sahāvasadrājā daśa varṣāṇi cāṣṭa ca / sapta ṣaṭsapta cāṣṭau ca daśa cāṣṭau ca vīryavān
verses.translation: Through the curse of Yuvana$va, Ganga gave birth from half of her part to Kaverl the praise-worthy wife of Jahnu, the most excellent of all rivers.
verses.wordMeaning: Through the curse of Yuvana$va, Ganga gave birth from half of her part to Kaverl the praise-worthy wife of Jahnu, the most excellent of all rivers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through the curse of Yuvana$va, Ganga gave birth from half of her part to Kaverl the praise-worthy wife of Jahnu, the most excellent of all rivers.

verses.sanskrit: वने चैत्ररथे रम्ये तथा मन्दाकिनीतटे । अलकायां विशालायां नन्दने च वनोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: vane caitrarathe ramye tathā mandākinītaṭe / alakāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ nandane ca vanottame
verses.translation: Jahnu begot of Kaverl a beloved son of great virtue named Sunaha. His son was Ajaka.
verses.wordMeaning: Jahnu begot of Kaverl a beloved son of great virtue named Sunaha. His son was Ajaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jahnu begot of Kaverl a beloved son of great virtue named Sunaha. His son was Ajaka.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धमादनपादेषु मेरुशृङ्गे नगोत्तमे । उत्तरांश्च कुरून्प्राप्य कलापग्राममेव च
verses.transliteration: gandhamādanapādeṣu meruśṛṅge nagottame / uttarāṃśca kurūnprāpya kalāpagrāmameva ca
verses.translation: Ajaka's heir Balakasva of great fame, became a habitual hunter. Kusa is remembered as his son.
verses.wordMeaning: Ajaka's heir Balakasva of great fame, became a habitual hunter. Kusa is remembered as his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajaka's heir Balakasva of great fame, became a habitual hunter. Kusa is remembered as his son.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषु वनमुख्येषु सुरैराचरितेषु च । उर्वश्या महितो राजा रेमे परमया मुदा
verses.transliteration: eteṣu vanamukhyeṣu surairācariteṣu ca / urvaśyā mahito rājā reme paramayā mudā
verses.translation: Ku$a had four sons of divine lustre and refulgence viz. Kusamba, Kusa-nabha, Amurtarayasa and Vasu.
verses.wordMeaning: Ku$a had four sons of divine lustre and refulgence viz. Kusamba, Kusa-nabha, Amurtarayasa and Vasu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ku$a had four sons of divine lustre and refulgence viz. Kusamba, Kusa-nabha, Amurtarayasa and Vasu.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः गन्धर्वी चोर्वशी देवी राजानं मानुषं कथम् । उत्सृज्य तं च संप्राप्ता तन्नो ब्रूहि च दुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ gandharvī corvaśī devī rājānaṃ mānuṣaṃ katham / utsṛjya taṃ ca saṃprāptā tanno brūhi ca duṣkṛtam
verses.translation: Kusika (? Kusaniibha) the excellent king performed a penance seeking a son. When a hundred years were complet- ed, Indra noticed him.
verses.wordMeaning: Kusika (? Kusaniibha) the excellent king performed a penance seeking a son. When a hundred years were complet- ed, Indra noticed him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kusika (? Kusaniibha) the excellent king performed a penance seeking a son. When a hundred years were complet- ed, Indra noticed him.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच ब्रह्मशापाभिभूता सा मानुषं समुपस्थिता । आत्मनः शापमोक्षार्थं नियमं सा चकार तु
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca brahmaśāpābhibhūtā sā mānuṣaṃ samupasthitā / ātmanaḥ śāpamokṣārthaṃ niyamaṃ sā cakāra tu
verses.translation: Paurukutsi (daughter ofPurukutsa) became the wife of Gadhi. At first a splendid girl of exalted fortune was born of her known by the name of Satyavatl.1
verses.wordMeaning: Paurukutsi (daughter ofPurukutsa) became the wife of Gadhi. At first a splendid girl of exalted fortune was born of her known by the name of Satyavatl.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Paurukutsi (daughter ofPurukutsa) became the wife of Gadhi. At first a splendid girl of exalted fortune was born of her known by the name of Satyavatl.1

verses.sanskrit: अनग्नदर्शनं चैव अकामात्सह मैथुनम् । द्वौ मेषौ शयनाभ्याशे सा तावद्ध्यवतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration: anagnadarśanaṃ caiva akāmātsaha maithunam / dvau meṣau śayanābhyāśe sā tāvaddhyavatiṣṭhate
verses.translation: This Caru should be eaten by you, O splendid lady and that Caru by your mother. To her will be born a lustrous son. a bull among K$atriyas, who can never be con- quered by Ksatriyas in battle and who will be able to slay even prominent K$atriya warriors. So you also, O lady of
verses.wordMeaning: This Caru should be eaten by you, O splendid lady and that Caru by your mother. To her will be born a lustrous son. a bull among K$atriyas, who can never be con- quered by Ksatriyas in battle and who will be able to slay even prominent K$atriya warriors. So you also, O lady of
verses.commentary: Sense: This Caru should be eaten by you, O splendid lady and that Caru by your mother. verses.sanskrit: घृतमात्रं तथाऽहारः कालमेकं तु पार्थिव । यद्येष समयो राजन्यावत्कालश्च ते दृढः
verses.transliteration: ghṛtamātraṃ tathā'hāraḥ kālamekaṃ tu pārthiva / yadyeṣa samayo rājanyāvatkālaśca te dṛḍhaḥ
verses.translation: Pargiter gives Kuiasva as the name of Kusa's son and Kuiika was. Kusasva's son (AIHT, ).
verses.hindi: श्री अगस्त्यजी ने कहा--लोहादि सात शालाओं के रक्षक भी होंगे ही। है प्राज्ञ ! अब आप उनके नामों को भी वतला दीजिए जिससे मेरे मन में संशय का छेदन हो जावे ।१। श्री हयग्रोव जी ने कहा--हे बुर भ सम्मब ! अनेक प्रकार के वृक्षों के महान उद्यान में समस्त लोकों के भक्षण करने वाला
verses.wordMeaning: Pargiter gives Kuiasva as the name of Kusa's son and Kuiika was. Kusasva's son (AIHT, ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Pargiter gives Kuiasva as the name of Kusa's son and Kuiika was. Kusasva's son (AIHT, ).

verses.sanskrit: तावत्कालं तु वत्स्यामि एष नः समयः कृतः । तस्यास्तं समयं सर्वं स राजा पर्यपालयत्
verses.transliteration: tāvatkālaṃ tu vatsyāmi eṣa naḥ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ / tasyāstaṃ samayaṃ sarvaṃ sa rājā paryapālayat
verses.translation: On being told thus, the sage said "O excellent lady, this has never been thought of by me or by you. This has never
verses.hindi: जिसका श्याम णरीर है वह महाकाल विद्यमान रहा करता है ।२। यह श्याम वर्ण की कञ्चुकी के धारण करने वाला था और मद से उसके लाल नेत्र ये । तथा ब्रह्माण्ड के ध्याले में वह विश्व रसायन का पान किया करता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the sage said "O excellent lady, this has never been thought of by me or by you. This has never
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the sage said "O excellent lady, this has never been thought of by me or by you. This has never

verses.sanskrit: एवं सा चावसत्तेन सहेलेना भिगामिनी । वर्षाण्यथ चतुःषष्टिं तद्भक्त्या शापमोहिता
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sā cāvasattena sahelenā bhigāminī / varṣāṇyatha catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ tadbhaktyā śāpamohitā
verses.translation: Therefore, Satyavati gave birth to Jamadagni, a son of the Bhrgu family, of quiescent nature, having perfect control over his sense-organs and devoted to the performance of penance.
verses.hindi: पात कर रहा था। कततात्मक कल्य के अन्त में वह सिंहासन पर विराज- मान रहा करता है ॥४। यह सदा ललिता देवी के ध्यान में सम्पन्न रहता है और ललितादेवी के पुजन करने में इसकी उत्सुकता रहती है। जो भी ललितादेवी के भक्त हैं उनकी आयु की दीघंता का विस्तार अधिक किया
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, Satyavati gave birth to Jamadagni, a son of the Bhrgu family, of quiescent nature, having perfect control over his sense-organs and devoted to the performance of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, Satyavati gave birth to Jamadagni, a son of the Bhrgu family, of quiescent nature, having perfect control over his sense-organs and devoted to the performance of penance.

verses.sanskrit: उर्वशी मानुषं प्राप्ता गन्धर्वाश्चिन्तयान्विताः । गन्धर्वा ऊचुः चिन्तयध्वं महाभागा यथा सा तु वराङ्गना
verses.transliteration: urvaśī mānuṣaṃ prāptā gandharvāścintayānvitāḥ / gandharvā ūcuḥ cintayadhvaṃ mahābhāgā yathā sā tu varāṅganā
verses.translation: Formerly, there had been an interchange of the Carus belonging to Rudra and Visnu. Since he ate (i.e. since he was born as a result of his mother eating) the fire (Caru) belong- ing to Visnu, lie became Jamadagni
verses.hindi: करता है । कालमृस्यु जिनमें प्रधान है ऐसे अनेक किद्धुरों के द्वारा वह सेवित रहता है ।५। महाकाली ओर महाकाल ये दोनों ही ललितादेवी की आज्ञा के प्रवते हैं ये प्रथम मार्ग में वास करने वाले सम्पूर्ण विश्व को कलित किया करते हैं ।६। उसी मतंग का यह काल चक्र आसनता को प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, there had been an interchange of the Carus belonging to Rudra and Visnu. Since he ate (i.e. since he was born as a result of his mother eating) the fire (Caru) belong- ing to Visnu, lie became Jamadagni
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, there had been an interchange of the Carus belonging to Rudra and Visnu. Since he ate (i.e. since he was born as a result of his mother eating) the fire (Caru) belong- ing to Visnu, lie became Jamadagni

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छेत्तु पुनर्देवानुर्वशी स्वर्गभूषणम् । ततो विश्वापसुर्नाम गन्धर्वः सुमहामतिः
verses.transliteration: āgacchettu punardevānurvaśī svargabhūṣaṇam / tato viśvāpasurnāma gandharvaḥ sumahāmatiḥ
