verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उवोद्धात पादे भार्गवचरिते अमावसुवंशानुकीर्त्तनं नाम षट्षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ६६॥ आयोः पुत्रा महात्मानः पञ्चैवासन्महाबलाः । स्वर्भानुत नयायां ते प्रभायां जज्ञिरे नृपाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya uvoddhāta pāde bhārgavacarite amāvasuvaṃśānukīrttanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 66// āyoḥ putrā mahātmānaḥ pañcaivāsanmahābalāḥ / svarbhānuta nayāyāṃ te prabhāyāṃ jajñire nṛpāḥ
verses.translation: Ayus had five noble-souled sons of great strength. Those kings were born of Prabha, the daughter ofSvarbhanu.
verses.wordMeaning: Ayus had five noble-souled sons of great strength. Those kings were born of Prabha, the daughter ofSvarbhanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ayus had five noble-souled sons of great strength. Those kings were born of Prabha, the daughter ofSvarbhanu.

verses.sanskrit: नहुषः प्रथमस्तेषां क्षत्रवृद्धस्ततः स्मृतः । रंभो रजिरनेनाश्च त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: nahuṣaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ kṣatravṛddhastataḥ smṛtaḥ / raṃbho rajiranenāśca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutāḥ
verses.translation: They were K&sa, Sala and lord Grtsamada. The son of Grtsamada was Sunaka from whom Saunaka was born.
verses.hindi: द्वादशी मधुशुक्ल है मधु शुक्ल त्रयोदशीमें तथा मधुशुबला चतुर्दशी है
verses.wordMeaning: They were K&sa, Sala and lord Grtsamada. The son of Grtsamada was Sunaka from whom Saunaka was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were K&sa, Sala and lord Grtsamada. The son of Grtsamada was Sunaka from whom Saunaka was born.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रवृद्धात्मजश्चैव सुनहोत्रो महायशाः । सुनहोत्रस्य दायादास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: kṣatravṛddhātmajaścaiva sunahotro mahāyaśāḥ / sunahotrasya dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaifyas and Sudras were born in his family, O Brahmanas, on account of their diverse Karmans.
verses.hindi: मक़शुक्ता पोणंमासी और मधुकृषणा प्रथमः है । मंधुकृष्णा द्वितीया ओर तृती या मधुक्रषिणका है ।५३। चतुर्थी मधुकृष्णा और मधुकृष्णा परूचमी। षष्ठी मधुकृष्णा और सप्तमी मधु कृष्ण से है ।५४। मधुकृष्णा अष्टमो मधुकृष्ण से नवमी है । है विध्यद निषूषदन ! दशमी मधुकृष्णा है।४४। मधुकूष्णा
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaifyas and Sudras were born in his family, O Brahmanas, on account of their diverse Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaifyas and Sudras were born in his family, O Brahmanas, on account of their diverse Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: काशः शलश्च द्वावेतौ तथा गृत्समदः प्रभुः । पुत्रो गृत्समदस्यापि शुनको यस्य शौनकः
verses.transliteration: kāśaḥ śalaśca dvāvetau tathā gṛtsamadaḥ prabhuḥ / putro gṛtsamadasyāpi śunako yasya śaunakaḥ
verses.translation: When the second Dvapara arrived, king Dlrgba- tapas, the ruler of Ka£i, a descendant of Sunahotra being desirous of a son, performed a penance.
verses.hindi: एकादशी है तथा दादशी मध,कृष्ण से है । मध् कृष्ण त्रयोदशी से है ओर मध कृष्ण चतुर्दशी है
verses.wordMeaning: When the second Dvapara arrived, king Dlrgba- tapas, the ruler of Ka£i, a descendant of Sunahotra being desirous of a son, performed a penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the second Dvapara arrived, king Dlrgba- tapas, the ruler of Ka£i, a descendant of Sunahotra being desirous of a son, performed a penance.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियाश्चैव वैश्याः शूद्रास्तथैव च । एतस्य वंशेसंभूता विचित्रैः कर्मभिर्द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścaiva vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathaiva ca / etasya vaṃśesaṃbhūtā vicitraiḥ karmabhirdvijāḥ
verses.translation: The king desired to propitiate lord Dhanvantari for the sake of a son. Thereupon, Dhanvantari urged the king to choose a boon as he pleased.
verses.wordMeaning: The king desired to propitiate lord Dhanvantari for the sake of a son. Thereupon, Dhanvantari urged the king to choose a boon as he pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king desired to propitiate lord Dhanvantari for the sake of a son. Thereupon, Dhanvantari urged the king to choose a boon as he pleased.

verses.sanskrit: शलात्मजो ह्यार्ष्टिषेणः शिशिरस्तस्य जात्मजः । शौनकाश्चार्ष्टिषेणाश्च क्षत्रोपेता द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: śalātmajo hyārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ śiśirastasya jātmajaḥ / śaunakāścārṣṭiṣeṇāśca kṣatropetā dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, if you are pleased with. me, be my son,, bestowerof my goal". After saying "So be it", the lord vanished there itself.
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, if you are pleased with. me, be my son,, bestowerof my goal". After saying "So be it", the lord vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, if you are pleased with. me, be my son,, bestowerof my goal". After saying "So be it", the lord vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: काश्यस्य काशिपो राजा पुत्रो दीर्घतपास्तथा । धन्वश्च दीर्घतपसो विद्वान्धन्वन्तरीस्ततः
verses.transliteration: kāśyasya kāśipo rājā putro dīrghatapāstathā / dhanvaśca dīrghatapaso vidvāndhanvantarīstataḥ
verses.translation: The son of Dhanvantari became well known as Ketuman. The son bom to Ketuman became king Bhfmaratha.
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Dhanvantari became well known as Ketuman. The son bom to Ketuman became king Bhfmaratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Dhanvantari became well known as Ketuman. The son bom to Ketuman became king Bhfmaratha.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्ॐऽते महातेजा जातो वृद्धस्य धीमतः । अथैनमृषयः प्रोचुः सूतं वाक्यमिद पुनः
verses.transliteration: tapasoṃ'te mahātejā jāto vṛddhasya dhīmataḥ / athainamṛṣayaḥ procuḥ sūtaṃ vākyamida punaḥ
verses.translation: The son of Bhimaratha became an intelligent lord of the subjects. Well-renowned as Divod&sa,1 he became the lord of Varanasi.
verses.hindi: मधु अमा है--वे तीस शक्तियां हं । इसी प्रकार से माधनारूय के ऊपर में स्थित हैं ।५७। शुक्ल प्रतिपदा आदिक अन्य तीस शक्तियाँ हैं । ये सब मिलकर वासन्त शक्तिर्या साठ विख्यात है ।५८। अपने-अपने मन्त्रों के द्वारा वहा चक्र में वासन्त चक्रराज में बासन्त चक्रराज की सात आवरण
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Bhimaratha became an intelligent lord of the subjects. Well-renowned as Divod&sa,1 he became the lord of Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Bhimaratha became an intelligent lord of the subjects. Well-renowned as Divod&sa,1 he became the lord of Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कश्च धन्वन्तरिर्देवो मानुषेष्विह जज्ञिवान् । एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामस्तन्नोब्रूहि परन्तप
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kaśca dhanvantarirdevo mānuṣeṣviha jajñivān / etadveditumicchāmastannobrūhi parantapa
verses.translation: At this time, a Raksasa named Ksemaka, colonised the city of Var&nasi which had been a desolate and tenantless place.
verses.hindi: भूमियाँ विधि से पूजन करने के योग्य हैं ।५९। साठ कूशियों में ये साठ
verses.wordMeaning: At this time, a Raksasa named Ksemaka, colonised the city of Var&nasi which had been a desolate and tenantless place.
verses.commentary: Sense: At this time, a Raksasa named Ksemaka, colonised the city of Var&nasi which had been a desolate and tenantless place.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच धन्वन्तरेः संभवो ऽयं श्रूयतामिह वै द्विजाः । स संभूतः समुद्रान्ते मथ्यमाने ऽमृते पुरा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca dhanvantareḥ saṃbhavo 'yaṃ śrūyatāmiha vai dvijāḥ / sa saṃbhūtaḥ samudrānte mathyamāne 'mṛte purā
verses.translation: Earlier, the city had been cursed by the noble-souled Nikumbha, again and again — "This city will be void of people and a deserted place for a thousand years".
verses.hindi: करने के योग्य हैं ।६०। उसी भांति से वासन्त चक्र तीन अन्यो में है और
verses.wordMeaning: Earlier, the city had been cursed by the noble-souled Nikumbha, again and again — "This city will be void of people and a deserted place for a thousand years".
verses.commentary: Sense: Earlier, the city had been cursed by the noble-souled Nikumbha, again and again — "This city will be void of people and a deserted place for a thousand years".

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नः कलशात्पूर्वं सर्वतश्च श्रिया वृतः । सद्यःसंसिद्धकार्यं तं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुखस्थितः
verses.transliteration: utpannaḥ kalaśātpūrvaṃ sarvataśca śriyā vṛtaḥ / sadyaḥsaṃsiddhakāryaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇukhasthitaḥ
verses.translation: What for did Nikumbha curse Varanasi formerly? Why did Nikumbha the noble-souled one curse the holy place of the Siddhas?
verses.wordMeaning: What for did Nikumbha curse Varanasi formerly? Why did Nikumbha the noble-souled one curse the holy place of the Siddhas?
verses.commentary: Sense: What for did Nikumbha curse Varanasi formerly? Why did Nikumbha the noble-souled one curse the holy place of the Siddhas?

verses.sanskrit: अब्जस्त्वमिति होवाच तस्मादब्जस्तु स स्मृतः । अब्जः प्रोवाच विष्णुं तं तनयो ऽस्मि तव प्रभो
verses.transliteration: abjastvamiti hovāca tasmādabjastu sa smṛtaḥ / abjaḥ provāca viṣṇuṃ taṃ tanayo 'smi tava prabho
verses.translation: The saintly king Divod&sa lived in that flourishing city after obtaining it. The ruler of men of great brilliance lived there in that prosperous city.
verses.hindi: शुक्र शुच्यादि के भेद से देवता भिन्न हैं ।६१ शक्तियाँ संख्या में साठ हैं जो महोदया ग्रीष्म चक्र में हैं। इसी तरह से वर्षादिक चक्र में भेद से नभन- भस्यज हैं ।६२। ये साठ-साठ शक्तियाँ प्रतिष्ठित हैं । ग्रन्थ के विस्तार से भय से उनकी संख्या करने से विराम लिया जा रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: The saintly king Divod&sa lived in that flourishing city after obtaining it. The ruler of men of great brilliance lived there in that prosperous city.
verses.commentary: Sense: The saintly king Divod&sa lived in that flourishing city after obtaining it. The ruler of men of great brilliance lived there in that prosperous city.

verses.sanskrit: विधत्स्व भागं स्थानं च मम लोके सुरोत्तम । एवमुक्तः स दृष्ट्वा तु तथ्यं प्रोवाच स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: vidhatsva bhāgaṃ sthānaṃ ca mama loke surottama / evamuktaḥ sa dṛṣṭvā tu tathyaṃ provāca sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, theParisadas (attendants) of various kinds of forms, the ascetics began to delight goddess Umi (MaheSvarl) by adopting the forms and guise as mentioned before.
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the lord, theParisadas (attendants) of various kinds of forms, the ascetics began to delight goddess Umi (MaheSvarl) by adopting the forms and guise as mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, theParisadas (attendants) of various kinds of forms, the ascetics began to delight goddess Umi (MaheSvarl) by adopting the forms and guise as mentioned before.

verses.sanskrit: कृतो यज्ञविभागस्तु दैतेयैर्हि सुरैस्तथा । वेदेषु विधियुक्तं च विधिहोत्रं महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: kṛto yajñavibhāgastu daiteyairhi suraistathā / vedeṣu vidhiyuktaṃ ca vidhihotraṃ maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: She said — "Your husband MaheSvara has no manners or good conduct even in my presence. He is always ifidigent in every respect. Alas, he is not ashamed".
verses.wordMeaning: She said — "Your husband MaheSvara has no manners or good conduct even in my presence. He is always ifidigent in every respect. Alas, he is not ashamed".
verses.commentary: Sense: She said — "Your husband MaheSvara has no manners or good conduct even in my presence. He is always ifidigent in every respect. Alas, he is not ashamed".

verses.sanskrit: न सक्यमिह होमं वै तुभ्यं कर्तुं कदायन । अर्वाक्सूतो ऽसि हे देव तव मन्त्रो न वै प्रभो
verses.transliteration: na sakyamiha homaṃ vai tubhyaṃ kartuṃ kadāyana / arvāksūto 'si he deva tava mantro na vai prabho
verses.translation: On being told thus by her mother in so many words, Parvati did not brook it, that being the natural characteristic of women. Smilingly, the goddess who bestowed boons, went near Hara.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by her mother in so many words, Parvati did not brook it, that being the natural characteristic of women. Smilingly, the goddess who bestowed boons, went near Hara.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by her mother in so many words, Parvati did not brook it, that being the natural characteristic of women. Smilingly, the goddess who bestowed boons, went near Hara.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयायां तु संभूत्यां लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यसि । अणिमादियुतां सिद्धिं गतस्तत्र भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: dvitīyāyāṃ tu saṃbhūtyāṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi / aṇimādiyutāṃ siddhiṃ gatastatra bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: With a sorrowful face, the goddess spoke to Mahadeva — "O lord, I will not stay here, Take me to your abode".
verses.hindi: ये शक्तियाँ ललिता देवी के सौख्य के देने बालो है इनका भाहरण करना चाहिए। जो भो ललिता के पूजन ध्यान जप और स्तोत्र में परायण हैं ।६४। कल्पादि थाठिका के चक्र में मदालता ये सङ्चरण किया करती हैं। अपने-अपने पुष्पों के मधष, से ये महेश्वरी का तपंण किया करती हैं ।६५। सब
verses.wordMeaning: With a sorrowful face, the goddess spoke to Mahadeva — "O lord, I will not stay here, Take me to your abode".
verses.commentary: Sense: With a sorrowful face, the goddess spoke to Mahadeva — "O lord, I will not stay here, Take me to your abode".

verses.sanskrit: एतेनैव शरीरेण देवत्वं प्राप्स्यसि प्रभो । चा (च) तुर्मन्त्रैर्घृतैर्गव्यैर्यक्ष्यन्ते त्वां द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: etenaiva śarīreṇa devatvaṃ prāpsyasi prabho / cā (ca) turmantrairghṛtairgavyairyakṣyante tvāṃ dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, Mah&deva examined all the worlds, O excellent Br&hmanas and desired to take up residence on the Earth.
verses.hindi: मिलकर तीन सौ साठ होती हैं। इसी तरह से सात शालो में चक्र देवता पालिका हैं।६६। आपने पूछा है तो आपके सामने नामों का कीर्तन कर विद्या है। अन्य शालाओं का उपादान पूइक है  उनका विस्तार ओर शक्ति कहता हैं, आप अबघारण कीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, Mah&deva examined all the worlds, O excellent Br&hmanas and desired to take up residence on the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, Mah&deva examined all the worlds, O excellent Br&hmanas and desired to take up residence on the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वा त्वं पुनश्चैव ह्यायुर्वेदं विधास्यसि । अवश्यभावीह्यर्थो ऽयं प्राग्दृष्टस्त्वब्जयोनिना
verses.transliteration: atha vā tvaṃ punaścaiva hyāyurvedaṃ vidhāsyasi / avaśyabhāvīhyartho 'yaṃ prāgdṛṣṭastvabjayoninā
verses.translation: "Since, without any fault on my side, my abode has been destroyed by you, O king, your city shall become a deserted wasteland suddenly".
verses.wordMeaning: "Since, without any fault on my side, my abode has been destroyed by you, O king, your city shall become a deserted wasteland suddenly".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since, without any fault on my side, my abode has been destroyed by you, O king, your city shall become a deserted wasteland suddenly".

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं द्वापर प्राप्य भविता त्वं न संशयः । तस्मात्तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा विष्णुरन्तर्दधे ततः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ dvāpara prāpya bhavitā tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / tasmāttasmai varaṃ dattvā viṣṇurantardadhe tataḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, on account of that curse, Varanasi be- came a void then. After cursing the city, Nikumbha brought Mahadeva there.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, on account of that curse, Varanasi be- came a void then. After cursing the city, Nikumbha brought Mahadeva there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, on account of that curse, Varanasi be- came a void then. After cursing the city, Nikumbha brought Mahadeva there.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीये द्वापरे प्राप्ते सौनहोत्रः स काशिराट् । पुत्रकामस्तपस्तेपे नृपो दीर्घतपास्तथा
verses.transliteration: dvitīye dvāpare prāpte saunahotraḥ sa kāśirāṭ / putrakāmastapastepe nṛpo dīrghatapāstathā
verses.translation: Mahadeva of great and noble mind made that deserted vacant city equal to the city of the Devas by means of its wealth and luxury, and made it his abode as well as that of the goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva of great and noble mind made that deserted vacant city equal to the city of the Devas by means of its wealth and luxury, and made it his abode as well as that of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva of great and noble mind made that deserted vacant city equal to the city of the Devas by means of its wealth and luxury, and made it his abode as well as that of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: अब्जं देवं तु पुत्रार्थे ह्यारिराधयिषुर्नृपः । वरेण च्छन्दयामास ततो धन्वन्तरिर्नृपम्
verses.transliteration: abjaṃ devaṃ tu putrārthe hyārirādhayiṣurnṛpaḥ / vareṇa cchandayāmāsa tato dhanvantarirnṛpam
verses.translation: The goddess sported and diverted her mind there itself. She was wonder-struck at the affluence. For the sake of sports and pastime of the goddess, lord Isana spoke these words: —
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess sported and diverted her mind there itself. She was wonder-struck at the affluence. For the sake of sports and pastime of the goddess, lord Isana spoke these words: —
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess sported and diverted her mind there itself. She was wonder-struck at the affluence. For the sake of sports and pastime of the goddess, lord Isana spoke these words: —

verses.sanskrit: नृप उवाच भगवन्यदि तुष्टस्त्वं पुत्रो मे गतिमान्भवेः । तथेति समनुज्ञाय तत्रैवान्तरधात्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nṛpa uvāca bhagavanyadi tuṣṭastvaṃ putro me gatimānbhaveḥ / tatheti samanujñāya tatraivāntaradhātprabhuḥ
verses.translation: "I will not leave off my abode. Indeed my abode is Avimukta ". Laughingly he said to her — "My abode is Avimukta. I will not go elsewhere, O gentle lady, after leaving thus.
verses.hindi: श्री हयग्रीवजी ने कहा--शिल्पियो के द्वारा निमित सप्त शालाओं का लक्षण बता दिया गया है । इसके अनन्तर रत्नों से परिपूर्ण शालायें अब कीत्तित को जाती है उनका आप अवधारण कीजिए ।१। सुवर्ण से परिपूर्ण शाल और पुष्प रोगों से परिपूर्ण शाल का जो मध्य में अन्तर है वह सात
verses.wordMeaning: "I will not leave off my abode. Indeed my abode is Avimukta ". Laughingly he said to her — "My abode is Avimukta. I will not go elsewhere, O gentle lady, after leaving thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I will not leave off my abode. Indeed my abode is Avimukta ". Laughingly he said to her — "My abode is Avimukta. I will not go elsewhere, O gentle lady, after leaving thus.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य गेहे समुत्पन्नो देवो धन्वन्तरिस्तदा । काशिराजो महाराजः सर्व रोगप्रणाशनः
verses.transliteration: tasya gehe samutpanno devo dhanvantaristadā / kāśirājo mahārājaḥ sarva rogapraṇāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Sport along with me in this holy spot, O resplendent lady who has no one superior to you". Hence that (holy place) was called Avimukta by the lord himself.
verses.hindi: योजन मात्र कहा गया है ।२। वहाँ पर सिद्ध और मद से विह्वल सिद्धों की नारियाँ सेला करती हैं। उनकी कीड़ा के साधन रस-रसायन-खड्ग और पादाजुजन होते हैं।३। ये ललिता देवी में भक्ति से युक्त हैं और महाजनों का तर्पण किया करती हैं । वहाँ पर अनेक प्रकार के वास करते हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: Sport along with me in this holy spot, O resplendent lady who has no one superior to you". Hence that (holy place) was called Avimukta by the lord himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sport along with me in this holy spot, O resplendent lady who has no one superior to you". Hence that (holy place) was called Avimukta by the lord himself.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्वेदं भरद्वाजात्प्राप्येह सभिषक्क्रियम् । तमष्टधा पुनर्व्यस्य शिष्येभ्यः प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: āyurvedaṃ bharadvājātprāpyeha sabhiṣakkriyam / tamaṣṭadhā punarvyasya śiṣyebhyaḥ pratyapādayat
verses.translation: King Divodasa colonized it after killing a hundred sons of Bhadrasena, who were excellent wielders of bows.
verses.hindi: मदिरारस का पान किया करते हैं ।३। पुष्पराज आदि की जो शालाएं हैं उनके दरारों की रचनाएं पूर की ही भाति हैं । पुष्प राग प्रभृति की शालो में कपाट अगला और गोपुर हैं। यह सभी पुष्य राग आदि से समुत्पन्न है तथा इन्दु और सूर्य के समान ही परम भास्वर हैं ।४। हेम के प्राकार वाले
verses.wordMeaning: King Divodasa colonized it after killing a hundred sons of Bhadrasena, who were excellent wielders of bows.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Divodasa colonized it after killing a hundred sons of Bhadrasena, who were excellent wielders of bows.

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तरिसुतश्चापि केतुमानिति विश्रुतः । अथ केतुमतः पुत्रो जज्ञे भीमरथो नृपः
verses.transliteration: dhanvantarisutaścāpi ketumāniti viśrutaḥ / atha ketumataḥ putro jajñe bhīmaratho nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Pratardana had two sons, Vatsa and Garga who be- came very famous. Alarka was the son of Vatsa anfl Sannati was his son.
verses.hindi: चक्र का और पुष्परागों से परिपूर्ण का जो अन्तर है उसमें जो स्थल है बह भी पुष्परागो से परिपूर्ण है ऐसा ही कहा गया है ।६। आगे कहे जाने वाली महा णालाओं की कक्षाओं में समस्तों में भी उनके ही बर्ण वाले सब पक्षी हैं और उनके ही वर्णों वाले सब सरोवर हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Pratardana had two sons, Vatsa and Garga who be- came very famous. Alarka was the son of Vatsa anfl Sannati was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pratardana had two sons, Vatsa and Garga who be- came very famous. Alarka was the son of Vatsa anfl Sannati was his son.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रो भीमरथस्यापि जातो धीमान्प्रजेश्वरः । दिवोदास इति ख्यातो वाराणस्यधिपो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: putro bhīmarathasyāpi jāto dhīmānprajeśvaraḥ / divodāsa iti khyāto vārāṇasyadhipo 'bhavat
verses.translation: At the end of the period of curse, the king of powerful and great arms killed the demon Ksemaka and got rehabilitated the city of Varanasi.
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the period of curse, the king of powerful and great arms killed the demon Ksemaka and got rehabilitated the city of Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the period of curse, the king of powerful and great arms killed the demon Ksemaka and got rehabilitated the city of Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु पुरीं वारामसीं पुरा । शून्यां निवेशयामास क्षेमको नाम राक्षसः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu purīṃ vārāmasīṃ purā / śūnyāṃ niveśayāmāsa kṣemako nāma rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: Recorded as Bhatga in AIHT, The line is shown to have dosed there, but our text records GargabhOmi as the son of G&rgya (W. 78-79).
verses.wordMeaning: Recorded as Bhatga in AIHT, The line is shown to have dosed there, but our text records GargabhOmi as the son of G&rgya (W. 78-79).
verses.commentary: Sense: Recorded as Bhatga in AIHT, The line is shown to have dosed there, but our text records GargabhOmi as the son of G&rgya (W. 78-79).

verses.sanskrit: शप्ता हि सा पुरी पूर्वं निकुंभेन महात्मना । शून्या वर्षसहस्रं वै भवित्रीति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: śaptā hi sā purī pūrvaṃ nikuṃbhena mahātmanā / śūnyā varṣasahasraṃ vai bhavitrīti punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: The heroic Raji had five hundred sons. This group of Ksatriyas is well known as Rajeya on the Earth. Indra was afraid of them.
verses.wordMeaning: The heroic Raji had five hundred sons. This group of Ksatriyas is well known as Rajeya on the Earth. Indra was afraid of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Raji had five hundred sons. This group of Ksatriyas is well known as Rajeya on the Earth. Indra was afraid of them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां तु शप्तमात्रायां दिवोदासः प्रजेश्वरः । विषयान्ते पुरीं रम्यां गोमत्यां संन्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ tu śaptamātrāyāṃ divodāsaḥ prajeśvaraḥ / viṣayānte purīṃ ramyāṃ gomatyāṃ saṃnyaveśayat
verses.translation: At that time a very terrible battle between the Devas and the Asuras took place, when the Devas and the Asuras asked Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: At that time a very terrible battle between the Devas and the Asuras took place, when the Devas and the Asuras asked Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time a very terrible battle between the Devas and the Asuras took place, when the Devas and the Asuras asked Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः वाराणसीं किमर्थं तां निकुंभः शप्तवान्पुरा । निकुंभश्चापि धर्मात्मा सिद्धक्षेत्रं शशाप यः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vārāṇasīṃ kimarthaṃ tāṃ nikuṃbhaḥ śaptavānpurā / nikuṃbhaścāpi dharmātmā siddhakṣetraṃ śaśāpa yaḥ
verses.translation: "Who will be victorious, O holy lord in the battle between us? Tell us, O lord of all worlds. We wish to hear.*'
verses.wordMeaning: "Who will be victorious, O holy lord in the battle between us? Tell us, O lord of all worlds. We wish to hear.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who will be victorious, O holy lord in the battle between us? Tell us, O lord of all worlds. We wish to hear.*'

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच दिवोदासस्तु राजर्षिर्नगरीं प्राप्य पार्थिवः । वसते स महातेजाः स्फीतायां वै नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca divodāsastu rājarṣirnagarīṃ prāpya pārthivaḥ / vasate sa mahātejāḥ sphītāyāṃ vai narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: "There is no doubt that those, on whose behalf Lord Raji will take up his arms and fight, will conquer the three worlds.1
verses.wordMeaning: "There is no doubt that those, on whose behalf Lord Raji will take up his arms and fight, will conquer the three worlds.1
verses.commentary: Sense: "There is no doubt that those, on whose behalf Lord Raji will take up his arms and fight, will conquer the three worlds.1

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कृतदारो महेश्वरः । देव्याः स प्रियकामस्तु वसन्वै श्वशुरान्तिके
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu kṛtadāro maheśvaraḥ / devyāḥ sa priyakāmastu vasanvai śvaśurāntike
verses.translation: "I shall defeat, O Daityas, the Devas with Indra at their head I shall become Indra with a virtuous soul. Therefore, I shall fight in the battle-field.
verses.hindi: वहाँ की समस्त नदियाँ भी उसो के वर्ण वाली हैं तथा मणियों के वृक्ष भी उसी वरणो वाले हैं। अनेक प्रकार के कमों से जो सिद्ध जातियों में देवी की उपासना करने वाले ये पूर्व शरीर को त्याग कर अङ्नाओं के साथ ही ये ।=। वे सभी ललितादेवी के मन्त्र का. जाप करने वाले ओर
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall defeat, O Daityas, the Devas with Indra at their head I shall become Indra with a virtuous soul. Therefore, I shall fight in the battle-field.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall defeat, O Daityas, the Devas with Indra at their head I shall become Indra with a virtuous soul. Therefore, I shall fight in the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: देवाज्ञया पारिषदा विश्वरुपास्तपोधनाः । पूर्वोक्तरूपसंवेषैस्तोषयन्ति महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: devājñayā pāriṣadā viśvarupāstapodhanāḥ / pūrvoktarūpasaṃveṣaistoṣayanti maheśvarīm
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: ललिता के ही क्रम में परायण थे । वे सभी ललितादेवी के नाम का कीर्तन करने वाले ही ये ।६। पुष्प राग के महाशाल के अन्तर में मारुत योजन में पदुमरागमय एक शाल है जो सभी ओर से चौकोर है।१०। वहाँ की जो स्यली है वह भी पद्मरागों से संुत है और गोपुर आदि भी उसी पदुमराग
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: हृष्यते तैर्महादेवो मेना नैव तु तुष्यति । जुगुप्सते सा नित्यं वै देवं देवीं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: hṛṣyate tairmahādevo menā naiva tu tuṣyati / jugupsate sā nityaṃ vai devaṃ devīṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: से परिपूर्ण है । वहा पर चारण देश में संस्थित होने वाले अपने देह के विनाश हो जाने से सिद्धि को प्राप्त हो गये हैं क्योंकि वे सभी महाराज्ञी के चरण कमलों के सेवक वे ।११। चारणों की स्त्रियाँ भो परम सुन्दर अङ्गो
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: मम पार्श्वे त्वनाचारस्तव भर्त्ता महेश्वरः । दरिद्रः सर्वथैवेह हा कष्टं लज्जते न वै
verses.transliteration: mama pārśve tvanācārastava bharttā maheśvaraḥ / daridraḥ sarvathaiveha hā kaṣṭaṃ lajjate na vai
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: मात्रा तथोक्ता वचसा स्त्रीस्वभावान्न चक्षमे । स्मितं कृत्वा तु वरदा हरपार्श्वमथागमत्
verses.transliteration: mātrā tathoktā vacasā strīsvabhāvānna cakṣame / smitaṃ kṛtvā tu varadā harapārśvamathāgamat
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: वालो हैं ओर मद से असस । वे सभी ललितादेवी के भरीत बन्धों को बार-बार गाया करती हैं ।६२। वहीं पर कल्प वृक्षों के मध्य में जो वेदिकाए चों उनमें संस्थित होकर अपने भर्त्ताओं के साथ सहचरण करती हुए मधर मध्, का पान किया करती हैं ।१३। पद्मरागो के महाशाल के मध्य में
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: विषण्णवदना देवी महादेवमभाषत । नेह वत्स्याम्यहं देव नय मां स्वं निवेशनम्
verses.transliteration: viṣaṇṇavadanā devī mahādevamabhāṣata / neha vatsyāmyahaṃ deva naya māṃ svaṃ niveśanam
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: मास्त योजन में गोमेद कौ महाशाल है ओर उसका आकार प्रकार भी के पूव के ही समान है। अत्यन्त ऊँचा हीरो का पाल है और उन दोनों के मध्य में ही रकों की ही भूमि भी है
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: तथोक्तस्तु महादेवः सर्वांल्लोकान्निरीक्ष्य ह । वासार्थं रोचयामास पृथिव्यां तु द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tathoktastu mahādevaḥ sarvāṃllokānnirīkṣya ha / vāsārthaṃ rocayāmāsa pṛthivyāṃ tu dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणसीं महातेजाः सिद्धक्षेत्रं महेश्वरः । दिवोदासेन तां ज्ञात्वा निविष्टां नगरीं भवः
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasīṃ mahātejāḥ siddhakṣetraṃ maheśvaraḥ / divodāsena tāṃ jñātvā niviṣṭāṃ nagarīṃ bhavaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: पार्श्वस्थं स समाहूय गणेशं क्षेममब्रवीत् । गणेश्वर पुरीं गत्वा शून्यां वाराणसीं कुरु
verses.transliteration: pārśvasthaṃ sa samāhūya gaṇeśaṃ kṣemamabravīt / gaṇeśvara purīṃ gatvā śūnyāṃ vārāṇasīṃ kuru
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: मृदुना चाभ्युपायेन अतिवीर्यः स पार्थिवः । ततो गत्वा निकुंभस्तु पुरीं वाराणसीं पुरा
verses.transliteration: mṛdunā cābhyupāyena ativīryaḥ sa pārthivaḥ / tato gatvā nikuṃbhastu purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ purā
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्ने संदर्शयामास मङ्कनं नामतो द्विजम् । श्रेयस्ते ऽहं करिष्यामि स्थानं मे रोचयानघ
verses.transliteration: svapne saṃdarśayāmāsa maṅkanaṃ nāmato dvijam / śreyaste 'haṃ kariṣyāmi sthānaṃ me rocayānagha
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: मद्रूपां प्रतिमां कृत्वा नगर्यन्ते निवेशय । तथा स्वप्ने यथा दृष्टं सर्वं कारितवान्द्विजः
verses.transliteration: madrūpāṃ pratimāṃ kṛtvā nagaryante niveśaya / tathā svapne yathā dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kāritavāndvijaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: नगरीद्वार्यनुज्ञाप्य राजानं तु यथाविधि । पूजा तुमहती चैव नित्यमेव प्रयुज्यते
verses.transliteration: nagarīdvāryanujñāpya rājānaṃ tu yathāvidhi / pūjā tumahatī caiva nityameva prayujyate
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: उवंशी मेनका चेब रम्भा चालंबुषा तथा
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धैर्धूपैश्च वाल्यैश्च प्रेक्षणीयेस्तथैव च । अन्नप्रदानयुक्तैश्च ह्यत्यद्भुतमिवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: gandhairdhūpaiśca vālyaiśca prekṣaṇīyestathaiva ca / annapradānayuktaiśca hyatyadbhutamivābhavat
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपूज्यते तत्र नित्यमेव गणेश्वरः । ततो वरसहस्राणि नागराणां प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjyate tatra nityameva gaṇeśvaraḥ / tato varasahasrāṇi nāgarāṇāṃ prayacchati
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्हिरण्यमायूंषि सर्वकामांस्तथैव च । राज्ञस्तु महिषी श्रेष्टा सुयशा नाम विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: putrānhiraṇyamāyūṃṣi sarvakāmāṃstathaiva ca / rājñastu mahiṣī śreṣṭā suyaśā nāma viśrutā
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थमागता साध्वी राज्ञा देवी प्रचोदिता । पूजां तु विपुलां कृत्वा देवी पुत्रानयाचत
verses.transliteration: putrārthamāgatā sādhvī rājñā devī pracoditā / pūjāṃ tu vipulāṃ kṛtvā devī putrānayācata
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: हे कुम्भज ! वहाँ पर देवी की भली भांति अचना करके परम शरेष्ठ गन्धो का समूह अप्स राओ के संभुंदायों के ही साथ यें निवास किया करते हैं।१४। वे सज वल्लकी नाच के शब्दों से महाराज्ञी के गुणगणों का गायन किया करते हैं। ये काम भोग में बड़े रसिक हैं तथा कामदेव के ही समान
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पुनरथागत्य बहुशः पुत्रकारणात् । न प्रयच्छति पुत्रांस्तु निकुंभः कारणेन तु
verses.transliteration: punaḥ punarathāgatya bahuśaḥ putrakāraṇāt / na prayacchati putrāṃstu nikuṃbhaḥ kāraṇena tu
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: क्रुध्यते यदि राजा तु तत किञ्चित्प्रवर्त्तते । अथ दीर्घेण कालेन क्रोधो राजानमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: krudhyate yadi rājā tu tata kiñcitpravarttate / atha dīrgheṇa kālena krodho rājānamāviśat
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: शरीरों वाले परमाधिक सुन्दर हैं। ये श्री देवी की भक्ति करने बाले हैं और इनकी प्रक्रतियां भी परम सुकुमार होतो है ।१६। गोमेदों का जो शाल है बह भी पहिले शाल के ही सदृश आकार वाला है । उसके मध्य में करोड़ों योगिनियाँ ओर भेरबों को भ्र णियां विद्यमान हैं वहां पर वे भक्तिभाव से
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: भूतं त्विदं मंहद्द्वारि नागराणां प्रयच्छति । प्रीत्या वरांश्च शतशो न किञ्चिन्नः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ tvidaṃ maṃhaddvāri nāgarāṇāṃ prayacchati / prītyā varāṃśca śataśo na kiñcinnaḥ prayacchati
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: काल संकषिणी अम्बा की सेदा किया करते हैं ।१७। गोमेदक थाल के मध्य में बहुत सी. प्रमुद्ध परम सुन्दरी अध्सराए' रहा करती हैं जो कि मारत योजन में है । उर्वेशी--नेनका--रम्मा-अलम्बुषा--मन्जुघोषा--सुकेशी-- पूवंचित्ति--पृताचिका--विश्‍वाची और पुडिजका स्थला--ये समी बहीं पर
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: मामकैः पूज्यते नित्यं नगर्यां मम चैव तु । स याचितश्च बहुशो देव्या मे पुत्रकारणात्
verses.transliteration: māmakaiḥ pūjyate nityaṃ nagaryāṃ mama caiva tu / sa yācitaśca bahuśo devyā me putrakāraṇāt
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: रहती हैं ।१८-१९। देवों की वेश्या तिलोत्तमा भी है और ऐसी अनेक दूसरी भी हैं। वे सब गर्धर्वो के साथ में रहकर कल्प वृक्षों के मधुओं का. पान किया करती है ।२०। तया ललिता देवी का ध्यान बार-बार करती है । सोभाग्य की वृद्धि के लिए ही उस देवी के मन्त्र का गुणन किया करती
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: न ददाति च पुत्रं मे कृतघ्नो बहुभोजनः । अतो नार्हति पूजा तु मत्सकाशात्कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: na dadāti ca putraṃ me kṛtaghno bahubhojanaḥ / ato nārhati pūjā tu matsakāśātkathañcana
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तु नाशयिष्यामितस्य स्थानं दुरात्मनः । एवं तु स विनिश्चित्य दुरात्मा राजकिल्बिषी
verses.transliteration: tasmāttu nāśayiṣyāmitasya sthānaṃ durātmanaḥ / evaṃ tu sa viniścitya durātmā rājakilbiṣī
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानं गणपतेश्तस्य नाशयामास दुर्मतिः । भग्नमायतनं दृष्ट्वा राजानमशपत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sthānaṃ gaṇapateśtasya nāśayāmāsa durmatiḥ / bhagnamāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānamaśapatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो हृदयं कामो मृत्युरु्वी च मारत: । तपनस्य कराश्रन्द्रकरो वेदाश्च पावकः
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्विनापराधं मे त्वया स्थानं विनाशितम् । अकस्मात्तु पुरी शून्या भवित्रीते नराधिप
verses.transliteration: yasmādvināparādhaṃ me tvayā sthānaṃ vināśitam / akasmāttu purī śūnyā bhavitrīte narādhipa
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेन तु शापेन शून्या वाराणसी तदा । शप्त्वा पुरीं निकुंभस्तु महादेवमथानयत्
verses.transliteration: tatastena tu śāpena śūnyā vārāṇasī tadā / śaptvā purīṃ nikuṃbhastu mahādevamathānayat
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: शून्यां पुरीं महा देवो निर्ममे पदमात्मनः । तुल्यां देवविभूत्या तु देव्याश्चैव महामनाः
verses.transliteration: śūnyāṃ purīṃ mahā devo nirmame padamātmanaḥ / tulyāṃ devavibhūtyā tu devyāścaiva mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: चौदह स्थानों में समस्त अप्सराए समुत्पन्न हुई हैं । वहीं पर परमा- मन्द से सुसम्पन्न होकर देवी का अचेन करती हुई निवास किया करतो हैं ।२२। अगस्त्यजी ने कहा--हे विभो ! आप तो समस्त विद्याओं के निधि हैं। है महाप्राज्ञ ! बन अप्सराओं के चोदहों जन्मों का आप वर्णन कीजिए
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: रमते तत्र वै देवी ह्यैश्वर्यात्सा तु विस्मिता । देव्या क्रीडार्थमीशानो देवो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ramate tatra vai devī hyaiśvaryātsā tu vismitā / devyā krīḍārthamīśāno devo vākyamathābravīt
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: ।२३। श्री हयग्रीव ने कहा--ब्ाहाग--हृदय--काम--मृत्यु--उर्वी--मारुत- तपन के कर--चम्द्रक्र--वेद--पावक--सौदामिनी--पीयूष--दक्ष कन्या- जल-ये ही मनीषो गण जन्म के कारण माना करते हैं।२४-२४। स्फुरित सौभाग्य की सम्पदा वाली देवगणों में मुख्यों की नारियों की ये समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं वेश्म विमोक्ष्यामि ह्यविमुक्तं हि मे गृहम् । प्रहस्यैनामथोवाच ह्यविमुक्तं हि मे गृहम् । नाहं देवि गमिष्यामि त्वन्यत्रेदं विहाय वै
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ veśma vimokṣyāmi hyavimuktaṃ hi me gṛham / prahasyaināmathovāca hyavimuktaṃ hi me gṛham / nāhaṃ devi gamiṣyāmi tvanyatredaṃ vihāya vai
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: गन्धो के ही साथ में चक्रिणों को अचना किया करती हैं ।२६। है मुने  अपनी नारियों के साय किन्नर तया किम्पुरुष अपनी स्त्रियों के सहित मद
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: मया सह रमस्वेह क्षेत्रे भामिन्यनुत्तमे । तस्मात्तदविमुक्तं हि प्रोक्तं देवेन वै स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: mayā saha ramasveha kṣetre bhāminyanuttame / tasmāttadavimuktaṃ hi proktaṃ devena vai svayam
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वाराणसी शप्ता ह्यविमुक्तं च कीर्त्तिता । यस्मिन्वसेद्भवो देवः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः

verses.sanskrit: युगेषु त्रिषु धर्मात्मा सह देव्या महेश्वरः । अन्तर्द्धानं कलौ याति तत्पुरं तु महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yugeṣu triṣu dharmātmā saha devyā maheśvaraḥ / antarddhānaṃ kalau yāti tatpuraṃ tu mahātmanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हिते पुरे तस्मिन्पुरी सा वसते पुनः । एवं वाराणसी शप्ता निवेशं पुनरागता
verses.transliteration: antarhite pure tasminpurī sā vasate punaḥ / evaṃ vārāṇasī śaptā niveśaṃ punarāgatā
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: तञ्जवलादुदिता देवी वज्ञ दत्त्वा बलट्विषे । पुनरंतदंधे सोऽपि कृतार्थः स्वगेमेथिवान्

verses.sanskrit: भद्रसेनस्य पुत्राणां शतमुत्तमधन्विनाम् । हत्वा निवेशयामास दिवोदासो नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: bhadrasenasya putrāṇāṃ śatamuttamadhanvinām / hatvā niveśayāmāsa divodāso narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रसेनस्य राज्यं तु हतं तेन बलीयसा । भद्रसेनस्य पुत्रस्तु दुर्मदो नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: bhadrasenasya rājyaṃ tu hataṃ tena balīyasā / bhadrasenasya putrastu durmado nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: दिवोदासेन बालेति घृणया स विसर्जितः । दिवोदासाद्दृषद्वत्यां वीरो जज्ञे प्रतर्द्दनः
verses.transliteration: divodāsena bāleti ghṛṇayā sa visarjitaḥ / divodāsāddṛṣadvatyāṃ vīro jajñe pratarddanaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: हे मुने ! वहीं पर हीरों की भूमि में एक वज्ज नाम बाली नदी हैं। उसके तट पर जो दरम हैं वे वज्ाकार हैं। उनसे वह निविडित है ऐसी ही भासमान होती है ।२९। वह नदी परम पावनी सदा ही बहती रहती है और सभी ओर उसका बहाव रहता है। उसका जल ही ऐसा प्रतीत होता है कि
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: तेन पुत्रेण बालेन प्रहृतं तस्य वै पुनः । वैरस्यान्त महाराज तदा तेन विधित्सता
verses.transliteration: tena putreṇa bālena prahṛtaṃ tasya vai punaḥ / vairasyānta mahārāja tadā tena vidhitsatā
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: बच्चों से परिपूर्ण है तथा उसकी सिकत्ता भी व्च (हीरा) रत्नों का ही मुख्य भाग है।३०। परमेशानी ललिता के जो मानव परम भक्त हैं वे ही उस नदी कै जल का पान करके यञ्च स्वरूप कसेवरों वाले हो जाया करते हैं। वे दोघं आयु वासे नीरोग है कलशोद्भव ! हुआ करते हैं ।३१। भण्डा:
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतर्दनस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ वत्सो गर्गश्च विश्रुतौ । वत्सपुत्रो ह्यलर्कस्तु सन्नतिस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: pratardanasya putrau dvau vatso gargaśca viśrutau / vatsaputro hyalarkastu sannatistasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: सुर के द्वारा गलित और बज्ध के मुक्त होने पर इन्द्रदेव ने बज्र शी के चरणों में भक्ति भाव से उस नदी के तट पर तपश्चर्या की थी ।३२। उसके जल से समुदित हुई देवी ने इनके लिए वज् दिया था । फिर वह अस्तहित हो गयी थीं और वह इन्द्र भो कृतायं होकर स्वर्ग को चला गया था।३३। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: अलर्कं प्रति राजर्षिं श्रोक्ॐ गीतः पुरातनैः । षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि षष्टिवर्षशतानि च
verses.transliteration: alarkaṃ prati rājarṣiṃ śrokoṃ gītaḥ purātanaiḥ / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: अनन्तर वज्याख्य शाल के अन्तर में मारत. योजन में ठीक बहुत ऊँचा वेदर्य शाल है और उसका भी गोपुर तथा द्वार पूर्व के हो समान है। वहाँ की स्थली भी वेदूयों से निमित है और उसकी आकृति परम भास्वर है
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: युवा रूपेण संपन्नो ह्यलर्कः काशिसत्तमः । लोपामुद्राप्रसादेन परमायुरवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: yuvā rūpeṇa saṃpanno hyalarkaḥ kāśisattamaḥ / lopāmudrāprasādena paramāyuravāptavān

verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: शापस्यान्ते महाबाहुर्हत्वा क्षेमकराक्षसम् । रम्यामावासयामास पुरीं वाराणसीं नृपः
verses.transliteration: śāpasyānte mahābāhurhatvā kṣemakarākṣasam / ramyāmāvāsayāmāsa purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: सन्नतेरपि दायादः सुनीथो नाम धार्मिकः । सुनीथस्य तु दायादः क्षैमाख्यो नाम धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: sannaterapi dāyādaḥ sunītho nāma dhārmikaḥ / sunīthasya tu dāyādaḥ kṣaimākhyo nāma dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.transliteration: kṣemasya ketumānputraḥ suketustasya cātmajaḥ / suketutanayaścāpi dharmaketuriti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मकेतोस्तु दायादः सत्यकेतुर्महारथः । सत्यकेतुसुतश्चापि विभुर्नाम प्रजेश्वरः

verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: सुविभुस्तु विभोः पुत्रः सुकुमारस्ततः स्मृतः । सुकुमारस्य पुत्रस्तु धृष्टकेतुः सुधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: suvibhustu vibhoḥ putraḥ sukumārastataḥ smṛtaḥ / sukumārasya putrastu dhṛṣṭaketuḥ sudhārmikaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टकेतोस्तु दायादो वेणुहोत्रः प्रजेश्वरः । वेणुहोत्रसुतश्चापि गार्ग्यो वै नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: dhṛṣṭaketostu dāyādo veṇuhotraḥ prajeśvaraḥ / veṇuhotrasutaścāpi gārgyo vai nāma viśrutaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: गार्ग्यस्य गर्गभूमिस्तु वंशो वत्सस्य धीमतः । ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियाश्चैव तयोः पुत्राः सुधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: gārgyasya gargabhūmistu vaṃśo vatsasya dhīmataḥ / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścaiva tayoḥ putrāḥ sudhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: अपनी अङ्कनामों के साथ लेकर असुरगण क्रौड़ा किया करते है।४०। बेढू- याय महाशाला के अन्तर में मारुत योजन में एक इन्द्रनील मणियों से परिपूर्ण-दूसरे चक्रवाल के ही तुल्य शाल है ।४१। उसके मध्य की कक्षा की भूमि भी है मुने ! नील रस्नमयी है और वहाँ पर नदियाँ मधुर हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.transliteration: vikrāntā balavantaśca sihatulyaparākramāḥ / ityete kāśyapāḥ proktā rajerapi nibodhata

verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
