verses.sanskrit: आवयोर्भगवन्युद्धे विजेता को भविष्यति । ब्रूहि नः सर्वलोकेश श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: āvayorbhagavanyuddhe vijetā ko bhaviṣyati / brūhi naḥ sarvalokeśa śrotumicchāmahe vayam
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । येषामर्थाय संग्रामे रजिरात्तायुधः प्रभुः । योत्स्यते ते विजष्यन्ते त्रींल्लोकान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca / yeṣāmarthāya saṃgrāme rajirāttāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ / yotsyate te vijaṣyante trīṃllokānnātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: रजिर्यतस्ततो लक्ष्मीर्यतो लक्ष्मीस्ततो धृतिः । यतो धृतिस्ततो धर्मो यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः
verses.transliteration: rajiryatastato lakṣmīryato lakṣmīstato dhṛtiḥ / yato dhṛtistato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ते देवा दानवाः सर्वे ततः श्रुत्वा रजेर्जयम् । अभ्ययुर्जयमिच्छन्तः स्तुवन्तो राजसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: te devā dānavāḥ sarve tataḥ śrutvā rajerjayam / abhyayurjayamicchantaḥ stuvanto rājasattamam
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: जो मानव भूलोक के मध्य में हैं और ललितादेवी के मन्त्र की साधना करने वाले हैं वे अपने देहॉ के अन्त में इन्द्र देव की नील कक्ष्या को प्राप्त करके वहाँ पर ही निबास किया करते हैं ।४३। वहाँ पर अपनों वनिताओं के साथ में दिव्य वस्तुओं का भोग करते हुए मधुर मच्च का पान किया
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ते हृष्टमनसः सर्वे राजानं देवदानवाः । ऊचुरस्मज्जयाय त्वं गृहाम वरकार्मुकम्
verses.transliteration: te hṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve rājānaṃ devadānavāḥ / ūcurasmajjayāya tvaṃ gṛhāma varakārmukam
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: करते हैं ओर भक्तिभाव में तिभंर होते हुए नृत्य करिया करते हैं १४४ हे कलशोद्भव ! उन सरोबरों में ओर नदियों के सपुदायों में--लताओं के गृहों में तथा रम्य एवं महास् ऋड्धियों वाले मन्दिरों में वे सदा श्रीदेवी का जाप करते और उसके ही गुणगणों को पढ़ा करते हैं। ये महान भाग वाले
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: रजिरुवाच अहं जेष्यामि भो दैत्या देवाञ्च्छ क्रपुरोगमान् । इन्द्रो भवामि धर्मात्मा ततो योत्स्ये रणाजिरे
verses.transliteration: rajiruvāca ahaṃ jeṣyāmi bho daityā devāñccha krapurogamān / indro bhavāmi dharmātmā tato yotsye raṇājire
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: पुरुष अपनी नारियों से परिवेष्टित होकर निवास किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: दानवा ऊचुः अस्माकमिन्द्रः प्रह्लादस्तस्यार्थे विजयामहे । अस्मिन्तु समये राजंस्तिष्ठेथा देवनोदिते
verses.transliteration: dānavā ūcuḥ asmākamindraḥ prahlādastasyārthe vijayāmahe / asmintu samaye rājaṃstiṣṭhethā devanodite
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: जब इतके पुण्म़ कर्मो का क्षय हो जाता है तो उस स्वर्गीय सुख का त्याग करके फिर इसी मनुष्य का देह ग्राप्त किया करते हैं। प की वासना उनकी आत्मा में बनी ही रहा करती है और वे पुनः चक्रिणो का अंचंत किया करते हैं । फिर वे श्रीनगर में शक्रनील महास्थली में गमन किया करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: स तथेति ब्रुवन्नेव देवैरप्यभिनोदितः । भविष्यसींद्रो जित्वेति देवैरपि निमन्त्रितः
verses.transliteration: sa tatheti bruvanneva devairapyabhinoditaḥ / bhaviṣyasīṃdro jitveti devairapi nimantritaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: ।४७। है मुने ! उस स्थल के सम्पकं से ही राग-द्रेष से समुत्पन्न भावों से जो नील होते है वे सबंदा युक्त होते हैं ऐसे हो मनृष्य रहते हैं ।४०। ओ ज्ञान बाले मनुष्य होते हैं वे नि ओर नियत इन्द्रियों बाले. हैं। है मुने ! वे विस्मय युक्त होकर महेश्वरी में प्रवेश किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: जघान दानवान्सर्वान्ये ऽवध्या वज्रपाणयः । स विप्रनष्टां देवानां परमश्रीः श्रियं वशी
verses.transliteration: jaghāna dānavānsarvānye 'vadhyā vajrapāṇayaḥ / sa vipranaṣṭāṃ devānāṃ paramaśrīḥ śriyaṃ vaśī
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य दानवान्सर्वा नाजहार रजिः प्रभुः । तं तथाह रजिं तत्र देवैः सह शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: nihatya dānavānsarvā nājahāra rajiḥ prabhuḥ / taṃ tathāha rajiṃ tatra devaiḥ saha śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: रजिपुत्रो ऽहमित्युक्त्वा पुनरेवाब्रहवीद्वचः । इन्द्रो ऽसि राजन्देवानां सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: rajiputro 'hamityuktvā punarevābrahavīdvacaḥ / indro 'si rājandevānāṃ sarveṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याहमिन्द्रः पुत्रस्ते ख्यातिं यास्यामि शत्रुहन् । स तु शक्रवचः श्रुत्वा वञ्चितस्तेन मायया
verses.transliteration: yasyāhamindraḥ putraste khyātiṃ yāsyāmi śatruhan / sa tu śakravacaḥ śrutvā vañcitastena māyayā
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्येवाह वै राजा प्रीयमाणः शतक्रतुम् । तस्मिंस्तु देवसदृशे दिवं प्राप्ते महीपतौ
verses.transliteration: tathetyevāha vai rājā prīyamāṇaḥ śatakratum / tasmiṃstu devasadṛśe divaṃ prāpte mahīpatau
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: दायाद्यमिन्द्रादा जह्नुराचार्यतनया रजेः । तानि पुत्रशतान्यस्य तच्च स्थानं शचीपतेः
verses.transliteration: dāyādyamindrādā jahnurācāryatanayā rajeḥ / tāni putraśatānyasya tacca sthānaṃ śacīpateḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: समाक्रामन्त बहुधा स्वर्गलोकं त्रिविष्टपम् । ततः काले बहुतिथे समतीते महाबलः
verses.transliteration: samākrāmanta bahudhā svargalokaṃ triviṣṭapam / tataḥ kāle bahutithe samatīte mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: हतराज्यो ऽब्रवीच्छक्रो हतभागो बृहस्पतिम् । बदरी फलमात्रं वै पुरोडाशं विधत्स्व मे
verses.transliteration: hatarājyo 'bravīcchakro hatabhāgo bṛhaspatim / badarī phalamātraṃ vai puroḍāśaṃ vidhatsva me
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षे येन तिष्ठेयं तेजसाप्यायितस्ततः । ब्रह्मन्कृशो ऽहं विमना त्दृतराज्यो हृतासनः
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣe yena tiṣṭheyaṃ tejasāpyāyitastataḥ / brahmankṛśo 'haṃ vimanā tdṛtarājyo hṛtāsanaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रनील नामक शाल के अन्तर में मरुत योजन में एक मुक्ताफलं से परिपूण शाल है और वह पहिलो भांति ही गोपुर से समन्वित है
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: हतौजा दुर्बलो युद्धे रजिपुत्रेः प्रसीद मे । बृहस्पतिरुवाच यद्येवं चोदितःशक्र त्वयास्यां पूर्वमेव हि
verses.transliteration: hataujā durbalo yuddhe rajiputreḥ prasīda me / bṛhaspatiruvāca yadyevaṃ coditaḥśakra tvayāsyāṃ pūrvameva hi
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: हे मुने ! उन दोनों के प्रध्य में अत्यधिक भास्वर स्थली है जो परम स्वच्छ है। बह सव ही मुक्ताओ से खचित है और शिभिर से अतोब मनोहर है।
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: नाभविष्यत्त्वत्प्रियार्थमकर्त्तव्यं ममानघ । प्रयतिष्यामि देवेन्द्र त्वद्धितार्थं महाद्युते
verses.transliteration: nābhaviṣyattvatpriyārthamakarttavyaṃ mamānagha / prayatiṣyāmi devendra tvaddhitārthaṃ mahādyute
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: जल मुक्ता फलों के ही समान हैं । ऐसी नदियां सवदा यहाँ बहा करती हैं। ।५२। उनके तटों पर सभी देवलोक के निवासी वास किया करते हैं जो अपने पूर्वजन्म में श्रीदेवो के मन्त्र को साधना करने वाले हैं ।५३। पूवं आदि आठ भागों में शक्रादि गोचर लोक हैं जो मुक्ता शाल के सब और द्वार
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञभागं च राज्यं च अचिरात्प्रतिपत्स्यसे । तथा शक्र गमिष्यामि मा भूत्ते विक्लवं मनः
verses.transliteration: yajñabhāgaṃ ca rājyaṃ ca acirātpratipatsyase / tathā śakra gamiṣyāmi mā bhūtte viklavaṃ manaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: देशकों को संयोजित करते हैं ।१४। मुक्ता शाल नील के द्वारों में मध्य देश से पूर्व भाग में इख लोक हैं और उसके कोण में वह्निलोक की भूमि है।
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कर्म चकारास्य तेजःसंवर्द्धनं महत् । तेषां च बुद्धिसंमोहमकरोद्बुद्धिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ karma cakārāsya tejaḥsaṃvarddhanaṃ mahat / teṣāṃ ca buddhisaṃmohamakarodbuddhisattamaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.hindi: किया करते हैं । सवंत्र ललिता के मन्त्र का जाप करने बाले हैं और बीन स्वभाव वाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ते यदा तु सुसंमूडा रागान्मत्तो विधर्मिणः । ब्रह्मद्विषश्च संबृत्ता हतवीर्यपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: te yadā tu susaṃmūḍā rāgānmatto vidharmiṇaḥ / brahmadviṣaśca saṃbṛttā hatavīryaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: ततो लेभे ऽसुरैश्वर्यमैन्द्रस्थानं तथोत्तमम् । हत्वा रजिसुतान्सर्वान्कामक्रोधपरायणान्
verses.transliteration: tato lebhe 'suraiśvaryamaindrasthānaṃ tathottamam / hatvā rajisutānsarvānkāmakrodhaparāyaṇān
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं च्यवनं स्थानात्प्रतिष्ठां च शतक्रतोः । शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेद्वापि न स दौरात्म्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ cyavanaṃ sthānātpratiṣṭhāṃ ca śatakratoḥ / śṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpi na sa daurātmyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone were to listen and narrate the details of dethronement and re-establishment of Indra, he shall never attain the state of wretchedness.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे धन्वन्तरिसंभवादिवर्णनं नाम सप्तषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ६७॥ ऋषय ऊचुः मरुतेन कथं कन्या राज्ञे दत्ता महात्मना । किंवीर्याश्च महात्मानो जाता मरुतकन्यया
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde dhanvantarisaṃbhavādivarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 67// ṛṣaya ūcuḥ marutena kathaṃ kanyā rājñe dattā mahātmanā / kiṃvīryāśca mahātmāno jātā marutakanyayā
verses.translation: That lord of subjects desirous of cooked food, per- formed the sacrifice Marutsoma. That king of great splendour performed it every month for sixty years.
verses.wordMeaning: That lord of subjects desirous of cooked food, per- formed the sacrifice Marutsoma. That king of great splendour performed it every month for sixty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord of subjects desirous of cooked food, per- formed the sacrifice Marutsoma. That king of great splendour performed it every month for sixty years.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच आहरत्स मरुत्सोममन्नकामः प्रजेश्वरः । मासिमासि महातेजाः षष्टिसंवत्सरान्नृप
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca āharatsa marutsomamannakāmaḥ prajeśvaraḥ / māsimāsi mahātejāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃvatsarānnṛpa
verses.translation: The gods, Maruts, were pleased by the sacrifice Marut- soma of that king. Delighted in their heart, they give never- failing cooked food with all the other articles he should desire.
verses.hindi: स्त्री द्विशंल्लोकविद्विषन्पाषंडानां हि पालिनः । कालसूत्रे रौरवे च कुम्मोपाके च कुम्भ
verses.wordMeaning: The gods, Maruts, were pleased by the sacrifice Marut- soma of that king. Delighted in their heart, they give never- failing cooked food with all the other articles he should desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods, Maruts, were pleased by the sacrifice Marut- soma of that king. Delighted in their heart, they give never- failing cooked food with all the other articles he should desire.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ते मरुतस्तस्य मरुत्सोमेन तोषिताः । अक्षय्यान्नं ददुः प्रीताः सर्वकामपरिच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: tena te marutastasya marutsomena toṣitāḥ / akṣayyānnaṃ daduḥ prītāḥ sarvakāmaparicchadam
verses.translation: VV. 1-6 speak of Maruta and Mitra-Jyoti. But these have no connection with any dynasty in this chapter.
verses.hindi: एवमादिषु कष्टेषु नरकेषु घटोदुभव । पातयत्याज्ञया तस्याः श्रीदेव्या: स महौजसः
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 1-6 speak of Maruta and Mitra-Jyoti. But these have no connection with any dynasty in this chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 1-6 speak of Maruta and Mitra-Jyoti. But these have no connection with any dynasty in this chapter.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं तस्य सकृद्भुक्तमहोरात्रं न क्षीयते । कोटिशो दीय मानं च सूर्यस्योदयनादपि
verses.transliteration: annaṃ tasya sakṛdbhuktamahorātraṃ na kṣīyate / koṭiśo dīya mānaṃ ca sūryasyodayanādapi
verses.translation: His food taken in once did not get wasted for a day
verses.wordMeaning: His food taken in once did not get wasted for a day
verses.commentary: Sense: His food taken in once did not get wasted for a day

verses.sanskrit: मित्रज्योतेस्तु कन्याया मरितस्य च धीमतः । तस्माज्जाता महासत्त्वा धर्मज्ञा मोक्षदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: mitrajyotestu kanyāyā maritasya ca dhīmataḥ / tasmājjātā mahāsattvā dharmajñā mokṣadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: To the daughter of Mitra-jyoti and the intelligent Maruta were bom many sons who were conversant with dharma, could realize salvation and who were endowed with great intrinsic strength.
verses.hindi: चित्रगुप्त जिनमें अग्रणी है ऐसे यमराज के भटों के साथ आज्ञा के
verses.wordMeaning: To the daughter of Mitra-jyoti and the intelligent Maruta were bom many sons who were conversant with dharma, could realize salvation and who were endowed with great intrinsic strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the daughter of Mitra-jyoti and the intelligent Maruta were bom many sons who were conversant with dharma, could realize salvation and who were endowed with great intrinsic strength.

verses.sanskrit: संन्यस्य गृहधर्माणि वैराग्यं समुपस्थिताः । यतिधर्ममवाप्येह ब्रह्मभूयाय ते गताः
verses.transliteration: saṃnyasya gṛhadharmāṇi vairāgyaṃ samupasthitāḥ / yatidharmamavāpyeha brahmabhūyāya te gatāḥ
verses.translation: They renounced the rites and vows pertaining to the householder and adopted Vairdgya (non-attachment to worldly desires or objects). After taking up the duties of recluses they attained salvation.
verses.hindi: धारण करने वाले गुह थ्रो देवी के समय को नियमित किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They renounced the rites and vows pertaining to the householder and adopted Vairdgya (non-attachment to worldly desires or objects). After taking up the duties of recluses they attained salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They renounced the rites and vows pertaining to the householder and adopted Vairdgya (non-attachment to worldly desires or objects). After taking up the duties of recluses they attained salvation.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनसः सुतो जातः क्षत्रधर्मः प्रतापवान् । क्षत्रधर्मसुतो जातः प्रतिपक्षो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: anenasaḥ suto jātaḥ kṣatradharmaḥ pratāpavān / kṣatradharmasuto jātaḥ pratipakṣo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: Sffijaya, the son of Pratipaksa, became well-known. Jaya was the son of Srfijaya. Vijaya was born to him.
verses.hindi: जो गुहु के द्वारा शप्त हैँ-दुराचारी हैं--ललिता के साथ दष करने वाले हैं--कृटभक्ति में तत्पर हैं--मूर्ख हैँ -स्तब्ध हैं और बहुत ही अधिक दपं बाले हैं--मन्ध चोर हैं-कुत्सित मन्त बाले हैं-कूबिद्या के पाप का संय करने वाले हैं-नास्तिक हैं--पाप कर्मों के करने वाले हैं उनको भिन्न-भिन्न
verses.wordMeaning: Sffijaya, the son of Pratipaksa, became well-known. Jaya was the son of Srfijaya. Vijaya was born to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sffijaya, the son of Pratipaksa, became well-known. Jaya was the son of Srfijaya. Vijaya was born to him.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपक्षसुतश्चापि सृंजयो नाम विश्रुतः । सृंजयस्य जयः पुत्रो विजयस्तस्य जज्ञिवान्
verses.transliteration: pratipakṣasutaścāpi sṛṃjayo nāma viśrutaḥ / sṛṃjayasya jayaḥ putro vijayastasya jajñivān
verses.translation: This dynasty of Anenas (also given in V&. 7-11 and Brahma 27-31) was limited and could not be properly located. Bh.P.IX. 17 gives a different line of Anenas.
verses.hindi: नरकों में डाल दिया जाता है । उन नरकों के नाम ये हैं-कालसूत्र-रौरव- कुम्भीपाक-बह महान ओज वाला उसी खी देवी को आज्ञा से है घटोदुभव ! इन नरकों में डाल दिया करता है ।५८-६२! उसके हो पश्चिम भाग में खड्ग का धारण करने वाला निति है। वह भी खरो ललिता का अर्चक
verses.wordMeaning: This dynasty of Anenas (also given in V&. 7-11 and Brahma 27-31) was limited and could not be properly located. Bh.P.IX. 17 gives a different line of Anenas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This dynasty of Anenas (also given in V&. 7-11 and Brahma 27-31) was limited and could not be properly located. Bh.P.IX. 17 gives a different line of Anenas.

verses.sanskrit: विजयस्य जयः पुत्रस्तस्य हर्यश्वकः स्मृतः । इर्यश्वस्य सुतो राजा सहदेवः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: vijayasya jayaḥ putrastasya haryaśvakaḥ smṛtaḥ / iryaśvasya suto rājā sahadevaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: Yati adopted the path of salvation. He became a sage and became one with Brahman. Among the other five*, it was Yayati who became king.
verses.hindi: राक्षस लोक का आस्रय ग्रहण करके रहा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Yati adopted the path of salvation. He became a sage and became one with Brahman. Among the other five*, it was Yayati who became king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yati adopted the path of salvation. He became a sage and became one with Brahman. Among the other five*, it was Yayati who became king.

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवस्य धर्मात्मा अहीन इति विश्रुतः । अहीनस्य चयत्सेनस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽथ संकृतिः
verses.transliteration: sahadevasya dharmātmā ahīna iti viśrutaḥ / ahīnasya cayatsenastasya putro 'tha saṃkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: He got Devayani, the daughter of U£anas, and Sarmistha the Asura lady and daughter of Vr$aparvan, as his wives.
verses.wordMeaning: He got Devayani, the daughter of U£anas, and Sarmistha the Asura lady and daughter of Vr$aparvan, as his wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: He got Devayani, the daughter of U£anas, and Sarmistha the Asura lady and daughter of Vr$aparvan, as his wives.

verses.sanskrit: संकृतेरपि धर्मात्मा कृतधर्मा महायशाः । इत्येते क्षत्रधर्माणो नहुषस्य निबोधत
verses.transliteration: saṃkṛterapi dharmātmā kṛtadharmā mahāyaśāḥ / ityete kṣatradharmāṇo nahuṣasya nibodhata
verses.translation: With that pre-eminent chariot* he constantly con- quered the different kingdoms on the earth. Yayati was invin- cible in battle to the Devas* Danavas and human beings.
verses.wordMeaning: With that pre-eminent chariot* he constantly con- quered the different kingdoms on the earth. Yayati was invin- cible in battle to the Devas* Danavas and human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: With that pre-eminent chariot* he constantly con- quered the different kingdoms on the earth. Yayati was invin- cible in battle to the Devas* Danavas and human beings.

verses.sanskrit: नहुषस्य तु दायादाः षडिन्द्रोपमतेजसः । यतिर्ययातिः संयातिरायतिर्वियतिः कृतिः
verses.transliteration: nahuṣasya tu dāyādāḥ ṣaḍindropamatejasaḥ / yatiryayātiḥ saṃyātirāyatirviyatiḥ kṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Abandoned (Banished) by the citizens and people of the outlying districts* that king Lohagandhi ran about here and there. He did not get happiness or mental peace anywhere.
verses.wordMeaning: Abandoned (Banished) by the citizens and people of the outlying districts* that king Lohagandhi ran about here and there. He did not get happiness or mental peace anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Abandoned (Banished) by the citizens and people of the outlying districts* that king Lohagandhi ran about here and there. He did not get happiness or mental peace anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: यतिर्ज्येष्ठस्तु तेषां वै ययातिस्तु ततो ऽवरः । काकुत्स्थकन्यां गां नाम लेभे पत्नीं यतिस्तदा
verses.transliteration: yatirjyeṣṭhastu teṣāṃ vai yayātistu tato 'varaḥ / kākutsthakanyāṃ gāṃ nāma lebhe patnīṃ yatistadā
verses.translation: Distressed with sorrow and misery as he was, he did not get sympathetic understanding from anyone anywhere. Utterly dejected he sought refuge in the sage Saunaka.
verses.wordMeaning: Distressed with sorrow and misery as he was, he did not get sympathetic understanding from anyone anywhere. Utterly dejected he sought refuge in the sage Saunaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Distressed with sorrow and misery as he was, he did not get sympathetic understanding from anyone anywhere. Utterly dejected he sought refuge in the sage Saunaka.

verses.sanskrit: स यतिर्मोक्षमास्थाय ब्रह्मभूतो ऽभवन्मुनिः । तेषां मध्ये तु पञ्चानां ययातिः पृथिवीपतिः
verses.transliteration: sa yatirmokṣamāsthāya brahmabhūto 'bhavanmuniḥ / teṣāṃ madhye tu pañcānāṃ yayātiḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
verses.translation: That saintly king Yayaii, the son of Nahusa, attain- ed old age. He then spoke these words to Yadu, his eldest and the most excellent son.
verses.wordMeaning: That saintly king Yayaii, the son of Nahusa, attain- ed old age. He then spoke these words to Yadu, his eldest and the most excellent son.
verses.commentary: Sense: That saintly king Yayaii, the son of Nahusa, attain- ed old age. He then spoke these words to Yadu, his eldest and the most excellent son.

verses.sanskrit: देवयानीमुशनसः सुतां भार्यामवाप ह । शर्मिष्ठामासुरीं चैव तनयां वृषपर्वणः
verses.transliteration: devayānīmuśanasaḥ sutāṃ bhāryāmavāpa ha / śarmiṣṭhāmāsurīṃ caiva tanayāṃ vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Dear son, wrinkles, grey hair and other infirmities of old age have overpowered (lit. encircled) me on account of
verses.hindi: उसके उत्तर भाग में दोनों के मध्य स्थल में वारुण लोक का आश्रके लेकर सदा वरुण देवता रहा करता है ।६४। यह वारुणी के अस्वादन में मत्त रहता है । इसका परमशुध्र है और वृष इसका वाहन है। यह भी श्रीदेवी के मन्त्र के जप करने वाला है और खरो के क्रम की साधन करने वाला है
verses.wordMeaning: "Dear son, wrinkles, grey hair and other infirmities of old age have overpowered (lit. encircled) me on account of
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dear son, wrinkles, grey hair and other infirmities of old age have overpowered (lit. encircled) me on account of

verses.sanskrit: यदुं च तुर्वसुं चैव देवयानो व्यजायत । द्रुह्युं चानुं च पूरुं च शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी
verses.transliteration: yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayāno vyajāyata / druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī
verses.translation: O Yadu, accept my sin along with my old age. Accept my old age."
verses.hindi: ।६५। जो भी ल्ली देवता से द्वेष करने बाले हैं उनको पाशों के बन्धनों से बांधकर भक्तों के बन्धन को छुड़ाने वाला यह अधो मार्ग में पहुँचा दिया करता है ।६६। और उसके उत्तर कोने में महती द्य ति वाला बायुलोक है। वहाँ पर वागु के हो शरीरों वाले तया स्वेदा आनन्द से पूणं महोदय सिद्धः
verses.wordMeaning: O Yadu, accept my sin along with my old age. Accept my old age."
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yadu, accept my sin along with my old age. Accept my old age."

verses.sanskrit: अजीजनन्महावीर्यान्सुतान्देवसुतोपमान् । रथं तस्मै ददौ शक्रः प्रीतः परमभास्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ajījananmahāvīryānsutāndevasutopamān / rathaṃ tasmai dadau śakraḥ prītaḥ paramabhāsvaram
verses.translation: On being told thus by Yadu, he became extremely furious. (The king) who was the most excellent among the elo- quent ones spoke to the eldest son after censuring him.
verses.hindi: गण और दिव्य ऋषिगण तथा दूसरे पवन के अभ्यास वाले--गो की रक्षा मैं प्रधान-योग में परायण योगी रहा करते हैं और इन्हीं के साथ महान सत्व वाला ख्रीमास्तेश्वर निवास करते हैं । इनकी मूति सर्वथा भिन्न है
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by Yadu, he became extremely furious. (The king) who was the most excellent among the elo- quent ones spoke to the eldest son after censuring him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by Yadu, he became extremely furious. (The king) who was the most excellent among the elo- quent ones spoke to the eldest son after censuring him.

verses.sanskrit: असंगं काञ्चनं दिव्यमक्षयौ च महेषुधी । युक्तं मनोजवैरश्वैर्येन कन्यां समुद्वहत्
verses.transliteration: asaṃgaṃ kāñcanaṃ divyamakṣayau ca maheṣudhī / yuktaṃ manojavairaśvairyena kanyāṃ samudvahat
verses.translation: "O evil-minded one, what other devout rite do you have for which you disregard me, your preceptor (and father)? What other Asrama (stage of life) can you have?'*
verses.hindi: हे कुम्भ-सम्भव ! इडा-पिङ्गला और सुषुम्णा इसकी शक्तियां हैं। ये तीन शक्तियाँ मरुतनाथ की सवंदा मधु के मद से अलस रहा करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O evil-minded one, what other devout rite do you have for which you disregard me, your preceptor (and father)? What other Asrama (stage of life) can you have?'*
verses.commentary: Sense: "O evil-minded one, what other devout rite do you have for which you disregard me, your preceptor (and father)? What other Asrama (stage of life) can you have?'*

verses.sanskrit: स तेन रथमुख्येन जिगाय सततं महीम् । ययातिर्युधि दुर्द्धर्षो देवदानवमानवैः
verses.transliteration: sa tena rathamukhyena jigāya satataṃ mahīm / yayātiryudhi durddharṣo devadānavamānavaiḥ
verses.translation: "An old man cannot drive a chariot or ride a horse. He cannot enjoy women. He has no pleasure. Therefore, I do not desire old age".
verses.wordMeaning: "An old man cannot drive a chariot or ride a horse. He cannot enjoy women. He has no pleasure. Therefore, I do not desire old age".
verses.commentary: Sense: "An old man cannot drive a chariot or ride a horse. He cannot enjoy women. He has no pleasure. Therefore, I do not desire old age".

verses.sanskrit: पौरवाणां नृपाणां च सर्वेषां सो ऽभवद्रथी । यावत्सुदेशप्रभवः कौरवो जनमेजयः
verses.transliteration: pauravāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ so 'bhavadrathī / yāvatsudeśaprabhavaḥ kauravo janamejayaḥ
verses.translation: "An old man is as weak and feeble as a child. He is always unclean. He does not perform Homa in the sacred fire at the proper time. I do not like that type of old age."
verses.wordMeaning: "An old man is as weak and feeble as a child. He is always unclean. He does not perform Homa in the sacred fire at the proper time. I do not like that type of old age."
verses.commentary: Sense: "An old man is as weak and feeble as a child. He is always unclean. He does not perform Homa in the sacred fire at the proper time. I do not like that type of old age."

verses.sanskrit: कुरोः पौत्रस्य राज्ञरतु राज्ञः पारीक्षितस्य ह । जगाम सरथो नाशं शापाद्गार्ग्यस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: kuroḥ pautrasya rājñaratu rājñaḥ pārīkṣitasya ha / jagāma saratho nāśaṃ śāpādgārgyasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: He delighted his wives by means of all favours desired by them. He made excellent Brahmanas pleased by granting them everything they desired. He pleased guests by means of foodstuffs and beverages and the Vaisyas (the merchant class) by according them benign administration.
verses.wordMeaning: He delighted his wives by means of all favours desired by them. He made excellent Brahmanas pleased by granting them everything they desired. He pleased guests by means of foodstuffs and beverages and the Vaisyas (the merchant class) by according them benign administration.
verses.commentary: Sense: He delighted his wives by means of all favours desired by them. He made excellent Brahmanas pleased by granting them everything they desired. He pleased guests by means of foodstuffs and beverages and the Vaisyas (the merchant class) by according them benign administration.

verses.sanskrit: गार्ग्यस्य हि सुतं बालं स राजा जनमेजयः । दुर्बुद्धिर्हिंसया मास लोहगन्धी नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: gārgyasya hi sutaṃ bālaṃ sa rājā janamejayaḥ / durbuddhirhiṃsayā māsa lohagandhī narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: He delighted Sudras by avoiding cruelty and pre- venting their harassment by others. He controlled decoits by giving punishments and restraining them otherwise. He delighted all subjects duly according to the injunctions of dharma.
verses.wordMeaning: He delighted Sudras by avoiding cruelty and pre- venting their harassment by others. He controlled decoits by giving punishments and restraining them otherwise. He delighted all subjects duly according to the injunctions of dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: He delighted Sudras by avoiding cruelty and pre- venting their harassment by others. He controlled decoits by giving punishments and restraining them otherwise. He delighted all subjects duly according to the injunctions of dharma.

verses.sanskrit: स लोहगन्धी राजर्षिः परिधावन्नितस्ततः । पौरजानपदैस्त्यक्तो न लेभे शर्म कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: sa lohagandhī rājarṣiḥ paridhāvannitastataḥ / paurajānapadaistyakto na lebhe śarma karhicit
verses.translation: Yayati protected the kingdom like another Indra.
verses.hindi: वह मास्तेश्वर श्रेष्ठ सिह के बाहुन पर विराजमान हैं--हाथ में धवजा लिए हुए हैं और ललिता देवो के यजन-ध्यान ओर अचेन के क्रम में परायण रहते हैं ।७१। आनन्द से पूरित अङ्गों वालो अन्य शक्तियों से समा वृत रहते हैं। बह श्रोमात मरुतेश्‍्वर सदा चक्रिणी का जाप किया करते
verses.wordMeaning: Yayati protected the kingdom like another Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yayati protected the kingdom like another Indra.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स दुःखसंतप्तो नालभत्संविदं क्वचित । स प्रायाच्छौनकमृषिं शरणं व्यथितस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa duḥkhasaṃtapto nālabhatsaṃvidaṃ kvacita / sa prāyācchaunakamṛṣiṃ śaraṇaṃ vyathitastadā
verses.translation: You may take up the administration of the realm. Indeed, you alone among all the sons carried out my wish in order to please me." King Yayati, the son of Nahusa took back his old age. Puru regained his youthful age.
verses.hindi: हैं ।७२। उसी के सत्व से चराचर प्रलोकय को कल्प के अन्त में परागमयता को प्राप्त करके उसो क्षण में निनो दित किया करते हँ ।७३। उसी सत्व की सिद्धि के लिए उसो ललितेशवरी की भावना तथा अचंना करते हुए समस्त आभरणो से भूषित हैँ ।७४। उस लोक के पूर्व भाग में यक्षलोक है उसमें
verses.wordMeaning: You may take up the administration of the realm. Indeed, you alone among all the sons carried out my wish in order to please me." King Yayati, the son of Nahusa took back his old age. Puru regained his youthful age.
verses.commentary: Sense: You may take up the administration of the realm. Indeed, you alone among all the sons carried out my wish in order to please me." King Yayati, the son of Nahusa took back his old age. Puru regained his youthful age.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रोतोनाम विख्यातो यो ऽसौ मुनि रुदारधीः । योजयामास चैन्द्रोतः शौनको जनमेजयम्
verses.transliteration: indrotonāma vikhyāto yo 'sau muni rudāradhīḥ / yojayāmāsa caindrotaḥ śaunako janamejayam
verses.translation: The story of Yay&ti requesting his sons to exchange their youth for a period of 1000 years for his old age is given in details in Mbh.Adi. Chs 81 and 85. The immortal verse:
verses.hindi: महान कान्ति सम्पन्न यक्षराज निवास किया करते हैं। यह श्री सम्पन्न हैं और उसके द्वारों के मध्य में स्थित हैं ।७५। निधियों के द्वारा जो नो हैं तथा ऋद्धि, वृद्धि आदि शक्तियों के द्वारा ललिता के भक्तों को धन सम्पदा से पूति किया करते हैं ।७६। अनुकूल प्रवृत्ति वाली परम सुन्दरी पत्नियों के
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Yay&ti requesting his sons to exchange their youth for a period of 1000 years for his old age is given in details in Mbh.Adi. Chs 81 and 85. The immortal verse:
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Yay&ti requesting his sons to exchange their youth for a period of 1000 years for his old age is given in details in Mbh.Adi. Chs 81 and 85. The immortal verse:

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधेन राजानं पावनार्थं द्विजोत्तमाः । स लोहगन्धो व्यनशत्त स्यावभृथमेत्य ह
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhena rājānaṃ pāvanārthaṃ dvijottamāḥ / sa lohagandho vyanaśatta syāvabhṛthametya ha
verses.translation: VV.77-90 show that kings in ancient India had to seek some sort of public sanction, before appointing a heir apparent to the throne.
verses.hindi: सहित अनेक प्रकार के मधु के भेदों से उसी चक्रिणी देबी की सविधि पूजा किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: VV.77-90 show that kings in ancient India had to seek some sort of public sanction, before appointing a heir apparent to the throne.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.77-90 show that kings in ancient India had to seek some sort of public sanction, before appointing a heir apparent to the throne.

verses.sanskrit: स वै दिव्यो रथस्तस्माद्वसोश्चेदिपतेस्तथा । दत्तः शक्रेन तुष्टेन लेभे तस्माद्बृहद्रथः
verses.transliteration: sa vai divyo rathastasmādvasoścedipatestathā / dattaḥ śakrena tuṣṭena lebhe tasmādbṛhadrathaḥ
verses.translation: VV.90-94 show that despite the disobedience of his sons Yayati gave parts of his kingdom to his sons, thougn the hereditary throne was given to the youngest son Puru.
verses.wordMeaning: VV.90-94 show that despite the disobedience of his sons Yayati gave parts of his kingdom to his sons, thougn the hereditary throne was given to the youngest son Puru.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.90-94 show that despite the disobedience of his sons Yayati gave parts of his kingdom to his sons, thougn the hereditary throne was given to the youngest son Puru.

verses.sanskrit: ततो हत्वा जरासंधं भीमस्तं रथमुत्तमम् । प्रददौ वासुदेवाय प्रीत्या कौरवनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: tato hatvā jarāsaṃdhaṃ bhīmastaṃ rathamuttamam / pradadau vāsudevāya prītyā kauravanandanaḥ
verses.translation: The king established the eldest son Yadu in the South-Western quarter. He assigned the Western quarter ta Druhyu and the northern quarter to Anu.
verses.hindi: तल्लोकपू वं भागे तु रुद्रलोको महोदयः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The king established the eldest son Yadu in the South-Western quarter. He assigned the Western quarter ta Druhyu and the northern quarter to Anu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king established the eldest son Yadu in the South-Western quarter. He assigned the Western quarter ta Druhyu and the northern quarter to Anu.

verses.sanskrit: स जरां प्राप्य राजर्षिर्ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः । पुत्रं श्रेष्टं वरिष्ठं च यदुमित्यब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration: sa jarāṃ prāpya rājarṣiryayātirnahuṣātmajaḥ / putraṃ śreṣṭaṃ variṣṭhaṃ ca yadumityabravīdvacaḥ
verses.translation: After conquering the Earth consisting "of seven oceans and continents, King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, divided it into five divisions and distributed them among his sons.
verses.wordMeaning: After conquering the Earth consisting "of seven oceans and continents, King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, divided it into five divisions and distributed them among his sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: After conquering the Earth consisting "of seven oceans and continents, King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, divided it into five divisions and distributed them among his sons.

verses.sanskrit: जरावली च मां तात पलितानि च पर्ययुः । काव्यस्योशनसः शापान्न च तृप्तो ऽस्मि यौवने
verses.transliteration: jarāvalī ca māṃ tāta palitāni ca paryayuḥ / kāvyasyośanasaḥ śāpānna ca tṛpto 'smi yauvane
verses.translation: The entire Earth consisting of towns and seven continents is being protected by them righteously without encroaching on other territories as they were conversant with Dharma.
verses.wordMeaning: The entire Earth consisting of towns and seven continents is being protected by them righteously without encroaching on other territories as they were conversant with Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire Earth consisting of towns and seven continents is being protected by them righteously without encroaching on other territories as they were conversant with Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं यदो प्रतिपद्यस्व पाप्मानं जरया सह । जरां मे प्रतिगृह्णीष्व तं यदुः प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yado pratipadyasva pāpmānaṃ jarayā saha / jarāṃ me pratigṛhṇīṣva taṃ yaduḥ pratyuvāca ha
verses.translation: After dividing the Earth among his sons and after transferring the royal glory to his sons, the king, the son of Nahu$a, became delighted.
verses.wordMeaning: After dividing the Earth among his sons and after transferring the royal glory to his sons, the king, the son of Nahu$a, became delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: After dividing the Earth among his sons and after transferring the royal glory to his sons, the king, the son of Nahu$a, became delighted.

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्दिष्टा हि मे भिक्षा ब्राह्मणस्य प्रतिश्रुता । सा तु व्यायामसाध्या वै न ग्रहीष्यामि ते जराम्
verses.transliteration: anirdiṣṭā hi me bhikṣā brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutā / sā tu vyāyāmasādhyā vai na grahīṣyāmi te jarām
verses.translation: After laying aside the bow and the arrows, after entrusting the kingdom to his sons and after allotting the duties and responsibilities to his kinsmen, the king became pleased.
verses.wordMeaning: After laying aside the bow and the arrows, after entrusting the kingdom to his sons and after allotting the duties and responsibilities to his kinsmen, the king became pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: After laying aside the bow and the arrows, after entrusting the kingdom to his sons and after allotting the duties and responsibilities to his kinsmen, the king became pleased.

verses.sanskrit: जरायां बहवो दोषाः पानभोजनकारिताः । तस्माज्जरां न ते राजन्ग्रहीतुमहमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: jarāyāṃ bahavo doṣāḥ pānabhojanakāritāḥ / tasmājjarāṃ na te rājangrahītumahamutsahe
verses.translation: In this context the following verses have been formerly sung by Yayati, the great king. By following the advice therein one should restrain and withdraw lustful desires like a tortoise that withdraws his limbs.1
verses.wordMeaning: In this context the following verses have been formerly sung by Yayati, the great king. By following the advice therein one should restrain and withdraw lustful desires like a tortoise that withdraws his limbs.1
verses.commentary: Sense: In this context the following verses have been formerly sung by Yayati, the great king. By following the advice therein one should restrain and withdraw lustful desires like a tortoise that withdraws his limbs.1

verses.sanskrit: सितश्मश्रुधरो दीनो जरया शिथिलीकृतः । वलीसंततगात्रश्च निराशो दुर्बलाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: sitaśmaśrudharo dīno jarayā śithilīkṛtaḥ / valīsaṃtatagātraśca nirāśo durbalākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: "Never can lust subside by enjoying the pleasures. Just as the fire is ablaze all the more by ghee offer- ings so also the desires get increased by indulgence.
verses.wordMeaning: "Never can lust subside by enjoying the pleasures. Just as the fire is ablaze all the more by ghee offer- ings so also the desires get increased by indulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Never can lust subside by enjoying the pleasures. Just as the fire is ablaze all the more by ghee offer- ings so also the desires get increased by indulgence.

verses.sanskrit: अशक्तः कार्यकरणे परिबूतस्तु यौवने । सहोपवीतिभिश्चैव तां जरां नाभिकामये
verses.transliteration: aśaktaḥ kāryakaraṇe paribūtastu yauvane / sahopavītibhiścaiva tāṃ jarāṃ nābhikāmaye
verses.translation: All the food-grains and barleys, all the gold, all the animals and all the women in the world — all these are not sufficient even for one. One who realizes this docs not become deluded.
verses.wordMeaning: All the food-grains and barleys, all the gold, all the animals and all the women in the world — all these are not sufficient even for one. One who realizes this docs not become deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the food-grains and barleys, all the gold, all the animals and all the women in the world — all these are not sufficient even for one. One who realizes this docs not become deluded.

verses.sanskrit: संति ते बहवः पुत्रा मत्तः प्रियतरा नृप । प्रतिगृह्णन्तु धर्मज्ञ पुत्रमन्यं वृणीष्व वै
verses.transliteration: saṃti te bahavaḥ putrā mattaḥ priyatarā nṛpa / pratigṛhṇantu dharmajña putramanyaṃ vṛṇīṣva vai
verses.translation: If one has no inauspicious feelings towards all living beings, if one is not ill-disposed towards anyone mentally* verbally or physically, one realizes the Brahman then.
verses.wordMeaning: If one has no inauspicious feelings towards all living beings, if one is not ill-disposed towards anyone mentally* verbally or physically, one realizes the Brahman then.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one has no inauspicious feelings towards all living beings, if one is not ill-disposed towards anyone mentally* verbally or physically, one realizes the Brahman then.

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो यदुना दीव्रकोपसमन्वितः । उवाच वदतां श्रेष्टो ज्येष्ठं तं गर्हयन्सुतम्
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto yadunā dīvrakopasamanvitaḥ / uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭo jyeṣṭhaṃ taṃ garhayansutam
verses.translation: If one does not terrify others, if one is not afraid of others, if one neither desires nor hates, one realizes the Brahman then.
verses.hindi: अहाँ पर बहुत से यक्षराज के सेनानी गण भो निवास किया करते हैं जिनके प्रमुख नाभ मणि भद्र-पूर्ण भद्र-मणिमान और मणिकन्धर हैं
verses.wordMeaning: If one does not terrify others, if one is not afraid of others, if one neither desires nor hates, one realizes the Brahman then.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one does not terrify others, if one is not afraid of others, if one neither desires nor hates, one realizes the Brahman then.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमः कस्तवान्यो ऽस्ति को वा धर्मविधिस्तव । मामनादृत्य दुर्बुद्धे यदहं तव देशिकः
verses.transliteration: āśramaḥ kastavānyo 'sti ko vā dharmavidhistava / māmanādṛtya durbuddhe yadahaṃ tava deśikaḥ
verses.translation: VV.97-103 are often quoted and have become in a way, immortal' verses.
verses.hindi: उस लोक के पूर्व भाग में महान उदय वाला रुद्रलोक भी हैं। बेशकी मती रत्नों से खचित वह पर रुद्र उसके अधिष्ठाता देव हूँ !७6। वह सदा हीं क्रोध से दीप्त रहता है और सर्वदा धनुष को बढ़ाये हुए रहते है । अपने ही सहश-दक्ष-योडण आवरणों में स्थित वकत्रों से निरन्तर आवृत श्री देवता
verses.wordMeaning: VV.97-103 are often quoted and have become in a way, immortal' verses.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.97-103 are often quoted and have become in a way, immortal' verses.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा यदुं राजा शशापैनं स मन्युमान् । यस्त्वं मे त्दृदयाज्जातो वयः स्वं न प्रयच्छसि
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā yaduṃ rājā śaśāpainaṃ sa manyumān / yastvaṃ me tdṛdayājjāto vayaḥ svaṃ na prayacchasi
verses.translation: Happiness befalls one who eschews Tr$n& (thirst, covetousness) which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded persons, which does not subside even when one becomes old and infirm and which can be considered an ailment that lasts till our vital airs last (or that causes death).
verses.hindi: के मन्त्र का जाप किया करता है ।८०.८१। श्री देवो के ध्यान से सम्पन्न और श्री देवी के पुजन में समुत्युक-बहुत सो करोड़ों रुद्वाणियों के गणों से मण्डित पाएं को भूमि बाले हैं ।5२। वे सभी स्ट्राणियां भो प्रदीप्त अज्ञों बाली हैं और नवीन यौवन के गे से अन्वित है । वे सभी श्री ललिता के
verses.wordMeaning: Happiness befalls one who eschews Tr$n& (thirst, covetousness) which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded persons, which does not subside even when one becomes old and infirm and which can be considered an ailment that lasts till our vital airs last (or that causes death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Happiness befalls one who eschews Tr$n& (thirst, covetousness) which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded persons, which does not subside even when one becomes old and infirm and which can be considered an ailment that lasts till our vital airs last (or that causes death).

verses.sanskrit: गृहाण यौवनं मत्तश्चर कामान्यथेप्सितान् । जरयाहं प्रतिच्छन्नो वयोरूपधरस्तव
verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇa yauvanaṃ mattaścara kāmānyathepsitān / jarayāhaṃ praticchanno vayorūpadharastava
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: यौवनं भवते दत्त्वा चरिष्यामि यथार्थवत् । ययातिरुवाच पूरो प्रीतो ऽस्मि भद्रं ते प्रीतश्चेदं ददामि ते
verses.transliteration: yauvanaṃ bhavate dattvā cariṣyāmi yathārthavat / yayātiruvāca pūro prīto 'smi bhadraṃ te prītaścedaṃ dadāmi te
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: तत्र स्थिताश्च रुद्रा: के केन नाम्ना प्रकीतिताः केष्वावरणबिबेषु किन्नामानो बसन्ति ते । यौगिकं रौढिक नाम तेषां ब्रूहि कृपानिधे
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धा ते प्रजा राज्ये भविष्यति । सूत उवाच पूरोरनुमतो राजा ययातिः स्वजरां ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhā te prajā rājye bhaviṣyati / sūta uvāca pūroranumato rājā yayātiḥ svajarāṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: संक्रामयामास तदा प्रासादद्भार्गवस्य तु । गौरवेणाथ वयसा ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāmayāmāsa tadā prāsādadbhārgavasya tu / gauraveṇātha vayasā yayātirnahuṣātmajaḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतियुक्तो नरश्रेष्ठश्चचार विषयान्स्वकान् । यथाकामं यथोत्साहं यथाकालं यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: prītiyukto naraśreṣṭhaścacāra viṣayānsvakān / yathākāmaṃ yathotsāhaṃ yathākālaṃ yathāsukham
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: धर्माविरोधी राजेन्द्रो यथाशक्ति स एव हि । देवानतर्पयद्यज्ञैः पितॄञ्श्राद्धैस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: dharmāvirodhī rājendro yathāśakti sa eva hi / devānatarpayadyajñaiḥ pitṝñśrāddhaistathaiva ca
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: दाराननुग्रहैरिष्टैः कामैश्च द्विजसत्तमान् । अतिथीनन्नपानैश्च वैश्यंश्च परिपालनैः
verses.transliteration: dārānanugrahairiṣṭaiḥ kāmaiśca dvijasattamān / atithīnannapānaiśca vaiśyaṃśca paripālanaiḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: आनृशंस्येन शूद्रांश्च दस्यून्संनिग्रहेण च । धर्मेण च प्रजाः सर्वा यथावदनुरञ्जयत्
verses.transliteration: ānṛśaṃsyena śūdrāṃśca dasyūnsaṃnigraheṇa ca / dharmeṇa ca prajāḥ sarvā yathāvadanurañjayat
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: श्री अगस्त्यजी ने कहा--थोडणावरण चक्र क्‍या वह रुद्र के अधिदेवत बाला है । वहाँ पर संस्थित रद्र कौन है ओर किस नाम से श्रकीत्तित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: ययातिः पालयामास साक्षादिन्द्र इवापरः । स राजा सिंहविक्रान्तो युवा विषयगोचरः
verses.transliteration: yayātiḥ pālayāmāsa sākṣādindra ivāparaḥ / sa rājā siṃhavikrānto yuvā viṣayagocaraḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: है कृपानिधे ! उनका योगिक और रौढिक नाम आप मुझे बतलाइये
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: अविरोधेन धर्मस्य चचार सुखमुत्तमम् । स मार्गमाणः कामानामतद्दोषनिदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: avirodhena dharmasya cacāra sukhamuttamam / sa mārgamāṇaḥ kāmānāmataddoṣanidarśanāt
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: श्री हयग्रीवजी ने कहा--वहाँ पर तीन रुद्र कहे गये हैं--मुक्ता जातक में निमित हैं। उसकी संख्या और आयाम से शोभित पांच योजन का विस्तार है ।३। मध्यपीड मनोहर सोलह आवरणों से युक्त है। मध्य में जो पीठ है जो जाज्वल्यमान मन्यु (क्रोध) वाले और तीन लोचनों से समन्वित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: विश्वाच्या सहितो रेमे वैब्राजे नन्दने वने । अपश्यत्स यदा तान्वै वर्द्धमानान्नृपस्तदा
verses.transliteration: viśvācyā sahito reme vaibrāje nandane vane / apaśyatsa yadā tānvai varddhamānānnṛpastadā
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: है गुने ! बह सर्वदा सुसश्जित कामुं क से हाथ में लेकर विद्यमान रहा करते हैं। है घटोदुभव ! त्रिकोण में तीन ही रुद्र कहे गये हैं ।५॥ एक तो हिरण्य बाहू है--दुसरे सेनानी हैं और तीसरे.का नाम दिशांपति है ।६। तथा वृक्ष- शरण और तीसरे पशुपति हैं। शब्पिझजर--त्विषोमाद् और पथीनां
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा पूरोः सकाशं वै स्वां जरां प्रत्यपद्यत । संप्राप्य स तु तान्कामांस्तृप्तः खिन्नश्च पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: gatvā pūroḥ sakāśaṃ vai svāṃ jarāṃ pratyapadyata / saṃprāpya sa tu tānkāmāṃstṛptaḥ khinnaśca pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: एते षट्कोणगाः कि च बच्नुशास्त्वश्कोणके । विव्याध्यन्नपतिश्चेव हरिकेगोपवीतिनौ
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: कालं वर्षसहस्रं वै सस्मार मनुजाधिपः । परिसंख्याय काले च कलाः काष्ठास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kālaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai sasmāra manujādhipaḥ / parisaṃkhyāya kāle ca kalāḥ kāṣṭhāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णं मत्वा ततः कालं पूरुं पुत्रमुवाच ह । यथा सुखं यथोत्साहं यथाकालमरिन्दम
verses.transliteration: pūrṇaṃ matvā tataḥ kālaṃ pūruṃ putramuvāca ha / yathā sukhaṃ yathotsāhaṃ yathākālamarindama
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: ये तो षट्कोणं में स्थित हैं और अष्ट कोणों में बहुत से हैं। निव्योधिं--हरिकेश--उपचीती--पृष्टों के पति--भव--हेति हैं। दश पत्र आवरण में प्रथम जगतों के पति हैं (८-६ रुद्व-अततावी--झेत्रपति--तथा सूत--अहंतु अन्य पति--रोहित और स्थपति हैं ॥१० अन्य वृक्षों का पति-
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: सेविता विषयः पुत्र यौवनेन मया तव । पूरो प्रीतो ऽस्मि भद्रं ते गृहाण त्वं स्वयौवनम्
verses.transliteration: sevitā viṣayaḥ putra yauvanena mayā tava / pūro prīto 'smi bhadraṃ te gṛhāṇa tvaṃ svayauvanam
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: ये धनुष को सुसज्जित रखने वाले हैं। मस्त्री-वाणिज-कक्ष पति-भवस्ति 'चौया और पाँचवाँ वाग्बिस्तत है। ओषधियों के पति-छठवां है कलश सम्भव है ।११-१२। उच्चंघोंष-आक्रन्दयन्त तथा पतियों का पति है। कृत्स्न वीत-घाव-सत्वों का पति--ये इतने द्वादश पन्नों में स्थित हैं जो पञ्चम
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं च त्वं गृहाणेदं त्वं हि मे प्रियकृत्सुतः । प्रतिपेदे जरां राजा ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः
verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ ca tvaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ tvaṃ hi me priyakṛtsutaḥ / pratipede jarāṃ rājā yayātirnahuṣātmajaḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: आवरण में वतंमान रहते हैं । सहमान तिर्व्याधि-के पति हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: यौवनं प्रतिपेदे च पूरुः स्वं पुनरात्मनः । अभिषेक्तुकामं च नृपं पूरुं पुत्रं कनीयसम्
verses.transliteration: yauvanaṃ pratipede ca pūruḥ svaṃ punarātmanaḥ / abhiṣektukāmaṃ ca nṛpaṃ pūruṃ putraṃ kanīyasam
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणप्रमुखा वर्णा इदं वचनमब्रुवन् । कथं शुक्रस्य नप्तारं देवयान्याः सुतं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇapramukhā varṇā idaṃ vacanamabruvan / kathaṃ śukrasya naptāraṃ devayānyāḥ sutaṃ prabho
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: अधः परिच रो3रण्य: पतिः कि च सृकाविषः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठं यदुमतिक्रम्य राज्यं दास्यसि पूरवे । यदुर्ज्येष्ठस्तव सुतो जातस्तमनुदतुर्वसुः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhaṃ yadumatikramya rājyaṃ dāsyasi pūrave / yadurjyeṣṭhastava suto jātastamanudaturvasuḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: शर्मिष्ठायाः सुतो द्रुह्युस्ततो ऽनुः पूरुरेव च । कथं ज्येष्ठानतिक्रम्य कनीयान्राज्यमर्हति । सुतः संबोधयामस्त्वां धर्मं समनुपालय
verses.transliteration: śarmiṣṭhāyāḥ suto druhyustato 'nuḥ pūrureva ca / kathaṃ jyeṣṭhānatikramya kanīyānrājyamarhati / sutaḥ saṃbodhayāmastvāṃ dharmaṃ samanupālaya
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: ययातिरुवाच ब्राह्मणप्रमुखा वर्णाः सर्वे शृण्वन्तु मे वचः
verses.transliteration: yayātiruvāca brāhmaṇapramukhā varṇāḥ sarve śṛṇvantu me vacaḥ
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."
verses.hindi: ककुभ--निषंग--स्तेनों के पति ओर निचचेरू-छठयें आवरण के
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.transliteration: sa putraḥ putravadyaśca varttate pitṛmātṛṣu / yadunāhamavajñātastathā turvasunāpi ca

verses.sanskrit: द्रुह्युना चानुना चैव मय्यवज्ञा कृता भृशम् । पूरुणा तु कृतं वाक्यं मानितश्च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: druhyunā cānunā caiva mayyavajñā kṛtā bhṛśam / pūruṇā tu kṛtaṃ vākyaṃ mānitaśca viśeṣataḥ

verses.sanskrit: कनीयान्मम दायादो जरा येन धृता मम । सर्वे कामा मम कृताः पूरुणा पुण्यकारिणा
verses.transliteration: kanīyānmama dāyādo jarā yena dhṛtā mama / sarve kāmā mama kṛtāḥ pūruṇā puṇyakāriṇā

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रेण च वरो दत्तः काव्येनोशनसा स्वयम् । पुत्रो यस्त्वानुवर्त्तेत स राजा तु महामते
verses.transliteration: śukreṇa ca varo dattaḥ kāvyenośanasā svayam / putro yastvānuvartteta sa rājā tu mahāmate
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: प्रजा ऊचुः भवतो ऽनुमतो ऽप्येवं पूरू राज्ये ऽभिषिच्यताम् । यः पुत्रो गुणसंपन्नो मातापित्रोर्हितः सदा
verses.transliteration: prajā ūcuḥ bhavato 'numato 'pyevaṃ pūrū rājye 'bhiṣicyatām / yaḥ putro guṇasaṃpanno mātāpitrorhitaḥ sadā

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमर्हति कल्याणं कनीयानपि स प्रभुः । अर्हे ऽस्य पूरू राज्यस्य यः प्रियः प्रियकृत्तव
verses.transliteration: sarvamarhati kalyāṇaṃ kanīyānapi sa prabhuḥ / arhe 'sya pūrū rājyasya yaḥ priyaḥ priyakṛttava
verses.translation: The pleasure of love in the world, the great pleasure of heaven, do not deserve to be on a par with a sixteenth part of the pleasure of destruction of covetousness."

verses.sanskrit: वरदानेन शुक्रस्य न शक्यं वक्तुमुत्तरम् । पौरजान पदैस्तुष्टैरित्युक्ते नाहुषस्तदा
verses.transliteration: varadānena śukrasya na śakyaṃ vaktumuttaram / paurajāna padaistuṣṭairityukte nāhuṣastadā

verses.hindi: धन्वकारा मृगयवः श्वनयः श्वान एव च ।

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिच्य ततः पूरुं स राज्ये सुतमात्मनः । दिशि दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां तुर्वसुं तु न्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration: abhiṣicya tataḥ pūruṃ sa rājye sutamātmanaḥ / diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ turvasuṃ tu nyaveśayat

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणापरतो राजा यदुं ज्येष्ठं न्यवेशयत् । प्रतीच्यामुत्तरस्यां च द्रुह्युं चानुं च तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāparato rājā yaduṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nyaveśayat / pratīcyāmuttarasyāṃ ca druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca tāvubhau

verses.hindi: और गृत्स ये अष्टमावृति में अष्टादश नामक देवता हैं। इसके

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपां ययातिस्तु जित्वा पृथ्वीं ससागराम् । व्यभजत्पञ्चधा राजा पुत्रेभ्यो नाहुषस्तदा
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpāṃ yayātistu jitvā pṛthvīṃ sasāgarām / vyabhajatpañcadhā rājā putrebhyo nāhuṣastadā
