verses.sanskrit: तेषामुत्सादनार्थाय उत्पन्ना यादवे कुले । समुत्पन्नं कुलशतं यादवानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāmutsādanārthāya utpannā yādave kule / samutpannaṃ kulaśataṃ yādavānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of the Devas viz. — Sahasrajit the excellent one (or the eldest), Krosfu, Nila, Aftjika and Laghu.
verses.wordMeaning: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of the Devas viz. — Sahasrajit the excellent one (or the eldest), Krosfu, Nila, Aftjika and Laghu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of the Devas viz. — Sahasrajit the excellent one (or the eldest), Krosfu, Nila, Aftjika and Laghu.

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रसूतिर्वृष्णीनां समासव्यासयोगतः । कीर्त्तिता कीर्त्तनीया स कीर्त्तिसिद्धिमभीप्सता
verses.transliteration: iti prasūtirvṛṣṇīnāṃ samāsavyāsayogataḥ / kīrttitā kīrttanīyā sa kīrttisiddhimabhīpsatā
verses.translation: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of the Devas viz. — Sahasrajit the excellent one (or the eldest), Krosfu, Nila, Aftjika and Laghu.
verses.wordMeaning: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of the Devas viz. — Sahasrajit the excellent one (or the eldest), Krosfu, Nila, Aftjika and Laghu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of the Devas viz. — Sahasrajit the excellent one (or the eldest), Krosfu, Nila, Aftjika and Laghu.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपदे वृष्णिवंशानुकीर्त्तनं नामैकसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ७१॥ सूत उवाच मनुष्यप्रकृतीन्देवान्कीर्त्यमानान्निबोधत । संकर्षणो वासुदेवः प्रद्युम्नः सांब एव च
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapade vṛṣṇivaṃśānukīrttanaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 71// sūta uvāca manuṣyaprakṛtīndevānkīrtyamānānnibodhata / saṃkarṣaṇo vāsudevaḥ pradyumnaḥ sāṃba eva ca
verses.translation: In the different Yugas, they (the learned sages) call him the lord with a thousand feet, a thousand rays, a thousand forms) and a thousand heads.
verses.wordMeaning: In the different Yugas, they (the learned sages) call him the lord with a thousand feet, a thousand rays, a thousand forms) and a thousand heads.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the different Yugas, they (the learned sages) call him the lord with a thousand feet, a thousand rays, a thousand forms) and a thousand heads.

verses.sanskrit: अनिरुद्धश्च पञ्चैते वंशवीराः प्रकीर्त्तिताः । सप्तर्ष्यः कुबेरश्च यज्ञे मणिवरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: aniruddhaśca pañcaite vaṃśavīrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ / saptarṣyaḥ kuberaśca yajñe maṇivarastathā
verses.translation: Formerly, on account of the intensity of her austeri- ties, Aditi, who is an Arani (i.e. source of origin) of the Suras (gods) accommodated in her womb the lord as well as Indra. It was the lord who kept the group of Daityas very much under check and restraint by the miscarriage of pregnancy (i.e. Daitya women became afraid of the lord so much so that they had abortions).
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, on account of the intensity of her austeri- ties, Aditi, who is an Arani (i.e. source of origin) of the Suras (gods) accommodated in her womb the lord as well as Indra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, on account of the intensity of her austeri- ties, Aditi, who is an Arani (i.e. source of origin) of the Suras (gods) accommodated in her womb the lord as well as Indra.…

verses.sanskrit: शालूकिर्नारदश्चैव विद्वान्धन्वन्तरिश्तथा । नन्दिनश्च महादेवः सालकायन एव च । आदिदेव स्तदा विष्णुरेभिश्च सह दैवतैः
verses.transliteration: śālūkirnāradaścaiva vidvāndhanvantariśtathā / nandinaśca mahādevaḥ sālakāyana eva ca / ādideva stadā viṣṇurebhiśca saha daivataiḥ
verses.translation: It was the lord who created all types of sacri- fices and the necessary adjuncts thereof. He duly created the sacred fires of Garhapatya and Ahavanlya and the monthly Srftddha rite of Anvaharya. He created the various adjuncts of sacrifice such as the Vedi (Altar), the KuSa grass, the Sruvd (holy ladle), water for consecrating (Proksaniya etc.), the Sruta (holy texts and Mantras) and the Avabkrtkya (holy water for purificatory bath at the conclusion of a sacrifice.
verses.wordMeaning: It was the lord who created all types of sacri- fices and the necessary adjuncts thereof. He duly created the sacred fires of Garhapatya and Ahavanlya and the monthly Srftddha rite of Anvaharya. He created the various adjuncts of sacrifice such as the Vedi (Altar),…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was the lord who created all types of sacri- fices and the necessary adjuncts thereof. He duly created the sacred fires of Garhapatya and Ahavanlya and the monthly Srftddha rite of Anvaharya. He created the various adjuncts of sacrifice such as the Vedi (Altar),…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः विष्णुः किमर्थं संभूतः स्मृताः संभूतयः कति । भविष्याः कति चान्ये च प्रादुर्भावा महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ viṣṇuḥ kimarthaṃ saṃbhūtaḥ smṛtāḥ saṃbhūtayaḥ kati / bhaviṣyāḥ kati cānye ca prādurbhāvā mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 42-51 contain ancient ideas about embryology.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 42-51 contain ancient ideas about embryology.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 42-51 contain ancient ideas about embryology.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मक्षत्रेषु शस्तेषु किमर्थमिह जायते । पुनः पुनर्मनुष्येषु तन्नः प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: brahmakṣatreṣu śasteṣu kimarthamiha jāyate / punaḥ punarmanuṣyeṣu tannaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām
verses.translation: These two Evolutes follow Rasa. In *the Semen the moon and the fire are present. Semen belongs to the category of Kapha (a humour in the body) and Menstrual blood shall be in the category of Pitta (Bile, a humour in the body).
verses.wordMeaning: These two Evolutes follow Rasa. In *the Semen the moon and the fire are present. Semen belongs to the category of Kapha (a humour in the body) and Menstrual blood shall be in the category of Pitta (Bile, a humour in the body).
verses.commentary: Sense: These two Evolutes follow Rasa. In *the Semen the moon and the fire are present. Semen belongs to the category of Kapha (a humour in the body) and Menstrual blood shall be in the category of Pitta (Bile, a humour in the body).

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरेणैव सर्वाणि कर्माणि रिपुघातिनः
verses.transliteration: vistareṇaiva sarvāṇi karmāṇi ripughātinaḥ
verses.translation: The five vital airs are Prana, Apana, Samana, Udana and Vyana. The vital air Prana moves round developing the great soul.
verses.wordMeaning: The five vital airs are Prana, Apana, Samana, Udana and Vyana. The vital air Prana moves round developing the great soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five vital airs are Prana, Apana, Samana, Udana and Vyana. The vital air Prana moves round developing the great soul.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतुमिच्छामहे सम्यग्वद कृष्णस्य धीमतः । कर्मणामानुपूर्वीं च प्रादुर्भावाश्च ये प्रभो
verses.transliteration: śrotumicchāmahe samyagvada kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ / karmaṇāmānupūrvīṃ ca prādurbhāvāśca ye prabho
verses.translation: Apana develops the lower body. Udana develops •half of the soul, Vydna is so called because it is scattered (i.e. spreads all over the body). Samdna is present in every Joint.
verses.wordMeaning: Apana develops the lower body. Udana develops •half of the soul, Vydna is so called because it is scattered (i.e. spreads all over the body). Samdna is present in every Joint.
verses.commentary: Sense: Apana develops the lower body. Udana develops •half of the soul, Vydna is so called because it is scattered (i.e. spreads all over the body). Samdna is present in every Joint.

verses.sanskrit: या वास्य प्रकृतिस्तात तां चास्मान्वक्तुमर्हसि । कथं स भगवान्विष्णुः सुरेष्वरिनिषूदनः
verses.transliteration: yā vāsya prakṛtistāta tāṃ cāsmānvaktumarhasi / kathaṃ sa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sureṣvariniṣūdanaḥ
verses.translation: How did Visnu attain the state of being a man in this mortal world? O intelligent one, this is our doubt. This is a great wonder, a miracle.
verses.wordMeaning: How did Visnu attain the state of being a man in this mortal world? O intelligent one, this is our doubt. This is a great wonder, a miracle.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did Visnu attain the state of being a man in this mortal world? O intelligent one, this is our doubt. This is a great wonder, a miracle.

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवकुले धीमान्वासुदेवत्वमागतः । अमरैरावृतं पुण्यं पुण्यकृद्भिरलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: vasudevakule dhīmānvāsudevatvamāgataḥ / amarairāvṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyakṛdbhiralaṅkṛtam
verses.translation: When the yuga-dharma (the devout activities peculiar to a Yuga) becomes reversed, when the time becomes slack and ineffective, the lord is born among human beings in order to establish Dharma (Virtue). (These incarnations are) due to the curse of Bhrgu brought about by the Devas and Asuras.
verses.wordMeaning: When the yuga-dharma (the devout activities peculiar to a Yuga) becomes reversed, when the time becomes slack and ineffective, the lord is born among human beings in order to establish Dharma (Virtue).…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the yuga-dharma (the devout activities peculiar to a Yuga) becomes reversed, when the time becomes slack and ineffective, the lord is born among human beings in order to establish Dharma (Virtue).…

verses.sanskrit: देवलोकं किमुत्सृज्य मर्त्यलोकमिहागतः । देवमानुषयोर्नेता धातुर्यः प्रसवो हरिः
verses.transliteration: devalokaṃ kimutsṛjya martyalokamihāgataḥ / devamānuṣayornetā dhāturyaḥ prasavo hariḥ
verses.translation: How did the lord become subject to this utterance — "brought about by the Devas and Asuras". This we wish to understand. What for and how did this incident of the Devas and Asuras take p lace.
verses.wordMeaning: How did the lord become subject to this utterance — "brought about by the Devas and Asuras". This we wish to understand. What for and how did this incident of the Devas and Asuras take p lace.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the lord become subject to this utterance — "brought about by the Devas and Asuras". This we wish to understand. What for and how did this incident of the Devas and Asuras take p lace.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं दिव्यमात्मानं मानुष्ये समवेशयत् । यश्चक्रं वर्त्तयत्येको मनुष्याणां मनोमयम्
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ divyamātmānaṃ mānuṣye samaveśayat / yaścakraṃ varttayatyeko manuṣyāṇāṃ manomayam
verses.translation: In this Varaha Kalpa, twelve ending with Saruja- marka are remembered.1 Even as I recount them listen to them succinctly by their names.
verses.wordMeaning: In this Varaha Kalpa, twelve ending with Saruja- marka are remembered.1 Even as I recount them listen to them succinctly by their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this Varaha Kalpa, twelve ending with Saruja- marka are remembered.1 Even as I recount them listen to them succinctly by their names.

verses.sanskrit: मानुष्ये स कथं बुद्धिं चक्रे चक्रभृतां वरः । गोपायन यः कुरुते जगतः सर्वकालिकम्
verses.transliteration: mānuṣye sa kathaṃ buddhiṃ cakre cakrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / gopāyana yaḥ kurute jagataḥ sarvakālikam
verses.translation: VV.72- 126 describe the incarnations of Vi $nu. The list of these is different in this Pur&na. vide — Introduction — Vaisnavism.
verses.wordMeaning: VV.72- 126 describe the incarnations of Vi $nu. The list of these is different in this Pur&na. vide — Introduction — Vaisnavism.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.72- 126 describe the incarnations of Vi $nu. The list of these is different in this Pur&na. vide — Introduction — Vaisnavism.

verses.sanskrit: स कथं गां गतो विष्णुर्गोपत्वमकरोत्प्रभुः । महाभूतानि भूतात्मा यो दधार चकार ह
verses.transliteration: sa kathaṃ gāṃ gato viṣṇurgopatvamakarotprabhuḥ / mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā yo dadhāra cakāra ha
verses.translation: Hiranyakasipu shone as the king and ruler of the three worlds for ten crores of years increased by seven million and two hundred and eighty thousand years.
verses.wordMeaning: Hiranyakasipu shone as the king and ruler of the three worlds for ten crores of years increased by seven million and two hundred and eighty thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyakasipu shone as the king and ruler of the three worlds for ten crores of years increased by seven million and two hundred and eighty thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगर्भः स कथं गर्भे स्त्रिया भूचरया वृतः । येन लोकान्क्रमैर्जित्वा सश्रीकास्त्रिदशाः कृताः
verses.transliteration: śrīgarbhaḥ sa kathaṃ garbhe striyā bhūcarayā vṛtaḥ / yena lokānkramairjitvā saśrīkāstridaśāḥ kṛtāḥ
verses.translation: As a hereditary ruler Bali reigned for ten crores thirty million and sixty thousand years (i.e. 13 crores and 60 thousand years).
verses.wordMeaning: As a hereditary ruler Bali reigned for ten crores thirty million and sixty thousand years (i.e. 13 crores and 60 thousand years).
verses.commentary: Sense: As a hereditary ruler Bali reigned for ten crores thirty million and sixty thousand years (i.e. 13 crores and 60 thousand years).

verses.sanskrit: स्थापिता जगतो मार्गास्त्रिक्रमं वपुराहृतम् । ददौ जितां वसुमतीं सुराणां सुरसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sthāpitā jagato mārgāstrikramaṃ vapurāhṛtam / dadau jitāṃ vasumatīṃ surāṇāṃ surasattamaḥ
verses.translation: In the company of Raksasas, Prahlada reigned victorious for as many years as the period of administration of Bali.
verses.wordMeaning: In the company of Raksasas, Prahlada reigned victorious for as many years as the period of administration of Bali.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the company of Raksasas, Prahlada reigned victorious for as many years as the period of administration of Bali.

verses.sanskrit: येन सैंहं वपुः कृत्वा द्विधाकृत्वा च तत्पुनः । पूर्वदैत्यो महावीर्यो हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः
verses.transliteration: yena saiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā dvidhākṛtvā ca tatpunaḥ / pūrvadaityo mahāvīryo hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ
verses.translation: These three were very famous as the Indras of the Asuras. They had great brilliance, strength and splendour.
verses.wordMeaning: These three were very famous as the Indras of the Asuras. They had great brilliance, strength and splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: These three were very famous as the Indras of the Asuras. They had great brilliance, strength and splendour.

verses.sanskrit: यः पुरा ह्यनलो भूत्वा त्वौर्वः संवर्त्तको विभुः । पातालस्थोर्ऽणवगतः पपौ तोयमयं हविः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ purā hyanalo bhūtvā tvaurvaḥ saṃvarttako vibhuḥ / pātālasthor'ṇavagataḥ papau toyamayaṃ haviḥ
verses.translation: " Why has this happened? Even as we are widely awake, Yajiia has abandoned our kingdom and gone to the Devas. We cannot stay here to-day. Let us enter Rasa tala".
verses.wordMeaning: " Why has this happened? Even as we are widely awake, Yajiia has abandoned our kingdom and gone to the Devas. We cannot stay here to-day. Let us enter Rasa tala".
verses.commentary: Sense: " Why has this happened? Even as we are widely awake, Yajiia has abandoned our kingdom and gone to the Devas. We cannot stay here to-day. Let us enter Rasa tala".

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रचरणं देवं सहस्रांशुं सहस्रशः । सहस्रशिरसं देवं यमाहुर्वै युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: sahasracaraṇaṃ devaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasraśaḥ / sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ yamāhurvai yuge yuge
verses.translation: On being told thus, Sukra became dejected. Con- soling them with his words he said — "O Asuras, do not be afraid. I shall sustain you all by means of my spiritual brilliance.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, Sukra became dejected. Con- soling them with his words he said — "O Asuras, do not be afraid. I shall sustain you all by means of my spiritual brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, Sukra became dejected. Con- soling them with his words he said — "O Asuras, do not be afraid. I shall sustain you all by means of my spiritual brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: नाभ्यरण्यां समुद्भूतं यस्य पैतामहं गृहम् । एकार्णवगते लोके तत्पङ्कजमपङ्कजम्
verses.transliteration: nābhyaraṇyāṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasya paitāmahaṃ gṛham / ekārṇavagate loke tatpaṅkajamapaṅkajam
verses.translation: Rainfall, medicinal herbs, Rasd (the world) and other things whatsoever — let all these things entirely remain with the Suras. The sin will be theirs (?)
verses.wordMeaning: Rainfall, medicinal herbs, Rasd (the world) and other things whatsoever — let all these things entirely remain with the Suras. The sin will be theirs (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Rainfall, medicinal herbs, Rasd (the world) and other things whatsoever — let all these things entirely remain with the Suras. The sin will be theirs (?)

verses.sanskrit: येन ते निहता दैत्याः संग्रामे तारकामये । सर्वदेवमयं कृत्वा सर्वायुधधरं वपुः
verses.transliteration: yena te nihatā daityāḥ saṃgrāme tārakāmaye / sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvāyudhadharaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the excited Devas approached Danavas and killed them. On being killed by them, Danavas rushed to Kavya himself.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the excited Devas approached Danavas and killed them. On being killed by them, Danavas rushed to Kavya himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the excited Devas approached Danavas and killed them. On being killed by them, Danavas rushed to Kavya himself.

verses.sanskrit: महाबलेन वोत्सिक्तः कालनेमिर्निपातितः । उत्तरांशे समुद्रस्य क्षीरोदस्यामृतोदधेः । यः शेतेशश्वतं योगमाच्छाद्य तिमिरं महत्
verses.transliteration: mahābalena votsiktaḥ kālanemirnipātitaḥ / uttarāṃśe samudrasya kṣīrodasyāmṛtodadheḥ / yaḥ śeteśaśvataṃ yogamācchādya timiraṃ mahat
verses.translation: On seeing them suddenly attacked by the Devas Kavya protected the frightened sons of Diti from the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them suddenly attacked by the Devas Kavya protected the frightened sons of Diti from the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them suddenly attacked by the Devas Kavya protected the frightened sons of Diti from the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सुरारणीगर्भमधत्त दिव्यं तपःप्रकर्षाददितिः पुरायम् । शक्रं च यो दैत्यगणं च रूद्धं गर्भावमानेन भृशं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: surāraṇīgarbhamadhatta divyaṃ tapaḥprakarṣādaditiḥ purāyam / śakraṃ ca yo daityagaṇaṃ ca rūddhaṃ garbhāvamānena bhṛśaṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: On seeing the Devas taking up the weapons once again, all the groups of Asuras rose up suddenly. They became frightened.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Devas taking up the weapons once again, all the groups of Asuras rose up suddenly. They became frightened.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Devas taking up the weapons once again, all the groups of Asuras rose up suddenly. They became frightened.

verses.sanskrit: पदानि यो लोकपदानि कृत्वा चकार दैत्यान्सलिलेशयांस्तान् । कृत्वा च देवांस्त्रिदिवस्य देवांश्चक्रे सुरेशं पुरुहूतमेव
verses.transliteration: padāni yo lokapadāni kṛtvā cakāra daityānsalileśayāṃstān / kṛtvā ca devāṃstridivasya devāṃścakre sureśaṃ puruhūtameva
verses.translation: Thereafter, those frightened Asuras resorted (to her). Freedom from fear (Assurance of protection) was granted by her to those frightened Daityas who sought freedom from fear.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, those frightened Asuras resorted (to her). Freedom from fear (Assurance of protection) was granted by her to those frightened Daityas who sought freedom from fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, those frightened Asuras resorted (to her). Freedom from fear (Assurance of protection) was granted by her to those frightened Daityas who sought freedom from fear.

verses.sanskrit: गार्हपत्येन विधिना अन्वाहार्येण कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: gārhapatyena vidhinā anvāhāryeṇa karmaṇā
verses.translation: Our seeing the Asuras being taken under her protection, the Devas p mdered over their strength and weak- ness and then struck at the Asuras violently.
verses.wordMeaning: Our seeing the Asuras being taken under her protection, the Devas p mdered over their strength and weak- ness and then struck at the Asuras violently.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our seeing the Asuras being taken under her protection, the Devas p mdered over their strength and weak- ness and then struck at the Asuras violently.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमाहवनीयं च वेदीं चैव कुशं स्रुवम् । प्रोक्षणीयं श्रुतं चैव आवभृथ्यं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: agnimāhavanīyaṃ ca vedīṃ caiva kuśaṃ sruvam / prokṣaṇīyaṃ śrutaṃ caiva āvabhṛthyaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: On seeing the Asuras being slain by the Devas, the infuriated gentle lady (the mother of the preceptor) spoke to them "I shall cause the destruction of Indra".
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Asuras being slain by the Devas, the infuriated gentle lady (the mother of the preceptor) spoke to them "I shall cause the destruction of Indra".
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Asuras being slain by the Devas, the infuriated gentle lady (the mother of the preceptor) spoke to them "I shall cause the destruction of Indra".

verses.sanskrit: अथर्षींश्चैव यश्चक्रे हव्यभागप्रदान्मखे । हव्यादांश्च सुरांश्चक्रे कव्यादांश्च पितॄनपि । भोगार्थं यज्ञविधिना यो यज्ञो यज्ञकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: atharṣīṃścaiva yaścakre havyabhāgapradānmakhe / havyādāṃśca surāṃścakre kavyādāṃśca pitṝnapi / bhogārthaṃ yajñavidhinā yo yajño yajñakarmaṇi
verses.translation: "Enter me, O lord of Suras," said he. "Welfare unto you. I shall take you away".
verses.wordMeaning: "Enter me, O lord of Suras," said he. "Welfare unto you. I shall take you away".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Enter me, O lord of Suras," said he. "Welfare unto you. I shall take you away".

verses.sanskrit: यूपान्समित्स्रुवं सोमं पवित्रं परिधीनपि । यज्ञियानि च द्रव्याणि यज्ञियांश्च तथानलान्
verses.transliteration: yūpānsamitsruvaṃ somaṃ pavitraṃ paridhīnapi / yajñiyāni ca dravyāṇi yajñiyāṃśca tathānalān
verses.translation: On observing that horrible slaughter of a woman his wife, Bhrgu the powerful one became angry. Then, due to the murder of his wife, Visnu was cursed by Bhtgu.
verses.wordMeaning: On observing that horrible slaughter of a woman his wife, Bhrgu the powerful one became angry. Then, due to the murder of his wife, Visnu was cursed by Bhtgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing that horrible slaughter of a woman his wife, Bhrgu the powerful one became angry. Then, due to the murder of his wife, Visnu was cursed by Bhtgu.

verses.sanskrit: सदस्यान्यजमानांश्च ह्यश्वमेधान्क्रतुत्तमान् । विचित्रान्राजसूयदीन्पारमेष्ठ्येन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: sadasyānyajamānāṃśca hyaśvamedhānkratuttamān / vicitrānrājasūyadīnpārameṣṭhyena karmaṇā
verses.translation: "Since a woman who should not be killed has been killed by you, though you are conversant with what is righteousness, you will have to take birth among human beings for seven times".
verses.wordMeaning: "Since a woman who should not be killed has been killed by you, though you are conversant with what is righteousness, you will have to take birth among human beings for seven times".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since a woman who should not be killed has been killed by you, though you are conversant with what is righteousness, you will have to take birth among human beings for seven times".

verses.sanskrit: उद्गात्रादींश्च यः कृत्वा यज्ञांल्लोकाननुक्रमम् । क्षणा निमेषाः काष्ठाश्च कलास्त्रैकाल्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: udgātrādīṃśca yaḥ kṛtvā yajñāṃllokānanukramam / kṣaṇā nimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāśca kalāstraikālyameva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter on account of that curse the lord is born again and again among human beings here (in this world), for the welfare of all the worlds, whenever there is a destruc- tion of piety and virtue.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter on account of that curse the lord is born again and again among human beings here (in this world), for the welfare of all the worlds, whenever there is a destruc- tion of piety and virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter on account of that curse the lord is born again and again among human beings here (in this world), for the welfare of all the worlds, whenever there is a destruc- tion of piety and virtue.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्त्तास्तिथयो मासा दिनं संवत्सरं तथा । ऋतवः कालयोगाश्च प्रमाणं त्रिविधं त्रिषु
verses.transliteration: muhūrttāstithayo māsā dinaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tathā / ṛtavaḥ kālayogāśca pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ triṣu
verses.translation: After speaking to Visnu, he himself took up the head and joined it to the body. After putting them together, he spoke these words -
verses.wordMeaning: After speaking to Visnu, he himself took up the head and joined it to the body. After putting them together, he spoke these words -
verses.commentary: Sense: After speaking to Visnu, he himself took up the head and joined it to the body. After putting them together, he spoke these words -

verses.sanskrit: आयुः क्षेत्राण्यथ बलं क्षणं यद्रूपसौष्ठवम् । मेधावित्वं च शौर्यं च शास्त्रस्येव च पारणम्
verses.transliteration: āyuḥ kṣetrāṇyatha balaṃ kṣaṇaṃ yadrūpasauṣṭhavam / medhāvitvaṃ ca śauryaṃ ca śāstrasyeva ca pāraṇam
verses.translation: After granting this boon to that son ofBhrgu, Bhava further gave him the status of a Prajapati (patriarch), the status of being the presiding deity of wealth and immunity from death.
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to that son ofBhrgu, Bhava further gave him the status of a Prajapati (patriarch), the status of being the presiding deity of wealth and immunity from death.
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to that son ofBhrgu, Bhava further gave him the status of a Prajapati (patriarch), the status of being the presiding deity of wealth and immunity from death.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयो वर्णास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रैविद्यं पावकास्त्रयः । त्रैकाल्यं त्रीणि कर्माणि तिस्रो मात्रा गुणास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: trayo varṇāstrayo lokāstraividyaṃ pāvakāstrayaḥ / traikālyaṃ trīṇi karmāṇi tisro mātrā guṇāstrayaḥ
verses.translation: Tatnra (the Copper-coloured one), Bhima (the terrible one), Ugra (the formidable), Siva (the benevolent one), Mahddeva (the great god), Sarva (Identical with everything), VisvarupaSiva ( omnipresent and auspicious ).
verses.wordMeaning: Tatnra (the Copper-coloured one), Bhima (the terrible one), Ugra (the formidable), Siva (the benevolent one), Mahddeva (the great god), Sarva (Identical with everything), VisvarupaSiva ( omnipresent and auspicious ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Tatnra (the Copper-coloured one), Bhima (the terrible one), Ugra (the formidable), Siva (the benevolent one), Mahddeva (the great god), Sarva (Identical with everything), VisvarupaSiva ( omnipresent and auspicious ).

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टा लोकेश्वराश्चैव येन येन च कर्मणा । सर्वभूतगणाः सृष्टाः सर्वभूतगणात्मना
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭā lokeśvarāścaiva yena yena ca karmaṇā / sarvabhūtagaṇāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ sarvabhūtagaṇātmanā
verses.translation: fliranya (abounding in gold — so the bestower of gold) Vasifjha (identical with sage Vasistha), Vara (causing rain), Madhyama (the middle one), Dhdman (the asylum), PiSanga (the tawny-coloured), Pingala (the reddish brown-coloured), Arutja (the pink-coloured).
verses.wordMeaning: fliranya (abounding in gold — so the bestower of gold) Vasifjha (identical with sage Vasistha), Vara (causing rain), Madhyama (the middle one), Dhdman (the asylum), PiSanga (the tawny-coloured), Pingala (the reddish brown-coloured), Arutja (the pink-coloured).
verses.commentary: Sense: fliranya (abounding in gold — so the bestower of gold) Vasifjha (identical with sage Vasistha), Vara (causing rain), Madhyama (the middle one), Dhdman (the asylum), PiSanga (the tawny-coloured), Pingala (the reddish brown-coloured), Arutja (the pink-coloured).

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं संधाय पूर्वेण योगेन रमते च यः । गतागतानां यो नेता सर्वत्र विविधेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇaṃ saṃdhāya pūrveṇa yogena ramate ca yaḥ / gatāgatānāṃ yo netā sarvatra vividheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Pinakin (wielding the bow Pinaka), I$umdn (possess- ing arrows), Cilra ( the variegated one, the miraculous one), Rohita (Maroon-coloured), Dundubhya (worthy of being honour- ed with the sound of wardrum), Ekapdda ( having a single foot )>Arha (the Deserving one), Buddhi (the intelligent one), Mrgavyddha (one who had assumed the form of a hunter of deer in Daksa's sacrifice), Sarva (immanent in everything), Sthdnu (standing steady), Bhi$ana (the terrible one).
verses.wordMeaning: Pinakin (wielding the bow Pinaka), I$umdn (possess- ing arrows), Cilra ( the variegated one, the miraculous one), Rohita (Maroon-coloured), Dundubhya (worthy of being honour- ed with the sound of wardrum), Ekapdda ( having a single foot )>Arha (the Deserving one),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pinakin (wielding the bow Pinaka), I$umdn (possess- ing arrows), Cilra ( the variegated one, the miraculous one), Rohita (Maroon-coloured), Dundubhya (worthy of being honour- ed with the sound of wardrum), Ekapdda ( having a single foot )>Arha (the Deserving one),…

verses.sanskrit: यो गतिर्द्धर्मयुक्तानामगतिः पापकर्मणाम् । चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य प्रभवश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता
verses.transliteration: yo gatirddharmayuktānāmagatiḥ pāpakarmaṇām / cāturvarṇyasya prabhavaścāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā
verses.translation: Bahurupa (Multiple-formed), Ugra (the awful one), Trinetra (three-eyed), Uvara (the Supreme Ruler), Kapila (Identical with sage Kapila or Tawny-coloured), Ekavira (the sole hero), Mrtyu (The god of Death), Tryambaka (the three- eyed).
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurupa (Multiple-formed), Ugra (the awful one), Trinetra (three-eyed), Uvara (the Supreme Ruler), Kapila (Identical with sage Kapila or Tawny-coloured), Ekavira (the sole hero), Mrtyu (The god of Death), Tryambaka (the three- eyed).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurupa (Multiple-formed), Ugra (the awful one), Trinetra (three-eyed), Uvara (the Supreme Ruler), Kapila (Identical with sage Kapila or Tawny-coloured), Ekavira (the sole hero), Mrtyu (The god of Death), Tryambaka (the three- eyed).

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्विद्यस्य यो वेत्ता चातुराशम्यसंश्रयः । दिगन्तरं नभो भूमिरापो वायुर्विभावसुः
verses.transliteration: cāturvidyasya yo vettā cāturāśamyasaṃśrayaḥ / digantaraṃ nabho bhūmirāpo vāyurvibhāvasuḥ
verses.translation: Vdsto$pati ( Presiding deity and protector of build- ings), Pinaka (having the bow Pinaka), Sankara (one who brings happiness), Siva (the auspicious one), Aranya (the forest- dweller), Gr hast ha (the house-holder), Tati (Ascetic), Brahma - edrin (the religious student observing celibacy).
verses.wordMeaning: Vdsto$pati ( Presiding deity and protector of build- ings), Pinaka (having the bow Pinaka), Sankara (one who brings happiness), Siva (the auspicious one), Aranya (the forest- dweller), Gr hast ha (the house-holder), Tati (Ascetic),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vdsto$pati ( Presiding deity and protector of build- ings), Pinaka (having the bow Pinaka), Sankara (one who brings happiness), Siva (the auspicious one), Aranya (the forest- dweller), Gr hast ha (the house-holder), Tati (Ascetic),…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्यद्वयं ज्योतिर्युगेशाः क्षणदाचराः । यः परं श्रुयते देवो यः परं श्रूयते तपः
verses.transliteration: candrasūryadvayaṃ jyotiryugeśāḥ kṣaṇadācarāḥ / yaḥ paraṃ śruyate devo yaḥ paraṃ śrūyate tapaḥ
verses.translation: Sdnkhya (approachable through the philosophy of Sdnkhya), Toga (Accessible through Yogic practice), Dhydnin (meditating one), Dikfita (the initiated one), Antarhita (the
verses.wordMeaning: Sdnkhya (approachable through the philosophy of Sdnkhya), Toga (Accessible through Yogic practice), Dhydnin (meditating one), Dikfita (the initiated one), Antarhita (the
verses.commentary: Sense: Sdnkhya (approachable through the philosophy of Sdnkhya), Toga (Accessible through Yogic practice), Dhydnin (meditating one), Dikfita (the initiated one), Antarhita (the

verses.sanskrit: यः परं तमसः प्राहुर्यः परं परमात्मवान् । आदित्यादिस्तु यो देवो यश्च दैत्यान्तको विभुः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paraṃ tamasaḥ prāhuryaḥ paraṃ paramātmavān / ādityādistu yo devo yaśca daityāntako vibhuḥ
verses.translation: Buddha (the enlightened one), Suddha • (the pure one), Mukta (the liberated one), Kevala (the single one), Rodhas (staying on mountain slopes), Cekitdna (the intelligent one), Brahmin tha ( the proficient one in Vedas), Maharsi (Great Sage and Seer).
verses.wordMeaning: Buddha (the enlightened one), Suddha • (the pure one), Mukta (the liberated one), Kevala (the single one), Rodhas (staying on mountain slopes), Cekitdna (the intelligent one), Brahmin tha ( the proficient one in Vedas), Maharsi (Great Sage and Seer).
verses.commentary: Sense: Buddha (the enlightened one), Suddha • (the pure one), Mukta (the liberated one), Kevala (the single one), Rodhas (staying on mountain slopes), Cekitdna (the intelligent one), Brahmin tha ( the proficient one in Vedas), Maharsi (Great Sage and Seer).

verses.sanskrit: युगान्तेष्वन्तको यश्च यश्च लोकान्तकान्तकः । सेतुर्यो लोकसेतूनां मेधो यो मध्यकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: yugānteṣvantako yaśca yaśca lokāntakāntakaḥ / seturyo lokasetūnāṃ medho yo madhyakarmaṇām
verses.translation: Apratita (Unobserved), Dipta (the illuminated one) Bhdskara (Creator of lustre), Sumedhas (of excellent intellect), KrUra (the cruel one), Vikrta ( the deformed one), Bibhatsa (the hideous one), Siva ( the bestower of welfare).
verses.wordMeaning: Apratita (Unobserved), Dipta (the illuminated one) Bhdskara (Creator of lustre), Sumedhas (of excellent intellect), KrUra (the cruel one), Vikrta ( the deformed one), Bibhatsa (the hideous one), Siva ( the bestower of welfare).
verses.commentary: Sense: Apratita (Unobserved), Dipta (the illuminated one) Bhdskara (Creator of lustre), Sumedhas (of excellent intellect), KrUra (the cruel one), Vikrta ( the deformed one), Bibhatsa (the hideous one), Siva ( the bestower of welfare).

verses.sanskrit: वेद्यो यो वेदविदुषां प्रभुर्यः प्रभवात्मनाम् । सोमभूतस्तु भूतानामग्निभूतो ऽग्निवर्चसाम्
verses.transliteration: vedyo yo vedaviduṣāṃ prabhuryaḥ prabhavātmanām / somabhūtastu bhūtānāmagnibhūto 'gnivarcasām
verses.translation: Suci (the bright one), Paridhdna (the enveloping one), Sadyojdta (Newly born), AIrtyu (God of Death), Pisitasa (meat-eater), Sarva (the benign one), Megha (the cloud), Vaidyuta (the lightning).
verses.wordMeaning: Suci (the bright one), Paridhdna (the enveloping one), Sadyojdta (Newly born), AIrtyu (God of Death), Pisitasa (meat-eater), Sarva (the benign one), Megha (the cloud), Vaidyuta (the lightning).
verses.commentary: Sense: Suci (the bright one), Paridhdna (the enveloping one), Sadyojdta (Newly born), AIrtyu (God of Death), Pisitasa (meat-eater), Sarva (the benign one), Megha (the cloud), Vaidyuta (the lightning).

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां मनुर्भूतस्तपोभूतस्तपस्विनाम् । विनयो नयतृप्तानां तेजस्तेजस्विनामपि
verses.transliteration: manuṣyāṇāṃ manurbhūtastapobhūtastapasvinām / vinayo nayatṛptānāṃ tejastejasvināmapi
verses.translation: Dak$a (the skilful), Jaghanya (the lowest and last), Lokdnam Uvara (Lord of the worlds ), Andmaya ( free from illness) Idhma (the sacred fuel), Hiranya (Gold), Ekacak$us (single- eyed).
verses.wordMeaning: Dak$a (the skilful), Jaghanya (the lowest and last), Lokdnam Uvara (Lord of the worlds ), Andmaya ( free from illness) Idhma (the sacred fuel), Hiranya (Gold), Ekacak$us (single- eyed).
verses.commentary: Sense: Dak$a (the skilful), Jaghanya (the lowest and last), Lokdnam Uvara (Lord of the worlds ), Andmaya ( free from illness) Idhma (the sacred fuel), Hiranya (Gold), Ekacak$us (single- eyed).

verses.sanskrit: विग्रहो विग्रहाणां यो गतिर्गतिमतामपि । आकाशप्रभवो वायुर्वायुप्राणो हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: vigraho vigrahāṇāṃ yo gatirgatimatāmapi / ākāśaprabhavo vāyurvāyuprāṇo hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Sresfha (the most excellent), Vdmadeva (A handsome god), liana ( the ruling master), Dhimdn ( Intelligent), Mahdkalpa ( the great sacred precept), Dipta (the shining one), Rodana (crying one), Hdsa (the laughing one).
verses.wordMeaning: Sresfha (the most excellent), Vdmadeva (A handsome god), liana ( the ruling master), Dhimdn ( Intelligent), Mahdkalpa ( the great sacred precept), Dipta (the shining one), Rodana (crying one), Hdsa (the laughing one).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sresfha (the most excellent), Vdmadeva (A handsome god), liana ( the ruling master), Dhimdn ( Intelligent), Mahdkalpa ( the great sacred precept), Dipta (the shining one), Rodana (crying one), Hdsa (the laughing one).

verses.sanskrit: देवा हुताशनप्राणाः प्राणो ऽग्नेर्मधुसूदनः । रसाच्छोणितसंभूतिः शोणितान्मासमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: devā hutāśanaprāṇāḥ prāṇo 'gnermadhusūdanaḥ / rasācchoṇitasaṃbhūtiḥ śoṇitānmāsamucyate
verses.translation: Dr<)handhanvin (having a firm bow ), Kavacin (having the coat of mail), Rathin (having a chariot), Varuthin (having an army )9 Bhrgundtha (Lord of the Bhrgus), Sukra (the bright one or identical with Sukra), Gahvariffha (Resident of a cave), Dhimdn (Sensible).
verses.wordMeaning: Dr<)handhanvin (having a firm bow ), Kavacin (having the coat of mail), Rathin (having a chariot), Varuthin (having an army )9 Bhrgundtha (Lord of the Bhrgus), Sukra (the bright one or identical with Sukra), Gahvariffha (Resident of a cave), Dhimdn (Sensible).
verses.commentary: Sense: Dr<)handhanvin (having a firm bow ), Kavacin (having the coat of mail), Rathin (having a chariot), Varuthin (having an army )9 Bhrgundtha (Lord of the Bhrgus), Sukra (the bright one or identical with Sukra), Gahvariffha (Resident of a cave), Dhimdn (Sensible).

verses.sanskrit: मांसात्त मेदसो जन्म मेदसो ऽस्थि निरुच्यते । अस्य्नो मज्जा समभवन्मज्जातः शुक्रसंभवः
verses.transliteration: māṃsātta medaso janma medaso 'sthi nirucyate / asyno majjā samabhavanmajjātaḥ śukrasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Amogha (never failing), Praidnta (tranquil), Saddvi - prapriya (ever endearing to scholarly Brahmanas), Digvdsah
verses.wordMeaning: Amogha (never failing), Praidnta (tranquil), Saddvi - prapriya (ever endearing to scholarly Brahmanas), Digvdsah
verses.commentary: Sense: Amogha (never failing), Praidnta (tranquil), Saddvi - prapriya (ever endearing to scholarly Brahmanas), Digvdsah

verses.sanskrit: शुक्राद्गर्भः समाभव द्रसमूलेन कर्मणा । तत्रापां प्रथमावापः स सौम्यो राशिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śukrādgarbhaḥ samābhava drasamūlena karmaṇā / tatrāpāṃ prathamāvāpaḥ sa saumyo rāśirucyate
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Pams (Animals i.e. In- dividual Souls), to the lord of all elements, Prabhu (the lord), to Rk, Yajus, Saman, Svaha and Svadlia.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Pams (Animals i.e. In- dividual Souls), to the lord of all elements, Prabhu (the lord), to Rk, Yajus, Saman, Svaha and Svadlia.

verses.transliteration: garbho 'śmasaṃbhavo jñeyo dvitīyo rāśirucyate / śukraṃ somātmakaṃ vidyādārttavaṃ pāvakātmakam

verses.transliteration: bhāvau rasānugāvetau vīrye ca śaśipāvakau / kaphavarge bhavecchukraṃ pittavarge ca śoṇitam

verses.transliteration: kaphasya tdṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ nābhyāṃ pittaṃ pratiṣṭhitam / dehasya madhye tdṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ tu manasaḥ smṛtam

verses.transliteration: nābhiścodara saṃsthā tu tatra devo hutāśanaḥ / manaḥ prajāpatirjñeyaḥ kaphaḥ somo vibhāvyate

verses.transliteration: pittamagniḥ smṛto hyetadagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagat / evaṃ pravarttite garbhe vṛtte karkandhusaṃnibhe

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे स्तवसमाप्तिर्नाम द्विसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ७२॥ सूत उवाच एवमाराध्य देवेशमीशानं नीललोहितम् । प्रह्वो ऽतिप्रणतस्तस्मै प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्

verses.translation: After propitiating Isana, Nllalohitn, the lord of the Devas, Sukra the preceptor of Asuras remained humble after prostrating at his feet. With palms joined in reverence, he spoke the words (indicating his wish).
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating Isana, Nllalohitn, the lord of the Devas, Sukra the preceptor of Asuras remained humble after prostrating at his feet. With palms joined in reverence, he spoke the words (indicating his wish).
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating Isana, Nllalohitn, the lord of the Devas, Sukra the preceptor of Asuras remained humble after prostrating at his feet. With palms joined in reverence, he spoke the words (indicating his wish).

verses.sanskrit: काव्यस्य गात्रं संस्पृश्य हस्तेन प्रीतिमान्भवः । निकामं दर्शनं दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधाद्धरः
verses.transliteration: kāvyasya gātraṃ saṃspṛśya hastena prītimānbhavaḥ / nikāmaṃ darśanaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhāddharaḥ
verses.translation: After touching the body of the preceptor of the Asuras with his hand, the delighted lord, Hara, manifested himself to his view adequately and then vanished there itself.
verses.wordMeaning: After touching the body of the preceptor of the Asuras with his hand, the delighted lord, Hara, manifested himself to his view adequately and then vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After touching the body of the preceptor of the Asuras with his hand, the delighted lord, Hara, manifested himself to his view adequately and then vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सो ऽतर्हिते तास्मिन्देवे सानुचरे तदा । तिष्ठन्तीं प्राजलिर्भूत्वा जयन्तीमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ so 'tarhite tāsmindeve sānucare tadā / tiṣṭhantīṃ prājalirbhūtvā jayantīmidamabravīt
verses.translation: When the lord, along with his followers, had vanished Sukra the preceptor spoke these words to Jayanti who was standing there with palms joined in reverence.
verses.wordMeaning: When the lord, along with his followers, had vanished Sukra the preceptor spoke these words to Jayanti who was standing there with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord, along with his followers, had vanished Sukra the preceptor spoke these words to Jayanti who was standing there with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: कस्य त्वं सुभगे का वा दुःखिते मयि दुःखिता । सहता तपसा युक्तं किमर्थं मां जिगीष्सि
verses.transliteration: kasya tvaṃ subhage kā vā duḥkhite mayi duḥkhitā / sahatā tapasā yuktaṃ kimarthaṃ māṃ jigīṣsi
verses.translation: ''O gentle lady of great fortune, whom do you belong to? Who are you who underwent misery when I was in misery? Why are you vying with me who am endowed with great power of penance.
verses.wordMeaning: ''O gentle lady of great fortune, whom do you belong to? Who are you who underwent misery when I was in misery? Why are you vying with me who am endowed with great power of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O gentle lady of great fortune, whom do you belong to? Who are you who underwent misery when I was in misery? Why are you vying with me who am endowed with great power of penance.

verses.sanskrit: अनया सततं भक्त्या प्रश्रयेण दमेन च । स्नेहेन चैव सुश्रोणि प्रीतो ऽस्मि वरवर्णिनि
verses.transliteration: anayā satataṃ bhaktyā praśrayeṇa damena ca / snehena caiva suśroṇi prīto 'smi varavarṇini
verses.translation: O lady of exquisite hips and excellent complexion, I am highly pleased with this constant (unwavering), devotion, humility, self-control and affection.
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of exquisite hips and excellent complexion, I am highly pleased with this constant (unwavering), devotion, humility, self-control and affection.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of exquisite hips and excellent complexion, I am highly pleased with this constant (unwavering), devotion, humility, self-control and affection.

verses.sanskrit: किमिच्छसि वरारोहे कस्ते कामः समृद्ध्यताम् । तं ते संपूरयाम्यद्य यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभः
verses.transliteration: kimicchasi varārohe kaste kāmaḥ samṛddhyatām / taṃ te saṃpūrayāmyadya yadyapi syātsudurlabhaḥ
verses.translation: O beautiful lady, what do you wish? What desire of yours is to be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to gel, I shall get it fulfilled for you".
verses.wordMeaning: O beautiful lady, what do you wish? What desire of yours is to be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to gel, I shall get it fulfilled for you".
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful lady, what do you wish? What desire of yours is to be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to gel, I shall get it fulfilled for you".

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ताब्रवीदेनं तपसा ज्ञातुमर्हसि । चिकीर्षितं मे ब्रह्मिष्ठ त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktābravīdenaṃ tapasā jñātumarhasi / cikīrṣitaṃ me brahmiṣṭha tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham
verses.translation: On being told thus she said:
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus she said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus she said:

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो ऽब्रवीदेनां दृष्ट्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा । माहेन्द्री त्वं वरारोहे मद्धितार्थमिहागता
verses.transliteration: evamukto 'bravīdenāṃ dṛṣṭvā divyena cakṣuṣā / māhendrī tvaṃ varārohe maddhitārthamihāgatā
verses.translation: After coming to know that Sukra had returned with his object realised, all the sons of Diti became delighted. Desirous of seeing him, they went to his house.
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to know that Sukra had returned with his object realised, all the sons of Diti became delighted. Desirous of seeing him, they went to his house.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to know that Sukra had returned with his object realised, all the sons of Diti became delighted. Desirous of seeing him, they went to his house.

verses.sanskrit: मया सह त्वं सुश्रोणि दशवर्षाणि भामिनि । अदृश्यं सर्वभूतैस्तु संप्रयोगमिहेच्छसि
verses.transliteration: mayā saha tvaṃ suśroṇi daśavarṣāṇi bhāmini / adṛśyaṃ sarvabhūtaistu saṃprayogamihecchasi
verses.translation: Thereafter, the Asuras became afraid of the Devas. Hence, they hastened to follow Sukra, keeping Prahlada as their leader.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the Asuras became afraid of the Devas. Hence, they hastened to follow Sukra, keeping Prahlada as their leader.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the Asuras became afraid of the Devas. Hence, they hastened to follow Sukra, keeping Prahlada as their leader.

verses.sanskrit: देवीन्द्रनीलवर्णाभेवरारोहे सुलोचने । इमं वृणीष्व कामं त्वं मत्तो वै वल्गुभाषिणि
verses.transliteration: devīndranīlavarṇābhevarārohe sulocane / imaṃ vṛṇīṣva kāmaṃ tvaṃ matto vai valgubhāṣiṇi
verses.translation: After approaching Sukra, they stood around him with their heads bent down. On seeing that his Tdjyas had approached him again, Sukra said to them: —
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching Sukra, they stood around him with their heads bent down. On seeing that his Tdjyas had approached him again, Sukra said to them: —
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching Sukra, they stood around him with their heads bent down. On seeing that his Tdjyas had approached him again, Sukra said to them: —

verses.sanskrit: एवं भवतु गच्छावो गृहान्मत्तेभगामिनि । ततः स्वगृहमागम्य जयत्या सहितः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhavatu gacchāvo gṛhānmattebhagāmini / tataḥ svagṛhamāgamya jayatyā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "You have been cautioned at proper time by me. But, since you did not pay heed to ine or approve me you have met with discomfiture on account of that arrogance".
verses.wordMeaning: "You have been cautioned at proper time by me. But, since you did not pay heed to ine or approve me you have met with discomfiture on account of that arrogance".
verses.commentary: Sense: "You have been cautioned at proper time by me. But, since you did not pay heed to ine or approve me you have met with discomfiture on account of that arrogance".

verses.sanskrit: स तया चावसद्देव्या दश वर्षाणि भार्गवः । अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां मायया संवृतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: sa tayā cāvasaddevyā daśa varṣāṇi bhārgavaḥ / adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ māyayā saṃvṛtastadā
verses.translation: On understanding the facts as they were in reality, Sukra was soon pacified on account of his great compassionate
verses.wordMeaning: On understanding the facts as they were in reality, Sukra was soon pacified on account of his great compassionate
verses.commentary: Sense: On understanding the facts as they were in reality, Sukra was soon pacified on account of his great compassionate

verses.sanskrit: कृतार्थमामतं ज्ञातवा काव्यं सर्वे दितेः सुताः । अभिजग्सुर्गृहं तस्य मुदितास्तं दिदृक्षवः
verses.transliteration: kṛtārthamāmataṃ jñātavā kāvyaṃ sarve diteḥ sutāḥ / abhijagsurgṛhaṃ tasya muditāstaṃ didṛkṣavaḥ
verses.translation: He said this: — ''You need not be afraid. There is no necessity to go to Rasatala. This event was inevitable. Hence, it befell you even when I was alert.
verses.wordMeaning: He said this: — ''You need not be afraid. There is no necessity to go to Rasatala. This event was inevitable. Hence, it befell you even when I was alert.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said this: — ''You need not be afraid. There is no necessity to go to Rasatala. This event was inevitable. Hence, it befell you even when I was alert.

verses.sanskrit: गता यदा न पश्यन्ति जयत्या संवृतं गुरुम् । लक्षमं तस्य तद् बुद्ध्वा प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: gatā yadā na paśyanti jayatyā saṃvṛtaṃ gurum / lakṣamaṃ tasya tad buddhvā pratijagmuryathāgatam
verses.translation: "Has the time of succession come?" said Brahma. It was due to my favour that the glorious realm of the three worlds has been enjoyed by you all.
verses.wordMeaning: "Has the time of succession come?" said Brahma. It was due to my favour that the glorious realm of the three worlds has been enjoyed by you all.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Has the time of succession come?" said Brahma. It was due to my favour that the glorious realm of the three worlds has been enjoyed by you all.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिस्तु संरुद्धं ज्ञात्वा काव्यं वरेण ह । प्रीत्यर्थे दश वर्षाणि जयन्त्या हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatistu saṃruddhaṃ jñātvā kāvyaṃ vareṇa ha / prītyarthe daśa varṣāṇi jayantyā hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: A long period of time reckoned as ten Yugas, has been completed since you had attacked the Devas and ruled over their head. Brahma had declared that much as the period of your rule.
verses.wordMeaning: A long period of time reckoned as ten Yugas, has been completed since you had attacked the Devas and ruled over their head. Brahma had declared that much as the period of your rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: A long period of time reckoned as ten Yugas, has been completed since you had attacked the Devas and ruled over their head. Brahma had declared that much as the period of your rule.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्वा तदन्तरं सो ऽथ देवानां मन्त्रचोदितः । काव्यस्य रूपमास्थाय सो ऽसुरान्समभाषत
verses.transliteration: buddhvā tadantaraṃ so 'tha devānāṃ mantracoditaḥ / kāvyasya rūpamāsthāya so 'surānsamabhāṣata
verses.translation: In the Savarnika Manvantara, you will have the suzerainty once more. Your grandson Bali will become the future lord of the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: In the Savarnika Manvantara, you will have the suzerainty once more. Your grandson Bali will become the future lord of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Savarnika Manvantara, you will have the suzerainty once more. Your grandson Bali will become the future lord of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सो ऽभ्यागतान्दृष्ट्वा बृहस्पतिरुवाच तान् । स्वागतं मम याज्यानां संप्राप्तो ऽस्मि हिताय च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ so 'bhyāgatāndṛṣṭvā bṛhaspatiruvāca tān / svāgataṃ mama yājyānāṃ saṃprāpto 'smi hitāya ca
verses.translation: This period and the over-lordship of your grand- son have been declared by Brahma himself. Therefore, we did not have any sorrow when the worlds were recaptured.
verses.wordMeaning: This period and the over-lordship of your grand- son have been declared by Brahma himself. Therefore, we did not have any sorrow when the worlds were recaptured.
verses.commentary: Sense: This period and the over-lordship of your grand- son have been declared by Brahma himself. Therefore, we did not have any sorrow when the worlds were recaptured.

verses.sanskrit: अहं वो ऽध्यापयिष्यामि प्राप्ता विद्या मया हि याः । ततस्ते हृष्टमनसो विद्यार्थमुपपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vo 'dhyāpayiṣyāmi prāptā vidyā mayā hi yāḥ / tataste hṛṣṭamanaso vidyārthamupapedire
verses.translation: Since Bali's activities were not prompted by personal love or passion, Brahma had become pleased and the kingdom had been bestowed upon him in the Savarnika Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: Since Bali's activities were not prompted by personal love or passion, Brahma had become pleased and the kingdom had been bestowed upon him in the Savarnika Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since Bali's activities were not prompted by personal love or passion, Brahma had become pleased and the kingdom had been bestowed upon him in the Savarnika Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे काव्यस्तदा तस्मिन्समये दशवार्षिके । समयान्ते देवयाजी सद्यो जातमतिस्तदा
verses.transliteration: pūrṇe kāvyastadā tasminsamaye daśavārṣike / samayānte devayājī sadyo jātamatistadā
verses.translation: IS vara (lord Siva) lias told me that the kingdom of the Devas should pass on to Bali. Hence, he remains waiting for the proper time. He is invisible to all living beings.
verses.wordMeaning: IS vara (lord Siva) lias told me that the kingdom of the Devas should pass on to Bali. Hence, he remains waiting for the proper time. He is invisible to all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: IS vara (lord Siva) lias told me that the kingdom of the Devas should pass on to Bali. Hence, he remains waiting for the proper time. He is invisible to all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिं चक्रे ततश्चापि याज्यानां प्रत्यवेक्षणे । शुक्र उवाच देवि गच्छाम्यहं द्रष्टुं तव याज्याञ्छुचिस्मिते
verses.transliteration: buddhiṃ cakre tataścāpi yājyānāṃ pratyavekṣaṇe / śukra uvāca devi gacchāmyahaṃ draṣṭuṃ tava yājyāñchucismite
verses.translation: (Defective text). Immortality has been granted to you by the delighted self-born lord Brahma. Hence why should you be lacking in enthusiasm regarding the succession by turns? You get agitated suddenly.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text). Immortality has been granted to you by the delighted self-born lord Brahma. Hence why should you be lacking in enthusiasm regarding the succession by turns? You get agitated suddenly.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text). Immortality has been granted to you by the delighted self-born lord Brahma. Hence why should you be lacking in enthusiasm regarding the succession by turns? You get agitated suddenly.

verses.sanskrit: विभ्रान्तप्रेक्षिते साध्वि त्रिवर्णायतलोचने । एवमुक्ताब्रवीद्देवी भज भक्तां महाव्रत । एष ब्रह्मन्सतां धर्मो न धर्मं लोपयामि ते
verses.transliteration: vibhrāntaprekṣite sādhvi trivarṇāyatalocane / evamuktābravīddevī bhaja bhaktāṃ mahāvrata / eṣa brahmansatāṃ dharmo na dharmaṃ lopayāmi te
verses.translation: These two are my disciples. They are on a par with Bfhaspati. They will support you when you are overwhelmed by or engaged in conflict with the Devas".
verses.wordMeaning: These two are my disciples. They are on a par with Bfhaspati. They will support you when you are overwhelmed by or engaged in conflict with the Devas".
verses.commentary: Sense: These two are my disciples. They are on a par with Bfhaspati. They will support you when you are overwhelmed by or engaged in conflict with the Devas".

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच ततो गत्वा सुरान्दृष्ट्वा देवाचार्येण धीमता
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca tato gatvā surāndṛṣṭvā devācāryeṇa dhīmatā
verses.translation: On being told thus by Sukra of indefatigable activity, Prahlada and other descendants of Diti went along with those two priests.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by Sukra of indefatigable activity, Prahlada and other descendants of Diti went along with those two priests.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by Sukra of indefatigable activity, Prahlada and other descendants of Diti went along with those two priests.

verses.sanskrit: वञ्चितान्काव्यरूपेण वचसा पुनरब्रवीत् । काव्यं मामनुजानीध्वमेष ह्याङ्गिरसो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: vañcitānkāvyarūpeṇa vacasā punarabravīt / kāvyaṃ māmanujānīdhvameṣa hyāṅgiraso muniḥ
verses.translation: We shall invite them for a sacrifice and thereby conquer the Asuras. Then the Devas invited both Santfa and Marka.
verses.wordMeaning: We shall invite them for a sacrifice and thereby conquer the Asuras. Then the Devas invited both Santfa and Marka.
verses.commentary: Sense: We shall invite them for a sacrifice and thereby conquer the Asuras. Then the Devas invited both Santfa and Marka.

verses.sanskrit: वञ्चिता बत यूयं वै मयि सक्ते तु दानवाः । श्रुत्वा तथा ब्रुवाणं तं संभ्रान्ता दितिजास्ततः
verses.transliteration: vañcitā bata yūyaṃ vai mayi sakte tu dānavāḥ / śrutvā tathā bruvāṇaṃ taṃ saṃbhrāntā ditijāstataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, Devas gained victory and the Danavas met with discomfiture. After vanquishing the Asuras, the Devas approached San<Ja and Marka (?).
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, Devas gained victory and the Danavas met with discomfiture. After vanquishing the Asuras, the Devas approached San<Ja and Marka (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, Devas gained victory and the Danavas met with discomfiture. After vanquishing the Asuras, the Devas approached San<Ja and Marka (?).

verses.sanskrit: संप्रैक्षन्तावुभौ तत्र स्थिरासीनौ शुचिस्मितौ । संप्रमूढाः स्थिताः सर्वे प्रापद्यन्त न किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: saṃpraikṣantāvubhau tatra sthirāsīnau śucismitau / saṃpramūḍhāḥ sthitāḥ sarve prāpadyanta na kiñcana
verses.translation: (The Danavas) who had no support, who were overwhelmed by the curse of Kavya and who were once again harassed by the Devas entered Rasatala.
verses.wordMeaning: (The Danavas) who had no support, who were overwhelmed by the curse of Kavya and who were once again harassed by the Devas entered Rasatala.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Danavas) who had no support, who were overwhelmed by the curse of Kavya and who were once again harassed by the Devas entered Rasatala.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषु प्रमूढेषु काव्यस्तान्पुनरब्रवीत् । आचार्यो यो ह्ययं काव्यो देवायार्यो ऽयमङ्गिराः
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣu pramūḍheṣu kāvyastānpunarabravīt / ācāryo yo hyayaṃ kāvyo devāyāryo 'yamaṅgirāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the Danavas were rendered inactive by Tndra as well as due to the curse originating from Sukra.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Danavas were rendered inactive by Tndra as well as due to the curse originating from Sukra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Danavas were rendered inactive by Tndra as well as due to the curse originating from Sukra.

verses.sanskrit: अनुगच्छत मां सर्वे त्यजतैनं बृहस्पतिम् । एवमुक्ते तु ते सर्वे तावुभौ समवेक्ष्य च
verses.transliteration: anugacchata māṃ sarve tyajatainaṃ bṛhaspatim / evamukte tu te sarve tāvubhau samavekṣya ca
verses.translation: When the cult of sacrifice became slack, lord Visnu incarnated again and again in order to destroy Sjn and re- establish Dharma (Piety).
verses.wordMeaning: When the cult of sacrifice became slack, lord Visnu incarnated again and again in order to destroy Sjn and re- establish Dharma (Piety).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the cult of sacrifice became slack, lord Visnu incarnated again and again in order to destroy Sjn and re- establish Dharma (Piety).

verses.sanskrit: तदासुरा विशेष तु न व्यजानंस्तयोर्द्वयोः । बृहस्पतिरुवाचैनामं भ्रातो ऽयमङ्गिराः
verses.transliteration: tadāsurā viśeṣa tu na vyajānaṃstayordvayoḥ / bṛhaspatiruvācaināmaṃ bhrāto 'yamaṅgirāḥ
verses.translation: Lord Brahma pronounced that those Asuras who did not abide by the directions of Prahla la were sure to be killed bv human beings.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Brahma pronounced that those Asuras who did not abide by the directions of Prahla la were sure to be killed bv human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma pronounced that those Asuras who did not abide by the directions of Prahla la were sure to be killed bv human beings.

verses.sanskrit: काव्यो ऽहं वो गुरुर्दैत्या मद्रूपो ऽयं बृहस्पतिः । संमोहयति रूपेण मामकेनैष वो ऽसुराः
verses.transliteration: kāvyo 'haṃ vo gururdaityā madrūpo 'yaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ / saṃmohayati rūpeṇa māmakenaiṣa vo 'surāḥ
verses.translation: When Bali, the lord of Daityas and the son of Virocana, was performing a sacrifice, he became a Brahmana, the delighter of the family of Aditi and spoke thus to Bali at an auspicious time: —
verses.wordMeaning: When Bali, the lord of Daityas and the son of Virocana, was performing a sacrifice, he became a Brahmana, the delighter of the family of Aditi and spoke thus to Bali at an auspicious time: —

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तस्य वचस्ते वै संमन्त्र्याथ वचो ऽब्रुवन् । अयं नो दशवर्षाणि सततं शास्ति वै प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tasya vacaste vai saṃmantryātha vaco 'bruvan / ayaṃ no daśavarṣāṇi satataṃ śāsti vai prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "You are the king of the three worlds. Everything is vested in you. It behoves you, O king, to give me three paces of land, so said the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: "You are the king of the three worlds. Everything is vested in you. It behoves you, O king, to give me three paces of land, so said the lord.

verses.sanskrit: एष वै गुरुरस्माकमन्तरेप्सुरयं द्विजाः । ततस्तेदानवाः सर्वे प्रणिपत्याभिवाद्य च
verses.transliteration: eṣa vai gururasmākamantarepsurayaṃ dvijāḥ / tatastedānavāḥ sarve praṇipatyābhivādya ca
verses.translation: "I shall of course give", said the king Bali the son of Virocana. Thinking him to be only a Dwarf he became glad and offered the same.

verses.sanskrit: वचनं जगृहुस्तस्य विद्याभ्यासेन मोहिताः । ऊचुस्तमसुराः सर्वे क्रुद्धाः संरक्तलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: vacanaṃ jagṛhustasya vidyābhyāsena mohitāḥ / ūcustamasurāḥ sarve kruddhāḥ saṃraktalocanāḥ
verses.translation: That Vamana, O excellent Brahmanas, the lord covered the entire Universe by means of three paces, viz. heaven, ether and Earth.
verses.wordMeaning: That Vamana, O excellent Brahmanas, the lord covered the entire Universe by means of three paces, viz. heaven, ether and Earth.

verses.sanskrit: अयं गुरुर्हितो ऽस्माकं गच्छ त्वं नासि नो गुरुः । भार्गवो ऽगिरसो वायं भवत्वेषैव नो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ gururhito 'smākaṃ gaccha tvaṃ nāsi no guruḥ / bhārgavo 'giraso vāyaṃ bhavatveṣaiva no guruḥ
verses.translation: The lord BkUtdtmd (the immanent soul of all living beings) excelled even the sun by means of his refulgence. The glorious lord illuminated the quarters and interstices.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord BkUtdtmd (the immanent soul of all living beings) excelled even the sun by means of his refulgence. The glorious lord illuminated the quarters and interstices.

verses.transliteration: sthitā vayaṃ nideśe 'sya gaccha tvaṃ sādhu mā ciram / evamuktvā surāḥ sarve prāpadyanta bṛhaspatim
verses.translation: After taking away the Royal splendour of Asuras, the mighty-armed Visnu of great prowess, brightened the worlds and shone.
verses.wordMeaning: After taking away the Royal splendour of Asuras, the mighty-armed Visnu of great prowess, brightened the worlds and shone.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वा अल्पायुषश्चैव भविष्यन्ति वनौकसः । सरित्पर्वतसेविन्यः पत्रमूलफलाशनाः
verses.transliteration: hrasvā alpāyuṣaścaiva bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ / saritparvatasevinyaḥ patramūlaphalāśanāḥ
verses.translation: Those who are not killed in this action, those who achieve something, will become deluded suddenly and fight with one another.

verses.sanskrit: चीरपत्राजिनघराः संकरं घोरमास्थिताः । अल्पायुषो नष्टवार्ता बह्वाबाधाः सुदुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: cīrapatrājinagharāḥ saṃkaraṃ ghoramāsthitāḥ / alpāyuṣo naṣṭavārtā bahvābādhāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ

verses.sanskrit: एवं काष्ठामनुप्राप्ताः कलिसंध्यांशके तदा । प्रजाः क्षयं प्रयास्यन्ति सार्द्धं कलियुगेन तु
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kāṣṭhāmanuprāptāḥ kalisaṃdhyāṃśake tadā / prajāḥ kṣayaṃ prayāsyanti sārddhaṃ kaliyugena tu

verses.sanskrit: क्षीणे कलियुगे तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते च कृते पुनः । प्रपत्स्यन्ते यथान्यायं स्वभावादेव नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: kṣīṇe kaliyuge tasminpravṛtte ca kṛte punaḥ / prapatsyante yathānyāyaṃ svabhāvādeva nānyathā
verses.translation: Those who are not killed in this action, those who achieve something, will become deluded suddenly and fight with one another.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्कीर्त्तितं सर्वं देवासुरविचेष्टितम् । यदुवंशप्रसंगेन महद्वो वैष्मवं यशः
verses.transliteration: ityetatkīrttitaṃ sarvaṃ devāsuraviceṣṭitam / yaduvaṃśaprasaṃgena mahadvo vaiṣmavaṃ yaśaḥ

verses.sanskrit: तुर्वसोस्तु प्रवक्ष्यामि पूरोर्द्रुह्योरनोस्तथा
verses.transliteration: turvasostu pravakṣyāmi pūrordruhyoranostathā
