verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे विष्णुमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ ७३॥ सूत उवाच तुर्वसोस्तु सुतो वह्निर्वह्नेर्गोभानुरात्मजः । गोभानोस्तु सुतो वीर स्त्रिसानुरपाजितः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde viṣṇumāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 73// sūta uvāca turvasostu suto vahnirvahnergobhānurātmajaḥ / gobhānostu suto vīra strisānurapājitaḥ
verses.translation: The successor of Duskanta (? Dusyanta) was the king named Sarupya. 2 Andira was born of Sarupya. He had four sons.
verses.wordMeaning: The successor of Duskanta (? Dusyanta) was the king named Sarupya. 2 Andira was born of Sarupya. He had four sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The successor of Duskanta (? Dusyanta) was the king named Sarupya. 2 Andira was born of Sarupya. He had four sons.

verses.sanskrit: करन्धमस्तु त्रैसानो मरुत्तस्तस्य चात्मजः । अन्यस्त्वाविज्ञितो राजा मरुत्तः कथितः पुरा
verses.transliteration: karandhamastu traisāno maruttastasya cātmajaḥ / anyastvāvijñito rājā maruttaḥ kathitaḥ purā
verses.translation: They were Panrjya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya. Their realms were Pandyas, Keralas, Colas and Kulyas.
verses.wordMeaning: They were Panrjya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya. Their realms were Pandyas, Keralas, Colas and Kulyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Panrjya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya. Their realms were Pandyas, Keralas, Colas and Kulyas.

verses.sanskrit: अनपत्यो मरुत्तस्तु स राजासीदिति श्रुतम् । दुष्कन्तं पौरवं चापि स वै पुत्रमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: anapatyo maruttastu sa rājāsīditi śrutam / duṣkantaṃ pauravaṃ cāpi sa vai putramakalpayat
verses.translation: The two sons of Druhyu, viz. Babhru and Setu were renowned warriors. Aruddha was Setu's son and Ripu is men- tioned as the son of Babhru.
verses.wordMeaning: The two sons of Druhyu, viz. Babhru and Setu were renowned warriors. Aruddha was Setu's son and Ripu is men- tioned as the son of Babhru.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two sons of Druhyu, viz. Babhru and Setu were renowned warriors. Aruddha was Setu's son and Ripu is men- tioned as the son of Babhru.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ययातिशापेन जरासंक्रमणे पुरा । तुर्वसोः पौरवं वंशं प्रविवेश पुरा किल
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yayātiśāpena jarāsaṃkramaṇe purā / turvasoḥ pauravaṃ vaṃśaṃ praviveśa purā kila
verses.translation: This strong king fought a great battle with Yauvana£va for full fourteen months. Due to great strain, he was killed in that battle by Yauvanasva.
verses.wordMeaning: This strong king fought a great battle with Yauvana£va for full fourteen months. Due to great strain, he was killed in that battle by Yauvanasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: This strong king fought a great battle with Yauvana£va for full fourteen months. Due to great strain, he was killed in that battle by Yauvanasva.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्कन्तस्य तु दायादः सरूप्यो नाम पार्थिवः । सरूप्यात्तु तथाण्डीरश्चत्वारस्तस्य चात्मजाः
verses.transliteration: duṣkantasya tu dāyādaḥ sarūpyo nāma pārthivaḥ / sarūpyāttu tathāṇḍīraścatvārastasya cātmajāḥ
verses.translation: The horses born (bred) in the country of Gandhara are excellent horses. Dharma was the son of Gandhara. Dhrta was his son.
verses.wordMeaning: The horses born (bred) in the country of Gandhara are excellent horses. Dharma was the son of Gandhara. Dhrta was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses born (bred) in the country of Gandhara are excellent horses. Dharma was the son of Gandhara. Dhrta was his son.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्ड्यश्च केरलश्चैव चोलः कुल्यस्तथैव च । तेषां जनपदाः कुल्याः पाण्ड्याश्चोलाः सकेरलाः
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍyaśca keralaścaiva colaḥ kulyastathaiva ca / teṣāṃ janapadāḥ kulyāḥ pāṇḍyāścolāḥ sakeralāḥ
verses.translation: AlHT. records Garbha as the descendent of Vahni and Gobh&nu comes after Garbha.
verses.wordMeaning: AlHT. records Garbha as the descendent of Vahni and Gobh&nu comes after Garbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: AlHT. records Garbha as the descendent of Vahni and Gobh&nu comes after Garbha.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुह्योश्च तनयौ वीरौ बभ्रुः सेतुश्च विश्रुतौ । अरुद्धः सेतुपुत्रस्तु बाब्रवो रिपुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: druhyośca tanayau vīrau babhruḥ setuśca viśrutau / aruddhaḥ setuputrastu bābravo ripurucyate
verses.translation: The same as Sarutha in V&.P. But Bharata is regarded as the son of Dusyanta and Sakuntala in Mbh. etc.
verses.wordMeaning: The same as Sarutha in V&.P. But Bharata is regarded as the son of Dusyanta and Sakuntala in Mbh. etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same as Sarutha in V&.P. But Bharata is regarded as the son of Dusyanta and Sakuntala in Mbh. etc.

verses.sanskrit: यौवनाश्वेन समितौ कृच्छेण निहतो बली । युद्धं सुमहदासीत्तु मासान्परिचतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: yauvanāśvena samitau kṛccheṇa nihato balī / yuddhaṃ sumahadāsīttu māsānparicaturdaśa
verses.translation: It means Druhyu dynasty ruled over a part of Afghanistan.
verses.wordMeaning: It means Druhyu dynasty ruled over a part of Afghanistan.
verses.commentary: Sense: It means Druhyu dynasty ruled over a part of Afghanistan.

verses.sanskrit: अरुद्धस्य तु दायादो गान्धारो नाम पार्थिवः । ख्यायते यस्य नाम्ना तु गान्धारविषयो महान्
verses.transliteration: aruddhasya tu dāyādo gāndhāro nāma pārthivaḥ / khyāyate yasya nāmnā tu gāndhāraviṣayo mahān
verses.translation: They were the rulers of the Mleccha territories in the northern quarter.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the rulers of the Mleccha territories in the northern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the rulers of the Mleccha territories in the northern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: गान्धारादेशजाश्चापि तुरगा वाजिनां वराः । गान्धारपुत्रो धर्मस्तु धृतस्तस्य सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: gāndhārādeśajāścāpi turagā vājināṃ varāḥ / gāndhāraputro dharmastu dhṛtastasya suto 'bhavat
verses.translation: They are renowned by the name of Sabhanara, Kalacaksus and Paraksa.
verses.wordMeaning: They are renowned by the name of Sabhanara, Kalacaksus and Paraksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are renowned by the name of Sabhanara, Kalacaksus and Paraksa.

verses.sanskrit: धृतस्य दुर्दमो जज्ञे प्रचेतास्तस्य चात्मजः । प्रचेतसः पुत्रशतं राजानः सर्व एव ते
verses.transliteration: dhṛtasya durdamo jajñe pracetāstasya cātmajaḥ / pracetasaḥ putraśataṃ rājānaḥ sarva eva te
verses.translation: The city of Sibi became well known as Sivapura.1 That of Nrga was Yaudheya; that of Nava was Navarasfra and the city of Krmi was Knnila.
verses.wordMeaning: The city of Sibi became well known as Sivapura.1 That of Nrga was Yaudheya; that of Nava was Navarasfra and the city of Krmi was Knnila.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Sibi became well known as Sivapura.1 That of Nrga was Yaudheya; that of Nava was Navarasfra and the city of Krmi was Knnila.

verses.sanskrit: म्लेच्छराष्ट्राधिपाः सर्वे ह्युदीचीं दिशमास्थिताः । अनोश्चैव सुता वीरास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: mleccharāṣṭrādhipāḥ sarve hyudīcīṃ diśamāsthitāḥ / anoścaiva sutā vīrāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: The following are the locations of places mentioned here:
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the locations of places mentioned here:
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the locations of places mentioned here:

verses.sanskrit: सभानरः कालचक्षुः पराक्षस्चेति विश्रुताः । सभानरस्य पुत्रस्तु विद्वान्कालानलो नृपः
verses.transliteration: sabhānaraḥ kālacakṣuḥ parākṣasceti viśrutāḥ / sabhānarasya putrastu vidvānkālānalo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Their territories viz. Angas, Vahgas, Suhmakas, Punras and Kalingas were very flourishing. Understand their genealogy.
verses.wordMeaning: Their territories viz. Angas, Vahgas, Suhmakas, Punras and Kalingas were very flourishing. Understand their genealogy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their territories viz. Angas, Vahgas, Suhmakas, Punras and Kalingas were very flourishing. Understand their genealogy.

verses.sanskrit: कालानलस्य धर्मात्मा सृंजयो नाम विश्रुतः । सृंजयस्याभवत्पुत्रो वीरो नाम्ना पुरञ्जयः
verses.transliteration: kālānalasya dharmātmā sṛṃjayo nāma viśrutaḥ / sṛṃjayasyābhavatputro vīro nāmnā purañjayaḥ
verses.translation: All those sons of his were Kfetrajas (bom of his wife to another). They w$re born to a sage. Those sons of great prowess were bom to Sudesna by Dirghatamas.
verses.wordMeaning: All those sons of his were Kfetrajas (bom of his wife to another). They w$re born to a sage. Those sons of great prowess were bom to Sudesna by Dirghatamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sons of his were Kfetrajas (bom of his wife to another). They w$re born to a sage. Those sons of great prowess were bom to Sudesna by Dirghatamas.

verses.sanskrit: आसीदिन्द्रसमो राजा प्रतिष्टितयशादिवि । महामनाः सुतस्तस्य महाशालस्य धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: āsīdindrasamo rājā pratiṣṭitayaśādivi / mahāmanāḥ sutastasya mahāśālasya dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: How were the five sons of Bali begot as K$etrajas, O holy Sir, by the sage Dirghatamas. Kindly recount this to us who ask you.
verses.wordMeaning: How were the five sons of Bali begot as K$etrajas, O holy Sir, by the sage Dirghatamas. Kindly recount this to us who ask you.
verses.commentary: Sense: How were the five sons of Bali begot as K$etrajas, O holy Sir, by the sage Dirghatamas. Kindly recount this to us who ask you.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपेश्वरो राजा चक्रवर्त्ती महायशाः । महामनास्तु द्वौ पुत्रौ जनयामास विश्रुतौ
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpeśvaro rājā cakravarttī mahāyaśāḥ / mahāmanāstu dvau putrau janayāmāsa viśrutau
verses.translation: Mamata who did not like Brhaspati said to him — "I am the wife of your elder brother and I am pregnant too.
verses.wordMeaning: Mamata who did not like Brhaspati said to him — "I am the wife of your elder brother and I am pregnant too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mamata who did not like Brhaspati said to him — "I am the wife of your elder brother and I am pregnant too.

verses.sanskrit: उशीनरं च धर्मज्ञं तितिक्षुं चैव धार्मिकम् । उशीनरस्य पत्न्यस्तु पञ्च राजर्षिवंशजाः
verses.transliteration: uśīnaraṃ ca dharmajñaṃ titikṣuṃ caiva dhārmikam / uśīnarasya patnyastu pañca rājarṣivaṃśajāḥ
verses.translation: This child in my womb, O Brhaspati, yells con- stantly practising the recitation of the Vedas along with their Angas (ancillary subjects).
verses.wordMeaning: This child in my womb, O Brhaspati, yells con- stantly practising the recitation of the Vedas along with their Angas (ancillary subjects).
verses.commentary: Sense: This child in my womb, O Brhaspati, yells con- stantly practising the recitation of the Vedas along with their Angas (ancillary subjects).

verses.sanskrit: नृगा कृमी नवा दर्वा पञ्चमी च दृषद्वती । उशीनरस्य पुत्र्यस्तु पञ्च तासु कुलोद्वहाः
verses.transliteration: nṛgā kṛmī navā darvā pañcamī ca dṛṣadvatī / uśīnarasya putryastu pañca tāsu kulodvahāḥ
verses.translation: You too are Amogharetas (one whose semen never goes in vain). It does not behove you, O lord, to approach me on this occasion or in the manner you think.' *
verses.wordMeaning: You too are Amogharetas (one whose semen never goes in vain). It does not behove you, O lord, to approach me on this occasion or in the manner you think.' *
verses.commentary: Sense: You too are Amogharetas (one whose semen never goes in vain). It does not behove you, O lord, to approach me on this occasion or in the manner you think.' *

verses.sanskrit: तपस्यतः सुमहतो जाता वृद्धस्य धार्मिकाः । नृगायास्तु नृगः पुत्रो नवाया नव एव तु
verses.transliteration: tapasyataḥ sumahato jātā vṛddhasya dhārmikāḥ / nṛgāyāstu nṛgaḥ putro navāyā nava eva tu
verses.translation: — "Do not discharge semen O Bfhaspati. There is no space here for two. You are one whose semen never goes in vain. But I have come here before.*'
verses.wordMeaning: — "Do not discharge semen O Bfhaspati. There is no space here for two. You are one whose semen never goes in vain. But I have come here before.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: — "Do not discharge semen O Bfhaspati. There is no space here for two. You are one whose semen never goes in vain. But I have come here before.*'

verses.sanskrit: कृम्याः कृमिस्तु दर्वायाः सुव्रतो नाम धार्मिकः । दृषद्वती सुतश्चापि शिबिरौशीनरो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: kṛmyāḥ kṛmistu darvāyāḥ suvrato nāma dhārmikaḥ / dṛṣadvatī sutaścāpi śibirauśīnaro dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the exalted sage Brhaspati, be- came infuriated then. He cursed the son of his brother U£ija, though he was yet in the womb.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the exalted sage Brhaspati, be- came infuriated then. He cursed the son of his brother U£ija, though he was yet in the womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the exalted sage Brhaspati, be- came infuriated then. He cursed the son of his brother U£ija, though he was yet in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: शिबे शिवपुरं ख्यातं यौधेयं तु नृगस्य च । नवस्य नवराष्ट्रं तु कृमेस्तु कृमिला पुरी
verses.transliteration: śibe śivapuraṃ khyātaṃ yaudheyaṃ tu nṛgasya ca / navasya navarāṣṭraṃ tu kṛmestu kṛmilā purī
verses.translation: "Since, out of delusion, you told me thus, at a time eagerly desired by all living beings, you will enter a period of prolonged darkness**.
verses.wordMeaning: "Since, out of delusion, you told me thus, at a time eagerly desired by all living beings, you will enter a period of prolonged darkness**.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since, out of delusion, you told me thus, at a time eagerly desired by all living beings, you will enter a period of prolonged darkness**.

verses.sanskrit: सुव्रतस्य तथांबष्टा शिबिपुत्रान्निबोधत । शिबेस्तु शिबयः पुत्राश्चत्वारो लोकसंमताः
verses.transliteration: suvratasya tathāṃbaṣṭā śibiputrānnibodhata / śibestu śibayaḥ putrāścatvāro lokasaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, due to the curse, the son of U£ija be- came a sage named Dirghatamas. He earned great reputation
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, due to the curse, the son of U£ija be- came a sage named Dirghatamas. He earned great reputation
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, due to the curse, the son of U£ija be- came a sage named Dirghatamas. He earned great reputation

verses.sanskrit: वृषदर्भः सुवीरस्तु केकयो मद्रकस्तथा । तेषां जनपदाः स्फीताः केकया मद्रकास्तथा
verses.transliteration: vṛṣadarbhaḥ suvīrastu kekayo madrakastathā / teṣāṃ janapadāḥ sphītāḥ kekayā madrakāstathā
verses.translation: His faiher's brother built a house for him. While he was staying, the bull came there casually.
verses.wordMeaning: His faiher's brother built a house for him. While he was staying, the bull came there casually.
verses.commentary: Sense: His faiher's brother built a house for him. While he was staying, the bull came there casually.

verses.sanskrit: वृषदर्भाः सुवीराश्च तितिक्षोः शृणुत प्रजाः । तितिक्षुरभवद्राजा पूर्वस्यां दिशि विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣadarbhāḥ suvīrāśca titikṣoḥ śṛṇuta prajāḥ / titikṣurabhavadrājā pūrvasyāṃ diśi viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: The son of Surabhi grazed the Darbha grass spread in the yard for the Daria rites (the holy rites to be performed on the New moon day). Dirghatamas caught hold of him by the horns even as he was struggling to free himself.
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Surabhi grazed the Darbha grass spread in the yard for the Daria rites (the holy rites to be performed on the New moon day). Dirghatamas caught hold of him by the horns even as he was struggling to free himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Surabhi grazed the Darbha grass spread in the yard for the Daria rites (the holy rites to be performed on the New moon day). Dirghatamas caught hold of him by the horns even as he was struggling to free himself.

verses.sanskrit: उशद्रथो महाबाहुस्तस्य हेमः सुतो ऽभवत् । हेमस्य सुतपा जज्ञे सुतः सुतपसो बलिः
verses.transliteration: uśadratho mahābāhustasya hemaḥ suto 'bhavat / hemasya sutapā jajñe sutaḥ sutapaso baliḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the name of cows, he became bewildered and released him. With his devotion and desire to hear the bull's words he propitiated the son of the cow.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the name of cows, he became bewildered and released him. With his devotion and desire to hear the bull's words he propitiated the son of the cow.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the name of cows, he became bewildered and released him. With his devotion and desire to hear the bull's words he propitiated the son of the cow.

verses.sanskrit: जातो मनुष्ययोन्यां वै क्षीणे वंशे प्रजेप्सया । महायोगी स तु बलिर्बद्धो यः स महामनाः
verses.transliteration: jāto manuṣyayonyāṃ vai kṣīṇe vaṃśe prajepsayā / mahāyogī sa tu balirbaddho yaḥ sa mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: By the grace of the leading bull he accepted Godharma1
verses.wordMeaning: By the grace of the leading bull he accepted Godharma1
verses.commentary: Sense: By the grace of the leading bull he accepted Godharma1

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रानुत्पादयामास जातुर्वर्ण्यकरान्भुवि । अङ्गं स जनयामास वङ्गं सुह्मं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: putrānutpādayāmāsa jāturvarṇyakarānbhuvi / aṅgaṃ sa janayāmāsa vaṅgaṃ suhmaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, as ill luck would have it he became deluded in his mind and so he sexually desired the wife of his younger brother (or son?) Autathya, although she struggled and cried in protest.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, as ill luck would have it he became deluded in his mind and so he sexually desired the wife of his younger brother (or son?) Autathya, although she struggled and cried in protest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, as ill luck would have it he became deluded in his mind and so he sexually desired the wife of his younger brother (or son?) Autathya, although she struggled and cried in protest.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धं कलिङ्गं च तथा वालेयं क्षत्रमुच्यते । वालेया ब्राह्मणाश्चैव तस्य वंशकराः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: yuddhaṃ kaliṅgaṃ ca tathā vāleyaṃ kṣatramucyate / vāleyā brāhmaṇāścaiva tasya vaṃśakarāḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: The king sent his wife named Sude$na to the sage. On seeing him blind and old, the queen did not go to him.
verses.wordMeaning: The king sent his wife named Sude$na to the sage. On seeing him blind and old, the queen did not go to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king sent his wife named Sude$na to the sage. On seeing him blind and old, the queen did not go to him.

verses.sanskrit: बलेस्तु ब्रह्मणा दत्ता वराः प्रीतेन धीमतः । महायोगित्वमायुश्च कल्पस्य परिमाणकम्
verses.transliteration: balestu brahmaṇā dattā varāḥ prītena dhīmataḥ / mahāyogitvamāyuśca kalpasya parimāṇakam
verses.translation: The Queen carried out his behest but coming to the anus she had feelings of revulsion and so she avoided it.
verses.wordMeaning: The Queen carried out his behest but coming to the anus she had feelings of revulsion and so she avoided it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Queen carried out his behest but coming to the anus she had feelings of revulsion and so she avoided it.

verses.sanskrit: संग्रामे वाप्यजेयत्वं धर्मे चैव प्रभावतः । त्रैलोक्यदर्शनं चैव प्राधान्यं प्रसवे तथा
verses.transliteration: saṃgrāme vāpyajeyatvaṃ dharme caiva prabhāvataḥ / trailokyadarśanaṃ caiva prādhānyaṃ prasave tathā
verses.translation: These five sons were born of the wife of Bali and they perpetuated the line. It was thus that these sons were formerly given to Bali by Dirghatamas.
verses.wordMeaning: These five sons were born of the wife of Bali and they perpetuated the line. It was thus that these sons were formerly given to Bali by Dirghatamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These five sons were born of the wife of Bali and they perpetuated the line. It was thus that these sons were formerly given to Bali by Dirghatamas.

verses.sanskrit: बलेश्चा प्रतिमत्वं वे धर्मतत्त्वार्थदर्शनम् । चतुरो नियतान्वर्णांस्त्वं वै स्थापयितेति वै
verses.transliteration: baleścā pratimatvaṃ ve dharmatattvārthadarśanam / caturo niyatānvarṇāṃstvaṃ vai sthāpayiteti vai
verses.translation: "O sage, you pondered over Godharma and did like this. Therefore, I am pleased with your single-minded devotion to us.
verses.wordMeaning: "O sage, you pondered over Godharma and did like this. Therefore, I am pleased with your single-minded devotion to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O sage, you pondered over Godharma and did like this. Therefore, I am pleased with your single-minded devotion to us.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो विभुना राजा बलिः शान्ति पराययौ । कालेन महता विद्वान्स्वं च स्थानमुपागतः
verses.transliteration: ityukto vibhunā rājā baliḥ śānti parāyayau / kālena mahatā vidvānsvaṃ ca sthānamupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Kaksivan went to Girivraja along with his father and performed elaborate penance as directed by him.
verses.wordMeaning: Kaksivan went to Girivraja along with his father and performed elaborate penance as directed by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kaksivan went to Girivraja along with his father and performed elaborate penance as directed by him.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां जनपदाः स्फीता अङ्गवङ्गाश्च सुह्मकाः । पुण्ड्राः कलिङ्गश्च तथा तेषां वंशं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ janapadāḥ sphītā aṅgavaṅgāśca suhmakāḥ / puṇḍrāḥ kaliṅgaśca tathā teṣāṃ vaṃśaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: After the lapse of a great deal of time, he became sanctified through austerities. The saintly lord got rid of his defects. He attained the status of a Brahmana along with his younger brother Caksus.
verses.wordMeaning: After the lapse of a great deal of time, he became sanctified through austerities. The saintly lord got rid of his defects. He attained the status of a Brahmana along with his younger brother Caksus.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the lapse of a great deal of time, he became sanctified through austerities. The saintly lord got rid of his defects. He attained the status of a Brahmana along with his younger brother Caksus.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते तनयाः सर्वे क्षेत्रजा मुनिसंभवाः । संभूता दीर्घतमसः सुदेष्णायां महौजसः
verses.transliteration: tasya te tanayāḥ sarve kṣetrajā munisaṃbhavāḥ / saṃbhūtā dīrghatamasaḥ sudeṣṇāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Then the father said to him: — "O- lord, now I am one endowed with son. With you as my famous son, O dear one, I am now contented and happy.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the father said to him: — "O- lord, now I am one endowed with son. With you as my famous son, O dear one, I am now contented and happy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the father said to him: — "O- lord, now I am one endowed with son. With you as my famous son, O dear one, I am now contented and happy.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कथं बलेः सुताः पञ्च जनिताः क्षेत्रजाः प्रभो । ऋषिणा दीर्घतमसा ह्येतत्प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ baleḥ sutāḥ pañca janitāḥ kṣetrajāḥ prabho / ṛṣiṇā dīrghatamasā hyetatprabrūhi pṛcchatām
verses.translation: Thereafter, he engaged himself in Yogic practice and attained the abode of Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he engaged himself in Yogic practice and attained the abode of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he engaged himself in Yogic practice and attained the abode of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच उशिजो नाम विख्यात आसीद्धीमानृषिः पुरा । भार्या वै ममता नाम बभूवास्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca uśijo nāma vikhyāta āsīddhīmānṛṣiḥ purā / bhāryā vai mamatā nāma babhūvāsya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: His son Srutasravas ruled for sixty-seven years. His son Ayutayu ruled the kingdom for twenty-six years.
verses.wordMeaning: His son Srutasravas ruled for sixty-seven years. His son Ayutayu ruled the kingdom for twenty-six years.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son Srutasravas ruled for sixty-seven years. His son Ayutayu ruled the kingdom for twenty-six years.

verses.sanskrit: उशिजस्य कनीयांस्तु पुरोधा यो दिवौकसाम् । बृहस्पतिर्बृहत्तेजा ममतां सो ऽभ्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: uśijasya kanīyāṃstu purodhā yo divaukasām / bṛhaspatirbṛhattejā mamatāṃ so 'bhyapadyata
verses.translation: Brhatkarman ruled the kingdom for twenty- three years. Senajit is reigning at present. The following kings of the future will rule the kingdom for the period (mentioned against their names).
verses.wordMeaning: Brhatkarman ruled the kingdom for twenty- three years. Senajit is reigning at present. The following kings of the future will rule the kingdom for the period (mentioned against their names).
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhatkarman ruled the kingdom for twenty- three years. Senajit is reigning at present. The following kings of the future will rule the kingdom for the period (mentioned against their names).

verses.sanskrit: उवाच ममता तं तु बृहस्पतिमनिच्छती । अन्तर्वत्न्यस्मि ते भ्रातुर्ज्येष्ठस्यास्य च भामिनी
verses.transliteration: uvāca mamatā taṃ tu bṛhaspatimanicchatī / antarvatnyasmi te bhrāturjyeṣṭhasyāsya ca bhāminī
verses.translation: VV. 107-203 give the brief history of different 'Future* dynasties. The dynasties mentioned here are (1) B&rhadratha, (2) Pradyota, (3) Sisun&ga (4) Nanda, (5) Maurya, (6) Kanva and (8) Andhra.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 107-203 give the brief history of different 'Future* dynasties. The dynasties mentioned here are (1) B&rhadratha, (2) Pradyota, (3) Sisun&ga (4) Nanda, (5) Maurya, (6) Kanva and (8) Andhra.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 107-203 give the brief history of different 'Future* dynasties. The dynasties mentioned here are (1) B&rhadratha, (2) Pradyota, (3) Sisun&ga (4) Nanda, (5) Maurya, (6) Kanva and (8) Andhra.

verses.sanskrit: अयं हि मे महान्गर्भो रोरवीति बृहस्पते । अजस्रं ब्रह्म चाभ्यस्य षडङ्गं वेदमुद्गिरन्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ hi me mahāngarbho roravīti bṛhaspate / ajasraṃ brahma cābhyasya ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vedamudgiran
verses.translation: K?ema will be the king for full twenty-eight years. The vigorous king Suvrata will retain the kingdom for sixty- four years.
verses.wordMeaning: K?ema will be the king for full twenty-eight years. The vigorous king Suvrata will retain the kingdom for sixty- four years.
verses.commentary: Sense: K?ema will be the king for full twenty-eight years. The vigorous king Suvrata will retain the kingdom for sixty- four years.

verses.sanskrit: अमोघरे तास्त्वं चापि न मां भजितुमर्हसि । अस्मिन्नेव यथाकाले यथा वा मन्यसे विभो
verses.transliteration: amoghare tāstvaṃ cāpi na māṃ bhajitumarhasi / asminneva yathākāle yathā vā manyase vibho
verses.translation: Then Sumati will obtain and rule the kingdom for thirty-three years. Thereafter, king Sunetra will enjoy (the kingdom) for forty years.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Sumati will obtain and rule the kingdom for thirty-three years. Thereafter, king Sunetra will enjoy (the kingdom) for forty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Sumati will obtain and rule the kingdom for thirty-three years. Thereafter, king Sunetra will enjoy (the kingdom) for forty years.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तया सम्यग्बृहतेजा बृहस्पतिः । कामात्मानं महात्मापि नात्मानं सो ऽभ्यधारयत्
verses.transliteration: evamuktastayā samyagbṛhatejā bṛhaspatiḥ / kāmātmānaṃ mahātmāpi nātmānaṃ so 'bhyadhārayat
verses.translation: Satyajit will rule over the Earth for eighty-three years. After obtaining the kingdom Vi$vajit will rule over it for twenty-five years.
verses.wordMeaning: Satyajit will rule over the Earth for eighty-three years. After obtaining the kingdom Vi$vajit will rule over it for twenty-five years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satyajit will rule over the Earth for eighty-three years. After obtaining the kingdom Vi$vajit will rule over it for twenty-five years.

verses.sanskrit: संबभूवैव धर्मात्मा तया सार्द्धं बृहस्पति । उत्सृजन्तं तदा रेतो गर्भस्थः सो ऽस्य भाषत
verses.transliteration: saṃbabhūvaiva dharmātmā tayā sārddhaṃ bṛhaspati / utsṛjantaṃ tadā reto garbhasthaḥ so 'sya bhāṣata
verses.translation: Thereafter, Palaka will be the king for twenty-four years. Visakhayupa will be the king for fifty years.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, Palaka will be the king for twenty-four years. Visakhayupa will be the king for fifty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, Palaka will be the king for twenty-four years. Visakhayupa will be the king for fifty years.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रं त्याक्षीश्च मा जीव द्वयोर्नेहास्ति संभवः । अमोघरेतास्त्वं वापि पूर्वं चाहमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: śukraṃ tyākṣīśca mā jīva dvayornehāsti saṃbhavaḥ / amogharetāstvaṃ vāpi pūrvaṃ cāhamihāgataḥ
verses.translation: Ajaka will have the kingdom for twenty-one years. His son Nandivardhana will be the king for twenty years.
verses.wordMeaning: Ajaka will have the kingdom for twenty-one years. His son Nandivardhana will be the king for twenty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajaka will have the kingdom for twenty-one years. His son Nandivardhana will be the king for twenty years.

verses.sanskrit: शशाप तं तदा क्रुद्ध एवमुक्तो बृहस्पतिः । उशिजस्य सुतं भ्रातुर्गर्भस्थं भगवानृषिः
verses.transliteration: śaśāpa taṃ tadā kruddha evamukto bṛhaspatiḥ / uśijasya sutaṃ bhrāturgarbhasthaṃ bhagavānṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Ajatagatru will be the king for twentyfive years. Darbhaka will be the king for thirtyfive years.
verses.wordMeaning: Ajatagatru will be the king for twentyfive years. Darbhaka will be the king for thirtyfive years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajatagatru will be the king for twentyfive years. Darbhaka will be the king for thirtyfive years.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्त्वमीदृशे काले सर्वभूतेप्सिते सति । मामेवमुक्तवान्मोहात्तमो दीर्घं ग्रवेक्ष्यसि
verses.transliteration: yasmāttvamīdṛśe kāle sarvabhūtepsite sati / māmevamuktavānmohāttamo dīrghaṃ gravekṣyasi
verses.translation: Mahanandi's son, begot of a Sudra woman, will become the king by force of Time (circumstances). (He will be called) Mahapadma. He will be an exterminator of all Ksatriyas.
verses.wordMeaning: Mahanandi's son, begot of a Sudra woman, will become the king by force of Time (circumstances). (He will be called) Mahapadma. He will be an exterminator of all Ksatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahanandi's son, begot of a Sudra woman, will become the king by force of Time (circumstances). (He will be called) Mahapadma. He will be an exterminator of all Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दीर्घतमा नाम शापादृषिरजायत । अथौशिजो बृहत्कीर्तिर्बृहस्पतिरिबौजसा
verses.transliteration: tato dīrghatamā nāma śāpādṛṣirajāyata / athauśijo bṛhatkīrtirbṛhaspatiribaujasā
verses.translation: Thereafter, his eight sons will be kings for twelve years in due order, in the family of Mahapadma.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, his eight sons will be kings for twelve years in due order, in the family of Mahapadma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, his eight sons will be kings for twelve years in due order, in the family of Mahapadma.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्द्ध्वरेतास्ततश्चापि न्यवसद्भ्रातुराश्रमे । गोधर्मं सौरभेयात्तु वृषभाच्छतवान्प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: ūrddhvaretāstataścāpi nyavasadbhrāturāśrame / godharmaṃ saurabheyāttu vṛṣabhācchatavānprabhoḥ
verses.translation: The leading Brahmana Kaiitilya will exterminate all of them. That leading man will enjoy* the Earth for a hundred years.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Brahmana Kaiitilya will exterminate all of them. That leading man will enjoy* the Earth for a hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Brahmana Kaiitilya will exterminate all of them. That leading man will enjoy* the Earth for a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भ्राता पितृव्यस्तु चकार भवनं तदा । तस्मिन्हि तत्र वसति यदृच्छाभ्यागतो वृषः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhrātā pitṛvyastu cakāra bhavanaṃ tadā / tasminhi tatra vasati yadṛcchābhyāgato vṛṣaḥ
verses.translation: Kautilya will instal Candragupta. He will be king for twenty-four years.
verses.wordMeaning: Kautilya will instal Candragupta. He will be king for twenty-four years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kautilya will instal Candragupta. He will be king for twenty-four years.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शार्थमास्तृतान्दर्भाञ्चचार सुरभीसुतः । जग्राह तं दीर्घ तमा विस्फुरन्तं तु शृङ्गयोः
verses.transliteration: darśārthamāstṛtāndarbhāñcacāra surabhīsutaḥ / jagrāha taṃ dīrgha tamā visphurantaṃ tu śṛṅgayoḥ
verses.translation: Bhadrasara (?) will be king for twenty-five years. The king will accord contentment to Asoka (by installing him as a king) for thiriy-six years.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadrasara (?) will be king for twenty-five years. The king will accord contentment to Asoka (by installing him as a king) for thiriy-six years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadrasara (?) will be king for twenty-five years. The king will accord contentment to Asoka (by installing him as a king) for thiriy-six years.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन निगृहीतस्तु न चचाल पदात्पदम् । ततो ऽब्रवीद् वृषस्तं वै सुंच मां बलिनां वर
verses.transliteration: sa tena nigṛhītastu na cacāla padātpadam / tato 'bravīd vṛṣastaṃ vai suṃca māṃ balināṃ vara
verses.translation: His son Kulala (Kusala, Kunala) will be king for eight years. Bandhupalita, the son of Kusala, shall enjoy the kingdom for eight years.
verses.wordMeaning: His son Kulala (Kusala, Kunala) will be king for eight years. Bandhupalita, the son of Kusala, shall enjoy the kingdom for eight years.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son Kulala (Kusala, Kunala) will be king for eight years. Bandhupalita, the son of Kusala, shall enjoy the kingdom for eight years.

verses.sanskrit: न मया सादितस्तात बलवांस्तद्विधः क्वचित् । त्र्यंबकं वहता देवं यतो जातो ऽस्मि भूतले
verses.transliteration: na mayā sāditastāta balavāṃstadvidhaḥ kvacit / tryaṃbakaṃ vahatā devaṃ yato jāto 'smi bhūtale
verses.translation: Indrapalita will be the heir and successor of Bandhupalita. [For Ten years' as emended in DKA ]. Devavarma shall become the ruler of men for seven years.
verses.wordMeaning: Indrapalita will be the heir and successor of Bandhupalita. [For Ten years' as emended in DKA ]. Devavarma shall become the ruler of men for seven years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indrapalita will be the heir and successor of Bandhupalita. [For Ten years' as emended in DKA ]. Devavarma shall become the ruler of men for seven years.

verses.sanskrit: सुंच मां बलिनां श्रेष्ठ प्रतिस्नेहं वरं वृणु । एवमुक्तो ऽब्रवीदेनं जीवंस्त्वं मे क्व यास्यसि
verses.transliteration: suṃca māṃ balināṃ śreṣṭha pratisnehaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu / evamukto 'bravīdenaṃ jīvaṃstvaṃ me kva yāsyasi
verses.translation: Pusyamitra the commander-in-chief will overthrow Brhadratha and rule the kingdom for sixty years.
verses.wordMeaning: Pusyamitra the commander-in-chief will overthrow Brhadratha and rule the kingdom for sixty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pusyamitra the commander-in-chief will overthrow Brhadratha and rule the kingdom for sixty years.

verses.sanskrit: तेन त्वाहं न मोक्ष्यामि परस्वादं चतुष्पदम् । ततस्तं दीर्घतमसं स वृषः प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: tena tvāhaṃ na mokṣyāmi parasvādaṃ catuṣpadam / tatastaṃ dīrghatamasaṃ sa vṛṣaḥ pratyuvāca ha
verses.translation: Agnimilra will be the king for eight years. There- after, Sujycstha will be the king for seven years.
verses.wordMeaning: Agnimilra will be the king for eight years. There- after, Sujycstha will be the king for seven years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agnimilra will be the king for eight years. There- after, Sujycstha will be the king for seven years.

verses.sanskrit: नास्माकं विद्यते तात पातकं स्तेयमेव च । भक्ष्याभक्ष्यं न जानीमः पेयापेयं च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: nāsmākaṃ vidyate tāta pātakaṃ steyameva ca / bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ na jānīmaḥ peyāpeyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Vasumitra will then become king and reign for ten years. Then Bhadra will be the ruler for two years.
verses.wordMeaning: Vasumitra will then become king and reign for ten years. Then Bhadra will be the ruler for two years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasumitra will then become king and reign for ten years. Then Bhadra will be the ruler for two years.

verses.sanskrit: कार्या कार्यं च वै विप्र गम्यगम्यं तथैव च । न पाप्मानो वयं विप्र धर्मो ह्येष गवां श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: kāryā kāryaṃ ca vai vipra gamyagamyaṃ tathaiva ca / na pāpmāno vayaṃ vipra dharmo hyeṣa gavāṃ śrutaḥ
verses.translation: Vajramitra will be the king for seven years. Bhagavaia will be the king for thirty two years.
verses.wordMeaning: Vajramitra will be the king for seven years. Bhagavaia will be the king for thirty two years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vajramitra will be the king for seven years. Bhagavaia will be the king for thirty two years.

verses.sanskrit: गवां नाम स वे श्रुत्वा संभ्रान्तस्त ममुञ्चत । भक्त्या चानुश्रविकया गोसुतं वै प्रसादयन्
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ nāma sa ve śrutvā saṃbhrāntasta mamuñcata / bhaktyā cānuśravikayā gosutaṃ vai prasādayan
verses.translation: Patuman will be the king for twenty-four year?. Anistakarma will be the king for twenty-five years.
verses.wordMeaning: Patuman will be the king for twenty-four year?. Anistakarma will be the king for twenty-five years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Patuman will be the king for twenty-four year?. Anistakarma will be the king for twenty-five years.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादतो वृषेन्द्रस्य गोधर्मं जगृहे ऽथ सः । मनसैव तदा दध्रे तद्विधस्तत्परायणः
verses.transliteration: prasādato vṛṣendrasya godharmaṃ jagṛhe 'tha saḥ / manasaiva tadā dadhre tadvidhastatparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then for a full year, Hala will be the king. The extremely powerful king named Pattallaka will be the king for five years.
verses.wordMeaning: Then for a full year, Hala will be the king. The extremely powerful king named Pattallaka will be the king for five years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then for a full year, Hala will be the king. The extremely powerful king named Pattallaka will be the king for five years.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यवीयसः पत्नीमौतथ्यस्याभ्यमन्यत । विचेष्टमानां रुदतीं दैवात्संमूढचेतनः
verses.transliteration: tato yavīyasaḥ patnīmautathyasyābhyamanyata / viceṣṭamānāṃ rudatīṃ daivātsaṃmūḍhacetanaḥ
verses.translation: Purlsabhiru will be the king for twentyone years. Satakarni will be the king for a year.
verses.wordMeaning: Purlsabhiru will be the king for twentyone years. Satakarni will be the king for a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purlsabhiru will be the king for twentyone years. Satakarni will be the king for a year.

verses.sanskrit: अवलेपं तु तंमत्वा सुरद्वांस्तस्य नाक्षमत् । गोधर्म वै बलं कृत्वा स्नुषां स ह्यभ्यमन्यत
verses.transliteration: avalepaṃ tu taṃmatvā suradvāṃstasya nākṣamat / godharma vai balaṃ kṛtvā snuṣāṃ sa hyabhyamanyata
verses.translation: Sivasvati will be the king.for twenty-eight years. Gautamlputra will be the king for twenty-one years.
verses.wordMeaning: Sivasvati will be the king.for twenty-eight years. Gautamlputra will be the king for twenty-one years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sivasvati will be the king.for twenty-eight years. Gautamlputra will be the king for twenty-one years.

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययं तु तं दृष्ट्वा शरद्वान्प्रविचिन्त्य च । भविष्यमर्थं ज्ञात्वा च महात्मा त्ववमत्य तम्
verses.transliteration: viparyayaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaradvānpravicintya ca / bhaviṣyamarthaṃ jñātvā ca mahātmā tvavamatya tam
verses.translation: Then Yajrla-Srl Satakarni will be the king for nineteen years. After him Vijaya will be the king for only six years.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Yajrla-Srl Satakarni will be the king for nineteen years. After him Vijaya will be the king for only six years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Yajrla-Srl Satakarni will be the king for nineteen years. After him Vijaya will be the king for only six years.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच दीर्घतमसं क्रोधात्संरक्तलोचनः । गम्यागम्यं न जानीषे गोधर्मात्प्रार्थयन्स्रुषाम्
verses.transliteration: provāca dīrghatamasaṃ krodhātsaṃraktalocanaḥ / gamyāgamyaṃ na jānīṣe godharmātprārthayansruṣām
verses.translation: Five families of Andhras have passed away. Those belonging to their families are seven in the future (?) There- after there will be ten Abhira kings.
verses.wordMeaning: Five families of Andhras have passed away. Those belonging to their families are seven in the future (?) There- after there will be ten Abhira kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five families of Andhras have passed away. Those belonging to their families are seven in the future (?) There- after there will be ten Abhira kings.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वृत्तं त्वां त्यजाम्येष गच्छ त्वं स्वेन कर्मणा । यस्मात्त्वमन्धो वृद्धश्च भर्त्तव्यो दुरनुष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: durvṛttaṃ tvāṃ tyajāmyeṣa gaccha tvaṃ svena karmaṇā / yasmāttvamandho vṛddhaśca bharttavyo duranuṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: Gardabhin kings arc seven. Then the Saka rulers are ten. There will be eight Yavana families and fourteen Tus&ras.
verses.wordMeaning: Gardabhin kings arc seven. Then the Saka rulers are ten. There will be eight Yavana families and fourteen Tus&ras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gardabhin kings arc seven. Then the Saka rulers are ten. There will be eight Yavana families and fourteen Tus&ras.

verses.sanskrit: तेनासि त्वं परित्यक्तो दुराचारो ऽसि मे मतः । सूत उवाच कर्मण्यस्मिंस्ततः क्रूरे तस्य बुद्धिरजायत
verses.transliteration: tenāsi tvaṃ parityakto durācāro 'si me mataḥ / sūta uvāca karmaṇyasmiṃstataḥ krūre tasya buddhirajāyata
verses.translation: There will be thirteen Gurundas and eleven Maunas. Andhras will enjoy the Earth for three hundred years.
verses.wordMeaning: There will be thirteen Gurundas and eleven Maunas. Andhras will enjoy the Earth for three hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: There will be thirteen Gurundas and eleven Maunas. Andhras will enjoy the Earth for three hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: निर्भर्त्स्य चैव बहुशो बाहुभ्यां परिगृह्य च । कोष्टे समुद्रे प्रक्षिप्य गङ्गांभसि समुत्सृजत्
verses.transliteration: nirbhartsya caiva bahuśo bāhubhyāṃ parigṛhya ca / koṣṭe samudre prakṣipya gaṅgāṃbhasi samutsṛjat
verses.translation: The ten Abhiras will be kings for sixty-seven years. The seven Gardabhins will enjoy the Earth for seventy- two years.
verses.wordMeaning: The ten Abhiras will be kings for sixty-seven years. The seven Gardabhins will enjoy the Earth for seventy- two years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ten Abhiras will be kings for sixty-seven years. The seven Gardabhins will enjoy the Earth for seventy- two years.

verses.sanskrit: उह्यमानः समुद्रस्तु सप्ताहं श्रोतसा तदा । तं सस्त्रीको बलिर्नाम राजा धर्मार्थतत्त्ववित्
verses.transliteration: uhyamānaḥ samudrastu saptāhaṃ śrotasā tadā / taṃ sastrīko balirnāma rājā dharmārthatattvavit
verses.translation: Sakas will enjoy the Earth for three hundred and eighty years.
verses.wordMeaning: Sakas will enjoy the Earth for three hundred and eighty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sakas will enjoy the Earth for three hundred and eighty years.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यन्मज्जमानं तु स्रोतसोभ्यासमागतम् । तं गृहीत्वा स धर्मात्मा बलिर्वैरोचनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: apaśyanmajjamānaṃ tu srotasobhyāsamāgatam / taṃ gṛhītvā sa dharmātmā balirvairocanastadā
verses.translation: When they are exterminated by force of time, the clan of Kilakila shall rule. After the Kilakilas, Vindhya- sakti will be the king.
verses.wordMeaning: When they are exterminated by force of time, the clan of Kilakila shall rule. After the Kilakilas, Vindhya- sakti will be the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they are exterminated by force of time, the clan of Kilakila shall rule. After the Kilakilas, Vindhya- sakti will be the king.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःपुरे जुगोपैनं भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैश्च तर्पयन् । प्रीतः स वै वरेणाथ च्छन्दयामास वै बलिम्
verses.transliteration: antaḥpure jugopainaṃ bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca tarpayan / prītaḥ sa vai vareṇātha cchandayāmāsa vai balim
verses.translation: He will retain the Earth for ninety-six years. Understand, henceforth, the kings of the future belonging to the land of Vidisa.
verses.wordMeaning: He will retain the Earth for ninety-six years. Understand, henceforth, the kings of the future belonging to the land of Vidisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will retain the Earth for ninety-six years. Understand, henceforth, the kings of the future belonging to the land of Vidisa.

verses.sanskrit: स च तस्माद्वरं वव्रे पुत्रार्थी दानवर्षभः । बलिरुवाच संतानार्थं महाभाग भार्यायां मम मानद
verses.transliteration: sa ca tasmādvaraṃ vavre putrārthī dānavarṣabhaḥ / baliruvāca saṃtānārthaṃ mahābhāga bhāryāyāṃ mama mānada
verses.translation: Bhutinanda shall succeed him as ruler in Vidisa. His younger brother will be Nandiyasas by name.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhutinanda shall succeed him as ruler in Vidisa. His younger brother will be Nandiyasas by name.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhutinanda shall succeed him as ruler in Vidisa. His younger brother will be Nandiyasas by name.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्धर्मार्थसंयुक्तानुत्पादयितुमर्हसि । एवमुक्तस्तुतेनर्षिस्तथास्त्वित्युक्तवान्हितम्
verses.transliteration: putrāndharmārthasaṃyuktānutpādayitumarhasi / evamuktastutenarṣistathāstvityuktavānhitam
verses.translation: t In his family, there will be only three kings. His daughters' son shall become the king in Purika.
verses.wordMeaning: t In his family, there will be only three kings. His daughters' son shall become the king in Purika.
verses.commentary: Sense: t In his family, there will be only three kings. His daughters' son shall become the king in Purika.

verses.sanskrit: सुदेष्णां नाम भार्यां स्वां राजास्मै प्राहिणोत्तदा । अन्धं वृद्धं च तं दृष्ट्वा न सा देवी जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: sudeṣṇāṃ nāma bhāryāṃ svāṃ rājāsmai prāhiṇottadā / andhaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā na sā devī jagāma ha
verses.translation: Vindhyasakti's son, a heroic warrior named Pravira will enjoy the city Kancanaka for sixty years.
verses.wordMeaning: Vindhyasakti's son, a heroic warrior named Pravira will enjoy the city Kancanaka for sixty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vindhyasakti's son, a heroic warrior named Pravira will enjoy the city Kancanaka for sixty years.

verses.sanskrit: स्वां च धात्रेयिकां तस्मै भूषयित्वा व्यसर्जयत् । कक्षीवच्चक्षुषौ तस्यां शूद्रयोन्यामृषिर्वशी
verses.transliteration: svāṃ ca dhātreyikāṃ tasmai bhūṣayitvā vyasarjayat / kakṣīvaccakṣuṣau tasyāṃ śūdrayonyāmṛṣirvaśī
verses.translation: He will perform Vajapeya sacrifices after distri- buting excellent Daksinas at the conclusion. His four sons will become rulers.
verses.wordMeaning: He will perform Vajapeya sacrifices after distri- buting excellent Daksinas at the conclusion. His four sons will become rulers.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will perform Vajapeya sacrifices after distri- buting excellent Daksinas at the conclusion. His four sons will become rulers.

verses.sanskrit: जनया मास धर्मात्मा पुत्रावेतौ महौजसौ । कक्षीवच्चक्षुषौ तौ तु दृष्ट्वा राजा बलिस्तदा
verses.transliteration: janayā māsa dharmātmā putrāvetau mahaujasau / kakṣīvaccakṣuṣau tau tu dṛṣṭvā rājā balistadā
verses.translation: There will be seven kings ruling over Mekala for seventy years. The kings in Komala will be very powerful.
verses.wordMeaning: There will be seven kings ruling over Mekala for seventy years. The kings in Komala will be very powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: There will be seven kings ruling over Mekala for seventy years. The kings in Komala will be very powerful.

verses.sanskrit: अधीतौ विधिवत्सम्य गीश्वरौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ । सिद्धौ प्रत्यक्षधर्माणौ बुद्धौ श्रेष्ठतमावपि
verses.transliteration: adhītau vidhivatsamya gīśvarau brahmavādinau / siddhau pratyakṣadharmāṇau buddhau śreṣṭhatamāvapi
verses.translation: They are called Meghas and they are very intelli- gent. There will be nine kings in that line. All the Naisa- dhas will be great kings, and the family will last till the close of Manvantara.
verses.wordMeaning: They are called Meghas and they are very intelli- gent. There will be nine kings in that line. All the Naisa- dhas will be great kings, and the family will last till the close of Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are called Meghas and they are very intelli- gent. There will be nine kings in that line. All the Naisa- dhas will be great kings, and the family will last till the close of Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: ममैताविति होवाच बलिर्वैरोचनस्त्वृषिम् । नेत्युवाच ततस्तं तु ममैताविति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: mamaitāviti hovāca balirvairocanastvṛṣim / netyuvāca tatastaṃ tu mamaitāviti cābravīt
verses.translation: Nine Naga kings will rule over the city of Campavatl. Seven Naga kings will enjoy the beautiful city of Mathura.
verses.wordMeaning: Nine Naga kings will rule over the city of Campavatl. Seven Naga kings will enjoy the beautiful city of Mathura.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nine Naga kings will rule over the city of Campavatl. Seven Naga kings will enjoy the beautiful city of Mathura.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नौ शूद्रयोनौ तु भवतः क्ष्मासुरोत्तमौ । अन्धं वृद्धं च मां मत्वा सुदेष्णा महिषी तव
verses.transliteration: utpannau śūdrayonau tu bhavataḥ kṣmāsurottamau / andhaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca māṃ matvā sudeṣṇā mahiṣī tava
verses.translation: The descendants of those seven families will enjoy the territories around Ganga such as Prayaga, Saketa and Magadha.
verses.wordMeaning: The descendants of those seven families will enjoy the territories around Ganga such as Prayaga, Saketa and Magadha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The descendants of those seven families will enjoy the territories around Ganga such as Prayaga, Saketa and Magadha.

verses.sanskrit: प्राहिणोदवमानीय शूद्रीं धात्रेयिकां मम । ततः प्रसादयामास पुनस्तमृषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prāhiṇodavamānīya śūdrīṃ dhātreyikāṃ mama / tataḥ prasādayāmāsa punastamṛṣisattamam
verses.translation: They will enjoy the following territories abounding in jewels and food-grains vi. Naisadha, Yaduka, SaiSita and Kalatoyaka.
verses.wordMeaning: They will enjoy the following territories abounding in jewels and food-grains vi. Naisadha, Yaduka, SaiSita and Kalatoyaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will enjoy the following territories abounding in jewels and food-grains vi. Naisadha, Yaduka, SaiSita and Kalatoyaka.

verses.sanskrit: बलिर्भार्यां सुदेष्णा च भर्त्सयामास वै प्रभुः । पुनश्चैनामलङ्कृत्य ऋषये प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: balirbhāryāṃ sudeṣṇā ca bhartsayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ / punaścaināmalaṅkṛtya ṛṣaye pratyapādayat
verses.translation: Devaraksitas (those guarded by Devas) will rule over the territories of Kosala, Andhra, Paundra, Tamralipta and Sagara as well as the charming city of Campa.
verses.wordMeaning: Devaraksitas (those guarded by Devas) will rule over the territories of Kosala, Andhra, Paundra, Tamralipta and Sagara as well as the charming city of Campa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devaraksitas (those guarded by Devas) will rule over the territories of Kosala, Andhra, Paundra, Tamralipta and Sagara as well as the charming city of Campa.

verses.sanskrit: तां स दीर्घतमा देवीमब्रवीद्यदि मां शुभे । दध्ना लवणमिश्रेण स्वभ्यक्तं नग्नकं तथा
verses.transliteration: tāṃ sa dīrghatamā devīmabravīdyadi māṃ śubhe / dadhnā lavaṇamiśreṇa svabhyaktaṃ nagnakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Guha will protect the following territories viz. Kalinga, Mahisa and Mahendranilaya.
verses.wordMeaning: Guha will protect the following territories viz. Kalinga, Mahisa and Mahendranilaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guha will protect the following territories viz. Kalinga, Mahisa and Mahendranilaya.

verses.sanskrit: लेहिष्यस्यजुगुप्सन्ती ह्यापादतलमस्तकम् । ततस्त्वं प्राप्स्यसे देवि पुत्रांश्च मनसेप्सितान्
verses.transliteration: lehiṣyasyajugupsantī hyāpādatalamastakam / tatastvaṃ prāpsyase devi putrāṃśca manasepsitān
verses.translation: Those persons will become kings by turns after the lapse of some time. They will be devoid of Dharma. They will be base and mean in the matter of love and wealth.
verses.wordMeaning: Those persons will become kings by turns after the lapse of some time. They will be devoid of Dharma. They will be base and mean in the matter of love and wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those persons will become kings by turns after the lapse of some time. They will be devoid of Dharma. They will be base and mean in the matter of love and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सा तद्वचो देवी सर्वं कृतवती तथा । अपानं च समासाद्य जुगुप्संती ह्यवर्जयत्
verses.transliteration: tasya sā tadvaco devī sarvaṃ kṛtavatī tathā / apānaṃ ca samāsādya jugupsaṃtī hyavarjayat
verses.translation: On account of them all the territories will become inter-mixed. They will follow the customs and conventions of the Mlecchas. They will act in contravention of established principles of religion and ruin the subjects.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of them all the territories will become inter-mixed. They will follow the customs and conventions of the Mlecchas. They will act in contravention of established principles of religion and ruin the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of them all the territories will become inter-mixed. They will follow the customs and conventions of the Mlecchas. They will act in contravention of established principles of religion and ruin the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाच ततः सर्षिर्यस्ते परिहृतं शुभे । विनापानं कुमारं त्वं जनयिष्यसि पूर्वजम्
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca tataḥ sarṣiryaste parihṛtaṃ śubhe / vināpānaṃ kumāraṃ tvaṃ janayiṣyasi pūrvajam
verses.translation: Similarly, all those who are unrighteous and extremely heretic will face destruction.
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, all those who are unrighteous and extremely heretic will face destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, all those who are unrighteous and extremely heretic will face destruction.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तं दीर्घतमसं सा देवी प्रत्युवाच ह ॥ नार्हसि त्वं महाभाग पुत्रं दातुं ममेदृशम्
verses.transliteration: tatastaṃ dīrghatamasaṃ sā devī pratyuvāca ha // nārhasi tvaṃ mahābhāga putraṃ dātuṃ mamedṛśam
verses.translation: The few people who survive till that period will face various hardships, as Dharma (virtue) has become discredited. They will become destitutes without possessions
verses.wordMeaning: The few people who survive till that period will face various hardships, as Dharma (virtue) has become discredited. They will become destitutes without possessions
verses.commentary: Sense: The few people who survive till that period will face various hardships, as Dharma (virtue) has become discredited. They will become destitutes without possessions

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच तवापरधो देव्येष नान्यथा भविता तु वै । देवीदृशं च ते पौत्रमहं दास्यामि सुप्रते
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiruvāca tavāparadho devyeṣa nānyathā bhavitā tu vai / devīdṛśaṃ ca te pautramahaṃ dāsyāmi suprate
verses.translation: VV.20 1-241 depict the gloomy picture of the Kali Age. This description is common to other Purapas also. R. C. Hazra, in PRHRG states that such was probably the condition of Hindu society from 200 B.G. to A.D. 200.
verses.wordMeaning: VV.20 1-241 depict the gloomy picture of the Kali Age. This description is common to other Purapas also. R. C. Hazra, in PRHRG states that such was probably the condition of Hindu society from 200 B.G. to A.D. 200.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.20 1-241 depict the gloomy picture of the Kali Age. This description is common to other Purapas also. R. C. Hazra, in PRHRG states that such was probably the condition of Hindu society from 200 B.G. to A.D. 200.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापानं विना चैव योग्यभावो भविष्यति । तां स दीर्घतमाश्चैव कुक्षौ स्पृष्ट्वदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasyāpānaṃ vinā caiva yogyabhāvo bhaviṣyati / tāṃ sa dīrghatamāścaiva kukṣau spṛṣṭvadamabravīt
verses.translation: They will be ruined due to drought and absence of rain and by killing one another.
verses.wordMeaning: They will be ruined due to drought and absence of rain and by killing one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be ruined due to drought and absence of rain and by killing one another.

verses.sanskrit: प्राशितं दधियत्ते ऽद्य ममाङ्गाद्वै शुचिस्मिते । तेन ते पूरितो गर्भः पौर्णमास्यामिवोदधिः
verses.transliteration: prāśitaṃ dadhiyatte 'dya mamāṅgādvai śucismite / tena te pūrito garbhaḥ paurṇamāsyāmivodadhiḥ
verses.translation: They will have none to support them. Due to great fear, they will desert their profession and places of work. They will become still more miserable. They will leave off cities and villages. They will begin to dwell in forest.
verses.wordMeaning: They will have none to support them. Due to great fear, they will desert their profession and places of work. They will become still more miserable. They will leave off cities and villages. They will begin to dwell in forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will have none to support them. Due to great fear, they will desert their profession and places of work. They will become still more miserable. They will leave off cities and villages. They will begin to dwell in forest.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यन्ति कुमारास्ते पञ्च देवसुतोपमाः । तेजस्विनः पराक्रान्ता यज्वानो धार्मिकास्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyanti kumārāste pañca devasutopamāḥ / tejasvinaḥ parākrāntā yajvāno dhārmikāstathā
verses.translation: The genealogy and the order of succession of the kings of the past, present and future, has been completely recounted to you.
verses.wordMeaning: The genealogy and the order of succession of the kings of the past, present and future, has been completely recounted to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The genealogy and the order of succession of the kings of the past, present and future, has been completely recounted to you.

verses.sanskrit: तत्ॐऽगस्तु सुदेष्णाया ज्येष्ठपुत्रो व्यजायत । वङ्गस्तस्मात्कलिङ्गस्तु पुण्ड्रः सुह्मस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tatoṃ'gastu sudeṣṇāyā jyeṣṭhaputro vyajāyata / vaṅgastasmātkaliṅgastu puṇḍraḥ suhmastathaiva ca
verses.translation: It should be known that the period beginning with the birth of Parlksit and ending with the coronation of Maha- nanda consists of a thousand and fifty years.
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the period beginning with the birth of Parlksit and ending with the coronation of Maha- nanda consists of a thousand and fifty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the period beginning with the birth of Parlksit and ending with the coronation of Maha- nanda consists of a thousand and fifty years.

verses.sanskrit: वंशभाजस्तु पञ्चैते बलेः क्षेत्रे ऽभवंस्तदा । इत्येते दीर्घतमसा बलेर्दत्ताः सुताः पुरा
verses.transliteration: vaṃśabhājastu pañcaite baleḥ kṣetre 'bhavaṃstadā / ityete dīrghatamasā balerdattāḥ sutāḥ purā
verses.translation: Brahmanas will perform Tdgas (sacrifices) on behalf of Sudras. Sudras will be the source of origin of Mantras. Brahmanas will resort to them and attend on them with a desire to get some base means of livelihood.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas will perform Tdgas (sacrifices) on behalf of Sudras. Sudras will be the source of origin of Mantras. Brahmanas will resort to them and attend on them with a desire to get some base means of livelihood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas will perform Tdgas (sacrifices) on behalf of Sudras. Sudras will be the source of origin of Mantras. Brahmanas will resort to them and attend on them with a desire to get some base means of livelihood.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजा ह्युपहतास्तस्य ब्रह्मणा कारणं प्रति । अपत्यमस्य दारेषु स्वेषु माभून्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: prajā hyupahatāstasya brahmaṇā kāraṇaṃ prati / apatyamasya dāreṣu sveṣu mābhūnmahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Their subjects will be falling away from Dharma little by little. At the end of the Yuga, the subjects will be utterly destroyed.
verses.wordMeaning: Their subjects will be falling away from Dharma little by little. At the end of the Yuga, the subjects will be utterly destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their subjects will be falling away from Dharma little by little. At the end of the Yuga, the subjects will be utterly destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मनुष्ययोन्यां वै जनयामास स प्रजाः । सुरभिर्दीर्घत मसमथ प्रीतो वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tato manuṣyayonyāṃ vai janayāmāsa sa prajāḥ / surabhirdīrghata masamatha prīto vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: Kali Yuga began on the day when Kr?na passed on to heaven. Understand how it is calculated.
verses.wordMeaning: Kali Yuga began on the day when Kr?na passed on to heaven. Understand how it is calculated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali Yuga began on the day when Kr?na passed on to heaven. Understand how it is calculated.

verses.sanskrit: विचार्य यस्माद्गोधर्मं त्वमेवं कृतवानसि । भक्त्या चानन्ययास्मासु मुने प्रीतास्मि तेन ते
verses.transliteration: vicārya yasmādgodharmaṃ tvamevaṃ kṛtavānasi / bhaktyā cānanyayāsmāsu mune prītāsmi tena te
verses.translation: The two dynasties viz. that of Aila and that of Iksvaku have been recounted along with their different clans and subdivisions. The solar dynasty of Iksvaku is remembered as ending with Sumitra.
verses.wordMeaning: The two dynasties viz. that of Aila and that of Iksvaku have been recounted along with their different clans and subdivisions. The solar dynasty of Iksvaku is remembered as ending with Sumitra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two dynasties viz. that of Aila and that of Iksvaku have been recounted along with their different clans and subdivisions. The solar dynasty of Iksvaku is remembered as ending with Sumitra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तव तमो दीर्घं निस्तदाम्यद्य पश्य वै । बार्हस्पत्यं च यत्ते ऽन्यत्पापं संतिष्ठते तनौ
verses.transliteration: tasmāttava tamo dīrghaṃ nistadāmyadya paśya vai / bārhaspatyaṃ ca yatte 'nyatpāpaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate tanau
verses.translation: I shall mention those persons from whom the Ksatriya race begins in this Yuga. Even as I recount it try to understand the same.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention those persons from whom the Ksatriya race begins in this Yuga. Even as I recount it try to understand the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention those persons from whom the Ksatriya race begins in this Yuga. Even as I recount it try to understand the same.

verses.sanskrit: जरामृत्युभयं चैव ह्याघ्राय प्रणुदामि ते । आघ्रातमात्रो ऽसा पश्यत्सद्यस्तमसि नाशिते
verses.transliteration: jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ caiva hyāghrāya praṇudāmi te / āghrātamātro 'sā paśyatsadyastamasi nāśite
verses.translation: Devapi, the king belonging to the family of Puru, and Maru who belongs to Iksvaku family, these two are endowed with great Yogic power. They occupied the village called Kalapa.
verses.wordMeaning: Devapi, the king belonging to the family of Puru, and Maru who belongs to Iksvaku family, these two are endowed with great Yogic power. They occupied the village called Kalapa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devapi, the king belonging to the family of Puru, and Maru who belongs to Iksvaku family, these two are endowed with great Yogic power. They occupied the village called Kalapa.

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्मांश्च युवा चैव चक्षुष्मांश्च ततो ऽभवत् । गवा हृततमाः सो ऽथ गौतमः समपद्यत
verses.transliteration: āyuṣmāṃśca yuvā caiva cakṣuṣmāṃśca tato 'bhavat / gavā hṛtatamāḥ so 'tha gautamaḥ samapadyata
verses.translation: When the Ksatriyas were completely exterminated by Rama son of Jamadagni, this entire Earth was rendered confused by the Ksatriya kings.
verses.wordMeaning: When the Ksatriyas were completely exterminated by Rama son of Jamadagni, this entire Earth was rendered confused by the Ksatriya kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Ksatriyas were completely exterminated by Rama son of Jamadagni, this entire Earth was rendered confused by the Ksatriya kings.

verses.sanskrit: कक्षीवांस्तु ततो गत्वा सह पित्रा गिरिव्रजम् । यथोद्दिष्टं हि पित्राथ चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: kakṣīvāṃstu tato gatvā saha pitrā girivrajam / yathoddiṣṭaṃ hi pitrātha cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Hundred and one families belonging to them have been accorded coronation. The extent of the Bhojas is remem- bered as twice.
verses.wordMeaning: Hundred and one families belonging to them have been accorded coronation. The extent of the Bhojas is remem- bered as twice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundred and one families belonging to them have been accorded coronation. The extent of the Bhojas is remem- bered as twice.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता तपसा भावितः स वै । विधूय सानुजो दोषान्ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्तवान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā tapasā bhāvitaḥ sa vai / vidhūya sānujo doṣānbrāhmaṇyaṃ prāptavānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: (Defective Text). Three-fourths of the Ksatriyas, become established. The other one-fourth is scattered here and there in various directions (?). Undersand even as I recount those who are equal (?) to those who are of the past.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Text). Three-fourths of the Ksatriyas, become established. The other one-fourth is scattered here and there in various directions (?). Undersand even as I recount those who are equal (?) to those who are of the past.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Text). Three-fourths of the Ksatriyas, become established. The other one-fourth is scattered here and there in various directions (?). Undersand even as I recount those who are equal (?) to those who are of the past.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽब्रवीत्पिता त्वेनं पुत्रवानस्म्यहं प्रभो । सुपुत्रेण त्वया तात कृतार्थश्च यशस्विना
verses.transliteration: tato 'bravītpitā tvenaṃ putravānasmyahaṃ prabho / suputreṇa tvayā tāta kṛtārthaśca yaśasvinā
verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तात्मानं ततः सो ऽथ प्राप्तवान्ब्रह्मणः क्षयम् । ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्य कक्षीवान्सहस्रमसृजत्सुतान्
verses.transliteration: yuktātmānaṃ tataḥ so 'tha prāptavānbrahmaṇaḥ kṣayam / brāhmaṇyaṃ prāpya kakṣīvānsahasramasṛjatsutān
verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.sanskrit: कूष्माण्डा गौतमास्ते वै स्मृताः कक्षीवतः सुताः । इत्येष दीर्घतमसो बलेर्वैरोचनस्य वै
verses.transliteration: kūṣmāṇḍā gautamāste vai smṛtāḥ kakṣīvataḥ sutāḥ / ityeṣa dīrghatamaso balervairocanasya vai
verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.sanskrit: समागमः समाख्यातः संतानश्चोभयोस्तथा । बलिस्तानभिषिच्येह पञ्च पुत्रानकल्मषान्
verses.transliteration: samāgamaḥ samākhyātaḥ saṃtānaścobhayostathā / balistānabhiṣicyeha pañca putrānakalmaṣān
verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.sanskrit: कृतार्थः सो ऽपि योगात्मा योगमाश्रित्य च प्रभुः । अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां कालाकाक्षी चरत्युत
verses.transliteration: kṛtārthaḥ so 'pi yogātmā yogamāśritya ca prabhuḥ / adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kālākākṣī caratyuta
verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राङ्गस्य तु राजर्षे राजासीद्दधिवाहनः । सो ऽपराधात्सुदेष्णाया अनपानो ऽभवन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: tatrāṅgasya tu rājarṣe rājāsīddadhivāhanaḥ / so 'parādhātsudeṣṇāyā anapāno 'bhavannṛpaḥ
verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.sanskrit: अनपानस्य पुत्रस्तु राजा दिविरथः स्मृतः । पुत्रो दिविरथस्यासीद्विद्वान्धर्मरथो नृपः
verses.transliteration: anapānasya putrastu rājā divirathaḥ smṛtaḥ / putro divirathasyāsīdvidvāndharmaratho nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.

verses.translation: There are hundred descendants of the Prativ- indhyas, hundred Nagas along with Haihayas, hundred and one Dhrtara?tr&s and eighty Janamejayas.
