verses.wordMeaning: They are Urdhvareras (those who have sublimated their sexual energy). They do not have anything which can slay them again (i.e. they are deathless). Their faith evolved J}y_rerjeated holy rites s indicated in the Vedantas (Upanisads
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Urdhvareras (those who have sublimated their sexual energy). They do not have anything which can slay them again (i.e. they are deathless). Their faith evolved J}y_rerjeated holy rites s indicated in the Vedantas (Upanisads

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुः सनत्कुमाराद्या यत्रासन्नूर्द्ध्वरेतसः । तपसा भावितात्मानस्तत्र संतीति वा तपः
verses.transliteration: ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyā yatrāsannūrddhvaretasaḥ / tapasā bhāvitātmānastatra saṃtīti vā tapaḥ
verses.translation: There, they engage themselves in the practice of Yogic union (with the Supreme Brahman). They worship the highest goal. They abandon their physical body, the cause of all sins and proceed ahead for their immortality.
verses.wordMeaning: There, they engage themselves in the practice of Yogic union (with the Supreme Brahman). They worship the highest goal. They abandon their physical body, the cause of all sins and proceed ahead for their immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, they engage themselves in the practice of Yogic union (with the Supreme Brahman). They worship the highest goal. They abandon their physical body, the cause of all sins and proceed ahead for their immortality.

verses.sanskrit: सत्येति ब्रह्मणः शब्दः सत्तामात्रस्तु स स्मृतः । ब्रह्मलोकस्ततः सत्यः सप्तमः स तु भास्वरः
verses.transliteration: satyeti brahmaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattāmātrastu sa smṛtaḥ / brahmalokastataḥ satyaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu bhāsvaraḥ
verses.translation: The main numbers are one, ten, hundred and thousand. All numbers till thousand should be understood. Ten Sahasras (thousands) make one Ayuta.
verses.wordMeaning: The main numbers are one, ten, hundred and thousand. All numbers till thousand should be understood. Ten Sahasras (thousands) make one Ayuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The main numbers are one, ten, hundred and thousand. All numbers till thousand should be understood. Ten Sahasras (thousands) make one Ayuta.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यक्षा गुह्यकास्तु सराक्षसाः । सर्वभूतपिशाचाश्च नागाश्च सह मानुषैः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāpsaraso yakṣā guhyakāstu sarākṣasāḥ / sarvabhūtapiśācāśca nāgāśca saha mānuṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Learned men say that a thousand Kofis make a Kharva. They know that ten thousand crores make a JVikharva.
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men say that a thousand Kofis make a Kharva. They know that ten thousand crores make a JVikharva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men say that a thousand Kofis make a Kharva. They know that ten thousand crores make a JVikharva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्लोकवासिनः सर्वे देवा भुवि निवासिनः । मरुतो मातरिश्वानो रुद्रा देवास्तथाश्विनौ
verses.transliteration: svarlokavāsinaḥ sarve devā bhuvi nivāsinaḥ / maruto mātariśvāno rudrā devāstathāśvinau
verses.translation: A thousand thousand Kofis multiplied by ten, is called Samudra (or Jafadhi) by persons well-versed in reckoning.
verses.wordMeaning: A thousand thousand Kofis multiplied by ten, is called Samudra (or Jafadhi) by persons well-versed in reckoning.
verses.commentary: Sense: A thousand thousand Kofis multiplied by ten, is called Samudra (or Jafadhi) by persons well-versed in reckoning.

verses.sanskrit: अनिकेतान्तरिक्षास्ते भुवर्लोका दिवौकसः । आदित्या ऋभवो विश्वे साध्याश्च पितरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: aniketāntarikṣāste bhuvarlokā divaukasaḥ / ādityā ṛbhavo viśve sādhyāśca pitarastathā
verses.translation: A hundred thousand multiplied by a thousand' Kofis is called Autya. A million multiplied by a thousand crores is called Madhya.
verses.wordMeaning: A hundred thousand multiplied by a thousand' Kofis is called Autya. A million multiplied by a thousand crores is called Madhya.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hundred thousand multiplied by a thousand' Kofis is called Autya. A million multiplied by a thousand crores is called Madhya.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयोङ्गिर सश्चैव भुवर्लोकं समाश्रिताः । एते वैमानिका देवास्ताराग्रहनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayoṅgira saścaiva bhuvarlokaṃ samāśritāḥ / ete vaimānikā devāstārāgrahanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: The countable and the uncountable are always based on Tantras (Scientific Treatises). The countable is observed through numbers. It is spoken ofupto Parardha.
verses.wordMeaning: The countable and the uncountable are always based on Tantras (Scientific Treatises). The countable is observed through numbers. It is spoken ofupto Parardha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The countable and the uncountable are always based on Tantras (Scientific Treatises). The countable is observed through numbers. It is spoken ofupto Parardha.

verses.sanskrit: आरंभन्ते तु तन्मात्रैः शुद्धास्तेषां परस्परम् । शुक्राद्याश्चक्षुषान्ताश्च ये व्यतीता भुवं श्रिताः
verses.transliteration: āraṃbhante tu tanmātraiḥ śuddhāsteṣāṃ parasparam / śukrādyāścakṣuṣāntāśca ye vyatītā bhuvaṃ śritāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing their utterance full of humility, Matari- svan (the Wind-god) uttered the following sweet words (ex- plaining everything) in the proper order and in the manner seen by him.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their utterance full of humility, Matari- svan (the Wind-god) uttered the following sweet words (ex- plaining everything) in the proper order and in the manner seen by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their utterance full of humility, Matari- svan (the Wind-god) uttered the following sweet words (ex- plaining everything) in the proper order and in the manner seen by him.

verses.sanskrit: महर्लोकश्चतुर्थस्तु तस्मिंस्ते कल्पवासिनः । इत्येते क्रमशः प्रोक्ता ब्रह्मव्याहारसंभवाः
verses.transliteration: maharlokaścaturthastu tasmiṃste kalpavāsinaḥ / ityete kramaśaḥ proktā brahmavyāhārasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: In VV. 115 ff Vayu states the units ofmeasuring distance to deter- mine how long was the world of Brahma (from this world). The distances and locations of the Sun and other Planets (VV. 129-135) are imaginary though supported in other Purana works. W. 138-145 state the distance and locations ofthe higher worlds like Maharloka and others.
verses.wordMeaning: In VV. 115 ff Vayu states the units ofmeasuring distance to deter- mine how long was the world of Brahma (from this world). The distances and locations of the Sun and other Planets (VV. 129-135) are imaginary though supported in other Purana works. W.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In VV. 115 ff Vayu states the units ofmeasuring distance to deter- mine how long was the world of Brahma (from this world). The distances and locations of the Sun and other Planets (VV. 129-135) are imaginary though supported in other Purana works. W.…

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोकप्रथमा लोका महरन्ताश्च ते स्मृताः । तान्सर्वान्सप्तसूर्यास्ते अर्चिभिर्निर्दहन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: bhūrlokaprathamā lokā maharantāśca te smṛtāḥ / tānsarvānsaptasūryāste arcibhirnirdahanti vai

verses.sanskrit: मारीचिः कश्यपो दक्षस्तथा स्वायंभुवोङ्गिराः । भृगुः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुरित्येवमादयः
verses.transliteration: mārīciḥ kaśyapo dakṣastathā svāyaṃbhuvoṅgirāḥ / bhṛguḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kraturityevamādayaḥ
verses.translation: There are ten parts of the Mahat. The gross part is called Bhutadi (i.e. Ahamkdra or Cosmic Ego). The magnitude of Bhutadi is more than a tenth part (?).
verses.wordMeaning: There are ten parts of the Mahat. The gross part is called Bhutadi (i.e. Ahamkdra or Cosmic Ego). The magnitude of Bhutadi is more than a tenth part (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: There are ten parts of the Mahat. The gross part is called Bhutadi (i.e. Ahamkdra or Cosmic Ego). The magnitude of Bhutadi is more than a tenth part (?).

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानां पतयः सर्वे वर्त्तंन्ने तत्र तैः सह । निःसत्त्वा निर्ममाश्चैव तत्र ते ह्यूर्द्वरेतसः
verses.transliteration: prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve varttaṃnne tatra taiḥ saha / niḥsattvā nirmamāścaiva tatra te hyūrdvaretasaḥ
verses.translation: Eight Balagras make one Liksa (the egg of a louse). Eight Liksds make one Tuka (a louse). They call the combina- tion of eight Yukds one Tava (a grain of barley). Eight Tavas make one Arigula (finger- breadth).
verses.wordMeaning: Eight Balagras make one Liksa (the egg of a louse). Eight Liksds make one Tuka (a louse). They call the combina- tion of eight Yukds one Tava (a grain of barley). Eight Tavas make one Arigula (finger- breadth).
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight Balagras make one Liksa (the egg of a louse). Eight Liksds make one Tuka (a louse). They call the combina- tion of eight Yukds one Tava (a grain of barley). Eight Tavas make one Arigula (finger- breadth).

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुः सनत्कुमाराद्या वैराजास्ते तपोधनाः । मन्वन्तराणां सर्वेषां सावर्णानां ततः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyā vairājāste tapodhanāḥ / manvantarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sāvarṇānāṃ tataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Twelve Ahgulaparvans (finger-joints or finger-breadths il called a Vitasti (a span). It should be known that twentyone finger breadths make one Ratni (a cubit) (the distance between the elbow and the closed fist).
verses.wordMeaning: Twelve Ahgulaparvans (finger-joints or finger-breadths il called a Vitasti (a span). It should be known that twentyone finger breadths make one Ratni (a cubit) (the distance between the elbow and the closed fist).
verses.commentary: Sense: Twelve Ahgulaparvans (finger-joints or finger-breadths il called a Vitasti (a span). It should be known that twentyone finger breadths make one Ratni (a cubit) (the distance between the elbow and the closed fist).

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशानां सर्वेषां पुनरावृत्तिहेतवः । योगं तपश्च सत्त्वं च समाधाय तदात्मनि
verses.transliteration: caturdaśānāṃ sarveṣāṃ punarāvṛttihetavaḥ / yogaṃ tapaśca sattvaṃ ca samādhāya tadātmani
verses.translation: Twentyfour Angulas make one Hasta (cubit — the distance between the elbow and the tip of the middle finger). Two Ratns or forty two Angulas, it should be known, make one Kisku.
verses.wordMeaning: Twentyfour Angulas make one Hasta (cubit — the distance between the elbow and the tip of the middle finger). Two Ratns or forty two Angulas, it should be known, make one Kisku.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twentyfour Angulas make one Hasta (cubit — the distance between the elbow and the tip of the middle finger). Two Ratns or forty two Angulas, it should be known, make one Kisku.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठे काले निवर्त्तते तदा प्राहुर्विपर्ययात् । सत्यस्तु सप्तमो लोको ह्यपुनर्मार्गगामिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhe kāle nivarttate tadā prāhurviparyayāt / satyastu saptamo loko hyapunarmārgagāminām
verses.translation: Two thousand Dhanus units make one Gavyuti. Eight thousand Dhanus units make one Tojana.
verses.wordMeaning: Two thousand Dhanus units make one Gavyuti. Eight thousand Dhanus units make one Tojana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two thousand Dhanus units make one Gavyuti. Eight thousand Dhanus units make one Tojana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोकः समाख्यातो ह्यप्रतीघातलक्षणः । पर्यासपरिमाणेन भूर्लोकः समभिस्मृतः
verses.transliteration: brahmalokaḥ samākhyāto hyapratīghātalakṣaṇaḥ / paryāsaparimāṇena bhūrlokaḥ samabhismṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The entire stellar zone shines a full hundred thousand Yojanas above the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: The entire stellar zone shines a full hundred thousand Yojanas above the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire stellar zone shines a full hundred thousand Yojanas above the moon.

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यन्तरं यदादित्यादन्तरिक्षं भुवः स्मृतम् । सूर्यध्रुवान्तरं यच्च स्वर्गलोको दिवः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bhūmyantaraṃ yadādityādantarikṣaṃ bhuvaḥ smṛtam / sūryadhruvāntaraṃ yacca svargaloko divaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The distance between the planets above the stellar zone is two hundred thousand Yojanas. Each of these worlds (planets) is so much above the one below.
verses.wordMeaning: The distance between the planets above the stellar zone is two hundred thousand Yojanas. Each of these worlds (planets) is so much above the one below.
verses.commentary: Sense: The distance between the planets above the stellar zone is two hundred thousand Yojanas. Each of these worlds (planets) is so much above the one below.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवाज्जनान्तरं यच्च महर्लोकः स उच्यते । व्याख्याताः सप्तलोकास्तु तेषां वक्ष्यामि सिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: dhruvājjanāntaraṃ yacca maharlokaḥ sa ucyate / vyākhyātāḥ saptalokāstu teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi siddhayaḥ
verses.translation: The planet Budha (Mercury) moves beneath all the stars and planets. Sukra (Venus) moves above this. Lohita (Mars) is above that.
verses.wordMeaning: The planet Budha (Mercury) moves beneath all the stars and planets. Sukra (Venus) moves above this. Lohita (Mars) is above that.
verses.commentary: Sense: The planet Budha (Mercury) moves beneath all the stars and planets. Sukra (Venus) moves above this. Lohita (Mars) is above that.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोकवासिनः सर्वे उन्नादास्तु रसात्मकाः । भुवि स्वर्गे च ये सर्वे सोमपा आज्यपाश्च ते
verses.transliteration: bhūrlokavāsinaḥ sarve unnādāstu rasātmakāḥ / bhuvi svarge ca ye sarve somapā ājyapāśca te
verses.translation: All the Narakas are situated under the jurisdiction of Yama. They are of Tamasa quality. Persons ofevil deeds fall in them severally.
verses.wordMeaning: All the Narakas are situated under the jurisdiction of Yama. They are of Tamasa quality. Persons ofevil deeds fall in them severally.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Narakas are situated under the jurisdiction of Yama. They are of Tamasa quality. Persons ofevil deeds fall in them severally.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थे ये ऽपि वर्त्तन्ते महर्लोकं समाश्रिताः । विज्ञेया मानसी तेषां सिद्धिर्वै पञ्चलक्षणा
verses.transliteration: caturthe ye 'pi varttante maharlokaṃ samāśritāḥ / vijñeyā mānasī teṣāṃ siddhirvai pañcalakṣaṇā
verses.translation: VV. 146-195 deal with seven hells, the tortures therein and the sins that. lead to them.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 146-195 deal with seven hells, the tortures therein and the sins that. lead to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 146-195 deal with seven hells, the tortures therein and the sins that. lead to them.

verses.sanskrit: सद्यश्चोत्पद्यते तेषां मनसा सर्वमीप्सितम् । एते देवा यजन्ते वै यज्ञैः सर्वैः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: sadyaścotpadyate teṣāṃ manasā sarvamīpsitam / ete devā yajante vai yajñaiḥ sarvaiḥ parasparam
verses.translation: The slayer of a Brahmana, one who drinks liquor and a person who steals gold sinks into the hell Sukara. A person who kills a Ksatriya as well as one who kills a Vaisya will fall into the hell Tala.
verses.wordMeaning: The slayer of a Brahmana, one who drinks liquor and a person who steals gold sinks into the hell Sukara. A person who kills a Ksatriya as well as one who kills a Vaisya will fall into the hell Tala.
verses.commentary: Sense: The slayer of a Brahmana, one who drinks liquor and a person who steals gold sinks into the hell Sukara. A person who kills a Ksatriya as well as one who kills a Vaisya will fall into the hell Tala.

verses.sanskrit: अतीता वर्त्तमानाश्च तथा ये चाप्यनागताः । प्रथमानन्तरोद्दिष्टा अन्तराः सांप्रतैः पुनः
verses.transliteration: atītā varttamānāśca tathā ye cāpyanāgatāḥ / prathamānantaroddiṣṭā antarāḥ sāṃprataiḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: He who transgresses the bounds of morality and established moral law' falls into the terrible hell of Vimoha. He who performs sacrificial rites for causing barm to other persons falls into the hell Kit a loll a.
verses.wordMeaning: He who transgresses the bounds of morality and established moral law' falls into the terrible hell of Vimoha. He who performs sacrificial rites for causing barm to other persons falls into the hell Kit a loll a.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who transgresses the bounds of morality and established moral law' falls into the terrible hell of Vimoha. He who performs sacrificial rites for causing barm to other persons falls into the hell Kit a loll a.

verses.sanskrit: निवर्त्तते हि संबन्धो ऽतीते देवगणे तपः । विनिवृत्ताधिकाराणां सिद्धस्तेषां तु मानसी
verses.transliteration: nivarttate hi saṃbandho 'tīte devagaṇe tapaḥ / vinivṛttādhikārāṇāṃ siddhasteṣāṃ tu mānasī
verses.translation: A person inimical to gods and Brahmanas, a person who does not honour elders and preceptors and he who con- taminates gems and jewels goes over to the hell Krmibhaksa.
verses.wordMeaning: A person inimical to gods and Brahmanas, a person who does not honour elders and preceptors and he who con- taminates gems and jewels goes over to the hell Krmibhaksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person inimical to gods and Brahmanas, a person who does not honour elders and preceptors and he who con- taminates gems and jewels goes over to the hell Krmibhaksa.

verses.sanskrit: तषां तु मानसी ज्ञेया शुद्धा सिद्धिः परस्परात् । उक्ता लोकास्तु चत्वारो जनस्यानुविधिस्तथा । समासेन मया विप्रा भूयस्तं वर्त्तयामि वः
verses.transliteration: taṣāṃ tu mānasī jñeyā śuddhā siddhiḥ parasparāt / uktā lokāstu catvāro janasyānuvidhistathā / samāsena mayā viprā bhūyastaṃ varttayāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: He who alone and by himself eats the food without offering the same to Branmanas and friends shall pass on to the foul-smelling hell Lalabhaksa and stay there.
verses.wordMeaning: He who alone and by himself eats the food without offering the same to Branmanas and friends shall pass on to the foul-smelling hell Lalabhaksa and stay there.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who alone and by himself eats the food without offering the same to Branmanas and friends shall pass on to the foul-smelling hell Lalabhaksa and stay there.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच मरीचिः कश्यपो दक्षो वसिष्ठश्चाङ्गिरा भृगुः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca marīciḥ kaśyapo dakṣo vasiṣṭhaścāṅgirā bhṛguḥ
verses.translation: The manufacturer of arrows, the potter, the person who takes away gold coins, the person who is a professional physician and he who sets fire to a garden — all these fall into the hell Visarhsana.
verses.wordMeaning: The manufacturer of arrows, the potter, the person who takes away gold coins, the person who is a professional physician and he who sets fire to a garden — all these fall into the hell Visarhsana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The manufacturer of arrows, the potter, the person who takes away gold coins, the person who is a professional physician and he who sets fire to a garden — all these fall into the hell Visarhsana.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यः पुलहस्छैव क्रतुरित्येवामादयः । पूर्वं ते संप्रसूयन्ते ब्रह्मणो मानसा इह
verses.transliteration: pulastyaḥ pulahaschaiva kraturityevāmādayaḥ / pūrvaṃ te saṃprasūyante brahmaṇo mānasā iha
verses.translation: He who takes monetary gifts from evil men, he who performs sacrifices on behalf of those who are ineligible and unworthy of them, and he who maintains himself through the stars (i.e. astrologer) — these pass on to the hell Adhomukha ( Adhahsiras).
verses.wordMeaning: He who takes monetary gifts from evil men, he who performs sacrifices on behalf of those who are ineligible and unworthy of them, and he who maintains himself through the stars (i.e. astrologer) — these pass on to the hell Adhomukha ( Adhahsiras).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who takes monetary gifts from evil men, he who performs sacrifices on behalf of those who are ineligible and unworthy of them, and he who maintains himself through the stars (i.e. astrologer) — these pass on to the hell Adhomukha ( Adhahsiras).

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रजाः प्रतिष्ठाप्य जनमेवाश्रयन्ति ते । कल्पदाहेषु तु सदा तथा कालेषु तेषु वै
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya janamevāśrayanti te / kalpadāheṣu tu sadā tathā kāleṣu teṣu vai
verses.translation: A person who sells milk, liquor, salt, lac, scents, sweet juices, gingelly seeds — and other similar articles shall fall in the terrible hell named Puyavaha.
verses.wordMeaning: A person who sells milk, liquor, salt, lac, scents, sweet juices, gingelly seeds — and other similar articles shall fall in the terrible hell named Puyavaha.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who sells milk, liquor, salt, lac, scents, sweet juices, gingelly seeds — and other similar articles shall fall in the terrible hell named Puyavaha.

verses.sanskrit: भूरादिषु महान्तेषु भृशं व्याप्ते यथाग्निना । शिखाः संवर्त्तकाग्नेर्याः प्राप्नुवन्ति सवासनाः
verses.transliteration: bhūrādiṣu mahānteṣu bhṛśaṃ vyāpte yathāgninā / śikhāḥ saṃvarttakāgneryāḥ prāpnuvanti savāsanāḥ
verses.translation: The shepherds who chop off (trees in the) foresta are butchered by means of saws and scissors by awfully terrible hunters of deer (when they fall) into the, hell Asipatra.
verses.wordMeaning: The shepherds who chop off (trees in the) foresta are butchered by means of saws and scissors by awfully terrible hunters of deer (when they fall) into the, hell Asipatra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The shepherds who chop off (trees in the) foresta are butchered by means of saws and scissors by awfully terrible hunters of deer (when they fall) into the, hell Asipatra.

verses.sanskrit: यामादयो गणाः सर्वे महर्लोकनिवासिनः । महर्लोकेषु दीप्तेषु जनमेवाश्रयन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: yāmādayo gaṇāḥ sarve maharlokanivāsinaḥ / maharlokeṣu dīpteṣu janamevāśrayanti te
verses.translation: A person who gives up the life of a religious mendi- cant (and relapses in the old bad ways of life) falls into the hell Agnijvala. They are devoured by crows that have beaks of iron and that are of dark and variegated colours.
verses.wordMeaning: A person who gives up the life of a religious mendi- cant (and relapses in the old bad ways of life) falls into the hell Agnijvala. They are devoured by crows that have beaks of iron and that are of dark and variegated colours.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who gives up the life of a religious mendi- cant (and relapses in the old bad ways of life) falls into the hell Agnijvala. They are devoured by crows that have beaks of iron and that are of dark and variegated colours.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे सूक्ष्मशरीरास्ते तत्रस्थाश्च भवन्ति ते । तेषां ते तुल्यसामर्थ्या स्तुल्यमूर्त्तिधरास्तथा
verses.transliteration: sarve sūkṣmaśarīrāste tatrasthāśca bhavanti te / teṣāṃ te tulyasāmarthyā stulyamūrttidharāstathā
verses.translation: A person falls into the hell called Sandarhsa due to his failure in observing the holy rites of performance of sacrifice (isfa) and of purta i.e. doing works of public charity (like dig- ging of wells, construction of gardens etc.)
verses.wordMeaning: A person falls into the hell called Sandarhsa due to his failure in observing the holy rites of performance of sacrifice (isfa) and of purta i.e. doing works of public charity (like dig- ging of wells, construction of gardens etc.)
verses.commentary: Sense: A person falls into the hell called Sandarhsa due to his failure in observing the holy rites of performance of sacrifice (isfa) and of purta i.e. doing works of public charity (like dig- ging of wells, construction of gardens etc.)

verses.sanskrit: जनलोके विवर्त्तन्ते संवर्त्तः प्लवते जगत् । व्युष्टायां तु रजन्यां वै ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तयोनितः
verses.transliteration: janaloke vivarttante saṃvarttaḥ plavate jagat / vyuṣṭāyāṃ tu rajanyāṃ vai brahmaṇo 'vyaktayonitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who act contrarily to the rules of the castes
verses.wordMeaning: Those who act contrarily to the rules of the castes
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who act contrarily to the rules of the castes

verses.sanskrit: अहरादौ प्रसूयन्ते पूर्ववत्क्रमशस्त्विह । स्वायंभुवादयः सर्वे मरीच्यन्तास्तु साधकाः
verses.transliteration: aharādau prasūyante pūrvavatkramaśastviha / svāyaṃbhuvādayaḥ sarve marīcyantāstu sādhakāḥ
verses.translation: The awfully terrible and great hell of fiery nature named Raurava is situated above. It is remembered that the dreadful hell of very chilly atmosphere is beneath it.
verses.wordMeaning: The awfully terrible and great hell of fiery nature named Raurava is situated above. It is remembered that the dreadful hell of very chilly atmosphere is beneath it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The awfully terrible and great hell of fiery nature named Raurava is situated above. It is remembered that the dreadful hell of very chilly atmosphere is beneath it.

verses.sanskrit: देवास्ते वै पुनस्तेषां जायन्ते निधनेष्विह । यामादयः क्रमेणैव कनिष्ठाद्याः प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: devāste vai punasteṣāṃ jāyante nidhaneṣviha / yāmādayaḥ krameṇaiva kaniṣṭhādyāḥ prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Understand that the hells being described (subse- quently) arc of this nature and order. Only seven hells are recounted as situated beneath the Earth.
verses.wordMeaning: Understand that the hells being described (subse- quently) arc of this nature and order. Only seven hells are recounted as situated beneath the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand that the hells being described (subse- quently) arc of this nature and order. Only seven hells are recounted as situated beneath the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं पूर्वे प्रसूयन्ते पश्चिमे पश्चिमास्तथा । देवान्वये देवता हि सप्त संभूत यः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ pūrve prasūyante paścime paścimāstathā / devānvaye devatā hi sapta saṃbhūta yaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They are Andhatamisra and so on, the result of all evils. Raurava is the first among them. It is Maharaurava
verses.wordMeaning: They are Andhatamisra and so on, the result of all evils. Raurava is the first among them. It is Maharaurava
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Andhatamisra and so on, the result of all evils. Raurava is the first among them. It is Maharaurava

verses.sanskrit: व्यतीताः कल्पजास्तेषां तिस्रः शिष्टास्तथापरे । आवर्त्तमाना देवास्ते क्रमेणैतेन सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: vyatītāḥ kalpajāsteṣāṃ tisraḥ śiṣṭāstathāpare / āvarttamānā devāste krameṇaitena sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Those hells are connected (with one another) from above as well as from below. They are remembered as devoid of illumination. There is "excess ofmisery in all of them on account of sin.
verses.wordMeaning: Those hells are connected (with one another) from above as well as from below. They are remembered as devoid of illumination. There is "excess ofmisery in all of them on account of sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those hells are connected (with one another) from above as well as from below. They are remembered as devoid of illumination. There is "excess ofmisery in all of them on account of sin.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा जव जवीभावं दशकृत्वाः पुनः पुनः । ततस्ते वै गणाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा भावेष्वनित्यताम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā java javībhāvaṃ daśakṛtvāḥ punaḥ punaḥ / tataste vai gaṇāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā bhāveṣvanityatām
verses.translation: Earthly worms that are procreated by means of seminal effusion constitute a thousandth part of the number of immobile beings.
verses.wordMeaning: Earthly worms that are procreated by means of seminal effusion constitute a thousandth part of the number of immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Earthly worms that are procreated by means of seminal effusion constitute a thousandth part of the number of immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: भाविनोर्ऽथस्य च बलात्पुण्यख्यातिबलेन च । निवृत्तवृत्त्यः सर्वे ऽत्रस्थाः सुमनसस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhāvinor'thasya ca balātpuṇyakhyātibalena ca / nivṛttavṛttyaḥ sarve 'trasthāḥ sumanasastathā
verses.translation: All the aquatic animals together constitute a thou- sandth part of the worms procreated by means of seminal effusion. Let this be understood decisively.
verses.wordMeaning: All the aquatic animals together constitute a thou- sandth part of the worms procreated by means of seminal effusion. Let this be understood decisively.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the aquatic animals together constitute a thou- sandth part of the worms procreated by means of seminal effusion. Let this be understood decisively.

verses.sanskrit: वैराजमुपपद्यन्ते लोकानुत्सृज्य तं गताः । ततो ऽनेनैव कालेन नित्ययुक्तास्तपस्विनः
verses.transliteration: vairājamupapadyante lokānutsṛjya taṃ gatāḥ / tato 'nenaiva kālena nityayuktāstapasvinaḥ
verses.translation: It should be understood that birds constitute a thousandth part ofthe living beings dwelling in water. All of them belong to this world.
verses.wordMeaning: It should be understood that birds constitute a thousandth part ofthe living beings dwelling in water. All of them belong to this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be understood that birds constitute a thousandth part ofthe living beings dwelling in water. All of them belong to this world.

verses.sanskrit: कथनाच्चैव धर्मस्य तेषां ते जज्ञिरे ऽन्वये । इहोत्पन्नास्ततस्ते वै स्थानान्यापूरयन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: kathanāccaiva dharmasya teṣāṃ te jajñire 'nvaye / ihotpannāstataste vai sthānānyāpūrayantyuta
verses.translation: Animals, the quadrupeds of the world are equal to a thousandth part ofthe number of birds.
verses.wordMeaning: Animals, the quadrupeds of the world are equal to a thousandth part ofthe number of birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Animals, the quadrupeds of the world are equal to a thousandth part ofthe number of birds.

verses.sanskrit: देवत्वे च ऋषित्वे च मनुष्यत्वे च सर्वशः । एवं देवगणाः सर्वे दशकृत्वो निवर्त्यवै
verses.transliteration: devatve ca ṛṣitve ca manuṣyatve ca sarvaśaḥ / evaṃ devagaṇāḥ sarve daśakṛtvo nivartyavai
verses.translation: Bipeds are reckoned as constituting a thousandth part of the number of quadrupeds. Righteous persons are reckoned as constituting a thousandth part ofbipeds.
verses.wordMeaning: Bipeds are reckoned as constituting a thousandth part of the number of quadrupeds. Righteous persons are reckoned as constituting a thousandth part ofbipeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bipeds are reckoned as constituting a thousandth part of the number of quadrupeds. Righteous persons are reckoned as constituting a thousandth part ofbipeds.

verses.sanskrit: वैराजेषूपपन्नास्ते दश तिष्ठन्त्युपप्लवान् । पूर्णोपूर्णो ततः कल्पेस्थित्वा वैराजके पुनः
verses.transliteration: vairājeṣūpapannāste daśa tiṣṭhantyupaplavān / pūrṇopūrṇo tataḥ kalpesthitvā vairājake punaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 198-210 contain the Furanic notion about the population of different kinds of species in this Brahmanda. The reply to the question of sages in. VV. 196-197 is imaginary from our point of view but people seriously believed in these figures in Puranic times.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 198-210 contain the Furanic notion about the population of different kinds of species in this Brahmanda. The reply to the question of sages in. VV. 196-197 is imaginary from our point of view but people seriously believed in these figures in Puranic times.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 198-210 contain the Furanic notion about the population of different kinds of species in this Brahmanda. The reply to the question of sages in. VV. 196-197 is imaginary from our point of view but people seriously believed in these figures in Puranic times.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोके विवर्त्तन्ते पूर्वपूर्वक्रमेण तु । एतस्मिन्ब्रह्मलोके तु कल्पे वैराजके गते
verses.transliteration: brahmaloke vivarttante pūrvapūrvakrameṇa tu / etasminbrahmaloke tu kalpe vairājake gate
verses.translation: In front of the world of Brahma and beneath the Anda of Brahma, in between these two, there is a divine city free from illness and unhappiness. It is Manomaya (mental in nature).'
verses.wordMeaning: In front of the world of Brahma and beneath the Anda of Brahma, in between these two, there is a divine city free from illness and unhappiness. It is Manomaya (mental in nature).'
verses.commentary: Sense: In front of the world of Brahma and beneath the Anda of Brahma, in between these two, there is a divine city free from illness and unhappiness. It is Manomaya (mental in nature).'

verses.sanskrit: वैराजः पुनरव्यक्ते कल्पस्थानमकल्पयत् । एवं पूर्वानुपूर्व्येण ब्रह्मलोकगतेन वै
verses.transliteration: vairājaḥ punaravyakte kalpasthānamakalpayat / evaṃ pūrvānupūrvyeṇa brahmalokagatena vai
verses.translation: VV. 233b-245 constitute a poetic description of the city of Siva and VV. 249-259 describe the holy residents who dwell there. It is a Puranic description of the types of Liberation called Salokata, Sarupata, Samipata.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 233b-245 constitute a poetic description of the city of Siva and VV. 249-259 describe the holy residents who dwell there. It is a Puranic description of the types of Liberation called Salokata, Sarupata, Samipata.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 233b-245 constitute a poetic description of the city of Siva and VV. 249-259 describe the holy residents who dwell there. It is a Puranic description of the types of Liberation called Salokata, Sarupata, Samipata.

verses.sanskrit: वैराजेषूपपद्यन्ते दशकृत्वो विवर्त्यत । एवं देवयुगानीह व्यतीतानि सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: vairājeṣūpapadyante daśakṛtvo vivartyata / evaṃ devayugānīha vyatītāni sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Its internal extent, O excellent Brahmanas, is a hundred thousand Yojanas. It is stationed in the Earthly zone.
verses.wordMeaning: Its internal extent, O excellent Brahmanas, is a hundred thousand Yojanas. It is stationed in the Earthly zone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its internal extent, O excellent Brahmanas, is a hundred thousand Yojanas. It is stationed in the Earthly zone.

verses.sanskrit: निधनं ब्रह्मलोके तु गतानामृषिभिः सह । न शक्यमानुपूर्व्येण तेषां वक्तुं प्रविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: nidhanaṃ brahmaloke tu gatānāmṛṣibhiḥ saha / na śakyamānupūrvyeṇa teṣāṃ vaktuṃ pravistaram
verses.translation: On hearing this, the ascetics and the sages of Naimisa forest cried out. As they had some doubts, they spoke these words to the Wind-god.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this, the ascetics and the sages of Naimisa forest cried out. As they had some doubts, they spoke these words to the Wind-god.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, the ascetics and the sages of Naimisa forest cried out. As they had some doubts, they spoke these words to the Wind-god.

verses.sanskrit: अनादित्वाच्च कालस्य ह्यसंख्यानाच्च सर्वशः । एवमेव न संदेहो यथावत्कथितं मया
verses.transliteration: anāditvācca kālasya hyasaṃkhyānācca sarvaśaḥ / evameva na saṃdeho yathāvatkathitaṃ mayā
verses.translation: "Who are those noble-souled followers of Bhava (God Siva) who very much deserve to be blessed and who rejoice very well in that excellent city?"
verses.wordMeaning: "Who are those noble-souled followers of Bhava (God Siva) who very much deserve to be blessed and who rejoice very well in that excellent city?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who are those noble-souled followers of Bhava (God Siva) who very much deserve to be blessed and who rejoice very well in that excellent city?"

verses.sanskrit: तदुपश्रुत्य वाक्यार्थमृषयः संशयान्विताः । सूतमाहुः पुराणज्ञं व्यासशिष्यं महामतिम्
verses.transliteration: tadupaśrutya vākyārthamṛṣayaḥ saṃśayānvitāḥ / sūtamāhuḥ purāṇajñaṃ vyāsaśiṣyaṃ mahāmatim
verses.translation: On hearing the speech of the sages Vayu spoke these words: —
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the speech of the sages Vayu spoke these words: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the speech of the sages Vayu spoke these words: —

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः वैराजास्ते यदाहारा यत्सत्त्वाश्च यदाश्रयाः । तिष्ठन्ति चैव यत्कालं तन्नो ब्रूहि यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vairājāste yadāhārā yatsattvāśca yadāśrayāḥ / tiṣṭhanti caiva yatkālaṃ tanno brūhi yathātatham
verses.translation: They have attained identity and similarity with the form of Bhava, the excellent state of equality with the lord. All of them are Vaisvdnara-Mukhas (having the god of fire for their mouths). They have the cosmic form and {the matted
verses.wordMeaning: They have attained identity and similarity with the form of Bhava, the excellent state of equality with the lord. All of them are Vaisvdnara-Mukhas (having the god of fire for their mouths). They have the cosmic form and {the matted
verses.commentary: Sense: They have attained identity and similarity with the form of Bhava, the excellent state of equality with the lord. All of them are Vaisvdnara-Mukhas (having the god of fire for their mouths). They have the cosmic form and {the matted

verses.sanskrit: तदुक्तमृषिभिर्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा लोकार्थतत्त्ववित् । सूतः पौराणिको वाक्यं विनयेनेदम ब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: taduktamṛṣibhirvākyaṃ śrutvā lokārthatattvavit / sūtaḥ paurāṇiko vākyaṃ vinayenedama bravīt
verses.translation: They are blue-throated and white-necked. They have three eyes and sharp curved teeth. The crescent-moon makes them a fine turban and they wear matted hair as though it were a crown.
verses.wordMeaning: They are blue-throated and white-necked. They have three eyes and sharp curved teeth. The crescent-moon makes them a fine turban and they wear matted hair as though it were a crown.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are blue-throated and white-necked. They have three eyes and sharp curved teeth. The crescent-moon makes them a fine turban and they wear matted hair as though it were a crown.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राप्य तु सर्वेशं शुद्धबुद्धिं तमाश्रयत् । आभूतसंप्लवास्तत्र दश तिष्ठन्ति ते ऽज्वराः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāpya tu sarveśaṃ śuddhabuddhiṃ tamāśrayat / ābhūtasaṃplavāstatra daśa tiṣṭhanti te 'jvarāḥ
verses.translation: All those heroes have ten arms. They have the sweet smell of the interior of a lotus. All of them shine like the mid-day sun. All of them wear yellow robes.
verses.wordMeaning: All those heroes have ten arms. They have the sweet smell of the interior of a lotus. All of them shine like the mid-day sun. All of them wear yellow robes.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those heroes have ten arms. They have the sweet smell of the interior of a lotus. All of them shine like the mid-day sun. All of them wear yellow robes.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे सूक्ष्मशरीरास्ते विद्वांसो घनमूर्तयः । स्थितलोकस्थितत्वाच्च तेषां भूतं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sarve sūkṣmaśarīrāste vidvāṃso ghanamūrtayaḥ / sthitalokasthitatvācca teṣāṃ bhūtaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: All of them hold the Pinaka bow in their hands. They have the white bulls as vehicles. They are endowed
verses.wordMeaning: All of them hold the Pinaka bow in their hands. They have the white bulls as vehicles. They are endowed
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them hold the Pinaka bow in their hands. They have the white bulls as vehicles. They are endowed

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुः सनत्कुमाराद्याः सिद्धास्ते योगधर्मिणः । एवमेव महाभागाः प्रणवं संप्रविश्य ह
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ sanatkumārādyāḥ siddhāste yogadharmiṇaḥ / evameva mahābhāgāḥ praṇavaṃ saṃpraviśya ha
verses.translation: That lord said — "What else shall 1 explain to you? O sages of holy rites, I shall recount whatever should be narrated by me."
verses.wordMeaning: That lord said — "What else shall 1 explain to you? O sages of holy rites, I shall recount whatever should be narrated by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord said — "What else shall 1 explain to you? O sages of holy rites, I shall recount whatever should be narrated by me."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोके प्रवर्त्तामस्तन्नः श्रेयो भविष्यते । एवमुक्त्वा तदा सर्वे ब्रह्माण्डाध्यवसायि नः
verses.transliteration: brahmaloke pravarttāmastannaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyate / evamuktvā tadā sarve brahmāṇḍādhyavasāyi naḥ
verses.translation: When Vayu has already described the Abhuta-sampiava (world-end) which destroys worlds like Bhur, Bhuvah etc, sages naturally want to know the fate ofthe residents of Siva's city at that time. The author wants to establish the greatness of Mahesvara. He replies that they ultimately enter in Him who is the Subtlest Anu. This shows the influence ofVaisesikas on the author. Historical teachers of the Sankhya School, Kapila, Asuri, Panca£ikha are elevated like the sages Sanaka, Sanandana etc.
verses.wordMeaning: When Vayu has already described the Abhuta-sampiava (world-end) which destroys worlds like Bhur, Bhuvah etc, sages naturally want to know the fate ofthe residents of Siva's city at that time. The author wants to establish the greatness of Mahesvara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Vayu has already described the Abhuta-sampiava (world-end) which destroys worlds like Bhur, Bhuvah etc, sages naturally want to know the fate ofthe residents of Siva's city at that time. The author wants to establish the greatness of Mahesvara.…

verses.sanskrit: याजयित्वा तदात्मानो वर्त्तन्ते योगधर्मिणः । तत्रैव संप्रलीयन्ते शान्ता दीपर्चिषो यथा
verses.transliteration: yājayitvā tadātmāno varttante yogadharmiṇaḥ / tatraiva saṃpralīyante śāntā dīparciṣo yathā
verses.translation: Then they cross the river of worldly existence, having a great whirlpool with births and deaths for its waters. Then they perceive the greatest, undivided and indivisible.
verses.wordMeaning: Then they cross the river of worldly existence, having a great whirlpool with births and deaths for its waters. Then they perceive the greatest, undivided and indivisible.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they cross the river of worldly existence, having a great whirlpool with births and deaths for its waters. Then they perceive the greatest, undivided and indivisible.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मकायमवर्त्तन्त पुन रावृत्तिदुर्लभम् । लोकं तं समनुप्राप्य सर्वे ते भावनामयम्
verses.transliteration: brahmakāyamavarttanta puna rāvṛttidurlabham / lokaṃ taṃ samanuprāpya sarve te bhāvanāmayam
verses.translation: Joined with Visnu, he creates once again the seven worlds and the five elements. Thereafter, he annihilates them too.
verses.wordMeaning: Joined with Visnu, he creates once again the seven worlds and the five elements. Thereafter, he annihilates them too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Joined with Visnu, he creates once again the seven worlds and the five elements. Thereafter, he annihilates them too.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दं ब्रह्मणः प्राप्य अमृतत्वाय ते गताः । वैराजेभ्यस्तथैवोर्द्ध्व मन्तरे षड्गुणे ततः
verses.transliteration: ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya amṛtatvāya te gatāḥ / vairājebhyastathaivorddhva mantare ṣaḍguṇe tataḥ
verses.translation: The seven continents, seven oceans, seven worlds along with the mountains — everything having water for its covering becomes merged in Jyotis (the Fire-element).
verses.wordMeaning: The seven continents, seven oceans, seven worlds along with the mountains — everything having water for its covering becomes merged in Jyotis (the Fire-element).
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven continents, seven oceans, seven worlds along with the mountains — everything having water for its covering becomes merged in Jyotis (the Fire-element).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोकः समाख्यातो यत्र ब्रह्मा पुरोहितः । ते सर्वे प्रणवात्मानो बुद्धिशुद्धतया स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: brahmalokaḥ samākhyāto yatra brahmā purohitaḥ / te sarve praṇavātmāno buddhiśuddhatayā sthitāḥ
verses.translation: The Taijasa (Fiery) covering gets merged in Maruta (Wind), the Vdyavya (gaseous) covering gets merged in Akdsa (Ether).
verses.wordMeaning: The Taijasa (Fiery) covering gets merged in Maruta (Wind), the Vdyavya (gaseous) covering gets merged in Akdsa (Ether).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Taijasa (Fiery) covering gets merged in Maruta (Wind), the Vdyavya (gaseous) covering gets merged in Akdsa (Ether).

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दं ब्रह्मणः प्राप्य ह्यमृतत्वं भजन्त्युत । द्वन्द्वैस्ते नाभिभूयन्ते भावत्रयविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya hyamṛtatvaṃ bhajantyuta / dvandvaiste nābhibhūyante bhāvatrayavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: VV. 293-297 describe the process of involution of the universe in the Sarikhya (-Vedantic) way; Avyakta and Brahma are the causes of 'annihilation and extension'.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 293-297 describe the process of involution of the universe in the Sarikhya (-Vedantic) way; Avyakta and Brahma are the causes of 'annihilation and extension'.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 293-297 describe the process of involution of the universe in the Sarikhya (-Vedantic) way; Avyakta and Brahma are the causes of 'annihilation and extension'.

verses.sanskrit: आधिपत्यं विना तुल्या ब्रह्मणस्ते महौजसः । प्रभावविजयैश्वर्यस्थितिवैराग्यदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: ādhipatyaṃ vinā tulyā brahmaṇaste mahaujasaḥ / prabhāvavijayaiśvaryasthitivairāgyadarśanaḥ
verses.translation: The covering ofthe sky merges with Bhutadi (Cosmic Ego). The Mahat (Great Principle), the characteristic feature of which is the intellect, swallows Bhutadi (the source of Bhutas).
verses.wordMeaning: The covering ofthe sky merges with Bhutadi (Cosmic Ego). The Mahat (Great Principle), the characteristic feature of which is the intellect, swallows Bhutadi (the source of Bhutas).
verses.commentary: Sense: The covering ofthe sky merges with Bhutadi (Cosmic Ego). The Mahat (Great Principle), the characteristic feature of which is the intellect, swallows Bhutadi (the source of Bhutas).

verses.sanskrit: ते ब्रह्मलौकिकाः सर्वे गतिं प्राप्यानिवर्त्तिनीम् । ब्रह्मणा सहदेवैश्च संप्राप्ते प्रतिसंचरे
verses.transliteration: te brahmalaukikāḥ sarve gatiṃ prāpyānivarttinīm / brahmaṇā sahadevaiśca saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare
verses.translation: The Unmanifest one swallows Mahat. Beyond that there is Gmasdmya (the equilibrium of the Gunas). The Avyakta and Brahma are thus the causes of annihilation and extension.
verses.wordMeaning: The Unmanifest one swallows Mahat. Beyond that there is Gmasdmya (the equilibrium of the Gunas). The Avyakta and Brahma are thus the causes of annihilation and extension.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Unmanifest one swallows Mahat. Beyond that there is Gmasdmya (the equilibrium of the Gunas). The Avyakta and Brahma are thus the causes of annihilation and extension.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्ॐऽते क्रियात्मानो बुद्धावस्था मनीषिणः । अव्यक्ते संप्रलीयन्ते सर्वे ते क्षणदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: tapasoṃ'te kriyātmāno buddhāvasthā manīṣiṇaḥ / avyakte saṃpralīyante sarve te kṣaṇadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: They say that the Avyakta (Unmanifest one) is Ksetra and Brahma is called Ksetrajna. 1 Their Union is with- out a beginning but is caused by Sddharmya (similarity of characteristics) and Vaidharmya (dissimilarity of characteristics).
verses.wordMeaning: They say that the Avyakta (Unmanifest one) is Ksetra and Brahma is called Ksetrajna. 1 Their Union is with- out a beginning but is caused by Sddharmya (similarity of characteristics) and Vaidharmya (dissimilarity of characteristics).
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that the Avyakta (Unmanifest one) is Ksetra and Brahma is called Ksetrajna. 1 Their Union is with- out a beginning but is caused by Sddharmya (similarity of characteristics) and Vaidharmya (dissimilarity of characteristics).

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदमृतं शुक्रं नित्यमक्षयव्ययम् । देवर्षयो ब्रह्मसत्रं सनातनमुपासते
verses.transliteration: ityetadamṛtaṃ śukraṃ nityamakṣayavyayam / devarṣayo brahmasatraṃ sanātanamupāsate
verses.translation: Thus, O Brahmanas, in the activities ofcreation, the K$etrajna should be known. The knower of Brahman also should be known separately, through the knowledge of Ksetra.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O Brahmanas, in the activities ofcreation, the K$etrajna should be known. The knower of Brahman also should be known separately, through the knowledge of Ksetra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O Brahmanas, in the activities ofcreation, the K$etrajna should be known. The knower of Brahman also should be known separately, through the knowledge of Ksetra.

verses.sanskrit: अपुनर्मारकादीनां तेषां चैवोद्ध्वरेतसाम् । कर्माभ्यासकृतां श्रद्धां वेदान्तेषूपलक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: apunarmārakādīnāṃ teṣāṃ caivoddhvaretasām / karmābhyāsakṛtāṃ śraddhāṃ vedānteṣūpalakṣyate
verses.translation: The state of being or not being the object of knowl- edge ofthe Ksetra and Ksetrajna is remembered. Brahma should be known as Avisaya (non-object) and Ksetra is called Visaya: (object).
verses.wordMeaning: The state of being or not being the object of knowl- edge ofthe Ksetra and Ksetrajna is remembered. Brahma should be known as Avisaya (non-object) and Ksetra is called Visaya: (object).
verses.commentary: Sense: The state of being or not being the object of knowl- edge ofthe Ksetra and Ksetrajna is remembered. Brahma should be known as Avisaya (non-object) and Ksetra is called Visaya: (object).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते ऽभ्यासिनो युक्ताः परां काष्ठामुपासते । हित्वा शरीरं पाप्मानममृतत्वाय ते गाताः
verses.transliteration: tatra te 'bhyāsino yuktāḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāmupāsate / hitvā śarīraṃ pāpmānamamṛtatvāya te gātāḥ
verses.translation: The Ksetra presided over by Ksetrajna, they say,, is for the sake of Ksetrajna. Since the bodies are many, the embodied one (soul) is remembered as manifold.
verses.wordMeaning: The Ksetra presided over by Ksetrajna, they say,, is for the sake of Ksetrajna. Since the bodies are many, the embodied one (soul) is remembered as manifold.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Ksetra presided over by Ksetrajna, they say,, is for the sake of Ksetrajna. Since the bodies are many, the embodied one (soul) is remembered as manifold.

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागा जितक्रोधा निर्मोहाः सत्यवादिनः । शान्ताः प्रणिहितात्मानो दयावन्तो जितेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: vītarāgā jitakrodhā nirmohāḥ satyavādinaḥ / śāntāḥ praṇihitātmāno dayāvanto jitendriyāḥ
verses.translation: W. 300-312 discuss the topic Ksetra and ' Ksetrajna and conclude that the self-born being brings about dissolution (of the universe) through Prakrti.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 300-312 discuss the topic Ksetra and ' Ksetrajna and conclude that the self-born being brings about dissolution (of the universe) through Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 300-312 discuss the topic Ksetra and ' Ksetrajna and conclude that the self-born being brings about dissolution (of the universe) through Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: निःसंगाः शुचयश्चैव ब्रह्मसायुज्यगाः स्मृताः । अकामयुक्तैर्ये वीरास्तपोभिर्दग्धकिल्बिषाः
verses.transliteration: niḥsaṃgāḥ śucayaścaiva brahmasāyujyagāḥ smṛtāḥ / akāmayuktairye vīrāstapobhirdagdhakilbiṣāḥ
verses.translation: He who abides by the discipline and conduct of life based on the castes and stages of life and listens to the narration ofthis Pratisarga (dissolution) shall attain the status ofhaving the same world as siva. He will be endowed with devotion and be free from ailments.
verses.wordMeaning: He who abides by the discipline and conduct of life based on the castes and stages of life and listens to the narration ofthis Pratisarga (dissolution) shall attain the status ofhaving the same world as siva. He will be endowed with devotion and be free from ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who abides by the discipline and conduct of life based on the castes and stages of life and listens to the narration ofthis Pratisarga (dissolution) shall attain the status ofhaving the same world as siva. He will be endowed with devotion and be free from ailments.

verses.sanskrit: तेषांमभ्रंशिनो लोका अप्रमेयसुखाः स्मृताः । एतद्ब्रह्मपदं दिव्यं परमे व्योम्नि भास्वरम् । यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति ह्यमरा ब्रह्मणा सह
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃmabhraṃśino lokā aprameyasukhāḥ smṛtāḥ / etadbrahmapadaṃ divyaṃ parame vyomni bhāsvaram / yatra gatvā na śocanti hyamarā brahmaṇā saha
verses.translation: Or he will be attaining the status of being the leader of Ganas i.e. groups of Siva's attendants of all-time duration.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he will be attaining the status of being the leader of Ganas i.e. groups of Siva's attendants of all-time duration.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he will be attaining the status of being the leader of Ganas i.e. groups of Siva's attendants of all-time duration.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कस्मादेषु परार्द्धंश्च कश्चैव पर उच्यते । एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामस्तन्नो निगद सत्तम
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kasmādeṣu parārddhaṃśca kaścaiva para ucyate / etadveditumicchāmastanno nigada sattama
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच शृणुध्वं मे परार्द्धस्य परिसंख्यां परस्यच
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ me parārddhasya parisaṃkhyāṃ parasyaca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एकं दशशतं चैव सहस्रं चैव संख्याया । विज्ञेयमासहस्रं तु सहस्राणि दशायुतम्
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ daśaśataṃ caiva sahasraṃ caiva saṃkhyāyā / vijñeyamāsahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇi daśāyutam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एकं शतसहस्रं तु नियुतं प्रोच्यते बुधैः । तथा शतसहस्राणां दशप्रयुतमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu niyutaṃ procyate budhaiḥ / tathā śatasahasrāṇāṃ daśaprayutamucyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तथा दशसहस्राणामयुतं कोटिरुच्यते । अर्बुदं दशकोट्यस्तु ह्यब्जं कोटिशतं विदुः
verses.transliteration: tathā daśasahasrāṇāmayutaṃ koṭirucyate / arbudaṃ daśakoṭyastu hyabjaṃ koṭiśataṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रमापि कोटीनां खर्वमाहुर्मनीषिणः । दशकोटिसहस्राणि निखर्वमिति तं विदुः
verses.transliteration: sahasramāpi koṭīnāṃ kharvamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / daśakoṭisahasrāṇi nikharvamiti taṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: शतं कोटि सहस्राणां शङ्कुरित्यभिधीयते । सहस्रं तु सहस्राणां कोटीनां पद्ममुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śataṃ koṭi sahasrāṇāṃ śaṅkurityabhidhīyate / sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ koṭīnāṃ padmamucyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि सहस्राणां कोटीनां दशधा पुनः । गुणितानि समुद्रं वै प्राहुः संख्याविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ koṭīnāṃ daśadhā punaḥ / guṇitāni samudraṃ vai prāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: कोटीसहस्रनियुतमन्त्यमित्यभिधीयते । कोटीसहस्रप्रयुतं मध्यमित्यभिसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: koṭīsahasraniyutamantyamityabhidhīyate / koṭīsahasraprayutaṃ madhyamityabhisaṃjñitam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: कोटिकोटिसहस्रं तु परार्द्ध इति कीर्त्यते । परार्द्धं द्विगुणं चापि परमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: koṭikoṭisahasraṃ tu parārddha iti kīrtyate / parārddhaṃ dviguṇaṃ cāpi paramāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: शतमाहुः परिवृढं सहस्रं परिपद्मकम् । विज्ञेयमयुतं तस्मान्नियुतं प्रयुतं ततः
verses.transliteration: śatamāhuḥ parivṛḍhaṃ sahasraṃ paripadmakam / vijñeyamayutaṃ tasmānniyutaṃ prayutaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अर्बुदं न्यर्बुदं चैव खर्बुदं च ततः स्मृतम् । खर्वं चैव निखर्वं च शङ्कुः पद्मन्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: arbudaṃ nyarbudaṃ caiva kharbudaṃ ca tataḥ smṛtam / kharvaṃ caiva nikharvaṃ ca śaṅkuḥ padmantathaiva ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रमन्त्यं मध्यं च परार्द्धं च परं ततः । एवमष्टादशैतानि स्थानानि गणनाविधौ
verses.transliteration: samudramantyaṃ madhyaṃ ca parārddhaṃ ca paraṃ tataḥ / evamaṣṭādaśaitāni sthānāni gaṇanāvidhau
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: शतादीनि विजानीयात्संज्ञितानि महर्षिभिः । कल्पसंख्याप्रवृत्तस्य परार्द्धो ब्रह्ममः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śatādīni vijānīyātsaṃjñitāni maharṣibhiḥ / kalpasaṃkhyāpravṛttasya parārddho brahmamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तावच्छेषो ऽपि कालो ऽस्य तस्यान्ते प्रतितिष्ठते । पर एव परार्द्धश्च संख्यातः संख्याया मया
verses.transliteration: tāvaccheṣo 'pi kālo 'sya tasyānte pratitiṣṭhate / para eva parārddhaśca saṃkhyātaḥ saṃkhyāyā mayā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादस्य परं विर्यं परमायुः परं तपः । परा शक्तिः परो धर्मः पराविद्या परा धृतिः
verses.transliteration: yasmādasya paraṃ viryaṃ paramāyuḥ paraṃ tapaḥ / parā śaktiḥ paro dharmaḥ parāvidyā parā dhṛtiḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: परं ब्रह्म परं ज्ञानं परमैश्वर्यमेव च । तस्मात्परतरं भूतं ब्रह्मणो यन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: paraṃ brahma paraṃ jñānaṃ paramaiśvaryameva ca / tasmātparataraṃ bhūtaṃ brahmaṇo yanna vidyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: परे स्थितो ह्येष परः सर्वार्थेवु ततः परम् । संख्यातस्तु परो ब्रह्मा तस्यार्द्धस्य परार्द्धता
verses.transliteration: pare sthito hyeṣa paraḥ sarvārthevu tataḥ param / saṃkhyātastu paro brahmā tasyārddhasya parārddhatā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: संख्येयं चाप्यसंख्येयं सततं चापि तान्त्रिकम् । संख्येयं संख्यया दृष्टमपरार्द्धाद्विभाष्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃkhyeyaṃ cāpyasaṃkhyeyaṃ satataṃ cāpi tāntrikam / saṃkhyeyaṃ saṃkhyayā dṛṣṭamaparārddhādvibhāṣyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: राशौ दृष्टे न संख्यास्ति तदसंख्यास्तु लक्ष्णम् । आनन्त्यं सिकता द्येषु हृष्टं चान्यं त्वलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: rāśau dṛṣṭe na saṃkhyāsti tadasaṃkhyāstu lakṣṇam / ānantyaṃ sikatā dyeṣu hṛṣṭaṃ cānyaṃ tvalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरैस्तत्प्रसंख्यानं शुद्धत्वाद्दिव्यदृष्टिभिः । एवं ज्ञानप्रतिष्ठत्वात्सर्वं ब्रह्मानुपश्यति
verses.transliteration: īśvaraistatprasaṃkhyānaṃ śuddhatvāddivyadṛṣṭibhiḥ / evaṃ jñānapratiṣṭhatvātsarvaṃ brahmānupaśyati
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः । बाष्पपर्याकुलाक्षास्तु प्रहर्षाद्गद्गदस्वराः
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā tu te sarve naimiṣeyāstapasvinaḥ / bāṣpaparyākulākṣāstu praharṣādgadgadasvarāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छुर्मातारिश्वानं सर्वे ते ब्रह्मवादिनः । ब्रह्मलोकस्तु भगवन्यावन्मात्रान्तरे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: papracchurmātāriśvānaṃ sarve te brahmavādinaḥ / brahmalokastu bhagavanyāvanmātrāntare prabho
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: योजनाग्रेण संख्यातः साधनं योजनस्य तु । क्रोशस्य च परीमाणं श्रोतुमीच्छाम तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: yojanāgreṇa saṃkhyātaḥ sādhanaṃ yojanasya tu / krośasya ca parīmāṇaṃ śrotumīcchāma tattvataḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मातरिश्वा विनीतवत् । उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं यथादृष्टं यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mātariśvā vinītavat / uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच एतद्वो ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रुणुध्वं मे विवक्षितम् । अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तभागो वै महान्स्थूलो विभाष्यते
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca etadvo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi śruṇudhvaṃ me vivakṣitam / avyaktādvyaktabhāgo vai mahānsthūlo vibhāṣyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: दशैव महतो भागा भूतादिः स्थूल उच्यते । दशभागाधिकं चापि भूतादिपरिमाणकम्
verses.transliteration: daśaiva mahato bhāgā bhūtādiḥ sthūla ucyate / daśabhāgādhikaṃ cāpi bhūtādiparimāṇakam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: परमाणुः सुसूक्ष्मस्तु भावग्राह्यो न चक्षुषा । यदभेद्यतमं लोके विज्ञेयं परमाणुवत्
verses.transliteration: paramāṇuḥ susūkṣmastu bhāvagrāhyo na cakṣuṣā / yadabhedyatamaṃ loke vijñeyaṃ paramāṇuvat
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: जालान्तरगते भानैं यत्सूक्ष्मं दृश्यते रजः । प्रथमं तत्प्रमाणानां परमाणुं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: jālāntaragate bhānaiṃ yatsūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ / prathamaṃ tatpramāṇānāṃ paramāṇuṃ pracakṣate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अष्टानां परमाणूनां समावायो यदा भवेत् । त्रसरेणुः समाख्यातस्तत्पद्मरज उच्यते
verses.transliteration: aṣṭānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ samāvāyo yadā bhavet / trasareṇuḥ samākhyātastatpadmaraja ucyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: त्रसरेणवो ऽथ ये ऽप्यष्टौ रथरेणुस्तु सस्मृतः । ते ऽप्यष्टौ समवायस्था बालाग्रं तत्स्मृतं बुधैः
verses.transliteration: trasareṇavo 'tha ye 'pyaṣṭau rathareṇustu sasmṛtaḥ / te 'pyaṣṭau samavāyasthā bālāgraṃ tatsmṛtaṃ budhaiḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: बालाग्राण्यष्टलिक्षा स्याद्यूकालिक्षाष्टकं भवेत् । यूकाष्टकं यवप्राहुरङ्गुलं तु यवाष्टकम्
verses.transliteration: bālāgrāṇyaṣṭalikṣā syādyūkālikṣāṣṭakaṃ bhavet / yūkāṣṭakaṃ yavaprāhuraṅgulaṃ tu yavāṣṭakam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशाङ्गुलपर्वाणि वितस्तिस्थानमुच्यते । रत्निश्चागुलिपर्वाणि विज्ञेयो ह्येकविंशतिः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśāṅgulaparvāṇi vitastisthānamucyate / ratniścāguliparvāṇi vijñeyo hyekaviṃśatiḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारो विंशतिश्चैव हस्तः स्यादङ्गुलानि तु । किष्कुर्द्विरत्निर्विज्ञेयो द्विचत्वारिंशदङ्गुलः
verses.transliteration: catvāro viṃśatiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṅgulāni tu / kiṣkurdviratnirvijñeyo dvicatvāriṃśadaṅgulaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: षण्णवत्यङ्गुलं चैव धनुराहुर्मनीषिणः । एतद्गव्यूतिसंख्यायामादानं धनुषः स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulaṃ caiva dhanurāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / etadgavyūtisaṃkhyāyāmādānaṃ dhanuṣaḥ smṛtam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: धनुर्दण्डयुगं नाली तुल्यान्यस्तैस्तथाङ्गुलैः । धनुषां त्रिशतं नल्वमाहुः संख्याविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: dhanurdaṇḍayugaṃ nālī tulyānyastaistathāṅgulaiḥ / dhanuṣāṃ triśataṃ nalvamāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: धनुः सहस्रे द्वे चापि गव्यूतिरुपदिश्यते । अष्टौ धनुः सहस्राणि योजनं तु विधीयते
verses.transliteration: dhanuḥ sahasre dve cāpi gavyūtirupadiśyate / aṣṭau dhanuḥ sahasrāṇi yojanaṃ tu vidhīyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एतेन धनुषा चैव योजनं तु समाप्यते । एतत्सहस्रं विज्ञेयं शक्रकोशान्तरं तथा
verses.transliteration: etena dhanuṣā caiva yojanaṃ tu samāpyate / etatsahasraṃ vijñeyaṃ śakrakośāntaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां च संख्यातं संख्याज्ञानविशारदैः । एतेन योजनाग्रेण शृणुध्वं ब्रह्मण्ॐऽतरे
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ ca saṃkhyātaṃ saṃkhyājñānaviśāradaiḥ / etena yojanāgreṇa śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tare
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: महीतलात्सहस्राणां रातादूर्ध्वं दिवाकरः । दिवाकरात्सहस्रे तु शते चौर्द्ध्वं निशाकरः
verses.transliteration: mahītalātsahasrāṇāṃ rātādūrdhvaṃ divākaraḥ / divākarātsahasre tu śate caurddhvaṃ niśākaraḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णं शतसहस्रं तु योजनानां निशाकरात् । नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नमुपरिष्टात्प्रकाशत
verses.transliteration: pūrṇaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu yojanānāṃ niśākarāt / nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnamupariṣṭātprakāśata
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: शतं सहस्रं संख्यातमेतद्द्विगुणितं पुनः । ग्रहान्तरमथैकैकमूर्द्ध्वं नक्षत्रमण्डरात्
verses.transliteration: śataṃ sahasraṃ saṃkhyātametaddviguṇitaṃ punaḥ / grahāntaramathaikaikamūrddhvaṃ nakṣatramaṇḍarāt
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ताराग्रहाणां सर्वेषामध्यस्ताच्चरते बुधः । तस्योर्द्ध्वं चरते शुक्रस्तस्मादूर्द्ध्वं च लोहितः
verses.transliteration: tārāgrahāṇāṃ sarveṣāmadhyastāccarate budhaḥ / tasyorddhvaṃ carate śukrastasmādūrddhvaṃ ca lohitaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ततो बृहस्पतिश्चोर्द्ध्वं तस्मादूर्द्ध्वं शनैश्चरः । उर्द्ध्वं शतसहस्रं तु योजनानां शनैश्चरात्
verses.transliteration: tato bṛhaspatiścorddhvaṃ tasmādūrddhvaṃ śanaiścaraḥ / urddhvaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu yojanānāṃ śanaiścarāt
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षिमण्डलं कृत्स्नमुपरिष्टात्प्रकाशते । ऋषिभ्यस्तु सहस्राणां शतादूर्द्ध्वं विभाष्यते
verses.transliteration: saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnamupariṣṭātprakāśate / ṛṣibhyastu sahasrāṇāṃ śatādūrddhvaṃ vibhāṣyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽसौ तारामये दिव्ये विमाने ह्रस्वरूपके । उत्तानपादपुत्रो ऽसौ मेढीभूतो ध्रुवो दिवि
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau tārāmaye divye vimāne hrasvarūpake / uttānapādaputro 'sau meḍhībhūto dhruvo divi
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यस्यैष उत्सेधो व्याख्यातो योजनैर्मया । मन्वन्तरेषु देवानामिज्या यत्रैव लौकिकी
verses.transliteration: trailokyasyaiṣa utsedho vyākhyāto yojanairmayā / manvantareṣu devānāmijyā yatraiva laukikī
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमेभ्य इष्टा तु लोके ऽस्मिन्संप्रवर्त्तते । सर्वासां देवयोनीनां स्थितिहेतुः स वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramebhya iṣṭā tu loke 'sminsaṃpravarttate / sarvāsāṃ devayonīnāṃ sthitihetuḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यमेतद्व्याख्यातमत ऊर्द्ध्वं निबोधत । ध्रुवादूर्द्ध्वं महर्लोको यस्मिंस्ते कल्पवासिनः
verses.transliteration: trailokyametadvyākhyātamata ūrddhvaṃ nibodhata / dhruvādūrddhvaṃ maharloko yasmiṃste kalpavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एकायोजनकोटीशा इत्येवं निश्चयोगतः । द्वीकोट्यां तु महर्लोकाज्जनलोको व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: ekāyojanakoṭīśā ityevaṃ niścayogataḥ / dvīkoṭyāṃ tu maharlokājjanaloko vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यत्र ते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा दक्षाद्याः साधकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: yatra te brahmaṇaḥ putrā dakṣādyāḥ sādhakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वै राजा यत्र ते देवा भूतदाहविवर्जिताः । षड्गुणं तु तपोलोकात्सत्यलोकान्तरं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: vai rājā yatra te devā bhūtadāhavivarjitāḥ / ṣaḍguṇaṃ tu tapolokātsatyalokāntaraṃ smṛtam
