verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अपुनर्मारको नाम ब्रह्मलोकः स उच्यते । यस्मिन्न च्यवते भूयो ब्रह्मणं य उपासते
verses.transliteration: apunarmārako nāma brahmalokaḥ sa ucyate / yasminna cyavate bhūyo brahmaṇaṃ ya upāsate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एककोटिर्योजनानां पञ्चाशन्नियुतानि तु । ऊर्द्ध्वभागस्तत्ॐऽडस्य ब्रह्मलोकात्परः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ekakoṭiryojanānāṃ pañcāśanniyutāni tu / ūrddhvabhāgastatoṃ'ḍasya brahmalokātparaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशैव कोट्यस्तु नियुतानि च पञ्च षट् । स चौर्द्ध्व संप्रचारो ऽस्य गत्यन्तश्चपरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: caturdaśaiva koṭyastu niyutāni ca pañca ṣaṭ / sa caurddhva saṃpracāro 'sya gatyantaścaparaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवाग्रमेतद्व्याख्यातं योजनग्राद्यथाश्रुतम् । अधोगतीनां वक्ष्यामि भूतानां स्थानकल्पनाम्
verses.transliteration: dhruvāgrametadvyākhyātaṃ yojanagrādyathāśrutam / adhogatīnāṃ vakṣyāmi bhūtānāṃ sthānakalpanām
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्ति घोरकर्माणः प्राणिनो यत्र कर्मभिः । नरको रौरवो घोरः शूकरस्ताल एवं च
verses.transliteration: gacchanti ghorakarmāṇaḥ prāṇino yatra karmabhiḥ / narako rauravo ghoraḥ śūkarastāla evaṃ ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तप्तकुम्भो महाज्वालः शबलो ऽथ विमोहनः । कृमी च कृमिभक्षश्च लालाभक्षो विशंसनः
verses.transliteration: taptakumbho mahājvālaḥ śabalo 'tha vimohanaḥ / kṛmī ca kṛmibhakṣaśca lālābhakṣo viśaṃsanaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अधःशिराः पूयवहो रुधिरान्धुस्तथैवच । विष्टाकीर्णश्च नरको मूत्रकीर्ण स्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: adhaḥśirāḥ pūyavaho rudhirāndhustathaivaca / viṣṭākīrṇaśca narako mūtrakīrṇa stathaiva ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तथा वैतरणी कृष्णमसिपत्रवनं तथा । अग्निज्वालो महाघोरः संदंशो ऽथाश्वभोजनः
verses.transliteration: tathā vaitaraṇī kṛṣṇamasipatravanaṃ tathā / agnijvālo mahāghoraḥ saṃdaṃśo 'thāśvabhojanaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तमश्चकृष्णसूत्रश्च लोहश्चाप्यभिजस्तथा । अप्रतिष्ठो ऽथ वीचिश्च नरका ह्येवमादयः
verses.transliteration: tamaścakṛṣṇasūtraśca lohaścāpyabhijastathā / apratiṣṭho 'tha vīciśca narakā hyevamādayaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तामसा नरकाः सर्वे यमस्य विषये स्थिताः । येषु दुष्कृतकर्माणः पतन्तीह वृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tāmasā narakāḥ sarve yamasya viṣaye sthitāḥ / yeṣu duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ patantīha vṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: भूमेरधस्तात्ते सर्वे रौरवाद्यः प्रकीर्त्तिताः । रौरवे कूटसाक्षे तुमिथ्या यश्चाभिशसति
verses.transliteration: bhūmeradhastātte sarve rauravādyaḥ prakīrttitāḥ / raurave kūṭasākṣe tumithyā yaścābhiśasati
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: क्रूरग्रह पक्षवादी ह्यसक्तः पतते नरः । राधो गोध्रो भ्रूणहा च ह्यग्निदाता पुरस्य च
verses.transliteration: krūragraha pakṣavādī hyasaktaḥ patate naraḥ / rādho godhro bhrūṇahā ca hyagnidātā purasya ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: शूकरे ब्रह्महा मज्जेत्सुरापः स्वर्णतस्करः । ताले पतेत्क्षत्रियहा हत्वा वैश्यं च मज्जति
verses.transliteration: śūkare brahmahā majjetsurāpaḥ svarṇataskaraḥ / tāle patetkṣatriyahā hatvā vaiśyaṃ ca majjati
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या च यः कुर्याद्यश्च स्याद्गुरुतल्पगः । सप्तकुम्भेष्वसौ गामी तथा राजभटश्च यः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā ca yaḥ kuryādyaśca syādgurutalpagaḥ / saptakumbheṣvasau gāmī tathā rājabhaṭaśca yaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: संताप्यते वाश्वणिक्तथाच धनरक्षिता । साध्वीविक्रयकर्त्ता च यस्तु भक्तं परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃtāpyate vāśvaṇiktathāca dhanarakṣitā / sādhvīvikrayakarttā ca yastu bhaktaṃ parityajet
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: महाज्वाले दुहितरं स्नुषां गच्छति यस्तु वै । वेदं विक्रीणतेये च वेदं वै दूषयन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: mahājvāle duhitaraṃ snuṣāṃ gacchati yastu vai / vedaṃ vikrīṇateye ca vedaṃ vai dūṣayanti ye
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: गुरुंश्चैवावमन्यन्ते वाक्शरैस्ताडयन्ति च । अगम्यगामी च नरो नरकं शबलं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: guruṃścaivāvamanyante vākśaraistāḍayanti ca / agamyagāmī ca naro narakaṃ śabalaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विमोहे पतते घोरे मर्यादां योभिनत्ति वै । दुरिष्टं कुरुते यस्तु कीडलोहं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: vimohe patate ghore maryādāṃ yobhinatti vai / duriṣṭaṃ kurute yastu kīḍalohaṃ prapadyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: देवब्राह्मणविद्वेष्टा गुरूणां वाप्यपूजकः । रत्नं दूषयते यस्तु कृमिभक्षे प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: devabrāhmaṇavidveṣṭā gurūṇāṃ vāpyapūjakaḥ / ratnaṃ dūṣayate yastu kṛmibhakṣe prapadyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पर्यश्नाति य एको ऽन्नं ब्राह्मणान्सुहृदो विना । लालाभक्षे स तिष्ठेत्तु दुर्गन्धे नरके गतः
verses.transliteration: paryaśnāti ya eko 'nnaṃ brāhmaṇānsuhṛdo vinā / lālābhakṣe sa tiṣṭhettu durgandhe narake gataḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: काण्डकर्त्ता कुलालश्च निष्कहर्ता चिकित्सकः । आरामे ऽप्यग्निदाता यः पतते स विशंसनि
verses.transliteration: kāṇḍakarttā kulālaśca niṣkahartā cikitsakaḥ / ārāme 'pyagnidātā yaḥ patate sa viśaṃsani
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: असत्प्रतिग्रही यश्च तथैवायाज्ययाजकः । नक्षत्रैर्जीवते यश्च नरो गच्छत्यधोमुखम्
verses.transliteration: asatpratigrahī yaśca tathaivāyājyayājakaḥ / nakṣatrairjīvate yaśca naro gacchatyadhomukham
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरं सुरां च लवणं लाक्षां गन्धं रसं तिलान् एवमादीनि विक्रीणन्घोरे पूयवहे पतेत्
verses.transliteration: kṣīraṃ surāṃ ca lavaṇaṃ lākṣāṃ gandhaṃ rasaṃ tilān evamādīni vikrīṇanghore pūyavahe patet
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यः कुक्कुटान्निबद्नाति मार्जारान्सूकरांस्तथा । पक्षिणश्च मृगाञ्छागान्सो ऽप्येनं नरकं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kukkuṭānnibadnāti mārjārānsūkarāṃstathā / pakṣiṇaśca mṛgāñchāgānso 'pyenaṃ narakaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अजाविको माहिषिकस्तथा चक्रध्वजी च यः । रङ्गोपजीवको विप्रः शाकनिर्ग्रामयाजकः
verses.transliteration: ajāviko māhiṣikastathā cakradhvajī ca yaḥ / raṅgopajīvako vipraḥ śākanirgrāmayājakaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अगारदाही गरदः कुण्डाशी सोमविक्रयी । सुरापो मासभक्षश्च तथा च पशुघातकः
verses.transliteration: agāradāhī garadaḥ kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī / surāpo māsabhakṣaśca tathā ca paśughātakaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विशस्ता महिषादीनां मृगहन्ता तथैव च । पर्वकारश्च मूची च यश्च स्यान्मित्रघातकः
verses.transliteration: viśastā mahiṣādīnāṃ mṛgahantā tathaiva ca / parvakāraśca mūcī ca yaśca syānmitraghātakaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: रुधिरान्धौ पतन्त्येते ह्येवमाहुर्मनीषिणः । उपविष्टं भोक्तुमथ पङ्क्त्यां वै वञ्चयन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: rudhirāndhau patantyete hyevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / upaviṣṭaṃ bhoktumatha paṅktyāṃ vai vañcayanti ye
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पतन्ति नरके घोरे विड्भुजे नात्र संशयः । मृषावादी नरो यश्च तथा प्राक्रोशको ऽशुभः
verses.transliteration: patanti narake ghore viḍbhuje nātra saṃśayaḥ / mṛṣāvādī naro yaśca tathā prākrośako 'śubhaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पतते नरके घोरे मूत्राकीर्णे स पापकृत । मधुग्राहाभिहन्तारो यान्ति वैतग्णीं नराः
verses.transliteration: patate narake ghore mūtrākīrṇe sa pāpakṛta / madhugrāhābhihantāro yānti vaitagṇīṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: उन्मत्ताश्चित्तभग्नाश्चशौचाचारविवर्जिताः । क्रोधना दुःखदा ये च कुहकाः कृष्णगामिनः
verses.transliteration: unmattāścittabhagnāścaśaucācāravivarjitāḥ / krodhanā duḥkhadā ye ca kuhakāḥ kṛṣṇagāminaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: असिपत्र वनच्छदकृतो ह्योरभ्रिकाश्च ये । कर्त्तनषु विकृत्यन्त मृगव्याधः सुदारुणैः
verses.transliteration: asipatra vanacchadakṛto hyorabhrikāśca ye / karttanaṣu vikṛtyanta mṛgavyādhaḥ sudāruṇaiḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: आश्रम प्रत्यवसिता ह्यग्निज्वाले पतन्ति वै । भक्ष्यन्ते श्यामशबलैरयस्तुडश्व वायसैः
verses.transliteration: āśrama pratyavasitā hyagnijvāle patanti vai / bhakṣyante śyāmaśabalairayastuḍaśva vāyasaiḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: इष्टापूर्तव्रतालोपात्संदंशे नरके पतेत् । स्कन्दन्ते ये दिवास्वप्ने व्रतिनो ब्रह्मचारिणः
verses.transliteration: iṣṭāpūrtavratālopātsaṃdaṃśe narake patet / skandante ye divāsvapne vratino brahmacāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रैरध्यापिता ये च पुत्रैराक्षापिताश्च ये । ते सर्व नरकं यान्ति नियतं तु श्वभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: putrairadhyāpitā ye ca putrairākṣāpitāśca ye / te sarva narakaṃ yānti niyataṃ tu śvabhojanam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धा ये क्रोधहर्षसमन्विताः । कर्माणि ये तु कुर्वन्ति सर्वे निरयवासिनः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramaviruddhā ye krodhaharṣasamanvitāḥ / karmāṇi ye tu kurvanti sarve nirayavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: उपरिष्टात्स्थितो घोर उष्णात्मा रौरवो महान् । सुदारुणस्तु शीतात्मा तस्याधस्तात्तपः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: upariṣṭātsthito ghora uṣṇātmā rauravo mahān / sudāruṇastu śītātmā tasyādhastāttapaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एवमादिक्रमेणैव वर्ण्यमानान्निबोधत । भूमेरधस्तात्सप्तैव नरकाः परिकीर्त्तिताः
verses.transliteration: evamādikrameṇaiva varṇyamānānnibodhata / bhūmeradhastātsaptaiva narakāḥ parikīrttitāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मसूतयस्ते स्युरन्धतामिस्रकादयः । रौरवः प्रथमस्तेषां महारौरव एव च
verses.transliteration: adharmasūtayaste syurandhatāmisrakādayaḥ / rauravaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ mahāraurava eva ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अस्याधः पुनरप्यन्यः शीतस्तप इति स्मृतः । तृतीयः कालसूत्रः स्यान्महाहिर्विविधः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: asyādhaḥ punarapyanyaḥ śītastapa iti smṛtaḥ / tṛtīyaḥ kālasūtraḥ syānmahāhirvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अप्रतिष्ठश्चतुर्थः स्याद वीचिः पञ्चमः स्मृतः । लोहः षष्ठः स्मृतस्तेषामविधेयस्तु सप्तमः
verses.transliteration: apratiṣṭhaścaturthaḥ syāda vīciḥ pañcamaḥ smṛtaḥ / lohaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ smṛtasteṣāmavidheyastu saptamaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: घोरात्वाद्रौरवः प्रोक्तः सोष्णको दहनः स्मृतः । सुदारुणस्तु शीतात्मा त्स्याधस्तात्तपो ऽधमः
verses.transliteration: ghorātvādrauravaḥ proktaḥ soṣṇako dahanaḥ smṛtaḥ / sudāruṇastu śītātmā tsyādhastāttapo 'dhamaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सवां निकृन्तनः प्रोक्तो कालसूत्रो ऽतिदारुणः । अप्रतिष्ठे स्थितिर्नास्ति भ्रमस्तस्मिन्सदा स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: savāṃ nikṛntanaḥ prokto kālasūtro 'tidāruṇaḥ / apratiṣṭhe sthitirnāsti bhramastasminsadā smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अवीचिर्दारुणः प्रोक्तो यन्त्रसंपीडनाच्च सः । तस्मात्सुदारुणो लोहः कर्मणां श्रयणाच्च सः
verses.transliteration: avīcirdāruṇaḥ prokto yantrasaṃpīḍanācca saḥ / tasmātsudāruṇo lohaḥ karmaṇāṃ śrayaṇācca saḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तथाभूतशरीत्वादविधेयस्तु स स्मृतः । पीडाबन्धवधासंगादप्रतीकारलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tathābhūtaśarītvādavidheyastu sa smṛtaḥ / pīḍābandhavadhāsaṃgādapratīkāralakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्द्ध्वाधः संगतास्ते तु निरालोकाश्च ते स्मृताः । दुःखोत्कर्षस्तु सर्वेषु ह्यधर्मस्य निमित्ततः ऊर्द्ध्वलोकैः समावेतौ निरालोकौ च तावुभौ । कूटागारप्र माणैश्च शरीरैस्तत्र नारकाः
verses.transliteration: ūrddhvādhaḥ saṃgatāste tu nirālokāśca te smṛtāḥ / duḥkhotkarṣastu sarveṣu hyadharmasya nimittataḥ ūrddhvalokaiḥ samāvetau nirālokau ca tāvubhau / kūṭāgārapra māṇaiśca śarīraistatra nārakāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: उपभोगसमर्थैस्तु सद्यो जायन्ति कर्मभिः । दुःखप्रकर्षश्चोग्रस्तु तेषु सर्वेषु वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: upabhogasamarthaistu sadyo jāyanti karmabhiḥ / duḥkhaprakarṣaścograstu teṣu sarveṣu vai smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: उपभोगसमर्थैस्तु सद्यो जायन्ति कर्मभिः । दुःखप्रकर्षश्चोग्रस्तु तेषु सर्वेषु वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: upabhogasamarthaistu sadyo jāyanti karmabhiḥ / duḥkhaprakarṣaścograstu teṣu sarveṣu vai smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यातनाश्चाप्यसंख्येया नारकाणां तथा स्मृताः । तत्रानुभूयते दुःखं क्षीणे कर्मणि वै पुनः
verses.transliteration: yātanāścāpyasaṃkhyeyā nārakāṇāṃ tathā smṛtāḥ / tatrānubhūyate duḥkhaṃ kṣīṇe karmaṇi vai punaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्योनौ प्रसूयन्ते कर्मशेषेण तेंऽततः । देवांश्च तारकाश्चैव ह्यूर्द्ध्वं चाधश्च संस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tiryagyonau prasūyante karmaśeṣeṇa teṃ'tataḥ / devāṃśca tārakāścaiva hyūrddhvaṃ cādhaśca saṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्मनिमित्तेन सद्यो जायन्ति मूर्त्तयः । उपभोगार्थमुत्पत्तिरौपपत्तिककर्मतः
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmanimittena sadyo jāyanti mūrttayaḥ / upabhogārthamutpattiraupapattikakarmataḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति नारकान्देवा ह्यधोवक्त्रा ह्यघोगतान् । नारकांश्च तथा देवान्सर्वान्पश्यं त्यधेमुखान्
verses.transliteration: paśyanti nārakāndevā hyadhovaktrā hyaghogatān / nārakāṃśca tathā devānsarvānpaśyaṃ tyadhemukhān
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अनयोस्तुल्यता यस्माद्धारमाश्च स्वभावतः । तस्मादूर्द्ध्वमधोभावो लोकालोके न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: anayostulyatā yasmāddhāramāśca svabhāvataḥ / tasmādūrddhvamadhobhāvo lokāloke na vidyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एषा स्वाभाविकी संज्ञा लोकालोके प्रवर्त्तते । अथाब्रुवन्पुनर्वायुंब्राह्मणाः सत्रिणस्तदा
verses.transliteration: eṣā svābhāvikī saṃjñā lokāloke pravarttate / athābruvanpunarvāyuṃbrāhmaṇāḥ satriṇastadā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः सर्वेषामेव भूतानां लोकालोकनिवासिनाम् । संसारे संसरन्तीह यावन्तः प्राणिनश्च ते
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ lokālokanivāsinām / saṃsāre saṃsarantīha yāvantaḥ prāṇinaśca te
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: संख्याया परिसंख्याय तान्नः प्रब्रूहि कृत्स्नशः । ऋषीणां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा मरुतो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: saṃkhyāyā parisaṃkhyāya tānnaḥ prabrūhi kṛtsnaśaḥ / ṛṣīṇāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā maruto vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच न शक्यं दिव्यया दृष्ट्या ज्ञातुं ज्ञानेन वा पुनः । चक्षुषा वै प्रसंख्यातुमतो ह्यन्ते न च द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca na śakyaṃ divyayā dṛṣṭyā jñātuṃ jñānena vā punaḥ / cakṣuṣā vai prasaṃkhyātumato hyante na ca dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अनाध्यानादमेयत्वान्नैव प्रश्नो विधीयते । ब्रह्मणा संज्ञितं यत्तु संख्यया तन्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: anādhyānādameyatvānnaiva praśno vidhīyate / brahmaṇā saṃjñitaṃ yattu saṃkhyayā tannibodhata
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यः सहस्रतमो भागः स्थावराणां भवेदिह । पार्थिवाः कृमयस्तावत्संसेकाद्येषु संभवः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sahasratamo bhāgaḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ bhavediha / pārthivāḥ kṛmayastāvatsaṃsekādyeṣu saṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: संसेकजानां भागेन सहस्रेणैव संमिताः । औदका जन्तवः सर्वे निश्चयात्तन्निधार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsekajānāṃ bhāgena sahasreṇaiva saṃmitāḥ / audakā jantavaḥ sarve niścayāttannidhāryatām
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रेणैव भागेन सत्त्वानां सलिलौकसाम् । विहङ्गमास्तु विज्ञेया लौकिकास्ते च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sahasreṇaiva bhāgena sattvānāṃ salilaukasām / vihaṅgamāstu vijñeyā laukikāste ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यः सहस्रतमो भागस्तेषां वै पक्षिमां भवेत् । पशवस्तत्समा ज्ञेया लौकिकास्तु चतुष्पदाः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sahasratamo bhāgasteṣāṃ vai pakṣimāṃ bhavet / paśavastatsamā jñeyā laukikāstu catuṣpadāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: चतुष्पदानां सर्वेषां सहस्रेणैव संमिताः । द्विपदास्तत्सहस्रेण संमिता धार्मिकाः पुनः
verses.transliteration: catuṣpadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sahasreṇaiva saṃmitāḥ / dvipadāstatsahasreṇa saṃmitā dhārmikāḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रेणैव भागेन धार्मिकेभ्यो दिवं गताः । यः सहस्रतमो भागो धार्मिकाणां भवेद्दिवि
verses.transliteration: sahasreṇaiva bhāgena dhārmikebhyo divaṃ gatāḥ / yaḥ sahasratamo bhāgo dhārmikāṇāṃ bhaveddivi
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: संमितास्तेन भागेन मोक्षिणस्तावदेव हि । स्वर्गोपपादकैस्तुल्या यातनास्थानवासिनः
verses.transliteration: saṃmitāstena bhāgena mokṣiṇastāvadeva hi / svargopapādakaistulyā yātanāsthānavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पतिताधर्मविद्वेषाद्दुरात्मानो म्रियन्ति ये । रौरवे तमसि ह्येते शीतोष्णं प्राप्नुवन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: patitādharmavidveṣāddurātmāno mriyanti ye / raurave tamasi hyete śītoṣṇaṃ prāpnuvanti te
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वेदनाः कटुकाः स्तब्धा यातनास्थानमागताः । उष्णस्तु रौरवो ज्ञेयस्तेजोघोररसात्मकः
verses.transliteration: vedanāḥ kaṭukāḥ stabdhā yātanāsthānamāgatāḥ / uṣṇastu rauravo jñeyastejoghorarasātmakaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तत्ॐऽधनामकश्चापि शीतान्मा सततं तपः । एवं सुदुर्लभाः संतः स्वर्गे वा धार्मिका नराः
verses.transliteration: tatoṃ'dhanāmakaścāpi śītānmā satataṃ tapaḥ / evaṃ sudurlabhāḥ saṃtaḥ svarge vā dhārmikā narāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एषा संज्ञीकृता संख्या चेश्वरेण स्वयंभुवा । गणाना दिनिवृत्तैषा संख्या ब्राह्मी त्वमानुषी
verses.transliteration: eṣā saṃjñīkṛtā saṃkhyā ceśvareṇa svayaṃbhuvā / gaṇānā dinivṛttaiṣā saṃkhyā brāhmī tvamānuṣī
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः महाञ्जनस्तपः सत्यो भूतो भव्यो भवस्तथा । उक्ता ह्येते त्वया लाका लाकानामन्तरण च
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ mahāñjanastapaḥ satyo bhūto bhavyo bhavastathā / uktā hyete tvayā lākā lākānāmantaraṇa ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: लोकान्तरं च यादृक् च तन्नो ब्रूहि यथा तथा । तेषां तद्वचन श्रुत्वा ऋषीणामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् । स वायुर्दृष्टतत्त्वार्थ इदं तत्त्वमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: lokāntaraṃ ca yādṛk ca tanno brūhi yathā tathā / teṣāṃ tadvacana śrutvā ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām / sa vāyurdṛṣṭatattvārtha idaṃ tattvamuvāca ha
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच व्यक्तं तर्केण पश्यन्ति योगात्प्रत्यक्षदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: vāyuruvāca vyaktaṃ tarkeṇa paśyanti yogātpratyakṣadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्याहारेण ध्यानेन तपसा क्षयमात्मनः । ऋभुः सनत्कुमाराद्याः संबुद्धाः शुद्धबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: pratyāhāreṇa dhyānena tapasā kṣayamātmanaḥ / ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyāḥ saṃbuddhāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: व्यपेतकोशा विरजाः संतो ब्रह्मैव सत्तमाः । अक्षयाः प्रीतिसंयुक्ता ब्राह्मे तिष्ठन्ति योगिनः
verses.transliteration: vyapetakośā virajāḥ saṃto brahmaiva sattamāḥ / akṣayāḥ prītisaṃyuktā brāhme tiṣṭhanti yoginaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां बालशिल्यानां तैर्यथाकृतमीश्वरैः । यथात्रैव सया दृष्टं सांनिध्यं तत्र कुर्वता
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ bālaśilyānāṃ tairyathākṛtamīśvaraiḥ / yathātraiva sayā dṛṣṭaṃ sāṃnidhyaṃ tatra kurvatā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अग्राह्यमकृतार्थानामालयं चेश्वरस्य यत् । ईश्वरः परमाणुत्वाद्भावग्राह्यो मनीषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: agrāhyamakṛtārthānāmālayaṃ ceśvarasya yat / īśvaraḥ paramāṇutvādbhāvagrāhyo manīṣiṇām
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं तपः सत्यं क्षमा धृतिः । द्रष्टृत्वमात्मसंबन्धमधिष्टातृत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ / draṣṭṛtvamātmasaṃbandhamadhiṣṭātṛtvameva ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अव्ययानि दशैतानि तस्मिस्तिंष्ठन्ति शङ्करे । विभुत्वात्खलु योगाढ्यो ब्रह्मणो ऽनुग्रहे रतः
verses.transliteration: avyayāni daśaitāni tasmistiṃṣṭhanti śaṅkare / vibhutvātkhalu yogāḍhyo brahmaṇo 'nugrahe rataḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: स लोकविग्रहो भूत्वा साहाय्यमुपतिष्ठते । अक्षरं ध्रुवमव्यग्रमष्टमं त्वौपसर्गिकम्
verses.transliteration: sa lokavigraho bhūtvā sāhāyyamupatiṣṭhate / akṣaraṃ dhruvamavyagramaṣṭamaṃ tvaupasargikam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तस्येश्वरस्य चिन्मात्रं स्थानं मायामयं परम् । मायया कृतमाचष्टे मायी देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasyeśvarasya cinmātraṃ sthānaṃ māyāmayaṃ param / māyayā kṛtamācaṣṭe māyī devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: देवानामुपसंहारस्तत्प्रमाणं हि कीर्त्यते । विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: devānāmupasaṃhārastatpramāṇaṃ hi kīrtyate / vistareṇānupūrvyā ca bruvato me nibodhata
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशैव कोट्यस्तु नियुतानि दशेषवः । भूलोकाद्ब्रह्मलोको वै योजनैः संप्रकीर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: trayodaśaiva koṭyastu niyutāni daśeṣavaḥ / bhūlokādbrahmaloko vai yojanaiḥ saṃprakīrtyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एका योजनकोटी तु पञ्चाशन्नियुतानि च । ऊर्द्ध्व भागवतो ऽडं तु ब्रह्मलोकात्परं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: ekā yojanakoṭī tu pañcāśanniyutāni ca / ūrddhva bhāgavato 'ḍaṃ tu brahmalokātparaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एषोर्द्ध्वगः प्रचारस्तु गत्यन्तश्च ततः स्मृतः । नित्या ह्यपरिसंक्षाताः परस्परगुणाश्रयात्
verses.transliteration: eṣorddhvagaḥ pracārastu gatyantaśca tataḥ smṛtaḥ / nityā hyaparisaṃkṣātāḥ parasparaguṇāśrayāt
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्माः प्रसवधर्मिण्यस्ततः प्रकृतयः स्मृताः । येभ्यो ऽधिकर्त्ता संजज्ञे क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmāḥ prasavadharmiṇyastataḥ prakṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ / yebhyo 'dhikarttā saṃjajñe kṣetrajño brahmasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तासु प्रकृतिमत्सूक्ष्ममधिष्ठातृत्वमव्ययम् । अनुत्पाद्यं परं धाम परमाणु परेशयम्
verses.transliteration: tāsu prakṛtimatsūkṣmamadhiṣṭhātṛtvamavyayam / anutpādyaṃ paraṃ dhāma paramāṇu pareśayam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयश्चाप्यनूह्यश्च त्वमूर्त्तिर्मूर्त्तिमानसौ । प्रादुर्भावस्तिरोभावः स्थितिश्चैवाप्यनुग्रहः
verses.transliteration: akṣayaścāpyanūhyaśca tvamūrttirmūrttimānasau / prādurbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sthitiścaivāpyanugrahaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विधिरन्यैरनौपम्यः परमाणुमहेश्वरः । सतेजा एष तमसो यः पुरस्तात्प्रकाशकः
verses.transliteration: vidhiranyairanaupamyaḥ paramāṇumaheśvaraḥ / satejā eṣa tamaso yaḥ purastātprakāśakaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यदण्डमासीत्सौवर्मं प्रथमं त्वौपसर्गिकम् । बृहत्तु सर्वतो वृत्तमीश्वरात्तद्व्यजायते
verses.transliteration: yadaṇḍamāsītsauvarmaṃ prathamaṃ tvaupasargikam / bṛhattu sarvato vṛttamīśvarāttadvyajāyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वराद्बीजनिर्भेदः क्षेत्रज्ञो बीजमिष्यते । योनिं प्रकृति माचष्टे सा च नारायणात्मिका
verses.transliteration: īśvarādbījanirbhedaḥ kṣetrajño bījamiṣyate / yoniṃ prakṛti mācaṣṭe sā ca nārāyaṇātmikā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विभुर्लोकस्य सृष्ट्यर्थं लोकसंस्थानमेव च । सन्निसर्गः सतत्त्वाच्च लोकधातुर्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: vibhurlokasya sṛṣṭyarthaṃ lokasaṃsthānameva ca / sannisargaḥ satattvācca lokadhāturmahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्ताद्ब्रह्मलोकस्य ह्यण्डादर्वाक् च ब्रह्मणः । त्योर्मध्ये पुरं दिव्यं मन मयमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: purastādbrahmalokasya hyaṇḍādarvāk ca brahmaṇaḥ / tyormadhye puraṃ divyaṃ mana mayamanāmayam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तद्विग्रहवतः स्थानमीश्वरस्यामितौजसः । शिवं नाम पुरं तत्र शरणं जन्मभीरुणाम्
verses.transliteration: tadvigrahavataḥ sthānamīśvarasyāmitaujasaḥ / śivaṃ nāma puraṃ tatra śaraṇaṃ janmabhīruṇām
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणां शतं पूर्वं योजनानां द्विजोत्तमाः । अभ्यन्तरं तु विस्तीर्णं महीमण्डलसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ yojanānāṃ dvijottamāḥ / abhyantaraṃ tu vistīrṇaṃ mahīmaṇḍalasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: मध्याह्नार्कप्रकाशेन परतेजो ऽभिमर्दिना । शात कैंभेन महता प्राकारेणार्कवर्चसा
verses.transliteration: madhyāhnārkaprakāśena paratejo 'bhimardinā / śāta kaiṃbhena mahatā prākāreṇārkavarcasā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: द्वारैश्चतुर्भिः सौवर्णैर्मुक्तादामविभूषितैः । तपनीयनिभैः शुभ्रैर्गाढं सुकृतवेष्टनम्
verses.transliteration: dvāraiścaturbhiḥ sauvarṇairmuktādāmavibhūṣitaiḥ / tapanīyanibhaiḥ śubhrairgāḍhaṃ sukṛtaveṣṭanam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तच्चाकाशे पुरं रम्यं दिव्यं घण्टादिनादितम् । रम्ये पुरवरश्रेष्ठे तस्मिन्वैहायभूमिषु
verses.transliteration: taccākāśe puraṃ ramyaṃ divyaṃ ghaṇṭādināditam / ramye puravaraśreṣṭhe tasminvaihāyabhūmiṣu
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: नानारत्नविचित्रेषु पताकाबहुलेषु च । सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु वनोपवनशोभिषु
verses.transliteration: nānāratnavicitreṣu patākābahuleṣu ca / sarvakāmasamṛddheṣu vanopavanaśobhiṣu
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: राजतेषु गृहान्तेषु शातकैंभमयेषु च । संध्याभ्रसन्निकाशेषु कैलासप्रतिमेषु च
verses.transliteration: rājateṣu gṛhānteṣu śātakaiṃbhamayeṣu ca / saṃdhyābhrasannikāśeṣu kailāsapratimeṣu ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टैः शब्दादिभिर्भोगैर्ये भविष्यानुसारिणः । प्रासादवरपृष्ठेषु तेषु मोदन्ति सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭaiḥ śabdādibhirbhogairye bhaviṣyānusāriṇaḥ / prāsādavarapṛṣṭheṣu teṣu modanti suvratāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघोषैरविरताः कथाश्च विविधाः शुभाः । गीतवादित्रघोषाश्च संस्रवाश्च समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: brahmaghoṣairaviratāḥ kathāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ / gītavāditraghoṣāśca saṃsravāśca samantataḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: संहताश्चैवमतुला जनाश्रयकृतस्तथा । एवमादीनि वर्तन्ते तेषां प्रासादमूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: saṃhatāścaivamatulā janāśrayakṛtastathā / evamādīni vartante teṣāṃ prāsādamūrddhani
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रपादः प्रासादस्तपनीयमयः शुभः । अनौपम्यैर्वरै रत्नैः सर्वतः संविभूषितः
verses.transliteration: sahasrapādaḥ prāsādastapanīyamayaḥ śubhaḥ / anaupamyairvarai ratnaiḥ sarvataḥ saṃvibhūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: स्फाटिकैश्चन्द्रसंकाशैर्वैडूर्यमणिसप्रभैः । बालसुर्यमयैश्चापि सौवर्णैश्चाग्निसप्रभैः
verses.transliteration: sphāṭikaiścandrasaṃkāśairvaiḍūryamaṇisaprabhaiḥ / bālasuryamayaiścāpi sauvarṇaiścāgnisaprabhaiḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: चुक्रुशुर्मुनयः श्रुत्वा नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः । आपन्नसंशयाश्चेमं वाक्यमूचुः समीरणम्
verses.transliteration: cukruśurmunayaḥ śrutvā naimiṣeyāstapasvinaḥ / āpannasaṃśayāścemaṃ vākyamūcuḥ samīraṇam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः के तु तत्र महात्मानो ये भवस्यानुसारिणः । अनुग्राह्यतमाः सम्यक्प्रमोदन्ते पुरोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ke tu tatra mahātmāno ye bhavasyānusāriṇaḥ / anugrāhyatamāḥ samyakpramodante purottame
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां वचनं श्रुत्वा वायुर्वाक्यमुदैरयत् । वायुरुवाच श्रूयतां देवदेवस्य भक्तिर्यैरनुकल्पिता
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā vāyurvākyamudairayat / vāyuruvāca śrūyatāṃ devadevasya bhaktiryairanukalpitā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ह्रीमन्तस्फूर्जिता दान्ताः शौर्ययुक्ता ह्यलोलुपाः । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: hrīmantasphūrjitā dāntāḥ śauryayuktā hyalolupāḥ / karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāntarātmanā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यमनसो भूत्वा प्रपन्ना ये महेश्वरम् । तैर्लब्धं रुद्रसालोक्यं शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: ananyamanaso bhūtvā prapannā ye maheśvaram / tairlabdhaṃ rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: भवस्य रूपसादृश्यं गताश्चैव ह्यनुत्तमम् । वैश्वानारमुखाः सर्वे विश्वरूपाः कपर्दिनः
verses.transliteration: bhavasya rūpasādṛśyaṃ gatāścaiva hyanuttamam / vaiśvānāramukhāḥ sarve viśvarūpāḥ kapardinaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: नीलकण्ठाः शितग्रीवास्तीक्ष्णदंष्टास्त्रिलोचनाः । अर्द्धचन्द्रकृतोष्णीषा जटामुकुट धारिणः
verses.transliteration: nīlakaṇṭhāḥ śitagrīvāstīkṣṇadaṃṣṭāstrilocanāḥ / arddhacandrakṛtoṣṇīṣā jaṭāmukuṭa dhāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे दशभुजा वीराः पद्मान्तरसुगन्धिनः । तरुणादित्यसंकाशाः सर्वे ते पीतवाससः
verses.transliteration: sarve daśabhujā vīrāḥ padmāntarasugandhinaḥ / taruṇādityasaṃkāśāḥ sarve te pītavāsasaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: पिनाकपाणयः सर्वेश्वेत गोवृषवाहनाः । श्रियान्विताः कुण्डलिनो मुक्ताहारविभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: pinākapāṇayaḥ sarveśveta govṛṣavāhanāḥ / śriyānvitāḥ kuṇḍalino muktāhāravibhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तेजसाभ्यधिकैर्दहैः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः । विभज्य बहुधात्मानं जरामृत्युविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: tejasābhyadhikairdahaiḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ / vibhajya bahudhātmānaṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्ते विविधैर्भावैर्भोगान्प्राप्य सुदुर्लभान् । स्वच्छन्दगतयः सिद्धाः सिद्धैश्चन्यैर्विबोधिताः
verses.transliteration: krīḍante vividhairbhāvairbhogānprāpya sudurlabhān / svacchandagatayaḥ siddhāḥ siddhaiścanyairvibodhitāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एकादशानां रुद्राणां कोट्यो नैका महात्मनाम् । एभिः सह महात्मा वै देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ koṭyo naikā mahātmanām / ebhiḥ saha mahātmā vai devadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: भक्तानुकंपी भगवान्मोदते पार्वतीप्रियः । नाहं तेषां तु रुद्राणां भवस्य च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: bhaktānukaṃpī bhagavānmodate pārvatīpriyaḥ / nāhaṃ teṣāṃ tu rudrāṇāṃ bhavasya ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: नानात्वमनुपश्यामि सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि वः । मातारिश्वाब्रवीत्पुण्यमित्येतामीश्वराच्छ्रुताम्
verses.transliteration: nānātvamanupaśyāmi satyametadbravīmi vaḥ / mātāriśvābravītpuṇyamityetāmīśvarācchrutām
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अथ ते ऋषयः सर्वे दिवाकरसमप्रभाः । श्रुत्वेमां परमां पुण्यां कथां त्रैयंबकीन्ततः
verses.transliteration: atha te ṛṣayaḥ sarve divākarasamaprabhāḥ / śrutvemāṃ paramāṃ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ traiyaṃbakīntataḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: भृशं चानुग्रहं प्राप्य हर्षं चैवाप्यनुत्तमम् । संभाजयित्वा चाप्येनं वायुमूचुर्महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛśaṃ cānugrahaṃ prāpya harṣaṃ caivāpyanuttamam / saṃbhājayitvā cāpyenaṃ vāyumūcurmahābalam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः समीरण महाभाग त्वस्माकं च त्वया विभो । ईश्वरस्योत्तमं पुण्यमष्टमं त्वौपसार्गिकम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ samīraṇa mahābhāga tvasmākaṃ ca tvayā vibho / īśvarasyottamaṃ puṇyamaṣṭamaṃ tvaupasārgikam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य स्थानं प्रमाणं च चथावत्परिकीर्तितम् । योगधर्मसमृद्धं वै परमं परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasya sthānaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca cathāvatparikīrtitam / yogadharmasamṛddhaṃ vai paramaṃ paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: महादेवस्य माहात्म्यं दुर्विज्ञेयं सुरैरपि । स्वेन माहात्म्ययोगेन सहस्रस्यामितौजसः
verses.transliteration: mahādevasya māhātmyaṃ durvijñeyaṃ surairapi / svena māhātmyayogena sahasrasyāmitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यस्य भक्तंषु संमोहो ह्यनुकंपार्थमेव च । ब्राह्मी लक्ष्म्या स्वयं जुष्टा या साप्रतिमशालिनी
verses.transliteration: yasya bhaktaṃṣu saṃmoho hyanukaṃpārthameva ca / brāhmī lakṣmyā svayaṃ juṣṭā yā sāpratimaśālinī
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्यज्योत्स्नेव चन्द्रस्य विन्यस्ता विश्वरूपिणः । विभूतिर्भ्राजते ऽत्यर्थं देवदेवस्य वेश्मनि
verses.transliteration: vyāpyajyotsneva candrasya vinyastā viśvarūpiṇaḥ / vibhūtirbhrājate 'tyarthaṃ devadevasya veśmani
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: महादेवस्य तुल्यानां रुद्राणां तु महात्मनाम् । तत्सर्वं निखिलेनेदं वक्त्रादमृतनिस्रवः
verses.transliteration: mahādevasya tulyānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ tu mahātmanām / tatsarvaṃ nikhilenedaṃ vaktrādamṛtanisravaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: आपीतं खलु शर्वस्य भक्त्यास्माभिस्तु सुव्रत । नास्ति किञ्चिदविज्ञेय मन्यच्चैवानुगामिनः । प्रश्नं देववरप्राण यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: āpītaṃ khalu śarvasya bhaktyāsmābhistu suvrata / nāsti kiñcidavijñeya manyaccaivānugāminaḥ / praśnaṃ devavaraprāṇa yathāvadvaktumarhasi
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच स खलूवाच भगवान्किं भूयो वर्त्तयाम्यहम् । यन्मया चैव वक्तव्यं तद्वदिष्यामि सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca sa khalūvāca bhagavānkiṃ bhūyo varttayāmyaham / yanmayā caiva vaktavyaṃ tadvadiṣyāmi suvratāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः आदित्याः परिपार्श्वे ये सिंहा वै क्रोधविक्रमाः । वैश्वानरा भूतगण व्याघ्रास्चैवानुगामिनः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ādityāḥ paripārśve ye siṃhā vai krodhavikramāḥ / vaiśvānarā bhūtagaṇa vyāghrāscaivānugāminaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: आभुतसंप्लवे घोरे सर्वप्राणिभृतां क्षये । किमावस्था भवन्त्येते तन्नो ब्रूहि यथार्थवत्
verses.transliteration: ābhutasaṃplave ghore sarvaprāṇibhṛtāṃ kṣaye / kimāvasthā bhavantyete tanno brūhi yathārthavat
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञायेश्वरसद्भावमव्यक्तं प्रभवं तथा । वायुरुवाच यत्र पूर्वं गतास्ते तु कुमारा ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: vijñāyeśvarasadbhāvamavyaktaṃ prabhavaṃ tathā / vāyuruvāca yatra pūrvaṃ gatāste tu kumārā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सनन्दनश्च सनकस्तृतीयश्च सनातनः । वोढुश्च कपिलस्तेषामासुरिश्च महायशाः
verses.transliteration: sanandanaśca sanakastṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ / voḍhuśca kapilasteṣāmāsuriśca mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: मुनिः पञ्जशिखश्चैव ये चान्ये ऽप्येवमादयः । ततः काले व्यतिक्रान्ते कल्पानां पर्यये गते
verses.transliteration: muniḥ pañjaśikhaścaiva ye cānye 'pyevamādayaḥ / tataḥ kāle vyatikrānte kalpānāṃ paryaye gate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतविनाशान्ते प्रलये प्रत्युपस्थिते । अनेकरुद्रकोट्यस्तु या प्रसन्ना महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: mahābhūtavināśānte pralaye pratyupasthite / anekarudrakoṭyastu yā prasannā maheśvarīm
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: शब्दादीन्विषयान्भोगान्संत्यज्याष्टविधाश्रयात् । प्रविश्य सर्वभूतानि ज्ञानयुक्तेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: śabdādīnviṣayānbhogānsaṃtyajyāṣṭavidhāśrayāt / praviśya sarvabhūtāni jñānayuktena tejasā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विहाय पदमव्यग्रं भूतानाम नुकंपया । तत्र यान्ति महात्मानः परमाणुं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vihāya padamavyagraṃ bhūtānāma nukaṃpayā / tatra yānti mahātmānaḥ paramāṇuṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तरन्ति सुमहावर्त्तां जन्ममृत्यूदकां नदीम् । ततः पश्यन्त्यपर्वाणं परं ब्रह्माणामेव च
verses.transliteration: taranti sumahāvarttāṃ janmamṛtyūdakāṃ nadīm / tataḥ paśyantyaparvāṇaṃ paraṃ brahmāṇāmeva ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: देव्या वै सहिताः सप्त या देव्यः परिकीर्त्तिताः । यत्तत्सहस्रं सिंहानामादित्यानां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: devyā vai sahitāḥ sapta yā devyaḥ parikīrttitāḥ / yattatsahasraṃ siṃhānāmādityānāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरा भूतगणा व्याघ्राश्चैवानुगामिनः । आवेश्यात्मनि तान्सर्वान् संख्यायोग्यभवांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānarā bhūtagaṇā vyāghrāścaivānugāminaḥ / āveśyātmani tānsarvān saṃkhyāyogyabhavāṃstathā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: लोकान्सप्त इमान्भूयो महाभूतानि पञ्च च । विष्णुना सह संयुक्तः करोति विकरोति च
verses.transliteration: lokānsapta imānbhūyo mahābhūtāni pañca ca / viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ karoti vikaroti ca
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: स रुद्रो यः साममयस्तथैव च यजुर्मयः । स एष ओतः प्रोतश्च बहिरन्तश्च निश्चयात्
verses.transliteration: sa rudro yaḥ sāmamayastathaiva ca yajurmayaḥ / sa eṣa otaḥ protaśca bahirantaśca niścayāt
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एको हि भगवान्नाथः प्रभवश्चान्तकृद्द्विजाः । ततस्ते ऋषयः सर्वे दिवाकरसमप्रभाः
verses.transliteration: eko hi bhagavānnāthaḥ prabhavaścāntakṛddvijāḥ / tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve divākarasamaprabhāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सुसत्यं श्रवसः सम्यगारोप्याग्निं तथात्मनि । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: susatyaṃ śravasaḥ samyagāropyāgniṃ tathātmani / karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāntarātmanā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
