verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यमनसो भूत्वा प्रपद्यन्ते महेश्वरम् । व्रतोपवासनिरताः सर्वभूतदयापराः
verses.transliteration: ananyamanaso bhūtvā prapadyante maheśvaram / vratopavāsaniratāḥ sarvabhūtadayāparāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: योगं त्वनुयमं दिव्यं प्राप्तन्तैश्छिन्नसंशयैः । प्रपद्य परया भक्त्याज्ञानयुक्तेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: yogaṃ tvanuyamaṃ divyaṃ prāptantaiśchinnasaṃśayaiḥ / prapadya parayā bhaktyājñānayuktena tejasā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तैर्लब्धं रुद्रसालोक्यं शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् । यः पठेत्तपसा युक्तो वायुप्रोक्तामिमां श्रुतिम्
verses.transliteration: tairlabdhaṃ rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam / yaḥ paṭhettapasā yukto vāyuproktāmimāṃ śrutim
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वापिवैश्यो वा स्वक्रियापरः । लभते रुद्रलोकं वै कारणं लोककारणम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpivaiśyo vā svakriyāparaḥ / labhate rudralokaṃ vai kāraṇaṃ lokakāraṇam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विनिवृत्ते तदा सर्गे प्रकृत्या वस्थितेन वै । तदात्यन्तपरोक्षत्वाददृष्टत्वाच्च कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: vinivṛtte tadā sarge prakṛtyā vasthitena vai / tadātyantaparokṣatvādadṛṣṭatvācca kasyacit
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अनाख्यानादबोध्यत्वादज्ञानाज्ज्ञानिनामपि । आगतागतिकत्वाच्च ग्रहणं तन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: anākhyānādabodhyatvādajñānājjñānināmapi / āgatāgatikatvācca grahaṇaṃ tanna vidyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: भावग्राह्यानुमानाच्च चिन्तयित्वेदमुच्यते । स्थिते तु कारणे तस्मिन्नित्ये सदसदात्मके
verses.transliteration: bhāvagrāhyānumānācca cintayitvedamucyate / sthite tu kāraṇe tasminnitye sadasadātmake
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्देश्ये प्रवृत्तिर्वै स्वात्मिकाकारणेन तु । एवं सप्तद्विरभ्यस्ताः क्रमात्प्रकृतयस्तु वै
verses.transliteration: anirdeśye pravṛttirvai svātmikākāraṇena tu / evaṃ saptadvirabhyastāḥ kramātprakṛtayastu vai
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्याहारे तदा सर्गे प्रविशन्ति परस्परम् । येनेदमावृतं सर्वमण्डमप्सु प्रलीयते
verses.transliteration: pratyāhāre tadā sarge praviśanti parasparam / yenedamāvṛtaṃ sarvamaṇḍamapsu pralīyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रान्तं सप्तलोकं सपर्वतम् । उदकावरणं यच्च ज्योतिष्यालीयते तु यत्
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpasamudrāntaṃ saptalokaṃ saparvatam / udakāvaraṇaṃ yacca jyotiṣyālīyate tu yat
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: यत्तेजसं चावरणं मारुतो ग्रसते नु यत् । यद्वायव्यं चावरणमाकाशग्रसते तु तत्
verses.transliteration: yattejasaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ māruto grasate nu yat / yadvāyavyaṃ cāvaraṇamākāśagrasate tu tat
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: आकाशावरणं यच्च भूतादिर्ग्रसते तु तत् । भूतादिं ग्रसते चापि महान्वै बुद्धिलक्षमः
verses.transliteration: ākāśāvaraṇaṃ yacca bhūtādirgrasate tu tat / bhūtādiṃ grasate cāpi mahānvai buddhilakṣamaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: महान्तं ग्रसते ऽव्यक्तं गुणसाम्यं ततः परम् । एतौ संहारविस्तारौ ब्रह्मा व्यक्तौ ततः पुनः
verses.transliteration: mahāntaṃ grasate 'vyaktaṃ guṇasāmyaṃ tataḥ param / etau saṃhāravistārau brahmā vyaktau tataḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सृजते ग्रसते चैव विकारात्सर्गसंयमे । संसिद्धकार्यकरणाः संसिद्धा ज्ञानिनस्तु ये
verses.transliteration: sṛjate grasate caiva vikārātsargasaṃyame / saṃsiddhakāryakaraṇāḥ saṃsiddhā jñāninastu ye
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा जवं जवीभावे स्थाने स्वेषु प्रसंयमात् । प्रत्याहारे ऽधियुज्यन्ते क्षेत्रज्ञाः करणैः पुनः
verses.transliteration: gatvā javaṃ javībhāve sthāne sveṣu prasaṃyamāt / pratyāhāre 'dhiyujyante kṣetrajñāḥ karaṇaiḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं क्षेत्रमित्याहुर्ब्रह्मा क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते । साधर्म्यवैधर्म्यकृतः संयोगो नादिमास्तयोः
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ kṣetramityāhurbrahmā kṣetrajña ucyate / sādharmyavaidharmyakṛtaḥ saṃyogo nādimāstayoḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्गेषु विज्ञेयः क्षेत्रज्ञेष्विह ब्राह्मणाः । ब्रह्मविच्चैव विज्ञेयः क्षेत्रज्ञानात्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sargeṣu vijñeyaḥ kṣetrajñeṣviha brāhmaṇāḥ / brahmaviccaiva vijñeyaḥ kṣetrajñānātpṛthak
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: विषयाविषयत्वं च क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोः स्मृतम् । ब्रह्मा त्वविषयो ज्ञेयो विषयः क्षेत्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: viṣayāviṣayatvaṃ ca kṣetrakṣetrajñayoḥ smṛtam / brahmā tvaviṣayo jñeyo viṣayaḥ kṣetramucyate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञार्थं प्रचक्षते । बहुत्वाच्च शरीराणां शरीरी बहुधा स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñārthaṃ pracakṣate / bahutvācca śarīrāṇāṃ śarīrī bahudhā smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अव्यूहाशङ्कराच्चैव ज्योतिर्यच्च व्यवस्थितम् । यस्मात्प्रतिशरीरं हि सुखदुःखो पलब्धिता
verses.transliteration: avyūhāśaṅkarāccaiva jyotiryacca vyavasthitam / yasmātpratiśarīraṃ hi sukhaduḥkho palabdhitā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पुरुषनानात्वं विज्ञेयं तु विजानता । यदा प्रवर्त्तते चैषां भेदानां चैव संयमः
verses.transliteration: tasmātpuruṣanānātvaṃ vijñeyaṃ tu vijānatā / yadā pravarttate caiṣāṃ bhedānāṃ caiva saṃyamaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावकारिताः सर्वे कालेन महता तदा । निवर्त्तन्ते तदा तस्मिन्स्थितरागाः स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: svabhāvakāritāḥ sarve kālena mahatā tadā / nivarttante tadā tasminsthitarāgāḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सह सायुज्यकैः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिभिः । विनिवृत्तेस्तदा तेषां स्थितेरात्मनिवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: saha sāyujyakaiḥ sarvairbrahmalokanivāsibhiḥ / vinivṛttestadā teṣāṃ sthiterātmanivāsinām
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: तत्कालवासिनां तेषां तत्र वै दोषदर्शिनाम् । उत्पद्यते ऽथ वैराग्यमात्मवाद प्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tatkālavāsināṃ teṣāṃ tatra vai doṣadarśinām / utpadyate 'tha vairāgyamātmavāda praṇāśanam
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: भोज्यभोक्तृत्वनानात्वैस्तेषां तद्भावदर्शिनाम् । पृथग्ज्ञानेन क्षेत्रज्ञास्ततस्ते ब्रह्मलौकिकाः
verses.transliteration: bhojyabhoktṛtvanānātvaisteṣāṃ tadbhāvadarśinām / pṛthagjñānena kṣetrajñāstataste brahmalaukikāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतौ कारणातीताः सर्वे नानाप्रदर्शिनः । स्वात्मन्येवावतिष्ठन्ते प्रशान्तादर्शनात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: prakṛtau kāraṇātītāḥ sarve nānāpradarśinaḥ / svātmanyevāvatiṣṭhante praśāntādarśanātmakāḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धा निरञ्जनाः सर्वे चेतनाचेतनास्तथा । तत्रैव परिनिर्वाणाः स्मृतानागामिनस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: śuddhā nirañjanāḥ sarve cetanācetanāstathā / tatraiva parinirvāṇāḥ smṛtānāgāminastu te
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणत्वाग्निरात्मानः प्रकृत्यन्ते व्यतिक्रमात् । इत्येवं प्राकृतः प्रोक्तः प्रतिसर्गः स्वयंभुवा
verses.transliteration: nirguṇatvāgnirātmānaḥ prakṛtyante vyatikramāt / ityevaṃ prākṛtaḥ proktaḥ pratisargaḥ svayaṃbhuvā
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाचारयुतः प्रतिसर्गं शृणोति यः । स व्रजेच्छिवसालोक्यं भक्तिमान्विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramācārayutaḥ pratisargaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ / sa vrajecchivasālokyaṃ bhaktimānvigatajvaraḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: अमद्यपश्च य शूद्रो भवभक्तो जितेद्रियः । आभूतसंप्लवस्थायी अप्रतीघातलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: amadyapaśca ya śūdro bhavabhakto jitedriyaḥ / ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī apratīghātalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: गाणपत्यं स लभते स्थानं वा सार्वकालिकम् । मद्यपो मद्यपैः सार्द्धं भूतसंघैश्च मोदते
verses.transliteration: gāṇapatyaṃ sa labhate sthānaṃ vā sārvakālikam / madyapo madyapaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiśca modate
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: सेव्यमानो महीपृष्ठे मर्त्यानां वरदो भवः । इति होवाच भगवान्वायुर्वाक्यमिदवरम्
verses.transliteration: sevyamāno mahīpṛṣṭhe martyānāṃ varado bhavaḥ / iti hovāca bhagavānvāyurvākyamidavaram
verses.translation: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.wordMeaning: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being served and resorted to on the Earth, Bhava becomes the bestower of boons to men."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते उत्तरभागे चतुर्थ उपसंहारपादे शिवपुरवर्णनं नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच प्रत्याहारं प्रवक्ष्यामि परस्यान्ते स्वयंभुवः । ब्रह्मणः स्थितिकाले तु क्षीणे तस्मिंस्तदा प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte uttarabhāge caturtha upasaṃhārapāde śivapuravarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca pratyāhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi parasyānte svayaṃbhuvaḥ / brahmaṇaḥ sthitikāle tu kṣīṇe tasmiṃstadā prabhoḥ
verses.translation: I shall explain the process of dissolution at the end of a Para (? i.e. one full day and.night) of the Self-born Lord (Brahma), when the period ofexistence of the Lord lapses.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall explain the process of dissolution at the end of a Para (? i.e. one full day and.night) of the Self-born Lord (Brahma), when the period ofexistence of the Lord lapses.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall explain the process of dissolution at the end of a Para (? i.e. one full day and.night) of the Self-born Lord (Brahma), when the period ofexistence of the Lord lapses.

verses.sanskrit: यथेदं कुरुते व्यक्तं सुसूक्ष्मं विश्वमीश्वरः । अव्यक्तं ग्रसते व्यक्तं प्रत्याहारे च कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: yathedaṃ kurute vyaktaṃ susūkṣmaṃ viśvamīśvaraḥ / avyaktaṃ grasate vyaktaṃ pratyāhāre ca kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: During the process of Pratydhdra (dissolution) the Avyakta ( the unmanifest one) sWallows the Vyakta (the manifest one — the whole Universe) entirely in the same way as Tsvara creates the manifest Universe which is extremely subtle.
verses.wordMeaning: During the process of Pratydhdra (dissolution) the Avyakta ( the unmanifest one) sWallows the Vyakta (the manifest one — the whole Universe) entirely in the same way as Tsvara creates the manifest Universe which is extremely subtle.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the process of Pratydhdra (dissolution) the Avyakta ( the unmanifest one) sWallows the Vyakta (the manifest one — the whole Universe) entirely in the same way as Tsvara creates the manifest Universe which is extremely subtle.

verses.sanskrit: पुरान्तद्व्यणुकाद्यानां संपूर्णे कल्पसंक्षये । उपस्थिते महाघोरे ह्यप्रत्यक्षे तु कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: purāntadvyaṇukādyānāṃ saṃpūrṇe kalpasaṃkṣaye / upasthite mahāghore hyapratyakṣe tu kasyacit
verses.translation: VV. 5-25 describe the process of involution of Tattvas ( Tattva - Prasamyama) after the end of Kalpa. Thus the element Prthvi is swallowed up by water as it (Prthvi) loses its peculiar characteristic viz. smell. The process may be indicated thus:
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 5-25 describe the process of involution of Tattvas ( Tattva - Prasamyama) after the end of Kalpa. Thus the element Prthvi is swallowed up by water as it (Prthvi) loses its peculiar characteristic viz. smell. The process may be indicated thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 5-25 describe the process of involution of Tattvas ( Tattva - Prasamyama) after the end of Kalpa. Thus the element Prthvi is swallowed up by water as it (Prthvi) loses its peculiar characteristic viz. smell. The process may be indicated thus:

verses.sanskrit: अन्ते द्रुमस्य संप्राप्ते पश्चिमास्य मनोस्तदा । अन्ते कलियुगे तस्मिन्क्षीणे संहार उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ante drumasya saṃprāpte paścimāsya manostadā / ante kaliyuge tasminkṣīṇe saṃhāra ucyate
verses.translation: Along with the destruction of Rasatanmdtra (the subtle element of rasa) waters become destroyed. When the Rasa is taken away by the fierce fiery element, waters assume the state of Jyotis (the element called Fire).
verses.wordMeaning: Along with the destruction of Rasatanmdtra (the subtle element of rasa) waters become destroyed. When the Rasa is taken away by the fierce fiery element, waters assume the state of Jyotis (the element called Fire).
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with the destruction of Rasatanmdtra (the subtle element of rasa) waters become destroyed. When the Rasa is taken away by the fierce fiery element, waters assume the state of Jyotis (the element called Fire).

verses.sanskrit: संप्रक्षाले तदा वृ-त्ते प्रत्याहारे ह्युपस्थिते । प्रत्याहारे तदा तस्मिन्भूततन्मात्रसंक्षये
verses.transliteration: saṃprakṣāle tadā vṛ-tte pratyāhāre hyupasthite / pratyāhāre tadā tasminbhūtatanmātrasaṃkṣaye
verses.translation: The auspiciousness and inauspiciousness of men of knowledge devoid of (adherence to) the Organs ofSense — all their merits and sins get merged into Prakrti.
verses.wordMeaning: The auspiciousness and inauspiciousness of men of knowledge devoid of (adherence to) the Organs ofSense — all their merits and sins get merged into Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspiciousness and inauspiciousness of men of knowledge devoid of (adherence to) the Organs ofSense — all their merits and sins get merged into Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: महदादिविकारस्य विशेषान्तस्य संक्षये । स्वभावकारिते तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते प्रतिसंचरे
verses.transliteration: mahadādivikārasya viśeṣāntasya saṃkṣaye / svabhāvakārite tasminpravṛtte pratisaṃcare
verses.translation: VV. 26-96 describe the nature of Gunas.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 26-96 describe the nature of Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 26-96 describe the nature of Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: आपो ग्रसंति वै पूर्वं भूमेर्गन्धात्मकं गुमम् । आत्तगन्धा ततो भूमिः प्रलयत्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: āpo grasaṃti vai pūrvaṃ bhūmergandhātmakaṃ gumam / āttagandhā tato bhūmiḥ pralayatvāya kalpate
verses.translation: In all the worlds, among all living beings, all activities are begun by human beings through their reliance on Avidya. 1 But that should not be pursued by one who possesses knowledge of reality.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the worlds, among all living beings, all activities are begun by human beings through their reliance on Avidya. 1 But that should not be pursued by one who possesses knowledge of reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the worlds, among all living beings, all activities are begun by human beings through their reliance on Avidya. 1 But that should not be pursued by one who possesses knowledge of reality.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणष्टे गन्धतन्मात्रे तोयावस्था धरा भवेत् । आपस्तदा प्रविष्टास्तु वेगवत्यो महास्वनाः
verses.transliteration: praṇaṣṭe gandhatanmātre toyāvasthā dharā bhavet / āpastadā praviṣṭāstu vegavatyo mahāsvanāḥ
verses.translation: These three courses of expedients are remembered as inauspicious and sinful by nature. When overwhelmed with Tamas, the creature does not get at the true state of affairs.
verses.wordMeaning: These three courses of expedients are remembered as inauspicious and sinful by nature. When overwhelmed with Tamas, the creature does not get at the true state of affairs.
verses.commentary: Sense: These three courses of expedients are remembered as inauspicious and sinful by nature. When overwhelmed with Tamas, the creature does not get at the true state of affairs.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमापूरयित्वेदं तिष्ठन्ति विचरन्ति च । अपामपि गणो यस्तु ज्योतिःष्वालीयते रसः
verses.transliteration: sarvamāpūrayitvedaṃ tiṣṭhanti vicaranti ca / apāmapi gaṇo yastu jyotiḥṣvālīyate rasaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 35-53 describe the nature of Ignorance (Ajhana). It causes three types of bondages (VV. 37-38), creates different defects such as, Raga (Attachment), Dvesa (Hatred in the mind (VV. 39-46) and leads to hell and birth in lower species.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 35-53 describe the nature of Ignorance (Ajhana). It causes three types of bondages (VV. 37-38), creates different defects such as, Raga (Attachment), Dvesa (Hatred in the mind (VV. 39-46) and leads to hell and birth in lower species.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 35-53 describe the nature of Ignorance (Ajhana). It causes three types of bondages (VV. 37-38), creates different defects such as, Raga (Attachment), Dvesa (Hatred in the mind (VV. 39-46) and leads to hell and birth in lower species.

verses.sanskrit: नश्यन्त्यापस्तदा तत्र रसतन्मात्रसंक्षयात् । तीव्रतेजोहृतरसाज्योतिष्ट्वं प्राप्नुवन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: naśyantyāpastadā tatra rasatanmātrasaṃkṣayāt / tīvratejohṛtarasājyotiṣṭvaṃ prāpnuvantyuta
verses.translation: Through perfect knowledge, one becomes ready to renounce everything. Through renunciation and sacrifice the intellect becomes detached. Through detachment, one becomes pure. Having become pure one is liberated through Sattva quality.
verses.wordMeaning: Through perfect knowledge, one becomes ready to renounce everything. Through renunciation and sacrifice the intellect becomes detached. Through detachment, one becomes pure. Having become pure one is liberated through Sattva quality.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through perfect knowledge, one becomes ready to renounce everything. Through renunciation and sacrifice the intellect becomes detached. Through detachment, one becomes pure. Having become pure one is liberated through Sattva quality.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रस्ते च सलिले तेजः सर्वतोमुखमीक्षते । अथाग्निः सर्वतो व्याप्त आदत्ते तज्जलं तदा
verses.transliteration: graste ca salile tejaḥ sarvatomukhamīkṣate / athāgniḥ sarvato vyāpta ādatte tajjalaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Henceforth, 1 shall recount Rdga (attachment) that destroys living beings. In regard to one who has not controlled himself, the contact with the sensual objects brings about intense attachment.
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, 1 shall recount Rdga (attachment) that destroys living beings. In regard to one who has not controlled himself, the contact with the sensual objects brings about intense attachment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, 1 shall recount Rdga (attachment) that destroys living beings. In regard to one who has not controlled himself, the contact with the sensual objects brings about intense attachment.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमापूर्यते ऽर्चिर्भिस्तदा जगदिदं शनैः । अर्चिर्भिः संतते तस्मिंस्तर्यगूर्ध्वमधस्ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvamāpūryate 'rcirbhistadā jagadidaṃ śanaiḥ / arcirbhiḥ saṃtate tasmiṃstaryagūrdhvamadhastataḥ
verses.translation: Due to the chilliness, the virulently excited Vdyu (Life-breath) pierces the Centres of Pranas (vital airs) and cuts off vulnerable parts of the body and rises up.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the chilliness, the virulently excited Vdyu (Life-breath) pierces the Centres of Pranas (vital airs) and cuts off vulnerable parts of the body and rises up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the chilliness, the virulently excited Vdyu (Life-breath) pierces the Centres of Pranas (vital airs) and cuts off vulnerable parts of the body and rises up.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिषो ऽपि गुणं रूपं वायुरत्ति प्रकाशकम् । प्रलीयते तदा तस्मिन्दीपार्चिरिव मारुते
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣo 'pi guṇaṃ rūpaṃ vāyuratti prakāśakam / pralīyate tadā tasmindīpārciriva mārute
verses.translation: VV. 61-72 teach how to cultivate Vairagya (non-attachment).
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 61-72 teach how to cultivate Vairagya (non-attachment).
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 61-72 teach how to cultivate Vairagya (non-attachment).

verses.sanskrit: प्रनष्टे रूपतन्मात्रे हृतरूपो विभावसुः । उपशाम्यति तेजो हिवायुराधूयते महान्
verses.transliteration: pranaṣṭe rūpatanmātre hṛtarūpo vibhāvasuḥ / upaśāmyati tejo hivāyurādhūyate mahān
verses.translation: (Defective) Just as, in this world, during a dream it is observed that the individual is being led here and there. It is gratifying to one who is subjected to it but actually there no other leader*.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) Just as, in this world, during a dream it is observed that the individual is being led here and there. It is gratifying to one who is subjected to it but actually there no other leader*.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) Just as, in this world, during a dream it is observed that the individual is being led here and there. It is gratifying to one who is subjected to it but actually there no other leader*.

verses.sanskrit: निरालोके तदा लोके वायुभूते च तेजसि । ततस्तु मूलमासाद्य वायुः संबन्धमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: nirāloke tadā loke vāyubhūte ca tejasi / tatastu mūlamāsādya vāyuḥ saṃbandhamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: It should be known that these Prakrtis are the eight causes mentioned before in due order. They are those beginning with Avyakta the Unmanifest one) and ending with Bhutas (Elements) evolved out of Prakrti.
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that these Prakrtis are the eight causes mentioned before in due order. They are those beginning with Avyakta the Unmanifest one) and ending with Bhutas (Elements) evolved out of Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that these Prakrtis are the eight causes mentioned before in due order. They are those beginning with Avyakta the Unmanifest one) and ending with Bhutas (Elements) evolved out of Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वञ्चाधश्च तिर्यक्च दोधवीति दिशो दश । वायोरपि गुणं स्पर्शमाकाशं ग्रसते च तत्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvañcādhaśca tiryakca dodhavīti diśo daśa / vāyorapi guṇaṃ sparśamākāśaṃ grasate ca tat
verses.translation: The eight abodes of gods are those beginning with that ofBrahma and ending with Pisaca. The supernatural powers beginning with Anima (State ofbeing very minute) are the causes characterised as eight.
verses.wordMeaning: The eight abodes of gods are those beginning with that ofBrahma and ending with Pisaca. The supernatural powers beginning with Anima (State ofbeing very minute) are the causes characterised as eight.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight abodes of gods are those beginning with that ofBrahma and ending with Pisaca. The supernatural powers beginning with Anima (State ofbeing very minute) are the causes characterised as eight.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशाम्यति तदा वायुः खन्तु तिष्ठत्यनावृतम् । अरूपमरसस्पर्शमगन्धं न च मूर्तिमत्
verses.transliteration: praśāmyati tadā vāyuḥ khantu tiṣṭhatyanāvṛtam / arūpamarasasparśamagandhaṃ na ca mūrtimat
verses.translation: (These divine powers called Animd etc.) are seen as the cause in the unobstructed objects of the sense characterised by Sound etc. These eight forms evolved by Prakrti become attached to Kselrajfias (individual souls) in due order in the forms of Gunas.'
verses.wordMeaning: (These divine powers called Animd etc.) are seen as the cause in the unobstructed objects of the sense characterised by Sound etc. These eight forms evolved by Prakrti become attached to Kselrajfias (individual souls) in due order in the forms of Gunas.'
verses.commentary: Sense: (These divine powers called Animd etc.) are seen as the cause in the unobstructed objects of the sense characterised by Sound etc. These eight forms evolved by Prakrti become attached to Kselrajfias (individual souls) in due order in the forms of Gunas.'

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमापूरयच्छब्दैः सुमहत्तत्प्रकाशते । तस्मिंल्लीने तदा शिष्टमाकाशं शब्दलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sarvamāpūrayacchabdaiḥ sumahattatprakāśate / tasmiṃllīne tadā śiṣṭamākāśaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: When the truth is realized, the principle that is lost comes out clearly. But in the different bodies that have completely ceased to exist, the Karana (i.e. Individual Soul) differs from Avyakta and Jndnin (one with knowledge). One who is completely liberated from the body in the form of Gunas as well as Prana etc. does not take up another body, just as the sprout (never comes out) when the seed is burnt.
verses.wordMeaning: When the truth is realized, the principle that is lost comes out clearly. But in the different bodies that have completely ceased to exist, the Karana (i.e. Individual Soul) differs from Avyakta and Jndnin (one with knowledge).…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the truth is realized, the principle that is lost comes out clearly. But in the different bodies that have completely ceased to exist, the Karana (i.e. Individual Soul) differs from Avyakta and Jndnin (one with knowledge).…

verses.sanskrit: शब्दमात्रं तदाकाशं सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति । तत्र शब्दं गुमं तस्य भूतदिर्ग्रसते पुनः
verses.transliteration: śabdamātraṃ tadākāśaṃ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati / tatra śabdaṃ gumaṃ tasya bhūtadirgrasate punaḥ
verses.translation: W. 76-95 give a desultory treatment of Ksetra and Ksetrajna. In the course of discussion, various terms e.g. Avyakta, Karana, Aksara Purusa, Sadbhava, Asadbhava and others are explained.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 76-95 give a desultory treatment of Ksetra and Ksetrajna. In the course of discussion, various terms e.g. Avyakta, Karana, Aksara Purusa, Sadbhava, Asadbhava and others are explained.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 76-95 give a desultory treatment of Ksetra and Ksetrajna. In the course of discussion, various terms e.g. Avyakta, Karana, Aksara Purusa, Sadbhava, Asadbhava and others are explained.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेन्द्रियेषु युगपद्भूतादौ संस्थितेषु वै । अभिमानात्मको ह्येष भूतादिस्तामसः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bhūtendriyeṣu yugapadbhūtādau saṃsthiteṣu vai / abhimānātmako hyeṣa bhūtādistāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: (?) Ksetrajna is remembered. Hence it is mentioned as Ksetra by those who know it. Ksetra is seen to be without intelligence, but Ksetrjha is always endowed with consciousness and intelligence.
verses.wordMeaning: (?) Ksetrajna is remembered. Hence it is mentioned as Ksetra by those who know it. Ksetra is seen to be without intelligence, but Ksetrjha is always endowed with consciousness and intelligence.
verses.commentary: Sense: (?) Ksetrajna is remembered. Hence it is mentioned as Ksetra by those who know it. Ksetra is seen to be without intelligence, but Ksetrjha is always endowed with consciousness and intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: भूतादिर्ग्रसते चापि महान्वै बुद्धिलक्षणः । महानात्मा तु विज्ञेयः संकल्पो व्यवसायकः
verses.transliteration: bhūtādirgrasate cāpi mahānvai buddhilakṣaṇaḥ / mahānātmā tu vijñeyaḥ saṃkalpo vyavasāyakaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are conversant with Ksetra, know it as Ksetra because of its impurity, defilement, destruction, Karana (cause) Ksatatrdna (protection form wounds or loss), Bhojyatva (worthy of being enjoyed), Visayatva (being the object of Senses).
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are conversant with Ksetra, know it as Ksetra because of its impurity, defilement, destruction, Karana (cause) Ksatatrdna (protection form wounds or loss), Bhojyatva (worthy of being enjoyed), Visayatva (being the object of Senses).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are conversant with Ksetra, know it as Ksetra because of its impurity, defilement, destruction, Karana (cause) Ksatatrdna (protection form wounds or loss), Bhojyatva (worthy of being enjoyed), Visayatva (being the object of Senses).

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिर्मनश्च लिङ्गं च महानक्षर एव च । पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैस्तमाहुस्तत्त्व चिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: buddhirmanaśca liṅgaṃ ca mahānakṣara eva ca / paryāyavācakaiḥ śabdaistamāhustattva cintakāḥ
verses.translation: All the objects beginning with Mahat and ending with Visesa, possess variety of form and they are characterised by Vikdra (change, evolute). Hencetheyare VHaksana (peculiar). Hence, verily, the Aksara (imperishable) approaches the Ksara (perishable).
verses.wordMeaning: All the objects beginning with Mahat and ending with Visesa, possess variety of form and they are characterised by Vikdra (change, evolute). Hencetheyare VHaksana (peculiar). Hence, verily, the Aksara (imperishable) approaches the Ksara (perishable).
verses.commentary: Sense: All the objects beginning with Mahat and ending with Visesa, possess variety of form and they are characterised by Vikdra (change, evolute). Hencetheyare VHaksana (peculiar). Hence, verily, the Aksara (imperishable) approaches the Ksara (perishable).

verses.sanskrit: संप्रलीनेषु भूतेषु गुणसाम्ये ततो महान् । लीयन्ते गुणसाम्यं तु स्वात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration: saṃpralīneṣu bhūteṣu guṇasāmye tato mahān / līyante guṇasāmyaṃ tu svātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate
verses.translation: Sukha (happiness) and Duhkha (sorrow) are called Bhojya (that which can be enjoyed) because of Ahambhava (Egotism). It is Visaya(ob')Qci) since it is Acetana (non-sent ient). That which has the opposite qualities is remembered as
verses.wordMeaning: Sukha (happiness) and Duhkha (sorrow) are called Bhojya (that which can be enjoyed) because of Ahambhava (Egotism). It is Visaya(ob')Qci) since it is Acetana (non-sent ient). That which has the opposite qualities is remembered as
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukha (happiness) and Duhkha (sorrow) are called Bhojya (that which can be enjoyed) because of Ahambhava (Egotism). It is Visaya(ob')Qci) since it is Acetana (non-sent ient). That which has the opposite qualities is remembered as

verses.sanskrit: लीयन्ते सर्वभूतानां कारणानि प्रसंगमे । इत्येष संयमश्चैव तत्त्वानां कारणैः सह
verses.transliteration: līyante sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇāni prasaṃgame / ityeṣa saṃyamaścaiva tattvānāṃ kāraṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: * (?) If it is said by an ignorant person like this —
verses.wordMeaning: * (?) If it is said by an ignorant person like this —
verses.commentary: Sense: * (?) If it is said by an ignorant person like this —

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वप्रसंयमो ह्येष स्मृतो ह्यावर्तको द्विजाः । धर्माधर्मौं तपो ज्ञानं शुभं सत्यानृते तथा
verses.transliteration: tattvaprasaṃyamo hyeṣa smṛto hyāvartako dvijāḥ / dharmādharmauṃ tapo jñānaṃ śubhaṃ satyānṛte tathā
verses.translation: The seer in the nature and capacity of the cause restrains himself by means of his own self. He remains within his own self, in the cause, in the Prakrti.
verses.wordMeaning: The seer in the nature and capacity of the cause restrains himself by means of his own self. He remains within his own self, in the cause, in the Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seer in the nature and capacity of the cause restrains himself by means of his own self. He remains within his own self, in the cause, in the Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वभावो ह्यधोभावः सुखदुःखे प्रियाप्रिये । सर्वमेतत्प्रपञ्चस्थं गुणमात्रात्मकं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvabhāvo hyadhobhāvaḥ sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye / sarvametatprapañcasthaṃ guṇamātrātmakaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: At its end, it consciously resorts to the Adhiffkana (Sub-stratum?). Their mutual contact is known as being brought about by Sddharmya and Vaidharmya (similarity and dissimilarity. The Sarhyoga (contact) of the great Purusa is proclaimed as beginningless.
verses.wordMeaning: At its end, it consciously resorts to the Adhiffkana (Sub-stratum?). Their mutual contact is known as being brought about by Sddharmya and Vaidharmya (similarity and dissimilarity. The Sarhyoga (contact) of the great Purusa is proclaimed as beginningless.
verses.commentary: Sense: At its end, it consciously resorts to the Adhiffkana (Sub-stratum?). Their mutual contact is known as being brought about by Sddharmya and Vaidharmya (similarity and dissimilarity. The Sarhyoga (contact) of the great Purusa is proclaimed as beginningless.

verses.sanskrit: निरिन्द्रियाणां च तदा ज्ञानिनां यच्छुभाशुभम् । प्रकृत्यां चैव तत्सर्वं पुण्यं पापं प्रतिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: nirindriyāṇāṃ ca tadā jñānināṃ yacchubhāśubham / prakṛtyāṃ caiva tatsarvaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ pratiṣṭhati
verses.translation: As long as the period of Primary and Secondary creations lasts, the Universe continues to exist. At the outset, it restrains (?) everything and functions consciously for the sake of Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: As long as the period of Primary and Secondary creations lasts, the Universe continues to exist. At the outset, it restrains (?) everything and functions consciously for the sake of Purusa.

verses.transliteration: eṣā nisargapratisargapūrvā prādhānikī ceśvarakāritā vā / anādyanantā hyabhimānapūrvakaṃ vitrāsayantī jagadabhyupaiti

verses.transliteration: ityeṣa pratisargo vastrividaḥ kīrttito mayā / vistareṇānupūrvyāca bhūyaḥ kiṃ varttayāmyaham

verses.sanskrit: इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते उत्तरभागे चतुर्थ उपसंहारपादे प्रतिसर्गो नाम तृतीयो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः श्रुतं सुमहदाख्यानं भवता परिकीर्त्तितम् । प्रजानां मनुभिः सार्द्धं देवानामृषिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte uttarabhāge caturtha upasaṃhārapāde pratisargo nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ śrutaṃ sumahadākhyānaṃ bhavatā parikīrttitam / prajānāṃ manubhiḥ sārddhaṃ devānāmṛṣibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: After duly honouring and propitiating Suta, the great sages engaged in Sattra asked him again about the process of creative function: —

verses.transliteration: atyadbhutāni karmāṇi vividhā dharmaniścayāḥ / vicitrāśca kathāyogā janma cāgryamanuttamam
verses.translation: In the previous two chapters the three typej of dissolutions of the world are described rather desultorily in a Puranic way. The description of dissolution forms an important characteristic (Lakfana) of a Purana. Now the author explains how the creation of universe takes place after the world-destruction.

verses.transliteration: tatkathyamānamasmākaṃ bhavatā ślakṣṇayā girā / manaḥ karṇasukhaṃ saute prīṇātyamṛtasannibham
verses.translation: The speech of the sages shows that they have heard practically all topics contained in the Purana. They have duly honoured him probably in a concluding ceremony. But they w'ish to hear one point viz how the world is re-created after destruction.

verses.transliteration: evamārādhya te sūtaṃ satkṛtya ca maharṣayaḥ / papracchuḥ sattriṇaḥ sarve punaḥ sargapravarttanam
verses.translation: The Guna (i.e. three Gunas taken collectively as one in combination with the Vikaras (evolutes) remains in the equilibrium. Pradhana stands by in a state wherein it has the same Dharmas or attributes.

verses.sanskrit: कथं सुत महाप्राज्ञ पुनः सर्गः प्रपत्स्यते । बन्धेषु संप्रलीनेषु गुणसाम्ये तमोमये
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ suta mahāprājña punaḥ sargaḥ prapatsyate / bandheṣu saṃpralīneṣu guṇasāmye tamomaye
verses.translation: All the activity ofthe Pradhana takes effect through Buddhi (the principle Mahat). The Ksetrajfia presides over those Gunas without Buddhi in between.
verses.wordMeaning: All the activity ofthe Pradhana takes effect through Buddhi (the principle Mahat). The Ksetrajfia presides over those Gunas without Buddhi in between.

verses.transliteration: vikāreṣvavisṛṣṭeṣu hyavyakte cātmani sthite / apravṛtte brahmaṇā tu sahasā yojyagaistadā
verses.translation: VV. 16-33 describe how the world evolves through the disequili- brium of Gunas and how this original balance of Gunas (Gupa-samya) is disturbed.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 16-33 describe how the world evolves through the disequili- brium of Gunas and how this original balance of Gunas (Gupa-samya) is disturbed.

verses.transliteration: kathaṃ prapatsyate sargastannaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām / evamuktastataḥ sūtastadāsau lomaharṣaṇaḥ

verses.transliteration: vyākhyātumupacakrāma punaḥ sargapravarttanam / atra vo varttayiṣyāmi yathā sargaḥ prapatsyate
verses.translation: By means of medicines named Gunas, a man. becomes subdued by Rajas at the time of activity. He attains the state of Mahat, Bhutddi, Visesa and the sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववत्स तु विज्ञेयः समासात्तन्निबोधत । दृष्टेनैवानुमेयं च तर्कं वक्ष्यामि युक्तितः
verses.transliteration: pūrvavatsa tu vijñeyaḥ samāsāttannibodhata / dṛṣṭenaivānumeyaṃ ca tarkaṃ vakṣyāmi yuktitaḥ
verses.translation: People have recourse to the water** in the middle of Ksetra (field), entirely at the beginning and at the end***(?) Abhimdnins (those who regard objects as referring to their own selves) are born with readily achieved instruments of activity.

verses.transliteration: yasmādvāco nivarttante tvaprāpya manasā saha / avyakta vatparokṣatvādgahanaṃ taddurāsadam
verses.translation: Dharma and Adharma are solely of the nature of •quality ofeach other. They give rise to each other through boons or blessings.

verses.sanskrit: विकारैः प्रतिसंसृष्टो गुणः साम्येन वर्त्तते । प्रधानं पुरुषाणां च साधर्म्येणैव तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: vikāraiḥ pratisaṃsṛṣṭo guṇaḥ sāmyena varttate / pradhānaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca sādharmyeṇaiva tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: For the sake of a similar creation*, the JIva (Indivi- dual Soul) undergoes a change at the beginning of creation. The Gunas (qualities) cling on to him. Hence that appeals to him.
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of a similar creation*, the JIva (Indivi- dual Soul) undergoes a change at the beginning of creation. The Gunas (qualities) cling on to him. Hence that appeals to him.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्मौं प्रलीयेते ह्यव्यक्ते प्राणिनां सदा । सत्त्वमात्रात्मको धर्मो गुणे सत्त्वे प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmauṃ pralīyete hyavyakte prāṇināṃ sadā / sattvamātrātmako dharmo guṇe sattve pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: On being created again and again, the Gunas have recourse to only those activities which they had had in the previous creation.
verses.wordMeaning: On being created again and again, the Gunas have recourse to only those activities which they had had in the previous creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being created again and again, the Gunas have recourse to only those activities which they had had in the previous creation.

verses.transliteration: tamomātrātmako dharmo guṇe tamasi tiṣṭhati / avibhāgena tāvetau guṇasāmye sthitāvubhau
verses.translation: Violent or Non-violent, gentle or cruel, righteous or sinful, true or false— all these have recourse to him on being evolved by him. Hence that appeals to him.
verses.wordMeaning: Violent or Non-violent, gentle or cruel, righteous or sinful, true or false— all these have recourse to him on being evolved by him. Hence that appeals to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Violent or Non-violent, gentle or cruel, righteous or sinful, true or false— all these have recourse to him on being evolved by him. Hence that appeals to him.

verses.commentary: Sense: From that Avyakta y the cause, the eternal one of the nature of Sat and Asat (the Existent and non-existent) Mahesvara is born through Pradhana and Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं तत्र वैपम्यं भजते तु तत् । ततः प्रपत्स्यते व्यक्तं क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ tatra vaipamyaṃ bhajate tu tat / tataḥ prapatsyate vyaktaṃ kṣetrakṣetrajñayordvayoḥ
verses.translation: Having the appellation 'Brahma', he becomes the evolver. He creates the worlds once again of the nature of Abhimana ( Referringall objects to the Self) and Guna (Sattva etc.)
verses.wordMeaning: Having the appellation 'Brahma', he becomes the evolver. He creates the worlds once again of the nature of Abhimana ( Referringall objects to the Self) and Guna (Sattva etc.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Having the appellation 'Brahma', he becomes the evolver. He creates the worlds once again of the nature of Abhimana ( Referringall objects to the Self) and Guna (Sattva etc.)

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं सत्त्वं विकारं जनयिष्यति । महदाद्यं विशेषान्तं चतुर्विंशगुणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ sattvaṃ vikāraṃ janayiṣyati / mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ caturviṃśaguṇātmakam
verses.translation: VV. 34-38 describe the same bringing in Puranic deities Mahesvara, Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 34-38 describe the same bringing in Puranic deities Mahesvara, Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 34-38 describe the same bringing in Puranic deities Mahesvara, Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञस्य प्रधानस्य पुरुषस्य प्रवर्त्स्यतः । आदिदेवः प्रधानस्यानुग्रहाय प्रजक्षते
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñasya pradhānasya puruṣasya pravartsyataḥ / ādidevaḥ pradhānasyānugrahāya prajakṣate
verses.translation: The different living beings are born from the Bhutas (elements). It is thus that the creation begins to function.
verses.wordMeaning: The different living beings are born from the Bhutas (elements). It is thus that the creation begins to function.
verses.commentary: Sense: The different living beings are born from the Bhutas (elements). It is thus that the creation begins to function.

verses.sanskrit: अनाद्यौ वरमुत्पादौ उभौ सूक्ष्मौ तु तौ स्मृतौ । अनादिसंयोगयुतौ सर्वं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च
verses.transliteration: anādyau varamutpādau ubhau sūkṣmau tu tau smṛtau / anādisaṃyogayutau sarvaṃ kṣetrajñameva ca
verses.translation: On hearing thus about the origin of the worlds, their stability and their dissolution, the ascetics of the Naimisa forest had their Avabhrtha (Valedictory bath) in the Sattra and became sanctified. The sages then attained the holy world (the heavens) 1 2 3 *
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing thus about the origin of the worlds, their stability and their dissolution, the ascetics of the Naimisa forest had their Avabhrtha (Valedictory bath) in the Sattra and became sanctified. The sages then attained the holy world (the heavens) 1 2 3 *
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing thus about the origin of the worlds, their stability and their dissolution, the ascetics of the Naimisa forest had their Avabhrtha (Valedictory bath) in the Sattra and became sanctified. The sages then attained the holy world (the heavens) 1 2 3 *

verses.sanskrit: अबुद्धिपूर्वकं युक्तमाशक्तौ तु वरौ तदा । अप्रत्ययममोघं च स्थितावुदकमत्स्यवत्
verses.transliteration: abuddhipūrvakaṃ yuktamāśaktau tu varau tadā / apratyayamamoghaṃ ca sthitāvudakamatsyavat
verses.translation: In the same manner you also worship duly Devatas etc., take the valedictory bath after the sacrifice and become pure. At the end of life be contented (that you have done your duty), abandon bodies, attain the rrieritorions world and rejoice thus.
verses.wordMeaning: In the same manner you also worship duly Devatas etc., take the valedictory bath after the sacrifice and become pure. At the end of life be contented (that you have done your duty), abandon bodies, attain the rrieritorions world and rejoice thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the same manner you also worship duly Devatas etc., take the valedictory bath after the sacrifice and become pure. At the end of life be contented (that you have done your duty), abandon bodies, attain the rrieritorions world and rejoice thus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तपूर्वौं तौ पूर्वं पुनः सर्वं प्रपत्स्यते । अज्ञा गुणैः प्रवर्त्तन्ते रजःसत्त्वतमो ऽभिधैः
verses.transliteration: pravṛttapūrvauṃ tau pūrvaṃ punaḥ sarvaṃ prapatsyate / ajñā guṇaiḥ pravarttante rajaḥsattvatamo 'bhidhaiḥ
verses.translation: In the same manner, O Brahmanas, you too, after performing various Yajnas shall go at the end of your life, O excellent Brahmanas, to Svarga (heaven).
verses.wordMeaning: In the same manner, O Brahmanas, you too, after performing various Yajnas shall go at the end of your life, O excellent Brahmanas, to Svarga (heaven).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the same manner, O Brahmanas, you too, after performing various Yajnas shall go at the end of your life, O excellent Brahmanas, to Svarga (heaven).

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिकाले रजसाभिपन्नो महत्त्वभूतादिविशेषतां च । विशेषतां चेन्द्रियतां च याति गुणावसानौषधिभिर्मनुष्यः
verses.transliteration: pravṛttikāle rajasābhipanno mahattvabhūtādiviśeṣatāṃ ca / viśeṣatāṃ cendriyatāṃ ca yāti guṇāvasānauṣadhibhirmanuṣyaḥ
verses.translation: The sattra (sacrificial session) concluded with the conclusion of the Purana. Just as the Naimisaranya sages took the Valedictory bath { avabhrtha snana) and went to heaven, the later audience of the Purana is exhorted to take such a bath and go to heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: The sattra (sacrificial session) concluded with the conclusion of the Purana. Just as the Naimisaranya sages took the Valedictory bath { avabhrtha snana) and went to heaven, the later audience of the Purana is exhorted to take such a bath and go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sattra (sacrificial session) concluded with the conclusion of the Purana. Just as the Naimisaranya sages took the Valedictory bath { avabhrtha snana) and went to heaven, the later audience of the Purana is exhorted to take such a bath and go to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तस्य ध्यायिनः सन्निमित्तकम् । रजः सत्त्वतमोव्यक्ता विधर्माणः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: satyābhidhyāyinastasya dhyāyinaḥ sannimittakam / rajaḥ sattvatamovyaktā vidharmāṇaḥ parasparam
verses.translation: Review of the main sections of the Purana.
verses.wordMeaning: Review of the main sections of the Purana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Review of the main sections of the Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यन्तं वै प्रवत्स्यन्ते क्षेत्रमज्ञाम्वु सर्वशः । संसिद्धकार्यकरणा उत्पद्यन्ते ऽभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: ādyantaṃ vai pravatsyante kṣetramajñāmvu sarvaśaḥ / saṃsiddhakāryakaraṇā utpadyante 'bhimāninaḥ
verses.translation: Vayu seems to be a member of the audience when the Purana was
verses.wordMeaning: Vayu seems to be a member of the audience when the Purana was
verses.commentary: Sense: Vayu seems to be a member of the audience when the Purana was

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे सत्त्वाः प्रपद्यन्ते ह्यव्यक्तात्पूर्वमेव च । प्राक्सृतौ ये त्वसुवहाः साधकाश्चाप्यसाधकाः
verses.transliteration: sarve sattvāḥ prapadyante hyavyaktātpūrvameva ca / prāksṛtau ye tvasuvahāḥ sādhakāścāpyasādhakāḥ
verses.translation: One who celebrates and proclaims the glory and reputation ofthe renowned noble-souled Prajapatis and lords of the Earths, attains finalemancip at ion.
verses.wordMeaning: One who celebrates and proclaims the glory and reputation ofthe renowned noble-souled Prajapatis and lords of the Earths, attains finalemancip at ion.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who celebrates and proclaims the glory and reputation ofthe renowned noble-souled Prajapatis and lords of the Earths, attains finalemancip at ion.

verses.sanskrit: असंशान्तास्तु ते सर्वे स्थानप्रकरणैः सह । कार्याणि प्रतिपत्स्यन्ते उत्पत्स्यन्ते पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: asaṃśāntāstu te sarve sthānaprakaraṇaiḥ saha / kāryāṇi pratipatsyante utpatsyante punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: This Purana is recounted by Krsna Dvaipaya'na, the expounder of Brahman. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It is meritorious. It is equal in extent and value to the Vedas.
verses.wordMeaning: This Purana is recounted by Krsna Dvaipaya'na, the expounder of Brahman. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It is meritorious. It is equal in extent and value to the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Purana is recounted by Krsna Dvaipaya'na, the expounder of Brahman. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It is meritorious. It is equal in extent and value to the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: गुणमात्रात्मकावेव धर्माधर्मौं परस्परम् । आरप्संते हि चान्योन्यं वरेणानुग्रहेण वा
verses.transliteration: guṇamātrātmakāveva dharmādharmauṃ parasparam / ārapsaṃte hi cānyonyaṃ vareṇānugraheṇa vā
verses.translation: Savitr recounted it to Mrtyu; Mrtyu to Indra; Indra to Vasistha and he recounted it to Sarasvata.
verses.wordMeaning: Savitr recounted it to Mrtyu; Mrtyu to Indra; Indra to Vasistha and he recounted it to Sarasvata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Savitr recounted it to Mrtyu; Mrtyu to Indra; Indra to Vasistha and he recounted it to Sarasvata.

verses.sanskrit: शर्वस्तुल्यप्रसृष्ट्यर्थ सर्गादौ याति विक्रियाम् । गुणास्तं प्रतिधीयन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते
verses.transliteration: śarvastulyaprasṛṣṭyartha sargādau yāti vikriyām / guṇāstaṃ pratidhīyante tasmāttattasya rocate
verses.translation: Sarasvata imparted it toTridhaman; Tridhaman to / _ / _
verses.wordMeaning: Sarasvata imparted it toTridhaman; Tridhaman to / _ / _
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarasvata imparted it toTridhaman; Tridhaman to / _ / _

verses.sanskrit: गुणास्ते यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्ट्यां प्रतिपेदिरे । तान्येव प्रतिपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: guṇāste yāni karmāṇi prāksṛṣṭyāṃ pratipedire / tānyeva pratipadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Antariksa recounted it to Carsin and he to Tray- yaruna. Dhananjaya got it from Trayyaruna. He handed it over to Krtaiijaya.
verses.wordMeaning: Antariksa recounted it to Carsin and he to Tray- yaruna. Dhananjaya got it from Trayyaruna. He handed it over to Krtaiijaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Antariksa recounted it to Carsin and he to Tray- yaruna. Dhananjaya got it from Trayyaruna. He handed it over to Krtaiijaya.

verses.sanskrit: हिंस्राहिंस्रे मृदुकूरे धर्माधर्मावृतानृते । तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते
verses.transliteration: hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdukūre dharmādharmāvṛtānṛte / tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante tasmāttattasya rocate
verses.translation: Trnanjaya got it from Krtanjaya and he imparted it to Bharadvaja. Bharadvaja recounted it to Gautama. He gave it to Niryantara.
verses.wordMeaning: Trnanjaya got it from Krtanjaya and he imparted it to Bharadvaja. Bharadvaja recounted it to Gautama. He gave it to Niryantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trnanjaya got it from Krtanjaya and he imparted it to Bharadvaja. Bharadvaja recounted it to Gautama. He gave it to Niryantara.

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतेषु नानात्वमिन्द्रियार्थेषु मूर्त्तिषु । विप्रयोगश्च भूतानां गुणेभ्यः संप्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārtheṣu mūrttiṣu / viprayogaśca bhūtānāṃ guṇebhyaḥ saṃpravarttate
verses.translation: Niryantara taught it to Vajasrava; he gave it to Somasusma and he handed it over to Trnabindu.
verses.wordMeaning: Niryantara taught it to Vajasrava; he gave it to Somasusma and he handed it over to Trnabindu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Niryantara taught it to Vajasrava; he gave it to Somasusma and he handed it over to Trnabindu.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष वो मया ख्यातः पुनः सर्गः समासतः । समासादेव वक्ष्यामि ब्रह्मणो ऽथ समुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa vo mayā khyātaḥ punaḥ sargaḥ samāsataḥ / samāsādeva vakṣyāmi brahmaṇo 'tha samudbhavam
verses.translation: Trnabindu recounted it to Daksa. Daksa recounted it to Sakti. Parasara who was in the womb heard this from Sakti.
verses.wordMeaning: Trnabindu recounted it to Daksa. Daksa recounted it to Sakti. Parasara who was in the womb heard this from Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trnabindu recounted it to Daksa. Daksa recounted it to Sakti. Parasara who was in the womb heard this from Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तात्कारणात्तस्मान्नित्यात्सदसदात्मकात् । प्रधानपुरुषाभ्यां तु जायते च महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: avyaktātkāraṇāttasmānnityātsadasadātmakāt / pradhānapuruṣābhyāṃ tu jāyate ca maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Jatukarnya heard this from Parasara. Holy lord Dvaipayana heard this from him. O excellent Brahmanas, it has been then acquired by me from Dvaipayana.
verses.wordMeaning: Jatukarnya heard this from Parasara. Holy lord Dvaipayana heard this from him. O excellent Brahmanas, it has been then acquired by me from Dvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jatukarnya heard this from Parasara. Holy lord Dvaipayana heard this from him. O excellent Brahmanas, it has been then acquired by me from Dvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: स पुनः संभावयिता जायते ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः । सृजते स पुनर्लोकानभिमान गुणात्मकान्
verses.transliteration: sa punaḥ saṃbhāvayitā jāyate brahmasaṃjñitaḥ / sṛjate sa punarlokānabhimāna guṇātmakān
verses.translation: This has been narrated to my son of unmeasured intellect. This is the enumerative statement of all Gurus beginning with Brahma. It has been cited.
verses.wordMeaning: This has been narrated to my son of unmeasured intellect. This is the enumerative statement of all Gurus beginning with Brahma. It has been cited.
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been narrated to my son of unmeasured intellect. This is the enumerative statement of all Gurus beginning with Brahma. It has been cited.

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारस्तु महतस्तस्माद्भूतानि चात्मनः । युगपत्संप्रवर्त्तन्ते भूतान्येवेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkārastu mahatastasmādbhūtāni cātmanaḥ / yugapatsaṃpravarttante bhūtānyevendriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: The genealogy of teachers who handed down the Purana unto Sauti, the son of S u ta - This list is longer than the one given in Introduction.
verses.wordMeaning: The genealogy of teachers who handed down the Purana unto Sauti, the son of S u ta - This list is longer than the one given in Introduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The genealogy of teachers who handed down the Purana unto Sauti, the son of S u ta - This list is longer than the one given in Introduction.

verses.sanskrit: भूतभेदाश्च भूतेभ्य इति सर्गः प्रवर्त्तते । विस्तरावयवस्तेषां यथाप्रज्ञं यथाश्रुतम् । कीर्त्त्यतो वो यथापूर्वं तथैवाप्युपधार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtabhedāśca bhūtebhya iti sargaḥ pravarttate / vistarāvayavasteṣāṃ yathāprajñaṃ yathāśrutam / kīrttyato vo yathāpūrvaṃ tathaivāpyupadhāryatām
verses.translation: Usual qualifications of the listener to the Purana. These are -common to all holy scriptures.
verses.wordMeaning: Usual qualifications of the listener to the Purana. These are -common to all holy scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Usual qualifications of the listener to the Purana. These are -common to all holy scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा नैमिषेया स्तदानीं लोकोत्पत्तिं सुस्थितिं चाप्ययं च । तस्मिन्सत्रे ऽवभृथं प्राप्य शुद्धाः पुण्यं लोकमृषयः प्राप्नुवन्ति
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā naimiṣeyā stadānīṃ lokotpattiṃ susthitiṃ cāpyayaṃ ca / tasminsatre 'vabhṛthaṃ prāpya śuddhāḥ puṇyaṃ lokamṛṣayaḥ prāpnuvanti
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: यथा यूयं विधिना देवातादीनिष्ट्वा चैवावभृथं प्राप्य शुद्धाः । त्यक्त्वा देहानायुष्ॐऽते कृतार्थाः पुण्यं लोकं प्राप्य मोदध्वमेवम्
verses.transliteration: yathā yūyaṃ vidhinā devātādīniṣṭvā caivāvabhṛthaṃ prāpya śuddhāḥ / tyaktvā dehānāyuṣoṃ'te kṛtārthāḥ puṇyaṃ lokaṃ prāpya modadhvamevam
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: एते ते नैमिषेया वै दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा च वै तदा । जग्मुश्चावभृथस्नाताः स्वर्गं सर्वे तु सत्रिणः
verses.transliteration: ete te naimiṣeyā vai dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca vai tadā / jagmuścāvabhṛthasnātāḥ svargaṃ sarve tu satriṇaḥ
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रास्तथा यूयमपि इष्टा बहुविधैर्मखैः । आयुष्ॐऽते ततः स्वर्गं गन्तारः स्थ द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: viprāstathā yūyamapi iṣṭā bahuvidhairmakhaiḥ / āyuṣoṃ'te tataḥ svargaṃ gantāraḥ stha dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्रिया प्रथमः पादः कथायास्तु परिग्रहः । अनुषङ्ग उपोद्धात उपसंहार एव च
verses.transliteration: prakriyā prathamaḥ pādaḥ kathāyāstu parigrahaḥ / anuṣaṅga upoddhāta upasaṃhāra eva ca
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव चतुःपादं पुराणं लोकसम्मतम् । उवाच भागवान्सक्षाद्वायुलोकहिते रतः
verses.transliteration: evameva catuḥpādaṃ purāṇaṃ lokasammatam / uvāca bhāgavānsakṣādvāyulokahite rataḥ
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: नैमिषे सत्रमा साद्य मुनिभ्यो मुनिसत्तम । तत्प्रसादं च संसिद्धं भूतोत्पत्तिलयान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: naimiṣe satramā sādya munibhyo munisattama / tatprasādaṃ ca saṃsiddhaṃ bhūtotpattilayānvitam
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: प्राधानिकीमिमां सृष्टिं तथैवेश्वरकारिताम् । सम्यग्विदित्वा मेधावी न मोहमधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: prādhānikīmimāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ tathaiveśvarakāritām / samyagviditvā medhāvī na mohamadhigacchati
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: इदं यो ब्राह्मणो विद्वानितिहासं पुरातनम् । शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेद्वापि तथाध्यापयते ऽपि च
verses.transliteration: idaṃ yo brāhmaṇo vidvānitihāsaṃ purātanam / śṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpi tathādhyāpayate 'pi ca
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानेषु स महेन्द्रस्य मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः । ब्रह्मसायुज्यगो भूत्वा ब्रह्मणा सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: sthāneṣu sa mahendrasya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / brahmasāyujyago bhūtvā brahmaṇā saha modate
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां कीर्तिमतां कीर्तिं प्रजेशानां महात्मनाम् । प्रथयन्पृथिवीशानां ब्रह्मभूयाय गच्छति
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ kīrtimatāṃ kīrtiṃ prajeśānāṃ mahātmanām / prathayanpṛthivīśānāṃ brahmabhūyāya gacchati
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं वेदैश्च संमितम् । कृष्णद्वैपायनेनोक्तं पुराण ब्रह्मवादिना
verses.transliteration: dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiśca saṃmitam / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanenoktaṃ purāṇa brahmavādinā
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेश्वराणां च यः कीर्तिं प्रथयेदिमाम् । देवतानामृषीणां च भूरिद्रविमतेजसाम्
verses.transliteration: manvantareśvarāṇāṃ ca yaḥ kīrtiṃ prathayedimām / devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca bhūridravimatejasām
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: स सर्वैर्मुच्यते पापैः पुण्यं च महदाप्नुयात् । यश्चेदं श्रावयेद्विद्वान्सदा पर्वणि पर्वणि
verses.transliteration: sa sarvairmucyate pāpaiḥ puṇyaṃ ca mahadāpnuyāt / yaścedaṃ śrāvayedvidvānsadā parvaṇi parvaṇi
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: धूतपाप्मा जितस्वर्गो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते । यश्चेदं श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे ब्राह्मणान् पादमन्ततः
verses.transliteration: dhūtapāpmā jitasvargo brahmabhūyāya kalpate / yaścedaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe brāhmaṇān pādamantataḥ
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षेयं सर्वकामीयं पितॄंस्तच्छोपतिष्ठते । यस्मात्पुरा ह्यणन्तीदं पुराणं तेन चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: akṣeyaṃ sarvakāmīyaṃ pitṝṃstacchopatiṣṭhate / yasmātpurā hyaṇantīdaṃ purāṇaṃ tena cocyate
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । तथैव त्रिषु वर्णेषु ये मनुष्या अधीयते
verses.transliteration: niruktamasya yo veda sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / tathaiva triṣu varṇeṣu ye manuṣyā adhīyate
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासमिमं श्रुत्वा धर्माय विदधे मतिम् । यावन्त्यस्य शरीरेषु रोमकूपानि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: itihāsamimaṃ śrutvā dharmāya vidadhe matim / yāvantyasya śarīreṣu romakūpāni sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तावत्कोटिसहस्राणि वर्षाणि दिवि मोदते । ब्रह्मसायुज्यगो भूत्वा दैवतैः सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: tāvatkoṭisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi divi modate / brahmasāyujyago bhūtvā daivataiḥ saha modate
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं पवित्रं च यशस्वि च । ब्रह्मा ददौ शास्त्रमिदं पुराणं मातरिश्वने
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca yaśasvi ca / brahmā dadau śāstramidaṃ purāṇaṃ mātariśvane
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्चोशनसा प्राप्तं तस्माच्चापि बृहस्पतिः । बृहस्पतिस्तु प्रोवाच सवित्रे तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāccośanasā prāptaṃ tasmāccāpi bṛhaspatiḥ / bṛhaspatistu provāca savitre tadanantaram
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: सविता मृत्यवे प्राह मृत्युश्चेन्द्राय वै पुनः । इन्द्रश्चापि वसिष्ठाय सो ऽपि सारस्वताय च
verses.transliteration: savitā mṛtyave prāha mṛtyuścendrāya vai punaḥ / indraścāpi vasiṣṭhāya so 'pi sārasvatāya ca
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतस्त्रिधाम्ने ऽथ त्रिधामा च शरद्वते । शरद्वांस्तु त्रिविष्टाय स्ॐऽतरिक्षाय दत्तवान्
verses.transliteration: sārasvatastridhāmne 'tha tridhāmā ca śaradvate / śaradvāṃstu triviṣṭāya soṃ'tarikṣāya dattavān
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: चर्षिणे चान्तरिक्षो वै सो ऽपि त्रय्यारुणाय च । त्रय्यारुणाद्धनञ्जयः स वै प्रादात्कृतञ्जये
verses.transliteration: carṣiṇe cāntarikṣo vai so 'pi trayyāruṇāya ca / trayyāruṇāddhanañjayaḥ sa vai prādātkṛtañjaye
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: कृतञ्जयात्तृणञ्जयो भरद्वाजाय सो ऽप्यथ । गौतमाय भरद्वाजः सो ऽपि निर्य्यन्तरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: kṛtañjayāttṛṇañjayo bharadvājāya so 'pyatha / gautamāya bharadvājaḥ so 'pi niryyantare punaḥ
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: निर्य्यन्तरस्तु प्रोवाच तथा वाजश्रवाय वै । स ददौ सोमशुष्माय स चादात्तृणबिन्दवे
verses.transliteration: niryyantarastu provāca tathā vājaśravāya vai / sa dadau somaśuṣmāya sa cādāttṛṇabindave
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तृणबिन्दुस्तु दक्षाय दक्षः प्रोवाच शक्तये । शक्तेः पराशरश्चापि गर्भस्थः श्रुतवानिदम्
verses.transliteration: tṛṇabindustu dakṣāya dakṣaḥ provāca śaktaye / śakteḥ parāśaraścāpi garbhasthaḥ śrutavānidam
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: पराशराज्जातुकर्ण्यस्तस्माद्द्वैपायनः प्रभुः । द्वैपायना त्पुनश्चापि मया प्राप्तं द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: parāśarājjātukarṇyastasmāddvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ / dvaipāyanā tpunaścāpi mayā prāptaṃ dvijottama
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: मया चैतत्पुनः प्रोक्तं पुत्रायामितबुद्धये । इत्येव वाक्यं ब्रह्मादिगुरुणां समुदात्दृतम्
verses.transliteration: mayā caitatpunaḥ proktaṃ putrāyāmitabuddhaye / ityeva vākyaṃ brahmādiguruṇāṃ samudātdṛtam
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कार्याश्च गुरवः प्रयत्नेन मनीषिभिः । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं सर्वार्थसाधकम्
verses.transliteration: namaskāryāśca guravaḥ prayatnena manīṣibhiḥ / dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvārthasādhakam
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: पापघ्नं नियमेनेदं श्रोतव्यं ब्राह्मणैः सदा । नाशुचौ नापि पापाय नाप्यसंवत्सरोषिते
verses.transliteration: pāpaghnaṃ niyamenedaṃ śrotavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sadā / nāśucau nāpi pāpāya nāpyasaṃvatsaroṣite
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: नाश्रद्दधाने ऽविदुषे नापुत्राय कथञ्चन । नाहिताय प्रदातव्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nāśraddadhāne 'viduṣe nāputrāya kathañcana / nāhitāya pradātavyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं वै यस्य योनिं वदन्ति व्यक्तं देहं कालमेतं गतिं च । वह्निर्वक्त्रं चन्द्रसूर्यौं च नेत्रेदिशः श्रोत्रे घ्राणमाहुश्च वायुम्
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ vai yasya yoniṃ vadanti vyaktaṃ dehaṃ kālametaṃ gatiṃ ca / vahnirvaktraṃ candrasūryauṃ ca netrediśaḥ śrotre ghrāṇamāhuśca vāyum
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: वाचो वेदा अन्तरिक्षं शरीरं क्षितिः पादास्तारका रोमकूपाः । सर्वाणि द्यौर्मस्तकानि त्वथो वै विद्याश्चैवोपनिषद्यस्य पुच्छम्
verses.transliteration: vāco vedā antarikṣaṃ śarīraṃ kṣitiḥ pādāstārakā romakūpāḥ / sarvāṇi dyaurmastakāni tvatho vai vidyāścaivopaniṣadyasya puccham
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तं देवदेवं जननं जनानां यज्ञात्मकं सत्यलोकप्रतिष्ठम् । वरं वराणां वरदं महेश्वरं ब्रह्माणमादिं प्रयतो नमस्ये
verses.transliteration: taṃ devadevaṃ jananaṃ janānāṃ yajñātmakaṃ satyalokapratiṣṭham / varaṃ varāṇāṃ varadaṃ maheśvaraṃ brahmāṇamādiṃ prayato namasye
verses.translation: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The usual concluding solutation lo the Primordial Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते द्वादशसाहर्स्यां संहितायां उत्तरभागे चतुर्थं उपसंहारपादे ब्रह्माण्डावर्त्तं नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः श्रीगणेशाय नमः । अथ श्रीललितोपाख्यानं प्रारभ्यते । चतुर्भुजे चन्द्रकलावतंसे कुचोन्नते कुङ्कुमरागशोणे । पुण्ड्रेक्षुपाशाङ्कुशपुष्पबाणहस्ते नमस्ते जगदेकमातः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte dvādaśasāharsyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ uttarabhāge caturthaṃ upasaṃhārapāde brahmāṇḍāvarttaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ / atha śrīlalitopākhyānaṃ prārabhyate / caturbhuje candrakalāvataṃse kuconnate kuṅkumarāgaśoṇe / puṇḍrekṣupāśāṅkuśapuṣpabāṇahaste namaste jagadekamātaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto you, O sole mother of the Universe,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance unto you, O sole mother of the Universe,
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance unto you, O sole mother of the Universe,

verses.sanskrit: अस्तु नः श्रेयसे नित्यं वस्तु वामाङ्गसुन्दरम् । यतस्तृतीयो विदुषां तृतीयस्तु परं महः
