verses.transliteration: astu naḥ śreyase nityaṃ vastu vāmāṅgasundaram / yatastṛtīyo viduṣāṃ tṛtīyastu paraṃ mahaḥ
verses.translation: Let the eternal Reality, a beautiful female Deity oi lovely form, be gracious for our welfare for ever— the Deity from whom learned men acquire the third Purusdrtha viz. K&ma i.e. all their desires and whose splendour is supreme.
verses.wordMeaning: Let the eternal Reality, a beautiful female Deity oi lovely form, be gracious for our welfare for ever— the Deity from whom learned men acquire the third Purusdrtha viz. K&ma i.e. all their desires and whose splendour is supreme.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the eternal Reality, a beautiful female Deity oi lovely form, be gracious for our welfare for ever— the Deity from whom learned men acquire the third Purusdrtha viz. K&ma i.e. all their desires and whose splendour is supreme.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यो नाम देवर्षिर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । सर्वसिद्धान्तसारज्ञो ब्रह्मानन्दरसात्मकः
verses.transliteration: agastyo nāma devarṣirvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / sarvasiddhāntasārajño brahmānandarasātmakaḥ
verses.translation: In those different places, hesawall creatures enveloped in the darkness of ignorance and devoted to the satisfaction of the urges of hunger a nd sexual desire. Hence, he thought wor- riedly about them.
verses.wordMeaning: In those different places, hesawall creatures enveloped in the darkness of ignorance and devoted to the satisfaction of the urges of hunger a nd sexual desire. Hence, he thought wor- riedly about them.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those different places, hesawall creatures enveloped in the darkness of ignorance and devoted to the satisfaction of the urges of hunger a nd sexual desire. Hence, he thought wor- riedly about them.

verses.sanskrit: चचाराद्भुतहेतूनि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च । शैलारण्यापगामुख्यान्सर्वाञ्जनपदानपि
verses.transliteration: cacārādbhutahetūni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / śailāraṇyāpagāmukhyānsarvāñjanapadānapi
verses.translation: As stated in Introduction SrT Lalitopakhyana is an Appendix — an apocryphal part— of the Brahmanda Purana (Bd. P.) It starts with a fresh set of Mangalacarana verses — a prayer of Sri Lalita, the main divinity of this Upakhydna and has a different set of interlocutors viz. Sage Agastya and Hayagriva (a partial incarnation of god Visnu as another sage).
verses.wordMeaning: As stated in Introduction SrT Lalitopakhyana is an Appendix — an apocryphal part— of the Brahmanda Purana (Bd. P.) It starts with a fresh set of Mangalacarana verses — a prayer of Sri Lalita, the main divinity of this Upakhydna and has a different set of interlocutors viz.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As stated in Introduction SrT Lalitopakhyana is an Appendix — an apocryphal part— of the Brahmanda Purana (Bd. P.) It starts with a fresh set of Mangalacarana verses — a prayer of Sri Lalita, the main divinity of this Upakhydna and has a different set of interlocutors viz.…

verses.sanskrit: तेषु तेष्वखिलाञ्जन्तूनज्ञानतिमिरावृतान् । शिश्नोदरपरान्दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास तान्प्रति
verses.transliteration: teṣu teṣvakhilāñjantūnajñānatimirāvṛtān / śiśnodaraparāndṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa tānprati
verses.translation: Conjeveram, 43 miles SW of Madras. The eastern portion of the town is Vismi-KahcT and the western is Siva-Kanci. The chief deity of Siva-
verses.wordMeaning: Conjeveram, 43 miles SW of Madras. The eastern portion of the town is Vismi-KahcT and the western is Siva-Kanci. The chief deity of Siva-
verses.commentary: Sense: Conjeveram, 43 miles SW of Madras. The eastern portion of the town is Vismi-KahcT and the western is Siva-Kanci. The chief deity of Siva-

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चिन्तयमानस्य चरतो वसुधामिमाम् । प्राप्तमासीन्महापुण्यं काञ्चीनगरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasya cintayamānasya carato vasudhāmimām / prāptamāsīnmahāpuṇyaṃ kāñcīnagaramuttamam
verses.translation: There the wise sage worshipped Siva installed in the shrine of Ekamra, the lord ofVarana Saila as well as god- dess KamaksI, the destroyer of sins and defects of the Kali Age.
verses.wordMeaning: There the wise sage worshipped Siva installed in the shrine of Ekamra, the lord ofVarana Saila as well as god- dess KamaksI, the destroyer of sins and defects of the Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: There the wise sage worshipped Siva installed in the shrine of Ekamra, the lord ofVarana Saila as well as god- dess KamaksI, the destroyer of sins and defects of the Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वारणशैलेनद्रमेकाम्रनिलयं शिवम् । कामाक्षीं करिदोषध्नीमपूजयदथात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: tatra vāraṇaśailenadramekāmranilayaṃ śivam / kāmākṣīṃ karidoṣadhnīmapūjayadathātmavān
verses.translation: Then the lord ofthe universe said, "1 am pleased with your penance. O excellent Brahmana, welfare unto you. Choose your boon."
verses.wordMeaning: Then the lord ofthe universe said, "1 am pleased with your penance. O excellent Brahmana, welfare unto you. Choose your boon."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord ofthe universe said, "1 am pleased with your penance. O excellent Brahmana, welfare unto you. Choose your boon."

verses.sanskrit: लोकहेतोर्दयार्द्रस्य धीमतश्चिन्तनो मुहुः । चिरकालेन तपसा तोषितो ऽभूज्जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: lokahetordayārdrasya dhīmataścintano muhuḥ / cirakālena tapasā toṣito 'bhūjjanārdanaḥ
verses.translation: I am the prime cause ofliving beings, the original creator and the lord. I am the cause of creation, sustenance and dissolution of everything.
verses.wordMeaning: I am the prime cause ofliving beings, the original creator and the lord. I am the cause of creation, sustenance and dissolution of everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the prime cause ofliving beings, the original creator and the lord. I am the cause of creation, sustenance and dissolution of everything.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीवां तनुं कृत्वा साक्षाच्चिन्मात्रविग्रहाम् । शङ्खचक्राक्षवलयपुस्तकोज्ज्वलबाहुकाम्
verses.transliteration: hayagrīvāṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā sākṣāccinmātravigrahām / śaṅkhacakrākṣavalayapustakojjvalabāhukām
verses.translation: At the end when the effects of evil actions perish on account of austerities continued for a long time as well as through Tanias' and Niyamas* (Restraints and holy observances) and Tyagas (renunciation ofthings), Salvation is immediately attained.
verses.wordMeaning: At the end when the effects of evil actions perish on account of austerities continued for a long time as well as through Tanias' and Niyamas* (Restraints and holy observances) and Tyagas (renunciation ofthings), Salvation is immediately attained.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end when the effects of evil actions perish on account of austerities continued for a long time as well as through Tanias' and Niyamas* (Restraints and holy observances) and Tyagas (renunciation ofthings), Salvation is immediately attained.

verses.sanskrit: पूरयित्रीं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रभया देहजातया । प्रादुर्बभूव पुरतो मुनेरमिततेजसा
verses.transliteration: pūrayitrīṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ prabhayā dehajātayā / prādurbabhūva purato muneramitatejasā
verses.translation: The moral observances viz. Non-violence, Truth, Non-stealing, Celibacy, Possession-lessness. Some Smrtis enumerate ten Tanias. Tanias are obligatory.
verses.wordMeaning: The moral observances viz. Non-violence, Truth, Non-stealing, Celibacy, Possession-lessness. Some Smrtis enumerate ten Tanias. Tanias are obligatory.
verses.commentary: Sense: The moral observances viz. Non-violence, Truth, Non-stealing, Celibacy, Possession-lessness. Some Smrtis enumerate ten Tanias. Tanias are obligatory.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वानन्दभरितः प्रणम्य च मुहुर्मुहुः । विनयावनतो भूत्वा सन्तुष्टाव जगत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvānandabharitaḥ praṇamya ca muhurmuhuḥ / vinayāvanato bhūtvā santuṣṭāva jagatpatim
verses.translation: The restraints, Yogasutra II. 32 enumerate the following: Sauca
verses.wordMeaning: The restraints, Yogasutra II. 32 enumerate the following: Sauca
verses.commentary: Sense: The restraints, Yogasutra II. 32 enumerate the following: Sauca

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच जगन्नाथस्तुष्टो ऽस्मि तपसा तव । वरं वरय भद्रं ते भविता भूसुरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: athovāca jagannāthastuṣṭo 'smi tapasā tava / varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te bhavitā bhūsurottamaḥ
verses.translation: Merely by meditating on that form, the sins and evils of those men who commit heinous crimes and those who are outside the pale of three Varnas, turn into meritorious deeds.
verses.wordMeaning: Merely by meditating on that form, the sins and evils of those men who commit heinous crimes and those who are outside the pale of three Varnas, turn into meritorious deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Merely by meditating on that form, the sins and evils of those men who commit heinous crimes and those who are outside the pale of three Varnas, turn into meritorious deeds.

verses.sanskrit: इति पृष्टो भगवता प्रोवाच मुनिसत्तमः । यदि तुष्टो ऽसि भगवन्निमे पामरजन्तवः
verses.transliteration: iti pṛṣṭo bhagavatā provāca munisattamaḥ / yadi tuṣṭo 'si bhagavannime pāmarajantavaḥ
verses.translation: By worshipping and propitiating her (the ParaSakti) and a so by means of the power of meditation and Yogic practice, Lord Siva became the leader of all Siddhas and also became the lord, half of whose body has the female Sakti form.
verses.wordMeaning: By worshipping and propitiating her (the ParaSakti) and a so by means of the power of meditation and Yogic practice, Lord Siva became the leader of all Siddhas and also became the lord, half of whose body has the female Sakti form.
verses.commentary: Sense: By worshipping and propitiating her (the ParaSakti) and a so by means of the power of meditation and Yogic practice, Lord Siva became the leader of all Siddhas and also became the lord, half of whose body has the female Sakti form.

verses.sanskrit: केनोपायेन मुक्ताः स्युरेतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि । इति पृष्टो द्विजेनाथ देवदेवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: kenopāyena muktāḥ syuretanme vaktumarhasi / iti pṛṣṭo dvijenātha devadevo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Hayagrlva, the lord wield- ing Sarnga bow, (sage Agastya) bowed down to him and spoke these words to Visnu (slayer of Madhu).
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of Hayagrlva, the lord wield- ing Sarnga bow, (sage Agastya) bowed down to him and spoke these words to Visnu (slayer of Madhu).
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Hayagrlva, the lord wield- ing Sarnga bow, (sage Agastya) bowed down to him and spoke these words to Visnu (slayer of Madhu).

verses.sanskrit: एष एव पुरा प्रश्नः शिवेन चरितो मम । अयमेव कृतः प्रश्नो ब्रह्मणा तु ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa eva purā praśnaḥ śivena carito mama / ayameva kṛtaḥ praśno brahmaṇā tu tataḥ param
verses.translation: "O Lord! It behoves you to recount to me of what sort is that form that has been mentioned by you before, what is its power and of what'type are its sports.
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord! It behoves you to recount to me of what sort is that form that has been mentioned by you before, what is its power and of what'type are its sports.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord! It behoves you to recount to me of what sort is that form that has been mentioned by you before, what is its power and of what'type are its sports.

verses.sanskrit: कृतो दुर्वाससा पश्चाद्भवता तु ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: kṛto durvāsasā paścādbhavatā tu tataḥ param
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिः सर्वभूतानां गुरुभूतैर्महात्मभिः । ममोपदेशो लोकेषु प्रथितो ऽस्तु वरो मम
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ gurubhūtairmahātmabhiḥ / mamopadeśo lokeṣu prathito 'stu varo mama
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: अहमादिर्हि भूतानामादिकर्ता स्वयं प्रभुः । सृष्टिस्थितिलयानां तु सर्वेषामपि कारकः
verses.transliteration: ahamādirhi bhūtānāmādikartā svayaṃ prabhuḥ / sṛṣṭisthitilayānāṃ tu sarveṣāmapi kārakaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिमूर्तिस्त्रिगुणातीतो गुणहीनो गुणाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: trimūrtistriguṇātīto guṇahīno guṇāśrayaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छाविहारो भूतात्मा प्रधानपुरुषात्मकः । एवं भूतस्य मे ब्रह्मंस्त्रिजगद्रूपधारिणः
verses.transliteration: icchāvihāro bhūtātmā pradhānapuruṣātmakaḥ / evaṃ bhūtasya me brahmaṃstrijagadrūpadhāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: द्विधाकृतमभूद्रूपं प्रधान पुरुषात्मकम् । मम प्रधानं यद्रूपं सर्वलोकगुणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: dvidhākṛtamabhūdrūpaṃ pradhāna puruṣātmakam / mama pradhānaṃ yadrūpaṃ sarvalokaguṇātmakam
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: अपरं यद्गुणातीतं परात्परतरं महत् । एवमेव तयोर्ज्ञात्वा मुच्यते ते उभे किमु
verses.transliteration: aparaṃ yadguṇātītaṃ parātparataraṃ mahat / evameva tayorjñātvā mucyate te ubhe kimu
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: तपोभिश्चिरकालोत्थैर्यमैश्च नियमैरपि । त्यागैर्दुष्कर्मनाशान्ते मुक्तिराश्वेव लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: tapobhiścirakālotthairyamaiśca niyamairapi / tyāgairduṣkarmanāśānte muktirāśveva labhyate
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: यद्रूपं यद्गुणयुतं तद्गुण्यैक्येन लभ्यते । अन्यत्सर्वजगद्रूपं कर्मभोगपराक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yadrūpaṃ yadguṇayutaṃ tadguṇyaikyena labhyate / anyatsarvajagadrūpaṃ karmabhogaparākramam
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभिर्लभ्यते तच्च तत्त्यागेनापि लभ्यते । दुस्तरस्तु तयोस्त्यागः सकलैरपि तापस
verses.transliteration: karmabhirlabhyate tacca tattyāgenāpi labhyate / dustarastu tayostyāgaḥ sakalairapi tāpasa
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: अनपायं च सुगमं सदसत्कर्मगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: anapāyaṃ ca sugamaṃ sadasatkarmagocaram
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मस्थेन गुणेनैव सता चाप्यसतापिवा । आत्मैक्येनैव यज्ज्ञानं सर्वसिद्धिग्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: ātmasthena guṇenaiva satā cāpyasatāpivā / ātmaikyenaiva yajjñānaṃ sarvasiddhigradāyakam
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णत्रयविहीनानां पापिष्ठानां नृणामपि । यद्रूपध्यानमात्रेण दुष्कृतं सुकृतायते
verses.transliteration: varṇatrayavihīnānāṃ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ nṛṇāmapi / yadrūpadhyānamātreṇa duṣkṛtaṃ sukṛtāyate
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: येर्ऽचयन्ति परां शक्तिं विधिनाविधिनापि वा । न ते संसारिणो नूनं मुक्ता एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yer'cayanti parāṃ śaktiṃ vidhināvidhināpi vā / na te saṃsāriṇo nūnaṃ muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो वा यां समाराध्य ध्यानयोगबलेन च । ईश्वरः सर्वसिद्धानामर्द्धनारीश्वरो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: śivo vā yāṃ samārādhya dhyānayogabalena ca / īśvaraḥ sarvasiddhānāmarddhanārīśvaro 'bhavat
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये ऽब्जप्रमुखा देवाः सिद्धास्तद्ध्यानवैभवात् । तस्मादशेषलोकानां त्रिपुराराधनं विना
verses.transliteration: anye 'bjapramukhā devāḥ siddhāstaddhyānavaibhavāt / tasmādaśeṣalokānāṃ tripurārādhanaṃ vinā
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: न स्तो भोगापवर्गौं तु यौगपद्येन कुत्रचित् । तन्मनास्तद्गतप्राणस्तद्याजी तद्गतेहकः
verses.transliteration: na sto bhogāpavargauṃ tu yaugapadyena kutracit / tanmanāstadgataprāṇastadyājī tadgatehakaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: तादात्म्येनैव कर्माणि कुर्वन्मुक्तिमवाप्स्यसि । एतद्रहस्यमाख्यातं सर्वेषां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tādātmyenaiva karmāṇi kurvanmuktimavāpsyasi / etadrahasyamākhyātaṃ sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तुष्टेनैव तपसा भवतो मुनिसत्तम । देवाश्च मुनयः सिद्धा मानुषाश्च तथापरे । त्वन्मुखांभोजतो ऽवाप्यसिद्धिं यान्तु परात्पराम्
verses.transliteration: santuṣṭenaiva tapasā bhavato munisattama / devāśca munayaḥ siddhā mānuṣāśca tathāpare / tvanmukhāṃbhojato 'vāpyasiddhiṃ yāntu parātparām
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हयग्रीवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः । प्रणिपत्य पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनम्
verses.transliteration: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā hayagrīvasya śārṅgiṇaḥ / praṇipatya punarvākyamuvāca madhusūdanam
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्कीदृशं रूपं भवता यत्पुरोदितम् । किंविहारं किंप्रभावमेतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: bhagavankīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ bhavatā yatpuroditam / kiṃvihāraṃ kiṃprabhāvametanme vaktumarhasi
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच एष्ॐऽशभूतो देवर्षे हयग्रीवो ममापरः । श्रोतुमिच्छसियद्यत्त्वं तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca eṣoṃ'śabhūto devarṣe hayagrīvo mamāparaḥ / śrotumicchasiyadyattvaṃ tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhati
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिश्य जगन्नाथो हयग्रीवं तपोधनम् । पुरतः कुम्भजातस्य मुनेरन्तरधाद्धरिः
verses.transliteration: ityādiśya jagannātho hayagrīvaṃ tapodhanam / purataḥ kumbhajātasya munerantaradhāddhariḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा तपोधनः । हयग्रीवेण मुनिना स्वाश्रमं प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: tatastu vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā tapodhanaḥ / hayagrīveṇa muninā svāśramaṃ pratyapadyata
verses.translation: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and commanding sage Hayagriva (like-wise) Hari, the lord of the universe, vanished in front of the pot-born sage Agastya.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने अगस्त्ययात्राजनार्दनाविर्भावो नाम पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः अथोपवेश्य चैवैनमासने परमाद्भुते । हयाननमुपागत्यागस्त्यो वाक्यं समब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne agastyayātrājanārdanāvirbhāvo nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ athopaveśya caivainamāsane paramādbhute / hayānanamupāgatyāgastyo vākyaṃ samabravīt
verses.translation: Then Agastya made Hayanana (Hayagriva) sit on a wonderful seat and approaching him, spoke these words:
verses.wordMeaning: Then Agastya made Hayanana (Hayagriva) sit on a wonderful seat and approaching him, spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Agastya made Hayanana (Hayagriva) sit on a wonderful seat and approaching him, spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ सर्वसिद्धान्तवित्तम् । लोकाभ्युदयहेतुर्हि दर्शनं हि भवादृशाम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvasiddhāntavittam / lokābhyudayaheturhi darśanaṃ hi bhavādṛśām
verses.translation: "O holy lord conversant with all religious activities, the most excellent one among those who know all logically established doctrines (siddhdntas), seeing people like you is a contributory cause for the prosperity ofthe world.
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord conversant with all religious activities, the most excellent one among those who know all logically established doctrines (siddhdntas), seeing people like you is a contributory cause for the prosperity ofthe world.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord conversant with all religious activities, the most excellent one among those who know all logically established doctrines (siddhdntas), seeing people like you is a contributory cause for the prosperity ofthe world.

verses.sanskrit: आविर्भावं महादेव्यास्तस्या रूपान्तराणि च । विहारश्चैव मुख्या ये तान्नो विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: āvirbhāvaṃ mahādevyāstasyā rūpāntarāṇi ca / vihāraścaiva mukhyā ye tānno vistarato vada
verses.translation: Mention in details to us all these things, namely — the manifestation ofthe great goddess, her other forms and the most important ones ofher sporting activities and pastimes."
verses.wordMeaning: Mention in details to us all these things, namely — the manifestation ofthe great goddess, her other forms and the most important ones ofher sporting activities and pastimes."
verses.commentary: Sense: Mention in details to us all these things, namely — the manifestation ofthe great goddess, her other forms and the most important ones ofher sporting activities and pastimes."

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच अनादिरखिलाधारा सदसत्कर्मरूपिणी । ध्यानैकदृश्या ध्यानाङ्गी विद्याङ्गी हृदयास्पदा
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca anādirakhilādhārā sadasatkarmarūpiṇī / dhyānaikadṛśyā dhyānāṅgī vidyāṅgī hṛdayāspadā
verses.translation: At the outset, Sakti manifested herself through the profound meditation ofgod Brahma. That Sakti is wellknown by the name of Prakrti. She is the bestower of Siddhi desired, by the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: At the outset, Sakti manifested herself through the profound meditation ofgod Brahma. That Sakti is wellknown by the name of Prakrti. She is the bestower of Siddhi desired, by the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset, Sakti manifested herself through the profound meditation ofgod Brahma. That Sakti is wellknown by the name of Prakrti. She is the bestower of Siddhi desired, by the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मैक्याद्व्यक्तिमायाति चिरानुष्ठानगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: ātmaikyādvyaktimāyāti cirānuṣṭhānagauravāt
verses.translation: Formerly, the overlord of the city of immortal ones, the lord endowed with prosperity and glory of victory,
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the overlord of the city of immortal ones, the lord endowed with prosperity and glory of victory,
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the overlord of the city of immortal ones, the lord endowed with prosperity and glory of victory,

verses.sanskrit: आदौ प्रादुरभूच्छक्तिर्ब्रह्मणो ध्यानयोगतः । प्रकृतिर्नाम सा ख्याता देवानामिष्टसिद्धिदा
verses.transliteration: ādau prādurabhūcchaktirbrahmaṇo dhyānayogataḥ / prakṛtirnāma sā khyātā devānāmiṣṭasiddhidā
verses.translation: The sage Durvasa assumed the guise of an insane person. He wore a piece of skin of an antelope and held a staff in his hand. His body was rendered greyish on account of dust. He walked along the path of Vidyadharas (i.e. the sky).
verses.wordMeaning: The sage Durvasa assumed the guise of an insane person. He wore a piece of skin of an antelope and held a staff in his hand. His body was rendered greyish on account of dust. He walked along the path of Vidyadharas (i.e. the sky).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage Durvasa assumed the guise of an insane person. He wore a piece of skin of an antelope and held a staff in his hand. His body was rendered greyish on account of dust. He walked along the path of Vidyadharas (i.e. the sky).

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयमुदभूद्रूपं प्रवृत्ते ऽमृतमन्थने । शर्वसंमोहजनकमवाङ्मनसगोजरम्
verses.transliteration: dvitīyamudabhūdrūpaṃ pravṛtte 'mṛtamanthane / śarvasaṃmohajanakamavāṅmanasagojaram
verses.translation: In the meantime a certain Vidyadhara lady of very beautiful form came in front of him by chance.
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime a certain Vidyadhara lady of very beautiful form came in front of him by chance.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime a certain Vidyadhara lady of very beautiful form came in front of him by chance.

verses.sanskrit: यद्दर्शनादभूदीशः सर्वज्ञो ऽपि विमोहितः । विसृज्य पार्वतीं शीघ्रन्तया रुद्धो ऽतनोद्रतम्
verses.transliteration: yaddarśanādabhūdīśaḥ sarvajño 'pi vimohitaḥ / visṛjya pārvatīṃ śīghrantayā ruddho 'tanodratam
verses.translation: After propitiating the great goddess Ambika by means of a penance for a long duration, she became delighted in her mind on receiving a garland handed over to her by the goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating the great goddess Ambika by means of a penance for a long duration, she became delighted in her mind on receiving a garland handed over to her by the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating the great goddess Ambika by means of a penance for a long duration, she became delighted in her mind on receiving a garland handed over to her by the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां वै जनयामास शास्तारमसुरार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ vai janayāmāsa śāstāramasurārdanam
verses.translation: VV. 11-31 describe sage Durvasa's curse to Indra for his arrogance.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 11-31 describe sage Durvasa's curse to Indra for his arrogance.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 11-31 describe sage Durvasa's curse to Indra for his arrogance.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच कथं वै सर्वभूतेशो वशी मन्मथ शासनः । अहो विमोहितो देव्या जनयामास चात्मजम्
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca kathaṃ vai sarvabhūteśo vaśī manmatha śāsanaḥ / aho vimohito devyā janayāmāsa cātmajam
verses.translation: On seeing that Fawn-eyed lady, the leading sage •iked: "Where are you going, O timorous lady? Whence was this got by you?"
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that Fawn-eyed lady, the leading sage •iked: "Where are you going, O timorous lady? Whence was this got by you?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Fawn-eyed lady, the leading sage •iked: "Where are you going, O timorous lady? Whence was this got by you?"

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच पुरामरपुराधीशो विजयश्रीसमृद्धिमान् । त्रैलोक्यं पालयामास सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca purāmarapurādhīśo vijayaśrīsamṛddhimān / trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa sadevāsuramānuṣam
verses.translation: After bowing down to the noble-souled sage, she said humbly — "It has been given, OBrahmana, by the goddess who was pleased with my long-term penance."
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to the noble-souled sage, she said humbly — "It has been given, OBrahmana, by the goddess who was pleased with my long-term penance."
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to the noble-souled sage, she said humbly — "It has been given, OBrahmana, by the goddess who was pleased with my long-term penance."

verses.sanskrit: कैलासशिखराकारं गजेन्द्रमधिरुह्य सः । चचाराखिललोकेषु पूज्यमानो ऽखिलैरपि । तं प्रमत्तं विदित्वाथ भवानीपतिख्ययः
verses.transliteration: kailāsaśikharākāraṃ gajendramadhiruhya saḥ / cacārākhilalokeṣu pūjyamāno 'khilairapi / taṃ pramattaṃ viditvātha bhavānīpatikhyayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing her words, he asked for that excellent garland. She became delighted on being requested thus and immediately she gave it to the noblc-soulcd sage.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing her words, he asked for that excellent garland. She became delighted on being requested thus and immediately she gave it to the noblc-soulcd sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words, he asked for that excellent garland. She became delighted on being requested thus and immediately she gave it to the noblc-soulcd sage.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वाससमथाहूय प्रजिघाय तदन्तिकम् । खण्डाजिनधरो दण्डीधूरिधूसरविग्रहः । उन्मत्तरूपधारी च ययौ विद्याधराध्वना
verses.transliteration: durvāsasamathāhūya prajighāya tadantikam / khaṇḍājinadharo daṇḍīdhūridhūsaravigrahaḥ / unmattarūpadhārī ca yayau vidyādharādhvanā
verses.translation: Saying, "lam delighted and contented", he quickly Received it with both the hands. He then placed it on his own
verses.wordMeaning: Saying, "lam delighted and contented", he quickly Received it with both the hands. He then placed it on his own
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying, "lam delighted and contented", he quickly Received it with both the hands. He then placed it on his own

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे काले काचिद्विद्याधराङ्गना । यदृच्छयागता तस्य पुरश्चारुतराकृतिः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare kāle kācidvidyādharāṅganā / yadṛcchayāgatā tasya puraścārutarākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The lord of the Devas took the garland and placed it on the shoulder of the elephant. The elephant took it and threw it on the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of the Devas took the garland and placed it on the shoulder of the elephant. The elephant took it and threw it on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of the Devas took the garland and placed it on the shoulder of the elephant. The elephant took it and threw it on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: चिरकालेन तपसा तोषयित्वा परांबिकाम् । तत्समर्पितमाल्यं च लब्ध्वा संतुष्टमानसा
verses.transliteration: cirakālena tapasā toṣayitvā parāṃbikām / tatsamarpitamālyaṃ ca labdhvā saṃtuṣṭamānasā
verses.translation: Thereafter his (Indra's) glory of victory went over to Bali the Daitya, NityasrI (the eternal glory) passed on to Vasudeva the eternal Purusa.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter his (Indra's) glory of victory went over to Bali the Daitya, NityasrI (the eternal glory) passed on to Vasudeva the eternal Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter his (Indra's) glory of victory went over to Bali the Daitya, NityasrI (the eternal glory) passed on to Vasudeva the eternal Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा मृगुशावाक्षीमुवाच मुनिपुङ्गवः । कुत्र वा गम्यते भीरु कुतो लब्धमिदं त्वया
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛguśāvākṣīmuvāca munipuṅgavaḥ / kutra vā gamyate bhīru kuto labdhamidaṃ tvayā
verses.translation: Seeing ill omens in the city of the immortal ones, he sent for Brhaspati and spoke these words: 1
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing ill omens in the city of the immortal ones, he sent for Brhaspati and spoke these words: 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing ill omens in the city of the immortal ones, he sent for Brhaspati and spoke these words: 1

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य सा महात्मानमुवाच विनयान्विता । चिरेण तपसा ब्रह्मन्देव्या दत्तं प्रसन्नया
verses.transliteration: praṇamya sā mahātmānamuvāca vinayānvitā / cireṇa tapasā brahmandevyā dattaṃ prasannayā
verses.translation: "O holy lord, conversant with all holy rites, efficient one with the knowledge of the affairs of the three units of time (i.e. past, present and future), inauspicious omens, which were never seen before, are being observed.
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord, conversant with all holy rites, efficient one with the knowledge of the affairs of the three units of time (i.e. past, present and future), inauspicious omens, which were never seen before, are being observed.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord, conversant with all holy rites, efficient one with the knowledge of the affairs of the three units of time (i.e. past, present and future), inauspicious omens, which were never seen before, are being observed.

verses.sanskrit: तछ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्याः सो ऽपृच्छन्माल्यमुत्तमम् । पृष्टमात्रेण सा तुष्टा ददौ तस्मै महात्मने
verses.transliteration: tachrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ so 'pṛcchanmālyamuttamam / pṛṣṭamātreṇa sā tuṣṭā dadau tasmai mahātmane
verses.translation: "No action (committed by man, O king, can perish even in hundred crores of Kalpas unless atonement is performed or the resul A is experienced."
verses.wordMeaning: "No action (committed by man, O king, can perish even in hundred crores of Kalpas unless atonement is performed or the resul A is experienced."
verses.commentary: Sense: "No action (committed by man, O king, can perish even in hundred crores of Kalpas unless atonement is performed or the resul A is experienced."

verses.sanskrit: कराभ्यां तत्समादाय कृतार्थो ऽस्मीति सत्वरम् । दधौ स्वशिरसा भक्त्या तामुवाचातिर्षितः
verses.transliteration: karābhyāṃ tatsamādāya kṛtārtho 'smīti satvaram / dadhau svaśirasā bhaktyā tāmuvācātirṣitaḥ
verses.translation: "Ofwhat nature is Karman (Action)? Of what nature is atonement? O holy Brahmana, I wish to hear every- thing. Explain to me in detail."
verses.wordMeaning: "Ofwhat nature is Karman (Action)? Of what nature is atonement? O holy Brahmana, I wish to hear every- thing. Explain to me in detail."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Ofwhat nature is Karman (Action)? Of what nature is atonement? O holy Brahmana, I wish to hear every- thing. Explain to me in detail."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादीनामलभ्यं यत्तल्लब्धं भाग्यतो मया । भक्तिरस्तु पदांभोजे देव्यास्तव समुज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: brahmādīnāmalabhyaṃ yattallabdhaṃ bhāgyato mayā / bhaktirastu padāṃbhoje devyāstava samujjvalā
verses.translation: Five types of actions committed by a king, they say, constitute a sin, viz.: (violence) killing, stealing, drinking and sexual intercourse with other women.
verses.wordMeaning: Five types of actions committed by a king, they say, constitute a sin, viz.: (violence) killing, stealing, drinking and sexual intercourse with other women.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five types of actions committed by a king, they say, constitute a sin, viz.: (violence) killing, stealing, drinking and sexual intercourse with other women.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यच्छोभनाकारे गच्छ सौम्ये यथासुखम् । सा तं प्रणम्य शिरसा ययौ तुष्टा यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyacchobhanākāre gaccha saumye yathāsukham / sā taṃ praṇamya śirasā yayau tuṣṭā yathāgatam
verses.translation: VV. 32ff give a discussion between Indra and Brhaspati regarding the nature of Karma. The nature of violence (Hirnsa) is discussed in this chapter.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 32ff give a discussion between Indra and Brhaspati regarding the nature of Karma. The nature of violence (Hirnsa) is discussed in this chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 32ff give a discussion between Indra and Brhaspati regarding the nature of Karma. The nature of violence (Hirnsa) is discussed in this chapter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयित्वा स तां भूयो ययौ विद्याधराध्वना । विद्याधरवधूहस्तात्प्रतिजग्राह वल्लकीम्
verses.transliteration: preṣayitvā sa tāṃ bhūyo yayau vidyādharādhvanā / vidyādharavadhūhastātpratijagrāha vallakīm
verses.translation: In the matter mentioned, one can point out sin in the case of Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and women. Expia- tion is for the father, mother, preceptor, master and sons.**
verses.wordMeaning: In the matter mentioned, one can point out sin in the case of Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and women. Expia- tion is for the father, mother, preceptor, master and sons.**
verses.commentary: Sense: In the matter mentioned, one can point out sin in the case of Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and women. Expia- tion is for the father, mother, preceptor, master and sons.**

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यस्रगनुलेपांश्च दिव्यान्याभरणानि च । क्वचिद्गृह्णन्क्वचिद्गा यन्क्वचिद्धसन्
verses.transliteration: divyasraganulepāṃśca divyānyābharaṇāni ca / kvacidgṛhṇankvacidgā yankvaciddhasan
verses.translation: A sin committed at the behest of a preceptor is signi- ficant when the command is disregarded*** (transgressed).
verses.wordMeaning: A sin committed at the behest of a preceptor is signi- ficant when the command is disregarded*** (transgressed).
verses.commentary: Sense: A sin committed at the behest of a preceptor is signi- ficant when the command is disregarded*** (transgressed).

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छाविहारी स मुनिर्ययौ यत्र पुरन्दरः । स्वकरस्थां ततो मालां शक्राय प्रददौ मुनिः
verses.transliteration: svecchāvihārī sa muniryayau yatra purandaraḥ / svakarasthāṃ tato mālāṃ śakrāya pradadau muniḥ
verses.translation: Or a Brahmana shall kill a Brahmana for the purpose of supporting a hundred Brahmanas.
verses.wordMeaning: Or a Brahmana shall kill a Brahmana for the purpose of supporting a hundred Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or a Brahmana shall kill a Brahmana for the purpose of supporting a hundred Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तां गृहीत्वा गजस्कन्धे स्थापयामास देवराट् । गजस्तु तां गृहीत्वाथ प्रेषयामास भूतले
verses.transliteration: tāṃ gṛhītvā gajaskandhe sthāpayāmāsa devarāṭ / gajastu tāṃ gṛhītvātha preṣayāmāsa bhūtale
verses.translation: For the sake often Vaisyas, one shall punish one or (more) Vaisyas. Similarly, for the sake ofa hundred Vaisyas one shall punish one Brahmana.
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake often Vaisyas, one shall punish one or (more) Vaisyas. Similarly, for the sake ofa hundred Vaisyas one shall punish one Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake often Vaisyas, one shall punish one or (more) Vaisyas. Similarly, for the sake ofa hundred Vaisyas one shall punish one Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा प्रेषितां मालां तदा क्रोधेन तापसः । उवाच न धृता माला शिरसा तु मयार्पिता
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā preṣitāṃ mālāṃ tadā krodhena tāpasaḥ / uvāca na dhṛtā mālā śirasā tu mayārpitā
verses.translation: For the sake ofa thousand Sudras, one shall punish a Brahmana; for the sake of hundred and fifty Sudras, one •hall punish one Sudra.
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake ofa thousand Sudras, one shall punish a Brahmana; for the sake of hundred and fifty Sudras, one •hall punish one Sudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake ofa thousand Sudras, one shall punish a Brahmana; for the sake of hundred and fifty Sudras, one •hall punish one Sudra.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यमत्तेन भवता ह्यवमानिता । महादेव्या धृता या तु ब्रह्माद्यैः पूज्यतेहि सा
verses.transliteration: trailokyaiśvaryamattena bhavatā hyavamānitā / mahādevyā dhṛtā yā tu brahmādyaiḥ pūjyatehi sā
verses.translation: One shall eschew three-fourths (of property) for the sake of kinsmen and friends: half for the sake of wives and sons and nothing for the sake of oneself.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall eschew three-fourths (of property) for the sake of kinsmen and friends: half for the sake of wives and sons and nothing for the sake of oneself.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall eschew three-fourths (of property) for the sake of kinsmen and friends: half for the sake of wives and sons and nothing for the sake of oneself.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया यच्छासितो लोकः सदेवासुरमानुषः । अशोभनो ह्यतेजस्को मम शापाद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tvayā yacchāsito lokaḥ sadevāsuramānuṣaḥ / aśobhano hyatejasko mama śāpādbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: If a person kills a Brahmana or a Ksatriya or a VaiSya or a cow or a horse or anything else in case he or it
verses.wordMeaning: If a person kills a Brahmana or a Ksatriya or a VaiSya or a cow or a horse or anything else in case he or it
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person kills a Brahmana or a Ksatriya or a VaiSya or a cow or a horse or anything else in case he or it

verses.sanskrit: इति शप्त्वा विनीतेन तेन संपूजितो ऽपि सः । तूष्णीमेव ययौ ब्रह्मन्भाविकार्यमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: iti śaptvā vinītena tena saṃpūjito 'pi saḥ / tūṣṇīmeva yayau brahmanbhāvikāryamanusmaran
verses.translation: The sin in killing and the merit in saving the following, O excellent one among the Suras, increases ten times the preceding one in the case of each succeeding one — one's own wife, son, brother and kinsman.
verses.wordMeaning: The sin in killing and the merit in saving the following, O excellent one among the Suras, increases ten times the preceding one in the case of each succeeding one — one's own wife, son, brother and kinsman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin in killing and the merit in saving the following, O excellent one among the Suras, increases ten times the preceding one in the case of each succeeding one — one's own wife, son, brother and kinsman.

verses.sanskrit: विजयश्रीस्ततस्तस्य दैत्यं तु बलिमन्वगात् । नित्यश्रीर्नित्यपुरुषं वासुदेवमथान्वगात्
verses.transliteration: vijayaśrīstatastasya daityaṃ tu balimanvagāt / nityaśrīrnityapuruṣaṃ vāsudevamathānvagāt
verses.translation: Good men say that the atonement for the slaughter ofthe king, the Brahmana proficient in the Vedas, a pious man practising penance and holy rites, and one who is conver- sant with the Vedas as well as Vedanta is once, twice, fifty times and ten thousand times.
verses.wordMeaning: Good men say that the atonement for the slaughter ofthe king, the Brahmana proficient in the Vedas, a pious man practising penance and holy rites, and one who is conver- sant with the Vedas as well as Vedanta is once, twice, fifty times and ten thousand times.
verses.commentary: Sense: Good men say that the atonement for the slaughter ofthe king, the Brahmana proficient in the Vedas, a pious man practising penance and holy rites, and one who is conver- sant with the Vedas as well as Vedanta is once, twice, fifty times and ten thousand times.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो ऽपि स्वपुरं गत्वा सर्वदेवसमन्वितः । विषण्णचेता निःश्रीकश्चिन्तयामास देवराट्
verses.transliteration: indro 'pi svapuraṃ gatvā sarvadevasamanvitaḥ / viṣaṇṇacetā niḥśrīkaścintayāmāsa devarāṭ
verses.translation: Ifways and means of protecting them are provided for and liberal gifts are distributed among them, they say that the merits gradually increase in the case of succeeding one as mentioned before, in the case of visiting or bowing down to them or serving people similar to them (the result is also similar).
verses.wordMeaning: Ifways and means of protecting them are provided for and liberal gifts are distributed among them, they say that the merits gradually increase in the case of succeeding one as mentioned before,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ifways and means of protecting them are provided for and liberal gifts are distributed among them, they say that the merits gradually increase in the case of succeeding one as mentioned before,…

verses.sanskrit: अथामरपुरे दृष्ट्वा निमित्तान्यशुभानि च । बृहस्पतिं समाहूय वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: athāmarapure dṛṣṭvā nimittānyaśubhāni ca / bṛhaspatiṃ samāhūya vākyametaduvāca ha
verses.translation: For the sake of gods and Brahmanas, the king shall always kill lions, tigers and other animals that cause harm to the people. 1
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of gods and Brahmanas, the king shall always kill lions, tigers and other animals that cause harm to the people. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of gods and Brahmanas, the king shall always kill lions, tigers and other animals that cause harm to the people. 1

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ त्रिकालज्ञानकोविद । दृश्यते ऽदृष्टपूर्वाणि निमित्तान्यशुभानि च
verses.transliteration: bhagavansarvadharmajña trikālajñānakovida / dṛśyate 'dṛṣṭapūrvāṇi nimittānyaśubhāni ca
verses.translation: In cases of emergency, even for one's own sake, one may kill and eat animals fit for sacrifice.
verses.wordMeaning: In cases of emergency, even for one's own sake, one may kill and eat animals fit for sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: In cases of emergency, even for one's own sake, one may kill and eat animals fit for sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: किंफलानि च तानि स्युरुपायो वाथ कीदृशः । इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवेन्द्रस्य बृहस्पतिः । प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃphalāni ca tāni syurupāyo vātha kīdṛśaḥ / iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devendrasya bṛhaspatiḥ / pratyuvāca tato vākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ śubham
verses.translation: One shall not cook food solely for one's own sake. One shall not cook animals solely for one's own sake. By cooking for the sake of gods and Brahmanas, one is not affect- ed by sins.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not cook food solely for one's own sake. One shall not cook animals solely for one's own sake. By cooking for the sake of gods and Brahmanas, one is not affect- ed by sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not cook food solely for one's own sake. One shall not cook animals solely for one's own sake. By cooking for the sake of gods and Brahmanas, one is not affect- ed by sins.

verses.sanskrit: कृतस्य कर्मणो राजन्कल्पकोटिशतैरपि । प्रायश्चित्तोपभोगाभ्यां विना नाशो न जायते
verses.transliteration: kṛtasya karmaṇo rājankalpakoṭiśatairapi / prāyaścittopabhogābhyāṃ vinā nāśo na jāyate
verses.translation: W. 50-7a state circumstances under which violence to life is condonablc.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 50-7a state circumstances under which violence to life is condonablc.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 50-7a state circumstances under which violence to life is condonablc.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच कर्म वा कीदृशं ब्रह्मन्प्रायश्चित्तं च कीदृशम् । तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्मे विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca karma vā kīdṛśaṃ brahmanprāyaścittaṃ ca kīdṛśam / tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanme vistarato vada
verses.translation: For the sake of gods and manes, for guests and preceptors as well as on the arrival of a great man, a twice- born person may kill animals worthy ofbeing used for sacrifice.
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of gods and manes, for guests and preceptors as well as on the arrival of a great man, a twice- born person may kill animals worthy ofbeing used for sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of gods and manes, for guests and preceptors as well as on the arrival of a great man, a twice- born person may kill animals worthy ofbeing used for sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच हननस्तेयहिंसाश्च पानमन्याङ्गनारतिः । कर्म पञ्चविधं प्राहुर्दुष्कृतं धरणीपतेः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca hananasteyahiṃsāśca pānamanyāṅganāratiḥ / karma pañcavidhaṃ prāhurduṣkṛtaṃ dharaṇīpateḥ
verses.translation: Ifin an emergency a Brahmana eats the meat of an animal worthy ofbeing sacrificed, he is not blameworthy or sinful. Rites ordained should be performed and activities forbidden should be avoided.
verses.wordMeaning: Ifin an emergency a Brahmana eats the meat of an animal worthy ofbeing sacrificed, he is not blameworthy or sinful. Rites ordained should be performed and activities forbidden should be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ifin an emergency a Brahmana eats the meat of an animal worthy ofbeing sacrificed, he is not blameworthy or sinful. Rites ordained should be performed and activities forbidden should be avoided.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रगोतुरङ्गखरोष्ट्रकाः । चतुष्पदो ऽण्डजाब्जाश्च तिर्यचो ऽनस्थिकास्तथा
verses.transliteration: brahmakṣatriyaviṭśūdragoturaṅgakharoṣṭrakāḥ / catuṣpado 'ṇḍajābjāśca tiryaco 'nasthikāstathā
verses.translation: Thereupon, Brahma, the grand-father of all the worlds, divided the animals and human beings and allotted them to Devas severally.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Brahma, the grand-father of all the worlds, divided the animals and human beings and allotted them to Devas severally.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, Brahma, the grand-father of all the worlds, divided the animals and human beings and allotted them to Devas severally.

verses.sanskrit: अयुतं च सहस्रं च शतं दश तथा दश । दशपञ्चत्रिरेकार्धमानुपूर्व्यादिदं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ayutaṃ ca sahasraṃ ca śataṃ daśa tathā daśa / daśapañcatrirekārdhamānupūrvyādidaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Thereat, the great Sakti assisted by the groups of Bhutas (goblins) became furious. Then Brahma equipped with tactful policies, said to her.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereat, the great Sakti assisted by the groups of Bhutas (goblins) became furious. Then Brahma equipped with tactful policies, said to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereat, the great Sakti assisted by the groups of Bhutas (goblins) became furious. Then Brahma equipped with tactful policies, said to her.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां स्त्रीणामुक्तार्थे पापमादिशेत् । पितृमातृगुरुस्वामि पुत्राणां चैव निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: brahmakṣatraviśāṃ strīṇāmuktārthe pāpamādiśet / pitṛmātṛgurusvāmi putrāṇāṃ caiva niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing (the goddess) appearing in front, Brahma became afraid of the goblins. Fie bowed down with palms joined in reverence and repeatedly said "Be pleased". He then continued:
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing (the goddess) appearing in front, Brahma became afraid of the goblins. Fie bowed down with palms joined in reverence and repeatedly said "Be pleased". He then continued:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing (the goddess) appearing in front, Brahma became afraid of the goblins. Fie bowed down with palms joined in reverence and repeatedly said "Be pleased". He then continued:

verses.sanskrit: गुर्वाज्ञया कृतं पापं तदाज्ञालङ्घनेर्ऽथकम् । दशब्राह्मणभृत्यर्थमेकं हन्याद्द्विजं नृपः
verses.transliteration: gurvājñayā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tadājñālaṅghaner'thakam / daśabrāhmaṇabhṛtyarthamekaṃ hanyāddvijaṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: "Since you have appeared in front of me, I am con- tented and blessed. All these activities auspicious as well as inauspicious have been created by you.
verses.wordMeaning: "Since you have appeared in front of me, I am con- tented and blessed. All these activities auspicious as well as inauspicious have been created by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since you have appeared in front of me, I am con- tented and blessed. All these activities auspicious as well as inauspicious have been created by you.

verses.sanskrit: शतब्राह्मणभृत्यर्थं ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणं तु वा । पञ्चब्रह्मविदामर्थे त्रैश्यमेकं तु दण्डयेत्
verses.transliteration: śatabrāhmaṇabhṛtyarthaṃ brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaṃ tu vā / pañcabrahmavidāmarthe traiśyamekaṃ tu daṇḍayet
verses.translation: Srutis and Smrtis have been composed byyou alone. It is by you alone that all the subsidiary sacrifices in a great Kratu have been arranged and ordained but through me.
verses.wordMeaning: Srutis and Smrtis have been composed byyou alone. It is by you alone that all the subsidiary sacrifices in a great Kratu have been arranged and ordained but through me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srutis and Smrtis have been composed byyou alone. It is by you alone that all the subsidiary sacrifices in a great Kratu have been arranged and ordained but through me.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यं दशविशामर्थे विशां वा दण्डयेत्तथा । तथा शतविशामर्थे द्विजमेकं तु दण्डयेत्
verses.transliteration: vaiśyaṃ daśaviśāmarthe viśāṃ vā daṇḍayettathā / tathā śataviśāmarthe dvijamekaṃ tu daṇḍayet
verses.translation: May all those animals, O great goddess, allotted severally to the Devas be your own. Let them be for the satis- faction of Bhutas (goblins, and other living beings)."
verses.wordMeaning: May all those animals, O great goddess, allotted severally to the Devas be your own. Let them be for the satis- faction of Bhutas (goblins, and other living beings)."
verses.commentary: Sense: May all those animals, O great goddess, allotted severally to the Devas be your own. Let them be for the satis- faction of Bhutas (goblins, and other living beings)."

verses.sanskrit: शूद्राणां तु सहस्राणां दण्डयेद्ब्राह्मणं तु वा । तच्छतार्थं तु वा वैश्यं तद्दशार्द्धं तु शूद्रकम्
verses.transliteration: śūdrāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ daṇḍayedbrāhmaṇaṃ tu vā / tacchatārthaṃ tu vā vaiśyaṃ taddaśārddhaṃ tu śūdrakam
verses.translation: After saying this, Pitamaha (god Brahma) vanished from their presence. He performed great Kratus in accordance with the injunction laid down by her.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, Pitamaha (god Brahma) vanished from their presence. He performed great Kratus in accordance with the injunction laid down by her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Pitamaha (god Brahma) vanished from their presence. He performed great Kratus in accordance with the injunction laid down by her.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धूनां चैव मित्राणामिष्टार्थे तु त्रिपादकम् । अर्थं कलत्रपुत्रार्थे स्वात्मार्थे न तु किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: bandhūnāṃ caiva mitrāṇāmiṣṭārthe tu tripādakam / arthaṃ kalatraputrārthe svātmārthe na tu kiñcana
verses.translation: He performed the sacrifice for the great Sakti after killing animals fit for sacrifice. The different divisions ofthe
verses.wordMeaning: He performed the sacrifice for the great Sakti after killing animals fit for sacrifice. The different divisions ofthe
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the sacrifice for the great Sakti after killing animals fit for sacrifice. The different divisions ofthe

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं हन्तुमारब्धं ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियं विशम् । गां वा तुरगमन्यं वा हत्वा दोषैर्न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ hantumārabdhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ viśam / gāṃ vā turagamanyaṃ vā hatvā doṣairna lipyate
verses.translation: Excepting a Brahmana the women and the Sudras may accept meat. In cases of emergency even a Brahmana may consume it with the permission of the preceptor.
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting a Brahmana the women and the Sudras may accept meat. In cases of emergency even a Brahmana may consume it with the permission of the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting a Brahmana the women and the Sudras may accept meat. In cases of emergency even a Brahmana may consume it with the permission of the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मदारात्मजभ्रातृबन्धूनां च द्विजोत्तम । क्रमाद्दशगुणो दोषो रक्षणे च तथा फलम्
verses.transliteration: ātmadārātmajabhrātṛbandhūnāṃ ca dvijottama / kramāddaśaguṇo doṣo rakṣaṇe ca tathā phalam
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: भूपद्विजश्रोत्रियवेदविद्व्रतीवेदान्तविद्वेदविदां विनाशे । एकद्विपञ्चाशदथायुतं च स्यान्निष्कृतिश्चेति वदन्ति संतः
verses.transliteration: bhūpadvijaśrotriyavedavidvratīvedāntavidvedavidāṃ vināśe / ekadvipañcāśadathāyutaṃ ca syānniṣkṛtiśceti vadanti saṃtaḥ
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: तेषां च रक्षणविधौ हि कृते च दाने पूर्वोदितोत्तरगुणं प्रवदन्ति पुण्यम् । तेषां च दर्शनविधौ नमने चकार्ये शूश्रूषणे ऽपि चरतां सदृशांश्च तेषाम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ ca rakṣaṇavidhau hi kṛte ca dāne pūrvoditottaraguṇaṃ pravadanti puṇyam / teṣāṃ ca darśanavidhau namane cakārye śūśrūṣaṇe 'pi caratāṃ sadṛśāṃśca teṣām
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: सिंहव्याघ्रमृगादीनि लोकहिंसाकराणि तु । नृपो हन्याच्च सततं देवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थके
verses.transliteration: siṃhavyāghramṛgādīni lokahiṃsākarāṇi tu / nṛpo hanyācca satataṃ devārthe brāhmaṇārthake
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: आपत्स्वात्मार्थके चापि हत्वा मेध्यानि भक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: āpatsvātmārthake cāpi hatvā medhyāni bhakṣayet
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: नात्मार्थे पाचयेदन्न नात्मार्थे पाचयेत्पशून् । देवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा पचमानो न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: nātmārthe pācayedanna nātmārthe pācayetpaśūn / devārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā pacamāno na lipyate
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: पुरा भगवती माया जगदुज्जीवनोन्मुखी । ससर्ज सर्वदेवांश्च तथैवासुरमानुषान्
verses.transliteration: purā bhagavatī māyā jagadujjīvanonmukhī / sasarja sarvadevāṃśca tathaivāsuramānuṣān
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: तेषां संरक्षणार्थाय पशूनपि चतुर्दश । यज्ञाश्च तद्विधानानि कृत्वा चैनानुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya paśūnapi caturdaśa / yajñāśca tadvidhānāni kṛtvā cainānuvāca ha
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: यजध्वं पशुभिर्देवान्विधिनानेन मानवाः । इष्टानि ये प्रदास्यन्ति पुष्टास्ते यज्ञभाविताः
verses.transliteration: yajadhvaṃ paśubhirdevānvidhinānena mānavāḥ / iṣṭāni ye pradāsyanti puṣṭāste yajñabhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः । दरिद्रो नारकश्चैव भवेज्जन्मनि जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravartitaṃ cakraṃ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ / daridro nārakaścaiva bhavejjanmani janmani
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: देवतार्थे च पित्रर्थे तथैवाभ्यागते गुरौ । महदागमने चैव हन्यान्मेध्यान्पशून्द्विजः
verses.transliteration: devatārthe ca pitrarthe tathaivābhyāgate gurau / mahadāgamane caiva hanyānmedhyānpaśūndvijaḥ
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: आपत्सु ब्राह्मणो मांसं मेध्यमश्नन्न दोषभाक् । विहितानि तु कार्याणि प्रतिषिद्धानि वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: āpatsu brāhmaṇo māṃsaṃ medhyamaśnanna doṣabhāk / vihitāni tu kāryāṇi pratiṣiddhāni varjayet
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: पुराभूद्युवनाश्वस्य देवतानां महाक्रतुः । ममायमिति देवानां कलहः समजायत
verses.transliteration: purābhūdyuvanāśvasya devatānāṃ mahākratuḥ / mamāyamiti devānāṃ kalahaḥ samajāyata
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: तदा विभज्य देवानां मानुषांश्च पशूनपि । विभज्यैकैकशः प्रदाद्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: tadā vibhajya devānāṃ mānuṣāṃśca paśūnapi / vibhajyaikaikaśaḥ pradādbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु परमा शक्तिर्भूतसंधसहायिनी । कुपिताभूत्ततो ब्रह्मा तामुवाच नयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: tatastu paramā śaktirbhūtasaṃdhasahāyinī / kupitābhūttato brahmā tāmuvāca nayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूता समुद्वीक्ष्य भूतानन्दभयान्वितः । प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतस्तुत्वा प्रसीदेति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: prādurbhūtā samudvīkṣya bhūtānandabhayānvitaḥ / prāñjaliḥ praṇatastutvā prasīdeti punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूता यतो ऽसि त्वं कृतर्थो ऽस्मि पुरो मम । त्वयैतदखिलं कर्म निर्मितं सुशुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: prādurbhūtā yato 'si tvaṃ kṛtartho 'smi puro mama / tvayaitadakhilaṃ karma nirmitaṃ suśubhāśubham
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतयः स्मृतयश्चैव त्वयैव प्रतिपादिताः । त्वयैव कल्पिता यागा मन्मुखात्तु महाक्रतौ
verses.transliteration: śrutayaḥ smṛtayaścaiva tvayaiva pratipāditāḥ / tvayaiva kalpitā yāgā manmukhāttu mahākratau
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: ये विभक्तास्तु पशवो देवानां परमेश्वरि । ते सर्वे तावकाः संतुभूतानामपि तृप्तये
verses.transliteration: ye vibhaktāstu paśavo devānāṃ parameśvari / te sarve tāvakāḥ saṃtubhūtānāmapi tṛptaye
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे तेषां पुर एव पितामहः । तदुक्तेनैव विधिना चकार च महाक्रतून्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvāntardadhe teṣāṃ pura eva pitāmahaḥ / taduktenaiva vidhinā cakāra ca mahākratūn
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: इयाज च परां शक्तिं हत्वा मेध्यान्पशूनपि । तत्तद्विभागो वेदेषु प्रोक्तत्वादिह नोदितः
verses.transliteration: iyāja ca parāṃ śaktiṃ hatvā medhyānpaśūnapi / tattadvibhāgo vedeṣu proktatvādiha noditaḥ
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियः शुद्रास्तथा मांसमादद्युर्ब्राह्मणं विना । आपत्सु ब्राह्मणो वापि भक्षयेद्गुर्वनुज्ञया
verses.transliteration: striyaḥ śudrāstathā māṃsamādadyurbrāhmaṇaṃ vinā / āpatsu brāhmaṇo vāpi bhakṣayedgurvanujñayā
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: शिवोद्भवमिद पिण्डमत्यथ शिवतां गतम् । उद्बुध्यस्व पशो त्वं हि नाशिवः सञ्छिवो ह्यसि
verses.transliteration: śivodbhavamida piṇḍamatyatha śivatāṃ gatam / udbudhyasva paśo tvaṃ hi nāśivaḥ sañchivo hyasi
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: ईशः सर्वजगत्कर्ता प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा । यतो विश्वाधिको रुद्रस्तेन रुद्रो ऽसि वै पशो
verses.transliteration: īśaḥ sarvajagatkartā prabhavaḥ pralayastathā / yato viśvādhiko rudrastena rudro 'si vai paśo
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: अनेन तुरगं गा वा गजोष्ट्रमहिषादिकम् । आत्मार्थं वा परार्थं वा हत्वा दोषैर्न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: anena turagaṃ gā vā gajoṣṭramahiṣādikam / ātmārthaṃ vā parārthaṃ vā hatvā doṣairna lipyate
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: गृहानिष्टकरान्वापि नागाखुबलिवृश्चिकान् । एतद्गृहाश्रमस्थानां क्रियाफलमभीप्सताम् । मनःसंकल्पसिद्धानां महतां शिववर्चसाम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhāniṣṭakarānvāpi nāgākhubalivṛścikān / etadgṛhāśramasthānāṃ kriyāphalamabhīpsatām / manaḥsaṃkalpasiddhānāṃ mahatāṃ śivavarcasām
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: पशुयज्ञेन चान्येषामिष्टा पूर्तिकरं भवेत् । जपहोमार्चनाद्यैस्तु तेषामिष्टं च सिध्यति
verses.transliteration: paśuyajñena cānyeṣāmiṣṭā pūrtikaraṃ bhavet / japahomārcanādyaistu teṣāmiṣṭaṃ ca sidhyati
verses.translation: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.wordMeaning: (The Mantras to be uttered)
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Mantras to be uttered)

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने हिंसाद्यस्वरूपकथनं नाम षष्ठो ऽध्यायः इन्द्र उवाच भगवन्सर्वमाख्यातं हिंसाद्यस्य तु लक्षणम् । स्तेयस्य लक्षणं किं वा तन्मे विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne hiṃsādyasvarūpakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ indra uvāca bhagavansarvamākhyātaṃ hiṃsādyasya tu lakṣaṇam / steyasya lakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vā tanme vistarato vada
verses.translation: "O holy lord, the characteristic of violence has been entirely recounted. What is the characteristic feature of stealth? Tell me in detail".
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord, the characteristic of violence has been entirely recounted. What is the characteristic feature of stealth? Tell me in detail".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord, the characteristic of violence has been entirely recounted. What is the characteristic feature of stealth? Tell me in detail".

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच पापानामधिकं पापं हननं जीवजातिनाम् । एतस्मादधिकं पापं विश्वस्ते शरणं गते
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca pāpānāmadhikaṃ pāpaṃ hananaṃ jīvajātinām / etasmādadhikaṃ pāpaṃ viśvaste śaraṇaṃ gate
verses.translation: The theft of the property ofa person who has trusted you is a greater sin. One should never steal the wealth of a poor man whether he has trusted you or not.
verses.wordMeaning: The theft of the property ofa person who has trusted you is a greater sin. One should never steal the wealth of a poor man whether he has trusted you or not.
verses.commentary: Sense: The theft of the property ofa person who has trusted you is a greater sin. One should never steal the wealth of a poor man whether he has trusted you or not.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्य हत्वा पापिष्ठं शूद्रं वाप्यन्त्यजातिजम् । ब्रह्महत्याधिकं पापं तस्मान्नास्त्यस्य निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: viśvasya hatvā pāpiṣṭhaṃ śūdraṃ vāpyantyajātijam / brahmahatyādhikaṃ pāpaṃ tasmānnāstyasya niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, one who unhesitatingly kills the thief of gold, gems a.nd jewels of twice-born ones and deities (in temples) acquires the fruit ofa horse-sacrifice.
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, one who unhesitatingly kills the thief of gold, gems a.nd jewels of twice-born ones and deities (in temples) acquires the fruit ofa horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, one who unhesitatingly kills the thief of gold, gems a.nd jewels of twice-born ones and deities (in temples) acquires the fruit ofa horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मज्ञस्य दरिद्रस्य कृच्छ्रार्जितधनस्य च । बहुपुत्रकलत्रस्य तेन जीवितुमिच्छतः । तद्द्रव्यस्तेयदोषस्य प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmajñasya daridrasya kṛcchrārjitadhanasya ca / bahuputrakalatrasya tena jīvitumicchataḥ / taddravyasteyadoṣasya prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: On account of theft (in regard to the property) •cfthe preceptor, deity, Brahmana, one's own friend, son and others, the sin accruing in this order is ten times the preceding one.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of theft (in regard to the property) •cfthe preceptor, deity, Brahmana, one's own friend, son and others, the sin accruing in this order is ten times the preceding one.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of theft (in regard to the property) •cfthe preceptor, deity, Brahmana, one's own friend, son and others, the sin accruing in this order is ten times the preceding one.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्तद्रव्यहरणं तस्याप्यधिकमुच्यते । विश्वस्ते वाप्यविश्वस्ते न दरिद्रधनं हरेत्
verses.transliteration: viśvastadravyaharaṇaṃ tasyāpyadhikamucyate / viśvaste vāpyaviśvaste na daridradhanaṃ haret
verses.translation: The person who steals wealth from a Candala, a Sudra, a Vaisya, a Ksatriya and a Brahmana is defiled by sins ten times more dreadful in each case than the previous one.
verses.wordMeaning: The person who steals wealth from a Candala, a Sudra, a Vaisya, a Ksatriya and a Brahmana is defiled by sins ten times more dreadful in each case than the previous one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The person who steals wealth from a Candala, a Sudra, a Vaisya, a Ksatriya and a Brahmana is defiled by sins ten times more dreadful in each case than the previous one.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवद्विजातीनां हेमरत्नापहारकम् । यो हन्यादविचारेण सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tato devadvijātīnāṃ hemaratnāpahārakam / yo hanyādavicāreṇa so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: In this context they cite the following traditional legend. It is a greater secret than all other secrets. It is destruc- tive of all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: In this context they cite the following traditional legend. It is a greater secret than all other secrets. It is destruc- tive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this context they cite the following traditional legend. It is a greater secret than all other secrets. It is destruc- tive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुदेवद्विजसुहृत्पुत्रस्वात्मसुखेषु च । स्तेयादधःक्रमेणैव दशोत्तरगुणं त्वघम्
verses.transliteration: gurudevadvijasuhṛtputrasvātmasukheṣu ca / steyādadhaḥkrameṇaiva daśottaraguṇaṃ tvagham
verses.translation: The story illustrates how the fruit i.e. merit of good actions from theft of property it distributed among the parties concerned.
verses.wordMeaning: The story illustrates how the fruit i.e. merit of good actions from theft of property it distributed among the parties concerned.
verses.commentary: Sense: The story illustrates how the fruit i.e. merit of good actions from theft of property it distributed among the parties concerned.

verses.sanskrit: अन्त्यजात्पादजाद्वैश्यात्क्षत्रियाद्ब्राह्मणादपि । दशोत्तरगुणैः पापैर्लिप्यते धनहारकः
verses.transliteration: antyajātpādajādvaiśyātkṣatriyādbrāhmaṇādapi / daśottaraguṇaiḥ pāpairlipyate dhanahārakaḥ
verses.translation: In this city flourishing exceedingly with all sorts of riches, that thief starting with a small amount and proceeding ahead little by little amassed a great deal of money.
verses.wordMeaning: In this city flourishing exceedingly with all sorts of riches, that thief starting with a small amount and proceeding ahead little by little amassed a great deal of money.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this city flourishing exceedingly with all sorts of riches, that thief starting with a small amount and proceeding ahead little by little amassed a great deal of money.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । रहस्यातिरहस्यं च सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam / rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: Getting more and more wealth, he thus deposited it under the ground. After reaching home; the delighted Kirata said to* his wife.
verses.wordMeaning: Getting more and more wealth, he thus deposited it under the ground. After reaching home; the delighted Kirata said to* his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting more and more wealth, he thus deposited it under the ground. After reaching home; the delighted Kirata said to* his wife.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा काञ्चीपुरे जातो वज्राख्यो नाम चोरकः । तस्मिन्पुरवरे रम्ये सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्विताः । सर्वे नीरोगिणो दान्ताः सुखिनो दययाञ्चिताः
verses.transliteration: purā kāñcīpure jāto vajrākhyo nāma corakaḥ / tasminpuravare ramye sarvaiśvaryasamanvitāḥ / sarve nīrogiṇo dāntāḥ sukhino dayayāñcitāḥ
verses.translation: "As I was going about gathering firewood, O timo- /Tbus woman, this wealth was acquired by me at a lonely place / on the way. O lady seeking wealth, keep this safe."
verses.wordMeaning: "As I was going about gathering firewood, O timo- /Tbus woman, this wealth was acquired by me at a lonely place / on the way. O lady seeking wealth, keep this safe."
verses.commentary: Sense: "As I was going about gathering firewood, O timo- /Tbus woman, this wealth was acquired by me at a lonely place / on the way. O lady seeking wealth, keep this safe."

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्वर्यसमृद्धे ऽस्मिन्नगरे स तु तस्करः । स्तोकास्तोकक्रमेणैव बहुद्रव्यमपाहरत्
