verses.transliteration: sarvaiśvaryasamṛddhe 'sminnagare sa tu taskaraḥ / stokāstokakrameṇaiva bahudravyamapāharat
verses.translation: The Brahmana who passes by my house everyday saw me and said: — "Ere long you will be very fortunate".
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmana who passes by my house everyday saw me and said: — "Ere long you will be very fortunate".
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmana who passes by my house everyday saw me and said: — "Ere long you will be very fortunate".

verses.sanskrit: तदरण्ये ऽवटं कृत्वा स्थापयामास लोभतः । तद्गोपनं निशार्धायां तस्मिन्दूरं गते सति
verses.transliteration: tadaraṇye 'vaṭaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayāmāsa lobhataḥ / tadgopanaṃ niśārdhāyāṃ tasmindūraṃ gate sati
verses.translation: If one (you) were amidst the women of the first four castes one would rather be a king's beloved. But LaksmI, the goddess ofwealth, does not stay for a long time amongst Bhillas, Kiratas and Candalas as well as in the family of a Sailusa (Musician, actor, da ncer). This is due to the curse of sage Valmlki.
verses.wordMeaning: If one (you) were amidst the women of the first four castes one would rather be a king's beloved. But LaksmI, the goddess ofwealth, does not stay for a long time amongst Bhillas, Kiratas and Candalas as well as in the family of a Sailusa (Musician, actor, da ncer).…
verses.commentary: Sense: If one (you) were amidst the women of the first four castes one would rather be a king's beloved. But LaksmI, the goddess ofwealth, does not stay for a long time amongst Bhillas, Kiratas and Candalas as well as in the family of a Sailusa (Musician, actor, da ncer).…

verses.sanskrit: किरातः कश्चिदागत्य तं दृष्ट्वा तु दशांशतः । जहाराविदितस्तेन काष्ठभारं वहन्ययौ
verses.transliteration: kirātaḥ kaścidāgatya taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu daśāṃśataḥ / jahārāviditastena kāṣṭhabhāraṃ vahanyayau
verses.translation: Still in the case of one blessed by merits, the cause ofgrcat fortune, his statement can never be in vain, as seen before.
verses.wordMeaning: Still in the case of one blessed by merits, the cause ofgrcat fortune, his statement can never be in vain, as seen before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still in the case of one blessed by merits, the cause ofgrcat fortune, his statement can never be in vain, as seen before.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि तच्छिलयाच्छाद्य मृद्भिरापूर्ययत्नतः । पुनश्च तत्पुरं प्रायाद्वज्रो ऽपि धनतृष्मया
verses.transliteration: so 'pi tacchilayācchādya mṛdbhirāpūryayatnataḥ / punaśca tatpuraṃ prāyādvajro 'pi dhanatṛṣmayā
verses.translation: One should utilize for sacred activities that wealth which comes to him by chance. Hence build and dig splendid tanks, wells etc. with this amount."
verses.wordMeaning: One should utilize for sacred activities that wealth which comes to him by chance. Hence build and dig splendid tanks, wells etc. with this amount."
verses.commentary: Sense: One should utilize for sacred activities that wealth which comes to him by chance. Hence build and dig splendid tanks, wells etc. with this amount."

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुधनं त्दृत्वा निश्चिक्षेप महीतले । किरातो ऽपि गृहं प्राप्य बभाषे मुदितः प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahudhanaṃ tdṛtvā niścikṣepa mahītale / kirāto 'pi gṛhaṃ prāpya babhāṣe muditaḥ priyām
verses.translation: That tank became a very splendid and huge reser- voir ofwater that never dried up. In the middle of the bund, he built a big shrine of Sankara.
verses.wordMeaning: That tank became a very splendid and huge reser- voir ofwater that never dried up. In the middle of the bund, he built a big shrine of Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: That tank became a very splendid and huge reser- voir ofwater that never dried up. In the middle of the bund, he built a big shrine of Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: मया काष्ठं समाहर्तुं गच्छता पथि निर्जने । लब्धं धनमिदं भीरु समाधत्स्व धनार्थिनि
verses.transliteration: mayā kāṣṭhaṃ samāhartuṃ gacchatā pathi nirjane / labdhaṃ dhanamidaṃ bhīru samādhatsva dhanārthini
verses.translation: The forest that had been infested with many wild beasts was denuded. Thereby he prepared many excellent fields of very great value.
verses.wordMeaning: The forest that had been infested with many wild beasts was denuded. Thereby he prepared many excellent fields of very great value.
verses.commentary: Sense: The forest that had been infested with many wild beasts was denuded. Thereby he prepared many excellent fields of very great value.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा तत्समादाय निधायाभ्यन्तरे ततः । चिन्तयन्ती ततो वाक्यमिदं स्वपतिमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā tatsamādāya nidhāyābhyantare tataḥ / cintayantī tato vākyamidaṃ svapatimabravīt
verses.translation: On hearing the words ofNarada, all the messengers went back. Dvijavarma assumed a gaseous state and moved about in space for a' period of twelve years.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words ofNarada, all the messengers went back. Dvijavarma assumed a gaseous state and moved about in space for a' period of twelve years.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words ofNarada, all the messengers went back. Dvijavarma assumed a gaseous state and moved about in space for a' period of twelve years.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं संचरते विप्रो मामकानां गृहेषु यः । मां विलोक्यैवमचिराद्बहुभाग्यवती भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ saṃcarate vipro māmakānāṃ gṛheṣu yaḥ / māṃ vilokyaivamacirādbahubhāgyavatī bhavet
verses.translation: The sage said to his wife — "You have not committed any defect or sin. With the meritorious acts committed by you, go to the region of Brahma from this world."
verses.wordMeaning: The sage said to his wife — "You have not committed any defect or sin. With the meritorious acts committed by you, go to the region of Brahma from this world."
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage said to his wife — "You have not committed any defect or sin. With the meritorious acts committed by you, go to the region of Brahma from this world."

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यासु नरीषु स्थेयं चेद्राजवल्लभा । किं तु भिल्ले किराते च शैलूषे चान्त्यजातिजे । लक्ष्मीर्न तिष्ठति चिरं शापाद्वल्मीकजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: cāturvarṇyāsu narīṣu stheyaṃ cedrājavallabhā / kiṃ tu bhille kirāte ca śailūṣe cāntyajātije / lakṣmīrna tiṣṭhati ciraṃ śāpādvalmīkajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing her husband transformed to a gaseous state she did not relish the idea ofgoing to) the abode of Brahma. Attaining the state ofcomplete indifference to worldly affairs, she spoke thus to the sage.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her husband transformed to a gaseous state she did not relish the idea ofgoing to) the abode of Brahma. Attaining the state ofcomplete indifference to worldly affairs, she spoke thus to the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her husband transformed to a gaseous state she did not relish the idea ofgoing to) the abode of Brahma. Attaining the state ofcomplete indifference to worldly affairs, she spoke thus to the sage.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि बहुभाग्यानां पुण्यानामपि पात्रिणे । दृष्टपूर्वं तु तद्वाक्यं न कदाचिद्वृथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi bahubhāgyānāṃ puṇyānāmapi pātriṇe / dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tu tadvākyaṃ na kadācidvṛthā bhavet
verses.translation: For the sake of doing something pleasing to her husband, she performed rites of meditation and the repeti- tion ofthe great Mantras. Liberated from the sin of theft, he regained his physical body.
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of doing something pleasing to her husband, she performed rites of meditation and the repeti- tion ofthe great Mantras. Liberated from the sin of theft, he regained his physical body.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of doing something pleasing to her husband, she performed rites of meditation and the repeti- tion ofthe great Mantras. Liberated from the sin of theft, he regained his physical body.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वात्मप्रयासेन कृच्छ्राद्यल्लभ्यते धनम् । तदेव तिष्ठति चिरादन्यद्गच्छति कालतः
verses.transliteration: atha vātmaprayāsena kṛcchrādyallabhyate dhanam / tadeva tiṣṭhati cirādanyadgacchati kālataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words thus, Vajra and others said: —
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words thus, Vajra and others said: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words thus, Vajra and others said: —

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमागतवित्तं तु धर्मार्थैर्विनियोजयेत् । कुरुष्वैतेन तस्मात्त्वं वापीकूपादिकाञ्छुभान्
verses.transliteration: svayamāgatavittaṃ tu dharmārthairviniyojayet / kuruṣvaitena tasmāttvaṃ vāpīkūpādikāñchubhān
verses.translation: Name of a celebrated hymn in Vaj. Sarhhita XVI. 1-66. But how- was the Kirata lady regarded eligible for repeating Vedic Mantras?
verses.wordMeaning: Name of a celebrated hymn in Vaj. Sarhhita XVI. 1-66. But how- was the Kirata lady regarded eligible for repeating Vedic Mantras?
verses.commentary: Sense: Name of a celebrated hymn in Vaj. Sarhhita XVI. 1-66. But how- was the Kirata lady regarded eligible for repeating Vedic Mantras?

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भाविभाग्यप्रबोधितम् । बहूदकसमं देशं तत्र तत्र व्यलोकयत्
verses.transliteration: iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāvibhāgyaprabodhitam / bahūdakasamaṃ deśaṃ tatra tatra vyalokayat
verses.translation: O highly intelligent one, mention the divisions and the comparative merits of construction of bunds and other meritorious deeds. It is conducive to the increase ofmerit."
verses.wordMeaning: O highly intelligent one, mention the divisions and the comparative merits of construction of bunds and other meritorious deeds. It is conducive to the increase ofmerit."
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly intelligent one, mention the divisions and the comparative merits of construction of bunds and other meritorious deeds. It is conducive to the increase ofmerit."

verses.sanskrit: निर्ममे ऽथ महेन्द्रस्य दिग्भागे विमलोदकम् । सुबहुद्रव्यसं साध्यं तटाकं चाक्षयोदकम्
verses.transliteration: nirmame 'tha mahendrasya digbhāge vimalodakam / subahudravyasaṃ sādhyaṃ taṭākaṃ cākṣayodakam
verses.translation: "What is the nature of Asava? (Liquor). What is its defect? What is its merit? What type of cooked food is defective? Mention this in detail to me." 1
verses.wordMeaning: "What is the nature of Asava? (Liquor). What is its defect? What is its merit? What type of cooked food is defective? Mention this in detail to me." 1
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is the nature of Asava? (Liquor). What is its defect? What is its merit? What type of cooked food is defective? Mention this in detail to me." 1

verses.sanskrit: दत्तेषु कर्मकारिभ्यो निखिलेषु धनेषु च । असंबूर्णं तु तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा चिन्ताकुलो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: datteṣu karmakāribhyo nikhileṣu dhaneṣu ca / asaṃbūrṇaṃ tu tatkarma dṛṣṭvā cintākulo 'bhavat
verses.translation: The different types of intoxicating beverages are as follows: Paiffika (made from flour or rice), Talaja (from the date palm) Kaira (coconut palm -juice), Mddhuka (made from honey or Madhuka flowers), Gudasambhava (prepared from molasses). In regard to sinful nature the later ones mentioned above are half as dreadful as the earlier ones.
verses.wordMeaning: The different types of intoxicating beverages are as follows: Paiffika (made from flour or rice), Talaja (from the date palm) Kaira (coconut palm -juice), Mddhuka (made from honey or Madhuka flowers), Gudasambhava (prepared from molasses).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The different types of intoxicating beverages are as follows: Paiffika (made from flour or rice), Talaja (from the date palm) Kaira (coconut palm -juice), Mddhuka (made from honey or Madhuka flowers), Gudasambhava (prepared from molasses).…

verses.sanskrit: तं चोर वज्रनामानमज्ञातो ऽनुचराम्यहम् । तेनैव बहुधा क्षिप्तं धनं भूरि महीतले
verses.transliteration: taṃ cora vajranāmānamajñāto 'nucarāmyaham / tenaiva bahudhā kṣiptaṃ dhanaṃ bhūri mahītale
verses.translation: Asava can be used as a beverage by the three castes beginning with the Ksatriyas. Excepting a Brahmana lady,
verses.wordMeaning: Asava can be used as a beverage by the three castes beginning with the Ksatriyas. Excepting a Brahmana lady,
verses.commentary: Sense: Asava can be used as a beverage by the three castes beginning with the Ksatriyas. Excepting a Brahmana lady,

verses.sanskrit: स्तोकंस्तोकं हरिष्यामि तत्रतत्र धनं बहु । इति निश्चित्य मनसा तेनाज्ञातस्तमन्वगात्
verses.transliteration: stokaṃstokaṃ hariṣyāmi tatratatra dhanaṃ bahu / iti niścitya manasā tenājñātastamanvagāt
verses.translation: The ratio of drinking liquors in the case of four castes beginning with the Brahmanas shall be ten to eight or six to four. In the case of women it shall be half of the above. If they drink in the company of their husbands it shall be one-fourth of the above.
verses.wordMeaning: The ratio of drinking liquors in the case of four castes beginning with the Brahmanas shall be ten to eight or six to four. In the case of women it shall be half of the above. If they drink in the company of their husbands it shall be one-fourth of the above.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ratio of drinking liquors in the case of four castes beginning with the Brahmanas shall be ten to eight or six to four. In the case of women it shall be half of the above. If they drink in the company of their husbands it shall be one-fourth of the above.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवात्दृत्य तद्द्रव्यं तेन सेतुमपूरयत् । मध्ये जलावृतस्तेन प्रासादश्चापि शार्ङ्गिणः
verses.transliteration: tathaivātdṛtya taddravyaṃ tena setumapūrayat / madhye jalāvṛtastena prāsādaścāpi śārṅgiṇaḥ
verses.translation: LaksmI, Sarasvatl, GaurT, Candika, Tripura, Ambika Vaisnavl, Bhairavl, Kali and MahendrI are the Mothers.
verses.wordMeaning: LaksmI, Sarasvatl, GaurT, Candika, Tripura, Ambika Vaisnavl, Bhairavl, Kali and MahendrI are the Mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: LaksmI, Sarasvatl, GaurT, Candika, Tripura, Ambika Vaisnavl, Bhairavl, Kali and MahendrI are the Mothers.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तटाकमभूद्दिव्यमशोषितजलं महत् । सेतुमध्ये चकारासौ शङ्करायतनं महत्
verses.transliteration: tattaṭākamabhūddivyamaśoṣitajalaṃ mahat / setumadhye cakārāsau śaṅkarāyatanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: There are other Sakti goddesses. In worshipping them the liquor prepared from honey is approved of. A Brahmana who has mastered the Vedarigas shall perform worship without wine.
verses.wordMeaning: There are other Sakti goddesses. In worshipping them the liquor prepared from honey is approved of. A Brahmana who has mastered the Vedarigas shall perform worship without wine.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other Sakti goddesses. In worshipping them the liquor prepared from honey is approved of. A Brahmana who has mastered the Vedarigas shall perform worship without wine.

verses.sanskrit: काननं च क्षयं नीतं बहुसत्त्वसमाकुलम् । तेनाग्र्याणि महार्हाणि क्षेत्राण्यपि चकार सः
verses.transliteration: kānanaṃ ca kṣayaṃ nītaṃ bahusattvasamākulam / tenāgryāṇi mahārhāṇi kṣetrāṇyapi cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: Those who are unattached to worldly objects attain
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are unattached to worldly objects attain
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are unattached to worldly objects attain

verses.sanskrit: देवताभ्यो द्विजेभ्यश्च पदत्तानि विभज्य वै । ब्राह्मणांश्च समामन्त्र्य देवव्रातमुखान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: devatābhyo dvijebhyaśca padattāni vibhajya vai / brāhmaṇāṃśca samāmantrya devavrātamukhānbahūn
verses.translation: This remembrance of the fact ofthe supreme power (para-Sakti) is prescribed as the expiation for all sins com- mitted cither knowingly or unknowingly.
verses.wordMeaning: This remembrance of the fact ofthe supreme power (para-Sakti) is prescribed as the expiation for all sins com- mitted cither knowingly or unknowingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: This remembrance of the fact ofthe supreme power (para-Sakti) is prescribed as the expiation for all sins com- mitted cither knowingly or unknowingly.

verses.sanskrit: संतोष्य हेमवस्त्राद्यैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् । क्व चाहं वीरदत्ताख्यः किरातः काष्ठविक्रयी
verses.transliteration: saṃtoṣya hemavastrādyairidaṃ vacanamabravīt / kva cāhaṃ vīradattākhyaḥ kirātaḥ kāṣṭhavikrayī
verses.translation: The base fellow who drinks liquor without worship- ping Para Sakti shall stay in hell called Raurava for a period calculated at the rate of a year for every drop so- consumed.
verses.wordMeaning: The base fellow who drinks liquor without worship- ping Para Sakti shall stay in hell called Raurava for a period calculated at the rate of a year for every drop so- consumed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The base fellow who drinks liquor without worship- ping Para Sakti shall stay in hell called Raurava for a period calculated at the rate of a year for every drop so- consumed.

verses.sanskrit: इति ब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने स्तेयपानकथनं नाम सप्तमो ऽध्यायः इन्द्र उवाच अगम्यागमनं किं वा को दोषः का च निष्कृतिः । एतन्मे मुनिशार्दूल विस्तराद्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: iti brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne steyapānakathanaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ indra uvāca agamyāgamanaṃ kiṃ vā ko doṣaḥ kā ca niṣkṛtiḥ / etanme muniśārdūla vistarādvaktumarhasi
verses.translation: One's own mother, sister, wife of the preceptor and the wife of one's maternal uncle — if one carnally approaches any ofthese, there is no means ofexpiation (for this sin).
verses.wordMeaning: One's own mother, sister, wife of the preceptor and the wife of one's maternal uncle — if one carnally approaches any ofthese, there is no means ofexpiation (for this sin).

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच अगम्यागमनं नाम मातृस्वसृगुरुस्त्रियः । मातुलस्य प्रिया चेति गत्वेमा नास्ति निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca agamyāgamanaṃ nāma mātṛsvasṛgurustriyaḥ / mātulasya priyā ceti gatvemā nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The sin in carnally approaching one's sister is the same as in the case of contact with one's mother. The same is the result in contacting the wife of the preceptor. And the pre- ceptors are of various types.
verses.wordMeaning: The sin in carnally approaching one's sister is the same as in the case of contact with one's mother. The same is the result in contacting the wife of the preceptor. And the pre- ceptors are of various types.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin in carnally approaching one's sister is the same as in the case of contact with one's mother. The same is the result in contacting the wife of the preceptor. And the pre- ceptors are of various types.

verses.sanskrit: मातृसङ्गे तु यदघं तदेव स्वसृसङ्गमे । गुरुस्त्रीसंगमे तद्वद्गुरवो बहवः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: mātṛsaṅge tu yadaghaṃ tadeva svasṛsaṅgame / gurustrīsaṃgame tadvadguravo bahavaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Beginning with Brahmopadesu (i.e. imparting the Gayatrl Mantra) and ending with (the exposition) of the Vedanta philosophy, if everything is taught by one person alone, he is called Maftazu.ru (Great preceptor).
verses.wordMeaning: Beginning with Brahmopadesu (i.e. imparting the Gayatrl Mantra) and ending with (the exposition) of the Vedanta philosophy, if everything is taught by one person alone, he is called Maftazu.ru (Great preceptor).
verses.commentary: Sense: Beginning with Brahmopadesu (i.e. imparting the Gayatrl Mantra) and ending with (the exposition) of the Vedanta philosophy, if everything is taught by one person alone, he is called Maftazu.ru (Great preceptor).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोपदेशमारभ्य यावद्वेदान्तदर्शनम् । एकेन वक्ष्यते येन स महागुरुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmopadeśamārabhya yāvadvedāntadarśanam / ekena vakṣyate yena sa mahāgururucyate
verses.translation: If one carnally approaches the Guru's wife, it is the ruin ofhis soul. Ifthe wife of Acarya is defiled, one should perform Krcchra and Atikrcchra rites for twelve years, each of them lasting for six years.
verses.wordMeaning: If one carnally approaches the Guru's wife, it is the ruin ofhis soul. Ifthe wife of Acarya is defiled, one should perform Krcchra and Atikrcchra rites for twelve years, each of them lasting for six years.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one carnally approaches the Guru's wife, it is the ruin ofhis soul. Ifthe wife of Acarya is defiled, one should perform Krcchra and Atikrcchra rites for twelve years, each of them lasting for six years.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोपदेशमेकत्र वेदशास्त्राण्यथैकतः । आचार्यः स तु विज्ञेयस्तदेकैकास्तु देशिकाः
verses.transliteration: brahmopadeśamekatra vedaśāstrāṇyathaikataḥ / ācāryaḥ sa tu vijñeyastadekaikāstu deśikāḥ
verses.translation: Ifa person, out ofdelusion, desires to cohabit with his wife during her monthly course, he shall become purified (after the act) only by taking bath, wearing new clothes and performing expiatory rites mentioned before.
verses.wordMeaning: Ifa person, out ofdelusion, desires to cohabit with his wife during her monthly course, he shall become purified (after the act) only by taking bath, wearing new clothes and performing expiatory rites mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ifa person, out ofdelusion, desires to cohabit with his wife during her monthly course, he shall become purified (after the act) only by taking bath, wearing new clothes and performing expiatory rites mentioned before.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोरात्मान्तमेव स्यादायार्यस्य प्रियागमे । द्वादशाब्दं चरेत्कृच्छ३मेकैकं तु षडब्दतः
verses.transliteration: gurorātmāntameva syādāyāryasya priyāgame / dvādaśābdaṃ caretkṛccha3mekaikaṃ tu ṣaḍabdataḥ
verses.translation: After fasting for the remaining part of the day, he should take bath and perform religious rites. In the case of sexual contact with other women also, everything should be performed similarly.
verses.wordMeaning: After fasting for the remaining part of the day, he should take bath and perform religious rites. In the case of sexual contact with other women also, everything should be performed similarly.
verses.commentary: Sense: After fasting for the remaining part of the day, he should take bath and perform religious rites. In the case of sexual contact with other women also, everything should be performed similarly.

verses.sanskrit: मातुलस्य प्रियां गत्वा षडब्दं कृच्छ्रमाचरेत् । ब्राह्मणस्तु सजातीयां प्रमदां यदि गच्छति
verses.transliteration: mātulasya priyāṃ gatvā ṣaḍabdaṃ kṛcchramācaret / brāhmaṇastu sajātīyāṃ pramadāṃ yadi gacchati
verses.translation: Ifa person cohabits with a virgin without the legiti- mate marital rites, but with the permission of her parents, he shall become purified by observing fast for three nights. Further, he must marry only that girl.
verses.wordMeaning: Ifa person cohabits with a virgin without the legiti- mate marital rites, but with the permission of her parents, he shall become purified by observing fast for three nights. Further, he must marry only that girl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ifa person cohabits with a virgin without the legiti- mate marital rites, but with the permission of her parents, he shall become purified by observing fast for three nights. Further, he must marry only that girl.

verses.sanskrit: उपोषितस्त्रिरात्रं तु प्राणायामशतं चरेत् । कुलटां तु सजातीयां त्रिरात्रेण विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: upoṣitastrirātraṃ tu prāṇāyāmaśataṃ caret / kulaṭāṃ tu sajātīyāṃ trirātreṇa viśudhyati
verses.translation: If any one cohabits with a virgin given in marriage to another, he becomes purified after a quarter of the day.* If anyone carnally approaches a virgin with the permission of her parents he becomes purified in halfa day.**
verses.wordMeaning: If any one cohabits with a virgin given in marriage to another, he becomes purified after a quarter of the day.* If anyone carnally approaches a virgin with the permission of her parents he becomes purified in halfa day.**
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one cohabits with a virgin given in marriage to another, he becomes purified after a quarter of the day.* If anyone carnally approaches a virgin with the permission of her parents he becomes purified in halfa day.**

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाहात्क्षत्रियाङ्गत्वा सप्ताहा द्वैश्यजामपि । चक्रीकिरातकैवर्तकर्मकारादियोषितः
verses.transliteration: pañcāhātkṣatriyāṅgatvā saptāhā dvaiśyajāmapi / cakrīkirātakaivartakarmakārādiyoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Ifa person with the knowledge of his parents co- habits with a girl for a month even when she is a virgin, he
verses.wordMeaning: Ifa person with the knowledge of his parents co- habits with a girl for a month even when she is a virgin, he
verses.commentary: Sense: Ifa person with the knowledge of his parents co- habits with a girl for a month even when she is a virgin, he

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धिः स्याद्द्वादशाहेन धराशक्त्यर्चनेन च । अनन्त्यजां ब्राह्मणो गत्वा प्रमादादब्दतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: śuddhiḥ syāddvādaśāhena dharāśaktyarcanena ca / anantyajāṃ brāhmaṇo gatvā pramādādabdataḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: But she must get blessings of Brahmanas and perform marital rites. Rites of renunciation* (?) should be performed. So also the rites laid down in Srutis, Smrtis etc.
verses.wordMeaning: But she must get blessings of Brahmanas and perform marital rites. Rites of renunciation* (?) should be performed. So also the rites laid down in Srutis, Smrtis etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: But she must get blessings of Brahmanas and perform marital rites. Rites of renunciation* (?) should be performed. So also the rites laid down in Srutis, Smrtis etc.

verses.sanskrit: देवदासी ब्रह्मदासी स्वतन्त्राशूद्रदासिका । दासी चतुर्विधा प्रोक्ता द्वे चाद्ये क्षत्रियासमे
verses.transliteration: devadāsī brahmadāsī svatantrāśūdradāsikā / dāsī caturvidhā proktā dve cādye kṣatriyāsame
verses.translation: The entire universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings, beginning with Brahma and ending with an ant, is said to be evolved out of the five elements and is endow- ed with four instincts.
verses.wordMeaning: The entire universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings, beginning with Brahma and ending with an ant, is said to be evolved out of the five elements and is endow- ed with four instincts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings, beginning with Brahma and ending with an ant, is said to be evolved out of the five elements and is endow- ed with four instincts.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यावेश्याङ्गनातुल्या तदन्या हीनजातिवत् । आत्मदासीं द्विजो मोहादुक्तार्थे दोषमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: anyāveśyāṅganātulyā tadanyā hīnajātivat / ātmadāsīṃ dvijo mohāduktārthe doṣamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: One should be endowed with devotion and faith.
verses.wordMeaning: One should be endowed with devotion and faith.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should be endowed with devotion and faith.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्त्रीमृतुमतीं गत्वा प्राजापत्यं चरेद्व्रतम् । द्विगुणेन परां नारीं चतुर्भिः क्षत्रियाङ्गनाम्
verses.transliteration: svastrīmṛtumatīṃ gatvā prājāpatyaṃ caredvratam / dviguṇena parāṃ nārīṃ caturbhiḥ kṣatriyāṅganām
verses.translation: By propitiating parasakti, one gets liberated from all* sins. Thereby the sins committed in the course of ten million Kalpas perish. He gets rid of all calamities and obtains alL ambitions. "
verses.wordMeaning: By propitiating parasakti, one gets liberated from all* sins. Thereby the sins committed in the course of ten million Kalpas perish. He gets rid of all calamities and obtains alL ambitions. "
verses.commentary: Sense: By propitiating parasakti, one gets liberated from all* sins. Thereby the sins committed in the course of ten million Kalpas perish. He gets rid of all calamities and obtains alL ambitions. "

verses.sanskrit: अष्टभिर्वैश्यनारीं च शूद्रां षौडशभिस्तथा । द्वात्रिंशता संकरजां वेश्यां शूद्रामिवाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭabhirvaiśyanārīṃ ca śūdrāṃ ṣauḍaśabhistathā / dvātriṃśatā saṃkarajāṃ veśyāṃ śūdrāmivācaret
verses.translation: "O Holy lord, conversant with all holy rites and pious activities, O holy sage, engaged in the welfare of all living
verses.wordMeaning: "O Holy lord, conversant with all holy rites and pious activities, O holy sage, engaged in the welfare of all living
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Holy lord, conversant with all holy rites and pious activities, O holy sage, engaged in the welfare of all living

verses.sanskrit: रजस्वलां तु यो भार्यां मोहतो गन्तुमिच्छति । स्नात्वान्यवस्त्रसंयुक्तमुक्तार्थेनैव शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: rajasvalāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ mohato gantumicchati / snātvānyavastrasaṃyuktamuktārthenaiva śudhyati
verses.translation: The esoteric fifteen-lettered mantra of Parasakti is: Ha Sa Ka La
verses.wordMeaning: The esoteric fifteen-lettered mantra of Parasakti is: Ha Sa Ka La
verses.commentary: Sense: The esoteric fifteen-lettered mantra of Parasakti is: Ha Sa Ka La

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्य तच्छेषदिनं स्नात्वा कर्म समाचरेत् । तथैवान्याङ्गनां गत्वा तदुक्तार्थं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: upoṣya taccheṣadinaṃ snātvā karma samācaret / tathaivānyāṅganāṃ gatvā taduktārthaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: The remaining chapter discusses the last Maliapataka viz associa- tion with those who have committed one of the Mahapatakas. As in the case ofincest, Smrtis like Manu XI. 181, Yaj III 261 etc. have prescribed different penances for such sinners but there is no unanimity among them.
verses.wordMeaning: The remaining chapter discusses the last Maliapataka viz associa- tion with those who have committed one of the Mahapatakas. As in the case ofincest, Smrtis like Manu XI. 181, Yaj III 261 etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The remaining chapter discusses the last Maliapataka viz associa- tion with those who have committed one of the Mahapatakas. As in the case ofincest, Smrtis like Manu XI. 181, Yaj III 261 etc.…

verses.sanskrit: पित्रोरनुज्ञया कन्यां यो गच्छेद्विधिना विना । त्रिरात्रोपोषणाच्छुद्धिस्तामेवोद्वाहयेत्तदा
verses.transliteration: pitroranujñayā kanyāṃ yo gacchedvidhinā vinā / trirātropoṣaṇācchuddhistāmevodvāhayettadā
verses.translation: "The sin due to contact is mentioned to be offour kinds: Kartd (the perpetrator) is the most important one. The others in due order are Sahakrt (collaborator), Nimitta
verses.wordMeaning: "The sin due to contact is mentioned to be offour kinds: Kartd (the perpetrator) is the most important one. The others in due order are Sahakrt (collaborator), Nimitta
verses.commentary: Sense: "The sin due to contact is mentioned to be offour kinds: Kartd (the perpetrator) is the most important one. The others in due order are Sahakrt (collaborator), Nimitta

verses.sanskrit: कन्यां दत्त्वा तु यो ऽन्यस्मै दत्ता यश्चानुयच्छति । पित्रोरनुज्ञया पाददिनार्धेन विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: kanyāṃ dattvā tu yo 'nyasmai dattā yaścānuyacchati / pitroranujñayā pādadinārdhena viśudhyati
verses.translation: The sin of these shall be thus: that of the latter is one-tenth of the preceding one. One's purity is in accordance with the manner mentioned before.
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of these shall be thus: that of the latter is one-tenth of the preceding one. One's purity is in accordance with the manner mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of these shall be thus: that of the latter is one-tenth of the preceding one. One's purity is in accordance with the manner mentioned before.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातः पितृभ्यां यो मासं कन्याभावे तु गच्छति । वृषलः स तु विज्ञेयः सर्वकर्मबहिष्कृतः
verses.transliteration: jñātaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ yo māsaṃ kanyābhāve tu gacchati / vṛṣalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The sin ofthepeople selling the following things 1 2 becomes reduced to the tenth from the earlier to the later in the order in which they are mentioned •
verses.wordMeaning: The sin ofthepeople selling the following things 1 2 becomes reduced to the tenth from the earlier to the later in the order in which they are mentioned •
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin ofthepeople selling the following things 1 2 becomes reduced to the tenth from the earlier to the later in the order in which they are mentioned •

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातः पितृभ्यां यो गत्वा परोढां तद्विनाशने । विधवा जायते नेयं पूर्वगन्तारमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: jñātaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ yo gatvā paroḍhāṃ tadvināśane / vidhavā jāyate neyaṃ pūrvagantāramāpnuyāt
verses.translation: VV. 41-45. list the prohibited things for sale.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 41-45. list the prohibited things for sale.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 41-45. list the prohibited things for sale.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहाद्द्विजातीनामुद्वाहविधिना तथा । त्यागकर्माणि कुर्वीत श्रौतस्मार्तादिकानि च
verses.transliteration: anugrahāddvijātīnāmudvāhavidhinā tathā / tyāgakarmāṇi kurvīta śrautasmārtādikāni ca
verses.translation: W. 46-59 throw light on complex social situation in ancient India and the superstition of pollution by sight.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 46-59 throw light on complex social situation in ancient India and the superstition of pollution by sight.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 46-59 throw light on complex social situation in ancient India and the superstition of pollution by sight.

verses.sanskrit: आदावुद्वाहिता वापि तद्विनाशे ऽन्यदः पिता । भोगेच्छोः साधनं सा तु न येग्याखिलकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: ādāvudvāhitā vāpi tadvināśe 'nyadaḥ pitā / bhogecchoḥ sādhanaṃ sā tu na yegyākhilakarmasu
verses.translation: If a woman eats the food of a Bruva etc., she shall feed Brahmanas for a day. If a Brahmana takes their food in an emergency, he is not defiled thereby.
verses.wordMeaning: If a woman eats the food of a Bruva etc., she shall feed Brahmanas for a day. If a Brahmana takes their food in an emergency, he is not defiled thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a woman eats the food of a Bruva etc., she shall feed Brahmanas for a day. If a Brahmana takes their food in an emergency, he is not defiled thereby.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिपिपीलकान्तं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । पञ्चभूतात्मकं प्रोक्तं चतुर्वासनयान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: brahmādipipīlakāntaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam / pañcabhūtātmakaṃ proktaṃ caturvāsanayānvitam
verses.translation: Ifa person takes food inspired seven times by the mantra ldarh Visnu etc. (RV. 1-22-17) and meditates over it with the idea "I am He", he shall not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Ifa person takes food inspired seven times by the mantra ldarh Visnu etc. (RV. 1-22-17) and meditates over it with the idea "I am He", he shall not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ifa person takes food inspired seven times by the mantra ldarh Visnu etc. (RV. 1-22-17) and meditates over it with the idea "I am He", he shall not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: जन्माद्याहारमथननिद्राभीत्यश्च सर्वदा । आहारेण विना जन्तुर्नाहारो मदनात्स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: janmādyāhāramathananidrābhītyaśca sarvadā / āhāreṇa vinā janturnāhāro madanātsmṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: दुस्तरो मदनस्तस्मात्सर्वेषां प्राणिनामपि । पुन्नारीरूपवत्कृत्वा मदननेनैव विश्वसृक्
verses.transliteration: dustaro madanastasmātsarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi / punnārīrūpavatkṛtvā madananenaiva viśvasṛk
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिमकरोदादौ सृष्टिस्थितिलयात्मिकाम् । तत्प्रवृत्त्या प्रवर्तन्ते तन्निवृत्त्याक्षयां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: pravṛttimakarodādau sṛṣṭisthitilayātmikām / tatpravṛttyā pravartante tannivṛttyākṣayāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्त्यैव यथा मुक्तिं प्राप्नुयुर्ये न धीयुताः । तद्रहस्यं तदोपायं शृणु वक्ष्यामि सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: pravṛttyaiva yathā muktiṃ prāpnuyurye na dhīyutāḥ / tadrahasyaṃ tadopāyaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
