verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा प्रोक्षयेदन्नमब्लिङ्गैः पावमानिकैः । अन्नसूक्तं जपित्वा तु भृगुर्वै वारुणीति च
verses.transliteration: athavā prokṣayedannamabliṅgaiḥ pāvamānikaiḥ / annasūktaṃ japitvā tu bhṛgurvai vāruṇīti ca
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मार्पणमिति श्लोकं जप्त्वा नियममाश्रितः । उपोष्य रजनीमेकां ततः शुद्धो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: brahmārpaṇamiti ślokaṃ japtvā niyamamāśritaḥ / upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ tataḥ śuddho bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्री भुक्त्वा तु ब्रुवाद्यन्नमेकाद्यान्भोजये द्द्विजान् । आपदि ब्राह्मणो ह्येषामन्नं भुक्त्वा न दोषभाक्
verses.transliteration: strī bhuktvā tu bruvādyannamekādyānbhojaye ddvijān / āpadi brāhmaṇo hyeṣāmannaṃ bhuktvā na doṣabhāk
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: इदं विष्णुरिति मन्त्रेण सप्तवाराभिमन्त्रितम् । सो ऽहंभावेन तद्ध्यात्वा भुक्त्वा दोषैर्न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: idaṃ viṣṇuriti mantreṇa saptavārābhimantritam / so 'haṃbhāvena taddhyātvā bhuktvā doṣairna lipyate
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा शङ्करं ध्यायञ्जप्त्वा त्रैय्यंबकं मनुम् । सो ऽहंभावेन तज्ज्ञानान्न दोषैः प्रविलिप्यते
verses.transliteration: athavā śaṅkaraṃ dhyāyañjaptvā traiyyaṃbakaṃ manum / so 'haṃbhāvena tajjñānānna doṣaiḥ pravilipyate
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: इदं रहस्यं देवेन्द्र शृणुष्व वचनं मम । ध्यात्वा देवीं परां शक्तिं जप्त्वा पञ्चदशाक्षरीम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ rahasyaṃ devendra śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ mama / dhyātvā devīṃ parāṃ śaktiṃ japtvā pañcadaśākṣarīm
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: तन्निवेदितबुद्ध्यादौ यो ऽश्नाति प्रत्यहं द्विजः । नास्यान्नदोषजं किञ्चिन्न दारिद्रयभयं तथा
verses.transliteration: tanniveditabuddhyādau yo 'śnāti pratyahaṃ dvijaḥ / nāsyānnadoṣajaṃ kiñcinna dāridrayabhayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: न व्याधिजं भयं तस्य न च शत्रुभयं तथा । जपतो मुक्तिरेवास्य सदा सर्वत्र मङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: na vyādhijaṃ bhayaṃ tasya na ca śatrubhayaṃ tathā / japato muktirevāsya sadā sarvatra maṅgalam
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: एष ते कथितः शक्र पापानामपि विस्तरः । प्रायश्चित्तं तथा तेषां किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: eṣa te kathitaḥ śakra pāpānāmapi vistaraḥ / prāyaścittaṃ tathā teṣāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi
verses.translation: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall meditate on Sankara, repeat the Mantra Tryambakam etc. (RV. 7-59-12) and meditate over it with the idea "I am He", he does not become defiled.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने ऽष्टमो ऽध्यायः इन्द्र उवाच भगवन्सर्व धर्मज्ञ त्रिकालज्ञानवित्तम । दुष्कृतं तत्प्रतीकारो भवता सम्यगीरितः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne 'ṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ indra uvāca bhagavansarva dharmajña trikālajñānavittama / duṣkṛtaṃ tatpratīkāro bhavatā samyagīritaḥ
verses.translation: O holy lord, conversant with all types of holy duties, the foremost among those who know the (events of the) three units of time (i.e. past, present and future); sinful activities and the means of remedy, thereofhave been perfectly recounted by you.
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, conversant with all types of holy duties, the foremost among those who know the (events of the) three units of time (i.e. past, present and future); sinful activities and the means of remedy, thereofhave been perfectly recounted by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, conversant with all types of holy duties, the foremost among those who know the (events of the) three units of time (i.e. past, present and future); sinful activities and the means of remedy, thereofhave been perfectly recounted by you.

verses.sanskrit: केन कर्मविपाकेन ममापदि यमागता । प्रायश्चित्तं च किं तस्य गदस्व वदतां वर
verses.transliteration: kena karmavipākena mamāpadi yamāgatā / prāyaścittaṃ ca kiṃ tasya gadasva vadatāṃ vara
verses.translation: The story of Indra killing liis preceptor TriSiras or ViSvajit on the suspicion ofhis complicity with Daityas and the consequent pursuit by Brahma-hatya (the sin of Brahmana murder) and Lord Naravana's division, of Indra's sin of Brahniahatya among women, trees and the earth is found in Mbh. Udyoga 9-3-4; Sdnti 342.32-34 and 41 and Udyoga 9.43 southern recension and other Puranas.
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Indra killing liis preceptor TriSiras or ViSvajit on the suspicion ofhis complicity with Daityas and the consequent pursuit by Brahma-hatya (the sin of Brahmana murder) and Lord Naravana's division, of Indra's sin of Brahniahatya among women,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Indra killing liis preceptor TriSiras or ViSvajit on the suspicion ofhis complicity with Daityas and the consequent pursuit by Brahma-hatya (the sin of Brahmana murder) and Lord Naravana's division, of Indra's sin of Brahniahatya among women,…

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच काश्यपस्य ततो जज्ञे दित्यां दनुरिति स्मृतः । कन्या रूपवती नाम धात्रे तां प्रददौ पिता
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiruvāca kāśyapasya tato jajñe dityāṃ danuriti smṛtaḥ / kanyā rūpavatī nāma dhātre tāṃ pradadau pitā
verses.translation: Then the lord of Daityas chose the son of Bhrgu (i.e. Sukra) as his priest. You were appointed here in the kingdom ofthe Devas as Vasava.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the lord of Daityas chose the son of Bhrgu (i.e. Sukra) as his priest. You were appointed here in the kingdom ofthe Devas as Vasava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord of Daityas chose the son of Bhrgu (i.e. Sukra) as his priest. You were appointed here in the kingdom ofthe Devas as Vasava.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पुत्रस्ततो जातो विश्वरूपो महाद्युतिः । नारायणपरो नित्यं वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ putrastato jāto viśvarūpo mahādyutiḥ / nārāyaṇaparo nityaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
verses.translation: Prior to this when you were in Sudharma (the Assembly Hall of Devas), a certain question was put by you in the presence of sages.
verses.wordMeaning: Prior to this when you were in Sudharma (the Assembly Hall of Devas), a certain question was put by you in the presence of sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prior to this when you were in Sudharma (the Assembly Hall of Devas), a certain question was put by you in the presence of sages.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दैत्येश्वरो वव्रे भृगुपुत्रं पुरोहितम् । भवानधिकृतो राज्ये देवानामिव वासवः
verses.transliteration: tato daityeśvaro vavre bhṛguputraṃ purohitam / bhavānadhikṛto rājye devānāmiva vāsavaḥ
verses.translation: "Which is better, worldly existence or pilgrimage? What is its excellence? Be pleased to bless me with a decisive answer."
verses.wordMeaning: "Which is better, worldly existence or pilgrimage? What is its excellence? Be pleased to bless me with a decisive answer."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Which is better, worldly existence or pilgrimage? What is its excellence? Be pleased to bless me with a decisive answer."

verses.sanskrit: ततः पूर्वे च काले तु सुधर्मायां त्वयि स्थिते । त्वया कश्चित्कृतः प्रश्न ऋषीणां सन्निधौ तदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pūrve ca kāle tu sudharmāyāṃ tvayi sthite / tvayā kaścitkṛtaḥ praśna ṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau tadā
verses.translation: " G o immediately to Karmabhumi, "Land of holy
verses.wordMeaning: " G o immediately to Karmabhumi, "Land of holy
verses.commentary: Sense: " G o immediately to Karmabhumi, "Land of holy

verses.sanskrit: संसारस्तीर्थयात्रा वा को ऽधिको ऽस्ति तयोर्गुमः । वदन्तु तद्विनिश्चित्य भवन्तो मदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: saṃsārastīrthayātrā vā ko 'dhiko 'sti tayorgumaḥ / vadantu tadviniścitya bhavanto madanugrahāt
verses.translation: The priest of great power of penance did not have any excessive enmity towards Daityas. At that time the lord ofDaityas and Vasava became equally powerful.
verses.wordMeaning: The priest of great power of penance did not have any excessive enmity towards Daityas. At that time the lord ofDaityas and Vasava became equally powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: The priest of great power of penance did not have any excessive enmity towards Daityas. At that time the lord ofDaityas and Vasava became equally powerful.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रश्नस्योत्तरं वक्तुं ते सर्व उपचक्रिरे । तत्पूर्वमेव कथितं मया विधिबलेन वै
verses.transliteration: tatpraśnasyottaraṃ vaktuṃ te sarva upacakrire / tatpūrvameva kathitaṃ mayā vidhibalena vai
verses.translation: Then once O king, you became very furious and desired to kill the nephew of the lord of Danavas. With that desire you hastened to the forest where he was practising penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Then once O king, you became very furious and desired to kill the nephew of the lord of Danavas. With that desire you hastened to the forest where he was practising penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then once O king, you became very furious and desired to kill the nephew of the lord of Danavas. With that desire you hastened to the forest where he was practising penance.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थ यात्रा समधिका संसारादिति च द्रुतम् । तच्छ्रुत्वा ते प्रकुपिताः शेपुर्मामृषयो ऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: tīrtha yātrā samadhikā saṃsārāditi ca drutam / tacchrutvā te prakupitāḥ śepurmāmṛṣayo 'khilāḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, the self-born lord (god Brahma) began to ponder over the remedy for that sin. But he was not able to find any such remedy.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the self-born lord (god Brahma) began to ponder over the remedy for that sin. But he was not able to find any such remedy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the self-born lord (god Brahma) began to ponder over the remedy for that sin. But he was not able to find any such remedy.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभूमिं व्रजेः शीघ्रं दारिर्द्येण मितैः सुतैः । एवं प्रकुपितैः शप्तः खिन्नः काञ्चीं समाविशम्
verses.transliteration: karmabhūmiṃ vrajeḥ śīghraṃ dārirdyeṇa mitaiḥ sutaiḥ / evaṃ prakupitaiḥ śaptaḥ khinnaḥ kāñcīṃ samāviśam
verses.translation: You, Indra came out of that cave and became the leader ofthe Devas. You acquired the wealth and glory of kingdom due to the favour of Parmesthin.
verses.wordMeaning: You, Indra came out of that cave and became the leader ofthe Devas. You acquired the wealth and glory of kingdom due to the favour of Parmesthin.
verses.commentary: Sense: You, Indra came out of that cave and became the leader ofthe Devas. You acquired the wealth and glory of kingdom due to the favour of Parmesthin.

verses.sanskrit: पुरीं पुरोधसा हीनां वीक्ष्य चिन्ताकुलात्मना । भवता सह देवैस्तु पौरोहित्यार्थमादरात्
verses.transliteration: purīṃ purodhasā hīnāṃ vīkṣya cintākulātmanā / bhavatā saha devaistu paurohityārthamādarāt
verses.translation: Till this time you were ruling over the three worlds- and being arrogant on account of your glory and suzerainty, you caused harm to the Kailasa mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: Till this time you were ruling over the three worlds- and being arrogant on account of your glory and suzerainty, you caused harm to the Kailasa mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Till this time you were ruling over the three worlds- and being arrogant on account of your glory and suzerainty, you caused harm to the Kailasa mountain.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थितो विश्वरूपस्तु बभूव तपतां वरः । स्वस्रीयो दानवानां तु देवानां च पुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: prārthito viśvarūpastu babhūva tapatāṃ varaḥ / svasrīyo dānavānāṃ tu devānāṃ ca purohitaḥ
verses.translation: The resull of both the curses has been the same. See, the three worlds have become devoid ofglory and brilliance.
verses.wordMeaning: The resull of both the curses has been the same. See, the three worlds have become devoid ofglory and brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The resull of both the curses has been the same. See, the three worlds have become devoid ofglory and brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: नात्यर्थम करोद्वैरं दैत्येष्वपि महातपाः । बभूवतुस्तुल्यबलौ तदा देत्येन्द्रवासवौ
verses.transliteration: nātyarthama karodvairaṃ daityeṣvapi mahātapāḥ / babhūvatustulyabalau tadā detyendravāsavau
verses.translation: Tajfias are not being performed nor Dunas (charitable gifts) are being distributed. O Vasava, there is neither raffia (Restraint on the sense-organs) nor Niyama (Holy observance of vows etc.). Penance and austerities are not found anywhere.
verses.wordMeaning: Tajfias are not being performed nor Dunas (charitable gifts) are being distributed. O Vasava, there is neither raffia (Restraint on the sense-organs) nor Niyama (Holy observance of vows etc.). Penance and austerities are not found anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tajfias are not being performed nor Dunas (charitable gifts) are being distributed. O Vasava, there is neither raffia (Restraint on the sense-organs) nor Niyama (Holy observance of vows etc.). Penance and austerities are not found anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वं कुपितो राजन्स्वक्लीयं दानवेशितुः । हन्तुमिच्छन्नगाश्चाशु तपसः साधनं वनम्
verses.transliteration: tatastvaṃ kupito rājansvaklīyaṃ dānaveśituḥ / hantumicchannagāścāśu tapasaḥ sādhanaṃ vanam
verses.translation: All the Brahmanas are devoid of glory and splendour. Their minds are overpowered by covetousness. They are devoid of inherent strength and deficient in courage. All of them have become more or less Atheists.
verses.wordMeaning: All the Brahmanas are devoid of glory and splendour. Their minds are overpowered by covetousness. They are devoid of inherent strength and deficient in courage. All of them have become more or less Atheists.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Brahmanas are devoid of glory and splendour. Their minds are overpowered by covetousness. They are devoid of inherent strength and deficient in courage. All of them have become more or less Atheists.

verses.sanskrit: तमासनस्थं मुनिभिस्त्रिशृङ्गमिव पर्वतम् । त्रयी मुखरदिग्भागं ब्रह्मानदैकनिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: tamāsanasthaṃ munibhistriśṛṅgamiva parvatam / trayī mukharadigbhāgaṃ brahmānadaikaniṣṭhitam
verses.translation: The earth has lost all its essential juice and herbal products. It is becoming more and more feeble and powerless. The sun has a dim and grey disc; the moon is bereft ofits lustre.
verses.wordMeaning: The earth has lost all its essential juice and herbal products. It is becoming more and more feeble and powerless. The sun has a dim and grey disc; the moon is bereft ofits lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth has lost all its essential juice and herbal products. It is becoming more and more feeble and powerless. The sun has a dim and grey disc; the moon is bereft ofits lustre.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतहितं तं तु मत्वा चेशानुकूलितः । शिरांसि यौगपद्येन छिन्नात्यासंस्त्वयैव तु
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtahitaṃ taṃ tu matvā ceśānukūlitaḥ / śirāṃsi yaugapadyena chinnātyāsaṃstvayaiva tu
verses.translation: Devas are weak. They appear entirely different. The three worlds including mobile and immobile beings are on the verge of ruin."
verses.wordMeaning: Devas are weak. They appear entirely different. The three worlds including mobile and immobile beings are on the verge of ruin."
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas are weak. They appear entirely different. The three worlds including mobile and immobile beings are on the verge of ruin."

verses.sanskrit: तेन पापेन संयुक्तः पीडितश्च मुहुर्मुहुः । ततो मेरुगुहां नीत्वा बहूनब्दान्हि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tena pāpena saṃyuktaḥ pīḍitaśca muhurmuhuḥ / tato meruguhāṃ nītvā bahūnabdānhi saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: "Even as Brhaspati and Mahendra were conversing thus, Malaka and other great Da it y as attacked Svargaloka (Heaven).
verses.wordMeaning: "Even as Brhaspati and Mahendra were conversing thus, Malaka and other great Da it y as attacked Svargaloka (Heaven).
verses.commentary: Sense: "Even as Brhaspati and Mahendra were conversing thus, Malaka and other great Da it y as attacked Svargaloka (Heaven).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ज्ञात्वा तु मुनिवाक्यतः । पुत्र शोकेन संतप्तस्त्वां शशाप रुषान्वितः
verses.transliteration: tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā jñātvā tu munivākyataḥ / putra śokena saṃtaptastvāṃ śaśāpa ruṣānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Haughty on account of their physical strength, they chopped off all trees in the whole of Nandana park. They hit and beat the gardeners with different weapons.
verses.wordMeaning: Haughty on account of their physical strength, they chopped off all trees in the whole of Nandana park. They hit and beat the gardeners with different weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haughty on account of their physical strength, they chopped off all trees in the whole of Nandana park. They hit and beat the gardeners with different weapons.

verses.sanskrit: निःश्रीको भवतु क्षिप्रं मम शापेन वासवः । अनाथकास्ततो देवा विषण्णा दैत्यपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: niḥśrīko bhavatu kṣipraṃ mama śāpena vāsavaḥ / anāthakāstato devā viṣaṇṇā daityapīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: They smashed down the rampart wall and rushed in the city. They thrashed and tortured the Suras staying in their palaces.
verses.wordMeaning: They smashed down the rampart wall and rushed in the city. They thrashed and tortured the Suras staying in their palaces.
verses.commentary: Sense: They smashed down the rampart wall and rushed in the city. They thrashed and tortured the Suras staying in their palaces.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया मया च रहिताः सर्वे देवाः पलायिताः । गत्वा तु ब्रह्मसदनं नत्वा तद्वृत्तमूचिरे
verses.transliteration: tvayā mayā ca rahitāḥ sarve devāḥ palāyitāḥ / gatvā tu brahmasadanaṃ natvā tadvṛttamūcire
verses.translation: Particularly, they abducted the gem-like (beauti- ful) celestial Damsels. Thereupon, the Devas who were com- pletely afflicted cried loudly.
verses.wordMeaning: Particularly, they abducted the gem-like (beauti- ful) celestial Damsels. Thereupon, the Devas who were com- pletely afflicted cried loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Particularly, they abducted the gem-like (beauti- ful) celestial Damsels. Thereupon, the Devas who were com- pletely afflicted cried loudly.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु चिन्तया मास तदघस्य प्रतिक्रियाम् । तस्य प्रतिक्रियां वेत्तुं न शशाकात्मभूस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tatastu cintayā māsa tadaghasya pratikriyām / tasya pratikriyāṃ vettuṃ na śaśākātmabhūstadā
verses.translation: On hearing such a noisy tumult. Vasava left his seat and began fleeing followed by all Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing such a noisy tumult. Vasava left his seat and began fleeing followed by all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing such a noisy tumult. Vasava left his seat and began fleeing followed by all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवैः परिवृतो नारायणमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: tato devaiḥ parivṛto nārāyaṇamupāgamat
verses.translation: After reaching the abode of Brahma, Vrsa (i.e. Indra) with gloomy face recounted factually the entire activity of the Daityas.
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the abode of Brahma, Vrsa (i.e. Indra) with gloomy face recounted factually the entire activity of the Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the abode of Brahma, Vrsa (i.e. Indra) with gloomy face recounted factually the entire activity of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा स्तुत्वा चतुर्वक्रस्तद्वृत्तान्तं व्यजिज्ञपत् । विचिन्त्य सो ऽपि बहुधा कृपया लोकनायकः
verses.transliteration: natvā stutvā caturvakrastadvṛttāntaṃ vyajijñapat / vicintya so 'pi bahudhā kṛpayā lokanāyakaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it, Brahma the creator of the worlds glanced at Harihaya (Indra) whose splendour and lustre had been destroyed and who had been accompanied by all Devas and said this to them.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing it, Brahma the creator of the worlds glanced at Harihaya (Indra) whose splendour and lustre had been destroyed and who had been accompanied by all Devas and said this to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, Brahma the creator of the worlds glanced at Harihaya (Indra) whose splendour and lustre had been destroyed and who had been accompanied by all Devas and said this to them.

verses.sanskrit: तदघं तु त्रिधा भित्त्वा त्रिषु स्थानेष्वथार्पयत् । स्त्रीषु भूम्यां च वृक्षेषु तेषामपि वरं ददौ
verses.transliteration: tadaghaṃ tu tridhā bhittvā triṣu sthāneṣvathārpayat / strīṣu bhūmyāṃ ca vṛkṣeṣu teṣāmapi varaṃ dadau
verses.translation: "O Indra, do seek refuge inMukunda alongwith all Devas. That destroyer of Daityas will bring about your welfare."
verses.wordMeaning: "O Indra, do seek refuge inMukunda alongwith all Devas. That destroyer of Daityas will bring about your welfare."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Indra, do seek refuge inMukunda alongwith all Devas. That destroyer of Daityas will bring about your welfare."

verses.sanskrit: तदा भर्त्तृसमायोगं पुत्रावाप्तिमृतुष्वपि । छेदे पुनर्भवत्वं तु सर्वेषामपि शाखिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tadā bharttṛsamāyogaṃ putrāvāptimṛtuṣvapi / chede punarbhavatvaṃ tu sarveṣāmapi śākhinām
verses.translation: After saying this, Brahma himself, the grandfather ofthe worlds, went to the ocean of Milk accompanied by him as well as Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, Brahma himself, the grandfather ofthe worlds, went to the ocean of Milk accompanied by him as well as Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Brahma himself, the grandfather ofthe worlds, went to the ocean of Milk accompanied by him as well as Devas.

verses.sanskrit: खातपूर्तिं धरण्यश्च प्रददौ मधुसूदनः । तेष्वघं प्रबभूवाशु रजोनिर्यासमूषरम्
verses.transliteration: khātapūrtiṃ dharaṇyaśca pradadau madhusūdanaḥ / teṣvaghaṃ prababhūvāśu rajoniryāsamūṣaram
verses.translation: Then Brahma and other Devas eulogised Lord Janardana, the great ruler of the worlds with excellent words.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma and other Devas eulogised Lord Janardana, the great ruler of the worlds with excellent words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma and other Devas eulogised Lord Janardana, the great ruler of the worlds with excellent words.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गतो गह्वरात्तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रो देवनायकः । राज्यश्रियं च संप्राप्तः प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: nirgato gahvarāttasmāttvamindro devanāyakaḥ / rājyaśriyaṃ ca saṃprāptaḥ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Vasudeva, the eternal lord who is eager to protect the universe, told Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the delighted lord Vasudeva, the eternal lord who is eager to protect the universe, told Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord Vasudeva, the eternal lord who is eager to protect the universe, told Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव सांत्वितो धाता जगाद च जनार्दनम् । मम शापो वृथा न स्यादस्तु कालान्तरे मुने
verses.transliteration: tenaiva sāṃtvito dhātā jagāda ca janārdanam / mama śāpo vṛthā na syādastu kālāntare mune
verses.translation: "I shall perfectly bring about an increase in your case by means of my brilliance alone. What is being suggested by me may be carried out by you all.
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall perfectly bring about an increase in your case by means of my brilliance alone. What is being suggested by me may be carried out by you all.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall perfectly bring about an increase in your case by means of my brilliance alone. What is being suggested by me may be carried out by you all.

verses.sanskrit: भगवांस्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा मुनेरमिततेजसः । प्रहृष्टो भाविकार्यज्ञस्तूष्णीमेव तदा ययौ
verses.transliteration: bhagavāṃstadvacaḥ śrutvā muneramitatejasaḥ / prahṛṣṭo bhāvikāryajñastūṣṇīmeva tadā yayau
verses.translation: Cast down into the ocean of Milk all types of medi- cinal herbs. Get into an alliance with those Asuras and do everything in collaboration with them.
verses.wordMeaning: Cast down into the ocean of Milk all types of medi- cinal herbs. Get into an alliance with those Asuras and do everything in collaboration with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cast down into the ocean of Milk all types of medi- cinal herbs. Get into an alliance with those Asuras and do everything in collaboration with them.

verses.sanskrit: एतावन्तमिमं कालं त्रिलोकीं पालयन्भवान् । एश्वर्यमदमत्तत्वात्कैलासाद्रिमपीडयत
verses.transliteration: etāvantamimaṃ kālaṃ trilokīṃ pālayanbhavān / eśvaryamadamattatvātkailāsādrimapīḍayata
verses.translation: Make the Mandara mountain yourchurningrod 1 and Vasuki your churning rope. I shall stand near to help you, O Suras. May the churning for the Nectar be carried out.
verses.wordMeaning: Make the Mandara mountain yourchurningrod 1 and Vasuki your churning rope. I shall stand near to help you, O Suras. May the churning for the Nectar be carried out.
verses.commentary: Sense: Make the Mandara mountain yourchurningrod 1 and Vasuki your churning rope. I shall stand near to help you, O Suras. May the churning for the Nectar be carried out.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञेन शिवेनाथ प्रेषितो भगवान्मुनिः । दुर्वासास्त्वन्मदभ्रंशं कर्त्तुकामः शशाप ह
verses.transliteration: sarvajñena śivenātha preṣito bhagavānmuniḥ / durvāsāstvanmadabhraṃśaṃ karttukāmaḥ śaśāpa ha
verses.translation: All Danavas should be addressed in a concilia- tory manner "Of course the benefit (of churning the ocean) is common to you and to us".
verses.wordMeaning: All Danavas should be addressed in a concilia- tory manner "Of course the benefit (of churning the ocean) is common to you and to us".
verses.commentary: Sense: All Danavas should be addressed in a concilia- tory manner "Of course the benefit (of churning the ocean) is common to you and to us".

verses.sanskrit: एकमेव फलं जातमुभयोः शापयोरपि । अधुना पश्यनिः श्रीकन्त्रैलोक्यं समजायत
verses.transliteration: ekameva phalaṃ jātamubhayoḥ śāpayorapi / adhunā paśyaniḥ śrīkantrailokyaṃ samajāyata
verses.translation: All of you will become strong and immortal by •drinking nectar that jvill come out when the ocean of milk is being churned.
verses.wordMeaning: All of you will become strong and immortal by •drinking nectar that jvill come out when the ocean of milk is being churned.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of you will become strong and immortal by •drinking nectar that jvill come out when the ocean of milk is being churned.

verses.sanskrit: न यज्ञाः संप्रवर्त्तन्ते न दानानि च वासव । न यमा नापि नियमा न तपासि च कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: na yajñāḥ saṃpravarttante na dānāni ca vāsava / na yamā nāpi niyamā na tapāsi ca kutracit
verses.translation: I shall manage everything in such a manner that the Daityas will only exert themselves but will not get any part of Nectar".
verses.wordMeaning: I shall manage everything in such a manner that the Daityas will only exert themselves but will not get any part of Nectar".
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall manage everything in such a manner that the Daityas will only exert themselves but will not get any part of Nectar".

verses.sanskrit: विप्राः सर्वे ऽपि निःश्रीका लोभोपहतचेतसः । निःस्त्त्वा धैर्यहीनाश्च नास्तिकाः प्रायशो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: viprāḥ sarve 'pi niḥśrīkā lobhopahatacetasaḥ / niḥsttvā dhairyahīnāśca nāstikāḥ prāyaśo 'bhavan
verses.translation: The gods were allotted places near the tail of Vasuki. The sons ofDiti were employed by Sauri (Visnu) at the portion ofthe head.
verses.wordMeaning: The gods were allotted places near the tail of Vasuki. The sons ofDiti were employed by Sauri (Visnu) at the portion ofthe head.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods were allotted places near the tail of Vasuki. The sons ofDiti were employed by Sauri (Visnu) at the portion ofthe head.

verses.sanskrit: निरौषधिरसा भूमिर्निवीर्य जायतेतराम् । भास्करो धूसराकारश्चन्द्रमाः कान्तिवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: nirauṣadhirasā bhūmirnivīrya jāyatetarām / bhāskaro dhūsarākāraścandramāḥ kāntivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Although the Daityas were very powerful, they became pale and devoid ofbrilliance when their bodies were scorched and singed by the fiery breaths of that (serpent).
verses.wordMeaning: Although the Daityas were very powerful, they became pale and devoid ofbrilliance when their bodies were scorched and singed by the fiery breaths of that (serpent).
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the Daityas were very powerful, they became pale and devoid ofbrilliance when their bodies were scorched and singed by the fiery breaths of that (serpent).

verses.sanskrit: निस्तेजस्को हविर्भोक्ता मनुद्धूलिकृताकृतिः । न प्रसन्ना दिशां भागा नभो नैव च निर्मलम्
verses.transliteration: nistejasko havirbhoktā manuddhūlikṛtākṛtiḥ / na prasannā diśāṃ bhāgā nabho naiva ca nirmalam
verses.translation: The Suras who were pulling at the portion of the tail were rendered robust and devoid of fatigue through a favour- able gust of wind induced. by Visnu.
verses.wordMeaning: The Suras who were pulling at the portion of the tail were rendered robust and devoid of fatigue through a favour- able gust of wind induced. by Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Suras who were pulling at the portion of the tail were rendered robust and devoid of fatigue through a favour- able gust of wind induced. by Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बला देवताः सर्वा विभान्त्यन्यादृशा इव । विनष्टप्रयमेवास्ति त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: durbalā devatāḥ sarvā vibhāntyanyādṛśā iva / vinaṣṭaprayamevāsti trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: In the middle ofthe ocean of Milk, the exceedingly lustrous lord in the form of primordial Tortoise became the basis and support ofthe Mandara mountain that was rotating therein.
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle ofthe ocean of Milk, the exceedingly lustrous lord in the form of primordial Tortoise became the basis and support ofthe Mandara mountain that was rotating therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle ofthe ocean of Milk, the exceedingly lustrous lord in the form of primordial Tortoise became the basis and support ofthe Mandara mountain that was rotating therein.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच इत्थं कथयतोरेव बृहस्पतिपहेन्द्रयोः । मलकाद्या महादैत्याः स्वर्गलोकं बबाधिरे
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca itthaṃ kathayatoreva bṛhaspatipahendrayoḥ / malakādyā mahādaityāḥ svargalokaṃ babādhire
verses.translation: The story of churning the milk-ocean for nectar appears in Mbh. Adi. 18, VR 1.45, Bh. P. VIII 6,7 and other Puranas all affirming pro- sura role of Visnu. This Purana is no exception as can be seen from VV. 49r54. The episode reflects against the greatness of Visnu.
verses.wordMeaning: The story of churning the milk-ocean for nectar appears in Mbh. Adi. 18, VR 1.45, Bh. P. VIII 6,7 and other Puranas all affirming pro- sura role of Visnu. This Purana is no exception as can be seen from VV. 49r54. The episode reflects against the greatness of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of churning the milk-ocean for nectar appears in Mbh. Adi. 18, VR 1.45, Bh. P. VIII 6,7 and other Puranas all affirming pro- sura role of Visnu. This Purana is no exception as can be seen from VV. 49r54. The episode reflects against the greatness of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दनोद्यान मखिलं चिच्छिदुर्बलगर्विताः । उद्यानपालकान्सर्वानायुधैः समताडयन्
verses.transliteration: nandanodyāna makhilaṃ cicchidurbalagarvitāḥ / udyānapālakānsarvānāyudhaiḥ samatāḍayan
verses.translation: Madhava pulled Vasuki speedily from the midst of all Devas by assuming a separate form and from the midst of Daityas by assuming another form.
verses.wordMeaning: Madhava pulled Vasuki speedily from the midst of all Devas by assuming a separate form and from the midst of Daityas by assuming another form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Madhava pulled Vasuki speedily from the midst of all Devas by assuming a separate form and from the midst of Daityas by assuming another form.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकारमवभिद्यैव प्रविश्य नगरान्तरम् । मन्दिरस्थान्सुरान्सर्वानत्यन्तं पर्यपीडयन्
verses.transliteration: prākāramavabhidyaiva praviśya nagarāntaram / mandirasthānsurānsarvānatyantaṃ paryapīḍayan
verses.translation: When the churning proceeded ahead, Parijata, the great tree, appeared in front of them rendering the region around fragrant by means of its sweet smell.
verses.wordMeaning: When the churning proceeded ahead, Parijata, the great tree, appeared in front of them rendering the region around fragrant by means of its sweet smell.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the churning proceeded ahead, Parijata, the great tree, appeared in front of them rendering the region around fragrant by means of its sweet smell.

verses.sanskrit: आजहुरप्सरोरत्नान्यशेषाणि विशेषतः । ततो देवाः समस्ताश्च चक्रुर्भृशमबाधिताः
verses.transliteration: ājahurapsaroratnānyaśeṣāṇi viśeṣataḥ / tato devāḥ samastāśca cakrurbhṛśamabādhitāḥ
verses.translation: The intelligent groups of celestial damsels, of exces- sively beautiful forms, O divine sage, appeared in front of them, captivating the minds of all people.
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent groups of celestial damsels, of exces- sively beautiful forms, O divine sage, appeared in front of them, captivating the minds of all people.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent groups of celestial damsels, of exces- sively beautiful forms, O divine sage, appeared in front of them, captivating the minds of all people.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशं घोषमाकर्म्य वासवः प्रोज्झितासनः । सर्वैरनुगतो देवैः पलायनपरो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tādṛśaṃ ghoṣamākarmya vāsavaḥ projjhitāsanaḥ / sarvairanugato devaiḥ palāyanaparo 'bhavat
verses.translation: A popular etymology: A-sura (Non-wine-imbibers). Originally it is derived from A as — 'to throw' — who threw out gods. But in Vedic it is. used with Varuna and as an adj. it means * divine', 'Supreme Spirit' (MW 121-1). The A-sura is a later formation come to be supported by- such Purana episodes as in VV. 00-09.
verses.wordMeaning: A popular etymology: A-sura (Non-wine-imbibers). Originally it is derived from A as — 'to throw' — who threw out gods. But in Vedic it is. used with Varuna and as an adj. it means * divine', 'Supreme Spirit' (MW 121-1).…
verses.commentary: Sense: A popular etymology: A-sura (Non-wine-imbibers). Originally it is derived from A as — 'to throw' — who threw out gods. But in Vedic it is. used with Varuna and as an adj. it means * divine', 'Supreme Spirit' (MW 121-1).…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं धाम समभ्येत्य विषण्मवदनो वृषा । यथावत्कथयामास निखिलं दैत्यचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṃ dhāma samabhyetya viṣaṇmavadano vṛṣā / yathāvatkathayāmāsa nikhilaṃ daityaceṣṭitam
verses.translation: Then the moon of cool rays rose up. Mahesvara took it up. The different kinds of poison rose up. The species of Nagas accepted them.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the moon of cool rays rose up. Mahesvara took it up. The different kinds of poison rose up. The species of Nagas accepted them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the moon of cool rays rose up. Mahesvara took it up. The different kinds of poison rose up. The species of Nagas accepted them.

verses.sanskrit: विधातापि तदाकर्ण्य सर्वदेवसमन्वितम् । हतश्रीकं हरिहयमालोक्येदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: vidhātāpi tadākarṇya sarvadevasamanvitam / hataśrīkaṃ harihayamālokyedamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Then the gem named Kaustubha came up. Janar- dana took it. Thereafter, the great medicinal herb named Vijaya
verses.wordMeaning: Then the gem named Kaustubha came up. Janar- dana took it. Thereafter, the great medicinal herb named Vijaya
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gem named Kaustubha came up. Janar- dana took it. Thereafter, the great medicinal herb named Vijaya

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रत्वमखिलैर्द्देवैर्मुकुन्दं शरणं व्रज । दैत्यारातिर्जगत्कर्ता स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति
verses.transliteration: indratvamakhilairddevairmukundaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja / daityārātirjagatkartā sa te śreyo vidhāsyati
verses.translation: Then, dressed in divine robes lord Dhanvantari, himself stood up holding a pot filled with Nectar in his hand.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, dressed in divine robes lord Dhanvantari, himself stood up holding a pot filled with Nectar in his hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, dressed in divine robes lord Dhanvantari, himself stood up holding a pot filled with Nectar in his hand.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा तेन सहितः स्वयं ब्रह्मा पितामहः । समस्तदेवसहितः क्षीरोदधिमुपाययौ
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā tena sahitaḥ svayaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ / samastadevasahitaḥ kṣīrodadhimupāyayau
verses.translation: Then, O storehouse of austerities, Devas, Daityas and sages all round became delighted and contented.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, O storehouse of austerities, Devas, Daityas and sages all round became delighted and contented.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O storehouse of austerities, Devas, Daityas and sages all round became delighted and contented.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवा भगवन्तं जनार्दनम् । तुष्टुवुर्वाग्वरिष्ठाभिः सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: atha brahmādayo devā bhagavantaṃ janārdanam / tuṣṭuvurvāgvariṣṭhābhiḥ sarvalokamaheśvaram
verses.translation: Then, from that great ocean of Milk, goddess Sri, the bestower of boons, came up holding a lotus in her hand and seated in a full blown lotus.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, from that great ocean of Milk, goddess Sri, the bestower of boons, came up holding a lotus in her hand and seated in a full blown lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, from that great ocean of Milk, goddess Sri, the bestower of boons, came up holding a lotus in her hand and seated in a full blown lotus.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रसन्नो भगवान्वासुदेवः सनातनः । जगाद स कलान्देवाञ्जगद्रक्षणलंपटः
verses.transliteration: atha prasanno bhagavānvāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ / jagāda sa kalāndevāñjagadrakṣaṇalaṃpaṭaḥ
verses.translation: Then with a contented heart, all sages eulogised the great goddess Sn by means of Srisukta*. The Gandharvas sang well.
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a contented heart, all sages eulogised the great goddess Sn by means of Srisukta*. The Gandharvas sang well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a contented heart, all sages eulogised the great goddess Sn by means of Srisukta*. The Gandharvas sang well.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच भवतां सुविधास्यामि तेजसैवोपबृंहमम् । यदुच्यते मयेदानीं युष्माभिस्त द्विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca bhavatāṃ suvidhāsyāmi tejasaivopabṛṃhamam / yaducyate mayedānīṃ yuṣmābhista dvidhīyatām
verses.translation: All the groups of celestial damsels, the leader of whom was VisvacI, danced. The Gariga and other sacred rivers approached her for the purpose of her bath.
verses.wordMeaning: All the groups of celestial damsels, the leader of whom was VisvacI, danced. The Gariga and other sacred rivers approached her for the purpose of her bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the groups of celestial damsels, the leader of whom was VisvacI, danced. The Gariga and other sacred rivers approached her for the purpose of her bath.

verses.sanskrit: ओषधिप्रवराः सर्वाः क्षिपत क्षीरसागरे । असुरैरपि संधाय सममेव च तैरिह
verses.transliteration: oṣadhipravarāḥ sarvāḥ kṣipata kṣīrasāgare / asurairapi saṃdhāya samameva ca tairiha
verses.translation: Taking up the water kept in a sacrificial vessel (gold vessel in N.) the eight elephants (supporters) ofthe quarters bathed goddess Sri occupying the lotus.
verses.wordMeaning: Taking up the water kept in a sacrificial vessel (gold vessel in N.) the eight elephants (supporters) ofthe quarters bathed goddess Sri occupying the lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking up the water kept in a sacrificial vessel (gold vessel in N.) the eight elephants (supporters) ofthe quarters bathed goddess Sri occupying the lotus.

verses.sanskrit: मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा कृत्वा योक्त्रं च वासुकिम् । मयि स्थिते सहाये तु मथ्यताममृतं सुराः
verses.transliteration: manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā yoktraṃ ca vāsukim / mayi sthite sahāye tu mathyatāmamṛtaṃ surāḥ
verses.translation: The ocean of Milk in an embodied form gave her a lotus garland. The excellent and valuable TulasI that was born then identified itselfwith Hari.
verses.wordMeaning: The ocean of Milk in an embodied form gave her a lotus garland. The excellent and valuable TulasI that was born then identified itselfwith Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ocean of Milk in an embodied form gave her a lotus garland. The excellent and valuable TulasI that was born then identified itselfwith Hari.

verses.sanskrit: समस्तदानवाश्चापि वक्तव्याः सांत्वपूर्वकम् । सामान्यमेव युष्माकमस्माकं च फलं त्विति
verses.transliteration: samastadānavāścāpi vaktavyāḥ sāṃtvapūrvakam / sāmānyameva yuṣmākamasmākaṃ ca phalaṃ tviti
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: मथ्यमाने तु दुग्धाब्धौ या समुत्पद्यते सुधा । तत्पानाद्बलिनो यूयममर्त्याश्च भविष्यथ
verses.transliteration: mathyamāne tu dugdhābdhau yā samutpadyate sudhā / tatpānādbalino yūyamamartyāśca bhaviṣyatha
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: यथा दैत्याश्च पीयूषं नैतत्प्राप्स्यन्ति किञ्चन । केवलं क्लेशवन्तश्च करिष्यामि तथा ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: yathā daityāśca pīyūṣaṃ naitatprāpsyanti kiñcana / kevalaṃ kleśavantaśca kariṣyāmi tathā hyaham
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीवासुदेवेन कथिता निखिलाः सुराः । संधानं त्वतुलैर्दैत्यैः कृतवन्तस्तदा सुराः । नानाविधौषधिगणं समानीय सुरासुराः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīvāsudevena kathitā nikhilāḥ surāḥ / saṃdhānaṃ tvatulairdaityaiḥ kṛtavantastadā surāḥ / nānāvidhauṣadhigaṇaṃ samānīya surāsurāḥ
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीराब्धिपयसि क्षिप्त्वा चन्द्रमो ऽधिकनिर्मलम् । मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा कृत्वा योक्त्रं तु वासुकिम् । प्रारेभिरे प्रयत्नेन मन्थितुं यादसां पतिम्
verses.transliteration: śrīrābdhipayasi kṣiptvā candramo 'dhikanirmalam / manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā yoktraṃ tu vāsukim / prārebhire prayatnena manthituṃ yādasāṃ patim
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: वासुकेः पुच्छभागे तु सहिताः सर्वदेवताः । शिरोभागे तु दैतेया नियुक्तास्तत्र शौरिणा
verses.transliteration: vāsukeḥ pucchabhāge tu sahitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ / śirobhāge tu daiteyā niyuktāstatra śauriṇā
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: बलवन्तो ऽपि ते दैत्यास्तन्मुखोच्छ्वासपावकैः । निर्दग्धवपुषः सर्वे निस्तेजस्कास्तदाभवन्
verses.transliteration: balavanto 'pi te daityāstanmukhocchvāsapāvakaiḥ / nirdagdhavapuṣaḥ sarve nistejaskāstadābhavan
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: पुच्छदेशे तु कर्षन्तो मुहुराप्यायिताः सुराः । अनुकूलेन वातेन विष्णुना प्रेरितेन तु
verses.transliteration: pucchadeśe tu karṣanto muhurāpyāyitāḥ surāḥ / anukūlena vātena viṣṇunā preritena tu
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: आदिकूर्माकृतिः श्रीमान्मध्ये क्षीरपयोनिधेः । भ्रमतो मन्दराद्रेस्तु तस्या धिष्टानतामगात्
verses.transliteration: ādikūrmākṛtiḥ śrīmānmadhye kṣīrapayonidheḥ / bhramato mandarādrestu tasyā dhiṣṭānatāmagāt
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये च सर्वदेवानां रूपेणान्येन माधवः । चकर्ष वासुकिं वेगाद्दैत्यमध्ये परेण च
verses.transliteration: madhye ca sarvadevānāṃ rūpeṇānyena mādhavaḥ / cakarṣa vāsukiṃ vegāddaityamadhye pareṇa ca
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.transliteration: brahmarūpeṇa taṃ śailaṃ vidhāryākrāntavāridhim / apareṇa ca devarṣirmahatā tejasā muhuḥ
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.
verses.wordMeaning: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: उपवृंहितवान्देवान्येन ते बलशालिनः । तेजसा पुनरन्येन बलात्कारसहेन सः
verses.transliteration: upavṛṃhitavāndevānyena te balaśālinaḥ / tejasā punaranyena balātkārasahena saḥ
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.transliteration: upabṛṃhitavānnāgaṃ sarvaśaktijanārdanaḥ / mathyamāne tatastasminkṣīrabdhau devadānavaiḥ
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: आविर्बभूव पुरतः सुरभिः सुरपूजिता । मुदं जग्मुस्तदा देवा दैतेयाश्च तपोधन
verses.transliteration: āvirbabhūva purataḥ surabhiḥ surapūjitā / mudaṃ jagmustadā devā daiteyāśca tapodhana
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: मथ्यमाने पुनस्तस्मिन्क्षीराब्दौ देवदानवैः । किमेतदिति सिद्धानां दिवि चिन्तयतां तदा
verses.transliteration: mathyamāne punastasminkṣīrābdau devadānavaiḥ / kimetaditi siddhānāṃ divi cintayatāṃ tadā
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थिता वारुणी देवी मदाल्लोलविलोचना । असुराणां पुरस्तात्सा स्मयमाना व्यतिष्ठत
verses.transliteration: utthitā vāruṇī devī madāllolavilocanā / asurāṇāṃ purastātsā smayamānā vyatiṣṭhata
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.commentary: Sense: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: जगृहुर्नैव तां दैत्या असुराश्चाभवंस्ततः । सुरा न विद्यते येषां तेनैवासुरशब्दिताः
verses.transliteration: jagṛhurnaiva tāṃ daityā asurāścābhavaṃstataḥ / surā na vidyate yeṣāṃ tenaivāsuraśabditāḥ
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: अथसा सर्वदेवानामग्रतः समतिष्ठत । जगृहुस्तां मुदा देवाः सूचिताः परमेष्ठिना । सुराग्रहणतो ऽप्येते सुरशब्देन कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: athasā sarvadevānāmagrataḥ samatiṣṭhata / jagṛhustāṃ mudā devāḥ sūcitāḥ parameṣṭhinā / surāgrahaṇato 'pyete suraśabdena kīrtitāḥ

verses.transliteration: atyarthasuṃdarākārā dhīrāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ / āvirbhūtāśca devarṣe sarvalokamanoharāḥ

verses.transliteration: tataḥ śītāṃśurudabhūttaṃ jagrāha maheśvaraḥ / viṣajātaṃ tadutpannaṃ jagṛhurnāgajātayaḥ

verses.sanskrit: कौस्तुभाख्यं ततो रत्नमाददे तज्जनार्दनः । ततः स्वपत्रगन्धेन मदयन्ती महौषधीः । विजया नाम संजज्ञे भैरवस्तामुपाददे
verses.transliteration: kaustubhākhyaṃ tato ratnamādade tajjanārdanaḥ / tataḥ svapatragandhena madayantī mahauṣadhīḥ / vijayā nāma saṃjajñe bhairavastāmupādade

verses.sanskrit: ततो दिव्यांबरधरो देवो धन्वन्तरिः स्वयम् । उपस्थितः करे बिभ्रदमृताढ्यं कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: tato divyāṃbaradharo devo dhanvantariḥ svayam / upasthitaḥ kare bibhradamṛtāḍhyaṃ kamaṇḍalum

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso devā daityāśca sarvataḥ / munayaścābhavaṃstuṣṭāstadānīṃ tapasāṃ nidhe
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विकसितांभोजवासिनी वरदायिनी । उत्थिता पद्महस्ता श्रीस्तस्मात्क्षीरमहार्मवात्
verses.transliteration: tato vikasitāṃbhojavāsinī varadāyinī / utthitā padmahastā śrīstasmātkṣīramahārmavāt
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तां मुनयः सर्वे श्रीसुक्तेन श्रियं पराम् । तुष्टुवुस्तुष्ट हृदया गन्धर्वाश्च जगुः परम्
verses.transliteration: atha tāṃ munayaḥ sarve śrīsuktena śriyaṃ parām / tuṣṭuvustuṣṭa hṛdayā gandharvāśca jaguḥ param
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.transliteration: viśvājīpramukhāḥ sarve nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ / gaṅgādyāḥ puṇyanadyaśca snānārthamupatasthire

verses.transliteration: aṣṭau digdantinaścaiva medhyapātrasthitaṃ jalam / ādāya snāpayāñcakrustāṃ śriyaṃ padmavāsinīm
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: तुलसीं च समुत्पन्नां परार्ध्या मैक्यजां हरेः । पद्ममालां ददौ तस्यै मूर्तिमान्क्षीरसागरः
verses.transliteration: tulasīṃ ca samutpannāṃ parārdhyā maikyajāṃ hareḥ / padmamālāṃ dadau tasyai mūrtimānkṣīrasāgaraḥ
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni ca divyāni viśvakarmā samarpayat / divyamālyāṃ baradharā divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā / yayau vakṣasthalaṃ viṣṇoḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ ramā
verses.translation: Visvakarma bequeathed her all divine ornaments. Wearing divine garlands and robes and adorned with divine ornaments, Rama proceeded towardsthe region ofthe chest of Visnu even as all were watching her.

verses.sanskrit: तुलसी तु धृता तेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना । पश्यति स्म च सा देवी विष्णुवक्षथलालया । देवान्दयार्द्रया दृष्ट्या सर्वलोकमहेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: tulasī tu dhṛtā tena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / paśyati sma ca sā devī viṣṇuvakṣathalālayā / devāndayārdrayā dṛṣṭyā sarvalokamaheśvarī

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने अमृतमन्थनं नाम नवमो ऽध्यायः हयग्रीव उवाच अथ देवा महेन्द्राद्या विष्णुना प्रभविष्मुना । अङ्गीकृता महाधीराः प्रमोदं परमं ययुः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne amṛtamanthanaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ hayagrīva uvāca atha devā mahendrādyā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣmunā / aṅgīkṛtā mahādhīrāḥ pramodaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: Then, on being accepted and assisted by lord Visnu of great might, the exceedingly courageous Devas with Mahen- dra ns their leader, became highly delighted.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, on being accepted and assisted by lord Visnu of great might, the exceedingly courageous Devas with Mahen- dra ns their leader, became highly delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, on being accepted and assisted by lord Visnu of great might, the exceedingly courageous Devas with Mahen- dra ns their leader, became highly delighted.

verses.sanskrit: मलकाद्यास्तु ते सर्वे दैत्या विष्णुपराङ्मुखाः । संत्यक्ताश्च श्रिया देव्या भृशमुद्वेगमागताः
verses.transliteration: malakādyāstu te sarve daityā viṣṇuparāṅmukhāḥ / saṃtyaktāśca śriyā devyā bhṛśamudvegamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Malaka and other Daityas had become adversely disposed towards Visnu, so they were abandoned by SrT (the goddess of glory and fortune). Hence, they were extremely dejected.
verses.wordMeaning: Malaka and other Daityas had become adversely disposed towards Visnu, so they were abandoned by SrT (the goddess of glory and fortune). Hence, they were extremely dejected.
verses.commentary: Sense: Malaka and other Daityas had become adversely disposed towards Visnu, so they were abandoned by SrT (the goddess of glory and fortune). Hence, they were extremely dejected.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जगृहिरे दैत्या धन्वन्तरिकरस्थितम् । परमामृतसाराढ्यं कलशं कनकोद्भवम् । अथासुराणां देवानामन्योन्यं कलहो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tato jagṛhire daityā dhanvantarikarasthitam / paramāmṛtasārāḍhyaṃ kalaśaṃ kanakodbhavam / athāsurāṇāṃ devānāmanyonyaṃ kalaho 'bhavat
verses.translation: So the Daityas snatched away the golden vessel that contained the excellent essence of nectar and that had been held in his hands by Dhanvantari. Thereat a violent dispute arose between the Asuras and Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: So the Daityas snatched away the golden vessel that contained the excellent essence of nectar and that had been held in his hands by Dhanvantari. Thereat a violent dispute arose between the Asuras and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: So the Daityas snatched away the golden vessel that contained the excellent essence of nectar and that had been held in his hands by Dhanvantari. Thereat a violent dispute arose between the Asuras and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुः सर्वलोकैकरक्षकः । सम्यगाराधयामासललितां स्वैक्यरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare viṣṇuḥ sarvalokaikarakṣakaḥ / samyagārādhayāmāsalalitāṃ svaikyarūpiṇīm
verses.translation: In the meantime, Visnu, the sole protector ofall the worlds, earnestly propitiated Lalita 2 whose form was in union with his own.
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, Visnu, the sole protector ofall the worlds, earnestly propitiated Lalita 2 whose form was in union with his own.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, Visnu, the sole protector ofall the worlds, earnestly propitiated Lalita 2 whose form was in union with his own.

verses.sanskrit: सुराणामसुराणां च रणं वीक्ष्य सुदारुणम् । ब्रह्मा निजपदं प्राप शंभुः कैलासमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca raṇaṃ vīkṣya sudāruṇam / brahmā nijapadaṃ prāpa śaṃbhuḥ kailāsamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the dreadful battle between the Suras and Asuras, Brahma went back to his own region and Sambhu remained in Kailasa.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the dreadful battle between the Suras and Asuras, Brahma went back to his own region and Sambhu remained in Kailasa.

verses.sanskrit: मलकं योधयामास दैत्यानामधिपं वृषा । असुरैश्च सुराः सर्वे सांपरायमकुर्वत
verses.transliteration: malakaṃ yodhayāmāsa daityānāmadhipaṃ vṛṣā / asuraiśca surāḥ sarve sāṃparāyamakurvata

verses.sanskrit: भगवानपि योगीन्द्रः समाराध्य महेश्वरीम् । तदेकध्यानयोगेन तद्रूपः समजायत
verses.transliteration: bhagavānapi yogīndraḥ samārādhya maheśvarīm / tadekadhyānayogena tadrūpaḥ samajāyata
verses.translation: Kaustubha (a jewel), 5. Parijata (a flowering tree), 6. Apsaras (Divine damsels) 7. Laksmi (a goddess), 8. Varuni (the wine-deity)

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसंमोहिनी सा तु साक्षाच्छृङ्गारनायिका । सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṃmohinī sā tu sākṣācchṛṅgāranāyikā / sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā
verses.translation: Dhanvantari (with ajar of Amrta), the Bhagavata list does not include Gandra, Visa (poison absorbed by Nagas) and Vijaya (Hemp) given in our lext.
verses.wordMeaning: Dhanvantari (with ajar of Amrta), the Bhagavata list does not include Gandra, Visa (poison absorbed by Nagas) and Vijaya (Hemp) given in our lext.
