verses.sanskrit: सुराणामसुराणां च निवार्य रणमुल्वणम् । मन्दस्मितेन दैतेयान्मोहयन्ती जगद ह
verses.transliteration: surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca nivārya raṇamulvaṇam / mandasmitena daiteyānmohayantī jagada ha
verses.translation: This being the glorious story of Lalita, Visnu is shown to have propitiated Lalita to assume the enchanting form of Mohini. No other Purana mentions this.
verses.wordMeaning: This being the glorious story of Lalita, Visnu is shown to have propitiated Lalita to assume the enchanting form of Mohini. No other Purana mentions this.
verses.commentary: Sense: This being the glorious story of Lalita, Visnu is shown to have propitiated Lalita to assume the enchanting form of Mohini. No other Purana mentions this.

verses.sanskrit: अलं युद्धेन किं शस्त्रेर्मर्मस्थानविभेदिभिः । निष्ठुरैः किं वृथालापैः कण्ठशोषणहेतुभिः
verses.transliteration: alaṃ yuddhena kiṃ śastrermarmasthānavibhedibhiḥ / niṣṭhuraiḥ kiṃ vṛthālāpaiḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣaṇahetubhiḥ
verses.translation: Vrsa (Indra) fought with Malaka, the leader of the Daityas. All the Suras fought with Asuras.
verses.wordMeaning: Vrsa (Indra) fought with Malaka, the leader of the Daityas. All the Suras fought with Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vrsa (Indra) fought with Malaka, the leader of the Daityas. All the Suras fought with Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: अहमेवात्र मध्यस्था युष्माकं च दिवौकसाम् । यूयं तथामी नितरामत्र हि क्लेशभागिनः
verses.transliteration: ahamevātra madhyasthā yuṣmākaṃ ca divaukasām / yūyaṃ tathāmī nitarāmatra hi kleśabhāginaḥ
verses.translation: The lord (Visnu), the leader of Yogins, propitiated MahesvarT. By meditating solely on her, he became identical in form with her.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord (Visnu), the leader of Yogins, propitiated MahesvarT. By meditating solely on her, he became identical in form with her.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord (Visnu), the leader of Yogins, propitiated MahesvarT. By meditating solely on her, he became identical in form with her.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां सममेवाद्य दास्याम्यमृतमद्भुतम् । मम हस्ते प्रदातव्यं सुधापात्रमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ samamevādya dāsyāmyamṛtamadbhutam / mama haste pradātavyaṃ sudhāpātramanuttamam
verses.translation: She fascinated and enchanted everyone. She was the very heroine incarnate of the sentiment of love. She was richly- clad in a seductively charming dress and she was bedecked with all ornaments.
verses.wordMeaning: She fascinated and enchanted everyone. She was the very heroine incarnate of the sentiment of love. She was richly- clad in a seductively charming dress and she was bedecked with all ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fascinated and enchanted everyone. She was the very heroine incarnate of the sentiment of love. She was richly- clad in a seductively charming dress and she was bedecked with all ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा दैत्यास्तद्वाक्यमोहिताः । पीयूषकलशं तस्यै ददुस्ते मुग्धचेतसः
verses.transliteration: iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā daityāstadvākyamohitāḥ / pīyūṣakalaśaṃ tasyai daduste mugdhacetasaḥ
verses.translation: After stopping the terrific battle between the Suras and Asuras, she enchanted the Daityas with her smile and said:
verses.wordMeaning: After stopping the terrific battle between the Suras and Asuras, she enchanted the Daityas with her smile and said:
verses.commentary: Sense: After stopping the terrific battle between the Suras and Asuras, she enchanted the Daityas with her smile and said:

verses.sanskrit: सा तत्पात्रं समादाय जगन्मोहनरूपिणी । सुराणामसुराणां च वृथक्पङ्क्तिं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: sā tatpātraṃ samādāya jaganmohanarūpiṇī / surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca vṛthakpaṅktiṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: "Enough of fighting. Of what avail are the weapons, that tear and pierce the vulnerable points? Of what avail are vain and harsh utterances that cause parched throats?
verses.wordMeaning: "Enough of fighting. Of what avail are the weapons, that tear and pierce the vulnerable points? Of what avail are vain and harsh utterances that cause parched throats?
verses.commentary: Sense: "Enough of fighting. Of what avail are the weapons, that tear and pierce the vulnerable points? Of what avail are vain and harsh utterances that cause parched throats?

verses.sanskrit: द्वयोः पङ्क्त्योश्च मध्यस्थास्तानुवाच सुरासुरान् । तूष्णीं भवन्तु सर्वे ऽपि क्रमशो दीयते मया
verses.transliteration: dvayoḥ paṅktyośca madhyasthāstānuvāca surāsurān / tūṣṇīṃ bhavantu sarve 'pi kramaśo dīyate mayā
verses.translation: I myself shall be the impartial Mediator between you and the heaven-dwellers. Both you and these Devas have worked strenuously in this enterprise.
verses.wordMeaning: I myself shall be the impartial Mediator between you and the heaven-dwellers. Both you and these Devas have worked strenuously in this enterprise.
verses.commentary: Sense: I myself shall be the impartial Mediator between you and the heaven-dwellers. Both you and these Devas have worked strenuously in this enterprise.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यमुररीचक्रुस्ते सर्वे समवायिनः । सा तु संमोहिताश्लेषलोका दातुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tadvākyamurarīcakruste sarve samavāyinaḥ / sā tu saṃmohitāśleṣalokā dātuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: shall distribute this wonderful nectar equally among all of you. The excellent vessel of nectar should be handed over to me".
verses.wordMeaning: shall distribute this wonderful nectar equally among all of you. The excellent vessel of nectar should be handed over to me".
verses.commentary: Sense: shall distribute this wonderful nectar equally among all of you. The excellent vessel of nectar should be handed over to me".

verses.sanskrit: क्वणत्कनकदर्वीका क्वणन्मङ्गलकङ्कणा । कमनीयविभूषाढ्या कला सा परमा बभौ
verses.transliteration: kvaṇatkanakadarvīkā kvaṇanmaṅgalakaṅkaṇā / kamanīyavibhūṣāḍhyā kalā sā paramā babhau
verses.translation: On hearing those words of hers, the Daityas were deluded by her utterances. Foolishly they gave the vessel of nectar to her.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words of hers, the Daityas were deluded by her utterances. Foolishly they gave the vessel of nectar to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of hers, the Daityas were deluded by her utterances. Foolishly they gave the vessel of nectar to her.

verses.sanskrit: वामे वामे करांभोजे सुधाकलशमुज्ज्वलम् । सुधां तां देवतापङ्क्तौ पूर्वं दर्व्या तदादिशत्
verses.transliteration: vāme vāme karāṃbhoje sudhākalaśamujjvalam / sudhāṃ tāṃ devatāpaṅktau pūrvaṃ darvyā tadādiśat
verses.translation: That lady of exquisite beauty that could fascinate the entire universe, made separate rows of seats for the Suras and Asuras.
verses.wordMeaning: That lady of exquisite beauty that could fascinate the entire universe, made separate rows of seats for the Suras and Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lady of exquisite beauty that could fascinate the entire universe, made separate rows of seats for the Suras and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: दिशन्ती क्रमशास्तत्र चन्द्रभास्करसूचितम् । दर्वीकरेण चिच्छेद सैंहिकेयं तु मध्यगम् । पीतामृतशिरोमात्रं तस्य व्योम जगाम च
verses.transliteration: diśantī kramaśāstatra candrabhāskarasūcitam / darvīkareṇa ciccheda saiṃhikeyaṃ tu madhyagam / pītāmṛtaśiromātraṃ tasya vyoma jagāma ca
verses.translation: Standing in between the two rows she spoke to the Suras and Asuras — "All of you be quiet. Everything will be given by me in due order".
verses.wordMeaning: Standing in between the two rows she spoke to the Suras and Asuras — "All of you be quiet. Everything will be given by me in due order".
verses.commentary: Sense: Standing in between the two rows she spoke to the Suras and Asuras — "All of you be quiet. Everything will be given by me in due order".

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वाप्यसुरास्तत्र तूष्णीमासन्विमोहिताः । एवं क्रमेण तत्सर्वं विबुधेभ्यो वितीर्य सा । असुराणां पुरः पात्रं सानिनाय तिरोदधे
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvāpyasurāstatra tūṣṇīmāsanvimohitāḥ / evaṃ krameṇa tatsarvaṃ vibudhebhyo vitīrya sā / asurāṇāṃ puraḥ pātraṃ sānināya tirodadhe
verses.translation: All of them unanimously accepted her statement. That lady powerful enough to delude the entire world, began to destribute.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them unanimously accepted her statement. That lady powerful enough to delude the entire world, began to destribute.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them unanimously accepted her statement. That lady powerful enough to delude the entire world, began to destribute.

verses.sanskrit: रिक्तपात्रं तु तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे दैतेयदानवाः । उद्वेलं केवलं क्रोधं प्राप्ता युद्धचिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: riktapātraṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve daiteyadānavāḥ / udvelaṃ kevalaṃ krodhaṃ prāptā yuddhacikīrṣayā
verses.translation: She made clinking sounds with her golden ladle. The auspicious bangles jingled and tinkled. Equipped with beautiful ornaments, she shone like the most exquisite of all fine arts.
verses.wordMeaning: She made clinking sounds with her golden ladle. The auspicious bangles jingled and tinkled. Equipped with beautiful ornaments, she shone like the most exquisite of all fine arts.
verses.commentary: Sense: She made clinking sounds with her golden ladle. The auspicious bangles jingled and tinkled. Equipped with beautiful ornaments, she shone like the most exquisite of all fine arts.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रादयः सुराः सर्वे सुधापानाद्बलोत्तराः । दुर्वलैरसुरैः सार्धं समयुद्ध्यन्त सायुधाः
verses.transliteration: indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve sudhāpānādbalottarāḥ / durvalairasuraiḥ sārdhaṃ samayuddhyanta sāyudhāḥ
verses.translation: In her beautiful left hand that resembled a lotus, the pot of nectar shone bri lliantly. At the outset, she served the nectar in the row of the Devas by means of her ladle.
verses.wordMeaning: In her beautiful left hand that resembled a lotus, the pot of nectar shone bri lliantly. At the outset, she served the nectar in the row of the Devas by means of her ladle.
verses.commentary: Sense: In her beautiful left hand that resembled a lotus, the pot of nectar shone bri lliantly. At the outset, she served the nectar in the row of the Devas by means of her ladle.

verses.sanskrit: ते विध्यमानाः शतशो दानवेन्द्राः सुरोत्तमैः । दिगन्तान्कतिचिज्जग्मुः पातालं कतिचिद्ययुः
verses.transliteration: te vidhyamānāḥ śataśo dānavendrāḥ surottamaiḥ / digantānkaticijjagmuḥ pātālaṃ katicidyayuḥ
verses.translation: Even after seeing it, the Asuras who were deluded remained quiet. In this manner, she distributed the entire quantity of nectar among the Devas. She placed the vessel in front of the Asuras and vanished.
verses.wordMeaning: Even after seeing it, the Asuras who were deluded remained quiet. In this manner, she distributed the entire quantity of nectar among the Devas. She placed the vessel in front of the Asuras and vanished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after seeing it, the Asuras who were deluded remained quiet. In this manner, she distributed the entire quantity of nectar among the Devas. She placed the vessel in front of the Asuras and vanished.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यं मलकनामानं विजित्य विबुधेश्वरः । आत्मीयां श्रियमाजह्रे श्रीकटाक्ष समीक्षितः
verses.transliteration: daityaṃ malakanāmānaṃ vijitya vibudheśvaraḥ / ātmīyāṃ śriyamājahre śrīkaṭākṣa samīkṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Indra and all other Suras had become stronger due to their imbibing the nectar. With their weapons they fought the weaker Asuras.
verses.wordMeaning: Indra and all other Suras had become stronger due to their imbibing the nectar. With their weapons they fought the weaker Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra and all other Suras had become stronger due to their imbibing the nectar. With their weapons they fought the weaker Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः सिंहासनं प्राप्य महेन्द्रः सुरसेवितः । त्रैलोक्यं पालयामास पूर्ववत्पूर्वदेवजित्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ siṃhāsanaṃ prāpya mahendraḥ surasevitaḥ / trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa pūrvavatpūrvadevajit
verses.translation: On being hit and pierced by the excellent Suras, hundreds of leading Danavas went to the ends of quarters and many went to the Patala.
verses.wordMeaning: On being hit and pierced by the excellent Suras, hundreds of leading Danavas went to the ends of quarters and many went to the Patala.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being hit and pierced by the excellent Suras, hundreds of leading Danavas went to the ends of quarters and many went to the Patala.

verses.sanskrit: निर्भया निखिला देवास्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे । यथाकामं चरन्ति स्म सर्वदा हृष्टचेतसः
verses.transliteration: nirbhayā nikhilā devāstrailokye sacarācare / yathākāmaṃ caranti sma sarvadā hṛṣṭacetasaḥ
verses.translation: After regaining his throne, Mahendra, the conqueror of demons, protected the three worlds as before, duly attended by the Suras.
verses.wordMeaning: After regaining his throne, Mahendra, the conqueror of demons, protected the three worlds as before, duly attended by the Suras.
verses.commentary: Sense: After regaining his throne, Mahendra, the conqueror of demons, protected the three worlds as before, duly attended by the Suras.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तदखिलं दृष्ट्वा मोहिनीचरितं मुनिः । विस्मितः कामचारी तु कैलासं नारदो गतः
verses.transliteration: tadā tadakhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā mohinīcaritaṃ muniḥ / vismitaḥ kāmacārī tu kailāsaṃ nārado gataḥ
verses.translation: As before, all the Devas roamed about as they pleased without fear, in the three worlds consisting of mobile and im- mobile beings. They were delighted in their minds for ever.
verses.wordMeaning: As before, all the Devas roamed about as they pleased without fear, in the three worlds consisting of mobile and im- mobile beings. They were delighted in their minds for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: As before, all the Devas roamed about as they pleased without fear, in the three worlds consisting of mobile and im- mobile beings. They were delighted in their minds for ever.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दिना च कृतानुज्ञः प्रणम्य परमेश्वरम् । तेन संभाव्यमानो ऽसौ तुष्टो विष्टरमास्त सः
verses.transliteration: nandinā ca kṛtānujñaḥ praṇamya parameśvaram / tena saṃbhāvyamāno 'sau tuṣṭo viṣṭaramāsta saḥ
verses.translation: After observing these activities of MohinT, sage Narada, who was surprised very much and who used to move about as he pleased, went to Kailasa.
verses.wordMeaning: After observing these activities of MohinT, sage Narada, who was surprised very much and who used to move about as he pleased, went to Kailasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: After observing these activities of MohinT, sage Narada, who was surprised very much and who used to move about as he pleased, went to Kailasa.

verses.sanskrit: आसनस्थं महादेवो मुनिं स्वेच्छाविहारिणम् । पप्रच्छ पार्वतीजानिः स्वच्छस्फटिकसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: āsanasthaṃ mahādevo muniṃ svecchāvihāriṇam / papraccha pārvatījāniḥ svacchasphaṭikasannibhaḥ
verses.translation: When the sage who habitually sported about as he pleased, was seated, the great lord, the consort of Parvatl, fair in complexion like crystal, asked him.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sage who habitually sported about as he pleased, was seated, the great lord, the consort of Parvatl, fair in complexion like crystal, asked him.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sage who habitually sported about as he pleased, was seated, the great lord, the consort of Parvatl, fair in complexion like crystal, asked him.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्सर्ववृत्तज्ञ पवित्रीकृतविष्टर । कलहप्रिय देवर्षे किं वृत्तं तत्र नाकिनाम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavansarvavṛttajña pavitrīkṛtaviṣṭara / kalahapriya devarṣe kiṃ vṛttaṃ tatra nākinām
verses.translation: "O holy lord conversant with everything that has taken place, O divine sage who have sanctified the seat you occupy, O sage fond of provoking quarrels, what about the tidings there of the heaven-dwellers?
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord conversant with everything that has taken place, O divine sage who have sanctified the seat you occupy, O sage fond of provoking quarrels, what about the tidings there of the heaven-dwellers?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord conversant with everything that has taken place, O divine sage who have sanctified the seat you occupy, O sage fond of provoking quarrels, what about the tidings there of the heaven-dwellers?

verses.sanskrit: सुराणामसुराणां वा विजयः समजायत । किं वाप्यमृतवृत्तान्तं विष्णुना वापि किं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ vā vijayaḥ samajāyata / kiṃ vāpyamṛtavṛttāntaṃ viṣṇunā vāpi kiṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: On being asked thus by Mahesa, the excellent sage Narada who was extremely delighted and surprised spoke.
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked thus by Mahesa, the excellent sage Narada who was extremely delighted and surprised spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked thus by Mahesa, the excellent sage Narada who was extremely delighted and surprised spoke.

verses.sanskrit: इति पृष्टो महेशेन नारदो मुनिसत्तमः । उवाच विस्मयाविष्टः प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणः
verses.transliteration: iti pṛṣṭo maheśena nārado munisattamaḥ / uvāca vismayāviṣṭaḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, you know everything because you are omniscient. Still, everything will be reported by me now, since I have been asked by you.
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, you know everything because you are omniscient. Still, everything will be reported by me now, since I have been asked by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, you know everything because you are omniscient. Still, everything will be reported by me now, since I have been asked by you.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं जानासि भगवन्सर्वज्ञो ऽसि यतस्ततः । तथापि परिपृष्टेन मया तद्वक्ष्यते ऽधुना
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ jānāsi bhagavansarvajño 'si yatastataḥ / tathāpi paripṛṣṭena mayā tadvakṣyate 'dhunā
verses.translation: When such a terrible battle took place between the Daityas and the heaven-dwellers, Adinarayana of glorious brilliance assumed the form of Mohini.
verses.wordMeaning: When such a terrible battle took place between the Daityas and the heaven-dwellers, Adinarayana of glorious brilliance assumed the form of Mohini.
verses.commentary: Sense: When such a terrible battle took place between the Daityas and the heaven-dwellers, Adinarayana of glorious brilliance assumed the form of Mohini.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशे समरे घोरे सति दैत्यदिवौकसाम् । आदिनारायमः श्रीमान्मोहिनीरूपमादधे
verses.transliteration: tādṛśe samare ghore sati daityadivaukasām / ādinārāyamaḥ śrīmānmohinīrūpamādadhe
verses.translation: On seeing that lady wearing grand splendid orna- ments, the very embodiment of the sentiment of Love and Romantic feelings, the Suras and Asuras desisted from their active fighting.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that lady wearing grand splendid orna- ments, the very embodiment of the sentiment of Love and Romantic feelings, the Suras and Asuras desisted from their active fighting.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that lady wearing grand splendid orna- ments, the very embodiment of the sentiment of Love and Romantic feelings, the Suras and Asuras desisted from their active fighting.

verses.sanskrit: तामुदारविभूषाढ्यां मूर्तां शृङ्गारदेवताम् । सुरासुराः समालोक्य विरताः समरोध्यमात्
verses.transliteration: tāmudāravibhūṣāḍhyāṃ mūrtāṃ śṛṅgāradevatām / surāsurāḥ samālokya viratāḥ samarodhyamāt
verses.translation: The Daityas who were deluded by her Maya, were requested (to hand back) the vessel of nectar. Immediately they gave it to her and made her the arbitrator.
verses.wordMeaning: The Daityas who were deluded by her Maya, were requested (to hand back) the vessel of nectar. Immediately they gave it to her and made her the arbitrator.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Daityas who were deluded by her Maya, were requested (to hand back) the vessel of nectar. Immediately they gave it to her and made her the arbitrator.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मायामोहिता दैत्याः सुधापात्रं च याचिताः । कृत्वा तामेव मध्यस्थामर्पयामासुरञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: tanmāyāmohitā daityāḥ sudhāpātraṃ ca yācitāḥ / kṛtvā tāmeva madhyasthāmarpayāmāsurañjasā
verses.translation: After receiving it with a captivating smile, that goddess distributed the entire quantity of nectar among the Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: After receiving it with a captivating smile, that goddess distributed the entire quantity of nectar among the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After receiving it with a captivating smile, that goddess distributed the entire quantity of nectar among the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तदा देवी तदादाय मन्दस्मितमनोहरा । देवेभ्य एव पीयूषमशेषं विततार सा
verses.transliteration: tadā devī tadādāya mandasmitamanoharā / devebhya eva pīyūṣamaśeṣaṃ vitatāra sā
verses.translation: Not being able to see her because she had vanished and finding the vessel (of nectar) empty, the Daityas became furious. They with their faces blazing (flushed) with anger, rose once again to fight.
verses.wordMeaning: Not being able to see her because she had vanished and finding the vessel (of nectar) empty, the Daityas became furious. They with their faces blazing (flushed) with anger, rose once again to fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not being able to see her because she had vanished and finding the vessel (of nectar) empty, the Daityas became furious. They with their faces blazing (flushed) with anger, rose once again to fight.

verses.sanskrit: तिरोहितामदृष्ट्वा तां दृष्ट्वा शून्यं च पात्रकम् । ज्वलन्मन्युमुखा दैत्या युद्धाय पुनरुत्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tirohitāmadṛṣṭvā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śūnyaṃ ca pātrakam / jvalanmanyumukhā daityā yuddhāya punarutthitāḥ
verses.translation: Since they had imbibed nectar, the immortal ones became more powerful with excessive exploits. Defeated by them and almost destroyed by them, the great Daityas went down to Pat a la."
verses.wordMeaning: Since they had imbibed nectar, the immortal ones became more powerful with excessive exploits. Defeated by them and almost destroyed by them, the great Daityas went down to Pat a la."
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they had imbibed nectar, the immortal ones became more powerful with excessive exploits. Defeated by them and almost destroyed by them, the great Daityas went down to Pat a la."

verses.sanskrit: अमरैरमृतास्वादादत्युल्वणपराक्रमैः । पराजिता महादैत्या नष्टाः पातालमभ्ययुः
verses.transliteration: amarairamṛtāsvādādatyulvaṇaparākramaiḥ / parājitā mahādaityā naṣṭāḥ pātālamabhyayuḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Lord Siva accompanied by his consort riding his vehicle (the bull) arrived at the shore of the (milky) ocean, Visnu got up from his seat, the body o* the serpent (Sesa) and came over to him.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Lord Siva accompanied by his consort riding his vehicle (the bull) arrived at the shore of the (milky) ocean, Visnu got up from his seat, the body o* the serpent (Sesa) and came over to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Lord Siva accompanied by his consort riding his vehicle (the bull) arrived at the shore of the (milky) ocean, Visnu got up from his seat, the body o* the serpent (Sesa) and came over to him.

verses.sanskrit: इमं वृत्तान्तमाकर्ण्य भवानीपतिख्ययः । नारदं प्रेषयित्वाशु तदुक्तं सततं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ vṛttāntamākarṇya bhavānīpatikhyayaḥ / nāradaṃ preṣayitvāśu taduktaṃ satataṃ smaran
verses.translation: Sarva repeatedly sent his glances all round. Then he saw a beautiful garden in a cerlain place, the like ofwhich had never been seen before.
verses.wordMeaning: Sarva repeatedly sent his glances all round. Then he saw a beautiful garden in a cerlain place, the like ofwhich had never been seen before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarva repeatedly sent his glances all round. Then he saw a beautiful garden in a cerlain place, the like ofwhich had never been seen before.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञातः प्रमथैः सर्वैः स्कन्दनन्दिविनायकैः । पार्वतीसहितो विष्णुमाजगाम सविस्मयः
verses.transliteration: ajñātaḥ pramathaiḥ sarvaiḥ skandanandivināyakaiḥ / pārvatīsahito viṣṇumājagāma savismayaḥ
verses.translation: Cuckoos were revelling and fluttering (by imbibing) the liquor-like nectar from bunches of mango blossoms. Peacocks
verses.wordMeaning: Cuckoos were revelling and fluttering (by imbibing) the liquor-like nectar from bunches of mango blossoms. Peacocks
verses.commentary: Sense: Cuckoos were revelling and fluttering (by imbibing) the liquor-like nectar from bunches of mango blossoms. Peacocks

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदतीरगं दृष्ट्वा सस्त्रीकं वृषवाहनम् । भोगिभोगासनाद्विष्णुः समुत्थाय समागतः
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodatīragaṃ dṛṣṭvā sastrīkaṃ vṛṣavāhanam / bhogibhogāsanādviṣṇuḥ samutthāya samāgataḥ
verses.translation: The humming sound of the swarms of bees appeared to be superior to the note of lutes. The garden shone brilliantly on account of PatalT (Trumpet flowers) red in colour and having excessive fragrance.
verses.wordMeaning: The humming sound of the swarms of bees appeared to be superior to the note of lutes. The garden shone brilliantly on account of PatalT (Trumpet flowers) red in colour and having excessive fragrance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The humming sound of the swarms of bees appeared to be superior to the note of lutes. The garden shone brilliantly on account of PatalT (Trumpet flowers) red in colour and having excessive fragrance.

verses.sanskrit: वाहनादवरुह्येशः पार्वत्या सहितः स्थितम् । तं दृष्ट्वा शीघ्रमागत्य संपूज्यार्घ्यादितो मुदा
verses.transliteration: vāhanādavaruhyeśaḥ pārvatyā sahitaḥ sthitam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā śīghramāgatya saṃpūjyārghyādito mudā
verses.translation: It had an elegant charm with the clusters of the flowers ofTa mala (xanthochymus pictorius), Ta la (palm tree) and Hintala (Phoenix) appearing like a garland. It was well- decorated by means of unsplit splendour and magnificence of lotus blossoms in the ponds along the borders.
verses.wordMeaning: It had an elegant charm with the clusters of the flowers ofTa mala (xanthochymus pictorius), Ta la (palm tree) and Hintala (Phoenix) appearing like a garland. It was well- decorated by means of unsplit splendour and magnificence of lotus blossoms in the ponds along the borders.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had an elegant charm with the clusters of the flowers ofTa mala (xanthochymus pictorius), Ta la (palm tree) and Hintala (Phoenix) appearing like a garland. It was well- decorated by means of unsplit splendour and magnificence of lotus blossoms in the ponds along the borders.

verses.sanskrit: सस्नेहं गाढमालिङ्ग्य भवानीपतिमच्युतः । तदागमनकार्यं च पृष्टवान्विष्टरश्रवाः
verses.transliteration: sasnehaṃ gāḍhamāliṅgya bhavānīpatimacyutaḥ / tadāgamanakāryaṃ ca pṛṣṭavānviṣṭaraśravāḥ
verses.translation: It abounded in full blown flowers and beautiful sprouts moving gracefully in the gentle breeze. It was rendered fragrant by the continued flow of sweet smell of flowers therein that excelled even the flowers of heavenly tree Santana.
verses.wordMeaning: It abounded in full blown flowers and beautiful sprouts moving gracefully in the gentle breeze. It was rendered fragrant by the continued flow of sweet smell of flowers therein that excelled even the flowers of heavenly tree Santana.
verses.commentary: Sense: It abounded in full blown flowers and beautiful sprouts moving gracefully in the gentle breeze. It was rendered fragrant by the continued flow of sweet smell of flowers therein that excelled even the flowers of heavenly tree Santana.

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाच महादेवो भगवन्पुरुषोत्तम । महायोगेश्वर श्रीमन्सर्वसौभाग्यसुन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca mahādevo bhagavanpuruṣottama / mahāyogeśvara śrīmansarvasaubhāgyasundaram
verses.translation: A beautiful woman w'as seen at the foot of a Parijata tree, there in that garden full of flowers and pleasing to the minds of all people.
verses.wordMeaning: A beautiful woman w'as seen at the foot of a Parijata tree, there in that garden full of flowers and pleasing to the minds of all people.
verses.commentary: Sense: A beautiful woman w'as seen at the foot of a Parijata tree, there in that garden full of flowers and pleasing to the minds of all people.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसंमोहजनकमवाङ्मनसगोचरम् । यद्रूपं भवतोपात्तं तन्मह्यं संप्रदर्शय
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṃmohajanakamavāṅmanasagocaram / yadrūpaṃ bhavatopāttaṃ tanmahyaṃ saṃpradarśaya
verses.translation: By profuse application of the splendid red dye and lac, her feet were blood-red in colour. She was very charming with lotus-like feet adorned with anklets producing sweet tinkling notes.
verses.wordMeaning: By profuse application of the splendid red dye and lac, her feet were blood-red in colour. She was very charming with lotus-like feet adorned with anklets producing sweet tinkling notes.
verses.commentary: Sense: By profuse application of the splendid red dye and lac, her feet were blood-red in colour. She was very charming with lotus-like feet adorned with anklets producing sweet tinkling notes.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपं शृङ्गारस्याधिदैवतम् । अवश्यं दर्शनीयं मे त्वं हि प्रार्थितकामधृक्
verses.transliteration: draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpaṃ śṛṅgārasyādhidaivatam / avaśyaṃ darśanīyaṃ me tvaṃ hi prārthitakāmadhṛk
verses.translation: Her shanks were capable of suppressing the pride of the quiver of the hero Anahga (Lord of Love). She shone charmingly with her thighs resembling the trunk of an elephant as well as the stem of a plantain tree in complexion (as well as shape).
verses.wordMeaning: Her shanks were capable of suppressing the pride of the quiver of the hero Anahga (Lord of Love). She shone charmingly with her thighs resembling the trunk of an elephant as well as the stem of a plantain tree in complexion (as well as shape).
verses.commentary: Sense: Her shanks were capable of suppressing the pride of the quiver of the hero Anahga (Lord of Love). She shone charmingly with her thighs resembling the trunk of an elephant as well as the stem of a plantain tree in complexion (as well as shape).

verses.sanskrit: इति संप्रार्थितः शश्वन्महादेवेन तेन सः । यद्ध्यानवैभवाल्लब्धं रूपमद्वैतमद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: iti saṃprārthitaḥ śaśvanmahādevena tena saḥ / yaddhyānavaibhavāllabdhaṃ rūpamadvaitamadbhutam
verses.translation: Her excellent buttocks were covered with a soft glossy silk of very fine texture and pink colour. She was very brilliant in appearance with big hips and loins.
verses.wordMeaning: Her excellent buttocks were covered with a soft glossy silk of very fine texture and pink colour. She was very brilliant in appearance with big hips and loins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her excellent buttocks were covered with a soft glossy silk of very fine texture and pink colour. She was very brilliant in appearance with big hips and loins.

verses.sanskrit: तदेवानन्यमनसा ध्यात्वा किञ्चिद्विहस्य सः । तथास्त्विति तिरो ऽधत्त महायोगेश्वरो हरिः
verses.transliteration: tadevānanyamanasā dhyātvā kiñcidvihasya saḥ / tathāstviti tiro 'dhatta mahāyogeśvaro hariḥ
verses.translation: She had arms tender like the Sirlsa ( Acacia Sirissa) flowers. She was bedecked in bangles and bracelets. In her fingers she had rings. Her neck was beautiful like the well polished conch-shell.
verses.wordMeaning: She had arms tender like the Sirlsa ( Acacia Sirissa) flowers. She was bedecked in bangles and bracelets. In her fingers she had rings. Her neck was beautiful like the well polished conch-shell.
verses.commentary: Sense: She had arms tender like the Sirlsa ( Acacia Sirissa) flowers. She was bedecked in bangles and bracelets. In her fingers she had rings. Her neck was beautiful like the well polished conch-shell.

verses.sanskrit: शर्वो ऽपि सर्वतश्चक्षुर्मुहुर्व्यापारयन्क्वचित् । अदृष्टपूर्वमाराममभिरामं व्यलोकयत्
verses.transliteration: śarvo 'pi sarvataścakṣurmuhurvyāpārayankvacit / adṛṣṭapūrvamārāmamabhirāmaṃ vyalokayat
verses.translation: Her braid of hair tied up neatly and adorned with the inner petals of Ketaka flowers shone well. Her eyes were long and fascinating. Her forehead resembled half the disc of the Moon. Her beautiful forelocks were neatly arranged.
verses.wordMeaning: Her braid of hair tied up neatly and adorned with the inner petals of Ketaka flowers shone well. Her eyes were long and fascinating. Her forehead resembled half the disc of the Moon. Her beautiful forelocks were neatly arranged.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her braid of hair tied up neatly and adorned with the inner petals of Ketaka flowers shone well. Her eyes were long and fascinating. Her forehead resembled half the disc of the Moon. Her beautiful forelocks were neatly arranged.

verses.sanskrit: विकसत्कुसुमश्रेणीविनोदिमधुपालिकम् । चंपकस्तबकामोदसुरभीकृतदिक्तटम्
verses.transliteration: vikasatkusumaśreṇīvinodimadhupālikam / caṃpakastabakāmodasurabhīkṛtadiktaṭam
verses.translation: Her ears were adorned with earings studded with rubies beautifying the tips of the ears. The betel leaf prepara- tion that she was chewing was rendered fragrant by scented juice, camphor and musk.
verses.wordMeaning: Her ears were adorned with earings studded with rubies beautifying the tips of the ears. The betel leaf prepara- tion that she was chewing was rendered fragrant by scented juice, camphor and musk.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her ears were adorned with earings studded with rubies beautifying the tips of the ears. The betel leaf prepara- tion that she was chewing was rendered fragrant by scented juice, camphor and musk.

verses.sanskrit: माकन्दवृन्दमाध्वीकमाद्यदुल्लोलकोकिलम् । अशोकमण्डलीकाण्डसताण्डवशिखण्डिकम्
verses.transliteration: mākandavṛndamādhvīkamādyadullolakokilam / aśokamaṇḍalīkāṇḍasatāṇḍavaśikhaṇḍikam
verses.translation: The mention of nose-ring shows that this work (Lalitcpakhyina) must be later than the 10th cent. A.D. (P. K. Gode had adduced adequate evidence to prove this). Rock-cut temples and frescos of pre-lOth cent, period do not show nose-rings.
verses.wordMeaning: The mention of nose-ring shows that this work (Lalitcpakhyina) must be later than the 10th cent. A.D. (P. K. Gode had adduced adequate evidence to prove this). Rock-cut temples and frescos of pre-lOth cent, period do not show nose-rings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mention of nose-ring shows that this work (Lalitcpakhyina) must be later than the 10th cent. A.D. (P. K. Gode had adduced adequate evidence to prove this). Rock-cut temples and frescos of pre-lOth cent, period do not show nose-rings.

verses.sanskrit: भृङ्गालिनवझङ्कारजितवल्लकिनिस्वनम् । पाटलोदारसौरभ्यपाटलीकुसुमोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛṅgālinavajhaṅkārajitavallakinisvanam / pāṭalodārasaurabhyapāṭalīkusumojjvalam
verses.translation: On seeing her beloved husband running thus, Uma was very much shaken by surprise. She censured herself and her beauty, overwhelmed with shame and envy, she stood there silently with the head bent down.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her beloved husband running thus, Uma was very much shaken by surprise. She censured herself and her beauty, overwhelmed with shame and envy, she stood there silently with the head bent down.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her beloved husband running thus, Uma was very much shaken by surprise. She censured herself and her beauty, overwhelmed with shame and envy, she stood there silently with the head bent down.

verses.sanskrit: तमालतालहिन्तालकृतमालाविलासितम् । पर्यन्तदीर्घिकादीर्घपङ्कजश्रीपरिष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tamālatālahintālakṛtamālāvilāsitam / paryantadīrghikādīrghapaṅkajaśrīpariṣkṛtam
verses.translation: Siva caught Jier somehow and embraced her frequently. Shaking hini off repeatedly, she too ran far away.
verses.wordMeaning: Siva caught Jier somehow and embraced her frequently. Shaking hini off repeatedly, she too ran far away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva caught Jier somehow and embraced her frequently. Shaking hini off repeatedly, she too ran far away.

verses.sanskrit: वातपातचलच्चारुपल्लवोत्फुल्लपुष्पकम् । सन्तानप्रसवामोदसन्तानाधिकवासितम्
verses.transliteration: vātapātacalaccārupallavotphullapuṣpakam / santānaprasavāmodasantānādhikavāsitam
verses.translation: Due to the contact with the drops of that semen, O suppressor of Vindhya mountain, the earth assumed the colour of silver and gold instantly at different places.
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the contact with the drops of that semen, O suppressor of Vindhya mountain, the earth assumed the colour of silver and gold instantly at different places.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the contact with the drops of that semen, O suppressor of Vindhya mountain, the earth assumed the colour of silver and gold instantly at different places.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वत्र पुष्पाढ्ये सर्वलोकमनोहरे । पारिजाततरोर्मूले कान्ता काचिददृश्यत
verses.transliteration: tatra sarvatra puṣpāḍhye sarvalokamanohare / pārijātatarormūle kāntā kācidadṛśyata
verses.translation: Similarly that deity Visvamohin! (the enchantress of the universe) vanished. Turning back in the company of GaurT, Girisa (Siva) too went to his mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly that deity Visvamohin! (the enchantress of the universe) vanished. Turning back in the company of GaurT, Girisa (Siva) too went to his mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly that deity Visvamohin! (the enchantress of the universe) vanished. Turning back in the company of GaurT, Girisa (Siva) too went to his mountain.

verses.sanskrit: बालार्कपाटलाकारा नवयौवनदर्पिता । आकृष्टपद्मरागाभा चरणाब्जनखच्छदा
verses.transliteration: bālārkapāṭalākārā navayauvanadarpitā / ākṛṣṭapadmarāgābhā caraṇābjanakhacchadā
verses.translation: I shall tell you a wonderful thing, O husband of Lopamudra.. Listen, this has been in my heart. It has never been revealed to anyone.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall tell you a wonderful thing, O husband of Lopamudra.. Listen, this has been in my heart. It has never been revealed to anyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall tell you a wonderful thing, O husband of Lopamudra.. Listen, this has been in my heart. It has never been revealed to anyone.

verses.sanskrit: यावकश्रीविनिक्षेपपादलौहित्यवाहिनी । कलनिःस्वनमञ्जीरपदपद्ममनोहरा
verses.transliteration: yāvakaśrīvinikṣepapādalauhityavāhinī / kalaniḥsvanamañjīrapadapadmamanoharā
verses.translation: From his right shoulder he created a Daitya named Visukra who was capable ofprotecting his species. He was on a par with Sukra and conversant with all thoughts.
verses.wordMeaning: From his right shoulder he created a Daitya named Visukra who was capable ofprotecting his species. He was on a par with Sukra and conversant with all thoughts.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his right shoulder he created a Daitya named Visukra who was capable ofprotecting his species. He was on a par with Sukra and conversant with all thoughts.

verses.sanskrit: अनङ्गवीरतूणीरदर्पोन्मदनजङ्घिका । करिशुण्डाकदलिकाकान्तितुल्योरुशोभिनी
verses.transliteration: anaṅgavīratūṇīradarponmadanajaṅghikā / kariśuṇḍākadalikākāntitulyoruśobhinī
verses.translation: He created Visariga of defiled crest from his left shoulder. Bhanda, the Danava, created a sister too named Duminl.
verses.wordMeaning: He created Visariga of defiled crest from his left shoulder. Bhanda, the Danava, created a sister too named Duminl.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created Visariga of defiled crest from his left shoulder. Bhanda, the Danava, created a sister too named Duminl.

verses.sanskrit: अरुणेन दुकूलेन सुस्पर्शेन तनीयसा । अलङ्कृतनितंबाढ्या जघनाभोगभासुरा
verses.transliteration: aruṇena dukūlena susparśena tanīyasā / alaṅkṛtanitaṃbāḍhyā jaghanābhogabhāsurā
verses.translation: In the company of his brothers of fierce valour, this demon killed all his enemies. With increased heroism and prowess he hit and hurt the entire cosmos.
verses.wordMeaning: In the company of his brothers of fierce valour, this demon killed all his enemies. With increased heroism and prowess he hit and hurt the entire cosmos.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the company of his brothers of fierce valour, this demon killed all his enemies. With increased heroism and prowess he hit and hurt the entire cosmos.

verses.sanskrit: नवमाणिक्यसन्नद्धहेमकाञ्जीविराजिता । नतनाभिमहावर्त्तत्रिवल्यूर्मिप्रभाझरा
verses.transliteration: navamāṇikyasannaddhahemakāñjīvirājitā / natanābhimahāvarttatrivalyūrmiprabhājharā
verses.translation: On seeing him enkindled in spirit and splendour, Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa began to flee immediately. They stayed in their respective abodes permanently.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him enkindled in spirit and splendour, Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa began to flee immediately. They stayed in their respective abodes permanently.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him enkindled in spirit and splendour, Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa began to flee immediately. They stayed in their respective abodes permanently.

verses.sanskrit: स्तनकुड्मलहिन्दोलमुक्तादामशतावृता । अतिपीवरवक्षोजभारभङ्गुरमध्यभूः
verses.transliteration: stanakuḍmalahindolamuktādāmaśatāvṛtā / atipīvaravakṣojabhārabhaṅguramadhyabhūḥ
verses.translation: At the very same time, stupefied on being thrashed by his arms, the groups of heaven-dwellers found themselves incapable of even breathing.
verses.wordMeaning: At the very same time, stupefied on being thrashed by his arms, the groups of heaven-dwellers found themselves incapable of even breathing.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the very same time, stupefied on being thrashed by his arms, the groups of heaven-dwellers found themselves incapable of even breathing.

verses.sanskrit: शिरीषकोमलभुजा कङ्कणाङ्गदशालिनी । सोर्मिकां गुलिमन्मृष्टशङ्खसुन्दरकन्धरा
verses.transliteration: śirīṣakomalabhujā kaṅkaṇāṅgadaśālinī / sormikāṃ gulimanmṛṣṭaśaṅkhasundarakandharā
verses.translation: Bhanda considered everyone no better than a blade of grass— every one namely Yaksas, great serpents, Siddhas and Sadhyas, although they were highly arrogant of their ability to fight. He did not mind even Brahma, Padma- nabha (Visnu) and Rudra as well as Indra, the wielder. of thunderbolt. Thus Bhanda ruled over all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने मोहिनीप्रादुर्भावमलकासुरवधो नाम दशमो ऽध्यायः समाप्तश्चोपोद्धातखण्डः । अगस्त्य उवाच कथं भण्डासुरो जातः कथं वा त्रिपुरांबिका । कथं बभञ्ज तं संख्ये तत्सर्वं वद विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne mohinīprādurbhāvamalakāsuravadho nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaścopoddhātakhaṇḍaḥ / agastya uvāca kathaṃ bhaṇḍāsuro jātaḥ kathaṃ vā tripurāṃbikā / kathaṃ babhañja taṃ saṃkhye tatsarvaṃ vada vistarāt
verses.translation: "How was Bhandasura born? How did Tripurambika originate? How did she smash him in battle? Mention everything in detail?"
verses.wordMeaning: "How was Bhandasura born? How did Tripurambika originate? How did she smash him in battle? Mention everything in detail?"

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच पुरा दाक्षायणीं त्यक्त्वा पितुर्यज्ञविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca purā dākṣāyaṇīṃ tyaktvā pituryajñavināśanam
verses.translation: The lord cupid ofmountains heard from Narada that his daughter had been Rudranl. Hence, he placed her near Siva for the sake of serving him.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord cupid ofmountains heard from Narada that his daughter had been Rudranl. Hence, he placed her near Siva for the sake of serving him.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमात्मना पश्यञ्ज्ञानानन्दरसात्मकः । उपास्यमानो मुनिभिरद्वन्द्वगुणलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: ātmānamātmanā paśyañjñānānandarasātmakaḥ / upāsyamāno munibhiradvandvaguṇalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, the Devas were harassed byTaraka. 1 On being advised by god Brahma, they called cupid (the god of Love) and said thus:

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाकूले हिमवतः पर्यन्ते प्रविवेश ह । सापि शङ्करमा राध्य चिरकालं मनस्विनी
verses.transliteration: gaṅgākūle himavataḥ paryante praviveśa ha / sāpi śaṅkaramā rādhya cirakālaṃ manasvinī
verses.translation: "At the beginning of the period of creation, lord Brahma began procreating all subjects; But he never had pleasure or satisfaction in his mind. He performed penance for a long time mentally, verbally and physically.
verses.wordMeaning: "At the beginning of the period of creation, lord Brahma began procreating all subjects; But he never had pleasure or satisfaction in his mind. He performed penance for a long time mentally, verbally and physically.

verses.sanskrit: योगेन स्वां तनुं त्यक्त्वा सुतासीद्धिमभूभृतः
verses.transliteration: yogena svāṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā sutāsīddhimabhūbhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, the delighted Lord Visnu the hestower ofboons unto all embodied beings appeared there accom- panied by-Laksml. He asked Brahma to choose any boon as he liked.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the delighted Lord Visnu the hestower ofboons unto all embodied beings appeared there accom- panied by-Laksml. He asked Brahma to choose any boon as he liked.

verses.sanskrit: स शैलो नारदाच्छ्रुत्वा रुद्राणीति स्वकन्याकाम् । तस्य शुश्रूषणार्थाय स्थापयामास चान्तिके
verses.transliteration: sa śailo nāradācchrutvā rudrāṇīti svakanyākām / tasya śuśrūṣaṇārthāya sthāpayāmāsa cāntike
verses.translation: "O lord, ifyou are pleased, let it be that I shall be able to create this entire universe consisting of mobile and immobile beings, without any strain. Let me be able to create, everything through your grace".
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, ifyou are pleased, let it be that I shall be able to create this entire universe consisting of mobile and immobile beings, without any strain. Let me be able to create, everything through your grace".

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवास्तारकेण हि पीडिताः । ब्रह्मणोक्ताः समाहूय मदनं चेदमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devāstārakeṇa hi pīḍitāḥ / brahmaṇoktāḥ samāhūya madanaṃ cedamabruvan
verses.translation: On being implored thus by Brahma, the lord glanced at MahalaksmI. Indeed, it was at that time that you manifested yourself, assuming a form that could enchant the universe.
verses.wordMeaning: On being implored thus by Brahma, the lord glanced at MahalaksmI. Indeed, it was at that time that you manifested yourself, assuming a form that could enchant the universe.

verses.sanskrit: सर्गादौ भगवान्ब्रह्म सृजमानो ऽखिलाः प्रजाः । न निर्वृतिरभूत्तस्य कदाचिदपि मानसे । तपश्चचार सुचिरं मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: sargādau bhagavānbrahma sṛjamāno 'khilāḥ prajāḥ / na nirvṛtirabhūttasya kadācidapi mānase / tapaścacāra suciraṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: An Asura chief. (PE, ) on the basis of some Puranas states (hat he gut a boon from Siva *tliat none other Ilian a son born to Siva should be able to kill him'. Our text here (VV. 16-17) attributes the granting of the boon to god Brahma. Siva was a widower then and he must be persuaded to marry to beget a son for killing Tarakasura. Hence, the deputation of Cupid the god of Love resulting in Kama's being burnt as narrated in the subsequent story.
verses.wordMeaning: An Asura chief. (PE, ) on the basis of some Puranas states (hat he gut a boon from Siva *tliat none other Ilian a son born to Siva should be able to kill him'. Our text here (VV. 16-17) attributes the granting of the boon to god Brahma.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान्सलक्ष्मीको जनार्दनः । वरेण च्छन्दयामास वरदः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavānsalakṣmīko janārdanaḥ / vareṇa cchandayāmāsa varadaḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: For serving you as weapons, the flower-arrows and the sugarcane bow were given to you. The delighted Hari granted you invincibility and the state of being always a Victor.
verses.wordMeaning: For serving you as weapons, the flower-arrows and the sugarcane bow were given to you. The delighted Hari granted you invincibility and the state of being always a Victor.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । यदि तुष्टो ऽसि भगवन्ननायासेन वै जगत् । चराचरयुतं चैतत्सृजामि त्वत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca / yadi tuṣṭo 'si bhagavannanāyāsena vai jagat / carācarayutaṃ caitatsṛjāmi tvatprasādataḥ
verses.translation: This (Brahma) creates living beings through the cause i.e. one's own Karman (past action), you shall be the witness through your own folk (aides). May you thus enjoy pleasure.
verses.wordMeaning: This (Brahma) creates living beings through the cause i.e. one's own Karman (past action), you shall be the witness through your own folk (aides). May you thus enjoy pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: This (Brahma) creates living beings through the cause i.e. one's own Karman (past action), you shall be the witness through your own folk (aides). May you thus enjoy pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो विधात्रा तु महाल क्ष्मीमुदैक्षत । तदा प्रादुरभूस्त्वं हि जगन्मोहनरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: evamukto vidhātrā tu mahāla kṣmīmudaikṣata / tadā prādurabhūstvaṃ hi jaganmohanarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: O Cupid, Brahma to whom boons have been granted, places the burden on you and realizes mental •satisfaction and remains care-free even today.
verses.wordMeaning: O Cupid, Brahma to whom boons have been granted, places the burden on you and realizes mental •satisfaction and remains care-free even today.
