verses.sanskrit: तवायुधार्थं दत्तं च पुष्पबाणेक्षुकार्मुकम् । विजयत्वमजेयत्वं प्रादा त्प्रमुदितो हरिः
verses.transliteration: tavāyudhārthaṃ dattaṃ ca puṣpabāṇekṣukārmukam / vijayatvamajeyatvaṃ prādā tpramudito hariḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you no one else can even say anything on this great task. This task can be achieved by you by means of your own hands, and not through anyone else.
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you no one else can even say anything on this great task. This task can be achieved by you by means of your own hands, and not through anyone else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you no one else can even say anything on this great task. This task can be achieved by you by means of your own hands, and not through anyone else.

verses.sanskrit: असौ सृजति भूतानि कारणेन स्वकर्मणा । साक्षिभूतः स्वजनतो भवान्भजतु निर्वृन्तिम्
verses.transliteration: asau sṛjati bhūtāni kāraṇena svakarmaṇā / sākṣibhūtaḥ svajanato bhavānbhajatu nirvṛntim
verses.translation: Accompanied by GaurT, and surrounded by the sages, Siva is now staying in the beautiful region ofHimacala. He is engrossed in the supreme Being.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by GaurT, and surrounded by the sages, Siva is now staying in the beautiful region ofHimacala. He is engrossed in the supreme Being.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by GaurT, and surrounded by the sages, Siva is now staying in the beautiful region ofHimacala. He is engrossed in the supreme Being.

verses.sanskrit: एष दत्तवरो ब्रह्मा त्वयि विन्यस्य तद्भरम् । मनसो निर्वृतिं प्राप्य वर्तते ऽद्यापि मन्मथ
verses.transliteration: eṣa dattavaro brahmā tvayi vinyasya tadbharam / manaso nirvṛtiṃ prāpya vartate 'dyāpi manmatha
verses.translation: Urge him on to GaurT. His son will then be born. Save us, O mighty one, by performing this task that can be easily accomplished."
verses.wordMeaning: Urge him on to GaurT. His son will then be born. Save us, O mighty one, by performing this task that can be easily accomplished."
verses.commentary: Sense: Urge him on to GaurT. His son will then be born. Save us, O mighty one, by performing this task that can be easily accomplished."

verses.sanskrit: अमोघं बलवीर्यं ते न ते मोघः पराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: amoghaṃ balavīryaṃ te na te moghaḥ parākramaḥ
verses.translation: On being entreated by the Devas thus, and being
verses.wordMeaning: On being entreated by the Devas thus, and being
verses.commentary: Sense: On being entreated by the Devas thus, and being

verses.sanskrit: सुकुमाराण्यमोघानि कुसुमास्त्राणि ते सदा । ब्रह्मदत्तवरो ऽयं हि तारको नाम दानवः
verses.transliteration: sukumārāṇyamoghāni kusumāstrāṇi te sadā / brahmadattavaro 'yaṃ hi tārako nāma dānavaḥ
verses.translation: The lord of Love with his weapon of flowery arrows raised, saw Isana seated there with his eyes closed and engrossed in propitiating something.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of Love with his weapon of flowery arrows raised, saw Isana seated there with his eyes closed and engrossed in propitiating something.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Love with his weapon of flowery arrows raised, saw Isana seated there with his eyes closed and engrossed in propitiating something.

verses.sanskrit: बाधते सकलांल्लोकानस्मानपि विशेषतः । शिवपुत्रादृते ऽन्यत्र न भयं तस्य विद्यते
verses.transliteration: bādhate sakalāṃllokānasmānapi viśeṣataḥ / śivaputrādṛte 'nyatra na bhayaṃ tasya vidyate
verses.translation: In the meantime the daughter of the Himavan, •equipped with wonderful personality came there with a desire to serve and propitiate Siva.
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime the daughter of the Himavan, •equipped with wonderful personality came there with a desire to serve and propitiate Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime the daughter of the Himavan, •equipped with wonderful personality came there with a desire to serve and propitiate Siva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां विनास्मिन्महाकार्ये न कश्चित्प्रवदेदपि । स्वकराच्च भवेत्कार्यं भवतो नान्यतः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ vināsminmahākārye na kaścitpravadedapi / svakarācca bhavetkāryaṃ bhavato nānyataḥ kvacit
verses.translation: The excessively powerful lord of Love, Smara saw -there, Girija (ParvatT) engaged in serving god Sambhu after
verses.wordMeaning: The excessively powerful lord of Love, Smara saw -there, Girija (ParvatT) engaged in serving god Sambhu after
verses.commentary: Sense: The excessively powerful lord of Love, Smara saw -there, Girija (ParvatT) engaged in serving god Sambhu after

verses.sanskrit: आत्म्यैक्यधयाननिरतः शिवो गौर्या समन्वितः । हिमाचलतले रम्ये वर्तते मुनिभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: ātmyaikyadhayānanirataḥ śivo gauryā samanvitaḥ / himācalatale ramye vartate munibhirvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Invisible to all living beings, he stood firmly not very far from him (Siva). With his excellent flowery arrows he pierced Mahesvara.
verses.wordMeaning: Invisible to all living beings, he stood firmly not very far from him (Siva). With his excellent flowery arrows he pierced Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Invisible to all living beings, he stood firmly not very far from him (Siva). With his excellent flowery arrows he pierced Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: तं नियोजय गौर्यां तु जनिष्यति च तत्सुतः । ईषत्कार्यमिदं कृत्वा त्रायस्वास्मान्महाबल
verses.transliteration: taṃ niyojaya gauryāṃ tu janiṣyati ca tatsutaḥ / īṣatkāryamidaṃ kṛtvā trāyasvāsmānmahābala
verses.translation: On being hit by those arrows Siva became one whose consciousness was completely permeated by the god of love. Forgetting all his duties, he glanced at Gaurl, who was standing by him.
verses.wordMeaning: On being hit by those arrows Siva became one whose consciousness was completely permeated by the god of love. Forgetting all his duties, he glanced at Gaurl, who was standing by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being hit by those arrows Siva became one whose consciousness was completely permeated by the god of love. Forgetting all his duties, he glanced at Gaurl, who was standing by him.

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैः स्तूयमानो मुहुर्मुहुः । जगामात्मविनाशाय यतो हिमवतस्तटम्
verses.transliteration: evamabhyarthito devaiḥ stūyamāno muhurmuhuḥ / jagāmātmavināśāya yato himavatastaṭam
verses.translation: Regaining his fortitude and mental steadiness, he began to think what it was (that had upset him.) Then he saw in front of him the cupid, the lord of love, with flowers for his weapon standing in readiness to attack.
verses.wordMeaning: Regaining his fortitude and mental steadiness, he began to think what it was (that had upset him.) Then he saw in front of him the cupid, the lord of love, with flowers for his weapon standing in readiness to attack.
verses.commentary: Sense: Regaining his fortitude and mental steadiness, he began to think what it was (that had upset him.) Then he saw in front of him the cupid, the lord of love, with flowers for his weapon standing in readiness to attack.

verses.sanskrit: किमप्याराधयान्तं तु ध्यानसंमीलितेक्षणम् । ददर्शेशानमासीनं कुसुमषुरुदायुधः
verses.transliteration: kimapyārādhayāntaṃ tu dhyānasaṃmīlitekṣaṇam / dadarśeśānamāsīnaṃ kusumaṣurudāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, the trident-bearing lord Siva wlm was competent to burn the three worlds, opened his third eye and burned the shark-bannered lord Cupid.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, the trident-bearing lord Siva wlm was competent to burn the three worlds, opened his third eye and burned the shark-bannered lord Cupid.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, the trident-bearing lord Siva wlm was competent to burn the three worlds, opened his third eye and burned the shark-bannered lord Cupid.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र हिमवत्तनया शिवम् । आरिराधयिषुश्चा गाद्बिभ्राणा रूपमद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra himavattanayā śivam / ārirādhayiṣuścā gādbibhrāṇā rūpamadbhutam
verses.translation: On being slighted thus by Siva, daughter of the mountain became dejected. Thereafter, with the permission of her parents, she went to the forest for performing penance.
verses.wordMeaning: On being slighted thus by Siva, daughter of the mountain became dejected. Thereafter, with the permission of her parents, she went to the forest for performing penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being slighted thus by Siva, daughter of the mountain became dejected. Thereafter, with the permission of her parents, she went to the forest for performing penance.

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य शम्भुं गिरिजां गन्धपुष्पोपहारकैः । शुश्रूषणपरां तत्र ददर्शातिबलः स्मरः
verses.transliteration: sametya śambhuṃ girijāṃ gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥ / śuśrūṣaṇaparāṃ tatra dadarśātibalaḥ smaraḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the ashes of the Cupid, Citrakarma, the lord of Ganas, made a man ofwonderful form by means of those ashes.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the ashes of the Cupid, Citrakarma, the lord of Ganas, made a man ofwonderful form by means of those ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the ashes of the Cupid, Citrakarma, the lord of Ganas, made a man ofwonderful form by means of those ashes.

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानान्नातिदूरे ऽस्य संस्थितः । सुमनोमार्गणैरग्र्यैस्स विव्याध महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānānnātidūre 'sya saṃsthitaḥ / sumanomārgaṇairagryaissa vivyādha maheśvaram
verses.translation: Citrakarma embraced him joyously with his arms and said, "O son, eulogise Mahadeva. Indeed he is the bestower of achievement of all objects."
verses.wordMeaning: Citrakarma embraced him joyously with his arms and said, "O son, eulogise Mahadeva. Indeed he is the bestower of achievement of all objects."
verses.commentary: Sense: Citrakarma embraced him joyously with his arms and said, "O son, eulogise Mahadeva. Indeed he is the bestower of achievement of all objects."

verses.sanskrit: विस्मृत्य स हि कार्याणि बाणविद्धो ऽन्तिके स्थिताम् । गौरीं विलोकयामास मन्मथाविष्टचेतनः
verses.transliteration: vismṛtya sa hi kāryāṇi bāṇaviddho 'ntike sthitām / gaurīṃ vilokayāmāsa manmathāviṣṭacetanaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, that person of immeasurable intellect taught him the Mantra Satarudriya. The boy bowed to Rudra one hundred times repeating the Satarudriya.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, that person of immeasurable intellect taught him the Mantra Satarudriya. The boy bowed to Rudra one hundred times repeating the Satarudriya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, that person of immeasurable intellect taught him the Mantra Satarudriya. The boy bowed to Rudra one hundred times repeating the Satarudriya.

verses.sanskrit: धृतिमालंब्य तु पुनः किमेतदिति चिन्तयन् । ददर्शाग्रे तु सन्नद्धं मन्मथं कुसुमायुधम्
verses.transliteration: dhṛtimālaṃbya tu punaḥ kimetaditi cintayan / dadarśāgre tu sannaddhaṃ manmathaṃ kusumāyudham
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Mahadeva with Bull as his banner, asked him to choose any boon he liked. The boy then chose the boon.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the delighted lord Mahadeva with Bull as his banner, asked him to choose any boon he liked. The boy then chose the boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord Mahadeva with Bull as his banner, asked him to choose any boon he liked. The boy then chose the boon.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा कुपितः शूली त्रैलोक्यदहनक्षमः । तार्तीयं चक्षुरुन्मील्य ददाह मकरध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā kupitaḥ śūlī trailokyadahanakṣamaḥ / tārtīyaṃ cakṣurunmīlya dadāha makaradhvajam
verses.translation: "Halfofthe power of my antagonist will be united
verses.wordMeaning: "Halfofthe power of my antagonist will be united
verses.commentary: Sense: "Halfofthe power of my antagonist will be united

verses.sanskrit: शिवेनैवमवज्ञाता दुःखिता शैलकन्यका । अनुज्ञया ततः पित्रोस्तपः कर्तुमगाद्वनम्
verses.transliteration: śivenaivamavajñātā duḥkhitā śailakanyakā / anujñayā tataḥ pitrostapaḥ kartumagādvanam
verses.translation: After promising him "Be it so" and pondering over something, the lord granted him the power to rule the kingdom for sixty thousand years.
verses.wordMeaning: After promising him "Be it so" and pondering over something, the lord granted him the power to rule the kingdom for sixty thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: After promising him "Be it so" and pondering over something, the lord granted him the power to rule the kingdom for sixty thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तद्भस्म संवीक्ष्य चित्रकर्मा गणेश्वरः । तद्भस्मना तु पुरुषं चित्राकारं चकार सः
verses.transliteration: atha tadbhasma saṃvīkṣya citrakarmā gaṇeśvaraḥ / tadbhasmanā tu puruṣaṃ citrākāraṃ cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: On observing this conduct the creator said "Bhand, bhand" 1 Therefore, he is being called Bhanda in worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: On observing this conduct the creator said "Bhand, bhand" 1 Therefore, he is being called Bhanda in worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing this conduct the creator said "Bhand, bhand" 1 Therefore, he is being called Bhanda in worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तं विचित्रतनुं रुद्रो ददर्शाग्रे तु पूरुषम् । तत्क्षणाज्जात जीवो ऽभून्मूर्तिमानिव मन्मथः । महाबलो ऽतितेजस्वी मध्याह्नार्कसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: taṃ vicitratanuṃ rudro dadarśāgre tu pūruṣam / tatkṣaṇājjāta jīvo 'bhūnmūrtimāniva manmathaḥ / mahābalo 'titejasvī madhyāhnārkasamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: तं चित्रकर्मा बाहुभ्यां समालिङ्ग्य मुदान्वितः । स्तुहि वाल महादेवं स तु सर्वार्थसिद्धिदः
verses.transliteration: taṃ citrakarmā bāhubhyāṃ samāliṅgya mudānvitaḥ / stuhi vāla mahādevaṃ sa tu sarvārthasiddhidaḥ
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा शतरुद्रीयमुपादिशदमेयधीः । ननाम शतशो रुद्रं शतरुद्रियमाजपन्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā śatarudrīyamupādiśadameyadhīḥ / nanāma śataśo rudraṃ śatarudriyamājapan
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान्महादेवो वृषध्वजः । वरेण च्छन्दयामास वरं वव्रे स बालकः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavānmahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ / vareṇa cchandayāmāsa varaṃ vavre sa bālakaḥ
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिद्वन्द्विबलार्थं तु मद्बलेनोपयोक्ष्यति । तदस्त्रशस्त्रमुख्यानि वृथा कुर्वन्तु नो मम
verses.transliteration: pratidvandvibalārthaṃ tu madbalenopayokṣyati / tadastraśastramukhyāni vṛthā kurvantu no mama
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: तथेति तत्प्रतिश्रुत्य विचार्य किमपि प्रभुः । षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि राज्यमस्मै ददौ पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatheti tatpratiśrutya vicārya kimapi prabhuḥ / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi rājyamasmai dadau punaḥ
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दृष्ट्वा तु चरितं धाता भण्डिति भण्डिति । यदुवाच ततो नाम्ना भण्डो लोकेषु कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: etaddṛṣṭvā tu caritaṃ dhātā bhaṇḍiti bhaṇḍiti / yaduvāca tato nāmnā bhaṇḍo lokeṣu kathyate
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: इति दत्त्वा वरं तस्मै सर्वैर्मुनिगणैर्वृतः । दत्त्वास्त्राणि च शस्त्राणि तत्रैवान्तरधाच्च सः
verses.transliteration: iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai sarvairmunigaṇairvṛtaḥ / dattvāstrāṇi ca śastrāṇi tatraivāntaradhācca saḥ
verses.translation: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.wordMeaning: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting this boon to him and bestowing on him missiles and weapons, the lord vanished there itself surrounded by all groups of sages (?)

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने भण्डासुरप्रादुर्भावो नामैकादशो ऽध्यायः रुद्रकोपानलाज्जातो यतो भण्डो महाबलः । तस्माद्रौद्रस्वभावो हि दानवश्चाभवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne bhaṇḍāsuraprādurbhāvo nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ rudrakopānalājjāto yato bhaṇḍo mahābalaḥ / tasmādraudrasvabhāvo hi dānavaścābhavattataḥ
verses.translation: Then Sukra, the extremely refulgent preceptor of the Daityas, came to him. Hundreds of very powerful Daityas too came to him.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Sukra, the extremely refulgent preceptor of the Daityas, came to him. Hundreds of very powerful Daityas too came to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Sukra, the extremely refulgent preceptor of the Daityas, came to him. Hundreds of very powerful Daityas too came to him.

verses.sanskrit: अथागच्छन्महातेजाः शुक्रो दैत्यपुरोहितः । समायाताश्च शतशो दैतेयाः सुमहाबलाः
verses.transliteration: athāgacchanmahātejāḥ śukro daityapurohitaḥ / samāyātāśca śataśo daiteyāḥ sumahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Urged by the son of Bhrgu(i.e. Sukra), Bhanda called Maya, the original architect and engineer and artisan of the race of Daityas, and spoke these meaningful words:
verses.wordMeaning: Urged by the son of Bhrgu(i.e. Sukra), Bhanda called Maya, the original architect and engineer and artisan of the race of Daityas, and spoke these meaningful words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by the son of Bhrgu(i.e. Sukra), Bhanda called Maya, the original architect and engineer and artisan of the race of Daityas, and spoke these meaningful words:

verses.sanskrit: अथाहूय मयं भण्डो दैत्यवंश्यादिशिल्पिनम् । नियुक्तो भृगुपुत्रेण निजगादार्थवद्वचः
verses.transliteration: athāhūya mayaṃ bhaṇḍo daityavaṃśyādiśilpinam / niyukto bhṛguputreṇa nijagādārthavadvacaḥ
verses.translation: "It was at Sonitapura' 2 that all leading Daityas stayed before and ruled the three worlds. Go there and re-build the city."
verses.wordMeaning: "It was at Sonitapura' 2 that all leading Daityas stayed before and ruled the three worlds. Go there and re-build the city."
verses.commentary: Sense: "It was at Sonitapura' 2 that all leading Daityas stayed before and ruled the three worlds. Go there and re-build the city."

verses.sanskrit: यत्र स्थित्वा तु दैत्येन्द्रैस्त्रैलोक्यं शासितं पुरा । तद्गत्वा शोणितपुरं कुरुष्व त्वं यथापुरम्
verses.transliteration: yatra sthitvā tu daityendraistrailokyaṃ śāsitaṃ purā / tadgatvā śoṇitapuraṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ yathāpuram
verses.translation: On hearing those words, the architect went to that great city and by means ofbis imaginative mind and power
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words, the architect went to that great city and by means ofbis imaginative mind and power
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words, the architect went to that great city and by means ofbis imaginative mind and power

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं शिल्पी स गत्वाथ पुरं महत् । चक्रे ऽमरपुरप्रख्यं मनसैवेक्षणेन तु
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ śilpī sa gatvātha puraṃ mahat / cakre 'marapuraprakhyaṃ manasaivekṣaṇena tu
verses.translation: y/bhand — 'to be fortunate'. Probably 'blianditi' was a blessing.
verses.wordMeaning: y/bhand — 'to be fortunate'. Probably 'blianditi' was a blessing.
verses.commentary: Sense: y/bhand — 'to be fortunate'. Probably 'blianditi' was a blessing.

verses.sanskrit: अथाभिषिक्तः शुक्रेण दैतेयैश्च महाबलैः । शुशभे परया लक्ष्म्या तेजसा च समन्वितः
verses.transliteration: athābhiṣiktaḥ śukreṇa daiteyaiśca mahābalaiḥ / śuśabhe parayā lakṣmyā tejasā ca samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Although Assamese claim Tejpur as ancient Sonitapura, the claim of Sonitapura on the bank of Kedar-Gaiiga or Mandakini about six miles from Usama fh in Kumaun appears more acceptable — De,
verses.wordMeaning: Although Assamese claim Tejpur as ancient Sonitapura, the claim of Sonitapura on the bank of Kedar-Gaiiga or Mandakini about six miles from Usama fh in Kumaun appears more acceptable — De,
verses.commentary: Sense: Although Assamese claim Tejpur as ancient Sonitapura, the claim of Sonitapura on the bank of Kedar-Gaiiga or Mandakini about six miles from Usama fh in Kumaun appears more acceptable — De,

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्याय तु यद्दत्तं किरीटं ब्रह्मणा पुरा । सजीवमविनाश्यं च दैत्येन्द्रैरपि भूषितम् । दधौ भृगुसुतोत्सृष्टं भण्डो बालार्कसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyāya tu yaddattaṃ kirīṭaṃ brahmaṇā purā / sajīvamavināśyaṃ ca daityendrairapi bhūṣitam / dadhau bhṛgusutotsṛṣṭaṃ bhaṇḍo bālārkasannibham
verses.translation: Bhanda wore on his head the crown that shone like the rising sun and that was placed (on his head) by the son ofBhrgu. Formerly, it had been given to H iranya- Kasipu by Brahma. It was lively and indestructible. It had been worn by many Daitya rulers.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda wore on his head the crown that shone like the rising sun and that was placed (on his head) by the son ofBhrgu. Formerly, it had been given to H iranya- Kasipu by Brahma. It was lively and indestructible. It had been worn by many Daitya rulers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda wore on his head the crown that shone like the rising sun and that was placed (on his head) by the son ofBhrgu. Formerly, it had been given to H iranya- Kasipu by Brahma. It was lively and indestructible. It had been worn by many Daitya rulers.

verses.sanskrit: चामरे चन्द्रसंकाशे सजीवे ब्रह्म निर्मिते । न रोगो न च दुःखानि संदधौ यन्निषेवणात्
verses.transliteration: cāmare candrasaṃkāśe sajīve brahma nirmite / na rogo na ca duḥkhāni saṃdadhau yanniṣevaṇāt
verses.translation: Two lively Camaras (i.e. chowries) were used by him as his insignia. They resembled the moon. They had been made by Brahma. Neither sickness nor miseries could assail one by resorting to them.
verses.wordMeaning: Two lively Camaras (i.e. chowries) were used by him as his insignia. They resembled the moon. They had been made by Brahma. Neither sickness nor miseries could assail one by resorting to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two lively Camaras (i.e. chowries) were used by him as his insignia. They resembled the moon. They had been made by Brahma. Neither sickness nor miseries could assail one by resorting to them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यातपत्रं प्रददौ ब्रह्मणैव पुरा कृतम् । यस्य च्छायानिषण्णास्तु बाध्यन्ते नास्त्रकोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: tasyātapatraṃ pradadau brahmaṇaiva purā kṛtam / yasya cchāyāniṣaṇṇāstu bādhyante nāstrakoṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: He (Sukra) presented him an umbrella formerly made by Brahma himself. People seated in its shade were never affected by even crores of missiles.
verses.wordMeaning: He (Sukra) presented him an umbrella formerly made by Brahma himself. People seated in its shade were never affected by even crores of missiles.
verses.commentary: Sense: He (Sukra) presented him an umbrella formerly made by Brahma himself. People seated in its shade were never affected by even crores of missiles.

verses.sanskrit: धनुश्च विजयं नाम शङ्खं च रिपुघातिनम् । अन्यान्यपि महार्हाणि भूषणानि प्रदत्तवान्
verses.transliteration: dhanuśca vijayaṃ nāma śaṅkhaṃ ca ripughātinam / anyānyapi mahārhāṇi bhūṣaṇāni pradattavān
verses.translation: (The preceptor) gave him a bow named Vijaya and a conch called 'the killer ofenemies'. He gave him other very valuable ornaments too.
verses.wordMeaning: (The preceptor) gave him a bow named Vijaya and a conch called 'the killer ofenemies'. He gave him other very valuable ornaments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The preceptor) gave him a bow named Vijaya and a conch called 'the killer ofenemies'. He gave him other very valuable ornaments too.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सिंहासनं प्रादादक्षय्यं सूर्यसन्निभम् । ततः सिंहासनासीनः सर्वाभरणभूषितः । बभूवातीव तेजस्वी रत्नमुत्तेजितं यथा
verses.transliteration: tasya siṃhāsanaṃ prādādakṣayyaṃ sūryasannibham / tataḥ siṃhāsanāsīnaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ / babhūvātīva tejasvī ratnamuttejitaṃ yathā
verses.translation: He presented him an everlasting throne dazzling like the sun. Seated on the throne and bedecked in all ornaments he became magnificently brilliant like a gem that had been whetted.
verses.wordMeaning: He presented him an everlasting throne dazzling like the sun. Seated on the throne and bedecked in all ornaments he became magnificently brilliant like a gem that had been whetted.
verses.commentary: Sense: He presented him an everlasting throne dazzling like the sun. Seated on the throne and bedecked in all ornaments he became magnificently brilliant like a gem that had been whetted.

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुरथ दैतेयास्तयाष्टौ तु महाबलाः । इन्द्रशत्रुरमित्रघ्नो विद्युन्माली विभीषणः । उग्रकर्मोग्रधन्वा च विजयश्रुति पारगः
verses.transliteration: babhūvuratha daiteyāstayāṣṭau tu mahābalāḥ / indraśatruramitraghno vidyunmālī vibhīṣaṇaḥ / ugrakarmogradhanvā ca vijayaśruti pāragaḥ
verses.translation: He had eight mighty Daityas (as his assistants),
verses.wordMeaning: He had eight mighty Daityas (as his assistants),
verses.commentary: Sense: He had eight mighty Daityas (as his assistants),

verses.sanskrit: सुमोहिनी कुमुदिनी चित्राङ्गी सुंदरी तथा । चतस्रो वनितास्तस्य बभूवुः प्रियदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: sumohinī kumudinī citrāṅgī suṃdarī tathā / catasro vanitāstasya babhūvuḥ priyadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: He had four beautiful wives, viz.: Sumohinl,
verses.wordMeaning: He had four beautiful wives, viz.: Sumohinl,
verses.commentary: Sense: He had four beautiful wives, viz.: Sumohinl,

verses.sanskrit: तमसेवन्त कालज्ञा देवाः सर्वे सवासवाः । स्यन्दनास्तुरगा नागाः पादाताश्च सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tamasevanta kālajñā devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ / syandanāsturagā nāgāḥ pādātāśca sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: All the Devas including Vasava (Indra) who understood the (exigencies of the) time served him. He had thousands of chariots, horses, elephants and foot-soldiers.
verses.wordMeaning: All the Devas including Vasava (Indra) who understood the (exigencies of the) time served him. He had thousands of chariots, horses, elephants and foot-soldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Devas including Vasava (Indra) who understood the (exigencies of the) time served him. He had thousands of chariots, horses, elephants and foot-soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: संबभूवुर्महाकाया महान्तो जितकाशिनः । बभूवुर्दानवाः सर्वे भृगुपुत्रमतानुगाः
verses.transliteration: saṃbabhūvurmahākāyā mahānto jitakāśinaḥ / babhūvurdānavāḥ sarve bhṛguputramatānugāḥ
verses.translation: Noble ones with huge bodies, they were very proud •of their victory. All the Danavas followed the directives of the son ofBhrgu (i.e. Sukra).
verses.wordMeaning: Noble ones with huge bodies, they were very proud •of their victory. All the Danavas followed the directives of the son ofBhrgu (i.e. Sukra).
verses.commentary: Sense: Noble ones with huge bodies, they were very proud •of their victory. All the Danavas followed the directives of the son ofBhrgu (i.e. Sukra).

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयन्तो महादेवमास्थिताः शिवशासने । बभूवुर्दानवास्तत्र पुत्रपौत्रधनान्विताः । गृहेगृहे च यज्ञाश्च संबभूवुः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: arcayanto mahādevamāsthitāḥ śivaśāsane / babhūvurdānavāstatra putrapautradhanānvitāḥ / gṛhegṛhe ca yajñāśca saṃbabhūvuḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: They worshipped god Mahadeva abiding by the injunctions (cult?) of Siva, The Danavas possessed sons, grand-
verses.wordMeaning: They worshipped god Mahadeva abiding by the injunctions (cult?) of Siva, The Danavas possessed sons, grand-
verses.commentary: Sense: They worshipped god Mahadeva abiding by the injunctions (cult?) of Siva, The Danavas possessed sons, grand-

verses.sanskrit: ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि मीमांसान्यायकादयः । प्रवर्तन्ते स्म दैत्यानां भूयः प्रतिगृहं तदा
verses.transliteration: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni mīmāṃsānyāyakādayaḥ / pravartante sma daityānāṃ bhūyaḥ pratigṛhaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Rg., Yajus and Saman Mantras were frequently chanted in all the houses of Daityas. Mlmarhsa, Nyaya and other systems ofphilosophy too were studied in every house.
verses.wordMeaning: Rg., Yajus and Saman Mantras were frequently chanted in all the houses of Daityas. Mlmarhsa, Nyaya and other systems ofphilosophy too were studied in every house.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rg., Yajus and Saman Mantras were frequently chanted in all the houses of Daityas. Mlmarhsa, Nyaya and other systems ofphilosophy too were studied in every house.

verses.sanskrit: यथाश्रमेषु मुख्येषु मुनीनां च द्विजन्मनाम् । तथा यज्ञेषु दैत्यानां बुभुजुर्हव्यभोजिनः
verses.transliteration: yathāśrameṣu mukhyeṣu munīnāṃ ca dvijanmanām / tathā yajñeṣu daityānāṃ bubhujurhavyabhojinaḥ
verses.translation: The Devas accepted Havya offerings in the Yajnas of the Daityas too as in the case of important hermitages of sages and Brahmanas.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas accepted Havya offerings in the Yajnas of the Daityas too as in the case of important hermitages of sages and Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas accepted Havya offerings in the Yajnas of the Daityas too as in the case of important hermitages of sages and Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृतवतो ऽप्यस्य भण्डस्य जितकाशिनः । षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि व्यतीतानि क्षणार्धवत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtavato 'pyasya bhaṇḍasya jitakāśinaḥ / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi vyatītāni kṣaṇārdhavat
verses.translation: Even as Bhanda carried on all these activities with great pride in his victory, sixty thousand years elapsed like halfof a moment.
verses.wordMeaning: Even as Bhanda carried on all these activities with great pride in his victory, sixty thousand years elapsed like halfof a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as Bhanda carried on all these activities with great pride in his victory, sixty thousand years elapsed like halfof a moment.

verses.sanskrit: वर्धमानमथो दैत्यं तपसा च बलेन च । हीयमानबलं चेन्द्रं संप्रेक्ष्य कमलापतिः
verses.transliteration: vardhamānamatho daityaṃ tapasā ca balena ca / hīyamānabalaṃ cendraṃ saṃprekṣya kamalāpatiḥ
verses.translation: "Fascinating and deluding all living beings by your own power do roam about as you please. No one will find you out.
verses.wordMeaning: "Fascinating and deluding all living beings by your own power do roam about as you please. No one will find you out.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Fascinating and deluding all living beings by your own power do roam about as you please. No one will find you out.

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज सहसा काञ्चिन्मायां लोकविमोहिनीम् । तामुवाच ततो मायां देवदेवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: sasarja sahasā kāñcinmāyāṃ lokavimohinīm / tāmuvāca tato māyāṃ devadevo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Go hence immediately and enchant Bhanda, the leader of Daityas. Ere long, you will enjoy all worldly pleasures."
verses.wordMeaning: Go hence immediately and enchant Bhanda, the leader of Daityas. Ere long, you will enjoy all worldly pleasures."
verses.commentary: Sense: Go hence immediately and enchant Bhanda, the leader of Daityas. Ere long, you will enjoy all worldly pleasures."

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सर्वाणि भूतानि मोहयन्ती निजौजसा । विचरस्व यथाकामं त्वां न ज्ञास्यति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi sarvāṇi bhūtāni mohayantī nijaujasā / vicarasva yathākāmaṃ tvāṃ na jñāsyati kaścana
verses.translation: After receiving this boon. Maya bowed to Janardana and requested for a few of the chief celestial damsels for assistance.
verses.wordMeaning: After receiving this boon. Maya bowed to Janardana and requested for a few of the chief celestial damsels for assistance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After receiving this boon. Maya bowed to Janardana and requested for a few of the chief celestial damsels for assistance.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तु शीघ्रमितो गत्वा भण्डं दैतेयनायकम् । मोहयित्वाचिरेणैव विषयानुपभोक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ tu śīghramito gatvā bhaṇḍaṃ daiteyanāyakam / mohayitvācireṇaiva viṣayānupabhokṣyase
verses.translation: On being requested by her, the lord sent some celestial damsels. Accompanied by those ladies, chief of whom was VisvacT, that fawn-eyed lady (i.e. Maya) went to the excellent shore of Manasa 1 lake where brilliant trees grew up.
verses.wordMeaning: On being requested by her, the lord sent some celestial damsels. Accompanied by those ladies, chief of whom was VisvacT, that fawn-eyed lady (i.e. Maya) went to the excellent shore of Manasa 1 lake where brilliant trees grew up.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being requested by her, the lord sent some celestial damsels. Accompanied by those ladies, chief of whom was VisvacT, that fawn-eyed lady (i.e. Maya) went to the excellent shore of Manasa 1 lake where brilliant trees grew up.

verses.sanskrit: एवं लब्ध्वा वरं माया तं प्रणम्य जनार्दनम् । ययाचे ऽप्सरसो मुख्याः सहायार्थं तु काश्चन
verses.transliteration: evaṃ labdhvā varaṃ māyā taṃ praṇamya janārdanam / yayāce 'psaraso mukhyāḥ sahāyārthaṃ tu kāścana
verses.translation: Then the leader ofthe Daityas came there surrounded
verses.wordMeaning: Then the leader ofthe Daityas came there surrounded
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the leader ofthe Daityas came there surrounded

verses.sanskrit: तया संप्रार्थितो भूयः प्रेषयामास काश्चन । ताभिर्विश्वाचिमुख्याभिः सहिता सा मृगेक्षणा । प्रययौ मानसस्याग्यं तटमुज्ज्वलभूरुहम्
verses.transliteration: tayā saṃprārthito bhūyaḥ preṣayāmāsa kāścana / tābhirviśvācimukhyābhiḥ sahitā sā mṛgekṣaṇā / prayayau mānasasyāgyaṃ taṭamujjvalabhūruham
verses.translation: The purana-writer had little idea that there are no trees near Manasa lake. It is a poetic vision of the lake.
verses.wordMeaning: The purana-writer had little idea that there are no trees near Manasa lake. It is a poetic vision of the lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purana-writer had little idea that there are no trees near Manasa lake. It is a poetic vision of the lake.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र क्रीडति दैत्येन्द्रो निजनारीभिरन्वितः । तत्र सा मृगशावाक्षी मूले चंपकशाखिनः । निवासमकरोद्रम्यं गायन्ती मधुरस्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yatra krīḍati daityendro nijanārībhiranvitaḥ / tatra sā mṛgaśāvākṣī mūle caṃpakaśākhinaḥ / nivāsamakarodramyaṃ gāyantī madhurasvaram
verses.translation: On seeing that lady beautiful in every limb like another streak of lightning, he fell into the deep abysm named Cupid of an illusory nature.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that lady beautiful in every limb like another streak of lightning, he fell into the deep abysm named Cupid of an illusory nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that lady beautiful in every limb like another streak of lightning, he fell into the deep abysm named Cupid of an illusory nature.

verses.sanskrit: अथागतस्तु दैत्येन्द्रो बलिभिर्भन्त्रिभिर्वृतः । श्रुत्वा तु वीणानिनदं ददर्श च वराङ्गनाम्
verses.transliteration: athāgatastu daityendro balibhirbhantribhirvṛtaḥ / śrutvā tu vīṇāninadaṃ dadarśa ca varāṅganām
verses.translation: His ministers too became deeply affected by Kama (lord of Love) in theirhearts.
verses.wordMeaning: His ministers too became deeply affected by Kama (lord of Love) in theirhearts.
verses.commentary: Sense: His ministers too became deeply affected by Kama (lord of Love) in theirhearts.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गीं विद्युल्लेखामिवापराम् । मायामये महागर्ते पतितो मदनाभिधे
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṃ vidyullekhāmivāparām / māyāmaye mahāgarte patito madanābhidhe
verses.translation: On being requested continuously by the leader of Daityas and those (ministers also), the Maya lady as well as her assistant damsels instantly promised them adequate pleasure.
verses.wordMeaning: On being requested continuously by the leader of Daityas and those (ministers also), the Maya lady as well as her assistant damsels instantly promised them adequate pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being requested continuously by the leader of Daityas and those (ministers also), the Maya lady as well as her assistant damsels instantly promised them adequate pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्य मन्त्रिणो ऽभूवन्त्दृदये स्मरतापि ताः
verses.transliteration: athāsya mantriṇo 'bhūvantdṛdaye smaratāpi tāḥ
verses.translation: On attaining those ladies, the chief of whom was MohinT. they derived the greatest pleasure because (ordinarily) they could not be obtained even by Asvamedha and other great Yajnas.
verses.wordMeaning: On attaining those ladies, the chief of whom was MohinT. they derived the greatest pleasure because (ordinarily) they could not be obtained even by Asvamedha and other great Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On attaining those ladies, the chief of whom was MohinT. they derived the greatest pleasure because (ordinarily) they could not be obtained even by Asvamedha and other great Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: तेन दैतेयनाथेन चिरं संप्रर्थिता सती । तैश्च संप्रर्थितास्ताश्च प्रतिशूश्रुवुरञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: tena daiteyanāthena ciraṃ saṃprarthitā satī / taiśca saṃprarthitāstāśca pratiśūśruvurañjasā
verses.translation: They forgot the Vedas and lord Umapati (Siva) too. They forsook Yajnas and other auspicious rites.
verses.wordMeaning: They forgot the Vedas and lord Umapati (Siva) too. They forsook Yajnas and other auspicious rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: They forgot the Vedas and lord Umapati (Siva) too. They forsook Yajnas and other auspicious rites.

verses.sanskrit: यास्त्वलभ्या महायज्ञैरश्वमेधादिकैरपि । ता लब्ध्वा मोहिनीमुख्या निर्वृतिं परमां ययुः
verses.transliteration: yāstvalabhyā mahāyajñairaśvamedhādikairapi / tā labdhvā mohinīmukhyā nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: When the Daityas were thus deluded, O Brahmana, the Devas including Vasava, became liberated from torment. They derived great pleasure.
verses.wordMeaning: When the Daityas were thus deluded, O Brahmana, the Devas including Vasava, became liberated from torment. They derived great pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Daityas were thus deluded, O Brahmana, the Devas including Vasava, became liberated from torment. They derived great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: विसस्मरुस्तदा वेदांस्तथा देवमुमापतिम् । विजहुस्ते तथा यज्ञक्रियाश्चान्याः शुभावहाः
verses.transliteration: visasmarustadā vedāṃstathā devamumāpatim / vijahuste tathā yajñakriyāścānyāḥ śubhāvahāḥ
verses.translation: Once, sage Narada came there and saw Devendra seated in his throne and surrounded by all Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: Once, sage Narada came there and saw Devendra seated in his throne and surrounded by all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, sage Narada came there and saw Devendra seated in his throne and surrounded by all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अवमानहतश्चासीत्तेषामपि पुरोहितः । मुहूर्त्तमिव तेषां तु ययावब्दायुतं तदा
verses.transliteration: avamānahataścāsītteṣāmapi purohitaḥ / muhūrttamiva teṣāṃ tu yayāvabdāyutaṃ tadā
verses.translation: After bowing down to that noble sage shining brillliantly like fire, the lord of Devas stood up in reverence with palms joined together and spoke these words:
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to that noble sage shining brillliantly like fire, the lord of Devas stood up in reverence with palms joined together and spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to that noble sage shining brillliantly like fire, the lord of Devas stood up in reverence with palms joined together and spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: मोहितेष्वथ दैत्येषु सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः । विमुक्तोपद्रवा ब्रह्मन्नामोदं परमं ययुः
verses.transliteration: mohiteṣvatha daityeṣu sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ / vimuktopadravā brahmannāmodaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: ' O holy lord, conversant with all sacred rites, the most excellent one among, those.who know the Para and Apara (the greatest thing and the lesser ones), you visit only such places as you wish to bless.
verses.wordMeaning: ' O holy lord, conversant with all sacred rites, the most excellent one among, those.who know the Para and Apara (the greatest thing and the lesser ones), you visit only such places as you wish to bless.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' O holy lord, conversant with all sacred rites, the most excellent one among, those.who know the Para and Apara (the greatest thing and the lesser ones), you visit only such places as you wish to bless.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिदथ देवेन्द्रं वीक्ष्य सिंहासने स्थितम् । सर्वदेवैः परिवृतं नारदो मुनिराययौ
verses.transliteration: kadācidatha devendraṃ vīkṣya siṃhāsane sthitam / sarvadevaiḥ parivṛtaṃ nārado munirāyayau
verses.translation: Bhanda the leader of the Daityas has become
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda the leader of the Daityas has become
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda the leader of the Daityas has become

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य मुनिशार्दूलं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् । कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा देवेशो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: praṇamya muniśārdūlaṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā deveśo vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: Without propitiating goddess Para sakti, 0 Vasava, it is impossible to achieve it by means of other types of austerities even in hundreds of crores ofKalpas.
verses.wordMeaning: Without propitiating goddess Para sakti, 0 Vasava, it is impossible to achieve it by means of other types of austerities even in hundreds of crores ofKalpas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without propitiating goddess Para sakti, 0 Vasava, it is impossible to achieve it by means of other types of austerities even in hundreds of crores ofKalpas.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ परापरविदां वर । तत्रैव गमनं ते स्याद्यं धन्यं कर्तुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: bhagavansarvadharmajña parāparavidāṃ vara / tatraiva gamanaṃ te syādyaṃ dhanyaṃ kartumicchasi
verses.translation: Prior to the rise of the enemy, O ignorant one, propitiate the Deity. On being propitiated the goddess will bring about your welfare."
verses.wordMeaning: Prior to the rise of the enemy, O ignorant one, propitiate the Deity. On being propitiated the goddess will bring about your welfare."
verses.commentary: Sense: Prior to the rise of the enemy, O ignorant one, propitiate the Deity. On being propitiated the goddess will bring about your welfare."

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यच्छोभनाकारं तवागमनकारणम् । त्वद्वाक्यामृतमाकर्ण्य श्रवणानन्दनिर्भरम् । अशेषदुःखान्युत्तीर्य कृतार्थः स्यां मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyacchobhanākāraṃ tavāgamanakāraṇam / tvadvākyāmṛtamākarṇya śravaṇānandanirbharam / aśeṣaduḥkhānyuttīrya kṛtārthaḥ syāṃ munīśvara
verses.translation: On being urged and enlightened thus by him, Sakra, the lord of the groups of Devas, duly honoured the sage.
verses.wordMeaning: On being urged and enlightened thus by him, Sakra, the lord of the groups of Devas, duly honoured the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being urged and enlightened thus by him, Sakra, the lord of the groups of Devas, duly honoured the sage.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच अथ संमोहितो भण्डो दैत्येन्द्रो विष्णुमायया । तया विमुक्तो लोकांस्त्रीन्दहेताग्निरिवापरः
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca atha saṃmohito bhaṇḍo daityendro viṣṇumāyayā / tayā vimukto lokāṃstrīndahetāgnirivāparaḥ
verses.translation: Along with all the gods, he performed the great worship of Parasakti on the bank of Bhaglrathl that was brilliant with flowers in everyone of the seasons. Even since then, that place bestowing all sorts of accomplishments came to be known by the name Indraprastha. 1
verses.wordMeaning: Along with all the gods, he performed the great worship of Parasakti on the bank of Bhaglrathl that was brilliant with flowers in everyone of the seasons. Even since then, that place bestowing all sorts of accomplishments came to be known by the name Indraprastha. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with all the gods, he performed the great worship of Parasakti on the bank of Bhaglrathl that was brilliant with flowers in everyone of the seasons. Even since then, that place bestowing all sorts of accomplishments came to be known by the name Indraprastha. 1

verses.sanskrit: अधिकस्तव तेजोभिरस्त्रैर्मायाबलेन च । तस्य तेजो ऽपहारस्तु कर्तव्यो ऽतिबलस्य तु
verses.transliteration: adhikastava tejobhirastrairmāyābalena ca / tasya tejo 'pahārastu kartavyo 'tibalasya tu
verses.translation: On seeing the Asuras deluded, the highly intelli- gent priest, the son of Bhrgu. approached Bhandasura and spoke thus.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Asuras deluded, the highly intelli- gent priest, the son of Bhrgu. approached Bhandasura and spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Asuras deluded, the highly intelli- gent priest, the son of Bhrgu. approached Bhandasura and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: विनाराधनतो देव्याः पराशक्तेस्तु वासव । अशक्यो ऽन्येन तपसा कल्पकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: vinārādhanato devyāḥ parāśaktestu vāsava / aśakyo 'nyena tapasā kalpakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: "It is relying on you alone, O leading king, that the excellent Danavas always sport and roam about as they please in three worlds without any fear.
verses.wordMeaning: "It is relying on you alone, O leading king, that the excellent Danavas always sport and roam about as they please in three worlds without any fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is relying on you alone, O leading king, that the excellent Danavas always sport and roam about as they please in three worlds without any fear.

verses.sanskrit: पुरैवोदयतः शत्रोराराधयत बालिशाः । आराधिता भगवती सा वः श्रेयो विधास्यति
verses.transliteration: puraivodayataḥ śatrorārādhayata bāliśāḥ / ārādhitā bhagavatī sā vaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati
verses.translation: On being told thus by his preceptor, the demon Bhanda left his excellent couch. Inviting the elderly ministers, he told them everything as it had happened.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by his preceptor, the demon Bhanda left his excellent couch. Inviting the elderly ministers, he told them everything as it had happened.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by his preceptor, the demon Bhanda left his excellent couch. Inviting the elderly ministers, he told them everything as it had happened.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संबोधितस्तेन शक्रो देवगणेश्वरः । तं मुनिं पूजयामास सर्वदेवैः समन्वितः । तपसे कृतसन्नाहो ययौ हैमवतं तटम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃbodhitastena śakro devagaṇeśvaraḥ / taṃ muniṃ pūjayāmāsa sarvadevaiḥ samanvitaḥ / tapase kṛtasannāho yayau haimavataṃ taṭam
verses.translation: Bhanda the leader of the Danavas agreed to his suggestion. Starting along with the armies he w'ent to the vaHey of the Himavan.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda the leader of the Danavas agreed to his suggestion. Starting along with the armies he w'ent to the vaHey of the Himavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda the leader of the Danavas agreed to his suggestion. Starting along with the armies he w'ent to the vaHey of the Himavan.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भागीरथीतीरे सर्वर्तुकुसुमोज्ज्वले । पराशक्तेर्महापूजां चक्रे ऽखिलसुरैः समम् । इन्द्रप्रस्थमभून्नाम्रा तदाद्यखिलसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: tatra bhāgīrathītīre sarvartukusumojjvale / parāśaktermahāpūjāṃ cakre 'khilasuraiḥ samam / indraprasthamabhūnnāmrā tadādyakhilasiddhidam
verses.translation: On seeing Danavas eager to create obstacles in the penance of god, the mother of the universe made a huge lustrous rampart wall in front of them that could not be crossed.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Danavas eager to create obstacles in the penance of god, the mother of the universe made a huge lustrous rampart wall in front of them that could not be crossed.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Danavas eager to create obstacles in the penance of god, the mother of the universe made a huge lustrous rampart wall in front of them that could not be crossed.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मात्मजोपदिष्टेन कुर्वतां विधिना पराम् । देव्यास्तु महतीं पूजां जपध्यानरतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: brahmātmajopadiṣṭena kurvatāṃ vidhinā parām / devyāstu mahatīṃ pūjāṃ japadhyānaratātmanām
verses.translation: On seeing the Mother ofthe Universe and noticing the lustrous rampart, the Devas trembled with fear abandon- ing all their holy rites.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Mother ofthe Universe and noticing the lustrous rampart, the Devas trembled with fear abandon- ing all their holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Mother ofthe Universe and noticing the lustrous rampart, the Devas trembled with fear abandon- ing all their holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रे तपसि संस्थानामनन्या र्पितचेतसाम् । दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशाहानि च संययुः
verses.transliteration: ugre tapasi saṃsthānāmananyā rpitacetasām / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśāhāni ca saṃyayuḥ
verses.translation: We shall become Brahman or we will be able to enjoy heaven." On being told thus, the Devas with Indra as their leader duly performed Homa by chopping off the flesh to the chanting of Mantras.
verses.wordMeaning: We shall become Brahman or we will be able to enjoy heaven." On being told thus, the Devas with Indra as their leader duly performed Homa by chopping off the flesh to the chanting of Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: We shall become Brahman or we will be able to enjoy heaven." On being told thus, the Devas with Indra as their leader duly performed Homa by chopping off the flesh to the chanting of Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: मोहितानथ तान्दृष्ट्वा भृगुपुत्रो महामतिः । भण्डासुरं समभ्येत्य निजगाद पुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: mohitānatha tāndṛṣṭvā bhṛguputro mahāmatiḥ / bhaṇḍāsuraṃ samabhyetya nijagāda purohitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the great goddess all Devas, including Vasava (Indra) became delighted in their minds and they
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the great goddess all Devas, including Vasava (Indra) became delighted in their minds and they
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the great goddess all Devas, including Vasava (Indra) became delighted in their minds and they

verses.sanskrit: त्वामेवाश्रित्य राचैन्द्र सदा दानवसत्तमाः । निर्भयास्त्रिषु लोकेषु चरन्तीच्छविहारिणः
verses.transliteration: tvāmevāśritya rācaindra sadā dānavasattamāḥ / nirbhayāstriṣu lokeṣu carantīcchavihāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: जातिमात्रं हि भवतो हन्ति सर्वान्सदा हरिः । तेनैव निर्मिता माया यया संमोहितो भवान्
verses.transliteration: jātimātraṃ hi bhavato hanti sarvānsadā hariḥ / tenaiva nirmitā māyā yayā saṃmohito bhavān
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तं मोहितं दृष्ट्वा रन्ध्रान्वेषण तत्परः । भवतां विजयार्थाय करोतीन्द्रो महत्तपः
verses.transliteration: bhavantaṃ mohitaṃ dṛṣṭvā randhrānveṣaṇa tatparaḥ / bhavatāṃ vijayārthāya karotīndro mahattapaḥ
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: यदि तुष्टा जगद्धात्री तस्यैव विजयो भवेत् । इमां मायामयीं त्यक्त्वा मन्त्रिभिः सहितो भवान् । गत्वा हैमवतं शैलं परेषां विघ्नमाचर
verses.transliteration: yadi tuṣṭā jagaddhātrī tasyaiva vijayo bhavet / imāṃ māyāmayīṃ tyaktvā mantribhiḥ sahito bhavān / gatvā haimavataṃ śailaṃ pareṣāṃ vighnamācara
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु गुरुणा हित्वा पर्यङ्कमुत्तमम् । मन्त्रिवृद्धानु पाहूय यथावृत्तान्तमाह सः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu guruṇā hitvā paryaṅkamuttamam / mantrivṛddhānu pāhūya yathāvṛttāntamāha saḥ
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा नृपतिं प्राह श्रुतवर्मा विमृश्य च । षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणां राज्यं तव शिवार्पितम्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā nṛpatiṃ prāha śrutavarmā vimṛśya ca / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ rājyaṃ tava śivārpitam
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादप्यधिकं वीर गतमासीदनेकशः । अशक्यप्रतिकार्यो ऽयं यः कालशिवचोदितः
verses.transliteration: tasmādapyadhikaṃ vīra gatamāsīdanekaśaḥ / aśakyapratikāryo 'yaṃ yaḥ kālaśivacoditaḥ
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: अशक्यप्रतिकार्यो ऽयं तदभ्यर्चनतो विना । काले तु भोगः कर्त्तव्यो दुःखस्य च सुखस्य वा
verses.transliteration: aśakyapratikāryo 'yaṃ tadabhyarcanato vinā / kāle tu bhogaḥ karttavyo duḥkhasya ca sukhasya vā
