verses.transliteration: jayakāri ca vāmākṣi jaya kāmākṣi sundari / jayākhilasurārādhye jaya kāmeśi mānade
verses.translation: O Kali ofbeautiful eyes; be victorious. O KamaksT (one oflovely and loveable eyes), O beautiful one, be victorious. Be victorious, O goddess worthy of being propitiated by all the Suras. O KameST, goddess of love, bestower of honour, be victorious.
verses.wordMeaning: O Kali ofbeautiful eyes; be victorious. O KamaksT (one oflovely and loveable eyes), O beautiful one, be victorious. Be victorious, O goddess worthy of being propitiated by all the Suras. O KameST, goddess of love, bestower of honour, be victorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kali ofbeautiful eyes; be victorious. O KamaksT (one oflovely and loveable eyes), O beautiful one, be victorious. Be victorious, O goddess worthy of being propitiated by all the Suras. O KameST, goddess of love, bestower of honour, be victorious.

verses.sanskrit: जय ब्रह्ममये देवि ब्रह्मात्मकरसात्मिके । जय नारायणि परे नन्दिताशेषविष्टपे
verses.transliteration: jaya brahmamaye devi brahmātmakarasātmike / jaya nārāyaṇi pare nanditāśeṣaviṣṭape
verses.translation: Be victorious, Q goddess, the embodiment of Brahman, the soul of elegance and beauty of Brahman. O NarayanI, O Supreme one, be victorious, O goddess, the bestower of delight on all the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, Q goddess, the embodiment of Brahman, the soul of elegance and beauty of Brahman. O NarayanI, O Supreme one, be victorious, O goddess, the bestower of delight on all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, Q goddess, the embodiment of Brahman, the soul of elegance and beauty of Brahman. O NarayanI, O Supreme one, be victorious, O goddess, the bestower of delight on all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: जय श्रीकण्ठदयिते जय श्रीललितेंबिके । जय श्रीविजये देवि विजय श्रीसमृद्धिदे
verses.transliteration: jaya śrīkaṇṭhadayite jaya śrīlaliteṃbike / jaya śrīvijaye devi vijaya śrīsamṛddhide
verses.translation: The use of a string or series of epithets as a prayer of a deity is as old as the Yajurveda in the 'Black' portion of which we have Rudrddhyaya (Tai. Sara. IV. 5.) and in the 'White' portion the Sata-rudriya (Vaj. Sara. Ch. 18). The tradition was continued in Puranas and we have'a thousand epithets ofVisnu' in the Mbh. Anu. ch. 149. Here though not a thousand names, we have a series of epithets glorifying Lalita and hailing her victory and equating her with the Almighty or Parahrahman (VV 1-29).
verses.wordMeaning: The use of a string or series of epithets as a prayer of a deity is as old as the Yajurveda in the 'Black' portion of which we have Rudrddhyaya (Tai. Sara. IV. 5.) and in the 'White' portion the Sata-rudriya (Vaj. Sara. Ch. 18).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The use of a string or series of epithets as a prayer of a deity is as old as the Yajurveda in the 'Black' portion of which we have Rudrddhyaya (Tai. Sara. IV. 5.) and in the 'White' portion the Sata-rudriya (Vaj. Sara. Ch. 18).…

verses.sanskrit: जातस्य जायमानस्य इष्टापूर्तस्य हेतवे । नमस्तस्यै त्रिजगतां पालयित्र्यै परात्परे
verses.transliteration: jātasya jāyamānasya iṣṭāpūrtasya hetave / namastasyai trijagatāṃ pālayitryai parātpare
verses.translation: Be victorious, O beloved of Srlkantha (Siva). Be victorious, O Mother Srllalita. Be victorious, O goddess, the conqueror of glory, O bestower of abundant riches and prosperity of victory.
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, O beloved of Srlkantha (Siva). Be victorious, O Mother Srllalita. Be victorious, O goddess, the conqueror of glory, O bestower of abundant riches and prosperity of victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O beloved of Srlkantha (Siva). Be victorious, O Mother Srllalita. Be victorious, O goddess, the conqueror of glory, O bestower of abundant riches and prosperity of victory.

verses.sanskrit: कलामुहूर्तकाष्ठाहर् मासर्तुशरदात्मने । नमः सहस्रशीर्षायै सहस्रमुखलोचने
verses.transliteration: kalāmuhūrtakāṣṭhāhar māsartuśaradātmane / namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāyai sahasramukhalocane
verses.translation: Hail to the goddess identical with (all units of time such as) Kalamuhurta, Kastha, days, months, seasons and' years. Obeisance to the goddess with thousand heads; 1 2 O goddess with thousand eyes and faces.
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the goddess identical with (all units of time such as) Kalamuhurta, Kastha, days, months, seasons and' years. Obeisance to the goddess with thousand heads; 1 2 O goddess with thousand eyes and faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the goddess identical with (all units of time such as) Kalamuhurta, Kastha, days, months, seasons and' years. Obeisance to the goddess with thousand heads; 1 2 O goddess with thousand eyes and faces.

verses.sanskrit: नमः सहस्रहस्ताब्जपादपङ्कजशोभिते । अणोरणुतरे देवि महतो ऽपि महीयसि
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sahasrahastābjapādapaṅkajaśobhite / aṇoraṇutare devi mahato 'pi mahīyasi
verses.translation: Bow to you appearing splendid with a thousand lotus-like hands and feet, Ogoddess, minuter than Atom, greater than the greatest.
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to you appearing splendid with a thousand lotus-like hands and feet, Ogoddess, minuter than Atom, greater than the greatest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to you appearing splendid with a thousand lotus-like hands and feet, Ogoddess, minuter than Atom, greater than the greatest.

verses.sanskrit: परात्परतरे मातस्तेजस्तेजीयसामपि । अतलं तु भवेत्पादौ वितलं जानुनी तव
verses.transliteration: parātparatare mātastejastejīyasāmapi / atalaṃ tu bhavetpādau vitalaṃ jānunī tava
verses.translation: O mother who art greater than the greatest, more brilliant than the most brilliant, the (nether-world) Atala' constitutes your feet andVitala, your knees.
verses.wordMeaning: O mother who art greater than the greatest, more brilliant than the most brilliant, the (nether-world) Atala' constitutes your feet andVitala, your knees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother who art greater than the greatest, more brilliant than the most brilliant, the (nether-world) Atala' constitutes your feet andVitala, your knees.

verses.sanskrit: रसातलं कटीदेशः कुक्षिस्ते धरणी भवेत् । हृदयं तु भुवर्लोकः स्वस्ते मुखमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: rasātalaṃ kaṭīdeśaḥ kukṣiste dharaṇī bhavet / hṛdayaṃ tu bhuvarlokaḥ svaste mukhamudāhṛtam
verses.translation: The Moon, Sun and Fire are your eyes, O Ambika and the quarters (cardinal points) are your arms. The winds are your breaths and the Vedas your, words.
verses.wordMeaning: The Moon, Sun and Fire are your eyes, O Ambika and the quarters (cardinal points) are your arms. The winds are your breaths and the Vedas your, words.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Moon, Sun and Fire are your eyes, O Ambika and the quarters (cardinal points) are your arms. The winds are your breaths and the Vedas your, words.

verses.sanskrit: दृशश्चन्द्रार्कदहना दिशस्ते बाहव्ॐबिके । मरुतस्तु तवोच्छ्वासा वाचस्ते श्रुतयो ऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: dṛśaścandrārkadahanā diśaste bāhavoṃbike / marutastu tavocchvāsā vācaste śrutayo 'khilāḥ
verses.translation: The Bhuvanas (Worlds) constitute your forms visible as well as invisible. The clouds are your tresses and the stars you r flowers.
verses.wordMeaning: The Bhuvanas (Worlds) constitute your forms visible as well as invisible. The clouds are your tresses and the stars you r flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Bhuvanas (Worlds) constitute your forms visible as well as invisible. The clouds are your tresses and the stars you r flowers.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडा ते लोकरचना सखा ते चिन्मयः शिवः । आहारस्ते सदानन्दो वासस्ते हृदये सताम्
verses.transliteration: krīḍā te lokaracanā sakhā te cinmayaḥ śivaḥ / āhāraste sadānando vāsaste hṛdaye satām
verses.translation: Dharma etc. are your arms. Adharma etc. constitute your weapons. Tarnas and Niyamas constitute the nails of your hands and feet.
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma etc. are your arms. Adharma etc. constitute your weapons. Tarnas and Niyamas constitute the nails of your hands and feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma etc. are your arms. Adharma etc. constitute your weapons. Tarnas and Niyamas constitute the nails of your hands and feet.

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यादृश्य स्वरूपाणि रूपाणि भुवनानि ते । शिरोरुहा घनास्ते तु तारकाः कुसुमानि ते
verses.transliteration: dṛśyādṛśya svarūpāṇi rūpāṇi bhuvanāni te / śiroruhā ghanāste tu tārakāḥ kusumāni te
verses.translation: VV. 8-10 describe how the different worlds— the nether-worlds and the higher worlds constitute the body of Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 8-10 describe how the different worlds— the nether-worlds and the higher worlds constitute the body of Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 8-10 describe how the different worlds— the nether-worlds and the higher worlds constitute the body of Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माद्या बाहवस्ते स्युरधर्माद्यायुधानि ते । यमाश्च नियमाश्चैव करपादरुहास्तथा
verses.transliteration: dharmādyā bāhavaste syuradharmādyāyudhāni te / yamāśca niyamāścaiva karapādaruhāstathā
verses.translation: The utterances of Svaha and Svadhd that enliven the worlds constitute your breasts. The PrSndyama (Breath-control) is your nose and Sarasvati (the goddess ofspeech) your tongue.
verses.wordMeaning: The utterances of Svaha and Svadhd that enliven the worlds constitute your breasts. The PrSndyama (Breath-control) is your nose and Sarasvati (the goddess ofspeech) your tongue.
verses.commentary: Sense: The utterances of Svaha and Svadhd that enliven the worlds constitute your breasts. The PrSndyama (Breath-control) is your nose and Sarasvati (the goddess ofspeech) your tongue.

verses.sanskrit: स्तनौ स्वाहास्वधाकरौ लोकोज्जीवनकारकौ । प्राणायामस्तु ते नासा रसना ते सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: stanau svāhāsvadhākarau lokojjīvanakārakau / prāṇāyāmastu te nāsā rasanā te sarasvatī
verses.translation: The trees are the hair on your body. The dawn is your robe. The past, present and future constitute your physical form.
verses.wordMeaning: The trees are the hair on your body. The dawn is your robe. The past, present and future constitute your physical form.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees are the hair on your body. The dawn is your robe. The past, present and future constitute your physical form.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्याहारस्त्विद्रिंयाणि ध्यानं ते धीस्तु सत्तमा । मनस्ते धारणाशक्तिर्हृदयं ते समाधिकः
verses.transliteration: pratyāhārastvidriṃyāṇi dhyānaṃ te dhīstu sattamā / manaste dhāraṇāśaktirhṛdayaṃ te samādhikaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to that great goddess at whose behest fire, sun, moon and winds function and so do also the elements beginning with the earth.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to that great goddess at whose behest fire, sun, moon and winds function and so do also the elements beginning with the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to that great goddess at whose behest fire, sun, moon and winds function and so do also the elements beginning with the earth.

verses.sanskrit: महीरुहास्तेङ्गरुहाः प्रभातं वसनं तव । भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च नित्यं च तव विग्रहः
verses.transliteration: mahīruhāsteṅgaruhāḥ prabhātaṃ vasanaṃ tava / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca nityaṃ ca tava vigrahaḥ
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to that goddess who, at the beginning of the (period of) creation, created Brahma, the primordial creator, the first bestower of plenty and who sustained him herself single-handed.
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to that goddess who, at the beginning of the (period of) creation, created Brahma, the primordial creator, the first bestower of plenty and who sustained him herself single-handed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to that goddess who, at the beginning of the (period of) creation, created Brahma, the primordial creator, the first bestower of plenty and who sustained him herself single-handed.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञरूपा जगद्धात्री विश्वरूपा च पावनी । आदौ या तु दयाभूता ससर्ज निखिलाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: yajñarūpā jagaddhātrī viśvarūpā ca pāvanī / ādau yā tu dayābhūtā sasarja nikhilāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess by whom the earth is held up, who is incomprehensible and immeasurable too, by whom the Ether is supported and in whom the sun rises.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess by whom the earth is held up, who is incomprehensible and immeasurable too, by whom the Ether is supported and in whom the sun rises.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess by whom the earth is held up, who is incomprehensible and immeasurable too, by whom the Ether is supported and in whom the sun rises.

verses.sanskrit: हृदयस्थापि लोकानामदृश्या मोहनात्मिका
verses.transliteration: hṛdayasthāpi lokānāmadṛśyā mohanātmikā
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess where the entire universe takes its origin, where it rests soundly and wherein at the proper time it gets merged.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess where the entire universe takes its origin, where it rests soundly and wherein at the proper time it gets merged.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess where the entire universe takes its origin, where it rests soundly and wherein at the proper time it gets merged.

verses.sanskrit: नामरूपविभागं च या करोति स्वलीलया । तान्यधिष्ठाय तिष्ठन्ती तेष्वसक्तार्थकामदा । नमस्तस्यै महादेव्यै सर्वशक्त्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: nāmarūpavibhāgaṃ ca yā karoti svalīlayā / tānyadhiṣṭhāya tiṣṭhantī teṣvasaktārthakāmadā / namastasyai mahādevyai sarvaśaktyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance. Obeisance to you of the Rajas, nature as the origin. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the Sattva nature for the sustenance. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the Tanias nature as the destroyer. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the nature of Siva when devoid of Gunas.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance. Obeisance to you of the Rajas, nature as the origin. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the Sattva nature for the sustenance. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the Tanias nature as the destroyer. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the nature of Siva when devoid of Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance. Obeisance to you of the Rajas, nature as the origin. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the Sattva nature for the sustenance. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the Tanias nature as the destroyer. Obeisance, obeisance to you of the nature of Siva when devoid of Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: यदाज्ञया प्रवर्तन्ते वह्निसूर्यैदुमारुताः । पृथिव्यादीनि भूतानि तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: yadājñayā pravartante vahnisūryaidumārutāḥ / pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tasyai devyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to" you, who are the sole mother of the universe. Obeisance, obeisance to you the sole father ofthe universe. Obeisance, obeisance to you, identical with all forms and Tantras (Rituals and rites). Obeisance, obeisance to you, O goddess in the form of all Tantras ( Talismans and mystical diagrams.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to" you, who are the sole mother of the universe. Obeisance, obeisance to you the sole father ofthe universe. Obeisance, obeisance to you, identical with all forms and Tantras (Rituals and rites). Obeisance, obeisance to you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to" you, who are the sole mother of the universe. Obeisance, obeisance to you the sole father ofthe universe. Obeisance, obeisance to you, identical with all forms and Tantras (Rituals and rites). Obeisance, obeisance to you,…

verses.sanskrit: या ससर्जादिधातारं सर्गादावादिभूरिदम् । दधार स्वयमेवैका तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: yā sasarjādidhātāraṃ sargādāvādibhūridam / dadhāra svayamevaikā tasyai devyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to you, O chief preceptor unto the worlds. Repeated obeisance to you, to the magni- ficence of all types of utterances. Obeisance to LaksmT, the sole goddess ofpleasure. Obeisance, obeisance to the omnipotent one, O consort of god Sambhu.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to you, O chief preceptor unto the worlds. Repeated obeisance to you, to the magni- ficence of all types of utterances. Obeisance to LaksmT, the sole goddess ofpleasure. Obeisance, obeisance to the omnipotent one, O consort of god Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to you, O chief preceptor unto the worlds. Repeated obeisance to you, to the magni- ficence of all types of utterances. Obeisance to LaksmT, the sole goddess ofpleasure. Obeisance, obeisance to the omnipotent one, O consort of god Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: यथा धृता तु धरिणी ययाकाशममेयया । यस्यामुदेति सविता तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: yathā dhṛtā tu dhariṇī yayākāśamameyayā / yasyāmudeti savitā tasyai devyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O mother, how can I describe your excellent prowess and influence. It is without beginning, middle or end. It is not constituted of five elements. It cannot be expressed by words or comprehended by mind. Its magnificence and power cannot be inferred. It is formless. It is without Dvandvas (mutually opposed pairs). It cannot be perceived by the eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: O mother, how can I describe your excellent prowess and influence. It is without beginning, middle or end. It is not constituted of five elements. It cannot be expressed by words or comprehended by mind. Its magnificence and power cannot be inferred. It is formless.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, how can I describe your excellent prowess and influence. It is without beginning, middle or end. It is not constituted of five elements. It cannot be expressed by words or comprehended by mind. Its magnificence and power cannot be inferred. It is formless.…

verses.sanskrit: यत्रोदेति जगत्कृत्स्नं यत्र तिष्ठति निर्भरम् । यत्रान्तमेति काले तु तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: yatrodeti jagatkṛtsnaṃ yatra tiṣṭhati nirbharam / yatrāntameti kāle tu tasyai devyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Be gracious unto us, O goddess ofthe universe. Be pleased, O goddess saluted by the universe. Be pleased, O goddess of learning, of the form of the Vedas. Be pleased, O Mayamayl (one equipped with the magical pow'er of delusion), O Mantravigrahd (who are the embodiment of Mantras). Be pleased, O goddess of everything, OOmniformed one."
verses.wordMeaning: Be gracious unto us, O goddess ofthe universe. Be pleased, O goddess saluted by the universe. Be pleased, O goddess of learning, of the form of the Vedas. Be pleased, O Mayamayl (one equipped with the magical pow'er of delusion),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Be gracious unto us, O goddess ofthe universe. Be pleased, O goddess saluted by the universe. Be pleased, O goddess of learning, of the form of the Vedas. Be pleased, O Mayamayl (one equipped with the magical pow'er of delusion),…

verses.sanskrit: नमोनमस्ते रजसे भवायै नमोनमः सात्त्विकसंस्थितायै । नमोनमस्ते तमसे हरायै नमोनमो निर्गुणतः शिवायै
verses.transliteration: namonamaste rajase bhavāyai namonamaḥ sāttvikasaṃsthitāyai / namonamaste tamase harāyai namonamo nirguṇataḥ śivāyai
verses.translation: After eulogising the great goddess thus, all Devas including Vasava (Indra) bowed down to her again and again and hurriedly sought refuge in her.
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising the great goddess thus, all Devas including Vasava (Indra) bowed down to her again and again and hurriedly sought refuge in her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising the great goddess thus, all Devas including Vasava (Indra) bowed down to her again and again and hurriedly sought refuge in her.

verses.sanskrit: नमोनमस्ते जगदेकमात्रे नमोनमस्ते जगदेकपित्रे । नमोनमस्ते ऽखिलरूपतन्त्रे नमोनमस्ते ऽखिलयन्त्ररूपे
verses.transliteration: namonamaste jagadekamātre namonamaste jagadekapitre / namonamaste 'khilarūpatantre namonamaste 'khilayantrarūpe
verses.translation: On seeing Vasava bowing down, that goddess became delighted. The bestower of boons on all embodied souls she asked him to request for any boon he liked.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Vasava bowing down, that goddess became delighted. The bestower of boons on all embodied souls she asked him to request for any boon he liked.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Vasava bowing down, that goddess became delighted. The bestower of boons on all embodied souls she asked him to request for any boon he liked.

verses.sanskrit: नमोनमो लोकगुरुप्रधाने नमोनमस्ते ऽखिलवाग्विभूत्यै । नमो ऽस्तु लक्ष्म्यै जगदेकतुष्ट्यै नमोनमः शांभवि सर्वशक्त्यै
verses.transliteration: namonamo lokagurupradhāne namonamaste 'khilavāgvibhūtyai / namo 'stu lakṣmyai jagadekatuṣṭyai namonamaḥ śāṃbhavi sarvaśaktyai
verses.translation: "(Defective Text) O goddess of welfare, if you are pleased, save our lives. We have approached you seeking refuge. Due to the harassment of Daitya king, our life has become unbearable. "
verses.wordMeaning: "(Defective Text) O goddess of welfare, if you are pleased, save our lives. We have approached you seeking refuge. Due to the harassment of Daitya king, our life has become unbearable. "
verses.commentary: Sense: "(Defective Text) O goddess of welfare, if you are pleased, save our lives. We have approached you seeking refuge. Due to the harassment of Daitya king, our life has become unbearable. "

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमध्यान्तमपाञ्चभौतिकं ह्यवाङ्मनोगम्यमतर्क्यवैभवम् । अरूपमद्वन्द्वमदृष्टगोचरं प्रभावमग्र्यं कथमंब वर्णये
verses.transliteration: anādimadhyāntamapāñcabhautikaṃ hyavāṅmanogamyamatarkyavaibhavam / arūpamadvandvamadṛṣṭagocaraṃ prabhāvamagryaṃ kathamaṃba varṇaye
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद विश्वेश्वरि विश्ववन्दिते प्रसीद विद्येश्वरि वेदरूपिणि । प्रसीद मायामयि मन्त्राविग्रहे प्रसीद सर्वेश्वरि सर्वरूपिणि
verses.transliteration: prasīda viśveśvari viśvavandite prasīda vidyeśvari vedarūpiṇi / prasīda māyāmayi mantrāvigrahe prasīda sarveśvari sarvarūpiṇi
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तत्वा महादेवीं देवाः सर्वे सवासवाः । भूयोभूयो नमस्कृत्य शरणं जगमुरञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: iti statvā mahādevīṃ devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ / bhūyobhūyo namaskṛtya śaraṇaṃ jagamurañjasā
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्ना सा देवी प्रणतं वीक्ष्य वासवम् । वरेण च्छन्दयामास वरदाखिलदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasannā sā devī praṇataṃ vīkṣya vāsavam / vareṇa cchandayāmāsa varadākhiladehinām
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच यदि तुष्टासि कर्याणि वरं दैत्येन्द्र पीडितः । दुर्धरं जीवितं देहि त्वां गताः शरणार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca yadi tuṣṭāsi karyāṇi varaṃ daityendra pīḍitaḥ / durdharaṃ jīvitaṃ dehi tvāṃ gatāḥ śaraṇārthinaḥ
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेव्युवाच अहमेव विनिर्जित्य भण्डं दैत्यकुलोद्भवम् । अचिरात्तव दास्यामि त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: śrīdevyuvāca ahameva vinirjitya bhaṇḍaṃ daityakulodbhavam / acirāttava dāsyāmi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: निर्भया मुदिताः सन्तु सर्वे देवगणास्तथा । ये स्तोष्यन्ति च मां भक्त्या स्तवेनानेन मानवाः
verses.transliteration: nirbhayā muditāḥ santu sarve devagaṇāstathā / ye stoṣyanti ca māṃ bhaktyā stavenānena mānavāḥ
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: भाजनं ते भविष्यन्ति धर्मश्रीयशसां सदा । विद्याविनयसंपन्ना नीरोगा दीर्घजीविनः
verses.transliteration: bhājanaṃ te bhaviṣyanti dharmaśrīyaśasāṃ sadā / vidyāvinayasaṃpannā nīrogā dīrghajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रमित्रकल त्राढ्या भवन्तु मदनुग्रहात् । इति लब्धवरा देवा देवेन्द्रो ऽपि महाबलः
verses.transliteration: putramitrakala trāḍhyā bhavantu madanugrahāt / iti labdhavarā devā devendro 'pi mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: आमोदं परमं जग्मुस्तां विलोक्य मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: āmodaṃ paramaṃ jagmustāṃ vilokya muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.wordMeaning: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya
verses.commentary: Sense: "I shall myself defeat Bhanda, bora of Daitya

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने ललितास्तवराजो नाम त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः हयग्रीव उवाच एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । आजगामाथ देवेशीं द्रष्टुकामो महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne lalitāstavarājo nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ hayagrīva uvāca etasminneva kāle tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / ājagāmātha deveśīṃ draṣṭukāmo maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: At the same time, Brahma, the grandfather of worlds, desirous of seeing the goddess of Devas, came there along with great sages.*
verses.wordMeaning: At the same time, Brahma, the grandfather of worlds, desirous of seeing the goddess of Devas, came there along with great sages.*
verses.commentary: Sense: At the same time, Brahma, the grandfather of worlds, desirous of seeing the goddess of Devas, came there along with great sages.*

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम ततो विष्णुरारूढो विनतासुतम् । शिवो ऽपि वृषमारूढः समायातो ऽखिलेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: ājagāma tato viṣṇurārūḍho vinatāsutam / śivo 'pi vṛṣamārūḍhaḥ samāyāto 'khileśvarīm
verses.translation: Then there arrived Visnu seated on the son ofVinata (i.e. Garuda). Siva too, seated on his Bull, came there to see the universal goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: Then there arrived Visnu seated on the son ofVinata (i.e. Garuda). Siva too, seated on his Bull, came there to see the universal goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then there arrived Visnu seated on the son ofVinata (i.e. Garuda). Siva too, seated on his Bull, came there to see the universal goddess.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षयो नारदाद्याः समाजग्मुर्महेश्वरीम् । आययुस्तां महादेवीं सर्वे चाप्सरसां गणाः
verses.transliteration: devarṣayo nāradādyāḥ samājagmurmaheśvarīm / āyayustāṃ mahādevīṃ sarve cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Narada and other celestial sages came in a group to the supreme Goddess. Then came the groups of celestial damsels to see that great Deity.
verses.wordMeaning: Narada and other celestial sages came in a group to the supreme Goddess. Then came the groups of celestial damsels to see that great Deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narada and other celestial sages came in a group to the supreme Goddess. Then came the groups of celestial damsels to see that great Deity.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वावसुप्रभृतयो गन्धर्वाश्चैव यक्षकाः । ब्रह्मणाथ समादिष्टो विश्वकर्मा विशांपतिः
verses.transliteration: viśvāvasuprabhṛtayo gandharvāścaiva yakṣakāḥ / brahmaṇātha samādiṣṭo viśvakarmā viśāṃpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Again as regard 'Parama-Siva* and his Sakti (Potency) called Lalita here as superior to the trinity of the lower grade viz. Brahma, Visnu and Siva. From philosophical standpoint there is no difference between Power and Master of the Pow er (Sakti and Saktimdn). When the Supreme Power (Pari Sakti) Lalita is born, her consort (the Saktimdn) Parama Siva must manifest. Here he has done so and is designated as Kamesvara due to his most beautiful form.
verses.wordMeaning: The Again as regard 'Parama-Siva* and his Sakti (Potency) called Lalita here as superior to the trinity of the lower grade viz. Brahma, Visnu and Siva. From philosophical standpoint there is no difference between Power and Master of the Pow er (Sakti and Saktimdn).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Again as regard 'Parama-Siva* and his Sakti (Potency) called Lalita here as superior to the trinity of the lower grade viz. Brahma, Visnu and Siva. From philosophical standpoint there is no difference between Power and Master of the Pow er (Sakti and Saktimdn).…

verses.sanskrit: चकार नगरं दिव्यं यथामरपुरं तथा । ततो भगवती दुर्गा सर्वमन्त्राधिदेवता
verses.transliteration: cakāra nagaraṃ divyaṃ yathāmarapuraṃ tathā / tato bhagavatī durgā sarvamantrādhidevatā
verses.translation: "Even ifhe happens to be ignorant and puerile, the person who presides over this city shall excel the worlds, due to the power and influence of this city.
verses.wordMeaning: "Even ifhe happens to be ignorant and puerile, the person who presides over this city shall excel the worlds, due to the power and influence of this city.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Even ifhe happens to be ignorant and puerile, the person who presides over this city shall excel the worlds, due to the power and influence of this city.

verses.sanskrit: विद्याधिदेवता श्यामा समाजग्मतुरंबिकाम् । ब्राहयाद्या मातरश्चैव स्वस्वभूतगणावृताः
verses.transliteration: vidyādhidevatā śyāmā samājagmaturaṃbikām / brāhayādyā mātaraścaiva svasvabhūtagaṇāvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: A woman alone does not deserve to rule over a kingdom. A man too without a woman (does not so deserve it). The Sruti says that one should crown a man who has the characteristics ofa great person, who has an auspicious precep- tor and who is united in wedlock to a woman who is agree- able and suitable to him.
verses.wordMeaning: A woman alone does not deserve to rule over a kingdom. A man too without a woman (does not so deserve it). The Sruti says that one should crown a man who has the characteristics ofa great person,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A woman alone does not deserve to rule over a kingdom. A man too without a woman (does not so deserve it). The Sruti says that one should crown a man who has the characteristics ofa great person,…

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धयो ह्यणिमाद्याश्च योगिन्यश्चैव कोटिशः । भैरवाः क्षेत्रपालाश्च महाशास्ता गणाग्रणीः
verses.transliteration: siddhayo hyaṇimādyāśca yoginyaścaiva koṭiśaḥ / bhairavāḥ kṣetrapālāśca mahāśāstā gaṇāgraṇīḥ
verses.translation: This lady shines like the embodiment of presiding deity of the sentiment oflove. Excepting Sankara, no one else in the three worlds can be her bridegroom.
verses.wordMeaning: This lady shines like the embodiment of presiding deity of the sentiment oflove. Excepting Sankara, no one else in the three worlds can be her bridegroom.
verses.commentary: Sense: This lady shines like the embodiment of presiding deity of the sentiment oflove. Excepting Sankara, no one else in the three worlds can be her bridegroom.

verses.sanskrit: महागणेश्वरः स्कन्दो बटुको वीरभद्रकः । आगत्य ते महादेवीं तुष्टुवुः प्रणतास्तदा
verses.transliteration: mahāgaṇeśvaraḥ skando baṭuko vīrabhadrakaḥ / āgatya te mahādevīṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāstadā
verses.translation: Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, embraced that youthful hero having a charming body and named him Kamesvara.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, embraced that youthful hero having a charming body and named him Kamesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, embraced that youthful hero having a charming body and named him Kamesvara.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राथ नगरीं रम्यां साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम् । गजाश्वरथशालाढ्यां राजवीथिविराजिताम्
verses.transliteration: tatrātha nagarīṃ ramyāṃ sāṭṭaprākāratoraṇām / gajāśvarathaśālāḍhyāṃ rājavīthivirājitām
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.transliteration: sāmantānāmamātyānāṃ sainikānāṃ dvijanma nām / vetāladāsadāsīnāṃ gṛhāṇi rucirāṇi ca

verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यं राजगृहं दिव्यं द्वारगोपुरभूषितम् । शालाभिर्बहुभिर्युक्तं सभा भिरुषशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: madhyaṃ rājagṛhaṃ divyaṃ dvāragopurabhūṣitam / śālābhirbahubhiryuktaṃ sabhā bhiruṣaśobhitam

verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनसभां चैव नवरत्नमयीं शुभाम् । मध्ये सिंहासनं दिव्यं चिन्तामणिवीनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: siṃhāsanasabhāṃ caiva navaratnamayīṃ śubhām / madhye siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ cintāmaṇivīnirmitam
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं प्रकाशमद्वन्द्वमुदयादित्यसंनिभम् । विलोक्य चिन्तयामास ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ prakāśamadvandvamudayādityasaṃnibham / vilokya cintayāmāsa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वेतत्समधिष्ठाय वर्तते बालिशो ऽपिवा । पुरस्यास्य प्रभावेण सर्वलोकाधिको भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yastvetatsamadhiṣṭhāya vartate bāliśo 'pivā / purasyāsya prabhāveṇa sarvalokādhiko bhavet
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: न केवला स्त्री राज्यार्हा पुरुषो ऽपि तया विना । मङ्गलाचार्यसंयुक्तं महापुरुषलक्षणम् । अनुकूलाङ्गनायुक्तमभिषिञ्चेदिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: na kevalā strī rājyārhā puruṣo 'pi tayā vinā / maṅgalācāryasaṃyuktaṃ mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇam / anukūlāṅganāyuktamabhiṣiñcediti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: विभातीयं वरारोहा भूर्ता शृङ्गारदेवता । वरो ऽस्यास्त्रिषु लोकेषु न चान्यः शङ्करादृते
verses.transliteration: vibhātīyaṃ varārohā bhūrtā śṛṅgāradevatā / varo 'syāstriṣu lokeṣu na cānyaḥ śaṅkarādṛte
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: जडिलो मुण्डधारी च विरूपाक्षः कपालभृत् । कल्माषी भस्मदिग्धाङ्गः श्मशानास्थिविभूषणः
verses.transliteration: jaḍilo muṇḍadhārī ca virūpākṣaḥ kapālabhṛt / kalmāṣī bhasmadigdhāṅgaḥ śmaśānāsthivibhūṣaṇaḥ

verses.transliteration: amaṅgalāspadaṃ cainaṃ varayetsā sumaṅgalā / iti cintayamānasya brahmaṇo 'gre maheśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: कोटिकन्दर्पलावण्ययुक्तो दिव्य शरीरवान् । दिव्यांबरधरः स्रग्वी दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनः
verses.transliteration: koṭikandarpalāvaṇyayukto divya śarīravān / divyāṃbaradharaḥ sragvī divyagandhānulepanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: किरीटहारकेयूरकुण्डलाद्यैरलङ्कृतः । प्रादुर्बभूव पुरतो जगन्मोहन रुपधृक्
verses.transliteration: kirīṭahārakeyūrakuṇḍalādyairalaṅkṛtaḥ / prādurbabhūva purato jaganmohana rupadhṛk
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: तं कुमारमथालिङ्ग्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । चक्रे कामेश्वरं नाम्ना कमनीयवपुर्धरम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ kumāramathāliṅgya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / cakre kāmeśvaraṃ nāmnā kamanīyavapurdharam
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तु परमाशक्तेरनुरूपो वरस्त्वयम् । इति निश्चित्य तेनैव सहितास्तामथाययुः
verses.transliteration: tasyāstu paramāśakteranurūpo varastvayam / iti niścitya tenaiva sahitāstāmathāyayuḥ
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: अस्तुवंस्ते परां शक्तिं ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । तां दृष्ट्वा मृगशावाक्षीं कुमारो नीललोहितः । अभवन्मन्मथाविष्टो विस्मृत्य सकलाः क्रियाः
verses.transliteration: astuvaṃste parāṃ śaktiṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ kumāro nīlalohitaḥ / abhavanmanmathāviṣṭo vismṛtya sakalāḥ kriyāḥ
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: सापि तं वीक्ष्य तन्वङ्गो मूर्तिंमन्तमिव स्मरम् । मदनाविष्टसर्वाङ्गी स्वात्मरूपममन्यत । अन्योन्यालोकनासक्तौ तावृभौ मदनातुरौ
verses.transliteration: sāpi taṃ vīkṣya tanvaṅgo mūrtiṃmantamiva smaram / madanāviṣṭasarvāṅgī svātmarūpamamanyata / anyonyālokanāsaktau tāvṛbhau madanāturau
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभावविशेषज्ञौ धृतिमन्तौ मनस्विनौ । परैरज्ञातचारित्रौ मुहूर्तास्वस्थचेतनौ
verses.transliteration: sarvabhāvaviśeṣajñau dhṛtimantau manasvinau / parairajñātacāritrau muhūrtāsvasthacetanau
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच महादेवीं ब्रह्मा लोकैकनायिकाम् । इमे देवाश्च ऋषयो गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः । त्वामीशां द्रष्टुमिच्छन्ति सप्रियां परमाहवे
verses.transliteration: athovāca mahādevīṃ brahmā lokaikanāyikām / ime devāśca ṛṣayo gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ / tvāmīśāṃ draṣṭumicchanti sapriyāṃ paramāhave
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: को वानुरूपस्ते देवि प्रियो धन्यतमः पुमान् । लोकसंरक्षणार्थाय भजस्व पुरुषं परम्
verses.transliteration: ko vānurūpaste devi priyo dhanyatamaḥ pumān / lokasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya bhajasva puruṣaṃ param
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञी भव पुरस्यास्य स्थिता भव वरासने । अभिषिक्तां महाभागैर्देवार्षे भिरकल्मषैः
verses.transliteration: rājñī bhava purasyāsya sthitā bhava varāsane / abhiṣiktāṃ mahābhāgairdevārṣe bhirakalmaṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: साम्राज्यचिह्नसंयुक्तां सर्वाभरणसंयुताम् । सप्रियामासनगतां द्रष्टुमिच्छामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: sāmrājyacihnasaṃyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇasaṃyutām / sapriyāmāsanagatāṃ draṣṭumicchāmahe vayam
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara eulogised Para Sakti. On seeing that fawn-eyed goddess the youthful Nllalohita (Siva) became overwhelmed with love and forgot his activities.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने मदनकामेश्वरप्रादुर्भावो नाम चतुर्दशो ऽध्यायः तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं देवी मन्दस्मितमुखांबुजा । उवाच स ततो वाक्यं ब्रह्मविष्णुमुखान्सुरान्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne madanakāmeśvaraprādurbhāvo nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ tacchrutvā vacanaṃ devī mandasmitamukhāṃbujā / uvāca sa tato vākyaṃ brahmaviṣṇumukhānsurān
verses.translation: On hearing those words, the goddess with a tender smile over her lotus-like face spoke to the Suras, the leaders among whom were Brahma and Visnu.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words, the goddess with a tender smile over her lotus-like face spoke to the Suras, the leaders among whom were Brahma and Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words, the goddess with a tender smile over her lotus-like face spoke to the Suras, the leaders among whom were Brahma and Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: स्वतन्त्राहं सदा देवाः स्वेच्छाचारविहारिणी । ममानुरूपचरितो भविता तु मम प्रियः
verses.transliteration: svatantrāhaṃ sadā devāḥ svecchācāravihāriṇī / mamānurūpacarito bhavitā tu mama priyaḥ
verses.translation: "O Devas, I am always independent. My conduct of life and my sports and pastimes are in accordance with my own wishes and whims. My husband shall be one whose conduct of life is befitting mine."
verses.wordMeaning: "O Devas, I am always independent. My conduct of life and my sports and pastimes are in accordance with my own wishes and whims. My husband shall be one whose conduct of life is befitting mine."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Devas, I am always independent. My conduct of life and my sports and pastimes are in accordance with my own wishes and whims. My husband shall be one whose conduct of life is befitting mine."

verses.sanskrit: तथेति तत्प्रतिश्रुत्य सर्वेर्देवैः पितामहः । उवाच च महादेवीं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः
verses.transliteration: tatheti tatpratiśrutya sarverdevaiḥ pitāmahaḥ / uvāca ca mahādevīṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: After promising — " Let it be so" along with all Devas, Pitamaha (grandfather i.e. Brahma) spoke to the great goddess, the following words containing Dharma and Artha (two goals in life).
verses.wordMeaning: After promising — " Let it be so" along with all Devas, Pitamaha (grandfather i.e. Brahma) spoke to the great goddess, the following words containing Dharma and Artha (two goals in life).
verses.commentary: Sense: After promising — " Let it be so" along with all Devas, Pitamaha (grandfather i.e. Brahma) spoke to the great goddess, the following words containing Dharma and Artha (two goals in life).

verses.sanskrit: कालक्रीता क्रयक्रीता पितृदत्ता स्वयंयुता । नारीपुरुषयोरेवमुद्वाहस्तु चतुर्विधः
verses.transliteration: kālakrītā krayakrītā pitṛdattā svayaṃyutā / nārīpuruṣayorevamudvāhastu caturvidhaḥ
verses.translation: "The marriage between a woman and a man is of four types. 1
verses.wordMeaning: "The marriage between a woman and a man is of four types. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: "The marriage between a woman and a man is of four types. 1

verses.sanskrit: कालक्रीता तु वेश्या स्यात्क्रयक्रीता तु दासिका । गन्धर्वोद्वाहिता युक्ता भार्या स्यात्पितृदत्तका
verses.transliteration: kālakrītā tu veśyā syātkrayakrītā tu dāsikā / gandharvodvāhitā yuktā bhāryā syātpitṛdattakā
verses.translation: VV. 4-7 show a later development, as all the eight forms of marriage ofthe Smrti Period [are not mentioned and terms used such as Kilakrili etc. are also different.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 4-7 show a later development, as all the eight forms of marriage ofthe Smrti Period [are not mentioned and terms used such as Kilakrili etc. are also different.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 4-7 show a later development, as all the eight forms of marriage ofthe Smrti Period [are not mentioned and terms used such as Kilakrili etc. are also different.

verses.sanskrit: समानधर्मिणी युक्ता भार्या पितृवशंवदा । यदद्वैतं परं ब्रह्म सदसद्भाववर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: samānadharmiṇī yuktā bhāryā pitṛvaśaṃvadā / yadadvaitaṃ paraṃ brahma sadasadbhāvavarjitam
verses.translation: You are beginningless immanence in everything. You are of the nature of Kdrya (effect) and Karana (cause). It is you whom Sanaka and other Yogins seek.
verses.wordMeaning: You are beginningless immanence in everything. You are of the nature of Kdrya (effect) and Karana (cause). It is you whom Sanaka and other Yogins seek.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are beginningless immanence in everything. You are of the nature of Kdrya (effect) and Karana (cause). It is you whom Sanaka and other Yogins seek.

verses.sanskrit: चिदानन्दात्मकं तस्मात्प्रकृतिः समजायत । त्वमेवासीच्च तद्ब्रह्म प्रकृतिः सा त्वमेव हि
verses.transliteration: cidānandātmakaṃ tasmātprakṛtiḥ samajāyata / tvamevāsīcca tadbrahma prakṛtiḥ sā tvameva hi
verses.translation: They praise you alone as the five-formed Brahman (Pancabrahma-S varupini ) namely you are Sadrupd (having the form ofthe Existent), Asadrupd (having the form of the non- existent), Karmarupd (having the form of Karman), Vyaktodayat- mikd (ofthe nature of manifest outcome) and Avyaktodayatmikd (ofthe nature of unmanifest outcome).
verses.wordMeaning: They praise you alone as the five-formed Brahman (Pancabrahma-S varupini ) namely you are Sadrupd (having the form ofthe Existent), Asadrupd (having the form of the non- existent), Karmarupd (having the form of Karman),…
verses.commentary: Sense: They praise you alone as the five-formed Brahman (Pancabrahma-S varupini ) namely you are Sadrupd (having the form ofthe Existent), Asadrupd (having the form of the non- existent), Karmarupd (having the form of Karman),…

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेवानादिरखिला कार्यकारणरूपिणी । त्वामेव हि विचिन्वन्ति योगिनः सनकादयः
verses.transliteration: tvamevānādirakhilā kāryakāraṇarūpiṇī / tvāmeva hi vicinvanti yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ
verses.translation: You alone create the universe at the outset. You alone protect it instantly. Resort to some Purusa with a desire to bless the world."
verses.wordMeaning: You alone create the universe at the outset. You alone protect it instantly. Resort to some Purusa with a desire to bless the world."
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone create the universe at the outset. You alone protect it instantly. Resort to some Purusa with a desire to bless the world."

verses.sanskrit: सदसत्कर्मरूपां च व्यक्ताव्यक्तो दयात्मिकाम् । त्वामेव हि प्रशंसंति पञ्चब्रह्मस्वरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: sadasatkarmarūpāṃ ca vyaktāvyakto dayātmikām / tvāmeva hi praśaṃsaṃti pañcabrahmasvarūpiṇīm
verses.translation: The garland ' hurled by her rendered the region of the firmament splendid and fell down on the neck of Kamesvara.
verses.wordMeaning: The garland ' hurled by her rendered the region of the firmament splendid and fell down on the neck of Kamesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The garland ' hurled by her rendered the region of the firmament splendid and fell down on the neck of Kamesvara.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामेव हि सृजस्यादौ त्वमेव ह्यवसि क्षणात् । भजस्व पुरुषं कञ्चिल्लोकानुग्रहकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tvāmeva hi sṛjasyādau tvameva hyavasi kṣaṇāt / bhajasva puruṣaṃ kañcillokānugrahakāmyayā
verses.translation: Then the Devas beginning withBrahtna and Visnu rejoiced. On being wafted by gentle breezes, the clouds made showers of flowers.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Devas beginning withBrahtna and Visnu rejoiced. On being wafted by gentle breezes, the clouds made showers of flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Devas beginning withBrahtna and Visnu rejoiced. On being wafted by gentle breezes, the clouds made showers of flowers.

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञापिता देवी ब्रह्मणा सकलैः सुरैः । स्रजमुद्यम्य हस्तेन चक्षेप गगनान्तरे
verses.transliteration: iti vijñāpitā devī brahmaṇā sakalaiḥ suraiḥ / srajamudyamya hastena cakṣepa gaganāntare
verses.translation: Then Brahma said to Lord J a n a r d a n a — "O Hari, the marriage of these two Blessed ones should be performed in accordance with the religious injunctions.
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma said to Lord J a n a r d a n a — "O Hari, the marriage of these two Blessed ones should be performed in accordance with the religious injunctions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma said to Lord J a n a r d a n a — "O Hari, the marriage of these two Blessed ones should be performed in accordance with the religious injunctions.

verses.sanskrit: तयोत्सृष्टा हि सा माला शोभयन्ती नभस्थलम् । पपात कण्ठदेशे हि तदा कामेश्वरस्य तु
verses.transliteration: tayotsṛṣṭā hi sā mālā śobhayantī nabhasthalam / papāta kaṇṭhadeśe hi tadā kāmeśvarasya tu
verses.translation: Brahma gave them, a sugarcane bow of imperishable nature and adamantine strength. Hari. gave them the immut- able and unfading flowery weapon (arrows).
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma gave them, a sugarcane bow of imperishable nature and adamantine strength. Hari. gave them the immut- able and unfading flowery weapon (arrows).
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma gave them, a sugarcane bow of imperishable nature and adamantine strength. Hari. gave them the immut- able and unfading flowery weapon (arrows).

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुमुदिरे देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः । ववृषुः पुष्पवर्षाणि मन्दवातेरिता घनाः
verses.transliteration: tato mumudire devā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ / vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi mandavāteritā ghanāḥ
verses.translation: Varuna the lord of aquatic beings gave them Nigapdsa (the serpentine noose). Visvakarma, the lord of subjects gave them goad.
verses.wordMeaning: Varuna the lord of aquatic beings gave them Nigapdsa (the serpentine noose). Visvakarma, the lord of subjects gave them goad.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna the lord of aquatic beings gave them Nigapdsa (the serpentine noose). Visvakarma, the lord of subjects gave them goad.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच विधाता तु भगवन्तं जनार्दनम् । कर्तव्यो विधिनोद्वाहस्त्वनयोः शिवयोर्हरे
verses.transliteration: athovāca vidhātā tu bhagavantaṃ janārdanam / kartavyo vidhinodvāhastvanayoḥ śivayorhare
verses.translation: Agni (the fire-god) gave a crown. The Moon and the Sun gave them two large ear-rings. TheRatnakara (Ocean- god) himself gave an ornament fully studded with the nine precious stones.
verses.wordMeaning: Agni (the fire-god) gave a crown. The Moon and the Sun gave them two large ear-rings. TheRatnakara (Ocean- god) himself gave an ornament fully studded with the nine precious stones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni (the fire-god) gave a crown. The Moon and the Sun gave them two large ear-rings. TheRatnakara (Ocean- god) himself gave an ornament fully studded with the nine precious stones.

verses.sanskrit: मुहुर्तो देवसम्प्राप्तो जगन्मङ्गलकारकः । त्वद्रूपा हि महादेवी सहजश्च भवानपि
verses.transliteration: muhurto devasamprāpto jaganmaṅgalakārakaḥ / tvadrūpā hi mahādevī sahajaśca bhavānapi
verses.translation: The ruler of Suras gave them an everlasting honey-vessel. Then Kubera gave a necklace full of Cintamanis (Philosopher's stones).
verses.wordMeaning: The ruler of Suras gave them an everlasting honey-vessel. Then Kubera gave a necklace full of Cintamanis (Philosopher's stones).
verses.commentary: Sense: The ruler of Suras gave them an everlasting honey-vessel. Then Kubera gave a necklace full of Cintamanis (Philosopher's stones).

verses.sanskrit: दातुमर्हसि कल्याणीमस्मै कामशिवाय तु । तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य देवदेवस्त्रिविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: dātumarhasi kalyāṇīmasmai kāmaśivāya tu / tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya devadevastrivikramaḥ
verses.translation: The consort of LaksmI (Visnu) gave them an umbrella that was an insignia of imperial power. The rivers Gariga and Yamuna gave them two chowries shining brilliantly like the moon.
verses.wordMeaning: The consort of LaksmI (Visnu) gave them an umbrella that was an insignia of imperial power. The rivers Gariga and Yamuna gave them two chowries shining brilliantly like the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The consort of LaksmI (Visnu) gave them an umbrella that was an insignia of imperial power. The rivers Gariga and Yamuna gave them two chowries shining brilliantly like the moon.

verses.sanskrit: ददौ तस्यै विधानेन प्रीत्या तां शङ्कराय तु । देवर्षिपितृमुख्यानां सर्वेषां देवयोगिनाम्
verses.transliteration: dadau tasyai vidhānena prītyā tāṃ śaṅkarāya tu / devarṣipitṛmukhyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ devayoginām
verses.translation: The eight Vasus, Rudras, Adityas, AsvinTdevas, guardians of the quarters, Maruts, Sadhyas, Gandharvas and the lords ofPramathas were delighted and they presented them their respective weapons.
verses.wordMeaning: The eight Vasus, Rudras, Adityas, AsvinTdevas, guardians of the quarters, Maruts, Sadhyas, Gandharvas and the lords ofPramathas were delighted and they presented them their respective weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight Vasus, Rudras, Adityas, AsvinTdevas, guardians of the quarters, Maruts, Sadhyas, Gandharvas and the lords ofPramathas were delighted and they presented them their respective weapons.

verses.sanskrit: कल्याणं कारयामास शिवयोरादिकेशवः । उपायनानि प्रददुः सर्वे ब्रह्मादयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: kalyāṇaṃ kārayāmāsa śivayorādikeśavaḥ / upāyanāni pradaduḥ sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: They gave them chariots, horses, and elephants of great velocity and strength, camels free from sickness, and horses devoid of hunger and thirst. They gave them (such animals) of adamantine shape and strength along with weapons and other requisites.
verses.wordMeaning: They gave them chariots, horses, and elephants of great velocity and strength, camels free from sickness, and horses devoid of hunger and thirst. They gave them (such animals) of adamantine shape and strength along with weapons and other requisites.
verses.commentary: Sense: They gave them chariots, horses, and elephants of great velocity and strength, camels free from sickness, and horses devoid of hunger and thirst. They gave them (such animals) of adamantine shape and strength along with weapons and other requisites.

verses.sanskrit: ददौ ब्रह्मेक्षुचापं तु वज्रसारमनश्वरम् । तयोः पुष्पायुधं प्रादादम्लानं हरिरव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: dadau brahmekṣucāpaṃ tu vajrasāramanaśvaram / tayoḥ puṣpāyudhaṃ prādādamlānaṃ hariravyayam
verses.translation: W. 26-54 describe the coronation of Ialita and K&mesvara.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 26-54 describe the coronation of Ialita and K&mesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 26-54 describe the coronation of Ialita and K&mesvara.

verses.sanskrit: नागपाशं ददौ ताभ्यां वरुणो यादसांपतिः । अङ्कुशं च ददौ ताभ्यां विश्वकर्मा विशांपतिः
verses.transliteration: nāgapāśaṃ dadau tābhyāṃ varuṇo yādasāṃpatiḥ / aṅkuśaṃ ca dadau tābhyāṃ viśvakarmā viśāṃpatiḥ
verses.translation: After getting down from the excellent aerial chariot she accepted the NTrajana rites (i.e. ceremonial waving of the lights) performed by the celestial damsels and entered the great Assembly chamber.
verses.wordMeaning: After getting down from the excellent aerial chariot she accepted the NTrajana rites (i.e. ceremonial waving of the lights) performed by the celestial damsels and entered the great Assembly chamber.
verses.commentary: Sense: After getting down from the excellent aerial chariot she accepted the NTrajana rites (i.e. ceremonial waving of the lights) performed by the celestial damsels and entered the great Assembly chamber.

verses.sanskrit: किरीटमग्निः प्रायच्छत्ताटङ्कौ चन्द्रभास्करौ । नवरत्नमयीं भूषां प्रादाद्रत्नाकरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kirīṭamagniḥ prāyacchattāṭaṅkau candrabhāskarau / navaratnamayīṃ bhūṣāṃ prādādratnākaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: Accompanied by Sambhu, she occupied the throne. Omniscient that she was, she understood what the noble people assembled there desired mentally. With the cast of her benign glance, she fulfilled all those desires.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Sambhu, she occupied the throne. Omniscient that she was, she understood what the noble people assembled there desired mentally. With the cast of her benign glance, she fulfilled all those desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Sambhu, she occupied the throne. Omniscient that she was, she understood what the noble people assembled there desired mentally. With the cast of her benign glance, she fulfilled all those desires.

verses.sanskrit: ददौ सुराणामधिपो मधुपात्रमथाक्षयम् । चिन्तामणिमयीं मालां कुबेरः प्रददौ तदा
verses.transliteration: dadau surāṇāmadhipo madhupātramathākṣayam / cintāmaṇimayīṃ mālāṃ kuberaḥ pradadau tadā
verses.translation: On observing this activity of the goddess, Brahma the grandfather of the worlds gave her the epithets of KamaksT and Kamesvarl.
verses.wordMeaning: On observing this activity of the goddess, Brahma the grandfather of the worlds gave her the epithets of KamaksT and Kamesvarl.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing this activity of the goddess, Brahma the grandfather of the worlds gave her the epithets of KamaksT and Kamesvarl.

verses.sanskrit: साम्राज्यसूचकं छत्रं ददौ लक्ष्मीपतिः स्वयम् । गङ्गा च यमुना ताभ्यां चामरे चन्द्रभास्वरे
verses.transliteration: sāmrājyasūcakaṃ chatraṃ dadau lakṣmīpatiḥ svayam / gaṅgā ca yamunā tābhyāṃ cāmare candrabhāsvare
verses.translation: At her. bidding, a miraculous cloud showered on that city excessively valuable articles and divine ornaments.
verses.wordMeaning: At her. bidding, a miraculous cloud showered on that city excessively valuable articles and divine ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: At her. bidding, a miraculous cloud showered on that city excessively valuable articles and divine ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ च वसवो रुद्रा आदित्याश्चाश्विनौ तथा । दिक्पाला मरुतः साध्या गन्धर्वाः प्रमथेश्वराः । स्वानिस्वान्यायुधान्यस्यै प्रददुः परितोषिताः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau ca vasavo rudrā ādityāścāśvinau tathā / dikpālā marutaḥ sādhyā gandharvāḥ pramatheśvarāḥ / svānisvānyāyudhānyasyai pradaduḥ paritoṣitāḥ
verses.translation: In every house of the city of the goddess, Cintamani (Philosopher's stone), Kalpa (desire-yielding tree), Kamala (Goddess LaksmI) and Kamadhenus (wish-yielding cows) stood for the purpose of the victory of the goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: In every house of the city of the goddess, Cintamani (Philosopher's stone), Kalpa (desire-yielding tree), Kamala (Goddess LaksmI) and Kamadhenus (wish-yielding cows) stood for the purpose of the victory of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: In every house of the city of the goddess, Cintamani (Philosopher's stone), Kalpa (desire-yielding tree), Kamala (Goddess LaksmI) and Kamadhenus (wish-yielding cows) stood for the purpose of the victory of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: रथांश्च तुरगान्नागान्महावेगान्महाबलान् । उष्टानरोगानश्वांस्तान्क्षुत्तृष्णापरिवर्जितान् । ददुर्वज्रोपमाकारान्सायुधान्सपरिच्छदान्
verses.transliteration: rathāṃśca turagānnāgānmahāvegānmahābalān / uṣṭānarogānaśvāṃstānkṣuttṛṣṇāparivarjitān / dadurvajropamākārānsāyudhānsaparicchadān
verses.translation: Thereafter once, the holy lord, sage Narada came
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter once, the holy lord, sage Narada came
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter once, the holy lord, sage Narada came

verses.sanskrit: अथाभिषेकमातेनुः साम्राज्ये शिवयोः शिवम् । अथाकरोद्विमानं च नाम्ना तु कुसुमाकरम्
verses.transliteration: athābhiṣekamātenuḥ sāmrājye śivayoḥ śivam / athākarodvimānaṃ ca nāmnā tu kusumākaram
verses.translation: "O great goddess, you are the supreme Brahman, you are the highest majestic lustre; you constitute the concepts like sad-bhdva (existence), asadbhava (non-existence), alterna- tive ideas and comprehensions.
verses.wordMeaning: "O great goddess, you are the supreme Brahman, you are the highest majestic lustre; you constitute the concepts like sad-bhdva (existence), asadbhava (non-existence), alterna- tive ideas and comprehensions.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great goddess, you are the supreme Brahman, you are the highest majestic lustre; you constitute the concepts like sad-bhdva (existence), asadbhava (non-existence), alterna- tive ideas and comprehensions.

verses.sanskrit: विधाताम्लानमालं वै नित्यं चाभेद्यमायुधैः । दिवि भुव्यन्तरिक्षे च कामगं सुसमृद्धिमत्
verses.transliteration: vidhātāmlānamālaṃ vai nityaṃ cābhedyamāyudhaiḥ / divi bhuvyantarikṣe ca kāmagaṃ susamṛddhimat
verses.translation: The gods have stayed here for a long time engaged in serving you. At your behest, they will go to their respective cities.
verses.wordMeaning: The gods have stayed here for a long time engaged in serving you. At your behest, they will go to their respective cities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods have stayed here for a long time engaged in serving you. At your behest, they will go to their respective cities.

verses.sanskrit: यद्गन्धघ्राणमात्रेण भ्रान्तिरोगक्षुर्धातयः । तत्क्षणादेव नश्यन्ति मनोह्लादकरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: yadgandhaghrāṇamātreṇa bhrāntirogakṣurdhātayaḥ / tatkṣaṇādeva naśyanti manohlādakaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: After honouring them duly, Ambika despatched Brahma, Hari, Sambhu, Vasava and other lords of cardinal points.
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring them duly, Ambika despatched Brahma, Hari, Sambhu, Vasava and other lords of cardinal points.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring them duly, Ambika despatched Brahma, Hari, Sambhu, Vasava and other lords of cardinal points.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विमानमथारोप्य तावुभौ दिव्यदंपती । चामख्याजनच्छत्रध्वजयष्टिमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: tadvimānamathāropya tāvubhau divyadaṃpatī / cāmakhyājanacchatradhvajayaṣṭimanoharam
verses.translation: Although they were allowed to go, the Suras thought that it was an offence to abandon completely. They continued to serve Siva and Siva the primordial parents. They served them by means oftheir parts (and partial incarnations).
verses.wordMeaning: Although they were allowed to go, the Suras thought that it was an offence to abandon completely. They continued to serve Siva and Siva the primordial parents. They served them by means oftheir parts (and partial incarnations).
verses.commentary: Sense: Although they were allowed to go, the Suras thought that it was an offence to abandon completely. They continued to serve Siva and Siva the primordial parents. They served them by means oftheir parts (and partial incarnations).

verses.sanskrit: वीणावेणुमृदङ्गादिविविधैस्तौर्यवादनैः । सेव्यमाना सुरगणैर्निर्गत्य नृपमन्दिरात्
verses.transliteration: vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādivividhaistauryavādanaiḥ / sevyamānā suragaṇairnirgatya nṛpamandirāt
verses.translation: The scholar who gets up early in the morning and recites this with faith and devotion shall become increasingly rich and one endowed with the power of speech flowing like nectar.
verses.wordMeaning: The scholar who gets up early in the morning and recites this with faith and devotion shall become increasingly rich and one endowed with the power of speech flowing like nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholar who gets up early in the morning and recites this with faith and devotion shall become increasingly rich and one endowed with the power of speech flowing like nectar.

verses.sanskrit: ययौ वीथीं विहारेशा शोभयन्ती निजौजसा । प्रतिहर्म्याग्रसंस्थाभिरप्सरोभिः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: yayau vīthīṃ vihāreśā śobhayantī nijaujasā / pratiharmyāgrasaṃsthābhirapsarobhiḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Nothing inauspicious can befall that intelligent one. He will attain immense glory as well as equality and even superiority over others.
verses.wordMeaning: Nothing inauspicious can befall that intelligent one. He will attain immense glory as well as equality and even superiority over others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nothing inauspicious can befall that intelligent one. He will attain immense glory as well as equality and even superiority over others.

verses.sanskrit: सलाजाक्षतहस्ताभिः पुरन्ध्रीभिश्च वर्षिता । गाथाभिर्मङ्गलार्थाभिर्वीणावेण्वादिनिस्वनैः । तुष्यन्ती वीवीथिवीथीषु मन्दमन्दमथाययौ
verses.transliteration: salājākṣatahastābhiḥ purandhrībhiśca varṣitā / gāthābhirmaṅgalārthābhirvīṇāveṇvādinisvanaiḥ / tuṣyantī vīvīthivīthīṣu mandamandamathāyayau
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्याप्स रोभिस्तु कृतं नीराजनाविधिम् । अवरुह्य विमानग्रात्प्रविवेश महासभाम्
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhyāpsa robhistu kṛtaṃ nīrājanāvidhim / avaruhya vimānagrātpraviveśa mahāsabhām
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनमधिष्ठाय सह देवेन शंभुना । यद्यद्वाञ्छन्ति तत्रस्था मनसैव महाजनाः । सर्वज्ञा साक्षिपातेन तत्तत्कामानपूरयत्
verses.transliteration: siṃhāsanamadhiṣṭhāya saha devena śaṃbhunā / yadyadvāñchanti tatrasthā manasaiva mahājanāḥ / sarvajñā sākṣipātena tattatkāmānapūrayat
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दृष्ट्वा चरितं देव्या ब्रह्मा लोक पितामहः । कामाक्षीति तदाभिख्यां ददौ कामेश्वरीति च
verses.transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā caritaṃ devyā brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ / kāmākṣīti tadābhikhyāṃ dadau kāmeśvarīti ca
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: ववर्षाश्चर्यमेघो ऽपि पुरे तस्मिंस्तदाज्ञया । महार्हाणि च वस्तूनि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च
verses.transliteration: vavarṣāścaryamegho 'pi pure tasmiṃstadājñayā / mahārhāṇi ca vastūni divyānyābharaṇāni ca
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणिः कल्पवृक्षः कमला कामधेनवः । प्रतिवेश्म ततस्तस्थुः पुरो देव्याजयाय ते
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇiḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ kamalā kāmadhenavaḥ / prativeśma tatastasthuḥ puro devyājayāya te
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: तां सेवैकरसाकारां विमुक्तान्यक्रियागुणाः । सर्वकामार्थसंयुक्ता हृष्यन्तः सार्वकालिकम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ sevaikarasākārāṃ vimuktānyakriyāguṇāḥ / sarvakāmārthasaṃyuktā hṛṣyantaḥ sārvakālikam
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहो हरिश्चैव महादेवश्च वासवः । अन्ये दिशामधीशास्तु सकला देवतागणाः
verses.transliteration: pitāmaho hariścaiva mahādevaśca vāsavaḥ / anye diśāmadhīśāstu sakalā devatāgaṇāḥ
verses.translation: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.
verses.wordMeaning: His prosperity and magnificence shall be unshake- able. At every step he will have welfare. He will never have anything to fear. He shall be brilliant and vigorous.

verses.transliteration: amaṅgalāni śūnyāni samṛddhārthāni saṃtvataḥ / evaṃ vijñāpitā devī nāradenākhileśvarī / svasvavāsanivāsāya preṣayāmāsa cāmarān

verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ ca hariṃ śaṃbhuṃ vāsavādīndiśāṃ patīn / yathārhaṃ pūjayitvā tu preṣayāmāsa cāṃbikā

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने वैवाहिकोत्सवो नाम पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः अथ सा जगतां माता ललिता परमेश्वरी । त्रैलोक्यकण्टकं भण्डं दैत्यं जेतुं विनिर्ययौ
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne vaivāhikotsavo nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ atha sā jagatāṃ mātā lalitā parameśvarī / trailokyakaṇṭakaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ daityaṃ jetuṃ viniryayau
verses.translation: "Then Lalita, the great goddess, the mother ofworlds, set out in order to conquer Bhanda Daitya, a thorn unto the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: "Then Lalita, the great goddess, the mother ofworlds, set out in order to conquer Bhanda Daitya, a thorn unto the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Then Lalita, the great goddess, the mother ofworlds, set out in order to conquer Bhanda Daitya, a thorn unto the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: चकार मर्दलाकारानंभोराशींस्तु सप्त ते । प्रभूतमर्द्दलध्वानैः पूरयामासुरंबरम्
verses.transliteration: cakāra mardalākārānaṃbhorāśīṃstu sapta te / prabhūtamarddaladhvānaiḥ pūrayāmāsuraṃbaram
verses.translation: She gathered together the seven oceans in the form of a Mardala (drum).
verses.wordMeaning: She gathered together the seven oceans in the form of a Mardala (drum).
verses.commentary: Sense: She gathered together the seven oceans in the form of a Mardala (drum).

verses.sanskrit: मृदङ्गमुरजाश्चैव पटहो ऽतुकुलीङ्गणाः । सेलुकाझल्लरीराङ्घाहुहुकाहुण्डुकाघटाः
verses.transliteration: mṛdaṅgamurajāścaiva paṭaho 'tukulīṅgaṇāḥ / selukājhallarīrāṅghāhuhukāhuṇḍukāghaṭāḥ
verses.translation: VV. 3-6 give a ist of musical instruments of the mediaeval period. Many of these are seen in the frescos and panels of cave-temple at Ajanta, Ellora, etc. Out of these Nihsana is a Sanskritisation of a Persian word. In Marathi historical records they are called 'Nisan'.

verses.sanskrit: आनकाः पणवाश्चैव गोमुखाश्चार्धचन्द्रिकाः । यवमध्या मुष्टिमध्या मर्द्दलाडिण्डिमा अपि

verses.translation: A deity named Sampatkarl rose out of the goad, a missile of Lalita Paramesanl. She moved on along with the other Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: A deity named Sampatkarl rose out of the goad, a missile of Lalita Paramesanl. She moved on along with the other Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: झर्झराश्च बरीताश्च इङ्ग्यालिङ्ग्यप्रभेदजाः । उद्धकाश्चैतुहुण्डाश्च निःसाणा बर्बराः परे
verses.transliteration: jharjharāśca barītāśca iṅgyāliṅgyaprabhedajāḥ / uddhakāścaituhuṇḍāśca niḥsāṇā barbarāḥ pare
verses.translation: She mounted an elephant named Kanakolahala. It, was in a state of excitement, huge in size like a mountain. It appeared to relish a fierce battle.
verses.wordMeaning: She mounted an elephant named Kanakolahala. It, was in a state of excitement, huge in size like a mountain. It appeared to relish a fierce battle.

verses.sanskrit: हुङ्कारा काकतुण्डाश्च वाद्यभेदास्तथापरे । दध्वनुः शक्तिसेनाभिराहताः समरोद्यमे
verses.transliteration: huṅkārā kākatuṇḍāśca vādyabhedāstathāpare / dadhvanuḥ śaktisenābhirāhatāḥ samarodyame
verses.translation: A great army shouting fiercely followed her, hitting the thick clouds by the fluttering clusters of banners and emblems.
verses.wordMeaning: A great army shouting fiercely followed her, hitting the thick clouds by the fluttering clusters of banners and emblems.
