verses.sanskrit: ललितापरमेशान्या अङ्कुशास्त्रान्समुद्गता । संपत्करी नाम देवी चचाल सह शक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: lalitāparameśānyā aṅkuśāstrānsamudgatā / saṃpatkarī nāma devī cacāla saha śaktibhiḥ
verses.translation: The horripilation of that deity Sampannatha, hem- med firmly within her stout breasts, shone like her desire within her heart for an elaborate preparation for war.
verses.wordMeaning: The horripilation of that deity Sampannatha, hem- med firmly within her stout breasts, shone like her desire within her heart for an elaborate preparation for war.
verses.commentary: Sense: The horripilation of that deity Sampannatha, hem- med firmly within her stout breasts, shone like her desire within her heart for an elaborate preparation for war.

verses.sanskrit: अनेककोटिमातङ्गतुरङ्गरथपङ्क्तिभिः । सेविता तरुणादित्यपाटला संपदीश्वरी
verses.transliteration: anekakoṭimātaṅgaturaṅgarathapaṅktibhiḥ / sevitā taruṇādityapāṭalā saṃpadīśvarī
verses.translation: A vibrant thin-bladed sword held in her hand shone dreadfully like the terrifying knitting of eyebrows of Kala- natha (God ofdeath).
verses.wordMeaning: A vibrant thin-bladed sword held in her hand shone dreadfully like the terrifying knitting of eyebrows of Kala- natha (God ofdeath).
verses.commentary: Sense: A vibrant thin-bladed sword held in her hand shone dreadfully like the terrifying knitting of eyebrows of Kala- natha (God ofdeath).

verses.sanskrit: मत्तमुद्दण्डसंग्रामरसिकं शैलसन्निभम् । रणकोलाहलं नाम सारुरोह मतङ्गजम्
verses.transliteration: mattamuddaṇḍasaṃgrāmarasikaṃ śailasannibham / raṇakolāhalaṃ nāma sāruroha mataṅgajam
verses.translation: Excellent elephants, crores and crores in number, followed her like huge mountains blown by the portentous whirl-winds.
verses.wordMeaning: Excellent elephants, crores and crores in number, followed her like huge mountains blown by the portentous whirl-winds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excellent elephants, crores and crores in number, followed her like huge mountains blown by the portentous whirl-winds.

verses.sanskrit: तामन्वगा ययौ सेना महती धोरराविणी । लोलाभिः केतुमालाभिरुल्लिखन्ती धनाधनात्
verses.transliteration: tāmanvagā yayau senā mahatī dhorarāviṇī / lolābhiḥ ketumālābhirullikhantī dhanādhanāt
verses.translation: Then (the deity) Atitvaritavikrdnti' (Extremaly speedy like Horse g a U°P) born ofthe lustrous weapon, noose of goddess Sri Lalita moved ahead, steated on a horse.
verses.wordMeaning: Then (the deity) Atitvaritavikrdnti' (Extremaly speedy like Horse g a U°P) born ofthe lustrous weapon, noose of goddess Sri Lalita moved ahead, steated on a horse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then (the deity) Atitvaritavikrdnti' (Extremaly speedy like Horse g a U°P) born ofthe lustrous weapon, noose of goddess Sri Lalita moved ahead, steated on a horse.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्च संपन्नाथायाः पीनस्तनसुसंकटः । कण्टको घनसंनाहो रुरुचे वक्षसिस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasyāśca saṃpannāthāyāḥ pīnastanasusaṃkaṭaḥ / kaṇṭako ghanasaṃnāho ruruce vakṣasisthitaḥ
verses.translation: Along with her, an army consisting mainly of horses moved ahead digging and tearing the surface of the ground by means of their hoofs as though by means of hoes.
verses.wordMeaning: Along with her, an army consisting mainly of horses moved ahead digging and tearing the surface of the ground by means of their hoofs as though by means of hoes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with her, an army consisting mainly of horses moved ahead digging and tearing the surface of the ground by means of their hoofs as though by means of hoes.

verses.sanskrit: कंपमाना खड्गलता व्यरुचत्तत्करे धृता । कुटिला कालनाथस्य भृकुटीव भयङ्करा
verses.transliteration: kaṃpamānā khaḍgalatā vyarucattatkare dhṛtā / kuṭilā kālanāthasya bhṛkuṭīva bhayaṅkarā
verses.translation: VV. 10-22 enumerate regions from which they came.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 10-22 enumerate regions from which they came.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 10-22 enumerate regions from which they came.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पातवातसंपाताच्चलिता इव पर्वताः । तामन्वगा ययुः कोटिसंख्याकाः कुञ्जरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: utpātavātasaṃpātāccalitā iva parvatāḥ / tāmanvagā yayuḥ koṭisaṃkhyākāḥ kuñjarottamāḥ
verses.translation: With her four hands she held the noose, the goad, the cane and the bridle of the horse. Her exploits shone splendidly.
verses.wordMeaning: With her four hands she held the noose, the goad, the cane and the bridle of the horse. Her exploits shone splendidly.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her four hands she held the noose, the goad, the cane and the bridle of the horse. Her exploits shone splendidly.

verses.sanskrit: अथ श्रीललितादेव्या श्रीपाशायुधसंभवा । अतित्वरितविक्रान्तिरश्वारूढाचलत्पुरः
verses.transliteration: atha śrīlalitādevyā śrīpāśāyudhasaṃbhavā / atitvaritavikrāntiraśvārūḍhācalatpuraḥ
verses.translation: She resembled the midday sun with blazing splendour of the girdle spreading everywhere. Seated on the horse, she moved up and down as though causing the horse to dance.
verses.wordMeaning: She resembled the midday sun with blazing splendour of the girdle spreading everywhere. Seated on the horse, she moved up and down as though causing the horse to dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: She resembled the midday sun with blazing splendour of the girdle spreading everywhere. Seated on the horse, she moved up and down as though causing the horse to dance.

verses.sanskrit: तया सह हयप्रायं सैन्यं हेषातरङ्गितम् । व्यचरत्खुरकुद्दालविदारितमहीतलम्
verses.transliteration: tayā saha hayaprāyaṃ sainyaṃ heṣātaraṅgitam / vyacaratkhurakuddālavidāritamahītalam
verses.translation: A few Saktis rose up with arms wonderfully hard as rocks. They pierced the ten quarters with terrible adamantine arrows.
verses.wordMeaning: A few Saktis rose up with arms wonderfully hard as rocks. They pierced the ten quarters with terrible adamantine arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: A few Saktis rose up with arms wonderfully hard as rocks. They pierced the ten quarters with terrible adamantine arrows.

verses.sanskrit: वनायुजाश्च कांबोजाः पारदाः सिंधुदेशजाः । टङ्कणाः पर्वतीयाश्च पारसीकास्तथा परे
verses.transliteration: vanāyujāśca kāṃbojāḥ pāradāḥ siṃdhudeśajāḥ / ṭaṅkaṇāḥ parvatīyāśca pārasīkāstathā pare
verses.translation: A few fierce Saktis of Srldandanatha kept watch over the vanguard ofthe army (of Srldandanatha). With swords and shields they leapt and sprang about.
verses.wordMeaning: A few fierce Saktis of Srldandanatha kept watch over the vanguard ofthe army (of Srldandanatha). With swords and shields they leapt and sprang about.
verses.commentary: Sense: A few fierce Saktis of Srldandanatha kept watch over the vanguard ofthe army (of Srldandanatha). With swords and shields they leapt and sprang about.

verses.sanskrit: अजानेया घट्टधरा दरदाः काल वन्दिजाः । वाल्मीकयावनोद्भूता गान्धर्वाश्चाथ ये हयाः
verses.transliteration: ajāneyā ghaṭṭadharā daradāḥ kāla vandijāḥ / vālmīkayāvanodbhūtā gāndharvāścātha ye hayāḥ
verses.translation: Saktis with canes in their hands tossed and struck them hundreds of times to avoid the jamming of soldiers. They moved about here and there.
verses.wordMeaning: Saktis with canes in their hands tossed and struck them hundreds of times to avoid the jamming of soldiers. They moved about here and there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktis with canes in their hands tossed and struck them hundreds of times to avoid the jamming of soldiers. They moved about here and there.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्देशजाताः कैराता प्रान्तदेशोद्भवास्तथा । विनीताः साधुवोढारो वेगिनः स्थिरचेतसः
verses.transliteration: prāgdeśajātāḥ kairātā prāntadeśodbhavāstathā / vinītāḥ sādhuvoḍhāro veginaḥ sthiracetasaḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis moved in front holding aloft tall banners and flags marked with pictures ofbuffaloes, deer and lions.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis moved in front holding aloft tall banners and flags marked with pictures ofbuffaloes, deer and lions.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis moved in front holding aloft tall banners and flags marked with pictures ofbuffaloes, deer and lions.

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिचित्तविशेषज्ञा महायुद्धसहिष्णवः । लक्षणैर्बहुभिर्युक्ता जितक्रोधा जितश्रमाः
verses.transliteration: svāmicittaviśeṣajñā mahāyuddhasahiṣṇavaḥ / lakṣaṇairbahubhiryuktā jitakrodhā jitaśramāḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of Saktis held the white umbrella of Sri Dandanatha with their lustrous hands and moved ahead.
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands of Saktis held the white umbrella of Sri Dandanatha with their lustrous hands and moved ahead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of Saktis held the white umbrella of Sri Dandanatha with their lustrous hands and moved ahead.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चधारासु शक्षढ्या विनीताश्च प्लवान्विताः
verses.transliteration: pañcadhārāsu śakṣaḍhyā vinītāśca plavānvitāḥ
verses.translation: "At the time when Dandanatha set out, the sky shone as though adorned with innumerable moons, due to the numerous umbrellas of white lustre.
verses.wordMeaning: "At the time when Dandanatha set out, the sky shone as though adorned with innumerable moons, due to the numerous umbrellas of white lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: "At the time when Dandanatha set out, the sky shone as though adorned with innumerable moons, due to the numerous umbrellas of white lustre.

verses.sanskrit: फलशुक्तिश्रिया युक्ताः श्वेतशुक्तिसमन्विताः । देवपद्मं देवमणिं देवस्वस्तिकमेव च
verses.transliteration: phalaśuktiśriyā yuktāḥ śvetaśuktisamanvitāḥ / devapadmaṃ devamaṇiṃ devasvastikameva ca
verses.translation: The darkness that gathered together densely under the white umbrellas rubbing and clashing against.one another, became dispelled by the lustre of jewels fitted to their handles.
verses.wordMeaning: The darkness that gathered together densely under the white umbrellas rubbing and clashing against.one another, became dispelled by the lustre of jewels fitted to their handles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The darkness that gathered together densely under the white umbrellas rubbing and clashing against.one another, became dispelled by the lustre of jewels fitted to their handles.

verses.sanskrit: अथ स्वस्तिकशुक्तिश्च गडुरं पुष्पगण्डिकाम् । एतानि शुभलक्ष्माणि ज्यराज्यप्रदानि च । वहन्तो वातजवना वाजिनस्तां समन्वयुः
verses.transliteration: atha svastikaśuktiśca gaḍuraṃ puṣpagaṇḍikām / etāni śubhalakṣmāṇi jyarājyapradāni ca / vahanto vātajavanā vājinastāṃ samanvayuḥ
verses.translation: In the army of KrodamukhT (Boarfaced Sakti), hundred varieties of Talavrntas (fans made of palm-leaves) proceeded ahead enveloping the faces of quarters, by means of the blazing lustre of diamonds (set in the fans).
verses.wordMeaning: In the army of KrodamukhT (Boarfaced Sakti), hundred varieties of Talavrntas (fans made of palm-leaves) proceeded ahead enveloping the faces of quarters, by means of the blazing lustre of diamonds (set in the fans).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the army of KrodamukhT (Boarfaced Sakti), hundred varieties of Talavrntas (fans made of palm-leaves) proceeded ahead enveloping the faces of quarters, by means of the blazing lustre of diamonds (set in the fans).

verses.sanskrit: अपराजितनामानमतितेजस्विनं चलम् । अत्यन्तोत्तुङ्गवर्ष्माणं कविकाविलसन्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: aparājitanāmānamatitejasvinaṃ calam / atyantottuṅgavarṣmāṇaṃ kavikāvilasanmukham
verses.translation: Many soldiers with the faces of Boars proceeded ahead. They had the same size, shape and ornaments as the goddess PotrlmukhI (Boarfaced). In their hands they had the same weapons as those of hers. Their vehicles too were the same. From their sharp curved teeth smoke and flames of fire issued forth covering up the whole of the sky. They were dark in com- plexion like the Tamala tree (xanthochymus pictorius). They were tawny-coloured and had eyes of ruthless features. They rode on thousands of buffaloes.
verses.wordMeaning: Many soldiers with the faces of Boars proceeded ahead. They had the same size, shape and ornaments as the goddess PotrlmukhI (Boarfaced). In their hands they had the same weapons as those of hers. Their vehicles too were the same.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Many soldiers with the faces of Boars proceeded ahead. They had the same size, shape and ornaments as the goddess PotrlmukhI (Boarfaced). In their hands they had the same weapons as those of hers. Their vehicles too were the same.…

verses.sanskrit: पार्श्वद्वये ऽपि पतितस्फुरत्केसरमण्डलम् । स्थूलवालधिविक्षेपक्षिप्यमाणपयोधरम्
verses.transliteration: pārśvadvaye 'pi patitasphuratkesaramaṇḍalam / sthūlavāladhivikṣepakṣipyamāṇapayodharam
verses.translation: As she betook herself to the task of slaying the Asuras with blazing fire of fury, the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings, experienced excessive excitement and alarm.
verses.wordMeaning: As she betook herself to the task of slaying the Asuras with blazing fire of fury, the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings, experienced excessive excitement and alarm.
verses.commentary: Sense: As she betook herself to the task of slaying the Asuras with blazing fire of fury, the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings, experienced excessive excitement and alarm.

verses.sanskrit: जङ्घाकाण्डसमुन्नद्धमणिकिङ्किणिभासुरम् । वादयन्तमिवोच्चण्डैः खुरनिष्ठुरकुट्टनैः
verses.transliteration: jaṅghākāṇḍasamunnaddhamaṇikiṅkiṇibhāsuram / vādayantamivoccaṇḍaiḥ khuraniṣṭhurakuṭṭanaiḥ
verses.translation: They tied far off hurriedly and in great fear and saw the goddess. With their palms joined in reverence the Devas made obeisance to her by repeating the twelve names and glorifying her in the firmament."
verses.wordMeaning: They tied far off hurriedly and in great fear and saw the goddess. With their palms joined in reverence the Devas made obeisance to her by repeating the twelve names and glorifying her in the firmament."
verses.commentary: Sense: They tied far off hurriedly and in great fear and saw the goddess. With their palms joined in reverence the Devas made obeisance to her by repeating the twelve names and glorifying her in the firmament."

verses.sanskrit: भूमण्डलमहावाद्यं विजयस्य समृद्धये । घोषमाणं प्रति मुहुः संदर्शितगतिक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmaṇḍalamahāvādyaṃ vijayasya samṛddhaye / ghoṣamāṇaṃ prati muhuḥ saṃdarśitagatikramam
verses.translation: "O holy lord Hayagriva, of excessive intelligence, what are the twelve names of that deity? Tell me. 1 am extremely eager to hear them."
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord Hayagriva, of excessive intelligence, what are the twelve names of that deity? Tell me. 1 am extremely eager to hear them."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord Hayagriva, of excessive intelligence, what are the twelve names of that deity? Tell me. 1 am extremely eager to hear them."

verses.sanskrit: आलोलचामरव्याजाद्वहन्तं पक्षती इव । भाण्डैर्मनोहरैर्युक्तं घर्घरीजालमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: ālolacāmaravyājādvahantaṃ pakṣatī iva / bhāṇḍairmanoharairyuktaṃ ghargharījālamaṇḍitam
verses.translation: By means of these names Devas stationed in the firmament eulogised Sanketa many times. For the purpose of blessing them, she moved ahead once again. Then the so unds'of t r umpets were heard in the firma- ment indicating the starting of Sanketayogini who touched the feet of Mantranatha.
verses.wordMeaning: By means of these names Devas stationed in the firmament eulogised Sanketa many times. For the purpose of blessing them, she moved ahead once again.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of these names Devas stationed in the firmament eulogised Sanketa many times. For the purpose of blessing them, she moved ahead once again.…

verses.sanskrit: एषां घोषस्य कपटाद्धुङ्कुर्वतीमि वासुरान् । अश्वारूढा महादेवी समारूढा हयं ययौ
verses.transliteration: eṣāṃ ghoṣasya kapaṭāddhuṅkurvatīmi vāsurān / aśvārūḍhā mahādevī samārūḍhā hayaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Then marched out the army of Saktis who mostly had the ornaments expressive ofthe sentiment ofLove, who
verses.wordMeaning: Then marched out the army of Saktis who mostly had the ornaments expressive ofthe sentiment ofLove, who
verses.commentary: Sense: Then marched out the army of Saktis who mostly had the ornaments expressive ofthe sentiment ofLove, who

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिर्वाहुभिः पाशमङ्कुशं वेत्रमेव च । हयवल्गां च दधती बहुविक्रमशोभिनी
verses.transliteration: caturbhirvāhubhiḥ pāśamaṅkuśaṃ vetrameva ca / hayavalgāṃ ca dadhatī bahuvikramaśobhinī
verses.translation: Some rode on horses. Some were intoxicated by honey from Kadamba (Curcuma Aromatica) flowers; keeping Mantranatha at the head, they moved ahead. The heaven-dwellers eulogised her by means of sixteen names. O Pot-born sage, listen to those sixteen names.
verses.wordMeaning: Some rode on horses. Some were intoxicated by honey from Kadamba (Curcuma Aromatica) flowers; keeping Mantranatha at the head, they moved ahead. The heaven-dwellers eulogised her by means of sixteen names. O Pot-born sage, listen to those sixteen names.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some rode on horses. Some were intoxicated by honey from Kadamba (Curcuma Aromatica) flowers; keeping Mantranatha at the head, they moved ahead. The heaven-dwellers eulogised her by means of sixteen names. O Pot-born sage, listen to those sixteen names.

verses.sanskrit: तरुणादित्यसङ्काशा ज्वलत्काञ्चीतरङ्गिणी । सञ्चचाल हयारूढा नर्तयन्तीव वाजिनम्
verses.transliteration: taruṇādityasaṅkāśā jvalatkāñcītaraṅgiṇī / sañcacāla hayārūḍhā nartayantīva vājinam
verses.translation: Wherever Mantrinatha casts her glance, the army of enemies will readily and undoubtedly fall down there.
verses.wordMeaning: Wherever Mantrinatha casts her glance, the army of enemies will readily and undoubtedly fall down there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever Mantrinatha casts her glance, the army of enemies will readily and undoubtedly fall down there.

verses.sanskrit: अथ श्रीदण्डनाथाया निर्याणपटहध्वनिः । उद्दण्डसिन्धुनिस्वानश्चकार बधिरं जगत्
verses.transliteration: atha śrīdaṇḍanāthāyā niryāṇapaṭahadhvaniḥ / uddaṇḍasindhunisvānaścakāra badhiraṃ jagat
verses.translation: From the young parrot held in the hand of Sariglta- yoginl, Dhanurveda (Science of archery) issued forth holding up a bow kept in readiness. The hero possessed four arms, three heads and three eyes. He devoutly bowed down to PradhaneSI and spoke thus.
verses.wordMeaning: From the young parrot held in the hand of Sariglta- yoginl, Dhanurveda (Science of archery) issued forth holding up a bow kept in readiness. The hero possessed four arms, three heads and three eyes. He devoutly bowed down to PradhaneSI and spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the young parrot held in the hand of Sariglta- yoginl, Dhanurveda (Science of archery) issued forth holding up a bow kept in readiness. The hero possessed four arms, three heads and three eyes. He devoutly bowed down to PradhaneSI and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रबाणैः कठोरैश्चभिन्दन्त्यः ककुभो दश । अन्युद्धतभुजाश्मानः शक्तयः काश्चिदुच्छ्रिताः
verses.transliteration: vajrabāṇaiḥ kaṭhoraiścabhindantyaḥ kakubho daśa / anyuddhatabhujāśmānaḥ śaktayaḥ kāściducchritāḥ
verses.translation: O goddess Mantrinayika, you are preparing for the fight with Bhanda, the lcadcrofthc Asuras. Hence, I should render all assistance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess Mantrinayika, you are preparing for the fight with Bhanda, the lcadcrofthc Asuras. Hence, I should render all assistance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess Mantrinayika, you are preparing for the fight with Bhanda, the lcadcrofthc Asuras. Hence, I should render all assistance to you.

verses.sanskrit: काश्चिच्छ्रीदण्डनाथायाः सेनानासीरसङ्गताः । खड्गं फलकमादाय पुप्लुवुश्चण्डसक्तयः
verses.transliteration: kāścicchrīdaṇḍanāthāyāḥ senānāsīrasaṅgatāḥ / khaḍgaṃ phalakamādāya pupluvuścaṇḍasaktayaḥ
verses.translation: Here are two quivers with everlasting supply of arrows. They are wonderfully embellished with gold. Accept them for jhe purpose of destroying Daityas as well as for blessing me." After saying this, Dhanurveda devoutly bent down his head and handed over the bow and quivers which Priya- kapriya accepted.
verses.wordMeaning: Here are two quivers with everlasting supply of arrows. They are wonderfully embellished with gold. Accept them for jhe purpose of destroying Daityas as well as for blessing me." After saying this,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Here are two quivers with everlasting supply of arrows. They are wonderfully embellished with gold. Accept them for jhe purpose of destroying Daityas as well as for blessing me." After saying this,…

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तसैन्यसम्बाधं वेत्रसंताडनैः शतैः । निवारयन्त्यो वेत्रिण्यो व्युच्छलन्ति स्मशक्तयः
verses.transliteration: atyantasainyasambādhaṃ vetrasaṃtāḍanaiḥ śataiḥ / nivārayantyo vetriṇyo vyucchalanti smaśaktayaḥ
verses.translation: Taking up the great bow Citrajlva, (the great goddess) Sukapriya played on the string repeatedly and produced a twanging sound.
verses.wordMeaning: Taking up the great bow Citrajlva, (the great goddess) Sukapriya played on the string repeatedly and produced a twanging sound.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking up the great bow Citrajlva, (the great goddess) Sukapriya played on the string repeatedly and produced a twanging sound.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तुङ्गध्वजश्रेणीर्महिषाङ्का मृगाङ्किकाम् । सिहाङ्काश्चैव बिभ्राणाः शक्तयो व्यचलन्पुरा
verses.transliteration: atha tuṅgadhvajaśreṇīrmahiṣāṅkā mṛgāṅkikām / sihāṅkāścaiva bibhrāṇāḥ śaktayo vyacalanpurā
verses.translation: Shehad two attendants named Yantrinland TantrinT. Holding the parrot and the lute, they attended upon her instantaneously. Holding the exceedingly charming bow, Ghanasyama (the deity ofcloud-like dark complexion) produced the twang- ing sound on its string increasing its loudness with the tinkling sound of her bangles moving to and fro.
verses.wordMeaning: Shehad two attendants named Yantrinland TantrinT. Holding the parrot and the lute, they attended upon her instantaneously. Holding the exceedingly charming bow,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Shehad two attendants named Yantrinland TantrinT. Holding the parrot and the lute, they attended upon her instantaneously. Holding the exceedingly charming bow,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्रीदण्डनाथायाः श्वेतच्छत्रं सहस्रशः । स्फुरत्कराः प्रचलिताः शक्तयः काश्चिदाददुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śrīdaṇḍanāthāyāḥ śvetacchatraṃ sahasraśaḥ / sphuratkarāḥ pracalitāḥ śaktayaḥ kāścidādaduḥ
verses.translation: GItayoginI embellished with the bow Citrajlva shone like a row of clouds with the clusters of Kadamba flowers for umbrella and bow.
verses.wordMeaning: GItayoginI embellished with the bow Citrajlva shone like a row of clouds with the clusters of Kadamba flowers for umbrella and bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: GItayoginI embellished with the bow Citrajlva shone like a row of clouds with the clusters of Kadamba flowers for umbrella and bow.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने ससेनविजययात्रा नाम षोडशो ऽध्यायः दण्डनाथाविनिर्याणे संख्यातीतैः सितप्रभैः । छत्रैर्गगनमारेजे निःसंख्याशशिमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne sasenavijayayātrā nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ daṇḍanāthāviniryāṇe saṃkhyātītaiḥ sitaprabhaiḥ / chatrairgaganamāreje niḥsaṃkhyāśaśimaṇḍitam
verses.translation: On attaining those ladies, the chief of whom was MohinT. they derived the greatest pleasure because (ordinarily) they could not be obtained even by Asvamedha and other great Yajnas.
verses.wordMeaning: On attaining those ladies, the chief of whom was MohinT. they derived the greatest pleasure because (ordinarily) they could not be obtained even by Asvamedha and other great Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On attaining those ladies, the chief of whom was MohinT. they derived the greatest pleasure because (ordinarily) they could not be obtained even by Asvamedha and other great Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यसक्तैर्थवलच्छत्रैरन्तर्घनीभवत् । तिमिरं नुनुदे भूयस्तत्काण्डमणिरोचिषा
verses.transliteration: anyonyasaktairthavalacchatrairantarghanībhavat / timiraṃ nunude bhūyastatkāṇḍamaṇirociṣā
verses.translation: They forgot the Vedas and lord Umapati (Siva) too. They forsook Yajnas and other auspicious rites.
verses.wordMeaning: They forgot the Vedas and lord Umapati (Siva) too. They forsook Yajnas and other auspicious rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: They forgot the Vedas and lord Umapati (Siva) too. They forsook Yajnas and other auspicious rites.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रप्रभाधगधगच्छायापूरितदिङ्मुखाः । तालवृन्ताः शतविधाः क्रोडमुख्या बले ऽचलन्
verses.transliteration: vajraprabhādhagadhagacchāyāpūritadiṅmukhāḥ / tālavṛntāḥ śatavidhāḥ kroḍamukhyā bale 'calan
verses.translation: When the Daityas were thus deluded, O Brahmana, the Devas including Vasava, became liberated from torment. They derived great pleasure.
verses.wordMeaning: When the Daityas were thus deluded, O Brahmana, the Devas including Vasava, became liberated from torment. They derived great pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Daityas were thus deluded, O Brahmana, the Devas including Vasava, became liberated from torment. They derived great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डो दण्डादयस्तीव्राभैरवाः शुलपाणयः । ज्वलत्केशापिशङ्गाभास्तडिद्भासुरदिङ्मुखाः
verses.transliteration: caṇḍo daṇḍādayastīvrābhairavāḥ śulapāṇayaḥ / jvalatkeśāpiśaṅgābhāstaḍidbhāsuradiṅmukhāḥ
verses.translation: Once, sage Narada came there and saw Devendra seated in his throne and surrounded by all Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: Once, sage Narada came there and saw Devendra seated in his throne and surrounded by all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, sage Narada came there and saw Devendra seated in his throne and surrounded by all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: दहत्य इव दैत्यौघांस्तीक्ष्णैर्मार्गणवह्निभिः । प्रचेलुर्दण्डनाथायास्सेना नासीरधाविताः
verses.transliteration: dahatya iva daityaughāṃstīkṣṇairmārgaṇavahnibhiḥ / pracelurdaṇḍanāthāyāssenā nāsīradhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to that noble sage shining brillliantly like fire, the lord of Devas stood up in reverence with palms joined together and spoke these words:
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to that noble sage shining brillliantly like fire, the lord of Devas stood up in reverence with palms joined together and spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to that noble sage shining brillliantly like fire, the lord of Devas stood up in reverence with palms joined together and spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: अथ पोत्रीमुखीदेवीसमानाकृतिभूषणाः । तत्समानायुधकरास्तत्समानस्ववाहनाः
verses.transliteration: atha potrīmukhīdevīsamānākṛtibhūṣaṇāḥ / tatsamānāyudhakarāstatsamānasvavāhanāḥ
verses.translation: ' O holy lord, conversant with all sacred rites, the most excellent one among, those.who know the Para and Apara (the greatest thing and the lesser ones), you visit only such places as you wish to bless.
verses.wordMeaning: ' O holy lord, conversant with all sacred rites, the most excellent one among, those.who know the Para and Apara (the greatest thing and the lesser ones), you visit only such places as you wish to bless.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' O holy lord, conversant with all sacred rites, the most excellent one among, those.who know the Para and Apara (the greatest thing and the lesser ones), you visit only such places as you wish to bless.

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्मदंष्ट३विनिष्ठ्यूतवह्रिधूमामितांबराः । तमालश्यामलाकाराः कपिलाः क्रूरलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: tīkṣmadaṃṣṭa3viniṣṭhyūtavahridhūmāmitāṃbarāḥ / tamālaśyāmalākārāḥ kapilāḥ krūralocanāḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda the leader of the Daityas has become
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda the leader of the Daityas has become
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda the leader of the Daityas has become

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रमहिषारूढाः प्रचेलुः सूकराननाः । अथ श्रीदण्डनाथा च करिचक्ररथोत्तमात्
verses.transliteration: sahasramahiṣārūḍhāḥ praceluḥ sūkarānanāḥ / atha śrīdaṇḍanāthā ca karicakrarathottamāt
verses.translation: Without propitiating goddess Para sakti, 0 Vasava, it is impossible to achieve it by means of other types of austerities even in hundreds of crores ofKalpas.
verses.wordMeaning: Without propitiating goddess Para sakti, 0 Vasava, it is impossible to achieve it by means of other types of austerities even in hundreds of crores ofKalpas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without propitiating goddess Para sakti, 0 Vasava, it is impossible to achieve it by means of other types of austerities even in hundreds of crores ofKalpas.

verses.sanskrit: अवरुह्य महासिंहमारुरोह स्ववाहनम् । वज्रघोष इति ख्यातं धूतकेसरमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: avaruhya mahāsiṃhamāruroha svavāhanam / vajraghoṣa iti khyātaṃ dhūtakesaramaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Prior to the rise of the enemy, O ignorant one, propitiate the Deity. On being propitiated the goddess will bring about your welfare."
verses.wordMeaning: Prior to the rise of the enemy, O ignorant one, propitiate the Deity. On being propitiated the goddess will bring about your welfare."
verses.commentary: Sense: Prior to the rise of the enemy, O ignorant one, propitiate the Deity. On being propitiated the goddess will bring about your welfare."

verses.sanskrit: व्यक्तास्यं विकटाकारं विशङ्कटविलोचनम् । दंष्ट्राकटकटत्कारबधिरीकृतदिक्तटम्
verses.transliteration: vyaktāsyaṃ vikaṭākāraṃ viśaṅkaṭavilocanam / daṃṣṭrākaṭakaṭatkārabadhirīkṛtadiktaṭam
verses.translation: On being urged and enlightened thus by him, Sakra, the lord of the groups of Devas, duly honoured the sage.
verses.wordMeaning: On being urged and enlightened thus by him, Sakra, the lord of the groups of Devas, duly honoured the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being urged and enlightened thus by him, Sakra, the lord of the groups of Devas, duly honoured the sage.

verses.sanskrit: आदिकूर्मकठोरास्थि खर्परप्रतिमैर्नखैः । विबन्तमिव भूचक्रमापातालं निमज्जिभिः
verses.transliteration: ādikūrmakaṭhorāsthi kharparapratimairnakhaiḥ / vibantamiva bhūcakramāpātālaṃ nimajjibhiḥ
verses.translation: Along with all the gods, he performed the great worship of Parasakti on the bank of Bhaglrathl that was brilliant with flowers in everyone of the seasons. Even since then, that place bestowing all sorts of accomplishments came to be known by the name Indraprastha. 1
verses.wordMeaning: Along with all the gods, he performed the great worship of Parasakti on the bank of Bhaglrathl that was brilliant with flowers in everyone of the seasons. Even since then, that place bestowing all sorts of accomplishments came to be known by the name Indraprastha. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with all the gods, he performed the great worship of Parasakti on the bank of Bhaglrathl that was brilliant with flowers in everyone of the seasons. Even since then, that place bestowing all sorts of accomplishments came to be known by the name Indraprastha. 1

verses.sanskrit: योजनत्रयमुत्तुङ्गं वगादुद्धूतवालधिम् । सिंहवाहनमारुह्य व्यचलद्दण्डनायिका
verses.transliteration: yojanatrayamuttuṅgaṃ vagāduddhūtavāladhim / siṃhavāhanamāruhya vyacaladdaṇḍanāyikā
verses.translation: On seeing the Asuras deluded, the highly intelli- gent priest, the son of Bhrgu. approached Bhandasura and spoke thus.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Asuras deluded, the highly intelli- gent priest, the son of Bhrgu. approached Bhandasura and spoke thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Asuras deluded, the highly intelli- gent priest, the son of Bhrgu. approached Bhandasura and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामसुरसंहारे प्रवृत्तायां ज्वलत्क्रुधि । उद्वेगं बहुलं प्राप त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāmasurasaṃhāre pravṛttāyāṃ jvalatkrudhi / udvegaṃ bahulaṃ prāpa trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: "It is relying on you alone, O leading king, that the excellent Danavas always sport and roam about as they please in three worlds without any fear.
verses.wordMeaning: "It is relying on you alone, O leading king, that the excellent Danavas always sport and roam about as they please in three worlds without any fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is relying on you alone, O leading king, that the excellent Danavas always sport and roam about as they please in three worlds without any fear.

verses.sanskrit: किमसौ धक्ष्यति रुषा विश्वमद्यैव पोत्रिणी । किं वा मुसलघातेन भूमिं द्वेधा करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: kimasau dhakṣyati ruṣā viśvamadyaiva potriṇī / kiṃ vā musalaghātena bhūmiṃ dvedhā kariṣyati
verses.translation: On being told thus by his preceptor, the demon Bhanda left his excellent couch. Inviting the elderly ministers, he told them everything as it had happened.
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus by his preceptor, the demon Bhanda left his excellent couch. Inviting the elderly ministers, he told them everything as it had happened.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus by his preceptor, the demon Bhanda left his excellent couch. Inviting the elderly ministers, he told them everything as it had happened.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वा हलनिर्घातैः क्षोभयिष्यति वारिधीन् । इति त्रस्तहृदः सर्वे गगने नाकिनां गणाः
verses.transliteration: atha vā halanirghātaiḥ kṣobhayiṣyati vāridhīn / iti trastahṛdaḥ sarve gagane nākināṃ gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda the leader of the Danavas agreed to his suggestion. Starting along with the armies he w'ent to the vaHey of the Himavan.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda the leader of the Danavas agreed to his suggestion. Starting along with the armies he w'ent to the vaHey of the Himavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda the leader of the Danavas agreed to his suggestion. Starting along with the armies he w'ent to the vaHey of the Himavan.

verses.sanskrit: दूराद्रुतं विमानैश्च सत्रासं ददृशुर्गताः । ववन्दिरे च ता देवा बद्धाञ्जलिपुटान्विताः । मुहुर्द्वादशनामानि कीर्तयन्तो नभस्तले
verses.transliteration: dūrādrutaṃ vimānaiśca satrāsaṃ dadṛśurgatāḥ / vavandire ca tā devā baddhāñjalipuṭānvitāḥ / muhurdvādaśanāmāni kīrtayanto nabhastale
verses.translation: On seeing Danavas eager to create obstacles in the penance of god, the mother of the universe made a huge lustrous rampart wall in front of them that could not be crossed.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Danavas eager to create obstacles in the penance of god, the mother of the universe made a huge lustrous rampart wall in front of them that could not be crossed.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Danavas eager to create obstacles in the penance of god, the mother of the universe made a huge lustrous rampart wall in front of them that could not be crossed.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच कानि द्वादशनामानि तस्या देव्या वद प्रभो । अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ येषु मे कौतुकं महत्
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca kāni dvādaśanāmāni tasyā devyā vada prabho / aśvānana mahāprājña yeṣu me kautukaṃ mahat
verses.translation: On seeing the Mother ofthe Universe and noticing the lustrous rampart, the Devas trembled with fear abandon- ing all their holy rites.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Mother ofthe Universe and noticing the lustrous rampart, the Devas trembled with fear abandon- ing all their holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Mother ofthe Universe and noticing the lustrous rampart, the Devas trembled with fear abandon- ing all their holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच शृणु द्वादशनामानि तस्या देव्या घटोद्भव । यदाकर्णनमात्रेण प्रसन्ना सा भविष्यति । पञ्चमी दण्डनाथा च संकेता समयेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca śṛṇu dvādaśanāmāni tasyā devyā ghaṭodbhava / yadākarṇanamātreṇa prasannā sā bhaviṣyati / pañcamī daṇḍanāthā ca saṃketā samayeśvarī
verses.translation: We shall become Brahman or we will be able to enjoy heaven." On being told thus, the Devas with Indra as their leader duly performed Homa by chopping off the flesh to the chanting of Mantras.
verses.wordMeaning: We shall become Brahman or we will be able to enjoy heaven." On being told thus, the Devas with Indra as their leader duly performed Homa by chopping off the flesh to the chanting of Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: We shall become Brahman or we will be able to enjoy heaven." On being told thus, the Devas with Indra as their leader duly performed Homa by chopping off the flesh to the chanting of Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: तथा समयसंकेता वाराही पोत्रिणी तथा । वार्ताली च महासेनाप्याज्ञा चक्रेश्वरी तथा
verses.transliteration: tathā samayasaṃketā vārāhī potriṇī tathā / vārtālī ca mahāsenāpyājñā cakreśvarī tathā
verses.translation: On seeing the great goddess all Devas, including Vasava (Indra) became delighted in their minds and they
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the great goddess all Devas, including Vasava (Indra) became delighted in their minds and they
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the great goddess all Devas, including Vasava (Indra) became delighted in their minds and they

verses.sanskrit: अरिघ्नी चेति सम्प्रोक्तं नामद्वादशकं मुने । नामद्वादशकाभिख्यवज्रपञ्जरमध्यगः । संकटे दुःखमाप्नोति न कदाचन मानवः
verses.transliteration: arighnī ceti samproktaṃ nāmadvādaśakaṃ mune / nāmadvādaśakābhikhyavajrapañjaramadhyagaḥ / saṃkaṭe duḥkhamāpnoti na kadācana mānavaḥ
verses.translation: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.wordMeaning: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being glanced at by her, all of them instantly became liberated from ailments. Their limbs became tougher and stronger with the deficiencies remedied. They became mighty with adamantine bodies. They eulogised the great goddess Ambika, the bestower of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्नामभिरभ्रस्थाः संकेतां बहु तुष्टुवुः । तेषामनुग्रहार्थाय प्रचचालच सा पुनः
verses.transliteration: etairnāmabhirabhrasthāḥ saṃketāṃ bahu tuṣṭuvuḥ / teṣāmanugrahārthāya pracacālaca sā punaḥ
verses.translation: "Be victorious O goddess, the Mother of the unTverseT Be victorious, O goddess, greater than the greatest. Bo victorious, O abode ofweal and prosperity. Be victorious, O soul of the art of Love.
verses.wordMeaning: "Be victorious O goddess, the Mother of the unTverseT Be victorious, O goddess, greater than the greatest. Bo victorious, O abode ofweal and prosperity. Be victorious, O soul of the art of Love.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Be victorious O goddess, the Mother of the unTverseT Be victorious, O goddess, greater than the greatest. Bo victorious, O abode ofweal and prosperity. Be victorious, O soul of the art of Love.

verses.sanskrit: अथ संकेतयोगिन्या मन्त्रनाथा पदस्पृशः । निर्याणसूचनकरी दिवि दध्वान काहली
verses.transliteration: atha saṃketayoginyā mantranāthā padaspṛśaḥ / niryāṇasūcanakarī divi dadhvāna kāhalī
verses.translation: "Be victorious O goddess, the Mother of the unTverseT Be victorious, O goddess, greater than the greatest. Bo victorious, O abode ofweal and prosperity. Be victorious, O soul of the art of Love.
verses.wordMeaning: "Be victorious O goddess, the Mother of the unTverseT Be victorious, O goddess, greater than the greatest. Bo victorious, O abode ofweal and prosperity. Be victorious, O soul of the art of Love.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Be victorious O goddess, the Mother of the unTverseT Be victorious, O goddess, greater than the greatest. Bo victorious, O abode ofweal and prosperity. Be victorious, O soul of the art of Love.

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गारप्रायभूषाणां शार्दूलश्यामलत्विषाम् । वीणासंयतपाणीनां शक्तीनां निर्ययौ बलम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṅgāraprāyabhūṣāṇāṃ śārdūlaśyāmalatviṣām / vīṇāsaṃyatapāṇīnāṃ śaktīnāṃ niryayau balam
verses.translation: "Be victorious O goddess, the Mother of the unTverseT Be victorious, O goddess, greater than the greatest. Bo victorious, O abode ofweal and prosperity. Be victorious, O soul of the art of Love.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने दण्डनाथाश्यामलासेनायात्रा नाम सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः अथ राजनायिका श्रिताज्वलिताङ्कुशा फणिसमानपाशभृत् । कलनिक्वणद्वलयमैक्ष्वं धनुर्दधती प्रदीप्तकुसुमेषुपञ्चका
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne daṇḍanāthāśyāmalāsenāyātrā nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ atha rājanāyikā śritājvalitāṅkuśā phaṇisamānapāśabhṛt / kalanikvaṇadvalayamaikṣvaṃ dhanurdadhatī pradīptakusumeṣupañcakā
verses.translation: She scattered a cascade of radiance from her person in all directions. It was more dazzlingly red than a thousand suns. Radiating the lustre ofher face in all directions, she made the sky appear as though filled with moons.
verses.wordMeaning: She scattered a cascade of radiance from her person in all directions. It was more dazzlingly red than a thousand suns. Radiating the lustre ofher face in all directions, she made the sky appear as though filled with moons.

verses.sanskrit: उदयत्सहत्स्रमहसा सहस्रतो ऽप्यतिपाटलं निजवपुः प्रभाझरम् । किरती दिशासु वदनस्य कान्तिभिः सृजतीव चन्द्रमयमभ्रमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: udayatsahatsramahasā sahasrato 'pyatipāṭalaṃ nijavapuḥ prabhājharam / kiratī diśāsu vadanasya kāntibhiḥ sṛjatīva candramayamabhramaṇḍalam
verses.translation: "O Hayagrlva of great intellect, give me that elixir of life gratifying and regaling my ears through the twentyfive names ofLalita Paramesanl."
verses.wordMeaning: "O Hayagrlva of great intellect, give me that elixir of life gratifying and regaling my ears through the twentyfive names ofLalita Paramesanl."

verses.sanskrit: दशयोजनायतिमाता जगत्त्रयीमभिवृण्वता विशदमौक्तिकात्मना । धवलातपत्रवलयेन भासुरा शशिमण्डलस्य सखितामुपेयुषा
verses.transliteration: daśayojanāyatimātā jagattrayīmabhivṛṇvatā viśadamauktikātmanā / dhavalātapatravalayena bhāsurā śaśimaṇḍalasya sakhitāmupeyuṣā

verses.sanskrit: अभिवीजिता च मणिकान्तशोभिना विजयादिमुख्यपरिचारिकागणैः । नवचन्द्रिकालहरिकान्तिकन्दलीचतुरेण चामरचतुष्टयेन च
verses.transliteration: abhivījitā ca maṇikāntaśobhinā vijayādimukhyaparicārikāgaṇaiḥ / navacandrikālaharikāntikandalīcatureṇa cāmaracatuṣṭayena ca

verses.sanskrit: शक्त्यैकराज्यपदवीमभिसूचयन्ती साम्राज्यचिह्नशतमण्डितसैन्यदेशा । संगीतवाद्यरचनाभिरथामरीणां संस्तूयमानविभवा विशदप्रकाशा
verses.transliteration: śaktyaikarājyapadavīmabhisūcayantī sāmrājyacihnaśatamaṇḍitasainyadeśā / saṃgītavādyaracanābhirathāmarīṇāṃ saṃstūyamānavibhavā viśadaprakāśā

verses.transliteration: vācāmagocaramagocarameva buddherīdṛktayā na kalanīyamananyatulyam

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यगर्भपरिपूरितशक्तिचक्रसाम्राज्यसंपदभिमानमभिस्पृशन्ती । आबद्धभक्तिविपुलाञ्जलिशेखराणामारादहंप्रथमिका कृतसेवनानाम्
verses.transliteration: trailokyagarbhaparipūritaśakticakrasāmrājyasaṃpadabhimānamabhispṛśantī / ābaddhabhaktivipulāñjaliśekharāṇāmārādahaṃprathamikā kṛtasevanānām

verses.transliteration: brahmeśaviṣṇuvṛṣamukhyasurottamānāṃ vaktrāṇivarṣitanutīni kaṭākṣayantī / uddīptapuṣpaśarapañcakataḥ samutthaijyotirmayaṃ tribhuvanaṃ sahasā dadhānā

verses.transliteration: dīptāyudhadyutitiraskṛta bhāskarābhirnityābhiraṅghrisavidhe samupākyamānā / śrīcakranāmatilakaṃ daśayojanātituṅgadhvajollikhitameghakadaṃbamuccaiḥ

verses.transliteration: tīvrābhirāvaṇasuśaktiparaṃparabhiryuktaṃ rathaṃ samarakarmaṇi cālayantī / prodyatpiśaṅgarucibhāgamalāṃśukena vītāmanohararucissamare vyabhāsīt

verses.transliteration: pañcādhikairviśatināmaratnaiḥ prapañcapāpapraśamātidakṣaiḥ / saṃstūyamānā lalitā marudbhiḥ saṃgrāmamuddiśya samuccacāla

verses.translation: "O Hayagrlva of great intellect, give me that elixir of life gratifying and regaling my ears through the twentyfive names ofLalita Paramesanl."
verses.wordMeaning: "O Hayagrlva of great intellect, give me that elixir of life gratifying and regaling my ears through the twentyfive names ofLalita Paramesanl."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Hayagrlva of great intellect, give me that elixir of life gratifying and regaling my ears through the twentyfive names ofLalita Paramesanl."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने ललितापरमेश्वरीसेनाजय यात्रा नामाष्टादशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच चक्रराजरथेन्द्रस्य याःपर्वणि समाश्रिताः । देवता प्रकटाभिख्यास्तासामाख्यां निवेदय
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne lalitāparameśvarīsenājaya yātrā nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca cakrarājarathendrasya yāḥparvaṇi samāśritāḥ / devatā prakaṭābhikhyāstāsāmākhyāṃ nivedaya
verses.translation: The author seems fond of presenting series of epithets like garlands. He gave twelve epithets ofDandanatha (Potrini) (supra 17.18-20) sixteen ofSyama or Syamala Mantrin! (supra 17.33-35). Here in VV. 14-19 he strings together twentyfive epithets of Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: The author seems fond of presenting series of epithets like garlands. He gave twelve epithets ofDandanatha (Potrini) (supra 17.18-20) sixteen ofSyama or Syamala Mantrin! (supra 17.33-35). Here in VV. 14-19 he strings together twentyfive epithets of Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: The author seems fond of presenting series of epithets like garlands. He gave twelve epithets ofDandanatha (Potrini) (supra 17.18-20) sixteen ofSyama or Syamala Mantrin! (supra 17.33-35). Here in VV. 14-19 he strings together twentyfive epithets of Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: संख्याश्च तासामखिला वर्णभेदांश्च शोभनान् । आयुधानि च दिव्यानि कथयस्व हयानन
verses.transliteration: saṃkhyāśca tāsāmakhilā varṇabhedāṃśca śobhanān / āyudhāni ca divyāni kathayasva hayānana
verses.translation: The struggle between Lalita and Bhandasura Is a symbolic descrip- tion of the struggle between good and evil forces. Thus the description of the chariot ofLalita is equally symbolic. For the convenience of, readers
verses.wordMeaning: The struggle between Lalita and Bhandasura Is a symbolic descrip- tion of the struggle between good and evil forces. Thus the description of the chariot ofLalita is equally symbolic. For the convenience of, readers
verses.commentary: Sense: The struggle between Lalita and Bhandasura Is a symbolic descrip- tion of the struggle between good and evil forces. Thus the description of the chariot ofLalita is equally symbolic. For the convenience of, readers

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच नवमं पर्व दीप्तस्य रथस्य समुपस्थिताः । तश प्रोक्ता सिद्धिदेव्यस्तासां नामानि मच्छृणु
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca navamaṃ parva dīptasya rathasya samupasthitāḥ / taśa proktā siddhidevyastāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu
verses.translation: "It is mentioned that ten Siddhidevls were stationed on the ninth step of the brilliant chariot. Listen to their names from me.
verses.wordMeaning: "It is mentioned that ten Siddhidevls were stationed on the ninth step of the brilliant chariot. Listen to their names from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is mentioned that ten Siddhidevls were stationed on the ninth step of the brilliant chariot. Listen to their names from me.

verses.sanskrit: अणिमा महिमाचैव लघिमा गरिमा तथा । ईशिता वशिता चैव प्राप्तिः सिद्धिश्च सप्तमी
verses.transliteration: aṇimā mahimācaiva laghimā garimā tathā / īśitā vaśitā caiva prāptiḥ siddhiśca saptamī
verses.translation: They were posted in the Raktaratha (Red chariot) in order to slay the Asura Bhanda. Listen from me to the names of those who were mentioned before as (deities) of secret names {Guptas).
verses.wordMeaning: They were posted in the Raktaratha (Red chariot) in order to slay the Asura Bhanda. Listen from me to the names of those who were mentioned before as (deities) of secret names {Guptas).
verses.commentary: Sense: They were posted in the Raktaratha (Red chariot) in order to slay the Asura Bhanda. Listen from me to the names of those who were mentioned before as (deities) of secret names {Guptas).

verses.sanskrit: प्राकाम्यमुक्तिसिद्धिश्च सर्वकामाभिधापरा । एतादेव्यश्चतुर्बाह्व्यो जपाकुसुमसंनिभाः
verses.transliteration: prākāmyamuktisiddhiśca sarvakāmābhidhāparā / etādevyaścaturbāhvyo japākusumasaṃnibhāḥ
verses.translation: The deities named Guplalaras stationed them- selves on the seventh step of the chariot Cakraratha that had the brightness of the lamp blazing in the evening.
verses.wordMeaning: The deities named Guplalaras stationed them- selves on the seventh step of the chariot Cakraratha that had the brightness of the lamp blazing in the evening.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities named Guplalaras stationed them- selves on the seventh step of the chariot Cakraratha that had the brightness of the lamp blazing in the evening.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणिकपालं च त्रिशूलं सिद्धिकज्जलम् । दधाना दयया पूर्णा योगिभिश्च निषेविताः
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇikapālaṃ ca triśūlaṃ siddhikajjalam / dadhānā dayayā pūrṇā yogibhiśca niṣevitāḥ
verses.translation: All these should be known as having four arms. They held the thunderbolt, javelin, iron club and discus. They were ready to slay the Asura Bhanda.
verses.wordMeaning: All these should be known as having four arms. They held the thunderbolt, javelin, iron club and discus. They were ready to slay the Asura Bhanda.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these should be known as having four arms. They held the thunderbolt, javelin, iron club and discus. They were ready to slay the Asura Bhanda.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पूर्वार्द्धभागे च ब्रह्माद्या अष्ट शक्तयः । ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्मवी तथा । वाराही चैव मांहेन्द्री चामुण्डा चैव सप्तमी
verses.transliteration: tatra pūrvārddhabhāge ca brahmādyā aṣṭa śaktayaḥ / brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣmavī tathā / vārāhī caiva māṃhendrī cāmuṇḍā caiva saptamī
verses.translation: The deities na med Rahasyayoginls were stationed on the third step ofthe leading chariot Cakraratha. They were wellknown presiding. deities of speech. Their lustre was like that of the red Asoka (Jonesia Asoka Roxb). They held bows, and arrows in their hands. Armours covered their whole bodies. They shone with lutes and books too. They were Vasini, KamesI, BhoginT, Vimala, Aruna, JavinI, SarvesI: and Kaulinl. These eight deities are remembered as the cause ofthe slaughter of Daityas.
verses.wordMeaning: The deities na med Rahasyayoginls were stationed on the third step ofthe leading chariot Cakraratha. They were wellknown presiding. deities of speech. Their lustre was like that of the red Asoka (Jonesia Asoka Roxb). They held bows, and arrows in their hands.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities na med Rahasyayoginls were stationed on the third step ofthe leading chariot Cakraratha. They were wellknown presiding. deities of speech. Their lustre was like that of the red Asoka (Jonesia Asoka Roxb). They held bows, and arrows in their hands.…

verses.sanskrit: महालक्ष्मीरष्टमी च द्विभुजाः शोणविग्रहाः । कपालमुत्पलं चैव बिभ्राणा रक्तवाससः
verses.transliteration: mahālakṣmīraṣṭamī ca dvibhujāḥ śoṇavigrahāḥ / kapālamutpalaṃ caiva bibhrāṇā raktavāsasaḥ
verses.translation: They had the same greatness and grandeur as that of Lalita and they had the same refulgence. They are glorified as one's most beloved Srldevl.
verses.wordMeaning: They had the same greatness and grandeur as that of Lalita and they had the same refulgence. They are glorified as one's most beloved Srldevl.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had the same greatness and grandeur as that of Lalita and they had the same refulgence. They are glorified as one's most beloved Srldevl.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वान्य प्रकारेण केचिद्ध्यानं पचक्षते । ब्रह्मादिसदृशाकारा ब्रह्मादिसदृशायुधाः
verses.transliteration: atha vānya prakāreṇa keciddhyānaṃ pacakṣate / brahmādisadṛśākārā brahmādisadṛśāyudhāḥ
verses.translation: Then next, fifteen imperishable deities are mentioned as having fixed up their residences all round on the Ananda- mahapljha (the great seat of Bliss), on the step in the middle: of the chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: Then next, fifteen imperishable deities are mentioned as having fixed up their residences all round on the Ananda- mahapljha (the great seat of Bliss), on the step in the middle: of the chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then next, fifteen imperishable deities are mentioned as having fixed up their residences all round on the Ananda- mahapljha (the great seat of Bliss), on the step in the middle: of the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादीनां परं चिह्नं धारयन्त्यः प्रकीर्तिताः । तासामूर्ध्वस्थानगतां मुद्रा देव्यो महत्तराः
verses.transliteration: brahmādīnāṃ paraṃ cihnaṃ dhārayantyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ / tāsāmūrdhvasthānagatāṃ mudrā devyo mahattarāḥ
verses.translation: They are also eternal in the form of Kala (Time). They had stationed themselves after pervading the universe. Their bows indicated their agitation and fury against Bhandasura and other Daityas.
verses.wordMeaning: They are also eternal in the form of Kala (Time). They had stationed themselves after pervading the universe. Their bows indicated their agitation and fury against Bhandasura and other Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are also eternal in the form of Kala (Time). They had stationed themselves after pervading the universe. Their bows indicated their agitation and fury against Bhandasura and other Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: मुद्राविरचनायुक्तैर्हस्तैः कमलकान्तिभिः । दाडिमीपुष्पसङ्काशाः पीतांबरमनोहराः
verses.transliteration: mudrāviracanāyuktairhastaiḥ kamalakāntibhiḥ / dāḍimīpuṣpasaṅkāśāḥ pītāṃbaramanoharāḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by these deities whose attention was solely on rendering service, goddess Paramesvar! set off in order to conquer the wicked Bhandasura.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by these deities whose attention was solely on rendering service, goddess Paramesvar! set off in order to conquer the wicked Bhandasura.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by these deities whose attention was solely on rendering service, goddess Paramesvar! set off in order to conquer the wicked Bhandasura.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजा भुजद्वन्द्वधृतचर्मकृपाणकाः । मदरक्तविलोलाक्ष्यस्तासां नामानि मच्छृणु
verses.transliteration: caturbhujā bhujadvandvadhṛtacarmakṛpāṇakāḥ / madaraktavilolākṣyastāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu
verses.translation: Seven steps are mentioned in the excellent chariot (named) Giticakra 1 (Geyacakra also. See verse 63) that belonged to Mantrinatha and that had great wheels. There listen to those deities of the Devi.
verses.wordMeaning: Seven steps are mentioned in the excellent chariot (named) Giticakra 1 (Geyacakra also. See verse 63) that belonged to Mantrinatha and that had great wheels. There listen to those deities of the Devi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven steps are mentioned in the excellent chariot (named) Giticakra 1 (Geyacakra also. See verse 63) that belonged to Mantrinatha and that had great wheels. There listen to those deities of the Devi.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसंक्षोभिणी चैव सर्वविद्राविणी तथा । सर्वाकर्षणकृन्मुद्रा तथा सर्ववशङ्करी
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathā / sarvākarṣaṇakṛnmudrā tathā sarvavaśaṅkarī
verses.translation: The deities of.thc arrows of the god of Love were stationed on the third step. They were five viz.: Dravini, SosinI, BandhinT, MohinI and Unmadinl. All these five had resplendent bows in their hands. Thereon the same step were stationed five gods too beneath the deities. They were Kamaraja, Kandarpa, Manmatha, Makaradhvaja and the fifth one Manobhava. All these were capable of enchanting the three worlds. Marks on their foreheads with Kasturi (Musk) shone brilliantly. They glittered with pearls. Their entire body was covered with armour. They had the lustre of flowers of Palasa (Butea Frondosa). They are called Paiicakamas (Five Kamas or gods of Love). They eagerly sought the killing of Bhandasura.
verses.wordMeaning: The deities of.thc arrows of the god of Love were stationed on the third step. They were five viz.: Dravini, SosinI, BandhinT, MohinI and Unmadinl. All these five had resplendent bows in their hands. Thereon the same step were stationed five gods too beneath the deities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities of.thc arrows of the god of Love were stationed on the third step. They were five viz.: Dravini, SosinI, BandhinT, MohinI and Unmadinl. All these five had resplendent bows in their hands. Thereon the same step were stationed five gods too beneath the deities.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोन्मादनमुद्रा च यष्टिः सर्वमहाङ्कुशा । सर्वखेचरिका मुद्रा सर्वबीजा तथापरा
verses.transliteration: sarvonmādanamudrā ca yaṣṭiḥ sarvamahāṅkuśā / sarvakhecarikā mudrā sarvabījā tathāparā
verses.translation: Then those stationed on the sixth step of the leading chariot GTti (i.e. Giticakra) were the Bhairavas beginning with Asitahga. They were dreadful due to their weapons. They held the trident and the drinking bowl. They were blue-complexioned. They were— Asitahga, Ruru, Ganda, Krodha, Unmattabhaira va, Kapall, Bhlsana and Sarhhara — these were the eight Bhairavas.
verses.wordMeaning: Then those stationed on the sixth step of the leading chariot GTti (i.e. Giticakra) were the Bhairavas beginning with Asitahga. They were dreadful due to their weapons. They held the trident and the drinking bowl. They were blue-complexioned. They were— Asitahga, Ruru, Ganda,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then those stationed on the sixth step of the leading chariot GTti (i.e. Giticakra) were the Bhairavas beginning with Asitahga. They were dreadful due to their weapons. They held the trident and the drinking bowl. They were blue-complexioned. They were— Asitahga, Ruru, Ganda,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वयोनिश्च नवमी तथा सर्वत्रिशण्डिका । सिद्धिब्राहयादिमुद्रास्ता एताः प्रकटशक्तयः
verses.transliteration: sarvayoniśca navamī tathā sarvatriśaṇḍikā / siddhibrāhayādimudrāstā etāḥ prakaṭaśaktayaḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: भण्डासुरस्य संहारं कर्तुं रक्तरथे स्थिताः । या गुप्ताख्याः पूर्वमुक्तास्तासां नामानि मच्छृणु
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍāsurasya saṃhāraṃ kartuṃ raktarathe sthitāḥ / yā guptākhyāḥ pūrvamuktāstāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu

verses.transliteration: kāmākarṣaṇikā caiva buddhyākarṣaṇikā kalā / ahaṅkārākarṣiṇī ca śabdākarṣaṇikā kalā

verses.transliteration: sparśākarṣaṇikā nityā rūpākarṣaṇikā kalā / rasākarṣaṇikā nityā gandhākarṣaṇikā kalā

verses.transliteration: cittākarṣaṇikā nityā dhairyākarṣaṇikā kalā / smṛtyā karṣaṇikā nityā nāmākarṇaṇikā kalā

verses.transliteration: bījākarṣaṇikā nityā cātmakarṣaṇikā kalā / amṛtākarṣaṇī nityā śarīrākarṣiṇī kalā

verses.sanskrit: एताः षोडश शीतांशुकलारूपाश्च शक्तयः । अष्टमं पर्व सम्प्राप्ता गुप्ता नाम्ना प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: etāḥ ṣoḍaśa śītāṃśukalārūpāśca śaktayaḥ / aṣṭamaṃ parva samprāptā guptā nāmnā prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: विद्रुमद्रुमसङ्काशा मन्दस्मित मनोहराः । चतुर्भुजास्त्रिनेत्राश्च चन्द्रार्कमुकुजोज्ज्वलाः
verses.transliteration: vidrumadrumasaṅkāśā mandasmita manoharāḥ / caturbhujāstrinetrāśca candrārkamukujojjvalāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: चापबाणौ चर्मखड्गौ दधाना दिव्यकान्तयः । भण्डासुरवधार्थाय प्रवृत्ताः कुम्भसम्भव
verses.transliteration: cāpabāṇau carmakhaḍgau dadhānā divyakāntayaḥ / bhaṇḍāsuravadhārthāya pravṛttāḥ kumbhasambhava
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: सायन्तनज्वलद्दीपप्रख्यचक्ररथस्य तु । सप्तमे पर्वणि कृतावासा गुप्ततराभिधाः
verses.transliteration: sāyantanajvaladdīpaprakhyacakrarathasya tu / saptame parvaṇi kṛtāvāsā guptatarābhidhāḥ

verses.transliteration: anaṅgamadanānaṅgamadanāturayā saha / anaṅgalekhā cānaṅgavegānaṅgāṅkuśāpi ca
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.transliteration: ratiḥ prītirmanojā ca vīṇākārmukapāṇayaḥ / tamālaśyāmalākārā dānavonmūlanakṣamāḥ

verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaparvasaṃrūḍhā manobhūbāṇadevatā / drāviṇī śoṣiṇī caiva bandhinī mohinī tathā

verses.transliteration: unmādinīti pañcaitā dīptakārmukapāṇayaḥ / tatra parvaṇyadhastāttu vartamānā mahaujasaḥ

verses.transliteration: kāmarājaśca kandarpauṃ manmatho makaradhvajaḥ / manobhavaḥ pañcamaḥ syādete trailokyamohanāḥ

verses.sanskrit: कस्तूरीतिलकोल्लासिभालामुक्ताविराजिताः । कवचच्छन्नसर्वाङ्गाः पलाशप्रसवत्विषः
verses.transliteration: kastūrītilakollāsibhālāmuktāvirājitāḥ / kavacacchannasarvāṅgāḥ palāśaprasavatviṣaḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चकामा इमे प्रोक्ता भण्डासुरवधार्थिनः । जेयचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य चतुर्थं पर्व संश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: pañcakāmā ime proktā bhaṇḍāsuravadhārthinaḥ / jeyacakrarathendrasya caturthaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मीमुख्यास्तु पूर्वोक्ताश्चण्डिका त्वष्टमी परा । तत्र पर्वण्यधस्ताच्च लक्ष्मीश्चैव सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: brahmīmukhyāstu pūrvoktāścaṇḍikā tvaṣṭamī parā / tatra parvaṇyadhastācca lakṣmīścaiva sarasvatī

verses.sanskrit: रतिः प्रीतिः कीर्तिशान्ती पुष्टिस्तुष्टिश्च शक्तयः । एताश्चक्रोधरक्ताक्ष्यो दैत्यं हन्तुं महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: ratiḥ prītiḥ kīrtiśāntī puṣṭistuṣṭiśca śaktayaḥ / etāścakrodharaktākṣyo daityaṃ hantuṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: कुन्तचक्रधराः प्रोक्ताः कुमार्यः कुंभसंभव । पञ्चमं पर्व संप्राप्ता वामाद्याः षोडशापराः
verses.transliteration: kuntacakradharāḥ proktāḥ kumāryaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhava / pañcamaṃ parva saṃprāptā vāmādyāḥ ṣoḍaśāparāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: गीतिं चक्रू रथेन्द्रस्य तासां नामानि मच्छृणु । वामा ज्येष्टा च रौद्री च शान्तिः श्रद्धा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: gītiṃ cakrū rathendrasya tāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu / vāmā jyeṣṭā ca raudrī ca śāntiḥ śraddhā sarasvatī

verses.sanskrit: श्रीभूशाक्तिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च सृष्टिश्चैव तु मोहिनी । तथा प्रमाथिनी चाश्वसिनी वीचिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: śrībhūśāktiśca lakṣmīśca sṛṣṭiścaiva tu mohinī / tathā pramāthinī cāśvasinī vīcistathaiva ca

verses.sanskrit: विद्युन्मालिन्यथ सुरानन्दाथो नागबुद्धिका । एतास्तु कुरविन्दाभा जगत्क्षोभणलंपटाः
verses.transliteration: vidyunmālinyatha surānandātho nāgabuddhikā / etāstu kuravindābhā jagatkṣobhaṇalaṃpaṭāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: महासरसमन्नाहमादधानाः पदेपदे । वज्रकङ्कटसंछन्ना अट्टहासोज्ज्वलाः परे । वज्रदण्डौ शतघ्नीं च संबिभ्राणा भुशुण्डिकाः
verses.transliteration: mahāsarasamannāhamādadhānāḥ padepade / vajrakaṅkaṭasaṃchannā aṭṭahāsojjvalāḥ pare / vajradaṇḍau śataghnīṃ ca saṃbibhrāṇā bhuśuṇḍikāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: अथ गीतिरथेन्द्रस्य षष्ठं पर्व समाश्रिताः । असिताङ्गप्रभृतयो भैरवाः शस्त्रभीषणाः
verses.transliteration: atha gītirathendrasya ṣaṣṭhaṃ parva samāśritāḥ / asitāṅgaprabhṛtayo bhairavāḥ śastrabhīṣaṇāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशिखं पानपात्रं च बिभ्राणा नीलवर्चसः । असिताङ्गो रुरुश्चण्डः क्रोध उन्मत्तभैरवः
verses.transliteration: triśikhaṃ pānapātraṃ ca bibhrāṇā nīlavarcasaḥ / asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodha unmattabhairavaḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: कपाली भीषणश्चैव संहारश्चाष्ट भैरवाः । अथ गीतिरथेन्द्रस्य सप्तमं पर्व संश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: kapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭa bhairavāḥ / atha gītirathendrasya saptamaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ

verses.sanskrit: मातङ्गी सिद्धलक्ष्मीश्च महामातङ्गिकापि च । महती सिद्धलक्ष्मीश्च शोणा बाणधनुर्धराः
verses.transliteration: mātaṅgī siddhalakṣmīśca mahāmātaṅgikāpi ca / mahatī siddhalakṣmīśca śoṇā bāṇadhanurdharāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव पर्वणो ऽधस्ताद्गणपः क्षेत्रपस्तथा । दुर्गांबा बटुकश्चेंव सर्वे ते शस्त्रपाणयः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva parvaṇo 'dhastādgaṇapaḥ kṣetrapastathā / durgāṃbā baṭukaśceṃva sarve te śastrapāṇayaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव पर्वणो ऽधस्ताल्लक्ष्मीश्चैव सरस्वती । शङ्खः पद्मो निधिश्चैव ते सर्वे शस्त्रपाणयः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva parvaṇo 'dhastāllakṣmīścaiva sarasvatī / śaṅkhaḥ padmo nidhiścaiva te sarve śastrapāṇayaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: लोकद्विषं प्रति क्रुद्धा भण्डं चण्डपराक्रमम् । शक्रादयश्च विष्म्वन्ता दश दिक्चक्रनायकाः
verses.transliteration: lokadviṣaṃ prati kruddhā bhaṇḍaṃ caṇḍaparākramam / śakrādayaśca viṣmvantā daśa dikcakranāyakāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिरूपास्तत्र पर्वण्यधस्तात्कृतसंश्रयाः । वज्रे शक्तिं कालदण्डमकिं पाशं ध्वजं तथा
verses.transliteration: śaktirūpāstatra parvaṇyadhastātkṛtasaṃśrayāḥ / vajre śaktiṃ kāladaṇḍamakiṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā

verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: गदां त्रिशूलं दर्भास्त्रं वज्रं च दधतस्त्वमी । सेवन्ते मन्त्रिनाथां तां नित्यं भक्तिसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: gadāṃ triśūlaṃ darbhāstraṃ vajraṃ ca dadhatastvamī / sevante mantrināthāṃ tāṃ nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: भण्डासुरान्दुर्दुरूढान्निहन्तुं विश्वकण्टकान् । मन्त्रिनाथाश्रयद्वारा ललिताज्ञापनोत्सुकाः
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍāsurāndurdurūḍhānnihantuṃ viśvakaṇṭakān / mantrināthāśrayadvārā lalitājñāpanotsukāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: गीतिचक्ररथोपान्ते दिक्पालाः संश्रयं ददुः । सर्वेषां चैव देवानां मन्त्रिणी द्वारतः कृता
verses.transliteration: gīticakrarathopānte dikpālāḥ saṃśrayaṃ daduḥ / sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ mantriṇī dvārataḥ kṛtā
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञापना महादेव्याः कार्यसिद्धिं प्रयच्छति । राक्षी विज्ञापना चेति प्रधानद्वारतः कृता
verses.transliteration: vijñāpanā mahādevyāḥ kāryasiddhiṃ prayacchati / rākṣī vijñāpanā ceti pradhānadvārataḥ kṛtā
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: यथा खलु फलप्राप्तिः सेवकानां हि जायते । अन्यथा कथमेतेषां सामर्थ्यं ज्वलितौजसः
verses.transliteration: yathā khalu phalaprāptiḥ sevakānāṃ hi jāyate / anyathā kathameteṣāṃ sāmarthyaṃ jvalitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: अपधृष्यप्रभावायाः श्रीदेव्या उपसर्पणे । सा हि संगीतविद्येति श्रीदेव्या अतिवल्लभा
verses.transliteration: apadhṛṣyaprabhāvāyāḥ śrīdevyā upasarpaṇe / sā hi saṃgītavidyeti śrīdevyā ativallabhā
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: नातिलङ्घति च क्वापि तदुक्तं कार्यसिद्धिषु । श्रीदेव्याःशक्तिसाम्राज्ये सर्वकर्माणि मन्त्रिणी
verses.transliteration: nātilaṅghati ca kvāpi taduktaṃ kāryasiddhiṣu / śrīdevyāḥśaktisāmrājye sarvakarmāṇi mantriṇī
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: अकर्त्तुमन्यथा कर्तुं कर्तुं चैव प्रगल्भते । तस्मात्सर्वे ऽपि दिक्पालाः श्रीदेव्या जयकाङ्क्षिणः । तस्याः प्रधानभूतायाः सेवामेव वितन्वते
verses.transliteration: akarttumanyathā kartuṃ kartuṃ caiva pragalbhate / tasmātsarve 'pi dikpālāḥ śrīdevyā jayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ / tasyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyāḥ sevāmeva vitanvate
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीललितादेव्याश्चक्रराजरथोत्तमे । पर्वस्थितानां देवीनां नामानि कथितान्यलम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīlalitādevyāścakrarājarathottame / parvasthitānāṃ devīnāṃ nāmāni kathitānyalam
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: भण्डासुरस्य संहारे तस्या दिव्यायुधान्यपि । प्रोक्तानि गेयचक्रस्य पर्वदेव्याश्च कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍāsurasya saṃhāre tasyā divyāyudhānyapi / proktāni geyacakrasya parvadevyāśca kīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: इमानि सर्वदेवीनां नामान्याकर्णयन्ति ये । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते स्युर्विजयिनो नराः
verses.transliteration: imāni sarvadevīnāṃ nāmānyākarṇayanti ye / sarvapāpavinirmuktāste syurvijayino narāḥ
verses.translation: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of appeals etc. to Lalita and the functions of Mantrinu

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपख्याने श्रीचक्रराजरथज्ञेयचक्ररथपर्वस्थदेवतानामप्रकाशनं नामैकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः हयग्रीव उवाच किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य पञ्चपर्वसमाश्रिताः । देवताश्च शृणु प्राज्ञ नाम यच्छृण्वतां जयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopakhyāne śrīcakrarājarathajñeyacakrarathaparvasthadevatānāmaprakāśanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ hayagrīva uvāca kiricakrarathendrasya pañcaparvasamāśritāḥ / devatāśca śṛṇu prājña nāma yacchṛṇvatāṃ jayaḥ
verses.translation: "O intelligent one, listen to the deities stationed in the five steps ofthe prominent chariot Kiricakra' ( Boar-wheeled). Victory to those who listen to their names.
verses.wordMeaning: "O intelligent one, listen to the deities stationed in the five steps ofthe prominent chariot Kiricakra' ( Boar-wheeled). Victory to those who listen to their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O intelligent one, listen to the deities stationed in the five steps ofthe prominent chariot Kiricakra' ( Boar-wheeled). Victory to those who listen to their names.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं पर्वबिन्द्वाख्यं संप्राप्ता दण्डनायिका । सा तत्र जगदुद्दण्डकण्टकव्रातघस्मरी
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ parvabindvākhyaṃ saṃprāptā daṇḍanāyikā / sā tatra jagaduddaṇḍakaṇṭakavrātaghasmarī
verses.translation: Five deities beginning with AndhinI were station- ed on the third step of the excellent leading chariot Kiricakra. They had fixed their base in the Devlyantra. They appeared to split the three worlds by means of their boisterous laughter. They appeared like the flames of fire which burns the uni- verse at the end of the world and which had assumed the guise ofwoman. With their tongues lolling and licking the sides, they were desirous oflapping up the flowing blood of all the soldiers of Bhandasura. They were dazzling in their brilliance. Thus they used to serve Danarfatha of terrific exploits, continuously.
verses.wordMeaning: Five deities beginning with AndhinI were station- ed on the third step of the excellent leading chariot Kiricakra. They had fixed their base in the Devlyantra. They appeared to split the three worlds by means of their boisterous laughter.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Five deities beginning with AndhinI were station- ed on the third step of the excellent leading chariot Kiricakra. They had fixed their base in the Devlyantra. They appeared to split the three worlds by means of their boisterous laughter.…

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधाभिर्ज्वालाभिर्नर्तयन्ती जयश्रियम्
verses.transliteration: nānāvidhābhirjvālābhirnartayantī jayaśriyam
verses.translation: The royal vehicle of Dandanatha, a buffalo of dusky white colour, was always stationed on the left side of those deities on the same step.
verses.wordMeaning: The royal vehicle of Dandanatha, a buffalo of dusky white colour, was always stationed on the left side of those deities on the same step.
verses.commentary: Sense: The royal vehicle of Dandanatha, a buffalo of dusky white colour, was always stationed on the left side of those deities on the same step.

verses.sanskrit: उद्दण्डपोत्रनिर्घातनिर्भिन्नोद्धतदानवाः । दंष्ट्राबालमृगाङ्कांशुविभावनविभावरी
verses.transliteration: uddaṇḍapotranirghātanirbhinnoddhatadānavāḥ / daṃṣṭrābālamṛgāṅkāṃśuvibhāvanavibhāvarī
verses.translation: Mitras, Gandharvas, who were always experts in singing and whose wellknown leaders were Visvavasu and others; other Bhutaganas (groups of goblins), Varuna, Vasus, Vidyadharas, Kinnaras, M arutesvara (wind-god), Citraratha, chariot-makers, artisans, Tumburu, Narada, Yaksa, Soma, Yaksesvara (Kubera), lord Govinda the consort of Kamala, along with Dcvas, Tsana who is terrible due to his trident and who is the devourer of the universe, Brahma, Asvinlputras who were efficient in the science of Medicine, lord Dhanvantari and other Gananayakas (leaders ofGanas) who had gratified bees by means of ichor exuding from their excellent temples (were stationed there).
verses.wordMeaning: Mitras, Gandharvas, who were always experts in singing and whose wellknown leaders were Visvavasu and others; other Bhutaganas (groups of goblins), Varuna, Vasus, Vidyadharas, Kinnaras, M arutesvara (wind-god), Citraratha, chariot-makers, artisans, Tumburu, Narada, Yaksa, Soma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mitras, Gandharvas, who were always experts in singing and whose wellknown leaders were Visvavasu and others; other Bhutaganas (groups of goblins), Varuna, Vasus, Vidyadharas, Kinnaras, M arutesvara (wind-god), Citraratha, chariot-makers, artisans, Tumburu, Narada, Yaksa, Soma,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रावृषेण्यपयोवाहव्यूहनीलवपुर्ल्लता । किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य सालङ्कारायते सदा । पोत्रिणी पुत्रिताशेषविश्वावर्तकदंबिका
verses.transliteration: prāvṛṣeṇyapayovāhavyūhanīlavapurllatā / kiricakrarathendrasya sālaṅkārāyate sadā / potriṇī putritāśeṣaviśvāvartakadaṃbikā
verses.translation: Then, near those boar-faced deities was station- ed the vehicle ofDandinl, a black antelope. It was as a conven- tional custom (that the antelope stood there). The (space
