verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव रथनाभस्य द्वितीयं पर्व संश्रिताः । जृंभिनी मोहिनी चैव स्तंभिनी तिस्र एव हि । उत्फुल्लदाडिमीप्रख्यं सर्वदानवमर्दनाः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva rathanābhasya dvitīyaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ / jṛṃbhinī mohinī caiva staṃbhinī tisra eva hi / utphulladāḍimīprakhyaṃ sarvadānavamardanāḥ
verses.translation: They were the excellent and great Bhairavas wellknown for their profound exploits. By the enkindled splendour of their weapons, they surpassed even the sun by day.
verses.wordMeaning: They were the excellent and great Bhairavas wellknown for their profound exploits. By the enkindled splendour of their weapons, they surpassed even the sun by day.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the excellent and great Bhairavas wellknown for their profound exploits. By the enkindled splendour of their weapons, they surpassed even the sun by day.

verses.sanskrit: मुसलं च हलं हालापात्रं मणिगणर्पितम् । ज्वलन्माणिक्यवलयैर्बि भ्राणाः पाणिपल्लवैः
verses.transliteration: musalaṃ ca halaṃ hālāpātraṃ maṇigaṇarpitam / jvalanmāṇikyavalayairbi bhrāṇāḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the deities of (the chariot) Kiricakra of Dandanatha beginning with Jrmbhini and ending with
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the deities of (the chariot) Kiricakra of Dandanatha beginning with Jrmbhini and ending with
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the deities of (the chariot) Kiricakra of Dandanatha beginning with Jrmbhini and ending with

verses.sanskrit: अतितीक्ष्णकरालाक्ष्यो ज्वालाभिर्दैत्यसैनिकान् । दहन्त्य इव निःशङ्कं सेवन्ते सूकराननाम्
verses.transliteration: atitīkṣṇakarālākṣyo jvālābhirdaityasainikān / dahantya iva niḥśaṅkaṃ sevante sūkarānanām
verses.translation: There in the battle, many Danavas would be killed by the groups of deities stationed there. Showers of blood would be drunk by them.
verses.wordMeaning: There in the battle, many Danavas would be killed by the groups of deities stationed there. Showers of blood would be drunk by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: There in the battle, many Danavas would be killed by the groups of deities stationed there. Showers of blood would be drunk by them.

verses.sanskrit: किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य तृतीयं पर्व संश्रिताः । अन्धिन्याद्याः पञ्च देव्यो देवीयन्त्रकृतास्पदाः
verses.transliteration: kiricakrarathendrasya tṛtīyaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ / andhinyādyāḥ pañca devyo devīyantrakṛtāspadāḥ
verses.translation: Thus Kiricakra the excellent chariot of Dandanetrl, with diverse protective devices through the groups of deities stationed on the steps, moved ahead.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Kiricakra the excellent chariot of Dandanetrl, with diverse protective devices through the groups of deities stationed on the steps, moved ahead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Kiricakra the excellent chariot of Dandanetrl, with diverse protective devices through the groups of deities stationed on the steps, moved ahead.

verses.sanskrit: कठोरेणाट्टहासेन भिन्दन्त्यो भुवनत्रयम् । ज्वाला इव तु कल्पग्नेरङ्गनावेषमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: kaṭhoreṇāṭṭahāsena bhindantyo bhuvanatrayam / jvālā iva tu kalpagneraṅganāveṣamāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Wherever the chariot Cakraraja went the excellent chariot Goya also went; wherever the chariot Geya (pro- ceeded) the excellent chariot Kiricakra also accompanied it.
verses.wordMeaning: Wherever the chariot Cakraraja went the excellent chariot Goya also went; wherever the chariot Geya (pro- ceeded) the excellent chariot Kiricakra also accompanied it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever the chariot Cakraraja went the excellent chariot Goya also went; wherever the chariot Geya (pro- ceeded) the excellent chariot Kiricakra also accompanied it.

verses.sanskrit: भण्डासुरस्य सर्वेषां सैन्यानां रुधिरप्लुतिम् । लिलिक्षमाणा जिह्वाभिर्लेलिहानाभिरुज्ज्वलाः
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍāsurasya sarveṣāṃ sainyānāṃ rudhiraplutim / lilikṣamāṇā jihvābhirlelihānābhirujjvalāḥ
verses.translation: In the midst of thousands of the armies of Sakti, these three splendid chariots that appeared like the three worlds set in motion, proceeded on and on.
verses.wordMeaning: In the midst of thousands of the armies of Sakti, these three splendid chariots that appeared like the three worlds set in motion, proceeded on and on.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the midst of thousands of the armies of Sakti, these three splendid chariots that appeared like the three worlds set in motion, proceeded on and on.

verses.sanskrit: सेवन्तें सततं दण्डनाथामुद्दण्डविक्रमाम् । किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य चतुर्थं पर्व संश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: sevanteṃ satataṃ daṇḍanāthāmuddaṇḍavikramām / kiricakrarathendrasya caturthaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ
verses.translation: It appeared as though (the mountains) Mcru, Mandara and Vindhya had joined together as one unit.
verses.wordMeaning: It appeared as though (the mountains) Mcru, Mandara and Vindhya had joined together as one unit.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appeared as though (the mountains) Mcru, Mandara and Vindhya had joined together as one unit.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माद्याः पञ्चमीवर्ज्या अष्टमीरवर्जिता अपि । षडेव देव्यः षट्चक्रज्वलज्ज्वालाकलेवराः
verses.transliteration: brahmādyāḥ pañcamīvarjyā aṣṭamīravarjitā api / ṣaḍeva devyaḥ ṣaṭcakrajvalajjvālākalevarāḥ
verses.translation: A great umbrella studded with pearls and having an extent often Yojanas was present only in the chariot of Lalitesan! and nowhere else (not in the other chariots).
verses.wordMeaning: A great umbrella studded with pearls and having an extent often Yojanas was present only in the chariot of Lalitesan! and nowhere else (not in the other chariots).
verses.commentary: Sense: A great umbrella studded with pearls and having an extent often Yojanas was present only in the chariot of Lalitesan! and nowhere else (not in the other chariots).

verses.sanskrit: महता विक्रमौघेण विबन्त्य इव दानवान् । आज्ञया दण्डनाथायास्तं प्रदेशमुपासते
verses.transliteration: mahatā vikramaugheṇa vibantya iva dānavān / ājñayā daṇḍanāthāyāstaṃ pradeśamupāsate
verses.translation: This alone has been glorified as indicative of the imperial power of Sakti. Ordinary umbrellas were provided in the other two chariots.
verses.wordMeaning: This alone has been glorified as indicative of the imperial power of Sakti. Ordinary umbrellas were provided in the other two chariots.
verses.commentary: Sense: This alone has been glorified as indicative of the imperial power of Sakti. Ordinary umbrellas were provided in the other two chariots.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव पर्वणो ऽधस्तात्त्वरिताः स्थानमाश्रिताः । यक्षिणी शङ्खिनी चैव लाकिनी हाकिनी तथा
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva parvaṇo 'dhastāttvaritāḥ sthānamāśritāḥ / yakṣiṇī śaṅkhinī caiva lākinī hākinī tathā
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: शाकिनी डाकिनी चैव तासामैक्यस्वरूपिणी । हाकिनी सप्तमीत्येताश्चण्डदोर्दण्डविक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: śākinī ḍākinī caiva tāsāmaikyasvarūpiṇī / hākinī saptamītyetāścaṇḍadordaṇḍavikramāḥ
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्त्य इव भूतानि पिबन्त्य इव मेदिनीम् । त्वचं रक्तं तथा मांसं मेदो ऽस्थि च विरोधिनाम्
verses.transliteration: pibantya iva bhūtāni pibantya iva medinīm / tvacaṃ raktaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ medo 'sthi ca virodhinām
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: मज्जानमथ शुक्रं च पिबन्तयो विकटाननाः । निष्ठुरैः सिंहनादैश्च पूरयन्त्यो दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: majjānamatha śukraṃ ca pibantayo vikaṭānanāḥ / niṣṭhuraiḥ siṃhanādaiśca pūrayantyo diśo daśa
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: धातुनाथा इति प्रोक्ता अणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धिदाः । मोहने मारणे चैव स्तंभने ताडने तथा
verses.transliteration: dhātunāthā iti proktā aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidāḥ / mohane māraṇe caiva staṃbhane tāḍane tathā
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षणे दुष्टदैत्यानामामूलं च निकृन्तने । पण्डिताः खण्डिताशेषविपदो भक्तिशालिषु
verses.transliteration: bhakṣaṇe duṣṭadaityānāmāmūlaṃ ca nikṛntane / paṇḍitāḥ khaṇḍitāśeṣavipado bhaktiśāliṣu
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: धातुनाथा इतिप्रोक्ताः सर्वधातुषु संस्थिताः । सप्तापि वारिधीनूर्मिमालासंचुंबितांबरान्
verses.transliteration: dhātunāthā itiproktāḥ sarvadhātuṣu saṃsthitāḥ / saptāpi vāridhīnūrmimālāsaṃcuṃbitāṃbarān
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणर्धेनैव निष्पातुं निष्पन्नबहुसाहसाः । शकटा कारदन्ताश्च भयङ्करविलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇardhenaiva niṣpātuṃ niṣpannabahusāhasāḥ / śakaṭā kāradantāśca bhayaṅkaravilocanāḥ
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्वामिनीद्रोहकृतां स्वकीयसमयद्रुहाम् । वैदिकद्रोहणादेव द्रोहिणां वीरवैरिणाम्
verses.transliteration: svasvāminīdrohakṛtāṃ svakīyasamayadruhām / vaidikadrohaṇādeva drohiṇāṃ vīravairiṇām
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.transliteration: kalpāntakāle daṇḍinyā ājñayā viśvaghasmarāḥ / atyudagraprakṛtayo radadaṣṭauṣṭhasaṃpuṭāḥ

verses.sanskrit: चचाल भण्डदेत्यस्य क्षयसिद्ध्यभिकाङ्क्षिणी । शब्दायन्ते दिशः सर्वाः कंपते च वसुंधरा
verses.transliteration: cacāla bhaṇḍadetyasya kṣayasiddhyabhikāṅkṣiṇī / śabdāyante diśaḥ sarvāḥ kaṃpate ca vasuṃdharā
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुभ्यन्ति सर्वभूतानि ललितेशाविनिर्गमे । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्निपेतुः पुष्पवृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: kṣubhyanti sarvabhūtāni laliteśāvinirgame / devadundubhayo nedurnipetuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वावसुप्रभृतयो गन्धर्वाः सुरगायकाः । तुम्बुरुर्नारदश्चैव साक्षादेव सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: viśvāvasuprabhṛtayo gandharvāḥ suragāyakāḥ / tumbururnāradaścaiva sākṣādeva sarasvatī
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: जयमङ्गल पद्यानि पठन्तः पटुगीतिभिः । हर्षसंफुल्लवदनाः स्फुरत्पुलकभूषणाः । मुहुर्जयजयेत्येवं स्तुवाना ललितेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: jayamaṅgala padyāni paṭhantaḥ paṭugītibhiḥ / harṣasaṃphullavadanāḥ sphuratpulakabhūṣaṇāḥ / muhurjayajayetyevaṃ stuvānā laliteśvarīm
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: हर्षेणाढ्या मदोन्मत्ताः प्रनृत्यन्तः पदेपदे । सप्तर्षयो वशिष्ठाद्या ऋग्यजुः सामरूपिभिः
verses.transliteration: harṣeṇāḍhyā madonmattāḥ pranṛtyantaḥ padepade / saptarṣayo vaśiṣṭhādyā ṛgyajuḥ sāmarūpibhiḥ
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: अथर्वरूपैर्मन्त्रैश्च वर्धयन्तो जयश्रियम् । हविषेव महावह्निशिखामत्यन्तपाविनीम्
verses.transliteration: atharvarūpairmantraiśca vardhayanto jayaśriyam / haviṣeva mahāvahniśikhāmatyantapāvinīm
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: आशीर्वादेन महता वर्धयामासुरुत्तमाः । तैः स्तूयमाना ललिता राजमाना रथोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: āśīrvādena mahatā vardhayāmāsuruttamāḥ / taiḥ stūyamānā lalitā rājamānā rathottame
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: भण्डासुरं विनिर्जेतुमुद्दण्डैः सह सैनिकैः
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍāsuraṃ vinirjetumuddaṇḍaiḥ saha sainikaiḥ
verses.translation: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.wordMeaning: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that imperial deity Lalita, the great goddess of all Saktis, the sovereign Deity who had ascended the ruler- ship of a great empire advanced against demon Bhanda with a desire to accomplish his death.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने किरिचक्ररथदेवताप्रकाशनं नाम विंशो ऽध्यायः आकर्ण्य ललितादेव्या यात्रानिगमनिस्वनम् । महान्तं क्षोभमायाता भण्डासुरपुरालयाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne kiricakrarathadevatāprakāśanaṃ nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ākarṇya lalitādevyā yātrānigamanisvanam / mahāntaṃ kṣobhamāyātā bhaṇḍāsurapurālayāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the loud noise ofthe march of goddess Lalita on her campaign (against Bhandasura), those who resided in the city of Bhandasura, became exceedingly agitated.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the loud noise ofthe march of goddess Lalita on her campaign (against Bhandasura), those who resided in the city of Bhandasura, became exceedingly agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the loud noise ofthe march of goddess Lalita on her campaign (against Bhandasura), those who resided in the city of Bhandasura, became exceedingly agitated.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र चास्ति दुराशस्य भण्डदैत्यस्य दुर्धियः । महेन्द्रपर्वतोपान्ते महार्णवतटे पुरम्
verses.transliteration: yatra cāsti durāśasya bhaṇḍadaityasya durdhiyaḥ / mahendraparvatopānte mahārṇavataṭe puram
verses.translation: In that very same city extending over a hundred
verses.wordMeaning: In that very same city extending over a hundred
verses.commentary: Sense: In that very same city extending over a hundred

verses.sanskrit: तत्तु शून्यकनाम्नैव विख्यातं भुवनत्रये । विषङ्गाग्रजदैत्यस्य सदावासः किलाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tattu śūnyakanāmnaiva vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatraye / viṣaṅgāgrajadaityasya sadāvāsaḥ kilābhavat
verses.translation: That entire city of the Asuras extending over a hundred Yojanas became frequently enveloped in smoke, as it were caused by portentous phenomena indicating a great calamity. 1 2
verses.wordMeaning: That entire city of the Asuras extending over a hundred Yojanas became frequently enveloped in smoke, as it were caused by portentous phenomena indicating a great calamity. 1 2
verses.commentary: Sense: That entire city of the Asuras extending over a hundred Yojanas became frequently enveloped in smoke, as it were caused by portentous phenomena indicating a great calamity. 1 2

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नेव पुरे तस्य शतयोजनविस्तरे । वित्रेसुर सुराः सर्वे श्रीदेव्यागमसंभ्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tasminneva pure tasya śatayojanavistare / vitresura surāḥ sarve śrīdevyāgamasaṃbhramāt
verses.translation: The walls in the city ofthat Daitya underwent un- timely cracks. Great meteors hovered round the city and fell down from the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: The walls in the city ofthat Daitya underwent un- timely cracks. Great meteors hovered round the city and fell down from the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: The walls in the city ofthat Daitya underwent un- timely cracks. Great meteors hovered round the city and fell down from the sky.

verses.sanskrit: शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं तत्सर्वं पुरमासुरम् । धूमैरिवावृतमभूदुत्पातजनितैर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ tatsarvaṃ puramāsuram / dhūmairivāvṛtamabhūdutpātajanitairmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Earthquake, the first and foremost among portentous phenomena occurred there in the city af Sunyaka. The entire earth blazed forth.
verses.wordMeaning: Earthquake, the first and foremost among portentous phenomena occurred there in the city af Sunyaka. The entire earth blazed forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Earthquake, the first and foremost among portentous phenomena occurred there in the city af Sunyaka. The entire earth blazed forth.

verses.sanskrit: अकाल एव निर्भिन्ना भित्तयो दैत्यपत्तने । धूर्णमाना पतन्ति स्म महोल्का गगनस्थलात्
verses.transliteration: akāla eva nirbhinnā bhittayo daityapattane / dhūrṇamānā patanti sma maholkā gaganasthalāt
verses.translation: VV. 5-20 describe the evil portents in the city of Sunyaka,.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 5-20 describe the evil portents in the city of Sunyaka,.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 5-20 describe the evil portents in the city of Sunyaka,.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पातानां प्राथमिको भूकंपः पर्यवर्तत । मही जज्वाल सकला तत्र शून्यकपत्तने
verses.transliteration: utpātānāṃ prāthamiko bhūkaṃpaḥ paryavartata / mahī jajvāla sakalā tatra śūnyakapattane
verses.translation: Although the series of those portentous phenomena were intense and dreadful, Bhanda did not lose his courage. He went to the chamber of consultation and deliberation.
verses.wordMeaning: Although the series of those portentous phenomena were intense and dreadful, Bhanda did not lose his courage. He went to the chamber of consultation and deliberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the series of those portentous phenomena were intense and dreadful, Bhanda did not lose his courage. He went to the chamber of consultation and deliberation.

verses.sanskrit: अकाल एव हृत्कंपं भेजुर्दैत्यपुरौकसः । ध्वजाग्रवर्तिनः कङ्कगृध्राश्चैव बकाः खगाः
verses.transliteration: akāla eva hṛtkaṃpaṃ bhejurdaityapuraukasaḥ / dhvajāgravartinaḥ kaṅkagṛdhrāścaiva bakāḥ khagāḥ
verses.translation: The leader of Daityas occupied an excellent throne that had been wonderfully studded with many gems and that appeared to be a piece of the body of Meru (i.e. golden).
verses.wordMeaning: The leader of Daityas occupied an excellent throne that had been wonderfully studded with many gems and that appeared to be a piece of the body of Meru (i.e. golden).
verses.commentary: Sense: The leader of Daityas occupied an excellent throne that had been wonderfully studded with many gems and that appeared to be a piece of the body of Meru (i.e. golden).

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यमण्डले दृष्ट्वादृष्ट्वा चक्रन्दुरुच्चकैः । क्रव्यादा बहवस्तत्र लोचनैर्नावलोकिताः
verses.transliteration: ādityamaṇḍale dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā cakranduruccakaiḥ / kravyādā bahavastatra locanairnāvalokitāḥ
verses.translation: With the thick cluster of rays of the gems and jewels fitted into his shining crown, the lord of Danavas brighten-
verses.wordMeaning: With the thick cluster of rays of the gems and jewels fitted into his shining crown, the lord of Danavas brighten-
verses.commentary: Sense: With the thick cluster of rays of the gems and jewels fitted into his shining crown, the lord of Danavas brighten-

verses.sanskrit: मुहुराकाशवाणीभिः परुषाभिर्बभाषिरे । सर्वतो दिक्षुदृश्यन्ते केतवस्तु मलीमसाः
verses.transliteration: muhurākāśavāṇībhiḥ paruṣābhirbabhāṣire / sarvato dikṣudṛśyante ketavastu malīmasāḥ
verses.translation: They never disobeyed the commands of their elder brother. They enhanced his great reputation acquired by conquering the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: They never disobeyed the commands of their elder brother. They enhanced his great reputation acquired by conquering the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They never disobeyed the commands of their elder brother. They enhanced his great reputation acquired by conquering the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: धूमायमानाः प्रक्षोभजनका दैत्यरक्षसाम् । दैत्यस्त्रीणां च विभ्रष्टा अकाले भूषणस्रजः
verses.transliteration: dhūmāyamānāḥ prakṣobhajanakā daityarakṣasām / daityastrīṇāṃ ca vibhraṣṭā akāle bhūṣaṇasrajaḥ
verses.translation: With their bent down heads, they pressed his foot- rest. After joining the palms together in reverence, they sat on the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: With their bent down heads, they pressed his foot- rest. After joining the palms together in reverence, they sat on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their bent down heads, they pressed his foot- rest. After joining the palms together in reverence, they sat on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: हाहेति दूरं क्रन्दन्त्यः पर्यश्रु समरोदिषुः । दपणानां वर्मणां च ध्वजानां खड्गसंपदाम्
verses.transliteration: hāheti dūraṃ krandantyaḥ paryaśru samarodiṣuḥ / dapaṇānāṃ varmaṇāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ khaḍgasaṃpadām
verses.translation: When that excellent one among the enemies of the Devas was present in the chamber ofaudience, all the vassal kings of Daityas came to see him.
verses.wordMeaning: When that excellent one among the enemies of the Devas was present in the chamber ofaudience, all the vassal kings of Daityas came to see him.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that excellent one among the enemies of the Devas was present in the chamber ofaudience, all the vassal kings of Daityas came to see him.

verses.sanskrit: मणीनामंबराणां च मालिन्यमभवन्मुहुः । सौधेषु चन्द्रशालासु केलिवेश्मसु सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: maṇīnāmaṃbarāṇāṃ ca mālinyamabhavanmuhuḥ / saudheṣu candraśālāsu keliveśmasu sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Each ofthem had countless armies. Declaring their own respective names, they bowed down to Bhanda, the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: Each ofthem had countless armies. Declaring their own respective names, they bowed down to Bhanda, the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Each ofthem had countless armies. Declaring their own respective names, they bowed down to Bhanda, the lord.

verses.sanskrit: अट्टालकेषु गोष्ठेषु विपणेषु सभासु च । चतुष्किकास्वलिङ्गेषु प्रग्रीवेषु वलेषु च
verses.transliteration: aṭṭālakeṣu goṣṭheṣu vipaṇeṣu sabhāsu ca / catuṣkikāsvaliṅgeṣu pragrīveṣu valeṣu ca
verses.translation: He honoured all those Asuras with benign look with steady pupils and remained thus for a while.
verses.wordMeaning: He honoured all those Asuras with benign look with steady pupils and remained thus for a while.
verses.commentary: Sense: He honoured all those Asuras with benign look with steady pupils and remained thus for a while.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतोभद्रवासेषु नन्द्यावर्तेषु वेश्मसु । विच्छन्दकेषु संक्षुब्धेष्ववरोधनपालिषु । स्वस्तिकेषु च सर्वेषु गर्भागारपुटेषु च
verses.transliteration: sarvatobhadravāseṣu nandyāvarteṣu veśmasu / vicchandakeṣu saṃkṣubdheṣvavarodhanapāliṣu / svastikeṣu ca sarveṣu garbhāgārapuṭeṣu ca
verses.translation: From that god of fire, a certain woman has cropp- ed up. She is proud of her strength. The Devas themselves beginning with Vasava, have created her.
verses.wordMeaning: From that god of fire, a certain woman has cropp- ed up. She is proud of her strength. The Devas themselves beginning with Vasava, have created her.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that god of fire, a certain woman has cropp- ed up. She is proud of her strength. The Devas themselves beginning with Vasava, have created her.

verses.sanskrit: गोपुरेषु कपाटेषु वलभीनां च सीमसु । वातायनेषु कक्ष्यासु धिष्ण्येषु च खलेषु च
verses.transliteration: gopureṣu kapāṭeṣu valabhīnāṃ ca sīmasu / vātāyaneṣu kakṣyāsu dhiṣṇyeṣu ca khaleṣu ca
verses.translation: Is this not ridiculous? Is this not shameful? They must be afraid of even those soldiers who will fight from the front line of our forces.
verses.wordMeaning: Is this not ridiculous? Is this not shameful? They must be afraid of even those soldiers who will fight from the front line of our forces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Is this not ridiculous? Is this not shameful? They must be afraid of even those soldiers who will fight from the front line of our forces.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र दैत्य नगरवासिभिर्जनमण्डलैः । अश्रूयन्त महाघोषाः परुषा भूतभाषिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvatra daitya nagaravāsibhirjanamaṇḍalaiḥ / aśrūyanta mahāghoṣāḥ paruṣā bhūtabhāṣitāḥ
verses.translation: What need one say ofVisnu? That Mahesvara too has become frightened. There is nothing to be mentioned of others. All those guardians of quarters have fled.
verses.wordMeaning: What need one say ofVisnu? That Mahesvara too has become frightened. There is nothing to be mentioned of others. All those guardians of quarters have fled.
verses.commentary: Sense: What need one say ofVisnu? That Mahesvara too has become frightened. There is nothing to be mentioned of others. All those guardians of quarters have fled.

verses.sanskrit: शिथिली सवतो जाता घोरपर्णा भयानका । करटैः कटुकालापैर्वलोकि दिवाकरः । आराविषु करोटीनां कोटयश्चापतन्भुवि
verses.transliteration: śithilī savato jātā ghoraparṇā bhayānakā / karaṭaiḥ kaṭukālāpairvaloki divākaraḥ / ārāviṣu karoṭīnāṃ koṭayaścāpatanbhuvi
verses.translation: The proud and conceited Devas have been hit by our sharp and invisible arrows that have fallen on their limbs. Their coats of mail have been hit and pierced.
verses.wordMeaning: The proud and conceited Devas have been hit by our sharp and invisible arrows that have fallen on their limbs. Their coats of mail have been hit and pierced.
verses.commentary: Sense: The proud and conceited Devas have been hit by our sharp and invisible arrows that have fallen on their limbs. Their coats of mail have been hit and pierced.

verses.sanskrit: अपतन्वेदिमध्येषु बिन्दवः शोणितांभसाम् । केशौघकाश्च निष्पेतुः सर्वतो धूमधूसराः
verses.transliteration: apatanvedimadhyeṣu bindavaḥ śoṇitāṃbhasām / keśaughakāśca niṣpetuḥ sarvato dhūmadhūsarāḥ
verses.translation: Despite the fact that we are endowed with such great valour and such powerful arms, a mere woman is rush- ing against us to conquer us.
verses.wordMeaning: Despite the fact that we are endowed with such great valour and such powerful arms, a mere woman is rush- ing against us to conquer us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Despite the fact that we are endowed with such great valour and such powerful arms, a mere woman is rush- ing against us to conquer us.

verses.sanskrit: भौमान्तरिक्षदिव्यानामुत्पातानामिति व्रजम् । अवलोक्य भृशं त्रस्ताः सर्वे नगरवासिनः । निवेदयामासुरमी भण्डाय प्रथितौजसे
verses.transliteration: bhaumāntarikṣadivyānāmutpātānāmiti vrajam / avalokya bhṛśaṃ trastāḥ sarve nagaravāsinaḥ / nivedayāmāsuramī bhaṇḍāya prathitaujase
verses.translation: Hence, servants should be despatched to drive her out. That proud and puffed up woman should be brought dragging her by her tresses.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, servants should be despatched to drive her out. That proud and puffed up woman should be brought dragging her by her tresses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, servants should be despatched to drive her out. That proud and puffed up woman should be brought dragging her by her tresses.

verses.sanskrit: स च भण्डः प्रचण्डोत्थैस्तैरुत्पातकदंबकैः । असंजातधृतिभ्रंशो मन्त्र स्थानमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: sa ca bhaṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍotthaistairutpātakadaṃbakaiḥ / asaṃjātadhṛtibhraṃśo mantra sthānamupāgamat
verses.translation: O Lord, that wicked woman shall after sometime take up the work of a slave unto the fawn-eyed ladies staying in your harem.
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, that wicked woman shall after sometime take up the work of a slave unto the fawn-eyed ladies staying in your harem.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, that wicked woman shall after sometime take up the work of a slave unto the fawn-eyed ladies staying in your harem.

verses.sanskrit: मेरोरिव वपुर्भेदं बहुरत्नविचित्रितम् । अध्यासामास दैत्येन्द्रः सिंहासनमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: meroriva vapurbhedaṃ bahuratnavicitritam / adhyāsāmāsa daityendraḥ siṃhāsanamanuttamam
verses.translation: Our enemies are afraid of each and every individual soldier in our armies. Indeed, the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings 'are frightened.
verses.wordMeaning: Our enemies are afraid of each and every individual soldier in our armies. Indeed, the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings 'are frightened.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our enemies are afraid of each and every individual soldier in our armies. Indeed, the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings 'are frightened.

verses.sanskrit: स्फुरन्मुकुटलग्नानां रत्नानां किरणैर्घनैः । दीपयन्नखिलाशान्तानद्युतद्दानवेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sphuranmukuṭalagnānāṃ ratnānāṃ kiraṇairghanaiḥ / dīpayannakhilāśāntānadyutaddānaveśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "O Lord, O suppressor of enemies, you alone know
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, O suppressor of enemies, you alone know
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, O suppressor of enemies, you alone know

verses.sanskrit: एकयोजनविस्तारे महत्यास्थानमण्डपे । तुङ्गसिंहासनस्थं तं सिषेवाते तदानुजै
verses.transliteration: ekayojanavistāre mahatyāsthānamaṇḍape / tuṅgasiṃhāsanasthaṃ taṃ siṣevāte tadānujai
verses.translation: Every action should be carried out after due delibe- ration. Careful thought is the ultimate course. If any work is pursued without thought, it will destroy one at the very root.
verses.wordMeaning: Every action should be carried out after due delibe- ration. Careful thought is the ultimate course. If any work is pursued without thought, it will destroy one at the very root.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every action should be carried out after due delibe- ration. Careful thought is the ultimate course. If any work is pursued without thought, it will destroy one at the very root.

verses.sanskrit: विशुक्रश्च विषङ्गश्च महाबलपराक्रमौ । त्रैलोक्यकण्टकीभूतभुजदण्डभयङ्करौ
verses.transliteration: viśukraśca viṣaṅgaśca mahābalaparākramau / trailokyakaṇṭakībhūtabhujadaṇḍabhayaṅkarau
verses.translation: Spies should be carefully sent to the enemy-camp and their strong and weak positions should be understood by one who wishes to achieve victory.
verses.wordMeaning: Spies should be carefully sent to the enemy-camp and their strong and weak positions should be understood by one who wishes to achieve victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Spies should be carefully sent to the enemy-camp and their strong and weak positions should be understood by one who wishes to achieve victory.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रजस्य सदैवाज्ञामविलङ्घ्य मुहुर्मुहुः । त्रैलोक्यविजये लब्धं वर्धयन्तौ महद्यशः
verses.transliteration: agrajasya sadaivājñāmavilaṅghya muhurmuhuḥ / trailokyavijaye labdhaṃ vardhayantau mahadyaśaḥ
verses.translation: An undertaking without proper reasoning and -deliberation causes loss and ruin. That carried out after due deliberation is conducive to pre-eminent victory.
verses.wordMeaning: An undertaking without proper reasoning and -deliberation causes loss and ruin. That carried out after due deliberation is conducive to pre-eminent victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: An undertaking without proper reasoning and -deliberation causes loss and ruin. That carried out after due deliberation is conducive to pre-eminent victory.

verses.sanskrit: न तेन शिरसा तस्य मृदूनन्तौ पादपीठिकाम् । कृतां जरिप्रणामौ च समुपाविशता भुवि
verses.transliteration: na tena śirasā tasya mṛdūnantau pādapīṭhikām / kṛtāṃ jaripraṇāmau ca samupāviśatā bhuvi
verses.translation: Indifference or disregard in the case ofenemies should not be indulged in by kings thinking them to be mere animals or women or insignificant one. It is sure that power exists in everyone.
verses.wordMeaning: Indifference or disregard in the case ofenemies should not be indulged in by kings thinking them to be mere animals or women or insignificant one. It is sure that power exists in everyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indifference or disregard in the case ofenemies should not be indulged in by kings thinking them to be mere animals or women or insignificant one. It is sure that power exists in everyone.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्थाने स्थिते तस्मिन्नमरद्वेषिणां वरे । सर्वे सामन्तदैत्येन्द्रास्तं द्रष्टुं समुपागताः
verses.transliteration: athāsthāne sthite tasminnamaradveṣiṇāṃ vare / sarve sāmantadaityendrāstaṃ draṣṭuṃ samupāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Hiranyakasipu, the lord of all living beings, was killed by a certain spirit that had assumed a body partially of a man and partially of an animal and that had manifested himself out of a pillar.
verses.wordMeaning: Hiranyakasipu, the lord of all living beings, was killed by a certain spirit that had assumed a body partially of a man and partially of an animal and that had manifested himself out of a pillar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyakasipu, the lord of all living beings, was killed by a certain spirit that had assumed a body partially of a man and partially of an animal and that had manifested himself out of a pillar.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामे कैकसैन्यानां गणना न हि विद्यते । स्वंस्वं नाम समुच्चार्य प्रणेमुर्भण्डकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāme kaikasainyānāṃ gaṇanā na hi vidyate / svaṃsvaṃ nāma samuccārya praṇemurbhaṇḍakeśvaram
verses.translation: Formerly, a woman Candika, a manifestation of Maya, had killed Mahisa, Sumbha and Nisumbha in the battlefield.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, a woman Candika, a manifestation of Maya, had killed Mahisa, Sumbha and Nisumbha in the battlefield.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, a woman Candika, a manifestation of Maya, had killed Mahisa, Sumbha and Nisumbha in the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: म च तानसुरान्सर्वानतिधीरकनीनकैः । संभावयन्समालोकैः कियन्तं चित्क्षणं स्थितः
verses.transliteration: ma ca tānasurānsarvānatidhīrakanīnakaiḥ / saṃbhāvayansamālokaiḥ kiyantaṃ citkṣaṇaṃ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: In that battle many Daityas had been destroyed by her. Hence, I say that no indifference should be shown in the case ofany woman.
verses.wordMeaning: In that battle many Daityas had been destroyed by her. Hence, I say that no indifference should be shown in the case ofany woman.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that battle many Daityas had been destroyed by her. Hence, I say that no indifference should be shown in the case ofany woman.

verses.sanskrit: अवोचत विशुक्रस्तमग्रजं दानवेश्वरम् । मथ्यमानमहासिंधुसमानार्गलनिस्वनः
verses.transliteration: avocata viśukrastamagrajaṃ dānaveśvaram / mathyamānamahāsiṃdhusamānārgalanisvanaḥ
verses.translation: Foolish ladies do not know anything. In vain do they imagine that they are bold and adventurous. Confused in
verses.wordMeaning: Foolish ladies do not know anything. In vain do they imagine that they are bold and adventurous. Confused in
verses.commentary: Sense: Foolish ladies do not know anything. In vain do they imagine that they are bold and adventurous. Confused in

verses.sanskrit: देवत्वदीयदोर्द्दण्डविध्वस्तबलविक्रमाः । पापिनः पामराचारा दुरात्मानः सुराधमाः
verses.transliteration: devatvadīyadorddaṇḍavidhvastabalavikramāḥ / pāpinaḥ pāmarācārā durātmānaḥ surādhamāḥ
verses.translation: Or the generals in my armies who are proud and confident of their ability in war will pound and smash the enemies as though they were ripe cucumbers.
verses.wordMeaning: Or the generals in my armies who are proud and confident of their ability in war will pound and smash the enemies as though they were ripe cucumbers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the generals in my armies who are proud and confident of their ability in war will pound and smash the enemies as though they were ripe cucumbers.

verses.sanskrit: शरण्यमन्यतः क्वापि नाप्नुवन्तो विषादिनः । ज्वलज्ज्वालाकुले वह्नौ पतित्वा नाशमागताः
verses.transliteration: śaraṇyamanyataḥ kvāpi nāpnuvanto viṣādinaḥ / jvalajjvālākule vahnau patitvā nāśamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: All of them in her battle-field exhibit their magi- cal illusory power of Maya. But our soldiers take delight in Mahamaya (greater Maya). They will make their army reduced to ashes.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them in her battle-field exhibit their magi- cal illusory power of Maya. But our soldiers take delight in Mahamaya (greater Maya). They will make their army reduced to ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them in her battle-field exhibit their magi- cal illusory power of Maya. But our soldiers take delight in Mahamaya (greater Maya). They will make their army reduced to ashes.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्देवात्समुत्पन्ना काचित्स्त्री बलगर्विता । स्वयमेव किलास्राक्षुस्तां देवा वासवादयः
verses.transliteration: tasmāddevātsamutpannā kācitstrī balagarvitā / svayameva kilāsrākṣustāṃ devā vāsavādayaḥ
verses.translation: Post the soldiers at all the entrances all round the city of Sunyaka. Fortify all the. fortresses. Make arrangements for fixing hundreds of Ksepanikas (slings and similar instru- ments to discharge missiles).
verses.wordMeaning: Post the soldiers at all the entrances all round the city of Sunyaka. Fortify all the. fortresses. Make arrangements for fixing hundreds of Ksepanikas (slings and similar instru- ments to discharge missiles).
verses.commentary: Sense: Post the soldiers at all the entrances all round the city of Sunyaka. Fortify all the. fortresses. Make arrangements for fixing hundreds of Ksepanikas (slings and similar instru- ments to discharge missiles).

verses.sanskrit: तैः पुनः प्रबलोत्साहैः प्रोत्साहितपराक्रमाः । बहुस्त्रीपरिवाराश्च विविधायुधमण्डिताः
verses.transliteration: taiḥ punaḥ prabalotsāhaiḥ protsāhitaparākramāḥ / bahustrīparivārāśca vividhāyudhamaṇḍitāḥ
verses.translation: Arrangements should be made by ministers and priests for evil rites of Black magic. Equip yourself fully with weapons and missiles. The war is imminent.
verses.wordMeaning: Arrangements should be made by ministers and priests for evil rites of Black magic. Equip yourself fully with weapons and missiles. The war is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arrangements should be made by ministers and priests for evil rites of Black magic. Equip yourself fully with weapons and missiles. The war is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माञ्जेतुं किलायान्ति हा कष्टं विधिवैशसम् । अबलानां समूहस्छेद्बलिनो ऽस्मान्विजेष्यते
verses.transliteration: asmāñjetuṃ kilāyānti hā kaṣṭaṃ vidhivaiśasam / abalānāṃ samūhaschedbalino 'smānvijeṣyate
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: तर्हि पल्लवभङ्गेन पाषाणस्य विदारणम् । ऊह्यमानमिदं हन्तुं परिहासाय कल्प्यते
verses.transliteration: tarhi pallavabhaṅgena pāṣāṇasya vidāraṇam / ūhyamānamidaṃ hantuṃ parihāsāya kalpyate
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: विडंबना न किमसौ लज्जाकरमिदं न किम् । अस्मत्सैनिकनासीरभटेभ्यो ऽपि भवेद्भयम्
verses.transliteration: viḍaṃbanā na kimasau lajjākaramidaṃ na kim / asmatsainikanāsīrabhaṭebhyo 'pi bhavedbhayam
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: कातरत्वं समापन्नाः शक्राद्यास्त्रिदिवौकसः । ब्रह्मादयश्च निर्विण्णविग्रहा मद्बलायुधैः
verses.transliteration: kātaratvaṃ samāpannāḥ śakrādyāstridivaukasaḥ / brahmādayaśca nirviṇṇavigrahā madbalāyudhaiḥ
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोश्च का कथैवास्ते वित्रस्तः स महेश्वरः । अन्येषामिह का वार्ता दिक्पालास्ते पलायिताः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇośca kā kathaivāste vitrastaḥ sa maheśvaraḥ / anyeṣāmiha kā vārtā dikpālāste palāyitāḥ
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमिषुभिस्तीक्ष्णैरदृश्यैरङ्गपातिभिः । सर्वत्र विद्धवर्माणो दुर्मदा विबुधाः कृताः
verses.transliteration: asmākamiṣubhistīkṣṇairadṛśyairaṅgapātibhiḥ / sarvatra viddhavarmāṇo durmadā vibudhāḥ kṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशानामपि महापराक्रमभुजोष्मणाम् । अस्माकंविजयायाद्य स्त्री काचिदभिधावति
verses.transliteration: tādṛśānāmapi mahāparākramabhujoṣmaṇām / asmākaṃvijayāyādya strī kācidabhidhāvati
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यपि स्त्री तथाप्येषा नावमान्या कदाचन । अल्पो ऽपि रिपुरात्मज्ञैर्नावमान्यो जिगीषुभिः
verses.transliteration: yadyapi strī tathāpyeṣā nāvamānyā kadācana / alpo 'pi ripurātmajñairnāvamānyo jigīṣubhiḥ
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तदुत्सारणार्थं प्रेषणीयास्तु किङ्कराः । सकचग्रहमाकृष्य सानेतव्या मदोद्धता
verses.transliteration: tasmāttadutsāraṇārthaṃ preṣaṇīyāstu kiṅkarāḥ / sakacagrahamākṛṣya sānetavyā madoddhatā
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: देव त्वदीय शुद्धान्तर्वर्तिनीनां मृगीदृशाम् । चिरेण चेटिकाभावं सा दुष्टा संश्रयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: deva tvadīya śuddhāntarvartinīnāṃ mṛgīdṛśām / cireṇa ceṭikābhāvaṃ sā duṣṭā saṃśrayiṣyati
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकस्माद्भटादस्मात्सैन्येषु परिपन्थिनः । शङ्कते खलु वित्रस्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: ekaikasmādbhaṭādasmātsainyeṣu paripanthinaḥ / śaṅkate khalu vitrastaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यद्देवस्य चित्तं तु प्रमाणमिति दानव । निवेद्य भण्डदैत्यस्य क्रोधं तस्य व्यवीवृधत्
verses.transliteration: anyaddevasya cittaṃ tu pramāṇamiti dānava / nivedya bhaṇḍadaityasya krodhaṃ tasya vyavīvṛdhat
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: विषङ्गस्तु महासत्त्वो विचारज्ञो विचक्षणः । इदमाह महादैत्यमग्रजन्मानमुद्धतम्
verses.transliteration: viṣaṅgastu mahāsattvo vicārajño vicakṣaṇaḥ / idamāha mahādaityamagrajanmānamuddhatam
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.translation: One of them covered himself with a coat of mail wonderfully studded with gems and jewels of various kinds and colours. He shone like a mobile lofty Rohana mountain (Adam's peak in Ceylon).

verses.commentary: Sense: Stroking the tip of his spear by means of his fingers, a certain soldier mounted on a horse'displayed different kinds of movement in the street.

verses.sanskrit: कालरात्रिमिवोदग्रां शस्त्रकारेण गोपिताम् । अधुनीत भटः कश्चिदतिधौतां कृपाणिकाम्
verses.transliteration: kālarātrimivodagrāṃ śastrakāreṇa gopitām / adhunīta bhaṭaḥ kaścidatidhautāṃ kṛpāṇikām
verses.translation: Some soldiers rode on elephants of huge-sized bodies as though on mountains propelled and tossed about by the violent gusts of winds of portentous phenomena.
verses.wordMeaning: Some soldiers rode on elephants of huge-sized bodies as though on mountains propelled and tossed about by the violent gusts of winds of portentous phenomena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some soldiers rode on elephants of huge-sized bodies as though on mountains propelled and tossed about by the violent gusts of winds of portentous phenomena.

verses.sanskrit: उल्ला सयन्कराग्रेण कुन्तपल्लवमेकतः । आरूढतुरगो वीथ्यां चारिभेदं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: ullā sayankarāgreṇa kuntapallavamekataḥ / ārūḍhaturago vīthyāṃ cāribhedaṃ cakāra ha
verses.translation: W. 10-19a give a list of weapons used in mediaeval India. The varieties of arrows, use of fire-arms and projectiles are note-worthy.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 10-19a give a list of weapons used in mediaeval India. The varieties of arrows, use of fire-arms and projectiles are note-worthy.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 10-19a give a list of weapons used in mediaeval India. The varieties of arrows, use of fire-arms and projectiles are note-worthy.

verses.sanskrit: केचिदारुरुहुर्योधा मातङ्गांस्तुङ्गवर्ष्मणः । उत्पात वातसंपातप्रेरितानिव पर्वतान्
verses.transliteration: kecidāruruhuryodhā mātaṅgāṃstuṅgavarṣmaṇaḥ / utpāta vātasaṃpātapreritāniva parvatān
verses.translation: Accompanied by those exceedingly mighty soldiers ofleonine strength, who appeared to be desirous of burning the entire universe, that general proceeded towards Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by those exceedingly mighty soldiers ofleonine strength, who appeared to be desirous of burning the entire universe, that general proceeded towards Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by those exceedingly mighty soldiers ofleonine strength, who appeared to be desirous of burning the entire universe, that general proceeded towards Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: पट्टिशैर्मुद्गरैश्चैव भिदुरैर्भिण्डिपालकैः । द्रुहणैश्च भुशुण्डीभिः कुठारैर्मुसलैरपि
verses.transliteration: paṭṭiśairmudgaraiścaiva bhidurairbhiṇḍipālakaiḥ / druhaṇaiśca bhuśuṇḍībhiḥ kuṭhārairmusalairapi
verses.translation: Splitting and piercing the fourteen worlds by means of loud sounds ofbig war-drums and shouting and howling along with boisterous laughs, Durmada went in her direction.
verses.wordMeaning: Splitting and piercing the fourteen worlds by means of loud sounds ofbig war-drums and shouting and howling along with boisterous laughs, Durmada went in her direction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Splitting and piercing the fourteen worlds by means of loud sounds ofbig war-drums and shouting and howling along with boisterous laughs, Durmada went in her direction.

verses.sanskrit: गदाभिश्च शतघ्नीभिस्त्रिशिखैर्विशिखैरपि । अर्धचक्रैर्महाचक्रैर्वक्राङ्गैरुरगाननैः
verses.transliteration: gadābhiśca śataghnībhistriśikhairviśikhairapi / ardhacakrairmahācakrairvakrāṅgairuragānanaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, on being commanded by Bhandasura, Kutilaksa of great strength deployed Talajarigha along with ten Aksauhinls at the Eastern entrance to the city of Sunyaka for the sake of its protection.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, on being commanded by Bhandasura, Kutilaksa of great strength deployed Talajarigha along with ten Aksauhinls at the Eastern entrance to the city of Sunyaka for the sake of its protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, on being commanded by Bhandasura, Kutilaksa of great strength deployed Talajarigha along with ten Aksauhinls at the Eastern entrance to the city of Sunyaka for the sake of its protection.

verses.sanskrit: फणिशीर्षप्रभेदैश्च धनुर्भिः शार्ङ्गधन्विभिः । दण्डैः क्षेपणिकाशस्त्रैर्वज्रबाणैर्दृषद्वरैः
verses.transliteration: phaṇiśīrṣaprabhedaiśca dhanurbhiḥ śārṅgadhanvibhiḥ / daṇḍaiḥ kṣepaṇikāśastrairvajrabāṇairdṛṣadvaraiḥ
verses.translation: At the southern entrance to the city, he empolyed a Daitya named Talabhuja accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, for its protection.
verses.wordMeaning: At the southern entrance to the city, he empolyed a Daitya named Talabhuja accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, for its protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the southern entrance to the city, he empolyed a Daitya named Talabhuja accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, for its protection.

verses.sanskrit: यवमध्यैर्मुष्टिमध्यैर्वललैः खण्डलैरपि । कटारैः कोणमध्यैश्च फणिदन्तैः परःशतैः
verses.transliteration: yavamadhyairmuṣṭimadhyairvalalaiḥ khaṇḍalairapi / kaṭāraiḥ koṇamadhyaiśca phaṇidantaiḥ paraḥśataiḥ
verses.translation: At the western entrance to the city, he appointed the Daitya named Talagrlva along with ten Aksauhinls for its protection.
verses.wordMeaning: At the western entrance to the city, he appointed the Daitya named Talagrlva along with ten Aksauhinls for its protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the western entrance to the city, he appointed the Daitya named Talagrlva along with ten Aksauhinls for its protection.

verses.sanskrit: पाशायुधैः पाशतुण्डैः काकतुण्डैः सहस्रशः । एवमादिभिरत्युग्रैरायुधैर्जीवहारिभिः
verses.transliteration: pāśāyudhaiḥ pāśatuṇḍaiḥ kākatuṇḍaiḥ sahasraśaḥ / evamādibhiratyugrairāyudhairjīvahāribhiḥ
verses.translation: He directed Talaketu, the exceedingly powerful (Daitya), to be at the northern entrance to the city along with
verses.wordMeaning: He directed Talaketu, the exceedingly powerful (Daitya), to be at the northern entrance to the city along with
verses.commentary: Sense: He directed Talaketu, the exceedingly powerful (Daitya), to be at the northern entrance to the city along with

verses.sanskrit: परिकल्पितहस्ताग्रा वर्मिता दैत्यकोटयः । अश्वारोहा गजारोहा गर्दभारोहिणः परे
verses.transliteration: parikalpitahastāgrā varmitā daityakoṭayaḥ / aśvārohā gajārohā gardabhārohiṇaḥ pare
verses.translation: He directed ten Aksauhinls to stay in a circle along the rampart wall in the cubicles and bunks over the copings.
verses.wordMeaning: He directed ten Aksauhinls to stay in a circle along the rampart wall in the cubicles and bunks over the copings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He directed ten Aksauhinls to stay in a circle along the rampart wall in the cubicles and bunks over the copings.

verses.sanskrit: उष्ट्रारोहा वृकारोहा शुनकारोहिणः परे । काकादिरोहिणो गृध्रारोहाः कङ्कादिरोहिणः
verses.transliteration: uṣṭrārohā vṛkārohā śunakārohiṇaḥ pare / kākādirohiṇo gṛdhrārohāḥ kaṅkādirohiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, by means of fifty Aksauhinls of soldiers, he
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, by means of fifty Aksauhinls of soldiers, he
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, by means of fifty Aksauhinls of soldiers, he

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रादिरोहिणश्चान्ये परे सिंहादिरोहिणः । शरभारोहिणश्चान्ये भेरुण्डारोहिणः परे
verses.transliteration: vyāghrādirohiṇaścānye pare siṃhādirohiṇaḥ / śarabhārohiṇaścānye bheruṇḍārohiṇaḥ pare
verses.translation: "O Lord, at the behest of your Majesty, armies have been deployed for the defence of the city. At the outset Durmada has already been despatched towards that wicked Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, at the behest of your Majesty, armies have been deployed for the defence of the city. At the outset Durmada has already been despatched towards that wicked Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, at the behest of your Majesty, armies have been deployed for the defence of the city. At the outset Durmada has already been despatched towards that wicked Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: सूकरारोहिणो व्यालारूढाः प्रेतादिरोहिणः । एवं नानाविधैर्वाहवाहिनो ललितां प्रति
verses.transliteration: sūkarārohiṇo vyālārūḍhāḥ pretādirohiṇaḥ / evaṃ nānāvidhairvāhavāhino lalitāṃ prati
verses.translation: That frail woman can easily be made frustrated merely by means of our domestic servants, yet the royal con- vention is that proper arrangement for the defence of the city should be made."
verses.wordMeaning: That frail woman can easily be made frustrated merely by means of our domestic servants, yet the royal con- vention is that proper arrangement for the defence of the city should be made."
verses.commentary: Sense: That frail woman can easily be made frustrated merely by means of our domestic servants, yet the royal con- vention is that proper arrangement for the defence of the city should be made."

verses.sanskrit: प्रचेलुः प्रबलक्रोधसंमूर्च्छितनिजाशयाः । कुटिलं सैन्यभर्त्तारं दुर्मदं नाम दानवम् । दशाक्षौहिणिकायुक्तं प्राहिणोल्ललितां प्रति
verses.transliteration: praceluḥ prabalakrodhasaṃmūrcchitanijāśayāḥ / kuṭilaṃ sainyabharttāraṃ durmadaṃ nāma dānavam / daśākṣauhiṇikāyuktaṃ prāhiṇollalitāṃ prati
verses.translation: After saying thus to Bhanda, the ruler of the Daityas, the excessively haughty Kutilaksa, accompanied by the commanding officers of different divisions of the army kept the entire army on the alert'and ready to act.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to Bhanda, the ruler of the Daityas, the excessively haughty Kutilaksa, accompanied by the commanding officers of different divisions of the army kept the entire army on the alert'and ready to act.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to Bhanda, the ruler of the Daityas, the excessively haughty Kutilaksa, accompanied by the commanding officers of different divisions of the army kept the entire army on the alert'and ready to act.

verses.sanskrit: दिधक्षुभिरिवाशेषं विश्वं सह बलोत्कटैः । भटैर्युक्तः स सेनानी ललिताभिमुखे ययौ
verses.transliteration: didhakṣubhirivāśeṣaṃ viśvaṃ saha balotkaṭaiḥ / bhaṭairyuktaḥ sa senānī lalitābhimukhe yayau
verses.translation: A Danava had previously been sent as a messenger* by Kutilaksa. In the company of an army, with tumultuous uproar, he had encircled the army of Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: A Danava had previously been sent as a messenger* by Kutilaksa. In the company of an army, with tumultuous uproar, he had encircled the army of Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Danava had previously been sent as a messenger* by Kutilaksa. In the company of an army, with tumultuous uproar, he had encircled the army of Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: भिन्दन्पटहसंरावैश्चतुर्दश जगन्ति सः । अट्टहासान्वितन्वानो दुर्मदस्तन्मुखो ययौ
verses.transliteration: bhindanpaṭahasaṃrāvaiścaturdaśa jaganti saḥ / aṭṭahāsānvitanvāno durmadastanmukho yayau
verses.translation: With a great clatter and clutter, thousands of Daitya soldiers waved their swords and fell on the soldiers of Sakti.
verses.wordMeaning: With a great clatter and clutter, thousands of Daitya soldiers waved their swords and fell on the soldiers of Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a great clatter and clutter, thousands of Daitya soldiers waved their swords and fell on the soldiers of Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: अथ भण्डासुराज्ञप्तः कुटिलाक्षो महाबलः । शून्यकस्य पुरद्वारे प्रचीने समकल्पयत् । रक्षणार्थं दशाक्षौ हिण्युपेतं तालजङ्घकम्
verses.transliteration: atha bhaṇḍāsurājñaptaḥ kuṭilākṣo mahābalaḥ / śūnyakasya puradvāre pracīne samakalpayat / rakṣaṇārthaṃ daśākṣau hiṇyupetaṃ tālajaṅghakam
verses.translation: Those dreadful Saktis with boisterous laughters and shouts, fought with the Danavas with their swords gleaming brightly.
verses.wordMeaning: Those dreadful Saktis with boisterous laughters and shouts, fought with the Danavas with their swords gleaming brightly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those dreadful Saktis with boisterous laughters and shouts, fought with the Danavas with their swords gleaming brightly.

verses.sanskrit: अवाचीने पुरद्वारे दशाक्षौहिणिकायुतम् । नाम्ना तालभुजं दैत्यं रक्षणार्थमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: avācīne puradvāre daśākṣauhiṇikāyutam / nāmnā tālabhujaṃ daityaṃ rakṣaṇārthamakalpayat
verses.translation: In the course of that war between Saktis and Danavas, the three worlds became exceedingly agitated and heavy dust spread throughout the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of that war between Saktis and Danavas, the three worlds became exceedingly agitated and heavy dust spread throughout the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of that war between Saktis and Danavas, the three worlds became exceedingly agitated and heavy dust spread throughout the sky.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतीचीने पुरद्वारे दशाक्षौहिणिकायुतम् । तालग्रीवं नाम दैत्यं रक्षार्थं समकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: pratīcīne puradvāre daśākṣauhiṇikāyutam / tālagrīvaṃ nāma daityaṃ rakṣārthaṃ samakalpayat
verses.translation: Intensified in the shafts of the chariots, amplified by the trumpets of elephants and scattered by the deep breaths of the horses, the dust columns rose up in the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: Intensified in the shafts of the chariots, amplified by the trumpets of elephants and scattered by the deep breaths of the horses, the dust columns rose up in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Intensified in the shafts of the chariots, amplified by the trumpets of elephants and scattered by the deep breaths of the horses, the dust columns rose up in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे तु पुरद्वारे तालकेतुं महा बलम् । आदिदेश स रक्षार्थं दशाक्षौहिणिकायुतम्
verses.transliteration: uttare tu puradvāre tālaketuṃ mahā balam / ādideśa sa rakṣārthaṃ daśākṣauhiṇikāyutam
verses.translation: On seeing him rushing in accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, Sampatsarasvatl furiously ran towards him in the battlefield.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him rushing in accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, Sampatsarasvatl furiously ran towards him in the battlefield.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him rushing in accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, Sampatsarasvatl furiously ran towards him in the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्य सालवलये कपिशीर्षकवेश्मसु । मण्डलाकारतो वस्तुन्दशाक्षौहिणिमादिशत्
verses.transliteration: purasya sālavalaye kapiśīrṣakaveśmasu / maṇḍalākārato vastundaśākṣauhiṇimādiśat
verses.translation: Horses and elephants in their rut occupied (and guided) by the Saktis equal (in strength) to SampatkarT thrashed and smashed the army of Danavas.
verses.wordMeaning: Horses and elephants in their rut occupied (and guided) by the Saktis equal (in strength) to SampatkarT thrashed and smashed the army of Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Horses and elephants in their rut occupied (and guided) by the Saktis equal (in strength) to SampatkarT thrashed and smashed the army of Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पञ्चाशता कृत्वाक्षौहिण्या पुररक्षणम् । शून्यकस्य पुरस्यैव तद्वृत्तं स्वामिने ऽवदत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pañcāśatā kṛtvākṣauhiṇyā purarakṣaṇam / śūnyakasya purasyaiva tadvṛttaṃ svāmine 'vadat
verses.translation: Like the mass of flames of the Kalpa fire that enve- lops the fine ocean, the soldiers of Daityas surrounded the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: Like the mass of flames of the Kalpa fire that enve- lops the fine ocean, the soldiers of Daityas surrounded the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the mass of flames of the Kalpa fire that enve- lops the fine ocean, the soldiers of Daityas surrounded the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: कुटिलाक्ष उवाच देव त्वदाज्ञया दत्तं सैन्यं नगररक्षणे । दुर्मदः प्रेषितः पूर्वं दुष्टां तां ललितां प्रति
verses.transliteration: kuṭilākṣa uvāca deva tvadājñayā dattaṃ sainyaṃ nagararakṣaṇe / durmadaḥ preṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ duṣṭāṃ tāṃ lalitāṃ prati
verses.translation: Heaps of heads of the Danavas rolled down on the battle-field when the necks (of Danavas) had been chopped off by the sharp edges of the brilliant weapons of the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: Heaps of heads of the Danavas rolled down on the battle-field when the necks (of Danavas) had been chopped off by the sharp edges of the brilliant weapons of the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Heaps of heads of the Danavas rolled down on the battle-field when the necks (of Danavas) had been chopped off by the sharp edges of the brilliant weapons of the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मत्किङ्कर मात्रेण सुनिराशा हि साबला । तथापि राज्ञामाचारः कर्त्तव्यं पुररक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: asmatkiṅkara mātreṇa sunirāśā hi sābalā / tathāpi rājñāmācāraḥ karttavyaṃ purarakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The battle-ground became entirely filled with heads with lips bitten (and firmly pressed by the teeth), terrible with knitted eyebrows and with eyes turned red due to fury.
verses.wordMeaning: The battle-ground became entirely filled with heads with lips bitten (and firmly pressed by the teeth), terrible with knitted eyebrows and with eyes turned red due to fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: The battle-ground became entirely filled with heads with lips bitten (and firmly pressed by the teeth), terrible with knitted eyebrows and with eyes turned red due to fury.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भण्डदैत्येन्द्रं कुबिलाक्षो ऽतिगर्वितः । स्वसैन्यं सज्जयामास सेनापतिभिरन्वितः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhaṇḍadaityendraṃ kubilākṣo 'tigarvitaḥ / svasainyaṃ sajjayāmāsa senāpatibhiranvitaḥ
verses.translation: When the battle that terrified all worlds thus began, Saktis who became excessively furious thrashed and smashed the army of the Daityas.
verses.wordMeaning: When the battle that terrified all worlds thus began, Saktis who became excessively furious thrashed and smashed the army of the Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the battle that terrified all worlds thus began, Saktis who became excessively furious thrashed and smashed the army of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: दूतस्तु प्रेषितः पूर्वं कुटिलाक्षेण दानवः । स ध्वनन्ध्वजिनीयुक्तो ललितासैन्य मावृणोत्
verses.transliteration: dūtastu preṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ kuṭilākṣeṇa dānavaḥ / sa dhvanandhvajinīyukto lalitāsainya māvṛṇot
verses.translation: Struck down by the weapons of Saktis and hit by the armies of goddess SampaddevI in this manner, the Danavas fell down senseless here and there and died there (on the battlefield).
verses.wordMeaning: Struck down by the weapons of Saktis and hit by the armies of goddess SampaddevI in this manner, the Danavas fell down senseless here and there and died there (on the battlefield).
verses.commentary: Sense: Struck down by the weapons of Saktis and hit by the armies of goddess SampaddevI in this manner, the Danavas fell down senseless here and there and died there (on the battlefield).

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा किलकिलारावं भटास्तत्र सहस्रशः । दोधूयमानैरसिभिर्निपेतुः शक्तिसैनिकैः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā kilakilārāvaṃ bhaṭāstatra sahasraśaḥ / dodhūyamānairasibhirnipetuḥ śaktisainikaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, Durmada the suppressor of enemies encouraged his army that had been utterly vanquished and routed, mounted a camel immediately and rushed against the army (of Saktis).
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Durmada the suppressor of enemies encouraged his army that had been utterly vanquished and routed, mounted a camel immediately and rushed against the army (of Saktis).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, Durmada the suppressor of enemies encouraged his army that had been utterly vanquished and routed, mounted a camel immediately and rushed against the army (of Saktis).

verses.sanskrit: ताश्च शक्त्य उद्दण्डाः स्फुरिताट्टहसस्वनाः । देदीप्यमानशस्त्राभाः समयुध्यन्त दानवैः
verses.transliteration: tāśca śaktya uddaṇḍāḥ sphuritāṭṭahasasvanāḥ / dedīpyamānaśastrābhāḥ samayudhyanta dānavaiḥ
verses.translation: Goaded furiously and occupied by Durmada, the longnecked camel vehicle with elevated back moved ahead (quickly).
verses.wordMeaning: Goaded furiously and occupied by Durmada, the longnecked camel vehicle with elevated back moved ahead (quickly).
verses.commentary: Sense: Goaded furiously and occupied by Durmada, the longnecked camel vehicle with elevated back moved ahead (quickly).

verses.sanskrit: शक्तीनां दानवानां च संशोभितजगत्त्रयः । समवर्तत संग्रामो धूलिग्रामतताम्बरः
verses.transliteration: śaktīnāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃśobhitajagattrayaḥ / samavartata saṃgrāmo dhūligrāmatatāmbaraḥ
verses.translation: (The Daityas) with fury in their minds followed that vicious (Durmada) who was seated on a camel. Desirous of fighting with Saktis, he consoled the frightened Danavas.
verses.wordMeaning: (The Daityas) with fury in their minds followed that vicious (Durmada) who was seated on a camel. Desirous of fighting with Saktis, he consoled the frightened Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Daityas) with fury in their minds followed that vicious (Durmada) who was seated on a camel. Desirous of fighting with Saktis, he consoled the frightened Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: रथवंशेषु मूर्च्छन्त्यः करिकण्ठैः प्रपञ्चिताः । अश्वनिःश्वासविक्षिप्ता धूलयः रवं प्रपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: rathavaṃśeṣu mūrcchantyaḥ karikaṇṭhaiḥ prapañcitāḥ / aśvaniḥśvāsavikṣiptā dhūlayaḥ ravaṃ prapedire
verses.translation: Like the cloud that showers the forest with water, he showered the circular military array of SampatkarT's forces in all quarters with arrows with their points dazzling brilliantly.
verses.wordMeaning: Like the cloud that showers the forest with water, he showered the circular military array of SampatkarT's forces in all quarters with arrows with their points dazzling brilliantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the cloud that showers the forest with water, he showered the circular military array of SampatkarT's forces in all quarters with arrows with their points dazzling brilliantly.

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तमालोक्य दशाक्षौहिणिकावृतम् । संपत्सरस्वती क्रोधादभिदुद्राव संगरे
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantamālokya daśākṣauhiṇikāvṛtam / saṃpatsarasvatī krodhādabhidudrāva saṃgare
verses.translation: Struck and hit with many arrows by that Daitya of unbearable inherent strength, in the course of battle, the army ofSampatkarl became as though stunned and stupe- fied for a moment.
verses.wordMeaning: Struck and hit with many arrows by that Daitya of unbearable inherent strength, in the course of battle, the army ofSampatkarl became as though stunned and stupe- fied for a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Struck and hit with many arrows by that Daitya of unbearable inherent strength, in the course of battle, the army ofSampatkarl became as though stunned and stupe- fied for a moment.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पत्करीसमानाभिः शक्तिभिः समधिष्ठिताः । अश्वाश्च दन्तिनो मत्ता व्यमर्दन्दानत्रीं चमुम्
verses.transliteration: sampatkarīsamānābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ samadhiṣṭhitāḥ / aśvāśca dantino mattā vyamardandānatrīṃ camum
verses.translation: With her eyes reddened on account of anger, Sampadambika rode on the elephant Ranakolahala and fought with him.
verses.wordMeaning: With her eyes reddened on account of anger, Sampadambika rode on the elephant Ranakolahala and fought with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her eyes reddened on account of anger, Sampadambika rode on the elephant Ranakolahala and fought with him.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यतुमुले युद्धे जाते किलिकिलारवे । धूलीषु धूयमानासु ताड्यमानासु भेरिषु
verses.transliteration: anyonyatumule yuddhe jāte kilikilārave / dhūlīṣu dhūyamānāsu tāḍyamānāsu bheriṣu
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: इतस्ततः प्रववृधे रक्तसिन्धुर्महीयसी । शक्तिभिः पात्यमानानां दानवानां सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: itastataḥ pravavṛdhe raktasindhurmahīyasī / śaktibhiḥ pātyamānānāṃ dānavānāṃ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, sparks and flames were ignited by
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, sparks and flames were ignited by
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, sparks and flames were ignited by

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजानि लुठितान्यासन्विलूनानि शिलीमुखैः । विस्रस्ततत्तच्छिह्नानि समं छत्रकदम्बकैः
verses.transliteration: dhvajāni luṭhitānyāsanvilūnāni śilīmukhaiḥ / visrastatattacchihnāni samaṃ chatrakadambakaiḥ
verses.translation: With his face reddened with wrath, Durmada hit and removed a precious gem from the crown of SampatkarT, with a powerful and tough arrow.
verses.wordMeaning: With his face reddened with wrath, Durmada hit and removed a precious gem from the crown of SampatkarT, with a powerful and tough arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his face reddened with wrath, Durmada hit and removed a precious gem from the crown of SampatkarT, with a powerful and tough arrow.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तारुणायां युद्धोर्व्यां पतितैश्छत्रमण्डलैः । आलंबि तुलना संध्यारक्ताभ्रहिमरोचिषा
verses.transliteration: raktāruṇāyāṃ yuddhorvyāṃ patitaiśchatramaṇḍalaiḥ / ālaṃbi tulanā saṃdhyāraktābhrahimarociṣā
