verses.translation: Thereat, her eyes became red with anger. Durmada was hit with arrows discharged by her. Wounded by them on the chest, he gave up his ghost instantaneously.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereat, her eyes became red with anger. Durmada was hit with arrows discharged by her. Wounded by them on the chest, he gave up his ghost instantaneously.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereat, her eyes became red with anger. Durmada was hit with arrows discharged by her. Wounded by them on the chest, he gave up his ghost instantaneously.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालाकपालः कल्पाग्निरिव चारुपयोनिधौ । दैत्यसैन्यानि निवहाः शक्तीनां पर्यवारयन्
verses.transliteration: jvālākapālaḥ kalpāgniriva cārupayonidhau / daityasainyāni nivahāḥ śaktīnāṃ paryavārayan
verses.translation: Thereupon, the excellent soldiers in the army of Saktis shouted uproariously. Many other excellent Danavas, the foremost among the soldiers of Durmada were killed by them.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the excellent soldiers in the army of Saktis shouted uproariously. Many other excellent Danavas, the foremost among the soldiers of Durmada were killed by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the excellent soldiers in the army of Saktis shouted uproariously. Many other excellent Danavas, the foremost among the soldiers of Durmada were killed by them.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिच्छन्दोज्ज्वलच्छस्त्रधारानिष्कृत्तकन्धराः । दानवानां रणतले निपेतुर्मुण्डराशयः
verses.transliteration: śakticchandojjvalacchastradhārāniṣkṛttakandharāḥ / dānavānāṃ raṇatale nipeturmuṇḍarāśayaḥ
verses.translation: Those who survived death among Daityas were vanquished completely. They fled from battle-field and took refuge in the city of Sunyaka.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who survived death among Daityas were vanquished completely. They fled from battle-field and took refuge in the city of Sunyaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who survived death among Daityas were vanquished completely. They fled from battle-field and took refuge in the city of Sunyaka.

verses.sanskrit: दष्टौष्ठैर्भ्रुकुटीक्रूरैः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनैः । मुण्डैरखण्डमभवत्संग्रामधरणीतलम्
verses.transliteration: daṣṭauṣṭhairbhrukuṭīkrūraiḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaiḥ / muṇḍairakhaṇḍamabhavatsaṃgrāmadharaṇītalam
verses.translation: Oh being sent forth thus by him, Kutilaksa called upon Kuranda of great strength with brawny arms, to present himselfin front ofthe lord.
verses.wordMeaning: Oh being sent forth thus by him, Kutilaksa called upon Kuranda of great strength with brawny arms, to present himselfin front ofthe lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Oh being sent forth thus by him, Kutilaksa called upon Kuranda of great strength with brawny arms, to present himselfin front ofthe lord.

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवृत्ते समये जगच्चक्रभयङ्करे । शक्तयो भृशसंक्रुद्धा दैत्यसेनाममर्दयन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravṛtte samaye jagaccakrabhayaṅkare / śaktayo bhṛśasaṃkruddhā daityasenāmamardayan
verses.translation: Thus directed by Kutilaksa in the presence ofhis lord, king Kuranda of fierce exploits set out immediately from the city.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus directed by Kutilaksa in the presence ofhis lord, king Kuranda of fierce exploits set out immediately from the city.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus directed by Kutilaksa in the presence ofhis lord, king Kuranda of fierce exploits set out immediately from the city.

verses.sanskrit: इतस्ततः शक्तिशस्त्रैस्ताडिता मूर्च्छिता इति । विनेशुर्दानवास्तत्र संपद्देवीबलाहताः
verses.transliteration: itastataḥ śaktiśastraistāḍitā mūrcchitā iti / vineśurdānavāstatra saṃpaddevībalāhatāḥ
verses.translation: The dreadful Kuranda, the elder brother of Du rmada, went to the battle surrounded by twenty Aksauhinls of soldiers. By means ofhis elephants, horses and foot-soldiers he appeared to pound and suppress the sphere ofearth.
verses.wordMeaning: The dreadful Kuranda, the elder brother of Du rmada, went to the battle surrounded by twenty Aksauhinls of soldiers. By means ofhis elephants, horses and foot-soldiers he appeared to pound and suppress the sphere ofearth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The dreadful Kuranda, the elder brother of Du rmada, went to the battle surrounded by twenty Aksauhinls of soldiers. By means ofhis elephants, horses and foot-soldiers he appeared to pound and suppress the sphere ofearth.

verses.sanskrit: अथ भग्नं समाश्वास्य निजं बलमरिन्दमः । उष्ट्रमारुह्य सहसा दुर्मदो ऽभ्यद्रवच्चमुम्
verses.transliteration: atha bhagnaṃ samāśvāsya nijaṃ balamarindamaḥ / uṣṭramāruhya sahasā durmado 'bhyadravaccamum
verses.translation: He took up his horn-made bow and made a dreadful twanging sound. With continuous discharge of arrows, he showered the great army of Sampatkarl.
verses.wordMeaning: He took up his horn-made bow and made a dreadful twanging sound. With continuous discharge of arrows, he showered the great army of Sampatkarl.
verses.commentary: Sense: He took up his horn-made bow and made a dreadful twanging sound. With continuous discharge of arrows, he showered the great army of Sampatkarl.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घग्रीवः समुन्नद्धः पृष्ठे निष्ठुरतोदनः । अधिष्ठितो दुर्मदेन वाहनोष्ट्रश्चचाल ह
verses.transliteration: dīrghagrīvaḥ samunnaddhaḥ pṛṣṭhe niṣṭhuratodanaḥ / adhiṣṭhito durmadena vāhanoṣṭraścacāla ha
verses.translation: Thereupon, CandT who prepared herself to thrash and smash the army of Kuranda of great might encouraged her own army.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, CandT who prepared herself to thrash and smash the army of Kuranda of great might encouraged her own army.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, CandT who prepared herself to thrash and smash the army of Kuranda of great might encouraged her own army.

verses.sanskrit: तमुष्ट्रवाहनं दुष्टमन्वीयुः क्रुद्धचेतसः । दानावनश्वसत्सर्वान्भीताञ्छक्तियुयुत्सया
verses.transliteration: tamuṣṭravāhanaṃ duṣṭamanvīyuḥ kruddhacetasaḥ / dānāvanaśvasatsarvānbhītāñchaktiyuyutsayā
verses.translation: Getting interested in an unusually delightful battle,,
verses.wordMeaning: Getting interested in an unusually delightful battle,,
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting interested in an unusually delightful battle,,

verses.sanskrit: अवाकिरद्दिशो भल्लैरुल्लसत्फलशालिभिः । संपत्करीचमूचक्रं वनं वार्भिरिवांबुदः
verses.transliteration: avākiraddiśo bhallairullasatphalaśālibhiḥ / saṃpatkarīcamūcakraṃ vanaṃ vārbhirivāṃbudaḥ
verses.translation: "Dear friend, Sampatkarl, may my words be listened' to with love. Hand over the fight with this fellow to be pursued by me, resulting in good benefits.
verses.wordMeaning: "Dear friend, Sampatkarl, may my words be listened' to with love. Hand over the fight with this fellow to be pursued by me, resulting in good benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Dear friend, Sampatkarl, may my words be listened' to with love. Hand over the fight with this fellow to be pursued by me, resulting in good benefits.

verses.sanskrit: तेन दुःसहसत्त्वेन ताडिता बहुभिः शरैः । स्तंभितेवाभवत्सेना संपत्कर्याः क्षणं रणे
verses.transliteration: tena duḥsahasattvena tāḍitā bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ / staṃbhitevābhavatsenā saṃpatkaryāḥ kṣaṇaṃ raṇe
verses.translation: Forbear awhile. This fellow will be engaged by me in fight. You have been requested in the capacity of a friend. Do not have any hesitation in this regard."
verses.wordMeaning: Forbear awhile. This fellow will be engaged by me in fight. You have been requested in the capacity of a friend. Do not have any hesitation in this regard."
verses.commentary: Sense: Forbear awhile. This fellow will be engaged by me in fight. You have been requested in the capacity of a friend. Do not have any hesitation in this regard."

verses.sanskrit: अथ क्रोधारुणं चक्षुर्दधाना संपदंबिका । रणकोलाहलगजमारूढायुध्यतामुना
verses.transliteration: atha krodhāruṇaṃ cakṣurdadhānā saṃpadaṃbikā / raṇakolāhalagajamārūḍhāyudhyatāmunā
verses.translation: On hearing these words of hers, Sampaddevi of pleasant smiles, turned away her army that was about to face Kuranda.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of hers, Sampaddevi of pleasant smiles, turned away her army that was about to face Kuranda.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of hers, Sampaddevi of pleasant smiles, turned away her army that was about to face Kuranda.

verses.sanskrit: आलोलकङ्कणक्वाणरमणीयतरः करः । तस्याश्चाकृष्य कोदण्डमौर्वीमाकर्णमाहवे
verses.transliteration: ālolakaṅkaṇakvāṇaramaṇīyataraḥ karaḥ / tasyāścākṛṣya kodaṇḍamaurvīmākarṇamāhave
verses.translation: When the fight between Saktis and demons went on like thus, (the goddess) mounted a speedy horse-
verses.wordMeaning: When the fight between Saktis and demons went on like thus, (the goddess) mounted a speedy horse-
verses.commentary: Sense: When the fight between Saktis and demons went on like thus, (the goddess) mounted a speedy horse-

verses.sanskrit: लघुहस्ततयापश्यन्नाकृष्टन्न च मोक्षणम् । ददृशे घनुषश्चक्रं केवलं शरधारणे
verses.transliteration: laghuhastatayāpaśyannākṛṣṭanna ca mokṣaṇam / dadṛśe ghanuṣaścakraṃ kevalaṃ śaradhāraṇe
verses.translation: Arrows fitted with golden feathers were discharged by the goddess seated on the horse spread over the extremities of quarters. They pervaded ten directions.
verses.wordMeaning: Arrows fitted with golden feathers were discharged by the goddess seated on the horse spread over the extremities of quarters. They pervaded ten directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arrows fitted with golden feathers were discharged by the goddess seated on the horse spread over the extremities of quarters. They pervaded ten directions.

verses.sanskrit: आश्वर्काबरसंपर्कस्फुटप्रतिफलत्फलाः । शराः सम्पत्करीचापच्युताः समदहन्नरीन्
verses.transliteration: āśvarkābarasaṃparkasphuṭapratiphalatphalāḥ / śarāḥ sampatkarīcāpacyutāḥ samadahannarīn
verses.translation: Kuranda of fierce exploits, the elder brother of Durmada, furiously showered the goddess mounted on the horse by means of arrows issuing forth from the Sarnga bow.
verses.wordMeaning: Kuranda of fierce exploits, the elder brother of Durmada, furiously showered the goddess mounted on the horse by means of arrows issuing forth from the Sarnga bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kuranda of fierce exploits, the elder brother of Durmada, furiously showered the goddess mounted on the horse by means of arrows issuing forth from the Sarnga bow.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्मदस्याथ तस्याश्च समभूद्युद्धमुद्धतम् । अभूदन्योन्यसंघट्टाद्विस्फुलिङ्गशिलीमुखैः
verses.transliteration: durmadasyātha tasyāśca samabhūdyuddhamuddhatam / abhūdanyonyasaṃghaṭṭādvisphuliṅgaśilīmukhaiḥ
verses.translation: Even the horse of the goddess seated on the horse, speedily split and hit the army with its hard and dreadful hoofs. It thrashed and smashed Danavas.
verses.wordMeaning: Even the horse of the goddess seated on the horse, speedily split and hit the army with its hard and dreadful hoofs. It thrashed and smashed Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the horse of the goddess seated on the horse, speedily split and hit the army with its hard and dreadful hoofs. It thrashed and smashed Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं प्रसृतैर्बाणैः सम्पद्देवीसुरद्विषोः । अन्धकारः समभवत्तिरस्कुर्वन्नहस्करम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ prasṛtairbāṇaiḥ sampaddevīsuradviṣoḥ / andhakāraḥ samabhavattiraskurvannahaskaram
verses.translation: Many of the armies of that enemy fainted and swooned from far at the neighing sound of that horse whose sound resembled the portentous roar of the ocean at the time of ultimate dissolution (of the universe).
verses.wordMeaning: Many of the armies of that enemy fainted and swooned from far at the neighing sound of that horse whose sound resembled the portentous roar of the ocean at the time of ultimate dissolution (of the universe).
verses.commentary: Sense: Many of the armies of that enemy fainted and swooned from far at the neighing sound of that horse whose sound resembled the portentous roar of the ocean at the time of ultimate dissolution (of the universe).

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे च बाणानामतिसंघट्टयोनयः । विष्फुलिङ्गा विदधिरे दधिरे भ्रमचातुरीम्
verses.transliteration: tadantare ca bāṇānāmatisaṃghaṭṭayonayaḥ / viṣphuliṅgā vidadhire dadhire bhramacāturīm
verses.translation: The Hayasana (Horse-seated goddess ) moving about here and there among the troops of Daityas, released her divine weapon Pasa (noose) ofblazing appearance.
verses.wordMeaning: The Hayasana (Horse-seated goddess ) moving about here and there among the troops of Daityas, released her divine weapon Pasa (noose) ofblazing appearance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Hayasana (Horse-seated goddess ) moving about here and there among the troops of Daityas, released her divine weapon Pasa (noose) ofblazing appearance.

verses.sanskrit: तयाधिरूढः संश्रोण्यारणकोलाहलः करी । पराक्रमं बहुविधं दर्शयामास संगरे
verses.transliteration: tayādhirūḍhaḥ saṃśroṇyāraṇakolāhalaḥ karī / parākramaṃ bahuvidhaṃ darśayāmāsa saṃgare
verses.translation: From that Pasa crores of other Pdsas as terrible as serpents issued forth. They bound the entire army and overpowered them.
verses.wordMeaning: From that Pasa crores of other Pdsas as terrible as serpents issued forth. They bound the entire army and overpowered them.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that Pasa crores of other Pdsas as terrible as serpents issued forth. They bound the entire army and overpowered them.

verses.sanskrit: करेण कतिचिद्दैत्यान्पादघातेन कांश्चन । उदग्रदन्तमुसलघातैरन्यांश्च दानवान्
verses.transliteration: kareṇa katiciddaityānpādaghātena kāṃścana / udagradantamusalaghātairanyāṃśca dānavān
verses.translation: Thereupon, Kurandaka who had become furious on account of the fact that his soldiers had been bound, cut off with a single arrow the string of her jewel-set bow.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Kurandaka who had become furious on account of the fact that his soldiers had been bound, cut off with a single arrow the string of her jewel-set bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, Kurandaka who had become furious on account of the fact that his soldiers had been bound, cut off with a single arrow the string of her jewel-set bow.

verses.sanskrit: वालकाण्डहतैरन्यान्फेत्कारैरपरान्रिपून् । गात्रव्यामर्द्दनैरन्यान्नखघातैस्तथापरान्
verses.transliteration: vālakāṇḍahatairanyānphetkārairaparānripūn / gātravyāmarddanairanyānnakhaghātaistathāparān
verses.translation: Abandoning the bow when the string had been cut off, Hayasana who had become very furious struck at the chest of that vicious fellow with her goad.
verses.wordMeaning: Abandoning the bow when the string had been cut off, Hayasana who had become very furious struck at the chest of that vicious fellow with her goad.
verses.commentary: Sense: Abandoning the bow when the string had been cut off, Hayasana who had become very furious struck at the chest of that vicious fellow with her goad.

verses.sanskrit: पृथुमानाभिघातेन कांश्चिद्दैत्यन्व्यमर्दयत् । चतुरं चरितं चक्रे संपद्देवीमतङ्गजः
verses.transliteration: pṛthumānābhighātena kāṃściddaityanvyamardayat / caturaṃ caritaṃ cakre saṃpaddevīmataṅgajaḥ
verses.translation: Some dreadful Putanas issuing forth from that
verses.wordMeaning: Some dreadful Putanas issuing forth from that
verses.commentary: Sense: Some dreadful Putanas issuing forth from that

verses.sanskrit: सुदुर्मदः क्रुधा रक्तो दृढेनैकेन पत्रिणा । संपत्करीमुकुटगं मणिमेकमपाहरत्
verses.transliteration: sudurmadaḥ krudhā rakto dṛḍhenaikena patriṇā / saṃpatkarīmukuṭagaṃ maṇimekamapāharat
verses.translation: When Kuranda the leader of twenty Aksauhinls was killed thus, the Daityas who survived death fled quickly.
verses.wordMeaning: When Kuranda the leader of twenty Aksauhinls was killed thus, the Daityas who survived death fled quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Kuranda the leader of twenty Aksauhinls was killed thus, the Daityas who survived death fled quickly.

verses.sanskrit: अथ क्रोधारुणदृशा तया मुक्तैः शिलीमुखैः । विक्षतो वक्षसि क्षिप्रं दुर्मदो जीवितं जहौ
verses.transliteration: atha krodhāruṇadṛśā tayā muktaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ / vikṣato vakṣasi kṣipraṃ durmado jīvitaṃ jahau
verses.translation: "Alas! What could not have occurred even in a dream, what has never been heard before, what has not even been suspected by us in our minds — such a calamity has befallen us.
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas! What could not have occurred even in a dream, what has never been heard before, what has not even been suspected by us in our minds — such a calamity has befallen us.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas! What could not have occurred even in a dream, what has never been heard before, what has not even been suspected by us in our minds — such a calamity has befallen us.

verses.sanskrit: ततः किलकिला रावं कृत्वा शक्तिचमूवरैः । तत्सैनिकवरास्त्वन्ये निहता दानवोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kilakilā rāvaṃ kṛtvā śakticamūvaraiḥ / tatsainikavarāstvanye nihatā dānavottamāḥ
verses.translation: Kuranda and Durmada had been very mighty brothers. The power of this wicked fraudulent female slave (practitioner ofblack magic) is greater than w'e expected.
verses.wordMeaning: Kuranda and Durmada had been very mighty brothers. The power of this wicked fraudulent female slave (practitioner ofblack magic) is greater than w'e expected.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kuranda and Durmada had been very mighty brothers. The power of this wicked fraudulent female slave (practitioner ofblack magic) is greater than w'e expected.

verses.sanskrit: हतावशिष्टा दैत्यास्तु शक्तिबाणैः खिलीकृताः । पलायिता रणक्षोण्याः शून्यकं पुरमाश्रयन्
verses.transliteration: hatāvaśiṣṭā daityāstu śaktibāṇaiḥ khilīkṛtāḥ / palāyitā raṇakṣoṇyāḥ śūnyakaṃ puramāśrayan
verses.translation: Now despatch five of our generals beginning with Kararika along with a hundred Aksauhinls to the battle-field.
verses.wordMeaning: Now despatch five of our generals beginning with Kararika along with a hundred Aksauhinls to the battle-field.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now despatch five of our generals beginning with Kararika along with a hundred Aksauhinls to the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वृत्तान्तमथाकर्ण्य संक्रुद्धो दानवेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tadvṛttāntamathākarṇya saṃkruddho dānaveśvaraḥ
verses.translation: They are genuinely proud-of (their ability in) fighting. They are great heroes ready to give up their bodies in fighting battles. In every respect they will vanquish that vainly proud woman."
verses.wordMeaning: They are genuinely proud-of (their ability in) fighting. They are great heroes ready to give up their bodies in fighting battles. In every respect they will vanquish that vainly proud woman."
verses.commentary: Sense: They are genuinely proud-of (their ability in) fighting. They are great heroes ready to give up their bodies in fighting battles. In every respect they will vanquish that vainly proud woman."

verses.sanskrit: प्रचण्डेन प्रभावेण दीप्यमान इवात्मनि । स पस्पर्श नियुद्धाय खड्गमुग्रविलोचनः । कुटिलाक्षं निकटगं बभाषे पृतनापतिम्
verses.transliteration: pracaṇḍena prabhāveṇa dīpyamāna ivātmani / sa pasparśa niyuddhāya khaḍgamugravilocanaḥ / kuṭilākṣaṃ nikaṭagaṃ babhāṣe pṛtanāpatim
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Bhanda, Kutilaksa hurriedly summoned the five generals beginning with Kararika.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of Bhanda, Kutilaksa hurriedly summoned the five generals beginning with Kararika.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Bhanda, Kutilaksa hurriedly summoned the five generals beginning with Kararika.

verses.sanskrit: कथं सा दुष्टवनिता दुर्मदं बलशालिनम् । निपातितवती युद्धे कष्ट एव विधेः क्रमः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ sā duṣṭavanitā durmadaṃ balaśālinam / nipātitavatī yuddhe kaṣṭa eva vidheḥ kramaḥ
verses.translation: Directed by Kutilaksa, they bowed down to theirlord and master and appeared to be ready to enter even fire (for his sake). Blind with fury, they set out from the city.
verses.wordMeaning: Directed by Kutilaksa, they bowed down to theirlord and master and appeared to be ready to enter even fire (for his sake). Blind with fury, they set out from the city.
verses.commentary: Sense: Directed by Kutilaksa, they bowed down to theirlord and master and appeared to be ready to enter even fire (for his sake). Blind with fury, they set out from the city.

verses.sanskrit: न सुरेषु न यक्षेषु नोरगेन्द्रेषु यद्बलम् । अभूत्प्रतिहतं सो ऽपि दुर्मदो ऽबलया हतः
verses.transliteration: na sureṣu na yakṣeṣu noragendreṣu yadbalam / abhūtpratihataṃ so 'pi durmado 'balayā hataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the tumultuous and unbearable sound of their drums at the time oftheir departure on their march, even the elephants guarding the quarters squirmed and writhed, as they experienced a sort of shattering of their ears.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the tumultuous and unbearable sound of their drums at the time oftheir departure on their march, even the elephants guarding the quarters squirmed and writhed, as they experienced a sort of shattering of their ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the tumultuous and unbearable sound of their drums at the time oftheir departure on their march, even the elephants guarding the quarters squirmed and writhed, as they experienced a sort of shattering of their ears.

verses.sanskrit: तां दुष्टवनितां जेतुमाक्रष्टुं च कचं हठात् । सेनापतिं कुरण्डाख्यं प्रेषयाहवदुर्मदम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ duṣṭavanitāṃ jetumākraṣṭuṃ ca kacaṃ haṭhāt / senāpatiṃ kuraṇḍākhyaṃ preṣayāhavadurmadam
verses.translation: When the dust particles ofthe ground were raised by the rims of the wheels, they obscured the lustre ofthe sun. Hence, it appeared to be covered with showers of snow.
verses.wordMeaning: When the dust particles ofthe ground were raised by the rims of the wheels, they obscured the lustre ofthe sun. Hence, it appeared to be covered with showers of snow.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the dust particles ofthe ground were raised by the rims of the wheels, they obscured the lustre ofthe sun. Hence, it appeared to be covered with showers of snow.

verses.sanskrit: एति संप्रोषितस्तेन कुटिलाक्षो महापलम् । कुरण्डं चण्डदोर्द्दण्डमाजुहाव प्रभोः पुरः
verses.transliteration: eti saṃproṣitastena kuṭilākṣo mahāpalam / kuraṇḍaṃ caṇḍadorddaṇḍamājuhāva prabhoḥ puraḥ
verses.translation: The entire universe appeared to be covered with dust. In some places, it was very noisy on account ofthe harsh sounds ofwar-drums.
verses.wordMeaning: The entire universe appeared to be covered with dust. In some places, it was very noisy on account ofthe harsh sounds ofwar-drums.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe appeared to be covered with dust. In some places, it was very noisy on account ofthe harsh sounds ofwar-drums.

verses.sanskrit: स कुरण्डः समागत्य प्रणाम स्वामिने ऽदिशत् । उवाच कुटिलाक्षस्तं गच्छ सज्जय सैनिकान्
verses.transliteration: sa kuraṇḍaḥ samāgatya praṇāma svāmine 'diśat / uvāca kuṭilākṣastaṃ gaccha sajjaya sainikān
verses.translation: The soldiers of the Daityas were overspread with the columns of dust that rose there. Hence, the number of soldiers could be conceived in the form "It is so much".
verses.wordMeaning: The soldiers of the Daityas were overspread with the columns of dust that rose there. Hence, the number of soldiers could be conceived in the form "It is so much".
verses.commentary: Sense: The soldiers of the Daityas were overspread with the columns of dust that rose there. Hence, the number of soldiers could be conceived in the form "It is so much".

verses.sanskrit: मायायां चतुरो ऽसि त्वं चित्रयुद्धविशारद । कूटयुद्धे च निपुणस्तां स्त्रियं परिमर्दय
verses.transliteration: māyāyāṃ caturo 'si tvaṃ citrayuddhaviśārada / kūṭayuddhe ca nipuṇastāṃ striyaṃ parimardaya
verses.translation: Banners of ma ny varieties with the emblems offish, snake etc. fluttered in the dust columns like fishes in the great ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: Banners of ma ny varieties with the emblems offish, snake etc. fluttered in the dust columns like fishes in the great ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Banners of ma ny varieties with the emblems offish, snake etc. fluttered in the dust columns like fishes in the great ocean.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्वामिपुरस्तेन कुटिलाक्षेण देशितः । निर्जगाम पुरात्तूर्णं कुरण्डश्चण्डविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: iti svāmipurastena kuṭilākṣeṇa deśitaḥ / nirjagāma purāttūrṇaṃ kuraṇḍaścaṇḍavikramaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing them rushing at the army of Lalita, all the immortal ones (Suras) became frightened apprehending breakdown and collapse ofthe Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them rushing at the army of Lalita, all the immortal ones (Suras) became frightened apprehending breakdown and collapse ofthe Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them rushing at the army of Lalita, all the immortal ones (Suras) became frightened apprehending breakdown and collapse ofthe Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: विंशत्यक्षौहिणीभिश्च समन्तात्परिवारितः । मर्दयन्स महीगोलं हस्तिवाजिपदातिभिः । दुर्मदस्याग्रजश्चण्डः कुरण्डः समरं ययौ
verses.transliteration: viṃśatyakṣauhiṇībhiśca samantātparivāritaḥ / mardayansa mahīgolaṃ hastivājipadātibhiḥ / durmadasyāgrajaścaṇḍaḥ kuraṇḍaḥ samaraṃ yayau
verses.translation: The five haughty generals, the chief of whom was Karanka, created in the course of their fight a huge Maya (illusory demoness) named Sarpinl.
verses.wordMeaning: The five haughty generals, the chief of whom was Karanka, created in the course of their fight a huge Maya (illusory demoness) named Sarpinl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five haughty generals, the chief of whom was Karanka, created in the course of their fight a huge Maya (illusory demoness) named Sarpinl.

verses.sanskrit: दूलीभिस्तुमुलीकुर्वन्दिगन्तं धीरमानसः । शोकरोषग्रहग्रस्तो जवनाश्वगतो ययौ
verses.transliteration: dūlībhistumulīkurvandigantaṃ dhīramānasaḥ / śokaroṣagrahagrasto javanāśvagato yayau
verses.translation: Rolling on the ground at the front line of the:
verses.wordMeaning: Rolling on the ground at the front line of the:
verses.commentary: Sense: Rolling on the ground at the front line of the:

verses.sanskrit: शार्ङ्गं धनुः समादाय घोरटङ्कारमुत्स्वनम् । ववर्ष शरधारभिः संपत्कर्या महाचमूम्
verses.transliteration: śārṅgaṃ dhanuḥ samādāya ghoraṭaṅkāramutsvanam / vavarṣa śaradhārabhiḥ saṃpatkaryā mahācamūm
verses.translation: Then began the battle between the Saktis and the enemies of gods. They incited one another's excessively violent fury by one another's heroically boastful utterances.
verses.wordMeaning: Then began the battle between the Saktis and the enemies of gods. They incited one another's excessively violent fury by one another's heroically boastful utterances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then began the battle between the Saktis and the enemies of gods. They incited one another's excessively violent fury by one another's heroically boastful utterances.

verses.sanskrit: पापे मदनुजं हत्वा दुर्मदं युद्धदुर्मदम् । वृथा वहसि विक्रान्तिलवलेशं महामदम्
verses.transliteration: pāpe madanujaṃ hatvā durmadaṃ yuddhadurmadam / vṛthā vahasi vikrāntilavaleśaṃ mahāmadam
verses.translation: On account of excessive confusion and perplexity, Saktis and Danavas could not distinguish one another. With the weapons in their hands they began to strike indiscriminately.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of excessive confusion and perplexity, Saktis and Danavas could not distinguish one another. With the weapons in their hands they began to strike indiscriminately.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of excessive confusion and perplexity, Saktis and Danavas could not distinguish one another. With the weapons in their hands they began to strike indiscriminately.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं चैव भवतीमेतैर्नाराचमण्डलैः । अन्तकस्य पुरीमत्र प्रापयिष्यामि पश्य माम्
verses.transliteration: idānīṃ caiva bhavatīmetairnārācamaṇḍalaiḥ / antakasya purīmatra prāpayiṣyāmi paśya mām
verses.translation: Very terrific serpents with two faces and smoke- coloured bodies came out of the pair of eyes of Sarpini. They were extremely furious.
verses.wordMeaning: Very terrific serpents with two faces and smoke- coloured bodies came out of the pair of eyes of Sarpini. They were extremely furious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Very terrific serpents with two faces and smoke- coloured bodies came out of the pair of eyes of Sarpini. They were extremely furious.

verses.sanskrit: अतिहृद्यमतिस्वादु त्वद्वपुर्बिलनिर्गतम् । अपूर्वमङ्गनारक्तं पिबन्तु रणपूतनाः
verses.transliteration: atihṛdyamatisvādu tvadvapurbilanirgatam / apūrvamaṅganāraktaṃ pibantu raṇapūtanāḥ
verses.translation: Crores of serpents issued forth from the ear cavity of Sarpini. They had yellow colour and three hoods. Their mouths were hideous due to their fangs.
verses.wordMeaning: Crores of serpents issued forth from the ear cavity of Sarpini. They had yellow colour and three hoods. Their mouths were hideous due to their fangs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Crores of serpents issued forth from the ear cavity of Sarpini. They had yellow colour and three hoods. Their mouths were hideous due to their fangs.

verses.sanskrit: ममानुजवधोत्थस्य प्रत्यवायस्य तत्फलम् । अधुना भोक्ष्यसे दुष्टे पश्य मे भुजयोर्बलम्
verses.transliteration: mamānujavadhotthasya pratyavāyasya tatphalam / adhunā bhokṣyase duṣṭe paśya me bhujayorbalam
verses.translation: Other serpents of brindled and variegated colours, with four mouths and four feet issued forth from her nostrils. They had fierce splendour.
verses.wordMeaning: Other serpents of brindled and variegated colours, with four mouths and four feet issued forth from her nostrils. They had fierce splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other serpents of brindled and variegated colours, with four mouths and four feet issued forth from her nostrils. They had fierce splendour.

verses.sanskrit: इति संतर्जयन्संपत्करीं करिवरस्थिताम् । सैन्यं प्रोत्साहयामास शक्तिसेनाविमर्दने
verses.transliteration: iti saṃtarjayansaṃpatkarīṃ karivarasthitām / sainyaṃ protsāhayāmāsa śaktisenāvimardane
verses.translation: Though they were split and cut frequently by the crores of weapons of Saktis, they increased in number more and more. They then glided and crawled re- gaining the fullness and compactness of their original bodies. Many serpents died but others were born. At the death of one many others sprang up. Since the wicked Sarpini the root cause did not perish, other serpents were produced (in plenty) on the destruction of serpents (originally) created by her.
verses.wordMeaning: Though they were split and cut frequently by the crores of weapons of Saktis, they increased in number more and more. They then glided and crawled re- gaining the fullness and compactness of their original bodies. Many serpents died but others were born.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Though they were split and cut frequently by the crores of weapons of Saktis, they increased in number more and more. They then glided and crawled re- gaining the fullness and compactness of their original bodies. Many serpents died but others were born.…

verses.sanskrit: अथ तां पृतनां चण्डी कुरण्डस्य महौजसः । विमर्दयितुमुद्युक्ता स्वसैन्यं प्रोदसीसहत्
verses.transliteration: atha tāṃ pṛtanāṃ caṇḍī kuraṇḍasya mahaujasaḥ / vimardayitumudyuktā svasainyaṃ prodasīsahat
verses.translation: W. 30-32 give various varieties of poisons known in ancient India. They had regional varieties like Sauras{ra, Brahmaputra, etc.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 30-32 give various varieties of poisons known in ancient India. They had regional varieties like Sauras{ra, Brahmaputra, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 30-32 give various varieties of poisons known in ancient India. They had regional varieties like Sauras{ra, Brahmaputra, etc.

verses.sanskrit: अपुर्वाहवसंजातकौतुकाथ जगाद ताम् । अश्वरूढा समागत्य सस्नेहार्द्रमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration: apurvāhavasaṃjātakautukātha jagāda tām / aśvarūḍhā samāgatya sasnehārdramidaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Garuda whose elevated shoulders were occupied by her (goddess Nakull) and who could toss even mountains with his wings, moved ahead in the battle ground like a mobile Sumeru.
verses.wordMeaning: Garuda whose elevated shoulders were occupied by her (goddess Nakull) and who could toss even mountains with his wings, moved ahead in the battle ground like a mobile Sumeru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Garuda whose elevated shoulders were occupied by her (goddess Nakull) and who could toss even mountains with his wings, moved ahead in the battle ground like a mobile Sumeru.

verses.sanskrit: सखि संपत्करि प्रीत्या मम वाणी निशम्यतम् । अस्य युद्धमिदं देहि मम कर्तुं गुणोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sakhi saṃpatkari prītyā mama vāṇī niśamyatam / asya yuddhamidaṃ dehi mama kartuṃ guṇottaram
verses.translation: On seeing the dreadful serpents born of Maya of Sarpini, Nakull had her eyes turned red due to anger and she opened her mouth.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the dreadful serpents born of Maya of Sarpini, Nakull had her eyes turned red due to anger and she opened her mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the dreadful serpents born of Maya of Sarpini, Nakull had her eyes turned red due to anger and she opened her mouth.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं सहस्व समरे मयैवैष नियोत्स्यते । याचितासि सखित्वेन नात्र संशयमाचर
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇaṃ sahasva samare mayaivaiṣa niyotsyate / yācitāsi sakhitvena nātra saṃśayamācara
verses.translation: Thereupon, the tips of the thirtytwo teeth of goddess Snnakulldevl turned into thirtytwo crores of mongooses with golden lustre.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the tips of the thirtytwo teeth of goddess Snnakulldevl turned into thirtytwo crores of mongooses with golden lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the tips of the thirtytwo teeth of goddess Snnakulldevl turned into thirtytwo crores of mongooses with golden lustre.

verses.sanskrit: इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा संपद्देव्या शुचिस्मिता । निवर्तयामास चमूङ्कुरुण्डाभिमुखोत्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā saṃpaddevyā śucismitā / nivartayāmāsa camūṅkuruṇḍābhimukhotthitām
verses.translation: Cutting the groups of serpents of (demoness) Sarpini into pieces by means of the crushing power of their curved teeth and neutralizing their poison, golden ichneumons capable ofdispelling poison wandered here and there in the course of that dreadful war.
verses.wordMeaning: Cutting the groups of serpents of (demoness) Sarpini into pieces by means of the crushing power of their curved teeth and neutralizing their poison, golden ichneumons capable ofdispelling poison wandered here and there in the course of that dreadful war.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cutting the groups of serpents of (demoness) Sarpini into pieces by means of the crushing power of their curved teeth and neutralizing their poison, golden ichneumons capable ofdispelling poison wandered here and there in the course of that dreadful war.

verses.sanskrit: अथ बालार्कवर्णाभिः शक्तिभिः समधिष्ठिताः । तरङ्गा इव सैन्याब्धेस्तुरङ्गा वातरंहसः
verses.transliteration: atha bālārkavarṇābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ samadhiṣṭhitāḥ / taraṅgā iva sainyābdhesturaṅgā vātaraṃhasaḥ
verses.translation: Raising up their ears and shaking up their hairs on account of excessive fury, the elated mongooses opened their mouths and bit the serpents.
verses.wordMeaning: Raising up their ears and shaking up their hairs on account of excessive fury, the elated mongooses opened their mouths and bit the serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Raising up their ears and shaking up their hairs on account of excessive fury, the elated mongooses opened their mouths and bit the serpents.

verses.sanskrit: खरैः खुरपुटैः क्षोणीमुल्लिखन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः । पेतुरेकप्रवाहेण कुरण्डस्य चमूमुखे
verses.transliteration: kharaiḥ khurapuṭaiḥ kṣoṇīmullikhanto muhurmuhuḥ / peturekapravāheṇa kuraṇḍasya camūmukhe
verses.translation: For everyone of the illusory serpents there arose an ichneumon and it cut off the body (ofthe serpent) with the penetrating thrust ofits sharp teeth.
verses.wordMeaning: For everyone of the illusory serpents there arose an ichneumon and it cut off the body (ofthe serpent) with the penetrating thrust ofits sharp teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: For everyone of the illusory serpents there arose an ichneumon and it cut off the body (ofthe serpent) with the penetrating thrust ofits sharp teeth.

verses.sanskrit: वल्गाविभागकृत्येषु संवर्तनविवर्तने । घतिभेदेषु चारेषु पञ्चधा खुरपातने
verses.transliteration: valgāvibhāgakṛtyeṣu saṃvartanavivartane / ghatibhedeṣu cāreṣu pañcadhā khurapātane
verses.translation: With their tongues resembling tender sprouts, the mongooses began licking up the two corners of their mouths that had become red due to the drops of blood exuding from the bodies of serpents. Then theyjumped about and leapt in the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: With their tongues resembling tender sprouts, the mongooses began licking up the two corners of their mouths that had become red due to the drops of blood exuding from the bodies of serpents. Then theyjumped about and leapt in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their tongues resembling tender sprouts, the mongooses began licking up the two corners of their mouths that had become red due to the drops of blood exuding from the bodies of serpents. Then theyjumped about and leapt in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोत्साहने च संज्ञाभिः करपादाग्रयोनिभिः । चतुराभिस्तुरङ्गस्य हृदयज्ञाभिराहवे
verses.transliteration: protsāhane ca saṃjñābhiḥ karapādāgrayonibhiḥ / caturābhisturaṅgasya hṛdayajñābhirāhave
verses.translation: In the course ofthe battle, the jewels stuck on to the weighty hoods ofthe serpents shone even after they had been bitten to death by the groups of mongooses.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course ofthe battle, the jewels stuck on to the weighty hoods ofthe serpents shone even after they had been bitten to death by the groups of mongooses.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course ofthe battle, the jewels stuck on to the weighty hoods ofthe serpents shone even after they had been bitten to death by the groups of mongooses.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वारूढांबिकासैन्यशक्तिभिः सह दानवाः । प्रोत्साहिताः कुरण्डेन समयुध्यन्त दुर्मदाः
verses.transliteration: aśvārūḍhāṃbikāsainyaśaktibhiḥ saha dānavāḥ / protsāhitāḥ kuraṇḍena samayudhyanta durmadāḥ
verses.translation: With their coiled hoods shattered and forced out by the blows ofthe mongooses, the serpents appeared like the flames of fires of their own great treachery (mahddroha.)*
verses.wordMeaning: With their coiled hoods shattered and forced out by the blows ofthe mongooses, the serpents appeared like the flames of fires of their own great treachery (mahddroha.)*
verses.commentary: Sense: With their coiled hoods shattered and forced out by the blows ofthe mongooses, the serpents appeared like the flames of fires of their own great treachery (mahddroha.)*

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवृत्ते समरे शक्तीनां च सुरद्विषाम् । अपराजितनामानं हयमारुह्य वेगिनम् । अभ्यद्रवद्दुराचारमश्वारूढाः कुरण्डकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravṛtte samare śaktīnāṃ ca suradviṣām / aparājitanāmānaṃ hayamāruhya veginam / abhyadravaddurācāramaśvārūḍhāḥ kuraṇḍakam
verses.translation: When the magical and illusory groups of serpents were thus broken into pieces by the sets of ichneumons Sarpini became excessively angry.
verses.wordMeaning: When the magical and illusory groups of serpents were thus broken into pieces by the sets of ichneumons Sarpini became excessively angry.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the magical and illusory groups of serpents were thus broken into pieces by the sets of ichneumons Sarpini became excessively angry.

verses.sanskrit: प्रचलद्वेणिसुभगा शरच्चन्द्रकलोज्ज्वला । संध्यानुरक्तशीतांशुमण्डलीसुंदरानना
verses.transliteration: pracaladveṇisubhagā śaraccandrakalojjvalā / saṃdhyānuraktaśītāṃśumaṇḍalīsuṃdarānanā
verses.translation: After fighting a great battle with her, that goddess. Nakull fixed the extremely ruthless G&rua'a (having Garuda for its deity) missile to her arrow.
verses.wordMeaning: After fighting a great battle with her, that goddess. Nakull fixed the extremely ruthless G&rua'a (having Garuda for its deity) missile to her arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: After fighting a great battle with her, that goddess. Nakull fixed the extremely ruthless G&rua'a (having Garuda for its deity) missile to her arrow.

verses.sanskrit: स्मयमानेव समरे गृहीतमणिकार्मुका । अवाकिरच्छरासारैः कुरण्डं तुरगानना
verses.transliteration: smayamāneva samare gṛhītamaṇikārmukā / avākiraccharāsāraiḥ kuraṇḍaṃ turagānanā
verses.translation: That Garuda missile which illuminated the faces of
verses.wordMeaning: That Garuda missile which illuminated the faces of
verses.commentary: Sense: That Garuda missile which illuminated the faces of

verses.sanskrit: तुरगारूढयोत्क्षिप्ताः समाक्रामन्दिगन्तरान् । दिशो दश व्यानशिरे रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलीमुखाः
verses.transliteration: turagārūḍhayotkṣiptāḥ samākrāmandigantarān / diśo daśa vyānaśire rukmapuṅkhāḥ śilīmukhāḥ
verses.translation: With the destruction of the Maya Power, Sarpini got dissolved. On account of her destruction, the five excellent generals became furious.
verses.wordMeaning: With the destruction of the Maya Power, Sarpini got dissolved. On account of her destruction, the five excellent generals became furious.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the destruction of the Maya Power, Sarpini got dissolved. On account of her destruction, the five excellent generals became furious.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्मदस्याग्रजः क्रुद्धः कुरण्डश्चण्डविक्रमः । विशिखैः शार्ङ्गनिष्ठ्यूतैरश्वारूढा मवाकिरत्
verses.transliteration: durmadasyāgrajaḥ kruddhaḥ kuraṇḍaścaṇḍavikramaḥ / viśikhaiḥ śārṅganiṣṭhyūtairaśvārūḍhā mavākirat
verses.translation: That Sarpini by means ofwhose strength those gene- rals contemptuously disregarded all the Suras, was led to her death due to the prowess of mongooses (or of goddess NakulT).
verses.wordMeaning: That Sarpini by means ofwhose strength those gene- rals contemptuously disregarded all the Suras, was led to her death due to the prowess of mongooses (or of goddess NakulT).
verses.commentary: Sense: That Sarpini by means ofwhose strength those gene- rals contemptuously disregarded all the Suras, was led to her death due to the prowess of mongooses (or of goddess NakulT).

verses.sanskrit: चण्डैः खुरपुटैः सैन्यं खण्डयन्नतिवेगतः । अश्वारूढातुरङ्गो ऽपि मर्दयामास दानवान्
verses.transliteration: caṇḍaiḥ khurapuṭaiḥ sainyaṃ khaṇḍayannativegataḥ / aśvārūḍhāturaṅgo 'pi mardayāmāsa dānavān
verses.translation: Hence, those generals became excessively furious on account of the loss of their powerful support. With a united effort, they showered goddess NakulT by means of multitudes of weapons.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, those generals became excessively furious on account of the loss of their powerful support. With a united effort, they showered goddess NakulT by means of multitudes of weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, those generals became excessively furious on account of the loss of their powerful support. With a united effort, they showered goddess NakulT by means of multitudes of weapons.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या हेषारवाद्दूरमुत्पातांबुधिनिःस्वनः । अमूर्च्छयन्ननेकानि तस्यानीतानि वैरिणः
verses.transliteration: tasyā heṣāravāddūramutpātāṃbudhiniḥsvanaḥ / amūrcchayannanekāni tasyānītāni vairiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Seated on her Garuda chariot, that heroine of the army fought with all the five though she was alone. With great deal of dexterity she showered weapons and missiles.
verses.wordMeaning: Seated on her Garuda chariot, that heroine of the army fought with all the five though she was alone. With great deal of dexterity she showered weapons and missiles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated on her Garuda chariot, that heroine of the army fought with all the five though she was alone. With great deal of dexterity she showered weapons and missiles.

verses.sanskrit: इतस्ततः प्रचलितैर्दैत्यचक्रे हयासना । निजं पाशायुधं दिव्यं मुमोच ज्वलिताकृति
verses.transliteration: itastataḥ pracalitairdaityacakre hayāsanā / nijaṃ pāśāyudhaṃ divyaṃ mumoca jvalitākṛti
verses.translation: She showered and wielded thousands of missiles and weapons such as spears with sharp edges, pestles and javelins. With her adamantine teeth, she bit them in their weak and vulnerable vital parts.
verses.wordMeaning: She showered and wielded thousands of missiles and weapons such as spears with sharp edges, pestles and javelins. With her adamantine teeth, she bit them in their weak and vulnerable vital parts.
verses.commentary: Sense: She showered and wielded thousands of missiles and weapons such as spears with sharp edges, pestles and javelins. With her adamantine teeth, she bit them in their weak and vulnerable vital parts.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पाशात्कोटिशो ऽन्ये पाशा भुजगभीषणाः । समस्तमपि तत्सैन्यं बद्ध्वाबद्ध्वा व्यमूर्छयन्
verses.transliteration: tasmātpāśātkoṭiśo 'nye pāśā bhujagabhīṣaṇāḥ / samastamapi tatsainyaṃ baddhvābaddhvā vyamūrchayan
verses.translation: Thereupon, the servants ofthe Daitya king yelled out dreadfully piteous cries of agony, as they were tortured by the mongooses of formidable power.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the servants ofthe Daitya king yelled out dreadfully piteous cries of agony, as they were tortured by the mongooses of formidable power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the servants ofthe Daitya king yelled out dreadfully piteous cries of agony, as they were tortured by the mongooses of formidable power.

verses.sanskrit: थ सैनिकबन्धेन क्रुद्धः स च कुरण्डकः । सरेणैकेन चिच्छेद तस्या मणिधनुर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: tha sainikabandhena kruddhaḥ sa ca kuraṇḍakaḥ / sareṇaikena ciccheda tasyā maṇidhanurguṇam
verses.translation: Some of the mongooses with blazing fury leaped from the sky with terrible shrieks and began biting the army of their enemies. Some mongooses entered the open mouths ofthe enemies. They pulled at them as if they were bodies of serpents and bit the bottoms of their tongues.
verses.wordMeaning: Some of the mongooses with blazing fury leaped from the sky with terrible shrieks and began biting the army of their enemies. Some mongooses entered the open mouths ofthe enemies. They pulled at them as if they were bodies of serpents and bit the bottoms of their tongues.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of the mongooses with blazing fury leaped from the sky with terrible shrieks and began biting the army of their enemies. Some mongooses entered the open mouths ofthe enemies. They pulled at them as if they were bodies of serpents and bit the bottoms of their tongues.

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नमौर्वि धनुस्त्यक्त्वा भृशङ्क्रुद्धा हयासना । अङ्कुशं पातयामास तस्य वक्षसि दुर्मतेः
verses.transliteration: chinnamaurvi dhanustyaktvā bhṛśaṅkruddhā hayāsanā / aṅkuśaṃ pātayāmāsa tasya vakṣasi durmateḥ
verses.translation: Other mongooses entered the ears ofthe enemies of the Devas. Ichneumons of very small size entered the different pores oftheir bodies.
verses.wordMeaning: Other mongooses entered the ears ofthe enemies of the Devas. Ichneumons of very small size entered the different pores oftheir bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other mongooses entered the ears ofthe enemies of the Devas. Ichneumons of very small size entered the different pores oftheir bodies.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाङ्कुशेन ज्वलता पीतजीवितशोणितः । कुरण्डो न्यपतद्भूमौ वज्ररुग्ण इव द्रुमः
verses.transliteration: tenāṅkuśena jvalatā pītajīvitaśoṇitaḥ / kuraṇḍo nyapatadbhūmau vajrarugṇa iva drumaḥ
verses.translation: On observing his own armies assailed and cast into wretched condition by the mongooses, Kararika became angry. Thereupon, goddess Nakull, the sole deity of speech and language, (identical with Sarasvatl) became very furious at the retreat of the mongooses.
verses.wordMeaning: On observing his own armies assailed and cast into wretched condition by the mongooses, Kararika became angry. Thereupon, goddess Nakull, the sole deity of speech and language, (identical with Sarasvatl) became very furious at the retreat of the mongooses.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing his own armies assailed and cast into wretched condition by the mongooses, Kararika became angry. Thereupon, goddess Nakull, the sole deity of speech and language, (identical with Sarasvatl) became very furious at the retreat of the mongooses.

verses.sanskrit: तदङ्कुशविनिष्ठ्यूताः पुतनाः काश्चिदुद्भटाः । तत्सैन्यं पाशनिष्यन्दं भक्षयित्वा क्षयं गताः
verses.transliteration: tadaṅkuśaviniṣṭhyūtāḥ putanāḥ kāścidudbhaṭāḥ / tatsainyaṃ pāśaniṣyandaṃ bhakṣayitvā kṣayaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: She fixed a great missile named Aksinanakula (undi- minishing (unending mongoose) to her Sarriga bow. The missile had faces (points) alt round and, its tip was enveloped by flames of fire.
verses.wordMeaning: She fixed a great missile named Aksinanakula (undi- minishing (unending mongoose) to her Sarriga bow. The missile had faces (points) alt round and, its tip was enveloped by flames of fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fixed a great missile named Aksinanakula (undi- minishing (unending mongoose) to her Sarriga bow. The missile had faces (points) alt round and, its tip was enveloped by flames of fire.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं कुरुण्डे निहते विंशत्यक्षौहिणीपतौ । हतावशिष्टास्ते दैत्याः प्रपलायन्त वै द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ kuruṇḍe nihate viṃśatyakṣauhiṇīpatau / hatāvaśiṣṭāste daityāḥ prapalāyanta vai drutam
verses.translation: Wounded and ruined in every limb by those crores Fighting witll them in various ways goddess Nakull chopped offthehard head ofKararika by means of her sharp edged spear.
verses.wordMeaning: Wounded and ruined in every limb by those crores Fighting witll them in various ways goddess Nakull chopped offthehard head ofKararika by means of her sharp edged spear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wounded and ruined in every limb by those crores Fighting witll them in various ways goddess Nakull chopped offthehard head ofKararika by means of her sharp edged spear.

verses.sanskrit: कुरण्डं सानुजं युद्धे शक्तिसैन्यैर्निपातितम् । श्रुत्वा शून्यकनाथो ऽपि निशश्वास भुजङ्गवत्
verses.transliteration: kuraṇḍaṃ sānujaṃ yuddhe śaktisainyairnipātitam / śrutvā śūnyakanātho 'pi niśaśvāsa bhujaṅgavat
verses.translation: Flying up seated on Garuda, she cut offwith her sword the heads of the other four enemies alsd'of whom Kakava. Sita was the chief.
verses.wordMeaning: Flying up seated on Garuda, she cut offwith her sword the heads of the other four enemies alsd'of whom Kakava. Sita was the chief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Flying up seated on Garuda, she cut offwith her sword the heads of the other four enemies alsd'of whom Kakava. Sita was the chief.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने दुर्मदकुरण्डवधो नाम द्वाविंशो ऽध्यायः अथाश्वरूढया क्षिप्ते कुरण्डे भण्डदानवः । कुटिलाक्षमिदं प्रोचे पुनरेव युयुत्सया
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne durmadakuraṇḍavadho nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ athāśvarūḍhayā kṣipte kuraṇḍe bhaṇḍadānavaḥ / kuṭilākṣamidaṃ proce punareva yuyutsayā
verses.translation: Arrangements should be made by ministers and priests for evil rites of Black magic. Equip yourself fully with weapons and missiles. The war is imminent.
verses.wordMeaning: Arrangements should be made by ministers and priests for evil rites of Black magic. Equip yourself fully with weapons and missiles. The war is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arrangements should be made by ministers and priests for evil rites of Black magic. Equip yourself fully with weapons and missiles. The war is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्ने ऽपि यन्न संभाव्यं यन्न श्रुतमितः पुरा । यच्च नो शङ्कितं चित्ते तदेतत्कष्टमागतम्
verses.transliteration: svapne 'pi yanna saṃbhāvyaṃ yanna śrutamitaḥ purā / yacca no śaṅkitaṃ citte tadetatkaṣṭamāgatam
verses.translation: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.wordMeaning: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.
verses.commentary: Sense: Send ahead someone from the commanders of the armies along with many divisions of soldiers. Let him be formidable and dreadful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: कुरण्डदुर्मदौ सत्त्वशालिनौ भ्रातरौ हितौ । दुष्टदास्याः प्रभावो ऽयं मायाविन्या महत्तरः
verses.transliteration: kuraṇḍadurmadau sattvaśālinau bhrātarau hitau / duṣṭadāsyāḥ prabhāvo 'yaṃ māyāvinyā mahattaraḥ
verses.translation: The sound ofthe war-drums ofthe Daityas suppressed the cardinal points, pierced the caves of mountains and over- whelmed the extensive firmament.
verses.wordMeaning: The sound ofthe war-drums ofthe Daityas suppressed the cardinal points, pierced the caves of mountains and over- whelmed the extensive firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sound ofthe war-drums ofthe Daityas suppressed the cardinal points, pierced the caves of mountains and over- whelmed the extensive firmament.

verses.sanskrit: इतः परं करङ्कादीन्पञ्चसेनाधिनायकान् । शतमक्षौहिणीनां च प्रस्थापय रणाङ्गणे
verses.transliteration: itaḥ paraṃ karaṅkādīnpañcasenādhināyakān / śatamakṣauhiṇīnāṃ ca prasthāpaya raṇāṅgaṇe
verses.translation: Thejhallarl (a kind ofdrum*) of the demons pro- duced a loud, harsh and discordant sound resembling the proud roar of infuriated Huthkara of the great Man-lion (Visnu).
verses.wordMeaning: Thejhallarl (a kind ofdrum*) of the demons pro- duced a loud, harsh and discordant sound resembling the proud roar of infuriated Huthkara of the great Man-lion (Visnu).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thejhallarl (a kind ofdrum*) of the demons pro- duced a loud, harsh and discordant sound resembling the proud roar of infuriated Huthkara of the great Man-lion (Visnu).

verses.sanskrit: ते युद्धदुर्मदाः शूराः संग्रामेषु तनुत्यजः । सर्वथैव विजेष्यन्ते दुर्विदग्धविलासिनीम्
verses.transliteration: te yuddhadurmadāḥ śūrāḥ saṃgrāmeṣu tanutyajaḥ / sarvathaiva vijeṣyante durvidagdhavilāsinīm
verses.translation: Thereupon, crores of Daityas producing reverberating chattering noise furiously prepared themselves (to fight) against Paramesvarl (Lalita).
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, crores of Daityas producing reverberating chattering noise furiously prepared themselves (to fight) against Paramesvarl (Lalita).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, crores of Daityas producing reverberating chattering noise furiously prepared themselves (to fight) against Paramesvarl (Lalita).

verses.sanskrit: इति भण्डवचः श्रुत्वा भृशं चत्वरयान्वितः । कुटिलाक्षः करङ्कादीनाजुहाव चमूपतीन्
verses.transliteration: iti bhaṇḍavacaḥ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ catvarayānvitaḥ / kuṭilākṣaḥ karaṅkādīnājuhāva camūpatīn
verses.translation: One of them covered himself with a coat of mail wonderfully studded with gems and jewels of various kinds and colours. He shone like a mobile lofty Rohana mountain (Adam's peak in Ceylon).
verses.wordMeaning: One of them covered himself with a coat of mail wonderfully studded with gems and jewels of various kinds and colours. He shone like a mobile lofty Rohana mountain (Adam's peak in Ceylon).
verses.commentary: Sense: One of them covered himself with a coat of mail wonderfully studded with gems and jewels of various kinds and colours. He shone like a mobile lofty Rohana mountain (Adam's peak in Ceylon).

verses.sanskrit: ते स्वामिनं नमस्कृत्य कुटिलाक्षेण देशिताः । अग्नौ प्रविष्णव इव क्रोधान्धा निर्ययुः पुरात्
verses.transliteration: te svāminaṃ namaskṛtya kuṭilākṣeṇa deśitāḥ / agnau praviṣṇava iva krodhāndhā niryayuḥ purāt
verses.translation: A certain soldier shook arid waved an extremely bright and glistening sword that wasjerrible like the Kdlaratri (Night of destruction) and that had been preserved well by the weapon maker.
verses.wordMeaning: A certain soldier shook arid waved an extremely bright and glistening sword that wasjerrible like the Kdlaratri (Night of destruction) and that had been preserved well by the weapon maker.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain soldier shook arid waved an extremely bright and glistening sword that wasjerrible like the Kdlaratri (Night of destruction) and that had been preserved well by the weapon maker.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां प्रयाणनिःसाणरणितं भृशदुःसहम् । आकर्ण्य दिग्गजास्तूर्णं शीर्णकर्णा जुघूर्णिरे
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ prayāṇaniḥsāṇaraṇitaṃ bhṛśaduḥsaham / ākarṇya diggajāstūrṇaṃ śīrṇakarṇā jughūrṇire
verses.translation: Stroking the tip of his spear by means of his fingers, a certain soldier mounted on a horse'displayed different kinds of movement in the street.
verses.wordMeaning: Stroking the tip of his spear by means of his fingers, a certain soldier mounted on a horse'displayed different kinds of movement in the street.
verses.commentary: Sense: Stroking the tip of his spear by means of his fingers, a certain soldier mounted on a horse'displayed different kinds of movement in the street.

verses.sanskrit: शतमक्षौहिणीनां च प्राचलत्केतुमालकम् । उत्तरङ्गतुरङ्गादि बभौ मत्तमतङ्गजम्
verses.transliteration: śatamakṣauhiṇīnāṃ ca prācalatketumālakam / uttaraṅgaturaṅgādi babhau mattamataṅgajam
verses.translation: Some soldiers rode on elephants of huge-sized bodies as though on mountains propelled and tossed about by the violent gusts of winds of portentous phenomena.
verses.wordMeaning: Some soldiers rode on elephants of huge-sized bodies as though on mountains propelled and tossed about by the violent gusts of winds of portentous phenomena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some soldiers rode on elephants of huge-sized bodies as though on mountains propelled and tossed about by the violent gusts of winds of portentous phenomena.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रेषमाणहयाकीर्णं क्रन्दद्भटकुलोद्भवम् । बृंहमाणगजं गर्जद्रथयक्रं चचाल तत्
verses.transliteration: hreṣamāṇahayākīrṇaṃ krandadbhaṭakulodbhavam / bṛṃhamāṇagajaṃ garjadrathayakraṃ cacāla tat
verses.translation: W. 10-19a give a list of weapons used in mediaeval India. The varieties of arrows, use of fire-arms and projectiles are note-worthy.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 10-19a give a list of weapons used in mediaeval India. The varieties of arrows, use of fire-arms and projectiles are note-worthy.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 10-19a give a list of weapons used in mediaeval India. The varieties of arrows, use of fire-arms and projectiles are note-worthy.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रनेमिहतक्षोणीरेणुक्षपितरोचिषा । बभूवे तुहिनासारच्छन्नेनेव विवस्वता
verses.transliteration: cakranemihatakṣoṇīreṇukṣapitarociṣā / babhūve tuhināsāracchanneneva vivasvatā
verses.translation: Accompanied by those exceedingly mighty soldiers ofleonine strength, who appeared to be desirous of burning the entire universe, that general proceeded towards Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by those exceedingly mighty soldiers ofleonine strength, who appeared to be desirous of burning the entire universe, that general proceeded towards Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by those exceedingly mighty soldiers ofleonine strength, who appeared to be desirous of burning the entire universe, that general proceeded towards Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: धूलीमयमिवाशेषमभवद्विश्वमण्डलम् । क्वचिच्छब्दमयं चैव निःसाणकठिनस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: dhūlīmayamivāśeṣamabhavadviśvamaṇḍalam / kvacicchabdamayaṃ caiva niḥsāṇakaṭhinasvanaiḥ
verses.translation: Splitting and piercing the fourteen worlds by means of loud sounds ofbig war-drums and shouting and howling along with boisterous laughs, Durmada went in her direction.
verses.wordMeaning: Splitting and piercing the fourteen worlds by means of loud sounds ofbig war-drums and shouting and howling along with boisterous laughs, Durmada went in her direction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Splitting and piercing the fourteen worlds by means of loud sounds ofbig war-drums and shouting and howling along with boisterous laughs, Durmada went in her direction.

verses.sanskrit: उद्भूतैर्धूलिकाजालैराक्रान्ता दैत्यसैनिकाः । इयत्तयातः सेनायाः संख्यापि परिभाविता
verses.transliteration: udbhūtairdhūlikājālairākrāntā daityasainikāḥ / iyattayātaḥ senāyāḥ saṃkhyāpi paribhāvitā
verses.translation: Thereafter, on being commanded by Bhandasura, Kutilaksa of great strength deployed Talajarigha along with ten Aksauhinls at the Eastern entrance to the city of Sunyaka for the sake of its protection.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, on being commanded by Bhandasura, Kutilaksa of great strength deployed Talajarigha along with ten Aksauhinls at the Eastern entrance to the city of Sunyaka for the sake of its protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, on being commanded by Bhandasura, Kutilaksa of great strength deployed Talajarigha along with ten Aksauhinls at the Eastern entrance to the city of Sunyaka for the sake of its protection.

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजा बहुविधाकारा मीनव्यालादिचित्रिताः । प्रचेलुर्धूलिकाजाले मत्स्या इव महोदधौ
verses.transliteration: dhvajā bahuvidhākārā mīnavyālādicitritāḥ / pracelurdhūlikājāle matsyā iva mahodadhau
verses.translation: At the southern entrance to the city, he empolyed a Daitya named Talabhuja accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, for its protection.
verses.wordMeaning: At the southern entrance to the city, he empolyed a Daitya named Talabhuja accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, for its protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the southern entrance to the city, he empolyed a Daitya named Talabhuja accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, for its protection.

verses.sanskrit: तानापतत आलोक्य ललितासैनिकं प्रति । वित्रेसुरमराः सर्वे शक्तीनां भङ्गशङ्कया
verses.transliteration: tānāpatata ālokya lalitāsainikaṃ prati / vitresuramarāḥ sarve śaktīnāṃ bhaṅgaśaṅkayā
verses.translation: At the western entrance to the city, he appointed the Daitya named Talagrlva along with ten Aksauhinls for its protection.
verses.wordMeaning: At the western entrance to the city, he appointed the Daitya named Talagrlva along with ten Aksauhinls for its protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the western entrance to the city, he appointed the Daitya named Talagrlva along with ten Aksauhinls for its protection.

verses.sanskrit: ते करङ्कमुखाः पञ्च सेनापतय उद्धताः । सर्पिणीं नाम समरे मायां चक्रुर्महीयसीम्
verses.transliteration: te karaṅkamukhāḥ pañca senāpataya uddhatāḥ / sarpiṇīṃ nāma samare māyāṃ cakrurmahīyasīm
verses.translation: He directed Talaketu, the exceedingly powerful (Daitya), to be at the northern entrance to the city along with
verses.wordMeaning: He directed Talaketu, the exceedingly powerful (Daitya), to be at the northern entrance to the city along with
verses.commentary: Sense: He directed Talaketu, the exceedingly powerful (Daitya), to be at the northern entrance to the city along with

verses.sanskrit: तैः समुत्पतिता दुष्टा सर्पिणी रमशांबरी । धूम्रवर्णा च धूम्रोष्ठी धूम्रवर्मपयोधरा
verses.transliteration: taiḥ samutpatitā duṣṭā sarpiṇī ramaśāṃbarī / dhūmravarṇā ca dhūmroṣṭhī dhūmravarmapayodharā
verses.translation: He directed ten Aksauhinls to stay in a circle along the rampart wall in the cubicles and bunks over the copings.
verses.wordMeaning: He directed ten Aksauhinls to stay in a circle along the rampart wall in the cubicles and bunks over the copings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He directed ten Aksauhinls to stay in a circle along the rampart wall in the cubicles and bunks over the copings.

verses.sanskrit: महोदधिरिवात्यन्तं गंभीरकुहरोदरी । पुरश्चचाल शक्तीनान्त्रासयन्ती मनो रणे
verses.transliteration: mahodadhirivātyantaṃ gaṃbhīrakuharodarī / puraścacāla śaktīnāntrāsayantī mano raṇe
verses.translation: Thus, by means of fifty Aksauhinls of soldiers, he
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, by means of fifty Aksauhinls of soldiers, he
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, by means of fifty Aksauhinls of soldiers, he

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूरिवापरा दुष्टा बहुसर्पविभूषणा । सर्पाणामुद्भवस्थानं मायामयशरीरिणाम्
verses.transliteration: kadrūrivāparā duṣṭā bahusarpavibhūṣaṇā / sarpāṇāmudbhavasthānaṃ māyāmayaśarīriṇām
verses.translation: "O Lord, at the behest of your Majesty, armies have been deployed for the defence of the city. At the outset Durmada has already been despatched towards that wicked Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, at the behest of your Majesty, armies have been deployed for the defence of the city. At the outset Durmada has already been despatched towards that wicked Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, at the behest of your Majesty, armies have been deployed for the defence of the city. At the outset Durmada has already been despatched towards that wicked Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: सेनापतीनां नासीरे वेल्लयन्तीमहीतले । वेल्लितं बहुधा चक्रे घोरारावविराविणी
verses.transliteration: senāpatīnāṃ nāsīre vellayantīmahītale / vellitaṃ bahudhā cakre ghorārāvavirāviṇī
verses.translation: That frail woman can easily be made frustrated merely by means of our domestic servants, yet the royal con- vention is that proper arrangement for the defence of the city should be made."
verses.wordMeaning: That frail woman can easily be made frustrated merely by means of our domestic servants, yet the royal con- vention is that proper arrangement for the defence of the city should be made."
verses.commentary: Sense: That frail woman can easily be made frustrated merely by means of our domestic servants, yet the royal con- vention is that proper arrangement for the defence of the city should be made."

verses.sanskrit: तथैव मायया पूर्वं ते ऽसुरेद्रा व्यजीजयन् । करङ्काद्या दुरात्मानः पञ्चपञ्चत्त्वकामुकाः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva māyayā pūrvaṃ te 'suredrā vyajījayan / karaṅkādyā durātmānaḥ pañcapañcattvakāmukāḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus to Bhanda, the ruler of the Daityas, the excessively haughty Kutilaksa, accompanied by the commanding officers of different divisions of the army kept the entire army on the alert'and ready to act.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to Bhanda, the ruler of the Daityas, the excessively haughty Kutilaksa, accompanied by the commanding officers of different divisions of the army kept the entire army on the alert'and ready to act.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to Bhanda, the ruler of the Daityas, the excessively haughty Kutilaksa, accompanied by the commanding officers of different divisions of the army kept the entire army on the alert'and ready to act.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रववृते युद्धं शक्तीनाममरद्रुहाम् । अन्योन्यवीरभाषाभिः प्रोत्साहितघनक्रुधाम्
verses.transliteration: atha pravavṛte yuddhaṃ śaktīnāmamaradruhām / anyonyavīrabhāṣābhiḥ protsāhitaghanakrudhām
verses.translation: A Danava had previously been sent as a messenger* by Kutilaksa. In the company of an army, with tumultuous uproar, he had encircled the army of Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: A Danava had previously been sent as a messenger* by Kutilaksa. In the company of an army, with tumultuous uproar, he had encircled the army of Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Danava had previously been sent as a messenger* by Kutilaksa. In the company of an army, with tumultuous uproar, he had encircled the army of Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तसंकुलतया न विज्ञातपरस्पराः । शक्तयो दानवश्चैव प्रजहुः शस्त्रपाणयः
verses.transliteration: atyantasaṃkulatayā na vijñātaparasparāḥ / śaktayo dānavaścaiva prajahuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ
verses.translation: With a great clatter and clutter, thousands of Daitya soldiers waved their swords and fell on the soldiers of Sakti.
verses.wordMeaning: With a great clatter and clutter, thousands of Daitya soldiers waved their swords and fell on the soldiers of Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a great clatter and clutter, thousands of Daitya soldiers waved their swords and fell on the soldiers of Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यशस्त्रसंघट्टसमुत्थितहुताशने । प्रवृत्तविशिखस्रोतःप्रच्छन्नहरिदन्तरे
verses.transliteration: anyonyaśastrasaṃghaṭṭasamutthitahutāśane / pravṛttaviśikhasrotaḥpracchannaharidantare
verses.translation: Those dreadful Saktis with boisterous laughters and shouts, fought with the Danavas with their swords gleaming brightly.
verses.wordMeaning: Those dreadful Saktis with boisterous laughters and shouts, fought with the Danavas with their swords gleaming brightly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those dreadful Saktis with boisterous laughters and shouts, fought with the Danavas with their swords gleaming brightly.

verses.sanskrit: बहुरक्तनदीपूरह्रियमाणमतङ्गजे । मांसकर्दमनिर्मग्ननिष्पन्दरथमण्डले
verses.transliteration: bahuraktanadīpūrahriyamāṇamataṅgaje / māṃsakardamanirmagnaniṣpandarathamaṇḍale
verses.translation: In the course of that war between Saktis and Danavas, the three worlds became exceedingly agitated and heavy dust spread throughout the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of that war between Saktis and Danavas, the three worlds became exceedingly agitated and heavy dust spread throughout the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of that war between Saktis and Danavas, the three worlds became exceedingly agitated and heavy dust spread throughout the sky.

verses.sanskrit: विकीर्णकेशशैवालविलसद्रक्तनिर्झरे । अतिनिष्ठुरविध्वंसि सिंहनादभयङ्करे
verses.transliteration: vikīrṇakeśaśaivālavilasadraktanirjhare / atiniṣṭhuravidhvaṃsi siṃhanādabhayaṅkare
verses.translation: Intensified in the shafts of the chariots, amplified by the trumpets of elephants and scattered by the deep breaths of the horses, the dust columns rose up in the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: Intensified in the shafts of the chariots, amplified by the trumpets of elephants and scattered by the deep breaths of the horses, the dust columns rose up in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Intensified in the shafts of the chariots, amplified by the trumpets of elephants and scattered by the deep breaths of the horses, the dust columns rose up in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: रजो ऽन्धकारतु मुले राक्षसीतृप्तिदायिनि । शस्त्रीशरणिविच्छिन्नदैत्यकण्ठोत्थितासृजि
verses.transliteration: rajo 'ndhakāratu mule rākṣasītṛptidāyini / śastrīśaraṇivicchinnadaityakaṇṭhotthitāsṛji
verses.translation: On seeing him rushing in accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, Sampatsarasvatl furiously ran towards him in the battlefield.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him rushing in accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, Sampatsarasvatl furiously ran towards him in the battlefield.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him rushing in accompanied by ten Aksauhinls, Sampatsarasvatl furiously ran towards him in the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्ते घोरसंग्रामे शक्तीनां च सुरद्विषाम् । अथस्वबलमादाय पञ्चभिः प्रेरिता सती । सर्पिणी बहुधा सर्पान्विससर्ज शरीरतः
verses.transliteration: pravṛtte ghorasaṃgrāme śaktīnāṃ ca suradviṣām / athasvabalamādāya pañcabhiḥ preritā satī / sarpiṇī bahudhā sarpānvisasarja śarīrataḥ
verses.translation: Horses and elephants in their rut occupied (and guided) by the Saktis equal (in strength) to SampatkarT thrashed and smashed the army of Danavas.
verses.wordMeaning: Horses and elephants in their rut occupied (and guided) by the Saktis equal (in strength) to SampatkarT thrashed and smashed the army of Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Horses and elephants in their rut occupied (and guided) by the Saktis equal (in strength) to SampatkarT thrashed and smashed the army of Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: तक्षकर्केटकसमा वासुकिप्रमुखत्विषः । नानाविधवपुर्वर्णा नानादृष्टिभयङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: takṣakarkeṭakasamā vāsukipramukhatviṣaḥ / nānāvidhavapurvarṇā nānādṛṣṭibhayaṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: Like the mass of flames of the Kalpa fire that enve- lops the fine ocean, the soldiers of Daityas surrounded the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: Like the mass of flames of the Kalpa fire that enve- lops the fine ocean, the soldiers of Daityas surrounded the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the mass of flames of the Kalpa fire that enve- lops the fine ocean, the soldiers of Daityas surrounded the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधविषज्वालानिर्दग्धभुवनत्रयाः । दारदं वत्सनाभं च कालकूटमथापरम्
verses.transliteration: nānāvidhaviṣajvālānirdagdhabhuvanatrayāḥ / dāradaṃ vatsanābhaṃ ca kālakūṭamathāparam
verses.translation: Heaps of heads of the Danavas rolled down on the battle-field when the necks (of Danavas) had been chopped off by the sharp edges of the brilliant weapons of the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: Heaps of heads of the Danavas rolled down on the battle-field when the necks (of Danavas) had been chopped off by the sharp edges of the brilliant weapons of the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Heaps of heads of the Danavas rolled down on the battle-field when the necks (of Danavas) had been chopped off by the sharp edges of the brilliant weapons of the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: सौराष्ट्रं च विषं घोरं ब्रह्मपुत्रमथापरम् । प्रतिपन्नं शौक्लिकेयमन्यान्यपि विषाणि च
verses.transliteration: saurāṣṭraṃ ca viṣaṃ ghoraṃ brahmaputramathāparam / pratipannaṃ śauklikeyamanyānyapi viṣāṇi ca
verses.translation: The battle-ground became entirely filled with heads with lips bitten (and firmly pressed by the teeth), terrible with knitted eyebrows and with eyes turned red due to fury.
verses.wordMeaning: The battle-ground became entirely filled with heads with lips bitten (and firmly pressed by the teeth), terrible with knitted eyebrows and with eyes turned red due to fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: The battle-ground became entirely filled with heads with lips bitten (and firmly pressed by the teeth), terrible with knitted eyebrows and with eyes turned red due to fury.

verses.sanskrit: व्यालैः स्वकीयवदनैर्विलोलरसनाद्वयैः । विकिरन्तः शक्तिसैन्ये विसम्रुः सर्पिणीतनोः
verses.transliteration: vyālaiḥ svakīyavadanairvilolarasanādvayaiḥ / vikirantaḥ śaktisainye visamruḥ sarpiṇītanoḥ
verses.translation: When the battle that terrified all worlds thus began, Saktis who became excessively furious thrashed and smashed the army of the Daityas.
verses.wordMeaning: When the battle that terrified all worlds thus began, Saktis who became excessively furious thrashed and smashed the army of the Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the battle that terrified all worlds thus began, Saktis who became excessively furious thrashed and smashed the army of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: धूम्रवर्णा द्विवदना सर्पा अतिभयङ्कराः । सर्पिण्या नयनद्वन्द्वा दुत्थिताः क्रोधदीपिताः
verses.transliteration: dhūmravarṇā dvivadanā sarpā atibhayaṅkarāḥ / sarpiṇyā nayanadvandvā dutthitāḥ krodhadīpitāḥ
verses.translation: Struck down by the weapons of Saktis and hit by the armies of goddess SampaddevI in this manner, the Danavas fell down senseless here and there and died there (on the battlefield).
verses.wordMeaning: Struck down by the weapons of Saktis and hit by the armies of goddess SampaddevI in this manner, the Danavas fell down senseless here and there and died there (on the battlefield).
verses.commentary: Sense: Struck down by the weapons of Saktis and hit by the armies of goddess SampaddevI in this manner, the Danavas fell down senseless here and there and died there (on the battlefield).

verses.sanskrit: पीतवर्णास्त्रिफणका दंष्ट्राभिर्विकटाननाः । सर्पिण्याः कर्णकुहरादुत्थिताः सर्पकोटयः
verses.transliteration: pītavarṇāstriphaṇakā daṃṣṭrābhirvikaṭānanāḥ / sarpiṇyāḥ karṇakuharādutthitāḥ sarpakoṭayaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, Durmada the suppressor of enemies encouraged his army that had been utterly vanquished and routed, mounted a camel immediately and rushed against the army (of Saktis).
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Durmada the suppressor of enemies encouraged his army that had been utterly vanquished and routed, mounted a camel immediately and rushed against the army (of Saktis).
