verses.sanskrit: शताक्षौहिणिके संख्ये ते स्वमात्रावशेषिताः । अतित्रासेन रोषेण गृहीताश्च चमूवराः । संग्राममधिकं तेनुः समाकृष्टशरासनाः
verses.transliteration: śatākṣauhiṇike saṃkhye te svamātrāvaśeṣitāḥ / atitrāsena roṣeṇa gṛhītāśca camūvarāḥ / saṃgrāmamadhikaṃ tenuḥ samākṛṣṭaśarāsanāḥ
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: तैः समं बहुधा युद्धं तन्वाना नकुलेश्वरी । पट्टिशेन करङ्कस्य चिच्छेद कठिनं शिरः
verses.transliteration: taiḥ samaṃ bahudhā yuddhaṃ tanvānā nakuleśvarī / paṭṭiśena karaṅkasya ciccheda kaṭhinaṃ śiraḥ
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: काकवाशितसुख्यानां चतुर्णामपि वैरिणाम् । उत्पत्योत्पत्य तार्क्ष्येण व्यलुनादसिना शिरः
verses.transliteration: kākavāśitasukhyānāṃ caturṇāmapi vairiṇām / utpatyotpatya tārkṣyeṇa vyalunādasinā śiraḥ
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशं लाघवं दृष्ट्वा नकुल्या श्यामलांबिका
verses.transliteration: tādṛśaṃ lāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā nakulyā śyāmalāṃbikā
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: बहु मेने महासत्त्वां दुष्टासुरविनाशिनीम् । निजाङ्गदेवतत्त्वं च तस्यै श्यामांबिका ददौ
verses.transliteration: bahu mene mahāsattvāṃ duṣṭāsuravināśinīm / nijāṅgadevatattvaṃ ca tasyai śyāmāṃbikā dadau
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: लोकोत्तरे गुणे दृष्टे कस्य न प्रीतिसंभवः । हतशिष्टा भीतभीता नकुलीशरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: lokottare guṇe dṛṣṭe kasya na prītisaṃbhavaḥ / hataśiṣṭā bhītabhītā nakulīśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: सापि तान्वीक्ष्य कृपया मा भैष्टेति विहस्य च । भवद्राज्ञे रणोदन्तमशेषं च निबोधत
verses.transliteration: sāpi tānvīkṣya kṛpayā mā bhaiṣṭeti vihasya ca / bhavadrājñe raṇodantamaśeṣaṃ ca nibodhata
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: तयैवं प्रेषिताः शीघ्रं तदालोक्य रणक्षितिम् । मुदितास्ते पुनर्भीत्या शून्यकायां पलायिताः
verses.transliteration: tayaivaṃ preṣitāḥ śīghraṃ tadālokya raṇakṣitim / muditāste punarbhītyā śūnyakāyāṃ palāyitāḥ
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: तदुदन्तं ततः श्रुत्वा भण्डश्चण्डो रुषाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tadudantaṃ tataḥ śrutvā bhaṇḍaścaṇḍo ruṣābhavat
verses.translation: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.wordMeaning: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fight between her (i.e. goddess) and Durmada was excessively intensified. Flames issued forth when the arrows came into clash with one another.

verses.sanskrit: इति ब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे ललितोपाख्याने करङ्कादिपञ्चसेनापतिवधो नाम त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः हतेषु तेषु रोषान्धो निश्वसञ्छून्यकेश्वरः । कुजलाशमिति प्रोचे युयुत्साव्याकुलाशयः
verses.transliteration: iti brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lalitopākhyāne karaṅkādipañcasenāpativadho nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ hateṣu teṣu roṣāndho niśvasañchūnyakeśvaraḥ / kujalāśamiti proce yuyutsāvyākulāśayaḥ
verses.translation: "When they were killed, the lord ofSunyaka became blind with fury. Heaving a deep sigh, he spoke thus to Kuti- laksa with his mind agitated on account ofhis eagerness for • war".
verses.wordMeaning: "When they were killed, the lord ofSunyaka became blind with fury. Heaving a deep sigh, he spoke thus to Kuti- laksa with his mind agitated on account ofhis eagerness for • war".
verses.commentary: Sense: "When they were killed, the lord ofSunyaka became blind with fury. Heaving a deep sigh, he spoke thus to Kuti- laksa with his mind agitated on account ofhis eagerness for • war".

verses.sanskrit: भद्र सेनापते ऽस्माकमभद्रं समुपागतम् । करङ्काद्यश्चमूनाथाः कन्दलद्भुजविक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: bhadra senāpate 'smākamabhadraṃ samupāgatam / karaṅkādyaścamūnāthāḥ kandaladbhujavikramāḥ
verses.translation: We have seven generals beginning with Balahaka. Send them to the battle-field as they have formidable power of arms.
verses.wordMeaning: We have seven generals beginning with Balahaka. Send them to the battle-field as they have formidable power of arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have seven generals beginning with Balahaka. Send them to the battle-field as they have formidable power of arms.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पिणीमायया सर्वगीर्वाणमदभञ्जनाः । पापीयस्या तया गूढमायया विनिपातिताः
verses.transliteration: sarpiṇīmāyayā sarvagīrvāṇamadabhañjanāḥ / pāpīyasyā tayā gūḍhamāyayā vinipātitāḥ
verses.translation: The chiefs and the soldiers in the army consisting of thirty Aksauhinis followed them then, scraping the region of clouds through the numerous banners and flags.
verses.wordMeaning: The chiefs and the soldiers in the army consisting of thirty Aksauhinis followed them then, scraping the region of clouds through the numerous banners and flags.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chiefs and the soldiers in the army consisting of thirty Aksauhinis followed them then, scraping the region of clouds through the numerous banners and flags.

verses.sanskrit: बलाहकप्रभृतयः सप्त ये सैनिकाधिपाः । तानुदग्रभुजासत्त्वान्प्राहिणु प्रधनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: balāhakaprabhṛtayaḥ sapta ye sainikādhipāḥ / tānudagrabhujāsattvānprāhiṇu pradhanaṃ prati
verses.translation: Through the sounds (beatings) of the different war- drums such as Bherl, Nihsanas, Tampottas, Panavasand Anakas, they rendered the entire universe full of qualities of the Ether (viz. sound) at every step.
verses.wordMeaning: Through the sounds (beatings) of the different war- drums such as Bherl, Nihsanas, Tampottas, Panavasand Anakas, they rendered the entire universe full of qualities of the Ether (viz. sound) at every step.
verses.commentary: Sense: Through the sounds (beatings) of the different war- drums such as Bherl, Nihsanas, Tampottas, Panavasand Anakas, they rendered the entire universe full of qualities of the Ether (viz. sound) at every step.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशतं चाक्षौहिणीनां प्रस्थापय सहैव तैः । ते मर्दयित्वा ललितासैन्यं मायापरायणाः
verses.transliteration: triśataṃ cākṣauhiṇīnāṃ prasthāpaya sahaiva taiḥ / te mardayitvā lalitāsainyaṃ māyāparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Taking the army consisting of thirty Aksauhinls, the extremely proud sons ofKTkasa started as though to enter Visva (the lord, i.e. to their death).
verses.wordMeaning: Taking the army consisting of thirty Aksauhinls, the extremely proud sons ofKTkasa started as though to enter Visva (the lord, i.e. to their death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the army consisting of thirty Aksauhinls, the extremely proud sons ofKTkasa started as though to enter Visva (the lord, i.e. to their death).

verses.sanskrit: अये विजयमाहार्य संप्राप्स्यन्ति ममान्तिकम् । कीकसगर्भसंजातास्ते प्रचण्डपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: aye vijayamāhārya saṃprāpsyanti mamāntikam / kīkasagarbhasaṃjātāste pracaṇḍaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: They were furious and hence they became red (in their face). Their armours were brightly illuminated by the suns' disc. Their weapons and ornaments glittered. Their hairs were tied up above heads. Thus the generals moved ahead.
verses.wordMeaning: They were furious and hence they became red (in their face). Their armours were brightly illuminated by the suns' disc. Their weapons and ornaments glittered. Their hairs were tied up above heads. Thus the generals moved ahead.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were furious and hence they became red (in their face). Their armours were brightly illuminated by the suns' disc. Their weapons and ornaments glittered. Their hairs were tied up above heads. Thus the generals moved ahead.

verses.sanskrit: बलाहकमुखाः सप्त भ्रातरो जयिनः सदा । तेषामवश्यं विजयो भविष्यति रणाङ्गणे
verses.transliteration: balāhakamukhāḥ sapta bhrātaro jayinaḥ sadā / teṣāmavaśyaṃ vijayo bhaviṣyati raṇāṅgaṇe
verses.translation: They hastened to the battle ground waving weapons in their hands. With great fury they rushed towards the army ofSaktis.
verses.wordMeaning: They hastened to the battle ground waving weapons in their hands. With great fury they rushed towards the army ofSaktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: They hastened to the battle ground waving weapons in their hands. With great fury they rushed towards the army ofSaktis.

verses.sanskrit: इति भण्डासुरेणोक्तः कुटिलाक्षः समाह्वयत् । बलाहकमुखान्सप्त सेनानाथान्मदोत्कटान्
verses.transliteration: iti bhaṇḍāsureṇoktaḥ kuṭilākṣaḥ samāhvayat / balāhakamukhānsapta senānāthānmadotkaṭān
verses.translation: With their loud shouts and shrieks they made the ten directions echo loudly. The proud Daityas (then) went to the place where the army ofgoddess was present.
verses.wordMeaning: With their loud shouts and shrieks they made the ten directions echo loudly. The proud Daityas (then) went to the place where the army ofgoddess was present.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their loud shouts and shrieks they made the ten directions echo loudly. The proud Daityas (then) went to the place where the army ofgoddess was present.

verses.sanskrit: बलाहकः प्रथमतस्तस्मा त्सूचीमुखो ऽपरः । अन्यः फालमुखश्चैव विकर्णो विकटाननः
verses.transliteration: balāhakaḥ prathamatastasmā tsūcīmukho 'paraḥ / anyaḥ phālamukhaścaiva vikarṇo vikaṭānanaḥ
verses.translation: A certain demon discharged ajavelin in the course of the battle. A certain Sakti cut off his javelin with an arrow. The same arrow killed him too.
verses.wordMeaning: A certain demon discharged ajavelin in the course of the battle. A certain Sakti cut off his javelin with an arrow. The same arrow killed him too.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain demon discharged ajavelin in the course of the battle. A certain Sakti cut off his javelin with an arrow. The same arrow killed him too.

verses.sanskrit: करालायुः करटकः सप्तैते वीर्यशालिनः । भण्डासुरं नमस्कृत्य युद्धकौतूहलोल्वणाः
verses.transliteration: karālāyuḥ karaṭakaḥ saptaite vīryaśālinaḥ / bhaṇḍāsuraṃ namaskṛtya yuddhakautūhalolvaṇāḥ
verses.translation: A certain Sakti riding on an elephant trained her elephant in the art of butting against mounds, on the broad chest of a wicked Daitya.
verses.wordMeaning: A certain Sakti riding on an elephant trained her elephant in the art of butting against mounds, on the broad chest of a wicked Daitya.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain Sakti riding on an elephant trained her elephant in the art of butting against mounds, on the broad chest of a wicked Daitya.

verses.sanskrit: कीकसासूनवः सर्वे भ्रातरो ऽन्योन्यमावृताः । अन्योन्यसुसहायाश्च निर्जगमुर्नगरान्तरात्
verses.transliteration: kīkasāsūnavaḥ sarve bhrātaro 'nyonyamāvṛtāḥ / anyonyasusahāyāśca nirjagamurnagarāntarāt
verses.translation: A certain Sakti suddenly struck in its forehead the elephant on which a soldier of the enemy was seated. She struck it with a sword and gave it the pleasure of heaven (i.e. killed it.)
verses.wordMeaning: A certain Sakti suddenly struck in its forehead the elephant on which a soldier of the enemy was seated. She struck it with a sword and gave it the pleasure of heaven (i.e. killed it.)
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain Sakti suddenly struck in its forehead the elephant on which a soldier of the enemy was seated. She struck it with a sword and gave it the pleasure of heaven (i.e. killed it.)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशाताक्षौहिणीसेनासेनान्यो ऽन्वगमंस्तदा । उल्लिखन्ति केतुजालैरंबरे घनमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: triśātākṣauhiṇīsenāsenānyo 'nvagamaṃstadā / ullikhanti ketujālairaṃbare ghanamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: (Defective text) Another Sakti exterminated the enemies with sharp arrows and granted pleasure to her dagger in her own Romdli (A line of hair on the abdomen above the navel (i.e. the dagger was given rest).
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective text) Another Sakti exterminated the enemies with sharp arrows and granted pleasure to her dagger in her own Romdli (A line of hair on the abdomen above the navel (i.e. the dagger was given rest).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective text) Another Sakti exterminated the enemies with sharp arrows and granted pleasure to her dagger in her own Romdli (A line of hair on the abdomen above the navel (i.e. the dagger was given rest).

verses.sanskrit: घोरसंग्रामिणीपादा घातैर्मर्दितभूतला । पिबन्ति धूलिकाजालैरशेषानपि सागरान्
verses.transliteration: ghorasaṃgrāmiṇīpādā ghātairmarditabhūtalā / pibanti dhūlikājālairaśeṣānapi sāgarān
verses.translation: With a blow ofher mace, certain Sakti smashed the chariot wheel ofher enemy and granted pleasure to her but- tocks with it (i.e. scratched it with it).
verses.wordMeaning: With a blow ofher mace, certain Sakti smashed the chariot wheel ofher enemy and granted pleasure to her but- tocks with it (i.e. scratched it with it).
verses.commentary: Sense: With a blow ofher mace, certain Sakti smashed the chariot wheel ofher enemy and granted pleasure to her but- tocks with it (i.e. scratched it with it).

verses.sanskrit: भेरीनिः साणतंपोट्टपणवानकनिस्वनैः । नभोगुणमयं विश्वमादधानाः पदेपदे
verses.transliteration: bherīniḥ sāṇataṃpoṭṭapaṇavānakanisvanaiḥ / nabhoguṇamayaṃ viśvamādadhānāḥ padepade
verses.translation: With her fierce sword a certain Sakti cut offthe pole, of the chariot ofa lordly Danava and enhanced the pleasure of the earth.
verses.wordMeaning: With her fierce sword a certain Sakti cut offthe pole, of the chariot ofa lordly Danava and enhanced the pleasure of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her fierce sword a certain Sakti cut offthe pole, of the chariot ofa lordly Danava and enhanced the pleasure of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशताक्षौहिणीसेनां तां गृहीत्वा मदेद्धताः । प्रवेष्टुमिव विश्वस्मिन्कैकसेयाः प्रतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: triśatākṣauhiṇīsenāṃ tāṃ gṛhītvā madeddhatāḥ / praveṣṭumiva viśvasminkaikaseyāḥ pratasthire
verses.translation: The army of Saktis infiltrated into the army of Daityas and the army of Daityas infiltrated into the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: The army of Saktis infiltrated into the army of Daityas and the army of Daityas infiltrated into the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: The army of Saktis infiltrated into the army of Daityas and the army of Daityas infiltrated into the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: धृतरोषारुणाः सूर्यमण्डलो द्दीप्तकङ्कटाः । उद्दीप्तशस्त्रभरणाश्चेलुर्द्दीप्तोर्ध्वकेशिनः
verses.transliteration: dhṛtaroṣāruṇāḥ sūryamaṇḍalo ddīptakaṅkaṭāḥ / uddīptaśastrabharaṇāścelurddīptordhvakeśinaḥ
verses.translation: The close intermingling of Saktis and the demons was like that ofwater and milk. During the time of fighting it confused both of them.
verses.wordMeaning: The close intermingling of Saktis and the demons was like that ofwater and milk. During the time of fighting it confused both of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The close intermingling of Saktis and the demons was like that ofwater and milk. During the time of fighting it confused both of them.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त लोकान्प्रमथितुं प्रोषिताः पूर्वमुद्धताः । भण्डासुरेण महता जगद्विजयकारिणा
verses.transliteration: sapta lokānpramathituṃ proṣitāḥ pūrvamuddhatāḥ / bhaṇḍāsureṇa mahatā jagadvijayakāriṇā
verses.translation: When the trunks and the tusks ofthe mad elephants of the Daityas were cut off by the swords of Saktis they appeared like huge boars.
verses.wordMeaning: When the trunks and the tusks ofthe mad elephants of the Daityas were cut off by the swords of Saktis they appeared like huge boars.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the trunks and the tusks ofthe mad elephants of the Daityas were cut off by the swords of Saktis they appeared like huge boars.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तलोकविमर्देन तेन दृष्ट्वा महाबलाः । प्रोषिता ललितासैन्यं जेतुकामेन दुर्धिया
verses.transliteration: saptalokavimardena tena dṛṣṭvā mahābalāḥ / proṣitā lalitāsainyaṃ jetukāmena durdhiyā
verses.translation: Samharagupta the huge vulture of cruel eyes bore Balahaka who kept the bow well drawn in the course of the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Samharagupta the huge vulture of cruel eyes bore Balahaka who kept the bow well drawn in the course of the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samharagupta the huge vulture of cruel eyes bore Balahaka who kept the bow well drawn in the course of the battle.

verses.sanskrit: ते पतन्तो रणतलमुच्चलच्छत्रपाणयः । शक्तिसेनामभिमुखं सक्रोधमभिदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration: te patanto raṇatalamuccalacchatrapāṇayaḥ / śaktisenāmabhimukhaṃ sakrodhamabhidudruvuḥ
verses.translation: Seated on the back of vulture with his body moving up and down, Balahaka appeared like the Balahaka cloud (at the time of dissolution) clinging to a Kuta mountain with wings.
verses.wordMeaning: Seated on the back of vulture with his body moving up and down, Balahaka appeared like the Balahaka cloud (at the time of dissolution) clinging to a Kuta mountain with wings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated on the back of vulture with his body moving up and down, Balahaka appeared like the Balahaka cloud (at the time of dissolution) clinging to a Kuta mountain with wings.

verses.sanskrit: मुहुः किलकिलाराबैर्घोषयन्तो दिशो दश । देव्यास्तु सैनिकं यत्र तत्र ते जगमुरुद्धताः
verses.transliteration: muhuḥ kilakilārābairghoṣayanto diśo daśa / devyāstu sainikaṃ yatra tatra te jagamuruddhatāḥ
verses.translation: The leading Daitya, Suclmukha mounted on his vehicle crow. The root of its wings was as sharp (hard) as needle. Riding on this he fought a hard battle.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Daitya, Suclmukha mounted on his vehicle crow. The root of its wings was as sharp (hard) as needle. Riding on this he fought a hard battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Daitya, Suclmukha mounted on his vehicle crow. The root of its wings was as sharp (hard) as needle. Riding on this he fought a hard battle.

verses.sanskrit: सैन्यं च ललितादेव्याः सन्नद्धं शास्त्रभीषणम् । अभ्यमित्रीणमभवद्बद्धभ्रुकुटिनिष्ठुरम्
verses.transliteration: sainyaṃ ca lalitādevyāḥ sannaddhaṃ śāstrabhīṣaṇam / abhyamitrīṇamabhavadbaddhabhrukuṭiniṣṭhuram
verses.translation: Then (the next general) Phalamukha took up a ploughshare as his weapon. Riding on a heron resembling a mountain, he shone brilliantly in the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Then (the next general) Phalamukha took up a ploughshare as his weapon. Riding on a heron resembling a mountain, he shone brilliantly in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then (the next general) Phalamukha took up a ploughshare as his weapon. Riding on a heron resembling a mountain, he shone brilliantly in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: पाशिन्यो मुसलिन्यश्च चक्रिण्यश्चापरा मुने । मुद्गरिण्यः पट्टिशिन्यः कोदण्डिन्यस्तथापराः
verses.transliteration: pāśinyo musalinyaśca cakriṇyaścāparā mune / mudgariṇyaḥ paṭṭiśinyaḥ kodaṇḍinyastathāparāḥ
verses.translation: The leading Daitya named Vikarna, the extremely mighty general, rode on his vehicle the Bherunda bird and fought a fierce battle.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Daitya named Vikarna, the extremely mighty general, rode on his vehicle the Bherunda bird and fought a fierce battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Daitya named Vikarna, the extremely mighty general, rode on his vehicle the Bherunda bird and fought a fierce battle.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकाःशक्तयस्तीव्रा ललितासैन्यसंगताः । पिबन्त्य इव दैत्याब्धिं सान्निपेतुः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: anekāḥśaktayastīvrā lalitāsainyasaṃgatāḥ / pibantya iva daityābdhiṃ sānnipetuḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: A fierce cock of extremely dreadful nature bore (the
verses.wordMeaning: A fierce cock of extremely dreadful nature bore (the
verses.commentary: Sense: A fierce cock of extremely dreadful nature bore (the

verses.sanskrit: आयातायात हे दुष्टाः पापिन्यो वनिताधमाः । मायापरिग्रहैर्दूरं मोहयन्त्यो जडाशयान्
verses.transliteration: āyātāyāta he duṣṭāḥ pāpinyo vanitādhamāḥ / māyāparigrahairdūraṃ mohayantyo jaḍāśayān
verses.translation: Surveying the army of Saktis from the front with blazing eyes, and roaring loudly, the cock moved about mak- ing the hairs on its neck stand on their ends.
verses.wordMeaning: Surveying the army of Saktis from the front with blazing eyes, and roaring loudly, the cock moved about mak- ing the hairs on its neck stand on their ends.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surveying the army of Saktis from the front with blazing eyes, and roaring loudly, the cock moved about mak- ing the hairs on its neck stand on their ends.

verses.sanskrit: नेष्यामो भवतीरद्य प्रेतनाथनिकेतनम् । श्वसद्भुजगसंकाशैर्बाणैर त्यन्तभीषणैः । इति शक्तीर्भर्त्सयन्तो दानवाश्चक्रुराहवम्
verses.transliteration: neṣyāmo bhavatīradya pretanāthaniketanam / śvasadbhujagasaṃkāśairbāṇaira tyantabhīṣaṇaiḥ / iti śaktīrbhartsayanto dānavāścakrurāhavam
verses.translation: Thus, these seven evil-souled haughty Danavas, comparable to the seven oceans, harassed and tormented the soldiers of Saktis there.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, these seven evil-souled haughty Danavas, comparable to the seven oceans, harassed and tormented the soldiers of Saktis there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, these seven evil-souled haughty Danavas, comparable to the seven oceans, harassed and tormented the soldiers of Saktis there.

verses.sanskrit: काचिच्चिच्छेद दैत्येन्द्रं कण्ठे पट्टिशपातनात् । तद्गलोद्गलितो रक्तपूर ऊर्ध्वमुखो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kācicciccheda daityendraṃ kaṇṭhe paṭṭiśapātanāt / tadgalodgalito raktapūra ūrdhvamukho 'bhavat
verses.translation: Formerly, these seven Daityas had propitiated the sun-god by means of penance. Boon had been granted to them by the sun-god who had been pleased with their penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, these seven Daityas had propitiated the sun-god by means of penance. Boon had been granted to them by the sun-god who had been pleased with their penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, these seven Daityas had propitiated the sun-god by means of penance. Boon had been granted to them by the sun-god who had been pleased with their penance.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र लग्ना बहुतरा गृध्रा मण्डलतां गताः । तैरेव प्रेतनाथस्य च्छत्रच्छविरुदञ्चिता
verses.transliteration: tatra lagnā bahutarā gṛdhrā maṇḍalatāṃ gatāḥ / taireva pretanāthasya cchatracchavirudañcitā
verses.translation: Looked at by them when eyes had been penetrated and occupied by the sungod, the innumerable weapons of Saktis became immobilized and they found their zeal (in war) futile.
verses.wordMeaning: Looked at by them when eyes had been penetrated and occupied by the sungod, the innumerable weapons of Saktis became immobilized and they found their zeal (in war) futile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Looked at by them when eyes had been penetrated and occupied by the sungod, the innumerable weapons of Saktis became immobilized and they found their zeal (in war) futile.

verses.sanskrit: काचिच्छक्तिः मुरारातिं मुक्तशक्त्यायुधं रणे । लूनतच्छक्तिनैकेन बाणेन व्यलुनीत च
verses.transliteration: kācicchaktiḥ murārātiṃ muktaśaktyāyudhaṃ raṇe / lūnatacchaktinaikena bāṇena vyalunīta ca
verses.translation: When the missiles and weapons were blocked and immobilized by those seven sons of KIkasa, of great inherent strength, Saktis could not exert themselves.
verses.wordMeaning: When the missiles and weapons were blocked and immobilized by those seven sons of KIkasa, of great inherent strength, Saktis could not exert themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the missiles and weapons were blocked and immobilized by those seven sons of KIkasa, of great inherent strength, Saktis could not exert themselves.

verses.sanskrit: एका तु गजमारूढा कस्यचिद्दैत्यदुर्मतेः । उरःस्थले स्वकरिणा वप्राघातमशिक्षयत्
verses.transliteration: ekā tu gajamārūḍhā kasyaciddaityadurmateḥ / uraḥsthale svakariṇā vaprāghātamaśikṣayat
verses.translation: Even when they exerted themselves they were over- come much by the immobilization of their weapons. So Saktis heaved a deep sigh and sat quiet.
verses.wordMeaning: Even when they exerted themselves they were over- come much by the immobilization of their weapons. So Saktis heaved a deep sigh and sat quiet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when they exerted themselves they were over- come much by the immobilization of their weapons. So Saktis heaved a deep sigh and sat quiet.

verses.sanskrit: काचित्प्रतिभटारूढं दन्तिनं कुंभसीमनि । खड्गेन सहसा हत्वा गजस्य स्वप्रियं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: kācitpratibhaṭārūḍhaṃ dantinaṃ kuṃbhasīmani / khaḍgena sahasā hatvā gajasya svapriyaṃ vyadhāt
verses.translation: Thereupon, finding a suitable opportunity, the Daityas who were directed by their masters, rose up with different kinds of weapons and smashed the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, finding a suitable opportunity, the Daityas who were directed by their masters, rose up with different kinds of weapons and smashed the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, finding a suitable opportunity, the Daityas who were directed by their masters, rose up with different kinds of weapons and smashed the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: करमुक्तेन चक्रेण कस्यचिद्देववैरिणः । धनुर्दण्डं द्विधा कृत्वा स्वभ्रुवोः प्रतिमां तनेत्
verses.transliteration: karamuktena cakreṇa kasyaciddevavairiṇaḥ / dhanurdaṇḍaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā svabhruvoḥ pratimāṃ tanet
verses.translation: Those Saktis who were deprived oftheir activity and who were prevented from using their weapons became perplexed and agitated on account of their arrows that could pierce even adamantine coats of mail.
verses.wordMeaning: Those Saktis who were deprived oftheir activity and who were prevented from using their weapons became perplexed and agitated on account of their arrows that could pierce even adamantine coats of mail.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Saktis who were deprived oftheir activity and who were prevented from using their weapons became perplexed and agitated on account of their arrows that could pierce even adamantine coats of mail.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिरन्या शरैः शातैः शातयित्वा विरोधिनः । कृपाणपद्मा रोमाल्यां स्वकीयायां मुदं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: śaktiranyā śaraiḥ śātaiḥ śātayitvā virodhinaḥ / kṛpāṇapadmā romālyāṃ svakīyāyāṃ mudaṃ vyadhāt
verses.translation: The Saktis whose bodies had been wounded and pierced by the numerous weapons of Daityas in the battle field appeared like the creepers ofKarikola with plenty of good sprouts.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis whose bodies had been wounded and pierced by the numerous weapons of Daityas in the battle field appeared like the creepers ofKarikola with plenty of good sprouts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis whose bodies had been wounded and pierced by the numerous weapons of Daityas in the battle field appeared like the creepers ofKarikola with plenty of good sprouts.

verses.sanskrit: काचिन्मुद्गरपातेन चूर्णयित्वा विरोधिनः । रथ्यक्रनितंबस्य स्वस्य तेनातनोन्मुदम्
verses.transliteration: kācinmudgarapātena cūrṇayitvā virodhinaḥ / rathyakranitaṃbasya svasya tenātanonmudam
verses.translation: All those Saktis whose weapons were immobilized by them shrieked and wailed. Crying piteously, they resorted to goddess Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: All those Saktis whose weapons were immobilized by them shrieked and wailed. Crying piteously, they resorted to goddess Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those Saktis whose weapons were immobilized by them shrieked and wailed. Crying piteously, they resorted to goddess Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: रथकूबरमुग्रेण कस्यचिद्दानवप्रभोः । खड्गेन छिन्दती स्वस्य प्रियमुव्यास्ततान ह
verses.transliteration: rathakūbaramugreṇa kasyaciddānavaprabhoḥ / khaḍgena chindatī svasya priyamuvyāstatāna ha
verses.translation: Then, at the bidding of the goddess, the deity Tiras- karanika (Magical veil), the body-guard of Dandanatha rose up in the arena oft he battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, at the bidding of the goddess, the deity Tiras- karanika (Magical veil), the body-guard of Dandanatha rose up in the arena oft he battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, at the bidding of the goddess, the deity Tiras- karanika (Magical veil), the body-guard of Dandanatha rose up in the arena oft he battle.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यन्तरं शक्तिसेना दैत्यानां प्रविवेश ह । प्रविवेश च दैत्यानां सेना शक्तिबलान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: abhyantaraṃ śaktisenā daityānāṃ praviveśa ha / praviveśa ca daityānāṃ senā śaktibalāntaram
verses.translation: That Mahamaya (great deity of magical powers) got into an aerial chariot named Tamolipta with doors all round and assured Saktis about freedom from fear.
verses.wordMeaning: That Mahamaya (great deity of magical powers) got into an aerial chariot named Tamolipta with doors all round and assured Saktis about freedom from fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Mahamaya (great deity of magical powers) got into an aerial chariot named Tamolipta with doors all round and assured Saktis about freedom from fear.

verses.sanskrit: नीरक्षीरवदत्यन्ताश्लेषं शक्तिसुरद्विषाम् । संकुलाकारतां प्राप्तो युद्धकाले ऽभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: nīrakṣīravadatyantāśleṣaṃ śaktisuradviṣām / saṃkulākāratāṃ prāpto yuddhakāle 'bhavattadā
verses.translation: The Daityas were unable to bear the arrows that had the form and features of black serpents, that resembled iron clubs at their lower ends and that charged with the missile Mohana.
verses.wordMeaning: The Daityas were unable to bear the arrows that had the form and features of black serpents, that resembled iron clubs at their lower ends and that charged with the missile Mohana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Daityas were unable to bear the arrows that had the form and features of black serpents, that resembled iron clubs at their lower ends and that charged with the missile Mohana.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तीनां खड्गपातेन लूनशुण्डारदद्वयाः । दैत्यानां करिणो मत्ता महाक्रोडा इवाभवन्
verses.transliteration: śaktīnāṃ khaḍgapātena lūnaśuṇḍāradadvayāḥ / daityānāṃ kariṇo mattā mahākroḍā ivābhavan
verses.translation: Thereafter, at the bidding of Dandanatha, the deity, Mother TiraskaranI discharged the great missile named Andha ( Blindingone) amidst the group ofenemies.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, at the bidding of Dandanatha, the deity, Mother TiraskaranI discharged the great missile named Andha ( Blindingone) amidst the group ofenemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, at the bidding of Dandanatha, the deity, Mother TiraskaranI discharged the great missile named Andha ( Blindingone) amidst the group ofenemies.

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवृत्ते समरे वीराणां च भयङ्करे । अशक्ये स्मर्तुमप्यन्तं कातरत्ववतां नृणाम् । भीषणानां भीषणे च शस्त्रव्यापारदुर्गमे
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravṛtte samare vīrāṇāṃ ca bhayaṅkare / aśakye smartumapyantaṃ kātaratvavatāṃ nṛṇām / bhīṣaṇānāṃ bhīṣaṇe ca śastravyāpāradurgame
verses.translation: Their eyes were afflicted by the blinding arrows that were discharged from the bow Mahamohana of the goddess Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: Their eyes were afflicted by the blinding arrows that were discharged from the bow Mahamohana of the goddess Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their eyes were afflicted by the blinding arrows that were discharged from the bow Mahamohana of the goddess Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: बलाहको महागृध्रं वज्रतीक्ष्णमुखादिकम् । कालदण्डोपमं जङ्घाकाण्डे चण्डपराक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: balāhako mahāgṛdhraṃ vajratīkṣṇamukhādikam / kāladaṇḍopamaṃ jaṅghākāṇḍe caṇḍaparākramam
verses.translation: All those seven became blinded. They did not look at anything. In the absence of that vision, the immobilization of weapons came to an end.
verses.wordMeaning: All those seven became blinded. They did not look at anything. In the absence of that vision, the immobilization of weapons came to an end.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those seven became blinded. They did not look at anything. In the absence of that vision, the immobilization of weapons came to an end.

verses.sanskrit: संहारगुप्तनामानं पूर्वमग्रे समुत्थितम् । धूमवद्धूसराकारं पक्षक्षेपभयङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhāraguptanāmānaṃ pūrvamagre samutthitam / dhūmavaddhūsarākāraṃ pakṣakṣepabhayaṅkaram
verses.translation: Once again those (Saktis) raised weapons in their hands roaring like lions. With a desire to kill Daityas, they made preparations for the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Once again those (Saktis) raised weapons in their hands roaring like lions. With a desire to kill Daityas, they made preparations for the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once again those (Saktis) raised weapons in their hands roaring like lions. With a desire to kill Daityas, they made preparations for the battle.

verses.sanskrit: आरुह्य विविधंयुद्धं कृतवान्युद्धदुर्मदः । पक्षौ वितत्य क्रोशार्धं स स्थितो भीमनिःस्वनैः । अङ्गारकुण्डवच्चञ्चुं विदार्याभक्षयच्चमूम्
verses.transliteration: āruhya vividhaṃyuddhaṃ kṛtavānyuddhadurmadaḥ / pakṣau vitatya krośārdhaṃ sa sthito bhīmaniḥsvanaiḥ / aṅgārakuṇḍavaccañcuṃ vidāryābhakṣayaccamūm
verses.translation: They kept the deity Tiraskaranika of great might in front of them. Due to the use of that good (effective) means, they became extremely delighted and fought.
verses.wordMeaning: They kept the deity Tiraskaranika of great might in front of them. Due to the use of that good (effective) means, they became extremely delighted and fought.
verses.commentary: Sense: They kept the deity Tiraskaranika of great might in front of them. Due to the use of that good (effective) means, they became extremely delighted and fought.

verses.sanskrit: संहारगुप्तं स महागृध्रः क्रूरविलोचनः । बलाहकमुवाहोच्चैराकृष्टधनुषं रणे
verses.transliteration: saṃhāraguptaṃ sa mahāgṛdhraḥ krūravilocanaḥ / balāhakamuvāhoccairākṛṣṭadhanuṣaṃ raṇe
verses.translation: "O Mother Tiraskarnika ofexalted fortune well done, "well done. You have appropriately screened off these wicked- souled enemies.
verses.wordMeaning: "O Mother Tiraskarnika ofexalted fortune well done, "well done. You have appropriately screened off these wicked- souled enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Mother Tiraskarnika ofexalted fortune well done, "well done. You have appropriately screened off these wicked- souled enemies.

verses.sanskrit: बलाहको वपुर्धुन्वन्गृध्रपृष्ठकृतस्थितिः । सपक्षकूटशैलस्थो बलाहक इवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: balāhako vapurdhunvangṛdhrapṛṣṭhakṛtasthitiḥ / sapakṣakūṭaśailastho balāhaka ivābhavat
verses.translation: You are the great medicinal herb for screening (blinding) the eyes ofthe wicked. This troop of Daityas has been blinded by you.
verses.wordMeaning: You are the great medicinal herb for screening (blinding) the eyes ofthe wicked. This troop of Daityas has been blinded by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the great medicinal herb for screening (blinding) the eyes ofthe wicked. This troop of Daityas has been blinded by you.

verses.sanskrit: सूचीमुखश्च दैत्येन्द्रः सूचीनिष्ठुरपक्षतिम् । काकवाहनमारुह्य कठिनं समरं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: sūcīmukhaśca daityendraḥ sūcīniṣṭhurapakṣatim / kākavāhanamāruhya kaṭhinaṃ samaraṃ vyadhāt
verses.translation: O deity, this task ofthe Devas has been perfectly carried out by you since you have brought a disaster among these Daityas who cannot be conquered by us.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity, this task ofthe Devas has been perfectly carried out by you since you have brought a disaster among these Daityas who cannot be conquered by us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity, this task ofthe Devas has been perfectly carried out by you since you have brought a disaster among these Daityas who cannot be conquered by us.

verses.sanskrit: मत्तः पर्वतशृङ्गाभश्चञ्चूदण्डं समुद्वहन् । कालदण्डप्रमाणेन जङ्घाकाण्डेन भीषणः
verses.transliteration: mattaḥ parvataśṛṅgābhaścañcūdaṇḍaṃ samudvahan / kāladaṇḍapramāṇena jaṅghākāṇḍena bhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, you alone, do kill these seven Daityas in the arena ofbattle. Raising up our weapons we shall destroy the entire army of these Daityas".
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you alone, do kill these seven Daityas in the arena ofbattle. Raising up our weapons we shall destroy the entire army of these Daityas".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you alone, do kill these seven Daityas in the arena ofbattle. Raising up our weapons we shall destroy the entire army of these Daityas".

verses.sanskrit: पुष्कलावर्तकसमा जंबालसदृशद्यतिः । क्रोशमात्रायतौ पक्षावुभावपि समुद्वहन्
verses.transliteration: puṣkalāvartakasamā jaṃbālasadṛśadyatiḥ / krośamātrāyatau pakṣāvubhāvapi samudvahan
verses.translation: Oh being told thus and encouraged by those Saktis on account of their zeal for war (that deity Tiraskaranika) proceeded towards the army of Balahaka by means of the vehicle Tamolipta.
verses.wordMeaning: Oh being told thus and encouraged by those Saktis on account of their zeal for war (that deity Tiraskaranika) proceeded towards the army of Balahaka by means of the vehicle Tamolipta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Oh being told thus and encouraged by those Saktis on account of their zeal for war (that deity Tiraskaranika) proceeded towards the army of Balahaka by means of the vehicle Tamolipta.

verses.sanskrit: सूचीमुखाधिष्ठितो ऽसौ करटः कटुवासितः । मर्दयञ्चञ्चुघातेन शक्तीनां मण्डलं महत्
verses.transliteration: sūcīmukhādhiṣṭhito 'sau karaṭaḥ kaṭuvāsitaḥ / mardayañcañcughātena śaktīnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ mahat
verses.translation: On seeing her advancing, those seven base Asuras immediately remembered the boon granted by the sun god.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her advancing, those seven base Asuras immediately remembered the boon granted by the sun god.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her advancing, those seven base Asuras immediately remembered the boon granted by the sun god.

verses.sanskrit: अथो फलमुखः फालं गृहीत्वा निजमायुधम् । कङ्कमारुह्य समरे चकाशे गिरिसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: atho phalamukhaḥ phālaṃ gṛhītvā nijamāyudham / kaṅkamāruhya samare cakāśe girisannibham
verses.translation: Although the splendour ofthe sun entered their eyes, that destructive power within the eyes was overcome when the eyes had been covered by the prowess of Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: Although the splendour ofthe sun entered their eyes, that destructive power within the eyes was overcome when the eyes had been covered by the prowess of Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the splendour ofthe sun entered their eyes, that destructive power within the eyes was overcome when the eyes had been covered by the prowess of Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: विकर्णाख्यश्च दैत्येन्द्रश्चमूभर्ता महाबलः । भेरुण्डपतनारूढः प्रचण्डयुद्धमातनोत्
verses.transliteration: vikarṇākhyaśca daityendraścamūbhartā mahābalaḥ / bheruṇḍapatanārūḍhaḥ pracaṇḍayuddhamātanot
verses.translation: The great asura Balahaka had formerly been blind due to his pride on being granted the boon as well as on account ofhis power ofweapons. He was blind due to anger also. Now he literally became blind on account of the missile (of the deity). Therefore, the deity Antardhidevata (i.e. Tiras- karanika) dragged him by his hairs and cut him off by means of Jier sword.
verses.wordMeaning: The great asura Balahaka had formerly been blind due to his pride on being granted the boon as well as on account ofhis power ofweapons. He was blind due to anger also. Now he literally became blind on account of the missile (of the deity). Therefore,…

verses.sanskrit: विकटानननामानं विलसत्पट्टिशायुधम् । उवाह समरे चण्डः कुक्कुटो ऽतिभयङ्करः
verses.transliteration: vikaṭānananāmānaṃ vilasatpaṭṭiśāyudham / uvāha samare caṇḍaḥ kukkuṭo 'tibhayaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: After cutting off, with an arrow, the head of his
verses.wordMeaning: After cutting off, with an arrow, the head of his
verses.commentary: Sense: After cutting off, with an arrow, the head of his

verses.sanskrit: गर्जन्कण्ठस्थरोमाणि हर्षयञ्ज्वलदीक्षणः । पश्यन्पुरः शक्तिसैन्यं चचाल चरणायुधः
verses.transliteration: garjankaṇṭhastharomāṇi harṣayañjvaladīkṣaṇaḥ / paśyanpuraḥ śaktisainyaṃ cacāla caraṇāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: After cutting off his hardhead with a blow of her sharp-edged spear, she gradually killed the other five Daityas too.
verses.wordMeaning: After cutting off his hardhead with a blow of her sharp-edged spear, she gradually killed the other five Daityas too.
verses.commentary: Sense: After cutting off his hardhead with a blow of her sharp-edged spear, she gradually killed the other five Daityas too.

verses.sanskrit: करालाक्षश्च भूभर्ता षष्ठो ऽत्यन्तगरिष्ठदः । वज्रनिष्ठुरघोषश्च प्राचलत्प्रेतवाहनः
verses.transliteration: karālākṣaśca bhūbhartā ṣaṣṭho 'tyantagariṣṭhadaḥ / vajraniṣṭhuraghoṣaśca prācalatpretavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: The deity Antardhidevata made a garland with the seven severed heads of the Daityas by joining one another by means of their own tresses. Wearing that garland round her neck she roared loudly.
verses.wordMeaning: The deity Antardhidevata made a garland with the seven severed heads of the Daityas by joining one another by means of their own tresses. Wearing that garland round her neck she roared loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity Antardhidevata made a garland with the seven severed heads of the Daityas by joining one another by means of their own tresses. Wearing that garland round her neck she roared loudly.

verses.sanskrit: श्मशानमन्त्रशूरेणतेन संसाधितः पुरा । प्रेतो भूतसमाविष्टस्तमुवाह रणाजिरे
verses.transliteration: śmaśānamantraśūreṇatena saṃsādhitaḥ purā / preto bhūtasamāviṣṭastamuvāha raṇājire
verses.translation: In the height of their fury, Saktis killed their army wholly and made many rivers of their blood flow.
verses.wordMeaning: In the height of their fury, Saktis killed their army wholly and made many rivers of their blood flow.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the height of their fury, Saktis killed their army wholly and made many rivers of their blood flow.

verses.sanskrit: अवाङ्मुखो दीर्घबाहुः प्रसारितपदद्वयः । प्रोतो वाहनतां प्राप्तःकरालाक्षमथावहत्
verses.transliteration: avāṅmukho dīrghabāhuḥ prasāritapadadvayaḥ / proto vāhanatāṃ prāptaḥkarālākṣamathāvahat
verses.translation: A few who survived the killing became utterly con- fused and frightened. In their extreme agony, they sought shcl-
verses.wordMeaning: A few who survived the killing became utterly con- fused and frightened. In their extreme agony, they sought shcl-
verses.commentary: Sense: A few who survived the killing became utterly con- fused and frightened. In their extreme agony, they sought shcl-

verses.sanskrit: अन्यः करटको नाम दैत्यसेनाशिखामणिः । सर्दयामास शक्तीनां सैन्यं वेतालवाहनः
verses.transliteration: anyaḥ karaṭako nāma daityasenāśikhāmaṇiḥ / sardayāmāsa śaktīnāṃ sainyaṃ vetālavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: Those Daityas who survived began to praise Daninl and Mahamaya again and again. They were pleased because they were able to receive the graceful blessing glance from her.
verses.wordMeaning: Those Daityas who survived began to praise Daninl and Mahamaya again and again. They were pleased because they were able to receive the graceful blessing glance from her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Daityas who survived began to praise Daninl and Mahamaya again and again. They were pleased because they were able to receive the graceful blessing glance from her.

verses.sanskrit: योजनायतमूर्तिः सन्वेतालः क्रूरलोचनः । श्मशानभूमौ वेतालो मन्त्रेणानेन साधितः
verses.transliteration: yojanāyatamūrtiḥ sanvetālaḥ krūralocanaḥ / śmaśānabhūmau vetālo mantreṇānena sādhitaḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: मर्दयामास पृतनां शक्तीनां तेन देशितः । तस्य वेतालवर्यस्य वर्तमान्ॐससीमनि । बहुधायुध्यत तदा शक्तिभिः सह दानवः
verses.transliteration: mardayāmāsa pṛtanāṃ śaktīnāṃ tena deśitaḥ / tasya vetālavaryasya vartamānoṃsasīmani / bahudhāyudhyata tadā śaktibhiḥ saha dānavaḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेते खलात्मानः सप्त सप्तार्णवोपमाः । शक्तीनां सैनिकं तत्र व्याकुलीचक्रुरुद्धताः
verses.transliteration: evamete khalātmānaḥ sapta saptārṇavopamāḥ / śaktīnāṃ sainikaṃ tatra vyākulīcakruruddhatāḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: ते सप्त पूर्वं तपसा सवितारमतोषयन् । तेन दत्तो वरस्तेषां तपस्तुष्टेन भास्वता
verses.transliteration: te sapta pūrvaṃ tapasā savitāramatoṣayan / tena datto varasteṣāṃ tapastuṣṭena bhāsvatā
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: कैकसेया महाभागा भवतां तपसाधुना । परितुष्टो ऽस्मि भद्रं वो भवन्तो वृणतां वरम्
verses.transliteration: kaikaseyā mahābhāgā bhavatāṃ tapasādhunā / parituṣṭo 'smi bhadraṃ vo bhavanto vṛṇatāṃ varam
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते दिननाथेन कैकसेयास्तपः कृशाः । प्रार्थयामासुरत्यर्थं दुर्दान्तं वरमीदृशम्
verses.transliteration: ityukte dinanāthena kaikaseyāstapaḥ kṛśāḥ / prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ durdāntaṃ varamīdṛśam
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: रणेषु सन्निधातव्यमस्माकं नेत्रकुक्षिषु । भवता घोरतेजोभिर्दहता प्रतिरोधिनः
verses.transliteration: raṇeṣu sannidhātavyamasmākaṃ netrakukṣiṣu / bhavatā ghoratejobhirdahatā pratirodhinaḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया यदा सन्निहितं तपनास्माकमक्षिषु । तदाक्षिविषयः सर्वो निश्चेष्टो भवतात्प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tvayā yadā sannihitaṃ tapanāsmākamakṣiṣu / tadākṣiviṣayaḥ sarvo niśceṣṭo bhavatātprabho
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्सान्निध्यसमिद्धेन नेत्रेणास्माकमीक्षिताः । स्तब्धशस्त्रा भविष्यन्ति प्रतिरोधकसैनिकाः
verses.transliteration: tvatsānnidhyasamiddhena netreṇāsmākamīkṣitāḥ / stabdhaśastrā bhaviṣyanti pratirodhakasainikāḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्तब्धेषु शस्त्रेषु वीक्षणादेव नः प्रभो । निश्चेष्टा रिपवो ऽस्माभिर्हन्तव्याः सुकरत्वतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ stabdheṣu śastreṣu vīkṣaṇādeva naḥ prabho / niśceṣṭā ripavo 'smābhirhantavyāḥ sukaratvataḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: इति पूर्वं वरः प्राप्तः कैकसेयौर्दिवाकरात् । वरदानेन ते तत्र युद्धे चेरुर्मधोद्धताः
verses.transliteration: iti pūrvaṃ varaḥ prāptaḥ kaikaseyaurdivākarāt / varadānena te tatra yuddhe cerurmadhoddhatāḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.transliteration: atha sūryasamāviṣṭanetraistestu nirīkṣitāḥ / śaktayaḥ stabdhaśastraughā viphalotsā hatāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: कीकसातनयैस्तैस्तु सप्तभिः सत्त्वशालिभिः । विष्टंभितास्त्रशस्त्राणां शक्तीनां नोद्यमो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kīkasātanayaistaistu saptabhiḥ sattvaśālibhiḥ / viṣṭaṃbhitāstraśastrāṇāṃ śaktīnāṃ nodyamo 'bhavat

verses.sanskrit: उद्यमे क्रियभाणे ऽपि शस्त्रस्तम्भेन भूयसा । अभिभूताः सनिश्वासं शक्तयो जोषमासत
verses.transliteration: udyame kriyabhāṇe 'pi śastrastambhena bhūyasā / abhibhūtāḥ saniśvāsaṃ śaktayo joṣamāsata

verses.sanskrit: अथ ते वासरं प्राप्य नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः । व्यमर्दयञ्छक्तिसैन्यं दैत्याः स्वस्वामिदेशिताः
verses.transliteration: atha te vāsaraṃ prāpya nānāpraharaṇodyatāḥ / vyamardayañchaktisainyaṃ daityāḥ svasvāmideśitāḥ

verses.sanskrit: शक्तयस्तास्तु सैन्येन निर्व्यापारा निरायुधाः । अक्षुभ्यन्त शरैस्तेषां वज्रकङ्कटभोदिभिः
verses.transliteration: śaktayastāstu sainyena nirvyāpārā nirāyudhāḥ / akṣubhyanta śaraisteṣāṃ vajrakaṅkaṭabhodibhiḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.transliteration: śaktayo daityaśastraudhairviddhagātrāḥ sṛtāmṛjaḥ / supallavā raṇe rejuḥ kaṅkolalatikā iva
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: हाहाकारं वितन्वत्यः प्रपन्ना ललितेश्वरीम् । चुक्रुशुः शक्तयः सर्वास्तैः स्तंभितनिजायुधाः

verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डिनीं च महामायां प्रशंसन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः । प्रसादमपरं चक्षुस्तस्या आदायपिप्रियुः
verses.transliteration: daṇḍinīṃ ca mahāmāyāṃ praśaṃsanti muhurmuhuḥ / prasādamaparaṃ cakṣustasyā ādāyapipriyuḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: साधुसाध्विति तत्रस्थाः शक्तयः कम्पमौलयः । तिरस्करणिकां देवीमश्लाघन्त पदेपदे
verses.transliteration: sādhusādhviti tatrasthāḥ śaktayaḥ kampamaulayaḥ / tiraskaraṇikāṃ devīmaślāghanta padepade
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने बलाहकादिसप्तसेनापतिवधो नाम चतुर्विंशो ऽध्यायः ततः श्रुत्वा वधं तेषां तपोबलवतामपि । न्यश्वसत्कृष्णसर्पेन्द्र इव भण्डो महासुरः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne balāhakādisaptasenāpativadho nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ tataḥ śrutvā vadhaṃ teṣāṃ tapobalavatāmapi / nyaśvasatkṛṣṇasarpendra iva bhaṇḍo mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: "Thereafter, on hearing the killing of those (Daityas) though they had the power of Penance, Bhanda, the great Asura, sighed deeply like the Lord of Black serpents.
verses.wordMeaning: "Thereafter, on hearing the killing of those (Daityas) though they had the power of Penance, Bhanda, the great Asura, sighed deeply like the Lord of Black serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Thereafter, on hearing the killing of those (Daityas) though they had the power of Penance, Bhanda, the great Asura, sighed deeply like the Lord of Black serpents.

verses.sanskrit: एकान्ते मन्त्रयामास स आहूय महोदरौ । भण्डः प्रचण्डशैण्डीर्यः काङ्क्षमाणो रणे जयम्
verses.transliteration: ekānte mantrayāmāsa sa āhūya mahodarau / bhaṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍaśaiṇḍīryaḥ kāṅkṣamāṇo raṇe jayam
verses.translation: This chapter describes how Nitya Saktis repulsed the surprise attack on the rear of the army by demons under Visanga, under cover of darkness.
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter describes how Nitya Saktis repulsed the surprise attack on the rear of the army by demons under Visanga, under cover of darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter describes how Nitya Saktis repulsed the surprise attack on the rear of the army by demons under Visanga, under cover of darkness.

verses.sanskrit: युवराजो ऽपि सक्रोधो विषङ्गेण यवीयसा । भण्डासुरं नमस्कृत्य मन्त्रस्थानमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: yuvarājo 'pi sakrodho viṣaṅgeṇa yavīyasā / bhaṇḍāsuraṃ namaskṛtya mantrasthānamupāgamat
verses.translation: Desirous ofvictory in the battle, Bhanda of fierce haughtiness, called his brothers and took counsel with them in a solitary place.
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous ofvictory in the battle, Bhanda of fierce haughtiness, called his brothers and took counsel with them in a solitary place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous ofvictory in the battle, Bhanda of fierce haughtiness, called his brothers and took counsel with them in a solitary place.

verses.sanskrit: अत्याप्तैर्मन्त्रिभिर्युक्तः कुटिलाक्षपुरःसरैः । ललिताविजये मन्त्रं चकार क्वथिताश्यः
verses.transliteration: atyāptairmantribhiryuktaḥ kuṭilākṣapuraḥsaraiḥ / lalitāvijaye mantraṃ cakāra kvathitāśyaḥ
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: भण्ड उवाच अहो बत कुलभ्रंशः समायातः सुरद्विषाम् । उपेक्षामधुना कर्तुं प्रवृत्तो बलवान्विधिः
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍa uvāca aho bata kulabhraṃśaḥ samāyātaḥ suradviṣām / upekṣāmadhunā kartuṃ pravṛtto balavānvidhiḥ
verses.translation: With his mind turbulently agitated (the lord of Daityas) held consultations with his very trustworthy ministers beginning with Kutilaksa regarding the conquest of Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: With his mind turbulently agitated (the lord of Daityas) held consultations with his very trustworthy ministers beginning with Kutilaksa regarding the conquest of Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his mind turbulently agitated (the lord of Daityas) held consultations with his very trustworthy ministers beginning with Kutilaksa regarding the conquest of Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भृत्यनाममात्रेण विद्रवन्ति दिवौकसः । तादृशानामिहास्माकमागतो ऽयं विपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: madbhṛtyanāmamātreṇa vidravanti divaukasaḥ / tādṛśānāmihāsmākamāgato 'yaṃ viparyayaḥ
verses.translation: "Alas! the downfall of Daityas (enemies of the Suras) is imminent. Powerful fate has begun to be indifferent now.
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas! the downfall of Daityas (enemies of the Suras) is imminent. Powerful fate has begun to be indifferent now.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas! the downfall of Daityas (enemies of the Suras) is imminent. Powerful fate has begun to be indifferent now.

verses.sanskrit: करोति बलिनं क्लीबं धनिनं धनवर्जितम् । दीर्घायुषमनायुष्कं दुर्धाता भवितव्यता
verses.transliteration: karoti balinaṃ klībaṃ dhaninaṃ dhanavarjitam / dīrghāyuṣamanāyuṣkaṃ durdhātā bhavitavyatā
verses.translation: The heaven-dwellers used to run away even at the very mention of the names of my servants. This adverse calamity has befallen such great men as we were.
verses.wordMeaning: The heaven-dwellers used to run away even at the very mention of the names of my servants. This adverse calamity has befallen such great men as we were.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heaven-dwellers used to run away even at the very mention of the names of my servants. This adverse calamity has befallen such great men as we were.

verses.sanskrit: क्व सत्त्वमस्मद्बाहुनां क्वेयं दुर्ल्ललिता वधूः । अकाण्ड एव विधिना कृतो ऽयं निष्ठुरो विधिः
verses.transliteration: kva sattvamasmadbāhunāṃ kveyaṃ durllalitā vadhūḥ / akāṇḍa eva vidhinā kṛto 'yaṃ niṣṭhuro vidhiḥ
verses.translation: Durdhatd (wicked fate) and the inevitable future convert a strong man into a eunuch, a rich man into a poor man and a man of longevity into one without long life.
verses.wordMeaning: Durdhatd (wicked fate) and the inevitable future convert a strong man into a eunuch, a rich man into a poor man and a man of longevity into one without long life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Durdhatd (wicked fate) and the inevitable future convert a strong man into a eunuch, a rich man into a poor man and a man of longevity into one without long life.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पिणीमाययोदग्रास्तंया दुर्घटशौर्यया । अधिसंग्रामभूचक्रे सेनान्यो विनिपातिताः
verses.transliteration: sarpiṇīmāyayodagrāstaṃyā durghaṭaśauryayā / adhisaṃgrāmabhūcakre senānyo vinipātitāḥ
verses.translation: The generals who had become excessively aggressive on account of Maya of Sarpini, have been struck down in the battle ground by her whose heroism is of extraordinary nature.
verses.wordMeaning: The generals who had become excessively aggressive on account of Maya of Sarpini, have been struck down in the battle ground by her whose heroism is of extraordinary nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: The generals who had become excessively aggressive on account of Maya of Sarpini, have been struck down in the battle ground by her whose heroism is of extraordinary nature.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुद्दामदर्पाढ्या वनिता कापि मायिनी । यदि संप्रहरत्यस्मान्धिग्बलं नो भुजार्जितम्
verses.transliteration: evamuddāmadarpāḍhyā vanitā kāpi māyinī / yadi saṃpraharatyasmāndhigbalaṃ no bhujārjitam
verses.translation: Ifa woman who possesses unrestricted pride thus and who makes use of Maya strikes at us, fie upon our strength earned by the use of powerful arms."
verses.wordMeaning: Ifa woman who possesses unrestricted pride thus and who makes use of Maya strikes at us, fie upon our strength earned by the use of powerful arms."
verses.commentary: Sense: Ifa woman who possesses unrestricted pride thus and who makes use of Maya strikes at us, fie upon our strength earned by the use of powerful arms."

verses.sanskrit: इमं प्रसंगं वक्तुं च जिह्वा जिह्वेति मामकी । वनिता किमु मत्सैन्यं मर्द यिष्यति दुर्मदा
verses.transliteration: imaṃ prasaṃgaṃ vaktuṃ ca jihvā jihveti māmakī / vanitā kimu matsainyaṃ marda yiṣyati durmadā
verses.translation: My tongue feels ashamed to (have been compelled to) speak of this context. Should a woman ofwicked pride suppress and smash my army?
verses.wordMeaning: My tongue feels ashamed to (have been compelled to) speak of this context. Should a woman ofwicked pride suppress and smash my army?
verses.commentary: Sense: My tongue feels ashamed to (have been compelled to) speak of this context. Should a woman ofwicked pride suppress and smash my army?

verses.sanskrit: तदत्र मूलच्छेदाय तस्या यत्नो विधीयताम् । मया चारमुखाज्ज्ञाता तस्या वृत्तिर्महाबला
verses.transliteration: tadatra mūlacchedāya tasyā yatno vidhīyatām / mayā cāramukhājjñātā tasyā vṛttirmahābalā
verses.translation: In this very opportune moment make an arrange- ment for someone to attack her from the rear. Perhaps Visanga maybe competent enough to carry out this task of attacking her from the rear.
verses.wordMeaning: In this very opportune moment make an arrange- ment for someone to attack her from the rear. Perhaps Visanga maybe competent enough to carry out this task of attacking her from the rear.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this very opportune moment make an arrange- ment for someone to attack her from the rear. Perhaps Visanga maybe competent enough to carry out this task of attacking her from the rear.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामपि सैन्यानां पश्चादेवावतिष्ठते । अग्रतश्चलितं सैन्यं हयहस्तिरथादिकम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmapi sainyānāṃ paścādevāvatiṣṭhate / agrataścalitaṃ sainyaṃ hayahastirathādikam
verses.translation: Let fifteen generals who had proudly served in many battles and who are genuinely proud of their rich experience as veterans, go along with him with earnest desire for war.
verses.wordMeaning: Let fifteen generals who had proudly served in many battles and who are genuinely proud of their rich experience as veterans, go along with him with earnest desire for war.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let fifteen generals who had proudly served in many battles and who are genuinely proud of their rich experience as veterans, go along with him with earnest desire for war.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नेव ह्यवसरे पार्ष्णिग्राहो विधीयताम् । पार्ष्णिग्रहमिमं कर्तुं विषङ्गश्चतुरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: asminneva hyavasare pārṣṇigrāho vidhīyatām / pārṣṇigrahamimaṃ kartuṃ viṣaṅgaścaturo bhavet
verses.translation: She has not many attendants in the back. She is perhaps guarded by a few. For that very same reason, she can easily be taken captive.
verses.wordMeaning: She has not many attendants in the back. She is perhaps guarded by a few. For that very same reason, she can easily be taken captive.
verses.commentary: Sense: She has not many attendants in the back. She is perhaps guarded by a few. For that very same reason, she can easily be taken captive.

verses.sanskrit: तेन प्रौढमदोन्मता बहुसंग्रामदुर्मदाः । दश पञ्च च सेनान्यः सह यान्तु युयुत्सया
verses.transliteration: tena prauḍhamadonmatā bahusaṃgrāmadurmadāḥ / daśa pañca ca senānyaḥ saha yāntu yuyutsayā
verses.translation: Hence, O Visanga, make an elaborate preparation A and be aggressively proud of it. Carry out the attack from the rear, very cautiously and secretly.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Visanga, make an elaborate preparation A and be aggressively proud of it. Carry out the attack from the rear, very cautiously and secretly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Visanga, make an elaborate preparation A and be aggressively proud of it. Carry out the attack from the rear, very cautiously and secretly.

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठतः परिवारास्तु न तथा संति ते पुनः । अल्पैस्तु रक्षिता वै स्यात्तेनैवासौ सुनिग्रहा
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhataḥ parivārāstu na tathā saṃti te punaḥ / alpaistu rakṣitā vai syāttenaivāsau sunigrahā
verses.translation: Only a limited number ofsoldiers need accompany you. But let some valorous generals proud of their conquest of the guardians of cardinal points come with you fully equipped.
verses.wordMeaning: Only a limited number ofsoldiers need accompany you. But let some valorous generals proud of their conquest of the guardians of cardinal points come with you fully equipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only a limited number ofsoldiers need accompany you. But let some valorous generals proud of their conquest of the guardians of cardinal points come with you fully equipped.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वं बहुसन्नाहमाविधाय मदोत्कटः । विषङ्ग गुप्तरूपेण पार्ष्णिग्राहं समाचर
verses.transliteration: atastvaṃ bahusannāhamāvidhāya madotkaṭaḥ / viṣaṅga guptarūpeṇa pārṣṇigrāhaṃ samācara
verses.translation: Let fifteen Aksauhinls of soldiers proceed ahead jin the usual manner). But in a disguise, you pounce upon that wicked woman and kill her.
verses.wordMeaning: Let fifteen Aksauhinls of soldiers proceed ahead jin the usual manner). But in a disguise, you pounce upon that wicked woman and kill her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let fifteen Aksauhinls of soldiers proceed ahead jin the usual manner). But in a disguise, you pounce upon that wicked woman and kill her.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पीयसी त्वया सार्द्धं सेना गच्छतु विक्रमात् । सज्जाश्च लन्तु सेनान्यो दिक्पालविजयोद्धताः
verses.transliteration: alpīyasī tvayā sārddhaṃ senā gacchatu vikramāt / sajjāśca lantu senānyo dikpālavijayoddhatāḥ
verses.translation: She alone is the greatest root cause of all Saktis. If she is exterminated along with the roots the entire troop of Saktis will perish like the cluster of leaves of a lotus in the water when the bulbous root at the bottom is cut off.
verses.wordMeaning: She alone is the greatest root cause of all Saktis. If she is exterminated along with the roots the entire troop of Saktis will perish like the cluster of leaves of a lotus in the water when the bulbous root at the bottom is cut off.
verses.commentary: Sense: She alone is the greatest root cause of all Saktis. If she is exterminated along with the roots the entire troop of Saktis will perish like the cluster of leaves of a lotus in the water when the bulbous root at the bottom is cut off.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिण्यश्च सेनानां दश पञ्च चलन्तु ते । त्वं गुप्तवेषस्तां दुष्टां सन्निपत्य दृढं जहि
verses.transliteration: akṣauhiṇyaśca senānāṃ daśa pañca calantu te / tvaṃ guptaveṣastāṃ duṣṭāṃ sannipatya dṛḍhaṃ jahi
verses.translation: These generals of great strength, beginning with Madana, will come with you. Each of them will have an Aksauhin! (ofarmy) with him.
verses.wordMeaning: These generals of great strength, beginning with Madana, will come with you. Each of them will have an Aksauhin! (ofarmy) with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: These generals of great strength, beginning with Madana, will come with you. Each of them will have an Aksauhin! (ofarmy) with him.

verses.sanskrit: सैव निःशेषशक्तीनां मूलभूता महीयसी । तस्याः समूलनाशेन शक्तिवृन्दं विनश्यति
verses.transliteration: saiva niḥśeṣaśaktīnāṃ mūlabhūtā mahīyasī / tasyāḥ samūlanāśena śaktivṛndaṃ vinaśyati
verses.translation: In this matter you adopt the matu rity (of experience) of great men. O Visanga, you will attain excellent victory".
verses.wordMeaning: In this matter you adopt the matu rity (of experience) of great men. O Visanga, you will attain excellent victory".
verses.commentary: Sense: In this matter you adopt the matu rity (of experience) of great men. O Visanga, you will attain excellent victory".

verses.sanskrit: कन्दच्छेदे सरोजिन्या दलजालमिवांभसि । सर्वेषामेव पश्चाद्यो रथश्चलति भासुरः
verses.transliteration: kandacchede sarojinyā dalajālamivāṃbhasi / sarveṣāmeva paścādyo rathaścalati bhāsuraḥ
verses.translation: Then, when the younger brother of the crowned prince began an attempt to attack from the rear on Sri Lalita Devi, the sun came to the mountain ofsetting.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, when the younger brother of the crowned prince began an attempt to attack from the rear on Sri Lalita Devi, the sun came to the mountain ofsetting.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, when the younger brother of the crowned prince began an attempt to attack from the rear on Sri Lalita Devi, the sun came to the mountain ofsetting.

verses.sanskrit: दशयोजनसंपन्ननिजदेहसमुच्छ्रयः । महामुक्तातपत्रेण सर्वोद्ध्व परिशोभितः
verses.transliteration: daśayojanasaṃpannanijadehasamucchrayaḥ / mahāmuktātapatreṇa sarvoddhva pariśobhitaḥ
verses.translation: A dense darkness that had smoke-like colour like that had the lustre of the body ofa wild Boar and that had the splendour of the blue throat of a peacock spread every- where.
verses.wordMeaning: A dense darkness that had smoke-like colour like that had the lustre of the body ofa wild Boar and that had the splendour of the blue throat of a peacock spread every- where.
verses.commentary: Sense: A dense darkness that had smoke-like colour like that had the lustre of the body ofa wild Boar and that had the splendour of the blue throat of a peacock spread every- where.

verses.sanskrit: वहन्मुहर्वीज्यमानं चामराणां चतुष्टयम् । उत्तङ्गकेतुसंघातलिखितांबुदमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: vahanmuharvījyamānaṃ cāmarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam / uttaṅgaketusaṃghātalikhitāṃbudamaṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: It was as if rolled into a lump among the bushes; it seemed to run through the joints; it appeared to come out from thousands of crevices of the earth; it appeared to come out densely from the caves of mountains; whenever at any place the light of lamps spread it appeared to act like a coward; it was given support as it were in the lustre of the blue lotus on the ears ofwomen; it seemed to have combined together in the mature elephants' of the quarters as well as in collyrium; it appeared to have secured the friendship of the shining verdant meadows; it appeared to have the loving embrace of
verses.wordMeaning: It was as if rolled into a lump among the bushes; it seemed to run through the joints; it appeared to come out from thousands of crevices of the earth; it appeared to come out densely from the caves of mountains;…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was as if rolled into a lump among the bushes; it seemed to run through the joints; it appeared to come out from thousands of crevices of the earth; it appeared to come out densely from the caves of mountains;…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्रथे समायाति सा दृष्टा हरिणेक्षणा । निबृतं संनिपत्य त्वं चिह्नेनानेन लक्षिताम्
verses.transliteration: tasminrathe samāyāti sā dṛṣṭā hariṇekṣaṇā / nibṛtaṃ saṃnipatya tvaṃ cihnenānena lakṣitām
verses.translation: Here ends the first day of the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Here ends the first day of the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here ends the first day of the battle.

verses.sanskrit: तां विजित्य दुराचारां केशेष्वा कृष्य मर्दय । पुरतश्चलिते सैन्ये सत्त्वशालिनि सा वधूः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ vijitya durācārāṃ keśeṣvā kṛṣya mardaya / purataścalite sainye sattvaśālini sā vadhūḥ
verses.translation: Crores and crores of enemies (of Danavas) fell down after being girt and bound by evil-souled Visariga, the generals beginning with Madana (Damana) and • the excellent soldiers,
verses.wordMeaning: Crores and crores of enemies (of Danavas) fell down after being girt and bound by evil-souled Visariga, the generals beginning with Madana (Damana) and • the excellent soldiers,
verses.commentary: Sense: Crores and crores of enemies (of Danavas) fell down after being girt and bound by evil-souled Visariga, the generals beginning with Madana (Damana) and • the excellent soldiers,

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीमात्ररक्षा भवतो वशमेष्यति सत्त्वरम् । भवत्सहायभूतायां सेनेन्द्राणामिहाभिधा
verses.transliteration: strīmātrarakṣā bhavato vaśameṣyati sattvaram / bhavatsahāyabhūtāyāṃ senendrāṇāmihābhidhā
verses.translation: The chariot Cakraraja encircled by the volleys* of arrows and (hundreds of other) missiles of Daityas shone like a lordly mountain surrounded by flights of cranes.
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot Cakraraja encircled by the volleys* of arrows and (hundreds of other) missiles of Daityas shone like a lordly mountain surrounded by flights of cranes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot Cakraraja encircled by the volleys* of arrows and (hundreds of other) missiles of Daityas shone like a lordly mountain surrounded by flights of cranes.

verses.sanskrit: शृणु यैर्भवतो युद्धे साह्यकार्यमतन्द्रितैः । आद्यो मदनको नाम दीर्घजिह्वो द्वितीयकः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu yairbhavato yuddhe sāhyakāryamatandritaiḥ / ādyo madanako nāma dīrghajihvo dvitīyakaḥ
verses.translation: An arrow discharged by the vicious-souled Visariga who had occupied the lowest step (of the chariot) shattered the royal fan of the goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: An arrow discharged by the vicious-souled Visariga who had occupied the lowest step (of the chariot) shattered the royal fan of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: An arrow discharged by the vicious-souled Visariga who had occupied the lowest step (of the chariot) shattered the royal fan of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: हुबको हुलुमुलुश्च कक्लसः कक्लिवाहनः । थुक्लसः पुण्ड्रकेतुश्च चण्डबाहुश्च कुक्कुरः
verses.transliteration: hubako hulumuluśca kaklasaḥ kaklivāhanaḥ / thuklasaḥ puṇḍraketuśca caṇḍabāhuśca kukkuraḥ
verses.translation: When the troops of Saktis became bewildered by this accidental mishap, the Nityd deities, the chief of whom was Kamesvarl became excessively furious.
verses.wordMeaning: When the troops of Saktis became bewildered by this accidental mishap, the Nityd deities, the chief of whom was Kamesvarl became excessively furious.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the troops of Saktis became bewildered by this accidental mishap, the Nityd deities, the chief of whom was Kamesvarl became excessively furious.

verses.sanskrit: जंबुकाक्षो जंभनश्च तीक्ष्णशृङ्गस्त्रिकण्टकः । चन्द्रगुप्तश्च पञ्चैते दश चोक्ताश्चमूवराः
verses.transliteration: jaṃbukākṣo jaṃbhanaśca tīkṣṇaśṛṅgastrikaṇṭakaḥ / candraguptaśca pañcaite daśa coktāścamūvarāḥ
verses.translation: On observing the lotus-like, face of SrldevI marked by the brows knitted slightly, the Nitya deities became greatly worried and exerted themselves all the more.
verses.wordMeaning: On observing the lotus-like, face of SrldevI marked by the brows knitted slightly, the Nitya deities became greatly worried and exerted themselves all the more.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing the lotus-like, face of SrldevI marked by the brows knitted slightly, the Nitya deities became greatly worried and exerted themselves all the more.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकाक्षौहिणीयुक्ताः प्रत्येकं भवता सह । आगमिष्यन्ति सेनान्यो दमनाद्या महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: ekaikākṣauhiṇīyuktāḥ pratyekaṃ bhavatā saha / āgamiṣyanti senānyo damanādyā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: These Nitya deities were Kalasvarupi nls (having time units for their forms). Ever/one of them had a Tithi (Lunar day) for her physical form. On seeing the fury of the
verses.wordMeaning: These Nitya deities were Kalasvarupi nls (having time units for their forms). Ever/one of them had a Tithi (Lunar day) for her physical form. On seeing the fury of the
verses.commentary: Sense: These Nitya deities were Kalasvarupi nls (having time units for their forms). Ever/one of them had a Tithi (Lunar day) for her physical form. On seeing the fury of the

verses.sanskrit: परस्य कटकं नैव यथा जानाति ते गतिम् । तथा गुप्तसमाचारः पार्ष्णिग्राहं समाचर
verses.transliteration: parasya kaṭakaṃ naiva yathā jānāti te gatim / tathā guptasamācāraḥ pārṣṇigrāhaṃ samācara
