verses.translation: They bowed to the goddess the great queen of great dignity and magnificence. With their voice choked on account of their eagerness for fighting that had risen in them suddenly they spoke.
verses.wordMeaning: They bowed to the goddess the great queen of great dignity and magnificence. With their voice choked on account of their eagerness for fighting that had risen in them suddenly they spoke.
verses.commentary: Sense: They bowed to the goddess the great queen of great dignity and magnificence. With their voice choked on account of their eagerness for fighting that had risen in them suddenly they spoke.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्कार्ये सुमहतां प्रौढिमानं समुद्वहन् । निषङ्ग त्वं हि तभसे जयसिद्धिमनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: asminkārye sumahatāṃ prauḍhimānaṃ samudvahan / niṣaṅga tvaṃ hi tabhase jayasiddhimanuttamām
verses.translation: Hence, we shall suppress the pride of the enemies of gods who have concealed their bodies behind darkness. Just observe it for a few moments.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, we shall suppress the pride of the enemies of gods who have concealed their bodies behind darkness. Just observe it for a few moments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, we shall suppress the pride of the enemies of gods who have concealed their bodies behind darkness. Just observe it for a few moments.

verses.sanskrit: इति मन्त्रितमन्त्रो ऽयं दुर्मन्त्री भण्डदानवः । विषङ्गं प्रेषयामास रक्षितं सैन्यपालकैः
verses.transliteration: iti mantritamantro 'yaṃ durmantrī bhaṇḍadānavaḥ / viṣaṅgaṃ preṣayāmāsa rakṣitaṃ sainyapālakaiḥ
verses.translation: After suppressing the pride of these Daityas engaged in attacking from the rear*, we shall immediately return to serve the lotus-like feet of (Your Highness). Command us, O great queen for the suppression of vicious fellows".
verses.wordMeaning: After suppressing the pride of these Daityas engaged in attacking from the rear*, we shall immediately return to serve the lotus-like feet of (Your Highness). Command us, O great queen for the suppression of vicious fellows".
verses.commentary: Sense: After suppressing the pride of these Daityas engaged in attacking from the rear*, we shall immediately return to serve the lotus-like feet of (Your Highness). Command us, O great queen for the suppression of vicious fellows".

verses.sanskrit: अथ श्रीललितादेव्याः पार्ष्णिग्राहकृतोद्यमे । युवराजानुजे दैत्ये सूर्यो ऽस्तगिरिमाययौ
verses.transliteration: atha śrīlalitādevyāḥ pārṣṇigrāhakṛtodyame / yuvarājānuje daitye sūryo 'stagirimāyayau
verses.translation: "O sinful fellows, stop. You are engaged in frau- dulent war after getting the help of darkness. I shall cut you off'.
verses.wordMeaning: "O sinful fellows, stop. You are engaged in frau- dulent war after getting the help of darkness. I shall cut you off'.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O sinful fellows, stop. You are engaged in frau- dulent war after getting the help of darkness. I shall cut you off'.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमे युद्धदिवसे व्यतीते लोकभीषणे । अन्धकारः समभवत्तस्य बाह्यचिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: prathame yuddhadivase vyatīte lokabhīṣaṇe / andhakāraḥ samabhavattasya bāhyacikīrṣayā
verses.translation: She taunted them thus. After extracting arrows from the quiver, she stepped down (from the last rung) while her movement faltered a little due to anger.
verses.wordMeaning: She taunted them thus. After extracting arrows from the quiver, she stepped down (from the last rung) while her movement faltered a little due to anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: She taunted them thus. After extracting arrows from the quiver, she stepped down (from the last rung) while her movement faltered a little due to anger.

verses.sanskrit: महिषस्कन्धधूम्राभं वनक्रोडवपुर्द्दुति । नीलकण्ठनिभच्छायं निबिडं पप्रथे तमः
verses.transliteration: mahiṣaskandhadhūmrābhaṃ vanakroḍavapurdduti / nīlakaṇṭhanibhacchāyaṃ nibiḍaṃ paprathe tamaḥ
verses.translation: Other N itya deities too moved on, such as Bhagamala and others. They had bows in their hands. They too got down from the step.
verses.wordMeaning: Other N itya deities too moved on, such as Bhagamala and others. They had bows in their hands. They too got down from the step.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other N itya deities too moved on, such as Bhagamala and others. They had bows in their hands. They too got down from the step.

verses.sanskrit: कुञ्जेषु पिण्डितमिव प्रधावदिव संधिषु । उज्जिहानमिव क्षोणीविवरेभ्यः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: kuñjeṣu piṇḍitamiva pradhāvadiva saṃdhiṣu / ujjihānamiva kṣoṇīvivarebhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The Nitya deities JvalamalinT and VahnivasinT got ready for the battle. They brightened the battle field by means of their refulgence.
verses.wordMeaning: The Nitya deities JvalamalinT and VahnivasinT got ready for the battle. They brightened the battle field by means of their refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nitya deities JvalamalinT and VahnivasinT got ready for the battle. They brightened the battle field by means of their refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गच्छदिव शैलानां भूरि कन्दरमन्दिरात् । क्वचिद्दीपप्रभाजाले कृतकातरचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: nirgacchadiva śailānāṃ bhūri kandaramandirāt / kvaciddīpaprabhājāle kṛtakātaraceṣṭitam
verses.translation: Those fifteen N itya deities beginning with Kamesvari
verses.wordMeaning: Those fifteen N itya deities beginning with Kamesvari
verses.commentary: Sense: Those fifteen N itya deities beginning with Kamesvari

verses.sanskrit: दत्तावलंबनमिव स्त्रीणां कर्णोत्पलत्विषि । एकीभूतमिव प्रौढदिङ्नागमिव कज्जले । आबद्धमैत्रकमिव स्फुरच्छाद्वलमण्डले
verses.transliteration: dattāvalaṃbanamiva strīṇāṃ karṇotpalatviṣi / ekībhūtamiva prauḍhadiṅnāgamiva kajjale / ābaddhamaitrakamiva sphuracchādvalamaṇḍale
verses.translation: There in the battle-field a great tumultuous sound arose as though the waves of the ocean were lashing at the shores, when it was stirred by the Mandara mountain (while churning for Amrta).
verses.wordMeaning: There in the battle-field a great tumultuous sound arose as though the waves of the ocean were lashing at the shores, when it was stirred by the Mandara mountain (while churning for Amrta).
verses.commentary: Sense: There in the battle-field a great tumultuous sound arose as though the waves of the ocean were lashing at the shores, when it was stirred by the Mandara mountain (while churning for Amrta).

verses.sanskrit: कृतप्रियाश्लेषमिव स्फुरन्तीष्वसियष्टिषु । गुप्तप्रविष्टमिव च श्यामासु वनपङ्क्तिषु
verses.transliteration: kṛtapriyāśleṣamiva sphurantīṣvasiyaṣṭiṣu / guptapraviṣṭamiva ca śyāmāsu vanapaṅktiṣu
verses.translation: Those Nitya deities drew their Pranakodandas (life-breath-bow). With their arms where bangles were moving to and fro they commenced a dreadful war.
verses.wordMeaning: Those Nitya deities drew their Pranakodandas (life-breath-bow). With their arms where bangles were moving to and fro they commenced a dreadful war.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Nitya deities drew their Pranakodandas (life-breath-bow). With their arms where bangles were moving to and fro they commenced a dreadful war.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेण बहुलीभूतं प्रससार महत्तमः । त्रियामावामनयना नीलकञ्चुकरोचिषा
verses.transliteration: krameṇa bahulībhūtaṃ prasasāra mahattamaḥ / triyāmāvāmanayanā nīlakañcukarociṣā
verses.translation: The battle thus went on for three Ydmas (watches; one Yama-three hours). The Aksauhinls were killed by the sharp arrows of Nitya deities.
verses.wordMeaning: The battle thus went on for three Ydmas (watches; one Yama-three hours). The Aksauhinls were killed by the sharp arrows of Nitya deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The battle thus went on for three Ydmas (watches; one Yama-three hours). The Aksauhinls were killed by the sharp arrows of Nitya deities.

verses.sanskrit: तिमिरेणावृतं विश्वं न किञ्चित्प्रत्यपद्यत । असुराणां प्रदुष्टानां रात्रिरेव बलावहा
verses.transliteration: timireṇāvṛtaṃ viśvaṃ na kiñcitpratyapadyata / asurāṇāṃ praduṣṭānāṃ rātrireva balāvahā
verses.translation: NTlapataka and Vjjaya proud oftheir victory made a sacrificial offering ofJambhana in the battle-field. The Nitya deity Sarvamarigalika chopped off TIksnasrriga. The Nitya deity JvalamalinI killed the terrible Trikarnaka (i.e. T rikantaka).
verses.wordMeaning: NTlapataka and Vjjaya proud oftheir victory made a sacrificial offering ofJambhana in the battle-field. The Nitya deity Sarvamarigalika chopped off TIksnasrriga. The Nitya deity JvalamalinI killed the terrible Trikarnaka (i.e. T rikantaka).
verses.commentary: Sense: NTlapataka and Vjjaya proud oftheir victory made a sacrificial offering ofJambhana in the battle-field. The Nitya deity Sarvamarigalika chopped off TIksnasrriga. The Nitya deity JvalamalinI killed the terrible Trikarnaka (i.e. T rikantaka).

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मायाविलासो ऽयं तस्यामेव हि वर्धते । अथ प्रचलितं सैन्यं विषङ्गेण महौजसा
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ māyāvilāso 'yaṃ tasyāmeva hi vardhate / atha pracalitaṃ sainyaṃ viṣaṅgeṇa mahaujasā
verses.translation: When the wicked Visariga, the brother of Bhanda fled, the night too dawned. All the cardinal points became bright.
verses.wordMeaning: When the wicked Visariga, the brother of Bhanda fled, the night too dawned. All the cardinal points became bright.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the wicked Visariga, the brother of Bhanda fled, the night too dawned. All the cardinal points became bright.

verses.sanskrit: धौतखड्गलताच्छायावर्धिष्णु तिमिरच्छटम् । दमनाद्याश्च सेनान्यः श्मामकङ्कटधारिणः
verses.transliteration: dhautakhaḍgalatācchāyāvardhiṣṇu timiracchaṭam / damanādyāśca senānyaḥ śmāmakaṅkaṭadhāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: "It is not proper to chase a warrior who flees from the battle-field". Thinking thus, the Nitya deities refrained from fighting at that time.
verses.wordMeaning: "It is not proper to chase a warrior who flees from the battle-field". Thinking thus, the Nitya deities refrained from fighting at that time.
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is not proper to chase a warrior who flees from the battle-field". Thinking thus, the Nitya deities refrained from fighting at that time.

verses.sanskrit: श्यामोष्णीषधराः श्यामवर्णसर्वपरिच्छदाः । एकत्वमिव संप्राप्तास्तिमिरेणातिभूयसा
verses.transliteration: śyāmoṣṇīṣadharāḥ śyāmavarṇasarvaparicchadāḥ / ekatvamiva saṃprāptāstimireṇātibhūyasā
verses.translation: The Nitya deities who were proud of their victory and whose bodies were drenched in blood oozing from the wounds made by the weapons of Daityas, bowed down to goddess Srllalita.
verses.wordMeaning: The Nitya deities who were proud of their victory and whose bodies were drenched in blood oozing from the wounds made by the weapons of Daityas, bowed down to goddess Srllalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nitya deities who were proud of their victory and whose bodies were drenched in blood oozing from the wounds made by the weapons of Daityas, bowed down to goddess Srllalita.

verses.sanskrit: विषङ्गमनुसंचेलुः कृताग्रजनमस्कृतिम् । कूटेन युद्धकृत्येन विजिगीषुर्महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: viṣaṅgamanusaṃceluḥ kṛtāgrajanamaskṛtim / kūṭena yuddhakṛtyena vijigīṣurmaheśvarīm
verses.translation: "Even the mighty Kutilaksa who was accompanied by an army often Aksauhinls was utterly defeated in the battle by the sharp arrows ofDandanatha and he fled from the field. The army consisting of ten Aksauhinls was destroyed by her at night.
verses.wordMeaning: "Even the mighty Kutilaksa who was accompanied by an army often Aksauhinls was utterly defeated in the battle by the sharp arrows ofDandanatha and he fled from the field. The army consisting of ten Aksauhinls was destroyed by her at night.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Even the mighty Kutilaksa who was accompanied by an army often Aksauhinls was utterly defeated in the battle by the sharp arrows ofDandanatha and he fled from the field. The army consisting of ten Aksauhinls was destroyed by her at night.

verses.sanskrit: मेघडंबरकं नाम दधे वक्षसि कङ्कटम् । यथा तस्य निशायुद्धानुरूपो वेषसंग्रहः
verses.transliteration: meghaḍaṃbarakaṃ nāma dadhe vakṣasi kaṅkaṭam / yathā tasya niśāyuddhānurūpo veṣasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this news Bhanda became bewildered.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this news Bhanda became bewildered.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this news Bhanda became bewildered.

verses.sanskrit: तथा कृतवती सेना श्यामलं कञ्चुकादिकम् । न च दुन्दुभिनिस्वानो न च मर्द्दलगर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: tathā kṛtavatī senā śyāmalaṃ kañcukādikam / na ca dundubhinisvāno na ca marddalagarjitam
verses.translation: "Alas a great calamity had befallen the goddess through Daityas. Shallow-minded that we were we had gone very far ahead.
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas a great calamity had befallen the goddess through Daityas. Shallow-minded that we were we had gone very far ahead.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas a great calamity had befallen the goddess through Daityas. Shallow-minded that we were we had gone very far ahead.

verses.sanskrit: पणवानकभेरीणां न च घोषविजृंभणम् । गुप्ताचाराः प्रचलितास्तिमिरेण समावृताः
verses.transliteration: paṇavānakabherīṇāṃ na ca ghoṣavijṛṃbhaṇam / guptācārāḥ pracalitāstimireṇa samāvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Proper defence of prominent chariot Mahacakra had not been provided for through soldiers'. Availing ofthis opportunity, damage has been effected by the wicked demons during the night.
verses.wordMeaning: Proper defence of prominent chariot Mahacakra had not been provided for through soldiers'. Availing ofthis opportunity, damage has been effected by the wicked demons during the night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Proper defence of prominent chariot Mahacakra had not been provided for through soldiers'. Availing ofthis opportunity, damage has been effected by the wicked demons during the night.

verses.sanskrit: परैरदृश्यगतयो विष्कोशीकृतरिष्टयः । पश्चिमाभिमुखं यान्ति ललितायाः पताकिनीम्
verses.transliteration: parairadṛśyagatayo viṣkośīkṛtariṣṭayaḥ / paścimābhimukhaṃ yānti lalitāyāḥ patākinīm
verses.translation: On being agitated by these doubts and fears, Danda- natha and others proceeded towards Lalita, keeping MantrinI in front of them.
verses.wordMeaning: On being agitated by these doubts and fears, Danda- natha and others proceeded towards Lalita, keeping MantrinI in front of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being agitated by these doubts and fears, Danda- natha and others proceeded towards Lalita, keeping MantrinI in front of them.

verses.sanskrit: आवृतोत्तरमार्गेण पूर्वभागमशिश्रियन् । निश्वासमपि सस्वानमकुर्वन्तः पदेपदे
verses.transliteration: āvṛtottaramārgeṇa pūrvabhāgamaśiśriyan / niśvāsamapi sasvānamakurvantaḥ padepade
verses.translation: When the night dawned, all those honoured generals of the troops of Saktis came and stood around the leading chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: When the night dawned, all those honoured generals of the troops of Saktis came and stood around the leading chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the night dawned, all those honoured generals of the troops of Saktis came and stood around the leading chariot.

verses.sanskrit: सावधानाः प्रचलिताः पार्ष्णिग्राहाय दानवाः । भूयः पुरस्य दिग्भागं गत्वा मन्दपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: sāvadhānāḥ pracalitāḥ pārṣṇigrāhāya dānavāḥ / bhūyaḥ purasya digbhāgaṃ gatvā mandaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: Mantrini and Dandanayika got down from. their vehicles, placed the army beneath and they themselves ascended the chariot (of the goddess).
verses.wordMeaning: Mantrini and Dandanayika got down from. their vehicles, placed the army beneath and they themselves ascended the chariot (of the goddess).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mantrini and Dandanayika got down from. their vehicles, placed the army beneath and they themselves ascended the chariot (of the goddess).

verses.sanskrit: ललितासैन्यमेव स्वान्सूचयन्तः प्रपृच्छतः । आगत्य निभृतं पृष्ठे कवचच्छन्नविग्रहाः
verses.transliteration: lalitāsainyameva svānsūcayantaḥ prapṛcchataḥ / āgatya nibhṛtaṃ pṛṣṭhe kavacacchannavigrahāḥ
verses.translation: "O Ambika, we heard that a great calamity took place. Harm has been caused by the wicked Daityas by a fraudulent battle.
verses.wordMeaning: "O Ambika, we heard that a great calamity took place. Harm has been caused by the wicked Daityas by a fraudulent battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Ambika, we heard that a great calamity took place. Harm has been caused by the wicked Daityas by a fraudulent battle.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रराजरथं तुङ्गं मेरुमन्दरसंनिभम् । अपश्यन्नतिदीप्ताभिः शक्तिभिः परिवारितम्
verses.transliteration: cakrarājarathaṃ tuṅgaṃ merumandarasaṃnibham / apaśyannatidīptābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritam
verses.translation: Fortunately, the arrows etc- ofthe vicious demons have not touched the person of our lady. Hence he is alive.
verses.wordMeaning: Fortunately, the arrows etc- ofthe vicious demons have not touched the person of our lady. Hence he is alive.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fortunately, the arrows etc- ofthe vicious demons have not touched the person of our lady. Hence he is alive.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र मुक्तातपत्रस्य वर्त्तमानामधःस्थले । सहस्रादित्यसंकाशां पश्चिमाभिमुखीं स्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: tatra muktātapatrasya varttamānāmadhaḥsthale / sahasrādityasaṃkāśāṃ paścimābhimukhīṃ sthitām
verses.translation: The base Danavas beginning with Bhanda should be defeated during the period of their misery. (Henceforth) they shall not be able to carry on fraudulent war nor shall they penetrate this army.
verses.wordMeaning: The base Danavas beginning with Bhanda should be defeated during the period of their misery. (Henceforth) they shall not be able to carry on fraudulent war nor shall they penetrate this army.
verses.commentary: Sense: The base Danavas beginning with Bhanda should be defeated during the period of their misery. (Henceforth) they shall not be able to carry on fraudulent war nor shall they penetrate this army.

verses.sanskrit: कामेश्वर्यादिनित्याभिः स्वसमानसमृद्धिभिः । नर्मालापविनोदेन सेव्यमानां रथोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: kāmeśvaryādinityābhiḥ svasamānasamṛddhibhiḥ / narmālāpavinodena sevyamānāṃ rathottame
verses.translation: For that purpose an enormous camp hundred Yojanas in extent should be built on the southern side of the mountain Mahendra.
verses.wordMeaning: For that purpose an enormous camp hundred Yojanas in extent should be built on the southern side of the mountain Mahendra.
verses.commentary: Sense: For that purpose an enormous camp hundred Yojanas in extent should be built on the southern side of the mountain Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit: तां तथाभूतवृत्तान्ताम तादृशरणोद्यमाम् । पुरोगतं महत्सैन्यं वीक्षमाण सकौतुकम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ tathābhūtavṛttāntāma tādṛśaraṇodyamām / purogataṃ mahatsainyaṃ vīkṣamāṇa sakautukam
verses.translation: After hearing these words of MantrinI and Danda- natha, Lalita spoke thus, shedding pearls, as it were, by means of the white sparkles of the teeth.
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing these words of MantrinI and Danda- natha, Lalita spoke thus, shedding pearls, as it were, by means of the white sparkles of the teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing these words of MantrinI and Danda- natha, Lalita spoke thus, shedding pearls, as it were, by means of the white sparkles of the teeth.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वानश्च हि तामेव विषङ्गः सुदुराशयः । पृष्ठवंशे रथेन्द्रस्य घट्टयामास सैनिकैः
verses.transliteration: manvānaśca hi tāmeva viṣaṅgaḥ sudurāśayaḥ / pṛṣṭhavaṃśe rathendrasya ghaṭṭayāmāsa sainikaiḥ
verses.translation: "This counsel of your is the result of a very good deliberation and a fine intelligence. This is the path of shrewd and wise people. This is the ancient and eternal policy.
verses.wordMeaning: "This counsel of your is the result of a very good deliberation and a fine intelligence. This is the path of shrewd and wise people. This is the ancient and eternal policy.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This counsel of your is the result of a very good deliberation and a fine intelligence. This is the path of shrewd and wise people. This is the ancient and eternal policy.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राणि मादिशक्तीनां परिवारवरूथिनी । महाकलकलं चक्रुरणिमाद्याः परःशतम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāṇi mādiśaktīnāṃ parivāravarūthinī / mahākalakalaṃ cakruraṇimādyāḥ paraḥśatam
verses.translation: After saying thus to MantrinI and Dandanatha that goddess Lalita called the- Nitya deity Jvalamalini and spoke hus.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to MantrinI and Dandanatha that goddess Lalita called the- Nitya deity Jvalamalini and spoke hus.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to MantrinI and Dandanatha that goddess Lalita called the- Nitya deity Jvalamalini and spoke hus.

verses.sanskrit: पट्टिशैर्द्रुघणैश्चैव भिन्दिपालैर्भुशुण्डिभिः । कठोरवज्रनिर्धातनिष्ठुरैः शक्तिमण्डलैः
verses.transliteration: paṭṭiśairdrughaṇaiścaiva bhindipālairbhuśuṇḍibhiḥ / kaṭhoravajranirdhātaniṣṭhuraiḥ śaktimaṇḍalaiḥ
verses.translation: "O dear one, you have the form of fire. Your fea- tures are fiery flames. Let the defence of this great army be provided for by you.
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear one, you have the form of fire. Your fea- tures are fiery flames. Let the defence of this great army be provided for by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear one, you have the form of fire. Your fea- tures are fiery flames. Let the defence of this great army be provided for by you.

verses.sanskrit: मर्दयन्तो महासत्त्वाः समरं बहुमेनिरे । आकस्मिकरणोत्साहविपर्याविष्टविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: mardayanto mahāsattvāḥ samaraṃ bahumenire / ākasmikaraṇotsāhaviparyāviṣṭavigraham
verses.translation: After encircling the ground to the extent of a hundred Yojanas assume the form of a fiery flame thirty Yojanas in height.
verses.wordMeaning: After encircling the ground to the extent of a hundred Yojanas assume the form of a fiery flame thirty Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: After encircling the ground to the extent of a hundred Yojanas assume the form of a fiery flame thirty Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: अकाण्डक्षुभितं चासीद्रथस्थं शक्तिमण्डलम् । विपाटैः पाटयामासुरदृश्यैरन्धकारिणः
verses.transliteration: akāṇḍakṣubhitaṃ cāsīdrathasthaṃ śaktimaṇḍalam / vipāṭaiḥ pāṭayāmāsuradṛśyairandhakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Leaving an opening of a Yojana retain your blazing body elsewhere. Having adopted the nature of a fiery flame protect the entire army".
verses.wordMeaning: Leaving an opening of a Yojana retain your blazing body elsewhere. Having adopted the nature of a fiery flame protect the entire army".
verses.commentary: Sense: Leaving an opening of a Yojana retain your blazing body elsewhere. Having adopted the nature of a fiery flame protect the entire army".

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चक्ररथेन्द्रस्य नवमे पर्वणि स्थिताः । अदृश्यमानशस्त्राणामदृश्यनिजवर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: tataścakrarathendrasya navame parvaṇi sthitāḥ / adṛśyamānaśastrāṇāmadṛśyanijavarmaṇām
verses.translation: After saying this to the Nitya deity J valamali nika, Lalita the goddess attempted to proceed to the northern region of the Mahendra.
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this to the Nitya deity J valamali nika, Lalita the goddess attempted to proceed to the northern region of the Mahendra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to the Nitya deity J valamali nika, Lalita the goddess attempted to proceed to the northern region of the Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit: तिमिरच्छन्नरूपाणां दानवानां शिलीमुखैः । इतस्ततो बहु क्लिष्टं छन्नवर्मितमर्मवत्
verses.transliteration: timiracchannarūpāṇāṃ dānavānāṃ śilīmukhaiḥ / itastato bahu kliṣṭaṃ channavarmitamarmavat
verses.translation: That Nitya deity who had the eternal features of blazing fiery flames and who presided over the Caturdasi
verses.wordMeaning: That Nitya deity who had the eternal features of blazing fiery flames and who presided over the Caturdasi
verses.commentary: Sense: That Nitya deity who had the eternal features of blazing fiery flames and who presided over the Caturdasi

verses.sanskrit: शक्तीनां मण्डलं तेने क्रन्दनं ललितां प्रति । पूर्वानुक्रम तस्तत्र संप्राप्तं सुमहद्भयम्
verses.transliteration: śaktīnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tene krandanaṃ lalitāṃ prati / pūrvānukrama tastatra saṃprāptaṃ sumahadbhayam
verses.translation: As directed by her alone before, the region of ground having the Mahendra mountain to its north (see verse 18) was encircled (by the Nitya deity who) blazed in the form of a fiery enclosure.
verses.wordMeaning: As directed by her alone before, the region of ground having the Mahendra mountain to its north (see verse 18) was encircled (by the Nitya deity who) blazed in the form of a fiery enclosure.
verses.commentary: Sense: As directed by her alone before, the region of ground having the Mahendra mountain to its north (see verse 18) was encircled (by the Nitya deity who) blazed in the form of a fiery enclosure.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णाकर्णिकयाकर्ण्य ललिता कोपमादधे । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भण्डश्चण्डदुर्मत्रिपण्डितः
verses.transliteration: karṇākarṇikayākarṇya lalitā kopamādadhe / etasminnantare bhaṇḍaścaṇḍadurmatripaṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, maki ng a great deal of tu multuous shoul and uproar, the great army of Saktis set out from the fiery enclosure through the opening.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, maki ng a great deal of tu multuous shoul and uproar, the great army of Saktis set out from the fiery enclosure through the opening.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, maki ng a great deal of tu multuous shoul and uproar, the great army of Saktis set out from the fiery enclosure through the opening.

verses.sanskrit: दशाक्षौहिणिकायुक्तं कुटिलाक्षं महौजसम् । ललितासैन्यनाशाय युद्धाय प्रजिघाय सः
verses.transliteration: daśākṣauhiṇikāyuktaṃ kuṭilākṣaṃ mahaujasam / lalitāsainyanāśāya yuddhāya prajighāya saḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that the interior of the camp of Lalita had been well guarded thus, Bhanda, the ferocious Danava, felt the fever ofgreat indignation all over again.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that the interior of the camp of Lalita had been well guarded thus, Bhanda, the ferocious Danava, felt the fever ofgreat indignation all over again.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that the interior of the camp of Lalita had been well guarded thus, Bhanda, the ferocious Danava, felt the fever ofgreat indignation all over again.

verses.sanskrit: यथा पश्चात्कलकलं श्रुत्वाग्रेवर्तिनी चमूः । नागच्छति तथा चक्रे कुटिलाक्षो महारणम्
verses.transliteration: yathā paścātkalakalaṃ śrutvāgrevartinī camūḥ / nāgacchati tathā cakre kuṭilākṣo mahāraṇam
verses.translation: His sons thirty in number, were mighty, with huge- bodies. I shall mention their names, O Pot-born sage, listen.
verses.wordMeaning: His sons thirty in number, were mighty, with huge- bodies. I shall mention their names, O Pot-born sage, listen.
verses.commentary: Sense: His sons thirty in number, were mighty, with huge- bodies. I shall mention their names, O Pot-born sage, listen.

verses.sanskrit: एवं चोभयतो युद्धं पश्चादग्रे तथाभवत् । अत्यन्ततुमुलं चासीच्छक्तीनां सैनिके महत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ cobhayato yuddhaṃ paścādagre tathābhavat / atyantatumulaṃ cāsīcchaktīnāṃ sainike mahat
verses.translation: "O! my sons, who can be equal to you on the Earth? It is with your help alone that the universe was former- ly conquered by me.
verses.wordMeaning: "O! my sons, who can be equal to you on the Earth? It is with your help alone that the universe was former- ly conquered by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O! my sons, who can be equal to you on the Earth? It is with your help alone that the universe was former- ly conquered by me.

verses.sanskrit: नक्तसत्त्वाश्च दैत्येन्द्रास्तिमिरेण समावृताः । इतस्ततः शिथिलतां कण्टके निन्युरुद्धताः
verses.transliteration: naktasattvāśca daityendrāstimireṇa samāvṛtāḥ / itastataḥ śithilatāṃ kaṇṭake ninyuruddhatāḥ
verses.translation: In the course of the batde, you have furiously pulled the tresses of (devas such as) Sakra, Agni, Yama, Nirrti and Va ru na.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of the batde, you have furiously pulled the tresses of (devas such as) Sakra, Agni, Yama, Nirrti and Va ru na.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of the batde, you have furiously pulled the tresses of (devas such as) Sakra, Agni, Yama, Nirrti and Va ru na.

verses.sanskrit: निषङ्गेण दुराशेन धमनाद्यैश्चमूवरैः । चमूभिश्च प्रणहिता न्यपतञ्छत्रुकोटयः
verses.transliteration: niṣaṅgeṇa durāśena dhamanādyaiścamūvaraiḥ / camūbhiśca praṇahitā nyapatañchatrukoṭayaḥ
verses.translation: You know (how to wield) all kinds of missiles and weapons. But, even when you all are wakeful and alert, this deprivation has befallen our family.
verses.wordMeaning: You know (how to wield) all kinds of missiles and weapons. But, even when you all are wakeful and alert, this deprivation has befallen our family.
verses.commentary: Sense: You know (how to wield) all kinds of missiles and weapons. But, even when you all are wakeful and alert, this deprivation has befallen our family.

verses.sanskrit: ताभिर्दैत्यास्त्रमालाभिश्चक्रराजरथो वृतः । बकावलीनिबिडतः शैलराज इवाबभौ
verses.transliteration: tābhirdaityāstramālābhiścakrarājaratho vṛtaḥ / bakāvalīnibiḍataḥ śailarāja ivābabhau
verses.translation: A certain way-ward and naughty woman, who employs Maya tactics and who is foolishly proud about (her capacity for) fighting and is accompanied by many women on a par with herself, is harassing us.
verses.wordMeaning: A certain way-ward and naughty woman, who employs Maya tactics and who is foolishly proud about (her capacity for) fighting and is accompanied by many women on a par with herself, is harassing us.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain way-ward and naughty woman, who employs Maya tactics and who is foolishly proud about (her capacity for) fighting and is accompanied by many women on a par with herself, is harassing us.

verses.sanskrit: आक्रान्तपर्वणाधस्ताद्विषङ्गेण दुरात्मना । मुक्त एकः शरोदेव्यास्तालवृन्तमचूर्णयत्
verses.transliteration: ākrāntaparvaṇādhastādviṣaṅgeṇa durātmanā / mukta ekaḥ śarodevyāstālavṛntamacūrṇayat
verses.translation: Therefore, you should certainly bring her under your control in the course of battle. She should be captured alive by you who are equipped with blazing weapons.
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, you should certainly bring her under your control in the course of battle. She should be captured alive by you who are equipped with blazing weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, you should certainly bring her under your control in the course of battle. She should be captured alive by you who are equipped with blazing weapons.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तेनाव्याहितेन संभ्रान्ते शक्तिमण्डले । कामेश्वरीमुखा नित्या महान्तं क्रोधमाययुः
verses.transliteration: atha tenāvyāhitena saṃbhrānte śaktimaṇḍale / kāmeśvarīmukhā nityā mahāntaṃ krodhamāyayuḥ
verses.translation: Please endure this one thing contrary to your heroism and glory".
verses.wordMeaning: Please endure this one thing contrary to your heroism and glory".
verses.commentary: Sense: Please endure this one thing contrary to your heroism and glory".

verses.sanskrit: ईषद्भृकुटिसंसक्तं श्रीदेव्या वदनांबुजम् । अवलोक्य भृशोद्विग्ना नित्या दधुरतिश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: īṣadbhṛkuṭisaṃsaktaṃ śrīdevyā vadanāṃbujam / avalokya bhṛśodvignā nityā dadhuratiśramam
verses.translation: Being the Tilakas (the sacred mark on the forehead) on the face of (the lady in the form of) the army consisting of two hundred Aksauhinis, they (the sons of Bhanda) went out from their abode with arms in their hands and theirbrows well- knitted in anger and frown.
verses.wordMeaning: Being the Tilakas (the sacred mark on the forehead) on the face of (the lady in the form of) the army consisting of two hundred Aksauhinis, they (the sons of Bhanda) went out from their abode with arms in their hands and theirbrows well- knitted in anger and frown.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being the Tilakas (the sacred mark on the forehead) on the face of (the lady in the form of) the army consisting of two hundred Aksauhinis, they (the sons of Bhanda) went out from their abode with arms in their hands and theirbrows well- knitted in anger and frown.

verses.sanskrit: नित्या कालस्वरूपिण्यः प्रत्येकं तिथिविग्रहाः । क्रोधमुद्वीक्ष्य सम्नाज्ञ्या युद्धाय दधुरुद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: nityā kālasvarūpiṇyaḥ pratyekaṃ tithivigrahāḥ / krodhamudvīkṣya samnājñyā yuddhāya dadhurudyamam
verses.translation: At the departure of the sons of Bhanda the earth quaked. There were many evil portentous phenomena. The universe became excessively frightened.
verses.wordMeaning: At the departure of the sons of Bhanda the earth quaked. There were many evil portentous phenomena. The universe became excessively frightened.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the departure of the sons of Bhanda the earth quaked. There were many evil portentous phenomena. The universe became excessively frightened.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपत्य च तां देवीं महाराज्ञीं महोदयाम् । ऊचुर्वाचमकाण्डोत्थां युद्धकौतुकगद्गदाम्
verses.transliteration: praṇipatya ca tāṃ devīṃ mahārājñīṃ mahodayām / ūcurvācamakāṇḍotthāṃ yuddhakautukagadgadām
verses.translation: As the princes went along the streets in their vehicles, the elderly women of the city showered those princes of great strength with fried grains.
verses.wordMeaning: As the princes went along the streets in their vehicles, the elderly women of the city showered those princes of great strength with fried grains.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the princes went along the streets in their vehicles, the elderly women of the city showered those princes of great strength with fried grains.

verses.sanskrit: तिथिनित्या उचुः । देवदेवी महाराज्ञी तवाग्रे ब्रेक्षितां चमूम् । दण्डिनीमन्त्रनाथादिमहाशक्त्याभपालिताम्
verses.transliteration: tithinityā ucuḥ / devadevī mahārājñī tavāgre brekṣitāṃ camūm / daṇḍinīmantranāthādimahāśaktyābhapālitām
verses.translation: The bards and the panegyrists eulogised the princes. The ladies of the city performed the rite of ceremonious waving of lights as a mark of good wishes at every door.
verses.wordMeaning: The bards and the panegyrists eulogised the princes. The ladies of the city performed the rite of ceremonious waving of lights as a mark of good wishes at every door.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bards and the panegyrists eulogised the princes. The ladies of the city performed the rite of ceremonious waving of lights as a mark of good wishes at every door.

verses.sanskrit: धर्षितु कातरा दुष्टा मायाच्छद्मपरायणाः । पार्ष्णिग्राहेण युद्धेन बाधन्ते रथपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: dharṣitu kātarā duṣṭā māyācchadmaparāyaṇāḥ / pārṣṇigrāheṇa yuddhena bādhante rathapuṅgavam
verses.translation: When they set off, the earth appeared as though it was being split; it seemed as though the sky was being dragged and it looked as though the sea was being churned up and revolving.
verses.wordMeaning: When they set off, the earth appeared as though it was being split; it seemed as though the sky was being dragged and it looked as though the sea was being churned up and revolving.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they set off, the earth appeared as though it was being split; it seemed as though the sky was being dragged and it looked as though the sea was being churned up and revolving.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तिमिरसंछन्नमूर्तीनां विबुधद्रुहाम् । शमयामो वयं दर्पं क्षणमात्रं विलोकय
verses.transliteration: tasmāttimirasaṃchannamūrtīnāṃ vibudhadruhām / śamayāmo vayaṃ darpaṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ vilokaya
verses.translation: Taking with them an army consisting of two hundred
verses.wordMeaning: Taking with them an army consisting of two hundred
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking with them an army consisting of two hundred

verses.sanskrit: या वह्निवासिनी नित्या या ज्वालामालिनी परा । ताभ्यां प्रदीपिते युद्धे द्रष्टुं शक्ताः सुरद्विषः
verses.transliteration: yā vahnivāsinī nityā yā jvālāmālinī parā / tābhyāṃ pradīpite yuddhe draṣṭuṃ śaktāḥ suradviṣaḥ
verses.translation: Blinded by youthfulness and arrogance, with their power ofvision all but restrained and with eyebrows lifted up crookedly, they made loud noise like the roar of a lion.
verses.wordMeaning: Blinded by youthfulness and arrogance, with their power ofvision all but restrained and with eyebrows lifted up crookedly, they made loud noise like the roar of a lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Blinded by youthfulness and arrogance, with their power ofvision all but restrained and with eyebrows lifted up crookedly, they made loud noise like the roar of a lion.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशमय्य महादर्पं पार्ष्णिग्राहप्रवर्तिनाम् । सहसैवागमिष्यामः सेवितुं श्रीपदांबुजम् । आज्ञां देहि महाराज्ञि मर्दनार्थं दुरात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: praśamayya mahādarpaṃ pārṣṇigrāhapravartinām / sahasaivāgamiṣyāmaḥ sevituṃ śrīpadāṃbujam / ājñāṃ dehi mahārājñi mardanārthaṃ durātmanām
verses.translation: The outcome of this loud sound that had not been experienced before excited and stirred up the ears and the minds of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: The outcome of this loud sound that had not been experienced before excited and stirred up the ears and the minds of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: The outcome of this loud sound that had not been experienced before excited and stirred up the ears and the minds of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते सति नित्याभिस्तथास्त्विति जगाद सा । अथ कामेश्वरी नित्या प्रणम्य ललितेश्वरीम् । तया संप्रेषिता ताभिः कुण्डलीकृत कार्मुका
verses.transliteration: ityukte sati nityābhistathāstviti jagāda sā / atha kāmeśvarī nityā praṇamya laliteśvarīm / tayā saṃpreṣitā tābhiḥ kuṇḍalīkṛta kārmukā
verses.translation: After coming they made a great uproar through their soldiers and discharged different weapons that increased the splendour of aerial chariots.
verses.wordMeaning: After coming they made a great uproar through their soldiers and discharged different weapons that increased the splendour of aerial chariots.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming they made a great uproar through their soldiers and discharged different weapons that increased the splendour of aerial chariots.

verses.sanskrit: सा हन्तुं तान्दुराचारान्कूटयुद्धकृतक्षणान् । बालारुणमिव क्रोधारुणं वक्त्रं वितन्वती
verses.transliteration: sā hantuṃ tāndurācārānkūṭayuddhakṛtakṣaṇān / bālāruṇamiva krodhāruṇaṃ vaktraṃ vitanvatī
verses.translation: On hearing that the sons of Daitya Bhanda the chief of whom was Gaturbahu had come for the purpose of fighting, Bala (the daughter ofLalita) showed interest in it.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that the sons of Daitya Bhanda the chief of whom was Gaturbahu had come for the purpose of fighting, Bala (the daughter ofLalita) showed interest in it.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that the sons of Daitya Bhanda the chief of whom was Gaturbahu had come for the purpose of fighting, Bala (the daughter ofLalita) showed interest in it.

verses.sanskrit: रे रे तिष्ठत पापिष्ठा मायानिष्ठाश्छिनद्मि वः । अन्धकारमनुप्राप्य कूटयुद्धपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: re re tiṣṭhata pāpiṣṭhā māyāniṣṭhāśchinadmi vaḥ / andhakāramanuprāpya kūṭayuddhaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: She was the daughter ofLalita Devi. 1 She always stayed near the goddess. She was worthy of being wor- shipped by all Saktis. She was an adept in martial feats and exploits. Her form and features were like those of Lalita. She was always like a nine year old girl yet she was a great
verses.wordMeaning: She was the daughter ofLalita Devi. 1 She always stayed near the goddess. She was worthy of being wor- shipped by all Saktis. She was an adept in martial feats and exploits. Her form and features were like those of Lalita.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She was the daughter ofLalita Devi. 1 She always stayed near the goddess. She was worthy of being wor- shipped by all Saktis. She was an adept in martial feats and exploits. Her form and features were like those of Lalita.…

verses.sanskrit: इति तान्भर्त्सयन्ती सा तूणीरोत्खातसायकात् । पर्वावरोहणं चक्रे क्रोधेन प्रस्खलद्गतिः
verses.transliteration: iti tānbhartsayantī sā tūṇīrotkhātasāyakāt / parvāvarohaṇaṃ cakre krodhena praskhaladgatiḥ
verses.translation: She took off one of her armours and gave it to her. From her weapons she gave her the requisite weapons and sent her off.
verses.wordMeaning: She took off one of her armours and gave it to her. From her weapons she gave her the requisite weapons and sent her off.
verses.commentary: Sense: She took off one of her armours and gave it to her. From her weapons she gave her the requisite weapons and sent her off.

verses.sanskrit: सज्जकार्मुकहस्ताश्च भगमालापुरःसराः । अन्याश्च चरिता नित्याः कृत पर्वावरोहणाः
verses.transliteration: sajjakārmukahastāśca bhagamālāpuraḥsarāḥ / anyāśca caritā nityāḥ kṛta parvāvarohaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Kumarika (the virgin goddess) got into the covered palanquin that had been extracted by the great queen from the staff of her bow and to which hundreds of swans were yoked for drawing.
verses.wordMeaning: Kumarika (the virgin goddess) got into the covered palanquin that had been extracted by the great queen from the staff of her bow and to which hundreds of swans were yoked for drawing.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kumarika (the virgin goddess) got into the covered palanquin that had been extracted by the great queen from the staff of her bow and to which hundreds of swans were yoked for drawing.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालिनि नित्या च या नित्या वह्निवासिनी । सज्जे युद्धे स्वतेजोभिः समदीपयतां रणे
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālini nityā ca yā nityā vahnivāsinī / sajje yuddhe svatejobhiḥ samadīpayatāṃ raṇe
verses.translation: On seeing the girl red-faced in fury coming on, MantrinT and Dandanatha were frightened. They said these words:
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the girl red-faced in fury coming on, MantrinT and Dandanatha were frightened. They said these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the girl red-faced in fury coming on, MantrinT and Dandanatha were frightened. They said these words:

verses.sanskrit: अथ ते दुष्टदनुजाः प्रदीप्ते युद्धमण्डले । प्रकाशवपुषस्तत्र मरान्तं क्रोधमाययुः
verses.transliteration: atha te duṣṭadanujāḥ pradīpte yuddhamaṇḍale / prakāśavapuṣastatra marāntaṃ krodhamāyayuḥ
verses.translation: MantrinT and Dandanayika were immensely surprised. They went along with her on either side in order to guard her.
verses.wordMeaning: MantrinT and Dandanayika were immensely surprised. They went along with her on either side in order to guard her.
verses.commentary: Sense: MantrinT and Dandanayika were immensely surprised. They went along with her on either side in order to guard her.

verses.sanskrit: कामेश्वर्यादिका नित्यास्ताः पञ्चदश सायुधाः । ससिंहनादास्तान्दैत्यानमृद्नन्नेव हेलया
verses.transliteration: kāmeśvaryādikā nityāstāḥ pañcadaśa sāyudhāḥ / sasiṃhanādāstāndaityānamṛdnanneva helayā
verses.translation: Followed by both ofthem along with plenty of sol- diers, Kumarika went out through the opening in the fiery enclosure.
verses.wordMeaning: Followed by both ofthem along with plenty of sol- diers, Kumarika went out through the opening in the fiery enclosure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Followed by both ofthem along with plenty of sol- diers, Kumarika went out through the opening in the fiery enclosure.

verses.sanskrit: महाकलकलस्तत्र समभूद्युद्धसीमनि । मन्दरक्षोभितांभोदिवेल्लत्कल्लोलमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: mahākalakalastatra samabhūdyuddhasīmani / mandarakṣobhitāṃbhodivellatkallolamaṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: Seated in her covered palanquin, she accepted and
verses.wordMeaning: Seated in her covered palanquin, she accepted and
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated in her covered palanquin, she accepted and

verses.sanskrit: ताश्च नित्यावलत्क्वाणकङ्कणैर्युधि पाणिभिः । आकृष्य प्रामकोदण्डास्तेनिरे युद्धमुद्धतम्
verses.transliteration: tāśca nityāvalatkvāṇakaṅkaṇairyudhi pāṇibhiḥ / ākṛṣya prāmakodaṇḍāstenire yuddhamuddhatam
verses.translation: The female attendants moving up and down every moment informed the great queen about the magnificent fight carried on by the girl.
verses.wordMeaning: The female attendants moving up and down every moment informed the great queen about the magnificent fight carried on by the girl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The female attendants moving up and down every moment informed the great queen about the magnificent fight carried on by the girl.

verses.sanskrit: यामत्रितयपर्यन्तमेवं युद्धमवर्त्तत । नित्यानां निशितैर्बाणैरक्षौहिण्यश्च संहृताः
verses.transliteration: yāmatritayaparyantamevaṃ yuddhamavarttata / nityānāṃ niśitairbāṇairakṣauhiṇyaśca saṃhṛtāḥ
verses.translation: MantrinI and Dandanatha remained there as silent onlookers but they never left her in the course of the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: MantrinI and Dandanatha remained there as silent onlookers but they never left her in the course of the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: MantrinI and Dandanatha remained there as silent onlookers but they never left her in the course of the battle.

verses.sanskrit: जघान दमनं दुष्टं कामेशी प्रथमं शरैः । दीर्घजिह्वं चमूनाथं भगमाला व्यदारत्
verses.transliteration: jaghāna damanaṃ duṣṭaṃ kāmeśī prathamaṃ śaraiḥ / dīrghajihvaṃ camūnāthaṃ bhagamālā vyadārat
verses.translation: Though the virgin had only one single physical form she appeared differently to each one of those sons of Daitya like a series of reflections of the sun.
verses.wordMeaning: Though the virgin had only one single physical form she appeared differently to each one of those sons of Daitya like a series of reflections of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though the virgin had only one single physical form she appeared differently to each one of those sons of Daitya like a series of reflections of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यक्लिन्ना च भेरुण्डा हुम्बेकं हुलुमल्लकम् । कक्लसं वह्निवासा च निजघान शरैः शतैः
verses.transliteration: nityaklinnā ca bheruṇḍā humbekaṃ hulumallakam / kaklasaṃ vahnivāsā ca nijaghāna śaraiḥ śataiḥ
verses.translation: By discharging the Narayana missile, the daughter of the great queen reduced the army consisting oftwo hundred Aksauhinls to ashes within a. trice.
verses.wordMeaning: By discharging the Narayana missile, the daughter of the great queen reduced the army consisting oftwo hundred Aksauhinls to ashes within a. trice.
verses.commentary: Sense: By discharging the Narayana missile, the daughter of the great queen reduced the army consisting oftwo hundred Aksauhinls to ashes within a. trice.

verses.sanskrit: महावज्रेश्वरी बाणैरभिनत्केकिवाहनम् । पुक्लसं शिवदूती च प्राहिणोद्यमसादनम्
verses.transliteration: mahāvajreśvarī bāṇairabhinatkekivāhanam / puklasaṃ śivadūtī ca prāhiṇodyamasādanam
verses.translation: By. the destruction of the Aksauhinls within a short while, they became furious. Drawing their big bows fully, they rushed in a body with ease.
verses.wordMeaning: By. the destruction of the Aksauhinls within a short while, they became furious. Drawing their big bows fully, they rushed in a body with ease.
verses.commentary: Sense: By. the destruction of the Aksauhinls within a short while, they became furious. Drawing their big bows fully, they rushed in a body with ease.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्ड्रकेतुं भुजोद्दण्डं त्वरिता समदारयत् । कुलसुन्दरिका नित्या चण्डबाहुं च कुक्कुरम्
verses.transliteration: puṇḍraketuṃ bhujoddaṇḍaṃ tvaritā samadārayat / kulasundarikā nityā caṇḍabāhuṃ ca kukkuram
verses.translation: Thereupon, a tumultuous and chaotic sound rose
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, a tumultuous and chaotic sound rose
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, a tumultuous and chaotic sound rose

verses.sanskrit: अथ निलपताका च विजया च जयोद्धते । जंबुकाक्षं जृंभणं च व्यतन्वातां रणे बलिम् । सर्वमङ्गलिका नित्या तीक्ष्णशृङ्गमखण्डयत् । ज्वालामालिनिका नित्या जघानोग्रं त्रिकर्णकम्
verses.transliteration: atha nilapatākā ca vijayā ca jayoddhate / jaṃbukākṣaṃ jṛṃbhaṇaṃ ca vyatanvātāṃ raṇe balim / sarvamaṅgalikā nityā tīkṣṇaśṛṅgamakhaṇḍayat / jvālāmālinikā nityā jaghānograṃ trikarṇakam
verses.translation: The heads of all thirty sons of Bhanda were
verses.wordMeaning: The heads of all thirty sons of Bhanda were
verses.commentary: Sense: The heads of all thirty sons of Bhanda were

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रगुप्तं च दुःशीलं चित्रं चित्रा व्यदारत् । सेनानाथेषु सर्वेषु निहतेषु दुरात्मसु
verses.transliteration: candraguptaṃ ca duḥśīlaṃ citraṃ citrā vyadārat / senānātheṣu sarveṣu nihateṣu durātmasu
verses.translation: When the sons of Bhanda attained the abode of the god of death thus, those celestials standing in the sky were surprised very much. They showered flowers.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sons of Bhanda attained the abode of the god of death thus, those celestials standing in the sky were surprised very much. They showered flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sons of Bhanda attained the abode of the god of death thus, those celestials standing in the sky were surprised very much. They showered flowers.

verses.sanskrit: विषङ्गः परमः कुद्धश्चचाल पुरतो बली । अथ यामावशेषायां यामिन्यां घटिकाद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: viṣaṅgaḥ paramaḥ kuddhaścacāla purato balī / atha yāmāvaśeṣāyāṃ yāminyāṃ ghaṭikādvayam
verses.translation: That daughter of the great queen who had killed
verses.wordMeaning: That daughter of the great queen who had killed
verses.commentary: Sense: That daughter of the great queen who had killed

verses.sanskrit: नित्याभिः सह संग्रामं विधाय स दुराशयः । अशक्यत्वं समुद्दिश्य चक्राम प्रपलायितुम्
verses.transliteration: nityābhiḥ saha saṃgrāmaṃ vidhāya sa durāśayaḥ / aśakyatvaṃ samuddiśya cakrāma prapalāyitum
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: कामेश्वरीकराकृष्टचापोत्थौर्निशितैः शरैः । भिन्नवर्मा दृढतरं विषङ्गो विह्वलाशयः । हतावशिष्टैर्योधैश्च सार्धमेव पलायितः
verses.transliteration: kāmeśvarīkarākṛṣṭacāpotthaurniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / bhinnavarmā dṛḍhataraṃ viṣaṅgo vihvalāśayaḥ / hatāvaśiṣṭairyodhaiśca sārdhameva palāyitaḥ
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ताभिर्न निहतो दुष्टो यस्माद्वध्यः स दानवः । दण्डनाथाशरेणैव कालदण्डसमत्विषा
verses.transliteration: tābhirna nihato duṣṭo yasmādvadhyaḥ sa dānavaḥ / daṇḍanāthāśareṇaiva kāladaṇḍasamatviṣā
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्पलायिते दुष्टे विषङ्गे भण्डसोदरे । सा विभाता च रजनी प्रसन्नाश्चाभवन्दिशः
verses.transliteration: tasminpalāyite duṣṭe viṣaṅge bhaṇḍasodare / sā vibhātā ca rajanī prasannāścābhavandiśaḥ
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पलायितं रणेवीरमनुसर्त्तुमनौचिती । इति ताः समरान्नित्यास्तस्मिन्काले व्यरंसिषुः
verses.transliteration: palāyitaṃ raṇevīramanusarttumanaucitī / iti tāḥ samarānnityāstasminkāle vyaraṃsiṣuḥ
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यशस्त्रव्रणस्यन्दिशोणितप्लुतविग्रहाः । नित्याः श्रीललितां देवीं प्रणिपेतुर्जयोद्धताः
verses.transliteration: daityaśastravraṇasyandiśoṇitaplutavigrahāḥ / nityāḥ śrīlalitāṃ devīṃ praṇipeturjayoddhatāḥ
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं रात्रौ महद्युद्धं तत्र जातं भयङ्करम् । नित्यानां रूपजालं च शस्त्रक्षतमलोकयत्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ rātrau mahadyuddhaṃ tatra jātaṃ bhayaṅkaram / nityānāṃ rūpajālaṃ ca śastrakṣatamalokayat
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वोदन्तं महाराज्ञी कृपापाङ्गेन सैक्षत । तदालोकनमात्रेण व्रणो निर्व्रणतामगात्
verses.transliteration: śrutvodantaṃ mahārājñī kṛpāpāṅgena saikṣata / tadālokanamātreṇa vraṇo nirvraṇatāmagāt
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानां विक्रमैश्चापि ललिता प्रीतिमासदत्
verses.transliteration: nityānāṃ vikramaiścāpi lalitā prītimāsadat
verses.translation: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With shouts of 'w'ell done' proclaiming her victory and increasing in their brilliance, due to her feats of exploits, the dancing Saktis made uproarious sounds exciting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने विषङ्गपलायनं नाम पञ्चविंशो ऽध्याय प्रथमयुद्धदिवसः । दशाक्षौहिणिकायुक्तः कुटिलाक्षो ऽपि वीर्यवान् । दण्डनाथाशरैस्तीक्ष्णै रणे भग्नः पलायितः । दशाक्षौहिणिकं सैन्यं तया रात्रौ विनाशितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne viṣaṅgapalāyanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāya prathamayuddhadivasaḥ / daśākṣauhiṇikāyuktaḥ kuṭilākṣo 'pi vīryavān / daṇḍanāthāśaraistīkṣṇai raṇe bhagnaḥ palāyitaḥ / daśākṣauhiṇikaṃ sainyaṃ tayā rātrau vināśitam
verses.translation: With her fierce sword a certain Sakti cut offthe pole, of the chariot ofa lordly Danava and enhanced the pleasure of the earth.
verses.wordMeaning: With her fierce sword a certain Sakti cut offthe pole, of the chariot ofa lordly Danava and enhanced the pleasure of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her fierce sword a certain Sakti cut offthe pole, of the chariot ofa lordly Danava and enhanced the pleasure of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: इमं वृत्तान्तमाकर्ण्य भण्डः क्षोभमथाययौ । रात्रौ कपटसंग्रामं दुष्टानां निर्जरद्रुहाम् । मन्त्रिणी दण्डनाथा च श्रुत्वा निर्वेदमापतुः
verses.transliteration: imaṃ vṛttāntamākarṇya bhaṇḍaḥ kṣobhamathāyayau / rātrau kapaṭasaṃgrāmaṃ duṣṭānāṃ nirjaradruhām / mantriṇī daṇḍanāthā ca śrutvā nirvedamāpatuḥ
verses.translation: The army of Saktis infiltrated into the army of Daityas and the army of Daityas infiltrated into the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: The army of Saktis infiltrated into the army of Daityas and the army of Daityas infiltrated into the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: The army of Saktis infiltrated into the army of Daityas and the army of Daityas infiltrated into the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: अहो बत महत्कष्टं दैत्यैर्देव्याः समागतम् । उत्तानबुद्धिभिर्दूरमस्माभिश्चलितं पुरः
verses.transliteration: aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ daityairdevyāḥ samāgatam / uttānabuddhibhirdūramasmābhiścalitaṃ puraḥ
verses.translation: The close intermingling of Saktis and the demons was like that ofwater and milk. During the time of fighting it confused both of them.
verses.wordMeaning: The close intermingling of Saktis and the demons was like that ofwater and milk. During the time of fighting it confused both of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The close intermingling of Saktis and the demons was like that ofwater and milk. During the time of fighting it confused both of them.

verses.sanskrit: महाचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य न जातं रक्षणं बलैः । एतं त्ववसरं प्राप्य रात्रौ दुष्टैः पराकृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahācakrarathendrasya na jātaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ balaiḥ / etaṃ tvavasaraṃ prāpya rātrau duṣṭaiḥ parākṛtam
verses.translation: When the trunks and the tusks ofthe mad elephants of the Daityas were cut off by the swords of Saktis they appeared like huge boars.
verses.wordMeaning: When the trunks and the tusks ofthe mad elephants of the Daityas were cut off by the swords of Saktis they appeared like huge boars.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the trunks and the tusks ofthe mad elephants of the Daityas were cut off by the swords of Saktis they appeared like huge boars.

verses.sanskrit: को वृत्तान्तो ऽभवत्तत्र स्वामिन्या किं रणः कृतः । अन्या वा शक्तयस्तत्र चक्रुर्युद्धं महासुरैः
verses.transliteration: ko vṛttānto 'bhavattatra svāminyā kiṃ raṇaḥ kṛtaḥ / anyā vā śaktayastatra cakruryuddhaṃ mahāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: Samharagupta the huge vulture of cruel eyes bore Balahaka who kept the bow well drawn in the course of the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Samharagupta the huge vulture of cruel eyes bore Balahaka who kept the bow well drawn in the course of the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samharagupta the huge vulture of cruel eyes bore Balahaka who kept the bow well drawn in the course of the battle.

verses.sanskrit: विम्रष्टव्यमिदं कार्यं प्रवृत्तिस्तत्र कीदृशी । महादेव्याश्च हृदये कः प्रसंगः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: vimraṣṭavyamidaṃ kāryaṃ pravṛttistatra kīdṛśī / mahādevyāśca hṛdaye kaḥ prasaṃgaḥ pravartate
verses.translation: Seated on the back of vulture with his body moving up and down, Balahaka appeared like the Balahaka cloud (at the time of dissolution) clinging to a Kuta mountain with wings.
verses.wordMeaning: Seated on the back of vulture with his body moving up and down, Balahaka appeared like the Balahaka cloud (at the time of dissolution) clinging to a Kuta mountain with wings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated on the back of vulture with his body moving up and down, Balahaka appeared like the Balahaka cloud (at the time of dissolution) clinging to a Kuta mountain with wings.

verses.sanskrit: इति शङ्काकुलास्तत्र दण्डनाथापुरोगमाः । मन्त्रिणीं पुरतः कृत्वा प्रचेलुर्ललितां प्रति
verses.transliteration: iti śaṅkākulāstatra daṇḍanāthāpurogamāḥ / mantriṇīṃ purataḥ kṛtvā pracelurlalitāṃ prati
verses.translation: The leading Daitya, Suclmukha mounted on his vehicle crow. The root of its wings was as sharp (hard) as needle. Riding on this he fought a hard battle.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Daitya, Suclmukha mounted on his vehicle crow. The root of its wings was as sharp (hard) as needle. Riding on this he fought a hard battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Daitya, Suclmukha mounted on his vehicle crow. The root of its wings was as sharp (hard) as needle. Riding on this he fought a hard battle.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिचक्रचमूनाथाः सर्वास्ताः पूजिता द्रुतम् । व्यतीतायां विभावर्यां रथेन्द्रं पर्यवारयन्
verses.transliteration: śakticakracamūnāthāḥ sarvāstāḥ pūjitā drutam / vyatītāyāṃ vibhāvaryāṃ rathendraṃ paryavārayan
verses.translation: Then (the next general) Phalamukha took up a ploughshare as his weapon. Riding on a heron resembling a mountain, he shone brilliantly in the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Then (the next general) Phalamukha took up a ploughshare as his weapon. Riding on a heron resembling a mountain, he shone brilliantly in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then (the next general) Phalamukha took up a ploughshare as his weapon. Riding on a heron resembling a mountain, he shone brilliantly in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: अवरुह्य स्वयानाभ्यां मन्त्रिणीदण्डनायिके । अधस्तात्सैन्यमावेश्य तदारुरुहतू रथम्
verses.transliteration: avaruhya svayānābhyāṃ mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyike / adhastātsainyamāveśya tadāruruhatū ratham
verses.translation: The leading Daitya named Vikarna, the extremely mighty general, rode on his vehicle the Bherunda bird and fought a fierce battle.
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Daitya named Vikarna, the extremely mighty general, rode on his vehicle the Bherunda bird and fought a fierce battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Daitya named Vikarna, the extremely mighty general, rode on his vehicle the Bherunda bird and fought a fierce battle.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेण नव पर्वाणि व्यतीत्य त्वरितक्रमैः । तत्तत्सर्वगतैः शक्तिचक्रैः सम्यङ् निवेदितैः
verses.transliteration: krameṇa nava parvāṇi vyatītya tvaritakramaiḥ / tattatsarvagataiḥ śakticakraiḥ samyaṅ niveditaiḥ
verses.translation: A fierce cock of extremely dreadful nature bore (the
verses.wordMeaning: A fierce cock of extremely dreadful nature bore (the
verses.commentary: Sense: A fierce cock of extremely dreadful nature bore (the

verses.sanskrit: अभजेतां महाराज्ञीं मन्त्रिणीदण्डनायिके । ते व्यजिज्ञपतां देव्या अष्टाङ्गस्पृष्टभूतले
verses.transliteration: abhajetāṃ mahārājñīṃ mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyike / te vyajijñapatāṃ devyā aṣṭāṅgaspṛṣṭabhūtale
verses.translation: Surveying the army of Saktis from the front with blazing eyes, and roaring loudly, the cock moved about mak- ing the hairs on its neck stand on their ends.
verses.wordMeaning: Surveying the army of Saktis from the front with blazing eyes, and roaring loudly, the cock moved about mak- ing the hairs on its neck stand on their ends.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surveying the army of Saktis from the front with blazing eyes, and roaring loudly, the cock moved about mak- ing the hairs on its neck stand on their ends.

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रमादः समभूदिति नः श्रुतमंबिके । कूटयुद्धप्रकारेण दैत्यैरपकृतं खलैः
verses.transliteration: mahāpramādaḥ samabhūditi naḥ śrutamaṃbike / kūṭayuddhaprakāreṇa daityairapakṛtaṃ khalaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus, these seven evil-souled haughty Danavas, comparable to the seven oceans, harassed and tormented the soldiers of Saktis there.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, these seven evil-souled haughty Danavas, comparable to the seven oceans, harassed and tormented the soldiers of Saktis there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, these seven evil-souled haughty Danavas, comparable to the seven oceans, harassed and tormented the soldiers of Saktis there.

verses.sanskrit: स दुरात्मा दुराचारः प्रकाशसमारात्त्रसन् । कुहकव्यवहारेण जयसिद्धिं तु काक्षति
verses.transliteration: sa durātmā durācāraḥ prakāśasamārāttrasan / kuhakavyavahāreṇa jayasiddhiṃ tu kākṣati
verses.translation: Formerly, these seven Daityas had propitiated the sun-god by means of penance. Boon had been granted to them by the sun-god who had been pleased with their penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, these seven Daityas had propitiated the sun-god by means of penance. Boon had been granted to them by the sun-god who had been pleased with their penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, these seven Daityas had propitiated the sun-god by means of penance. Boon had been granted to them by the sun-god who had been pleased with their penance.

verses.sanskrit: दैवान्नः स्वामिनीगात्रे दुष्टानाममरद्रुहाम् । शरादिकपरामर्शो न जातस्तेन जीवति
verses.transliteration: daivānnaḥ svāminīgātre duṣṭānāmamaradruhām / śarādikaparāmarśo na jātastena jīvati
verses.translation: Looked at by them when eyes had been penetrated and occupied by the sungod, the innumerable weapons of Saktis became immobilized and they found their zeal (in war) futile.
verses.wordMeaning: Looked at by them when eyes had been penetrated and occupied by the sungod, the innumerable weapons of Saktis became immobilized and they found their zeal (in war) futile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Looked at by them when eyes had been penetrated and occupied by the sungod, the innumerable weapons of Saktis became immobilized and they found their zeal (in war) futile.

verses.sanskrit: एकावलंबनं कृत्वा महाराज्ञि भवत्पदम् । वयं सर्वा हि जीवामः साधयामः समीहितम्
verses.transliteration: ekāvalaṃbanaṃ kṛtvā mahārājñi bhavatpadam / vayaṃ sarvā hi jīvāmaḥ sādhayāmaḥ samīhitam
verses.translation: When the missiles and weapons were blocked and immobilized by those seven sons of KIkasa, of great inherent strength, Saktis could not exert themselves.
verses.wordMeaning: When the missiles and weapons were blocked and immobilized by those seven sons of KIkasa, of great inherent strength, Saktis could not exert themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the missiles and weapons were blocked and immobilized by those seven sons of KIkasa, of great inherent strength, Saktis could not exert themselves.

verses.sanskrit: अतो ऽस्माभिः प्रकर्तव्यं श्रीमत्यङ्गस्य रक्षणम् । मायाविनश्च दैत्येन्द्रास्तत्र मन्त्रो विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: ato 'smābhiḥ prakartavyaṃ śrīmatyaṅgasya rakṣaṇam / māyāvinaśca daityendrāstatra mantro vidhīyatām
verses.translation: Even when they exerted themselves they were over- come much by the immobilization of their weapons. So Saktis heaved a deep sigh and sat quiet.
verses.wordMeaning: Even when they exerted themselves they were over- come much by the immobilization of their weapons. So Saktis heaved a deep sigh and sat quiet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when they exerted themselves they were over- come much by the immobilization of their weapons. So Saktis heaved a deep sigh and sat quiet.

verses.sanskrit: आपत्कालेषु जेतव्या भण्डाद्या दानवाधमाः । कूटयुद्धं न कुर्वन्ति न विशन्ति चमूमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: āpatkāleṣu jetavyā bhaṇḍādyā dānavādhamāḥ / kūṭayuddhaṃ na kurvanti na viśanti camūmimām
verses.translation: Thereupon, finding a suitable opportunity, the Daityas who were directed by their masters, rose up with different kinds of weapons and smashed the army of Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, finding a suitable opportunity, the Daityas who were directed by their masters, rose up with different kinds of weapons and smashed the army of Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, finding a suitable opportunity, the Daityas who were directed by their masters, rose up with different kinds of weapons and smashed the army of Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: तथा महेन्द्रशैलस्य कार्यं दक्षिणदेशतः । शिबिरं बहुविस्तारं योजनानां शतावधि
verses.transliteration: tathā mahendraśailasya kāryaṃ dakṣiṇadeśataḥ / śibiraṃ bahuvistāraṃ yojanānāṃ śatāvadhi
verses.translation: Those Saktis who were deprived oftheir activity and who were prevented from using their weapons became perplexed and agitated on account of their arrows that could pierce even adamantine coats of mail.
verses.wordMeaning: Those Saktis who were deprived oftheir activity and who were prevented from using their weapons became perplexed and agitated on account of their arrows that could pierce even adamantine coats of mail.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Saktis who were deprived oftheir activity and who were prevented from using their weapons became perplexed and agitated on account of their arrows that could pierce even adamantine coats of mail.

verses.sanskrit: वह्लिप्राकारवलयं रक्षणार्थं विधीयताम् । अस्मत्सेनानिवेशस्य द्विषां दर्पशमाय च
verses.transliteration: vahliprākāravalayaṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ vidhīyatām / asmatsenāniveśasya dviṣāṃ darpaśamāya ca
verses.translation: The Saktis whose bodies had been wounded and pierced by the numerous weapons of Daityas in the battle field appeared like the creepers ofKarikola with plenty of good sprouts.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis whose bodies had been wounded and pierced by the numerous weapons of Daityas in the battle field appeared like the creepers ofKarikola with plenty of good sprouts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis whose bodies had been wounded and pierced by the numerous weapons of Daityas in the battle field appeared like the creepers ofKarikola with plenty of good sprouts.

verses.sanskrit: शतयोजनमात्रस्तु मध्यतेशः प्रकल्प्यताम् । वह्निप्राकाराचक्रस्य द्वारन्दक्षिणतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śatayojanamātrastu madhyateśaḥ prakalpyatām / vahniprākārācakrasya dvārandakṣiṇato bhavet
verses.translation: All those Saktis whose weapons were immobilized by them shrieked and wailed. Crying piteously, they resorted to goddess Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: All those Saktis whose weapons were immobilized by them shrieked and wailed. Crying piteously, they resorted to goddess Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those Saktis whose weapons were immobilized by them shrieked and wailed. Crying piteously, they resorted to goddess Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: यतो दक्षिणदेशस्थं शून्यकं विद्विषां पुरम् । द्वारे च बहवः कल्प्याः परिवारा उदायुधाः
verses.transliteration: yato dakṣiṇadeśasthaṃ śūnyakaṃ vidviṣāṃ puram / dvāre ca bahavaḥ kalpyāḥ parivārā udāyudhāḥ
verses.translation: Then, at the bidding of the goddess, the deity Tiras- karanika (Magical veil), the body-guard of Dandanatha rose up in the arena oft he battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Then, at the bidding of the goddess, the deity Tiras- karanika (Magical veil), the body-guard of Dandanatha rose up in the arena oft he battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, at the bidding of the goddess, the deity Tiras- karanika (Magical veil), the body-guard of Dandanatha rose up in the arena oft he battle.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गच्छतां प्रविशतां जनानामुपरोधकाः । अनालस्या अनिद्राश्च विधेयाः सततोद्यताः
verses.transliteration: nirgacchatāṃ praviśatāṃ janānāmuparodhakāḥ / anālasyā anidrāśca vidheyāḥ satatodyatāḥ
verses.translation: That Mahamaya (great deity of magical powers) got into an aerial chariot named Tamolipta with doors all round and assured Saktis about freedom from fear.
verses.wordMeaning: That Mahamaya (great deity of magical powers) got into an aerial chariot named Tamolipta with doors all round and assured Saktis about freedom from fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Mahamaya (great deity of magical powers) got into an aerial chariot named Tamolipta with doors all round and assured Saktis about freedom from fear.

verses.sanskrit: एवं च सति दुष्टानां कूटयुद्धं चिकीर्षितम् । अवेलासु च संध्यासु मध्यरात्रिषु च द्विषाम् । अशक्यमेव भवति प्रौढमाक्रमणं हठात्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ ca sati duṣṭānāṃ kūṭayuddhaṃ cikīrṣitam / avelāsu ca saṃdhyāsu madhyarātriṣu ca dviṣām / aśakyameva bhavati prauḍhamākramaṇaṃ haṭhāt
verses.translation: The Daityas were unable to bear the arrows that had the form and features of black serpents, that resembled iron clubs at their lower ends and that charged with the missile Mohana.
verses.wordMeaning: The Daityas were unable to bear the arrows that had the form and features of black serpents, that resembled iron clubs at their lower ends and that charged with the missile Mohana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Daityas were unable to bear the arrows that had the form and features of black serpents, that resembled iron clubs at their lower ends and that charged with the missile Mohana.

verses.sanskrit: नो चेद्दुराशया दैत्या बहुमायापरिग्रहाः । पश्यतोहरवत्सर्वं विलुठन्ति महद्बलम्
verses.transliteration: no ceddurāśayā daityā bahumāyāparigrahāḥ / paśyatoharavatsarvaṃ viluṭhanti mahadbalam
verses.translation: Thereafter, at the bidding of Dandanatha, the deity, Mother TiraskaranI discharged the great missile named Andha ( Blindingone) amidst the group ofenemies.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, at the bidding of Dandanatha, the deity, Mother TiraskaranI discharged the great missile named Andha ( Blindingone) amidst the group ofenemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, at the bidding of Dandanatha, the deity, Mother TiraskaranI discharged the great missile named Andha ( Blindingone) amidst the group ofenemies.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रिण्या दण्डनाथाया इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तदा । शुचिदन्तरुचा मुक्ता वहन्ती ललिताब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: mantriṇyā daṇḍanāthāyā iti śrutvā vacastadā / śucidantarucā muktā vahantī lalitābravīt
verses.translation: Their eyes were afflicted by the blinding arrows that were discharged from the bow Mahamohana of the goddess Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: Their eyes were afflicted by the blinding arrows that were discharged from the bow Mahamohana of the goddess Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their eyes were afflicted by the blinding arrows that were discharged from the bow Mahamohana of the goddess Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: भवतीनामयं मन्त्रश्चारुबुद्ध्या विचारितः । अयं कुशलधीमार्गोनीतिरेषा सनातनी
verses.transliteration: bhavatīnāmayaṃ mantraścārubuddhyā vicāritaḥ / ayaṃ kuśaladhīmārgonītireṣā sanātanī
verses.translation: All those seven became blinded. They did not look at anything. In the absence of that vision, the immobilization of weapons came to an end.
verses.wordMeaning: All those seven became blinded. They did not look at anything. In the absence of that vision, the immobilization of weapons came to an end.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those seven became blinded. They did not look at anything. In the absence of that vision, the immobilization of weapons came to an end.

verses.sanskrit: स्वचक्रस्य पुरो रक्षां विधाय दृढसाधनैः । परचक्राक्रमः कार्यो जिगीषद्भिर्महाजनैः
verses.transliteration: svacakrasya puro rakṣāṃ vidhāya dṛḍhasādhanaiḥ / paracakrākramaḥ kāryo jigīṣadbhirmahājanaiḥ
verses.translation: Once again those (Saktis) raised weapons in their hands roaring like lions. With a desire to kill Daityas, they made preparations for the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Once again those (Saktis) raised weapons in their hands roaring like lions. With a desire to kill Daityas, they made preparations for the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once again those (Saktis) raised weapons in their hands roaring like lions. With a desire to kill Daityas, they made preparations for the battle.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथे सा ललितेश्वरी । ज्वालामालिनिकां नित्यामाहूयेदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe sā laliteśvarī / jvālāmālinikāṃ nityāmāhūyedamuvāca ha
verses.translation: They kept the deity Tiraskaranika of great might in front of them. Due to the use of that good (effective) means, they became extremely delighted and fought.
verses.wordMeaning: They kept the deity Tiraskaranika of great might in front of them. Due to the use of that good (effective) means, they became extremely delighted and fought.
verses.commentary: Sense: They kept the deity Tiraskaranika of great might in front of them. Due to the use of that good (effective) means, they became extremely delighted and fought.

verses.sanskrit: वत्से त्वं वह्निरूपासि ज्वालामालामयाकृतिः । त्वया विधीयतां रक्षा बलस्यास्य महीयसः
verses.transliteration: vatse tvaṃ vahnirūpāsi jvālāmālāmayākṛtiḥ / tvayā vidhīyatāṃ rakṣā balasyāsya mahīyasaḥ
verses.translation: "O Mother Tiraskarnika ofexalted fortune well done, "well done. You have appropriately screened off these wicked- souled enemies.
verses.wordMeaning: "O Mother Tiraskarnika ofexalted fortune well done, "well done. You have appropriately screened off these wicked- souled enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Mother Tiraskarnika ofexalted fortune well done, "well done. You have appropriately screened off these wicked- souled enemies.

verses.sanskrit: शतयोजनविस्तारं परिवृत्य महीतलम् । त्रिंशद्योजनमुन्नद्धं ज्वालाकारत्वमाव्रज
verses.transliteration: śatayojanavistāraṃ parivṛtya mahītalam / triṃśadyojanamunnaddhaṃ jvālākāratvamāvraja
verses.translation: You are the great medicinal herb for screening (blinding) the eyes ofthe wicked. This troop of Daityas has been blinded by you.
verses.wordMeaning: You are the great medicinal herb for screening (blinding) the eyes ofthe wicked. This troop of Daityas has been blinded by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the great medicinal herb for screening (blinding) the eyes ofthe wicked. This troop of Daityas has been blinded by you.

verses.sanskrit: द्वारयोजनमात्रं तु मुक्त्वान्यत्र ज्वलत्तनुः । वह्निज्वालात्वमापन्ना संरक्ष सकलं बलम्
verses.transliteration: dvārayojanamātraṃ tu muktvānyatra jvalattanuḥ / vahnijvālātvamāpannā saṃrakṣa sakalaṃ balam
verses.translation: O deity, this task ofthe Devas has been perfectly carried out by you since you have brought a disaster among these Daityas who cannot be conquered by us.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity, this task ofthe Devas has been perfectly carried out by you since you have brought a disaster among these Daityas who cannot be conquered by us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity, this task ofthe Devas has been perfectly carried out by you since you have brought a disaster among these Daityas who cannot be conquered by us.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथे सा ललितेश्वरी । महेन्द्रोत्तरभूभागं चलितुं चक्र उद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe sā laliteśvarī / mahendrottarabhūbhāgaṃ calituṃ cakra udyamam
verses.translation: Hence, you alone, do kill these seven Daityas in the arena ofbattle. Raising up our weapons we shall destroy the entire army of these Daityas".
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you alone, do kill these seven Daityas in the arena ofbattle. Raising up our weapons we shall destroy the entire army of these Daityas".
