verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you alone, do kill these seven Daityas in the arena ofbattle. Raising up our weapons we shall destroy the entire army of these Daityas".

verses.sanskrit: सा च नित्यानित्यमयी ज्वलज्ज्वा लामयाकृतिः । चतुर्दशीतिथिमयी तथेति प्रणनाम ताम्
verses.transliteration: sā ca nityānityamayī jvalajjvā lāmayākṛtiḥ / caturdaśītithimayī tatheti praṇanāma tām
verses.translation: Oh being told thus and encouraged by those Saktis on account of their zeal for war (that deity Tiraskaranika) proceeded towards the army of Balahaka by means of the vehicle Tamolipta.
verses.wordMeaning: Oh being told thus and encouraged by those Saktis on account of their zeal for war (that deity Tiraskaranika) proceeded towards the army of Balahaka by means of the vehicle Tamolipta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Oh being told thus and encouraged by those Saktis on account of their zeal for war (that deity Tiraskaranika) proceeded towards the army of Balahaka by means of the vehicle Tamolipta.

verses.sanskrit: तयैव पूर्वनिर्दिष्टं महेन्द्रोत्तरभूतलम् । कुण्डलीकृत्य जज्वालशालरूपेण सा पुनः
verses.transliteration: tayaiva pūrvanirdiṣṭaṃ mahendrottarabhūtalam / kuṇḍalīkṛtya jajvālaśālarūpeṇa sā punaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing her advancing, those seven base Asuras immediately remembered the boon granted by the sun god.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her advancing, those seven base Asuras immediately remembered the boon granted by the sun god.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her advancing, those seven base Asuras immediately remembered the boon granted by the sun god.

verses.sanskrit: नभोवलयजंबालज्वालामालामयाकृतिः । बभासे दण्डनाथाया मन्त्रिनाथचमूरपि
verses.transliteration: nabhovalayajaṃbālajvālāmālāmayākṛtiḥ / babhāse daṇḍanāthāyā mantrināthacamūrapi
verses.translation: Although the splendour ofthe sun entered their eyes, that destructive power within the eyes was overcome when the eyes had been covered by the prowess of Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: Although the splendour ofthe sun entered their eyes, that destructive power within the eyes was overcome when the eyes had been covered by the prowess of Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the splendour ofthe sun entered their eyes, that destructive power within the eyes was overcome when the eyes had been covered by the prowess of Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: अन्या सामपि शक्तीनां महतीनां महद्बलम् । विशङ्कटोदरं सालं प्रविवेश गतक्लमा
verses.transliteration: anyā sāmapi śaktīnāṃ mahatīnāṃ mahadbalam / viśaṅkaṭodaraṃ sālaṃ praviveśa gataklamā
verses.translation: The great asura Balahaka had formerly been blind due to his pride on being granted the boon as well as on account ofhis power ofweapons. He was blind due to anger also. Now he literally became blind on account of the missile (of the deity). Therefore, the deity Antardhidevata (i.e. Tiras- karanika) dragged him by his hairs and cut him off by means of Jier sword.
verses.wordMeaning: The great asura Balahaka had formerly been blind due to his pride on being granted the boon as well as on account ofhis power ofweapons. He was blind due to anger also. Now he literally became blind on account of the missile (of the deity). Therefore,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The great asura Balahaka had formerly been blind due to his pride on being granted the boon as well as on account ofhis power ofweapons. He was blind due to anger also. Now he literally became blind on account of the missile (of the deity). Therefore,…

verses.sanskrit: राजचक्ररथेन्द्रं तु मध्ये संस्थाप्य दण्डिनी । वामपक्षे रथं स्वीयं दक्षिणे श्यामलारथम्
verses.transliteration: rājacakrarathendraṃ tu madhye saṃsthāpya daṇḍinī / vāmapakṣe rathaṃ svīyaṃ dakṣiṇe śyāmalāratham
verses.translation: After cutting off, with an arrow, the head of his
verses.wordMeaning: After cutting off, with an arrow, the head of his
verses.commentary: Sense: After cutting off, with an arrow, the head of his

verses.sanskrit: पश्चाद्भागे सम्पदेशीं पुरस्ताश्च हयासनाम् । एवं संवेश्य परितश्चक्रराजरथस्य च
verses.transliteration: paścādbhāge sampadeśīṃ purastāśca hayāsanām / evaṃ saṃveśya paritaścakrarājarathasya ca
verses.translation: After cutting off his hardhead with a blow of her sharp-edged spear, she gradually killed the other five Daityas too.
verses.wordMeaning: After cutting off his hardhead with a blow of her sharp-edged spear, she gradually killed the other five Daityas too.
verses.commentary: Sense: After cutting off his hardhead with a blow of her sharp-edged spear, she gradually killed the other five Daityas too.

verses.sanskrit: द्वारे निवेशयामास विंशत्यक्षौहिणीयुताम् । ज्वलद्दण्डायुधोदग्रां स्तम्भिनीं नाम देवताम्
verses.transliteration: dvāre niveśayāmāsa viṃśatyakṣauhiṇīyutām / jvaladdaṇḍāyudhodagrāṃ stambhinīṃ nāma devatām
verses.translation: The deity Antardhidevata made a garland with the seven severed heads of the Daityas by joining one another by means of their own tresses. Wearing that garland round her neck she roared loudly.
verses.wordMeaning: The deity Antardhidevata made a garland with the seven severed heads of the Daityas by joining one another by means of their own tresses. Wearing that garland round her neck she roared loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity Antardhidevata made a garland with the seven severed heads of the Daityas by joining one another by means of their own tresses. Wearing that garland round her neck she roared loudly.

verses.sanskrit: या देवी दण्डनाथाया विघ्नदेवीति विश्रुता । एवं सुरक्षितं कृत्वा शिबिरं योत्रिणी तथा । पूषण्युदितभूयिष्ठे पुनर्युद्धमुपाश्रयत्
verses.transliteration: yā devī daṇḍanāthāyā vighnadevīti viśrutā / evaṃ surakṣitaṃ kṛtvā śibiraṃ yotriṇī tathā / pūṣaṇyuditabhūyiṣṭhe punaryuddhamupāśrayat
verses.translation: In the height of their fury, Saktis killed their army wholly and made many rivers of their blood flow.
verses.wordMeaning: In the height of their fury, Saktis killed their army wholly and made many rivers of their blood flow.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the height of their fury, Saktis killed their army wholly and made many rivers of their blood flow.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा किलकिलारावं ततः शक्तिमहाचमूः । अग्निप्राकारकद्वारान्निर्जगाम् महारवा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā kilakilārāvaṃ tataḥ śaktimahācamūḥ / agniprākārakadvārānnirjagām mahāravā
verses.translation: A few who survived the killing became utterly con- fused and frightened. In their extreme agony, they sought shcl-
verses.wordMeaning: A few who survived the killing became utterly con- fused and frightened. In their extreme agony, they sought shcl-
verses.commentary: Sense: A few who survived the killing became utterly con- fused and frightened. In their extreme agony, they sought shcl-

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं सुरक्षितं श्रुत्वा ललिताशिबिरोदरम् । भूयः संज्वरमापन्नः प्रचण्डो भण्डदानवः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ surakṣitaṃ śrutvā lalitāśibirodaram / bhūyaḥ saṃjvaramāpannaḥ pracaṇḍo bhaṇḍadānavaḥ
verses.translation: Those Daityas who survived began to praise Daninl and Mahamaya again and again. They were pleased because they were able to receive the graceful blessing glance from her.
verses.wordMeaning: Those Daityas who survived began to praise Daninl and Mahamaya again and again. They were pleased because they were able to receive the graceful blessing glance from her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Daityas who survived began to praise Daninl and Mahamaya again and again. They were pleased because they were able to receive the graceful blessing glance from her.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रयित्वा पुनस्तत्र कुटिलाक्षपुरोगमैः । विषङ्गेण विशुक्रेणासममात्मसुतैरपि
verses.transliteration: mantrayitvā punastatra kuṭilākṣapurogamaiḥ / viṣaṅgeṇa viśukreṇāsamamātmasutairapi
verses.translation: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were there shook their heads in approbation saying "Well done, well done." At every step they praised the deity Tiraskaranika.

verses.sanskrit: एकौघस्य प्रसारेण युद्धं कर्तुं महाबलः । चतुर्बाहुमुखान्पुत्रांश्चतुर्जलधिसन्निभान्
verses.transliteration: ekaughasya prasāreṇa yuddhaṃ kartuṃ mahābalaḥ / caturbāhumukhānputrāṃścaturjaladhisannibhān
verses.translation: "Thereafter, on hearing the killing of those (Daityas) though they had the power of Penance, Bhanda, the great Asura, sighed deeply like the Lord of Black serpents.
verses.wordMeaning: "Thereafter, on hearing the killing of those (Daityas) though they had the power of Penance, Bhanda, the great Asura, sighed deeply like the Lord of Black serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Thereafter, on hearing the killing of those (Daityas) though they had the power of Penance, Bhanda, the great Asura, sighed deeply like the Lord of Black serpents.

verses.sanskrit: चतुरान्युद्धकृत्येषु समाहूय स दानवः । प्रेषयामास युद्धाय भण्डश्चण्डक्रुधा ज्वलन्
verses.transliteration: caturānyuddhakṛtyeṣu samāhūya sa dānavaḥ / preṣayāmāsa yuddhāya bhaṇḍaścaṇḍakrudhā jvalan
verses.translation: This chapter describes how Nitya Saktis repulsed the surprise attack on the rear of the army by demons under Visanga, under cover of darkness.
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter describes how Nitya Saktis repulsed the surprise attack on the rear of the army by demons under Visanga, under cover of darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter describes how Nitya Saktis repulsed the surprise attack on the rear of the army by demons under Visanga, under cover of darkness.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशत्संख्याश्च तत्पुत्रा महाकाया महाबलाः । तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि समाकर्णय कुम्भज
verses.transliteration: triṃśatsaṃkhyāśca tatputrā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ / teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi samākarṇaya kumbhaja
verses.translation: Desirous ofvictory in the battle, Bhanda of fierce haughtiness, called his brothers and took counsel with them in a solitary place.
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous ofvictory in the battle, Bhanda of fierce haughtiness, called his brothers and took counsel with them in a solitary place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous ofvictory in the battle, Bhanda of fierce haughtiness, called his brothers and took counsel with them in a solitary place.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्बाहुश्चकोराक्षस्तृतीयस्तु चतुः शिराः । वज्रघोषश्चोर्ध्वकेशो महाकायो महाहनुः
verses.transliteration: caturbāhuścakorākṣastṛtīyastu catuḥ śirāḥ / vajraghoṣaścordhvakeśo mahākāyo mahāhanuḥ
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: मखशत्रुर्मखस्कन्दीसिंहघोषः सिरालकः । लडुनः पट्टसेनश्च पुराजित्पूर्वमारकः
verses.transliteration: makhaśatrurmakhaskandīsiṃhaghoṣaḥ sirālakaḥ / laḍunaḥ paṭṭasenaśca purājitpūrvamārakaḥ
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गशत्रुः स्वर्गबलो दुर्गाख्यः स्वर्गकण्टकः । अतिमायो बृहन्माय उपमायश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: svargaśatruḥ svargabalo durgākhyaḥ svargakaṇṭakaḥ / atimāyo bṛhanmāya upamāyaśca vīryavān
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते दुर्मदाः पुत्रा भण्डदैत्यस्य दुर्द्धियः । पितुः सदृशदोर्वीर्याः पितुः सदृशविग्रहाः
verses.transliteration: ityete durmadāḥ putrā bhaṇḍadaityasya durddhiyaḥ / pituḥ sadṛśadorvīryāḥ pituḥ sadṛśavigrahāḥ
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य भण्डचरणावभ्यवन्दत भक्तितः । तानुद्वीक्ष्य प्रसन्नाभ्यां लोचनाभ्यां स दानवः । सगौरवमिदं वाक्यं बभाषे कुलघातकः

verses.sanskrit: त्वां विना क्षणमात्रं मे न निश्वासः प्रवर्तते । ममोच्छ्वसितमेवासि न त्वं याहि महाहवम्
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ vinā kṣaṇamātraṃ me na niśvāsaḥ pravartate / mamocchvasitamevāsi na tvaṃ yāhi mahāhavam

verses.sanskrit: दण्डिनी मन्त्रिणी चैव शक्तयो ऽन्याश्च कोटिशः । संत्येव समरे कर्तुं वत्से त्वं किं प्रमाद्यसि
verses.transliteration: daṇḍinī mantriṇī caiva śaktayo 'nyāśca koṭiśaḥ / saṃtyeva samare kartuṃ vatse tvaṃ kiṃ pramādyasi

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीललितादेव्या निरुद्धापि कुमारिका । कौमारकौतुकाविष्टा पुनर्युद्धमयाचत

verses.sanskrit: सुदृढं निश्चयं दृष्ट्वा तस्याः श्रीललितांबिका । अनुज्ञां कृतवत्येव गाढमाश्लिष्य बाहुभिः
verses.transliteration: sudṛḍhaṃ niścayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyāḥ śrīlalitāṃbikā / anujñāṃ kṛtavatyeva gāḍhamāśliṣya bāhubhiḥ

verses.sanskrit: स्वकीयकवचादेकमाच्छिद्य कवचं ददौ । स्वायुधेभ्यश्चायुधानि वितीर्यविससर्ज ताम्
verses.transliteration: svakīyakavacādekamācchidya kavacaṃ dadau / svāyudhebhyaścāyudhāni vitīryavisasarja tām

verses.sanskrit: कर्णीरथं महाराज्ञ्या चापदण्डात्समुद्धृतम् । हंसयुग्यशतैर्युक्तमारुरोह कुमारिका

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां रणे प्रवृत्तायां सर्वपर्वस्थदेवताः । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा नेमुः प्रधृतासिपरंपराः

verses.sanskrit: ताभिः प्रणम्यमाना सा चक्रराजरथोत्तमात् । अवरुह्य तले सैन्यं वर्तमानमगाहत

verses.sanskrit: तामायान्तीमथो दृष्ट्वा कुमारीं कोपपाटलाम् । मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथे च सभये वाचमूचतुः
verses.transliteration: tāmāyāntīmatho dṛṣṭvā kumārīṃ kopapāṭalām / mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe ca sabhaye vācamūcatuḥ

verses.sanskrit: किं भर्तृदारिके युद्धे व्यवसायः कृतस्त्वया । अकाण्डे किं महाराज्ञ्या प्रेषितासि रणं प्रति

verses.transliteration: athāgnivaraṇadvārā tābhyāmanugatā satī / prabhūtasenāyuktābhyāṃ nirjagāma kumārikā

verses.transliteration: vavarṣa śarajālāni daityendreṣu kumārikā / bhaṇḍāsurakumāraistairmahārājñīkumārikā / yadyuddhamatanottattu spṛhaṇīyaṃ surāsuraiḥ

verses.transliteration: kṣaṇekṣaṇe bālikayā kriyamāṇaṃ mahāraṇam / vyajijñapanmahārājñyai bhramantyaḥ paricārikāḥ

verses.transliteration: āścaryaṃ bruvato vyomni paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām / sādhuvādairbahuvidhairmatriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ

verses.transliteration: arcyamānā raṇaṃ cakre laghuhastā kumārikā / dvitīyaṃ yuddhadivasaṃ samastamapi sā raṇe
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशयामास बलं ललितादुहिता निजम् । अस्त्रप्रत्यस्त्रमोक्षेण तान्सर्वानपि भिन्दती
verses.transliteration: prakāśayāmāsa balaṃ lalitāduhitā nijam / astrapratyastramokṣeṇa tānsarvānapi bhindatī
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणास्त्रमोक्षेण महराज्ञीकुमारिका । द्विशत्यक्षौहिणीसैन्यं भस्मसादकरोत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇāstramokṣeṇa maharājñīkumārikā / dviśatyakṣauhiṇīsainyaṃ bhasmasādakarotkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिणीनां क्षयतः क्षणात्कोपमुपागताः । आकृष्टगुरुधन्वानस्ते ऽपतन्नेकहेलया
verses.transliteration: akṣauhiṇīnāṃ kṣayataḥ kṣaṇātkopamupāgatāḥ / ākṛṣṭagurudhanvānaste 'patannekahelayā
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कलकले जाते शक्तीनां च दिवौकसाम् । युगपत्त्रिंशतो बाणानसृजत्सा कुमारिका
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kalakale jāte śaktīnāṃ ca divaukasām / yugapattriṃśato bāṇānasṛjatsā kumārikā
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तलाघवमाश्रित्य मुक्तैश्चन्द्रार्धसायकैः । त्रिंशता त्रिंशतो भण्डपुत्राणा साहतं शिरः
verses.transliteration: hastalāghavamāśritya muktaiścandrārdhasāyakaiḥ / triṃśatā triṃśato bhaṇḍaputrāṇā sāhataṃ śiraḥ
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: इति भण्डस्य पुत्रेषु प्राप्तेषु यमसादनम् । अत्यन्तविस्मयाविष्टा वबृषुः पुष्पमभ्रगाः
verses.transliteration: iti bhaṇḍasya putreṣu prāpteṣu yamasādanam / atyantavismayāviṣṭā vabṛṣuḥ puṣpamabhragāḥ
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: सा च पुत्री महाराज्ञ्याः विध्वस्तासुरमैनिका । मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथाभ्यामालिङ्ग्यत भृशं मुदा
verses.transliteration: sā ca putrī mahārājñyāḥ vidhvastāsuramainikā / mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthābhyāmāliṅgyata bhṛśaṃ mudā
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पराक्रमोन्मेषैर्नृत्यन्त्योजयदायिभिः । शक्तयस्तुमुलं चक्रुः साधुवादैर्जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ parākramonmeṣairnṛtyantyojayadāyibhiḥ / śaktayastumulaṃ cakruḥ sādhuvādairjagattrayam
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाश्च शक्तिसेनान्यो दण्डनाथापुरःसराः । तदाश्चर्यं महाराज्ञ्यै निवेदयितुमुद्गताः
verses.transliteration: sarvāśca śaktisenānyo daṇḍanāthāpuraḥsarāḥ / tadāścaryaṃ mahārājñyai nivedayitumudgatāḥ
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: ताभिर्निवेद्यमानानि सा देवी ललितांबिका । पुत्रीभुजावदानानि श्रुत्वा प्रीतिं समाययौ
verses.transliteration: tābhirnivedyamānāni sā devī lalitāṃbikā / putrībhujāvadānāni śrutvā prītiṃ samāyayau
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: समस्तमपि तच्चक्रं शक्तीनां तत्पराक्रमैः । अदृष्टपूर्वैर्देवेषु विस्मयस्य वशं गतम्
verses.transliteration: samastamapi taccakraṃ śaktīnāṃ tatparākramaiḥ / adṛṣṭapūrvairdeveṣu vismayasya vaśaṃ gatam
verses.translation: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince too in the company ofVisanga, the younger brother, made obeisance to Bhandasura and went to the counsel chamber in anger.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने भण्डपुत्रवधो नाम षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः अथ नष्टेषु पुत्रेषु शोकानलपरिप्लुतः । विललाप स दैत्येन्द्रो मत्वा जातं कुलक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne bhaṇḍaputravadho nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ atha naṣṭeṣu putreṣu śokānalapariplutaḥ / vilalāpa sa daityendro matvā jātaṃ kulakṣayam
verses.translation: When the sons were killed, that leader ofthe Daityas thought that the ruin ofthe whole family had set in. He was over-whelmed with the fire ofgrief and lamented.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sons were killed, that leader ofthe Daityas thought that the ruin ofthe whole family had set in. He was over-whelmed with the fire ofgrief and lamented.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sons were killed, that leader ofthe Daityas thought that the ruin ofthe whole family had set in. He was over-whelmed with the fire ofgrief and lamented.

verses.sanskrit: हा पुत्रा हा गुणोदारा हा मदेकपरायणाः । हा मन्नेत्रसुधापूरा हा मत्कुलविवर्धनाः
verses.transliteration: hā putrā hā guṇodārā hā madekaparāyaṇāḥ / hā mannetrasudhāpūrā hā matkulavivardhanāḥ
verses.translation: "Alas my sons, of liberal qualities. O my sons devot- ed solely lo me. O my sons instilling nectar into my eyes. Alas! my sons, the cause of my flourishing family.
verses.wordMeaning: "Alas my sons, of liberal qualities. O my sons devot- ed solely lo me. O my sons instilling nectar into my eyes. Alas! my sons, the cause of my flourishing family.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Alas my sons, of liberal qualities. O my sons devot- ed solely lo me. O my sons instilling nectar into my eyes. Alas! my sons, the cause of my flourishing family.

verses.sanskrit: हा समस्तसुरश्रेष्ठमदभञ्जनतत्पराः । हा समस्तसुरस्त्रीणामन्तर्मोहनमन्मथाः
verses.transliteration: hā samastasuraśreṣṭhamadabhañjanatatparāḥ / hā samastasurastrīṇāmantarmohanamanmathāḥ
verses.translation: You were eager to break the pride of all excellent Suras, O my sons! You were like the god of love enchanting the minds of all damsels of Suras.
verses.wordMeaning: You were eager to break the pride of all excellent Suras, O my sons! You were like the god of love enchanting the minds of all damsels of Suras.
verses.commentary: Sense: You were eager to break the pride of all excellent Suras, O my sons! You were like the god of love enchanting the minds of all damsels of Suras.

verses.sanskrit: दिशत प्रीतिवाचं मे ममाङ्के वल्गताधुना । किमिदानीमिमं तातमवमुच्य सुखं गताः
verses.transliteration: diśata prītivācaṃ me mamāṅke valgatādhunā / kimidānīmimaṃ tātamavamucya sukhaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: Do reply unto me! Do bounce into and dance in my lap. Why have you forsaken this your father now? Why have you gone in search of happiness (elsewhere)?
verses.wordMeaning: Do reply unto me! Do bounce into and dance in my lap. Why have you forsaken this your father now? Why have you gone in search of happiness (elsewhere)?
verses.commentary: Sense: Do reply unto me! Do bounce into and dance in my lap. Why have you forsaken this your father now? Why have you gone in search of happiness (elsewhere)?

verses.sanskrit: युष्मान्विना न शोभन्ते मम राज्यानि पुत्रकाः । रिक्तानि मम गेहानि रिक्ता राजसभापि मे
verses.transliteration: yuṣmānvinā na śobhante mama rājyāni putrakāḥ / riktāni mama gehāni riktā rājasabhāpi me
verses.translation: O my sons, without you, my kingdoms do not appear splendid. My abodes are empty and void! My royal council- chamber is void without you;
verses.wordMeaning: O my sons, without you, my kingdoms do not appear splendid. My abodes are empty and void! My royal council- chamber is void without you;
verses.commentary: Sense: O my sons, without you, my kingdoms do not appear splendid. My abodes are empty and void! My royal council- chamber is void without you;

verses.sanskrit: कथमेवं विनिःशेषं हतायूयं दुराशयाः । अप्रधृष्यभुजासत्त्वान्भवतो मत्कुलाङ्कुरान् । कथमेकपदे दुष्टा वनिता संगरे ऽवधीत्
verses.transliteration: kathamevaṃ viniḥśeṣaṃ hatāyūyaṃ durāśayāḥ / apradhṛṣyabhujāsattvānbhavato matkulāṅkurān / kathamekapade duṣṭā vanitā saṃgare 'vadhīt
verses.translation: O dejected ones (?), how were you all wholly killed? How did that wicked woman abruptly kill in the battle all of you, the prowess ofwhose mighty arms could not be challenged and who are, as it were, the sprouts of my family?
verses.wordMeaning: O dejected ones (?), how were you all wholly killed? How did that wicked woman abruptly kill in the battle all of you, the prowess ofwhose mighty arms could not be challenged and who are, as it were, the sprouts of my family?
verses.commentary: Sense: O dejected ones (?), how were you all wholly killed? How did that wicked woman abruptly kill in the battle all of you, the prowess ofwhose mighty arms could not be challenged and who are, as it were, the sprouts of my family?

verses.sanskrit: मम नष्टानि सौख्यानि मम नष्टाः कुलस्त्रियः । इतः परं कुले क्षीणे साहसानि सुखानि च
verses.transliteration: mama naṣṭāni saukhyāni mama naṣṭāḥ kulastriyaḥ / itaḥ paraṃ kule kṣīṇe sāhasāni sukhāni ca
verses.translation: ViSukra, Visartga and Kutilaksa consoled Bhanda, in the assembly chamber (by emphasizing) on the crooked workings of fate.
verses.wordMeaning: ViSukra, Visartga and Kutilaksa consoled Bhanda, in the assembly chamber (by emphasizing) on the crooked workings of fate.
verses.commentary: Sense: ViSukra, Visartga and Kutilaksa consoled Bhanda, in the assembly chamber (by emphasizing) on the crooked workings of fate.

verses.sanskrit: भवतः सुकृतैर्लब्ध्वा मम पूर्वजनुःकृतैः । नाशो ऽयं भवतामद्य जातो नष्टस्ततो ऽस्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: bhavataḥ sukṛtairlabdhvā mama pūrvajanuḥkṛtaiḥ / nāśo 'yaṃ bhavatāmadya jāto naṣṭastato 'smyaham
verses.translation: He suddenly drew his Yama-likc fierce sword from its scabbard. Keeping his pair of eyes distended, he shone brilliantly with his splendour.
verses.wordMeaning: He suddenly drew his Yama-likc fierce sword from its scabbard. Keeping his pair of eyes distended, he shone brilliantly with his splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: He suddenly drew his Yama-likc fierce sword from its scabbard. Keeping his pair of eyes distended, he shone brilliantly with his splendour.

verses.sanskrit: हा हतो ऽस्मि विपन्नो ऽस्मि मन्दभाग्यो ऽस्मि पुत्रकाः । इति शोकात्स पर्यस्यन्प्रलपन्मुक्तमूर्धजः । मूर्च्छया लुप्तहृदयो निष्पपात नुपासनात्
verses.transliteration: hā hato 'smi vipanno 'smi mandabhāgyo 'smi putrakāḥ / iti śokātsa paryasyanpralapanmuktamūrdhajaḥ / mūrcchayā luptahṛdayo niṣpapāta nupāsanāt
verses.translation: All the leading Danavas became bewildered. They restrained him and uttered these scathing words against Lalita. due to great anger.
verses.wordMeaning: All the leading Danavas became bewildered. They restrained him and uttered these scathing words against Lalita. due to great anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the leading Danavas became bewildered. They restrained him and uttered these scathing words against Lalita. due to great anger.

verses.sanskrit: विशुक्रश्च विषङ्गश्च कुटिलाक्षश्च संसदि । भण्डमाश्वासयामासुर्दैवस्य कुटिलक्रमैः
verses.transliteration: viśukraśca viṣaṅgaśca kuṭilākṣaśca saṃsadi / bhaṇḍamāśvāsayāmāsurdaivasya kuṭilakramaiḥ
verses.translation: "For that purpose, O lord, this flurried agitation need not be evinced by you. We shall carry on war enthu- siastically along with our army.
verses.wordMeaning: "For that purpose, O lord, this flurried agitation need not be evinced by you. We shall carry on war enthu- siastically along with our army.
verses.commentary: Sense: "For that purpose, O lord, this flurried agitation need not be evinced by you. We shall carry on war enthu- siastically along with our army.

verses.sanskrit: विशुक्र उवाच देवकि प्राकृत इव प्राप्तः शोकस्य वश्यताम् । लपसि त्वे प्रति सुतान्प्राप्तमृत्यून्महाहवे
verses.transliteration: viśukra uvāca devaki prākṛta iva prāptaḥ śokasya vaśyatām / lapasi tve prati sutānprāptamṛtyūnmahāhave
verses.translation: At your slightest behest we are capable of subjugat- ing and suppressing the entire universe violently. What then, with regard to that stupid woman?
verses.wordMeaning: At your slightest behest we are capable of subjugat- ing and suppressing the entire universe violently. What then, with regard to that stupid woman?
verses.commentary: Sense: At your slightest behest we are capable of subjugat- ing and suppressing the entire universe violently. What then, with regard to that stupid woman?

verses.sanskrit: धर्मवान्विहितः पन्था वीराणामेष शाश्वतः । अशोच्यमाहवे मृत्युं प्राप्नुवन्ति यदर्हितम्
verses.transliteration: dharmavānvihitaḥ panthā vīrāṇāmeṣa śāśvataḥ / aśocyamāhave mṛtyuṃ prāpnuvanti yadarhitam
verses.translation: Shall we massacre all Suras? Shall we split their
verses.wordMeaning: Shall we massacre all Suras? Shall we split their
verses.commentary: Sense: Shall we massacre all Suras? Shall we split their

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव विनाशाय शल्यवद्बाधते मनः । यत्स्त्री समागत्य हठान्नि हन्ति सुभटान्रणे
verses.transliteration: etadeva vināśāya śalyavadbādhate manaḥ / yatstrī samāgatya haṭhānni hanti subhaṭānraṇe
verses.translation: After hearing this utterance full of haughtiness and pride, the furious Daitya spoke these words with his eyes turned- red due to wrath.
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing this utterance full of haughtiness and pride, the furious Daitya spoke these words with his eyes turned- red due to wrath.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing this utterance full of haughtiness and pride, the furious Daitya spoke these words with his eyes turned- red due to wrath.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते तेन दैत्येन पुत्रशोको व्यमुच्यत । भण्डेन चण्डकालाग्निसदृशः क्रोध आदधे
verses.transliteration: ityukte tena daityena putraśoko vyamucyata / bhaṇḍena caṇḍakālāgnisadṛśaḥ krodha ādadhe
verses.translation: "O ViSukra, you go to the camp ofthe enemy with your body concealed by means of Maya and operate the great Tantra (mystical diagram) J ayavighna '*
verses.wordMeaning: "O ViSukra, you go to the camp ofthe enemy with your body concealed by means of Maya and operate the great Tantra (mystical diagram) J ayavighna '*
verses.commentary: Sense: "O ViSukra, you go to the camp ofthe enemy with your body concealed by means of Maya and operate the great Tantra (mystical diagram) J ayavighna '*

verses.sanskrit: स कोशात्क्षिप्रमुद्धृत्य खड्गमुग्रं यमोपमम् । विस्फारिताक्षियुगलो भृशं जज्वाल तेजसा
verses.transliteration: sa kośātkṣipramuddhṛtya khaḍgamugraṃ yamopamam / visphāritākṣiyugalo bhṛśaṃ jajvāla tejasā
verses.translation: On hearing his words Visukra went towards the army of Lalita in great fury, with his body concealed by means of Maya.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words Visukra went towards the army of Lalita in great fury, with his body concealed by means of Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words Visukra went towards the army of Lalita in great fury, with his body concealed by means of Maya.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीमेव तां दुष्टां खड्गेनानेन खण्डशः । शकलीकृत्य समरे श्रमं प्राप्स्यामि बन्धुभिः
verses.transliteration: idānīmeva tāṃ duṣṭāṃ khaḍgenānena khaṇḍaśaḥ / śakalīkṛtya samare śramaṃ prāpsyāmi bandhubhiḥ
verses.translation: The eigh! deities presiding over the Yantra which brings or creates difficulties in getting success (Jaya-vighna) are the personifications of tenden- cies which create disaffection among people and demoralise the army (videVV. 36-39). The adverse effects of the Yantra are described in VV. 43-52. The Yantra may be symbolic of the fifth-columnists or the enemy- agents of the ancient period. The belief in such destructive black magic •dates from the days of Atharvaveda.
verses.wordMeaning: The eigh! deities presiding over the Yantra which brings or creates difficulties in getting success (Jaya-vighna) are the personifications of tenden- cies which create disaffection among people and demoralise the army (videVV. 36-39).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eigh! deities presiding over the Yantra which brings or creates difficulties in getting success (Jaya-vighna) are the personifications of tenden- cies which create disaffection among people and demoralise the army (videVV. 36-39).…

verses.sanskrit: इति रोषस्खलद्वर्णः श्वसन्निव भुजङ्गमः । खड्गं विधुन्वन्नुत्थाय प्रचचाला तिमत्तवत्
verses.transliteration: iti roṣaskhaladvarṇaḥ śvasanniva bhujaṅgamaḥ / khaḍgaṃ vidhunvannutthāya pracacālā timattavat
verses.translation: As the sun dropped into the western ocean with great rapidity, water rose up in a great splash due to the contact with his body. The drops ofwaterso raised shone as stars in the sky.
verses.wordMeaning: As the sun dropped into the western ocean with great rapidity, water rose up in a great splash due to the contact with his body. The drops ofwaterso raised shone as stars in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the sun dropped into the western ocean with great rapidity, water rose up in a great splash due to the contact with his body. The drops ofwaterso raised shone as stars in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: तं निरुध्य च संभ्रान्ताः सर्वे दानवपुङ्गवाः । वाचमूचुरतिक्रोधाज्ज्वलन्तो ललितां प्रति
verses.transliteration: taṃ nirudhya ca saṃbhrāntāḥ sarve dānavapuṅgavāḥ / vācamūcuratikrodhājjvalanto lalitāṃ prati
verses.translation: Then a dense darkness as black as collyrium set in. It appeared to make his Savarna (a man of the same caste, having the same colour) the evil-minded sword meaningful (i.e. purposeful).
verses.wordMeaning: Then a dense darkness as black as collyrium set in. It appeared to make his Savarna (a man of the same caste, having the same colour) the evil-minded sword meaningful (i.e. purposeful).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a dense darkness as black as collyrium set in. It appeared to make his Savarna (a man of the same caste, having the same colour) the evil-minded sword meaningful (i.e. purposeful).

verses.sanskrit: न तदर्थे त्वया कार्यः स्वामिन्संभ्रम ईदृशः । अस्माभिः स्वबलैर्युक्तै रणोत्साहो विधीयते
verses.transliteration: na tadarthe tvayā kāryaḥ svāminsaṃbhrama īdṛśaḥ / asmābhiḥ svabalairyuktai raṇotsāho vidhīyate
verses.translation: Seated in his magical chariot and concealed and enveloped in thick gloom, the rogue reached the camp of Lalita in an invisible form.
verses.wordMeaning: Seated in his magical chariot and concealed and enveloped in thick gloom, the rogue reached the camp of Lalita in an invisible form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated in his magical chariot and concealed and enveloped in thick gloom, the rogue reached the camp of Lalita in an invisible form.

verses.sanskrit: भवदाज्ञालवं प्राप्य समस्तभुवनं हठात् । विमर्द्दयितुमीशाः स्मः किमु तां मुग्धभामिनीम्
verses.transliteration: bhavadājñālavaṃ prāpya samastabhuvanaṃ haṭhāt / vimarddayitumīśāḥ smaḥ kimu tāṃ mugdhabhāminīm
verses.translation: After going there, the evil-minded Daitya saw the circular fiery enclosure extending to a hundred Yojanas and blazing brilliantly.
verses.wordMeaning: After going there, the evil-minded Daitya saw the circular fiery enclosure extending to a hundred Yojanas and blazing brilliantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going there, the evil-minded Daitya saw the circular fiery enclosure extending to a hundred Yojanas and blazing brilliantly.

verses.sanskrit: किं चूषयामः सप्ताब्धीन्क्षोदयामो ऽथ वा गिरीन् । अधरोत्तरमेवैतत्त्रैलोक्यं करवाम वा
verses.transliteration: kiṃ cūṣayāmaḥ saptābdhīnkṣodayāmo 'tha vā girīn / adharottaramevaitattrailokyaṃ karavāma vā
verses.translation: He went round the enclosure and obtaining an opportunity came near the southern door. The haughty fellow thought for a moment.
verses.wordMeaning: He went round the enclosure and obtaining an opportunity came near the southern door. The haughty fellow thought for a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went round the enclosure and obtaining an opportunity came near the southern door. The haughty fellow thought for a moment.

verses.sanskrit: छिनदाम सुरान्सर्वान्भिनदाम तदालयान् । पिन्षाम हरित्पालानाज्ञां देहि महामते
verses.transliteration: chinadāma surānsarvānbhinadāma tadālayān / pinṣāma haritpālānājñāṃ dehi mahāmate
verses.translation: There, at the entrance, he saw guards who had great inherent strength, who were cautious and alert, who held weapons in their hands, who were seated in their respective vehicles and who had put on coats of mail.
verses.wordMeaning: There, at the entrance, he saw guards who had great inherent strength, who were cautious and alert, who held weapons in their hands, who were seated in their respective vehicles and who had put on coats of mail.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, at the entrance, he saw guards who had great inherent strength, who were cautious and alert, who held weapons in their hands, who were seated in their respective vehicles and who had put on coats of mail.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युदीरित माकर्ण्य महाहङ्कारगर्वितम् । उवाच वचनं क्रुद्धः प्रतिघारुणलोचनः
verses.transliteration: ityudīrita mākarṇya mahāhaṅkāragarvitam / uvāca vacanaṃ kruddhaḥ pratighāruṇalocanaḥ
verses.translation: He performed the worship of Yantra and offered goats etc. as oblation. In the course of battle, (?) that Asura hurled the Tantra into the enemy camp.
verses.wordMeaning: He performed the worship of Yantra and offered goats etc. as oblation. In the course of battle, (?) that Asura hurled the Tantra into the enemy camp.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the worship of Yantra and offered goats etc. as oblation. In the course of battle, (?) that Asura hurled the Tantra into the enemy camp.

verses.sanskrit: विशुक्र भवता गत्वा मायान्तार्हितवर्ष्मणा । जयविघ्नं महायन्त्रं कर्त्तव्यं कटके द्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: viśukra bhavatā gatvā māyāntārhitavarṣmaṇā / jayavighnaṃ mahāyantraṃ karttavyaṃ kaṭake dviṣām
verses.translation: In the course of the battle (that Yantra) hurled by that wicked-souled Daitya who was standing outside the rampart-wall crossed the rampart and fell into the camp.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of the battle (that Yantra) hurled by that wicked-souled Daitya who was standing outside the rampart-wall crossed the rampart and fell into the camp.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of the battle (that Yantra) hurled by that wicked-souled Daitya who was standing outside the rampart-wall crossed the rampart and fell into the camp.

verses.sanskrit: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विशुक्रो रोषरूषितः । मायातिरोहितवपुर्जगाम ललिताबलम्
verses.transliteration: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā viśukro roṣarūṣitaḥ / māyātirohitavapurjagāma lalitābalam
verses.translation: As an adverse effect of that Yantra, the Saktis stationed within the camp became dejected in their minds. They set aside weapons and adopted the attitude of renouncing everything.
verses.wordMeaning: As an adverse effect of that Yantra, the Saktis stationed within the camp became dejected in their minds. They set aside weapons and adopted the attitude of renouncing everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: As an adverse effect of that Yantra, the Saktis stationed within the camp became dejected in their minds. They set aside weapons and adopted the attitude of renouncing everything.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रयातुमुद्युक्ते सुर्यो ऽस्तं समुपागतः । पर्यस्तकिरणस्तोमपाटलीकृतदिङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: tasminprayātumudyukte suryo 'staṃ samupāgataḥ / paryastakiraṇastomapāṭalīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Then the sounds ofhis war drum were heard. Still those Saktis were devoid of any activity in the camp.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the sounds ofhis war drum were heard. Still those Saktis were devoid of any activity in the camp.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sounds ofhis war drum were heard. Still those Saktis were devoid of any activity in the camp.

verses.sanskrit: अनुरागवती संध्या प्रयान्तं भानुमालिनम् । अनुवव्राज पातालकुञ्जे रन्तुमिवोत्सुका
verses.transliteration: anurāgavatī saṃdhyā prayāntaṃ bhānumālinam / anuvavrāja pātālakuñje rantumivotsukā
verses.translation: In view oftheir exalted glorious state MantrinI and Dandanatha were not adversely affected by the Vighnayantra. They became worried about the effect on the Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: In view oftheir exalted glorious state MantrinI and Dandanatha were not adversely affected by the Vighnayantra. They became worried about the effect on the Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: In view oftheir exalted glorious state MantrinI and Dandanatha were not adversely affected by the Vighnayantra. They became worried about the effect on the Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: वेगात्प्रपततो भानोर्देहसंगात्समुत्थिताः । चरमाब्धेरिव पयःकणास्तारा विरेजिरे
verses.transliteration: vegātprapatato bhānordehasaṃgātsamutthitāḥ / caramābdheriva payaḥkaṇāstārā virejire
verses.translation: Thus MantrinI and Dandanatha in their great anxiety climbed up the Cakrasyandana chariot and spoke to the great queen.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus MantrinI and Dandanatha in their great anxiety climbed up the Cakrasyandana chariot and spoke to the great queen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus MantrinI and Dandanatha in their great anxiety climbed up the Cakrasyandana chariot and spoke to the great queen.

verses.sanskrit: अथाससाद बहुलं तमः कज्जलमेचकम् । सार्थं कर्त्तुमिवोद्युक्तं सवर्णस्यासिदुर्धिया
verses.transliteration: athāsasāda bahulaṃ tamaḥ kajjalamecakam / sārthaṃ karttumivodyuktaṃ savarṇasyāsidurdhiyā
verses.translation: "O goddess, what is this aberration due to? The Saktis have ceased to be active. O great queen, they do not pay heed to your commands which the entire universe abides by.
verses.wordMeaning: "O goddess, what is this aberration due to? The Saktis have ceased to be active. O great queen, they do not pay heed to your commands which the entire universe abides by.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O goddess, what is this aberration due to? The Saktis have ceased to be active. O great queen, they do not pay heed to your commands which the entire universe abides by.

verses.sanskrit: मायारथं समारूढो गूढशर्वरसंवृतः । अदृश्यवपुरापेदे ललिताकटकं खलः
verses.transliteration: māyārathaṃ samārūḍho gūḍhaśarvarasaṃvṛtaḥ / adṛśyavapurāpede lalitākaṭakaṃ khalaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, goddess Lalita glanced at the face of Kamesvara, she then laughed displaying a row' ofextremely red teeth.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, goddess Lalita glanced at the face of Kamesvara, she then laughed displaying a row' ofextremely red teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, goddess Lalita glanced at the face of Kamesvara, she then laughed displaying a row' ofextremely red teeth.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा ज्वलज्ज्वालं वह्निप्राकारमण्डलम् । शतयोजनविस्तारामालोकयत् दुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā jvalajjvālaṃ vahniprākāramaṇḍalam / śatayojanavistārāmālokayat durmatiḥ
verses.translation: In the mass of lustre of her smile, a certain god became visible. His face had the features of an elephant. Ichor w'as oozing from the middle ofhis temple. 1
verses.wordMeaning: In the mass of lustre of her smile, a certain god became visible. His face had the features of an elephant. Ichor w'as oozing from the middle ofhis temple. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: In the mass of lustre of her smile, a certain god became visible. His face had the features of an elephant. Ichor w'as oozing from the middle ofhis temple. 1

verses.sanskrit: परितो विभ्रमञ्शालमवकाशमवाप्नुवन् । दक्षिणं द्वारमासाद्य निदध्यौ क्षणमुद्धतः
verses.transliteration: parito vibhramañśālamavakāśamavāpnuvan / dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramāsādya nidadhyau kṣaṇamuddhataḥ
verses.translation: After being blessed by her, the great elephant-faced lord of the Ganas quickly set offfrom there to shatter the great Yantra called Jayavighna.
verses.wordMeaning: After being blessed by her, the great elephant-faced lord of the Ganas quickly set offfrom there to shatter the great Yantra called Jayavighna.
verses.commentary: Sense: After being blessed by her, the great elephant-faced lord of the Ganas quickly set offfrom there to shatter the great Yantra called Jayavighna.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापश्यन्महासत्त्वास्सावधाना धृतायुधाः । आरूढयानाः सनद्धवर्माणो द्वारदेशतः
verses.transliteration: tatrāpaśyanmahāsattvāssāvadhānā dhṛtāyudhāḥ / ārūḍhayānāḥ sanaddhavarmāṇo dvāradeśataḥ
verses.translation: The elephant-faced lord moving about within enclosure saw Jayavighna the amulet secretly fixed some- where.
verses.wordMeaning: The elephant-faced lord moving about within enclosure saw Jayavighna the amulet secretly fixed some- where.
verses.commentary: Sense: The elephant-faced lord moving about within enclosure saw Jayavighna the amulet secretly fixed some- where.

verses.sanskrit: स्तंभिनीप्रमुखाः शक्तीर्विशत्यक्षौहिणीयुताः । सर्वदा द्वाररक्षार्थं निर्दिष्टा दण्डनाथया
verses.transliteration: staṃbhinīpramukhāḥ śaktīrviśatyakṣauhiṇīyutāḥ / sarvadā dvārarakṣārthaṃ nirdiṣṭā daṇḍanāthayā
verses.translation: By hitting with his tusks that produced dreadful noise very difficult to bear, that lord reduced the huge slab of Jayavighna to pow'der instantaneously.
verses.wordMeaning: By hitting with his tusks that produced dreadful noise very difficult to bear, that lord reduced the huge slab of Jayavighna to pow'der instantaneously.
verses.commentary: Sense: By hitting with his tusks that produced dreadful noise very difficult to bear, that lord reduced the huge slab of Jayavighna to pow'der instantaneously.

verses.sanskrit: विलोक्य विस्मयाविष्टो विचार्य च चिरं तदा । शालस्य बहिरेवासौ स्थित्वा यन्त्रं समातनोत्
verses.transliteration: vilokya vismayāviṣṭo vicārya ca ciraṃ tadā / śālasya bahirevāsau sthitvā yantraṃ samātanot
verses.translation: Along with the wicked deities posted there, he reduced that Yantra to powder and cast it off in air.
verses.wordMeaning: Along with the wicked deities posted there, he reduced that Yantra to powder and cast it off in air.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with the wicked deities posted there, he reduced that Yantra to powder and cast it off in air.

verses.sanskrit: गव्यूतिमात्रकायामे तत्समानप्रविस्तरे । शिलापट्टे सुमहति प्रालिखद्यन्त्रमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: gavyūtimātrakāyāme tatsamānapravistare / śilāpaṭṭe sumahati prālikhadyantramuttamam
verses.translation: Thereupon, Saktis got rid of their lethargy. Making a tumultuous uproar, they prepared themselves for carrying on fight with weapons in their arms.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Saktis got rid of their lethargy. Making a tumultuous uproar, they prepared themselves for carrying on fight with weapons in their arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, Saktis got rid of their lethargy. Making a tumultuous uproar, they prepared themselves for carrying on fight with weapons in their arms.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टदिक्ष्वष्टशूलेन संहाराक्षरमौलिना । अष्टभिर्दैवतैश्चैव युक्तं यन्त्रं समालिखत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭaśūlena saṃhārākṣaramaulinā / aṣṭabhirdaivataiścaiva yuktaṃ yantraṃ samālikhat
verses.translation: The birth of Ganesa from the laugh of Lalita (as against from Parvatl) is an attempt to enhance the greatness of Lalita. The six forms of Gananathas or V iglinanay akas (the 'masters' of vighnat impediments) given, in VV. 77-82 emphasize the auspicious powers of these deities.
verses.wordMeaning: The birth of Ganesa from the laugh of Lalita (as against from Parvatl) is an attempt to enhance the greatness of Lalita. The six forms of Gananathas or V iglinanay akas (the 'masters' of vighnat impediments) given, in VV. 77-82 emphasize the auspicious powers of these deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The birth of Ganesa from the laugh of Lalita (as against from Parvatl) is an attempt to enhance the greatness of Lalita. The six forms of Gananathas or V iglinanay akas (the 'masters' of vighnat impediments) given, in VV. 77-82 emphasize the auspicious powers of these deities.

verses.sanskrit: अलसा कृपणा दीना नितन्द्राच प्रमीलिका । क्लीबा च निरहङ्कारा चेत्यष्टौ देवताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: alasā kṛpaṇā dīnā nitandrāca pramīlikā / klībā ca nirahaṅkārā cetyaṣṭau devatāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Coming out of the enclosure of fiery rampart-wall those elephant-faced heroes moved ahead for assisting Mahaganapati in the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Coming out of the enclosure of fiery rampart-wall those elephant-faced heroes moved ahead for assisting Mahaganapati in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Coming out of the enclosure of fiery rampart-wall those elephant-faced heroes moved ahead for assisting Mahaganapati in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: देवताष्टकमेतश्च शूलाष्टकपुटोपरि । नियोज्य लिखितं यन्त्रं मायावी सममन्त्रयत्
verses.transliteration: devatāṣṭakametaśca śūlāṣṭakapuṭopari / niyojya likhitaṃ yantraṃ māyāvī samamantrayat
verses.translation: Knitting his brows, Visukra bit his own exces- sively red lips and then fought with him. The quarters and their inter-spaces became agitated by means of various sounds such as the sounds produced when weapons came into clash with one another, the humkdras of the Daityas, the sounds of hoofs of horses of Daityas, that resembled the sounds produced by a number of spades A operated together, the trumpeting sounds of leading elephants, the cries of agony due to fear, the neighing sound of a number of horses, the creaking sounds of the wheels of chariots, the twanging sounds of bows, the chattering sounds of troops, the loud sounds o
verses.wordMeaning: Knitting his brows, Visukra bit his own exces- sively red lips and then fought with him. The quarters and their inter-spaces became agitated by means of various sounds such as the sounds produced when weapons came into clash with one another, the humkdras of the Daityas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Knitting his brows, Visukra bit his own exces- sively red lips and then fought with him. The quarters and their inter-spaces became agitated by means of various sounds such as the sounds produced when weapons came into clash with one another, the humkdras of the Daityas,…

verses.sanskrit: पूजां विधाय मन्त्रस्य बलिभिश्छागलादिभिः । तद्यन्त्रं चारिकटके प्राक्षिपत्समरे ऽसुरः
verses.transliteration: pūjāṃ vidhāya mantrasya balibhiśchāgalādibhiḥ / tadyantraṃ cārikaṭake prākṣipatsamare 'suraḥ
verses.translation: Then (Visukra) became highly furious. Standing in front ofhis army, he sent a Gajasura (An Asura in the form of an elephant) against the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: Then (Visukra) became highly furious. Standing in front ofhis army, he sent a Gajasura (An Asura in the form of an elephant) against the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then (Visukra) became highly furious. Standing in front ofhis army, he sent a Gajasura (An Asura in the form of an elephant) against the lord.

verses.sanskrit: पाकारस्य बहिर्भागे वर्तिना तेन दुर्धिया । क्षिप्तमुल्लङ्घ्य च रणे पपात कटकान्तरे
verses.transliteration: pākārasya bahirbhāge vartinā tena durdhiyā / kṣiptamullaṅghya ca raṇe papāta kaṭakāntare
verses.translation: Ganesvara fought with the Gajadaitya (Demon in the form of an elephant) of wicked nature who roared like a ferocious lion and who was accompanied by seven Aksauhinis of soldiers.
verses.wordMeaning: Ganesvara fought with the Gajadaitya (Demon in the form of an elephant) of wicked nature who roared like a ferocious lion and who was accompanied by seven Aksauhinis of soldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ganesvara fought with the Gajadaitya (Demon in the form of an elephant) of wicked nature who roared like a ferocious lion and who was accompanied by seven Aksauhinis of soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: तद्यन्त्रस्य विकारेण कटकस्थास्तुशक्तयः । विमुक्तशस्त्रसंन्यासमास्थिता दीनमानसाः
verses.transliteration: tadyantrasya vikāreṇa kaṭakasthāstuśaktayaḥ / vimuktaśastrasaṃnyāsamāsthitā dīnamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Alone and single-handed that leader ofheroeswith a mouse for his vehicle moved about (in the battle-field) and smashed Gajasura along with his seven Aksauhinis of soldiers.
verses.wordMeaning: Alone and single-handed that leader ofheroeswith a mouse for his vehicle moved about (in the battle-field) and smashed Gajasura along with his seven Aksauhinis of soldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Alone and single-handed that leader ofheroeswith a mouse for his vehicle moved about (in the battle-field) and smashed Gajasura along with his seven Aksauhinis of soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: किं हतैरसुरैः कार्यं शस्त्राशस्त्रिक्रमैरलम् । जयसिद्धफलं किं वा प्राणिहिंसा च पापदा
verses.transliteration: kiṃ hatairasuraiḥ kāryaṃ śastrāśastrikramairalam / jayasiddhaphalaṃ kiṃ vā prāṇihiṃsā ca pāpadā
verses.translation: After Gajasura had been killed and Visukra had fled, Mahaganapati went to the presence of Lalita from the battle- field.
verses.wordMeaning: After Gajasura had been killed and Visukra had fled, Mahaganapati went to the presence of Lalita from the battle- field.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Gajasura had been killed and Visukra had fled, Mahaganapati went to the presence of Lalita from the battle- field.

verses.sanskrit: अमराणां कृते को ऽयं किमस्माकं भविष्यति । वृथा कलकलं कृत्वा न फलं युद्धकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: amarāṇāṃ kṛte ko 'yaṃ kimasmākaṃ bhaviṣyati / vṛthā kalakalaṃ kṛtvā na phalaṃ yuddhakarmaṇā
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: का स्वामिनी महाराज्ञी का वासौ दण्डनायिका । का वा सा मन्त्रिणी श्यामा भृत्यत्वं नो ऽथ कीदृशम्
verses.transliteration: kā svāminī mahārājñī kā vāsau daṇḍanāyikā / kā vā sā mantriṇī śyāmā bhṛtyatvaṃ no 'tha kīdṛśam
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: इह सर्वाभिरस्माभिर्भृत्यभूताभिरेकिका । वनिता स्वामिनीकृत्ये किं फलं मोक्ष्यते परम्
verses.transliteration: iha sarvābhirasmābhirbhṛtyabhūtābhirekikā / vanitā svāminīkṛtye kiṃ phalaṃ mokṣyate param
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: परेषां मर्मभिदुरैरायुधैर्न प्रयोजनम् । युद्धं शाम्यतु चास्माकं देहशस्त्रक्षतिप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: pareṣāṃ marmabhidurairāyudhairna prayojanam / yuddhaṃ śāmyatu cāsmākaṃ dehaśastrakṣatipradam
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धे च मरणं भावि वृथा स्युर्जीवितानि नः । युद्धे मृत्युर्भवेदेव इति तत्र प्रमैव का
verses.transliteration: yuddhe ca maraṇaṃ bhāvi vṛthā syurjīvitāni naḥ / yuddhe mṛtyurbhavedeva iti tatra pramaiva kā
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: उत्साहेन फलं नास्ति निद्रैवैका सुखावहा । आलस्यसदृशं नास्ति चित्तविश्रान्तिदायकम्
verses.transliteration: utsāhena phalaṃ nāsti nidraivaikā sukhāvahā / ālasyasadṛśaṃ nāsti cittaviśrāntidāyakam
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: एतादृशीश्च नो ज्ञात्वा सा राज्ञी किं करिष्यति । तस्या राज्ञीत्वमपि नः समवायेन कल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: etādṛśīśca no jñātvā sā rājñī kiṃ kariṣyati / tasyā rājñītvamapi naḥ samavāyena kalpitam
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: एवं चोपेक्षितास्माभिः सा विनष्टबला भवेत् । नष्ट सत्त्वा च सा राज्ञी कान्नः शिक्षां करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ copekṣitāsmābhiḥ sā vinaṣṭabalā bhavet / naṣṭa sattvā ca sā rājñī kānnaḥ śikṣāṃ kariṣyati
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव रणारंभं विमुच्य विधुतायुधाः । शक्तयो निद्रया द्वारे घूर्णमाना इवाभवन्
verses.transliteration: evameva raṇāraṃbhaṃ vimucya vidhutāyudhāḥ / śaktayo nidrayā dvāre ghūrṇamānā ivābhavan
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र मान्द्यं कार्येषु महदालस्यमागतम् । शिथिलं चाभवत्सर्वं शक्तीनां कटकं महत्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra māndyaṃ kāryeṣu mahadālasyamāgatam / śithilaṃ cābhavatsarvaṃ śaktīnāṃ kaṭakaṃ mahat
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: जयविघ्नं महायन्त्रमिति कृत्वा स दानवः
verses.transliteration: jayavighnaṃ mahāyantramiti kṛtvā sa dānavaḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: निर्विद्य तत्प्रभावेण कटकं प्रमिमन्थिषुः । द्वितीययुद्धदिवसस्यार्धरात्रे गते सति
verses.transliteration: nirvidya tatprabhāveṇa kaṭakaṃ pramimanthiṣuḥ / dvitīyayuddhadivasasyārdharātre gate sati
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: निस्मृत्य नगराद्भूयस्त्रिंशदक्षौहिणीवृतः । आजगाम पुनर्दैत्यो विशुक्रः कटकं द्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: nismṛtya nagarādbhūyastriṃśadakṣauhiṇīvṛtaḥ / ājagāma punardaityo viśukraḥ kaṭakaṃ dviṣām
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: अश्रूयन्त ततस्तस्य रणनिःसाणनिस्वनाः । तथापि ता निरुद्योगाः शक्तयः कटके ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: aśrūyanta tatastasya raṇaniḥsāṇanisvanāḥ / tathāpi tā nirudyogāḥ śaktayaḥ kaṭake 'bhavan
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: तदा महानुभावत्वाद्विकारैर्विघ्नयन्त्रजैः । अस्पृष्टे मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथे चिन्तामवा पतुः
verses.transliteration: tadā mahānubhāvatvādvikārairvighnayantrajaiḥ / aspṛṣṭe mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe cintāmavā patuḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: अहो बत महत्कष्टमिदमापतितं भयम् । कस्य वाथ विकारेण सैनिका निर्गतोद्यमाः
verses.transliteration: aho bata mahatkaṣṭamidamāpatitaṃ bhayam / kasya vātha vikāreṇa sainikā nirgatodyamāḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: निरस्तायुधसंरंभा निद्रातन्द्राविघूर्णिताः । न मानयन्ति वाक्यानि रार्चयन्ति महेश्वरीम् । औदासीन्यं वितन्वन्ति शक्तयो निस्पृहा इमाः
verses.transliteration: nirastāyudhasaṃraṃbhā nidrātandrāvighūrṇitāḥ / na mānayanti vākyāni rārcayanti maheśvarīm / audāsīnyaṃ vitanvanti śaktayo nispṛhā imāḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.transliteration: iti te mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe cintāparāyaṇe / cakrasyandanamārūḍhe mahārājñīṃ samūcatuḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.transliteration: mantriṇyuvāca devi sakya vikāro 'yaṃ śaktayo vigatodyamāḥ / na śṛṇvanti mahārājñi tavājñāṃ viśvapālitām
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यं च विरक्तास्ताः पराच्यः सर्वकर्मसु । निद्रातन्द्रामुकुलिता दुर्वाक्यानि वितन्वते
verses.transliteration: anyonyaṃ ca viraktāstāḥ parācyaḥ sarvakarmasu / nidrātandrāmukulitā durvākyāni vitanvate
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: का दण्डिनी मन्त्रिणी का महाराज्ञीति का पुनः । युद्धं च कीदृशमिति क्षेपं भूरि वितन्वते
verses.transliteration: kā daṇḍinī mantriṇī kā mahārājñīti kā punaḥ / yuddhaṃ ca kīdṛśamiti kṣepaṃ bhūri vitanvate
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नेवान्तरे शत्रुरागच्छति महाबलः । उद्दण्डभेरीनिस्वानैर्विभिन्दन्निव रोदसी
verses.transliteration: asminnevāntare śatrurāgacchati mahābalaḥ / uddaṇḍabherīnisvānairvibhindanniva rodasī
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र यत्प्राप्तरूपं तन्महाराज्ञि प्रपद्यताम् । इत्युक्त्वा सह दण्डिन्या मन्त्रिणी प्रणतिं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: atra yatprāptarūpaṃ tanmahārājñi prapadyatām / ityuktvā saha daṇḍinyā mantriṇī praṇatiṃ vyadhāt
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा ललिता देवी कामेश्वरमुखं प्रति । दत्तदृष्टडिः समहसदतिरक्तरदावलिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā lalitā devī kāmeśvaramukhaṃ prati / dattadṛṣṭaḍiḥ samahasadatiraktaradāvaliḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः स्मितप्रभापुञ्जे कुञ्जराकृतिमान्मुखे । कटक्रोडगलद्दानः कश्चिदेव व्यजृंभत
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ smitaprabhāpuñje kuñjarākṛtimānmukhe / kaṭakroḍagaladdānaḥ kaścideva vyajṛṃbhata
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: जपापटलपाटल्यो बालचन्द्रवपुर्धरः । बीजपूरगदामिक्षुचापं शूलं सुदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: japāpaṭalapāṭalyo bālacandravapurdharaḥ / bījapūragadāmikṣucāpaṃ śūlaṃ sudarśanam
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
