verses.transliteration: atha krodhasamāviṣṭo nijasainyapurogamaḥ / preṣayāmāsa devasya gajāsura masau punaḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: प्रचण्डसिंहनादेन गजदैत्येन दुर्धिया । सप्ताक्षौहिणियुक्तेन युयुधे स गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pracaṇḍasiṃhanādena gajadaityena durdhiyā / saptākṣauhiṇiyuktena yuyudhe sa gaṇeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: हीयमानं समालोक्य गजासुरभुजाबलम् । वर्धमानं च तद्वीर्यं विशुक्रः प्रपलायितः
verses.transliteration: hīyamānaṃ samālokya gajāsurabhujābalam / vardhamānaṃ ca tadvīryaṃ viśukraḥ prapalāyitaḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: स एक एव वीरेद्रः प्रचलन्नाखुवाहनः । सप्ताक्षौहिणिकायुक्तं गजासुरममर्दयत्
verses.transliteration: sa eka eva vīredraḥ pracalannākhuvāhanaḥ / saptākṣauhiṇikāyuktaṃ gajāsuramamardayat
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: गजासुरे च निहते विशुक्रे प्रपलायिते । ललितान्तिकमापेदे महागमपतिर्मृधात्
verses.transliteration: gajāsure ca nihate viśukre prapalāyite / lalitāntikamāpede mahāgamapatirmṛdhāt
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: कालरात्रिश्च दैत्यानां सा रात्रिर्विरतिं गता । ललिता चाति मुदिता बभूवास्य पराक्रमैः
verses.transliteration: kālarātriśca daityānāṃ sā rātrirviratiṃ gatā / lalitā cāti muditā babhūvāsya parākramaiḥ
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: विततार महाराज्ञीप्रीयमाणा गणेशितुः । सर्वदैवतपूजायाः पूर्वपूज्यत्वमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vitatāra mahārājñīprīyamāṇā gaṇeśituḥ / sarvadaivatapūjāyāḥ pūrvapūjyatvamuttamam
verses.translation: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly pleased the great queen granted the following boon to Ganesvara viz.: the right ofbeing worshipped before the worship of all other deities.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डपुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने गणनाथपराक्रमो नाम सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः रणेभग्नं महादैत्यं भण्डदैत्यः सहोदरम् । सेनानां कदनं श्रुत्वा सन्तप्तो बहुचिन्तया
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne gaṇanāthaparākramo nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ raṇebhagnaṃ mahādaityaṃ bhaṇḍadaityaḥ sahodaram / senānāṃ kadanaṃ śrutvā santapto bahucintayā
verses.translation: On hearing that his brother, the great Daitya, had been vanquished in the battle, and that his army was slaughter- ed, Bhanda, the Daitya, became extremely distressed with great anxiety.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that his brother, the great Daitya, had been vanquished in the battle, and that his army was slaughter- ed, Bhanda, the Daitya, became extremely distressed with great anxiety.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that his brother, the great Daitya, had been vanquished in the battle, and that his army was slaughter- ed, Bhanda, the Daitya, became extremely distressed with great anxiety.

verses.sanskrit: उभावपि समेतौ तौ युक्तौ सर्वैश्चसैनिकैः । प्रेषयामास युद्धाय भण्डदैत्यः सहोदरौ
verses.transliteration: ubhāvapi sametau tau yuktau sarvaiścasainikaiḥ / preṣayāmāsa yuddhāya bhaṇḍadaityaḥ sahodarau
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Daitya, sent both ofhis brothers together to the battle along with all the soldiers.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Daitya, sent both ofhis brothers together to the battle along with all the soldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Daitya, sent both ofhis brothers together to the battle along with all the soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: तावुभौ परमक्रुद्धौ भण्डदैत्येन देशितौ । विषङ्गश्च विशुक्रश्च महोद्यम मवापनुः
verses.transliteration: tāvubhau paramakruddhau bhaṇḍadaityena deśitau / viṣaṅgaśca viśukraśca mahodyama mavāpanuḥ
verses.translation: The two Daityas, Visanga and Visukra became excessively angry and directed by Bhanda, the Daitya, they strained themselves to the utmost.
verses.wordMeaning: The two Daityas, Visanga and Visukra became excessively angry and directed by Bhanda, the Daitya, they strained themselves to the utmost.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two Daityas, Visanga and Visukra became excessively angry and directed by Bhanda, the Daitya, they strained themselves to the utmost.

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठसहितं तत्र युवराजं महाबलम् । विशुक्रमनुवव्राज सेना त्रैलोक्यकम्पिनी
verses.transliteration: kaniṣṭhasahitaṃ tatra yuvarājaṃ mahābalam / viśukramanuvavrāja senā trailokyakampinī
verses.translation: The crown prince surrounded by four hundred Aksauhinls of soldiers increased in great vigour.
verses.wordMeaning: The crown prince surrounded by four hundred Aksauhinls of soldiers increased in great vigour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crown prince surrounded by four hundred Aksauhinls of soldiers increased in great vigour.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिणीचतुःशत्या सेनानामावृतश्च सः । युवराजः प्रववृधे प्रतापेन महीयसा
verses.transliteration: akṣauhiṇīcatuḥśatyā senānāmāvṛtaśca saḥ / yuvarājaḥ pravavṛdhe pratāpena mahīyasā
verses.translation: They had their several vehicles which they got in full of pride. They kept their weighty bows ready drawn and followed Visukra.
verses.wordMeaning: They had their several vehicles which they got in full of pride. They kept their weighty bows ready drawn and followed Visukra.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had their several vehicles which they got in full of pride. They kept their weighty bows ready drawn and followed Visukra.

verses.sanskrit: उलूकजित्प्रभृतयो भागिनेया दशोद्धताः । भण्डस्य च भगिन्यान्तु धूमिन्यां जातयोनयः
verses.transliteration: ulūkajitprabhṛtayo bhāgineyā daśoddhatāḥ / bhaṇḍasya ca bhaginyāntu dhūminyāṃ jātayonayaḥ
verses.translation: Visukra reached the battle-field riding on his •elephant. He was fully rendered splendid with the umbrella and
verses.wordMeaning: Visukra reached the battle-field riding on his •elephant. He was fully rendered splendid with the umbrella and
verses.commentary: Sense: Visukra reached the battle-field riding on his •elephant. He was fully rendered splendid with the umbrella and

verses.sanskrit: कृतास्त्रशिक्षा भण्डेन मातुलेन महीयसा । विक्रमेण वलन्तस्ते सेनानाथाः प्रतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: kṛtāstraśikṣā bhaṇḍena mātulena mahīyasā / vikrameṇa valantaste senānāthāḥ pratasthire
verses.translation: Thereupon, surrounded by the army making an uproarious tumultuous sounds, Visukra roared terrifically like a lion.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, surrounded by the army making an uproarious tumultuous sounds, Visukra roared terrifically like a lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, surrounded by the army making an uproarious tumultuous sounds, Visukra roared terrifically like a lion.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोद्गतैश्चापनिर्घोषैर्घोषयन्तो दिशो दश । द्वयोर्मातुलयोः प्रीतिं भागिनेया वितेनिरे
verses.transliteration: prodgataiścāpanirghoṣairghoṣayanto diśo daśa / dvayormātulayoḥ prītiṃ bhāgineyā vitenire
verses.translation: Saktis were excited within their hearts on
verses.wordMeaning: Saktis were excited within their hearts on
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktis were excited within their hearts on

verses.sanskrit: आरूढयानाः प्रत्येकगाढाहङ्कारशालिनः । आकृष्टगुरुधन्वानो विशुक्रमनुवव्रजुः
verses.transliteration: ārūḍhayānāḥ pratyekagāḍhāhaṅkāraśālinaḥ / ākṛṣṭagurudhanvāno viśukramanuvavrajuḥ
verses.translation: By their physical splendour, they appeared to make the sky full of lightning streaks. The circle of firmament was rendered enveloped with red lotuses, as they lifted up their faces eager to carry on battle.
verses.wordMeaning: By their physical splendour, they appeared to make the sky full of lightning streaks. The circle of firmament was rendered enveloped with red lotuses, as they lifted up their faces eager to carry on battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: By their physical splendour, they appeared to make the sky full of lightning streaks. The circle of firmament was rendered enveloped with red lotuses, as they lifted up their faces eager to carry on battle.

verses.sanskrit: यौवराज्यप्रभाचिह्नच्छत्रचामरशोभितः । आरूढवारणः प्राप विशुक्रो युद्धमेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration: yauvarājyaprabhācihnacchatracāmaraśobhitaḥ / ārūḍhavāraṇaḥ prāpa viśukro yuddhamedinīm
verses.translation: Eight thousand Aksauhinls of soldiers, haughty of their ability to wage war, led by her, resembled the limitless ocean at the close of a Kalpa.
verses.wordMeaning: Eight thousand Aksauhinls of soldiers, haughty of their ability to wage war, led by her, resembled the limitless ocean at the close of a Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight thousand Aksauhinls of soldiers, haughty of their ability to wage war, led by her, resembled the limitless ocean at the close of a Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कलकलारावकारिण्या सेनया वृतः । विशुक्रः पटु दध्वान सिंहनादं भयङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kalakalārāvakāriṇyā senayā vṛtaḥ / viśukraḥ paṭu dadhvāna siṃhanādaṃ bhayaṅkaram
verses.translation: Among the multitudes of troops of her Saktis, sonic had the refulgence ofgold, some resembled the pome- granate flowers and some had the lustre ofclouds.
verses.wordMeaning: Among the multitudes of troops of her Saktis, sonic had the refulgence ofgold, some resembled the pome- granate flowers and some had the lustre ofclouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the multitudes of troops of her Saktis, sonic had the refulgence ofgold, some resembled the pome- granate flowers and some had the lustre ofclouds.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षोभात्क्षुभितस्वान्ताः शक्तयः संभ्रमोद्धताः । अग्निप्राकारवलयान्निर्जगमुर्बद्धपङ्कयः
verses.transliteration: tatkṣobhātkṣubhitasvāntāḥ śaktayaḥ saṃbhramoddhatāḥ / agniprākāravalayānnirjagamurbaddhapaṅkayaḥ
verses.translation: Others were saffron-complexioned. A few were pink- coloured like the Patala (Trumpet) flowers; some had robes (shining) like the crystal mountain and some were pleasingly tender and beautiful though dark in colour.
verses.wordMeaning: Others were saffron-complexioned. A few were pink- coloured like the Patala (Trumpet) flowers; some had robes (shining) like the crystal mountain and some were pleasingly tender and beautiful though dark in colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others were saffron-complexioned. A few were pink- coloured like the Patala (Trumpet) flowers; some had robes (shining) like the crystal mountain and some were pleasingly tender and beautiful though dark in colour.

verses.sanskrit: तडिन्मयमिवाकाशं कुर्वन्त्यः स्वस्वरोचिषा । रक्ताम्वुजावृतमिव व्योमचक्रं रणोन्मुखाः
verses.transliteration: taḍinmayamivākāśaṃ kurvantyaḥ svasvarociṣā / raktāmvujāvṛtamiva vyomacakraṃ raṇonmukhāḥ
verses.translation: Others had the lustre ofdiamonds; some others were comparable to emeralds. Some displayed their bodily lustre wielding different kinds of weapons including the five arrows (of cupid) opposed to one another and mingled with hundred-edged thunderbolts.
verses.wordMeaning: Others had the lustre ofdiamonds; some others were comparable to emeralds. Some displayed their bodily lustre wielding different kinds of weapons including the five arrows (of cupid) opposed to one another and mingled with hundred-edged thunderbolts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others had the lustre ofdiamonds; some others were comparable to emeralds. Some displayed their bodily lustre wielding different kinds of weapons including the five arrows (of cupid) opposed to one another and mingled with hundred-edged thunderbolts.

verses.sanskrit: अथ भण्डकनीयांसावागतौ युद्धदुर्मदौ । निशम्य युगपद्योद्धं मन्त्रिणीदण्डनायके
verses.transliteration: atha bhaṇḍakanīyāṃsāvāgatau yuddhadurmadau / niśamya yugapadyoddhaṃ mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyake
verses.translation: When the armies of MantrinI and Dandanatha moved on thus, the earth reached a breaking point due to their burden and it heaved like a swing.
verses.wordMeaning: When the armies of MantrinI and Dandanatha moved on thus, the earth reached a breaking point due to their burden and it heaved like a swing.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the armies of MantrinI and Dandanatha moved on thus, the earth reached a breaking point due to their burden and it heaved like a swing.

verses.sanskrit: किरिचकं ज्ञेयचक्रमारूढे रथशेखरम् । धृतातपत्रवलये चामराभ्यां च वीजिते
verses.transliteration: kiricakaṃ jñeyacakramārūḍhe rathaśekharam / dhṛtātapatravalaye cāmarābhyāṃ ca vījite
verses.translation: Thereupon, a chaotic and uproarious battle ensued. It caused horripilation. The waters ofthc seven oceans turned into a slushy moss by the dust particles that rose up.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, a chaotic and uproarious battle ensued. It caused horripilation. The waters ofthc seven oceans turned into a slushy moss by the dust particles that rose up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, a chaotic and uproarious battle ensued. It caused horripilation. The waters ofthc seven oceans turned into a slushy moss by the dust particles that rose up.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोभिः प्रनृत्ताभिर्गीयमानमहोदये । निर्जगमतू रणं कर्तुमुभाभ्यां ललिताज्ञया
verses.transliteration: apsarobhiḥ pranṛttābhirgīyamānamahodaye / nirjagamatū raṇaṃ kartumubhābhyāṃ lalitājñayā
verses.translation: The cavalry fought with those on horse-back. Those riding in the chariots fought with those stationed in chariots. The elephant-riders fought with those who rode on elephants. The infantry fought with swords.
verses.wordMeaning: The cavalry fought with those on horse-back. Those riding in the chariots fought with those stationed in chariots. The elephant-riders fought with those who rode on elephants. The infantry fought with swords.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cavalry fought with those on horse-back. Those riding in the chariots fought with those stationed in chariots. The elephant-riders fought with those who rode on elephants. The infantry fought with swords.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीचक्ररथराजस्य रक्षणार्थं निवेशिते । शताक्षौहिणिकां सेनां वर्जयित्वास्त्रभीषणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīcakraratharājasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ niveśite / śatākṣauhiṇikāṃ senāṃ varjayitvāstrabhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: In the course ofthe battle Dandanatha fought with Visanga. Drawing he r jewel-studded bow, Syama fought with Visukra.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course ofthe battle Dandanatha fought with Visanga. Drawing he r jewel-studded bow, Syama fought with Visukra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course ofthe battle Dandanatha fought with Visanga. Drawing he r jewel-studded bow, Syama fought with Visukra.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्सर्वं चमुजालं निर्जगाम रणोन्मुखी । पुरतः प्राचलद्दण्डनाथा रथनिषेदुषी
verses.transliteration: anyatsarvaṃ camujālaṃ nirjagāma raṇonmukhī / purataḥ prācaladdaṇḍanāthā rathaniṣeduṣī
verses.translation: Asvarudha (Deity seated on a horse) powerfully fought with Ulukajit. With a great desire for fighting, Sampa- dlsa came into clash with the Demon Purusena.
verses.wordMeaning: Asvarudha (Deity seated on a horse) powerfully fought with Ulukajit. With a great desire for fighting, Sampa- dlsa came into clash with the Demon Purusena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asvarudha (Deity seated on a horse) powerfully fought with Ulukajit. With a great desire for fighting, Sampa- dlsa came into clash with the Demon Purusena.

verses.sanskrit: एकयैव कराङ्गुल्या घूर्णयन्ती हलायुधम् । मुसलं चान्यहस्तेन भ्रामयन्ती मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: ekayaiva karāṅgulyā ghūrṇayantī halāyudham / musalaṃ cānyahastena bhrāmayantī muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: The deity Nakuli challenged and came into a clash with Kuntisena.
verses.wordMeaning: The deity Nakuli challenged and came into a clash with Kuntisena.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity Nakuli challenged and came into a clash with Kuntisena.

verses.sanskrit: तरलेन्दुकलाचूडास्फुरत्पोत्रमुखाम्बुजा । पुरः प्रहर्त्री समरे सर्वदा विक्रमोद्धता । अस्या अनुप्रचलिता गेयचक्ररथस्थिता
verses.transliteration: taralendukalācūḍāsphuratpotramukhāmbujā / puraḥ prahartrī samare sarvadā vikramoddhatā / asyā anupracalitā geyacakrarathasthitā
verses.translation: U nmattabhairavl fought with Malada. Laghusyama fought with Kusura.
verses.wordMeaning: U nmattabhairavl fought with Malada. Laghusyama fought with Kusura.
verses.commentary: Sense: U nmattabhairavl fought with Malada. Laghusyama fought with Kusura.

verses.sanskrit: धनुषो ध्वनिना विश्वं पूरयन्ती महोद्धता । वेणीकृतकचन्यस्तविलसच्चन्द्रपल्लवा
verses.transliteration: dhanuṣo dhvaninā viśvaṃ pūrayantī mahoddhatā / veṇīkṛtakacanyastavilasaccandrapallavā
verses.translation: SvapnesT waged war with the leading Daitya named Marigala. VagvadinI clashed with Draghana in the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: SvapnesT waged war with the leading Daitya named Marigala. VagvadinI clashed with Draghana in the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: SvapnesT waged war with the leading Daitya named Marigala. VagvadinI clashed with Draghana in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: स्फुरत्त्रितयनेत्रेण सिन्दूरतिलकत्विषा । पाणिना पद्मरम्येण मणिकङ्कणचारुणा
verses.transliteration: sphurattritayanetreṇa sindūratilakatviṣā / pāṇinā padmaramyeṇa maṇikaṅkaṇacāruṇā
verses.translation: CandakalT fought with the wicked Kolata. The hundred Aksauhinls of deities fought with the Aksauhinls ofthe Daityas. Highly furious both the armies fought a great battle mutually.
verses.wordMeaning: CandakalT fought with the wicked Kolata. The hundred Aksauhinls of deities fought with the Aksauhinls ofthe Daityas. Highly furious both the armies fought a great battle mutually.
verses.commentary: Sense: CandakalT fought with the wicked Kolata. The hundred Aksauhinls of deities fought with the Aksauhinls ofthe Daityas. Highly furious both the armies fought a great battle mutually.

verses.sanskrit: तूणीरमुखतः कृष्टं भ्रामयन्ती शिलीमुखम् । जय वर्धस्ववर्धस्वेत्यतिहर्षसमाकुले
verses.transliteration: tūṇīramukhataḥ kṛṣṭaṃ bhrāmayantī śilīmukham / jaya vardhasvavardhasvetyatiharṣasamākule
verses.translation: The author's ingenuity in converting vices, virtues, physical and mental handicaps into Astras "missiles" appears now and then. It reached its climax in Bhandasura's fight with Lalita, Infra ch. 29. Here this Astra is capable of making the whole army thirsty. Its effect is described in VV. 45-53
verses.wordMeaning: The author's ingenuity in converting vices, virtues, physical and mental handicaps into Astras "missiles" appears now and then. It reached its climax in Bhandasura's fight with Lalita, Infra ch. 29. Here this Astra is capable of making the whole army thirsty.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The author's ingenuity in converting vices, virtues, physical and mental handicaps into Astras "missiles" appears now and then. It reached its climax in Bhandasura's fight with Lalita, Infra ch. 29. Here this Astra is capable of making the whole army thirsty.…

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यद्भिर्दिव्यमुनिभिर्वर्द्धिताशीर्वचो ऽमृतैः । गेयचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य चक्रनेमिविघट्टनैः
verses.transliteration: nṛtyadbhirdivyamunibhirvarddhitāśīrvaco 'mṛtaiḥ / geyacakrarathendrasya cakranemivighaṭṭanaiḥ
verses.translation: Among the sixteen thousand Aksauhinls, dear Potrini, there is not even a single Sakti who is not afflicted by thirst.
verses.wordMeaning: Among the sixteen thousand Aksauhinls, dear Potrini, there is not even a single Sakti who is not afflicted by thirst.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the sixteen thousand Aksauhinls, dear Potrini, there is not even a single Sakti who is not afflicted by thirst.

verses.sanskrit: दारयन्ती क्षितितलं दैत्यानां हृदयैः सह । लोकातिशायिता विश्वमनोमोहनकारिणा । गीतिबन्धेनामरीभिर्बह्वीभिर्गीतवैभवा
verses.transliteration: dārayantī kṣititalaṃ daityānāṃ hṛdayaiḥ saha / lokātiśāyitā viśvamanomohanakāriṇā / gītibandhenāmarībhirbahvībhirgītavaibhavā
verses.translation: On seeing this opportunity when the army has cast off its weapons, the Danavas, ever eager to strike at weak and vulnerable points, are alas! striking and killing by means of arrows.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing this opportunity when the army has cast off its weapons, the Danavas, ever eager to strike at weak and vulnerable points, are alas! striking and killing by means of arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing this opportunity when the army has cast off its weapons, the Danavas, ever eager to strike at weak and vulnerable points, are alas! striking and killing by means of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणामष्टकं समरोद्धतम् । कर्षती कल्पविश्लेषनिर्मर्यादाब्धिसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration: akṣauhiṇīsahasrāṇāmaṣṭakaṃ samaroddhatam / karṣatī kalpaviśleṣanirmaryādābdhisaṃnibham
verses.translation: That Madirasindhu (ocean of liquor) alone will satisfy the troops of Saktis. Command that noble-souled one
verses.wordMeaning: That Madirasindhu (ocean of liquor) alone will satisfy the troops of Saktis. Command that noble-souled one
verses.commentary: Sense: That Madirasindhu (ocean of liquor) alone will satisfy the troops of Saktis. Command that noble-souled one

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः शक्तिचमूचक्रे काश्चित्कनकरोचिषः । काश्चिद्दाडिमसंकाशाः काश्चिज्जीमूतरोचिषः
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ śakticamūcakre kāścitkanakarociṣaḥ / kāściddāḍimasaṃkāśāḥ kāścijjīmūtarociṣaḥ
verses.translation: The ocean of liquor showered those (beverages), by the mere fragrance of which even the dead man might rise up perfectly well and the weak ones would become very strong.
verses.wordMeaning: The ocean of liquor showered those (beverages), by the mere fragrance of which even the dead man might rise up perfectly well and the weak ones would become very strong.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ocean of liquor showered those (beverages), by the mere fragrance of which even the dead man might rise up perfectly well and the weak ones would become very strong.

verses.sanskrit: अन्याः सिंदूररुचयः पराः पाटलपाटलाः । काचाद्रिकाम्बराः काश्चित्पराः श्यामलकोमलाः
verses.transliteration: anyāḥ siṃdūrarucayaḥ parāḥ pāṭalapāṭalāḥ / kācādrikāmbarāḥ kāścitparāḥ śyāmalakomalāḥ
verses.translation: Quaffing those series of liquor torrents surpassing Parardha (1 followed by 17 zeroes) in number, by means of their mouths distressed by thirst, Saktis rose up.
verses.wordMeaning: Quaffing those series of liquor torrents surpassing Parardha (1 followed by 17 zeroes) in number, by means of their mouths distressed by thirst, Saktis rose up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Quaffing those series of liquor torrents surpassing Parardha (1 followed by 17 zeroes) in number, by means of their mouths distressed by thirst, Saktis rose up.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यास्तु हीरकप्रख्याः परा गारुत्मतोपमाः । विरुद्धैः पञ्चभिर्बाणैर्मिश्रितैः शतकोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: anyāstu hīrakaprakhyāḥ parā gārutmatopamāḥ / viruddhaiḥ pañcabhirbāṇairmiśritaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: Each one of theYoginls (i.e. Saktis) joyously drank the torrent of liquor as big as the trunk of Airavata elephant uninterruptedly for the period of one full Yama. (3 hours).
verses.wordMeaning: Each one of theYoginls (i.e. Saktis) joyously drank the torrent of liquor as big as the trunk of Airavata elephant uninterruptedly for the period of one full Yama. (3 hours).
verses.commentary: Sense: Each one of theYoginls (i.e. Saktis) joyously drank the torrent of liquor as big as the trunk of Airavata elephant uninterruptedly for the period of one full Yama. (3 hours).

verses.sanskrit: व्यञ्जयन्त्यो देहरुचं कतिचिद्विविधायुधाः । असंख्याः शक्तयश्चेलुर्दण्डिन्यास्सैनिके तथा
verses.transliteration: vyañjayantyo deharucaṃ katicidvividhāyudhāḥ / asaṃkhyāḥ śaktayaścelurdaṇḍinyāssainike tathā
verses.translation: Saktis went on drinking liquor joyously with their eyes closed. Their faces were supine and moving to and fro with lolling tongues.
verses.wordMeaning: Saktis went on drinking liquor joyously with their eyes closed. Their faces were supine and moving to and fro with lolling tongues.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktis went on drinking liquor joyously with their eyes closed. Their faces were supine and moving to and fro with lolling tongues.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव सैन्यसन्नाहो मन्त्रिण्याः कुम्भसम्भव । यथा भूषणवेषादि यथा प्रभावलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva sainyasannāho mantriṇyāḥ kumbhasambhava / yathā bhūṣaṇaveṣādi yathā prabhāvalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The battle seems to have come to a standstill for sometime while Saktis were drinking wine. The period is recorded in V. 70 and 77 and effects of drinking in VV. 82-84, 96-97.
verses.wordMeaning: The battle seems to have come to a standstill for sometime while Saktis were drinking wine. The period is recorded in V. 70 and 77 and effects of drinking in VV. 82-84, 96-97.
verses.commentary: Sense: The battle seems to have come to a standstill for sometime while Saktis were drinking wine. The period is recorded in V. 70 and 77 and effects of drinking in VV. 82-84, 96-97.

verses.sanskrit: यथा सद्गुणशालित्वं यथा चाश्रितलक्षणम् । यथा दैत्यौघसंहारो यथा सर्वैश्च पूजिता
verses.transliteration: yathā sadguṇaśālitvaṃ yathā cāśritalakṣaṇam / yathā daityaughasaṃhāro yathā sarvaiśca pūjitā
verses.translation: Varieties of wine in ancient India.
verses.wordMeaning: Varieties of wine in ancient India.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varieties of wine in ancient India.

verses.sanskrit: यथा शक्तिर्महाराज्ञ्या देडिन्यश्च तथाखिलम् । विशेषस्तु परं तस्याः साचिव्ये तत्करे स्थितम् । महाराज्ञीवितीर्णं तदाज्ञामुद्राङ्गुलीयकम्
verses.transliteration: yathā śaktirmahārājñyā deḍinyaśca tathākhilam / viśeṣastu paraṃ tasyāḥ sācivye tatkare sthitam / mahārājñīvitīrṇaṃ tadājñāmudrāṅgulīyakam
verses.translation: After propitiating them by means of torrents of liquors of various kinds in this manner, the ocean of liquor assumed a divine form and came there.
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating them by means of torrents of liquors of various kinds in this manner, the ocean of liquor assumed a divine form and came there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating them by means of torrents of liquors of various kinds in this manner, the ocean of liquor assumed a divine form and came there.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं प्रचलिते सैन्ये मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः । तद्भारभङ्गुरा भूमिर्देलालीलामलंबत
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ pracalite sainye mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ / tadbhārabhaṅgurā bhūmirdelālīlāmalaṃbata
verses.translation: He approached Dandanatha and after bowing to her spoke these words in a pleasant and majestic tone.
verses.wordMeaning: He approached Dandanatha and after bowing to her spoke these words in a pleasant and majestic tone.
verses.commentary: Sense: He approached Dandanatha and after bowing to her spoke these words in a pleasant and majestic tone.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् । उद्धूतधूलिजंबालीभूतसप्तार्णवीजलम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam / uddhūtadhūlijaṃbālībhūtasaptārṇavījalam
verses.translation: Some ofthem are dancing and singing with their girdles and waistbands tinkling sweetly. Some of them are clapping their hands in front of those who dance.
verses.wordMeaning: Some ofthem are dancing and singing with their girdles and waistbands tinkling sweetly. Some of them are clapping their hands in front of those who dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some ofthem are dancing and singing with their girdles and waistbands tinkling sweetly. Some of them are clapping their hands in front of those who dance.

verses.sanskrit: हयस्थैर्हयसादिन्यो रथस्थै रथसंस्थिताः । आधोरणैर्हस्तिपकाः खड्गैः पद्गाश्च सङ्गताः
verses.transliteration: hayasthairhayasādinyo rathasthai rathasaṃsthitāḥ / ādhoraṇairhastipakāḥ khaḍgaiḥ padgāśca saṅgatāḥ
verses.translation: Some are laughing (boisterously) with their beauti- ful breasts shaking and bouncing. A few of them lean on one another's bodies with the laziness and slackness due to delight.
verses.wordMeaning: Some are laughing (boisterously) with their beauti- ful breasts shaking and bouncing. A few of them lean on one another's bodies with the laziness and slackness due to delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some are laughing (boisterously) with their beauti- ful breasts shaking and bouncing. A few of them lean on one another's bodies with the laziness and slackness due to delight.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डनाथाविषङ्गेण समयुध्यन्त सङ्गरे । विशुक्रेण समं श्यामा विकृष्टमणिकार्मुका
verses.transliteration: daṇḍanāthāviṣaṅgeṇa samayudhyanta saṅgare / viśukreṇa samaṃ śyāmā vikṛṣṭamaṇikārmukā
verses.translation: Some begin to swagger as girdles and garments begin to slip down from their hips. Some have got up ready for fighting but without any weapon. They simply shake and shiver".
verses.wordMeaning: Some begin to swagger as girdles and garments begin to slip down from their hips. Some have got up ready for fighting but without any weapon. They simply shake and shiver".
verses.commentary: Sense: Some begin to swagger as girdles and garments begin to slip down from their hips. Some have got up ready for fighting but without any weapon. They simply shake and shiver".

verses.sanskrit: अश्वरूढा चकारोच्चैः सहोलूकजिता रणम् । सम्पदीशाच जग्राह पुरुषेण युयुत्सया
verses.transliteration: aśvarūḍhā cakāroccaiḥ saholūkajitā raṇam / sampadīśāca jagrāha puruṣeṇa yuyutsayā
verses.translation: On seeing Saktis thus pointed out by the ocean
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Saktis thus pointed out by the ocean
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Saktis thus pointed out by the ocean

verses.sanskrit: विषेण नकुली देवी समाह्वास्त युयुत्सया । कुन्तिषेणेन समरं महामाया तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: viṣeṇa nakulī devī samāhvāsta yuyutsayā / kuntiṣeṇena samaraṃ mahāmāyā tadākarot
verses.translation: "I am gratified, O ocean ofliquor. A good help and assistance has been rendered by you. This is a work on behalf of the Devas. It has been achieved without any hindrance.
verses.wordMeaning: "I am gratified, O ocean ofliquor. A good help and assistance has been rendered by you. This is a work on behalf of the Devas. It has been achieved without any hindrance.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am gratified, O ocean ofliquor. A good help and assistance has been rendered by you. This is a work on behalf of the Devas. It has been achieved without any hindrance.

verses.sanskrit: मलदेन समं चक्रे युद्धमुन्मत्तभैरवी । लघुश्यामा चकारोच्चैः कुशूरेण समं रणम्
verses.transliteration: maladena samaṃ cakre yuddhamunmattabhairavī / laghuśyāmā cakāroccaiḥ kuśūreṇa samaṃ raṇam
verses.translation: Due to my favour henceforth, in the age of
verses.wordMeaning: Due to my favour henceforth, in the age of
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to my favour henceforth, in the age of

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नेशी मङ्गलाख्येन दैत्येन्द्रेण रणंव्यधात् । वाग्वादिनी तु जघटे द्रुघणेन समं रणे
verses.transliteration: svapneśī maṅgalākhyena daityendreṇa raṇaṃvyadhāt / vāgvādinī tu jaghaṭe drughaṇena samaṃ raṇe
verses.translation: Saktis had the refulgence of beaming pride.
verses.wordMeaning: Saktis had the refulgence of beaming pride.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktis had the refulgence of beaming pride.

verses.sanskrit: कोलाटेन च दुष्टेन चण्डकाल्यकरोद्रणम् । अक्षौहिणीभिर्दैत्यानां शताक्षौहिणिकास्तथा । महान्तं समरे चक्रुरन्योन्यं क्रोधमूर्छिताः
verses.transliteration: kolāṭena ca duṣṭena caṇḍakālyakarodraṇam / akṣauhiṇībhirdaityānāṃ śatākṣauhiṇikāstathā / mahāntaṃ samare cakruranyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ
verses.translation: DandinT shattered a hundred Aksauhinls; MantrinI annihilated a hundred and fifty Aksauhinls.
verses.wordMeaning: DandinT shattered a hundred Aksauhinls; MantrinI annihilated a hundred and fifty Aksauhinls.
verses.commentary: Sense: DandinT shattered a hundred Aksauhinls; MantrinI annihilated a hundred and fifty Aksauhinls.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तमाने समरे विशुक्रो दुष्टदानवः । वर्धमानां शक्तिचमूं हीयमानां निजां चमूम्
verses.transliteration: pravartamāne samare viśukro duṣṭadānavaḥ / vardhamānāṃ śakticamūṃ hīyamānāṃ nijāṃ camūm
verses.translation: Asvarudha and others with their eyes red due to inebriation (collectively) led a hundred and fifty Aksauhinls to the, mansion of god of Death.
verses.wordMeaning: Asvarudha and others with their eyes red due to inebriation (collectively) led a hundred and fifty Aksauhinls to the, mansion of god of Death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asvarudha and others with their eyes red due to inebriation (collectively) led a hundred and fifty Aksauhinls to the, mansion of god of Death.

verses.sanskrit: अवलोक्य रुषाविष्टः स कृष्टगुरुकार्मुकः । शक्तिसैन्ये समस्ते ऽपि तृषास्त्रं प्रमुमोच ह
verses.transliteration: avalokya ruṣāviṣṭaḥ sa kṛṣṭagurukārmukaḥ / śaktisainye samaste 'pi tṛṣāstraṃ pramumoca ha
verses.translation: In the course of the battle, the deity Turagarohim smashed and shattered Ulukajit with the excessively sharp goad and made him a guest in the other world (i.c. killed him).
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of the battle, the deity Turagarohim smashed and shattered Ulukajit with the excessively sharp goad and made him a guest in the other world (i.c. killed him).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of the battle, the deity Turagarohim smashed and shattered Ulukajit with the excessively sharp goad and made him a guest in the other world (i.c. killed him).

verses.sanskrit: तेन दावानलज्वालादीप्तेन मथितं बलम् । तृतीये युद्धदिवसे याममात्रं गते रवौ । विशुक्रमुक्ततर्षास्त्रव्याकुलाः शक्तयो ऽवन्
verses.transliteration: tena dāvānalajvālādīptena mathitaṃ balam / tṛtīye yuddhadivase yāmamātraṃ gate ravau / viśukramuktatarṣāstravyākulāḥ śaktayo 'van
verses.translation: Sampatkarl and others, generals of the divi- sions of the army of Saktis, checked and restrained. others the chief of whom was Purusena (?) and ultimately tore them up.
verses.wordMeaning: Sampatkarl and others, generals of the divi- sions of the army of Saktis, checked and restrained. others the chief of whom was Purusena (?) and ultimately tore them up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sampatkarl and others, generals of the divi- sions of the army of Saktis, checked and restrained. others the chief of whom was Purusena (?) and ultimately tore them up.

verses.sanskrit: क्षोभयन्निन्द्रियग्रामं तालुमूलं विशोषयन् । रूक्षयन्कर्णकुहरमङ्गदौर्वल्यमाहवन्
verses.transliteration: kṣobhayannindriyagrāmaṃ tālumūlaṃ viśoṣayan / rūkṣayankarṇakuharamaṅgadaurvalyamāhavan
verses.translation: When the sun set, the entire army had been killed. Thereupon, Syamala became excessively angry and fought with Visukra.
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun set, the entire army had been killed. Thereupon, Syamala became excessively angry and fought with Visukra.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun set, the entire army had been killed. Thereupon, Syamala became excessively angry and fought with Visukra.

verses.sanskrit: पातयन्पृथिवीपृष्ठे देहं विस्रंसितायुधम् । आविर्बभूव शक्तीनामतितीव्रस्तृषाज्वरः
verses.transliteration: pātayanpṛthivīpṛṣṭhe dehaṃ visraṃsitāyudham / āvirbabhūva śaktīnāmatitīvrastṛṣājvaraḥ
verses.translation: By discharging missiles and counter missiles Mantrini displayed a great deal of war-like activity dreadful even to the heaven-dwellers and continued the war.
verses.wordMeaning: By discharging missiles and counter missiles Mantrini displayed a great deal of war-like activity dreadful even to the heaven-dwellers and continued the war.
verses.commentary: Sense: By discharging missiles and counter missiles Mantrini displayed a great deal of war-like activity dreadful even to the heaven-dwellers and continued the war.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धेष्वनुद्यमकृता सर्वोत्साहविरोधिना । तर्षेण तेन क्वथितं शक्तिसैन्यं विलोक्यसा । मन्त्रिणी सह पोत्रिण्या भृशं चिन्तामवाप ह
verses.transliteration: yuddheṣvanudyamakṛtā sarvotsāhavirodhinā / tarṣeṇa tena kvathitaṃ śaktisainyaṃ vilokyasā / mantriṇī saha potriṇyā bhṛśaṃ cintāmavāpa ha
