verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यमङ्गं मृद्नन्तौ गदायुद्धप्रवर्तिनौ । चण्डाट्टहासमुखरौ परिभ्रमणकारिणौ
verses.transliteration: anyonyamaṅgaṃ mṛdnantau gadāyuddhapravartinau / caṇḍāṭṭahāsamukharau paribhramaṇakāriṇau
verses.translation: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.wordMeaning: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वाणौ विविधांश्चारान्घूर्णन्तौ तूर्मवेष्टिनौ । अन्योन्यदण्डहननैर्मोहयन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: kurvāṇau vividhāṃścārānghūrṇantau tūrmaveṣṭinau / anyonyadaṇḍahananairmohayantau muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.wordMeaning: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यप्रहृतौ रन्ध्रमीक्षमाणौ महोद्धतौ । महामुसलदण्डाग्रघट्टनक्षोभितांबरौ । अयुध्येतां दुराधर्षौं दण्डिनीदैत्यशेखरौ
verses.transliteration: anyonyaprahṛtau randhramīkṣamāṇau mahoddhatau / mahāmusaladaṇḍāgraghaṭṭanakṣobhitāṃbarau / ayudhyetāṃ durādharṣauṃ daṇḍinīdaityaśekharau
verses.translation: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.wordMeaning: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.

verses.sanskrit: अथार्द्धरात्रिसमयपर्यन्तं कृतसंगरा । संक्रुद्धा हन्तुमारेभे विषङ्गं दण्डनायिका
verses.transliteration: athārddharātrisamayaparyantaṃ kṛtasaṃgarā / saṃkruddhā hantumārebhe viṣaṅgaṃ daṇḍanāyikā
verses.translation: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.wordMeaning: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.

verses.sanskrit: तं मूर्धनि निमग्नेन हलेनाकृष्य वैरिणम् । कठोरं ताडनं चक्रे मुसलेनाथ पोत्रिणी
verses.transliteration: taṃ mūrdhani nimagnena halenākṛṣya vairiṇam / kaṭhoraṃ tāḍanaṃ cakre musalenātha potriṇī
verses.translation: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.wordMeaning: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुसलघातेन त्यक्तप्राणो महासुरः । चूर्णितेन शताङ्गेन समं भूतलमाश्रयत्
verses.transliteration: tato musalaghātena tyaktaprāṇo mahāsuraḥ / cūrṇitena śatāṅgena samaṃ bhūtalamāśrayat
verses.translation: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.wordMeaning: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.

verses.sanskrit: इति कृत्वा महत्कर्म मन्त्रिणीदण्डनायिके । तत्रैव तं निशा शेषं निन्यतुः शिबिरं प्रति
verses.transliteration: iti kṛtvā mahatkarma mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyike / tatraiva taṃ niśā śeṣaṃ ninyatuḥ śibiraṃ prati
verses.translation: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.wordMeaning: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fought with him till mid-night. Dandana- yika who became very furious began to strike at Visanga.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपख्याने विशुक्रविषङ्गवधो नामाष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ वर्णितं मन्त्रिणीबलम् । विषङ्गस्य वधो युद्धे वर्णितो दण्डनाथया
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopakhyāne viśukraviṣaṅgavadho nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca aśvānana mahāprājña varṇitaṃ mantriṇībalam / viṣaṅgasya vadho yuddhe varṇito daṇḍanāthayā
verses.translation: O highly intelligent sage Hayagrlva, the strength of MantrinT has been described. The slaying ofVisarigaby Danda- natha in battle has been described.
verses.wordMeaning: O highly intelligent sage Hayagrlva, the strength of MantrinT has been described. The slaying ofVisarigaby Danda- natha in battle has been described.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly intelligent sage Hayagrlva, the strength of MantrinT has been described. The slaying ofVisarigaby Danda- natha in battle has been described.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेव्याः श्रोतुमिच्छामि रणचक्रे पराक्रमम् । सोदरस्यापदं दृष्ट्वा भण्डः किमकरोच्छुचा
verses.transliteration: śrīdevyāḥ śrotumicchāmi raṇacakre parākramam / sodarasyāpadaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaṇḍaḥ kimakarocchucā
verses.translation: I wish to hear about the exploits of SrldevI n the course of the battle. After seeing the mishap ofhis brother, w hat did Bhanda do, due to the grief thereof?
verses.wordMeaning: I wish to hear about the exploits of SrldevI n the course of the battle. After seeing the mishap ofhis brother, w hat did Bhanda do, due to the grief thereof?
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to hear about the exploits of SrldevI n the course of the battle. After seeing the mishap ofhis brother, w hat did Bhanda do, due to the grief thereof?

verses.sanskrit: कथं तस्य रणोत्साहः कैः समं समयुध्यत । सहायाः के ऽभवंस्तस्य हतभ्रातृतनूभुवः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tasya raṇotsāhaḥ kaiḥ samaṃ samayudhyata / sahāyāḥ ke 'bhavaṃstasya hatabhrātṛtanūbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: Listen to this, O highly intelligent one. The narrative ofLalita is destructive of all sins. It is holy and it yields qualities, (i.e. siddhis like) Anima (minuteness) etc.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to this, O highly intelligent one. The narrative ofLalita is destructive of all sins. It is holy and it yields qualities, (i.e. siddhis like) Anima (minuteness) etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to this, O highly intelligent one. The narrative ofLalita is destructive of all sins. It is holy and it yields qualities, (i.e. siddhis like) Anima (minuteness) etc.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच इदं शृणु महाप्राज्ञ सर्वपापनिकृन्तनम् । ललिताचरितं पुण्यमणिमादिगुमप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca idaṃ śṛṇu mahāprājña sarvapāpanikṛntanam / lalitācaritaṃ puṇyamaṇimādigumapradam
verses.translation: During the equinoctial periods as well as during the transits ofthe sun, on holy occasions and during the five Parvan* days, it bestows Siddhis ahd'glory. It destroys all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: During the equinoctial periods as well as during the transits ofthe sun, on holy occasions and during the five Parvan* days, it bestows Siddhis ahd'glory. It destroys all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the equinoctial periods as well as during the transits ofthe sun, on holy occasions and during the five Parvan* days, it bestows Siddhis ahd'glory. It destroys all sins.

verses.sanskrit: वैषुवायनकालेषु पुण्येषु समयेषु च । सिद्धिदं सर्वपापघ्नं कीर्तिदं पञ्चपर्वसु
verses.transliteration: vaiṣuvāyanakāleṣu puṇyeṣu samayeṣu ca / siddhidaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ kīrtidaṃ pañcaparvasu
verses.translation: On hearing that there in the battle his brothers had been killed. Bhanda was overwhelmed with great grief. He began to lament loudly.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that there in the battle his brothers had been killed. Bhanda was overwhelmed with great grief. He began to lament loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that there in the battle his brothers had been killed. Bhanda was overwhelmed with great grief. He began to lament loudly.

verses.sanskrit: तदा हतौ रणे तत्र श्रुत्वा निजसहोदरौ । शोकेन महताविष्टो भण्डः प्रविललाप सः
verses.transliteration: tadā hatau raṇe tatra śrutvā nijasahodarau / śokena mahatāviṣṭo bhaṇḍaḥ pravilalāpa saḥ
verses.translation: With his hairs dishevelled and scattered, he fell on the ground in a swoon. He did not get any consolation. He became emaciated due to the sorrow for his brother.
verses.wordMeaning: With his hairs dishevelled and scattered, he fell on the ground in a swoon. He did not get any consolation. He became emaciated due to the sorrow for his brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his hairs dishevelled and scattered, he fell on the ground in a swoon. He did not get any consolation. He became emaciated due to the sorrow for his brother.

verses.sanskrit: विकीर्मकेशो धरणौ मूर्छितः पतितस्तदा । न लेभे किञ्चिदाश्वासं भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितः
verses.transliteration: vikīrmakeśo dharaṇau mūrchitaḥ patitastadā / na lebhe kiñcidāśvāsaṃ bhrātṛvyasanakarśitaḥ
verses.translation: Again and again he went on lamenting. On being pacified repeatedly by Kutilaksa, he got rid of his sorrow and became very furious.
verses.wordMeaning: Again and again he went on lamenting. On being pacified repeatedly by Kutilaksa, he got rid of his sorrow and became very furious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again and again he went on lamenting. On being pacified repeatedly by Kutilaksa, he got rid of his sorrow and became very furious.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पुनः प्रविलपन्कुटिलाक्षेण भूरिशः । आश्वास्यामानः शोकेन युक्तः कोपमवाप सः
verses.transliteration: punaḥ punaḥ pravilapankuṭilākṣeṇa bhūriśaḥ / āśvāsyāmānaḥ śokena yuktaḥ kopamavāpa saḥ
verses.translation: The lord of Daityas who w'as a great chariot-fighter and haughty in war, mounted his excellent chariot called Abhila to which a thousand lions were yoked.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of Daityas who w'as a great chariot-fighter and haughty in war, mounted his excellent chariot called Abhila to which a thousand lions were yoked.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Daityas who w'as a great chariot-fighter and haughty in war, mounted his excellent chariot called Abhila to which a thousand lions were yoked.

verses.sanskrit: फालं वहन्नतिक्रूरं भ्रमद्भ्रुकुटिभीषणम् । अङ्गारपाटलाक्षश्च निःश्वसन्कृष्णसर्पवत्
verses.transliteration: phālaṃ vahannatikrūraṃ bhramadbhrukuṭibhīṣaṇam / aṅgārapāṭalākṣaśca niḥśvasankṛṣṇasarpavat
verses.translation: He hastened with great lustre like the fire of •world-destruction whose flames blazed. The name of his sword was Ghataka. It had the same shape as the Candrahasa sword.
verses.wordMeaning: He hastened with great lustre like the fire of •world-destruction whose flames blazed. The name of his sword was Ghataka. It had the same shape as the Candrahasa sword.
verses.commentary: Sense: He hastened with great lustre like the fire of •world-destruction whose flames blazed. The name of his sword was Ghataka. It had the same shape as the Candrahasa sword.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच कुटिलाक्षं द्राक्समस्तपृतनापतिम् । क्षिप्रं मुहुर्मुहुः स्पृष्ट्वा धुन्वानः करवालिकाम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca kuṭilākṣaṃ drāksamastapṛtanāpatim / kṣipraṃ muhurmuhuḥ spṛṣṭvā dhunvānaḥ karavālikām
verses.translation: When the armies moved here and there, dust columns were raised. Being unable to bear their burden, it appeared as though the earth went to the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: When the armies moved here and there, dust columns were raised. Being unable to bear their burden, it appeared as though the earth went to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the armies moved here and there, dust columns were raised. Being unable to bear their burden, it appeared as though the earth went to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधहुङ्कारमातन्वन्गर्जन्नुत्पातमेघवत्
verses.transliteration: krodhahuṅkāramātanvangarjannutpātameghavat
verses.translation: Some ofthem who could not be contained on the earth moved ahead along the path of the sky. Some mighty warriors moved on riding on the shoulders of some.
verses.wordMeaning: Some ofthem who could not be contained on the earth moved ahead along the path of the sky. Some mighty warriors moved on riding on the shoulders of some.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some ofthem who could not be contained on the earth moved ahead along the path of the sky. Some mighty warriors moved on riding on the shoulders of some.

verses.sanskrit: ययैव दृष्टया मायाबलाद्युद्धे विनाशिताः । भ्रातरो मम पुत्राश्च सेनानाथाः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: yayaiva dṛṣṭayā māyābalādyuddhe vināśitāḥ / bhrātaro mama putrāśca senānāthāḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Neither in the cordinal points nor on the sphere of the earth nor in the sky could they be contained. They moved on with very great difficulty as though they were addicted by the close contact of one another.
verses.wordMeaning: Neither in the cordinal points nor on the sphere of the earth nor in the sky could they be contained. They moved on with very great difficulty as though they were addicted by the close contact of one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither in the cordinal points nor on the sphere of the earth nor in the sky could they be contained. They moved on with very great difficulty as though they were addicted by the close contact of one another.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः स्त्रियाः प्रमत्तायाः कण्ठोत्थैः शोणितद्रवैः । भ्रातृपुत्रमहाशोकवह्निं निर्वापयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ striyāḥ pramattāyāḥ kaṇṭhotthaiḥ śoṇitadravaiḥ / bhrātṛputramahāśokavahniṃ nirvāpayāmyaham
verses.translation: A loud roar resembling the rumbling sound of the cloud was given out by him who was moving on along with all the soldiers.
verses.wordMeaning: A loud roar resembling the rumbling sound of the cloud was given out by him who was moving on along with all the soldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: A loud roar resembling the rumbling sound of the cloud was given out by him who was moving on along with all the soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ रे कुटिलाक्ष त्वं सज्जीकुरु पताकिनीम् । इत्युक्त्वा कठिनं वर्म वज्रपातसहं महत्
verses.transliteration: gaccha re kuṭilākṣa tvaṃ sajjīkuru patākinīm / ityuktvā kaṭhinaṃ varma vajrapātasahaṃ mahat
verses.translation: The universe became torn asunder by that exces- sively harsh leonine roar coming out ofthe mouth ofBhanda, the Daitya.
verses.wordMeaning: The universe became torn asunder by that exces- sively harsh leonine roar coming out ofthe mouth ofBhanda, the Daitya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe became torn asunder by that exces- sively harsh leonine roar coming out ofthe mouth ofBhanda, the Daitya.

verses.sanskrit: दधानो भुजमध्येन बध्नन्पृष्ठ तथेषुधी । उद्दाममौर्विनिःश्वासकठोरं भ्रामयन्धनुः
verses.transliteration: dadhāno bhujamadhyena badhnanpṛṣṭha tatheṣudhī / uddāmamaurviniḥśvāsakaṭhoraṃ bhrāmayandhanuḥ
verses.translation: The oceans became dried up. The moon and the sun fled. The stars fell down from the sky. The earth began to heave to and fro.
verses.wordMeaning: The oceans became dried up. The moon and the sun fled. The stars fell down from the sky. The earth began to heave to and fro.
verses.commentary: Sense: The oceans became dried up. The moon and the sun fled. The stars fell down from the sky. The earth began to heave to and fro.

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्निरिव संक्रुद्धो निर्जगाम निजात्पुरात् । तालजङ्घादिकैः सार्द्धंपूर्वद्वारे निवेशिते
verses.transliteration: kālāgniriva saṃkruddho nirjagāma nijātpurāt / tālajaṅghādikaiḥ sārddhaṃpūrvadvāre niveśite
verses.translation: The elephants of the cardinal points became frighten- ed. The heaven-dwellers swooned. The camp of the Saktis became excited on account ofa sudden and unexpected fear.
verses.wordMeaning: The elephants of the cardinal points became frighten- ed. The heaven-dwellers swooned. The camp of the Saktis became excited on account ofa sudden and unexpected fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: The elephants of the cardinal points became frighten- ed. The heaven-dwellers swooned. The camp of the Saktis became excited on account ofa sudden and unexpected fear.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिर्धृतशस्त्रौघैर्धृतवर्मभिरुद्धतैः । पञ्चत्रिंशच्चमूनाथैः कुटिलाक्षपुरःसरैः
verses.transliteration: caturbhirdhṛtaśastraughairdhṛtavarmabhiruddhataiḥ / pañcatriṃśaccamūnāthaiḥ kuṭilākṣapuraḥsaraiḥ
verses.translation: Considering that the great fight with the Daitya Bhanda, of vicious conduct, was not possible for the other saktis she herself took up the task.
verses.wordMeaning: Considering that the great fight with the Daitya Bhanda, of vicious conduct, was not possible for the other saktis she herself took up the task.
verses.commentary: Sense: Considering that the great fight with the Daitya Bhanda, of vicious conduct, was not possible for the other saktis she herself took up the task.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसेनापतीन्द्रेण कुटिलाक्षेण स क्रुधा । मिलितेन च भण्डेन चत्वारिंशच्चमूवराः
verses.transliteration: sarvasenāpatīndreṇa kuṭilākṣeṇa sa krudhā / militena ca bhaṇḍena catvāriṃśaccamūvarāḥ
verses.translation: Saktis who repeatedly endeavoured to kill Bhanda and his Asura followers were of multifbrmed nature. Although the opening of the circular fiery rampart extended to a Yojana in length, it was not sufficient for the outward march of the army.
verses.wordMeaning: Saktis who repeatedly endeavoured to kill Bhanda and his Asura followers were of multifbrmed nature. Although the opening of the circular fiery rampart extended to a Yojana in length, it was not sufficient for the outward march of the army.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktis who repeatedly endeavoured to kill Bhanda and his Asura followers were of multifbrmed nature. Although the opening of the circular fiery rampart extended to a Yojana in length, it was not sufficient for the outward march of the army.

verses.sanskrit: दीप्तायुधा दीप्तकेशा निर्जग्मुर्दीप्तकङ्कटाः । द्विसहस्राक्षौहिणीनां पञ्चाशीतिः परार्धिका
verses.transliteration: dīptāyudhā dīptakeśā nirjagmurdīptakaṅkaṭāḥ / dvisahasrākṣauhiṇīnāṃ pañcāśītiḥ parārdhikā
verses.translation: Desirous of an easy exit for all the armies, the Nitya deity named Jvalamalinika enlarged the opening further.
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of an easy exit for all the armies, the Nitya deity named Jvalamalinika enlarged the opening further.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of an easy exit for all the armies, the Nitya deity named Jvalamalinika enlarged the opening further.

verses.sanskrit: तदेनमन्वगादेकहेलया मथितुं द्विषः । भण्डासुरे विनिर्याते सर्वसैनिकसंकुले
verses.transliteration: tadenamanvagādekahelayā mathituṃ dviṣaḥ / bhaṇḍāsure viniryāte sarvasainikasaṃkule
verses.translation: As observed in Note 1 on Ch. 19, the chariot of Lalita symbolizes Vedic religion; the Vedas, Purusarthas etc. are parts of her chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: As observed in Note 1 on Ch. 19, the chariot of Lalita symbolizes Vedic religion; the Vedas, Purusarthas etc. are parts of her chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: As observed in Note 1 on Ch. 19, the chariot of Lalita symbolizes Vedic religion; the Vedas, Purusarthas etc. are parts of her chariot.

verses.sanskrit: शून्यके नगरे तत्र स्त्रीमात्रमवशेषितम् । आभिलो नाम दैत्येन्द्रो रथवर्यो महारथः । सहस्रयुग्यसिंहाढ्यमारुरोह रणोद्धतः
verses.transliteration: śūnyake nagare tatra strīmātramavaśeṣitam / ābhilo nāma daityendro rathavaryo mahārathaḥ / sahasrayugyasiṃhāḍhyamāruroha raṇoddhataḥ
verses.translation: Then the gloriously splendid mother of the worlds, the great queen of excessive valour and exploits, went out ofthe fiery city through the excellent opening.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the gloriously splendid mother of the worlds, the great queen of excessive valour and exploits, went out ofthe fiery city through the excellent opening.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gloriously splendid mother of the worlds, the great queen of excessive valour and exploits, went out ofthe fiery city through the excellent opening.

verses.sanskrit: तत्वरे विज्वलज्ज्वालाकालाग्निरिव दीप्तिमान् । घातको नाम वै खड्गश्चन्द्रहाससमाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: tatvare vijvalajjvālākālāgniriva dīptimān / ghātako nāma vai khaḍgaścandrahāsasamākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis (wardrums) sounded. Showers of flowers fell down. The great royal umbrella set with pearls was seen shining brilliantly in the firmament.
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis (wardrums) sounded. Showers of flowers fell down. The great royal umbrella set with pearls was seen shining brilliantly in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis (wardrums) sounded. Showers of flowers fell down. The great royal umbrella set with pearls was seen shining brilliantly in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: इतस्ततश्चलन्तीनां सेनानां धूलिरुत्थिता । वोढुं तासां भरं भूमिरक्षमेव दिवं ययौ
verses.transliteration: itastataścalantīnāṃ senānāṃ dhūlirutthitā / voḍhuṃ tāsāṃ bharaṃ bhūmirakṣameva divaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Pleasingly clear omens indicating the glory ofvictory occurred in the army ofLalita. Portentous ill-omens occurred in the army of enemies.
verses.wordMeaning: Pleasingly clear omens indicating the glory ofvictory occurred in the army ofLalita. Portentous ill-omens occurred in the army of enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pleasingly clear omens indicating the glory ofvictory occurred in the army ofLalita. Portentous ill-omens occurred in the army of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद्भूमेरपर्याप्ताः प्रचेलुर्व्योमवर्त्मना । केषाञ्चित्स्कन्धमारूढाः केचिच्चेलुर्महारथाः
verses.transliteration: kecidbhūmeraparyāptāḥ pracelurvyomavartmanā / keṣāñcitskandhamārūḍhāḥ keciccelurmahārathāḥ
verses.translation: Neither the quarters nor the sky, neither the mountains nor the earth, nothing was seen. Only the dust column was seen increasing in size.
verses.wordMeaning: Neither the quarters nor the sky, neither the mountains nor the earth, nothing was seen. Only the dust column was seen increasing in size.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither the quarters nor the sky, neither the mountains nor the earth, nothing was seen. Only the dust column was seen increasing in size.

verses.sanskrit: न दिक्षु न च भूचक्रे न व्योमनि च ते ममुः । दुःखदुखेन ते चेलुरन्योन्याश्लेषपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: na dikṣu na ca bhūcakre na vyomani ca te mamuḥ / duḥkhadukhena te celuranyonyāśleṣapīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: On the fourth day of the battle, beginning in the morning and extending to two Praharas (six hours) the terrible battle between the two armies ensued causing fear even to the god of Death.
verses.wordMeaning: On the fourth day of the battle, beginning in the morning and extending to two Praharas (six hours) the terrible battle between the two armies ensued causing fear even to the god of Death.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the fourth day of the battle, beginning in the morning and extending to two Praharas (six hours) the terrible battle between the two armies ensued causing fear even to the god of Death.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्त सेनासंमर्दाद्रथचक्रैर्विचूर्णिताः । केचित्पादेन नागानां मर्दिता न्यपतन्भुवि
verses.transliteration: atyanta senāsaṃmardādrathacakrairvicūrṇitāḥ / kecitpādena nāgānāṃ marditā nyapatanbhuvi
verses.translation: He discharged a great missile named Andhatamisraka '
verses.wordMeaning: He discharged a great missile named Andhatamisraka '
verses.commentary: Sense: He discharged a great missile named Andhatamisraka '

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं प्रचलिता तेन समं सर्वैश्च सैनिकैः । वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशो मेघनादो व्यधीयत
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ pracalitā tena samaṃ sarvaiśca sainikaiḥ / vajraniṣpeṣasadṛśo meghanādo vyadhīyata
verses.translation: As stated elsewhere this battle symbolizes the struggle between good and evil forces. The missiles also signify evil forces used'by Bhanda and good forces countered by Lalita. I give.below the list of so-called Astros discharged by Bhanda and destroyed by Lalita with a counter (good) force.
verses.wordMeaning: As stated elsewhere this battle symbolizes the struggle between good and evil forces. The missiles also signify evil forces used'by Bhanda and good forces countered by Lalita.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As stated elsewhere this battle symbolizes the struggle between good and evil forces. The missiles also signify evil forces used'by Bhanda and good forces countered by Lalita.…

verses.sanskrit: तेनातीव कठोरेण सिंहनादेन भूयसा । भण्डदैत्यमुखोत्थेन विदीर्णमभवज्जगत्
verses.transliteration: tenātīva kaṭhoreṇa siṃhanādena bhūyasā / bhaṇḍadaityamukhotthena vidīrṇamabhavajjagat
verses.translation: Pdkhapaa

verses.sanskrit: सागराः शोषमापन्नाश्चन्द्राकारै प्रपलायितौ । उडूनि न्यपतन्व्योम्नो भूमिर्देलायिताभवत्
verses.transliteration: sāgarāḥ śoṣamāpannāścandrākārai prapalāyitau / uḍūni nyapatanvyomno bhūmirdelāyitābhavat
verses.translation: Bhanda the great hero discharged the missile Pakkandastra (Heresy) in the course of battle. For dispelling it, the mother of the universe discharged the missile of Gayatri.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda the great hero discharged the missile Pakkandastra (Heresy) in the course of battle. For dispelling it, the mother of the universe discharged the missile of Gayatri.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda the great hero discharged the missile Pakkandastra (Heresy) in the course of battle. For dispelling it, the mother of the universe discharged the missile of Gayatri.

verses.sanskrit: दिङ्नागाश्चाभवंस्त्रस्ता मूर्च्छिताश्च दिवौकसः । शक्तीनां कटकं चासीदकाण्डत्रासविह्वलम्
verses.transliteration: diṅnāgāścābhavaṃstrastā mūrcchitāśca divaukasaḥ / śaktīnāṃ kaṭakaṃ cāsīdakāṇḍatrāsavihvalam
verses.translation: Bhanda discharged the missile Andhastra (Blindness) that was destructive of the vision of Saktis. The mother subdued it by means ofthe great- missile Caksus-matta (Endow- ment with eyes.)
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda discharged the missile Andhastra (Blindness) that was destructive of the vision of Saktis. The mother subdued it by means ofthe great- missile Caksus-matta (Endow- ment with eyes.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda discharged the missile Andhastra (Blindness) that was destructive of the vision of Saktis. The mother subdued it by means ofthe great- missile Caksus-matta (Endow- ment with eyes.)

verses.sanskrit: प्राणान्संधारयामासुः कथञ्चिन्मध्य आहवे । शक्तयो भयविभ्रष्टान्यायुधानि पुनर्दधुः
verses.transliteration: prāṇānsaṃdhārayāmāsuḥ kathañcinmadhya āhave / śaktayo bhayavibhraṣṭānyāyudhāni punardadhuḥ
verses.translation: In the course of great battle, Bhanda discharged the missile named Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis. (The goodess) dispelled its pride by the missile of Visvavasu.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of great battle, Bhanda discharged the missile named Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis. (The goodess) dispelled its pride by the missile of Visvavasu.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of great battle, Bhanda discharged the missile named Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis. (The goodess) dispelled its pride by the missile of Visvavasu.

verses.sanskrit: वह्निप्राकारवलयं प्रशान्तं पुनरुत्थितम् । दैत्येन्द्रसिंहनादेन चमूनाथधनुःस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: vahniprākāravalayaṃ praśāntaṃ punarutthitam / daityendrasiṃhanādena camūnāthadhanuḥsvanaiḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the extremely infuriated Danava discharged the missile Antakdstra (with Antaka the god of death as the presiding deity). The goddess destroyed its power by the missile of Mahdmrtyuhjaya (with lord Siva the conqueror of the god of death as the presiding lord)
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the extremely infuriated Danava discharged the missile Antakdstra (with Antaka the god of death as the presiding deity). The goddess destroyed its power by the missile of Mahdmrtyuhjaya (with lord Siva the conqueror of the god of death as the presiding lord)
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the extremely infuriated Danava discharged the missile Antakdstra (with Antaka the god of death as the presiding deity). The goddess destroyed its power by the missile of Mahdmrtyuhjaya (with lord Siva the conqueror of the god of death as the presiding lord)

verses.sanskrit: क्रन्दनैश्चापि योद्धॄणामभूच्छब्दमयं जगत् । तेन नादेन महता भण्डदैत्यविनिर्गमम् । निश्चित्य ललिता देवी स्वयं योद्धुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: krandanaiścāpi yoddhṝṇāmabhūcchabdamayaṃ jagat / tena nādena mahatā bhaṇḍadaityavinirgamam / niścitya lalitā devī svayaṃ yoddhuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: Bhanda discharged the missile named Sarvastrasmrti - rtdia. (Destruction of the memory of all missiles). CakresT
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda discharged the missile named Sarvastrasmrti - rtdia. (Destruction of the memory of all missiles). CakresT
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda discharged the missile named Sarvastrasmrti - rtdia. (Destruction of the memory of all missiles). CakresT

verses.sanskrit: अशक्यमन्यशक्तीनामाकलय्य महाहवम् । भण्डदैत्येन दुष्टेन स्वयमुद्योगमास्थिता
verses.transliteration: aśakyamanyaśaktīnāmākalayya mahāhavam / bhaṇḍadaityena duṣṭena svayamudyogamāsthitā
verses.translation: Andhastra (Blindness)
verses.wordMeaning: Andhastra (Blindness)
verses.commentary: Sense: Andhastra (Blindness)

verses.sanskrit: चक्रराजरथस्तस्याः प्रचचाल महोदयः । चतुर्वेदमहाचक्रपुरुषार्थमहाभयः
verses.transliteration: cakrarājarathastasyāḥ pracacāla mahodayaḥ / caturvedamahācakrapuruṣārthamahābhayaḥ
verses.translation: Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis)
verses.wordMeaning: Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis)
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis)

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दध्वजसंयुक्तो नवभिः पर्वभिर्युतः । नवपर्वस्थदेवीभिराकृष्टगुरुधन्विभिः
verses.transliteration: ānandadhvajasaṃyukto navabhiḥ parvabhiryutaḥ / navaparvasthadevībhirākṛṣṭagurudhanvibhiḥ
verses.translation: Bhaya (Fear)
verses.wordMeaning: Bhaya (Fear)
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhaya (Fear)

verses.sanskrit: परार्धाधिकसंख्यातपरिवारसमृद्धिभिः । पर्वस्थानेषु सर्वेषु पालितः सर्वतो दिशम्
verses.transliteration: parārdhādhikasaṃkhyātaparivārasamṛddhibhiḥ / parvasthāneṣu sarveṣu pālitaḥ sarvato diśam
verses.translation: Mahirogas (great diseases)
verses.wordMeaning: Mahirogas (great diseases)
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahirogas (great diseases)

verses.sanskrit: दशयोजनमुन्नद्धश्चतुर्योजन विस्तृतः । महाराज्ञीचक्रराजो रथेन्द्रः प्रचलन्बभौ
verses.transliteration: daśayojanamunnaddhaścaturyojana vistṛtaḥ / mahārājñīcakrarājo rathendraḥ pracalanbabhau
verses.translation: Mahasurastra
verses.wordMeaning: Mahasurastra
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahasurastra

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रचलिते जुष्टे श्यामया दण्डनाथया । गेयचक्रं तु बालाग्रे किरिचक्रं तु बृष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: tasminpracalite juṣṭe śyāmayā daṇḍanāthayā / geyacakraṃ tu bālāgre kiricakraṃ tu bṛṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda discharged the missile of Bhaya (fear) that
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda discharged the missile of Bhaya (fear) that
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda discharged the missile of Bhaya (fear) that

verses.sanskrit: अन्यासामपि शक्तीनां वाहनानि परार्द्धशः । नृसिंहोष्ट्रनरव्यालमृगपक्षिहयास्तथा
verses.transliteration: anyāsāmapi śaktīnāṃ vāhanāni parārddhaśaḥ / nṛsiṃhoṣṭranaravyālamṛgapakṣihayāstathā
verses.translation: The Danava discharged the missile of Maharogas (great diseases) among the armies of Saktis. Thereupon pulmonary consumption and thousands of other diseases began to ravage.
verses.wordMeaning: The Danava discharged the missile of Maharogas (great diseases) among the armies of Saktis. Thereupon pulmonary consumption and thousands of other diseases began to ravage.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Danava discharged the missile of Maharogas (great diseases) among the armies of Saktis. Thereupon pulmonary consumption and thousands of other diseases began to ravage.

verses.sanskrit: गजभेरुण्डशरभ व्याघ्रवातमृगास्तथा । एतादृशश्च तिर्यञ्चो ऽप्यन्ये वाहनतां गताः
verses.transliteration: gajabheruṇḍaśarabha vyāghravātamṛgāstathā / etādṛśaśca tiryañco 'pyanye vāhanatāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: In order to achieve their eradication and prevention, Lalita, the great goddess, discharged the great missile ofthe great Mantra ofthe three names (of Lord Visnu).
verses.wordMeaning: In order to achieve their eradication and prevention, Lalita, the great goddess, discharged the great missile ofthe great Mantra ofthe three names (of Lord Visnu).
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to achieve their eradication and prevention, Lalita, the great goddess, discharged the great missile ofthe great Mantra ofthe three names (of Lord Visnu).

verses.sanskrit: मुहुरुच्चावचाः शक्तीर्भण्डासुरवधोद्यताः । योजनायामविस्तारमपि तद्द्वारमण्डलम् । वह्निप्राकारचक्रस्य न पर्याप्तं चमूपतेः
verses.transliteration: muhuruccāvacāḥ śaktīrbhaṇḍāsuravadhodyatāḥ / yojanāyāmavistāramapi taddvāramaṇḍalam / vahniprākāracakrasya na paryāptaṃ camūpateḥ
verses.translation: Acyuta, Ananta and Govinda rose up from the
verses.wordMeaning: Acyuta, Ananta and Govinda rose up from the
verses.commentary: Sense: Acyuta, Ananta and Govinda rose up from the

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालिनिका नित्या द्वारस्यात्यन्तविस्तृतिम् । विततान समस्तानां सैन्यानां निर्गमैषिणी
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālinikā nityā dvārasyātyantavistṛtim / vitatāna samastānāṃ sainyānāṃ nirgamaiṣiṇī
verses.translation: They bowed down to MahesanT. They were
verses.wordMeaning: They bowed down to MahesanT. They were
verses.commentary: Sense: They bowed down to MahesanT. They were

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा जगतां माता महाराज्ञी महोदया । निर्जगामा ग्निपुरता वरद्वारात्प्रतापिनी
verses.transliteration: atha sā jagatāṃ mātā mahārājñī mahodayā / nirjagāmā gnipuratā varadvārātpratāpinī
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पतिताः पुष्पवृष्टयः । महामुक्तातपत्रं तद्दिवि दीप्तमदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo neduḥ patitāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ / mahāmuktātapatraṃ taddivi dīptamadṛśyata
verses.translation: Thereupon arose a glorious deity named Durga. She had a cosmic form evolved by the refulgence of all Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon arose a glorious deity named Durga. She had a cosmic form evolved by the refulgence of all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon arose a glorious deity named Durga. She had a cosmic form evolved by the refulgence of all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: निमित्तानि प्रसन्नानि शंसकानि जयश्रियाः । अभवंल्ललितासैन्ये उत्पातास्तु द्विषां बले
verses.transliteration: nimittāni prasannāni śaṃsakāni jayaśriyāḥ / abhavaṃllalitāsainye utpātāstu dviṣāṃ bale
verses.translation: The wicked Danava discharged the missile Mukdstra (that of dumbness) among the armies of Saktis. The mother of the universe discharged the missile named Mahdvdgvadini (the great and eloquent one).
verses.wordMeaning: The wicked Danava discharged the missile Mukdstra (that of dumbness) among the armies of Saktis. The mother of the universe discharged the missile named Mahdvdgvadini (the great and eloquent one).
verses.commentary: Sense: The wicked Danava discharged the missile Mukdstra (that of dumbness) among the armies of Saktis. The mother of the universe discharged the missile named Mahdvdgvadini (the great and eloquent one).

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं सेन योरुभयोरपि । प्रसर्पद्विशिखैः स्तोमबद्धान्धतमसच्छटम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ sena yorubhayorapi / prasarpadviśikhaiḥ stomabaddhāndhatamasacchaṭam
verses.translation: ' In the course of battle the haughty and ferocious
verses.wordMeaning: ' In the course of battle the haughty and ferocious
verses.commentary: Sense: ' In the course of battle the haughty and ferocious

verses.sanskrit: हन्यमानगजस्तोमसृतशोणितबिन्दुभिः । ह्नीयमाणशिरश्छन्नदैत्यश्वेतातपत्रकम्
verses.transliteration: hanyamānagajastomasṛtaśoṇitabindubhiḥ / hnīyamāṇaśiraśchannadaityaśvetātapatrakam
verses.translation: From V. 90 onwards Bhanda used an Astra for counteracting which God Visnu had to incarnate. Here the Nine Aoataras of Visnu as we know them today are given and not the ones in the body of the Bd. P. (such as Dattatreya etc).
verses.wordMeaning: From V. 90 onwards Bhanda used an Astra for counteracting which God Visnu had to incarnate. Here the Nine Aoataras of Visnu as we know them today are given and not the ones in the body of the Bd. P. (such as Dattatreya etc).
verses.commentary: Sense: From V. 90 onwards Bhanda used an Astra for counteracting which God Visnu had to incarnate. Here the Nine Aoataras of Visnu as we know them today are given and not the ones in the body of the Bd. P. (such as Dattatreya etc).

verses.sanskrit: न दिशो न नभो नागा न भूमिर्न च किञ्चन । दृश्यते केवलं दृष्टं रजोमात्रं च सूर्च्छितम्
verses.transliteration: na diśo na nabho nāgā na bhūmirna ca kiñcana / dṛśyate kevalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ rajomātraṃ ca sūrcchitam
verses.translation: The Saktis who were supported by him by means of that huge skull-like shell of large area became delighted. They discarded their fear ofthe Sagara (sea) missile.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were supported by him by means of that huge skull-like shell of large area became delighted. They discarded their fear ofthe Sagara (sea) missile.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were supported by him by means of that huge skull-like shell of large area became delighted. They discarded their fear ofthe Sagara (sea) missile.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यत्कबन्धनिवहाविर्भूततटपादपम् । दैत्यकेशसहस्रैस्तु शैवालाङ्कुरकोमला
verses.transliteration: nṛtyatkabandhanivahāvirbhūtataṭapādapam / daityakeśasahasraistu śaivālāṅkurakomalā
verses.translation: Arnavdstra

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतातपत्रयवलयश्वेतपङ्कजभासुरा । चक्रकृत्तकरिग्रामपादकूर्मपरंपरा
verses.transliteration: śvetātapatrayavalayaśvetapaṅkajabhāsurā / cakrakṛttakarigrāmapādakūrmaparaṃparā
verses.translation: Hiranyaksa

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिध्वस्तमहादैत्यगलगण्डशिलोच्चया । विलूनकाण्डैः पतितैः सफेना बलचामरैः
verses.transliteration: śaktidhvastamahādaityagalagaṇḍaśiloccayā / vilūnakāṇḍaiḥ patitaiḥ saphenā balacāmaraiḥ
verses.translation: Hiranyakasipu
verses.wordMeaning: Hiranyakasipu
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyakasipu

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णासिवल्लरीजालैर्निबिडीकृततीरभूः । दैत्यवीरेक्षमश्रेणिमुक्तिंसपुटभासुरा
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇāsivallarījālairnibiḍīkṛtatīrabhūḥ / daityavīrekṣamaśreṇimuktiṃsapuṭabhāsurā
verses.translation: Ballndra (Bali)
verses.wordMeaning: Ballndra (Bali)
verses.commentary: Sense: Ballndra (Bali)

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यवाहनसंघातन क्रमीनशताकुला । प्रावहच्छोणितनदी सेनयोर्युध्यमानयोः
verses.transliteration: daityavāhanasaṃghātana kramīnaśatākulā / prāvahacchoṇitanadī senayoryudhyamānayoḥ
verses.translation: Sahasrarjuna
verses.wordMeaning: Sahasrarjuna
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahasrarjuna

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं प्रववृते युद्धं मृत्योश्च त्रासदायकम् । चतुर्थयुद्धदिवसे प्रातरा रभ्यभीषणम् । प्रहरद्वयपर्यन्तं सेनयोरुभयोरपि
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ mṛtyośca trāsadāyakam / caturthayuddhadivase prātarā rabhyabhīṣaṇam / praharadvayaparyantaṃ senayorubhayorapi
verses.translation: Paulastya (Havana)
verses.wordMeaning: Paulastya (Havana)
verses.commentary: Sense: Paulastya (Havana)

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्रीललितादेव्या भण्डस्याथाभवद्रणः । अस्त्रप्रत्यस्त्रसंक्षोभैस्तुमुलीकृतदिक्तटः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śrīlalitādevyā bhaṇḍasyāthābhavadraṇaḥ / astrapratyastrasaṃkṣobhaistumulīkṛtadiktaṭaḥ
verses.translation: Rajasura (A great number of demons were born as kings
verses.wordMeaning: Rajasura (A great number of demons were born as kings
verses.commentary: Sense: Rajasura (A great number of demons were born as kings

verses.sanskrit: धनुर्ज्यातलटङ्कारहुङ्कारैरतिभीषणः । तूणीरवदनात्कृष्टधनुर्वरविनिः सृतैः । विमुक्तैर्विशिशैर्भीमैराहवे प्राणहारिभिः
verses.transliteration: dhanurjyātalaṭaṅkārahuṅkārairatibhīṣaṇaḥ / tūṇīravadanātkṛṣṭadhanurvaraviniḥ sṛtaiḥ / vimuktairviśiśairbhīmairāhave prāṇahāribhiḥ
verses.translation: Kali missile (Buddha is not mentioned here)
verses.wordMeaning: Kali missile (Buddha is not mentioned here)
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali missile (Buddha is not mentioned here)

verses.sanskrit: हस्तलाघववेगेन न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन । महाराज्ञीकरांभोजव्यापारं शरमोक्षणे । शृणु सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि कुम्भसंभव सङ्गरे
verses.transliteration: hastalāghavavegena na prājñāyata kiñcana / mahārājñīkarāṃbhojavyāpāraṃ śaramokṣaṇe / śṛṇu sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi kumbhasaṃbhava saṅgare
verses.translation: The lord then quaffed the entire quantity of water in the ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord then quaffed the entire quantity of water in the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord then quaffed the entire quantity of water in the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: संधाने त्वेकधा तस्य दशधा चापनिर्गमे । शतधा गगने दैत्यसैन्यप्राप्तौ सहस्रधा । दैत्याङ्गसंगे संप्राप्ताः कोटिसंख्याः शिलीमुखाः
verses.transliteration: saṃdhāne tvekadhā tasya daśadhā cāpanirgame / śatadhā gagane daityasainyaprāptau sahasradhā / daityāṅgasaṃge saṃprāptāḥ koṭisaṃkhyāḥ śilīmukhāḥ
verses.translation: Crores and crores of those Hiranyaksas were utterly annihilated when they were smashed and crushed as well as torn asunder by that snouted Boar as hard as adamant.
verses.wordMeaning: Crores and crores of those Hiranyaksas were utterly annihilated when they were smashed and crushed as well as torn asunder by that snouted Boar as hard as adamant.
verses.commentary: Sense: Crores and crores of those Hiranyaksas were utterly annihilated when they were smashed and crushed as well as torn asunder by that snouted Boar as hard as adamant.

verses.sanskrit: परान्धकारं सृजती भिन्दती रोदसी शरैः । मर्माभिनत्प्रचण्डस्य महाराज्ञी महेषुभिः
verses.transliteration: parāndhakāraṃ sṛjatī bhindatī rodasī śaraiḥ / marmābhinatpracaṇḍasya mahārājñī maheṣubhiḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the great Asura, thendischarged against the goddess Lalita the extremely dreadful missile Ballndra that was destructive of all deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the great Asura, thendischarged against the goddess Lalita the extremely dreadful missile Ballndra that was destructive of all deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the great Asura, thendischarged against the goddess Lalita the extremely dreadful missile Ballndra that was destructive of all deities.

verses.sanskrit: वहत्कोपारुणं नेत्रं ततो भण्डः स दानवः । ववष शरजालेन महता ललितेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: vahatkopāruṇaṃ netraṃ tato bhaṇḍaḥ sa dānavaḥ / vavaṣa śarajālena mahatā laliteśvarīm
verses.translation: For destroying the pride of that missile, hundreds of Vamanas came out from the highly powerful tip of the
verses.wordMeaning: For destroying the pride of that missile, hundreds of Vamanas came out from the highly powerful tip of the
verses.commentary: Sense: For destroying the pride of that missile, hundreds of Vamanas came out from the highly powerful tip of the

verses.sanskrit: अन्धतामिस्रकं नाम महास्त्रं प्रमुमोच सः । महातरणिबाणेन तन्नुनोद महेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: andhatāmisrakaṃ nāma mahāstraṃ pramumoca saḥ / mahātaraṇibāṇena tannunoda maheśvarī
verses.translation: In the course of battle, Bhanda, the Daitya, discharged Haihaya missile. From that were born thousands and crores of Arjunas with thousand hands.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of battle, Bhanda, the Daitya, discharged Haihaya missile. From that were born thousands and crores of Arjunas with thousand hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of battle, Bhanda, the Daitya, discharged Haihaya missile. From that were born thousands and crores of Arjunas with thousand hands.

verses.sanskrit: पाखण्डास्त्रं महावीरो भण्डः प्रमुमुचे रणे । गायत्र्यस्त्रं तस्य नुत्यै ससर्ज जगदंबिका
verses.transliteration: pākhaṇḍāstraṃ mahāvīro bhaṇḍaḥ pramumuce raṇe / gāyatryastraṃ tasya nutyai sasarja jagadaṃbikā
verses.translation: When they were destroyed, Asura Bhanda became highly furious. He discharged the dreadful Kali missile that caused violation and transgression of virtue.
verses.wordMeaning: When they were destroyed, Asura Bhanda became highly furious. He discharged the dreadful Kali missile that caused violation and transgression of virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were destroyed, Asura Bhanda became highly furious. He discharged the dreadful Kali missile that caused violation and transgression of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धास्त्रमसृजद्भण्डः शक्तिदृष्टिविनाशनम् । चाक्षुष्मतमहास्त्रेण शमयायास तत्प्रसूः
verses.transliteration: andhāstramasṛjadbhaṇḍaḥ śaktidṛṣṭivināśanam / cākṣuṣmatamahāstreṇa śamayāyāsa tatprasūḥ
verses.translation: When all the miraculous missiles were thus destroyed, the evil-minded (Asuras) discharged the missile of Mahamoha (great delusion and fainting). The Saktis. swooned on account of that.
verses.wordMeaning: When all the miraculous missiles were thus destroyed, the evil-minded (Asuras) discharged the missile of Mahamoha (great delusion and fainting). The Saktis. swooned on account of that.
verses.commentary: Sense: When all the miraculous missiles were thus destroyed, the evil-minded (Asuras) discharged the missile of Mahamoha (great delusion and fainting). The Saktis. swooned on account of that.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिनाशाभिधं भण्डो मुमोचास्त्रं महारणे । विश्वावसोरथास्त्रेण तस्य दर्पमपाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: śaktināśābhidhaṃ bhaṇḍo mumocāstraṃ mahāraṇe / viśvāvasorathāstreṇa tasya darpamapākarot
verses.translation: By discharging the Sambhava missile (that of Lord (Siva) the mother split up the Mahamoha missile. As the great battle took place thus with the continuous flow of missiles and counter missiles the sun, the lord of rays was about to reach the western mountain (the mountain ofsetting).
verses.wordMeaning: By discharging the Sambhava missile (that of Lord (Siva) the mother split up the Mahamoha missile. As the great battle took place thus with the continuous flow of missiles and counter missiles the sun,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By discharging the Sambhava missile (that of Lord (Siva) the mother split up the Mahamoha missile. As the great battle took place thus with the continuous flow of missiles and counter missiles the sun,…

verses.sanskrit: अन्तकास्त्रं ससर्जोच्चैः संक्रुद्धो भडदानवः । महामृत्युञ्जयास्त्रेण नाशयामास तद्बलम्
verses.transliteration: antakāstraṃ sasarjoccaiḥ saṃkruddho bhaḍadānavaḥ / mahāmṛtyuñjayāstreṇa nāśayāmāsa tadbalam
verses.translation: Then by means ofNarayana missile the goddess Lalitambika reduced all Aksauhinls to ashes, in the course of the battle.
verses.wordMeaning: Then by means ofNarayana missile the goddess Lalitambika reduced all Aksauhinls to ashes, in the course of the battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then by means ofNarayana missile the goddess Lalitambika reduced all Aksauhinls to ashes, in the course of the battle.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वास्त्रस्मृतिनाशाख्यमस्त्रं भण्डो व्यमुञ्चत । धारणास्त्रेण चक्रेशी तद्बलं समनाशयत्
verses.transliteration: sarvāstrasmṛtināśākhyamastraṃ bhaṇḍo vyamuñcata / dhāraṇāstreṇa cakreśī tadbalaṃ samanāśayat
verses.translation: Then by the Pasupata missile which had the lustre of the enkindled fire of Destruction ofthe world the great queen smashed and crushed forty generals.
verses.wordMeaning: Then by the Pasupata missile which had the lustre of the enkindled fire of Destruction ofthe world the great queen smashed and crushed forty generals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then by the Pasupata missile which had the lustre of the enkindled fire of Destruction ofthe world the great queen smashed and crushed forty generals.

verses.sanskrit: भयास्त्रमसृजद्भण्डः शक्तीनां भीतिदायकम् । अभयङ्करमैन्द्रास्त्रं मुमुचे जगदंबिका
verses.transliteration: bhayāstramasṛjadbhaṇḍaḥ śaktīnāṃ bhītidāyakam / abhayaṅkaramaindrāstraṃ mumuce jagadaṃbikā
verses.translation: After carrying out this task ofthe Devas, Kamesvari whose conduct was never blame-worthy, who was the orna-
verses.wordMeaning: After carrying out this task ofthe Devas, Kamesvari whose conduct was never blame-worthy, who was the orna-
verses.commentary: Sense: After carrying out this task ofthe Devas, Kamesvari whose conduct was never blame-worthy, who was the orna-

verses.sanskrit: महारोगास्त्रमसृजच्छक्तिसेनासु दानवः । राजयक्ष्मादयो रोगास्ततो ऽभूवन्सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: mahārogāstramasṛjacchaktisenāsu dānavaḥ / rājayakṣmādayo rogāstato 'bhūvansahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: All her soldiers had been subjected to fatigue on account of their work in the battle-field (viz. fighting). They had been burned by the fire of powerful arrows of Bhanda, the Asura. When the sun set, Sri Devata whose prowess was well-renowned brought them to her camp.
verses.wordMeaning: All her soldiers had been subjected to fatigue on account of their work in the battle-field (viz. fighting). They had been burned by the fire of powerful arrows of Bhanda, the Asura. When the sun set, Sri Devata whose prowess was well-renowned brought them to her camp.
verses.commentary: Sense: All her soldiers had been subjected to fatigue on account of their work in the battle-field (viz. fighting). They had been burned by the fire of powerful arrows of Bhanda, the Asura. When the sun set, Sri Devata whose prowess was well-renowned brought them to her camp.

verses.sanskrit: तन्निवारणसिद्ध्यर्थं ललिता परमेश्वरी । नामत्रयमहामन्त्रमहास्त्रं सा मुमोच ह
verses.transliteration: tannivāraṇasiddhyarthaṃ lalitā parameśvarī / nāmatrayamahāmantramahāstraṃ sā mumoca ha
verses.translation: O leading ascetic, if anyone reads even once (the narrative) of the slaying of Bhanda, the Danava, carried out thus by Lalitamba, all his sorrows will be destroyed. He will be master of all eight Siddhis. Both worldly enjoyment and salvation are within his reach.
verses.wordMeaning: O leading ascetic, if anyone reads even once (the narrative) of the slaying of Bhanda, the Danava, carried out thus by Lalitamba, all his sorrows will be destroyed. He will be master of all eight Siddhis. Both worldly enjoyment and salvation are within his reach.

verses.sanskrit: अच्युतश्चाप्यनन्तश्च गोविन्दस्तु शरोत्थिताः । हुङ्कारमात्रतो दग्ध्वारोगांस्ताननयन्मुदम्
verses.transliteration: acyutaścāpyanantaśca govindastu śarotthitāḥ / huṅkāramātrato dagdhvārogāṃstānanayanmudam
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.wordMeaning: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा च तां महेशानीं तद्भक्तव्याधिमर्दनम् । विधातुं त्रिषु लोकेषु नियुक्ताः स्वपदं ययुः
verses.transliteration: natvā ca tāṃ maheśānīṃ tadbhaktavyādhimardanam / vidhātuṃ triṣu lokeṣu niyuktāḥ svapadaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.wordMeaning: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्नाशनमस्त्रं तु मुक्तवान्भण्डदानवः । कालसंकर्षणीरूपमस्त्रं राज्ञी व्यमुञ्चत
verses.transliteration: āyurnāśanamastraṃ tu muktavānbhaṇḍadānavaḥ / kālasaṃkarṣaṇīrūpamastraṃ rājñī vyamuñcata
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.wordMeaning: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: महासुरास्त्रमुद्दामं व्यसृजद्भण्डदानवः । ततः सहस्रशो जाता महाकाया महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: mahāsurāstramuddāmaṃ vyasṛjadbhaṇḍadānavaḥ / tataḥ sahasraśo jātā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: मधुश्च कैटभश्चैव महिषासुर एव च । धूम्रलोचनदैत्यश्च चण्डमुण्डादयो ऽसुराः
verses.transliteration: madhuśca kaiṭabhaścaiva mahiṣāsura eva ca / dhūmralocanadaityaśca caṇḍamuṇḍādayo 'surāḥ
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षुभश्चामरश्चैव रक्तबीजो ऽसुरस्तथा । शुम्भश्चैव निशुम्भश्च कालकेया महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: cikṣubhaścāmaraścaiva raktabījo 'surastathā / śumbhaścaiva niśumbhaśca kālakeyā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.transliteration: dhūmrābhidhānāśca pare tasmādastrātsamutthitāḥ / te sarve dānavaśreṣṭhāḥ kaṭhoraiḥ śastramaṇḍalaiḥ
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.commentary: Sense: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डपुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने भण्डासुरवधो नामैकोनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ श्रुतमाख्यानमुत्तमम् । विक्रमो ललितादेव्या विशिष्टो वर्णितस्त्वया
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne bhaṇḍāsuravadho nāmaikonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca aśvānana mahāprājña śrutamākhyānamuttamam / vikramo lalitādevyā viśiṣṭo varṇitastvayā
verses.translation: O Hayagrlva, O highly intelligent one, the excellent narrative has been heard. The excellant valour of goddess Lai it a has been described by you.
verses.wordMeaning: O Hayagrlva, O highly intelligent one, the excellent narrative has been heard. The excellant valour of goddess Lai it a has been described by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Hayagrlva, O highly intelligent one, the excellent narrative has been heard. The excellant valour of goddess Lai it a has been described by you.

verses.sanskrit: चरितैरनघैर्देव्याः सुप्रीतो ऽस्मि हयानन । श्रुता सा महतीशक्तिर्मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः
verses.transliteration: caritairanaghairdevyāḥ suprīto 'smi hayānana / śrutā sā mahatīśaktirmantriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ
verses.translation: On account of flawless and meritorious anecdotes of the goddess, I have become extremely delighted, O Haya- griva, The great power of MantrinI and Dandanatha also has been heard.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of flawless and meritorious anecdotes of the goddess, I have become extremely delighted, O Haya- griva, The great power of MantrinI and Dandanatha also has been heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of flawless and meritorious anecdotes of the goddess, I have become extremely delighted, O Haya- griva, The great power of MantrinI and Dandanatha also has been heard.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात्किमकरोत्तत्र युद्धानन्तरमंबिका । चतुर्थदिनशर्वर्यां विभातायां हयानन
verses.transliteration: paścātkimakarottatra yuddhānantaramaṃbikā / caturthadinaśarvaryāṃ vibhātāyāṃ hayānana
verses.translation: After the night of the fourth day of the battle had dawned, O Hayagriva, what did Ambika do after the battle was over?
verses.wordMeaning: After the night of the fourth day of the battle had dawned, O Hayagriva, what did Ambika do after the battle was over?
verses.commentary: Sense: After the night of the fourth day of the battle had dawned, O Hayagriva, what did Ambika do after the battle was over?

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच शृणु कुम्भज तत्प्राज्ञ यत्तया जगदंबया । पश्चादाचरितं कर्म निहते भण्डदानवे
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca śṛṇu kumbhaja tatprājña yattayā jagadaṃbayā / paścādācaritaṃ karma nihate bhaṇḍadānave
verses.translation: Listen, O Pot-born Sage, O intelligent one, to what had been done by Jagadamba after Danava. Bhanda, had been killed.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O Pot-born Sage, O intelligent one, to what had been done by Jagadamba after Danava. Bhanda, had been killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O Pot-born Sage, O intelligent one, to what had been done by Jagadamba after Danava. Bhanda, had been killed.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तीनामखिलं सैन्यं दैत्ययुधशतार्दितम् । मुहुराह्लादयामास लोचनैरमृताप्लुतैः
verses.transliteration: śaktīnāmakhilaṃ sainyaṃ daityayudhaśatārditam / muhurāhlādayāmāsa locanairamṛtāplutaiḥ
verses.translation: With her eyes immersed in nectar (as it were), she repeatedly delighted the entire army of Saktis harassed and bruised by hundreds of weapons ofDaityas.
verses.wordMeaning: With her eyes immersed in nectar (as it were), she repeatedly delighted the entire army of Saktis harassed and bruised by hundreds of weapons ofDaityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her eyes immersed in nectar (as it were), she repeatedly delighted the entire army of Saktis harassed and bruised by hundreds of weapons ofDaityas.

verses.sanskrit: ललितापरमेशान्याः कटाक्षामृतधारया । जहुर्युद्धपरिश्रान्तिं शक्तयः प्रीतिमानसाः
verses.transliteration: lalitāparameśānyāḥ kaṭākṣāmṛtadhārayā / jahuryuddhapariśrāntiṃ śaktayaḥ prītimānasāḥ
verses.translation: By the current of nectarine glances of the supreme goddess Lalita, saktis got rid of their fatigue due to her war. They became delighted in their minds.
verses.wordMeaning: By the current of nectarine glances of the supreme goddess Lalita, saktis got rid of their fatigue due to her war. They became delighted in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the current of nectarine glances of the supreme goddess Lalita, saktis got rid of their fatigue due to her war. They became delighted in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नवसरे देवा भण्डमर्दनतोषिताः । सर्वे ऽपि सेवितुं प्राप्ता ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: asminnavasare devā bhaṇḍamardanatoṣitāḥ / sarve 'pi sevituṃ prāptā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, Devas with Brahma and Visnu as their leaders, became gratified due to the smashing ofBhanda and they approached the goddess to serve her.
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, Devas with Brahma and Visnu as their leaders, became gratified due to the smashing ofBhanda and they approached the goddess to serve her.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, Devas with Brahma and Visnu as their leaders, became gratified due to the smashing ofBhanda and they approached the goddess to serve her.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च शक्राद्यास्त्रिदशास्तथा । आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतः साध्यदेवताः
verses.transliteration: brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śakrādyāstridaśāstathā / ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaḥ sādhyadevatāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to you, O supreme lady of
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to you, O supreme lady of
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to you, O supreme lady of

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धाः किंपुरुषा यक्षा निरृत्याद्या निशाचराः । प्रह्लादाद्या महादैत्याः सर्वे ऽप्यण्डनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: siddhāḥ kiṃpuruṣā yakṣā nirṛtyādyā niśācarāḥ / prahlādādyā mahādaityāḥ sarve 'pyaṇḍanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O Cintamani (wish-yielding jewel), O goddess
verses.wordMeaning: O Cintamani (wish-yielding jewel), O goddess
verses.commentary: Sense: O Cintamani (wish-yielding jewel), O goddess

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य तुष्टुवुः प्रीत्या सिंहासनमहेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: āgatya tuṣṭuvuḥ prītyā siṃhāsanamaheśvarīm
verses.translation: Devas have come in deputation to plead Rati's case. As usual Lalita must be propitiated by singing a string of her epithets — a glowing tribute to her. Hence her epithets in VV. 11-30.
verses.wordMeaning: Devas have come in deputation to plead Rati's case. As usual Lalita must be propitiated by singing a string of her epithets — a glowing tribute to her. Hence her epithets in VV. 11-30.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas have come in deputation to plead Rati's case. As usual Lalita must be propitiated by singing a string of her epithets — a glowing tribute to her. Hence her epithets in VV. 11-30.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माद्या ऊचुः नमोनमस्ते जगदेकनाथे नमोनमः श्रीत्रिपुराभिधाने । नमोनमो भण्डमहासुरघ्ने नमो ऽस्तु कामेश्वरि वामकेशि
verses.transliteration: brahmādyā ūcuḥ namonamaste jagadekanāthe namonamaḥ śrītripurābhidhāne / namonamo bhaṇḍamahāsuraghne namo 'stu kāmeśvari vāmakeśi
verses.translation: O bestower of salvation, O deity with the crescent moon as crest-jewel, O deity of sweet smiles, O lady discussing administrative policies with MudresvarT, O deity fond of Mudras (mystical gestures), O deity, obeisance, obeisance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O bestower of salvation, O deity with the crescent moon as crest-jewel, O deity of sweet smiles, O lady discussing administrative policies with MudresvarT, O deity fond of Mudras (mystical gestures), O deity, obeisance, obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O bestower of salvation, O deity with the crescent moon as crest-jewel, O deity of sweet smiles, O lady discussing administrative policies with MudresvarT, O deity fond of Mudras (mystical gestures), O deity, obeisance, obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणे चिन्तितदानदक्षे ऽचिन्तये चिराकारतरङ्गमाले । चित्राम्बरे चित्रजगत्प्रसूते चित्राख्यनित्ये सुखदे नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇe cintitadānadakṣe 'cintaye cirākārataraṅgamāle / citrāmbare citrajagatprasūte citrākhyanitye sukhade namaste
verses.translation: O destroyer of the cruel god of death, O lady with tender body, O lady taking up the body of Kali while in fury, O deity with the face of a Boar, O deity who has protected all troops and armies, O deity clasping to your own bosom the fear ofall (i.e. one who dispels their fears), obeisance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O destroyer of the cruel god of death, O lady with tender body, O lady taking up the body of Kali while in fury, O deity with the face of a Boar, O deity who has protected all troops and armies, O deity clasping to your own bosom the fear ofall (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षप्रदे मुग्धशशाङ्कचूडे मुग्धस्मिते मोहनभेददक्षे । मुद्रेश्वरीचर्चितराजतन्त्रे मुद्राप्रिये देवि नमोनमस्ते
verses.transliteration: mokṣaprade mugdhaśaśāṅkacūḍe mugdhasmite mohanabhedadakṣe / mudreśvarīcarcitarājatantre mudrāpriye devi namonamaste
verses.translation: O dark-complexioned deity with six attendant deities, O goddess worthy of being sought by the words of Vedas along with their six ancillary subjects, O deity stationed in the six mystical cakras in the body, equipped with Sadurmis (viz.: Soka (grief), Moha (delusion), Sara (old age), Mrtyu (death), Ksut (hunger) and Pipasa (thirst) or six plaits in the tresses,
verses.wordMeaning: O dark-complexioned deity with six attendant deities, O goddess worthy of being sought by the words of Vedas along with their six ancillary subjects, O deity stationed in the six mystical cakras in the body, equipped with Sadurmis (viz.: Soka (grief), Moha (delusion),…
