verses.sanskrit: क्रूरान्तकध्वंसिनि कोमलाङ्गे कोपेषु कालीं तनुमादधाने । क्रोडानने पालितसैन्यचक्रे क्रोडीकृताशेषभये नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: krūrāntakadhvaṃsini komalāṅge kopeṣu kālīṃ tanumādadhāne / kroḍānane pālitasainyacakre kroḍīkṛtāśeṣabhaye namaste
verses.translation: O deity first one among divine penances, O deity having forms ofgroups of cities, O divine being, O deity as lustrous as a thousand suns, O refulgent one, O deity endued with sympathy, O consort of the overlord of Devas, obeisance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity first one among divine penances, O deity having forms ofgroups of cities, O divine being, O deity as lustrous as a thousand suns, O refulgent one, O deity endued with sympathy, O consort of the overlord of Devas, obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity first one among divine penances, O deity having forms ofgroups of cities, O divine being, O deity as lustrous as a thousand suns, O refulgent one, O deity endued with sympathy, O consort of the overlord of Devas, obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: षडङ्गदेवीपरिवारकृष्णे षडङ्गयुक्तश्रुतिवाक्यमृग्ये । षट्चक्रसंस्थे च षडूर्मियुक्ते षड्भावरूपे ललिते नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaṅgadevīparivārakṛṣṇe ṣaḍaṅgayuktaśrutivākyamṛgye / ṣaṭcakrasaṃsthe ca ṣaḍūrmiyukte ṣaḍbhāvarūpe lalite namaste
verses.translation: O deity worthy of being always served by the eight Siddhis beginning with Anima (Minuteness), O deity residing in Sadasiva's own shining conch, O cultured one, O deity with
verses.wordMeaning: O deity worthy of being always served by the eight Siddhis beginning with Anima (Minuteness), O deity residing in Sadasiva's own shining conch, O cultured one, O deity with
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity worthy of being always served by the eight Siddhis beginning with Anima (Minuteness), O deity residing in Sadasiva's own shining conch, O cultured one, O deity with

verses.sanskrit: कामे शिवे मुख्यसमस्तनित्ये कान्तासनान्ते कमलायताक्षि । कामप्रदे कामिनि कामशंभोः काम्ये कलानामधिपे नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: kāme śive mukhyasamastanitye kāntāsanānte kamalāyatākṣi / kāmaprade kāmini kāmaśaṃbhoḥ kāmye kalānāmadhipe namaste
verses.translation: O deity worthy of being served by the Matrs (Mothers) the chief among whom is Brahml, O deity beloved of Brahman, O deity who severs the (worldly) bondage of one who has realised Brahman, O royal Swan (swimming) in. the nectarine current of Brahman, O goddess of Brahma, O SrTlalita, bow to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity worthy of being served by the Matrs (Mothers) the chief among whom is Brahml, O deity beloved of Brahman, O deity who severs the (worldly) bondage of one who has realised Brahman, O royal Swan (swimming) in. the nectarine current of Brahman, O goddess of Brahma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity worthy of being served by the Matrs (Mothers) the chief among whom is Brahml, O deity beloved of Brahman, O deity who severs the (worldly) bondage of one who has realised Brahman, O royal Swan (swimming) in. the nectarine current of Brahman, O goddess of Brahma,…

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यौषधाद्ये नगरौघरूपे दिव्ये दिनाधीशसहस्रकान्ते । देदीप्यमाने दयया सनाथे देवाधिदेवप्रमदे नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: divyauṣadhādye nagaraugharūpe divye dinādhīśasahasrakānte / dedīpyamāne dayayā sanāthe devādhidevapramade namaste
verses.translation: O deity served by the Mudrds (Mystical gestures by means of fingers) the chief of them being SamksobhinI, O destroyer of worldly existence, O deity having features of worldly sports, O deity with eyes resembling lotuses, perpetual obeisance to you, O Lalita, O presiding deity, O eternal one, O deity attracting her lord through the sixteen digits, O presid- ing deity worthy of being served by the Pramathas.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity served by the Mudrds (Mystical gestures by means of fingers) the chief of them being SamksobhinI, O destroyer of worldly existence, O deity having features of worldly sports, O deity with eyes resembling lotuses, perpetual obeisance to you, O Lalita, O presiding deity,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity served by the Mudrds (Mystical gestures by means of fingers) the chief of them being SamksobhinI, O destroyer of worldly existence, O deity having features of worldly sports, O deity with eyes resembling lotuses, perpetual obeisance to you, O Lalita, O presiding deity,…

verses.sanskrit: सदाणिमाद्यष्टकसेवनीये सदाशिवात्मोज्ज्वलमञ्चवासे । सभ्ये सदेकाल यपादपूज्ये सवित्रि लोकस्य नमोनमस्ते
verses.transliteration: sadāṇimādyaṣṭakasevanīye sadāśivātmojjvalamañcavāse / sabhye sadekāla yapādapūjye savitri lokasya namonamaste
verses.translation: O eternal one, O deity with merciful activities- devoid of fear, O lady with black forelocks of hairs, Obeisance, Obeisance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O eternal one, O deity with merciful activities- devoid of fear, O lady with black forelocks of hairs, Obeisance, Obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O eternal one, O deity with merciful activities- devoid of fear, O lady with black forelocks of hairs, Obeisance, Obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मीमुखैर्मातृगणैर्निषेव्ये ब्रह्मप्रिये ब्राह्मणबन्धमेत्रि । ब्रह्मामृतस्रोतसि राजहंसिब्रह्मेश्वरि श्रीललिते नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: brāhmīmukhairmātṛgaṇairniṣevye brahmapriye brāhmaṇabandhametri / brahmāmṛtasrotasi rājahaṃsibrahmeśvari śrīlalite namaste
verses.translation: O deity with extremely illuminated form of great mobility, surrounded by fourteen series of flames, the chief of whom being SamksobhinI. O deity possessed of your own spirit, O deity endowed with graceful beauty, O deity the resort of everything splendid, O deity with auspicious feet, Obeisance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity with extremely illuminated form of great mobility, surrounded by fourteen series of flames, the chief of whom being SamksobhinI. O deity possessed of your own spirit, O deity endowed with graceful beauty, O deity the resort of everything splendid,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity with extremely illuminated form of great mobility, surrounded by fourteen series of flames, the chief of whom being SamksobhinI. O deity possessed of your own spirit, O deity endowed with graceful beauty, O deity the resort of everything splendid,…

verses.sanskrit: संक्षोभिणीमुख्यसमस्तमुद्रासंसेविते संसरणप्रहन्त्रि । संसारलीलाकृतिसारसाक्षि सदा नमस्ते ललिते ऽधिनाथे । नित्ये कलाषोडशकेन नामाकर्षिण्यधीशि प्रमथेन सेव्ये
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyasamastamudrāsaṃsevite saṃsaraṇaprahantri / saṃsāralīlākṛtisārasākṣi sadā namaste lalite 'dhināthe / nitye kalāṣoḍaśakena nāmākarṣiṇyadhīśi pramathena sevye
verses.translation: O deity worthy of being saluted by Saktis, Siddhas and others including Sarva, O deity whose lotus-like feet have been comprehended by Sarvajna (Siva), O deity surpassing everything, O omnipresent deity, O bestower of all types of Siddhis (spiritual attainments), O srl Lalita, obeisance be to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity worthy of being saluted by Saktis, Siddhas and others including Sarva, O deity whose lotus-like feet have been comprehended by Sarvajna (Siva), O deity surpassing everything, O omnipresent deity, O bestower of all types of Siddhis (spiritual attainments), O srl Lalita,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity worthy of being saluted by Saktis, Siddhas and others including Sarva, O deity whose lotus-like feet have been comprehended by Sarvajna (Siva), O deity surpassing everything, O omnipresent deity, O bestower of all types of Siddhis (spiritual attainments), O srl Lalita,…

verses.sanskrit: नित्ये निरातङ्कदयाप्रपञ्चे नीलालकश्रेणि नमोनमस्ते । अनङ्गपुष्पादिभिरुन्नदाभिरनङ्गदेवीभिरजस्रसेव्ये । अभव्यहन्त्र्यक्षरराशिरूपे हतारिवर्गे ललिते नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: nitye nirātaṅkadayāprapañce nīlālakaśreṇi namonamaste / anaṅgapuṣpādibhirunnadābhiranaṅgadevībhirajasrasevye / abhavyahantryakṣararāśirūpe hatārivarge lalite namaste
verses.translation: salute you the deity with a number of super
verses.wordMeaning: salute you the deity with a number of super
verses.commentary: Sense: salute you the deity with a number of super

verses.sanskrit: संक्षोभिणीमुख्यचतुर्दशार्चिर्मालावृतोदारमहाप्रदीप्ते । आत्मानमाबिभ्रति विभ्रमाढ्ये शुभ्राश्रये शुभ्रपदे नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyacaturdaśārcirmālāvṛtodāramahāpradīpte / ātmānamābibhrati vibhramāḍhye śubhrāśraye śubhrapade namaste
verses.translation: O KamesI, O VajresI (goddess of thunderbolt), O BhagesI (goddess of exalted splendour), O deity without form, O virgin, O Kala, O deity powerful enough to wipe off even god of death, O deity who reduced the army of Daityas only as a legend (i.e. completely destroyed them); O Kamesa- kanta (beloved of KameSvara (Lord Siva), O Kamala, obeisance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O KamesI, O VajresI (goddess of thunderbolt), O BhagesI (goddess of exalted splendour), O deity without form, O virgin, O Kala, O deity powerful enough to wipe off even god of death, O deity who reduced the army of Daityas only as a legend (i.e. completely destroyed them);…
verses.commentary: Sense: O KamesI, O VajresI (goddess of thunderbolt), O BhagesI (goddess of exalted splendour), O deity without form, O virgin, O Kala, O deity powerful enough to wipe off even god of death, O deity who reduced the army of Daityas only as a legend (i.e. completely destroyed them);…

verses.sanskrit: सशर्वसिद्धादि कशक्तिवन्द्ये सर्वज्ञविज्ञातपदारविन्दे । सर्वाधिके सर्वगते समस्तसिद्धिप्रदे श्रीललिते नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: saśarvasiddhādi kaśaktivandye sarvajñavijñātapadāravinde / sarvādhike sarvagate samastasiddhiprade śrīlalite namaste
verses.translation: O deity stationed on Bindu (Mystical point in the mystical diagram); O deity having the soul form of the digit of the Bindu, O deity identical with Bindu, O deity that has increasingly cherished the illumination of Cit (consciousness). O deity with the necklace swinging to and fro on the big breasts resembling (the buds of) lotuses; O Lalita of growing prowess, obeisance to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity stationed on Bindu (Mystical point in the mystical diagram); O deity having the soul form of the digit of the Bindu, O deity identical with Bindu, O deity that has increasingly cherished the illumination of Cit (consciousness).…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity stationed on Bindu (Mystical point in the mystical diagram); O deity having the soul form of the digit of the Bindu, O deity identical with Bindu, O deity that has increasingly cherished the illumination of Cit (consciousness).…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञजातप्रथमाभिरन्यदेवी भिरप्याश्रितचक्रभूमे । सर्वामराकाङ्क्षितपूरयित्रि सर्वस्य लोकस्य सवित्रि पाहि
verses.transliteration: sarvajñajātaprathamābhiranyadevī bhirapyāśritacakrabhūme / sarvāmarākāṅkṣitapūrayitri sarvasya lokasya savitri pāhi
verses.translation: O deity with perpetual residence on the lap of Kamesvara, O deity identical with Kala (Time), O goddess taking pity on others; O deity with the form of Kali, that rises up at the close of Kalpa, O deity the bestower of desires, O deity identical with the wish-yielding creeper Kalpa- lata, salute to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O deity with perpetual residence on the lap of Kamesvara, O deity identical with Kala (Time), O goddess taking pity on others; O deity with the form of Kali, that rises up at the close of Kalpa, O deity the bestower of desires,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity with perpetual residence on the lap of Kamesvara, O deity identical with Kala (Time), O goddess taking pity on others; O deity with the form of Kali, that rises up at the close of Kalpa, O deity the bestower of desires,…

verses.sanskrit: वन्दे वशिन्यादिकवाग्विभूते वर्द्धिष्णुचक्र द्युतिवाहवाहे । बलाहकश्यामकचे वचो ऽब्धे वरप्रदे सुंदरि पाहि विश्वम्
verses.transliteration: vande vaśinyādikavāgvibhūte varddhiṣṇucakra dyutivāhavāhe / balāhakaśyāmakace vaco 'bdhe varaprade suṃdari pāhi viśvam
verses.translation: O deity accompanied by VarunI (Varuna's wife as attendant); O deity as cool as the moon with abundant necta- Tine rays, O deity having eyes like those of a fawn, O deity naving the face resembling the lotus, O deity the perpetual sole base of the essence of agreeable loveliness, O presiding
verses.wordMeaning: O deity accompanied by VarunI (Varuna's wife as attendant); O deity as cool as the moon with abundant necta- Tine rays, O deity having eyes like those of a fawn, O deity naving the face resembling the lotus,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity accompanied by VarunI (Varuna's wife as attendant); O deity as cool as the moon with abundant necta- Tine rays, O deity having eyes like those of a fawn, O deity naving the face resembling the lotus,…

verses.sanskrit: बाणादिदिव्यायुधसार्वभौमे भण्डासुरानीकवनान्तदावे । अत्युग्रतेजोज्ज्वलितांबुराशे प्रसेव्यमाने परितो नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: bāṇādidivyāyudhasārvabhaume bhaṇḍāsurānīkavanāntadāve / atyugratejojjvalitāṃburāśe prasevyamāne parito namaste
verses.translation: After assuming fresh forms and bodies. (or after making all our bodies fresh) by means of currents of abundant nectar of mercifulness, O beautiful deity worthy of being attained by cultured people *, the entire world has been resuscitated and rendered full of joy.
verses.wordMeaning: After assuming fresh forms and bodies. (or after making all our bodies fresh) by means of currents of abundant nectar of mercifulness, O beautiful deity worthy of being attained by cultured people *, the entire world has been resuscitated and rendered full of joy.
verses.commentary: Sense: After assuming fresh forms and bodies. (or after making all our bodies fresh) by means of currents of abundant nectar of mercifulness, O beautiful deity worthy of being attained by cultured people *, the entire world has been resuscitated and rendered full of joy.

verses.sanskrit: कामेशि वज्रेशि भगेश्यरूपे कन्ये कले कालविलोपदक्षे । कथाविशेषीकृतदैत्यसैन्ये कामेशयान्ते कमले नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: kāmeśi vajreśi bhageśyarūpe kanye kale kālavilopadakṣe / kathāviśeṣīkṛtadaityasainye kāmeśayānte kamale namaste
verses.translation: Thereafter, that evil-minded wicked fellow very haughty about his ability to fight in war, was killed by you. Now Kama has become Atanu (bodiless) for our sake. Hence you kindly do resuscitate Kama immediately.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, that evil-minded wicked fellow very haughty about his ability to fight in war, was killed by you. Now Kama has become Atanu (bodiless) for our sake. Hence you kindly do resuscitate Kama immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, that evil-minded wicked fellow very haughty about his ability to fight in war, was killed by you. Now Kama has become Atanu (bodiless) for our sake. Hence you kindly do resuscitate Kama immediately.

verses.sanskrit: बिन्दुस्थिते बिन्दुकलैकरूपे बिन्द्वात्मिके बृंहितचित्प्रकाशे । बृहत्कुचंभोजविलोलहारे बृहत्प्रभावे ललिते नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: bindusthite bindukalaikarūpe bindvātmike bṛṃhitacitprakāśe / bṛhatkucaṃbhojavilolahāre bṛhatprabhāve lalite namaste
verses.translation: As before, the moon-crested lord may become enchant- ed by the mindborn god of love united with her. Isa will ere
verses.wordMeaning: As before, the moon-crested lord may become enchant- ed by the mindborn god of love united with her. Isa will ere
verses.commentary: Sense: As before, the moon-crested lord may become enchant- ed by the mindborn god of love united with her. Isa will ere

verses.sanskrit: कामेश्वरोत्संगसदानिवासे कालात्मिके देवि कृतानुकंपे । कल्पावसानोत्थित कालिरूपे कामप्रदे कल्पलते नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: kāmeśvarotsaṃgasadānivāse kālātmike devi kṛtānukaṃpe / kalpāvasānotthita kālirūpe kāmaprade kalpalate namaste
verses.translation: By their union Kumara (Skanda), the leader of all the armies of Devas will be born. It is through that hero, alone that the king of demons named Taraka should be defeat- ed and driven away. 1
verses.wordMeaning: By their union Kumara (Skanda), the leader of all the armies of Devas will be born. It is through that hero, alone that the king of demons named Taraka should be defeat- ed and driven away. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: By their union Kumara (Skanda), the leader of all the armies of Devas will be born. It is through that hero, alone that the king of demons named Taraka should be defeat- ed and driven away. 1

verses.sanskrit: सवारुणे सांद्रसुधांशुशीते सारङ्गशावाक्षि सरोजवक्त्रे । सारस्य सारस्य सदैकभूमे समस्तविद्येश्वरि संनतिस्ते
verses.transliteration: savāruṇe sāṃdrasudhāṃśuśīte sāraṅgaśāvākṣi sarojavaktre / sārasya sārasya sadaikabhūme samastavidyeśvari saṃnatiste
verses.translation: O deity with the designation Tripura, this helpless widow whose body has become very emaciated on account of the death of her husband takes refuge in you and bows down to you. Hence, please directa digit of your compassionate glance towards her".
verses.wordMeaning: O deity with the designation Tripura, this helpless widow whose body has become very emaciated on account of the death of her husband takes refuge in you and bows down to you. Hence, please directa digit of your compassionate glance towards her".
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity with the designation Tripura, this helpless widow whose body has become very emaciated on account of the death of her husband takes refuge in you and bows down to you. Hence, please directa digit of your compassionate glance towards her".

verses.sanskrit: तव प्रभावेण चिदग्निजायां श्रीशंभुनाथप्रकडीकृतायाः । भण्डासुराद्याः समरे प्रचण्डा हता जगत्कण्टकतां प्रयाताः
verses.transliteration: tava prabhāveṇa cidagnijāyāṃ śrīśaṃbhunāthaprakaḍīkṛtāyāḥ / bhaṇḍāsurādyāḥ samare pracaṇḍā hatā jagatkaṇṭakatāṃ prayātāḥ
verses.translation: After eulogising MahesanI thus, the excellent Devas beginning with Brahma showed her Rati who had become untidy and emaciated on account ofgrief.
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising MahesanI thus, the excellent Devas beginning with Brahma showed her Rati who had become untidy and emaciated on account ofgrief.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising MahesanI thus, the excellent Devas beginning with Brahma showed her Rati who had become untidy and emaciated on account ofgrief.

verses.sanskrit: नव्यानि सर्वाणि वपूंषि कृत्वा हि सांद्रकारुण्यसुधाप्लवैर्न्नः । त्वया समस्तं भुवनं सहर्षं सुजीवितं सुंदरि सभ्यलभ्ये
verses.transliteration: navyāni sarvāṇi vapūṃṣi kṛtvā hi sāṃdrakāruṇyasudhāplavairnnaḥ / tvayā samastaṃ bhuvanaṃ saharṣaṃ sujīvitaṃ suṃdari sabhyalabhye
verses.translation: That Rati who had abandoned all her ornaments on account of widowhood, whose face was covered with flow of tears, whose tresses had become scattered, and whose colour had become greyish on account of dust particles, bowed down to Jagadamba.
verses.wordMeaning: That Rati who had abandoned all her ornaments on account of widowhood, whose face was covered with flow of tears, whose tresses had become scattered, and whose colour had become greyish on account of dust particles, bowed down to Jagadamba.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Rati who had abandoned all her ornaments on account of widowhood, whose face was covered with flow of tears, whose tresses had become scattered, and whose colour had become greyish on account of dust particles, bowed down to Jagadamba.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशंभुनाथस्य महाशयस्य द्वितीयतेजः प्रसरात्मके यः । स्थाण्वाश्रमे कॢप्ततया विरक्तः सतीवियोगेन विरस्तभोगः
verses.transliteration: śrīśaṃbhunāthasya mahāśayasya dvitīyatejaḥ prasarātmake yaḥ / sthāṇvāśrame kḷptatayā viraktaḥ satīviyogena virastabhogaḥ
verses.translation: Gods wanted to kill Taraka for which Sankara must be tempted to marry. The pleading for Rati is in their own interest.
verses.wordMeaning: Gods wanted to kill Taraka for which Sankara must be tempted to marry. The pleading for Rati is in their own interest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gods wanted to kill Taraka for which Sankara must be tempted to marry. The pleading for Rati is in their own interest.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाद्रिवंशे धृतजन्मलाभां कन्यामुमां योजयितुं प्रवृत्ताः । एवं स्मरं प्रेरितवन्त एव तस्यान्तिकं घोर तपःस्थितस्य
verses.transliteration: tenādrivaṃśe dhṛtajanmalābhāṃ kanyāmumāṃ yojayituṃ pravṛttāḥ / evaṃ smaraṃ preritavanta eva tasyāntikaṃ ghora tapaḥsthitasya
verses.translation: On knowing that both of them had their minds filled with devotion and that their inner souls had great bliss, the lotus-like face of the great queen beamed with smile. Look- ing at Rati who had kept her head bent down due to shyness, she spoke to Syamala thus: —
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that both of them had their minds filled with devotion and that their inner souls had great bliss, the lotus-like face of the great queen beamed with smile. Look- ing at Rati who had kept her head bent down due to shyness, she spoke to Syamala thus: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that both of them had their minds filled with devotion and that their inner souls had great bliss, the lotus-like face of the great queen beamed with smile. Look- ing at Rati who had kept her head bent down due to shyness, she spoke to Syamala thus: —

verses.sanskrit: तेनाथ वैराग्यतपोविघातक्रोधेन लालाटकृशानुदग्धः । भस्मावशेषो मदनस्ततो ऽभूत्ततो हि भण्डासुर एष जातः
verses.transliteration: tenātha vairāgyatapovighātakrodhena lālāṭakṛśānudagdhaḥ / bhasmāvaśeṣo madanastato 'bhūttato hi bhaṇḍāsura eṣa jātaḥ
verses.translation: "O Syamala, let her take bath and let her be adorned with girdle and other ornaments. Let her wear gar- ments too as before, and then be brought here quickly".
verses.wordMeaning: "O Syamala, let her take bath and let her be adorned with girdle and other ornaments. Let her wear gar- ments too as before, and then be brought here quickly".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Syamala, let her take bath and let her be adorned with girdle and other ornaments. Let her wear gar- ments too as before, and then be brought here quickly".

verses.sanskrit: ततो वधस्तस्य दुराशयस्य कृतो भवत्या रणदुर्मदस्य । अथास्मदर्थे त्वतनुस्सजातस्त्वं कामसंजीवनमाशुकुर्याः
verses.transliteration: tato vadhastasya durāśayasya kṛto bhavatyā raṇadurmadasya / athāsmadarthe tvatanussajātastvaṃ kāmasaṃjīvanamāśukuryāḥ
verses.translation: "O mother Lalita, the physical body ofminc which had been burned by the eye oflsa has been restored to me due to the grace ofyour benign side-glance.
verses.wordMeaning: "O mother Lalita, the physical body ofminc which had been burned by the eye oflsa has been restored to me due to the grace ofyour benign side-glance.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O mother Lalita, the physical body ofminc which had been burned by the eye oflsa has been restored to me due to the grace ofyour benign side-glance.

verses.sanskrit: इयं रतिर्भर्तृवियोगखिन्ना वैधव्यमत्यन्तमभव्यमाप । पुनस्त्वदुत्पादितकामसंगाद्भविष्यति श्रीललिते सनाथा
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ ratirbhartṛviyogakhinnā vaidhavyamatyantamabhavyamāpa / punastvadutpāditakāmasaṃgādbhaviṣyati śrīlalite sanāthā
verses.translation: I am your son. I am your slave, employ me anywhere in any task".
verses.wordMeaning: I am your son. I am your slave, employ me anywhere in any task".
verses.commentary: Sense: I am your son. I am your slave, employ me anywhere in any task".

verses.sanskrit: तया तु दृष्टेन मनोभवेन संमोहितः पूर्ववदिन्दुमौलिः । चिरं कृतात्यन्तमहासपर्या तां पार्वतीं द्राक्परिणेष्यतीशः
verses.transliteration: tayā tu dṛṣṭena manobhavena saṃmohitaḥ pūrvavadindumauliḥ / ciraṃ kṛtātyantamahāsaparyā tāṃ pārvatīṃ drākpariṇeṣyatīśaḥ
verses.translation: "O dear one born ofthe mind (i.e. cupid), come on. You have nothing to be afraid of. O cupid, with no hind-
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear one born ofthe mind (i.e. cupid), come on. You have nothing to be afraid of. O cupid, with no hind-
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear one born ofthe mind (i.e. cupid), come on. You have nothing to be afraid of. O cupid, with no hind-

verses.sanskrit: तयोश्च संगाद्भविता कुमारः समस्तगीर्वाणचमूविनेता । तेनैव वीरेण रणे निरस्य स तारको नाम सुरारिराजः
verses.transliteration: tayośca saṃgādbhavitā kumāraḥ samastagīrvāṇacamūvinetā / tenaiva vīreṇa raṇe nirasya sa tārako nāma surārirājaḥ
verses.translation: These were the words of behest of Sri Lalita Devi. The cupid received the command of the goddess humbly and said "Let it be so". With palms joined in reverence, he set out from that place.
verses.wordMeaning: These were the words of behest of Sri Lalita Devi. The cupid received the command of the goddess humbly and said "Let it be so". With palms joined in reverence, he set out from that place.
verses.commentary: Sense: These were the words of behest of Sri Lalita Devi. The cupid received the command of the goddess humbly and said "Let it be so". With palms joined in reverence, he set out from that place.

verses.sanskrit: यो भण्डदैत्यस्य दुराशयस्य मित्रं स लोकत्रयधूमकेतुः । श्रीकण्ठपुत्रैण रणे हतश्चेत्प्राणप्रतिष्ठैव तदा भवेन्नः
verses.transliteration: yo bhaṇḍadaityasya durāśayasya mitraṃ sa lokatrayadhūmaketuḥ / śrīkaṇṭhaputraiṇa raṇe hataścetprāṇapratiṣṭhaiva tadā bhavennaḥ
verses.translation: From all the hair-pores of the lord of Love arose many Madanas whose features were splendid and who could enchant the entire universe.
verses.wordMeaning: From all the hair-pores of the lord of Love arose many Madanas whose features were splendid and who could enchant the entire universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: From all the hair-pores of the lord of Love arose many Madanas whose features were splendid and who could enchant the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वमंबत्रिपुरे जनानां मानापहं मन्मथवीरवर्यम् । उत्पाद्यरत्या विधवात्वदुःखमपाकुरु व्याकुलकुन्तलायाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvamaṃbatripure janānāṃ mānāpahaṃ manmathavīravaryam / utpādyaratyā vidhavātvaduḥkhamapākuru vyākulakuntalāyāḥ
verses.translation: After fascinating and enchanting the entire sphere ofthe world through them, the cupid went once again to the hermitage of Sthanu with the desire to conquer the moon- crested lord.
verses.wordMeaning: After fascinating and enchanting the entire sphere ofthe world through them, the cupid went once again to the hermitage of Sthanu with the desire to conquer the moon- crested lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: After fascinating and enchanting the entire sphere ofthe world through them, the cupid went once again to the hermitage of Sthanu with the desire to conquer the moon- crested lord.

verses.sanskrit: एषा त्वनाथा भवतीं प्रपन्ना भर्तृप्रणाशेन कृशाङ्गयष्टिः । नमस्करोति त्रिपुराभिधाने तदत्र कारुण्यकलां विधेहि
verses.transliteration: eṣā tvanāthā bhavatīṃ prapannā bhartṛpraṇāśena kṛśāṅgayaṣṭiḥ / namaskaroti tripurābhidhāne tadatra kāruṇyakalāṃ vidhehi
verses.translation: He struck with his arrows, the moon-crested lord who was engaged in penance.
verses.wordMeaning: He struck with his arrows, the moon-crested lord who was engaged in penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He struck with his arrows, the moon-crested lord who was engaged in penance.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच इति स्तुत्वा महेशानी ब्रह्माद्या विबुधोत्तमाः । तां रतिं दर्शयमासुर्मलिनां शोककर्शितम्
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca iti stutvā maheśānī brahmādyā vibudhottamāḥ / tāṃ ratiṃ darśayamāsurmalināṃ śokakarśitam
verses.translation: He frequently rolled in the flowery bed brought by the circle ofhis Ganas (attendants) the chief among whom were Nandin, Bhrrigi and Mahakala.
verses.wordMeaning: He frequently rolled in the flowery bed brought by the circle ofhis Ganas (attendants) the chief among whom were Nandin, Bhrrigi and Mahakala.
verses.commentary: Sense: He frequently rolled in the flowery bed brought by the circle ofhis Ganas (attendants) the chief among whom were Nandin, Bhrrigi and Mahakala.

verses.sanskrit: सा पर्यश्रुमुखी कीर्णकुन्तला धूलिधूसरा । ननाम जगदंबां वै वैधव्यत्यक्तभूषणा
verses.transliteration: sā paryaśrumukhī kīrṇakuntalā dhūlidhūsarā / nanāma jagadaṃbāṃ vai vaidhavyatyaktabhūṣaṇā
verses.translation: Supported by the hand of Nandin he went on from one flowery bed to another flowery bed and moved restlessly on it again and again.
verses.wordMeaning: Supported by the hand of Nandin he went on from one flowery bed to another flowery bed and moved restlessly on it again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Supported by the hand of Nandin he went on from one flowery bed to another flowery bed and moved restlessly on it again and again.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तद्दर्शनोत्पन्नकारुण्या परमेश्वरी । ततः कटाक्षादुत्पन्नः स्मयमानसुखांबुजः
verses.transliteration: atha taddarśanotpannakāruṇyā parameśvarī / tataḥ kaṭākṣādutpannaḥ smayamānasukhāṃbujaḥ
verses.translation: Neither on the flowery bed nor in the nectar exuding from the crescent Moon nor in the snowy cold waters (of Ganga) did the heat offever of his body come down.
verses.wordMeaning: Neither on the flowery bed nor in the nectar exuding from the crescent Moon nor in the snowy cold waters (of Ganga) did the heat offever of his body come down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither on the flowery bed nor in the nectar exuding from the crescent Moon nor in the snowy cold waters (of Ganga) did the heat offever of his body come down.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वदेहाधिकरुचिर्मन्मथो मदमेदुरः । द्विभुजः सर्वभूषाढ्यः पुष्पेषुः पुष्पकार्मुकः
verses.transliteration: pūrvadehādhikarucirmanmatho madameduraḥ / dvibhujaḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyaḥ puṣpeṣuḥ puṣpakārmukaḥ
verses.translation: Tile Love-lorn condition of Siva like an ordinary person is described in W. 71-84. It is the author's special contribution not found in other Puranas.
verses.wordMeaning: Tile Love-lorn condition of Siva like an ordinary person is described in W. 71-84. It is the author's special contribution not found in other Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tile Love-lorn condition of Siva like an ordinary person is described in W. 71-84. It is the author's special contribution not found in other Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दयन्कटाक्षेण पूर्वजन्मप्रियां रतिम् । अथ सापि रतिर्देवी महत्यानन्दसागरे । मज्जन्ती निजभर्तारमवरोक्य मुदं गता
verses.transliteration: ānandayankaṭākṣeṇa pūrvajanmapriyāṃ ratim / atha sāpi ratirdevī mahatyānandasāgare / majjantī nijabhartāramavarokya mudaṃ gatā
verses.translation: On observing that this pain ofpassion could not be treated otherwise, Dhurjati exerted himself very much for the sake of marriage.
verses.wordMeaning: On observing that this pain ofpassion could not be treated otherwise, Dhurjati exerted himself very much for the sake of marriage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing that this pain ofpassion could not be treated otherwise, Dhurjati exerted himself very much for the sake of marriage.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दयन्कटाक्षेण पूर्वजन्मप्रियां रतिम् । अथ सापि रतिर्देवी महत्यानन्दसागरे । मज्जन्ती निजभर्तारमवलोक्य मुदं गता
verses.transliteration: ānandayankaṭākṣeṇa pūrvajanmapriyāṃ ratim / atha sāpi ratirdevī mahatyānandasāgare / majjantī nijabhartāramavalokya mudaṃ gatā
verses.translation: After enchanting the lord thus at the behest of Lalita, Kandarpa tormented the daughter of the lord of the mountain by means ofhis arrows. 1
verses.wordMeaning: After enchanting the lord thus at the behest of Lalita, Kandarpa tormented the daughter of the lord of the mountain by means ofhis arrows. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: After enchanting the lord thus at the behest of Lalita, Kandarpa tormented the daughter of the lord of the mountain by means ofhis arrows. 1

verses.sanskrit: श्यामले स्नापयित्वैनां वस्त्रकाञ्च्यादिभूषणैः । अलङ्कृत्य यथापूर्वं शीघ्रमानीयतामिह
verses.transliteration: śyāmale snāpayitvaināṃ vastrakāñcyādibhūṣaṇaiḥ / alaṅkṛtya yathāpūrvaṃ śīghramānīyatāmiha
verses.translation: Scorched and distressed by the fire of separation, Parvatl could not sleep at all. By the feverish distress of her body she enhanced the sorrow of her father.
verses.wordMeaning: Scorched and distressed by the fire of separation, Parvatl could not sleep at all. By the feverish distress of her body she enhanced the sorrow of her father.
verses.commentary: Sense: Scorched and distressed by the fire of separation, Parvatl could not sleep at all. By the feverish distress of her body she enhanced the sorrow of her father.

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञां शिरसा धृत्वा श्यामा सर्वं तथाकरोत । ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्वसिष्ठाद्यैर्वैवाहि कविधानतः
verses.transliteration: tadājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā śyāmā sarvaṃ tathākarota / brahmarṣibhirvasiṣṭhādyairvaivāhi kavidhānataḥ
verses.translation: On observing that his daughter's pangs ofseparation from Siva were irremediably severe, the lord of mountains felt great sorrow.
verses.wordMeaning: On observing that his daughter's pangs ofseparation from Siva were irremediably severe, the lord of mountains felt great sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing that his daughter's pangs ofseparation from Siva were irremediably severe, the lord of mountains felt great sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: कारयामास दंपत्योः पाणिग्रहणमङ्गलम् । अप्सरोभिश्च सर्वाभिर्नृत्यगीतादिसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: kārayāmāsa daṃpatyoḥ pāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalam / apsarobhiśca sarvābhirnṛtyagītādisaṃyutam
verses.translation: For securing her husband, Parvatl performed a very severe penance on the peak of the mountain Himalaya, named Gaurlsikhara.
verses.wordMeaning: For securing her husband, Parvatl performed a very severe penance on the peak of the mountain Himalaya, named Gaurlsikhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: For securing her husband, Parvatl performed a very severe penance on the peak of the mountain Himalaya, named Gaurlsikhara.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दृष्ट्वा महेन्द्राद्या ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । साधुसाध्विति शंसंतस्तुष्टुवुर्ललितांबिकाम्
verses.transliteration: etaddṛṣṭvā mahendrādyā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / sādhusādhviti śaṃsaṃtastuṣṭuvurlalitāṃbikām
verses.translation: She practised a dreadfully severe penance by stay- ing in water during the winter and by standing in the middle of fires with the eyes fixed on the sun during the summer.
verses.wordMeaning: She practised a dreadfully severe penance by stay- ing in water during the winter and by standing in the middle of fires with the eyes fixed on the sun during the summer.
verses.commentary: Sense: She practised a dreadfully severe penance by stay- ing in water during the winter and by standing in the middle of fires with the eyes fixed on the sun during the summer.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पवृष्टिं विमुञ्चन्तः सर्वे सन्तुष्टमानसाः । बभूवुस्तौ महाभक्त्या प्रणम्य ललितेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vimuñcantaḥ sarve santuṣṭamānasāḥ / babhūvustau mahābhaktyā praṇamya laliteśvarīm
verses.translation: Gratified by that penance Siva granted his proxi- mity to her. He accepted her as his wife in accordance with the religious injunctions regarding marriage ceremony.
verses.wordMeaning: Gratified by that penance Siva granted his proxi- mity to her. He accepted her as his wife in accordance with the religious injunctions regarding marriage ceremony.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gratified by that penance Siva granted his proxi- mity to her. He accepted her as his wife in accordance with the religious injunctions regarding marriage ceremony.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पार्श्वे तु समागत्य बद्धाञ्जलिपुटौ स्थितौ । अथ कन्दर्पवीरो ऽपि नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरीम् । व्यज्ञापयदिदं वाक्यं भक्तिनिर्भरमानसः
verses.transliteration: tatpārśve tu samāgatya baddhāñjalipuṭau sthitau / atha kandarpavīro 'pi namaskṛtya maheśvarīm / vyajñāpayadidaṃ vākyaṃ bhaktinirbharamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Then after requesting for her hand through the seven sages at the outset, he married the lotus-eyed daughter, on being offered by the lord of the mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: Then after requesting for her hand through the seven sages at the outset, he married the lotus-eyed daughter, on being offered by the lord of the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after requesting for her hand through the seven sages at the outset, he married the lotus-eyed daughter, on being offered by the lord of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: यद्दग्धमीशनेत्रेण वपुर्मे ललितांबिके । तत्त्वदीयकटाक्षस्य प्रसादात्पुनरागतम्
verses.transliteration: yaddagdhamīśanetreṇa vapurme lalitāṃbike / tattvadīyakaṭākṣasya prasādātpunarāgatam
verses.translation: Engaged in amorous dalliance with her for a long time, Mahesvara stayed in the abode ofhis father-in-law in the city of Osadhiprastha.
verses.wordMeaning: Engaged in amorous dalliance with her for a long time, Mahesvara stayed in the abode ofhis father-in-law in the city of Osadhiprastha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Engaged in amorous dalliance with her for a long time, Mahesvara stayed in the abode ofhis father-in-law in the city of Osadhiprastha.

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रो ऽस्मि दासो ऽस्मि क्वापि कृत्ये नियुङ्क्ष्व माम् । इत्युक्ता परमेशानी तमाह मकरध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: tava putro 'smi dāso 'smi kvāpi kṛtye niyuṅkṣva mām / ityuktā parameśānī tamāha makaradhvajam
verses.translation: Thereafter, he came back to Kailasa along with all the Pramathas (attendants). He brought Parvatl there and thereby made the lord of the mountain (all the more) pleased.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he came back to Kailasa along with all the Pramathas (attendants). He brought Parvatl there and thereby made the lord of the mountain (all the more) pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he came back to Kailasa along with all the Pramathas (attendants). He brought Parvatl there and thereby made the lord of the mountain (all the more) pleased.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेव्युवाच वत्सागच्छ मनोजन्मन्न भयं तव विद्यते । मत्प्रसादाज्जगत्सर्वं मोहयाव्याहताशुग
verses.transliteration: śrīdevyuvāca vatsāgaccha manojanmanna bhayaṃ tava vidyate / matprasādājjagatsarvaṃ mohayāvyāhatāśuga
verses.translation: Day by day, he grew up into a highly valorous hero. He was trained by his father and he acquired all lores.
verses.wordMeaning: Day by day, he grew up into a highly valorous hero. He was trained by his father and he acquired all lores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Day by day, he grew up into a highly valorous hero. He was trained by his father and he acquired all lores.

verses.sanskrit: तद्बाणपातनाज्जातधैर्यविप्लव ईश्वरः । पर्वतस्य सुतां गौरीं परिणेष्यति सत्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tadbāṇapātanājjātadhairyaviplava īśvaraḥ / parvatasya sutāṃ gaurīṃ pariṇeṣyati satvaram
verses.translation: On being permitted by his father he became the general ofthe army of the Devas. He killed Taraka along with Danavas.
verses.wordMeaning: On being permitted by his father he became the general ofthe army of the Devas. He killed Taraka along with Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being permitted by his father he became the general ofthe army of the Devas. He killed Taraka along with Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रकोटयः कामा मत्प्रसादात्त्वदुद्भवाः । सर्वेषां देहमाविश्य दास्यन्ति रतिमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrakoṭayaḥ kāmā matprasādāttvadudbhavāḥ / sarveṣāṃ dehamāviśya dāsyanti ratimuttamām
verses.translation: Thereupon, he married Devasena offered by Sakra who was highly pleased when the leading Daitya Taraka was slain.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, he married Devasena offered by Sakra who was highly pleased when the leading Daitya Taraka was slain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, he married Devasena offered by Sakra who was highly pleased when the leading Daitya Taraka was slain.

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसादेन वैराग्यात्संक्रुद्धो ऽपि स ईश्वरः । देहदाहं विधातुं ते न समर्थो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: matprasādena vairāgyātsaṃkruddho 'pi sa īśvaraḥ / dehadāhaṃ vidhātuṃ te na samartho bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: That glorious daughter ofSakra named Devasena became excessively delighted on securing Skanda as her husband.
verses.wordMeaning: That glorious daughter ofSakra named Devasena became excessively delighted on securing Skanda as her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: That glorious daughter ofSakra named Devasena became excessively delighted on securing Skanda as her husband.

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यमूर्तिः सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भवमोहनः । स्वभार्याविरहाशङ्की देहस्यार्धं प्रदास्यति । प्रयातो ऽसौ कातरात्मा त्वद्बाणाहतमानसः
verses.transliteration: adṛśyamūrtiḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhavamohanaḥ / svabhāryāvirahāśaṅkī dehasyārdhaṃ pradāsyati / prayāto 'sau kātarātmā tvadbāṇāhatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: After neatly accomplishing the task of Devas thus, the god oflove who enchanted the entire sphere of the universe went to Srlpura again.
verses.wordMeaning: After neatly accomplishing the task of Devas thus, the god oflove who enchanted the entire sphere of the universe went to Srlpura again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After neatly accomplishing the task of Devas thus, the god oflove who enchanted the entire sphere of the universe went to Srlpura again.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य प्रभृति कन्दर्प मत्प्रसादान्महीयसः । त्वन्निन्दां ये करिष्यन्ति त्वयि वा विमुखाशयाः । अवश्यं क्लीबतैव स्यात्तेषां जन्मनिजन्मनि
verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛti kandarpa matprasādānmahīyasaḥ / tvannindāṃ ye kariṣyanti tvayi vā vimukhāśayāḥ / avaśyaṃ klībataiva syātteṣāṃ janmanijanmani
verses.translation: There in the holy city ofSrlnagara' he went to that place, where Lalita ParamesvarT stayed for the sake ofthe pros- perity ofthe worlds. He went there in orderto serve her.
verses.wordMeaning: There in the holy city ofSrlnagara' he went to that place, where Lalita ParamesvarT stayed for the sake ofthe pros- perity ofthe worlds. He went there in orderto serve her.
verses.commentary: Sense: There in the holy city ofSrlnagara' he went to that place, where Lalita ParamesvarT stayed for the sake ofthe pros- perity ofthe worlds. He went there in orderto serve her.

verses.sanskrit: ये पापिष्ठा दुरात्मानो मद्भक्तद्रोहिणश्च हि । तानगम्यासु नारीषु पातयित्वा विनाशय
verses.transliteration: ye pāpiṣṭhā durātmāno madbhaktadrohiṇaśca hi / tānagamyāsu nārīṣu pātayitvā vināśaya
verses.translation: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15. His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…

verses.sanskrit: येषां मदीय पूजासु मद्भक्तेष्वादृतं मनः । तेषां कामसुखं सर्वं संपादय समीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ madīya pūjāsu madbhakteṣvādṛtaṃ manaḥ / teṣāṃ kāmasukhaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpādaya samīpsitam

Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15. His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीललितादेव्या कृताज्ञावचनं स्मरः । तथेति शिरसा बिभ्रत्सांजलिर्निर्ययौ ततः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīlalitādevyā kṛtājñāvacanaṃ smaraḥ / tatheti śirasā bibhratsāṃjalirniryayau tataḥ
verses.translation: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15. His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena

verses.sanskrit: तस्यानङ्गस्य सर्वेभ्यो रोमकूपेभ्य उत्थिताः । बहवः शोभनाकारा मदना विश्वमोहनाः
verses.transliteration: tasyānaṅgasya sarvebhyo romakūpebhya utthitāḥ / bahavaḥ śobhanākārā madanā viśvamohanāḥ
verses.translation: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15. His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena

verses.sanskrit: तैर्विमोह्य समस्तं च जगच्चक्रं मनोभवः । पुनः स्थाण्वाश्रमं प्राप चन्द्रमौलेर्जिगीषया
verses.transliteration: tairvimohya samastaṃ ca jagaccakraṃ manobhavaḥ / punaḥ sthāṇvāśramaṃ prāpa candramaulerjigīṣayā
verses.translation: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15. His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena

verses.sanskrit: वसंतेन च मित्रेण सेनान्या शीतरोचिषा । रागेण पीठमर्देन मन्दानिलरयेण च
verses.transliteration: vasaṃtena ca mitreṇa senānyā śītarociṣā / rāgeṇa pīṭhamardena mandānilarayeṇa ca
verses.translation: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15.
