His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं संमोहिताशेषविश्वचक्रो मनोभवः । देवकार्यं सुसम्पाद्य जगाम श्रीपुरं पुनः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ saṃmohitāśeṣaviśvacakro manobhavaḥ / devakāryaṃ susampādya jagāma śrīpuraṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15. His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…

verses.sanskrit: यत्र श्रीनगरे पुण्ये ललिता परमेश्वरी । वर्तते जगतामृद्ध्यै तत्र तां सेवितुं ययौ
verses.transliteration: yatra śrīnagare puṇye lalitā parameśvarī / vartate jagatāmṛddhyai tatra tāṃ sevituṃ yayau
verses.translation: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him. For his different mothers vide Mbh Vana 230.6,15. His killing Taraka (Mbh Salya 46.73-75). His marriage with Devasena
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Skanda's birth, his killing ofTaraka and his marriage with Devasena are recorded in Mbh and other Puranas. Thus in Xlbh Ami 83.68-82 86.5-14 we are told how he was born and the causes of the differ- ent epithets given to him.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने मदनपुनर्भवो नाम त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच किमिदं श्रीपुरं नाम केन रूपेण वर्तते । केन वानिर्मितं पूर्व तत्सर्वं मे निवदय
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne madanapunarbhavo nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca kimidaṃ śrīpuraṃ nāma kena rūpeṇa vartate / kena vānirmitaṃ pūrva tatsarvaṃ me nivadaya
verses.translation: I wish to hear about the exploits of SrldevI n the course of the battle. After seeing the mishap ofhis brother, w hat did Bhanda do, due to the grief thereof?
verses.wordMeaning: I wish to hear about the exploits of SrldevI n the course of the battle. After seeing the mishap ofhis brother, w hat did Bhanda do, due to the grief thereof?
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to hear about the exploits of SrldevI n the course of the battle. After seeing the mishap ofhis brother, w hat did Bhanda do, due to the grief thereof?

verses.sanskrit: कियत्प्रमाणं किं वर्णं कथयस्व मम प्रभो । त्वमेव सर्वसन्देहपङ्कशोषणभास्करः
verses.transliteration: kiyatpramāṇaṃ kiṃ varṇaṃ kathayasva mama prabho / tvameva sarvasandehapaṅkaśoṣaṇabhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: Listen to this, O highly intelligent one. The narrative ofLalita is destructive of all sins. It is holy and it yields qualities, (i.e. siddhis like) Anima (minuteness) etc.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to this, O highly intelligent one. The narrative ofLalita is destructive of all sins. It is holy and it yields qualities, (i.e. siddhis like) Anima (minuteness) etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to this, O highly intelligent one. The narrative ofLalita is destructive of all sins. It is holy and it yields qualities, (i.e. siddhis like) Anima (minuteness) etc.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच यथा चक्ररथं प्राप्य पूर्वोक्तैर्लक्षणैर्युतम् । महायागानलोत्पन्ना ललिता परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca yathā cakrarathaṃ prāpya pūrvoktairlakṣaṇairyutam / mahāyāgānalotpannā lalitā parameśvarī
verses.translation: During the equinoctial periods as well as during the transits ofthe sun, on holy occasions and during the five Parvan* days, it bestows Siddhis ahd'glory. It destroys all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: During the equinoctial periods as well as during the transits ofthe sun, on holy occasions and during the five Parvan* days, it bestows Siddhis ahd'glory. It destroys all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the equinoctial periods as well as during the transits ofthe sun, on holy occasions and during the five Parvan* days, it bestows Siddhis ahd'glory. It destroys all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वैवाहिकीं लीलां ब्रह्माद्यैः प्रार्थिता पुनः । व्यजेष्ट भण्डनामानमसुरं लोककण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vaivāhikīṃ līlāṃ brahmādyaiḥ prārthitā punaḥ / vyajeṣṭa bhaṇḍanāmānamasuraṃ lokakaṇṭakam
verses.translation: On hearing that there in the battle his brothers had been killed. Bhanda was overwhelmed with great grief. He began to lament loudly.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that there in the battle his brothers had been killed. Bhanda was overwhelmed with great grief. He began to lament loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that there in the battle his brothers had been killed. Bhanda was overwhelmed with great grief. He began to lament loudly.

verses.sanskrit: तदा देवा महेन्द्राद्याः सन्तोषं बहु भेजिरे । अथ कामेश्वरस्यापि ललितायाश्च शोभनम् । नित्योपभोगसर्वार्थं मन्दिरं कर्तुमुत्सुकाः
verses.transliteration: tadā devā mahendrādyāḥ santoṣaṃ bahu bhejire / atha kāmeśvarasyāpi lalitāyāśca śobhanam / nityopabhogasarvārthaṃ mandiraṃ kartumutsukāḥ
verses.translation: With his hairs dishevelled and scattered, he fell on the ground in a swoon. He did not get any consolation. He became emaciated due to the sorrow for his brother.
verses.wordMeaning: With his hairs dishevelled and scattered, he fell on the ground in a swoon. He did not get any consolation. He became emaciated due to the sorrow for his brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his hairs dishevelled and scattered, he fell on the ground in a swoon. He did not get any consolation. He became emaciated due to the sorrow for his brother.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारा ललितादेव्या ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । वर्धकिं विश्वकर्माणं सुराणां शिल्पकोविदम्
verses.transliteration: kumārā lalitādevyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / vardhakiṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ surāṇāṃ śilpakovidam
verses.translation: Again and again he went on lamenting. On being pacified repeatedly by Kutilaksa, he got rid of his sorrow and became very furious.
verses.wordMeaning: Again and again he went on lamenting. On being pacified repeatedly by Kutilaksa, he got rid of his sorrow and became very furious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again and again he went on lamenting. On being pacified repeatedly by Kutilaksa, he got rid of his sorrow and became very furious.

verses.sanskrit: सुराणां शिल्पनं च मयं मायाविचक्षणम् । आहूय कृतसत्कारानूचिरे ललिताज्ञया
verses.transliteration: surāṇāṃ śilpanaṃ ca mayaṃ māyāvicakṣaṇam / āhūya kṛtasatkārānūcire lalitājñayā
verses.translation: The lord of Daityas who w'as a great chariot-fighter and haughty in war, mounted his excellent chariot called Abhila to which a thousand lions were yoked.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of Daityas who w'as a great chariot-fighter and haughty in war, mounted his excellent chariot called Abhila to which a thousand lions were yoked.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Daityas who w'as a great chariot-fighter and haughty in war, mounted his excellent chariot called Abhila to which a thousand lions were yoked.

verses.sanskrit: अधिकारिपुरुषा ऊचुः भो विश्वकर्मञ्छिल्पज्ञ भोभो मय महोदय । भवन्तौ सर्वशास्त्रज्ञौ घटनामार्गकोविदौ
verses.transliteration: adhikāripuruṣā ūcuḥ bho viśvakarmañchilpajña bhobho maya mahodaya / bhavantau sarvaśāstrajñau ghaṭanāmārgakovidau
verses.translation: He hastened with great lustre like the fire of •world-destruction whose flames blazed. The name of his sword was Ghataka. It had the same shape as the Candrahasa sword.
verses.wordMeaning: He hastened with great lustre like the fire of •world-destruction whose flames blazed. The name of his sword was Ghataka. It had the same shape as the Candrahasa sword.
verses.commentary: Sense: He hastened with great lustre like the fire of •world-destruction whose flames blazed. The name of his sword was Ghataka. It had the same shape as the Candrahasa sword.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पमात्रेण महाशिल्पकल्पविशारदौ । युवाभ्यां ललितादेव्या नित्यज्ञानमहोदधेः
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpamātreṇa mahāśilpakalpaviśāradau / yuvābhyāṃ lalitādevyā nityajñānamahodadheḥ
verses.translation: When the armies moved here and there, dust columns were raised. Being unable to bear their burden, it appeared as though the earth went to the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: When the armies moved here and there, dust columns were raised. Being unable to bear their burden, it appeared as though the earth went to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the armies moved here and there, dust columns were raised. Being unable to bear their burden, it appeared as though the earth went to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशीक्षेत्रमध्येषु तत्क्षेत्रसमसंख्यया । कर्तव्या श्रीनगर्यो हि नानारत्नैरलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśīkṣetramadhyeṣu tatkṣetrasamasaṃkhyayā / kartavyā śrīnagaryo hi nānāratnairalaṅkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Some ofthem who could not be contained on the earth moved ahead along the path of the sky. Some mighty warriors moved on riding on the shoulders of some.
verses.wordMeaning: Some ofthem who could not be contained on the earth moved ahead along the path of the sky. Some mighty warriors moved on riding on the shoulders of some.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some ofthem who could not be contained on the earth moved ahead along the path of the sky. Some mighty warriors moved on riding on the shoulders of some.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र षोडशधा भिन्ना ललिता परमेश्वरी । विश्वत्राणाय सततं निवासं रचयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yatra ṣoḍaśadhā bhinnā lalitā parameśvarī / viśvatrāṇāya satataṃ nivāsaṃ racayiṣyati
verses.translation: Neither in the cordinal points nor on the sphere of the earth nor in the sky could they be contained. They moved on with very great difficulty as though they were addicted by the close contact of one another.
verses.wordMeaning: Neither in the cordinal points nor on the sphere of the earth nor in the sky could they be contained. They moved on with very great difficulty as though they were addicted by the close contact of one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither in the cordinal points nor on the sphere of the earth nor in the sky could they be contained. They moved on with very great difficulty as though they were addicted by the close contact of one another.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं हि प्रियमिदं मरुतामपिच प्रियम् । सर्वलोकप्रियं चैतत्तन्नाम्नैव विरच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: asmākaṃ hi priyamidaṃ marutāmapica priyam / sarvalokapriyaṃ caitattannāmnaiva viracyatām
verses.translation: A loud roar resembling the rumbling sound of the cloud was given out by him who was moving on along with all the soldiers.
verses.wordMeaning: A loud roar resembling the rumbling sound of the cloud was given out by him who was moving on along with all the soldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: A loud roar resembling the rumbling sound of the cloud was given out by him who was moving on along with all the soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: इति कारणदेवानां वचनं सुनिशम्य तौ । विश्वकर्ममयौ नत्वा व्यभाषेतां तथास्त्विति
verses.transliteration: iti kāraṇadevānāṃ vacanaṃ suniśamya tau / viśvakarmamayau natvā vyabhāṣetāṃ tathāstviti
verses.translation: The universe became torn asunder by that exces- sively harsh leonine roar coming out ofthe mouth ofBhanda, the Daitya.
verses.wordMeaning: The universe became torn asunder by that exces- sively harsh leonine roar coming out ofthe mouth ofBhanda, the Daitya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe became torn asunder by that exces- sively harsh leonine roar coming out ofthe mouth ofBhanda, the Daitya.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्नत्वा पृष्टवन्तौ तौ तान्कारण पूरुषान् । केषु क्षेत्रेषु कर्तव्याः श्रीनगर्यो महोदयाः
verses.transliteration: punarnatvā pṛṣṭavantau tau tānkāraṇa pūruṣān / keṣu kṣetreṣu kartavyāḥ śrīnagaryo mahodayāḥ
verses.translation: The oceans became dried up. The moon and the sun fled. The stars fell down from the sky. The earth began to heave to and fro.
verses.wordMeaning: The oceans became dried up. The moon and the sun fled. The stars fell down from the sky. The earth began to heave to and fro.
verses.commentary: Sense: The oceans became dried up. The moon and the sun fled. The stars fell down from the sky. The earth began to heave to and fro.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माद्याः परिपृष्टास्ते प्रोचुस्तौ शिल्पिनौ पुनः । क्षेत्राणां प्रविभागं तु कल्पयन्तौ यथोचितम्
verses.transliteration: brahmādyāḥ paripṛṣṭāste procustau śilpinau punaḥ / kṣetrāṇāṃ pravibhāgaṃ tu kalpayantau yathocitam
verses.translation: The elephants of the cardinal points became frighten- ed. The heaven-dwellers swooned. The camp of the Saktis became excited on account ofa sudden and unexpected fear.
verses.wordMeaning: The elephants of the cardinal points became frighten- ed. The heaven-dwellers swooned. The camp of the Saktis became excited on account ofa sudden and unexpected fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: The elephants of the cardinal points became frighten- ed. The heaven-dwellers swooned. The camp of the Saktis became excited on account ofa sudden and unexpected fear.

verses.sanskrit: कारणपुरुषा ऊचुः प्रथमं मेरुपृष्ठे तु निषधे च महीधरे । हेमकूटे हिमगिरौ पञ्चमे गन्धमादने
verses.transliteration: kāraṇapuruṣā ūcuḥ prathamaṃ merupṛṣṭhe tu niṣadhe ca mahīdhare / hemakūṭe himagirau pañcame gandhamādane
verses.translation: Considering that the great fight with the Daitya Bhanda, of vicious conduct, was not possible for the other saktis she herself took up the task.
verses.wordMeaning: Considering that the great fight with the Daitya Bhanda, of vicious conduct, was not possible for the other saktis she herself took up the task.
verses.commentary: Sense: Considering that the great fight with the Daitya Bhanda, of vicious conduct, was not possible for the other saktis she herself took up the task.

verses.sanskrit: नीले मेषे च शृङ्गारे महेन्द्रे च महागिरौ । क्षेत्राणि हि नवैतानि भौमानि विदितान्यथ
verses.transliteration: nīle meṣe ca śṛṅgāre mahendre ca mahāgirau / kṣetrāṇi hi navaitāni bhaumāni viditānyatha
verses.translation: Saktis who repeatedly endeavoured to kill Bhanda and his Asura followers were of multifbrmed nature. Although the opening of the circular fiery rampart extended to a Yojana in length, it was not sufficient for the outward march of the army.
verses.wordMeaning: Saktis who repeatedly endeavoured to kill Bhanda and his Asura followers were of multifbrmed nature. Although the opening of the circular fiery rampart extended to a Yojana in length, it was not sufficient for the outward march of the army.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktis who repeatedly endeavoured to kill Bhanda and his Asura followers were of multifbrmed nature. Although the opening of the circular fiery rampart extended to a Yojana in length, it was not sufficient for the outward march of the army.

verses.sanskrit: औदकानि तु सप्तैव प्रोक्तान्यखिल सिन्धुषु । लवणो ऽब्धीक्षुसाराब्धिः सुराब्धिर्घृतसागरः
verses.transliteration: audakāni tu saptaiva proktānyakhila sindhuṣu / lavaṇo 'bdhīkṣusārābdhiḥ surābdhirghṛtasāgaraḥ
verses.translation: Desirous of an easy exit for all the armies, the Nitya deity named Jvalamalinika enlarged the opening further.
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of an easy exit for all the armies, the Nitya deity named Jvalamalinika enlarged the opening further.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of an easy exit for all the armies, the Nitya deity named Jvalamalinika enlarged the opening further.

verses.sanskrit: दधिसिन्धुः क्षीरसिन्धुर्जलसिन्धुश्च सप्तमः । पूर्वोक्ता नव शैलेन्द्राः पश्चात्सप्त च सिन्धवः
verses.transliteration: dadhisindhuḥ kṣīrasindhurjalasindhuśca saptamaḥ / pūrvoktā nava śailendrāḥ paścātsapta ca sindhavaḥ
verses.translation: As observed in Note 1 on Ch. 19, the chariot of Lalita symbolizes Vedic religion; the Vedas, Purusarthas etc. are parts of her chariot.
verses.wordMeaning: As observed in Note 1 on Ch. 19, the chariot of Lalita symbolizes Vedic religion; the Vedas, Purusarthas etc. are parts of her chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: As observed in Note 1 on Ch. 19, the chariot of Lalita symbolizes Vedic religion; the Vedas, Purusarthas etc. are parts of her chariot.

verses.sanskrit: आत्दृत्य षोडश क्षेत्राण्यंबाश्रीपुरकॢप्तये । येषु दिव्यानि वेश्मानि ललिताया महौजसः । सृजतं दिव्यघटनापण्डितौ शिल्पिनौ युवाम्
verses.transliteration: ātdṛtya ṣoḍaśa kṣetrāṇyaṃbāśrīpurakḷptaye / yeṣu divyāni veśmāni lalitāyā mahaujasaḥ / sṛjataṃ divyaghaṭanāpaṇḍitau śilpinau yuvām
verses.translation: Then the gloriously splendid mother of the worlds, the great queen of excessive valour and exploits, went out ofthe fiery city through the excellent opening.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the gloriously splendid mother of the worlds, the great queen of excessive valour and exploits, went out ofthe fiery city through the excellent opening.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the gloriously splendid mother of the worlds, the great queen of excessive valour and exploits, went out ofthe fiery city through the excellent opening.

verses.sanskrit: येषु क्षेत्रेषु कॢप्तानि घ्नन्त्या देव्या महासुरान् । नामानि नित्यानाम्नैव प्रथितानि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yeṣu kṣetreṣu kḷptāni ghnantyā devyā mahāsurān / nāmāni nityānāmnaiva prathitāni na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis (wardrums) sounded. Showers of flowers fell down. The great royal umbrella set with pearls was seen shining brilliantly in the firmament.
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis (wardrums) sounded. Showers of flowers fell down. The great royal umbrella set with pearls was seen shining brilliantly in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis (wardrums) sounded. Showers of flowers fell down. The great royal umbrella set with pearls was seen shining brilliantly in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: सा हि नित्यास्वरूपेण कालव्याप्तिकरी परा । सर्वं कलयते देवी कलनाङ्कतया जगत्
verses.transliteration: sā hi nityāsvarūpeṇa kālavyāptikarī parā / sarvaṃ kalayate devī kalanāṅkatayā jagat
verses.translation: Pleasingly clear omens indicating the glory ofvictory occurred in the army ofLalita. Portentous ill-omens occurred in the army of enemies.
verses.wordMeaning: Pleasingly clear omens indicating the glory ofvictory occurred in the army ofLalita. Portentous ill-omens occurred in the army of enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pleasingly clear omens indicating the glory ofvictory occurred in the army ofLalita. Portentous ill-omens occurred in the army of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानाच महाराज्ञी नित्या यत्र न तद्भिदा । अतस्तदीयनाम्ना तु सनामा प्रथिता पुरा
verses.transliteration: nityānāca mahārājñī nityā yatra na tadbhidā / atastadīyanāmnā tu sanāmā prathitā purā
verses.translation: Neither the quarters nor the sky, neither the mountains nor the earth, nothing was seen. Only the dust column was seen increasing in size.
verses.wordMeaning: Neither the quarters nor the sky, neither the mountains nor the earth, nothing was seen. Only the dust column was seen increasing in size.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither the quarters nor the sky, neither the mountains nor the earth, nothing was seen. Only the dust column was seen increasing in size.

verses.sanskrit: कामेश्वरीपुरी चैव भगमालापुरी तथा । नित्यक्लिन्नापुरीत्यादिनामानि प्रथितान्यलम्
verses.transliteration: kāmeśvarīpurī caiva bhagamālāpurī tathā / nityaklinnāpurītyādināmāni prathitānyalam
verses.translation: On the fourth day of the battle, beginning in the morning and extending to two Praharas (six hours) the terrible battle between the two armies ensued causing fear even to the god of Death.
verses.wordMeaning: On the fourth day of the battle, beginning in the morning and extending to two Praharas (six hours) the terrible battle between the two armies ensued causing fear even to the god of Death.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the fourth day of the battle, beginning in the morning and extending to two Praharas (six hours) the terrible battle between the two armies ensued causing fear even to the god of Death.

verses.sanskrit: अतो नामानि वर्णेन योग्ये पुण्यतमे दिने । महाशिल्पप्रकारेण पुरीं रचयतां शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: ato nāmāni varṇena yogye puṇyatame dine / mahāśilpaprakāreṇa purīṃ racayatāṃ śubhām
verses.translation: He discharged a great missile named Andhatamisraka '
verses.wordMeaning: He discharged a great missile named Andhatamisraka '
verses.commentary: Sense: He discharged a great missile named Andhatamisraka '

verses.sanskrit: इति कारणकृत्येन्द्रैर्ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरैः । प्रोक्तौ तौ श्रीपुरीस्थेषु तेषु क्षेत्रेषु चक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: iti kāraṇakṛtyendrairbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ / proktau tau śrīpurīstheṣu teṣu kṣetreṣu cakratuḥ
verses.translation: As stated elsewhere this battle symbolizes the struggle between good and evil forces. The missiles also signify evil forces used'by Bhanda and good forces countered by Lalita. I give.below the list of so-called Astros discharged by Bhanda and destroyed by Lalita with a counter (good) force.
verses.wordMeaning: As stated elsewhere this battle symbolizes the struggle between good and evil forces. The missiles also signify evil forces used'by Bhanda and good forces countered by Lalita.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As stated elsewhere this battle symbolizes the struggle between good and evil forces. The missiles also signify evil forces used'by Bhanda and good forces countered by Lalita.…

verses.sanskrit: अथ श्रीपुरविस्तारं पुराधिष्ठातृदेवताः । कथयाम्यहमाधार्य लोपामुद्रापते शृणु
verses.transliteration: atha śrīpuravistāraṃ purādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ / kathayāmyahamādhārya lopāmudrāpate śṛṇu
verses.translation: Pdkhapaa

verses.sanskrit: यो मेरुरखिलाधारस्तुङ्गश्चानन्तयोजनः । चतुर्दशजगच्चक्रसंप्रोतनिजविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: yo merurakhilādhārastuṅgaścānantayojanaḥ / caturdaśajagaccakrasaṃprotanijavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda the great hero discharged the missile Pakkandastra (Heresy) in the course of battle. For dispelling it, the mother of the universe discharged the missile of Gayatri.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda the great hero discharged the missile Pakkandastra (Heresy) in the course of battle. For dispelling it, the mother of the universe discharged the missile of Gayatri.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda the great hero discharged the missile Pakkandastra (Heresy) in the course of battle. For dispelling it, the mother of the universe discharged the missile of Gayatri.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चत्वारि शृङ्गाणि शक्रनैरृतवायुषु । मध्यस्थलेषु जातानि प्रोच्छ्रायस्तेषु कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: tasya catvāri śṛṅgāṇi śakranairṛtavāyuṣu / madhyasthaleṣu jātāni procchrāyasteṣu kathyate
verses.translation: Bhanda discharged the missile Andhastra (Blindness) that was destructive of the vision of Saktis. The mother subdued it by means ofthe great- missile Caksus-matta (Endow- ment with eyes.)
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda discharged the missile Andhastra (Blindness) that was destructive of the vision of Saktis. The mother subdued it by means ofthe great- missile Caksus-matta (Endow- ment with eyes.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda discharged the missile Andhastra (Blindness) that was destructive of the vision of Saktis. The mother subdued it by means ofthe great- missile Caksus-matta (Endow- ment with eyes.)

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वोक्तशृङ्गत्रितयं शतयोजनमुन्नतम् । शतयोजनविस्तारं तेषु लोकास्त्रयो मताः
verses.transliteration: pūrvoktaśṛṅgatritayaṃ śatayojanamunnatam / śatayojanavistāraṃ teṣu lokāstrayo matāḥ
verses.translation: In the course of great battle, Bhanda discharged the missile named Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis. (The goodess) dispelled its pride by the missile of Visvavasu.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of great battle, Bhanda discharged the missile named Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis. (The goodess) dispelled its pride by the missile of Visvavasu.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of great battle, Bhanda discharged the missile named Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis. (The goodess) dispelled its pride by the missile of Visvavasu.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोको विष्णुलोकः शिवलोकस्तथैव च । एतेषां गृहविन्यासान्वक्ष्याम्यवसरान्तरे
verses.transliteration: brahmaloko viṣṇulokaḥ śivalokastathaiva ca / eteṣāṃ gṛhavinyāsānvakṣyāmyavasarāntare
verses.translation: Bhanda, the extremely infuriated Danava discharged the missile Antakdstra (with Antaka the god of death as the presiding deity). The goddess destroyed its power by the missile of Mahdmrtyuhjaya (with lord Siva the conqueror of the god of death as the presiding lord)
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the extremely infuriated Danava discharged the missile Antakdstra (with Antaka the god of death as the presiding deity). The goddess destroyed its power by the missile of Mahdmrtyuhjaya (with lord Siva the conqueror of the god of death as the presiding lord)
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the extremely infuriated Danava discharged the missile Antakdstra (with Antaka the god of death as the presiding deity). The goddess destroyed its power by the missile of Mahdmrtyuhjaya (with lord Siva the conqueror of the god of death as the presiding lord)

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये स्थितस्य शृङ्गस्य विस्तारं चोच्छ्रयं शृणु । चतुःशतं योजनानामुच्छ्रितं विस्तृतं तथा
verses.transliteration: madhye sthitasya śṛṅgasya vistāraṃ cocchrayaṃ śṛṇu / catuḥśataṃ yojanānāmucchritaṃ vistṛtaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Bhanda discharged the missile named Sarvastrasmrti - rtdia. (Destruction of the memory of all missiles). CakresT
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda discharged the missile named Sarvastrasmrti - rtdia. (Destruction of the memory of all missiles). CakresT
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda discharged the missile named Sarvastrasmrti - rtdia. (Destruction of the memory of all missiles). CakresT

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव शृङ्गे महति शिल्पिभ्यां श्रीपुरं कृतम् । चतुःशतं योजनानां विस्तृत कुम्भसंभव
verses.transliteration: tatraiva śṛṅge mahati śilpibhyāṃ śrīpuraṃ kṛtam / catuḥśataṃ yojanānāṃ vistṛta kumbhasaṃbhava
verses.translation: Andhastra (Blindness)
verses.wordMeaning: Andhastra (Blindness)
verses.commentary: Sense: Andhastra (Blindness)

verses.sanskrit: तत्रायं प्रविभागस्ते प्रविविच्य प्रदर्श्यते । प्राकारः प्रथमः प्रोक्तः कालायसविनिर्मितः
verses.transliteration: tatrāyaṃ pravibhāgaste pravivicya pradarśyate / prākāraḥ prathamaḥ proktaḥ kālāyasavinirmitaḥ
verses.translation: Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis)
verses.wordMeaning: Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis)
verses.commentary: Sense: Saktinasa (Destruction of Saktis)

verses.sanskrit: षट्दशाधिकसाहस्रयोजनायतवेष्टनः । चतुर्दिक्षु द्वार्युतश्च चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭdaśādhikasāhasrayojanāyataveṣṭanaḥ / caturdikṣu dvāryutaśca caturyojanamucchritaḥ
verses.translation: Bhaya (Fear)
verses.wordMeaning: Bhaya (Fear)
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhaya (Fear)

verses.sanskrit: शालमूलपरीणाहो योजनायुतमब्धिप । शालाग्रस्य तु गव्यूतेर्नद्धवातायनं पृथक्
verses.transliteration: śālamūlaparīṇāho yojanāyutamabdhipa / śālāgrasya tu gavyūternaddhavātāyanaṃ pṛthak
verses.translation: Mahirogas (great diseases)
verses.wordMeaning: Mahirogas (great diseases)
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahirogas (great diseases)

verses.sanskrit: शालद्वारस्य चौन्नत्यमेकयोजनमाश्रितम् । द्वारेद्वारे कपाटे द्वे गव्यूत्यर्धप्रविस्तरे
verses.transliteration: śāladvārasya caunnatyamekayojanamāśritam / dvāredvāre kapāṭe dve gavyūtyardhapravistare
verses.translation: Mahasurastra
verses.wordMeaning: Mahasurastra
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahasurastra

verses.sanskrit: एकयोजनमुन्नद्धे कालायस विनिर्मिते । उभयोरर्गला चेत्थमर्धक्रोशसमायता
verses.transliteration: ekayojanamunnaddhe kālāyasa vinirmite / ubhayorargalā cetthamardhakrośasamāyatā
verses.translation: Bhanda discharged the missile of Bhaya (fear) that
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda discharged the missile of Bhaya (fear) that
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda discharged the missile of Bhaya (fear) that

verses.sanskrit: एवं चतुर्षु द्वारेषु सदृशं परिकीर्तितम् । गोपुरस्य तु संस्थानं कथये कुंभसंभव
verses.transliteration: evaṃ caturṣu dvāreṣu sadṛśaṃ parikīrtitam / gopurasya tu saṃsthānaṃ kathaye kuṃbhasaṃbhava
verses.translation: The Danava discharged the missile of Maharogas (great diseases) among the armies of Saktis. Thereupon pulmonary consumption and thousands of other diseases began to ravage.
verses.wordMeaning: The Danava discharged the missile of Maharogas (great diseases) among the armies of Saktis. Thereupon pulmonary consumption and thousands of other diseases began to ravage.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Danava discharged the missile of Maharogas (great diseases) among the armies of Saktis. Thereupon pulmonary consumption and thousands of other diseases began to ravage.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वोक्तस्य तु शालस्य मूले योजनसंमिते । पार्श्वद्वये योजने द्वे द्वे समादाय निर्मिते
verses.transliteration: pūrvoktasya tu śālasya mūle yojanasaṃmite / pārśvadvaye yojane dve dve samādāya nirmite
verses.translation: In order to achieve their eradication and prevention, Lalita, the great goddess, discharged the great missile ofthe great Mantra ofthe three names (of Lord Visnu).
verses.wordMeaning: In order to achieve their eradication and prevention, Lalita, the great goddess, discharged the great missile ofthe great Mantra ofthe three names (of Lord Visnu).
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to achieve their eradication and prevention, Lalita, the great goddess, discharged the great missile ofthe great Mantra ofthe three names (of Lord Visnu).

verses.sanskrit: विस्तारमपि तावन्तं संप्राप्तं द्वारगर्भितम् । पार्श्वद्वयं योजने द्वे मध्ये शालस्य योजनम्
verses.transliteration: vistāramapi tāvantaṃ saṃprāptaṃ dvāragarbhitam / pārśvadvayaṃ yojane dve madhye śālasya yojanam
verses.translation: Acyuta, Ananta and Govinda rose up from the
verses.wordMeaning: Acyuta, Ananta and Govinda rose up from the
verses.commentary: Sense: Acyuta, Ananta and Govinda rose up from the

verses.sanskrit: मेलयित्वा पञ्च मुने योजनानि प्रमाणतः । पार्श्वद्वयेन सार्धेन क्रोशयुग्मेन संयुतम्
verses.transliteration: melayitvā pañca mune yojanāni pramāṇataḥ / pārśvadvayena sārdhena krośayugmena saṃyutam
verses.translation: They bowed down to MahesanT. They were
verses.wordMeaning: They bowed down to MahesanT. They were
verses.commentary: Sense: They bowed down to MahesanT. They were

verses.sanskrit: मेलयित्वा पञ्चसंख्यायोजनान्यायतस्तथा । एवं प्राकारतस्तत्र गोपुरं रचितं मुने
verses.transliteration: melayitvā pañcasaṃkhyāyojanānyāyatastathā / evaṃ prākāratastatra gopuraṃ racitaṃ mune
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गोपुरमूलस्य वेष्टो विंशतियोजनः । उपर्युपरि वेष्टस्य ह्रास एव प्रकीर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmādgopuramūlasya veṣṭo viṃśatiyojanaḥ / uparyupari veṣṭasya hrāsa eva prakīrtyate
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: गोपुरस्योन्नतिः प्रोक्तापञ्चविंशतियोजना । योजनेयोजने द्वारं सकपाटं मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: gopurasyonnatiḥ proktāpañcaviṃśatiyojanā / yojaneyojane dvāraṃ sakapāṭaṃ manoharam
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: भूमिकाश्चापि तावन्त्यो यथोर्ध्वं ह्राससंयुताः । गोपुराग्रस्य निस्तारो योजनं हि समाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: bhūmikāścāpi tāvantyo yathordhvaṃ hrāsasaṃyutāḥ / gopurāgrasya nistāro yojanaṃ hi samāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: आयामो ऽपि च तावान्वै तत्र त्रिमुकुटं स्मृतम् । मुकुटस्य तु विस्तारः क्रोशमानो घटोद्भव
verses.transliteration: āyāmo 'pi ca tāvānvai tatra trimukuṭaṃ smṛtam / mukuṭasya tu vistāraḥ krośamāno ghaṭodbhava
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: क्रोशद्वयं समुन्नद्धं ह्रासं गोपुरवन्मुने । मुकुटस्यान्तरे क्षोणी क्रोशार्धेन च संमिता
verses.transliteration: krośadvayaṃ samunnaddhaṃ hrāsaṃ gopuravanmune / mukuṭasyāntare kṣoṇī krośārdhena ca saṃmitā
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: मुकुटं पश्चिमे प्राच्यां दक्षिणे द्वारगोपुरे । दक्षोत्तरस्तु मुकुटाः पश्चिमद्वारगोपुरे
verses.transliteration: mukuṭaṃ paścime prācyāṃ dakṣiṇe dvāragopure / dakṣottarastu mukuṭāḥ paścimadvāragopure
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणद्वारवत्प्रोक्ता उत्तरद्वाःकिरीटिकाः । पश्चिमद्वारवत्पूर्वद्वारे मुकुटकल्पना
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇadvāravatproktā uttaradvāḥkirīṭikāḥ / paścimadvāravatpūrvadvāre mukuṭakalpanā
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: कालायसाख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने । अन्तरे कांस्यशालस्य पूर्ववद्गोपुरो ऽन्वितः
verses.transliteration: kālāyasākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane / antare kāṃsyaśālasya pūrvavadgopuro 'nvitaḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: शालमूलप्रमाणं च पूर्ववत्परिकीर्तितम् । कांस्यशालो ऽपि पूर्वादिदिक्षु द्वारसमन्विन्तः
verses.transliteration: śālamūlapramāṇaṃ ca pūrvavatparikīrtitam / kāṃsyaśālo 'pi pūrvādidikṣu dvārasamanvintaḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: द्वारेद्वारे गोपुराणि पर्वलक्षणभाञ्जि च । कालायसस्य कांस्यस्य य्ॐऽतर्देशः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: dvāredvāre gopurāṇi parvalakṣaṇabhāñji ca / kālāyasasya kāṃsyasya yoṃ'tardeśaḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: नानावृक्षमहोद्यानं तत्प्रोक्तं कुम्भसंभव । उद्भिज्जाद्यं यावदस्ति तत्सर्वं तत्र वर्तते
verses.transliteration: nānāvṛkṣamahodyānaṃ tatproktaṃ kumbhasaṃbhava / udbhijjādyaṃ yāvadasti tatsarvaṃ tatra vartate
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: परंसहस्रास्तरवः सदापुष्पाः सदाफलाः । सदापल्लवशोभाढ्याः सदा सौरभसंकुलाः
verses.transliteration: paraṃsahasrāstaravaḥ sadāpuṣpāḥ sadāphalāḥ / sadāpallavaśobhāḍhyāḥ sadā saurabhasaṃkulāḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: । घोरैस्तपोभिरत्यर्थं पूरयामास धीरधीः । मतङ्गमुनिपुत्रेण सुचिरं समुपासिता
verses.transliteration: . ghoraistapobhiratyarthaṃ pūrayāmāsa dhīradhīḥ / mataṅgamuniputreṇa suciraṃ samupāsitā
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रिणी कृतसान्निध्या वृणीष्व वरमित्यशात् । सो ऽपिसर्वमुनिश्रेष्ठो मातङ्गस्तपसां निधिः । उवाच तां पुरो दत्तसान्निध्यां श्यामलांबिकाम्
verses.transliteration: mantriṇī kṛtasānnidhyā vṛṇīṣva varamityaśāt / so 'pisarvamuniśreṣṭho mātaṅgastapasāṃ nidhiḥ / uvāca tāṃ puro dattasānnidhyāṃ śyāmalāṃbikām
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: मातङ्गमहामुनिरुवाच देवी त्वत्स्मृतिमात्रेण सर्वाश्च मम सिद्धयः । जाता एवाणिमाद्यास्ताः सर्वाश्चान्या विभूतयः
verses.transliteration: mātaṅgamahāmuniruvāca devī tvatsmṛtimātreṇa sarvāśca mama siddhayaḥ / jātā evāṇimādyāstāḥ sarvāścānyā vibhūtayaḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: प्रापणीयन्न मे किञ्चिदस्त्यंबभुवनत्रये । सर्वतः प्राप्तकालस्य भवत्याश्चरितस्मृतेः
verses.transliteration: prāpaṇīyanna me kiñcidastyaṃbabhuvanatraye / sarvataḥ prāptakālasya bhavatyāścaritasmṛteḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: अथापि तव सांनिध्यमिदं नो निष्फलं भवेत् । एवं परं प्रार्थये ऽहं तं वरं पूरयांबिके
verses.transliteration: athāpi tava sāṃnidhyamidaṃ no niṣphalaṃ bhavet / evaṃ paraṃ prārthaye 'haṃ taṃ varaṃ pūrayāṃbike
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं हिमवता सार्थं सौहार्दं परिहासवान् । क्रीडामत्तेन चावाच्यैस्तत्र तेन प्रगल्भितम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ himavatā sārthaṃ sauhārdaṃ parihāsavān / krīḍāmattena cāvācyaistatra tena pragalbhitam
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्गौरीगुरुरिति श्लाघामात्मनि तेनिवान् । तद्वाक्यं मम नैवाभूद्यतस्तत्राधिको गुणः
verses.transliteration: ahaṅgaurīgururiti ślāghāmātmani tenivān / tadvākyaṃ mama naivābhūdyatastatrādhiko guṇaḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: उभयोर्गुणसाम्ये तु मित्रयोरधिके गुणे । एकस्य कारणाज्जाते तत्रान्यस्य स्पृहा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ubhayorguṇasāmye tu mitrayoradhike guṇe / ekasya kāraṇājjāte tatrānyasya spṛhā bhavet
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: गौरीगुरुत्वश्लाघार्थं प्राप्तकामो ऽप्यहं तपः । कृतवान्मन्त्रिणीनाथे तत्त्वंमत्तनया भव
verses.transliteration: gaurīgurutvaślāghārthaṃ prāptakāmo 'pyahaṃ tapaḥ / kṛtavānmantriṇīnāthe tattvaṃmattanayā bhava
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: यतो मन्नामविख्याता भविष्यसि न संशयः । इत्युक्तं वचनं श्रुत्वा मातङ्गस्य महामुनेः । तथास्त्विति तिरोघत् स च प्रीतो ऽभवन्मुनिः
verses.transliteration: yato mannāmavikhyātā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ / ityuktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā mātaṅgasya mahāmuneḥ / tathāstviti tiroghat sa ca prīto 'bhavanmuniḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: मातङ्गस्य महर्षेस्तु तस्य स्वप्ने तदा मुदा । तापिच्छमञ्जरीमेकां ददौ कर्णावतंसतः
verses.transliteration: mātaṅgasya maharṣestu tasya svapne tadā mudā / tāpicchamañjarīmekāṃ dadau karṇāvataṃsataḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: तत्स्वप्नस्य प्रभावेण मातङ्गस्य सधर्मिणी । नाम्ना सिद्धिमती गर्भे लघुश्यामामधारयत्
verses.transliteration: tatsvapnasya prabhāveṇa mātaṅgasya sadharmiṇī / nāmnā siddhimatī garbhe laghuśyāmāmadhārayat
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: तत एव समुत्पन्ना मातङ्गी तेन कीर्तिताः । लघुश्यामेति सा प्रोक्त श्यामा यन्मूलकन्दभूः
verses.transliteration: tata eva samutpannā mātaṅgī tena kīrtitāḥ / laghuśyāmeti sā prokta śyāmā yanmūlakandabhūḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: मातङ्गकन्यका हृद्याः कोटीनामपि कोटिशः । लघुश्यामा महाश्यामामातङ्गी वृन्दसंयुताः । अङ्गशक्तित्वमापन्नाः सेवन्ते प्रियकप्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: mātaṅgakanyakā hṛdyāḥ koṭīnāmapi koṭiśaḥ / laghuśyāmā mahāśyāmāmātaṅgī vṛndasaṃyutāḥ / aṅgaśaktitvamāpannāḥ sevante priyakapriyām
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: इति मातङ्गकन्यानामुत्पत्तिः कुंभसंभव । कथिताः सप्तकक्षाश्च शाला लोहादिनिर्मिताः
verses.transliteration: iti mātaṅgakanyānāmutpattiḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhava / kathitāḥ saptakakṣāśca śālā lohādinirmitāḥ
verses.translation: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the Danava, discharged the missile

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे ललितोपाख्याने हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे सप्तकक्ष्या मतङ्गकन्याप्रादुर्भावो नामैकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच लोहादिसप्तशालानां रक्षका एव संति वै । तन्नामकीर्तय प्राज्ञ येन मे संशयच्छिदा
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lalitopākhyāne hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde saptakakṣyā mataṅgakanyāprādurbhāvo nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca lohādisaptaśālānāṃ rakṣakā eva saṃti vai / tannāmakīrtaya prājña yena me saṃśayacchidā
verses.translation: Thereupon arose a glorious deity named Durga. She had a cosmic form evolved by the refulgence of all Devas.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon arose a glorious deity named Durga. She had a cosmic form evolved by the refulgence of all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon arose a glorious deity named Durga. She had a cosmic form evolved by the refulgence of all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच नानावृक्षमहोद्याने वर्तते कुंभसंभव । महाकालः सर्वलोकभक्षकः श्यामविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca nānāvṛkṣamahodyāne vartate kuṃbhasaṃbhava / mahākālaḥ sarvalokabhakṣakaḥ śyāmavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: The wicked Danava discharged the missile Mukdstra (that of dumbness) among the armies of Saktis. The mother of the universe discharged the missile named Mahdvdgvadini (the great and eloquent one).
verses.wordMeaning: The wicked Danava discharged the missile Mukdstra (that of dumbness) among the armies of Saktis. The mother of the universe discharged the missile named Mahdvdgvadini (the great and eloquent one).
verses.commentary: Sense: The wicked Danava discharged the missile Mukdstra (that of dumbness) among the armies of Saktis. The mother of the universe discharged the missile named Mahdvdgvadini (the great and eloquent one).

verses.sanskrit: श्यामकञ्चुकधारी च मदारुणविलोचनः । ब्रह्माण्डचषके पूर्णं पिबन्विश्वरसायनम्
verses.transliteration: śyāmakañcukadhārī ca madāruṇavilocanaḥ / brahmāṇḍacaṣake pūrṇaṃ pibanviśvarasāyanam
verses.translation: ' In the course of battle the haughty and ferocious
verses.wordMeaning: ' In the course of battle the haughty and ferocious
verses.commentary: Sense: ' In the course of battle the haughty and ferocious

verses.sanskrit: महाकालीं घनश्यामामनङ्गार्द्रामपाङ्गयन् । सिंहासने समासीनः कल्पान्ते कलनात्मके
verses.transliteration: mahākālīṃ ghanaśyāmāmanaṅgārdrāmapāṅgayan / siṃhāsane samāsīnaḥ kalpānte kalanātmake
verses.translation: From V. 90 onwards Bhanda used an Astra for counteracting which God Visnu had to incarnate. Here the Nine Aoataras of Visnu as we know them today are given and not the ones in the body of the Bd. P. (such as Dattatreya etc).
verses.wordMeaning: From V. 90 onwards Bhanda used an Astra for counteracting which God Visnu had to incarnate. Here the Nine Aoataras of Visnu as we know them today are given and not the ones in the body of the Bd. P. (such as Dattatreya etc).
verses.commentary: Sense: From V. 90 onwards Bhanda used an Astra for counteracting which God Visnu had to incarnate. Here the Nine Aoataras of Visnu as we know them today are given and not the ones in the body of the Bd. P. (such as Dattatreya etc).

verses.sanskrit: ललिताध्यानसंपन्नो ललितापूजनोत्सुकः । वितन्वंल्लरिताभक्तेः स्वायुषो दीर्घ दीर्घताम् । कालमृत्युप्रमुख्यैश्च किङ्करैरपि सेवितः
verses.transliteration: lalitādhyānasaṃpanno lalitāpūjanotsukaḥ / vitanvaṃllaritābhakteḥ svāyuṣo dīrgha dīrghatām / kālamṛtyupramukhyaiśca kiṅkarairapi sevitaḥ
verses.translation: The Saktis who were supported by him by means of that huge skull-like shell of large area became delighted. They discarded their fear ofthe Sagara (sea) missile.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis who were supported by him by means of that huge skull-like shell of large area became delighted. They discarded their fear ofthe Sagara (sea) missile.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis who were supported by him by means of that huge skull-like shell of large area became delighted. They discarded their fear ofthe Sagara (sea) missile.

verses.sanskrit: महाकालीमहाकालौ ललिताज्ञाप्रवर्त्तकौ । विश्वं कलयतः कृत्स्नं प्रथमे ऽध्वनि वासिनौ
verses.transliteration: mahākālīmahākālau lalitājñāpravarttakau / viśvaṃ kalayataḥ kṛtsnaṃ prathame 'dhvani vāsinau
verses.translation: Arnavdstra

verses.sanskrit: कालचक्रं मतङ्गस्य तस्यैवासनतां गताम् । चतुरावरणोपेतं मध्ये बिन्दुमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: kālacakraṃ mataṅgasya tasyaivāsanatāṃ gatām / caturāvaraṇopetaṃ madhye bindumanoharam
verses.translation: Hiranyaksa

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकोणंपञ्चकोणं च षोडशच्छदपङ्कजम् । अष्टारपङ्कजं चैवं महाकालस्तु मध्यगः
verses.transliteration: trikoṇaṃpañcakoṇaṃ ca ṣoḍaśacchadapaṅkajam / aṣṭārapaṅkajaṃ caivaṃ mahākālastu madhyagaḥ
verses.translation: Hiranyakasipu
verses.wordMeaning: Hiranyakasipu
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyakasipu

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकोणे तु महाकाल्या महासंध्या महानिशा । एतास्तिस्रो महादेव्यो महाकालस्य शक्तयः
verses.transliteration: trikoṇe tu mahākālyā mahāsaṃdhyā mahāniśā / etāstisro mahādevyo mahākālasya śaktayaḥ
verses.translation: Ballndra (Bali)
verses.wordMeaning: Ballndra (Bali)
verses.commentary: Sense: Ballndra (Bali)

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव पञ्चकोणाग्रे प्रत्यूषश्च पितृप्रसूः । प्राह्णापराह्णमध्याह्नाः पञ्च कालस्य शक्तयः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva pañcakoṇāgre pratyūṣaśca pitṛprasūḥ / prāhṇāparāhṇamadhyāhnāḥ pañca kālasya śaktayaḥ
verses.translation: Sahasrarjuna
verses.wordMeaning: Sahasrarjuna
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahasrarjuna

verses.sanskrit: अथ षोडशपत्राब्जे स्थिता शक्तीर्मुने शृणु । दिनमिश्रा तमिस्रा च ज्योत्स्नी चैव तु पक्षिणी
verses.transliteration: atha ṣoḍaśapatrābje sthitā śaktīrmune śṛṇu / dinamiśrā tamisrā ca jyotsnī caiva tu pakṣiṇī
verses.translation: Paulastya (Havana)
verses.wordMeaning: Paulastya (Havana)
verses.commentary: Sense: Paulastya (Havana)

verses.sanskrit: प्रदोषा च निशीथा च प्रहरा पूर्णिमापि च । राका चानुमतिश्चैव तथैवामावस्यिका पुनः
verses.transliteration: pradoṣā ca niśīthā ca praharā pūrṇimāpi ca / rākā cānumatiścaiva tathaivāmāvasyikā punaḥ
verses.translation: Rajasura (A great number of demons were born as kings
verses.wordMeaning: Rajasura (A great number of demons were born as kings
verses.commentary: Sense: Rajasura (A great number of demons were born as kings

verses.sanskrit: सिनीवाली कुहूर्भद्रा उपरागा च षोडशी । एता षोडशमात्रस्थाः शक्तयः षोडश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sinīvālī kuhūrbhadrā uparāgā ca ṣoḍaśī / etā ṣoḍaśamātrasthāḥ śaktayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Kali missile (Buddha is not mentioned here)
verses.wordMeaning: Kali missile (Buddha is not mentioned here)
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali missile (Buddha is not mentioned here)

verses.sanskrit: कला काष्ठा निमेषाश्च क्षणाश्चैव लवास्त्रुटिः । मुहुर्ताः कुतपाहोरा शुक्लपक्षस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kalā kāṣṭhā nimeṣāśca kṣaṇāścaiva lavāstruṭiḥ / muhurtāḥ kutapāhorā śuklapakṣastathaiva ca
verses.translation: The lord then quaffed the entire quantity of water in the ocean.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord then quaffed the entire quantity of water in the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord then quaffed the entire quantity of water in the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षायनाश्चैव विषुवा च त्रयोदशी । संवत्सरा च परिवत्सरेडावत्सरापि च
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣāyanāścaiva viṣuvā ca trayodaśī / saṃvatsarā ca parivatsareḍāvatsarāpi ca
verses.translation: Crores and crores of those Hiranyaksas were utterly annihilated when they were smashed and crushed as well as torn asunder by that snouted Boar as hard as adamant.
verses.wordMeaning: Crores and crores of those Hiranyaksas were utterly annihilated when they were smashed and crushed as well as torn asunder by that snouted Boar as hard as adamant.
verses.commentary: Sense: Crores and crores of those Hiranyaksas were utterly annihilated when they were smashed and crushed as well as torn asunder by that snouted Boar as hard as adamant.

verses.sanskrit: एताःषोडश पत्राब्जवासिन्यः शक्तयः स्मृताः । इद्वत्सरा ततश्चेन्दुवत्सरावत्सरे ऽपि च
verses.transliteration: etāḥṣoḍaśa patrābjavāsinyaḥ śaktayaḥ smṛtāḥ / idvatsarā tataścenduvatsarāvatsare 'pi ca
verses.translation: Bhanda, the great Asura, thendischarged against the goddess Lalita the extremely dreadful missile Ballndra that was destructive of all deities.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanda, the great Asura, thendischarged against the goddess Lalita the extremely dreadful missile Ballndra that was destructive of all deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanda, the great Asura, thendischarged against the goddess Lalita the extremely dreadful missile Ballndra that was destructive of all deities.

verses.sanskrit: तिथिर्वारांश्च नक्षत्रं योगाश्च करणानि च । एतास्तु शक्तयो नागपत्रांभोरुहसंस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tithirvārāṃśca nakṣatraṃ yogāśca karaṇāni ca / etāstu śaktayo nāgapatrāṃbhoruhasaṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: For destroying the pride of that missile, hundreds of Vamanas came out from the highly powerful tip of the

verses.sanskrit: कलिः कल्पा च कलना काली चेति चतुष्टयम् । द्वारपालकतां प्राप्तं कालच क्रस्य भास्वतः
verses.transliteration: kaliḥ kalpā ca kalanā kālī ceti catuṣṭayam / dvārapālakatāṃ prāptaṃ kālaca krasya bhāsvataḥ
verses.translation: In the course of battle, Bhanda, the Daitya, discharged Haihaya missile. From that were born thousands and crores of Arjunas with thousand hands.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of battle, Bhanda, the Daitya, discharged Haihaya missile. From that were born thousands and crores of Arjunas with thousand hands.

verses.sanskrit: एता महाकालदेव्यो मदप्रहसिताननाः । मदिरापूर्णचषकमशेषं चारुणप्रभम् । दधानाः श्यामलाकाराः सर्वाः कालस्य योषितः
verses.transliteration: etā mahākāladevyo madaprahasitānanāḥ / madirāpūrṇacaṣakamaśeṣaṃ cāruṇaprabham / dadhānāḥ śyāmalākārāḥ sarvāḥ kālasya yoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: When they were destroyed, Asura Bhanda became highly furious. He discharged the dreadful Kali missile that caused violation and transgression of virtue.
verses.wordMeaning: When they were destroyed, Asura Bhanda became highly furious. He discharged the dreadful Kali missile that caused violation and transgression of virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were destroyed, Asura Bhanda became highly furious. He discharged the dreadful Kali missile that caused violation and transgression of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: ललितापूजनध्यानजपस्तोत्रपरायणाः । निषेवन्ते महाकालं कालचक्रासनस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: lalitāpūjanadhyānajapastotraparāyaṇāḥ / niṣevante mahākālaṃ kālacakrāsanasthitam
verses.translation: When all the miraculous missiles were thus destroyed, the evil-minded (Asuras) discharged the missile of Mahamoha (great delusion and fainting). The Saktis. swooned on account of that.
verses.wordMeaning: When all the miraculous missiles were thus destroyed, the evil-minded (Asuras) discharged the missile of Mahamoha (great delusion and fainting). The Saktis. swooned on account of that.
verses.commentary: Sense: When all the miraculous missiles were thus destroyed, the evil-minded (Asuras) discharged the missile of Mahamoha (great delusion and fainting). The Saktis. swooned on account of that.

verses.transliteration: atha kalpakavaṭyāstu rakṣakaḥ kumbhasaṃbhava / vasantarturmahātejā lalitāpriyakiṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: By discharging the Sambhava missile (that of Lord (Siva) the mother split up the Mahamoha missile. As the great battle took place thus with the continuous flow of missiles and counter missiles the sun, the lord of rays was about to reach the western mountain (the mountain ofsetting).

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पसिंहासनासीनः पुष्पमाध्वीमदारुणाः । पुष्पायुधः पुष्पभूषः पुष्पच्छत्रेण शोभितः
verses.transliteration: puṣpasiṃhāsanāsīnaḥ puṣpamādhvīmadāruṇāḥ / puṣpāyudhaḥ puṣpabhūṣaḥ puṣpacchatreṇa śobhitaḥ

verses.transliteration: madhuśrīrmādhavaśrīśca dve devyau tasya dīvyataḥ / prasūnamadirāmatte prasūnaśaralālase
verses.translation: Then by the Pasupata missile which had the lustre of the enkindled fire of Destruction ofthe world the great queen smashed and crushed forty generals.
verses.wordMeaning: Then by the Pasupata missile which had the lustre of the enkindled fire of Destruction ofthe world the great queen smashed and crushed forty generals.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्र श्रीश्च शुचिश्रीश्च तस्य भार्ये उभे स्मृते । हरिचन्दनवाटी तु मुने वर्षर्तुना स्थिता
verses.transliteration: śukra śrīśca śuciśrīśca tasya bhārye ubhe smṛte / haricandanavāṭī tu mune varṣartunā sthitā
verses.translation: All her soldiers had been subjected to fatigue on account of their work in the battle-field (viz. fighting). They had been burned by the fire of powerful arrows of Bhanda, the Asura. When the sun set, Sri Devata whose prowess was well-renowned brought them to her camp.
