verses.sanskrit: मिलित्वा चैव संख्याताः षष्ट्युत्तरशतत्रयम् । एवं सप्तसु शालेषु पालिकाश्चक्रदेवताः
verses.transliteration: militvā caiva saṃkhyātāḥ ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatrayam / evaṃ saptasu śāleṣu pālikāścakradevatāḥ
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.wordMeaning: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: नामकीर्तनपूर्वं तु प्रोक्तस्तुभ्यं प्रपृच्छते । अन्येषामपि शालानामुपादानं तु पूरकम् । विस्तारं तत्र शक्तिं च कथयाम्यवधारय
verses.transliteration: nāmakīrtanapūrvaṃ tu proktastubhyaṃ prapṛcchate / anyeṣāmapi śālānāmupādānaṃ tu pūrakam / vistāraṃ tatra śaktiṃ ca kathayāmyavadhāraya
verses.translation: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.wordMeaning: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those men who read this narrative on holy days will attain flourishing excellent fortune. This narrative of Lalita's valour is destructive of all sins. It is sacred and condu- cive to the attainment of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसम्वादे ललितोपाख्याने श्रीनगरत्रिपुरासप्तकक्षापालकदेवताप्रकाशन कथनं नाम द्वात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः हयग्रीव उवाच कथितं सप्तशालानां लक्षणं शिल्पिभिः कृतम् । अथ रत्नमयाः शालाः प्रकीर्त्यन्ते ऽवधारय
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasamvāde lalitopākhyāne śrīnagaratripurāsaptakakṣāpālakadevatāprakāśana kathanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ hayagrīva uvāca kathitaṃ saptaśālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śilpibhiḥ kṛtam / atha ratnamayāḥ śālāḥ prakīrtyante 'vadhāraya
verses.translation: This chapter describes the seven concentric chambers or enclosures built of precious stones — each enclosure built exclusively of the following precious stones — Topaz and gold, rubies, Gonuda ( a gem of four colours
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter describes the seven concentric chambers or enclosures built of precious stones — each enclosure built exclusively of the following precious stones — Topaz and gold, rubies, Gonuda ( a gem of four colours
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter describes the seven concentric chambers or enclosures built of precious stones — each enclosure built exclusively of the following precious stones — Topaz and gold, rubies, Gonuda ( a gem of four colours

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णमयशालस्य पुष्परागमयस्य च । सप्तयोजनमात्रं स्यान्मध्येन्तरमुदात्दृतम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇamayaśālasya puṣparāgamayasya ca / saptayojanamātraṃ syānmadhyentaramudātdṛtam
verses.translation: The intervening space between the enclosure of gold and the enclosure of Topaz is mentioned to be only seven Yojanas. 1
verses.wordMeaning: The intervening space between the enclosure of gold and the enclosure of Topaz is mentioned to be only seven Yojanas. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: The intervening space between the enclosure of gold and the enclosure of Topaz is mentioned to be only seven Yojanas. 1

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सिद्धाःसिद्धनार्यः खेलन्ति मदविह्वलाः । रसै रसायनैश्चापि खड्गैः पादाञ्जनैरपि
verses.transliteration: tatra siddhāḥsiddhanāryaḥ khelanti madavihvalāḥ / rasai rasāyanaiścāpi khaḍgaiḥ pādāñjanairapi
verses.translation: They are endowed with devotion to Lalita and please the great people. They stay there and imbibe different kinds of juicy liquor.
verses.wordMeaning: They are endowed with devotion to Lalita and please the great people. They stay there and imbibe different kinds of juicy liquor.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are endowed with devotion to Lalita and please the great people. They stay there and imbibe different kinds of juicy liquor.

verses.sanskrit: ललितायां भक्तियुक्तास्तर्पयन्तो महाजनान् । वसंति विविधास्तत्र पिबन्ति मदिरारसान्
verses.transliteration: lalitāyāṃ bhaktiyuktāstarpayanto mahājanān / vasaṃti vividhāstatra pibanti madirārasān
verses.translation: The arrangements of the doorway of enclosures built of topaz and other gems, are as before. The panels of doors, bolts and Gopuras> it should be known, are made of topaz etc. sparkling like the moon and the sun at the height of their lustre.
verses.wordMeaning: The arrangements of the doorway of enclosures built of topaz and other gems, are as before. The panels of doors, bolts and Gopuras> it should be known, are made of topaz etc. sparkling like the moon and the sun at the height of their lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: The arrangements of the doorway of enclosures built of topaz and other gems, are as before. The panels of doors, bolts and Gopuras> it should be known, are made of topaz etc. sparkling like the moon and the sun at the height of their lustre.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्परागादिशालानां पूर्ववद्द्वारकॢप्तयः । पुष्परागादिशालेषु कवाटार्गलगोपुरम् । पुष्परागादिजं ज्ञेयमुच्चेन्द्वादित्यभास्वरम्
verses.transliteration: puṣparāgādiśālānāṃ pūrvavaddvārakḷptayaḥ / puṣparāgādiśāleṣu kavāṭārgalagopuram / puṣparāgādijaṃ jñeyamuccendvādityabhāsvaram
verses.translation: The space in between the circular golden rampart and that of topaz is also remembered as made of topaz.
verses.wordMeaning: The space in between the circular golden rampart and that of topaz is also remembered as made of topaz.
verses.commentary: Sense: The space in between the circular golden rampart and that of topaz is also remembered as made of topaz.

verses.sanskrit: हेमप्राकारचक्रस्य पुष्परागमयस्य च । अन्तरे या स्वली सापि पुष्परागमयी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: hemaprākāracakrasya puṣparāgamayasya ca / antare yā svalī sāpi puṣparāgamayī smṛtā
verses.translation: In all the great enclosures and chambers described subsequently, the birds and lakes have the same uniform colour.
verses.wordMeaning: In all the great enclosures and chambers described subsequently, the birds and lakes have the same uniform colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the great enclosures and chambers described subsequently, the birds and lakes have the same uniform colour.

verses.sanskrit: वक्ष्यमाणमहाशालाकक्षासु निखिलास्वपि । तद्वर्णाः पक्षिणस्तत्र तद्वर्णानि सरांसि च
verses.transliteration: vakṣyamāṇamahāśālākakṣāsu nikhilāsvapi / tadvarṇāḥ pakṣiṇastatra tadvarṇāni sarāṃsi ca
verses.translation: VV.2-9 describe the enclosure of gold and topaz. The residents of
verses.wordMeaning: VV.2-9 describe the enclosure of gold and topaz. The residents of
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.2-9 describe the enclosure of gold and topaz. The residents of

verses.sanskrit: तद्वर्मसलिला नद्यस्तद्वर्णाश्च मणिद्रुमाः । सिद्धजातिषु ये देवीमुपास्य विविधैः क्रमै । त्यक्तवन्तो वपुः पूर्वं ते सिद्धास्तत्र सांगनाः
verses.transliteration: tadvarmasalilā nadyastadvarṇāśca maṇidrumāḥ / siddhajātiṣu ye devīmupāsya vividhaiḥ kramai / tyaktavanto vapuḥ pūrvaṃ te siddhāstatra sāṃganāḥ
verses.translation: Within the great enclosure of topaz and seven Yojanas from it is the square enclosure made of ruby. 1 2
verses.wordMeaning: Within the great enclosure of topaz and seven Yojanas from it is the square enclosure made of ruby. 1 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the great enclosure of topaz and seven Yojanas from it is the square enclosure made of ruby. 1 2

verses.sanskrit: ललितामन्त्रजप्तारो ललिताक्रमतत्पराः । ते सर्वे ललितादेव्या नामकीर्तनकारिणः
verses.transliteration: lalitāmantrajaptāro lalitākramatatparāḥ / te sarve lalitādevyā nāmakīrtanakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Womenfolk of the Caranas have beautiful limbs. They are desirous of getting inebriated. They frequently sing the musical compositions eulogising goddess LalitA.
verses.wordMeaning: Womenfolk of the Caranas have beautiful limbs. They are desirous of getting inebriated. They frequently sing the musical compositions eulogising goddess LalitA.
verses.commentary: Sense: Womenfolk of the Caranas have beautiful limbs. They are desirous of getting inebriated. They frequently sing the musical compositions eulogising goddess LalitA.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्परागमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने । पद्मरागमयः शालश्चतुरस्रः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: puṣparāgamahāśālāntare mārutayojane / padmarāgamayaḥ śālaścaturasraḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Within the great enclosure of rubies and seven Yojanas from it, is the great enclosure of the gem called G omeda* (a gem from Himalayas, of four colours ).
verses.wordMeaning: Within the great enclosure of rubies and seven Yojanas from it, is the great enclosure of the gem called G omeda* (a gem from Himalayas, of four colours ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the great enclosure of rubies and seven Yojanas from it, is the great enclosure of the gem called G omeda* (a gem from Himalayas, of four colours ).

verses.sanskrit: स्थली च पद्मरागढ्या गोपुराद्यं च तन्मयम् । तत्र चारणदेशस्थाः पूर्वदेहविनाशतः । सिद्धिं प्राप्ता महाराज्ञीचरमाम्भोजसेवकाः
verses.transliteration: sthalī ca padmarāgaḍhyā gopurādyaṃ ca tanmayam / tatra cāraṇadeśasthāḥ pūrvadehavināśataḥ / siddhiṃ prāptā mahārājñīcaramāmbhojasevakāḥ
verses.translation: By means of notes on the lutes, they sing about the good qualities of the empress. They take excessive interest in the sole enjoyment of amorous pleasures. Their bodies resemble the body of the god of love. They are gentle-natured. They have great devotion towards Sridevi.
verses.wordMeaning: By means of notes on the lutes, they sing about the good qualities of the empress. They take excessive interest in the sole enjoyment of amorous pleasures. Their bodies resemble the body of the god of love. They are gentle-natured. They have great devotion towards Sridevi.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of notes on the lutes, they sing about the good qualities of the empress. They take excessive interest in the sole enjoyment of amorous pleasures. Their bodies resemble the body of the god of love. They are gentle-natured. They have great devotion towards Sridevi.

verses.sanskrit: चारणीनां स्त्रियश्चापि चार्वङ्ग्यो मदलालसाः । गायन्ति ललितादेव्या गीतिबन्धान्मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: cāraṇīnāṃ striyaścāpi cārvaṅgyo madalālasāḥ / gāyanti lalitādevyā gītibandhānmuhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: VV. 10*13 describe the enclosure of rubies. It is inhabited by C&ratias.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 10*13 describe the enclosure of rubies. It is inhabited by C&ratias.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 10*13 describe the enclosure of rubies. It is inhabited by C&ratias.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव कल्पवृक्षाणां मध्यस्थवेदिकास्थिताः । भर्तृभिः सहचारिण्यः पिबन्ति मधुरं मधु
verses.transliteration: tatraiva kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ madhyasthavedikāsthitāḥ / bhartṛbhiḥ sahacāriṇyaḥ pibanti madhuraṃ madhu
verses.translation: VV. 14-26 describe the enclosure of gomeda. It is populated by crores of Yoginls and Bhairavas. Its special feature is the residence of Apsaras (Heavenly courtesans) and Gandharvas all drunkards but meditate upon Laliti. VV. 24-26 enumerate ihe fourteen sources of origin of these divine damsels.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 14-26 describe the enclosure of gomeda. It is populated by crores of Yoginls and Bhairavas. Its special feature is the residence of Apsaras (Heavenly courtesans) and Gandharvas all drunkards but meditate upon Laliti. VV.…
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 14-26 describe the enclosure of gomeda. It is populated by crores of Yoginls and Bhairavas. Its special feature is the residence of Apsaras (Heavenly courtesans) and Gandharvas all drunkards but meditate upon Laliti. VV.…

verses.sanskrit: पद्मरागमहाशालान्तरे मरुतयोजने । गोमेदकमहाशालः पूर्वशालासमाकृतिः । अतितुङ्गो हीरशालस्तयोर्मध्ये च हीरभूः
verses.transliteration: padmarāgamahāśālāntare marutayojane / gomedakamahāśālaḥ pūrvaśālāsamākṛtiḥ / atituṅgo hīraśālastayormadhye ca hīrabhūḥ
verses.translation: O holy lord, recount the fourteen sources of origin of those Apsaras (celestial damsels ), O highly intelligent one, O great storehouse of all lores.
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, recount the fourteen sources of origin of those Apsaras (celestial damsels ), O highly intelligent one, O great storehouse of all lores.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, recount the fourteen sources of origin of those Apsaras (celestial damsels ), O highly intelligent one, O great storehouse of all lores.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवीं समभ्यर्च्य पूर्वजन्मनि कुम्भज । वसन्त्यप्सरसां वृन्दैः साकं गन्धर्वपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: tatra devīṃ samabhyarcya pūrvajanmani kumbhaja / vasantyapsarasāṃ vṛndaiḥ sākaṃ gandharvapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: The Kinnaras and the Kimpurugas, O sage, have resorted to the region of diamond. 1 They are accompanied by their womanfolk and they are maddened with inebriation.
verses.wordMeaning: The Kinnaras and the Kimpurugas, O sage, have resorted to the region of diamond. 1 They are accompanied by their womanfolk and they are maddened with inebriation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kinnaras and the Kimpurugas, O sage, have resorted to the region of diamond. 1 They are accompanied by their womanfolk and they are maddened with inebriation.

verses.sanskrit: महाराज्ञीगुणगणान्गायन्तो वल्लकीस्वनैः । कामभोजैकरसिकाः कामसन्निभविग्रहाः । सुकुमारप्रकृतयः श्रीदेवीभक्तिशालिनः
verses.transliteration: mahārājñīguṇagaṇāngāyanto vallakīsvanaiḥ / kāmabhojaikarasikāḥ kāmasannibhavigrahāḥ / sukumāraprakṛtayaḥ śrīdevībhaktiśālinaḥ
verses.translation: They get rid of all their sins by repeating the Mantra of the empress (La litk). O Pot-born sage, they stay there dancing and singing.
verses.wordMeaning: They get rid of all their sins by repeating the Mantra of the empress (La litk). O Pot-born sage, they stay there dancing and singing.
verses.commentary: Sense: They get rid of all their sins by repeating the Mantra of the empress (La litk). O Pot-born sage, they stay there dancing and singing.

verses.sanskrit: गोमेदकस्य शालस्तुपूर्वशालसमाकृतिः । तदन्तरे योगिनीनां भैरवाणां च कोटयः । कालसङ्कर्षणीमंबां सेवन्ते तत्र भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: gomedakasya śālastupūrvaśālasamākṛtiḥ / tadantare yoginīnāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ ca koṭayaḥ / kālasaṅkarṣaṇīmaṃbāṃ sevante tatra bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: Those excellent men who are devotees of Lalita ParameSani and drink its water, attain adamantine physical
verses.wordMeaning: Those excellent men who are devotees of Lalita ParameSani and drink its water, attain adamantine physical
verses.commentary: Sense: Those excellent men who are devotees of Lalita ParameSani and drink its water, attain adamantine physical

verses.sanskrit: गोमेदकमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने । उर्वशी मेनका चैव रम्भा चालंबुषा तथा
verses.transliteration: gomedakamahāśālāntare mārutayojane / urvaśī menakā caiva rambhā cālaṃbuṣā tathā
verses.translation: VV.2 7-33 describe the enclosure of diamonds* Its residents are Kinnaras and Kimpurufas.
verses.wordMeaning: VV.2 7-33 describe the enclosure of diamonds* Its residents are Kinnaras and Kimpurufas.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.2 7-33 describe the enclosure of diamonds* Its residents are Kinnaras and Kimpurufas.

verses.sanskrit: मञ्जुघोषा सुकेशी च पूर्वचित्तिर्घृताचिका । कृतस्थला च विश्वाची पुञ्जिकस्थलया सह
verses.transliteration: mañjughoṣā sukeśī ca pūrvacittirghṛtācikā / kṛtasthalā ca viśvācī puñjikasthalayā saha
verses.translation: The goddess rose from its waters, gave the thunder- bolt to the enemy of Vala (i.e. Indra) and vanished once again. Gratified thereby he too went back to the heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess rose from its waters, gave the thunder- bolt to the enemy of Vala (i.e. Indra) and vanished once again. Gratified thereby he too went back to the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess rose from its waters, gave the thunder- bolt to the enemy of Vala (i.e. Indra) and vanished once again. Gratified thereby he too went back to the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तिलोत्तमेति देवानां वेश्या एतादृशो ऽपराः । गन्धर्वैः सह नव्यानि कल्पवृक्षम धूनि च
verses.transliteration: tilottameti devānāṃ veśyā etādṛśo 'parāḥ / gandharvaiḥ saha navyāni kalpavṛkṣama dhūni ca
verses.translation: Within the enclosure of diamond and seven Yojanas from it is the lofty VaiduryaSala (Enclosure of Lapis Lazuli. 1 ). It has Gopuras as mentioned before. The land there is also made of Lapis Lazuli. It has sparkling features.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the enclosure of diamond and seven Yojanas from it is the lofty VaiduryaSala (Enclosure of Lapis Lazuli. 1 ). It has Gopuras as mentioned before. The land there is also made of Lapis Lazuli. It has sparkling features.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the enclosure of diamond and seven Yojanas from it is the lofty VaiduryaSala (Enclosure of Lapis Lazuli. 1 ). It has Gopuras as mentioned before. The land there is also made of Lapis Lazuli. It has sparkling features.

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्त्यो ललितादेवीं ध्यायन्त्यश्च मुहुर्मुहुः । स्वसौभाग्यविवृद्ध्यर्थं गुणयन्त्यश्च तन्मनुम्
verses.transliteration: pibantyo lalitādevīṃ dhyāyantyaśca muhurmuhuḥ / svasaubhāgyavivṛddhyarthaṃ guṇayantyaśca tanmanum
verses.translation: Those residents of Pa tala who had been aspirants for spiritual enlightenment and worshippers of Sridevi reside there in the forms of Siddhas with abundant happiness.
verses.wordMeaning: Those residents of Pa tala who had been aspirants for spiritual enlightenment and worshippers of Sridevi reside there in the forms of Siddhas with abundant happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those residents of Pa tala who had been aspirants for spiritual enlightenment and worshippers of Sridevi reside there in the forms of Siddhas with abundant happiness.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशसुचोत्पन्ना स्थानेष्वप्सरसो ऽखिलाः । तत्रैव देवीमर्चन्त्यो वसंति मुदिताशयाः
verses.transliteration: caturdaśasucotpannā sthāneṣvapsaraso 'khilāḥ / tatraiva devīmarcantyo vasaṃti muditāśayāḥ
verses.translation: There, in the chamber of Lapis Lazuli, the rivers have icy chill waters. The waters in the lakes have sparkling lustre free from dirt. The lakes are adorned with cranes, swans and lotuses.
verses.wordMeaning: There, in the chamber of Lapis Lazuli, the rivers have icy chill waters. The waters in the lakes have sparkling lustre free from dirt. The lakes are adorned with cranes, swans and lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, in the chamber of Lapis Lazuli, the rivers have icy chill waters. The waters in the lakes have sparkling lustre free from dirt. The lakes are adorned with cranes, swans and lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच चतुर्दशापि जन्मानि तासामप्सरसां विभो । कीर्तय त्वं महाप्राज्ञ सर्वविद्यामहानिधे
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca caturdaśāpi janmāni tāsāmapsarasāṃ vibho / kīrtaya tvaṃ mahāprājña sarvavidyāmahānidhe
verses.translation: The mansions are divine and embellished with Lapis Lazuli gems. Those serpents and Asuras play there along with their womenfolk.
verses.wordMeaning: The mansions are divine and embellished with Lapis Lazuli gems. Those serpents and Asuras play there along with their womenfolk.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mansions are divine and embellished with Lapis Lazuli gems. Those serpents and Asuras play there along with their womenfolk.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच ब्राह्मणो हृदयं कामो मृत्युरुर्वी च मारुतः । तपनस्य कराश्चन्द्रकरो वेदाश्च पावकः
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca brāhmaṇo hṛdayaṃ kāmo mṛtyururvī ca mārutaḥ / tapanasya karāścandrakaro vedāśca pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 41-49 describe the enclosure of Sapphire.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 41-49 describe the enclosure of Sapphire.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 41-49 describe the enclosure of Sapphire.

verses.sanskrit: सौदामिनी च पीयूषं दक्षकन्या जलं तथा । जन्मनः कारणान्येतान्या मनन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: saudāminī ca pīyūṣaṃ dakṣakanyā jalaṃ tathā / janmanaḥ kāraṇānyetānyā mananti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Those people of earthly world who had attained mastery over Lalita's Mantra attain the chamber of sapphire on giving up their bodies and stay there.
verses.wordMeaning: Those people of earthly world who had attained mastery over Lalita's Mantra attain the chamber of sapphire on giving up their bodies and stay there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those people of earthly world who had attained mastery over Lalita's Mantra attain the chamber of sapphire on giving up their bodies and stay there.

verses.sanskrit: गीर्वाणगण्यनारीणां स्फुरत्सौभाग्यसंपदाम् । एताः समस्ता गन्धर्वैः सार्धमर्चन्ति चक्रिणीम्
verses.transliteration: gīrvāṇagaṇyanārīṇāṃ sphuratsaubhāgyasaṃpadām / etāḥ samastā gandharvaiḥ sārdhamarcanti cakriṇīm
verses.translation: When their Karmans become exhausted they go back to their human bodies on the earth. Enduced with the previous Vdsana (imprints of former actions) they once again worship CakrinT. Again they go to the great enclosure of sapphire in Srinagar a.
verses.wordMeaning: When their Karmans become exhausted they go back to their human bodies on the earth. Enduced with the previous Vdsana (imprints of former actions) they once again worship CakrinT. Again they go to the great enclosure of sapphire in Srinagar a.
verses.commentary: Sense: When their Karmans become exhausted they go back to their human bodies on the earth. Enduced with the previous Vdsana (imprints of former actions) they once again worship CakrinT. Again they go to the great enclosure of sapphire in Srinagar a.

verses.sanskrit: किन्नराः सह नारीभिस्तथा किंपुरुषा मुने । स्त्रीभिः सह मदोन्मत्ता हीरकस्थलमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: kinnarāḥ saha nārībhistathā kiṃpuruṣā mune / strībhiḥ saha madonmattā hīrakasthalamāśritāḥ
verses.translation: The description of this inner-most enclosure is important. It mentions the fame of the river Tamrapanpl for pearl-fisheries. The mention of the rivers of Tamilnad only confirms the author's native Province. It gives the distribution of eight quarters to traditional Dik-P&las ( guardians of the quarters) such as Indr a, Agni, Yam a etc. Under Yama's jurisdiction are hells which too are enumerated.
verses.wordMeaning: The description of this inner-most enclosure is important. It mentions the fame of the river Tamrapanpl for pearl-fisheries. The mention of the rivers of Tamilnad only confirms the author's native Province.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The description of this inner-most enclosure is important. It mentions the fame of the river Tamrapanpl for pearl-fisheries. The mention of the rivers of Tamilnad only confirms the author's native Province.…

verses.sanskrit: महाराज्ञीमन्त्रजापैर्विधूताशेष कल्मषाः । नृत्यन्तश्चैव गायन्तो वर्तन्ते कुंभसंभव
verses.transliteration: mahārājñīmantrajāpairvidhūtāśeṣa kalmaṣāḥ / nṛtyantaścaiva gāyanto vartante kuṃbhasaṃbhava
verses.translation: In the eight directions beginning with the east are the worlds of Sakra etc. with their doorways unitedly facing the pearl enclosure along its periphery.
verses.wordMeaning: In the eight directions beginning with the east are the worlds of Sakra etc. with their doorways unitedly facing the pearl enclosure along its periphery.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the eight directions beginning with the east are the worlds of Sakra etc. with their doorways unitedly facing the pearl enclosure along its periphery.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव हीरकक्षोण्यां वज्रा नाम नदी मुने । वज्रकारैर्निबिडिता भासमाना तटद्रुमैः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva hīrakakṣoṇyāṃ vajrā nāma nadī mune / vajrakārairnibiḍitā bhāsamānā taṭadrumaiḥ
verses.translation: His assistant official Guha implements the Law and Order of SridevI through the soldiers of Yama with Citragupta as their leader.
verses.wordMeaning: His assistant official Guha implements the Law and Order of SridevI through the soldiers of Yama with Citragupta as their leader.
verses.commentary: Sense: His assistant official Guha implements the Law and Order of SridevI through the soldiers of Yama with Citragupta as their leader.

verses.sanskrit: वज्ररत्नैकसिकता वज्रद्रवमयोदका । सदा वहति सा सिंधुः परितस्तत्र पावनी
verses.transliteration: vajraratnaikasikatā vajradravamayodakā / sadā vahati sā siṃdhuḥ paritastatra pāvanī
verses.translation: To the west of it (i.e. in the south-west corner) is Nirrti who holds a sword. Resorting to the Rak$asa world, he worships Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: To the west of it (i.e. in the south-west corner) is Nirrti who holds a sword. Resorting to the Rak$asa world, he worships Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the west of it (i.e. in the south-west corner) is Nirrti who holds a sword. Resorting to the Rak$asa world, he worships Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: ललितापरमेशान्यां भक्त ये मानवोत्तमाः । ते तस्या उदकं पीत्वा वज्ररूपकलेवराः । दीर्घायुषश्च नीरोगा भवन्ति कलशोद्भव
verses.transliteration: lalitāparameśānyāṃ bhakta ye mānavottamāḥ / te tasyā udakaṃ pītvā vajrarūpakalevarāḥ / dīrghāyuṣaśca nīrogā bhavanti kalaśodbhava
verses.translation: The Saktis of Marutanatha 1 are three viz.: Ida, Pirigala and Susumna. They are always lethargic in their inebriation due to wine.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis of Marutanatha 1 are three viz.: Ida, Pirigala and Susumna. They are always lethargic in their inebriation due to wine.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis of Marutanatha 1 are three viz.: Ida, Pirigala and Susumna. They are always lethargic in their inebriation due to wine.

verses.sanskrit: भण्डासुरेण गलिते मुक्ते वज्रे शतक्रतुः । तरयास्तीरे तपस्तेपे वज्रेशीं प्रति भक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍāsureṇa galite mukte vajre śatakratuḥ / tarayāstīre tapastepe vajreśīṃ prati bhaktimān
verses.translation: The epithet 'Natha' to the wind god shows the influence of Yogic N&tha Cult. Here instead of mentioning five Pr&gas as his Saktis, the Yogic flow of breath in the 'right and left nostrils is noted as his &akti. Even the chief officers of Lalit& are mentioned as 'MantriQl nkthk* and Dapda-natha. This may be due to the influence of the Natha cult.
verses.wordMeaning: The epithet 'Natha' to the wind god shows the influence of Yogic N&tha Cult. Here instead of mentioning five Pr&gas as his Saktis, the Yogic flow of breath in the 'right and left nostrils is noted as his &akti.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The epithet 'Natha' to the wind god shows the influence of Yogic N&tha Cult. Here instead of mentioning five Pr&gas as his Saktis, the Yogic flow of breath in the 'right and left nostrils is noted as his &akti.…

verses.sanskrit: तज्जलादुदिता देवी वज्रं दत्त्वा बलद्विषे । पुनरन्तर्दधेसो ऽपि कृतार्थःस्वर्गमेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: tajjalāduditā devī vajraṃ dattvā baladviṣe / punarantardadheso 'pi kṛtārthaḥsvargameyivān
verses.translation: Kubera, the Lord of Yak$as, of great lustre and glory, resides in Yaksaloka situated to the east of his (Vayu's) world. He is in the middle of the two gateways.
verses.wordMeaning: Kubera, the Lord of Yak$as, of great lustre and glory, resides in Yaksaloka situated to the east of his (Vayu's) world. He is in the middle of the two gateways.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kubera, the Lord of Yak$as, of great lustre and glory, resides in Yaksaloka situated to the east of his (Vayu's) world. He is in the middle of the two gateways.

verses.sanskrit: अथ वज्राख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने । वैदूर्यशाल उत्तुङ्गः पूर्ववद्गोपुरान्वितः । स्थाली च तत्र वैदृर्यनिर्मिता भास्वराकृतिः
verses.transliteration: atha vajrākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane / vaidūryaśāla uttuṅgaḥ pūrvavadgopurānvitaḥ / sthālī ca tatra vaidṛryanirmitā bhāsvarākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Along with Yaksis of charming features and obedient activities, he worships Cakrini with different kinds of wine.
verses.wordMeaning: Along with Yaksis of charming features and obedient activities, he worships Cakrini with different kinds of wine.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with Yaksis of charming features and obedient activities, he worships Cakrini with different kinds of wine.

verses.sanskrit: पातालवासिनो येये श्रीदेव्यर्चनसाधकाः । ते सिद्धमूर्तयस्तत्र वसन्ति सुखमेदुराः
verses.transliteration: pātālavāsino yeye śrīdevyarcanasādhakāḥ / te siddhamūrtayastatra vasanti sukhamedurāḥ
verses.translation: There are Yaksa generals such as Manibhadra, Purnabhadra, Maniman, Manikandhara and others like them in that place.
verses.wordMeaning: There are Yaksa generals such as Manibhadra, Purnabhadra, Maniman, Manikandhara and others like them in that place.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are Yaksa generals such as Manibhadra, Purnabhadra, Maniman, Manikandhara and others like them in that place.

verses.sanskrit: शेषकर्केटकमहापद्मवासुकिशङ्खकाः । तक्षकः शङ्खचूडश्च महादन्तो महाफणः
verses.transliteration: śeṣakarkeṭakamahāpadmavāsukiśaṅkhakāḥ / takṣakaḥ śaṅkhacūḍaśca mahādanto mahāphaṇaḥ
verses.translation: To the east of his world (i.e. North-east corner) is the world of Rudra of great prosperity. He is bedecked in very valuable jewels. He is the presiding deity.
verses.wordMeaning: To the east of his world (i.e. North-east corner) is the world of Rudra of great prosperity. He is bedecked in very valuable jewels. He is the presiding deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the east of his world (i.e. North-east corner) is the world of Rudra of great prosperity. He is bedecked in very valuable jewels. He is the presiding deity.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमादयस्तत्र नागा नागास्त्रयो ऽपि च । बलीन्द्रप्रमुखानां च दैत्यानां धर्मवर्तिनाम् । गणस्तत्र तथा नागैः सार्धं वसति सांगनाः
verses.transliteration: ityevamādayastatra nāgā nāgāstrayo 'pi ca / balīndrapramukhānāṃ ca daityānāṃ dharmavartinām / gaṇastatra tathā nāgaiḥ sārdhaṃ vasati sāṃganāḥ
verses.translation: All of them have highly refulgent limbs. They are proud of their fresh youthfulness. They are engrossed in the meditation of Lalita. They are perpetually lethargic in their inebriation due to wines.
verses.wordMeaning: All of them have highly refulgent limbs. They are proud of their fresh youthfulness. They are engrossed in the meditation of Lalita. They are perpetually lethargic in their inebriation due to wines.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them have highly refulgent limbs. They are proud of their fresh youthfulness. They are engrossed in the meditation of Lalita. They are perpetually lethargic in their inebriation due to wines.

verses.sanskrit: ललितामन्त्र जप्तारो ललिताशास्त्रदीक्षिताः । ललितापूजका नित्यं वसन्त्यसुरभोगिनः
verses.transliteration: lalitāmantra japtāro lalitāśāstradīkṣitāḥ / lalitāpūjakā nityaṃ vasantyasurabhoginaḥ
verses.translation: The glorious Maharudra who holds the trident is ' served by other Rudras, the chief among whom is Hirayabahu.
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious Maharudra who holds the trident is ' served by other Rudras, the chief among whom is Hirayabahu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious Maharudra who holds the trident is ' served by other Rudras, the chief among whom is Hirayabahu.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वैदूर्यकक्षायां नद्यः शिशिरपाथसः । सरांसिविमलांभांसि सारसालङ्कृतानि च
verses.transliteration: tatra vaidūryakakṣāyāṃ nadyaḥ śiśirapāthasaḥ / sarāṃsivimalāṃbhāṃsi sārasālaṅkṛtāni ca
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: भवनानि तु दिव्यानि वैदूर्यमणिमन्ति च । तेषु क्रीडन्ति ते नागा असुराश्च सहाङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: bhavanāni tu divyāni vaidūryamaṇimanti ca / teṣu krīḍanti te nāgā asurāśca sahāṅganāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: वैदूर्याख्यमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने । इन्द्रनीलमयः शालश्चक्रवाल इवापरः
verses.transliteration: vaidūryākhyamahāśālāntare mārutayojane / indranīlamayaḥ śālaścakravāla ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्यकक्षाभूमिश्च नीलरत्नमयी मुने । तत्र नद्यश्च मधुराः सरांसि शिशिराणि च । नानाविधानि भोग्यानि वस्तूनि सरसान्यपि
verses.transliteration: tanmadhyakakṣābhūmiśca nīlaratnamayī mune / tatra nadyaśca madhurāḥ sarāṃsi śiśirāṇi ca / nānāvidhāni bhogyāni vastūni sarasānyapi
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ये भूलोकगता मर्त्या ललितामन्त्रसाधकाः । ते देहान्ते शक्रनीलकक्ष्यां प्राप्य वसंति वै
verses.transliteration: ye bhūlokagatā martyā lalitāmantrasādhakāḥ / te dehānte śakranīlakakṣyāṃ prāpya vasaṃti vai
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दिव्यानि वस्तूनि भुञ्जाना वनितासखाः । पिबन्तो मधुरं मद्यं नृत्यन्तो भक्तिनिर्भराः
verses.transliteration: tatra divyāni vastūni bhuñjānā vanitāsakhāḥ / pibanto madhuraṃ madyaṃ nṛtyanto bhaktinirbharāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: सरस्सु तेषु सिंधूनां कुलेषु कलशोद्भव । लतागृहेषु रम्येषु मन्दिरेषु महर्द्धिषु
verses.transliteration: sarassu teṣu siṃdhūnāṃ kuleṣu kalaśodbhava / latāgṛheṣu ramyeṣu mandireṣu maharddhiṣu
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: सदा जपन्तः श्रीदेवी पठन्तश्चापि तद्गुणान् । निवसंति महाभागा नारीभिः परिवेष्टिताः
verses.transliteration: sadā japantaḥ śrīdevī paṭhantaścāpi tadguṇān / nivasaṃti mahābhāgā nārībhiḥ pariveṣṭitāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: कर्मक्षये पुनर्यान्ति भूलोके मानुषीं तनुम् । पूर्ववासनया युक्ताः पुनरर्चन्ति चक्रिणीम् । पुनर्यान्ति श्रीनगरे शक्रनीलमहास्थलीम्
verses.transliteration: karmakṣaye punaryānti bhūloke mānuṣīṃ tanum / pūrvavāsanayā yuktāḥ punararcanti cakriṇīm / punaryānti śrīnagare śakranīlamahāsthalīm
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तत्स्थलस्यैव संपर्काद्रागद्वेषसमुद्भवैः । नीलैर्भावैः सदा युक्ता वर्तन्ते मनुजा मुने
verses.transliteration: tatsthalasyaiva saṃparkādrāgadveṣasamudbhavaiḥ / nīlairbhāvaiḥ sadā yuktā vartante manujā mune
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनर्ज्ञानिनो मर्त्या निर्द्वन्द्वा नियतेन्द्रियाः । ते मुने विस्मयाविष्टाः संविशन्ति महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: ye punarjñānino martyā nirdvandvā niyatendriyāḥ / te mune vismayāviṣṭāḥ saṃviśanti maheśvarīm
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रनीलाख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने । मुक्ताफलमयःशालः पूर्ववद्गोपुरान्वितः
verses.transliteration: indranīlākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane / muktāphalamayaḥśālaḥ pūrvavadgopurānvitaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तभास्वरा स्वच्छा तयोर्मध्ये स्थली मुने । सर्वापि मुक्ताखचिताः शिशिरातिमनोहराः
verses.transliteration: atyantabhāsvarā svacchā tayormadhye sthalī mune / sarvāpi muktākhacitāḥ śiśirātimanoharāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ताम्रपर्णी महापर्णी सदा मुक्ताफलोदका । एवमाद्या महानद्यः प्रवरन्ति महास्थले
verses.transliteration: tāmraparṇī mahāparṇī sadā muktāphalodakā / evamādyā mahānadyaḥ pravaranti mahāsthale
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तासां तीरेषु सर्वे ऽपि देवलोकनिवासिनः । वसंति पूर्वजनुषि श्रीदेवीमन्त्रसाधकाः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ tīreṣu sarve 'pi devalokanivāsinaḥ / vasaṃti pūrvajanuṣi śrīdevīmantrasādhakāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाद्यष्टसु भागेषु लोकाः शक्रादिगोचराः । मुक्ताशालस्य परितः संयुज्य द्वारदेशकान्
verses.transliteration: pūrvādyaṣṭasu bhāgeṣu lokāḥ śakrādigocarāḥ / muktāśālasya paritaḥ saṃyujya dvāradeśakān
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: मुक्ताशालस्य नीलस्य द्वारयोर्मध्यदेशतः । पूर्वभागे शक्रलोकस्तत्कोणे वह्निलोकभूः
verses.transliteration: muktāśālasya nīlasya dvārayormadhyadeśataḥ / pūrvabhāge śakralokastatkoṇe vahnilokabhūḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: याम्यभागे यमपुरं तत्र दण्डधरः प्रभुः । सर्वत्र ललितामन्त्रजापी तीव्रस्वभाववान्
verses.transliteration: yāmyabhāge yamapuraṃ tatra daṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ / sarvatra lalitāmantrajāpī tīvrasvabhāvavān
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञाधरो यमभटैश्चित्रगुप्तपुरोगमैः । सार्धं नियमयत्येव श्रीदेवीसमयं गुहः
verses.transliteration: ājñādharo yamabhaṭaiścitraguptapurogamaiḥ / sārdhaṃ niyamayatyeva śrīdevīsamayaṃ guhaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: गुहशप्तान्दुराचाराल्लंलिताद्वेषकारिणः । कूडभक्तिपरान्मूर्खांस्तब्धानत्यन्तदर्पितान्
verses.transliteration: guhaśaptāndurācārāllaṃlitādveṣakāriṇaḥ / kūḍabhaktiparānmūrkhāṃstabdhānatyantadarpitān
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रचोरान्कुमन्त्रांश्च कुविद्यानघसंश्रयान् । नास्तिकान्पापशीलांश्च वृथैव प्राणिहिंसकान्
verses.transliteration: mantracorānkumantrāṃśca kuvidyānaghasaṃśrayān / nāstikānpāpaśīlāṃśca vṛthaiva prāṇihiṃsakān
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीद्विष्टांल्लोकविद्विष्टान्पाषण्डानां हि पालिनः । कालसूत्रे रौरवे च कुम्भीपाके च कुम्भज
verses.transliteration: strīdviṣṭāṃllokavidviṣṭānpāṣaṇḍānāṃ hi pālinaḥ / kālasūtre raurave ca kumbhīpāke ca kumbhaja
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: असिपत्रवने घोरे कृमिभक्षे प्रतापने । लालाक्षेपे सूचिवेधे तथैवाङ्गारपातने
verses.transliteration: asipatravane ghore kṛmibhakṣe pratāpane / lālākṣepe sūcivedhe tathaivāṅgārapātane
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: एवमादिषु कष्टेषु नरकेषु घटोद्भव । पातयत्याज्ञया तस्याः श्रीदेव्याः स महौजसः
verses.transliteration: evamādiṣu kaṣṭeṣu narakeṣu ghaṭodbhava / pātayatyājñayā tasyāḥ śrīdevyāḥ sa mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे निरृतिः खड्गधारकः । राक्षसं लोकमाश्रित्य वर्तते ललितार्चकः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva paścime bhāge nirṛtiḥ khaḍgadhārakaḥ / rākṣasaṃ lokamāśritya vartate lalitārcakaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चोत्तरभागे तु द्वारयोरन्तस्यले । वारुणं लोकमाश्रित्य वरुणे वर्तते सदा
verses.transliteration: tasya cottarabhāge tu dvārayorantasyale / vāruṇaṃ lokamāśritya varuṇe vartate sadā
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: वारुण्यास्वादनोन्मत्तः शुभ्राङ्गो झषवाहनः । सदा श्रीदेवतामं त्रजापी श्रीक्रमसाधकः
verses.transliteration: vāruṇyāsvādanonmattaḥ śubhrāṅgo jhaṣavāhanaḥ / sadā śrīdevatāmaṃ trajāpī śrīkramasādhakaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेवतादर्शनस्य द्वेषिणः पाशबन्धनैः । बद्ध्वा नयत्यधोमार्गं भक्तानां बन्धमोचकः
verses.transliteration: śrīdevatādarśanasya dveṣiṇaḥ pāśabandhanaiḥ / baddhvā nayatyadhomārgaṃ bhaktānāṃ bandhamocakaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चोत्तरकोणेषु वायुलोको महाद्युतिः । तत्र वायुशरीराश्च सदानन्दमहोदयाः
verses.transliteration: tasya cottarakoṇeṣu vāyuloko mahādyutiḥ / tatra vāyuśarīrāśca sadānandamahodayāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धा दिव्यर्षयश्चैव पवनाभ्यासिनो ऽपरे । गोरक्षप्रमुखाश्चान्ये योगिनो योगतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: siddhā divyarṣayaścaiva pavanābhyāsino 'pare / gorakṣapramukhāścānye yogino yogatatparāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: एतैः सह महासत्त्वक्तत्र श्रीमारुतेश्वरः । सर्वथा भिन्नमूर्तिश्च वर्तते कुम्भसम्भव
verses.transliteration: etaiḥ saha mahāsattvaktatra śrīmāruteśvaraḥ / sarvathā bhinnamūrtiśca vartate kumbhasambhava
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: इडा च पिङ्गला चैव सुषुम्णा तस्य शक्तयः । तिस्रो मारुतनाथस्य सदा मधुमदालसाः
verses.transliteration: iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumṇā tasya śaktayaḥ / tisro mārutanāthasya sadā madhumadālasāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजहस्तो मृगवरे वाहने महति स्थितः । ललितायजनध्यानक्रमपूजनतत्परः
verses.transliteration: dhvajahasto mṛgavare vāhane mahati sthitaḥ / lalitāyajanadhyānakramapūjanatatparaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दपूरिताङ्गीभिरन्याभिः शक्तिभिर्वृतः । स मारुतेश्वरः श्रीमान्सदा जपति चक्रिणीम्
verses.transliteration: ānandapūritāṅgībhiranyābhiḥ śaktibhirvṛtaḥ / sa māruteśvaraḥ śrīmānsadā japati cakriṇīm
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तेन सत्त्वेन कल्पान्ते त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । परागमयतां नीत्वा विनोदयति तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tena sattvena kalpānte trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / parāgamayatāṃ nītvā vinodayati tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्त्वस्य सिद्ध्यर्थं तामेव ललितेश्वरीम् । पूजयन्भावयन्नास्ते सर्वाभरणभूषितः
verses.transliteration: tasya sattvasya siddhyarthaṃ tāmeva laliteśvarīm / pūjayanbhāvayannāste sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तल्लोकपूर्वभागस्थे यक्षलोके महाद्युतिः । यक्षेन्द्रो वसति श्रीमांस्तद्द्वारद्वन्द्वमध्यगः
verses.transliteration: tallokapūrvabhāgasthe yakṣaloke mahādyutiḥ / yakṣendro vasati śrīmāṃstaddvāradvandvamadhyagaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: निधिभिश्च नवाकारैरृद्धिवृद्ध्यादिशक्तिभिः । सहितो ललिताभक्तान्पूरयन्धनसम्पदा
verses.transliteration: nidhibhiśca navākārairṛddhivṛddhyādiśaktibhiḥ / sahito lalitābhaktānpūrayandhanasampadā
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: यक्षीभिश्च मनोज्ञाभिरनुकूलप्रवृत्तिभिः । विविधैर्मधुभेदैश्च सम्पूजयति चक्रिणीम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣībhiśca manojñābhiranukūlapravṛttibhiḥ / vividhairmadhubhedaiśca sampūjayati cakriṇīm
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: मणिभद्रः पूर्णभद्रो मणिमान्माणिकन्धरः । इत्येवमादयो यक्षसेनान्यस्तत्र संति वै
verses.transliteration: maṇibhadraḥ pūrṇabhadro maṇimānmāṇikandharaḥ / ityevamādayo yakṣasenānyastatra saṃti vai
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: तल्लोकपूर्वभागे तु रुद्रलोको महोदयः । अनर्ध्यरत्नखचितस्तत्र रुद्रो ऽधिदेवता
verses.transliteration: tallokapūrvabhāge tu rudraloko mahodayaḥ / anardhyaratnakhacitastatra rudro 'dhidevatā
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: सदैव मन्युना दीप्तः सदा बद्धमहेषुधिः । स्वसमानैर्महासत्त्वैलोङ्कनिर्वाहदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: sadaiva manyunā dīptaḥ sadā baddhamaheṣudhiḥ / svasamānairmahāsattvailoṅkanirvāhadakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: अधिज्यकार्मुकैर्दक्षैः षोडशावरणस्थितैः । आवृतः सततं वक्त्रैर्जपञ्छीदेवतामनुम्
verses.transliteration: adhijyakārmukairdakṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśāvaraṇasthitaiḥ / āvṛtaḥ satataṃ vaktrairjapañchīdevatāmanum
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेवीध्यानसम्पन्नः श्रीदेवीपूजनोत्सुकः । अनेककोटिरुद्राणीगणमण्डितपार्श्वभूः
verses.transliteration: śrīdevīdhyānasampannaḥ śrīdevīpūjanotsukaḥ / anekakoṭirudrāṇīgaṇamaṇḍitapārśvabhūḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ताश्च सर्वाः प्रदीप्ताङ्ग्यो नवयौवनगर्विताः । ललिताध्याननिरनाः सदासवमदालसाः
verses.transliteration: tāśca sarvāḥ pradīptāṅgyo navayauvanagarvitāḥ / lalitādhyānaniranāḥ sadāsavamadālasāḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ताभिश्च साकं स श्रीमान्महारुद्रस्त्रिशूलभृत् । हिरण्यबाहुप्रमुशै रुद्रैरन्यैर्निषेवितः
verses.transliteration: tābhiśca sākaṃ sa śrīmānmahārudrastriśūlabhṛt / hiraṇyabāhupramuśai rudrairanyairniṣevitaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ललितादर्शनभ्रष्टानुद्धतान्गुरुधिक्कृतान् । शूलकोट्या विनिर्भिद्य नेत्रोत्थैः कटुपावकैः
verses.transliteration: lalitādarśanabhraṣṭānuddhatāngurudhikkṛtān / śūlakoṭyā vinirbhidya netrotthaiḥ kaṭupāvakaiḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: दहंस्तेषा वधूभृत्यान्प्रजाश्चैव विनाशयन् । आज्ञाधरो महावीरो ललिताज्ञाप्रपालकः
verses.transliteration: dahaṃsteṣā vadhūbhṛtyānprajāścaiva vināśayan / ājñādharo mahāvīro lalitājñāprapālakaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोके ऽतिरुचिरे वर्तते कुम्भसम्भव । महारुद्रस्य तस्यर्षे परिवाराः प्रमाथिनः
verses.transliteration: rudraloke 'tirucire vartate kumbhasambhava / mahārudrasya tasyarṣe parivārāḥ pramāthinaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ये रुद्रास्तानसंख्यातान्को वा वक्तुं पटुर्भवेत् । ये रुद्रा अधिभूम्यां तु सहस्राणां सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: ye rudrāstānasaṃkhyātānko vā vaktuṃ paṭurbhavet / ye rudrā adhibhūmyāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: दिविये ऽपि च वर्तन्ते सहस्राणां सहस्रशः । येषामन्नमिषश्चव येषां वातास्तथेषवः
verses.transliteration: diviye 'pi ca vartante sahasrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ / yeṣāmannamiṣaścava yeṣāṃ vātāstatheṣavaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: येषां च वर्षमिषवः प्रदीप्ताः पिङ्गलेक्षणाः । अर्णवे चान्तरिक्षे च वर्तमाना महौजसः
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ ca varṣamiṣavaḥ pradīptāḥ piṅgalekṣaṇāḥ / arṇave cāntarikṣe ca vartamānā mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: जटावन्तो मधुष्मन्तो नीलग्रीवा विलोहिताः । ये भूतानामधिभुवो विशिखासः कपर्दिनः
verses.transliteration: jaṭāvanto madhuṣmanto nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ / ye bhūtānāmadhibhuvo viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ये अन्नेषु विविध्यन्ति पात्रेषु पिबतो जनान् । ये पथां रथका रुद्रा ये च तीर्थनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: ye anneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janān / ye pathāṃ rathakā rudrā ye ca tīrthanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रसंख्या ये चान्ये सृकावन्तो निषङ्गिणः । ललिताज्ञाप्रणेतारो दिशो रुद्रा वितस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: sahasrasaṃkhyā ye cānye sṛkāvanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ / lalitājñāpraṇetāro diśo rudrā vitasthire
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे सुमहात्मानः क्षणाद्विश्वत्रयीवहाः । श्रीदेव्या ध्याननिषणाताञ्छ्रीदेवीमन्त्रजापिनः
verses.transliteration: te sarve sumahātmānaḥ kṣaṇādviśvatrayīvahāḥ / śrīdevyā dhyānaniṣaṇātāñchrīdevīmantrajāpinaḥ
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेवतायां भक्ताश्च पालयन्ति कृपालवः । षोडशावरणं चक्रं मुक्ताप्राकारमण्डले
verses.transliteration: śrīdevatāyāṃ bhaktāśca pālayanti kṛpālavaḥ / ṣoḍaśāvaraṇaṃ cakraṃ muktāprākāramaṇḍale
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: आश्रित्य रुद्रास्ते सर्वे महारुद्रं महोदयम् । हिरण्यबाहुप्रमुखा ज्वलन्मन्युमुपासते
verses.transliteration: āśritya rudrāste sarve mahārudraṃ mahodayam / hiraṇyabāhupramukhā jvalanmanyumupāsate
verses.translation: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.wordMeaning: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,
verses.commentary: Sense: He stays thus in the extremely beautiful Rudraloka,

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने पुष्परागप्रकारादिभुक्ताकरान्तसप्तकक्षान्तरकथनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच षोडशावरणं चक्रं किं तद्रुद्राधिदैवतम् । तत्र स्थिताश्च रुद्राः के केन नाम्ना प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne puṣparāgaprakārādibhuktākarāntasaptakakṣāntarakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca ṣoḍaśāvaraṇaṃ cakraṃ kiṃ tadrudrādhidaivatam / tatra sthitāśca rudrāḥ ke kena nāmnā prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: As this verse suggests, this chapter (main portion at least) describes the Cakra of sixteen Avarapas with Rudra (or Maharudra) as the central,
verses.wordMeaning: As this verse suggests, this chapter (main portion at least) describes the Cakra of sixteen Avarapas with Rudra (or Maharudra) as the central,
verses.commentary: Sense: As this verse suggests, this chapter (main portion at least) describes the Cakra of sixteen Avarapas with Rudra (or Maharudra) as the central,

verses.sanskrit: केष्वावरणबिंबेषु किन्नामानो वसंति ते । यौगिकं रौढिकं नाम तेषां ब्रूहि कृपानिधे
verses.transliteration: keṣvāvaraṇabiṃbeṣu kinnāmāno vasaṃti te / yaugikaṃ rauḍhikaṃ nāma teṣāṃ brūhi kṛpānidhe
verses.translation: In which circular outer coverings and with which designation do they stav? O storehouse of mercy! Mention their names with their derivative as well as conventional meanings.
verses.wordMeaning: In which circular outer coverings and with which designation do they stav? O storehouse of mercy! Mention their names with their derivative as well as conventional meanings.
verses.commentary: Sense: In which circular outer coverings and with which designation do they stav? O storehouse of mercy! Mention their names with their derivative as well as conventional meanings.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच तत्र रुद्रा लयः प्रोक्तो मुक्ताजालकनिर्मितः । पञ्चयोजनविस्तारस्तत्संख्यायामशोभितः
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca tatra rudrā layaḥ prokto muktājālakanirmitaḥ / pañcayojanavistārastatsaṃkhyāyāmaśobhitaḥ
verses.translation: The Rudras stationed in the hexagon are Vrksah, Harikefah, PaSupati, Sa§pifijara, Tvisiman and Pathinampati.
verses.wordMeaning: The Rudras stationed in the hexagon are Vrksah, Harikefah, PaSupati, Sa§pifijara, Tvisiman and Pathinampati.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Rudras stationed in the hexagon are Vrksah, Harikefah, PaSupati, Sa§pifijara, Tvisiman and Pathinampati.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशावरणैर्युक्तो मध्यपीठमनोहरः । मध्यपीठे महारुद्रो ज्वलन्मन्युस्त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśāvaraṇairyukto madhyapīṭhamanoharaḥ / madhyapīṭhe mahārudro jvalanmanyustrilocanaḥ
verses.translation: The following twentyfour Rudras are mentioned as occupying the eleventh Cakra (outer covering): — Isuman, Hrasva, Vamana, Brhan, Varsiyan, Vrddha, Samrddhi, Agrya, Prathama, A$u, Ajira, Sighra, Sibhyaka, Urmyavasu, Anyarudra Srotasya, Divya, Jyestha,Kanistha, Purvaja,Avaraja, Madhyama Avagamya and Jaghanya. All of them are very mighty.
verses.wordMeaning: The following twentyfour Rudras are mentioned as occupying the eleventh Cakra (outer covering): — Isuman, Hrasva, Vamana, Brhan, Varsiyan, Vrddha, Samrddhi, Agrya, Prathama, A$u, Ajira, Sighra, Sibhyaka, Urmyavasu, Anyarudra Srotasya, Divya, Jyestha,Kanistha, Purvaja,Avaraja,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following twentyfour Rudras are mentioned as occupying the eleventh Cakra (outer covering): — Isuman, Hrasva, Vamana, Brhan, Varsiyan, Vrddha, Samrddhi, Agrya, Prathama, A$u, Ajira, Sighra, Sibhyaka, Urmyavasu, Anyarudra Srotasya, Divya, Jyestha,Kanistha, Purvaja,Avaraja,…

verses.sanskrit: सच्चकार्मुकहस्तश्च सर्वदा वर्तते मुने । त्रिकोणे कथिता रुद्रास्त्रय एव घटोद्भव
verses.transliteration: saccakārmukahastaśca sarvadā vartate mune / trikoṇe kathitā rudrāstraya eva ghaṭodbhava
verses.translation: Listen, O sage, the following are the Rudras stationed in the thirteenth outer covering
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O sage, the following are the Rudras stationed in the thirteenth outer covering
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O sage, the following are the Rudras stationed in the thirteenth outer covering

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्य बाहुः सेनानीर्दिशांपतिरथापरः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇya bāhuḥ senānīrdiśāṃpatirathāparaḥ
verses.translation: Enumerated in the Satarudriya scripture, these Rudras of great strength protect day and night all those who are richly endowed with devotion to Lalita. These (deities) put obstacles in the path of those who are not the devotees of goddess Lalita.
verses.wordMeaning: Enumerated in the Satarudriya scripture, these Rudras of great strength protect day and night all those who are richly endowed with devotion to Lalita. These (deities) put obstacles in the path of those who are not the devotees of goddess Lalita.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enumerated in the Satarudriya scripture, these Rudras of great strength protect day and night all those who are richly endowed with devotion to Lalita. These (deities) put obstacles in the path of those who are not the devotees of goddess Lalita.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाश्च हरिकेशाश्च तथा पशुपतिः परः । शष्पिञ्जरस्त्विषीमांश्च पथीनां पतिरेव च
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāśca harikeśāśca tathā paśupatiḥ paraḥ / śaṣpiñjarastviṣīmāṃśca pathīnāṃ patireva ca
verses.translation: In this manner the guardians of the quarters, beginning with Sakra resort to the pearl-chamber and perform service unto Lalita Paramesvarl.
verses.wordMeaning: In this manner the guardians of the quarters, beginning with Sakra resort to the pearl-chamber and perform service unto Lalita Paramesvarl.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner the guardians of the quarters, beginning with Sakra resort to the pearl-chamber and perform service unto Lalita Paramesvarl.

verses.sanskrit: एते षट्कोणगाः किं च बभ्रुशास्त्वष्टकोणके । विव्याध्यन्नपतिश्चैव हरिकेशोपवीतिनौ
verses.transliteration: ete ṣaṭkoṇagāḥ kiṃ ca babhruśāstvaṣṭakoṇake / vivyādhyannapatiścaiva harikeśopavītinau
verses.translation: Within the pearl chamber and seven Yojanas from it is the chamber of emerald. 1 It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the pearl chamber and seven Yojanas from it is the chamber of emerald. 1 It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the pearl chamber and seven Yojanas from it is the chamber of emerald. 1 It is four Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्टानां पतिरप्यन्यो भवो हेतिस्तथैव च । दशापत्रे त्वावरणे प्रथमो जगतां पतिः
verses.transliteration: puṣṭānāṃ patirapyanyo bhavo hetistathaiva ca / daśāpatre tvāvaraṇe prathamo jagatāṃ patiḥ
verses.translation: VV. 54-65 describe the emerald chamber of DaQdan&th&.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 54-65 describe the emerald chamber of DaQdan&th&.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 54-65 describe the emerald chamber of DaQdan&th&.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रातताविनौ क्षेत्रपतिः सूतस्तथापरः । अहं त्वन्यो वनपती रोहितः स्थपतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: rudrātatāvinau kṣetrapatiḥ sūtastathāparaḥ / ahaṃ tvanyo vanapatī rohitaḥ sthapatistathā
verses.translation: In the emerald enclosure, seven Yojanas away from it is the rampart wall of coral as pink-coloured as the morning sun.
verses.wordMeaning: In the emerald enclosure, seven Yojanas away from it is the rampart wall of coral as pink-coloured as the morning sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the emerald enclosure, seven Yojanas away from it is the rampart wall of coral as pink-coloured as the morning sun.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाणां पतिरप्यन्यश्चैते सज्जशरासनाः । मन्त्री च वाणिजश्चैव तथा कक्षपतिः परः
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāṇāṃ patirapyanyaścaite sajjaśarāsanāḥ / mantrī ca vāṇijaścaiva tathā kakṣapatiḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: There the entire ground is paved and beauti- fied with corals. Here Brahma sits in his lotus seat. Brahma who resembles coral in his complexion always comes there from Brahmaloka along with all leading sages for serving Srilalitadevi. He is always active and alert in this respect. O Quaffer of the ocean, he remains there along with the creators of subjects beginning with Marici. 1
verses.wordMeaning: There the entire ground is paved and beauti- fied with corals. Here Brahma sits in his lotus seat. Brahma who resembles coral in his complexion always comes there from Brahmaloka along with all leading sages for serving Srilalitadevi.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There the entire ground is paved and beauti- fied with corals. Here Brahma sits in his lotus seat. Brahma who resembles coral in his complexion always comes there from Brahmaloka along with all leading sages for serving Srilalitadevi.…

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तिस्तु चतुर्थः स्यात्पञ्चमो वारिवस्ततः । ओषधीनां पतिश्चैव षष्ठः कलशसंभव
verses.transliteration: bhavantistu caturthaḥ syātpañcamo vārivastataḥ / oṣadhīnāṃ patiścaiva ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalaśasaṃbhava
verses.translation: VV.71-84 describe the region of Vi?nu with ruby Mandapas. The
verses.wordMeaning: VV.71-84 describe the region of Vi?nu with ruby Mandapas. The
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.71-84 describe the region of Vi?nu with ruby Mandapas. The

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैर्घोषाक्रन्दयन्तौ पतीनां च पतिस्तथा । कृत्स्नवीतश्च धावंश्च सत्त्वानां पतिरेव च
verses.transliteration: uccairghoṣākrandayantau patīnāṃ ca patistathā / kṛtsnavītaśca dhāvaṃśca sattvānāṃ patireva ca
verses.translation: Thus by means of his twelve bodies the lotus-eyed Lord shines in the Visnuloka occupying the ruby dais.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus by means of his twelve bodies the lotus-eyed Lord shines in the Visnuloka occupying the ruby dais.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus by means of his twelve bodies the lotus-eyed Lord shines in the Visnuloka occupying the ruby dais.

verses.sanskrit: एते द्वादश पत्रस्थाः पञ्चमावरणस्थिताः । सहमानश्च निर्व्याधिरव्याधीनां पतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ete dvādaśa patrasthāḥ pañcamāvaraṇasthitāḥ / sahamānaśca nirvyādhiravyādhīnāṃ patistathā
verses.translation: Within the enclosure of diverse kinds of gems and seven Yojanas from it there is a charming dais named Saha - srastambhaka 1 (thousand-columned).
verses.wordMeaning: Within the enclosure of diverse kinds of gems and seven Yojanas from it there is a charming dais named Saha - srastambhaka 1 (thousand-columned).
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the enclosure of diverse kinds of gems and seven Yojanas from it there is a charming dais named Saha - srastambhaka 1 (thousand-columned).

verses.sanskrit: ककुभश्च निषङ्गी च स्तेनानां च पतिस्तथा । निचेरुश्चेति विज्ञेयाः षष्ठावरणदेवताः
verses.transliteration: kakubhaśca niṣaṅgī ca stenānāṃ ca patistathā / niceruśceti vijñeyāḥ ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇadevatāḥ
verses.translation: VV. 85-94 give the description of a thousand-pillared hall and the residence of Siva. This Siva is Sridevi's devotee (on a lower level). Mention of 28 £aiva Agamas in V. 89 does not clarify whether the Advaita or Dvaita theory is advocated by them.

verses.transliteration: adhaḥ paricaro 'raṇyaḥ patiḥ kiṃ ca sṛkāviṣaḥ / jighāṃsaṃto muṣṇatāṃ ca patayaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhava

verses.sanskrit: असीमन्तश्च सुप्राज्ञस्तथा नक्तञ्चरो मुने । प्रकृतीनां पतिश्चैव उष्णीषी च गिरेश्चरः
verses.transliteration: asīmantaśca suprājñastathā naktañcaro mune / prakṛtīnāṃ patiścaiva uṣṇīṣī ca gireścaraḥ
verses.translation: VV. 85-94 give the description of a thousand-pillared hall and the residence of Siva. This Siva is Sridevi's devotee (on a lower level). Mention of 28 £aiva Agamas in V. 89 does not clarify whether the Advaita or Dvaita theory is advocated by them.

verses.sanskrit: कुलुञ्चानां पतिश्चैवेषुमन्तः कलशोद्भव । धन्वाविदश्चातन्वानप्रतिपूर्वदधानकाः
verses.transliteration: kuluñcānāṃ patiścaiveṣumantaḥ kalaśodbhava / dhanvāvidaścātanvānapratipūrvadadhānakāḥ

verses.sanskrit: आयच्छतः षोडशैते षोडशारनिवासिनः । विसृजन्तस्तथास्यन्तो विध्यन्तश्चापि सिंधुप
verses.transliteration: āyacchataḥ ṣoḍaśaite ṣoḍaśāranivāsinaḥ / visṛjantastathāsyanto vidhyantaścāpi siṃdhupa
verses.translation: VV. 85-94 give the description of a thousand-pillared hall and the residence of Siva. This Siva is Sridevi's devotee (on a lower level). Mention of 28 £aiva Agamas in V. 89 does not clarify whether the Advaita or Dvaita theory is advocated by them.
