verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्य संवादे ललितोपाख्याने दिक्पालादिशिवलोकान्तरकथनं ना चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः हयग्रीव उवाच अथ वापीत्र यादीनां कक्ष्याभेदान्प्रचक्ष्महे । एषां श्रवणमात्रेण जायते श्रीमहोदयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastya saṃvāde lalitopākhyāne dikpālādiśivalokāntarakathanaṃ nā catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ hayagrīva uvāca atha vāpītra yādīnāṃ kakṣyābhedānpracakṣmahe / eṣāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa jāyate śrīmahodayaḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth, we shall recount different chambers of Vdpitraya (three tanks) etc. Merely by listening to these, great prosperity can be attained.
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, we shall recount different chambers of Vdpitraya (three tanks) etc. Merely by listening to these, great prosperity can be attained.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, we shall recount different chambers of Vdpitraya (three tanks) etc. Merely by listening to these, great prosperity can be attained.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रस्तम्भशालस्यातरमारुतयोजने । मनो नाम महाशालः सर्वरत्नविचित्रितः
verses.transliteration: sahasrastambhaśālasyātaramārutayojane / mano nāma mahāśālaḥ sarvaratnavicitritaḥ
verses.translation: Within the thousand-columned enclosure and seven Yojanas away is the great chamber named Mandh. It is wonderfully built and beautified with all kinds of gems and jewels.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the thousand-columned enclosure and seven Yojanas away is the great chamber named Mandh. It is wonderfully built and beautified with all kinds of gems and jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the thousand-columned enclosure and seven Yojanas away is the great chamber named Mandh. It is wonderfully built and beautified with all kinds of gems and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववद्गोपुरद्वारकपाटार्गलसंयुतः । तन्मध्यकक्ष्याभागस्तु सर्वाप्यमृतवापिका
verses.transliteration: pūrvavadgopuradvārakapāṭārgalasaṃyutaḥ / tanmadhyakakṣyābhāgastu sarvāpyamṛtavāpikā
verses.translation: It has Gopuras. gateways, panels and bolts as before. The entire space within that chamber (enclosure) is a nectarine lake.
verses.wordMeaning: It has Gopuras. gateways, panels and bolts as before. The entire space within that chamber (enclosure) is a nectarine lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has Gopuras. gateways, panels and bolts as before. The entire space within that chamber (enclosure) is a nectarine lake.

verses.sanskrit: यत्पीत्वा योगिनः सिद्धा वज्रकाया महाबलाः । भवन्ति पुरुषाः प्राज्ञास्तदेव हि रसायनम्
verses.transliteration: yatpītvā yoginaḥ siddhā vajrakāyā mahābalāḥ / bhavanti puruṣāḥ prājñāstadeva hi rasāyanam
verses.translation: A series of steps in the lake are wonderfully paved with different kinds of gems and jewels. The swans and cranes in the lake are golden and gem-coloured.
verses.wordMeaning: A series of steps in the lake are wonderfully paved with different kinds of gems and jewels. The swans and cranes in the lake are golden and gem-coloured.
verses.commentary: Sense: A series of steps in the lake are wonderfully paved with different kinds of gems and jewels. The swans and cranes in the lake are golden and gem-coloured.

verses.sanskrit: वाप्याममृतमय्यां तु वर्तते तोयतां गतम् । तद्गन्धाघ्राणमात्रेण सिद्धिकान्तापतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vāpyāmamṛtamayyāṃ tu vartate toyatāṃ gatam / tadgandhāghrāṇamātreṇa siddhikāntāpatirbhavet
verses.translation: The boat-women of Tara are crores in number. They are all in their fresh bloom of youth. They dance and repeated- ly sing the meritorious glory of the goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: The boat-women of Tara are crores in number. They are all in their fresh bloom of youth. They dance and repeated- ly sing the meritorious glory of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: The boat-women of Tara are crores in number. They are all in their fresh bloom of youth. They dance and repeated- ly sing the meritorious glory of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: अस्पृशन्नपि विन्धयारे पुरुषः क्षीणकल्मषः । उभयोः शालयोः पार्श्वे सुधावापीतटद्वये
verses.transliteration: aspṛśannapi vindhayāre puruṣaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ / ubhayoḥ śālayoḥ pārśve sudhāvāpītaṭadvaye
verses.translation: Some of them have oars in their hands. Some have horns filled with water in their hands. They drink the nectarine water of that lake. They move about in hundreds of rafts and boats.
verses.wordMeaning: Some of them have oars in their hands. Some have horns filled with water in their hands. They drink the nectarine water of that lake. They move about in hundreds of rafts and boats.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them have oars in their hands. Some have horns filled with water in their hands. They drink the nectarine water of that lake. They move about in hundreds of rafts and boats.

verses.sanskrit: अधक्रोशसमायामा अन्यास्सर्वाश्च वापिकाः । चतुर्योजनदूरं तु तलं तस्या जलान्तरे
verses.transliteration: adhakrośasamāyāmā anyāssarvāśca vāpikāḥ / caturyojanadūraṃ tu talaṃ tasyā jalāntare
verses.translation: Rowing continuously in the waters of the lake, both clockwise and anticlockwise directions, Tar& guards this enclosure.
verses.wordMeaning: Rowing continuously in the waters of the lake, both clockwise and anticlockwise directions, Tar& guards this enclosure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rowing continuously in the waters of the lake, both clockwise and anticlockwise directions, Tar& guards this enclosure.

verses.sanskrit: सोपानावलयस्तस्या नानारत्नविचित्रिताः । स्वर्णवर्णा रत्नवर्णास्तस्यां हंसाश्च सारसाः
verses.transliteration: sopānāvalayastasyā nānāratnavicitritāḥ / svarṇavarṇā ratnavarṇāstasyāṃ haṃsāśca sārasāḥ
verses.translation: Within the enclosure of Manab&la (Chamber of mind) and seven Yojanas away from it is the enclosure well- known as Buddhti&la (Chamber of Intellect). It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the enclosure of Manab&la (Chamber of mind) and seven Yojanas away from it is the enclosure well- known as Buddhti&la (Chamber of Intellect). It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the enclosure of Manab&la (Chamber of mind) and seven Yojanas away from it is the enclosure well- known as Buddhti&la (Chamber of Intellect). It is four Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: आस्फोट्यते तटद्वन्द्वतरङ्गैर्मन्दचञ्चलैः । पक्षिणस्तज्जलं पीत्वा रसायनमयं नवम्
verses.transliteration: āsphoṭyate taṭadvandvataraṅgairmandacañcalaiḥ / pakṣiṇastajjalaṃ pītvā rasāyanamayaṃ navam
verses.translation: The entire space in the middle of that chamber is occupied by Anandav&pikd (the lake of Bliss). The great divine wine rendered highly fragrant by the Bahula ( Mimusops elengi ) flowers and having the lustre of heated gold serves the purpose of water in that river.
verses.wordMeaning: The entire space in the middle of that chamber is occupied by Anandav&pikd (the lake of Bliss). The great divine wine rendered highly fragrant by the Bahula ( Mimusops elengi ) flowers and having the lustre of heated gold serves the purpose of water in that river.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire space in the middle of that chamber is occupied by Anandav&pikd (the lake of Bliss). The great divine wine rendered highly fragrant by the Bahula ( Mimusops elengi ) flowers and having the lustre of heated gold serves the purpose of water in that river.

verses.sanskrit: अजरामरतां प्राप्तास्तत्र विन्ध्यनिषूदन । सदाकूजितलक्षेण तत्र कारण्डवद्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ajarāmaratāṃ prāptāstatra vindhyaniṣūdana / sadākūjitalakṣeṇa tatra kāraṇḍavadvijāḥ
verses.translation: The depth etc. of the lake of bliss are recounted as before. The structure of the series of steps etc. and the nature and features of the birds — everything is as before.
verses.wordMeaning: The depth etc. of the lake of bliss are recounted as before. The structure of the series of steps etc. and the nature and features of the birds — everything is as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: The depth etc. of the lake of bliss are recounted as before. The structure of the series of steps etc. and the nature and features of the birds — everything is as before.

verses.sanskrit: जपन्ति ललितादेव्या मन्त्रमेव महत्तरम् । परितो वापिकाचक्रपरिवेषणभूयसा
verses.transliteration: japanti lalitādevyā mantrameva mahattaram / parito vāpikācakrapariveṣaṇabhūyasā
verses.translation: By frequently drinking the water therein viz,: wine.
verses.wordMeaning: By frequently drinking the water therein viz,: wine.
verses.commentary: Sense: By frequently drinking the water therein viz,: wine.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र गन्तु मार्गो ऽस्ति नौकावाहनमन्तरा । आज्ञया केवलं तत्र मन्त्रिणी दण्डनाथयोः । तारा नाम महाशक्तिर्वर्तते तोरणेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: na tatra gantu mārgo 'sti naukāvāhanamantarā / ājñayā kevalaṃ tatra mantriṇī daṇḍanāthayoḥ / tārā nāma mahāśaktirvartate toraṇeśvarī
verses.translation: Then within the great enclosure of intellect and seven Yojanas away from it, is Aharhk&ra Mahdi&la (the great chamber of Ego). It is fitted with Gopuras as before.
verses.wordMeaning: Then within the great enclosure of intellect and seven Yojanas away from it, is Aharhk&ra Mahdi&la (the great chamber of Ego). It is fitted with Gopuras as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then within the great enclosure of intellect and seven Yojanas away from it, is Aharhk&ra Mahdi&la (the great chamber of Ego). It is fitted with Gopuras as before.

verses.sanskrit: बह्व्यस्तत्रोत्पलश्यामास्तारायाः परिचारिकाः । रत्ननौकासहस्रेण खेलन्त्यो सरसीजले
verses.transliteration: bahvyastatrotpalaśyāmāstārāyāḥ paricārikāḥ / ratnanaukāsahasreṇa khelantyo sarasījale
verses.translation: The entire ground, O sage, between those two cham- bers is occupied by the pond named VimarSavapikd (the lake of deliberation and consideration). It is in the form of the Nectar of the Nerve Susumna (or of the Susumna ray of the sun).
verses.wordMeaning: The entire ground, O sage, between those two cham- bers is occupied by the pond named VimarSavapikd (the lake of deliberation and consideration). It is in the form of the Nectar of the Nerve Susumna (or of the Susumna ray of the sun).
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire ground, O sage, between those two cham- bers is occupied by the pond named VimarSavapikd (the lake of deliberation and consideration). It is in the form of the Nectar of the Nerve Susumna (or of the Susumna ray of the sun).

verses.sanskrit: अपरं पारमायान्ति पुनर्यान्ति परं तटम् । वीणावेणुमृदङ्गादि वादयन्त्यो मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: aparaṃ pāramāyānti punaryānti paraṃ taṭam / vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādi vādayantyo muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Within the great Yogins, in their inner mind, there is wind filling it. In the hollow of the bonelike nerve Susumna there is the most excellent Amrta (Nectar).
verses.wordMeaning: Within the great Yogins, in their inner mind, there is wind filling it. In the hollow of the bonelike nerve Susumna there is the most excellent Amrta (Nectar).
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the great Yogins, in their inner mind, there is wind filling it. In the hollow of the bonelike nerve Susumna there is the most excellent Amrta (Nectar).

verses.sanskrit: कोटिशस्तत्र ताराया नाविक्यो नवयौवनाः । मुहुर्गायन्ति नृत्यन्ति देव्याः पुण्यतमं यशः
verses.transliteration: koṭiśastatra tārāyā nāvikyo navayauvanāḥ / muhurgāyanti nṛtyanti devyāḥ puṇyatamaṃ yaśaḥ
verses.translation: Seated in her jewel-studded boat, O sage, she moves
verses.wordMeaning: Seated in her jewel-studded boat, O sage, she moves
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated in her jewel-studded boat, O sage, she moves

verses.sanskrit: अरित्रपाणयः काश्चित्काश्चिच्छूगाम्बुपाणयः । पिबन्त्यस्तत्सुधातोयं संचरन्त्यस्तरीशतैः
verses.transliteration: aritrapāṇayaḥ kāścitkāścicchūgāmbupāṇayaḥ / pibantyastatsudhātoyaṃ saṃcarantyastarīśataiḥ
verses.translation: Within the enclosure of ego and seven Yojanas away from it is the SUryabimbamah&S&la ( the great chamber of the solar disc). It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the enclosure of ego and seven Yojanas away from it is the SUryabimbamah&S&la ( the great chamber of the solar disc). It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the enclosure of ego and seven Yojanas away from it is the SUryabimbamah&S&la ( the great chamber of the solar disc). It is four Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: तासां नौकावाहिकानां शक्तीनां श्यामलत्विषाम् । प्रधानभूता तारांबा जलौघशमनक्षमा
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ naukāvāhikānāṃ śaktīnāṃ śyāmalatviṣām / pradhānabhūtā tārāṃbā jalaughaśamanakṣamā
verses.translation: The groups of planets, the constellations and stars — all these performed penance here and attained the power of illuminating the worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: The groups of planets, the constellations and stars — all these performed penance here and attained the power of illuminating the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The groups of planets, the constellations and stars — all these performed penance here and attained the power of illuminating the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञां विना तयोस्तारा मन्त्रिणीदण्डधारयोः । त्रिनेत्रस्यापि नो दत्ते वापिकांभसि सन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: ājñāṃ vinā tayostārā mantriṇīdaṇḍadhārayoḥ / trinetrasyāpi no datte vāpikāṃbhasi santaram
verses.translation: He illuminates the sense organs of her devotees and makes them refulgent. He exterminates the dense darkness within and without. There in the regioA of Bdldtapodgdra (where the early morning rays of the sun spread) Martanda Bhairava shines.
verses.wordMeaning: He illuminates the sense organs of her devotees and makes them refulgent. He exterminates the dense darkness within and without. There in the regioA of Bdldtapodgdra (where the early morning rays of the sun spread) Martanda Bhairava shines.
verses.commentary: Sense: He illuminates the sense organs of her devotees and makes them refulgent. He exterminates the dense darkness within and without. There in the regioA of Bdldtapodgdra (where the early morning rays of the sun spread) Martanda Bhairava shines.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्तीनां चलन्तीनां नौकाभिर्मणिचारुभिः । महाराज्ञी महौदार्यं पतन्तीनां पदेपदे
verses.transliteration: gāyantīnāṃ calantīnāṃ naukābhirmaṇicārubhiḥ / mahārājñī mahaudāryaṃ patantīnāṃ padepade
verses.translation: He drinks the nectar of moonlight in gobletfuls. He is surrounded by the Saktis of twentyseven constellations.
verses.wordMeaning: He drinks the nectar of moonlight in gobletfuls. He is surrounded by the Saktis of twentyseven constellations.
verses.commentary: Sense: He drinks the nectar of moonlight in gobletfuls. He is surrounded by the Saktis of twentyseven constellations.

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्तीनां मधु भृशं माणिक्यचषकोदरैः । प्रतिनौकं मणिगृहे वसन्तीनां मनोहरे
verses.transliteration: pibantīnāṃ madhu bhṛśaṃ māṇikyacaṣakodaraiḥ / pratinaukaṃ maṇigṛhe vasantīnāṃ manohare
verses.translation: Lord Sail stays there itself in Candrikadvara always in his full form. He has his own form and features and is devoid of black spot.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Sail stays there itself in Candrikadvara always in his full form. He has his own form and features and is devoid of black spot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Sail stays there itself in Candrikadvara always in his full form. He has his own form and features and is devoid of black spot.

verses.sanskrit: तारातरणिशक्तीनां समवायो ऽतिसुन्दरः । काश्चिन्नौकाः सुवर्णाढ्याः काश्चिद्रत्नकृता मुने
verses.transliteration: tārātaraṇiśaktīnāṃ samavāyo 'tisundaraḥ / kāścinnaukāḥ suvarṇāḍhyāḥ kāścidratnakṛtā mune
verses.translation: The moon spends his time there in Japas, meditations, eulogies and hundreds of worships of Lalita, along with Alvin! and others (i.e. constellation Saktis)
verses.wordMeaning: The moon spends his time there in Japas, meditations, eulogies and hundreds of worships of Lalita, along with Alvin! and others (i.e. constellation Saktis)
verses.commentary: Sense: The moon spends his time there in Japas, meditations, eulogies and hundreds of worships of Lalita, along with Alvin! and others (i.e. constellation Saktis)

verses.sanskrit: मकराकारमापन्नाः काश्चिन्नौका मृगाननाः । काश्चित्सिंहासना नावः काश्चिद्दन्तावलाननाः
verses.transliteration: makarākāramāpannāḥ kāścinnaukā mṛgānanāḥ / kāścitsiṃhāsanā nāvaḥ kāściddantāvalānanāḥ
verses.translation: There are thousands of other Saktis named Taras. They stay near him. That chamber is filled with them.
verses.wordMeaning: There are thousands of other Saktis named Taras. They stay near him. That chamber is filled with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are thousands of other Saktis named Taras. They stay near him. That chamber is filled with them.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं विचित्ररूपाभिर्नौङ्काभिः परिवेष्टिता । तारांबामहतीं नौकामधिगम्य विराजते
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ vicitrarūpābhirnauṅkābhiḥ pariveṣṭitā / tārāṃbāmahatīṃ naukāmadhigamya virājate
verses.translation: Within the chamber of Moon's disc and seven Yojanas away from it, is the chamber named Srrigara (toilette.) It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the chamber of Moon's disc and seven Yojanas away from it, is the chamber named Srrigara (toilette.) It is four Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the chamber of Moon's disc and seven Yojanas away from it, is the chamber named Srrigara (toilette.) It is four Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: अनुलोमविलोमाभ्यां सञ्चारं वापिकाजले । तन्वाना सततं तारा कक्ष्यामेनां हि रक्षति
verses.transliteration: anulomavilomābhyāṃ sañcāraṃ vāpikājale / tanvānā satataṃ tārā kakṣyāmenāṃ hi rakṣati
verses.translation: Within the encircling Parikha (moat) filled with Srngararasa ( the essence of the sentiment of Love) there are Srhgara Saktis. They sparkle in their diverse kinds of jewels and ornaments.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the encircling Parikha (moat) filled with Srngararasa ( the essence of the sentiment of Love) there are Srhgara Saktis. They sparkle in their diverse kinds of jewels and ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the encircling Parikha (moat) filled with Srngararasa ( the essence of the sentiment of Love) there are Srhgara Saktis. They sparkle in their diverse kinds of jewels and ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: मनशालस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनदूरतः । बुद्धिशाल इति ख्यातश्चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः
verses.transliteration: manaśālasyāntarāle saptayojanadūrataḥ / buddhiśāla iti khyātaścaturyojanamucchritaḥ
verses.translation: Haughty with intoxication, they move about in thousand boats. They always worship and serve the flower- weaponed lord (Kama) who is also intoxicated and who is seated in his boat.
verses.wordMeaning: Haughty with intoxication, they move about in thousand boats. They always worship and serve the flower- weaponed lord (Kama) who is also intoxicated and who is seated in his boat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haughty with intoxication, they move about in thousand boats. They always worship and serve the flower- weaponed lord (Kama) who is also intoxicated and who is seated in his boat.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्यकक्ष्याभागे ऽस्ति सर्वाप्यानन्दवापिका । तत्र दिव्यं महामद्यं बकुलामोदमेदुरम् । प्रतप्तकनकच्छायं तज्जलत्वेन वर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: tanmadhyakakṣyābhāge 'sti sarvāpyānandavāpikā / tatra divyaṃ mahāmadyaṃ bakulāmodameduram / prataptakanakacchāyaṃ tajjalatvena varttate
verses.translation: Subject to the control and commands of Lalita he enchants all the worlds, entire universe by means of his
verses.wordMeaning: Subject to the control and commands of Lalita he enchants all the worlds, entire universe by means of his
verses.commentary: Sense: Subject to the control and commands of Lalita he enchants all the worlds, entire universe by means of his

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दवापिकागाधाः पूर्ववत्परिकीर्त्तिताः । सोपानादिक्रमश्चैव पक्षिणास्तत्र पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: ānandavāpikāgādhāḥ pūrvavatparikīrttitāḥ / sopānādikramaścaiva pakṣiṇāstatra pūrvavat
verses.translation: Those who are enchanted by his power go to the region of Mahapadmatavi in order to honour and worship (Lalita ). They take up and assure pure guise and garments. They are full of devotion to Lalita. With great concentration in their minds they proceed towards the region of Padmafavi (Park of lotus flowers ).
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are enchanted by his power go to the region of Mahapadmatavi in order to honour and worship (Lalita ). They take up and assure pure guise and garments. They are full of devotion to Lalita.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are enchanted by his power go to the region of Mahapadmatavi in order to honour and worship (Lalita ). They take up and assure pure guise and garments. They are full of devotion to Lalita.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्रत्यं सलिलं मद्यं पायम्पायं तटस्थिताः । विहरन्ति मदोन्मत्ताः शक्तयो मदपाटलाः
verses.transliteration: tatratyaṃ salilaṃ madyaṃ pāyampāyaṃ taṭasthitāḥ / viharanti madonmattāḥ śaktayo madapāṭalāḥ
verses.translation: But neither Suras nor human beings nor the celestial Siddhas become competent to go there. But Brahma, Visnu and Maheia, who are naturally pure in their minds go to the region of Mahapadmatavi at her bidding.
verses.wordMeaning: But neither Suras nor human beings nor the celestial Siddhas become competent to go there. But Brahma, Visnu and Maheia, who are naturally pure in their minds go to the region of Mahapadmatavi at her bidding.
verses.commentary: Sense: But neither Suras nor human beings nor the celestial Siddhas become competent to go there. But Brahma, Visnu and Maheia, who are naturally pure in their minds go to the region of Mahapadmatavi at her bidding.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाच्च वारुणी देवी तत्र नौकाधिनायिका । यां सुधामालिनीमाहुर्यामा हुरमृतेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: sākṣācca vāruṇī devī tatra naukādhināyikā / yāṃ sudhāmālinīmāhuryāmā huramṛteśvarīm
verses.translation: Then, within the chamber of Srngara and seven Yojanas away from it, is the great abode of Cakrar&ja named Cintdmanigrha ( the abode of Philosopher's stone ).
verses.wordMeaning: Then, within the chamber of Srngara and seven Yojanas away from it, is the great abode of Cakrar&ja named Cintdmanigrha ( the abode of Philosopher's stone ).

verses.sanskrit: सा तत्र मणिनौकास्थशक्तिसेनासमावृता । ईषदालोकमात्रेण त्रैलोक्यमददायिनी
verses.transliteration: sā tatra maṇinaukāsthaśaktisenāsamāvṛtā / īṣadālokamātreṇa trailokyamadadāyinī
verses.translation: V.71 and onwards are devoted to the description of Mahapadmi- tavi proper. Here every thing is set in a magnified form. Thus the vessels for Arghya in the eastern portion of that chamber are Yojanas in dimension. The following gods have maintained the Arghya vessel along with their Kalis or &aktis to serve. The Fire-god (vv.79-83), with his ten Kalas, the Sun-god with his 12 Kalis (w.84-87), the moon -god with his 16 Kalis,
verses.wordMeaning: V.71 and onwards are devoted to the description of Mahapadmi- tavi proper. Here every thing is set in a magnified form. Thus the vessels for Arghya in the eastern portion of that chamber are Yojanas in dimension.…
verses.commentary: Sense: V.71 and onwards are devoted to the description of Mahapadmi- tavi proper. Here every thing is set in a magnified form. Thus the vessels for Arghya in the eastern portion of that chamber are Yojanas in dimension.…

verses.sanskrit: तरुणादित्य सङ्काश मदारक्तकपोलभूः । पारिजातप्रसूनस्रक्परिवीतकचाचिता
verses.transliteration: taruṇāditya saṅkāśa madāraktakapolabhūḥ / pārijātaprasūnasrakparivītakacācitā
verses.translation: There are Gopuras in the chambers (beginning with) •Sfngara and ending with Mahakala, O sage. The arrangement of Gopuras, in all the four directions is like this.
verses.wordMeaning: There are Gopuras in the chambers (beginning with) •Sfngara and ending with Mahakala, O sage. The arrangement of Gopuras, in all the four directions is like this.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are Gopuras in the chambers (beginning with) •Sfngara and ending with Mahakala, O sage. The arrangement of Gopuras, in all the four directions is like this.

verses.sanskrit: वहन्ती मदिरापूर्णं चषकं लोलदुत्पलम् । पक्वं पिशितखण्डं च मणिपात्रे तथान्यके
verses.transliteration: vahantī madirāpūrṇaṃ caṣakaṃ loladutpalam / pakvaṃ piśitakhaṇḍaṃ ca maṇipātre tathānyake
verses.translation: I shall describe the region of Padmatavi which extends to one Yojana and which is the root of all the cham- bers, O sage, listen attentively*.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall describe the region of Padmatavi which extends to one Yojana and which is the root of all the cham- bers, O sage, listen attentively*.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall describe the region of Padmatavi which extends to one Yojana and which is the root of all the cham- bers, O sage, listen attentively*.

verses.sanskrit: वारुणीतरणिश्रेणीनायिका तत्र राजते । साप्याज्ञयैव सर्वेषां मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः । ददाति वापीतरणं त्रिनेत्रस्यापि नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: vāruṇītaraṇiśreṇīnāyikā tatra rājate / sāpyājñayaiva sarveṣāṃ mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ / dadāti vāpītaraṇaṃ trinetrasyāpi nānyathā
verses.translation: The stalks are one Yojana in length covered with soft thorns. The length of the leaves is equal to the height of ten palm trees.
verses.wordMeaning: The stalks are one Yojana in length covered with soft thorns. The length of the leaves is equal to the height of ten palm trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: The stalks are one Yojana in length covered with soft thorns. The length of the leaves is equal to the height of ten palm trees.

verses.sanskrit: अथ बुद्धिमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने । अहङ्कारमहाशालः पूर्ववद्गोपुरान्वितः
verses.transliteration: atha buddhimahāśālāntare mārutayojane / ahaṅkāramahāśālaḥ pūrvavadgopurānvitaḥ
verses.translation: The filaments of the lotuses have a length equal to the height of five T&las ( Palm trees). The pericarps are reputed to be as high as ten palms.
verses.wordMeaning: The filaments of the lotuses have a length equal to the height of five T&las ( Palm trees). The pericarps are reputed to be as high as ten palms.

verses.sanskrit: तयोस्तु शालयोर्मध्ये कक्ष्याभूरखिला मुने । विमर्शवापिका नाम सौषुम्णामृतरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: tayostu śālayormadhye kakṣyābhūrakhilā mune / vimarśavāpikā nāma sauṣumṇāmṛtarūpiṇī
verses.translation: There are many crores and crores of lotuses here. They are very tender and in perpetual bloom. They have very agreeable fresh fragrance and wide petals.
verses.wordMeaning: There are many crores and crores of lotuses here. They are very tender and in perpetual bloom. They have very agreeable fresh fragrance and wide petals.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are many crores and crores of lotuses here. They are very tender and in perpetual bloom. They have very agreeable fresh fragrance and wide petals.

verses.sanskrit: तन्महायोगिनामन्तर्मनो मारुतपूरितम् । सुषुम्णदण्डविवरे जागर्ति परमामृतम्
verses.transliteration: tanmahāyogināmantarmano mārutapūritam / suṣumṇadaṇḍavivare jāgarti paramāmṛtam
verses.translation: The sun-god assumes the form of a vessel and occupies that base, the sun-god whose rise is well reputed as the destroyer of darkness of the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: The sun-god assumes the form of a vessel and occupies that base, the sun-god whose rise is well reputed as the destroyer of darkness of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun-god assumes the form of a vessel and occupies that base, the sun-god whose rise is well reputed as the destroyer of darkness of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तदेव तस्याः सलिलं वापिकायास्तपोधन । पूर्ववत्तटसोपानपक्षिनौका हि ताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: tadeva tasyāḥ salilaṃ vāpikāyāstapodhana / pūrvavattaṭasopānapakṣinaukā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ

verses.wordMeaning: There are twelve Kalds of extremely sparkling rays with their bodies in contact with that vessel all round like dolls.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are twelve Kalds of extremely sparkling rays with their bodies in contact with that vessel all round like dolls.

verses.translation: They have been employed by Paramesthin to cleanse and purify the Arghya. After drinking that nectarine Arghya, the Saktis are always elated.

verses.translation: At the bidding of Lalita, a sacred Cidvahni (fire of Cit i.e. knowledge and consciousness) blazes there. It is honoured and adored by hundreds of nectarine currents. It is the cause of the greatest prosperity.

verses.wordMeaning: Within the royal abode there are sparkling gemset lamps with their handle fixed on the walls. They have the splendour of ten million suns. They are fixed in various places all round, brightening the whole of the interior of the Mansion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the royal abode there are sparkling gemset lamps with their handle fixed on the walls. They have the splendour of ten million suns. They are fixed in various places all round, brightening the whole of the interior of the Mansion.

verses.sanskrit: गेयचक्ररथेन्द्रस्तु मन्त्रिण्याः प्रान्ततिष्ठति । चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य रुद्रभागेम्बुजाटवौ
verses.transliteration: geyacakrarathendrastu mantriṇyāḥ prāntatiṣṭhati / cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya rudrabhāgembujāṭavau
verses.translation: In the splendid central area of the mansion of Cinta- mani in a part of the altar is the great and lofty Hindu Cakra (Circular spot).
verses.wordMeaning: In the splendid central area of the mansion of Cinta- mani in a part of the altar is the great and lofty Hindu Cakra (Circular spot).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the splendid central area of the mansion of Cinta- mani in a part of the altar is the great and lofty Hindu Cakra (Circular spot).

verses.sanskrit: वल्लभो दण्डनाथायाः किरिचक्रे महारथः । एतद्रथत्रयं सर्वक्षेत्रश्रीपुरपक्तिषु । समानमेव विज्ञेयमङ्गस्था देवता यथा
verses.transliteration: vallabho daṇḍanāthāyāḥ kiricakre mahārathaḥ / etadrathatrayaṃ sarvakṣetraśrīpurapaktiṣu / samānameva vijñeyamaṅgasthā devatā yathā
verses.translation: The space in between the lofty wall of the mansion of Cintamani and Birdu is after leaving off a KroSa occupied by the wall cited to be three Kro£as ( in width).
verses.wordMeaning: The space in between the lofty wall of the mansion of Cintamani and Birdu is after leaving off a KroSa occupied by the wall cited to be three Kro£as ( in width).
verses.commentary: Sense: The space in between the lofty wall of the mansion of Cintamani and Birdu is after leaving off a KroSa occupied by the wall cited to be three Kro£as ( in width).

verses.sanskrit: आनलं कुण्डमाग्नेये यत्तिष्ठति सदा ज्वलत् । तप्तमेतत्तु गायत्री तप्तं स्याद भयङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: ānalaṃ kuṇḍamāgneye yattiṣṭhati sadā jvalat / taptametattu gāyatrī taptaṃ syāda bhayaṅkaram
verses.translation: In that section (extending to) three Krosas are their own rays of (Siddhis like) Animd etc. If we reckon the entire length of the three KroSas in Hastas (Cubits) it is said to be consisting of twentyfour thousand Hastas.
verses.wordMeaning: In that section (extending to) three Krosas are their own rays of (Siddhis like) Animd etc. If we reckon the entire length of the three KroSas in Hastas (Cubits) it is said to be consisting of twentyfour thousand Hastas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that section (extending to) three Krosas are their own rays of (Siddhis like) Animd etc. If we reckon the entire length of the three KroSas in Hastas (Cubits) it is said to be consisting of twentyfour thousand Hastas.

verses.sanskrit: घृणिसूर्यस्तु तत्पश्चाद् ॐकारस्य च मन्दिरम् । देवी तुरीयगायत्री चक्षुष्मत्यपि तापस
verses.transliteration: ghṛṇisūryastu tatpaścād oṃkārasya ca mandiram / devī turīyagāyatrī cakṣuṣmatyapi tāpasa
verses.translation: From Bindu to the PifheSa, there are fourteen different (sections). In the portion thus differentiated, the number of Hastas is being mentioned by me.
verses.wordMeaning: From Bindu to the PifheSa, there are fourteen different (sections). In the portion thus differentiated, the number of Hastas is being mentioned by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Bindu to the PifheSa, there are fourteen different (sections). In the portion thus differentiated, the number of Hastas is being mentioned by me.

verses.sanskrit: अथ गन्धर्वराजश्च परिषद्रुद्र एव च । तारांबिका भगवती तत्पश्चाद्भागतः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: atha gandharvarājaśca pariṣadrudra eva ca / tārāṃbikā bhagavatī tatpaścādbhāgataḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: The interior of the mansion of Cintamani, 1 O Sage, is twenty Hastas above the level of the ground of the lotus grove. The Animd and other ( Siddhis ) abide there.
verses.wordMeaning: The interior of the mansion of Cintamani, 1 O Sage, is twenty Hastas above the level of the ground of the lotus grove. The Animd and other ( Siddhis ) abide there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The interior of the mansion of Cintamani, 1 O Sage, is twenty Hastas above the level of the ground of the lotus grove. The Animd and other ( Siddhis ) abide there.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य रक्षोभागं समाश्रितः । नामत्रय पहामन्त्रवाच्यो ऽस्ति भगवान्हरिः
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya rakṣobhāgaṃ samāśritaḥ / nāmatraya pahāmantravācyo 'sti bhagavānhariḥ
verses.translation: The extent of (the plot of the abodes of Aitimd etc. is four Nalvas. Four hundred Kifkus make one Naha, By the word Ki$ku it is a Hasta (cubit) that is mentioned.
verses.wordMeaning: The extent of (the plot of the abodes of Aitimd etc. is four Nalvas. Four hundred Kifkus make one Naha, By the word Ki$ku it is a Hasta (cubit) that is mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent of (the plot of the abodes of Aitimd etc. is four Nalvas. Four hundred Kifkus make one Naha, By the word Ki$ku it is a Hasta (cubit) that is mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: महागणपतिस्तस्योत्तरसंश्रितकेतनः । पञ्चाक्षरीमन्त्रवाच्यस्तस्य चाप्युत्तरे शिवः
verses.transliteration: mahāgaṇapatistasyottarasaṃśritaketanaḥ / pañcākṣarīmantravācyastasya cāpyuttare śivaḥ
verses.translation: They are full of fresh youthful bloom. Their lotus-like faces beam with smiles (for ever). Their hands (palms) are like radiant Cint&mani gems. They are always sixteen years in age. They have noble and highly exalted nature. They play about in their excitement due to inebriation.
verses.wordMeaning: They are full of fresh youthful bloom. Their lotus-like faces beam with smiles (for ever). Their hands (palms) are like radiant Cint&mani gems. They are always sixteen years in age. They have noble and highly exalted nature. They play about in their excitement due to inebriation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are full of fresh youthful bloom. Their lotus-like faces beam with smiles (for ever). Their hands (palms) are like radiant Cint&mani gems. They are always sixteen years in age. They have noble and highly exalted nature. They play about in their excitement due to inebriation.

verses.sanskrit: अथ मृत्युञ्जयेशश्च वाच्यर्त्र्यक्षरमात्रतः । सरस्वती धारणाख्या ह्यस्य चोत्तरवासिनी
verses.transliteration: atha mṛtyuñjayeśaśca vācyartryakṣaramātrataḥ / sarasvatī dhāraṇākhyā hyasya cottaravāsinī
verses.translation: They are eight: Brahmi, Mahe£vari, Kaum&ri, Vaiggavi, Mahendri, Varahi, Ca.muii<J& and Mahalak?mi. These have built their abodes here.
verses.wordMeaning: They are eight: Brahmi, Mahe£vari, Kaum&ri, Vaiggavi, Mahendri, Varahi, Ca.muii<J& and Mahalak?mi. These have built their abodes here.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are eight: Brahmi, Mahe£vari, Kaum&ri, Vaiggavi, Mahendri, Varahi, Ca.muii<J& and Mahalak?mi. These have built their abodes here.

verses.sanskrit: अकारादिक्षकारान्तवर्णमूर्तेस्तु मन्दिरम् । मातृकाया उत्तरतस्तस्यां विन्ध्यनिषूदन
verses.transliteration: akārādikṣakārāntavarṇamūrtestu mandiram / mātṛkāyā uttaratastasyāṃ vindhyaniṣūdana
verses.translation: They are armed with different kinds of weapons. They have different Saktis as their retinue. Beginning with the East, they have got their abodes built in a circle.
verses.wordMeaning: They are armed with different kinds of weapons. They have different Saktis as their retinue. Beginning with the East, they have got their abodes built in a circle.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are armed with different kinds of weapons. They have different Saktis as their retinue. Beginning with the East, they have got their abodes built in a circle.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे सम्पदेशी वै कालसंकर्षणी तथा । श्रीमहाशम्भुनाथा च देव्याविर्भावकारणम्
verses.transliteration: uttare sampadeśī vai kālasaṃkarṣaṇī tathā / śrīmahāśambhunāthā ca devyāvirbhāvakāraṇam
verses.translation: These three Antaras constitute Cakra (Wheel) that fascinates the three worlds. Those who are Saktis among these have been recounted with their names expressed.
verses.wordMeaning: These three Antaras constitute Cakra (Wheel) that fascinates the three worlds. Those who are Saktis among these have been recounted with their names expressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: These three Antaras constitute Cakra (Wheel) that fascinates the three worlds. Those who are Saktis among these have been recounted with their names expressed.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीः परांबा च विशदज्योत्स्ना निर्मलविग्रहा । उत्तरोत्तरमेतास्तु देवताः कृतमन्दिराः
verses.transliteration: śrīḥ parāṃbā ca viśadajyotsnā nirmalavigrahā / uttarottarametāstu devatāḥ kṛtamandirāḥ
verses.translation: The Nitya Kamakar?anika, Buddhyakar§anika, Nitya Ras&karsa$ika, Kala Gandhakar§anika, Nitya Citta- kar$anika, Kala Dhaii)&karsanik&, Nitya Sm!'ty&karsanik&, Kala Namakarsanika, Nitya Bljakar$anika, Kali Arthakarsa- niki, Am; takarsanl and Kala Sarirakar$anl — These are Gupta (invisible) Yoginls. TripuresI the ruler of Tripura is CakrinI, is also called Sai vasapurika who is the presiding deity of the Cakra. The protectress in this Gakra is the Mudra named
verses.wordMeaning: The Nitya Kamakar?anika, Buddhyakar§anika, Nitya Ras&karsa$ika, Kala Gandhakar§anika, Nitya Citta- kar$anika, Kala Dhaii)&karsanik&, Nitya Sm!'ty&karsanik&, Kala Namakarsanika, Nitya Bljakar$anika, Kali Arthakarsa- niki, Am;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nitya Kamakar?anika, Buddhyakar§anika, Nitya Ras&karsa$ika, Kala Gandhakar§anika, Nitya Citta- kar$anika, Kala Dhaii)&karsanik&, Nitya Sm!'ty&karsanik&, Kala Namakarsanika, Nitya Bljakar$anika, Kali Arthakarsa- niki, Am;…

verses.sanskrit: बालाचैवान्नपूर्णा च हयारूढा तथैव च । श्रीपादुकाचतस्रस्तदुत्तरोत्तरमन्दिराः
verses.transliteration: bālācaivānnapūrṇā ca hayārūḍhā tathaiva ca / śrīpādukācatasrastaduttarottaramandirāḥ
verses.translation: Twenty Hastas above the level of the Antara of Anafigaiakti, O Pot-born Sage, is the Antara of Sarfikfobhini and others. It extends to four Nalvas. It is the bestower of all good fortune and felicity.
verses.wordMeaning: Twenty Hastas above the level of the Antara of Anafigaiakti, O Pot-born Sage, is the Antara of Sarfikfobhini and others. It extends to four Nalvas. It is the bestower of all good fortune and felicity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twenty Hastas above the level of the Antara of Anafigaiakti, O Pot-born Sage, is the Antara of Sarfikfobhini and others. It extends to four Nalvas. It is the bestower of all good fortune and felicity.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य वायव्यवसुधादितः । महापद्माटवौ त्वन्या देवताः कृतमन्दिराः
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya vāyavyavasudhāditaḥ / mahāpadmāṭavau tvanyā devatāḥ kṛtamandirāḥ
verses.translation: Then comes the goddess of speech named Vimala who is embellished by the Ta-varga (cerebrals ). The fifth one is the goddess of speech called Pradharajia accompanied by Ta-varga (Dentals).
verses.wordMeaning: Then comes the goddess of speech named Vimala who is embellished by the Ta-varga (cerebrals ). The fifth one is the goddess of speech called Pradharajia accompanied by Ta-varga (Dentals).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then comes the goddess of speech named Vimala who is embellished by the Ta-varga (cerebrals ). The fifth one is the goddess of speech called Pradharajia accompanied by Ta-varga (Dentals).

verses.sanskrit: उन्मत्तभैरवी चैव स्वप्नवाराहिका परा । तिरस्करणिकांबा च तथान्या पञ्चमी परा
verses.transliteration: unmattabhairavī caiva svapnavārāhikā parā / tiraskaraṇikāṃbā ca tathānyā pañcamī parā
verses.translation: They are considered to be fondled by the spontaneous flow of prose and poetry. They stay there, O Pot-born Sage, delighting and amusing Sri-Devi by means of sweet lyrics and dramas pleasing to the ears.
verses.wordMeaning: They are considered to be fondled by the spontaneous flow of prose and poetry. They stay there, O Pot-born Sage, delighting and amusing Sri-Devi by means of sweet lyrics and dramas pleasing to the ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are considered to be fondled by the spontaneous flow of prose and poetry. They stay there, O Pot-born Sage, delighting and amusing Sri-Devi by means of sweet lyrics and dramas pleasing to the ears.

verses.sanskrit: यथापूर्वं कृतगृहा एता देव्यो महोदयाः । श्रीपूर्तिश्च महादेवी श्रीमहापादुकापि च
verses.transliteration: yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtagṛhā etā devyo mahodayāḥ / śrīpūrtiśca mahādevī śrīmahāpādukāpi ca
verses.translation: These divine weapons are extremely gratified by the blood of the wicked Danavas that was drunk by them in the course of the great battle with the Asura Bhanda. Those divine weapons are active and alert now.
verses.wordMeaning: These divine weapons are extremely gratified by the blood of the wicked Danavas that was drunk by them in the course of the great battle with the Asura Bhanda. Those divine weapons are active and alert now.
verses.commentary: Sense: These divine weapons are extremely gratified by the blood of the wicked Danavas that was drunk by them in the course of the great battle with the Asura Bhanda. Those divine weapons are active and alert now.

verses.sanskrit: यथापूर्वं कृतगृहे द्वे एते देवतोत्तमे । शङ्करेण षडाम्नायसागरे प्रतिपादिताः । या विद्यास्ताः समस्ताश्च महापद्माटवीस्थले
verses.transliteration: yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtagṛhe dve ete devatottame / śaṅkareṇa ṣaḍāmnāyasāgare pratipāditāḥ / yā vidyāstāḥ samastāśca mahāpadmāṭavīsthale
verses.translation: Among other weapons there are supplementary weapons of these weapons. Their number runs into crores.
verses.wordMeaning: Among other weapons there are supplementary weapons of these weapons. Their number runs into crores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among other weapons there are supplementary weapons of these weapons. Their number runs into crores.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं श्रीरश्मिमालाया मणिकॢप्ता गहागृहाः । उच्चध्वजा उच्चशालास्ससोपानास्तपोधन
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ śrīraśmimālāyā maṇikḷptā gahāgṛhāḥ / uccadhvajā uccaśālāssasopānāstapodhana
verses.translation: All those different kinds of deities remembered as pertaining to all the systems of philosophy serve the great goddesses there beginning wish Karnesi.
verses.wordMeaning: All those different kinds of deities remembered as pertaining to all the systems of philosophy serve the great goddesses there beginning wish Karnesi.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those different kinds of deities remembered as pertaining to all the systems of philosophy serve the great goddesses there beginning wish Karnesi.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य पूर्वद्वारे समुद्रप । दक्षिणे पार्श्वभागेतु मन्त्रिनाथागृहं महत्
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya pūrvadvāre samudrapa / dakṣiṇe pārśvabhāgetu mantrināthāgṛhaṃ mahat
verses.translation: Sri Devi is the deity that completes the number when these deities as well as the deities named Nityas, Cakrinis and the Yoginis are reckoned. Mother Lalita who reclines on the lap of Lord Kamesvara is the fourth one in the group of Karnesi and others. She is the sixteenth among Nityas. She is glorified as the ninth one among Yoginis and Cakra Devis.
verses.wordMeaning: Sri Devi is the deity that completes the number when these deities as well as the deities named Nityas, Cakrinis and the Yoginis are reckoned. Mother Lalita who reclines on the lap of Lord Kamesvara is the fourth one in the group of Karnesi and others.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sri Devi is the deity that completes the number when these deities as well as the deities named Nityas, Cakrinis and the Yoginis are reckoned. Mother Lalita who reclines on the lap of Lord Kamesvara is the fourth one in the group of Karnesi and others.…

verses.sanskrit: वामभागे दण्डनाथाभवनं रत्ननिर्मितम् । ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानामर्ध्यस्थानम्य पूर्वतः
verses.transliteration: vāmabhāge daṇḍanāthābhavanaṃ ratnanirmitam / brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāmardhyasthānamya pūrvataḥ
verses.translation: They are very close to Lalita, the consort of §rikame£vara. All their limbs are full with the freshness of youthful bloom and beauty. They are very attentive. They hold weapons.
verses.wordMeaning: They are very close to Lalita, the consort of §rikame£vara. All their limbs are full with the freshness of youthful bloom and beauty. They are very attentive. They hold weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are very close to Lalita, the consort of §rikame£vara. All their limbs are full with the freshness of youthful bloom and beauty. They are very attentive. They hold weapons.

verses.sanskrit: भवनं दीपिताशेषदिक्चक्रं रत्नरश्मिभिः । समस्ता देवता एता ललिताभक्तिनिर्भराः । ललितामन्त्रजाप्याश्च श्रीदेवीं समुपासते
verses.transliteration: bhavanaṃ dīpitāśeṣadikcakraṃ ratnaraśmibhiḥ / samastā devatā etā lalitābhaktinirbharāḥ / lalitāmantrajāpyāśca śrīdevīṃ samupāsate
verses.translation: Haughtily they move about both within the Bindu - pi (ha and all round too. They carry out the order of Lalita. They are the close companions and confidants of the VaJls.
verses.wordMeaning: Haughtily they move about both within the Bindu - pi (ha and all round too. They carry out the order of Lalita. They are the close companions and confidants of the VaJls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haughtily they move about both within the Bindu - pi (ha and all round too. They carry out the order of Lalita. They are the close companions and confidants of the VaJls.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वोक्त मर्ध्यस्थानं च पूर्वोक्तं चार्ध्यकल्पनम् । याम्यद्वारप्रभृतिषु सर्वेष्वपि समं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvokta mardhyasthānaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ cārdhyakalpanam / yāmyadvāraprabhṛtiṣu sarveṣvapi samaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: All these have weapons with them. They are adorned with all ornaments. Above and below, they have the forms of pillars. They have personal forms in the middle.
verses.wordMeaning: All these have weapons with them. They are adorned with all ornaments. Above and below, they have the forms of pillars. They have personal forms in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these have weapons with them. They are adorned with all ornaments. Above and below, they have the forms of pillars. They have personal forms in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चिन्तामणिगृहं वक्ष्ये शृणु महामुने । तच्छ्रीपट्टनमध्यस्थं योजनद्वयविस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: atha cintāmaṇigṛhaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu mahāmune / tacchrīpaṭṭanamadhyasthaṃ yojanadvayavismṛtam
verses.translation: They keep their eyes closed in meditation on Sri. Their limbs are steady without any movement due to medita- tion on Sri. Above them, the plank of the couch is Sad&£iva.
verses.wordMeaning: They keep their eyes closed in meditation on Sri. Their limbs are steady without any movement due to medita- tion on Sri. Above them, the plank of the couch is Sad&£iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: They keep their eyes closed in meditation on Sri. Their limbs are steady without any movement due to medita- tion on Sri. Above them, the plank of the couch is Sad&£iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चिन्तामणिभयी भित्तिः कोशसुविस्तृता । चिन्तामणिशिलाभिश्च च्छादिनीभिस्तथोपरि
verses.transliteration: tasya cintāmaṇibhayī bhittiḥ kośasuvistṛtā / cintāmaṇiśilābhiśca cchādinībhistathopari
verses.translation: It has the splendour of a full-blown pomegranate flower. The plank is six Nalvas long and four Nalvas broad. It is continuously sparkling and refulgent.
verses.wordMeaning: It has the splendour of a full-blown pomegranate flower. The plank is six Nalvas long and four Nalvas broad. It is continuously sparkling and refulgent.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has the splendour of a full-blown pomegranate flower. The plank is six Nalvas long and four Nalvas broad. It is continuously sparkling and refulgent.

verses.sanskrit: संवृता कूटरूपेण तत्रतत्र समुन्नता । गृहभित्तिस्तथोन्नम्रा चतुर्योजनमानतः
verses.transliteration: saṃvṛtā kūṭarūpeṇa tatratatra samunnatā / gṛhabhittistathonnamrā caturyojanamānataḥ
verses.translation: Thus the rows of stairs numbering thirtysix have been recounted. The entire row of stairs is on the eastern side of the couch.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the rows of stairs numbering thirtysix have been recounted. The entire row of stairs is on the eastern side of the couch.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the rows of stairs numbering thirtysix have been recounted. The entire row of stairs is on the eastern side of the couch.

verses.sanskrit: विंशतिर्योजनं तस्याश्चोन्नम्रा भूमिरुच्यते । ततोर्ध्वं ह्राससंयुक्तं स्थौल्यत्रिमुकुटोज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: viṃśatiryojanaṃ tasyāśconnamrā bhūmirucyate / tatordhvaṃ hrāsasaṃyuktaṃ sthaulyatrimukuṭojjvalā
verses.translation: (Description of Goddess Lali la) K
verses.wordMeaning: (Description of Goddess Lali la) K
verses.commentary: Sense: (Description of Goddess Lali la) K

verses.sanskrit: तानि चेच्छाक्रियाज्ञानरूपाणि मुकुटान्यृषे । सदा देदीप्यमानानि चिन्तामणिमयान्यपि
verses.transliteration: tāni cecchākriyājñānarūpāṇi mukuṭānyṛṣe / sadā dedīpyamānāni cintāmaṇimayānyapi
verses.translation: She has the lustre of unpolished ruby stone. The splendour of her nails is like that of sandal paste and lotus. She has redness in the soles of her feet regardless of application of red lac.
verses.wordMeaning: She has the lustre of unpolished ruby stone. The splendour of her nails is like that of sandal paste and lotus. She has redness in the soles of her feet regardless of application of red lac.
verses.commentary: Sense: She has the lustre of unpolished ruby stone. The splendour of her nails is like that of sandal paste and lotus. She has redness in the soles of her feet regardless of application of red lac.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणिगृहे सर्वं चिन्तामणिमयं स्मृतम् । यस्य द्वाराणि चत्वारि क्रोशार्धायामभाञ्जि च
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇigṛhe sarvaṃ cintāmaṇimayaṃ smṛtam / yasya dvārāṇi catvāri krośārdhāyāmabhāñji ca
verses.translation: The knot of her garment comes upto the middle of her thighs. She shines with a girdle set with gems and jewels. Her navel is depressed like a great whirl-pool and the three wrinkled folds spreading over it appear like a river of light and gleam.
verses.wordMeaning: The knot of her garment comes upto the middle of her thighs. She shines with a girdle set with gems and jewels. Her navel is depressed like a great whirl-pool and the three wrinkled folds spreading over it appear like a river of light and gleam.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knot of her garment comes upto the middle of her thighs. She shines with a girdle set with gems and jewels. Her navel is depressed like a great whirl-pool and the three wrinkled folds spreading over it appear like a river of light and gleam.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोशार्द्धार्द्धं च विस्तारो द्वाराणां कथितो मुने । द्वारेषु सर्वेषु पुनश्चिन्तामणिगृहान्तरे
verses.transliteration: krośārddhārddhaṃ ca vistāro dvārāṇāṃ kathito mune / dvāreṣu sarveṣu punaścintāmaṇigṛhāntare
verses.translation: She has worn a number of pearl necklaces swinging to and fro over her breasts. Her slender waist appears to be breaking due to the weight of her plump breasts.
verses.wordMeaning: She has worn a number of pearl necklaces swinging to and fro over her breasts. Her slender waist appears to be breaking due to the weight of her plump breasts.
verses.commentary: Sense: She has worn a number of pearl necklaces swinging to and fro over her breasts. Her slender waist appears to be breaking due to the weight of her plump breasts.

verses.sanskrit: पिहिता ललिता देव्या मूतर्लोहितसिन्धुवत् । तरुणार्कसहस्राभा चन्द्रवच्छीतला ह्यपि । मुहुः प्रवाहरूपेण प्रसरन्ती महामुने
verses.transliteration: pihitā lalitā devyā mūtarlohitasindhuvat / taruṇārkasahasrābhā candravacchītalā hyapi / muhuḥ pravāharūpeṇa prasarantī mahāmune
verses.translation: She shines with many ornaments set with pearls. Her eyes are as large and long as the inner petal of the Ketaka flower.
verses.wordMeaning: She shines with many ornaments set with pearls. Her eyes are as large and long as the inner petal of the Ketaka flower.
verses.commentary: Sense: She shines with many ornaments set with pearls. Her eyes are as large and long as the inner petal of the Ketaka flower.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाम्नाय मयं चैव पूर्वद्वारं प्रकीर्तितम् । दक्षिणद्वारदेशस्तु दक्षिणाम्नायलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: pūrvāmnāya mayaṃ caiva pūrvadvāraṃ prakīrtitam / dakṣiṇadvāradeśastu dakṣiṇāmnāyalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: In her forehead as charming as the crescent moon the forelocks have been neatly arranged. Her ears are adorned with different kinds of ornaments and ear-rings of ruby.
verses.wordMeaning: In her forehead as charming as the crescent moon the forelocks have been neatly arranged. Her ears are adorned with different kinds of ornaments and ear-rings of ruby.
verses.commentary: Sense: In her forehead as charming as the crescent moon the forelocks have been neatly arranged. Her ears are adorned with different kinds of ornaments and ear-rings of ruby.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमद्वारदेशस्तु पश्चिमाम्नायलक्षणः । उत्तरद्वारदेशः स्यादुत्तराम्नायलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: paścimadvāradeśastu paścimāmnāyalakṣaṇaḥ / uttaradvāradeśaḥ syāduttarāmnāyalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Her tresses are dark and thick-set like the dense
verses.wordMeaning: Her tresses are dark and thick-set like the dense
verses.commentary: Sense: Her tresses are dark and thick-set like the dense

verses.sanskrit: गृहराजस्यान्तराले भित्तौ खचितदण्डकाः । रत्नप्रदीपा भास्वन्तः कोट्यर्कसदृशत्विषः । परितस्तत्र वर्तन्ते भासयन्तो गृहान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: gṛharājasyāntarāle bhittau khacitadaṇḍakāḥ / ratnapradīpā bhāsvantaḥ koṭyarkasadṛśatviṣaḥ / paritastatra vartante bhāsayanto gṛhāntaram
verses.translation: The crescent moon shines like a diadem. Her eyes move to and fro due to inebriation. She possesses all romantic dress and make-up exciting love. She is embellished with all ornaments.
verses.wordMeaning: The crescent moon shines like a diadem. Her eyes move to and fro due to inebriation. She possesses all romantic dress and make-up exciting love. She is embellished with all ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: The crescent moon shines like a diadem. Her eyes move to and fro due to inebriation. She possesses all romantic dress and make-up exciting love. She is embellished with all ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामणिगृहस्यास्य मध्यस्थाने महीयसि । अत्युच्चैर्वेदिकाभागे बिन्दुचक्रं महात्तरम्
verses.transliteration: cintāmaṇigṛhasyāsya madhyasthāne mahīyasi / atyuccairvedikābhāge binducakraṃ mahāttaram
verses.translation: She delights exeryone with the stream of sympathy
verses.wordMeaning: She delights exeryone with the stream of sympathy
verses.commentary: Sense: She delights exeryone with the stream of sympathy

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तारत्नगृहोत्तुङ्गभिन्त्तेर्बिन्दोश्च मध्यभूः । भित्तिः क्रोशं परित्यज्य क्रोशत्रयमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: cintāratnagṛhottuṅgabhintterbindośca madhyabhūḥ / bhittiḥ krośaṃ parityajya krośatrayamudāhṛtam
verses.translation: People know that the benefit of worship of other deities is the opportunity to worship her. Hence, the benefit of her worship is the opportunity to worship her.
verses.wordMeaning: People know that the benefit of worship of other deities is the opportunity to worship her. Hence, the benefit of her worship is the opportunity to worship her.
verses.commentary: Sense: People know that the benefit of worship of other deities is the opportunity to worship her. Hence, the benefit of her worship is the opportunity to worship her.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र क्रोशत्रयस्थाने ह्यणिमाद्यात्मरोचिषा । क्रोशत्रयं समस्तं तद्धस्तसंख्याप्रकारतः । चतुर्विंशतिसाहस्रहस्तैः संमितमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra krośatrayasthāne hyaṇimādyātmarociṣā / krośatrayaṃ samastaṃ taddhastasaṃkhyāprakārataḥ / caturviṃśatisāhasrahastaiḥ saṃmitamucyate
verses.translation: How can I then describe Goddess Lalita adequately. Even in the course of a thousand crores of years, a fraction of it cannot be described.
verses.wordMeaning: How can I then describe Goddess Lalita adequately. Even in the course of a thousand crores of years, a fraction of it cannot be described.
verses.commentary: Sense: How can I then describe Goddess Lalita adequately. Even in the course of a thousand crores of years, a fraction of it cannot be described.

verses.sanskrit: बिन्दुपीठेशपर्यम्तं चतुर्दशविभेदतः । अन्तरे भेदिते जाते हस्तसंख्या मयोच्यते
verses.transliteration: bindupīṭheśaparyamtaṃ caturdaśavibhedataḥ / antare bhedite jāte hastasaṃkhyā mayocyate
verses.translation: All round the Bindupifha a handsome and symmetri- cal curtain hangs down. It is the MahdmSydjaoanikd (screen of Mahamaya) and is dark in colour.
verses.wordMeaning: All round the Bindupifha a handsome and symmetri- cal curtain hangs down. It is the MahdmSydjaoanikd (screen of Mahamaya) and is dark in colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round the Bindupifha a handsome and symmetri- cal curtain hangs down. It is the MahdmSydjaoanikd (screen of Mahamaya) and is dark in colour.

verses.sanskrit: पद्माटवीस्थलाच्चिन्तामणिवेश्मान्तरं मुने । हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं तत्र स्युरणिमादयः
verses.transliteration: padmāṭavīsthalāccintāmaṇiveśmāntaraṃ mune / hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ tatra syuraṇimādayaḥ
verses.translation: She alone knows everything regarding the good features obtaining there. Her exalted grandeur and felicity is far beyond even our comprehension. By whom can it be described?
verses.wordMeaning: She alone knows everything regarding the good features obtaining there. Her exalted grandeur and felicity is far beyond even our comprehension. By whom can it be described?
verses.commentary: Sense: She alone knows everything regarding the good features obtaining there. Her exalted grandeur and felicity is far beyond even our comprehension. By whom can it be described?

verses.sanskrit: अणिमान्तरविस्तारश्चतुर्नल्वसमन्वितः । किष्कुश्चतुःशती नल्वकिष्कुर्हस्त उदीर्यते
verses.transliteration: aṇimāntaravistāraścaturnalvasamanvitaḥ / kiṣkuścatuḥśatī nalvakiṣkurhasta udīryate
verses.translation: Thus for the sake of slaying Bhanda, the great Daitya, Lalitimbika has manifested herself from the Cidanala. (the fire of knowledge and consciousness). She has entirely burned all Danavas.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus for the sake of slaying Bhanda, the great Daitya, Lalitimbika has manifested herself from the Cidanala. (the fire of knowledge and consciousness). She has entirely burned all Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus for the sake of slaying Bhanda, the great Daitya, Lalitimbika has manifested herself from the Cidanala. (the fire of knowledge and consciousness). She has entirely burned all Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रान्तरे ऽणिमाद्यास्तु पूर्वादिकृतमन्दिराः । अणिमा महिमा चैव लघिमा गरिमा तथा
verses.transliteration: tatrāntare 'ṇimādyāstu pūrvādikṛtamandirāḥ / aṇimā mahimā caiva laghimā garimā tathā
verses.translation: Presiding over Srinagara which had been built by celestial artisans and craftsman and which has sixteen holy establishments, she protects the Universe continuously.
verses.wordMeaning: Presiding over Srinagara which had been built by celestial artisans and craftsman and which has sixteen holy establishments, she protects the Universe continuously.
verses.commentary: Sense: Presiding over Srinagara which had been built by celestial artisans and craftsman and which has sixteen holy establishments, she protects the Universe continuously.

verses.sanskrit: ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च प्राकाम्यं मुक्तिरेव च । इच्छा प्राप्तिः सर्वकामेत्येताः सिद्धय उत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca prākāmyaṃ muktireva ca / icchā prāptiḥ sarvakāmetyetāḥ siddhaya uttamāḥ
verses.translation: There are other Sripuras also in this manner. In the arrangement there is no difference among them. The differ- ence is only in the name.
verses.wordMeaning: There are other Sripuras also in this manner. In the arrangement there is no difference among them. The differ- ence is only in the name.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other Sripuras also in this manner. In the arrangement there is no difference among them. The differ- ence is only in the name.

verses.sanskrit: रससिद्धिर्मोक्षसिद्धिर्बलसिद्धिस्तथैव च । खड्गसिद्धिः पादुकाया सिद्धिरञ्जनसिद्धिकः
verses.transliteration: rasasiddhirmokṣasiddhirbalasiddhistathaiva ca / khaḍgasiddhiḥ pādukāyā siddhirañjanasiddhikaḥ
verses.translation: Those who recount the story of Sripura beginning with the garden of many trees attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those who recount the story of Sripura beginning with the garden of many trees attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who recount the story of Sripura beginning with the garden of many trees attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: वाक्सिद्धिर्लोकसिद्धिश्च देहसिद्धिरनन्तरम् । एता अष्टौ सिद्धयस्तु बह्व्यो ऽन्या योगिसंमताः
verses.transliteration: vāksiddhirlokasiddhiśca dehasiddhiranantaram / etā aṣṭau siddhayastu bahvyo 'nyā yogisaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: The men too who listen to it, who ask about it, who search for it and who hold the book thereof attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: The men too who listen to it, who ask about it, who search for it and who hold the book thereof attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The men too who listen to it, who ask about it, who search for it and who hold the book thereof attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रान्तरे तु परितः सेवते परमेश्वरीम् । कोटिशः सिद्धयस्तस्मिन्नणिमाद्यन्तरे मुने
verses.transliteration: tatrāntare tu paritaḥ sevate parameśvarīm / koṭiśaḥ siddhayastasminnaṇimādyantare mune
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: नवलावण्यसंपूर्णाः स्मयमानमुखांबुजाः । ज्वलच्चिन्तामणि कराः मदा षोडशवर्षिकाः । अत्युदारप्रकृतयः खेलन्ति मदविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: navalāvaṇyasaṃpūrṇāḥ smayamānamukhāṃbujāḥ / jvalaccintāmaṇi karāḥ madā ṣoḍaśavarṣikāḥ / atyudāraprakṛtayaḥ khelanti madavihvalāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याणिमाद्यन्तरस्योपरिष्टात्सुमनोहरम् । हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāṇimādyantarasyopariṣṭātsumanoharam / hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दिक्षु च सोपानपङ्क्तिभिः सुमनोहरम् । ब्रह्माद्यंबरधिष्ण्यं स्यात्तत्रदेवीः स्थिताः शृणु
verses.transliteration: caturdikṣu ca sopānapaṅktibhiḥ sumanoharam / brahmādyaṃbaradhiṣṇyaṃ syāttatradevīḥ sthitāḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा । वाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डाप्यथ सप्तमी । महालक्ष्मीरष्टमी तु तत्रैताः कृतमन्दिराः
verses.transliteration: brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā / vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍāpyatha saptamī / mahālakṣmīraṣṭamī tu tatraitāḥ kṛtamandirāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधायुधाढ्याश्च नानाशक्तिपरिच्छदाः । पूर्वादिदिशमारभ्य प्रादक्षिण्यकृतालयाः
verses.transliteration: nānāvidhāyudhāḍhyāśca nānāśaktiparicchadāḥ / pūrvādidiśamārabhya prādakṣiṇyakṛtālayāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ब्राह्यन्तरा तस्योपरिष्टात्कुम्भसंभव । हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् । मुद्रान्तरमिति त्रैधं तत्र मुद्राः कृतालयाः
verses.transliteration: atha brāhyantarā tasyopariṣṭātkumbhasaṃbhava / hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram / mudrāntaramiti traidhaṃ tatra mudrāḥ kṛtālayāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: संक्षोभद्रावणाकर्षवश्योन्मादमहाङ्कुशाः । खेचरी बीजयोन्याख्या त्रिखण्डा दशमी पुनः
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣobhadrāvaṇākarṣavaśyonmādamahāṅkuśāḥ / khecarī bījayonyākhyā trikhaṇḍā daśamī punaḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
