verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसिद्धिप्रदा चैव सर्वसंपत्प्रदा तथा । सर्वप्रियङ्करी देवी सर्वमङ्गलकारिणी
verses.transliteration: sarvasiddhipradā caiva sarvasaṃpatpradā tathā / sarvapriyaṅkarī devī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामप्रदा देवी सर्वदुःखविमोचनी । सर्वमृत्युप्रशमिनी सर्वविघ्ननिवारिणी
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmapradā devī sarvaduḥkhavimocanī / sarvamṛtyupraśaminī sarvavighnanivāriṇī
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी देवी सर्वसौभाग्यदायिनी । एता देव्यः कलोत्कीर्णा योगिन्यो नामतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgasundarī devī sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī / etā devyaḥ kalotkīrṇā yoginyo nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रिणी श्रीश्च विज्ञेया चक्रं सर्वार्थसाधकम् । सर्वोन्मादनमुद्राश्च चक्रस्य परिपालिकाः
verses.transliteration: cakriṇī śrīśca vijñeyā cakraṃ sarvārthasādhakam / sarvonmādanamudrāśca cakrasya paripālikāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसिद्ध्याद्यन्तरस्योपरिष्टात्कुम्भसम्भव । हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasiddhyādyantarasyopariṣṭātkumbhasambhava / hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञाद्यन्तरं नाम्ना सर्वरक्षाकरं स्मृतम् । चक्रं महत्तरं दिव्यं सर्वज्ञाद्याः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvajñādyantaraṃ nāmnā sarvarakṣākaraṃ smṛtam / cakraṃ mahattaraṃ divyaṃ sarvajñādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञा सर्वशक्तिश्च सर्वैश्वर्यप्रदायिनी । सर्वज्ञानमयी देवी सर्वव्याधिविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradāyinī / sarvajñānamayī devī sarvavyādhivināśinī
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाधारस्वरूपा च सर्वपापहरी तथा । सर्वानन्दमयी देवी सर्वरक्षास्वरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: sarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharī tathā / sarvānandamayī devī sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेप्सितप्रदा चैता निर्गर्वा योगिनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sarvepsitapradā caitā nirgarvā yoginīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: मालिनी चक्रिणी प्रोक्ता मुद्रा सर्वमहाङ्कुशा । इति चिन्तामणि गृहे सर्वज्ञाद्यन्तरावधि । चक्राणि कानिचित्प्रोक्तान्यन्यान्यपि मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: mālinī cakriṇī proktā mudrā sarvamahāṅkuśā / iti cintāmaṇi gṛhe sarvajñādyantarāvadhi / cakrāṇi kānicitproktānyanyānyapi mune śṛṇu
verses.translation: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who get a replica of Sripura, made through craftsmen, with the different parts of the same duly represented and build a huge temple of Sridevi, do attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने चिन्तामणिगृहान्तरकथनं नाम षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः हयग्रीव उवाच सर्वज्ञद्यन्तरालस्योपरिष्टात्कलशोद्भव । हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne cintāmaṇigṛhāntarakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ hayagrīva uvāca sarvajñadyantarālasyopariṣṭātkalaśodbhava / hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram
verses.translation: Thousands of Vidyas seat themselves in Rudra's boats and in the form of Saktis and play about here and there.
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands of Vidyas seat themselves in Rudra's boats and in the form of Saktis and play about here and there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of Vidyas seat themselves in Rudra's boats and in the form of Saktis and play about here and there.

verses.sanskrit: वशिन्याद्यन्तरं ज्ञेयं प्राग्वत्सोपानमन्दिरम् । सर्वरोगहरं नाम्ना तच्चक्रमिति विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: vaśinyādyantaraṃ jñeyaṃ prāgvatsopānamandiram / sarvarogaharaṃ nāmnā taccakramiti viśrutam
verses.translation: They have been employed by Paramesthin to cleanse and purify the Arghya. After drinking that nectarine Arghya, the Saktis are always elated.
verses.wordMeaning: They have been employed by Paramesthin to cleanse and purify the Arghya. After drinking that nectarine Arghya, the Saktis are always elated.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have been employed by Paramesthin to cleanse and purify the Arghya. After drinking that nectarine Arghya, the Saktis are always elated.

verses.sanskrit: वशिन्याद्यास्तत्र देव्यः पूर्वादिदिगनुक्रमात् । स्वरैस्तु रहितास्तत्र प्रथमा वशिनीश्वरी
verses.transliteration: vaśinyādyāstatra devyaḥ pūrvādidiganukramāt / svaraistu rahitāstatra prathamā vaśinīśvarī
verses.translation: The Saktis attending upon those who stay in the abodes of Cintamani are proud and intoxicated. They offer this Arghya to Anima and other Saktis.
verses.wordMeaning: The Saktis attending upon those who stay in the abodes of Cintamani are proud and intoxicated. They offer this Arghya to Anima and other Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saktis attending upon those who stay in the abodes of Cintamani are proud and intoxicated. They offer this Arghya to Anima and other Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: कवर्गसहिता पश्चात्कामेश्वर्याख्यवाह्मयी । चवर्गजुष्टा वागीशी मोदिनी स्यात्तृतीयका
verses.transliteration: kavargasahitā paścātkāmeśvaryākhyavāhmayī / cavargajuṣṭā vāgīśī modinī syāttṛtīyakā
verses.translation: S third in N. The list of god Brahm&'s Kal&s in N. is as follows: Sr?ti, Buddhi, Smfti, Medha, K&nti, Lak$mi, Dyuti* Sthir&, Sthiti and Siddhi. 31-101.
verses.wordMeaning: S third in N. The list of god Brahm&'s Kal&s in N. is as follows: Sr?ti, Buddhi, Smfti, Medha, K&nti, Lak$mi, Dyuti* Sthir&, Sthiti and Siddhi. 31-101.
verses.commentary: Sense: S third in N. The list of god Brahm&'s Kal&s in N. is as follows: Sr?ti, Buddhi, Smfti, Medha, K&nti, Lak$mi, Dyuti* Sthir&, Sthiti and Siddhi. 31-101.

verses.sanskrit: टवर्गमण्डिताकारा विमलाख्या सरस्वती । तवर्गेण तथोपेता पञ्चमी वाक्प्रधारणा
verses.transliteration: ṭavargamaṇḍitākārā vimalākhyā sarasvatī / tavargeṇa tathopetā pañcamī vākpradhāraṇā
verses.translation: At the bidding of Lalita, a sacred Cidvahni (fire of Cit i.e. knowledge and consciousness) blazes there. It is honoured and adored by hundreds of nectarine currents. It is the cause of the greatest prosperity.
verses.wordMeaning: At the bidding of Lalita, a sacred Cidvahni (fire of Cit i.e. knowledge and consciousness) blazes there. It is honoured and adored by hundreds of nectarine currents. It is the cause of the greatest prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the bidding of Lalita, a sacred Cidvahni (fire of Cit i.e. knowledge and consciousness) blazes there. It is honoured and adored by hundreds of nectarine currents. It is the cause of the greatest prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: पवर्गेण परिस्फीता षष्ठी तु जयिनी मता । यादिवर्णचतुष्कोणे सर्वैश्वर्यादिवाङ्मयी
verses.transliteration: pavargeṇa parisphītā ṣaṣṭhī tu jayinī matā / yādivarṇacatuṣkoṇe sarvaiśvaryādivāṅmayī
verses.translation: Without fuel, the fire of consciousness blazes with great flames. It is kindled by means of Sudhd (Nectar). It has the lustre of tender shoots of Kankoll — (a plant with aromatic berries.)
verses.wordMeaning: Without fuel, the fire of consciousness blazes with great flames. It is kindled by means of Sudhd (Nectar). It has the lustre of tender shoots of Kankoll — (a plant with aromatic berries.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Without fuel, the fire of consciousness blazes with great flames. It is kindled by means of Sudhd (Nectar). It has the lustre of tender shoots of Kankoll — (a plant with aromatic berries.)

verses.sanskrit: साधिकाक्षरषट्केन कौलिनी त्वष्टमी मता । एता देव्यो जपरता मुक्ताभरणमण्डिताः
verses.transliteration: sādhikākṣaraṣaṭkena kaulinī tvaṣṭamī matā / etā devyo japaratā muktābharaṇamaṇḍitāḥ
verses.translation: VV.1-32 of this chapter state the position or distribution of places to various deities in Lalita's paraphernalia. The'following are their location:
verses.wordMeaning: VV.1-32 of this chapter state the position or distribution of places to various deities in Lalita's paraphernalia. The'following are their location:
verses.commentary: Sense: VV.1-32 of this chapter state the position or distribution of places to various deities in Lalita's paraphernalia. The'following are their location:

verses.sanskrit: सदा स्फुरद्गद्यपद्यलहरीलालिता मताः । काव्यैश्च नाटकैश्चैव मधुरैः कर्णहारिभिः । विनोदयन्त्यः श्रीदेवीं वर्तन्ते कुम्भसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: sadā sphuradgadyapadyalaharīlālitā matāḥ / kāvyaiśca nāṭakaiścaiva madhuraiḥ karṇahāribhiḥ / vinodayantyaḥ śrīdevīṃ vartante kumbhasambhavaḥ
verses.translation: The following deities have their mansions built consecutively to the North viz. Sri, Paramba (the great Mother goddess), Vi£adajyotsna (of clear moonlight) and Nirmala-Vigraha (of a body devoid of impurities).
verses.wordMeaning: The following deities have their mansions built consecutively to the North viz. Sri, Paramba (the great Mother goddess), Vi£adajyotsna (of clear moonlight) and Nirmala-Vigraha (of a body devoid of impurities).
verses.commentary: Sense: The following deities have their mansions built consecutively to the North viz. Sri, Paramba (the great Mother goddess), Vi£adajyotsna (of clear moonlight) and Nirmala-Vigraha (of a body devoid of impurities).

verses.sanskrit: एता रहस्यनाम्नैव ख्याता वातापितापन । नायिका स्वस्य चक्रस्य सिद्धानाम्ना प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: etā rahasyanāmnaiva khyātā vātāpitāpana / nāyikā svasya cakrasya siddhānāmnā prakīrtitā
verses.translation: The following four deities have their mansions successively to the north viz. — Bala, Annapurn&, Hayaru<Jh& and Sripaduka.
verses.wordMeaning: The following four deities have their mansions successively to the north viz. — Bala, Annapurn&, Hayaru<Jh& and Sripaduka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following four deities have their mansions successively to the north viz. — Bala, Annapurn&, Hayaru<Jh& and Sripaduka.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य चक्रस्य संरक्षाकारिणी खेचरी मता । वशिन्याद्यन्तरालस्योपरिष्टाद्विन्ध्यमर्दन
verses.transliteration: asya cakrasya saṃrakṣākāriṇī khecarī matā / vaśinyādyantarālasyopariṣṭādvindhyamardana
verses.translation: In this manner, thpre are great mansions of SriraSmimala. They are made of jewels and gems. O ascetic, they have flags fluttering very much high above. The chambers are huge and lofty with stair-cases.
verses.wordMeaning: In this manner, thpre are great mansions of SriraSmimala. They are made of jewels and gems. O ascetic, they have flags fluttering very much high above. The chambers are huge and lofty with stair-cases.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner, thpre are great mansions of SriraSmimala. They are made of jewels and gems. O ascetic, they have flags fluttering very much high above. The chambers are huge and lofty with stair-cases.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् । अस्त्रं चक्रमितिज्ञेयं तत्र बाणादिदेवताः
verses.transliteration: hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram / astraṃ cakramitijñeyaṃ tatra bāṇādidevatāḥ
verses.translation: In the eastern gate of the Palatial Cint&mani mansion, O quaffer of the ocean, on the right hand side is the great abode of Mantrinath&.
verses.wordMeaning: In the eastern gate of the Palatial Cint&mani mansion, O quaffer of the ocean, on the right hand side is the great abode of Mantrinath&.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the eastern gate of the Palatial Cint&mani mansion, O quaffer of the ocean, on the right hand side is the great abode of Mantrinath&.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च बाणेश्वरीदेव्यः पञ्च कामेश्वराशुगाः । अङ्कुशद्वितयं दीप्तमादिस्त्रीपुंसयोर्द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: pañca bāṇeśvarīdevyaḥ pañca kāmeśvarāśugāḥ / aṅkuśadvitayaṃ dīptamādistrīpuṃsayordvayoḥ
verses.translation: The mantra of three syllables: Orh jQth Safi
verses.wordMeaning: The mantra of three syllables: Orh jQth Safi
verses.commentary: Sense: The mantra of three syllables: Orh jQth Safi

verses.sanskrit: धनुर्द्वयं च विन्ध्यारे नव पुण्ड्रेषु कल्पितम् । पाशद्वयं च दीप्ताभं चत्वार्यस्त्राणि कुम्भज
verses.transliteration: dhanurdvayaṃ ca vindhyāre nava puṇḍreṣu kalpitam / pāśadvayaṃ ca dīptābhaṃ catvāryastrāṇi kumbhaja
verses.translation: The place of Arghya and the preparation of Arghya materials mentioned before are, it is remembered, the same in all the entrances beginning with the Southern one.
verses.wordMeaning: The place of Arghya and the preparation of Arghya materials mentioned before are, it is remembered, the same in all the entrances beginning with the Southern one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The place of Arghya and the preparation of Arghya materials mentioned before are, it is remembered, the same in all the entrances beginning with the Southern one.

verses.sanskrit: कामेश्वर्यास्तु चत्वारि चत्वारि श्रीमहेशितुः । आहत्याष्टायुधानीति प्रज्वलन्ति विभान्ति च
verses.transliteration: kāmeśvaryāstu catvāri catvāri śrīmaheśituḥ / āhatyāṣṭāyudhānīti prajvalanti vibhānti ca
verses.translation: Now I shall describe in detail the abode of Cintamani. Listen, O great sage. It is situated in the centre of Sripattana and it extends to two Yojanas.
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall describe in detail the abode of Cintamani. Listen, O great sage. It is situated in the centre of Sripattana and it extends to two Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall describe in detail the abode of Cintamani. Listen, O great sage. It is situated in the centre of Sripattana and it extends to two Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: भण्डासुरमहायुद्धे दुष्टदानवशोणितैः । पीतैरतीव तृप्तानिदिव्यास्त्राण्यति जाग्रति
verses.transliteration: bhaṇḍāsuramahāyuddhe duṣṭadānavaśoṇitaiḥ / pītairatīva tṛptānidivyāstrāṇyati jāgrati
verses.translation: Within the royal abode there are sparkling gemset lamps with their handle fixed on the walls. They have the splendour of ten million suns. They are fixed in various places all round, brightening the whole of the interior of the Mansion.
verses.wordMeaning: Within the royal abode there are sparkling gemset lamps with their handle fixed on the walls. They have the splendour of ten million suns. They are fixed in various places all round, brightening the whole of the interior of the Mansion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within the royal abode there are sparkling gemset lamps with their handle fixed on the walls. They have the splendour of ten million suns. They are fixed in various places all round, brightening the whole of the interior of the Mansion.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषामायुधानां तु परिवारायुधान्यलम् । वर्तन्ते ऽस्त्रान्तरे तत्र तेषां संख्या तु कोटिशः
verses.transliteration: eteṣāmāyudhānāṃ tu parivārāyudhānyalam / vartante 'strāntare tatra teṣāṃ saṃkhyā tu koṭiśaḥ
verses.translation: In the splendid central area of the mansion of Cinta- mani in a part of the altar is the great and lofty Hindu Cakra (Circular spot).
verses.wordMeaning: In the splendid central area of the mansion of Cinta- mani in a part of the altar is the great and lofty Hindu Cakra (Circular spot).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the splendid central area of the mansion of Cinta- mani in a part of the altar is the great and lofty Hindu Cakra (Circular spot).

verses.sanskrit: वज्रशक्तिः शतघ्नी च भुशुण्डी मुसलं तथा । कृपाणः पट्टिशं चैव मुद्गरं भिन्दिपालकम्
verses.transliteration: vajraśaktiḥ śataghnī ca bhuśuṇḍī musalaṃ tathā / kṛpāṇaḥ paṭṭiśaṃ caiva mudgaraṃ bhindipālakam
verses.translation: The space in between the lofty wall of the mansion of Cintamani and Birdu is after leaving off a KroSa occupied by the wall cited to be three Kro£as ( in width).
verses.wordMeaning: The space in between the lofty wall of the mansion of Cintamani and Birdu is after leaving off a KroSa occupied by the wall cited to be three Kro£as ( in width).
verses.commentary: Sense: The space in between the lofty wall of the mansion of Cintamani and Birdu is after leaving off a KroSa occupied by the wall cited to be three Kro£as ( in width).

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि शस्त्राणि सहस्राणां सहस्रशः । अष्टायुधमहाशक्तीः सेवन्ते मदविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: evamādīni śastrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ / aṣṭāyudhamahāśaktīḥ sevante madavihvalāḥ
verses.translation: In that section (extending to) three Krosas are their own rays of (Siddhis like) Animd etc. If we reckon the entire length of the three KroSas in Hastas (Cubits) it is said to be consisting of twentyfour thousand Hastas.
verses.wordMeaning: In that section (extending to) three Krosas are their own rays of (Siddhis like) Animd etc. If we reckon the entire length of the three KroSas in Hastas (Cubits) it is said to be consisting of twentyfour thousand Hastas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that section (extending to) three Krosas are their own rays of (Siddhis like) Animd etc. If we reckon the entire length of the three KroSas in Hastas (Cubits) it is said to be consisting of twentyfour thousand Hastas.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शस्त्रान्तरालस्योपरि वातापितापन । हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् । धिष्ण्यं तु समयेशीनां स्थानं च तिसृणां मतम्
verses.transliteration: atha śastrāntarālasyopari vātāpitāpana / hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram / dhiṣṇyaṃ tu samayeśīnāṃ sthānaṃ ca tisṛṇāṃ matam
verses.translation: From Bindu to the PifheSa, there are fourteen different (sections). In the portion thus differentiated, the number of Hastas is being mentioned by me.
verses.wordMeaning: From Bindu to the PifheSa, there are fourteen different (sections). In the portion thus differentiated, the number of Hastas is being mentioned by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Bindu to the PifheSa, there are fourteen different (sections). In the portion thus differentiated, the number of Hastas is being mentioned by me.

verses.sanskrit: कामेशाद्यास्तत्र देव्यस्तिस्रो ऽन्या तु चतुर्थिका । सैव निःशेषविश्वानां सवित्री ललितेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: kāmeśādyāstatra devyastisro 'nyā tu caturthikā / saiva niḥśeṣaviśvānāṃ savitrī laliteśvarī
verses.translation: The interior of the mansion of Cintamani, 1 O Sage, is twenty Hastas above the level of the ground of the lotus grove. The Animd and other ( Siddhis ) abide there.
verses.wordMeaning: The interior of the mansion of Cintamani, 1 O Sage, is twenty Hastas above the level of the ground of the lotus grove. The Animd and other ( Siddhis ) abide there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The interior of the mansion of Cintamani, 1 O Sage, is twenty Hastas above the level of the ground of the lotus grove. The Animd and other ( Siddhis ) abide there.

verses.sanskrit: तिसृणां शृणु नामानि कामेशी प्रथमा मता । वज्रेशी भगमाला च ताः सेवन्ते सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tisṛṇāṃ śṛṇu nāmāni kāmeśī prathamā matā / vajreśī bhagamālā ca tāḥ sevante sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The extent of (the plot of the abodes of Aitimd etc. is four Nalvas. Four hundred Kifkus make one Naha, By the word Ki$ku it is a Hasta (cubit) that is mentioned.
verses.wordMeaning: The extent of (the plot of the abodes of Aitimd etc. is four Nalvas. Four hundred Kifkus make one Naha, By the word Ki$ku it is a Hasta (cubit) that is mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent of (the plot of the abodes of Aitimd etc. is four Nalvas. Four hundred Kifkus make one Naha, By the word Ki$ku it is a Hasta (cubit) that is mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां दर्शनानां च या देव्यो विविधाः स्मृताः । ताः सर्वास्तत्र सेवन्ते कामेशादिमहोदयाः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ darśanānāṃ ca yā devyo vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ / tāḥ sarvāstatra sevante kāmeśādimahodayāḥ
verses.translation: They are full of fresh youthful bloom. Their lotus-like faces beam with smiles (for ever). Their hands (palms) are like radiant Cint&mani gems. They are always sixteen years in age. They have noble and highly exalted nature. They play about in their excitement due to inebriation.
verses.wordMeaning: They are full of fresh youthful bloom. Their lotus-like faces beam with smiles (for ever). Their hands (palms) are like radiant Cint&mani gems. They are always sixteen years in age. They have noble and highly exalted nature. They play about in their excitement due to inebriation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are full of fresh youthful bloom. Their lotus-like faces beam with smiles (for ever). Their hands (palms) are like radiant Cint&mani gems. They are always sixteen years in age. They have noble and highly exalted nature. They play about in their excitement due to inebriation.

verses.sanskrit: एतासांच प्रसंगेषु नित्यानां च प्रसञ्जने । चक्रिणीनां योगिनीनां श्रीदेवी पूरणात्मिका
verses.transliteration: etāsāṃca prasaṃgeṣu nityānāṃ ca prasañjane / cakriṇīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ śrīdevī pūraṇātmikā
verses.translation: They are eight: Brahmi, Mahe£vari, Kaum&ri, Vaiggavi, Mahendri, Varahi, Ca.muii<J& and Mahalak?mi. These have built their abodes here.
verses.wordMeaning: They are eight: Brahmi, Mahe£vari, Kaum&ri, Vaiggavi, Mahendri, Varahi, Ca.muii<J& and Mahalak?mi. These have built their abodes here.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are eight: Brahmi, Mahe£vari, Kaum&ri, Vaiggavi, Mahendri, Varahi, Ca.muii<J& and Mahalak?mi. These have built their abodes here.

verses.sanskrit: या कामेश्वरदेवाङ्कशायिनी ललितांबिका । कामेश्यादिचतुर्थी सा नित्यानां षोडशी मता
verses.transliteration: yā kāmeśvaradevāṅkaśāyinī lalitāṃbikā / kāmeśyādicaturthī sā nityānāṃ ṣoḍaśī matā
verses.translation: They are armed with different kinds of weapons. They have different Saktis as their retinue. Beginning with the East, they have got their abodes built in a circle.
verses.wordMeaning: They are armed with different kinds of weapons. They have different Saktis as their retinue. Beginning with the East, they have got their abodes built in a circle.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are armed with different kinds of weapons. They have different Saktis as their retinue. Beginning with the East, they have got their abodes built in a circle.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनी चक्रदेवीनां नवमी परिकीर्तिता । समयेश्यन्तरालस्योपरिष्टादिल्वलान्तक
verses.transliteration: yoginī cakradevīnāṃ navamī parikīrtitā / samayeśyantarālasyopariṣṭādilvalāntaka
verses.translation: These three Antaras constitute Cakra (Wheel) that fascinates the three worlds. Those who are Saktis among these have been recounted with their names expressed.
verses.wordMeaning: These three Antaras constitute Cakra (Wheel) that fascinates the three worlds. Those who are Saktis among these have been recounted with their names expressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: These three Antaras constitute Cakra (Wheel) that fascinates the three worlds. Those who are Saktis among these have been recounted with their names expressed.

verses.sanskrit: नाथान्तरमिति प्रोक्तं हस्तविंशतिरुन्नतम् । चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तारं प्राग्वत्सोपानमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: nāthāntaramiti proktaṃ hastaviṃśatirunnatam / caturnalvapravistāraṃ prāgvatsopānamaṇḍitam
verses.translation: The Nitya Kamakar?anika, Buddhyakar§anika, Nitya Ras&karsa$ika, Kala Gandhakar§anika, Nitya Citta- kar$anika, Kala Dhaii)&karsanik&, Nitya Sm!'ty&karsanik&, Kala Namakarsanika, Nitya Bljakar$anika, Kali Arthakarsa- niki, Am; takarsanl and Kala Sarirakar$anl — These are Gupta (invisible) Yoginls. TripuresI the ruler of Tripura is CakrinI, is also called Sai vasapurika who is the presiding deity of the Cakra. The protectress in this Gakra is the Mudra named
verses.wordMeaning: The Nitya Kamakar?anika, Buddhyakar§anika, Nitya Ras&karsa$ika, Kala Gandhakar§anika, Nitya Citta- kar$anika, Kala Dhaii)&karsanik&, Nitya Sm!'ty&karsanik&, Kala Namakarsanika, Nitya Bljakar$anika, Kali Arthakarsa- niki, Am;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nitya Kamakar?anika, Buddhyakar§anika, Nitya Ras&karsa$ika, Kala Gandhakar§anika, Nitya Citta- kar$anika, Kala Dhaii)&karsanik&, Nitya Sm!'ty&karsanik&, Kala Namakarsanika, Nitya Bljakar$anika, Kali Arthakarsa- niki, Am;…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नाथामहादेव्या योगशास्त्रप्रवर्त्तकाः । सर्वेषां मन्त्रगुरवः सर्वविद्यामहार्णवाः
verses.transliteration: tatra nāthāmahādevyā yogaśāstrapravarttakāḥ / sarveṣāṃ mantraguravaḥ sarvavidyāmahārṇavāḥ
verses.translation: Twenty Hastas above the level of the Antara of Anafigaiakti, O Pot-born Sage, is the Antara of Sarfikfobhini and others. It extends to four Nalvas. It is the bestower of all good fortune and felicity.
verses.wordMeaning: Twenty Hastas above the level of the Antara of Anafigaiakti, O Pot-born Sage, is the Antara of Sarfikfobhini and others. It extends to four Nalvas. It is the bestower of all good fortune and felicity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twenty Hastas above the level of the Antara of Anafigaiakti, O Pot-born Sage, is the Antara of Sarfikfobhini and others. It extends to four Nalvas. It is the bestower of all good fortune and felicity.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारो यागनाथाश्च लोकानामिह गुप्तये । सृष्टाः कामंशदेवेन तेषां नामानि मे शृणु
verses.transliteration: catvāro yāganāthāśca lokānāmiha guptaye / sṛṣṭāḥ kāmaṃśadevena teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu
verses.translation: Then comes the goddess of speech named Vimala who is embellished by the Ta-varga (cerebrals ). The fifth one is the goddess of speech called Pradharajia accompanied by Ta-varga (Dentals).
verses.wordMeaning: Then comes the goddess of speech named Vimala who is embellished by the Ta-varga (cerebrals ). The fifth one is the goddess of speech called Pradharajia accompanied by Ta-varga (Dentals).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then comes the goddess of speech named Vimala who is embellished by the Ta-varga (cerebrals ). The fifth one is the goddess of speech called Pradharajia accompanied by Ta-varga (Dentals).

verses.sanskrit: मित्री च शोडिशश्चैव चर्याख्यः कुम्भसम्भव । तैः सृष्टा बहवो लोकारक्षार्थं पादुकात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: mitrī ca śoḍiśaścaiva caryākhyaḥ kumbhasambhava / taiḥ sṛṣṭā bahavo lokārakṣārthaṃ pādukātmakāḥ
verses.translation: They are considered to be fondled by the spontaneous flow of prose and poetry. They stay there, O Pot-born Sage, delighting and amusing Sri-Devi by means of sweet lyrics and dramas pleasing to the ears.
verses.wordMeaning: They are considered to be fondled by the spontaneous flow of prose and poetry. They stay there, O Pot-born Sage, delighting and amusing Sri-Devi by means of sweet lyrics and dramas pleasing to the ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are considered to be fondled by the spontaneous flow of prose and poetry. They stay there, O Pot-born Sage, delighting and amusing Sri-Devi by means of sweet lyrics and dramas pleasing to the ears.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यविद्या मानवौघसिद्धौघाः सुरतापसाः । प्राप्तसालोक्यसारूप्यसायुज्यादिकसिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: divyavidyā mānavaughasiddhaughāḥ suratāpasāḥ / prāptasālokyasārūpyasāyujyādikasiddhayaḥ
verses.translation: These divine weapons are extremely gratified by the blood of the wicked Danavas that was drunk by them in the course of the great battle with the Asura Bhanda. Those divine weapons are active and alert now.
verses.wordMeaning: These divine weapons are extremely gratified by the blood of the wicked Danavas that was drunk by them in the course of the great battle with the Asura Bhanda. Those divine weapons are active and alert now.
verses.commentary: Sense: These divine weapons are extremely gratified by the blood of the wicked Danavas that was drunk by them in the course of the great battle with the Asura Bhanda. Those divine weapons are active and alert now.

verses.sanskrit: महान्तो गुरवस्तांस्तु सेवन्ते प्रचुरा गुरून् । अथ नाथान्तरालस्योपरिष्टाद्धिष्ण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mahānto guravastāṃstu sevante pracurā gurūn / atha nāthāntarālasyopariṣṭāddhiṣṇyamuttamam
verses.translation: Among other weapons there are supplementary weapons of these weapons. Their number runs into crores.
verses.wordMeaning: Among other weapons there are supplementary weapons of these weapons. Their number runs into crores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among other weapons there are supplementary weapons of these weapons. Their number runs into crores.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तविंशतिरुन्नमं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् । नित्यान्तरमिति प्रोक्तं नित्याः पञ्चदशात्र वै
verses.transliteration: hastaviṃśatirunnamaṃ caturnalvapravistaram / nityāntaramiti proktaṃ nityāḥ pañcadaśātra vai
verses.translation: All those different kinds of deities remembered as pertaining to all the systems of philosophy serve the great goddesses there beginning wish Karnesi.
verses.wordMeaning: All those different kinds of deities remembered as pertaining to all the systems of philosophy serve the great goddesses there beginning wish Karnesi.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those different kinds of deities remembered as pertaining to all the systems of philosophy serve the great goddesses there beginning wish Karnesi.

verses.sanskrit: अथ कामेश्वरी नित्या नित्या च भगमालिनी । नित्यक्लिन्ना अपि तथा भेरुण्डा वह्निवासिनी
verses.transliteration: atha kāmeśvarī nityā nityā ca bhagamālinī / nityaklinnā api tathā bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinī
verses.translation: Sri Devi is the deity that completes the number when these deities as well as the deities named Nityas, Cakrinis and the Yoginis are reckoned. Mother Lalita who reclines on the lap of Lord Kamesvara is the fourth one in the group of Karnesi and others. She is the sixteenth among Nityas. She is glorified as the ninth one among Yoginis and Cakra Devis.
verses.wordMeaning: Sri Devi is the deity that completes the number when these deities as well as the deities named Nityas, Cakrinis and the Yoginis are reckoned. Mother Lalita who reclines on the lap of Lord Kamesvara is the fourth one in the group of Karnesi and others.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sri Devi is the deity that completes the number when these deities as well as the deities named Nityas, Cakrinis and the Yoginis are reckoned. Mother Lalita who reclines on the lap of Lord Kamesvara is the fourth one in the group of Karnesi and others.…

verses.sanskrit: महावज्रेश्वरी दूती त्वरिता कुलसुन्दरी । नित्या नीलपताका च विजया सर्वमङ्गला
verses.transliteration: mahāvajreśvarī dūtī tvaritā kulasundarī / nityā nīlapatākā ca vijayā sarvamaṅgalā
verses.translation: They are very close to Lalita, the consort of §rikame£vara. All their limbs are full with the freshness of youthful bloom and beauty. They are very attentive. They hold weapons.
verses.wordMeaning: They are very close to Lalita, the consort of §rikame£vara. All their limbs are full with the freshness of youthful bloom and beauty. They are very attentive. They hold weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are very close to Lalita, the consort of §rikame£vara. All their limbs are full with the freshness of youthful bloom and beauty. They are very attentive. They hold weapons.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालिनिका चित्रेत्येताः पञ्चदशोदिताः । एता देवीस्वरूपाः स्युर्महाबलपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālinikā citretyetāḥ pañcadaśoditāḥ / etā devīsvarūpāḥ syurmahābalaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: Haughtily they move about both within the Bindu - pi (ha and all round too. They carry out the order of Lalita. They are the close companions and confidants of the VaJls.
verses.wordMeaning: Haughtily they move about both within the Bindu - pi (ha and all round too. They carry out the order of Lalita. They are the close companions and confidants of the VaJls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haughtily they move about both within the Bindu - pi (ha and all round too. They carry out the order of Lalita. They are the close companions and confidants of the VaJls.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमा मुख्यतिथितां प्राप्ता व्याप्य जगत्त्रयाः । कालत्रितयरूपाश्च कालग्रासविचक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: prathamā mukhyatithitāṃ prāptā vyāpya jagattrayāḥ / kālatritayarūpāśca kālagrāsavicakṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: All these have weapons with them. They are adorned with all ornaments. Above and below, they have the forms of pillars. They have personal forms in the middle.
verses.wordMeaning: All these have weapons with them. They are adorned with all ornaments. Above and below, they have the forms of pillars. They have personal forms in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these have weapons with them. They are adorned with all ornaments. Above and below, they have the forms of pillars. They have personal forms in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादीनामशेषाणां चिरकालमुपेयुषाम् । तत्तत्कालशतायुष्यरूपा देव्याज्ञया स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: brahmādīnāmaśeṣāṇāṃ cirakālamupeyuṣām / tattatkālaśatāyuṣyarūpā devyājñayā sthitāḥ
verses.translation: They keep their eyes closed in meditation on Sri. Their limbs are steady without any movement due to medita- tion on Sri. Above them, the plank of the couch is Sad&£iva.
verses.wordMeaning: They keep their eyes closed in meditation on Sri. Their limbs are steady without any movement due to medita- tion on Sri. Above them, the plank of the couch is Sad&£iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: They keep their eyes closed in meditation on Sri. Their limbs are steady without any movement due to medita- tion on Sri. Above them, the plank of the couch is Sad&£iva.

verses.sanskrit: नित्योद्यता निरान्तकाः श्रीपराङ्गसमुद्भवाः । सेवन्ते जगतामृद्ध्यै ललितां चित्स्वरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: nityodyatā nirāntakāḥ śrīparāṅgasamudbhavāḥ / sevante jagatāmṛddhyai lalitāṃ citsvarūpiṇīm
verses.translation: It has the splendour of a full-blown pomegranate flower. The plank is six Nalvas long and four Nalvas broad. It is continuously sparkling and refulgent.
verses.wordMeaning: It has the splendour of a full-blown pomegranate flower. The plank is six Nalvas long and four Nalvas broad. It is continuously sparkling and refulgent.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रादिस्तु लोपामुद्रा स्यात्कामराजस्तु कादिकाः । हंसादेर्वाच्यतां याताः कामराजो महेस्वरः
verses.transliteration: hrādistu lopāmudrā syātkāmarājastu kādikāḥ / haṃsādervācyatāṃ yātāḥ kāmarājo mahesvaraḥ
verses.translation: Those highly fortunate ones who worship* (with) Paficatrika Maha-Vidya (the Mantra expressed by three sets of five i.e. 15 letters) which describes Lalitamba will have
verses.wordMeaning: Those highly fortunate ones who worship* (with) Paficatrika Maha-Vidya (the Mantra expressed by three sets of five i.e. 15 letters) which describes Lalitamba will have
verses.commentary: Sense: Those highly fortunate ones who worship* (with) Paficatrika Maha-Vidya (the Mantra expressed by three sets of five i.e. 15 letters) which describes Lalitamba will have

verses.sanskrit: स्मरादेर्वाच्यतां याता देवी श्रीललितांबिका । हादिकाद्योर्मन्त्रयोस्तु भेदो वर्णत्रयोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: smarādervācyatāṃ yātā devī śrīlalitāṃbikā / hādikādyormantrayostu bhedo varṇatrayodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: After receiving from the great good preceptor the Mantra sanctified and consecrated by Tripaficana (Three X five
verses.wordMeaning: After receiving from the great good preceptor the Mantra sanctified and consecrated by Tripaficana (Three X five
verses.commentary: Sense: After receiving from the great good preceptor the Mantra sanctified and consecrated by Tripaficana (Three X five

verses.sanskrit: त्योश्च कामराजो ऽयं सिद्धिदो भक्तिशालिनाम् । शिवेन शक्त्या कामेन क्षित्या चैव तु मायया
verses.transliteration: tyośca kāmarājo 'yaṃ siddhido bhaktiśālinām / śivena śaktyā kāmena kṣityā caiva tu māyayā
verses.translation: He should then wear clean clothes red or brown in colour. He should then perform Acamana ( ceremonious sipping of water). With great purity (in mind and body) the learned devotee should mentally meditate upon the great Ambika (Mo ther-godd ess ).
verses.wordMeaning: He should then wear clean clothes red or brown in colour. He should then perform Acamana ( ceremonious sipping of water). With great purity (in mind and body) the learned devotee should mentally meditate upon the great Ambika (Mo ther-godd ess ).
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then wear clean clothes red or brown in colour. He should then perform Acamana ( ceremonious sipping of water). With great purity (in mind and body) the learned devotee should mentally meditate upon the great Ambika (Mo ther-godd ess ).

verses.sanskrit: हंसेन भृगुणा चैव कामेन शशिमौलिना । शक्रेण भुवनेशेन चन्द्रेण च मनोभुवा
verses.transliteration: haṃsena bhṛguṇā caiva kāmena śaśimaulinā / śakreṇa bhuvaneśena candreṇa ca manobhuvā
verses.translation: He should put sacred marks on his forehead in the manner to which he is accustomed, viz. Orddhva Pundra (in the shape of capital U ), Paficavardhana ( in the shape of the leaf of castor oil plant) Tripundra (three parallel and horizontal lines) or Agastyapatra— shaped (like the leaf of Agasti Grandi- flora). Pure in soul (mind) he should perform Sandhyd Vandana in a secluded spot.
verses.wordMeaning: He should put sacred marks on his forehead in the manner to which he is accustomed, viz. Orddhva Pundra (in the shape of capital U ),…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should put sacred marks on his forehead in the manner to which he is accustomed, viz. Orddhva Pundra (in the shape of capital U ),…

verses.sanskrit: क्षित्या हृल्लेखया चैव प्रोक्तो हंसादिमन्त्रराट् । कामादिमन्त्रराजस्तु स्मरयोनिः श्रियो मुखे
verses.transliteration: kṣityā hṛllekhayā caiva prokto haṃsādimantrarāṭ / kāmādimantrarājastu smarayoniḥ śriyo mukhe
verses.translation: He should offer Arghya (water-oblation) along with Darbha grass, raw rice, flower and sandal paste in a vessel of the shape of the leaf of an A£vattha ( Ficus Regligiosa) tree.
verses.wordMeaning: He should offer Arghya (water-oblation) along with Darbha grass, raw rice, flower and sandal paste in a vessel of the shape of the leaf of an A£vattha ( Ficus Regligiosa) tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should offer Arghya (water-oblation) along with Darbha grass, raw rice, flower and sandal paste in a vessel of the shape of the leaf of an A£vattha ( Ficus Regligiosa) tree.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चत्रिकमहाविद्या ललितांबा प्रवाचिकाम् । ये यजन्ति महाभागास्तेषां सर्वत्र सिद्धये
verses.transliteration: pañcatrikamahāvidyā lalitāṃbā pravācikām / ye yajanti mahābhāgāsteṣāṃ sarvatra siddhaye
verses.translation: W. 17-32 describe the procedure of S&dhand for getting 'mastery" over the Lalid mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: W. 17-32 describe the procedure of S&dhand for getting 'mastery" over the Lalid mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: W. 17-32 describe the procedure of S&dhand for getting 'mastery" over the Lalid mantra.

verses.sanskrit: सद्गुरोस्तु मनुं प्राप्य त्रिपञ्चार्णपरिष्कृतम् । सम्यक्संसाधयेद्विद्वान्वक्ष्यमाणप्रकारतः
verses.transliteration: sadgurostu manuṃ prāpya tripañcārṇapariṣkṛtam / samyaksaṃsādhayedvidvānvakṣyamāṇaprakārataḥ
verses.translation: Hotna should be oneitenth (of Japa), i. e. three hundred and sixty thousand. The Tarpana shall be one- tenth (of the Homo) i.e., thirty six thousand. The feeding of the Brahmanas is expressed as one-tenth of the same, i.e. three thousand six hundred.
verses.wordMeaning: Hotna should be oneitenth (of Japa), i. e. three hundred and sixty thousand. The Tarpana shall be one- tenth (of the Homo) i.e., thirty six thousand. The feeding of the Brahmanas is expressed as one-tenth of the same, i.e. three thousand six hundred.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hotna should be oneitenth (of Japa), i. e. three hundred and sixty thousand. The Tarpana shall be one- tenth (of the Homo) i.e., thirty six thousand. The feeding of the Brahmanas is expressed as one-tenth of the same, i.e. three thousand six hundred.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्रमेण प्रवक्ष्यामि सावधानो मुने शृणु । प्रातरुत्थाय शिरसिस्मृत्वा कमलमुज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: tatkrameṇa pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno mune śṛṇu / prātarutthāya śirasismṛtvā kamalamujjvalam
verses.translation: After having achieved the mastery over the Mantra, the devotee should continue Japa for other purposes desired by him. 1 By performing Japas, a hundred thousand times,
verses.wordMeaning: After having achieved the mastery over the Mantra, the devotee should continue Japa for other purposes desired by him. 1 By performing Japas, a hundred thousand times,
verses.commentary: Sense: After having achieved the mastery over the Mantra, the devotee should continue Japa for other purposes desired by him. 1 By performing Japas, a hundred thousand times,

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रपत्रशोभाढ्यं सकेशरसुकर्णिकम् । तत्र श्रीमद्गुरुं ध्वात्वा प्रसन्नं करुणामयम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrapatraśobhāḍhyaṃ sakeśarasukarṇikam / tatra śrīmadguruṃ dhvātvā prasannaṃ karuṇāmayam
verses.translation: VV. 33-62 described the "fruits'* or powers one achieves after performing specific quantity of Japa of mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 33-62 described the "fruits'* or powers one achieves after performing specific quantity of Japa of mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 33-62 described the "fruits'* or powers one achieves after performing specific quantity of Japa of mantra.

verses.sanskrit: ततोबहिर्विनिर्गत्य कुर्याच्छौचादिकाः क्रियाः । अथागत्य च तैलेन सामोदेन विलेपितः
verses.transliteration: tatobahirvinirgatya kuryācchaucādikāḥ kriyāḥ / athāgatya ca tailena sāmodena vilepitaḥ
verses.translation: By performing Japas two hundred thousand times, he can fascinate and win over women. By performing Japas three hundred thousand times, he can control all beings and win them over.
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Japas two hundred thousand times, he can fascinate and win over women. By performing Japas three hundred thousand times, he can control all beings and win them over.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Japas two hundred thousand times, he can fascinate and win over women. By performing Japas three hundred thousand times, he can control all beings and win them over.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वर्तितश्च सुस्नातः शुद्धेनोष्णेन वारिणा । आपो निसर्गतः पूताः किं पुनर्वह्निसंयुताः । तस्मादुष्णोदके स्नायात्तदभावे यथोदकम्
verses.transliteration: udvartitaśca susnātaḥ śuddhenoṣṇena vāriṇā / āpo nisargataḥ pūtāḥ kiṃ punarvahnisaṃyutāḥ / tasmāduṣṇodake snāyāttadabhāve yathodakam
verses.translation: When the completed Japas come to four hundred thousand times, the daughters of serpents become excited in love for him. When the Japas reach five hundred thousand times, the women of Patala become excited for him.
verses.wordMeaning: When the completed Japas come to four hundred thousand times, the daughters of serpents become excited in love for him. When the Japas reach five hundred thousand times, the women of Patala become excited for him.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the completed Japas come to four hundred thousand times, the daughters of serpents become excited in love for him. When the Japas reach five hundred thousand times, the women of Patala become excited for him.

verses.sanskrit: परिधाय पटौ शुद्धे कौसुम्भौ वाथ वारुणौ । आचम्य प्रयतो विद्वान्हृदि ध्यायन्परांबिकाम्
verses.transliteration: paridhāya paṭau śuddhe kausumbhau vātha vāruṇau / ācamya prayato vidvānhṛdi dhyāyanparāṃbikām
verses.translation: The entire group of beautiful women of th cBhQloka (Earth) shall be won over by performing Japa six hundred thousand times. The fawn-eyed beauties of the Svargaloka (Heaven) become excited by seven hundred thousand (Japa).
verses.wordMeaning: The entire group of beautiful women of th cBhQloka (Earth) shall be won over by performing Japa six hundred thousand times. The fawn-eyed beauties of the Svargaloka (Heaven) become excited by seven hundred thousand (Japa).
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire group of beautiful women of th cBhQloka (Earth) shall be won over by performing Japa six hundred thousand times. The fawn-eyed beauties of the Svargaloka (Heaven) become excited by seven hundred thousand (Japa).

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रं त्रिपुण्डं वा पट्टवर्धनमेव वा । अगस्त्यपत्राकारं वा धृत्वा भाले निजोचितम् । अन्तर्हितश्च शुद्धात्मा सन्ध्यावन्दनमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tripuṇḍaṃ vā paṭṭavardhanameva vā / agastyapatrākāraṃ vā dhṛtvā bhāle nijocitam / antarhitaśca śuddhātmā sandhyāvandanamācaret
verses.translation: All those who are born of the race of Devas can be won over and subdued by means of eight hundred thousand Japas. One shall win over all gods by means of nine hundred thousand Japas*
verses.wordMeaning: All those who are born of the race of Devas can be won over and subdued by means of eight hundred thousand Japas. One shall win over all gods by means of nine hundred thousand Japas*
verses.commentary: Sense: All those who are born of the race of Devas can be won over and subdued by means of eight hundred thousand Japas. One shall win over all gods by means of nine hundred thousand Japas*

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थपत्राकारेण पात्रेण सकुशाक्षतम् । सपुष्पचन्दनं चार्ध्यं मार्तण्डाय समुत्क्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: aśvatthapatrākāreṇa pātreṇa sakuśākṣatam / sapuṣpacandanaṃ cārdhyaṃ mārtaṇḍāya samutkṣipet
verses.translation: One can win over and subdue Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara by means of one million one hundred thousand Japas. One can achieve the eight Siddhis (Super-human powers) by means of one million two hundred thousand Japas.
verses.wordMeaning: One can win over and subdue Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara by means of one million one hundred thousand Japas. One can achieve the eight Siddhis (Super-human powers) by means of one million two hundred thousand Japas.
verses.commentary: Sense: One can win over and subdue Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara by means of one million one hundred thousand Japas. One can achieve the eight Siddhis (Super-human powers) by means of one million two hundred thousand Japas.

verses.sanskrit: तथार्ध्यभावदेवत्वाल्ललितायै त्रिरर्ध्यकम् । तर्प्पयित्वा यथाशक्ति मूलेन ललितेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: tathārdhyabhāvadevatvāllalitāyai trirardhyakam / tarppayitvā yathāśakti mūlena laliteśvarīm
verses.translation: Indu(the Moon-god) achieved his moonhood by means of this, Bhanu (The Sun-god) achieved his solar status through this. Understand that the different refulgent mystic powers of all Devas have been acquired by this prominent Mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: Indu(the Moon-god) achieved his moonhood by means of this, Bhanu (The Sun-god) achieved his solar status through this. Understand that the different refulgent mystic powers of all Devas have been acquired by this prominent Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indu(the Moon-god) achieved his moonhood by means of this, Bhanu (The Sun-god) achieved his solar status through this. Understand that the different refulgent mystic powers of all Devas have been acquired by this prominent Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिपितृवर्गांश्च तर्पयित्वा विधानतः । दिवाकरमुपास्थाय देवीं च रविबिम्बगाम्
verses.transliteration: devarṣipitṛvargāṃśca tarpayitvā vidhānataḥ / divākaramupāsthāya devīṃ ca ravibimbagām
verses.translation: He shall be endowed with all Siddhis. He shall
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be endowed with all Siddhis. He shall
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be endowed with all Siddhis. He shall

verses.sanskrit: मौनी विशुद्धहृदयः प्रविश्य मखमन्दिरम् । चारुकर्पूरकस्तूरीचन्दनादिविलेपितः
verses.transliteration: maunī viśuddhahṛdayaḥ praviśya makhamandiram / cārukarpūrakastūrīcandanādivilepitaḥ
verses.translation: He shall be equal to Vacaspati (Preceptor of Devas) in eloquent speech. In glory and magnificence, he shall be equal to the wind-god. In steadiness and firmness, he will be like the Himalaya mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be equal to Vacaspati (Preceptor of Devas) in eloquent speech. In glory and magnificence, he shall be equal to the wind-god. In steadiness and firmness, he will be like the Himalaya mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be equal to Vacaspati (Preceptor of Devas) in eloquent speech. In glory and magnificence, he shall be equal to the wind-god. In steadiness and firmness, he will be like the Himalaya mountain.

verses.sanskrit: भूषणैर्भूषिताङ्गश्च चारुशृङ्गारवेषधृक् । आमोदिकुसुमस्रग्भिरवतंसितकुन्तलः
verses.transliteration: bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṅgaśca cāruśṛṅgāraveṣadhṛk / āmodikusumasragbhiravataṃsitakuntalaḥ
verses.translation: In loftiness he will be equal to Meru. In depth and majesty he shall be like a great ocean. Within a trice he can cause excitement in villages, rural settlements, cities, etc. by his personality.
verses.wordMeaning: In loftiness he will be equal to Meru. In depth and majesty he shall be like a great ocean. Within a trice he can cause excitement in villages, rural settlements, cities, etc. by his personality.
verses.commentary: Sense: In loftiness he will be equal to Meru. In depth and majesty he shall be like a great ocean. Within a trice he can cause excitement in villages, rural settlements, cities, etc. by his personality.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पभूषणो वाथ यथाविभवभूषणः । पूजाखण्डे वक्ष्यमाणान्कृत्वा न्यासाननुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpabhūṣaṇo vātha yathāvibhavabhūṣaṇaḥ / pūjākhaṇḍe vakṣyamāṇānkṛtvā nyāsānanukramāt
verses.translation: Clusters of flames of excessive passion make them blaze as it were. They appear to be burned by showers of fiery arrows of the god of love.
verses.wordMeaning: Clusters of flames of excessive passion make them blaze as it were. They appear to be burned by showers of fiery arrows of the god of love.
verses.commentary: Sense: Clusters of flames of excessive passion make them blaze as it were. They appear to be burned by showers of fiery arrows of the god of love.

verses.sanskrit: मृद्वासने समासीनो ध्यायेच्छ्रीनगरं महत् । नानावृक्षमहोद्यानमारभ्य ललितावधि
verses.transliteration: mṛdvāsane samāsīno dhyāyecchrīnagaraṃ mahat / nānāvṛkṣamahodyānamārabhya lalitāvadhi
verses.translation: They are afflicted by anxiety; they seem to suffer on account of the fever of love; they are dried up due to bashfulness.
verses.wordMeaning: They are afflicted by anxiety; they seem to suffer on account of the fever of love; they are dried up due to bashfulness.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are afflicted by anxiety; they seem to suffer on account of the fever of love; they are dried up due to bashfulness.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायेच्छ्रीनगरं दिव्यं बहिरन्तरतः शुचिः । पूजाखण्डोक्तमार्गेम पूजां कृत्वा विलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyecchrīnagaraṃ divyaṃ bahirantarataḥ śuciḥ / pūjākhaṇḍoktamārgema pūjāṃ kṛtvā vilakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Just as a drop of water when blown about, moves up and down on a lotus leaf, so also the minds of beautiful ladies become restless on seeing him.
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a drop of water when blown about, moves up and down on a lotus leaf, so also the minds of beautiful ladies become restless on seeing him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a drop of water when blown about, moves up and down on a lotus leaf, so also the minds of beautiful ladies become restless on seeing him.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षमालां समादाय चन्द्रकस्तूरिवासिताम् । उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्खो वा जपेत्सिंहासनेश्वरीम् । षट्त्रिंशल्लक्षसंख्यां तु जपेद्विद्या प्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: akṣamālāṃ samādāya candrakastūrivāsitām / udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅkho vā japetsiṃhāsaneśvarīm / ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣasaṃkhyāṃ tu japedvidyā prasīdati
verses.translation: * (Partially defective text). He is humble and modest. Driving away the rude and impolite persons is the greatest achievement. Rows and rows of all lores serve him.
verses.wordMeaning: * (Partially defective text). He is humble and modest. Driving away the rude and impolite persons is the greatest achievement. Rows and rows of all lores serve him.
verses.commentary: Sense: * (Partially defective text). He is humble and modest. Driving away the rude and impolite persons is the greatest achievement. Rows and rows of all lores serve him.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दशांशस्तु होमः स्यात्तद्दशांशं च तर्पणम् । तद्दशांशं ब्राह्मणानां भोजनं समुदीरितम्
verses.transliteration: taddaśāṃśastu homaḥ syāttaddaśāṃśaṃ ca tarpaṇam / taddaśāṃśaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ samudīritam
verses.translation: When TrilokI Lai ana ( the three worlds in the form of a woman) shines with the discs of the moon and sun as her two breasts, begging to love him at his very sight, then, O ascetic, what need be said about other women more wretched and pitiable?
verses.wordMeaning: When TrilokI Lai ana ( the three worlds in the form of a woman) shines with the discs of the moon and sun as her two breasts, begging to love him at his very sight, then, O ascetic, what need be said about other women more wretched and pitiable?
verses.commentary: Sense: When TrilokI Lai ana ( the three worlds in the form of a woman) shines with the discs of the moon and sun as her two breasts, begging to love him at his very sight, then, O ascetic, what need be said about other women more wretched and pitiable?

verses.sanskrit: एवं स सिद्धमन्त्रस्तु कुर्यात्काम्यजपं पुनः । लक्षमात्रं जपित्वा तु मनुष्यान्वशमानयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa siddhamantrastu kuryātkāmyajapaṃ punaḥ / lakṣamātraṃ japitvā tu manuṣyānvaśamānayet
verses.translation: At his very sight the signs of sinners perish. Only his good qualities are proclaimed everywhere by leading poets.
verses.wordMeaning: At his very sight the signs of sinners perish. Only his good qualities are proclaimed everywhere by leading poets.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his very sight the signs of sinners perish. Only his good qualities are proclaimed everywhere by leading poets.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षद्वितयजाप्येन नारीः सर्वा वशं नयेत् । लक्षत्रितयजापेन सर्वान्वशयते नृपान्
verses.transliteration: lakṣadvitayajāpyena nārīḥ sarvā vaśaṃ nayet / lakṣatritayajāpena sarvānvaśayate nṛpān
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the great goddess ( Mah&devi ) by means of different letters, weapons, different vehicles and ornaments attain the respective super-human powers (Siddhis)
verses.wordMeaning: Those who meditate on the great goddess ( Mah&devi ) by means of different letters, weapons, different vehicles and ornaments attain the respective super-human powers (Siddhis)
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who meditate on the great goddess ( Mah&devi ) by means of different letters, weapons, different vehicles and ornaments attain the respective super-human powers (Siddhis)

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्लक्षजपे जाते क्षुभ्यन्ति फणिकन्यकाः । पञ्चलक्षजपे जाते सर्वाः पातालयोषितः
verses.transliteration: caturlakṣajape jāte kṣubhyanti phaṇikanyakāḥ / pañcalakṣajape jāte sarvāḥ pātālayoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: The first part of the Mantra has the fine white lustre of the jasmine and the Moon. That should be thought and pondered over at the root of Ahaicakra, (Wheel of the day) *. It has blazing flames.

verses.transliteration: bhūlokasundarīvargo vaśyaḥṣaḍlakṣajāpataḥ / kṣubhyanti sapta lakṣeṇa svargalokamṛgīdṛśaḥ
verses.translation: The third part that dispels all sins should be observed in the follow of the two-petalled lotus placed inside the lotus of Bala and others. * * *

verses.transliteration: devayonibhavāḥ sarve 'pyaṣṭalakṣajapādvaśāḥ / navalakṣeṇa gīrvāṇā nakhilānvaśamānayet
verses.translation: For the sake of salvation, Ambika with white complexion and feature like the Moon-light should be meditated upon. 1

verses.transliteration: lakṣaikādaśajāpyena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān / lakṣadvādaśajāpena siddhīraṣṭau vaśaṃ nayet

verses.transliteration: indrasyendratvametena mantreṇa hyabhavatpurā / viṣṇorviṣṇutvametena śivasya śivatāmunā
verses.translation: VV. 67-71 Various Dhyinas of Lalit& for different objectives or

verses.sanskrit: इन्दोश्चन्द्रत्वमेतेन भानोर्भास्करतामुना । सर्वासां देवतानां च तास्ताः सिद्धय उज्ज्वलाः । अनेन मन्त्रराजेन जाता इत्यवधारय

verses.translation: Those who meditate upon her as a great mass of splen- dour refulgent like a ruby-lamp from the Mulidharacakra to the Brakmarandhra ( the aperture on the crown of the head) shall achieve all siddhis (Super-natural powers).

verses.translation: Thus, O Pot-born sage, those who observe and meditate upon SrldevI by means of various types of Dhyanas obtain great glory and wealth. This is attained only by good people, never by bad people.

verses.translation: Only, they, by whom severe penance has been practised, do perform meditation. He who meditates has no subsequent birth. He who is not Sankara himself, never gains Mantra Vidy& of Lalita Parame£vari).
