verses.transliteration: aśvānana mahāprājña vedavedāntavittama / śrutametanmahāpuṇyaṃ lalitākhyānamuttamam
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by you that Tripura, the greatest deity is worthy of being worshipped by all. Her four arms are equipped with noose, goad, bow and arrows.
verses.wordMeaning: It has been mentioned by you that Tripura, the greatest deity is worthy of being worshipped by all. Her four arms are equipped with noose, goad, bow and arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been mentioned by you that Tripura, the greatest deity is worthy of being worshipped by all. Her four arms are equipped with noose, goad, bow and arrows.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपूज्या त्वया प्रोक्ता त्रिपुरा परदेवता । पाशाङ्कुशधनुर्बाण परिष्कृतचतुर्भुजा
verses.transliteration: sarvapūjyā tvayā proktā tripurā paradevatā / pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇa pariṣkṛtacaturbhujā
verses.translation: Her Mantra* also has been mentioned. So also the Sri Cakra which has nine outer coverings and the mystic circles as its ornaments. (You have mentioned that) l£ani is the presiding deity of Sripura.
verses.wordMeaning: Her Mantra* also has been mentioned. So also the Sri Cakra which has nine outer coverings and the mystic circles as its ornaments. (You have mentioned that) l£ani is the presiding deity of Sripura.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her Mantra* also has been mentioned. So also the Sri Cakra which has nine outer coverings and the mystic circles as its ornaments. (You have mentioned that) l£ani is the presiding deity of Sripura.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या मन्त्रमिति प्रोक्तं श्रीचक्रं चक्रूषणम् । नवावरणमीशानी श्रीपरस्याधिदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: tasyā mantramiti proktaṃ śrīcakraṃ cakrūṣaṇam / navāvaraṇamīśānī śrīparasyādhidaivatam
verses.translation: She has only two arms. Her slim creeper-like body shines magnificently and gracefully in every respect. Her beauty is something never seen before. She is the greatest deity in the form of great refulgence.
verses.wordMeaning: She has only two arms. Her slim creeper-like body shines magnificently and gracefully in every respect. Her beauty is something never seen before. She is the greatest deity in the form of great refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: She has only two arms. Her slim creeper-like body shines magnificently and gracefully in every respect. Her beauty is something never seen before. She is the greatest deity in the form of great refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: काञ्चीपुरे पवित्रे ऽस्मिन्महीमण्डलमण्डले । केयं विभाति कल्याणी कामाक्षीत्यभिविश्रुता
verses.transliteration: kāñcīpure pavitre 'sminmahīmaṇḍalamaṇḍale / keyaṃ vibhāti kalyāṇī kāmākṣītyabhiviśrutā
verses.translation: "On being addressed thus by Agastya, the noble- hearted Hayagriva became delighted. In honour of that refulgence, he closed his eyes and meditated on that brilliance. After meditating upon and bowing down (to that refulgence), he spoke to Agastya: — **
verses.wordMeaning: "On being addressed thus by Agastya, the noble- hearted Hayagriva became delighted. In honour of that refulgence, he closed his eyes and meditated on that brilliance. After meditating upon and bowing down (to that refulgence), he spoke to Agastya: — **
verses.commentary: Sense: "On being addressed thus by Agastya, the noble- hearted Hayagriva became delighted. In honour of that refulgence, he closed his eyes and meditated on that brilliance. After meditating upon and bowing down (to that refulgence), he spoke to Agastya: — **

verses.sanskrit: द्विभुजा विविधोल्लासविलसत्तनुवल्लरी । अदृष्टपूर्वसैन्दर्या परज्योतिर्मयी परा
verses.transliteration: dvibhujā vividhollāsavilasattanuvallarī / adṛṣṭapūrvasaindaryā parajyotirmayī parā
verses.translation: She had a wonderfully exquisite beauty. She was the greatest deity in the form of a great splendour. She was renowned as Adilaksmi (Primordial Laksmi). She was stationed in the heart of everyone.
verses.wordMeaning: She had a wonderfully exquisite beauty. She was the greatest deity in the form of a great splendour. She was renowned as Adilaksmi (Primordial Laksmi). She was stationed in the heart of everyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: She had a wonderfully exquisite beauty. She was the greatest deity in the form of a great splendour. She was renowned as Adilaksmi (Primordial Laksmi). She was stationed in the heart of everyone.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच अगस्त्येनैवमुक्तः सन्परानन्दादृतेक्षणः । ध्यायंस्तच्च परं तेजो हयग्रीवो महामनाः । इति ध्यात्वा नमस्कृत्य तमगस्त्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca agastyenaivamuktaḥ sanparānandādṛtekṣaṇaḥ / dhyāyaṃstacca paraṃ tejo hayagrīvo mahāmanāḥ / iti dhyātvā namaskṛtya tamagastyamathābravīt
verses.translation: They call her Tripura herself, the mother of Brahma, Visnu and Isa. She was famous by the name Kamak$i. On
verses.wordMeaning: They call her Tripura herself, the mother of Brahma, Visnu and Isa. She was famous by the name Kamak$i. On
verses.commentary: Sense: They call her Tripura herself, the mother of Brahma, Visnu and Isa. She was famous by the name Kamak$i. On

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच रहस्यं संप्रवक्ष्यामि लोपामुद्रापते शृणु
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca rahasyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi lopāmudrāpate śṛṇu
verses.translation: "Be victorious, O goddess, O mother of the Universe,
verses.wordMeaning: "Be victorious, O goddess, O mother of the Universe,
verses.commentary: Sense: "Be victorious, O goddess, O mother of the Universe,

verses.sanskrit: आद्या याणुतरा सा स्याच्चित्परा त्वादिकारणम् । अन्ताख्येति तथा प्रोक्ता स्वरूपात्तत्त्वचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: ādyā yāṇutarā sā syāccitparā tvādikāraṇam / antākhyeti tathā proktā svarūpāttattvacintakaiḥ
verses.translation: Be victorious, O mass of glory and mercifulness. Be victorious, O heroine of sentiment of Love. Be victorious, O goddess of devotees with many Siddhis. Be victorious, O goddess saluted by leading Yogins.
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, O mass of glory and mercifulness. Be victorious, O heroine of sentiment of Love. Be victorious, O goddess of devotees with many Siddhis. Be victorious, O goddess saluted by leading Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O mass of glory and mercifulness. Be victorious, O heroine of sentiment of Love. Be victorious, O goddess of devotees with many Siddhis. Be victorious, O goddess saluted by leading Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयाभूत्ततः शुद्धपराद्विभुजसंयुता । दक्षहस्ते योगमुद्रां वामहस्ते तु पुस्तकम्
verses.transliteration: dvitīyābhūttataḥ śuddhaparādvibhujasaṃyutā / dakṣahaste yogamudrāṃ vāmahaste tu pustakam
verses.translation: Be victorious, be victorious, O mother of the Universe, O goddess of eternal form. Be victorious, be victorious, O goddess, the bestower of happiness to all the people who praise and extol. Be victorious, O goddess worthy of being glorified by the Himalaya Mountain. Be victorious, O beautiful, consort of Sankara in the from ofKamesvara.
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, be victorious, O mother of the Universe, O goddess of eternal form. Be victorious, be victorious, O goddess, the bestower of happiness to all the people who praise and extol. Be victorious, O goddess worthy of being glorified by the Himalaya Mountain.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, be victorious, O mother of the Universe, O goddess of eternal form. Be victorious, be victorious, O goddess, the bestower of happiness to all the people who praise and extol. Be victorious, O goddess worthy of being glorified by the Himalaya Mountain.…

verses.sanskrit: बिभ्रती हिमकुन्देन्दुमुक्तासमवपुर्द्युतिः । परापरा तृतीया स्याद्बा लार्कायुतसंमिता
verses.transliteration: bibhratī himakundendumuktāsamavapurdyutiḥ / parāparā tṛtīyā syādbā lārkāyutasaṃmitā
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to that goddess who frequently carries out creation, sustenance, annihilation, concealment and blessing of worlds simply by her volition.
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to that goddess who frequently carries out creation, sustenance, annihilation, concealment and blessing of worlds simply by her volition.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to that goddess who frequently carries out creation, sustenance, annihilation, concealment and blessing of worlds simply by her volition.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाभरणसंयुक्ता दशहस्तधृताम्बुजा । वामोरुन्यस्तहस्ता वा किरीटार्धेन्दुभूषणा
verses.transliteration: sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā daśahastadhṛtāmbujā / vāmorunyastahastā vā kirīṭārdhendubhūṣaṇā
verses.translation: By means of very sharp arrows and missiles, she annihilates now all those sinful people who create confusion and chaos in the discipline of castes and stages of life. Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: By means of very sharp arrows and missiles, she annihilates now all those sinful people who create confusion and chaos in the discipline of castes and stages of life. Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of very sharp arrows and missiles, she annihilates now all those sinful people who create confusion and chaos in the discipline of castes and stages of life. Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चाच्चतुर्भुजा जाता सा परा त्रिपुरारुणा । पाशाङ्कुशेक्षुकोदण्डपञ्चबाणलसत्करा
verses.transliteration: paścāccaturbhujā jātā sā parā tripurāruṇā / pāśāṅkuśekṣukodaṇḍapañcabāṇalasatkarā
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess on whom Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Is vara and Sad&£iva meditate and in whom they are solely engaged.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess on whom Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Is vara and Sad&£iva meditate and in whom they are solely engaged.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess on whom Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Is vara and Sad&£iva meditate and in whom they are solely engaged.

verses.sanskrit: ललिता सैव कामाक्षी काञ्च्यां व्यक्तिमुपागता । सरस्वतीरमागौर्यस्तामेवाद्यामुपासते
verses.transliteration: lalitā saiva kāmākṣī kāñcyāṃ vyaktimupāgatā / sarasvatīramāgauryastāmevādyāmupāsate
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess (about whom it is said) that the Vedas constitute her vital airs, that the five
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess (about whom it is said) that the Vedas constitute her vital airs, that the five
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, obeisance to that goddess (about whom it is said) that the Vedas constitute her vital airs, that the five

verses.sanskrit: नेत्रद्वयं महेशस्य काशीकाञ्जीपुरद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: netradvayaṃ maheśasya kāśīkāñjīpuradvayam
verses.translation: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess at whose bidding the thousand-hooded leading serpent (Sesa) supports the Earth, the base of all people.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess at whose bidding the thousand-hooded leading serpent (Sesa) supports the Earth, the base of all people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess at whose bidding the thousand-hooded leading serpent (Sesa) supports the Earth, the base of all people.

verses.sanskrit: विख्यातं वैष्णवं क्षेत्रं शिवसांनिध्य कारकम् । काञ्चीक्षेत्रे पुरा धाता सर्वलोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: vikhyātaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ śivasāṃnidhya kārakam / kāñcīkṣetre purā dhātā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Sages say that the twenty-five Tattvas and the five sheaths (coverings) of Maya are identical with her. Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess.
verses.wordMeaning: Sages say that the twenty-five Tattvas and the five sheaths (coverings) of Maya are identical with her. Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages say that the twenty-five Tattvas and the five sheaths (coverings) of Maya are identical with her. Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेवीदर्शनायैव तपस्तेपे सुदुष्करम् । आत्मैकध्यानयुक्तस्य तस्यव्रतवतो मुने
verses.transliteration: śrīdevīdarśanāyaiva tapastepe suduṣkaram / ātmaikadhyānayuktasya tasyavratavato mune
verses.translation: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess (about whom it is said that) the learned men know that all DarSanas (Systemes of philosophy) are her limbs. She has the forms of different religious observances.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess (about whom it is said that) the learned men know that all DarSanas (Systemes of philosophy) are her limbs. She has the forms of different religious observances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess (about whom it is said that) the learned men know that all DarSanas (Systemes of philosophy) are her limbs. She has the forms of different religious observances.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुरासीत्पुरो लक्ष्मीः पद्महस्ता परात्परा । पद्मासने च तिष्ठन्ती विष्णुना जिष्णुना सह
verses.transliteration: prādurāsītpuro lakṣmīḥ padmahastā parātparā / padmāsane ca tiṣṭhantī viṣṇunā jiṣṇunā saha
verses.translation: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess who shines in all worlds in the forms of mystic jewel, Mantra and medi- cine and whose form is the instruction in the Tattvas.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess who shines in all worlds in the forms of mystic jewel, Mantra and medi- cine and whose form is the instruction in the Tattvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess who shines in all worlds in the forms of mystic jewel, Mantra and medi- cine and whose form is the instruction in the Tattvas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता । सिंहासनेश्वरी ख्याता सर्वलोकैकरक्षिणी
verses.transliteration: sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā / siṃhāsaneśvarī khyātā sarvalokaikarakṣiṇī
verses.translation: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess who is antagonistic to the Daityas (?), who habitually possesses all auspicious qualities and who is called Viivottirnd ( one who is transcendental to the Universe )*\
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess who is antagonistic to the Daityas (?), who habitually possesses all auspicious qualities and who is called Viivottirnd ( one who is transcendental to the Universe )*\
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, Obeisance to that goddess who is antagonistic to the Daityas (?), who habitually possesses all auspicious qualities and who is called Viivottirnd ( one who is transcendental to the Universe )*\

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वाद्भुतसैन्दर्यां परज्योतिर्मयीं पराम् । आदिलक्ष्मीमिति ख्यातां सर्वेषां हृदये स्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvādbhutasaindaryāṃ parajyotirmayīṃ parām / ādilakṣmīmiti khyātāṃ sarveṣāṃ hṛdaye sthitām
verses.translation: After eulogising Mahadevi thus, Brahma the grand father of all worlds bowed to her again and again and suddenly sought refuge in her.
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising Mahadevi thus, Brahma the grand father of all worlds bowed to her again and again and suddenly sought refuge in her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising Mahadevi thus, Brahma the grand father of all worlds bowed to her again and again and suddenly sought refuge in her.

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुस्त्रिपुरामेव ब्रह्मविष्णवीशमातरम् । कामाक्षीति प्रसिद्धां तामस्तौ षीत्पुर्मभक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: yāmāhustripurāmeva brahmaviṣṇavīśamātaram / kāmākṣīti prasiddhāṃ tāmastau ṣītpurmabhaktimān
verses.translation: On seeing Brahma bowing down then, that goddess became pleased. She the bestower of boons on all the worlds commanded him saying "Choose your boon".
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Brahma bowing down then, that goddess became pleased. She the bestower of boons on all the worlds commanded him saying "Choose your boon".
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Brahma bowing down then, that goddess became pleased. She the bestower of boons on all the worlds commanded him saying "Choose your boon".

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । जय देवि जगन्मातर्जय त्रिपुरसुन्दरि । जय श्रीनाथसहजे जय श्रीसर्वमङ्गले
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca / jaya devi jaganmātarjaya tripurasundari / jaya śrīnāthasahaje jaya śrīsarvamaṅgale
verses.translation: "There is no doubt in this that I am blessed and gratified by your vision due to my devotion. Yet I pray for something with a desire for getting a blessing unto the world.
verses.wordMeaning: "There is no doubt in this that I am blessed and gratified by your vision due to my devotion. Yet I pray for something with a desire for getting a blessing unto the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: "There is no doubt in this that I am blessed and gratified by your vision due to my devotion. Yet I pray for something with a desire for getting a blessing unto the world.

verses.sanskrit: जय श्रीकरुणाराशे जय शृङ्गारनायिके । जयजयेधिकसिद्धेशि जय योगीन्द्रवन्दिते
verses.transliteration: jaya śrīkaruṇārāśe jaya śṛṅgāranāyike / jayajayedhikasiddheśi jaya yogīndravandite
verses.translation: Saying "So be it" she fulfilled that desire of Brahma. Thereafter, Brahma allotted to her a place of residence.
verses.wordMeaning: Saying "So be it" she fulfilled that desire of Brahma. Thereafter, Brahma allotted to her a place of residence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying "So be it" she fulfilled that desire of Brahma. Thereafter, Brahma allotted to her a place of residence.

verses.sanskrit: जयजय जगदम्ब नित्यरूपे जयजय सन्नुतलोकसौख्यदात्रि । जयजय हिमशैलकीर्तनीये जयजय शङ्करकामवामनेत्रि
verses.transliteration: jayajaya jagadamba nityarūpe jayajaya sannutalokasaukhyadātri / jayajaya himaśailakīrtanīye jayajaya śaṅkarakāmavāmanetri
verses.translation: After bowing down to the lotus-eyed Acyuta, the brother of Sridevi, he earnestly pleaded for his prepetual residence at Kaftci.
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to the lotus-eyed Acyuta, the brother of Sridevi, he earnestly pleaded for his prepetual residence at Kaftci.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to the lotus-eyed Acyuta, the brother of Sridevi, he earnestly pleaded for his prepetual residence at Kaftci.

verses.sanskrit: जगज्जन्मस्थितिध्वंसपिधानानुग्रहान्मुहुः । या करोति स्वसङ्कल्पात्तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsapidhānānugrahānmuhuḥ / yā karoti svasaṅkalpāttasyai devyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, Janardana said to him, "I shall do so". Then the creator of the Universe who was satisfied said to Mahe&vari once again: —
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, Janardana said to him, "I shall do so". Then the creator of the Universe who was satisfied said to Mahe&vari once again: —
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, Janardana said to him, "I shall do so". Then the creator of the Universe who was satisfied said to Mahe&vari once again: —

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाणां सांकर्यकारिणः पापिनो जनान् । निहन्त्याद्यातितीक्ष्णास्त्रैस्तस्यै देव्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāṃkaryakāriṇaḥ pāpino janān / nihantyādyātitīkṣṇāstraistasyai devyaidṛ
verses.translation: Thereupon, from the benign glance of the eye in the forehead of Sri Kamak?!, a certain young girl manifested herself. She was excessively refulgent and white in complexion.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, from the benign glance of the eye in the forehead of Sri Kamak?!, a certain young girl manifested herself. She was excessively refulgent and white in complexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, from the benign glance of the eye in the forehead of Sri Kamak?!, a certain young girl manifested herself. She was excessively refulgent and white in complexion.

verses.sanskrit: नागमैश्च न वेदैश्च न शास्त्रैर्न च योगिभिः । देद्या या च स्वसंवेद्या तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: nāgamaiśca na vedaiśca na śāstrairna ca yogibhiḥ / dedyā yā ca svasaṃvedyā tasyai devyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: To the North-West of the temple of the primordial Sri is the extensive excellent abode of Mahe£a. It had been built by Parame§thin.
verses.wordMeaning: To the North-West of the temple of the primordial Sri is the extensive excellent abode of Mahe£a. It had been built by Parame§thin.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the North-West of the temple of the primordial Sri is the extensive excellent abode of Mahe£a. It had been built by Parame§thin.

verses.sanskrit: रहस्याम्नायवेदान्तैस्तत्त्वविद्भिर्मुनीश्वरैः । परं ब्रह्मेति या ख्याता तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: rahasyāmnāyavedāntaistattvavidbhirmunīśvaraiḥ / paraṃ brahmeti yā khyātā tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: After circumambulating those great deities the couple, Brahma and Vi$nu reached the Sambhdvandgdra (the hall of Reception).
verses.wordMeaning: After circumambulating those great deities the couple, Brahma and Vi$nu reached the Sambhdvandgdra (the hall of Reception).
verses.commentary: Sense: After circumambulating those great deities the couple, Brahma and Vi$nu reached the Sambhdvandgdra (the hall of Reception).

verses.sanskrit: हृदयस्थापि सर्वेषां या न केनापि दृश्यते । सूक्ष्मविज्ञानरूपायैदृ
verses.transliteration: hṛdayasthāpi sarveṣāṃ yā na kenāpi dṛśyate / sūkṣmavijñānarūpāyaidṛ
verses.translation: After coming there they joyously accorded welcome duly to the members of the assembly by reciting the Vedic Mantras.
verses.wordMeaning: After coming there they joyously accorded welcome duly to the members of the assembly by reciting the Vedic Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming there they joyously accorded welcome duly to the members of the assembly by reciting the Vedic Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च ईश्वरश्च सदाशिवः । यद्ध्यानैकपरा नित्यं तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ / yaddhyānaikaparā nityaṃ tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: The primordial Adilaksmi, Sri Paramesvari, in front of all, glanced at Brahma with her right eye and at Hari with her left eye.
verses.wordMeaning: The primordial Adilaksmi, Sri Paramesvari, in front of all, glanced at Brahma with her right eye and at Hari with her left eye.
verses.commentary: Sense: The primordial Adilaksmi, Sri Paramesvari, in front of all, glanced at Brahma with her right eye and at Hari with her left eye.

verses.sanskrit: यच्चरणभक्ता इन्द्राद्या यदाज्ञामेव बिभ्रति । साम्राज्यसंपदीशायै तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: yaccaraṇabhaktā indrādyā yadājñāmeva bibhrati / sāmrājyasaṃpadīśāyai tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: Both of them (Brahm& and Vi$nu) stood there bend- ing down their heads to Sridevata, with palms joined in rever- ence. They said "Be victorious, O KAmak$I O Kam&k$i" and bowed down to her.
verses.wordMeaning: Both of them (Brahm& and Vi$nu) stood there bend- ing down their heads to Sridevata, with palms joined in rever- ence. They said "Be victorious, O KAmak$I O Kam&k$i" and bowed down to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of them (Brahm& and Vi$nu) stood there bend- ing down their heads to Sridevata, with palms joined in rever- ence. They said "Be victorious, O KAmak$I O Kam&k$i" and bowed down to her.

verses.sanskrit: वेदा निःश्वसितं यस्या वीक्षितं भूतपञ्चकम् । स्मितं चराचरं विश्वं तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: vedā niḥśvasitaṃ yasyā vīkṣitaṃ bhūtapañcakam / smitaṃ carācaraṃ viśvaṃ tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: He had the same shape and size as those of Maha- gauri with a shining divine body. He had a pair of feet shining brilliantly like the full moon with all its beauty.
verses.wordMeaning: He had the same shape and size as those of Maha- gauri with a shining divine body. He had a pair of feet shining brilliantly like the full moon with all its beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had the same shape and size as those of Maha- gauri with a shining divine body. He had a pair of feet shining brilliantly like the full moon with all its beauty.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षा भोगीन्द्रो धरित्रीं तु यदाज्ञया । धत्ते सर्वजनाधारां तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā bhogīndro dharitrīṃ tu yadājñayā / dhatte sarvajanādhārāṃ tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: The bangles and anklets went on tinkling as though a partridge* had been made the pedestal (?) His charmingly beautiful girdle set with jewels shone as brilliantly as lightning and tinkled sweetly.
verses.wordMeaning: The bangles and anklets went on tinkling as though a partridge* had been made the pedestal (?) His charmingly beautiful girdle set with jewels shone as brilliantly as lightning and tinkled sweetly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bangles and anklets went on tinkling as though a partridge* had been made the pedestal (?) His charmingly beautiful girdle set with jewels shone as brilliantly as lightning and tinkled sweetly.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलत्यग्निस्तपत्यर्केवातो वाति यदाज्ञया । ज्ञानशक्तिस्वरूपायै तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: jvalatyagnistapatyarkevāto vāti yadājñayā / jñānaśaktisvarūpāyai tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: The pair of his arms shone with gem-set bangles and armlets. His excellent waistband was set with pearls. Lapis Lazuli and ruby.
verses.wordMeaning: The pair of his arms shone with gem-set bangles and armlets. His excellent waistband was set with pearls. Lapis Lazuli and ruby.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pair of his arms shone with gem-set bangles and armlets. His excellent waistband was set with pearls. Lapis Lazuli and ruby.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वानि मायाकञ्चुकपञ्चकम् । यन्मयं मुनयः प्राहुस्तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśatitattvāni māyākañcukapañcakam / yanmayaṃ munayaḥ prāhustasyaidṛ
verses.translation: He shone with the waist refulgent with the three Volts (folds of skin on the stomach regarded as mark of beauty). He was adorned with a navel that appeared splendid like the whirlpool in the river Ganga.
verses.wordMeaning: He shone with the waist refulgent with the three Volts (folds of skin on the stomach regarded as mark of beauty). He was adorned with a navel that appeared splendid like the whirlpool in the river Ganga.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shone with the waist refulgent with the three Volts (folds of skin on the stomach regarded as mark of beauty). He was adorned with a navel that appeared splendid like the whirlpool in the river Ganga.

verses.sanskrit: शिवशक्तीश्वराश्चैव शुद्धबोधः सदाशिवः । यदुन्मेषविभेदाः स्युस्तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: śivaśaktīśvarāścaiva śuddhabodhaḥ sadāśivaḥ / yadunmeṣavibhedāḥ syustasyaidṛ
verses.translation: The breasts (in the reflection) were brilliantly adorned and beautified by means of sandal paste, camphor and saffron. The jacket worn over the breasts was exquisitely embellished with pearl ornaments.
verses.wordMeaning: The breasts (in the reflection) were brilliantly adorned and beautified by means of sandal paste, camphor and saffron. The jacket worn over the breasts was exquisitely embellished with pearl ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: The breasts (in the reflection) were brilliantly adorned and beautified by means of sandal paste, camphor and saffron. The jacket worn over the breasts was exquisitely embellished with pearl ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुर्मन्त्रो देवता च तथा प्राणाश्च पञ्चधा । या विराजति चिद्रूपा तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: gururmantro devatā ca tathā prāṇāśca pañcadhā / yā virājati cidrūpā tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: A good chain hung suspended from his waist just for the purpose of diversion. He was adorned with rings set with pieces of ruby.
verses.wordMeaning: A good chain hung suspended from his waist just for the purpose of diversion. He was adorned with rings set with pieces of ruby.
verses.commentary: Sense: A good chain hung suspended from his waist just for the purpose of diversion. He was adorned with rings set with pieces of ruby.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मनामन्तरात्मा परमान्दरूपिणी । श्रीविद्येति स्मृता वा तु तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: sarvātmanāmantarātmā paramāndarūpiṇī / śrīvidyeti smṛtā vā tu tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: The cluster of rays from gems and jewels of brilliant ornaments brightened the faces of quarters. He was rendered splendid by means of gems round his neck fitted to fine heated gold.
verses.wordMeaning: The cluster of rays from gems and jewels of brilliant ornaments brightened the faces of quarters. He was rendered splendid by means of gems round his neck fitted to fine heated gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cluster of rays from gems and jewels of brilliant ornaments brightened the faces of quarters. He was rendered splendid by means of gems round his neck fitted to fine heated gold.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनानि च सर्वाणि यदङ्गानि विदुर्बुधाः । तत्तन्नियमयूपायै तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: darśanāni ca sarvāṇi yadaṅgāni vidurbudhāḥ / tattanniyamayūpāyai tasyai devyai namonamaḥ
verses.translation: His neck had the red colour due to the rays of gems and jewels in the M&ftgalya SUtra (Holy thread indi- cating conjugal bliss ). He was adorned with large ear-rings made of rubies to embellish the ears.
verses.wordMeaning: His neck had the red colour due to the rays of gems and jewels in the M&ftgalya SUtra (Holy thread indi- cating conjugal bliss ). He was adorned with large ear-rings made of rubies to embellish the ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: His neck had the red colour due to the rays of gems and jewels in the M&ftgalya SUtra (Holy thread indi- cating conjugal bliss ). He was adorned with large ear-rings made of rubies to embellish the ears.

verses.sanskrit: या भाति सर्वलोकेषु मणिमन्त्रौष धात्मना । तत्त्वोपदेशरूपायै तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: yā bhāti sarvalokeṣu maṇimantrauṣa dhātmanā / tattvopadeśarūpāyai tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: He had lovely lips which were like tender sprouts and which had the beauty of the China rose and coral. He appeared splendid with a row of teeth having the lustre of the pomegranate fruit.
verses.wordMeaning: He had lovely lips which were like tender sprouts and which had the beauty of the China rose and coral. He appeared splendid with a row of teeth having the lustre of the pomegranate fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had lovely lips which were like tender sprouts and which had the beauty of the China rose and coral. He appeared splendid with a row of teeth having the lustre of the pomegranate fruit.

verses.sanskrit: देशकालपदार्थात्मा यद्यद्वस्तु यथा तथा । तत्तद्रूपेण या भाति तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: deśakālapadārthātmā yadyadvastu yathā tathā / tattadrūpeṇa yā bhāti tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: He had pure and tender cheeks glittering with gentle smiles. He was very charming in his nose-ring of matchless beauty and exalted splendour.
verses.wordMeaning: He had pure and tender cheeks glittering with gentle smiles. He was very charming in his nose-ring of matchless beauty and exalted splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had pure and tender cheeks glittering with gentle smiles. He was very charming in his nose-ring of matchless beauty and exalted splendour.

verses.sanskrit: हे प्रतिभटाकारा कल्याणगुणशालिनी । विश्वोत्तीर्णेति चाख्याता तस्यैदृ
verses.transliteration: he pratibhaṭākārā kalyāṇaguṇaśālinī / viśvottīrṇeti cākhyātā tasyaidṛ
verses.translation: He had a lifted up nose of blameless beauty with the sparkling splendour of the flower of sesamum indicum. His eyes had the sweetness and beauty of the blue lotus about to bloom.
verses.wordMeaning: He had a lifted up nose of blameless beauty with the sparkling splendour of the flower of sesamum indicum. His eyes had the sweetness and beauty of the blue lotus about to bloom.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a lifted up nose of blameless beauty with the sparkling splendour of the flower of sesamum indicum. His eyes had the sweetness and beauty of the blue lotus about to bloom.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुत्वा महादेवीं धाता लोकपितामहः । भूयोभूयो नमस्कृत्य सहसा शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: iti stutvā mahādevīṃ dhātā lokapitāmahaḥ / bhūyobhūyo namaskṛtya sahasā śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: The lovely and graceful eyebrows shone like the flowery bow (of Kama). His forehead could be compared to the crescent Moon. His face had the sweetness and charm of the full Moon.
verses.wordMeaning: The lovely and graceful eyebrows shone like the flowery bow (of Kama). His forehead could be compared to the crescent Moon. His face had the sweetness and charm of the full Moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lovely and graceful eyebrows shone like the flowery bow (of Kama). His forehead could be compared to the crescent Moon. His face had the sweetness and charm of the full Moon.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तुष्टा सा तदा देवी ब्रह्माणं प्रेक्ष्य संनतम् । वरदा सर्वलोकानां वृणीष्व वरमित्यशात्
verses.transliteration: santuṣṭā sā tadā devī brahmāṇaṃ prekṣya saṃnatam / varadā sarvalokānāṃ vṛṇīṣva varamityaśāt
verses.translation: The tied up braid of hair had in it garlands of Parijata flowers. The head was beautified by a crown abund- antly inlaid with gems and jewels. He was the abode of every aspect of beauty, the very storehouse of splendour of grace and charm.
verses.wordMeaning: The tied up braid of hair had in it garlands of Parijata flowers. The head was beautified by a crown abund- antly inlaid with gems and jewels. He was the abode of every aspect of beauty, the very storehouse of splendour of grace and charm.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tied up braid of hair had in it garlands of Parijata flowers. The head was beautified by a crown abund- antly inlaid with gems and jewels. He was the abode of every aspect of beauty, the very storehouse of splendour of grace and charm.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । भक्त्या त्वद्दर्शनेनैव कृतार्थो ऽस्मि न संशयः । तथापि प्रार्थये किञ्चिल्लोकानुग्रहकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca / bhaktyā tvaddarśanenaiva kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ / tathāpi prārthaye kiñcillokānugrahakāmyayā
verses.translation: For the prosperity of worlds and the opportunity for heaven-dwellers to serve you, O Sri Devi of perpetual bliss and felicity, the marriage of both viz. Mah&gauri and Mahe$a should be celebrated every year here itself.
verses.wordMeaning: For the prosperity of worlds and the opportunity for heaven-dwellers to serve you, O Sri Devi of perpetual bliss and felicity, the marriage of both viz. Mah&gauri and Mahe$a should be celebrated every year here itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the prosperity of worlds and the opportunity for heaven-dwellers to serve you, O Sri Devi of perpetual bliss and felicity, the marriage of both viz. Mah&gauri and Mahe$a should be celebrated every year here itself.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभूमौ तु लोके ऽस्मिन्प्रायो मूढा इमे जनाः । तेषामनुग्रहार्थाय नित्यं कुर्वत्र संनिधिम्
verses.transliteration: karmabhūmau tu loke 'sminprāyo mūḍhā ime janāḥ / teṣāmanugrahārthāya nityaṃ kurvatra saṃnidhim
verses.translation: Let the foolish and confounded people of this Earth,
verses.wordMeaning: Let the foolish and confounded people of this Earth,
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the foolish and confounded people of this Earth,

verses.sanskrit: तथेति तस्य तं कामं पूरयामास वेधसः । अथ धाता पुनस्तस्या देव्या वासमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: tatheti tasya taṃ kāmaṃ pūrayāmāsa vedhasaḥ / atha dhātā punastasyā devyā vāsamakalpayat
verses.translation: The greatest goddess replied thereto by the ethereal voice 'So be it'. She permitted all of them to return to their respective abodes.
verses.wordMeaning: The greatest goddess replied thereto by the ethereal voice 'So be it'. She permitted all of them to return to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatest goddess replied thereto by the ethereal voice 'So be it'. She permitted all of them to return to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेवीसोदरं नत्वा पुण्डरीकाक्षमच्युतम् । तत्सांनिध्यं सदा काञ्च्यां प्रार्थयामास चादृतः
verses.transliteration: śrīdevīsodaraṃ natvā puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam / tatsāṃnidhyaṃ sadā kāñcyāṃ prārthayāmāsa cādṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Remembering again and again this wonderful nature and activity of the goddess, they all bowed down to her and went from there in the manner they had come.
verses.wordMeaning: Remembering again and again this wonderful nature and activity of the goddess, they all bowed down to her and went from there in the manner they had come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Remembering again and again this wonderful nature and activity of the goddess, they all bowed down to her and went from there in the manner they had come.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तथा करिष्यामीत्यब्रवीत्तं जनार्दनः । अथ तुष्टो जगद्धाता पुनः प्राह महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: tatastathā kariṣyāmītyabravīttaṃ janārdanaḥ / atha tuṣṭo jagaddhātā punaḥ prāha maheśvarīm
verses.translation: Along with Mukunda and Siva, the delighted grandfather of the world i.e. Brahma installed her in the temple Srimandira fully equipped with the Mantras. After propitiating her through the Vedic Mantras, he bowed down to her with all the eight limbs touching the ground.
verses.wordMeaning: Along with Mukunda and Siva, the delighted grandfather of the world i.e. Brahma installed her in the temple Srimandira fully equipped with the Mantras. After propitiating her through the Vedic Mantras, he bowed down to her with all the eight limbs touching the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with Mukunda and Siva, the delighted grandfather of the world i.e. Brahma installed her in the temple Srimandira fully equipped with the Mantras. After propitiating her through the Vedic Mantras, he bowed down to her with all the eight limbs touching the ground.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो ऽप्यत्रैव सांनिध्यं तव प्रीत्या करोत्विति । अथ श्रीत्रिपुरादक्षभागात्कामेश्वरः परः
verses.transliteration: śivo 'pyatraiva sāṃnidhyaṃ tava prītyā karotviti / atha śrītripurādakṣabhāgātkāmeśvaraḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O Pot-born Sage, the wonderful activity of Kamaksi has been factually recounted unto you. Consider her as Mahalak$mi herself.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O Pot-born Sage, the wonderful activity of Kamaksi has been factually recounted unto you. Consider her as Mahalak$mi herself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O Pot-born Sage, the wonderful activity of Kamaksi has been factually recounted unto you. Consider her as Mahalak$mi herself.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानःसर्वविद्या नामीश्वरः सर्वदेहिनाम् । आविरासीन्महादेवः साक्षाच्छृङ्गारनायकः
verses.transliteration: īśānaḥsarvavidyā nāmīśvaraḥ sarvadehinām / āvirāsīnmahādevaḥ sākṣācchṛṅgāranāyakaḥ
verses.translation: Neither Brahm&nor Visnu nor Rudra knows this.
verses.wordMeaning: Neither Brahm&nor Visnu nor Rudra knows this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither Brahm&nor Visnu nor Rudra knows this.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनः श्रीकामाक्षीभालनेत्रकटाक्षतः । काचिद्बाला प्रादुरासीन्महागौरा महोज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: tataḥ punaḥ śrīkāmākṣībhālanetrakaṭākṣataḥ / kācidbālā prādurāsīnmahāgaurā mahojjvalā
verses.translation: Mahegvara who always considered thus — "I am tht alone" but deluded by her Maya became helpless and assumed the form of Sava*
verses.wordMeaning: Mahegvara who always considered thus — "I am tht alone" but deluded by her Maya became helpless and assumed the form of Sava*
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahegvara who always considered thus — "I am tht alone" but deluded by her Maya became helpless and assumed the form of Sava*

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या महालावण्यशेवधिः । अथ श्रीपुण्डरीकाक्षो ब्रह्मणा सह सादरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā mahālāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ / atha śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣo brahmaṇā saha sādaram
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: कारयामास कल्याणमादिस्त्रीपुंसयोस्तयोः । आखण्डलादयो देवा वसुरुद्रादिदेवताः
verses.transliteration: kārayāmāsa kalyāṇamādistrīpuṃsayostayoḥ / ākhaṇḍalādayo devā vasurudrādidevatāḥ
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयादिमुनयो वसिष्ठादिमुनीश्वराः । योगीन्द्राः सनकाद्याश्च नारदाद्याः सुरर्षयः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyādimunayo vasiṣṭhādimunīśvarāḥ / yogīndrāḥ sanakādyāśca nāradādyāḥ surarṣayaḥ
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मादहं किञ्चिद्वेद्मि वक्ष्ये न चान्यथा । रहस्यमन्त्रं संवक्ष्येशृणु तं त्वं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: tatastasmādahaṃ kiñcidvedmi vakṣye na cānyathā / rahasyamantraṃ saṃvakṣyeśṛṇu taṃ tvaṃ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: न ब्रह्मा न च विष्णुर्वा न रुद्रश्च त्रयो ऽप्यमी । मोहिता मायया यस्यास्तुरीयस्तु स चेश्वरः । सदाशिवो न जानाति कथं प्राकृतदेवताः
verses.transliteration: na brahmā na ca viṣṇurvā na rudraśca trayo 'pyamī / mohitā māyayā yasyāsturīyastu sa ceśvaraḥ / sadāśivo na jānāti kathaṃ prākṛtadevatāḥ
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवस्तु सर्वात्मा सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः । अकर्तुमन्यथा कर्तुं कर्तुमस्या अनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: sadāśivastu sarvātmā saccidānandavigrahaḥ / akartumanyathā kartuṃ kartumasyā anugrahāt
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: सदा कश्चित्तदेवाहं मन्यमानो महेश्वरः । तन्मायामोहितो भूत्वा त्ववशः शवतामगात्
verses.transliteration: sadā kaścittadevāhaṃ manyamāno maheśvaraḥ / tanmāyāmohito bhūtvā tvavaśaḥ śavatāmagāt
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: सैव कारणमेतेषामुत्पत्तौ च लये ऽपि च । कश्चिदत्र विशेषो ऽस्ति वक्तव्यांशो ऽपि तं शृणु
verses.transliteration: saiva kāraṇameteṣāmutpattau ca laye 'pi ca / kaścidatra viśeṣo 'sti vaktavyāṃśo 'pi taṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादीनां त्रयाणां च तुरीयस्त्वीश्वरः प्रभुः । चतुर्णामपि सर्वेषामादि कर्ता सदाशिवः
verses.transliteration: brahmādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ ca turīyastvīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ / caturṇāmapi sarveṣāmādi kartā sadāśivaḥ
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्रहस्यं कथितं तस्याश्चरितमद्भुतम् । भूय एव प्रवक्ष्यामि सावधानमनाः शृणु
verses.transliteration: etadrahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tasyāścaritamadbhutam / bhūya eva pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānamanāḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.wordMeaning: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: This secret has been mentioned. Her wonderful conduct of life has been recounted. I shall say something more. Listen with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने एकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच श्रीकामकोष्ठपीठस्था महात्रिपुरसुन्दरी । कङ्कं विलासमकरोत्कामाक्षीत्यभिविश्रुता
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca śrīkāmakoṣṭhapīṭhasthā mahātripurasundarī / kaṅkaṃ vilāsamakarotkāmākṣītyabhiviśrutā
verses.translation: "Although she is stationed here (on the earth) O Pot- born Sage, she abides in the heart of everyone. She bestows the
verses.wordMeaning: "Although she is stationed here (on the earth) O Pot- born Sage, she abides in the heart of everyone. She bestows the
verses.commentary: Sense: "Although she is stationed here (on the earth) O Pot- born Sage, she abides in the heart of everyone. She bestows the

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकामाक्षीति सा देवी महात्रिपुरसुंदरी । भूमण्डलस्थिता देवी किं करोति महेश्वरी । एतस्याश्चरितं दिव्यं वद मे वदतां वर
verses.transliteration: śrīkāmākṣīti sā devī mahātripurasuṃdarī / bhūmaṇḍalasthitā devī kiṃ karoti maheśvarī / etasyāścaritaṃ divyaṃ vada me vadatāṃ vara
verses.translation: She employed Brahma in the task of creating the worlds, Vasudeva in the task of sustaining and the three-eyed lord (Siva) in the task of annihilation.
verses.wordMeaning: She employed Brahma in the task of creating the worlds, Vasudeva in the task of sustaining and the three-eyed lord (Siva) in the task of annihilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: She employed Brahma in the task of creating the worlds, Vasudeva in the task of sustaining and the three-eyed lord (Siva) in the task of annihilation.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच अत्र स्थितापि सर्वेषां हृदयस्था घटोद्भव । तत्तत्कर्मानुरूपं सा प्रदत्ते देहिनां फलम्
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca atra sthitāpi sarveṣāṃ hṛdayasthā ghaṭodbhava / tattatkarmānurūpaṃ sā pradatte dehināṃ phalam
verses.translation: All these stay in Brahmaloka, Vaikuritha and Kailasa (respectively) always meditating on Mahalaksmi, the bestower of welfare.
verses.wordMeaning: All these stay in Brahmaloka, Vaikuritha and Kailasa (respectively) always meditating on Mahalaksmi, the bestower of welfare.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these stay in Brahmaloka, Vaikuritha and Kailasa (respectively) always meditating on Mahalaksmi, the bestower of welfare.

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिद्वर्तते लोके सर्वमस्या विचेष्टितम् । किञ्चिच्चिन्तयते कश्चित्स्वच्छन्दं विदधात्यसौ
verses.transliteration: yatkiñcidvartate loke sarvamasyā viceṣṭitam / kiñciccintayate kaścitsvacchandaṃ vidadhātyasau
verses.translation: Then the people in all the worlds abandoned the rites pertaining to the Devas and the manes. They were con- fused as to what they should do. They could not comprehend anything.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the people in all the worlds abandoned the rites pertaining to the Devas and the manes. They were con- fused as to what they should do. They could not comprehend anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the people in all the worlds abandoned the rites pertaining to the Devas and the manes. They were con- fused as to what they should do. They could not comprehend anything.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या एवावतारास्तु त्रिपुराद्याश्च शक्तयः । इयमेव महालक्ष्मीः ससर्जाण्डत्रयं पुरा
verses.transliteration: tasyā evāvatārāstu tripurādyāśca śaktayaḥ / iyameva mahālakṣmīḥ sasarjāṇḍatrayaṃ purā
verses.translation: On seeing it, lord Rudra spoke to P&rvatl thus: — "Sin has been committed by you, O gentle lady, by closing my eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing it, lord Rudra spoke to P&rvatl thus: — "Sin has been committed by you, O gentle lady, by closing my eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it, lord Rudra spoke to P&rvatl thus: — "Sin has been committed by you, O gentle lady, by closing my eyes.

verses.sanskrit: परत्रयाणामावासं शक्तीनां तिसृणामपि । एकस्मादण्डतो जातावंबिकापुरुषोत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: paratrayāṇāmāvāsaṃ śaktīnāṃ tisṛṇāmapi / ekasmādaṇḍato jātāvaṃbikāpuruṣottamau
verses.translation: The sages have abandoned their penances. The followers of the Vedic injunctions have dropped their Sandhya rites (Vedic prayers and rituals). O Ambika, all the Vedic rites have been ruined by you.
verses.wordMeaning: The sages have abandoned their penances. The followers of the Vedic injunctions have dropped their Sandhya rites (Vedic prayers and rituals). O Ambika, all the Vedic rites have been ruined by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages have abandoned their penances. The followers of the Vedic injunctions have dropped their Sandhya rites (Vedic prayers and rituals). O Ambika, all the Vedic rites have been ruined by you.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीविरिञ्चौ ततो ऽन्यस्मादन्य स्माच्च गिराशिवौ । इन्दिरां योजयामास मुकुन्देन महेश्वरी । पार्वत्या परमेशानं सरस्वत्या पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: śrīviriñcau tato 'nyasmādanya smācca girāśivau / indirāṃ yojayāmāsa mukundena maheśvarī / pārvatyā parameśānaṃ sarasvatyā pitāmaham
verses.translation: Hence, for the expiation of the sin, perforin the difficult task of penance. Go to Kail and perforin holy rites and observances there for some time.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, for the expiation of the sin, perforin the difficult task of penance. Go to Kail and perforin holy rites and observances there for some time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, for the expiation of the sin, perforin the difficult task of penance. Go to Kail and perforin holy rites and observances there for some time.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं सर्व लोकानां सृष्टिकार्ये न्ययुङ्क्त सा । वासुदेवं परित्राणे संहारे च त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ sarva lokānāṃ sṛṣṭikārye nyayuṅkta sā / vāsudevaṃ paritrāṇe saṃhāre ca trilocanam
verses.translation: Go to Kaflclpura afterwards. There you will see Kamakgi. Propitiate this eternal deity §iv& who destroys all sins.
verses.wordMeaning: Go to Kaflclpura afterwards. There you will see Kamakgi. Propitiate this eternal deity §iv& who destroys all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Go to Kaflclpura afterwards. There you will see Kamakgi. Propitiate this eternal deity §iv& who destroys all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे ऽपि महालक्ष्मीं ध्यायन्तः शर्मदां सदा । ब्रह्मलोके च वैकुण्ठे कैलासे च वसंत्यमी
verses.transliteration: te sarve 'pi mahālakṣmīṃ dhyāyantaḥ śarmadāṃ sadā / brahmaloke ca vaikuṇṭhe kailāse ca vasaṃtyamī
verses.translation: Keep the Holy basil Tulasi plant in front of you, perform penance on the banks of Kampa".
verses.wordMeaning: Keep the Holy basil Tulasi plant in front of you, perform penance on the banks of Kampa".
verses.commentary: Sense: Keep the Holy basil Tulasi plant in front of you, perform penance on the banks of Kampa".

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्पार्वती देवी कैलासशिखरे शुभे । विहरन्ती महेशस्य पिधानं नेत्रयोर्व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: kadācitpārvatī devī kailāsaśikhare śubhe / viharantī maheśasya pidhānaṃ netrayorvyadhāt
verses.translation: After pondering thus she glanced all round. There- upon, she saw her smiling friends Jaya and Vijaya. As they
verses.wordMeaning: After pondering thus she glanced all round. There- upon, she saw her smiling friends Jaya and Vijaya. As they
verses.commentary: Sense: After pondering thus she glanced all round. There- upon, she saw her smiling friends Jaya and Vijaya. As they

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्यौं यतस्तस्य नेत्रात्तस्माज्जगत्त्रयम् । अन्धकारावृतमभूदतेजस्कं समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: candrasūryauṃ yatastasya netrāttasmājjagattrayam / andhakārāvṛtamabhūdatejaskaṃ samantataḥ
verses.translation: "O dear ones, where had you been so long? Did you see Kamaksi seen by me? "
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear ones, where had you been so long? Did you see Kamaksi seen by me? "
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear ones, where had you been so long? Did you see Kamaksi seen by me? "

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च सकला लोका स्त्यक्तदेवपितृक्तियाः । इति कर्त्तव्यतामूढा न प्रजानन्त किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: tataśca sakalā lokā styaktadevapitṛktiyāḥ / iti karttavyatāmūḍhā na prajānanta kiñcana
verses.translation: On hearing her words their eyes beamed with ecstatic delight. After placing the flowers intended for worship in front of her, they said: —
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing her words their eyes beamed with ecstatic delight. After placing the flowers intended for worship in front of her, they said: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words their eyes beamed with ecstatic delight. After placing the flowers intended for worship in front of her, they said: —

verses.sanskrit: तद्दृष्ट्वा भगवान्रुद्रः पार्वतीमिदमब्रवीत् । त्वया पापं कृतं देवि मम नेत्रपिधानतः
verses.transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā bhagavānrudraḥ pārvatīmidamabravīt / tvayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ devi mama netrapidhānataḥ
verses.translation: "It is true that the great goddess has been seen now by both of us. It is neither a dream nor an illusion. She directly went into your heart".
verses.wordMeaning: "It is true that the great goddess has been seen now by both of us. It is neither a dream nor an illusion. She directly went into your heart".
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is true that the great goddess has been seen now by both of us. It is neither a dream nor an illusion. She directly went into your heart".

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयस्त्यक्ततपसो हतसन्ध्याश्च वैदिकाः । सर्वं च वैदिकं कर्म त्वया नाशितमंबिके
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayastyaktatapaso hatasandhyāśca vaidikāḥ / sarvaṃ ca vaidikaṃ karma tvayā nāśitamaṃbike
verses.translation: At the root of the sole mango tree, the lord (Siva) who was in agony due to separation from Bhavani, control- led his sense-organs and meditated on Kamaksi for the sake of acquiring Gauri.
verses.wordMeaning: At the root of the sole mango tree, the lord (Siva) who was in agony due to separation from Bhavani, control- led his sense-organs and meditated on Kamaksi for the sake of acquiring Gauri.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the root of the sole mango tree, the lord (Siva) who was in agony due to separation from Bhavani, control- led his sense-organs and meditated on Kamaksi for the sake of acquiring Gauri.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पापस्य शान्त्यर्थं तपः कुरु सुदुष्करम् । गत्वा काशीं व्रतं तत्र किञ्चित्कालं समाचर
verses.transliteration: tasmātpāpasya śāntyarthaṃ tapaḥ kuru suduṣkaram / gatvā kāśīṃ vrataṃ tatra kiñcitkālaṃ samācara
verses.translation: Listen to another thing, O Pot-born Sage of great intellect. O sinless one, I shall tell you the power of the primor- dial Laksmi.
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to another thing, O Pot-born Sage of great intellect. O sinless one, I shall tell you the power of the primor- dial Laksmi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to another thing, O Pot-born Sage of great intellect. O sinless one, I shall tell you the power of the primor- dial Laksmi.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात्काञ्चीपुरं गत्वा कामाक्षीं तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि । आराधयैतां नित्यां त्वं सर्वपापहरीं शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: paścātkāñcīpuraṃ gatvā kāmākṣīṃ tatra drakṣyasi / ārādhayaitāṃ nityāṃ tvaṃ sarvapāpaharīṃ śivām
verses.translation: Thus both of them were deluded by Maya. Between them appeared Mahe£vara in the form of a gr$at column of fire as though to demonstrate his greatness to them as Brahma.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus both of them were deluded by Maya. Between them appeared Mahe£vara in the form of a gr$at column of fire as though to demonstrate his greatness to them as Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus both of them were deluded by Maya. Between them appeared Mahe£vara in the form of a gr$at column of fire as though to demonstrate his greatness to them as Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तुलसीमग्रतः कृत्त्वा कम्पाकूले तपः कुरु । इत्यादिश्य महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tulasīmagrataḥ kṛttvā kampākūle tapaḥ kuru / ityādiśya mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: The skull of Brahma stuck to the nail of Bhairava who tried to shake it off again and again but it did not fall off.
verses.wordMeaning: The skull of Brahma stuck to the nail of Bhairava who tried to shake it off again and again but it did not fall off.
verses.commentary: Sense: The skull of Brahma stuck to the nail of Bhairava who tried to shake it off again and again but it did not fall off.

verses.sanskrit: तथा कृतवतीशानी भर्तुराज्ञानुवर्तिनी । चिरेण तपसा क्लिष्टामनन्यहृदयां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: tathā kṛtavatīśānī bharturājñānuvartinī / cireṇa tapasā kliṣṭāmananyahṛdayāṃ śivām
verses.translation: In order to get rid of that sin of Brahmin-slaughter, he wandered over the whole of the Earth visiting all holy spots and the great rivers, like Gariga etc.
verses.wordMeaning: In order to get rid of that sin of Brahmin-slaughter, he wandered over the whole of the Earth visiting all holy spots and the great rivers, like Gariga etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to get rid of that sin of Brahmin-slaughter, he wandered over the whole of the Earth visiting all holy spots and the great rivers, like Gariga etc.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रतः कृतसांनिध्या कामाक्षी वाक्यमब्रवीत् । वत्से तपोभिरत्युग्रैरलं प्रीतास्मि सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: agrataḥ kṛtasāṃnidhyā kāmākṣī vākyamabravīt / vatse tapobhiratyugrairalaṃ prītāsmi suvrate
verses.translation: Kapali (one holding the skull i.e. Bhairava) was not released from that sin of Brahmin-slaughter. His very face indicated his despondent state. He appeared dejected and devoid of splendour. After a long time he reached Kafici where Brahma had stayed before.
verses.wordMeaning: Kapali (one holding the skull i.e. Bhairava) was not released from that sin of Brahmin-slaughter. His very face indicated his despondent state. He appeared dejected and devoid of splendour. After a long time he reached Kafici where Brahma had stayed before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kapali (one holding the skull i.e. Bhairava) was not released from that sin of Brahmin-slaughter. His very face indicated his despondent state. He appeared dejected and devoid of splendour. After a long time he reached Kafici where Brahma had stayed before.

verses.sanskrit: उन्मील्य नयने पश्चात्पार्वती स्वपुरः स्थिताम् । बालार्कायुतसंकाशां सर्वाभरणभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: unmīlya nayane paścātpārvatī svapuraḥ sthitām / bālārkāyutasaṃkāśāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām
verses.translation: Checking the movement of vital airs within, Acalesvara (i.e. Lord Bhairava who did not move) remained motionless like a lamp in a place where no wind blows and like a sea with no ripples on it.
verses.wordMeaning: Checking the movement of vital airs within, Acalesvara (i.e. Lord Bhairava who did not move) remained motionless like a lamp in a place where no wind blows and like a sea with no ripples on it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Checking the movement of vital airs within, Acalesvara (i.e. Lord Bhairava who did not move) remained motionless like a lamp in a place where no wind blows and like a sea with no ripples on it.

verses.sanskrit: किरीटहारकेयूरकटकाद्यैरलङ्कृताम् । पाशाङ्कुशेक्षुकोदण्डपञ्चबाणलसत्कराम्
verses.transliteration: kirīṭahārakeyūrakaṭakādyairalaṅkṛtām / pāśāṅkuśekṣukodaṇḍapañcabāṇalasatkarām
verses.translation: On account of the sacred feelings regarding Sri and Yogic practice, Siva attained identity with Sri. Thereupon, goddess Sri Devi was delighted. In the middle of the night she stood before him surrounded by a halo of brilliant refulgence. She who was identical with speech (i.e. goddess of speech) spoke these words —
verses.wordMeaning: On account of the sacred feelings regarding Sri and Yogic practice, Siva attained identity with Sri. Thereupon, goddess Sri Devi was delighted. In the middle of the night she stood before him surrounded by a halo of brilliant refulgence. She who was identical with speech (i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of the sacred feelings regarding Sri and Yogic practice, Siva attained identity with Sri. Thereupon, goddess Sri Devi was delighted. In the middle of the night she stood before him surrounded by a halo of brilliant refulgence. She who was identical with speech (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: किरीटमुकुटोल्लासिचन्द्ररेखाविभूषणाम् । विधातृहरिरुद्रेशसदाशिवपदप्रदाम्
verses.transliteration: kirīṭamukuṭollāsicandrarekhāvibhūṣaṇām / vidhātṛharirudreśasadāśivapadapradām
verses.translation: She gave him alms in the form of a refulgent mass of splendour and immediately vanished. Instantaneously that Kapala (skull) of Brahma dropped down from the tip of his
verses.wordMeaning: She gave him alms in the form of a refulgent mass of splendour and immediately vanished. Instantaneously that Kapala (skull) of Brahma dropped down from the tip of his
verses.commentary: Sense: She gave him alms in the form of a refulgent mass of splendour and immediately vanished. Instantaneously that Kapala (skull) of Brahma dropped down from the tip of his

verses.sanskrit: सगुणं ब्रह्मतामाहुरनुत्तरपदाभिधाम् । प्रपञ्चद्वयनिर्माणकारिणीं तां परांबिकाम्
verses.transliteration: saguṇaṃ brahmatāmāhuranuttarapadābhidhām / prapañcadvayanirmāṇakāriṇīṃ tāṃ parāṃbikām
verses.translation: On seeing that wonderfully excellent act of K&mak?i, the lotus-like face of Siva became delighted. He honoured it very much.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that wonderfully excellent act of K&mak?i, the lotus-like face of Siva became delighted. He honoured it very much.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that wonderfully excellent act of K&mak?i, the lotus-like face of Siva became delighted. He honoured it very much.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वाथ महाराज्ञीं महा नन्दपरिप्लुता । पुलकाचितसर्वाङ्गी हर्षेणोत्फुल्ललोचना
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvātha mahārājñīṃ mahā nandapariplutā / pulakācitasarvāṅgī harṣeṇotphullalocanā
verses.translation: Thus, due to the power of the goddess, Hara was liberated from his difficulty. Regaining normalcy he went to his own abode, praising the greatest Sri.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, due to the power of the goddess, Hara was liberated from his difficulty. Regaining normalcy he went to his own abode, praising the greatest Sri.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, due to the power of the goddess, Hara was liberated from his difficulty. Regaining normalcy he went to his own abode, praising the greatest Sri.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डिकामङ्गलाद्यैश्च सहसा स्वसखीजनैः । प्रणिपत्य च साष्टाङ्गं कृत्वा चैव प्रदक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: caṇḍikāmaṅgalādyaiśca sahasā svasakhījanaiḥ / praṇipatya ca sāṣṭāṅgaṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇām
verses.translation: I shall recount another gracious activity of great potentiality of Srimah&devi. Listen, O Pot-born Sage. To those who listen to it, it always yields whatever is desired.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount another gracious activity of great potentiality of Srimah&devi. Listen, O Pot-born Sage. To those who listen to it, it always yields whatever is desired.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount another gracious activity of great potentiality of Srimah&devi. Listen, O Pot-born Sage. To those who listen to it, it always yields whatever is desired.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा भूयः प्रणता स्वैक्यरूपिणी । तामाह कृपया वीक्ष्य महात्रिपुरसुंदरी
verses.transliteration: baddhāñjalipuṭā bhūyaḥ praṇatā svaikyarūpiṇī / tāmāha kṛpayā vīkṣya mahātripurasuṃdarī
verses.translation: The intelligent king, very pure in conduct, secretly called his priest Vasiha who was conversant with the subject matter of all Sastras (scriptures) and said —
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent king, very pure in conduct, secretly called his priest Vasiha who was conversant with the subject matter of all Sastras (scriptures) and said —
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent king, very pure in conduct, secretly called his priest Vasiha who was conversant with the subject matter of all Sastras (scriptures) and said —

verses.sanskrit: बाहुभ्यां संपरिष्वज्य सस्नेहमिदमब्रवीत् । वत्से लभस्व भर्तारं रुद्रं स्वमनसेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: bāhubhyāṃ saṃpariṣvajya sasnehamidamabravīt / vatse labhasva bhartāraṃ rudraṃ svamanasepsitam
verses.translation: "O glorious one, I have spent a long time but I have not obtained a single son. My agony due to (yearning) for a son increases continuously. What shall I do whereby I will get a child? Please tell it to me."
verses.wordMeaning: "O glorious one, I have spent a long time but I have not obtained a single son. My agony due to (yearning) for a son increases continuously. What shall I do whereby I will get a child? Please tell it to me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O glorious one, I have spent a long time but I have not obtained a single son. My agony due to (yearning) for a son increases continuously. What shall I do whereby I will get a child? Please tell it to me."

verses.sanskrit: लोके त्वमपि रक्षार्थं ममाज्ञाम नुवर्तय । अहं त्वमिति को भेदस्त्वमेवाहं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: loke tvamapi rakṣārthaṃ mamājñāma nuvartaya / ahaṃ tvamiti ko bhedastvamevāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The king duly honoured his preceptor who told him thus. Fbr the sake of obtaining a bosom-born son, the king duly presented to his preceptor various articles of gifts that he desired and sent him back.
verses.wordMeaning: The king duly honoured his preceptor who told him thus. Fbr the sake of obtaining a bosom-born son, the king duly presented to his preceptor various articles of gifts that he desired and sent him back.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king duly honoured his preceptor who told him thus. Fbr the sake of obtaining a bosom-born son, the king duly presented to his preceptor various articles of gifts that he desired and sent him back.

verses.sanskrit: किं पापं तव कल्याणि त्वं हि पापनिकृन्तनी । आमनन्ति हि योगीन्द्रास्त्वामेव ब्रह्मरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ pāpaṃ tava kalyāṇi tvaṃ hi pāpanikṛntanī / āmananti hi yogīndrāstvāmeva brahmarūpiṇīm
verses.translation: Thereafter, the leading king endowed with great devotion worshipped Lalita ParameSvari in the manner men- tioned by his preceptor.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the leading king endowed with great devotion worshipped Lalita ParameSvari in the manner men- tioned by his preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the leading king endowed with great devotion worshipped Lalita ParameSvari in the manner men- tioned by his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: लीलामात्रमिदं वत्से परलोकविडंबनम् । इत्यूचिषीं महाराज्ञीमबिकां सर्वमङ्गला । भक्त्या प्रणम्य पश्यन्ती परां प्रीतिमुपाययौ
verses.transliteration: līlāmātramidaṃ vatse paralokaviḍaṃbanam / ityūciṣīṃ mahārājñīmabikāṃ sarvamaṅgalā / bhaktyā praṇamya paśyantī parāṃ prītimupāyayau
verses.translation: * (Defective Text) Thus he performed the worship
verses.wordMeaning: * (Defective Text) Thus he performed the worship
verses.commentary: Sense: * (Defective Text) Thus he performed the worship

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवत्यामेव पार्वत्यां तदानीमेव सापरा । प्रविष्टा हृदयं तस्याः प्रहृष्टाया महामुने
verses.transliteration: stuvatyāmeva pārvatyāṃ tadānīmeva sāparā / praviṣṭā hṛdayaṃ tasyāḥ prahṛṣṭāyā mahāmune
verses.translation: O glorious and sinless Da£aratha, you are destined to have sons. There are certain sinful activities performed by you before, such as breach of faith, treachery etc.
verses.wordMeaning: O glorious and sinless Da£aratha, you are destined to have sons. There are certain sinful activities performed by you before, such as breach of faith, treachery etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: O glorious and sinless Da£aratha, you are destined to have sons. There are certain sinful activities performed by you before, such as breach of faith, treachery etc.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विस्मयमापन्ना चिन्तयन्ती मुहुर्मुहुः । स्वप्नः किमेष दृष्टो वा मया किमथ वा भ्रमः
verses.transliteration: atha vismayamāpannā cintayantī muhurmuhuḥ / svapnaḥ kimeṣa dṛṣṭo vā mayā kimatha vā bhramaḥ
verses.translation: For the purpose of subduing such sinful activities, go to the excellent city of Kaflcipura. After taking your bath hi the Kampa, see me the sanctifying (goddess installed there).
verses.wordMeaning: For the purpose of subduing such sinful activities, go to the excellent city of Kaflcipura. After taking your bath hi the Kampa, see me the sanctifying (goddess installed there).
verses.commentary: Sense: For the purpose of subduing such sinful activities, go to the excellent city of Kaflcipura. After taking your bath hi the Kampa, see me the sanctifying (goddess installed there).

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं विमृश्य परितः प्रेरयामास लोचने । जयां च विजयां पश्चात्सख्यावालोक्य सस्मिते । प्रसन्नवदना सा तु प्रणते वदति स्म सा
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ vimṛśya paritaḥ prerayāmāsa locane / jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ paścātsakhyāvālokya sasmite / prasannavadanā sā tu praṇate vadati sma sā
verses.translation: I am in the form of Mahalaksmi with only two arms. I hold a lotus (in the hand). I am CakreSvari, the great queen, invisible to ordinary persons with the gross (ordinary physical) eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: I am in the form of Mahalaksmi with only two arms. I hold a lotus (in the hand). I am CakreSvari, the great queen, invisible to ordinary persons with the gross (ordinary physical) eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am in the form of Mahalaksmi with only two arms. I hold a lotus (in the hand). I am CakreSvari, the great queen, invisible to ordinary persons with the gross (ordinary physical) eyes.

verses.sanskrit: एतावन्तमलं कालं कुत्र याते युवां प्रिये । मया दृष्टां तु कामाक्षीं युवां चेत्किमपश्यतम्
verses.transliteration: etāvantamalaṃ kālaṃ kutra yāte yuvāṃ priye / mayā dṛṣṭāṃ tu kāmākṣīṃ yuvāṃ cetkimapaśyatam
verses.translation: Perform great PUjd unto me with sugar, honey, ghee, milk puddings, different kinds of edibles and foodstuffs and articles having six tastes.
verses.wordMeaning: Perform great PUjd unto me with sugar, honey, ghee, milk puddings, different kinds of edibles and foodstuffs and articles having six tastes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Perform great PUjd unto me with sugar, honey, ghee, milk puddings, different kinds of edibles and foodstuffs and articles having six tastes.

verses.sanskrit: सख्यौ तु तद्वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचने । पुष्पाणि पूजनार्हाणि निधायाग्रे समूचतुः
verses.transliteration: sakhyau tu tadvacaḥ śrutvā praharṣotphullalocane / puṣpāṇi pūjanārhāṇi nidhāyāgre samūcatuḥ
verses.translation: I shall be delighted and shall fulfil your boon".
verses.wordMeaning: I shall be delighted and shall fulfil your boon".
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be delighted and shall fulfil your boon".

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमेवाधुना दृष्टा ह्यावाभ्यामपि सा परा । न स्वप्नो न भ्रमो वापि साक्षात्ते हृदयं गता । इत्युक्त्वा पार्श्वयोस्तस्या निषण्णे विनयानते
verses.transliteration: satyamevādhunā dṛṣṭā hyāvābhyāmapi sā parā / na svapno na bhramo vāpi sākṣātte hṛdayaṃ gatā / ityuktvā pārśvayostasyā niṣaṇṇe vinayānate
verses.translation: Early in the morning the delighted king set out for Kaftcipura along with his wife, ministers and armies and reached it.
verses.wordMeaning: Early in the morning the delighted king set out for Kaftcipura along with his wife, ministers and armies and reached it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Early in the morning the delighted king set out for Kaftcipura along with his wife, ministers and armies and reached it.

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रमूले भगवान्भवानीविरहार्तिमान् । गौरीसंप्राप्तये दध्यौ कामाक्षीं नियतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: ekāmramūle bhagavānbhavānīvirahārtimān / gaurīsaṃprāptaye dadhyau kāmākṣīṃ niyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: After meditating for a long time, the great king offered the deity many excellent garments and divine abodes. Thereafter, he eulogised her.
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating for a long time, the great king offered the deity many excellent garments and divine abodes. Thereafter, he eulogised her.
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating for a long time, the great king offered the deity many excellent garments and divine abodes. Thereafter, he eulogised her.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि कृतसांनिध्या श्रीविद्यादेवता परा । अचष्ट कृपया तुष्टा ध्यायन्तं निश्चलं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi kṛtasāṃnidhyā śrīvidyādevatā parā / acaṣṭa kṛpayā tuṣṭā dhyāyantaṃ niścalaṃ śivam
verses.translation: O goddess with the Pundra variety of sugar-cane shining as bow in the delicately soft and tender left hand, with the gem-set ring and flowery arrows beautifying the right hand.
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess with the Pundra variety of sugar-cane shining as bow in the delicately soft and tender left hand, with the gem-set ring and flowery arrows beautifying the right hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess with the Pundra variety of sugar-cane shining as bow in the delicately soft and tender left hand, with the gem-set ring and flowery arrows beautifying the right hand.

verses.sanskrit: अलं ध्यानेन कन्दर्पदर्पघ्न त्वं ममाज्ञया । अङ्गीकुरुष्व कन्दर्पं भूयो मच्छासने स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: alaṃ dhyānena kandarpadarpaghna tvaṃ mamājñayā / aṅgīkuruṣva kandarpaṃ bhūyo macchāsane sthitam
verses.translation: O goddess who had conquered the beauty and splendour of the disc of the autumnal moon by the splendour of your face, whose cheeks have been adorned by the sparkling rays of gems in the earrings; O goddess who hold a lotus with an excellent fibrous stalk in the left hand, O Maheli (great goddess) with side-glances exuding a stream of kindness.
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess who had conquered the beauty and splendour of the disc of the autumnal moon by the splendour of your face, whose cheeks have been adorned by the sparkling rays of gems in the earrings; O goddess who hold a lotus with an excellent fibrous stalk in the left hand,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess who had conquered the beauty and splendour of the disc of the autumnal moon by the splendour of your face, whose cheeks have been adorned by the sparkling rays of gems in the earrings; O goddess who hold a lotus with an excellent fibrous stalk in the left hand,…

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रसंज्ञे मत्पीठे त्विहैव निवसन्सदा । त्वमेवागत्य मत्प्रीत्यै संनिधौ मम सुव्रत । गौरीमनुगृहाण त्वं कंपानीरनिवासिनीम्
verses.transliteration: ekāmrasaṃjñe matpīṭhe tvihaiva nivasansadā / tvamevāgatya matprītyai saṃnidhau mama suvrata / gaurīmanugṛhāṇa tvaṃ kaṃpānīranivāsinīm
verses.translation: O goddess with conch-like neck sparkling with necklaces set with rubies and other jewels, O goddess having forelocks brightly illuminated by the crescent moon stationed on the forehead, O goddess having sparkling smiles and beautiful nose, O goddess who had conquered the petals of the blue lotus by the brightness of the eyes.
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess with conch-like neck sparkling with necklaces set with rubies and other jewels, O goddess having forelocks brightly illuminated by the crescent moon stationed on the forehead, O goddess having sparkling smiles and beautiful nose,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess with conch-like neck sparkling with necklaces set with rubies and other jewels, O goddess having forelocks brightly illuminated by the crescent moon stationed on the forehead, O goddess having sparkling smiles and beautiful nose,…

verses.sanskrit: तापद्वयं जहीह्याशु योगजं तद्वियोगजम् । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे तस्य हृदये परमा रमा
verses.transliteration: tāpadvayaṃ jahīhyāśu yogajaṃ tadviyogajam / ityuktvāntardadhe tasya hṛdaye paramā ramā
verses.translation: O goddess with excellent creeper-like eyebrows, beautiful face and remarkably fine forehead, O goddess who are like a female swan having its abode in the lotus of the Manasa lake of leading Yogins, O goddess having a large golden crown inlaid with gems and jewels, O goddess who are beautiful in every limb and who are worthy of being saluted by all leading gods.
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess with excellent creeper-like eyebrows, beautiful face and remarkably fine forehead, O goddess who are like a female swan having its abode in the lotus of the Manasa lake of leading Yogins, O goddess having a large golden crown inlaid with gems and jewels,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess with excellent creeper-like eyebrows, beautiful face and remarkably fine forehead, O goddess who are like a female swan having its abode in the lotus of the Manasa lake of leading Yogins, O goddess having a large golden crown inlaid with gems and jewels,…

verses.sanskrit: शिवो व्युत्थाय सहसा धीरः संहृष्टमानसः । तस्या अनुग्रहं लब्ध्वा सर्वदेवनिषेवितः
verses.transliteration: śivo vyutthāya sahasā dhīraḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ / tasyā anugrahaṃ labdhvā sarvadevaniṣevitaḥ
verses.translation: O goddess who are the bestower of boons in accord- ance with the desires of the devotee, whose mind melts with compassion, who are proud (?) of her imperial assets, O goddess of the mystic wheel, O goddess whose lotus-like feet are served by Indra and other Devas, O great goddess of the throne, be manifest to me".
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess who are the bestower of boons in accord- ance with the desires of the devotee, whose mind melts with compassion, who are proud (?) of her imperial assets, O goddess of the mystic wheel, O goddess whose lotus-like feet are served by Indra and other Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess who are the bestower of boons in accord- ance with the desires of the devotee, whose mind melts with compassion, who are proud (?) of her imperial assets, O goddess of the mystic wheel, O goddess whose lotus-like feet are served by Indra and other Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: हृदिध्यायंश्च तामेव महात्रिपुरसुन्दरीम् । यद्विलासात्समुत्पन्नं लयं याति च यत्र वै
verses.transliteration: hṛdidhyāyaṃśca tāmeva mahātripurasundarīm / yadvilāsātsamutpannaṃ layaṃ yāti ca yatra vai
verses.translation: After eulogising thus with devotion that king came out and visited Mahagauri seated in her right side.
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising thus with devotion that king came out and visited Mahagauri seated in her right side.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising thus with devotion that king came out and visited Mahagauri seated in her right side.

verses.sanskrit: जगच्चराचरं चैतत्प्रपञ्चद्वितयात्मकम् । भूषयन्तीं शिवां कम्पामनुकंपार्द्रमानसाम्
verses.transliteration: jagaccarācaraṃ caitatprapañcadvitayātmakam / bhūṣayantīṃ śivāṃ kampāmanukaṃpārdramānasām
verses.translation: On the eighth day he bowed down to the goddess with devotion. He mentally prayed thus — "O mother, grant me what I have desired".
verses.wordMeaning: On the eighth day he bowed down to the goddess with devotion. He mentally prayed thus — "O mother, grant me what I have desired".
verses.commentary: Sense: On the eighth day he bowed down to the goddess with devotion. He mentally prayed thus — "O mother, grant me what I have desired".

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गीकृत्य तदा गौरी वैवाहिकविधानतः । आदाय वृषमारुह्य कैलासशिखरं ययौ

verses.translation: K&maksi has such potentiality. She desires the welfare of all the worlds. She fulfils completely the desires of all her devotees.
verses.wordMeaning: K&maksi has such potentiality. She desires the welfare of all the worlds. She fulfils completely the desires of all her devotees.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरन्यं महप्राज्ञं समाकर्णय कुम्भज । आदिलक्ष्म्याः प्रभावं तु कथयामि तवानघ
verses.transliteration: punaranyaṃ mahaprājñaṃ samākarṇaya kumbhaja / ādilakṣmyāḥ prabhāvaṃ tu kathayāmi tavānagha
verses.translation: Even today, the devotees do obtain the benefit, O sage, of the benign glance of Kamak?i. Many will be like that ( in days to come).

verses.transliteration: sabhāyāṃ brahmaṇo gatvā samāsedustrimurttayaḥ / dikpālāśca surāḥ sarve sanakādyāśca yoginaḥ
