verses.transliteration: devarṣayo nāradādyā vaśiṣṭhādyāśca tāpasāḥ / te sarve sahitāstatra brahmaṇaśca kapardinaḥ / dvayoḥ pañcamukhatvena bhedaṃ na vividustadā

verses.transliteration: anyonyaṃ pṛṣṭavantaste brahmā kaḥ kaścaśaṅkaraḥ / teṣāṃ saṃvadatāṃ madhye kṣipramantarhitaḥ śivaḥ

verses.sanskrit: अ५मन्नाभिकमलाज्जातस्त्वं यन्ममात्मजः । सृष्टिकर्ता त्वहं ब्रह्मा नामसाधर्म्यतस्तथा । त्वं च रुद्रश्च मे पुत्रौ सृष्टिकर्तुरुभौ युवाम्

verses.transliteration: iti māyāmohitayorubhayorantare tadā / tayośca svasya māhātmyamahaṃ brahmeti darśayan / prādurāsīnmahājyotistaṃbharūpo maheśvaraḥ

verses.transliteration: jñātvaivainaṃ maheśānaṃ viṣṇustūṣṇīṃ tataḥ sthitaḥ / pañcavaktrastato brahmā hyavamatyaivamāsthitaḥ / brahmaṇaḥ śirasāmūrdhvaṃ jyotiścakramabhūtpuraḥ

verses.transliteration: tanmadhye saṃsthito devaḥ prādurāsomayā saha / ūrdhvamaikṣatha bhūyastamavamatya vaco 'bravīt

verses.transliteration: tayoreva samutpanno bhairavaḥ krodhasaṃyutaḥ / mūrdhānamekaṃ ciccheda nakhenaiva tadā vidheḥ / hāheti tatra sarve 'pi krandantaśca palāyitāḥ

verses.transliteration: śrīkāmakoṣṭhamāgatya purastāttasya saṃsthitaḥ / ādilakṣmīpadadhyānamātatāna yatātmavān

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच मन्त्रं श्रीचक्रगेवास्याः सेयं हि त्रिपुरांबिका । सैषैव हि महालक्ष्मीः स्फुरच्चैवात्मनः पुरा
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca mantraṃ śrīcakragevāsyāḥ seyaṃ hi tripurāṃbikā / saiṣaiva hi mahālakṣmīḥ sphuraccaivātmanaḥ purā
verses.translation: If a person worships with splendid yellow flowers as before Sri (Goddess of Wealth) herself will certainly stay on his chest permanently.
verses.wordMeaning: If a person worships with splendid yellow flowers as before Sri (Goddess of Wealth) herself will certainly stay on his chest permanently.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person worships with splendid yellow flowers as before Sri (Goddess of Wealth) herself will certainly stay on his chest permanently.

verses.sanskrit: पस्यति स्म तदा चक्रं ज्योतिर्मयविजृंभितम् । अस्य चक्रस्य माहात्म्यमपरिज्ञेयमेव हि
verses.transliteration: pasyati sma tadā cakraṃ jyotirmayavijṛṃbhitam / asya cakrasya māhātmyamaparijñeyameva hi
verses.translation: One shall not worship Siva with foulsmelling or odourless flowers even if they have good colours. One shall worship Siva with only sweet-smelling flowers and blossoms.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not worship Siva with foulsmelling or odourless flowers even if they have good colours. One shall worship Siva with only sweet-smelling flowers and blossoms.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not worship Siva with foulsmelling or odourless flowers even if they have good colours. One shall worship Siva with only sweet-smelling flowers and blossoms.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षात्सैव महालक्ष्मीः श्रीचक्रमिति तत्त्वतः । यदभ्यर्च्य महाविष्णुः सर्वलोकविमोहनम् । कामसंमोहिनीरूपं भेजे राजीवलोचनः
verses.transliteration: sākṣātsaiva mahālakṣmīḥ śrīcakramiti tattvataḥ / yadabhyarcya mahāviṣṇuḥ sarvalokavimohanam / kāmasaṃmohinīrūpaṃ bheje rājīvalocanaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 15-17 describe the importance of$ri-Vidy£. It consists of 16 syllabled Mantra — the mantra of 15 syllables given in note of chapter 39 and the syllable the Mantra of 16 syllables. The importance of this
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 15-17 describe the importance of$ri-Vidy£. It consists of 16 syllabled Mantra — the mantra of 15 syllables given in note of chapter 39 and the syllable the Mantra of 16 syllables. The importance of this
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 15-17 describe the importance of$ri-Vidy£. It consists of 16 syllabled Mantra — the mantra of 15 syllables given in note of chapter 39 and the syllable the Mantra of 16 syllables. The importance of this

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयित्वा तदीशानः सर्वविद्येश्वरो ऽभवत् । तदाराध्य विशेषेण ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माण्डसूरभूत् । मुनीनां मोहनश्चासीत्स्मरो यद्वरिवस्यया
verses.transliteration: arcayitvā tadīśānaḥ sarvavidyeśvaro 'bhavat / tadārādhya viśeṣeṇa brahmā brahmāṇḍasūrabhūt / munīnāṃ mohanaścāsītsmaro yadvarivasyayā
verses.translation: A man strictly observing the vow of celibacy, should worship with white flowers the deity clad in white garments and present in the centre of a white abode.
verses.wordMeaning: A man strictly observing the vow of celibacy, should worship with white flowers the deity clad in white garments and present in the centre of a white abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man strictly observing the vow of celibacy, should worship with white flowers the deity clad in white garments and present in the centre of a white abode.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेव्याः पुरतश्चक्रं हेमरौप्यादिनिर्मितम् । निधाय गन्धैरभ्यर्च्य षोडशाक्षरविद्यया
verses.transliteration: śrīdevyāḥ purataścakraṃ hemaraupyādinirmitam / nidhāya gandhairabhyarcya ṣoḍaśākṣaravidyayā
verses.translation: The Naivedyas (food offerings) shoul 1 also be white such as curds, milk, cooked rice etc. The devotee should worship the Highest Deity (ParameSvai!) with imaginary white articles as well. While meditating, he should imagine (hat he is worshipping with white flowers etc.
verses.wordMeaning: The Naivedyas (food offerings) shoul 1 also be white such as curds, milk, cooked rice etc. The devotee should worship the Highest Deity (ParameSvai!) with imaginary white articles as well. While meditating, he should imagine (hat he is worshipping with white flowers etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Naivedyas (food offerings) shoul 1 also be white such as curds, milk, cooked rice etc. The devotee should worship the Highest Deity (ParameSvai!) with imaginary white articles as well. While meditating, he should imagine (hat he is worshipping with white flowers etc.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यहं तुलसीपत्रैः पवित्रैर्मङ्गलाकृतिः । सहस्रैर्मूलमन्त्रेण श्रीदेवीध्यानसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: pratyahaṃ tulasīpatraiḥ pavitrairmaṅgalākṛtiḥ / sahasrairmūlamantreṇa śrīdevīdhyānasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: With pure mind the devotee should worship the sixteen-syllabled 2 Mantra with the Tryaksari Bijas (i.e. the three syllables forming the seed).
verses.wordMeaning: With pure mind the devotee should worship the sixteen-syllabled 2 Mantra with the Tryaksari Bijas (i.e. the three syllables forming the seed).
verses.commentary: Sense: With pure mind the devotee should worship the sixteen-syllabled 2 Mantra with the Tryaksari Bijas (i.e. the three syllables forming the seed).

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयित्वा च मध्वाज्यशर्करापायसैः शुभैः । अनवद्यैश्च नैवेद्यैर्माषापूपैर्मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: arcayitvā ca madhvājyaśarkarāpāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ / anavadyaiśca naivedyairmāṣāpūpairmanoharaiḥ
verses.translation: If he repeats the Mantra two hundred thousand times, the greatest Kala destroys the sins of the S&dhaka (Aspirant devotee) committed in the course of seven births.
verses.wordMeaning: If he repeats the Mantra two hundred thousand times, the greatest Kala destroys the sins of the S&dhaka (Aspirant devotee) committed in the course of seven births.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he repeats the Mantra two hundred thousand times, the greatest Kala destroys the sins of the S&dhaka (Aspirant devotee) committed in the course of seven births.

verses.sanskrit: यः प्रीणति महालक्ष्मीं मतिमान्मण्डलत्रये । महसा तस्य सांनिध्यमाधत्ते परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: yaḥ prīṇati mahālakṣmīṃ matimānmaṇḍalatraye / mahasā tasya sāṃnidhyamādhatte parameśvarī
verses.translation: By repeating the Mantra three hundred thousand times the devotee is liberated from the sins of a thousand births. There is no doubt about this, O sage, that he becomes exceed- ingly pure. In that order if he repeats the Mantra one million
verses.wordMeaning: By repeating the Mantra three hundred thousand times the devotee is liberated from the sins of a thousand births. There is no doubt about this, O sage, that he becomes exceed- ingly pure. In that order if he repeats the Mantra one million
verses.commentary: Sense: By repeating the Mantra three hundred thousand times the devotee is liberated from the sins of a thousand births. There is no doubt about this, O sage, that he becomes exceed- ingly pure. In that order if he repeats the Mantra one million

verses.sanskrit: मनसा वाञ्छितं यच्च प्रसन्ना तत्प्रपूरयेत् । धवलै कुसुमैश्चक्रमुक्तरीत्या तु योर्ऽचयेत्
verses.transliteration: manasā vāñchitaṃ yacca prasannā tatprapūrayet / dhavalai kusumaiścakramuktarītyā tu yor'cayet
verses.translation: W.24-29 describe the procedure of Japa of the 16 Syllabled Mantra and its efficacy.
verses.wordMeaning: W.24-29 describe the procedure of Japa of the 16 Syllabled Mantra and its efficacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: W.24-29 describe the procedure of Japa of the 16 Syllabled Mantra and its efficacy.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव रसनाभागे नित्यं नृत्यति भारती । पाटलैः कुसुमैश्चक्रं योर्ऽचयेदुक्तमार्गतः । सार्वभौमं च राजानं दासवद्वशयेदसौ
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva rasanābhāge nityaṃ nṛtyati bhāratī / pāṭalaiḥ kusumaiścakraṃ yor'cayeduktamārgataḥ / sārvabhaumaṃ ca rājānaṃ dāsavadvaśayedasau
verses.translation: The Purakarana 1 (Repetition of the name of deity accompanied with Homa etc.) is mentioned as follows. The Puj& is to be performed three times every day. Then the Japa, Tarpana, Homa and the feeding of Br&hmanas — all these should be performed.
verses.wordMeaning: The Purakarana 1 (Repetition of the name of deity accompanied with Homa etc.) is mentioned as follows. The Puj& is to be performed three times every day. Then the Japa, Tarpana, Homa and the feeding of Br&hmanas — all these should be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purakarana 1 (Repetition of the name of deity accompanied with Homa etc.) is mentioned as follows. The Puj& is to be performed three times every day. Then the Japa, Tarpana, Homa and the feeding of Br&hmanas — all these should be performed.

verses.sanskrit: पीतवर्णैः शुभैः पुष्पैः पूर्ववत्पूजयेच्च यः । तस्य वक्षस्थले नित्यं साक्षाच्छ्रीर्वसति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: pītavarṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūrvavatpūjayecca yaḥ / tasya vakṣasthale nityaṃ sākṣācchrīrvasati dhruvam
verses.translation: In the course of. Homa and Tarpana the word Svdhd should be used. In the course of Nyasa rites and worship the word Hamah should be used. At the time of Japa the devotee should duly worship Devi at the end of the Mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of. Homa and Tarpana the word Svdhd should be used. In the course of Nyasa rites and worship the word Hamah should be used. At the time of Japa the devotee should duly worship Devi at the end of the Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of. Homa and Tarpana the word Svdhd should be used. In the course of Nyasa rites and worship the word Hamah should be used. At the time of Japa the devotee should duly worship Devi at the end of the Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गन्धैर्गन्धहीनैश्च सुवर्णैरपि नार्चयेत् । सुगन्धैरेव कुसुमैः पुष्पैश्चाभ्यर्चर्योच्छवाम्
verses.transliteration: durgandhairgandhahīnaiśca suvarṇairapi nārcayet / sugandhaireva kusumaiḥ puṣpaiścābhyarcaryocchavām
verses.translation: The Homa shall be one-tenth of Japa; Tarpana shall be one-tenth of Homa; O suppressor of the Vindhya mountain, feeding of the Brahmanas is one-tenth of the Tarparia.
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa shall be one-tenth of Japa; Tarpana shall be one-tenth of Homa; O suppressor of the Vindhya mountain, feeding of the Brahmanas is one-tenth of the Tarparia.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa shall be one-tenth of Japa; Tarpana shall be one-tenth of Homa; O suppressor of the Vindhya mountain, feeding of the Brahmanas is one-tenth of the Tarparia.

verses.sanskrit: कामाक्ष्यैव महालक्ष्मीश्चक्रं श्रीचक्रमेव हि । श्रीविद्यैषा परा विद्या नायिका गुरुनायिका
verses.transliteration: kāmākṣyaiva mahālakṣmīścakraṃ śrīcakrameva hi / śrīvidyaiṣā parā vidyā nāyikā gurunāyikā
verses.translation: If due to obstacles arising from time or place any of the ancillary rites has to be dropped, the devotee should repeat the Mantra twice that number and conclude Purakarana rites.
verses.wordMeaning: If due to obstacles arising from time or place any of the ancillary rites has to be dropped, the devotee should repeat the Mantra twice that number and conclude Purakarana rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: If due to obstacles arising from time or place any of the ancillary rites has to be dropped, the devotee should repeat the Mantra twice that number and conclude Purakarana rites.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्या मन्त्रराजस्तु श्रीविद्यैव तपोधन । कामराजान्तमन्त्रान्ते श्रीबीजेन समन्वितः
verses.transliteration: etasyā mantrarājastu śrīvidyaiva tapodhana / kāmarājāntamantrānte śrībījena samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, for the sake of Kdmyaprayoga (rite for the achievement of any desired object) the devotee should repeat the Mantra three hundred thousand times. The devotee should observe Vratas steadily without emotional aberrations. He shall be engaged in the worship three times a day. If he performs Vaiya and other rites (rites in order to win over persons) thereafter, he shall attain Siddhi (that achievement).
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, for the sake of Kdmyaprayoga (rite for the achievement of any desired object) the devotee should repeat the Mantra three hundred thousand times. The devotee should observe Vratas steadily without emotional aberrations.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, for the sake of Kdmyaprayoga (rite for the achievement of any desired object) the devotee should repeat the Mantra three hundred thousand times. The devotee should observe Vratas steadily without emotional aberrations.…

verses.sanskrit: षोडशाक्षरविद्येयं श्रीविद्येति प्रकीर्तिता । इत्थं रहस्यमाख्यातं गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśākṣaravidyeyaṃ śrīvidyeti prakīrtitā / itthaṃ rahasyamākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The procedure of Purafcarapa of this Vidya is described in vv 30-33. This Vidya can be used for achieving certain peisonal objectives and can be used destructively as well. VV.34-39 describe how the Mantra is to be used for personal positive advantages and vv.40-70 explain how the mantra be used as black-magic such as Mdraoa, Uccdfana etc.
verses.wordMeaning: The procedure of Purafcarapa of this Vidya is described in vv 30-33. This Vidya can be used for achieving certain peisonal objectives and can be used destructively as well.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The procedure of Purafcarapa of this Vidya is described in vv 30-33. This Vidya can be used for achieving certain peisonal objectives and can be used destructively as well.…

verses.sanskrit: तिसृणामपि मूर्तीनां शक्तिर्विद्येयमीरिता । सर्वेषा मपि मन्त्राणां विद्यैषा प्राणरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: tisṛṇāmapi mūrtīnāṃ śaktirvidyeyamīritā / sarveṣā mapi mantrāṇāṃ vidyaiṣā prāṇarūpiṇī
verses.translation: O ascetic, in the same way, if a flower, fruit, scent, beverage or cloth is taken and the Japa is performed one hundred and eight times and the article so taken is sent to a woman, immediately that woman is attracted towards him. Her heart will be in utter confusion.
verses.wordMeaning: O ascetic, in the same way, if a flower, fruit, scent, beverage or cloth is taken and the Japa is performed one hundred and eight times and the article so taken is sent to a woman, immediately that woman is attracted towards him. Her heart will be in utter confusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ascetic, in the same way, if a flower, fruit, scent, beverage or cloth is taken and the Japa is performed one hundred and eight times and the article so taken is sent to a woman, immediately that woman is attracted towards him. Her heart will be in utter confusion.

verses.sanskrit: पारंपर्येण विज्ञाता विद्येयं बन्धमोचिनी । संस्मृता पापहरणी जरामृत्युविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: pāraṃparyeṇa vijñātā vidyeyaṃ bandhamocinī / saṃsmṛtā pāpaharaṇī jarāmṛtyuvināśinī
verses.translation: The devotee should draw the picture of a beautiful woman on the ground with Gorocana (yellow pigment). It should be in a secluded spot. She should be depicted as one dressed gracefully and amorously. She should be bedecked in all ornaments.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee should draw the picture of a beautiful woman on the ground with Gorocana (yellow pigment). It should be in a secluded spot. She should be depicted as one dressed gracefully and amorously. She should be bedecked in all ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee should draw the picture of a beautiful woman on the ground with Gorocana (yellow pigment). It should be in a secluded spot. She should be depicted as one dressed gracefully and amorously. She should be bedecked in all ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: पूजिता दुःखदौर्भाग्यव्याधिदारिद्रयनाशिनी । स्तुता विघ्नौघशमिनी ध्याता सर्वार्थसिद्धिदा
verses.transliteration: pūjitā duḥkhadaurbhāgyavyādhidāridrayanāśinī / stutā vighnaughaśaminī dhyātā sarvārthasiddhidā
verses.translation: Birth (pedigree), name, Vidya and the picture °f & goad — all should be written in her forehead, neck, breast, navel and knee.
verses.wordMeaning: Birth (pedigree), name, Vidya and the picture °f & goad — all should be written in her forehead, neck, breast, navel and knee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Birth (pedigree), name, Vidya and the picture °f & goad — all should be written in her forehead, neck, breast, navel and knee.

verses.sanskrit: मुद्राविशेषतत्त्वज्ञो दीक्षाक्षपितकल्मषः । भजेद्यः परमेशानीमभीष्टफलमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: mudrāviśeṣatattvajño dīkṣākṣapitakalmaṣaḥ / bhajedyaḥ parameśānīmabhīṣṭaphalamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thereafter, he should think that the Earth including mountains, parks and forests and bounded by the four oceans has come within the Cakra and is.blazing forth.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he should think that the Earth including mountains, parks and forests and bounded by the four oceans has come within the Cakra and is.blazing forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he should think that the Earth including mountains, parks and forests and bounded by the four oceans has come within the Cakra and is.blazing forth.

verses.sanskrit: धवलांबरसंवीतां धवलावासमध्यगाम् । पूजयेद्धवलैः पुष्पैर्ब्रह्मचर्ययुतो नरः
verses.transliteration: dhavalāṃbarasaṃvītāṃ dhavalāvāsamadhyagām / pūjayeddhavalaiḥ puṣpairbrahmacaryayuto naraḥ
verses.translation: If the devotee practises this rite for six months he becomes very handsome comparable to the god of Love. Merely by looking on, he attracts the world. By this very act of seeing, he wins over everyone.
verses.wordMeaning: If the devotee practises this rite for six months he becomes very handsome comparable to the god of Love. Merely by looking on, he attracts the world. By this very act of seeing, he wins over everyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the devotee practises this rite for six months he becomes very handsome comparable to the god of Love. Merely by looking on, he attracts the world. By this very act of seeing, he wins over everyone.

verses.sanskrit: धवलैश्चैव नैवेद्यैर्दधिक्षीरौदनादिभिः । संकल्पधवलैर्वापि पूजयेत्परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: dhavalaiścaiva naivedyairdadhikṣīraudanādibhiḥ / saṃkalpadhavalairvāpi pūjayetparameśvarīm
verses.translation: Simply by casting his glance he can excite any woman; by his sight alone he can remove poison; by his very look alone he can make some-one the lord of Speech; by his mere act of seeing he can enchant everyone. By seeing he instantaneously removes Cdturlhika (quartan fever) and other fevers.
verses.wordMeaning: Simply by casting his glance he can excite any woman; by his sight alone he can remove poison; by his very look alone he can make some-one the lord of Speech; by his mere act of seeing he can enchant everyone.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Simply by casting his glance he can excite any woman; by his sight alone he can remove poison; by his very look alone he can make some-one the lord of Speech; by his mere act of seeing he can enchant everyone.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीर्वालन्त्र्यक्षीबीजैः क्रमात्खण्डेषु योजिताम् । षोडशाक्षरविद्यां तामर्चयेच्छुद्धमानसः
verses.transliteration: śrīrvālantryakṣībījaiḥ kramātkhaṇḍeṣu yojitām / ṣoḍaśākṣaravidyāṃ tāmarcayecchuddhamānasaḥ
verses.translation: The devotee should secretly wear on h; s person Sricakra drawn with yellow material. There is no doubt about it that thereby he can quickly stun the speech of the disput- ant.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee should secretly wear on h; s person Sricakra drawn with yellow material. There is no doubt about it that thereby he can quickly stun the speech of the disput- ant.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee should secretly wear on h; s person Sricakra drawn with yellow material. There is no doubt about it that thereby he can quickly stun the speech of the disput- ant.

verses.sanskrit: अनुलोमविलोमेन प्रजपन्मात्रिकाक्षरैः
verses.transliteration: anulomavilomena prajapanmātrikākṣaraiḥ
verses.translation: One should draw Cakra with the juice of Maha- nlll (Indigo plant) along with the name of the enemy. He shall then sit facing the south and burn the same in the fire. This causes the death of the enemy.
verses.wordMeaning: One should draw Cakra with the juice of Maha- nlll (Indigo plant) along with the name of the enemy. He shall then sit facing the south and burn the same in the fire. This causes the death of the enemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should draw Cakra with the juice of Maha- nlll (Indigo plant) along with the name of the enemy. He shall then sit facing the south and burn the same in the fire. This causes the death of the enemy.

verses.sanskrit: भावयन्नेव देवाग्रे श्रीदेवीं दीपरूपिणीम् । मनसोपांशुना वापि निगदेनापि तापस
verses.transliteration: bhāvayanneva devāgre śrīdevīṃ dīparūpiṇīm / manasopāṃśunā vāpi nigadenāpi tāpasa
verses.translation: (Defective Text) The name is written with yellow pigment and the Cakra is tied with the hair from the sidelocks of children. The enemy will hang suspended like that (in the sky) (or if the same is hung up) this is a great means of Ucc&tana (Eradication or extirpation).
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Text) The name is written with yellow pigment and the Cakra is tied with the hair from the sidelocks of children. The enemy will hang suspended like that (in the sky) (or if the same is hung up) this is a great means of Ucc&tana (Eradication or extirpation).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Text) The name is written with yellow pigment and the Cakra is tied with the hair from the sidelocks of children. The enemy will hang suspended like that (in the sky) (or if the same is hung up) this is a great means of Ucc&tana (Eradication or extirpation).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेवीन्याससहितः श्रीदेवीकृतविग्रहः । एकलक्षजपेनैव महापापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śrīdevīnyāsasahitaḥ śrīdevīkṛtavigrahaḥ / ekalakṣajapenaiva mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: If the Cakra be drawn with the juice of the Indigo plant mixed with milk, lac and Rocand and if the same is worn on one's person one can win over the people of the four castes.
verses.wordMeaning: If the Cakra be drawn with the juice of the Indigo plant mixed with milk, lac and Rocand and if the same is worn on one's person one can win over the people of the four castes.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the Cakra be drawn with the juice of the Indigo plant mixed with milk, lac and Rocand and if the same is worn on one's person one can win over the people of the four castes.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षद्वयेन देवर्षे सप्तजन्मकृतान्यपि । पापानि नाशयत्येव साधकस्य परा कला
verses.transliteration: lakṣadvayena devarṣe saptajanmakṛtānyapi / pāpāni nāśayatyeva sādhakasya parā kalā
verses.translation: If the devotee thinks continuously about the ter- ritory, city or excellent lady depicted in the middle of the Cakra as blazing up, O Sage, he can excite and stir them up within seven days.
verses.wordMeaning: If the devotee thinks continuously about the ter- ritory, city or excellent lady depicted in the middle of the Cakra as blazing up, O Sage, he can excite and stir them up within seven days.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the devotee thinks continuously about the ter- ritory, city or excellent lady depicted in the middle of the Cakra as blazing up, O Sage, he can excite and stir them up within seven days.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षत्रितयजापेन सहस्रजनिपातकैः । मुच्यते नात्र संदेहो निर्मलो नितरां मुने । क्रमात्षोडशलक्षेण देवीसांनिध्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: lakṣatritayajāpena sahasrajanipātakaiḥ / mucyate nātra saṃdeho nirmalo nitarāṃ mune / kramātṣoḍaśalakṣeṇa devīsāṃnidhyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The devotee should face the north and worship the Cakra drawn in saffron colour. The whole world can be won over by him thus and not otherwise.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee should face the north and worship the Cakra drawn in saffron colour. The whole world can be won over by him thus and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee should face the north and worship the Cakra drawn in saffron colour. The whole world can be won over by him thus and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: पूजा त्रैकालिकी नित्यं जपस्तर्पणमेव च । होमो ब्राह्मणभुक्तिश्च पुरश्चरणमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: pūjā traikālikī nityaṃ japastarpaṇameva ca / homo brāhmaṇabhuktiśca puraścaraṇamucyate
verses.translation: If the devotee draws the Cakra with red chalk and worship it facing west, he can then attract all women, win them over and make them excited.
verses.wordMeaning: If the devotee draws the Cakra with red chalk and worship it facing west, he can then attract all women, win them over and make them excited.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the devotee draws the Cakra with red chalk and worship it facing west, he can then attract all women, win them over and make them excited.

verses.sanskrit: होमतर्पणयोः स्वाहा न्यासपूजनयोर्नमः । मन्त्रान्ते पूजयेद्देवीं जपकाले यथोचितम्
verses.transliteration: homatarpaṇayoḥ svāhā nyāsapūjanayornamaḥ / mantrānte pūjayeddevīṃ japakāle yathocitam
verses.translation: The devotee should wander over a mountain alone and in secret and worship the Cakra, O Suppressor of the arrogance of the Vindhya mountain. The repeater of the Mantras attains immortality and freedom from old age. There is no doubt about this.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee should wander over a mountain alone and in secret and worship the Cakra, O Suppressor of the arrogance of the Vindhya mountain. The repeater of the Mantras attains immortality and freedom from old age. There is no doubt about this.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee should wander over a mountain alone and in secret and worship the Cakra, O Suppressor of the arrogance of the Vindhya mountain. The repeater of the Mantras attains immortality and freedom from old age. There is no doubt about this.

verses.sanskrit: जपाद्दशांशो होमः स्यात्तद्दशांशं तु तर्पणम् । तद्दशांशं ब्राह्मणानां भोजनं विन्ध्यमर्दन
verses.transliteration: japāddaśāṃśo homaḥ syāttaddaśāṃśaṃ tu tarpaṇam / taddaśāṃśaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ vindhyamardana
verses.translation: If, without performing the Puraicarana. O sage, anyone performs (the above-mentioned) holy rite he will not obtain mastery over the Mantra or achievement thereof).
verses.wordMeaning: If, without performing the Puraicarana. O sage, anyone performs (the above-mentioned) holy rite he will not obtain mastery over the Mantra or achievement thereof).
verses.commentary: Sense: If, without performing the Puraicarana. O sage, anyone performs (the above-mentioned) holy rite he will not obtain mastery over the Mantra or achievement thereof).

verses.sanskrit: देशकालोपघाते तु यद्यदङ्गं विहीयते । तत्संख्याद्विगुणं जप्त्वा पुरश्चर्यां समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: deśakālopaghāte tu yadyadaṅgaṃ vihīyate / tatsaṃkhyādviguṇaṃ japtvā puraścaryāṃ samāpayet
verses.translation: In order to quell defects in the performance, the learned devotee shall repeat Jafa one hundred thou- sand times more. He should duly perform the Puja too. Then only he shall become qualified and competent once again.
verses.wordMeaning: In order to quell defects in the performance, the learned devotee shall repeat Jafa one hundred thou- sand times more. He should duly perform the Puja too. Then only he shall become qualified and competent once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to quell defects in the performance, the learned devotee shall repeat Jafa one hundred thou- sand times more. He should duly perform the Puja too. Then only he shall become qualified and competent once again.

verses.sanskrit: ततः काम्यप्रयोगार्थं पुनर्लक्षत्रयं जपेत् । व्रतस्थो निर्विकारश्च त्रिकालं पूजनेरतः । पश्चाद्वश्यादिकर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāmyaprayogārthaṃ punarlakṣatrayaṃ japet / vratastho nirvikāraśca trikālaṃ pūjanerataḥ / paścādvaśyādikarmāṇi kurvansiddhimavāpsyati
verses.translation: "O Hayagriva, what is the meaning of the term Parana gala 1 (one who has sought refuge)? Tell me. Who is that Saranagata whom Gauri follows like a cow that follows her running calf?
verses.wordMeaning: "O Hayagriva, what is the meaning of the term Parana gala 1 (one who has sought refuge)? Tell me. Who is that Saranagata whom Gauri follows like a cow that follows her running calf?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Hayagriva, what is the meaning of the term Parana gala 1 (one who has sought refuge)? Tell me. Who is that Saranagata whom Gauri follows like a cow that follows her running calf?

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य चक्रमध्यस्थो मन्त्री चिन्तयते यदा । सर्वमात्मानमरुणं साध्यमप्यरुणीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: abhyarcya cakramadhyastho mantrī cintayate yadā / sarvamātmānamaruṇaṃ sādhyamapyaruṇīkṛtam
verses.translation: If at any time people praise him or censure him, the man who has sought refuge in the deity thinks like this — "Let the worlds censure or let the people praise**. After thinking thus and after observing his own form with good intellect, he ceases to experience pleasure or sorrow.
verses.wordMeaning: If at any time people praise him or censure him, the man who has sought refuge in the deity thinks like this — "Let the worlds censure or let the people praise**. After thinking thus and after observing his own form with good intellect, he ceases to experience pleasure or sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: If at any time people praise him or censure him, the man who has sought refuge in the deity thinks like this — "Let the worlds censure or let the people praise**. After thinking thus and after observing his own form with good intellect, he ceases to experience pleasure or sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भवति विन्ध्यारे सर्वसौभाग्यसुन्दरः । वल्लभः सर्वलोकानां वशयेन्नात्रसंशयः
verses.transliteration: tato bhavati vindhyāre sarvasaubhāgyasundaraḥ / vallabhaḥ sarvalokānāṃ vaśayennātrasaṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 72-70 explain the concept of Prapatti or Sarandgati,
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 72-70 explain the concept of Prapatti or Sarandgati,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 72-70 explain the concept of Prapatti or Sarandgati,

verses.sanskrit: रोचनाकुङ्कुमाभ्यां तु समभागं तु चन्दनम् । शतमष्टोत्तरं जप्त्वा तिलकं कारयेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: rocanākuṅkumābhyāṃ tu samabhāgaṃ tu candanam / śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā tilakaṃ kārayed budhaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यमीक्षते वक्ति स्पृशते चिन्तयेच्च यम् । अर्धेन च शरीरेण स वशं याति दासवत्
verses.transliteration: tato yamīkṣate vakti spṛśate cintayecca yam / ardhena ca śarīreṇa sa vaśaṃ yāti dāsavat
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तथा पुष्पं फलं गन्धं पानं वस्त्रं तपोधन । शतमष्टोत्तरं जप्त्वा यस्यै संप्रोष्यते स्त्रियै । सद्य आकृष्यते सा तु विमूढहृदया सती
verses.transliteration: tathā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ gandhaṃ pānaṃ vastraṃ tapodhana / śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā yasyai saṃproṣyate striyai / sadya ākṛṣyate sā tu vimūḍhahṛdayā satī
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: लिखेद्रोचन यैकान्ते प्रतिमामवनीतले । सुरूपां च सशृङ्गारवेषाभरणमण्डिताम्
verses.transliteration: likhedrocana yaikānte pratimāmavanītale / surūpāṃ ca saśṛṅgāraveṣābharaṇamaṇḍitām
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तद्भालगलहृन्नाभिजानुमण्डलयोजितम् । जन्मनाममहाविद्यामङ्कुशान्तर्विदर्भितम्
verses.transliteration: tadbhālagalahṛnnābhijānumaṇḍalayojitam / janmanāmamahāvidyāmaṅkuśāntarvidarbhitam
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गसंधिसंलीनामालिख्य मदनाक्षरैः । तदाशाभिमुखो भूत्वा त्रिपुरीकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgasaṃdhisaṃlīnāmālikhya madanākṣaraiḥ / tadāśābhimukho bhūtvā tripurīkṛtavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वा तु क्षोभिणीं मुद्रां विद्यामष्टशतं जपेत् । संयोज्य दहनागारे चन्द्रसूर्यप्रभाकुले
verses.transliteration: baddhvā tu kṣobhiṇīṃ mudrāṃ vidyāmaṣṭaśataṃ japet / saṃyojya dahanāgāre candrasūryaprabhākule
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विह्वलितापाङ्गीमनङ्गशरपीडिताम् । प्रज्वलन्मदनोन्मेषप्रस्फुरज्जघनस्थलाम्
verses.transliteration: tato vihvalitāpāṅgīmanaṅgaśarapīḍitām / prajvalanmadanonmeṣaprasphurajjaghanasthalām
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिचक्रे लसद्रश्मिवलनाकवलीकृताम् । दूरीकृतसुचारित्रां विशालनयनाम्बुजाम्
verses.transliteration: śakticakre lasadraśmivalanākavalīkṛtām / dūrīkṛtasucāritrāṃ viśālanayanāmbujām
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्टनयनां नष्टधैर्यसंलीनव्रीडनाम् । मन्त्रयन्त्रौषधमहामुद्रानिगडबन्धनाम् । दूरीकृतसुचारित्रां विशालनयनाम्बुजाम्
verses.transliteration: ākṛṣṭanayanāṃ naṣṭadhairyasaṃlīnavrīḍanām / mantrayantrauṣadhamahāmudrānigaḍabandhanām / dūrīkṛtasucāritrāṃ viśālanayanāmbujām
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: मनो ऽधिकमहामन्त्रजपमानां हृतांशुकाम् । विमूढामिव विक्षुब्धामिव प्लुष्टामिवाद्भुताम्
verses.transliteration: mano 'dhikamahāmantrajapamānāṃ hṛtāṃśukām / vimūḍhāmiva vikṣubdhāmiva pluṣṭāmivādbhutām
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: लिखितामिव निःसंज्ञामिव प्रमथितामिव । निलीनामिव निश्चेष्टामिवान्यत्वं गतामिव
verses.transliteration: likhitāmiva niḥsaṃjñāmiva pramathitāmiva / nilīnāmiva niśceṣṭāmivānyatvaṃ gatāmiva
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमन्मन्त्रानिलोद्धूतवेणुपत्राकृतिं च खे । भ्रमन्तीं भावयेन्नारीं योजनानां शतादपि
verses.transliteration: bhramanmantrāniloddhūtaveṇupatrākṛtiṃ ca khe / bhramantīṃ bhāvayennārīṃ yojanānāṃ śatādapi
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रमध्यगतां पृथ्वीं सशैलवनकाननाम् । चतुःसमुद्रपर्यन्तं ज्वलन्तीं चिन्तयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: cakramadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ saśailavanakānanām / catuḥsamudraparyantaṃ jvalantīṃ cintayettataḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: षण्मासाभ्यासयोगेन जायते मदनोपमः । दृष्ट्वा कर्षयते लोकं दृष्ट्वैव कुरुते वशम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogena jāyate madanopamaḥ / dṛṣṭvā karṣayate lokaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva kurute vaśam
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा संक्षोभयेन्नारीं दृष्ट्वैव हरते विषम् । दृष्ट्वा करीति वागीशं दृष्ट्वा सर्वं विमोहयेत् । दृष्ट्वा चातुर्थिकादींश्च ज्वरान्नाशयते क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣobhayennārīṃ dṛṣṭvaiva harate viṣam / dṛṣṭvā karīti vāgīśaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ vimohayet / dṛṣṭvā cāturthikādīṃśca jvarānnāśayate kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पीतद्रव्येण लिखितं चक्रं गूढं तु धारयेत् । वाक्स्तंभं वादिनां क्षिप्रं कुरुते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: pītadravyeṇa likhitaṃ cakraṃ gūḍhaṃ tu dhārayet / vākstaṃbhaṃ vādināṃ kṣipraṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: महानीलीरसेनापि शत्रुनामयुतं लिखेत् । दक्षिणाभिमुखो वह्नौ दग्ध्वा मारयते रिपून्
verses.transliteration: mahānīlīrasenāpi śatrunāmayutaṃ likhet / dakṣiṇābhimukho vahnau dagdhvā mārayate ripūn
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: महिषाश्वपुरीषाभ्यां गोमूत्रैर्नाम टङ्कितम् । आरनालस्थितं चक्रं विद्वेषं कुरुते द्विषाम्

verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: युक्त्वा रोचनया नाम काकपक्षेण मध्यगम् । लंबमानस्तदाकारो उच्चाटनकरं परम्
verses.transliteration: yuktvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣeṇa madhyagam / laṃbamānastadākāro uccāṭanakaraṃ param

verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: दुग्धलाक्षारोचनाभिर्महानीलीरसेन च । लिखित्वा धारयंश्चक्रं चातुर्वर्ण्यं वशं नयेत्
verses.transliteration: dugdhalākṣārocanābhirmahānīlīrasena ca / likhitvā dhārayaṃścakraṃ cāturvarṇyaṃ vaśaṃ nayet
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव विधानेन जलमध्ये यदि क्षिपेत् । सौभाग्यमतुलं तस्य स्नानपानान्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: anenaiva vidhānena jalamadhye yadi kṣipet / saubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya snānapānānna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रमध्यगतं देशं नगरीं वा वराङ्गनाम् । ज्वलन्तीं चिन्तयेन्नित्यं सप्ताहात्क्षोभयेन्मुने
verses.transliteration: cakramadhyagataṃ deśaṃ nagarīṃ vā varāṅganām / jvalantīṃ cintayennityaṃ saptāhātkṣobhayenmune
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: लिखित्वा पीतवर्णं तु चक्रमेतद्यदाचरेत् । पूर्वाशाभिमुखो भूत्वा स्तंभयेत्सर्ववादिनः
verses.transliteration: likhitvā pītavarṇaṃ tu cakrametadyadācaret / pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā staṃbhayetsarvavādinaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सिंदूरवर्णलिखितं पूजयेदुत्तरामुखः । यदा तदा स्ववशगो लोको भवति नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: siṃdūravarṇalikhitaṃ pūjayeduttarāmukhaḥ / yadā tadā svavaśago loko bhavati nānyathā
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं गौरिकयालिख्यपूजयेत्पश्चिमामुखः । यः ससर्वाङ्गनाकर्षवश्यक्षोभकरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: cakraṃ gaurikayālikhyapūjayetpaścimāmukhaḥ / yaḥ sasarvāṅganākarṣavaśyakṣobhakaro bhavet
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेद्विन्ध्यदर्पारे रहस्येकचरो गिरौ । अजरामरतां मन्त्री लभते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: pūjayedvindhyadarpāre rahasyekacaro girau / ajarāmaratāṃ mantrī labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: रहस्यमेतत्कथितं गोपितव्यं महामुने । गोपनात्सर्वसिद्धिः स्याद्भ्रंश एव प्रकाशनात्
verses.transliteration: rahasyametatkathitaṃ gopitavyaṃ mahāmune / gopanātsarvasiddhiḥ syādbhraṃśa eva prakāśanāt
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अविधाय पुरश्चर्यां यः कर्म कुरुते मुने । देवताशापमाप्नोति न च सिद्धिं स विन्दति
verses.transliteration: avidhāya puraścaryāṃ yaḥ karma kurute mune / devatāśāpamāpnoti na ca siddhiṃ sa vindati
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयोगदोषशान्त्यर्थं पुनर्लक्षं जपेद्बुधः । कुर्याच्च विधिवत्पूजां पुनर्योग्यो भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: prayogadoṣaśāntyarthaṃ punarlakṣaṃ japedbudhaḥ / kuryācca vidhivatpūjāṃ punaryogyo bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: निष्कामो देवतां नित्यं योर्ऽचयेद्भक्तिनिर्भरः
verses.transliteration: niṣkāmo devatāṃ nityaṃ yor'cayedbhaktinirbharaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तामेव चिन्तयन्नास्ते यथाशक्ति मनुं जपन्
verses.transliteration: tāmeva cintayannāste yathāśakti manuṃ japan
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सैव तस्यैहिकं भारं वहेन्मुक्तिं च साधयेत् । सदा संनिहिता तस्य सर्वं च कथयेत सा
verses.transliteration: saiva tasyaihikaṃ bhāraṃ vahenmuktiṃ ca sādhayet / sadā saṃnihitā tasya sarvaṃ ca kathayeta sā
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: वात्सल्यसहिता धेनु यथा वत्समनुव्रजेत् । तथानुगच्छेत्सा देवी स्वभक्तं शरणागतम्
verses.transliteration: vātsalyasahitā dhenu yathā vatsamanuvrajet / tathānugacchetsā devī svabhaktaṃ śaraṇāgatam
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच शरणागतशब्दस्य कोर्ऽथो वद हया नन । वत्सं गौरिव यं गौरी धावन्तमनुधावति
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca śaraṇāgataśabdasya kor'tho vada hayā nana / vatsaṃ gauriva yaṃ gaurī dhāvantamanudhāvati
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच यः पुमानखिलं भारमैहिकामुष्मिकात्मकम् । श्रीदेवतायां निक्षिप्य सदा तद्गतमानसः
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca yaḥ pumānakhilaṃ bhāramaihikāmuṣmikātmakam / śrīdevatāyāṃ nikṣipya sadā tadgatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानुकूलः सर्वत्र प्रतिकूलविवर्जितः । अनन्यशरणो गौरीं दृढं सम्प्रार्थ्य रक्षणे
verses.transliteration: sarvānukūlaḥ sarvatra pratikūlavivarjitaḥ / ananyaśaraṇo gaurīṃ dṛḍhaṃ samprārthya rakṣaṇe
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षिष्यतीति विश्वासस्तत्सेवैकप्रयोजनः । वरिवस्यातत्परः स्यात्सा एव शरणागतिः
verses.transliteration: rakṣiṣyatīti viśvāsastatsevaikaprayojanaḥ / varivasyātatparaḥ syātsā eva śaraṇāgatiḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: यदा कदाचित्स्तुतिनिन्दनादौ निन्दन्तु लोकाः स्तुवतां जनो वा । इति स्वरूपं सुधिया समीक्ष्य विषादखेदौ न भजेत्प्रपन्नः
verses.transliteration: yadā kadācitstutinindanādau nindantu lokāḥ stuvatāṃ jano vā / iti svarūpaṃ sudhiyā samīkṣya viṣādakhedau na bhajetprapannaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अनुकूलस्य संकल्पः प्रतिकूलस्य वर्जनम् । रक्षिष्यतीति विश्वासो गोप्तृत्ववरणं तथा
verses.transliteration: anukūlasya saṃkalpaḥ pratikūlasya varjanam / rakṣiṣyatīti viśvāso goptṛtvavaraṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनिक्षेपकार्पण्ये षड्विधा शरणागतिः । अङ्गीकृत्यात्मनिक्षेपं पञ्चाङ्गानि समर्पयेत् । न ह्यस्य सदृशं किञ्चिद्भुक्तिमुक्त्योस्तु साधनम्
verses.transliteration: ātmanikṣepakārpaṇye ṣaḍvidhā śaraṇāgatiḥ / aṅgīkṛtyātmanikṣepaṃ pañcāṅgāni samarpayet / na hyasya sadṛśaṃ kiñcidbhuktimuktyostu sādhanam
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अमानित्वमदंभित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् । आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: amānitvamadaṃbhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam / ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च । जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् । असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु
verses.transliteration: indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṅkāra eva ca / janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanam / asaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु । मयि चानन्यभावेन भक्तिख्यभिचारिणी
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu / mayi cānanyabhāvena bhaktikhyabhicāriṇī
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि । अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् । एतानि सर्वदा ज्ञानसाधनानि समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi / adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam / etāni sarvadā jñānasādhanāni samabhyaset
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्मकृत्तत्परमस्तद्भक्तः संगवर्जितः । निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स याति परां श्रियम्
verses.transliteration: tatkarmakṛttatparamastadbhaktaḥ saṃgavarjitaḥ / nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa yāti parāṃ śriyam
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुस्तु मादृशो धीमान्ख्यातो वातापितापन । शिष्यो ऽपि त्वादृशः प्रोक्तो रहस्याम्नायदेशिकः
verses.transliteration: gurustu mādṛśo dhīmānkhyāto vātāpitāpana / śiṣyo 'pi tvādṛśaḥ prokto rahasyāmnāyadeśikaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 78-81 enumerate the qualities essential for attaining perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने एकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच मुद्राविरचनारीतिमश्वानन निवेदय । याभिर्विरचिताभिस्तु श्रीदेवी संप्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca mudrāviracanārītimaśvānana nivedaya / yābhirviracitābhistu śrīdevī saṃprasīdati
verses.translation: "O Hayagriva, narrate the various positions of fingers in the formation of mystical gestures whereby SridevI becomes delight ed."
verses.wordMeaning: "O Hayagriva, narrate the various positions of fingers in the formation of mystical gestures whereby SridevI becomes delight ed."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Hayagriva, narrate the various positions of fingers in the formation of mystical gestures whereby SridevI becomes delight ed."

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच आवाहनी महामुद्रा त्रिखण्डेति प्रकीर्तिता । परिवृत्य करौ स्पष्टमङ्गुष्ठौ कारयेत्समौ
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca āvāhanī mahāmudrā trikhaṇḍeti prakīrtitā / parivṛtya karau spaṣṭamaṅguṣṭhau kārayetsamau
verses.translation: The middle fingers should be kept in the middle flanked by the thumbs and small fingers. The index fingers are kept upright like rods. The ring fingers are placed over the middle fingers.
verses.wordMeaning: The middle fingers should be kept in the middle flanked by the thumbs and small fingers. The index fingers are kept upright like rods. The ring fingers are placed over the middle fingers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The middle fingers should be kept in the middle flanked by the thumbs and small fingers. The index fingers are kept upright like rods. The ring fingers are placed over the middle fingers.

verses.sanskrit: अनामान्तर्गते कृत्वा तर्जन्यौ कुटिलाकृती । कनिष्ठिके नियुञ्जीत निजस्थाने तपोधन । संक्षोभिण्याख्यामुद्रां तु कथयाम्यधुना श्रुणु
verses.transliteration: anāmāntargate kṛtvā tarjanyau kuṭilākṛtī / kaniṣṭhike niyuñjīta nijasthāne tapodhana / saṃkṣobhiṇyākhyāmudrāṃ tu kathayāmyadhunā śruṇu
verses.translation: If in this Mudra, the middle fingers are kept upright, O suppressor of the pride of Vindhya, the Mudra is then called Vidravini (Driving others).
verses.wordMeaning: If in this Mudra, the middle fingers are kept upright, O suppressor of the pride of Vindhya, the Mudra is then called Vidravini (Driving others).
verses.commentary: Sense: If in this Mudra, the middle fingers are kept upright, O suppressor of the pride of Vindhya, the Mudra is then called Vidravini (Driving others).

verses.sanskrit: मध्यमे मध्यगे कृत्वा कनिष्ठाङ्गुष्टरोधिते । तर्जन्यो दण्डवत्कृत्वा मध्यमोपर्यनामिके
verses.transliteration: madhyame madhyage kṛtvā kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭarodhite / tarjanyo daṇḍavatkṛtvā madhyamoparyanāmike
verses.translation: The small fingers and the ring fingers are equally kept in the middle of the middle fingers and the index fingers that have the shape of goads, O Pit-born Sage. This Mudrd (named) Akar?ini ( Attracting one ) is capable of attracting the three worlds.
verses.wordMeaning: The small fingers and the ring fingers are equally kept in the middle of the middle fingers and the index fingers that have the shape of goads, O Pit-born Sage. This Mudrd (named) Akar?ini ( Attracting one ) is capable of attracting the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्या एव मुद्राया मध्यमे सरले यदि । क्रियते विन्ध्यदर्पारे मुद्रा विद्राविणी तथा
verses.transliteration: etasyā eva mudrāyā madhyame sarale yadi / kriyate vindhyadarpāre mudrā vidrāviṇī tathā
verses.translation: This chapter deals with Mudrds specially observed in $rividy&. The most important is Yonimudri described in w.17-18.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यमातर्जनीभ्यां तु कनिष्ठानामिके समे । अङ्कुशाकाररूपाभ्यां मध्यगे कलशोद्भव । इयमाकर्षिणी मुद्रा त्रैलोक्याकर्षणे क्षमा
verses.transliteration: madhyamātarjanībhyāṃ tu kaniṣṭhānāmike same / aṅkuśākārarūpābhyāṃ madhyage kalaśodbhava / iyamākarṣiṇī mudrā trailokyākarṣaṇe kṣamā
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: पुटाकारौ करौ कृत्वा तर्जन्यावङ्कुशाकृती । परिवर्तक्रमेणैव मध्यमे तदधोगते
verses.transliteration: puṭākārau karau kṛtvā tarjanyāvaṅkuśākṛtī / parivartakrameṇaiva madhyame tadadhogate
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेणानेन देवर्षे मध्यमामध्यगे ऽनुजे । अनामिके तु सरले तद्बहिस्तर्जनीद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: krameṇānena devarṣe madhyamāmadhyage 'nuje / anāmike tu sarale tadbahistarjanīdvayam
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डाकारौ तत्ॐऽगुष्ठौ मध्यमावर्तदेशगौ । मुद्रैषोन्मादिनी नाम्ना ख्याता वातापितापन
verses.transliteration: daṇḍākārau tatoṃ'guṣṭhau madhyamāvartadeśagau / mudraiṣonmādinī nāmnā khyātā vātāpitāpana

verses.sanskrit: अस्यास्त्वनामिकायुग्ममधः कृत्वाङ्कुशाकृति । तर्जन्यावपि तेनैव क्रमेण विनियोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: asyāstvanāmikāyugmamadhaḥ kṛtvāṅkuśākṛti / tarjanyāvapi tenaiva krameṇa viniyojayet
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: इयं महाङ्कुशा मुद्रा सर्वकार्यार्थसाधिका
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ mahāṅkuśā mudrā sarvakāryārthasādhikā
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: सव्यं दक्षिणादेशे तु दक्षिणं सव्यदेशतः । बाहू कृत्वा तु देवर्षे हस्तौ सम्परिवर्त्य च ४२।१२ । कनिष्ठानामिके युक्ते क्रमेणानेन तापस । तर्जनीभ्यां समाक्रान्ते सर्वोर्ध्वमपि मध्यमे
verses.transliteration: savyaṃ dakṣiṇādeśe tu dakṣiṇaṃ savyadeśataḥ / bāhū kṛtvā tu devarṣe hastau samparivartya ca 42.12 / kaniṣṭhānāmike yukte krameṇānena tāpasa / tarjanībhyāṃ samākrānte sarvordhvamapi madhyame
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: लोपामुद्रापतेङ्गुष्ठौ कारयेत्सकलावपि । इयं तु खेचरी नाम मुद्रा सर्वोत्तमोत्तमा । एतद्विज्ञानमात्रेण योगिनीनां प्रियो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: lopāmudrāpateṅguṣṭhau kārayetsakalāvapi / iyaṃ tu khecarī nāma mudrā sarvottamottamā / etadvijñānamātreṇa yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्य करौ स्पृष्टावर्धचन्द्रसमाकृती । तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठयुगलं युगपद्योजयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: parivartya karau spṛṣṭāvardhacandrasamākṛtī / tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayugalaṃ yugapadyojayettataḥ
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: अधः कनिष्ठावष्टब्धमध्यमे विनियोजयेत् । अथैते कुटिले युक्त्वा सर्वाधस्तादनामिके । बीजमुद्रेयमाचिरात्सर्वसिद्धप्रवर्तिनी
verses.transliteration: adhaḥ kaniṣṭhāvaṣṭabdhamadhyame viniyojayet / athaite kuṭile yuktvā sarvādhastādanāmike / bījamudreyamācirātsarvasiddhapravartinī
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: मध्याग्रे कुटिलाकारे तर्जन्युपरि संस्थिते । अनामिकामध्यगते तथैव हि कनिष्टिके
verses.transliteration: madhyāgre kuṭilākāre tarjanyupari saṃsthite / anāmikāmadhyagate tathaiva hi kaniṣṭike
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वा एकत्र संयोज्य चाङ्गुष्ठपरिपीडिताः । एषा तु प्रथमा मुद्रा योनिमुद्रेति संज्ञिता
verses.transliteration: sarvā ekatra saṃyojya cāṅguṣṭhaparipīḍitāḥ / eṣā tu prathamā mudrā yonimudreti saṃjñitā
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: एता मुद्रास्तु देवर्षे श्रीदेव्याः प्रीतिहेतवः । पूजाकाले प्रयोक्तव्या यथानुक्रमयोगतः
verses.transliteration: etā mudrāstu devarṣe śrīdevyāḥ prītihetavaḥ / pūjākāle prayoktavyā yathānukramayogataḥ
verses.translation: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, these Mudras cause delight unto Sridevi. They should be made use of at the time of worship in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे ललितोपाख्याने हयग्रीवागस्त्यसम्वादे द्वाचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः अगस्त्य उवाच अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ करुणामृतवारिधे । श्रीदेवीदर्शने दीक्षा यादृशी तां निवेदय
verses.transliteration: iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lalitopākhyāne hayagrīvāgastyasamvāde dvācatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ agastya uvāca aśvānana mahāprājña karuṇāmṛtavāridhe / śrīdevīdarśane dīkṣā yādṛśī tāṃ nivedaya
verses.translation: "O Hayagriva of great intellect, O ocean of nectarine mercy! Inform me of the type of initiation 1 2 which is (necessary) in visualizing Srldevl.**
verses.wordMeaning: "O Hayagriva of great intellect, O ocean of nectarine mercy! Inform me of the type of initiation 1 2 which is (necessary) in visualizing Srldevl.**

verses.sanskrit: हयग्रीव उवाच यदि ते देवताभावो यया कल्मषकर्दमाः । क्षाल्यन्ते च तथा पुसां दीक्षामाचक्ष्महे ऽत्र ताम्
verses.transliteration: hayagrīva uvāca yadi te devatābhāvo yayā kalmaṣakardamāḥ / kṣālyante ca tathā pusāṃ dīkṣāmācakṣmahe 'tra tām
verses.translation: "We shall communicate Dik$d (initiation) where- from one attains identity with the deity and whereby the dirts of sins of persons are washed off.
verses.wordMeaning: "We shall communicate Dik$d (initiation) where- from one attains identity with the deity and whereby the dirts of sins of persons are washed off.
verses.commentary: Sense: "We shall communicate Dik$d (initiation) where- from one attains identity with the deity and whereby the dirts of sins of persons are washed off.

verses.sanskrit: हस्ते शिवपुरन्ध्यात्वा जपेन्मूलाङ्गमालिनीम् । गुरुः स्पृशेच्छिष्यतनुं स्पर्शदीक्षेयमीरिता
verses.transliteration: haste śivapurandhyātvā japenmūlāṅgamālinīm / guruḥ spṛśecchiṣyatanuṃ sparśadīkṣeyamīritā
verses.translation: The preceptor meditates uponSivapura (as stationed) in the hand, repeats the Mula Mantras of the deity AhgamalinI (?) and touches the body of the disciple. This is called Sparla - dikfd (the initiation by touch).
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor meditates uponSivapura (as stationed) in the hand, repeats the Mula Mantras of the deity AhgamalinI (?) and touches the body of the disciple. This is called Sparla - dikfd (the initiation by touch).

verses.sanskrit: निमील्य नयने ध्यात्वा श्रीकामाक्षीं प्रसन्नधीः । सम्यक्पश्येद्गुरुः शिष्यं दृग्दीक्षा सेयमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: nimīlya nayane dhyātvā śrīkāmākṣīṃ prasannadhīḥ / samyakpaśyedguruḥ śiṣyaṃ dṛgdīkṣā seyamucyate
verses.translation: The preceptor closes his eyes and meditates on Srl- kamaksI.With delighted mind he looks properly at the disciple. This is called Drgdikfd (the initiation by vision).
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor closes his eyes and meditates on Srl- kamaksI.With delighted mind he looks properly at the disciple. This is called Drgdikfd (the initiation by vision).
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor closes his eyes and meditates on Srl- kamaksI.With delighted mind he looks properly at the disciple. This is called Drgdikfd (the initiation by vision).

verses.sanskrit: गुरोरालोकमात्रेण भाषणात्स्पर्शनादपि । सद्यः सञ्जायते ज्ञानं सा दीक्षा शाम्भवी मता
verses.transliteration: gurorālokamātreṇa bhāṣaṇātsparśanādapi / sadyaḥ sañjāyate jñānaṃ sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī matā
verses.translation: Merely when the proceptor beholds, speaks and touches, perfect knowledge arises immediately. That initiation is considered &ambhavi (pertaining toSambhu the bestower of happiness).
verses.wordMeaning: Merely when the proceptor beholds, speaks and touches, perfect knowledge arises immediately. That initiation is considered &ambhavi (pertaining toSambhu the bestower of happiness).

verses.sanskrit: देव्या देहो यथा प्रोक्तो गुरुदेहस्तथैव च । तत्प्रसादेन शिष्यो ऽपि तद्रूपः सम्प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration: devyā deho yathā prokto gurudehastathaiva ca / tatprasādena śiṣyo 'pi tadrūpaḥ samprakāśate
verses.translation: The leading spiritual preceptor properly gratified by
verses.wordMeaning: The leading spiritual preceptor properly gratified by
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading spiritual preceptor properly gratified by

verses.sanskrit: चिरं शुश्रूषया सम्यक्तोषितो देशिकेश्वरः । तूष्णीं संकल्पयेच्छिष्यं सा दीक्षा मानसी मता
verses.transliteration: ciraṃ śuśrūṣayā samyaktoṣito deśikeśvaraḥ / tūṣṇīṃ saṃkalpayecchiṣyaṃ sā dīkṣā mānasī matā
verses.translation: VV.8-35. describe the procedure of Dik?a.
verses.wordMeaning: VV.8-35. describe the procedure of Dik?a.

verses.sanskrit: दीक्षाणामपि सर्वासामियमेवोत्तमोत्तमा । आदौ कुर्यात्क्रियादीक्षां तत्प्रकारः प्रवक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: dīkṣāṇāmapi sarvāsāmiyamevottamottamā / ādau kuryātkriyādīkṣāṃ tatprakāraḥ pravakṣyate
verses.translation: With the utterance of this thousand-syllabled Mantra, the devotee should offer handful of flowers. Other- wise his worship shall be futile — so say the expounders of the Vedas.
verses.wordMeaning: With the utterance of this thousand-syllabled Mantra, the devotee should offer handful of flowers. Other- wise his worship shall be futile — so say the expounders of the Vedas.

verses.transliteration: śuklapakṣe śubhadine vidhāya śucimānasam / jihvāsyamalaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā snātvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: The disciple should then take bath in ordinary pure water and wear two clothes. He should repeat the Mantra one hundred and eight times and then go to sleep.

verses.sanskrit: संध्याकर्म समाप्याथ गुरुदेहं परं स्मरन् । एकान्ते निवसञ्छ्रीमान्मौनी च नियताशनः
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyākarma samāpyātha gurudehaṃ paraṃ smaran / ekānte nivasañchrīmānmaunī ca niyatāśanaḥ
verses.translation: The worship of Tripuramba should be carried out in ihe manner mentioned above. If no dream is seen the achieve- ment ol Siddhi will be after some long time.
verses.wordMeaning: The worship of Tripuramba should be carried out in ihe manner mentioned above. If no dream is seen the achieve- ment ol Siddhi will be after some long time.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुश्च तादृशोभूत्वा पूजामन्दिरमाविशेत् । देवीसूक्तेन संयुक्तं विद्यान्यासं समातृकम्
verses.transliteration: guruśca tādṛśobhūtvā pūjāmandiramāviśet / devīsūktena saṃyuktaṃ vidyānyāsaṃ samātṛkam
verses.translation: With great devotion the disciple should partake of the remnants of offerings unto the goddess which have more benefit. The disciple shall imme liately be a sanctifier of rows.
verses.wordMeaning: With great devotion the disciple should partake of the remnants of offerings unto the goddess which have more benefit. The disciple shall imme liately be a sanctifier of rows.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great devotion the disciple should partake of the remnants of offerings unto the goddess which have more benefit. The disciple shall imme liately be a sanctifier of rows.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पुरुषसूक्तेन षोडशैरुपचारकैः । आवाहना सने पाद्यमर्ध्यमाचमनं तथा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā puruṣasūktena ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ / āvāhanā sane pādyamardhyamācamanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The disciple should dedicate unto his Guru (precep- tor) his body, possessions and vital airs. He should conduct himself obediently subservient to him continuously. He should never transgress his words.
verses.wordMeaning: The disciple should dedicate unto his Guru (precep- tor) his body, possessions and vital airs. He should conduct himself obediently subservient to him continuously. He should never transgress his words.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple should dedicate unto his Guru (precep- tor) his body, possessions and vital airs. He should conduct himself obediently subservient to him continuously. He should never transgress his words.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं वस्त्रं च भूषा च गन्धः पुष्पं तथैव च । धूपदीपौ च नैवेद्यं ताम्बूलं च प्रदक्षिणा
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣā ca gandhaḥ puṣpaṃ tathaiva ca / dhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca pradakṣiṇā
verses.translation: After obtaining a preceptor in the form of the bes tower of perfect knowledge, one should not have recourse to another preceptor. He should consider even the harsh words uttered by the preceptor as blessings.
verses.wordMeaning: After obtaining a preceptor in the form of the bes tower of perfect knowledge, one should not have recourse to another preceptor. He should consider even the harsh words uttered by the preceptor as blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: After obtaining a preceptor in the form of the bes tower of perfect knowledge, one should not have recourse to another preceptor. He should consider even the harsh words uttered by the preceptor as blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणामश्चेति विख्यातैः प्रीणयेत्त्रिपुरांबिकाम् । अथ पुष्पाञ्जलिं दद्यात्सहस्राक्षरविद्यया
verses.transliteration: praṇāmaśceti vikhyātaiḥ prīṇayettripurāṃbikām / atha puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyātsahasrākṣaravidyayā
verses.translation: He should at the outset make obeisance to him and from him alone should receive secular, Vedic and spiritual knowledge.
verses.wordMeaning: He should at the outset make obeisance to him and from him alone should receive secular, Vedic and spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should at the outset make obeisance to him and from him alone should receive secular, Vedic and spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं ऐं क्लीं सौः ॐ नमस्त्रिपुरसुन्दरि हृदये देवि शिरोदेवि शिखादेवि कवचदेवि नेत्रदेवि आस्यदेवि कामेश्वरि भगमालिनि नित्यक्लिन्नें भैरुण्डे वह्निवासिनि महावज्रेश्वरि विद्येश्वरि परशिवदूति त्वरिते कुलसुंदरि नित्ये नीलपताके विजये सर्वमङ्गले ज्वालामालिनि चित्रे महानित्ये परमेश्वरि मन्त्रेशमयि षष्ठीशमय्युद्यानमयि लोपामुद्रामय्यगस्त्यमयि कालतापनमयि धर्माचारमयि मुक्तके शीश्वरमयि दीपकलानाथमयि विष्णुदेवमयि प्रभाकरदेवमयि तेजोदेवमयि मनोजदेवमयि अणिमसिद्धे महिमसिद्धे गरिम सिद्धे लघिमसिद्धे ईशित्वसिद्धे वशित्वसिद्धे प्राप्तिसिद्धे प्राकाम्यसिद्धे रससिद्धे मोक्षसिद्धे ब्राह्मि माहेश्वरी कौमारि वैष्णवि वाराहि इन्द्राणि चामुण्डे महालक्ष्मि सर्वसंक्षोभिणि सर्वविद्राविणि सर्वाकर्षिणि सर्ववशङ्करि सर्वोन्मादिनि सर्वमहाङ्कुशे सर्वखेचरि सर्वबीजे सर्वयोने सर्वास्त्रखण्डिनि त्रैलोक्यमोहिनि चक्रस्वामिनि प्राटयोगिनि बौद्धदर्शनाङ्गि कामाकर्षिणि बुद्ध्याकर्षिणि अहङ्काराकर्षिणि शब्दाकर्षिणि स्पर्शाकर्षिणि रूपाकर्षिणि रसाकर्षिणि गन्धाकर्षिणि चित्ताकर्षिणि धैर्याकर्षिणि स्मृत्याकर्षिणि नामाकर्षिणि बीजाकर्षिणात्माकिर्षिणि अमृताकर्षिणि शरीराकर्षिणि गुप्तयोगिनि सर्वाशापरिपूरकचक्रस्वामिनि अनङ्गकुसुमे अनङ्गमेखले अनङ्गमादिनि अनङ्गमदनातुरे ऽनङ्गरेखे ऽनङ्गवेगिन्यनङ्गाङ्कुशे ऽनङ्गमालिनि गुप्ततरयोगिनि वैदिकदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वसंक्षोभकारक चक्रस्वामिनि पूर्वाम्नायाधिदेवते सृष्टिरूपे सर्वसंक्षोभिणि सर्वविद्राविणि सर्वाकर्षिणि सर्वाह्लादिनि सर्वसंमोहिनि सर्वस्तंभिणि सर्वजृंभिणि सर्ववशङ्करि सर्वरञ्जिनि सर्वोन्मादिनि सर्वार्थसाधिके सर्वसंपत्प्रपूरिणि सर्वमन्त्रमयि सर्वद्वन्द्वक्षयकरि सम्प्रदाययोगिनि सौरदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वसौभाग्यदायकचक्रे सर्वसिद्धिप्रदे सर्वसम्पत्प्रदे सर्वप्रियङ्करि सर्वमङ्गलकारिणि सर्वकामप्रदे सर्वदुःखविमोचिनि सर्वमृत्युप्रशमिनि सर्वविघ्ननिवारिणि सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि सर्वसौभाग्यदायिनि कुलोत्तीर्णयोगिनि सर्वार्थसाधकचक्रेशि सर्वज्ञे सर्वशक्ते सर्वैश्वर्यफलप्रदे सर्वज्ञानमयि सर्वव्याधिनिवारिणि सर्वाधारस्वरूपे सर्वपापहरे सर्वानन्दमयि सर्वरक्षास्वरूपिणि सर्वेप्सित फलप्रदे नियोगिनि वैष्णवदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वरक्षाकरचक्रस्थे दक्षिणाम्नायेशि स्थितिरूपे वशिनि कामेशि मोदिनि विमले अरुणे जयिनि सर्वेश्वरि कौलिनि रहस्ययोगिनि रहस्यभोगिनि रहस्यगोपिनि शाक्तदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वरोगहरचक्रेशि पश्चिमाम्नाये धनुर्बाणपाशाङ्कुशदेवते कामेशि वज्रेशि फगमालिनि अतिरहस्ययोगिनि शैवदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वसिद्धिप्रदचक्रगे उत्तराम्नायेशि संहाररूपे शुद्धपरे विन्दुपीठगते महारात्रिपुरसुन्दरि परापरातिरहस्ययोगिनि शांभवदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वानन्दमयचक्रेशि त्रिपुरसुंदरि त्रिपुरवासिनि त्रिपुरश्रीः त्रिपुरमालिनि त्रिपुरसिद्धे त्रिपुरांब सर्वचक्रस्थे अनुत्तराम्नायाख्यस्वरूपे महात्रिपुरभैरवि चतुर्विधगुणरूपे कुले अकुले कुलाकुले महाकौलिनि सर्वोत्तरे सर्वदर्शनाङ्गि नवासनस्थिते नवाक्षरि नवमिथुनाकृते महेशमाधवविधातृमन्मथस्कन्दनन्दीन्द्रमनुचन्द्रकुबेरागस्त्यदुर्वासःक्रोधभट्टारकविद्यात्मिके कल्याणतत्त्वत्रयरूपे शिवशिवात्मिके पूर्मब्रह्मशक्ते महापरमेश्वरि महात्रिपुरसुन्दरि तव श्रीपादुकां पूजयामि नमः । क एं ईल ह्रीं हस कहल ह्रीं ऐं क्लीं सौः सौः क्लीं ऐं श्रीं । देव्याः पुष्पाञ्जलिं दद्यात्सहस्राक्षरविद्याया । नोचेत्तत्पूजनं व्यर्थमित्याहुर्वेदवादिनः
verses.transliteration: oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ oṃ namastripurasundari hṛdaye devi śirodevi śikhādevi kavacadevi netradevi āsyadevi kāmeśvari bhagamālini nityaklinneṃ bhairuṇḍe vahnivāsini mahāvajreśvari vidyeśvari paraśivadūti tvarite kulasuṃdari nitye nīlapatāke vijaye sarvamaṅgale jvālāmālini citre mahānitye parameśvari mantreśamayi ṣaṣṭhīśamayyudyānamayi lopāmudrāmayyagastyamayi sṛṣṭirūpe sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇi sarvavidrāviṇi sarvākarṣiṇi sarvāhlādini sarvasaṃmohini sarvastaṃbhiṇi sarvajṛṃbhiṇi sarvavaśaṅkari sarvarañjini sarvonmādini sarvārthasādhike sarvasaṃpatprapūriṇi sarvamantramayi sarvadvandvakṣayakari sampradāyayogini sauradarśanāṅgi sarvasaubhāgyadāyakacakre sarvasiddhiprade sarvasampatprade sarvapriyaṅkari sarvamaṅgalakāriṇi sarvakāmaprade sarvaduḥkhavimocini
