sarvādhārasvarūpe sarvapāpahare sarvānandamayi sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇi sarvepsita phalaprade niyogini vaiṣṇavadarśanāṅgi sarvarakṣākaracakrasthe dakṣiṇāmnāyeśi sthitirūpe vaśini kāmeśi modini vimale aruṇe jayini sarveśvari kaulini rahasyayogini rahasyabhogini rahasyagopini śāktadarśanāṅgi sarvarogaharacakreśi paścimāmnāye dhanurbāṇapāśāṅkuśadevate kāmeśi vajreśi phagamālini atirahasyayogini śaivadarśanāṅgi sarvasiddhipradacakrage uttarāmnāyeśi saṃhārarūpe śuddhapare vindupīṭhagate mahārātripurasundari parāparātirahasyayogini śāṃbhavadarśanāṅgi sarvānandamayacakreśi tripurasuṃdari tripuravāsini tripuraśrīḥ tripuramālini tripurasiddhe tripurāṃba sarvacakrasthe anuttarāmnāyākhyasvarūpe mahātripurabhairavi caturvidhaguṇarūpe kule akule kulākule mahākaulini sarvottare sarvadarśanāṅgi navāsanasthite navākṣari navamithunākṛte maheśamādhavavidhātṛmanmathaskandanandīndramanucandrakuberāgastyadurvāsaḥkrodhabhaṭṭārakavidyātmike kalyāṇatattvatrayarūpe śivaśivātmike pūrmabrahmaśakte mahāparameśvari mahātripurasundari tava śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ / ka eṃ īla hrīṃ hasa kahala hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ śrīṃ / devyāḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyātsahasrākṣaravidyāyā / nocettatpūjanaṃ vyarthamityāhurvedavādinaḥ
verses.translation: One sanctified by and equipped with many good qualities free from impurities, good qualities like decent habits and spotless character, is called Si$ya (disciple) because he abides by the S&sana (behest) of the preceptor.
verses.wordMeaning: One sanctified by and equipped with many good qualities free from impurities, good qualities like decent habits and spotless character, is called Si$ya (disciple) because he abides by the S&sana (behest) of the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: One sanctified by and equipped with many good qualities free from impurities, good qualities like decent habits and spotless character, is called Si$ya (disciple) because he abides by the S&sana (behest) of the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गोमयसंलिप्ते भूतले द्रोणशालिभिः । तावद्भिस्तण्डुलैः शुद्धैः शस्तार्णैस्तत्र नूतनम्
verses.transliteration: tato gomayasaṃlipte bhūtale droṇaśālibhiḥ / tāvadbhistaṇḍulaiḥ śuddhaiḥ śastārṇaistatra nūtanam
verses.translation: If one becomes tired by Japa, one should begin to meditate. If one is tired by Dhy&na (meditation) one should begin to perform Japa. If one is fully endowed with Japa, Dhyana etc., one accomplishes and acquires mastery over the Mantra.
verses.wordMeaning: If one becomes tired by Japa, one should begin to meditate. If one is tired by Dhy&na (meditation) one should begin to perform Japa. If one is fully endowed with Japa, Dhyana etc., one accomplishes and acquires mastery over the Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one becomes tired by Japa, one should begin to meditate. If one is tired by Dhy&na (meditation) one should begin to perform Japa. If one is fully endowed with Japa, Dhyana etc., one accomplishes and acquires mastery over the Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणोदपूरितं कुंभं पञ्चरत्नैर्नवैर्युतम् । न्यग्रोधाश्वत्थमाकन्दजंबूदुम्बरशाखिनाम्
verses.transliteration: droṇodapūritaṃ kuṃbhaṃ pañcaratnairnavairyutam / nyagrodhāśvatthamākandajaṃbūdumbaraśākhinām
verses.translation: Just as, due to the power of contemplation, even a worm turns out to be a black bee so also, due to the power of ecstatic trance, a man becomes Brahman.
verses.wordMeaning: Just as, due to the power of contemplation, even a worm turns out to be a black bee so also, due to the power of ecstatic trance, a man becomes Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as, due to the power of contemplation, even a worm turns out to be a black bee so also, due to the power of ecstatic trance, a man becomes Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: त्वग्भिश्च पल्लवैश्चैव प्रक्षिप्तैरधिवासिनम् । कुम्भाग्रे निक्षिपेत्पक्वं नारिकेलफलं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tvagbhiśca pallavaiścaiva prakṣiptairadhivāsinam / kumbhāgre nikṣipetpakvaṃ nārikelaphalaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Just as at the time of dissolution, the universe is not observed, so also (the external world should not be seen) when one closes the eyes (for meditation). This is the characteristic feature of Dhyana ( Meditation).
verses.wordMeaning: Just as at the time of dissolution, the universe is not observed, so also (the external world should not be seen) when one closes the eyes (for meditation). This is the characteristic feature of Dhyana ( Meditation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as at the time of dissolution, the universe is not observed, so also (the external world should not be seen) when one closes the eyes (for meditation). This is the characteristic feature of Dhyana ( Meditation).

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्धूपदीपादि दर्शयेत् । श्रीचिन्तामणिमन्त्रं तु हृदि मातृकमाजपेत्
verses.transliteration: abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairdhūpadīpādi darśayet / śrīcintāmaṇimantraṃ tu hṛdi mātṛkamājapet
verses.translation: Ail his activities, since he strictly adheres to the realisation of the unity of Souls, constitute his Daraiana (Vision, System of philosophy). The purpose of Yogic practice and penance is served by his Mantra. His (Pieceptor's) very glance constitutes his (disciple's) asset.
verses.wordMeaning: Ail his activities, since he strictly adheres to the realisation of the unity of Souls, constitute his Daraiana (Vision, System of philosophy). The purpose of Yogic practice and penance is served by his Mantra. His (Pieceptor's) very glance constitutes his (disciple's) asset.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ail his activities, since he strictly adheres to the realisation of the unity of Souls, constitute his Daraiana (Vision, System of philosophy). The purpose of Yogic practice and penance is served by his Mantra. His (Pieceptor's) very glance constitutes his (disciple's) asset.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भ स्पृशञ्छ्रीकामाप्तिरूपीकृतकलेवरम् । अष्टोत्तरशते जाते पुनर्दीपं प्रदर्शयेत्
verses.transliteration: kumbha spṛśañchrīkāmāptirūpīkṛtakalevaram / aṣṭottaraśate jāte punardīpaṃ pradarśayet
verses.translation: If one sees and realizes the non-dualistic omni- present, quiescent and blissful Atman nothing remains for him to be obtained or known.
verses.wordMeaning: If one sees and realizes the non-dualistic omni- present, quiescent and blissful Atman nothing remains for him to be obtained or known.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one sees and realizes the non-dualistic omni- present, quiescent and blissful Atman nothing remains for him to be obtained or known.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यमाहूय रहसि वाससा बद्धलोचनम् । कारयित्वा प्रणामानां साष्टाङ्गानां त्रयं गुरुः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyamāhūya rahasi vāsasā baddhalocanam / kārayitvā praṇāmānāṃ sāṣṭāṅgānāṃ trayaṃ guruḥ
verses.translation: The worship connected with daily routine of holy rites should be performed during the day. The worship con- nected with the Naimittika (needed for a particular situation) rites should be performed at night. The performance of rites is a K&mya Karma (performance of acts for achieving desires). This is the conclusion arrived at in scriptures.
verses.wordMeaning: The worship connected with daily routine of holy rites should be performed during the day. The worship con- nected with the Naimittika (needed for a particular situation) rites should be performed at night.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The worship connected with daily routine of holy rites should be performed during the day. The worship con- nected with the Naimittika (needed for a particular situation) rites should be performed at night.…

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पाणि तत्करे दत्त्वा कारये त्कुसुमाञ्जलिम् । श्रीनाथकरुणाराशे परञ्ज्योतिर्मयेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: puṣpāṇi tatkare dattvā kāraye tkusumāñjalim / śrīnāthakaruṇārāśe parañjyotirmayeśvari
verses.translation: Whatever comes out of the mouth of the preceptor is called S&stra (scripture). Even if it is forbidden (in Sastra) one should carry it out. One should not transgress the com- mands of the preceptor.
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever comes out of the mouth of the preceptor is called S&stra (scripture). Even if it is forbidden (in Sastra) one should carry it out. One should not transgress the com- mands of the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसूनाञ्जलिरेषा ते निक्षिप्ता चरणांबुजे । परं धाम परं ब्रह्म मम त्वं परदेवता
verses.transliteration: prasūnāñjalireṣā te nikṣiptā caraṇāṃbuje / paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahma mama tvaṃ paradevatā
verses.translation: Even if one hails from a high caste, even if one possesses great learning and is endowed with wealth, one should, after seeing the preceptor from a distance, joyously prostrate one's self before him once and circumambulate him three times.
verses.wordMeaning: Even if one hails from a high caste, even if one possesses great learning and is endowed with wealth, one should, after seeing the preceptor from a distance, joyously prostrate one's self before him once and circumambulate him three times.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति मे पुत्रान्रक्ष मां शारणागतम् । इत्युक्त्वा गुरुपादाव्जे शिष्यो मूर्ध्नि विधारयेत्
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti me putrānrakṣa māṃ śāraṇāgatam / ityuktvā gurupādāvje śiṣyo mūrdhni vidhārayet
verses.translation: One should bow down to everyone whether a deity or a blade of grass regarding that it is the preceptor him-
verses.wordMeaning: One should bow down to everyone whether a deity or a blade of grass regarding that it is the preceptor him-

verses.sanskrit: जन्मान्तर सुकृतत्वं स्यान्न्यस्ते शिरसि पादुके । गुरुणा कमलासनमुरशासनपुरशासनसेवया लब्धे
verses.transliteration: janmāntara sukṛtatvaṃ syānnyaste śirasi pāduke / guruṇā kamalāsanamuraśāsanapuraśāsanasevayā labdhe
verses.translation: (The following are sinful activities causing people to become Brahmaraksasas (demoniac Brahmanas, Brahminical demons). If one speaks in contempt of the preceptor or address- es him by base terms, if one defeats a Brahmana in arguments or if one reveals secret scriptural tenets or makes them public, one shall become a Brahmaraksasa.
verses.wordMeaning: (The following are sinful activities causing people to become Brahmaraksasas (demoniac Brahmanas, Brahminical demons). If one speaks in contempt of the preceptor or address- es him by base terms,…

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भक्तिभरितः पुनरुत्थाय शान्तिमान् । वामपार्श्वे गुरोस्तिष्ठेदमानी विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhaktibharitaḥ punarutthāya śāntimān / vāmapārśve gurostiṣṭhedamānī vinayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: One shall continuously entertain non-dualistic conception, but no non-dualistic feeling in regard to the pre- ceptor. One should not censure other people's religious cults or principles nor the Vedas, nor the scriptural texts nor the gamas (philosophical treatises).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुंबीजलैः प्रोक्ष्य वामभागे निवेदयेत् । विमुच्य नेत्रबन्धं तु दर्शयेदर्चनक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tatastuṃbījalaiḥ prokṣya vāmabhāge nivedayet / vimucya netrabandhaṃ tu darśayedarcanakramam
verses.translation: If the disciple stays in the same village as the preceptor, he should pay ( personal) obeisance to the precep- tor during the three Sandhyas (dawn, midday and dusk). If he stays about 3 Kilometres, (Kms) away he shall devoutly bow down to the preceptor once every day.

verses.sanskrit: सितामध्वाज्यकदलीफलपायसरूपकम् । महात्रिपुरसुन्दर्या नैवेद्यमिति चादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: sitāmadhvājyakadalīphalapāyasarūpakam / mahātripurasundaryā naivedyamiti cādiśet
verses.translation: One should never approach a king, a deity or the preceptor with empty hands. He should offer fruits, flowers, garments etc. in accordance with his, capacity.
verses.wordMeaning: One should never approach a king, a deity or the preceptor with empty hands. He should offer fruits, flowers, garments etc. in accordance with his, capacity.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशर्णमनुं तस्य वदेद्वामश्रुतौ शनैः । ततो बहिर्विनिर्गत्य स्थाप्य दार्वासने शुचिम्
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśarṇamanuṃ tasya vadedvāmaśrutau śanaiḥ / tato bahirvinirgatya sthāpya dārvāsane śucim
verses.translation: (A preceptor) is personally Supreme Siva (Para Siva) himself encased in human skin. He wanders over the Earth in- cognito in order to bless a good disciple.
verses.wordMeaning: (A preceptor) is personally Supreme Siva (Para Siva) himself encased in human skin. He wanders over the Earth in- cognito in order to bless a good disciple.

verses.transliteration: niveśya prāṅmukhaṃ tatra paṭṭavastrasamāstṛte / śiṣyaṃ śrīkumbhasalilairabhiṣiñcetsamantrakam
verses.translation: Like the blind men who do not see the rising sun, only those devoid of good luck do not see Sriguru who has the splendour of the greatest principle and who stands before your very eyes in the same manner.
verses.wordMeaning: Like the blind men who do not see the rising sun, only those devoid of good luck do not see Sriguru who has the splendour of the greatest principle and who stands before your very eyes in the same manner.

verses.translation: If one cannot afford, one should always worship Ambika with articles mentally conceived and imagined. A householder shall worship Mahadevi with the full equipment of auspicious conduct and accompanied by his wife favourably disposed towards him.
